english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
translation: Nomba Abafilisiti basansa abena Israeli, na bena Israeli babutuka ukufuma ku cinso ca Bafilisiti elyo na bengi babepaila pa lupili lwa Giliboa.

english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
translation: Babika ifyanso fyakwe mwitempele lya milungu yabo, elyo baya kobeka umutwe wakwe mwitempele lya mulungu wabo Dagoni.

english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation: Ilyo abekalacalo ba mu Yabeshi Gileadi baumfwa fyonse ifyo Abafilisiti bacita kuli Saulo,

english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
translation: abaume babo bonse ababulamba baima, baya senda ifitumbi fyakwa Saulo na bana bakwe, bafileta ku Yabeshi. Elyo bashiika amafupa yabo mwisamba lya cimuti cikalamba ica oki mu Yabeshi, bafunga ukulya pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
translation: Saulo afwile pa mulandu wakukanaba ne cishinka kuli Yawe. Alifililwe ukubaka ishiwi lyakwa Yawe elyo asukile afika na mukuya ipusha imipashi ukuti imutungulule.

english: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
translation: Afililwe ukwipusha Yawe, kanshi Yawe nao epakumwipaya. Elyo asesesha no bufumu kuli Davidi mwana Yese.

english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
translation: Abafilisiti bakonka nganshi mukubutusha Saulo na bana bakwe mpaka baipaya Yonatani, Abinadabu elyo na Malikishua.

english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
translation: Ulubuli lwabipisha ukushinguluka Saulo. Elyo abaleposa imifwi bamusanga, bamucena.

english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
translation: Saulo epakweba uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe ati, “Somona ulupanga lobe umpwishishishe, pantu aba bantu abashasembululwa kuti baisa mukuncusha.”

english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
translation: Ilyo uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe amona ukuti Saulo afwa, nao abuula ulupanga lwakwe epo awila aitungako afwa.

english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
translation: Kanshi Saulo na bana bakwe batatu efyo bafwile, pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwe bonse.

english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli abali mwishika bamona ukuti abashilika babutuka elyo Saulo na bana bakwe bafwa, awe nabo basha imishi yabo babutuka. Elyo Abafilisiti emo baisa ikala.

english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, ilyo Abafilisiti baishile mukutapa ifintu ku bafwile, baisa sanga Saulo na bana bakwe nabafwa pa lupili lwa Giliboa.

english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
translation: Bamufuula elyo bamuputulako umutwe, basenda pamo ne fyanso fyakwe, elyo batuma bakabilo mu calo conse ica Bafilisiti mukuma imbila ku tulubi twabo na ku bantu bonse.

english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli balongene bonse pamo kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni no kutila, “Ifwe tuli munofu obe kabili umulopa obe.

english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.
translation: Aba ebali abakalamba ba mpalume shabulwi shakwa Davidi abo akwete. Aba bene pamo na bena Israeli bonse abapeele icikoseleshi icikalamba ku bufumu bwakwe, no kulenga ubufumu bukumane mu calo conse nge shiwi Yawe alaile.

english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
translation: Kanshi impalume shabulwi shakwa Davidi ni ishi:

english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
translation: Uwamukonkelepo ni Eleasa umwana wakwa Dodo, umwina Ahoyi umo pa mpalume shabulwi shitatu.

english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
translation: Ali pamo na Davidi pa Pasi Damimu ilyo Abafilisiti balongene mukulwa. Pa ncende apali ibala umwaiswile bale epo abashilika bafulumwike ukufuma ku Bafilisiti.

english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
translation: Lelo baya iminina mukati ke bala, balicingilila elyo baipaya na Bafilisiti, kabili Yawe abapeele ukucimfya ukukalamba.

english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Batatu pa ba makumi yatatu (30) abaletungulula abashilika, batentemwike baisa ku cilibwe kuli Davidi ku lucengo lwa Adulamu. Elyo ibumba lya Bafilisiti lyalongene mwishika lya Refaimu.

english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
translation: Pali ilya nshita Davidi ali mwilinga elyo akamba ka bashilika ba Bafilisiti kali mu Betelemu.

english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
translation: Davidi alefwaisha amenshi elyo alanda ati, “Iye, nga kuti umo andetelako amenshi yakunwa ukufuma ku cishima icaba mupepi ne mpongolo ya ku Betelemu!”

english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
translation: Kanshi balya batatu epakupula mu mipaka ya Bafilisiti, no kuya tapa amenshi ukufuma mu cishima icali pa mpongolo ya ku Betelemu, baleta na kuli Davidi. Lelo ena akaana ukuti anwe aya menshi. Mu cifulo cakunwa Davidi ayetila ukuba umutuulo pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
translation: Elyo asosa ati, “Lesa akaanye ukuti ine ncite ici cintu. Bushe kuti nanwa umulopa wa aba bantu uo bacishitikilapo ubumi bwabo?” Pantu bacishitika ubumi bwabo pakuya yaleta. Kanshi Davidi epakukana ukunwa. Ifi efyabombele ishi mpalume shabulwi shitatu.

english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
translation: Ku nshita iyapita, nelyofye Saulo acili mfumu, niwe watungulwile Israeli mu nshita shabulwi. Kabili Yawe Lesa obe asosele kuli iwe ati, ‘Uli nokucema abantu bandi abena Israeli, kabili ukaba kateeka wabo.’”

english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
translation: Abishai munyina kwa Yoabu ewali umukalamba pali ishi shitatu . Ewaimishe ifumo lyakwe pa balwani imyanda itatu (300), abepaya. Elyo aisa ba ne shina ilyalumbuka nga aba bene batatu.

english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
translation: Abap 1:21

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
translation: Benaya umwana wakwa Yehoiyada umwina Kabiseli ali umwaume wine wine mukulwa, uwabombele ifintu ifingi nganshi. Aipeye amalamba ya baume babili abena Moabu. Kabili aya ingila mu cilindi, ninshi kuli na menshi makasa, aipayamo inkalamo.

english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
translation: Elyo aipaya no mwina Egupto uwalepele bamita babili na citika . Nangu umwina Egupto akwete ifumo mu minwe yakwe ilyali nge cimuti cakupikwilako insalu, Benaya amulungeme ne nkonto, apokolola ifumo ukufuma mu minwe ya mwina Egupto no kumwipaila kwifumo lyakwe line.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
translation: Ifi efyabombele Benaya mwana Yehoiyada. Nao wine ali no lulumbi nge mpalume shabulwi shitatu.

english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
translation: Apeelwe umucinshi uukalamba nganshi ukucila na pa baume bene bene amakumi yatatu (30) abaletungulula abashilika, lelo tapendelwe pali shilya shitatu. Awe Davidi epakumubika ukuba kangalila wa bakumulinda.

english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
translation: Impalume shabulwi shali ni ishi.

english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
translation: Shamoti umwina Harori,

english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
translation: Ira umwana mwaume wakwa Ikeshi uwa ku Tekoa,

english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
translation: Sibekai umwina Hushati,

english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
translation: Ilyo abakalamba bonse aba bena Israeli baisa ku Hebuloni, elyo Davidi apanga nabo icipangano ku Hebuloni pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Elyo basubile Davidi amafuta yakuba imfumu ya bena Israeli, ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyasoselwe muli Samwele.

english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
translation: Maharayi umwina Netofa,

english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
translation: Itai umwana mwaume wakwa Ribai uwa ku Gibea muli Benjamini.

english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
translation: Hurai uwa ku tumimana twa Gaashi,

english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
translation: Asimafeti umwina Baharumi,

english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
translation: abana baume bakwa Hashemu umwina Gisoni,

english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
translation: Ahiamu umwana mwaume wakwa Sakari umwina Harari,

english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
translation: Hefa umwina Makerati,

english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
translation: Hesiro umwina Kameli,

english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
translation: Yoeli munyina wakwa Natani,

english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
translation: Seleki umwina Amoni,

english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
translation: Davidi na bena Israeli bonse baimine no kuya ku Yerusalemu, uko batila Yebusi. Abena Yebusi ebaleikala kulya.

english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
translation: Ira umwina Itira,

english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
translation: Uria umwina Hiti,

english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
translation: Adina mwana Shisa umwina Rubeni uwali umukalamba wa bena Rubeni elyo na ba makumi yatatu (30) abo ali nabo,

english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
translation: Hanani mwana Maaka,

english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
translation: Usia umwina Ashiterati,

english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
translation: Yedieli mwana Shimuri,

english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
translation: Elieli umwina Mahafi,

english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
translation: Elieli, Obedi elyo na Yasieli umwina Mesoba.

english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
translation: Abekashi ba mu Yebusi balanda kuli Davidi abati, “Tawaingilemo muno.” Lelo Davidi apokolola ilinga lya Sioni, nomba uwitwa umusumba wakwa Davidi.

english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
translation: Davidi alandile ukuti, “Uyo onse uuletangila mukulwisha abena Yebusi euli nokuba umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo.” Yoabu mwana Seruiya uwabalilepo, efyo apeelwe no kuba umukalamba wa fita.

english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
translation: Awe Davidi epakuya ikala mukati ke linga, kabili ni pali ici lyainikilwe ishina umusumba wakwa Davidi.

english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
translation: Kabili Davidi akuulamo umusumba ukushinguluka, ukufuma ku fibumbili fyakwikasha ifikulwa ukushinta ku cibumba cashingulwike. Elyo ninshi Yoabu alepwishishisha incende yashele iya musumba.

english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.
translation: Kabili amaka yakwa Davidi yaleya yalecililakofye, pantu Yawe umwine wa fita ali nankwe.

english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
translation: Aba e baume abaishile kuli Davidi ku Sikilagi, ilyo aile belama ukufuma ku cinso cakwa Saulo mwana Kishi. Bali pebumba lya bashilika abamaka abamwafwileko mu nkondo.

english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
translation: Mishimana ewali uwabune,

english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
translation: Atai ewalenga mutanda,

english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
translation: Yohanani ewalenga cine konse konse,

english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
translation: Yeremia ewalenga ikumi limo

english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
translation: Aba abena Gadi bali abakalamba ba fita fya nkondo. Uwacepeshe alingene na bantu umwanda umo (100), no wakulishepo alingene na bantu ikana limo (1,000).

english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
translation: Ni aba bene ebayabwike umumana wa Yordani mu mweshi wakutendeka, ninshi nawisula mu ncende shonse ishauko no kuya fulumunamo abantu bonse abaleikala mu mawanga, ku kabanga elyo na ku masamba.

english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
translation: Bambi abena Benjamini na baume bambi ukufuma ku Yuda nabo baisa kuli Davidi pa ncende yakwe iye linga.

english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
translation: Davidi afuma aya mukubakumanya no kuya beba ati, “Nga cakuti mwishile kuli ine mu mutende, mukwisa ngafwa, ine ndi uwaiteyanya ukuti tupuminkane nenu. Lelo nga cakuti mwishile mukumposa mu minwe ya balwani bandi ilyo iminwe yandi ili iyakaele ku fyabulwi, cibe ukuti Lesa wa bashifwe amone no kumupingula.”

english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
translation: Elyo umupashi waisa pali Amasai, uwali umukalamba pa ba makumi yatatu (30), elyo walanda auti,

english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
translation: Abaume bamo aba muli Manase bapatukile kuli Davidi ilyo aile na Bafilisiti mukulwisha Saulo. Lelo ena na bantu bakwe tabayafwile Abafilisiti, pantu panuma yakulandishanya bakateeka ba Bafilisiti balimutamfishe. Balandile ukuti, “Tukashitisha imitwe yesu nga cakuti apatukila kuli Saulo shikulu wakwe.”

english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
translation: Bakwete amata kabili bali abacenjela ukuposa imifwi nangu ukulasa amabwe ku kuboko kwa ku kulyo nangu ku kuso. Bali bamunyina wakwa Saulo ukufuma ku ba mu nko shakwa Benjamini.

english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
translation: Ilyo Davidi aile ku Sikilagi, kwaliko abaume bakwa Manase abapilibukile kuli ena, naba bonse ni aba: Adina, Yosabadi, Yediaeli, Mikaeli, Yosabadi, Elihu na Siletai abali intungulushi sha makana ya bena Manase.

english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
translation: Bayafwile Davidi ukulwisha abalesansa, pantu bonsefye bali abacenjela mukulwa, kabili bali abakalamba mu bashilika.

english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
translation: Ubushiku no bushiku abaume baleisa mukwafwa Davidi mpakafye akwata abashilika abengi, kwati bashilika bakwa Lesa.

english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Iyi eyali e mpendwa ya baume ababulwi kabili abaishile kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni mukwisa mwafwako ukufumya ubufumu kuli Saulo ukwisa kuli ena, ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe asosele.

english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
translation: Abana abakwa Yuda abakusenda inkwela elyo na mafumo bali amakana mutanda ne myanda cine konse konse (6,800).

english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
translation: Abana abakwa Simeoni, abamaka, impalume bali amakana cine lubali no mwanda umo (7,100).

english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
translation: Abaume aba muli Levi bali amakana yane ne myanda mutanda (4,600).

english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
translation: Kabili Yehoiyada, intungulushi ya ba mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni ali na baume amakana yatatu ne myanda cine lubali, (3,700).

english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
translation: Elyo Sadoki umulumendo, umushilika wacenjela, ali na bacilolo ukufuma mu ba mu lupwa lwakwa wishi, amakumi yabili na babili (22).

english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.
translation: Abaume aba muli Benjamini aba mu lupwa lwakwa Saulo, abashele abamupetamina ukufikafye na pali ilya ine inshita, bali amakana yatatu (3,000).

english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
translation: Uwali umukalamba ni Ahiesa elyo pakonka Yoashi, bamwana Shema umwina Gibeati, elyo Yesieli na Peleti abana bakwa Asimafeti, Beraka na Yehu abena Anatoti.

english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
translation: Abaume abena Efulemu abacenjela ukulwa, kabili abaishibikwa nganshi mu mikowa yabo, bali amakana amakumi yabili ne myanda cine konse konse (20,800).

english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
translation: Abaume abali citika wa luko lwa bena Manase, abalumbwilwe amashina kukwisa bika Davidi pa bufumu bali amakana ikumi na cine konse konse (18,000).

english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
translation: Abaume aba muli Isaka abaishibe inshita no kwishiba ifyo abena Israeli bafwile ukucita, bali imyanda ibili (200) abakalamba pamo na ba mu ndupwa shabo abo balelinda.

english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
translation: Abaume aba muli Sebuloni, abashilika abaishiba kabili abaiteyanya ukulwa inkondo mukubomfya ifyanso ifili fyonse abakwafwa Davidi ne mitima yabo yonse, bali amakana amakumi yasano (50,000).

english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
translation: Abaume aba muli Naftali bali bacilolo ikana limo (1,000), pamo na baume amakana amakumi yatatu na cine lubali (37,000), abakusenda inkwela na mafumo.

english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
translation: Abaume aba muli Dani abali abaiteyanya ku nkondo, bali amakana amakumi yabili na cine konse konse ne myanda mutanda (28,600).

english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
translation: Abaume aba muli Asheri abashilika abaishiba kabili abaiteyanya ukulwa inkondo, bali amakana amakumi yane (40,000).

english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
translation: Elyo ukufuma ku kabanga ku Yordani, abaume aba muli Rubeni, Gadi, elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, abaipekenye no musango onse uwa fyanso fyakulwilako, bali amakana umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120,000).

english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
translation: Bonse aba, bali baume ba nkondo abaipeeleshe ukubomba mu fifulo fya milimo. Ebaishile ku Hebuloni abapambana nganshi mukwisa bika Davidi pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli. Elyo na bonse abena Israeli balifye no mutima umo uwakubika Davidi pa bufumu.

english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
translation: Aba baume bali kulya inshiku shitatu pamo na Davidi, balelya no kunwa, pantu indupwa shabo shalibapekanishisheko ifyakulya.

english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
translation: Elyo ni Ishimaiya umwina Gibeoni, umwaume uwabulamba pakati ka ba makumi yatatu (30), kabili uwali ntungulushi pa ba makumi yatatu (30), Yeremia, Yahasieli, Yohanani, Yosabadi umwina Gederati,

english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
translation: Kabili abena mupalamano babo, abakufuma ku ncende shakutali pamo nga ku Isaka, Sebuloni elyo na ku Naftali, baletele ifyakulya pali bakabalwe, bapunda, ingamila ne ŋombe. Baletele ifyakulya ifingi, ubunga bwa ŋanu, amakunyu, umusangulo wa myangashi, amafuta, iŋombe elyo ne mpaanga pantu kwali ukusekelela ukukalamba nganshi mu Israeli.

english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;
translation: Elusai, Yerimoti, Bealiya, Shemariya elyo na Shefatiya umwina Harufi,

english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
translation: Elikana, Ishiya, Asareli, Yoesa elyo na Yashobeamu umwina Kora,

english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
translation: elyo Yoeli na Sebadia abana bakwa Yerohamu uwa ku Gedori.

english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
translation: Bamo abena Gadi bapatukila kuli Davidi pa ncende ye linga iyo aikelepo mu matololo. Bali abashilika abacenjela, abaiteyanya kukulwa kabili abacenjela ukubomfya inkwela ne fumo. Impumi shabo shali nge sha nkalamo elyo ku lubilo bali nge nama sha mu mpili.

english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
translation: Eseri ewali umukalamba,

english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
translation: Davidi alandishenye na bacilolo bakwe na bakalamba ba pa fita amakana (1,000) na ba pa fita imyanda (100) elyo ne ntungulushi iyili yonse.

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
translation: Lelo Yawe afulilwa nganshi Usa, amwipaya, pantu atambike ukuboko kwakwe ku Mbokoshi ya Cipangano. Afwila na palya pene pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
translation: Elyo Davidi nao afulwa pa mulandu wa cipyu cakwa Yawe pali Usa. Kabili ukufika na pali buno bushiku ilya ncende itwa ukuti ni Peresi Usa .

english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
translation: Davidi atiinine Lesa pali bulya bushiku, aipusha ati, “Bushe kuti naleta shani Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa kumwandi?”

english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
translation: Davidi afilwa ukusenda Imbokoshi ukuisunga mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Lelo asenda aya sha ku ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu umwina Gati.

english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
translation: Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa yashele ku lupwa lwakwa Obedi Edomu pa myeshi itatu mu ŋanda yakwe. Elyo Yawe apaalile iŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu ne fintu fyonse ifyo akwete.

english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba abena Israeli bonse abo alongenye ati, “Nga cakuti calolamo kuli imwe, elyo nga cakuti cili ubufwayo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wesu, natutume ishiwi kuli bamunyinefwe bonse abali ukutali na mu ncende ishasalangana mu calo conse ica Israeli, na kuli bashimapepo na bena Levi abo bali nabo mu mishi yabo ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo, bakese longana na ifwe.

english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
translation: Elyo tuye bwesha ne Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa wesu kuno tuli pantu tatwaleipushapo mu nshiku sha bufumu bwakwa Saulo.”

english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
translation: Awe abantu bonse basumina ukucita ifi, pantu calisekeshe abantu bonse.

english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakulonganika abena Israeli bonse, ukufuma ku mumana wa Shihori mu Egupto ukufika ku Lebo Hamati , kukuya senda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa ukufuma ku Kiriati Yarimu.

english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
translation: Davidi na bena Israeli bonse baya ku Baala uwaba mu Yuda ku Kiriati Yarimu mukuya senda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa iyitwa peshina lyakwa Yawe uwaikala pa kati ka bakerubi.

english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
translation: Basenda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Abinadabu peceleta ilipya, ninshi Usa na Ahio baletungulula.

english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
translation: Davidi na bena Israeli bonse balasefya na maka yabo yonse pa cinso cakwa Lesa, baleimba inyimbo balelisha amaseese, insango, insombo, imiwaya na mapenga.

english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
translation: Ilyo bafika pa lubansa lwakutwilapo ulwa ku Kidoni, Usa atambika ukuboko kukubika bwino Imbokoshi, pantu iŋombe shapene ukuwa.

english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
translation: Nomba Hiramu imfumu ya ku Turi yatumine inkombe kuli Davidi, pamo ne fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda na bakusona mabwe elyo na bakabasa wa mbao abakwisa kuula isano lyakwe.

english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipusha Lesa ati, “Bushe kuti nanina no kuya sansa Abafilisiti? Bushe kuti wabapeela mu minwe yandi?”

english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na bantu bakwe epakwima baya ku Bali Perasimu, na Davidi eko aya bacimfisha. Elyo Davidi asosa nokuti, “Ngefyo amenshi yapongoloka, Lesa napongolokela pa balwani bandi ukupitila mu kuboko kwandi.” Kanshi epakwita ilya ncende ati Baali Perasimu .

english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
translation: Abafilisiti baposele imilungu yabo kulya kwine, na Davidi apeele icipope cakuti bayoce mu mulilo.

english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
translation: Kabili Abafilisiti babwekeshepo ukusansa aba mu mukonko.

english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
translation: Elyo Davidi epakwipusha Lesa, kabili na Lesa amwasuka ati, “Wibalungama pakunina pamulu, lelo ubashinguluke elyo ubasanse ku ntanshi ya fimuti fya basamu.

english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
translation: Ilyofye uleumfwa iciunda ca nshindo pa mulu wa fimuti fya basamu, elyo uli nokuya mukulwa, pantu Lesa naima mukukutangilila, mukusansa ifita fya nkondo ifya Bafilisiti.”

english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakucita ifyo Lesa amukonkomeshe, kabili aipeye ifita fya nkondo ifya Bafilisiti, inshila yonse ukufuma ku Gibeoni ukufika ku Gesa.

english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
translation: Kanshi ululumbi lwakwa Davidi epakusalangana mpanga yonse, na Yawe alenga imishobo yonse ukulamutiina.

english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
translation: Kabili Davidi aishiba nokuti Yawe namwimika ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli, kabili nokutila ubufumu bwakwe nabusumbulwa nganshi pa mulandu wa bantu baiko abena Israeli.

english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Mu Yerusalemu Davidi aupile abakashi na bambi. Akwata na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
translation: Aya e mashina ya bana bakwe abafyelwe kuli ena mu Yerusalemu: Shamua, Shobabu, Natani, Solomoni,

english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
translation: Ibihali, Elishua, Elipeleti,

english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
translation: Noga, Nefegi, Yafiya,

english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
translation: Elishama, Beeliyada elyo na Elifeleti.

english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.
translation: Ilyo Abafilisiti baumfwile ukuti Davidi nasubwa ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli, baimine bonse mu maka ukuya balefwaya Davidi. Lelo Davidi alyumfwile pali ifi, nao aima kukuya bakumanya.

english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Nomba Abafilisiti balishile no kusansa ishika lya Refaimu.

english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
translation: Panuma Davidi apwile ukukuula ifikulwa fyakwe mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Kabili apekenye ne ncende yakwikalamo Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa, no kushimpa Itenti lyaiko.

english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
translation: Ukufuma kuba mu ndupwa shakwa Usieli ni Aminadabu uwali intungulushi ya bamunyina umwanda umo, ikumi limo na babili (112).

english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
translation: Elyo Davidi aita Sadoki na Abiyata nga bashimapepo elyo Urieli, Asaiya, Yoeli, Shemaiya, Elieli na Aminadabu nga bena Levi.

english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
translation: Abeba ati, “Nimwe ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha bena Levi, eico imwe na bamunyinenwe abena Levi muisangulule mwe bene elyo muye leta Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, ku ncende iyo mpekanishishe iyi Mbokoshi.

english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
translation: Ici cali ifi pantu imwe mwe bena Levi tamwaile buula Imbokoshi pa muku wantanshi icalengele nokuti Yawe Lesa wesu emye ubukali pali ifwe. Tatwaipwishe kuli ena ifyo twali nokucita mu nshila iyatunguluka.”

english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Kanshi bashimapepo na bena Levi epakuisangulula pakuti babe abakuya leta Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Elyo abena Levi baya senda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa, babikile ifimuti fyakupingilako pa mabeya yabo, ngefyo Mose abakonkomeshe ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
translation: Davidi aeba intungulushi sha bena Levi ukusonta bamunyinabo abakwimba inyimbo ishakusekelela, ishakwimbila pamo ne nsango, amaseese elyo ne miwaya.

english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
translation: Kanshi abena Levi epakusonta Hemani mwana Yoeli, kabili ukufuma pali bamunyina basonta Asafu mwana Berekiya, elyo ukufuma muli bamunyinabo abena Merari ni Etani mwana Kushaiya.

english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
translation: Elyo abo bali nabo ni bamunyinabo ababakonkelepo mu fifulo: Sakaria, Yaasieli, Shemiramoti, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikineya, Obedi Edom elyo na Yeyeli bakalinda wa mpongolo.

english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
translation: Abakwimba inyimbo, Hemani, Asafu na Etoni, ebali abakulisha imiwaya ya mukuba.

english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
translation: Elyo Davidi asosa ati, “Takuli nangu umbi, lelo kanofye abena Levi ebakusenda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa, pantu ebo asala ukusenda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe elyo no kubomba pa cinso cakwe umuyayaya.”

english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
translation: Sakaria, Asieli, Shemiramoti, Yehieli, Unni, Eliabu, Maaseya elyo na Benaya ebali abakulisha insango ukulingana na Alamoti.

english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
translation: Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikineiya, Obedi, Edomu, Yeli elyo na Asasiya ebali abakulisha amaseese ukutangilila ukulingana na Sheminiti .

english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
translation: Kenaniya umukalamba wa bena Levi ewaletungulula pakwimba. Iyi eyali imilimo yakwe pantu ali uwaishibisha nganshi.

english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
translation: Berekiya na Elikana ebalelinda pa mwinshi wa muputule umwali Imbokoshi ya Cipangano.

english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
translation: Shebaniya, Yoshafate, Netaneli, Amasai, Sakaria, Benaya na Eliese bashimapepo ebakulisha amapenga pa cinso ca Mbokoshi yakwa Lesa. Obedi Edomu na Yehiya nabo bene ebalelinda umwinshi wakwingilila ku Mbokoshi.

english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na bakalamba ba mu Israeli, elyo na bakalamba ba fita ikana limo (1,000) baya no kuya leta Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe, ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu abasansamuka.

english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation: Pantu Lesa alyafwile abena Levi abasendele Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, batuulile iŋombe ishilume cine lubali elyo na basukusuku cine lubali.

english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
translation: Nomba Davidi afwele umwingila wa nsalu ishapikulwa ubusaka, ngefyo cali ku bena Levi abasendele Imbokoshi elyo na bakwimba, na Kenaniya uwaletungulula bakemba wa nyimbo. Kabili Davidi afwele icakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi.

english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli bonse epakuleta Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe no tupundu ne ciunda ca ku cipuuta ca nsengo sha basukusuku na ku mapenga elyo no kulisha imiwaya, amaseese ne nsango.

english: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
translation: Cilya Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe yaba pakwingila mu musumba wakwa Davidi, Mika umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo ninshi eminine pa nsolokoto epo aletambila. Ilyo amwene uko imfumu Davidi ilecinda no kusefya, ena amususha mu mutima wakwe.

english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
translation: Davidi alonganika abena Israeli bonse mu Yerusalemu mukuya senda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe ukuleta ku ncende uko ifwile ukwikala.

english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
translation: Elyo Davidi alonganika pamo aba mu ndupwa shakwa Aroni, elyo na bena Levi.

english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
translation: Ukufuma ku ba mu ndupwa shakwa Koati ni Urieli uwali intungulushi ya bamunyina abali umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120).

english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
translation: Ukufuma ku ba mu ndupwa shakwa Merari ni Asaiya uwali intungulushi ya bamunyina abali imyanda ibili na makumi yabili (220).

english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
translation: Ukufuma ku ba mu ndupwa shakwa Geshoni ni Yoeli uwali intungulushi ya bamunyina abali umwanda umo na makumi yatatu (130).

english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
translation: Amaf 10:8

english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
translation: Ukufuma ku ba mu ndupwa shakwa Hebuloni bali ni Elieli uwali intungulushi ya bamunyina abali amakumi cine konse konse (80).

english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
translation: Awe baletele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa, baisa ibika mukati ke tenti lyakwa Lesa lintu Davidi aimike umwakwisa ifikilisha. Elyo batuula amalambo ya cakoca ne mituulo yakwampana pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
translation: Mulesekelela mwishina lyakwe ilyamushilo.

english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
translation: Mulelolesha kuli Yawe na ku maka yakwe,

english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
translation: Muleibukisha ifipeshamano ifyo acita,

english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
translation: Mwe bufyashi bwakwa Israeli umubomfi wakwa Yawe,

english: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
translation: “Ena ni Yawe, e Lesa wesu.

english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
translation: Alebukisha icipangano cakwe umuyayaya,

english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
translation: E cipangano ico apangene na Abrahamu,

english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
translation: Acifikilishepo kuli Yakobo ukuba icipope,

english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
translation: ‘Kuli iwe ine nkapeela icalo ca Kenani,

english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
translation: “Ilyo mwali abampendwa iyinono,

english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
translation: Panuma yakupwisha ukutuula amalambo ya cakoca ne mituulo yakwampana, Davidi epakupaala abantu mwishina lyakwa Yawe.

english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
translation: Abaleendauka ukufuma ku mushobo umo ukuya ku mushobo ubiye

english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
translation: Nomba Yawe tasuminishe nangu umo ukuti alebacusha,

english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
translation: Atile, ‘Kwiba uwakwikata mu basubwa bandi abo nasala,

english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
translation: “Imbileni Yawe mweba pano isonde bonse,

english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
translation: Mulesabankanya ubucindami bwakwe mu mishobo yonse,

english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
translation: Pantu Yawe alipulamisha kabili ewalinga ukulumbanya,

english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
translation: Pantu imilungu yonse iya mishobo tulubifye,

english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
translation: Ubucindami no bupulami fyaba pa cinso cakwe.

english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa bwa bulamba bwakwa Yawe mwe ndupwa sha mishobo,

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa ubwalinga ishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
translation: Elyo apeela abena Israeli bonse umwaume no mwanakashi umukate umo umo, icimamantwa ca tuncindu cimo cimo elyo ne cimamantwa ca myangashi cimo cimo.

english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
translation: Muletutuma pa cinso cakwe bonse mwe ba pano isonde.

english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
translation: Lekeni imyulu isansamuke ne sonde lisekelele,

english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
translation: Lekeni bemba afumye iciunda pamo na fyonse ifya bamo,

english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
translation: Elyo ifimuti fya mu mutengo fili nokwimba ne nsansa pa cinso cakwa Yawe,

english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: “Muletotela Yawe, pantu ena musuma,

english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
translation: Kuteni amuti, ‘Tupususheko we Lesa umupusushi wesu.

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli,

english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
translation: Davidi epakusha Asafu na bamunyina pa cinso ca Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe pakubomba imilimo yabo inshita yonse ukulingana ne fyalefwaikwa cila bushiku.

english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
translation: Kabili asha Obedi Edomu na bamunyina amakumi mutanda na cine konse konse (68) abakubomba nabo. Obedi Edomu mwana Yedutuni elyo na Hosa ebali abakulinda pa mpongolo.

english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
translation: David asha Sadoki shimapepo na bashimapepo banankwe pa cinso ce Tenti lyakwa Yawe ilyali pa ncende yakupepelamo iyo balecindika mu Gibeoni,

english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
translation: Davidi asonta bamo abena Levi ukubomba pa cinso ca Mbokoshi yakwa Yawe umulimo wakulombelako, ukutotela elyo no kulumbanya Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
translation: mukulatuula amalambo yakoca kuli Yawe pa bulambo bwakocelapo pa nshita yonse, akacelo elyo ne cungulo, ukulingana ne fyalembwa fyonse mu mafunde yakwa Yawe ayo apeele abena Israeli.

english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Abali nabo ni Hemani na Yedutuni elyo na bashala bonse abo abasalilwe elyo no kusontwa mu mashina yabo ukulapeela ukutotela kuli Yawe, “Pantu ukutemwa kwakwe kwamuyayaya.”

english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
translation: Hemani na Yedutuni ebali no mulimo wakulisha amapenga, imiwaya na fimbi ifya nyimbo shakwa Lesa. Abana bakwa Yedutuni ebalelinda pa mpongolo.

english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse basalangene, cila muntu alungama kumwakwe. Elyo Davidi abwelelamo kumwakwe mukuya paala ulupwa lwakwe.

english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
translation: Asafu ewali intungulushi, uwacibili ni Sakaria, pakonka Yoeli, Shemiramoti, Yehieli, Matitiya, Eliabu, Benaya, Obedi Edomu elyo na Yeli. Ebali abakulisha amaseese ne nsango, Asafu ewali uwakulisha imiwaya.

english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
translation: Elyo Benaya na Yahasieli bashimapepo ebali abakulisha amapenga inshita ne nshita pa ntanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa.

english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
translation: Pa bushiku bwine bulya Davidi abalilepo ukupeela Asafu na bamunyina ulu lwimbo ulwakutotela kuli Yawe ulwakuti:

english: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
translation: “Akutoteleni Yawe! Mulekuuta peshina lyakwe.

english: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
translation: Mulemwimbila, muleimba isha malumbo,

english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
translation: Nomba ilyo Davidi aikele bwino mwisano lyakwe, aeba Natani kasesema ati, “Mona ine ninjikala mwisano lya fimuti fya keda, nomba Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe ili mwitenti.”

english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.
translation: ukutulafye apo nasontele abapingushi ukuba intungulushi pa bantu bandi abena Israeli. Kabili nkacimfya na balwani bobe.

english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
translation: Inshiku shobe nga shapwa elyo ukaye ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe, nkemya aba mu bufyashi bobe ukukupyana, umo uwa pa bana bobe, kabili nkakosha ubufumu bwakwe.

english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
translation: Ena euli nokunkuulila iŋanda, kabili ndi nokukosha icipuna ca bufumu bwakwe umuyayaya.

english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
translation: Ine nkaba wishi, elyo na ena akaba umwana wandi. Kabili nshakatale mfumya ukutemwa kwandi pali ena, nga filya nafumishe ukutemwa kwandi pali ulya wapyana.

english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
translation: Nkamwimika pa milimo ya mu ŋanda yandi ne ya bufumu bwandi umuyayaya, ne cipuna ca bufumu bwakwe cikashimpwa umuyayaya.’”

english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
translation: Awe Natani epakuya sosa amashiwi aya yonse kuli Davidi no kumulondolwela ubusokololo bonse.

english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi yaingile mukati no kwikala ku cinso cakwa Yawe, yasosa aiti,

english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.
translation: Kabili kwati ifi fyacepa mu kumona kobe we Lesa, walanda na pa mulandu wa mikalile ya kuntanshi iya ŋanda ya mubomfi obe. Umwene kwati ndi umo umwaume uwacindama nganshi, we Yawe Lesa.

english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
translation: Kol 6:18

english: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
translation: We Yawe, pa mulandu wa mubomfi obe, elyo ukulingana no bufwayo bobe, wancitila ici cintu icakulisha ifi, no kulenga ubulayo bobe bwishibikwe.

english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
translation: Natani ayaswike Davidi ati, “Conse ico uli naco mu mano cita, pantu Lesa ali na iwe.”

english: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translation: Takwaba umbi uwaba nga iwe we Yawe, kabili takwaba Lesa umbi, kanofye iwe, ngefyo twayumfwila na matwi yesu.

english: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
translation: Kabili ni bani ababa nga bantu bobe abena Israeli pano isonde? Bushe kwaliba umushobo na umbi uo Lesa wabo aimine ukuya ilubwila nga bantu abakwe umwine, no kucindamika ishina lyobe? Bushe kwaliba bambi abo Lesa wabo alecitila ifipeshamano ifikulu elyo ne fyakutiinya mukutamfya imishobo ku cinso ca bantu bobe, abo walubula ukufuma ku Egupto?

english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
translation: Walengele abantu bobe abena Israeli ukuba abantu bobe umuyayaya, kabili iwe, we Yawe waisa ba Lesa wabo.

english: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
translation: “Elyo nomba we Yawe ubake pe na pe icilayo ico walaya palwa mubomfi obe pamo ne ŋanda yakwe. Cita ukulingana no kulaya kobe

english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
translation: pakuti fibelelele, elyo ne shina lyobe likabe ilyacindama umuyayaya. Elyo abantu bakatila, ‘Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wa mu Israeli, e Lesa wa bena Israeli!’ Kabili iŋanda ya mubomfi obe Davidi ili nokubelelela pa cinso cobe.

english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
translation: “Iwe, we Lesa wandi, nausokolola ku mubomfi obe ukuti uli nokumukuulila iŋanda. Eico umubomfi obe asangila ukushipa pakupepa kuli iwe.

english: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
translation: We Yawe, icine cine uli Lesa, walilaya ifintu ifi ifisuma ku mubomfi obe.

english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
translation: Nomba nacikusekesha ukupaala iŋanda ya mubomfi obe, pakuti ikabe iyakubelelela pa cinso cobe. Pantu iwe we Yawe naupaala, eico ili nokuba iyapaalwa umuyayaya.”

english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
translation: Bulya bwine ubushiku ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyaisa kuli Natani aliti,

english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
translation: “Kabiye webe umubomfi wandi Davidi auti, ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Teiwe uli nokunkuulila iŋanda iyakwikalamo.’

english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
translation: Ine nshatala njikala mu ŋanda ukutula pa bushiku nafumishe abena Israeli mu Egupto ukushinta ilelo. Ine nyendafye ukufuma pa ncende imo ukuya pa ncende imbi, ukufuma pa nsakwe imo ukuya pa ibiye.

english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
translation: Monsefye umo nyendauka na bena Israeli bonse, bushe nalitala njebapo abapingushi ba bena Israeli abo nakonkomesha ukucema abantu bandi nati, ‘Cinshi ico mushankuulila iŋanda ya fimuti fya keda?’

english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
translation: “Eico nomba, eba umubomfi wandi Davidi utile, ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, ‘Nakusendele ukufuma mu mpanga ya mulemfwe, na mukukonka umukuni wa mpaanga, kukwisa ba kateeka pa bantu bandi abena Israeli.

english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
translation: Lyonse mbafye na iwe konse uko wapitila, kabili nalipwisha abalwani bonse pa cinso cobe. Nomba ndi nokulenga ishina lyobe ukuba ilyalulumbi, kwati mashina ya bantu abacindami aba mwisonde.

english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
translation: Kabili nkapekanya incende iya bantu bandi abena Israeli, iyakuti emo nkababike pakuti bakaikwatile icifulo cabo umo bashakalebasunkanya. Abantu imbifi tabakatale ababacusha nakabili, ngefyo balecita kukutendeka,

english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
translation: Nomba panuma ya ifi fintu, Davidi alwishishe Abafilisiti no kubacimfya elyo apoka umusumba wa Gati ne mishi yonse iyaushingulwike ukufuma mu maboko ya Bafilisiti.

english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
translation: atuma umwana wakwe Hadoramu ku mfumu Davidi kukuya muposha no kumutasha pakulwisha Hadadesa no kumucimfya. Pantu kunuma Hadadesa lyonse ewalelwa na Tou. Hadoramu aletele ifyabupe ifingi ifya golide, silifa ne fya mukuba.

english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
translation: Imila 4:11-18

english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
translation: Abishai umwana wakwa Seruiya aipaya abena Edomu amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000) mwi Shika Lyamucele.

english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
translation: Elyo abika no twamba twa bashilika mu calo ca bena Edomu, elyo na bonse abena Edomu bacimba kuli Davidi. Kabili Yawe alengele Davidi ukulacimfya konse uko aile.

english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
translation: Davidi ateekele icalo ca bena Israeli conse mu mulinganya. Alecita ubupingushi ubwacishinka ku bantu bakwe bonse.

english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
translation: Sadoki mwana Ahitubi na Aimeleki mwana Abiyata bali bashimapepo. Shafisha nao ali kalemba wa milandu.

english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
translation: Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ewali intungulushi ya bena Kereti na bena Peleti. Elyo abana bakwa Davidi nabo ebali bacilolo ba mfumu.

english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
translation: Elyo Davidi acimfya abena Moabu, balamunakila, bayamba no kulasonka umusonko.

english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
translation: Kabili Davidi acimfya Hadadesa imfumu ya ku Soba, ukuya fikafye na ku Hamati, ilyo aile kukupoka icalo ukufika ku lulamba lwa mumana wa Yufurate.

english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
translation: Davidi apokolola amaceleta yakwa Hadadesa ikana limo (1,000), bakensha ba maceleta amakana cine lubali (7,000), elyo ifita fya pa makasa nafyo amakana amakumi yabili (20,000). Kabili Davidi alemanika bakabalwe ba maceleta bonse, ashapofye umwanda umo (100).

english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
translation: Ilyo abena Aramu aba ku Damasiko baishile mukwafwako Hadadesa imfumu ya ku Soba, Davidi aipayapo abashilika babo amakana amakumi yabili na makana yabili (22,000).

english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
translation: Abika utwamba twa bashilika mu calo ca bena Aramu mu Damasiko. Elyo abena Aramu bacimba kuli Davidi, bayamba no kulasonka umusonko. Yawe apeele Davidi ukucimfya konse uko aile.

english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
translation: Davidi apokolwele inkwela sha golide ishalesenda bakangalila ba fita bakwa Hadadesa no kushileta ku Yerusalemu.

english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
translation: Ukufuma ku Teba na ku Kuni , imisumba iyali iyakwa Hadadesa, Davidi asendako umukuba uwingi nganshi, uo Solomoni aishile bomfya pakupanga icakusambilamo ica mukuba, elyo inceshi ne fipe ifyalekana lekana ifya mukuba.

english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
translation: Ilyo Tou imfumu ya ku Hamati aumfwile ukuti Davidi nacimfya ifita fya nkondo fyonse ifyakwa Hadadesa imfumu ya ku Soba,

english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
translation: Panuma ya nshita iyi, Nahashi imfumu ya bena Amoni alifwile elyo umwana wakwe ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
translation: Cilya Yoabu amona ukuti kuli imilongo yabulwi kuntanshi elyo na ku numa yakwe, asalapo fimo ifita ifyacenjela nganshi mu Israeli no kufitantamika ukulungamana na bena Aramu.

english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
translation: Ifita fimbi ifyashala apeela mu maboko yakwa munyina Abishai kukufyangalila. Kabili afitantika ukulungamana na bena Amoni.

english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
translation: Elyo Yoabu asosa ati, “Nga cakuti abena Aramu bancila amaka, awe lyena uli nokwisafye mukumpokololako. Lelo nga cakuti abena Amoni bakucila amaka, elyo ndi nokwisa mukukupokololako.

english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”
translation: Natube abakosa kabili abashangila pakuti tulwileko na maka abantu besu pamo ne misumba yakwa Lesa wesu. Shi Yawe nacitepo icilewama mu menso yakwe.”

english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
translation: Kanshi Yoabu na bashilika ali nabo bafuma mukulwisha abena Aramu, awe nabo bafulumuka ukufuma pantanshi yabo.

english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
translation: Cilya abena Amoni bamona ukuti abena Aramu balafulumuka, nabo bene bafulumuka pa cinso cakwa Abishai munyina kabili baya ingila na mu musumba. Kanshi Yoabu epakubwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
translation: Panuma cilya abena Aramu bamona ukuti babacimfya ku bena Israeli, batuma inkombe shaya ita abena Aramu bonse abali kwishilya lya mumana. Elyo Shofaki umukalamba wa fita fyakwa Hadadesa ewalebatungulula.

english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
translation: Ilyo Davidi bamweba pali ifi, alonganika abena Israeli bonse bayabuka no mumana wa Yordani. Abapalamina elyo abatantika mu milongo ya bulwi kuntanshi yabo. Davidi atantamika abashilika bakwe kukukumanya abena Aramu mu bulwi, bayamba no kubalwisha.

english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
translation: Lelo abena Aramu bafulumuka pantanshi ya bena Israeli. Kabili Davidi nao epakwipaya abali pa maceleta yabo amakana cine lubali (7,000), na bashilika ba pa makasa amakana amakumi yane (40,000). Elyo aipaya na Shofaki umukalamba wa bashilika.

english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
translation: Ilyo ababomfi bakwa Hadadesa bamona ukuti babacimfya ku bena Israeli, bapanga umutende na Davidi bayamba no kumubombela. Kanshi abena Aramu tabafwaile ukwafwa abena Amoni nakabili.

english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
translation: Davidi atontonkanya ati, “Kanange uluse kuli Hanuni umwana wakwa Nahashi, pantu wishi alilangile uluse kuli ine.” Kanshi Davidi epakutuma inkombe kuli Hanuni kukulanga icililishi cakuloosha wishi. Ilyo inkombe shakwa Davidi shafikile kuli Hanuni mu calo ca bena Amoni mukuyaloosha,

english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
translation: bacilolo ba bena Amoni basosa kuli Hanuni abati, “Bushe muletontonkanya ukuti Davidi alecindika wiso mukutuma abantu bakwe kuli imwe mukulanga icililishi cakuloosha? Bushe aba bantu bakwe tabeshilefye mukulengula na mukufwailisha icalo kukuconaula?”

english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
translation: Kanshi Hanuni epakwikata abantu bakwa Davidi, ababeya, aputula na malaya yabo pakati pa matako no kubabweseshamo.

english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
translation: Ilyo umuntu umo aishile eba Davidi pa fyacitike kuli aba bantu, atuma inkombe shakuya bakumanya, pantu balibasebenye nganshi. Imfumu epakusosa aiti, “Ikalenifye ku Yeriko mpaka imyefu yenu ikamene, elyo mukabwele.”

english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
translation: Ilyo abena Amoni bailwike ukuti naba lufyanya kuli Davidi, Hanani na bena Amoni batuma indalama amatalanta ikana limo (1,000) isha silifa ishakwashimina amaceleta elyo na bakensha wa maceleta ukufuma kuli Aramu Naharaimu, Aramu Maaka elyo na Soba.

english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
translation: Bayashima amaceleta amakana amakumi yatatu na yabili (32,000) na bakensha wayako, pamo pene ne mfumu ya ku Maaka na bashilika baiko, baisa cita inkambi mupepi na ku Medeba. Elyo abena Amoni nabo bafuma mu mishi yabo balongana no kwisa mukulwa.

english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
translation: Ilyo Davidi aumfwa ifi, Davidi atumako Yoabu ne fita fyonse ifya baume babulwi ababulamba.

english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
translation: Elyo abena Amoni bafuma baisa tantama mu mpuka shakulwilamo pa mpongolo yakwingilila mu musumba wabo, ninshi imfumu ishaishile shilifye sheka mu mpanga pa lwalala.

english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
translation: Adamu, Seti, Enoshi,

english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
translation: Kushi ewali wishi wakwa Nimurodi. Aisa ba ipaka lyantanshi pano isonde.

english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation: Misraimu ewali wishi wa bena Ludi, abena Anamu, abena Lehabu elyo na bena Nafutu,

english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
translation: abena Patulusi, abena Kaselu, ukwatuntuka Abafilisiti, elyo na bena Kafuto.

english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
translation: Kenani ewali wishi wakwa Sidoni ibeli lyakwe elyo na bena Hiti,

english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
translation: abena Yebusi, abena Amoli, abena Girigashi,

english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
translation: abena Hifi, abena Aki, abena Sini,

english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
translation: abena Afadi, abena Semari elyo na bena Hamati.

english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
translation: Abana bakwa Shemu ni Elamu, Ashuri, Afakisadi, Ludi elyo na Aramu. Abana bakwa Aramu ni Usi, Huli, Geteri elyo na Mesheki.

english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
translation: Afakisadi ewali wishi wakwa Shela, elyo Shela nao ewali wishi wakwa Eberi.

english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
translation: Elyo kuli Eberi kwafyelwe abana babili, umo ishina lyakwe ni Pelegi , pantu ni mu nshiku shakwe emo isonde lyayakanikwe. Elyo ne shina lyakwa munyina ali ni Yokitani.

english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
translation: Kenani, Mahalaleli, Yarede,

english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
translation: Yokitani ewali wishi wakwa Alimodadi, Shelefi, Hasarimafeti elyo na Yera,

english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
translation: Hadoramu, Usali, Dikila,

english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
translation: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,

english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
translation: Ofiri, Hafila elyo na Yobabu. Bonse aba bali abana bakwa Yokitani.

english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
translation: Shemu, Afakisadi, Shela,

english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
translation: Eberi, Pelegi, Reu,

english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
translation: Serugi, Naho, Tera,

english: Abram (also called Abraham).
translation: elyo na Abramu (uwitwa Abrahamu).

english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
translation: Abana bakwa Abrahamu ni Isaki elyo na Ishimaeli.

english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
translation: Aba ebali e ba mu lupwa lwabo: Nebaiyoti ewali ibeli lyakwa Ishimaeli, elyo na Keda, Adibeli, Mibisamu,

english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
translation: Enoki, Metusela, Lameki, Noa.

english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
translation: Mishima, Duma, Masa, Hadadi, Tema,

english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
translation: Yetu, Nafishi elyo na Kedema. Aba ebali abana bakwa Ishimaeli.

english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
translation: Abana abafyelwe kuli Ketura, umukashi uushaupilwe mu bwinga uwakwa Abrahamu , ni Simurani, Yokishani, Medani, Midiani, Ishibaki elyo na Shua.

english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
translation: Abana bakwa Midiani ni Efah, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida elyo na Eluda.

english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
translation: Abrahamu ewali wishi wakwa Isaki. Abana bakwa Isaki ni Esau elyo na Israeli.

english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation: Abana abaume bakwa Esau ni Elifasi, Reueli, Yeushi, Yalamu elyo na Kora.

english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
translation: Elyo abana bakwa Elifasi bali ni Temani, Oma, Sefo, Gatamu, elyo na Kenasi. Muli Timuna afyelemo Amaleki.

english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
translation: Abana bakwa Reueli ni Nahati, Sera, Shamaya elyo na Misa.

english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation: Abana bakwa Seiri ni Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ane, Dishoni, Eseri, elyo na Dishani.

english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
translation: Abana bakwa Lotani ni Hori na Homamu. Timuna ali ni nkashi yakwa Lotani.

english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translation: Abana bakwa Noa ni Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.

english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
translation: Abana bakwa Shobali ni Alifani, Manaati, Ebali, Shefo, elyo na Onamu.

english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation: Umwana wakwa Ane ni Dishoni.

english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Eseri ni Biluani, Safani elyo na Akani.

english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
translation: Kabili ishi e mfumu ishateekelepo mu calo ca Edomu lintu mu Israeli tamulati mube imfumu nangu imo.

english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
translation: Panuma ilyo Bela afwile, Yobabu mwana Sera uwafumine ku Bosira ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Yobabu afwile, Hushamu uwafumine ku calo ca bena Temani ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
translation: Ilyo Hushamu afwile, Hadadi mwana Bedadi uwacimfishe abena Midiani mu calo ca Moabu ewamupyene pa bufumu. Ainike umusumba wakwe ishina lya Afiti.

english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Hadadi afwile, Samula uwafumine ku Masireka ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Samula afwile, Shauli uwafumine ku Rehoboti umusumba uwali pa mumana ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Shauli afwile, Bali Hanani mwana Akibo ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
translation: Bamwana Yafeti abaume bali Gomeri, Magogi, Madai, Yafani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.
