english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
translation: Ilyo Bali Hanani afwile, Hadadi ewamupyene pa bufumu. Ainike umusumba wakwe ishina lya Pai kabili ishina lya mukashi wakwe ali ni Metabeli umwana wakwa Matiredi, kabili umwishikulu wakwa Mesabu.

english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
translation: Hadadi nao alifwile.

english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
translation: Olibama, Elaya, Pinoni,

english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
translation: Kenasi, Temani, Mibisa,

english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
translation: Magidieli elyo na Iramu. Ishi eshali imfumu sha mu Edomu.

english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Gomeri ni Ashikenasi, Rifati na Togalima.

english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Yafani ni Elisha, Tashishi, abena Kitimu elyo na bena Rodanimu.

english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Hamu ni Kushi, Misraimu, Puti elyo na Kenani.

english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Kushi bali ni Seba, Hafila, Sabuta, Rama elyo na Sabuteka.

english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
translation: Kabili pakwaluka kwa mwaka pa nshita ilya mfumu shifuma ukuya ku nkondo, Yoabu elyo afumishe ifita aya kukonaula icalo ca bena Amoni. Kabili aile ku Raba no kuya cipokolola. Lelo Davidi ena, ashele mu Yerusalemu. Elyo Yoabu aya sansa Raba no kuonaula.

english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
translation: Davidi abuula ne cisote cabufumu ukufuma ku mutwe wa mfumu yabo. Ukufina kwaciko kwali italanta lya golide limo , kabili mukati mwali no tumabwe utwauma umutengo. Baisa cibika pa mutwe wakwa Davidi. Kabili abuula ifitapwa ifingi nganshi ukufuma mu musumba.

english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo afumya abantu abali mu musumba, abatwala kukubomba imilimo yakubomfya ifyakuputwilako imbao, bancinde elyo na masembe. Kanshi Davidi acitile ifi fine na ku misumba yonse iya bena Amoni. Elyo Davidi ne fita fyakwe fyonse babwelela ku Yerusalemu.

english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
translation: Nomba umuyila inshiku, paimine inkondo na Abafilisiti ku musumba wabo ku Gesa. Napali ilya ine nshita Sibekai umwina Hushati aipaya Sipai, umo uwali mu lupwa lwakwa Refa, icalengele na Abafilisiti ukucimba.

english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
translation: Mukulwa inkondo na imbi na Abafilisiti, Elianani mwana Yairi aipaya Lami munyina kwa Goliati umwina Gati, uwakwete ifumo ilyali no musako kwati mulando wa bapikula insalu.

english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
translation: Nakabili ku bulwi na bumbi ubwacitike ku cifulo ca Gati, kwaliko icimuntu icalunduka nganshi. Cali ne minwe mutanda kuli cila cisansa, kabili cali ne fikondo mutanda kuli cila lukasa, fyonse pamo fyali amakumi yabili na fine (24). Nao wine ali uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Rafa.

english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
translation: Kanshi ilyo ena asebenye abena Israeli, Yonatani mwana Shimea, munyina kwa Davidi ewamwipeye.

english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
translation: Aba ebali aba mu lupwa lwakwa Rafa mu Gati, kabili bonse bafwile ku minwe yakwa Davidi na ku minwe ya bantu bakwe.

english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.
translation: Nomba Satana aimine abena Israeli no kutunka Davidi ukuti apende abena Israeli.

english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
translation: “Kabiye kebe Davidi auti, ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Nalakupeela ifya kusalapo fitatu. Salapo cimo ico ulefwaya, ico mfwile ukucita kuli iwe.’”

english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:
translation: Kanshi Gadi epakuya kuli Davidi no kumweba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Isalile we mwine,

english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”
translation: napamo imyaka itatu iya cipowe, nangu imyeshi itatu iyakonaulwa ku balwani bobe ilyo ulupanga lwabo lukakusanga, nangu inshiku shitatu ku lupanga lwakwa Yawe, nangu inshiku isha cikuko mu calo, ilyo malaika wakwa Yawe alepitamo mukonaula incende shonse isha mu Israeli. Nomba iwe tontonkanya ifyo ndeya eba uuntumine.’”

english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”
translation: Elyo Davidi ayasuka Gadi ati, “Awe kwena ndi uwacucutika nganshi. Kanshi ndekenifye mponene mu minwe yakwa Yawe, pantu uluse lwakwe lukalamba nganshi. Lelo mwileka mponene mu minwe ya bantunse.”

english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakutuma icikuko pa bena Israeli na bantu abaume amakana cine lubali (70,000) bafwa.

english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
translation: Elyo Lesa atuma malaika mukonaula Yerusalemu. Ilyo malaika aleonaula, Yawe amonako no kumfwa bulanda pa mulandu wa cikuko, elyo aeba malaika uwaleonaula ati, “Capwa! Bwesha ukuboko kobe.” Malaika wakwa Yawe ninshi eminine pa lubansa lwakutwilapo ulwakwa Arauna umwina Yebusi.

english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
translation: Davidi ainwina amenso mu mulu elyo amona malaika wakwa Yawe naiminina pakati ka mulu ne sonde, ninshi napambula ulupanga mu minwe yakwe pa musumba wa Yerusalemu. Elyo Davidi na bakalamba bafwala insalu shabulanda bawa panshi ubukupeme.

english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
translation: Davidi nao asosa kuli Lesa ati, “Bushe teine wapeele ifunde lyakupenda abaume babulwi? Ninefye ncitile icabubifi no kulufyanya. Aba bonse bena ni mpaangafye. Ni finshi bacitile? We Yawe Lesa wandi, uleke ukuboko kobe kuponene pali ine na ba ŋanda yandi, lelo wileka ici cibe pa bantu bobe.”

english: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe apeele Gadi icipope cakweba Davidi ukwima no kuya kuula ubulambo bwakwa Yawe pa lubansa lwakutwilapo ulwakwa Arauna umwina Yebusi.

english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakuya mukumfwila ishiwi ilyo Gadi asosele mwishina lyakwa Yawe.

english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakweba Yoabu na bakalamba ba fita fyankondo ati, “Kabiyeni, kapendeni abena Israeli ukufuma ku Beresheba ukufika ku Dani. Mwise munjebe pakuti njise njishibe ifyo bali.”

english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
translation: Ilyo Arauna acili aletwa iŋanu, ati apilibuke amona malaika. Na bana bakwe abaume abo ali nabo bafumapo baya belama.

english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
translation: Lintu Davidi apalama, elyo Arauna alolesha no kumumona, afuma apo aletwila no kuya kontama pa cinso cakwa Davidi, ashimpa ne mpumi panshi.

english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba Arauna ati, “Mpeela ulo lubansa lobe ulwakutwilapo pakuti nkuulepo ubulambo bwakwa Yawe, pakuti icikuko icili pa bantu cipwe. Nshitisha pa mutengo uutuntulu.”

english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
translation: Lelo Arauna aeba Davidi ati, “Buulafye we mwine, leka shikulu imfumu yandi icite icili conse icalaiwamina ku menso yaiko. Moneni, nalapeela iŋombe ishe lambo lyakoca, imilando yakutwilako eyo ibe inkuni elyo ne ŋanu sha mutuulo wa cabunga. Awe nalapeela fyonse.”

english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
translation: Lelo imfumu Davidi yayasuka Arauna aiti, “Iyo, ine ndefwayafye ukulipila umutengo uutuntulu. Pantu nshilefwaya ukutwalila Yawe ifintu fyobe, nangu ukutuula ilambo lyakoca ilyo nshiposelepo nangu cimo.”

english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakulipila Arauna indalama amashekeli imyanda mutanda (600) isha golide pali ilya ncende.

english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
translation: Palya pene epo Davidi akuula ubulambo bwakwa Yawe, atuula na malambo yakoca na malambo yakwampana. Elyo Davidi apepa na kuli Yawe, na Yawe amwasuka, no mulilo wafuma ku mulu ukwisa pa bulambo bwa mutuulo wakoca.

english: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba malaika, nao abweseshe ulupanga mu citubo.

english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, ilyo Davidi amona ukuti Yawe amwasuka pa lubansa lwakutwilapo lwakwa Arauna umwina Yebusi, awe atuulilapo na malambo.

english: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
translation: Itenti lyakwa Yawe, lilya Mose apangile mu matololo, elyo no bulambo bwakocelapo pali ilya nshita fyali pa ncende yakupepelapo iyo balecindika ku Gibeoni.

english: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
translation: Elyo Yoabu ayasuka imfumu ati, “Nacibe ukuti Yawe asandulule ubwingi bwa bashilika imiku umwanda umo (100) ukucila ifyo bali. Lelo, mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, bushe bonse aba te babomfi ba mfumu? Cinshi kanshi calenga ukuti shikulu acite icintu ca musango uyu? Mulandu nshi uwalenga alete umulandu pali Israeli?”

english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.
translation: Lelo Davidi alifililwe ukuya pantanshi ye Tenti kukwipusha kuli Lesa, pantu atiinine ulupanga lwakwa malaika wakwa Yawe.

english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
translation: Lelo icebo ca mfumu capula pa cebo cakwa Yoabu. Kanshi Yoabu epakwima no kupitana mu calo conse ica Israeli no kubwelulukila ku Yerusalemu.

english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
translation: Elyo Yoabu aisa sosa impendwa ya bashilika kuli Davidi. Mu calo conse ica Israeli mwali umuntapendwa umo na makana umwanda umo (1,100,000) abaume abengabomfya ulupanga pakulwa, ukulundapo na bambi amakana imyanda ine na makumi cine lubali (470,000) abali mu Yuda.

english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
translation: Lelo Yoabu tasanshisheko abena Levi na bena Benjamini pakupenda, pa mulandu wakuti ifunde lyapeele imfumu talyali lyakusekesha Yoabu.

english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.
translation: Ili line ifunde lyali ilyabubifi pa cinso cakwa Lesa, nao epakukanda Israeli.

english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
translation: Elyo Davidi asosa kuli Lesa ati, “Ine nimbifya apakalamba paco ncitile. Nomba kanshi, nakupapata, fumya umulandu uyu pa mubomfi obe, pantu nincita icintu icabulamo amano nganshi.”

english: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Gadi kamona wakwa Davidi ati,

english: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atile, “Iŋanda yakwa Yawe Lesa ili nokuba pano, pamo no bulambo bwakocela ubwa bena Israeli.”

english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
translation: Ni ena, euli nokukuula iŋanda ye shina lyandi. Ali nokuba umwana wandi, na ine ndi nokuba wishi. Kabili ndi nokwimika ubufumu bwakwe pa bena Israeli umuyayaya.’

english: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
translation: “Eico we mwana wandi, shi Yawe engalaba na iwe. Kabili ukashuke pakuti ukakuule iŋanda yakwa Yawe Lesa obe, pamo ngefyo asosele pali iwe.

english: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.
translation: Shi Yawe engakupeela amano no kwiluka, ilyo akakubika pa cipuna ca bena Israeli, pakuti ukabe uwakusunga amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa obe.

english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
translation: Elyo uli nokukwata ishuko, nga cakuti watekanya mukubaka ifipope na mafunde ifyo Yawe apeele Mose ifya bena Israeli. Ube uwashuka kabili uwashipa. Wikwata mwenso nangu ukunenuka.

english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
translation: “Nimomba no mukoosha nganshi pakupekanya ifyakukuulila iŋanda yakwa Yawe amatalanta amakana umwanda umo (100,000) uwa golide, na matalanta umuntapendwa umo uwa silifa (1,000,000) , imipili ya mukuba ne fyela ukufina kwafiko ukushingapimwa, elyo imilando na mabwe. Na iwe kuti walundapo.

english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;
translation: Naukwata ababomfi abengi bakabasa wa mabwe, abaishiba ukukuula ku mabwe na baishiba kubasa imbao. Elyo naukwata na bantu bambi abaishiba imilimo abashingapendwa, abacenjela mu milimo iyalekana lekana

english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”
translation: iya muli golide, silifa, umukuba ne fyela. Eico ima, tampako ukubomba Yawe nao aleba na iwe.”

english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
translation: Elyo Davidi apeele cipope ku bakalamba bonse aba mu Israeli ukwafwa umwana wakwe Solomoni.

english: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.
translation: Abeba ati, “Bushe Yawe Lesa wenu tali na imwe? Kabili bushe tamupeele ukutuusha ku mbali shonse? Pantu nabuula abekalacalo bonse nampeela, elyo ne calo nacipeelwa mu minwe yakwa Yawe na ku bantu bakwe.

english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”
translation: Nomba bikeni umutima wenu na mano yenu mukufwaya Yawe Lesa wenu, pakuti mukalete Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe elyo ne fipe fyamushilo ifyakwa Lesa mu ŋanda iyili nokukuulwa mwishina lyakwa Yawe.”

english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakupeela icipope cakulonganika abenafyalo bonse abaleikala mu Israeli. Elyo pakati kabo asontapo abakutoba amabwe pakuti balepekanya amabwe ayabaswa bwino ayakukuulila Iŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,
translation: Elyo Davidi apekanya ifyela ifingi ifyakupangamo imisomali iyakupangilako ifiibi fya pa mpongolo ne fyakwikatanya ifimiti, pamo no mukuba uushingapimwa.

english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
translation: Kabili apekanya na imbi imilando ya fimuti fya keda imintapendwa, pantu abena Sidoni na bena Turi baliletele impendwa iyingi nganshi iya milando kuli Davidi.

english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
translation: Davidi asosa ati, “Umwana wandi Solomoni mwaice kabili muteku, elyo ne ŋanda ali nokukuula iyakwa Yawe ili nokuba iyacindama mu menso ya mishobo yonse. Eico nalapekanya ifyakubomfya.” Kanshi Davidi epakupekanya ifintu ifingi ilyo talafwa.

english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Elyo aita umwana wakwe Solomoni no kumupeela umulimo wakukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.
translation: Davidi aeba Solomoni ati,

english: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
translation: Lelo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti, ‘Walisumya umulopa uwingi no kulwa inkondo ishingi. Tauli nakukuula iŋanda iye shina lyandi, pantu walisumya umulopa uwingi pano isonde mu menso yandi.

english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
translation: Lelo uli nokukwata umwana uukaba umuntu uwamutende. Kabili nkamulenga ukutuusha ukufuma ku balwani bakwe mu ncende shonse. Ishina lyakwe likaba ni Solomoni pantu nkapeela umutende kuli Israeli ne cibote mu nshita ya bufumu bwakwe.

english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
translation: Ilyo Davidi akotele pa myaka iyingi, abuulile umwana wakwe Solomoni eo abika pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli.

english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
translation: Elyo bamwana Shimei bali ni Yahati, Sisa, Yeushi elyo na Beriya. Aba bane ebali abana abaume bakwa Shimei.

english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
translation: Yahati ewali uwantanshi, elyo Sisa aba uwacibili. Lelo Yeushi na Beriya tabakwete abana abaume abengi. Ecalengele ukuti bapendelwe pamo nga bana ba lupwa lumo lwine.

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
translation: Abana bakwa Koati bali ni Amuramu, Isa, Hebuloni na Usieli, bonse pamo bali bane.

english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
translation: Abana bakwa Amuramu bali ni Aroni na Mose.

english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
translation: Abana bakwa Mose, umuntu wakwa Lesa, bapendelwe ukuba icipande cimo ica luko lwa bena Levi.

english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
translation: Abana bakwa Mose bali ni Geshomu na Eliese.

english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Geshomu ni Shubaeli ewali uwantanshi.

english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Eliese ni Rehabia ewali uwantanshi. Kabili Eliesi takwete abana bambi abaume, lelo abana abaume bakwa Rehabia bali abengi.

english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Isa ni Shelomiti ewantanshi.

english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Hebuloni ni Yeriya ewantanshi, pakonka Amaria, uwabutatu ni Yahasieli, elyo uwalenga bune ni Yekameamu.

english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
translation: Kabili alonganika pamo intungulushi shonse isha mu Israeli, bashimapepo elyo na bena Levi.

english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Usieli ni Mika ewali uwantanshi elyo uwabubili Ishiya.

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
translation: Abana bakwa Merari bali ni Mali na Mushi.

english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
translation: Eleasa afwilefye ukwabula ukukwata abana abaume lelo akwetefye abana abanakashi. Bamwana Kishi ebabopile.

english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
translation: Abana bakwa Mushi bali ni Mali, Ederi na Yerimoti, bonse pamo bali batatu.

english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
translation: Aba e bana bakwa Levi umo bafyalilwe mu mayanda ya bashibo, abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo, pamo ngefyo balependwa cila umo umo ukulingana ne mpendwa ya mashina yabo, abo ababombele imilimo iya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ukufuma pa myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo.

english: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
translation: Pantu Davidi atile “Apo Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli napeela ukutuusha ku bantu bakwe nokuti naisa mukwikala mu Yerusalemu umuyayaya,

english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
translation: kanshi abena Levi nomba takuli ukulasenda Itenti lyakwa Lesa nangu ifipe fyonse ifibomba mwi Tenti ili.”

english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
translation: Ukulingana na mashiwi yakulekelesha ayakwa Davidi, abena Levi babapendele ukufuma pa bali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo.

english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
translation: Imilimo ya bena Levi yali yakwafwa abana bakwa Aroni mu milimo ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ukuba abakumona pa milimo ya mu mansa, mu miputule ya mumbali, ukusangulula ifipe fyonse ifyamushilo, no kubomba imilimo imbi iyalekana lekana iya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;
translation: Ebapeelwe ukumona pa mikate iyalebikwa petebulo, ubunga bwa mutuulo wa cabunga, utumikate utwapapatala utwabulamo intutumushi, pa milimo iyakupanga no kusakaanya, elyo ne fipimo fyonse ifyakupenda no kupiminako mu musango onse.

english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
translation: Abena Levi abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) nangu ukucilapo, ebapendelwe. Elyo impendwa ya baume yali amakana amakumi yatatu na cine konse konse (38,000).

english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;
translation: Ebali nokulaima cila lucelo mukutotela no kulumbanya Yawe. Ifi fine efyo bali nokwisa bwekeshapo inshita ya cungulo,

english: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;
translation: kabili nelyo lyonse kwaba ukoca amalambo yakupeela kuli Yawe pa masabata, pakutampa umweshi elyo na pa nshikunkulu shonse ishasalwa. Bali nokulabomba pa cinso cakwa Yawe inshita yonse iyapeelwe ukulingana ne mpendwa iyasontwa.

english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo abena Levi balebomba imilimo yabo iya mwi Tenti lyakukumaninamo, mu cifulo camushilo nelyo bali mu minwe ya bamunyinabo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni, mu milimo ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
translation: Davidi asosa ati, “Pali aba, impendwa iyili amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000), ebakulamona pa milimo ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Elyo bambi nabo amakana mutanda (6,000) ni bacilolo na bapingushi.

english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
translation: Impendwa amakana yane (4,000) ni bakalinda wa mpongolo. Elyo impendwa imbi iya makana yane (4,000) bali nokulabomfya ifilimba mpekenye pakulumbanya Yawe.”

english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation: Kabili Davidi alekanya abena Levi mu mabumba ukulingana na bana bakwa Levi, Geshoni, Koati na Merari.

english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
translation: Mu bena Geshoni mwali Ladani na Shimei.

english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
translation: Bamwana Ladani bali ni Yehieli ewali ibeli, elyo Setamu na Yoeli, bonse bali batatu.

english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
translation: Bamwana Shimei bali ni Shelomoti, Hasieli na Harani, bonse pamo bali batatu. Aba ebali intungulushi sha ndupwa shakwa Ladani.

english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation: Iyi eyali imipaka ya bana bakwa Aroni.

english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
translation: ukwalenga cine lubali pali Hakosi,

english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
translation: ukwalenga pabula pali Yeshua,

english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
translation: ukwalenga ikumi limo na umo (11) pali Eliashibu,

english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
translation: ukwalenga ikumi limo na itatu (13) pali Hupa,

english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
translation: ukwalenga ikumi limo na isano (15) pali Biliga,

english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
translation: ukwalenga ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) pali Hesili,

english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
translation: ukwalenga ikumi limo na pabula (19) pali Petahiya,

english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
translation: ukwalenga amakumi yabili na umo (21) pali Yakini,

english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
translation: ukwalenga amakumi yabili na itatu (23) pali Delaiya,

english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
translation: Ifi efyatantikwe ukukonkana kwabo mukubomba ilyo baleingila mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, umwabelele ifipope ifya bashilile shibo Aroni, ngefyo Lesa wa bena Israeli amukonkomeshe.

english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation: Lelo Nadabu na Abihu bafwile lintu shibo talafwa, elyo tabakwete abana abaume. Kanshi Eleasa na Itama ebalebomba imilimo ya bushimapepo.

english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
translation: Pa bashele aba mu lupwa lwakwa Levi bafumine mu bana bakwa Amuramu, Shubaeli, na ba muli Shubaeli ni Yedeiya.

english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
translation: Ukufuma mu bana bakwa Rehabiya, Ishiya ewali uwantanshi.

english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
translation: Ukufuma mu ba mu bena Isa ni Shelomoti,

english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
translation: Abana bakwa Hebuloni, uwantanshi ni Yeria, Amaria ewakonkelepo, Yahasieli ewali uwabutatu elyo Yekameamu nao ewali uwacine.

english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
translation: Mwana Usieli ali ni Mika,

english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
translation: Munyina kwa Mika ali ni Ishiya,

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
translation: Abana bakwa Merari bali ni Mali na Mushi.

english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation: Abana bakwa Merari ukufuma muli Yaasia, bali ni Beno, Shohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.

english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
translation: Ukufuma muli Mali, ni Eleasa uushakwetepo abana abaume.

english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
translation: Ukufuma muli Kishi, mwana Kishi ali ni Yerahimeli.

english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
translation: Elyo Sadoki uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Eleasa na Ahimeleki uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Itama ebayafwilishe Davidi ukubabika mu mpuka mu mpuka mukubomba imilimo bapeelwe.

english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
translation: Elyo abana bakwa Mushi bali ni Mali, Eda na Yerimoti.

english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
translation: Aba nabo bene bacitile ukupendula, filya fine bamunyinabo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni bacitile pa cinso ca mfumu Davidi na Sadoki, Aimeleki elyo ne ntungulushi sha mayanda ya bashimapepo na bena Levi. Abana baume ba mukalamba bacitile cimo cine na bana bakwa munyina, umwaice wakwe.

english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
translation: Impendwa iyikalamba iya ntungulushi yasangilwe mu ba mu lupwa lwakwa Eleasa ukucila mu ba mu lupwa lwakwa Itama. Eico bafumya intungulushi ikumi limo na mutanda (16) isha mayanda ya bashibo mu lupwa lwakwa Eleasari, elyo impendwa cine konse konse intungulushi sha mu mayanda ya bashibo mu lupwa lwakwa Itama.

english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
translation: Babakenye mukubapendula pantu palipo bacilolo ba mu cifulo camushilo na bacilolo bakwa Lesa pakati ka ba mu lupwa lwakwa Eleasa na ba mu lupwa lwakwa Itama.

english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
translation: Kalemba uwe shina lya Shemaiya mwana Netaneli umwina Levi, ewalembele amashina yabo pa menso ya mfumu elyo na bacilolo abali ni Sadoki shimapepo, Ahimeleki mwana Abiyata elyo ne ntungulushi sha mu mayanda ya bashimapepo na ya bena Levi. Babalemba mukutantika aba mu ŋanda imo ukufuma muli Eleasa elyo na ba mu ŋanda imo ukufuma muli Itama.

english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
translation: Ukupendula kwantanshi kwaponene pali Yehoyaribu,

english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
translation: ukwacitatu pali Harimu,

english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
translation: ukwacisano pali Malikiya,

english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
translation: Davidi pamo na bakalamba ba fita fya nkondo, bapatwilepo abana bamo abakwa Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni ku milimo yakusesema ukubomfya amaseese, insango ne miwaya. Ifi efyali ubutantiko bwa bantu abaume abali nokulabomba iyi milimo.

english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwacitatu pali Sakuri, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwacine pali Isiri, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwacisano pali Netania, pa bana bakwe abaume na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga mutanda pali Bukia, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga cine lubali pali Yesarela, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga cine konse konse pali Yeshaiya, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga pabula pali Mataniya, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo pali Shimei, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na umo (11) pali Asareli, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na ibili (12) pali Hashabia, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
translation: Ukufuma mu bana bakwa Asafu bali ni Sakuri, Yosefu, Netania na Asarela. Uwalemona pa mibombele ya bana bakwa Asafu ali ni Asafu wine, uwalesesema ukulingana no butungulushi bwa mfumu ine.

english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na itatu (13) pali Shubaeli, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na ine (14) pali Matitiya, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na isano (15) pali Yerimoti, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na mutanda (16) pali Hanania, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) pali Yoshibekasha, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) pali Hanani, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga ikumi limo na pabula (19) pali Maloti, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga amakumi yabili (20) pali Eliata, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga amakumi yabili na umo (21) pali Hotiri, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga amakumi yabili na ibili (22) pali Gidaliti, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
translation: Ukufuma ku bana bakwa Yedutuni, bali ni Gedalia, Seri, Yeshaiya, Shimei, Hashabia na Matitiya. Bonse pamo bali mutanda, no walemona pa milimo yabo ni shibo Yedutuni, uwalesesema alebomfya iseese pakutotela no kulumbanya Yawe.

english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translation: Ukwalenga amakumi yabili na itatu (23) pali Mahasioti, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
translation: Ukwalenga amakumi yabili na ine (24) pali Romamiti Eseri, pa bana bakwe na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, bali ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
translation: Ukufuma mu bana bakwa Hemani bali ni Bukia, Mataniya, Usieli, Shubaeli na Yerimoti, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidati, Romami Eseri, Yoshibekasha, Maloti, Hoti elyo na Mahasioti.

english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
translation: Bonse aba bali bana bakwa Hemani kamona wa mfumu ukulingana ne cebo cakwa Lesa ico alaile kukwimya Hemani. Pantu Lesa apeele Hemani abana abaume ikumi limo na bane (14), elyo abanakashi batatu.

english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
translation: Bonse abaume aba bali mu maboko ya bashibo pakwimba inyimbo sha mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, mukubomfya imiwaya, insango na maseese, pa milimo iya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Asafu, Yedutuni na Hemani bena baleumfwila imfumu.

english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
translation: Pamo pene ne ndupwa shabo, bonse abasambilishiwe no kusalapulwa mukwimba inyimbo shakwa Yawe, bali impendwa imyanda ibili na makumi cine konse konse na cine konse konse (288).

english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
translation: Bacitile ukupendula nge cakumwenako kuli onse imilimo yakwe, umukalamba, umwaice, kafundisha elyo no musambi.

english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
translation: Ukupendula kwantanshi ukwali kwakwa Asafu kwaponena pali Yosefu.

english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
translation: Ifi efyali mpuka sha bakalinda wa pa mpongolo.

english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
translation: Kabili Hosa, umwina Merari, alikwete abana. Shimuri ewantanshi nangu cali ukuti tewali ibeli,

english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
translation: Sam 6:11

english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.
translation: Ishi mpuka sha bakalinda wa pa mpongolo, ukupitila mu ntungulushi shabo, shali ne milimo yakubomba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, filya fine cali kuli bamunyinabo.

english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
translation: Balebomfya ukupendula pali cila mpongolo, umwakonkanine indupwa sha bashibo.

english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
translation: Imila 13:14

english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
translation: Ukupendula kwa pa mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo kwaponena pali Obedi Edomu, elyo ukupendula kwa pa ŋanda iya butala kwaponena pa bana bakwe.

english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
translation: Ukupendula kwa pa mpongolo ya ku masamba ne mpongolo ya pa Sheleketi iyabelele pa musebo wa pamulu, kwaponena pali Shupimu na Hosa.

english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
translation: Cila bushiku kwaleba abena Levi mutanda pa mpongolo ya ku kabanga, bambi nabo cila bushiku pa mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, bambi bane nabo pa mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo elyo pa ŋanda ya butala paleba bakalinda babili pa nshita imo.

english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
translation: Elyo ukuya ku masamba kwali bane abalelinda pa musebo, bambi nabo babili pa mpongolo pene.

english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
translation: Ifi efyali mpuka sha bakalinda wa pa mpongolo abafumine mu ndupwa shakwa Kora na Merari.

english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
translation: Kabili Meshelemia alikwete abana.

english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
translation: Abena Levi banabo bambi ebali ne milimo yakusunga icipao ca mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa elyo no kusunga icipao ca fipe abantu baletuula.

english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
translation: Abana bakwa Ladani, bali ni nkonkani shakwe mu bena Geshoni, kabili ebali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo mu lupwa lwakwa Ladani umwina Geshoni. Umo ali ni Yehieli.

english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.
translation: Bamwana Yehieli bali ni Setamu na munyina Yoeli. Ebali abakumona pa milimo ya bakusunga icipao ca mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
translation: Abafumine mu bena Amuramu, abena Isa, abena Hebuloni elyo na bena Usieli bali ni aba.

english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
translation: Shubaeli umwana wakwa Geshomu, mwana Mose, ewali cilolo mukalamba wa bakusunga icipao.

english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
translation: Abali bamunyina ukupitila muli Eliese, uwafyele Rehabia, nao uwafyele Yeshaiya wishi wakwa Yoramu nao wishi wakwa Sikiri nao wishi wakwa Shelomiti.

english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
translation: Shelomiti na bamunyina ebali ne milimo yakusunga ifintu ifyaletuula imfumu Davidi ne ntungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo ishali e bakalamba ba pa fita amakana (1,000) na bakalamba ba pa fita imyanda (100) elyo na bakalamba bambi aba fita.

english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.
translation: Fimo pa fitapwa ifyapokelwe mu nkondo nafyo bafituulile ku mulimo wakuwamisha iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.
translation: Kabili na fyonse ifyo Samwele uwali kamona atuulile, ne fyatuulile Saulo mwana Kishi, Abune mwana Neri na Yoabu mwana Seruiya elyo na fyonsefye ifyatuulilwe, fyapeelwe mukusungwa mu maboko yakwe Shelomiti na bamunyina.

english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
translation: Ukufuma ku bena Isa ni Kenaiya na bana bakwe ebapeelwe imilimo iya kunse ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa, bena bali ni bacilolo elyo na bapingushi ba pali Israeli.

english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
translation: uwalenga basano ni Elamu,

english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
translation: Ukufuma ku bena Hebuloni ni Hashabiya na bamunyina ikana limo ne myanda cine lubali (1,700), abantu abakosa, ebalebomba imilimo yonse iyakwa Yawe. Kabili ebakutumika imfumu mu Israeli kwisamba lya mumana wa Yordani.

english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
translation: Palwa bena Hebuloni, Yeria ewali intungulushi umo batantamine ukulingana ne cifyalilwa ca bashibo. Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yane (40) uwakwa Davidi pa bufumu, bafwailishe mu ndupwa sha bena Hebuloni elyo basangamo impalume ishakosa ku Yaseri wa mu Gileadi.

english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
translation: Yeria akwete bamunyina amakana yabili ne myanda cine lubali (2,700), abali abaume abakosa kabili abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo. Imfumu Davidi yabapeele ukulatungulula abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase pa milimo yakwa Lesa elyo na pa fya milandu ya mfumu.

english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
translation: Obedi Edomu nao alikwete abana.

english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
translation: uwalenga mutanda ni Amieli,

english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
translation: Shemaiya umwana wakwe nao alikwete abana abaume abali intungulushi ya mu ŋanda yakwa shibo pantu bali impalume ishakosa.

english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
translation: Bamwana Shemaiya amashina yabo ni Otini, Refaeli, Obedi na Elisabadi, na bamunyina Elihu na Semakiya nabo bene bali impalume ishakosa.

english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
translation: Bonse aba bafumine mu lupwa lwakwa Obedi Edomu. Bena na bana babo pamo bali impalume ishakosa kabili na maka ayakubomba imilimo. Bonse pamo mu lupwa lwakwa Obedi Edomu bali amakumi mutanda na babili (62).

english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
translation: Meshelemia ali na bana abaume na bamunyina ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18), abantu abakosa.

english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Iyi e mpendwa ya bena Israeli, intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo, abakalamba ba pa fita amakana (1,000), na bakalamba ba pa fita imyanda (100) na bacilolo babo abaletumika imfumu mu milimo yonse iyakumine impuka sha bashilika, abaleba pa ncito cila mweshi mu mwakafye onse. Cila mpuka yali na bantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000).

english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga cine lubali umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, ali ni Helesi umwina Peloni, uwa mu bana bakwa Efulemu. Mwali abantu abaume amakana yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga cine konse konse umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga cine konse konse, ali ni Sibekai umwina Hushati uwa mu bena Sera. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga pabula umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga pabula, ali ni Abiesa umwina Anatoti, uwa mu bena Benjamini. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga ikumi limo umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo, ali ni Maharai umwina Netofati uwa mu bena Sera. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga ikumi limo na umo (11) umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo na umo (11) ali ni Benaya umwina Piratoni uwa mu bena Efulemu. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga ikumi limo na babili (12) umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo na ibili (12) ali ni Helidai umwina Netofati, ukufuma mu lupwa lwakwa Otinieli. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
translation: Abaletungulula inko sha bena Israeli bali ifi.

english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
translation: Pa luko lwa bena Levi, ni Hashabiya mwana Kemueli.

english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
translation: Pa luko lwakwa Yuda, ni Elihu munyina Davidi.

english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
translation: Pa luko lwakwa Sebuloni, ni Ishimaiya mwana Obadiya.

english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwantanshi ukwangalila mpuka mu mweshi wakwamba ali ni Yashobeamu mwana Sabudieli. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000), mu mpuka yakwe.

english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
translation: Pa luko lwakwa Efulemu, ni Hoshea mwana Asasiya.

english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
translation: Pali citika imbi iya luko lwakwa Manase mu Gileadi, ni Ido mwana Sakaria.

english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
translation: Pa luko lwakwa Dani, ni Asareli mwana Yerohamu.

english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
translation: Davidi tapendeleko abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukwisa panshi, pantu Yawe alaile ukulenga abena Israeli ukusanda kwati ni ntanda sha mu mulu.

english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.
translation: Yoabu mwana Seruiya ewatendeke ukupenda abaume lelo afilwa ukupwisha pantu ubukali bwakwa Yawe bwaishile pa bena Israeli pa mulandu wa uku kupenda. Kabili uku kupenda takwalembelwe mwibuku lya milandu ya bufumu bwakwa Davidi.

english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
translation: Asimafeti mwana Adieli ewaleangalila pa fyuma baletutila ifya mfumu.

english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
translation: Esiri mwana Kelubi ewaleangalila pa babomfi abalelima amabala.

english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
translation: Shimei umwina Rama ewaleangalila pa milimo ya mu mabala ya myangashi.

english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
translation: Baali Hanani umwina Gederi ewaleangalila pa fimiti fya miolifa ne mikunyu iyali mwisamba lya lupili lwa ku masamba.

english: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
translation: Shitirai umwina Sharoni ewaleangalila pa fitekwa ifyalelya umulemfwe wa mu Sharoni.

english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
translation: Ali wa mu bana bakwa Peresi, kabili umukalamba pali bacilolo ba bashilika mu mweshi wakutampa.

english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
translation: Obili umwina Ishimaeli ewaleangalila pa ngamila.

english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.
translation: Yasisi umwina Hagiri ewaleangalila pa mikuni.

english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
translation: Yonatani, nalume wakwa Davidi, ewali mpandamano. Ali umuntu uwakwete ukwishiba kabili ali ni kalemba.

english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
translation: Ahitofeli ewali mpandamano wa mfumu.

english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
translation: Uwaishile pyana Ahitofeli ni Yehoiyada mwana Benaya, elyo pakonka Abiyata.

english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwacibili uwakwangalila impuka mu mweshi walenga ibili, ali ni Dodai umwina Ahoyi. Uwali ntungulushi ya mpuka yakwe ali ni Mikiloti. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwacitatu umukalamba aleyangalila aba mu mweshi walenga itatu ali ni Benaya mwana Yehoiyada shimapepo. Ewali intungulushi kabili mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
translation: Uyu e Benaya uwali impalume ine ine mwibumba lya makumi yatatu (30) kabili ewali intungulushi ya ili ibumba. Umwana wakwe Amisabadi ewaleyangalila ili bumba.

english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga bane umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga ine, ali ni Asaeli munyina wakwa Yoabu. Umwana wakwe Sebadiya ewamupyene. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwacisano umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga isano, ali ni Shamuhuti umwina Isira. Mwali abantu abaume amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Uwalenga mutanda, umukalamba aleyangalila abashilika mu mweshi walenga mutanda, ali ni Ira mwana Ikeshi umwina Tekoa. Mwali abantu abaume amakana yabili na yane (24,000) mu mpuka yakwe.

english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
translation: Davidi aitile bacilolo bonse aba mu Israeli mukulongana ku Yerusalemu. Bacilolo ba nko, abakalamba ba mpuka ya bantu abalebombela imfumu, abakalamba ba pa fita amakana (1,000), abakalamba ba pa fita imyanda (100), bacilolo abalemona pa fipe, elyo na balemona pa fitekwa fya mfumu pamo na bana bakwe, bacilolo ba kwisano, impalume shabulwi elyo na bonse abacenjela mukulwa inkondo.

english: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
translation: Nomba tontonkanya, pantu Yawe niwe asalile ukumukuulila iŋanda yakwe iyamushilo. Ube uwashipa, no kubomba.”

english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
translation: Elyo Davidi apeela umwana wakwe Solomoni ifipepala ifyalelangilila ifyo engakuula Umuputule wa pa mwinshi we Tempele, amayanda, amatala, imiputule ya pamulu elyo ne miputule ya mukati no muputule wa cifulo ca kufutilwapo ifyabubifi.

english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
translation: Amupeela ifipepala apali ukulangilila fyonse ifyo atontonkanya mu mano yakwe pakukuula imansa sha ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ne miputule iyashingulwike, na pa matala ya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, elyo na pa matala ya fyamushilo ifyaletuulwa.

english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—
translation: Amukonkomesha na pa musango wa mabumba ya bashimapepo na bena Levi elyo na pa milimo yonse iyakubomba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, pamo pene ne fibombelo fyonse ifyakubomfya.

english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
translation: Amupeela golide icipimo ukulingana no wakubomba pakupangamo ifipe fyonse ifya golide, ifyakubomfya mu milimo iyalekana lekana. Kabili na silifa icipimo, ukulingana no wakupangilamo ifipe fyonse ifya silifa ifyakubomfya mu milimo iyalekana lekana.

english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;
translation: Amupeela icipimo ca golide uwakupangilamo icakutekapo ifisaniko, ne fisaniko fyafiko ifya golide, cila cimo icakutekapo pamo ne cisaniko caciko, kabili ne cipimo ca silifa uwakupangilamo icakutekapo ifisaniko, ne fisaniko fyafiko ifya silifa, ukulingana ne milimo yakwete cila cakutekapo.

english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
translation: Amupeela icipimo ca golide uwalinga ukupangilako itebulo lyakutekapo imikate. Kabili amupeele ne cipimo ca silifa uwakupangilako amatebulo yakutekapo ifipe fya silifa.

english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
translation: Amupeela icipimo ca golide wine wine, uwakupangila amafoloko, imbale shakusambilamo ne ya nkombo. Amupeela icipimo ca golide wakupangila imbale imo imo, ne cipimo ca silifa wakupangila imbale imo imo.

english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.
translation: Amupeele ne cipimo ca golide uwasungululwa uwakupangila ubulambo bwakocelapo ububani. Kabili amupeela ne cipepala icalelangilila iceleta, emukutila bakerubi wa golide abafungulwile amapindo yabo no kufimba pa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe.

english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
translation: Davidi asosa ati, “Fyonse ifi fyalembwa ukufuma ku kuboko kwakwa Yawe kuli ine, kabili alimpeela ukwiluka muli fyonse ifishinka fya mibombele.”

english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi yaimine yalanda aiti,

english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
translation: Kabili Davidi aeba umwana wakwe Solomoni ati, “Ube uwakosa kabili uwashipa no kubomba uyu mulimo. Wikwata umwenso nangu ukufupuka pantu Yawe Lesa, Lesa wandi, ali na iwe. Takafilwepo nangu cimo mu mweo obe nangu ukukuposa, mpakafye imilimo yakubomba iya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ikapwe.

english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
translation: Amabumba ya bashimapepo na bena Levi yalifye ayaipekanya ukubomba imilimo yonse iya pa ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Kabili umuntu onse uwacenjela mu milimo iyalekana lekana ali nokukwafwa ukubomba. Elyo ne ntungulushi pamo na bantu bonse bali nokumfwila fyonse ifyo wakulabeba.”

english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
translation: Lelo Lesa atile kuli ine, ‘Teiwe uli nokukuula iŋanda apakuba ishina lyandi, pantu uli muntu wabulwi kabili uwasumyapo umulopa.’

english: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
translation: “Nomba Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, ewansalile ukufuma mu lupwa lwandi lonse ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli umuyayaya. Alisalile Yuda ukuba intungulushi, elyo mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda asala ulupwa lwandi. Elyo ukufuma pa bana bonse abakwa tata, calimusekeshe ukumbika pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli.

english: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.
translation: Yawe alimpeela abana abengi, kabili pa bana bandi bonse asalapo umwana wandi Solomoni ukuti akabe uwakwikala pa cipuna ca bufumu bwakwa Yawe ubwa bena Israeli.

english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
translation: Alandile kuli ine ati, ‘Umwana obe Solomoni euli nokunkuulila iŋanda elyo ne mansa shandi, pantu nimusala ukuba umwana wandi, na ine ndi nokuba wishi.

english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
translation: Ndi nokwimika ubufumu bwakwe umuyayaya, nga cakuti aikatisha ukulakonka amafunde yandi ne fipope fyandi, ngefyo cili pali ino nshita.’

english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
translation: “Kanshi nomba pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse, na ku lukuta lwakwa Yawe, na pa cinso cakwa Lesa wesu, mulecenjela pakukonka bwino amafunde yonse ayakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pakuti mukabe abakukwata icalo ici icisuma no kulenga cikabe icakushiilako abana benu nge cikwatwa ca pe na pe.

english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
translation: “Kabili iwe, we mwana wandi Solomoni, ishiba Lesa wakwa wiso, ulemubombela no mutima obe onse uwacishinka, elyo na mano yakuitemenwa. Pantu Yawe alafwailisha ifya muli cila mutima no kwishibisha akantu konse akali kunuma ya matontonkanyo. Nga cakuti wamufwaya, uli nokumusanga. Lelo nga cakuti wamutaluka, ali nokukukaana umuyayaya.

english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi yaebele ibumba lya bantu bonse aiti,

english: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
translation: Davidi alumbanya Yawe pa cinso cabalongene bonse alanda ati,

english: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
translation: Pantu fyonse fyobe we Yawe, ubukulu na maka,

english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!
translation: Ubukankala no mucinshi fifuma kuli iwe!

english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
translation: Nomba twakupeela amalumbo we Lesa wesu,

english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.
translation: “Lelo ine nine ani, kabili abantu bandi ni bani, pakuti tupeele apakalamba umutuulo muli uyu musango? Ifintu fyonse fifuma kuli iwe, elyo na ifwe tupeelefye ififuma ku minwe yobe.

english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.
translation: Ifwe tuli balebeshi kabili abeni pa cinso cobe, ngefyo bashifwe bali. Inshiku shesu pano calo shaba nge cinshingwa icishakwata isubilo.

english: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.
translation: Kabili ifintu fyonse ifyo twatuula, ifyakukuulila iyi ŋanda apakuba ishina lyobe ilyamushilo, fyafuma ku minwe yobe, kabili fyonsefye fyobe.

english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.
translation: We Lesa wandi nalishiba ukuti ulafwailisha ifyaba mu mutima kabili walitemwa ubololoke, na mu bololoke ubwa mutima wandi emo mpeelele ifi fintu fyonse. Elyo ine pakuba no mutima uwasekelela kabili uwacishinka napeela mukuitemenwa icibwesha. Nomba ndi ne nsansa pakumona abantu bobe, abatuulile kukuitemenwa kuli iwe abene.

english: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;
translation: We Yawe, Lesa wa bashifwe Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, sunga pe na pe uku kukabila mu mitima ya bantu bobe, no kutungulula imitima yabo uko uli.

english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
translation: Kabili upeele ku mwana wandi Solomoni umutima uwacishinka pakuti alebaka amafunde yobe ne fipope fyobe mukubomba fyonse ifyo ufwaya, elyo na fyonse ifyakulenga akakuule Itempele ilyo ine mpekanishishe ifi ifibombelo.”

english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
translation: Nimomba na maka yandi yonse ukupekanya ifyakukuulila iŋanda yakwa Lesa, golide uwakubomfya mu milimo ya golide, silifa uwakubomfya ku milimo ya silifa, umukuba uwakubomfya ku milimo ya fya mukuba, ifyela ifyakubomfya ku milimo ya fyela, elyo ne fimuti ifyakubomfya ku milimo ya fimuti, pamo pene no tumabwe twakutantikila utwa onikisi na tumbi utwamutengo, utumabwe twa mabala ayalekana lekana, elyo ne misango yonse iya mabwe ayakulungilwa bwino aya marbo, kabili fyonse fyapekanishiwa ifingi.

english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba abantu bonse abalongene ati, “Nomba paaleni Yawe Lesa wenu na matotelo.” Kanshi bonse epakulapaala Yawe, Lesa wa bashibo, na matotelo. Bonse bakontamika imitwe yabo panshi no kupeela umucinshi kuli Yawe na ku mfumu.

english: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo abena Israeli balekele Yawe amalambo na malambo yakoca. Balekele iŋombe ishilume ikana limo (1,000), basukusuku ikana limo (1,000), utwana twa mpaanga utwaume ikana limo (1,000), pamo ne mituulo ya fyakunwa, elyo na malambo ayengi ukulingana na bena Israeli.

english: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
translation: Kanshi pali bulya bushiku balya no kunwa ne nsansa ishingi pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
translation: Elyo Solomoni aya ikala pa cipuna cabufumu ico Yawe amusontelepo kukuteeka pa malo yakwa wishi Davidi. Atendeka no kushuka mufyo alecita elyo na bena Israeli bonse balamubeela.

english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
translation: Bacilolo bonse, impalume shonse, pamo pene na bana baume bonse aba mfumu Davidi, baipeele ukulanakila imfumu Solomoni.

english: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
translation: Kanshi Yawe nao acindamika Solomoni apakalamba nganshi pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse, amupeela no bufumu ubwalulumbi, ubushatalile abukwata imfumu nelyo imo mu Israeli.

english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
translation: Davidi mwana Yese ateekele Israeli yonse ilyo ali pa bufumu.

english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
translation: Ateekele pa bufumu mu calo ca Israeli pa myaka amakumi yane (40). Imyaka cine lubali ateekele mu Hebuloni, elyo pa myaka amakumi yatatu na itatu (33) ateekele mu Yerusalemu.

english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
translation: Afwile ninshi ali ne myaka isuma nganshi iyabukote bwe shuko, ubwa nshiku ishingi, ifyuma ifingi elyo no mucinshi uwingi. Solomoni umwana wakwe epakupyana pa cifulo cakwe icabufumu mukuteeka icalo.

english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Davidi, ukufuma ilyo atendeke ukuteeka ukufika na ku mpela, fyonse fyalilembwa mu citabo camilandu cakwa kamona Samwele, mu citabo camilandu cakwa Natani kasesema, elyo na mu citabo camilandu cakwa Gadi uwali kamona.

english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:
translation: Kabili ine pa mulandu wakutemwa iŋanda yakwa Lesa wandi, napeela nomba ubunonshi bwandi ubwa golide na silifa ku milimo ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa wandi, ukucila pa mulu wa fintu fyonse ifyo napeela ku mulimo wa iyi ŋanda yamushilo.

english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
translation: Mu fitabo fine ifi emwaba ne fishinka fyonse ifya pa bufumu bwakwe, amaka akwete, ifintu fyonse ifyamucitikile, ifyacitikile Israeli lintu ali pa bufumu, elyo ne fyacitike ku shamfumu sha mu fyalo fimbi.

english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;
