translation: Emukuti, amatalanta amakana yatatu (3,000) aya golide wa ku Ofiri, elyo na matalanta amakana cine lubali (7,000) aya silifa uwasungululwa bwino, uwakukambatika ku fibumba fya ŋanda.

english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”
translation: Imila 22:5

english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
translation: Elyo intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo, abakalamba ba nko sha bena Israeli, abakalamba ba pa fita amakana (1,000), abakalamba ba pa fita imyanda (100), elyo na bacilolo abalemona pa milimo ya mfumu baliipeele mukuitemenwa.

english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.
translation: Bapeele ku mulimo wa ŋanda yakwa Lesa amatalanta amakana yasano (5,000) elyo na madariki amakana ikumi limo (10,000) aya golide, , amatalanta amakana ikumi limo (10,000) aya silifa , amatalanta amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000) aya mukuba elyo na matalanta amakana umwanda umo (100,000) aya cela .

english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
translation: Onse uwakwete utumabwe twamutengo apeela ku cipao ca ŋanda yakwa Yawe no kufisha mu minwe yakwa Yehieli umwina Geshoni.

english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
translation: Icintubwingi calisansamwike pa musango wa fintu intungulushi shabo shasekelele ukupeela kwakuitemenwa ne mitima yabo kuli Yawe. Kabili imfumu Davidi nayo yalisansamwike nganshi.

english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
translation: Aba ebali abana bakwa Israeli: Rubeni, Simeoni, Levi, Yuda, Isaka, Sebuloni,

english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
translation: Ramu ewali wishi wakwa Aminadabu, elyo na Aminadabu nao afyele Nashoni intungulushi ya bana bakwa Yuda.

english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
translation: Nashoni ewali wishi wakwa Salima, nao Salima afyele Boasi,

english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
translation: nao Boasi afyele Obedi. Obedi nao ewali wishi wakwa Yese.

english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
translation: Yese nao afyele Eliabu ibeli lyakwe, elyo uwacibili ni Abinadabu, uwacitatu ni Shimeya.

english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
translation: Elyo umwana walenga bane ni Netaneli. Uwacisano ni Radai,

english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;
translation: uwalenga mutanda ni Osemu elyo walenga cine lubali ni Davidi.

english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
translation: Bankashi yabo bali ni Seruiya elyo na Abigaili. Abana bakwa Seruiya ni Abishai, Yoabu elyo na Asaeli.

english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
translation: Abigaili afyele Amasa elyo wishi ali ni Yete umwina Ishimaeli.

english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation: Kalebu mwana Hesroni akwete abana muli Asuba umukashi wakwe elyo na muli Yerioti . Nomba aba ebali abana bakwe: Yesheri, Shobabu na Adoni.

english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
translation: Ilyo Asuba afwile, Kalebu aupile Efulati no kufyalamo Huri.

english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation: Dani, Yosefu, Benjamini, Naftali, Gadi elyo na Asheri.

english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
translation: Huri afyele Uri, elyo Uri nao afyele wishi wakwa Besaleli.

english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
translation: Panuma, Hesroni alele no mwana mwanakashi wakwa Makiri wishi wakwa Gileadi, untu aupile ilyo ali ne myaka amakumi mutanda (60) iyakufyalwa. Afyelemo na Segubu.

english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
translation: Segubu afyele Yairi, uwali ne mishi amakumi yabili na itatu (23) mu calo ca Gileadi.

english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
translation: Lelo Geshuri na Aramu bapokolola Hafoti Yairi elyo na Kenati ne ncende shonse ishashinguluka umwali imishi amakumi mutanda (60). Aba bonse bali ba mu lupwa lwakwa Makiri wishi wakwa Gileadi.

english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Hesroni ku Kalebu Efulata, Abiya umukashi wakwa Hesroni afyala umwana ishina lyakwe ni Ashuri, nao afyele Tekoa.

english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation: Abana bakwa Yerameli ibeli lyakwa Hesroni bali ni Ramu uwali ibeli, Buna, Oreni, Osemu, elyo na Ahiya.

english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
translation: Yerameli alyupile umukashi na umbi ishina lyakwe ni Atara. Uyu ewali nyina wakwa Onamu.

english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation: Abana bakwa Ramu ibeli lyakwa Yerameli ni Masi, Yamini elyo na Ekeri.

english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
translation: Abana bakwa Onamu nabo ni Shamai, elyo na Yada.

english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
translation: Ishina lyakwa muka Abishuri ni Abihaili, afyele Ahibani elyo na Molidi.

english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
translation: Abana bakwa Yuda ni Ere, Onani elyo na Shela. Aba abana batatu afyele mu mukashi umwina Kenani, umwana mwanakashi wakwa Shua. Ere, uwali ibeli lyakwa Yuda ali umubi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kanshi Yawe epakumwipaya.

english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
translation: Abana bakwa Nadabu ni Seledi elyo na Apaimu. Seledi afwile ukwabula ukufyalapo abana.

english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
translation: Umwana wakwa Apaimu ni Ishi, elyo umwana wakwa Ishi ni Sheshani uwali wishi wakwa Ahilai.

english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
translation: Abana bakwa Yada, munyina wakwa Shamai ni Yeteri elyo na Yonatani. Yeteri afwile ukwabula ukufyalapo abana.

english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
translation: Abana bakwa Yonatani ni Peleti elyo na Sasa. Aba bali bana bakwa Yerameli.

english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
translation: Sheshani takwetepo abana abaume kanofye abana abanakashi beka. Sheshani ali no mubomfi wakwe umwina Egupto ishina lyakwe ni Yariya.

english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
translation: Sheshani aufishe umwana wakwe umwanakashi ku mubomfi wakwe Yariya eko afyala umwana Atai.

english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
translation: Atai afyele wishi wakwa Sabadi.

english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
translation: Sabadi afyele Efula, elyo nao Efula afyele Obedi.

english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
translation: Obedi afyele Yehu, elyo nao ewafyele Asaria.

english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
translation: Asaria afyele Helesi, elyo nao Helesi afyele Eleasa.

english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
translation: Elyo Tama nafyala wakwa Yuda, ewafyele Peresi na Sera. Bonse abana bakwa Yuda bali basano.

english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
translation: Eleasa afyele Sismai elyo nao Sismai afyele Shalumu.

english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
translation: Shalumu afyele Yekamia elyo nao Yekamia ewafyele Elishama.

english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
translation: Ulupwa lwakwa Kalebu, munyina wakwa Yerameli ni Mesha ibeli lyakwe, uwali wishi wakwa Sifu, elyo no mwana wakwe Maresha uwali wishi wakwa Hebuloni.

english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation: Abana bakwa Hebuloni ni Kora, Tapua, Rekemu elyo na Shema.

english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
translation: Shema afyele Rahamu, elyo nao Rahamu afyele Yorokeamu. Elyo nao Rekemu afyele Shamai.

english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
translation: Umwana wakwa Shemai ni Maoni elyo nao Maoni afyala Beti Suri.

english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
translation: Efah, umukashi uushaupilwe mu bwinga uwakwa Kalebu, afyele Harani, Mosa elyo na Gasesi. Elyo Harani nao alikwete umwana uwe shina lya Gasesi.

english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
translation: Abana bakwa Yadai bali ni Regemu, Yotamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efah elyo na Shafu.

english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation: Maka, umukashi uushaupilwe mu bwinga uwakwa Kalebu, ewali nyina wakwa Sheberi elyo na Tirana.

english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
translation: Kabili ewafyele na Shafu wishi wakwa Madimana elyo na Shefa uwali wishi wakwa Makibena elyo na Gibeya. Umwana umwanakashi wakwa Kalebu ali ni Akisa.

english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
translation: Abana bakwa Peresi ni Hesroni elyo na Hamuli.

english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
translation: Aba ebali aba mu lupwa lwakwa Kalebu.

english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
translation: Salima wishi wakwa Betelehemu, elyo na Harefu wishi wakwa Beti Gada.

english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Shobali wishi wakwa Kiriati Yarimu nabo ni Haroe, na citika wa bena Manahati.

english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
translation: Elyo na ba mu mukowa wakwa Kiriati Yarimu bali ni aba: abena Itira, abena Puti, abena Shumati elyo na bena Mishira. Kuli aba ekwafumine indupwa sha bena Sorati elyo na bena Eshitaoli.

english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
translation: Indupwa shakwa Salima shali ni Betelehemu, abena Netofati, abena Atoti Beti Yoabu, citika wa bena Manahati, abena Sorati.

english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
translation: Elyo ne mikowa ya bakalemba abaikele ku Yabesi bali ni aba: abena Tirati, abena Shimeati elyo na bena Sukati. Aba e bena Keni abafumine muli Hamati wishi wa ba ŋanda yakwa Rekabu.

english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
translation: Abana bakwa Sera ni Simuri, Etani, Hemani, Kalikoli elyo na Dada. Kanshi bonse pamo bali basano.

english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
translation: Abana bakwa Kami ni Aka , uwaletele ubwafya pa bena Israeli pakufulunganya icipope icakukanasenda ifyapeelwe mukonaulwa.

english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
translation: Umwana wakwa Etani ni Asaria.

english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
translation: Kabili abana abafyelwe kuli Hesroni ni Yerameli, Ramu na Kalebu.

english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
translation: Nomba aba e bana baume bakwa Davidi abafyelwe kuli ena mu Hebuloni. Ibeli lyakwe ali ni Amunoni muli Ainoamu umwina Yesireli, uwacibili ni Daniele muli Abigaili umwina Kameli.

english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
translation: Umwana wakwa Solomoni ali ni Reoboamu.

english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
translation: Yehoramu nao ewali umwana wakwa Yehoshafati.

english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
translation: Amasiya nao ewali mwana wakwa Yoashi.

english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
translation: Ahasi nao ewali umwana wakwa Yotamu.

english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
translation: Amoni nao ewali umwana wakwa Manase.

english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
translation: Abana bakwa Yosaya nabo ni Yohanani ewali ibeli, Yehoyakimu ewali uwacibili, Sedekia ewali uwacitatu, Shalumu ewali uwacine.

english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
translation: Impyani shakwa Yehoyakimu bali ni Yekoniya umwana wakwe, elyo na Sedekia umwana wakwe.

english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
translation: Balupwa bakwa Yehoiyakini uwali muli bunkole bali ni Shealitieli umwana wakwe,

english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation: elyo Malikiromu, Pedaiya, Shenasa, Yekamia, Hoshama na Nedabia.

english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
translation: Abana bakwa Pedaiya bali ni Serubabeli elyo na Shimei.

english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
translation: Uwacitatu ni Abusalomu muli Maka umwana mwanakashi wakwa Talimai, imfumu ya ku Geshuri. Uwacine ni Adoniya muli Hagiti.

english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
translation: Kabili kwali na bambi basano Hashuba, Oheli, Berekiya, Hasadiya elyo na Yushabu Hesedi.

english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
translation: Balupwa bakwa Hanania bali ni Peletiya na Yeshaiya. Yeshaiya afyele Refaiya nao afyele Arinani, nao afyele Obadiya elyo nao afyele Shekaniya.

english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
translation: Balupwa bakwe Shekaniya bali ni Shemaiya na bana bakwe Hatushi, Igali, Bariya, Neariya elyo na Shepati. Bonse pamo bali mutanda.

english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
translation: Abana bakwa Neariya bali ni Elioenai, Hisikiya elyo na Asirikamu. Bonse pamo bali batatu.

english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
translation: Abana bakwa Elioenai bali ni Hodafiya, Eliashibu, Pelaiya, Akuba, Yohanani, Delaiya elyo na Anani. Bonse pamo bali cine lubali.

english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
translation: Uwacisano, ni Shefatiya muli Abitali. Elyo uwalenga mutanda, ni Itilemu mu mukashi wakwe Egila.

english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
translation: Aba bonse mutanda bafyelwe kuli Davidi mu Hebuloni ninshi ali pa bufumu imyaka cine lubali ne myeshi mutanda.

english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
translation: Kabili aba ebana abafyelwe kuli ena mu Yerusalemu: Shamua, Shobabu, Natani elyo na Solomoni. Abana aba bane ba muli Batisheba umwana mwanakashi wakwa Amieli.

english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
translation: Elyo kabili na Ibihali, Elishua, Elifeleti,

english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
translation: Noga, Nefegi, Yafiya,

english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
translation: Elishama, Eliada elyo na Elifeleti, bonse pamo bali pabula.

english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
translation: Bonse aba bali bana bakwa Davidi, ukwabula ukupendelako abana ba mu bakashi bakwe abo ashaupile mu bwinga. Elyo na Tama ewali nkashi yabo.

english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation: Abana bakwa Yuda bali ni Peresi, Hesroni, Kami, Huri, elyo na Shobali.

english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
translation: Elyo Yabesi alilile kuli Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, “Iye ukupaala nga wampaala no kukusha icalo candi. Uleke no kuboko kobe kukaleba na ine, no kungafwa ukufuma ku bubi, pakuti mpusuke ukufuma ku bukali!” Kanshi Lesa nao epakumupeela ico alombele.

english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
translation: Kalebu, munyina Shuha afyele Meiri, elyo ewafyele Eshitoni.

english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
translation: Elyo Eshitoni nao ewafyele Betirafa, Pasea, na Tehina wishi wakwa Iri Nahashi. Aba ebali abaume bakwa Reka.

english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
translation: Abana bakwa Kenasi ni Otinieli na Seraya.

english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
translation: Meonotai ewafyele Ofura.

english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
translation: Abana bakwa Kalebu mwana Yefune ni Iru, Elaya, elyo na Namu.

english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
translation: Abana bakwa Yehaleleli ni Sifu, Sifa, Tiria elyo na Asareli.

english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
translation: Abana bakwa Esira ni Yete, Meredi, Eferi elyo na Yaloni. Kabili umukashi umo uwakwa Meredi ewafyele Miriamu, Shamai elyo na Ishiba wishi wakwa Estemoa.

english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
translation: Aba ebali abana bakwa Bitia umwana mwanakashi wakwa Farao untu Meredi aupile. Umukashi wakwe umwina Yuda afyele Yeredi wishi wakwa Gedori, Heberi wishi wakwa Soko elyo na Yekutieli wishi wakwa Samoa.

english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
translation: Abana ba mukashi wakwa Hodia, nkashi yakwa Nahamu, bali e bawishi wakwa Keila umwina Gami elyo na Eshitemoa umwina Makati.

english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
translation: Reaiya umwana wakwa Shobali ewafyele Yahati, elyo Yahati nao ewafyele Ahumai na Lahadi. Aba ebali ba mu mikowa ya bena Sorati.

english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
translation: Abana bakwa Shimoni ni Amunoni, Rina, Beni Hanani elyo na Tiloni.

english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
translation: Abana bakwa Shela mwana Yuda ni Ere wishi wakwa Leka, Lada wishi wakwa Maresha elyo ne ndupwa sha ba mu ŋanda ya bakapikula wa nsalu ishatelela aba ku Beti Ashibea,

english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
translation: elyo Yokimu, na baume ba ku Koseba, na mu Yoashi, na mu Sarafu ebateekele mu Moabu na mu Yashubi Lehemu. Iyi milandu yakale nganshi.

english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
translation: Aba ebalebomba imilimo yakubumba na bonse abaikele ku Netaimu elyo na ku Gedera. Kulya eko baikele mukubomba imilimo ya mfumu.

english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
translation: Bamwana Simeoni abaume ni Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Sera na Shauli.

english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
translation: Shalumu ewali umwana wakwa Shauli, nao afyele Mibisamu elyo nao afyele Mishima.

english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
translation: Kabili abana bakwa Mishima ni Hamueli, Sakuri elyo na Shimei bonse bali abaume.

english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
translation: Shimei akwete abana abaume ikumi limo na mutanda (16) elyo na bana abanakashi nabo bali mutanda. Lelo bamunyina bena tabakwete abana abengi, ne ndupwa shabo tapali nelyo lumo ulwasandulwike nga bena Yuda.

english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
translation: Baikele ku Beresheba, ku Molada, ku Hasa Shuali,

english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
translation: ku Bilua, ku Esemu, ku Toladi,

english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
translation: Aba ebali abana bakwa Etamu: Yesireli, Ishima na Idibashi. Elyo ishina lyakwa nkashi yabo ali ni Haseleponi.

english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
translation: ku Betueli, ku Homa, ku Sikilagi,

english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
translation: ku Beti Makaboti, ku Hasa Susimu, ku Beti Biri elyo na ku Sharaimu. Iyi eyali imisumba yabo ukwisa fika na pa kuteeka kwakwa Davidi.

english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
translation: Elyo imishi yabo yali ni Etamu, Aini, Rimoni, Tokeni na Ashani, yali isano.

english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
translation: Imishi yonse iyashingulwike iyi misumba yafikilefye na ku Baalati. Umu, emo baleikala. Kabili balilembele umwakonkanina ukufyalwa kwabo.

english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
translation: Meshobabu, Yamuleki, Yosha mwana Amasiya,

english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
translation: Yoeli, Yehu mwana Yoshibia, nao mwana Seraya, nao mwana Asieli,

english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
translation: kabili Elioenai, Yakoba, Yeshohaiya, Asaiya, Adieli, Yesimieli, Benaya,

english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
translation: elyo na Sisa umwana wakwa Shifi, nao umwana wakwa Aloni, nao umwana wakwa Yedaiya, nao umwana wakwa Shimuri nao umwana wakwa Shemaiya.

english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
translation: Aba abalumbwilwe mu mashina ebali ntungulushi mu ndupwa shabo. Kabili aba mu ŋanda yakwa wishi balisandene nganshi.

english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
translation: Elyo baile kuntanshi ku bwingililo bwe shika lya Gedori, ku kabanga ke shika mukufwaya incende yakulishishamo ifitekwa fyabo.

english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
translation: Penueli e wishi wakwa Gedori, elyo nao Eseri e wishi wakwa Husha.

english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
translation: Eko baile sanga umulemfwe uwalelema elyo ne ncende iyikalamba iyamutende kabili iyabula icongo. Pantu bamo abena Hami eko kale baikele.

english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
translation: Aba abalumbwilwe mu mashina baishile mu nshiku shakwa Hesekia imfumu ya bena Yuda. Elyo baisa sansa na bena Hami mu matenti yabo pamo na bena Meuni abali kulya, no kupeela bonsefye kukonaulwa, ngefyo caba ukufika na lelo. Kanshi epakwikala mu ncende yabo, pantu mwali umulemfwe wakulisha ifitekwa fyabo.

english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
translation: Nomba ibumba limo ilya bana bakwa Simeoni imyanda isano (500) baile ku mpili sha Seiri, batungulwilwe na Pelatiya, Nearia, Refaiya elyo na Usieli bamwana Ishi.

english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
translation: Kabili bacimfishe abena Amaleki bonse abashele pali aba ababutwike. Kabili kulya kwine eko baikala ukufika na lelo.

english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
translation: Ashuri uwali wishi wakwa Tekoa akwete abakashi babili, Hela elyo na Nara.

english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
translation: Nara amufyalile Ahusamu, Heferi, Temeni elyo na Hahashitari, ebali balupwa bakwa Nara.

english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation: Abana bakwa Hela nabo ni Sereti, Soha, Etinani,

english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
translation: na Kosi uwali wishi wakwa Anubu na Hasobeba elyo na ba mu mukowa wakwa Aheli mwana Harumu.

english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
translation: Nomba Yabesi ali uwacindikwa nganshi ukucila bamunyina. Nyina amwinike ishina lya Yabesi ati, “Namufyalile mu bucushi.”

english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
translation: Aba e bana bakwa Rubeni ibeli lyakwa Israeli. Icine cine ewali ibeli, lelo pa mulandu wakukowesha umusengele wakwa wishi, insambu shakwe ishabubeli shapeelwe ku bana abaume bakwa Yosefu mwana Israeli, ecalenga Rubeni ukukana pendelwa mu cifyalilwa cakwe icabubeli.

english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
translation: Nomba mu nshiku sha bufumu bwakwa Saulo baimishe inkondo na bena Hagiri, abo bacimfishe ku minwe yabo. Elyo baikala mu matenti yabo no mwaleikala abena Hagiri ukushingulukafye icitungu conse ica ku kabanga ka ku Gileadi.

english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
translation: Abena Gadi ebaikele mupepi nabo mu Bashani ukushintafye na ku Saleka.

english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
translation: Yoeli ewali ntungulushi, Shafamu ewamukonkelepo elyo pakonka Yanai na Shafati mu Bashani.

english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
translation: Kabili bamunyinabo aba mu ndupwa shabo ni Mikaeli, Meshulamu, Sheba, Yorai, Yakani, Sia elyo na Eberi. Bonse pamo bali cine lubali.

english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
translation: Aba ebali abana bakwa Abihaili umwana wakwa Huri, nao umwana wakwa Yaroya, uwali umwana wakwa Gileadi, nao uwali umwana wakwa Yeshishai, nao uwali umwana wakwa Yado, nao uwali umwana wakwa Busi.

english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
translation: Ahi umwana wakwa Abudiele, umwana wakwa Guni, ewali intungulushi ya lupwa lwakwe.

english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
translation: Abena Gadi baikele mu Gileadi, mu Bashani na mu mishi iyali mumbali na mu ncende shonse ishakucemenamo ifitekwa isha Sharoni ukuya fikafye na ku mipaka yabo.

english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
translation: Bonse aba balilembelwe ukulingana nomo bakonkanine mu kufyalwa kwabo, mu nshiku sha bufumu bwakwa Yotamu imfumu ya bena Yuda, na Yeroboamu imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
translation: Abana bakwe Rubeni, abena Gadi elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase mwali abaume ababulamba amakana amakumi yane na yane ne myanda cine lubali na makumi mutanda (44,760) abacenjela ku nkondo, abengasenda inkwela no lupanga, abengabomfya ubuta kabili abasambilishiwa ukulwa.

english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
translation: Babushishe inkondo na bena Hagiri, Yetu, Nafishi elyo na bena Nadabu.

english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
translation: Elyo nangu Yuda akwatishepo amaka pali bamunyina, icakuti na kateeka afumine muli ena, lelo insambu shabubeli shapeelwe kuli Yosefu.

english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.
translation: Lesa alibafwile mukulwisha Hagiri na bonse abalemwafwa, abapeele mu minwe yabo pantu balilile kuli Lesa mu nshita yabulwi. Ayaswike amapepo yabo pantu balicetekele muli ena.

english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
translation: Bapokolwele ifitekwa fya bena Hagiri: Ingamila shabo amakana amakumi yasano (50,000), impaanga shabo amakana imyanda ibili na makumi yasano (250,000), elyo na bapunda babo amakana yabili (2,000). Kabili basenda na bantu amakana umwanda umo (100,000) muli bunkole.

english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
translation: Icite 35:22

english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation: Abantu citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bali abengi kabili baikele mu calo ukufuma ku Bashani ukufika ku Baali Hemoni, emukutila ku Seni nangu ulupili lwa Hemoni.

english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
translation: Aba ebali intungulushi sha ndupwa sha bashibo: Efa, Ishi, Elieli, Asirieli, Yeremia, Hodafia elyo na Yadieli. Bali abacenjela mukulwa, abalumbuka, kabili intungulushi sha ndupwa sha bashibo.

english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
translation: Lelo tabali bacishinka kuli Lesa wa bashibo, kabili baipeele kukucita bucilende bwakupepa imilungu ya bantu abali kale muli ici calo abo Lesa aonawile pa cinso cabo

english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
translation: Eico Lesa wa bena Israeli aimishe umutima wakwa Puli, imfumu ya bena Asiria emukutila Tigilati Pilese imfumu ya bena Asiria. Nao ewasendele abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase muli bunkole. Abasendele ku Hala, Habori, Hara elyo na ku mumana wa Gosani, uko baikala ukufika na pali lelo.

english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
translation: Abana bakwa Yoeli ni Shemaiya, umwana wakwe. Gogi nao ewali umwana wakwa Shemaiya. Shimei nao ewali umwana wakwa Gogi.

english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
translation: Mika nao ewali umwana wakwa Shimei. Reaiya nao ewali umwana wakwa Mika. Baali nao ewali umwana wakwa Reaiya.

english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
translation: Elyo Bera e mwana wakwa Baali untu Tigilati Pilese imfumu ya ku Asiria asendele muli bunkole. Bera ewali intungulushi ya bena Rubeni.

english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
translation: Bamunyina mu ndupwa shabo, abatantikwe umo bakonkanina mukufyalwa ni Yeli uwali intungulushi, Sakaria,

english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
translation: Icite 49:8-10

english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
translation: Lwa ku kabanga baikele mu calo conse mpaka ku mpela ya matololo ayaya fika ku mumana wa Yufurate, pantu ifitekwa fyabo fyalisandile nganshi mu Gileadi.

english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation: Abana bakwa Levi bali ni Geshoni, Koati elyo na Merari.

english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
translation: Yohanani afyele Asariya uyu wine ewali shimapepo mwi Tempele Solomoni akuulile mu Yerusalemu.

english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
translation: Asariya afyele Amaria, Amaria afyele Aitubi,

english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
translation: Ahitubi afyele Sadoki, elyo Sadoki nao afyala Shalumu,

english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
translation: Shalumu afyele Hilikiya, elyo Hilikiya nao afyala Asariya.

english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
translation: Asariya afyele Seraya, elyo Seraya nao afyala Yehosadaki.

english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
translation: Yehosadaki nao asendelwe muli bunkole ilyo Yawe alekele abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu basendwa muli bunkole ku kuboko kwakwa Nebukadinesa.

english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
translation: Abana bakwa Levi bali ni Geshoni , Koati na Merari.

english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
translation: Aya e mashina ya bana bakwa Geshoni: Libini na Shimei.

english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation: Abana bakwa Koati bali ni Amuramu, Isari, Hebuloni na Usieli.

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
translation: Abana bakwa Merari bali ni Mali na Mushi.

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation: Abana bakwa Koati ni Amuramu, Isa, Hebuloni elyo na Usieli.

english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
translation: Geshoni afyele Libini, Libini nao afyele Yehati elyo Yehati nao afyala Sima.

english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
translation: Sima nao afyala Yoa, Yoa nao afyala Ido, Ido nao afyala Sera, Sera nao afyala Yeateraiya.

english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
translation: Koati afyele Aminadabu, Aminadabu nao afyala Kora, Kora nao afyala Asiri,

english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
translation: Asiri afyala Elikana, Elikana nao afyala Ebiyasafu, nao afyala Asiri.

english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
translation: Asiri afyala Tahati, Tahati nao afyala Urieli, Urieli nao afyala Usia, Usia nao afyala Shauli.

english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation: Abana bakwa Elikana ni Amasai na Ahimoti.

english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
translation: Ahimoti afyala Elikana, Elikana nao afyala Sofai, Sofai nao afyala Nahati.

english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
translation: Nahati afyala Eliabu, Eliabu nao afyala Yerohamu, Yerohamu nao afyala Elikana elyo Elikana nao afyala Samwele.

english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
translation: Samwele afyele Yoeli, uwali ibeli lyakwe, na Abiya uwali uwacibili.

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
translation: Abana abaume bakwa Merari ni Maili, uwafyele Libini, Libini afyele Shimei, Shimei nao afyala Usa.

english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation: Abana bakwa Amuramu ni Aroni, Mose elyo na Miriamu.

english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
translation: Usa afyala Shimea, Shimea nao afyala Haggia, elyo nao afyala Asaya.

english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.
translation: Aba e baume Davidi asalile ukulatungulula inyimbo mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, umo baletele imbokoshi ya Cipangano ukwisa tuushamo.

english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
translation: Balebomba umulimo wakwimba inyimbo mu cifulo cakwikalamo ice Tenti lyakwa Lesa ilyakukumaninamo, mpaka Solomoni ilyo akuulile iŋanda yakwa Yawe mu Yerusalemu. Balebomba imilimo yabo ukulingana na mafunde yapeelwe kuli bena.

english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
translation: Aba e baume babombele pamo na bana babo.

english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
translation: nao uwali umwana wakwa Elikana, mwana Yerohami, nao uwali umwana wakwa Toa,

english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
translation: nao uwali umwana wakwa Sufu, nao uwali umwana wakwa Elikana, nao uwali umwana wakwa Mahati, nao uwali umwana wakwa Amasai,

english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
translation: nao uwali umwana wakwa Elikana, nao uwali umwana wakwa Yoeli, mwana Asariya, nao uwali umwana wakwa Sefania,

english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
translation: nao ewali umwana wakwa Tahati, mwana Asiri, nao ewali umwana wakwa Ebiasafu, mwana Kora,

english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
translation: nao uwali umwana wakwa Isa, umwana wakwa Koati, nao ewali umwana wakwa Levi, mwana Israeli.

english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
translation: Elyo Asafu ewaleiminina ku kuboko kwakwa Hemani munyina. Asafu ewali umwana wakwa Berekiya, mwana Shimea,

english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
translation: Eleasa afyele Fineasi, elyo Fineasi nao afyala Abishua.

english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
translation: nao umwana wakwa Mikaeli, umwana wakwa Baseiya, mwana Milikiya,

english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
translation: umwana wakwa Etini, mwana Sera, nao ewali umwana wakwa Adaiya,

english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
translation: umwana wakwa Etani, uwali umwana wakwa Sima, mwana Shimei,

english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
translation: uwali umwana wakwa Yahati, umwana wakwa Geshoni, nao uwali umwana wakwa Levi.

english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
translation: Elyo na bamunyina abana bakwa Merari abali ku kuboko kwa ku kuso, bali ni Etani umwana wakwa Kisi, mwana Abudi, nao uwali umwana wakwa Maluki,

english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
translation: nao umwana wakwa Hashabia, mwana Amasiya, nao uwali umwana wakwa Hilikiya,

english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
translation: mwana Amusi, nao uwali umwana wakwa Bani, mwana Shemeri,

english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
translation: nao ewali mwana wakwa Maili, mwana Mushi, uwali umwana wakwa Merari, mwana Levi.

english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
translation: Elyo bamunyinabo abena Levi balisontelwe ukubomba imilimo imbi iyalekana lekana iya mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa, ekutila mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
translation: Lelo Aroni na bana bakwe bena ebaletuula imituulo pa bulambo bwakocelapo amalambo elyo na pa bulambo bwakocelapo ububani, mu milimo yonse iyalecitika mu muputule wamushilo icine cine, no kufutilako abena Israeli pa fyabubifi ukulingana na fyonse ifyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Lesa akonkomeshe.

english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
translation: Abishua afyele Buki, elyo Buki nao afyele Usi.

english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
translation: Aba e bana bakwa Aroni: Eleasa ewali umwana wakwe, Fineasi nao ewali umwana wakwa Eliese, Abishua nao ewali umwana wakwa Fineasi.

english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
translation: Buki nao ewali umwana wakwa Abishua, na Usi ewali umwana wakwa Buki. Serahiya ewali umwana wakwa Usi.

english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
translation: Meraioti nao ewali umwana wakwa Serahiya, Amaria nao ewali umwana wakwa Meraioti, Ahitubi nao ewali umwana wakwa Amaria.

english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
translation: Sadoki nao ewali umwana wakwa Ahitubi elyo na Aimasi nao ewali umwana wakwa Sadoki.

english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
translation: Ishi e ncende baleikalamo, ukulingana ne mipaka ya fifulo fyabo ifyapeelwe ku bana bakwa Aroni aba mu lupwa lwakwa Koati, pantu ebo icipendwilo cantanshi cawilile.

english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
translation: Babapeele Hebuloni mu calo cakwa Yuda pamo ne fitungu ifyashingulukako ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa.

english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
translation: Lelo amabala ne mishi iyashingulwike umusumba fyena fyapeelwe kuli Kalebu umwana wakwa Yefune.

english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
translation: Elyo ku bana bakwa Aroni bena bapeelwe umusumba wakufisamamo Hebuloni elyo ne misumba ya ku Libuna, Yatiri, Eshitemoa,

english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
translation: Hileni, Debi,

english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;
translation: Ashani, Yuta elyo na Beti Shemeshi, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyaiko ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa.

english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
translation: Usi afyele Serahia, elyo Serahia nao afyala Meraioti,

english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
translation: Kabili ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Benjamini bapeelwe imisumba ya Gibeoni, Geba, Alemeti elyo na Anatoti pamo pene ne fitungu ifyaiko ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa. Imisumba iyi iyapeelwe kuli ba lupwa lwakwa Koati yali yonse pamo ikumi limo na itatu (13).

english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
translation: Abashele aba mu lupwa lwa mutundu wakwa Koati bapeelwe imisumba ikumi limo iyapendelwe ukufuma kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase.

english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
translation: Kabili ku bana bakwa Geshoni, ku ndupwa shabo shonse, bapeelwe imisumba ikumi limo na itatu (13) ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Isaka, Asheri elyo na Naftali, no kufuma ku luko lwakwa Manase mu Bashani.

english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Merari, ku ndupwa shabo shonse, bapeelwe imisumba ikumi limo na ibili (12) ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Rubeni, Gadi elyo na Sebuloni.

english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli efyo bapeele abena Levi imisumba pamo ne fitungu ifyashingulukako ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa.

english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
translation: Elyo ukufuma ku nko shakwa Yuda, Simeoni elyo na Benjamini babapeele imisumba ukupitila mukupendula yonse iyilumbwilwe amashina yaiko.

english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translation: Bamo aba mu lupwa lwa bana bakwa Koati bapeelwe imisumba ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Efulemu.

english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
translation: Meraioti afyele Amaria, elyo Amaria nao afyala Ahitubi,

english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
translation: Ahitubi afyele Sadoki, elyo Sadoki afyala Aimasi.

english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
translation: Aimasi afyele Asariya, elyo Asariya nao afyala Yohanani.

english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
translation: Abana bakwa Isaka bali ni Tola, Pua, Yashubu na Shimuroni bonse pamo bali bane.

english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation: Umwana wakwa Yediyaeli ali ni Biluani.

english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
translation: Aba bonse bana bakwa Yediyaeli bali ni ntungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo. Bali impendwa amakana ikumi limo na cine lubali ne myanda ibili (17,200) abaume ababulamba abengaya mukulwa inkondo.

english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
translation: Abena Shupimu na bena Hupimu bali abana bakwa Iri, elyo abena Hushimu bali abana bakwa Aheri.

english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
translation: Abana bakwa Naftali bali ni Yasieli, Guni, Yesa na Shilemu, abo bonse ba mu lupwa lwakwa Bilua.

english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
translation: Aba mu ndupwa shakwa Manase, mu mukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga umwina Aramu, afyelemo Asirieli elyo na Makiri wishi wakwa Gileadi.

english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
translation: Makiri aupile umwanakashi ukufuma ku bena Hupi na bena Shupi. Ishina lyakwa Makiri ni Maaka. Umwana wakwa Makiri uwacibili ni Selofeadi, uwakwetefye abana abanakashi beka beka.

english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
translation: Maaka umukashi wakwa Makiri afyele umwana amwinike ishina lya Pereshi. Ndume yakwe balemwita ishina lya Shereshi elyo na bana bakwe ni Ulamu na Rakemu.

english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
translation: Umwana wakwa Ulamu ali ni Bedani.

english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation: Nkashi yakwe Hamoleketi afyele Ishihodi, Abiesa na Maila.

english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
translation: Elyo abana bakwa Shemida bali ni Ahiyani, Shekemu, Likihi elyo na Aniamu.

english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
translation: Abana bakwa Tola ni Usi, Rafaiya, Yerieli, Yamai, Yibusamu na Shemueli abali ntungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo. Mu nshita ya bufumu bwakwa Davidi, aba mu lupwa lwakwa Tola abaume babulamba abapendelwe ukuba abakulwa inkondo bali amakana amakumi yabili na yabili ne myanda mutanda (22,600) ukulingana no butantiko bwa kufyalwa kwabo.

english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Efulemu ni aba. Shutela afyele Beredi, nao Tahati ewali umwana wakwe, nao Eleada ewali umwana wakwe,

english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
translation: nao Sabadi ewali umwana wakwe, nao Shutela ewali umwana wakwe.

english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
translation: Shibo Efulemu alibalooseshe pa nshiku ishingi elyo bamunyina baishile mukumutalalikako.

english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
translation: Kabili ilyo bakumene no mukashi wakwe, alimite no kufyala umwana. Elyo amwinika ne shina lya Beria pantu mwacitika ububi mu ba mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
translation: Ishina lya mwana wakwe umwanakashi ali ni Shera, uwakuulile Beti Horoni ya pamulu elyo ne ya pesamba ukulundapo na Useni Shera.

english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
translation: Kabili Rafa ewali umwana wakwe, na Reshefi nao ewali umwana wakwe, Tela nao ewali umwana wakwe, Tahani nao ewali umwana wakwe,

english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
translation: Ladani nao ewali umwana wakwe, Amihudi nao ewali umwana wakwe, Elishama nao ewali umwana wakwe,

english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
translation: Nuni nao ewali umwana wakwe elyo Yoshua nao ewali umwana wakwe.

english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
translation: Impanga shabo ne ncende shakwikalamo kwalundile Betele ne mishi iyashingulwike, ku kabanga ni Narani, ku masamba nako ni Gesa ne mishi iyashingulwike, Shekemu ne mishi yauko, ukuyafye mpaka na ku Aya ne mishi yauko.

english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
translation: Ukukonka imipaka ya bana bakwa Manase kwali imisumba ya ku Beti Shani, Tanaki, Megido na Dori pamo ne mishi yauko. Umu emwaleikala abana bakwa Yosefu, mwana Israeli.

english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
translation: Umwana wakwa Usi ali ni Israiya.

english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
translation: Abana bakwa Asheri bali ni Imuna, Ishifa, Ishifi elyo na Beria, elyo nkashi yabo ishina lyakwe ni Sera.

english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
translation: Abana bakwa Beria ni Heberi na Malikieli uwali wishi wakwa Bisaiti.

english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
translation: Elyo Heberi afyele Yafuleti, Shoma na Hotamu elyo na nkashi yabo Shua.

english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
translation: Abana bakwa Yafuleti bali ni Pasaki, Bimali na Ashifati, aba ebali abana bakwa Yafuleti.

english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
translation: Abana bakwa munyina Shoma bali ni Ahi, Roga, Hubi na Aramu.

english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation: Elyo abana bakwa munyina Helemu bali ni Sofa, Imuna, Sheleshi na Amali.

english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation: Abana bakwa Sofa bali ni Sua, Hanefa, Shuali, Beri, Imura,

english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation: Besa, Hodi, Shama, Shilisha, Itirani na Bera.

english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation: Abana bakwa Yete ni Yefune, Pisipa na Ara.

english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation: Abana bakwa Ula bali ni Ara, Hanieli na Risia.

english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
translation: Ukulingana no mwapendelwe aba mu mayanda ya bashibo abakwete abaume ababulamba bali amakana amakumi yatatu na mutanda (36,000) abaipekanya ukulwa inkondo, pantu balikwete abakashi abengi elyo na bana abengi.

english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
translation: Aba bonse bali bana bakwa Asheri, intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo abaume abasalwa, impalume shabulwi kabili intungulushi ishacine. Abaume abengalwa inkondo, abapendelwe ukulingana no butantiko bwa kufyalwa kwabo bali amakana amakumi yabili na mutanda (26,000).

english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
translation: Abaume babulamba abengalwa inkondo aba mu ndupwa sha mikowa yakwa Isaka abapendelwe ukulingana no butantiko bwa kufyalwa kwabo bali amakana cine konse konse na makana cine lubali (87,000) bonse pamo.

english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
translation: Abana batatu abakwa Benjamini bali ni Bela, Beka na Yediyaeli.

english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
translation: Abana bakwa Bela ni Esiboni, Usi, Usieli, Yerimoti na Iri, bonse pamo bali basano. Bali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo kabili bali amakana amakumi yabili na yabili elyo amakumi yatatu na bane (22,034) bonse abakulwa inkondo.

english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
translation: Abana bakwa Beka bali ni Semira, Yoashi, Eliese, Eliyoenai, Omuri, Yerimoti, Abiya, Anatoti na Alemeti. Bonse aba bali abana bakwa Beka.

english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
translation: Pa bapendelwe pali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo elyo na baume babulamba amakana amakumi yabili ne myanda ibili (20,200) abengalwa inkondo.

english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
translation: Benjamini afyele Bela uwali ibeli lyakwe, Ashibeli ewali uwacibili, Ahara nao ewacitatu,

english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
translation: Yeushi, Sakiya na Mima. Aba ebali abana bakwe abaume, intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo.

english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
translation: Muli Hushimu afyelemo Abitubi na Elipalu.

english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
translation: Abana bakwa Elipalu bali ni Eberi, Mishimu, Shemedi uwakuulile Ono na Lodi ne mishi yashingulwike mumbali,

english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
translation: elyo Beria na Shema abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo abaleikala mu Aiyaloni kabili ebatamfishemo abaleikala mu Gati.

english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
translation: Ahio, Sheshaki, Yeremoti,

english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
translation: Sebadiya, Aradi, Ederi,

english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
translation: Mikaeli, Ishipa na Yoha e bana bakwa Beria.

english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
translation: Abana abali bakwa Elipalu ni Sebadia, Meshulamu, Hisiki, Heberi,

english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
translation: Ishimerai, Isilia na Yobabu.

english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
translation: Abana bakwa Shimei bali ni Yakimu, Sikiri, Sabudi,

english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
translation: Noha uwabune elyo Rafa uwacisano.

english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
translation: Elienai, Siletai, Elieli,

english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
translation: Adaiya, Beraiya na Shimurati.

english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
translation: Abana bakwa Shashaki bali ni Ishipani, Eberi, Elieli,

english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
translation: Abudoni, Sikiri, Hanani,

english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
translation: Hamania, Elamu, Antotiya,

english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
translation: Ipideya na Penueli.

english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
translation: Abana bakwa Yerohamu bali ni Shemusherai, Shehariya, Ataliya,

english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
translation: Yareshiya, Eliya na Sikiri.

english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
translation: Aba bonse ebali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo mu nkulo shabo. Kabili baikele mu Yerusalemu.

english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
translation: Wishi wakwa Gibeoni aikele mu Gibeoni. Ishina lya mukashi wakwe ali ni Maaka.

english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation: Abana bakwa Bela bali ni Adda, Gera, Abihudi,

english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
translation: Elyo umwana wakwe ibeli ali ni Abudoni, elyo Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,

english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation: Gedori, Ahiyo, Sekeri,

english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
translation: na Mikiloti uwafyele Shimea. Nabo bene baikele mupepi na bamunyinabo mu Yerusalemu.

english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation: Neri ewafyele Kishi, Kishi nao afyala Saulo. Elyo Saulo nao e wishi wakwa Yonatani, Malikishua, Abinadabu na Eshi Baali .

english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
translation: Umwana wakwa Yonatani ali ni Meribu Baali nao ewafyele Mika.

english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation: Abana bakwa Mika ni Pitoni, Meleki, Tarea na Ahasi.

english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
translation: Kabili Ahasi afyele Yehoada, Yehoada nao ewafyele Alemeti, Asimafeti na Simuri. Elyo Simuri nao ewafyele Mosa.

english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
translation: Mosa ewafyele Binea, Binea nao ewafyele Rafaya elyo Rafaya nao ewafyele Eleasa, na Eleasa ewafyele Aseli.

english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
translation: Aseli akwete abana mutanda, na mashina yabo ni aya: Asirikamu, Bokeru, Ishimaeli, Sheariya, Obadia na Hanani. Aba bonse bali ni bamwana Aseli.

english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
translation: Kabili abana bakwa Esheki munyina bali ni Ulamu ibeli lyakwe, Yeushi uwacibili elyo Elifeleti nao ewacitatu.

english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation: Abishua, Namani, Ahoa,

english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
translation: Abana bakwa Ulamu bali abantu impalume shabulamba mukulwa inkondo, abacenjela mukubomfya amata. Balikwete abana na beshikulu abengi, bonse pamo bali umwanda umo na makumi yasano (150).

english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation: Gera, Shefufani na Huramu.

english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
translation: Aba ebali abana bakwa Ehudi abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo abaleikala mu Geba elyo babatamfisha ku Manahati.

english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
translation: Amashina yabo ni Namani, Ahiya na Gera uwabatamfishe. Kabili ewafyele Usa na Ahiudi.

english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
translation: Kabili Sharaimu ashele afyala abana mu Moabu panuma yakutamfya abakashi bakwe Hushimu na Bara.

english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
translation: Mu mukashi wakwe Hodeshi, afyelemo Yobabu, Sibia, Mesha, Malikamu,

english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
translation: Abena Israeli bonse batantikwe ukulingana no mwakonkanine icifyalilwa cabo, pamo ngefyo calembwa mu fitabo fya shamfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
translation: Muli bashimapepo bali ni Yedaiya, Yehoiyabu na Yakini.

english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
translation: Asaria mwana Hilikiya mwana Meshulamu, nao mwana Sadoki, umwana wakwa Meraiyoti, umwana wakwa Aitubi, cilolo uwali mukalamba mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
translation: Adaiya mwana Yerohamu, umwana wakwa Pashuri, mwana Malikiya elyo na Masai mwana Adieli, umwana wakwa Yasera, mwana Meshulamu, umwana wakwa Meshilemiti mwana Imeri.

english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
translation: Bashimapepo abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo, bali ikana limo, imyanda cine lubali na makumi mutanda (1,760). Bali abaume icine cine, abacishinka mukubomba imilimo mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
translation: Mu bena Levi bali ni aba.

english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
translation: Bakibaka, Hereshi, Galali na Matanya mwana Mika, umwana wakwa Sikiri mwana Asafu.

english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
translation: Obadia umwana wakwa Shemaiya, umwana wakwa Galali, umwana wakwa Yedutuni, na Berekiya mwana Asa, umwana wakwa Elikana uwaikele mu mishi ya bena Netofa.

english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
translation: Bakalinda wa pa mpongolo bali ni Shalumu, Akubu, Talimoni elyo na bamunyinabo. Shalumu ewali umukalamba wa bakalinda wa pa mpongolo,

english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
translation: uyo ukufika na pali nomba eminina pa mpongolo ya kwisano iyabela ku kabanga. Aba ebali bakalinda wa mpongolo ku nkambi iya bena Levi.

english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
translation: Shalumu mwana Kore, umwana wakwa Ebiyasafu, umwana wakwa Kora na bakasunga wa mpongolo babiye abafumine mu lupwa lwakwe ulwa bena Kora, ebali ne ncito yakulonda apakwingilila mwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe, ngefyo ifikolwe fyabo efyalelonda kale pa mwinshi wa kwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe

english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
translation: Nomba abantanshi ukubwelela mu fifulo fyabo na mu misumba yabo bali bamo aba mu bena Israeli, bashimapepo, abena Levi na babomfi ba mwi Tempele.

english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
translation: Mu nshita shakale, Fineasi mwana Eleasa ewali umukalamba wa bakalinda wa pa mpongolo, kabili Yawe ali nankwe.

english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Sakaria mwana Meshelemiya ewali kalinda wa pa mwinshi wakwingilila mwi Tenti lyakukumaninamo.

english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
translation: Bonse pamo abasalilwe ukuba bakalinda wa pa mpongolo bali imyanda ibili ikumi limo na babili (212). Balembelwe ukulingana ne nkulo ya kufyalwa kwabo mu mishi yabo. Bakalinda wa mpongolo basontelwe ukuba mu fifulo fyacishinka kuli Davidi na Samwele kamona.

english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
translation: Bena pamo na bana babo ebaba ne milimo yakulonda pa mpongolo sha mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, iŋanda iyitwa Itenti lyakwa Yawe.

english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
translation: Bakalinda wa pa mpongolo baleiminina mu ncende shine, ku kabanga, ku masamba, ku kapinda ka ku kuso elyo na ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
translation: Kabili bamunyinabo abaikele mu mishi balaisa mu nshita mu nshita mukukomboshanya imilimo pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
translation: Lelo intungulushi sha bakalinda wa pa mpongolo, abali abena Levi, bena bapeelwe imilimo yakubaka imiputule na matala ya cuma aya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
translation: Kabili baleikala ubushiku bonse balelonda iŋanda yakwa Lesa, pantu ebalifye ne nsambu shakulonda, ne nsambu shakwisulako cila lucelo.

english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.
translation: Bamo aba muli bena ebali no mulimo wakusunga ifipe ifyakubomfya mu nshita ya mapepo mwi Tempele. Ebakufipenda lintu bafileta na pakufibweseshamo.

english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
translation: Bambi nabo bapeelwe mulimo wakusunga ifipe elyo na fimbi fyonse ifya mu cifulo camushilo, pamo pene no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino no mwangashi, na mafuta, ububani ne fyanunka ubusaka.

english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
translation: Lelo ni bashimapepofye bamo ebakwete insambu shakusakanya ifyanunka ubusaka.

english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
translation: Umwina Levi umo ishina lyakwe Matitiya uwali beli lyakwa Shalumu umwina Kora, ewapeelwe umulimo wakupanga umukate wa mutuulo.

english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
translation: Bamunyina bamo aba mu bena Koati ebapeelwe umulimo wakupekanya imikate yakutantama petebulo cila Sabata.

english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
translation: Abali bakemba, abakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Levi, bena baleikala mu miputule ya mwi Tempele kabili balibaleseshe no kubomba imilimo imbi pantu bena bali nokubomba milimo yabo akasuba no bushiku.

english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
translation: Bonse aba bali abakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Levi, intungulushi ukulingana ne nkulo ya kufyalwa kwabo, elyo baikele mu Yerusalemu.

english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
translation: Yeli wishi wakwa Gibeoni aikele mu Gibeoni. Ishina lya mukashi wakwe ali ni Maaka,

english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation: elyo umwana wakwe ibeli ali ni Abudoni. Pakonka Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,

english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
translation: Gedori, Ahio, Sakaria elyo na Mikiloti.

english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
translation: Mikiloti ewali wishi wakwa Shimeamu. Nabo bene baikele mupepi na bamunyinabo mu Yerusalemu.

english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation: Neri ewali wishi wakwa Kishi, Kishi nao wishi wakwa Saulo, elyo Saulo nao wishi wakwa Yonatani, Malikishua, Abinadabu na Eshi Baali .

english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
translation: Nehem 11:4-19

english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
translation: Umwana wakwa Yonatani ali ni Meribu Baali , uwali wishi wakwa Mika.

english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation: Abana bakwa Mika bali ni Pitoni, Meleki, Tarea elyo na Ahasi.

english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
translation: Ahasi ewafyele Yada, nao Yada afyele Alemeti, Asimafeti na Simuri. Simuri ewali wishi wakwa Mosa.

english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
translation: Nao Mosa aba wishi wakwa Binea, nao afyala Refaiya, nao afyala Eleasa elyo nao afyala Aseli.

english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
translation: Aseli akwete abana mutanda, na mashina yabo yali ni Asirikamu, Bokeru, Ishimaeli, Sheariya, Obadiya na Hanani. Aba ebali abana bakwa Aseli.

english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
translation: Mu bena Shiloni bali ni Asaiya ibeli lyakwe elyo na bana bakwe.

english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
translation: Mu bana bakwa Sera ni Yeueli.

english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
translation: Mu bana bakwa Benjamini ni Salu mwana Meshulamu, mwana Hodafiya, mwana Hasenuya.

english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
translation: Ibineya mwana Yerohamu,

english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
translation: Kabili bamunyinabo abena Benjamini bapendelwe ukulingana ne nkulo ya kufyalwa kwabo, bali imyanda pabula, amakumi yasano na mutanda (956). Bonse aba ebali intungulushi sha mu mayanda ya bashibo.

english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
translation: Bamunyinane, ndefwaya ukumwibukishako ifyacitike ku fikolwe fyesu. Baletungululwa ne kumbi ilyalebacingilila. Kabili pakwabuka bapitile muli bemba.

english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
translation: Twilailishanya nga filya bamo balecita, kabili malaika wakubonaula aishile balofya.

english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
translation: Kanshi umuntu onse uitunga ukukosa mu cisumino, nacenjele epali limbi awila mukubifya.

english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
translation: Ukutunkwa konse ukumwishila, kutunkwafye uko abantu bonse batunkwako. Pantu Lesa wacishinka, tekuti aleke mutunkwe ukucila pa maka yenu. Lelo intunko nga shamwishila, akulamupeela amaka yakushipikisha, epakumona ukwansha isho ntunko.

english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane, talukeni kukupepa utulubi.

english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
translation: Ndelanda kuli imwe nga ku bamano, kanshi ipinguleni mwe bene pali ifyo nalanda.

english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
translation: Ilyo tunwa ku lukombo lwa pakutasha Lesa, bushe ninshi tatulekuma ku mulopa wakwa Kristu? Elyo nelyo tulya umukate tumokaula, bushe ninshi tatulekuma ku mubili wakwa Kristu?

english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
translation: Pantu kwaba umukate umo. Elyo na ifwe bonse tulyako umukate umo wine. Kanshi na ifwe nangu tube abengi, twaba umubili umo.

english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
translation: Shimoneni ificita abena Israeli. Bena abo abalyako ku fituulilwe pa bulambo, balakuma na kukutumika Lesa ku bulambo.

english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
translation: Bushe nalosha mwi? Bushe calola mukutila ifyakulya batuula ku tulubi filabomba akantu? Nangu akalubi, bushe cintu cacine?

english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
translation: Ni mwikumbi line ilyo na muli bemba emo babatishiwe ukuba abantu bakwa Mose.

english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
translation: Awe iyoo! Nalosha mukuti amalambo ya bantu abashaishiba Lesa bayatuulafye ku mipashi yakowela, tekuli Lesa iyoo. Kanshi tekuti ntemwe ukuti muleampana ne mipashi yakowela.

english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
“All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
translation: Umo kuti atila, “Calisuminishiwa ukucita ifintu fyonse.” Lelo te fyonse fingatuwamina. “Calisuminishiwa ukucita ifintu fyonse.” Lelo te fyonse fingatwafwilisha.

english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
translation: Kanshi takuli nakuba nelyo umo uwakuisakamanafye umwine, kano nokusakamana abanankwe.

english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
translation: Mulelya inama shonse isho bashitisha pa cisankano. Tacilingile ukwipusha amepusho yakumusakamika mu mitima yenu.
