english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
translation: Umuntu uushasumina muli Kristu nga amwita ku cakulya, elyo na imwe mwasumina ukuyako, muye mulyeko fyonse ifyo amutebeta. Mwitampa ukwipusha amepusho ayakumusakamika imitima.

english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”
translation: Nomba umo nga amweba ati, “Ifi fyakulya fintu batuula ku tulubi.” Lyena ninshi tekuti mulyeko, pa mulandu wa uyo muntu uwamweba na pa mulandu wakusakamana mu mutima.

english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
and all ate the same spiritual food;
translation: Bonse balelya icakulya cimo cine ico Lesa alebapeela.

english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
translation: Nga natasha Lesa pa cakulya nalya, nga nani enganjebaula pali ico nalya icakulya ico ntashishepo Lesa?

english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
translation: Kanshi fyonse ifyo mulecita, cibe kulya nangu ukunwa, fyonse muleficita pa mulandu wakulumbanya Lesa.

english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
translation: Mu bumi bwenu mwilacita cintu icakulenga umuntu ukubifya ku Bayuda, nangu ku Benafyalo, nangu ni ku lukuta lwakwa Lesa lwine.

english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
translation: Mulecita ifyo ncita. Ine mfwaya ukusansamusha umuntu onse muli fyonse ifyo ncita. Nshicita ifyakuiwaminafye ne mwine, lelo ncita ifyakuwamina bonse, pakuti bonse bakapusuke.

english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
translation: Elyo bonse balenwa ne cakunwa cimo cine ico Lesa alebapeela ukuti balenwa. Balenwa ukufuma ku libwe lyakwa Lesa ilyalebakonka uko baleya. Elyo ne lyo libwe ni Kristu umwine wine.

english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
translation: Nomba nangu cali ifyo, abengi tabalewamya kuli Lesa, ne fitumbi fyabo fyashelefye nsale nsale mu matololo.

english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
translation: Ukuf 17:6

english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
translation: Twilapepa tulubi nga filya bamo pali bena balecita. Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Abantu balikele kukulya na kukunwa, kabili baima balayangila imilungu yabo.”

english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
translation: Twilawila mu bulalelale nga filya bamo balecita, kabili mu bushiku bumofye pafwa abantu amakana amakumi yabili na yatatu (23,000).

english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
translation: Twilaesha Imfumu nga filya bamo bacitile, kabili insoka shalibepeye.

english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
translation: Mulempashanya nga filya ine mpashanya Kristu.

english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
translation: Pa mulandu wa bamalaika, umwanakashi afwile ukukwata icakufimba ku mutwe, nge cishibilo ca nsambu shakwe.

english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
translation: Lelo mukwampana ne Mfumu mwena, umwaume alakabila umwanakashi, elyo umwanakashi nao alakabila umwaume.

english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
translation: Pantu nga filya umwanakashi abumbilwe ukufuma ku mwaume, efyo nomba umwaume afyalwa ku mwanakashi. Kabili ifintu fyonse fyatula kuli Lesa.

english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
translation: Nomba pinguleni mwe bene, bushe kuti calolamo umwanakashi kukupepa Lesa ukwabula ukufimba ku mutwe?

english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
translation: Bushe tefyo efintu tumona ukuti umwaume nga ateka ifimishishi ifingi cansoni nganshi?

english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
translation: Lelo umwanakashi nga ateka imishishi iyitali, wena cakumuyemfya. Pantu imishishi apeelwa yakumufimba.

english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
translation: Lelo umo nga alacita ifikansa pafyo nalanda, kwena ifwe e lutambi twaishiba, elyo ne nkuta shakwa Lesa shonse nasho e lutambi shikonka.

english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
translation: Mu mashiwi ya fyakukonka nalamweba, nshilemutasha iyoo, pantu ukulongana kwenu kukupepa takumuwamya, kumubifyafye.

english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
translation: Icakubalilapofye, nalyumfwa ukuti kulaba ukupusana ilyo mulongana kukupepa. Kwena nalisumina ukuti fimo pali ifyo naumfwa fyacishinka.

english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
translation: Elyo ukupusana kwena kuli nokubako, epakwishiba bwino bwino abacishinka pali imwe.

english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
translation: Ine ndemutasha pali ico lyonse mulanjibukisha. Kabili mulabaka na mafunde namushilile.

english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
translation: Kanshi ilyo mulongana pamo, tamulongana kukulya umulalilo wa Mfumu iyoo.

english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
translation: Pantu pakulya, cila muntu atampa alalya icakulya cakwe, bamo bekala ne nsala, elyo bambi bena balekolwa.

english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
translation: Bushe tamwaba na mayanda yakulilamo no kunwenamo? Bushe nalimo lukuta lwakwa Lesa mwasuula? Nangu nalimo kufwayafye ukuti abalanda bekatwe ne nsoni? Bushe finshi ningamwebapo pali ici? Bushe muleti kumutasha? Awe iyoo tekuti mutashe!

english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
translation: Pantu ici eco napokelele ku Mfumu, kabili eco namushila. Neci cakuti, icungulo ubushiku bwine Imfumu Yesu yaposelwemo ku balwani, yabuulile umukate.

english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
translation: Elyo yatasha Lesa, yaumokola, yasosa nokuti, “Uyu mubili wandi uo nalapeela kuli imwe, mukalecita ifi pakunjibukisha.”

english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
translation: Mu musango umo wine ilyo bapwa ukulya, Yesu abuula ulukombo, asosa ati, “Uyu mwangashi uli mu lukombo e cipangano cipya ica mulopa wandi. Lyonse ilyo mukalanwa, mukalecita ifi pakunjibukisha.”

english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
translation: Kanshi ilyo mulelya uyu mukate no kunwa umwangashi muli ulu lukombo, ninshi mulebila imfwa ya Mfumu, mpaka ikabwele.

english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
translation: Eico kanshi onse uwalya uyu umukate, nangu anwa kuli ulu lukombo lwa Mfumu mu musango uushilingile, ninshi acita umusaalula ku mubili na ku mulopa wa Mfumu.

english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
translation: Kanshi pakubala umuntu aleimona nga nalinga, elyo alyeko umukate no kunwako ku lukombo.

english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
translation: Pantu umuntu uwalya no kunwa, ukwabula ukwiluka bwino pa mulandu wa mubili wa Mfumu, ninshi wena kukandwa kwakwe alya no kunwa.

english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
translation: Nomba ndefwaya ukuti mumfwikishe ukuti Kristu e mutwe wa mwaume onse. Elyo umwaume nao e mutwe wa mwanakashi wakwe. Elyo Lesa nao e mutwe wakwa Kristu.

english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
translation: Eico kanshi pali imwe, abengi balwele kabili balinakuka, elyo bambi balifwa nokufwa.

english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
translation: Nomba ilyo Imfumu itupingula nokutusalapusha, ni pakuti twikakandilwa pamo na bantu ba cino calo.

english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane, nga mwalongana kukulya umulalilo wa Mfumu, mulepembela abanenu.

english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
translation: Uyo onse uuli ne nsala, kuti alila kumwakwe, epakuti ukulongana kwenu kwikalenga ukuti mube no mulandu. Imilandu imbi yena nkesa mweba ifyakucita nga naisa.

english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
translation: Kanshi umwaume onse nga alepepa nangu alesesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa nafimba ku mutwe, ninshi alesebanya umutwe wakwe.

english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
translation: Elyo umwanakashi onse nao nga alepepa nangu alesesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, ukwabula ukufimba ku mutwe, ninshi alesebanya umulume, umutwe wakwe. Pantu uyu wena cimo cinefye no mwanakashi uubeya ulukuso.

english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
translation: Pantu umwanakashi nga talefimba ku mutwe calingafye nokuti abeye ulukuso. Apo cansoni ku mwanakashi ukubeya imishishi nangu ulukuso, kanshi alefimba ku mutwe.

english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
translation: Umwaume wena tali nakufimba nelyo cimo ku mutwe, pantu aba e cata cakwa Lesa, alenga nokuti ubucindami bwakwa Lesa bumoneke. Umwanakashi ena e bucindami bwa mwaume.

english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
translation: Pantu Lesa tabumbile umwaume ukufuma ku mwanakashi, lelo umwanakashi ewabumbilwe ukufuma ku mwaume.

english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
translation: Pantu umwaume tabumbilwe pa mulandu wa mwanakashi, lelo umwanakashi wena abumbilwe pa mulandu wa mwaume.

english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
translation: Nomba bamunyinane, ndefwaya ukuti mwishibe bwino bwino pa mulandu wa bupe Mupashi Wamushilo apeela.

english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
translation: Umbi, Mupashi amupeela amaka yakucita ifipeshamano, umbi amupeela bukasesema, umbi amupeela ukwishiba ukusobolola imipashi nga isuma nangu ibi. Umbi, Mupashi amupeela ubupe bwakulanda indimi ishalekana lekana, elyo umbi wena ukulondolola ifyalandwa muli isho indimi.

english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
translation: Fyonse ifi ni Mupashi umo wine eufibomba. Kabili eupeela ubupe kuli cila muntu, umo umwine alefwaila.

english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
translation: Kristu aba ngo mubili wa muntu. Umubili wa muntu wakwata ifilundwa ifingi. Lelo nangu wakwata ifilundwa ifingi, fyonse fipangafye umubili umo.

english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
translation: Eifyo fine na ifwe bonse, Abayuda nangu Abenafyalo, abasha nangu abantungwa, bonse twabatishiwa kuli Mupashi umo wine ukuba umubili umo. Kabili bonse balitunwesha Mupashi umo wine mu myeo yesu.

english: For the body is not one member, but many.
translation: Pantu umubili tawapangwa na cilundwa cimofye, lelo wakwata ifilundwa ifingi.

english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
translation: Ulukasa nga lwatila, “Ine nshili cisansa, kanshi nshili cilundwa ca mubili,” bushe ico ecingalenga ukuti ulukasa lukaane ukuba icilundwa ca mubili?

english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
translation: Elyo ukutwi nako nga kwatila, “Ine nshili linso, kanshi nshili cilundwa ca mubili,” bushe ico ecingalenga ukuti ukutwi kukaane ukuba icilundwa ca mubili?

english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
translation: Umubili onse aubafye ilinso nga kuti walaumfwa shani? Kabili umubili onse aubafye ukutwi, nga kuti walanunsha shani?

english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
translation: Nomba Lesa wena abika ifilundwa fya mubili cimo cimo mu ncende alefwaya ukuti fibelemo.

english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
translation: Ifilundwa fyonse ifya mubili afibafye icilundwa cimo, ninshi nga tekuti kube umubili.

english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
translation: Mwibukishe ilyo mwali tamulaishiba Lesa, ifyo mwalekonkelela ukupepa utulubi, ifintu ifyabula na maka yakulanda.

english: But now they are many members, but one body.
translation: Lelo ngefyo caba, ifilundwa fyena fyaba ifingi, nomba umubili wena wabafye umo.

english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
translation: Kanshi ilinso tekuti lyebe icisansa aliti, “Nshilekukabila iyoo!” Nangu umutwe tekuti webe amakasa auti, “Nshilemukabila iyoo!”

english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
translation: Mu cacine, ifilundwa ifimoneka ukuti tafyakosa, ifi e filundwa tukabila nganshi.

english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
translation: Kabili ifilundwa ifyo tumona ukuti tafyacindama, ifi e filundwa tusakamana nganshi. Elyo ifilundwa fya mubili ifituletela insoni, fyena tulafifwika bwino bwino.

english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
translation: Nomba ifilundwa ifimoneka bwino fyena tatufisakamana. Ni Lesa ewapanga umubili icakuti ifilundwa ifikabila umucinshi, alefipeela umucinshi.

english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
translation: Epakuti mu mubili mwilaba kupusana, lelo cila cilundwa cilesakamana ifibiye ngefyo ciisakamana icine.

english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
translation: Icilundwa cimo nga calacula, ne filundwa fimbi fyonse nafyo filacula. Elyo icilundwa cimo nga cacindikwa, ifilundwa fimbi fyonse nafyo filasansamuka.

english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
translation: Imwe bonse pamo, muli mubili wakwa Kristu. Elyo cila umo pali imwe muli cilundwa ca mubili wakwa Kristu.

english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
translation: Lesa alitantikafye bwino fyonse mu lukuta. Abakubalilapo basole, elyo abacibili, bakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, abacitatu ni bakafundisha. Elyo pakonka abacita ifipeshamano, elyo pakonka ababa na maka yakundapa, elyo abasakamana abalanda, elyo intungulushi, elyo na balanda indimi ishalekana lekana.

english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
translation: Bushe bonse basole? Bushe bonse ni bakasesema wa mashiwi yakwa Lesa? Bushe bonse ni bakafundisha? Bushe bonse balacita ifipeshamano?

english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
translation: Kanshi eico ndefwaya mwishibe ukuti, tapaba nangu umo uutungululwa na Mupashi wakwa Lesa engasosa ati, “Yesu nalapishiwe!” Elyo tapaba uwingalanda ati, “Yesu ni Mfumu” kano alatungululwa na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
translation: Bushe ni bonse baba na maka yakundapa? Bushe ni bonse balanda indimi ishalekana lekana? Bushe ni bonse baba no bupe bwakulondolola ifyalandwa mu ndimi ishalekana lekana?

english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
translation: Kanshi mulefwaisha ubupe ubwacindamapo.

english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
translation: Ubupe bwena bwaba imisango ne misango, lelo ni Mupashi umo wine eupeela.

english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
translation: Kwabafye imisango iyingi iyakubombela Imfumu, lelo Imfumu yena yabafye imo.

english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
translation: Kwaliba imisango yakubombelamo iyalekana lekana, lelo ni Lesa umo wine eulenga abantu bonse baibombe yonse.

english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
translation: Mupashi alailanga muli cila muntu, lelo ni kukuwamina bonse.

english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
translation: Umuntu umo, Mupashi amupeela amano mu fyakulanda, umuntu umbi, Mupashi umo wine amupeela ukwiluka mufyo alanda.

english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
translation: Elyo ku muntu umbi wena Mupashi umo wine amupeela icisumino, umbi amupeela amaka yakundapa.

english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
translation: Nangu ningalanda indimi sha bantu ne sha bamalaika, lelo nshikwete citemwiko, ninshi naba nge cela icilewela, nangu nge miwaya iyilelila.

english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
translation: Nomba ilyo icapwililika cikesa, lyena icishapwililika cikafumapo.

english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
translation: Ilyo nali umwaice, nalelanda ngo mwaice, ifintu fyonse nalefimona ngo mwaice. Nomba ilyo nakula naba umukalamba, nalileka imisango yabwaice.

english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
translation: Pa nshita ino tumona Lesa mu cilesha kwati ni filya tumona ifintu mu mulolani. Lelo ilyo lyena tukalashimpanafye amenso. Pa nshita ino naishibapofye fimo fimo, lelo ilyo lyena nkeshiba fyonse bwino bwino, nga filya Lesa anjishiba.

english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
translation: Pa nshita ino tuli nefi fintu fitatu, icisumino, isubilo ne citemwiko. Nomba icacilapo pali ifi fitatu, citemwiko.

english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
translation: Nangu ningakwata ubupe bwakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, naishiba ne nkaama shakwa Lesa shonse, nakwata na mano yonse, nangu ningakwata icisumino conse icakuti ningaseseshako ne mpili, lelo nga nshikwete citemwiko, ninshi ndi cafye.

english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
translation: Nangu ningapeela ifyuma fyandi fyonse kukwafwa abalanda, napeela no mubili wandi ukuti baoce, lelo nga nshikwete citemwiko, ninshi fyonse ifi tafimombele nelyo cimo.

english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
translation: Mu citemwiko mwaba umutekatima kabili no luse. Mu citemwiko tamwaba mufimbila, tamwaba kuitutumuna nangu ukuba na mataki.

english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
translation: Icitemwiko tacaba na miya, nangu ukuba na kaso. Icitemwiko tacaba na cipyu, nangu ukwenda ne cikonko ku mukoshi.

english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
translation: Icitemwiko tacisansamukila mu bubi, lelo cisansamukila mu fyacishinka.

english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
translation: Icitemwiko lyonse tacifupuka, lyonse cacisumino, lyonse cacisubilo, kabili cishipikisha muli fyonse.

english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
translation: Icitemwiko cena cakubelelela. Ukusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa kukapita, ukulanda mu ndimi ishalekana lekana nako kukapwa, elyo no kwishiba kwine nako kukapita.

english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
translation: Pantu twishibafye fimo fimo, no kusesema tusesemafye fimo fimo.

english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
translation: Mulefwaisha ukuba ne citemwiko. Mulefwaisha ubupe bonse Mupashi apeela, no kucila mulefwaya ubupe bwakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
translation: Pano isonde nelyo paba indimi ishalekana lekana, lelo abashishiba balomfwa umo shilolele.

english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
translation: Nomba ine nga nshileumfwa ululimi alelanda umo lulolele, ninshi uyu muntu alelanda aba mwinafyalo kuli ine. Elyo na ine wine ninshi ndi mwinafyalo kuli uyu muntu.

english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
translation: Cimo cine na kuli imwe bene, apo mulefwaisha ukukwata ubupe bwakwa Mupashi, sakamanisheni ukukwata ubupe ubwakuwamina ulukuta.

english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
translation: Eico kanshi uulelanda indimi ishalekana lekana, ali nokulomba Lesa ukuti amupeele na maka yakwishiba umwakwilwila ifyo alelanda.

english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
translation: Nga ndepepa mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, umupashi wandi wena wapepafye bwino, lelo amano yandi yena tayamwenenemo nelyo cimo.

english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
translation: Nga kanshi ndi nokucita shani? Ndi nokupepa mu mupashi wandi, kabili ndi nokupepa na mu mano yandi mwine. Ndi nokwimbila Lesa mu mupashi wandi kabili ndi nokumwimbila na mu mano yandi mwine.

english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
translation: Pantu nga uletasha Lesa mu mupashi obefye, nga uushafundwa uo mulongene nao kukupepa, kuti ayasuka shani “Ameni” kwipepo lyobe ilyakutasha nga teshibe ifyo ulesosa?

english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
translation: Ukuba kwena ipepo lyobe ilyakutasha Lesa lilifye bwino, lelo umunobe wena talilemuwamina nakalya.

english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
translation: Ndetasha Lesa pali ico nalimucila bonse ukulanda indimi ishalekana lekana.

english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
translation: Lelo ilyo tulongene kukupepa, lyena kuti natemwa ukulandafye amashiwi yasano pakuti bomfwe ifyo ndefunda, ukucila ukulanda amashiwi amakana na makana mu ndimi shimbi ishalekana lekana.

english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
translation: Umuntu uulandila mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, te ku bantu alandila, lelo alanda kuli Lesa. Pantu abantu tabaleumfwa ifyo alelanda. Ni ku maka yakwa Mupashi alandila ifya nkaama yakwa Lesa.

english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, mukutontonkanya mwena mwilaba nga baice. Mulepala ngo tunya mukukanabifya. Lelo mukutontonkanya mwena mube abakalamba.

english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
translation: Calilembwa mu Mafunde yakwa Mose ukuti,

english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
translation: Kanshi ubupe bwakulanda indimi ishalekana lekana cishibilo ku bantu abashasumina, tebasumina iyoo. Lelo ukusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa cena cishibilo ku bantu abasumina, tebashasumina iyoo.

english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
translation: Kanshi ilyo ulukuta lonse lwalongana kukupepa, nga bonse mwatampa ukulalanda mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, bushe abantu abashafundwa nangu abashasumina nga baisamo, bushe tekuti batile aba bantu nabapena?

english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti bonse balesesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa elyo umuntu uushasumina nangu uushafundwa nga aisamo, kuti aumfwa amashiwi bonse balelanda yamushinina. Elyo kuti amashiwi yalenga ashininkishe no bubi bwakwe.

english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
translation: Kuti asanga no bubi ubwafisama mu mutima wakwe bwasokoloka. Elyo afukama panshi alapepa Lesa ati, “Cine cine Lesa ali muno pakati kenu!”

english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
translation: Nga kanshi kuti twacita shani, mwe bamunyinane? Ilyo mwalongana kukupepa, umuntu umo alesamuna ulwimbo, umbi eo afunde, umbi nao ashimike amashiwi ayo Lesa amusokolwelele, umbi nao alande mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, elyo pabe no wakwilula ifyalandwa. Nomba fyonse ifi fibe ifyakuwamina ulukuta.

english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
translation: Nga cakuti kwaba abakulanda mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, muleke babili nangu batatu ebo balande, lelo balelekanina pakulanda. Kabili kube umo uwakwilula ifyo balanda.

english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
translation: Nomba nga tapali nelyo umo uwakwilula ifyo alelanda, ninshi ekalefye tondolo, alandefye umwine mu mutima na Lesa.

english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.
translation: Abakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa babe babili nangu batatu, lelo kwena pabe bambi abakupingula pafyo balanda.

english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
translation: Lelo uusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, wena alanda ku bantu, pakuti abafwilisheko, abakoseleshe, kabili abatalalike imitima.

english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
translation: Pa bekele mukupepa, nga umo Lesa amusokolwela amashiwi, ninshi uwacilalanda ekale tondolo.

english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
translation: Mulelekanina bonse pakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Lyena bonse kuti mwasambililako, elyo nefyo balanda kuti fyamukoselesha.

english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
translation: Bakasesema baliba na maka yakwishiba ilyakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa nelyo bashingasesema.

english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
translation: Pantu Lesa tafwaya cimfulunganya kano icibote. Kanshi ngefyo caba konse mu nkuta sha bamushilo,

english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
translation: abanakashi bena bali nokwikalafye tondolo mu nkuta. Pantu bena tacasuminishiwa ukulandapo. Efyo na Mafunde yakwa Mose yatila, umwanakashi ali nokupetamina wiba.

english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
translation: Nga balefwaya ukwipushapo cimo, ninshi kuti baya ipusha abalume babo ku ŋanda kumwabo. Pantu cansoni nganshi umwanakashi ukulanda mu lukuta.

english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
translation: Bushe ni kuli imwe amashiwi yakwa Lesa yatula? Nangu bushe nimwefye mweka yaishila?

english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
translation: Kanshi uyo onse uuletontonkanya ukuti ni kasesema, nangu aliba no bupe bumbi ubo Mupashi amupeela, ashininkishe ukuti ifyo namulembela efyo Imfumu yakonkomesha.

english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
translation: Nga tasakamene ifi, ninshi na imwe mwilamusakamana.

english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
translation: Eico kanshi bamunyinane, sakamaneni ukusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Kabili mwilalesha abalelanda mu ndimi ishalekana lekana.

english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
translation: Umuntu uulanda indimi ishalekana lekana, ubu bupe bwakumuwaminafye umwine. Lelo umuntu uusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, ubu bupe bwena bwakuwamina ulukuta.

english: Let all things be done decently and in order.
translation: Lelo fyonse filecitika bwino bwino kabili ukwabula icimfulunganya.

english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
translation: Ine kwena kuti natemwa ukuti bonse mulelanda indimi ishalekana lekana, lelo kuti natemwishapo ukuti bonse mulesesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Pantu uusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, acila pali uyo uulanda mu ndimi ishalekana lekana, kano ninshi aleilula ifyo alesosa, pakuti ifyo alesosa fimone ukuwamina ulukuta.

english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
translation: Eico kanshi bamunyinane nga naisa kuli imwe ndelanda indimi ishalekana lekana, bushe kuti camuwamina shani? Awe iyoo, kano ninshi namuletela ifyo Lesa alemusokolwela, nangu ifyo alefwaya ukuti mwishibe, nangu ukusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa nangu ifyakumufunda.

english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
translation: Tontonkanyeni pa filimba, ifili nga mutolilo nangu isese, ifintu ifishaba na bumi. Uulelisha nga talelisha bwino, nga nani engeshiba ulwimbo alelisha?

english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
translation: Kabili umuntu uulelisha ipenga, nomba talishishe bwino, nga kuti abantu baipekanya shani ku bulwi?

english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
translation: Eifyo fine na imwe mwe balanda indimi ishalekana lekana, ngo muntu kuti aishiba shani ifyo mulelanda, ngefyo mulelanda tafili fyatunguluka? Bushe ninshi tamuleicushafye ukulanda!

english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
translation: Nomba bamunyinane, ndefwaya ukumwibukishako Imbila Nsuma namushimikile, iyo mwapokelela, kabili iyo mwashintililapo.

english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
translation: Nomba ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa naba fino fine naba. Elyo ne cikuuku Lesa ankwatila calibomba nganshi muli ine. Pantu nalibomba no kucila abasole bambi, nomba kwena tekuti ntile nine, lelo cikuuku Lesa ankwatila ecibomba muli ine.

english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
translation: Kanshi cibe nine nangu basole bambi, ifi fine efyo tushimika. Kabili ifi fine efyo mwasuminamo.

english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
translation: Nomba ifwe tufunda ukuti Kristu alibuuka ku bafwa, nga kanshi bamo pali imwe kuti balasosa shani ukuti abafwa tabakashukuke?

english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
translation: Abafwa nga tabakashukuke, ninshi na Kristu tabuuka ku bafwa.

english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
translation: Mako 16:14

english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
translation: Teico ceka, lelo ninshi na ifwe tubepeshafye Lesa. Pantu ifwe tusosa ukuti cacishinka Lesa alibuusha Kristu ku bafwa. Nomba nga cacine ukuti abafwa tababuuka, ninshi na Kristu wine Lesa tamubuusha ku bafwa.

english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
translation: Elyo nga Kristu tabuukile ku bafwa, ninshi icisumino cenu cafyefye, elyo kabili ninshi mucili mu fyabubifi fyenu.

english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
translation: Elyo na basumine muli Kristu abafwa, ninshi nabo balilobelela.

english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
translation: Yoani 20:19

english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
translation: Iyi Mbila Nsuma naimupususha, kumfwa nga mwaikatisha amashiwi namushimikile. Lelo nga mwasuminefye pa kanwa, ninshi ukusumina kwenu kwafyefye.

english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
translation: Nomba icacishinka cakuti, Kristu alibuuka ku bafwa. Kabili pa bafwa bonse ewabalilapo ukubuuka.

english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
translation: Nga filya umuntu umo ewaleta imfwa, efyo nomba umuntu umo aleta ukushukuka kwa bafwa.

english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
translation: Pantu nga filya bonse tufwa pa mulandu wa cikolwe cesu Adamu, efyo bonse tukabuuka ku bafwa pa mulandu wakusumina Kristu.

english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
translation: Cila muntu akabuuka pa nshita Lesa apima. Uwabalilapo ni Kristu. Elyo panuma ilyo akabwela, elyo na bena Kristu bakabuuka.

english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
translation: Kanshi pa kupwa kwa calo pena, panuma yakucimfya ubufumu bonse, bakateeka bonse na bonse abamaka, elyo akalubwila ubufumu kuli Lesa Wishi.

english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
translation: Pantu Kristu ali nokulateeka mpakafye akacimfye abalwani bakwe bonse.

english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
translation: Elyo no mulwani akalekeleshako ukucimfya ni mfwa.

english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Lesa alilenga na fyonse ukulamukunkwila.” Lelo amashiwi yakuti “fyonse” tacilolele mukuti na Lesa wine uwalengele ici nao ali pali ifyo fintu ifili nokumunakila.

english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
translation: Kanshi ifintu fyonse nga fyanakila Kristu, elyo Mwane wine nao akanakila Wishi uwalenga ukuti ifintu fyonse fimucimbile. Elyo Lesa nao akaleteeka fyonse.

english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
translation: Nomba nga takwaba kushukuka kwa bafwa, bushe calola mwi ico abantu babatishiwa pa malo ya bantu abafwa? Nga cacine abafwa tabakabuuke nakalya, cinshi kanshi abantu babatishiwa pa malo ya bantu abafwa?

english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
translation: Pakubalilapofye icintu icikalamba ico nafundilwe, ico na imwe namushila cakuti Kristu afwilile pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyesu, nga filya calembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
translation: Nga ifwe ni shani? Cinshi twingalaendela lyonse mu busanso bwakulufya imyeo yesu?

english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
translation: Ala bamunyinane, umo shicela nyendafye mu mfwa! Icilumba nakwata pali imwe, nico mwasumina muli Kristu Yesu Imfumu yesu, ecalenga nokuti nande ifi.

english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
translation: Nga cakuti ubulwi ndelwishamo ifiswango fya muno Efeso bwali bwabuntunsefye, bushe finshi ningamwenamo? Nomba abafwa nga tababuuka, ninshi kutilafye, “Natuipakishe no kunwa tunwe, pantu mailo ninshi twafwa.”

english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
translation: Ala mwilabepwa. “Ukwampana na bantu babi, konaula ne mibeele ya bantu basuma.”

english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
translation: Luka 24:34

english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
translation: Bamo kuti baipusha abati, “Bushe abafwa kuti babushiwa shani? Mubili wa musango shani bakabuuka nao?”

english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
translation: Luka 24:36

english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
translation: Kabili ico ubyala, lubutofye, nalimo lwa ŋanu nangu ulubuto lumbifye, taubyala cintu cikamena ku lubuto.

english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
translation: Lesa eulenga ukuti ulubuto lumene lukwate icimuti ico alefwaya. Cila lubuto Lesa eulupeela umusango wa cimuti lwakwata.

english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
translation: Ifintu fyonse ifyabumi tafyaba na musango umo wine uwa munofu. Abantu bakwata umusango umo uwa munofu. Inama nasho shaba no musango wa munofu uwaibela, ifyuni nafyo waliibela, elyo ne sabi nalyo waliibela.

english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
translation: Kabili alishiikilwe, elyo aisa bushiwa pa bushiku ubwalenga shitatu nga filya calembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
translation: Mateo 12:40

english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
translation: Ukubengeshima kwa kasuba kwaliibela. Elyo ukubengeshima kwa mweshi nako kwaliibela, elyo no kwa ntanda nako kwaibela. Kabili ne ntanda shine nasho shalipusana mukubengeshima.

english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
translation: Kanshi ifyo fine efyo cikaba na ku bafwa ilyo bakashukuka. Ilyo bashika umuntu uwafwa, umubili ulabola, nomba ilyo aisa buuka, lyena tewakubola.

english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
translation: Icitumbi ilyo balecishiika, cibafye icintu cafyefye, nomba pakushukuka, cabuuka icacindama. Ilyo balecishiika, ciba icabula amaka, nomba pakubuuka, cabuuka na maka.

english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
translation: Ilyo cashiikwa, cishiikwa no mubili wabumuntu, nomba ilyo caisa shukuka, cabuuka no mubili wamupashi. Nga kwaliba umubili wabumuntu, ninshi kwaliba no mubili wamupashi.

english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Lesa abumbile umuntu wapakubala Adamu, umuntu uwabumi.” Lelo Adamu wa pakulekelesha, wena mupashi uupeela umweo.

english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
translation: Lelo icibalilapo ukwisa te mubili wamupashi, mubili wabumuntu, elyo panuma umubili wamupashi.

english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
translation: Adamu wapakubala afumine kwiloba, wena wa pano calo. Lelo Adamu wacibili wena afumine ku mulu.

english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
translation: Abantu bonse aba pano calo babafye nga Adamu uo Lesa abumbile kwiloba. Aba ku mulu nabo baba nga Yesu uwafumine ku mulu.

english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
translation: Filya twaba ne cata cakwa Adamu uo Lesa abumbile kwiloba, efyo tukaba ne cata cakwa Yesu uwafumine ku mulu.

english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
translation: Esaya 53:5-12

english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
translation: Bamunyinane, ico ndemweba nici cakuti iyi mibili yesu iya munofu no mulopa, yena tayakapyane Bufumu bwakwa Lesa. Pantu icintu icibola tekuti cikume ku cintu icishibola.

english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
translation: Lekeni kanshi mwebeko icankaama. Teifwe bonse tukafwa, lelo bonse tukaluka,

english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
translation: pakulila kwe penga lyakulekelesha mu kashita akanono nga mu kushibawila kwa linso. Pantu ipenga nga lyalila, elyo abafwa bakabuuka, kabili tabakatale abafwa nakabili. Elyo na ifwe fwe bakaba abomi tukalulwa.

english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
translation: Pantu umubili uubola uli nokwalulwa ukuba uushili wakubola. Elyo kabili uyu mubili uwinakufwa, uli nokwalulwa ukuba uushili wakufwa.

english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
translation: Kanshi ilyo umubili uubola ukaluka uushili wakubola, kabili umubili uwinakufwa ukaluka uushili wakufwa, elyo ifyalembwa fikafikilishiwa ifyakuti,

english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
translation: “We mfwa, ngo kucimfya kobe kuli kwi?

english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
translation: Imfwa ifumya amaka yabukali bwaiko ku bubifi. Elyo ububifi nabo bufumya amaka ku Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Kanshi tulifye nokutasha Lesa uwatupeela Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu uwalenga ukuti tukwate amaka yakucimfya.

english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane mwe batemwikwa bandi, muleshangila, mwilatelententa. Mube abakalabana mukubombela Imfumu. Mwalishiba ukuti tamwaba kuicushafye mukubombela Imfumu.

english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
translation: Elyo aishile monekela na ku babwananyina bonse pamo abacilile imyanda isano. Abengi bacili abomi, bamo bena balifwa.

english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
translation: Kabili aishile monekela na kuli Yakobo, elyo panuma aisa monekela na ku basole bonse.

english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
translation: Amalu 16:8-10

english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
translation: Abasole banandi bonse balicindamapo ukucila ine. Ine nshalinga nokuti balenjita umusole, pantu ine nalecusha ulukuta lwakwa Lesa.

english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
translation: Nomba pa musangulo uyo wakwafwilishako abamushilo mu Yerusalemu, pena ndeti mucite ngefyo naebele inkuta sha mu Galatia.

english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
translation: Ilyo Timote akesa uko, mukamupokelele bwino ukwabula icakumutiinya, pantu nao mubomfi wa Mfumu nga ine wine.

english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
translation: Kanshi tapali na kuba nelyo umo uwakumusuula. Lelo mukamwafweko kufyo alekabila pa bulendo, pakuti akabwele umutende kuli ine. Pantu ine ndemulolela ukuti akese na bamunyinefwe.

english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
translation: Nomba pali munyinefwe Apolo, ine imikufye iyingi nalimweba ukuti ese pamo na bamunyinefwe bambi kukumupempula. Lelo umwine talefwaya ukwisa pali ino nshita. Akesa limbi nga amona inshita.

english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
translation: Muleba abaiteyanya. Mube ne cisumino icakosa. Mube abantu abashipa kabili abamaka.

english: Let all that you do be done in love.
translation: Muleba ne citemwiko mu milimo yonse iyo mulebomba.

english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
translation: Bamunyinane mwalishiba bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Stefana. Aba ebabalilepo ukusumina muli Kristu mu calo ca Akaia. Kabili baliipeela nganshi mukubombela abamushilo.

english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
translation: Kanshi ndemupapata mulenakila abantu ba uyu musango, elyo na bonsefye abo babomba nabo umulimo wabutumishi.

english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
translation: Kabili ndi ne nsansa pakumona ukuti Stefana na Fotunato na Akaiko nabesa. Pantu ebamwimininako nga tamuliko.

english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
translation: Awe nabansansamusha nganshi ngefyo na imwe bene bamusansamwishe. Abantu ba musango uyu mulebatasha.

english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
translation: Inkuta sha mu Asia shamuposha. Akwila na Prisila no lukuta ululongana mu ŋanda yabo, bonse bamuposha mwe banakila Imfumu.

english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
translation: Cila bushiku pa Mulungu, cila muntu pali imwe pa fintu amwenenepo, afumyepo fimo, afisunge bwino. Epakuti ilyo nkesa uko, nkasange mwalisangula kale.

english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
translation: Ababwananyina bonse balemuposha. Muleposhanya mukutomona kwamushilo.

english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
translation: Ine, ne Paulo, nalemba no kuboko kwandi aya mashiwi yakumuposha.

english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
translation: Nga paba uushatemwa Mfumu, alapishiwe! Marana tha.

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu Yesu cileba na imwe.

english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
translation: Namutumina icitemwiko candi imwe bonse muli Kristu Yesu.

english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo nkesa uko elyo nkatuma abo mukasala. Nkabapeela na makalata yakubeshibilako ilyo bakalatwala ubupe bwenu ku Yerusalemu.

english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
translation: Nga cakuti mwamona calinga ukuti nkaye nabo, ninshi kuti twaya nabo.

english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
translation: Nkesa uko kumwenu nga napita mu Makedonia. Pantu napanga ukupita mu Makedonia.

english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
translation: Nalimo uko kumwenu nkesa kokolako panono. Nalimo ne nshita yonse iyampepo eko ikampwila. Epakuti mukamone ukungafwilishako pa bulendo bwandi konse uko nkalaya.

english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
translation: Pantu nshilefwaya kumumonapofye mu lupita. Ndefwaya ukwisa ikala nenu inshita ikalamba, nge Mfumu yasuminisha.

english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation: Lelo kwena ndi nokwikala muno mwine mu Efeso mpaka ne nshikunkulu ya Pentekoste.

english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
translation: Pantu kuno kuli ishuko lyakubomba imilimo iyingi nganshi. Lelo na kuno kwine abalwani bena eko bali abengi.

english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
translation: Ine Paulo, Lesa kukufwaya kwakwefye anjita ukuba umusole wakwa Kristu Yesu. Namutumina kalata, tuli pamo na munyinefwe Sositeni.

english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ndemupapata bonse ku maka ya Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ukuti muleumfwana, epakuti kwilaba kupatulukana apo muli. Muli nokuba abaikatana pamo mu mitontonkanishishe yenu kabili aba mutima umo.

english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
translation: Bamunyinane, abantu bamo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Koloe balinshimikilako ukuti pakati kenu paliba ukupusana.

english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
translation: Ico ndeeba nici icakuti, bamo balesosa abati, “Ine ndi wakwa Paulo,” umbi nao ati, “Ine ndi wakwa Apolo,” umbi nao ati, “Ine ndi wakwa Kefa,” elyo umbi nao ati, “Ine ndi wakwa Kristu.”

english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
translation: Bushe Kristu alyakanikana? Bushe ni Paulo ewamutanikilwe pa musalaba? Bushe mwabatishiwe ulubatisho lwakwa Paulo?

english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
translation: Ndetasha na Lesa, nshabatishepo nelyo umo pali imwe kanofye Kilisipo na Gayo.

english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
translation: Eico kanshi tekuti pabe nelyo umo wingalanda ukuti abatishiwe mu lubatisho lwandi.

english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
translation: Ee kwena nalibatishe Stefana na ba mu ŋanda yakwe, lelo nshileibukisha nga nalibatishepo na umbi.

english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
translation: Pantu Kristu tantumine kukubatisha, lelo antumine kukubila Imbila Nsuma. Elyo muli uyu mulimo tekulabomfya amashiwi ya mano yabumuntu, epakushininkisha ukuti amaka ya mfwa yakwa Kristu pa musalaba tayonaike.

english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
translation: Pantu ku bantu abalelobelela bena, amashiwi ya pa mfwa yakwa Kristu pa musalaba yabuwelewele. Lelo kuli ifwe fwe bali mukupusuka, maka yakwa Lesa.

english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti,

english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
translation: Twamulembela mwe lukuta lwakwa Lesa mwe ba mu Kolinti. Imwe Lesa alimusangulula no kumwita ukuba abamushilo pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu, pamo pene na bantu bonse mpanga yonse abakuuta ku Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu, Imfumu yabo, kabili Imfumu yesu.

english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
translation: Nga bamano nomba bali kwi? Nga abasambilila Amafunde yakwa Mose na bamano yabuntunse nabo bali kwi? Lesa alilanga ukuti amano yabuntunse buwelewele.

english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
translation: Pantu Lesa umwine mu mano yakwe apekenye ukuti abantu tabali nakumwishiba ku mano yabo ayabuntunse. Lelo Lesa wena asala ukupususha abantu abasumina mu mashiwi tubila ayo batila buwelewele.

english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
translation: Abayuda bena bafwaya ukumona ifishibilo ifyacipeshamano, elyo Abagiriki bena bafwaya amano.

english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
translation: Nomba ifwe tubila Kristu uwatanikwe pa musalaba. Aya mashiwi ku Bayuda cakuipununako elyo ku Benafyalo yabuwelewele.

english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
translation: Lelo kuli abo Lesa aita, Abayuda na Benafyalo, aya mashiwi e Kristu uwaba e maka yakwa Lesa kabili e mano yakwa Lesa.

english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
translation: Pantu ifimoneka ngo buwelewele bwakwa Lesa fyalicilapo pa mano yabumuntu. Elyo ifimoneka ngo bunasha bwakwa Lesa fyalikosapo ukucila amaka yabumuntu.

english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
translation: Bamunyinane ibukisheni ifyo mwali ilyo Lesa amwitile. Pali imwe te bengi bali abamano ukulingana na mano yabuntunse, te bengi bali mu fifulo ifyamaka, elyo kabili te bengi bafumine mu ndupwa ishikankala.

english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
translation: Lelo Lesa asala ifiwelewele fya pano calo pakuti abamano bekatwe ne nsoni. Kabili Lesa asala abanakuka pano calo pakuti abamaka bekatwe ne nsoni.

english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
translation: Lesa asala ifyo abantu ba pano calo bamona ukuti fyafye, ifyo basuula ifishili fintu fine fine, efyakonawilako ifyo abantu ba pano calo bamona ukuti efyacindama.

english: that no flesh should boast before God.
translation: Lesa acita ifyo, epakuti peba muntu nelyo umo uwakuitakisha pa cinso cakwe.

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
translation: Lelo imwe Lesa amulenga ukwampana na Kristu Yesu, uo Lesa alenga ukuba amano yesu. Pa mulandu wakwa Yesu Kristu, Lesa atwalula ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe, abantu bakwa Lesa abamushilo, kabili abalubulwa.

english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Onse uulefwaya ukuitakisha, ali nokuitakishisha muficita Imfumu.”

english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
translation: Lyonse ndatasha Lesa wandi, pa mulandu wa imwe, pantu pa mulandu wakwa Kristu mwalishukila icikuuku cakwa Lesa.

english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
translation: Pantu mu nshilafye shonse, mu milandile yonse na mukwishiba konse, namushukila ubukankala mukuba pamo na Kristu.

english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
translation: Elyo na mashiwi ya bukambone bwesu pali Kristu namuyasunga nganshi.

english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Kanshi eico nomba mushukila ubupe bonse ubwakwa Mupashi Wamushilo ilyo mulelolela ukusokoloka kwa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Ewakulamusunga abashipa mpaka na ku bushiku bwakupelekeshako, pakuti bakamusange abakaele pa Bushiku bwa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation: Lesa tafutuka, ewamwita ukwampana na Mwane Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu.

english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
translation: Bamunyinane ilyo naishile uko kumwenu ndefunda pa fintu fikankala Lesa abomba, nshalebomfya bucenjeshi mukulanda nangu kulanga ukumucila ukucenjela mu mano.

english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
translation: Ifi e fintu Lesa atusokolwela ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwe. Pantu Mupashi alabebeta muli fyonse. Abebeta ne fyafisama fine muli Lesa.

english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
translation: Pantu na ku bantu, uwishiba ifyo umuntu atontonkanya, mupashi wakwe akwata. Kanshi eifyo fine na kuli Lesa, ni Mupashi wakwa Lesa eka, ewaishiba fyonse pali Lesa.

english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
translation: Nomba ifwe te mupashi wa muno calo twapokelela iyoo. Ifwe twapokelela Mupashi uwafuma kuli Lesa, epakuti tuleishiba fyonse ifyo Lesa atupeela.

english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
translation: Eico ifyo tulanda, te fintu fyafundwa na mano ya bantu, lelo ni mu mashiwi Mupashi atufunda, epakuti tulelondolola ifishinka pali Lesa ku bantu ababa na Mupashi.

english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
translation: Umuntu uwabula Mupashi, tekuti apokelele ifintu Mupashi alemweba. Wena afimona ukuti fyabuwelewele. Alafilwa ukufyumfwa, pantu kanofye umuntu uuli na Mupashi Wamushilo ewingafyumfwa.

english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
translation: Umuntu uwaba na Mupashi ewingapingula ifintu fyonse, lelo umwine wena teti pabe nangu umo uwakumupingula.

english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
translation: Pantu ilyo nali na imwe nshalefwaya ukulanga ukwishiba nelyo cimo, kanofye Yesu Kristu uo batanike pa musalaba.

english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
translation: Ilyo naishile uko, nshali uwashipa, lelo nali no mwenso no kututuma naletutuma.

english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
translation: Mu mashiwi yandi na mukubila mwine tamwali mashiwi yamano ayakumusembeleka iyoo, lelo icalemonekamofye maka yakwa Mupashi wakwa Lesa.

english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
translation: Epakuti icisumino cenu cishintililefye pa maka yakwa Lesa te mu mano yabumuntu iyoo.

english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
translation: Lelo ifwe tulanda ifyamano ku bantu abafumaluka mu cisumino. Nomba te mano ya muli cino calo nangu aya bakateeka ba cino calo, abo amaka yabo yalaswa yapwe.

english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
translation: Ifwe tulanda pa mano ya nkaama yakwa Lesa, ayo Lesa afisa ku bantu. Lelo ayo mano Lesa asalile ne calo tacilabako, pakuti na ifwe tushukile ukucindama.

english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
translation: Pali bakateeka ba cino calo tapali nangu umo uwaishiba ayo mano. Pantu abeshiba nga tapali watanike Imfumu yacindama.

english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
translation: Lelo calembwa ukuti,

english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
translation: Bamunyinane, nalifililwe ukulanda kuli imwe nga ku bantu abatungululwa na Mupashi, lelo nalelanda kuli imwe nga ku bantufye, pantu mwalifye utucece mukukonka Kristu.

english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
translation: Lesa ku cikuuku ankwatila, ndabomba nge ncenshi mukukuula. Nalimba umufula, na umbi eulekuulapo. Elyo na onse uulekuulapo, acenjele pakukuulapo.

english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
translation: Kabili tapali nangu umo uwingemba umufula umbi. Umufula waimbwa kale, ni Yesu Kristu.

english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
translation: Lelo imilimo cila muntu abomba ikeshibikwa, pantu Ubushiku bwa Mfumu bukesa isokolola. Ubo Bushiku bukesa no mulilo uwakusokolola imilimo cila muntu abomba. Pantu ni kukupya mu mulilo eko imilimo ya cila muntu abomba ikamoneka ifyo yaba.

english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
translation: Uo ico akuula pa mufula tacakapye na mulilo, ninshi uyo eukapoka icilambu.

english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
translation: Lelo uo ico akuula cikapya, wena akapelwapofye, nangu umwine wena akapusuka kwempe ku mulilo.

english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
translation: Bushe tamwashininkisha ukuti nimwe itempele lyakwa Lesa, na Mupashi wakwa Lesa ekala muli imwe?

english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
translation: Umuntu nga aonaula itempele lyakwa Lesa, nao Lesa akamonaula. Pantu itempele lyakwa Lesa lyamushilo, kabili imwe, imwe bene nimwe tempele lyakwe.

english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
translation: Umuntu nelyo umo elaibepa. Ngo muntu umo pali imwe aleitunga ukuba uwamano, ukulingana na mano ya bantu ba cino calo, atale aisangule impelwamano, elyo ninshi akaba uwamano icine cine.

english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
translation: Pantu amano ya bantu ba cino calo, buwelewele pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Lesa ekatila abamano ku bucenjeshi bwabo bwine.”

english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
translation: Nalemonshafye ibele, nshalemulisha ifyakulya ifyakosa, pantu mwali tamulalinga. Kwena na nombaline tamulalinga.

english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
translation: Elyo pambi napo calembwa ukuti, “Imfumu yalishiba ifitontonkanya abamano, no kwishiba yaishiba ukuti fyabuwelewele.”

english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
translation: Kanshi mwilaitakisha pafyo abantu bacita. Pantu ifintu fyonse fyenu.

english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
translation: Paulo, Apolo, na Kefa, cino calo, ubumi ne mfwa, ifilipo ne fya kuntanshi, fyonse ifi, fyenu.

english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
translation: Nomba imwe muli bakwa Kristu, Kristu nao wakwa Lesa.

english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
translation: Pantu na nomba mucili na mano ya bantu ba cino calo. Pali imwe pacili umufimbila no kulaumana, bushe te manofye ya bantu ba cino calo ayo? Bushe tamulelangafye ukuti muleikalafye nga bantu ba cino calo?

english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
translation: Ilyo umo alasosa ati, “Ine ndi wakwa Paulo,” na umbi nao ati, “Ine ndi wakwa Apolo,” bushe tamulekonkafye amano ya bantu ba cino calo?

english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
translation: Nga kanshi Apolo nani? Nga Paulo nao nani? Aba bonse babomfifye bakwa Lesa, abalenga ukuti musumine. Kwena cila umo ali nokubomba umulimo Imfumu yamupeela.

english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
translation: Ine nalibyala imbuto, Apolo nao aisa tapilila, lelo uwalenga ukuti fikule ni Lesa.

english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
translation: Uulimba no utapilila tabali nelyo cimo, lelo Lesa uulenga fikule ewacindama.

english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
translation: Uulimba no utapilila babombafye umulimo umo wine. Lesa akabalambula ukulingana nefyo cila muntu abombele umulimo wakwe.

english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
translation: Ifwe pamo tulifye ababomfi bakwa Lesa. Elyo imwe muli bala lyakwa Lesa, kabili iŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
translation: Abantu bali nokutwishiba ukuti tuli babomfi bakwa Kristu, abo Lesa apeela umulimo wakwangalila inkaama shakwe.

english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
translation: Ifwe tuli fiwelewele pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, lelo imwe muli bamano ico mwaba na Kristu. Ifwe tatwaba na maka, imwe muli bamaka! Ifwe twalisuulwa, imwe balimucindika!

english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
translation: Ukufika na pali nomba ifwe twendafye ne nsala ne cilaka. Kabili twendafye abasapula no kupumwa, elyo tatwakwata cifulo kulaseulukafye.

english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
translation: Elyo kabili tulanaka nganshi mukuibombela fwe bene. Nga batucitila umusaalula, ifwe tulabapaala. Nga balatucusha, ifwe tulashipikisha.

english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
translation: Nga batutuka, ifwe tubasuka no mutembo. Ukufika na pali nomba twabafye nge fisoso, nge fiseekwa fya pano calo.

english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
translation: Nshilemulembela ifi pakuti mwikatwe ne nsoni, lelo ndemusokakofye ico muli bana bandi abo natemwa.

english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
translation: Pantu nangu mwingakwata bakafundisha amakana na makana abena Kristu, lelo mwakwatafye shinwe umo. Pantu ku maka yakwa Kristu Yesu mwaba abana bandi ico namufunda Imbila Nsuma.

english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
translation: Kanshi eico ndemupapata ukuti mulempashanya.

english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
translation: Fili 3:17

english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
translation: Bamo pali imwe nabatampa ukulaitutumuna ku cilumba. Bena baleti nshakese kukumupempula.

english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
translation: Awe nkesafye bwangu bwangu, Imfumu nga ilefwaya. Elyo nkesa ishiba amaka ya abo bantu baleitutumuna, te fintu basosa iyoo.

english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
translation: Nomba icifwaikwa pali bakangalila, kuba uwacishinka.

english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
translation: Pantu Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa tabwaba mukulandafye, lelo mukubomba na maka.

english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
translation: Cinshi ico mwingatemwapo? Bushe nkese ne cikoti nangu nkese no mutima wa citemwiko no mutembo?

english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
translation: Kwena ine tacinsakamika ukupingulwa na imwe, nangu ukupingulwa ne cilye conse ica bantu. Kabili na ine wine ne mwine nshiipingula iyoo.

english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
translation: Kwena ne mwine nshasanga ukuti nalilufyanya nelyo cimo. Lelo ici tacilepilibula ukuti kanshi ndi wakaele. Ine uwakumpingula ni Mfumu fye yeka.

english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
translation: Pa nshita ino mwilapingula muntu nelyo cimo. Mulepembela inshita ilyo Imfumu ikesa. Lyena elyo Imfumu ikesa sanikila pa fyabelama mu mfifi no kusokolola amapange ayafisama mu mitima ya bantu. Elyo Lesa akatasha cila muntu ukulingana ne milimo abombele.

english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
translation: Bamunyinane, ni pa mulandu wenu nalandila aya mashiwi. Aya mashiwi nayalosha kuli Apolo na ine wine. Ndefwaya tube icilangililo icakumufunda umwalola iyi nsoselo yakuti, “Mulekonka ifyalembwa.” Epakuti mwilaba na cilumba cakuitakisha pa muntu umo no kusuula umubiye.

english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
translation: Bushe nani uwakupeela ubukalamba pali bambi? Ngeco wakwata ico Lesa ashakupeela cinshi? Nga kanshi kuti waitakisha shani, kwati ifyo wakwata tawapeelwafye?

english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
translation: Bushe kanshi mwalikwata kale fyonse ifyo mukabila? Bushe kanshi nomba muli bakankala? Bushe nomba muli mfumu, ifwe tucili abapabi? Ee kwena kuti cawama nga cine cine muli mfumu, epakuti tukabe imfumu pamo na imwe.

english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
translation: Ine mona kwati ifwe, fwe basole nifwe Lesa abika mu ncende yakupelekeshako icine cine, kwati bantu bapingwila ukubepaila pa cinso ca bantu. Kanshi tuli bakutambwa ku fibumbwa fyonse, bamalaika na bantu bene.

english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
translation: Calyumfwika ukuti bamo pali imwe bawila muli bucilende ubwabipisha. Bucilende ubwakuti nangu ni ku bantu abashaishiba Lesa tekuti mubusange. Umo pali imwe alyupa muka wishi.

english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
translation: Nshaloseshe mukutila muletaluka ku bantu ba pano calo bacilende nangu abalunkumbwa lwa fyuma, nangu abapupu nangu abapepa utulubi. Awe pakutaluka kuli aba bantu shikanofye ninshi wafuma muno calo.

english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
translation: Naloseshe mukutila muletaluka ku muntu uwakuti aleti, “Ndi munyinenwe muli Kristu,” lelo kabili ni cilende, nangu walunkumbwa lwa fyuma, nangu alapepa utulubi, nangu wamusaalula, nangu ni cakolwa, nangu ni mpupu. Umuntu wa musango uyo tecakwesha ukwikala nankwe nangu ukulya nankwe.

english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
translation: Tauli mulimo wandi ukulapingula abantu abashili mu lukuta. Lesa umwine eukabapingula.

english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
translation: Lelo aba mu lukuta kuti mwabapingula. Kabili calembwa ukuti, “Tamfyeni umuntu umubi mwibumba lyenu.”

english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
translation: Nga cilumba nshi mwingakwata! Awe cena cifwile ukumuletela ubulanda. Mufwile ukutamfya mwibumba lyenu umuntu uwacita ifyo.

english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
translation: Ine nangu ndi ukutali, mu mupashi mwena tuli na imwe pamo. Kabili umuntu uwacita icabipa ifyo, ine ku maka ya Mfumu Yesu nimupingula kwatifye tuli na imwe.

english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Ilyo mukalongana pamo, na ine mu mupashi tukalongana na imwe. Elyo ku maka yakwa Yesu Imfumu yesu uukaba na ifwe,

english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
translation: tukalubwila uyo muntu kuli Satana akonaule umubili wakwe, pakuti pa Bushiku bwa Mfumu, umupashi wakwe ukapusuke.

english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
