translation: Awe ukuitakisha kwenu takuweme! Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti intutumushi inono itutumuna umufuba onse?

english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
translation: Kanshi fumyeni intutumushi yakale, pakuti mube umufuba upya. Lyena mukaba kwati mufuba upya umwabula intutumushi. Ine nalishininkisha ifyo fine efyo mwaba. Inshikunkulu ye Pasaka lyesu yalipekanishiwa, pantu Kristu umwana wa mpaanga we Pasaka, balimuleka ilambo.

english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
translation: Kanshi natusefye Ipasaka lyesu, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila. Tusefye ukwabulamo intutumushi yakale, intutumushi ibi kabili iyabukakashi, lelo tusefye no mukate uusuma uwacishinka uwabulamo intutumushi.

english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
translation: Muli kalata umbi uo namulembele, namwebele ukuti muletaluka kuli bacilende.

english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
translation: Umo pali imwe nga ali no mulandu no mwina Kristu munankwe, bushe cine kuti atwala umulandu ku bantu abashaishiba Lesa? Bushe tafwile ukutwala umulandu wakwe ku bantu bakwe abamushilo?

english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
translation: nangu abapupu, nangu abalunkumbwa lwa fyuma, nangu bacakolwa, nangu abamusaalula, nangu abacenjesha abanabo, tabakapyane Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
translation: Bamo pali imwe nabo, kale efyo bali. Lelo ku maka ya Mfumu Yesu Kristu na ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwa Lesa mwalisambika, mwalisangululwa, mwaba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
translation: Umo kuti atila, “Ine naliba ne nsambu shakucita fyonse.” Lelo te fyonse fingakuwamina. Kwena naliba ne nsambu shakucita fyonse, lelo nshili nakuleka icintu nelyo cimo ukunteeka ubusha.

english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
translation: Icakulya caba nokuya mwifumo, elyo ifumo nalyo lyaba nokupokelela icakulya. Nomba Lesa nao akafyonaula fyonse fibili. Umubili tewabulalelale iyoo, lelo wakubombela Imfumu. Kabili Imfumu nayo e ine ya mubili.

english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
translation: Lesa ewabusha Imfumu ku bafwa, na ifwe ku maka yakwe eukatubusha.

english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
translation: Bushe imwe tamwaishiba ukuti imibili yenu filundwa fya mubili wakwa Kristu? Bushe nomba kuti nabuula icilundwa ca mubili wakwa Kristu eco nauminkanya ku mubili wakwa cilende? Awe cakaana!

english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti uwauminkana na cilende, ninshi baba nankwe umubili umo? Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Aba babili baba umubili umo!”

english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
translation: Lelo uyo uwauminina ku Mfumu, wena uyo ninshi aba no mupashi umo ne Mfumu.

english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
translation: Talukeni ku bulalelale. Ububifi bumbi bonse umuntu acita, bwacitwa kunse ya mubili, nomba uwacita ubulalelale abifya na ku mubili wakwe wine.

english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti umubili wenu litempele lyakwa Lesa umwikala Mupashi Wamushilo? Mupashi, Lesa amupeela, ekala muli imwe. Kanshi nomba muli bantu bakwa Lesa, tamuikalilafye mwe bene.

english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti abamushilo ebakapingula abantu ba pano isonde? Kanshi apo nimwe mukapingula abantu ba pano isonde, nga kuti mwafilwa shani ukupingula utumilandu utunono?

english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
translation: Imwe Lesa alimushita pa mutengo ukulu. Eico kanshi muli nokucindika Lesa mu mibili yenu.

english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti nifwe bene tukapingula na bamalaika? Palibufi kanshi imilandu ya mu bumi bwesu?

english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
translation: Kanshi ilyo paba imilandu ya musango uyo pakati kenu, bushe elyo mwingatwala imilandu yenu ku bantu abo ulukuta lushacetekela?

english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
translation: Kwena cansoni nganshi! Bushe cine cine pali imwe, tapaba umuntu uwamano uwakuti aleputula imilandu ya basumina?

english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
translation: Nomba imwe, uwabwananyina nga ali no mulandu no wabwananyina munankwe, imwe mutwala umulandu ku bantu abashasumina muli Kristu ebo baye mupingula.

english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
translation: Ala kuli imwe mwe bena Kristu camusebanya nganshi ukulatwalana ku filye fyamilandu. Cinshi ico imwe mushisuulilakofye abanenu nga bamulufyanya nangu nga bamufyengafye?

english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
translation: Ala na imwe bene mulalufyanya no kucenjesha abanenu, kabili babwananyina banenu!

english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti abantu ababifi tabakapyane Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa? Kanshi mwilaibepa, bacilende, nangu abapepa utulubi, nangu abantu ababembuka, nangu abacita ubucende na baume banabo,

english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
translation: Nomba nalayasuka pa milandu mwanembela.

english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
translation: Ku baba mu cupo bena nabapeela icebo, kwena teine, lelo cebo ca Mfumu ukuti umwanakashi tali nakufuma kuli wiba.

english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
translation: Nga cakuti afuma kuli wiba, ninshi ali nokwikala umushimbe, nangu abwele bawikishanye na wiba. Umwaume nao tali nakuleka mukashi wakwe.

english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
translation: Lelo bambi bena bonse nine ndebeba te Mfumu iyoo. Munyinenwe umwina Kristu uwaupa umwanakashi uushasumina Kristu, nomba uyu mwanakashi alefwaya ukuti aleikala nankwe, ninshi umulume tali nakumuleka, iyoo.

english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
translation: Elyo no mwanakashi umwina Kristu uwaupwa ku mwaume uushasumina Kristu, nomba uyu mwaume alefwaya ukuti aleikala nankwe, ninshi umwanakashi tali nakufuma kuli wiba.

english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
translation: Pantu uyu wiba uushasumina alipalamikwa kuli Lesa ico umukashi mwina Kristu. Elyo no mukashi uushasumina alipalamikwa kuli Lesa ico wiba mwina Kristu. Acikaana kuba ifyo abana babo nga kuti baba nga bana ba bashaishiba Lesa, lelo nomba bana abapalamikwa kuli Lesa.

english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
translation: Lelo uushasumina nga akaana ukwikala no mwina Kristu, ninshi lyena kuti balekana. Elyo na munyinefwe umwina Kristu umwaume nangu umwanakashi, ninshi akakulwa. Pantu imwe Lesa amwita kukwikala umutelelwe.

english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
translation: We mukashi umwina Kristu, kuti waishiba shani, limbi niwe ukapususha umwinamobe? Nangu iwe we mulume umwina Kristu, kuti waishiba shani limbi niwe ukapususha umukashi obe?

english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
translation: Cila muntu ali nokwikala ifyo fine Imfumu yamuteyanishisha, ubo bwine bumi Lesa amwitilemo. Kabili ifi fine efyo mfunda ku nkuta shonse.

english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
translation: Uwasembululwa nga aitaba ubwite bwakwa Lesa elaesha ukufisa ukuti alisembululwa. Elyo uushasembululwa nga aitaba ubwite bwakwa Lesa, ninshi nao tali nakusembululwa.

english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
translation: Ukusembululwa kwafye, elyo no kukanasembululwa nako kwafyefye, icikalamba kukonka amafunde yakwa Lesa.

english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
translation: Nomba ubulalelale nabufulisha, kanshi cila mwaume afwile akwata umukashi wakwe. Elyo cila mwanakashi nao afwile akwata umulume wakwe.

english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
translation: Kanshi cila muntu aleikala ifyo ali ilyo talati etabe ubwite bwakwa Lesa.

english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
translation: Bushe wali umusha ilyo waitebe ubwite? Wileka ici cilekusakamika. Lelo nga cakuti washukila ukuba umuntungwa naco cisuma

english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
translation: Pantu umusha uwaitaba ubwite bwa Mfumu, ninshi aba umuntungwa wa Mfumu. Ifyo fine no muntu umuntungwa uwaitaba ubwite bwa Mfumu, ninshi nomba aba umusha wakwa Kristu.

english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
translation: Lesa alimushita pa mutengo ukulu, kanshi mwilaicita abasha ba bantu.

english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
translation: Bamunyinane, cila muntu aleikala pa cinso cakwa Lesa ngefyo ali ilyo aitebe ubwite bwa Mfumu.

english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wa bashimbe pena Imfumu tayalandapo ifunde lyakubeba. Lelo apo Imfumu ku luse lwaiko yanenga ukuba uwacishinka, nalamweba ifyo ine ntontonkanya.

english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
translation: Nga mwalolesha pa mafya ya shino nshiku, ine ndetontonkanya ukuti umuntu kuti camuwamina ukwikala ifyo aba.

english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
translation: Bushe walyupa? Wiesha kutamfya mukashi obe. Nga tawaupa, wifwaya ukuti uupe.

english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
translation: Lelo nga waupa, ninshi taubifishe. Elyo no mukashana uushaupwa nga aupwa, nao wine ninshi tabifishe. Lelo abaupa na baupwa balasanga amacushi ayengi mu bumi bwabo. Kanshi eico ndefwayafye ukumupususha kuli aya macushi.

english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane ndemwebako ukuti inshita naiya ilecepa. Ukufuma pali nomba abaupa babe kwati bantu abashaupa.

english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
translation: Umwaume ali nokufikilisha insambu sha mu cupo ku mukashi wakwe. Umwanakashi nao ali nokufikilisha insambu sha mu cupo ku mulume wakwe.

english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
translation: Abalelila ifilamba, babe nga abashilelila. Abalesansamuka, babe nga abashilesansamuka. Abanonshi nabo, babe nga abashakwata nelyo kamo.

english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
translation: Elyo abo bonse ababomba ne fya muno calo, besendwa ne fya muno calo. Pantu cino calo mwamona, cileya cilepita.

english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
translation: Mateo 5:32

english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
translation: Lelo umwaume uwaupa asakamikwa ne fya pano calo, pantu ali nokusansamusha umukashi wakwe.

english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
translation: Kanshi ena alakanika pabili. Umwanakashi umushimbe nangu umukashana uushaupwa asakamanafye ifyakubombela Imfumu. Pantu afwayafye ukuituula onse umubili no mupashi ku Mfumu. Lelo umwanakashi uwaupwa ena asakamikwa ne fya pano calo, pantu ali nokusansamusha wiba.

english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
translation: Ndelanda ifi pa mulandu wakufwaya ukumwafwilishako, tekufwaya ukumucincintila iyoo. Makamaka ndefwaya ukuti mwishibe bwino ifyo mulingile ukucita, epakuti muleituula onsefye kukubombela Imfumu.

english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
translation: Elyo pa mulandu wa mwaume uwakobekela umukashana, nomba balyumfwana ukukanaupana, lelo umwaume alaumfwisha ulunkumbwa ku mukashana, alafwaya nokumuupa, kuti baupanafye. Kabili tapali cilubo iyoo.

english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
translation: Nomba umwaume ukwabula no wakumupatikisha, lelo umwine eka mu mutima wakwe apingula ukuti tali nakuupa, kabili amona nokuti nakwata amaka yakushipikisha, kabili mwinefye apingwile ukucita ifyo, ninshi wena awamya ukukanaupa umukashana.

english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
translation: Kanshi umuntu uwaupa umukashana, awamya. Elyo uushimuupile wena awamya nokucilapo.

english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
translation: Umwanakashi uwaupwa ali nokwikala na wiba mu cupo cabo mpaka ilyo wiba akafwa. Kumfwa wiba nga afwa lyena ninshi icupo cabo capwa, kuti aupwa na ku mwaume umbi onse uo atemenwe. Lelo kwena ali nokuupwa mu musango wa bwina Kristu.

english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
translation: Umwanakashi te mwine wa mubili wakwe iyoo, kano wiba. Eifyo fine no mwaume te mwine wa mubili wakwe iyoo, wa mukashi wakwe.

english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
translation: Ine mona ukuti, nga aikala ifyo fine ukwabula ukuupwa, kuti akwatishapo insansa ukucilapo. Efyo ine ntontonkanya, na ine naliba na Mupashi wakwa Lesa.

english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation: Mwilakaana munenu mu cupo, kano ninshi mwaumfwana ukukanakumana pa nshita inono, ico mulefwaya ukuti muipeeleshe ku mapepo. Panuma ya iyo nshita, mutampe kabili ukulaikala nga baupana. Lyena ninshi tekuti muleke Satana alemutunka ku mulandu wa bunasha bwenu.

english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
translation: Nalanda ifi kukumupandakofye amano, nshilemupangila ifunde iyoo.

english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
translation: Pantu kwena ine kuti natemwa ukuti abantu bonse baba ifyo ine ndi. Nomba cila muntu alipeelwa ubupe ubwaibela kuli Lesa. Umuntu umo apeelwa ubupe bwa musango ifi, elyo umbi ubwa musango umbi.

english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
translation: Abashimbe na bamukamfwilwa bena ndebeba ukuti cabawamina bekale ifyo fine nga ine.

english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
translation: Lelo nga bafilwa ukushipikisha, cawama ukuti baupa nangu baupwa. Cawamapo ukuupa nangu ukuupwa ukucila ukucushiwa no lunkumbwa.

english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
translation: Nomba, pa mulandu wa fyakulya ifyo batuula ku tulubi, twalishiba ukuti ifwe bonse twalikwata amano. Amano yalenga ukuti umuntu aleitutumuna ku cilumba. Icitemwiko cena cilatuwamina ukwikala bwino.

english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
translation: Nga cakuti umo akumona iwe we wamano, ulelya mwitempele bapepelamo utulubi, bushe ici tekuti calenga umuntu uwaba na kampingu uushakosa ukupama ukulya ifilyo batuula ku tulubi?

english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
translation: Mukucita ifyo ku mano yobe, walenga umuntu wa cisumino icishakosa munonko ukuloba uo Kristu afwilile.

english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
translation: Kanshi ninshi mwabifya kuli Kristu, apo mwabifya ku babwananyina banenu, kabili mwafulunganya na kampingu wa mitima yabo uushakosa.

english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
translation: Eico kanshi icakulya nga calenga munyinane ukuwila mukubifya, ninshi ndi nokulekelelafye ukulya inama, pakuti nileka munyinane ukuwila mukubifya.

english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
translation: Umuntu kuti alatontonkanya ukuti nalishiba fimo, kanshi nakalya talati eshibe nefyo afwile ukwishiba.

english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
translation: Lelo umuntu uwatemwa Lesa, wena ninshi alishibikwa kuli Lesa.

english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
translation: Kanshi pa mulandu wakulyako ifyakulya ifyo batuula ku tulubi, ifwe twalishiba ukuti utulubi fintu fyafyefye. Ifwe twaishiba ukuti Lesa abafye umo.

english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
translation: Nangu kwena abantu bamo batila mu mulu nangu muno calo mwaliba imilungu. Kabili batila mwaliba imilungu iyingi ne shamfumu ishingi,

english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
translation: nomba kuli ifwe kwabafye Lesa umo mpo, e Shifwe. Uyu Lesa ewabumba ifintu fyonse, na ifwe bene eo tuli nokubombela mu bumi bwesu. Elyo kwabafye Imfumu imo, ni Yesu Kristu. Kabili ni ku maka yene ya Mfumu Yesu Kristu eko Lesa abumbila ifintu fyonse, kabili ni ku maka yakwa Kristu umwine alenga nokuti na ifwe tuleenda abomi.

english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
translation: Lelo kwena te bonse baishiba ifi. Bamo ico babelela ukumona ifyo bapepa utulubi, bena ukufika na nomba nga balyako ifyo fyakulya, batontonkanya ukuti balelya ifyakulya fya tulubi. Kanshi ilyo balyako, bamona ukuti bakowela, ico kampingu wa mitima yabo ashakosa.

english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.
translation: Kwena ifyakulya tefyo fingatupalamika kuli Lesa. Nga tatulile tatulufyanyapo nelyo cimo kuli Lesa, elyo nga twalyapo tacitwafwako ukupalama kuli Lesa.

english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
translation: Nomba muletekanya, mwilaleka insambu mwakwata iyakulya conse, ilelenga ukuti abashakosa mu cisumino bawile mukubifya.

english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
translation: Bushe nshili muntungwa? Bushe ine nshili musole? Bushe nshamona Yesu Imfumu yesu? Bushe imwe ico mwasuminina teico mombela Imfumu?

english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
translation: Bushe te mulandu wa ifwe alandile ifyo? Ee nifwe bene fyalembelwe. Atulangafye ukuti umuntu uulima no usokola iŋanu bonse balasubila ukupokako kufyo basombola.

english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
translation: Ifwe twalibyala ishiwi lyakwa Lesa muli imwe. Bushe kuti camupesha amano nga twapokako ifisuma mwakwata pano calo?

english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.
translation: Nga bambi bena balikwata insambu ishakupoka ifi fintu kuli imwe, nga palibufi ifwe, bushe tatukwete isho nsambu?

english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti ababomba mwi Tempele icakulya cabo cifuma kwi Tempele? Elyo nabo babomba umulimo wakulekela Lesa ilambo, nabo balyako ifyo batuula ku bulambo.

english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
translation: Imfumu nayo efyo yakonkomesha ukuti ababila Imbila Nsuma, nabo balemona icakulya mukubila Imbila Nsuma.

english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
translation: Nomba kwena nshatala momfya ishi nsambu shonse. Nshilelemba ifi pakuti nomba efyo mulencitila, iyoo. Awe ine no kufwa kwawama, ukucila ukuti umo ampoke icintu ico ine njitashishapo!

english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
translation: Ine nshakwata nsambu shakuitakisha pa mulandu wakubila Imbila Nsuma. Ukubila Imbila Nsuma kwena e mulimo Imfumu yampeela. Pantu nga nshilebila Imbila Nsuma ninshi nashamininafye!

english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
translation: Uyu mulimo auba wakuisalilafye ne mwine, nga ndalipililwapo. Lelo uyu mulimo banjebafye ukuubomba. Kanshi mfikilishafye umulimo Imfumu yampeela.

english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
translation: Timo 5:18

english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
translation: Ine ndi muntungwa, nshili musha wa muntu nelyo umo. Lelo naicita umusha wa bantu bonse, pakuti mwenepo abengi abakukonka Kristu.

english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
translation: Nga nshili musole kuli bambi, kuli imwe kwena ndi musole! Kabili imwe bene, nimwe cakushininkishishako ukuti ndi musole.

english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;
translation: Ku Bayuda mba ngo Muyuda, pakuti Abayuda nabo mbalete kuli Kristu. Ine nangu nshikonka Mafunde yakwa Mose, kuli abo bakonka Amafunde yakwa Mose, na ine mba nga uukonka Amafunde yakwa Mose pakuti nabo mbalete kuli Kristu.

english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
translation: Ku Benafyalo abashaba na Mafunde yakwa Mose, na ine mba ngo Mwinafyalo, pakuti nabo mbalete kuli Kristu. Ici tacilepilibula ukuti ine nshikonka mafunde yakwa Lesa, awe ine ndakonka amafunde yakwa Kristu.

english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
translation: Ilyo mba na bacisumino icishakosa, na ine mba nga uwacisumino icishakosa, pakuti nabo mbalete kuli Kristu. Kanshi ku bantu bonse mbafye ngefyo bali, pakuti mbapusushe bamo mu nshilafye ishili shonse.

english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
translation: Fyonse ifi, ncita pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma, pakuti na ine nshukileko ipaalo lya Mbila Nsuma.

english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
translation: Mwalishiba ukuti ilyo balecimfyanya mukubutuka, ababutukamo bengi, lelo umofye eupoka icilambu. Kanshi na imwe mulebutuka icakuti mukapoke icilambu.

english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
translation: Bonse abalecimfyanya mu fyangalo, balaipamfya nganshi ukuti baipekanye bwino. Elyo bacita ifyo pakutifye bapoke icilambu icishili cakubelelela, lelo ifwe, icilambu cakubelelela.

english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
translation: Eico ine mbutukafye ukulungama ku cishilwa pakuti mpoke icilambu. Ilyo ndeposa amakofi nungamikafye pa mulwani.

english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
translation: Roma 15:27

english: My defense to those who examine me is this:
translation: Ifi efyo njasuka abantu abakuti baisa baleipusha pali ine.

english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
translation: Bushe ifwe tatwakwata insambu shakuti muletupeelako ifyakulya ne fyakunwa?

english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
translation: Bushe ifwe nifwe tushakwata nsambu shakusenda umukashi umwina Kristu ilyo tuli pa bulendo, nga filya abasole bambi na bamunyina wa Mfumu na Kefa bacita?

english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?
translation: Bushe ine na Banaba nifwefye twaba nokuibombela pakumona ifyakulya?

english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?
translation: Bushe kwaliba ifita fya nkondo fiilipila? Bushe kwaliba uulima ibala lya myangashi ukwabula ukuti alelyako ifitwalo? Bushe nani acema ifitekwa ashibuulako umukaka wa fitekwa?

english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
translation: Ifi ndelanda te fya pa mutwe wandifye, pantu na Mafunde yakwa Mose yalandafye fimo fine.

english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,
translation: Calilembwa mu Mafunde yakwa Mose ukuti, “Wilakaka ŋombe ku kanwa ilyo ilenyantaula pa ŋanu pakushisokola.” Bushe iŋombe eingasakamika Lesa?

english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
translation: Uo twalalandapo ni Lishiwi upeela umweo. Wena ewabako ukufumafye na ku citendekelo. Twalimumfwa no kumumona twalimumona na menso yesu. Ee twalimumona no kumwikatamo ne minwe yesu.

english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
translation: Nga twatila tatwatala atubifya, ninshi tweba Lesa ukuti wabufi, na mashiwi yakwe tayabamo muli ifwe.

english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
translation: Ilyo uyu uupeela umweo aishile sokoloka, twalimumwene, kabili ifwe tuli bakambone. Tulemushimikila pa mweo uwape, uwali na Wishi uo aisa tusokolwela.

english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
translation: Ifyo twamona no kumfwa, efyo tulemwebako na imwe, epakuti mukwampana na imwe tuleampana pamo na Tata na Mwane Yesu Kristu.

english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
translation: Kanshi ico twamulembela aya mashiwi ni pakuti tube ne nsansa ishapwililika.

english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
translation: Aya e mashiwi twaumfwa kuli Mwane, kabili eyo tulemweba ayakuti Lesa lubuuto, elyo muli ena tamwaba mfifi nakalya.

english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
translation: Nga twasosa twatila ifwe twalyampana na Lesa ilyo tuli mu mfifi, ninshi tulebepafye ubufi, pantu tatwaba na cishinka mu bumi bwesu.

english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
translation: Lelo nga twenda mu lubuuto nga filya Lesa aba mu lubuuto, ninshi lyena twalyampana na banensu no mulopa wakwa Yesu Umwana wakwe ulatusamba ifyabubifi fyesu fyonse.

english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
translation: Nga tutila tatwaba na bubifi, ninshi tulaibepa ne cishinka tamwaba muli ifwe.

english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
translation: Lelo nga tulayebelela ifyabubifi fyesu kuli Lesa, apo wena wacishinka alacita ifyo alaile. Alatubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyesu fyonse, no kutusamba ku fibi fyonse ifyo tucita.

english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
translation: Mwe bana bandi namulembela ifi, ni pakuti mwilabifya. Lelo umo nga abifya, twalikwata Yesu Kristu ndubulwila wesu uwakaele uutupapatilako kuli Wishi.

english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
translation: Onse uwatemwa munyina, ewaba mu lubuuto, muli ena tamwaba nangu cimo icakumulenga ukubifya.

english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
translation: Nomba uwapata munyina ena aba mu mfifi, kabili no kwenda emo enda. Teshiba noko aleya, pantu imfifi yalimupofusha.

english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
translation: Namulembela mwe bana bandi,

english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
translation: Namulembela mwe bafyashi,

english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
translation: Namulembela mwe bafyashi,

english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
translation: Mwilatemwa calo nangu ifintu fya pano calo. Nga watemwa icalo, ninshi tekuti utemwe Lesa Tata.

english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
translation: Pantu ifintu fyonse ifya pano calo, ulunkumbwa lubi, ulunkumbwa lwa menso na mataki ya fyuma, ifi fyonse tafifuma kuli Lesa, fifuma ku calo.

english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
translation: Icalo ne fintu fyonse ifyo abantu bakumbwa fileya kukupwa. Lelo abacita ifyo Lesa afwaya bena bakabelelela pe.

english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
translation: Mwe bana bandi ino nshita, yakupelekeshako. Umulwani wakwa Kristu ali nokwisa nga fintu mwaumfwa. Nombaline abalwani bakwa Kristu eko bali abengi. Ici eco tuleishibilako ukuti ino ni nshita yakupelekeshako.

english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
translation: Abo balwani bakwa Kristu abafumine mwibumba lyesu, tabatalile ababa aba mwibumba lyesu icine cine. Pantu ababa aba mwibumba lyesu, na nombaline nga tuli nabo. Bafumine mwibumba lyesu, epakuti cimoneke apabuuta tuutu ukuti abo bene bonse tabatalile ababa aba mwibumba lyesu icine cine.

english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
translation: Kristu umwine ewaba ilambo ilifumya ifyabubifi fyesu, kabili te fyabubifi fyesu fyekafye lelo ne fya bantu bonse pano calo.

english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
translation: Lelo imwe Kristu alimusuba na Mupashi Wamushilo, eico kanshi nomba mwalishiba fyonse.

english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
translation: Nshimulembele ifi pa mulandu wakuti tamwaishiba cishinka, lelo ni pa mulandu wakuti mwalicishiba kale. Kabili mwalishiba nokuti mu cishinka teti mufume bufi iyoo.

english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
translation: Nga kanshi uwabufi nani? Uwabufi muntu onse uutila Yesu tali e Kristu Umuntu wa musango uyu uukaana Wishi na Mwana e mulwani wakwa Kristu.

english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
translation: Pantu uukaana Mwane ninshi taba na Wishi, lelo uusumina Mwane ninshi aba na Wishi wine.

english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
translation: Kanshi mulesunga mu mitima yenu ayo mashiwi mwaumfwa ukutulafye ku citendekelo. Nga mwalasunga ayo mashiwi, lyena mwakulaikalila mukwampana pamo na Mwane na Wishi.

english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
translation: Kabili umweo wa pe e cintu Kristu umwine atulaya.

english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
translation: Ico nalembela ifi kuli imwe ni pa mulandu wa abo abalefwaya ukulamufulunganya.

english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
translation: Lelo imwe Kristu alimusuba Mupashi Wamushilo uwaikala muli imwe. Kanshi nomba tamukabila nelyo umo uwakumufunda. Mupashi wakwe eumufundafye fyonse. Aba uwacishinka no kubepa tabepa iyoo. Kanshi mulenakila ifyo alemufunda, mwikale na mukwampana na Kristu.

english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
translation: Eico kanshi mwe bana bandi ikaleni mukwampana pamo nankwe, pakuti ilyo akamoneka twikaba na mwenso, kabili twikekatwa ne nsoni apo ali pa Bushiku ubo akesamo.

english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
translation: Mwalishiba ukuti Kristu acita lyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya, kanshi mufwile no kwishiba ukuti umuntu onse uucita ifyo Lesa afwaya e mwana wakwa Lesa icine cine.

english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
translation: Nga twalakonka amafunde yakwa Lesa, ninshi kuti twashininkisha ukuti twalimwishiba.

english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
translation: Umo nga atila, “Nalimwishiba” nomba takonka mafunde yakwe, ninshi uyo muntu wabufi, taba na cishinka.

english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
translation: Lelo uunakila amashiwi yakwa Lesa, ninshi icitemwiko cakwa Lesa caba mu mutima wakwe umupwilapo. Kuli ici eko twingashininkishisha ukuti twalyampana na Lesa.

english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
translation: Uyo onse uulanda ukuti aba na Lesa, afwile ukukwata imibeele Kristu akwete.

english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi ici cebo nalamulembela, te cipya iyoo, lelo cakale. Ni cilya cine mwaba naco ukufumafye ku citendekelo. Icebo cakale, e mashiwi ya Mbila Nsuma mwaumfwile.

english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
translation: Lelo kwena icebo nalamulembela cipya, ne cishinka caciko cimoneka muli Kristu na muli imwe. Pantu imfifi ileya ilepwa, no lubuuto lwine lwine lulebengeshima.

english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
translation: Uyo onse uutila aba mu lubuuto lelo alipata munyina, ninshi acili mu mfifi.

english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
translation: Moneni ifyo Lesa Tata atutemwa! Alitutemwa nganshi, ecalenga nokuti tuleitwa abana bakwe kabili cacine efyo twaba. Icalo tacawishiba pantu tacamwishibe.

english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
translation: Kuli ici eko twishibila abana bakwa Lesa na bana bakwa Ciwa. Pantu uyo onse uushitwalilila ukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, kabili tatemwa na munyina, ninshi tali mwana wakwa Lesa.

english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
translation: Pantu aya e mashiwi mwaumfwile ukufuma ku citendekelofye, ayakutila tuli nokulatemwana.

english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
translation: Yoani 1:12

english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
translation: Eico kanshi mwe bamunyinane mwilapapa abantu ba mu calo nga bamupata.

english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
translation: Natwishiba ukuti twalifuma mu mfwa, kabili twaliingila na mu mweo. Ico twaishibila ici, nico twatemwa bamunyinefwe! Uyo onse uushakwata citemwiko, ninshi acili uwafwa.

english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
translation: Onse uwapata munyina wamisoka. Kabili mwalishiba ukuti mu wamisoka tamwaba mweo wape.

english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
translation: Kristu alenga ukuti twishibe ifyo icitemwiko caba ilyo alekele umweo wakwe pa mulandu wa ifwe. Kanshi na ifwe bene tulingile ukuleka imyeo yesu pali bamunyinefwe.

english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
translation: Umuntu uwakwata ifintu fya pano calo nga amona munyina alekabila, lelo akaana ukumumfwila uluse, bushe kuti atila alitemwa Lesa mu mutima wakwe?

english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
translation: Mwe bana bandi twilaleka icitemwiko cesu cibefye pa kanwa na mu mashiwi, lelo icitemwiko cesu cibe mu ficitwa fyesu kabili icacine cine.

english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
translation: Kanshi muli ici emo twingeshibila ukuti tuli bantu bacishinka. Lyena tukekala ne mitima tondolo pa cinso cakwa Lesa,

english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi, nomba tuli bana bakwa Lesa, lelo tatulaishiba bwino ifyo tukaba. Lelo twalishiba ukuti ilyo akamoneka tukapalana nankwe pantu tukalamumona icine cine ifyo aba.

english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
translation: nangu imitima yesu iletushinina mu fintu ifingi. Pantu Lesa alishiba ifintu fyonse kabili alicindamapo ukucila pali kampingu wa mitima yesu.

english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
translation: Eico kanshi mwe batemwikwa bandi nga kampingu wa mitima yesu taletushinina, ninshi teti tube na mwenso pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
translation: Lesa alatupeela fyonse ifyo tumulomba, pantu tulakonka amafunde yakwe no kucita ifimusansamusha.

english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
translation: Ifunde lyakwe nalyo nili ilyakutila, tuli bonse nokusumina muli Mwane Yesu Kristu. Kabili tuli nokulatemwana nga filya atukonkomeshe.

english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
translation: Yoani 5:24

english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
translation: Onse uwakwata ili subilo muli Kristu, alaiwamya umutima no kuba uwamushilo nga filya Kristu aba uwamushilo.

english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
translation: Onse uubifya, ninshi alapula mu mafunde yakwa Lesa, pantu ukubifya ekupula mu mafunde.

english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
translation: Mwalishiba ukuti ico Kristu amonekele, ni kukufumya ifyabubifi fyesu, pantu muli ena tamwaba ububifi nakalya.

english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
translation: Kanshi onse uwaba na Kristu tatwalilila mukubifya pantu uyo onse uutwalilila mukubifya, ninshi tabala amumona nangu kumwishiba tamwishiba.

english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
translation: Mwe bana bandi mwilaleka umuntu nelyo umo alemufulunganya! Onse uutwalilila mukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, aba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa nga filya fine Kristu aba uwakaele.

english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
translation: Umuntu onse uutwalilila mukubifya, ninshi wakwa Ciwa. Pantu Ciwa wena mubifi ukutulafye na ku citendekelo. Kabili ico Umwana wakwa Lesa amonekele, ni kukwisa onaula imilimo yakwa Ciwa.

english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
translation: Onse umwana wakwa Lesa icine cine tatwalilila mukubifya, pantu amaka ya mweo wakwa Lesa yaba muli ena. Kabili apo Lesa e Wishi, tekuti atwalilile mukubifya iyoo.

english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi, mwilasumina bonse abatila baliba na Mupashi, lelo mulebala mwabesha pakumona imipashi baba nayo nga yafuma kuli Lesa. Pantu bakasesema babufi balisalanganina mu calo conse.

english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
translation: Ici citemwiko caba ifi, te pa mulandu wakuti nifwe twatemenwe Lesa, lelo ni Lesa umwine ewabalilepo ukututemwa, atumine na Mwane ukwisa ba ilambo lyakufumya ifyabubifi fyesu.

english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa, apo Lesa atutemwa ifi, ninshi na ifwe bene tufwile ukulatemwana.

english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
translation: Tapaba nangu umo uwatala amona Lesa. Lelo nga tuletemwana, ninshi Lesa aba na ifwe ne citemwiko cakwe muli ifwe cintu capwililika.

english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti twaba na Lesa, kabili nao aba muli ifwe, pantu alitupeelako Mupashi wakwe.

english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
translation: Kabili twalimona ukuti Lesa atumine mwane ukuba Umupusushi wa bantu pano calo, na ifwe tuli bakambone.

english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
translation: Onse uushitiina ukulumbula ukuti Yesu ni Mwana Lesa, ninshi aba na Lesa, kabili Lesa nao aba nankwe.

english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
translation: Kabili na ifwe bene twalishiba no kusumina twalisumina ukuti Lesa alitutemwa.

english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
translation: Kanshi emukutila icitemwiko nga caba icapwililika muli ifwe, ninshi tatwakabe na mwenso pa Bushiku bwa bupingushi, pantu pano calo twaba ifyaba Kristu.

english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
translation: Yoani 1:18

english: We love him, because he first loved us.
translation: Ico tutemenwa nico Lesa ewabalilepo ukututemwa.

english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
translation: Ico mwakulaishibilako Mupashi wakwa Lesa nici icakuti, uyo onse uusumina ukuti Yesu Kristu aishile yaluka umuntu, ninshi alikwata Mupashi wakwa Lesa.

english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
translation: Umo nga atila, “Nalitemwa Lesa,” lelo apata munyina, ninshi wabufi. Pantu kuti atemwa shani Lesa untu ashimona nga apata munyina uo amona.

english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
translation: Ili kabili e funde lintu atupeela ilyakuti uyo uwatemwa Lesa, ali nokutemwa na munyina wine.

english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
translation: Lelo uyo onse uushisumina ifi pali Yesu, ninshi takwata Mupashi wakwa Lesa. Umupashi akwata wa mulwani wakwa Kristu uyo mwaumfwile ukuti uleisa. Kanshi nomba waba na muno calo.

english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
translation: Lelo imwe mwe bana bandi muli bakwa Lesa. Kabili mwalicimfya bakasesema babufi. Pantu Mupashi uwaba muli imwe wamaka nganshi ukucila umupashi wa bantu ba pano calo.

english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
translation: Aba bakasesema babufi ifintu balanda fya ba pano calo, na bantu ba pano calo balabomfwa pantu nabo ba pano calo.

english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
translation: Lelo ifwe tuli bantu bakwa Lesa. Onse uwaishiba Lesa alatumfwa, lelo onse uushili muntu wakwa Lesa tatumfwa. Kanshi kuli ici eko twishibila Mupashi wacishinka no mupashi wabufi.

english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa, ala natuletemwana, pantu icitemwiko cifuma kuli Lesa. Onse uwakwata icitemwiko mwana wakwa Lesa, kabili alishiba Lesa.

english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
translation: Onse uushaba na citemwiko, ninshi taishiba Lesa, pantu Lesa citemwiko.

english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
translation: Muli ici emo Lesa atulangila icitemwiko cakwe, icakuti atumine Mwane muno calo, uwabafye umo mpo, pakuti pa mulandu wakwe tube no mweo.

english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
translation: Onse uusumina ukuti Yesu e Kristu ninshi mwana wakwa Lesa wine wine. Kabili onse uwatemwa umufyashi, atemwa no mwana wine.

english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
translation: Uyo onse uwasumina Mwana Lesa, alikwata ubu bukambone mu mutima wakwe. Lelo onse uushisumina Lesa, ninshi amucita uwabufi, pantu tasumina bukambone Lesa apeele pa Mwana wakwe.

english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
translation: Na bukambone ubu bwakuti, Lesa alitupeela umweo wape, noyu mweo waba muli Mwane.

english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
translation: Onse uwaba na Mwana ninshi alikwata umweo, lelo onse uushaba na Mwana Lesa, wena taba na mweo.

english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
translation: Ico namulembela ifi ni pakuti mwishibe ukuti, imwe mwe basumina muli Mwana Lesa mwalikwata umweo wape.

english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
translation: Ifwe tatumfwa mwenso pa cinso cakwa Lesa pantu alatumfwa nga twamulomba icintufye conse ukulingana no bufwayo bwakwe.

english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
translation: Yoani 14:15

english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
translation: Umo nga alemona munyina alecita ububifi ubushitwala ku mfwa, alingile ukumupepelako kuli Lesa, na Lesa nao alemupeela umweo. Ici cikumine abo ububifi bwabo bushitwala ku mfwa. Lelo eko bwaba ububifi ubutwala ku mfwa, awe bwena nshileti nabo kuti mwapepelapo iyoo.

english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
translation: Ukucita icabipa conse bubifi, lelo eko buli ububifi ubushitwala ku mfwa.

english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti umwana wakwa Lesa wine wine tekalilila mukubifya, pantu Mwana Lesa wine alamucingilila, no mubi tekuti amwikatemo nakalya.

english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti tuli bana bakwa Lesa, elyo ne sonde lyonse lyaliteekwa no Mubi.

english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
translation: Ici eco twishibilako ukuti twalitemwa abana bakwe ico twatemwa Lesa no kukonka amafunde yakwe.

english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti Mwana Lesa alisa, kabili alitupeela na mano pakuti twishibe Lesa wine wine. Twalyampana na Lesa wacine cine pantu twalyampana na Mwane Yesu Kristu. Uyu wine e Lesa wacine cine, kabili e mweo wape.

english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
translation: Mwe bana bandi muletalukako ku tulubi.

english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
translation: Ukutemwa Lesa kukonka amafunde yakwe. Kabili amafunde yakwe tayayafya.

english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
translation: Pantu umwana wakwa Lesa onse alikwata amaka yakucimfya icalo. Neco tucimfishako icalo cisumino cesu.

english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
translation: Uwingacimfya icalo nani? Ni uyo muntu uwasumina ukuti Yesu ni mwana Lesa.

english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
translation: Ni uyu wine Yesu Kristu ewaishile ku menshi na ku mulopa. Te ku menshi yeka aishile, lelo aishile na ku menshi elyo na ku mulopa. Kabili Mupashi wine e kambone, pantu Mupashi wine e cishinka.

english: For there are three who testify:
translation: Kwaba bakambone batatu,

english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
translation: ni Mupashi, amenshi no mulopa. Kabili ifi fintu fitatu filasuminishanya.

english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
translation: Tulasumina bukambone bwa bantu, nomba bukambone bwakwa Lesa bwena bwalicilapo, pantu bwakwa Lesa. Nobu bukambone ebo apeela pa Mwana wakwe.

english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
translation: Ilyo namfumu wa ku Sheba aumfwile ululumbi pali Solomoni ifyo acindamike ishina lyakwa Yawe, aishile mukumwesha ku mepusho ayayafya.

english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
translation: Elyo apeele imfumu amatalanta ya golide umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120) , ifya cena cisuma, no tumabwe twa mutengo uukalamba. Kabili takwatalile akuletwa ifya cena cisuma ku mfumu Solomoni ifyakulingana ne fyaletele namfumu wa ku Sheba.

english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
translation: Amato yakwa Hiramu eyaletele golide ukufuma ku Ofiri, kabili kulya kwine eko yaleta ne miti iya aligumi elyo no tumabwe utwa mutengo uukalamba.

english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.
translation: Imfumu yabomfya imiti iyalukula ukupangamo inceshi shakwikasha iŋanda yakwa Yawe elyo ne ŋanda ye sano, elyo no kupangilamo amaseese ne nsango ifya bakemba. Iyi miti iyakosa iya mikula tayatala aimoneka nangu ukuletwa ukushinta na pa bushiku bwa lelo.

english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni apeele namfumu wa ku Sheba conse ico afwaile kabili ico alombele, ukulunda pafyo umwine amupeelefye ukufuma pa bunonshi bwa kwisano. Elyo namfumu abwelelemo ku calo kumwakwe pamo na babomfi bakwe.

english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
translation: Ukufina kwa golide Solomoni alepoka cila mwaka kwali amatalanta imyanda mutanda na makumi mutanda na mutanda (666) ,

english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
translation: ukwabula ukupendelako iyalefuma ku musonko wa bamakwebo yakalamba na bashitisha ifipe elyo no kufuma ku mfumu shonse isha ku Arabia elyo na ku balashi ba mu calo.

english: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni apangile inkwela ishikulu imyanda ibili (200) kuli golide uwakufula. Cila nkwela mwalebomba golide uwafina amakilo yatatu na citika (3.5kg).

english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
translation: Kabili apanga inkwela na shimbi ishinono imyanda itatu (300) kuli golide uwafulwa. Na muli cila nkwela mwalebomba golide uwafina mupepi na makilo yabili. Imfumu yasungila inkwela mwisano ilyaleitwa “Umutengo wa ku Lebanoni.”

english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
translation: Elyo imfumu yapangile icipuna icikulu ica meno ya nsofu kabili yalambatikako golide umusuma.

english: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
translation: Icipuna cakwete amatabo mutanda, elyo kunuma yaciko cali icashinguluka pamulu. Mu mbali yaciko mwaba apakushintilisha amaboko uku noku, ne nkalamo shibili ishaiminina ku mbali ya fyakushintilishapo amaboko.

english: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
translation: Aisa fika mu Yerusalemu no mulongo ukalamba uwa babomfi ne ngamila ishasendele ifya cena cisuma, golide uwingi nganshi no tumabwe utwa mutengo uukalamba. Afika kuli Solomoni no kulandishanya nankwe fyonse ifyali mu mano yakwe.

english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
translation: Inkalamo shimbi ikumi limo na shibili (12) shaiminina mu matabo mutanda, imo pa mpela ya cile tabo. Takwaba icipuna ca ifi icatala acipangwa mu bufumu ubuli bonse.

english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.
translation: Ifipe fyonse ifyakunwenamo ifya mfumu Solomoni fyali ifya golide, kabili ifipe fyonse ifya mu ŋanda ye sano iyaleitwa “Umutengo wa ku Lebanoni” fyali fya golide wine wine. Tamwali icapangilwe kuli silifa pantu silifa tayali iyacindama mu nshiku shakwa Solomoni.

english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
translation: Imfumu yakwete amato aya ku Tashishi ayengi pali bemba ayali pamo na yakwa Hiramu. Umuku umo panuma ya myaka itatu yalebwela nayasenda golide, silifa, ameno ya nsofu, bakolwe bakalamba elyo na bapikoko .

english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni yalicilile imfumu shonse isha pano isonde mu bunonshi na mu mano.

english: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.
translation: Aba pano isonde bonse balafwaya ukumonana na Solomoni pakuti bomfweko amano Lesa abikile mu mutima wakwe.

english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.
translation: Cila mwaka, umuntu onse uwaisa aleta ifipe fya silifa na golide, imingila, ifyanso fya nkondo, ifinyamuti ifyanunka ubusaka muri pamo na fimbi ifya cena icisuma, bakabalwe ne mfalashi.

english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
translation: Solomoni alonganika amaceleta na bakabalwe. Akwete amaceleta ikana limo ne myanda ine (1,400) elyo na bakabalwe amakana ikumi limo na yabili (12,000) afibika mu misumba ya maceleta elyo fimbi aba nafyo mu Yerusalemu.

english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
translation: Imfumu yalenga silifa ukufula mu Yerusalemu nga mabwe, ne fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda ubwingi kwati mikunyu ya mwisamba lya mpili.

english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
translation: Bakabalwe bakwa Solomoni babashitile mu calo ca ku Egupto na ku Kuwe . Bashimakwebo ba mfumu ebaleshita ukufuma ku Kuwe.

english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.
translation: Bashitile iceleta ukufuma ku Egupto pa ndalama imyanda mutanda (600) isha mashekeli ya silifa elyo kabalwe umo pa ndalama amashekeli umwanda umo na makumi yasano (150). Bashimakwebo bakwa Solomoni nabo baleshitisha ku shamfumu shonse isha bena Hiti na bena Aramu.

english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.
translation: Solomoni nao ayasuka amepusho yakwe yonse, tapali ico afililwe ukulondolwela uyu namfumu.

english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
translation: Ilyo namfumu wa ku Sheba amona amano yakwa Solomoni elyo ne sano akuulile,

english: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
translation: ifyakulya ifyali petubulo lyakulilapo, imikalile ya bacilolo bakwe, imitumikile ya babomfi ne fyakufwala fyabo, bakatumika ba lukombo lwa mfumu elyo no mutuulo wakoca atuulile pa ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ena calimupapwishe nganshi.

english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
translation: Elyo atile ku mfumu, “Akasebo naumfwile ilyo ncili mu calo candi pafyo wabomba elyo na pa mano yobe kanshi fyacine.

english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
translation: Lelo nshasumine ifi fintu fyonse mpaka ili naisa imwena na menso yandi. Mu cine ifyo naumfwile tafipaleme na pali citika wa fintu ukwete. Iwe, ku mano na ku cuma wakwata, walicila pa lulumbi naumfwile.

english: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
translation: Yangu ifyo bashuka abaume bobe! Yangu ifyo bashuka bacilolo bobe abeminina ku cinso cobe cila nshita no kumfwa ku mano yobe.

english: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe Lesa obe, uwasekela muli iwe no kukubika pa cipuna ca bufumu bwa bena Israeli. Pa mulandu wa kutemwa kwa pe na pe uko Yawe akwatila abena Israeli, akulenga ukuba imfumu pakuti uleputula imilandu mu bulungami.”

english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,
translation: Lelo Imfumu Solomoni yalitemenwe abanakashi na bambi ukucila pali mwana Farao. Alyupilepo na banakashi ba ku Moabu, aba ku Amoni, abena Edomu, abena Sidoni na bena Hiti.

english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.
translation: Nangu Solomoni bamuleseshe kuli Lesa ukukonka imilungu imbi, Solomoni tasungile amafunde yakwa Yawe.

english: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
translation: Eico Yawe aebele Solomoni ati, “Apo iyi e mbela yobe kabili wafilwa no kubaka icipangano candi ne fipope fyandi ifyo nakukonkomeshe, nalasesha ubufumu ukufuma kuli iwe no kubupeela kuli umo pa babomfi bobe.

english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
translation: Lelo, pa mulandu wakwa Davidi wiso, nshakacite ici mu nshita ya bumi bobe. Ndi no kwisa sesha ubufumu ukufuma ku mwana obe.

english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”
translation: Nalyo line nshakaseshe ubufumu bonse ukufuma kuli ena. Ndi nokumupeelako uluko lumo pa mulandu wakwa Davidi umubomfi wandi na pa mulandu wa Yerusalemu umusumba uo nasala.”

english: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.
translation: Elyo Yawe aimisha Solomoni umulwani Hadadi umwina Edomu, ukufuma ku bufumu bwa bena Edomu.

english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom
translation: Kunuma ilyo Davidi alelwisha abena Edomu, Yoabu umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo ilyo aile mukushiika abafwa, aile ipaya abaume bonse mu Edomu.

english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),
translation: Yoabu na bonse abena Israeli baile ikala kulya pa myeshi mutanda mpaka balofyafye bonse abaume ba mu Edomu.

english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.
translation: Amaf 17:17

english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
translation: Pakubutuka, bafumine ku Midiani baya ku Parani. Lilya basendako abantu ku Parani baya ku Egupto kuli Farao imfumu ya ku Egupto. Farao amupeela iŋanda ne ncende elyo amupeela ne fyakulya.

english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
translation: Farao atemwa nganshi Hadadi icakuti amupeela na mulamu wakwe, nkashi nankwe wakwa namfumu Tapenesi ukuba umukashi wakwe.

english: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.
translation: Bali ba ku mitundu iyo Yawe aebele abena Israeli ukuti, “Tamufwile ukulaupana nabo, pantu bakapilibula imitima yenu ukwamba ukulakonka imilungu yabo.” Lelo Solomoni akonenafye mukubatemwa.

english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
translation: Kuli nkashi nankwe yakwa Tapenesi, Hadadi afyalako umwana umwaume amwinika ishina lya Genubati. Tapenesi akushishe uyu mwana kwisano, eko alakulila pamo na bamwana Farao.

english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”
translation: Lintu acili mu Egupto, Hadadi aumfwile ukuti Davidi nafwa no kuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, kabili aumfwa nokuti Yoabu umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo nao nafwa. Elyo Hadadi aebele Farao ati, “Leka ndeya pakuti mbwelelemo ku calo ca kumwesu.”

english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”
translation: Farao amwasuka ati, “Finshi ifyo uculila ifyalenga ukuti ufwaye ukubwelela ku calo kumwenu?”

english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
translation: Kabili Lesa aimishe Solomoni na umbi umulwani, Resoni mwana Eliada uwabutwike ukufuma kuli shikulu wakwe Hadadesa imfumu ya ku Soba.

english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.
translation: Alonganika impuka ya bantu abakumukonka ababulwi elyo aba ne ntungulushi ya bacisanguka. Pali ilya nshita Davidi aleonaula abashilika bakwa Soba, bacisanguka baile ku Damasika eko baya ikala. Babika na Resoni ukuba imfumu yabo.

english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
translation: Resoni ali umulwani wa bena Israeli pa nshita yonse iya bumi bwakwa Solomoni, alunda na ku bubi bonse Hadadi alecita. Kanshi Resoni ateekele mu Aramu kabili ali cipondo ca bena Israeli.

english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
translation: Yeroboamu nao, mwana Nebati, apondokele imfumu. Ali umo pali bacilolo bakwa Solomoni. Ali umwina Efulemu uwa ku Sereda, kabili nyina ali ni namfwilwa ishina lyakwe Serua.

english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
translation: Umfweni icalengele ukuti apondokele imfumu. Solomoni alikuulile ifibumbili fyakwikasha ifikulwa no kucilika umupokapoka mu cibumba ca musumba wakwa Davidi wishi.

english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
translation: Nomba Yeroboamu aba umwaume uwamaka, kabili ilyo Solomoni amona ifyo uyu mulumendo alebomba imilimo yakwe bwino, amubika ukuba umukalamba wa babomfi bamulaasa ku ŋanda yakwa Yosefu.

english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya Yeroboamu aima ubulendo ukuya ku Yerusalemu, elyo pa nshila akumanya Ahiya kasesema wa ku Shilo, nafwala umwingila upya. Bonse babili babafye beka mu mpanga,

english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.
translation: Akwata abakashi imyanda cine lubali (700) aba ku bufumu elyo na bakashi bakwe abo ashaupile mu bwinga nabo imyanda itatu (300). Na bakashi bakwe bayalula umutima wakwe.

english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
translation: na Ahiya abuula umwingila upya afwele no kuulepaula mu tupimfya ikumi limo na tubili (12).

english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
translation: Elyo asosa kuli Yeroboamu ati, “Buulapo utupimfya ikumi limo tube tobe, pantu ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli alanda ukuti, ‘Mona, nalaputula ubufumu ukufuma mu maboko yakwa Solomoni no kukupeelako inko ikumi limo.

english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wa mubomfi wandi Davidi, na pa mulandu wa musumba wa Yerusalemu uo nasala ukufuma mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli, ali nokushalapo no luko lumo.

english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.
translation: Nalacita ifi pa mulandu wakuti nabansha no kwamba ukupepa Ashitoreti umulungu wa bena Sidoni, Kemoshi umulungu wa bena Moabu elyo na Moleki umulungu wa bena Amoni. Kabili bafilwa no kwenda mu nshila shandi nangu ukucita ifintu ifyalungama pa cinso candi, nangu ukubaka ifipope fyandi na mafunde yandi ngefyo Davidi wishi wakwa Solomoni acitile.

english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,
translation: “‘Nomba nshafumye ubufumu bonse mu maboko yakwa Solomoni. Nalimubika ukuba imfumu mu nshiku shonse isha mweo wakwe pa mulandu wa mubomfi wandi Davidi, uo nasalile elyo kabili uwabakile ifikomo na mafunde yandi.

english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.
translation: Ndi nokufumya ubufumu ukufuma mu minwe ya mwana wakwe no kukupeelapo inko ikumi limo.

english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.
translation: Nkapeela uluko lumo ku mwana wakwe pakuti umubomfi wandi inshita yonse akakwate icisaniko pa cinso candi mu Yerusalemu, mu musumba umo nasalile ukubika ishina lyandi.

english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
translation: Lelo palwa iwe, nkakubuula kabili uli nokuba imfumu pali Israeli yonse.

english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
translation: Iwe nga wacita fyonse ifyo nakukonkomesha, no kwenda mu nshila shandi no kucita ifyalungama mu menso yandi mukubaka ifipope na mafunde yandi ngefyo Davidi umubomfi wandi acitile, ninshi ndi nokuba nobe. Nkakukuulila ubufumu ubwamaka, kwati ni bulya nakuulile Davidi, no kupeela icalo ca Israeli kuli iwe.

english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”
translation: Nkapetamika aba mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi pa mulandu uyu, nomba te nshiku shonse.’”

english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.
translation: Ilyo Solomoni akota, abakashi bakwe balenga umutima wakwe ukupilibukila ku milungu imbi, no mutima wakwe waleka ukuba uwacishinka kuli Yawe Lesa wakwe, ngefyo umutima wakwa wishi Davidi wali.

english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
translation: Solomoni afwaile ukwipaya Yeroboamu, nomba nao abutukila ku Egupto kuli Shishaki imfumu eko aya ikala mpaka ilyo Solomoni afwile.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
translation: Palwa milandu imbi iya bufumu bwakwa Solomoni, fyonse ifyo acitile na mano akwete, bushe tafyalembwa fyonse mu citabo ca milandu yakwa Solomoni?

english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
translation: Solomoni aikele mu Yerusalemu no kuteeka icalo conse ica Israeli pa myaka amakumi yane (40).

english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo afwile, bamushiikile ku ncende ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe mu musumba wakwa Davidi wishi. Kabili Reoboamu umwana wakwe umwaume ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
