translation: Alakonka Ashitoreti umulungu uwanakashi wa bena Sidoni, na Moleki umulungu uwakowela uwa bena Amoni.

english: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.
translation: Solomoni asuka acita ifyabipa mu menso yakwa Yawe, aleka ukulakonka Yawe umupwilapo ngefyo Davidi wishi acitile.

english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
translation: Pa lupili ku kabanga ka musumba wa Yerusalemu, Solomoni akuula incende yakupepelapo akalubi ka Kemoshi umulungu uwakowela uwa bena Moabu. Acita cimo cine kabili akuulila akalubi ka Moleki, umulungu uwakowela uwa bena Amoni.

english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
translation: Ifyo fine efyo acitila ne milungu ya bakashi bakwe bonse abafumine kumbi. Balafukilisha ububani no kulatuula amalambo ku milungu yabo.

english: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
translation: Yawe afulilwe Solomoni pafyo umutima wakwe wafumine kuli Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli uwamonekele kuli ena imiku ibili.

english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
translation: Reoboamu aile ku Shekemu pantu abena Israeli bonse eko baile mukuya mubika pa bufumu.

english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
translation: Na balumendo abo akulile pamo nankwe bamwasuka abati, “Eba aba bantu basosele kuli iwe ati, ‘Wiso abikile ikoli lyafina pali ifwe, nomba iwe utwangushisheko ikoli,’ ubebe bonse auti, ‘Umunwe wandi unono untu waina ukucila umusana wa batata .

english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
translation: Tata abikile pali imwe ikoli ilyafina, lelo ine nalalundapo ukufina. Tata alemuma ku fikoti, nomba ine nakulamumina kuli bakaliŋongo.’”

english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
translation: Panuma ya nshiku shitatu Yeroboamu na bantu bonse baisa kuli Reoboamu, ngefyo imfumu yasosele ati, “Mukabwele kuli ine panuma ya nshiku shitatu.”

english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
translation: Imfumu yayasuka abantu bukali bukali, yakaana na mano abakalamba baipandileko,

english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
translation: yakonka amano yafumine ku balumendo baiko no kulanda aiti, “Tata abikile pali imwe ikoli lyafina, ine ndi nokucishapo. Tata alemumina ku fikoti, ine nakulamumina kuli bakaliŋongo.”

english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
translation: Imfumu yafilwa ukumfwa ku bantu pantu ukucitika kwa ifi fyonse kwafumine kuli Yawe, pakufikilisha ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyalandilwe kuli Yeroboamu mwana Nebati ukupitila muli Ahiya umwina Shiloni.

english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bamona ukuti imfumu yakaana ukubomfwa, bayasuka imfumu abati,

english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
translation: Lelo ku bena Israeli abaikele mu misumba ya mu Yuda, Reoboamu ewali mfumu.

english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
translation: Imfumu Reoboamu yatumine Adoniramu, uwali umukalamba pa milimo ya mulaasa, nomba abena Israeli baisa mupola amabwe mpaka afwa. Imfumu Reoboamu yena yaendesha ukunina mwiceleta no kufyukila ku Yerusalemu.

english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
translation: Kanshi efyo abena Israeli baba abasangukila iŋanda yakwa Davidi ukufika ne lelo.

english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;
translation: Ilyo Yeroboamu mwana Nebati aumfwa ifi ninshi acili mu Egupto, mu calo abutukilemo ilyo afulumwike ukufuma kuli Solomoni. Pakumfwa lyena epakubwela ukufuma ku Egupto.

english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli baumfwile ukuti Yeroboamu nabwela, elyo bamwitile uko balongene, baisa mubika ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli. Uluko lwakwa Yuda elwashelefye ku bufumu bwa ŋanda yakwa Davidi.

english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
translation: Ilyo Reoboamu afikile mu Yerusalemu, alonganike aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda bonse na ba mu luko lwakwa Benjamini abaume babulwi amakana umwanda umo na makana amakumi cine konse konse (180,000) ukuti balwe na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli, pakuti bapokolole no kubwesesha ubufumu kuli Reoboamu mwana Solomoni.

english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
translation: Nomba kwaisa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe kuli Shemaiya umuntu wakwa Lesa ilyakuti,

english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
translation: “Landa kuli Reoboamu mwana Solomoni imfumu ya mu Yuda, ku ŋanda yonse iyakwa Yuda na Benjamini na ku bantufye bonse.

english: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, ‘Mwiya mukulwisha bamunyinenwe, abena Israeli. Kabiyeni ku mayanda yenu cila umo onse pantu nine ncitile ifi.’” Nabo baumfwila ishiwi lyakwa Yawe babwelelamo ku mayanda yabo ngefyo Yawe apeele icipope.

english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
translation: Elyo Yeroboamu akuulile ilinga ilyakosa nganshi ku Shekemu mu mpili sha ku Efulemu eko aikala. Kulya eko afumine pakuya kuula Penieli.

english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.
translation: Yeroboamu atontonkanya mu mano yakwe ati, “Ubufumu kuti bwasuka bwabwelela mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi,

english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
translation: nga cakuti aba bantu batwalilila ukulaya mukutuula amalambo ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe mu Yerusalemu. Kabili bakatampa ukunakila shikulwibo Reoboamu imfumu ya bena Yuda. Bali nokunjipaya bakabwelele na ku mfumu Reoboamu.”

english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
translation: Panuma ilyo atontonkanyapo, imfumu yapangile ifiponti fibili ifya golide. Yaeba na bantu aiti, “Mulimo uukalamba nganshi uwakuti lyonse muleyafye ku Yerusalemu. Iyi e milungu yenu mwe bena Israeli iyamufumishe mu calo ca ku Egupto.”

english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
translation: Umulungu umo aubika mu Betele elyo na ubiye mu Dani.

english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
translation: Abena Israeli baita Yeroboamu, elyo ena na bena Israeli bonse baya kuli Reoboamu bamweba abati,

english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.
translation: Kabili ici acitile caba icabubifi. Abantu balayafye ukufika na ku Dani mukupepa umulungu uwaliko.

english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
translation: Yeroboamu akuula amayanda yakupepelamo apasansama, asontelamo na bashimapepo ukufuma mu bantu abalekana lekana, abo abashali na bena Lefi.

english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
translation: Abika inshikunkulu pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi walenga cine konse konse ukulingana ne nshikunkulu yaleba ku Yuda elyo atuula na malambo ya pa bulambo. Acite ifi mu Betele, ukutuula ku mulungu uo apangile. Kabili pa Betele asontelapo bashimapepo pa mayanda ya mapepo akuulile.

english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.
“Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
translation: “Wiso alilumike nganshi ikoli pali ifwe. Nomba iwe utwangushisheko imibombele yacibe ne koli ilyafina wiso abikile pali ifwe, na ifwe twalaba abakukubombela.”

english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
translation: Reoboamu abasuka ati, “Taleni kabiyeni, panuma ya nshiku shitatu elyo mukabwele kuli ine.” Na bantu bafumapo baya.

english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”
translation: Elyo imfumu Reoboamu alandishanya na bakalamba abalebomba na wishi Solomoni ilyo alipo. Abepusha ati, “Bushe mano nshi mwalampandako ayakwisa asukilamo aba bantu?”

english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”
translation: Bamwasuka abati, “Nga cakuti ilelo walaicita umubomfi wa aba bantu no kubabombela no kulabasuka bwino, nabo bali nokuba ababomfi bobe lyonse.”

english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
translation: Lelo Reoboamu akaana amano yamupandileko abakalamba, elyo aya ipusha amano ukufuma ku baice banankwe abo akulile nabo kabili abalemubombela.

english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
translation: Abepusha ati, “Imwe kuti mwatipo shani? Aba bantu kuti twabasuka shani abatile kuli ine ati, ‘Unashe ikoli wiso abikile pali ifwe.’”

english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
translation: Lintu Yeroboamu aiminine ku bulambo mukutuula umutuulo, umuntu wakwa Lesa uwafumine ku Yuda aishile ku Betele peshiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.
translation: Kanshi epakupita inshila imbi, akaana ukubwelela mu nshila apitile pakwisa ku Betele.

english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
translation: Nomba kwali kasesema uwakale uwaleikala ku Betele, uyo abana bakwe baishile londolwela fyonse ifyo umuntu wakwa Lesa acitile pali bulya bushiku. Elyo baeba wishi ifyo uyu muntu aebele imfumu.

english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.
translation: Wishi abepusha ati, “Ni nshila nshi elemo?” Kabili abana bakwe epakumulangilila inshila umo umuntu wakwa Lesa uwafumine ku Yuda elemo.

english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
translation: Ena aeba abana bakwe ati, “Mpekanishisheniko kabalwe.” Kabili ilyo bapwisha ukupekanya kabalwe, aisa ninapo.

english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”
translation: Elyo akonka ukwaile umuntu wakwa Lesa, mpaka aya musanga naikala mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki. Elyo amwipusha ati, “Bushe niwe muntu wakwa Lesa uwafumine ku Yuda?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Nine.”

english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”
He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa ayasuka ati, “Teti mbwelele kunuma ukukonka iwe, nangu ukulya umukate nangu ukunwa amenshi muli ino ncende.

english: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”
translation: Yawe alinkonkomesha kwishiwi lyakwe ukukanalyako umukate, nangu ukunwa amenshi, nangu ukubwelela mu nshila naishilemo.”

english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.
translation: Kasesema wakale ayasuka ati, “Na ine wine ndi kasesema nga iwe. Ni malaika eunjebele kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe ati, ‘Kamubweseshe, ku ŋanda yobe pakuti ese alye umukate no kunwa amenshi.’” Ninshi kanshi alemubepafye.

english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
translation: Kanshi umuntu wakwa Lesa epakubwelela nankwe aya lya no kunwa mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”
translation: Na peshiwi lyakwa Yawe asesema pali ubu bulambo ati, “We bulambo, we bulambo, umfwa ifyo Yawe alanda, ‘Kuli nokufyalwa umwana umwaume mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi, uo bakalaita Yosaya. Pali iwe epo ali nokwipaila bashimapepo aba ncende shakupepelamo imilungu abesa mukutuula imituulo pano, na mafupa ya bantu yali nokupiila pali iwe.’”

english: As they sat at the table, the LORD’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;
translation: Lilya bacili nabekala petebulo, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli kasesema wakale uwamulengele ukubwela.

english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,
translation: Abilikisha ku muntu wakwa Lesa uwafumine ku Yuda ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Pa mulandu wakuti wasuula ishiwi lyakwa Yawe kabili wafilwa ukubaka ishiwi ilyo Yawe Lesa obe akukonkomeshe,

english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”
translation: lelo wabwelela kunuma no kwisa lya umukate no kunwa amenshi muli ino ncende umo akwebele ukukanalyamo umukate nangu ukunwamo amenshi, kanshi nomba umubili obe tawakashiikwe ukwashiikwa ifikolwe fyobe.’”

english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
translation: Ilyo umuntu wakwa Lesa apwishishe ukulya no kunwa, kasesema uwamubweseshe amupekanishisha kabalwe wakwe.

english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
translation: Lilya acili mukuya, inkalamo yamukumanya pa musebo no kumwipaya. Yaposa no mubili wakwe pa musebo. Elyo kabalwe aiminina ku lubali lumbi ulwa citumbi ne nkalamo nayo ulubali lumbi.

english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.
translation: Abantu abalepita basanga icitumbi nacilala mu musebo ne nkalamo naiminina mumbali, elyo baya eba aba mu musumba umwaleikala kasesema wakale.

english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”
translation: Ilyo kasesema uwamubweseshe pa lwendo lwakwe aumfwile, alandile ati, “Ni ulya umuntu wakwa Lesa uwafililwe ukubeela ishiwi lyakwa Yawe. Yawe eumupeele ku nkalamo iyacimwikata no kumwipaya ngefyo icebo cakwa Yawe casokele.”

english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
translation: Kasesema aeba abana bakwe ati, “Mpekanishisheni kabalwe,” nabo efyo bacita.

english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
translation: Elyo aima aya sanga icitumbi nacitambalala pa musebo ne nkalamo naimininina pa mbali. Inkalamo tayalile icitumbi nangu ukwikata kabalwe.

english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.
translation: Elyo kasesema aimya icitumbi ca muntu wakwa Lesa abika na pali kabalwe, acileta na ku musumba wakwe kukwisa muloosha no kumushiika.

english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”
translation: Pa bushiku bwine ubu, umuntu wakwa Lesa apeele icishibilo, “Ici e cishibilo Yawe alapeela. Ubulambo bwalabongoloka ne mito ilipo yalaitika.”

english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
translation: Aya lalika icitumbi mu nshinshi yakwe elyo bamuloosha no kulanda ati, “Iye we munyinefwe.”

english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.
translation: Panuma ya kumushiika elyo aeba abana bakwe ati, “Ine nga nafwa, mukanshiike mu cilindi ici cine twashiikamo umuntu wakwa Lesa. Mukabike amafupa yandi pa mbali ya mafupa yakwe.

english: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”
translation: Pantu imbila abilile kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe pa mulandu wa bulambo mu Betele na pa mayanda yonse ya ku ncende shakupepelapo imilungu isha mishi ya mu Samaria ili nokufikilishiwa.”

english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
translation: Lelo na panumafye ya fyonse ifi, Yeroboamu tafumine ku nshila shakwe ishabubifi, lelo nakabili abwekeshapo ukusonta bashimapepo ku ncende shakupepelapo imilungu ukufuma ku bantu abalekana lekana. Onsefye uwafwaya ukuba shimapepo amusuminisha, amupeela ne ncende yakupepelapo.

english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
translation: Ici ecali icabubifi ico iŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu yacitile, icalengele no bufumu ukuwa elyo no konaika mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.

english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Yeroboamu aumfwa ifyo umuntu wakwa Lesa aseseme pa bulambo ubu ku Betele, afumya ukuboko ku bulambo nokutila, “Mwikateni.” Nomba ukuboko asonteleko uyu muntu kwatunkana icakuti afilwa no kukubwesha.

english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.
translation: Elyo ubulambo nabo bwabongoloka ne mito yaitika ukulingana ne cishibilo capeele umuntu wakwa Lesa mukukonke shiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.
translation: Elyo imfumu yatila ku muntu wakwa Lesa, “Mpapatilako kuli Yawe Lesa obe no kumpepelako pakuti ukuboko kwandi kufunguluke.” Kanshi umuntu wakwa Lesa epakupapata kuli Yawe, no kuboko kwa mfumu kwafunguluka no kubafye ifyo kwaba na kale.

english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”
translation: Imfumu yaeba umuntu wakwa Lesa aiti, “Tuleya ku ŋanda kumwandi uye lyako ifyakulya, na ine njekupeelako ne cabupe.”

english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;
translation: Lelo umuntu wakwa Lesa ayasuka imfumu ati, “Nangufye cingaba ukuti ulempeela icalo cobe pakati, teti nje na iwe nangu ukulya umukate no kunwa amenshi kuno.

english: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”
translation: Pantu Yawe alinkonkomeshe kwishiwi lyakwe ati, ‘Taufwile ukulya umukate nangu ukunwa amenshi nangufye ukubwelela inshila wapitilemo.’”

english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, Abiya mwana Yeroboamu alilwele,

english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
translation: “‘Pa mulandu wa ici, nalaponya icinkunka pa ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu. Ndi no kuputula ukufuma kuli Yeroboamu umwaume onse uwakulekelesha mu Israeli, umusha nangu uwakaele. Ndi nokoca iŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu, ngefyo boca amafi, mpaka yalokota.

english: The dogs will eat he who belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’
translation: Imbwa shikalya bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu abakafwila mu musumba, elyo ifyuni fya mu lwelele nafyo fikalya abakafwila mu mpanga.’ Yawe efyo alanda.

english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.
translation: “Nomba iwe bwelelamo kumobe. Ilyo walaya ingila mu musumba umwana alaya fwa.

english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
translation: Abena Israeli bonse bali nokumuloosha kabili no kumushiika. Ena e umofye paba mu ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu uo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli asangilemo ubusuma.

english: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.
translation: “Yawe umwine ali nokufwailapo imfumu imbi pa bena Israeli iyo iyili no kwisa onaula iŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu. Buno bwine e bushiku, nga cinshi? Ee ni nombalinefye.

english: For the LORD will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
translation: Kabili Yawe ali nokupunganya abena Israeli ukuba kwati litete lilepungana mu mulonga wa menshi. Ali nokushimpula Israeli ukufuma muli cilya calo icisuma ico apeele ifikolwe fyabo, no kubasalanganishisha kwishilya lya mumana, pantu nabakalifya Yawe umutima pakupanga inceshi sha mulungu Ashera.

english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
translation: Kabili ali nokubasha pa mulandu wa pa bubifi ubo Yeroboamu acitile no kulenga abena Israeli nabo ukubifya.”

english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
translation: Elyo muka Yeroboamu aimine afuma no kuya ku Tirisa. Lilya line afikafye pa lubansa lwa ŋanda, no mwana afwa.

english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.
translation: Bamushiika elyo na bena Israeli bonse bamuloosha nge shiwi Yawe asosele ukupitila mu mubomfi wakwe Ahiya.

english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
translation: Imilimo imbi iyo Yeroboamu acitile mu nshiku shakwe ishabufumu, ubulwi alwile, ifyo ateekele, fyonse fyalilembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
translation: na Yeroboamu aeba umukashi wakwe ati, “Kabiye, uilufyanye pakuti bekwishiba ukuti niwe muka Yeroboamu. Elyo uye ku Shilo. Ahiya kasesema eko ali, ulya uwanjebele ukuti ndi nokuba imfumu ya aba bantu.

english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ali imfumu pa myaka amakumi yabili na ibili (22) elyo afwa ayalala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. No mwana wakwe Nadabu ewamupyene ukuba imfumu.

english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
translation: Reoboamu mwana Solomoni ali imfumu mu Yuda. Ali ne myaka amakumi yane na umo (41) ilyo aishile ba imfumu. Kabili aikele pa bufumu imyaka ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) mu Yerusalemu, umusumba uo Yawe asalile ukufuma mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli umwakwikala ishina lyakwe. Ishina lyakwa nyina ni Nama, umwina Amoni.

english: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.
translation: Abena Yuda bacitile icabipa mu menso yakwa Yawe. Ukucila na pa fyabubifi ifikolwe fyabo fyacitile.

english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
translation: Baikuulila ne ncende shakupepelamo imilungu yabo, baimika amabwe ne nceshi sha mulungu Ashera pa mulu wa mpili shonse ishitali na pesamba lya cimuti conse icafumba.

english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.
translation: Mwaba na bacilende ba ku mfuba abaume mu calo. Abantu bonse baiposa mukucita ifyamakankamike ifyalecita abantu abo Yawe atamfishe ku cinso ca bena Israeli.

english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;
translation: Mu mwaka walenga isano iya bufumu bwakwa Reoboamu, Shishaki imfumu ya ku Egupto yasansa umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: and he took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.
translation: Asenda icuma conse icali mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ne cuma ca mu ŋanda ye sano. Asendafye fyonse, asendela kumo ne nkwela sha golide isho Solomoni apangile.

english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Reoboamu epakupanga shimbi inkwela isha mukuba ishakupyanikishapo, yashipeela na ku bakalamba ba bashilika abalelonda pa mpongolo ya kwisano.

english: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.
translation: Ilyo lyonse imfumu yaya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe, abashilika baya nabafwala, elyo pakubwela bashibwesesha mu muputule wakushisungilamo.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Isham 15:29

english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”
translation: Usende mikate ikumi limo, umukate uwanaka bwino no lukunku lwa buci elyo uye kuli ena. Alaya kweba ifili nokucitika ku mwana.”

english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
translation: Paali ukulwishanya ukwatwalilila pakati kakwa Reoboamu na Yeroboamu.

english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.
translation: Kabili Reoboamu ilyo afwa aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, aya shiikwa pamo nabo mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Nyina ishina lyakwe ni Nama umwina Amoni. Elyo Abiya umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
translation: Eico muka Yeroboamu acita ifyo mulume amwebele aya ku ŋanda yakwa Ahiya ku Shilo.

english: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
translation: Lelo Yawe alyebele Ahiya ukuti, “Muka Yeroboamu ali mukwisa kukwipusha palwa mwana wakwe umulwele. Eico nga afika, wise umwasuke ifi nefi. Ilyo alefika aleisa icita kwati muntu umbi.”

english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.
translation: Kanshi ilyofye Ahiya aumfwa inshindo pa mwinshi atila, “Ingila muka Yeroboamu. Cinshi ico uleilufyanishisha. Nintumwa ukuleta amashiwi ayabi kuli iwe.

english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,
translation: Kabiye, kebe Yeroboamu ukuti ifi efyo Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli alanda, ‘Nakwimishe ukufuma mu bantufye no kwisa kubika pa bufumu bwa bantu bandi abena Israeli.

english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,
translation: Napatwile ubufumu ukufuma kuba mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi, napeela kuli iwe. Nomba naufilwa ukuba ngo mubomfi wandi Davidi, uwabakile amafunde yandi no kuyakonka no mutima wakwe, na lyonse ukulacita ifyalungama mu menso yandi.

english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,
translation: Naucita icabipa ukucila pali bonse abakutangilile. Nauyipangila imilungu yobe we mwine, ifimpashanya ifyaengululwa, naunkalifya umutima no kumposa ku numa yobe.

english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) uwa bufumu bwakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati, Abiya ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Yuda.

english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
translation: kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu imyaka amakumi yane na umo (41). Nakulu ishina lyakwe ali ni Maaka mwana Abishalomu.

english: Asa did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, as David his father did.
translation: Asa acitile ifintu ifyalungama pa menso yakwa Yawe, ngefyo Davidi wishi acitile.

english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
translation: Atamfya mu calo bonse bacilende ba ku mfuba abaume, aonaula no tulubi tonse ifikolwe fyakwe fyapangile.

english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.
translation: Afumya Maaka nakulu pa cifulo cakwe ica bunyina wakwa namfumu, pantu alipangile icamuselu ca luceshi lwa mulungu uwanakashi Ashera ku cimuti. Asa atema icimuti panshi aya cocela na mu mukonko wa Kidironi.

english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.
translation: Nangu tafumishe incende shakupepelako isho balecindika, umutima wakwa Asa wali uwaituula nganshi kuli Yawe mu bumi bwakwe bonse.

english: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.
translation: Aletele mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe silifa, golide ne fipe fyonse ifyo ena na wishi batuulile.

english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
translation: Asa balelwa inkondo na Baasha imfumu ya ku bena Israeli mu nshita yonse iya bufumu bwabo.

english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
translation: Baasha imfumu ya bena Israeli yaima mukulwisha Yuda kabili ashingulusha ilinga kuli Rama pakulesha ukuti kwiba nangu umo uwakufuma nangu ukwingila mu calo cakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda.

english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
translation: Asa elyo abuula silifa na golide onse uwashele mu cipao ca mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ne ya kwisano, afibika mu minwe ya babomfi bakwe abatuma na kuli Beni Hadadi mwana Taburimoni, umwana wakwa Hesioni imfumu ya ku Aramu, uwaleteeka mu Damasiko.

english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
translation: Ayeba ati, “Leka pabe icipangano pakati ka iwe na ine, nga filya cali kuli batata na kuli bawiso. Mona, ine nakutumina ifyabupe silifa na golide. Nomba pangulula icipangano wapangana na Baasha imfumu ya ku Israeli pakuti antaluke.”

english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
translation: Kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka itatu. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Maaka mwana Abishalomu.

english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
translation: Beni Hadadi asumine amashiwi ya mfumu Asa elyo atuma na bakalamba ba fita fya nkondo ukuya sansa imisumba ya mu Israeli. Acimfya imisumba ya Iyoni, Dani, Abeli Beti Maaka na ku calo ca ku Kinereti konse ukulundapo ne calo ca Naftali.

english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
translation: Ilyo Baasha aumfwa ifi, aleka ukukuula ilinga ku Rama elyo abwelela ku Tirisa.

english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
translation: Elyo Imfumu Asa yapeela icipope kuli bonse abena Yuda, takwashele nangu umo. Elyo bayamba ukutunta ukufuma ku Rama amabwe ne mbao isho Baasha alebomfya kulya. Ifi efyo imfumu Asa abomfya ukukuulila Geba wa ku Benjamini elyo na Misipa.

english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Asa, na pali fyonse ifyo abombele, fyonse ifyo acitile elyo ne misumba akuulile, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha mu Yuda? Mu nshiku shakwe ishabukote, amakasa yakwe yalishile kwata ubulwele.

english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
translation: Elyo Asa afwa no kuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, eko ashiikwa mu musumba wakwa Davidi wishi. Kabili Yehoshafati umwana wakwe umwaume ewamupyana pa bufumu.

english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
translation: Nadabu mwana Yeroboamu ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli mu mwaka wabubili uwa bufumu bwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, kabili ateekele icalo ca bena Israeli pa myaka ibili.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifibi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ena akonkelelafye mu fyabubifi ifyalecitako wishi ifyo aposelemo na bena Israeli ukucita.

english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
translation: Baasha mwana Ahiya uwa mu luko lwakwa Isaka amwimina no kuya mwipaya ku Gibetoni, umusumba wa Bafilisiti, ninshi Nadabu na bena Israeli bonse bali pakuupoka.

english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.
translation: Baasha aipeye Nadabu mu mwaka wabutatu uwa bufumu bwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, amupyana na pa bufumu.

english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
translation: Ilyo atampafye ukuteeka, aipaya aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu bonse. Tashilepo nangu umo uwamweo pa bakwa Yeroboamu, lelo alofyafye bonse pakukonka ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyapeelwe ukupitila mu mubomfi wakwe Ahiya umwina Shiloni.

english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
translation: Acitile ifyabubifi fyonse ifyo wishi acitileko. Umutima wakwe tawaipeele kuli Yawe Lesa wakwe ngefyo umutima wa cikolwe cakwe Davidi wali.

english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
translation: Ifi fyacitike pa mulandu wa fyabubifi Yeroboamu acitile, no kuwikishamo abena Israeli ukuficita kabili alenga nokuti Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli akalipe.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Nadabu, elyo na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
translation: Paleba ukulwa pakati kakwa Asa na Baasha imfumu ya bena Israeli mu nshita yonse iya bufumu bwabo.

english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.
translation: Mu mwaka wabutatu uwa bufumu bwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, Baasha ewatendeke ukuteeka icalo conse ica Israeli mu Tirisa, kabili aikele pa bufumu imyaka amakumi yabili na ine (24).

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, akonkafye mu nshila yakwa Yeroboamu na mu fyabubifi fyakwe ifyo aposelemo na bena Israeli ukuficita.

english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;
translation: Lelo pa mulandu we shina lyakwa Davidi, Yawe Lesa wakwe amupeela ulubuuto mu Yerusalemu pakwimya mwane ukumupyana elyo no kulenga umusumba wa Yerusalemu ukukosa.

english: because David did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
translation: Pantu Davidi alicitile icisuma pa cinso cakwa Yawe elyo no kubaka amafunde yakwa Yawe inshiku shonse isha mweo wakwe ngefyo bamukonkomeshe, kanofye pa mulandu wakwa Uria umwina Hiti.

english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
translation: Paleba ukulwa pakati kakwa Abiya na Yeroboamu mu nshiku shonse isha mweo wakwa Abiya.

english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifyakwa Abiya ifyo acitile pa bufumu, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda? Paleba ukulwa pakati kakwa Abiya na Yeroboamu.

english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.
translation: Elyo Abiya afwa, aya lala no kwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, baya mushiika mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Elyo Asa umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili (20) uwa bufumu bwakwa Yeroboamu imfumu ya bena Israeli, Asa ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Yuda,

english: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yehu mwana Hanani palwakwa Baasha.

english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
translation: Simuri aisa ingilafye, akoma Elaya no kumwipaya mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27) uwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda. Elyo amupyana na pa bufumu.

english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.
translation: Cilya ayamba ukuteeka, kabili aikala na pa cipuna cabufumu, aipayafye bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Baasha. Tashilemo umwaume nangu umo, nangu uwa mu lupwa nangu icibusa.

english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
translation: Efyo Simuri alofeshe ulupwa lonse ulwa ŋanda yakwa Baasha umwasoselwe ishiwi lyakwa Yawe palwakwa Baasha ukupitila muli kasesema Yehu,

english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
translation: pa mulandu wa fyabubifi Baasha no mwana wakwe Elaya bacitile. Kabili balenga na bena Israeli ukubifya, icalengele nokuti Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli akalipe pa mulandu wakupepa utulubi.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Elaya, nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27) uwakwa Asa ukuba imfumu ya bena Yuda, Simuri ateekele ku Tirisa inshiku cine lubali. Abashilika bacitile nkambi mupepi na Gibetoni, umusumba wa Bafilisiti.

english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli abali pa nkambi baumfwa ukuti Simuri aliimina imfumu no kuyipaya, basala Omuri, umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo, ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli ubushiku bulya bwine ninshi bacili pa nkambi.

english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
translation: Elyo Omuri na bena Israeli abali nankwe bafuma ku Gibetoni no kuya shinguluka umusumba wa Tirisa.

english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
translation: Ilyo Simuri amona ukuti umusumba wapokwa, aya ingila mu muputule we sano, asonteka umulilo ayocela mukati no kufwa emo afwila.

english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.
translation: Ici cacitike pa mulandu wa fyabubifi acitile, ukubifya pa cinso cakwa Yawe no kulaenda mu nshila shakwa Yeroboamu, na mu fyabubifi acitile no kulenga abena Israeli ukubifya.

english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,
translation: “Nakwimishe ukufuma ku lukungu no kukubika pa butungulushi bwa bantu bandi abena Israeli. Lelo iwe waenda mu nshila shakwa Yeroboamu no kulenga abantu bandi abena Israeli ukubifya, kabili walenga nokuti nkalipe pa bubifi bwabo.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Simuri, na bucisanguka acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
translation: Elyo abantu ba mu Israeli bapatukene pabili, abantu bamo bawilile kuli Tibuni mwana Ginati ukuti abe mfumu, kabili bambi nabo bawila kuli Omuri.

english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
translation: Nomba abakwa Omuri bakwatishapo amaka ukucila abakwa Tibuni mwana Ginati. Efyo Tibuni afwile na Omuri aba imfumu.

english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na umo (31) uwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, Omuri ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli. Ateekelemo imyaka ikumi limo na ibili (12), kabili pa myaka mutanda aikele mu Tirisa.

english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
translation: Ashita ulupili lwa Samaria kuli Shemeri pa matalanta ya silifa yabili , epo akuula umusumba pa mulu wa lupili no kuwita Samaria, pantu Shemeri elyali ishina lya mwine wa lupili.

english: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
translation: Nomba Omuri acita ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe kabili abifya ukucila na pali bonse abamutangilile.

english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
translation: Alaendafye mu nshila shonse ishakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati na mu fyabubifi fyakwe, ifyo aposelemo na Israeli ukuficita, icalengele ukusonsomba Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ukuti akalipe pa mulandu wa tulubi twabo.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Pa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Omuri, ifyo acitile elyo ne fya bulamba bwakwe, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
translation: Omuri ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe kabili ashiikilwe mu Samaria. Elyo Ahabu umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu (30) uwa bufumu bwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, Ahabu mwana Omuri ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli, kabili ateekele icalo ca Israeli mu musumba wa Samaria pa myaka amakumi yabili na ibili (22).

english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
translation: Eico naba mupepi no kulofya Baasha pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwe, kabili ndi nokulenga iŋanda yobe ukuba nge yakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati.

english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.
translation: Ahabu mwana Omuri ena acilapo ukubifya pa cinso cakwa Yawe ukucila pali bonse abamutangilile.

english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.
translation: Ena tamwenemo no bubi mukucitako ifyabubifi fyacitile Yeroboamu mwana Nebati, kabili alundapo ukuupa Yesebele umwana mwanakashi wakwa Etibaali imfumu ya bena Sidoni, no kulatumika Baali no kumupepa.

english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
translation: Aimika ubulambo bwakwa Baali mwitempele lyakwa Baali ilyo akuulile mu Samaria.

english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
translation: Ahabu aimika uluceshi lwa mulungu Ashera no kucitafye ifintu ifyakusonsomba Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ukuti akalipe ukucila na pafyo imfumu shonse ishamutangilile isha mu Israeli shacitile.

english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
translation: Mu nshiku shakwa Ahabu, Hieli uwa ku Betele akuula cipya cipya umusumba wa Yeriko. Ena pakupanga umufula alekelapo umweo wa mwana wakwe umwaume Abiramu, kabili pakukuula impongolo alekelapo umweo wakwa kasuli wakwe Segubu, ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyasosele Yoshua mwana Nuni.

english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”
translation: Imbwa shikalya bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Baasha abakafwila mu musumba, elyo ne fyuni fya mu lwelele nafyo fikalya abakafwila mu mpanga.”

english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Baasha, ifyo acitile nefyo abombele, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Baasha ilyo afwile alele ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, kabili ashiikilwe ku Tirisa. Elyo Elaya umwana wakwe ewamupyana pa bufumu.

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
translation: Ne calengele ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ukwisa ukupitila muli kasesema Yehu mwana Hanani kuli Baasha na ba mu ŋanda yakwe, ni pa mulandu wa fyabubifi acitile pa cinso cakwa Yawe, no kumulenga ukuti akalipe pa fintu acitile, no kusanguka kwati ni ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu, na pa mulandu wakuyonaula.

english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na mutanda (26) uwa bufumu bwakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda, Elaya mwana Baasha ewatendeke ukuteeka mu calo ca bena Israeli. Kabili aikele pa bufumu imyaka ibili mu Tirisa.

english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;
translation: Simuri, umo pali bacilolo bakwe, uwaleyangalila icipani cimo ica maceleta amukwatila amapange ayabi. Elaya ninshi ali ku Tirisa pali iyi nshita alekolwa ubwalwa mu ŋanda yakwa Alusa, uwali umukalamba wa kwisano ku Tirisa.

english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
translation: Nomba Eliya umwina Tishibe uwafumine ku Tishibe mu calo ca Gileadi aebele Ahabu ati, “Napali Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli uwamweo uyo mombela, takwakatale akube mfula no mume mu myaka ileisa kanofye peshiwi lyandi.”

english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
translation: Kanshi Eliya epakuya ku Sarepati. Ilyo afika pa mpongolo ya musumba, aya sanga namfwilwa aleteba inkuni. Elyo amwita no kumweba ati, “Mpeelako amenshi mu lukombo ayakuti nwe?”

english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
translation: Cilya aima ukuya mukubuula amenshi, kabili amubilikisha ati, “Napapata undeteleko na kamukate.”

english: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
translation: Namfwilwa ayasuka ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Lesa obe uwamweo, ine nshikwete umukate nangu umo. Nkwetefye utubunga utunono mu mpakwilo no tumafuta utunono mu musukupala. Ndeteba inkuni, ntwale ku ŋanda ishakuya ipikila utwakuti ine no mwana wandi umwaume tulye, elyo tufwe.”

english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
translation: Eliya amweba ati, “Witiina iyoo. Kabiye ku ŋanda no kuya cita ifyo walanda. Nomba icantanshi upange akamukate akanono aka ine ukufuma pali uto twine ukwete no kuleta kuli ine, elyo upange iya iwe no mwana obe umwaume.

english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”
translation: Pantu ifi efyo Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli asosa ati, ‘Ubunga tabwakapwe mu mpakwilo elyo na mafuta tayali nakupwa mu musukupala obe ukushintafye na pa bushiku Yawe akalokesha imfula muno calo.’”

english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.
translation: Namfwilwa aya no kuya cita ifyo Eliya amwebele. Kanshi cila bushiku kwalaba ifyakulya fyakwa Eliya, ifyakwa namfwilwa na ba mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
translation: Kabili ubunga tabwatalile abupwa mu mpakwilo, elyo na mafuta tayatalile ayapwa mu musukupala ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyasosele Eliya.

english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
translation: Yako 5:17

english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
translation: Elyo umwine ŋanda aeba Eliya ati, “Finshi wamfulilwa, we muntu wakwa Lesa? Bushe wacisa mukuncinkula pa fyabubifi fyandi eco waipaila umwana?”

english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
translation: Eliya amweba ati, “Mpeela umwana obe,” Amubuula ukufuma mu minwe yakwe, amusenda ku muputule wa pamulu umo aleikala, elyo amulalika pa musengele wakwe.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli Eliya aliti,

english: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”
translation: Elyo alomba kuli Yawe ati, “We Yawe, Lesa wandi, bushe niwe uletele ubu busanso pali uyu namfwilwa ndeikalako, pakulenga umwana wakwe ukufwa?”

english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”
translation: Elyo Eliya alambalala pa citumbi ca mwana imiku itatu, nakabili alomba kuli Yawe ati, “We Yawe, Lesa wandi, suminisha umweo wa uyu mwana ubwelelemo muli ena.”

english: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
translation: Yawe aumfwa ukulila kwakwa Eliya, no mweo wa mwana wabwelela muli ena, aba umutuntulu,

english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
translation: Eliya aimya umwana amusenda, batentemukila mu muputule wa panshi. Amupeela kuli nyina elyo atila, “Mona umwana obe mutuntulu.”

english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”
translation: Elyo umwanakashi aeba Eliya ati, “Nomba naishiba ukuti uli muntu wakwa Lesa, kabili nokuti ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilifuma mu kanwa kobe lyacishinka.”

english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
translation: “Fuma kuno, kabiye ku kabanga uye ubelame mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Keriti uwaba ku kabanga ka Yordani.

english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
translation: Wakulanwa amenshi mu mumana elyo ninkonkomesha bamwankole ukulakupeela ifyakulya uko kwine.”

english: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
translation: Eliya acita ifyo Yawe amwebele. Aya ku mumana wa Keriti, ku kabanga ka Yordani eko aya ikala.

english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
translation: Bamwankole balamuletela umukate ne nama ulucelo, kabili umukate ne nama mu nshita ya cungulo elyo alanwa amenshi ukufuma mu mumana.

english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
translation: Ilyo papite nshita umumana wakama pa mulandu wakuti tamwali imfula mu calo.

english: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli Eliya aliti,

english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
translation: “ Ima nombaline kabiye ku Sarepati iya ba ku Sidoni eko uye wikale. Ninkonkomesha namfwilwa wa kuli ilya ncende ukuya kupeelako ifyakulya.”

english: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”
translation: Panuma ya nshita iyitali, mu mwaka walenga itatu, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Eliya no kumweba ati, “Kabiye uye monekela kuli Ahabu, kabili ndi nokutuma imfula pa calo.”

english: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.
translation: Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Lesa obe uwamweo, tapaba icalo nangu ubufumu uko shikulu tatuma umuntu uwakukufwaya. Kabili konse uko icalo nangu ubufumu balanda ukuti tawafikako, alebalenga ukulapa ukuti tabakusangile.

english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’
translation: Nomba, iwe ulenjeba ukuti nje kuli shikulu nokuya mweba ati, ‘Eliya ali kuno.’

english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
translation: Ine nshaishibe noko Umupashi wakwa Yawe ulekusenda nga nakusha. Nga cakuti naya eba Ahabu elyo ese asange taulipo ninshi alenjipaya. Lelo ine ne mubomfi obe ukutulafye ku bwaice bwandi lyonse mpepa Yawe.

english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
translation: Bushe shikulu, tawaumfwa ifyo nacitile ilyo Yesebele aleipaya bakasesema bakwa Yawe? Ine nafishile bakasesema bakwa Yawe umwanda umo (100) mu ncengo shibili, muli cila lucengo balimo amakumi yasano (50), kabili no kubapeela ifyakulya elyo na menshi yakunwa.

english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
translation: Elyo nomba unjebe ukuya kuli shikulu nje mwebe ati, ‘Eliya ali kuno!’ Ena aleya njipayafye.”

english: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”
translation: Eliya asosa ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, umwine wa fita, uo ntumika, nalaya monekele kuli Ahabu ilelo.”

english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
translation: Awe Obadia aile kumanya Ahabu no kumweba, na Ahabu nao aimine no kuya kumanya Eliya.

english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
translation: Ilyo amona Eliya amweba ati, “Bushe niwe, we ucusha Israeli?”

english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.
translation: Eliya ayasuka ati, “Nshacitapo nangu cimo icakucusha Israeli. Lelo iwe ne ŋanda yakwa wiso nimwe mwalenga. Mwalifutuka ku mafunde yakwa Yawe no kukonka aya milungu ba Baali.

english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
translation: Nomba longanika abantu bonse aba mu Israeli twise tukumane nabo pa lupili lwa Kameli. Kabili ulete na bakasesema bonse imyanda ine na makumi yasano (450) abakwa Baali, elyo na bakasesema bonse imyanda ine (400) aba mulungu Ashera abaliila petebulo limo pamo na Yesebele.”

english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
translation: Kanshi Eliya epakuya monekela kuli Ahabu.

english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
translation: Elyo Ahabu atuma imbila mu calo conse ica Israeli no kulonganika bakasesema bonse pa lupili lwa Kameli.

english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
translation: Eliya aiminina ku cinso ca bantu no kubeba ati, “Bushe ni lilali mukekalilila abatangalikwa no bupingushi bubili? Nga cakuti Yawe e lesa, eo mukonke, lelo nga cakuti Baali e lesa, eo mukonke.” Lelo abantu batalala tondolo.

english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.
translation: Elyo Eliya abeba ati, “Ninefye neka pali bakasesema bakwa Yawe uushele, lelo Baali ali na bakasesema imyanda ine na makumi yasano (450).

english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.
translation: Tufwaileniko bacilume wa ŋombe babili. Kabili bakasesema bakwa Baali baisalilepo iyo balefwaya, baiputaule mu fipimfya fipimfya bafibike na pa mulu wa nkuni, lelo besontekapo umulilo. Na ine ndebuule iŋombe ishele njibike pa mwina wa nkuni lelo nshasontekepo umulilo.

english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”
translation: Elyo imwe mukuute peshina lya mulungu wenu, na ine ndeisa kuuta peshina lyakwa Yawe. Elyo umulungu uuleisa asuka ku mulilo, e Lesa.” Na abantu bonse batila, “Ico cena wasosa cawama.”

english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”
translation: Eliya aeba bakasesema bakwa Baali ati, “Salenipo iŋombe imo mubalilepo ukupekanya, apo imwe muli abengi nganshi. Mukuute na peshina lya mulungu wenu, lelo mwisonteka umulilo pa nkuni.”

english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.
translation: Kanshi epakubuula iŋombe iyo basalile no kupekenya. Elyo bakuuta peshina lyakwa Baali ukufuma ulucelo ukufika akasuba pakati ka mutwe, balekuuta ati, “We Baali twasuke.” Nomba takwali ubwasuko, nangufye umo uwakwasuka. Elyo balacinda ukushinguluko ubulambo bapangile.

english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”
translation: Lilya akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe Eliya ayamba ukubaseka ati, “Pundisheni, kabili ni ku mulungu. Nalimo ucili uletontonkanya, nalimo naupasuka, nalimo uli ne fiupamfishe, nalimo uli pa lwendo, nalimo uli mu tulo ulefwaikwa ukuubusha.”

english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.
translation: Epakupunda ishiwi likalamba, baitetaula pa mibili ne mpanga na mafumo umwabelele ulutambi lwabo mpaka umulopa wasuuma.

english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kapita pakati ka mutwe, nabo bakonkanyapofye amapepo yakusabaila mpaka inshita yakutuula ilambo lya cungulo, nomba takwali ubwasuko, nangu umo uwayaswike, nangu ukumfwa.

english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly;
translation: Kanshi Ahabu nao epakwita Obadia uwaleyangalila abalebomba kwisano. Uyu Obadia ali umuntu uwacisumino icikulu muli Yawe.

english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.
translation: Elyo Eliya aeba abantu bonse ati, “Palameni kuli ine.” Bonse baisa uko ali, elyo awaminisha ubulambo bwakwa Yawe ubwali ubwabongoloka.

english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
translation: Eliya abuula amabwe ikumi limo na yabili (12), cila libwe limo lyaimininako uluko lumo ukulingana na bana bakwa Yakobo, kuli uyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile no kulanda ati, “Ishina lyobe likaba ni Israeli.”

english: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.
translation: Kuli aya yene mabwe akuulilako ubulambo mwishina lyakwa Yawe. Aimbako ne cilindi ukushinguluka icikulu ico bengabikamo imbuto ukucila petepe limo.

english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”
translation: Ateba ne nkuni, aputaula na cilume wa ŋombe mu fipimfya fipimfya no kubika pa mulu wa nkuni. Elyo abeba ati, “Isusheni amenshi mu mitondo ine, mwitile pa bulambo elyo na pa nkuni.”

english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.
translation: Kabili abeba ati, “Bwekeshenipo.” Nabo babwekeshapo.

english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
translation: Amenshi yakonkoloka mu mbali shonse isha bulambo no kwisula mu cilindi icashingulwikeko.

english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
translation: Pa nshita yakutuula ilambo, Eliya kasesema aisa iminina pantanshi no kupepa ati, “We Yawe, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, lekeni cishibikwe ilelo ukuti niwe Lesa wakwa Israeli, kabili ukuti ine ndi mubomfi obe, kabili ncita ifintu fyonse ifi ukukonka ishiwi lyobe.

english: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”
translation: Unjasuke we Yawe, unjasuke, pakuti abantu aba beshibe ukuti we Yawe niwe Lesa, kabili nokuti walabwesha imitima yabo kuli iwe we mwine.”

english: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
translation: Elyo Yawe atuma umulilo wakwe no koca ilambo, inkuni, amabwe elyo no mushili no kumika amenshi mu cilindi.

english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”
translation: Ilyo abantu bamona ifi, bawa panshi ubukupeme no kulila abati, “Yawe ni Lesa, Yawe ni Lesa.”

english: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
translation: Lintu Yesebele acili aleipaya bakasesema bakwa Yawe, Obadia alifyushishepo bakasesema umwanda umo (100) no kuya bafisa mu ncengo shibili, cila lucengo mwali bakasesema amakumi yasano (50), elyo no kubapeela ifyakulya na menshi yakunwa.

english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.
translation: Elyo Eliya apeela icipope ati, “Ikateni bonse bakasesema bakwa Baali. Mwileka nangu umo abutuke.” Epakubekata bonse kabili Eliya abasenda no kubaleta kwishika lya Kishoni eko abepaila.

english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”
translation: Kabili Eliya aeba Ahabu ati, “Kabiye uye ulye no kunwa, pantu naumfwa iciunda ca mfula iyingi nganshi.”

english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
translation: Kanshi Ahabu epakuya mukulya na mukunwa, lelo Eliya ena anina pa mulu wa lupili lwa Kameli, akontamina panshi ya mushili abika umutwe pakati ka makufi.

english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.
translation: Aeba umubomfi wakwe ati, “Kabiye uye uloleshe kuli bemba.” Umubomfi aya nokuya lolesha, elyo asosa ati, “Takuli nangu cimo kulya.” Pa miku cine lubali Eliya alemwebafye ati, “Bwelelamo”

english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”
translation: Pa muku walenga cine lubali umubomfi alanda ati, “Namona akalikumbi akanono akali kwati cisansa ca kuboko kwa muntu kaleima ukufuma muli bemba” Elyo Eliya atila, “Ima kebe Ahabu auti pekanye celeta lyobe wendeshe ukuya lintu imfula tailakucilikila.”

english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, umulu wafiita fititi ku makumbi, icikuku naco caima, ne mfula iyingi nganshi yalaloka, elyo Ahabu anina iceleta aya ku Yesireli.

english: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
translation: Amaka yakwa Yawe yaisa pali Eliya, akakilila umwingila mu mushipi elyo abutukisha ukucilila Ahabu pakuya ku Yesireli.

english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”
translation: Ahabu alyebele Obadia ukuti, “Pitana mukati ka calo monse, umone ukuliko imilonga nangu inika ukwakuti tusangeko icani icakulya bakabalwe na bapunda pakuti twiipaya inama nangu imo.”

english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
translation: Kanshi epakwakana incende shakuya mukufwailishako, Ahabu aya ku ncende imo na Obadia ku ncende ibiye.

english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
translation: Ilyo Obadia acili mukuya, Eliya amukumanya. Obadia amwishiba, akontamina panshi no kumweba ati, “Bushe cine niwe shikulu Eliya?”

english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”
translation: Eliya amwasuka ati, “Ee, kabiye kebe sokulu auti, ‘Eliya ali kuno.’”

english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
translation: Obadia amweba ati, “Nga cinshi ico nakulufyanya icakuti utume ine ne musha obe kuli Ahabu ukuti aye njipaya?

english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
translation: Nomba Ahabu aya eba Yesebele fyonse ifyo Eliya acitile nefyo aipeye bakasesema bonse ku lupanga.

english: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
translation: Ayasuka ati, “Naliba uwapimpa mukubombela Yawe, Lesa umwine wa fita. Abena Israeli balikaana icipangano cobe, balitobaula ifibumbili fya malambo fyobe, no kwipaya bakasesema bobe bonse ku lupanga. Ninefye neka nshele elyo kabili na ine wine balefwaya ukunjipaya.”

english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD.” Behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.
translation: Yawe amweba ati, “Kabiye uye wiminine pa lupili pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pantu Yawe alefwaya ukupita.” Elyo icimwela icikulu capupa no kulepula ulupili pakati pa cinso cakwa Yawe, lelo Yawe talimo mu mwela. Panuma ya cimwela, kwaisa icinkukuma, lelo Yawe talimo mu cinkukuma.

english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
translation: Panuma ya cinkukuma kwaisa umulilo, lelo Yawe talimo mu mulilo. Panuma ya mulilo elyo kwaisa ishiwi ilyakutotosha.

english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
translation: Ilyo Eliya aumfwa ishiwi, afimba umwingila pa menso, afumina panse aiminina pa mwinshi wa lucengo.

english: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
translation: Ayasuka ati, “Naliba uwapimpa mukubombela Yawe, Lesa umwine wa fita. Abena Israeli balikaana icipangano cobe, balitobaula ne fibumbili fya malambo fyobe, no kwipaya bakasesema bobe bonse ku lupanga. Ninefye neka nshele, elyo kabili na ine wine balefwaya ukunjipaya.”

english: The LORD said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
translation: Yawe amweba ati, “Bwekelamo uye mu nshila wafumininemo, uye ku matololo ya ku Damasiko. Nga wafika kulya, uye suba Hasaeli ukuba imfumu ya bena Aramu.
