english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.
translation: Kabili uye suba Yehu umwana umwaume wakwa Nimushi, ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli. Kabili usube na Elisha umwana umwaume wakwa Shafati ukufuma ku Abeli Mehola ukukupyana pali bukasesema.

english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.
translation: Yehu ali nokwipaya umuntu onse uukapusumuka ku lupanga lwakwa Hasaeli, na Elisha ali nokwipaya umuntu onse uukapusumuka ku lupanga lwakwa Yehu.

english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.”
translation: Lelo ninsungapo abantu amakana cine lubali (7,000) mu Israeli abo amakufi yabo tayatala ayafukamina Baali, kabili abo imilomo yabo tayatala aimutomona.”

english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.
translation: Elyo Eliya afumine kulya, aya sanga na Elisha umwana mwaume wakwa Shafati. Ali mwibala, balelima ne ŋombe ikumi limo na shibili (12), umwine alelima na shibili ishalekelesheko. Eliya amupalamina amuposela umwingila wakwe wamukupa.

english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”
translation: Kanshi Yesebele epakutuma amashiwi kuli Eliya ati, “Imilungu ikancitile icili conse, nangu cikabipa shani, nga cakuti mailo pa nshita nga ino ine nshicitile cimo cine umweo obe ukuba nga umo pali abo wipeye.”

english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”
translation: Elisha elyo asha iŋombe shakwe akonka Eliya. Elisha alanda ati, “Ndeka nje nshalikepo batata na bamayo elyo njise nkukonke.” Eliya amweba ati, “Bwelelamo, nga ine finshi ncitile kuli iwe.”

english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.
translation: Elisha epakufumako no kubwelako. Aya buula ne ŋombe shakwe ishabulimi aipaya. Abuula ifibombelo fyakulimina efyo akoseshako umulilo, aipikilapo inama apeela na bantu bakwe, no kulya balya. Elyo aimine akonka Eliya, aba umubomfi wakwe.

english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
translation: Eliya aumfwa umwenso, abutuka ukutiina ukufwa. Ilyo afika ku Beresheba mu Yuda, eko asha umubomfi wakwe,

english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”
translation: nomba ena aya mu matololo pa lwendo lwa bushiku bumo. Afika apali icimuti, aikala mwisamba apepa nokuti cawama afwe. Alanda nokuti, “Nacula pafula we Yawe. Njipayafye, pantu ine nshacila ifikolwe fyandi ubusuma.”

english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
translation: Elyo alala mwisamba lya cimuti, apona na mu tulo. Pa nshita ine ilya malaika amwikata no kumweba ati, “Buka ulye.”

english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.
translation: Lilya aceba ceba, elyo amona umukate lwa ku mitwe uwapangilwe pa mabwe ayakaba, elyo no lukombo lwa menshi. Alya elyo anwa na menshi, abwela alala nakabili.

english: The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
translation: Malaika wakwa Yawe abwela umuku wacibili aisa mwikata elyo amweba ati, “Ima, ulye pantu ulwendo ulu nalukukosela.”

english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
translation: Elyo aima, alya no kunwa. Cilya ifyakulya fyamupa amaka, aima ubulendo ubwakwendapo inshiku amakumi yane (40) akasuba no bushiku mpaka aya fika ku Holebu, ulupili lwakwa Lesa.

english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
translation: Aya ingila mu lucengo emo asendama.

english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
translation: Imfumu Davidi yakota no kuba ne myaka iyingi icakuti yalakaana no kumfwa icikabilila nangu baifimba ifyakufimbana.

english: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
translation: Nomba Natani kasesema, Benaya, impalume shabulwi ishakulinda imfumu elyo na munyina Solomoni bena tabetileko.

english: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
translation: Elyo Natani aipwishe Batisheba no kumweba ati, “Bushe tawishibe iwe ukuti Adoniya, mwana Hagiti, naibika pa bufumu ukwabula ukuti imfumu Davidi ishibe?

english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.
translation: Eico nomba leka nkupandeko amano pakuti upusushe umweo obe elyo no mweo wa mwana obe Solomoni.

english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’
translation: Kabiye ku mfumu Davidi uye wipushe auti, ‘Kanabesa we mfumu yandi bushe tekuli ine ne musha obe walapile auti, umwana obe Solomoni eukapyana pa bufumu kabili eukekala pa cipuna candi? Nga kanshi Adoniya aba shani imfumu?’

english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”
translation: Na ine nalaisa lingafye lilya line ucili ulelanda ne mfumu elyo nyingile nokwisa suminisha fyonse ifyo ulelanda.”

english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
translation: Nao Batisheba epakwingila mu muputule umwali imfumu umo umukashana Abishagi alesungila imfumu. Pali iyi nshita ninshi yalikota nganshi.

english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
translation: Ilyo aingila Batisheba afukama no kutota ku mfumu. Elyo imfumu yamwipusha aiti, “Cinshi ico ulefwaya?”

english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “We mfumu yandi, niwe walapile kuli Yawe Lesa obe ukuti, ‘Solomoni umwana wandi eukapyana pa bufumu kabili eukekala pa cipuna candi.’

english: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.
translation: Nomba moneni, Adoniya euli pa bufumu ilyo iwe we mfumu tawishibepo nelyo cimo.

english: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.
translation: Adoniya natuula ne lambo lya ŋombe ishingi, ne fiponti ifingi ifyaina elyo ne mpaanga ishingi. Na ku mitebeto naitako abana ba mfumu bonse abaume, shimapepo Abiyata, Yoabu umukalamba wa fita, lelo tetilekofye umwana obe Solomoni.

english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”
translation: Eico ababomfi baiko batila kuli ena, “Natufwaye umukashana uushatala opwa uwakuti aleikala nankwe, alebomba umulimo wa kusunga imfumu. Ena akulasendama kumbali pakuti imfumu ileumfwako icikabilila.”

english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
translation: Kanabesa we mfumu yandi, icalo conse ica Israeli ciposele amenso pali iwe pakuti cishibe uuli nokupyana pa bufumu.

english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
translation: Pantu, ilyo shikulu we mfumu yandi ukaya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe, ine no mwana wandi Solomoni bakatucita ngo tupondo.”

english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
translation: Ilyo Batisheba acili alelondolwela imfumu amashiwi, kasesema Natani nao afika mwisano.

english: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
translation: Elyo ababomfi baeba imfumu abati, “Natani kasesema aisa.” Natani aingila umwali imfumu elyo atota ninshi nakontamike cinso.

english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
translation: Lelo line acima no kuya tuula ilambo lya ŋombe ishingi, ifiponti ifyaina elyo ne mpaanga. Naitako na bana ba mfumu abaume bonse, abakalamba ba fita fya nkondo elyo na shimapepo Abiyata. Na ino ine nshita ndelanda elyo balelya no kunwa pamo pene nankwe, balelanda na mashiwi yakuti, ‘Ube no mweo wamuyayaya we mfumu Adoniya.’

english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
translation: Lelo ine ne musha wenu, Sadoki shimapepo, Benaya mwana Yehoiyada elyo no mubomfi obe Solomoni bena tapali uo betileko kuli uyu umutebeto.

english: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”
translation: Bushe ici cintu niwe kanabesa we mfumu ucitile ukwabula ukwishibisha ababomfi bobe umuntu uuli nokwikala pa cipuna cobe we mfumu?”

english: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi yatila, “Njitileniko Batisheba.” Nao aisa nokwisa ingila umwali imfumu aiminina pa cinso caiko.

english: The king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
translation: Elyo imfumu yalanda amashiwi yamulapo aiti, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe umumi, uwampususha no kumfumya mu mafya yonse,

english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
translation: Elyo bafwailisha mu calo conse ica Israeli mpaka basanga umukashana umusuma nganshi uwe shina lya Abishagi, umwina Shunemu, eo basenda no kuleta ku mfumu.

english: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”
translation: ine pa bushiku bwa lelo nalafikilishapo ifyo nakulaile mwishina lyakwa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli ukuti, ‘Solomoni umwana obe euli nokumpyana pa bufumu kabili euli nokwisa ikala na pa cipuna cino cine.’”

english: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”
translation: Awe Batisheba akontamika icinso cakwe panshi, afukama na pa cinso ca mfumu alanda nokuti, “Ube no mweo wamuyayaya kanabesa we mfumu Davidi.”

english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi yatila, “Njitileniko Sadoki shimapepo, Natani kasesema elyo na Benaya mwana Yehoiyada.” Ilyo baingila apali imfumu, elyo yabeba aiti,

english: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
translation: “Buuleni ababomfi bandi bonse, muye nabo mubike no mwana wandi Solomoni pali punda wandi mumutwale ku Gihoni.

english: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
translation: Kulya eko Sadoki shimapepo na Natani kasesema baye musuba ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli. Muye lisha ne penga no kupunda amuti, ‘Abe no mweo wamuyayaya imfumu Solomoni.’

english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”
translation: Na pakwisa mwise nankwe pakuti eo ese ekale pa cipuna candi no kwamba ukuteeka. Nimusonta ukuti abe mfumu ya calo ca Israeli elyo na Yuda.”

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.
translation: Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ayasuka imfumu ati, “Ameni! Lekeni Yawe, Lesa wakwa kanabesa imfumu yandi, asuminishe icacitwa.

english: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”
translation: Ngefyo Yawe ali na kanabesa imfumu yandi efyo abe na kuli Solomoni, no kulenga icipuna cakwe cikwatishe amaka ukucila na pa cipuna cakwa kanabesa imfumu Davidi.”

english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
translation: Awe Sadoki shimapepo, Natani kasesema, Benaya mwana Yehoiyada, abena Kereti na bena Peleti baima baya bika Solomoni pali punda wa mfumu Davidi bamushindika na ku Gihoni.

english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation: Sadoki shimapepo epakubuula amafuta ayali mu lusengo ukufuma mwitenti lyakwa Lesa no kusuba Solomoni. Elyo baisa lisha ne penga na bantu bonse baisa punda abati, “Abe no mweo uwamuyayaya imfumu Solomoni.”

english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
translation: Uyu mukashana ali umusuma nganshi kanshi ewayambile ukulabomba umulimo wakusunga imfumu, lelo imfumu tayamwishibe mu nshila ya cupo.

english: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.
translation: Elyo na bantu bonse baima bayamba no kumukonka, balelisha imitolilo no kusekelela ukukalamba icalengele nokuti umushili usunkane pa mulandu wa ciunda.

english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”
translation: Cilyafye baba mukupwa ukulya, Adoniya na bantu bonse abo aitile ku mutebeto baumfwa ificitike. Nomba Yoabu pakumfwa iciunda ce penga epakwipusha ati, “Bushe icongo conse icileumfwika mukati ka musumba cilolele mwi?”

english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
translation: Lintu Yoabu talapwisha no kulanda, Yonatani mwana Abiyata shimapepo afika apo bali. Adoniya amupokelela amweba ati, “Ingila, pantu umuntu umucindami nga iwe afwile aleta amashiwi ayasuma nganshi.”

english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.
translation: Yonatani ayasuka ati, “Awe iyoo! Icilipo kutila kanabesa imfumu Davidi isontele Solomoni ukuba imfumu.

english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.
translation: Imfumu itumine pamo nankwe Sadoki shimapepo, Natani kasesema, Benaya mwana Yehoiyada, abena Kereti elyo na bena Peleti, ebaciya nankwe, nabamuninika na pali punda wa mfumu.

english: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
translation: Elyo Sadoki shimapepo na Natani kasesema nabaya musuba ukuba imfumu ku Gihoni. Ukufuma uko euko beshile baleyaula utupundu, na bantu bonse mu musumba nabaponenamo. Kanshi e ico congo muleumfwa.

english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
translation: Ne cikulishepo nomba cakuti Solomoni naya ikala na pa cipuna cabufumu.

english: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.
translation: Elyo na bacilolo bonse aba kwisano nabesa mukutasha kanabesa imfumu Davidi abati, ‘Cawama Lesa obe alenga ne cipuna cakwa Solomoni cikwatishe amaka ukucila icipuna cobe.’ Nayo imfumu yakontamika icinso ninshi ili pa musengele yatampa ukupepa.

english: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”
translation: Akonkanyapo no kupepa ati, ‘Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, uwasuminisha ukuti amenso yandi yamone uwakwikala pa cipuna candi ilelo.’”

english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.
translation: Pakumfwa ifi fyonse abantu bonse abo Adoniya aitile baikatwa no mwenso, na bonse epakwima basalangana.

english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
translation: Nomba Adoniya, uyo nyina ali ni Hagiti, aima no kulanda ati, “Nine nalaba imfumu.” Epakuiteyanishisha amaceleta na bakabalwe elyo na bantu abaume amakumi yasano (50) abakutangila pa ntanshi yakwe.

english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.
translation: Lelo Adoniya pa mulandu wakutiina Solomoni, aima ayakonena ku nsengo sha ku bulambo.

english: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”
translation: Elyo Solomoni baisa mweba abati, “Munonko alekutiina pakuba imfumu. Ena nabutuka ele konena na ku nsengo shabulambo eko ekele. Alandile nokutila, ‘Ndefwaya imfumu Solomoni ilape kuli ine ukuti tayanjipaye ku lupanga.’”

english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”
translation: Solomoni epakwasuka ati, “Nga cakuti ali nokuilanga ukuba umuntu wine wine, takwakafume umushishi nangu umo ku mutwe wakwe ukuponena panshi, lelo nga cakuti ububifi bwasangwa muli ena ninshi lyena ali nokufwa.”

english: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Solomoni yatumine abantu, nabo baya musenda bamuleta ukufuma ku bulambo. Adoniya epakwisa ku mfumu Solomoni aisa kontamika umutwe no kutota. Nao Solomoni epakumweba ati, “Kabiye kumobe.”

english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.
translation: Lelo wishi tatalile amwipusha ukuti, “Nga kanshi cinshi ulecitila ifi?” Ali umwana uwayemba nganshi elyo ewakonkelepo Abusalomu mukufyalwa.

english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
translation: Adoniya ayambile ukumfwana na Yoabu mwana Seruiya elyo na shimapepo ishina lyakwe ni Abiyata. Aba ebamupeele icikoselesho.

english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
translation: Lelo shimapepo uwe shina lya Sadoki, Benaya mwana Yehoiyada, kasesema uwe shina lya Natani, Shimei elyo na Rei pamo pene ne mpalume shabulwi sha imfumu Davidi, bena tabamukonkele Adoniya.

english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;
translation: Elintu Adoniya atuula ilambo lya mpaanga, iŋombe elyo ne fiponti ifyaina pa cilibwe ca Soheleti mupepi na ku Eni Rogeli. Aitako na bamunyina bonse abana ba mfumu abaume, na baume bonse aba mu calo ca Yuda ababomfi ba kwisano.

english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.
translation: Nomba Beni Hadadi imfumu ya bena Aramu alonganike ifita fyakwe fyonse. Afwaya ne mfumu ishakumwafwa amakumi yatatu na shibili (32) ishali na bakabalwe na maceleta, efyo aile no kuya shinguluka no kusansa Samaria.

english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”
translation: Elyo Beni Hadadi atuma amashiwi na yambi kuli Ahabu ati, “Ala imilungu incitile icili conse nangufye cintu icabubi ubuli bonse, nga cakuti mukashala ulukungu mu Samaria ulwakupeela abantu ndi nabo cila muntu ulupi lumo.”

english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yayasuka aiti, “Kamwebeni ukuti, ‘Umuntu uwafwala inkwela talingene no wafuula.’”

english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.
translation: Beni Hadadi aumfwa amashiwi aya pa nshita ena ne mfumu ali nasho balenwa mu matenti yabo, elyo aeba abashilika bonse ati, “Ipekanyeni ukuya sansa.” Nabo bonse baya ipekanya ukusansa umusumba.

english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Nomba pa nshita ine ilya kwaishile kasesema kuli Ahabu imfumu ya bena Israeli no kwisa landa ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Bushe namumona uyu mulongo uukalamba uwa bashilika? Nalaupeela mu minwe yobe ilelo, kabili uli nokwishiba ukuti nine Yawe.’”

english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “The LORD says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”
translation: Ahabu aipusha ati, “Nga abalacita ifi ni bani?”

english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
translation: Ahabu epakwita abalumendo ba balashi bafitungu abaume imyanda ibili na makumi yatatu na babili (232). Elyo alonganika na bena Israeli bonse amakana cine lubali (7,000).

english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.
translation: Bafuma ninshi akasuba kali pakati ka mutwe ilyo Beni Hadadi ne mfumu shimbi amakumi yatatu na babili (32) abalemutungilila bacili mu matenti balenwa.

english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”
translation: Abalumendo ba balashi bafitungu ebabalilapo ukufuma.

english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”
translation: Ena asosa ati, “Nga baishila umutende, mubekate abatuntulu. Nangu nga baishila ukulwa inkondo, nalyo line mubekate abatuntulu.”

english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.
translation: Abalumendo ba balashi bafitungu babalilapo ukufuma mu musumba, na bashilika bakonka panuma,

english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,
translation: Atuma inkombe mu musumba ku mfumu Ahabu iya bena Israeli ati, “Ifi efyo Beni Hadadi alanda ukuti,

english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.
translation: elyo cila umo alakoma umulwani wakwe. Pa mulandu wa ici abena Aramu babutuka, babakunkunika ku bena Israeli. Lelo Beni Hadadi imfumu ya bena Aramu yapusumuka yanina pali kabalwe pamo na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe.

english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yakonkanyapo ukufuma no kuya cimfya abamaceleta na ba pali bakabalwe, no kwipaya abalwani abengi abena Aramu.

english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”
translation: Panuma yakulwa, kasesema aisa ku mfumu ya bena Israeli no kusosa ati, “Ukoshe icifulo cobe elyo kabili utontonkanye bwino ifyo ufwile ukucita pantu uyu mwaka imfumu ya bena Aramu ili nokwisa kusansa kabili.”

english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.
translation: Pali ilya ine nshita, bacilolo ba mfumu ya bena Aramu bapanda imfumu amano abati, “Imilungu ya balya bantu milungu ya mu mpili, eco bakwatile amaka ukutucila. Lelo nga twabalwisha mu mawanga, lyena tuli nokukwatapo amaka ukubacila.

english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.
translation: Kanshi iwe ucite ici, fumya imfumu shonse mukucincisha ifita no kupyanikishapo abakalamba ba fita.

english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.
translation: Ukemye ifita fya nkondo nga filya fine fyalobele, ifyakuti kabalwe na kabalwe elyo iceleta peceleta, pakuti tukaye lwisha abena Israeli mu mawanga. Lyena cacine tuli nokubacila amaka.” Awe abasuminisha no kucita ukulingana na fyonse.

english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
translation: Mu mwaka wakonkelepo Beni Hadadi alonganike abena Aramu, no kunina aya ku Afeki mukulwisha abena Israeli.

english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.
translation: Abena Israeli nabo balongana, bapeelwa ne fyakulya elyo baima ukuya bakumanya. Abena Israeli bacita inkambi shibili ukulungatana nabo, epo baikala kwati tumabumba twa mbushi ninshi abena Aramu beswilefye mpanga yonse.

english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “The LORD is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa aisa no kwisa eba imfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “ifi efyo Yawe alanda ukuti, ‘Pantu abena Aramu baletontonkanya ukuti Yawe e mulungu wa mpili, lelo te mulungu wa mawanga, nalapeela umulongo wa bashilika bonse aba mu minwe yenu, pakuti na imwe mwishibe ukuti nine Yawe.’”

english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.
translation: Pa nshiku cine lubali baikele nabalungatana, elyo na pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali bakumana mukulwa. Abena Israeli baipaya abena Aramu amakana umwanda umo (100,000) uwa fita fya pa makasa mu bushiku bumo.

english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”
translation: ‘Silifa na golide yobe nomba yandi elyo na bakashi bobe bonse na bana abasuma bandi.’”

english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.
translation: Abashelepo bapusumuka baya ku musumba wa Afeki, nako ilinga lyaya wila pa bantu amakana amakumi yabili na makana cine lubali (27,000). Elyo Beni Hadadi abutukila mu kati ka musumba abelama mu muputule wa mu kati.

english: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”
translation: Bacilolo bakwe bamweba abati, “Mona, natumfwa ukuti imfumu ya ŋanda yakwa Israeli yaluse. Leka tuye ku mfumu ya bena Israeli natufwala insalu shabulanda mu misana yesu, no kupomba imyando ku mitwe yesu. Nalimo kusuka yakwelela.”

english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”
translation: Bafwala insalu shabulanda mu misana yabo no kupomba intambo ku mitwe yabo, baya ku mfumu ya bena Israeli no kuya yeba ati, “Umusha obe Beni Hadadi atile, ‘Napapata mwinjipaya.’”

english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
translation: Abantu batontonkanya ukuti ici cena caba lishuko, bayangufyanya no kubuula amashiwi yakwe abati, “Ca cine Beni Hadadi ni munonko.”

english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.
translation: Beni Hadadi apeela ubulayo ati, “Ndi nokubwesha imisumba yonse tata apokolwele kuli wiso. Kabili kuti wakuula amayanda yobe aya makwebo mu Damasiko nga filya tata acitile mu Samaria.”

english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.
translation: Ukulingana nefyo Yawe akonkomeshe, umwana umo umwaume uwa bakasesema aebele umunankwe ati, “Nkoma ku lupanga lobe.” Lelo umunankwe akaana.

english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.
translation: Elyo kasesema alanda ati, “Pantu wafilwa ukumfwila Yawe, ilyofye walafuma pano inkalamo yalaya kwipaya.” Kabili cilya umuntu afumapofye aya, inkalamo yamusanga no kumwipaya.

english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.
translation: Kabili kasesema asanga umuntu umbi elyo amweba ati, “Napapata nkoma” elyo umuntu amukoma no kumucena.

english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.
translation: Elyo kasesema aya iminina mu mbali ya musebo alalolela imfumu. Aifungushanya, akaka ne citambala ku mutwe cakopokela pa menso.

english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
translation: Cilya imfumu yalapita, kasesema abilikisha imfumu ati, “Umubomfi obe aciya ingila mu kati ka bulwi, umushilika umo acileta umulwani uwiketwe, elyo anjeba ati, ‘Sunga uyu muntu, nga aluba, cili nokuba umweo obe pa mweo wakwe, nangu ufwile ukufuta italanta limo ilya silifa .’

english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yayasuka ati, “Nacibe ifyo fine usosele we mfumu. Ine wine, na fyonse ifyo nkwete fyaba fyobe.”

english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”
translation: Ilyo umubomfi obe acipamfiwa kuli ifi na kuli filya, uyu muntu aongoloka aluba.”

english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.
translation: Elyo kasesema bwangu bwangu afimbula icisalu pa menso, ne mfumu ya bena Israeli yamwishiba ukuti ni umo pali bakasesema.

english: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”
translation: Aeba imfumu ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa, ‘Naukakula no kuleka umuntu uo nalefwaya ukuti afwe. Eico calaba ukuti umweo obe pa mweo wakwe, abantu bobe pa bantu bakwe.’”

english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yafumapo, yaya kwisano ku Samaria iyafitwa ku mutima kabili iyafulwa.

english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;
translation: Inkombe shaya bwela nakabili no kusosa ashiti, “Ifi efyo Beni Hadadi alanda ati, ‘Nacituma amashiwi yakufwaya silifa na golide, abakashi bobe na bana bobe.

english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”
translation: Lelo mailo, inshita nga ino ine, nkatuma bacilolo bandi ukwisa sokota mu ŋanda yobe iye sano na mayanda ya bacilolo bobe. Bali nokwisa pokolola fyonse ifyacindama no kusenda.’”

english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yaita abakalamba bonse aba mu calo no kubeba aiti, “Shimoneni uyu muntu ifyo alefwaya ifyongo. Ilyo acituma amashiwi yakumpoka abakashi na bana bandi, silifa na golide, nshacimukaanina.”

english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”
translation: Abakalamba na bantu bonse bayasuka ati, “Wisumina nangu ukumfwila ifyo alefwaya.”

english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.
translation: Elyo aeba inkombe shakwa Beni Hadadi ati, “Kebeni imfumu kanabesa amuti, ‘Umusha wenu naipeelesha ukucita fyonse ifyo wacibalilapo ukufwaya, nomba ici ica muku wabubili cena nafilwa.’” Inkombe shabwekelamo no kuya eba Beni Hadadi.

english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
translation: Panuma ya nshita iyitali kwacitike umulandu uwakumine kwibala lyakwa Naboti umwina Yesireli. Ili bala lyali mu Yesireli, mupepi ne sano lyakwa Ahabu, imfumu ya bena Samaria.

english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”
translation: Lelo muteke abaume babili ifinangwa fya bantu pa menso yakwe abakuti bamubepeshe abati natuka Lesa kabili natuka ne mfumu. Elyo mumusende no kuya mutobaula amabwe afwe.”

english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
translation: Elyo abakalamba na basambashi abaikele mu musumba wakwa Naboti bacita ifyo Yesebele abebele mu nkalata abalembele.

english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
translation: Bapekanya ubushiku bwakufunga baisa teka Naboti pa ncende iyicindami pakati ka bantu.

english: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.
translation: Elyo ifinangwa fibili fyaisa ikala kuntanshi yakwe fyalabepesha Naboti pa cinso ca bantu filetila, “Naboti natuka Lesa pamo ne mfumu.” Epa kumwimya bamusenda kunse ya musumba bamupolaula amabwe afwa.

english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”
translation: Elyo batuma amashiwi kuli Yesebele abati, “Naboti nabamupola amabwe nafwa.”

english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
translation: Yesebele panuma yakumfwa ukuti Naboti nabamupola amabwe nafwa, aeba Ahabu ati, “Ima uye poka ibala Naboti umwina Yesireli akene ukukushitisha. Pantu Naboti tali mumi, nafwa.”

english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
translation: Ilyo Ahabu aumfwa ukuti Naboti nafwa, aima aya pokolola ibala lyakwa Naboti.

english: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Eliya umwina Tishibe aliti,

english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
translation: “Kabiye uye eba Ahabu imfumu ya bena Israeli uuteeka mu Samaria. Pali ino nshita ali mwibala lyakwa Naboti ilyo endele ukuya pokolola.

english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”
translation: Umwebe auti, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, bushe tawipeye umuntu no kumupokolola icipe cakwe?’ Elyo umwebe auti, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, pa ncende apo imbwa shacimyanga umulopa wakwa Naboti epo imbwa shili nokumyanga umulopa obe na iwe wine, ee, umulopa uobe.’”

english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”
translation: Ahabu aeba Naboti ati, “Nimpe bala lyobe pakuti ndelimamo umusalu, pantu ili bala nalipalama kwisano lyandi. Mukukabushanya, na ine ndi nokukupeelelapo ibala ilisuma, nangu nga ulefwaya nkulipile icuma conse ico ulepingula.”

english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.
translation: Ahabu aeba Eliya ati, “Kanshi wansanga we mulwani wandi?”

english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
translation: Nalaleta icinkunka pali iwe. Nalalofya uluko lobe elyo nalaonaula mu ŋanda yakwa Ahabu umwaume onse uwakulekelesha uwa bena Israeli umusha nangu umuntungwa.

english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
translation: Nalalenga iŋanda yobe ukuba nge yakwa Yeroboamu umwana umwaume wakwa Nebati kabili nge yakwa Baasha umwana mwaume wakwa Ahiya, pantu naunsonsomba ukuti nkalipe kabili walenga na bena Israeli ukucita ububifi.

english: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
translation: “Elyo pa mulandu wakwa Yesebele, Yawe asosa ati, ‘Imbwa shili nokulya Yesebele mukati ke linga lya ku Yesireli.’

english: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
translation: “Imbwa shili nokulya bonse abakwa Ahabu abakafwila mu musumba ne fyuni ifipupuka fikalya bonse abakafwila mu mpanga.”

english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
translation: Tapatalile apaba umuntu uwapala Ahabu ukuiposaika mukucita ububifi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kabili uwalesembeleka Ahabu no kumutunka ni Yesebele umukashi wakwe.

english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
translation: Ahabu alikwete umulandu pa fintu acitile ifyakwamba ukupepa utulubi tumbi, kwati bena Amoli abo Yawe atamfishe pantanshi ya bena Israeli.

english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.
translation: Ilyo Ahabu aumfwa amashiwi aya, alepula ifyakufwala fyakwe, afwala insalu shabulanda elyo afunga. Alala nafwala insalu shabulanda kabili aima no kwenda bulanda bulanda.

english: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Eliya umwina Tishibe aliti,

english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”
translation: “Bushe naumona ifyo Ahabu aicefeshe pa cinso candi? Pa mulandu wakuti aicefya, nshalete icinkunka mu nshiku shakwe, lelo ndi nokucileta pa ŋanda yakwe mu nshiku sha mwana wakwe umwaume.”

english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May the LORD forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”
translation: Lelo Naboti ayasuka ati, “Yawe aleshe ukuti nkupeele icacishilano ca fikolwe fyandi.”

english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
translation: Elyo Ahabu aya ku ŋanda, nafitwa ku mutima kabili uwafulwa pantu Naboti umwina Yesireli acimweba ati, “Nshakupeele icacishilano ca fikolwe fyandi.” Alala pa musengele wakwe aletontonkanya, afilwa nokulya.

english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”
translation: Umukashi wakwe Yesebele aingila amwipusha ati, “Cinshi wafitilwa ku mutima icakuti wafilwa no kulya?”

english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”
translation: Ayasuka umukashi ati, “Nico naceba Naboti umwina Yesireli nati, ‘Nshitisha ibala lyobe, nangu nga ulefwaya nkupeelelepo ibala limbi pali lyena.’ Lelo acasuka ati, ‘Nshakupeele ibala lyandi.’”

english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
translation: Yesebele umukashi wakwe asosa ati, “Bushe ifi efyo ufwile ukucita nge mfumu ya bena Israeli? Ima ulye. Sansamuka pantu ine ndekupokela ibala lyakwa Naboti umwina Yesireli.”

english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.
translation: Yesebele alemba inkalata mwishina lyakwa Ahabu, aumapo inshimbi ya mfumu no kushituma ku bakalamba na basambashi abaleikala nankwe mu musumba wakwa Naboti.

english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
translation: Muli ishi nkalata alembamo ukutila,

english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
translation: Pa myaka itatu tapatalile apaba inkondo pakati ka bena Aramu na bena Israeli.

english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli na Yehoshafati imfumu ya bena Yuda baikele pa fipuna fyabo ifyabufumu pa lubansa lwakutwilapo mupepi ne mpongolo yakwingililapo mu Samaria, ninshi nabafwala ifyakufwala fyabufumu kabili na bonse bakasesema balesesema pa cinso ca shamfumu.

english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
translation: Nomba Sedekia umwana umwaume wakwa Kenana alipangile insengo sha fyela elyo asosa ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ukuti, ‘Kuli ishi nsengo eko uli nokupunkila abena Aramu mpaka ukabonaule.’”

english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
translation: Bakasesema bonse bambi balesesema cimo cine abati, “Usanse Ramoti Gileadi kabili uli nokuucimfya, pantu Yawe ali nokucipeela mu minwe ya mfumu.”

english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”
translation: Inkombe batumine kuli Mikaiya yamweba ati, “Mona, abanobe bonse nabasesema ukuti imfumu ili nokucimfya. Kanshi na iwe ulekefye amashiwi yobe yabe nga yabo, kabili ulande ifisuma.”

english: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”
translation: Lelo Mikaiya asosa ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, ine nalamwebafye ifyo Yawe alenjeba.”

english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
translation: Ilyo afika, imfumu yamwipusha aiti, “Mikaiya bushe kuti twaya lwisha Ramoti Gileadi nangu ndeke?”

english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”
translation: Imfumu yamweba aiti, “Bushe miku inga nkakulenga ukulapa ukuti wilanjeba ifintu fimbi kanofye icine mwishina lyakwa Yawe?”

english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
translation: Elyo Mikaiya ayasuka ati, “Namona abena Israeli nabasalangana bonse mu mpili nge mpaanga ishabula kacema, na Yawe atila, ‘Aba bantu tabakwata shikulu wabo. Eico lekeni cila muntu abwelele ku ŋanda mu cibote.’”

english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yaeba Yehoshafati aiti, “Bushe nshacikweba nati tasesema ifisuma nangu fimo palwa ine kanofye ifibi fyeka?”

english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word. I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
translation: Mikaiya akonkanyapo ati, “Eico umfwa kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe. Nimona Yawe ekele pa cipuna cabufumu ne fita fyonse ifya mu mulu nafiminina ukushinguluka ku lubali lwa ku kulyo no lwa ku kuso.

english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
translation: Lelo mu mwaka walenga itatu Yehoshafati imfumu ya bena Yuda yaima yaya mukupempula imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.
translation: Kabili Yawe alanda ati, ‘Ninani alaya tunka Ahabu mukuya lwisha Ramoti Gileadi pakuti kulya ekwakuti aye afwile?’ Pakwasuka uyu alanda ici, umbi nao alanda ici.

english: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
translation: “Elyo pakulekelesha, umupashi waisa iminina pantanshi yakwa Yawe walanda auti, ‘Nalaya mutunka.’

english: The LORD said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’
translation: “Yawe aipusha ati, ‘Ni mu nshila nshi?’

english: Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”
translation: “Nomba mona, Yawe nabika umupashi wakubepa ubufi mu tunwa twa bonse aba bakasesema bobe. Yawe napingula icinkunka pali iwe.”

english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
translation: Elyo Sedekiya umwana mwaume wakwa Kenana aima aya toba Mikaiya ulupi pa menso. Amwipusha ati, “Ni nshila nshi umupashi wakufuma kuli Yawe wilemo ilyo wacifuma kuli ine ukwisa landa kuli iwe?”

english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
translation: Mikaiya amwasuka ati, “Uli nokushininkisha pa bushiku ukaya belama mu muputule wamukati.”

english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.
translation: Elyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yapeela icipope aiti, “Sendeni Mikaiya mumutwale kuli Amoni, kateeka wa musumba, na kuli Yoashi umwana wa mfumu.

english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”
translation: Muye mweba ati, ‘Ifi efyo imfumu yasosa aiti, bikeni uyu muntu mu cifungo kabili tecakwesha ukumupeela icintu nangu cimo, kanofye umukate na menshi mpaka ilyo nkabwela umutende.’”

english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”
translation: Mikaiya alanda ati, “Nga cakuti uli nokubwela umutende, ninshi Yawe talandile ukupita muli ine.” Alundapo nokuti, “Mwe bantu bonse, mumfwe amashiwi aya nalanda.”

english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
translation: Kanshi imfumu ya bena Israeli na Yehoshafati imfumu ya bena Yuda epakuya ku Ramoti Gileadi.

english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yalyebele bacilolo baiko aiti, “Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti Ramoti Gileadi yesu? Nomba ifwe tatwacitapo nangu cimo icakulenga tupoke iyi ncende ukufuma ku mfumu ya bena Aramu.”

english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yaeba Yehoshafati aiti, “Ine nalaifungushanya pakwingila mu bulwi, lelo iwe ufwale ifyakufwala fyabufumu.” Elyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yaifungushanya pakwingila mu bulwi.

english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
translation: Nomba imfumu ya bena Aramu yalipeele icipope ku bakalamba ba bashilika ba maceleta amakumi yatatu na babili (32) ukutila, “Imwe mwilwisha umuntu umbi, abe umunono nangu umucindami, kanofye imfumu ya bena Israeli.”

english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.
translation: Ilyo abakalamba ba maceleta bamona Yehoshafati, batila, “Cacine uyu wine e mfumu ya bena Israeli.” Epakumwalukila ukuti bamusanse, lelo ilyo Yehoshafati apunda,

english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
translation: abakalamba ba bashilika ba maceleta bamona ukuti te mfumu ya bena Israeli, elyo baleka ukumukunkunika.

english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”
translation: Mako 6:34

english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.
translation: Akasuba konse inkondo yakoselakofye ninshi imfumu ikelefye mwiceleta, naishintilila kwiceleta mukati yalosha amenso ukwali abena Aramu. Umulopa walefuma pa cilonda cakwe walasumina panshi ya mwiceleta, mpaka mu nshita ya cungulo yafwa no kufwa.

english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”
translation: Mateo 9:36

english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
translation: Kanshi imfumu ilyo yafwile, baletele icitumbi ku Samaria, eko baisa shiika.

english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.
translation: Baya samfya iceleta pa cishiba mu Samaria (apalesamba bacilende) elyo imbwa shaisa mukumyanga umulopa wakwe ukulingana nefyo ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyasosele.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya bufumu bwakwa Ahabu, na fyonse ifyo acitile, isano akuulile, ne misumba acingileko amalinga, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya mfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
translation: Elyo aipusha Yehoshafati ati, “Bushe teti ungafweko ukuya lwisha Ramoti Gileadi?”

english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ahabu aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Na Ahasia umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
translation: Yehoshafati umwana mwaume wakwa Asa aishile ba imfumu ya bena Yuda mu mwaka walenga ine ilyo Ahabu ali imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
translation: Yehoshafati ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu na isano (35) ilyo apyene pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu musumba wa Yerusalemu pa myaka amakumi yabili na isano (25). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Asuba umwana umwanakashi wakwa Shili

english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
translation: Muli fyonse alaendafye mu nshila shakwa wishi Asa, kabili tatalile afumamo. Acitile ifintu ifyalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Nomba incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika taonawile, na mulya mwine emo na bantu bakonkenyepo ukulatuula amalambo no kocelamo ububani.

english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
translation: Kabili Yehoshafati aikele umutende ne mfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehoshafati, ifintu fyonse ifyo abombele ne nkondo alwile, bushe tafyalembwa mwibuku lya milandu ya mfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.
translation: Alifumishe mu calo bacilende ba ku mfuba abaume bonse, nabashele panuma yakuteeka kwakwa wishi Asa.

english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
translation: Mu Edomu tamwali imfumu, inkonkani eyateekele.

english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
translation: Nomba Yehoshafati alipangile amato ya makwebo ayengi nganshi ayakuya ku Ofiri mukusenda golide. Nomba yafilwa ukwenda pa menshi, yaonaikila pa Esioni Geberi.

english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
translation: Pali ilya ine nshita Ahasia umwana mwaume wakwa Ahabu aeba Yehoshafati ati, “Leka abantu bandi baye pamo na bantu bobe mu mato,” nomba Yehoshafati akaana.

english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”
translation: lelo Yehoshafati kabili alanda ku mfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “Utale wipushe kuli Yawe.”

english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
translation: Elyo Yehoshafati afwa ayalala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, baya mushiika mu musumba wakwa Davidi wishi elyo Yehoramu umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana.

english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
translation: Ahasia umwana umwaume wakwa Ahabu aishile ba imfumu ya bena Israeli mu Samaria mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) ilyo Yehoshafati ali imfumu ya bena Yuda. Kabili ateekele icalo ca Israeli pa myaka ibili.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pantu akonkele mu nshila shakwa wishi na nyina, elyo na mu nshila shakwa Yeroboamu umwana umwaume wakwa Nebati, uwaposele na Israeli mukucita ububifi.

english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
translation: Aletumika no kupepa Baali kabili asonsomba Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ukukalipa ngefyo wishi acitile.

english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
translation: Elyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yalonganika bakasesema bonse abaume abali imyanda amakumi yane (400) no kubepusha ati, “Bushe kuti naya lwisha Ramoti Gileadi nangu ndeke?”

english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?”
translation: Lelo Yehoshafati epakwipusha ati, “Bushe pano tapali kasesema wakwa Yawe uwakuti twipusheko?”

english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli yayasuka Yehoshafati aiti, “Kwena kuciliko umuntu na umbi uwakuti atwipushisheko kuli Yawe, nomba nalimupata pantu tatala asesema icisuma nangu cimo palwa ine, kanofye ifibi. Uyu muntu ni Mikaiya mwana Imula.”

english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”
translation: Elyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yaita umo pali bacilolo baiko no kumweba ati, “Kalete Mikaiya mwana Imula nombaline.”

english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,
translation: Ilyo Davidi apalamine ku nshita yakufwa aitile umwana wakwe Solomoni no kumweba amashiwi aya ati,

english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
translation: Ateekele icalo ca Israeli pa myaka amakumi yane (40). Imyaka cine lubali yali mu Hebuloni elyo imyaka amakumi yatatu na itatu (33) ateekele mu Yerusalemu.

english: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.
translation: Efyo Solomoni abuulile amalo yakwa wishi Davidi no buteeko bwakwe bwakwata amaka nganshi.

english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.
translation: Nomba Adoniya, umwana wakwa Hagiti, alimine aya kuli Batisheba, nyina wakwa Solomoni. Elyo Batisheba amwipusha ati, “Bushe waisa mu mutende?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ee ni mu mutende.”

english: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”
translation: Elyo amweba ati, “Ninkwatako utumashiwi utwakulanda na iwe.” Batisheba ayasuka ati, “Landa.”

english: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the LORD.
translation: Asosa ati, “Ukulingana ngefyo waishiba, nine nali nokuba imfumu ya bena Israeli, na bonse balesubilafye ukuti nine ndi nokuba imfumu yabo. Nomba ifintu fyapilibuka, no bufumu nomba bwile kuli munyinane pantu Yawe eumusalile.

english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”
He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
translation: Nao akonkanyapo ati, “Napapata kanombeleko ku mfumu Solomoni, pantu iwe takukaanine, ukuti ampeele Abishagi umwina Shunemu ukuba umukashi wandi.”

english: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”
translation: Batisheba nao ayasuka ati, “Cisuma, nalaya nkulandileko ku mfumu.”

english: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
translation: Batisheba nao aya na ku mfumu Solomoni mukuya landilako Adoniya. Ilyo afika, imfumu yaima pa cipuna yaisa mukumanya, yakontamiko mutwe elyo yaya ikala pa cipuna. Elyo yaeba na bakuleta icipuna apakwisa ikala nyina, baciteka na ku kuboko kwa kulyo kwa cipuna ca mfumu.

english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;
translation: “Ine nomba napalamina ukuya ku nshila iyilolako ifikolwe fyonse. Eico ndefwaya ube umuntu uwakosa kabili umwaume uwashipa.

english: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”
translation: Batisheba nyina alanda ati, “Kuli icintu cimo ico ndefwaya ukulomba kuli iwe, wintana iyoo.” Imfumu yayasuka aiti, “Lombeni mayo ine nshakaane.”

english: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”
translation: Elyo Batisheba nyina ati, “Suminisha ukuti Abishagi umwina Shunemu opwe kuli munonko Adoniya.”

english: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
translation: Imfumu Solomoni yayasuka nyina aiti, “Nga cinshi waipushisha Abishagi umwina Shunemu ukuti opwe kuli Adoniya? Ici cena calangafye ukuti no bufumu bwine kuti wamulombela apofye mukalamba wandi elyo kabili na Abiyata shimapepo, na Yoabu mwana Seruiya bawila kuli ena.”

english: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.
translation: Imila 29:23

english: Now therefore as the LORD lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”
translation: Eico mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe umumi uwambika bwino pa cipuna cakwa tata Davidi kabili ampeela ne ŋanda ngefyo alaile, lelo line Adoniya alafwa.”

english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.
translation: Apopene imfumu Solomoni yapeela ne cipope kuli Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ukuya ipaya Adoniya, nao aya mwipaya.

english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord GOD’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yaebele Abiyata shimapepo ukuti, “Bwelelamo kumwenu ku Anatoti. Iwe ulingile ukufwa, lelo nshakwipaye pali ino nshita pantu walibombele umulimo wakusenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iya Mfumu Yawe pa cinso cakwa tata Davidi no kupita nankwe pamo mu macushi.”

english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD, that he might fulfill the LORD’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
translation: Sam 3:27

english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to the LORD’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.
translation: Ilyo amashiwi ya fyacitike yafika kuli Yaobu, pakuba uwasuminishe Adoniya nangu tasuminisheko ifyakwa Abusalomu, ena epakubutukila mwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe no kuya konena ku nsengo sha bulambo.

english: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to the LORD’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”
translation: Baisa eba imfumu Solomoni ukuti Yoabu nabutukila mwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe emo ekele kumbali ya bulambo. Elyo imfumu Solomoni yapeela icipope kuli Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ukuti, “Kabiye uye umwipaye.”

english: and keep the instruction of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.
translation: Ufwile ukuba umuntu uwakucita ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe Lesa obe afwaya. Uleenda mu nshila shakwe no kubaka amafunde yakwe ne fyebo fyakwe ne fipope fyakwe, na fyonse ifyo amafunde yafwaya ngefyo calembwa mu mafunde yakwa Mose. Ici cikalenga ukuti ukalepaalwa muli fyonse ifyo ulecita na konse uko uleya.

english: Benaiah came to the LORD’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”
translation: Benaya epakuya, aya ingila mwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe no kweba Yoabu ati, “Imfumu itile, ‘Fumina panse.’” Yoabu nao ayasuka ati, “Awe ine nshafume, ndefwilafye muno mwine.” Benaya epakuya eba imfumu Solomoni amashiwi yasosele Yoabu.

english: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.
translation: Elyo imfumu yapeela Benaya icipope cakuti, “Iwe kacite ifyo asosele. Kamukome, umwipaye no kumushiika, pakuti ufumye pali ine na pa ŋanda yakwa tata umulandu wa mulopa wakaele ulya Yoabu asumishe apabula umulandu.

english: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.
translation: Yawe euli nokumukanda pa mulopa asumishe pantu, ukwabula ukuti tata Davidi eshibe, aimine no kusansa abantu babili no kubepaya ku lupanga. Aba babili, ni Abune mwana Neri uwali umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo fya bena Israeli, na Amasa mwana Yete umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo fya bena Yuda. Aba bali abantu abacishinka ukucila pali ena.

english: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from the LORD.”
translation: No mulandu wa mulopa wa pali aba bantu uli nokutulumana pa mutwe wakwa Yoabu na ba mu lupwa lwakwe pe na pe. Lelo pali Davidi na ba mu lupwa lwakwe, pa ba ŋanda yakwe na pa cipuna cakwe, pena palebafye umutende wakwa Yawe pe na pe.”

english: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
translation: Elyo Benaya mwana Yehoiyada aile no kuya koma Yoabu no kumwipaya, no kuya mushiika mu mpanga iyakwe iyali mu matololo.

english: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
translation: Imfumu yabika Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ukuba umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo pa malo yakwa Yoabu elyo yabika na Abiyata ukuba shimapepo pa cifulo cakwa Sadoki.

english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaita Shimei no kumweba ukuti, “Kuule iŋanda mu Yerusalemu nokuti uleikala mu musumba mwine wikatala aufumamo no kuya ku ncende kumbi.

english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”
translation: Pantu ilyo lyonse ukafuma mu musumba no kwabuka umukonko wa Kidironi, wishibefye ukuti ukafwa no mulandu wa mulopa ukaba pa mutwe obe.”

english: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.
translation: Shimei ayasuke imfumu ati, “Kanabesa, cabafye bwino. Umusha wenu ali nokucita ifyo imfumu kanabesa yalanda.” Na Shimei aikele mu Yerusalemu pa nshita iyitali.

english: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”
translation: Cilya papitafye imyaka itatu, abasha babili abakwa Shimei babutuka no kuya kuli Akishi mwana Maaka, imfumu ya ku Gati. Awe bashimikila Shimei ukuti, “Abasha bobe nababutuka, bele ku Gati.”

english: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’
translation: Kabili ni pakuti Yawe akabe uwakufikilisha ubulayo bwakwe kuli ine, ukulingana nefyo alandile ukuti, ‘Abana bobe nga batekanya mu bwikashi bwabo, na pa cinso candi bakaleenda abapetama ne mitima yabo elyo na mano yabo yonse, ninshi tawakatale aubulisha umwana mwaume uwakwikala pa bufumu mu Israeli.’

english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
translation: Pakumfwa ifi apekanya kabalwe wakwe anina aya na kuli Akishi ku Gati mukufwaya abasha bakwe. Shimei aimine aya, mpaka aya senda abasha bakwe ukufuma ku Gati.

english: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.
translation: Ilyo Solomoni bamweba ukuti Shimei nafuma mu Yerusalemu no kuya ku Gati elyo no kubwela,

english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by the LORD and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’
translation: imfumu epakutuma abakuya ita Shimei no kumweba ati, “Bushe iwe nshakulengele ukulapa kuli Yawe elyo no kusosa ukuti, ‘Pa bushiku ubuli bonse ukafuma muno no kuya kumbi ukeshibefye ati uli nokufwa?’ Napali ilya nshita iwe wayaswike ukuti ifyo nalanda fyabafye bwino, ‘Ndi no kubeela.’

english: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi wafililwa ukusunga umulapo obe kuli Yawe elyo no kukanabeela icipope nakupeele?”

english: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore the LORD will return your wickedness on your own head.
translation: Imfumu yakonkanyapo ukweba Shimei aiti, “Iwe nawishiba na mu mutima obe ifilubo fyonse ifyo wacitile kuli tata Davidi. Eico nomba Yawe alakukanda pa bubi bobe.

english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before the LORD forever.”
translation: Imfumu Solomoni ili no kwikala iyapaalwa, ne cipuna cakwa Davidi icabufumu cili no kwikalilila pa cinso cakwa Yawe umuyayaya.”

english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
translation: Imfumu epakupeela icipope kuli Benaya umwana umwaume wakwa Yehoiyada nao afuma aya koma Shimei no kumwipaya. No bufumu bwaikala na maka mu minwe yakwa Solomoni.

english: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.
translation: “Nomba iwe walishiba bwino ifintu ifyo Yoabu mwana Seruiya acitile kuli ine ilyo aipeye abakalamba ba fita fya nkondo ifya bena Israeli babili, Abune mwana Neri na Amasa mwana Yete. Alibepeye no kusumya umulopa wabo pa nshita ya mutende kwati ni nshita ya nkondo. Abuulile no mulopa wabo ashinga ku mushipi uo afwele mu musana elyo na ku ndyato shali ku makasa yakwe.

english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
translation: Eico ukamucitile umwabela amano yobe, icikulufye wikaleka akaifwile imfwa yamutende.

english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
translation: “Lelo ukalange uluse kuli bamwana Basilai uwa ku Gileadi, no kubalenga ukuti bakalelyafye nobe petebulo lyobe. Bena balingafwile pali ilya nshita nafulumwike kuli munonko Abusalomu.

english: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
translation: “Eico ibukisha Shimei mwana Gera umwina Benjamini uwa ku Baharumi ulya uwantukile insele ishingi nganshi bulya bushiku naile ku Manaimu ukuti epo acili. Ilyo aishile mukunkumanya pa mumana wa Yordani, ine nalilapile kuli ena peshina lyakwa Yawe ukuti tali nakufwa ku lupanga.

english: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”
translation: Lelo nomba wimulinga ukuba uwakaele. Iwe uli muntu uwamano nganshi eico uli nokwishiba ifya kumucitila. Ukamonefye ukuti akengile mu calo ca bafwa ku mfwa yakusuuma umulopa.”

english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, the LORD’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.
translation: Solomoni ayambile ukumfwana na Farao imfumu ya mu calo ca Egupto icakuti aupa no mwana wakwe. Amuleta ukulaikala mu musumba wakwa Davidi mpaka ilyo apwile ukukuula isano lyakwe, iŋanda yakwa Yawe, elyo ne linga lyacingilila umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
translation: Ici casekeshe Yawe icakuti Solomoni alomba amano.

english: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,
translation: Na Lesa atile kuli ena, “Apo walomba amano, taulombele icuma nangu umweo wa pe nangu ukulomba ukuti wipaye abalwani bobe, lelo umutima uwamano yakupingula pa butungulushi,

english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.
translation: na ine nalakucitila ukulingana nefyo ulombele. Nalakupeela umutima uwamano no kwiluka ifyo umuntu nelyo umo tatala akwatako elyo kabili takwakabe uukakwatako.

english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.
translation: Na ine nomba nalakulundilapo nefyo ushacilomba. Nalakupeela icuma no kucindama icakuti mu nshiku sha bumi bobe takwakabe imfumu iyikalingana nobe.

english: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”
translation: Kabili nga cakuti walaenda mu nshila shandi no kubaka ifipope fyandi na mafunde yandi ngefyo Davidi wiso acitile, nkalenga ukekale inshiku ishingi pano isonde.”

english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
