translation: Elyo Solomoni abuuka, aishiba nokuti aciba alelota.

english: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.
translation: Elyo kwaishile bacilende babili baisa iminina ku cinso ca mfumu.

english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.
translation: Umo asosa ati, “Kanabesa, uyu umwanakashi pamo na ine wine twikala mu ŋanda imo. Nalifyele umwana ninshi acili aleikala na ine.

english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.
translation: Panumafye ya nshiku shitatu ukutula apo umwana wandi afyalilwe, uyu mwanakashi nao akwata umwana. Twalifye fweka babili, tamwali umuntu umbi mu ŋanda.

english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.
translation: Pa nshita ya bushiku umwana wa uyu mwanakashi acifwa pantu acimwilikisha.

english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for the LORD’s name.
translation: Lelo abantu bena pali ilya nshita balepeelela amalambo mu ncende shakupepelapo isho balecindika, pantu iŋanda yali tailakuulwa iya peshina lyakwa Yawe.

english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
translation: Elyo aisa ima pakati ka bushiku no kwisa senda umwana wandi apo ine nacilala ne musha wenu. Acibuula umwana wandi amulalika pa cifuba cakwe no kubuula umwana wakwe uwafwa amulalika pa cifuba candi.

english: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”
translation: Ilyo nacibuka ulucelo ukuti ŋonshe umwana, nacisanga ukuti nafwa. Nomba ilyo nacimulolekesha bwino ku lubuuto lwa kacelo, nacisanga ukuti te mwana wandi ulya nafyele.”

english: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.
translation: Umwanakashi umbi nao ayasuka ati, “Awe, umwana wandi ine ni uyu umutuntulu, teuyu uwafwa.”

english: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”
translation: Imfumu yasosa aiti, “Cila umo alelanda ukuti, ‘Uyu ufwile te mwana wandi, ine umwana wandi mutuntulu.’”

english: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu yalanda aiti, “Ndeteleni ulupanga.” Awe baleta ulupanga ku mfumu.

english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”
translation: Nayo imfumu epakupeela icipope aiti, “Buuleni umwana umutuntulu mu muputule pakati, mubuule ciputulwa cimo mupeele umo elyo ne ciputulwa cimbi mupeele ku munankwe.”

english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”
translation: Nyina afyele umwana uyo uwali umutuntulu aumfwila umwana wakwe uluse epakulanda ku mfumu ati, “Napapata kanabesa mwiipaya umwana, mubuulenifye mumupeele kuli uyu.”

english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yapingula ukuti, “Peeleni umwana uyo umutuntulu kuli uyo mwanakashi wantanshi pantu e nyina, mwimwipaya iyoo.”

english: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.
translation: Ilyo Israeli yonse yaumfwile ubupingushi bwa mfumu, bapeela imfumu umucinshi pantu bamwene bonse ukuti ilebomfya amano ukufuma kuli Lesa mukupingula imilandu.

english: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
translation: Solomoni alangile ukutemwa Yawe ukupitila mukwendela mu fipope fyakwa wishi Davidi, nomba nao wine aletuulila amalambo no koca ububani mu ncende shakupepelapo.

english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
translation: Imfumu elyo yaima no kuya ku Gibeoni mukutuula amalambo, pantu eyali incende yakupepelapo iyikalamba nganshi iyakutuulilako amalambo, kanshi eko Solomoni aile tuula amalambo ya cakoca ikana limo (1,000) pa bulambo.

english: In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
translation: Ni ku Gibeoni eko Yawe amonekele kuli Solomoni mu ciloto pa nshita ya bushiku no kumweba ati, “Lomba icintu conse ico ulefwaya ukuti nkupeele.”

english: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.
translation: Solomoni ayasuka ati, “Walilanga uluse ulukalamba nganshi ku mubomfi obe Davidi, tata wandi, ukulingana nefyo aendele pa cinso cobe mu cishinka, mu bulungami elyo na mu bololoke bwa mutima. Nakabili ucili uletwalilila ukulanga ulu luse ulukalamba kuli ena pantu naumupeela umwana uwakupyana pa cipuna cakwe ukufika na pali lelo.

english: Now, LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.
translation: Apo iwe we Yawe Lesa wandi, naulenga ine ne mubomfi obe ukuba imfumu mu cifulo cakwa tata Davidi, nomba ine ncilifye umwana umunono elyo nshishibe ne fyakufikilishapo ukubomba bwino imilimo.

english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.
translation: Ine ne mubomfi obe ndi pano pakati ka bantu abo waisalila, abantu abengi abakufilwa no kupenda.

english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
translation: Eico ine nalomba ukuti umpeeleko ne mubomfi obe umutima uwamano pakuti ndeteeka bwino kabili ndeiluka ukulekanya ububi no busuma. Pantu nani uwingabomba umulimo wakutungulula aba bantu bobe abashaicindamina?”

english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Solomoni yateekele icalo conse ica Israeli.

english: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);
translation: Beni Hesedi ewali umulashi wa misumba ya Aruboti, Sokoyo elyo ne citungu conse ica ku Heferi cali cakwe.

english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);
translation: Beni Abinadabu ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Nafoti Dori. Uyu wine ewaupile Tafati mwana Solomoni.

english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
translation: Baana mwana Ailudi, ewali umulashi wa misumba ya Tanaki, ku Megido na ku ncende yonse iya ku Beti Shani mupepi na ku Saretani pesamba lya Yesireli, ukufumafye ku Beti Shani ukushinta ku Abeli Mehola no kucilinganya mpaka ku Yokimeamu.

english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);
translation: Beni Geberi ewali umulashi wa musumba wa Ramoti Gileadi, e ncende shonse ishaleikalamo Yairi mwana Manase mu Gileadi yali yakwe, no musumba wa Agobu uwaba mu Bashani pamo pene ne misumba imbi amakumi mutanda (60) iyashingulwikeko amalinga ne fisalilo fya pa mpongolo ifya mukuba.

english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
translation: Ainadabu mwana Ido ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Manaimu.

english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
translation: Aimasi ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Naftali, kabili ewaupile Basemati mwana Solomoni.

english: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
translation: Baana mwana Hushai ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Asheri elyo na ku Aloti.

english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
translation: Yehoshafati mwana Palua ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Isaka.

english: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
translation: Shimei mwana Ela ewali umulashi wa ku calo ca Benjamini.

english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
translation: Geberi mwana Uri ewali umulashi wa calo ca ku Gileadi icaleteeka Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli elyo ne calo cakwa Ogi imfumu ya ku Bashani. Geberi ewalifye umulashi eka muli uyu musumba.

english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
translation: Na aba ebali bacilolo bakalamba:

english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
translation: Abena Yuda na bena Israeli basandana bafula baba kwati musensenga wa pali bemba. Balalya no kunwa elyo no kusansamuka nganshi.

english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
translation: Eliolefu na Ahiya bamwana Shisha ebali bakalemba ba milandu.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
translation: Benaya mwana Yehoiyada ewali umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo.

english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
translation: Asariya mwana Natani ewali umukalamba wa bacilolo balesunga imisumba.

english: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
translation: Aisha nga kangalila mukalamba uwa kwisano.

english: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
translation: Solomoni alikwete na bantu ikumi limo na babili (12) abo asontele ukuba abalashi bafitungu mu calo conse ica Israeli kukubomba umulimo wakuleta ifyakulya fya mfumu ne fya kwisano. Cila umo ali nokuleta ukufuma ku citungu cakwe ifyakulya ifya mweshi umo cila mwaka.

english: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
translation: Na aya e mashina yabo:

english: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
translation: Beni Dekeli ewali umulashi wa misumba ya Makasi, Shalibimu, Beti Shemeshi na ku Eloni Beti Hanani.

english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.
translation: Ilyo Hiramu imfumu ya ku Turi yaumfwa ukuti Solomoni nasubwa ukuti eo apyane pa bufumu bwakwa wishi Davidi, atumako bacilolo bakwe kuli Solomoni pa mulandu wakuti Hiramu ali ni cibusa wakwa Davidi.

english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.
translation: Muli iyi nshila Hiramu akonkenyepo ukupeela Solomoni imilando yonse iyalefwaikwa iya fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda ne fimuti fya paini.

english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.
The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni yalemba na bantu abakubomba umulaasa amakana amakumi yatatu (30,000) ukufuma mu calo conse ica Israeli.

english: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
translation: Imfumu yalabatuma ku Lebanoni mu mabumba ya bantu amakana ikumi limo (10,000) cila mweshi pakuti umweshi utuntulu umo baikala ku Lebanoni elyo imyeshi ibili baikala pa mushi. Adoniramu bamupeela ukuba mushika wa bamulaasa.

english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,
translation: Imfumu Solomoni yali na bakasenda wa fipe amakana amakumi cine lubali (70,000) elyo na bantu amakana amakumi cine konse konse (80,000) abakusona amabwe mu mpili.

english: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
translation: Elyo akwata na bantu bambi amakana yatatu ne myanda itatu (3,300) abali bakangalila abakutungulula imilimo ya bantu.

english: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.
translation: Imfumu yapeela icipope icakushula amabwe ayakulu ukufuma ku mpili elyo ayabaswa ubusaka ayakukuulila mu mufula wa ŋanda.

english: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
translation: Ababomfi bakwa Solomoni na bakwa Hiramu elyo na baume ba ku Gebali ebaleputaula imbao no kupekanya amabwe yakukuulile iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
translation: Solomoni nao abweseshamo amashiwi aya kuli Hiramu ati,

english: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet.
translation: “Iwe nawishiba ukuti pa mulandu wa nkondo shalwile tata Davidi ukufuma ku mbali shonse, tata asuka afilwa ukuti akuulile Yawe Lesa wakwe iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyakwe, mpakafye Yawe amulenga ukucimfya abalwani bakwe.

english: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.
translation: Lelo Yawe Lesa wandi nampeela umutende ukufuma ku mbali shonse, takuli na balwani nangu ifinkunka.

english: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’
translation: Eico nomba ndefwaya ukuti nkuulile Yawe Lesa wandi iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyakwe ukulinganafye ngefyo umwine Yawe aebele tata Davidi ilyo atile, ‘Umwana obe uo ndi nokupyanika pa cipuna cobe euli nokukuula iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyandi.’

english: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”
translation: “Eico iwe konkomesha abantu ukuti baye ntemenako ifimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda wa ku Lebanoni. Ndi nokutuma abantu abakwisa bomba na bantu bobe elyo kabili ndi nokulipila abantu bobe amalipilo yonse ayo uli nokupingula. Nawishiba ukuti ifwe tatwakwata abantu abacenjela ukuputula ifimuti nga bena Sidoni.”

english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”
translation: Ilyo Hiramu aumfwa amashiwi yakwa Solomoni, yamusekesha nganshi alanda no kuti, “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe pa bushiku bwa lelo, pantu apeela Davidi umwana uwamano uwakuteeka pali ici calo icacindama.”

english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.
translation: Hiramu epakutuma amashiwi aya kuli Solomoni ukuti, “Nimpokelela amashiwi untumine na ine nalabomba ukulingana nefyo ulefwaya ukukuletela ifimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda elyo ne milando ya fimuti fya paini.

english: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”
translation: Abantu bandi ebakulakulula imilando ukufuma ku Lebanoni ukutwala kuli bemba, elyo no kulafiponesha pa menshi pakuti fileisa fileelela mpaka ukufika ku ncende ukasonta. Kuli iyo ncende eko nkalafipatulula pakuti ukalesenda. Kabili na iwe ukapeele iŋanda yandi ifyakulya ukulingana nefyo nkakweba.”

english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga imyanda ine na makumi cine konse konse (480) ukufuma apo abena Israeli bafumine mu Egupto, uyu wine e mwaka wakulenga bune ukutula apo Solomoni atendekele ukuteeka icalo ca Israeli, umweshi wabubili, emukutila umweshi washinde, Solomoni atendeka ukukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.
translation: Kabili akuula no tumiputule utunono ukushingulusha iŋanda. Ubutali bwacila kamo ukulola mumulu kali amakubiti yasano. Imilando ya fimuti fya keda eyaletusuntinkanya ku ŋanda.

english: The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli Solomoni aliti,

english: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
translation: “Pali iyi ŋanda ulekuula, nga cakuti uli nokukonka ifipope fyandi, no kucita amafunde yandi elyo no kusunga ifyebo fyandi no kufibaka, ndi nokufikilishapo ubulayo nalaile kuli wiso Davidi.

english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
translation: Kabili ndi nokwikala pakati ka bana bakwa Israeli elyo nshakabapose aba bantu bandi abena Israeli.”

english: So Solomon built the house and finished it.
translation: Efyo Solomoni akuulile iŋanda yakwa Yawe no kuipwisha.

english: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.
translation: Apopele mukati ka cibumba imbao sha cimuti icalepesha ica keda ukufuma panshi ya mu ŋanda no kufika mu mutenge, elyo akupa imbao shimbi isha paini panshi mukati ka ŋanda.

english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.
translation: Apaatulako umuputule umbi lwa mukati kunuma ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe uwalepele amakubiti amakumi yabili. Aimika imbao sha cimuti icalepesha ica keda mukati ka uyu umuputule ukufuma panshi mpaka mu mutenge. Uyu ewali Umuputule wamushilo icine cine.

english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.
translation: Incende ya kuntanshi ka uyu muputule yalepele amakubiti amakumi yane ubutali.

english: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
translation: Mukati ka ŋanda mwali imbao sha cimuti ca keda ishabaswapo inkombo na maluba ayabalula. Incende yonse yalifye imbao sha fimuti fya keda, tapali apalemoneka ilibwe.

english: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.
translation: Apekanya bwino Umuputule uwamushilo icine cine mukati ka ŋanda umwakubika Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe.

english: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
translation: Iŋanda iyo imfumu Solomoni yakuulile Yawe yalepele icipimo amakubiti amakumi mutanda (60) mubutali, mubwipi amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) elyo amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30) ukulola mumulu.

english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.
translation: Umuputule uwamushilo cine cine mukati wali amakubiti amakumi yabili mubutali, mukucilinganya amakubiti amakumi yabili no kulola mu mulu amakubiti amakumi yabili. Mukati monse ashingulamo golide wine wine kabili ashingula na ku bulambo bwa fimuti fya keda.

english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.
translation: Solomoni ashingula golide wine wine ku fibumba fyonse ifya mukati ka ŋanda, elyo atantika no tuminyololo twa golide kuntanshi yonse iya Muputule wamushilo uo ashingwilemo golide.

english: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.
translation: Elyo mukati monse ashingulamo golide, pakuti iŋanda yonse ibe iyawama. Ashingula golide na ku bulambo bonse ubwa mu Muputule wamushilo icine cine.

english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
translation: Mukati ka Muputule wamushilo icine cine apangilamo bakerubi babili ku cimuti ca miolifa abalepele amakubiti ikumi limo ukulola mumulu.

english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.
translation: Ipindo limo kuli Kerubi wantanshi lyalepele amakubiti yasano ne pindo libiye nalyo amakubiti yasano, emukutila amakubiti ikumi limo ukufuma pa mpela ye pindo limo ukufika kwipindo libiye.

english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
translation: Kerubi wacibili nao alepa amakubiti ikumi limo pantu bonse babili bakerubi bali abapalana mu cipimo na mu nshiki.

english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.
translation: Kerubi umo alepele amakubiti ikumi limo ukulola mu mulu, kabili ifi fine efyali na Kerubi mubiye.

english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.
translation: Ateka bakerubi bonse babili mukati ka Muputule wamukati ka ŋanda, elyo atambalika na mapindo yabo pakuti ipindo lya umo lileshimpa mu cibumba nelya mubiye ku cibumba cibiye. Elyo amapindo yambi yasuntikana pakati ka Muputule.

english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
translation: Kuli bakerubi ashingulako golide.

english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
translation: Ku fibumba fyonse ifya mukati na kunse abashilako ifilengwa fya bakerubi, utuncindu na maluba ayabalula.

english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.
translation: Umuputule wakwingililapo mu ŋanda walepele amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) mukucilinganya, elyo mubwipi amakubiti ikumi limo ukufuma pa mwinshi we Tempele.

english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.
translation: Elyo panshi ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe na panshi lwa kunse ya ŋanda napo ashingulapo golide.

english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.
translation: Pa mwinshi wakwingilila mu Muputule wamushilo icine cine apangilapo ifiibi ifya mbao sha cimuti ca miolifa ne fimuti fya maingwe fisano.

english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
translation: Kabili pa fiibi fibili ifya mbao sha miolifa akambatikapo bakerubi ababaswa, utuncindu elyo na maluba ayabalula, kabili ashinga golide kuli bakerubi na ku tuncindu.

english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,
translation: Mu nshila imo ine apanga amaingwe aya mbali shine aya ku fimuti fya miolifa pa mwinshi wa mu muputule ukalamba.

english: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
translation: Apanga ifiibi fibili ifya mbao sha ku fimuti fya paini cila cimo cali mu fipande fibili ifyapapikana nga baisula.

english: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
translation: Abashilapo bakerubi, utuncindu elyo na maluba ayabalula elyo ashingulako golide iyaengululwa bwino.

english: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
translation: Kabili akuula ulubansa lwa mukati mu mitande itatu ku mabwe ayabaswa bwino no mutande umo ku milando iyasukulwa iya cimuti icalepesha ica keda.

english: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.
translation: Umufula wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe wapangilwe mu mwaka walenga bune mu mweshi wabubili ekutila umweshi washinde.

english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na umo (11) mu mweshi wa lusuba lunono emukutila umweshi walenga cine konse konse, emo bapwishishe ukukuula iŋanda muli fyonse ukulingana nefyo yapekanishiwe. Apwilepo imyaka cine lubali pakuti apwishe ukukuula.

english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.
translation: Pa mawindo ya mu ŋanda apangilapo ifyakwikashapo ifyapikulwa.

english: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.
translation: Ashintilishe ku cibumba ce Tempele icikuulwa cimbi icakwete utumiputule utunono utwa mumbali.

english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.
translation: Umuputule wa panshi mukucilinganya walepele icipimo amakubiti yasano, uwapakati wali amakubiti mutanda elyo uwa pa mulu wali amakubiti cine lubali. Ukushinguluka kunse ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe alicefeshe icibumba pakuti takuli icintu icingashimpwa mu cibumba ca ŋanda.

english: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.
translation: Pakukuula ŋanda yakwa Yawe balebomfya amabwe ayabashilwa libela kuntu yalefuma, kabili takwali nangu ni nondo, nangu lisembe nangu conse icibombelo ca cela icakumfwika pa ŋanda pa nshita yakukuula.

english: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.
translation: Umwinshi wakwingilila mu muputule wa panshi uwabelele ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, pali amatabo yakunininapo ukuya pa muputule wapakati, na yambi ukufuma pali uyu muputule ukuya fika pa walenga butatu.

english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
translation: Efyo akuulile iŋanda yakwa Yawe no kulipwishishisha. Abomfya imilando ne mbao sha cimuti icalepesha ica keda pakupalika umutenge.

english: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
translation: Solomoni aposelepo imyaka ikumi limo na itatu (13) pakuti apwishe ukukuula isano lyakwe.

english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.
translation: Mu mufula wayako mwapangilwe na mabwe ayakulu kabili ayasuma ayalepele amakubiti ikumi limo, yambi amakubiti cine konse konse.

english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
translation: Pamulu napo pali amabwe ayapekanishiwa bwino, ayalingana mukuputaula elyo ne milando ya fimuti fya keda.

english: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.
translation: Ku lubansa lukalamba bashingulwisheko icibumba ica mitande itatu iya mabwe ayabaswa bwino elyo no mutande umo uwa milando iyasukulwa iya fimuti fya keda, filya fine bapangile umuputule wa mukati uwa ŋanda yakwa Yawe pamo pene no lubansa.

english: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.
translation: Elyo imfumu Solomoni yatumine abakuya ita Hiramu umwina Turi elyo yaisa mupokelela.

english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.
translation: Uyo nyina ali ni namfwilwa uwa mu luko lwakwa Naftali elyo wishi ali mwina Turi kafula wa mukuba. Hiramu ali umuntu uwaishibishe imilimo kabili uwacenjela nganshi mu milimo yonse iya pa mukuba. Aishile ku mfumu Solomoni no kwisa bomba bwino imilimo yonse iyo apeelwe.

english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
translation: Aengele inceshi shibili isha mukuba, cila luceshi lwalepele amakubiti ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) ukulola mu mulu elyo amakubiti ikumi limo na yabili ukushinguluka.

english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
translation: Kabili apanga ne mitwe ibili ku mukuba uwayengululwa iyakubika pa mulu wa nceshi. Cila mutwe wali amakubiti yasano ukulola mumulu.

english: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
translation: Apanga ne minyololo iyapikulwa nge citabataba aipomba ku mitwe iyali pa mulu wa nceshi. Cila mutwe wakwete iminyololo cine lubali.

english: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.
translation: Apanga amateke mu mitande ibili ukushinguluka icapikulwa cimo cimo ifyakuwaminisha imitwe iyali pa mulu wa nceshi. Acita cimo cine kuli cila mutwe.

english: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.
translation: Imitwe iyali pa mulu wa nceshi sha mu lukungu yali kwati maluba ayalepa amakubiti yane.

english: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
translation: Elyo akuulile isano ilyaitilwe “Umutengo wa ku Lebanoni,” mubutali yalepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100), mubwipi amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) elyo ukulola mumulu amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30). Elyo imitande ine iya nceshi sha fimuti fya keda eyatungilile imyalo ya mutenge.

english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.
translation: Pa mitwe yonse iyali pa nceshi pa ncende yapangilwe kwati ni nongo mupepi ne fyapikulwa epali amateke mu mitande ukushinguluka.

english: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.
translation: Ashimpile inceshi pa lukungu lwe Tempele. Uluceshi lwali ku kapinda ka ku kulyo alwinike ishina lya Yakini elyo lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso alwinike ishina lya Boasi.

english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.
translation: Imitwe pamulu yali mu musango wa maluba. Efyo imilimo ya pa nceshi yapwile.

english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
translation: Apangile icishiba icaengululwa ku fyela, icashinguluka, icalepele amakubiti ikumi limo ukufuma mu mushingo umo ukufika ku unankwe elyo calepele ukucilako amakubiti yasano ukulola mu mulu. Pakucipima mukushinguluka pamulu kano babomfya umwando uulepele amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30).

english: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
translation: Pesamba lyaciko ashingulushapo inkombo ikumi limo kuli cila cipimo kubiti. Inkombo shatantikwa mu mitande ibili iyo bengelela lintu balepanga icishiba.

english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
translation: Icishiba caikele pali bacilume ba ŋombe ikumi limo na babili (12). Batatu baloleshe ku kapinda ka ku kuso, bambi batatu ku masamba, bambi batatu ku kapinda ka ku kulyo elyo na bambi batatu ku kabanga. Pa mulu wa ŋombe epaikala icishiba ne numa shashiko shakumanina pakati.

english: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.
translation: Ukutikama kwaciko kwali ngo lupi lumo, no mulomo waciko wapala umulomo wa lukombo, uwapala iluba ilyabalula. Mu cishiba mwalaba amenshi ayakumana balita amakana amakumi yane na yane (44,000).

english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.
translation: Apangile impanda isha mukuba ikumi limo ishakusesha. Cila lupanda lwalepele amakubiti yane, yane mubwipi, elyo kubiti umo na citika ukulola mumulu.

english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;
translation: Ifi efyo impanda shapangilwe, shakwete imbao sha mumbali apakwikala ishalola mumulu.

english: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
translation: Pali ishi mbao, pakati ka shalolele mumulu, pali inkalamo, iŋombe ishilume elyo na bakerubi. Elyo pa nceshi shonse ishalolele mumulu na pesamba lya nkalamo ne ŋombe apangilapo ifyanyongana.

english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.
translation: Umutenge wapangilwe ne mbao sha fimuti fya keda ishaikele pa mulu wa milando iyashintilile pa cibumba iyali amakumi yane na isano (45), iyaleikala ikumi limo na isano (15) mu mutande.

english: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.
translation: Cila lupanda lwakwata imipeto ya mukuba ine ne misomali ya mukuba elyo cila lupanda lwakwata ne cakusambilamo icaikele pa fyakucifikilila fine ifyaengwa.

english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.
translation: Ku lubali lwa mukati lwa cakutekapo paba icipunda icashinguluka ukufika apalepele kubiti umo mukushika. Ici icipunda cali icashinguluka elyo ne cakutekapo calepele mupepi na kubiti umo na citika. Ukushinguluka mu mbali ya cipunda mwali ifyabaswa. Amolu ya cakutekapo yali ayapapatala monse monse, tayali ayashinguluka.

english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
translation: Imipeto yonse ine yali mwisamba lya molu, ne misomali ya ku mipeto yakakilwa ku molu. Ubutali bwakufuma ku mupeto umo ukufika ku unankwe paba kubiti umo na citika.

english: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.
translation: Imipeto yapangwa kwati mipeto ye celeta. Imisomali, ifingolongolo, amashipoko elyo na maabu fyonse fyali fya mukuba uwalopolwa.

english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.
translation: Icakutekapo conse cakwete ifyakwikatilako fine, cila cimo caikalila lubali nacikambatila ku cakutekapo.

english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.
translation: Pa mulu wa cakutekapo pali umushingo uwashinguluka uwali citika wa kubiti ukulola mumulu. Ifyakutungilila elyo ne mikonso fyakakilwa pa mulu pa cakutekapo.

english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.
translation: Abasa bakerubi, inkalamo elyo no tuncindu pa mulu wa cakwikatilako elyo na pa mulu wa mikonso ponse apaba incende apangilapo ifyanyongana.

english: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.
translation: Ifi efyo apanga ifyakutekapo ikumi limo. Fyonse fyataminwe mu fikombola fimo fine elyo fyaba ifyapalana mu bukulu na mu musango.

english: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.
translation: Apangile ifyakusambilamo ikumi limo ifya mukuba. Cila musambilo walesunga amenshi ayali balita imyanda cine konse konse na makumi cine konse konse (880). Cila musambilo walepele amakubiti yane, na cila musambilo walikwete icakutekapo

english: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.
translation: Abika ifyakutekapo fisano ku kapinda ka ku kulyo aka ŋanda yakwa Yawe kabili fisano ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Abika icishiba ku lubali lwa ku kulyo lwa ku kabanga ka ŋanda.

english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.
translation: Amawindo yaiko yabikilwe mumulu mu mitande itatu, kuli cila cibumba ayaloshanya.

english: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD’s house:
translation: Kabili apanga ne misambilo, bafosholo ne fyakusanshilako amenshi. Hiramu nao abomba no kupwisha imilimo yonse yamupeele imfumu Solomoni iya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe:

english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;
translation: Inceshi shibili,

english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;
translation: Amateke imyanda ine (400) aya ku minyololo ibili iyapikulwa, cila capikulwa imilongo ibili iya mateke iyakuwaminisha imitwe iyapala inweno pa mulu wa nceshi,

english: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;
translation: Ifyakutekapo ikumi ne misambilo nayo ikumi,

english: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;
translation: Icishiba na bacilume ba ŋombe ikumi limo na babili (12) pesamba lyaciko.

english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon in the LORD’s house, were of burnished bronze.
translation: Inongo, bafosholo elyo ne fya kwitililako amenshi.

english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
translation: Ifi fyonse imfumu yafyengulwile kwibumba lya mwiwanga lya Yordani pakati ka Sukoti na Saretani.

english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
translation: Solomoni ashile ifi fipe ukwabula ukuti afipime pa mulandu wa bwingi bwafiko. Eico no kufina kwa mukuba takwaishibikwe.

english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in the LORD’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;
translation: Solomoni apangile ne fipe fyonse ifyakubomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe:

english: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;
translation: Ifyakutekapo ifisaniko ifya golide iyaengwa bwino (fisano fyali ku kulyo kabili fimbi fisano ku kuso kuntanshi ya Muputule wamushilo icine cine),

english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.
translation: Iminshi yonse yakwete inceshi isha matungi yane. Eyabikilwe yatatu yatatu ku ntanshi ya ŋanda kabili yaleloleshanya.

english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.
translation: Ifisambilo ifya golide wine wine,

english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of the LORD’s house.
translation: Ilyo imilimo yonse imfumu Solomoni abombele pakukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe yapwile, aisa ingishamo ne cuma conse ico wishi Davidi atuulile. Aletelamo silifa, golide elyo ne fibombelo fyonse no kwisa fibika fyonse mu matala ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.
translation: Elyo akuula no muputule wa nceshi sheka sheka mubutali uwalepele amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) elyo mubwipi wali amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30). Kuntanshi abikako ulukungu ulwafimbwa no mutenge uwatungililwa ne nceshi.

english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
translation: Akuulile umuputule umwakwikala icipuna ca mfumu, apo ali nokwikala pakupingula imilandu. Akambatikamo imbao sha fimuti fya keda ukufuma panshi ukufika mu mutenge.

english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.
translation: Iŋanda ye sano iyakwe yali kunuma ya iyi ŋanda iyalimo icipuna cakwe, kabili yakulilwe mu musangofye umo. Solomoni akuula isano limbi ilya musango umo wine umwakwikala mwana Farao ulya aupile.

english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
translation: Aya yonse amayanda, ukufuma mu mufula ukufika mu mutenge yapangilwe na mabwe ayalingana mukuputaula ukufumafye kunse ukufika mu lubansa, kabili yali ayakuswa bwino mukati na kunse.

english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.
translation: Elyo imfumu Solomoni yaitile kwisano ku Yerusalemu abakalamba bonse aba mu Israeli, intungulushi sha nko shonse elyo na bakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Israeli ukuti baye senda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe ukufuma ku Sioni, umusumba wakwa Davidi.

english: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,
translation: Ilyo bashimapepo bafumine mu Muputule wamushilo elyo ikumbi lyaishile isula mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.
translation: Na pa mulandu we kumbi ili bashimapepo bafilwa no kubomba imilimo yabo pantu ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bwaisula mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
translation: Ine ninkukuulila iŋanda iyacindama, incende iyakuti iwe uleikalamo pe na pe.”

english: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.
translation: Ninshi ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lucili nalwiminina palya pene, imfumu yapilubuka no kulupaala.

english: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
translation: Elyo yalanda aiti,

english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’
translation: ‘Ukufumafye pa bushiku nafumishe abantu bandi abena Israeli ukufuma mu calo ca ku Egupto, nshatala nsalapo umusumba nangu umo uwa nko sha bena Israeli umwakukuula iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyandi, lelo nalisala Davidi ukuteeka abantu bandi abena Israeli.’

english: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Cali pa mutima wakwa tata Davidi ukukuula iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyakwa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli.

english: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
translation: Nomba Yawe atile kuli tata Davidi, ‘Pa mulandu wakuti cali mu mutima obe ukuti ukuule iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyandi, na iwe wacitile icawama pakuba neci mu mutima obe.

english: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’
translation: Nomba teiwe uli nokukuula iŋanda, lelo umwana obe umwaume uwakuifyalila uwa mulopa obe, kabili umubili obe, euli nokukuula iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyandi.’

english: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
translation: Abaume bonse abena Israeli baisa longana pamo ku mfumu Solomoni pa nshita ya nshikunkulu mu mweshi uwalenga cine lubali ekutila umweshi wa Etanimu .

english: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: “Yawe nafikilisha ubulayo alaile. Nine napyana Davidi tata kabili nine naikala na pa cipuna ca bufumu bwa bena Israeli, ngefyo Yawe alaile. Kabili ninkuula Iŋanda umwakwikala ishina lyakwa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli.

english: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”
translation: Nimpekanya ne ncende ya Mbokoshi iyabamo icipangano Yawe apangene ne fikolwe fyesu ilyo abafumishe mu Egupto.”

english: Solomon stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;
translation: Elyo Solomoni aiminine ku cinso ca bulambo bwakwa Yawe kuntanshi ukwalongene abena Israeli, asumbwila amaboko mu mulu, nokutila,

english: and he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;
translation: “Iwe Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli, takwaba umbi Lesa uwaba nga iwe mu mulu nangu pano isamba lya calo uusunga icipangano cobe icacitemwiko na babomfi bobe abo abekalilila mu nshila shobe ne mitima yacishinka.

english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.
translation: Levi 23:24

english: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’
“Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.
translation: Eico nomba, we Lesa wakwa Israeli, leka ishiwi walaile umubomfi obe Davidi tata lifikilishiwe.

english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!
translation: “Nomba bushe Lesa kuti aikala pano calo? Apofye imyulu nangufye imyulu ya pamulu teti imukumane, bushe iyi ŋanda nkuulile eingamukumana?

english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;
translation: Lelo kutika kwipepo lya mubomfi obe na ku kupapata kwakwe ukwakubelelwa uluse, we Yawe Lesa wandi. Kutika ku nkuuta na kwipepo mubomfi obe alepepa ku cinso cobe muli buno bushiku.

english: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.
translation: Shileka amenso yobe yesukile no kulalolesha pali iyi ŋanda ubushiku na kasuba, pali ino ncende walanda ukuti, ‘Epo ishina lyandi likaba,’ pakuti uleumfwa amapepo ya musha obe aya pali ino ncende.

english: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.
translation: Ilyo abakalamba bonse aba mu Israeli bafikile, elyo bashimapepo baimishe Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe

english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.
translation: Umfwa ukupapata kwa mubomfi obe nokwa bantu bobe abena Israeli ilyo bapepa pali ino ncende. Shi wingalaumfwa ukufuma ku mulu uko waikala kabili ilyo waumfwa ulebelela uluse.

english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,
translation: “Umuntu nga abifya umwina mupalamano wakwe kabili alefwaikwa ukwisa lapa, elyo aisa lapa umulapo pa ntanshi ya bulambo muli iyi ŋanda,

english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
translation: lyena uleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu no kucita icilefwaikwa. Ulepingula pakati ka babomfi bobe no kupeela umulandu ku ulubile, no kuleta pa mutwe wakwe ububi acitile. Ulefumya uwakaele mu mulandu, no kubalambula pali bucishinka bwabo.

english: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,
translation: Ilyo abantu bobe abena Israeli babacimfya ku balwani babo pa mulandu wa bubifi bwabo kuli we Yawe, kabili babwela no kulumbula ishina lyobe, bapepa no kupapata kuli iwe muli ino ŋanda,

english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.
“When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,
translation: “Ilyo imyulu yaisalika ne mfula yaleka ukuloka pantu abantu bacita ifyabubifi kuli iwe, nabo baisa pali ino ncende mukupepa no kulumbula ishina lyobe no kupilibuka ukufuma ku fibi fyabo lintu wabakanda,

english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
translation: elyo uleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu no kubelela ababomfi bobe abena Israeli uluse pa fyabubifi fyabo. Elyo ukabafunde ne mbela isuma iyakwikalilamo, no kutuma imfula pa calo wapeele abantu bobe ukuba icuma cacishilano.

english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,
translation: “Ilyo icipowe nangu icikuko caisa pa calo, nangu ukukunkutana kwa mabula nangu ukufufuma, makanta nangu ifipaso, nangu abalwani babashinguluka mu musumba uuli onse, ifinkunka ifili fyonse nangu ubulwele nga bwaisa,

english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,
translation: kabili ilyo abantu bobe abena Israeli bapepa no kupapata, na cila umo nashininwa mu mutima wakwe, kabili atambalika na maboko yakwe kuli ino ŋanda,

english: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);
translation: elyo ukaleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu, incende waikalako. Ulebomba umulimo wakubelela uluse no kucitila cila umo umwabela imibeele yakwe, apo iwe walishiba umutima wakwe, pantu niwe weka waishiba imitima ya bantu bonse.

english: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.
translation: no kuleta Imbokoshi ya cipangano cakwa Yawe, Itenti lyakukumaninamo ne fipe fyonse ifyamushilo ifyali mukati. Bashimapepo na bena Levi ebasendele.

english: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.
translation: Ulecita ifi pakuti balekutiina ne nshita yonse iya bumi bwabo mu calo wapeele ifikolwe fyesu.

english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake
translation: “Na pa mulandu wa mweni uushili mu bantu bobe abena Israeli, lelo afuma ku calo ca kutali pa mulandu wa kucindama kwe shina lyobe,

english: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,
translation: pantu abantu bali nokumfwa ubukulu bwe shina lyobe na maka ya kuboko kobe nefyo kwatambalala. Ilyo aba bantu baisa pali ino ŋanda mukupepa,

english: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
translation: nalyo line uleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu, incende waikalako, no kucita conse ico umwinafyalo alomba, pakuti abantu bonse aba pano isonde bakeshibe ishina lyobe no kukutiina, nge ficita abantu bobe abena Israeli kabili bakeshibe nokuti ino ŋanda nkuulile mwikala ishina lyobe.

english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to the LORD toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,
translation: “Ilyo abantu bobe baya ku nkondo mukulwisha abalwani babo, mu musango onse uo wabatuminamo, elyo bapepa kuli Yawe pali uno musumba wasala na pa ŋanda nkuulile umwakwikala ishina lyobe,

english: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
translation: lyena uleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu amapepo yabo no kupapata kwabo elyo no kubapeela ukucimfya.

english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;
translation: “Abantu nga bakubifya, pantu takwaba umuntu nangu umo uushibifya, na iwe wabafulilwa no kubapeela mu minwe ya balwani babo, nabo babasenda bunkole ku calo cabo, kube ukutali nelyo mupepi,

english: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’
translation: kabili nga cakuti bapilibula imitima ilyo bali muli cilya calo muli bunkole, elyo balapila no kupapata kuli iwe ninshi bacili mu calo babasendamo bunkole no kutila, ‘Natucita ububifi, natulufyanya, natucita icabipa,’

english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,
translation: elyo bapilibukila kuli iwe ne mitima yabo yonse ne myeo yabo mu calo ca balwani ababasenda bunkole, kabili bapepa kuli iwe pali cino calo wapeele ifikolwe fyabo pali uno musumba wasala na pa ŋanda iyi nkuulile umwakwikala ishina lyobe,

english: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;
translation: elyo uleumfwa ukufuma ku mulu incende waikalako, uleumfwa amapepo no kupapata kwabo no kubafwa.

english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni no lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli abalongene kulya ali, batangila pa ntanshi ya Mbokoshi no kutuula impaanga ne ŋombe ishingi isho bashingebukisha nangu ukupenda.

english: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them
translation: Kabili ulebelela abantu bobe uluse abacitile ifyabubifi kuli iwe, ulebabelela uluse pali bumpulamafunde bonse ubo bacitile kuli iwe, no kulenga abalwani babo babakwatila uluse,

english: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);
translation: pantu bantu bobe kabili abacishilano cobe, abo wafumishe mu calo ca Egupto umwali nga mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.
translation: “Uleke amenso yobe yesuke ku kupapata kwa babomfi bobe na ku kupapata kwa bantu bobe abena Israeli, no kulabomfwa inshita yonse bakuuta kuli iwe.

english: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”
translation: Pantu walibapatula ukufuma mu nko shonse isha pano isonde kukuba abacishilano cobe ngefyo wakonkomeshe ukupitila mu mubomfi obe Mose ilyo iwe we Mfumu Yawe, wafumishe ifikolwe fyesu ukufuma mu Egupto.”

english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.
translation: Ilyo Solomoni apwile ukupepa no kulomba kuli Yawe, elyo aiminina kuntanshi ya bulambo bwakwa Yawe pa ncende pene aciba afukeme ninshi nasumbula amaboko yakwe ku mulu.

english: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
translation: Aiminina no kupaala ibumba lyonse ilya bena Israeli mwishiwi ilikalamba no kutila,

english: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
translation: “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, uupele ukutuusha ku bantu bakwe abena Israeli ukulingana nefyo alaile. Tapaba ishiwi nangu limo ilyafilwa ukufikilishiwapo pa fisuma fya bulayo bonse ubo apeele ukupitila mu mubomfi wakwe Mose.

english: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,
translation: Yawe Lesa wesu abe na ifwe ngefyo ali ne fikolwe fyesu, kabili ekatusha nangu ukutuposa.

english: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.
translation: Alenge imitima yesu ukupilibukila uko ali, no kulaenda mu nshila shakwe shonse, no kulasunga ifyebo fyakwe, ifipope elyo na mafunde wapeele ifikolwe fyesu.

english: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;
translation: Kabili na mashiwi yonse ndelanda, ayo nabomfya pakupepa kuli Yawe, yapalame kuli Yawe Lesa wesu akasuba no bushiku pakuti afikilishepo inshila ya mubomfi wakwe no kufikilisha iya bantu bakwe abena Israeli iyo iya cila bushiku,

english: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.
translation: Bashimapepo epakuleta Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe pa cifulo caiko mu Muputule wa mukati ka ŋanda uwamushilo icine cine no kuiteeka mwisamba lya mapindo ya bakerubi.

english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.
translation: pakuti na bantu bonse aba pano isonde beshibe ukuti Yawe ni Lesa kabili takwaba na umbi.

english: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”
translation: Lelo imitima yenu ifwile ukuba iyacishinka kuli Yawe Lesa wesu, mukulaikala mu fipope fyakwe no kubeela amafunde yakwe nga fino cili nomba.”

english: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
translation: Elyo imfumu na bena Israeli bonse abalipo batuulile amalambo pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.
translation: Solomoni atuula amalambo yakwampana kuli Yawe, iŋombe amakana amakumi yabili na makana yabili (22,000) elyo impaanga ne mbushi amakana umwanda umo na makana amakumi yabili (120,000). Ifi efyo imfumu na bena Israeli bonse balubwile iyo iŋanda kuli Yawe.

english: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.
translation: Pa bushiku bwine bulya, imfumu yasangulula incende ya pakati ka lubansa ulwali ku ntanshi ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe, epo atuulila amalambo yakoca, umutuulo wa cabunga na mafuta ya mituulo yakwampana, pantu ubulambo bwa mukuba ubwakwa Yawe bwali ubunono ubwakutuulilapo amalambo yakoca, imituulo ya cabunga na mafuta ya mituulo yakwampana.

english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.
translation: Kanshi Solomoni na bena Israeli bonse ali nabo pali ilya nshita epakusefya inshikunkulu. Abantu bali abengi abafumine ukutendekela ku Lebo Hamati ukufika na ku kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto. Basefeshe iyi nshikunkulu pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wesu pa nshiku cine lubali ukulundapo na shimbi cine lubali, shonse pamo ikumi limo na shine (14).

english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.
translation: Pa bushiku bwakonkelepo asalanganya abantu bonse. Abantu nabo batasha imfumu, babwelela ku mayanda yabo abasansamuka no kusekelela mu mitima pa fisuma fyonse Yawe acitile umubomfi wakwe Davidi na bantu bakwe Abena Israeli.

english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
translation: Amapindo ya bakerubi yayanshile pa mulu wa Mbokoshi icakuti yafimbilikisha kumo ne fimuti fyakupingilako fyaiko.

english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.
translation: Ifi fimuti fyali ifitali icalengele nokuti impela yafiko ilemoneka ku bali mu Muputule wamushilo, lwa kuntanshi ya Muputule wamushilo icine cine, nomba tashalemoneka ku bali kumbi iyoo. Kabili eko fyaba ukufika na nomba.

english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Tamwali cintu cimbi mu Mbokoshi kanofye amabwe ayapapatala yabili ayo Mose abikilemo pa ncende ya ku Holebu palya Yawe apangile icipangano na bena Israeli ukutula apo bafumine mu Egupto.

english: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
translation: Ilyo imfumu Solomoni yapwile ukukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe ne sano lyaiko, kabili yasekela na muli fyonse ifyo yakabile ukucita,

english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the LORD’s house and the king’s house
translation: Panuma ya myaka amakumi yabili (20), inshita iyo Solomoni akuulilemo ifikulwa ifi fibili, iŋanda yakwa Yawe ne ŋanda ye sano,

english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
translation: imfumu Solomoni yapeela Hiramu imfumu ya ku Turi imisumba amakumi yabili (20) mu calo ca Galile pa mulimo Hiramu abombele uwakumupeela imbao sha fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda, imilando ya paini elyo na golide afwaile.

english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.
translation: Nomba ilyo Hiramu aile ukufuma ku Turi mukuya mona imisumba Solomoni amupeele, ayakaana ukusekelamo.

english: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.
translation: Elyo atila kuli Solomoni, “Nga misumba ya musango nshi iyi umpeele we munyinane?” Elyo ainika cilya calo ati, “calo ca Kabuli,” ishina ilyo beta ukushinta na lelo.

english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.
translation: Lelo Hiramu ninshi alituma kale ku mfumu amatalanta ya golide umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120) .

english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
translation: Ifi efyo cali pa bamulaasa abo imfumu Solomoni yalembele pakukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe, iŋanda yakwe iye sano, ifibumbili fyakwikasha ifikulwa, ilinga lya mu Yerusalemu na Hasoli, Megido na Gesa.

english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
translation: Farao imfumu ya ku Egupto yalisanshile no kupoka umusumba wa Gesa no kuoca. Aipaya na bena Kenani abaikalamo elyo aupeela na kuli mwane muka Solomoni nge cabupe ca pa bwinga.

english: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,
translation: Elyo Solomoni akuula cipya cipya umusumba wa Gesa. Akuula na Beti Horoni wa pesamba,

english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,
translation: Baalati na Tadimo wa mu matololo ya mukati ka calo, pamo pene

english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
translation: Imila 36:19

english: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
translation: Yawe amonekele kuli Solomoni umuku wacibili, mu musango amonekelemo ku Gibeoni.

english: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
translation: Kwaliko abantu bambi abashele mu calo abo abashali abena Israeli pamo nga bena Amoli, abena Hiti, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na abena Yebusi.

english: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.
translation: Aba bali ba mu ndupwa shabo abashele mu calo abo abena Israeli bafilwa ukupeela kukonaulwa . Kanshi Solomoni epakubabuula abacita abasha bamulaasa ngefyo caba ukufika na pa bushiku bwa lelo.

english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
translation: Lelo Solomoni tacitilepo umwina Israeli nangu umo ukuba umusha. Bena abacitafye abashilika ba nkondo, ababomfi babuteko, abatumishi bakwe, abakutungulula abashilika na bakalamba ba fita fya maceleta na bakabalwe.

english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
translation: Ebaba bacilolo bakalamba abakumona pa milimo yakwa Solomoni. Bonse bali bacilolo imyanda isano na makumi yasano (550) abakwangalila abaume abalebomba imilimo.

english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
translation: Panuma mwana Farao akukile ukufuma ku musumba wakwa Davidi ukwisa kwisano Solomoni amukuulile kulya, alundileko ifibumbili fyakwikasha ifikulwa.

english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
translation: Imiku itatu cila mwaka Solomoni aletuula amalambo yakoca ne mituulo yakwampana pa bulambo akuulile Yawe, no koca ububani pa cinso cakwe. Pa nshita imo ine elyo afikilisha ne fyalefwaikwa ukucita mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni akuulile amato ayakalamba pa Esioni Geberi iyaba mupepi na Elati iya mu calo ca Edomu pa lulamba lwa Bemba Wakashika.

english: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
translation: Elyo Hiramu atuma abantu bakwe abamato abaishiba bemba ukubombela pamo na bantu bakwa Solomoni.

english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.
translation: Baya na mato ku Ofiri no kuya senda golide amatalanta imyanda ine na makumi yabili (420) baleta ku mfumu Solomoni.

english: The LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
translation: Yawe atile kuli ena,

english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,
translation: Nomba iwe, nga cakuti walaenda pa cinso candi no mutima uwacishinka kabili uwatambalala, ngefyo wiso Davidi acitile, no kucita fyonse ifyo nakukonkomesha kabili no kubaka ifipope na mafunde yandi,

english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’
translation: Isham 3:5

english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
translation: “Lelo iwe nangu abana bobe nga mwafuma ku cinso candi kabili mwakaana ukubaka amafunde ne fipope nkupeele, kabili mukambe ukulabombela imilungu imbi no kulaipepa,

english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
translation: Imila 1:7

english: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’
translation: Kabili nangu iŋanda ino nshita ilemoneka iyapulama, bonse abakalapitapo bakasunguka no kulaipusha abati, ‘Bushe cinshi calenga Yawe ukucita icintu ca musango uyu kuli cino calo na kuli iyi ŋanda?’

english: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them.’”
translation: Isham 25:9

english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
translation: Ine Petelo, umusole wakwa Yesu Kristu, namulembela imwe mwe bekala kwati ni mbutushi, mwasalanganina mu fyalo fya Ponti, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na mu Betunia.

english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
translation: Uko kwine kupusuka eko bakasesema basakamene no kufwailisha nganshi, kabili ubo bwine bupe balesesemapo e buntu Lesa ali nokumupeela.

english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
translation: Umupashi wakwa Kristu uo bakwete ewalebeba pafyo Kristu ali nokwisa cula, elyo nefyo ali nokwisa peelwa umucinshi. Kanshi balefwaya ukwishiba inshita fikacitikilwapo elyo nefyo fikacitikwa.

english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
translation: Lesa alisokolwele kuli aba bakasesema ukuti tabaleibombela abene mu mulimo wabo, lelo nimwe balebombela. Ifintu ifyo balandilepo, e fintu muleumfwa balemushimikila mu Mbila Nsuma kuli abo Mupashi Wamushilo wafumine ku mulu aishile langa. Ifi e fintu na bamalaika bene bengatemwa ukwishiba.

english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
translation: Kanshi mu mitima yenu mube abaiteyanya kukubomba. Muletekanya, mulesubilafye pa maka mu cikuuku cikamwishila ilyo Yesu Kristu akasokoloka.

english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
translation: Nga bana abanakila Shinwe, mwilakonkelela lunkumbwa lubi ulo mwali nalo ilyo mwali tamulaishiba Kristu.

english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
translation: Filya Lesa uwamwita aba uwamushilo, efyo na imwe muli fyonse mulecita muleba abamushilo.

english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Muleba abamushilo pantu ine ndi wamushilo.”

english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
translation: Apo ilyo mulepepa mwita Lesa amuti ni Shifwe, uyu uupingula umuntu onse no mulinganya pafyo acita, kanshi mu nshita yonse iya bumi bwenu mucili pano calo, mulemukwatila akatiina.

english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
translation: Imwe mwalishiba ifyalipilwe pakumulubula ku misango ya buwelewele iyo ifikolwe fyenu fyamushilile. Tabomfeshe ifintu ifyonaika, ifili nga silifa nangu golide.

english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
translation: Lelo imwe mwalubulwa no mulopa uwacindamisha uwakwa Kristu, uwali kwati mwana wa mpaanga uwabula ubulema nelyo akabi konse.

english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
translation: Imwe Lesa Tata ku kufwaya kwakwe amusalile kale ukuba abantu bakwe. Mupashi wakwe nao amucita ukuba abantu abamushilo abanakila Yesu Kristu, kabili abasangululwa no mulopa wakwe.

english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
translation: Wena Lesa amusalile ne calo tacilabumbwa. Lelo pa mulandu wa ifwe, muli shino nshiku shakupelekeshako, Lesa alimusokolola.

english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
translation: Ni ku maka yakwa Kristu mwakwatila icisumino muli Lesa. Uyu wine Lesa ewabushishe Kristu ku bafwa, kabili ewamucindamika. Eico kanshi icisumino cenu ne subilo fyabafye muli Lesa.

english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
