translation: Kanshi nomba mwalisangulula imitima yenu pali ico mwanakila icishinka, mwakwata ne citemwiko cacine cine icabwananyina. Kanshi bonse muletemwana nganshi ne mitima yenu yonse.

english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
translation: Pantu mwafyalwa cipya cipya te ku mufyashi uufwa, lelo ni ku mufyashi uushifwa, kanshi emukutila ni kwishiwi lyakwa Lesa ilyamweo kabili ilyakubelelela.

english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
translation: Pantu catila,

english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
translation: lelo ishiwi lya Mfumu lyena lilabelelela.”

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Lesa, Wishi wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu. Pantu pakubusha Yesu Kristu ku bafwa, Lesa alitukwatila uluse nganshi no kutufyala cipya cipya. Elyo ici naco cilenga ukuti tukwate isubilo ilyacishinka.

english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
translation: Kanshi eico tulolela ukukwatako ifintu fikankala Lesa asungila abantu bakwe. Amusungila ifi fintu mu mulu, umo fishibola, nangu ukukowela nangu ukukota.

english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
translation: Lesa ku maka yakwe ico imwe mwamusumina, alimusungila ifyo fintu bwino pakuti mukamone ipusukilo likasokololwa pa kupwa kwa nshita.

english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
translation: Pali ici cena mulesansamuka, nangu pa kashita kano kuti mwaumfwa ubulanda pa mulandu wakucula amacushi ayalekana lekana.

english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
translation: Aya macushi yakushininkishafye ukuti icisumino cenu cacine cine. Icela ca golide, iconaika, naco balacoca mu mulilo pakuti bashininkishe ukuti ni golide. Kanshi icisumino cenu icacindamisha ukucila na golide, naco bali nokucishininkisha ukuti cacine cine. Lyena epakuti bakamutashe no kumulumbanya no kumucindika pa Bushiku Yesu Kristu akasokolokelapo.

english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
translation: Nangu mushamumona mwalimutemwa. Nangu mushilamumona mwalimusumina. Kanshi eico mulasansamuka ne nsansa ishikalamba nganshi isho umuntu ashingalondolola.

english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
translation: Pantu mulepokelela ukupusuka kwa myeo yenu uko icisumino cenu cifwaya.

english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
translation: Kanshi mutaluke ku fibi fyonse, ku bufi bonse, kuli bumfundabuteshi, ku mufimbila na kukubepeshanya.

english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
translation: Kale tamwali bantu bakwa Lesa, lelo nomba muli bantu bakwe. Kale tamwapokelele luse lwakwa Lesa, lelo nomba mwalipokelela uluse lwakwe.

english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi, apo mwaba abeni kabili abalendo muli cino calo, ndemupapata ukuti mwilakonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi ululwisha imyeo yenu.

english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
translation: Ilyo muleikala na bantu abashaishiba Lesa, muleba ne mibeele isuma. Lyena epakuti nelyo balemubepesha ukucita ifibi, lelo bakese lumbanya Lesa pa Bushiku Imfumu ikabwela ico balemona ifisuma mucita.

english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
translation: Pa mulandu wa Mfumu mulenakila ubuteko bonse ubwa bantu. Mulenakila kateeka mukalamba, pantu e mukalamba pali bonse.

english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
translation: Esaya 8:14-15

english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
translation: Pantu Lesa afwaya ukuti, imwe ku ficitwa fyenu ifisuma, muputule umulomo wakusabaila kwa fipumbu fya bantu.

english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
translation: Esaya 28:16

english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
translation: Mulecindika umuntu onse, muletemwa na babwananyina. Muleba na katiina kuli Lesa, mulecindika na kateeka mukalamba.

english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
translation: Mwe babomfi mulebeela no kucindika bashikulwinwe. Mwilacita ifyo kuli abo aba luse no mutembo, lelo na ku bakali bene.

english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
translation: Pantu nga mwaba no mutima wakucita ubufwayo bwakwa Lesa, ilyo muleshipikisha mu macushi ayakumufyengeleshafye, ninshi Lesa akamupaala.

english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
translation: Mube kwati tunya tufyelwe nomba, mulefwaishafye ukonka ibele lyeka lyeka ilyakulisha imipashi yenu. Epakuti mukonka ilyo ibele mumone ukukula bwino mukupusuka.

english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
translation: Ala ni kuli ifi fine eko Lesa amwitilako. Pantu Kristu umwine alimuculile, amushilile ne cilangililo pakuti na imwe mulemupashanya.

english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
translation: Kristu ena tabifishe, kabili tatalile alanda fyabufi.

english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
translation: Hosea 2:23

english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
translation: Kristu umwine asendele ifyabubifi fyesu mu mubili wakwe pa musalaba, epakuti na ifwe tutaluke umupwilapo ku bubifi, tuleikala abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa. “Filonda fyakwe efyamundapa.”

english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
translation: Pantu kale mwali kwati ni mpaanga ishaleendafye icende ende, lelo nomba mwalibwelulukila kuli Kacema, kabili Kangalila wa myeo yenu.

english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
translation: Pantu imwe mwaliyumfwila ifyo Imfumu yawama.

english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
translation: Iseni ku Mfumu, ilibwe ilyumi, ilyo abantu basuulile abati lyafyefye, lelo Lesa elyo asala ukuba ilikankala.

english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
translation: Imwe mube nga mabwe ayomi ayakuti Lesa abomfya pakukuula iŋanda yakwe. Muli iyi ŋanda yakwe emo imwe ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu mwakulabombela Lesa nga bashimapepo bamushilo, pakulamulekela amalambo ya mapepo ya mitima yenu ayakusansamusha Lesa.

english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
translation: Pantu ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo fitila,

english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
translation: Kuli imwe mwe basumina, ili libwe lyacindamisha. Lelo ku bashasumina bena,

english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
translation: Amalu 38:8

english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
translation: Lelo imwe muli mukowa Lesa asala, bashimapepo ba Mfumu, umushobo uwamushilo, abantu bakwa Lesa bene bene. Fyonse ifi ni pakuti muleba abakubila ku bantu ifintu ifyakupapa ifyo Lesa acita mukumwita ukufuma mu mfifi no kumuleta mu lubuuto lwakwe ulwakupapa.

english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
translation: Mu musango umo wine abakashi balenakila abalume. Epakuti nga pali bamo abashanakila amashiwi yakwa Lesa, imyendele yenu iyisuma ibanashe ukwabula ukusosa nangu ishiwi nelyo limo.

english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
translation: Pantu calemba ukuti,

english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
translation: Ali nokuleka ukucita ifyabipa,

english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
translation: Nomba nga mwalicincila mukucita ifisuma, nga nani engamucita icakumubipila?

english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
translation: Lelo nangu cakuti mulecula ico mulecita ifyo Lesa afwaya, ninshi mwalishuka. Mwilatiina abantu, nangu ukusakamikwa iyoo.

english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
translation: Mulecindika Kristu no kumucita Imfumu ya bumi bwenu. Lyonse muleba abaiteyanya ukwasuka umuntu onse uwamwipusha ukumulondolwela pesubilo ilyo mwakwata. Muleyasuka uyo muntu mucinshi mucinshi no mutembo.

english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
translation: Muleenda na kampingu wa mitima yenu umusuma, ukwabula akakumusakamika. Epakuti ilyo bamusaalula, abo bantu balelanda ifibi pa myendele yenu iya bwina Kristu, baleikatwa ne nsoni.

english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
translation: Pantu cawamapo ukucula pakucita ifisuma, nga efyo Lesa alefwaya, ukucila ukuculila pakucita ifibi.

english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
translation: Kolo 3:18

english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
translation: Kolo 3:19

english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
translation: Pantu balemona ifyo imyendele yenu yakaele, kabili iyamucinshi.

english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
translation: Iyi e mipashi ya bantu abo bakeene ukunakila Lesa mu nshiku shilya Noa alepanga icibwato, lelo Lesa wena alebapembela nateka umutima. Bantufye abanono abali mu cibwato ebapuswike ku menshi, bali cine konse konse.

english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
translation: Ici cena cilangililo ca lubatisho ulumupususha imwe nomba. Ulu lubatisho talusamba ifiko ifya mubili iyoo, lelo cilayo umuntu alaya kuli Lesa muli kampingu musuma wa mutima wakwe. Lubatisho elutupususha ku maka yakushukuka kwakwa Yesu Kristu.

english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
translation: Efe 5:22

english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
translation: Lekeni ukuyemba kwenu kwiba ku fyakuisamika ifili ngo musango mulelukilamo imishishi, nangu ukulafwala ifisamo ifya golide nangu insalu ishaciyembelo.

english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
translation: Lelo ukuyemba kwenu kuli nokuba mu mitima yenu. Muleba nokuyemba ukushonaika, ukwamutembo no mutima uwaikala tondolo. Ala ici e cintu cikankala pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
translation: Ifi efyo abanakashi aba pakale abamushilo baleisamika. Balesubila muli Lesa, kabili balenakila na balume babo.

english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
translation: Efyo Sara alecita, alenakila Abrahamu, alemwita nokuti, “We mfumu.” Na imwe ninshi muli bana bakwa Sara nga mulecita ifisuma, tamukwete na mwenso wakutiina nelyo cimo.

english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
translation: E cimo cine na imwe mwe balume, mu mikalile yenu mube na mano yasuma pa bakashi benu. Nangu abanakashi bantu abashakosa, mulebacindika, pantu pamo pene na imwe, nabo bene bapokelelako ubupe bwakwa Lesa ubwamweo wape. Ifi efyo mulecita, pakuti kwilaba nelyo cimo icakufulunganya amapepo yenu.

english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
translation: Pakulekelesha ndeti, bonse muleba no mutima umo. Muleumfwilana uluse, mube ne citemwiko cabwananyina, mube ne cilela kabili muleicefya.

english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
translation: Timo 3:9

english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
translation: Kanshi apo Kristu aculile mu mubili wakwe, na imwe imitontonkanishishe iyo akwete ifwile ukumukoselesha. Pantu uucula mu mubili wakwe ninshi nataluka ku bubifi.

english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
translation: Bonse umo umo Lesa alimupeela ubupe ubwaibela ibela. Kanshi mulebomfya ubo bupe Lesa amupeela kukutumika abanenu. Ukucita ifyo, ekuba kasunga musuma wa bupe bwalekana lekana ubo Lesa amupeela.

english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Uulanda, nalelandafye amashiwi ayafuma kuli Lesa. Uuletumika bambi, naletumika na maka yonse Lesa amupeela, epakuti muli fyonse abantu bonse balelumbanya Lesa ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu. Yesu Kristu e mwine bucindami na maka pe na pe. Ameni.

english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
translation: Amap 10:12

english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
translation: Ala mulesansamukafye ico muleculako amacushi Kristu aculileko. Epakuti mukasansamuke nganshi ilyo ubucindami bwakwe bukasokoloka.

english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
translation: Ala, mwalishuka abantu nga balamusaalula pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, pantu ninshi Mupashi Mucindami, Mupashi wakwa Lesa, aba na imwe icine cine.

english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
translation: Pali imwe tapali nakuba uwakucula pa mulandu wakuba icipondo, nangu impupu, nangu mpulamafunde nangu ico muntu wacimfulunganya.

english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
translation: Lelo umo nga alecula ico mwina Kristu, awe tali nakumfwa insoni pali ici, lelo alifye nokutasha Lesa pakuba uwakwa Kristu.

english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
translation: Ubushiku bwabupingushi buli mupepi. Abo Lesa akabalilapo ukupingula bantu bakwe. Nga nifwe Lesa akabalilapo ukupingula, nga abo abashanakila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa bena cikaba shani?

english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
translation: Calembwa ukuti,

english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
translation: Kanshi eico, abo balecula pantu Lesa efyo alefwaya, baleituula kuli Lesa Kabumba wabo bakonkanyepo no kulacita ifisuma.

english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
translation: Pantu nomba inshiku shonse isha bumi bwakwe pano calo tekuti ateekwe no lunkumbwa lubi ulwabuntunse, lelo kanofye ukucita ififwaya Lesa.

english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
translation: Kale mwaikele inshita ikalamba mulecita ifyo abantu abashaishiba Lesa batemwa ukucita. Mwaleikala mu bulalelale, mukukonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi, muli bucakolwa, mu kuipakisha kwa misango yonse, mu bunweshi na mukucita icintu icansoni nganshi icakupepa utulubi.

english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
translation: Kanshi nomba abantu bashaishiba Lesa nacibapesha amano ico mushilebakonka mu mikalile ibi iyabuwelewele, kanshi e mulandu wine balemusaalwila.

english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
translation: Lelo bakaba nokulubulula kuli Lesa, uwaipekanya ukuputula imilandu ya bomi na bafwa.

english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
translation: Kanshi ecalengele ukuti na bafwa bene babililwe Imbila Nsuma pakuti, nelyo balebapingula pafyo bacitile ilyo bali abomi nga filya bapingula abantu bonse, imipashi yabo ibe no mweo Lesa akwata.

english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
translation: Ukupwa kwa calo kuli mupepi. Kanshi muletekanya, mube abamano, epakuti mulepepa.

english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
translation: Nomba ukucilapo pali fyonse muletemwana icine cine, pantu icitemwiko cifimba pa fyabubifi ifingi.

english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
translation: Mulesekelelana mu mayanda yenu ukwabula ukuilishanya.

english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
translation: Ine apo ndi mukalamba munenu, ndemupapata imwe mwe bakalamba ba nkuta. Ine ndi kambone pafyo Kristu aculile, kabili nalikumako ku bucindami ubukesa sokoloka.

english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
translation: Ala mukaculafye akashita akanono. Elyo Lesa wacikuuku conse, uwamwita ico tuli muli Kristu kukukuma ku bucindami bwakwe ubwakubelelela, akamuwamya umupwilapo, akamupeela amaka, akamukosha mukabe abashangila icine cine.

english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Luka 14:11

english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
translation: Mateo 23:12

english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
translation: Ulukuta lunenu ulwa mu Babiloni ulo Lesa asala nga imwe bene, lwamuposha, elyo no mwana wandi Mako amuposha.

english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
translation: Kanshi mulecema umukuni uo Lesa amupeela ukwangalila, teico pantu muli nokubomba lelo nico mulefwaya ukubomba ifyo Lesa alefwaya mubombe. Mwilabomba icofye mulefwaya amalipilo iyoo, lelo mulebomba ico mulefwaisha ukutumika.

english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
translation: Mwilaumya bufumu ku bantu abo mwapeelwa ukubaka, lelo muleba icilangililo icakuti umukuni wakwa Lesa ulepashanya.

english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
translation: Ilyo Kacema mukalamba akamoneka, elyo mukapeelwa icilambu icacindama icishakonaike.

english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
translation: Eifyo fine na imwe mwe balumendo mulenakila abakalamba. Elyo bonsefye muletumika abanenu mukuicefya. Pantu catila, “Lesa acincintila abacilumba, lelo abaicefya bena alabakwatila icikuuku.”

english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
translation: Kanshi muleicefya pa cinso cakwa Lesa uwamaka nganshi, umwine akamucindamika pa nshita alefwaya.

english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
translation: Mulemutuula amasakamiko yenu yonse, pantu eumusunga.

english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
translation: Muletekanya, kabili mulelola! Umulwani wenu Ciwa, endauka kwati ni nkalamo ilebuluma, ilefwaya uwakuti ikate imulye.

english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
translation: Mube ne cisumino icakosa, mulemwansha. Kabili mwalishiba ukuti ababwananyina banenu isonde lyonse balepita mu macushi ya musango umo wine.

english: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?
translation: Elyo Samwele abuulile umusukupala wa mafuta no kwitila pa mutwe wakwa Saulo elyo amutomona, amweba nokuti, “Ala niwe Yawe asubile ukuba intungulushi pakati ka bantu bakwe abena Israeli. Niwe uli nokuteeka abantu bakwa Yawe no kubapususha ku kuboko kwa balwani babo ababashinguluka. Icishibilo cakwishibilako ukuti ni Yawe eukusontele ukuba intungulushi ya bacishilano bakwe nici.

english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
translation: Ilyo bafikile pa Gibea, bakasesema umulongo balimukumenye, no mupashi wakwa Lesa waishile na maka pali wena nao ayamba no kusesema nga bena.

english: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
translation: Ilyo bonse abo ali nabo kale abamwishibe bamwene alesesema pamo na bakasesema, baipushanya abati, “Bushe ni cinshi icacitika kuli mwana Kishi? Bushe Saulo nao ni umo pali bakasesema?”

english: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
translation: Elyo umuntu umo uwaleikala kulya ayankula ati, “Nga kanshi shibo ni nani?” Eico cayalwike ipinda icakusosa ati, “Bushe Saulo nao ali pakati ka bakasesema?”

english: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
translation: Ilyo Saulo alekele ukusesema aile fika ku ncende yakupepelapo.

english: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
translation: Nomba nalume wakwa Saulo alimwipwishe pamo no mubomfi wakwe ati, “Bushe ni kwi waciba?” Nao atile, “Kukufwaya bapunda. Nomba ilyo twacifilwa ukubamona twaciya kwa Samwele.”

english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”
translation: Nalume kwa Saulo atile, “Njebako ifyo Samwele acisosa kuli iwe.”

english: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.
translation: Saulo atile, “Cacine bapunda nabamoneka.” Lelo taebele nalume ifyo Samwele asosele pa mulandu wa fyabufumu.

english: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah;
translation: Panuma ya ifi Samwele alonganike abena Israeli kuli Yawe ku Misipa,

english: and he said to the children of Israel, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
translation: elyo atile kuli bena, “Ifi efyo Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli asosa. Nine nafumishe Israeli mu Egupto, kabili nine namupokolwele ukufuma ku maka ya bena Egupto pamo no kumupokolola kuli bashamfumu bonse abalemucusha.

english: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.”
translation: Nomba imwe ilelo mwakaana Lesa wenu, uumupususha mu macushi yenu yonse elyo na mu masakamika yenu yonse. Kabili mwalanda nokuti, ‘Iyoo, ifwe tupeelefye imfumu iyakututeeka.’ Eico kanshi nomba iseni mumonekele ku cinso cakwa Yawe, umo mwabela mu nko ne mikowa yenu.”

english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’
translation: Ilyo walaya ukufuma kuli ine ilelo, uleya kumanya abantu babili abaume mupepi na pa nshinshi yakwa Rebeka, ku Selisa mu calo ca bena Benjamini. Baleyatila kuli iwe, ‘Bapunda waile mukufwaya nabamoneka. Eico nomba bawiso nabaleka ukutontonkanya pali bapunda, nomba basakamene pa mulandu wa iwe wine. Batendeke no kwipusha ati, bushe cinshi ndi nokucita pa mulandu wa mwana wandi?’

english: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.
translation: Elyo Samwele apalamike aba nko sha bena Israeli mupepi, na ba luko lwa bena Benjamini ebasalilwe mukubomfya ukupendula.

english: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
translation: Elyo apalamika kuntanshi aba luko lwa bena Benjamini, mu ndupwa shabo, elyo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Matiri ebasalilwe mukubomfya ukupendula. Pakulekelesha Saulo mwana Kishi ewasalilwe. Lelo ilyo balemufwaya tabamusangile.

english: Therefore they asked of the LORD further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” The LORD answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
translation: Ecalengele bepushe kuli Yawe nakabili abati, “Bushe uyu muntu naisako kuno?” Elyo Yawe nao abasuka ati, “Ee, nomba nafisama mu fipe.”

english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”
translation: Samwele atile ku bantu bonse, “Bushe mwamumona umuntu uo Yawe asalile? Tapali uuli kwati ena pakati ka bantu bonse.” Elyo abantu baweleshe abati, “Imfumu naibe no bumi pe!”

english: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the LORD. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
translation: Samwele alondolwele abantu insambu elyo ne milimo yaba pa bufumu. Epakulemba fyonse mu citabo no kubika pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Elyo Samwele asalanganya abantu, cila muntu ukuya kumwakwe.

english: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
translation: Saulo nao aile kumwakwe ku Gibea, na bantu ababulamba abo Lesa anashishe ku mitima bamushindika.

english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.
translation: Lelo bamo bantalamisoka batile, “Bushe kuti uyu atupususha shani?” Balimusushishe nganshi kabili tabamupeeleko nangu fyabupe. Lelo Saulo atalelefye tondolo.

english: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.
translation: Elyo uli nokutwalilila ukuya ukufuma palya mpaka ukafike ku cimuti icikalamba ica oki ica Tabo. Abantu batatu abaume abalenina mukuya tuula amalambo kuli Lesa ku Betele ebali nokukukumanya palya pene. Umo ninshi nasenda utwana twa mbushi tutatu, umbi nao imikate itatu, elyo umbi nao inyambi ya mwangashi.

english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
translation: Bali nokuya kuposha no kukupeela imikate ibili iyo uli nokupokelela ukufuma kuli bena.

english: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.
translation: “Elyo panuma ya ifyo, uleya fika ku lupili lwakwa Lesa uko Abafilisiti babika inkambi ya fita. Nga walapalamina ku musumba, uli nokukumanya umulongo wa bakasesema baletentemuka ku ncende yakupepelapo ninshi balelisha insango, insombo, imitolilo na maseese ku ntanshi yabo, ninshi bonse balesesema.

english: Then the LORD’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.
translation: Umupashi wakwa Yawe uli nokwisa pali iwe mu maka elyo na iwe uleisa yamba ukulasesema pamo nabo. Kabili uli nokusanguka umuntu umbi.

english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.
translation: Elyo ifi fishibilo nga fyaba pali iwe, lyena ucite conse ico iminwe yobe ili nokubomba, pantu Lesa ali na iwe.

english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”
translation: Kabili wambeko utangile ukuya ku Giligali, na ine nkesa kusanga kulya kwine kukutuula umutuulo wakoca no wakwampana. Lelo ulingile ukulolela pa nshiku cine lubali mpaka nkese no kukweba ifyo uli nokucita.”

english: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.
translation: Ilyo Saulo apilibwike ukufuma kuli Samwele, Lesa apilibwile umutima wakwa Saulo, no kuleka ifi fishibilo fyonse fifikilishiwe pali bulya bushiku.

english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
translation: Panuma ya mweshi umo, Nahashi umwina Amoni aishile no kwisa pokolola Yabeshi Gileadi. Elyo abantu bonse aba mu Yabeshi batile kuli ena, “Cita icipangano na ifwe, elyo na ifwe twakulakubombela.”

english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”
translation: Kanshi abaleikala ku Yabeshi epakweba abena Amoni ati, “Mailo tuli nokucimba kuli imwe elyo na imwe kuti mwatucitilafye conse icingaba icisuma kuli imwe.”

english: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Saulo ayakanya abaume bakwe mu fipani fitatu. Elyo ulucelo ku macaca baingilile abena Amoni mu nkambi yabo no kubakomaula mpaka ukufika na pa nshita akasuba kabalikishe. Kabili bonse abapusunswikeko balisalangene icakuti nangufye babili tabashele pamo iyoo.

english: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”
translation: Abantu epakwipusha Samwele abati, “Nga ni bani abaipwishe ati, ‘Bushe Saulo ewingateeka ifwe? Baleteni kuli ifwe pakuti tubepaye.’”

english: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today the LORD has rescued Israel.”
translation: Lelo Saulo atile, “Takwabe nangu umo uuli nokwipaiwa mu bushiku bwa lelo, pantu ubushiku bwa lelo Yawe napususha Israeli.”

english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”
translation: Elyo Samwele aeba abantu ati, “Iseni, natuleya ku Giligali kabili kulya kwine eko tuleya lumbula cipya cipya ifyabufumu.”

english: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
translation: Kanshi abantu bonse epakuya ku Giligali no kuya bilisha Saulo nge mfumu pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Kulya kwine eko baile tuula imutuulo yakwampana pa cinso cakwa Yawe, elyo Saulo na bena Israeli bonse basansamuka nganshi.

english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”
translation: Lelo Nahashi umwina Amoni ayaswike ati, “Ine kuti napanga icipangano na imwe nga twasuminishanya ukuti ine nkatonkole cila umo ilinso lya ku kulyo pakuti nkalete umusebanya pali Israeli onse.”

english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”
translation: Abakalamba ba mu Yabeshi epakumweba abati, “Tupeeleko inshiku cine lubali pakuti tutume inkombe ku bena Israeli bonse, elyo nga cakuti takuli nangu umo uwakwisa tupususha, lyena tuli nokucimba kuli iwe.”

english: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.
translation: Ilyo inkombe shaishile ku Gibea umushi wakwa Saulo no kutula umulandu onse ku bantu, bonse batendeke ukulila imisowa iyikalamba.

english: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
translation: Califye ilyo Saulo alebwela ukufuma ku mabala, ninshi nakonka iŋombe shakulima panuma, elyo aipwishe ati, “Bushe cinshi cilubene ku bantu? Ni cinshi ico balelila?” Abantu epakumulondolwela ifyo abaume ba ku Yabeshi basosele.

english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
translation: Ilyo Saulo aumfwile amashiwi yabo, umupashi wakwa Lesa waishile pali ena na maka, icakuti aikatwa no bukali.

english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.
translation: Abuulile iŋombe shibili ishakuliminako ashiputaula mu fipimfya, no kutumina bonse abena Israeli mu ncende shonse. Atuma inkombe ishakuyalanda ukuti, “Ifi efyo cili nokucitika ku ŋombe iyilima iya muntufye onse uushakonke Saulo na Samwele.” Elyo umwenso wakwa Yawe waishile pa bantu bonse, nabo baima capamo ngo muntu umo.

english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
translation: Ilyo Saulo abalongenye abantu ku Beseki, abaume ba mu Israeli bali amakana imyanda itatu (300,000) elyo na baume bakwa Yuda amakana yatatu (30,000).

english: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
translation: Baebele inkombe ishaishile abati, “Kabiyeni kasoseni ku baume ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi amuti, ‘Mailo ilyofye akasuba kakabalikisha, ninshi mwalubulwa.’” Ilyo inkombe shaile no kuyatula ilyashi ili ku baume ba ku Yabeshi, nabo balisaminwe.

english: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.
translation: Elyo Samwele aebele abena Israeli bonse ati, “Ine nalyumfwa fyonse ifyo mwasosa kuli ine kabili nalimupeela ne mfumu iyakumuteeka.

english: They cried to the LORD, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’
translation: Elyo balilile kuli Yawe nokutila, ‘Natubifya pantu natusangukila Yawe no kulabombela imilungu ba Baali na ba Ashitoreti. Lelo nomba, tupokololeniko ku minwe ya balwani besu, elyo na ifwe twakulamubombela.’

english: The LORD sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.
translation: Elyo Yawe atumine Yerubibaali, Baraki, Yefuta na Samwele abamupokolwele ukufuma mu minwe ya balwani benu mu ncendefye shonse, pakuti mwikale umutende.

english: “When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when the LORD your God was your king.
translation: Abap 3:12

english: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, the LORD has set a king over you.
translation: Nomba moneni, imfumu iyi iyo mwasalile, iyo mwe bene mwalombele. Eico Yawe naimika imfumu pali imwe.

english: If you will fear the LORD, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of the LORD your God.
translation: Eico nomba nga cakuti muli nokuba na katiina kuli Yawe, mulemubombela no kumubeela elyo no kukanasangukila amafunde yakwe. Kabili nga cakuti imwe bonse pamo pene ne mfumu yakulamuteeka mwakulakonka Yawe Lesa wenu, ninshi cili nokumuwamina!

english: But if you will not listen to the LORD’s voice, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then the LORD’s hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwakaana ukubeela ishiwi lyakwa Yawe, kabili mwasangukila na mafunde yakwa Yawe, lyena ninshi ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kuli nokuba pali imwe elyo na pa mfumu yenu ngefyo cali pali bashinwe.

english: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.
translation: “Eico nomba, iminineni ifyo fine no kumona icintu icikalamba ico Yawe alacita mu menso yenu!

english: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to the LORD, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the LORD’s sight, in asking for a king.”
translation: Bushe ino te nshita yakusombola iŋanu? Ine nalalomba kuli Yawe alete ukubulukuta ne mfula. Kabili muli nokushininkisha no kwishiba ukuti cintu icibi mwacita ku cinso cakwa Yawe icakwipusha ukumupeela imfumu.”

english: So Samuel called to the LORD, and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
translation: Elyo Samwele alombele kuli Yawe, na pa bushiku bwine bulya Yawe atumine ukubulukuta ne mfula, icakuti abantu bonse baiketwe no mwenso uukalamba uwa kuli Yawe na Samwele.

english: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to the LORD your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”
translation: Sam 8:19

english: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.
translation: Moneni, ala nomba ni mfumu eyakulamutungulula. Pantu nomba ine ninkota kabili ndi ne mfwi, lelo abana bandi abaume bena muli nabo. Ine nali intungulushi yenu ukufuma ku bulumendo bwandi ukufika na ku bushiku bwa lelo.

english: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
translation: Sam 3:20

english: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
translation: Mwiyalukila ukukonka ifyaciwelewele ifilubi ifishingamwafwa. Tafibomba busuma nakalya, nangu ukumupususha teti fimupusushe, pantu fyaciwelewele.

english: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased the LORD to make you a people for himself.
translation: Pa mulandu we shina lyakwe ilicindami, Yawe takalekeleshe abantu bakwe, pantu Yawe alitemenwe ukumucita abantu bakwe.

english: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.
translation: Ukuf 2:23

english: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
translation: Lelo imwe mukwatilefye Yawe akatiina no kulamubombela mu cishinka ne mitima yenu yonse. Mufwile ukuba abakwibukisha ifintu ifikankala ifyo amucitila.

english: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king.”
translation: Nomba nga cakuti mwakonkanyapo ukulabifya, bonse imwe pamo ne mfumu yenu mukaloba.”

english: Here I am. Witness against me before the LORD and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”
translation: Ine naiminina pano, nshinineni pa cinso cakwa Yawe elyo na ku wasubwa wakwe. Bushe nani nasendelapo iŋombe iyilima? Ni punda wakwa nani ine nasendapo? Ninani uo nacenjeshapo? Nani uo nafyengelepo? Bushe ni ku minwe yakwa nani nafumishe amafisakanwa pakulenga amenso yandi yashibate? Nga cakuti nalicitapo cimo pali ifi, ine ndi nokumubwesesha.”

english: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”
translation: Nabo abantu bayaswike abati, “Tawatala autucenjesha nangu ukutufyenga. Kabili tawatala aupoka akantu ku minwe ya muntu nangu umo.”

english: He said to them, “The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” They said, “He is witness.”
translation: Samwele atile kuli bena, “Yawe e kambone pali imwe kabili no musubwa wakwe wine ni kambone mu bushiku bwa lelo ukuti tamusangilepo akantu nangu kamo mu minwe yandi.” Nabo batile, “Ni kambone.”

english: Samuel said to the people, “It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Elyo Samwele atile ku bantu, “Yawe e kambone uwasalile Mose na Aroni kabili afumya ne fikolwe fyenu mu calo ca ku Egupto.

english: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before the LORD concerning all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.
translation: Eico nomba palameni bonse pakuti mwebe ifishinka pa cinso cakwa Yawe pali fyonse ifya bulungami bwakwa Yawe, ifyo amucitila pamo na bashinwe.

english: “When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.
translation: “Ilyo Yakobo aingile mu Egupto, na bena Egupto bayamba ukubacusha, ifikolwe fyenu fyalilile kuli Yawe ukuti abafwe. Elyo Yawe epakutuma Mose na Aroni abafumishe ifikolwe fyenu muli cilya calo, no kubaleta ukuti baleikala mu cifulo cino.

english: But they forgot the LORD their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.
translation: Lelo bena balaba kuli Yawe Lesa wabo, nao epakubashitisha mu minwe yakwa Sisera umukalamba wa fita fya mfumu Yabini uwa ku Hasoli, elyo na mu minwe ya Bafilisiti, kabili na mu minwe ya mfumu ya ku Moabu ababalwishishe.

english: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.
translation: Saulo ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ilyo bamusontele pa bufumu, kabili ateekele abena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yane na ibili (42).

english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.
translation: Kanshi cilya apwafye ukupeela ilambo lyakoca, na Samwele afika, kabili Saulo aile mukumusengela no kumuposha.

english: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,
translation: Samwele aipusha ati, “Bushe cinshi wacita?” Saulo ayasuka ati, “Ilyo nacimona ukuti abantu balasalangana kabili nokuti tawishile pa nshita wapimine, elyo Abafilisiti nabo balelongana ku Mikimashi,

english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of the LORD.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”
translation: eco nasosele nati, ‘Nomba Abafilisiti balanjishilila ine wine ku Giligali, kabili nshilalomba nokuti Yawe ansekelele. Kanshi epakuipatikisha mukutuula ilambo lyakoca.’”

english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which he commanded you; for now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.
translation: Samwele epakweba Saulo ati, “Ucitilefye nge mbulwamano. Taubakile ifunde Yawe Lesa obe akupeela. Aucita ifyo akukonkomesha, nga nakosha ubufumu bobe pali Israeli ukuba ubwa pe na pe.

english: But now your kingdom will not continue. The LORD has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which the LORD commanded you.”
translation: Lelo nomba ubufumu bobe tabwatwalilile. Yawe nafwaya umuntu uwa mibeele iyisansamusha umutima wakwe, kabili eo asontele ukuba intungulushi ya bantu bakwe, pantu iwe taubakile ifunde lyakwa Yawe.”

english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.
translation: Elyo Samwele afumine ku Giligali no kuya ku Gibea wa muli Benjamini. Elyo Saulo apendele abaume abashele nankwe asanga ati bali nalimo imyanda mutanda (600).

english: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
translation: Saulo no mwana wakwe umwaume Yonatani na baume bali nabo baikele mu Geba wakwa Benjamini, ninshi Abafilisiti nabo bacitile inkambi ku Mikimashi.

english: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;
translation: Elyo ibumba lya bantu abonaushi lyafumine ku nkambi ya Bafilisiti mu mpuka shitatu. Impuka imo yalungeme ku Ofira mu calo cakwa Shuali,

english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
translation: imbi yalungeme ku Beti Horoni elyo iyacitatu nayo yalolele ku mpanga ya mupaka walungatana ne shika lya Seboyimu ukulolenkana ku matololo.

english: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;
translation: Nomba takwali uwakufula ifyela mu calo conse ica Israeli, pantu Abafilisiti batile, “Epali Abahibulu bayamba ukufula impanga nangu amafumo!”

english: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.
translation: Saulo asalile abaume amakana yatatu (3,000) ukufuma mu Israeli. Amakana yabili (2,000) yali nankwe ku Mikimashi na mu calo ca mpili sha Betele, elyo ikana limo (1,000) lyali na Yonatani ku Gibea wa mu Benjamini. Abantu bonse abashelepo ababweseshamo ku ncende sha kumwabo uko bafumine.

english: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.
translation: Kanshi bonse abena Israeli baleya ku Bafilisiti mukunonesha inkasu sha ŋombe, bapiki, amasembe, elyo ne fikwakwa.

english: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.
translation: Umutengo wakunonesha inkasu sha ŋombe na bapiki wali ukucila citika wa shekeli umo, elyo pakunona amasembe elyo na pa kolola kwa misumbo kwine wali mupepi na citika wa shekeli.

english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.
translation: Imili 13:22

english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
translation: Nomba impuka imo iya Bafilisiti yaile ku mupokapoka wa ku Mikimashi.

english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
translation: Yonatani acimfishe impuka ya Bafilisiti abali pa nkambi ya ku Geba, na Bafilisiti bonse baumfwako icacitike. Elyo Saulo alishishe ipenga mu calo conse nokutila, “Lekeni Abahibulu bomfwe!”

english: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.
translation: Kanshi bonse abena Israeli balyumfwile amashiwi yonse ayakuti Saulo nasansa inkambi ya Bafilisiti elyo nomba Israeli asangwike umulwani wa Bafilisiti. Kabili abantu balongene mukuba pamo na Saulo ku Giligali.

english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.
translation: Abafilisiti nabo balongana pamo pakulwisha abena Israeli, bali na maceleta amakana amakumi yatatu (30,000) na aba pali bakabalwe amakana mutanda (6,000) elyo ne fita ifingi kwati munsensenga wa kuli bemba. Baile no kuya cita inkambi ku Mikimashi, ku kabanga ka Beti Afeni.

english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.
translation: Ilyo abaume abena Israeli bamwene ukuti bakwata ubwafya ubushaibipila, kabili nokuti ifita fyabo fyacilikilwa, bafisama mu ncengo na mu filindi, mu mateshi, mu mabwe elyo na mu mendo ya mabwe.

english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
translation: Bamo Abahibulu balyabwike umumana wa Yordani ukuya mu calo ca Gadi na Gileadi. Saulo ashele ku Giligali ne mpuka shonse isha fita isho ali nasho shilekankafye ku mwenso.

english: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.
translation: Apembele pa nshiku cine lubali, ukulingana ne nshita Samwele apimine. Lelo Samwele taishileko ku Giligali! Abantu bakwa Saulo batampile no kusalangana.

english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.
translation: Eico Saulo atile, “Leteni kuli ine ilambo lyakoca elyo ne mituulo yakwampana.” Elyo Saulo atuulile ilambo lyakoca.

english: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.
translation: Ubushiku bumo Yonatani umwana mwaume wakwa Saulo atile ku mulumendo uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe, “Isa, tuleya twabukile kulya kwishilya ku nkambi ya Bafilisiti.” Lelo taebele wishi.

english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for the LORD has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti batila, ‘Iseni ninikeni kuli ifwe,’ lyena tuli nokuninika ukuya pamulu pantu ninshi cili ukuba icishibilo kuli ifwe icakuti Yawe nabapeela mu minwe yesu.”

english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”
translation: Bonsefye babili baisokolwele ku nkambi ya Bafilisiti. Abafilisiti batile, “Moneni! Abahibulu bayamba ukufuma mu mendo bafisama.”

english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”
translation: Abantu ba pa nkambi ya Bafilisiti bapundile kuli Yonatani no mubomfi walesenda ifyanso fyakwe ati, “Iseni pano pakuti twise tumufundeko icintu cimo.” Elyo Yonatani atile ku mubomfi walesenda fyanso fyakwe, “Nina ulenkonka pantu Yawe napeela aba bantu mu minwe ya bena Israeli.”

english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.
translation: Yonatani pakunina ukuya pamulu, alebomfya iminwe na makasa ninshi umubomfi uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe namukonka panuma. Abafilisiti bayambile ukuiwilafye pa cinso cakwa Yonatani, elyo umubomfi walesenda ifyanso nao ninshi nakonka panuma alebepaya.

english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.
translation: Muli uku kusansa kwantanshi Yonatani no mubomfi walesenda ifyanso fyakwe baipeye nalimo abantu amakumi yabili (20) mu ncende iyinono ukulingana na citika wa ekare (0:5 acre).

english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.
translation: Kabili umwenso waikata ifita fyonse ifyali mu nkambi, ne fyali mu mpanga elyo na bantu bonse. Waikata ne fita ifyalelonda ifyanso elyo ne fita ifyaya kukusansa icakuti no mushili walatenta. Ici cabaletele umwenso uukalamba nganshi

english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.
translation: Inengu shakwa Saulo mu Gibea wa mu Benjamini shaletamba uko ifita filesalanganina mu ncendefye shonse.

english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.
translation: Elyo Saulo aebele ifita ali nafyo ati, “Pendeni ifita pakuti mumone abafuminepo.” Ilyo bapwile ukupenda, basangile ukuti ni Yonatani no mubomfi walesenda ifyanso fyakwe ebashalipofye.

english: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.
translation: Saulo aebele Ahiya ati, “Leta kuno Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa .” Pa nshita ilya calesungwa na bena Israeli.

english: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”
translation: Ilyo Saulo acili alelanda kuli shimapepo, icongo mu nkambi ya Bafilisiti ninshi cilekulilakofye nganshi. Saulo epakweba shimapepo ati, “Fumyako ukuboko kobe.”

english: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,
translation: Saulo aleikala kunse ya Gibea mwisamba lya cimuti ca mateke mu Migironi. Ali ne fita ukulingana nalimo imyanda mutanda (600),

english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.
translation: Elyo Saulo na bantu bonse abo ali nabo balongana no kuya ku bulwi. Basangile Abafilisiti mu cimfulunganya icikalamba, balekomanafye abene beka ne mpanga shabo.

english: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
translation: Nomba icacitike cakuti Abahibulu bamo abali kale ku lubali lwa Bafilisiti kabili abaile ikala na ku nkambi yabo, bayalukile ku bena Israeli abali na Saulo pamo na Yonatani.

english: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
translation: Kabili, ilyo bonse abena Israeli abafiseme mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu baumfwile ukuti Abafilisiti nabafulumuka, nabo baliponenemo mukubalwisha no kubasupila.

english: So the LORD saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.
translation: Kanshi Yawe alipuswishe Israeli mu bushiku bulya, kabili ubulwi bwalilundulwike ukucila Beti Afeni.

english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.
translation: Nomba muli bulya bushiku abaume abena Israeli baliculile nganshi, pantu Saulo akakile abantu ku mulapo ati, “Alapishiwe umuntu onse uuli nokulya icilyo ilyo icungulo tacilafika, lintu nshilalandula ne mwine pa balwani bandi!” Kanshi takwali impuka nangu imo iyasondele icakulya.

english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.
translation: Elyo ifita fyonse fyaingile mu mpanga iyamutengo, no kuya sangamo ubuci panshi.

english: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.
translation: Ilyo bafikile apali ubuci, bamona ubuci bulefumya uluto kunse, lelo takwali nelyo umo uwakomfwele umunwe wakwe no kutwala pa kanwa kakwe, pantu abantu batiinine umulapo.

english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
translation: Nomba Yonatani taumfwileko ukuti wishi ebakakile abantu ku mulapo, kanshi ena epakupisha impela ya nkonto yakwe iyali mu minwe no kutumpa mu cipepe ca buci. Aimya iminwe yakwe no kutwala pa kanwa kakwe elyo amenso yakwe yacelebwike.

english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.
translation: Elyo umo uwa mu fita atile kuli ena, “Bawiso bacikaka ifita icine cine ku mulapo uwakuti, ‘Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu onse uuli nokulya icilyo mu bushiku bwa lelo!’ Uyu e mulandu wine abantu bafwilile ulushile.”

english: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
translation: Yonatani atile, “Batata nabacita icabipa mu calo. Moneni ifyo amenso yandi yacelebwike ilyofye nsondelepo utubuci tunono.

english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.
translation: apo apali na Ahiya uwalefwala icakufwala cabushimapepo ica efodi. Ali mwana mwaume wakwa Aitubu munyina Ikabodi uwali mwana Fineasi, nao mwana Eli, shimapepo wakwa Yawe mu Shilo. Takwali muntu uwaishibe ukuti Yonatani naya.

english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”
translation: Bushe nga tacaciwama icakuti abantu abalyapo ifitapwa fimo ilelo ifyo bafumishe ku balwani babo? Nga cakuti abalya, bushe aba Bafilisiti nga tatubepeye ukucilapo?”

english: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;
translation: Pa numa ya bena Israeli ukwipaya Abafilisiti pali bulya ubushiku, ukufuma ku Mikimashi ukufika ku Aiyaloni, ifita fyalinakile nganshi.

english: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.
translation: Kanshi ifita epakomokela pa fitapwa, fyabuula impaanga, iŋombe no twana twa ŋombe, no kwipaila pa lwalala panshi elyo balalya pamo pene no mulopa kumo.

english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against the LORD, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”
translation: Elyo baebele Saulo abati, “Mona abantu balebifya kuli Yawe pakulya inama iyili no mulopa.” Abaswike ati, “Namulufya icisumino. Kunkulusheni icilibwe pano nombaline.”

english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against the LORD in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.
translation: Saulo epakubeba ati, “Salanganeni mu bantu no kubeba amuti, ‘Cila umo alete iŋombe nangu impaanga yakwe no kwisa yipaila pano pene epo alile, pakuti mwibifya kuli Yawe mukulalya inama iyicilimo no mulopa mukati kaiko.’” Kanshi ifita epakuleta iŋombe ishilima mu cungulo cine cilya no kushipaila kulya kwine.

english: Saul built an altar to the LORD. This was the first altar that he built to the LORD.
translation: Elyo Saulo akuulile ubulambo bwakwa Yawe. E bulambo bwantanshi ubo akuulile Yawe.

english: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”
translation: Saulo atile, “Natuleya tutentemuke tukonke Abafilisiti mu nshita ya bushiku no kubatapa mpaka ulucelo, kabili peshala nelyo umo umumi.” Nabo batile, “Citeni conse icilemoneka icisuma mu menso yenu.” Lelo shimapepo atile, “Natubale twipushe Lesa kuno kwine.”

english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.
translation: Kanshi Saulo aipwishe Lesa ati, “Bushe kuti natentemuka nakonka Abafilisiti? Bushe mulebapeela mu minwe yakwa Israeli?” Lelo Lesa tamwaswike pali bulya bushiku iyoo.

english: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.
translation: Saulo epakulanda ati, “Iseni kuno bonse imwe mwe ntungulushi sha fita pakuti tufwailishe ububifi tucitile mu bushiku bwa lelo.

english: For as the LORD lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.
translation: Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo uupususha imyeo ya bena Israeli, nangufye cileba ukuti umwana wandi umwaume Yonatani, afwile ukufwa.” Lelo tapali umuntu nangu umo uwasoselepo ishiwi.

english: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
translation: Ku mbali shonse isha mupokapoka apo Yonatani alefwaya ukwabukila ukufika ku nkambi ya Bafilisiti kwali ifimabwe ifyacenjemana, cimo icilibwe balecita Basosi elyo na cimbi Sena.

english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”
translation: Saulo elyo aebele bonse abena Israeli ati, “Imwe, mwalaiminina ulubali lumo, elyo ine na Yonatani umwana wandi umwaume twalaiminina ulubali lumbi.” Elyo abantu bamwasuka ati, “Citeni conse icilemoneka icisuma mu menso yenu.”

english: Therefore Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.
translation: Elyo Saulo apepele kuli Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, “Mpeeleni ubwasuko ubusuma.” Kabili Yonatani na Saulo babacitile ulubuko, lelo abantu bali abakaele.

english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
translation: Saulo atile, “Penduleni pakati ka ine elyo no mwana wandi umwaume Yonatani.” Awe cawilile Yonatani.

english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”
translation: Elyo Saulo atile kuli Yonatani, “Njebako ico ucitile.” Elyo Yonatani amwebele ati, “Nacisondakofye utubuci tunono ku mpela ya nkonto yandi, eico kanshi nomba mfwilefye ukufwa.”

english: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”
translation: Saulo atile, “Lesa nankandefye ine wine no kulundapo nga cakuti iwe Yonatani taufwile.”

english: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As the LORD lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.
translation: Elyo abantu batile kuli Saulo, “Bushe Yonatani kuti afwa, uulengele Israeli ukucimfya apakalamba ifi? Awe, ifyo tefyo! Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, takuli mushishi wa ku mutwe wakwe uuleponena panshi, pantu abombele uyu mulimo ilelo mukwafwiwa na Lesa.” Kanshi abantu bapuswishe Yonatani kabili tabamwipeye iyoo.

english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.
translation: Elyo Saulo alekele no ukusupila Abafilisiti, kabili Abafilisiti balekele ubulwi no kubwelelamo ku calo cabo.

english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.
translation: Panuma lintu Saulo ayambile ukuteeka Israeli, alwishishe abalwani bakwe mu mbali shonse, abena Moabu, abena Amoni abena Edomu, ishamfumu sha ku Soba elyo na Bafilisiti. Konsefye uko ayalukile alecimfya.

english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
translation: Alwishishe no bulamba no kucimfya abena Amaleki, elyo afumishe abena Israeli mu minwe ya abo abalebatapa ifyuma.

english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
translation: Abana abaume abakwa Saulo bali ni Yonatani, Ishifi elyo na Malikishua. Ishina lya mwana wakwe umwanakashi umukalamba lyali ni Merabu ne shina lya mwaice lyali ni Mikali.

english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
translation: Icilibwe cimo icacenjemana cabelele ku kapinda ka ku kuso ku ntanshi ya ku Mikimashi, elyo cimbi naco ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ku ntanshi ya ku Gibea.

english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
translation: Ishina lya mukashi wakwa Saulo lyali ni Ainoamu umwana mwanakashi wakwa Aimasi. Ishina lya mukalamba wa fita fyakwe lyali ni Abune umwana mwaume wakwa Neri, uwali nalume wakwa Saulo.

english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
translation: Wishi wakwa Saulo ali ni Kishi. Elyo wishi wakwa Abune ni Neri uwali umwana mwaume wakwa Abieli.

english: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.
translation: Inshiku shonse ishakwa Saulo shali isha bulwi bwabipisha na Bafilisiti. Kanshi ilyo lyonse Saulo amona umwaume uwamaka nganshi nangu uwashipa, alemulunda ku fita fyakwe.

english: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the LORD will work for us, for there is no restraint on the LORD to save by many or by few.”
translation: Elyo Yonatani atile ku mubomfi uwalesenda ifyanso, “Isa tuleya twabukile kwishilya ku nkambi ya balya bantu abashasembululwa. Limbi Yawe kuti atwafwilishako. Takuli icintu nangu cimo icingalesha Yawe ukupususha ku bengi nangu ku banono.”

english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”
translation: Umubomfi walesenda ifyanso fyakwe atile, “Citeni conse icili mu mutima wenu, ine ndi na imwe mu mutima na ku mupashi.”

english: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.
translation: Yonatani atile, “Kanshi isa twabukile kulya pakuti balya bantu batumone.

english: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.
translation: Nga cakuti batweba abati, ‘Pembeleni apo pene mpaka nifwe twise kuli imwe,’ tuli nokwikala pamo pene kabili tatufwile ukuya kuntu bali iyoo.

english: Samuel said to Saul, “The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of the LORD’s words.
translation: Elyo Samwele aebele Saulo ati, “Yawe atumine ine ukwisa kusuba ukuba imfumu pa bantu bakwe abena Israeli. Eico nomba umfwa amashiwi ukufuma kuli Yawe.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Samuel, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Samwele aliti,

english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to the LORD all night.
translation: “Ningumfwa ububi pakubika Saulo pa bufumu, pantu nanjalukila kabili nafilwa no kukonka amafunde yandi.” Samwele epakufulwa nganshi, kabili aikele ubushiku bonse bulya alekuta peshina lyakwa Yawe.

english: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”
translation: Samwele abukile akacelocelo mukuya kumanya Saulo, nomba baya mweba abati, “Saulo naya ku Kameli. Kulya kwine eko aikuulila umwine icakumwibukishishako, elyo pakubwela alepitila ku Giligali.”

english: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by the LORD! I have performed the commandment of the LORD.”
translation: Ilyo Samwele afikile apali Saulo, Saulo amweba ati, “Yawe akupaale! Ine nalicita ifyo Yawe ankonkomeshe.”

english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”
translation: Elyo Samwele amweba ati, “Nga kanshi uko kulila kwa mpaanga kuleumfwika mu matwi yandi, no kulila kwa ŋombe uko ndeumfwa kwatula kwi?”

english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to the LORD your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”
translation: Saulo ayaswike ati, “Ifita efyaletele ukufuma ku bena Amaleki, ebashilepo impaanga pamo ne ŋombe ishawamisha ifyakutuula ilambo kuli Yawe Lesa obe, lelo fimbi fyena fyonse twalionaula umupwilapo.”

english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”
translation: Samwele atile kuli Saulo, “Leka no kulanda! Umfwafye nkwebe ifyo Yawe anjebele pa bushiku bwafumineko.” Saulo atile, “Njeba.”

english: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel;
and the LORD sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
translation: Nomba Yawe alikutumine kukubomba umulimo wakwe ilyo akwebele ati, ‘Kabiye, kapeele abo bantu imbifi abena Amaleki kukonaulwa umupwilapo, uye ubalwishe mpakafye bakalobelele.’

english: Why then didn’t you obey the LORD’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight?”
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi ico wafililwe ukumfwila Yawe? Mulandu nshi waiposelefye pa fitapwa no kucita icabubifi pa menso yakwa Yawe?”

english: The LORD of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ukuti, ‘Ine nkakanda abena Amaleki pafyo bacitile ku bena Israeli ilyo balebalwisha mu nshila pakufuma mu calo ca Egupto.’

english: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed the LORD’s voice, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
translation: Saulo atile kuli Samwele ati, “Kwena ine nalicita ifyo Yawe anjebele, naliya bomba umulimo wakwa Yawe untu ampeele. Naliya peela abena Amaleki kukonaulwa umupwilapo, nasendelekofye Agagi imfumu yabo.

english: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal.”
translation: Ifita efyasendele impaanga ne ŋombe ukufuma pa fitapwa ifyawamisha ifyo ifyali nokonaulwa, pakuti fibe ilambo kuli Yawe Lesa obe ku Giligali.”

english: Samuel said, “Has the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the LORD’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
translation: Lelo Samwele ayaswike ati,

english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected the LORD’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”
translation: Bucisanguka cimo ngo bubifi bwakubuka,

english: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
translation: Elyo Saulo aebele Samwele ati, “Nimbifya pakusuula amafunde yakwa Yawe pamo nefyo wanjebele, pa mulandu wakutiina abantu nokubomfwila.

english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.”
translation: Eico nomba ndekupapata, unjeleleko pa bubifi bwandi kabili nakulomba ukuti tuye bonse iwe na ine pakuti nje mpepe kuli Yawe.”

english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected the LORD’s word, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.”
translation: Lelo Samwele amwebele ati, “Ine teti nje na iwe, elyo pa mulandu wakuti walikaana ishiwi lyakwa Yawe, Yawe nao alikukaana ukuba imfumu pa bena Israeli!”

english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
translation: Ilyo Samwele apilibwike ukuti aleya, Saulo aikete ku mpela ya mwingila wakwe elyo walepuka.

english: Samuel said to him, “The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.
translation: Samwele epakumweba ati, “Iwe ilelo line, Yawe nakupoka ubufumu bwakuteeka Israeli no kupeela kuli umbi umubiyo uukucilile.

english: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”
translation: Lesa uwaba umucindami wakwa Israeli tabepa kabili tapilibula amano iyoo. Pantu te muntunse uwakupilibula amano yakwe iyoo.”

english: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”
translation: Eico nomba kabiye kalwishe abena Amaleki kabili uye peela ifintu fyonse ifyo bakwata kukonaulwa. Tecakwesha ukushapo nangu umo. Wipaye abaume na banakashi, abaice na bana abacili baleonka, iŋombe ne mpaanga, ingamila na bapunda.”

english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship the LORD your God.”
So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped the LORD.
translation: Elyo Samwele epakubweluluka akonka na Saulo, elintu Saulo nao ayapepa kuli Yawe.
