english: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
translation: Elyo Samwele atile, “Muleteni kuno Agagi imfumu ya bena Amaleki.” Agagi aile kuli ena alesubila ukuti nalimo ubutanshi bwa mfwa bwalipita.

english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
translation: Lelo Samwele atile, “Ifyo ulupanga lobe lwalenga abanakashi ukube iŋumba, efyo na noko ali nokuba iŋumba pakati ka banakashi.” Kabili Samwele aipeye Agagi pa cinso cakwa Yawe ku Giligali.

english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
translation: Elyo Samwele aile ku Rama, lelo Saulo ena aya ku ŋanda yakwe ku Gibea umshi wakwe.

english: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. The LORD grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.
translation: Ukufikafye na pa bushiku Samwele afwililepo, tatalile amonanapo na Saulo, lelo Samwele aiketwe no bulanda ubukalamba pali Saulo. Nomba Yawe alilangulwike pakubika Saulo pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli.

english: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.
translation: Saulo aitile abantu no kubapenda mu Telaimu, ifita fya pa makasa amakana imyanda ibili (200,000), elyo ifita ukufuma ku bena Yuda amakana ikumi limo (10,000).

english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.
translation: Saulo aile ku musumba wa bena Amaleki, no kuya babelamina mwishika.

english: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
translation: Elyo Saulo aebele abena Keni ati, “Kabiyeni, fumeni mu bena Amaleki pakuti nimonawila pamo, pantu mwali no luse ku bena Israeli bonse ilyo balefuma mu Egupto.” Kanshi abena Keni epakufuma mu bena Amaleki.

english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.
translation: Elyo Saulo alwishishe abena Amaleki inshila yonse ukufuma ku Hafila ukufika na ku Shuri, na ku kabanga ka ku Egupto.

english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
translation: Lelo Saulo pamo ne fita bashako Agagi, elyo ne mpaanga, iŋombe, inama ishaina elyo no twana twa mpaanga utwaina pamo na conse icalemoneka icisuma. Ifi tabalefwaya kufyonaula iyoo, nomba fyonse ifishali bwino ku menso yabo fyena balipeele kukonaulwafye.

english: The LORD said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”
translation: Yawe aebele Samwele ati, “Bushe ukafika pa nshita nshi ukumfwa ubulanda pa mulandu wakwa Saulo, apo ine nalimukaana ukuba imfumu pali Israeli? Isusha ulusengo lobe amafuta, wambeko ukuya ubulendo. Nalakutuma kuli Yese umwina Betelemu. Ninsalapo umo ne mwine pa bana bakwe abaume ukuba imfumu.”

english: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “The LORD has not chosen these.”
translation: Yese apishishe abana cine lubali ku cinso cakwa Samwele, lelo Samwele atile kuli wena, “Tapali nangu umo uo asalile pali aba.”

english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”
translation: Elyo Samwele aipusha Yese ati, “Bushe abana bobe bonse abaume epo bali pano?” Yese atile, “Kushelefye umwaice pali bonse, nomba ena ali kukucema impaanga.” Samwele atile, “Tuma uwakuya mubuula. Tatwaikale panshi mpaka ese.”

english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. The LORD said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”
translation: Elyo Yese atumine uwakuya mubuula kabili bamuleta mukati. Ali uwakashikila, ne mimonekele iyayemba kabili umusuma mukumoneka. Nomba Yawe atile, “Ima umusube amafuta, pantu euyu wine.”

english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.
translation: Kanshi Samwele abuulile ulusengo lwa mafuta no kumusuba pa cinso ca bamunyina, elyo ukufuma pali ubu bwine bushiku ukuya kuntanshi Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile pali Davidi na maka. Elyo Samwele afumapo aya na ku Rama.

english: Now the LORD’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
translation: Nomba Yawe afumishe Umupashi wakwe pali Saulo, elyo amupeelelapo umupashi ubi uwatendeke ukumucusha.

english: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.
translation: Elyo ababomfi bakwa Saulo bamwebele abati, “Mona umupashi ubi ukufuma kuli Lesa eulekucusha.

english: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”
translation: Eico peelafye icipope ku babomfi aba pano pesano ukuti bafwaye umuntu uwacenjela ukulisha iseese, pakuti aleti ilyo umupashi ubi ukufuma kuli Lesa waisa, ayamba ukulisha, lyena wakulaumfwafye bwino.”

english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”
translation: Kanshi Saulo epakweba ababomfi bakwe ati, “Fwayenipo umo uwacenjela bwino kukulisha iseese mumulete kuli ine.”

english: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the LORD is with him.”
translation: Umubomfi wakwe umo ayasuka ati, “Nimona umwana mwaume wakwa Yese uwa ku Betelemu uwacenjela ukulisha iseese. Untu washipa nganshi kabili mushilika wa nkondo, uwacenjela mukulanda kabili uwayemba mukumoneka. Elyo Yawe aba na ena.”

english: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”
translation: Elyo Saulo atumine inkombe shakwe kuli Yese nokutila, “Tuma kuli ine umwana obe umwaume Davidi, ulya uucema impaanga.”

english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” The LORD said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’
translation: Elyo Samwele ayaswike ati, “Bushe ndi nokuya mu musango nshi? Pantu Saulo nga aumfwa, ali nokunjipaya.” Yawe atile, “Usende umusepela wa ŋombe iyikota no kuyatila, ‘Naisa kukuleka ilambo kuli Yawe.’

english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.
translation: Yese epakubuula punda uo batwikile imikate, kabili abuula ne nyambi umwali umwangashi, no mwana wa mbushi, elyo atuma Davidi umwana wakwe umwaume ukutwalila Saulo.

english: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.
translation: Davidi afikile kuli Saulo no kwamba imilimo yakwe. Saulo alimutemenwe nganshi, kabili amucitile ukuba umo uwa bakusenda ifyanso fyakwe.

english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”
translation: Elyo Saulo atumine ishiwi kuli Yese nokutila, “Suminisha Davidi ukuti ambe ukulabomba imilimo kuno, pantu nacinsekesha ukuba nankwe.”

english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
translation: Ilyo lyonse umupashi ubi uwalefuma kuli Lesa waleisa pali Saulo, Davidi alebuula iseese lyakwe no kulisha, lyena Saulo aleumfwako bwino, ku mutima kwalebwela kabili no mupashi ubi wafuma pali ena.

english: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”
translation: Ukete Yese kwilambo elyo na ine nkakulanga ifyakucita. Mukunjimininako, uli nokusuba amafuta pali uyo nkakusontela.”

english: Samuel did that which the LORD spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”
translation: Awe Samwele acitile ifyo Yawe asosele. Ilyo afikile ku Betelemu, abakalamba ba mu musumba balaitutuminafye pakumukumanya. Bamwipwishe abati, “Bushe waisa mu cibote?”

english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
translation: Samwele nao ayaswike ati, “Ee, naisa mu cibote. Njishile kukutuula ilambo kuli Yawe. Isangululeni mwe bene, kabili tuleyeni bonse mukutuula ilambo.” Elyo asangulwile Yese na bana bakwe abaume no kubasenda ukuya ba nabo kwilambo.

english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.”
translation: Ilyo bafikile, Samwele amwene Eliabu elyo atontonkanya ukutila, “Ca cine umusubwa wakwa Yawe euyu aiminina pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.”
translation: Lelo Yawe aebele Samwele ati, “Tecakwesha ukulolesha imimonekele yakwe nangu icimo, pantu nimukaana. Yawe tamona ifyo umuntunse amona. Umuntunse aloleshafye ifimoneka kunse epela, lelo Yawe amona mukati ka mutima.”

english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”
translation: Kanshi Yese aitile Abinadabu kabili nao amupishishe na ku ntanshi yakwa Samwele. Lelo Samwele atile, “Noyu wine teo Yawe asalile.”

english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”
translation: Yese kabili apisha Shamaya ku ntanshi yakwa Samwele, nalyo line Samwele atile, “Noyu wine nao teo Yawe asalile.”

english: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.
translation: Kabili Abafilisiti baitile ifita fyabo ku bulwi no kufilonganika ku Sokoyo iyali ncende ya ku Yuda. Bacitile inkambi ku Efesi Damimu, pakati ka Sokoyo na Aseka.

english: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”
translation: Elyo Umufilisiti alundilepo nokutila, “Ubushiku bwa lelo ine nasusha ifita fya bena Israeli! Mpeeleni umuntu pakuti tulwe nankwe.”

english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.
translation: Pakumfwa amashiwi ya Mufilisiti, Saulo na Israeli onse balinakwike no kukwata umwenso ukalamba nganshi.

english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.
translation: Nomba Davidi ali umwana mwaume wakwa Yese umwina Efulati uwa ku Betelemu mu calo ca Yuda. Yese ali na bana abaume cine konse konse. Kabili mu nshita yakwa Saulo ali umukote ne myakafye iyingi.

english: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
translation: Abana bakwa Yese batatu abaume abakalamba baile na Saulo ku bulwi. Uwali ibeli ni Eliabu. Uwacibili ni Abinadabu elyo uwacitatu ali ni Shamaya.

english: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.
translation: Davidi ewali umwaice pali bonse. Elyo batatu abali abakalamba ebakonkele Saulo,

english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
translation: lelo Davidi aleya no kubwelelamo ukufuma kuli Saulo mukucema impaanga shakwa wishi ku Betelemu.

english: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
translation: Pa nshiku amakumi yane (40), Umufilisiti aleisa ulucelo ne cungulo no kwiminina apo aleiminina.

english: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;
translation: Nomba Yese atile ku mwana wakwe Davidi, “Endesha utwalile bamunonko ku nkambi nseke ishasalulwa isha cipimo ca efa umo neyi mikate ikumi limo.

english: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”
translation: Elyo utwalileko no mukalamba wabo uwa pa fita ikana limo uyu mukaka uwakosa ikumi limo. Uye mona nefyo bamunonko bali, no kuletako icishibilo cimo ukufuma kuli bena.

english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
translation: Nomba Saulo na bamunonko elyo na bantu bonse abena Israeli bali mwishika lya Elaya, emo balelwisha Abafilisiti.”

english: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
translation: Saulo na bena Israeli balongene pamo no kucita inkambi mwishika lya Elaya, elyo batantama mu mpuka mukukumanya Abafilisiti.

english: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.
translation: Davidi abuukile lucelocelo no kushila umukuni kuli kacema, alongele ifipe no kuya, pamo ngefyo Yese wishi amukonkomeshe. Afikile ku nkambi ilyo ifita fyalefuma ukuya mu ncende shabo isha bulwi, filepunda na mashiwi ya bulwi.

english: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.
translation: Abena Israeli na Bafilisiti batanteme imilongo yabo iyakulwilamo nabalungatana.

english: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
translation: Davidi ashile ifyakulya mu minwe ya walesunga ifyakulya, abutukila ku milongo ya fita fyabulwi no kuya posha bamunyina.

english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.
translation: Ilyo acili alelanda na bamunyina, Goliati, Umufilisiti ilamba ilyafumine ku Gati, afuma mu milongo ya Bafilisiti elyo apunda ngefyo lyonse alecita. Davidi aumfwako ifyo alelanda.

english: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bonse bamwene uyu muntu, balibutwike ukufuma kuntu ali, ninshi nabekatwa umwenso uukalamba nganshi.

english: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and will make his father’s house tax-free in Israel.”
translation: Abena Israeli balalanda abati, “Bushe mwamumona uyu muntu aisa apa? Ico eshile ni mukusebanya Israeli. Imfumu ili nokupeela ifyuma ifingi nganshi ku muntu onse uuli nokumwipaya. Kabili ili nokumupeela no mwana waiko umwanakashi ukuba umukashi wakwe no kuleka ulupwa lwakwa wishi ukukanasonka umusonko mu calo ca Israeli.”

english: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipwishe abaume abaiminine mupepi nankwe ati, “Bushe ni finshi bakacitila umuntu uuli nokwipaya uyu Mufilisiti no kufumya umusebanya pali Israeli? Bushe uyu Mufilisiti uushasembululwa ni nani uwakuti alesebanya ifita fyakwa Lesa uwamweo?”

english: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”
translation: Abantu babwekeshapo ukusosa kuli ena fintu baciba balesosa intanshi, elyo bamweba nokuti, “Ifi efili nokucitika ku muntu onse uuli nokumwipaya.”

english: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”
translation: Ilyo Eliabu umukalamba wakwa Davidi aumfwile alelanda na bantu, afulilwe Davidi nganshi no kumwipusha ati, “Cinshi wishile kuno? Kabili ni nani ushilile ukusunga impaanga ishishafula na kufula mu matololo? Ine nalishiba ukuimona kobe ifyo kwaba nefyo ububi bwa mutima obe bwaba. Iwe icikuletele kuno ni mukutamba ulubuli.”

english: David said, “What have I now done? Is there not a cause?”
translation: Elyo Davidi atile, “Nomba ine cinshi nacita? Ine naciba ndeipushafye.”

english: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
translation: Abafilisiti balongene ku lubali lumbi ulwa lupili elyo abena Israeli nabo balongana ku lubali lubiye, ne shika lyali pakati kabo.

english: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.
translation: Elyo apilibuka ukufuma kuli ena aya ku muntu umbi uwaibelele no kumweba umulandu umo wine. Kabili abantu bamwaswikefye ngefyo bacisosa intanshi.

english: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.
translation: Ilyo amashiwi yalandile Davidi yaumfwikike, baile yafisha ku mfumu Saulo, elyo Saulo atuma abakuya mwita.

english: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”
translation: Davidi epakweba Saulo ati, “Peba umuntu nangu umo uwakuti akwate umwenso pa mulandu wa uyu Mufilisiti, ine ne mubomfi wenu nalaya lwisha uyu Umufilisiti.”

english: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”
translation: Saulo alyaswike ati, “Taufikile pa mushinku wakuti uye mukulungatana noyu Mufilisiti kukulwa nankwe. Iwe ucilifye akalumendo elyo wena muntu wa bulwi ukufumafye ku bulumendo bwakwe.”

english: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,
translation: Lelo Davidi atile kuli Saulo, “Umubomfi obe eusunga umukuni wa mpaanga shakwa wishi. Kanshi ilyo lyonse inkalamo nangu iciswango ca bea caisa ikatapo impaanga imo ukufuma pa mukuni,

english: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.
translation: ndacikonka mpaka naya cikomaula no kupokolola impaanga ukufuma ku kanwa kaciko. Nga cakuti canjimina bwangu bwangu ncikatafye ku mwefu waciko, elyo nacikomaula no kucipaya.

english: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”
translation: Umubomfi obe alipayapo fyonse fibili, inkalamo elyo ne ciswango ca bea. Kanshi noyu wine Mufilisiti uushasembululwa cili nokubafye cimo cine nga fyena, pantu nasebanya ifita fyakwa Lesa uwamweo.

english: David said, “The LORD, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! The LORD will be with you.”
translation: Yawe uwampuswishe ku maka ya nkalamo na ku maka ya cibea, ali nokumpususha ukufuma mu minwe ya uyu Mufilisiti.” Saulo nao atile kuli Davidi, “Kabiye, na Yawe abe na iwe.”

english: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.
translation: Elyo Saulo afwikile Davidi ifyakufwala fyabulwi. Amufwika icisote ca mukuba ku mutwe, elyo amufwika ne cililaya icatikama ku mubili.

english: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.
translation: Davidi akakile ulupanga lwakwa Saulo ku fyakufwala fyakwe elyo aesha ukuti ende, nomba afilwa pantu tafibeleshe. Elyo aeba Saulo ati, “Tekuti nyende muli ifi fintu, pantu nshabelela ukwenda nafyo.” Kanshi Davidi epakufifula.

english: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.
translation: Elyo kwafumine ipaka lya mushilika limo ilyacilile ababiye amaka mu nkambi ya Bafilisiti uwe shina lya Goliati umwina Gati. Ukuya pamulu alepele ukucila pali bamita batatu.

english: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.
translation: Elyo asendele inkonto yakwe mu minwe, asala na mabwe yasano ayatelela ukufuma mu kamana, ayabika mu nyambi yakwe iyabukacema, elyo ne lekeni mu minwe yakwe, alapalamina na ku Mufilisiti.

english: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.
translation: Umufilisiti nao ayamba ukupalamina ukwali Davidi, ninshi uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe ali pa ntanshi yakwe.

english: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.
translation: Ilyo Umufilisiti alolekesha Davidi, amusuula pa mulandu wakuti alifye umulumendo, uwakashikila kabili umusuma mukumoneka.

english: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.
translation: Elyo Umufilisiti aeba Davidi ati, “Bushe ndi mbwa ine pakuti wise kuli ine ne nkonto?” Elyo Umufilisiti alapisha Davidi ku milungu yakwe.

english: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”
translation: Umufilisiti aeba Davidi ati, “Isa kuno, pakuti mpeele umubili obe ku fyuni fya mu lwelele kabili na ku finama fya mu mpanga!”

english: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
translation: Davidi nao aeba Umufilisiti ati, “Iwe waisa kuli ine no lupanga elyo ne fumo, lelo ine naisa kuli iwe mwishina lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wa fita fya nkondo fya bena Israeli, untu iwe wasebanya.

english: Today, the LORD will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
translation: Buno bwine bushiku Yawe alakupeela mu minwe yandi, elyo na ine ndekulimuna no kuputulako umutwe obe. Ilelo line ndepeela ifitumbi fya fita fya Bafilisiti ku fyuni fya mu lwelele na ku finama fya pano sonde, kabili ne calo conse cikeshiba ukuti mwaliba Lesa mu Israeli.

english: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.”
translation: Na bonse abalongene pano balaishiba ukuti te ku lupanga nangu ifumo eko Yawe apusushisha iyoo. Pantu Yawe e mwine wa bulwi kabili alapeela imwe mu minwe yesu.”

english: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
translation: Nomba ilyo Umufilisiti apalamina kukumulwisha, Davidi bwangu bwangu abutukila pa ncende yakulwilapo pakuti akumanye Umufilisiti.

english: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.
translation: Davidi apisha iminwe muli tumba wakwe, abuula ilibwe abika mwilekeni, asukushila Umufilisiti elyo lyamutoba pa mpumi. Ilibwe lyaingila mu mpumi yakwe elyo awa ubukupeme panshi.

english: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
translation: Ali ne cisote ca mukuba ku mutwe elyo afwele ne laya lya mukuba ilyatikama pa cifuba ilyafinine amakilo amakumi mutanda (60).

english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.
translation: Davidi acimfishe Umufilisiti kwilekeni ne libwe, efyo abomfeshe ukumwipailako. Ena Davidi takwete lupanga mu minwe yakwe.

english: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
translation: Davidi abutuka, aya iminina pa Mufilisiti, abuula no lupanga lwa Mufilisiti alusomona mu citubo elo amwipailako. Elyo panuma yakumwipaya, amuputulako umutwe ku lupanga. Kabili ilyo Abafilisiti bamwene ukuti impalume yabo yafwa, bonse bafulumuka ulubilo.

english: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
translation: Elyo ifita fya bena Israeli pamo na bena Yuda baimine no kusowesha apakalamba, elyo bakunkunika Abafilisiti mpaka ku cipata ca ku Gati na ku mpongolo sha ku Ekironi. Abalefwa bonse baleshalafye inshila yonse mu musebo walola ku Sharaimu mpaka na ku Gati elyo na ku Ekironi.

english: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli babwelele ukufuma kukutamfya Abafilisiti, no kwisa tapa inkambi yabo.

english: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
translation: Davidi asendele umutwe wa Mufilisiti no kuutwala ku Yerusalemu, elyo abika ne fyanso fya Mufilisiti mwitenti lyakwe.

english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”
translation: Ilyo Saulo amwene Davidi uko aleya kukukumanya Umufilisiti, atile kuli Abune, umukalamba wa fita, “Abune, bushe mwana mwaume wakwani uyu mulumendo?” Abune ayaswike ati, “Ica cine cine napo uli umumi we mfumu, ine nshishibe.”

english: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”
translation: Imfumu yatile, “Fwailishafye pakuti njishibe umwine wa uyu mwana mwaume.”

english: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
translation: Ilyofye Davidi abwelele ukufuma mukwipaya Umufilisiti, Abune amusendele no kumutwala kuli Saulo ninshi Davidi acili naikata umutwe wa Mufilisiti.

english: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”
translation: Saulo aipusha ati, “Bushe iwe mulumendo niwe mwana wakwa nani?” Davidi nao atile, “Ndi mwana wa mubomfi wenu Yese wa ku Betelemu.”

english: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.
translation: Ku molu yakwe afwele ifyakucingilila imikonso ifya mukuba, napindika ne fumo lya mukuba pa mabeya yakwe.

english: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.
translation: Umusako we fumo lyakwe wali kwati mulando wakwa kapikula wa nsalu, elyo icilimi ce fumo ica cela cafinine mupepi na makilo cine lubali. Kasenda wa nkwela yakwe ewalemutangilila kuntanshi.

english: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
translation: Elyo Goliati aiminine no kulabilikisha ku bena Israeli abali mu milongo yabo aletila, “Cinshi mufumine ukwisa ku bulwi? Bushe ine nshili Mufilisiti elyo na imwe bushe tamuli babomfi bakwa Saulo? Salenipo umuntu umo mwe bene muleke ese kuli ine.

english: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you will be our servants and serve us.”
translation: Nga cakuti alekwata amaka yakulwa na ine no kunjipaya, ninshi ifwe tuli nokuba ababomfi benu. Lelo nga namucimfya no kumwipaya, ninshi nimwe muli nokuba ababomfi besu no kulatubombela.”

english: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
translation: Ilyo Davidi apwile ukulanda na Saulo, umutima wakwa Yonatani wasuntinkene no mutima wakwa Davidi mu mupashi kabili alimutemenwe pamo ngefyo aitemenwe umwine.

english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo umupashi ubi ukufuma kuli Lesa waishile na maka pali Saulo, nao alesesema mu ŋanda yakwe, ninshi Davidi alelisha iseese pamo ngefyo alecita lyonse. Saulo ali ne fumo mu minwe yakwe,

english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.
Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and had departed from Saul.
translation: Kanshi Saulo epakwamba ukutiina Davidi pantu Lesa ali na Davidi, lelo muli Saulo mwena alifuminemo.

english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
translation: Elyo Saulo atalusha Davidi pa cinso cakwe, amupeela ukuba umukalamba wa fita ikana limo (1,000). No kufuma pali iyi nshita, Davidi ewatendeke ukutungulula impuka ya fita konse uko fileya na pakubwela.

english: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
translation: Muli conse ico alecita ali uwashuka mukubomba bwino pantu Yawe ali nankwe.

english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
translation: Ilyo Saulo amwene ukuti Davidi aba uwashuka mu kubomba kwakwe, alimukwatile akatiina.

english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli na bena Yuda bonse balitemenwe Davidi pantu ewaletungulula ifita konse uko fileya na pakubwela.

english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”
translation: Elyo Saulo aebele Davidi ati, “Uyu e mwana wandi umwanakashi umukalamba Merabi, ndi nokumupeela kuli iwe ukuba umukashi obe nga cakuti washangila mukumombela, na mukulwa ubulwi bwakwa Yawe.” Pantu Saulo atontonkenye ati, “Ine nshakemye iminwe yandi pali ena, kano Abafilisiti ebo bakacite ici!”

english: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”
translation: Davidi nao ayaswike Saulo ati, “Bushe ine nine ani, kabili balupwa bandi ni bani nangu umukowa wakwa tata finshi uli mu Israeli, pakuti ine mbe shifyala wa mfumu?”

english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
translation: Lelo ilyo inshita yafikile iyakwa Merabi umwana mwanakashi wakwa Saulo ukuti apeelwe kuli Davidi, bamuufishe kuli Adirieli umwina Meholati.

english: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.
translation: Ukufuma bulya bwine ubushiku, Saulo abuulile Davidi no kulaikala nankwe, talefwaya nokuti abwelelemo ku ŋanda kuli wishi.

english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
translation: Nomba Mika umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo atemenwe Davidi elyo baebele Saulo pali ici, nao alisansamwike nganshi.

english: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”
translation: Atontonkenye ati, “Nkamupeelafye Mika, pakuti eo akabe citeyo kuli ena, epakuti iminwe ya Bafilisiti ikabe pali ena.” Saulo epakweba Davidi ati, “Nomba wakwata ishuko lyacibili ilyakuba lumbwe wandi.”

english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”
translation: Elyo Saulo akonkomeshe ababomfi bakwe ati, “Landeni na Davidi mu nkaama nokutila, ‘Mona, imfumu yaliba iyasansamuka pali iwe, na babomfi bakwe bonse balikutemwa. Kanshi ubefye lumbwe wa mfumu.’”

english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”
translation: Ababomfi babwekeshepo ukulanda amashiwi yamo yene aya mu nkaama kuli Davidi. Davidi nao atile kuli bena, “Bushe muletontonkanya ukuti uyu mulandu unono ukuba shifyala wa mfumu? Ine ndi muntu umupina kabili naishibikwafye panono.”

english: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”
translation: Ilyo ababomfi bakwa Saulo baebele Saulo ifyo Davidi asosele,

english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
translation: Saulo ayaswike ati, “Ebeni Davidi amuti imfumu tailefwaya impango shimbi pa mwana, kanofye inkanda sha pa mpela ya bwaume bwa Bafilisiti umwanda umo (100) pakulandula ku balwani bakwe.” Amapange yakwa Saulo yali yakuti Davidi awile mu minwe ya Bafilisiti.

english: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,
translation: Kanshi ilyo ababomfi bakwa Saulo baebele Davidi ifi fyonse, ali uwasansamuka nganshi pakuba lumbwe wa mfumu. Ilyo inshita apeelwe tailapwa,

english: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.
translation: Davidi na bantu bakwe baimine no kuya ipaya Abafilisiti imyanda ibili (200). Aletele inkanda shabo isha pa mpela ya bwaume no kutuula impendwa yonse ku mfumu pakuti nomba abe lumbwe wa mfumu. Elyo Saulo amupeele umwana wakwe umwanakashi Mika kukuba umukashi wakwe.

english: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
translation: Nomba ilyo Saulo aishibe ukuti Yawe ali na Davidi, nokutila umwana mwanakashi Mika alitemwa Davidi,

english: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.
translation: lyena Saulo alundilepo ukutiina Davidi no kumucita umulwani wakwe mu nshiku shakwe shonse.

english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
translation: Elyo Yonatani apangile icipangano na Davidi pantu alimutemenwe pamo ngefyo aitemenwe umwine.

english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba fita fya Bafilisiti baishile ku bulwi, kabili lyonse ilyo balelwa Davidi alebacimfya ukucila bonse abakalamba ba fita fyakwa Saulo. Elyo ne shina lyakwa Davidi lyaishibikwe nganshi.

english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.
translation: Yonatani afulile umwingila alefwala no kuupela kuli Davidi, abikapo ne laya lyakwe, no lupanga lwakwe, ubuta bwakwe elyo no mushipi wakwe.

english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
translation: Davidi aleya konse uko Saulo alemutuma no kuya bombafye bwino, icakuti Saulo amupeela ne cifulo icikalamba pa fita. Abantu bonse balisekelele nganshi pamo na bacilolo bakwa Saulo.

english: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.
translation: Ilyo abantu balebwela ku mushi panuma Davidi aipeye Umufilisiti, abanakashi baishile ukufuma mu misumba yonse iya bena Israeli mukukumanya imfumu Saulo. Baleimba inyimbo no kucinda, elyo balelisha insombo ne nsango.

english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
translation: Lintu balecinda batendeke ukwimba ulwimbo abati, “Saulo epeye abalwani bakwe amakana na makana, elyo Davidi epeye amakana amakumi na makumi.”

english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”
translation: Saulo epakufulwa nganshi, pa mulandu wakuti aya mashiwi tayamusekeshe nangu panono. Elyo alanda ati, “Davidi bamulumbanya ukwipaya abantu amakana amakumi ayengi, nomba ine banumbanya ukwipaya abantu amakanafye. Bushe ni finshi fingashalako ukucila pakumpoka ubufumu?”

english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.
translation: Kanshi ukufumafye pali ilya nshita ukuya na kuntanshi, Saulo ali uwabufuba pali Davidi.

english: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.
translation: Saulo aebele umwana wakwe umwaume Yonatani elyo na bonse ababomfi ukuti bepaye Davidi. Lelo Yonatani alitemenwe Davidi nganshi.

english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.
translation: Saulo alefwaya ukulasa Davidi ifumo ilyakuti amushintilishe ku cibumba, lelo Davidi amuleuka icakuti Saulo alasafye ifumo lyakwe mu cibumba. Mu bushiku bulya Davidi alipuswike no kubutuka.

english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”
translation: Saulo atumine abaume abakuya mukulinda iŋanda yakwa Davidi pakuti bakamwipaye ulucelo. Lelo Mika umukashi wakwa Davidi amucenjeshako amweba ati, “Nga cakuti taubutwike buno bwine ubushiku mukupususha ubumi bobe, mailo uli nokufwa.”

english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
translation: Elyo Mika aishisha Davidi panshi ukupitila pa windo nao afulumuka pakuti apusuke.

english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.
translation: Elyo Mika abuula icilubi icakupangafye no kucilalika pa busanshi, acifimba ne nsalu, elyo abika no musamino wapikulwa na masako ya mbushi ku mutwe.

english: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”
translation: Ilyo Saulo atumine abantu abakuya ikata Davidi, Mika atile, “Nalwala.”

english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”
translation: Kabili Saulo abwekeshepo ukutuma abantu kukumona Davidi abeba nokuti, “Muye muleta mu busanshi bwakwe pakuti njise mwipaye.”

english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
translation: Lelo ilyo aba bantu baingile mu ŋanda, baya monafye icilubi icakupangafye ecilele pa busanshi, na ku mutwe kulifye amasako ya mbushi.

english: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”
translation: Elyo Saulo atile kuli Mika, “Cinshi wancenjesesha muli uyu musango no kuleka umulwani wandi apusuke?” Mika nao atile kuli ena, “Acinjeba ukuti, ‘Leka ine mfumepo. Cinshi ine ningakwipaila?’”

english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.
translation: Ilyo Davidi afulumwike pakuti apusuke, aile kuli Samwele ku Rama no kusosa fyonse Saulo acitile kuli ena. Elyo ena na Samwele baile ku Naioti eko baya ikala.

english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”
translation: Saulo aishile umfwa ukuti, “Davidi ali mu Naioti ku Rama.”

english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.
translation: Elyo amucenjeshako ati, “Batata ba Saulo balefwaya inshila yakuti bakakwipailemo. Kanshi mailo ulucelo ukaisunge bwino. Ukaye fisama kabili ukekale noko kwine.

english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.
translation: Kanshi Saulo epakutuma abantu abakuya mwikata. Lelo ilyo bamwene bakasesema balesesema, Samwele nao naiminina palya pene nge ntungulushi yabo, umupashi wakwa Lesa waishile pa bantu atumine nabo bene balasesema.

english: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
translation: Ilyo bamwebele Saulo pa fyacitike, elyo atumine abantu bambi nabo bene baya sesema. Saulo talekele, kabili atumine na bambi umuku wacitatu, awe nabo bene baile sesema.

english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
translation: Pakulekelesha, Saulo umwine ailile ku Rama no kufika pa cishima cikalamba ku Seku. Elyo aipusha ati, “Bushe Samwele na Davidi bali kwi?” Umo atile, “Moneni mu Naioti ku Rama.”

english: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
translation: Lelo Umupashi wakwa Lesa waishile pali ena nao wine no kuya alesesema ilyo aleenda mpaka ku Naioti.

english: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
translation: Afumisheko ifyakufwala fyakwe ifyabufumu ayamba no kusesema pa cinso cakwa Samwele. Alele panshi muli kalya kasuba no bushiku bonse. E mulandu wine abantu basosela abati, “Bushe Saulo nao ali uwa muli bakasesema?”

english: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”
translation: Ine ndi nokuya iminina pamo na batata mwibala umo ukafisama. Ndi nokulanda na batata pa mulandu obe kabili nkakweba fyonse ifikacitika.”

english: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;
translation: Yonatani asosele ifisuma palwakwa Davidi kuli Saulo wishi nokutila kuli ena, “We mfumu wicita icabipa ku mubomfi obe Davidi, pantu takwaba ico Davidi alufyanya kuli iwe, elyo ifyo acita fyalikwafwa apakalamba nganshi.

english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”
translation: Tatiinine ukulufya umweo wakwe ilyo aipeye Umufilisiti, na Yawe alengele abena Israeli ukucimfya apakalamba. Na we mwine waliimwene no kuba uwasangalala. Nga nomba cinshi wingacitila icabipa ku muntu wakaele nga Davidi mukumwipaya apabula umulandu?”

english: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.”
translation: Nao Saulo alyumfwile ifyasosele Yonatani. Elyo acitile no mulapo atila, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, Davidi tali nakufwa.”

english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
translation: Kanshi Yonatani epakwita Davidi no kumweba ilyashi lyonse. Amuletele na kuli Saulo. Kabili Davidi alamutumika ngefyo alecita kale.

english: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
translation: Ilyo inkondo nakabili yatampile, Davidi alile no kulwisha Abafilisiti. Abakomaula nganshi pa maka icakuti bamufulumukafye.

english: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.
translation: Elyo umupashi ubi ukufuma kuli Yawe waishile pali Saulo ninshi naikala mu ŋanda yakwe ne fumo lyakwe mu minwe. Nomba ilyo Davidi acili alelisha iseese,

english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
translation: Nomba kwali umuntu umo umwina Sufu uwafumine ku musumba wa Ramataimu Sofimu mu calo ca mpili cakwa Efulemu, uwe shina lya Elikana umwana wakwa Yerohamu, umwana wakwa Eliyu, mwana Tohu, umwana wakwa Sufu, umwina Efulemu.

english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly.
translation: Hana mu kushikitika kwa mutima wakwe, alilile nganshi no kupepa kuli Yawe.

english: She vowed a vow, and said, “LORD of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”
translation: Kabili acitile umulapo nokutila, “We Yawe umwine wa fita, nga cakuti walolesha pa bulanda bwa mubomfi obe no kunjibukisha, kabili ukwabula ukulaba umubomfi obe, wamupeelako umwana umwaume, elyo na ine nkamupeela kuli iwe we Yawe mu nshiku shonse isha mweo wakwe. Kabili mu mutwe wakwe takabeyemo nangu limo.”

english: As she continued praying before the LORD, Eli saw her mouth.
translation: Ilyo Hana atwalilile ukupepa kuli Yawe, shimapepo Eli alelolekesha ku kanwa kakwe.

english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
translation: Hana ninshi nao alepepafye mu mutima wakwe. Kanshi imilomo yakwe eyaletentafye, lelo ishiwi lyena talyaleumfwika. Ecalengele Eli atontonkanye ukuti Hana nakolwa.

english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”
translation: Eico Eli epakumweba ati, “Bushe uli nokwikalilila muli bucakolwa ukufika lilali? Shileka ukukolwa kwa mwangashi obe kupwe.”

english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.
translation: Lelo Hana nao amwasuka ati, “Awe tefyo cili, we mfumu yandi, ine ndi mwanakashi uwaisulamo amafya ayengi nganshi mu mutima wandi. Awe ine nshinwene mwangashi nangufye ubwalwa. Ine nacilalondololafye ifili mu mweo wandi kuli Yawe.

english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”
translation: Mwintunganya ine ne mubomfi wenu ukuba umwanakashi iciwelewele. Ine nacilapepa kuli Yawe pa mulandu wa masakamika ayakalamba nkwete elyo no kushikitika kwa mutima wandi.”

english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”
translation: Eli nao atile, “Kabiye wende umutende, kabili na Lesa wakwa Israeli engakupeela conse ico wipwishe kuli ena.”

english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.
translation: Hana nao ayasuka ati, “Shilekeni umubomfi wenu asange ububile mu menso yenu.” Elyo Hana aile kumwakwe aya lya no kunwa, ne mpumi yakwe yayaluka yabafye iyansansa.

english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
translation: Mu lucelo lwakonkelepo, Elikana no lupwa lwakwe babuuka, no kupepa kuli Yawe, elyo babwelelamo na kumwabo ku Rama. Awe Elikana akumene no mukashi wakwe Hana, asuka Yawe amwibukisha.

english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
translation: Uyu Elikana ali na bakashi babili. Umukashi umo ishina lyakwe ni Hana, elyo umbi nao ali ni Penina. Penina wena alikwete abana lelo Hana wena takwete umwana nangu umo.

english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of the LORD.”
translation: Eico mu kuya kwa nshiku Hana alimite no kukwata umwana umwaume. Uyu mwana Hana amwinike ishina lya Samwele, pantu atile, “Namulombele kuli Yawe.”

english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
translation: Kanshi lyonse uyu muntu Elikana no lupwa lwakwe lonse baleya kukutuula ilambo lya pa mwaka kuli Yawe no kufikilisha umulapo wakwe alapile.

english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and stay there forever.”
translation: Lelo Hana wena taileko. Atile ku mulume wakwe, “Panuma ngo mwana asumuka, ine elyo nkamutwala no kumutuula kuli Yawe. Kabili kulya kwine eko akekalilila lyonse.”

english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may the LORD establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.
translation: Elyo Elikana umulume wakwe atile, “Cisuma cita conse ico uletontonkanya ukuti eciweme. Wikale kuno kwine mpaka ilyo ukasumuna umwana. Kabili Yawe nakabe uwakufikilisha ishiwi lyakwe.” Awe umwanakashi epakushala no kulaonsha umwana mpakafye napo asumukile.

english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.
translation: Ilyo umwana asumwike, aile nankwe ninshi acili akanya. Asenda ne ŋombe iyilume iya myaka itatu, ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwa cipimo ca efa umo ne nyambi ya myangashi, elyo amutwala na ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe ku Shilo.

english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.
translation: Elyo baipaya cilume wa ŋombe, bapalamika no mwana kuli shimapepo Eli.

english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.
translation: Elyo Hana atile kuli Eli, “We mfumu yandi, icine cine apo uli umumi, ine, nine mwanakashi waiminine pano lubali na iwe no kupepa kuli Yawe.

english: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him.
translation: Ine napepele no kulomba uyu mwana, elyo Yawe nao nampeela ico namulombele.

english: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD. As long as he lives he is given to the LORD.” He worshiped the LORD there.
translation: Eico kanshi na ine nomba namupeela kuli Yawe. Mu bumi bwakwe bonse ubwa pano calo namupeela kuli Yawe.” Elyo kulya kwine apepa na kuli Yawe.

english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.
translation: Nomba cila mwaka, uyu muntu Elikana aleya ukufuma ku musumba wakwe kukupepa no kutuula ilambo kuli Yawe umwine wa fita ku Shilo, uko bamwana Eli babili Hofini na Fineasi ebali bashimapepo bakwa Yawe.

english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;
translation: Ilyo lyonse ubushiku bwakupelelapo ilambo bwafika, Elikana alepeela imipusa ya nama ku mukashi wakwe Penina na ku bana bonse abaume na banakashi.

english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.
translation: Lelo Hana ena alemupeela imipusa ibili pantu alimutemenwe nganshi, nangu Yawe amwisalile ubufyashi.

english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti Yawe alimwisalile ubufyashi, umukashi mubiye alemusonsomba no kumukalifya umutima nganshi.

english: So year by year, when she went up to the LORD’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
translation: Ifi efyo alecita cila mwaka. Ilyo lyonse Hana aleya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe kukupepa, umukashi mubiye Penina alemukalifya umutima mpakafye alalila icakuti afilwa no kulya.

english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
translation: Elikana umulume wakwe atile kuli ena, “Hana bushe cinshi ico ulelila? Kabili bushe cinshi ico ukanine ukulalya? Bushe cinshi ico wikalile ubulanda? Bushe ine nshakuwamina ukucila abana baume ikumi limo?”

english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ilyo bapwile ukulya no kunwa mu Shilo, Hana alimine no kuya ituula ku cinso cakwa Yawe. Nomba Eli wena nga shimapepo, aleikala mu cipuna ca bushimapepo mupepi no luceshi lwapa mwinshi we tempele lyakwa Yawe.

english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”
translation: Elyo Davidi afyukile ukufuma mu Naioti ku Rama no kuya kuli Yonatani mukwipusha ukutila, “Bushe cinshi nacita? Nangu mulandu nshi ncitile? Ni finshi nalufyanya kuli bawiso icakuti balefwaya ukunjipaya?”

english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”
translation: Davidi nao amwipwishe ati, “Bushe nani enganjeba nga cakuti bawiso balekwasuka bukali bukali?”

english: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

Jonathan said to David, “By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?
translation: Kabili Yonatani aeba Davidi ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ine mu cine cine nkafumya umupu nga naishiba amatontonkanyo ya batata mu bushiku bukakonkapo! Nga cakuti bacili abakusekelela, bushe nshakatume ishiwi kuli iwe no kuleka wishibe?

english: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti batata bakonenafye mukuti bakucitile ububi, kwena Yawe nakankande ine wine, nangu cikabe icakuti calola ku bubi, nga cakuti nshikwishibishe no kukuleka ukuya umutende. Yawe naleba na iwe pamo ngefyo aleba na batata.

english: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of the LORD while I still live, that I not die;
translation: Lelo unkwatile uluse nga lulya ulwakwa Yawe ilyo ncili umumi, pakuti nshipaiwe.

english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the LORD has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”
translation: Kanshi tecakwesha ukuleka ukutemwa aba mu lupwa lwandi, nangufye Yawe engalofya abalwani bakwa Davidi mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.”

english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “The LORD will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”
translation: Kanshi Yonatani epakupanga icipangano na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi icakuti, “Yawe engeta no kulubulwisha abalwani bakwa Davidi.”

english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
translation: Elyo Yonatani aeba Davidi ukubwekeshapo umulapo wakwe uwa pa citemwiko amukwatile pantu alimutemenwe pamo ngefyo aitemenwe umwine.

english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
translation: Elyo Yonatani aebele Davidi ati, “Mailo ni nshikunkulu ya mweshi upya. Cikeshibikwa ukuti taulipo, pantu pa cipuna cobe tapakabe nangu umo.

english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.
translation: Pa bushiku bukalenga shitatu ilyo ciletwala mu cungulo, ukaye ku ncende uko wafiseme ilyo ubu bwafya bwayambile no kulolela pa mbali ya libwe Eseli.

english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”
translation: Yonatani epakumweba ati, “Awe, ifyo tefyo! Tauli nokwipaiwa! Mona, batata tabacita icintu icikalamba nangu icinono ukwabula ukunjeba. Cinshi ico bengamfishila ici cintu? Awe, tefyo cili!”

english: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.
translation: Na ine nkalasa imifwi itatu kulya kwine ku ncende, kwati nalimo ndi pa candamali.

english: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as the LORD lives.
translation: Elyo ndi nokutuma umulumendo nokumweba ati, ‘Kabiye, kafwaye imifwi.’ Nga cakuti nasosa kuli ena nati, ‘Mona imifwi ili kuli ulubali lobe, itole undetele,’ ninshi kuti waisa, pantu mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, uli nokupusuka. Kabili no busanso ninshi tapali.

english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for the LORD has sent you away.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti nasosa ku mulumendo natila, ‘Mona, imifwi ili ku ntanshi yobe,’ elyo ulingile ukuya, pantu ninshi ni Yawe eukutumine ukuti ufumepo.

english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD is between you and me forever.”
translation: Kabili pa mulandu uo iwe na ine twalanshenyepo, ibukisha ukuti Yawe e kambone pakati kobe na ine pe na pe.”

english: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakuya fisama mwibala. Kabili ilyo inshikunkulu ya mweshi upya yafikile, imfumu yaikele kwitebulo kukulya.

english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
translation: Ukulingana no lutambi imfumu yaikele mu cifulo caiko lwa ku cibumba, ukulungatana na Yonatani, elyo Abune ena aikala mupepi na Saulo, lelo pa cifulo cakwa Davidi tapali nangu umo.

english: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”
translation: Saulo tasosele nangu cimo pali bulya bushiku, pantu aletontonkanya ukuti, “Pali cimo icicitikile Davidi mukumulenga abe uwakowela. Kwena nakowela.”

english: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”
translation: Lelo mu bushiku bwakonkelepo, ubushiku bwacibili mukwamba kwa mweshi, pa cifulo cakwa Davidi nalyo line tapali nangu umo. Elyo Saulo aipusha umwana wakwe umwaume Yonatani ati, “Bushe mulandu nshi umwana wakwa Yese teshile ku malila, nangufye bushiku bwapitile na lelo line tamoneke?”

english: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.
translation: Yonatani ayasuka ati, “Davidi mu cinefye alipwishe kuli ine ukumupeelako ulusa lwakuya ku Betelemu.

english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”
translation: Atile, ‘Uleke ndeya, pantu ulupwa lwesu luletuula ilambo mu musumba wesu. Kanshi munyinane nanjita ukuti nsangweko. Nga cakuti ndi uwatemwikwa ku menso yobe, unsuminisheko nkaye mona bamunyinane.’ Uyu e mulandu ashishile kwitebulo lya mfumu.”

english: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”
translation: Lelo Davidi alapile umulapo nokutila, “Bawiso balishibafye bwino ifyo nasanga ububile mu menso yobe, eico abene batilafye, ‘Yonatani tali nakwishiba ici cintu epali aba no bulanda.’ Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, ngefyo na iwe uli uwamweo, kulifye ulutampulo lumo pakati ka ine elyo ne mfwa.”

english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
translation: Saulo epakufulilwa Yonatani apakalamba nokutila kuli wena, “We mwana wa mpulumushi ya mwanakashi! Bushe nshaishiba ukuti iwe waba ku lubali lwakwa mwana Yese kukuiletela insoni elyo no kuletela insoni kuli banoko abakufyele?

english: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”
translation: Iwe, pa nshita yonse iyo mwana Yese ali nokuba umumi pano isonde, tawakamone mutende nangu ukuba pa bufumu. Nomba tuma abakuya mwita ese kuli ine, pantu afwilefye ukwipaiwa!”

english: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
translation: Elyo Yonatani aipusha wishi ati, “Bushe cinshi ico ali nokufwila? Ni cinshi ico acitile?”

english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
translation: Elyo Saulo asumbula ifumo lyakwe pakuti amulase Yonatani. Neci ecalengele Yonatani ukuti eshibe ati caliba mapange yakwa wishi ukufwaya ukwipaya Davidi.

english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
translation: Awe Yonatani aima afuma kwitebulo nafulwa nganshi. Na pali bulya bushiku bwacibili ubwa mweshi talilepo akantu nelyo kamo, pantu ali uwaikatwa no bulanda pafyo wishi acitile ifyansoni kuli Davidi.

english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
translation: Ulucelo, ubushiku bwakonkelepo, Yonatani aya ku mabala mukukumanya Davidi pamo ngefyo baumfwene. Ali na kalumendo kakumutumika.

english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
translation: Elyo atile ku kalumendo, “Butuka no kuya fwaya imifwi mposele.” Ilyo akalumendo kacili kalebutuka, Yonatani aposa umufwi ku ntanshi yakwe.

english: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”
translation: Ilyo akalumendo kafikile pa ncende apo umufwi wakwa Yonatani wali, Yonatani amubilikisha ati, “Bushe te mufwi uyo uuli ku ntanshi yobe?”

english: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
translation: Elyo abilikisha na maka ati, “Endesha! Kabiye bwangu bwangu! Wiiminina iyoo!” Awe akalumendo katola umufwi no kubwelela kuli shikulu wakwe.

english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
translation: Akalumendo takaishibepo nangu cimo pali ifi, kanofye Yonatani na Davidi ebaishibe.

english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
translation: Yonatani atile kuli Davidi, “Ico conse ico ulefwaya ukukucitila, ine ndi nokukucitila.”

english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
translation: Elyo Yonatani apeela ifyanso fyakwe ku kalumendo nokutila, “Kabiye, fisende fyonse no kubwelela ku musumba.”

english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.
translation: Panuma ninshi akalumendo kaya, Davidi aima ukufuma umo abeleme mwilibwe lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo no kukontamina panshi ku cinso cakwa Yonatani imiku itatu, nalosha impumi yakwe panshi. Elyo bonse balatomoshanya no kulalila ifilamba. Lelo Davidi ewacililemo ukulila nganshi.

english: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘The LORD is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
translation: Yonatani aeba Davidi ati, “Kabiye umutende, pantu twalilapa umulapo muli bucibusa bwesu mwishina lyakwa Yawe nokutila, ‘Yawe e kambone pa kati kobe elyo na ine, kabili pa kati ka lupwa lobe elyo no lupwa lwandi pe na pe.’” Awe Davidi aima aya, Yonatani nao abwelelamo ku musumba.

english: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.
translation: Davidi epakweba Yonatani ati, “Mona, mailo bushiku ubupya ubwa mweshi ubwakusefya, kabili ine mfwile ukuya ikala no kulila pamo ne mfumu. Lelo undeke ndeya no kufisama mwibala mpaka icungulo mu bushiku bukakonkapo.

english: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’
translation: Bawiso nga bamona nshilipo, mukabebe amuti, ‘Davidi alipoka ulusa ulwakuti aye bwangu ku Betelemu, umusumba wakwe, pantu ekukabela ukupeelela umutuulo we lambo lya pa mwaka ilya mukowa wabo.’

english: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.
translation: Nga cakuti batila, ‘Cisuma,’ lyena ninshi umubomfi obe apusuka. Lelo nga cakuti baisa fulwa, ukeshibe bwino ukuti baba na mapange ayankucitila ububi.

english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”
translation: Eico iwe langafye uluse ku mubomfi obe, pantu niwe wandetele mu cipangano cakwa Yawe kuli iwe. Kanshi nga cakuti ndi no mulandu, awe we mwine unjipaye! Cinshi ico wingamposela mu minwe ya bawiso?”

english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”
translation: Yonatani atile, “Awe iyoo! Nga cakuti ine nalishiba ukuti batata balikosapo ukufwaya ukukwipaya bushe nga nshakweba?”

english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”
translation: Elyo Davidi aile ku Nobu, kuli shimapepo Aimeleki. Aimeleki alatutuma ilyo akumanya Davidi no kumwipusha ati, “Nga cinshi waishila weka? Cinshi ico taubelelepo no muntu umo uwakuba na iwe?”

english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
translation: Mu bushiku bwine bulya, Davidi afulumukile kuli Akishi imfumu ya ku Gati ukufuma kuli Saulo.

english: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”
translation: Lelo ababomfi bakwa Akishi bamweba abati, “Bushe teuyu wine Davidi imfumu ya calo? Bushe teuyu uo bembapo mu kucinda kwabo abati, ‘Saulo aipaya abalwani bakwe amakana na makana, elyo Davidi ena aipaya amakana amakumi na makumi?’”

english: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
translation: Davidi abikile aya mashiwi mu mutima no kuba no mwenso kuli Akishi imfumu ya ku Gati.

english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.
translation: Kanshi Davidi aicita kwati untu wafulungana pa cinso cabo. Elyo ne nshita yonse iyo aikele nabo, aicitile ukuba ngo wapena, aleipamaula ku fiibi fya pa mpongolo no kuponya ululenda ku myefu yakwe.

english: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?
translation: Elyo Akishi atile ku babomfi bakwe, “Moneni uyu umuntu untu wapena! Wanshi mwaleta kuli ine?

english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
translation: Bushe ine nshikwete abaume abapena pakuti mundetele noyu muntu kuno alepena na ku ntanshi yandi? Bushe uyu muntu ali nokwisa mu ŋanda yandi?”

english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’
translation: Davidi atile kuli Aimeleki shimapepo, “Kateeka alimpeela umulimo no kutila kuli ine, ‘Takuli umuntu nangu umo uulingile ukwishiba icintu nelyo cimo pa mulandu wa mulimo obe pamo ne fipope fyobe.’ Lelo abantu bandi bena, mbebele ukuti tukumane nabo pa ncende imo.

english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”
translation: Mateo 12:3-4

english: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”
translation: Nomba shimapepo ayasuka Davidi ati, “Kwena nshikwete umukate uwafyefye mupepi na ine. Lelo umukate ulipofye pano untu wasangululwa. Nomba te mulandu, icikulufye abaume uli nabo babe abantu abaitalusha abene ukufuma ku banakashi.”

english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”
translation: Davidi ayasuka ati, “Cine cine abanakashi balaba abatalushiwa kuli ifwe, ngefyo ciba pe lyonse ilyo mba pa lwendo. Imibili ya baume yena yamushilo nangufye ilyo tuli pa milimo iyishili yamushilo. Pali bufi ilelo tanacicilapo ukuba ifyamushilo!”

english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before the LORD, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
translation: Kanshi shimapepo epakumupeela umukate uwasanguluka, pantu tapali umukate wakulya kanofye umukate wa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, uyo uufumishiwapofye ilyo kwaba ukupyanikishapo umukate uwakaba mu bushiku baleufumyapo.

english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.
translation: Nomba umubomfi wakwa Saulo umo alisangilwepo pali ubu bushiku uwalindikwe kuli Yawe. Ishina lyakwe ni Doegi umwina Edomu, umukalamba wa pa bacemi bakwa Saulo.

english: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipusha Aimeleki ati, “Bushe taukwetepo ifumo nangu ulupanga pano? Pantu ine nshishile no lupanga lwandi nangufye icanso cimbi pantu umulimo wakwa kateeka wacimpamfya.”

english: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”
translation: Shimapepo ayasuka ati, “Pano palifye ulupanga lwakwa Goliati Umufilisiti, ulya waipaile mwishika lya Elaya, nalupombwa bwino mu nsalu. Luli ku numa ya cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila wakwa shimapepo ica efodi. Nga cakuti ulelufwaya, senda.” Nao Davidi asosa ati, “Apo takuli lumbi ululi nga ulu, mpeelafye ulo lwine.”

english: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
translation: Elyo Davidi afumine ku Gati no kufyukila ku lucengo lwa Adulamu. Ilyo bamunyina pamo na ba mu ŋanda ya bantu bonse bakwa wishi baumfwile pali ifi fintu, balimukonkele kulya kwine.

english: He inquired of the LORD for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”
translation: Aimeleki acimwipushishako kuli Yawe. Elyo amupeele ne mpao no lupanga lwakwa Goliati Umufilisiti.”

english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu yatuma uwakwita shimapepo Aimeleki mwana Ahitubu elyo no lupwa lwakwa wishi lonse, bashimapepo abali mu Nobu, elyo bonse baisa ukwali mfumu.

english: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”
translation: Saulo abeba ati, “Umfwa nomba we mwana wakwa Ahitubu.” Nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi shikulu.”

english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
translation: Saulo atile kuli wena, “Bushe cinshi ico unsangukile, iwe elyo na mwana Yese, wamupeela umukate elyo no lupanga no kumwipushishako kuli Lesa pakuti anjimine no kundalilila, pamo ngefyo cili mu bushiku bwa lelo?”

english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?
translation: Aimeleki ayaswike imfumu ati, “Nani uwa pa babomfi bobe bonse uuli uwacishinka kwati ni Davidi lumbwe wa mfumu umukalamba wa fita ifikulinda, kabili uwacindikwa nganshi mu ŋanda yobe?

english: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”
translation: Bushe bulya bushiku ebwali ubwantanshi namwipushisheko kuli Lesa? Cacinefye teifyo iyoo! Mwileka imfumu ipeele umulandu umubomfi waiko, nangu umo uwa mu lupwa lwakwa wishi, pantu umubomfi wenu teshibepo nelyo cimo pali ifi fyonse.”

english: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”
translation: Lelo imfumu yatile, “Icine cinefye uli nokufwa, Aimeleki iwe, no lupwa lonse ulwakwa wiso.”

english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaeba abalinshi abali ku lubali lwaiko aiti, “Pilibukeni no kwipaya bashimapepo bakwa Yawe, pantu nabo bene bali ku lubali lwakwa Davidi. Balishibe ati ali nokumfulumuka, lelo tabanjebeleko.” Lelo bacilolo ba mfumu tabafwaile ukwimya amaboko yabo mukwipaya bashimapepo bakwa Yawe.

english: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaebele Doegi aiti, “Iwe pilibuka nokwipaya bashimapepo.” Kanshi Doegi umwina Edomu epakupilibuka no kubepaya bonse. Muli bulya bushiku aipeye bashimapepo amakumi cine konse konse na basano (85) abafwele ifyakufwala fya pa mulu wa mwingila ifyabuuta ubusaka ifya efodi.

english: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
translation: Kabili mu musumba wa Nobu umwaleikala bashimapepo, aya ipayamo abaume na banakashi, abaice elyo na bana, pamo pene ne ŋombe ishabamo, bapunda elyo ne mpaanga.

english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.
translation: Bonse abantu abakwete ubulanda, nangu abakwete nkongole nangu abali ne cikonko, baya longana apo ali. Elyo nao aba intungulushi yabo. Nalimo bali imyanda ine (400) abali nankwe.

english: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
translation: Lelo Abiyata umwana wakwa Aimeleki mwana Ahitubu, abutuka no kufulumukila ukwali Davidi.

english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.
translation: Abiyata aya eba Davidi ukuti Saulo naipaya bashimapepo bakwa Yawe.

english: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.
