translation: Elyo Davidi atile kuli Abiyata, “Bulya bushiku ilyo Doegi umwina Edomu ali kulya, nalishibefye bwino ukuti ali nokweba Saulo. Nine wine nalenga ne mfwa sha lupwa lonse ulwakwa wiso.

english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”
translation: Ikala na ine wine. Umuntu uyo uulefwaya ubumi bobe ninshi alefwaya no bumi bwandi bwine. Uli nokubafye uwasungwa bwino mukwikala na ine.”

english: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”
translation: Ukufuma kulya Davidi aile ku musumba wa ku Misipa mu Moabu no kuya eba imfumu ya ku Moabu ati, “Bushe teti muleke batata na bamayo bese no kwikala na imwe mpaka nkeshibe ifyo Lesa afwaya ukuncitila?”

english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
translation: Kanshi epakubasha ku mfumu ya mu Moabu, eko bashala baleikala pa nshiku shonse Davidi ali mwilinga.

english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.
translation: Lelo kasesema Gadi atile kuli Davidi, “Wiyikala mwilinga, kabiyefye mu calo cakwa Yuda.” Elyo Davidi afuma aya na ku mutengo wa Hereti.

english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.
translation: Nomba Saulo alyumfwile ukuti Davidi na bantu bakwe nababasanga. Kabili Saulo ninshi ali ne fumo mu minwe yakwe naikala mwisamba lya cimuti ca Tamarisiki pa lupili lwa Gibea, na bacilolo bakwe bonse nabeminina ukumushinguluka.

english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?
translation: Elyo Saulo aeba bacilolo bakwe ati, “Umfweni, mwe baume bakwa Benjamini! Bushe mwana Yese akamupeela imwe bonse amabala elyo ne myangashi? Bushe bonse imwe akamucita ukuba abakalamba ba fita pa makana elyo na pa myanda?

english: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
translation: Bushe ifi fine e fintu filengele imwe mumfwane mukunsangukila? Pantu takwaba nangu umo uwanjeba ilyo umwana wandi acita icipangano no mwana wakwa Yese. Pali imwe, tapali nangu umo uwasakamene ukunjeba ati umwana wandi eutunkile umubomfi wandi ukundalilila, ngefyo cili mu bushiku bwa lelo.”

english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
translation: Elyo Doegi umwina Edomu, uwaiminine pamo na bacilolo bakwa Saulo atile, “Nacimona umwana wakwa Yese aisa kuli Aimeleki mwana Ahitubu ku Nobu.

english: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”
translation: Nomba baebele Davidi ukuti, “Mona, Abafilisiti balelwisha Keila kabili baletapa ne filyo fya pa mansa batwilapo.”

english: Then David said, “O LORD, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.
translation: Elyo Davidi atile, “We Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, umubomfi obe naumfwa mu cine cinefye ifyo Saulo alefwaya ukwisa ku Keila kukonaula umusumba pa mulandu wandi.

english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? LORD, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” The LORD said, “He will come down.”
translation: Bushe abekashi ba mu Keila bakampeela mu minwe yakwe? Bushe Saulo ali nokwisa kuno ukulingana nefyo umubomfi obe omfwile? Mwe Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ebeni umubomfi wenu eshibe.” Elyo Yawe atile, “Ee ali nokwisa.”

english: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” The LORD said, “They will deliver you up.”
translation: Kabili Davidi aipusha ati, “Bushe abantu ba mu Keila bakampeela mu minwe yakwa Saulo pamo na bantu bandi?” Elyo Yawe atile, “Bali nokumupeela mu minwe yabo.”

english: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.
translation: Elyo Davidi na bantu bakwe ukulingana ne mpendwa imyanda mutanda (600), bafumine ku Keila no kwamba ukwenda ukufuma pa cifulo ne cifulo. Ilyo Saulo bamwebele ukuti Davidi nafyuka ukufuma ku Keila, nao taileko kulya ku Keila.

english: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.
translation: Davidi aikele mu ncengo sha mu matololo, elyo na mu matololo ya mu mpili sha Sifu. Kanshi cila bushiku Saulo alefwaya fwayafye Davidi, lelo Lesa tamupeele ku minwe yakwe iyoo.

english: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.
translation: Davidi ilyo ali ku matololo ya Sifu, aumfwile ukuti Saulo naisa mukufwaya ukumwipaya.

english: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
translation: Elyo Yonatani mwana Saulo aya kuli Davidi ku Horeshi no kumukoselesha pakuti abe uwashipa muli Lesa.

english: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”
translation: Amwebele ati, “Witiina. Tata Saulo takakwipaye iyoo. Ala niwe uli nokuba imfumu ya bena Israeli elyo na ine nkaba inkonkani yobe. Na tata wine Saulo alishibafye bwino pali ici.”

english: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.
translation: Bonse babili bacitile icipangano pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Elyo Yonatani aile kumwakwe, lelo Davidi wena ashele ku Horeshi.

english: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?
translation: Elyo abena Sifu baile kuli Saulo ku Gibea no kuya mweba ati, “Bushe te Davidi uufiseme mu ncengo ku Horeshi, pa lupili lwa Hakila, ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ka Yeshimoni?

english: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” The LORD said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”
translation: Eico Davidi aipwishe kuli Yawe nokutila, “Bushe kuti naya no kulwisha aba Bafilisiti?” Yawe ayasuka ati, “Kabiye, kalwishe Abafilisiti no kupususha Keila.”

english: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”
translation: Nomba we mfumu nga wasanga cakusekesha kuti waisa, na ifwe tuleisa mona ukuti waba mulimo wesu uwakumupeela kuli imwe.”

english: Saul said, “You are blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.
translation: Elyo Saulo ayasuka ati, “Yawe amupaale pakunsakamana ine.

english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.
translation: Kabiyeni no kuyashininkisha bwino. Muye ishiba uko Davidi lyonse aya kabili ni nani uwamumonapo kulya kwine. Balinjeba ukuti Davidi muntu uwacenjela nganshi.

english: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
translation: Muye fwailisha bwino incende shonse isho abomfya elyo mukabweluluke ne cishinka icine cine kuli ine. Lyena tuli nokwisa ya na imwe. Nga cakuti ali mu ncende ine iyi, ninshi ndi nokufwailisha monsefye mu mikowa yakwa Yuda.”

english: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
translation: Kanshi epakuya, batangilila Saulo ku Sifu. Nomba Davidi na bantu bakwe bali mu matololo ya Maoni mu Araba ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ka Yeshimoni.

english: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
translation: Saulo na bantu bakwe bayambile ukufwayafwaya. Kabili ilyo Davidi aumfwile pali ici, aile ingila mu cilibwe no kwikala mu matololo ya Maoni. Nao Saulo ilyo aumfwile ifi, aile ku matololo ya Maoni mukufwaya Davidi.

english: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.
translation: Saulo alefwaila ku lubali lumbi ulwa lupili, elyo Davidi nao na bantu bakwe ulubali lubiye. Davidi aleendesha ukuti Saulo emumona, lelo Saulo ne fita fyakwe balepalamina mukuti bekate Davidi na bantu bakwe.

english: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”
translation: Nomba pali ilya ine nshita kwaishile inkombe imo kuli Saulo nokutila, “Iseni bwangu! Abafilisiti balapokolola icalo.”

english: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.
translation: Elyo Saulo alekele ukufwaya Davidi no kubwelulukako aya mukukumanya Abafilisiti. Uyu e mulandu wine betila icifulo ici ukuti ni Sela Hamalekoti .

english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
translation: Lelo abantu bakwa Davidi batile kuli ena, “Moneni ifwe muno mu Yuda tulifye aba mwenso. Bushe tacili nokucililakofye nga cakuti twaile ku Keila no kuyalolenkana ne fita fya Bafilisiti!”

english: Then David inquired of the LORD yet again. The LORD answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
translation: Kabili Davidi abwekeshapo ukwipusha Yawe, na Yawe ayasuka ati, “Kabiye utentemukile ku Keila, pantu ndepeela Abafilisiti mu minwe yobe.”

english: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na bantu bakwe epakuya ku Keila. Balalwisha Abafilisiti no kusenda ifitekwa fyabo. Davidi acimfya Abafilisiti apakalamba no kupususha abena Keila.

english: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.
translation: Nomba ilyo Abiyata mwana Aimeleki afulumukile kuli Davidi ku Keila nasenda ne cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila wa bushimapepo ica efodi.

english: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”
translation: Saulo alyumfwile ukuti Davidi ali ku Keila, elyo atile, “Lesa namupeela mu minwe yandi, pantu naifunga umwine pakwingila mu musumba wa mpongolo ne fyakwisalila.”

english: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
translation: Elyo Saulo aita fyonse ifita fyakwe ku bulwi, kukutentemukila ku Keila kukushinga Davidi na bantu bakwe.

english: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”
translation: Ilyo Davidi aishibe ukuti Saulo alemupangila, aebele Abiyata shimapepo ati, “Leta kuno icakufwala ca mwingila ica efodi.”

english: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
translation: Ilyo Saulo abwelele ukufuma mukukunkunika Abafilisiti, bamwebele abati, “Davidi ali mu matololo ya Eni Gedi.”

english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the LORD’s anointed.’
translation: Buno bushiku nauimwena we mwine ifyo Yawe akulubwilile mu maboko yandi mu lucengo. Bamo abantu bacinjeba abati, ‘Mwipayefye,’ lelo ine nakaana ukuti nciteco, nakulekafye. Nacitila, ‘Ine nshakemye ukuboko kwandi pali shikulu, pantu musubwa wakwa Yawe.’

english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.
May the LORD judge between me and you, and may the LORD avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
translation: Shi Yawe nabe kapingula pakati kobe na ine. Kabili Yawe nalandule ububifi bonse wacita kuli ine, lelo amaboko yandi tayakatale ayakwikatamo.

english: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.
translation: Pamo ngefyo insoselo shakale shitila, ‘Ku babifi, kufuma ububifi,’ kanshi amaboko yandi tayakakwikatemo iyoo.

english: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
translation: Bushe ni kukulwisha nani imfumu ya Israeli yafumina? Nani uo mulekonka umusango uyu? Bushe ni mbwa iyafwa? Bushe lupantila?

english: May the LORD therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
translation: Lekeni Yawe umwine eo abe kapingula pakati ka iwe na ine. Umwine eo akashininkishe pa mulandu wandi no kuncitila umulinganya wakumfumya mu minwe yobe.”

english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
translation: Ilyo Davidi apwile ukusosa ifi, Saulo aipwishe ati, “Bushe ilyo lishiwi lyobe Davidi we mwana wandi?” Elyo Saulo apumunapo umusowa uukalamba.

english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
translation: Saulo aeba Davidi ati, “Iwe uli mololoke ukuncila. Pantu iwe nauncitila icisuma nomba ine nkucitilafye ifyabipa.

english: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when the LORD had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.
translation: Mona wanjeba ifisuma ifyo wancitila nombaline. Yawe ewacimpeela mu maboko yobe, lelo iwe tawacinjipaya.

english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may the LORD reward you good for that which you have done to me today.
translation: Ilyo lyonse umuntu asanga umulwani wakwe, bushe alaleka aya ukwabula ukucenekwa? Shi Yawe engakulambula bwino pa busuma uncitile pa bushiku ubwa lelo.

english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.
translation: Saulo epakusenda abaume amakana yatatu (3,000) abasalilwe ukufuma mu Israeli yonse no kuya mukufwaya ukwali Davidi na bantu bakwe mupepi na Mabwe ya ku Mbushi sha Mpanga.

english: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.
Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”
translation: Nomba lapa kuli ine muli Yawe ukuti tawakonaule abana bandi nangu ukulofya ishina lyandi ukufuma mu lupwa lwakwa tata.”

english: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
translation: Davidi epakucita umulapo kuli Saulo. Elyo Saulo abwelelamo kumwabo, lelo Davidi wena pamo na bantu bakwe baninike ukuya kwilinga.

english: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.
translation: Saulo afikile pa ncende apali macinka ya mpaanga ayali mu mbali ya nshila, asanga ulucengo, elyo Saulo aingilamo mukuya yafwilisha. Kanshi ninshi Davidi na bantu bakwe bali muli ulu lwine lucengo kukati nankati.

english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.
translation: Abantu bakwa Davidi bamweba abati, “Ala buno e bushiku Yawe alandile ati, ‘Nkalubwila umulwani obe mu maboko yobe no kumucita ico ulefwaya.’” Elyo Davidi aongoloka ukwabula ukuti abantu beshibe, aya putulako icisempe ca mwingila wakwa Saulo.

english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
translation: Davidi panuma yakucita ifi, alalanguluka ico aputwilile icisempe ca mwingila wakwa Saulo.

english: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”
translation: Atile ku bantu bakwe, “Yawe naleshe ukuti ine mbe uwakucita icintu ici ku mfumu yandi, kabili umusubwa wakwa Yawe, nangu ukuti njimye ukuboko kwandi pali ena. Pantu untu wasubwa wakwa Yawe.”

english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
translation: Ilyo apwa ukulanda aya mashiwi, Davidi akalipila na bantu bakwe ukuti becita icabipa kuli Saulo. Elyo Saulo afuma mu lucengo aya noko aleya.

english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
translation: Panuma Davidi nao epakufuma mu lucengo no kubilikisha Saulo ati, “We mfumu kanabesa ee!” Ilyo Saulo acebukila kunuma, Davidi akontamina mpumi yakwe panshi amutotela.

english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?
translation: Davidi atile kuli Saulo, “Bushe cinshi umfwila ku bantu abakweba ukuti, ‘Davidi afwaya ukukucitapo icibi?’

english: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
translation: Nomba ilyo Samwele afwile, abena Israeli bonse balongene mukumuloosha. Kabili bamushiikile ku ŋanda yakwe mu Rama. Elyo Davidi aimine atentemukila ku matololo ya Maoni .

english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.
translation: Nabali pakwasuka ababomfi bakwa Davidi atile ati, “Nga uyu wine Davidi nani? Nga uyu wine mwana Yese nani? Muli shino inshiku, kuli ababomfi abengi abalefyuka ukufuma kuli bashikulu wabo.

english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi ningalasendela umukate wandi pamo na menshi elyo ne nama njipeye ishakupeela bakabeya wandi, no kupeela ku bantu abo nshishibe uko bafumine?”

english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.
translation: Elyo abantu bakwa Davidi bapilibwike no kubwelelamo. Ilyo bafikile basosa yonse amashiwi kuli Davidi.

english: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.
translation: Kabili Davidi nao atila ku bantu bakwe, “Pikileni cila muntu ulupanga lwakwe!” Kanshi nabo epakupikila impanga shabo, na Davidi apikila ulupanga lwakwe. Nalimo ukulingana ne myanda ine (400) iya bantu ebaile na Davidi, elyo imyanda ibili (200) bashele nga bakalinda wa fipe.

english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.
translation: Nomba umubomfi umo uwakwa Nabali aebele Abigaili muka Nabali ati, “Davidi acituma inkombe ukufuma ku matololo kukuleta umutende kuli shikulu, lelo ena acisa shitukaulafye no kushotokela.

english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.
translation: Nomba aba bantu bena bali abasuma nganshi kuli ifwe. Tabatalile abatucushapo nelyo limo pa nshita yonse twaleya mu mabala mupepi na bena, elyo takwali ne cintu nelyo cimo icalubile.

english: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
translation: Bali e linga lyesu ubushiku na kasuba ilyo lyonse twalecema impaanga mupepi nabo.

english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”
translation: Nomba tontonkanyenipo bwino no kumona ifyo mwingacitapo, pantu icinkunka cili pali shikulu elyo ne ŋanda yakwe yonse. Shikulu aba uwaotoka uo nangu umo teti alande nankwe.”

english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.
translation: Awe Abigaili taposele inshita. Abuulile imikate imyanda ibili (200), inyambi sha mwangashi shibili, impaanga shisano ishapekanishiwa, iŋanu ishasalulwa amatepe yasano, ifisansangu fya myangashi iyauma umwanda umo (100) ne myanda ibili (200) iya cikati ca makunyu ayakamwa, elyo afilonga pali bapunda.

english: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.
translation: Elyo aeba ababomfi bakwe ati, “Tangileni na ine nalamukonka panuma.” Lelo taebele umulume Nabali.

english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
translation: Umuntu umo uwa mu Maoni, uwakwete umulimo wa bunonshi kulya ku Kameli, ali uwanonka nganshi. Akwete imbushi ikana limo (1,000) elyo impaanga nasho amakana yatatu (3,000) isho alebeya mu Kameli.

english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.
translation: Ilyo acili nanina pali punda wakwe aletentemuka ulupili, elyo amona Davidi na bantu bakwe nabo baletentemuka ku lubali lubiye. Elyo Abigaili abakumanya.

english: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.
translation: Pali iyi nshita, ninshi Davidi nasosa ati, “Kanshi kwali kuicushafye ku mulimo nabombele uwakusungila icuma ca uyu muntu mu matololo, elyo tapaba nangu cimo icipe cakwe icalubapo. Nomba ewambweshesha ububi pa busuma.

english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”
translation: Nalapa ukuti Lesa nakacitile Davidi icili conse, nga cakuti mailo akacelo kukashala umuntu umwaume nangu umo ukufuma mu lupwa lwakwe nangufye uwa mu lupwa lwa babomfi bakwe.”

english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.
translation: Ilyo Abigaili amwene Davidi, bwangu bwangu aika pali punda wakwe no kukontamina panshi ku cinso cakwa Davidi.

english: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.
translation: Awa pa makasa yakwe elyo atile, “We mfumu yandi, shilekafye ububi bube pali ine wine. Napapata lekafye umubomfi obe alande kuli iwe. Kutika kufyo umubomfi obe ali nokusosa.

english: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.
translation: Ala we mfumu yandi wiposa amano kuli ilya mbifi ya muntu Nabali. Ulya muntu abafye ngefyo ishina lyakwe lipilibula. Ishina lyakwe lipilibula ukuti cipuba, kabili ubupumbu bwendela pamo nankwe. Lelo ine ne mubomfi obe, nshacibamona ababomfi bobe ilyo wacibatuma.

english: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD lives and as your soul lives, since the LORD has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.
translation: Nomba apo Yawe alikupokolola, we shikulu, kukusumya umulopa kabili kukulandula na maboko yobe we mwine, mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo ngefyo na iwe we mfumu uli uwamweo, shi abalwani bobe kabili bonse abafwaya ukonaula shikulu wandi babe kwati Nabali.

english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.
translation: Kanshi nomba lekeni ubu bupe ubo umubomfi aletele kuli shikulu wandi, bupeelwe ku bantu aba uli nabo.

english: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the LORD’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.
translation: Napapata belela kanakashi obe uluse pa bubi ubuli bonse, pantu Yawe mu cine cine ali nokupeela iŋanda yakubelelela kuli shikulu, pa mulandu wakuti shikulu alwisha ubulwi bwakwa Yawe. Wileka ububi nelyo bumo busangwe muli iwe ilyo ucili umumi.

english: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.
translation: Nangufye kube umuntu uulefwaya ukukwipaya, ubumi bwakwa shikulu buli nokusungwa bwino pamo na babumi bakwa Yawe Lesa obe. Lelo imyeo ya balwani bobe ali nokuifwinta nge libwe ilyafuma mwilekeni.

english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.
translation: Ishina lyakwe ali ni Nabali. Elyo ishina lya mukashi wakwe ali ni Abigaili. Ali umwanakashi uwashilimuka nganshi kabili uwayemba mukumoneka, lelo umulume wakwe umwina Kalebu ali umukali kabili inkakashi mu micitile yakwe.

english: It will come to pass, when the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,
translation: Ilyo Yawe akafikilisha ukucita ifi fyonse kuli shikulu, conse icisuma ico amulaya kabili alimusala ukuba intungulushi pali Israeli,

english: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When the LORD has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”
translation: shikulu wandi takabe na matontokanyo yakulanguluka icisendo cakusumya umulopa apabula umulandu, nangu icakuilandula we mwine. Kabili ilyo Yawe akaletela shikulu ubusuma elyo ukanjibukishe ne mubomfi obe.”

english: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
translation: Elyo Davidi atile kuli Abigaili, “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, uwacikutuma kukunkumanya mu bushiku bwa lelo.

english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.
translation: Naube uwapaalwa pa bupingushi bobe ubusuma elyo na pakundesha ukusumya umulopa muli buno bushiku, na pakukana bomfya iminwe yandi ku cilandushi.

english: For indeed, as the LORD the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”
translation: Pantu mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, Lesa wakwa Israeli uundeseshe ukucita icabipa, aubula ukwisa bwangu kukunkumanya, nga takwashele umwaume nangu umo uwabumi mu ŋanda yakwa Nabali mu kuca kwa mailo.”

english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”
translation: Elyo Davidi apokelele ukufuma ku maboko yakwa Abigaili ifyo amuletele, elyo amweba nokuti, “Kabiye ku mushi umutende. Ine ningumfwa amashiwi yobe no kusumina ubwipusho bobe.”

english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.
translation: Ilyo Abigaili afikikile kuli Nabali, amusangile mu ŋanda alecita umutebeto ngo wa mfumu. Asangile Nabali ali uwasansamuka nganshi pantu ali uwakolwa. Kanshi Abigaili tamwebele nangu cimo mpakafye ku macaca.

english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
translation: Elyo ulucelo, ilyo Nabali akololweke, umukashi wakwe epakumushimikila ifintu fyonse. Kabili umutima wakwe wafililwe ukubomba bwino elyo aumalalafye aba kwati libwe.

english: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, so that he died.
translation: Panuma ya nshiku ikumi limo Yawe apuma Nabali, no kufwa afwa.

english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is the LORD, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. The LORD has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.
translation: Ilyo Davidi aumfwile ukuti Nabali nafwa, atile, “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe uwanandwilako Nabali pa musebanya acitile. Yawe ewalenga ukuti umubomfi wakwe ataluke kukucita icabipa. Kabili nalenga ububi bwakwa Nabali bube pa mutwe wakwe wine.” Elyo Davidi atumine ishiwi kuli Abigaili ukumwipusha ukuti akabe umukashi wakwe.

english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
translation: Ilyo Davidi acili mu matololo, aumfwa ati Nabali alebeya impaanga shakwe mu Kameli.

english: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”
translation: Ababomfi bakwa Davidi baya na ku Kameli ukwali Abigaili nokutila, “Davidi atutuma kuli iwe mukukusenda mukuba umukashi wakwe.”

english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”
translation: Awe Abigaili aima akontamina panshi nokutila, “Epo ndi ne mubomfi obe, ninjipekanya ukukubombela elyo no kusamba amakasa ya babomfi bakwa shikulu bene.”

english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
translation: Abigaili bwangu bwangu anina pali punda. Ababomfi bakwe abanakashi basano bamukonka. Awe nao akonka inkombe shakwa Davidi no kuya ba umukashi wakwe.

english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.
translation: Davidi ninshi alyupa Ainoamu uwa ku Yesireli kabili bonse baba abakashi bakwe.

english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.
translation: Lelo Saulo ninshi alipeela umwana wakwe umwanakashi Mika, muka Davidi, kuli Paliti mwana Leishi uwafumine ku Galimu.

english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.
translation: Atuma abalumendo ikumi limo no kubeba ati, “Kabiyeni ninikeni muye kuli Nabali ku Kameli no kuya muposesha mwishina lyandi.

english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!
translation: Mutile kuli wena, ‘Ubumi bobe nabutantalile! Kube umutende kuli iwe pamo na ba ŋanda yobe! Kabili kube umutende kuli conse ico wakwata!

english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.
translation: Nomba ningumfwa ukuti pali ino nshita ulebeya impaanga. Ilyo bakacema bobe bali na ifwe, tatwabasungile buluku buluku. Kabili inshita yonsefye ilyo bali ku Kameli, takwali icintu nangu cimo ico balufishepo.

english: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”
translation: Ipusha ababomfi bobe, nabo balakweba. Eico kanshi lekeni abalumendo bandi basange ukusekelelwa pa cinso cenu, pantu twaisa mu bushiku ubwansansa. Napapata peeleniko ababomfi benu elyo no mwana wenu Davidi ico mwamona ukuti nacilinga kuli bena.’”

english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.
translation: Ilyo abantu bafikile, bapeele Nabali aya mashiwi mwishina lyakwa Davidi. Elyo balapembela.

english: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”
translation: Abena Sifu baile kuli Saulo ku Gibea nokutila, “Bushe Davidi tabelama pa lupili lwa Hikila, ulwalolenkana na Yeshimoni?”

english: David said, “As the LORD lives, the LORD will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.
translation: Kabili Davidi asosa nokutila, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, Yawe umwine euli nokumwipaya. Ilyo inshita yakwe ikafika, ali nokufwa, nangu ilyo akaya ku bulwi eko akalobela.

english: The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”
translation: Yawe alindesha ukutambalika ukuboko pa wasubwa wakwe. Nomba kanshi buula ifumo ilili ku mutwe no lukunku lwa menshi ululi mupepi na ku mutwe wakwe, tufumeko tuleya.”

english: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it, or knew it, nor did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakubuula ulukunku lwa menshi ne fumo mupepi no mutwe wakwa Saulo elyo baya. Tapali umuntu nangu umo uwamwene nangu uwaishibe pali ici, nelyo uwabukile mu tulo. Bonsefye balisendeme, pantu Yawe ewabalalike mu tulo utukalamba.

english: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;
translation: Elyo Davidi ayabukila bushilya bubiye no kwiminina pa mulu wa lupili akatalamukila. Pali intamfu iyikalamba pa kati kabo.

english: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”
translation: Davidi abilikisha ku fita na kuli Abune mwana Neri ati, “Bushe cinshi tauleyasukila iwe Abune?” Elyo Abuna ayasuka ati, “Bushe niwe nani we uleita imfumu?”

english: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
translation: Davidi atile, “Bushe tauli mwaume? Kabili ni nani uwaba nga iwe mu Israeli? Nga cinshi ico mufililwe ukulinda imfumu kateeka wenu? Pantu kwacisa umuntu umo kukonaula shikulu imfumu yenu.

english: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As the LORD lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the LORD’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”
translation: Ico mucitile te cisuma iyoo. Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, iwe elyo na bantu bobe mufwilefye ukufwa pantu tamwacilinda shikulu wenu, uwasubwa wakwa Yawe. Lolesheni konse konse. Bushe ni kwi ukuli ifumo elyo no lukunku lwa menshi ifya mfumu ifyaciba mupepi na ku mutwe waiko?”

english: Saul recognized David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”
translation: Awe Saulo aishiba ishiwi lyakwa Davidi, elyo asosa ati, “Bushe ilyo lishiwi lyobe, Davidi mwana wandi?” Davidi ayasuka ati, “Ee, lishiwi lyandi we shikulu imfumu yandi.”

english: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?
translation: Kabili alundapo nokutila, “Bushe cinshi imfumu ilekonkela mukufwaya umubomfi waiko? Kabili mulandu nshi uo ncitile?

english: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that the LORD has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before the LORD; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to the LORD’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’
translation: Nomba shi lekeni shikulu imfumu yandi yumfwe ku mashiwi ya mubomfi wakwe. Nga cakuti ni Yawe ewamulenga ukuti munjimine, lyena engaba uwakupokelela umutuulo uyu. Lelo nga cakuti cafumafye ku bantu, awe kwena nababe abalapishiwa ku cinso cakwa Yawe! Pantu nabantamfya nomba na ku cakaniko ca cishilano cakwa Yawe, elyo balanda nokuti, ‘Kabiye ukaye mukubombela imilungu imbi.’

english: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
translation: Kanshi Saulo epakwima, aya ku matololo ya Sifu, ninshi nasenda abashilika amakana yatatu (3,000) abasalilwe ukufuma mu bena Israeli, kukuya mukufwaya Davidi kulya kwine.

english: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of the LORD; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”
translation: Nomba wileka umulopa wandi witikile panshi ukutalwike ku cinso cakwa Yawe. Imfumu ya bena Israeli naifuma ilefwaya ine ngo lupantila, pamo ngefyo umuntu alunga inkwale mu mpili.”

english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”
translation: Elyo Saulo atile, “Ine nimembuka. Bwela we mwana wandi Davidi. Pantu naucindikisha ubumi bwandi ilelo, ine nshakatale mfwaya ukukwipaya nakabili! Icine cine nacitile kwati cipuba kabili nalilufyenye nganshi.”

english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.
translation: Davidi ayasuka ati, “Ifumo lya mfumu ili kuno. Shilekeni umo uwa balumendo benu ese no kulipoka.

english: The LORD will render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because the LORD delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
translation: Ala Yawe apeela icilambu ukulingana no bulungami elyo ne cisumino ca muntu. Yawe acikupeela mu maboko yandi ilelo, nomba nshakatale ntambalika ukuboko kwandi pa musubwa wakwa Yawe.

english: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in the LORD’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”
translation: Ala mu cine ngefyo nacipeela umucinshi ku bumi bobe ilelo, shi Yawe nao nacindamike ubumi bwandi no kumpususha ku mafya yonse.”

english: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.
translation: Elyo Saulo atile kuli Davidi, “Shi naube uwapaalwa we mwana wandi Davidi. Ukacita ifintu ifikankala kabili mu cinefye ukacimfya.” Kanshi Davidi aile inshila yakwe, elyo Saulo nao abwelelamo ku mushi.

english: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
translation: Saulo acitile inkambi lubali lumbi ulwa musebo pa lupili lwa Hakila ukulolenkana na Yeshimoni. Lelo Davidi aikele mu matololo. Ilyo amona ukuti Saulo amukonka na kulya kwine,

english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.
translation: atuma inengu kabili nasho shashininkisha ukuti Saulo cine cinefye nafika.

english: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.
translation: Elyo Davidi aima no kuya uko Saulo acitile inkambi. Davidi amona apo Saulo na Abune umwana wakwa Neri, umukalamba wa fita, balele. Saulo wena alele mukati ka nkambi, ne fita nafimushinguluka.

english: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipwishe Aimeleki umwina Hiti elyo na Abishai umwana wakwa Seruiya, munyina Yoabu ati, “Bushe ni nani twalaya nankwe mu nkambi umuli Saulo?” Abishai atile, “Ine, twalaya na iwe.”

english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na Abishai epakuya ku fita ubushiku, na Saulo ali kulya kwine, nalala mu tulo mukati ka nkambi, ne fumo lyakwe nashimpa panshi mupepi na ku mitwe. Abune pamo ne fita nabo balele mu mbali yakwe.

english: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”
translation: Elyo Abishai atile kuli Davidi, “Ilelo Lesa nakupeela umulwani obe mu maboko yobe. Nomba leka palya pene alele panshi mushimpe ifumofye limo, ine nshamulase imiku ibili iyoo.”

english: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?”
translation: Lelo Davidi atile, “Awe wimonaula! Ala takuli nangu umo uwingabika ukuboko kwakwe pa musubwa wakwa Yawe no kuba uwabula umulandu.”

english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atontonkanya mu mutima wakwe ati, “Ubushiku bumo ndi nokonaulwa ku maboko yakwa Saulo. Icintufye icisuma ico ningacita cakufyukila ku calo ca Bafilisiti. Elyo Saulo ali nokuleka ukumfwaya mu calo conse ica Israeli, na ine nkapusuka ukufuma mu maboko yakwe.”

english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”
translation: Ilyo lyonse Akishi amwipusha ati, “Bushe ni ncende nshi wile sansa ilelo?” Davidi aleyasuka ati, “Ni ku matololo ya ku Yuda nangu ku matololo ya ku Yerameli nangu ku matololo ya ku bena Keni.”

english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”
translation: Davidi tapuswishepo nangu umo umwaume nangu umwanakashi umutuntulu uwakusenda ku Gati, pantu aletontonkanya ati, “Pantu limbi kuti baya tusoselela, nokulanda ati, ‘Ifi efyo Davidi acita.’” Kabili ifi efyo Davidi alecita mu nshiku shonse isho aikele mu calo ca Bafilisiti.

english: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”
translation: Akishi alicetekele Davidi, elyo atile, “Davidi nabamupata ku bantu bakwe abena Israeli, eico kanshi ali nokuba umubomfi wandi pee.”

english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
translation: Kanshi Davidi pamo na bantu imyanda mutanda (600) abali nankwe baima nokuya kuli Akishi mwana Maoki imfumu ya ku Gati.

english: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
translation: Davidi pamo na bantu bakwe epakwikala mu Gati kuli Akishi. Cila muntu aikele no lupwa lwakwe. Elyo Davidi nao ali na bakashi bakwe babili Ainoamu uwa ku Yesireli elyo na Abigaili uwa ku Kameli, uwafwililwe umulume Nabali.

english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.
translation: Ilyo bamwebele Saulo ukuti Davidi nafyukila ku Gati, alekele no kumufwaya fwaya.

english: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”
translation: Elyo Davidi aebele Akishi ati, “Nga cakuti ninsanga ukusekelelwa mu menso yenu, mumpeeleko incende imo mu mushi umo uwa mu calo cenu, umwakuti ndeikala. Nga mulandu nshi umubomfi wenu engekalila mu musumba wa mfumu umo na imwe mwikala?”

english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
translation: Kanshi pa bushiku bwine ubu, Akishi amupeela Sikilagi. Kanshi e mulandu wine Sikilagi abela ku mfumu sha bena Yuda ukufumafye na pakale.

english: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
translation: Davidi aikele mu calo ca Bafilisiti umwaka umo ne myeshi ine.

english: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.
translation: Elyo Davidi na bantu bakwe bafumine baya sansa abena Geshuri, abena Girisi na bena Amaleki. Pantu ukufuma ku nshita yakale aba bantu baleikala mu calo icasuntinkene ku Shuri elyo na ku Egupto.

english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.
translation: Kanshi lyonse ilyo Davidi alesansa incende, taleshako umuntu nelyo umo umwaume nangu umwanakashi umumi. Lelo alesenda impaanga, iŋombe, bapunda, ingamila elyo ne fyakufwala, elyo abwelelamo ku Akishi.

english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”
translation: Mu nshiku shilya Abafilisiti balongenye ifita fyabo kukulwisha abena Israeli. Akishi atile kuli Davidi, “Ufwile ukwibukisha ukuti iwe na bantu bobe muli nokunshindika ku bulwi.”

english: Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, “As the LORD lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”
Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”
translation: Elyo umwanakashi aipusha ati, “Bushe ni nani uo ndekwimisha ku bafwa?” Nao atile “Ndefwaya Samwele.”

english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”
translation: Ilyo umwanakashi amwene Samwele, alilile umusowa uukalamba nokutila kuli Saulo, “Bushe cinshi umbepele? Ilyo niwe Saulo!”

english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatile ku mwanakashi, “Witiina. Bushe cinshi wamona?” Umwanakashi ati, “Namona umulungu ulefuma mu mushili.”

english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.
translation: Asosa ku mwanakashi ati, “Bushe ulemoneka shani?” Nao atile, “Ulemoneka kwati mwaume umukote uufwele umwingila alefumina pamulu.” Nomba Saulo elyo aishiba ukuti ni Samwele, elyo akontamina panshi amupakata.

english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”
translation: Samwele epakutila kuli Saulo, “Bushe mulandu nshi wamfulunganishisha ukutuusha pakumbusha?” Saulo atile, “Ine ndi ne sakamika ilikalamba. Abafilisiti bali pa bulwi na ine, kabili Lesa nao naleka ukunjasuka nangu kupitila muli bakasesema nangu ni mu filoto. E mulandu wine njishile kuli iwe pakuti unjebeko ifyo ningacita.”

english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since the LORD has departed from you and has become your adversary?
translation: Samwele nao atile, “Nomba mulandu nshi uleipushisha ine, ilyo Yawe nakufutatila nasanguka no mulwani obe?

english: The LORD has done to you as he spoke by me. The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.
translation: Yawe ena nabomba ifyo asobele ukupitila muli ine. Yawe napokolola ubufumu mu maboko yobe no kubupeela kuli umo umwina mupalamano obe, kuli Davidi.

english: Because you didn’t obey the LORD’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you today.
translation: Pa mulandu wakukanabeela ifyo Yawe akwebele, elyo wakaana nokucita icifukushi cabukali bwakwe pali Amaleki, Yawe nacita ici kuli iwe mu bushiku bwa lelo.

english: Moreover the LORD will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The LORD will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”
translation: Yawe ali nokupeela bonse abena Israeli pamo na iwe mu maboko ya Bafilisiti. Kabili mailo iwe pamo na bana bobe muli nokuba pamo na ine. Yawe kabili ali nokupeela ifita fya bena Israeli ku Bafilisiti.”

english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”
translation: Davidi nao atile, “Nomba muli nokuimwena mwe bene ifyo umubomfi wenu ali nokucita.” Elyo nao Akishi ayasuka ati, “Wawamya nganshi, kanshi ine ndi nokukucita ukuba uwakuninda inshiku pe.”

english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.
translation: Awe bwangu bwangu Saulo awa panshi atambalala ku mwenso ukalamba, pa mulandu wa mashiwi Samwele amwebele. Amaka yapwa kuli Saulo, pantu akasuba konse talile elyo no bushiku bwine.

english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.
Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”
translation: Nomba napapata umfwa ku mubomfi obe no kuleka nkupeelekofye utwakulya tumo, pakuti ulye no kukwata amaka uko uleya mu nshila yobe.”

english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.
translation: Nao alikene ati, “Nshalye.” Lelo ababomfi bakwe no mwanakashi bamupatikisha, elyo asumina ifyo balemweba. Awe aima panshi no kwikala pa busanshi.

english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.
translation: Umwanakashi ali ne ciponti icaina pa ŋanda pamwakwe, aya bwangu bwangu acipaya. Asenda no bunga ubwakandawilwa no kupangako umukate uushitutumuka.

english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.
translation: Elyo apalamika kuli Saulo pamo na babomfi bakwe, nabo balya. Bulya bwine bushiku baima no kuya.

english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.
translation: Nomba Samwele alifwile, na bena Israeli bonse balimulooseshe, bamushiika na mu mushi wakwe ku Rama. Saulo ninshi natamfya bakabuka elyo na babomba ne mipashi bonse ukufuma mu calo.

english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
translation: Abafilisiti balongene pamo mukucita inkambi ku Shunemu, ninshi Saulo nao nalonganya abena Israeli bonse no kucita inkambi ku Giliboa.

english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
translation: Ilyo Saulo amona impuka ya Bafilisiti, atiina. Umwenso waikete umutima wakwe, alatutuma nganshi.

english: When Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
translation: Saulo epakwipusha Yawe, lelo Yawe akaana ukumwasuka mu filoto nangu muli Urimu nangu muli bakasesema.

english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
translation: Elyo Saulo atile ku babomfi bakwe, “Mfwaileniko umwanakashi umo uwaishiba ukubuka pakuti eko nje mukwipusha.” Elyo batila, “Moneni, eko aba umo umwanakashi ku Eni Dori uubuka.”

english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”
translation: Kanshi Saulo epakuifulunganya afwala insalu shimbi. Elyo ubushiku, wena na bantu babili baima baya na ku mwanakashi. Saulo amweba ati, “Njipushishako ku mipashi, elyo undetelepo umuntu uo nalakweba ishina.”

english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”
translation: Lelo umwanakashi atile kuli ena, “Icine cine walishibafye bwino ifyo Saulo acita. Uyu muntu alitamfya bonse bakabuka na babomba ne mipashi mu calo cakwe. Nga cinshi uletele iciteyo pa bumi bwandi icingandetela imfwa?”

english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.
translation: Abafilisiti balongenye ifita fyonse ku Afeki, elyo abena Israeli nabo bacitile inkambi pa kamfukumfuku ka mu Yesireli.

english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”
translation: Eico mailo mukeme bwangu bwangu pamo na babomfi bakwa sokulu abaisa na iwe, mukabwelelemo ku ncende namupeela ukwikalamo. Mukacelele lilyafye kwalabuuta”

english: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.
translation: Ilyo bakateeka wa Bafilisiti baleenda mu milongo, mu mpuka mu myanda elyo mu makana na makana, Davidi na bantu bakwe baleenda mu milongo panuma bali na Akishi.

english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba fita ba Bafilisiti baipusha abati, “Nga aba, Abahibulu banshi?” Akishi ayasuka ati, “Bushe uyu te Davidi, uwali umubomfi wakwa Saulo imfumu ya bena Israeli? Aikala na ine no mwaka umo naupwa, elyo ukufuma ubushiku ashile Saulo ukushinta na nomba, ine nshasangamo ububi nangu bumo muli Davidi.”

english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?
translation: Lelo abakalamba ba Bafilisiti bakalipa nokutila, “Bweseshamo uyu muntu ku ncende wamupeele. Tafwile kutukonka ku bulwi, limbi kuti atupilibukila ilyo tucili tulelwa. Bushe kuti atemwikwa shani kuli shikulu wakwe, te lintufye amutwalila imitwe ya bantu besu aba?

english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”
translation: Bushe teuyu wine Davidi bemba na mu lwimbo ilyo balecinda ulwakuti, ‘Saulo aipaya abalwani bakwe amakana na makana, elyo Davidi ena aipaya amakana amakumi na makumi.’”

english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As the LORD lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.
translation: Kanshi Akishi epakwita Davidi nokutila kuli wena, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, uli muntu wacishinka kabili ine kuti natemwa ukubomba na iwe mu bulwi. Pantu ukufumafye pa bushiku waishile ukufika na nomba, ine nshasangamo ububi muli iwe Davidi, lelo bakateeka bena tabakusuminishe.

english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”
translation: Sam 18:7

english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
translation: Davidi atile, “Nomba bushe cinshi ncitile? Cinshi teti njile nokulwisha abalwani bakwa shikulu, imfumu yandi?”

english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
translation: Akishi ayasuka Davidi ati, “Kuli ine walibafye uwakunsekesha mu menso yandi kwati ni malaika wakwa Lesa. Nomba ifita fikalamba fya Bafilisiti efitile, ‘Tafwile ukuya na ifwe ku bulwi.’

english: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
translation: Elyo Hana apepele kuli Yawe ati,

english: Those who strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “The LORD will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”
translation: Bonse abapinkana na Yawe bena bakonaulwa.

english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served the LORD before Eli the priest.
translation: Elyo Elikana abwelelamo kumwabo ku Rama, lelo akalumendo ka Samwele kena kashala mukubombela Yawe, kaleyafwilishako Eli shimapepo.

english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know the LORD.
translation: Nomba abana baume bakwa Eli bali ifiwelewele, bena tabasakamene ukwishiba Yawe,

english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
translation: nangu ukwishiba imilimo ya bashimapepo iyo bali nokubomba pakati ka bantu. Nomba cali lutambi lwa bashimapepo ulwakuti inshita yonse ilyo umuntu aletuula ilambo, ninshi nabepika inama ilepya, umubomfi wakwa shimapepo ali nokusenda umutunkwilo wa mpanda shitatu mu minwe yakwe.

english: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.
translation: Uyu mubomfi ali nokulasa muli conse ico bepikemo inama, cibe ni mu nongo, muli pani, mu mupika nangu mu kalongo. Kanshi conse ico umutunkwilo walasa ninshi shimapepo alesenda. Ifi efyo balecita kuli onse umwina Israeli uwaleisa ku Shilo.

english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
translation: Kabili balecita ifi ukuti ilyo tabalaoca amafuta, umubomfi wakwa shimapepo ali nokwisa no kusosa ku muntu uuleleka ilambo ati, “Peelapo shimapepo inama yakoca, pantu tasumine ukupoka inama iyaipikwa ukufuma kuli iwe kanofye iyibishi.”

english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
translation: Lelo uyu muntu nga atila kuli ena, “Shileka batale boce amafuta, elyo lyena walasendapo conse ico ulefwaya.” Lelo umubomfi wena kwasuka ati, “Iyoo, mpeelafye nombaline, pantu nga wakaana ukumpeela ninshi nalapokelafye ku maka.”

english: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men despised the LORD’s offering.
translation: Kanshi ububifi bwa bana baume bakwa Eli bwali ubukalamba nganshi pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Pantu tabapeele umucinshi kuli conse icaletuulwa kuli Yawe.

english: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
translation: Umulumendo Samwele alefwala insalu isha kolokondwe pakubomba imilimo pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
translation: Elyo cila mwaka nyina nao alemubilila umwingila unono, no kumutwalila ilyo baleya na balume kukutuula ilambo lya pa mwaka.

english: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
translation: “Takwaba uwamushilo nelyo umo, uwaba nga Yawe,

english: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.
translation: Awe Eli alepaala Elikana no mukashi wakwe mu mashiwi ayakuti, “Shi, Yawe engakupeela abana muli uyu mwanakashi, abengaba abakukonka pali uyu alombele mwipepo, kabili untu aisa peela kuli Yawe.” Elyo na panuma ya ifi balebwelelamo kumwabo.

english: The LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before the LORD.
translation: Awe Yawe akwatile Hana icikuuku, nao aimita no kufyala abana abaume batatu, na banakashi nabo babili. No mulumendo Samwele atwalililafye ukulakula pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Nomba Eli alikotele nganshi, elyo aumfwa fyonse ifyo abana bakwe abaume balecita ku bena Israeli bonse. Kabili aumfwa nefyo balesendama na banakashi abalebomba pa mwinshi we tenti lyakukumaninamo.

english: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
translation: Eli epakweba abana bakwe ati, “Bushe cinshi ico mulecitila ifintu fyonse ifi ndeumfwa? Ine ndeumfwa ukufuma ku bantu bonse pa mulandu wa ubu buwelewele bwenu mucita.

english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD’s people disobey.
translation: Iyoo, mwe bana bandi abaume, kwena te cintu icisuma icili muli aka kasebo ako ndeumfwa, akasalangene monse mu bantu bakwa Yawe.

english: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD intended to kill them.
translation: Ala nga cakuti umuntu abembukila umuntu munankwe, umbi kuti amupapatilako kuli Yawe. Lelo nga cakuti umuntu abembukila Yawe, nani engamupapatilako?” Awe abana bakwe abaume, nangu cali ifi, tabaumfwile ku kukalipilwa kwakwa wishi pantu bwali bufwayo bwakwa Yawe ukuti bakepaiwe.

english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with the LORD and also with men.
translation: Kabili umulumendo Samwele, alitwalilile ukulakula mu cimo no kulatemwikwa kuli Yawe pamo pene na ku bantu.

english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
translation: Nomba umuntu wakwa Lesa umo aishile kuli Eli no kumweba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Bushe ine nshaisokolwele bwino bwinofye ne mwine ku ba ŋanda yakwa wiso ilyo bali mu busha bwakwa Farao mu calo ca Egupto?

english: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
translation: Nine nasalile wiso ukufuma pa nko shonse isha bena Israeli ukuti abe shimapepo wandi, uwakubomba pa bulambo bwandi, no kulafutumuna ububani bwa cena cisuma, elyo no kulafwala icakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi pa cinso candi. Kabili napeele ku ba ŋanda yakwa wiso fyonse ifyo bacitile ifya mituulo iyakoca, iyo abena Israeli batuulile.

english: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’
translation: Bushe cinshi ushulukila ifye lambo fyandi ne fya mutuulo wandi ifyo nakonkomesha abantu ukulantuula ku cifulo candi? Bushe mulandu nshi wacindikila abana bobe abaume ukucila ine mukulalya ifisuma pakuti muleina mwe bene mweka, pakusala ifipande balefwaya ifya mutuulo we lambo ukufuma pafyo abantu bandi abena Israeli batuula?’

english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.
translation: Tecakwesha nakabili ukulanda ifyakuitakisha,

english: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now the LORD says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.
translation: Eico kanshi Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli, asosa ati, ‘Ine nakulaile nati, iŋanda yobe, ne ŋanda yakwa wiso, nimwe muli nokulantumika umuyayaya.’ Nomba Yawe alandile ukuti, ‘Cibefye ukutali kuli ine, pantu nshakacicite! Kuli abo bonse abancindika, na ine ebo nkacindika. Lelo kuli abo bonse abansuula, bali nokusaalulwa.’

english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.
translation: “Mona, inshita ileisa ilyo ine ndi nokuputula amaka yobe pamo pene na maka ya ŋanda yakwa wiso, pakuti kwikalaba umuntu umwaume nelyo umo mu lupwa lwenu uwakufika ku bukote.

english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.
translation: Mukucucutika ukalalolesha no lunkumbwa mu menso yobe pa kushuka konse uko ndi nokupeela abena Israeli. Elyo na mu lupwa lobe tamwakatale amuba umuntu umwaume uwakufika ku bukote.

english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.
translation: No muntu obe onse uo nshakaleshe ukufika ku bulambo bwandi, wena akashala pakulenga amenso yakwe yanakuke no kuleka umutima wakwe wikatwe no bulanda. Kabili na bonse aba mu lupwa lobe bali nokufwila ku lupanga.

english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.
translation: Kabili ici ecikaba icishibilo kuli iwe icili nokuponena abana bobe babili abaume, Hofini na Fineasi, bonse babili bali nokufwa mu bushiku bumo bwinefye.

english: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.
translation: Ine ne mwine nkaifwaila shimapepo uwacishinka, uyo ukalabomba ukulingana nefyo umutima wandi na mano yandi fifwaya. Ine nkalenga aba mu ŋanda yakwe ukwiminina, kabili inshiku shonse akalatumika uwasubwa wandi.

english: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”
translation: Elyo umuntu onse uukashalako mu lupwa lobe akesa mufukamina no kumulomba indalama sha silifa nangu umukate elyo no kulanda ati, ‘Shi napapata mpeeleniko umulimo wa bushimapepo pakuti na ine ndekwatako akapande ka mukate akakulya.’”

english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
translation: “Amata ya bamaka nayakontaika,

english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.
translation: Abo abalelya no kwikuta, ebatendeke ukubombela ifyakulya,

english: “The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
translation: “Yawe eulenga ukufwa, kabili eulenga ukuba no mweo,

english: The LORD makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
translation: Yawe eulenga ubupina, kabili eupeela ubunonshi,

english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s. He has set the world on them.
translation: Ewimya abapina ukubafumya mu mito.

english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.
translation: “Yawe ali nokubaka abamushilo bakwe,

english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,
translation: Davidi na bantu bakwe bafikile ku Sikilagi mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu. Nomba ninshi abena Amaleki nabesa sansa mu matololo ya Negebu elyo na mu Sikilagi. Basansa Sikilagi elyo baoca no musumba.

english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.
translation: Pantu imyanda ibili (200) iya bantu balinakile sana bafilwa no kwabuka umumana. Lelo Davidi na bantu imyanda ine (400) batwalilila ukuya balebafwaya.

english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.
translation: Awe basanga umwina Egupto umo mwibala bamuleta kuli Davidi. Bamupeelako amenshi yakunwa ne fyakulya.

english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.
translation: Bamupeelako akacipande ka mukate wa mukunyu uwakamwa, elyo ne mikate ibili iya fisansangu fya myangashi iyauma. Awe alya elyo akwata amaka, pantu talilepo kantu nelyo kamo nangufye kunwa amenshi pa nshiku shitatu, akasuba no bushiku.

english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.
translation: Elyo Davidi atampa ukumwipusha ati, “Bushe uli muntu wakwa nani? Kabili ni kwi wafuma?” Nao atile, “Ine ndi mwina Egupto, umusha wa mwina Amaleki. Shikulu nao alinsha pantu nali umulwele pa nshiku shitatu ishapita.

english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”
translation: Twasanshile aba mu matololo ya Negebu wa ku Kereti elyo ne calo ca bena Yuda na Negebu wakwa Kalebu. Elyo twasha twaoca na Sikilagi.”

english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”
translation: Davidi amwipusha ati, “Bushe kuti wantungulula ku mpuka iyo iyaishile sansa?” Ayasuka ati, “Icikulu ulape kuli ine pa cinso cakwa Lesa ukuti tauli nakunjipaya nangu ukumpeela mu maboko yakwa shikulu elyo lyena nalakutwala uko bali.”

english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
translation: Elyo atungulula Davidi uko baile. Ilyo bafikile, basangile basalangenefye mpanga yonse, balelya, balenwa nokusansamuka pa mulandu wa bwingi bwa fitapwa bafumishe mu calo ca Bafilisiti elyo ne calo cakwa Yuda.

english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.
translation: Davidi abalwishishe ukufuma ulucelo mpaka ukufika na ku cungulo ca bushiku bwakonkelepo. Kanshi tapali nelyo umo pali bena uwafulumwike kanofye abalumendo imyanda ine (400) abaninine pa ngamila no kufulumuka.

english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
translation: Davidi apokolwele icintu conse ico abena Amaleki basendele, ukulundapofye na bakashi bakwe bonse babili.

english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.
translation: Tapali icintu nelyo cimo icabulilepo, icinono nangu icikalamba, umulumendo nangu umukashana, icitapwa nangu icintufye conse pafyo basendele. Davidi abweseshefye fyonse.

english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.
translation: Kabili basenda na bankole abanakashi na bonse abali mu mushi, bonse abaice na bakote. Tabaipeyepo nangu umo, lelo babasendafye ilyo baleya uko balungeme.

english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.
translation: Elyo Davidi afikile pa bantu imyanda ibili (200) abanakile nganshi mukumukonka, abo ashile kunuma ku kamana ka Beso. Nabo bafumine kukumukumanya pamo na bantu ali nabo. Ilyo Davidi na bantu bakwe bapalama, abaposha.

english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”
translation: Lelo abantu imbifi kabili abawelewele bonse abo bali nabo kabili abakonkele Davidi batila, “Pantu tatwaile pamo nabo, ifwe tatwabakenyeko ifitapwa twile sanga. Lelo umwaume onse kuti asenda umukashi elyo na bana bakwe, no kuya aleya.”

english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
translation: Elyo Davidi ayasuka ati, “Awe, mwe bamunyinane mwicita ifyo pali ifi fintu Yawe atupeele. Yawe alitucingilila no kupeela mu maboko yesu abalwani aba abaishile tusansa.

english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”
translation: Nga kanshi, ni bani bengamusuminisha kufyo mwasosa pali ifi? Pantu icakaniko ca bantu bashele balelinda ifipe efyo ne cakaniko ca baile ku bulwi cili nokuba cimo cinefye. Bonse bali nokwakanafye cimo cine.”

english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
translation: Kanshi Davidi acitile ici ukuba ifunde ne cebo ku bena Israeli, ukufumafye pali bulya bwine ubushiku ukufika na pali lelo.

english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
translation: Ilyo Davidi afikile mu Sikilagi, atumine ifitapwa fimo ku bakalamba ba bena Yuda, abali abanankwe asosa nokuti, “Ubu e bupe kuli imwe ubo nafumya pa fitapwa fya balwani bakwa Yawe.”

english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,
translation: Awe afituma na ku bali ku Betele, Ramoti wa mu Negebu, elyo na ku bena Yatiri.

english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,
translation: Kabili atuma na ku Aroeli, Sifimoti, Eshitemoa,

english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
translation: elyo na ku Rakali. Kabili atuma na kuli bonse abaleikala mu misumba ya bena Yerameli na ku bena Keni.

english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.
translation: Ilyo Davidi na bantu bakwe baishile ku Sikilagi basanga umusumba naocewa ku mulilo. Elyo abakashi babo, abana babo abaume elyo na bakashana bonse nababasenda muli bunkole.

english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,
translation: Atuma na ku bali mu Homa, Borashani, na ku Ataki,
