english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.
translation: elyo na ku Hebuloni. Kabili atuma na kuli bonse abali mu fifulo fimbi uko Davidi na bantu bakwe baendawike.

english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na bantu bakwe balalooshafye apakalamba mpaka na maka yakuloosha yapwa.

english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
translation: Na bakashi bonse babili abakwa Davidi balibasendele muli bunkole, Ainoamu wa ku Yesireli elyo na Abigaili, mukamfwilwa uwali muka Nabali wa ku Kameli.

english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.
translation: Davidi aumfwile ubulanda nganshi pantu abantu balalanda pakumulasaula amabwe. Cila muntu ali uwakalipwa pa mulandu wa bana babo abaume elyo na bakashana. Lelo Davidi asangile amaka muli Yawe Lesa wakwe.

english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
translation: Elyo Davidi aebele Abiyata shimapepo mwana Aimeleki ati, “Shindetelako icakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila efodi.” Abiyata nao amuletela.

english: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”
translation: Kabili Davidi aipusha Yawe ati, “Bushe nkonke mukufwaya aba abatapile ifyuma? Bushe ndebasanga?” Yawe amweba ati, “Bakonke uye bafwaya. Icine cine ulebasanga nokuya lubula abantu bonse.”

english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.
translation: Davidi elyo na bantu imyanda mutanda ali nabo bafikile ku kamana ka Beso, pa ncende apo baishile shapo bamo.

english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
translation: Nomba ilyo Abafilisiti balwile na bena Israeli, abena Israeli balifulumwike. Elyo na bengi babepaile pa lupili lwa Giliboa.

english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
translation: Babika ifyanso fyakwe mwitempele lyakwa Ashitoreti, elyo bapampamina icitumbi cakwe ku cibumba ca Beti Shani.

english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation: Nomba ilyo abantu ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi baumfwile ifyo Abafilisiti bacitile kuli Saulo,

english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.
translation: abantu babo bonse ababulamba balimine no kwenda ubushiku bonse ukuya ku Beti Shani. Basenda ifitumbi fyonse ifyakwa Saulo elyo ne fya bana bakwe abaume ukufuma ku cibumba ca Beti Shani no kuya ku Yabeshi, eko baya fyocela.

english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
translation: Elyo basendele amafupa yabo no kuya yashiika mwisamba lya cimuti ca Tamarisiki ku Yabeshi. Kabili bafungile ukulya pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
translation: Abafilisiti bakonkele Saulo pamo na bana bakwe abaume pa maka nganshi. Kabili baipaya abana bakwe Yonatani, Abinadabu na Malikishua.

english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.
translation: Awe ubulwi bwabipisha nganshi pali Saulo. Elyo abamata basuka bamusanga no kumucena bubi bubi.

english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
translation: Elyo Saulo aeba kasenda wa fyanso fyakwe ati, “Somona ulupanga lobe umpwishishishe, epali aba bantu abashasembululwa ebo bese banjipaye babikepo no kunseka.” Lelo kasenda wa fyanso aba no mwenso, akaana ukumucita ifyo aebelwe. Kanshi Saulo epakubuula ulupanga lwakwe no kuwilapo.

english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.
translation: Ilyo kasenda wa fyanso fyakwe amona ukuti Saulo afwa, nao epakuwila pa lupanga lwakwe no kufwila pamo nankwe.

english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli abali ku lubali lumbi ulwe shika na bonse abalungatene na Yordani bamona ukuti ifita fya bena Israeli fyafulumuka, nokuti Saulo na bana bakwe abaume nabafwa, awe nabo basha imisumba yabo no kufulumuka. Elyo na Bafilisiti baishile no kwamba ukulaikala muli iyi imisumba.

english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, ilyo Abafilisiti baishile kukutapa ifintu ku bafwile, elyo basanga Saulo na bana bakwe batatu abaume nabafwa pa lupili lwa Giliboa.

english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.
translation: Baputula umutwe wakwa Saulo no kumufuula ifyanso fyakwe elyo batuma intumi mu calo conse ica Bafilisiti mukubila imbila mu matempele ya tulubi twabo, elyo na ku bantu bonse.

english: The child Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. The LORD’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.
translation: Kanshi Eli shimapepo ewatendeke ukulangilila Samwele imilimo yakubombela Yawe. Na mu nshiku shilya, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe talyasekele. Kabili takwali ne fimonwa ifingi iyoo.

english: The LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aishile no kwiminina pantu ali, alamwita nga filya fine cali intanshi, nokutila, “Samwele! Samwele!” Nao Samwele ayasuka ati, “Soseni pantu umubomfi wenu aleumfwa.”

english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Samwele ati, “Mona, ine ndi nokucita icintu cimo ku bena Israeli icikalenga na matwi ya uyo onse uukomfwako yakawele.

english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
translation: Napali bulya ubushiku epo ine nkafikilisha fyonse ifyo nalandile pa ba ŋanda yakwa Eli no lupwa lwakwe, ukufuma apo yatendekele ukufika na ku mpela.

english: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.
translation: Pantu nalimwebele nati, ine nomba nalafikilishapo ukupingula aba mu ŋanda yakwe umupwilapo. Pantu ena alishibe ububifi bwa bana bakwe abaume ubo balecita ubwakusaalula Lesa, nokuti abakalipile iyoo.

english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”
translation: Eico nalilapile palwa ŋanda yakwa Eli ukuti ububifi bwa ŋanda yakwa Eli tabwakabale abufutilwapo kwilambo nangu umutuulo mpaka umuyayaya.”

english: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the LORD’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.
translation: Samwele epakulala palya pene mpaka ulucelo, elyo aisa isulako ifiibi fya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Nomba alitiinine ukwebako Eli icimonwa amwene.

english: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”
translation: Nomba Eli amwita no kumweba ati, “Samwele we mwana wandi.” Nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi.”

english: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”
translation: Elyo Eli amwipusha ati, “Bushe finshi bacikweba? Tecakwesha ukumfisa nelyo kamo, pantu nga wafisa conse ico akwebele, Lesa alekucitapo cimo, nelyofye cingabipisha kuti cakucitikila.”

english: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is the LORD. Let him do what seems good to him.”
translation: Elyo Samwele nao amushimikilafye fyonse ukwabula ukufisapo nelyo kamo kuli wena. Nao Eli epakusosa ati, “Ala ni Yawe, nacite conse ico umwine amwene ukuti nacilungama.”

english: Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
translation: Awe Yawe ali na Samwele mu kukula kwakwe, kabili talekele amashiwi yakwe ukonaika iyoo.

english: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),
translation: Nomba ubushiku bumo Eli, uyo amenso yakwe yaile yalenakuka icakuti tekuti amone bwino bwino, alilambaleleko mu cifulo cakwe muntu aletuushisha lyonse.

english: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
translation: Ecalengele ukufumafye ku calo cakwa Dani ukufika na ku Beresheba, bonse abena Israeli baishibe ukuti Samwele ni kasesema wakwa Yawe uwacishinka.

english: The LORD appeared again in Shiloh; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD’s word.
translation: Kabili Yawe alitwalilile ukulamonekela ku Shilo. Elyo kulya kwine eko Yawe aisokolwele umwine eka kuli Samwele ukupitila mu mashiwi yakwe.

english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in the LORD’s temple where God’s ark was,
translation: Awe ne cisaniko cakwa Lesa cali tacilaleka ukwaka, ninshi Samwele nao nalambalala mwi tempele lyakwa Yawe , umwali Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa.

english: The LORD called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aitile ati, “Samwele! Samwele!” Nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi.”

english: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.
translation: Awe nao abutwike no kuya kuli Eli nokutila, “Epo ndi. Mwacilanjita.” Lelo Eli nao amwasuka ati, “Awe teine nacilakwita. Bwelelamo, kabiye uye ulale.” Awe abwelelamo no kuya lala.

english: The LORD called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”
translation: Kabili Yawe abwekeshapo ukwita ati, “Samwele!” Kabili aima no kuya kuli Eli nokutila, “Epo ndi. Mwacilanjita.” Lelo Eli nao amwasuka ati, “We mwana wandi, teine ndekwita. Kabiye bwelelamo no kuya lala.”

english: Now Samuel didn’t yet know the LORD, neither was the LORD’s word yet revealed to him.
translation: Nomba Samwele ena aali talaishiba Yawe, elyo ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe lyali talilasokolwelwa kuli ena.

english: The LORD called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.
translation: Kabili Yawe abwekeshepo ukwita Samwele umuku walenga itatu. Nao aima no kuya kuli Eli ayatila, “Epo ndi. Mwacilanjita.” Elyo Eli ailwike ukuti ni Yawe euleita umulumendo.

english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, LORD; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
translation: Eico Eli aebele Samwele ati, “Bwekelamo kabiye ulale, nomba nga cakuti waumfwa bakwita, usose auti, ‘Soseni mwe Yawe, pantu umubomfi wenu aleumfwa.’” Samwele epakuya lala nakabili mu cifulo cakwe.

english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.
translation: Kabili amashiwi yakwa Samwele yaumfwike kuli bonse abena Israeli.

english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.
translation: Kanshi Abafilisiti balilwishishe no kucimfya abena Israeli, icakuti cila muntu afulumukila kumwakwe. Awe ukwipaiwa kwali ukukalamba nganshi. Abena Israeli balofeshe imyeo ukulingana na makana amakumi yatatu (30,000) aya fita ifyaleenda pa makasa.

english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
translation: Awe bapokolola ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa. Kabili bonse babili abana baume bakwa Eli, Hofini na Fineasi, nababepaya.

english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
translation: Pa bushiku bumo bwine umwina Benjamini umo afulumwike ukufuma kuntu balelwila, no kuya ku Shilo, ninshi ifyakufwala fyakwe nafilepauka no lukungu ku mutwe onse.

english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.
translation: Ilyo afikilefye, amona Eli naikala pa cipuna cakwe mumbali ya musebo, alekutika, pantu umutima wakwe waletutuma pa mulandu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa. Eico ilyofye uyu muntu afikile mu musumba no kushimika ifyacitike, abantu bonse mu musumba basowesha mukulila imisowa.

english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.
translation: Ilyo Eli nao aumfwa ukupunda kwa misowa, aipusha abantu ati, “Nga ici icongo cakula ifi camusango nshi?” Elyo uyu muntu nao mukwangufyanya aya shimikila Eli.

english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.
translation: Pali iyi nshita Eli ali ne myaka amakumi pabula na cine konse konse (98). Kabili na menso yakwe ninshi nayanaka, yalefilwa no kulamona.

english: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”
translation: Uyu muntu epakweba Eli ati, “Ala ine, nombaline nafuma ku bulwi. Mfulumwikeko ilelo linefye.” Nao Eli amwipusha ati, “Nga finshi ficitikeko uku kuntu we mwana wandi?”

english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”
translation: Umuntu uwaletele ilyashi nao atile, “Abena Israeli nabafulumuka ukufuma ku Bafilisiti. Kabili ifita ifingi nafifwa ifya bena Israeli. Elyo bonse babili abana bobe abaume Hofini na Fineasi nabo bene na babepaya. Kabili Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa nayo ine nabapokolola.”

english: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.
translation: Awe ilyofye alumbula palwa Mbokoshi yakwa Lesa, Eli apona pa cipuna cakwe ubuseneme, lubali lwa ku mpongolo. Umukoshi wakwe wafunika, no kufwa afwa. Pantu kwena ali mwaume umukote kabili uwafina. Atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yane (40).

english: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.
translation: Elyo muka Fineasi, nafyala wakwa Eli, ali pabukulu elyo ne nshita yakupapa nayo yali mupepi. Ilyo aumfwile ilyashi lyakuti Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa nabapokolola, elyo nokuti bashifyala elyo no mulume wakwe nabo bonse nabafwa, awe alikomenwe ne fumo no kufyala umwana, pantu ubukali bwa kukomwa kwe fumo bwalicililemo.

english: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.
translation: Abafilisiti batantike ifita fyabo kukukumanya abena Israeli. Ilyo batendeke ukulwa, abena Israeli balibacimfishe ku Bafilisiti, abaipeye abantu ukulingana na makana yane (4,000) apo pene pa cibansa ca bulwi.

english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.
translation: Elyo na pa nshita yakufwa, umwanakashi uwalemusunga atile, “Witiina, naupapa umwana umwaume.” Lelo wena tayaswike, nangufye ukuposako amano.

english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
translation: Ainike umwana ishina lya Ikabodi, ilyalola mukutila, “Ubucindami bwa bena Israeli nabupwa,” pantu Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa naipokololwa, elyo na pa mulandu wa mfwa yakwa shifyala no mulume wakwe.

english: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
translation: Ukuf 25:22

english: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has the LORD defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”
translation: Ilyo ifita fyabwelelamo ku nkambi, bacilolo ba bena Israeli batile, “Bushe cinshi ico Yawe alekela Abafilisiti ukuti batucimfye pa bushiku bwa lelo? Natuye buula Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe ku Shilo pakuti tuleendafye nayo, elyo iletupusushako ukufuma na ku maboko ya balwani besu.”

english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
translation: Abantu epekutuma abaume ku Shilo mukuya buula Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe umwine wa fita, uyo waikala pakati ka bakerubi. Kabili bamwana Eli shimapepo bonse babili, Hofini na Fineasi, nabo bene eko bali pamo ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa.

english: When the ark of the LORD’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.
translation: Ilyo bafishishe Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe mu nkambi, abena Israeli bonse baliweleshe ukuwelesha ukukalamba icakuti no mushili watenta.

english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that the LORD’s ark had come into the camp.
translation: Pakumfwa ukuwelesha kwa congo icikalamba nganshi, Abafilisiti batile, “Bushe kuwelesha kwa musango nshi uko mu nkambi ya Bahibulu?” Ilyo baishibe ukuti Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe naisa mu nkambi,

english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.
translation: Abafilisiti baikatwa umwenso, balanda nokuti, “Umulungu nawisa mu nkambi,” kabili balanda nokuti, “Awe nomba twaba mu bwafya, pantu icintu ca musango uyu tacabala acicitika!

english: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
translation: Akalanda kuli ifwe! Bushe nani akatupokololako ukufuma ku maboko ya iyi milungu iyamaka yonse? Eiyi ine milungu yakomawile abena Egupto ku fikuko ifyalekana lekana mu matololo.

english: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”
translation: Eico kanshi kosenifye mwe Bafilisiti! Mube abaume, epali mwaba abasha ku bahibulu, pamo ngefyo baba abasha kuli imwe. Mubefye abaume, no kulwisha!”

english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
translation: Ilyo Abafilisiti bapokele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa, baifumishe ku Ebenesa no kuitwala ku Ashidodi.

english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”
translation: Kabili babuula Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa wa bena Israeli baitwala ku Ekironi. Ilyofye Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa yaingile mu Ekironi, abantu ba mu musumba wa Ekironi balaipundilafye abene abati, “Cinshi batuletela Imbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli kukwisa twipaya pamo na bantu besu?”

english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
translation: Eico balonganike bonse bakateeka ba Bafilisiti no kubeba ukuti, “Bweseshenimo Imbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli. Muibweseshe ku cifulo caiko, epali limbi kuti yatwipaya pamo na bantu besu.” Balandile ifi pantu imfwa yatiinishe abantu bonse mu musumba. Kabili ukuboko kwakwa Lesa kwatitikishe abantu nganshi.

english: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
translation: Abapuswike ku mfwa bena balwele ifipute, icakuti no kupunda kwa bantu aba mu musumba kwasukile kwaumfwika na ku mulu.

english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
translation: Elyo basendele Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa no kuitwala mu ŋanda balepepelamo umulungu wabo Dagoni, no kuya ibika ku lubali lwakwa Dagoni.

english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.
translation: Ilyo abena Ashidodi babukile ulucelo mu bushiku bwakonkelepo, basanga Dagoni nawa panshi ubukupeme ku ntanshi ya Mbokoshi yakwa Yawe. Awe baimishe Dagoni no kumubika pa cifulo cakwe.

english: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.
translation: Lelo ilyo babukile ulucelo ubushiku bwakonkelepo, kabili nalyo basanga Dagoni nawa panshi ubukupeme ku ntanshi ya Mbokoshi yakwa Yawe. Kabili umutwe wakwe na maboko nafiputukako, filele na pa mwinshi kushelefye icitimbatimba ceka.

english: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
translation: Uyu e mulandu wine na pa bushiku bwa lelo, caba ukuti nangufye ni bashimapepo bakwa Dagoni, nangu bonse abengila mu ŋanda ya mapepo yakwa Dagoni ku Ashidodi, bashinyantila pa mwinshi wakwa Dagoni.

english: But the LORD’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.
translation: Awe ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwatitikishe nganshi abantu ba mu Ashidodi, na bonse abali mu pepi nabo. Kabili abalengele ukuti babe no mwenso ukalamba nganshi, no kubalwalika ifipute.

english: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”
translation: Ilyo abena Ashidodi bamwene ifyalebacitikila, batile, “Imbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli tailingile kwikala kuno na ifwe, pantu ukuboko kwauko nakufinisha pali ifwe kabili na pali Dagoni umulungu wesu.”

english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.
translation: Ecalengele ukuti balonganike bonse bakateeka ba Bafilisiti no kubepusha ukutila, “Bushe ifwe nomba tuli nokucita shani neyi Mbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli?” Nabo batile, “Lekeni Imbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli tuitwale ku Gati.” Kanshi epakutwala Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa wa bena Israeli ku Gati.

english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, the LORD’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.
translation: Lelo panuma ya kutwala iyi Mbokoshi ku Gati, ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwaimiine uyu musumba, abantu bonse baiketwe no mwenso ukalamba. Yawe alwalike abantu bonse mu musumba, abaice na bakalamba, bonse bakumenefye ifipute.

english: The LORD’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
translation: Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe yali mu calo ca Bafilisiti imyeshi cine lubali.

english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
translation: Awe nabo bacita ifyo fine babebele. Babuula iŋombe shibili no kushikakila kwiceleta elyo bayaisalila no twana twashiko mwitanga.

english: They put the LORD’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.
translation: Babika ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe pa mulu we celeta, elyo mu fyakusendelamo ifya mumbali babikamo ifya golide ifyapala bakwindi ne fya golide ifyapala ifipute.

english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.
translation: Iŋombe shalungamafye ku Beti Shemeshi, ukukonkafye umusebo umo wine shile shilelila pakwenda, ukwabula ukupasukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso. Intungulushi sha Bafilisiti shaya nashikonka panuma mpakafye na ku mupaka wa ku Beti Shemeshi.

english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
translation: Nomba abantu ba mu Beti Shemeshi baleseepa iŋanu shabo mwishika. Cilya bati benuke bamona Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, awe epakutemwa nganshi pakuya ipokelela.

english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to the LORD.
translation: Iceleta lyaisa na mwibala lyakwa Yoshua umwina Beti Shemeshi no kwiminina ku mbali ya cilibwe icikalamba. Abantu balepaula inkuni ukufuma kwiceleta no kutuula iŋombe shine kuli Yawe nge lambo lyakoca.

english: The Levites took down the LORD’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.
translation: Elyo abena Levi baisha Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe, pamo ne fyakusendelamo ifyali mumbali umwali ifintu ifya golide, no kufibika pa mulu wa cilibwe icikalamba. Pa bushiku ubu epo abantu ba mu Beti Shemeshi batuulile umutuulo wakoca no kuleka amalambo kuli Yawe.

english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.
translation: Ilyo intungulushi shisano isha Bafilisiti shamwene ifi fyonse, pa bushiku bwine bulya shabwelelamo na ku Ekironi.

english: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to the LORD: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;
translation: Aba e bagolide abapala ifipute abo Abafilisiti batumine ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi kuli Yawe. Umo kuli Ashidodi, Gasa, Eshikeloni, Gati elyo na Ekironi.

english: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down the LORD’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
translation: Kabili impendwa ya golide iyapala bakwindi, ili nokuba ukulingana ne mpendwa ya misumba ya Bafilisiti iya ntungulushi shisano iyamalinga pamo pene ne mishi yabo iya mu calo iyishacingililwa. Icilibwe cikalamba ico babikilepo Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, e kambone mu bushiku bwa lelo mwibala lyakwa Yoshua umwina Beti Shemeshi.

english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into the LORD’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter.
translation: Lelo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Yekonia bena tabasekelele capamo na bena Beti Shemeshi, ilyo kwali ukupokelela Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe. Kanshi Yawe epakwipayapo abantu abali amakumi cine lubali (70) pa mulandu wakulengela mu Mbokoshi ya Cipangano. Abantu epakuloosha apakalamba nganshi pa bwingi bwa bantu Yawe aipeye.

english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the LORD’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”
translation: Abafilisiti baita bashimapepo na bakabuka babo no kutila kuli bena, “Twalacita shani ku Mbokoshi yakwa Yawe? Twebeni ifyo twinga ibweseshamo ku ncende yaiko.”

english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before the LORD, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”
translation: Elyo abaume abena Beti Shemeshi baipusha abati, “Nani wingeminina ku cinso cakwa Yawe, uyu mulungu uwamushilo? Ni kuli nani Imbokoshi ya Cipangano yalaya pakuti tumufumye pano?”

english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back the LORD’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”
translation: Elyo batuma inkombe ku bantu ba ku Kiriati Yarimu nokutila, “Abafilisiti nababwesha Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe. Iseni, mwise musende Imbokoshi muitwale ku ncende kumwenu.”

english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Nga cakuti mwabweseshamo Imbokoshi ya mulungu wa bena Israeli, mwikaibweseshamo umwabula nelyo cimo, lelo mu nshilafye yonse mukabikemo no mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Lyena muli nokupola elyo nokulubuka kabili muli nokwishiba neco ukuboko kwakwe takwafumine pali imwe.”

english: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.
translation: Abafilisiti baipusha abati, “Bushe mutuulo nshi uwakufuta pa fyabubifi tuli nokutuma kuli ena?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Ifimpashanya ifyapala ifipute ifya golide fisano ne fimpashanya ifyapala bakwindi ifya golide fisano, ukulingana ne mpendwa sha bakateeka ba Bafilisiti, pantu icikuko cimo cine icili pali imwe bonse ecili na pa ntungulushi shenu.

english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
translation: Kanshi eico pangeni ifyapala ifipute ne fyapala bakwindi ifileonaula icalo, efyo mucindikilepo umulungu wa bena Israeli. Nalimo kuti afumya ukuboko kwakwe pali imwe, pa milungu yenu elyo na pa calo cenu.

english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?
translation: Bushe cinshi mwalafwaila ukukosha imitima yenu nga filya abena Egupto pamo na Farao bacitile? Panuma yakubaletela ubucushi, bushe telyo balekele abena Israeli ukufuma nokuti baleya?

english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;
translation: Nomba kanshi pekanyeni iceleta ilipya, iŋombe shibili ishileonsha kabili isho bashatala abakakapo amakoli. Ishi iŋombe mushikakile kwiceleta, no kubweseshamo utwana kwitanga no kutwisalila.

english: and take the LORD’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.
translation: Mubuule Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe no kuibika pa mulu we celeta kabili mu fyakusendelamo fya mumbali mubikemo ifipe ifya golide mule mutumina ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Elyo mulitume no kuleka lileya.

english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”
translation: Lelo mulelimona ilyo lileya. Nomba nga cakuti lyalaya ku calo caliko, ukulungama ku Beti Shemeshi, ninshi Yawe ewaleta ici cinkunka icikalamba pali ifwe. Lelo nga cakuti talilungemeko, elyo tuli nokwishiba ukuti te kuboko kwakwe kwatuletele ici, lelo catuponenefye epela.”

english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took the LORD’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the LORD’s ark.
translation: Elyo abaume ba ku Kiriati Yarimu baishile no kusenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe, baleta ku ŋanda yakwa Abinadabu iyabelele pa lupili. Kabili bacita umwana wakwe umwaume Eleasa abe uwapatulwa pakuti alelinda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe.

english: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.
translation: Mu nshita ine ilya Samwele acili aletuula ilambo lyakoca kuli Yawe, Abafilisiti bapalama kukulwisha abena Israeli. Lelo pali bulya bushiku, Yawe abulukuta nge mfula kwishiwi ilikalamba no kubafulunganya icakuti bafulumuka ukufuma ku cinso ca bena Israeli.

english: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.
translation: Abena Israeli epakufuma mu Misipa no kukunkunika Abafilisiti, baya balebakomaula nshila yonse mpakafye ku mutentemuko wa Beti-Kari.

english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “The LORD helped us until now.”
translation: Elyo Samwele abuula ilibwe, alibika pakati ka Misipa na Yeshana, alinika ne shina lya Ebenesa, elyo atile, “Ukufika na pano Yawe ewatwafwile.”

english: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. The LORD’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
translation: Kanshi Abafilisiti epakucimba, kabili tababwekeshepo ukufwaya ukupokolola icalo ca bena Israeli nakabili. Elyo na pa nshita ya bumi bwakwa Samwele, ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwalifye ukwafina pa Bafilisiti.

english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
translation: Ne misumba Abafilisiti bapokolwele ku bena Israeli ukufuma ku Ekironi ukufika ku Gati, yalibweshiwe. Abena Israeli bapokolola ne ncende shabo ishapalamineko ukufuma ku maka ya Bafilisiti. Elyo kwaba umutende pakati ka bena Israeli na bena Amoli.

english: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
translation: Samwele atwalilile ngo mupingushi pakati ka bena Israeli mu nshiku shonse isha bumi bwakwe.

english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
translation: Cila mwaka aleenda ukufuma ku Betele, Giligali na ku Misipa, mukupingula abena Israeli mu ncende shonse ishi.

english: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to the LORD there.
translation: Aleti nga apwisha elyo alebwelelamo ku Rama ukwali iŋanda yakwe, kabili nako kwine alepingula abena Israeli. Elyo akuula no bulambo bwakwa Yawe kulya kwine.

english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.

Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to the LORD, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”
translation: Elyo Samwele epakusosa ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli yonse ati, “Nga cakuti mulebwelela kuli Yawe ne mitima yenu yonse, italusheni ku milungu ya benafyalo na ku ba Ashitoreti, no kuipeelesha mwe bene kuli Yawe no kulamubombela ekafye, lyena nao akamupususha ku minwe ya Bafilisiti.”

english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakutaluka ku milungu ba Baali na ba Ashitoreti, no kwamba ukulabombela Yawe eka.

english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD for you.”
translation: Imila 13:5-7

english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against the LORD.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.
translation: Kanshi abantu bonse epakulongana ku Misipa, batapa na menshi no kwitila panshi ku cinso cakwa Yawe. Na pa bushiku ubo, bafunga ukulya balanda nokuti, “Natubifya kuli Yawe.” Kabili Samwele ewali umupingushi wa bena Israeli ku Misipa.

english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
translation: Kabili ilyo Abafilisiti baumfwile ukuti abena Israeli nabalongana ku Misipa, bacilolo ba Bafilisiti balimine no kuya kukubalwisha. Lelo ilyo abena Israeli baumfwile, batiinine nganshi Abafilisiti.

english: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baebele Samwele abati, “Wileka ukutupapatila kuli Yawe Lesa wesu, pakuti atupusushe ukufuma ku kuboko kwa Bafilisiti.”

english: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to the LORD. Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.
translation: Elyo Samwele abuula akana ka mpaanga akashilasumuka no kukatuula nge lambo lyakoca kuli Yawe. Alilile kuli Yawe, mukupapatilako abena Israeli, elyo Yawe nao amwasuka.

english: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
translation: Ilyo Samwele akotele, asontele abana bakwe abaume ukuba abapingushi ba bena Israeli.

english: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
translation: Samwele nao epakulondolwela abantu abaishile mukumwipusha palwa kukwata imfumu amashiwi yonse ayakwa Yawe.

english: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
translation: Abeba ati, “Ifi efyo imfumu iyili nokumuteeka ili nokulacita. Ili nokulasenda abana benu abaume no kubapeela imilimo yakubomba ku maceleta yaiko, na pali bakabalwe, elyo bambi bakalabutuka pa ntanshi ya maceleta yaiko.

english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.
translation: Bamo akabalenga ukuba intungulushi sha pa fita amakana (1,000), elyo na pa fita amakumi yasano (50). Bambi nabo ukulima umushili no kusombola ifisabo fyaiko, kabili bambi nabo ukupanga ifyanso fya nkondo, no kupanga ifibombelo fya maceleta yaiko.

english: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
translation: Ali nokusenda abana benu abanakashi ukuba bakenga wa mafuta yanunka ubusaka, abakwipika, elyo na bakupanga imikate.

english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.
translation: Amaf 17:14

english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.
translation: Ali nokubuulapo cimo pa capekumi cenu pa fisabo na pa fya myangashi no kupeela kuli bacilolo elyo na babomfi bakwe.

english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.
translation: Ababomfi benu abaume na banakashi, iŋombe shenu ishawamisha na bapunda, akafibuula fikaba fibombelo fyakwe.

english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
translation: Ali nokubuulapo cimo pa capekumi ca fitekwa fyenu, elyo imwe mwe bene muli nokuba abasha bakwe.

english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”
translation: Ilyo bulya bushiku bukafika, mukakabila Yawe ukumupususha ukufuma kuli iyi mfumu muisalile mwe bene, lelo Yawe nao takamwasuke muli bulya bushiku.”

english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,
translation: Lelo abantu bakaanininafye ukumfwa kwishiwi lyakwa Samwele, nokutila, “Iyoo! Ifwe tulefwayafye imfumu iyakututeeka,

english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
translation: Umwana wakwe ibeli ishina lyakwe ali ni Yoeli, kabili ishina lya cikonkebeli ali ni Abiya, ebali abapingushi ku Beresheba.

english: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
translation: pakuti na ifwe tukabe nge mishobo imbi. Tulefwaya na ifwe tukwate mfumu yakututungulula kabili nokututangilila pakufuma ilyo tulelwa ubulwi.”

english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
translation: Ilyo Samwele aumfwa fyonse ifyo abantu basosele, aya fisosa nakabili kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
translation: Yawe nao ayasuka ati, “Umfwila amashiwi yabo no kubapeela imfumu.” Elyo Samwele aeba abaume abena Israeli ukubwelelamo ku cifulo cila umo afumako.

english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
translation: Lelo abana bakwe bafilwa ukulakonka ukwenda mu nshila shakwe, bayalukila mu nshila shakufwaisha indalama no kulasumina amafisakanwa no kupingwila imilandu mu bubifi.

english: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.
translation: Elyo bonse abakalamba ba bena Israeli balongana pamo no kwisa kuli Samwele ku Rama.

english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
translation: Cilya bamusanga, bamweba abati, “Mona, iwe naukota, elyo abana bobe abaume tabalekonka mu nshila shobe, kanshi tusontele imfumu iyakuti iletutungulula pamo ngefyo imishobo yonse yacita.”

english: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.
translation: Nomba ilyo batile, “Tupeeleni imfumu iyakututungulula,” Samwele tatemenwe. Elyo Samwele apepa kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
translation: Yawe nao amweba ati, “Umfwila ku fintu abantu bonse balekweba, pantu teiwe basuulile, nine basuulile nge mfumu yabo.

english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.
translation: Ifi fine efyo bacita na kuli ine, ukufuma pa bushiku nabafumishe mu calo ca Egupto ukufika mu bushiku bwa lelo, ifyakunsangukila no kulatumikila imilungu imbi, kanshi ifi fine eifi balecita na kuli iwe wine.

english: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
translation: Nomba iwe bomfwilefye, lelo ubasoke na maka, no kubebukisha ifyo imfumu iyo balefwaya ikalacita pali bena.”

english: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.
translation: Mu bena Benjamini mwali umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Kishi umwana mwaume wakwa Abieli, umwana mwaume wakwa Serori, umwana mwaume wakwa Bekorati, umwana mwaume wakwa Afia umwina Benjamini umukankala nganshi.

english: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.
translation: Saulo atile ku mubomfi wakwe, “Cawama walanda bwino, isa tuleya.” Epakwima baya na ku musumba ukwali umuntu wakwa Lesa.

english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”
translation: Ilyo baleninika ulupili pakuya ku musumba, bakumanya abakashana bamo abaleisa mukutapa amenshi, elyo babepusha abati, “Bushe kamona eko ali?”

english: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Ee uyo ali ku ntanshi yenu. Angufyanyeni nombaline pantu lelo line elyo eshile muno musumba wesu. Kabili e bushiku abantu baletuula amalambo pa ncende iyakupepelapo.

english: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”
translation: Nga mwaingilafye mu musumba, mulemusanga ilyo talaya pamulu pa ncende yakupepelapo kukulya. Abantu tekuti batampe ukulya ilyo talafika. Pantu euli nokupaala ifya malambo, elyo abo bonse abetilwe bali nokwamba ukulya. Kabiyeni nineni pamulu nombaline, pa nshita ino kuti mwamusanga.”

english: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.
translation: Elyo baile ku musumba, kabili ilyo baleingila mu musumba bamwene Samwele nao ali mu nshila aleisa kuli bena, aleya ku ncende yakupepelapo.

english: Now the LORD had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
translation: Nomba mu bushiku bwa kunuma ilyo Saulo talaisa, Yawe alisokolwele ici kuli Samwele ati,

english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”
translation: “Mailo pa nshita nga ino ine, nkakutumina umwaume umo ukufuma ku calo cakwa Benjamini. Ukamusube amafuta yakuba kateeka wa pa bantu bandi abena Israeli. Akapususha abantu bandi ukufuma ku kuboko kwa Bafilisiti, pantu nimona ukucula kwabo, no kulilishika kwabo nakufika kuli ine.”

english: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”
translation: Ilyo Samwele amwene Saulo, Yawe atile kuli wena, “Uyu e muntu nakwebele ukuti euli nokuba kateeka wa bantu bandi.”

english: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”
translation: Elyo Saulo apalamina kuli Samwele mukati ka mpongolo nokutila, “Shi napapata, nangeniko uko iŋanda yakwa kamona yabela?”

english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.
translation: Elyo Samwele ayasuka Saulo ati, “Nine wine kamona. Tangila unine ku ncende yakupepelapo, pantu niwe ilelo tulelila pamo na ine. Elyo ulucelo nkaleka ukaleya kabili nkakweba fyonse ifili mu mutima obe.

english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
translation: Alikwete umwana umwaume uwe shina lya Saulo, umulumendo uwayemba bwino. Mu bena Israeli tamwali uwalingene nankwe ukuwama. Kabili tamwali nelyo umo uwalepele ukumucila, bonse balepelafye pa mabeya yakwe.

english: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wa bapunda balya baluba pali ishi nshiku shitatu shapita, wiposako mano yobe, bonsefye nabamoneka. Kabili ni kuli nani ukukabila konse ukwa bena Israeli kuli nokuya, nga cakuti tekuli iwe na ku ba ŋanda ya bashinwe?”

english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”
translation: Saulo ayasuka ati, “Bushe ine nshili umwina Benjamini, uwa mu luko ulwacepesha mu bena Israeli? Kabili no lupwa lwandi elwacepesha pa ndupwa shonse isha nko sha bena Benjamini. Nga cinshi wasosela icintu ici kuli ine?”

english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.
translation: Elyo Samwele asenda Saulo no mubomfi wakwe mu ŋanda ya maliila, abateeka kuntashi ya balalikwe abali mu mpendwa nalimo amakumi yatatu (30).

english: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”
translation: Samwele atile ku waleipika, “Leta icipande ca nama nacikupeela, ico nacitila ucibike ceka.”

english: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.
translation: Uwaleipika nao abuula umwendo na fyonse ifyaliko no kufipalamika ku ntanshi yakwa Saulo. Elyo Samwele atile, “Ifi efyo bacikubikila, lya, pantu fyapeelwa pa nshita iyasontwa pakuti ulile pamo na bashimucindikwa.” Elyo Saulo alile pamo na Samwele pali bulya bushiku.

english: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.
translation: Ilyo babwelele ukufuma ku ncende yakupepelapo ukwisa ku musumba, Samwele alanshenye na Saulo pa mulu wa ŋanda yakwe epo bamupekanishisha na pakusendama.

english: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.
translation: Bonse babuka lucelocelo, elyo Samwele aitile Saulo uwali pa mutenge ati, “Ima uipekanye pakuti nkuleke uleya.” Ilyo Saulo aipekanya ena na Samwele bafumina panse bonse.

english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”
translation: Cilyafye bafika lwa ku mpela ya musumba, Samwele aeba Saulo ati, “Eba umubomfi obe atangile ku ntanshi yesu. Elyo nga atangila, iwe ubale ushaleko pano pene panono, pakuti nkwebe ishiwi ukufuma kuli Lesa.”

english: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”
translation: Nomba bapunda bakwa Kishi wishi wakwa Saulo balilubile. Elyo Kishi aeba umwana wakwe Saulo ati, “Senda umubomfi umo, muye nankwe no kuya mukufwaya bapunda.”

english: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.
translation: Kanshi nabo epakulalanya icalo ca mpili ica bena Efulemu elyo apulinkanya na mu calo ca Shalisha, no kubasanga iyoo. Kabili apulinkanya na mu calo ca Shalimu noko kwine tabaliko. Elyo atwalilila ukufwaya, alalanya icalo ca bena Benjamini, nako kwine tabaliko.

english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”
translation: Ilyo bafikile ku Sufi, Saulo aeba umubomfi uo bali nankwe ati, “Tuleya tubwelelemo, pantu batata kuti baleka ukutontonkanya pali bapunda no kwamba ukusakamana pali ifwe.”

english: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”
translation: Elyo umubomfi amwasuka ati, “Moneni muli uno musumba mwaliba umuntu wakwa Lesa uwacindikwa nganshi, kabili conse ico asosa cilaba cacishinka. Kanshi natuleyako nomba, nalimo kuti atwebako inshila twingayamo.”

english: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”
translation: Elyo Saulo ayaswike umubomfi wakwe ati, “Nga cakuti twayako ni cinshi ico tuleya peela uyu muntu? Pantu ifilyo nafipwa mu mifuko yesu. Tatukwete icabupe icakutwala ku muntu wakwa Lesa. Bushe cinshi tukwetepo?”

english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”
translation: Umubomfi abwekeshapo ukwasuka Saulo nakabili ati, “Moneni ine ninkwatapo akandalama kamo aka silifa , efyo ndeya peela ku muntu wakwa Lesa pakuti aye tulanga bwino inshila tuli nokuyamo.”

english: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)
translation: Mu nshita shakale mu Israeli umuntu nga aya kukwipusha fimo kuli Lesa, alesosa ati, “Iseni, tuleya kuli kamona.” Pantu ino nshita uwitwa kasesema, kale aleitwa ukuti ni kamona.

english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Ine Paulo na Sailasi na Timote, twamulembela mwe lukuta lwa mu Tesalonika, mwe baampana na Lesa Tata ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu. Icikuuku no mutende fileba na imwe.

english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
translation: Lyena epakulalolela ukwisa kwa Mwana wakwe Yesu ukufuma ku mulu, uo abushishe ku bafwa, eutupususha ku bukali bwakwa Lesa ubuleisa.

english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
translation: Lyonsefye tulatasha Lesa pa mulandu wa imwe bonse, kabili lyonsefye tulamupepelako mu mapepo yesu.

english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
translation: Lyonse ilyo tupepa Lesa wesu kabili Shifwe, tulebukisha ifyo mubomba pa mulandu wa cisumino cenu. Twibukisha no kubombesha kwenu pa mulandu wa citemwiko cenu. Twibukisha nefyo isubilo lyenu mu Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu lyaba ilyakosa.

english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, twalishiba ukuti Lesa alimutemwa, kabili alimusala.

english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
translation: Pantu ilyo twamuletele Imbila Nsuma, tatwaishile na mashiwi yekafye iyoo, lelo twaishile na maka na Mupashi Wamushilo nefyo twashininkisha umupwilapo. Mwalishiba ifyo twaleikala ilyo twali na imwe, fyali fyakumwafwilishako.

english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
translation: Mwasukile mwalapashanya ifwe pamo ne Mfumu. Nangu mwaculile nganshi, mwapokelele Imbila Nsuma ne nsansa isho Mupashi Wamushilo apeela.

english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
translation: Eico, imwe mwaba nomba icilangililo kuli bonse abasumina aba mu Makedonia na mu Akaia.

english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.
translation: Amashiwi ya Mfumu tayasalanganafye mu Makedonia na mu Akaia ukufuma kuli imwe, lelo ilyashi lya pa cisumino cenu muli Lesa, lyalisalangana mpanga yonse. Awe tapali ico twingalandapo pali ici.

english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
translation: Abantu abene ebalanda pafyo mwatupokelele bwino. Balanda na pafyo mwafuma kukupepa utulubi, mwayalukila kukupepa Lesa, pakuti mulebombela Lesa wine wine kabili uwamweo.

english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, imwe mwe bene mwalishiba ukuti tatwaicushishefye pakwisa kuli imwe.

english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
translation: Imibeele yesu kuli imwe mwe basumina, yali iyakaele, iyamushilo, kabili iyabulamo icilubo. Imwe nimwe bene bakambone besu pamo na Lesa.

english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
translation: Mwalishiba nefyo twalemulela bonse umo umo nga filya shibo alela abana bakwe.

english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
translation: Twalemucincisha no kumukoselesha no kumweba ukuti, muleikala imikalile iyakusansamusha Lesa uwamwita kukumupeela Ubufumu no bucindami bwakwe bwine.

english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
translation: Kuliko no mulandu umbi uo lyonse tutashishapo Lesa. Ilyo twamuletele amashiwi yakwa Lesa, mwayomfwile no kuyapokelela nga mashiwi ayafuma kuli Lesa, te ku bantu iyoo. Kabili cacine eko yafuma. Aya mashiwi eyabomba muli imwe, mwe basumina.

english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ala ifintu ifyamuponena, efyaponena ne nkuta shakwa Lesa isha mu Yudeya. Abantu benu aba mu calo cenu ebamucusha imwe, nga filya Abayuda balecusha abena Yudeya.

english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
translation: Bayuda bene ebaipeye Imfumu Yesu na bakasesema, kabili ebaletutamfya na ifwe. Muli ifi tabasansamusha Lesa iyoo! Balwani ku muntu onse.

english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
translation: Baeseshe no kutukaanya ukushimikila Abenafyalo amashiwi yakubaletela ukupusuka. Mukucita ifi, basuka bapwishishisha ukufikilisha ifyabubifi ifyo lyonse balecita. Eico pakulekelesha ubukali bwakwa Lesa nabwisa pali bena.

english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, pa kashita kalya ilyo batupatikishe ukumusha, twalekelefye ukumumona mu menso, lelo tatwalekele ukulamwibukisha. Twamufulwike nganshi, elyo twafwaishe nganshi ukumumona nakabili.

english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
translation: Twaeseshe ukwisa mupempula. Imiku iyingi, ine wine Paulo nalefwaya ukwisa mupempula, lelo Satana alefulunganya ukuti twise.

english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
translation: Mwalishiba ifyo twaculile no kutukwa mu Filipi ilyo twali tatulaisa kuli imwe ku Tesalonika. Nangu kwali ukupusana na bantu abengi, Lesa wesu alitupeele ukushipa pakumushimikila Imbila Nsuma yakwe.

english: For you are our glory and our joy.
translation: Cine cinefye tulomfwa icilumba ne nsansa nganshi pali imwe.

english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
translation: Ilyo twalemufunda tatwalefwaya ukumutwala mu cilubo nangu ukumutwala kukubifya nangu ukwesha ukubepa umuntu nelyo umo. Imitima yesu yalifye iyatambalala.

english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
translation: Lelo tulanda ifyo Lesa alefwaya ukuti tulande, pantu Lesa alitumona ukuti natulinga, epakutupeela no mulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma. Eico tatusansamusha bantu iyoo, tusansamusha Lesa uumona ifyaba mu mitima yesu.

english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
translation: Mwalishibafye bwino ukuti tatwaishile kuli imwe na mashiwi ayasuma ayakumubeleleka, nangu ukubomfya amashiwi yakufisa umutima wakufwailisha ifyuma. Ala Lesa e kambone wesu.

english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
translation: Tatwalefwaya kutashiwa ku muntu nangu umo, kuli imwe nangu ku bantu bambi. Lelo nangu twaba abasole bakwa Kristu, tatwafwaile nangu cimo kuli imwe.

english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
translation: Lelo ilyo twali na imwe, twali abamutembo kuli imwe, kwati ni nyina uulesunga bamwane.

english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
translation: Pa mulandu wakumutemwisha, tatwasakamenefye ukumuletela Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa, lelo twaipeeleshe nganshi ne mitima yesu ukucita fyonse ifyakumwafwa. Twalimutemenwe nganshi.

english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, ibukisheni ifyo twalecululuka mukubombesha. Twalebomba ubwaca no bwaila pakuti twimusakamika ku cintu nelyo cimo ilyo twalebila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa kuli imwe.

english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
translation: Kanshi pa mulandu wakufwaisha nganshi ukumumona, twafililwe ukushipikisha. Elyo twapingushenye ukuti ifwe tushale mu Atensi.

english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
translation: Ubwaca no bwaila tupapata Lesa ne mitima yesu yonse ukuti akaleke tukamonane kabili no kumwafwilishako kufyo mulekabila mu cisumino cenu.

english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
translation: Lesa Shifwe umwine na Yesu Imfumu yesu bengatuwamisha inshila tukese kuli imwe.

english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
translation: Imfumu yesu ingamulundilako ukutemwana mwatemwana nefyo mwatemwa abantu bonse. Mube abatemwisha bambi ngefyo ifwe twamutemwa.

english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
translation: Imfumu ingalakosha imitima yenu no kumuwamya pakuti mukabe abapwililika abamushilo pa cinso cakwa Lesa Shifwe, mpaka nelyo Yesu Imfumu yesu ikabwela na bamushilo bonse.

english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
translation: Twatumine Timote munyinefwe umubomfi munensu wakwa Lesa mu mulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu. Twamutumine ukuti ese amukoseleshe no kumucincisha mu cisumino cenu,

english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
translation: epakuti umuntu nelyo umo pali imwe enenuka pa mulandu wa aya macushi. Mwalishiba mwe bene ukuti amacushi aya, yaba nokutwishila.

english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
translation: Ilyo twali na imwe twalimwebele libela ukuti bali nokutucusha. Ngefyo mwaishiba bwino, ifyo fine efyacitika nokucitika.

english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
translation: Kanshi ilyo nafililwe ukushipikisha, nasukile natuma Timote kukwisa mona ifili icisumino cenu. Nalelanguluka lyonse ukuti, limbi Ciwa namutunka ne milimo yesu yonse nayonaika.

english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
translation: Nomba Timote nabwela ukufuma kumwenu. Naisa tushimikilako ilyashi ilisuma ilya pa cisumino cenu ne citemwiko cenu. Atushimikile ukuti lyonse mulomfwa insansa ilyo mutwibukisha, elyo kabili mulatufuluka ngefyo na ifwe tumufuluka.

english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
translation: Eico pa mulandu wenu, mwe bamunyinefwe, icisumino cenu cilatukoselesha mu mafya yesu na mu macushi yonse.

english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
translation: Ala nomba kuti twatemwa no kuba abomi apo mu bumi bwenu muli ne cisumino icakosa mu Mfumu.

english: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
translation: Pa mulandu wa imwe tulatasha Lesa wesu. Tulamutasha pa cinso cakwe pa nsansa atupeela. Tulamutasha pa mulandu wa imwe.

english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
translation: Pakulekelesha mwe bamunyinefwe, ibukisheni ukuti twalimufundile ifyo mufwile ukwikala pakusansamusha Lesa. Kabili ifi fine nakuba efyo mwikala. Ala nomba tulemulomba no kumupapata pa mulandu wa Mfumu Yesu twati, mulecishapo.

english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
translation: Kabili ifi efyo mucitila ababwananyina bonse aba mu calo ca Makedonia. Kanshi mwe bamunyinefwe, tulemupapata ukuti mulecishapo ukucita ifyo fine.

english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
translation: Mulefwaisha ukwikala abataluka ku fyakukansana, mulesakamana ukubomba imilimo yenu, elyo muleibombela mwe bene pakumona ifyakulya ngefyo twamwebele kale.

english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
translation: Nga mulecita ifi, mukalenga balya abashasumina ukumucindika. Elyo kabili mukakwata ifyo mulekabila, tamwakalekabila ukuti abantu bambi bamupeele ifyo mulefwaya.

english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, tulefwaya ukuti mwishibe bwino pa mulandu wa bafwile nabasumina. Tulefwaya mwishibe ifi, pakuti mwilalilishika nga balya abashakwata isubilo.

english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
translation: Twasumina ukuti Yesu alifwile no kubuuka alibuukile. Kanshi kuti twasumina nokuti Lesa akababwesha abomi pamo na Yesu abo abafwile nabamusumina.

english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
translation: Ifi tulemweba nomba e fintu Imfumu yafunda. Ubushiku Imfumu ikesa, ifwe fwe bali abomi tatwakatangilile abafwile nabasumina iyoo.

english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
translation: Ishiwi ilyamaka likomfwika, malaika mukalamba akalanda, abantu bakomfwa ipenga lyakwa Lesa, elyo Imfumu ikeka ukufuma ku mulu. Elyo abo abafwile nabasumina Kristu, bakabalilapo ukubuuka.

english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
translation: Elyo ifwe fwe bali abomi pa nshita ilya, tukasendelwa pamo nabo mu makumbi kukukumanya Imfumu mu lwelele. Elyo tukalaba ne Mfumu pe na pe.

english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
translation: Kanshi efyo mulekoseleshanya kuli aya mashiwi.

english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
translation: Mwalishiba amafunde twamupeele ayafuma ku Mfumu Yesu.

english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
translation: Lesa alefwaya ukuti mube abamushilo, abataluka na ku fyabulalelale.

english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
translation: Cila muntu pali imwe eshibe ifyakusunga umubili wakwe mu nshila iyamushilo ne yamucinshi.

english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
translation: Mwilakonkelela lunkumbwa lubi kwati bantu abashaishiba Lesa.

english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
translation: Kanshi nelyo umo elafyengelesha munyina pali uyu mulandu. Twalimwebele kale ifi no kumusoka ukuti, Imfumu ikakanda abacita ifi fyonse.

english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
translation: Pantu Lesa tatwita ukuti tuleba bacilende, lelo ukuti tuleba abamushilo.

english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
translation: Eico kanshi uwasuula aya mafunde, ninshi te muntu asuula, lelo ni Lesa uwamupeela Mupashi wakwe Uwamushilo.

english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
translation: Pa mulandu wakutemwa ababwananyina pena tacilefwaikwa ukumulembelapo, pantu Lesa umwine alimufunda ifyo muli nokutemwana na banenu.

english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe tacilefwaikwa ukumulembela pa nshita no bushiku ilyo ifi fikacitika.

english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
translation: Pet 3:10

english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
translation: Eico kanshi mulekoseleshanya no kucincishanya, ngefyo fine mucita.

english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe tulemupapata ukuti mulecindika abo abalebombesha pakati kenu. Abo ebo Imfumu yasonta ukulamutungulula no kulamufunda.

english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, tulemucincisha ukuti muleebaula abanaŋani, mulekoselesha abamwenso, muleafwako abanakuka, muletekela abanenu imitima.

english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
translation: Mwilaleka umuntu nelyo umo ukulailandula pa bubi bamucitila, lelo lyonsefye mulefwaisha ukucitila abanenu na bantu bonse ifisuma.

english: Always rejoice.
translation: Mulesansamuka pe.

english: Pray without ceasing.
translation: Muleba no mute mukupepa.

english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
translation: Muletasha Lesa muli fyonse. Pantu ifi efyo Lesa afwaya ukuti mulecita apo mwaba muli Kristu Yesu.

english: Don’t quench the Spirit.
translation: Mwilalesha Mupashi Wamushilo ukubomba.

english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
translation: Awe mwalishibafye bwino bwino ukuti Ubushiku bwa Mfumu bukesa nga filya umupupu esa ubushiku.

english: Don’t despise prophecies.
translation: Mwilasuula amashiwi ya bakasesema.

english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
translation: Mulepima ifintu fyonse, mulesungapo ifisuma.

english: Abstain from every form of evil.
translation: Muletaluka ku misango yonse iyibi.

english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Lesa wamutende umwine amuwamye umupwilapo mu nshila shonse. Alemusunga ababula icilubo ku mipashi yenu, ku myeo yenu na ku mibili yenu mpaka Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ikabwele.

english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
translation: Lesa uwamwita tafutuka, no kucita akacicita.

english: Brothers, pray for us.
translation: Muletupepelako na ifwe mwe bamunyinefwe.

english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
translation: Posheni ababwananyina bonse mukutomona kwamushilo.

english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
translation: Ndemukonkomesha ukuti mubelengele bamunyinefwe bonse uyu kalata, pantu ici eco Imfumu ilefwaya.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe.

english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
translation: Ilyo abantu bakalasosa abati, “Muli umutende, takuli cakutiina,” elyo ubonaushi bukesa bapumikisha nga filya ubukali bupumikisha umwanakashi uwakomwa ne fumo. Kabili tapakabe wakupusuka nakalya.

english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
translation: Lelo nomba imwe mwe bamunyinefwe tamwaba mu mfifi, na bulya Bushiku tabwakamupumikishe ngo mupupu.

english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
translation: Imwe bonse muli bana ba lubuuto abenda akasuba. Tatwaba abana ba mfifi abenda ubushiku.

english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
translation: Kanshi tatufwile ukuba nga bantu bambi abalala utulo, lelo tuleba abalola, kabili abatekanya.

english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
translation: Ni nshita ya bushiku abantu balala utulo, kabili bushiku abantu bakolwa.

english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
translation: Lelo ifwe twenda akasuba, kanshi tuleba abatekanya. Icela tuli nokufwala icakufimba icifuba, cisumino ne citemwiko. Isubilo lyakupusuka, e cimpompo cakufwala ku mutwe.

english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Pantu Lesa tatusalile pakuti twingesa kukukandwa ku bukali bwakwe, lelo ni pakuti ku maka ya Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu tumone ukupusuka.

english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
translation: Ine ne Paulo ne wasalwa ukuba umusole wakwa Kristu Yesu ku maka yakwa Lesa Umupusushi wesu na Kristu Yesu uwaba e isubilo lyesu.

english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
translation: bacilende, abacita ubupulumushi na baume banabo, abafyusha abantu, ababufi na balapa ubufi, elyo na bonse abacita ifyapusana ne funde line line.

english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
translation: Ili ifunde lyaba mu Mbila Nsuma iyalulumbi iyo Lesa umucindami ampeela ukubila. Ili ifunde lyaba mu Mbila Nsuma iyo Lesa mucindami kabili umwinakulumbwa ampeela ukubila.

english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
translation: Ndetasha Kristu Yesu Imfumu yesu uwampeela amaka yakubomba umulimo wandi. Kabili ndetasha Kristu Yesu pakumona ukuti nininga, ansala nokuti ndemubombela.

english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
translation: Kwena kale nalelanda ifyamusaalula pali ena, elyo no kumutuka no kumucusha. Lelo Lesa alimbelelako uluse ico nali nshilasumina. Kanshi nshaishibe nefyo nalecita.

english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
translation: Eico ku cikuuku ico Imfumu yesu yankwatila nganshi, yalimpeela icisumino ne citemwiko ifyaba muli Kristu Yesu.
