english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
translation: Kanshi aya mashiwi yacishinka, ayo umuntu onse afwile ukupokelela no kusumina ayakuti, Kristu Yesu aishile muno calo kukupususha ababifi. Elyo ne wacila bonse ku fyabubifi nganshi nine.

english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
translation: Lelo Lesa alimbelelako uluse, pakuti alange ukushipikisha ukwapwililika ukwakwa Yesu Kristu pali ine ne wacila bonse ifyabubifi. Lyena epakuti mbe icilangililo ca bonse abakasumina kuntanshi no kupokelela umweo wape.

english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Ku Mfumu ya pe na pe iyishifwa, kabili taimoneka, e Lesa fye ekafye, ewakucindika no kulumbanya pe na pe! Ameni.

english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
translation: Timote, mwana wandi, nakupeela ili funde ilyo na kale bakasesema balandilepo pali iwe. Ulebomfya ayo mashiwi yabe kwati fyanso fyakulwilako ubulwi ubusuma.

english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
translation: Uleikatilila mu cisumino na kuli kampingu musuma mu mutima. Abantu bamo tabasakamana kukutika kuli kampingu mu mitima yabo, basuka baonawilamo ne cisumino cabo.

english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: Nakulembela Timote, we mwana wandi icine cine mu cisumino. Icikuuku, uluse no mutende wakwa Lesa Tata na Kristu Yesu Imfumu yesu fileba na iwe.

english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
translation: Bamo pali abo ni Imeneo na Alekisanda. Bena aba nalibaposa kuli Satana, pakubafunda ukuti bali nokuleka ukusaalula Lesa.

english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
translation: Ndefwaya ukuti wikale mu Efeso ngefyo nakwebele ilyo naleya ku Makedonia. Abantu bamo uko, balefunda ifyabufi. Kanshi uli nokubakonkomesha baleke ifyo.

english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.
translation: Uli nokubeba baleke ukukonkelela ifya mu milumbe ne fya mashina yabula impela aya fikolwe fyabo. Pantu ifi fintu filetafye ifikansa, tafyafwako mulimo wakwa Lesa iyoo. Pantu ici cena cishibikwafye mukuba ne cisumino.

english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
translation: Kanshi ico nakupeelela ili funde ni pakuti ube ne citemwiko icifuma ku mutima wakaele, na kuli kampingu musuma wa mutima, elyo na ku cisumino icacishinka.

english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
translation: Abantu bamo balifuma kuli ifi, bayalukila na ku fyakusabailafye.

english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.
translation: Bafwaya ukuba bakafundisha ba Mafunde yakwa Mose, lelo tabaishiba nefyo bafundapo nangu ifyo balandapo ukwabula no kutwishika.

english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
translation: Bonse twalishiba ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose yasuma, cikulu umuntu aleyabomfya ifyo yafwile ukubomba.

english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
translation: Kabili bonse twalishiba ukuti tabapangila abololoke amafunde. Lelo bapanga amafunde pa mulandu wa bampulamafunde, na bantalamisoka, abantu abashili bena Lesa na babifi, abantu abashipepa nangu ukusakamana ifyakwa Lesa, abantu abepaya bashibo nangu banyinabo, abamisoka,

english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
translation: Ndemukonkomesha ukuti, icakubalilapo pali fyonse pakupepa Lesa, mulepapatilako no kupepelako no kulombelako no kutashishako abantu bonse.

english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
translation: Lelo bali nokuisamika ne milimo isuma ngefyo cingalinga abanakashi abatila tulapepa Lesa.

english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
translation: Timo 1:11

english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
translation: Nshilesuminisha umwanakashi ukufunda nangu ukuba na maka yakucila umwaume. Umwanakashi ali nokwikala umutalalila.

english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
translation: Pantu uwabalilepo ukubumbwa ni Adamu, elyo panuma Efa.

english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
translation: Elyo kabili te Adamu ewabepelwe, lelo mwanakashi ewabepelwe, apula na mwifunde lyakwa Lesa.

english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
translation: Lelo umwanakashi akapusuka pa mulandu wakufyala abana, kumfwa nga tabasakamenefye ukuiyemfya, lelo bakoselela mukusumina, mukutemwa na mukuba abakaele.

english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
translation: Mulepepelako na bashamfumu na bonse bambi aba mu buteko, epakuti tuleikala ku matwi tondolo mu cibote, abapetamina Lesa, kabili aba mibeele isuma.

english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
translation: Ici cine e cisuma, kabili ecisansamusha Lesa Umupusushi wesu.

english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
translation: Ena afwaya ukuti abantu bonse bapusuke, beshibe ne cishinka.

english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
translation: Pantu kwabafye Lesa umo mpo. Kabili kwabafye umo uulenga abantu babe pamo na Lesa, noyu muntu ni Kristu Yesu.

english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
translation: Uyu Kristu Yesu, ewaipeela umwine kukulubula ubwina bantu bonse. Uko kuipeela kwakwa Kristu Yesu pa nshita iyalingile, e bukambone bwakuti Lesa afwaya ukuti abantu bonse bapusuke.

english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
translation: Ni pali uyu wine mulandu epo natuminwa ukuba kabila wa Mbila Nsuma, umusole kabili kafundisha wa cisumino ne cishinka ku Benafyalo. Nshilebepa iyoo, ndelandafye icishinka!

english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
translation: Lyonse ilyo mwalongana kukupepa, ndefwaya abaume balepepa ninshi nabemya amaboko yamushilo, ababula icipyu nangu ifikansa.

english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
translation: Kabili ndefwaya abanakashi ifyo fine, nokuti balefwala insalu shaciyembelo, cikulu balefwala bwino kabili ishilingile. Tabali na kuluka imishishi, nangu ukuisamika ubulungu ubwamutengo nangu ukufwala insalu shamutengo.

english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
translation: Aya mashiwi yacishinka ayakuti umuntu nga alefwaya ukuba kangalila wa lukuta, ninshi alefwaya umulimo uusuma.

english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
translation: Pakubala bali nokweshiwa. Elyo nga basanga ukuti tapali cakubalesha, lyena elyo balebomba nga badikoni.

english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
translation: Abakashi babo nabo bene bali nokuba abaicindika. Tabali nakuba abalwambo, lelo bali nokuba abatekanya kabili abacishinka muli fyonse.

english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
translation: Badikoni bali nokukwata umukashi umofye. Kabili bali nokuba abantu abaishiba ukusunga bwino abana babo na ba mu ŋanda mumwabo.

english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
translation: Badikoni ababomba imilimo yabo bwino, bakamona ukuti abantu babacindika. Elyo bakamona nokuti balalanda pa cisumino cabo muli Kristu Yesu ukwabula umwenso.

english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
translation: Ilyo ndekulembela ifi fintu, ndesubila ukuti nalaswa njisefye bwangu kuli iwe.

english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
translation: Lelo nga kwaba ifyakunshingilisha, uyu kalata alekwishibisha ifyo imibeele ya ba mu lupwa lwakwa Lesa ili nokuba. Pantu bena e lukuta lwakwa Lesa uwamweo, ebaba ulupami ulwakutungilila icishinka.

english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
translation: Cinefye, te cakutwishika, inkaama iyaba mwipepo lyesu ikulu nganshi.

english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
translation: Kangalila wa lukuta afwile ukuba umuntu uwabula umulandu, uwakwata umukashi umofye epela, umuntu uwa misango isuma, uwatekanya, uwaicindika, uwaishiba ukupokelela abeni, kabili uwaishiba no kufunda.

english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
translation: Tali nakuba cakolwa wa bwalwa nangu ukuba uwalubuli, lelo ali nokuba uwamutembo, kabili uwacibote. Kabili tafwile kuba umuntu uwatemwisha indalama.

english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
translation: Ali nokuba umuntu uwaishiba ukusunga aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe bwino, kabili ali nokulenga ukuti bamwane balemubeela no kumucindika.

english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
translation: Pantu umuntu nga taishiba ifyakusunga aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe, nga kuti asunga shani ulukuta lwakwa Lesa?

english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
translation: Tito 1:6-9

english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
translation: Kabili ali nokuba umuntu uo abantu abashili bena Kristu bacindika epali asebana, kabili aiposa mu citeyo cakwa Ciwa.

english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
translation: Badikoni nabo bene bali nokuba abaicindika kabili abacishinka. Tabali nakuba bacakolwa wa bwalwa nangu abatemwisha indalama.

english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
translation: Bali nokwikatisha imilandu ya nkaama ya cisumino, ukwabula ukutwishika mu mitima yabo.

english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
translation: Mupashi asosafye apabuuta tuutu ati, mu nshiku ishakupelekeshako abantu bamo bakasangukila icisumino. Bakanakila imipashi yakubabepaika, bakalakonka ne fintu imipashi yakowela ilefunda.

english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
translation: Kanshi ifwe tulalwisha no kubombesha nganshi, pantu twabika isubilo lyesu muli Lesa uwamweo, Umupusushi wa bantu bonse, palibufi kuli abo abamusumina.

english: Command and teach these things.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo ulebafunda no kubakonkomesha.

english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
translation: Wileka muntu nelyo umo akusuule ico uli mulumendo. Lelo uleba icilangililo ku basumina mu milandile yobe, mu mibeele yobe, mu citemwiko, mu cisumino na muli bukaele bobe.

english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
translation: Mpaka nkese, inshita yonse ulebika umutima kukubelengela abantu Amalembo Yamushilo, ulebafunda no kubakoselesha.

english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
translation: Wilalekelesha ubupe ubo wapeelwe ilyo bakasesema baseseme ne bumba lya bakalamba lyakutambikepo amaboko.

english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
translation: Ulebomba iyi milimo, ulebikako umutima epakuti bonse balemonamo ubuyantanshi muli fyonse ifyo ulebomba.

english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
translation: Ulesakamana imibeele yobe, ulesakamana nefyo ulefunda. Ifi, efyo ulecita lyonse. Pantu nga walacita ifyo, lyena ukapusuka we mwine, elyo nabo bene abalekumfwa bakapusuka.

english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
translation: Aya mafunde yafuma ku mfundabuteshi ishabufi. Kampingu wa mitima yashiko alifwa, aba kwati untu baoca ne cela icakaba.

english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
translation: Aba bantu balesha abantu ukuupa, elyo beba na bantu ukukanalya ifyakulya fimo fimo. Lelo Lesa afibumbile pakuti abantu abasumina, kabili abaishiba ne cishinka, balefipokelela no kutasha baletasha.

english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
translation: Icintu conse ico Lesa abumba cisuma. Tapaba nelyo cimo icakusuula, lelo tuli nokupokelela conse, kulila twabikapo ukutasha.

english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
translation: Pantu amashiwi yakwa Lesa ne pepo filenga ukuti fisangululwe.

english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
translation: Nga walafunda ifi fintu kuli bamunyinefwe, ninshi ukaba umubomfi musuma wakwa Kristu Yesu. Elyo lyena wakulapokelela amaka yakukula ayaba ku mashiwi yacisumino na ku mafunde yacishinka ayo wakonka.

english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
translation: Lelo iwe uletaluka ku milumbe yafyefye na ku fyakusabaila ifya banamayo abakote. Ulebikafye amano kukusambilila imikalile ya bwina Lesa.

english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
translation: Kwena cintu cisuma ukucita ifintu ifyakusalapula umubili, lelo icawamishapo ukucila pali fyonse, kucita ifintu ifyakusalapuka mukuba umwina Lesa. Pantu muli ici mwena mwaba isubilo lyakuba abomi pali nomba elyo no kuba abomi kuntanshi.

english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
translation: Aya mashiwi nasosa, yacishinka, kabili bonse bafwile ukuyasumina no kuyapokelela.

english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
translation: Wilabomfya bukali pakwalulula umukalamba uwalufyanya, lelo ulemusosha ne shiwi ilisuma kwati ni bawiso. Abalumendo bena ulelanda nabo kwati ni bamunonko.

english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
translation: Elyo na bantu balamutasha pa milimo isuma. Ali nokuba umwanakashi uwakusha abana bakwe bwino, uwaishiba ukupokelela abeni mumwakwe, umuntu uwaleicefya mukutumika abantu bamushilo, uwaleyafwilisha abantu abali mu bwafya, kabili aliipeeleshe nganshi mukubomba imilimo yonse iyisuma.

english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
translation: Lelo bamukamfwilwa abakashana bena wilabalemba amashina yabo pa mashina ya bamukamfwilwa. Pantu kuti basangukila Kristu, kumfwa ngo lunkumbwa lwakuupwa nga lwabeshila.

english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
translation: Elyo kabili basangwa no mulandu wakonaula icilayo balaile kuli Kristu kale.

english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
translation: Kabili kuti bayaluka abanaŋani, balaseulukafye baleti bafuma muli iyi ŋanda baya muli imbi. Lelo teici ceka, kuti basambilila no kuba abalwambo, balaibika na mu milandu ishili yabo, balalanda na pa fintu bashifwile kulandapo.

english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
translation: Kanshi kwena ine kuti natemwapo ukuti bamukamfwilwa abakashana bena baleupwa, bakwata abana, kabili balasunga na mayanda yabo, epakuti abalwani besu belakwata apakulandila ifibi pali ifwe.

english: For already some have turned away after Satan.
translation: Pantu bamukamfwilwa bamo balitusangukila, balekonka Satana.

english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
translation: Nga cakuti umwanakashi uwasumina muli Kristu nakwata ba lupwa lwakwe bamukamfwilwa, afwile ukulabasunga. Tafwile kulekela ulukuta uyu mulimo wakubasunga. Epakuti ulukuta lulesungafye bamukamfwilwa abashikwete bakubasunga.

english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
translation: Abakalamba abalebomba bwino umulimo wa butungulushi bena bafwile ukucindikwa nganshi. Palibufi nga balebombesha mu mulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma no kufunda.

english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
translation: Pantu Amalembo Yamushilo yatila, “Wilakaka ŋombe ku kanwa ilyo ilenyantaula pa ŋanu pakushisokola.” Kabili yatila nokuti, “Umubomfi ali nokupeelwa amalipilo yakwe.”

english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
translation: Wilasumina ukulubulwisha umulandu bapeela umukalamba wa lukuta, kano ninshi bakambone babili nangu ukucilapo ebaleta uyo mulandu.

english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
translation: Abanakashi abakalamba ulelanda nabo kwati ni banoko. Elyo abanakashi abacikashana nabo ulelanda nabo no mutima uwakaele kwati ulelanda na bankashi yobe.

english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
translation: Abo abalebikapofye ukubifya, ulebakalipila pa cinso ca bonse, epakuti bambi baletiina.

english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
translation: Pa menso yakwa Lesa na pa menso yakwa Kristu Yesu na pali bamalaika abasalwa, ndekukonkomesha ulesunga aya mafunde. Wilaba na kapatulula nangu umucishacinani muli conse ico ulecita.

english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
translation: Uleteka umutima pakutambalikila umuntu amaboko. Kabili uletaluka kukuikumika ku fyabubifi fya bantu bambi. Uleisunga uwakaele.

english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
translation: Uleke ukulanwafye amenshi yeka yeka, lelo ulenwa no mwangashi panono pantu ulacula mu mala elyo na pa mulandu wa kulwalilila kobe.

english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
translation: Abantu bamo ifyabubifi fyabo fyabafye pa bwelu, fishibikwa nelyo bashilafika kukupingulwa. Lelo abantu bambi bena ifyabubifi fyabo fyalafisama, fishibikwafye panuma.

english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
translation: E cimo cine ne fintu ifisuma abantu bacita, nafyo fyabafye pa bwelu, lelo nangu fimo fishingeshibikwa bwino, fikasuka fikeshibikwe.

english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
translation: Ulesunga no mucinshi bamukamfwilwa ababula abakubasunga.

english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
translation: Lelo mukamfwilwa nga alikwata abana nangu abeshikulu, basambilile ukuti icakubalilapo kulanga ubwina Lesa bwine bwine pakusakamana no kusunga aba lupwa lwabo. Muli ici emo batashisha abafyashi babo ne fikolwe fyabo, pantu ici ecisekesha Lesa.

english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
translation: Mukamfwilwa uwakuti alifye eka, takwete nangu umo uwakumusunga, atetekelafye muli Lesa, alapepa Lesa ubwaca no bwaila, alalomba Lesa ukuti alemwafwilishako.

english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
translation: Lelo mukamfwilwa uwakuti aishibafye ukuisansamusha, wena ninshi afwa kale, nangu acili umumi.

english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
translation: Kanshi e fintu ulebafunda, epakuti nelyo umo ebasanga ne cilubo.

english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
translation: Lelo uyo uushisakamana kusunga ba lupwa lwakwe, palibufi aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe, wena ninshi asangukila icisumino, abipapo no kucila uushasumina.

english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
translation: Pakuti ulembe mukamfwilwa pa mashina ya bamukamfwilwa, kano ninshi nacila pa myaka amakumi mutanda, kabili aupilwefye ku mwaume umo epela.

english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
translation: Elyo abo abali abasha, bali nokulacindika bashikulwibo mu nshila shonse. Lyena epakuti kwilaba nelyo umo uwakulanda ifyamusaalula pali Lesa na pafyo tufunda.

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
translation: Pantu ukutemwa indalama e ntulo ya fibi fya misango yonse. Abantu bamo mukufwaisha indalama, basuka basangukila icisumino na mu mitima yabo mwaisula amacushi ayengi.

english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
translation: Nomba iwe we muntu wakwa Lesa uli nokutaluka kuli ifi fintu fyonse. Ulefwaishafye bukaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, ukupetamina Lesa, icisumino, icitemwiko, ukushipikisha, no mutembo.

english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
translation: Ulelwa ubulwi busuma ubwa cisumino, epakushangila mu mweo wape. Ubu bwine ebo Lesa akwitileko lilya pa cinso ca bantu abengi wasosekeshe ifyo wasumina.

english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
translation: Kanshi pa cinso cakwa Lesa uupeela umweo ku fintu fyonse, na pa cinso cakwa Kristu Yesu uwapeele bukambone pa cishinka ilyo asosekeshe pa cinso cakwa Pontio Pilato,

english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: ndekukonkomesha ukuti ulesunga aya mafunde ukwabula ukulufyanyapo nelyo cimo, mpaka bulya Bushiku ilyo Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ikamonekelapo.

english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
translation: Pa nshita ikalinga Lesa umucindami, Imfumu ya maka yonse iyabafye yeka mpo, Imfumu ya bashamfumu, Kateeka wa bakateeka, akalenga ukuti Yesu Kristu akese moneka.

english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
translation: Lesa ekafye ewakubelelela pe, tafwa. Lesa ekafye ewikala mu lubuuto ulo umuntu ashingapalamako. Umuntu nelyo umo tatala amumona kabili tekuti amumone. Uyu eo nalecindikwa, akwate na maka yakubelelela. Ameni.

english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
translation: Ulekonkomesha abakankala mu fintu fya pano calo ukuti belaba na cilumba. Tabali nakubika isubilo lyabo mu fyuma ifi ifishibelelela. Bali nokusubila muli Lesa uutupeela fyonsefye ifitusansamusha.

english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
translation: Ulebakonkomesha ukuti bali nokucita ifisuma. Bali nokubomba imilimo iyingi nganshi iyisuma. Bali nokuba no mutima wabukapekape, balepeelako na banabo ifyo bakwete.

english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
translation: Mukucita ifi, bakatutila ifyuma fyabo abene, ifikaba kwati mufula uwakosa uwakwikasha umweo wabo kuntanshi. Elyo lyena bakashangila mu mweo uwaba umweo wine wine.

english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
translation: Abasha abo bashikulwibo basumina muli Kristu, tabali nakubasuula pantu ni bamunyinabo. Lelo bafwile ukubabombela bwino ukucilapo, pantu abashukila mufyo balebomba, bantu abasumina abo batemwa.

english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
translation: We Timote, ulesunga bwino ico baseekesha kuli iwe. Uletaluka ku mashiwi yacilandelande ayabula ukukuma kuli Lesa, na ku fikansa fyaciwelewele ifyo abantu bamo mukuluba kwabo batila, “E mano.”

english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
translation: Bamo basuka balufishamo ne cisumino cabo, ku mulandu wakusumina muli aya mano.

english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
translation: Onse uulelanda amafunde ayaibela, kabili akaana no kunakila amashiwi yacishinka aya Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu na mafundisho ayakulenga ukuba umwina Lesa,

english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
translation: ninshi aisulamofye icilumba, kabili taishiba nelyo cimo. Aliiminwa kukupaashanya ne fikansa fya pa mashiwi yafyefye. Elyo ici cena cilengafye umufimbila, ukuumana, ukubepeshanya no kutunganya ifyabipa.

english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
translation: Cilenga na bantu abo amano yabo yashibomba bwino, ne cishinka tabacishiba, ukulaumana lyonse. Bena batontonkanya ukuti ukuba umwina Lesa ni nshila yakunonkelamo ifyuma.

english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
translation: Kwena ukuba umwina Lesa bunonshi ubukalamba, kumfwa nga alaumfwa ukuti ifyo akwete nafimulinga.

english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
translation: Pantu ifwe tatwaletele nelyo cimo pano calo, kabili tatwakasendepo nelyo cimo.

english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
translation: Kanshi ifwe nga natukwata ifyakulya ne fyakufwala, nga icakukabila cimbi cinshi!

english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
translation: Lelo abantu abafwaya ukuba abakankala bafyuma, bena bawila mu ntunko no kwikatwa ne fintu ifyabuwelewele ifingi no lunkumbwa lwakubaletelela. Elyo ifi fibaposa mukubonaula no kuloba.

english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
translation: Kabili Reoboamu aile ku Shekemu, pantu kulya eko abena Israeli bonse baile pakuya mubika pa bufumu.

english: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
translation: Abalumendo abo akulile nabo pamo bamwasuka abati, “Abo bantu abakwebele ukuti, ‘Wiso abikile ikoli ilyafina pali ifwe, lelo iwe utwangushisheko ikoli,’ ubebe ukuti, ‘Umunwe wandi uunono untu waina ukucila umusana wa batata.

english: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
translation: Tata abikile pali imwe ikoli ilyafina, lelo ine ndi nokucishapo. Tata alemuma ku fikoti, nomba ine nakulamumina kuli bakaliŋongo.’”

english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
translation: Panuma ya nshiku shitatu Yeroboamu pamo na bantu bonse baisa kuli Reoboamu, ngefyo imfumu yabebele aiti, “Mukabwele kuli ine panuma ya nshiku shitatu.”

english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,
translation: Imfumu yabasuka bukali bukali, yakaana na mano yamupandile abakalamba.

english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
translation: Abasuka ukulingana na mano abalumendo bamupandile. Pakubasuka abeba ati, “Tata abikile ikoli ilyafina pali imwe, lelo ine ndi nokucishapo. Tata alemuma ku fikoti, lelo ine nakulamumina kuli bakaliŋongo.”

english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
translation: Kanshi imfumu yakaana ukumfwila abantu pantu ukucitika kwa ifi fyonse kwafumine kuli Yawe, pakufikilisha ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyalandilwe kuli Yeroboamu mwana Nebati ukupitila muli Ahiya umwina Shiloni.

english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.
translation: Ilyofye abena Israeli bamona ukuti imfumu yakaana ukuti ibomfwile, bonse bayasuka imfumu abati,

english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
translation: Lelo ku bena Israeli abaleikala mu misumba ya mu Yuda, bena bashala baleteekwa na Reoboamu.

english: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo imfumu Reoboamu yatuma Adoniramu uwali umukalamba pa milimo ya mulaasa, lelo abena Israeli bamupola amabwe mpaka afwa. Nomba imfumu Reoboamu yena yaendesha ukunina mwiceleta, yafulumukila na ku Yerusalemu.

english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo abena Israeli baba abasangukila iŋanda yakwa Davidi ukufika na ku bushiku bwa lelo.

english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
translation: Ilyo Yeroboamu mwana Nebati aumfwa ifi ninshi acili mu Egupto, mu calo abutukilemo ilyo afulumwike ukufuma kuli Solomoni. Pakumfwa lyena epakubwela ukufuma ku Egupto.

english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
translation: Abena Israeli epakwita Yeroboamu no kuya nankwe kuli Reoboamu no kumweba abati,

english: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
translation: “Wiso abikile ikoli ilyafina pali ifwe, nomba iwe utwangushisheko imibombele yacibe ne koli ilyafina wiso abikile pali ifwe, elyo na ifwe twakulakubombela.”

english: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.
translation: Reoboamu abasuka ati, “Mukabwele panuma ya nshiku shitatu.” Abantu bonse babwelelamo.

english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”
translation: Elyo imfumu Reoboamu alandishanya na bakalamba ababombele kuli wishi Solomoni mu nshiku sha bumi bwakwe. Abepusha ati, “Bushe mano nshi mwalampandako ayakwisa asukilamo aba bantu?”

english: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Nga cakuti wakulaba no luse kuli aba bantu elyo no kubasekesha kabili ubapeele ubwasuko ubusuma, lyena inshita yonse bali nokuba ababomfi bobe.”

english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
translation: Lelo Reoboamu akaana amano abakalamba bamupandileko elyo aya ipusha amano ukufuma ku baice banankwe abo akulile nabo pamo kabili abalemubombela.

english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
translation: Abepusha ati, “Bushe muletipo shani? Bushe aba bantu kuti twabasuka finshi abalelanda kuli ine abati, ‘Wangusheko ikoli wiso abikile pali ifwe?’”

english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
translation: Ilyo Reoboamu afikile mu Yerusalemu, alonganike aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda na Benjamini abaume ababulwi amakana umwanda umo na makana amakumi cine konse konse (180,000) ukuti balwishe abena Israeli pakuti bapokolole ubufumu bubwelele kuli Reoboamu.

english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.
translation: ku Sora, ku Aiyaloni elyo na ku Hebuloni. Iyi eyali imisumba iyacingililwa mu Yuda na mu Benjamini.

english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.
translation: Aicingilila na malinga ayakosa, abikamo na bakalamba ba bashilika, abikamo ne fyakulya, amafuta ya miolifa elyo no mwangashi.

english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
translation: Abikamo amafumo ne nkwela mu misumba yonse elyo aikosha nganshi. Kanshi epakuti Yuda na Benjamini fibe fyakwe.

english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
translation: Bashimapepo na bena Levi aba mu misumba yonse iya mu Israeli bawila kuli ena.

english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to the LORD.
translation: Abena Levi basha ne fitungu fyabo ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa pamo ne fyuma fyabo, baisa ku Yuda elyo na ku Yerusalemu. Bacitile ifi pa mulandu wakuti Yeroboamu elyo na bana bakwe balibafumishepo pali bushimapepo bwakwa Yawe.

english: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.
translation: Kabili abika bashimapepo bakwe mu ncende shakupepelamo isho bacindika elyo na pa tulubi twa mbushi no tulubi twa twana twa ŋombe uto apangile.

english: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
translation: Na bantu aba mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli abapeele imitima yabo mukufwaya icinso cakwa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, bakonka abena Levi ku Yerusalemu mukuya tuula amalambo kuli Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo.

english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
translation: Baya koselesha ubufumu bwakwa Yuda no kwafwa Reoboamu umwana wakwa Solomoni pa myaka itatu, baleendela mu mibeele yakwa Davidi na Solomoni pali iyi nshita.

english: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
translation: Reoboamu aupile Mahalati uwali umwana mwanakashi wakwa Yerimoti mwana Davidi. Nyina kwa Mahalati ni Abihaili uwali umwana mwanakashi wakwa Eliabu mwana Yese.

english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation: Mahalati afyelemo abana abaume Yeushi, Shemariya elyo na Sahamu.

english: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
translation: Lelo kwaisa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe kuli Shemaiya umuntu wakwa Lesa ilyakuti,

english: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation: Kabili Reoboamu aupilepo Maaka, umwana mwanakashi wakwa Abusalomu. Muli uyu afyalamo Abiya, Atai, Sisa elyo na Shelomiti.

english: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
translation: Elyo Reoboamu atemwishapo Maaka mwana Abusalomu ukucila pa bakashi bakwe bonse na pa bakashi bakwe abashaupilwe mu bwinga. Akwete abakashi bonse pamo ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) elyo na bakashi bakwe abashaupilwe mu bwinga amakumi mutanda (60). Akwete abana abaume amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28) elyo abana abanakashi amakumi mutanda (60).

english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
translation: Reoboamu asonta Abiya umwana mwaume wakwa Maaka ukuba umukalamba pali bamunyina pakuti akamupeele ubufumu.

english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.
translation: Acitile ifintu ifyamano, kabili asalangenye bambi abana bakwe abaume mu misumba yonse iya mu Yuda na mu bena Benjamini elyo na mu misumba yonse iya malinga. Abapeela ne fyakulya ifingi, abafwaila na bakashi abengi.

english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
translation: “Kebe Reoboamu mwana Solomoni imfumu ya bena Yuda elyo na ku bena Israeli bonse abekala mu Yuda na muli Benjamini auti,

english: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
translation: ‘Ifi efyo Yawe asosa, wiima ukuya lwisha bamunonko. Bwelelenimo cila muntu ku ŋanda yakwe, pantu uucitile ifi nine.’” Kanshi bonse epakumfwila amashiwi yakwa Yawe bapilibuka ukufuma mukuya lwisha Yeroboamu.

english: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
translation: Reoboamu aikele mu Yerusalemu kabili akuulile imisumba ya malinga mu Yuda.

english: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation: Akuulile ku Betelemu, ku Etamu, ku Tekoa

english: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation: ku Beti Suri, ku Soko, ku Adulamu,

english: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation: ku Gati, ku Maresha, ku Sifi,

english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation: ku Adoraimu, ku Lakishi, ku Aseka,

english: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD’s law, and all Israel with him.
translation: Panuma ilyo ubufumu bwakwa Reoboamu bwakosele elyo akwata na maka ayengi, ena na bena Israeli bonse abo ali nabo basangukila amafunde yakwa Yawe.

english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Reoboamu epakupanga inkwela shimbi isha mukuba ishakupyanikishapo, elyo ashipeela ku bakalamba ba bakalinda abali pa ncito yakulinda pa mwinshi wa kwisano.

english: As often as the king entered into the LORD’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.
translation: Inshita yonse ilyo imfumu yaya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe, bakalinda baya nankwe nabasenda inkwela, elyo panuma bashibwesha ku muputule wa bakalinda.

english: When he humbled himself, the LORD’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti Reoboamu aicefya umwine, ubukali bwakwa Yawe bwafumako kuli ena, na Yawe tamonawile. Ne cacine, mwalisangilwe ubusuma mu Yuda.

english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
translation: Imfumu Reoboamu yakosha bwino ukuteeka kwaiko mu Yerusalemu, yatwalilila no kuba imfumu. Yali ne myaka amakumi yane na umo (41) ilyo yaishile pa bufumu. Yateekele pa myaka ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) mu Yerusalemu, umusumba uo Yawe asalile ukufuma mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli umwakuba ishina lyakwe. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Naama, umwina Amoni.

english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek the LORD.
translation: Acitile ububi pa mulandu wakuti tabikile umutima wakwe kukufwaya Yawe.

english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
translation: Imila 9:15-16

english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,
translation: Pa mulandu wa bena Israeli ukukanaba ne cishinka kuli Yawe, Shishaki imfumu ya ku Egupto yaisa sansa umusumba wa Yerusalemu mu mwaka walenga isano uwakwa Reoboamu uwakuba pa bufumu.

english: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
translation: Ali na maceleta ikana limo ne myanda ibili (1,200) elyo na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe amakana amakumi mutanda (60,000). Abantu abo ali nabo ukufuma mu Egupto bali imintapendwa, pali aba ku Libya, aba ku Suki elyo na ba ku Kushi.

english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
translation: Apoka imisumba iyali na malinga iya mu Yuda kabili aisa fikafye mupepi na Yerusalemu.

english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “The LORD says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”
translation: Elyo kasesema Shemaiya aisa kuli Reoboamu na ku ntungulushi sha bena Yuda abalongene mu Yerusalemu ilyo batiininine Shishaki, abeba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Imwe namunsangukila, na ine nomba nalamulekelako mu minwe yakwa Shishaki.’”

english: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “The LORD is righteous.”
translation: Intungulushi sha bena Israeli elyo ne mfumu ine baicefya basosa nokuti, “Yawe nalungika.”

english: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
translation: Ilyo Yawe amona ukuti abantu bakwe baicefya, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli Shemaiya aliti, “Apo aba bantu baicefya, ine nshabonaule, lelo nalabalubula mukwangufyanyafye. Nshaponye ubukali bwandi pali Yerusalemu ukupitila muli Shishaki.

english: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”
translation: Lelo nangu cibe ifi, balaba abasha bakwe, pakuti beshibe ubupusano ubwaba pakutumika ine no bwaba pakutumika ishamfumu sha mu fyalo fimbi.”

english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
translation: Ilyo Shishaki imfumu ya ku Egupto yasanshile Yerusalemu, yasendele icipao conse ica mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe elyo ne cuma ca mwisano. Yasenda fyonsefye pamo pene ne nkwela sha golide isho Solomoni apangile.

english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) uwakwa Yeroboamu ukuba pa bufumu, Abiya ewaishile ba imfumu ya bena Yuda.

english: “But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.
translation: Lelo ifwe, Yawe e Lesa wesu, kabili tatwamusangukila. Bashimapepo ababombela Yawe bana abaume abakwa Aroni, elyo na bena Levi ebabatumika.

english: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God, but you have forsaken him.
translation: Cila kacelo ne cungulo balatuula amalambo yakoca elyo no bubani bwa cena cisuma kuli Yawe. Balatantika imikate petebulo ilyasanguluka no kusanika ifisaniko ifyaba pa cakutekapo ifisaniko ica golide cila cungulo. Ifwe tukonka ubufwayo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wesu lelo imwe mwalimusangukila.

english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”
translation: Lesa ali na ifwe kabili e ntungulushi yesu. Bashimapepo bakwe abali na mapenga yabo ebalapunda umusowa wakuti tumulwishe. Mwe baume ba mu Israeli, mwiima mukulwisha Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu pantu tamwashuke.”

english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
translation: Lelo Yeroboamu ali ninshi natuma abashilika bamo ku numa yabo abakubabelamina pakuti abasanshile kunuma lintu ena alemonekela ku ntanshi ya bena Yuda.

english: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
translation: Nomba abena Yuda bapilibuka bamona nokuti abalwani bali kunuma elyo na kuntanshi. Elyo bakuuta kuli Yawe. Bashimapepo balisha na mapenga yabo,

english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
translation: na baume abena Yuda bapunda umusowa wa bulwi. Cilya umusowa wa bulwi waumfwika, Lesa akanda Yeroboamu elyo na bena Israeli bonse pa ntanshi yakwa Abiya na bena Yuda.

english: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
translation: Abena Israeli bafulumuka ukufuma kuli Yuda, lelo Lesa abapeela mu minwe yabo.

english: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.
translation: Abiya na bantu bakwe baonaula nganshi abalwani babo, icakuti baipaya impendwa ya bena Israeli abacenjela kukulwa amakana imyanda isano (500,000).

english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
translation: Ifi efyo abena Israeli babacimfishe pali ilya nshita, na bena Yuda bacimfishe pa mulandu wakuti basubile muli Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo.

english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
translation: Abiya akonka Yeroboamu panuma no kuya mupoka imisumba ya Betele, Yeshana elyo na Efuloni pamo pene ne mishi iyashingulwike mumbali.

english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
translation: Kabili ateekele pa myaka itatu mu Yerusalemu. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Maaka, umwana mwanakashi wakwa Urieli uwa ku Gibea.

english: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died.
translation: Yeroboamu tatalile abwekeshapo ukukwata amaka mu nshiku shakwa Abiya. Kabili Yawe amukanda, nao afwa.

english: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
translation: Lelo Abiya ena alundapo ukukosa. Aupa abakashi ikumi limo na bane (14), akwata na bana abaume amakumi yabili na babili (22) elyo abana abanakashi ikumi limo na mutanda (16).

english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Abiya, ifyo acitile elyo nefyo asosele, fyalilembwa mu mashiwi yalondolwele kasesema Ido.

english: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
translation: Abiya aingila mu bulwi na bashilika amakana imyanda ine (400,000) iya baume abaishiba ukulwa, elyo Yeroboamu ena aingilamo mu nkondo na bashilika amakana imyanda cine konse konse (800,000) iya baishiba ukulwa.

english: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
translation: Elyo Abiya aiminina pa lupili lwa Semaraimu, mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu, asosa ati, “Iwe Yeroboamu pamo na bena Israeli bonse kutikeni kuli ine.

english: Ought you not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli apeela ubufumu bwa bena Israeli kuli Davidi na bana bakwe abaume mu cipangano ca pe ica mucele?

english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
translation: Nomba Yeroboamu mwana Nebati, uwalifye umubomfi wakwa Solomoni mwana Davidi, ewaima no kusangukila shikulu wakwe.

english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.
translation: Lelo abantu bamo abacabecabe kabili abawelewele bawila kuli ena ilyo acili umwaice uwabula kampingu, bamutunka ukukaanina Reoboamu ninshi takwete na maka yakubakaanina.

english: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.
translation: “Ukufika na nomba mucili mulefwaya ukutalamina ubufumu bwakwa Yawe ubo abika mu maboko ya ba mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi. Cacine muli umulongo uukalamba nganshi uwa bashilika elyo kabili muli no tulubi utwa golide uto Yeroboamu apanga ukuba imilungu yenu.

english: Haven’t you driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.
translation: Lelo bushe tamwatamfyamo bashimapepo bakwa Yawe, abana baume bakwa Aroni na bena Levi, elyo no kuipangila bashimapepo abenu ngefyo abantu aba mu fyalo fimbi bacita? Mucita onse uwaisa ne ciponti ca ŋombe icilume na basukusuku cine lubali mukutuula kuli bashimapepo, mulamupeela bushimapepo bwa ishili imilungu.

english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.
translation: Kanshi Abiya epakuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, kabili bamushiikile mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Asa umwana wakwe umwaume ewamupyene pa bufumu elyo na mu nshiku shakwe icalo caikele mu cibote pa myaka ikumi limo (10).

english: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
translation: Kanshi Asa epakwima ukuya mukumanya, na cila ibumba lyaikala mu cifulo caliko icakulwilamo mwishika lya Sefata mupepi na Maresha.

english: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”
translation: Elyo Asa akuuta kuli Yawe Lesa wakwe no kusosa ati, “We Yawe takwaba umbi uwaba nga iwe uwingafwa abashakwata amaka ukulwisha abamaka. Utwafweko we Yawe Lesa wesu. Niwe twashintililako kabili ni mwishina lyobe tulelwishisha cinkupiti wa bashilika uyu. We Yawe niwe Lesa wesu. Wileka umuntufye eo acimfye iwe.”

english: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
translation: Yawe epakucimfya abena Kushi pa cinso cakwa Asa elyo na pa cinso ca bena Yuda. Abena Kushi bafulumuka ulubilo.

english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.
translation: Elyo Asa na bashilika bakwe babakunkunika ukuya bafisha ku Gerari. Baipaya umulongo uukalamba nganshi uwa bena Kushi icakuti bafilwa no kushansha. Baonawilwe ku maka yakwa Yawe na bashilika bakwe. Abaume ba mu Yuda basenda ifitapwa ifingi nganshi.

english: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.
translation: Baonaula imishi yonse iyashingulwike Gerari pantu umwenso wakutiina Yawe wafikile pali bena. Batapa fyonse ifyali mu mishi yonse iyi, pantu mwali ubunonshi ubwingi.

english: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God’s eyes,
translation: Asa acitile ifintu ifisuma kabili ifyalungama mu menso yakwa Yawe Lesa wakwe.

english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,
translation: Elyo mu nshiku shakwe afumya ifibumbili fya malambo fya milungu ya benafyalo, ne ncende shakupepelamo isho bacindika, atobaula inceshi sha mabwe balepepelapo elyo atema ne nceshi sha mulungu Asher.

english: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.
translation: Akonkomeshe abena Yuda ukufwaya icinso cakwa Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo, no kubaka amafunde ne fipope fyakwe.

english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.
translation: Afumyamo incende shakupepelamo isho bacindika elyo ne fibumbili fya malambo ifyakufutumwinapo ububani mu misumba yonse iya mu Yuda, elyo ne calo conse cakwata icibote mu nshiku shakwe.

english: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because the LORD had given him rest.
translation: Akuula imisumba iyacingililwako amalinga mu Yuda pa mulandu wakuti mu calo mwali icibote. Takwali nangu umo uwaishile mukumulwisha mu myaka yakwe iya pa bufumu pantu Yawe alimupeele ukutuusha.

english: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
translation: Asa aebele abena Yuda ati, “Natukuule imisumba iyi, kabili tukuulilileko ne fibumba, tukuule ne mpungu ne mpongolo ishabapo inshimbi. Icalo cicili mu minwe yesu, pantu natusanga Yawe, Lesa wesu. Na panuma yakumusanga ena natupeela ukutuusha ku mbali shonse.” Kanshi efyo bakuulile no kupaalwa nganshi.

english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.
translation: Asa akwete abashilika amakana imyanda itatu (300,000) abaume abafumine mu Yuda abaishiba ukubomfya inkwela ishikulu elyo na mafumo, kabili na bambi amakana imyanda ibili na makumi cine konse konse (280,000) ukufuma mu bena Benjamini abaishibe ukubomfya inkwela ishinono elyo ne mifwi. Bonse aba bali baume abashipa abacenjela nganshi kukulwa.

english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
translation: Inshita imo, Sera umwina Kushi aisa ima no kusansa icalo, ninshi ali no mulongo wa bashilika uukalamba elyo na maceleta imyanda itatu (300). Elyo aisa palama, afika ku Maresha.

english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.
translation: Umupashi wakwa Lesa waishile pali Asariya umwana wakwa Odedi.

english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
translation: Balongana mu Yerusalemu mu mweshi wabutatu mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na isano (15) uwakwa Asa ukuba pa bufumu.

english: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day, of the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya batuula amalambo kuli Yawe aya ŋombe imyanda cine lubali (700), elyo impaanga pamo ne mbushi amakana cine lubali (7,000) ukufuma pa fitapwa ifyo babwelele nafyo.

english: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
translation: Kabili bapangana ne cipangano icakufwaya Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo, ne mitima yabo yonse ne myeo yabo yonse

english: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
translation: Elyo abo abafilwa ukufwaya Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, bena kubepaya, abe muntu umwaice nangu umukalamba, umwaume nangu umwanakashi.

english: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.
translation: Bapanga umulapo kuli Yawe mu mashiwi ayakalamba ninshi balepunda, balelisha amapenga no kupuuta insengo.

english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.
translation: Abena Yuda bonse balisekelele pali uyu mulapo pantu baucitile ne mitima yabo yonse. Bafwaile Lesa ninshi nabatemwa kabili balimusangile. Kanshi Yawe nao epakubapeela ukutuusha ku mbali shonse.

english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.
translation: Kabili imfumu Asa yafumya Maaka uwali nakulu pa cifulo cakwe ica bunyina wakwa namfumu pa mulandu wakuti alipangile icamuselu ca luceshi lwa mulungu uwanakashi Ashera ku cimuti. Asa atema ici cimuti, aciputaula acocela na mu mukonko wa Kidironi.

english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
translation: Lelo nangu afililwe ukufumya incende shakupepelako isho balecindika mu Israeli, umutima wakwa Asa wali uwaipeelesha nganshi kuli Yawe mu nshiku sha bumi bwakwe bonse.

english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.
translation: Aletele mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa silifa na golide ne fipe fyonse ifyo ena na wishi batuulile.

english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
translation: Takwatalile akuba inkondo mpaka ukufika mu mwaka uwalenga amakumi yatatu na isano (35) uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Asa.

english: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
translation: Elyo aima aya mukukumanya Asa, aya mweba ati, “Umfwa kuli ine iwe Asa, abena Yuda bonse elyo na bena Benjamini. Yawe ali na imwe lintu na imwe muli nankwe. Nga cakuti mwamufwaya, muli nokumusanga. Lelo nga mwamusuula, nao ali nokumusuula.

english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.
translation: Elyo pa nshita iyitali nganshi abena Israeli baikele ukwabula Lesa wacine, ukwabula shimapepo uwakubafunda kabili ababula amafunde.

english: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
translation: Nomba ilyo baumfwile ubulanda, balipilibwike no kubwelela kuli Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli, no kumufwaya mpaka bamusanga.

english: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
translation: Muli shilya nshiku tacali icayanguka ukwendauka apo ulefwaila, pa mulandu wakuti abekalacalo bonse bali mu mafya ayakosa nganshi.

english: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.
translation: Kwaleba ukuti umushobo umo waima mukonaula umushobo unankwe, no musumba nao waima mukonaula umusumba unankwe. Neci cacitike pa mulandu wakuti Lesa alebacusha ku macushi aya misango misango.

english: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”
translation: Lelo imwe mube abakosa kabili mwibwelela numa, pantu imilimo yenu ili nokulambulwa.”

english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.
translation: Ilyo Asa aumfwile aya mashiwi ya kusesema kwakwa Asariya mwana Odedi uwali kasesema, lyena akwata amaka. Abomba umulimo wakufumya utulubi utwamuselu ukufuma mu calo conse ica bena Yuda ne ca bena Benjamini elyo na mu misumba iyo apokolwele mu mpili sha Efulemu. Alungisha no bulambo bwakwa Yawe ubwali pa ntanshi ya lubansa lwa ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
translation: Elyo alonganika abantu bonse aba mu Yuda, abena Benjamini elyo na bantu ba ku Efulemu, Manase na Simeoni abaishile ikala nabo, pantu abantu abengi balishile ukufuma ku Israeli ilyo bamwene ukuti Yawe Lesa wakwe ali nankwe.

english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na mutanda uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Asa, Baasha imfumu ya bena Israeli yaimya ulubuli na bena Yuda elyo yashingulusha ilinga ku musumba wa Rama pakulesha ukuti kwiba nangu umo uwakufuma nangu uwakwingila mu calo cakwa Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda.

english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.
translation: Asa epakufulilwa kamona pa mulandu wa aya mashiwi. Kanshi afulwa nganshi icakuti amuposa na mu cifungo. Kabili pa nshita imo ine atendeka ukucusha bamo abantu bakwe.

english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
translation: Ifintu ifyacitike mu nshita ya bufumu bwakwa Asa ukufuma ku kutendeka ukufika ku mpela fyalembwa mu citabo ca shamfumu sha bena Yuda na bena Israeli.

english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek the LORD, but just the physicians.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na pabula (39) uwa pa bufumu, Asa alwala ubulwele mu makasa yakwe. Nangu cali cakuti ubulwele bwali ubukali, lelo na mukulwala kwakwe talombele ubwafwilisho ukufuma kuli Yawe, kanofye kuli bashiŋanga.

english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.
translation: Elyo mu mwaka walenga amakumi yane na umo (41) uwa pa bufumu bwakwe emo Asa afwile no kuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe.

english: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
translation: Baya mushiika na mu cilindi ico umwine afukwile mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Bamulalika pa musengele uo babikilepo ifya cena cisuma elyo na mafuta ya cena icisuma ayalekana lekana. Elyo bakosha no mulilo uwingi nganshi uwakumucindikilapo.

english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
translation: Elyo Asa abuula silifa na golide ukufuma mu cipao ca mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe elyo ne ya mu ŋanda yakwe iye sano, afituma kuli Beni Hadadi imfumu ya ku Aramu, uwaleteeka mu Damasiko.

english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
translation: Amweba ati, “Leka pabe icipangano pakati ka iwe na ine, nga filya caliko pakati ka batata elyo na bawiso. Mona, nakutumina silifa na golide. Eico pangulula icipangano ca pakati ka iwe na Baasha imfumu ya ku Israeli pakuti afume mu calo candi.”

english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.
translation: Beni Hadadi asuminisha ifyasosa imfumu Asa elyo atuma abakalamba ba bashilika bakwe mu misumba ya bena Israeli. Baya cimfya imisumba ya Iyoni, Dani, Abeli Maimu elyo ne misumba yonse iya matala iyakwa Naftali.

english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
translation: Ilyo Baasha aumfwa ifi, aleka ukukuula Rama no kuleka ifyo alecita.

english: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.
translation: Elyo imfumu Asa aleta abaume bonse aba mu Yuda ukwisa senda amabwe yonse elyo ne mbao ukufuma ku Rama isho Baasha alebomfya. Kuli ifi fipe Asa afibomfya ukukuulilako imisumba ya Geba na Misipa.

english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, Hanani kamona aisa kuli Asa imfumu ya bena Yuda elyo amweba ati, “Pa mulandu wakuti wacicetekela mu mfumu ya bena Aramu ukwabula ukuti ucetekele muli Yawe, Lesa obe, ecalenga ukuti abashilika ba mfumu ya ku Aramu bapusuke ukufuma mu minwe yobe.

english: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.
translation: Bushe Abena Kushi na bena Libya tabaali impuka ya bashilika abengi nganshi ninshi nabakwata amaceleta na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe? Nomba ilyo wakuutile peshina lyakwa Yawe, alibapeele mu minwe yobe.

english: For the LORD’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”
translation: Pantu amenso yakwa Yawe yalalolekesha mukati ke sonde lyonse no kukoselesha bonse abo imitima ili iyaipeelesha kuli ena. Iwe ucitile icintu icabulamo amano, eico nomba ukufuma lelo walatendeka ukulalwa inkondo.”

english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
translation: Umwana wakwe Yehoshafati umwaume ewamupyene pa bufumu elyo akosha na maka yakwe pa bena Israeli.

english: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
translation: Umwenso wakutiina Yawe waikete ishamfumu shonse ishashingulwike icalo ca Yuda, icakuti takwali uwakucita ulubuli na Yehoshafati.

english: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
translation: Bamo Abafilisiti baletela Yehoshafati ifyabupe elyo na silifa ngo mutuulo. Elyo Abaarabu bamuletela ifitekwa, basukusuku amakana cine lubali ne myanda cine lubali (7,700) elyo na basawe nabo amakana cine lubali ne myanda cine lubali (7,700).

english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
translation: Yehoshafati alekoselakofye asuka akwatisha amaka. Akuula imisumba ya malinga ne ya matala mu Yuda,

english: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
translation: elyo akwata ne fipe ifingi nganshi ifyo asunga mu misumba ya mu Yuda. Kabili asunga mu Yerusalemu abashilika abaishiba nganshi ukulwa.

english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;
translation: Kabili ifi efyali ukupendwa kwabo umwabela indupwa shabo,

english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;
translation: Uwakonkapo ni Yehohanani umukalamba wa fita ali na bashilika amakana imyanda ibili na makumi cine konse konse (280,000).

english: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
translation: Uwakonkapo ni Amasiya mwana Sikiri uwaipeeleshefye umwine ku mulimo wakwa Yawe, ali na bashilika amakana imyanda ibili (200,000).

english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
translation: Ukufuma muli Benjamini ni aba:

english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.
translation: Uwakonkapo ni Yehosabadi, ali na bashilika amakana umwanda umo na makumi cine konse konse (180,000) abacenjela ukulwa inkondo.

english: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
translation: Aba e bashilika abalelinda imfumu, ukwabula ukupenda abo yatekele mu misumba ya malinga mu calo conse ica bena Yuda.

english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
translation: Abika abashilika ba nkondo mu misumba yonse iya malinga iya mu Yuda elyo abika ne nkambi sha bashilika mu Yuda elyo na mu misumba yakwa Efulemu ilya Asa wishi apokolwele.

english: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
translation: Yawe ali na Yehoshafati, pantu mu myaka yakwe iyakwambilapo aendele bwino mu nshila shaleendamo wishi Davidi. Talefwaya icinso ca milungu ba Baali,

english: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.
translation: lelo ena afwaile Lesa wakwa wishi no kukonka amafunde yakwe ukucila imicitile yakwete abena Israeli.

english: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
translation: Yawe akosha ubufumu ubwali mu minwe yakwe. Elyo abena Yuda batendeka ukuleta ifyabupe kuli Yehoshafati, icakuti akwata icuma icingi nganshi elyo no mucinshi.

english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
translation: Umutima wakwe waipeeleshe ku nshila shakwa Yawe, kabili afumyamo incende shonse ishakupepelamo isho bacindika elyo atema ne nceshi sha mulungu Ashera ukufuma mu Yuda.

english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
translation: Mu mwaka walenga itatu uwa pa bufumu bwakwe, atuma bacilolo bakwe Beni Haili, Obadia, Sakaria, Netaneli elyo na Mikaiya mukuya balesambilisha mu misumba ya mu Yuda.

english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
translation: Pakati kabo pali na bamo abena Levi aba, Shemaiya, Netaniya, Sebadiya, Asaeli, Shemiramoti, Yehonatani, Adoniya, Tobiya, Tobadoniya elyo na bashimapepo Elishama na Yehoramu.

english: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
translation: Balasambilisha mu Yuda monse ninshi nabasenda icitabo ca mafunde yakwa Yawe. Baendawike mu misumba yonse iya mu Yuda, balesambilisha abantu.

english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.
translation: Nomba Yehoshafati alikwete icuma icingi nganshi elyo no bucindami, kabili aliilundinkenye na kuli Ahabu mu cupo.

english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
translation: Nomba Sedekiya mwana Kenana alipangile insengo sha fyela elyo asosa ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ukuti, ‘Kuli ishi nsengo eko uli nokupunkila abena Aramu mpaka ukabonaule.’”

english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
translation: Bakasesema bambi bonse balesesema cimo cine abati, “Usanse Ramoti Gileadi kabili uli nokuucimfya, pantu Yawe ali nokucipeela mu minwe ya mfumu.”

english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”
translation: Inkombe iyaile kukwita Mikaiya yamweba ati, “Mona iwe ulifye weka, bambi bonse bakasesema balekomailafye pakuti imfumu ili nokucimfya. Na iwe ulekefye amashiwi yobe yabe nga yabo, kabili ulande ifisuma.”

english: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”
translation: Lelo Mikaiya pakwasuka asosa ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, ine ndi nokumweba ifyo Lesa alenjeba.”

english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”
translation: Cilya afika ku mfumu, nayo yamwipusha ati, “Mikaiya, bushe kuti twaya mukulwisha Ramoti Gileadi nangu tulekefye?”

english: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”
translation: Imfumu epakumweba ati, “Bushe miku inga nkakulenga ukulapa ukuti wilanjeba ifintu fimbi kanofye icine mwishina lyakwa Yawe?”

english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
translation: Elyo Mikaiya ayasuka ati, “Namona abena Israeli bonse nabasalangana bonse mu mpili nge mpaanga ishabula kacema, kabili Yawe asosa ati, ‘Aba bantu tabakwata shikulwibo. Lekeni cila umo abwelele ku ŋanda yakwe umutende.’”

english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
translation: Mikaiya akonkanyapo ukusosa ati, “Eico umfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe. Ine nacimona Yawe naikala pa cipuna cakwe ne fita fya ku mulu nafiminina ku kulyo kwakwe na ku kuso kwakwe.

english: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati, ‘Nani uwalatunka Ahabu imfumu ya bena Israeli ukuya lwisha Ramoti Gileadi nokuti aye mukufwa?’ Pakwasuka uyu alanda ici, umbi nao alanda ici.
