english: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!
translation: Lelo nshasumine ifyo balelanda mpakafye naisa imwena na menso yandi. Kabili mona ifyo balondolwele kuli ine tafyafikile na pali citika wa bwingi bwa mano yobe. Iwe walicila pa lulumbi naumfwile.

english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.
translation: “Yangu ifyo bashuka abaume bobe! Yangu ifyo bashuka bacilolo bobe, abeminina pantanshi yobe cila nshita mukumfwa amano yobe.

english: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe Lesa obe, uwasekela muli iwe elyo akubika na pa cipuna cakwe ukuba imfumu iyakulabombela Yawe Lesa obe. Elyo pa mulandu wafyo Lesa atemwa abena Israeli no bufwayo bwakwe ubwakubasunga pe, eco akubikile ukuba imfumu pali bena, pakubaputwila imilandu yabo bwino kabili mu bulungami.”

english: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
translation: Elyo apeela imfumu amatalanta umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120) aya golide , ifya cena cisuma ifingi nganshi elyo no tumabwe utwauma umutengo. Takwatala akuba ifya cena cisuma ifingalingana nefyo namfumu wa ku Sheba apeele imfumu Solomoni.

english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
translation: Ine wine ne Paulo neo beba abati naba uwafuuka kabili uwamutembo ilyo ndi na imwe, lelo mba uwapama nga ndi ukutali.

english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
translation: Pantu bamo baleisosha abati, “Amakalata yakwa Paulo yantu yayafya kabili ayakosa. Nomba umwine wine nga epo ali, amonekafye umuntu wafye na mashiwi yakwe teyakuposako na mano.”

english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
translation: Abo bantu bali nokushininkisha ukuti, ifyo tumulembela mu makalata ilyo tuli ukutali, tafyakapusane nefyo tukacita ilyo tukaba na imwe uko.

english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
translation: Lelo kwena tekuti tupame ukulingana nangu ukuipalanya kuli abo bantu abaimona ukucila bambi. Awe aba bantu ni mpelwamano! Abene bene baipangila icipimo cakuipiminako, elyo balaipima ku cipimo baipangila abene!

english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
translation: Ifwe ukuitakisha kwesu teti kucile mu cipimo. Ifwe ukuitakisha kwesu kuti kwabafye nokulingana no mulimo Lesa atupeela. Elyo muli ici cena, no mulimo tubomba pakati kenu emo uli.

english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
translation: Apo na imwe mwaba muli ici cipimo tuitakishamo, kanshi tatwacililemo iyoo, ilyo twaishile kumwenu no kuleta Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu.

english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
translation: Eico ifwe tatuitakisha ukucila pa cipimo ico Lesa atupimina, pantu tatuitakisha pa mulimo uo abantu bambi babomba. Lelo ifwe tusubila ukuti icisumino cenu cakulakulilakofye, epakuti na ifwe umulimo tubomba pakati kenu ulelundulukilakofye, ukulingana nomo Lesa apimina.

english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
translation: Elyo lyena ukufuma mu calo cenu tukalabila Imbila Nsuma na mu fyalo fimbi. Kabili epakuti kwikaba ukuitakisha pa mulimo uwabombwa no muntu umbi kale.

english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
translation: Calembwa ukuti, “Onse uulefwaya ukuitakisha, ali nokuitakishisha muficita Imfumu.”

english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
translation: Pantu umuntu uo Imfumu imona ukuti aliba bwino e wacishinka, te muntu uimona umwine ukuti aliba bwino.

english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
translation: Ala ndemupapata ku cilela no luse lwakwa Kristu ukuti, mwilampatikisha ukuba uwapama ilyo nkesa. Pantu cine kuti nailanga ukuba uwapama kuli abo baleti tukonkafye amano yabuntunse.

english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
translation: Kwena twikalafye ngo muntu onse pano calo, lelo tatulwila na mano yabuntunse.

english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
translation: Ifyanso tulwishishako te fyabuntunse iyoo, lelo fyanso fyakwa Lesa ifyamaka, ifyo tubongolwelako amalinga ayakosa.

english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
translation: Tulacimfya ifikansa fyonse ifyabufi. Tulacimfya icilumba conse icilesha ukwishiba Lesa. Tulanasha amatontonkanyo yonse aya bantu ukuti yanakile Kristu.

english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
translation: Kanshi ilyo mukanakila Kristu umupwilapo lyena elyo tukakanda abo bonse abamusangukila.

english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
translation: Lolekesheni bwino ifintu muleimwena na menso yenu! Bushe palipo umuntu umo uuleimona ukuti cine cine muntu wakwa Kristu? Ala na ifwe bene tuli bakwa Kristu ngefyo fine aletontonkanya ukuti wena muntu wakwa Kristu.

english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
translation: Kwena insoni shena nshikwete, nangu nalimo nacishamo mukuitakisha pa maka Imfumu yampeela ayakumukosha mu cisumino teyakumonaula iyoo.

english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
translation: Nshilefwaya ukuti cimoneke kwati ndefwaya ukumutiinya ku makalata yandi.

english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
translation: Kuti cawama nga mwantekela umutima nangu natumpa panono! Napapata ntekeleniko umutima.

english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
translation: Kanshi mu cishinka cakwa Kristu icaba muli ine, ndemweba tapakabe nangu umo uwakundesha ukulaitakisha mu calo conse ica Akaia.

english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
translation: Cinshi nasosela ifi? Bushe nico nshamutemwa? Lesa wena alishiba ukuti nalimutemwa!

english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
translation: Ifyo ndecita nomba efyo nakulakonkanyapo ukucita lyonse, epakuti abo abaita ukuti basole, bemona mulandu wakuitakishishapo no kulasosa abati babombafye ngefyo ifwe tubomba.

english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
translation: Abo bantu tabali basole bacine cine. Basole babufi, ababepa abantu mu mibombele yabo, mukumoneka kwati basole bene bene bakwa Kristu.

english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
translation: Awe cena ico te cakupapa iyoo! Pantu na Satana nao alabepa abantu, amoneka no lubuuto kwati ni malaika musuma!

english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
translation: Kanshi tecakusunguka iyoo, nga cakuti ababomfi bakwa Satana nabo balamoneka kwati babomfi basuma. Lelo pakulekelesha bakapoka icilambu ca milimo yabo.

english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
translation: Kabili nabwekeshapo ukulanda ukuti nangu umo elatontonkanya ukuti ine ndi ciwelewele. Lelo nga efyo mutontonkanya, kanshi lekeni mbe nge ciwelewele, pakuti mba njitakisheko panono.

english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
translation: Lelo ifi nalasosa te milandile ya Imfumu. Muli ici cena icakuitakisha ndelandafye icine cine nge ciwelewele.

english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
translation: Lelo apo abantu abengi baitakisha pafyo babomba ifyabuntunse, na ine wine nalacita ifyo fine.

english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
translation: Apo imwe mwe bene muli bamano nganshi, kanshi eico ne fipuba mulatemwa ukufitekela imitima!

english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
translation: Filya Lesa aba no bufuba pali imwe, efyo na ine wine naba no bufuba pali imwe. Pantu mwaba ngo mukashana musuma uushakuma ku mwaume, uo nasobwela ukupwa ku mwaume umo mpo, Kristu.

english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
translation: Imwe mutekela imitima no muntu uulemuteeka nga basha, uulemuliila pa mutwe, nangu uulemucenjesha, nangu uwamusuula, nangu uwamutoba ulupi pa menso.

english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
translation: Awe cena cansoni nasumina, ifwe tuli bamwenso teti tucite ifyo.

english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
translation: Bushe Bahibulu? Na ine wine. Bushe bena Israeli? Na ine wine. Bushe ba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu? Na ine wine.

english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
translation: Bushe babomfi bakwa Kristu? Lyena nalalanda nga uwapena, ine nalibacila ukubombela Kristu! Ine nalibomba ukubacila. Nalibacila ne miku bamposa mu cifungo. Nalibacila imiku iyingi iyo bangumine ifikoti. Elyo imikufye iyingi naleba mupepi no kufwa.

english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
translation: Pa miku isano Abayuda bangumine ifikoti amakumi yatatu na pabula.

english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
translation: Abena Roma nabo bangumine ne nkonto pa miku itatu. Elyo umuku umo bandashile amabwe. Pa miku itatu napuswike kukubunda na mato pali bemba. Umuku umo nali mu menshi pali bemba akasuba no bushiku.

english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
translation: Mu nyendo shandi ishingi naleisanga mu masanso pakwabuka imimana, mu masanso ku bapupu, mu masanso ku Bayuda banandi na ku Benafyalo. Nalesanga amasanso mu misumba, amasanso mu matololo, amasanso pali fibemba, elyo amasanso na kuli bamunyinefwe ababufi.

english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
translation: Kwali ukubomba imilimo iyakosa nganshi. Ilingi bwalecafye ukwabula ukusendama. Kabili ilingi line naleendafye ne nsala ne cilaka, elyo no kututuma ku mpepo, kabili ukwabula ukukwata ifyakufwala ifilingile.

english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
translation: Kulifye na fimbi ifingi ifyo nshilumbwile, lelo kabili cila bushiku nyendafye uwasakamana nganshi pa mulandu wa nkuta shonse.

english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
translation: Umwina Kristu umo nga aleumfwa ukunakuka, na ine ninshi ndomfwa ukunakuka. Umwina Kristu umo nga awila mukubifya, ine ndomfwa ubulanda nganshi.

english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
translation: Ndi no mwenso wakuti amano yenu kuti yayalukila ku bubi, kabili mwasuula no kupetamina Kristu ne mitima yenu yonse, nga filya Efa abepelwe ku bucenjeshi bwa nsoka.

english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
translation: Nga ndi nokuitakisha, ninshi ndi nokuitakishafye pa fintu ifilanga ubunasha bwandi.

english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
translation: Lesa Wishi wa Mfumu Yesu, uufwile alelumbwa lyonse pe, naishiba ukuti nshilebepa iyoo.

english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
translation: Ilyo nali mu Damasiko, umulashi wa mfumu Aleta abikile abantu bakulinda impongolo sha musumba pakuti banjikate.

english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
translation: Lelo nalifyukile, banjishishe mu museke, bampisha mu cipunda ce linga.

english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
translation: Pantu imwe mupokelela bwangu bwangufye onse uwaisa kuli imwe alabila na pali Yesu umbi uo ifwe tushamubililapo. Kabili mupokelela mupashi ne mbila ifyapusana na Mupashi ne Mbila Nsuma mwapokelele kuli ifwe.

english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
translation: Ine ndetontonkanya ukuti abo basole mulumbilisha tabancilile nakalya.

english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
translation: Nalimo mukulanda mwena nshacenjela, lelo mu mano mwena iyoo. Ici cena twalimulangafye bwino bwino mu nshila shonse, kabili na mu nshitafye shonse.

english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
translation: Nshatalile mulipilisha pakumushimikila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa. Bushe nalilufyenye pali ico naleicefya pakuti imwe mucindame?

english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
translation: Ilyo nalebomba pakati kenu, inkuta shimbi eshalengafwilishako. Cali kwati nalebebilafye ifyuma pakuti mwafweko.

english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
translation: Kabili ilyo nali na imwe nshatalile musakamika pakuti mungafwilisheko pafyo nalekabila. Bamunyinefwe abafumine ku Makedonia ebandetele fyonse ifyo nalekabila. Ifyo fine kale nshalemusakamika efyo na kuntanshi kwine cikaba.

english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
translation: Ndeitakisha nangu mushaba kantu mukuitakisha. Nomba nalalanda pa fintu ifyo Imfumu yalengele mone nefyo yansokolwelele.

english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
translation: Pa mulandu wakwa Kristu ndasekela mu bunasha, mukutukwa insele, mu mafya, mukucushiwa, na mu masanso. Pantu ni mu bunasha bwandi, emo mba na maka.

english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
translation: Nalanda kwati ndi ciwelewele, lelo nimwe mwalenga ukuti nande ifyo. Pantu nimwe mwali nokulantasha. Pantu nangu ningaba icinangwa, abo basole benu mulumbilisha tabancilile nakalya.

english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
translation: Ifishibilo ifilanga ukuba umusole wine wine, ifinjelengwe ne fipeshamano, fyonse nalifibomba no mutekatima pakati kenu.

english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
translation: Ngefyo nshabomba kuli imwe ifyo nabomba ku nkuta shimbi finshi? Shikanofye ninshi nico nshamusakamike kukungafwa? Kanshi mbeleleniko uluse pali ici cilubo!

english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
translation: Nomba uyu muku ewalenga butatu uwakwisa mupempula. Kabili nshakamusakamike ku cintu nelyo cimo. Ico ine mfwaya nimwe, te fyuma iyoo. Kabili kwena abana tabapekanya icuma cakusungilamo abafyashi, lelo abafyashi ebapekanya icuma cakusungilamo abana.

english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
translation: Ine kuti nasansamuka nganshi ukubomfya fyonse ifyo nakwata no kuleka umweo wandi pakumwafwako. Bushe nico namutemwisha ifyo, eco imwe mwingantemenwa panono?

english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
translation: Kanshi ninshi na imwe mulesumina ukuti nshalemusakamika nelyo panono. Nomba umo kuti ati ala nico wabucenjeshi, eco amongwelele ku bucenjeshi bwakwe.

english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
translation: Bushe ninshi namucenjelele muli abo bantu naletuma ukwisa kuli imwe?

english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
translation: Nalombele Tito ukwisa uko, elyo natumine na munyinefwe umwina Kristu ukwisa nankwe. Bushe kuti mwatila Tito aishile mucenjelela? Bushe Tito na ine tatwabombelefye no mutima umo ne myendele yesu nayo imo ine?

english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
translation: Nalimo imwe mutontonkanya ukuti fyonse ifyo tumweba fyakuiwaminishafye? Awe iyoo! Tulandafye ngefyo Kristu engafwaya tulande pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Ala fyonse ifyo tucita mwe batemwikwa besu fyakumwafwakofye.

english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
translation: Nalishiba umwina Kristu umo uwasendelwe ku mulu ukutali nganshi, nomba papita imyaka ikumi limo na ine. Kwena nshishibe nga asendelwe umutuntulu no mubili, nangu nalimo califye mu cimonwa, ico cena ni Lesa ewishibe.

english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
translation: Ine ndetiina ukuti ilyo nkesa uko, nkesa musanga ifyo nshingatemwa ukuti mube. Elyo na imwe mukansange ifyo mushingatemwa ukuti mbe. Kabili ndetiina ukuti nkesa sanga ukuumana, umufimbila, icipyu, bukaitemwe, ukubepeshanya, ulwambo, imiya elyo ne cimfulunganya.

english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
translation: Ndetiina ukuti limbi ilyo nkesa, Lesa wandi akaleka nkekatwe ne nsoni pa cinso cenu. Kabili nkesa lila ne filamba pali abo bantu abengi abakaana ukulapila no kupilibuka pa fyabupulumushi bacita kale, pa lunkumbwa lubi lwabo na pali bucilende bwabo.

english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
translation: Nalishibe ukuti uyu muntu asendelwe ku Cifulo Cansansa. Nga asendelwe umutuntulu no mubili nalimo califye mu cimonwa, nshishibe, ni Lesa ewishibe.

english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
translation: Muli iyo ncende aumfwile ifintu umuntu ashingalondolola, kabili teti asuminishiwe ukufilandapo.

english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
translation: Pali uyu muntu pena epo ningaitakishishapo. Nomba pali ine ne mwine tekuti njitakishe, shikano ninshi pa fintu filanga ubunasha bwandi.

english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
translation: Kwena nangu ningaitakisha tekuti mbe iciwelewele, pantu ifyo ningalanda fyacishinka. Lelo nshaitakishe, pantu nshilefwaya ukuti umuntu nelyo umo aletontonkanya pali ine ukucila pafyo amona ncita na pafyo aumfwa nsosa.

english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
translation: Nomba pakutalusha kukuba ne cilumba pa mulandu wa fintu ifyakupapa nganshi ifyo namwene, Lesa alimpeela icintu icilasa mu mubili kwati munga. Ici cintu caba kwati ni nkombe yakwa Satana, icakuncusha pakuti mone ukutaluka kukuba ne cilumba.

english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
translation: Napapete Imfumu pa miku itatu pakuti imfumyemo ici cintu.

english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
translation: Lelo Imfumu yanjaswike aiti, “Ala icikuuku nakukwatila eco ulekabila, pantu amaka yandi yamonekesha bwino ilyo uli mu bunasha.” Kanshi nakulasansamuka nganshi no kuitakisha mu bunasha bwandi, epakuti amaka yakwa Kristu yekalilile muli ine.

english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
translation: Uyu e muku walalenga butatu ukwisa mupempula. “Pa kupeela umuntu umulandu kano pali bakambone babili nangu batatu.”

english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
translation: Eico nalembela kalata uyu ilyo ncili ukutali noko muli. Epakuti ilyo nkesa uko, nikesa bomfya ubukali, mukubomfya amaka Imfumu yampeela. Aya maka teyakumonaula iyoo, lelo yakumwafwako pakuti muwamineko.

english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
translation: Bamunyinane, pakulekelesha ndeti shalenipo! Muleesha ukuba abapwililika. Mulekonka ifyo mwebele. Mube aba mutima umo, muleikala mu mutende na banenu. Kabili Lesa uwacitemwiko, kabili uwamutende, engalaba na imwe.

english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
translation: Muleposhanya mukutomona kwamushilo.

english: All the saints greet you.
translation: Abamushilo bonse balemuposha.

english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
translation: Naishile musokako lilya naishile mupempula pa lwendo lwacibili. Nomba nalabwekeshapo nakabili ilyo ncili ukutali. Ndemweba ukuti ilyo nkesa nakabili, nkakanda bonse abo ababifishe kale na bambi bene bonse.

english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
translation: Lyena elyo mukashininkisha ukuti ni Kristu eulandila muli ine. Pantu ilyo Kristu abomba muli imwe, alanga amaka yakwe, talanga ukuti taba na maka.

english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
translation: Pantu nangu imfwa ya pa musalaba ilanga ukuti taba na maka, lelo ni ku maka yakwa Lesa eko abela umumi. Kanshi na ifwe nelyo twaampana na Kristu, tatwakwata maka. Lelo ilyo tumubombela, tulakwatako amaka yakwa Lesa ayo na Kristu akwatako.

english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
translation: Muipime mwe bene, muyeshe mumone nga cine cine mwaliba ne cisumino. Bushe tamwashininkisha ukuti Kristu Yesu aba muli imwe? Nga teifyo ninshi mwalifilililwafye.

english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
translation: Amaf 17:6

english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
translation: Ifwe tulamupepelako kuli Lesa ukuti mwilawila mu filubo. Te mulandu wakufwaya ukulanga abantu ukuti ifwe tatwafilwa iyoo, lelo ni pakuti imwe mulecita ifilungeme, nangu nalimo ifwe tulemoneka kwati twalifilwa.

english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
translation: Pantu ifwe teti tucite nelyo cimo icakukaanya icishinka, kanofye icakwafwilisha icishinka.

english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
translation: Ifwe tulasansamuka ukuba mu bunasha, kumfwa imwe muli abakosa. Kanshi ifwe tulamupepelako pakuti mwaluke mube abapwililika.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
translation: Ine Paulo, Lesa kukufwaya kwakwefye anjita ukuba musole wakwa Kristu Yesu. Ine ndi na Timote munyinefwe.

english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
translation: Lesa uyu uwatupuswishe ku macushi yakututwala ku mfwa, akulatupususha. Pantu ifwe eo twatetekela ukuti akatupususha nakabili.

english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
translation: Imwe muletwafwako mukutupepelako. Kanshi abengi nga balatupepelako, Lesa akaasuka amapepo yabo, na ifwe ninshi akatupaala, elyo na bengi bakatasha Lesa pafyo atucitila.

english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
translation: Ici ecilenga tuleumfwa icilumba, na kambone wesu ni kampingu wa mu mitima yesu. Pantu mu bumi bwesu pano calo, palibufi mufyo twaleikala na imwe, mwalifye ubufumacumi no bwina Lesa. Tamwali mano yabuntunse iyoo, kanofye amaka ya cikuuku cakwa Lesa.

english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
translation: Pantu ifwe tumulembelafye ifyakuti mwabelenga no kumfwa mwaumfwa.

english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
translation: Nomba nangu pa nshita ino tamuletumfwa bwino bwino, ndesubila ukuti kuntanshi mukalatumfwafye bwino bwino. Epakuti mu Bushiku bwa Mfumu, imwe mukomfwe icilumba pali ifwe ngefyo na ifwe tukomfwa icilumba pali imwe.

english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
translation: Pali ici cine nshaletwishika, eico napangile ukubalilapo ukumupempula, pakuti mwashukila ukumupempula imiku ibili.

english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
translation: Pantu napangile ukumupempula pa bulendo bwandi ubwakuya ku Makedonia, elyo na pakubwela ukufuma ku Makedonia. Lyena epakuti mwangafwilishako na pa bulendo bwandi ubwakuya ku Yudeya.

english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
translation: Bushe ilyo nalepanga ifi, bushe nshaishibe ico nalecita? Bushe ilyo mpanga ukucita icintu, bushe muleti nkonkelelafye amano yabuntunse? Icakuti pa nshita imo ine natila, “Ee” kabili nati, “Iyoo”?

english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
translation: Awe mu cishinka cakwa Lesa amashiwi yesu kuli imwe teyakutila, “Ee na iyoo” pa nshita imo ine.

english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
translation: Pantu Mwana Lesa Kristu Yesu, uo Sailasi na Timote na ine twamushimikilapo, teuyu uutila, “Ee na Iyoo” pa nshita imo ine. Awe wene lyonse ni “Ee” wakwa Lesa.

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
translation: Pantu mu filayo fyonse Lesa alaile abantu, Kristu ewaba “Ee” wakwa Lesa. Eico ku maka yakwa Kristu tusosela atuti, “Ameni,” pakuti Lesa alelumbwa.

english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
translation: Ni Lesa umwine ku maka yakwa Kristu alenga ukuti twaampane pamo. Ni Lesa umwine ewatusala ukuba abantu bakwe.

english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
translation: Alitufwatika ne cishibilo cakulanga ukuti tuli bantu bakwe. Kabili pakutulaya ukuti aba nokutupa na fimbi, alitupeela Mupashi Wamushilo mu mitima yesu.

english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
translation: Lesa e kambone, ewaishiba umutima wandi! Ala ico nshaishile ku Kolinti nico nshalefwaya ukumukalifya imitima.

english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
translation: Ifwe tatufwaya kulamupatikisha mu cisumino cenu. Lelo ifwe tubombela pamo na imwe pakuti mube ne nsansa. Pantu ifwe twalishiba ukuti mwaba ne cisumino icakosa.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Lesa kabili Wishi wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu. Ni Shifwe waluse, Lesa uutukoselesha muli fyonse.

english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
translation: Eutukoselesha mu bwafya bonse, epakuti na ifwe tumone ukukoselesha bonse abali mu bwafya ubwalekana lekana. Tulebakoseleshako ne cikoseleshi cine ico Lesa atukoseleseshako.

english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
translation: Pantu apo na ifwe tuculako amacushi ayengi Kristu aculileko, kanshi na ifwe kuti twakoseleshako abengi ku maka yene yakwa Kristu.

english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
translation: Nga tulecula, ninshi ni pakumukoseleshako kabili pakuti mupusuke. Nga Lesa atukoseleshako, ninshi ni pakuti na ifwe tumukoselesheko. Ici cine e cikoseleshi mukwata pakuti mushipikishe mu macushi ayo yene na ifwe tuculako.

english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
translation: Kanshi ifwe twalimutetekela nganshi. Pantu twalishiba ukuti apofye muculako amacushi yene na ifwe tuculako, na imwe bene mukashukilako icikoseleshi tushukila.

english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
translation: Bamunyinefwe, tulefwaya ukumwishibishako amacushi twaculile mu calo ca Asia. Ala, ayo macushi yali yacipeshamano, kabili ayabipisha, icakuti tatwalesubila no kupusuka.

english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
translation: Ifwe twamwene ukuti iyi e mfwa yesu, lelo ici cacitike pakutulanga ukuti tatuli nakucetekela mu maka yesu fwe bene, kanofye muli Lesa uubusha na bafwa.

english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
translation: Kanshi ecalengele ukupangulula ubo bulendo, nico nshalefwaya ukwisa mubika mu bulanda nakabili.

english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
translation: Kanshi lyonse ilyo mwabelela umuntu uluse pafyo amulufyanya, na ine wine ninshi nimubelela uluse. Nga cakuti nabelela uluse, nga cine pali icakubelelapo umuntu uluse, ninshi nacita ifyo pa cinso cakwa Kristu pa mulandu wenu.

english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
translation: Lyena epakwansha Satana, pantu twalishiba amapange yakwe.

english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
translation: Ilyo naile kukubila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu mu Troa, nasangile ukuti Imfumu yalimpekanishisha inshila pakuti mombe.

english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
translation: Lelo icansakamike nganshi, nico nshasangileko munyinefwe Tito. Kanshi epakubashalikapo, naya na ku Makedonia.

english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
translation: Ala natuletasha Lesa. Pantu alenga ukuti tulebomba pamo na Kristu uwacimfya fyonse. Kabili nifwe Lesa alenga ukuti tusalanganye ku bantu bonse amano yakwishiba Kristu kwati cena cisuma.

english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish:
translation: Ifwe twaba kwati cena cisuma ca bubani Kristu atuula kuli Lesa, icisalanganina ku balepusuka na ku baleloba.

english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
translation: Kuli abo balelobelela, bena cena icanunka pipi icakubepaya. Lelo ku balepusuka bena cena icisuma icakubapeela umweo. Nga kanshi nani engabomba uyu mulimo?

english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
translation: Ifwe tatwaba nga bantu bambi abengi. Ifwe tatubomfya ishiwi lyakwa Lesa pakunonkelamo. Lelo ifwe pantu ni Lesa watutuma, tulanda amashiwi yakwa Lesa pa cinso cakwe mu cishinka nga babomfi bakwa Kristu.

english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
translation: Pantu nga nimwe nabika mu bulanda, nga kanshi nani umbi engandetela insansa? Bushe teabo bene bantu nengele ukuba no bulanda!

english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
translation: Kanshi eco namulembele ulya kalata, nshalefwaya ukwisa kuli imwe nokwisa mbika mu bulanda mwe bantu mwe bafwile nimwe mulendetela insansa. Pantu nalishininkisha ukuti nga ndesansamuka ninshi na imwe bonse muli ne nsansa.

english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
translation: Ilyo namulembele ulya kalata, nalembele ndelila ne filamba nganshi ku mutima ubukali, kabili nali no bulanda nganshi. Kanshi nshalefwaya ukumuletela ubulanda, nalefwayafye ukuti mwishibe ifyo namutemwisha.

english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
translation: Nomba umo nga alilufyanya, kwena ninshi tekuli ine, lelo nalimo ni kuli imwe bonse. Kwena nshilefwaya kukosha umulandu.

english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
translation: Apo bonse balimukalipila, ico cine ecilingile.

english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
translation: Nomba icilefwaikwa kumubelelako uluse no kulamukoseleshako. Pantu limbi kuti aikatwa no bulanda nganshi icakuti anenuka.

english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
translation: Kanshi ndemulomba mulemulanga ukuti eshibe ukuti icine cine mwalimutemwa.

english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
translation: Pantu uyu wine e mulandu namulembele kalata. Nalefwaya ukumwesha njishibe nga mulabeela muli fyonse.

english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
translation: Bushe ici calamoneka kwati tulefwaya ukuti mube bakambone besu? Bushe cilefwaikwa ukuti tulecita nga bantu bambi, tulepoka amakalata yakulondolola kuli imwe, nangu ayakufuma kuli imwe?

english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
translation: Kanshi ico paisa icakwata ubucindami ubwacilapo, icali no bucindami nomba tacakwata.

english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
translation: Pantu nga cilya icali nokubakofye pa kashita kanono caishile no bucindami, palibufi icakubelelela, ubucindami tabwalicilapo nganshi!

english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
translation: Pali ico twakwata ili isubilo, eco tupamina no kulanda.

english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
translation: Ifwe tatwaba nga Mose uwalefimba insalu pa mpumi, pakuti abena Israeli belamona uko ukubengeshima pa mpumi kwile kulepwa.

english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
translation: Imitima yabo yali iyakutwa. Pantu ukufika na nomba babelenga icipangano cakale ne nsalu imo ine naibafimba pa menso. Pantu ni mukuba pamo na Kristu emo tumona amaka yakufumyapo insalu.

english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
translation: Ukufikafye na lelo, lyonse ilyo babelenga Amafunde yakwa Mose, imitima yabo ibafye iyakupwa ne nsalu.

english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
translation: Lelo insalu ilafimbulwapo ilyo umuntu ayalukila ku Mfumu.

english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
translation: Nomba muli aya mashiwi, Imfumu baloshako ni Mupashi. Ukuli Mupashi wa Mfumu ninshi ekuli ubuntungwa.

english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
translation: Ifwe tatwafimbwa pa menso pakulolesha ubucindami bwa Mfumu. Kabili ni Mfumu Mupashi eutwalula pakuti tulecililako mu bucindami, tutole icata cakwe.

english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
translation: Ala imwe bene nimwe kalata wesu wakutulondolola uwalembwa mu mitima yesu pakuti onse abelenge eshibe no kwishiba.

english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
translation: Kabili te cakutwishika nimwe bene kalata Kristu alemba uo na ifwe twasakamana mu kubomba kwesu. Pakulemba uyu kalata, talebomfya inki iyoo, lelo alemba na Mupashi wakwa Lesa wamweo. Kabili uyu kalata talembwa pa mabwe ayapapatala, lelo alembwa mu mitima ya bantu.

english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
translation: Ico twalandila ifi nico ku maka yakwa Kristu twalicetekela Lesa.

english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
translation: Pantu muli ifwe tamwaba cakutulanga ukuti twaliba na maka yakubomba uyu mulimo. Ni Lesa ewatupeela amaka yakubomba.

english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
translation: Ni Lesa ewatupeela amaka yakuba ababomfi ba cipangano cipya. Ici, cipangano icishaba pa mafunde yalembwa, lelo cakwa Mupashi. Pantu amafunde yalembwa yena yaleta imfwa, lelo Mupashi wena apeela umweo.

english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
translation: Ifilembo fya Mafunde yakwa Mose ayaletele imfwa fyafukwilwe pa mabwe. Kabili ilyo aya mafunde yapeelwe, kwamoneka no bucindami bwakwa Lesa. Abena Israeli balefilwa no kulolesha pa mpumi yakwa Mose ico yalebengeshima, nangu uko kubengeshima kwaile kulepwa.

english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
translation: Palibufi umulimo wakwa Mupashi wena walicilapo nganshi ukucindama.

english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
translation: Nga kanshi apo imibombele iyaleta imilandu yaishile no bucindami, palibufi imibombele iyalenga tube abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa tayalicilapo nganshi ku bucindami!

english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
translation: Lesa ku luse lwakwe ewatupeela ukubomba uyu mulimo, kanshi tatuli nakunenuka.

english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
translation: Lyonse twenda ne mfwa yakwa Yesu pa mibili yesu, epakuti umweo wakwa Yesu ulemoneka mu mibili yesu.

english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
translation: Pantu ilyo tucili abomi lyonsefye twenda mu busanso bwa mfwa pa mulandu wakwa Yesu, epakuti umweo wakwa Yesu ulemoneka mu mibili yesu iyinakufwa.

english: So then death works in us, but life in you.
translation: Kanshi emukutila imfwa eibomba muli ifwe, nomba muli imwe mweo.

english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
translation: Calembwa ukuti, “Ine nalisumine, ecalengele nalisosele.” Na ifwe pantu apo twaba no mutima umo wine uwacisumino, tulalanda pantu twalisumina.

english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti Lesa uwabushishe Imfumu Yesu ku bafwa, na ifwe bene akatubusha ngefyo abushishe Yesu. Kabili akatusenda pamo na imwe, akatubike na pa cinso cakwe.

english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
translation: Fyonse ifi fyacitika pa mulandu wa imwe. Epakuti abantu balefulilako abaleshukila icikuuku cakwa Lesa, balecililako ukutasha no kulumbanya Lesa.

english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
translation: Ni pali uyu mulandu eco tushinenukila. Nangu umubili wesu wena wile ulekota, awe umutima wesu wena ulecililakofye ukuwama cila bushiku.

english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
translation: Kabili utu tumacushi tuleculako pali nomba etukalenga tukashukile ubucindami ubwakubelelela ubwacipeshamano ubwacila nganshi na pa macushi.

english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
translation: Kabili ifwe tatwabika imitima yesu pa fintu ifimoneka, lelo kano pa fintu ifishimoneka. Ifintu ifimoneka fiya pa nshitafye inono, lelo ifishimoneka fyena fyakubelelela.

english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
translation: Ifyo fyonse ificitwa mu bumfisolo ifilenga insoni twalifitalukako. Ifwe tatwaba na bucenjeshi nangu ukufulunganya amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Ifwe lyonse twaba abacishinka pa cinso cakwa Lesa pakuti umuntu wa mutima usuma aletupashanya.

english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
translation: Pantu Imbila Nsuma tufunda nga yalifisama, ninshi yafisamafye ku bantu abalelobelela.

english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
translation: Ico bashasuminina, nico Ciwa, lesa we sonde lino abateeka mu mfifi. Abateeka mu mfifi pakuti bemona ulubuuto ulwabasanikila ulwa Mbila Nsuma ya bucindami bwakwa Kristu. Uyu Kristu ewaba icine cine icata cakwa Lesa.

english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
translation: Pantu ifyo tubila te fya pali ifwe iyoo. Ifwe tubila pali Yesu Kristu Imfumu, elyo ifwe tulifye basha benu pa mulandu wakwa Kristu.

english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
translation: Pantu ni Lesa ewasosele ati, “Mu mfifi namufume ulubuuto lulesanika.” Ni uyu wine Lesa ewalenga ukuti ulubuuto lwakwe lulesanika mu mitima yesu, pakuti tumone ukwishiba ubucindami bwakwa Lesa ububengeshima pa mpumi yakwa Kristu.

english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
translation: Nomba ici cuma caba muli ifwe. Ifwe twabafye nge nongo she bumba. Epakulanga ukuti uwakwatisha amaka ni Lesa teifwe iyoo.

english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
translation: Ifwe amacushi yatwishilafye ukufuma konse konse, nomba tatunenuka. Ilyo catwansha ifyakucita, nalyo tatufupuka.

english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
translation: Abantu balatucusha, lelo Lesa tatulekelesha. Balatupuma, lelo tatufwa.

english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
translation: Nomba twalishiba ukuti iyi nsakwe twikalamo pano calo, umubili wesu nga waonaika, Lesa alitupekanishisha iŋanda imbi mu mulu iyakwikalamo. Iyi ŋanda yena ni Lesa umwine ewakuula, kabili yakubelelela.

english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
translation: Pantu bonse tukeminina pa cinso cakwa Kristu pakuti akatupingule. Elyo cila muntu akapoka icilambu icimulingile ukulingana nefyo acitile, ifisuma nangu ifibi ilyo acili umumi.

english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
translation: Ifwe twalishiba ifyo ukuba na katiina kuli Lesa kwaba, kanshi eico tulacincisha na bambi ukuba na katiina. Lesa alitwishiba bwino ifyo twaba. Kabili ndesubila ukuti mu mitima yenu na imwe mwalitwishiba ifyo twaba.

english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
translation: Tatulefwaya cimoneke ukuti tulefwaya mube bakambone besu nakabili. Lelo tulefwayafye ukumulanga ico mufwile ukumfwilapo icilumba pali ifwe. Epakuti mumone umwakwasukila abo bantu ababa ne cilumba pafyo balemona umuntu, nomba tepafyo aba mu mutima.

english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
translation: Kanshi nga tusabailafye, ninshi ni kuli Lesa tusabaila. Lelo nga tulanda ifyamano, ninshi ni pa mulandu wenu.

english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
translation: Ifwe, icitemwiko Kristu atukwatila cilatupamfya. Pantu ifwe twalishininkisha ukuti muntu umo ewafwila pa bantu bonse, kanshi na ifwe bonse twalifwa nankwe.

english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
translation: Apo afwila abantu bonse, kanshi ninshi na bonse abacili abomi tabali nakuisakamanafye abene beka, lelo bali nokusakamanafye uyo uwabafwilile. Elyo kabili pa mulandu wabo alibushiwa na ku bafwa.

english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
translation: Kanshi nomba tatupima umuntu pakukonka amano yabuntunse. Nangu kwena kale twalepima Kristu mukukonka amano yabuntunse nomba tatucita ifyo iyoo.

english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
translation: Eico, umuntu onse uwaba muli Kristu ninshi nomba aba umuntu mupya. Bumuntu bwakale bwapwa, nomba aba umupya.

english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
translation: Uubomba fyonse ifi ni Lesa. Ewatuwikishanya nankwe umwine pa mulandu wakwa Kristu. Elyo na ifwe atupeela uyu wine mulimo uwakuwikishanya.

english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
translation: Kanshi ekutila Lesa umwine ewawikishanya na bantu ba pano isonde pa mulandu wakwa Kristu. Alasuula ku fyabubifi bacita. Kabili alitupeela imbila yakuwikishanya.

english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
translation: Ilyo tucili pano calo, tulaisosha no kufwaisha nganshi ukufwala imibili ya ku mulu.

english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
translation: Ifwe tuli nkombe shakwimininako Kristu. Ilyo tulemwita ukubwelela kuli Lesa, ni Lesa umwine eulemwita. Pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, tulemupapata ukuti lekeni amuwikishanye nankwe.

english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
translation: Kristu wena takwete bubifi. Lelo pa mulandu wa ifwe Lesa amucita ngo wabubifi nga ifwe, epakuti mukuba nankwe pamo, tumone ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
translation: Pantu ukufwala imibili ya ku mulu, kukalenga ukuti twikaba ubwamba.

english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
translation: Pantu ilyo tucili muli ino nsakwe ya pano calo, tulaisosha no kuba abasakamikwa. Temukutila nico tulefwaya ukufwa, ukusha imibili yesu, lelo nico tulefwaya ukufwala imibili ya ku mulu, pakuti umweo ukalule imibili ifwa.

english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
translation: Ni Lesa umwine ewatupekanishishe ici cintu. Kabili Mupashi uo atupeela e cishibilo cakushininkishishako fintu fyonse ifyo atupekanishisha.

english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
translation: Eco ifwe lyonse twabela abashipa. Twalishiba ukuti ilyo tucili abomi ne mibili yesu, ninshi tucili ukutali no kwaba Imfumu.

english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
translation: Ifwe icitutungulula mu bumi bwesu cisumino, te fintu tumona.

english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
translation: Ifwe twalishipa nganshi. Kabili ndetila kuti twatemwapo ukusha umubili wesu pakuti twaya kukwikala ne Mfumu.

english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
translation: Ifwe ilyo tuli abomi ne mibili, nangu panuma yakusha imibili, lyonse tufwayafye ukusansamusha Imfumu.

english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
translation: Apo ifwe bonse tubombela pamo na Lesa, tulemupapata apo Lesa amukwatila icikuuku, mwicilekelesha.

english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
translation: Ifwe tuli ababulanda, lelo lyonse tulasansamuka. Tuli bapina, nomba nifwe tulenga abengi ukuba abakankala. Tatwakwata nelyo kamo, lelo nifwe twakwata fyonse.

english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
translation: Mwe bena Kolinti, twamwebafye fyonse ukwabula ukushapo nelyo kamo. Ala twalimutemwa nganshi.

english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
translation: Ifwe tatwaleka ukumutemwa, lelo imwe nimwe mushilefwaya ukututemwa.

english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
translation: Ndelanda kuli imwe ngefyo ningalanda ku bana bandi. Kanshi na imwe langeni icitemwiko mwatukwatila.

english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
translation: Mwilaesha ukwampana na bantu abashasumina. Ngo busuma no bubi kuti fyaampana shani? Ngo lubuuto ne mfifi kuti fyaikala shani pamo?

english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
translation: Nga Kristu kuti baumfwana shani na Satana? Nga finshi uwasumina bengomfwana no ushasumina?

english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
translation: Bushe itempele lyakwa Lesa kuti lyaumfwana shani no tulubi? Pantu ifwe bonse tuli tempele lyakwa Lesa wamweo. Lesa umwine atila ati,

english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
translation: Kabili Imfumu yatila aiti,

english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
translation: Nkaba Shinwe,

english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
translation: Pantu Lesa atila ati,

english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
translation: Ifwe tatufwaya ukuti umuntu asanga icilubo mu milimo yesu. Kanshi eico tatuleka cintu nelyo cimo mu muntu icakumufulunganya.

english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
translation: Mu cintu conse ico tulecita, tulapamfiwa ukuti tube ababomfi bakwa Lesa bene bene. Kanshi tulashipikisha mu macushi ayaletwishila, mu mafya na mu masanso.

english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
translation: Ifwe balatupuma, balatuposa na mu fifungo, elyo no kucenwa mu fimfulunganya. Kabili baleka tulebombesha nganshi, nomba ukwabula ukulya nangu ukusendama.

english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
translation: Ifwe twenda ne mitima iyakaele, abamano, abateka imitima, kabili twaliba no luse. Twenda na Mupashi Wamushilo ne citemwiko cesu cacishinka.

english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
translation: Tulanda ifyacishinka, kabili maka yakwa Lesa ayabomba muli ifwe. Ifyanso fyesu ifyakulwishishako no kuipokolwelako kucita ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
translation: Esaya 49:8

english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
translation: Twaba kwati tabatwishiba, lelo bonse balitwishiba. Twaba kwati baletwipaya, nomba moneni, epo tucili abomi. Balatucusha, lelo tabatwipaya.

english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
translation: Mwe bacibusa bandi, fyonse ifi ni Lesa ewatulaya. Kanshi natuisangulule kuli fyonse ifikowesha umubili no mupashi. Tube na katiina kuli Lesa, mukuba icine cine abamushilo pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
translation: Pantu ubulanda ubo Lesa afwaya bulalenga ukulapila no kupilibuka, elyo ici naco cilenga ukupusuka. Kanshi pali ici tapali cakulangulukapo. Lelo ubulanda bwa muno calo bwena bulaleta imfwa.

english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
translation: Shimoneni ifyo Lesa abomfeshe ubo bulanda. Nomba bulengele ukuti mube abacincila mulefwaisha nganshi ukukanaikumika kuli ico cilubo. Yangu ifyo mufulilwe uwabifishe, ifyo mukwatishe umwenso! Yangu ifyo muli abakalabana, no kuipeelesha nganshi ku Mfumu, elyo no kufwaisha nganshi ukulungika uwabifishe! Muli ifi fyonse mwalangafye ukuti tamwabamo muli uyo mulandu.

english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
translation: Eico kanshi ilyo nalembele ulya kalata, nshalembele pa mulandu wa ico uyo abifishe, nangu pali uyo abifisheko. Nalembele pakuti mushininkishe pa cinso cakwa Lesa ifyo cine cine mwatusakamana.

english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
translation: Ici cine ecitukoselesha.

english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
translation: Pantu ilyo nalelanda pali imwe kuli Tito, nalemutasha nganshi. Awe na imwe tamwansebenye iyoo. Pantu nga filya lyonsefye tumulandila ifyacishinka, nefyo twalemutasha kuli Tito nafyo afisangile ukuti fyacishinka.

english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
translation: Elyo icitemwiko amukwatila cilelundulukilako nga aibukisha ifyo imwe bonse mwalemunakila, nefyo mwamusekelele no mucinshi na katiina.

english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
translation: Awe mwandini ine ndi ne nsansa nganshi pakumona ukuti imwe kuti namucetekela muli fyonse.

english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
translation: Kanshi tulangeni icitemwiko mwatukwatila. Ifwe tatwalufyanyapo ku muntu nelyo umo. Kabili tatwalenga umuntu nelyo umo ukubifya, nangufye ukucenjeshapo umuntu nelyo umo.

english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
translation: Nshilelanda ifi ico ndefwaya ukumupeela umulandu. Pantu nimweba kale ukuti, ala twalimutemwisha nganshi, cibe ni mu bumi nangu mu mfwa, lyonse tuba na imwe pamo.

english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
translation: Ine nalimucetekela nganshi. Kabili ndomfwa icilumba pa mulandu wa imwe! Ala ici cilankoselesha nganshi. Elyo na mu macushi yesu yonse ndomfwa insansa nganshi.

english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
translation: Ilyo twafikile mu Makedonia, awe tatwamwene na pakutuushisha. Twaisangile mu mafya mpanga yonse, ukubikana ifikansa na bantu, elyo no kumfwa umwenso mu mitima yesu.

english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
translation: Nomba Lesa uukoselesha abafupuka mu mitima, alitukoseleshe ico Tito aishile.

english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
translation: Twalikoseleshiweko te pa mulandufye wakwisa kwakwe, lelo kabili twalikoseleshiwe na pafyo atushimikile pafyo mwamukoselesheko. Aishile tushimikilako nokuti mulefwaya tukamonane na imwe. Atushimikileko nefyo muli no bulanda, nefyo mulebombesha nganshi pakumpokololako. Awe ici canengele nomba ukuba ne nsansa nganshi.

english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
translation: Kwena nangu ulya kalata wandi aishile mukalifya imitima, awe ine nshilanguluka nakalya. Lelo kwena ilyo namwene ukuti camukalipa, nangu califye pa kashita akanono, nalilangulwike.

english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
translation: Nomba ilelo ine ninsansamuka, teico namulengele ubulanda iyoo, lelo nico ubulanda bwalenga ukuti mulapile no kupilibuka. Ubo bulanda ebo Lesa alefwaya, kanshi ifwe tapali nelyo cimo ico twamucushisheko.

english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, tulefwaya ukuti mwishibe ifyo Lesa ku cikuuku cakwe abomba mu nkuta sha mu Makedonia.

english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
translation: Ine ifyo ndetontonkanya icingamuwamina ukucita pali uyu mulandu nifi. Pali ino nshita mutale mupwishe umulimo mwatampile uyu mwaka wapwile. Nimwe mwabalilepo ukutampa ukubomba uyu mulimo, elyo teico ceka, lelo kabili nimwe mwabalilepo no kufwaya ukubomba uyu mulimo.

english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
translation: Aleni kanshi pwilishisheni umulimo! Kalabaneni ukupwisha, ngefyo mwakalabene ilyo mwalepangana ukubomba. Mubomfyefye ifyo fine mukwete.

english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
translation: Nga cine cine mulefwaya ukupeela, Lesa akapokelela ubupe bwenu mwapeela ukulingana napo mukwatile, te pa fintu mushikwete.

english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
translation: Kanshi nshiloseshefye mukutila, muleafwa bambi pakuti bena baleikala bwino elyo imwe mulecula. Lelo icilefwaikwa mulinganya.

english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
translation: Apo imwe pa nshita ino namukwata ifingi, nacilinga ukuti mwayafwako kanshi abashikwete ifyo balekabila. Epakuti na imwe ilyo mushikwete ifintu mulekabila, elyo bena nabakwata ifingi, nabo bakamwafweko. Muli uyu musango ekucita umulinganya.

english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Ku muntu uwakungwibe ifingi tafyashelepo, elyo uwakungwibe utunono nao wine tabulishe.”

english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
translation: Ndetasha Lesa pakulenga Tito amusakamane nga filya ine musakamana.

english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
translation: Teicofye namwipwishe ukuti ese, lelo umwine winefye ewafwaile ukuti ese kuli imwe. Kabili umwine wine alefwaisha nganshi ukuti ese amwafwilisheko.

english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
translation: Ukuf 16:18

english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
translation: Teico ceka, lelo uyu munyinefwe ni nkuta shonse eshamusala ukuti tuleenda nankwe mukubomba uyu mulimo waluse, pa mulandu wakucindika Lesa no kulanga ukuti tulafwaya ukwafwa.

english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
translation: Kwena abo bantu balyeshiwa nganshi ku macushi ayabipisha bapitilemo. Eico nangu bali mu bupina ubwabipisha, lelo basansamwike nganshi mukupeela ubupe ukwabula akaso nelyo panono.

english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
translation: Tulasakamana nganshi ukuti abantu belaisosha pafyo tulebomba uyu mulimo wa fyabupe fyafula ifi.

english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
translation: Ifwe tufwaya ukucita ifisuma, te pa cinsofye ca Mfumu, lelo na pa cinso ca bantu pene.

english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
translation: Kanshi twatuma na umbi munyinefwe ukwisa nabo. Uyu munyinefwe twalimwesha mu nshila ishingi lelo twasanga ukuti lyonse abafye uwacincila. Nomba nico imwe alimucetekela nganshi, awe elyo acilile ukucincila.

english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
translation: Tito wena eo twaampana nankwe, kabili eico tuba nankwe mukubombela imwe. Elyo bamunyinefwe bambi abo baleisa nabo, ebemininako inkuta no kuletela Kristu umucinshi.

english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
translation: Mulange ukuti mwalibatemwa. Epakuti inkuta shonse shishininkishe no kwishiba ukuti tulalungika pakumutasha.

english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, balipeele ukufika napo bakwatile, kabili balicishishe napo bakwatile. Elyo kabili ni kukufwayafye kwabo abene.

english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
translation: Benefye ebabikilepo ukutulomba ukuti tubapeele ili shuko lyakwafwako abamushilo ba mu Yudeya.

english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
translation: Ukupeela kwabo kwacilile na pafyo twalecetekela! Icakubalilapo baituulile abene ku Mfumu, elyo kabili baituula na kuli ifwe bene, ngomo Lesa alefwaila.

english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
translation: Eico twakonkomesha Tito uwatampile uyo mulimo, ukuti akonkanyepo ukumwafwilisha mupwishishishe bwino uyo mulimo wacikuuku.

english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
translation: Imwe mwalicilamo ukukwatisha fyonse, mu cisumino, mukulanda, na mu fyakwishiba, mukukalabana muli fyonse, elyo na mu citemwiko mwatukwatila. Efyo tulefwaya nokuti muli uyu mulimo wacikuuku mwiba na kaso.

english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
translation: Ine nshilemupangila ifunde nelyo limo. Lelo ndefwayafye ukumona apo icitemwiko cenu capela, pakumulanga ifyo bambi bacincila mukwafwa.

english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
translation: Imwe mwalishiba icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu. Nangu wena ali umukankala, ayalwike umupina, epakuti ico wena ayalwike umupina, imwe mumone ukuba abakankala.

english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
translation: Kwena mu cacine tacilefwaikwa ukumulembela pa mulimo wakwafwa abamushilo ba mu Yudeya.

english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
translation: Kabili Lesa uupeela imbuto kuli katanda ne cakulya cakuti alye, akamupeela ne mbuto shonse mukabila. Akalenga nokuti shikule, shikatwale ne fisabo ifingi ukufuma kukucita ifintu ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
translation: Lesa nao akulalenga lyonse mulekwata ifingi, epakuti mulemona ukwafwilishako bambi inshita yonse. Epakuti abantu abengi baletasha Lesa pa bupe bwenu ubo balepoka ukufuma kuli ifwe.

english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
translation: Pantu uyu mulimo mulebomba, tewakwafwakofye abamushilo mufyo balekabila epela, lelo wakulenga nokuti abantu abengi baletasha Lesa.

english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
translation: Ala uyu mulimo mubombele, wakushininkishafye ifyo mwanakila Imbila yakwa Kristu iyo mwasumina. Kabili wakulenga na bantu abengi ukulalumbanya Lesa. Elyo ukubafwilishako no kwafwako bambi fyakulalanga ukuti tamwaba na kaso.

english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
translation: Bakulamupepelako no kufwaisha ukumumona pa mulandu wa cikuuku cacipeshamano Lesa amukwatila.

english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
translation: Ala natuletasha Lesa pa bupe bwakwe ubushaikulila!

english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
translation: Nalishiba ukuti mulafwaisha ukwafwa. Kanshi eico mutashisha ku bantu ba mu Makedonia. Ndabeba ukuti abanenu mu Akaia bena batendeke umulimo wakwafwilishako uyu mwaka wapwile. Kanshi ukucincila kwenu nakulenga abengi pali bena babe abacincila.

english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
translation: Nomba natuma aba bamunyinefwe, epakuti ukumutasha kwesu pali uyu mulandu kwiba kwabufi. Kanshi ngefyo nandile, muipekanye no bupe bwenu bwakwafwilishako.

english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
translation: Limbi nalimo kuti naisa na bena Makedonia bamo, kabili twasanga tamupekenye fyonse. Ninshi tukomfwa insoni, palibufi imwe mwebo twacetekela nganshi.

english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
translation: Eico ine ntontonkenye ukuti, cilefwaikwa ukuti twatuma aba bamunyinefwe bese uko ilyo ifwe tatulaisa. Epakuti mwapekanya kabela ifyabupe ifyo mwalaya ukupeela. Ilyo nkafika, nkasangefye nafiteyanishiwa. Ici cikalanga ukuti mupeelafye ku kufwaya kwenu tekumupatikisha iyoo.

english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
translation: Mwibukishe ukuti umuntu uutanda utunono, no kuseepa aseepa utunono. Lelo uutanda ifingi, no kuseepa aseepa ifingi.

english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
translation: Cila muntu ali nokupeela apo umwine alefwaila, tekupeela na mutimako, nangu mukupatikishiwa iyoo. Pantu Lesa atemwa umuntu uupeela ne nsansa.

english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
translation: Kabili Lesa aliba na maka yakupeela icikuuku ukucila na pali fyonse ifyo mukabila. Epakuti lyonse imwe mwe bene mulekwata fyonse ifyo mulekabila, elyo mukwate na fimbi ifingi pakwafwako bambi.

english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
translation: Ine ne Mukalamba nakulembela kalata iwe we wasalwa na Lesa, Mayo wesu pamo na bamwano, mwebo natemwa icine cine. Teine nekafye namutemwa iyoo, lelo na abo bonse abaishiba icishinka balimutemwa.

english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
translation: Umo nga aisa kuli imwe alefunda ifyaibela, mwilamupokelela mu ŋanda yenu nangu ukumuposha.

english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
translation: Pantu onse uwamuposha, ninshi baampana nankwe mu milimo yakwe ibi.

english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
translation: Bamwana nkashi mbiyo uwasalwa bakuposha.

english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
translation: Ico twamutemenwa nico muli ifwe mwaliba icishinka kabili twakulaba naco pe na pe.

english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
translation: Lesa Tata na Yesu Kristu, Mwana Lesa Tata, mu cishinka cabo ne citemwiko cabo, bengalatukwatila icikuuku no luse, kabili bengalatupeela no mutende.

english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
translation: Nasansamwike nganshi pakusanga ukuti abana bobe bamo balanakila icishinka nga filya Lesa Tata atukonkomesha.

english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
translation: Eico ine nomba ndekupapata Mayo wesu ukuti ala bonse natuletemwana. Ici te cebo cipya nakulembela iyoo, cebo twakwata ukutulafye ku citendekelo.

english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
translation: Icitemwiko ndelandapo calola mukuti tufwile ukulanakila ifyebo fyakwa Lesa. Icebo mwaumfwa ukutulafye ku citendekelo cakuti, bonse muletemwana.

english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
translation: Ababufi abengi balisalangana isonde lyonse. Aba bantu tabasumina ukuti Yesu aishile yaluka umuntu. Onse uwaba nga aba bantu ninshi wabufi, kabili mulwani wakwa Yesu Kristu.

english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
translation: Eico kanshi mulecenjela pakuti mwikalufya ifyo twabomba, lelo mukapokelele icilambu cenu conse.

english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
translation: Onse uushitwalilila ukusunga amafunde yakwa Kristu, kabili abikapo fimbi, ninshi taba na Lesa iyoo. Lelo uyo onse uutwalilila ukusunga amafunde yakwa Kristu, aba na Tata na Mwana.

english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,
translation: Mu Samaria mwali abana abaume bakwa Ahabu amakumi cine lubali (70). Kanshi Yehu epakulemba amakalata nokuyatuma ku Samaria kuli bacilolo ba mu Yesireli, ku bakalamba na ku balesunga abana bakwa Ahabu. Mu nkalata atile,

english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD’s word, which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”
translation: Eico ishibeni ukuti tapakabe ishiwi lyakwa Yawe nangu limo ilyalandwa pa ŋanda yakwa Ahabu ili shakafikilishiwe. Yawe nacita ifyo alaile ukupitila mu mubomfi wakwe Eliya.”
