english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.
translation: Kanshi Yehu epakwipaya bonse mu Yesireli abashelemo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Ahabu, pamo pene na bonse abacindami bakwe, bacibusa bakwe elyo na bashimapepo. Kabili tashilepo uwamweo nangu umo.

english: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,
translation: Yehu afuma alola lwa ku Samaria. Ilyo ali mu nshila pa Beti Ekedi wa bakacema,

english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”
translation: akumanya aba lupwa lwakwa Ahasia imfumu ya bena Yuda nokubepusha ati, “Nga imwe nimwe bani?”

english: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.
translation: Apeela icipope ati, “Bekateni abatuntulu!” Elyo babasenda abatuntulu baya bepaila ku lulamba lwa cishima ca ku Beti Ekedi. Bonse pamo bali amakumi yane na babili (42). Tashilepo nangu umo.

english: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
translation: Panuma yakufuma kulya, akumanya Yehonadabu umwana mwaume wakwa Rekabu, uwali mu lwendo lwakwisa mukumanya. Yehu amuposha elyo amweba ati, “Bushe uli ku lubali lwandi, ngefyo ine ndi na iwe?”

english: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD.” So they made him ride in his chariot.
translation: Yehu amweba ati, “Tuleya bonse, pakuti uye mona ukucincila kwandi mukubombela Yawe.” Kanshi epakumusenda mwiceleta lyakwe.

english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to Elijah.
translation: Ilyo Yehu afika mu Samaria, aipayafye bonse abashele aba mu lupwa lwakwa Ahabu. Abalofya ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyalandilwe muli Eliya.

english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.
translation: Elyo Yehu alonganya abantu bonse no kubeba ati, “Ahabu aletumika Baali panono, nomba Yehu ali nokumutumika apakalamba.

english: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
translation: Eico nomba, iteni bonse bakasesema bakwa Baali, ababomfi bakwe bonse pamo na bashimapepo bakwe bonse. Mumone ukuti tapashele nangu umo, pantu ndefwaya ukutuula ilambo ilikalamba nganshi kuli Baali. Onse uyo uwafilwa ukwisako takekale no mweo.” Lelo Yehu alelanda ifi mu bucenjeshi pakuti epaye ababomfi bakwa Baali.

english: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,
translation: “Apo abana bakwa shikulu wenu muli nabo, elyo na imwe namukwata na maceleta na bakabalwe, no musumba wenu untu wacingililwa ne linga elyo ne fyanso,

english: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.
translation: Yehu alanda ati, “Longanikeni abantu pakupeela umucinshi kuli Baali.” Nabo bacita ifyo fine.

english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.
translation: Elyo atuma amashiwi mu calo conse ica bena Israeli, na babomfi bonse abakwa Baali baisa. Takwali uwashele. Bonse baingila balongana mwitempele lyakwa Baali mpakafye lyaisula ukufuma ku mpela ukufika ku mpela ibiye.

english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.
translation: Elyo Yehu aeba kasunga wa fyakufwala ati, “Leta imingila ya aba bonse ababomfi bakwa Baali.” Nao afumya imingila abaletela.

english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”
translation: Elyo Yehu na Yehonadabu mwana Rekabu baingila mwitempele lyakwa Baali. Yehu aeba ababomfi bakwa Baali ati, “Lolekesheni, mumone ukuti tamuli babomfi bakwa Yawe pakati kenu, kanofye ababomfi bakwa Baali.”

english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”
translation: Kanshi efyo baingila mukutuula amalambo elyo na ya cakoca. Nomba Yehu ninshi naimika abaume amakumi cine konse konse (80) panse ye tempele no kubeba ati, “Nga cakuti umo pali imwe aleka umuntu pali aba abutuka, ali nokulekelapo umweo wakwe.”

english: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.
translation: Panumafye ilyo Yehu apwisha ukutuula umutuulo wa cakoca, apeele icipope kuli bakalinda na bamushika ati, “Ingileni mubepaye, mwileka nangu umo abutuuke.” Nabo baingila no kubakomaula ku lupanga. Bakalinda na bamushika balaposa ifitumbi panse elyo baya ingila na mu ncende yacindama iye tempele lyakwa Baali.

english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.
translation: Bafumisha panse uluceshi lwa mabwe ulo balepepelapo Baali no kulonaula.

english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.
translation: Babongolola no bulambo bwakwa Baali no kutobolola itempele lyakwa Baali na bantu epo basangula icimbusu ukushinta ne lelo.

english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
translation: Kanshi Yehu epakonaula amapepo yakwa Baali mu Israeli.

english: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.
translation: Lelo nao wine tafumine ku fyabubifi fyakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati, kufyo aletelele na bena Israeli ukucitako, ifyakupepa utulubi emukuti ifiponti fya golide babikile ku Betele na ku Dani.

english: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”
translation: eico salenipo uwawama kabili uwalinga pali bamwana shikulu wenu eo mubike pa cipuna cakwa wishi, elyo mulecingililako na ba ŋanda yakwa shikulu wenu.”

english: The LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”
translation: Yawe aeba Yehu ati, “Pantu wawamya mukucita icisuma pa cinso candi kabili wacitila iŋanda yakwa Ahabu fyonse ifyo nalefwaya ukucita mu mano yandi, aba mu ŋanda yobe bali nokulaikala pa cipuna cabufumu ukufikafye na ku nkulo yalenga shine.”

english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Lelo Yehu tasakamene ukulabeela ifyebo fyakwa Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli no mutima wakwe onse. Alifililwe ukufuma ku fyabubifi fyakwa Yeroboamu ifyo aleteleleko abena Israeli ukucitako.

english: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel
translation: Muli shilya nshiku Yawe ayamba ukucefya ubukulu bwa calo ca bena Israeli. Hasaeli acimfya abena Israeli monsefye mu calo cabo,

english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
translation: ku kabanga ku mumana wa Yordani, mu mpanga yonse iya ku Gileadi (incende ya bena Gadi, Rubeni elyo ne yakwa Manase), ukufuma ku Aroeli lubali lwa ku mukonko wa Alinoni ukucilinganya mu Gileadi mpaka ku Bashani.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehu, fyonse ifyo acitile na fyonse ifyo abombele, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yehu ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, bamushiika mu Samaria. Na Yehoahasi umwana wakwe ewamupyana pa bufumu.

english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
translation: Inshita Yehu ateekele pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria yakumene imyaka amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28).

english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”
translation: Nomba bonse batiina nokulanda abati, “Nga cakuti imfumu shibili shafilwa ukumulwisha, nga ifwe kuti twamulwisha shani?”

english: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”
translation: Elyo kangalila wa kwisano, no mulashi wa musumba, pamo pene na bakalamba na balesunga abana batuma amashiwi kuli Yehu ayakuti, “Ifwe tuli babomfi bobe kabili tuli nokucita icintu conse ico watweba. Tatwakasale nangu umo ukuba imfumu. Citafye conse ico uli nokumona ukuti cisuma.”

english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.
translation: Elyo Yehu abalembela kalata wabubili alandamo amashiwi ayakuti, “Nga cakuti muli ku lubali lwandi elyo kabili muli abaipekanya ukuŋumfwila, mwipaye nokundetela imitwe ya bana abaume abakwa shikulu wenu kuno ku Yesireli nga ino ine nshita mailo.”

english: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.
translation: Ilyo inkalata yaisa, aba abantu basenda abana ba mfumu bonse amakumi cine lubali (70) babepaya. Babaputulako imitwe baibika na mu miseke no kutuma kuli Yehu ku Yesireli.

english: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”
translation: Ilyo inkombe shafika kuli Yehu, baya mweba ati, “Nabaleta imitwe ya bana ba mfumu.”

english: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Yehu aisa fuma. Aiminina pa cinso ca bantu bonse no kubeba ati, “Imwe muli bakaele. Nine nafimbile shikulu nokumwipaya, nomba ni bani baipeye bonse aba?

english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.
translation: Ilyo Ataliya nyina kwa Ahasia amwene ukuti umwana wakwe afwa, atendeke ukwipaya ulupwa lwa mfumu lonse.

english: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the LORD’s house.
translation: Elyo shimapepo apeela abakalamba ba fita amafumo ne nkwela ifyali fya mfumu Davidi kabili ifyalesungwa mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.
translation: Bakalinda, cila umo ne fyanso mu minwe yakwe, baikala ukushinguluka imfumu mupepi nobulambo mu ŋanda ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ukufika ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”
translation: Yehoiada elyo afumya umwana wa mfumu, amufwika icisote cabufumu, amupeela ne citabo ca mafunde ya calo no kumubika pa bufumu. Bamusuba na mafuta yakumupeela ubufumu. Awe abantu bonse balatota no kupunda abati, “Kalebalika kanabesa we mfumu.”

english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD’s house;
translation: Ilyo Ataliya aumfwa icongo capangile bakalinda elyo na bantu bonse, aima aya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe umwalongene abantu.

english: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”
translation: Alolesha elyo amona imfumu naiminina mupepi no luceshi ukulingana nefyo ulutambi lwali. Bacilolo na bakalisha wa mapenga nabo bali mu mbali ya mfumu, na bantu bonse abekalacalo baleyanga no kulisha amapenga. Elyo Ataliya alepula insalu shakwe apunda nokuti, “Bucisanguka, bucisanguka!”

english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in the LORD’s house.”
translation: Yehoiyada shimapepo apeela icipope ku bakalamba ba fita umwanda umo (100) abalemona pa bashilika ati, “Muleteni mumwimike pakati ka milongo ya bashilika kabili mwipaye onse uulemukonka.” Pantu shimapepo acilanda ukuti, “Mwimwipaila mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.”

english: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.
translation: Nabo epakumwikata, cilyafye afika pa ncende apo bakabalwe bengilila mu lubansa lwa mwisano epo bamwipaila.

english: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; also between the king and the people.
translation: Yehoiyada elyo apanga icipangano pakati kakwa Yawe ne mfumu elyo na bantu ukuti abantu bali nokuba abantu bakwa Yawe. Kabili apanga na cimbi icipangano ica pakati ka mfumu na bantu.

english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.
translation: Abantu bonse aba mu calo baya ku ŋanda ya mulungu Baali no kuya ibongolola. Batobaula ne fibumbili fya malambo no tulubi mu tupimfya tupimfya no kwipaya Matani, shimapepo wakwa Baali, kuntanshi ya fibumbili fya malambo.

english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the LORD’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.
translation: Asenda abakalamba ba fita umwanda umo (100), abena Kari, bakalinda na bantu bonse abekala mu calo elyo bafumya imfumu mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe baya ingila na mwisano, baingilila ku mpongolo ya bakalinda. Elyo imfumu yaya ikala pa cipuna cabufumu,

english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
translation: Nomba Yehosheba, umwana mwanakashi wa mfumu Yehoramu, uwali nkashi yakwa Ahasia, abuula Yoashi umwana mwaume wakwa Ahasia elyo amwiba ukufuma pa bana ba mfumu abo bali nokuti bepaye. Aya mubika pamo no walemulela mu muputule wakusendamamo pakumufisa kuli Ataliya. Kanshi efyo ashele ukwabula ukwipaiwa.

english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.
translation: na bantu bonse abekalacalo basekela. Kabili na mu musumba mwaba icibote, pantu Ataliya bamwipaile ku lupanga pesano.

english: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
translation: Aikelefye uwafiswa pamo no walemusunga mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe pa myaka mutanda ilyo Ataliya ateekele icalo.

english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into the LORD’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in the LORD’s house, and showed them the king’s son.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga cine lubali Yehoiyada aitile intungulushi sha cila fita umwanda umo (100), ishaletungulula abena Kari pamo ne ntungulushi sha bakalinda bonse babaleta mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Apanga icipangano nabo nokubeba ukulapa mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Elyo abalanga umwana wa mfumu.

english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;
translation: Abakonkomesha nokuti, “Ifi efyo muli nokucita mwe bonse mwe bali mu fipani fitatu ifikaba pa ncito pa bushiku bwa pe Sabata. Icipani cabumo cikaba kwisano mukulonda.

english: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.
translation: Icipani cimbi icacibili cikaba pa mpongolo ya Suri, ne cipani cimbi icabutatu pa mpongolo iyaba panuma ya bakalinda abo abapeeleshanya inshita pakulinda iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the LORD’s house around the king.
translation: Elyo na imwe mwe ba mu fipani fimbi fibili ifishibomba pe Sabata muli nokubombela imfumu mukulinda iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”
translation: Mwikale abashinguluka imfumu, cila muntu ne fyanso fyakwe mu minwe yakwe. Onse umuntu uwapalama apo mutantamine mufwile ukumwipaya. Muleba mupepi nganshi ne mfumu konsefye uko yaya.”

english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
translation: Abakalamba ba fita umwanda umo (100) bacita fyonse ifyo Yehoiyada shimapepo akonkomeshe. Cila umo asenda abantu bakwe bonse abali nokubomba pa bushiku bwe Sabata elyo na bonse abashali nokubomba pa bushiku bwe Sabata nokwisa kuli Yehoiada shimapepo.

english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga cine lubali uwakwa Yehu, elyo Yoashi atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu musumba wa Yerusalemu imyaka amakumi yane (40). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Sibia. Uyu mwanakashi afumine ku Beresheba.

english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.
translation: Ilyo lyonse bamona ukuti mwaba indalama ishingi mu mbokoshi, lyena kalemba wa kwisano elyo na shimapepo mukalamba bali nokwisa penda indalama shonse ishituulilwe mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe elyo nokushilonga mu mifuko.

english: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,
and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
translation: elyo na ku babomfya amabwe pakukuula na kuli bakabasa wa mabwe. Balashitamo imbao na mabwe ayabaswa ayakuwamisha iŋanda yakwa Yawe. Balipila ne ndalama shonse ishalefwaikwa mu milimo yakuwamya iŋanda.

english: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;
translation: Lelo indalama shonse ishaleisa tashabombele mukupangilamo imbale, ifyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto, inweno, amapenga nangu ifipe fimbi ifya golide nangu silifa ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.
translation: Shalelipilwa ku babomfi abaleshibomfya mukuwamisha mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
translation: Kabili takwali ukusakamana ukwishiba nga cakuti abalepoka indalama balelipila ababomfi, pantu bena bali bacishinka nganshi mu mibombele yabo.

english: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.
translation: Indalama shakufuma ku mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi no wakwelelwa pa bubifi shena tabashitwele mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, pantu shali sha bashimapepo.

english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
translation: Pa nshita ilya ine Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu aima aya sansa icifulo ca Gati nokucipoka, kabili aipekanya nokuya mukusansa Yerusalemu.

english: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.
translation: Nomba Yoashi imfumu ya bena Yuda epakubuula fyonse ifyamushilo ifyatuulilwe ne fikolwe fyakwe, Yehoshafati, Yehoramu na Ahasia imfumu sha bena Yuda, elyo ne fyabupe fyonse ifyo atuulile elyo na golide yonse iyo asangile mu cipao ca ŋanda yakwa Yawe neca kwisano, atumina Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu nao epakufuma na mu Yerusalemu.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yoashi, elyo na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
translation: Yoashi acitile ifintu ifyawama pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa myaka yonse iyo Yehoiyada shimapepo alemutungulula.

english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
translation: Bacilolo bakwa Yoashi bamupingila, bamwimina mpaka bamwipaya. Baisa mwipaila ku Beti Milo ninshi ali mukuya ku Sila.

english: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Bacilolo abamwipeye ni Yosabada umwana mwaume wakwa Shimeati na Yehosabadi umwana mwaume wakwa Shoma. Ilyo afwile baya mushiika na ku fikolwe fyakwe mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Elyo Amasiya umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
translation: Lelo incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika tashaonawilwe. Abantu batwalililefye ukutuula amalambo no koca ububani muli shilya shine ncende.

english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,
translation: Yoashi aeba bashimapepo ati, “Longanikeni indalama shonse isho besa mukutuula mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, indalama isho cila muntu apingwilwa ukutuula mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, elyo nesho abantu baituulilafye abene.

english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”
translation: Lekeni shimapepo uuli onse apoke indalama ukufuma kuli cila kasunga wandalama, elyo no kuleka shibombe umulimo wakuwamisha iŋanda apali ponse apalefwaikwa ukuwamya.”

english: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.
translation: Lelo ukufikafye na mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na itatu (23) uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Yoashi, bashimapepo bali bacili tabalawamya ifyaonaike mu ŋanda.

english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
translation: Eico imfumu Yoashi epakwita Yehoiyada shimapepo elyo na bashimapepo bambi nokubepusha ati, “Nga cinshi ico mushiwamisha ifyaonaika fyonse mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe? Lekeni ukupoka indalama ukufuma kuli bakasunga wandalama, lelo shonse ishileisa mushitwale mukuwamisha iŋanda.”

english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.
translation: Bashimapepo basumina ukuleka ukupoka indalama ukufuma ku bantu, elyo kabili bena tebali nokuwamya iyo ŋanda.

english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.
translation: Yehoiyada shimapepo epakufwaya imbokoshi elyo atula icipunda pa nkupiko yaiko. Aibika pambali ya bulambo lubali ku kulyo kwa muntu uwaingila mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Bashimapepo abalelinda pa mwinshi ebalebika mu mbokoshi indalama shonse isho baleleta mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na itatu (23) uwa buteko bwakwa Yoashi umwana wakwa Ahasia imfumu ya bena Yuda, Yehoahasi umwana wakwa Yehu ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria. Kabili ateekele pa myaka ikumi limo na cine lubali (17).

english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na cine lubali (37) uwakwa Yoashi imfumu ya bena Yuda, Yehoashi umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoahasi ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria, kabili ateekele imyaka ikumi limo na mutanda (16).

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Kabili talekele ifyabubifi fyonse ifyo Yeroboamu umwana mwaume wakwa Nebati acitile, ifyo aletelele abena Israeli ukucitako. Kabili atwalilifye no kulaendamo.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehoashi, na fyonse ifyo acitile nefyo abombele, ukulundapo ne nkondo alwile na Amasiya imfumu ya bena Yuda, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
translation: Yehoashi ilyo afwile aya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, na Yeroboamu amupyana pa bufumu. Yehoashi ashiikilwe mu Samaria pamo ne mfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”
translation: Nomba Elisha alilwele ubulwele ubo ubwaishile fika na kukumwipaya. Yehoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli alileko mukuya mupempula, elyo alila ifilamba apunda ati, “Tata wandi, tata wandi ee, Amaceleta ya mu Israeli na ba pali bakabalwe.”

english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.
translation: Elisha asosa ati, “Fwayeni ubuta ne mifwi.” Nao acita ifyo fine.

english: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.
translation: Aeba imfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “Buula ubuta mu maboko yobe.” Ilyo abuula mu maboko yakwe, Elisha abika amaboko yakwe pa maboko ya mfumu.

english: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”
translation: Asosa ati, “Isule windo lya ku kabanga,” nayo imfumu yaisula. Elisha aeba imfumu ati, “Lasa umufwi,” nayo yalasa. Elisha elyo alanda ukuti, “Uyu mufwi wakucimfya kwakwa Yawe, umufwi wakucimfya abena Aramu. Uuli nokulofya abena Aramu umupwilapo pa Apeki.”

english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.
translation: Kabili alanda ati, “Buula imifwi ulase panshi.” Imfumu yabuula imifwi nokulasa panshi imiku itatu elyo yaleka.

english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa epakufulilwa imfumu no kuyeba ati, “Aulasa pa mushili imiku isano nangu imiku mutanda, nga waliba uwakucimfya abena Aramu no kubalofya. Nomba uli nokubacimfyafye imiku itatu.”

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe mukukonka inshila ya fya bubifi bwakwa Yeroboamu umwana mwaume wakwa Nebati, mufyo aletelele na bena Israeli ukuti bacite ifyabubifi. Ena alifililwe nokuti afumemo mu fyabubifi.

english: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
translation: Awe Elisha afwa, nokumushiika bamushiika.

english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
translation: Pa nshita imo ninshi abena Israeli baleshiika umuntu, nomba mukupumikisha ekwisa mona ibumba lya balesansa. Kanshi epakuposa icitumbi mu nindi yakwa Elisha. Nomba icitumbi caya kumya ku mafupa yakwe, noyu umuntu abuuka ukufuma ku bafwa aima aiminina na makasa yakwe.

english: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
translation: Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu yaikalilafye ukucusha abena Israeli pa nshita ya bufumu bwakwa Yehoahasi.

english: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.
translation: Lelo ukusenamina kwakwa Yawe kwali pali bena kabili alibakwatile uluse no kulanga ukubasakamana nganshi pa mulandu wa cipangano cakwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Ukushinta na pa bushiku bwalelo tafwaya ukubonaula nangu ukubafumya ku cinso cakwe.

english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.
translation: Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu afwa, elyo umwana mwaume wakwe Beni Hadadi amupyana pa bufumu.

english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.
translation: Elyo Yehoashi umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoahasi apokolola imisumba ukufuma kuli Beni Hadadi mwana wakwa Hasaeli, iyo apokele mukulwa ukufuma kuli wishi Yehoahasi. Pa miku itatu Yehoashi amucimfishe epo apokele ne misumba ya bena Israeli.

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakufulilwa abena Israeli icakuti ukwabula no kuposa inshita, abaposa mu minwe yakwa Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu na Beni Hadadi umwana wakwa Hasaeli.

english: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.
translation: Elyo Yehoahasi apapata kuli Yawe, nao Yawe amumfwa, pantu alimwene ubuluku ubo imfumu ya bena Aramu yalecushishamo abena Israeli.

english: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.
translation: Yawe epakupekanya uwakulubula abena Israeli, elyo balubuka ukufuma ku maka yakwa Aramu. Na bena Israeli bayamba ukwikala mu mayanda yabo ngefyo baikele kale.

english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)
translation: Lelo tabafumine kukucita ububifi ubo Yeroboamu aletelele abena Israeli ukucita icakuti nabo efyo bashala balecita. Kabili no luceshi lwa mulungu Ashera lwashelefye nalwiminina mu Samaria.

english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.
translation: Takwashele ifita ifingi ifyakwa Yehoahasi, kwashelefye abashilika ba pali bakabalwe amakumi yasano (50), amaceleta ikumi limo, na bashilika ba pa makasa amakana ikumi limo (10,000). Pantu imfumu ya bena Aramu yalyonawile bonse no kubalenga babe kwati lukungu lwa pa nshita yakutwa.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehoahasi, ifintu fyonse ifyo acitile nefyo abombele, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yehoahasi ilyo afwile, aya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, bamushiika mu musumba wa Samaria. Elyo Yehoashi umwana mwaume ewamupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ibili uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Yoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli, elyo Amasiya umwana mwaume wakwa Yoashi uwa ku Yuda, atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu.

english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”
translation: Iwe panuma yakucimfya abena Edomu, nawamba ukuyumfwa. Sekelela mukucimfya kobe, nomba ikalafye kumobe. Nga cinshi ulefwaila ifyongo no kufwaya ukuti uyonaule elyo nokonaula abena Yuda?”

english: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
translation: Lelo Amasiya akaana ukumfwa, icalengele ukuti Yehoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli amusanse. Ena na Amasiya balwilile ku Beti Shemeshi mu calo ca Yuda.

english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.
translation: Abena Yuda babapuma ku bena Israeli na cila muntu abutukila ku ŋanda kumwakwe.

english: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
translation: Yehoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli yaikata Amasiya imfumu ya bena Yuda, umwana mwaume wakwa Yoashi uwali mwana Ahasia, pa Beti Shemeshi amutwala na ku Yerusalemu. Kulya Yehoashi aya bongolola ilinga lya musumba, ukufumafye pa mpongolo yakwa Efulemu ukufika ku mpongolo ya pa cinshoko incende iyalepele amakubiti imyanda ine (400) .

english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
translation: Asenda golide yonse na silifa ne fipe fyonse ifya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ne fyuma fyonse ifya kwisano. Asendako na bantu bacikatilo, abwelela na ku Samaria.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehoashi, ifyo acitile ne milimo abombele, ukulundapo no bulwi alwile na Amasiya imfumu ya bena Yuda, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
translation: Amaf 24:16

english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.
translation: Amasiya mwana Yoashi imfumu ya bena Yuda yaikele imyaka ikumi limo na isano (15) panuma ya mfwa yakwa Yehoashi mwana Yehoahasi imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Amasiya, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shafumu sha bena Yuda?

english: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
translation: Abantu bamupangila mu Yerusalemu, elyo abutukila ku Lakishi, lelo batuma abantu abaile musanga no kumwipaya.

english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
translation: Ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na isano (25) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka amakumi yabili na pabula (29). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Yehoadini umwina Yerusalemu.

english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.
translation: Icitumbi cena balicibweseshe pali bakabalwe, baisa cishiika mu Yerusalemu pamo ne fikolwe fyakwe mu musumba wakwa Davidi.

english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse aba mu Yuda babuula Asariya, uwalifye ne myaka yakufyalwa ikumi limo na mutanda (16) eo babika pa bufumu apyana wishi Amasiya.

english: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
translation: Ena ewakuulile umusumba wa Elati cipya cipya no kuubwesesha ku bena Yuda panuma ya mfwa yakwa Amasiya, ilyo aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe.

english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na isano (15) uwakwa Amasiya mwana Yoashi imfumu ya bena Yuda, Yeroboamu mwana Yehoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu mu Samaria, kabili ateekele imyaka amakumi yane na umo (41) pa bufumu.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, talekele imisango iyabipa iyo imfumu Yeroboamu mwana Nebati alecita no kuletelela abena Israeli nabo ukubifya.

english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.
translation: Yeroboamu ewabwekeshepo imipaka ya calo ca Israeli, ukufuma ku Lebo Hamati ukufika kuli bemba wa Araba, ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, ilyasoselwe ukupitila mu mubomfi wakwe Yona mwana Amitai, kasesema ukufuma ku Gati Hefa.

english: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.
translation: Yawe namona ubucushi bulecula umuntu onse mu Israeli, abe umuntungwa nangu umusha elyo takuli no wakubafwa.

english: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
translation: Lelo Yawe talefwaya ukulofya ishina lya bena Israeli ukufuma pano isonde, abapususha ukupitila mu kuboko kwakwa Yeroboamu mwana Yehoashi.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yeroboamu, fyonse ifyo acitile, ne milimo yonse iya bulwi iyo abombele, ukulundapo nefyo alubwile imisumba ya bena Israeli, Damasiko na Hamati, iyali yakwa Yaudi, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yeroboamu ilyo afwile, aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe imfumu sha bena Israeli. Elyo Sakaria umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.
translation: Acitile ifyawama pa cinso cakwa Yawe, nomba tacali ngefyo icikolwe cakwe Davidi acitile. Ena muli fyonse alakonkafye mu mbela yakwa wishi Yoashi.

english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
translation: Lelo incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika shena taonawile. Abantu bakonkenyepofye ukutuula amalambo nokoca ububani muli shilya shine ncende.

english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,
translation: Panuma yakumona ukuti ubufumu bwakosa mu minwe yakwe, aipaya bacilolo bonse abaipeye imfumu wishi.

english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”
translation: Lelo taipeye abana ba bantu abaipeye wishi, ukulingana ne fyalembwa mu citabo ca mafunde yakwa Mose umo Yawe akonkomeshe ati, “Bashibo tabali nokufwila pa milandu iyacita abana babo. Na bana nabo bene tabali nakufwila pa milandu iyacitwa na bashibo. Lelo cila muntu ali nokufwila pa fyabubifi fyakwe.”

english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
translation: Ni ena uwacimfishe abena Edomu amakana ikumi limo (10,000) mwi Shika Lyamucele no kupoka Sela mu bulwi. Acinika ne shina lya Yokiteli, ishina ilyo baciita ukushinta ne lelo.

english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”
translation: Elyo Amasiya atuma inkombe kuli Yehoashi umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoahasi, mwana Yehu, imfumu ya bena Israeli na mashiwi yakuti, “Wise twise tulwe!”

english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.
translation: Nomba Yehoashi imfumu ya bena Israeli yabwesha amashiwi kuli Amasiya imfumu ya bena Yuda aiti, “Icimpusa ica myunga ica mu Lebanoni catumine amashiwi ku cimuti icalepesha ica keda wa mu Lebanoni aciti, ‘Peela umwana obe umwanakashi pakuti bopane no mwana wandi umwaume!’ Elyo icinama ca mu mpanga ica mu Lebanoni caisa nyantaula umunga.

english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27) uwakwa Yeroboamu imfumu ya bena Israeli, Asariya umwana mwaume wakwa Amasiya imfumu ya bena Yuda ewatendeke ukuteeka abena Yuda.

english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.
translation: Shalumu umwana mwaume wakwa Yabeshi apangila Sakaria. Amusansa pa cinso ca bantu no kumwipaya elyo amupyana na pa bufumu.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
translation: Ifintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Sakaria fyalilembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: This was the LORD’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyalandilwe kuli Yehu lyafikilishiwe ilyakuti, “Aba mu lupwa lobe ebakekala pa cipuna ca bufumu bwa bena Israeli ukufika ku nkulo yalenga shine.”

english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.
translation: Shalumu umwana mwaume wakwa Yabeshi atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na pabula (39) uwakwa Usia imfumu ya bena Yuda. Kabili ateekele mu Samaria umweshi umo.

english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.
translation: Elyo Menahemu mwana Gadi afuma ku Tirisa aya ku Samaria. Aya sansa Shalumu mwana Yabeshi mu Samaria, amwipaya. Elyo amupyana na pa bufumu.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
translation: Ifintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Shalumu, nefyo asangukile Sakaria, fyonse fyalilembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, Menahemu afuma mu Tirisa aya sansa ku Tifisa pamo no muntu onse mu musumba elyo ne mipaka yauko, pa mulandu wakuti bakeene ukumwiswila impongolo. Aonaula Tifisa elyo atumbula na banakashi bonse abali pabukulu.

english: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na pabula (39) uwakwa Asariya imfumu ya bena Yuda, Menahemu mwana Gadi ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu mu Israeli, kabili ateekele imyaka ikumi limo mu Samaria.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Pa nshita yakwe yonse iya pa bufumu tapilibwike ukufuma ku fyabubifi fyakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati ifyo aletelele na bena Israeli ukubifyako.

english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
translation: Puli imfumu ya ku Asiria aisa sansa icalo ca bena Israeli. Elyo Menahemu epakumupeela amatalanta ya silifa ikana limo (1,000) pakuti amwafwilisheko ukukosha ubufumu bwakwe.

english: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
translation: Ali ne myaka ikumi limo na mutanda (16) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka amakumi yasano na ibili (52). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Yekolia umwina Yerusalemu.

english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.
translation: Menahemu indalama apeele Puli afumishe ku bena Israeli. Cila mukankala asonkele silifa indalama amashekeli amakumi yasano iyakupeela imfumu ya ku Asiria. Puli epakubwelelamo kumwakwe.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Menahemu, elyo na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Menahemu ilyo afwile, aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Elyo Pekaya umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na isano (50) uwakwa Asaria imfumu ya bena Yuda, Pekaya umwana mwaume wakwa Menahemu ewatampile ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria, kabili ateekele pa myaka ibili.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Pekaya acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Tapilibwike ukufuma ku fyabubifi fyakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati ifyo aletelele na bena Israeli ukubifyako.

english: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
translation: Peka uwali umukalamba wa bacilolo wakwe, umwana mwaume wakwa Remaliya, epakwimina imfumu. Asenda abantu abaume amakumi yasano (50) abena Gileadi, aya ipaya Pekaya pamo pene na Agobu elyo na Arie mu lukungu lwa kwisano mu Samaria. Panuma Peka aipaya Pekaya elyo amupyana pa bufumu.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
translation: Ifintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Pekaya, na fyonse ifyo acitile, fyalilembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli.

english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yasano na ibili (52) iyakwa Asaria imfumu ya bena Yuda, Peka umwana mwaume wakwa Remaliya ewatampile ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria, kabili ateekele pa myaka amakumi yabili (20).

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Tapilibwike ukufuma ku fyabubifi fyakwa Yeroboamu mwana Nebati ifyo aletelele na bena Israeli ukubifyako.

english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.
translation: Mu nshita yakwa Peka imfumu ya bena Israeli, Tigilati Pilese imfumu ya bena Asiria yaisa pokolola imisumba ya ku Iyoni, Abeli-Beti-Maka, Yanoa, Kedeshi na Hasoli. Apoka Gileadi na Galile, ukulundapo ne mpanga yonse iya ku Naftali elyo atamfisha na bantu ku Asiria.

english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
translation: Acitile ifyalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo wishi Amasiya acitile.

english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
translation: Isham 10:30

english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Peka, nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ibili uwakwa Peka mwana Remaliya imfumu ya bena Israeli, Yotamu umwana mwaume wakwa Usia mfumu ya bena Yuda ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu.

english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
translation: Ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na isano (25) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu imyaka ikumi limo na mutanda (16). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Yelusha umwana umwanakashi wakwa Sadoki.

english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
translation: Acitile ifisuma pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo wishi Usia acitile.

english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house.
translation: Lelo incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika taonawile. Abantu batwalililefye ukutuula amalambo nokoca ububani mulya mwine. Yotamu akuula cipya cipya impongolo ya pamulu iya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yotamu, nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
translation: Mu nshiku shilya Yawe ayamba ukutuma Resini imfumu ya bena Aramu na Peka mwana Remaliya ukucusha Yuda.

english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yotamu ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe no kumushiika bamushiikile pamo pene nabo mu musumba wakwa Davidi wishi. Elyo Ahasi umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
translation: Nomba incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika shena tashonawile iyoo. Abantu bakonkenyepofye ukoca amalambo no bubani mulya mwine.

english: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.
translation: Yawe epakulwalika imfumu ifibashi mpaka no bushiku yafwile. Kabili yaleikalafye yeka mu ŋanda yaiko. Yotamu umwana wakwe ewalateeka abantu ba mu calo.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Asariya, na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
translation: Asariya ilyo afwile, aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, kabili bamushiikile mupepi nabo mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Elyo Yotamu umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na cine konse konse (38) uwakwa Asariya imfumu ya bena Yuda, Sakaria umwana mwaume wakwa Yeroboamu ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo wishi acitile. Talekele imisango yabipa iyo imfumu Yeroboamu mwana Nebati alecita no kuletelela abena Israeli ukubifyako.

english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) uwakwa Peka umwana mwaume uwakwa Remaliya, Ahasi mwana Yotamu imfumu ya bena Yuda ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu.

english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
translation: Elyo imfumu Ahasi yaile ku Damasiko mukuya kumanya Tigilati Pilese imfumu ya ku Asiria, yaya mona ubulambo ifyo bwali mu Damasiko elyo yatuma amashiwi kuli Uria shimapepo aya pa fipimo fya bulambo ne filangililo fyabuko pakukuula.

english: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
translation: Kanshi Uria shimapepo epakukuula ubulambo ukulingana ne filangililo fyabuko ifyo imfumu Ahasi yatumine ukufuma ku Damasiko, elyo nokupwisha ukukuula ilintu imfumu Ahasi tailabweluluka.

english: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yabwela ukufuma ku Damasiko no kwisa mona ubulambo, yapalama mupepi elyo yapeelelapo ilambo.

english: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
translation: Yatuulilapo ilambo lyakoca elyo no mutuulo wa cabunga, aitilapo no mutuulo wa cakunwa, elyo akana no mulopa wa mutuulo wakwampana pa bulambo.

english: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.
translation: Afumya ku ntanshi ya ŋanda ubulambo bwa mukuba ubwali pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ukufuma pakati ka bulambo bupya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, elyo abubika ku lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka bulambo bupya.

english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Ahasi yapeela ifi fipope kuli Uria shimapepo ukuti, “Pali ubu bulambo ubukulu ubupya, epakutuulila ilambo lyakoca ilya lucelo, no mutuulo wa cabunga uwa cungulo, ilambo lyakoca ilya mfumu elyo no mutuulo wa cabunga, ne lambo lyakoca ilya bantu bonse abekalacalo, no mutuulo wa cabunga pamo pene no wa cakunwa. Ulekana pa bulambo umulopa onse uwa kwilambo lyakoca na malambo yambi. Lelo ndi no kubomfya ubulambo bwa mukuba kukulabukilapo.”

english: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
translation: Kabili Uria shimapepo acita fyonse umo imfumu Ahasi yamukonkomeseshe.

english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
translation: Imfumu Ahasi yapangulula imbao sha mumbali elyo yafumyapo ne mbale shakusambilamo ukufuma pa mpanda shakusesha. Afumya icakusambilamo ca mukuba ukufuma pa ŋombe sha mukuba ishacikoseshe, no kuya bika pa libwe.

english: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to the LORD’s house, because of the king of Assyria.
translation: Afumya insaka ye Sabata iyo bakuulile mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, elyo afumya incende ya panse ya ŋanda iyapangilwe apakwingilila imfumu, pa mulandu wakusekesha imfumu ya ku Asiria.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Ahasi, nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya mfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.
translation: Ahasi ali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu imyaka ikumi limo na mutanda (16). Tali nga Davidi wishi, wena tacitile ifyawama pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wakwe.

english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ahasi ilyo afwile, aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe, bamushiika pamo pene nabo mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Na Hesekia umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
translation: Alepashanya imyendele ya mfumu sha bena Israeli. Abuula no mwana wakwe umo umwaume amupisha mu mulilo no kumupeela ilambo mukukonkelela imisango yabipisha iyalecita imishobo imbi ilya Yawe afulumwine pa cinso ca bena Israeli.

english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
translation: Aletuula amalambo no koca ububani mu ncende shakupepelamo imilungu pa mulu wa mpili elyo na pesamba lya cimuti icafumba conse.

english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
translation: Elyo Resini imfumu ya bena Aramu na Peka mwana Remaliya imfumu ya bena Israeli baima ukuya lwisha umusumba wa Yerusalemu, lelo bafilwa ukumucimfya Ahasi.

english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and lived there to this day.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya, Resini imfumu ya bena Edomu yapokolola Elati yabwesesha ku bena Edomu panuma yakutamfyamo abaume abena Yuda. Abena Edomu epakukukila mu Elati kabili emo baikala ukushinta ne lelo.

english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
translation: Ahasi epakutuma inkombe ukuya eba Tigilati Pilese imfumu ya bena Asiria ati, “Ndi mubomfi obe kabili umwana obe. Isa umpokololeko ukufuma mu minwe ya mfumu ya bena Aramu elyo na mu minwe ya mfumu ya bena Israeli abansanshile.”

english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
translation: Elyo Ahasi abuula silifa na golide iyali mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ne yali ku ŋanda ye sano atumina imfumu ya ku Asiria nge cabupe.

english: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Asiria yamumfwila, yaya sansa no musumba wa Damasiko no kuupoka. Yatamfisha abekalamushi bonse ku Kiri elyo yaipaya Resini.

english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na ibili (12) uwakwa Ahasi imfumu ya bena Yuda, Hoshea mwana Elaya ewatampile ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Israeli mu Samaria, kabili ateekele pa myaka pabula.

english: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;
translation: Bakuula inceshi sha mabwe ishakupepelapo ne nceshi sha mulungu Ashera pa mulu wa mpili ishitali na mwisamba lya cimuti icafumba.

english: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom the LORD carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger;
translation: Pali cila ncende yakupepelapo epo balaocela ububani ngefyo imishobo ilya Yawe atamfishe pantanshi yabo yalecita. Bacitile ifintu ifibi ifyakuti fyalenga na Yawe ukukalipa.

english: and they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”
translation: Balapepa utulubi, nangu Yawe abebele ati, “Mwikatala amucita ica musango uyu.”

english: Yet the LORD testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”
translation: Yawe alisokele abena Israeli na bena Yuda ukupitila muli bakasesema na bakamona ukuti, “Pilibukeni no kufuma mu nshila shibi. Mulebaka amafunde yandi ne fipope fyandi, ukulingana na mafunde yonse ayo nakonkomeshe ifikolwe fyenu ukulabeela kabili ayo napeele kuli imwe ukupitila mu babomfi bandi bakasesema.”

english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in the LORD their God.
translation: Nomba bafilwa ukumfwa elyo batalamika imitima nge fikolwe fyabo, abashacetekele Yawe Lesa wabo.

english: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom the LORD had commanded them that they should not do like them.
translation: Bakaana ifipope fyakwe ne cipangano apangene ne fikolwe fyabo, elyo nokubasoka abasokele. Balakonkelela ifilubi ifyabuwelewele icakuti nabo bene baba abawelewele. Balapalanyafye imishobo iyabashingulwike nangu Yawe abakonkomeshe ati, “Mwilacita ifyo bena bacita.” Nomba bena batwalililafye ukulacita ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe abaleseshe ukucita.

english: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.
translation: Basuula mafunde yonse ayakwa Yawe Lesa wabo, elyo baipangila ifilubi fibili ifyalengwa mu cipasho ca fiponti fya ŋombe elyo no luceshi lwa mulungu Asher. Balapepa ne fita fyonse fya mu mulu no kushinshimuna umulungu Baali.

english: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
translation: Balapisha abana babo abaume na banakashi mu mulilo. Balabuka no kupanda ubwanga elyo no kuiposaika mukubifya pa cinso cakwa Yawe, bamulenga no kukalipa.

english: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakufulilwa abena Israeli apakalamba, abafumya na ku cinso cakwe. Uluko lwa bena Yuda elwashelefye.

english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
translation: Elyo na bena Yuda bene balifililwe ukubaka amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wabo. Balakonkelela imisango iyo abena Israeli batendeke.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, lelo tali nge mfumu sha bena Israeli ishamutangilile.

english: The LORD rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.
translation: Ecalengele Yawe akaane umutundu wa bena Israeli onse, abacusha no kubapeela mu minwe ya bantalamisoka mpaka abafumya pa cinso cakwe.

english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
translation: Ilyo apatula abena Israeli ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Davidi, bena babuulile Yeroboamu mwana Nebati bamucita imfumu. Yeroboamu ena epakutunka abena Israeli ukufuma kukukonka Yawe no kubalenga ukuti babifye nganshi.

english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them
translation: Abena Israeli batwalililafye mu fyabubifi fyonse ifyo Yeroboamu acitile icakuti bafilwa no kulekako,

english: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.
translation: Isham 14:23

english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Asiria yaleta abantu ukufuma ku Babiloni, ku Kuta, ku Afa, ku Hamati na ku Sefafaimu no kubateka mu mishi iya mu Samaria ukupyana abena Israeli, basuka bapokolola Samaria baikala na mu mishi.

english: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear the LORD. Therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
translation: Ilyo batampile ukwikala mulya mwine tabalepepa Yawe, eco atumine inkalamo pakati kabo nasho shaipayapo abantu bamo bamo.

english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”
translation: Elyo baeba imfumu ya ku Asiria ukuti, “Abantu watwele nokuya bateka mu mishi ya mu Samaria tabaishiba ifyo umulungu wa muli cilya calo ufwaya. Nautuma inkalamo pakati kabo ishambile ukubepaya, pantu abantu tabaishiba ifyo umulungu wa muli cilya calo ufwaya.”

english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”
translation: Elyo imfumu ya ku Asiria yapeela icebo ukuti, “Buulenipo shimapepo umo pali balya mwasendele bunkole ukufuma ku Samaria abwelelemo mukuya ikala kulya elyo akaye funda abantu ifyo umulungu wa muli cilya calo wafwaya.”

english: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
translation: Isham 12:28

english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.
translation: Lelo cila mushobo waicitila imilungu wauko mu misumba baikelemo no kuubika mu mayanda yakupepelamo ayo abantu ba mu Samaria bakuulile mu ncende ishasansama.

english: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
translation: Shalimaneseri imfumu ya bena Asiria yaisa mukulwisha Hoshea, nao acimba kuli Shalimaneseri, alasonka no musonko wa cila mwaka.

english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
translation: Abaume ba ku Babiloni bapanga umulungu wa Sukoti Benoti, abaume ba ku Kuta bapanga uwa Negali, elyo na baume ba ku Hamati bapanga uwa Ashima.

english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
translation: Abena Afi bapanga umulungu wa Nibihasi na Tataki, elyo abena Sefafaimu bena balaoca abana babo mu mulilo nga malambo kuli Adarameleki na Anameleki, imilungu ya bena Sefafaimu.

english: So they feared the LORD, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
translation: Balapepa Yawe, nomba basonta abantu babo icisontesonte abakulabomba nga bashimapepo mu mayanda yakupepelamo pa ncende isho bacindika.

english: They feared the LORD, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
translation: Lelo ilyo bayambile ukupepa Yawe, nomba mu misango imbi balebombela imilungu yabo ukulingana ne ntambi sha mishobo iyo babafumishemo.

english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear the LORD, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
translation: Ukufika na pa bushiku bwa lelo bacili batwalililafye mu micitile yakale. Tabapepa Yawe nangu ukumfwila ifipope elyo ne fikomo, amafunde elyo ne fyebo ifyo Yawe apeela aba mu lupwa lwakwa Yakobo abo ainika abena Israeli.

english: with whom the LORD had made a covenant and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;
translation: Ilyo Yawe apangile icipangano na bena Israeli, alibakonkomeshe ati, “Mwilapepa imilungu imbi nangu ukutucindika, ukutubombela nangu ukulatutuulila amalambo.

english: but you shall fear the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.
translation: Lelo Yawe uwamufumishe mu Egupto ku maka ayengi no kuboko ukwatambalala ena ekafye eo mulepepa. Kuli ena eko muletuula amalambo elyo no kumucindika.

english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.
translation: Mufwile ukuba abatekanya lyonse no kubaka ifipope, ifikomo, amafunde ne fyebo ifyo amulembela. Mwilapepa imilungu imbi.

english: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.
translation: Mwikalaba icipangano napangile na imwe, kabili mwilapepa imilungu imbi.

english: But you shall fear the LORD your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”
translation: Lelo mulepepafye Yawe Lesa wenu, pantu ni ena euli nokumupokolola ukufuma mu minwe ya balwani benu.”

english: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.
translation: Nomba imfumu ya ku Asiria yasangile ukuti Hoshea ali ncenjeshi, pantu alitumine inkombe kuli So imfumu ya ku Egupto, kabili aleka no kusonka umusonko ku mfumu ya bena Asiria ngefyo alecita cila mwaka. Kanshi Shalimaneseri epakumwikata amubika na mu cifungo.

english: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.
translation: Nabo bakaana ukumfwa, batwalililafye mu micitile yabo iyakale.

english: So these nations feared the LORD, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.
translation: Nelyo aba bantu balepepa Yawe, lelo balitwalilile mukulabombela imilungu yabo. Ukufika na pa bushiku bwa lelo, abana babo na beshikulu babo balitwalililafye ukucita ifyo ifikolwe fyabo fyalecita.

english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Asiria yaishile sansa icalo conse, yafikafye na ku Samaria no kuushinguluka pa myaka itatu.

english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga pabula uwakwa Hoshea, imfumu ya ku Asiria yapoka umusumba wa Samaria, yatamfyamo na bena Israeli baya na ku Asiria. Aya bapeela ukwikala mu Hala, mu Gosani mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Habori na mu misumba inono iya ku Medesi.

english: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
translation: Fyonse ifi fyacitike pa mulandu wakuti abena Israeli bacitile ifyabubifi kuli Yawe Lesa wabo, uwabafumishe ku Egupto mu minwe yakwa Farao imfumu ya bena Egupto. Bakwete umulandu wakupepa imilungu imbi,

english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.
translation: elyo nokukonka imbela sha mishobo Yawe atamfishe pa ntanshi yabo, pamo pene ne mbela isho imfumu sha bena Israeli shabalangile.

english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the LORD their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;
translation: Abena Israeli balacita mu bumfisolo ifishali fyacishinka kuli Yawe Lesa wabo. Ukutula pa lupungu lwa balinshi ukufika ku musumba we linga, bakuula incende ishakupepelamo mu misumba yabo.

english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
