translation: Mu mwaka walenga itatu uwakwa Hoshea umwana mwaume wakwa Elaya imfumu ya bena Israeli, Hesekia mwana Ahasi imfumu ya bena Yuda ewatendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu.

english: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
translation: Panuma ya myaka itatu abena Asiria baupoka. Kanshi Samaria baipokele mu mwaka walenga mutanda uwakwa Hesekia, uyo uwali umwaka walenga pabula kuli Hoshea imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
translation: Imfumu ya bena Asiria epakutamfisha abena Israeli ku Asiria no kuya bapeela ukwikala ku Hala, ku Gosani mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Habori elyo na mu misumba iyinono iya bena Media.

english: because they didn’t obey the LORD their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear it or do it.
translation: Ifi fyacitike pa mulandu wakuti bakeene ukumfwila Yawe Lesa wabo, lelo baonawile icipangano na fyonse ifyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe abakonkomeshe. Balikeene ukumfwa amafunde nangu ukuyakonka.

english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na ine (14) uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Hesekia, Senakeribu imfumu ya bena Asiria yasansa imisumba ya malinga yonse iya mu calo ca Yuda, no kuicimfya yaicimfya.

english: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
translation: Kanshi Hesekia imfumu ya bena Yuda epakutuma amashiwi ku mfumu ya bena Asiria iyali ku Lakishi aiti, “Ine nindufyanya. Fuma kuli ine ubwelelemo, elyo ine nalalipila conse ico walafwaya kuli ine.” Imfumu ya ku Asiria yafwaya amatalanta ya silifa imyanda itatu (300) na ya golide amakumi yatatu (30) .

english: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.
translation: Kanshi Hesekia epakumupeela silifa yonse iyali mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe elyo ne yali mu ŋanda ya kwisano.

english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the LORD’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
translation: Pali iyi nshita Hesekia imfumu ya bena Yuda asapulula golide yonse iyo ashingwilile ku fiibi na ku maingwe ya mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe no kupeela imfumu ya ku Asiria.

english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Asiria yatuma umukalamba wa fita fyonse ifya nkondo, umukalamba wa bacilolo na Rabushake umukalamba wa mpuka ikalamba iya fita pamo ne bumba likalamba ilya fita fya nkondo, ukufuma ku Lakishi ukuya ku mfumu Hesekia ku Yerusalemu. Baisa fika mu Yerusalemu elyo baiminina mupepi no mulonga wa cishiba ca pamulu, icaba pa musebo wakuya kwi Bala lyakwa Kasamba ukwalebombela abantu abalecapa insalu.

english: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.
translation: Ilyo baita imfumu, uwaishile fuma ni Eliakimu umwana mwaume wakwa Hilikiya uwali mushika wa kwisano, na Shebina kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano elyo na Yoa umwana mwaume wakwa Asafu kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo, baya mukukumanya abaishile.

english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
translation: Uyu Rabushake asosa ati, “Eba Hesekia ukuti, ifi efyo imfumu nkalamba, imfumu ya bena Asiria yasosa ukuti,

english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
translation: Ali ne myaka yakufyalwa amakumi yabili na isano (25) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu. Kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka amakumi yabili na pabula (29). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Abiya umwana umwanakashi wakwa Sakaria.

english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
translation: Bushe iwe uletontonkanya ukuti ukulandaukafye amashiwi yeka yeka auti e mano nangu maka yakulwa inkondo, mwa? Bushe nani uyo wine washintililamo pakuti iwe unsangukile?

english: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.
translation: Mona, iwe ushintilile pali Egupto, uwaba nge nkoto ye tete iyalepauka iyakuti lilya umuntu ashintililako, yamucena mu minwe. Ifi efyo Farao imfumu ya bena Egupto aba. Kabili efyo acita na kuli bonse abashintilila kuli ena.

english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?
translation: Kabili nga wasosa kuli ine auti, “Ifwe tucetekele pali Yawe Lesa wesu,” bushe teuyo incende shakwe mu tupili ishakupepelamo elyo ne fibumbili fyakwe ifya malambo imfumu Hesekia aonawile? Elyo yaeba abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu aiti, “Muli nokulapepelafye pali ubu bulambo bwa mu Yerusalemu?”

english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
translation: “‘Kanshi isa nomba upangane na shikulu, imfumu ya ku Asiria. Ndi nokukupeela bakabalwe amakana yabili (2,000) nga wakwata abantu abakumanina abakuninapo!

english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
translation: Kuti wafulumuna shani cilolo umo uwacepesha pali bacilolo bakwa shikulu, ilyo washintilila pa bena Egupto ku maceleta na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe?

english: Have I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”
translation: Kabili bushe ine muleti njishile mukonaula ino ncende ukwabula ishiwi ukufuma kuli Yawe? Yawe umwine eunjebele ukwimina cino calo no kuconaula.’”

english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”
translation: Elyo Eliakimu mwana Hilikiya, Shebina na Yoa baeba uyu Rabushake abati, “Twapapata, landa kuli ifwe fwe babomfi bobe mu cilimi ca Ciaramaiki pantu tulomfwa. Wilanda kuli ifwe mu Cihibulu pantu balya bonse abali pelinga ni kuno balekutika.”

english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”
translation: Lelo uyu Rabushake ayasuka ati, “Bushe imwe kumo kwine ne mfumu yenu muleti nimwefye mweka imfumu yandi intumineko pakwisa landa iyi milandu yonse, batini? Ala iyoo, ine ndeeba balya bantu bali pelinga, abo pamo na imwe muli nokulya amafi yenu no kunwa imisu yenu.”

english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.
translation: Elyo uyu Rabushake aiminina aololoka no kubilikisha mu Cihibulu ati, “Umfweni ishiwi lya mfumu nkalamba, imfumu ya ku Asiria!

english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.
translation: Ifi efyo imfumu yasosa aiti, ‘Imwe mwileka Hesekia amubepe. Teti amupokolole ukufuma mu kuboko kwandi.

english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
translation: Acitile ifyalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ukulingana nefyo wishi Davidi acitile.

english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”
translation: Mwileka Hesekia amusembeleke ukutetekela muli Yawe nga alanda ukuti, “Yawe aletupokolola, uno musumba tawapeelwe mu minwe ya mfumu ya ku Asiria.” ’

english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;
translation: “Mwimumfwila Hesekia. Ifi efyo imfumu ya ku Asiria yasosa ifyakuti, ‘Lekeni tumfwane mu mutende, mwise mucimbefye kuli ine. Awe ninshi, na cila umo pali imwe ali nokulya kwibala lyakwe lya myangashi ne mikunyu, no kunwa amenshi ukufuma mu cishima cakwe,

english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.”
translation: mpaka nkese mubuula no kumutwala mu calo icabafye nge calo cenu, icalo ica ŋanu no mwangashi upya. Icalo ica mikate na mabala ya myangashi. Icalo ica miti ya miolifa ne ca buci. Saleni umweo ukucila imfwa!’

english: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
translation: Bushe kwalibako umulungu wa mushobo uuli onse uwapokololako icalo cauko ukufuma ku kuboko kwa mfumu ya bena Asiria?

english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
translation: Nge milungu ya ku Hamati na ku Apadi ili kwi? Nge milungu ya ku Sefafaimu, ku Hena na ku Ifa ili kwi? Bushe yalipokolola Samaria ukufuma mu kuboko kwandi?

english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”
translation: Bushe mulungu nshi pa milungu ya fyalo ifi fyonse walitala aupusushako icalo cauko kuli ine? Nga nomba imwe cinshi ico muleelenganishisha ukuti Yawe akapusushako Yerusalemu ku kuboko kwandi?”

english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”
translation: Lelo abantu baikalafye tondolo ukwabula ukuti bamwasuke, pantu imfumu yalikonkomeshe bonse aiti, “Mwimwasuka.”

english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.
translation: Elyo Eliakimu mwana Hilikiya uwali mushika wa kwisano, Shebina kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano na Yoa mwana Asafu kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo, baya kuli Hesekia nabalepula insalu shabo, no kumulondolwela ifyo uyu Rabushake aciba alelanda.

english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.
translation: Aonaula incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika, abongolola inceshi sha mabwe balepepelapo elyo atema no luceshi lwa mulungu Asher. Atobaula ne nsoka ya mukuba intu Mose apangile. Pantu ukushinta pali ilya nshita abena Israeli balecifukilisha no bubani. Balecita ishina lya Nebushitani pakucicindika.

english: He trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.
translation: Hesekia acetekele Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli. Pa mfumu shonse isha bena Yuda ishabalilepo, pali ena nangu ishakonkelepo, tapalifye nangu imo iyalingene nankwe.

english: For he joined with the LORD. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Hesekia alebeela Yawe, tatalile amusangukila nakalya. Ena alesunga amafunde yonse ayo Yawe apeele Mose.

english: The LORD was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.
translation: Na Yawe aleba nankwe, kabili aleba uwapaalwa mu cintu conse ico alecita. Asangukila imfumu ya ku Asiria, akaana nokuti aleibombela.

english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.
translation: Ukutampa pa lupungu lwa bakalinda ukufika ku musumba we linga, acimfya Abafilisiti ukuya fikafye ku Gasa ne calo conse.

english: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.
translation: Imp 21:9

english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Hesekia yaumfwile ifi, yalepwile ifyakufwala fyaiko, yafwala insalu shabulanda elyo yaya ingila mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
translation: “Mwebe Hesekia imfumu ya bena Yuda ukuti, ‘Wileka umulungu washintililamo ukubepe nga watila Yerusalemu tayapeelwe mu minwe ya mfumu ya bena Asiria.’

english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?
translation: Mu cacine walyumfwa ifyo imfumu sha ku Asiria shacita ku fyalo fyonse, ukonaulafye fyonse. Elyo bushe iwe niwe walapusuka?

english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
translation: Nge milungu ya mishobo iyo iyaonawilwe ku fikolwe fyandi bushe yalibapokolweleko? Imilungu ya Gosani, Harani, Resefu na bantu ba ku Edeni abali mu Teli Asari.

english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
translation: “Ili kwi imfumu ya ku Hamati, imfumu ya ku Apadi, imfumu ya ku musumba wa Sefafaimu nangu uwa ku Hena nangu Ifa?”

english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.
translation: Hesekia apokele kalata ukufuma ku nkombe nokubelenga. Elyo aya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe, abuula na kalata, yafungulula, yabika na pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, “LORD, the God of Israel, who are enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
translation: Elyo Hesekia apepa kuli Yawe ati,

english: Incline your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.
translation: Teya ukutwi, we Yawe, kabili umfwa. Isula amenso yobe, we Yawe, no kumona. Umfwa ku mashiwi Senakeribu atumine ayakutuka Lesa uwamweo.

english: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
translation: “Cacine we Yawe ukuti imfumu sha bena Asiria shalyonaula imishobo yonse iyi ne fyalo fyaiko.

english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.
translation: Shaliposa imilungu yabo mu mulilo no kuonaula. Nangu cali ukuti tafyali milungu, lelo fyalifye ifya fimiti na mabwe fintu fyapangwa ne minwe ya bantu.

english: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, LORD, are God alone.”
translation: Nomba we Yawe, Lesa wesu, twapapata, tupokololeko ukufuma mu minwe yakwe, pakuti ne shamfumu shonse pano calo shishibe ukuti iwefye weka we Yawe, niwe Lesa.”

english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
translation: Kabili yabuula Eliakimu mushika wa kwisano, na Shebina kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano, na bakalamba ba bashimapepo, yabatuma na kuli kasesema Esaya mwana Amosi, ninshi bonse nabafwala insalu shabulanda.

english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.
translation: Elyo Esaya mwana Amosi atuma amashiwi kuli Hesekia ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli asosa ukuti, ‘Niŋumfwa ipepo lyobe pa mulandu wakwa Senakeribu imfumu ya bena Asiria.’

english: This is the word that the LORD has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
translation: Ili e shiwi Yawe alandile pali ena ilyakuti,

english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!
translation: Ukuf 25:22

english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.
translation: Ukupitila mu nkombe shobe

english: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”
translation: Ninyimba ifishima mu fyalo fya kutali,

english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.
translation: “‘Bushe tawaumfwa ukuti nacipekenye ukufuma kale?

english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.
translation: Abantu babo amaka nayapwamo,

english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
translation: “‘Lelo nalishiba uko wikala,

english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’
translation: Apo iwe waliitutumuna pali ine,

english: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
translation: “Ici ecikaba icishibilo cobe, we Hesekia.

english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.
translation: Bamweba ati, “Ifi efyo Hesekia alanda ifyakuti, ‘Buno bushiku, bushiku bwakuculamo, bushiku bwakushobolwamo no bwakumfwamo insoni. Ifwe tulifye ngo mwanakashi uushikwete maka yakupapa ilyo inshita yakupapilapo imufikile.

english: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
translation: Kabili abakashalapo mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda,

english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. The LORD’s zeal will perform this.
translation: Pantu mu Yerusalemu emukafuma abantu abakashalamo abomi,

english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
translation: “Eico ifi efyo Yawe alanda palwa mfumu ya ku Asiria.

english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says the LORD.
translation: Inshila yaishilemo eyo ikabwelelamo.

english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake.’”
translation: ‘Ndecingilila uno musumba no kuupususha,

english: That night, the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
translation: Awe, malaika wakwa Yawe aya na mu nkambi ya fita fya bena Asiria, aipayamo ifita amakana umwanda umo na makana amakumi cine konse konse na yasano (185,000). Kutifye ulucelo cilya bwaca, awe abantu bamonafye ifitumbi fya bantu filelefye ntangali ntangali.

english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.
translation: Kanshi Senakeribu imfumu ya bena Asiria epakufuma mu nkambi nokubwelelamo. Abwelela ku Ninife eko aya ikala.

english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ninshi alepepa mwitempele lya mulungu wakwe Nisroki, abana bakwe abaume, Adarameleki na Sharesa, bamukoma ku lupanga, elyo babutukila ku calo ca ku Aralati. Elyo Esahadoni umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: It may be the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”
translation: Limbi kuti caba ukuti Yawe Lesa obe naumfwa amashiwi yonse aya uyu Rabushake uo shikulu wakwe imfumu ya ku Asiria itumine kukutuka Lesa uwamweo. Elyo na pakuti Yawe Lesa obe akalipe pa mashiwi aya omfwile. Eico pepelako abashele abacili abomi.’”

english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
translation: Ilyo bacilolo ba mfumu Hesekia bafika kuli Esaya,

english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
translation: nao Esaya ababweseshamo ati, “Kebeni shikulwinwe ukuti ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti, ‘Wikwata umwenso pafyo umfwile, palwa mashiwi yakuntuka ayo ababomfi ba mfumu ya bena Asiria bakwebele.

english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”
translation: Umfwa, ine ndebika umupashi muli yena uulelenga ukuti yumfwepo fimo ifyamaŋwiŋwi, ifyalalenga nokuti ibwelelemo ku calo caiko, no kuleka eko nkaleka bakaye mwipaila ku lupanga.’”

english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.
translation: Ilyo uyu Rabushake aumfwa ukuti imfumu yabo naifuma ku Lakishi, abwelelamo no kuya sanga imfumu ilelwa no musumba wa ku Libina.

english: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,
translation: Nomba Senakerubi apokelela amashiwi ayakuti Tiraka imfumu ya bena Kushi naifuma mukwisa mulwisha. Kanshi epakutuma nakabili inkombe kuli Hesekia na mashiwi yakuti,

english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Ahabu, abena Moabu basangukile abena Israeli.

english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
translation: Lelo Eliya ayasuka umukalamba wa bashilika ati, “Nga cakuti ndi muntu wakwa Lesa, umulilo naufume ku mulu no koca iwe pamo na bashilika bobe amakumi yasano (50).” Elyo umulilo waponene ukufuma ku mulu no koca umukalamba wa bashilika pamo na bashilika bonse.

english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”
translation: Pa numa ya ifi, imfumu yatuma nakabili umukalamba wa bashilika na bashilika bakwe amakumi yasano (50) kuli Eliya. Umukalamba wa bashilika amweba ati, “We muntu wakwa Lesa umfwa ifyo imfumu yasosa ukutila, ika nombalinefye.”

english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
translation: Eliya ayasuka ati, “Nga cakuti ndi muntu wakwa Lesa, umulilo naufume ku mulu no koca iwe pamo na bashilika uli nabo amakumi yasano (50).” Elyo umulilo wapona ukufuma ku mulu no koca umukalamba wa bashilika pamo na bashilika ali nabo amakumi yasano (50).

english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.
translation: Imfumu pa muku walenga butatu, yatuma umukalamba wa bashilika na bashilika amakumi yasano (50). Uyu mukalamba wa bashilika uwalenga butatu ena ilyo afika afukama pa cinso cakwa Eliya no kupapata ati, “We muntu wakwa Lesa, napapata umfwila uluse umweo wandi ne myeo ya bantu aba amakumi yasano (50) ababomfi bobe.

english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”
translation: Mona, umulilo naufuma ku mulu no koca abakalamba babili aba bashilika abacintangilila ukwisa kuno pamo na bashilika baciba nabo. Nomba umfwila uluse umweo wandi.”

english: The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.
translation: Elyo Malaika wakwa Yawe aeba Eliya ati, “Kabiyeni nankwe, wimutiina iyoo.” Kanshi Eliya epakwima aya nankwe ku mfumu.

english: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”
translation: Aya eba imfumu ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakutila, ‘Bushe tamwaba Lesa mu Israeli pakuti wambe ukubuka nga filya wacituma inkombe shakuya mukubuka kuli Baali Sebubu umulungu wa ku Ekironi? Pa mulandu wakucita ici, tauli nakufuma mu musengele ulelepo. Ala ulifye no kufwa!’”

english: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.
translation: Elyo afwa, ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyo Eliya asosele.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Ahasia, elyo nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Israeli?

english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover of this sickness.”
translation: Nomba Ahasia aliponene pa ncende yakutuushishamo iyali pa mutenge wa ŋanda ya kwisano, iyali mu Samaria, no kuicena nganshi. Elyo atuma inkombe nokusheba ati, “Kabiyeni muye buka kuli Baali Sebubu, umulungu wa ku Ekironi, pakuti mwishibe nga ndi nokupola kuli ifi naicena.”

english: But the LORD’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?
translation: Lelo malaika wakwa Yawe aeba Eliya umwina Tishibe ati, “Ima uye kumanya inkombe sha mfumu ya ku Samaria. Uye bepusha auti, ‘Bushe tamwaba Lesa mu Israeli pakuti muye mukubuka kuli Baali Sebubu, umulungu wa ku Ekironi?’

english: Now therefore the LORD says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, ‘Iwe tauli no kwima pa musengele ulelepo, ulifye no kufwa.’” Eliya aima aya no kuya.

english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”
translation: Ilyo inkombe shabwelele ku mfumu, yalibepwishe aiti, “Cinshi ico mwabwelela?”

english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”
translation: Bayasuka abati, “Umuntu aciisa tukumanya no kutweba ati, ‘Bwelelenimo ku mfumu imutumine, muye yeba amuti, ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti, bushe tamwaba Lesa mu Israeli eco watumina abakuya buka kuli Baali Sebubu, umulungu wa ku Ekironi? Eico tawaime pa musengele ulelepo. Ulifye nokufwa!’”

english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”
translation: Imfumu yabepusha aiti, “Bushe aciba muntu wa musango nshi uyo uwaciisa mukumanya no kumweba aya mashiwi?”

english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”
translation: Bayasuka abati, “Aciba muntu umwaume nafwala ne cakufwala icamasako. Afwele no mushipi wa mpapa mu musana wakwe.” Imfumu aiti, “Ni Eliya umwina Tishibe.”

english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatuma umukalamba wa bashilika pamo na bashilika bakwe amakumi yasano (50). Umukalamba wa bashilika aya fika kuli Eliya, amusanga naikala pa mulu wa lupili no kumweba ati, “We muntu wakwa Lesa, imfumu ilekwita ika!”

english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”
translation: Mu nshiku shine shilya, Hesekia alwala ubulwele ubwafwaile ukumwipaya. Kasesema Esaya mwana Amosi aya kuli ena amweba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, ‘Ubangililile uipekanye bwino pantu ulefwa, tauli nakupola.’”

english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”
translation: Hesekia asosa ati, “Cintu icayanguka icinshingwa ukulola kuntanshi intampulo ikumi, nomba leka cilole kunuma intampulo ikumi.”

english: Isaiah the prophet cried to the LORD; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.
translation: Elyo kasesema Esaya apepa kuli Yawe. Elyo nao Yawe alenga icinshingwa ukulola kunuma intampulo ikumi umusango cacitikilemo pa matabo yakwa Ahasi.

english: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
translation: Pali ilya nshita Merodaki Baladani umwana mwaume wakwa Baladani imfumu ya ku Babiloni yatumine Hesekia amakalata elyo ne cabupe, pantu alyumfwile ukulwala kwakwe.

english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.
translation: Hesekia ilyo apokelela ishi nkombe, ashilangilila fyonse ifyali mu matala yakwe, silifa, golide ne fyanunka ubusuka, amafuta ayasuma, iŋanda ya fyanso fyakwe elyo na fyonse ifyali mu ŋanda yakutulilamo ifyuma. Mwisano lyakwe na mu calo cakwe conse tamwashele nelyo kamo ako Hesekia ashalangile inkombe.

english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”
translation: Elyo Esaya kasesema aya ku mfumu Hesekia no kumwipusha ati, “Ni finshi balya bantu bacisosa, kabili ni kwisa bafumine?”

english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”
translation: Kasesema aipusha ati, “Ni finshi bacimona mu ŋanda yobe iya mwisano?”

english: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the LORD’s word.
translation: Elyo Esaya aeba Hesekia ati, “Umfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.
translation: Inshita ileisa ilyo ifintu fyonse mu ŋanda yobe iye sano, na fyonse ifyo ifikolwe fyenu fyatutile ukushinta ilelo fili nokusendwa ku Babiloni. Ala takwakashale nangu kamo, efyasosa Yawe.

english: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”
translation: Kabili na pa ba mu lupwa lobe, aba mubili no mulopa obe, abo waifyalila we mwine, bakasendapo bamo no kuya bacita bamutungwi abakubombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni kwisano lyaiko.”

english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”
translation: Hesekia ayasuka ati, “Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyo walanda lisuma.” Pantu atontonkenye ati, “Bushe emukuti takwakatale akuba umutende no kucingililwa mu nshita ya bumi bwandi?”

english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD, saying,
translation: Hesekia nao epakupilibukila ku cibumba, alapapata kuli Yawe ati,

english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Hesekia, fyonse ifyo abombele, kabili ifyo apangile icishiba nefyo aimbile umufolo wakuleta amenshi mu musumba, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
translation: Hesekia ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Elyo Manase umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
translation: “Nakulomba we Yawe, ibukisha ifyo nyenda pa cinso cobe mu cishinka na mu bololoke bwa mutima no kucita ifyawama pa cinso cobe.” Elyo kabili Hesekia alalila nganshi, tepakulila mwe.

english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, the LORD’s word came to him, saying,
translation: Lintu Esaya talati afume mu lubansa lwa mukati, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli ena aliti,

english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to the LORD’s house.
translation: “Bwelela kuli Hesekia intungulushi ya bantu bandi, no kuya mweba ukuti Yawe aletila ati, ‘Ine ne Yawe Lesa wa cikolwe cobe Davidi, niŋumfwa ukupapata kobe, kabili nimona ne filamba fyobe. Cisuma, ine nalakuposha. Pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu ukutula nomba, uli nokuya na ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”
translation: Nalalunda imyaka ikumi limo na isano (15) ku bumi bobe. Kabili ine nkalakupokololako, no kupokololako uno musumba, ku kuboko kwa mfumu ya calo ca Asiria. Nkacingilila na uno wine umusumba pa mulandu wandi na pa mulandu wa cilayo ico ine nalaile umubomfi wandi Davidi.’”

english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
translation: Elyo Esaya asosa ati, “Pekanya icimamantwa ca makunyu.” Nabo bacita ifyo fine elyo bashinga pa cipute nao apola.

english: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I will go up to the LORD’s house the third day?”
translation: Hesekia alitalile aipusha Esaya ati, “Bushe ni cinshi icakwishibilako ukuti Yawe alemposha kabili ndi nokukwata amaka yakwenda no kuya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu ukufuma nomba?”

english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”
translation: Esaya ayasuka ati, “Ici e cishibilo cakwa Yawe kuli iwe icakuti Yawe ali nokufikilisha ifyo alaya ukuti, ‘Bushe cintu cayanguka icinshingwa ukulola kuntanshi intampulo ikumi, nangu ukushalila kunuma intampulo ikumi?’”

english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
translation: Manase ali ne myaka ikumi limo na ibili (12) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Yuda, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu imyaka amakumi yasano na isano (55). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Hefisiba.

english: The LORD spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,
translation: Yawe epakulanda ukupitila mu babomfi bakwe bakasesema ati,

english: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;
translation: “Manase imfumu ya bena Yuda nacita ifyamakankamike. Nacita ububifi ubwakucila na pa bena Amoli abamutangilile, no kuposa Yuda mukubifya pa mulandu wa tulubi twakwe.

english: therefore the LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.
translation: Imila 7:12-18

english: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
translation: Sam 7:13

english: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,
translation: Nkaposa abantu bandi abakashalapo no kubapeela mu minwe ya balwani babo. Bakabasansa no kutapa ifyuma fyabo fyonse,

english: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”
translation: pantu nabacita ifyabipa pa cinso candi no kunenga ukukalipa, ukufumafye pa bushiku ifikolwe fyabo fyafumine mu Egupto ukushinta ne lelo.’”

english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
translation: Na cimbi cakuti Manase alisumya umulopa wakaele uwingi uwakwisula mu Yerusalemu ukufuma ku mpela ukufika na ku mpela imbi, ukwabula ukubikako ifyabubifi ifyo atweleko abena Yuda ukucitako, ukubalenga ukubifya nganshi pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Manase, na fyonse ifyo acitile, ukulundapo ne fyabubifi acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
translation: Manase ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe kabili bamushiikile mwibala lye sano lyakwe ilyakwa Usa. Elyo umwana wakwe Amoni amupyana pa bufumu.

english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
translation: Amoni ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na ibili (22) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka ibili. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Meshulemeti umwana umwanakashi wakwa Harusi. Afumine ku Yotiba.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, akonkelele imicitile yabipa iyalecita imishobo Yawe atamfishe ku cinso ca bena Israeli.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.
translation: Amoni acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo wishi Manase acitile.

english: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;
translation: Aendele mu nshila shonse ishakwa wishi, no kulapepa utulubi tonse uto wishi alepepa nokutucindika.

english: and he abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of the LORD.
translation: Asangukila Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyakwe, elyo afilwa no kwenda mu nshila shakwa Yawe.

english: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
translation: Bacilolo bakwa Amoni bamupangila, baya mwipaila mu ŋanda ye sano lyakwe.

english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
translation: Elyo abekalacalo epakwipaya bonse abaimine nokwipaya imfumu Amoni. Elyo babuula umwana wakwe Yosaya eo bapyanikisha pa bufumu.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Amoni nefyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Bamushiikile mu nshinshi yakwe ya mwibala lyakwa Usa. Elyo Yosaya umwana wakwe amupyana pa bufumu.

english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
translation: Akuula cipya cipya incende shakupepelamo isho Hesekia wishi aonawile. Apangila Baali ifibumbili fya malambo elyo abasa no luceshi lwa mulungu Asher, ngefyo Ahabu imfumu ya bena Israeli yacitile. Alacindika ifita fyonse ifya mu mulu, no kufipepa.

english: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”
translation: Yere 15:4

english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.
translation: Mu mansa shonse shibili isha mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, akuulila ifita fyonse ifya mu mulu ifibumbili fya malambo.

english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
translation: Atuula ilambo lyakupisha umwana wakwe umwaume mu mulilo, alacita ubuloshi, ayamba nokulabuka, no kubomba ne mipashi ya bafwa elyo ne ngulu. Acita ububifi ubwingi pa cinso cakwa Yawe icakuti amukalifya umutima.

english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;
translation: Abuula uluceshi ulwa mulungu Ashera, abika mu ŋanda umo Yawe aebelepo Davidi no mwana wakwe Solomoni ukuti, “Muli ino ŋanda na muno mu Yerusalemu, incende iyo nsalile ukufuma mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli, emukaba ishina lyandi umuyayaya.

english: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”
translation: Nshakaleke nakabili ukuti amakasa ya bena Israeli yakaleendauka ukufuma mu calo napeele ifikolwe fyabo, nga cakuti batekanya mukucita ifintu fyonse ifyo mbakonkomeshe elyo nokubaka amafunde yonse ayo umubomfi wandi Mose abapeele.”

english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
translation: Lelo abantu tabaumfwile. Manase alibafulungenye, icakuti bacita ububifi ubwingi ukucila na pa mishobo Yawe afulumwine pa ntanshi ya bena Israeli.

english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
translation: Yosaya ali ne myaka cine konse konse ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka amakumi yatatu na umo (31). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Yedida umwana umwanakashi wakwa Adaia. Ali umwina Bosikati.

english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.
translation: Elyo Shafani uwali kalemba aeba imfumu ati, “Hilikiya shimapepo nampeela icitabo.” Elyo abelengela imfumu ifyali mu citabo.

english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yaumfwa amashiwi ya mu citabo ca mafunde, yalepaula ifyakufwala fyaiko.

english: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
translation: Imfumu epakupeela ifipope ifi kuli Hilikiya shimapepo, Ahikamu mwana Shafani, Akibo mwana Mikaiya, Shafani uwali kalemba elyo na Asaiya uwali mushika wa mfumu aiti,

english: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”
translation: “Kabiyeni mwishina lyandi nelya bantu nelya Yuda yonse, muye twipushishako pali aya mashiwi yalembwa muli ici citabo basangile. Pantu ubukali bwakwa Yawe nabukulisha nganshi pali ifwe pa mulandu wakuti ifikolwe fyesu fyalifilwa ukubeela amashiwi ya muli ici icitabo. Balifilwa ukucita ifintu fyonse bwino umo fyalembelwe palwa ifwe.”

english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.
translation: Hilikiya shimapepo, Ahikamu, Akibo, Shafani elyo na Asaiya baya mukuya landishanya na kasesema mwanakashi Hulida, uwali umukashi wakwa Shalumu mwana Tikifa, uwali umwana wakwa Harasi, kasunga wa fyakufwala. Uyu mwanakashi aleikala mu Yerusalemu, mu ciputulwa cabubili .

english: She said to them, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
translation: Isham 12:15

english: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.
translation: Yawe alanda ati, ‘Nalaleta icinkunka pali ino incende na pa bantu baiko, ukulingana na pa fyalembwa mu citabo ico imfumu ya bena Yuda ibelengele.

english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti balinsangukila no kocela ububani imilungu imbi elyo no kunenga ukuti nkalipe pa mulandu wa tulubi uto bapanga ne minwe yabo, ubukali bwandi buli nokuba pali ino ncende kabili tabuli nakutalalikwa.’

english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,
translation: Kebeni imfumu ya bena Yuda iyacimutuma ukwisa ipusha kuli Yawe ukuti, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli asosa pa mulandu wa mashiwi umfwile ukuti,

english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says the LORD.
translation: pantu umutima obe naulanguluka elyo no kuicefya pa cinso cakwa Yawe ilyo wacumfwa ifyo Yawe acilanda palwa ino ncende na bantu baiko, ukuti bali nokulapishiwa elyo nokuposwa, nomba iwe walepula ifyakufwala fyobe no kulila pa cinso candi. Eico na ine ninkumfwa, efyo Yawe asosa.

english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.
translation: Yosaya acitile ifyawama pa cinso cakwa Yawe no kwendela mu nshila shonse ishakwa wishi Davidi ukwabula ukulayalukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso.

english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.
translation: Kanshi iwe ndi nokukutwala ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe, kabili bali nokukushiika mu cibote. Amenso yobe tayali nakumonako ifinkunka fyonse ndi nokuleta pali ino ncende.’”

english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the LORD’s house, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ukumi limo na cine konse konse (18) uwa pa bufumu, Yosaya atumine Shafani kalemba wa milandu uwali mwana Asaliya, nao umwana wakwa Meshulamu ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe na mashiwi yakuti,

english: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into the LORD’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.
translation: “Kabiye kuli Hilikiya shimapepo mukalamba no kuya mweba ukuti alonganike indalama shonse isho abantu baleta ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe, shilya bakalinda wa pa mwinshi bapoka ukufuma ku bantu.

english: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of the LORD’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in the LORD’s house, to repair the damage to the house,
translation: Muye mumwebe apeele ishi indalama ku bantu abangalila umulimo wakuwamisha Yawe iŋanda. Kabili muye mona nokuti aba bantu nabo balipila ababomfi abawamya iŋanda yakwa Yawe,

english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.
translation: Yere 3:6

english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”
translation: Lelo tacilefwaikwa ukubepusha pafyo babomfeshe indalama pantu balikwata icishinka mu mibombele yabo.”

english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
translation: Hilikiya shimapepo mukalamba aeba Shafani uwali kalemba ati, “Ninsanga icitabo ca mafunde mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.” Acipeela kuli Shafani pakuti abelenge.

english: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of the LORD’s house.”
translation: Elyo Shafani uwali kalemba aya ku mfumu no kuya eba imfumu ati, “Bacilolo bobe nabaya folesha indalama ishaciba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, bacishiila ababomfi elyo na bakangalila wa milimo ya pa ŋanda.”

english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo imfumu Yosaya yaitile abakalamba bonse aba mu Yuda na mu Yerusalemu.

english: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
translation: Aonaula ne ncende ya Tofeti iyali mu mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu, pakuti pelaba nangu umo uwakuibomfya ukulekela kuli Moleki umwana wakwe umwaume nangu umwana wakwe umwanakashi nge lambo lyakoca.

english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of the LORD’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
translation: Afumya pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe bakabalwe abo imfumu sha bena Yuda shatuulile ku kasuba. Aba bakabalwe bali mu lukungu ulwali mupepi no muputule wakwa cilolo ishina lyakwe ni Natani Meleki. Yosaya aoca na maceleta ayo balebomfya pakupepa akasuba.

english: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.
translation: Abongolola ifibumbili fya malambo imfumu sha bena Yuda shakuulile pa mutenge mupepi no muputule wa pamulu uwakwa Ahasi, elyo ne fibumbili fya malambo Manase akuulile mu mansa shibili isha ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Afumyapo apo fyali, no kufitobaula mu tupimfya utunono no kuposa ubufungau mu mukonko wa Kidironi.

english: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
translation: Imfumu yatobaula incende shakupepelamo isho balecindika ishali ku kabanga ka Yerusalemu lwa ku masamba ya Lupili lwa Bonaushi isho Solomoni imfumu ya bena Israeli yakuulile Ashitoreti, umulungu uwanakashi wa bena Sidoni, Kemoshi umulungu wa bena Moabu, elyo na Meleki umulungu uwamuselu uwa bena Amoni.

english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.
translation: Yosaya atobaula inceshi sha mabwe balepepelapo, atemaula ne nceshi sha mulungu Ashera, elyo abikapo na mafupa ya bantu abafwa pali shilya ncende.

english: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
translation: Kabili aonaula no bulambo bwa ku Betele, ne ncende yakupepelamo iyapangile Yeroboamu mwana Nebati, uwaletelele abena Israeli ukucita ifyabubifi. Abongolola bulya bwine ubulambo ne ncende yakupepelamo iyo balecindika. Aocapo umulilo no kushonaula fyonse ukuba ulukungu, elyo aoca no luceshi lwakwa Ashera.

english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the LORD’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
translation: Yosaya acebuka elyo amona inshinshi ishali pa ncende ya lupili. Aya buulamo amafupa aisa yocela pa bulambo pakuti abukoweshe, ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyalandilwe no muntu wakwa Lesa uwasobele fyonse ifi.

english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”
translation: Imfumu yaipusha aiti, “Nga lilya ilibwe lya pa nshinshi namona lya finshi?”

english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.
translation: Imfumu yabeba ati, “Lekeni abe, mwiikatako, mwileka nangu umo ekate ku mafupa yakwe.” Kanshi epakuleka amafupa yakwe pamo na yakwa kasesema uwafumine ku Samaria.

english: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
translation: Nga filya fine acitile ku Betele, Yosaya aonaula kabili akowesha na mayanda yonse aya mu ncende shakupepelamo isho imfumu sha mu Israeli shakuulile mu misumba ya mu Samaria ishalengele nokuti Yawe afulwe.

english: The king went up to the LORD’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the LORD’s house.
translation: Aya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe pamo na bena Yuda abaume, na bantu ba mu Yerusalemu, bashimapepo na bakasesema na bantufye bonse ukufuma ku twaice ukufika ku bakulu. Elyo Yosaya abelengela abantu pakuti bomfwe amashiwi yonse aya mu citabo ca cipangano ico basangile mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
translation: Yosaya aya ipaila pa fibumbili fya malambo bashimapepo bonse aba mu ncende shonse ishakupepelamo, aocelapo na mafupa ya bantu. Elyo abwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”
translation: Levi 18:21

english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
translation: Takwatalile akuba ukusefya inshikunkulu ye Pasaka ngeyi ukufumafye mu nshiku abapingushi batungulwile icalo ca Israeli ukufika mu nshita sha mfumu sha bena Israeli ne mfumu sha bena Yuda.

english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.
translation: Lelo mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) uwakwa Yosaya, iyi nshikunkulu baisefeshe mukucindika Yawe mu Yerusalemu.

english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD’s house.
translation: Yosaya akonkanyapo ukufumya imilimo ya mipashi ya bafwa no kubuka. Afumyamo ne milungu iyo balependwilako pa mayanda, utulubi elyo na fyonse ifyamakankamike balebomfya mu Yuda na mu Yerusalemu. Ifi fyacitilwe pakufikilisha ififwaikwa mu mafunde ayalembwa mu citabo cilya Hilikiya shimapepo asangile mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.
translation: Ukufumafye lintu talabapo nangu ilyo afuminepo, takwatalile akuba imfumu iyali nga ena mukubwelela kuli Yawe ngefyo acitile no mutima wakwe onse, no mweo wakwe onse, elyo na maka yakwe yonse umwabela amafunde yonse ayakwa Mose.

english: Notwithstanding, the LORD didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.
translation: Lelo nangu cali ifi, Yawe tabweseshe ubukali bwa mutima wakwe, ubo afulilwe abena Yuda pa mulandu wafyo Manase acitile ifyakulenga Yawe akalipe.

english: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakusosa ati, “Ndi nokufumya abena Yuda pa cinso candi ngefyo nafumishe abena Israeli, kabili ndi nokukaana Yerusalemu, umusumba uo nasalile, elyo neyi ine ŋanda apo nalandile ukuti, ‘e cifulo apakaba ishina lyandi umuyayaya.’”

english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Lelo palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yosaya, elyo na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.
translation: Ilyo Yosaya acili ali mfumu, Farao Neko imfumu ya ku Egupto yaile ku mumana wa Yufurate kukuya afwa imfumu ya ku Asiria ukulwa inkondo. Yosaya aima mukuya mulwisha, nomba ilyo Neko amukumanya ku Megido, amwipaya.

english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.
translation: Imfumu Yosaya yaiminina mupepi no luceshi elyo yabukulusha icipangano pa cinso cakwa Yawe, icakulaenda mu nshila shakwa Yawe no kubaka amalango yakwe ne fipope fyakwe na mafunde yakwe no mutima waiko onse elyo no mweo waiko onse, mukufikilisha amashiwi ya cipangano ayalembwa muli ici citabo. Elyo na bantu bonse epakulaya ukuti bakulasunga icipangano.

english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
translation: Yere 7:31

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
translation: Yehoahasi acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe filya fine fyonse fyacitile fikolwe fyakwe.

english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
translation: Isham 12:33

english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.
translation: Farao Neko abuula Eliakimu mwana Yosaya eo abika pa bufumu pa cifulo cakwa wishi Yosaya, elyo ayalula ne shina lyakwa Eliakimu ukuba ni Yehoyakimu. Lelo abuula Yehoahasi amusenda ku Egupto, kabili kulya kwine eko aya fwila no kufwila.

english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
translation: Yehoyakimu ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na isano (25) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu pa myaka ikumi limo na umo (11). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Sebida umwana umwanakashi wakwa Pedaiya. Afumine ku Ruma.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
translation: Kabili Yehoyakimu acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe filya fine fyonse fyacitile fikolwe fyakwe.

english: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of the LORD’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
translation: Imfumu yapeela icipope kuli Hilikiya shimapepo mukalamba, na bashimapepo abamukonkelepo na bakalinda wa pa mwinshi ukuti bafumye mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe ifipe fyonse ifyo balebomfya mukupepa imilungu Baali na Ashera elyo na mukupepa ifita fyonse fya mu mulu . Afyocela kunse ya Yerusalemu mu mabala ayaba mu mukonko wa Kidironi, asenda ne mito ku Betele.

english: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.
translation: Atamfya bashimapepo babufi abo imfumu sha bena Yuda shasontele ukulaoca ububani pa ncende shakupepelapo isha mu misumba ya mu Yuda na kuli shonse ishashinguluka Yerusalemu. Bonse abalefukilisha ububani kuli Baali, ku kasuba, ku mweshi, na ku ntanda ne fita fyonse fya mumulu.

english: He brought out the Asherah from the LORD’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.
translation: Afumya uluceshi lwa mulungu Ashera mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, alusenda kunse ya musumba ku mukonko wa Kidironi eko aya locela. Eko alushonaula mpaka lwasanguka imito, elyo asenda aya isansa pa nshinshi sha bantu abafwile.

english: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
translation: Atobaula na mayanda ya bacilende ba ku mfuba abaume ayali mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, umo abanakashi balepikwila insalu sha mulungu Ashera.

english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
translation: Yosaya abwesha bashimapepo bonse ukufuma mu misumba ya mu Yuda elyo aonaula incende shonse balepepelamo, ukufuma ku Geba ukufika ku Beresheba uko bashimapepo balefukilisha ububani. Abongolola ne ncende shakupepelamo isha pa mpongolo, ishi ncende shali pa mwinshi wa mpongolo yakwa Yoshua uwali umulashi wa musumba iyali ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka mpongolo ya mu musumba.

english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to the LORD’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
translation: Nangu cali ukuti aba bashimapepo ba ishi ncende shakupepelamo, tabalebombako imilimo ya ku bulambo bwakwa Yawe mu Yerusalemu, lelo balelyako umukate uushatutumuka pamo na bashimapepo banabo.

english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
translation: Mu nshita ya bufumu bwakwa Yehoyakimu, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaingile mukulwisha icalo. Acicimfya, ne mfumu Yehoyakimu yalamubombela pa myaka itatu. Lelo aisa pilibula umutima no kusangukila Nebukadinesa.

english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
translation: Pali ilya ine nshita, bacilolo bakwa Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni baima mukuya lwisha Yerusalemu nokuya ushinguluka.

english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni umwine aisa ku musumba ninshi bacilolo bakwe nabaushinguluka.

english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.
translation: Kanshi Yehoiyakini imfumu ya bena Yuda, nyina, ababomfi bakwe, abacindami bakwe elyo na bacilolo bakwe bonse epakucimba kuli Nebukadinesa. Mu mwaka walenga cine konse konse uwa mfumu ya ku Babiloni, Nebukadinesa asenda Yehoiyakini ukuba umufungwa.

english: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.
translation: Ngefyo Yawe asosele, Nebukadinesa asenda icuma conse ica mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe elyo neca kwisano, kabili asenda ne fipe fya golide ifyo Solomoni imfumu ya bena Israeli apangile ifya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.
translation: Asenda muli bunkole abantu bonse aba mu Yerusalemu, bacilolo bonse pamo ne fita fya nkondo, bakabasa elyo na bakafula wa fyela. Bonse pamo bakumene amakana ikumi limo (10,000). Kwashelefye abantu abalanda beka beka epela.

english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
translation: Nebukadinesa asenda Yehoiyakini muli bunkole ku Babiloni pamo na nyina wa mfumu, abakashi ba mfumu, bacilolo bakwe elyo na bacindami ba mu calo. Awe abafumya mu Yerusalemu no kubasenda bunkole ku Babiloni.

english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Babiloni yabuula ifita fya nkondo ifyakosa amakana cine lubali (7,000) afituma ku Babiloni pamo na bakabasa na bakafula wa fyela nabo ikana limo (1,000).

english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
translation: Abuula Matania, nalume wakwa Yehoiyakini eo abika pa bufumu pa cifulo cakwa Yehoiyakini. Ayalula ne shina lyakwe ati ni Sedekia.

english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
translation: Sedekia ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na umo (21) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele pa myaka ikumi limo na umo (11) mu Yerusalemu. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Hamutali umwana wakwa Yeremia uwafumine ku Libina.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
translation: Sedekia acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo imfumu Yehoyakimu yacitile.

english: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.
translation: Yawe epakutuma ifita fya bena Kaludea , abena Aramu, abena Moabu na bena Amoni mukumulwisha. Abatumine mukonaula Yuda mukukonka ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyasoselwe na babomfi bakwe bakasesema.

english: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wakuti Yawe alifulilwe, ecalengele fyonse ifi ficitike kuli Yerusalemu na kuli Yuda, na pakulekelesha abafumya pa cinso cakwe.

english: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,
translation: Mu cishinka, ifi fintu fyacitikile abena Yuda ukulingana nefyo Yawe akonkomeshe, palwa kubafumya pa cinso cakwe, pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyakwa Manase na pali fyonse ifyo acitile.

english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.
translation: Pali ifi alundilepo no mulandu wakusumya umulopa wakaele, pantu aiswishe umusumba wa Yerusalemu no mulopa wakaele, icalengele nokuti Yawe talefwaya no kumubelela uluse.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Nomba palwa fintu fimbi ifya pambufumu bwakwa Yehoyakimu elyo na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yehoyakimu ilyo afwile aile lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Elyo umwana wakwe umwaume Yehoiyakini ewamupyana pa bufumu.

english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.
translation: Imfumu ya mu Egupto tayatalile aifuma nakabili mu calo caiko mukuya lwisha, pantu imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalimupokele icalo ukufumafye ku kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto ukufika ku mumana wa Yufurate.

english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
translation: Yehoiyakini ali ne myaka ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele pa myeshifye itatu mu musumba wa Yerusalemu. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Nehushita umwana umwanakashi wakwa Elinatani uwafumine ku Yerusalemu.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.
translation: Imila 36:9-10

english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.
translation: Kanshi mu mwaka walenga pabula uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Sedekia, pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi mu mweshi walenga ikumi, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaima mukuya lwisha Yerusalemu ne fita fyakwe fyonse. Akuula inkambi kunse ya musumba elyo ashingulusha imina ya maloba na fimbi fyakubomfya pakwikata umusumba.

english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation: Ifita fyonse ifya bena Kaludea ifyali no mukalamba wa bakalinda ba mfumu batobaula na malinga ayashingulwike umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.
translation: Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda wa mfumu asenda muli bunkole abantu bonse abashele mu musumba, pamo pene na bantu abafyukile ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni. Asendela kumo na bantu abacenjela ku fyakutukuta tukuta.

english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
translation: Lelo uyu mukalamba wa bakalinda ashako abekalacalo bamo abalanda nganshi abakuti balesunga imyangashi elyo no kulalima amabala.

english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.
translation: Esek 12:13

english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
translation: Kabili basenda imipika, bafosholo, ifyakukushilamo imito, ifyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto, imbale elyo na fyonse ifipe fya mukuba ifyo balebomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.
translation: Isham 7:15-26

english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.
translation: Imila 4:16

english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.
translation: Cila luceshi lwalepele lumo lumo amakubiti ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) . Umutwe wa mukuba umo uwali pa mulu wa luceshi wali amakubiti yatatu ukulola mumulu, elyo ukushinguluka cila luceshi balengeleko amaluba ayasuma ayapala amateke aya mukuba. Uluceshi lwacibili nalo lwine lwali ulwapalana ku lubiye.

english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;
translation: Kabili Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda asenda Seraya shimapepo mukalamba, Sefania shimapepo wamukonkelepo na bakalinda wa pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe batatu ukuba abafungwa.

english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.
translation: Ku bashelepo mu musumba, asenda uwaletungulula ifita elyo na bampandamano basano aba kwisano. Asenda na kalemba uwali cilolo mukalamba wa bashilika ba nkondo uwalesunga imilandu ya bulwi elyo na bambi abaume amakumi mutanda (60) abasangilwe mu musumba.

english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
translation: Esek 24:2

english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
translation: Awe Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda abatwala bonse ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni, iyali mu mushi wa Ribula.

english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
translation: Esek 33:21

english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.
translation: Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni yasonta Gedalia umwana wakwa Ahikamu, mwana Shafyani ukuba umulashi wa bantu bashele mu Yuda abo bashasendeleko muli bunkole ku Babiloni.
