english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
translation: Ilyo bacilolo wa fita pamo na bantu babo baumfwa ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni naisonta Gedalia ukuba umulashi, baima baisa kuli Gedalia ku Misipa. Abaishile bali ni Ishimaeli mwana Netaniya, Yohanani mwana Karea, Seraya mwana Tanihumeti umwina Netofa, Yasaniya umwana wa mwina Makati elyo na bantu babo bonse.

english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”
translation: Gedalia alapa umulapo wakubalaya, bena pamo na bantu babo. Abeba nokuti, “Mwitiina bacilolo ba bena Kaludea, lelo iseni mwikale muno calo. Mulebombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni, ninshi na fyonse fili nokubafye bwino kuli imwe.”

english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.
translation: Nomba mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, Ishimaeli umwana wakwa Netaniya, mwana Elishama uwali uwa ku bufumu aisa na bantu ikumi limo no kwisa ipaya Gedalia na baume abena Yuda elyo na bena Kaludea abali nankwe ku Misipa.

english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
translation: Pali iyi nshita, abantu bonse ukufuma pa wacepesha ukufika na ku wacindamisha pamo pene na bacilolo wa bashilika babutukila ku Egupto pa mulandu wakutiina abena Kaludea.

english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na cine lubali (37) apo basendele Yehoiyakini imfumu ya bena Yuda muli bunkole, pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27) mu mweshi we kumi limo na ibili (12), emo imfumu Efili Merodaki atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Babiloni. Abelela Yehoiyakini uluse, amufumya na mu cifungo.

english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
translation: Efili Melodaki alemutentemba, alimupeele ne cipuna icacindamisha pa fipuna fya shamfumu shimbi shonse ishali pamo na Yehoiyakini muli bunkole mu Babiloni.

english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;
translation: Kanshi Yehoiyakini epakufula ifyakufwala fya mu cifungo, elyo na mu nshiku shonse isha bumi bwakwe lyonse alalya kwisano lya mfumu.

english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga pabula mu mweshi walenga bune, insala mu musumba yakulisha icakuti abantu balafilwa no kumona icakulya.

english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
translation: Kabili imfumu Efili Melodaki yalemupeela ifintu fyonse ifyo alekabila cila bushiku pa nshiku shonse ishashele ku bumi bwakwe.

english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.
translation: Amalinga ya ku musumba epakulabongololwa. Pakumona ifi, imfumu Sedekia na bashilika bonse aba mu musumba bena bafulumuka ubushiku, ninshi na bena Kaludea nabashinguluka umusumba. Bakonka inshila iyalola kwibala lya mfumu, bapitila pa mpongolo iyaba pakati ka fibumba fibili, balola na ku Araba.

english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
translation: Nomba ifita fya bena Kaludea fyakunkunika imfumu Sedekia, mpaka fyamwikatila mu mawanga ya Yeriko, na bashilika bakwe bonse ninshi baya basalangana ukufuma kuli ena.

english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.
translation: Fyati fikate imfumu, awe fyaitwala na kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni ilyo ninshi wena ali ku mushi wa Ribula, uko kwine eko na Nebukadinesa aputwila Sedekia umulandu.

english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
translation: Baipaya abana abaume bakwa Sedekia pa cinso cakwe. Elyo ena bamutonkola amenso, bamukaka mu minyololo ya mukuba elyo bamusenda ku Babiloni.

english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali mu mweshi walenga isano, mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na pabula (19) apo Nebukadinesa atampile ukuteeka ubufumu mu Babiloni, elintu Nebusaradani aingile mu musumba wa Yerusalemu. Uyu Nebusaradani ali ni shicilye wa mfumu, kabili ewali mushika mukalamba uwa bakalinda ba mfumu.

english: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.
translation: Kanshi Nebusaradani epakoca iŋanda yakwa Yawe, aoca na mayanda ya kwisano, aocela kumo na mayanda yonse ayacindami ya mu Yerusalemu.

english: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
translation: Ilyo inshita yafikile mupepi iyakuti Yawe asende Eliya ku mulu muli kankungwe, Eliya na Elisha bali pa lwendo lwakufuma ku Giligali.

english: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”
translation: Eliya amweba ati, “Walomba icintu icayansha, lelo nga cakuti uleisa monako ilyo balensenda ukufuma kuli iwe, cileisa ba ifyo fine ulombele, nga teifyo lyena iyoo.”

english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
translation: Lilya bacili mukuya balelanda ilyashi, mukupumikisha kwaisa iceleta lya mulilo ilyo bakabalwe abamulilo baletinta no kwisa bapatulula, na Eliya asendwa mu mulu muli kankungwe.

english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
translation: Elisha pakumonako apunda ati, “Tata wandi, tata wandi ee! Amaceleta ya mu Israeli na ba pali bakabalwe.” Ukufumapo Elisha tatalile amumona nakabili. Elyo abuula ifyakufwala fyakwe afilepula pakati.

english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
translation: Abuula umwingila Eliya aponeshe asenda abwelelamo uko afumine, aya iminina pa lulamba lwa Yordani.

english: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.
translation: Isham 13:14

english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
translation: Impuka ya bakasesema abafumine ku Yeriko abaletamba ifilecitika basosa abati, “Umupashi wakwa Eliya waikala pali Elisha.” Elyo baya mukumukumanya kabili bakontamika imitwe yabo pa cinso cakwe.

english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”
translation: Bamweba ukuti, “Mona, ifwe fwe babomfi bobe natukwata abaume abamaka amakumi yasano (50). Leka baye balefwaya sokulu. Pantu limbi kuti Umupashi wakwa Yawe wacimusenda nauya musha ku ncende ya ku mpili nangu mwishika.”

english: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.
translation: Amaf 21:17

english: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”
translation: Ilyo babwelele kuli Elisha ninshi ekala mu Yeriko, abeba ukuti, “Bushe nshamuleseshe ukuya?”

english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”
translation: Abaume ba mu musumba baebele Elisha abati, “Moneni mwe shikulu, uno musumba wakuulwa apasuma, ngefyo mulemona lelo amenshi yaba ayabi no mushili taukwata ifyakulya.”

english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.
translation: Elyo Eliya aeba Elisha ati, “Ikala pano pantu Yawe nantuma ku Betele.”

english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.
translation: Abeba ati, “Leteni imbale ipya, elyo mubikemo no mucele.” Nabo bamuletela.

english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”
translation: Elyo aima aya ku mulonga, abuula no mucele aposamo, alanda nokuti, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, ‘Nimposha aya menshi. Tayakatale ayaleta imfwa nangu ukulenga umushili ukukanakwata ifyakulya.’”

english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.
translation: Na menshi yabafye ayasuma ukufika na kuli buno bushiku, ukulingana ne shiwi Elisha asosele.

english: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”
translation: Ukufuma kulya Elisha aile ku Betele. Lilya acili mukuya mu musebo, abana bacilumendo baisa ukufuma mu musumba bayamba ukumuwela abati, “Kabiye ube cilipala, kabiye ube cilipala.”

english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.
translation: Elyo apilibuka abalolesha no kulanda icitipu pali bena mwishina lyakwa Yawe. Elyo ifiswango fibili fibea fyafuma mu mpanga no kwipayapo abana amakumi yane na babili (42).

english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
translation: Kabili aima aya ku lupili lwa Kameli elyo ukufuma kulya abwelela na ku Samaria.

english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
translation: Impuka ya bakasesema ba ku Betele baishile ukwali Elisha bamwipusha ati, “Bushe nawishiba ukuti Yawe ilelo alesenda sokulu ukufuma kuli iwe?”

english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.
translation: Elyo Eliya aeba Elisha ati, “Ikala pano Elisha pantu ine Yawe nantuma ku Yeriko.”

english: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
translation: Impuka ya bakasesema ba mu Yeriko baya ukwali Elisha bamwipusha abati, “Bushe nawishiba ukuti Yawe ilelo alesenda sokulu ukufuma kuli iwe?”

english: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.
translation: Elyo Eliya amweba ati, “Ikala pano pantu Yawe nantuma ku Yordani.”

english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.
translation: Impuka ya bakasesema amakumi yasano (50) bakonka baya iminina akatalamukila ukulolesha ku ncende ukwaiminine Eliya na Elisha pa lulamba lwa mumana wa Yordani.

english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.
translation: Eliya epakubuula umwingila wakwe aupomba elyo auma pa menshi. Amenshi yayakanika pakati yatulumana uku noku elyo bonse babili bayabuka pa mushili uwauma.

english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”
translation: Ilyo bayabuka, Eliya aeba Elisha ati, “Njeba, bushe finshi ulefwaya nkucitile pa nshita tabalansenda ukufuma kuli iwe.”

english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
translation: Yoramu umwana mwaume wakwa Ahabu, ayambile ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa mu Israeli, mu musumba wa Samaria, mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) ilyo Yehoshafati ali imfumu ya bena Yuda. Kabili ateekelemo imyaka ikumi limo na ibili (12).

english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
translation: Imfumu ya bena Israeli epakuilishanya aiti, “Cinshi, bushe Yawe alonganikila fwe mfumu shitatu pamo, icakuti nomba ese atupeelefye mu minwe ya bena Moabu?”

english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
translation: Lelo Yehoshafati epakwipusha ati, “Bushe takuli kuno kasesema wakwa Yawe pakuti eo atwipushisheko kuli Yawe.”

english: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
translation: Yehoshafati asosa ati, “Ulya wine euli ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe.” Kanshi imfumu ya bena Israeli na Yehoshafati ne mfumu ya bena Edomu epakuya kuli ena.

english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
translation: Elisha aeba imfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “Bushe ni finshi twingabombela pamo iwe na ine? Kabiye kuli bakasesema bakwa wiso na bakasesema bakwa noko.”

english: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
translation: Elisha asosa ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe umwine wa fita uwamweo, uyo ine ntumika, mbula ukuba no mucinshi kuli Yehoshafati imfumu ya bena Yuda, nga nshikusakamene nangu ukukulolesha.

english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.
translation: Nomba ndeteleniko kalisha we seese.” Cilya kalisha we seese alelisha, ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwaisa pali Elisha.

english: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
translation: Elyo alanda ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti, ‘Imbeni ifishima ifingi muli lino ishika.’

english: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.
translation: Pantu ifi efyo Yawe asosa ukuti, ‘Tamwamone umwela nangu imfula, lelo amenshi yalaisula mu mpanga yonse iya mwishika, kabili imwe, iŋombe shenu elyo ne fitekwa fyenu fimbi eyo muli nokunwa.’

english: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
translation: Ici, cintu cayanguka nganshi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kabili ali nokupeela Moabu kuli imwe.

english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”
translation: Muli nokupokolola imisumba yonse iya malinga pamo ne mishi iyikalamba. Muli nokutema umuti onse uusuma, ukucilika intulo shonse isha mimana, elyo no konaula ibala lyonse ilisuma ku mabwe.”

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
translation: Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, lelo tacali nge fyacitile wishi na nyina. Ena alibongolwele uluceshi lwa mabwe ulwamapepo ulwakwa Baali ulo wishi akuulile.

english: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
translation: Ulucelo lwakonkelepo, ukulingana ne nshita yakutuulilapo ilambo, bamona amenshi yatelemuka ukufuma ku lubali lwa ku Edomu. Kabili impanga yonse yaisulamo amenshi.

english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.
translation: Nomba bonse abena Moabu ilyo baumfwile ukuti ishamfumu nashima ukwisa mukubalwisha, baimishe umwaume onse, umwaice nangu umukote uwingalwa ulubuli, baisa mwimika ku mupaka.

english: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
translation: Ilyo babuuka ulucelo, basanga akasuba nakasanika pa menshi. Ku lubali lwa bena Moabu amenshi yalemoneka ayakashika kwati mulopa.

english: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”
translation: Elyo basosa abati, “Mulopa ulya, ni shilya imfumu shifwile nashilwa no kwipayana. Mwe bena Moabu twendeni mukutapa icuma.”

english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.
translation: Lelo ilyo abena Moabu baisa fika pa nkambi ya bena Israeli, abena Israeli babemina no kubalwisha mpaka bafulumuka. Kabili abena Israeli bakumana mpanga yonse no kwipaya abena Moabu.

english: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.
translation: Baonaula imisumba, na cila muntu aposapo ilibwe pebala ilisuma mpaka lyafimbwa. Bacilika utumfukumfuku twa menshi no kutemaula imiti iyisuma yonse. Kanofye Kiri Hareseti eo bashilekofye na mabwe yonse umo yaikalila. Nomba abaume abali na malekeni baushinguluka no kuusansa nao wine.

english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
translation: Ilyo imfumu ya ku Moabu yamona ukuti ulubuli lwaikosela, yaima yasenda abaume abalwila ku lupanga imyanda cine lubali (700) ukwesha ukupatikisha ukuti ifike ku mfumu ya ku Edomu, nomba yafilwa.

english: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
translation: Elyo yabuula umwana wakwe ibeli umwaume, uwali nokuipyana pa bufumu, yamutuula ilambo pelinga lya musumba. Abena Moabu epakufulilwa abena Israeli icine cine, baima babwelela na ku calo cabo.

english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
translation: Nomba alitwalilile mu fyabubifi ifyo Yeroboamu umwana mwaume uwakwa Nebati aletelele na bena Israeli ukubifyako. Tapilibwike ukufumako.

english: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
translation: Nomba Mesha imfumu ya bena Moabu alikwete umwine umulimo alebomba uwakuteeka impaanga, kabili aletuula ku mfumu ya bena Israeli utwana twa mpaanga amakana umwanda umo (100,000), na masako ya basukusuku amakana umwanda umo (100,000).

english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
translation: Lelo panuma ya mfwa yakwa Ahabu, imfumu ya ku Moabu yasangukila imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
translation: Kanshi pali ilya nshita imfumu Yoramu yaima ukufuma ku Samaria no kulonganika abashilika ba mu Israeli bonse.

english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
translation: Atuma na mashiwi aya kuli Yehoshafati imfumu ya bena Yuda ati, “Imfumu ya ku Moabu nainsangukila. Bushe kuti wanshindika kukuya lwisha abena Moabu?”

english: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
translation: Kabili aipusha nokuti, “Bushe tukabomfya nshila nshi pakuya balwisha?”

english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.
translation: Kanshi imfumu ya bena Israeli yaima pamo ne mfumu ya bena Yuda elyo ne ya bena Edomu. Panuma yakwenda inshiku cine lubali ulwendo lwakushinguluka, amenshi yakunwa abashilika pamo ne nama bakwete fyapwa.

english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”
translation: Umukashi wa mwaume umo ukufuma mu mpuka ya bakasesema aliliile kuli Elisha ati, “Umwina mwandi uwali umubomfi obe alifwa, elyo walishiba ukuti ali na katiina kuli Yawe. Lelo uo akongweleko ali mukwisa senda abana abaume babili ukuti bakabe abasha bakwe.”

english: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”
translation: Natupange umuputule uunono pa mulu wa ŋanda. Tubikemo no musengele apakulala, ne tebulo, umupando elyo ne lampi ifyakuti alebomfya. Pakuti emo aleikala nshita yonse ilyo atupempula.”

english: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ilyo Elisha aishile, aile ingila mu muputule wakwe no kulambalala panshi mulya mwine.

english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
translation: Elyo aeba umubomfi wakwe Gehasi ati, “Ita umwanakashi umwina Shunemu.” Elyo amwita, nao aisa iminina pa cinso cakwe.

english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”
translation: Elisha aeba umubomfi ati, “Mwebe uyu mwanakashi auti, ‘Nautuculila nganshi. Nomba ni finshi twingakucitilako? Bushe kuti twakulandilako ku mfumu nangu ku mukalamba wa fita fyankondo?’”

english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
translation: Elisha aipusha ati, “Bushe ni finshi twingamucitila?”

english: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.
translation: Elyo Elisha asosa ati, “Mwite umwanakashi.” Amwita, nao aisa iminina mu mwinshi.

english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”
translation: Elisha amweba ati, “Pa nshita nga ino ine iya uyu mwaka uleisa, uli nokulela umwana mwaume mu maboko yobe.”

english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
translation: Lelo umwanakashi aisa kwata ifumo, na mu mwaka wakonkelepo pa nshita nga ilya ine aisa kwata umwana mwaume ukulingana nefyo Elisha amwebele.

english: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.
translation: Umwana cilya akula, elyo ubushiku bumo aya kuli wishi, ninshi ali ku baleseepa.

english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
translation: Aeba wishi ati, “Nafwa umutwe, nafwa umutwe ee.”

english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”
translation: Elisha amwasuka ati, “Nalakwafa shani? Njeba, ni finshi ukwete mu ŋanda yobe?”

english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
translation: Panuma yakumwimya, umubomfi amusenda amutwala kuli nyina. Uyu mwana aya ikalafye pa molu yakwa nyina mpaka akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe, no mwana afwa.

english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.
translation: Umwanakashi aya ingila mu muputule wa pamulu no kuya bika umwana uwafwa pa musengele wa muntu wakwa Lesa, afumamo aisalako ne ciibi.

english: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”
translation: Umwanakashi aita umulume wakwe amweba ati, “Ntumineniko umubomfi umo elyo na kabalwe pakuti nje ku muntu wakwa Lesa bwangu bwangu no kubwelako.”

english: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”
translation: Umulume aipusha ati, “Ngeco walailako ubushiku bwa lelo cinshi? Apo buno tebushiku bwa mweshi upya nangu ubwe Sabata.”

english: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
translation: Anina pali kabalwe elyo aeba no mubomfi wakwe ati, “Tangila tecakwesha ukunasha ukwenda pa mulandu wa ine kano nakweba.”

english: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
translation: Epakwima mpaka aisa fika ku muntu wakwa Lesa ku lupili lwa Kameli.

english: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”
translation: Butuka kamukonkele umukumanye no kumwipusha auti, ‘Bushe ulifye bwino? Ngo mulume obe ali bwino? Ngo mwana obe ali bwino?’”

english: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”
translation: Lelo ilyo afika apali umuntu wakwa Lesa pa mulu wa lupili, aya mwikata ku makasa. Gehasi aisa ukuti ese amusunke, lelo umuntu wakwa Lesa asosa ati, “Muleke abe. Uyu mwanakashi nakwata ubucushi sana, lelo Yawe namfisa uyu mulandu nakaana no kunjeba ifyo cili.”

english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”
translation: Umwanakashi asosa ati, “Bushe nine shikulu nakulombele umwana mwaume? Bushe nshakwebele ukuti winkubulafye umutima?”

english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”
translation: Elisha aeba Gehasi ati, “Kaka umushipi pa mwingila, buula inkonto yandi usende mu minwe yobe wambefye ulubilo. Nga wakumanya uuli onse, tecakwesha ukumuposha, nangufye umuntu nga akuposha, wimwasuka. Uye lalika inkonto pa mulu wa mwana.”

english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.
translation: Elisha amweba ati, “Endauka wipushe abena mupalamano bonse washimeko imisukupala umushili fintu. Wiyashima utunono.

english: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.
translation: Nomba nyina kwa mwana asosa ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, ngefyo na iwe wine uli uwamweo, nshakushe iyoo.” Nao epakwima akonka umwanakashi.

english: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”
translation: Gehasi ena ninshi nabatangilila aya lalika inkonto pa mwaice, lelo takwali ishiwi nangu icishibilo cabumi. Elyo Gehasi ena abwelelamo ukuya konkela Elisha no kuya mweba ati, “Umwaice tabuukile.”

english: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
translation: Ilyo Elisha afika ku ŋanda, asanga umwaice uwafwa nabamulalika na pa musengele wakwe.

english: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.
translation: Aingila mu ŋanda aisalako iciibi, asha abo babili aishile nabo, elyo apepa kuli Yawe.

english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.
translation: Elyo anina pa musengele no kulambalala pa mulu wa mwaice. Ashintilisha akanwa kakwe pa kanwa ka mwaice, amenso yakwe pa ya mwaice, na maboko yakwe pa ya mwaice. Lilya alambalelepo, umubili wa mwaice wayamba ukukabilila.

english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
translation: Elisha aimapo pa musengele ayamba ukwendauka mukati ka muputule elyo abwelela pa musengele no kulambalala pa mwaice nakabili. Umwaice atesemuna imiku cine lubali, aisula na menso alalolesha.

english: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”
translation: Elisha aita Gehasi amweba ati, “Ita umwanakashi umwina Shunemu.” Nao aya mwita. Ilyo aisa, amweba ati, “Senda umwana obe.”

english: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
translation: Umwanakashi aingila, afukama pa nkasa shakwe akontamika umutwe panshi. Elyo abuula umwana wakwe umwaume amusenda.

english: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”
translation: Ilyo Elisha abwelela ku Giligali asanga ukuti kwali icipowe kuli ilya ncende. Elyo pa nshita acili alelanshanya ne mpuka ya bakasesema, aeba umubomfi wakwe ati, “Tekapo inongo iyo iyikalamba wipikilepo abantu aba icakulya.”

english: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.
translation: Umo pali bena afuma aya mu mpanga, aya mukusaba umusalu. Elyo asanga umwangashi wa mpanga, asabako ifitwalo fyauko aupomba na mu mwingila wakwe. Ilyo abwela, aisa putawila mu nongo ya fyaipikwe, nangu cali cakuti tapali uwaishibe ifi fintu.

english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”
translation: Elyo wingile mu ŋanda, muisalile iwe pamo na bana bobe abaume mukati ka ŋanda. Wambe ukulaminsulwila amafuta mu misukupala yonse, elyo umo nga waisula wauseshapo waubika lubali.”

english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.
translation: Icakulya caisa pekanishiwa no kupeelwa ku bantu, nomba cilya bayamba ukulya, balila abati, “Iwe we muntu wakwa Lesa, muli imfwa mu nongo.” Na bantu bafilwa ukulya.

english: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
translation: Elisha asosa ati, “Leteni ubunga.” Abika ubunga mu nongo alanda nokuti, “Peela abantu uleke balye.” Elyo takwali nangu cimo icakulola ku bubi.

english: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”
translation: Umwaume umo aishile ukufuma ku Baali Shalisha, nasenda imikate ya bale amakumi yabili (20) ukuletela umuntu wakwa Lesa iyapangilwa ku fisabo fyantanshi, pamo pene ne mitwe ya nseke shipya. Elisha amweba ati, “Peela abantu balye.”

english: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”
translation: Umubomfi wakwe aipusha ati, “Bushe iyi ine mikate kuti naipeela shani ku bantu umwanda umo (100)?”

english: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Afipeela kuli bena, nabo balya, kabili bashapo nokusha ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe asosele.

english: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.
translation: Umwanakashi afumapo aya ingila mu ŋanda aisalako ne ciibi, ena na bana bakwe abaume. Baleta imisukupala kuli ena, nao ayamba ukwitilamo amafuta.

english: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
translation: Ilyo imisukupala yonse yaisula, umwanakashi aeba umwana wakwe umwaume ati, “Ndetelako na umbi umusukupala.” Lelo ayasuka ati, “Tapali umusukupala nangu umo uushelepo.” Elyo amafuta yaleka ukupongoloka.

english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”
translation: Umwanakashi aima aya eba umuntu wakwa Lesa, nao amweba ati, “Kabiye uye ushitishe amafuta elyo uye lipila inkongole. Iwe na bana bobe abaume mwakulaliila pa yaleshalapo.”

english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
translation: Ubushiku bumo Elisha aile ku Shunemu, uko ailesanga umwanakashi umucindami nganshi, uyo uwamulombele ukuti ekale pakuti alyeko icakulya. Kanshi alatifye nshita yonse ilyo apita mupepi, ashokelapo mukulya.

english: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.
translation: Elyo umwanakashi aeba umwina mwakwe ati, “Ninjishiba ukuti uyu muntu uwisa mukutupempula lyonse muntu uwashila uwakwa Lesa.

english: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
translation: Nomba Namani ewali umukalamba wa fita fyankondo fya mfumu ya bena Aramu. Ali umuntu uwacindama mu menso yakwa shikulu wakwe elyo no kutemwikwa pantu kupitila muli ena Yawe apeele abena Aramu ukucimfya abalwani babo. Ali umushilika uwacenjela nganshi, nomba alilwele ifibashi.

english: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”
translation: Elisha atuma inkombe yakuya mweba ati, “Kabiye usambe imiku cine lubali mu mumana wa Yordani, no mubili obe walabwelela ifyo wali kale elyo walasanguluka nakabili.”

english: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’
translation: Nomba Namani afulwa, afumapo icipyu, alanda ati, “Ine nacilatontonkanya ukuti alafuma ese kuli ine elyo eminine no kukuuta peshina lyakwa Yawe Lesa wakwe, atambike no kuboko kwakwe apali ubulwele no kumposha ku bulwele bwa fibashi.

english: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
translation: Bushe Abana na Fapa te mimana iyaba mu Damasiko iyawama ukucila amenshi yonse aya mu Israeli? Bushe tekuti nsambe muli iyi mimana no kusangululwa?” Kanshi epakupilibuka afumapo ne cipyu, aya.

english: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”
translation: Ababomfi bakwa Namani baya kuli ena no kumweba ati, “Mwe tata, nga cakuti kasesema akweba ukucita icintu icikulu, bushe tekuti ucicitefye? Pali bufi apo akwebafye ati, ‘Kabiye usambe mu mumana, walasanguluka?’”

english: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
translation: Elyo aima ayasamba imiku cine lubali mu mumana wa Yordani, ukulingana ne shiwi umuntu wakwa Lesa acimweba, no mubili wakwe wabwelela ifyo wali kale, no kusanguka kwati wa kamwana akanono.

english: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”
translation: Elyo Namani pamo na babomfi bakwe babwelela ku muntu wakwa Lesa. Aiminina pa cinso cakwe alanda no kuti, “Nomba naishiba ukuti takwaba Lesa muli lino isonde lyonse kanofye mu Israeli. Nakupapata sumina icabupe ukufuma ku musha obe.”

english: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
translation: Kasesema ayasuka ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe umumi, uo ntumika, nshapoke icintu nangu cimo.” Kabili Namani aesha ukumupatikisha, lelo akaana.

english: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.
translation: Namani asosa ati, “Nga wakaana, kanshi nsuminisha ukuti ine ne mubomfi obe bampeele umushili uwingi uwakuti imfalashi shibili shisende, pantu umubomfi obe takatale atuula amalambo yakoca ku mulungu uuli onse kanofye kuli Yawe.

english: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”
translation: Nomba Yawe engalabelela umubomfi obe uluse pa cintu cimo. Neci cintu cakutila ilyo nashindika shikulu pakuya mukupepa mwitempele lya mulungu wakwe Rimoni, ninshi ena nashintilila pa kuboko kwandi, nga akontama elyo na ine nakontama, ndelomba ukuti Yawe engabelela umubomfi obe uluse pali ici.”

english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
translation: Elisha amweba ati, “Kabiye uleenda umutende.”

english: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
translation: Nomba abena Aramu ilyo baile mukusansa, ku calo ca bena Israeli baiketeko akamukashana kamo ukuba umusha wakubombela muka Namani.

english: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”
translation: Gehasi, umubomfi wakwa Elisha umuntu wakwa Lesa ashala atontonkanya umwine ati, “Shikulu alekelesha Namani uyu umwina Aramu ukubwelelamo ne fintu acileta ukwabula ukupoka. Nomba kwena ine, mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, nalamukonka ulubilo nje mpokeko fimo kuli ena.”

english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”
translation: Kanshi Gehasi epakukonka Namani. Ilyo Namani amumona eshile alebutukila uko ali, aikila ukufuma mwiceleta amukonkela. Amwipusha ati, “Bushe kwaba ifyalubana?”

english: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”
translation: Gehasi ayasuka ati, “Takuli icilubene. Ni shikulu ewantuma ukwisa sosa ati, ‘Abalumendo babili ukufuma mu mpuka ya bakasesema ebaisa kuli ine ukufuma mu calo ca mpili ca ku Efulemu. Napapata bapeko italanta lya silifa limo elyo ne misango ibili iya fyakufwala.’”

english: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
translation: Namani ayasuka ati, “Cilifye bwino, buula amatalanta ya silifa aya yabili.” Akoselesha Gehasi ukuti ekaana elyo akaka na matalanta ya silifa yabili mu mifuko ibili, pamo ne misango ibili iya fyakufwala. Aipeela na ku babomfi bakwe babili, nabo basenda nabatangila pantanshi yakwa Gehasi.

english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.
translation: Ilyo Gehasi afika ku lupili, apoka ifipe ukufuma ku babomfi aya bika mu ŋanda. Aeba na babomfi ukuya, nabo baya.

english: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”
translation: Elyo aingila mu ŋanda no kuya iminina pa cinso cakwa shikulu wakwe Elisha.

english: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?
translation: Lelo Elisha amweba ati, “Bushe umupashi wandi tawaciba na iwe ilyo ulya muntu acifuma mwiceleta ukwisa kukonkela? Bushe ino ni nshita yakupoka indalama, nangu ukupoka ifyakufwala, nangu amabala ya miolifa, nangu amabala ya myangashi, nangu impaanga, nangu iŋombe nangu ababomfi abaume na babomfi abanakashi?

english: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.
translation: Luka 4:27

english: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
translation: Elyo umukashana aeba nakulu ati, “Nga cakuti cingawama shikulu amona kasesema uwaba mu Samaria, kuti aisa posha ubu bulwele bwa fibashi.”

english: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”
translation: Namani epakuya ku mfumu no kuya sosa ifyo umukashana wa ku Israeli alandile.

english: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Aramu yayasuka aiti, “Mu nshila iyili yonse kabiye, nalatuma kalata ku mfumu ya ku Israeli.” Kanshi Namani epakuya, asenda amatalanta ya silifa ikumi limo, indalama sha golide amashekeli amakana mutanda (6,000) ne fyakufwala ifisuma ikumi.

english: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”
translation: Kalata asendele ku mfumu ya ku Israeli yalembelwe ukuti, “Pali iyi nkalata epo natumina umubomfi wandi Namani kuli iwe ukuti umuposhe ubulwele bwa fibashi.”

english: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”
translation: Panumafye yakubelenga kalata, imfumu ya ku Israeli yalepula insalu shabufumu no kusosa aiti, “Bushe ndi Lesa? Bushe kuti naipaya kabili napeela ubumi? Cinshi ena antumina umuntu ukuti njise muposha ifibashi? Moneni ifyo alefwaya ukwamba ukuumana na ine!”

english: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”
translation: Ilyo Elisha umuntu wakwa Lesa aumfwa ukuti imfumu ya bena Israeli nailepula ifyakufwala, aitumina amashiwi yakuti, “Cinshi ico walepwila ifyakufwala? Leka uyo muntu ese kuli ine, ena alaisa ishiba ukuti mwaliba kasesema mu Israeli.”

english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
translation: Kanshi Namani epakusenda bakabalwe bakwe na maceleta, aya iminina pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa Elisha.

english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.
translation: Impuka ya bakasesema yaebele Elisha aiti, “Mona incende ilya twikalamo, naicepa kuli ifwe.

english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.
translation: Kanshi imfumu ya bena Israeli epakutumako abakulengula ilya ncende yalandile umuntu wakwa Lesa. Elyo cila nshita Elisha alasoka imfumu pakuti ibe iyaipekanya muli shilya ncende.

english: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”
translation: Imfumu ya ku Aramu yafulwa nganshi ifyalacitika. Yaita na bacilolo no kubepusha aiti, “Bushe tamwanjebe uyo umo pakati kesu uwawila ku mfumu ya bena Israeli?”

english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”
translation: Umo pali bacilolo ayasuka ati, “Tapali nangu umo pali ifwe kanabesa we mfumu, lelo ni Elisha kasesema uwa bena Israeli eweba imfumu ya bena Israeli amashiwi yalya iwe ulandila mu muputule obe wakukati.”

english: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”
translation: Imfumu yakonkomesha bacilolo aiti, “Kabiyeni mufwailishe uko ali pakuti ntumeko abakuya mwikata.” Baya bwesha amashiwi ukuti, “Ali ku Dotani.”

english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.
translation: Elyo atuma bakabalwe na maceleta ne mpuka ya bashilika iyamaka. Baya ubushiku no kuya shinguluka umusumba onse.

english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”
translation: Ilyo uwaletumika umuntu wakwa Lesa ashibuka ulucelo lwakonkelepo, afumina panse, elyo asanga abashilika na bakabalwe na maceleta nabashinguluka umusumba. Elyo aipusha ati, “Iye mwe shikulu, bushe twalacita shani?”

english: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
translation: Kasesema ayasuka ati, “Witiina, pantu abali na ifwe nabacila pabo bali nabo.”

english: Elisha prayed, and said, “LORD, please open his eyes, that he may see.” the LORD opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.
translation: Elyo Elisha apepa ati, “We Yawe, isula amenso ya uyu muntu pakuti amone.” Elyo Yawe aisula amenso ya mubomfi, nao alolesha amona impili ishaisulamo bakabalwe na maceleta aya mulilo nayashinguluka Elisha.

english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.
translation: Cilya abalwani balapalamina uko ali, Elisha apepa kuli Yawe ati, “Shi wingesala amenso ya aba bantu baleke ukumona.” Nao Yawe aisala amenso yabo baleka ukumona ngefyo Elisha alombele.

english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.
translation: Elisha abeba ati, “Inshila ino teyo, no musumba uno teo. Twendeni munkonke, nalamutwala ku muntu mulefwaya.” Elyo abaleta ku Samaria.

english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”
translation: Natuleya ku mumana wa Yordani, ukwakuti cila umo aye temako icimuti icakukuulile iŋanda iyakuti tuleikalamo.”

english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “LORD, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.
translation: Panuma yakwingila mu musumba, Elisha alanda ati, “We Yawe, shi wingesula amenso ya aba bantu pakuti bambe ukumona.” Elyo Yawe abesula amenso bayamba ukumona. Elyo baishiba nokuti bali mu Samaria.

english: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”
translation: Ilyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yabamona, yaipusha Elisha aiti, “Bushe mbepaye mwe tata? Bushe mbepaye?”

english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”
translation: Elisha ayasuka ati, “Wibepaya, bushe kuti waipaya abantu abo wikete kale ku lupanga lobe na ku mufwi? Bapeeleko icakulya ubapeko na menshi pakuti balye no kunwa pakuti babwelelemo kuli shikulwibo.”

english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.
translation: Elyo abapekanishisha ifyakulya ifingi, na panuma yakupwisha ukulya no kunwa abeba no kuya, nabo babwelela kuli shikulwibo. Ne mpuka sha bashilika ba mu Aramu shaleka ukwisa mukulwisha abena Israeli mu calo cabo.

english: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
translation: Elyo papitile inshita, Beni Hadadi imfumu ya bena Aramu yalonganika ifita fyonse no kwima fyaya shinguluka umusumba wa Samaria.

english: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.
translation: Mwapona insala iyikalamba mu musumba, pantu ukushingulukwa kwaposele inshita iyitali icakutila umutwe wakwa kabalwe walashitwa indalama amashekeli amakumi cine konse konse aya silifa, no lukombo lumo ulwa matotoli ya nkunda indalama amashekeli yasano aya silifa.

english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
translation: Lilya imfumu ya bena Israeli ilepita lwapa cibumba ce linga lya musumba, umwanakashi umo amulilila ati, “Ngafweniko, kanabesa mwe mfumu.”

english: He said, “If the LORD doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”
translation: Imfumu yayasuka ati, “Nga Yawe akaana ukukwafwa, kuti ine nafumya kwi ifyakukwafwako? Bushe ni ku fili pa lubansa lwakutwilapo? Nangu ifili apakukamina umwangashi?”

english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’
translation: Elyo amwipusha ati, “Bwafya nshi ukwete?”

english: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”
translation: Kanshi efyo twaipike umwana wandi no kumulya. Ubushiku bwakonkelepo namweba nati, ‘Leta umwana obe pakuti tumulye,’ nomba ena nafisa umwana wakwe.”

english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”
translation: Umo pali bena asosa ati, “Bushe teti utemwe ukwisa pamo na babomfi bobe?”

english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yaumfwa amashiwi ya mwanakashi, yalepula insalu shabufumu. Cilya aleenda mumbali ye linga, abantu bamona ukuti mukati afwele insalu shabulanda pa mubili wakwe.

english: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”
translation: Elyo asosa ati, “Lekeni Lesa akancite ine icili conse mu bukali bwaciko, nga cakuti umutwe wakwa Elisha umwana mwaume wakwa Shafati uleba pa mabeya yakwe muli buno bushiku.”

english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”
translation: Nomba Elisha ninshi naikala mu ŋanda yakwe, na bakalamba ninshi nabekala nankwe. Imfumu yatangisha inkombe, nomba lintu inkombe tailafika, Elisha aeba abakalamba ati, “Bushe tamulemona uko ici cipondo catuma umuntu kukwisa mputulako umutwe? Moneni, nge nkombe yaisa, mwisaleko iciibi kabili mwikatishe pakuti cimwisalile. Bushe isho te nshindo shakwa shikulu wakwe shimukonkele panuma?”

english: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”
translation: Lintu acili alelanda nabo, inkombe yafika apo ali. Elyo imfumu yasosa aiti, “Ici cinkunka ca cipowe cafuma kuli Yawe. Cinshi ico nakulalolela kuli Yawe nakabili?”

english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.
translation: Aima aya nabo.

english: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”
translation: Lilya umo aletema icimuti, isembe lyasokoka lyaponena na mu menshi. Elyo akuuta ati, “Iye mwe mfumu yandi, lisembe lyakwashima.”

english: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa aipusha ati, “Liponene pesa?” Ilyo amulanga incende, Elisha akontola akamuti aposa pa ncende ine, ne sembe lyaibuka lyalaelela.

english: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.
translation: Amweba ati, “Limye.” Elyo umuntu atambika ukuboko kwakwe alibuula.

english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”
translation: Nomba imfumu ya bena Aramu yalelwisha abena Israeli. Panuma yakulandishanya na bacilolo ba fita, yalanda ati, “Nalacita inkambi pali ilya ncende na pali ilya.”

english: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa atuma amashiwi ku mfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “Ucenjele nganshi pakupita kuli ilya ncende pantu abena Aramu epo balekwikalila.”

english: Elisha said, “Hear the LORD’s word. The LORD says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”
translation: Lelo Elisha asosele ati, “Umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe. Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti, ‘Inshitafye nga ino ine mailo, icipimo cabunga bwa mukate bukalashitikwa pa ndalama shekeli umo, ne fipimo fibili ifya bale nafyo pa ndalama shekeli umo pa mpongolo ya mu Samaria.’”

english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”
translation: Kanshi epakuya bilikisha kuli bakalinda wa mpongolo ya musumba abati, “Twaciya ku nkambi ya bena Aramu elyo twasanga ukuti tamushele umuntu nelyo umo, nangu ciunda ca muntu kanofye bakabalwe na bapunda abakakilwe elyo na matenti yashelefye umo yabela.”

english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.
translation: Bakalinda wa mpongolo basalanganya amashiwi, kabili mukwangufyanya yafika na kwisano.

english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”
translation: Imfumu yabuuka ubushiku no kweba bacilolo aiti, “Nalamweba ico abena Aramu bacitile ifyo. Nabeshiba ukuti ifwe tuli ne cipowe, kanshi bafuminepofye pa nkambi nabaya belama mu mpanga, pantu batontonkenye ukuti cacine tuleisa fuma mu musumba pakuti bese batwikate abatuntulu elyo baye ingilamo.”

english: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”
translation: Cilolo umo ayasuka ati, “Salenipo abaume bamo basendepo bakabalwe basano pa bashelepo mu musumba. Apo aba abashelepo bali nokuculafye mu musango umo wine ngo wa bantu bonse abaloba kale, eico natubatume baye shininkisha ificitike.”

english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
translation: Kanshi epakusala amaceleta yabili na bakabalwe bayako, ne mfumu yabatuma kukukonka ifita fya bena Aramu. Yakonkomesha bakensha wa maceleta ukuti, “Kabiyeni muye fwailisha ificitike.”

english: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.
translation: Nabo bakonka ukuya shinta na ku mumana wa Yordani, kabili basanga ukuti umusebo onse nabaponaishamo ifyakufwala ne fipe ifyo abena Aramu baleposa pakubutuka. Kanshi inkombe epakubwela no kwisa eba imfumu.

english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse baima baya tapa ifipe mu nkambi ya bena Aramu. Kanshi icipimo ca bunga bwa mikate calashitwa pa ndalama shekeli umo, ne fipimo fibili ifya bale nafyo pa ndalama shekeli umo, ngefyo shiwi lyakwa Yawe lyalandile.

english: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.
translation: Nomba imfumu yabikile cilolo ulya yashintilishe pa kuboko kwakwe ukuba umukalamba wa pa mpongolo. Elyo abantu pakupita baisa munyantaula mpaka afwa, ukulingana nefyo umuntu wakwa Lesa asobele ilyo imfumu yaile ku ŋanda kumwakwe.

english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”
translation: Na mu cine, cacitike umo umuntu wakwa Lesa aebele imfumu ati, “Mailo pa nshita nga ino ine, icipimo ca bunga bwa mikate bukalashitikwa pa ndalama shekeli umo, ne fipimo fibili ifya bale nafyo pa ndalama shekeli umo pa mpongolo ya mu Samaria.”

english: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”
translation: Cilolo aebele umuntu wakwa Lesa ati, “Mona, nangufye Yawe engesulako iminshi yonse iya ku mulu, bushe iwe ico walanda kuti cacitika?” Umuntu wakwa Lesa ayaswike ati, “Uli nokuimwena na menso yobe, lelo tauli nakulyako nangu cimo.”

english: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”
translation: Cilolo uyo imfumu yashintililepo ukuboko aeba umuntu wakwa Lesa ati, “Mona, nangufye Yawe engesulako iminshi ya ku mulu, bushe ico ulelanda kuti cacitika?”

english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.
translation: Kabili ifi fine efyacitike kuli ena, pantu abantu bamunyantawilile pa mwinshi wa mpongolo, epo afwila.

english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
translation: Nomba kwali abantu abaume bane abakwete ifibashi pa mpongolo yakwingilila mu musumba. Balandishanya abati, “Cinshi ico twakulaikalila pano mpaka ukufwa?

english: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”
translation: Nga twati, ‘Natuleya mu musumba,’ icipowe emo cili, ninshi tuli nokufwa. Kabili nga twati, ‘Natwikale muno’ namo mwine tuli nokufwa. Kanshi ifwe natuleyafye ku nkambi ya bena Aramu no kuya cimba. Nga batulekako, tatwafwe. Nga batwipaya ninshi kufwafye.”

english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.
translation: Cilya akasuba kawa, baima baya na ku nkambi ya bena Aramu. Ilyo bafika ku mpela ya nkambi, basanga ukuti takuli umuntu nangu umo.

english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”
translation: Ici cacitike pa mulandu wakuti Yawe alilengele abena Aramu ukumfwa iciunda ca maceleta na bakabalwe elyo no mulongo uukalamba uwa fita, icalengele nokuti balande cila umo ku mubiye abati, “Moneni, imfumu ya bena Israeli nailomba imfumu sha bena Hiti na bena Egupto ukwisa tulwisha.”

english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
translation: Kanshi epakwima no kubutuka mu nshita ya cungulo icakuti basha amatenti pamo na bakabalwe elyo na bapunda. Bashe inkambi umo yabela, bafulumuka pakupusushako ubumi bwabo.

english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.
translation: Abaume bafibashi bafika pa mpela ya nkambi, baingila na mwitenti limo. Balya no kunwa ifyo basangilemo, basendamo silifa, golide ne fyakufwala elyo baya fifisa. Babwela baisa ingilila mwitenti limbi, namo basendamo ifintu, nafyo baya fisa.

english: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”
translation: Elyo balandishanya abati, “Ifi tulecita tefisuma iyoo. Buno bushiku bwa lyashi ilisuma nganshi nomba nifwefye fweka tulisungilile. Nga cakuti twaikala mpaka bwaisaca bali nokutukanda. Natuleyafye nombaline mukwishibisha aba kwisano.”

english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for the LORD has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”
translation: Nomba Elisha alyebele umwanakashi ulya apepele umwana ukubuuka ku bafwa ati, “Fuma muno, kabiye no lupwa lobe no kuya ikala konse uko wingafwaya pa kashita akalinga, pantu Yawe alatuma icipowe muli cino calo icili nokupwa imyaka cine lubali.”

english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die.”
translation: Elisha ayasuka ati, “Kabiye kamwebe utile, ‘Cacine uli nokupola.’ Lelo Yawe nansokolwela ukuti ena ali nokufwa.”

english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.
translation: Elyo Elisha atontafye amenso pamo pene ne mpumi yakwe yakashika mpakafye Hasaeli aumfwa insoni. Elyo umuntu wakwa Lesa atampa ukulila.

english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”
translation: Hasaeli aipusha ati, “Cinshi ico we shikulu watampila ukulila?”

english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”
translation: Hasaeli asosa ati, “Nga ine ne mubomfi obe, ne mbwafye, kuti nacita shani icintu cakula mu musango uyo?”

english: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”
translation: Elyo Hasaeli afuma pali Elisha abwelela kuli shikulu wakwe. Ilyo Beni Hadadi aipusha ati, “Finshi Elisha akwebele?” Hasaeli ayasuka ati, “Acinjeba ukuti mu cacine uli nokupola.”

english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.
translation: Isham 19:15

english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga isano uwakwa Yoramu umwana mwaume wakwa Ahabu ilyo ali imfumu ya bena Israeli, Yehoshafati nao ewali imfumu ya Bena Yuda. Elyo Yehoramu umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoshafati ewamupyene pa bufumu bwa bena Yuda.

english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
translation: Ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu na ibili (32) ilyo aishileba imfumu, kabili aikele pa bufumu imyaka cine konse konse mu Yerusalemu.

english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
translation: Aendele mu nshila shaleendamo imfumu shonse isha bena Israeli ngefyo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Ahabu bacitile, pantu na mu kuupa kwakwe aupile umwana wakwa Ahabu. Acitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: However, the LORD would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.
translation: Lelo Yawe tafwaile ukonaula abena Yuda pa mulandu wa mubomfi wakwe Davidi. Yawe alilaile ukumusungila icengelo pamo na bana bakwe umushinsanshiku.

english: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.
translation: Umwanakashi acitile ukulingana nefyo umuntu wakwa Lesa amwebele. Ena no lupwa lwakwe bafuma baya ikala mu calo ca Bafilisiti pa myaka cine lubali.

english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
translation: Mu nshita shakwa Yehoramu, abena Edomu basangukile ubufumu bwa bena Yuda no kuikwatila imfumu yabo abene.

english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
translation: Kanshi Yehoramu epakuya kuli Sairi asenda na maceleta yonse. Abena Edomu bamushinguluka pamo ne fita fikalamba ifya maceleta, nomba mu nshita ya bushiku Yehoramu aima ailwishisha inshila yakupusukilamo lelo abashilika bakwe bena babutuka babwelela kumwabo.

english: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
translation: Ukushinta ne lelo abena Edomu baikala abasangukila abena Yuda. Abena Libina nabo bapondweke pa nshita imo ine.

english: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translation: Palwa fintu fimbi ifya pa bufumu bwakwa Yehoramu, na fyonse ifyo acitile, bushe tafyalembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya shamfumu sha bena Yuda?

english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
translation: Yehoramu asuka afwa no kuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Bamushiika pamo nabo mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Kabili Ahasia umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na ibili (12) uwakwa Yoramu umwana wakwa Ahabu imfumu ya bena Israeli, Ahasia umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoramu imfumu ya bena Yuda ewatendeke ukuteeka.

english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
translation: Ahasia ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na ibili (22) ilyo ayambile ukuteeka pa bufumu. Kabili ateekele pa bufumu umwaka umo mu musumba wa Yerusalemu. Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Ataliya, umwanakashi umwishikulu wakwa Omuri imfumu ya mu Israeli.

english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.
translation: Akonkelele imicitile ya ba mu ŋanda yakwa Ahabu no kucita ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe ngefyo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Ahabu bacitile, pantu ali ni shifyala wakwa Ahabu.

english: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
translation: Ahasia aya ku nkondo pamo na Yoramu umwana mwaume wakwa Ahabu mukulwisha Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu ku Ramoti Gileadi. Abena Aramu bacena Yoramu.

english: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Yoramu epakubwelela ku Yesireli mukundapwa ifilonda abena Aramu bamucenene ku Ramoti lintu balelwa na Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu.

english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.
translation: Panuma ya myaka cine lubali abwelele ukufuma ku calo ca Bafilisiti elyo aya ku mfumu no kwipusha pakuti bamubweseshe iŋanda ne bala lyakwe.

english: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”
translation: Nomba imfumu yalelanda kuli Gehasi, umubomfi wa muntu wakwa Lesa, kabili yalemweba aiti, “Njeba palwa fintu fyonse ifikulu ifyo Elisha acita.”

english: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”
translation: Ilyo Gehasi acili alelondolwela imfumu ifyo Elisha abushishe umuntu ukufuma ku bafwa, umwanakashi umwine wa mwana ulya Elisha abushishe ukufuma ku bafwa afika mukulomba ku mfumu ukumubweshesha iŋanda ne bala lyakwe.

english: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”
translation: Imfumu yaipusha umwanakashi pali ifi, nao alondolola.

english: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”
translation: Elisha aile ku Damasiko, kabili pa nshita ilya Beni Hadadi imfumu ya ku Aramu ali umulwele. Ilyo baeba imfumu ukuti, “Umuntu wakwa Lesa naenda ukwisa fika kuno,”

english: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”
translation: Isham 4:8-37

english: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”
translation: Hasaeli aima aya mukukumanya Elisha, nasenda mu minwe yakwe nge cabupe ifipe ifyakusenda ingamila amakumi yane (40) ifintu ifikankala fyonse ifya mu Damasiko. Aingila no kuya iminina pa cinso cakwa Elisha no kusosa ati, “Umwana obe Beni Hadadi imfumu ya ku Aramu nantuma ukwisa ipusha ukuti, ‘Bushe ine ndi nokupola ukufuma kuli ubu bulwele?’”

english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.
translation: Kasesema Elisha aitile umuntu umo ukufuma pa mpuka ya bakasesema nokumweba ati, “Kaka umushipi pa cakufwala, usende umusukupala wa mafuta uye ku Ramoti Gileadi.

english: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.
translation: Nomba Yesebele ena, imbwa eshili nokumulya mu ncende ilya iya mu Yesireli, kabili takwakabe no wakumushiika.’” Elyo aisulako iciibi abutuka no lubilo.

english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”
translation: Ilyo Yehu afuma abwelela kuli bacilolo banankwe aba fita, umo pali bena aipusha ati, “Bushe ifintu fili bwino? Cinshi lilye shilu lyacilafwaya kuli iwe?”

english: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘The LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”
translation: Bonse bayasuka abati, “Ubo bufi, iwe twebefye icishinka.”

english: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”
translation: Ukwabula ukuposa inshita, babula imingila yabo bayansa pa makasa yakwe pa matabo pene. Elyo balisha ipenga bapunda nokuti, “Yehu e mfumu.”

english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;
translation: Kanshi Yehu umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoshafati, umwishikulu wakwa Nimushi, alipangila Yoramu. Nomba Yoramu na bena Israeli bonse ninshi balecingilila Ramoti Gileadi kuli Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu,

english: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”
translation: lelo imfumu Yoramu yalibwelele ku Yesireli kukundapwa ifilonda abena Aramu bamucenene mu nkondo balelwa na Hasaeli imfumu ya bena Aramu.

english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.
translation: Isham 19:16

english: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”
translation: Ilyo malonda uwali pamulu we linga lya mu Yesireli amona ifita fyakwa Yehu fileisa, akuuta aiti, “Namona ifita fileisa.”

english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”
translation: Umushilika wa pali kabalwe epakuya kumanya Yehu, amweba ati, “Ifi efyo imfumu yalanda ukuti, ‘Bushe waisa mu cibote?’”

english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatuma umuntu wacibili uwa pali kabalwe. Nao aya bakumanya, abeba ati, “Imfumu yasosa aiti, ‘Bushe waisa mu cibote?’” Yehu ayasuka ati, “Bushe mulandu obe nga cakuti takuli mutende? Ingila kunuma ya mu mulongo wandi.”

english: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.
translation: Ilyo uleya fika kulya uye ufwaye ukuli Yehu, mwana umwaume wakwa Yehoshafati, mwana Nimushi. Uye kuli ena, uye umufumye pa banankwe uye mwingisha mu muputule wa mukati.

english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”
translation: Nakabili malonda asosa ati, “Inkombe naiya fika, nomba tailebweluluka nayo ine. Imyendele ili kwati yakwa Yehu mwana Nimushi pantu aleenda kwati lishilu.”
