english: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.
translation: Yoramu apeela icipope ati, “Pekanyeni iceleta lyandi.” Elyo panuma yakupekanya, Yoramu imfumu ya mu Israeli elyo na Ahasia imfumu ya bena Yuda banina mu maceleta bafuma cila umo mwiceleta lyakwe, baya mukukumanya Yehu. Baya mukumanya pa ncende apali ibala lyakwa Naboti umwina Yesireli.

english: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”
translation: Ilyo Yoramu amona Yehu amwipusha ati, “Bushe waisa mu cibote Yehu?”

english: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”
translation: Isham 21:23

english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
translation: Elyo Yehu abuula ubuta no kulasa umufwi pakati ka mabeya yakwa Yoramu. Umufwi waya lasa mu mutima, aponena na panshi mwiceleta lyakwe.

english: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden on him:
translation: Yehu aeba Bidika, cilolo wakwe uwe celeta ati, “Mwimye uye umupose mwibala lilya ilyali lyakwa Naboti umwina Yesireli. Wibukishe ifyo iwe na ine twaleensha amaceleta panuma yakwa Ahabu wishi ilyo Yawe apeele ubusesemo ubu palwa ena.

english: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to the LORD’s word.”
translation: Yawe alanda ukuti, ‘Ubushiku bwafumineko ubwa mailo, namwene umulopa wakwa Naboti no mulopa wa bana bakwe abaume. Eico na ine nkamona ukuti nkaulandwila pali lino line ibala.’ Eico nomba mwimye uye umupose pali ilya ine ncende ukulingana ne shiwi lyakwa Yawe.”

english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.
translation: Ilyo Ahasia imfumu ya bena Yuda amona ifyacitika, abutuka akonka umusebo waya ku Beti Hagani. Yehu amukunkunika, alepunda ati, “Mwipayeni nao wine.” Bamucena mukati ke celeta lyakwe ninshi ali mukuya ku Suri mupepi na ku Ibileamu, lelo abutukila ku Megido eko aya fwila.

english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.
translation: Ababomfi bakwe bamusendela mwiceleta ku Yerusalemu no kuya mushiika pamo ne fikolwe fyakwe mu nshinshi yakwe mu musumba wakwa Davidi.

english: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na umo (11) uwa bufumu bwakwa Yoramu mwana Ahabu, elyo Ahasia atendeka ukuba imfumu ya bena Yuda.

english: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘The LORD says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”
translation: “Elyo uye ubuule umusukupala uminsulwile amafuta pa mutwe wakwe elyo ulande auti, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, nakusuba ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli.’ Elyo wisuleko iciibi ufume nokubutuka, wishingashinga.”

english: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.
translation: Elyo Yehu aile ku Yesireli. Ilyo Yesebele aumfwa palwa ifi, apenta pa menso yakwe, awamya imishishi yakwe, elyo afumya umutwe pa windo.

english: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”
translation: Lilya Yehu aingila pa mpongolo, uyu mwanakashi aipusha ati, “Bushe waisa mu cibote, Simuri we wakomene sokulu?”

english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
translation: Yehu ainwina umutwe ku windo elyo abilikisha ati, “Bushe uuli ku lubali lwandi ni nani?” Elyo bamutungwi babili nangu batatu bamulolesha.

english: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.
translation: Elyo asosa ati, “Muposeni panshi.” Nabo bamuposa panshi, no mulopa wakwe wasabukila ku cibumba na kuli bakabalwe lintu balemunyantaula panshi.

english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”
translation: Yehu aingila mu ŋanda alya no kunwa anwa. Elyo asosa ati, “Sungeni uyo mwanakashi watipwa, elyo no kumushiika pantu ali mwana wa mfumu.”

english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
translation: Lelo ilyo baile kukumushiika, basanga tapali icitumbi. Pashelefye icipanga, amakasa elyo ne minwe.

english: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,
translation: Babwelelamo mukuya eba Yehu, nao atila, “Ili lishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyo alandile mu mubomfi wakwe Eliya umwina Tishibe ilyakuti pa mushili wa ncende ya ku Yesireli epo imbwa shikalila umubili wakwa Yesebele.

english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”
translation: Umubili wakwa Yesebele ukaba kwati ni citindi pa mushili wa ncende ya mu Yesireli, pakuti pekaba nelyo umo uwakumwishiba ukuti, ‘Uyu ni Yesebele.’”

english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.
translation: Kanshi umulumendo kasesema epakuya ku Ramoti Gileadi.

english: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”
translation: Ilyo afika, asanga abashilika nabekala pamo. Asosa ati, “Ninkwata amashiwi aya pali iwe we mukalamba wa fita fya nkondo.”

english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.
translation: Yehu aima aya ingila mu ŋanda. Elyo kasesema aminsulwila amafuta pa mutwe wakwa Yehu, alanda nokuti, “Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, asosa ati, ‘Nakusuba ukuba imfumu pa bantu bakwa Yawe abena Israeli.

english: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
translation: Uli nokulofya iŋanda yakwa Ahabu sokulu, pakuti nkalandule pa umulopa wa babomfi bandi bakasesema na pa mulopa wa babomfi bonse abakwa Yawe abo Yesebele aipeye.

english: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
translation: Iŋanda yonse iyakwa Ahabu ili nokuloba. Ndi nokuputula ukufumya kuli Ahabu umwana mwaume onse uwalekeleshako mu bena Israeli, umusha nangu umuntungwa.

english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.
translation: Ndi nokulenga iŋanda yakwa Ahabu ukuba nge ŋanda yakwa Yeroboamu umwana mwaume wakwa Nebati, kabili nge yakwa Baasha umwana mwaume wakwa Ahiya.

english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
translation: Ine Simoni Petelo, musha kabili umusole wakwa Yesu Kristu, namulembela imwe mwebo pamo nga ifwe mwalipokelela icisumino icacindama pa mulandu wa bololoke bwakwa Lesa wesu kabili Umupusushi wesu Yesu Kristu.

english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, mulekalabana pakulanga ukuti ni Lesa ewamwita kabili ewamusala. Pantu nga mwalacita ifyo ninshi tamwakawe mu cisumino cenu.

english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
translation: Elyo ninshi lyena mukapeelwa insambu shonse shakwingila mu Bufumu bwakubelelela ubwa Mfumu yesu kabili Umupusushi wesu Yesu Kristu.

english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
translation: Eico nakulamwibukishako ifi fintu, nangu kwena mwafishiba kale no kusumina pa maka mu cishinka mwafundilwe.

english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
translation: Ine ndetontonkanya ukuti, inshiku shonse njikala mu nsakwe iyi ya pano icalo, umubili wandi, nacilinga ukuti ndemwibukishako pali ifi fintu.

english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
translation: Pantu ine ninjishiba ukuti nalaswa mfume mu nsakwe iyi iya pano calo, efyo Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu yansokolwela.

english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
translation: Kanshi ndi nokwesha nganshi ukuti nga nafwa mukaleibukisha ifi ifintu inshita yonse.

english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
translation: Ifwe ilyo twamushimikile pa kwisa ukwamaka ukwa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu tatwabomfeshe imilumbe iyakwelenganyafye iyoo. Ifwe twaliimwenene na menso yesu ubucindami bwakwe.

english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
translation: Ifwe epo twali ilyo Lesa Wishi alemulumbanya no kumucindika. Ishiwi lyafumine kuli Lesa umwine bucindami aliti, “Uyu e mwana wandi, uo natemwa, uo nsekelamo.”

english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
translation: Ifwe fwe bene nifwe twaumfwile ili shiwi lilefuma ku mulu ilyo twali nankwe pa lupili lwamushilo.

english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
translation: Icikuuku cakwa Lesa no mutende wakwe fileba na imwe umupwilapo pali ico mwaishiba Lesa na Yesu Imfumu yesu.

english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
translation: Icakwibukisha pali fyonse nici icakuti, tapaba nangu umo uwingalondolola umwine amashiwi ya bakasesema ayaba mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
translation: Pantu bakasesema tabaitendekefye abene pakulanda ayo mashiwi, lelo ni Mupashi Wamushilo ewalengele ukuti balande aya mashiwi yafumine kuli Lesa.

english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
translation: Lesa ku maka yakwe alitupeela fyonse ifyakutwafwako ukwikala nga bantu bakwe icine cine. Atwita ku bucindami bwakwe na ku busuma bwakwe pali ico twalimwishiba.

english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
translation: Ni ku bucindami bwakwe no busuma bwakwe eco atupeelela ifyabupe ifikankala ifyacindamisha nganshi ifyo atulaile. Pakuti kuli ifi fyabupe mumone ukukuma kuli Bulesa bwakwe, mupusuke na ku konaika kwa bantu ba pano calo ku mulandu wa lunkumbwa lubi.

english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
translation: Eico kanshi na imwe muli nokubombesha, ku cisumino cenu mulundeko imibeele isuma, elyo ku mibeele isuma mulundeko ukwishiba Lesa.

english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
translation: Elyo kukwishiba Lesa, mulundeko ukutekanya, kukutekanya nako mulundeko umukoosha. Elyo ku mukoosha nako mulundeko ubwina Lesa.

english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
translation: Ku bwina Lesa, mulundeko icitemwiko cabwananyina. Elyo ku citemwiko cabwananyina, mulundeko icitemwiko cakutemwa abantufye bonse.

english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Iyi e mibeele muli nokukwata. Nga mwakwata iyi imibeele kabili yalalundulukilako, lyena mukapambana no kumwenamo ukwishiba Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
translation: Lelo umuntu onse uushakwata iyi mibeele, wena ni mpofu, ni ndoleshapepi, kabili alilaba nokuti alisangulwilwe ku fyabubifi fyakwe ifyakale.

english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
translation: Na kale line pa bantu ba mu Israeli epo bali bakasesema babufi. Epamo na pali imwe bene bakabapo bakafundisha babufi. Bakalamufunda amafundisho yabufi, ayakumonaula ukwabula ukuti mwishibe. Elyo bakakaana no kusumina Imfumu iyabalubwile, na mukucita ifyo, bakailetelela ukonaulwafye bwangu bwangu.

english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
translation: Palibufi Lesa akakanda abantu abakonkelela ulunkumbwa lwabo lubi no kusuula amaka yakwa Lesa.

english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
translation: Nangu ni bamalaika bene, abacilapo nganshi kukukosa na maka pali bakafundisha babufi, tababakwatila musaalula pakubebelela pa cinso ca Mfumu.

english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
translation: Aba bakafundisha babufi balanda no musaalula pa fintu ifyo bashishibe. Baba kwati ni nama sha mpanga ishishaishiba ico shilecita. Shena shifyalwafye pakuti shikatwe no kwipaiwa. Naba bakafundisha babufi bakonaulwafye kwati ni nama sha mpanga.

english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
translation: Bakacula pa mulandu wakucusha bambi. Bena insansa shabo kucita ifyakusansamusha imibili yabo pa lwalala. Baba kwati matoni ya fiko ayaleta insoni, pantu ilyo muli nabo pakulya, bena basansamukila mukucita ifyakumubepaika.

english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
translation: Amenso yabo yabafye pa banakashi bakubembuka nabo. Baba no lunkumbwa ulushinaka ukufwaya ukubifya. Basembeleka abantu bashakosa pakuti babifye. Imitima yabo yateekwa no lunkumbwa. Aba bantu Lesa alibatipwila.

english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
translation: Balisha inshila yacishinka no kuluba baliluba. Bakonka inshila yakonkele Balamu mwana Beori, uwatemenwe ukumwenamo indalama mukucita icilubo.

english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
translation: Lelo asukile akalipilwa pa cilubo cakwe. Punda wakwe inama iyishilanda, alandile ne shiwi lya muntu, alesha kasesema Balamu ukulacita ifyabuwelewele.

english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
translation: Aba bakafundisha babufi baba kwati tumfukumfuku twa menshi utwakama, kwati makumbi ayaleululwa ne cikuuku ca mwela. Ala Lesa alibapekanishisha icifulo camfifi.

english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
translation: Pantu aba bantu pakuitasha balanda amashiwi yaciwelewele, kabili babomfya ulunkumbwa lubi ulwa mubili pakusembelela abantu abo batampilefye ukupusuka ku bantu abekala mu cilubo.

english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
translation: Babalaya ukuba abantungwa, nomba abene bena bacili abasha ba misango yabo iyakubonaula, pantu umuntu musha wa ico conse icamucimfya.

english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
translation: Abengi bakakonka imisango yabo iyabupulumushi, elyo na mukucita ifyo cikalenga bamo ukulasuula inshila yacishinka.

english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
translation: Ukwishiba Imfumu yesu kabili Umupusushi wesu Yesu Kristu kwalipususha abantu ku fibi fya pano isonde. Nomba umwine nga aitwalako, ne fibi fyamucimfya, abantu ba uyo musango baba nomba mu mibeele iyabipisha ukucila ilyo batampile ukwishiba Yesu Kristu.

english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
translation: Kuli aba bantu bena, nga caweme ukukanaishiba nelyo panono ifyakuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, ukucila ukuti ilyo baishiba, elyo bayalukila ifunde lyamushilo bapeelwe.

english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
translation: Ifyo bacita filanga ukuti aya mapinda yacishinka ayatila “Imbwa ibwelela ku malushi yaciluka,” ne litila, “Inkumba basamba, ibwelela kukwalangana mu matipa.”

english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
translation: Aba bakafundisha babufi pa mulandu wakuba no lunkumbwa lwa fyuma, bakalamucenjesha pa fyuma fyenu mukulamufunda ifyabufi. Nomba kaputula wa milandu yabo apingula kale ukubakanda, no wakubonaula alolafye lyonse alebalindila.

english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
translation: Ilyo bamalaika babifishe, Lesa tabapanishe nakalya. Lelo abaposele mu cifungo no kubakakila mu cifulo umwafiita fititi, emo abakakila balelolela Ubushiku bwabupingushi.

english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
translation: Lesa tapanishe na bantu ba cino calo aba pakale, lelo aletele ilyeshi pa bantu ababi abali pa calo. Abo Lesa apuswishe, ni Noa umuntu uwaleeba abantu ifyo bali nokuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, elyo na bantu bambi cine lubali.

english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
translation: Lesa apingwilile ne misumba ya Sodoma na Gomora ukonaika, iyo aocele ku mulilo, yapya nakalya nakalya. Acitile ifyo ku misumba pakuti ibe icilangililo cafyo akacita ku bantu ababi.

english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
translation: Lesa apuswishe umuntu umololoke Loti. Loti ena imisango yabupulumushi iya bantu ababi yalemuletela ubulanda.

english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
translation: Uyu muntu umololoke Loti aleikala nabo, kanshi cila bushiku alecula nganshi mu mutima wakwe uusuma, ilyo alemona no kumfwa ifintu ifibi ifyo balecita.

english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
translation: Kanshi Imfumu yalishiba ukupususha abantu abapetamina Lesa mu mafya yabo. Kabili yalishiba no kusunga abantu babi abali nokukandwa pa Bushiku bwabupingushi.

english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi, uyu e kalata wabubili namulembela. Mu makalata aya yonse yabili ndemwibukishako ifi fintu pakuti muleba na matontonkanyo yasuma.

english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
translation: Lelo Ubushiku bwa Mfumu bukesa kwati mupupu. Pali ubo Bushiku imyulu ikapita ne congo icikalamba, ifyaba mu mulu fikapya ku mulilo fikonaike, elyo icalo na fyonse ifyabapo fikapya.

english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
translation: Icite 7:11

english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
translation: Kanshi ilyo mulelolela Ubushiku bwakwa Lesa, mulecita ifyakuti bwaca bwangu. Pali ubu Bushiku imyulu ikonaika ku mulilo ne fyaba mu mulu fikasunguluka kukukaba kwa mulilo.

english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
translation: Lelo ifwe tulolela ifintu Lesa alaya, emukuti imyulu ipya ne calo cipya umo bonse bakalacita ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
translation: Eico kanshi mwe batemwikwa bandi, ilyo mulelolela ifi fintu, mulebomba na maka yenu yonse ukuba abakaele, ababula icilubo, kabili abekala mu mutende na Lesa.

english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
translation: Mulemona iyi nshita Imfumu yesu iletekela abantu umutima, e nshita ye pusukilo. Paulo munyinefwe uo twatemwa, mukubomfya amano Lesa amupeele nao efyo amulembele.

english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
translation: Ifi fine efyo alanda mu makalata yakwe yonse, ilyo alemba pali uyu mulandu. Mu makalata yakwa Paulo mwaliba ifintu fimo ifyayafya ukumfwa. Abantu abashasambilila kabili abashakosa mu cisumino balayonaula abene ilyo balufyanya ukufilondolola, nga filya balufyanya ukulondolola ifipande fimbi ifya Malembo Yamushilo.

english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi, imwe ifi fintu balimusokako kale. Kanshi mulecenjela, mwileka ifilubo fya aba bantu babi fimusensenune mufume na mu cishinka mwashintililamo.

english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
translation: Yuda 18

english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
translation: Ndefwaya muleibukisha amashiwi bakasesema bamushilo balandile kale na mafunde ya Mfumu kabili Umupusushi ayo abasole benu bamupeele.

english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
translation: Icapakubala ico muli nokwishiba nici icakuti mu nshiku shakupelekeshako kukesa abantu bamo abakalakonkelelafye ulunkumbwa lwabo lubi, bakalamuseka no kumuseka.

english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
translation: Bakalasosa abati, “Bushe talaya ukuti akabwela? Nga ali kwi? Bashifwe bafwa kale, lelo ukufumafye apo icalo cabumbilwe ifintu fyonse fyabafye umo fyabeela.”

english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
translation: Aba bantu baba no mufulo, tabafwayafye kwibukisha ukuti Lesa kalefye alengele imyulu kwishiwi lyakwe. Lesa abumbile icalo ku menshi no kucifumya mu menshi.

english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
translation: Icite 1:6-9

english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
translation: Lelo ishiwi limo line elisunga imyulu ne calo ifilipo nomba, pakuti fikese pya ku mulilo. Lesa akafisunga mpaka no bushiku bwabupingushi ilyo abantu ababi bakonaulwa.

english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi tamuli nakulaba ici cintu cimo. Pa cinso ca Mfumu ubushiku bumo bwaba kwati myaka ikana limo, ne myaka ikana limo yaba kwati bushiku bumo.

english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
translation: Abantu bamo batontonkanya ukuti Imfumu ilashingashinga pakufikilisha ifyo yalaya. Imwe kwena ilamutekela umutima, pantu taifwaya ukuti nelyo umo akalobelele, lelo ifwaya ukuti bonse balapile no kupilibuka.

english: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyonse fyapitile, imfumu ya bena Amoni yafwa, elyo umwana waiko Hanuni apyana wishi pa bufumu.

english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.
translation: Ifita fimbi ifyashala apeela mu maboko yakwa munyina Abishai kukufyangalila. Kabili afitantika ukulungamana na bena Amoni.

english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
translation: Elyo Yoabu asosa ati, “Nga cakuti abena Aramu bancila amaka, awe lyena uli nokwisafye mukumpokololako. Lelo nga cakuti abena Amoni bakucila amaka, elyo ndi nokwisa mukukupokololako.

english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”
translation: Natube abakosa kabili abashangila pakuti tulwileko na maka abantu besu pamo ne misumba yakwa Lesa wesu. Shi Yawe nacitepo icilewama mu menso yakwe.”

english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
translation: Kanshi Yoabu na bashilika ali nabo bafuma mukulwisha abena Aramu, awe nabo bafulumuka ukufuma pantanshi yabo.

english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.
translation: Cilya abena Amoni bamona ukuti abena Aramu balafulumuka, nabo bene bafulumuka pa cinso cakwa Abishai, kabili baya ingila na mu musumba. Kanshi Yoabu epakubwela ukufuma kukulwisha abena Amoni, baisa na ku Yerusalemu.

english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.
translation: Panuma ilyo abena Aramu bamwene ukuti babacimfya ku bena Israeli, balonganika ifita nakabili.

english: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
translation: Hadadesa aita abena Aramu abaleta ukufuma kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate. Baya ku Helamu, na Shobaki umukalamba wa fita fyakwa Hadadesa ewalebatungulula.

english: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.
translation: Ilyo Davidi bamwebele pali ici, alongenye abena Israeli bonse, bayabuka Yordani no kuya ku Helamu. Abena Aramu batantamika imilongo ya fita fyabo mukukumanya Davidi mu bulwi, bayamba no kumulwisha.

english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.
translation: Lelo abena Aramu bafulumuka pantanshi ya bena Israeli. Kabili Davidi nao epakwipaya abali pa maceleta yabo imyanda cine lubali (700) elyo ifita fyabo ifya pa makasa amakana amakumi yane (40,000). Kabili bacena Shobaki umukalamba wa fita fya nkondo, nao afwila na palya pene.

english: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.
translation: Ilyo imfumu shonse ishali ishinono kuli Hadadesa shamona ukuti nabacimfiwa ku bena Israeli, bapanga umutende na bena Israeli mukuba ababomfi babo. Eico abena Aramu baletiina ukulayafwako abena Amoni nakabili.

english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
translation: Elyo Davidi atontonkanya ati, “Kanange uluse kuli Hanuni umwana wakwa Nahashi pamo ngefyo wishi na ena alangile uluse kuli ine.” Kanshi Davidi epakutuma inkombe kuli Hanuni kukulanga icililishi cakuloosha wishi.

english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”
translation: bacilolo ba bena Amoni basosa kuli Hanuni abati, “Bushe muletontonkanya ukuti Davidi alecindika wiso mukutuma abantu bakwe kuli imwe mukulanga icililishi cakuloosha? Bushe Davidi tabatuminefye mukulengula umusumba no kufwailisha bwino pakuti bakese tulwisha no kuupoka?”

english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
translation: Kanshi Hanuni epakwikata abantu bakwa Davidi, ababeya lubali citika wa myefu, aputula na malaya yabo pakati pa matako no kubabweseshamo.

english: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
translation: Ilyo Davidi bamwebele pa fyacitike, atumine inkombe shakuya bakumanya, pantu abantu bakwa Davidi balilengelwe insoni nganshi. Imfumu epakusosa aiti, “Ikalenifye ku Yeriko mpaka imyefu yenu ikakule elyo mukabwele.”

english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.
translation: Ilyo abena Amoni bamona ukuti nabaleta ulupato pakati kabo na Davidi, bayashima ifita fya pa nkasa amakana amakumi yabili (20,000) ku bena Aramu ukufuma ku Beti Rehobu na ku Soba, elyo ne mfumu ya ku Maaka na bantu ikana limo (1,000), elyo nakabili na bantu amakana ikumi limo na yabili (12,000) ukufuma ku Tobi.

english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
translation: Ilyo Davidi aumfwa ifi, Davidi atumako Yoabu ne fita fyonse ifya baume babulwi ababulamba.

english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.
translation: Abena Amoni nabo epakufuma mu nkambi no kutantama mu mpuka shakulwilamo pa mpongolo ya musumba wabo. Lelo abena Aramu ba ku Soba na ku Rehobu na bantu ba ku Tobi elyo na Maaka, bena balifye abene beka mu mpanga pa lwalala.

english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.
translation: Ilyo Yoabu amona ukuti kuli imilongo yabulwi kuntanshi elyo na ku numa yakwe, asalapo fimo ifita ifyacenjela nganshi mu Israeli no kufitantamika ukulungamana na bena Aramu.

english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.
translation: Kabili pakwaluka kwa mwaka pa nshita ilya imfumu shifuma ukuya ku nkondo, Davidi atumine Yoabu pamo na bacilolo bakwe elyo ne fita fyonse ifya bena Israeli. Nabo baya ipaulula abena Amoni no kupokolola umusumba onse uwa Raba. Lelo Davidi wena ninshi nashala mu Yerusalemu.

english: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”
translation: Ilyo Davidi aumfwa ukuti Uria taciya ku ŋanda, amwipusha ati, “Bushe taufumine pa lwendo ulutali? Cinshi ico tawailile ku ŋanda?”

english: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”
translation: Uria atile kuli Davidi, “Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, abena Israeli elyo na bena Yuda bonse bekala mu matenti. Kabili shikulu Yoabu elyo na babomfi bakwa shikulu nabo bacita inkambi mu mpanga, pa lwalala. Nga ine kuti naya shani ku ŋanda yandi kukulya, kukunwa elyo no kulala no mukashi wandi? Icine cine apo iwe uli no bumi, teti ncite icintu ica musango ngoyu!”

english: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.
translation: Elyo Davidi atila kuli ena, “Cisuma ikala pano pene ubushiku bwa lelofye, mailo nkakuleka ukubwelelamo.” Kanshi Uria epakushala mu Yerusalemu pali bulya bushiku elyo nobwakonkelepo.

english: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.
translation: Elyo Davidi aita Uria kukulya no kunwa nankwe, amulenga no kukolwa. Lelo mu cungulo Uria aya mukusendama pa butanda bwakwe pamo na babomfi bakwa shikulu wakwe. Kumwakwe ku ŋanda kwena taileko iyoo.

english: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo ulucelo, Davidi alemba inkalata kuli Yoabu no kupeela Uria ukusenda.

english: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”
translation: Muli kalata alemba atila, “Bika Uria apo ubulwi bulumishe mu mulongo wantanshi. Elyo mubwelele kunuma yakwe pakuti bamukome no kufwa.”

english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.
translation: Kanshi cilya Yoabu aba pakushinguluka uyu musumba, alishibe apali ifita ifyakosa nganshi mukucingilila uyu musumba, epo abika Uria.

english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
translation: Ilyo abantu ba mu musumba bafuma mukulwisha Yoabu, bamo abaume bakwa Davidi abali ifita fyakwe baipaiwa pamo pene na Uria umwina Hiti nao afwila kumo.

english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
translation: Elyo Yoabu atumine kuli Davidi amashiwi yonse aya pa mulandu wa bulwi.

english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,
translation: Akonkomesha kapaso ati, “Ilyo uleya pwisha ukusosa imilandu yonse iyi iya bulwi ku mfumu,

english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.
translation: Icungulo cimo Davidi aima pa busanshi bwakwe no kwamba ukwendauka pa mutenge wa ŋanda ye sano. Lintu acili pa mutenge, alolesha panshi amona umwanakashi aleowa. Uyu mwanakashi ali umusuma nganshi.

english: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?
translation: limbi aya mashiwi kuti yaimya ubukali ku mfumu, kabili kuti yakwipusha aiti, ‘Nga mulandu nshi mwapalamineko ku musumba kukulwa? Bushe tamwaishibe ukuti aba pa cibumba kuti bamilasa imifwi?

english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”
translation: Nga uwaipaye Abimeleki mwana Yerubesheti nani? Bushe te mwanakashi amulashile impelo ye libwe ukufuma pelinga pakuti afwe mu Tebeshi? Mulandu nshi mwaikalile mupepi ne linga?’ Nga cakuti yakwipusha pali ici, elyo utile kuli yena, ‘No mubomfi wenu Uria umwina Hiti nao nafwa.’”

english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
translation: Awe inkombe yalile, elyo ilyo yafika, yaeba Davidi amashiwi yonse bamutumine ukusosa.

english: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.
translation: Inkombe yaeba Davidi aiti, “Abantu balitucila amaka no kwisa mukutulwisha pa lwalala. Lelo kwena twali bafulumuna mpakafye na ku mwinshi wakwingilila pa mpongolo ya musumba.

english: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”
translation: Elyo abali na mata balashile ababomfi benu ne mifwi ukufuma pa cibumba no kwipayapo bamo abantu ba mfumu. Nakabili no mubomfi wenu Uria umwina Hiti nao nafwa.”

english: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba inkombe ati, “Eba Yoabu utile, ‘Ici, ciikusakamika, ulupanga lwena lwipaya uyu elyo noyu wine. Ikatishafye ukulwisha umusumba no kuonaula. Umwebe Yoabu ifi pakumukoselesha.’”

english: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
translation: Ilyo muka Uria aumfwile ukuti umulume wakwe nafwa, alaloosha umulume wakwe.

english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
translation: Na panuma ya nshita yakuloosha, Davidi atuma abakuya leta muka Uria ku ŋanda kumwakwe. Awe nao aisa ba umukashi wakwe. Kabili amufyalila umwana umwaume. Lelo ici cintu Davidi acitile tacasekeshe Yawe.

english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”
translation: Elyo Davidi atuma uwakwipusha pali uyu mwanakashi. Umwaume asosa ati, “Bushe uyu, te Batisheba, umwana umwanakashi wakwa Eliamu kabili umukashi wakwa Uria umwina Hiti?”

english: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.
translation: Elyo Davidi atuma abakuya mubuula. Awe nao aisa kuli Davidi no kulala nankwe. Pali iyi nshita ninshi Batisheba ali uwasanguluka ku kukowela kwakwe. Elyo abwelela kumwakwe.

english: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”
translation: Umwanakashi uyu, aimita elyo atuma amashiwi kuli Davidi atila, “Ine ninjimita.”

english: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.
translation: Davidi kanshi epakutuma amashiwi kuli Yoabu ati, “Ntumina Uria umwina Hiti.” Nao Yoabu atuma Uria kuli Davidi.

english: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.
translation: Ilyo Uria afikile kuli Davidi, amwipusha umutende wakwa Yoabu ifyo uli, ifyo ifita fili elyo nefyo inkondo ileenda.

english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba Uria ati, “Kabiye, tentemukila ku ŋanda yobe no kusamba amakasa yobe.” Awe Uria afuma mwisano aya. Kabili imfumu yamukonkesha icabupe ukufuma kwisano kwine.

english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.
translation: Lelo Uria taile kumwakwe ngefyo bamwebele, asendeme pa mwinshi wa mpongolo pamo pene na bonse ababomfi bakwa shikulu wakwe.

english: The LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.
translation: Elyo Yawe atuma Natani kuli Davidi. Ilyo afika kuli ena, amweba ati, “Kwali abantu babili mu musumba umo, umo umukankala elyo umbi nao umupina.

english: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’
translation: Nomba ecalenga ulupanga talwakatale alufuma mu ŋanda mumobe pantu walinsuula no kusenda muka Uria umwina Hiti mukuba umukashi obe?’

english: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
translation: “Ifi efyo Yawe asosele, ‘Ukufuma mu ŋanda yobe mwinefye, ine ndi nokukuletela icimfulunganya. Mu mensofye yobe ine nkabuula abakashi bobe no kubapeela ku mubiyo uo waishiba nganshi, nao akalala nabo pakabalika.

english: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”
translation: Iwe wacitile mu bumfisolo, lelo Ine nkacita pakabalika kabili pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse.’”

english: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan said to David, “The LORD also has put away your sin. You will not die.
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba Natani ati, “Ine nincita ububifi kuli Yawe.” Nao Natani amwasuka ati, “Yawe nakubelela uluse pa bubifi bobe. Tauli nakufwa iyoo.

english: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wakuti naucita ici, naulenga abalwani bakwa Yawe bamupontele, umwana uo wafyala ali nokufwa.”

english: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.
translation: Panuma ilyo Natani aile kumwakwe, Yawe aumine no kulwalika umwana mwaume untu muka Uria afyele kuli Davidi.

english: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.
translation: Davidi nao epakupapata kuli Lesa pa mulandu wa mwana. Afungile ukulya no kuya mu ŋanda yakwe, alambalala panshi inshiku ishingi.

english: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba mwisano lyakwe baisa iminina mu mbali yakwe pakuti bamwimye panshi, awe akanininafye. Akaana no kulya pamo nabo icakulya.

english: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, umwana afwa. Elyo ababomfi bakwa Davidi baba no mwenso uwakumweba ukuti umwana nafwa, pantu batontonkenye abati, “Lintu umwana acili umumi, twalelanda na Davidi, lelo taletumfwa iyoo. Nomba kuti twamweba shani ati umwana nafwa? Awe limbi kuti acitapo icabipa.”

english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”
translation: Davidi amona ukuti ababomfi bakwe baletotoshanya elyo ailuka ukuti umwana nafwa. Aipusha ati, “Bushe umwana nafwa?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Ee, nafwa.”

english: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,
translation: Umukankala alikwete iŋombe ne mpaanga ishingi.

english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.
translation: Awe Davidi aima ukufuma panshi. Panuma yakowa, asuba na mafuta no kufwala ifyakufwala fimbi, aya ingila na mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe mukupepa. Cilya afuma aipusha ababomfi bakwe ukumupeelako icakulya nao alya.

english: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”
translation: Ababomfi bakwe epakumwipusha abati, “Nga cinshi ulecitila umusango uyu? Ilyo umwana acili umumi, walifungile ukulya, kabili waleloosha. Lelo nomba ilyo umwana afwa, waima no kulya!”

english: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’
But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
translation: Lelo nomba apo nafwa, cinshi ningafungila ukulya? Bushe kuti namubwesha nakabili. Ine nkaya kuli ena, lelo ena takabwelele kuli ine iyoo.”

english: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. The LORD loved him;
translation: Elyo Davidi alakoselesha umukashi wakwe Batisheba, kabili aya kuli ena no kulala nankwe. Awe nao afyala umwana umwaume, bamwinika ishina lya Solomoni. Yawe amutemwa nganshi.

english: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD’s sake.
translation: Pantu Yawe amutemwa nganshi, atuma ishiwi ukupitila muli Natani kasesema mukumwinika ishina lya Yedidiya .

english: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
translation: Kabili Yoabu ali pa bulwi ku Raba umusumba ukalamba ku bena Amoni no kupokolola uyu musumba wa mfumu.

english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.
translation: Elyo Yoabu atuma inkombe kuli Davidi nokutila, “Ine nindwisha Raba ne fishima fya menshi nimpokolola.

english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”
translation: Nomba longanikeni impuka ya fita fyonse no kwisa shinguluka, umusumba no kuupoka. Pantu ine nga naupoka kuti nawinika ishina lyandi”.

english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.
translation: Elyo Davidi alonganika impuka ya fita fyonse no kuya ku Raba kukulwisha no kupokolola umusumba.

english: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.
translation: Lelo umupina takwetefye nangu cimo kanofye akakota ka mpaanga ako ashitile. Alekakusha bwino no kukulila pamo nankwe elyo na bana bakwe. Kalepeelwako ifilyo fimo fine, ukunwena ku lukombo lumo lwine nankwe elyo kabili kalelala mu maboko yakwe. Awe kalifye kwati mwana umwanakashi kuli ena.

english: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.
translation: Abuula ne cisote cabufumu ukufuma ku mutwe wa mfumu yabo. Ukufina kwaciko kwali italanta lya golide limo , kabili mukati mwali no tumabwe utwauma umutengo. Baisa cibika pa mutwe wakwa Davidi. Kabili abuula ifitapwa ifingi nganshi ukufuma mu musumba.

english: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo afumya abantu abali mu musumba, abatwala kukubomba imilimo yakubomfya ifyakuputwilako imbao, bancinde elyo na masembe. Kabili abapeela imilimo yakutama matafwali. Ifi efyo acitile na ku misumba yonse iya bena Amoni. Elyo Davidi ne fita fyakwe fyonse babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”
translation: “Nomba kwaishile umulendo ku mukankala lelo umukankala afilwa ukubuulapo imo impaanga nangu iŋombe iyakuti apekanishishepo umulendo uwamufikilile. Mu nshita yakubuula impaanga yakwe, asenda akapaanga ka mupina no kupekanya icakulya ca mweni uwamufikile.”

english: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!
translation: Elyo Davidi aikatwa no bukali kuli uyu muntu, no kweba Natani ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, umuntu uyu uucitile ici wena alingilefye ukufwa!

english: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”
translation: Afwilefye ukubweseshapo impaanga shine pa kapaanga akakota kamo pa mulandu wa ici acitile, pantu no luse takwete.”

english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.
translation: Elyo Natani atile kuli Davidi, “Uyu muntu niwe! Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli asosa ati, ‘Nine nakusuba ukuba imfumu pa bena Israeli, kabili nine nakupokolola ukufuma mu minwe yakwa Saulo.

english: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.
translation: Nine napeela iŋanda yakwa sokulu kuli iwe pamo pene na bakashi bakwa sokulu mu maboko yobe. Nine nakupeele iŋanda yakwa Israeli ne yakwa Yuda. Kanshi nga cakuti ifi fyonse naficepesha, nga nalikupeelelapo na fimbi.

english: Why have you despised the LORD’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
translation: Bushe cinshi wasuulile ishiwi lyakwa Yawe nokucita icabubifi pa cinso cakwe? Iwe walipaya Uria umwina Hiti no kusenda umukashi wakwe, aba umukashi obe. Wamwipaya ku lupanga lwa bena Amoni.

english: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyonse fyapitile, Amunoni mwana Davidi alitemenwe Tama uwali umusuma nganshi. Ali ni nkashi yakwa Abusalomu umwana wakwa Davidi.

english: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.
translation: Elyo Amunoni aeba Tama ati, “Ndetela ifyakulya kuno ku muputule wandi uwakusendamako pakuti undisheko ne minwe yobe.” Tama nao abuula umukate acipekanya no kutwala kuli ndume yakwe Amunoni ku muputule wakwe uwakusendamako.

english: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”
translation: Lelo ilyo atwala kuli ena ukuti alye, Amunoni amufukukila nokutila, “Isa tulale na iwe, we nkashi yandi.”

english: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!
translation: Nao Tama atila kuli Amunoni, “Tecakwesha we ndume yandi! Wimpatikisha. Pantu ica musango uyu tacatala acicitika mu bena Israeli! Wicita ici cintu icabipa.

english: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”
translation: Nomba ine, ni kwi nkatwala uyu musebanya wandi? Na iwe, uli nokubafye iciwelewele ca muntu mu bena Israeli. Nakupapata landafye ku mfumu pantu tekuti ikaanye ine ukupwa kuli iwe.”

english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.
translation: Lelo Amunoni akaana ukumfwa kuli Tama, nomba ico icakuti ali na maka ukumucila, asuka amunasha, asendama nankwe kumupatikisha.

english: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”
translation: Elyo Amunoni apata Tama nganshi, kabili impatila yakwe kuli Tama yacilile pafyo amutemenwe. Amunoni aeba Tama ati, “Ima, no kufuma uleya!”

english: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.
translation: Tama nao akaana, nokutila kuli ena, “Iyoo nshaye! Ala ukuntamfya calabipishapo nganshi ukucila nefyo ucitile kale kuli ine.” Lelo Amunoni wena akaanininafye ukumfwa kuli Tama.

english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”
translation: Amunoni epakwita umubomfi wakwe nokumweba ati, “Shifumya uyu mwanakashi muno elyo wisalisheko ku ciibi panuma nga afuma.”

english: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.
translation: Awe umubomfi wakwe amufumya elyo aisalako ne ciibi panuma ilyo Tama afuma. Tama afwele umwingila wa maboko ayatali uwamutengo, pantu efyakufwala abana ba mfumu abanakashi banacisungu balefwala.

english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
translation: Tama epakuisuba imito mu mutwe no kulepula insalu ya mwingila wakwe afwele. Abika na maboko pa mutwe wakwe, aya aleloosha apakalamba ilyo aleya.

english: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.
translation: Awe Amunoni tepakucululuka mu mutima, icakuti camufisha na mukulwala pa mulandu wakwa nkashi yakwe Tama. Pa mulandu wakuti Tama ali ni nacisungu, calikosele kuli Amunoni ukuti acite ico alefwaya kuli Tama.

english: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
translation: Elyo ndume yakwe Abusalomu asosele kuli Tama ati, “Bushe ni Amunoni ndume yobe ewakubifya? Nomba talala we nkashi yandi. Ala ni ndume yobe. Tecakwesha ukubika ici cintu ku mutima.” Elyo Tama aikala na mu ŋanda yakwa ndume yakwe Abusalomu, umweo uwa nkumbabulili.

english: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yaumfwile fyonse ifi, yalifulilwe nganshi. Nomba imfumu yalifililwe ukumucita icintu nelyo cimo pantu uyu ewali umwana wakwe ibeli, elyo alimutemenwe nganshi.

english: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
translation: Lelo Abusalomu tatalile alanda ishiwi nangu limo kuli Amunoni, ilibi nangu ilisuma, pantu alimupatile pakupatikisha ukusendama na nkashi yakwe.

english: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
translation: Panuma ya myaka ibili, ilyo bakabeya ba mpaanga shakwa Abusalomu bali ku Baali Hasori mupepi no mupaka wa ku Efulemu, Abusalomu aitile bonse abana ba mfumu abaume.

english: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”
translation: Abusalomu epakuya ku mfumu nokutila, “Umubomfi obe aisa na bakabeya ba mpaanga. Bushe imfumu na bacilolo baiko kuti batemwa ukwisa sangwako?”

english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.
translation: Imfumu yamwasuka aiti, “Iyoo mwana wandi. Ifwe bonse tekuti tuyeko, epali twakucushafye.” Awe Abusalomu aesha ukupatikisha imfumu, nalyo line yakaana ukuyako lelo yamupeelafye ipaalo.

english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu atile, “Nga cakuti teifyo, napapata kanshi lekeni tuleyafye na munyinane Amunoni.” Nayo imfumu epakumwipusha aiti, “Bushe mulandu nshi ulefwaila ukuya nankwe?”

english: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
translation: Nomba mu mupatikisha wakwa Abusalomu, imfumu epakuleka Amunoni pamo na bana ba mfumu abaume bonse ukuya nankwe.

english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu apeela icipope ku babomfi bakwe ati, “Umfweni! Ilyo mwalaisa mona Amunoni asansamuka panuma yakunwa umwangashi, na ine naisa mweba ati, ‘Ipayeni Amunoni,’ mwitiina, mumwipayefye. Bushe teine mpeele ici cipope? Mubefye abakosa kabili abashipa.”

english: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.
translation: Eico kanshi ababomfi bakwa Abusalomu bacitile ifyo Abusalomu abakonkomeshe ukucita kuli Amunoni. Elyo abana ba mfumu abaume bonse baima, banina cila muntu pali punda wakwe no kufulumuka.

english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.
translation: Nomba Amunoni alikwetepo umunankwe ishina lyakwe ni Yonadabu umwana wakwa Shimeya, munyina wakwa Davidi. Yonadabu ali umucenjeshi nganshi.

english: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”
translation: Ilyo bacili mu nshila baleya, kwafika akasebo kuli Davidi akakutila, “Abusalomu naipaya bonse abana ba mfumu abaume, tapali nangu umo pali bena uushelepo.”

english: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
translation: Awe imfumu yaima apo yaikele no kulepaula ifyakufwala fyaiko no kulambalala panshi. Kabili bonse ababomfi baiko abaiminine pantu yali, nabo balepaula ifyakufwala fyabo.

english: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
translation: Lelo Yonadabu mwana Shimeya, munyina wakwa Davidi asosa ati, “Mwe shikulu mwitila amuti ni bonse abana ba mfumu bepeye iyoo, ni Amunoni eufwilefye. Ifi fyalimoneke kuli Abusalomu ukuti eyali amapange yakwe nakale, ukutulafye pa bushiku Amunoni alele na nkashi yakwe Tama kumaka.

english: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”
translation: Mwe shikulu wandi, cimusakamika ku kasebo kakutila abana ba mfumu abaume nabafwa. Ni Amunoni ekafye eufwile.”

english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.
translation: Ninshi pali iyi nshita Abusalomu nafulumuka. Nomba umulinshi umo uwaiminine ainuna amenso lwa pamulu elyo amona abantu abengi bali mu musebo, lwa ku masamba yakwe baleisa mu mbali ya lupili. Elyo umulinshi aya eba imfumu ukutila, “Ine namona abantu ku ntunga ya ku Horonaimu, mu mbali ya lupili.”

english: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”
translation: Yonadabu nao asosa ku mfumu ati, “Moneni abana ba mfumu abaume aba pano, neci cacitikafye pamo ngefyo umubomfi wenu asosele.”

english: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.
translation: Ilyofye apwa ukulanda, awe abana ba mfumu abaume baingila, balalila imisowa mukwikatisha. Imfumu nayo pamo na babomfi baiko, balaloosha apakalamba.

english: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
translation: Lelo Abusalomu afulumwike no kuya kuli Talimai mwana Amihudi, imfumu ya Geshuri. Lelo imfumu Davidi yena yalalooshafye umwana waiko inshiku shonse.

english: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
translation: Panuma yakufulumuka kwakwa Abusalomu aile ikala ku Geshuri pa myaka itatu.

english: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
translation: Kabili umupashi wa mfumu Davidi walefuluka ukuya kuli Abusalomu, pantu balimukoselesheko pa mulandu wa mfwa yakwa Amunoni.

english: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”
translation: Awe aipusha Amunoni ati, “Bushe mulandu nshi iwe, we mwana wa mfumu, ulemonekela uwabulanda cila lucelo? Bushe teti unjebeko?” Amunoni atile kuli ena, “Ine nalitemwa Tama, inkashi yakwa munyinane Abusalomu.”

english: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”
translation: Elyo Yonadabu amweba ati, “Kabiye ku busanshi bobe usendame kwati naulwala. Ilyo bawiso baleisa kukukumona, ubebe ati, ‘Ndefwaya nkashi yandi Tama ese apekanye icakulya pa cinso candi ilyo ndemonako, pakuti ese andisheko ukufuma mu minwe yakwe.’”

english: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”
translation: Awe Amunoni aya lambalala pa musengele apashanya kwati mulwele. Ilyo imfumu yaisa mukumumona, Amunoni asosa ku mfumu ati, “Kuti natemwa nkashi yandi Tama aisa mpangilako utumikate utwawamisha pa cinso candi pakuti ndye ku filefuma ku minwe yakwe.”

english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atumine ishiwi kuli Tama kwisano ati, “Kabiye ku ŋanda yakwa ndume yobe Amunoni uye mupekanishako ifyakulya fimo.”

english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.
translation: Awe Tama epakuya ku ŋanda yakwa ndume yakwe Amunoni, uko asendeme. Abuula umufuba umo, aukasawila, apangamo umukate ninshi Amunoni alemonako, elyo afumbika.

english: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.
translation: Epakubuula pani afumyapo umukate nokupeela Amunoni ukuti alye, nao akaana ukulya. Elyo asosa ati, “Fumya abantu bonse kuno.” Abantu bonse epakufumamo bamusha baya.

english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
translation: Nomba Yoabu umwana wakwa Seruiya alishibe ukuti mu mutima wa mfumu muli ukufuluka Abusalomu.

english: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”
translation: Elyo imfumu nayo yayaswike aiti, “Nga cakuti kwaba umuntu uwakwisa sosa icintiinya kuli iwe, umulete kuli ine, pantu takabwekeshepo ukukucusha.”

english: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”
translation: Elyo umwanakashi asosa ati, “Kanshi shi lekeni imfumu ibukishe Yawe, Lesa waiko, ukuti acingilile kalandula wa mulopa ukufuma ku bonaushi na bumbi, pakuti umwana wandi eonaulwa.” Imfumu nayo yasosa aiti, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, takuli umushishi nangufye umo uwa ku mutwe wa mwana obe uukaponena panshi.”

english: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
translation: Elyo umwanakashi asosa ati, “Shilekeni umubomfi wenu asosepo ishiwi limo kuli shikulu imfumu yandi.” Imfumu nayo yayasuka aiti, “Landa.”

english: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.
translation: Umwanakashi atile, “Bushe cinshi nomba imfumu yacitile icilubo camusango ifi pa bantu bakwa Lesa? Pantu pakupingula muli iyi nshila, imfumu yaipeela icilubo iyine, pakukanabwesha umwana waiko, uko abutukile?

english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
translation: Pantu tuli benakufwa, twapala nga menshi ayetikila panshi ayashingalonganikwa pamo nakabili. Lelo Lesa tasenda ubumi, ena alafwaya inshila yakubweseshamo umuntu uo batamfya ukuti etaluka kuli ena.

english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’
translation: “Kanshi nomba ninjisa kuli imwe mwe shikulu imfumu yandi ukuti nsose ici, pantu abantu nabanenga ukutiina. Kanshi umubomfi wenu epakutontonkanya ati, ‘Kankaye landafye ku mfumu, nalimo kuti yamona ifyo ingacita pafyo umubomfi waiko alomba.

english: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
translation: Pantu imfumu yalaumfwa, no kulubula umubomfi waiko ukufuma ku maboko ya muntu uulefwaya ukonaula bonse ine elyo no mwana wandi umwaume ku cuma cacishilano Lesa atupeela.’

english: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”
translation: “Eico nomba umubomfi wenu atontonkenye ukuti, ‘Ishiwi lyakwa shikulu imfumu yandi lilendetela ukutuusha.’ Pantu shikulu imfumu yandi aba kwati ni malaika wakwa Lesa mukwishiba ifisuma ne fyabipa. Shi Yawe Lesa wenu abe na imwe.”

english: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatile ku mwanakashi, “Tecakwesha ukufisa nangu kamo ukufuma kufyo nalakwipusha.” Umwanakashi nao ayasuka ati, “Lekeni shikulu imfumu yandi ilande.”

english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaipusha aiti, “Bushe te Yoabu waibikamo muli ifi fyonse?” Umwanakashi ayasuka ati, “Icine cinefye napo imwe muli abomi mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, takwingaba nangu umo uwingapilibukila ku kulyo nangufye ni ku kuso, ukufuma ku cintu conse ico shikulu imfumu yandi ilesosa. Ee cacine, mubomfi wenu Yoabu uwanjebele ukuti ncite ifi. Kabili ewabikile na mashiwi yonse aya mu kanwa ka mubomfi wenu.

english: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.
translation: Kanshi Yoabu epakutumapo umuntu umo ku Tekoa no kuya letako umwanakashi uwamano ukufuma kulya kwine, amweba ati, “Umoneke kwati uli ne cililo. Ufwale ifyakufwala fya malilo, kabili tecakwesha ukubomfya amafuta yakukuyemfya iyoo. Umonekefye kwati mwanakashi uupwile inshiku ishingi mu bulanda bwakuloosha uwafwa.

english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”
translation: Umubomfi wenu Yoabu ewacitile ifi pakuti umulandu ubele mu musango umbi. Shikulu wandi alikwata amano kwati ni malaika wakwa Lesa. Aleshiba conse icilecitika mu calo conse.”

english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatila kuli Yoabu, “Cisuma, nalacita ico walanda. Kabiye, kabweshe umulumendo Abusalomu.”

english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”
translation: Yoabu alambalala panshi ubukupeme panshi mukupeela umucinshi, elyo apaala imfumu. Yoabu epakutila, “Ilelo umubomfi wenu aishiba ukuti asangwa uwatemwikwa ku menso yenu, mwe shikulu imfumu yandi pantu imfumu yacita ico umubomfi waiko alombele.”

english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo Yoabu aile ku Geshuri nokuya buula Abusalomu ukumubwesesha ku Yerusalemu.

english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.
translation: Lelo imfumu yasosa aiti, “Afwile ukuyafye ku ŋanda kumwakwe. Tafwile ukumoneka ku cinso candi iyoo.” Kanshi Abusalomu epakuya ku ŋanda kumwakwe. Kabili tamwenepo icinso ca mfumu nakalya.

english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.
translation: Kanshi mu calo conse ica bena Israeli, tamwali umuntu uo balelumbanya pakuyemba pamo nga Abusalomu. Ukufumafye pa mulu wa mutwe wakwe ukufika na ku katende ka lukasa lwakwe, takwali kalema nelyo kamo muli ena.

english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.
translation: Inshita yonse ilyo amona ukuti umushishi wa ku mutwe wakwe wafulisha, aleya mukuubeya. Aleupimisha, kabili ukufina kwauko kwaleba amashekeli pa cipimo ca mfumu imyanda ibili (200).

english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
translation: Abusalomu afyele abana batatu elyo no mwanakashi umo. Ishina lya mwana umwanakashi ali ni Tama. Tama ali umusuma nganshi mukumoneka.

english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.
translation: Abusalomu aikele imyaka ibili mu Yerusalemu ukwabula ukumonanapo ne mfumu.

english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
translation: Elyo Abusalomu aita Yoabu pakuti engamutuma ku mfumu. Lelo Yoabu akaana ubwite bwakuya kuli ena. Kabili epakutumako intumi na imbi iyacibili, nalyo line akaana ku bwite.

english: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.
translation: Elyo nomba uye ku mfumu no kuya landa aya mashiwi.” Elyo Yoabu epakumweba amashiwi yakuya landa.

english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
translation: Elyo asosa ku babomfi bakwe ati, “Moneni, ibala lyakwa Yoabu lyasuntinkana ne bala lyandi, elyo alilimamo na bale mulya mwine. Kabiyeni no kulyoca ku mulilo.” Kanshi ababomfi bakwa Abusalomu epakuya oca ibala ku mulilo.

english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”
translation: Elyo Yoabu aima aya ku ŋanda yakwa Abusalomu nokutila kuli ena, “Mulandu nshi ababomfi baocela ibala lyandi ku mulilo?”

english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”
translation: Abusalomu ayasuka ati, “Mona nalituma ishiwi kuli iwe nati isa kuno pakuti ningesa kutuma ku mfumu, kukwipusha ukuti, ‘Bushe mulandu nshi nafumina ku Geshuri? Nga caliwemefye ne mwine nga cakuti na nomba njikala kulya kwine!’ Elyo nomba, ine ndefwaya ukumonana ne mfumu kanshi nga cakuti nasangwa no mulandu uli onse, lekenifye injipaye.”

english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
translation: Kanshi Yoabu epakuya ku mfumu no kuyeba ici. Elyo imfumu yaita Abusalomu, nao aingila, akontamina panshi mukupeela umucinshi pakuiposha. Imfumu nayo yatomona Abusalomu pakumuposha.

english: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
translation: Ilyo umwanakashi uwafumine ku Tekoa aile ku mfumu, alambalala panshi ubukupeme, ashimpa ne mpumi yakwe panshi mukupeela umucinshi nokusosa ati, “Ngafweni, mwe mfumu!”

english: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
translation: Elyo imfumu yamwipusha aiti, “Bushe cinshi cilekucusha?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ine icine cine ndi mukamfwilwa. Umulume wandi alifwa.

english: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.
translation: Ine ne mubomfi wenu nali na bana baume babili nomba ilyo bali mu mpanga balelwa no wakubalamununa tapali. Umo akomene umunankwe no kumwipaya.

english: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”
translation: Nomba ulupwa lonse lwaimina umubomfi wenu, nokutila, ‘Tufumisheni uwaipeye munyina, pakuti na ifwe tumwipaye pa bumi bwakwa munyina uo aipaya. Nangu calaba ukuti tulofye mpyani yakwe pamo pene.’ Nomba nga bacita ifi, bakashimya umusolilo wandi uwashala, no kulenga ishina lya mulume wandi pamo na bana nangu abakukonkapo bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse bakalobelele.”

english: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatile ku mwanakashi, “Kabiye ku ŋanda yobe na ine nalapeela amafunde aya pa mulandu obe.”

english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
translation: Lelo umwanakashi uwafumine ku Tekoa nao atila kuli ena, “Mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, shi lekenifye umulandu ube pali ine wine pamo no lupwa lwakwa tata. Kabili shi lekeni imfumu pamo ne cipuna caiko ibe iyakaele.”

english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyonse fyapitile, Abusalomu aipekanishishe umwine iceleta, bakabalwe elyo na bantu amakumi yasano (50) abakutangila pa ntanshi yakwe.

english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu mu nkaama atuma inkombe monse mu nko sha bena Israeli mukusosa ati, “Ilyo lyonse muli nokumfwa ukulila kwa mapenga, elyo mukalebilisha amuti, ‘Abusalomu ali ni mfumu mu Hebuloni.’”

english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.
translation: Kanshi abantu imyanda ibili (200) ebashindike Abusalomu ukufuma ku Yerusalemu. Aba bonse ebalalikwe nga bashimucindikwa. Kabili bena bali abakaele abashaishibe nangufye kamo pali uyu mulandu.

english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.
