translation: Ilyo Abusalomu acili aletuula amalambo, atuma uwakwita Aitofeli umwina Giloni, cilolo wakwa Davidi, ukufuma ku Gilo umusumba wakwe. Kabili ukwikatana pamo kwakosa nganshi, na balekonka Abusalomu balafulilakofye.

english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”
translation: Kabili kwaishile umo uwakweba Davidi ukuti, “Imitima ya bena Israeli nayalukila kuli Abusalomu.”

english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba ababomfi bakwe abo ali nabo mu Yerusalemu ati, “Iseni! Tufulumukefye, pantu takuli nangu umo uuli nokupusuka ukufuma kuli Abusalomu. Nombalinefye tufwile ukuya, epali ayangufyanya ukulwisha no kucimfya elyo atonaula, aonaula no musumba ku lupanga.”

english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”
translation: Elyo bacilolo ba mfumu bamwasuka abati, “Ababomfi benu bali abaipekanya ukucitafye conse ico shikulu imfumu yesu isalile.”

english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.
translation: Awe imfumu epakufuma na baŋanda bonse bamukonka. Lelo ashakofye abakashi bakwe abo asaupile mu bwinga ikumi limo kukusunga isano lya mfumu.

english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.
translation: Kanshi imfumu epakufuma na bantu bonse bamukonka. Elyo baya iminina pa ŋanda yakulekelesha.

english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
translation: Abantu bonse baleenda balemupita mumbali, ninshi bali pamo bonse na bena Kereti, abena Peleti, elyo na bonse imyanda mutanda (600) iya bena Gati abamushindike ukufuma ku Gati baleenda ukupita pa cinso ca mfumu.

english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.
translation: Elyo imfumu yasosa kuli Itai umwina Gati aiti, “Bushe cinshi ico na iwe walatukonkela? Bwelelamo uye ikala ne mfumu Abusalomu. Ala iwe uli mwinafyalo, uli mweni uwafuma ku calo ca kumwenu.

english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”
translation: Abusalomu aleima ulucelo no kwiminina pa mbali ya musebo uwaya ku mpongolo. Ilyo lyonse umuntu aisa na kasebo akakutwala ku mfumu kukupingulwa, Abusalomu amwita no kumwipusha ati, “Bushe ni ku musumba nshi ufumine?” Nao ali nokwasuka ati, “Umubomfi wenu afumine mu luko lumo lwa nko sha bena Israeli.”

english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”
translation: Iwe ni mailo waishilefye. Elyo ilelo wati tube abakwendauka bonse, ilyo ine nshishibe uko ndi nokuya? Bwelelamo, elyo usende na bamunonko. Shi uluse ne cishinka fileba na iwe.”

english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”
translation: Elyo Itai ayasuka imfumu ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, kabili apofye shikulu wandi imfumu yandi yabumi, uko konsefye shikulu imfumu yandi ili nokuba cibe ni mu bumi nangu ni mfwa, eko no mubomfi wenu ali nokuba.”

english: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.
translation: Elyo Davidi aeba Itai ati, “Cisuma tuleya, tangila.” Awe Itai umwina Gati epakuya pamo na bantu bakwe bonse ne ndupwa shintu ali nasho.

english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.
translation: Abantu bonse mu calo bapumunapo imisowa ikalamba balalila ilyo balepita. Awe imfumu nayo epakwabuka umukonko wa Kidironi, elyo abantu bonse bena balepitililafye ukulungama ku matololo.

english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.
translation: Abiyata epo ali pamo na Sadoki, na bonse abena Levi abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa. Elyo babika Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa panshi na Abiyata atuulapo na malambo mpakafye abantu bonse bapwa ukufuma mu musumba.

english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in the LORD’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;
translation: Elyo imfumu yaeba Sadoki aiti, “Bwesesha Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa mu musumba. Nga cakuti nasanga uluse ku cinso cakwa Yawe, ali nokumbwesha no kunenga kabili ukuimona pamo ne cifulo cakwe icakwikalamo.

english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti atila, ‘Ine nshisekelele muli iwe,’ awe lyena ine ndifye uwaipekanya ukuti acite conse kuli ine ico atemenwe.”

english: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
translation: Imfumu nayo epakusosa kuli Sadoki shimapepo aiti, “Bushe iwe, teiwe kamona iyoo? Bwelelamo umutende ku musumba, no mwana obe umwaume Aimasi elyo na Yonatani mwana Abiyata. Iwe na Abiyata sendeni abana benu babili abaume.

english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”
translation: Ndi nokuya mukulolela mu mawanga ya mu matololo mpaka ishiwi likafume kuli imwe mukanjebe.”

english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
translation: Kanshi Sadoki na Abiyata epakusenda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa no kuibwesesha ku Yerusalemu. Kabili eko baikala no kwikala.

english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu ali nokusosa kuli ena ati, “Mona, umulandu obe ulifye bwino kabili uwatambalala, lelo tapali nangu umo pa bemininako imfumu uwingakumfwa.”

english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
translation: Lelo Davidi atwalilila ukunina ulupili lwa Miolifa. Ilyo alenina ulupili ninshi aleya alelila nokulila. Ku mutwe wakwe kwalifimbilwe kabili aleendafye ukwabula indyato ku makasa. Bonse abantu abo ali nabo, ku mitwe yabo kwalifimbilwe. Elyo nabo bene ilyo balenina ulupili baile balelila.

english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”
translation: Nomba Davidi bamweba ukuti, “Aitofeli nao ali pamo na bekatene na Abusalomu.” Elyo Davidi apepa ati, “We Yawe, bwesheni Aitofeli ku mano yaciwelewele.”

english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.
translation: Ilyo Davidi afikile pa mulu wa lupili, apo abantu balepepela Lesa, Hushai umwina Aki epo ali kukumusengela, ninshi nalepula umukansu wakwe, na ku mutwe wakwe kuli ulukungu.

english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;
translation: Davidi asosa kuli ena ati, “Nga cakuti waile na ine, uli nokubafye icisendo kuli ine.

english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then will you defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’
translation: Lelo nga cakuti wabwelelamo ku musumba no kusosa kuli Abusalomu auti, ‘Ine ndi nokuba umubomfi wenu, mwe mfumu. Ine nali umubomfi wakwa wiso mu nshita yapita, lelo nomba ndi nokuba umubomfi wenu.’ Elyo lyena kuti mwangafwilisha kukufulunganya bumpandamano bwakwa Aitofeli.

english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
translation: Bushe bashimapepo Sadoki na Abiyata tabakabe na iwe kulya? Ulebeba conse ico uli nokumfwa mwisano lya mfumu.

english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”
translation: Abana babo abaume babili, Aimasi mwana Sadoki na Yonatani mwana Abiyata nabo bali kulya kwine pamo nabo. Ulebatuma kuli ine, na conse ico umfwile.”

english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
translation: Kanshi Hushai umunankwe wakwa Davidi, afika ku Yerusalemu ilyofye Abusalomu aleingila mu musumba.

english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”
translation: Abusalomu alundapo nokutila, “Nga cakuti nine bacitile umupingushi mu calo, umuntu onse uwamulandu nangu uwakuilishanya kuti aisa kuli ine, na ine kuti namona ukuti apingulwa mu mulinganya.”

english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.
translation: Elyo kabili umuntu onse ilyo aya kuli ena ukuti amukontamine pakumuposha, Abusalomu ena aletambikafye ukuboko kwakwe no kumwikata, elyo amutomona.

english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
translation: Abusalomu efyo alecita ku bena Israeli bonse, abaleya ku mfumu kukufwaya ubwafwilisho bwa bupingushi bwamulinganya. Ifi efyo Abusalomu alesembeleka imitima ya baume ba bena Israeli.

english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.
translation: Nomba pa mpela ya myaka ine, Abusalomu atile ku mfumu, “Shilekeni nje ku Hebuloni no kuya fikilisha icilayo nacitile kuli Yawe.

english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”
translation: Ilyo umubomfi wenu aleikala ku Geshuri mu Aramu, acitile icilayo cakutila, ‘Nga cakuti Yawe ambweseshamo ku Yerusalemu, ndi nokulapepela Yawe mu Hebuloni.’”

english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.
translation: Elyo imfumu yamweba ati, “Kabiye umutende.” Kanshi Abusalomu epakuya na ku Hebuloni.

english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.
translation: Ilyo Davidi acilile panono pa mulu wa lupili apo balepepela, akumanya Siba, kangalila wakwa Mefibosheti alepembela ukumukumanya, ali na bapunda nakakilapo ne fyakwikalapo. Kabili pali ne mipusa ya mikate imyanda ibili (200), ifisansangu fya myangashi umwanda umo (100) elyo ne nyambi ya mwangashi imo.

english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because the LORD has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”
translation: Lelo imfumu yasosa aiti, “Bushe imwe na ine cinshi tuli naco cimo mu mano, imwe mwe bana baume bakwa Seruiya? Nga cakuti aletipwila pantu Yawe eumwebele ati, ‘Lapisha Davidi,’ tapali uwingamulesha ukutila, ‘Cinshi ulecitila ifi?’”

english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD has invited him.
translation: Elyo Davidi atile kuli Abishai na bacilolo bakwe bonse, “Umwana, umwaume wa munofu wandifye, eulefwaya ukunjipaya. Nomba palibufi kuti caba shani kuli uyu umwina Benjamini! Mulekeni umwine. Lekeni alelapisha, pantu ni Yawe eumwebele ukucita ifi.

english: It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me, and that the LORD will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”
translation: Nalimo kuti Yawe alolesha pa bulanda bwandi no kunambwilapo ubusuma pakulapishiwa ndepokelela ilelo.”

english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.
translation: Awe Davidi na bantu bakwe bakonkanyapo ukulaya mu musebo, ninshi Shimei nao aleya, alekonka ulupili mumbali, nabalungatana na Davidi, aleya alelapisha, alemuposela na mabwe elyo no kumufukwila ulukungu.

english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.
translation: Imfumu na bantu yali nabo bonse bafika pa cifulo cakulalapo ninshi nabanaka nganshi. Kabili apa epo atuushishe.

english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
translation: Nomba Abusalomu na bantu bakwe bonse aba mu Israeli baile ku Yerusalemu, elyo Aitofeli nao ali pamo nankwe.

english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
translation: Elyo Hushai umwina Aki, umubiye wakwa Davidi, aya kuli Abusalomu nokutila kuli ena, “Shi ubumi nabutwalilile we mfumu!”

english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu aipusha Hushai ati, “Bushe kanshi ici e citemwiko ulanga ku mubiyo? Cinshi ico ushaila pamo no munobe?”

english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever the LORD and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.
translation: Hushai asosa kuli Abusalomu ati, “Iyoo, umuntu uusalilwe na Yawe, na bantu aba elyo na bonse abena Israeli, eo ine ninshi nkaba uwakwe. Uyu wine eo nkashala pamo nankwe.

english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”
translation: Elyo kabili, bushe ni ani uo ndi nokubombela? Bushe teti mombele umwana? Ifyo, nabombele wiso efyo ndi nokulakubombela na iwe wine.”

english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yaipusha Siba aiti, “Bushe cinshi waletela ifi?” Siba nao ayasuka ati, “Bapunda aba, ba mu ŋanda ya mfumu abakuninapo. Elyo umukate ne fisabo fyakulya fya bashilika. No mwangashi wakunwa abanakuka mu matololo.”

english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”
translation: Elyo Abusalomu atile kuli Aitofeli, “Tupandeko amano yobe. Bushe tuli nokucita shani?”

english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”
translation: Aitofeli ayasuka ati, “Usendame na bakashi abo ashaupile mu bwinga bonse abakwa wiso, abo asha mukulinda isano. Elyo lyena Israeli yonse ikomfwa ukutila cine cine nausebanya wiso. Ici cikalenga iwe na bonse abakukonka ukuba abamaka nganshi.”

english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakwanshika itenti lyakwa Abusalomu pa mulu wa mutenge. Elyo nao Abusalomu alalala na bakashi abashaupilwe mu bwinga abakwa wishi mu menso ya bena Israeli bonse.

english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.
translation: Nomba mu nshiku shilya bumpandamano Aitofeli apeele bwali kwati muntu umo uuleipusha kuli Lesa. Ifi efyo bonse Davidi na Abusalomu balemona fyonse ifya bumpandamano bwakwa Aitofeli.

english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”
translation: Elyo imfumu yaipusha aiti, “Ngo mwishikulu wakwa sokulu ali kwi?” Siba epakumwasuka ati, “Ala ekala mu Yerusalemu, pantu atontonkanya ukuti ubushiku bwa lelo iŋanda yakwa Israeli ili nokumubwesesha ubufumu bwakwa shikulu wakwe.”

english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yasosa kuli Siba aiti, “Ala fyonse ifyo Mefibosheti akwata nomba fyobe.” Siba nao asosa ati, “Mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, ine ndi panshi no kuicefya. Shi lekeni nsange ukutemwikwa ku cinso cenu.”

english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Davidi yafikile ku Bahurimu, umuntu umo uwa mu mukowa umo wine no lupwa lwakwa Saulo, ishina lyakwe ni Shimei mwana Gera, aishile alelapisha ninshi aleisa.

english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
translation: Shimei aleposela Davidi pamo na bacilolo ba mfumu bonse amabwe, nangu ifita fyonse na bakumulinda balifye ku mbali shonse, ku kulyo na ku kuso.

english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!
translation: Ilyo Shimei alelapisha alesosa ati, “Fuma muno, fuma muno we ntalamisoka we, we cinangwa camuntu!

english: The LORD has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! The LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”
translation: Yawe nakulandula pa mulopa onse wasumya mu ŋanda yakwa Saulo, mu cifulo cakwe umo wateeka. Yawe nao napeela ubufumu ku mwana obe Abusalomu. Kabili mona, wailetelela pantu uli ntalamisoka!”

english: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.
translation: Elyo Aitofeli atile kuli Abusalomu, “Ine ndi nokusala abantu amakana ikumi na yabili (12,000), no kuya ilelo line ubushiku mukukunkunika Davidi.

english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
translation: Ici cikalenga ukuti ne cita conse icashipa nganshi, icaba no mutima kwati mutima wa nkalamo, awe cili nokusunguluka ku mwenso. Pantu Israeli yonse yalishiba ukuti wiso wa bulwi, kabili bonse abo aba nabo bantu abashipa.

english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.
translation: Kanshi ine ndekupanda amano yakutila, ‘Leka Israeli yonse ukufuma ku Dani ukufika ku Beresheba, abafulisha ngo musensenga wa ku lulamba lwa bemba, bakalongane kuli iwe. Na iwe wine we mwine niwe ukabe katungulula wabo mu bulwi.’

english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.
translation: Nomba ilyo tukamusansa konse uko akasangwa, elyo tuli nokumuwililila ngefyo umume uwa pa mushili. Nangu ni ena, nangufye ni onse uwa mu bantu bakwe uukashala umumi, bonse bakepaiwa.

english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”
translation: Nga cakuti abutukila mu musumba umo, elyo Israeli yonse ikaleta imyando ku musumba ulya, tukaukulila ku mukonko, mpaka tapakashale nangufye kalibwe akacepesha.”

english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil on Absalom.
translation: Abusalomu na bantu bonse abena Israeli epakusosa abati, “Bumpandamano bwakwa Hushai umwina Aki, bwawamapo ukucila ubwakwa Aitofeli.” Pantu Yawe napanga ukufulunganya bumpandamano bwakwa Aitofeli mukuleta icinkunka pali Abusalomu.

english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.
translation: Elyo Hushai aebele Sadoki na Abiyata bashimapepo ati, “Aitofeli e mpandamano wakwa Abusalomu na bakalamba ba mu Israeli kukucita cakuti elyo na cakuti, lelo ine nimbapandako amano ayakucita ifyaibela.

english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”
translation: Eico nombalinefye tuma ishiwi no kweba Davidi auti, ‘Wisendama mu fyabu fya mu matololo, lelo wabukile kwishilya ukwabula ukufilwa.’ Pantu limbi imfumu na bantu bonse ili nabo baleisa ipaiwa.”

english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.
translation: Nomba Yonatani na Aimasi baleikala ku Eni Rogeli. Awe umubomfi umukashana eko aleya no kubeba, kabili nabo baleya no kweba imfumu Davidi, pantu cali icayafya nganshi ukumonekela uko baleingila mu musumba.

english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.
translation: Lelo akalumendo kamo kena kabamona no kweba Abusalomu. Kanshi bonse babili baima bwangu no kuya ku ŋanda ya umo mulumendo mu Bahurimu. Uyu muntu alikwete icishima mu lubansa lwa ŋanda yakwe, emo baingila.

english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.
translation: Awe umukashi epakubuula icakukupika pa cishima, akupikapo, ayanikapo ne mbuto. Kanshi tapali nelyo umo uwaishibe pali ici.

english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,
translation: Ndeya mulwisha ilyo acili uwatompoka no kunaka. Kabili ndeya mutiinya. Elyo abantu bakwe nabo bali nokufulumuka. Elyo ndi nokukoma imfumu yekafye,

english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo abantu bakwa Abusalomu baisa pa ŋanda ya uyu mwanakashi, baipusha abati, “Bushe bali kwi Aimasi na Yonatani?” Umwanakashi nao abasuka ati, “Nababuka umulonga.” Awe nabo abantu bafwayafwaya, lelo tabasangilepo nangu umo nakalya, kanshi epakubwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”
translation: Panuma ya aba bantu ilyo baya, Aimasi na Yonatani bafuma mu cishima no kuya eba imfumu Davidi abati, “Ima bwangu wabuke umumana. Pantu ifi efyo Aitofeli apandile amano pali iwe.”

english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na bantu bonse abalemukonka baima no kwabuka umumana wa Yordani. Elyo na pakuca ulucelo, takwashele nelyo umo uushayabwike umumana wa Yordani.

english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.
translation: Nomba Aitofeli ilyo amona ukuti tabakonkele ifyo abapandile amano, akaka icikakilo pali punda wakwe no kwima ukuya ku ŋanda yakwe, ku musumba wakwe. Apekanya bwino iŋanda yakwe elyo aikulika afwa, na bantu bamushiika mu nshinshi yakwa wishi.

english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
translation: Davidi aile ku Mahanaimu, ilyo Abusalomu ayabwike umumana wa Yordani pamo pene na bena Israeli bonse.

english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
translation: Elyo Abusalomu abikile Amasa ukuba umukalamba wa fita mu cifulo cakwa Yoabu. Amasa ali mwana wa muntu umo uo baleita ishina lya Yete umwina Israeli . Yete aupile Abigaili, umwana umwanakashi wakwa Nahashi, inkashi yakwa Seruiya nyina wakwa Yoabu.

english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.
translation: Abena Israeli na Abusalomu bacita inkambi mu calo ca bena Gileadi.

english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
translation: Ilyo Davidi aishile ku Mahanaimu, Shobi umwana wakwa Nahashi wa ku Raba wa bena Amoni, kabili Maki umwana wakwa Amieli wa ku Lo Deba, na Basilai umwina Gileadi wa ku Rogelimu,

english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,
translation: baleta ifyakusendamapo, ifyakufimbana, imbale ne nongo. Kabili baleta iŋanu, bale, ubunga, imbuto ishasalulwa, cilemba, elyo ne landa.

english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
translation: Baletele ubuci, umukaka uwasasamina, impaanga elyo no mukaka uwatikama ukufuma ku mukaka wa ŋombe kuli Davidi na bantu bakwe pakuti balye. Pantu batile, “Abantu bali ne nsala, nabanaka kabili bali ne cilaka mu matololo.”

english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”
translation: kabili nkabwesesha na bantu bonse kuli iwe. Imfwa ya muntu uo ufwaya ikalenga ukubwela kwa bonse. Abantu bonse bakaba umutende.”

english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
translation: Ubupekanyo ubu bwaba busuma kuli Abusalomu pamo na bakalamba bonse aba mu Israeli.

english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”
translation: Lelo Abusalomu asosele ati, “Shi iteni na Hushai mwana Aki, pakuti twise umfwa nao ifyo engasosapo.”

english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”
translation: Ilyo Hushai aisa kuli ena, Abusalomu atila, “Ni Aitofeli eutupandile aya mano. Bushe kuti twacita ifi asosele? Nga teifyo, twebeko amatontonkanyo yobe.”

english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”
translation: Nao Hushai epakwasuka Abusalomu ati, “Bumpandamano bwakwa Aitofeli uno muku tebusuma.”

english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
translation: Kabili atila, “Bawiso walibeshiba, pamo na bantu babo, ukuti babulwi kabili bakutiina nganshi kwatifye cinama ca mu mpanga cibea ico bafyushisha utwana. Elyo na cimbi cakutila, wiso untu wasalapuka nganshi ku bulwi. Ena tasendame apalelala ifita fyakwe.

english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’
translation: Moneni na nombaline wena nafisama mu lucengo nangu ku ncende imbi. Nga cakuti Davidi na bantu bakwe ebabalilapo ukusansa ifita fyobe, uyo onse uwaumfwa pali ici, kuti asosa atila, ‘Ifita fyakwa Abusalomu nabafipaulula.’

english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
translation: Elyo Davidi alonganike abantu ali nabo, no kusontapo abakalamba ba pa makana (1,000) elyo na bakalamba ba pa myanda (100).

english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”
translation: Ilyo umuntu umo amona ici, aeba Yoabu ati, “Nimona Abusalomu alepelela mu cimuti ca oki.”

english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”
translation: Yoabu nao asosa ku muntu uumwebele ifi ati, “Watila shani! Wacimumona? Cinshi ico ushacimukomawila palya pene, aponena na panshi? Lyena nga nakupeela indalama amashekeli ya silifa ikumi limo no mushipi wa mpalume.”

english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’
translation: Nao umuntu ayasuka Yoabu ati, “Nangufye wingampeela indalama amashekeli ikana limo (1,000) no kuyapima na mu lupi lwandi, awe ine teti njimye ukuboko kwandi no kwipaya umwana wa mfumu. Pantu bonse ala twacilayumfwila ilyo imfumu yacilakonkomesha iwe na Abishai na Itai ati, ‘Munsungileko bwino umulumendo Abusalomu.’

english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”
translation: Kanshi ine ncita icabipa mu bumi bwandi no kumwipaya, pantu takwaba icintu nelyo cimo icifiswa ku mfumu, na iwe wine nga nauntaluka.”

english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.
translation: Elyo Yoabu atila, “Ine nshikwete nshita yakonawila kuli iwe ngefi.” Abuula amafumo yatatu mu minwe yakwe no kuyalasa pa cifuba cakwa Abusalomu ilyo ninshi acili umumi ku cimuti ca oki.

english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.
translation: Elyo bakasenda wa fyanso fyakwa Yoabu bashinguluka Abusalomu, bamulasa no kumwipaya.

english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.
translation: Elyo Yoabu epakulisha ipenga, ne fita fyaleka ukukunkunika abena Israeli pakuleshiwa na Yoabu.

english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.
translation: Epakubuula Abusalomu, bamuposa mu cilindi icikalamba mu mutengo, no kutulikapo umwina ukulu uwa mabwe. Mu nshita iyi ninshi abena Israeli nabafulumuka cila umo ku ŋanda yakwe.

english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.
translation: Ilyo Abusalomu acili umumi, aliimikile umwine ilibwe lya cibukisho cakwe mu mukonko wa mfumu. Pantu atontonkenye ukuti, “Ine nshakwatapo umwana umwaume uwakulenga ishina lyandi ukwibukishiwa.” Ainike ici cibukisho ce libwe ishina lyakwe, ukushinta na lelo line bacita Icibukisho cakwa Abusalomu.

english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how the LORD has avenged him of his enemies.”
translation: Elyo Aimasi mwana Sadoki atile, “Shilekeni mbutukileko no kutwala ilyashi ku mfumu ukuti Yawe nakulubula ukufuma mu minwe ya balwani bobe.”

english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”
translation: Awe Davidi epakwakanya impuka sha fita patatu. Impuka imo abika mu minwe yakwa Yoabu, impuka imbi mu minwe yakwa Abishai munyina wakwa Yoabu umwana wakwa Seruiya, elyo imbi nayo mu minwe yakwa Itai umwina Gati. Elyo imfumu yaeba ifita aiti, “Icine cinefye na ine wine, tuleya bonse pamo.”

english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”
translation: Lelo Yoabu amweba ati, “Telelo uli nokutwala ilyashi ku mfumu. Uli nalimo ukutwala ili lyashi inshita imbi, lelo teti ucite ifi mu bushiku bwa lelo iyoo, pantu umwana wa mfumu nafwa.”

english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.
translation: Elyo Yoabu aeba umo umwina Kushi ati, “Kabiye kebe imfumu ifyo wamona.” Umwina Kushi nao epakukontamina panshi pakupeela umucinshi kuli Yoabu elyo abutuka.

english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”
translation: Aimasi umwana wakwa Sadoki atile kuli Yoabu, “Nangu cibe shani, napapata ndekafye na ine nkonke ulubilo pa numa ya mwina Kushi.” Lelo Yoabu ayasuka ati, “Mwana wandi cinshi ico na iwe ulefwaila ukukonkela? Iwe taukwete ilyashi nangu limo ilingapeelelwapo icilambu kuli iwe.”

english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.
translation: Nao Aimasi atile, “Nangu cibe shani, ndebutuka nkonke.” Kanshi Yoabu epakumweba ati, “Butuka.” Elyo Aimasi akonka ulubilo mu mbali ya nshila ye wanga no kucilawila umwina Kushi.

english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.
translation: Davidi acili ekele pakati ka mpongolo shibili, umulinshi anina pa mulu wa mutenge wa mpongolo pa cibumba. Ilyo ainuna amenso, amona umuntu umwaume alebutuka eka.

english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.
translation: Umulinshi apunda ku mfumu no kuyeba pali ici. Elyo imfumu yatila, “Nga cakuti alifye eka afwile ali ne lyashi ilisuma.” Nao umuntu esafye no kupalamina.

english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The king said, “He also brings news.”
translation: Kabili umulinshi amona umuntu na umbi alebutuka, elyo aita umulinshi wa pa mpongolo ati, “Mona umuntu na umbi alebutuka eka!” Elyo imfumu yatile, “Nao wine afwile aleletafye ilyashi ilisuma.”

english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”
translation: Elyo umulinshi atila, “Namona ine kwati muntu wantanshi ukubutuka kwakwe kupalile Aimasi mwana Sadoki.” Imfumu yatila, “Muntu umusuma uuli ne lyashi lisuma.”

english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is the LORD your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”
translation: Awe Aimasi akuuta ku mfumu nokutila, “Fyonse filifye bwino!” Pakuposha imfumu akontamina panshi nokutila, “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe Lesa wenu pakulubula abantu abaimishe amaboko yabo kuli shikulu imfumu yandi.”

english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “When Joab sent the king’s servant, even me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I don’t know what it was.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yaipwishe aiti, “Bushe umulumendo Abusalomu ali umutende?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Namwene icimfulunganya icikalamba mu nshitafye ilyo Yoabu ali nokuntuma ne mubomfi wenu. Elyo na ine ne mubomfi wenu, kwena nshishibe ifyo cali.”

english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”
translation: Lelo abantu batile, “Tecakwesha ukuti iwe we mfumu uye. Pantu nga cakuti ifwe twatitikishiwa, twafulumuka, tabakatusakamane ifwe iyoo. Nangufye nalimo citika wa pali ifwe afwa, nalyo line tabakatusakamane. Pantu iwe we mfumu naucila pali ifwe nangu tube amakana ikumi limo (10,000). Iwe cawama ukuti ube mu musumba pakuti uletutuminako ubwafwilisho.”

english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.
translation: Nayo imfumu yamweba aiti, “Iminina kumbali no kulolela pano pene.”

english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”
translation: Kabili nao umwina Kushi afika no kusosa ati, “Mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, umfweni ilyashi ilisuma! Yawe namulubula imwe ilelo ukufuma kuli bonse abamwimine.”

english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yaipusha umwina Kushi aiti, “Bushe umulumendo Abusalomu ali umutende?” Umwina Kushi nao ayasuka ati, “Shi abalwani bakwa shikulu imfumu yandi, na bonse abakwimina kukucita ububi bengaba ngo mulumendo uyu.”

english: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
translation: Elyo imfumu nayo yayasuka aiti, “Ine ndifye nokucita conse icamoneka icisuma kuli imwe.” Awe imfumu epakwiminina pa mbali ya mpongolo ilyo abantu bonse balefuma mu mpuka mu mpuka sha myanda elyo na mu makana.

english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.
translation: Elyo imfumu yakonkomesha Yoabu, Abishai na Itai aiti, “Pa mulandu wa ine, namulomba munsungileko umulumendo Abusalomu.” Elyo ne mpuka shonse shalyumfwile ifyo imfumu yakonkomeshe pa mulandu wakwa Abusalomu kuli cila mukalamba wa fita.

english: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.
translation: Kabili ifita fyakwa Davidi fyaile mu mpanga mukulwisha abena Israeli. Elyo ubulwi bwabelele mu mutengo wa Efulemu.

english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.
translation: Abena Israeli babacimfya ku bantu bakwa Davidi. Kabili kwali impendwa iyikulu nganshi iya bantu abo baipeye ukulingana na bantu amakana amakumi yabili (20,000).

english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
translation: Ubulwi bwasalangenefye mu calo conse. Elyo umutengo nao waipeye abantu abengi ukucila na bafwile ku lupanga.

english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.
translation: Awe cabafye nkuma, Abusalomu ninshi nanina pa mfalashi, yayapita mwisamba lya misambo ya cimuti cikulu ica oki, umutwe wakwa Abusalomu wakofya mu cimuti. Elyo ashala alepelelafye mu lwelele, ninshi imfalashi anininepo yena ileyafye.

english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”
translation: Elyo Yoabu aishile umfwa ukuti, “Imfumu ilelilafye no kuloosha Abusalomu.”

english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”
translation: Nomba Abusalomu, uo twasuba ukututeeka, nao nafwa mu bulwi. Nomba cinshi mushilelandilapo palwa kubwesha imfumu?”

english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?
translation: Imfumu Davidi epakutuma ishiwi kuli Sadoki na Abiyata bashimapepo ati, “Landeni ku bakalamba ba bena Yuda mutile, ‘Bushe mulandu nshi imwe mwabela abakushalikisha kukubwesha imfumu kwisano lyaiko? Pantu conse icasoswa calyumfwika na ku mfumu uko ikala.

english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’
translation: Imwe nimwe bamunyinane, umunofu wandifye kabili umulopa wandi. Kanshi ico mwingabela abakushalikisha mukubwesesha imfumu kwisano cinshi?’

english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”
translation: Kabili sosa kuli Amasa auti, ‘Bushe iwe tauli munofu wandifye kabili umulopa wandi? Shi Lesa mukulu nancitile conse ico engafwaya, nangufye ici cililepo, nga cakuti ukufuma pali nomba ukuya kuntanshi, nga cakuti tauli nokuba umukalamba wa fita fyandi mu cifulo cakwa Yoabu.’”

english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”
translation: Awe Amasa epakwalula imitima ya bantu bonse abena Yuda kwatifye mutima wa muntu umo. Elyo batuma ne shiwi ku mfumu abati, “Bweleni, imwe na bantu benu bonse.”

english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.
translation: Elyo imfumu nayo yabwelela no kuya lwa ku Yordani. Abena Yuda nabo bonse eko baya mukukonkela imfumu ku Giligali no kuileta ku Yordani.

english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
translation: Shimei umwana wakwa Gera, umwina Benjamini uwa mu Bahurimu, ewayangufyanya ukutentemukila pamo na bantu bakwa Yuda kukukumanya imfumu Davidi!

english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.
translation: Kabili ali na bena Benjamini ikana limo (1,000). Siba nao epo ali nga kangalila wa ŋanda yakwa Saulo, abana bakwe abaume ikumi limo na basano (15) elyo na babomfi amakumi yabili (20). Awe bayangufyanya ukuya ku Yordani, ilyo imfumu tailafikako.

english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.
translation: Elyo bonse bayabuka kukwabusha abana ba mfumu elyo no kubomba fyonse ifyo yalekabila. Ilyo Shimei umwana wakwa Gera ayabwike Yordani awile panshi ku cinso ca mfumu,

english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
translation: nokutila kuli ena, “Shi mwe shikulu wandi mwimpeela mulandu. Mwiibukisha ifyo umubomfi wenu acitile pa bushiku shikulu imfumu yandi yafumine mu Yerusalemu. Shi imfumu nga ingacifumya mu mutima waiko.

english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”
translation: Kabili ukucimfya kwa fita fyonse pali bulya bushiku kwasangwike ukuloosha ku bantu bonse, pantu ifita fyonse fyaumfwa ukuti pa bushiku bulya imfumu ilelilishika pa mwana waiko.

english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”
translation: Pantu ine ngo mubomfi wenu nalishiba ukuti nalibifya, lelo mu bushiku bwa lelo, ine ninjileta kuno ngo wakubalilapo pali bonse aba ŋanda yakwa Yosefu ukwisa no kukumanya shikulu imfumu yandi.”

english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
translation: Elyo Abishai umwana wakwa Seruiya atile, “Bushe Shimei talingile ukwipaiwa pali ici? Alilapishe umusubwa wakwa Yawe.”

english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”
translation: Elyo Davidi nao ayaswike ati, “Bushe imwe na ine, cinshi tuli naco cimo mu mano icakuti imwe mwe bana baume bakwa Seruiya mu bushiku bwe lelo musanguke abalwani bandi? Bushe mu bushiku bwe lelo ebo bengepayamo umuntu mu Israeli? Bushe ine muleti nshishibe ukuti ilelo nine imfumu ya bena Israeli?”

english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.
translation: Kanshi imfumu epakutila kuli Shimei, “Tauli nakufwa.” Ne mfumu epakumulaya mu mulapo.

english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.
translation: Mefibosheti, umwishikulu wakwa Saulo nao alishile mukwisa kumanya imfumu. Talesunga bwino amakasa yakwe nangufye ukubeya umwefu, talecapa ifyakufwala ukufuma ubushiku imfumu yaile no kufika ubushiku yabwelele mu cibote.

english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”
translation: Ilyo afikile ukufuma ku Yerusalemu ukukonkela imfumu, imfumu yamwipusha aiti, “Bushe cinshi calengele ukuti ukaane ukunkonka, Mefibosheti?”

english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Mwe shikulu imfumu yandi, apo ine ne mubomfi wenu ndi cilema, natile ndi nokuikakila icikakilo pali punda elyo ndi nokuninapo, nkaye pamo ne mfumu. Lelo Siba umubomfi wandi ewambepele ati ali nokucita.

english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.
translation: Kabili nabepesha no mubomfi wenu kuli shikulu imfumu yandi. Shikulu imfumu yandi aba kwati ni malaika wakwa Lesa, kanshi citeni icalamuwamina mu menso yenu.

english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”
translation: Pantu ulupwa lwakwa tata lonse lwalingilefye ukuti shikulu imfumu yandi ilwipaye. Lelo mwapeele umubomfi wenu incende pali abo abalya petebulo lyenu. Bushe ni nsambu nshi ndi nasho ishakupapata ku mfumu nakabili?”

english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatila kuli ena, “Cinshi ico ulesosa nakabili? Ine napingula ukuti iwe na Siba muli nokwakana impanga.”

english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
translation: Awe abantu basokelele mu musumba pali bulya bushiku kwati ni filya abantu basokelela ne nsoni nga bafuma ku bulwi.

english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”
translation: Nao Mefibosheti atile ku mfumu, “Shilekeni abuulefye fyonse, apo imfumu nomba naifika kwisano umutende.”

english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.
translation: Basilai umwina Gileadi, nao alitentemwike ukufuma ku Rogelimu mukwabusha imfumu umumana wa Yordani elyo no kuilangilila inshila ukufuma palya.

english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.
translation: Nomba Basilai ali mukote nganshi, ali ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse (80). Ewalepeelako imfumu ifyakulya, ilyo yaleikala mu Mahanaimu, pantu ali muntu umukankala nganshi.

english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
translation: Elyo imfumu epakweba Basilai aiti, “Isa twabuke bonse no kuya ikala bonse mu Yerusalemu. Kabili nakulakupeela fyonse ifyo ulekabila.”

english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
translation: Lelo Basilai nao ayasuka imfumu ati, “Bushe imyaka yandi ishele iyakwikala umumi ni inga pakuti ningaya ku Yerusalemu pamo ne mfumu?

english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?
translation: Ine nomba ndi ne myaka cine konse konse (80). Bushe ine kuti naishiba ukulekanya pakati kakuti ici cisuma nangu ukuti ici naco cibi? Bushe umubomfi obe kuti asonda icilyo ico ndyako neco nwako? Bushe na nombaline ncili ndeumfwa amashiwi ya bakemba abaume nangu abanakashi? Cinshi umubomfi wenu engabela icakufinya shikulu imfumu yandi?

english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?
translation: Umubomfi wenu alifye nokwabuka ne mfumu umumana wa Yordani intamfu iyinono. Nomba mulandu nshi imfumu inganambwila no kumpeela icilambu muli uyu musango?

english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”
translation: Shi umubomfi wenu lekeni abwelelemofye, pakuti nkafwilefye mu musumba wandi mupepi ukuli inshinshi yakwa tata na mayo. Lelo shi moneni umubomfi wenu Kimuamu, eo mulekeni abuke umumana pamo na shikulu imfumu yandi. Kanshi mumucitile conse icingawama mu menso yenu.”

english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yatile, “Kimuamu ali nokwabuka pamo na ine, elyo na ine, ndi nokumucitila conse icingakusekesha ku cinso cobe. Kabili na conse ico utemenwe ukuti ndi nokukucitila lyena nkacita.”

english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakwabuka no mumana wa Yordani, elyo imfumu nayo yayabuka. Imfumu epakutomona Basilai no kumupaala. Elyo Basilai abwelelamo kumwakwe ku ŋanda.

english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”
translation: Imfumu yafimbile ku menso no kulila umusowa uukalamba ileti, “We mwana wandi Abusalomu! We Abusalomu, mwana wandi!”

english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yayabukila ku Giligali, Kimuamu ayabwike nankwe pamo. Impuka shonse ishakwa Yuda elyo na citika wa mpuka shonse isha bena Israeli bayafwilishe bonse mukwabusha imfumu umumana.

english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”
translation: Kabili moneni bwangu bwangu abantu bonse abena Israeli baleisa ku mfumu no kulasosa kuli yena abati, “Bushe mulandu nshi bamunyinefwe abena Yuda basendela imfumu no lupwa no kubabusha umumana wa Yordani pamo pene na bantu bakwe bonse?”

english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”
translation: Elyo abantu bonse abena Yuda bayasuka abena Israeli abati, “Tucitile ici pantu imfumu muntu uupalamine na ifwe nganshi. Nomba ico mwingafulwa cinshi? Bushe ifwe tulya icili conse icifuma ku mfumu? Bushe natusendapo icintu nangu cimo ukuba icesu?”

english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bayasuka abena Yuda abati, “Ifwe natukwata icakaniko ukulingana ne kumi limo mu mfumu. Kabili na cimbi nici, ifwe natukwatapo insambu ishingi pali Davidi ukucila isho imwe mukwete. Kanshi cinshi ico mwatusuulila? Bushe teifwe twali abantanshi abakulanda palwa kubwela kwakwa Davidi imfumu?” Lelo abena Yuda bayasuka bukali bukali ukucila abena Israeli.

english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;
translation: Awe Yoabu aingila mu ŋanda umwali mfumu nokutila, “Ilelo walenga abantu bobe bonse insoni abapuswishe ubumi bobe ne myeo ya bana bobe abaume elyo na bakashi bobe pamo na bakashi bobe abo washaupile mu bwinga.

english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.
translation: Pantu iwe watemwa abakupata elyo wapata abakutemwa. Ilelo walanga apabuuta ukuti abakalamba ba fita na bantu babo tabali cintu kuli iwe. Ine namona ukuti iwe nga wacisansamuka ilelo, Abusalomu eo aba umumi na ifwe bonse atufwa.

english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by the LORD, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”
translation: Nomba kabiye, fuma no kuya koselesha abantu bobe. Ine nalapa napalifye Yawe ukuti iwe nga taufumine nokuya, takwabe umuntu nangu umo uuleshala na iwe pakuti buce. Ici cili nokukubipila nganshi ukucila na pa mashamo yakuponena ukufuma ku bulumendo bobe ukufika na nomba.”

english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.
translation: Kanshi imfumu epakwima no kwikala pa cipuna caiko pa mpongolo. Ilyo baeba abantu ukuti, “Imfumu ikele pa mpongolo,” awe bonse baisa longana ku cinso caiko.

english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.
translation: Mu ncendefye monse umwali inko sha bena Israeli, abantu bonse balaumana abene beka, balasosa abati, “Imfumu eyatulubwile mu maboko ya balwani besu. Kabili eyatupuswishe ukufuma mu maboko ya Bafilisiti. Lelo nomba moneni, naifulumuka mu calo pa mulandu wakwa Abusalomu.

english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Saulo, Davidi abwelele ukufuma uko aile lwisha no kucimfya abena Amaleki no kuya ikala mu Sikilagi inshiku shibili.

english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”
translation: Kanshi efyo naciya palama pali ena no kumwipaya, pantu nacishiba ukuti filya aciwa, teti abuuke no kuba no mweo. Elyo nabuula icisote icali ku mutwe wakwe, ne kosa ilyali ku kuboko no kufileta kuno kwine kuli shikulu wandi.”

english: Then David took hold on his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.
translation: Awe Davidi na bantu bakwe bonse abo ali nabo babuula ifyakufwala fyabo no kulepaula.

english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
translation: Baloosha no kulila elyo bafunga ukulya mpaka icungulo, pali Saulo na Yonatani umwana wakwe, pa fita fyakwa Yawe elyo na pa ŋanda yakwa Israeli pantu bafwile ku lupanga.

english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipusha umulumendo uwamuletele ilyashi ati, “Bushe ni kwi ufumine?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ine ndi mwana wa mwinafyalo umwina Amaleki.”

english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
translation: Elyo Davidi amwipusha ati, “Bushe mulandu nshi tawacikwatila umwenso wakwimya ukuboko kobe mukonaula umusubwa wakwa Yawe?”

english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.
translation: Elyo Davidi aita umo pa bantu bakwe nokutila, “Kabiye, umukome!” Kanshi epakumukoma, mpaka afwa.

english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain the LORD’s anointed.’”
translation: Elyo Davidi amweba ati, “Umulopa obe, ube pa mutwe obe. Pantu akanwa kobe ekakushinine ilyo usosele auti, ‘Ine nine njipeye umusubwa wakwa Yawe.’”

english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son
translation: Elyo Davidi aimbile ulwimbo lwa cililo pali Saulo no mwana wakwe Yonatani.

english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):
translation: Kabili akonkomeshe abena Yuda ukuti bafwile ukusambilisha ulu lwimbo lwakufwa ku buta, ngefyo calembwa mu citabo cakwa Yasha ukuti,

english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
translation: “Ubucindami bobe we Israeli bwaipailwa pa mpili shobe.

english: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.
translation: Ubushiku bwalenga shitatu, umuntu umo aisa ukufuma ku nkambi yakwa Saulo, ninshi ne nsalu shakwe nashilepauka no lukungu luli ku mutwe wakwe. Ilyo afika pali Davidi, alambalala panshi mukupeela umucinshi.

english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
translation: Tecakwesha ukucilandapo mu Gati,

english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.
translation: “Imwe mwe mpili sha Giliboa,

english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.
translation: Ukufuma ku mulopa wa abo baipeye,

english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.
translation: “Saulo na Yonatani abatemwikwa kabili abantu abasuma,

english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
translation: “Imwe mwe bana banakashi bakwa Israeli loosheni Saulo,

english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.
translation: “Yangu ifyo impalume shafwila mu bulwi ee!

english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.
translation: Ndi no bulanda pa mulandu wa iwe Yonatani we munyinane.

english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”
translation: “Yangu ifyo impalume shafwa ee!

english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”
translation: Elyo Davidi amwipusha ati, “Bushe ni kwisa wafuma?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ine nafyukafye ukufuma ku nkambi ya bena Israeli.”

english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”
translation: Davidi amwipusha ati, “Cinshi cicitike? Njeba.” Nao ayasuka ati, “Abashilika abengi nabafulumuka ukufuma ku bulwi, elyo kabili abengi nabo nabafwa, na Saulo no mwana wakwe Yonatani nabo nabafwa.”

english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”
translation: Elyo Davidi atile ku mulumendo uwamuletele ilyashi, “Bushe iwe wishibe shani ukuti Saulo elyo no mwana wakwe Yonatani nabafwa?”

english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.
translation: Umulumendo ayasuka ati, “Ine naciba pa mulu wa lupili lwa Giliboa elyo namona Saulo ninshi ifumo nalimulasa elyo aba maceleta na benda pali bakabalwe balepalamina apo ali.

english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’
translation: Ilyo acipilibuka amona, elyo acinjita. Na ine nacasuka nati, ‘Ndi pano mukwai.’

english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
translation: Elyo anjipusha ati, ‘Bushe niwe ani?’ Na ine nayasuka nati, ‘Ndi mwina Amaleki.’

english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’
translation: Epakunjeba ati, ‘Isa pano ndi, wise unjipaye! Ine ndifye mu mfwa, nelyo ncili umumi.’

english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”
translation: Elyo kwali intalamisoka yamuntu, ishina lyakwe ni Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri, umwina Benjamini. Alilishishe ipenga no kulapunda ati, “Ifwe tatuli na cakaniko muli Davidi, tatukwetemo ne cishilano muli mwana Yese! Mwe bena Israeli bonse kabiyeni cila umo kumwakwe!”

english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
translation: Nomba Amasa tamwene ukuti Yoabu ali no lupanga mu minwe yakwe. Yoabu epakumulasa mwifumo, na mala yapongolokela panshi. Kabili tabwekeshepo ukumulasa nakabili, Amasa afwa no kufwa. Elyo Yoabu na Abishai munyina, epakukonka lunkwa lunkwa Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri.

english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”
translation: Awe umo uwa mu bantu bakwa Yoabu aiminina pambali ya citumbi cakwa Amasa nokusosa ati, “Uyo onse uwatemwa Yoabu, kabili uuli uwakwa Davidi, nakonke Yoabu!”

english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.
translation: Ninshi icitumbi cakwa Amasa cilefuntaukafye mu mulopa waciko mukati ka musebo. Uyu muntu amona nokuti fyonse ifita fyaimiminafye palya pene. Ilyo amona ukuti onse umuntu naiminina, epakusesha icitumbi ukucifumya mu musebo, amulalika mu mpanga, amufimba ne cakufwala.

english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
translation: Na panuma ilyo Amasa aseshiwa mu musebo, abantu bonse batwalilila pamo na Yoabu ukukonka lunkwa lunkwa Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri.

english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.
translation: Uyu Sheba ninshi napita kale mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli ukufika na ku Abeli Beti Maka no kupitilila ukuya ku mpanga yonse iya bena Beri, bonse epakulongana no kumukonka.

english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
translation: Bonse abantu pamo na Yoabu bashinguluka umusumba wa Abeli Beti Maka umwali Sheba. Batulumanika imina ya fisoso fya maloba ukufika ku musumba, ukulinganafye ne linga lyabelele kunse, elyo batampa ukubolaula icibumba pakuti baciwishe.

english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”
translation: Isham 12:16

english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”
translation: Nao aya kuli ena elyo amwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe niwe Yoabu?” Nao atila, “Nine wine.” Umwanakashi ati, “Umfwa kufyo umubomfi obe alesosa.” Nao Yoabu ayasuka ati, “Ndeumfwa.”

english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.
translation: Awe umwanakashi atwalilila mukusosa ati, “Mu nshiku shakale abantu balesosa abati, ‘nga ulefwaya ubwasuko busuma kabiye ku Abeli, elyo ukapwisha umulandu.’

english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
translation: Ifwe tuli aba mutende kabili aba cishinka mu Israeli. Imwe mulefwayafye ukonaula umusumba uuli e nyina mu Israeli. Cinshi ico mulefwaila ukumina icuma ca cishilano cakwa Yawe?”

english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.
translation: Kanshi bonse abena Israeli epakusha Davidi nokulakonka Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri. Lelo abena Yuda bena mu cishinka bashala ne mfumu yabo, ukufuma ku Yordani mpaka ku Yerusalemu.

english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
translation: Yoabu nao epakwasuka ati, “Awe nacitaluke kuli ine icakumina nangu ukonaula umusumba!

english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
translation: Uyo teo e mulandu iyoo. Umuntu uwe shina lya Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri ukufuma ku calo ca mpili ica Efulemu, eubifishe ku mfumu Davidi. Mpeni uyu wine umuntu eka, na ine nalafumako ku musumba.” Elyo umwanakashi ayasuka Yoabu ati, “Umutwe wakwe twalauposa kuli imwe pa mulu wa cibumba.”

english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
translation: Yoabu ali e mukalamba wa fita fyonse ifya bena Israeli. Benaya umwana wakwa Yehoiyada ali nao e mukalamba pa bena Kereti na bena Peleti.

english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
translation: Adoramu nao ali kangalila wa bamulaasa. Yehoshafati umwana wakwa Ailudi nao ali ni kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo.

english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
translation: Shefa ali ni kalemba wa milandu. Sadoki na Abiyata bali ni bashimapepo.

english: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.
translation: Elyo Ira umwina Yairi nao ali shimapepo wakwa Davidi.

english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
translation: Ilyo Davidi abwelele kwisano lyakwe mu Yerusalemu, abuula abakashi balya abo ashaupile mu bwinga ikumi, abo ashile mukusunga isano, ababika mu ŋanda yakubalindilamo. Alabapeela fyonse ifyo balekabila, lelo talekumana nabo iyoo. Basungilwe bucitente mpaka ubushiku bwa mfwa yabo. Baikele kwati ni bamukamfwilwa.

english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yasosa kuli Amasa ati, “Njitila abena Yuda bonse bese kuli ine mu nshiku shitatu, na iwe wine ulingile ukuba kuno kwine.”

english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.
translation: Lelo ilyo Amasa aya mukwita Yuda, akokola ukucila pa nshita imfumu yamupimine.

english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atila kuli Abishai, “Nomba Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri ali uwabonaushi ububi kuli ifwe, ukucila ububi bwakwa Abusalomu. Iwe buula abantu bakwa sokulu no kumukonka lunkwa lunkwa, epali asanga imisumba ya malinga no kupusukilamo ukufuma kuli ifwe.”

english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
translation: Kanshi abantu bakwa Yoabu, abena Kereti, abena Peleti elyo na shonse impalume shabulamba, shafuma shaya ukulingana no kukonkomeshiwa kwakwa Abishai. Awe bafuma mu Yerusalemu mukukonka lunkwa lunkwa Sheba umwana wakwa Bikiri.

english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.
translation: Ilyo bacili pa cilibwe icikalamba icaba mu Gibeoni, Amasa aisa mukubakonkela. Yoabu afwele tumba yakwe iyabulwi, napikila mu musana ulupanga, ulwali mu citubo. Ilyo apalaminako, ulupanga lwasolomoka ukufuma mu citubo lwawa panshi.

english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
translation: Elyo Yoabu asosa kuli Amasa ati, “Bushe we munyinane, uli shani?” Nao Yoabu aikata Amasa ku mwefu ku kuboko kwa ku kulyo kukumutomona.

english: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”
translation: Mu nshiku sha kuteeka kwakwa Davidi, kwali icipowe pa myaka itatu, calebako cila mwaka. Kanshi Davidi epakwipusha Yawe. Nao Yawe amwasuka ati, “Saulo no lupwa lwakwe bacili no mulandu wakusumya umulopa, pantu balipaya abena Gibeoni.”

english: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.
translation: Risipa umwana umwanakashi wakwa Aia abuula insalu shabulanda no kuyanshikila icakwikalapo pa mwalala. Ukufuma pa kwamba kwa kusombola mpaka imfula yaloboka ukufuma ku mulu yalokela na pa fitumbi, Risipa talekele ifyuni fya mu lwelele fiwepo akasuba nangufye finama fya mpanga mu bushiku.

english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
translation: Baebele Davidi ifyo Risipa umwana wakwa Aia acitile, uwali umukashi wakwa Saulo uo ashaupile mu bwinga.

english: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;
translation: Ilyo Davidi aumfwileko, aimine aya senda amafupa yakwa Saulo pamo no mwana wakwe Yonatani ukuyafumya ku bakalamba abekalacalo ba mu Yabeshi Gileadi. Aba ebayafyushishe mu bumfisolo ukufuma mu lubansa lwa cintubwingi ulwa Beti Shani, uko Abafilisiti babakulikile, panuma yakwipaya Saulo pa Giliboa.

english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
translation: Davidi epakuleta amafupa yakwa Saulo no mwana wakwe Yonatani ukuyafumya kulya, na mafupa ya bantu balya abo baipeye mukukulikwa pa lwalala, bayalonganya pamo.

english: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
translation: Bashiikile amafupa yakwa Saulo na yakwa Yonatani umwana wakwe mu nshinshi yakwa Kishi, wishi wakwa Saulo ku Sela mu calo cakwa Benjamini. Kabili bacitile fyonse ifyo imfumu ya bakonkomeshe. Elyo na panuma ya ifyo, Lesa epakwasuka amapepo, alangulukila ne calo.

english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;
and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
translation: Elyo Ishibi Benobu, umo uwa pa lupwa lwakwa Rafa, uo ifumo lya mukuba lyakwe lyafinine amashekeli imyanda itatu (300) kabili uwaipangeshe no lupanga ulupya, atile, “Ndi nokwipaya Davidi.”

english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
translation: Lelo Abishai mwana Seruiya epakwisa kuli Davidi kukumupususha. Awe alasapo Umufilisiti uyo, amwipaya. Elyo abantu bakwa Davidi balapa pa cinso cakwe abati, “Tecakwesha nakabili ukuya na ifwe ku bulwi, epakuti icisaniko ca bena Israeli cikashima.”

english: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
translation: Nomba umuyila inshiku, ubulwi na bumbi bwabako na Bafilisiti, ku Gobu. Muli ubu bulwi Sibekai umwina Hushati aipeye Safa, uwali uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Rafa.

english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);
translation: Awe imfumu epakwita abena Gibeoni no kulanda nabo. Nomba abena Gibeoni tabali ba mu bena Israeli iyoo, lelo bena bali bena Amoli abasheleko, abo abena Israeli balapilepo umulapo ukuti bena bakabasha. Lelo Saulo mukutemwisha abena Israeli na bena Yuda, eco alefwaila ukwipaya abena Gibeoni.

english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
translation: Nakabili ku bulwi na bumbi ubwacitike ku cifulo ca Gati, kwaliko icimuntu icalunduka nganshi. Cali ne minwe mutanda kuli cila cisansa, kabili cali ne fikondo mutanda kuli cila lukasa, fyonse pamo fyali amakumi yabili na fine (24). Nao wine ali uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Rafa.

english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
translation: Kanshi ilyo ena asebenye abena Israeli, Yonatani mwana Shimeya, munyina Davidi alimwipeye.

english: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
translation: Aba bonse bane bali ba mu lupwa lwakwa Rafa mu Gati, kabili bonse bafwile ku minwe yakwa Davidi na bantu bakwe.

english: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”
translation: Yosh 9:3-15

english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”
translation: Abena Gibeoni nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatwakwata nsambu shakwipusha silifa nangu golide ukufuma kuli Saulo nangu ku lupwa lwakwe. Kabili tecansambu kuli ifwe ukubuula umo umwina Israeli no kumwipaya.” Davidi akonkeshapo ukubepusha nakabili ati, “Cinshi ico mulefwaya ine ukumucitila?”
