english: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,
translation: Nabo kabili bayasuka imfumu ati, “Pamo ngo muntu uwatonawile kabili uwapangile no kutulofya pakuti twibako nangu ukukwatamo incende mu calo ca bena Israeli,

english: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”
translation: shi tulubwilenifye abana abaume bakwe cine lubali tukabepaye no kubatwala pa lwalala mukubakulikila pa cinso cakwa Yawe ku Gibea icifulo cakwa Saulo uo Yawe asalile.” Nayo imfumu epakusumina aiti, “Cisuma ndi nokubalubwila kuli imwe.”

english: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
translation: Lelo imfumu yalangulukila Mefibosheti umwana wakwa Yonatani mwana Saulo pa mulandu wa mulapo bacitile pa cinso cakwa Yawe, uwali pakati kakwa Davidi elyo na Yonatani umwana wakwa Saulo.

english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
translation: Lelo imfumu epakubuula Amoni, Mefibosheti, abana abaume babili abakwa Risipa umwana mwanakashi wakwa Aia, abo afyele kuli Saulo, pamo pene na bana abaume basano abo Merabi umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo afyele kuli Adirieli umwana wakwa Basilai umwina Meholati.

english: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
translation: Aba bonse imfumu Davidi yabalubwila na mu maboko ya bena Gibeoni, nabo babepaya no kubatwala pa lwalala epo babakulikila pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Bonsefye cine lubali bafwilefye pamo. Baipaiwa mu nshiku shantanshi isha bulobololo bwa fisabo, pakutendeka ubulobololo bwa bale.

english: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
translation: Davidi aimbile amashiwi ya muli ulu lwimbo kuli Yawe, ilyo Yawe amupokolwele ku balwani bakwe bonse na ku kuboko kwakwa Saulo.

english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
translation: Afumine ku mulu no kwisa ikila pano panshi,

english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
translation: Kabili aninine na pali kerubi no kupupuka.

english: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
translation: Alengele imfifi ukumushinguluka monse monse,

english: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
translation: Ukufuma mu lubuuto lwa pa ntanshi yakwe,

english: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
translation: Yawe abulukuta nge mfula mu mulu,

english: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.
translation: Aposa imifwi no kusalanganya abalwani,

english: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
translation: Kabili panshi ya bemba palamoneka,

english: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
translation: “Elyo atambalike ukuboko kwakwe ukufuma mu mulu,

english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
translation: Ampokolwele ku balwani bandi abamaka,

english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
translation: Banjimine mu bushiku bwa cinkunka candi,

english: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
translation: “Yawe e cilibwe candi, ilinga lyandi kabili kapokolola wandi.

english: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
translation: Amfumishemo no kumbika apapabuka,

english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
translation: “Yawe nancitila ukulingana no bulungami bwandi.

english: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
translation: Pantu ine ndacita ififwaya Yawe,

english: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
translation: Nshafumako ku mafunde yakwe yonse ayaba ku ntanshi yandi,

english: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
translation: Kanshi ine ndi uwabula akalema ku cinso cakwa Yawe,

english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
translation: Eico Yawe nanambula ukulingana no bulungami bwandi.

english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
translation: “Ku wacishinka, na iwe we mwine ulailanga uwacishinka.

english: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
translation: Kuli abo abapwililika, na iwe we mwine ulailanga ukuba uwapwililika.

english: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
translation: Iwe upususha abaicefya,

english: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.
translation: Mu cinefye ala niwe cisaniko candi, we Yawe.

english: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
translation: Lesa wandi e cilibwe candi, umo ine nguba,

english: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
translation: Ku maka yobe kuti nasansa impuka ya mulalo,

english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
translation: Lelo Lesa ena, inshila yakwe yalilungama,

english: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?
translation: “Nga Lesa umbi nani, uwingacila pali Yawe?

english: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
translation: Ala ni Lesa eumpangasha amaka,

english: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
translation: Eulenga makasa yandi ukuba nga makasa ya nsebula,

english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
translation: Alasambilisha ne minwe yandi ku bulwi,

english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
translation: Kabili walimpeela inkwela ye pusukilo.

english: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
translation: Kabili walikusha inshila umwakupita intampulo shandi,

english: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
translation: Nakunkunike abalwani bandi no kubonaula,

english: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
translation: Napwishishefye bonse umupwilapo, icakuti bafilwa ukwima,

english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
translation: Ndekuuta kuli Yawe uwalinga ukulumbanya,

english: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
translation: Pantu walimpangeshe amaka yakulwilako,

english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
translation: Walengele na balwani bandi bamfutatile inuma shabo pakufulumuka,

english: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
translation: Bafwaile uwakubafwa, lelo takwali nangu umo uwakubapususha.

english: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
translation: Nalibonawile baba ngo lukungu lwa panshi.

english: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
translation: “Walimpuswishe ukufuma ku bantu bandi abansangukila.

english: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
translation: Abenafyalo baisa mukumpakata.

english: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
translation: Bena bonse baba abatompoka imitima,

english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
translation: “Nakalebalika kuli Yawe! Napaalwe na matotelo Icilibwe candi!

english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
translation: E Lesa uunandwilako,

english: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
translation: Kabili uumpususha ku balwani bandi.

english: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
translation: “Pantu amatamba ya mfwa yalinshingulwike,

english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
translation: “Eico kanshi ine ndifye nokulalumbanya iwe we Yawe pakati ka mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
translation: Ulalenga imfumu yobe ukucimfya,

english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
translation: Imyando ya ku calo ca bafwa yalimpombele.

english: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
translation: Mu kupelelwa kwandi nalilile kuli Yawe,

english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
translation: “Isonde lyalitenkene no kusunkana,

english: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
translation: Mu myona yakwe mwafumine icushi.

english: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
translation: Aya e mashiwi yakulekelesha ayakwa Davidi.

english: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
translation: Awe Eleasa wena ashipa, alaipaya na Bafilisiti mpakafye amaboko yakwe yanakuka, ne minwe yalambatila ku lupanga. Nao Yawe alenga nokuti bacimfye apakalamba pa bushiku bulya. Awe ne fita fyonse fyabwelela na kuli Eleasa, kukubuulako ifitapwa ku bafwa.

english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
translation: Uwakonka pali Eleasa ni Shamaya umwana mwaume wakwa Age umwina Harari. Ilyo Abafilisiti balongene pamo mu mpuka shabo pa cifulo cimo apali ibala lye landa, abena Israeli balifulumwikepo.

english: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.
translation: Lelo Shamaya wena ashipa, aiminina na pakati ke bala. Alicingilila, elyo aipaya Abafilisiti. Awe Yawe nao alengele ukuti bacimfye apakalamba.

english: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Elyo batatu pa ntungulushi amakumi yatatu (30), batentemwike baisa kuli Davidi ku lucengo lwa Adulamu, mu nshiku shabulobololo, ninshi impuka ya Bafilisiti nabacita inkambi mwishika lya Refaimu.

english: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
translation: Pa nshita ilya Davidi ali mwilinga, elyo akamba ka bashilika ba Bafilisiti nako kaleikala mu Betelemu.

english: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
translation: Awe Davidi nao alefwaisha amenshi elyo asosa ati, “Yangu ifyo ningatemwa nga cakuti umo andetelako amenshi yakunwa ukufuma mu cishima ca mupepi ne mpongolo ya ku Betelehemu.”

english: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.
translation: Awe impalume shitatu shaima, shalalanya pakati ka mipaka ya Bafilisiti, shatapa na menshi ukufuma mu cishima caba mupepi ne mpongolo ya Betelehemu no kusenda ukutwala kuli Davidi. Lelo Davidi akaana ukunwa amenshi. Mu cifulo cakunwa Davidi ayetila kukuyatuula ku cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
translation: Atile ati, “Yawe nampusushe, nacibe ukutali ici cintu! Bushe uku tekunwa umulopa wa bantu abaile nabashitika ubumi bwabo abene kukufwa?” Kanshi Davidi akaana ukunwa. Efyo ishi mpalume shitatu shacitile.

english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
translation: Abishai munyina wakwa Yoabu umwana mwaume wakwa Seruiya ewali umukalamba pali ishi mpalume shitatu . Ena ewaimishe ifumo lyakwe alasaula abalwani imyanda itatu (300) no kubepaya. Elyo aisa ba ne shina ilyalumbuka nga aba bene batatu.

english: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
translation: Bushe ena tewalumbwike nganshi ukucila pali batatu ? Icakuti aisa ba no mukalamba wabo, nangu cali ukuti tapendelwe pakati kabo.

english: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
translation: “Umupashi wakwa Yawe ulandila muli ine.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
translation: Benaya umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoiyada, umwina Kabiseli, ali ni mpalume yapilikita kukulwa, umuntu uwacitile ifintu ifingi ifyabulamba. Aipeye abantu abapambana abena Moabu. Elyo kabili atentemukila mu cilindi ninshi kuli na menshi makasa, no kwipayamo inkalamo.

english: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
translation: Kabili aipaya no mwina Egupto uwalunduka nganshi. Nangu umwina Egupto akwete ifumo mu minwe yakwe, Benaya nao aile kuli ena ne nkontofye. Amusompola ifumo mu minwe, amwipaila na kwifumo lyakwe line.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
translation: Efintu ifyo Banaya umwana mwaume wakwa Yehoiyada acitile. Uyu nao wine ishina lyakwe lyali ilyaishibikwa kwati ni mpalume shitatu isha bantu.

english: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
translation: Ali uwacindikwa nganshi ukucila pali onse uwa pa makumi yatatu (30), nomba tapendelwe pali balya batatu. Elyo Davidi epakumucita ukuba kangalila wa bakalinda wakwe.

english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
translation: Impalume shimbi isha mu ba makumi yatatu (30) ni aba:

english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
translation: Shamaya umwina Harodi,

english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
translation: Helesi umwina Paliti,

english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
translation: Abiesa umwina Anatoti,

english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
translation: Salimoni umwina Ahoyi,

english: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
translation: Helebu umwana mwaume wakwa Baanaya umwina Netofa,

english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
translation: Lesa wakwa Israeli nalanda,

english: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
translation: Benaya umwina Piratoni,

english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
translation: Abi Aliboni umwina Aribati,

english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
translation: Eliaba umwina Shaaliboni

english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
translation: Yonatani umwana mwaume wakwa Shamaya umwina Harari,

english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
translation: Elifeleti umwana mwaume wakwa Ahasibai umwina Maakati,

english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
translation: Hesiro umwina Kameli,

english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
translation: Igali umwana mwaume wakwa Natani umwina Soba,

english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
translation: Seleki umwina Amoni,

english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
translation: Ira umwina Itira,

english: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
translation: elyo na Uria umwina Hiti.

english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
translation: aba kwati lubuuto lwa kacelo,

english: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?
translation: “Bushe iŋanda yandi tayaba ifi kuli Lesa?

english: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.
translation: Lelo abantu babifi bena baba nge myunga ya mu matololo iyakuposafye,

english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
translation: Elyo umuntu onse pakuikatako,

english: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.
translation: Aya e mashina ya mpalume shabulwi shakwa Davidi: Yoshebu Basebeti umwina Takemoni, umukalamba wa baume bene bene batatu. Aimishe ifumo lyakwe mukulwisha abantu imyanda cine konse konse (800), abo aipeye pa muku umofye.

english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.
translation: Kabili uwamukonkelepo pali bumpalume ali ni Eleasa umwana umwaume wakwa Dodo umwina Ahoyi. Pamo nga umo uwali pa mpalume shitatu, ali na Davidi ilyo baile sonsomba Abafilisiti uko balongene ku bulwi ku Pasi Damimu. Elyo abena Israeli bafulumuka.

english: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
translation: Kabili ubukali bwakwa Yawe bwabwekeshepo ukwisa pa bena Israeli. Awe aluminisha Davidi pakuti abaletelele, amweba ati, “Ima kabiye uye penda abena Israeli elyo na bena Yuda.”

english: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”
translation: Davidi aumfwile umutima wakunta panuma yakupenda abantu ababulamba. Elyo asosa kuli Yawe ati, “Ine nimbifya apakalamba paco ncitile. Nomba we Yawe, nakupapata, fumya umulandu uyu pa mubomfi obe, pantu ico ncitile cabuwelewele.”

english: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
translation: Ilyo Davidi ashibwike mu lucelo lwakonkelepo, kwafuma ishiwi kuli Yawe ukweba Gadi kasesema, kamona wakwa Davidi aliti,

english: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
translation: “Kabiye kebe Davidi auti, ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Nalakupeela ifya kusalapo fitatu. Salapo cimo ico ulefwaya, ico mfwile ukucita kuli iwe.’”

english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”
translation: Kanshi nao Gadi epakuya kuli Davidi no kumweba ati, “Bushe ulefwaya pa myaka itatu kukese icipowe mu calo? Nangu pa myeshi itatu ukalefulumukafye abalwani bobe ilyo bakukonka lunkwa lunkwa? Nangu ukuti icikuko pa nshiku shitatu cikese onaula icalo cobe? Kanshi nomba tontonkanya, unjebe icakuya eba uuntumine.”

english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”
translation: Elyo Davidi ayasuka Gadi ati, “Awe kwena ndi uwacucutika nganshi. Shi katuibikefye mu minwe yakwa Yawe, pantu uluse lwakwe lukalamba nganshi. Lelo mwileka mponene mu minwe ya bantunse.”

english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakutuma icikuko pa bena Israeli, ukufuma pali lulya lucelo ukushinta na pakupwa kwa nshita iyapiminwe. Abantu abafwile ukufuma ku Dani ukufika na ku Beresheba bali amakana amakumi cine lubali (70,000).

english: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
translation: Lelo ilyo malaika atambalike ukuboko pa Yerusalemu kukuonaula, Yawe nao epakulangulukila abantu pa mulandu wa macushi. Aeba malaika uwaleipaya abantu ati, “Capwa! Bwesha ukuboko kobe.” Ninshi malaika wakwa Yawe ali pa lubansa lwakutwilapo ulwakwa Arauna umwina Yebusi.

english: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”
translation: Ilyo Davidi amona malaika uwaleipaya abantu, asosa kuli Yawe ati, “Ala ne wabifishe nine no kulufyanya. Lelo aba ni mpaangafye. Ni finshi bacitile? Uleke ukuboko kobe kube pali ine no lupwa lwandi.”

english: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”
translation: Pa bushiku bwine ubu, Gadi aile kuli Davidi nokutila kuli ena, “Ima kabiye mukukuulila Yawe ubulambo pa lubansa lwakutwilapo ulwakwa Arauna umwina Yebusi.”

english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.
translation: Davidi nao epakuya, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe ukupitila muli Gadi.

english: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”
translation: Elyo Davidi epakweba Yoabu ne ntungulushi sha fita fyali nankwe ati, “Ima kabiyeni piteni mu nko shonse isha bena Israeli ukufuma ku Dani ukufika ku Beresheba no kupenda abantu pakuti njishibe bali banga.”

english: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
translation: Ilyo Arauna alolesha no kumona imfumu na bantu baiko baleisa kuli ena, afumina panse no kukontama pa cinso ca mfumu, ashimpa ne mpumi panshi.

english: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
translation: Elyo Arauna asosa ati, “Mulandu nshi shikulu imfumu yaishila ku mubomfi wenu?” Davidi nao ayasuka ati, “Naisa kukushita ulubansa lobe ulwakutwilapo, apakuti tukuulile Yawe ubulambo, pakuti icikuko cipwe ku bantu.”

english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
translation: Awe Arauna ayasuka Davidi ati, “Shi, shikulu imfumu yandi naibuule icaisekesha no kutuula kuli Yawe. Moneni iŋombe ishilume ishi, ishakutuula ilambo lya cakoca. Kabili moneni imilando yakutwilako elyo na makoli ya ŋombe aya, e nkuni.

english: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”
translation: Moneni fyonse ifi, mwe mfumu, Arauna apeela kuli imwe.” Elyo kabili asosa ati “Shi Yawe Lesa obe engapokelela ilambo lyobe.”

english: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
translation: Lelo imfumu yayasuka Arauna aiti, “Iyoo ine ndefwayafye ukushita. Ine nshilefwaya ukutuula ku mfumu Lesa wandi amalambo yakoca ayo nshishitile iyoo.”

english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.
translation: Davidi akuulile Yawe ubulambo kulya no kutuula amalambo ya cakoca na yakwampana. Elyo Yawe aumfwile amapepo mwipunda lya calo, ne cikuko pa bena Israeli capwa.

english: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”
translation: Lelo Yoabo nao ayasuka imfumu ati, “Shi Yawe Lesa obe engafushishako impuka, ukuti shibe imiku umwanda umo (100). Kabili epakulenga na menso yakwa shikulu imfumu yamone ici. Nomba cinshi shikulu imfumu yandi ilefwaila ukucitila ici cintu?”

english: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
translation: Awe imfumu yapatikisha Yoabu ne ntungulushi sha fita, baima baya mukupenda abantu bonse aba mitundu ya bena Israeli.

english: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;
translation: Panuma yakwabuka umumana wa Yordani, bacita inkambi mupepi na Aroeli, ku musumba uwabela ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, uwabela pakati ka mukonko, elyo bayapita ku Gadi no kutwalilila ukuya ku Yaseri.

english: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,
translation: Elyo baya ku Gileadi na ku calo ca Talitimu Hodishi, na ku Dani Yani no kushingulukila na ku Sidoni.

english: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.
translation: Kabili baile ukulungama ku musumba we linga wa Turi elyo na kuli yonse imisumba ya bena Hifi na bena Kenani. Mukulekelesha elyo baile ku Beresheba mu matololo ya Negebu mu calo ca bena Yuda.

english: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
translation: Cilya bapwa ukupitana mu calo conse pa myeshi pabula ne nshiku amakumi yabili (20) babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
translation: Yoabu nao apeela ku mfumu impendwa ya bantu abo bapendele. Mu bena Israeli ababulamba bali amakana imyanda cine konse konse (800,000), abena Yuda nabo bali amakana imyanda isano (500,000) abengabomfya ulupanga.

english: After this, David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” The LORD said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”
translation: Nomba panuma ya ifi Davidi aipwishe Yawe ati, “Bushe kuti nayako ku musumba umo uwaba mu Yuda?” Yawe nao atile, “Kabiye.” Elyo Davidi ati, “Bushe ni kwi ndi nokuya?” Nao Yawe atile, “Kabiye ku Hebuloni.”

english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
translation: Ishi Bosheti mwana Saulo ali ne myaka amakumi yane (40) ilyo aishile ba imfumu ya bena Israeli kabili ateekelepofye imyaka ibili. Nomba aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda bena bakonkele Davidi.

english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
translation: Inshita iyo Davidi aikele pa bufumu mu Hebuloni pa ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda yakumene imyaka cine lubali na citika.

english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
translation: Nomba Abune mwana Neri na babomfi bakwa Ishi Bosheti mwana Saulo bafuma ku Manaimu no kuya ku Gibeoni.

english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
translation: Elyo Yoabu mwana Seruiya na babomfi bakwa Davidi nabo bafuma no kuya bakumanya pa cishiba ca Gibeoni. Akabungwe kamo kaikala bushilya bumo ubwa cishiba, elyo akabungwe kambi nako lubali lubiye.

english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”
translation: Elyo Abune atile kuli Yoabu, “Shi natubuulepo abalumendo bamo tuleke balwe pa ntanshi yesu.” Yoabu nao asumina ati, “Cisuma, nabacite ifyo fine.”

english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.
translation: Kanshi abalumendo epakwima no kubapenda. Abakwa Benjamini na Ishi Bosheti bali ikumi limo na babili (12), elyo na babomfi bakwa Davidi bali nabo bene ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.
translation: Cila umo aikata umulwani wakwe mu mutwe no kulasa ulupanga mu lubafu lwa mubiye no kuwa panshi bonse bafwa. Kanshi eco palya pa cifulo ca mu Gibeoni petilwa Helikati Hasulimu.

english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.
translation: Ubulwi pa bushiku bulya bwali ubwabipisha. Abune na bantu bakwe abena Israeli babacimfya ku bantu bakwa Davidi.

english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
translation: Nomba abana batatu abakwa Seruiya eko bali Yoabu, Abishai na Asaeli. Nomba uyu Asaeli amolu yali ayayanguka nge nama ya mu mpanga.

english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
translation: Asaeli epakukunkunika Abune, amutamfishe ukwabula ukwalukila nangufye ni ku kulyo nangu ku kuso.

english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakusenda abakashi bakwe bonse babili, Ainoamu umwina Yesireli elyo na Abigaili, mukamfwilwa wakwa Nabali umwina Kameli.

english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”
translation: Elyo Abune alolesha kunuma nokutila kuli ena, “Bushe niwe Asaeli?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Nine wine.”

english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.
translation: Elyo Abune amweba ati, “Pilibukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso kobe, eko wikateko umulumendo umo no kumupoka ifyanso fyakwe.” Lelo Asaeli akaana ukuleka ukumubutusha.

english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”
translation: Kabili Abune asoka Asaeli ati, “Leka ukumbutusha! Mulandu nshi ningakwipaila? Bushe kuti namoneka shani ku menso yakwa munonko Yoabu?”

english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
translation: Nalyo line Asaeli akaanininafye ukuleka ukumukonka. Kanshi Abune epakulasa coco we fumo lyakwe cimfutyanuma mwifumo lyakwa Asaeli, lyafumina napanuma. Awe awa na panshi no kufwa. Kanshi umuntu onse uwafika apawilile Asaeli, talepitilila aleiminina.

english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
translation: Lelo Yoabu na Abishai bena bakonkanyapofye ukukunkunika Abune. Kabili akasuba ilyo kalaba mukuwa, bafika ku lupili lwa Ama kuntanshi ya Gia mu nshila ya ku matololo ya Gibeoni.

english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
translation: Elyo abantu bakwa Benjamini balongana kunuma yakwa Abune bapanga akabungwe no kuya iminina abene pa mulu wa lupili.

english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”
translation: Abune abilikisha kuli Yoabu ati, “Bushe cine cine ulupanga lwakulakomaulafye lyonse? Bushe tawishibe ukuti ici cintu cikaba icabipa pakulekelesha? Bushe cikafika ku nshita nshi ilyo ukeba abantu bobe ukuleka ukukunkunika bamunyinabo?”

english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”
translation: Yoabu ayasuka ati, “Mu cishinka cakwa Lesa wamweo, aubula ukulanda, abantu nga bacitwalililafye ukukunkunika bamunyinabo ukufika na ku lucelo.”

english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.
translation: Elyo Yoabu alisha ipenga, na bonse abantu baiminina shika. Baleka ukukunkunika abena Israeli, no bulwi bwine bwapwa.

english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.
translation: Abune na bantu bakwe baenda bushiku bonse nokulalanya Araba, baya abuka no mumana wa Yordani, ukupula mu Bitironi yonse elyo baya ku Manaimu.

english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.
translation: Elyo Davidi na bantu ali nabo, cila umo no lupwa lwakwe, baima no kuya ikala mu misumba ya ku Hebuloni.

english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.
translation: Elyo Yoabu abwelulwike kukukunkunika Abune, no kulonganika abantu bakwe bonse. Panuma yakulonganika abantu, elyo asanga ukuti abantu ikumi limo na pabula (19) tabalipo ukwabula ukupendelako Asaeli.

english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.
translation: Lelo abantu bakwa Davidi ninshi nabepayapo imyanda itatu elyo na makumi mutanda (360) abena Benjamini abali na Abune.

english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.
translation: Basenda icitumbi cakwa Asaeli no kuya mushiika mu nshinshi yakwa wishi ku Betelemu. Elyo Yoabu na bantu bakwe baenda nabatantama bushiku bonse nokuya fika ku Hebuloni ilyo bwaca.

english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”
translation: Elyo abantu bakwa Yuda baya ku Hebuloni, no kuya suba Davidi ukuba imfumu ya ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda. Nomba panuma ya nshita ilyo Davidi bamweba ukuti abashiikile Saulo bantu ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi,

english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by the LORD, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.
translation: atumine inkombe ku bantu ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi no kubeba ati, “Yawe amupaale pa luse mwalangile kuli Saulo imfumu yenu pakumushiika.

english: Now may the LORD show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.
translation: Nacibe ukuti Yawe amulange icitemwiko icishipwa na bucishinka bwakwe, na ine wine ndi nokucita cimo cine kuli imwe pa mulandu wafyo mwacitile.

english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”
translation: Kanshi nomba beni abakosa kabili abashipa apo Saulo imfumu yenu alifwa. Kabili iŋanda yakwa Yuda nainsuba ukuba imfumu pali bena.”

english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
translation: Lelo Abune mwana Neri, umukalamba wa fita fyakwa Saulo ena asendele Ishi Bosheti mwana Saulo no kumutwala ku Manaimu.

english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
translation: Aya cita Ishi Bosheti ukuba imfumu pa bena Gileadi, Ashuri na Yesireli kabili na pa bena Efulemu, Benjamini elyo na bonse abena Israeli.

english: Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.
translation: Ubulwi bwalitantalile pakati ka ŋanda yakwa Saulo ne yakwa Davidi. Davidi wena alekoselakofye nganshi, ilyo iŋanda yakwa Saulo yena yaile ilepwafye amaka.

english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
translation: Alapile ukusesha ubufumu ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Saulo, no kushimpa icipuna cabufumu icakwa Davidi pali Israeli na Yuda, ukufumafye ku Dani ukufika na kuli Beresheba.”

english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
translation: Ishi Bosheti afilwa ukuti alandeko amashiwi na yambi kuli Abune, pantu alemutiina.

english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”
translation: Elyo Abune atuma inkombe kuli Davidi ati, “Bushe umwine calo nani? Cita icipangano na ine, elyo nkakwafwa ukuleta Israeli yonse kuli iwe.”

english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”
translation: Nao Davidi atila, “Cisuma, ndi nokucita icipangano na iwe. Lelo kuli icintu cimo ndefwaya kuli iwe. Tecakwesha ukwisa ku cinso candi, lelo icantanshi kano ukalete Mikali umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo ilyo ukesa mukumona.”

english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atuma inkombe kuli Ishi Bosheti, mwana Saulo ati, “Mpeeleni umukashi wandi Mikali, uo nakobekele ne mwine pa mutengo wa mwanda umo (100) uwankanda sha pa mpela ya mibili ya Bafilisiti.”

english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.
translation: Kanshi Ishi Bosheti epakutuma abakuya mupokolola ukufuma ku mulume wakwe Paliteli mwana Laishi.

english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.
translation: Lelo umulume wakwe akonkele panuma alelila nshila yonse mpaka ku Bahurimu. Elyo Abune atila kuli ena, “Bwelelamo ku mushi!” Kanshi nao epakubwelelamo.

english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
translation: Elyo Abune aebele abakalamba ba mu Israeli nokutila, “Mu nshita yonse iyapita mwalefwaya ukubuula Davidi ukuba imfumu yenu.

english: Now then do it! For the LORD has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”
translation: Eico nomba citeni ici cintu! Pantu Yawe ewalaile Davidi ukutila, ‘Ni muli Davidi umubomfi wandi ndi nokulubwila abantu bandi abena Israeli ukufuma mu maboko ya Bafilisiti, elyo na mu maboko ya bonse abalwani babo.’”

english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
translation: Abune umwine aebako na bena Benjamini kabili aya na ku Hebuloni kukwebako Davidi fyonse ifyo abena Israeli ne ŋanda yonse iyakwa Benjamini balefwaya ukucita.

english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
translation: Davidi atendeke ukukwata abana abaume ilyo ali ku Hebuloni, ne beli lyali ni Amunoni, nyina ali ni Ainoamu umwina Yesireli.

english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.
translation: Elyo Abune uwakwete abantu amakumi yabili (20) afikile kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni, Davidi amupekanishisha umutebeto pamo na bantu bakwe.

english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
translation: Elyo Abune atila kuli Davidi, “Shileka nje bwangu no kulonganika abena Israeli bonse kuli shikulu imfumu yandi, pakuti bengacita icipangano na iwe kabili pakuti nomba niwe ukabe niwe mfumu pali bonse abo umutima obe utemenwe.” Kanshi Davidi epakulekako Abune ukuti aleya, nao aile umutende.

english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
translation: Tapapitile nshita, abantu bakwa Davidi abaile na Yoabu babwela ukufuma kukutapa ifyuma, kabili baishile ne fitapwa ifingi. Lelo Abune wena ninshi tali na Davidi mu Hebuloni pantu ninshi alimulekeleko, no kuya aile umutende.

english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”
translation: Ilyo Yoabu ne fita fyonse ali nafyo bafika, bamweba ati Abune mwana Neri acisa ku mfumu elyo imfumu nayo yamulekako ukuya kabili aciyafye umutende.

english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?
translation: Kanshi Yoabu epakuya ku mfumu nokutila, “Bushe cinshi ucitile? Mona, Abune acisa kuli iwe, ngeco wacimulekelako pakuti aye cinshi?

english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”
translation: Walimwishiba Abune mwana Neri, ukuti acisa mukukubepa no kumona imyendele yobe, kabili nokufwailisha muli fyonse ulebomba.”

english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.
translation: Ilyo Yoabu afumine kuli Davidi, atumine inkombe panuma yakwa Abune mukuya mubwesha ukufuma ku cishima ca Sira. Lelo Davidi taishibepo nangu cimo.

english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.
Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”
translation: Shi umulopa wakwe wingapongolokela pa mutwe wakwa Yoabu na pali bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa wishi! Shi mu ŋanda yakwa Yoabu mwikalabula muntu ushikwete ifilonda ififumwa mafina nangu ifibashi , uwendela ku nkonto, abakukomwa ku lupanga nangu uwabula ifilyo.”

english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
translation: Uwali uwacibili ni Kileabu nyina ali ni Abigaili mukamfwilwa wakwa Nabali umwina Kameli. Uwabutatu ni Abusalomu, nyina ali ni Maka umwana mwanakashi wakwa Talimai imfumu ya ku Geshuri.

english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
translation: Yoabu na munyina Abishai baipeye Abune pa mulandu wakuti nao aipeye Asaeli munyinabo mu bulwi bwa ku Gibeoni.

english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.
translation: Elyo Davidi aebele Yoabu na bantu bonse abo ali nabo ati, “Lepauleni ifyakufwala fyenu no kufwala insalu shabulanda no kuloosha pa mfwa yakwa Abune.” Imfumu Davidi nayo ninshi ilekonka panuma ya citumbi.

english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.
translation: Abune bamushiikile mu Hebuloni, ne mfumu yalilile umusowa uukalamba pa nshinshi yakwa Abune, pamo pene na bantu bonse nabo balilile nganshi.

english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?
translation: Imfumu epakwimba ulwimbo lwa malilo pali Abune ulwakuti,

english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.
translation: Amaboko yobe tayakakilwe,

english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”
translation: Elyo abantu bonse baishile nokupapata Davidi pakuti alye icakulya ilyo akasuba kaciliko. Nomba Davidi nao epakulapa ati, “Shi Lesa nancitepo cimo, cibe nangufye icintu icabipisha nga cakuti nalya umukate nangu icintufye conse ilyo akasuba takalawa!”

english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.
translation: Awe abantu bonse baishiba no kutemwa icine cine ngefyo conse ico imfumu yacitile calibasekeshe.

english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.
translation: Kanshi pali bulya bushiku abantu bonse, pamo na bena Israeli bonse baishibe ukuti imfumu yena tayakwetemo ulubali mukwipaya Abune mwana Neri.

english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?
translation: Elyo imfumu yaebele abantu baiko ati, “Bushe tamwishibe ukuti umwana wa mfumu kabili umukalamba wa bena Israeli eufwile ilelo?

english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”
translation: Ilelo nshikwete amaka, nangu ndi imfumu iyasubwa, pantu aba bantu, abana baume bakwa Seruiya, bantu bakosa nganshi ukuncila. Shi Yawe engabwesesha ububi ku uucita ububi ukulingana ne micitile yakwe iyabubifi!”

english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
translation: Umwana uwakulenga bune ni Adoniya nyina ali ni Hagiti. Uwalenga busano, ni Shefatiya, nyina ali ni Abitali.

english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
translation: Elyo uwalenga mutanda ni Itilemu, nyina ali ni Egila muka Davidi. Aba e bana bafyalilwe mu Hebuloni abakwa Davidi.

english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.
translation: Mu nshita ya bulwi pakati ka ŋanda yakwa Saulo ne ŋanda yakwa Davidi, Abune akonkenyepo ukuba uwamaka mu ŋanda yakwa Saulo.

english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
translation: Nomba Saulo ali no mukashi uo ashaupile mu bwinga, ishina lyakwe ni Risipa umwana umwanakashi wakwa Aia. Elyo Ishi Bosheti aeba Abune ati, “Bushe cinshi ico wasendamina no mukashi wakwa tata ulya ashaupile mu bwinga?”

english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!
translation: Awe Abune afulwa nganshi pafyo Ishi Bosheti amwebele, elyo amwasuka ati, “Bushe ine ndi mutwe wa mbwa wa ku lubali lwakwa Yuda? Ukufika pa bushiku bwa lelo, ine naliba uwanakila iŋanda yakwa wiso Saulo, ulupwa lwakwe elyo na ku banankwe. Nshakulubwila na mu minwe yakwa Davidi. Lelo iwe wampela umulandu pali uyu umwanakashi!

english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as the LORD has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:
translation: Shi Lesa nacitepo cimo pali Abune, nangu cibefye icibi, nga cakuti nshicitile Davidi ifyo Yawe alapile ukumucitila.

english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
translation: Ilyo Ishi Bosheti mwana Saulo aumfwile ukuti Abune nafwa mu Hebuloni, anenuka, na bena Israeli bonse pamo basakamikwa.

english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.
translation: ilyo umuntu umo anjebele ukuti, ‘Saulo nafwa,’ ninshi wena aletontonkanya ukuti aletele imbila isuma, nalimwikete nokumwipaila mu Sikilagi. Ici cali e cilambu namupeele pa mbila yakwe!

english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”
translation: Pali bufi ilyo ababifi ba bantu nga imwe baipaya umuntu uwakaele mu ŋanda yakwe kabili pa musengele wakwe, bushe nomba tekuti nombe umulopa wakwe ukufuma mu maboko yenu elyo no kumonaula ukufuma pano isonde?”

english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.
translation: Elyo Davidi apeela icipope ku bantu bakwe, nabo babepaya. Babaputaula amaboko yabo na molu elyo batanika imibili yabo pa cishiba ca mu Hebuloni. Lelo umutwe wakwa Ishi Bosheti wena baya ushiika mu nshinshi yakwa Abune ku Hebuloni.

english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;
translation: Nomba uyu umwana wakwa Saulo umwaume ali na bantu babili abali intungulushi sha mpuka ishalesansa. Umo ni Baanaya umbi nao ni Rekabu. Bonse aba, bali bamwana Rimoni umwina Beroti ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Benjamini, pantu Beroti nao apendelwa ku ciputulwa cakwa Benjamini.

english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).
translation: Pantu abantu ba mu Beroti bafulumukile ku Gitaimu no kuya ikala kulya kwine nga beni ukufika na mu bushiku bwa lelo.

english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.
translation: Nomba Yonatani mwana Saulo ali no mwana umwaume uwalemene amolu yonse. Ali ne myaka isano ilyo ilyashi lyakufwa kwakwa Saulo na Yonatani lyaishile ukufuma ku Yesireli. Umuleshi wakwe amusendele no kufulumuka, nomba lintu ali mukufulumuka, umwana apona elyo aba icilema. Ishina lyakwe ali ni Mefibosheti.

english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.
translation: Nomba Rekabu na Baanaya bamwana Rimoni umwina Beroti, baimine no kuya ku ŋanda yakwa Ishi Bosheti, baya fika kulya ilyo akasuba kaba pakati ka mutwe, ninshi nalala aletuusha mu nshita ya kasuba.

english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
translation: Baile mukati nankati ka ŋanda kwati nalimo balefwaya ukubula iŋanu shimo, elyo bamulasa mu lufumo afwa. Elyo Rekabu na ndume nankwe Baanaya baongoloka baya no kuya.

english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.
translation: Nomba ilyo baingile mu ŋanda, basangile nalala pa musengele mu muputule wakwe, epakumulasa bamwipaya, bamuputulako no mutwe. Basenda umutwe baenda bushiku bonse mu nshila ya bena Araba.

english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”
translation: Awe bafisha umutwe wakwa Ishi Bosheti kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni nokutila ku mfumu, “Moneni umutwe wa mulwani wenu Ishi Bosheti mwana Saulo, uwafwaile ubumi bwenu. Muli buno bushiku Yawe nalandwilako imfumu kateeka wandi kuli Saulo elyo na bana bakwe.”

english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
translation: Elyo Davidi epakwasuka Rekabu na ndume nankwe Baanaya bamwana Rimoni umwina Beroti ati, “Awe Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe wamweo uwampuswishe mu mafya ayengi,

english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
translation: Elyo inko shonse isha bena Israeli shaishile kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni no kumweba ati, “Ifwe tuli munofu obe kabili umulopa obe.

english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.
translation: Isham 2:11

english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
translation: Elyo nao Davidi aishiba nokuti Yawe namusuminisha ukuba imfumu pa bena Israeli kabili nasansabalika ubufumu bwakwe pa mulandu wa bantu bakwe abena Israeli.

english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
translation: Panuma, ilyo afumine mu Hebuloni no kwisa ku Yerusalemu, Davidi aupilepo na bambi bakashi basano, kabili alundapo na bakashi abo ashaupile mu bwinga. Kabili afyalilapo abana abaume na banakashi na bambi.

english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
translation: Aya e mashina ya bana abo afyele kulya: Shamua, Shobabu, Natani, Solomoni,

english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
translation: Ibihali, Elishua, Nefegi, Yafiya,

english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation: Elishama, Eliada elyo na Elifeleti.

english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
translation: Ilyo Abafilisiti baumfwile ukuti nabasuba Davidi ukuba imfumu ya bena Israeli, baima na maka nganshi ukuya balemufwaya. Lelo Davidi ilyo aumfwa ukuti balemufwaya, aya ingila kwilinga.

english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Nomba Abafilisiti baisa no kusalanganina mwishika lya Refaimu.

english: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
translation: Elyo Davidi epakwipusha Yawe ati, “Bushe kuti naya no kulwisha Abafilisiti? Bushe ulebapeela mu maboko yandi?” Elyo Yawe amwasuka ati, “Kabiyefye pantu icine cine ndepeela Abafilisiti mu maboko yobe.”

english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. The LORD said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”
translation: Mu nshita shapita, ilyo Saulo ali imfumu pali ifwe, iwe niwe waletungulula Israeli mu bulwi bwabo. Kabili Yawe atile kuli iwe, ‘Iwe uli nokucema abantu bandi abena Israeli, kabili ukaba kateeka wabo.’”

english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakuya ku Baali Perasimu no kuya bacimfya kulya kwine. Asosa nokuti, “Ngefyo amenshi yapongoloka, Yawe napongolokela pa balwani bandi pa cinso candi.” Kanshi eco betila icifulo cilya ukuti Baali Perasimu.

english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.
translation: Abap 1:21

english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Kabili Abafilisiti babwekeshapo ukwisa tantama mwishika lya Refaimu.

english: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakwipusha Yawe, nao ayasuka ati, “Wibalungama pakunina pamulu, lelo ushinguluke ku numa yabo no kubasanshila ku ntanshi ya fimuti fya basamu.

english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
translation: Eico bwangu bwangu nga waumfwa inshindo pa mulu wa fimuti fya basamu, wangufyanye pantu ninshi ni Yawe ewile pantanshi yobe kukulwisha ifita fya Bafilisiti.”

english: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
translation: Davidi nao epakucita ifyo Yawe amukonkomeshe. Davidi aipeye Abafilisiti inshila yonse ukufuma ku Gibeoni ukufikafye na ku Gesa.

english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba bena Israeli bonse baishile kuli Davidi ku Hebuloni, imfumu nayo epakucita icipangano nabo ku Hebuloni pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Elyo basuba Davidi amafuta yakuba imfumu ya bena Israeli.

english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
translation: Davidi ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ilyo aishile pa bufumu, no kuteeka ateekelepo imyaka amakumi yane (40).

english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
translation: Mu Hebuloni ateekele icalo ca Yuda imyaka cine lubali na citika. Elyo mu Yerusalemu ateekele Israeli pamo na Yuda pa myaka amakumi yatatu na itatu (33).

english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi na bantu baiko baile ku Yerusalemu kukulwisha abena Yebusi, abaleikala muli ici calo. Abena Yebusi baebele Davidi ati, “Iwe muno tawaingilemo. Pantufye impofu nangu abalemana amolu ebalekutamfya.” Bena baletontonkanya ukuti, “Davidi tekuti engilemo.”

english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.
translation: Lelo Davidi apokolwele ilinga lya Sioni, nomba uwitwa umusumba wakwa Davidi.

english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”
translation: Pali bulya bushiku, Davidi atile, “Uyo onse uuli nokucimfya abena Yebusi, afwile ukubomfya umufolo umupita amenshi pakufika kuli abo abalemana ne mpofu ababa abalwani bakwa Davidi.” E mulandu wine basosela abati, “Impofu na balemana tabali na kwingila kwisano lya mfumu.”

english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.
translation: Awe Davidi epakuya ikala mukati ke linga nokulaita umusumba ukuti wakwa Davidi. Akuulamo umusumba ukushinguluka, ukufuma ku fibumbili ifyakwikasha ilinga ukufika na mukati.

english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
translation: Kabili Davidi alonganike pamo ifita ifyasalilwe ukufuma mu bena Israeli amakana amakumi yatatu (30,000).

english: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
translation: Davidi tasuminisha ukuti Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe ifike kuli ena mu musumba wakwa Davidi. Lelo aitwalafye ku ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu umwina Gati.

english: The LORD’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.
translation: Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe yashele mu ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu umwina Gati pa myeshi itatu. Awe Yawe nao epakumupaala pamo na ba ŋanda yakwe bonse.

english: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.
translation: Nomba imfumu Davidi yaumfwile ukuti, “Yawe napaala aba mu ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu na fyonse ifyo akwata pa mulandu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa.” Kanshi Davidi epakuya senda Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Obedi Edomu, atwala mu musumba wakwa Davidi no kusekelela.

english: When those who bore the LORD’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
translation: Kanshi epakutila ati lyonse ilyo abakusenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe nga batampula intampulo mutanda, Davidi aipaya cilume wa ŋombe elyo ne ciponti ca ŋombe icaina ifye lambo lyakwa Yawe.

english: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
translation: Davidi ninshi afwele icakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi, alecinda pa cinso cakwa Yawe na maka yakwe yonse.

english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
translation: Kanshi Davidi na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli yonse, pakuleta Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe, balepunda no kulisha amapenga.

english: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
translation: Nomba ilyo baleingisha Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe mu musumba wakwa Davidi, Mikali umwana mwanakashi wakwa Saulo ninshi alelengela pa nsolokoto. Nomba ilyo amona imfumu Davidi ilecilauka no kucinda pa cinso cakwa Yawe, awe amususha mu mutima wakwe.

english: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
translation: Ifi efyo baletele Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe no kuibika mu cifulo mukati ke tenti lintu Davidi aimike umwakwisa ifikilisha. Elyo Davidi acitile amalambo ya cakoca ne mituulo yakwampana pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.
translation: Elyo panuma yakupwisha ukutuula amalambo ya cakoca ne mituulo yakwampana, Davidi apaala abantu mwishina lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
translation: Elyo apeela umukate umo umo, icimamantwa ca tuncindu cimo cimo elyo ne cimamantwa ca myangashi cimo cimo kuli cila muntu mwibumba lyonse ilya bena Israeli, bonse abaume na banakashi. Elyo abantu bonse epakubwelelamo cila umo kumwabo.

english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.
translation: Elyo Davidi na bantu bonse abasalilwe baima ukufuma ku Baala wa mu calo cakwa Yuda kukuya buula ukufuma kulya Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa, iyo beta peshina lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita, uwaikala apasansama pakati ka bakerubi ababa pa mulu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano.

english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”
translation: Nomba ilyo Davidi abwelele kukupaala aba mu ŋanda yakwe, Mikali umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo aisa fuma kukumukumanya nokutila, “Yangu ifyo imfumu ya bena Israeli yaicindamika ilelo, yaifuula iyine pa cinso ca basha banakashi aba babomfi bakwe kwatifye ni umo uwa mu bawelewele engacita!”

english: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.
translation: Davidi atile kuli Mikali, “Ni pa cinso cakwa Yawe uwansala, ambika na pa cifulo apali wiso, elyo na pali bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwe no kumpeela ubufumu pa bantu bakwa Yawe abena Israeli epo nacilacindila.

english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”
translation: Ndi nokubafye uwaicefya nganshi ukucila pali fino ndi. Kabili ndi nokuba uwasuulwa nganshi mu menso yandi ne mwine. Lelo kuli aba banakashi abasha ulandilepo, ine ndi nokucindikwa kuli bena.”

english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
translation: Mikali nao umwana umwanakashi wakwa Saulo takwetepo abana ukufika na pa bushiku bwa mfwa yakwe.

english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
translation: Babika Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa peceleta ilipya pakupekanya ukuifumya mu ŋanda yakwa Abinadabu iyali pa mulu wa lupili. Usa na Ahio abana baume bakwa Abinadabu ebaletungulula ili celeta.

english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.
translation: Bafumisha iceleta panse ukufuma mu ŋanda yakwa Abinadabu iyali pa mulu wa lupili ninshi Imbokoshi yakwa Lesa ili pamulu. Elyo Ahio ewaletangila ku ntanshi ye celeta.

english: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
translation: Davidi ne ŋanda yonse iya bena Israeli ninshi bena balesefya na maka yabo yonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe, baleimba inyimbo, balelisha amaseese, insango, insombo, ifisekese elyo ne miwaya.

english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.
translation: Ilyo bafikile ku lubansa batwilapo iŋanu ulwakwa Nakoni, Usa atambalika ukuboko no kwikatilila Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa, pantu iŋombe shapene ukuwa.

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
translation: Awe Yawe afulilwa nganshi Usa, pa mulandu wa milimo acitile iyakutambika ukuboko aikata ku Mbokoshi yakwa Lesa. Kanshi Lesa nao epakumwipaya palya pene pa mbali ya Mbokoshi.

english: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.
translation: Elyo Davidi nao afulwa pa mulandu wa cipyu cakwa Yawe pali Usa. Kanshi ukufika na mu bushiku bwa lelo cilya cifulo eco citilwa Peresi Usa.

english: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”
translation: Davidi muli bulya bushiku atiinine Yawe nokutila, “Bushe kuti Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe yaisa shani kuli ine?”

english: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
translation: Panuma ya ifi, imfumu yaikele bwino mwisano lyaiko kabili Yawe amulengele ukutuusha ku balwani bakwe bonse aba mushingulwike.

english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,
translation: Kabili nkapekanya incende iya bantu bandi abena Israeli, iyakuti emo nkababike pakuti bakaikwatile icifulo cabo umo bashakalebasunkanya. Abantu imbifi tabakatale ababacusha nakabili, ngefyo balecita kukutendeka.

english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house.
translation: Cili nokuba ukufumafye pa nshita nasontele abapingushi pakati ka bantu bandi abena Israeli. Kabili ndi nokulenga ukakwate ukutuusha ukufuma ku balwani bobe bonse. Kabili Yawe nasosa kuli iwe ati, Yawe umwine ali nokukukuulila iŋanda.

english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
translation: Ilyo inshiku shobe shikapwa kabili waya lala ukwalala ne fikolwe fyobe, ine ndi nokubuula umwana obe ukuba impyani yobe. Na ine nkakosha ubufumu bwakwe.

english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
translation: Uyu wine euli nokukuula iŋanda iye shina lyandi, kabili ndi nokukosha icipuna ca bufumu bwakwe pe na pe.

english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;
translation: Ine nkaba wishi, elyo na ena akaba umwana wandi. Ilyo lyonse acita icilubo, ine ndi nokumukanda ne nkonto ya bantu bandi, mukumupuma ne mpumo shipuma abantu.

english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.
translation: Lelo icitemwiko candi cena tacakatale acifuma pali ena, pamo ngefyo nacifumishe pali Saulo, uo nafumishe pa cinso cobe.

english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”
translation: Iŋanda yobe elyo no bufumu fili nokubelelela pe na pe pa cinso candi. Icipuna cabufumu cobe cili nokukoshiwa pe na pe.’”

english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
translation: Awe Natani epakuya sosa amashiwi aya yonse kuli Davidi no kumulondolwela ubusokololo bonse.

english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
translation: Imila 6:18

english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!
translation: Kabili kwati ifi fyacepa mu kumona kobe we Mfumu Yawe, walanda na pa mulandu wa mikalile ya kuntanshi iya ŋanda ya mubomfi obe. Bushe iyi e mibeele ubombelamo ku muntu uuli onse, we Mfumu Yawe?

english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”
translation: Elyo Davidi atile kuli Natani kasesema, “Nomba mona, ine njikele mwisano lya fimuti fya keda, ilyo Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Lesa yena ilifye mukati ke tenti.”

english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.
translation: “Bushe finshi fimbi ificilile apa Davidi engasosa kuli iwe? Pantu umubomfi obe walimwishiba, we Mfumu Yawe.

english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
translation: Pa mulandu we shiwi lyobe elyo ukulingana no bufwayo bobe, naucita icintu ici icikankala no kulenga cishibikwe na ku mubomfi obe.

english: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translation: “Kwena uli mukulu we Mfumu Yawe! Takuli umbi uwalingana na iwe. Kabili takuli Lesa umbi lelo kanofye iwe, pamo ngefyo twayumfwila fwe bene na matwi yesu.

english: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
translation: Kabili ni bani ababa nga bantu bobe abena Israeli pano isonde? Bushe kwaliba umushobo na umbi uo Lesa wabo aile lubula nga bantu abakwe umwine, no kucindamika ishina lyakwe? Bushe kwaliba bambi abo Lesa wabo alecitila ifipeshamano ifikulu elyo ne fyakutiinya mukutamfya imishobo pamo ne milungu yabo ku cinso ca bantu bobe, abo walubula ukufuma ku Egupto?

english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
translation: Pantu naushimpa abantu bobe abena Israeli nga bantu bobefye pe na pe. Kabili niwe Yawe waisa ba Lesa wabo.

english: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.
translation: “Nomba kabili, we Yawe Lesa, ubake pe na pe icilayo ico walaya palwa mubomfi obe pamo ne ŋanda yakwe. Ucite ukulingana no kulaya kobe,

english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’
For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
translation: “We Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wa bena Israeli, wasokolola ifi ku mubomfi obe mukutila, ‘Ine nkakukuulila iŋanda.’ Kanshi umubomfi obe nao nasanga ukushipa pakupepa kuli iwe ili ipepo.

english: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
translation: We Mfumu Yawe, iwe uli Lesa! Amashiwi yobe yacishinka. Kabili naulaya umubomfi obe ifintu ifisuma.

english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
translation: Nomba ube uwasekela mukupaala iŋanda ya mubomfi obe, pakuti itwalilile pe na pe pa cinso cobe. Pantu niwe we Mfumu Yawe ulandile, elyo ne paalo lyobe pa ŋanda ya mubomfi obe ili nokuba iyapaalwa pe na pe.”

english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”
translation: Elyo Natani atile ku mfumu, “Conse ico uli naco mu mano kacitafye, pantu Yawe ali na iwe.”

english: That same night, the LORD’s word came to Nathan, saying,
translation: Lelo bulya bwine bushiku, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli Natani, nokumweba ati,

english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
translation: “Kabiye kebe umubomfi wandi Davidi, utile, ‘Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, bushe niwe uli nokunkuulila iŋanda iyakwikalamo?

english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.
translation: Ine nshatala njikala mu ŋanda ukutula pa bushiku nafumishe abena Israeli mu Egupto ukushinta pa bushiku bwa lelo. Ine naikalilafye ukwendauka, ukufuma pali ici cifulo no kuya pa cifulo cimbi mwitenti nge cakwikalamo.

english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
translation: Monse umo nyendauka pamo na bena Israeli bonse, bushe nalitala nsosa kuli kateeka nangu umo uo nakonkomesha ukucema abantu bandi abena Israeli ukuti, bushe ico mushankuulila iŋanda ya fimuti fya keda cinshi?’”

english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.
translation: “Eico nomba, eba umubomfi wandi Davidi utile, ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, ‘Nakusendele ukufuma mu mpanga ya mulemfwe, na mukukonka umukuni wa mpaanga kukwisa ba kateeka pa bantu bandi abena Israeli.

english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
