translation: Lyonse mbafye na iwe konse uko wapitila, kabili nalipwisha abalwani bonse pa cinso cobe. Nomba ndi nokulenga ishina lyobe ukuba ilyalulumbi, kwati mashina ya bantu abacindami aba mwisonde.

english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
translation: Nomba panuma ya ifi fyonse, Davidi aishile cimfya Abafilisiti no kubanasha. Elyo apokolola na Metegi Ama ukufuma mu maboko ya Bafilisiti.

english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
translation: yatuma umwana wakwe Yoramu ku mfumu Davidi mukumuposha no kumutasha pa kucimfya kwakwe mu bulwi na Hadadesa, pantu inshita ishingi alelwa na Toi. Yoramu amuletela ifipe umwali silifa, golide elyo no mukuba.

english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—
translation: Elyo imfumu Davidi afituulile kuli Yawe, pamo ngefyo acitile kuli silifa na golide yafumine ku mishobo yonse intu acimfishe.

english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
translation: Yafumine ku bena Edomu na bena Moabu, ku bena Amoni na ku Bafilisiti elyo na ku bena Amaleki. Kabili atuulile ne fitapwa afumishe kuli Hadadesa umwana wakwa Reobu, imfumu ya Soba.

english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
translation: Kanshi Davidi epakuba uwaishibikwa nganshi panuma yakubwela ukufuma kukulwisha abena Edomu amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000) mwi Shika Lyamucele.

english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
translation: Awe Davidi abikile utwamba twa bashilika mu ncende ishalekana lekana mu Edomu monse. Elyo na bonse abena Edomu baba ababomfi bakwa Davidi. Yawe alengele Davidi ukucimfya konse uko aya.

english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
translation: Davidi ateekele icalo ca bena Israeli conse mu mulinganya. Alecita ubupingushi ubwacishinka ku bantu bakwe bonse.

english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
translation: Yoabu umwana wakwa Seruiya ali e mukalamba wa fita. Yehoshafati umwana wakwa Ailudi ewali kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo.

english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,
translation: Sadoki umwana wakwa Aitubu elyo na Aimeleki umwana wakwa Abiyata ebali bashimapepo. Seraya nao ali ni kalemba wa milandu.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
translation: Benaya umwana wakwa Yehoiyada ali e ntungulushi ya bena Kereti elyo na bena Peleti. Elyo bamwana Davidi nabo bali ni bampandamano ba mfumu.

english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
translation: Kabili Davidi acimfya na bena Moabu. Abalalika panshi mu milongo, elyo alabapima na ku mwando. Abali mu mitande ibili abapingula ukwipaiwa. Elyo abo bonse abali mu mutande wacitatu basuminishiwa ukuba abomi. Kanshi abena Moabu epakusanguka ababomfi bakwa Davidi no kwamba ukulaleta umutuulo.

english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
translation: Kabili Davidi alwishishe no kucimfya Hadadesa mwana Reobu imfumu ya ku Soba, ilyo aile kukubweshapo ubufumu bwakwe mu ncende iyakonka umumana wa Yufurate.

english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.
translation: Davidi amupokolola amaceleta yakwe ikana limo (1,000), bakensha ba maceleta amakana cine lubali (7,000), elyo ifita fya pa makasa nafyo amakana amakumi yabili (20,000). Kabili Davidi alemanika bakabalwe ba maceleta bonse, ashapofye umwanda umo (100).

english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
translation: Ilyo abena Aramu ba ku Damasiko baishile kukwafwilisha Hadadesa imfumu ya ku Soba, Davidi aipeyepo abashilika babo amakana amakumi yabili na yabili (22,000).

english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
translation: Davidi epakubika utwamba twa bashilika bakwe mu calo ca bena Aramu wa ku Damasiko. Elyo abena Aramu nabo baba ababomfi bakwa Davidi, bayamba no kulasonka umusonko. Yawe alengele Davidi ukucimfya konse uko aya.

english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
translation: Davidi apokolwele inkwela sha golide isha bakangalila ba fita bakwa Hadadesa no kushileta ku Yerusalemu.

english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
translation: Ukufuma ku Beta na Berotai, imisumba iyali iyakwa Hadadesa, imfumu Davidi yapokeleko umukuba uwingi nganshi.

english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
translation: Kabili ilyo imfumu Toi iya ku Hamati yaumfwile ukuti Davidi nacimfya ifita fyonse ifyakwa Hadadesa,

english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
translation: Elyo Davidi aipwishe ati, “Bushe pacili na nomba uusheleko uwa mu ŋanda yakwa Saulo, uo ningalangilako uluse pa mulandu wakwa Yonatani?”

english: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
translation: Kanshi iwe pamo na bana bobe abaume elyo na babomfi bobe mwakulamulimina no kumuletela ifisabo pakuti umwishikulu wakwa sokulu elabulwa icakulya. Nomba Mefibosheti ena, inshiku shonse akulalya petebulo lyandi.” Nomba Siba ali na bana baume ikumi limo na basano (15), elyo na babomfi amakumi yabili (20).

english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
translation: Elyo Siba epakwasuka imfumu ati, “Umubomfi wenu ali nokulacita conse ico shikulu imfumu yandi yakonkomesha.” Kanshi Mefibosheti epakulalya petebulo lyakwa Davidi, kwatifye ni umo uwa mu bana ba mfumu.

english: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
translation: Mefibosheti alikwetepo umwana umwaume umwaice uwe shina lya Mika. Elyo bonse abaleikala ku ŋanda kwa Siba balifye ababomfi bakwa Mefibosheti.

english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.
translation: Kabili Mefibosheti aikele mu Yerusalemu, pantu lyonse ena alelya petebulo lya mfumu. Elyo ali uwalemana amakasa yonse yabili.

english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
translation: Nomba kwaliko umubomfi umo uwa mu ŋanda yakwa Saulo, ishina lyakwe ni Siba. Awe epakuya mwita ukuti amonane ne mfumu Davidi. Elyo imfumu yatila kuli ena, “Bushe eiwe Siba?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Nine, umubomfi wenu.”

english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
translation: Kabili imfumu yaipwishe ati, “Bushe nakabili kuti kwaba uusheleko uwa mu ŋanda yakwa Saulo, uo ningalangilako uluse lwakwa Lesa?” Elyo Siba ayasuka imfumu ati, “Kuciliko umo umwana wakwa Yonatani, uwalemana amakasa yonse.”

english: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
translation: Sam 4:4

english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Davidi epakutuma abakumubuula ukufuma mu ŋanda yakwa Makiri umwana wakwa Amieli.

english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
translation: Ilyo Mefibosheti umwana wakwa Yonatani, mwana Saulo, aishile kuli Davidi, akontama pakumuposha no mucinshi. Elyo Davidi atila, “Bushe eiwe Mefibosheti!” Nao ayasuka ati, “Nine mubomfi wenu.”

english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
translation: Elyo Davidi amweba ati, “Witiina! Pantu mu cine cine ine ndekubelela uluse pa mulandu wakwa wiso Yonatani. Ine ndi nokukubwesesha impanga yonse iyali iyakwa sokulu Saulo, kabili inshiku shonse wakulalya petebulo lyandi.”

english: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
translation: Elyo Mefibosheti akontama amupeela umucinshi nokusosa ati, “Bushe ne mubomfi wenu nine ani, pakuti musakamane imbwa iyafwa nga ine?”

english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaitile Siba, umubomfi wakwa Saulo no kusosa kuli ena ati, “Ine nimpeela conse icali cakwa sokulu na ku ba lupwa lwakwe ku mwishikulu wakwe.

english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
translation: Ine Paulo na Sailasi na Timote, twamulembela mwe lukuta lwa mu Tesalonika, mwe baampana na Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu.

english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
translation: Esaya 2:10

english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
translation: Eico lyonsefye tulamupepelako. Tupapata Lesa wesu ukuti mube ne mibeele iyalinga ubwite amwitako. Ku maka yakwe engafikilisha ifisuma fyonse ifyo mufwaya ukucita no kupwishishisha imilimo yenu yonse iyo mubombela mu cisumino.

english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Ninshi lyena mwakulacindika Yesu Imfumu yesu, na imwe akulamucindika pa mulandu wa cikuuku Lesa wesu ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu bamukwatila.

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Tata ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, ifwe tuli nokutasha Lesa lyonsefye pa mulandu wa imwe. Ala ici ecilungeme kuli ifwe ukulacita, pantu icisumino cenu cilekulilakofye nganshi no kutemwana kwenu nako kulelundulukilakofye.

english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
translation: Eico ifwe tulatakisha mu kulanda kwesu pali imwe ku nkuta shakwa Lesa. Tutakisha pafyo mwakonkanyapo ukushipikisha no kusumina ilyo bamucusha na mu mafya yene mulimo.

english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
translation: Ala ifi fyonse fishininkisha ukuti Lesa wamulinganya mukupingula. Kabili muli ifi, Lesa alemulenga ukuti mube abalinga Ubufumu bwakwe, ubo muculila.

english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
translation: Lesa wamulinganya, akacusha abo abamucusha.

english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
translation: Akapwisha amacushi yenu pamo na macushi yesu yene. Akacita ici ilyo Imfumu Yesu ikasokoloka ilefuma ku mulu pamo na bamalaika baiko abamaka.

english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
translation: Ikesa mu lubingu lwa mulilo kukukanda abo bonse abashifwaya ukwishiba Lesa na bakaana ukunakila Imbila Nsuma iyakwa Yesu Imfumu yesu.

english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
translation: Lesa akabakanda, bakalobelelafye. Akabafumyapo, tabakamone cinso ca Mfumu na maka ya bucindami bwaiko.

english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
translation: Nomba ilyo Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ikabwela, tukalongana uko ikaba. Kanshi tulemupapata mwe bamunyinefwe

english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
translation: Akabomfya imisango iyalekana lekana pakubepaika abakaba nokulobelela. Bakalobelela, pantu bakeene ukupokelela icishinka no kucitemwa pakuti bengapusuka.

english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
translation: Eico Lesa akabatumina amaka yakubafulunganya, ayakubalenga ukusumina ifyabufi.

english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
translation: Kanshi abo bonse bakaba no mulandu, pantu bakaana ukusumina amashiwi yacishinka, batemwa ukucita ifibi.

english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
translation: Lelo ifwe lyonse tulatasha Lesa pali imwe mwe bamunyinefwe, mwebo Imfumu yatemwa. Pantu nimwe Lesa asalilepo ukufuma ku citendekelo pakuti mupusuke. Amuwemye ukuba abantu bamushilo ku maka yakwa Mupashi, na pali ico mwasumina mu cishinka.

english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Lesa ku Mbila Nsuma twamushimikile, eko amwitile kukupusuka. Amwitile na kukukwatako ubucindami bwa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
translation: Kanshi nomba mwe bamunyinefwe, muleshipa. Muleikatililafye ku fyacishinka ifyo twamufundile nefyo twamulembele muli kalata.

english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
translation: Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu umwine na Lesa Shifwe uwatutemwa, na ku cikuuku cakwe atupeela icikoseleshi ca pe ne subilo ilyamaka,

english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
translation: engalasansamusha imitima yenu no kulamukosha pakuti mulebomba no kulalanda ifisuma fyonse.

english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
translation: ukuti, mwilatunsha mitima nangu ukuba no mwenso bamo nga batila, Ubushiku bwa Mfumu nabufika. Nalimo kuti mwatontonkanya ukuti mupashi ewalanda ifyo nangu nifwe twafunda nangu twalemba ifyo muli kalata, awe iyoo.

english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
translation: Mwileka umuntu nelyo umo alemubepa nangufye panono. Ubushiku bulya tabwakafike mpaka ilyo ukusangukila Lesa ukwa bantu abengi kukacitika, no mubi uwakulobelela akasokoloke.

english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
translation: Akaisansabalika ukucila pali fyonse ifitwa umulungu nangu pali fyonse ifyo abantu bapepa. Akengila mwitempele lyakwa Lesa akatile nokuti nine Lesa.

english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
translation: Bushe tamuleibukisha? Nalimwebele ifi ilyo twali na imwe.

english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
translation: Kabili mwalishiba icilesha umubi ukuti esokoloka pali ino nshita. Lelo pa nshita iyalinga umubi akasokoloka.

english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
translation: Kwena inkaama ya mubi ilabomba na kale. Lelo ifyo nandile ukuti fikacitika, teti ficitike mpaka Lesa akafumyepo uulesha ifi fintu ukucitika.

english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
translation: Lyena umubi elyo akasokoloka. Lelo Imfumu Yesu ikesa, ikamwipailafye ku mupu waiko, no kumoneka kwaiko ukwabucindami kukamonaula.

english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
translation: Umubi ilyo akesa, akakwata amaka yakwa Satana. Akalacita ifishibilo, ifipeshamano ne finjelengwe ifya misango yonse ifyabufi.

english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
translation: Pakulekelesha, mwe bamunyinefwe muletupepelako ukuti amashiwi ya Mfumu yasalangane bwangu bwangu nokuti yapokelelwe no mucinshi, ngefyo imwe mwayapokelela.

english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
translation: Kabili ilyo twali na imwe twamupeele ifunde ilyakuti, “Uwakaana ukubomba, mwilamupa fyakulya.”

english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
translation: Tulesosa ifi, pantu twalyumfwa ukuti bamo pali imwe banaŋani. Tababomba milimo, baikalilafye umulomo.

english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
translation: Ku maka ya Mfumu Yesu Kristu, tulekonkomesha abo bantu no kubeba ukuti, baleikala ifyo bafwile ukwikala, balebomba pakuti baleilisha abene.

english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
translation: Lelo imwe mwe bamunyinefwe, mwilatendwa ukulacita ifisuma.

english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
translation: Nga umo akaana ukubeela aya mashiwi twamulembela muli uyu kalata, mwishibeni bwino uyo. Mutalukeniko uyo muntu pakuti ekatwe insoni.

english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
translation: Nomba mwilamumona kwati mulwani iyoo, lelo mulemusokako pantu ni munyinenwe.

english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
translation: Imfumu iyine yamutende, ingamupeela umutende mu nshita yonse na muli fyonse. Imfumu ileba na imwe bonse.

english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
translation: Ine ne Paulo nalemba no kuboko kwandi aya mashiwi yakumuposha. Pakupwisha ukulemba kalata yonse, ifi efyo nemba ishina lyandi.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe bonse.

english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
translation: Mulepepa nokuti Lesa aletupokololako ku bantu ababi na bacintomfwa. Pantu te bonse basumina.

english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
translation: Lelo Imfumu yena yacishinka yakulamukosha no kumucingilila ku Mubi.

english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
translation: Imfumu eilenga ukuti tulemucetekela ukuti mulakonka ifyo tumweba, kabili mwakulatwalilila ukukonka ifyo tumweba.

english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
translation: Imfumu ingalamutungulula mukwishibisha ifyo Lesa amutemwa na mukushipikisha nga Kristu.

english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
translation: Mwe bamunyinefwe, tulemukonkomesha ku maka ya Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ukuti, muletaluka kuli bamunyinefwe bonse abanaŋani, abakaana ukukonka amafunde twamufundile.

english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
translation: Imwe mwe bene mwalishibafye bwino ukuti mufwile ukulatupashanya. Ifwe tatwali abanaŋani ilyo twali na imwe.

english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
translation: Ifwe tatwalepoka icakulya ku muntu nelyo umo ukwabula ukulipila. Lelo twalebombesha nganshi no kucucutika ubwaca no bwaila pakuti twibika muntu nelyo umo mu bwafya bwakutulisha.

english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
translation: Twalebombesha, temukutila nico tushakwata insambu shakusungwa, lelo twalecita ifyo pakuti tube icilangililo kuli imwe ico muli nokukonka.

english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
translation: Ine Paulo, Lesa kukufwaya kwakwefye anjita ukuba umusole wakwa Kristu Yesu, antuma kukubila pa mweo Lesa atulaya ico twaba muli Kristu Yesu.

english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
translation: Lelo ukwisa kwa Mupusushi wesu Kristu Yesu, ekwaisa sokolola ici. Aisa onaula imfwa, elyo ku Mbila Nsuma atusokolwela umweo no kukanafwa.

english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
translation: Ine Lesa alinsala ukuba kabila, umusole na kafundisha wa Mbila Nsuma.

english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
translation: Kabili ni pali uyu wine mulandu epo ndeculila ifi. Lelo nshanenuka nakalya, pantu nalishiba uo natetekelamo. Nalishininkisha nokuti wena akasunga bwino bwino ifyo aseekesha kuli ine mpaka na pali bulya Bushiku.

english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
translation: Amashiwi yacishinka ayo nakufunda, uyekatishe, yabe icilangililo uli nokulakonka mukufunda. Uyekatishe ne cisumino ne citemwiko ifyo twakwata ico tuli muli Kristu Yesu.

english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
translation: Ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo uwaikala muli ifwe, ulebaka ifishinka ifyo Lesa aseekesha kuli iwe.

english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation: Nawishiba ukuti abantu aba mu calo ca Asia, ukubikapofye na Fugelo na Hermogene bonse balinsangukila.

english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
translation: Lesa engakwatila aba mu ŋanda yakwa Onesifolo uluse, pantu wena imikufye iyingi alensansamusha. Elyo kabili wena taleumfwa insoni pali ico naba mu cifungo.

english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
translation: Awe wena atile cilya afikafye mu Roma, atampa no kumfwaya mpaka asuka ansanga.

english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
translation: Imfumu ikamubelelekofye uluse pali bulya Bushiku! Kabili iwe Timote nawishibafye bwino ifyo angafwilisheko mu Efeso.

english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: Nakulembela iwe Timote umwana wandi uo natemwa.

english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
translation: Ndatasha Lesa uo mombela no mutima onse uwatambalala ngefyo ifikolwe fyandi fyalecita. Ndamutasha lyonse ilyo nkwibukishako mu mapepo yandi ubwaca no bwaila.

english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
translation: Nshilaba filamba fyobe. Kabili ndafuluka nganshi ukukumona, pakuti nkasansamuke nganshi.

english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
translation: Ndebukisha ne cisumino cacishinka wakwata. Ici cine e cisumino nokokulu Loisi na noko Eunike bakwete. Ine ninshininkisha e cisumino na iwe wine ukwete.

english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
translation: Kanshi e mulandu wine ndekucinkulako ukuti wikatishe ukubomfya icabupe Lesa akupeele mukutambalikilapo amaboko yandi.

english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
translation: Pantu Mupashi Lesa atupeela tewakulenga ukuti tube no mwenso, lelo ni Mupashi wakutupeela amaka, icitemwiko, no mutekatima.

english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
translation: Kanshi wilakwata nsoni pakuba kambone wa Mfumu yesu, nangu ukuba ne nsoni pali ine ico bamposa mu cifungo. Lelo ku maka Lesa akupeela, iwe uleibikafye pamo na ine mukucula pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma.

english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
translation: Ni Lesa ewatupususha no kutwita ukuti tube abamushilo, te pa mulandu wa mulimo twacita, lelo ni pa mulandu wa cikuuku cakwe nokuti efyo umwine alefwaya. Kabili ili shuko Lesa atupeele pa mulandu wakuba muli Kristu Yesu ninshi no kutampa kwa nshita takulafika.

english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
translation: Nomba iwe, we mwana wandi ube uwakosa pa mulandu wa cikuuku ico twashukila ico tuli muli Kristu Yesu.

english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
translation: Kanshi eico ndashipikisha ukucula muli fyonse pa mulandu wa basalwa bakwa Lesa, epakuti nabo bamone ukushukila ukupusuka ukwaba muli Kristu Yesu, elyo nako kuleta ubucindami bwape.

english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
translation: Awe iyi nsoselo yacishinka iyakuti.

english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
translation: Nga twashipikisha mukucula,

english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
translation: Nga tatuli na cishinka,

english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
translation: Uleibukisha abantu bobe pali ifi ifintu. Ulebasokako nganshi pa cinso cakwa Lesa ukuti, tabali nakulaumana pa mashiwifye. Tacawama nelyo panono. Kabili conaulafye icisumino ca bantu abaleumfwako.

english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
translation: Iwe, ulebombeshafye na maka yobe yonse, pakuti Lesa akushininkishe ukuti uli mubomfi uushaba na nsoni pa mulimo wakwe, kabili uufunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa ayacishinka ukwabula ukulufyanya.

english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
translation: Uletaluka ku mashiwi yacilandelande ayabula ukukuma kuli Lesa na ku mashiwi yaciwelewele, pantu yalengafye ukuti abantu balundepo ukutaluka kuli Lesa.

english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
translation: Amashiwi ya musango uyu yena yalunduluka kwati cilonda icishipola. Aba bantu babili Imeneo na Fileto ebafunda amashiwi ya musango uyo.

english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
translation: Aba bantu balifuma ku cishinka. Bena balesosa abati ukushukuka kwa bafwa kwalicitika kale. Kanshi bafulunganya ne cisumino ca bantu bamo abasumina.

english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
translation: Lelo icakuulwa pa mufula uwakosa uo Lesa aimba te cakuteletenta. Pali ici palembwa ukuti, “Lesa umwine alishiba abantu bakwe,” kabili nokuti, “Uyo onse uwasosa ukuti ndi muntu wakwa Lesa, ali nokutaluka kukubifya.”

english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
translation: Walyumfwa ifyo nalefunda pa menso ya bantu abengi bakambone, efyo na iwe ulefunda ku bantu abacishinka, abakuti nabo bakalefunda abantu bambi ifyo fine.

english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
translation: Mu ŋanda iyacindama tamubafye ifipe ifya golide ne fya silifa, lelo muba ne fipe ifya cimuti ne fye bumba. Pali ifi fipe fimo fyakubomfya ku milimo ikankala, elyo fimbi fyakubomfya lyonse.

english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
translation: Kanshi umuntu nga aitalusha ku fibi ifyo nandilepo, lyena akaba icipe icakubomfya ku milimo ikankala. Pantu ninshi naituula kuli Lesa, ali nomba icibombelo cakubomfya Imfumu ku milimo yonse isuma iyo ilefwaya ukubomba.

english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
translation: Uletaluka ku lunkumbwa lubi ulwa mu bulumendo. Kabili pamo na bantu abamitima iyakaele abakuuta Lesa ukuti alebafwilisha, na iwe uli nokufwaisha ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, uwacisumino icitemwiko ne cumfwano.

english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
translation: Lelo iwe uletaluka ku fikansa fyabupuba no buwelewele. Walishiba ukuti ifi filengafye ukulaumana.

english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
translation: Umusha wa Mfumu wena tafwile kulaumana na bantu. Afwile ukuba uwamutembo kuli bonse, kafundisha umusuma kabili uwamutekatima.

english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
translation: Ali nokuba no mutembo mukwalulula abantu abalekanya ifyo alebeba. Pantu limbi kuti Lesa abalenga ukulapila, basuka baishiba icishinka.

english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
translation: Awe lyena elyo amano yakabwela, bakapusuke na ku citeyo cakwa Ciwa umo abekete no kulakonka ifyo alefwaya.

english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
translation: Kanshi na iwe uli nokuculako pamo na ifwe nge cita cacine cine icakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
translation: Icita icili pakubomba, tacifwile kuiposa mu milimo ya bekalacalo, lelo cifwile ukufwayafye ukusansamusha umukalamba wa fita.

english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
translation: Elyo umuntu uulebutuka mukucimfyanya mu lubilo, tekuti acimfye no kupoka icilambu kano alekonka amafunde yakucimfyanya.

english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
translation: Umulimi uwabombeshe eufwile ukubalilapo ukupokako ku fisabo fyalobololwa.

english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
translation: Utontonkanyepo pali ifyo nasosa, pantu Imfumu ikalenga ukuti wiluke pali ifyo fyonse.

english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
translation: Uleibukisha Imbila Nsuma tufunda iyitweba ukuti Yesu Kristu alibushiwe ku bafwa, kabili ali wa mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi.

english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma, epo ndeculila no kukakwa mu minyololo kwati cipondo. Lelo amashiwi yakwa Lesa yena tayakakwa mu munyololo.

english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
translation: Uli nokwishiba ukuti mu nshiku shakupelekeshako mukaba inshita ishabipisha.

english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
translation: Nomba iwe Timote walishiba ifyo mfunda, imyendele yandi, nefyo mfwaya mu bumi bwandi. Walishiba icisumino candi, ifyo naba no mutekatima, icitemwiko candi nefyo nshipikisha.

english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
translation: Walishiba nefyo abantu bancusha na mafya yandi. Iwe walishiba fyonse ifyancitikile, na macushi ayabipisha ayo bancushisheko mu Antioki, Ikonia na mu Lisitila. Lelo Imfumu yalimpokolweleko kuli ifi fyonse.

english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
translation: Mu cine umuntu onse uwaba muli Kristu Yesu, uufwaya ukwikala ngo muntu wakwa Lesa, abantu bakamucusha.

english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
translation: Lelo abantu babi na baitunga ukuba ifyo bashaba, bena bakacililakofye ukubipa, balebepaika bambi no kuibepaika abene.

english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
translation: Lelo iwe ukonkanyepofye ukukonka ifyacishinka wafundwa kabili ifyo washininkisha nganshi. Pantu walishiba na bakafundisha abakufundile.

english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
translation: Kabili uleibukisha ukuti ukufumafye ku bwaice, walishiba Amalembo Yamushilo, ayafwile ukukupanda amano ayakulenga ukuti ku cisumino wakwata muli Kristu Yesu ukapusuke.

english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
translation: Amalembo Yamushilo yonse yena mashiwi yakwa Lesa. Kanshi kuti wayabomfya pakufunda pa cishinka, pakwebaula abaluba, pakwaluluka abali mu filubo, na pakufunda ifyo abantu bali nokuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
translation: Eico kanshi Amalembo Yamushilo yalafwa umuntu wakwa Lesa ukuti akwate fyonse ifyo alekabila pakuti akwate amaka yakubomba umulimo usuma uwa musango onse.

english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
translation: Abantu bakalaisakamanafye abene, bakatemwisha ifyuma, abamataki, kabili abaitutumuna. Bakaba abansele, abashumfwila abafyashi, abashitasha kabili abashili bamushilo.

english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
translation: Bakaba abantu ababula icitemwiko, ababula uluse, ababepeshanya, abashatekanya, abakali kabili abapata ifisuma.

english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
translation: Bakaba abantu abashili bakucetekela, abashisakamana nelyo cimo, abaisulamo icilumba, abatemwa ifyakuisansamusha ukucila ukutemwa Lesa.

english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
translation: Bakalamoneka kwati bantu abapetamina Lesa, lelo mu cacine bakasuula na maka ayaba mukuba umwina Lesa. Uletaluka ku bantu ba musango uyo.

english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
translation: Bamo pali aba bantu bengila mu mayanda ya bantu no kunasha abanakashi abashashipa. Aba banakashi bantu batitikishiwa no bubi bwa fyabubifi fyabo, kabili bantu basendwa no lunkumbwa ulwa misango yonse.

english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
translation: Aba banakashi balafwaya ukusambilila lyonse, lelo tabakatale abeshiba icishinka.

english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
translation: Nga filya Yanesi na Yambulesi bakeenye Mose efyo aba bantu nabo bakaana icishinka. Aba bantu amano yabo tayabomba bwino kabili icisumino cabo cafyefye.

english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
translation: Lelo tabakaye patali nakalya, pantu umuntu onse akamona ukuti fiwelewele fya bantu. Ifyo fine efyacitike na kuli Yanesi na Yambulesi.

english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
translation: Ine ndekukonkomesha pa cinso cakwa Lesa na pa cinso cakwa Kristu Yesu uukabwela kukuputula imilandu ya bomi na bafwa, kabili pantu akesa moneka no kuteeka nge Mfumu.

english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
translation: Pantu Demasi wena alisendwa ne fya calo cino, alinsha, aya na ku Tesalonika. Keleseni aliya ku Galatia, elyo Tito nao ku Dalamatia.

english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
translation: Ndifye na Luka epela. Ukabuule Mako, ukese nankwe, pantu wena kuti alangafwako mu mulimo wandi.

english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation: Tukiko eo natuma ku Efeso.

english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
translation: Ilyo ukalaisa, ukandetele ne cakufimbana candi ico nashile mu Troa kuli Kapo. Ukandeteleko ne fitabo, na shilya mpapa ishalembwapo wikasha iyoo.

english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
translation: Alekisanda, kafula wa fyela ancitile icabipa nganshi. Imfumu eikamukanda pali ifyo acita.

english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
translation: Uli nokucenjela kuli uyu muntu, pantu wena akoselepofye nganshi pakukaanya amafundisho yesu.

english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
translation: Umuku wapakubala ilyo nalelubulula, tapali nelyo umo uwakumpokololako, bonse balindekeleshe. Ndelombafye ukuti Lesa ekabapeela mulandu pali ici.

english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
translation: Lelo Imfumu yali na ine, yampeele na maka pakuti mone ukubila amashiwi yonse aya Mbila Nsuma, pakuti na Benafyalo bonse bayomfwe. Kanshi epakupusuka kukupingwilwa ukufwa.

english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Imfumu yakulampokololako ku fibi fyonse bengancitila, kabili eikansenda no kumfisha umutuntulu mu Bufumu bwaiko ubwa mu mulu. Imfumu nailelumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
translation: Ndeposhapo Prisila na Akwila na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Onesifolo.

english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
translation: Eico ndekukonkomesha nganshi ukuti ulebila amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Ulekomailapo ilyo cilingile nelyo cishilingile line. Ilyo ulefunda, ulebakalipila, uleyalulula abali mu cilubo, kabili ulebakoseleshako, lelo ulecita ifi no mutekatima.

english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
translation: Elasto ashele mu Kolinti, elyo Tulofimo wena namushile mu Mileto, pantu alilwele.

english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
translation: Weshe na maka yobe yonse ukwisa ilyo inshita yampepo tailafika.

english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
translation: Imfumu ileba na iwe. Icikuuku cakwa Lesa cileba na imwe bonse.

english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
translation: Ala inshita ikesa ilyo abantu tabakalefwaya ukumfwa amafunde yacine cine. Lelo bakalakonkafye ifyo balefwaya abene. Bakaikolonganikila bakafundisha abengi abakubeba ifyo abene bafwaya ukumfwa.

english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
translation: Bakaleka ukukutika ku fyacishinka, elyo bakalesakamana ukumfwa ku milumbe.

english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
translation: Lelo iwe uleba uwatekanya inshita yonse. Wilatiina kucula, ulebombafye umulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma, kabili ulebomba no mulimo onse ngo mubomfi wa Mfumu.

english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
translation: Ine nomba ndetuulwa nge cakunwa icaitilwa pelambo. Kabili inshita naifika iyakufuma pano calo.

english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
translation: Nindwa ubulwi ubusuma, nimbutuka ukufika na ku mpela, kabili nalisunga icisumino.

english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
translation: Nomba icilambu bapeela abantu abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa cilempembela. Ici cilambu ni Mfumu iyiputula imilandu no mulinganya ikampeela pali bulya bushiku. Elyo kwena tekuli ine neka, lelo na kuli bonse abalolela ukuti ikamoneke.

english: Be diligent to come to me soon,
translation: Ukeshe na maka yobe yonse ukwisa bwangu kuli ine.

english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
translation: Ine ne Mukalamba nakulembela kalata iwe we mutemwikwa wandi Gayo, uo natemwa icine cine.

english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
translation: Kanshi nga naisa elyo nkesa mweba ifyo acita ne fintu ifibi ifingi alanda ifyakutubepesha. Elyo teifi fyeka, akaana nokupokelela bamunyinefwe ilyo besa, kabili alesha na abo abalefwaya ukubapokelela, elyo alabatamfya na mu lukuta.

english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
translation: We mutemwikwa wilakonkelela aba abacita ifyabipa, lelo ulekonkelela abacita ifisuma. Onse uucita ifisuma muntu wakwa Lesa, lelo onse uucita ifibi wena tatala amona Lesa.

english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
translation: Bonse balatasha nganshi Demetrio, na bucishinka bwakwe bulenga ukuti balemutasha. Na ifwe bene tuli bakambone, na imwe bene mwalishiba ukuti bukambone bwesu bwacishinka.

english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
translation: Ndi ne fyakukweba ifingi, lelo nshilefwaya ukufilemba muli kalata.

english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
translation: Kol 1:14

english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
translation: We mutemwikwa wandi ndakupepelako ukuti uleenda umutende, kabili uleba ne shuko muli fyonse, nga filya waba no mutima we shuko.

english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
translation: Nasansamwike nganshi ilyo naumfwile kuli bamunyinefwe bamo abaishile tushimikilako ifyo wanakila icishinka, nga filya fine lyonse waba.

english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
translation: Takuli cintu nangu cimo icinsansamusha nganshi, ukucila ukumfwa ukuti abana bandi balenakila icishinka.

english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
translation: We mutemwikwa wandi waliba uwacishinka nganshi pa milimo intu ubombela bamunyinefwe nangufye abeni.

english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
translation: Abantu balisa shimika ku lukuta pa mulandu wa citemwiko cobe. Kanshi ndekupapata, ubafwilisheko pa bulendo bwabo mu musango uwingasansamusha Lesa.

english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
translation: Pantu baima ubulendo pa mulandu wa mulimo wakwa Yesu, kabili tabasumina ukupokelela akantu nangu kamo ku bashasumina Lesa.

english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
translation: Kanshi tufwile ukwafwilishako abantu ba uyu musango, epakuti tuleampana nabo mukubombela icishinka.

english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
translation: Nalembele kalata ku lukuta, lelo Diotelefe uufwaisha ubutungulushi alikaana ukumbeela.

english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
translation: Mu musumba wa Kesalia mwalimo umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Konelio. Ali umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo. Iyi mpuka ya fita, baleita ukuti impuka ya bena Itali.

english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
translation: Awe insala yamwikata, alafwaya icakulya. Ilyo balepekanya icakulya, Petelo aisanga mu cimonwa.

english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
translation: Amona umulu waisuka. Amona ne cintu cimo icapala icisalu icikalamba, balecishisha panshi ku fisempe fine.

english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
translation: Mukati muli inama sha misango ne misango, ne fikulaika ne fyuni.

english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyamweba aliti, “Petelo, ima, ipaya, ulye!”

english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
translation: Lelo Petelo ayasuka ati, “Cakaana we Mfumu! Ine nshatala ndya icishasangululwa nangu icakowela.”

english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
translation: Ishiwi lyabwekeshapo umuku wabubili aliti, “Ifyo Lesa asangulula, iwe wilafita auti fyakowela.”

english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
translation: Awe ici cintu cabwekeshapo imiku itatu. Elyo apopene icisalu bacisenda mu mulu nakabili.

english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
translation: Petelo elyo alatontonkanya umulolele icimonwa amona. Mu nshita ine iyo, abantu Konelio atumine ninshi nabasanga ukwabelele iŋanda yakwa Simoni. Awe baiminina pa mwinshi.

english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
translation: Balaipusha abati, “Bushe muli iyi ŋanda, emwikala Simoni uo batila Petelo?”

english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
translation: Ilyo Petelo acili aletontonkanya pa cimonwa, Mupashi amweba ati, “Ala abantu batatu balekufwaya.

english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
translation: Ali umuntu uwapetamina Lesa. Kabili umwine wine no lupwa lwakwe lonse balikwatile Lesa akatiina. Aleyafwilisha nganshi Abayuda abalanda. Kabili lyonse alebikapofye ukupepa Lesa.

english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
translation: Ale ika, muye nabo wishingashinga, pantu nine mbatumine.”

english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
translation: Awe Petelo aika. Elyo abeba ati, “Ala nine wine uo mulefwaya. Cinshi mwaishila?”

english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ni Konelio umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo eututumine. Muntu umusuma kabili uwapetamina Lesa, kabili no mushobo onse uwa Bayuda walimucindika nganshi. Ni malaika wamushilo umo ewamwebele ukuti akwite wise kumwakwe, pakuti omfwe ifyo uli nokumweba.”

english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
translation: Awe Petelo aingisha aba bantu mu ŋanda, abalanga no kwakusendama. Bwaisaca aima, aya nabo. Ababwananyina bamo aba mu Yopa nabo bakonka.

english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkapo elyo bafika mu Kesalia. Konelio wena ninshi alemulolela, naitako ba lupwa lwakwe na batemwikwa bakwe.

english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
translation: Kanshi cilya Petelo afika kwa Konelio, Konelio aisa fuma kukumusengela. Amufukamina amuposha.

english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
translation: Lelo Petelo, amwimya. Amweba ati, “Iminina, ala na ine ndi muntufye.”

english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
translation: Petelo aingila mu ŋanda ninshi balelanda na Konelio. Asangamo na bantu abengi nabalongana.

english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
translation: Alabeba ati, “Imwe mwalishibafye bwino ukuti amafunde ya Bayuda yalilesha Umuyuda ukupempula nangu ukwikala pamo na Benafyalo. Lelo Lesa alinanga ukuti nshili nakweba nelyo umo ukuti uyu muntu untu ashasangululwa nangu wakowela.

english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
translation: Eico ilyo unjitile, njishilefye ukwabula ukukaana. Lelo ndefwayafye ukwishiba ico unjitile.”

english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
translation: Ubushiku bumo cilya akasuba kasendama lwa pa nshita ya 15:00, amona icimonwa. Muli ici cimonwa amonafye bwino bwino uko malaika wakwa Lesa aingila umo ali. Malaika amweba ati, “Konelio!”

english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
translation: Konelio ayasuka ati, “Papita inshiku shitatu, ilyo nalepepa nga pa nshita ino ine mu ŋanda mumwandi cilya akasuba kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00. Awe apopene umuntu uwafwele insalu ishabuuta aisa iminina pa ntanshi yandi.

english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
translation: Asosa ati, ‘Konelio, Lesa naumfwa amapepo yobe, kabili namona nefyo ukumbusuka abalanda.

english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
translation: Kanshi tuma ku Yopa abakuyaita Simoni uo batila Petelo. Ekala kwa Simoni kanuka wampapa. Iŋanda yakwe yaba mupepi na bemba.’

english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
translation: Kanshi na ine apopene epakutuma abakukwita, elyo na iwe wacitafye bwino, waisa. Bonse tuli muno pa cinso cakwa Lesa, tulepembelafye ukumfwa ifyo Imfumu ikwebele ukutweba.”

english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
translation: Elyo Petelo alabeba ati, “Nomba nashininkisha ukuti, cine cine Lesa taba na kapatulula.

english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
translation: Lelo asekelafye umuntu onse uwa mu mushobo onse kumfwa nga akwatila Lesa akatiina kabili alecita nefyo afwaya.

english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
translation: Imwe mwalishiba amashiwi Lesa atumine abena Israeli. Aya mashiwi yakutila, kuti mwaba no mutende ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu, Imfumu ya bantu bonse.

english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
translation: Imwe namwishiba ifyacitika mu Yudeya monse, ukutampafye mu Galile, ukufumafye lilya Yoani alebila palwa kubatishiwa.

english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
translation: Mwalishiba nefyo Lesa afumfumwine Mupashi Wamushilo na maka yakwe pali Yesu wa ku Nasaleti. Elyo nao alapitana konse alecita ifintu ifisuma, aleundapa na bonse abalecushiwa kuli Ciwa, pantu Lesa ali nankwe.

english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
translation: Ifwe tuli bakambone muli fyonse ifyo Yesu acitile mu Yerusalemu na mu calofye conse ica Bayuda. Basukile bamwipaya mukumutanika pa musalaba.

english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
translation: Konelio aikatwa no mwenso, amulolekesha, amwipusha ati, “Ni shani we Mfumu?” Malaika amwasuka ati, “Amapepo yobe nefyo ukumbusuka abalanda filasekesha Lesa. Eico nao alefwaya ukukwasuka.

english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
translation: Lelo pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu, Lesa amubusha ku bafwa, alenga nokuti abantu bamumone.

english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
translation: Kwena te ku bantu bonse iyoo, lelo ni kuli ifwe fwebo Lesa asala ukuba bakambone. Ifwe twalilya no kunwa nankwe panuma yakubuuka ku bafwa.

english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
translation: Atukonkomeshe no kulashimikila abantu, elyo no kulabeba ukuti icine cine Yesu eo Lesa asonta ukuba kapingula wa milandu ya bomi na bafwa.

english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
translation: Kanshi eo bakasesema bonse bapeelapo bukambone abati, ‘Bonse abamusumina, Lesa akababelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo ku maka yakwa Yesu.’ ”

english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
translation: Ilyo Petelo acili alesosa aya mashiwi, awe na Mupashi Wamushilo aisa pali bonse abaleumfwako.

english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
translation: Abayuda abasumina abaishile na Petelo ukufuma ku Yopa, balapapafye pali ico Lesa apeela Abenafyalo ubupe bwakwa Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
translation: Baumfwa noko balelanda indimi ishalekana lekana, balelumbanya na Lesa. Elyo Petelo asosa ati,

english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
translation: “Nga nani engakaanya aba bantu ukubatishiwa ku menshi. Bapokelela Mupashi Wamushilo nga filya fine na ifwe twapokelele.”

english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
translation: Petelo epakubeba ukuti babatishiwe mwishina lyakwa Yesu Kristu. Elyo bamulomba ukuti ekale nabo inshiku shimo shimo.

english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
translation: Kanshi nomba tuma abantu bamo ku Yopa, baye ita umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Simoni, kabili bamwita nokuti Petelo!

english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
translation: Aleikala kwa Simoni kanuka wampapa. Iŋanda yakwe yaba mupepi na bemba.”

english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
translation: Cilya malaika apwa ukulanda nankwe, afumapo aya. Konelio elyo aitapo ababomfi bakwe babili ne cita cimo icapetamina Lesa, icali pa fita ifyalemulinda.

english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
translation: Abashimikilako fyonse ifimoneke, elyo abatuma ku Yopa.

english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
translation: Ubushiku ubwakonkelepo cilyafye akasuba kalafika pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00, abantu Konelio atumine, nabo bafika mupepi na Yopa. Petelo nao anina pa mulu wa ŋanda kukupepa.

english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
translation: Abasole na babwananyina bonse mu Yudeya baumfwile ukuti Abenafyalo nabo nabapokelela ishiwi lyakwa Lesa.

english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
translation: Ici cintu cabwekeshepo imiku itatu. Elyo icisalu casendwa mu mulu.

english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
translation: Pa nshita ine iyo, abantu batatu abo batumine ukufuma ku Kesalia ukwisa kuli ine, bafika. Baiminina na pa mwinshi wa ŋanda naleikalamo.

english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
translation: Elyo Mupashi anjeba ukuya nabo ukwabula ukushingashinga. Aba bamunyinefwe mutanda twaile nabo ku Kesalia. Awe twaya ingila na mu ŋanda mwa Konelio.

english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
translation: Elyo Konelio alatushimikila ifyo amwene malaika naiminina mu ŋanda mumwakwe. Uyu malaika amweba ati, ‘Tuma umuntu ku Yopa uwakuti aye ita Simoni uo batila Petelo.

english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
translation: Uyu muntu eukesa kweba amashiwi yakuti iwe no lupwa lobe mukamone ukupusuka.’

english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
translation: Kutifye cilya natampa ukulanda, awe Mupashi Wamushilo aisa pali bena nga filya fine cali kuli ifwe pakutampa.

english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
translation: Elyo naibukisha nefyo Imfumu yasosele aiti, ‘Yoani alebatisha ku menshi, lelo imwe mukalabatishiwa kuli Mupashi Wamushilo.’

english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
translation: Kanshi apopene Lesa apeela Abenafyalo ubupe bumo bwine ubo atupeele ilyo twasumine mu Mfumu Yesu Kristu, bushe ine nine ningalesha Lesa?”

english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
translation: Ilyo baumfwa ifi, awe ne mitima yaikala. Balalumbanya na Lesa abati, “Kanshi Lesa naleka na Benafyalo nabo bamone ukulapila no kupilibuka, pakuti bakwate umweo!”

english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
translation: Panuma yakwipaya Stefano, abasumina epakusalangana, ico Abayuda balebacusha nganshi. Basuka bamo bafika na mu calo ca Fonisia na ku cishi ca Saiprasi na ku musumba wa Antioki. Kwena baleshimikilakofye Abayuda beka amashiwi yakwa Yesu.

english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
translation: Kanshi ilyo Petelo abwelela ku Yerusalemu, abasumina Abayuda balamumanya.

english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
translation: Lelo bamo pa basumina, abafumine ku Saiprasi na ku Kurene, baile ku Antioki balabila Imbila Nsuma ya Mfumu Yesu ku Benafyalo.

english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
translation: Imfumu nayo yalabafwako. Awe na bantu abengi basumina, banakila Imfumu.

english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
translation: Ili lyashi lyasuka lyaumfwika kwibumba lya ku lukuta lwa ku Yerusalemu. Elyo nabo batumineko Banaba ku Antioki.

english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
translation: Ilyo afikileko, cilya amwene ifilangililo fya cikuuku cakwa Lesa, awe alisansamwike. Abakonkomeshe ukwikatilila ku Mfumu mu cisumino ne mitima yabo yonse.

english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
translation: Banaba ali umuntu umusuma, uwacisumino kabili uwaisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo. Awe na bantu abengifye epakunakila Imfumu.

english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation: Elyo Banaba aya ku Taso kukufwaya Saulo

english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
translation: Cilya amusanga, amuleta ku Antioki. Kanshi pa mwaka utuntulu Banaba na Saulo baikele mu lukuta, balefunda na bantu abengi. Kabili ni mu Antioki emo batampile ukulaita abasambi ukuti “Bena Kristu.”

english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
translation: Mu nshita ine iyi ilyo Banaba na Saulo bali mu Antioki elyo bakasesema bamo baishile ku Antioki ukufuma ku Yerusalemu.

english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
translation: Elyo umo pali aba bakasesema, ishina lyakwe ni Agabu, aiminina. Elyo ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo asobela nokuti, “Mu calo conse ca bena Roma mukapona icipowe icabipisha.” Na cine kwaishile pona icipowe ilyo Kilaudio ali kateeka mukalamba mu buteko bwa bena Roma.

english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
translation: Elyo abasambi baumfwana ukuti bali nokutuma ifyakwafwako ababwananyina banabo aba mu Yudeya. Abati “Cila muntu ali nokupeela apo akwatile.”

english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
translation: Balamweba ati, “Waile fikilila ku bantu abashasembululwa, kabili no kulya walalya nabo!”

english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
translation: Kanshi efintu bacitile. Bapeela Banaba na Saulo indalama ishakutwala ku bakalamba mu Yerusalemu.

english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
translation: Kanshi Petelo epakutampa, alabalondolwela bwino bwino fyonse ifyo cali.

english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
translation: Ati, “Ine nali mu musumba wa Yopa, ndepepa, awe naisanga mu cimonwa. Elyo namona icintu cimo icapala icisalu icikalamba, balecishisha panshi ukufuma mu mulu ku fisempe fine. Awe cafika mupepi napo ndi.

english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
translation: Awe nati ndolekeshe mukati, namonamo inama sha misango ne misango, ne fikulaika ne fyuni.

english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
translation: Elyo natesha ishiwi lyanjeba aliti, ‘Petelo, ima, ipaya, ulye.’

english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
translation: Lelo ine nayasuka nati ‘Awe, cakaana we Mfumu. Ine nshatala ndya icishasangululwa nangu icakowela.’

english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
translation: Nakabili ishiwi lyabwekeshepo ukufuma mu mulu aliti, ‘Ifyo Lesa asangulula, iwe wilafita auti fyakowela.’

english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
translation: Muli iyo ine nshita, imfumu Herodi epakutampa ukulacusha bamo aba mu lukuta.

english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
translation: Bapita pa mpuka yapakubala iya fita fyalelonda, bapita na pa yabubili, basuka bafika na pa mpongolo ya cela iyakwingililamo mu musumba. Awe iciibi ca mpongolo caisukila icine ceka, bafuma. Awe bati bendeko ukukonka umusebo umo, apopene malaika aya, asha Petelo.

english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
translation: Elyo Petelo ashininkisha icicitike. Asosa ati, “Nomba nashininkisha cine cine. Ni Mfumu eintumine malaika waiko pakuti impusushe ukufuma mu minwe yakwa Herodi na kuli fyonse ifyo umushobo wa Bayuda walesubila ukucita.”

english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
translation: Cilya Petelo ashininkisha ifyo cili, alungama ku ŋanda yakwa Maria, nyina kwa Yoani Mako. Ekwalongene abantu abengi, balepepa.

english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
translation: Elyo Petelo akonkonsha ku ciibi. Awe umukashana umo umubomfi ishina lyakwe ni Roda, aisa kukumfwa uulekonkonsha.

english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
translation: Cilya aishiba ishiwi lyakwa Petelo, asansamuka nganshi. Abwelelamo ulubilo, ukwabula ukuti esuleko iciibi. Aya eba abantu ati, “Petelo ali panse pa mwinshi.”

english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
translation: Bonse bamwasuka abati, “Ale akusabaila!” Elyo nao abikapofye ati, “Ala, cine cinefye!” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Kanshi ninshi ni malaika wakwe.”

english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
translation: Petelo wena ninshi abikilepofye ukukonkonsha. Elyo baisulako iciibi. Awe bamumona, cabapesha na mano.

english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
translation: Petelo aimya ukuboko pakuti batalale. Elyo alabashimikilako ifyo Imfumu imufumishe mu cifungo. Abeba nokuti, “Bashimikileko Yakobo na babwananyina bonse.” Elyo afumako aya na kumbi.

english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
translation: Cilya bwaca, ifita ifyalelinda Petelo fyasakamikwa nganshi. Fyalati, “Nga cinshi cicitike kuli Petelo?”

english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
translation: Herodi wena akonkomesha ukuti bali nokumufwaya. Lelo bafilililwafye ukumusanga. Kanshi epakulubulwisha ifita fyalemulinda, elyo apingula nokuti bafipaye. Kabili Herodi afuma mu Yudeya, aya ikala pa nshita inono mu Kesalia.

english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
translation: Yaipaya Yakobo munyina kwa Yoani, yamuputulako umutwe ku lupanga.

english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
translation: Herodi tabaleumfwana na bantu ba mu Turi na ba mu Sidoni. Kanshi nabo epakuyako ibumba kukumonana na Herodi. Babalilapo ukusembeleka Blasto no kwikatana nankwe, pantu ewali kangalila wa kwisano. Elyo baya kuli Herodi pakuti bomfwane nao palwa kwikala mu cibote. Pantu icalo cabo calefumya ifyakulya mu calo ca Mfumu Herodi.

english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
translation: Pa bushiku bwasontelwe, Herodi afwala insalu shakwe ishabufumu. Aikala na pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu. Elyo alalanda ku bantu.

english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
translation: Abantu balasowesha abati, “Walandafye kwati mulungu, taulelanda nga muntunse!”

english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
translation: Apopene malaika wa Mfumu aponesha Herodi ubulwele ico ashali na mucinshi kuli Lesa. Awe imititi yalamulya, asuka afwa.

english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
translation: Nomba ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyene lyaya lilelundulukilakofye.

english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
translation: Cilya Banaba na Saulo bapwile umulimo wabo, awe babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu, basenda na Yoani Mako.

english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
translation: Ilyo yamona ukuti ici casansamusha Abayuda, yabikapo no kwikata Petelo. Ici cacitike mu nshikunkulu yakulyamo Imikate Ishatutumuka.

english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
translation: Cilya yaikata Petelo yamuposa mu cifungo. Yaeba ne mpuka shine isha fita fine ukulakomboshanya pakumulinda. Herodi alefwaya ukumulubulwisha pa lwalala panuma ye Pasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila.

english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
translation: Ilyo Petelo ali mu cifungo, ulukuta lwena lwabikapofye ukulamupepelako kuli Lesa.

english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
translation: Ubushiku bwakutila mailo nga bwaca Herodi ali nokulubulwisha Petelo, ena Petelo alele pakati ka fita fibili, ninshi nabamukaka ne minyololo ibili. Kabili pa mpongolo ya cifungo pali fita fyalelonda.

english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
translation: Awe apopene malaika wa Mfumu aisa aiminina apo ali, na mu kamuputule mwabuuta tuutu ku cengelo. Elyo malaika asunka Petelo mu lubafu, amushibusha. Asosa ati, “Ima bwangu!” Awe ne minyololo yali ku maboko yakwe yapona.

english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
translation: Elyo malaika amweba ati, “Ale kaka umushipi obe, fwala ne ndyato shobe.” Awe efyo Petelo acita. Kabili malaika amweba ati, “Buula ne cakufimbana cobe, unkonke.”

english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
translation: Petelo amukonka, afuma na mu cifungo. Lelo Petelo taishibe ukuti ifilecita malaika fyacine cine. Wena aletontonkanya ukuti alemona icimonwa.

english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
translation: Bakasesema na bakafundisha abali mu lukuta lwa ku Antioki ni Banaba, na Simeoni uo baleti Cifita, na Lukio wa ku Kurene, na Manaeni cibusa wine wine wa mfumu Herodi, elyo na Saulo.

english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
translation: Elyo amweba ati, “We mwana wakwa Ciwa we! Waisula ubufi no bucenjeshi! Niwe mulwani wa fintu fyonse ifyacine cine! Bushe ukaleka lilali ukufulunganya ififwaya Lesa?

english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
translation: Nomba Imfumu yalakukanda. Walapofula, na muli iyi nshita tawakulamona kasuba.” Awe apopene pa menso yakwe paisa icaba nga fubefube, pafiita na fititi. Alapulumpuntafye, alafwaya no wakuti amwikate ku minwe amutungululeko.

english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
translation: Umulashi cilya amona ifyacitika, asumina. Asunguka na pa mashiwi ya Mfumu balemufunda.

english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
translation: Paulo na banankwe elyo bafumine no bwato ku Pafosi baya na ku Pelima mu calo ca Pamfulia. Yoani Mako wena eko abasha, abwelelamo ku Yerusalemu.

english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
translation: Abanankwe bena bafuma ku Pega, baya na ku Antioki mu calo ca Pisidia. Pa bushiku bwe Sabata, baya mu sinagoga, baikala no kwikala.

english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
translation: Cilya bapwa ukubelenga Amafunde yakwa Mose ne fyalemba bakasesema, abakalamba ba sinagoga babatumina inkombe. Babeba abati, “Bamunyinefwe, nga mulipo na mashiwi yakucincisha abantu, kuti mwabeba.”

english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
translation: Paulo epakwiminina aimya ukuboko pakuti bekale tondolo. Elyo alasosa ati, “Umfweni kuno! Mwe bena Israeli na imwe mwe Benafyalo mwe bapepa Lesa.

english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
translation: Lesa wa bena Israeli, asalile ifikolwe fyesu. Ilyo bali abeni mu calo ca Egupto, ewalebafwilisha pakuti babe umutundu uwakosa. Ni Lesa umwine ku maka yakwe ewabafumishe mu Egupto.

english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
translation: Ilyo bali mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane, Lesa wena abikilepofye ukubasakamana.

english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
translation: Kabili ilyo Lesa alofeshe imishobo cine lubali iya mu calo ca Kenani, apeele icalo ca iyo mishobo ku fikolwe fyesu.

english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
translation: Ubushiku bumo ilyo bali mukupepa Imfumu, balefunga ukulya, Mupashi Wamushilo abeba ati, “Mfumishenipo Banaba na Saulo pakuti balebomba umulimo nabasalila.”

english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
translation: Fyonse ifi fyacitike pa myaka cikanga imyanda ine, na makumi yasano (450).

english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
