translation: Kabili balomba Lesa ukubapeela imfumu. Lesa epakubapeela Saulo mwana Kishi, uwa mu luko lwakwa Benjamini. Saulo aikele pa bufumu imyaka amakumi yane.

english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
translation: Elyo Lesa afumya Saulo pa bufumu, abikapo na Davidi ukuba imfumu. Eo Lesa asosapo ati, ‘Ninsanga Davidi mwana Yese, umuntu uwa mibeele iyisansamusha umutima wandi. Wena akulacita fyonse ifyo mfwaya.’

english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
translation: Lesa alaile ukuti, umo muli ba lupwa lwakwa Davidi, eukapususha abena Israeli. Noyu ni Yesu.

english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
translation: Lelo ilyo Yesu talati ese, ninshi Yoani wena alebila ku bena Israeli bonse ukuti babatishiwe no lubatisho lwakulanga ukulapila no kupilibuka.

english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
translation: Ilyo Yoani ali mupepi nokupwisha umulimo wakwe, alasosa ati, ‘Nga imwe muleti nine ani? Bushe imwe muleti nalimo ni ulya ali nokwisa? Awe iyoo! Uuli nokwisa akankonka panuma. Kabili ine nshilingile na kukakula indyato shakwe.’

english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
translation: “Bamunyinane, bamwana Abrahamu, na imwe bonse mwe Benafyalo mwe bapepa Lesa! Nifwe Lesa atumina aya amashiwi yakutupususha.

english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
translation: Abantu ba mu Yerusalemu ne ntungulushi shabo tabaishibe bwino pali Yesu. Tabaumfwile no mwalola amashiwi ya bakasesema ayo babelenga lyonse pa bushiku bwe Sabata. Lelo pakupeela Yesu umulandu bafikilishefye ifyo bakasesema balemba.

english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
translation: Nelyo bashamwene mulandu wakumwipailapo, balombele Pilato ukuti amwipaye.

english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
translation: Ilyo bafikilisha mukucita fyonse ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo pa mulandu wakwe, bamufumya pa musalaba, bamushiika mu nindi.

english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
translation: Panuma yakuleka ukufunga ukulya no kupepa, epakubatambalikilapo amaboko, elyo babatuma.

english: But God raised him from the dead,
translation: Lelo Lesa amubusha ku bafwa.

english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
translation: Amaf 1:31

english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
translation: Ifwe twishile kuno kukumushimikilako Imbila Nsuma iyo Lesa alaile ifikolwe fyesu.

english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
translation: Elyo nafikilisha neci cilayo kuli ifwe fwe bana babo pakubusha Yesu ku bafwa. Efyo calembwa mu Malumbo, mwilumbo lyabubili ukuti,

english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
translation: Elyo pambi napo atila,

english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
translation: Kanshi Davidi mu nshita yakwe abombele imilimo Lesa amupeele, nokufwa afwa. Elyo bamushiika pamo ne fikolwe fyesu no mubili wakwe walibola.

english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
translation: Lelo uo Lesa abusha ku bafwa, ena tabola.

english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane bonse mushininkishe ukuti ku mulandu wa Mbila yakwa Yesu iyi tulebila kuli imwe, Lesa akamubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyenu.

english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
translation: Mushininkishe nokuti onse uwasumina Yesu, Lesa amulenga ukuba uwakaele ku fintu fyonse ifyo Amafunde yakwa Mose yalefilwa ukumulenga ukuba uwakaele.

english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
translation: Atile cilya Mupashi Wamushilo atuma Banaba na Saulo ku mulimo wabo, awe nabo baima baya na ku Selukia. Ukufuma ku Selukia baya no bwato ku cishi ca Saiprasi.

english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
translation: Cenjeleni kanshi, pakuti ifyo bakasesema basobele fikamufikila ifyakuti,

english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
translation: ‘Cenjeleni mwe bamisuula!

english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
translation: Cilya bapwisha ukulongana kwa sinagoga, Abayuda abengi na bayaluka Abayuda abengi abapetamina Lesa balakonka Paulo na Banaba. Elyo Paulo na Banaba nabo balabakonkomesha ukulashangila mu cikuuku Lesa abakwatila.

english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
translation: Kanshi pa bushiku bwe Sabata ubwakonkelepo, abantu ni cikangafye umusumba onse balongana kukumfwa amashiwi ya Mfumu.

english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
translation: Nomba Abayuda cilya bamona cinkupiti wa bantu, ubufuba bwabekata. Balabomfya amashiwi yamusaalula, balakaanya na fyonse ifyo Paulo alesosa.

english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
translation: Elyo Paulo na Banaba balabebekesha abati, “Nimwe twali nokubalilapo ukushimikila amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Kanshi apo mwakaana, mwamona nokuti tamulingile mweo wape, cisuma twalamusha, tuye ku Benafyalo.

english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
translation: Pantu ne Mfumu efyo yatukonkomesha aiti,

english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
translation: Cilya Abenafyalo baumfwa ifi, basansamuka nganshi. Balalumbanya ne shiwi lya Mfumu. Na bonse abo Imfumu yasala kukumona umweo wape, basumina.

english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
translation: Ishiwi lya Mfumu lyalasalanganafye mpanga yonse muli cilya calo.

english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
translation: Bafika na mu musumba wa Salami. Elyo balashimika amashiwi yakwa Lesa mu masinagoga ya Bayuda. Bali na Yoani Mako uwalebafwako.

english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
translation: Lelo Abayuda bena balasokawila abanakashi bakankala abapetamina Lesa na bacilolo ba mu musumba ukuti bemine Paulo na Banaba. Batampa nokulacusha Paulo na Banaba. Babatamfya ukufuma na mu calo cabo.

english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
translation: Nabo abasole babakuntila ulukungu lwa ku makasa yabo, baya na ku Ikoniamu.

english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
translation: Abasambi ba mu Antioki bena basansamuka nganshi, baisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
translation: Elyo Banaba na Saulo bapita ne nshila ya ku mulundu baya fika na ku Pafosi. Ku Pafosi eko basanga Umuyuda umo ishina lyakwe ni Bar-Yesu. Uyu muntu alecita amalele, kabili ali kasesema wabufi.

english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
translation: Kabili ali cibusa wakwa Segio Paulo umulashi wa mu Saiprasi. Uyu Segio Paulo ali umuntu uwamano nganshi. Umulashi Segio Paulo aita Banaba na Saulo pakuti omfweko amashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
translation: Lelo Elima, ekutila, “Uwamalele,” abalesha. Talefwaya ukuti umulashi asumine muli Yesu.

english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
translation: Nomba Saulo, ishina lyakwe limbi ni Paulo, aisulamo na mu Mupashi Wamushilo. Alolekesha na pali Elima.

english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
translation: Mu Ikoniamu namo, pamo nga mu Antioki, Paulo na Banaba balaya ku sinagoga ya Bayuda. Balafunda abantu icakuti Abayuda abengi na Bagiriki abengi basumina mu Mfumu.

english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
translation: Aikatisha ishiwi ati, “Iminina, ololoka!” Awe umuntu afwampuka napo ekele, atampa no kulaenda.

english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
translation: Cilya abantu bamona icacita Paulo, balasowesha mu cina Lukaonia abati, “Ala imilungu naisanguka abantu, nayikila uko tuli!”

english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
translation: Banaba balamwita Seo. Elyo Paulo wena ico ewalelandisha balamwita Elemesi.

english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
translation: Itempele lya mulungu Seo lyali kunse ya musumba. Shimapepo wakwa Seo na bantu ba mu musumba baleta iŋombe ishilume ishasamikwa na maluba ku mpongolo ya musumba pakuti balekele Paulo na Banaba ilambo.

english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
translation: Ilyo abasole Paulo na Banaba baumfwa ifyo balefwaya ukucita, balepaula insalu shabo. Baiposa na mwibumba.

english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
translation: Balapunda abati, “Mwe bantu mwe, cinshi mwalacitila ifi? Ala na ifwe tulifye bantu nga imwe bene! Ifwe twaisa kuno kukubila Imbila Nsuma kuli imwe pakuti tumufumye kuli ifi fintu fyafye. Elyo nokuti mwalukile kuli Lesa wamweo, uwabumba umulu ne calo na bemba na fyonse ifyabamo.

english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
translation: Mu myaka yakale Lesa alekele imishobo yonse ukulacita ifyo ilefwaya.

english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
translation: Lelo Lesa lyonse alailanga ukuti eko aba ku fisuma fyonse acita. Alamupeela imfula ukufuma ku mulu, elyo ne fisabo pa nshita yafiko. Alamupeela ifyakulya, nokulenga imitima yenu isansamuke nganshi.”

english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
translation: Nangu abasole basosele aya mashiwi, awe nalyo line cabafishe nganshi pakulesha abantu ukuti bebalekela ilambo.

english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
translation: Elyo Abayuda bamo abafumine ku Antioko na ku Ikonia baisa ongola amabumba ya bantu. Balasaula Paulo amabwe. Bamukulila na kunse ya musumba pantu baletontonkanya ukuti nafwa.

english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
translation: Lelo Abayuda abashasumine mu Mfumu balasokawila Abenafyalo, baimina ababwananyina balabacusha.

english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
translation: Lelo ilyo abasambi baisa longana apo ali, Paulo aima abwelelamo nabo mu musumba. Bwaisaca, Paulo na Banaba baya ku Debe.

english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
translation: Mu Debe, Paulo na Banaba balabila Imbila Nsuma. Awe balenga na bengi ukuba basambi ba Mfumu. Elyo babwelela ku Lusitila na ku Ikonia na ku Antioki wa mu calo ca Pisidia.

english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
translation: Awe balakoseleshako abasambi, balabakonkomesha no kushipa mu cisumino. Balabeba abati, “Pakwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, tuli nokupita mu macushi ayengi.”

english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
translation: Paulo na Banaba epakusonta abakalamba cila lukuta. Elyo balapepa no kufunga icakulya epakubalubwila mu maboko ya Mfumu iyo basuminemo.

english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
translation: Kabili cilya bapita mu calo ca Pisidia, epakufika mu calo ca Pamfulia.

english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
translation: Mu Pega namo bafundamo amashiwi ya Mfumu, elyo baya ku Atalia.

english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
translation: Kabili bafuma ku Atalia, babwelelamo no bwato ku Antioki, uko babalubwilile ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa pakuti babombe umulimo uo nomba bapwisha.

english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
translation: Ilyo bafika ku Antioki, awe balonganya ulukuta. Elyo balabashimikilako fyonse ifyo Lesa abafwileko ukubomba. Balabashimikilako nefyo Lesa atungulwile Abenafyalo ku cisumino.

english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
translation: Awe uku kwena baikalakofye inshita ikalamba na basambi.

english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
translation: Paulo na Banaba baikalako inshita ikalamba. Balefunda pa Mfumu ukwabula umwenso. Imfumu nayo yabapeela amaka yakucita ifishibilo ne finjelengwe, pakuti abantu bashininkishe ukuti ifyo balesosa pa cikuuku caiko fyacine cine.

english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.
translation: Abantu mu musumba basuka bapatukana. Bamo bawila ku Bayuda, bambi bena ku basole.

english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
translation: Basuka Abenafyalo na Bayuda pamo pene ne ntungulushi shabo, bapanga ukulacusha Paulo na Banaba no kubatobaula amabwe.

english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
translation: Ilyo Paulo na Banaba baumfwa ifi, bafulumukila ku Lusitila na ku Debe, imisumba ya mu calo ca Lukaonia, elyo na mu calo ca mumbali.

english: There they preached the Good News.
translation: Nako kwine balebila Imbila Nsuma.

english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
translation: Mu Lusitila mwali umuntu uwalemana amakasa. Afyelwe icilema, kabili tatalile endapo.

english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
translation: Uyu muntu alekutika kufyo Paulo alelanda. Paulo amulolekesha, elyo amumona ukuti nakwata icisumino cakuti apola.

english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
translation: Elyo abantu bamo, abafumine ku Yudeya baishile ku Antioki. Balafunda ababwananyina ukuti, “Imwe nga tamulesembululwa, ukulingana no lutambi Mose atufunda, ninshi tekuti mupusuke.”

english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi ico muleesesha Lesa pakutwika Abenafyalo icipe icafina, ico ifwe bene ne fikolwe fyesu twafilwa ukusenda?

english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
translation: Awe iyoo! Na ifwe bene pamo nga basambi, cikuuku ca Mfumu Yesu ecitupususha ilyo twamusumina.”

english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
translation: Awe ibumba lyonse lyaikalafye tondolo. Lyalakutika kufyo Banaba na Paulo baleshimika ifishibilo ne finjelengwe Lesa abapeele ukucita mu Benafyalo.

english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
translation: Cilya bapwa ukulanda, Yakobo nao ati, “Bamunyinane, kutikeni kuno!

english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
translation: Simoni natushimikila ukuti ni Lesa ewabalilepo ukulanga ifyo asakamana Abenafyalo, ilyo abuulilepo bamo ukuba abantu bakwe.

english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
translation: Ifi fyayanafye bwino na mashiwi ya bakasesema. Pantu calembwa ukuti,

english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up
translation: ‘Panuma ya ifi elyo nkabwela,

english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’
translation: Epakuti impuka ya bantu abakashala

english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
translation: Efyasosa Imfumu,

english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
translation: Elyo Yakobo alundapo nokuti, “Ine ndepingula ukuti, tatufwile kufushanya ifyakwafya Abenafyalo abaleyalukila kuli Lesa.

english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
translation: Awe Paulo na Banaba balaumana nabo no kubikana nabo ifikansa nganshi pali uyu mulandu. Kanshi elyo bapingula ukuti Paulo na Banaba na bambi bamo, baye ku Yerusalemu kukuya monana na basole na bakalamba pali uyu mulandu.

english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
translation: Tufwile twabalembela kalata. Twabebamo ukuti, tabali nakulyako inama isho batuulile ku tulubi, bali nokutaluka ku bulalelale, tabali nakulyako inama isho baipaya ukwabula ukuteeta pa mukoshi nangu ukulyako umulopa.

english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
translation: “Pantu ukufuma na kale Amafunde yakwa Mose balayafunda mu misumba yonse, elyo na pa bushiku bwe Sabata lyonse balayabelenga mu masinagoga.”

english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
translation: Elyo abasole na bakalamba no lukuta lonse lwine bonse bapingushanya ukuti batume ku Antioki abantu bamo aba mwibumba lyabo, baye pamo na Paulo na Banaba. Awe basala Yuda, uo baleti Basaba, na Sailasi. Aba bantu babili bali intungulushi ishalumbuka pakati ka babwananyina.

english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
translation: Babapeela na kalata wakusenda apalembelwe ifi,

english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
translation: Twalyumfwa ukuti abanensu bamo aba mwibumba lyesu, balisa musakamika no kumumika imitima kufyo balandile. Aba bantu baitendekefye abene, tefwe twabebele iyoo.

english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
translation: Kanshi ifwe twalilongana, twalisuminishanya nokuti tusale bamo, tubatume uko muli. Bakesa na babile besu Banaba na Paulo.

english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Aba bantu baipeela onse kukubombela Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
translation: Eico kanshi twatuma Yuda na Sailasi pakuti nabo bakamushimikileko ifintu twalemba muli kalata.

english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
translation: Mupashi Wamushilo pamo na ifwe bene tulemwebafye ukuti tatulefwaya ukufushanya amafunde yakumusakamika, lelo muli nokulakonkafye aya mafunde twalalemba.

english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
translation: Tamuli nakulyako ifyakulya fyonse batuula ku tulubi. Tamuli nakulyako umulopa. Tamuli nakulyako inama iyo baipaya ukwabula ukuteeta pa mukoshi. Muletaluka na ku bulalelale. Ifi fintu nga mwalafikonka, ninshi mulewamya.

english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
translation: Levi 12:3

english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
translation: Awe inkombe shaima shaya na ku Antioki. Mu Antioki inkombe shalonganya ulukuta lonse shabapeela na kalata.

english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
translation: Cilya babelenga amashiwi yacikoseleshi ayalimo, awe basansamuka nganshi.

english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
translation: Yuda na Sailasi, ico bena ni bakasesema, nabo balanda nabo pa nshitafye ikalamba ifyakukoselesha no kucincisha ababwananyina.

english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
translation: Kabili cilya baikalako inshita iyilingile, ababwananyina babalekamo pakuti babwelelemo ku babatumine, abati, “Kafikenipo umutende.”

english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
translation: Lelo Paulo na Banaba bena bashala mu Antioki. Bali pamo na bambi abengi, balefunda nokubila Imbila Nsuma ya Mfumu.

english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
translation: Pati papite inshita, Paulo aebele Banaba ati, “Natubwelelemo, tupempule ababwananyina bonse mu misumba yonse umo twashimikile amashiwi ya Mfumu. Tumone nefyo bali mu cisumino cabo.”

english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
translation: Banaba wena alafwaya ukusenda Yoani Mako.

english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
translation: Lelo Paulo akaana ati, “Awe tacilolelemo, pantu alitushile ilyo twali mu Pamfulia, aleka no kulabomba na ifwe.”

english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
translation: Awe paba nokuumana nganshi, elyo balekana. Banaba asenda Mako baya no bwato ku Saiprasi.

english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
translation: Cilya bafika mu Yerusalemu, ulukuta na basole na bakalamba bonse babasekelelafye bwino. Elyo nabo balabashimikila fyonse ifyo Lesa abafwilishe ukubomba.

english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
translation: Paulo ena asala Sailasi. Elyo ababwananyina babalubwila ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa, awe baima baya.

english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
translation: Bapita mu Siria na mu Kilikia, balecincisha inkuta.

english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
translation: Nomba abasumina bamo, abali mwibumba lya Bafalise baiminina balasosa abati, “Abena Kristu Abenafyalo bali nokusembululwa. Kabili tuli nokubeba ukulakonka Amafunde yakwa Mose.”

english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
translation: Elyo abasole na bakalamba balongana pakuti bomfwane pali uyu mulandu.

english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.
translation: Awe balandaukapo nganshi pa nshita iyitali. Elyo Petelo aiminina alabeba ati, “Mwe bamunyinane, mwalishibafye bwino ukuti, ni kalefye Lesa ansalile mwibumba lyenu ukuti ndebila amashiwi ya Mbila Nsuma ku Benafyalo, pakuti nabo bayumfwe, basumine.

english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
translation: Kabili Lesa uwaishiba imitima ya bantu, alilanga ukuti alibapokelela pakubapeela Mupashi Wamushilo, nga filya fine na ifwe atucitile.

english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
translation: Lesa taba na kapatulula pali ifwe fwe Bayuda na Benafyalo. Pantu nabo alibabelela uluse pali ico bamusumina.

english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.
translation: Paulo elyo aile ku Debe na ku Lusitila. Kuli uyu musumba ekwaleikala umusambi umo ishina lyakwe ni Timote. Nyina kwa Timote ali Muyuda, kabili uwasumina muli Kristu, lelo wishi ena ali Mugiriki.

english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
translation: Atile cilya Paulo amona ici cimonwa, awe apopene twalaipekanya ukuya ku Makedonia. Pantu twalishininkishe ukuti Lesa natwita ukuya bila Imbila Nsuma kuli aba bantu.

english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
translation: Elyo twafuma no bwato ku Troa, twalungamafye ku Samotulake. Bwaisaca epakuya ku Neapoli.

english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
translation: Elyo twafumako twaya ku Filipi, umusumba walumbwike mu citungu ici ca Makedonia. Abena Roma ebaleikalamo. Awe na ifwe twaikalamo inshiku shimo shimo.

english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
translation: Pa bushiku bwe Sabata, twafumina kunse ya musumba, twaya ku lulamba lwa mumana, ku ncende uko twalesubila ukuti eko Abayuda balongana kukupepa. Twaikala twalalanda na banakashi abalongeneko.

english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
translation: Kanshi umwanakashi umo pali abo baleumfwako, ni Ludia, umwina Tiatila, kashitisha wa nsalu ishakashikila. Uyu mwanakashi alepepa Lesa. Imfumu yamunasha umutima, pakuti apokelele amashiwi Paulo alesosa.

english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.
translation: Awe umwine wine na bonse abo aleikala nabo pa ŋanda babatishiwa. Elyo atwita kumwakwe ati, “Nga cine muletontonkanya ukuti na ine ndi wasumina icine cine mu Mfumu, iseni kumwandi eko muleikala.” Awe na ifwe epakuya kumwakwe.

english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
translation: Ubushiku bumo twaleya ku ncende uko bapepela. Elyo twakumanya umukashana umo, umusha, uwawililwe no mupashi uwakowela. Uyu mupashi walengele nokuti alesesema ifili nokucitika kuntanshi. Mukweba abantu ifili nokubacitikila kuntanshi, uyu mukashana alengele bashikulu wakwe ukulamwenamo indalama ishingi.

english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
translation: Uyu mukashana alakonka Paulo na ifwe bene alepunda ati, “Aba bantu e basha bakwa Lesa Mukulu! Ebalemweba amashiwi yakumulanga ifyo muli nokupusuka!”

english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
translation: Efyo akonkanyapo ukucita inshiku ishingi. Asuka Paulo afulwa, apilibuka aeba no mupashi uwakowela ati, “Ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu, ndekweba fuma muli uyu mukashana!” Awe apopene umupashi uwakowela wamufumamo.

english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
translation: Nomba bashikulu wa mukashana cilya bamona ukuti nomba nacipwa takuli kwakumwena indalama, baikata Paulo na Sailasi. Babatantanya, babatwala ku cilye mu lubansa lwa cisankano.

english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
translation: Ababwananyina bonse aba mu Lusitila na ku Ikoniamu balesosa abati, “Timote muntu umusuma.”

english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
translation: Babaleta na kuli bakaputula wamilandu. Balabeba abati, “Aba bantu Bayuda, nomba baleleta icimfulunganya mu musumba wesu.

english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
translation: Elyo balefunda ne misango iyapusana na mafunde yesu, iyo ifwe fwe bena Roma tushingasumina nangu ukukonka.”

english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
translation: Elyo ibumba lyawilamo mukupuma Paulo na Sailasi. Bakaputula wamilandu balepaula ifyakufwala fyakwa Paulo na Sailasi, babeba nokuti babome ifikoti.

english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
translation: Awe cilya bapwa ukubalopaula, babaposa na mu cifungo. Elyo bakonkomesha kalinda wa cifungo ukubalinda bwino.

english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
translation: Kalinda nao pakumfwa ifyo bamukonkomesha, abaposa mu kamuputule ka mukati na nkati. Elyo akakila amolu yabo mu makoli.

english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
translation: Cilya calafika pakati ka bushiku Paulo na Sailasi balapepa, balaimba ne nyimbo shakulumbanya Lesa. Abafungwa bambi bena balekutikakofye.

english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
translation: Apopene icinkukuma icikalamba capita, ne ŋanda ya cifungo yonse yalatenta. Elyo kabili apopene ifiibi fyonse fyaisuka, ne minyololo ku bafungwa bonse yaiponenafye iyine.

english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
translation: Kalinda wa cifungo ashibuka. Amona nokuti ifiibi fya cifungo fyonse nafisuka. Wena alatontonkanya ukuti abafungwa bonse nabafyuka. Kanshi asomona ulupanga alafwaya ukuipaya.

english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
translation: Lelo Paulo apunda ne shiwi likalamba ati, “Leka, wiipaya, bonse emo tuli!”

english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
translation: Kalinda wa cifungo epakwita abakuleta ifisaniko. Elyo ayamo ulubilo afukamina Paulo na Sailasi, aletutumafye ku mwenso.

english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
translation: Paulo alafwaya ukuti baye nankwe pa bulendo. Kanshi epakumusembulula. Acitile ifi ku mulandu wa Bayuda bali muli cilya calo. Pantu bonse balishibe ukuti wishi Mugiriki.

english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
translation: Elyo abafumisha panse, alabepusha ati, “Mukwai, ndi nokucita shani pakuti mpusuke?”

english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
translation: Nabo bamweba abati, “Sumina Imfumu Yesu, elyo iwe na ba mu ŋanda yobe mulepusuka.”

english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
translation: Elyo balamufunda na ba mu ŋanda yakwe bonse amashiwi ya Mfumu.

english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
translation: Mu nshita ine iyo iya bushiku kalinda wa cifungo abasenda, alabasambila ne filonda fyabo. Awe apopene bamubatisha pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwe bonse.

english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.
translation: Elyo aleta Paulo na Sailasi mumwakwe, abapeela ne cakulya balalya. Awe kalinda wa cifungo pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwe bonse basansamuka nganshi ico basumina muli Lesa.

english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
translation: Cilya bwaca ulucelo, bakaputula wamilandu batuma inkombe kuli kalinda bakonkomesha abati, “Kakula abo bantu, uleke baleya.”

english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
translation: Awe kalinda afisha aya mashiwi kuli Paulo. Amweba ati, “Bakaputula wamilandu bakonkomesha ukuti mukakule muleya. Kanshi nomba fumeni, mufikepo umutende.”

english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
translation: Paulo aeba inkombe ati, “Ifwe tuli bena Roma. Batuumine pa lwalala, ukwabula ukutulubulwisha, batuposa na mu cifungo. Elyo nomba balefwaya ukutufumya mu bumfisolo? Awe cakaana! Mubebe bakaputula wamilandu abene bese, ebo bese batufumye.”

english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
translation: Awe inkombe batumine shaya fisha aya mashiwi kuli bakaputula wamilandu. Cilya baumfwa ukuti Paulo na Sailasi bena Roma, awe umwenso wabekata.

english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
translation: Bakaputula wamilandu epakwisa balabapapata. Elyo babafumya mu cifungo. Babalomba nokuti bafume mu musumba.

english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo balepitana mu misumba, baleshimikilako abena Kristu amafunde ayo abasole na bakalamba bapingwile mu Yerusalemu. Balebakonkomesha ukulasunga ayo mafunde.

english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
translation: Ilyo Paulo na Sailasi bafuma mu cifungo, baya ku ŋanda kwa Ludia. Mwa Ludia emo bamonanina na babwananyina. Cilya bapwa ukubeba amashiwi yacikoseleshi, bafuma baya.

english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
translation: Awe cisumino ca nkuta calakoselakofye, kabili inshiku shonse inkuta shalafulilakofye ku bwingi.

english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
translation: Paulo na banankwe bapitile mu calo ca Fulugia na mu ca Galatia. Pantu Mupashi Wamushilo talefwaya ukuti babile Imbila Nsuma mu calo ca Asia.

english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
translation: Cilya bafika ku mupaka wa Musia, balafwaya ukuti baye mu calo ca Bitunia. Lelo Mupashi wakwa Yesu abalesha.

english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
translation: Kanshi epakulaya, balalanya icalo ca Musia, baya na ku musumba wa Troa.

english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
translation: Mu nshita ya bushiku, Paulo amona icimonwa. Mu cimonwa amona umwina Makedonia naiminina alemupapata aleti, “Mwabukile kuno calo ca Makedonia, mwise mutwafwe.”

english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
translation: Elyo Paulo na Sailasi bapitile mu mishi ya Amfipoli na Apolonia. Bafika na ku musumba wa Tesalonika umwali sinagoga iya Bayuda.

english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
translation: Cilyafye bwaila ababwananyina batuma Paulo na Sailasi ku Belea. Elyo cilya bafikako baya ku sinagoga iya Bayuda.

english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
translation: Mu Belea mwena Abayuda bali ne cumfwila ukucila aba ku Tesalonika. Awe bena basampuka nganshi mukupokelela amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Cila bushiku balapituluka mu Malembo Yamushilo, pakumona ngefyo Paulo alelanda fyacishinka.

english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
translation: Awe Abayuda abengi basumina. Abanakashi bakankala abengi Abagiriki na baume Abagiriki abengi nabo basumina.

english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
translation: Nomba Abayuda mu Tesalonika baumfwako ukuti Paulo aleshimikila ishiwi lyakwa Lesa na ku Belea. Awe nabo baisako, batampa no kusokawila abantu, mwaba ne cimfulunganya.

english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
translation: Ababwananyina nabo bwangu bwangu batuma Paulo ku calo ca ku lulamba lwa bemba. Lelo Sailasi na Timote bena bashala mu Belea.

english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
translation: Abantu abaleshindika Paulo, bamushindika ukufika na ku musumba wa Atensi. Elyo babwelelamo ku Belea. Paulo abakonkomesha nokuti bebe Sailasi na Timote ukuti bendeshe ukuya kuntu ali.

english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
translation: Elyo Paulo alalolela Sailasi na Timote mu Atensi. Ilyo ali mu Atensi, amwene ukuti umusumba waisulamofye utulubi, awe camusakamika nganshi.

english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
translation: Mu sinagoga alalanshanya na Bayuda na Benafyalo abapetamina Lesa. Lelo mu mansa sha pa cisankano alelanshanyafye cila bushiku no muntu onse uo akumanya.

english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
translation: Elyo ibumba lya bantu bamo abalekonkelela amano yakwa Epikulo na Sitoiki balabikana ifikansa. Bamo balasosa abati, “Ngoyu muntu cilandelande finshi alefwaya ukusosa?” Bambi balasosa abati, “Ali kwati alelanda pa milungu imbi imbifye.” Ico balelandila ifyo nico Paulo aleshimikila pali Yesu na pa kushukuka kwa bafwa.

english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
translation: Elyo bamusenda bamutwala na ku cilye baleteka pa lupili lwa Aleopago Balamweba abati, “Tulefwaya ukwishiba ifi fintu fipya ulefunda.

english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
translation: Paulo aya ku sinagoga, ico efyo abelele ukucita. Elyo pa nshiku she Sabata shitatu, alelanshanya na bantu pa milandu yalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
translation: Pantu ifintu fimo ifyo ulelandapo fyeni kuli ifwe. Kanshi kuti twatemwa ukwishiba umo filolele.”

english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
translation: Abena Atensi bonse na beni bene abaleikalamo batemwikwa icintu cimo, ukulanshanya no kumfwa ifintu ifipya.

english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
translation: Elyo Paulo aiminina mu cilye ca pa lupili lwa Aleopago. Alasosa ati, “Mwe bena Atensi! Ine nimona ukuti mulapepa nganshi.

english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.
translation: Pantu ilyo naletandala mu musumba wenu, nimona incende isho mupepalapo. Mwenepo no bulambo bumo apo calembwa ukuti, ‘Kuli Lesa Ushaishibikwa.’ Kanshi ico cine mupepa, ico mushaishiba, eco ine nalamulondolwela.

english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
translation: Lesa uwabumba icalo na fyonse ifyabamo, e Mfumu ya mulu ne calo. Tekala mu matempele ayakuulwa na bantu,

english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
translation: Lesa takabila nelyo cimo, kanshi takabila nelyo cimo ico abantu bengamubombela. Pantu ni Lesa eupeela abantu ubumi nokuti balepema, eubapeela na fyonsefye.

english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,
translation: Ukufuma ku muntu umofye Lesa apanga imishobo yonse iya bantu, ababika ne mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse. Umwine wine ewabapimina inshita ne mipaka ya fyalo fyabo.

english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
translation: Isham 8:27

english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
translation: Pantu ngefyo umo asosa ati,

english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
translation: Kanshi apo ‘tuli bana bakwa Lesa,’ tatufwile kulatontonkanya ukuti Lesa aba nge cilubi bafundi bapanga mu fyakubasabasa ifya cela ca golide nangu icela ca silifa, nangu ilibwe.

english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
translation: Alabalondolwela no kubalanga ukuti Kristu ali nokucula no kushukuka ku bafwa. Paulo alasosa nokuti, “Uyu Yesu ndemushimikilapo, ala e Kristu wine.”

english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
translation: Kwena Lesa alisuulako kuli ifyo fintu balecita pantu pa nshita iyo tabamwishibe. Lelo ndakai alekonkomesha abantu bonse mpanga yonse ukuti balapile no kupilibuka.

english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
translation: Pantu Lesa alisala kale ubushiku bwakupingwilamo aba pano isonde bonse no mulinganya. Lesa alisonta no muntu wakuba kaputula wamilandu. Lesa alilanga apabuuta tuutu uyu muntu ku bantu bonse pakumubusha ku bafwa.”

english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
translation: Cilya baumfwa Paulo alanda palwa kubuuka ku bafwa, bamo balamuseka. Bambi balasosa abati, “Pali ici cena tukesa umfwako limbi.”

english: Thus Paul went out from among them.
translation: Kanshi Paulo epakufuma pa cilye.

english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
translation: Lelo bamo bena balakonka Paulo, basumina na mu Mfumu. Pali abo, umo ni Dionisi shicilye wa cilye ca pa lupili, Aleopago, no mwanakashi umo ishina lyakwe ni Damali, elyo na bambipo.

english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
translation: Awe bamo basumina, balakonka Paulo na Sailasi. Ibumbafye ilikalamba ilya Bagiriki abapetamina Lesa, na banakashi bakankala abengi nabo basumina.

english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
translation: Kanshi Abayuda baikatwa no bufuba. Balonganya ifiwelewele fya bantu ukufuma ku cisankano. Bapanga ibumba, lyaimya ne cimfulunganya mu musumba. Kabili baya sansa iŋanda yakwa Yasoni, ico balefwaya Paulo na Sailasi pakuti babalete kwibumba.

english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
translation: Lelo ico bashibasangileko, batantanya Yasoni na babwananyina bamo babatwala na kuli bakaputula wamilandu, balepunda abati, “Aba bantu ebaleta icimfulunganya konsefye! Nomba nabesa na muno musumba wesu.

english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
translation: Bafikila kwa Yasoni. Elyo tabalekonka amafunde yakwa kateeka mukalamba Kesalo. Balesosa nokuti kuli imfumu imbi, ishina lyaiko ni Yesu.”

english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
translation: Pakumfwa ifi abantu bonse na bakaputula wamilandu basakamana nganshi.

english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
translation: Elyo bakaputula wamilandu baeba Yasoni na banankwe ukulipila indalama sha cikatila mulandu. Elyo babalekamo.

english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
translation: Elyo Paulo afumine ku Atensi aile ku Kolinti.

english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
translation: Ine tuli nobe. Tapali nangu umo uwakukucusha, pantu abantu abengi aba muli uyu musumba bantu bandi.”

english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
translation: Kanshi Paulo epakwikala mu musumba umwaka umo ne myeshi mutanda, alefunda abantu amashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
translation: Ilyo Galio ali umulashi wa calo ca Akaia, Abayuda balongana baumfwana, baikata Paulo. Bamutwala na ku cilye.

english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
translation: Balamwebelela abati, “Uyu muntu alesembeleka abantu ukulapepa Lesa mu musango uwapusana na mafunde yesu.”

english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
translation: Paulo talati atampe no kulanda, Galio asosa ati, “Umfweni mwe Bayuda, nga cakuti apaba ukonaula amafunde nangu ukulufyanya fimo nga kuti nasakamana ukumfwa umulandu wenu.

english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
translation: Lelo nga kubikanafye ifikansa pa mashiwi na pa mashina, nangu pa mafunde yenu, fyena ifyo kuti mwaumfwana mwe bene. Ine nshifwaya ukuba kaputula wamilandu ya uyo musango.”

english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
translation: Awe abatamfisha na kunse ya cilye.

english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
translation: Awe elyo bonse bafukukila Sositeni, umukalamba wa sinagoga, balamupuminafye pa menso ya bashicilye. Galio wena tewakuposako mano nakalya.

english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
translation: Imp 6:18

english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
translation: Ilyo bafika mu musumba wa Efeso, Paulo eko asha Prisila na Akwila. Umwine wena aya ku sinagoga alalanshanya na Bayuda.

english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
translation: Mu Kolinti asangamo Umuyuda umo ishina lyakwe ni Akwila, uwafyalilwe ku Ponti. Nao kanshi elyo afuminefye ku Itali no mukashi wakwe Prisila. Pantu kateeka mukalamba wa bena Roma, Kilaudio akonkomeshe ukuti, Abayuda bonse bali nokufuma mu Roma. Paulo epakuyako kukubapempula.

english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
translation: Balamulomba ukuti ekale nabo inshiku shimo shimo, lelo akaana.

english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
translation: Pakuya alabashalikapo ati, “Nkabwela nakabili nga Lesa alefwaya.” Elyo afuma ku Efeso, aya no bwato.

english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
translation: Ilyo afika ku Kesalia, aya kukuposha ulukuta, elyo aya ku Antioki.

english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
translation: Mu Antioki aikalamofye inshita inono, elyo afumamo, aya alakoselesha abasambi bonse mu calo ca Galatia na Fulugia.

english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
translation: Umuyuda umo umwina Alekisandilia, ishina lyakwe ni Apolo aishile ku Efeso. Ali uwacenjela nganshi mukulanda. Kabili uwaishibisha nganshi Amalembo Yamushilo.

english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
translation: Alifundilwe bwino pa mafunde ya Mfumu. Ali uwakalabana nganshi mukulanda na mukufunda fyonse bwino pali Yesu. Lelo kwena aishibefye ulubatisho lwakwa Yoani.

english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
translation: Elyo atampa ukulalanda ukwabula umwenso mu sinagoga. Cilya Prisila na Akwila baumfwa ifyo alelanda, bamusenda kumwabo. Balamulondolwela bwino inshila Lesa afwaya ukuti abantu balekonka.

english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
translation: Elyo Apolo alafwaya ukuya ku calo ca Akaia. Ababwananyina ba mu Efeso balamukoselesha, balemba na kalata ku basambi ba mu Kolinti ukuti bamupokelele bwino. Cilya afikako, alayafwilishako abantu abo Lesa mu cikuuku cakwe alengele ukuti basumine muli Yesu.

english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
translation: Pa mulandu wa kukalabana kwakwe, acimfya Abayuda ilyo balepaashanya pa lwalala. Alebomfya ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo pakubashinina ukuti, Yesu e Kristu wine.

english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
translation: Paulo ico asanga ukuti balebomba umulimo umo wine nao alebomba, uwakupikula amatenti yakwikalamo, awe aikala nabo. Alabomba nabo.

english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
translation: Elyo cila bushiku bwe Sabata, aleya ku sinagoga alelanshanya na Bayuda na Bagiriki. Alefwaya ukuti basumine ifyo alebeba.

english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
translation: Cilya Sailasi na Timote bafika ukufuma ku Makedonia, Paulo lyena inshita yonse alaikalilafye ukufunda Abayuda no kupeela bukambone ukuti Yesu e Kristu wine.

english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
translation: Ilyo balamukaanya, balalanda ne fyamusaalula, Paulo abuula insalu shakwe alabakuntila ulukungu. Alabeba ati, “Mwailofyafye mwe bene, ine nshikwete mulandu! Ukufuma nomba ine nakulayafye ku Benafyalo.”

english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
translation: Elyo Paulo afuma mu sinagoga, aya na kukwikala no muntu umo uupepa Lesa, ishina lyakwe ni Titio Yusito. Iŋanda yakwe yalifye mupepi na sinagoga.

english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
translation: Kilisipo umukalamba wa sinagoga, nao asumina mu Mfumu pamo pene na ba mu ŋanda yakwe bonse. Awe na bena Kolinti abengi ilyo baumfwa ifyo Paulo alefunda, basumina no kubatishiwa babatishiwa.

english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
translation: Ubushiku bumo mu nshita ya bushiku, Imfumu yamonekela Paulo, yalamweba aiti, “Wilatiina, konkanyapofye ukufunda, tauli nakuleka iyoo.

english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.
translation: Ilyo Apolo acili mu Kolinti, Paulo apitile ne nshila ya ku mulundu afika na ku Efeso. Asangako abasambi bamo.

english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
translation: Alecita ifi ifine pa myaka ibili. Kanshi ici calengele ukuti Abayuda na Bagiriki abaleikala mu calo ca Asia bomfwe amashiwi ya Mfumu.

english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
translation: Mateo 3:11

english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
translation: Kanshi abantu balasenda ifitambala ne nsalu balemukumya nafyo, bafitwala ku balwele. Abalwele balapola na bali ne mipashi yakowela yalabafumamo.

english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
translation: Elyo Abayuda bamo abaleendauka mukufumya imipashi yakowela, nabo baleesha ukulumbula ishina lya Mfumu Yesu, pakuti bafumye imipashi yakowela. Balasosa abati, “Ndekukonkomesha mwishina lya Mfumu Yesu, uo Paulo ashimikila, fumamo.”

english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
translation: Bamwana Skefa abaume cine lubali e bamo pali abo balecita ifi. Sikefa ali shimapepo mucindami wa Bayuda.

english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
translation: Lelo umupashi uwakowela wabeba auti, “Yesu nalimwishiba, elyo na Paulo wine nao nalimwishiba. Nga imwe, nimwe bani?”

english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
translation: Awe umuntu uwawililwe no mupashi uwakowela abafukukila na maka nganshi abacimfya. Abapamaula, abacenaula, babutuka ulubilo ubwamba ukufuma mu ŋanda.

english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
translation: Cilya Abayuda na Bagiriki abaleikala mu Efeso baumfwa ificitike, awe baikatwa no mwenso. Balalumbanya ne shina lya Mfumu Yesu.

english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.
translation: Abengi pali abo basumine muli Yesu, balailetafye abene, baleyebelela pa lwalala ifintu ifibi bacitile.

english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
translation: Abengi pali abo abalecita ifyamalele, baleta ifitabo fyabo pamo, elyo bafyocela pa cinso ca bantu bonse. Cilya balonganya pamo imitengo ya fitabo fyonse, cafika ku ndalama sha silifa amakana amakumi yasano (50,000).

english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
translation: Alabepusha ati, “Bushe ilyo mwasumine muli Yesu, mwalipokelele Mupashi Wamushilo?” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Awe ifwe tatwatala atumfwa ukuti kwaliba Mupashi Wamushilo.”

english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
translation: Pa mulandu wa ifi ficitwa fya maka, ishiwi lya Mfumu lyalasalanganinakofye no kubomba na maka.

english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
translation: Ilyo ifi fyati fipite, Paulo apanga ukuya ku Yerusalemu ukupita mu calo ca Makedonia na mu Akaia. Alati, “Nga nafuma ku Yerusalemu, lyena elyo nkaya tandala na ku Roma.”

english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
translation: Kanshi epakutangisha ku Makedonia abakumwafwako babili, Timote na Elasto. Paulo wena ashala mu calo ca Asia inshiku shinono.

english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
translation: Ni mu nshita ine iyo elyo kwaimine icimfulunganya icikalamba pa mulandu wakukonka Inshila Yesu alanga.

english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
translation: Kafula wa fyela fya silifa, ishina lyakwe ni Demetrio, alefula ifintu ifya cela ca silifa ifyakupashanya kwitempele lya mulungu uwanakashi Atemi. Muli uyu mulungu, ababomfi balemwenano nganshi.

english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
translation: Kanshi uyu muntu alonganya ababomfi bakwe, na bambi bonse abakwete imilimo yabo iyapalana no mulimo wakwe. Alabeba ati, “Mwe bantu mwe, namwishiba ukuti ni muli uyu mulimo emo tumwena icuma.

english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
translation: Nomba mulemona no kuyumfwila ifyo uyu Paulo alecita. Alesosa ukuti, imilungu iyipangwa na bantu, taili imilungu ine ine iyoo. Kabili abantu ba muno Efeso, elyo ni cikangafye na bonse aba mu calo ca Asia, Paulo nabongola, balemumfwila.

english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
translation: Nomba iciletiinya nici cakuti, umulimo wesu abantu bakausuula. Lelo teici ceka, ne tempele lya mulungu uwanakashi Atemi mukulu nalyo abantu bakalisuula. Elyo no mucinshi bapeela uyu mulungu, uo bapepa mu Asia monse na mwisonde lyonse, ukapwa.”

english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
translation: Abantu cilya baumfwa aya mashiwi bafulwa nganshi. Balapunda abati, “Atemi mukulu wa bena Efeso!”

english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
translation: Awe icongo ca bantu balepunda cakumana umusumba onse. Awe ibumba lya balepunda lyaikata abantu babili abena Makedonia, Gayo na Alisitako, abaleenda na Paulo. Baya balebatantanya ku cibansa ca fyangalo.

english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
translation: Elyo Paulo abepusha ati, “Nga kanshi lubatisho nshi mwabatishiwe?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Lubatisho lwakwa Yoani.”

english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
translation: Paulo alafwaya ukuya kwibumba, lelo abasambi bamulesha.

english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
translation: Bacilolo bamo aba mu calo ca Asia, nabo batuma inkombe ishakumweba ukuti eya ku cibansa ca fyangalo.

english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
translation: Kanshi ukulongana kwabo kwalifye ukwa fyongo fyeka fyeka. Abantu bamo balepunda ifi, elyo bambi nabo balesowesha fimbi. Abengi bena tabaishibe neco balonganine.

english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
translation: Kabinge bamo ico bamona Abayuda balesunkila Alekisanda kuntanshi, bena balatontonkanya ukuti alipo ne fyakulanda. Elyo Alekisanda aimya ukuboko pakuti batalale. Alefwaya ukuti abalondolwele bwino bwino ifyo cili.

english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
translation: Nomba cilya baishiba ukuti Muyuda, bonse balapunda pa nsa shibili cimo cine baleti, “Atemi mukulu wa bena Efeso!”

english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
translation: Kalemba mukalamba wa musumba asuka atalalika ibumba. Alasosa ati, “Mwe bena Efeso, nga muntu nshi ushaishiba ukuti, umusumba wa Efeso e kalinda we tempele lyakupepelamo Atemi Mukulu? Kabili e kalinda wa cilubi cakwe cilya caponene ukufuma ku mulu?

english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.
translation: Tapali nangu umo uwingakaana ifi fintu. Kanshi imwe tekenifye imitima, mwipupumina mukucita nelyo cimo.

english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
translation: Aba bantu muletele kuno, tabaibapo nelyo cimo mu matempele. Elyo kabili tabalandapo nangu cimo icamusaalula pali lesa wesu.

english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
translation: Kanshi Demetrio na babomfi bakwe nga palipo ico umuntu abalufyanya, eko fili ifilye, na balashi eko bali. Kanshi ni ku cilye eko bengatwala umulandu.

english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
translation: Kumfwa nga palipo fimbi ificilile pali ifyo, ninshi muli nokutwala ku cilye ca bena musumba.

english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”
translation: Paulo abeba ati, “Ulubatisho lwakwa Yoani, lubatisho lwakulanga ukulapila no kupilibuka. Yoani aleeba abantu ukuti bali nokusumina uwali nokumukonka panuma, emukutila ni Yesu.”

english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
translation: Pantu pali ifi fyacitika lelo, kuti batupeela umulandu wakucita icimfulunganya. Tapali mulandu wakupangila ici congo conse. Tekuti pabe na cakusosa mukuipokololako.”

english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation: Bati bomfwe ifi, epakubatishiwa ulubatisho lwa Mfumu Yesu.

english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
translation: Elyo Paulo abatambalikilapo amaboko, awe Mupashi Wamushilo aisa pali bena. Balanda indimi ishalekana lekana, balasesema na mashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
translation: Pa myeshi itatu Paulo aleya ku sinagoga, alelanshanya na bantu ukwabula umwenso. Alefwaya ukuti banakile Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
translation: Lelo bamo bali abakosa imitima, bakaana no kusumina. Balalanda ne fyamusaalula pa cinso ca bantu pa Nshila Yesu alanga. Kanshi Paulo afumapo asenda na basambi. Cila bushiku alalanshanya nabo mu ŋanda yakusambililamo iyakwa Turano.

english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
translation: Mukwai ba Teofili, mu citabo candi icakubalilapo nalilembamo fyonse ifyo Yesu acitile nefyo alefunda,

english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
translation: Kanshi ilyo bacili balelolekesha ku mulu, awe apopene bamona abantu babili, bafwele insalu ishabuuta. Baisa iminina na apo bali.

english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
translation: Mateo 3:11

english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
translation: Elyo abasole babwelelemo ku Yerusalemu ukufuma ku lupili ulo batila, Ulupili lwa Miolifa. Ulu lupili lwaba mupepi no musumba, teti cifike na ku mulundu umo.

english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
translation: Cilya baingila mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, baya mu ŋanda mu muputule wa pamulu umo baleikala. Abalimo ni Petelo, Yoani, Yakobo na Andele, Filipo na Toma, Batolomeo na Mateo, Yakobo mwana Alufeyo, Simoni uo baleti “Umuselote,” elyo na Yuda mwana Yakobo.

english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
translation: Aba bonse balelonganafye ilingi aba mutima umo, kukupepa pamo na banakashi, na Maria nyina wakwa Yesu na bamunyina bakwa Yesu.

english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
translation: Mako 16:15

english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
translation: Yuda ali wa mwibumba lyesu, kabili twalebombafye nankwe uyu wine mulimo.”

english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.
translation: (Yuda, mu ndalama shamisoka apokele, ashitilemo ibala. Muli ili line ibala emo aponene kamfulimukonko, elyo alepuka, na mala yakwe yonse yapongoloka.

english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
translation: Abantu bonse abekala mu Yerusalemu balyumfwileko ici cintu. Eico ili bala mu lulimi lwabo batila, Akeldama, calola mukutila, “Ibala lyamisoka.”)

english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
translation: ukufumafye apo atampile ukufikafye nelyo asendelwe ku mulu. Ilyo talati asendwe ku mulu, Yesu ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo akonkomeshe abasole bakwe abo aisalile umwine.

english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
translation: “Pantu calembwa mu citabo ca Malumbo ukuti,

english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
translation: “Kanshi tuli nokusala umuntu umo pali aba bantu abali na ifwe inshita yonse, ilyo twaleendauka ne Mfumu Yesu.

english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
translation: Uwali na ifwe ukufumafye ilyo Yoani atampile ukubatisha, ukufikafye nelyo Yesu asendelwe ku mulu. Uyu muntu afwile ukuba kambone pamo na ifwe palwa kushukuka kwakwa Yesu.”

english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
translation: Awe babuulapo abantu babili, Yosefu uo baleita Basaba, ishina lyakwe limbi ni Yusito, elyo na Matia.

english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
translation: Elyo balapepa abati, “We Mfumu iwe walishiba imitima ya bantu bonse. Kanshi tulange uo wasalapo pali aba babili.

english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
translation: Amalu 69:25

english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
translation: Elyo balapendula. Awe cawila Matia. Kanshi Matia epakumubika pa basole ikumi limo na umo.

english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
translation: Panuma ya macushi yakwe, Yesu aleilanga ku basole imikufye iyingi pa nshiku amakumi yane, pakuti bashininkishe ukuti ali umumi. Alebafunda pa mulandu wa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
translation: Kanshi bushiku bumo ilyo Yesu ali nabo pamo, abakonkomeshe ati, “Tamuli nakufuma mu Yerusalemu, lelo mupembele ico Tata alaya. Eco namwebelapo nati,

english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
translation: Yoani alebatisha ku menshi, lelo imwe mu nshikufye isha mpendwa mukabatishiwa kuli Mupashi Wamushilo.”

english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
translation: Ilyo abasole balongene pamo, elyo baipwishe Yesu abati, “We Mfumu, bushe ni pali ino ine nshita elyo walabwesesha ubufumu ku bena Israeli?”

english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
translation: Yesu abaswike ati, “Uyo te mulimo wenu ukwishiba inshiku ne nshita, Tata umwine apima ku maka yakwe.

english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
translation: Mako 1:8

english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
translation: Cilyafye alanda ifi, awe bamona uko alesendwa ku mulu, paisa ne kumbi baleka no kumumona.

english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
translation: Ilyo ifimfulunganya fyapita, Paulo alonganya abasambi bonse pamo. Alabeba amashiwi yacikoseleshi, elyo abashalikapo, aya na ku calo ca Makedonia.

english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
translation: Elyo Paulo aikila panshi, afukama apali umulumendo, amufukatila. Alaeba abantu ati, “Mwisakamana iyoo, acili umumi!”

english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
translation: Elyo Paulo abwelela ku muputule wa pamulu, amokaula umukate, twalalya nokulya. Kabili Paulo akonkanyapo ukulanda inshita ikalamba, bwasuka bwaca. Elyo abasha aya.

english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
translation: Elyo babuula umulumendo bamutwala kumwabo, abansansa nganshi.

english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
translation: Nomba ifwe twatangila twaya no bwato ku Aso. Pantu Paulo apingwile ati eko mukesa mbuula, ico wena alefwaya ukuyako na makasa.

english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.
translation: Cilya atusanga ku Aso, elyo twamusenda no bwato twaya na ku Mitulene.

english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
translation: Bwaisaca, kabili twaima no bwato twaya fika na mupepi ne cishi ca Kiosi. Elyo ubushiku bwakonkapo twafika na ku cishi ca Samosi. Kabili mu bwakonkelepo twafika na ku Mileto.

english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
translation: Paulo elyo apingula ukukanapita ku Efeso, pakukanapwa inshita mu calo ca Asia. Alefwaya ukufika bwangu mu Yerusalemu, ilyo ubushiku bwa Pentekoste tabulafika.

english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
translation: Ilyo Paulo ali mu Mileto elyo atumine amashiwi ku bakalamba ba lukuta mu Efeso ukuti bese bakumane nankwe mu Mileto.

english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
translation: Ilyo bafika, alabeba ati, “Imwe mwalishiba ifyo naleikala inshita yonse twali na imwe, ukufuma pa bushiku bwakubalilapo ilyo nafikile mu calo ca Asia.

english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
translation: Nangu Abayuda bancushishe nganshi kufyo balepangila, lelo nalebomba ngo mubomfi wa Mfumu, uwaicefya ne filambapo.

english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
translation: Apita mu fifulo ifingi ifya muli cilya calo, alekoselesha abasumina mu mashiwi ayengi. Elyo aya ku Akaia.

english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
translation: Mwalishiba nokuti nshatalile nshingashinga nelyo panono ukubila fyonse fyakumwafwilisha. Lelo nalemufunda pa lwalala na mu mayanda yenu.

english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
translation: Abayuda na Bagiriki bena, bonse nalebakonkomesha ukuti balapile, balukile na kuli Lesa, basumine na muli Yesu, Imfumu yesu.

english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
