translation: Nomba mukukonka ifyo Mupashi alefwaya, ndeya ku Yerusalemu. Nshishibe ne fikaya ncitikilako.

english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
translation: Ico njishibe cakuti Mupashi Wamushilo alensokako ukuti, icifungo na macushi filendolela.

english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
translation: Lelo ine ukwenda umumi tacinsakamika iyoo. Icinsakamikafye kupwishishisha ukubomba umulimo Imfumu Yesu yampeela. Umulimo wakuba kambone wa Mbila Nsuma ya cikuuku cakwa Lesa.

english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
translation: “Nomba ninjishiba ukuti, imwe bonse mwebo naleshimikila ifya Bufumu ilyo nalepitana uko muli, tamwakamone nakabili.

english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
translation: Kanshi mu bushiku bwa lelo ndemweba ukuti umo nga alufya umweo wakwe, ine uyo te mulandu wandi.

english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
translation: Pantu nalimwebafye bwino bwino fyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
translation: Kanshi muleisunga bwino, mulesunga no mukuni onse Mupashi Wamushilo amupeela ukwangalila. Mube bakacema ba lukuta lwakwa Lesa, ulo umwine ainonkela ku mfwa yakwe.

english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
translation: Ninjishiba ukuti nga naya, imimbulu iyikali ikamwingilila, elyo tayakapanye mukuni wakwa Kristu.

english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
translation: Ku Akaia aikalako imyeshi itatu. Elyo Paulo alafwaya ukuya no bwato ku Siria. Cilya aumfwa ku bantu ukuti Abayuda balemupangila, kanshi epakutila, “Ndi nokubwelelamofye ne nshila yakupita mu Makedonia.”

english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
translation: Na pali imwe bene pakema bamo, bakalalanda ifyabufi pakuti bongole abasambi, balebakonka.

english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
translation: Kanshi muleenda abaibukila! Muleibukisha ifyo akasuba no bushiku pa myaka itatu, nalemusokako umo umo ndelila ne filamba.

english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
translation: “Nomba namulubwila mu minwe yakwa Lesa na kwishiwi lyakwe ilyacikuuku. Ili shiwi lyakumwafwilisha no kumupeela ifyabupyani ifyo Lesa apekanishisha abantu abo aisangulwila.

english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
translation: Ine nshatala nkwatapo ulunkumbwa lwa fyuma nangu indalama sha muntu iyoo.

english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
translation: Na imwe mwe bene mwalishiba ukuti fyonse ifyo nalekabila pamo pene nabo twaba nabo, nalefibombelafye ne mwine.

english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
translation: Nalimulanga ukuti tuli nokwafwa imbulwamaka mukubombesha. Tuli nokwibukisha amashiwi ya Mfumu Yesu ayo iyine yasosa aiti, ‘Insansa shaba mukupeela ukucila mukupokelela.’ ”

english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
translation: Cilya Paulo apwa ukulanda, elyo afukama alapepa pamo nabo.

english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
translation: Awe bonse balalila, balamukumbatila no kumutomona pakumufishapo.

english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
translation: Nomba icabapeele ubulanda nganshi nico alandile ati, “Tamwakamone nakabili.” Awe baima balamushindika na ku bwato.

english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
translation: Abaile na Paulo ni Sopata mwana Pailusi umwina Belea, na Alisitako na Sekundo abena Tesalonika, na Gayo umwina Debe, na Timote, na Tukiko na Trofimo bena bafumine ku calo ca Asia.

english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
translation: Aba bena batangilako, balatulolela ku Troa.

english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
translation: Cilya Inshikunkulu Yakulyamo Imikate Ishatutumuka yapita, na ifwe twafuma ku Filipi no bwato. Panuma ya nshiku shisano, twafika ku Troa, eko twabasanga. Mu Troa, twaikalamo umulungu umo.

english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.
translation: Pa bushiku bwakutampa umulungu awe twalongene kukulya Umulalilo wa Mfumu. Elyo Paulo alafunda abantu. Ico ali nokuya ulucelo, awe akonkanyapo ukufunda mpaka cafika pakati ka bushiku.

english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
translation: Kabili mu muputule wa pamulu umo twalongene mwali ifisaniko ifingi.

english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.
translation: Umulumendo umo ishina lyakwe Yutiko aikele pa windo. Ilyo Paulo acili alelanda, Yutiko alashipula, asuka alala. Cilya alalisha utulo, elyo aponena panshi ukufuma pa muputule wa lupungu lwabutatu. Ilyo bamutola, basanga nafwa.

english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
translation: Awe twashalikapo abakalamba ba mu Efeso. Elyo twaima no bwato twalungamafye ukucilinganya bemba, twafika na ku cishi ca Kosi. Ubushiku ubwakonkapo twafika na ku cishi ca Rode. Elyo ukufuma ku Rode epakuya ku Patala.

english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
translation: Cilya twaikalako inshiku shimo shimo, kwaisa kasesema umo ukufuma ku Yudeya, ishina lyakwe ni Agabu.

english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
translation: Cilya aisa uko tuli, abuula umushipi wakwa Paulo. Aikaka umwine amakasa ne fisansa. Elyo asosa ati, “Mupashi Wamushilo atila ati, ‘Umwine wa uyu mushipi efyo bakamukaka ku Bayuda mu Yerusalemu. Kabili bakamuposa na mu minwe ya Benafyalo.’ ”

english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo twaumfwa ifi, ifwe na bakaya twalapapata Paulo ukuti eya ku Yerusalemu.

english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
translation: Lelo Paulo wena atwasuka ati, “Bushe cinshi mwalalilishikila no kuntompola umutima? Ala ine ndifye uwaiteyanya tekukukakwafye mu Yerusalemu, lelo no kufwila pa mulandu wa Mfumu Yesu.”

english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
translation: Awe twafilwa ukumunasha. Twaikalafye tondolo twati, “Ifyo Imfumu ilefwaya naficitike.”

english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo papita inshiku shimo shimo, elyo twalonga ifipe fyesu, twaya na ku Yerusalemu.

english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
translation: Pakuya, twaya na basambi bamo abena Kesalia. Batutwala ku ŋanda kwa Nasoni, uko twali nokulaikala. Uyu ali umwina Saiprasi kabili umusambi wakale na kale.

english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
translation: Ilyo twafikile mu Yerusalemu, ababwananyina batusekelela ne nsansa nganshi.

english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
translation: Bwaisaca twaya pamo na Paulo kukupempula Yakobo. Eko twasanga na bakalamba bonse.

english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
translation: Awe Paulo alabaposhapo bonse. Elyo alabalondolwela fyonse ifyo Lesa acitile ku Benafyalo pa mulandu wa kubomba kwakwe.

english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
translation: Ku Patala eko twasangile ubwato bwaleya ku Fonisia. Kanshi ebo twaya nabo.

english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
translation: Nabo cilya baumfwa ifi, balalumbanya Lesa. Elyo balaeba Paulo abati, “Kanshi wamona we munyinefwe, Abayuda amakana na makana nabasumina mu Mfumu Yesu. Kabili bantu abaikatisha Amafunde yakwa Mose.

english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
translation: Nomba bonse balyumfwa ukuti iwe ulafunda Abayuda bonse abaikala mu Benafyalo ukukanakonka Amafunde yakwa Mose. Ulabalesha ukusembulula abana babo. Ulabalesha no kukonka intambi sha Ciyuda.

english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
translation: Kanshi tulecita shani? Pantu ukumfwa kwena baleumfwa ukuti nawisa.

english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
translation: Kanshi ucite ifyo twalakweba. Tulipo na bantu abaume bane abalaya icilayo kuli Lesa.

english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
translation: Kanshi kabiye nabo muye sangululwa nabo pamo. Ulipile ne ndalama shakubabeyela imishishi ku mitwe. Lyena bonse baleishiba ukuti ifyo bomfwa pali iwe fyabufi, kabili ulakonka na Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
translation: Lelo abasumina Abenafyalo bena twalibalembela kalata pafyo twapingwile ukuti, tabali nakulyako inama batuula ku tulubi ne nama bashateeta pa mukoshi, nangu ukulyako umulopa, no kutaluka ku bulalelale.”

english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
translation: Kanshi ubushiku ubwakonkapo Paulo epakubuula aba bantu, aisangulula pamo nabo. Elyo aingila mwi Tempele. Alaishibisha abantu ilyo inshita yakusangululwa ikapwa, nelyo cila umo umo ali nokutuula umutuulo.

english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
translation: Ilyo inshiku cine lubali shaya kukupwa, Abayuda bamo aba ku calo ca Asia bamona Paulo mwi Tempele. Aba bantu basokawila ibumba lya bantu, baikata Paulo.

english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
translation: Balapunda abati, “Mwe bena Israeli, twafweniko! Ala uyu e muntu apitana mpanga yonse, alefunda abantu bonse ukusuula umushobo wesu, Amafunde yakwa Mose ne Tempele. Nomba nakowesha ne Ncende Yamushilo, naingisha Abenafyalo mwi Tempele.”

english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
translation: Balesosa ifi, ico bamwene Tulofimo umwina Efeso bali na Paulo mu musumba, kanshi balatontonkanya ukuti namuleta na mwi Tempele.

english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
translation: Twapita mupepi icakuti twalamona ne cishi ca Saiprasi. Elyo twapitila lubali lwa ku kapinda ka kulyo ka ici cishi, twaya na ku Siria. Ubwato bwesu bwaya shiika mu musumba wa Turi, pantu mu bwato mwali ifipe ifyakupatulamo.

english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
translation: Awe mu musumba mwabafye icimfulunganya ceka ceka. Abantu balongana baikata Paulo. Balamutintanya, bamufumisha kunse ye Tempele. Elyo apopene baisalako ne fiibi fye Tempele.

english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
translation: Aba bantu balafwaya ukwipaya Paulo. Elyo amashiwi yafika ku mukalamba wa fita fya bena Roma. Bamweba abati, “Mu Yerusalemu mwabafye icimfulunganya ceka ceka.”

english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
translation: Nao apopene abuula abakalamba ba fita umwanda umo ne fita, eko babutukila. Cilya abantu bamona umukalamba wa fita ne fita fyakwe, awe baleka ukuma Paulo.

english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
translation: Elyo umukalamba wa fita aya kuli Paulo amwikata aeba nokuti bamukake iminyololo ibili. Umukalamba wa fita aipusha ati, “Ngoyu muntu nani? Finshi acita?”

english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
translation: Nomba abantu mwibumba balapundafye, bamo basosa ifi, bambi basosa fimbi. Kanshi ku mulandu wa congo, umukalamba wa fita afilwa ukwishiba icilengele icimfulunganya. Kanshi umukalamba wa fita akonkomesha ifita ukumusenda mu ncende umwikala ifita.

english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
translation: Cilya bafika pa matabo, ibumba lyacilamo ku bukali, icakuti ifita fyasumbulafye Paulo pakumusenda.

english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
translation: Bonse abalekonka panuma balepunda ati, “Mwipayeni!”

english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
translation: Kanshi ilyo baleingisha Paulo mu ncende umwikala ifita, Paulo aipusha umukalamba wa fita ati, “Bushe tekuti nandepo cimo na imwe?” Umukalamba wa fita amwasuka ati, “Bushe walishiba ukulanda Icigiriki?

english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
translation: Bushe iwe tauli ulya mwina Egupto, tapalati papite inshiku ishingi apo waimishe icimfulunganya, waya ne fipondo amakana yane mu matololo?”

english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
translation: Paulo amwasuka ati, “Ine ndi Muyuda, umwina Taso, umusumba uwalumbuka nganshi mu calo ca Kilikia. Napapata leka nande kuli aba bantu.”

english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
translation: Mu Turi twasangilemo abasambi. Twaikala nabo umulungu umo. Ico Mupashi abasokolwela, bena balesha Paulo ukuti eya ku Yerusalemu.

english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
translation: Awe umukalamba wa fita amusuminisha. Paulo aiminina pa matabo. Aimya no kuboko pakuti abantu baleke icongo. Ilyo baleka icongo, Paulo alabeba mu Cihibulu ati,

english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
translation: Nomba ilyo inshita yakufumako yafika, twaima twalaya. Awe bonse pamo na bakashi babo na bana batushindika ukufika na kunse ya musumba. Elyo twafukama pa lulamba lwa bemba twalapepa.

english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
translation: Elyo twashalikanapo, ifwe twaingila mu bwato, bena babwelelamo kumwabo.

english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
translation: Ukufuma ku Turi, twakonkenyepo ubulendo bwesu no bwato, twaya shiika ku Tolemai. Twaposhanya na bamunyinefwe, twaikala nabo ubushiku bumo.

english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
translation: Bwaisaca twaima, twaya fika na ku Kesalia. Mu Kesalia twafikilila kwa Filipo kabila wa Mbila Nsuma, eko twaikala nankwe. Uyu Filipo, e umo pali balya baume cine lubali abasalilwe mu Yerusalemu.

english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
translation: Filipo ali na bana abanakashi bane, abashaupwa, bakasesema.

english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
translation: “Bamunyinane, na imwe bashifwe, kutikeni kufyo nalamweba ukuti ine nshili na mulandu.”

english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
translation: Na ine naipusha nati, ‘Nga ndecita shani we Mfumu?’ Imfumu epakunjeba ati, ‘Ima akuya mu Damasiko. Emo balaya kweba fyonse ifyo Lesa apekanya ukuti efyo uli nokucita.’

english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
translation: Ku mulandu wa kubekesha kwa lulya lubuuto, nasangwike impofu. Abo twali nabo epakunjikata ku minwe bantwala na mu Damasiko.

english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
translation: “Mu Damasiko mwali umuntu umo, ishina lyakwe ni Anania. Ali umuntu uwapetamina Lesa, alenakila na Mafunde yakwa Mose. Kabili na Bayuda bonse mu Damasiko bamucindike nganshi.

english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
translation: Kanshi Anania epakwisa kuli ine. Aisa iminina apo ndi. Anjeba ati, ‘Saulo, we munyinane akulolesha nakabili!’ Awe pa nshita ine iyo nalalolesha, namumona no kumumona.

english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
translation: Elyo asosa ati, ‘Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu alikusala pakuti wishibe ifyo alefwaya ukucita. Alikusala nokuti umone Uwakaele, no kumfwa ishiwi lyakwe ilyo alelanda.

english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
translation: Pantu niwe uli nokuba kambone wakwe ku bantu bonse. Uli nokubeba ifyo umfwile nefyo umwene.

english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
translation: Nga kanshi finshi ifyo ulepembela? Ale ima, ubatishiwe, ne fyabubifi fyobe fisambike ilyo ulekuuta Imfumu.’

english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance
translation: “Elyo nabwelulukila ku Yerusalemu. Ilyo ndi pakupepa mwi Tempele, namona icimonwa.

english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
translation: Namona Imfumu, ilenjeba aiti, ‘Endesha, fuma bwangu mu Yerusalemu. Pantu abantu muno tabakasumine bukambone bobe pali ine.’

english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
translation: Na ine nayasuka nati, ‘We Mfumu, aba bantu balishiba ukuti nine naleya ku masinagoga no kuma abasumina muli iwe no kubaposa mu cifungo.

english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
translation: Nomba cilya baumfwa uko Paulo alebalandila mu Cihibulu, awe lyena patalalafye tondolo.

english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
translation: Na lilya baleipaya Stefano kambone obe, na ine wine epo nali. Kabili nasuminishe nokuti bamwipaye, nasunga ne nsalu sha balemwipaya.’

english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”
translation: Lelo Imfumu yanjebele aiti, ‘Kabiyefye, pantu ndekutuma ukutali ku Benafyalo.’ ”

english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
translation: Abantu bonse balekutikafye mpaka ilyo Paulo asosele aya mashiwi ayakuya ku benafyalo. Elyo batampa ukulapundisha nganshi abati, “Mwipayeni! Uyu muntu alingilefye ukufwa!”

english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
translation: Balapanga icongo nganshi, balepukanya insalu shabo mu mulu, baleulwila no lukungu mu mulu.

english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
translation: Umukalamba wa fita akonkomesha ifita fyakwe ukwingisha Paulo mu ncende umwikala ifita. Aeba ifita ukuma Paulo ifikoti pakuti alondolole icilengele ukuti abantu balepanga icongo umusango uyu.

english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
translation: Cilya bamukaka pakuti bamume ifikoti, Paulo aipusha umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo uwaiminine mupepi ati, “Bushe amafunde yalisuminisha ukuma umwina Roma ifikoti ukwabula ukuti bamulubulwishe?”

english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
translation: Cilya umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo aumfwa ifi, aya ku mukalamba wabo. Amweba ati, “Bushe nawishiba ico ulecita? Uyu muntu, mwina Roma!”

english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
translation: Kanshi umukalamba wa fita epakuya kuli Paulo amwipusha ati, “Unjebe, bushe uli mwina Roma?” Paulo nao amwasuka ati, “Ee.”

english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita ati, “Ine naposele indalama ishingi pakuba umwina Roma.” Paulo amwasuka ati, “Ine nafyalwafye umwina Roma.”

english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
translation: Awe apopene abantu abali nokumulubulwisha bamutalukako. No mukalamba wa fita nao aikatwa no mwenso, ico aishiba ukuti Paulo mwina Roma, kabili namukaka na mu minyololo.

english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
translation: Elyo Paulo nao alabeba ati, “Ine ndi Muyuda. Nafyalilwe mu Taso mu calo ca Kilikia. Ukukula kwena nakulile muli uno wine musumba wa Yerusalemu. Kafundisha uwansambilisha ni Gamalieli. Alinsambilisha bwino bwino ukulakonka Amafunde ayo Mose apeele ifikolwe fyesu. Nali uwakalabana nganshi mukubombela Lesa ngefi fine na imwe bonse muli lelo.

english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
translation: Kabili ubushiku ubwakonkelepo umukalamba wa fita, ico alefwaya ukwishiba bwino umulandu Abayuda balefwaila ukwipaya Paulo, alimukakwile. Elyo aeba bashimapepo bacindami na bashicilye bonse aba cilye cikalamba ica Bayuda ukulongana. Elyo aleta Paulo amwiminika na mu lwalala.

english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
translation: Naleesha no kwipaya abantu abakonka Inshila Yesu alanga. Nalekaka abaume na banakashi no kubaposa mu cifungo.

english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba na bashicilye bonse e bakambone bandi. Kabili aba bene ebampeele amakalata yakutwala kuli bamunyinabo intungulushi sha Bayuda mu Damasiko. Kanshi na ine epakuyako kukuya ikata abena Kristu no kubaleta ku Yerusalemu kukwisa bakanda.”

english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
translation: “Kanshi natile ilyo ndeya napalama ku Damasiko, ninshi ilyo akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00. Awe apopene ulubuuto lwafuma mu mulu, lwasanika ukushinguluka apo ndi.

english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
translation: Awe nawa panshi. Elyo naumfwa ishiwi lilenjeba aliti, ‘Saulo, Saulo ee, cinshi ico ulencushisha?’

english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
translation: Na ine naipusha nati, ‘Niwani we Mfumu?’ Nao anjasuka ati, ‘Nine Yesu uwa ku Nasaleti, neo iwe ulecusha.’

english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
translation: Abantu abo twali nabo, ulubuuto lwena balilumwene, lelo ishiwi lya walensosha, lyena tabalyumfwile.

english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
translation: Paulo alolekesha bashicilye, elyo asosa ati, “Mwe bamunyinane, ukufikafye na lelo ine umutima wandi tausakamikwa pa cintu nelyo cimo pa cinso cakwa Lesa.”

english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.
translation: Ifikansa fyasuka fyabipisha icakuti umukalamba wa fita umwenso wamwikata ati, “Balaipaya Paulo.” Kanshi epakutumako ifita ifyakuya fumyako Paulo ku maka, no kumutwala mu ncende umwikala ifita.

english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
translation: Cilya bwaila, Imfumu yaisa iminina apali Paulo, yamweba aiti, “Ushipefye! Ifi fine walanga mu Yerusalemu ukuti uli kambone wandi, efyo uli nokuba kambone wandi na mu Roma mwine.”

english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
translation: Cilya bwaca Abayuda bamo balilongene mu bumfisolo, balapangana. Balapa no mulapo abati, “Ifwe tatuli nakulya nangu ukunwa nelyo cimo kanofye twatala twaipaya Paulo.”

english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
translation: Abantu balapile uyu mulapo balicilile amakumi yane.

english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
translation: Elyo baya kuli bashimapepo bacindami na ku bakalamba. Balabeba abati, “Ifwe natulapa umulapo ukuti tatuli nakulya nelyo cimo kanofye twatala twaipaya Paulo.

english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
translation: Nomba imwe na bashicilye, mwebe umukalamba wa fita ukuti amuletele Paulo. Mucite kwati mulefwaya ukushininkisha umulandu wakwa Paulo bwino bwino. Ifwe natuiteyanya ukumwipaya ilyo talati afike kuli imwe.”

english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
translation: Lelo umwipwa wakwa Paulo umwaume aumfwako uko balemupangila. Kanshi aya ingila mu ncende yaleikalamo ifita. Ayashimikilako na Paulo ifyo balemupangila!

english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
translation: Paulo epakwita umo umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo. Amweba ati, “Twala uyu mulumendo ku mukalamba wa fita, alipo na fimo ifyakumweba.”

english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo, nao asenda umulumendo amutwala ku mukalamba wa fita. Amweba ati, “Umufungwa Paulo acinjita, elyo anjeba nokuti, ‘Twala uyu mulumendo ku mukalamba wa fita, alipo na fimo ifyakumweba.’ ”

english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita aikata umulumendo ku minwe amusenda ukwakuti baba beka. Elyo amwipusha ati, “Finshi ifyo uli nokunjeba?”

english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
translation: Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba, Anania aeba abali mupepi na Paulo ukumuma pa kanwa.

english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
translation: Umulumendo amweba ati, “Abayuda nabomfwana ukuti mailo bakamulomba ukubaletela Paulo ku cilye. Bakacita kwati balefwaya ukushininkisha umulandu wakwa Paulo bwino bwino.

english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
translation: Mwikabasuminisha, pantu kuli abantu ukucila amakumi yane abakamubelamina. Nabalapa no mulapo abati, ‘Ifwe tatuli nakulya nangu ukunwa nelyo cimo, kanofye twatala twaipaya Paulo.’ Kanshi nabaiteyanya, balelolelafye ukuti ukasuminishe.”

english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita aeba umulumendo ati, “Kabiye, nomba tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu ukuti naunshimikilako ifi fintu.”

english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
translation: Mateo 22:23

english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
translation: Bapekanishishe Paulo bakabalwe bamo abakwendelapo. Mukaye mufisha umutende ku mulashi Felikisi.”

english: He wrote a letter like this:
translation: Elyo umukalamba wa fita alemba kalata ati,

english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
translation: “Ine ne Kilaudio Lusia, natuma kalata kuli imwe kanabesa, mwe balashi ba Felikisi. Mwapoleni mukwai.

english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
translation: Uyu muntu, Abayuda balimwikata, bapene no kumwipaya. Ico naumfwile ukuti mwina Roma, kanshi naileko ne fita fyandi epakuya mupokololako.

english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
translation: Ukuf 22:28

english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.
translation: Naile sanga ukuti uyu muntu takwete mulandu wakuti bamwipailapo nangu ukumuposa mu cifungo. Umulandu walipofye kupusana pa mafunde yabo abene.

english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
translation: Paulo amweba ati, “Lesa na iwe akakuma, we cibumba cashingulwa ne mpemba we! Wikele kuno kukupingula umulandu wandi ukulingana na Mafunde yakwa Mose kabili wapula mu Mafunde yakwa Mose pakweba ukuti bangume!”

english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”
translation: Nomba ico naumfwile ukuti Abayuda balemupangila balefwaya ukumwipaya, eco namutumina kuli imwe. Elyo abo bapeela Paulo umulandu, bena nimbeba ukuleta umulandu kuli imwe.”

english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
translation: Awe ifita fyacita fyonse ngomo mwine bafyebele. Fyasenda Paulo ubushiku, fyaya mufisha ku Antipatili.

english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.
translation: Cilya bwaca, ifita fya pa makasa fyena fyabwelelamo ku cifulo fyafumine. Ifita fya pali bakabalwe fyena fyakonkanyapo ukuya nankwe.

english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
translation: Cilya fyafika ku Kesalia, ifita fyapeela kalata ku mulashi, fyamutwalila na Paulo.

english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,
translation: Cilya umulashi apwa ukubelenga kalata, aipusha Paulo ati, “Ni ku calo nshi wafuma?” Elyo aumfwa ukuti ni ku Kilikia.

english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
translation: Aeba Paulo ati, “Abakupeela umulandu nga baisa elyo nkesa umfwa umulandu obe.” Elyo akonkomesha ukuti basunge Paulo mwisano ilyali kale ilyakwa Herodi. Babikeko na bakumulonda.

english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
translation: Elyo abeminine mupepi na Paulo bamweba abati, “Ala, uyu uletuka ni Shimapepo mukalamba wakwa Lesa!”

english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
translation: Paulo epakwasuka ati, “Mwe bamunyinane, ala nshishibe ukuti ni Shimapepo mukalamba. Pantu calilembwa ukuti, ‘Wilasaalula kateeka wa mushobo obe.’ ”

english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”
translation: Paulo elyo amona ukuti mwibumba bamo Basaduki, bambi nabo Bafalise. Aikatisha ishiwi alaeba icilye ati, “Bamunyinane! Ine ndi Mufalise, na bafyashi bandi Bafalise. Ico bandetele kukulubulula, nico ine nsubila ukuti abafwa bakashukuka!”

english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
translation: Cilyafye Paulo asosa ifi, apopene Abafalise na Basaduki batampa ukubikana ifikansa. Awe bashicilye bayakanikana pabili.

english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
translation: Pantu Abasaduki bena batila, “Takwaba kushukuka kwa bafwa, takwaba bamalaika, takwaba na mipashi.” Lelo Abafalise bena balisumina ukuti fyonse fitatu eko fyaba.

english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
translation: Awe pabuka ne congo icikalamba. Bakafundisha bamafunde bamo aba mu mpuka ya Bafalise nabo baiminamo. Balasosekesha nganshi abati, “Ifwe tatumwene cibi nelyo cimo ico uyu muntu acita. Epali umupashi nangu malaika eumwebele.”

english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.
translation: Cilya papita inshiku shisano, Shimapepo mukalamba Anania aile ku Kesalia na bakalamba, pamo na fundi wa mafunde, ishina lyakwe ni Tetulo. Batwala no mulandu wakwa Paulo ku mulashi Felikisi.

english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,
translation: Elyo umulashi aimya ukuboko alembula Paulo pakuti nao alande. Paulo nao elyo alasosa ati,

english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
translation: Na mwe bene kuti mwaishiba, tekuti cicile pa nshiku ikumi limo na shibili apo nailile kukupepa ku Yerusalemu.

english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.
translation: Abayuda tabansangile ndebikana ifikansa no muntu nelyo umo mwi Tempele, nangu ukusokawila abantu mu masinagoga, nangufye ni mu musumba mwine.

english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
translation: Elyo tapalifye nangu umo uwingalanda ifyacishinka ifyakuti fyanshinina pali iyo milandu balenjebelela.

english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;
translation: Kwena nasumina ukuti mpepa Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu ukukonka Inshila Yesu alanga, iyo bena baleti, ni mpuka ishili yacine. Lelo ine nalisumina mu Mafunde yakwa Mose na muli fyonse ifyalembwa na bakasesema.

english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
translation: Pamo pene nga bena, na ine ndetetekela ukuti Lesa akabusha abantu abololoke na babifi ku bafwa.

english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
translation: Eico kanshi ine lyonse mfwaya ukwenda no mutima uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa na bantu.

english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
translation: “Kwena pa myaka imo imo nalifumine mu Yerusalemu. Nabwelelefye kukuleta ifyabupe ku mushobo wandi ifyakwafwako abalanda, elyo no kulekela Lesa ilambo.

english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
translation: Ilyo ncili ndecita ifi elyo bansanga mwi Tempele, ninshi elyo napwafye amapepo yakuisangulula. Tamwali ibumba lya bantu, kabili takwali na cimfulunganya.

english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.
translation: Lelo mwali Abayuda bamo ukufuma ku calo ca Asia. Aba ebafwile ukuleta umulandu wandi kuli imwe, kumfwa nga nabakwata umulandu na ine.

english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,
translation: Elyo baita Paulo. Tetulo atampa no kulondolola umulandu wakwa Paulo ati,

english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
translation: Nangu aba bene bali pano, nabasose umulandu basangile nabifya ilyo naiminine mu cilye cabo.

english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
translation: Shikanofye ninshi ilyo baiminine pakati kabo naikatishe ishiwi nasosa nati, ‘Ni pa mulandu wa kushukuka kwa bafwa eco ndelubulwila pali imwe lelo.’ ”

english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
translation: Kanshi eico Felikisi uwaishibe bwino ifya pa Nshila Yesu alanga, aisala icilye. Abeba ati, “Umukalamba wa fita Lusia nga aisa, elyo nkesa putula umulandu wenu.”

english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.
translation: Elyo aeba umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo ukuti bali nokulasopa Paulo. Bali nokumona ukuti aleyendela icilingile, elyo na bantu bakwe balemucitila ifyo alekabila.

english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
translation: Cilya papita inshiku shimo shimo, Felikisi aishile no mukashi wakwe Dusila, Umuyuda. Epakweba ukuti bamuletele Paulo. Elyo Felikisi alakutika kufyo Paulo alelanda palwa cisumino muli Kristu Yesu.

english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”
translation: Nomba ilyo Paulo atampa ukulanda palwa kucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, ukuisunga, na pa bushiku bwabupingushi ubuli nokwisa, awe Felikisi umwenso wamwikata. Aeba Paulo ati, “Pa nshita ino bala kabiye, nkakwita nakabili ilyo nkakwata inshita.”

english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.
translation: Kwena pa nshita imo ine Felikisi alesubila ukuti Paulo alamupeelako indalama. Kanshi eico ilingi alemwita no kulalanda nankwe.

english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
translation: Cilya papita imyaka ibili, Pokio Fesito aishile buula amalo ya mulashi Felikisi. Ico Felikisi alefwaya ukuti Abayuda bamutemwe, epakusha Paulo mu cifungo.

english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
translation: Kabili inshita yonsefye mpanga yonse ifi ifintu filatusansamusha. Kanshi tulemutotela nganshi.

english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
translation: Nshilefwaya ukumuposela inshita, lelo nabakutike cinono kufyo twalalanda.

english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
translation: Ifwe natusanga ukuti uyu muntu lisakamika lya muntu. Aleta icimfulunganya konse pano isonde ukuli Abayuda. Kabili e ntungulushi ya mpuka ya bena Nasaleti.

english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
translation: Kabili alefwaya no kukoweshe Tempele, elyo na ifwe twamwikata. [Twalefwaya ukumupingula ukulinga na mafunde yesu.

english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”
translation: Elyo Lusia aeba bonse abapeele Paulo umulandu ukuti bakese kuli imwe.] Mumwipushe mwe bene, mulesanga ukuti muli cishinka muli fyonse tulelanda pali uyu muntu.”

english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.
translation: Abayuda nabo basuminisha abati, “Cine cine nifyo fine.”

english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
translation: Cilyafye papita inshiku shitatu apo afikile mu calo, Fesito aima ku Kesalia, aya na ku Yerusalemu.

english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.
translation: Paulo ayasuka ati, “Ine umulandu wandi uli mu cilye cakwa Kesalo, emo bali nokundubulwisha. Nshalufyanya ku Bayuda nelyo cimo, na imwe ico cena namwishibafye bwino.

english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
translation: Lelo nga nalibifyapo cimo icifwile ukuti banjipailapo, ine nshilekaana kufwa. Lelo imilandu balelanda pali ine nga yabufi, ninshi tapali nangu umo uwingamposa mu minwe yabo. Umulandu wandi uli nokuyafye kuli Kesalo.”

english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”
translation: Fesito epakulanshanya na bashicilye bakwe, elyo aeba Paulo ati, “Ulefwaya ukutwala umulandu obe kuli Kesalo, kanshi uli nokuya kuli Kesalo.”

english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.
translation: Pati papite inshiku shimo shimo, imfumu Agilipa na Benike baisa ku Kesalia kukuposha Fesito.

english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;
translation: Cilya baikalako inshiku shimo shimo, Fesito ashimikilako imfumu Agilipa umulandu wakwa Paulo. Amweba ati, “Felikisi asha umuntu umo mu cifungo.

english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.
translation: Ilyo naile ku Yerusalemu, bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba ba Bayuda baletele imilandu iyingi pali uyu muntu. Balefwaya ukuti mupeele umulandu.

english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.
translation: Lelo ine nabebele nati, ‘Abena Roma tabakwata lutambi lwakulubwila umuntu ku muntu nelyo umo ilyo abalemupeela umulandu tabalamushinina. Elyo uo balepeela umulandu nao ali nokuipokololako mukulandila pa mulandu wakwe.’

english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
translation: Kanshi ilyo twaishile nabo kuno, nshapwile ne nshita. Bwaisaca naikala na pa cipuna cakuputwilapo imilandu, naeba nokuti balete Paulo.

english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;
translation: Elyo abamupeele umulandu baiminina, nomba bafilwa ukuleta umulandu nelyo umo uwakuti bamushininapo ngefyo nalesubila.

english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
translation: Bakwetefye fimo ifyo balebikanapo ifikansa ifya pa mapepo yabo. Elyo na pa muntu umo uwafwile, ishina lyakwe ni Yesu, ico Paulo atila mumi.

english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,
translation: Mu Yerusalemu, bashimapepo bacindami ne ntungulushi sha Bayuda baleta imilandu iyo Paulo abalufyanya.

english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.
translation: Kanshi nalifililwe ukwishiba icishinka pali uyu mulandu. Eico naipwishe Paulo nga kuti afwaya ukuya ku Yerusalemu pakuti eko bakaye mulubulwisha pali uyu mulandu.

english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”
translation: Lelo Paulo atile, ‘Ine umulandu wandi uli nokuyafye kuli kateeka mukalamba Kesalo, eukandubulwisha.’ Kanshi epakumusunga, nakonkomesha ne fita ifyakumusopa ukufika nelyo nkamutuma kuli Kesalo.”

english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”
translation: Agilipa elyo aeba Fesito ati, “Na ine kuti natemwa ukumumfwa uyu muntu.” Fesito nao ayasuka ati, “Ukamumfwa mailo.”

english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.
translation: Bwaisaca Agilipa na Benike baisa nabafwala ifyabufumu na bantu balebawila. Baingila na mu ŋanda yamilandu ninshi bali na bakalamba ba fita na bacindami ba mu musumba. Elyo Fesito aeba ukuti balete Paulo.

english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
translation: Kabili Fesito alasosa ati, “We mfumu Agilipa na imwe bonse mwe bali muno na ifwe, mwamumona uyu muntu! Abayuda bonse, aba kuno Kesalia na ba ku Yerusalemu baisa kuli ine, balepunda abati, ‘Alingilefye ukufwa!’

english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,
translation: Lelo ine nshasanga ukuti alicitapo icakuti bamwipailapo. Nomba umwine alanda ukuti umulandu wakwe uli nokuyafye kuli kateeka mukalamba Kesalo. Kanshi na ine eko ndi nokumutuma.

english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.
translation: Lelo ine nshikwetepo cishinka icakuti ningalembela kuli Kesalo pali uyu muntu. Eico namuletela kuli imwe, makamaka kuli imwe mwe mfumu Agilipa. Pakuti na imwe nga mwapituluka bwino bwino mu mulandu wakwe, elyo na ine mone ifyakulemba.

english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”
translation: Pantu ine nimona ukuti tacilungeme ukutuma umuntu wa milandu ukwabula ukulondolola umulandu acita.”

english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.
translation: Balapapata Fesito ukuti abafweko, abaletele Paulo ku Yerusalemu. Pantu balepekanya ukumubelamina no kumwipaya ilyo alepita mu nshila.

english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.
translation: Fesito abasuka ati, “Paulo asungwa mu cifungo ku Kesalia. Elyo na ine nalaswa mbwelelemo ku Kesalia.

english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”
translation: Kanshi muleke tuye ne ntungulushi shenu shimo ku Kesalia. Elyo kuti baya mupeela umulandu, nga pali ifyo alufyanya.”

english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.
translation: Fesito aikelekofye inshiku cine konse konse nangu ikumi limo, elyo aya ku Kesalia. Bwaisaca, aikala na pa cipuna cakuputwilapo imilandu, aeba nokuti balete Paulo.

english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
translation: Cilya Paulo afika, Abayuda abafumine ku Yerusalemu bamushinguluka. Elyo batampa ukulamubepesha imilandu iyingi, kabili iyikulu, nomba iyabula ukushininkisha.

english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”
translation: Lelo Paulo alaipokololako ati, “Ine nshacitapo nelyo cimo icakonaula amafunde ya Bayuda, nangu umusaalula kwi Tempele, nangu umusaalula kuli kateeka mukalamba Kesalo.”

english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”
translation: Fesito ico alefwaya ukuti Abayuda bamutemwe, aeba Paulo ati, “Bushe ulefwaya ukuya ku Yerusalemu, eko nkaye kulubulwisha pali iyi milandu?”

english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.
translation: Agilipa elyo aeba Paulo ati, “Kanshi nomba ilandile we mwine.” Paulo elyo aimya ukuboko alalubulula ati,

english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.
translation: Efyo no kucita nalecita mu Yerusalemu. Bashimapepo bacindami ebampeele aya maka. Naleikata abamushilo nalebaposa na mu cifungo. Nelyo balebapingwila ukufwa, na ine wine nalesuminishako.

english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.
translation: Imikufye iyingi nalepitana mu masinagoga ndebakanda, ndebapatikisha no kusuula icisumino cabo. Kabili ico nabakwatile icipyu nganshi, naleya na ku misumba ya Benafyalo kukubacusha.

english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,
translation: “Mulandu wa uyu wine mulimo ewalengele ukuti bashimapepo bacindami bampeele ulusa na maka yakuya ku Damasiko.

english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.
translation: Kanshi twali mukuya, ninshi akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00. Elyo Kanabesa Mulopwe, namona ulubuuto ulwabekesha ukucila na kasuba lwafuma ku mulu. Lwasanika ukushinguluka apo ndi pamo nabo twali nabo.

english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
translation: Bonse twawa panshi. Elyo naumfwa ishiwi lilenjeba mu Cihibulu aliti, ‘Saulo, Saulo cinshi uncushisha? Ala kuti waicena mukupilikita nge ŋombe ili mu minwe yakwa shikulu wakwe.’

english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
translation: Na ine naipusha nati, ‘Nga niwe ani we Mfumu?’ Nayo Imfumu yanjasuka aiti, ‘Nine Yesu, neo ucusha.

english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;
translation: Nomba ima, iminina. Namonekela kuli iwe ico nkusalile ukuba umubomfi wandi. Uli nokuba kambone pa fintu wamona lelo na pafyo nkakulanga kuntanshi.

english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,
translation: Nkalakupususha ku bantu ba mushobo obe na ku Benafyalo bene, abo ndekutumako.

english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
translation: Uli nokuya bashibatula amenso, kubafumya mu mfifi no kubaleta ku lubuuto. Ukabafumya mu minwe yakwa Satana, nokubaleta kuli Lesa. Pakuti nga basumina muli ine, bakabelelwe uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo. Elyo bakashukile no kwikala pamo nabo Lesa aisangulwila.’

english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,
translation: “Kanshi we mfumu Agilipa, nalifililwe ukukanabeela ico namwene ukufuma ku mulu.

english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews,
translation: “Kanabesa Agilipa! Awe lelo nashuka nganshi pakuti njilandile pa cinso cenu imilandu yonse iyo Abayuda bambepesha.

english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.
translation: Nabalilepo mu Damasiko, elyo mu Yerusalemu na ku ba mu calo conse ica Yudeya, na ku Benafyalo nalebila ukuti bali nokulapila ifyabubifi fyabo no kubwelela kuli Lesa. Bali nokulacita ifintu ifyakulanga ukuti nabalapila no kupilibuka.

english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.
translation: Ni pali uyu mulandu epo Abayuda banjikatile ilyo nali mwi Tempele, bafwaya no kunjipaya.

english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,
translation: Lelo ku maka yakwa Lesa epo ndi na lelo. Njiminine pano kukupeela bukambone bwandi kuli bonse, ku baice na ku bakalamba. Nsosafye ifintu bakasesema na Mose basosele ukuti fili nokucitika.

english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”
translation: ‘Nefi fyakutila, Kristu ali nokucula, kabili eukabalilapo ukubuuka ku bafwa, no kuba ulubuuto lwakutungulula Abayuda na Benafyalo.’ ”

english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”
translation: Ilyo Paulo acili alelanda aya mashiwi yakuipokololako, Fesito apunda ati, “Paulo, uli shilu! Amasambililo wasambilila yalekupenya!”

english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.
translation: Paulo ayasuka ati, “Awe Mulopwe Fesito nshili shilu. Aya mashiwi nalanda yatuntulu, yacishinka.

english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.
translation: Tekuti ntiine ukulanda ifi fintu ku mfumu Agilipa, pantu yalifishiba. Ninshininkisha ukuti ifi fyonse naifishiba bwino, pantu te mu bumfisolo fyalecitika.

english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”
translation: We mfumu Agilipa, bushe walisumina mu fyalemba bakasesema? Ninjishiba ukuti walisumina!”

english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”
translation: Agilipa aeba Paulo ati, “Bushe ulesubila ukuti mu kashita kacepa ifi, emo winganjalula ukuba umwina Kristu?”

english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”
translation: Paulo amwasuka ati, “Inshita nangu icepe nangu ilepe, ine ndepepa kuli Lesa ukuti imwe bene na bonse abali muno abalekutika kufyo ndelanda lelo, bengaba nga fino ndi, ukufumyakofye iyi minyololo.”

english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.
translation: Pantu imwe mwalishibafye bwino intambi shonse isha Bayuda ne fikansa babikana. Eico nalomba ukuti muntekele umutima pakumfwa ifyo nalalanda.

english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.
translation: Elyo imfumu Agilipa no mulashi Fesito, na Benike na bantu bonse baima.

english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
translation: Ilyo bafuma balalanshanya abati, “Uyu muntu tacita mulandu nelyo umo uwakumwipailapo nelyo ukumuposa mu cifungo.”

english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
translation: Elyo Agilipa aeba Fesito ati, “Uyu muntu akaanalanda ukutwala umulandu wakwe kuli kateeka mukalamba Kesalo nga kuti twamulekamofye.”

english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;
translation: “Abayuda bonse balishiba ubumi bwandi ukufuma ku bwaice bwandi. Balishiba na ku kale imyendele yandi mu calo candi na mu Yerusalemu.

english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
translation: Balinjishiba ukufuma na ku kale. Kabili nga balefwaya kuti banjiminina na bukambone ukuti nali Umufalise, impuka ya bantu abasakamana nganshi ukubaka amafunde ya mipepele yesu ukucila bonse.

english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
translation: Na nomba ndi mukulubulula pali ico nsubila mu cilayo Lesa alaya ifikolwe fyesu.

english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!
translation: Ni mukutetekela muli ici cilayo ico inko shesu shonse ikumi limo na shibili shipepela Lesa ubwaca no bwaila. Kanshi Kanabesa Mulopwe ni pa cilayo cine ici epo Abayuda bampeelela umulandu.

english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi ico mushingasuminina ukuti Lesa alabusha abafwa?

english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
translation: “Kwena na ine wine kale naletontonkanya ukuti, ndi nokwesha na maka yandi yonse ukulwisha Yesu wa ku Nasaleti.

english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.
translation: Awe basuka bapingula ukuti tuli nokuya no bwato ku Itali. Basontele Yulio umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo ukuti eo aleyangalila Paulo na bambi bamo bafungwa. Uyu Yulio ali wa mu mpuka ya fita iyaleitwa iyakwa Angusto.

english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”
translation: Elyo Paulo alabasoka ati, “Mwe bantu, ine namona ukuti twalaibikafye mu busanso kuli ubu bulendo. Ifipe no bwato fikonaika, elyo na ifwe tukafwilamo.”

english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.
translation: Lelo Yulio umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo asuula ku filesosa Paulo, asuminisha amashiwi yakwa kangalila wa bwato na ya mwine wa bwato.

english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.
translation: Lelo kwena icabu cine ca Fyabu Fisuma tacalingile kwikalamo mu nshita yampepo. Eco abengi balefwaila ukufumako no bwato no kwesha ukufika ku Fenikisi pakuti eko baikala mu nshita yampepo. Fenikisi, cabu ca mu cishi ca Kiliti. Ici cabu casalalila lwa ku masamba, ne myela isano ya ku masamba, limo ifuma lwa ku kulyo, limbi ifuma ku kuso.

english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.
translation: Awe umwela watampile ukulapuupa panono panono ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Kanshi abantu epakutila natucite ifyo tupekenye ukucita. Awe baimya ne cakulesha ubwato ukulaenda. Elyo twaima twalakonkafye ululamba lwa cishi ca Kiliti.

english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.
translation: Lelo tapalati papite inshita, ku mulundu kwafuma icikuuku icamaka. Cafuma lwa ku kabanga lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.
translation: Icikuuku caisa puma mu bwato, awe twafilwa no kubupindulwila ku mulundu ukulefuma icikuuku. Kanshi twabulekafye bwaya bulesendwa ne cimwela.

english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.
translation: Twasuka twapitila lwa ku kapinda ka kulyo ka ku cishi ca Kauda uko umwela ushakosele. Kwena uku nangu cayafishe, twakoselela twasuka twakakila akabwato pa mulu wa bwato bukalamba.

english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.
translation: Elyo bapisha imyando mwisamba lya bwato no kubukakisha pakuti bwionaika. Nomba, pakulesha ukuti ubwato bwipuma mu filundulundu fya micanga panshi ya menshi, ifyabela lwa ku lulamba lwa calo ca Libia, baisha ifisalu fyakwenseshako ubwato. Baleka ubwato bulesendwafye no mwela.

english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
translation: Icikuuku naco cakonkanyapofye, bwasuka ubushiku ubwakonkapo batampa ukulaposa ifipe fimo muli bemba.

english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
translation: Pa bwalenga shitatu abene bene batampa ukuposa muli bemba ifibombelo fimo fimo ifya bwato.

english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.
translation: Mu Adilamitimu twaingila mu bwato. Ubu bwato bwali nokushika mu fyabu fya mu misumba ya mu calo ca Asia. Awe twaima twalaya. Twali na Alistako umwina Tesalonika uwa ku calo ca Makedonia.

english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.
translation: Pa nshikufye ishingi akasuba ne ntanda te fyakumoneka, lelo icikuuku cena te cakunakako nakalya. Awe ifwe twalufya ne subilo lyonse ilyakupusuka.

english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.
translation: Papitafye inshiku ishingi ukwabula ukulya. Paulo epakwiminina alaeba abantu ati, “Mwe bantu, amuŋumfwa nga tatwafumine ku Kiliti. Lyena fyonse ifi nga tapali filubile nangu ukonaika.

english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
translation: Lelo na nombaline ndemupapata, shipenifye mwinenuka! Pantu tapakafwe nelyo umo, lelo ubwato ebukonaika.

english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
translation: Pantu lelo ubushiku malaika wakwa Lesa wandi uo mombela, acimonekela.

english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
translation: Elyo alanjeba ati, ‘Paulo, witiina! Pantu uli nokuya lubulula pa cinso cakwa kateeka mukalamba Kesalo. Kabili Lesa ku luse lwakwe, nabika ubumi bwa bonse abo muli nabo mu bwato mu minwe yobe ukuti peloba nelyo umo.’

english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
translation: Kanshi mwe bantu mwe, shipenifye! Pantu ine ninsumina ukuti fyonse fikabafye ngomo malaika anjebele.

english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”
translation: Lelo kwena icimwela ciletusenda no kuya tuposa pa cishi cimo.”

english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.
translation: Pa nshiku ikumi limo na shine, icikuuku caletusendafye pali bemba wa Meditelaneani. Elyo ubushiku pakati bacoba wa bwato batampa ukulatontonkanya ukuti capala kwati tuli mupepi na ku mulundu.

english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.
translation: Elyo baponesha mu menshi umwando uo bakakileko icela icafina. Basanga ukuti pashikile imikono amakumi cine lubali na ibili (72). Elyo cilya baendelelako nakabili bapima basanga imikono amakumi yasano na ine (54).

english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
translation: Kanshi epakutiina abati kuti ubwato bwapuma ku mabwe. Elyo baposa muli bemba ifintu fine ifyakulesha ubwato ukulaenda. Balalomba nokuti buce bwangu.

english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
translation: Ubushiku ubwakonkapo twafika na ku musumba wa Sidoni. Yulio ico aleumfwila Paulo uluse, amuleka ukuti aye kuli bacibusa bakwe pakuti bamwafwilisheko kufyo alekabila.

english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,
translation: Bacoba ba bwato epakwesha ukufyuka mu bwato. Baishisha na kabwato kanono mu menshi. Baba kwati bantu balefwaya ukuya posa pali bemba kuntanshi ya bwato icakulesha ubwato ukulaenda.

english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”
translation: Elyo Paulo alaeba ifita no mukalamba wa fita umwanda umo Yulio ati, “Nga mwaleka bacoba basha ubwato, ninshi teti mupusuke.”

english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.
translation: Kanshi ifita epakuputula imyando na kabwato kaponena mu menshi.

english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
translation: Cilya caba ku macaca, Paulo alapapata bonse ukuti balye icakulya. Alabeba ati, “Inshiku nomba shaba ikumi limo na shine mulakalakafye ukwabula ukulya nelyo cimo.

english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
translation: Namupapata lyeni icakulya. Muli nokulya nga mukwate umutende. Ala tapakabefye nelyo umo uwakuloba.”

english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.
translation: Cilya asosa ifi, Paulo abuula umukate, atasha Lesa pa cinso cabo. Elyo aumokaula atampa no kulalya.

english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
translation: Awe bonse epakuikoselesha balya ne cakulya.

english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.
translation: Bonse fwe bali pa bwato, twali imyanda ibili na makumi cine lubali na mutanda (276).

english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
translation: Cilya bonse twalya twaikuta, elyo balaposa iŋanu muli bemba pakuti ubwato bwangukeko.

english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.
translation: Cilya bwaca, bacoba bamona icalo, lelo bafilwa ukucishiba. Elyo bamona apo bemba aya umusonsongela mu mulundu na pa lulamba pali umucanga. Kanshi epakupingushanya ukuti beshe ukushiika pali iyi ncende.

english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
translation: Awe twafuma ku Sidoni twalaya. Nomba ico icimwela calafuma uko tuleya, awe twalakonkafye ululamba lwa cishi ca Saiprasi.

english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
translation: Epakuputula imyando ya fyakulesha ubwato ukulaenda, fyaponena na muli bemba. Kabili bakakulula ne myando ya nkafi. Elyo babika ne cisalu cakwensesha ubwato kuntanshi, pakuti umwela utunkilishe ubwato kuntanshi. Awe balaya balungama ku lulamba.

english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
translation: Lelo ubwato bwapuma mu filundulundu fya micanga pesamba lya menshi no bwato bwatika mu micanga. Icipande ca bwato icakuntanshi cafilililwafye ukwenda. Elyo icakunuma naco ku mulandu wa matamba ukupumamo casuka camokaika.

english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
translation: Ifita elyo fyaumfwana ukuti fipaye abafungwa bonse, epali baowa bafika ku mulundu, kabili bafyuka.

english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;
translation: Lelo umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo Yulio, ico alefwaya ukupususha Paulo, abalesha ukucita ifyo. Kabili abeba ati, abo bonse abaishiba ukowa, ebo babalilepo ukuiposa pali bemba, bowe ukuya ku mulundu.

english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
translation: Abaleshalapo, bamo babukile pa fipampa, bambi pa fipimfya fya bwato. Kanshi ifi efyo bonse twapuswike, twafika na ku mulundu.

english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
translation: Elyo twalalanya bemba wabela lubali lwa Kilikia na Pamfulia, twafika na ku cabu ca Mila mu calo ca Likia.

english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.
translation: Umo mwine mu Mila, emo umukalamba wa fita asanga icibwato icafumine ku Alekisandilia, cileya ku Itali. Kanshi emo atuninika.

english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.
translation: Pa nshikufye ishingi, twalaya no bwato panono panono. Kabili twayafiwa nganshi mpaka no kufika mupepi ku Nido. Nomba ico umwela wakosa, twafilwa no kulungama intunga twaleyamo, twakonkafye ululamba lwa cishi ca Kiliti uko umwela ushakosele, twapita mupepi na Salumone.

english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.
translation: Twakonka ululamba, lelo twayafiwa nganshi pakufika ku ncende batila, “Ifyabu Fisuma” mupepi no musumba wa Lasea.

english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them
translation: Twakokolamo nganshi muli iyi ncende. Ne nshita yakufunga ukulya yapita. Nomba caba cabusanso ukwenda pali bemba.

english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
translation: Ilyo twapuswike, twafikile ku mulundu, elyo twaishiba ukuti cishi ca Molta.

english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
translation: Abantu nabo batukwatila umucinshi nganshi, nelyo twaleima no bwato, awe batulongelesha fyonse ifyo twalekabila pa bulendo.

english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”
translation: Panuma yakupwa imyeshi itatu mu Molta, elyo twaima no bwato ubwaikele mu cabu ca Molta mu nshita yampepo. Ubu bwato bwafumine ku Alekisandilia ubo baleti, “Bampundu.”

english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
translation: Cilya twafika ku musumba wa Silakusi, awe twalindako inshiku shitatu.

english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,
translation: Ukufuma ku Silakusi twaya fika ku Legimu. Ubushiku ubwakonkapo umwela walapuupa ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Awe mu nshiku shibili twafika na ku Puteoli.

english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
translation: Mu Puteoli twasangamo ababwananyina, nabo batulomba ukuti twikale nabo umulungu umo. Elyo kabili twaima twaya fika na ku Roma.

english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
translation: Ababwananyina ba mu Roma cilya baumfwa ukuti tuli mu nshila tuleisa, batukonkela baisa fika na ku cisankano ca Apiya na pa Mayanda ya Beni Yatatu. Paulo cilya abamona, ici camuletela icikoseleshi, alatasha na Lesa.

english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
translation: Ilyo twafikile mu Roma, Paulo bamusuminishe ukuti aleikalila eka umwine, ne cita cimo icakumulonda.

english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,
translation: Kabili cilya papita inshiku shitatu, Paulo alonganya intungulushi sha Bayuda. Alabeba ati, “Bamunyinane! Ine nshacitapo nelyo cimo icabipa ku mushobo wesu, nangu ukusuula intambi sha fikolwe fyesu. Lelo mu Yerusalemu balinjikete no kumposa mu minwe ya bena Roma.

english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
translation: Nabo batile ilyo bandubulwisha, basanga ukuti nshikwete mulandu uwakunjipailapo. Balafwaya no kundekamo.

english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
translation: Lelo ico Abayuda bakosapo pa mulandu wandi, awe na ine epakutila, kanshi umulandu wandi uli nokuyafye kuli kateeka mukalamba Kesalo. Lelo ine nshakwete mulandu na bantu ba mushobo wandi.

english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
translation: Abantu ba pali ici cishi batupokelelafye bwino bwino. Awe imfula yatampa ukuloka, kwaba ne mpepo. Elyo batukosesha umulilo twalaonta.

english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
translation: Eico kanshi nombele ukumonana na imwe no kulanda na imwe. Pantu ndi mu minyololo pa mulandu wa cilayo Lesa alaya abena Israeli.”

english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
