translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatwapokapo kalata ukufuma ku Yudeya pa mulandu obe. Elyo tapaba nelyo umo pali bamunyinefwe uwafuma ku Yudeya no kwisa tushimikila nangu ukulanda icibi nelyo cimo pali iwe.

english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”
translation: Lelo kwena tulefwaya ukumfwa ifyo iwe uletontonkanyapo. Ifwe twalishiba ukuti mpangafye yonse abantu baletila iyi mpuka wabamo tayaba bwino.”

english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
translation: Elyo baumfwana na Paulo ubushiku bwakulongana. Pali ubu bushiku, lyena baisa longana umwaleikala Paulo, bafulilako nganshi. Alabalondolwela pa mulandu wa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa ukufumafye ulucelo mpaka na ku cungulo. Aesha nganshi ukuti beshibe bwino Yesu mu Mafunde yakwa Mose na mu fyalemba bakasesema.

english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
translation: Bamo bena basuminisha ifyo Paulo alesosa, lelo bambi bena tabasumine iyoo.

english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
translation: Awe basalangana ukwabula ukusuminishanya, elyo Paulo asosa aya mashiwi ayakutila, “Cine cine Mupashi Wamushilo alilungike ilyo alandile kuli kasesema Esaya ukweba ifikolwe fyesu ati,

english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.
translation: ‘Kabiye kuli aba bantu ubebe auti,

english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
translation: Pantu imitima ya aba bantu yalikutwa,

english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
translation: Paulo alundapo ati, “Kanshi mwishibe nokuti Lesa atumiine Abenafyalo amashiwi yakubapususha. Bena bakayomfwa!”

english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
translation: Elyo Paulo aya kumbilisha inkuni, akaka ne cifinga. Ashibika na pa mulilo. Cilya insoka yabusungu yaumfwa icikabilila yafuma mu nkuni, yasuma na Paulo ku cisansa.

english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
translation: Pa myaka ibili ituntulu Paulo aleikala mu ŋanda alesonkela. Alesekelelafye bonse abaleisa kukumupempula.

english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
translation: Alebila pa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa no kufunda pa Mfumu Yesu Kristu ku muntu onse ukwabula umwenso, kabili takwali no wakumulesha.

english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
translation: Ilyo abantu ba muli ici cishi bamona uko icisoka cilepelela ku cisansa cakwa Paulo, balaebana abati, “Uyu muntu cine cine cipondo. Nangu apusuka ku menshi nomba Lesa talefwaya ukuti ekale umumi.”

english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
translation: Lelo Paulo akuntila icisoka mu mulilo, ukwabula ukumfwa ubukali.

english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
translation: Bena balasubila ukuti alafimba nangu ukuti awe panshi afwe no kufwa. Nomba cilya bamona ukuti papita inshita iyikalamba ne cakumucitikila nakalya, lyena bayaluka balatontonkanya no kusosa abati, “Uyu muntu, mulungu!”

english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
translation: Kanshi mupepi napo twali, kwali amabala yakwa Publio, umukalamba uwaleyangalila ici cishi. Awe atupokelelafye bwino. Kabili pa nshiku shitatu atusungafye bwino bwino.

english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
translation: Wishi wakwa Publio wena ninshi alelefye, ico alwele impepo no kupolomya umulopa. Elyo Paulo aingilamo kukumupempula. Awe amupepelela, amutambalikapo amaboko, amuposha no kumuposha.

english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
translation: Ilyo Paulo aposha uyu muntu, abantu abalwele muli ici cishi balaisa kuli Paulo, nao alabaposha.

english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
translation: Cilya ubushiku bwa Pentekoste bwafika, abasambi ninshi balongene mu muputule mu ŋanda imo ine.

english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
translation: fwe bena Fulugia, fwe bena Pamfulia, fwe bena Egupto, fwe bena Libya lubali lwa ku Kurene, na ifwe fwe bena Roma fwe baisa tuletandala.

english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
translation: Fwe Bayuda, na ifwe fwe bayaluka Abayuda, fwe bena Kiliti, na fwe bena Arabia, bonse tuleumfwila uko baletushimikila mu ndimi shesu ifintu fikankala ifyo Lesa acita!”

english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
translation: Awe bonse balapapa na mano yabapela. Elyo balaipusha abati, “Nomba ici cintu calola mwi?”

english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
translation: Bamo bena balaseka abasambi abati, “Aba bantu bakolelwefye umwangashi!”

english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
translation: Elyo Petelo aiminine pamo na basole ikumi limo na umo. Asansula ishiwi alaeba abantu ati, “Imwe mwe Bayuda banandi, na imwe bonse mwe baikala mu Yerusalemu, ishibeni ifyo nalalondolola!

english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
translation: Aba bantu tabakolelwe iyoo, ngefyo imwe muletunganya. Kabili cicilifye ulucelo, pa nshita ya 09:00.

english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
translation: Ala ici ecilya kasesema Yoeli alandapo ati,

english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
translation: “‘Lesa asosa ati, mu nshiku shakupelekeshako,

english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
translation: Mu nshiku shilya, cinefye nkapongolwela Mupashi wandi

english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
translation: Nkalanga ifinjelengwe mulya mu mulu

english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
translation: Awe apopene icilulumo cafuma ku mulu, caisa nge cikuuku ca mwela icamaka. Caisula iŋanda yonse umo bekele.

english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
translation: Akasuba kakafiita fititi

english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
translation: Elyo abantu bonse abakalilila peshina lyakwa Yawe ebakapusuka.’

english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
translation: “Mwe bena Israeli, umfweni ifyo nalamweba, Lesa alimulanga apabuuta tuutu ku fipeshamano, ku finjelengwe ne fishibilo ifyo Yesu alecita, ukuti Yesu wa ku Nasaleti e muntu uo Lesa amutumine. Neci cintu mwalishiba.

english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
translation: Lesa umwine alishibe no kufwaya efyo alefwaya ukuti uyu Yesu aposwe mu minwe yenu. Nimwe bene mwamwipeye pakulenga Abenafyalo bamutanike pa musalaba.

english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
translation: Mako 15:24

english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
translation: Eo Davidi alandapo ati,

english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,
translation: Eico umutima wandi uli ne nsansa

english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
translation: Pantu we Mfumu tawakaleke umweo wandi

english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
translation: Yoeli 2:28-32

english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
translation: “Mwe bamunyinane, lekeni mwebe bwino bwino pa cikolwe cesu Davidi. Davidi alifwa no kumushiika balimushiika, ne nindi yakwe tucili nayo kuno ukufika na lelo.

english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
translation: Elyo bamona ifyapala imingu sha mulilo, shalekana, shaisa ikala pali cila muntu.

english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
translation: Nomba Davidi ali ni kasesema. Alishibe ukuti Lesa alimulaile no kulapa alapa ati, ‘Umo pali ba lupwa lwakwe eukesa ikala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu.’

english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
translation: Davidi nga kasesema amwene ifyali nokwisa citika. Eico ni pa kushukuka kwakwa Kristu alandile ilyo atile ati, ‘Imfumu tamulekele ashale mu calo ca bafwa. Nangu ukuleka ukuti umubili wakwe ubole.’

english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
translation: “Lesa alibusha Yesu ku bafwa. Kabili bonse tuli bakambone pali ici cintu.

english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.
translation: Lesa alimusansabalika, amuteka na ku kulyo kwakwe. Alipokelela kuli Wishi Mupashi Wamushilo uo Wishi amulaile. Na ifwe Yesu natupeela Mupashi Wamushilo. Kanshi eifi muleimwena no kuyumfwila.

english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand
translation: Davidi umwine wine asosa ati,

english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
translation: Mateo 27:35

english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
translation: “Kanshi abena Israeli bonse bashininkishe ukuti uyu Yesu, uo mwatanike, eo Lesa acita Imfumu kabili Kristu!”

english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
translation: Cilya abantu baumfwa ifyo Petelo alanda, imitima yabo yabilimuka. Balaipusha Petelo na basole bambi abati, “Bamunyinefwe, bushe tuli nokucita shani?”

english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation: Petelo abasuka ati, “Cila muntu ali nokulapila no kupilibuka, no kubatishiwa mwishina lyakwa Yesu Kristu, epakuti mubelelwe uluse ku fyabubifi fyenu. Elyo mwalapokelela Mupashi Wamushilo, ubupe bwakwa Lesa.

english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
translation: Pantu nimwe bene na bana benu Lesa alaya ubu bupe. Alaya na kuli bonse abali ukutali na bonsefye abo Imfumu Lesa wesu akuuta ukuti bese uko ali.”

english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
translation: Elyo bonse baisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo. Batampa nokulalanda mu ndimi shimbi umo Mupashi abapeelele ukulanda.

english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
translation: Kabili Petelo abebafye ifingi na fimbi ifyakubasoka. Alabakonkomesha ati, “Ipususheni kuli iyi nkulo ibi.”

english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
translation: Awe abantu abengi basekelela ifyo abeba, no kubatishiwa babatishiwa. Ubo bwine bushiku, abalundilweko ku basambi bakwa Yesu bali cikanga amakana yatatu (3,000).

english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
translation: Abantu balebika imitima yabo kufyo abasole balebafunda, no kulaikala pamo nga babwananyina, no kulalila pamo Umulalilo wa Mfumu, no kupepa.

english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
translation: Abasole balecita ifinjelengwe ne fishibilo ifingi. Kanshi abantu bonse bali na katiina.

english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
translation: Mateo 22:44

english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
translation: Baleshitisha ifyuma fyabo na fyonse ifyo bakwete. Elyo indalama balemonamo, baleshakanya kuli bonse ukulingana nefyo cila muntu alekabila.

english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
translation: Cila bushiku baleya kukulongana pamo kwi Tempele. Mu mayanda yabo mwena balekumana kukulya icakulya. Balelya ne nsansa, kabili aba mutima umo.

english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
translation: Balelumbanya Lesa, na bantu bonse balebatemwa. Cila bushiku Imfumu yalebalundilako kwibumba lyabo bonse abo yalepususha.

english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
translation: Kanshi mu Yerusalemu mwalimo Abayuda abapetamina Lesa, ukufumafye ku mishobo yonse iya pano isonde.

english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
translation: Ilyo baumfwa ici cilulumo abantu balongana ibumba ilikalamba. Bonse cabapelenganya ico cila muntu alaumfwa uko abasambi balelandila mu lulimi lwakwe.

english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
translation: Balapapa, cabapesha na mano. Balaipushanya abati, “Bushe aba bonse balelanda, te bena Galile?

english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
translation: Nga kanshi caba shani icakuti bonse umo umo tuleumfwa ifyo balelanda mu lulimi twafyalilwamo?

english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
translation: Ubushiku bumo Petelo na Yoani baya kwi Tempele, pa nshita ya mapepo, cilya akasuba kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00.

english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
translation: Bamwishiba ukuti euyu wine uwaleikala pa mpongolo yayemba iye Tempele alelomba. Awe bonse cabapesha amano, balapapafye pa cicitike ku cite.

english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
translation: Ilyo bamona uwali cite ekatilile kuli Petelo na Yoani, abantu bonse cabapesha amano, epakwisa ulubilo ku ncende iyo beta “Ulukungu lwakwa Solomoni.”

english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
translation: Cilya Petelo amona abantu, alabeba ati, “Mwe bena Israeli, cinshi ico mulesungukila pali ici cintu? Cinshi ico muletulolekesha ifi? Bushe imwe muleti ni ku maka yesu nangu nico tuli bena Lesa eco twalengela uyu muntu aleenda?

english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
translation: Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki, Lesa wakwa Yakobo, Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu, ewacindamika umubomfi wakwe Yesu. Imwe nimwe mwamuposele ku balwani, mwamukaana na pa cinso cakwe Pilato, nangu Pilato wena alefwaya ukuti amulekemo.

english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
translation: Imwe mwakeene Yesu umuntu Wamushilo, kabili Uwakaele. Mwaipusha Pilato ukuti amulubwile icipondo.

english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
translation: Ukuf 3:15

english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
translation: Uyu muntu mulemona uo mwaishiba no kwishiba, icalenga ukulaenda maka yakwa Yesu. Cisumino muli Yesu ecilengele ukuti uyu muntu apolelefye ngefyo bonse mulemona.

english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
translation: “Nomba bamunyinane, ninjishiba ukuti fyonse ifyo mwacitile kuli Yesu, imwe bene ne ntungulushi shenu, mwacitile mukukanaishiba.

english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
translation: Lelo e nshila Lesa apekenye pakufikilisha ifyo asosele kuli bakasesema bonse ukuti, Kristu wakwe ali nokucula.

english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
translation: Kanshi nomba lapileni, mwalukile na kuli Lesa, pakuti Lesa afuute ifyabubifi fyenu.

english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
translation: Pa mpongolo ye Tempele iyo baleti, “Impongolo Yayemba” basangapo umuntu uwafyelwe icite. Cila bushiku balemuleta pali iyi mpongolo pakuti alelomba ku bantu abaleingila mwi Tempele.

english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
translation: Epakuti Imfumu imupeele inshita yakumutalalika imitima. Imutumine Yesu uo yamupekanisha, emukutila Kristu.

english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
translation: Uyu wine Yesu ali nokuba mu mulu mpaka no kufika ku nshita iyo Lesa akapanga fyonse cipya cipya, nga mulya alandile kale kuli bakasesema bakwe abamushilo.

english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
translation: Pantu Mose nao asosele ati, ‘Imfumu Lesa wenu akasala umo mu mushobo wenu ukuba kasesema, ngefi fine yansala. Muli nokulabeela fyonse ifyo amweba.

english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
translation: Uyo onse uwakaana ukubeela ifyo uyo kasesema abeba, bali nokumufumya mu bantu bandi.’

english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.
translation: Bakasesema bonse, Samwele wine na bakasesema abamukonkelepo bonse balisobela ifilecitika muli shino nshiku.

english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’
translation: Nimwe mpyani sha filayo bakasesema balelandapo. Kabili nimwe mpyani sha cipangano Lesa aebele Abrahamu ati, ‘Ni ku bufyashi bobe eko abantu bonse aba pano isonde bakapaalilwa.’

english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
translation: Kanshi Lesa asalile Umubomfi wakwe no kumutuma kuli imwe pakubala, epakuti kwipaalo lyakwe, bonse mumone ukufuma ku misango yenu ibi.”

english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
translation: Icite cilya camona ukuti Petelo na Yoani balaingila mwi Tempele, cabalomba ubupe.

english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
translation: Elyo bonse Petelo na Yoani bamulolesha. Petelo wena amweba ati, “Tuloleshe!”

english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
translation: Awe abalolesha, alesubila ukuti balamupeelako fimo.

english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
translation: Petelo epakumweba ati, “Ine ndalama nshikwete. Nalakupafye ico nkwete. Ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu wa ku Nasaleti, akwenda.”

english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
translation: Elyo Petelo amwikata ku kuboko kwa ku kulyo, amwimya. Awe apopene amaka yaisa mu makasa na mu nkolokoso.

english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
translation: Afwampuka napo ekele, aiminina, atampa no kulaenda. Elyo aya nabo mwi Tempele, aleenda, aleyangafye, alelumbanya Lesa.

english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
translation: Abantu bonse bamumona uko aleenda, alelumbanya na Lesa.

english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
translation: Bashimapepo no mukalamba wa fita fyakulinda Itempele, na Basaduki baishile kuli Petelo na Yoani ilyo balelanda ku bantu.

english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.
translation: Kanshi imwe bonse, mwishibe ukuti uyu muntu uwiminine pano napolafye bwino, apolele ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu umwina Nasaleti, uo mwatanike. Nomba Lesa alimubusha ku bafwa.

english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
translation: Uyu Yesu eo calembwapo ukuti,

english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
translation: “Ni kuli Yesu fye eka eko twingamona ukupusuka. Pantu tapaba na umbi pano isonde, uo Lesa apeela ku bantu uwaba na amaka yakuti tumone ukupusukilamo.”

english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
translation: Cilya bashicilye bamona ifyo Petelo na Yoani bapamine pakulanda, abantu bafyefye abashasambilila, awe cabapesha amano. Elyo bailuka ukuti aba bantu baleenda na Yesu.

english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
translation: Awe bafilwa ne fyakusosapo, nga neco bamona no muntu wapolele ali pamo na Petelo na Yoani.

english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
translation: Kanshi epakweba abasole ukufumina panse. Bashicilye bena bashala balelanshanya.

english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
translation: Balaipushanya abati, “Tulecita shani aba bantu? Abantu bonse mu Yerusalemu nabeshiba ukuti aba bantu nabacita icishibilo icacipeshamano. Na ifwe bene tekuti tukaane.

english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
translation: Nomba pakulesha ici cintu ukusalanganina ku bantu natubebekeshe ukuti tabali nakulanda ku muntu nelyo umo pali Yesu.”

english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
translation: Kabili babeta mu cilye. Balabakonkomesha abati, “Tecakwesha nelyo panono ukulalanda, nangu ukulafunda pali Yesu.”

english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
translation: Nomba Petelo na Yoani bayasuka bashicilye abati, “Pinguleni mwe bene, icalungama cinshi? Bushe kubeela imwe, nangu kubeela Lesa?

english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
translation: Baisa nabafulwa, ico aba basole balefunda ukuti Yesu alishukuka ku bafwa. Ukufunda ifi, ekufundafye nokuti abafwa bakashukuka.

english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
translation: Awe ifwe tekuti tuleke ukulanda pa fintu ifyo ifwe fwe bene twaimwena no kuyumfwila.”

english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
translation: Bashicilye, pakubalesha babebekesha pa maka nganshi, elyo babaleka balaya. Tabamwene umulandu wakubakandilapo, pantu abantu bonse balelumbanyafye Lesa pa cipeshamano bacitile.

english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
translation: Amalu 118:22

english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
translation: Apopenefye ilyo icilye cabalekelemo, Petelo na Yoani babwelelemo ku banabo. Baya bashimikilako na fyonse ifyo bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba babebele.

english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
translation: Ilyo baumfwa umulandu, awe bonse capamo balapepa Lesa, abati, “Kabumba, we mwine wa mulu ne calo na bemba na fyonse ifyabamo.

english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
translation: Niwe ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo walengele icikolwe cesu Davidi umubomfi obe atile ati,

english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
translation: Ishamfumu sha pano isonde shileipekanya ku bulwi,

english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
translation: “Pantu Herodi na Pontio Pilato balongene pamo na Benafyalo na bena Israeli muno Yerusalemu. Balapangila na Yesu umubomfi obe uwamushilo, umusubwa obe.

english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
translation: Kwena bena balongenefye kukufikilisha ifyo iwe we Lesa ku maka yobe na ku mano yobe ifyo wapangile ukuti fili nokucitika.

english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
translation: Kanshi nomba we Mfumu, lolesha pa mapange yabo. Afwako abasha bobe, uleke balefunda amashiwi yobe ukwabula umwenso.

english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
translation: Awe babekata, nomba ico bwalaila babaposa mu cifungo mpaka bwaca.

english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
translation: Tambalika ukuboko kobe kukundapa. Cita ifinjelengwe ne fishibilo ku maka yakwa Yesu, umubomfi obe uwamushilo.”

english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
translation: Cilya bapwafye ukupepa, iŋanda balongenemo yalatenta. Elyo bonse baisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo. Batampa no kulafunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa ukwabula umwenso.

english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
translation: Ibumba ilya basumina lyalifye ilya mutima umo na mano yamo yene. Tapali no wakulatila, “Ifyuma nakwata fyandifye neka.” Nomba fyonse ifyo cila muntu akwete, fyali fya bonse.

english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
translation: Abasole bena balebikapofye ukwiminina na maka pali bukambone bwa kushukuka kwa Mfumu Yesu. Ne cikuuku cakwa Lesa cali pali bonse bene nganshi.

english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
translation: Takwali uwakukabila akantu mwibumba lyabo. Bonse abakwete amabala nangu amayanda balefishitisha. Elyo indalama balemonamo,

english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
translation: baleleta ku basole. Elyo bashakanya kuli bonse ukulingana nefyo cila muntu alekabila.

english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
translation: Kanshi kwali umuntu umo uwa mu luko lwa bena Levi, ishina lyakwe ni Yosefu. Afyalilwe mu cishi ca Saiprasi. Abasole bena balemwita Banaba emukutila, “Umuntu wacikoseleshi.”

english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
translation: Uyu muntu alikwete ibala, elyo ashitisha. Indalama amwenemo, ashileta ku basole.

english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
translation: Lelo abengi abaumfwileko ifyo balefunda, basumina. Awe ne mpendwa ya baume abasumine yaba ni cikanga amakana yasano (5,000).

english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
translation: Cilya bwaca, intungulushi sha Bayuda, abakalamba na bakafundisha bamafunde balongana mu Yerusalemu.

english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
translation: Bateka icilye pamo na Anosi Shimapepo mukalamba, na Kayafa na Yoani na Alekisandilia na bonsefye aba mu lupwa lwa bashimapepo bakalamba.

english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
translation: Baiminika Petelo na Yoani mu lwalala, elyo balabepusha abati, “Bushe maka nshi mucitileko ici cintu? Nangu bushe maka yakwani mwabomfeshe?”

english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,
translation: Elyo Petelo aisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo, alabeba ati, “Imwe mwe ntungulushi na bakalamba ba bantu!

english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
translation: Ifwe ilelo nga muletulubulwisha, ni pa mulimo usuma tubombele uwakuposha umuntu uwali icite.

english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
translation: Kwaliko umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Anania, umukashi wakwe ni Safira. Awe bashitisha ibala lyabo.

english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
translation: Apopene Safira awa panshi apali Petelo, afwa no kufwa. Awe na balumendo cilya baingilamo basanga Safira nafwa. Nao bamusenda, baya mushiika mupepi na wiba.

english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
translation: Awe ulukuta lonse, na bonse abaleumfwako baikatwa no mwenso ukalamba.

english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
translation: Elyo abasole balacita ifishibilo ne finjelengwe ifingi ku bantu. Abasumina bonse balelongana pamo aba mutima umo mu lukungu baleti, “Lwakwa Solomoni.”

english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
translation: Abantu nangu balelumbanya abasumina, awe tapali nangu umo uwapamine ukuikumika kwibumba lyabo.

english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
translation: Awe ibumba lya baume na banakashi abalesumina mu Mfumu lyaya lilelundulukilakofye.

english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
translation: Pakumona ifipeshamano ifyo abasole balecita, abantu epakulaleta abalwele pa misengele na pa matanda mu misebo. Epakuti Petelo nga alapita kusuka icinshingwa cakwe cakupa pali bamo.

english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
translation: Kanshi abantu abengi ukufuma mu misumba iyashinguluka Yerusalemu nabo balaisako. Baleleta abalwele babo na balecushiwa ku mipashi yakowela, awe bonsefye balepola.

english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy
translation: Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba pamo na banankwe aba mwibumba lya Basaduki umufimbila wabekete, baimina abasole.

english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
translation: Awe babekata, babaposa umo balebika aba mu cifungo bonse.

english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
translation: Lelo ubushiku malaika wa Mfumu aisa isula impongolo sha cifungo. Afumisha na basole panse.

english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
translation: Nomba Anania afisapo indalama shimo, ninshi umukashi naishiba. Ishashelepo, aleta ku basole.

english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
translation: Abeba ati, “Kabiyeni muye iminina mwi Tempele. Muleshimikila abantu pali uyu mweo upya.

english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
translation: Awe nabo bakonka ifyo malaika abeba. Lucelocelo, baya mwi Tempele, batendeka no kulafunda abantu.”

english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
translation: Ilyo abo batumine bafika mu cifungo, basanga abasole tabalimo, baya shimika umulandu ku cilye.

english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
translation: Abati, “Ilyo twacifika tusangile impongolo sha cifungo shonse ishaisalwafye bwino bwino na bakalinda nabeminina pa mpongolo. Nomba ilyo twaisula impongolo twasanga mukati tamuli muntu.”

english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
translation: Ilyo umukalamba wa fita fya bakalinda we Tempele na bashimapepo bacindami baumfwa ifi, cabapesha amano. Bafilwa ukumfwa ifyo cicitike.

english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
translation: Elyo paisa umuntu, alabeba ati, “Umfweni, balya bantu mwaposele mu cifungo, bali mwi Tempele, balefunda abantu!”

english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
translation: Elyo umukalamba wa fita fya bakalinda we Tempele ayako ne fita fyakwe, aya leta na basole. Lelo tababomfeshe maka, pantu baletiina abantu abati, “Epali batulasa amabwe.”

english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
translation: Awe baleta abasole, babatwala na mu cilye cikalamba ca Bayuda. Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba alabepusha.

english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
translation: Abeba ati, “Twalimukonkomesha ukuleka ukufunda pali uyu muntu. Nomba namusalanganya amafunde yenu mu Yerusalemu monse. Kabili mubikilepofye ukutupeela umulandu wa mfwa yakwe.”

english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
translation: Petelo na basole bambi bayasuka abati, “Ifwe tuli nokubeela Lesa, te bantu iyoo.

english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
translation: Petelo amweba ati, “Anania, cinshi ulekele Satana engile mu mutima obe? Wabepa na Mupashi Wamushilo, wafisapo shimo pasho wapokele pakushitisha ibala!

english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
translation: Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu, alibusha Yesu ku bafwa uo imwe mwaipeye pakumutanika pa musalaba.

english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
translation: Lesa alimucindamika, amuteka na ku kulyo kwakwe ukuba Intungulushi kabili Umupusushi. Epakuti apeele abena Israeli ukulapila no kupilibuka, no kubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo.

english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
translation: Ifwe tuli bakambone pali iyi milandu, pamo pene na Mupashi Wamushilo uo Lesa apeela ku bantu abamunakila.”

english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
translation: Cilya bashicilye baumfwa ifi, bafulwa nganshi, balafwaya nokuti bepaye abasole.

english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
translation: Lelo shicilye umo, uwa mwibumba lya Bafalise, kabili kafundisha wamafunde, ishina lyakwe Gamalieli, uo abantu bonse bacindike, awe aiminina mu cilye. Aeba bashicilye ati, “Fumisheni aba bantu panse pa nshita inono.”

english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
translation: Elyo alaeba bashicilye ati, “Mwe bena Israeli, cenjeleni pafyo mulefwaya ukucita aba bantu.

english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
translation: Tapalati papite inshita iyitali apo twamwene Teuda uwaleitunga ukuti te muntu wafyefye. Awe na bantu cikanga imyanda ine balamukonka. Lelo bamwipaya, na bonse abalemukonka basalangana. Awe ne cilonganino cakwe caonaika.

english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
translation: Panuma yakwa Teuda, lilya kwali ukupenda abantu, kwaishile Yuda umwina Galile. Aongola ibumba lya bantu. Nomba cilya bamwipaya, abantu bonse abalemukonka basalangana.

english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
translation: Kanshi pali uyu mulandu ndemweba nati, lekeni aba bantu baleya. Pantu amapange yabo nefyo balecita nga fyabuntunsefye ninshi fikonaika.

english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
translation: Lelo nga fyafuma kuli Lesa ninshi mukafilwa ukufyonaula. Mukasangafye ukuti mulelwisha Lesa wine!”

english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
translation: Ilyo taulashitisha ibala, lyali lyobe. Elyo panuma yakushitisha, indalama nasho shine shali shobe, kuti washibomfya umo ulefwaila. Nga kanshi cinshi cilengele ukuti ucite ifi? Ala te bantu ubepele, ubepelefye Lesa.”

english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
translation: Awe bamusuminisha. Elyo baeba abasole ukwingila mu cilye. Baeba ne fita ukuboma ifikoti. Babalesha no kufunda pali Yesu, elyo babalekamo.

english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
translation: Abasole bafuma mu cilye nabasansamuka, pakusanga ukuti Lesa abacindika ico basebana mukuculila Yesu.

english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
translation: Cila bushiku babikilepofye ukulafunda no kubila Imbila Nsuma iyakutila Yesu e Kristu, mwi Tempele na mu mayanda ya bantu.

english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
translation: Anania ati omfwe aya mashiwi awa panshi afwa no kufwa. Elyo bonse abaumfwileko baikatwa no mwenso.

english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
translation: Elyo abalumendo baisa, bamupomba mu nsalu, bamusenda, baya mushiika.

english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
translation: Cilya papita kwati insa shitatu, umukashi wakwe Safira nao aisamo. Teshibe ne cicitike.

english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
translation: Petelo amwipusha ati, “Njebako, bushe ishi shine e ndalama iwe na Anania mushitishemo ibala?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ee nisho shine.”

english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
translation: Elyo Petelo amweba ati, “Nga cinshi ico iwe no mulume obe mumfwanine ukwesha Mupashi wa Mfumu? Abantu bafuma mukushiika umulume obe, balya bali pa mwinshi. Na iwe wine balaisa kusenda.”

english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
translation: Kanshi pa nshita iyi, abasambi baya balefulilako. Abasambi Abayuda abalelanda Icigiriki balailishanya pa basambi Abahibulu. Balasosa abati, “Ifwe bamukamfwilwa wesu cila bushiku tabalebapako ifintu baleyakanya.”

english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
translation: Nomba bafilwa ukumwansha mufyo alesosa ku mulandu wa mano yakwe, ico Mupashi alemwafwa mufyo alesosa.

english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
translation: Elyo basembeleka abantu mu bumfisolo ukuti basose abati, “Ifwe twaumfwile uko Stefano alelanda amashiwi yamusaalula kuli Mose na kuli Lesa.”

english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
translation: Kanshi abantu, na bakalamba na bakafundisha bamafunde epakwimina Stefano. Bamwikata, bamusenda, bamutwala na ku cilye cikalamba ca Bayuda.

english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
translation: Elyo baletamo na bakambone babufi. Balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu lyonse alandafye amashiwi ayakususha Itempele na Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
translation: Twalyumfwile uko alesosa ati, ‘Yesu wa ku Nasaleti akonaula Itempele. Elyo akalula ne ntambi batushila kuli Mose.’ ”

english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
translation: Bashicilye bonse elyo batontomesha amenso pali Stefano. Bamona nokuti impumi yakwe yalamoneka kwati ni mpumi yakwa malaika.

english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
translation: Kanshi abasole ikumi limo na babili epakulonganya ibumba lyonse ilya basambi. Balabeba abati, “Tacilungeme ukuti tuleyakanya ifyakulya, elyo twalekelesha ukufunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
translation: Kanshi bamunyinefwe, saleni mwe bene pali imwe, abaume cine lubali, abacetekelwa, abaisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo, kabili abamano. Abo ebo twalapeela uyu mulimo.

english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
translation: Elyo ifwe twakulaibikafye pakupepa no kufunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa.”

english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
translation: Awe ibumba lyonse lyasekela aya amashiwi. Lyasala Stefano, umuntu uwacisumino nganshi, kabili uwaisula na Mupashi Wamushilo. Lyasala na Filipo na Prokoro, na Nikano, na Timoni, na Pamena, na Nikola Umwinafyalo, uwa ku Antioki, uwayalukile kwipepo lya Bayuda.

english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
translation: Ibumba lya basambi lyabaleta ku basole. Nabo abasole babapepelela, babatambalikila na maboko.

english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
translation: Awe ne shiwi lyakwa Lesa lyaya lilelunduluka. Abasambi mu Yerusalemu nabo baya balefulilakofye. Elyo ne bumba ilikalamba ilya bashimapepo lyanakila icisumino.

english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
translation: Stefano ali uwamaka kabili uwakwatisha icikuuku cakwa Lesa. Alecita ifishibilo ifyakupapa ne finjelengwe pakati ka bantu.

english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
translation: Nomba abantu bamo batampa ukubikana ifikansa na Stefano. Bamo bena Kurene na bena Alekisandilia abafumine ku sinagoga baleti, “Sinagoga ya Bantu balubulwa.” Elyo bambi bena Kilikia na bena Asia.

english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba elyo aipusha Stefano ati, “Bushe cine cine ifyo fine efyo usosa?”

english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
translation: Icite 37:11

english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
translation: Ilyo Yakobo aumfwa ukuti mu Egupto mwena muli ifyakulya, atumako bamwane ifikolwe fyesu pa lwendo lwakubalilapo.

english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
translation: Elyo Yosefu alaisha amashiwi kuli wishi Yakobo, ukuti ese ku Egupto pamo pene na ba lupwa lwakwe bonse. Bonse pamo bali amakumi cine lubali na basano.

english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
translation: Awe Yakobo aya ku Egupto. Mu Egupto mwine emo afwila. Emwafwila ne fikolwe fyesu.

english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
translation: Ifitumbi fyabo balefibwesesha ku Shekemu. Balefishiika mu nindi Abrahamu ashitile ne ndalama kuli bamwana Hamori.

english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
translation: Elyo paisa imfumu imbi iyishaishibe Yosefu, eyalateeka mu Egupto.

english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
translation: Iyi mfumu yacenjelela abantu besu, yalacusha ne fikolwe fyesu. Yalabapatikisha ukuposa utwana twabo utunya panse, pakuti tulefwa.

english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
translation: Stefano ayasuka ati, “Bamunyinane na imwe bashifwe, umfweni! Lesa uwacindamisha amonekele ku cikolwe cesu Abrahamu mu Mesopotamia ninshi talati ese kukwikala mu Harani.

english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
translation: Ni mu nshita ine iyo elyo Mose afyelwe. Ali umwana uwayemba nganshi. Abafyashi bakwe bamulela kumwabo pa myeshi itatu.

english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
translation: Nomba ilyo baya musha kunse, mwana Farao umukashana amubuula alamulela kwati mwana wakwe.

english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
translation: Mose bamusambilisha acenjela nganshi mu masambililo yonse aya bena Egupto. Awe alumbuka nganshi mufyo alelanda na mufyo alecita.

english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
translation: “Mose cilya afika imyaka amakumi yane iyakufyalwa, alafwaya ukupempula bamunyina, abena Israeli.

english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
translation: Amonako uko umwina Egupto alecusha umwina Israeli umo. Awe apokololako umwina Israeli, aipaya umwina Egupto.

english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
translation: Mose alatontonkanya ukuti abena Israeli kuti bailuka, baishiba nokuti ni Lesa eumutumine pakuti abalubule. Nomba tabailwike na kalya.

english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkapo Mose asanga abena Israeli babili balelwa. Aesha ukubalamununa. Alabeba ati, ‘Mwe bantu mwe, ala muli bamunyina, cinshi mulelwila?’

english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
translation: Bushe ulefwaya ukunjipaya nga filya mailo waipeye umwina Egupto?’

english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
translation: Cilya Mose aumfwa ifi, afulumuka mu Egupto, aya ikala mu calo ca Midiani. Ilyo ali muli ici calo afyala na bana babili abaume.

english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
translation: Aebele Abrahamu ati, ‘Fuma mu calo cobe, ushe no lupwa lobe uye na ku calo nkakulanga.’

english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
translation: “Patile cilya papita imyaka amakumi yane, malaika amonekela Mose mu matololo mupepi no lupili lwa Sinai. Amumonekela mu cimpusa cilebilima no lubingu lwa mulilo.

english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
translation: Icite 11:31

english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
translation: Yosh 24:32

english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
translation: Elyo Imfumu yamweba aiti, ‘Fuula insapato shobe. Pantu incende wimininepo ni ncende yamushilo.

english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
translation: Ninjimwena ne mwine ifyo abantu bandi balecula nganshi mu Egupto. Niŋumfwa nefyo balelilishika. Eico ninjika kukubalubula. Kanshi isa nkutume ku Egupto.’

english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
translation: “Ni Mose umo wine uo abena Israeli bakeene, ilyo basosele abati, ‘Bushe nani akucitile imfumu na kaputula wa milandu yesu?’ Eo Lesa atumine kukubateeka no kubalubula. Malaika uwamumonekele mu cimpusa icalebilima ewalemwafwako.

english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
translation: Mose asuka abafumya mu Egupto. Acitile ifinjelengwe ne fishibilo ifingi mu Egupto, pali Bemba Wakashika, elyo na mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane.

english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
translation: Ni uyu wine Mose ewaebele abena Israeli ati, ‘Lesa akamwimisha umo mu mushobo wenu uukaba kasesema nga ine.’

english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
translation: Ali pamo ne cilonganino ca bena Israeli mu matololo. Ni Mose eo malaika alandile nankwe pa lupili lwa Sinai, ninshi ali pamo ne fikolwe fyesu. Elyo apokelele na mashiwi yamweo ayo ali nokutweba.

english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
translation: Awe afuma mu calo ca Kaludea aya na kukwikala mu Harani. Panuma ya mfwa yakwa wishi, Lesa afumya Abrahamu mu Harani, amuleta na muli cino calo muleikalamo.

english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
translation: Kanshi epakweba Aroni afiti, ‘Tupangile imilungu yakuti iletutangilila, pantu tatwishibe icaponena ulya Mose uwatutungulula ukufuma mu Egupto.’

english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
translation: Awe kanshi epakupanga icilubi icapala iciponti ca ŋombe. Balacituula na malambo. Basefya ne nsansa icintufye ico abene bapangile ne minwe yabo.

english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
translation: Lesa nao abalukila, abasuulako. Abaleka nokuti balepepa ifita fya mu mulu nga mulya calembelwa mu citabo ca bakasesema ukuti,

english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
translation: Nimwe mwalesenda itenti lya mulungu Moleki,

english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
translation: “Ilyo bali mu matololo ifikolwe fyesu fyali ne Tenti lyakwa Lesa ilyakulanga ukuti Lesa ali pakati kabo. Lyapangilwe mu musango Lesa alangilemo Mose ukulipanga, kabili ukulinganafye nefyo Lesa amulangile.

english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
translation: Ifikolwe fyesu fyaleshilana Itenti lyakwa Lesa umukonkanina inkulo. Fyalelisenda no kulingisha mu calo bapokolwele ku mishobo imbi, ninshi fili na Yoshua. Ni Lesa ewalefulumuna iyi mishobo ilyo ifikolwe fyesu fyaleisa. Itenti lyakwa Lesa epakwikala muli cilya calo mpaka na ku nshita yakwa Davidi.

english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
translation: Lesa alitemenwe Davidi. Davidi epakulomba Lesa ukuti akuulile Lesa wakwa Yakobo umwakwikala.

english: But Solomon built him a house.
translation: Lelo ni Solomoni ewakuulile Lesa iŋanda.

english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
translation: “Lelo Lesa Mukulu tekala mu mayanda yakuulwa na bantu. Efyo na kasesema alanda ati,

english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
translation: “‘Lesa atila ati,

english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
translation: Muli cino calo mwena Lesa tapeelamo Abrahamu nangu akapanga akakuti atile, ni mpanga yandi. Lelo nangu Abrahamu ali talakwata mwana, Lesa alimulaile ukumupeela pamo na bana bakwe abali nokumukonkapo ukuti cino calo cali nokuba cakwe.

english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
translation: Bushe teine ne mwine napanga ifi fyonse?’

english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
translation: “Mwe bantu bakosa imitwe mwe! Mwaumalala imitima no kukanaumfwa nga Benafyalo. Mwabafye nge fikolwe fyenu. Imwe lyonse mukaana ukumfwila Mupashi Wamushilo!

english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
translation: Bushe palibapo kasesema uo ifikolwe fyenu fishacushishe? Ifikolwe fyenu fyaleipaya inkombe shakwa Lesa ishalesobela ukwisa kwa Mubomfi uwapetamina Lesa. Nomba imwe mwamuposa ku balwani, mwamwipaya.

english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
translation: Nimwe mwapokelele Amafunde yakwa Mose, ayo bamalaika bamuletele. Nomba kabili mwakaana no kulayakonka!”

english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
translation: Ilyo bashicilye baumfwa ifyo Stefano alanda, bafulwa icibi, balasenganya na meno.

english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
translation: Nomba Stefano aisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo. Elyo apunamina ku mulu, amona ubucindami bwakwa Lesa na Yesu eminine ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa.

english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
translation: Stefano elyo asosa ati; “Namona umulu naucenama, elyo no Mwana wa muntu eminine lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa!”

english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
translation: Awe bashicilye balasowesha, bacilika na matwi. Elyo bonse capamo bamufukukila.

english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation: Balamutintanya, bamufumisha na kunse ya musumba. Elyo balamulasa na mabwe. Abasangilwepo babuula insalu shabo basha pa mulumendo, ishina lyakwe Saulo.

english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
translation: Ilyo balemulasa amabwe, Stefano aikalilefye ukulomba Lesa aleti, “We Mfumu Yesu, pokelela umweo wandi!”

english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
translation: Kabili Lesa amwebele nokuti, ‘Abana bobe bakekala mu bweni mu calo ca bene. Muli ico calo bakabateka ubusha nokulabacusha pa myaka imyanda ine.’

english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
translation: Elyo afukama panshi apunda ati, “We Mfumu wingababelela uluse pali ubu bubi bacita!” Ati asose ifi, awa afwa no kufwa.

english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
translation: Icite 12:7

english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
translation: Elyo Lesa apeela Abrahamu ulutambi lwakusembulula abana abaume ukuba icishibilo ca cipangano. Kanshi ilyo Isaki afyelwe, Abrahamu amusembulula pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse. Isaki nao aisa sembulula bamwane ikumi limo na babili, ifikolwe ifyalumbuka.

english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
translation: “Nomba ifi ifikolwe ifyalumbuka fyafimbila Yosefu. Fyamushitisha, bamusenda mu busha ku Egupto. Lelo Lesa tamulekeleshe.

english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
translation: Saulo wena amwene ukuti balungika pakwipaya Stefano. Pali ubo bwine bushiku Abayuda batampileko ukulacusha ulukuta mu Yerusalemu. Abalukuta bonse epakusalanganina mu calo ca Yudeya na mu ca Samaria. Abashelefye mu musumba basolefye beka.

english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
translation: Abantu bonse abakalamba na baice balekutikisha nganshi kufyo alesosa. Baleti, “Uyu muntu e maka yakwa Lesa ayo beta Amaka Yakalamba!”

english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
translation: Balemukutikisha nganshi, pantu pa nshitafye itali Simoni alebapelenganya amano ku malele yakwe.

english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
translation: Nomba ilyo basumina ifyo Filipo alebila Mbila Nsuma ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa ne yakwa Yesu Kristu, awe abaume na banakashi bonse babatishiwa.

english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
translation: Na Simone nao wine asuka asumina. Ilyo abatishiwa, lyonse aleenda na Filipo. Alesunguka nganshi pakumona ifishibilo ifyakupapa ne finjelengwe fyalecitika.

english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
translation: Ilyo abasole mu Yerusalemu baumfwa ukuti abena Samaria nabasekelela amashiwi yakwa Lesa, batumako Petelo na Yoani.

english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
translation: Cilya bafikako, Petelo na Yoani epakupepelela abasumina pakuti bapoke Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
translation: Pantu Mupashi Wamushilo tali talaisa pali bene. Babatishiwefye mwishina lya Mfumu Yesu.

english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
translation: Elyo Petelo na Yoani babatambalikilapo amaboko, bapokelela na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
translation: Simoni cilya amona ukuti bapoka Mupashi Wamushilo ico abasole babatambalikilapo amaboko, atwalako indalama kuli Petelo na Yoani.

english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
translation: Abeba ati, “Mpeeleniko na ine aya maka. Pakuti na ine onse uo natambalikilapo amaboko alepoka Mupashi Wamushilo.”

english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
translation: Awe abantu bamo abapetamina Lesa baya shiika Stefano, kabili bamuloosha nganshi.

english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
translation: Lelo Petelo amwasuka ati, “Kabiye uko ukafwa ne ndalama shobe! Iwe uletontonkanya ukuti, kuti washita ubupe bwakwa Lesa ne ndalama!

english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
translation: Taulingile nelyo panono ukulabomba na ifwe. Pantu uli no mutima uwafulungana pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
translation: Kanshi lapila pali iyi mitontonkanishishe yobe ibi. Upapate ku Mfumu. Uleke ikubeleleko uluse pakukwata imitontonkanishishe ya uyu musango mu mutima obe.

english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
translation: Pantu namona ukuti umutima obe waisulamo ubukali, kanshi uli musha wabubifi!”

english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
translation: Simoni epakwasuka ati, “Nimwe mpapatileniko ku Mfumu. Pakuti pali ifyo mwasosa pekancitikila nelyo cimo.”

english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
translation: Petelo na Yoani balafunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa baleshimika nokuti bena ni bakambone. Elyo babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu. Ilyo baleya, baya balebila Imbila Nsuma mu mishi iyingi iya bena Samaria.

english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
translation: Malaika wa Mfumu aebele Filipo ati, “Ima, kabiye ku kapinda ka ku kulyo no musebo wa matololo, uwafuma ku Yerusalemu waya ku Gasa.”

english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
translation: Awe aima alaya. Kanshi umwina Etiopia mutungwi nao alebwelelamo kumwabo. Uyu muntu ali cilolo uwacindama, uwaleyangalila ifyuma fyonse ifyakwa namfumu, Kandake wa bena Etiopia. Aishile ku Yerusalemu kukupepa.

english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
translation: Nomba alebwelamo kumwabo, naikala mwiceleta lyakwe. Alebelenga ne fyalemba kasesema Esaya.

english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
translation: Mupashi aeba Filipo ati, “Kabiye mupepi ne celeta lilya.”

english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
translation: Lelo Saulo wena aswangana nganshi mukulofya ulukuta lonse. Alaingila muli cila ŋanda alekulululamo abasumina abaume na banakashi, alebaposa na mu cifungo.

english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation: Awe Filipo abutukilako. Aumfwa nokuti alebelenga ifyalemba kasesema Esaya. Elyo Filipo amwipusha ati, “Bushe uletesha ifyo ulebelenga?”

english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Nga kuti natesha shani? Kano pali uwakunondolwelako.” Elyo aeba Filipo ukuti anine, bekale nankwe mwiceleta.

english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
translation: Kanshi Amalembo Yamushilo ayo alebelenga ni aya,

english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
translation: Balemusaalula,

english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
translation: Elyo mutungwi aeba Filipo ati, “Njebako, bushe nani uo kasesema alelandapo? Bushe mwine wine nangu ni umbi alelandapo?”

english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
translation: Elyo Filipo atampa ukulanda. Atampilafye ku Malembo Yamushilo yene acilabelenga. Elyo amulondolwelako na pa Mbila Nsuma yakwa Yesu.

english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
translation: Nomba ilyo baleya mu musebo, basuka bafika na pali amenshi. Cilolo ati, “Amenshi aya, cinshi cingandesha ukubatishiwa?”

english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
translation: Elyo mutungwi aeba ukuti iceleta liminine. Awe bonse babili, Filipo na mutungwi wine baya mu menshi. Elyo Filipo amubatisha.

english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
translation: Cilya bafuma mu menshi na Mupashi wa Mfumu asenda Filipo. Cilolo tatalile amumona nakabili. Awe akonkanyapo ulwendo lwakwe nasansamuka nganshi.

english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
translation: Abasumina abasalangene, balebila Imbila Nsuma konse uko balepita.

english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
translation: Filipo wena aisangafye ali mu Asoti. Elyo aya alepitana mu mishi alebila Imbila Nsuma, asuka afika na ku Kesalia.

english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
translation: Filipo ayile ku musumba umo uwa mu Samaria. Alabila Kristu ku bantu.

english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
translation: Amabumba yalakutikisha pakumfwa bwino ifyo Filipo alefunda, elyo no kumona ifishibilo ifyakupapa alecita.

english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
translation: Pantu imipashi yakowela yalefuma mu bantu abengi ilepunda. Elyo ifite ne filema ifingi nafyo fyalepola.

english: There was great joy in that city.
translation: Awe na mu musumba mwabafye insansa sheka sheka.

english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
translation: Mu musumba uyo uwa mu Samaria mwalimo umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Simoni. Pa nshita imo alecita ifyamalele mu musumba, alepelenganya na bena Samaria amano. Aleitunga ukuti te muntu wafyefye.

english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
translation: Saulo akonkenyepofye ukululunkana nganshi mukufwaya ukwipaya abasambi. Awe aya kuli Shimapepo mukalamba.

english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
translation: Mu Damasiko mwaleikala umusambi umo, ishina lyakwe ni Anania. Imfumu yamweba mu cimonwa aiti, “Anania!” Nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi we Mfumu.”

english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
translation: Imfumu yamweba aiti, “Ima, uye no musebo batila Uwaololoka. Uye ku ŋanda yakwa Yuda. Uye fwayamo umuntu umo umwina Taso, ishina lyakwe ni Saulo. Nomba alepepa.

english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
translation: Mu cimonwa, wena namona umuntu ishina lyakwe ni Anania, aisa nomo ali. Amutambalikilapo amaboko pakuti alelolesha nakabili.”

english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
translation: Anania ayasuka ati, “We Mfumu, abantu abengi balinshimikilako pali uyu muntu. Balinshimikilako ne fintu ifingi ifibi nganshi uyu muntu acita ku bamushilo bobe mu Yerusalemu.

english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
translation: Kanshi na kuno kwine eshile ku maka ya bashimapepo bacindami, kukwikata bonse ababomfya ishina lyobe mukupepa.”

english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
translation: Imfumu yamweba aiti, “Ala akuyafye, pantu ine uyu muntu nimusala ukuba umubomfi wandi. Akalenga Abenafyalo ne mfumu sha Benafyalo, na bantu ba mu Israeli bene ukuti banjishibe.

english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
translation: Kabili nine wine ne mwine nkamulanga ifyo ali nokucula pa mulandu wa ine.”

english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation: Anania epakwima, aya ingila na mu ŋanda. Atambalikila amaboko pali Saulo. Asosa ati, “Munyinane Saulo, Imfumu Yesu iyakumonekele mu nshila ilyo waleisa kuno, naintuma kuli iwe pakuti ulelolesha nakabili, elyo wisulemo na Mupashi Wamushilo.”

english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
translation: Apopene mu menso yakwa Saulo mwalukuta ifintu ifyaba nga mamba. Awe atampa no kulalolesha nakabili. Elyo aima, no kubatishiwa abatishiwa.

english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
translation: Ati alye icakulya, awe na maka yabwela.

english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
translation: Aya lomba amakalata yakutwala ku masinagoga mu Damasiko. Pakuti nga asangako abaume nangu abanakashi abakonka inshila Yesu alanga, akabekate no kubaleta ku Yerusalemu.

english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
translation: Apopene atampa no kulashimikila mu masinagoga ukuti Yesu ni Mwana Lesa.

english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
translation: Awe bonse abaleteshako balapapa. Balaipushanya abati, “Bushe uyu muntu tewalecusha nganshi abantu basumina muli Yesu mu Yerusalemu? Na kuno kwine aisa, bushe tekukwikata aba bantu no kubatwala kuli bashimapepo bacindami?”

english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
translation: Lelo Saulo akalabana nganshi mukufunda. Alapelenganya Abayuda ba mu Damasiko amano, ico alabashinina ukuti Yesu e Kristu wine.

english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
translation: Cilya papita inshiku ishingi, Abayuda balapanga ukwipaya Saulo.

english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
translation: Lelo Saulo aumfwako ifyo balemupangila. Akasuba no bushiku balalonda impongolo sha musumba pakuti bamwipaye.

english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
translation: Nomba abasambi bakwa Saulo ubushiku bamubuula, bamubika mu museke. Elyo bamupisha mu cipunda ce linga lya musumba. Bamwishisha panshi.

english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
translation: Saulo afikile ku Yerusalemu elyo alefwaya ukuti aleikumika ku basambi. Lelo balamutiina bonse, pantu baletwishika nga cine cine musambi.

english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
translation: Elyo Banaba amusenda, amutwala na ku basole. Alabashimikilako nefyo Saulo ilyo ali pa lwendo, amwene Imfumu, nefyo Imfumu yalandile nankwe. Abashimikilako nefyo Saulo alefunda mu Damasiko pali Yesu ukwabula umwenso.

english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
translation: Elyo Saulo alaendauka nabo, alepitana mu Yerusalemu monse, alefunda na pa Mfumu Yesu ukwabula umwenso.

english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
translation: Kabili alalanda na Bayuda abalanda Icigiriki no kupaashanya nabo. Lelo bena balafwaya ukumwipaya.

english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
translation: Kanshi ilyo aleya ku Damasiko, cilyafye apalama ku musumba, awe apopene ulubuuto ukufuma ku mulu lwasanika ukushinguluka apo ali.

english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
