translation: Cilya ababwananyina baishiba ifi, bamusenda, bamutwala ku Kesalia. Elyo ukufuma kulya bamutuma ku Taso.

english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
translation: Kanshi ulukuta lonse mu Yudeya, mu Galile, na mu Samaria, elyo lwaikala ku matwi tondolo. Elyo ku bwafwilisho bwakwa Mupashi Wamushilo, ulukuta lwakulilako, kabili lwakosa na mukupetamina Imfumu.

english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
translation: Mu Luda emo asanga umuntu umo, icite, ishina lyakwe ni Enea. Uyu muntu pa myaka cine konse konse tatalile afuma pa musengele.

english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
translation: Petelo amweba ati, “Enea, Yesu Kristu akundapa. Ima wansule umusengele obe.” Awe apopene Enea aima no kwima.

english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
translation: Abantu bonse abaleikala mu Luda na mu Sharoni cilya bamumona, basumina mu Mfumu.

english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
translation: Mu Yopa mwali umusambi umo umwanakashi, ishina lyakwe ni Tabita mu Cigiriki ni Doka. Lyonse alecita ifisuma, alekumbusuka na balanda.

english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
translation: Mu nshiku shine isho, alwala no kufwa afwa. Elyo basamba icitumbi cakwe, bacibika na mu muputule umo uwa pamulu.

english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
translation: Luda ni mupepi na Yopa. Kanshi abasambi baumfwa ukuti Petelo ali mu Luda. Batumako abantu babili abakumweba ukuti, “Wendeshe, wise kuno mwesu.”

english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
translation: Petelo aima aya nabo. Cilya afika, bamusenda, bamutwala na ku muputule wa pamulu. Bamukamfwilwa bonse bamushinguluka balelila. Balamulanga imingila ne nsalu Doka alebila ilyo acili umumi.

english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
translation: Awe Saulo awa panshi. Aumfwa ne shiwi lilemweba aliti, “Saulo, Saulo ee, cinshi ico ulencushisha?”

english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation: Elyo Petelo abafumya mu muputule. Afukama, alapepa. Elyo apilibukila ku citumbi, asosa ati, “Tabita buuka!” Nao ashibatula amenso. Ilyo amona Petelo, aikala nokwikala.

english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
translation: Petelo amwikata pa kuboko, amwafwako aiminina. Elyo aita abamushilo na bamukamfwilwa abalanga na Tabita umumi.

english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
translation: Awe ici cintu caishibikwafye mu Yopa monse, na bantu abengi epakusumina mu Mfumu.

english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
translation: Petelo aikala mu Yopa inshikufye ishingi. Alaikala na kanuka wampapa umo, ishina lyakwe Simoni.

english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
translation: Saulo aipusha ati, “Niwe ani we Mfumu?” Ishiwi nalyo lyayasuka aliti, “Nine Yesu, nine ulecusha.

english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
translation: Nomba ima, kabiye mu musumba. Baleya kweba ifyo uli nokucita.”

english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
translation: Abantu bali na Saulo pa lwendo, bena baimininafye tondolo. Ishiwi lyena balyumfwa, lelo tabamwene muntu nelyo umo.

english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
translation: Saulo aima panshi. Ati ashibatule amenso, afilwa ukumona nelyo cimo. Awe bamutungululafye mu Damasiko nabamwikata ku minwe.

english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
translation: Pa nshiku shitatu tewakulolesha nakalya. Kabili talelya nangu ukunwa kantu.

english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
translation: Amashiwi ayasosele Amosi, uwali umo pali bakacema abafumine ku Tekoa, pafyo amwene pa bena Israeli ninshi kwashala imyaka ibili ukuti icinkukuma cikalamba cise. Cali e nshita Usia ateekele icalo ca Yuda, elyo Yeroboamu mwana Yoashi nao e nshita ateekele icalo ca Israeli.

english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”
translation: Na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo pa malinga ya musumba wabo uwa Turi,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”

The LORD says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.
But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;
translation: Na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo pa malinga ya musumba wabo uwa Raba,

english: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
He said: “The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”
translation: Amosi alisosele ati,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.
translation: Na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo pa ŋanda ya mfumu Hasaeli,

english: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says the LORD.
translation: Nkonaula impongolo sha mu musumba wa Damasiko,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
translation: Ee, na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo pa malinga ya musumba wabo uwa Gasa,

english: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nkalofya kateeka ulya aikala mu musumba wa Ashidodi,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says the LORD.
translation: Pa bana benu abaume, nalisalilepo bamo abakuba bakasesema ba mashiwi yandi,

english: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
translation: Nomba imwe mwatampile ukulapatikisha Abanasiliti ukulanwa umwangashi,

english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
translation: “Eico ine nomba, nkamutitikisha panshi,

english: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.
translation: Ala nangufye abakwatisha ulubilo, tabakabutunge,

english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.
translation: Abacenjela ukuposa imifwi, tabakamone pakwiminina,

english: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says the LORD.
translation: Ubo bushiku abashilika balya abashipa nganshi bakafulumuka ubwamba.

english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
translation: Na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo mu calo ca bena Moabu,

english: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says the LORD.
translation: Ine nkalofya kateeka wa calo ca Moabu,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
translation: Na ine nomba nkaposa umulilo mu calo ca Yuda,

english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.
translation: Banyantaula pa mitwe ya balanda,

english: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
translation: “Lelo kwena nalilofeshe abena Amoli pa cinso ca bena Israeli,

english: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
translation: Imwe mwe bena Israeli, umfweni amashiwi ayo Yawe alelanda pali imwe, pa mutundu wenu onse mwebo afumishe mu calo ca Egupto, aletila ati,

english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
translation: Yawe alesosa ati,

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ukuti,

english: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
translation: Kabili Yawe aletila ati,

english: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
translation: “Umfweni kuno, kabili musoke aba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo,”

english: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
translation: “Ubushiku ubo nkakandamo abena Israeli palwa bubifi bwabo,

english: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
translation: Isham 23:15

english: “I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
translation: “Pa bantu ba mitundu yonse iya pano isonde,

english: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
translation: “Bushe abantu babili kuti baendela pamo

english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
translation: Bushe inkalamo kuti yalaibuluminafye mu mutengo,

english: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
translation: Bushe icuni kuti caikila panshi apali iciteyo,

english: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?
translation: Ipenga nga lyalila mu musumba umo,

english: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
translation: “Cine cinefye Yawe pakucitapo cimo,

english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
translation: Inkalamo iyo ilebuluma,

english: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
translation: Bilikisheni abantu balya baikala mu mayanda ayakosa aya mu musumba wa Ashidodi ,

english: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
translation: Umfweni kuno, imwe mwe banakashi ba mu musumba wa Samaria,

english: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Nine namuletele icikuko,

english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Ine ne Lesa nine nalofeshe abanenu bamo,

english: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
translation: “Kanshi mwe bena Israeli ine nomba nalaswa mukande,

english: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: The LORD, the God of Armies, is his name.”
translation: Ala ni Lesa ewabumba impili,

english: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.
translation: Yawe nalapa ati, “Napalifye ine ne Wamushilo,

english: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says the LORD.
translation: Bakalamukululula no kumufumisha pa cipunda ca mwilinga,

english: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,
translation: Imfumu Yawe alisosele ati,

english: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Konkanyenipofye ukulatuula umukate wenu uwatutumuka pakuntotela ine ne Lesa,

english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Nine naponeshe icipowe mu misumba yenu yonse,

english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.
translation: Ilyo ifisabo fyenu fyasumbile ukupya,

english: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
translation: Ilyo abantu balekabila amenshi,

english: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Inshita ishingi nalionawile amabala yenu ne filime fyenu,

english: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
translation: Imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, umfweni luno lwimbo lwa malilo ulo ine ne Amosi nalamwimbila.

english: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
translation: Imwe mwe bantu mulapata umuntu onsefye uulanda bwino mu cilye,

english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
translation: Imwe mulacusha abalanda,

english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.
translation: Ala ine nalishiba ifyo ulufyengo lwenu lwakulisha,

english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
translation: Eco uwamano ekala tondolo mu nshita shabipa ngeshi,

english: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
translation: Mulefwaya ukucita ifisuma, lekeni ukulacita ifibi,

english: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
translation: Mulepata ifyabipa, muletemwafye ifisuma,

english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
translation: Kanshi Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita aletila ati,

english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.
translation: Mu mabala yonse aya myangashi mukaba imisowa.

english: “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.
translation: Mwashama imwe mwe bafuluka ubushiku Yawe ali nokufika.

english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.
translation: Cikaba ngo muntu uwakuti cilya afulumuka inkalamo,

english: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
translation: Umukashana nacisungu Israeli nawa panshi,

english: Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
translation: Ubushiku Yawe akesa kukabafye imfifi,

english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
translation: Ilyo mwakulandetela amalambo yenu ayakoca,

english: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
translation: Lekeni no kulanyimbila inyimbo shenu isha congo,

english: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
translation: Lekeni umulinganya ulebapo pe nga menshi ya mu mulonga uupita,

english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
translation: “Imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, ilyo mwali mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane (40),

english: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
translation: Lelo mwasenda Sakuti imfumu yenu na Kaiwani umulungu wenu,

english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
translation: Eico na ine nkamusenda bunkole,

english: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
translation: Imfumu Yawe aletila ati,

english: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
translation: Yawe aleeba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ati,

english: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
translation: Mwilaesha kulamfwaila ku Betele,

english: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.
translation: Kanshi imwe mwe bena Israeli, mulefwaya Yawe,

english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
translation: Pantu umulinganya imwe mulawalula icakukalifya,

english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,
translation: Ni Yawe ewabumba intanda,

english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.
translation: Yobo 9:9

english: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
translation: Mwashama imwe mwe baikala mu Sioni ubwanalale,

english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention the LORD’s name.’
translation: Umuntu wa mu lupwa lwa bantu abafwile, akalati nga aisa mu ŋanda kukubuula icitumbi ca muntu wakwe uufwile, pakuti aye acoce, elyo akalaipusha onsefye uukabelamamo ati, “Bushe kucili na bambi abali umo?” Uyo muntu uubelememo nga ayasuka ati, “Awe.” Elyo kabili akatila, “Iwe talalafye tondolo. Ala twilalumbula ishina lyakwa Yawe.”

english: “For, behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
translation: Apo Yawe napeela icipope,

english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,
translation: Bushe bakabalwe kuti babutuka ulubilo pa fimabwe?

english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
translation: Imwe mulaitakisha pa mulandu wakupoka umushi wa Lo Deba.

english: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says the LORD, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
translation: Yawe, Lesa umwine wa fita, umwine nasosa ati,

english: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?
translation: Kabiyeni, muye tamba umusumba wa Kaline,

english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,
translation: Imwe mwe batalushisha ukutali ubushiku mukakandwa,

english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,
translation: Mukacimona imwe mwe basendama pa masanshi aya bikwako ameno ya nsofu,

english: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
translation: Imwe mwalitemwa ukushika inyimbo,

english: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
translation: Imwe munwa umwangashi inkombo pa,

english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.
translation: Eico imwe nimwe mukabalilapo ukusendwa bunkole,

english: “The Lord GOD has sworn by himself,” says the LORD, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
translation: Imfumu Yawe nalapa ati,

english: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.
translation: Mu ŋanda imo nga mukashalamo abaume ikumi limo (10), ala nabo bene bakafwa bonse.

english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.
translation: Imfumu Yawe alinangile ine icintu cimo mu cimonwa. Namwene Yawe alebumba makanta nao umwingi, abantu ninshi balipwa kale ukutulikila imfumu ya calo ifyani fya musangulo, ninshi ne fyani fimbi fyalitampa nakabili ukulapuuka.

english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.
translation: Amasiya shimapepo wa mu Betele, alitumine amashiwi kuli Yeroboamu imfumu ya bena Israeli ati, “Amosi alekupangila pa menso ya bena Israeli. Imilandile yakwe, awe ikonaula icalo cino pantu na bantu nabafilwa ukushipikisha ku fyebo fyakwe.

english: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
translation: Amosi alesosa ati, ‘Yeroboamu akafwa ku nkondo, abena Israeli nabo bakabafumya muli cino calo cabo, no kubatwala muli bunkole kumbi kumbifye.’”

english: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,
translation: Elyo Amasiya aeba Amosi ati, “Iwe kamona, awe fyatala fyafula. Fuma kuno, bwelelamo ku calo ca Yuda, eko ukaye ikala no kulamwenamo ifyakulya fyobe, no kulasesema kulya kwine amashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
translation: Tecakwesha nakabili ukulasesemena kuno ku Betele, pantu kuno ni ncende yamushilo iya mfumu ya calo, e kwitempele uko bonse bapepela.”

english: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;
translation: Nao Amosi epakwasuka Amasiya ati, “Ine nshili kasesema nangu mwana kasesema iyoo. Ine naleteeka impaanga, kabili nalesunga ne bala lyandi ilya mikunyu.

english: and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
translation: Nomba Yawe alimfumya pa mulimo wandi uwakusunga impaanga, alinkonkomesha ati, ‘Kabiye, ulepitana mu bantu bandi abena Israeli, ulebasesemena na mashiwi yandi.’

english: Now therefore listen to the LORD’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’
translation: Kanshi iwe Amasiya umfwa kuno ifyo Yawe alesosa.

english: Therefore the LORD says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
translation: “Kanshi apo iwe walanda ifi, Yawe alekweba ati,

english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord GOD, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
translation: Muli ico cimonwa, awe namona makanta nao alyafye fyonse ifyalepuuka mu calo.

english: The LORD relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says the LORD.
translation: Yawe nao epakubwesha umutima, Yawe ati nokuti, “Cilya cintu wali wamona, tacakacitike iyoo.”

english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.
translation: Imfumu Yawe kabili alinangile ine icintu cimbi mu cimonwa. Namwene Imfumu Yawe alepekanya umulilo uwakoca abantu bakwe. Uyo mulilo nao epakulabilima panshi apashika pesamba, kabili watampa no kulaoca umulundu.

english: Then I said, “Lord GOD, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
translation: Na ine epakusosa nati, “We Mfumu Yawe, leka napapata. Nga nomba abantu bobe balepusuka shani? Tumwana Yakobo, ala tunono, kabinge tufwanda twa bantu.”

english: The LORD relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Yawe nao epakubwesha umutima, Imfumu Yawe ati nokuti, “Ici cintu naco cine tacacitike iyoo.”

english: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
translation: Yawe kabili alinangile ine icintu cimbi mu cimonwa. Namwenemo Yawe naiminina ku cibumba cimo ico abantu balekuula, ninshi balecipima na ku mwando wa bakakula uwakupiminako. Kanshi Yawe nao alikete umwando, no kulapima ico cibumba.

english: The LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
translation: Elyo Yawe anjipusha ati, “Amosi, bushe finshi ulemona?”

english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
translation: “Incende shikonaika isho bamwana Isaki bapepelamo.

english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.
translation: Kabili Imfumu Yawe alinangile ine icintu cimbi mu cimonwa. Namwenemo umuseke uwa fitwalo ifyapya mu lusuba.

english: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.
translation: Inshikunkulu shenu ine nkashisangula amalilo,

english: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the LORD’s words.
translation: “Nine Imfumu Yawe ndelanda ukutila,

english: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD’s word, and will not find it.
translation: Mukalaendauka,

english: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.
translation: Ubo bushiku abakashana ababa imbeka,

english: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”
translation: Imwe mwe bantu, mwe balumbula amashina ya tulubi twa mu Samaria

english: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
translation: Elyo Yawe anjipusha ati, “Amosi, bushe finshi ulemona?”

english: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord GOD. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.
translation: Shilya nyimbo abanakashi bemba kwi Tempele,

english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
translation: Umfweni kuno, imwe mwe banyanyantilila ababusu,

english: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;
translation: Imwe mulasosa amuti,

english: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”
translation: Twakulashita abalanda mu ndalama,

english: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
translation: Yawe nalapa pa cilumba cakwa Yakobo ati,

english: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.
translation: Kanshi nomba kukaba icinkukuma,

english: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.
translation: “Pali ubo bushiku ine nkawisha akasuba ilyo kakaba pakati ka mutwe,

english: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.
translation: Ine nalimwene Yawe naiminina ku bulambo, anjeba nokuti,

english: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
translation: Ababifi bonse ababa pakati ka bantu bandi,

english: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says the LORD who does this.
translation: epakuti abena Israeli bakapoke icalo ca bena Edomu icashalako,

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.
translation: Abantu bandi abena Israeli,

english: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
translation: Nkalimba abena Israeli mu calo cabo,

english: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
translation: Nangu bakemba umwimba uwakuya fika ku calo ca bafwa,

english: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.
translation: Nga bakafisama pa lupili lwa Kameli,

english: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.
translation: Abalwani babo nga ebakabasenda bunkole,

english: For the Lord, the GOD of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
translation: Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita nga akumya icalo,

english: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—the LORD is his name.
translation: Yawe alikuula amayanda yakwe mu mulu,

english: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says the LORD. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
translation: Yawe alesosa ati,

english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says the LORD.
translation: Moneni, amenso ya Mfumu Yawe atontele pali ubu bufumu ububifi,

english: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.
translation: “Ine nkapeela icebo, elyo nkapukanya aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli,

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
translation: Ine Paulo, Lesa ku kufwaya kwakwefye anjita ukuba umusole wakwa Kristu Yesu. Ine ndi na Timote munyinefwe.

english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
translation: Elyo muleikala umo Imfumu ifwaila. Kabili mulecita lyonse ifyakusansamusha Imfumu. Mu milimo yenu mulefuma ifisuma. Lyena elyo mukamona ukwishibilako Lesa.

english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
translation: Tulamulombela kuli Lesa ukuti, ku maka yonse ayafuma ku maka yakwe ayacindama, mube abakosa pakuti mube no mutekatima no kushipikisha muli fyonse.

english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
translation: Kabili muletasha Lesa Tata ne nsansa, ewamulenga ukuba abalinga ukupyana ifyo Lesa abikila abamushilo mu Bufumu bwalubuuto.

english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
translation: Alitupokololako ku maka ya mfifi no kutuleta mu Bufumu bwakwa Mwane uo atemwa.

english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
translation: Uyu ewatulubula, pantu atubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyesu.

english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
translation: Kristu e cata cakwa Lesa uushimoneka. E beli pa fibumbwa fyonse.

english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
translation: Pantu ni ku maka yakwa Kristu, Lesa abumbila ifintu fyonse ifyaba mu mulu na muno calo, ifimoneka ne fishimoneka, imipashi yamaka, bashamfumu, bakateeka na bamaka bonse. Ni ku maka yakwa Kristu, Lesa abumbila ifintu fyonse, kabili ni Kristu eo ifintu fyonse fili nokubombela.

english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
translation: Ilyo ifintu fyonse fishilabako Kristu eko ali, kabili ewakumbinkanya ifintu fyonse.

english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
translation: E mutwe wa lukuta lonse ulwaba umubili wakwe. E ntulo ya fintu fyonse. E beli mukubuuka ku bafwa. Pakuti ena ekafye abe uwantanshi muli fyonse.

english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
translation: Pantu Lesa umwine apingwile ukuti Mwane abe na Bulesa bonse.

english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Twamulembela mwe bamushilo abaikala mu Kolose, mwe bamunyinefwe mwe bali muli Kristu. Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe fileba na imwe.

english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
translation: Lesa apingwile nokuti ku maka yakwa Mwane, eko Lesa awikishanye ne fintu fyonse. Lesa alipanga icibote mukuwikishanya ne fintu fyonse ifya pano calo ne fya mu mulu pa mulandu wa mfwa yakwa Mwane iya pa musalaba.

english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
translation: Na imwe bene kale mwali ukutali na Lesa, kabili mwali abalwani bakwe pa mulandu wa fyabipa ifyo mwaletontonkanya no kucita.

english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
translation: Lelo nomba pa mulandu wa mfwa yakwa Mwane, Lesa alimuwikishanya nankwe, pakuti amulete mube abamushilo, abakaele, ababula icilubo pa cinso cakwe.

english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
translation: Mufwile ukutwalilila mu cisumino icakuulwa pa mufula uwakosa. Mwileka nelyo cimo cimusunkanye, cimufumye kuco mwasubilamo ukutula apo mwaumfwilile Imbila Nsuma. Ine, ne Paulo, nine mubomfi wa iyi Imbila Nsuma iyashimikwa ku muntu onse icalo conse.

english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
translation: Nomba ndi uwasansamuka pa mulandu wakuculila pali imwe. Pantu ku macushi ya mubili wandi wine, ndepwishishisha amacushi ayaciliko ku macushi Kristu aculila umubili wakwe, ulukuta lwakwe.

english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
translation: Ine, Lesa alinsonta ukuba umubomfi wa lukuta lwakwe. Lesa ewampeele uyu mulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma umupwilapo kuli imwe.

english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
translation: Imbila Nsuma e nkaama Lesa afishile mu myaka yapita na mu nkulo shonse, lelo nomba naisokolola ku bamushilo.

english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
translation: Lesa apangile ukwishibisha inkaama yakwe iyacindamisha ku Benafyalo. Inkaama niyi iyakuti Kristu aba muli imwe, eico kanshi mwakulashukilako ubucindami bwakwa Lesa.

english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
translation: Eico kanshi tubila Kristu ku muntu onse. Tusoka no kufunda abantu na mano yonse, pakuti twafwe umuntu onse abe uwapwililika pa cinso cakwa Lesa, ku maka yakwa Kristu.

english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
translation: Pakucita ici ndabombesha nganshi, mombela ku maka Kristu ampeela ayabomba muli ine.

english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
translation: Lyonse ilyo tumupepelako, tulatasha Lesa Wishi wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
translation: Ala twalyumfwa palwa cisumino cenu muli Kristu Yesu nefyo mwatemwa abamushilo bonse.

english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
translation: Icisumino ne citemwiko cenu fyashinta pafyo musubila ifyo Lesa amusungila bwino mu mulu. Ilyo amshiwi yacishinka aya Mbila Nsuma yabalilepo ukufika kuli imwe, elyo mwaumfwile na pesubilo ili

english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
translation: ilyaba mu Mbila Nsuma iyilaleta ipaalo, no kulasalanganina isonde lyonse. Efintu yacita muli imwe ukutula pa bushiku buntu mwabalilepo ukumfwa ifya cikuuku cakwa Lesa, no kwishiba bwino ifyo caba.

english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
translation: Ni Epafula ewamufundile pa cikuuku cakwa Lesa, kabili musha munensu uwakwa Kristu uwacishinka uo twatemwa, uutubombelako ico abombela Kristu.

english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
translation: Ewatwebeleko pa citemwiko ico Mupashi amupeela.

english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
translation: Eico pa mulandu wa ifi, lyonsefye tulamupepelako ukutula pa bushiku twaumfwile ifi pali imwe. Tulomba Lesa ukuti amupeelesha amano yonse ayakwishiba fyonse ifyo afwaya. Aya mano no kwiluka, ni Mupashi wakwe eupeela.

english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
translation: Ndemwishibishako ifyo mombesha nganshi pali imwe na ba mu Laodikea, ukubikapofye na bonse abo abashamonapo.

english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
translation: Kabili mwalipeelwa umweo uwapwililika pa mulandu wa ico mwaba muli ena. Kristu e mutwe ukucila pali bakateeka na bamakafye bonse.

english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
translation: Kabili mukuba muli ena, mwalisembululwa. Tekusembululwa kwa ku bantu, lelo kwakwa Kristu ukwaba mukufuma kukuteekwa no mubili wabuntunse.

english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
translation: Ilyo mwabatishiwe, mwashiikilwe pamo na Kristu. Kabili mu lubatisho mwabukile pamo na Kristu pa mulandu wa cisumino cenu mu maka yakwa Lesa, uwabushishe Kristu ku bafwa.

english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
translation: Kale mwali abafwa pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyenu na pa mulandu mwali abashasembululwa ukufuma ku mubili wabuntunse. Lelo nomba Lesa alimulenga ukuba abamweo pamo na Kristu. Lesa alitubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyesu fyonse.

english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
translation: Lesa alifuuta imisha yesu yonse iya mafunde ayaletupeela umulandu, aliyafumyapo yonse no kuyapampamina pa musalaba.

english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
translation: Pa musalaba epo acimfishe amaka ya bakateeka na bamaka aba mu lwelele, no kubabika pa lwalala ukuti bonse bamone uko alebasenda bunkole.

english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
translation: Eico mwileka umuntu nelyo umo amupingule pafyo mwingalalya nefyo mwingalanwa, nangu pa nshiku shakupepapo, nangu pakusefya umweshi upya, nangu ni Sabata.

english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
translation: Ifi fintu fyali fyakwishibilakofye ifintu ifyali nokwisa. Icintu cacine cine ni Kristu.

english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
translation: Mwileka nelyo umo amusuule ukuti alimucila pa mulandu wa fimonwa, ukuicefya kwabufi no kupepa bamalaika. Uwaba ifi aitutumunafye apabula nelyo cimo, akonkafye amano yabuntunse.

english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
translation: Kabili alileka ukunakila Kristu uwaba e mutwe wa lukuta, umubili wakwe. Kristu eulenga umubili onse ukwate amaka, eulenga nokuti ifilundwa ne mishipa filundane pamo, no kukula emo ukulila ngomo Lesa alefwaila.

english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
translation: Ncita ifi pakuti imitima yabo ilesansamuka nokuti bekale abatemwana, abomfwikisha icishinka. Elyo bakeshibe inkaama yakwa Lesa, neyi inkaama ni Kristu wine.

english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
translation: Imwe mwalifwa pamo na Kristu, eico nomba imipashi iyiteeka pano calo tayaba na maka pali imwe. Kanshi cinshi ico mwikalila nga bantu ba cino calo? Cinshi ico munakila amafunde yatila,

english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
translation: “Wilaikata kuli ici!” “Wilasonda kuli cilya!” “Wilakumya kuli cimbi ico!”?

english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
translation: Ala aya mafunde ya pa fintu ifyonaika ilyo bafibomfya. Aya mafunde ne mifundile, fyabuntunsefye.

english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
translation: Ee cine cine aya mafunde ayakulaipatikisha ukupepa, ukuicefya bufi bufi no kulacusha umubili buluku buluku, yamoneka ukuba nga yamano, lelo tayaba na maka yakwansha ulunkumbwa lubi lwa mubili.

english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
translation: Kristu e cipao umo Lesa afisa ifyuma fya mano yonse no kwishiba konse.

english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
translation: Ndemweba nati, mwileka muntu nelyo umo amubepaike ku mashiwi yabufi.

english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
translation: Eico nelyo nshili na imwe ku mubili, mu mupashi mwena ndi na imwe. Kabili ndi ne nsansa pakumona ifyo mwatekanya nefyo imwe bonse pamo mwaba ne cisumino icakosa muli Kristu.

english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
translation: Apo mwasumina ukuti Kristu Yesu ni Mfumu, muleikala abaampana pamo nankwe.

english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
translation: Mwandemo ne mishila muli Kristu, mushimpwe umo ali. Mube abakosa mu cisumino cenu umo mwine mwafundilwe. Kabili muletasha Lesa lyonsefye.

english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
translation: Moneni mwileka nelyo umo ukuti amuteeke ubusha na mano yabuntunse aya bucenjeshi bwafye, ayafuma kufyo bafunda mu ntambi sha bantu, na ku mano ya pano calo, tekuli Kristu iyoo.

english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
translation: Pantu mu mubili wakwa Kristu emwaisula Bulesa bonse.

english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
translation: Imwe mwalibushiwa ku bafwa pamo na Kristu. Eico nomba akufwayeni ifintu ifya mu mulu, umo Kristu aikala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu, lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa.

english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
translation: Mwalingila muli bumuntu bupya. Lesa e kabumba wa bumuntu bupya. Amulenga ukuti mulealukilako cipya cipya mu cata cakwe, epakuti amulete kukumwishiba bwino bwino.

english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
translation: Muli bumuntu bupya tamwaba kapatulula kakuti uyu Mwinafyalo noyu Muyuda, uyu alisembululwa noyu tasembululwa, uyu mututu noyu mwina mpanga, uyu musha noyu muntungwa. Lelo kuli ifwe bonse, Kristu ewacindamisha kabili aba muli ifwe bonse.

english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
translation: Imwe muli basalwa bakwa Lesa, abamushilo kabili abo atemwa. Kanshi nomba toleni imisango iyalinga, muleba abaluse, abacikuuku, abafuuka, abamutembo no mutekatima.

english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
translation: Muleshipikishanya no kubeleshanya uluse nga umo ali no mulandu ku munankwe. Mulebeleshanya uluse ngefyo Imfumu yamubelela uluse.

english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
translation: Na pali iyi mibeele, lundenipo icitemwiko, pantu ecikakanya no kukumbinkanya ifintu fyonse pamo umupwilapo.

english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
translation: Umutende untu Kristu apeela, eo ulemutungulula mufyo mulepingula. Ni pali uyu mutende epo Lesa amwitila pakuti mube umubili umo. Kanshi muletasha Lesa.

english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
translation: Lekeni amashiwi yakwa Kristu ayacindamisha yaleikala mu mitima yenu. Mulebomfya nganshi amano mukufundana no kupandana amano, muleimba inyimbo sha malumbo ne shakwa Lesa ne sha bena Lesa. Muleimbila Lesa no kumutasha ne mitima yenu yonse.

english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
translation: Lekeni fyonse ifyo mulecita no kusosa, muleficita pa mulandu wa Mfumu Yesu, kabili eo muletashishako na Lesa Tata.

english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
translation: Mwe bakashi, mulenakila abalume benu ngefyo abanakila Imfumu bafwile ukulacita.

english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
translation: Bikeni imitima yenu pa fintu fya mu mulu, te pa fintu fya muno calo.

english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
translation: Mwe bana, mulenakila abafyashi benu lyonsefye, pantu ici ecisansamusha Imfumu.

english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
translation: Mwe bashibo, mwilakalifya abana benu imitima, epali banenuka.

english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
translation: Efe 4:22

english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
translation: Fyonse ifyo mulebomba, mulebomba ne mitima yenu yonse, kwati mulebombela Imfumu te bantu iyoo.

english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
translation: Muleibukisha ukuti Imfumu ikamupeela icilambu yalaya abantu baiko. Pantu Kristu e Shikulwinwe wine wine uo mubombela.

english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
translation: Na onse uwalufyanya akakandwa ukulingana no kulufyanya kwakwe, pantu Lesa taba na mucishacinani.

english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
translation: Pantu mwalifwa, ne myeo yenu yalifisama pamo na Kristu muli Lesa.

english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
translation: Umweo wenu uwacine cine ni Kristu. Ilyo akamoneka, na imwe mukamoneka pamo nankwe mu bucindami bwakwe.

english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
translation: Mufwile ukuleka ifwe imibeele yenu yonse iyabuntunse, iyili ngo bulalelale, ubupulumushi, ulunkumbwa lubi, amano yabi, ulunkumbwa lwa fyuma, pantu ulunkumbwa lwa fyuma e cimo ngo kupepa utulubi.

english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wa ifi fintu epo ubukali bwakwa Lesa bwishila abantu abashimunakila.

english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
translation: Na imwe bene e mibeele mwaleendelamo kale ilyo mwaleikala muli iyo misango.

english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
translation: Lelo nomba muli nokutaluka kuli fyonse ifili ngefi, ubukali, icipyu no lupato. Imwe tamufwile kutukana insele, nelyo ukulanda ilyashi ilibi.

english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
translation: Mwilabepana, pantu mwalifuma muli bumuntu bwakale na mu mibeele yabuko.

english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
translation: Mwe bashikulwibo, mulesunga abasha benu mu nshila isuma, kabili iyalungama. Muleibukisha ukuti na imwe bene mwalikwata Shikulwinwe mu mulu.

english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
translation: Alisitako, uo tuli nankwe mu cifungo amuposha, pamo na Mako umufyala wakwa Banaba. Eulya namwebele kale ukuti nga aisa uko mukamupokelele.

english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
translation: Yesu, kabili uwitwa Yusito, nao amuposha. Aba benefye batatu e Bayuda abasumina, ababomba na ine umulimo wa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, kabili ebankoseleshako nganshi.

english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
translation: Epafula, uwaba nao wa mwibumba lyenu kabili umusha wakwa Kristu Yesu, nao amuposha. Lyonsefye alamupepelako pa maka. Alomba Lesa ukuti mube abakosa mu cisumino, abapwililika, abashitwishika mu cisumino, kabili abanakila Lesa muli fyonse.

english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
translation: Ala ine wine ndi kambone pafyo abombesha pali imwe pamo na ba mu Hielapoli na Laodikea.

english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
translation: Luka shiŋanga wesu uo twatemwisha nganshi pamo na Dimasi bamuposha.

english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
translation: Muposhepo bamunyinefwe aba mu Laodikea, na Numfa no lukuta ululongana mu ŋanda mumwakwe.

english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
translation: Nga mwapwisha ukubelenga iyo kalata, mumone ukuti babelengela no lukuta lwa mu Laodikea. Elyo na imwe mukabelenge kalata yandi imbi iyikafuma ku Laodikea.

english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
translation: Kabili mwebe Akipo ukuti, afwile ukubikako amano ukupwisha umulimo untu apeelwe uwakubombela Imfumu.

english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
translation: Ine, ne Paulo, nalemba no kuboko kwandi aya mashiwi yakumuposha. Muleibukisha ukuti naba mu cifungo! Icikuuku cileba na imwe.

english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
translation: Mwilanenuka mukupepa. Mulebikako amano mukupepa, muletasha na Lesa.

english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
translation: Muletupepelako na ifwe bene, pakuti Lesa atupekanishishe inshila pakubila amashiwi ya nkaama yakwa Kristu. Ni pa mulandu wine uyu epo bamposela mu cifungo.

english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
translation: Eico kanshi mulepepa ukuti ndebila Imbila bwino bwino ngefyo mfwile ukucita.

english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
translation: Mulecenjela kufyo mulecita ku bantu abashasumina. Mulebomfya bwino ne nshita yonse iyo mwashukila.

english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
translation: Imilandile yenu ileba lyonse iyacikuuku ku bantu ne yakubafwilisha. Mwishibe ukwasuka cila muntu bwino bwino.

english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
translation: Munyinefwe uo twatemwa Tukiko, musha uwacetekelwa uubombela Imfumu pamo na ifwe, eukamweba fyonse pali ine.

english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
translation: Namutuma kuli imwe kukwisa musansamushako no kumwebako ifyo bonse tuli.

english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
translation: Efe 6:9

english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the message was true, even a great warfare. He understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.
translation: Mu mwaka wabutatu ilyo imfumu Sairasi yateekele icalo ca Pesia, kwaliko umulandu umo uo basokolwele kuli Daniele, uo baleita ne shina limbi ilya Beliteshasa. Uyo mulandu wali uwacishinka, nomba uwayafya nganshi ukumfwa umo walolele. Lelo Daniele aliwilwike no kuwishiba mu cimonwa.

english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
translation: Elyo iminwe imo yanjikata, yanjimya, na ine epakufukamako ninshi ninjikata na panshi, nalyo line ninshi ndeikankilafye.

english: He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.
translation: Elyo anjeba ati, “Iwe Daniele, ala Lesa alikutemwa. Iminina, ukutike bwino ifyo ine nalakweba. Ine ni kuli iwe ntuminwe.” Cilya alanda ifi, awe na ine naiminina, lelo kwena ninshi ncili ndeikankilafye.

english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.
translation: Ubuso 1:13-15

english: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”
translation: Ine njishile kukwisa kwishibishako ifikeshila abantu bobe kuntanshi. Pantu naco icimonwa ca fintu ifikabako kuntanshi.”

english: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.
translation: Cilya alanda aya mashiwi, ine nainamafye ukwabula ukulanda nelyo kamo.

english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.
translation: Elyo umo uwapala umuntu apopene ankumya pa milomo. Na ine epakutampa ukulanda, naeba uwaiminine apo ndi nati, “Mukwai, ici cintu namona, awe ine tepakuntiinya, kabili nacimpoka na maka.

english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”
translation: Ine ndifye ngo musha uwiminine pali shikulu wakwe. Ngakuti twalanda nobe shani? Ine amaka nayampwa, ndefilwa no kupema.”

english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”
translation: Ati nokuti, “Witiina, iwe we muntu uwatemwikwa, umutende ube na iwe, ukose kabili ube uwashipa.”

english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.
translation: Pali iyo ine nshita, ninshi ine ne Daniele ncili ndeloosha pa milungu itatu ituntulu.

english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
translation: Elyo nao ati, “Bushe nawishiba umulandu uundetele kuli iwe? Nombaline ine nalabwelelamo kukuya lwisha ulya kateeka wa calo ca Pesia. Ilyo nkafumako, elyo kukesa kateeka wa calo ca Bagiriki.

english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.
translation: Nomba pakubala nalakwebako ifyalembwa mu citabo ca fyacishinka. Ine nshakwata wakungafwako ukubalwisha nelyo umo, kanofye Mikaeli kateeka wa mushobo obe we Daniele.

english: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.
translation: Nalilekele ukulya icakulya icikankala, nalilekele ukulya inama, nshanwene nangu mwangashi, nshalesuba na mafuta, ukushintafye na pa kupwa kwa iyo milungu itatu.

english: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,
translation: Pa bushiku ubwalenga amakumi yabili na shine (24) ubwa mweshi wantanshi, ine naiminine mu lulamba lwa mumana ukulu uwa Tigilisi.

english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
translation: Kutifye cilya nainuna amenso, awe napulikilwafye umuntu umo, nao nafwala insalu ishatelela, nakaka na mu musana umushipi uwa golide uwine wine.

english: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.
translation: Umubili wakwe nao wali uwabengeshima nga kalibwe kamutengo kirisaliti. Impumi yakwe nayo yabeka ngo mwele wa nkuba, amenso yakwe nayo kwati myenge ya mulilo. Amaboko na molu yakwe yalebengeshima ngo mukuba uwapukushika, ne shiwi lyakwe kwati ciunda ca mashiwi ya bantu abali ibumba ilikalamba.

english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.
translation: Ine neka ne Daniele, nine namwene ico cimonwa. Abantu abo twali nabo bena tabacimwene iyoo, lelo kwena baliketwe no mwenso ukalamba, kanshi epakufulumuka, baya belama.

english: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.
translation: Nashalapofye neka, ninshi ncili ndetamba ico cintu icakupapa ico nalemona. Ninshi na maka nayapwa, icakuti na pa menso napalubana.

english: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.
translation: Cilya naumfwa uko uyo muntu alalanda, awe ine nawa panshi ubukupeme, napona na mu tulo utukalamba.

english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.
translation: “Na ine, mu mwaka wantanshi kukuteeka kwakwa Dariusi umwina Media naimine kukuba uwakumutungilila, kabili uwakumukoselesha.

english: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress.
translation: “Abana ba mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso bakapekanya ibumba ilikalamba ilya fita no kubusha inkondo. Bakalulunkana nge lyeshi ilyamaka mpaka ukufika na kwilinga lya balwani.

english: “The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.
translation: Elyo imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ikafulwa, ikemina imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ikaicimfya, ikacimfya ne bumba line ilikalamba ilya fita fyaiko.

english: The multitude will be carried off, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.
translation: Iyo mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ikalaitakisha pa mulandu wakucimfya ifita ifishaifulila, na pa mulandu wakwipaululapo ifita ifingi, lelo kwena ukucimfya kwaiko epo kukapelela.

english: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with abundant supplies.
translation: Pantu imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikabwelela mu calo caiko, no kuya longanya ifita ifingi ukucila na pafyo yali nafyo kale. Pa nshita iyalinga ikabwelelamo, ninshi lyena ikaya ne fita ifingi, ne fyanso nafyo ifingi.

english: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.
translation: “Pa nshita ilya abantu abengi bakasangukila imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Na mu mushobo obe wine iwe Daniele, ala mukabamo abantu bamo abakali abakasanguka pa mulandu wacimonwa ico bamwene, lelo kwena bakailetelelafye.

english: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.
translation: Kanshi imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikaya shinga umusumba we linga, no kupoka ikaupoka. Ifita fya calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kulyo tafyakatwalilile ukulwa inkondo iyoo. Nangufye ifita fya calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ifyacenjelesha, awe nafyo fine tafyakakwate amaka ayakushanshako nakalya.

english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.
translation: Uukaya basansa akabacita ifyo alefwaya, tapakamoneke uwakumulesha iyoo. Kabili akesa iteeka mu calo icawamisha pa fyalo fyonse, no kucimfya akacicimfya conse.

english: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.
translation: Imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikapekanya ifita fyaiko fyonse pakuyapoka icalo conse ica mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Nomba ikatala ikapande amano ayakumfwaninamo neyo mfumu. Ikatala ikatumine imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo mwane umwanakashi uwakuti ikope, epakuti ikamone umwakwipaila iyo mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, lelo kwena imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikaicushafye.

english: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.
translation: Elyo kabinge ikapilibukila mu lulamba lwa bemba na mu fishi mwine, no kuya sansa abantu abekalamo, no kucimfyamo abengi. Nomba mushika umo akansha iyo mfumu no kuipwisha icilumba.

english: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.
translation: Elyo iyo mfumu ikabwelela ku calo caiko, no kulaikala mu misumba yaiko iya malinga. Uko kwine eko bakainashisha no kuipoka ubufumu, no kuloba ninshi yaloba.

english: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.
translation: “Kanshi nomba kankwebe icacine. Imfumu shitatu eshikabala shikateeka icalo ca Pesia, elyo pakakonka iyalenga bune, yena ikakwatishapo ubukankala ukucila pa shinankwe. Ilyo ikakwatisha amaka ne fyuma, elyo ikalenga bonse ukwimina ubufumu bwa Bagiriki.

english: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.
translation: “Pa malo yaiko pakesa imfumu imbi. Yena ikatuma kasonkesha wamusonko pakuti ifyuma fyaiko fifulishe. Nomba pakapitafye akashita kanono ninshi akonaulwa, nomba tabakamwipaye ku mufulo nangu mu nkondo iyoo.

english: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
translation: “Imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso iyikakonkapo yena ikaba imfumu iyibi, ishakalinge na kuteeka abantu. Yena ikesa pumikishafye abantu, no kupoka ubufumu mu bucenjeshi.

english: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.
translation: Ifita ifikaicilima ikafipasanganya, ikafyonawila kumo kwine na cilolo wa cipangano.

english: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.
translation: Nangu iyo mfumu ikateekafye akamushobo ka bantu akanono, kwena ubufumu bwaiko bukakulilako, pantu ikalacita ubucenjeshi ubwakumfwana na bantu ba mitundu imbi.

english: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.
translation: Mukupumikisha ikasansa icitungu cimo icikankala nganshi ica mu calo, ico yaleumfwana naco kale, no kucitamo ifintu ifyo ifikolwe fyaiko fishabalile aficita. Ifyuma ifyo ikatapamo, ne fya bene ifyo ikebamo pa nshita ya nkondo, ikafipeelaika abantu abakalaikonka. Ikalapanga ukusansa imisumba ya malinga, nomba ni pa nshita inono.

english: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.
translation: “Ikapama ukwimya ibumba ilikalamba ilya fita pakuya lwisha imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, lelo kwena nayo ine imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ikapekanya ifita ifingi kabili ifyamaka ifyakulwa ne mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Lelo iyo mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo tayakashangileko, pantu abantu baiko bakaisangukila.

english: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.
translation: Abalya ne mfumu ifya kwisano ebakayonaula. Ibumba lyonse ilya fita fyaiko likapashika, ne fita fyaiko ifingi fikafwa mu nkondo.

english: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.
translation: Elyo isho imfumu shibili shikalila petebulo limo, lelo mu mitima yashiko shikalapingilana, kabili shikalalandafye ifyakubepana. Tashakashuke mufyo shikapanga ukucita, pantu ninshi inshita iyapimwa tailafika.

english: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.
translation: Imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikabwelelamo ku calo caiko, ikasenda fyonse ifyo ikatapa mu nkondo. Ikabwelela ku calo caiko ninshi ilepanga ukonaula icipangano camushilo. Lelo kwena ikatala yashala yabacitapo cimo ico itemenwe, elyo ikabwelelemo ku calo caiko.

english: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
translation: “Limbi kuntanshi ikabwelelako nakabili kukuya sansa icalo ca ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, nomba tacakabe ngefyo caleba kale.

english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
translation: “Elyo kukesa imfumu iyapambana. Yena ikateeka icalo icikulu, kabili ikalacitafye ifyo ilefwaya.

english: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.
translation: Pantu lyena aba ku Kitimu bakaya na mato yabo kukuya icincintila, nayo ikayatiina no kubwelelamo. Ikabwela ne cipyu no kwisa fulilwa abantu bakwa Lesa. Ikesa esha ukonaula icipangano icamushilo, pantu ikesa konkelela amano ya bantu abakasangukila icipangano camushilo.

english: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.
translation: Ifita fyaiko fimo fikesa kowesha Itempele lyakwa Lesa, kumo kwine na malinga yaliko. Fikalesha na malambo ayatulwa inshiku shonse, fikabikamo ne cintu icabunani kabili icabonaushi.

english: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.
translation: Iyo mfumu ikalacita amano pakusembeleka abantu abakalasuula icipangano camushilo, nomba abantu abaishiba Lesa awe bena bakashala umo bakosela ndi, no kukanya bakalakanya ne mfumu ine.

english: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
translation: Abamano ba muli abo bantu, bakalapandako abengi amano. Nomba pa kashita kamo, pali abo bantu bamo bakafwa ku nkondo, bamo bakafwa ku mulilo, bambi bakafwila muli bunkole, bambi bakafwila mukutapwa.

english: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.
translation: Ilyo bakacula, kukamoneka abakubakoseleshako panono, lelo kwena abengi bakaikumika uko bali mu bucenjeshi.

english: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.
translation: Abamano bamo bamo bakaipununa no kuwa, lelo cikalenga ukuti balopololwe, basangululwe kabili bawamishiwe ilyo inshita icilipo, pantu impela ikesa pa nshita iyo Lesa umwine apima.

english: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.
