translation: “Imfumu ikalacitilafye umo ilefwaila. Ikalaitakisha no kuisansabalika ukuti yena yalicila pa milungu yonse, ikalalanda na mashiwi ayakusuula Lesa Mukulu wine. Yena ikatwalilila ukushuka, mpakafye inshita yabukali ikapwe pantu ifyo Lesa apanga ukucita, fili nokucitika.

english: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.
translation: Iyo mfumu yena ikasuulilapo ne milungu ya fikolwe fyaiko, ikasuulilapo no mulungu wine uo abanakashi batemwa. Emukuti ikasuulilapo ne milungu yonsefye, pantu ikaisansabalika ukucila iyi milungu yonse.

english: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.
translation: Pa malo ya iyo milungu, ikapyanikilapo umulungu umo uwakulinda imisumba ya malinga, uo ifikolwe fyaiko fishaishibe. Yena e mulungu uo ikalatuula golide, na silifa, no tumabwe twamutengo, ne fintu fimbi ifikankala ifyo ikakwata.

english: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.
translation: Abenafyalo abakalapepa uyo mulungu, ebo imfumu ikapeela umulimo uwakulinda amalinga yaiko, na bakaisumina ukuti e mfumu yabo ebo ikapeela imilimo imbi iyacindamisha, no kubalambula impanga iyakuti emo bakaleikalila nge cilambu.

english: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.
translation: Nomba ikatilafye cilya yakwatisha amaka elyo ubufumu bwaiko bukonaika, bukakanishiwe mu tupinda tune, lelo tabwakapeelwe kuli bamwane iyoo, elyo kabili tabwakakwate na maka nga yalya akwete pantu ubufumu bwaiko bukafumishiwapo no kupeelwa kuli bambi.

english: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.
translation: “Ilyo ubufumu bwaiko bukalasumbila ukupwa, elyo imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ikaya sansa imfumu mbiye iya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, lelo nayo imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikemya amaceleta, ne fita fya pali bakabalwe na mato ayengi, no kulwisha pa maka imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikengilila ifyalo kwati lyeshi, no kufipupanya ikafipupanya.

english: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
translation: Ikengilila ne calo icawamisha pali fyonse, no kwipaululamo abantu amakana na makana. Lelo icalo ca bena Edomu, ne ca bena Moabu, ne ntungulushi sha bena Amoni, fyena fikapusukako.

english: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.
translation: Ikasansa ifyalo ifingi, ne calo ca Egupto cine tacakapusukeko.

english: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.
translation: Mu Egupto ikasendamo ifyuma ifyafiswa ifya golide ne fya silifa, kumo kwine ne fintu fimbi ifyamutengo ifyabamo. Ikacimfya na bena Libya na bena Kushi .

english: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
translation: Nomba intulubundi sha ku kabanga ne sha ku kapinda ka ku kuso shikaitiinya, kanshi ikalalwisha inkondo cipyu cipyu, no kulaipaya abantu abengi.

english: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
translation: Ikabika amatenti yaiko ayakulu kabili ayacindama pakati uku ni bemba, uku nako lupili ulwayemba kabili ulwamushilo. Awe no kufwa epo ikafwila, ukwabula nelyo umo uwakuti ayafweko.”

english: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.
translation: “Imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ikaba iyamaka. Nomba mushika umo uwa fita fyaiko akacisha imfumu amaka, no buteko bwakwe bukacilapo, ne calo ico uyo mushika akalateeka cikacilapo ubukulu.

english: At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement, but she will not retain the strength of her arm. He will also not stand, nor will his arm; but she will be given up, with those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.
translation: Panuma ya myaka imo imo, bakacita icipangano. Umwana umukashana wa mfumu ya mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kulyo bakamufya ku mfumu ya calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso pakuti baleumfwana. Lelo takakwate amaka ne cumfwano cabo tacakaye patali, pantu umukashana wine pamo na babomfi bakwe abo akasenda pamo pene na mwane, bakabepaya bonse, bakepaila kumo kwine no wamukoseleshe.

english: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.
translation: “Elyo umwaume umo pa ba lupwa lwa uyu mwanakashi akasansa ifita fya mfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, akabengilila mwilinga no kubacimfya.

english: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.
translation: Akasenda ne milungu yabo, akasenda ifilubi fya cela kumo ne fintu fyabo ifyamutengo ifya golide ne fya silifa, no kufitwala akafitwala ku Egupto. Pakapita imyaka imo imo iyakuikalila ku matwi tondolo, takalaimina imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.
translation: Elyo imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ikaya sansa imfumu ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, nomba bakaya ifulumunako.

english: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
translation: “We Daniele, pali iyo nshita akafika kateeka mukalamba uwitwa Mikaeli uulinda abantu bobe. Kukaba inshita yabulanda ubwabipisha ubushabala abumoneka ukufumafye apo imishobo ya bantu yatendekele ukubapo. Ni muli iyi nshita emo abantu bobe bonse abo amashina yabo yalembwa mu citabo cakwa Lesa bakapusuka.

english: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.
translation: Ubuso 22:10

english: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
translation: Ubuso 22:11

english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
translation: Balishuka abantu abakashipikisha inshiku ikana limo ne myanda itatu na makumi yatatu na shisano (1,335).

english: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
translation: Lelo iwe Daniele kabiye. Ukafwa, lelo ukashukuka pakuti ukapoke cilambu cobe ilintu ikafika inshita iyo ifintu fikapwilapo.”

english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
translation: Cinkupiti wa bantu pali balya abalala utwamfwa bakashukuka. Bamo ku mweo wamuyayaya, bambi ni kukuba ne nsoni pamo no kusekwa umuyayaya.

english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
translation: Lelo abamano bakalabengeshima ngo lubuuto lwa mu mulu, na balya abafundile abantu ukucita ifyabulungami bakalabeka nge ntanda.

english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”
translation: Nomba we Daniele isala no kukakatika icitabo icipombwa ukufika ku nshita ilintu ifintu fikapwilapo. Abantu abengi bakasabanta uku noku, na mano yakafulilako.”

english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.
translation: Elyo ne Daniele namwene abantu babili nabeminina umo ku bushilya bwa mumana na umbi ku bushilya bubiye.

english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”
translation: Elyo umuntu uwaiminine akatalamukila abilikisha uwafwele insalu ishatelela uwali ku mulu wa mumana ati, “Bushe ni nshita nshi ikapitapo pakuti ifi fintu ifyakupapa fikafikilishiwe?”

english: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti nelyo naleumfwa ifyo uyo muntu alelanda nshaleiluka, namwipwishe nati, “Mukwai, bushe finshi fikatumbuka muli ifi fintu?”

english: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
translation: Nao atile, “Daniele, kabiye pantu ayo mashiwi nayesalilwa no kukakatikwa ukufika ku nshita iyo ifintu fikapwilapo.

english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
translation: Mu mwaka wabutatu ilintu imfumu Yehoyakimu yaleteeka icalo ca bena Yuda, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya Babiloni aishile sansa no kushinguluka umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
translation: Kanshi Daniele epakuya kuli kalinda untu Ashipenasi asontele ukulasunga Daniele, Hanania, Mishaeli pamo na Asaria, no kumweba ati,

english: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
translation: “Napapata ifwe fwe babomfi bobe utweshe pa nshiku ikumi limo. Uletupeelakofye umusalu nge cakulya elyo na menshi nge cakunwa.

english: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”
translation: Panuma ukalinganye imimonekele yesu ne ya balumendo abakulalya no kunwa ifya kwisano, elyo ukapingule ukulingana nefyo tukalamoneka.”

english: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
translation: Kalinda alisumine ukubesha pa nshiku ikumi limo.

english: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.
translation: Panuma ya nshiku ikumi limo imibili yabo yali iyalelema kabili balemoneka abaina ukucila na banabo abalelya ifya kwisano.

english: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.
translation: Kanshi kalinda epakufumyapo ifyakulya ifisuma no mwangashi ifyapeelwe kuli bena, atwalilile ukubapeela umusalu pamo na menshi.

english: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
translation: Panuma ya myaka itatu iyapiminwe ukulingana ne cipope ca mfumu, Ashipenasi cilolo mukalamba atwele abalumendo bonse kuli Nebukadinesa.

english: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore stood they before the king.
translation: Ilintu imfumu yapwile ukulanda na balumendo bonse yamwene ukuti Daniele, Hanania, Mishaeli na Asaria bali na mano ukucila abalumendo bambi, eico yabasontele ukubombela kwisano.

english: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
translation: Imfumu Lesa alekele Nebukadinesa acimfye Yehoyakimu no kusende fipe fimo ifya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Kabili asendele bankole no kubatwala ku Babilonia , ne fipe ifyo asendele ailefibika mu ŋanda umo alepepela umulungu wakwe.

english: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.
translation: Mu milandu yonse iyakuma ku mano na kukwishiba ifyo imfumu yalebepusha calemoneka ukuti aba balumendo bane bali abacenjela ukucila abantu bonse abalecita ifyakupendula pamo na bacita fyakusobela mu calo conse ico yaleteeka.

english: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.
translation: Daniele ena alitwalilile ukwikala kwisano ukushinta na mu mwaka Sairasi atendeke ukuteeka.

english: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
translation: Elyo imfumu Nebukadinesa yakonkomeshe Ashipenasi, cilolo mukalamba wa mu cilye, ukuti pali bankole abena Israeli asalepo abalumendo aba mu lupwa lwabufumu pamo na mu ndupwa ishacindama.

english: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.
translation: Abo balumendo balingile ukuba abayemba pa finso, abashakwata kalema, abashilimuka muli fyonse, abasalapuka mu fyakusambilila kabili abayanguka ukwishiba fintu, abakuti baba abalinga ukubomba kwisano. Ashipenasi wine ewali nokulabasambilisha ukubelenga pamo no kulemba ululimi lwa bena Kaludea .

english: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
translation: Pa balumendo abasalilwe pali Daniele, Hanania, Mishaeli pamo na Asaria aba ku luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
translation: Esaya 39:7-8

english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
translation: Daniele ena asalilepo ukukanaikowesha ku cakulya pamo no mwangashi wa kwisano, apapatile Ashipenasi, cilolo mukalamba ukuti amusuminishe ukukanaikowesha.

english: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
translation: Nomba Lesa alenga Ashipenasi, cilolo mukalamba wa mu cilye, ukulangulukilako Daniele no kumukwatila inkumbu.

english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
translation: Mu mwaka wabubili uwa kuteeka kwakwe, Nebukadinesa alilotele ifiloto. Ifyo filoto fyalimusakamike icakuti afilwa no kulala utulo.

english: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.
translation: Abena Kaludea abamano baebele imfumu abati, “Takuli muntu nelyo umo pano isonde mulopwe uwingacita ico uleipusha kabili takwatala akuba imfumu iyaipushapo ici uleipusha ukufuma ku bantu abapendula na bacita ifyakusobela ifikesa na bacita ifyamalele pamo ne fyakubuka.

english: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”
translation: Umulandu untu uleipusha mulopwe nawafya, teti pabe umuntu uwingashimbwila imfumu, kanofye imilungu iyishikala na bantu.”

english: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.
translation: Pakumfwa ifi, imfumu yalifulilwe no kukalipa apakalamba, yakonkomesha nokuti abamano bonse mu Babiloni bepaiwe.

english: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
translation: Kanshi epakutuma icipope icakwipaya abamano bonse, kumo kwine na Daniele na banankwe bene.

english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.
translation: Ilintu Alioki mushika wa fita fya mfumu alepekanya ukwima ukuya aleipaya abamano mu Babiloni, Daniele aile kuli ena mu musango usuma kabili uwamano.

english: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
translation: Aipwishe mushika ati, “Cinshi ico imfumu yafumishe icipope ici icalukakala?” Elyo Alioki alondolwele fyonse kuli Daniele.

english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
translation: Elyo Daniele aile ku mfumu no kulomba inshita pakuti alondolole iciloto caiko.

english: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
translation: Daniele abwelele ku ŋanda kumwakwe no kulondolola umulandu ku banankwe Hanania, Misheki na Asaria.

english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
translation: Abacincishe ukupapata ukuti Lesa wa ku mulu abacitile inkumbu pa mulandu wa cipeshamano ici kukuleka bena pamo na bamano mu Babiloni beipaiwa.

english: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
translation: Pali ubo bwine bushiku pa nshita ya bushiku iciloto calisokolwelwe kuli Daniele mu cimonwa. Elyo Daniele alumbenye Lesa wa ku mulu ati,

english: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu yatumine abakufwaya abantu abapendula, abacita ifyakusobela, na bacita ifyamalele pamo ne fyakubuka, na bena Kaludea abamano pakuti bese balondolwele imfumu ifi ifiloto yalotele. Kanshi nabo epakwisa baisa iminina ku cinso ca mfumu.

english: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.
translation: “Ishina lyakwa Lesa lipaalwe pe na pe,

english: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.
translation: Eupilibula inshita pamo ne myaka,

english: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
translation: Ni Lesa eusokolola ifyaba umwashika ne nkaama shine,

english: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”
translation: Nakutotela kabili nakulumbanya we Lesa wa fikolwe fyandi,

english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”
translation: Daniele aile kuli Alioki untu imfumu yasontele ukwipaya abamano aba mu musumba wa Babiloni, no kumweba ati, “Wiipaya abamano aba mu Babiloni. Ntwala ku mfumu nje nondolole umwalola iciloto.”

english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”
translation: Awe Alioki atwele Daniele ku mfumu no kuyeba ati, “Ninsanga umo uwa muli bankole, umwina Yuda, uwingamulondolwela iciloto cenu.”

english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”
translation: Imfumu yaipwishe Daniele (uwaishibikwe nga Beliteshasa) aiti, “Bushe iwe kuti wanondolwela pamo no kunshimbwila iciloto candi?”

english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;
translation: Daniele nao ayaswike ati, “Mulopwe kanabesa, pa bantu bonse abamano, abacite fyamalele ne fyakusobela ifikesa, na bapendula nelyofye bakabuka, tekuti pabe nangu umo uwingakulondolwela uyu mulandu.

english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:
translation: Lelo eko aba Lesa mu mulu uusokolola ifyankaama. Uyu wine eulekusokolwela ifyalaswa ficitike, we mfumu Nebukadinesa. Kanshi iciloto cobe ne cimonwa wamwene ku tulo nifi.

english: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.
translation: “Ilintu mwali mu tulo, mulopwe, no kulota pa mulandu wa fintu ifyalaswa ficitike, Lesa uusokolola ifyankaama alemwishibisha ifintu ifili nokupona.

english: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yabeba aiti, “Nalilotele iciloto icilensakamika, ndefwaya ukwishiba umo cilolele.”

english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.
translation: Ici cimonwa tacisokolwelwe kuli ine pa mulandu wakuti nalicila bonse abamano, lelo ni pakuti iwe kanabesa wishibe umulolele iciloto cobe no kwiluka pa mulandu wa matontonkanyo yobe.

english: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.
translation: “Mulopwe ilyo walele walotele icimpashanya ca muntu uushaikulila kabili icabeka nganshi naciminina ku cinso cobe. Cali icakutiinya mukumoneka.

english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,
translation: Umutwe waciko wali uwa golide wine wine, icifuba na maboko fyaciko fyali ifya silifa, elyo ifumo na matanta fyena fyali ifya mukuba.

english: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.
translation: Amolu yaciko yali aya cela, amakasa yena yali aya cela icasakaniwa ne bumba.

english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.
translation: Ilintu wali ulelolekesha, wamwene icimokolwa ca cilibwe ukwabula umuntu uwakucimokola. Neco cimokolwa ca cilibwe caishile fwanta icimpashanya pa makasa aya cela icasakaniwa ne bumba, nayo yalitobaike.

english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
translation: Icela, ibumba, umukuba, silifa pamo na golide wine wine fyasansaika, ukwaluka nge misungu ya male. Umwela nao wafyulula icakuti tapashele nelyo kamo. Kumfwa icimokolwa ca cilibwe icafwantile ici cimpashanya ca cimuntu, casangwike ulupili ulukalamba no kukumana pesonde ponse.

english: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.
translation: “Ifi efyali ciloto cintu mulopwe walotele nomba twalashimbula umo cilolele.

english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.
translation: Kanabesa iwe niwe imfumu iyacila ishamfumu shonse. Lesa wa ku mulu alikupeela ubufumu, amaka, ubucindami pamo no bukata.

english: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.
translation: Kabili alikupeela bukateeka pa bantu bonse ne nama sha mpanga ne fyuni fya mu lwelele. Konse uko fikala alifipeela mu maboko yobe ukuti uleba kateeka wafiko. Icilepilibula ukuti niwe mutwe wa golide.

english: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
translation: “Panuma ya bufumu bobe pakakonka ubufumu bwacibili ubwacepako. Elyo kabili pakakonke ubufumu bwalenga citatu ubwa mukuba ubukateeke sonde lyonse.

english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
translation: Elyo Abena Kaludea abamano bayasuka imfumu mu lulimi lwa Ciaramaiki ati, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya. Twebeko iciloto fwe babomfi bobe pakuti tukushimbwile.”

english: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.
translation: Elyo pakese ubufumu bumbi ubwabune ubwakosa pamo nge cela. Nga filya fine icela citobaula no konaula ifintu fimbi efyo ubu bufumu bukesa onaula ubufumu bonse ubwantanshi.

english: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.
translation: Nga filya fine wamwene mu ciloto amakasa ne fikondo fyali fya cela icasakaniwa ne bumba efyo ubo bufumu bukaba ubwapatukana.

english: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.
translation: Pamo nga fintu wamwene ifikondo fyali ifya cela icasakaniwa ne bumba, efyo ubu bufumu bukaba ubwakosa lubali lumo kabili ubwanaka lubali lumbi.

english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.
translation: Elyo kabili fintu wamwene, ukusakanishiwa kwa cela ne bumba cilelola mukuti abantu ba mu bufumu bakasankana nga filya ciba mu cupo lelo tabakabe abaikatana, pamo nga fintu icela tafikatana bwino ne bumba.

english: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.
translation: “Mu nshita ilyo isho shine imfumu shikalateeka, Lesa wa ku mulu akaletapo ubufumu bumo ubushakonaike nangu ukupeelwa mu minwe ya bantu bambi. Bukashonaula no kupwisha amaka ya shamfumu shonse kabili bwena ebukabelelela pe na pe.

english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”
translation: Filya wamwene icimokolwa ca cilibwe ukufuma pa lupili ukwabula umuntu wacimokwele, caisa tobaula icela, umukuba, ibumba, silifa pamo na golide ifyo babumbileko icimpashanya, emo Lesa mukulu alekulangila ifyalaswa ficitike. Iciloto ici cacine cine no kushimbulwa kwaciko kwacishinka.”

english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa awile panshi mukutotela Daniele. Akonkomesha ukuti batuule umutuulo kuli Daniele no kumufutumwina ububani.

english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Nebukadinesa yatile kuli Daniele, “Cine cine Lesa obe e Lesa uwapulamo pa milungu yonse, e mfumu ukucila ishamfumu shonse kabili ena eusokolola ifyankaama fyonse pantu naulondolola umulandu onse.”

english: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.
translation: Elyo imfumu yalashike Daniele pa bufumu no kumutuula ifyabupe fingi. Yamucitile ukuba umulashi mukalamba mu citungu conse ica Babiloni kabili kangalila wa bamano bonse aba ku Babiloni.

english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.
translation: Nomba Nebukadinesa acitile Shadiraki, Mesheki na Abedinego ukuba bakangalila ba citungu ca Babiloni ukulingana nefyo Daniele amulombele, lelo Daniele ena atwalilile ukusangwa kwisano.

english: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaasuka abena Kaludea abamano aiti, “Ishibeni ifyo mpangile ukucita. Nga cakuti imwe mwafilwa ukunjeba iciloto candi pamo no kushimbula iciloto cine ico, ndemuputaula no kubongolola amayanda yenu pakuti pashalefye ifitantala.

english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwanjeba iciloto cine no kushimbula umo cilolele, ndemupeela ifyabupe ifikalamba no kumucindamika apakalamba. Eico kanshi njebeni iciloto nalotele nomo cilolele.”

english: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka imfumu nakabili abati, “Twebe iciloto fwe babomfi bobe pakuti tucishimbule.”

english: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.
translation: Icite 41:8

english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”
translation: Nga mwafilwa ukunjeba iciloto ninshi palifye ubupingushi bumo pali imwe. Namusuminishanya ukunjeba amashiwi yabucenjeshi na yabufi pakuti muleke inshita ipite. Aleni njebeni iciloto elyo nalaishiba ukuti kanshi kuti mwalondolola na muntu cilolele.”

english: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
translation: Imfumu Nebukadinesa yapangishe icimpashanya kuli golide icali amakubiti amakumi mutanda (60) mumulu, na mubufumo cali amakubiti mutanda, no kucimika mu nika ya Dula mu citungu ca Babiloni.

english: You, O king, have made a decree that every man who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music shall fall down and worship the golden image;
translation: Walipeela icipope we mfumu, icakuti umuntu onse nga aumfwa amapenga, amasese, amapango, indiyele, insango, umutolilo pamo ne misango imbi iya filimba alingile ukuwa panshi kukushinshimuna icimpashanya ca golide.

english: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.
translation: Kabili watile umuntu onse uwakaana ukuwa panshi kukushinshimuna, akaposwa mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, and don’t worship the golden image which you have set up.”
translation: Lelo kuli Abayuda abo walashika ukwangalila icitungu ca Babiloni, pamo nga Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego, abashinakile ifunde lyobe we mfumu. Bena tababombela imilungu yobe nelyo ukushinshimuna icimpashanya ca golide cintu waimika.”

english: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king.
translation: Ilintu Nebukadinesa aumfwile, aiswilemo icipyu no bukali, epakutuma abakuleta Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego. Elyo baleta aba bantu pa cinso ca mfumu.

english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa abepwishe ati, “Bushe cishinka ukuti imwe Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego tamubombela imilungu yandi nelyo kushinshimuna icimpashanya ica golide cintu naimika?

english: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands?”
translation: Ukufuma lelo nga cakuti mwaumfwa amapenga, amasese, amapango, indiyele, insango, umutolilo pamo ne misango imbi iya filimba, nga mwawa panshi no kushinshimuna icimpashanya ico napangisha ninshi cawama. Lelo nga cakuti mwakaana, mukaposwa mwilungu lya mulilo. Nga mulungu nshi uwingamupokolola ukufuma mu maboko yandi?”

english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
translation: Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego bayaswike Nebukadinesa ati, “Mulopwe, ifwe tatulekabila ukuipokolola muli uyu mulandu pa cinso cobe.

english: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
translation: Nga cakuti twaposwa mwilungu lya mulilo, Lesa untu tubombela kuti atupususha kabili kuti atupokololako ukufuma mu maboko yobe we mfumu.

english: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
translation: Nelyofye Lesa wesu tatupuswishe, we mfumu tulefwaya wishibe ukuti tatuli nokubombela imilungu yobe nelyo ukushinshimuna icimpashanya ca golide ico waimika.”

english: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.
translation: Ubukali buntu Nebukadinesa akwete pali Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego bwalicililemo icakuti ne cinso cakwe cayaluka. Akonkomesha ukuti ilungu lya mulilo balikafye imiku cine lubali ukucila fintu balikafya mu nshiku shimbi,

english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
translation: Elyo imfumu Nebukadinesa yakonkomeshe bonse abali pali bukateeka bwa fitungu, bamushika, abalashi, bashicilye, bakasunga wa fipao, bakapingula, bakabaka wa mafunde ya calo, pamo pene na bakalamba bonse aba mu fitungu ukusangwa ku kushinshimuna kwa cimpashanya imfumu Nebukadinesa yaimike.

english: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
translation: no kweba bamo pa mpalume sha bashilika bakwe ukukaka Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego pakuti baposwe mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
translation: Elyo abashilika bakakile abo balumendo ninshi nabafwala insalu, imingila, ifisote pamo ne fyakufwala fyabo fimbi, no kubaposa mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.
translation: Pa mulandu wa cebo ca mfumu, ilungu lya mulilo balilikafishe ukufika ku cipimo icakuti ulubingu lwa mulilo lwaipeye abashilika abaleposa Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
translation: Na aba balumendo batatu baponene mwilungu lya mulilo ninshi nabakakwa.

english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste. He spoke and said to his counselors, “Didn’t we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire?” They answered the king, “True, O king.”
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa imfumu acilimwike no kupapa, elyo atile kuli bampandamano bakwe, “Bushe te bantu batatu tukakile no kuposa mu mulilo?” Bampandamano batile, “Ee kanabesa.”

english: He answered, “Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed. The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.”
translation: Kabili atile, “Moneni, muli abantu bane abaleendauka mu mulilo, no kukakwa tabakakilwe nelyo kupya, kabili uwabune alemoneka ngo mwana wa milungu.”

english: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!” Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out of the middle of the fire.
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa apalamine pa mwinshi ati, “Shadiraki, Mesheki na Abedinego, mwe babomfi bakwa Lesa uwapulamo, fumeni iseni kuno.”

english: The local governors, the deputies, and the governors, and the king’s counselors, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power on their bodies. The hair of their head wasn’t singed. Their pants weren’t changed. The smell of fire wasn’t even on them.
translation: kabili bamushika, abalashi, bashicilye pamo na bampandamano bali bashingulwikwe, no kushininkisha ukuti umulilo tawaocele mibili yabo, nelyo mushishi wa ku mitwe yabo tawababwike, ne fyakufwala fyabo tafyapile kabili tapanunkile nangu cushi ca mulilo pa mibili yabo.

english: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God.
translation: Elyo Nebukadinesa alandile ati, “Napaalwe na matotelo Lesa wakwa Misheki, Shadiraki na Abedinego uutumine malaika wakwe kukupokolola ababomfi bakwe. Batetekele Lesa wabo ukucila kunakila cipope ca mfumu, kabili bali abaipekanya ukufwa ukucila ukubombela nelyo ukupepa umulungu umbi.

english: Therefore I make a decree that every people, nation, and language which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill, because there is no other god who is able to deliver like this.”
translation: “Eico nabika icipope icakuti abantu aba luko ululi lonse pamo no lulimi ululi lonse abalepontela Lesa wakwa Shadiraki, Mesheki na Abedinego basantaulwe na mayanda yabo yabongololwe, pantu takwaba Lesa umbi uwingapususha umuntu muli uyu musango.”

english: Then the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
translation: Ecalengele ukuti abali pali bukateeka bwa fitungu, bamushika, abalashi, bashicilye, bakasunga wa fipao, bakapingula, bakabaka wa mafunde ya calo pamo pene na bakalamba bonse aba mu fitungu balongane mukutuula icimpashanya ico Nebukadinesa abumbile. Na bonse baisa iminina ku ntanshi yaciko.

english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.
translation: Awe imfumu yapeela Shadiraki, Misheki na Abedinego imilimo iyacindama mu citungu ca Babiloni.

english: Then the herald cried aloud, “To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages,
translation: Elyo kabilisha wa mafunde abilikisha ukuti, “Ifi efyo bamukonkomesha ukucita, mwe bantu bonse ne mishobo yonse pamo na bantu aba ndimi ishalekana lekana shonse.

english: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.
translation: Nga cakuti mwaumfwa amapenga, amasese, amapango, indiyele, insango, umutolilo pamo ne misango imbi iya filimba, mulingile ukuwa panshi kukushinshimuna icimpashanya ca golide ico Nebukadinesa imfumu yaimika.

english: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”
translation: Kumfwa umuntu onse uwakaana ukuwa panshi kukucishinshimuna, akaposwa mwilungu lya mulilo apopene.”

english: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
translation: Ecalengele ukuti pa nshita ilya ine baumfwile amapenga, amasese, amapango, indiyele, insango, umutolilo pamo ne misango imbi iya filimba, abantu bonse ne mishobo yonse pamo na bantu aba ndimi ishalekana lekana bawile panshi kukushinshimuna icimpashanya ca golide ico Nebukadinesa imfumu yaimike.

english: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near and brought accusation against the Jews.
translation: Abena Kaludea bamo bamo abali pali bukateeka bwa calo basebele Abayuda.

english: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, live for ever!
translation: Batile ku mfumu Nebukadinesa, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya.

english: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.
translation: Imfumu Nebukadinesa yatumine amashiwi ku bantu aba mishobo yonse abalanda indimi shalekana lekana aiti, “Mutende bonse.

english: These were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.
translation: “Ifi e fimonwa ifyo namwene lintu nalele pa musengele wandi, naliloleshe no kumona icimuti icishailepela pakati ka calo. Ubutali bwaciko bwali ubwapulamo.

english: The tree grew and was strong. Its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth.
translation: Ici cimuti calekula no kukosa mpaka cafika mu lwelele, na bantu bonse pano isonde balecimona.

english: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
translation: Amabula yaciko yali ayalelema, ne fisabo ifingi ifyakukumana abantu bonse. Mwisamba lyaciko emwaletuusha inama sha mpanga kabili ne fyuni fya mu lwelele fyaleikala mu misambo yaciko. Ne fibumbwa fyonse ku cimuti eko fyalelya.

english: “I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a holy watcher came down from the sky.
translation: “Mu cimonwa, ninshi nindala pa musengele, nasanswile amenso no kumona malaika uwamushilo alefuma mu mulu.

english: He cried aloud and said this: ‘Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches! Shake off its leaves and scatter its fruit! Let the animals get away from under it and the birds from its branches.
translation: Abilikishe ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, ‘Temeni icimuti muputaule ne misambo, mupulule na mabula yaciko kabili mupulule ne fisabo fyaciko. Lekeni ne nama shifulumuke mwisamba lyaciko ne fyuni fifume mu misambo.

english: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals in the grass of the earth.
translation: Lelo lekeni icishiki icashingulukwa ne cela pamo no mukuba cishale mu cani ca mu mpanga, elyo imishila yaciko ishale mu mushili wa mu calo. Lekeni umume wa mu mulu ubomfye uyu muntu, lekeni ekale ne nama pakati ka filimwa fya pano isonde.

english: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him. Then let seven times pass over him.
translation: Lekeni amano yakwe yapilibuke ukufuma ku mano ya buntu kabili apeelwe amano ya bunama pa myaka cine lubali.

english: “‘The sentence is by the decree of the watchers and the demand by the word of the holy ones, to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.’
translation: Efyo fwe bamalaika twaputula umulandu pakuti abamweo beshibe ukuti Uwapulamo ateeka pa bufumu bwa bantu kabili abupeela kubo atemenwe kabili alalashikapo na bacepeshapo.’

english: “This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”
translation: “Ici e ciloto ico ine ne mfumu Nebukadinesa ndotele. Nomba Beliteshasa nondolwela muntu cilolele pantu tapali nelyo umo pa bantu ba mu bufumu bwandi uwinganondolwela. Lelo iwe kuti walondolola ico umupashi wa milungu iyamushilo waba muli iwe.”

english: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, “Belteshazzar, don’t let the dream or the interpretation, trouble you.” Belteshazzar answered, “My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries.
translation: Pakubala Daniele uwaleitwa Beliteshasa alisungwike icakuti afilwa ukulanda, na matontonkanyo yakwe yamutiinya. Elyo imfumu yasosa ati, “We Beliteshasa shipikisha, wileka iciloto no bupilibulo bwaciko fikusakamike.”

english: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.
translation: “Ndi ne nsansa pakumwishibishako ifipapwa pamo ne fipeshamano ifyo Lesa uwapulamo ancitila.

english: The tree that you saw, which grew and was strong, whose height reached to the sky and its sight to all the earth;
translation: Icimuti mwacimona, icacikula no kukosa ne mpela yaciko yafika na mu lwelele no kumoneka ku bantu ba mwisonde lyonse,

english: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation—
translation: na mabula ayalelema kabili ne fisabo ifingi ifyakwafwilisha ifyamweo fyonse, no kupeela icintelelwe ku nama sha mpanga kabili no kupeela ifyuni umwakupangila ifisansala,

english: it is you, O king, that have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
translation: nimwe mwe mfumu! Ubucindami bwenu mwe mfumu nabukula no kukosa, elyo ubukulu bwenu nabufika mu lwelele, kabili ubuteeko bwenu nabufika na mu fyalo fya kutali pano isonde.

english: “Whereas the king saw a holy watcher coming down from the sky and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.’
translation: Mwe mfumu mwamwene malaika wamushilo alefuma ku mulu aletila, ‘Temeni icimuti kabili conauleni, lelo lekeni icishiki icashingulukwa ne cela pamo no mukuba cishale mu cani ca mu mpanga, elyo imishila yaciko ishale mu mushili wa mu calo. Lekeni umume wa mu mulu ubomfye uyo muntu, lekeni ekale nge nama sha mpanga mpaka imyaka cine lubali ikapite pali ena.’

english: “This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:
translation: “Ubu e bupilibulo bwa ciloto mwe mfumu. Uwapulamo eupingwile ukuti ici ciponene pali shikulu wandi imfumu,

english: You will be driven from men and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You will be made to eat grass as oxen, and will be wet with the dew of the sky, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.
translation: mukatamfiwa ukufuma ku bantu no kuya ikala ne nama sha mpanga. Mukalalya icani nge ŋombe no kubomfiwa ku mume wa mu mulu. Imyaka cine lubali ikapita mpaka mukasumine ukuti Uwapulamo ewateeka pa bufumu bwa bantu kabili abupeela ku muntu atemenwe.

english: Whereas it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be sure to you after you know that Heaven rules.
translation: Icebo cakusha icishiki ca cimuti ne mishila yaciko, calola mukuti ubufumu bwenu bakamubwesesha nga mwasumina ukuti Uwa mu mulu euteeka isonde lyonse.

english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.”
translation: Ecalenga mwe mfumu konkeni amano aya ndemupandako. Yebeleleni imembu shenu ukupitila mukucita ubulungami, kabili muyebelele ububifi bwenu ukupitila mukuba ne nkumbu ku bantu abatitikishiwa elyo ubucindami bwenu bukatwalilila.”

english: All this came on the King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation: Fyonse ifi fyalifikilishiwe ku mfumu Nebukadinesa.

english: At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.
translation: Panuma ya myeshi ikumi limo na ibili (12), ilintu imfumu yaleenda pa mutenge we sano lya mu Babiloni,

english: How great are his signs! How mighty are his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. His dominion is from generation to generation.
translation: “We fishibilo ulakula,

english: The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”
translation: yatile, “We Babiloni nobe ulakula. Nakukuulile ku maka yandi ukuba isano lyandi pakuti ukucindama kwandi kumoneke.”

english: While the word was in the king’s mouth, a voice came from the sky, saying, “O King Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken: ‘The kingdom has departed from you.
translation: Kutifye talapwa na kulanda, ishiwi lyafumine ku mulu aliti, “We mfumu Nebukadinesa, ici e cipope ca pali iwe, amaka yobe ayabufumu nayapokwa.

english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.’”
translation: Walatamfiwa ukufuma ku bantu bobe no kuya ikala ne nama sha mpanga wakulalya icani nge ŋombe. Imyaka cine lubali ikapita mpaka ukasumine ukuti Uwapulamo ewateeka pa bufumu bwa bantu kabili abupeela ku muntu atemenwe.”

english: This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men and ate grass like oxen; and his body was wet with the dew of the sky until his hair had grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.
translation: Apopene conse icasoselwe kuli Nebukadinesa cafikilishiwe. Alitamfiwe ukufuma ku bantu kabili alelya icani nge ŋombe. Umubili wakwe walebomfiwa ku mume wa mu mulu mpaka ubupipi bwakulile kwati masako ya kapumpe, kabili ingala shakwe shalepele nga mala ya cuni.

english: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.
translation: “Ilintu inshita yafikile, ine ne Nebukadinesa nainwine amenso no kulolesha ku mulu, amano yandi yalibwelele. Elyo nalumbenye Uwapulamo. Napeele umucinshi pamo no lulumbi ku waba no mweo pe na pe.

english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.
translation: “Ine ne mfumu Nebukadinesa nali mu ŋanda yandi iye sano, kabili nali umutende ne fyuma ifingi.

english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
translation: Nalilotele iciloto icandetele umwenso. Ilyo nasendeme pa busanshi bwandi, ifyakwelenganya ne fimonwa ifyalepita mu mano yandi fyalimpeele umwenso.

english: Therefore I made a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
translation: Ecalengele ukuti mpeele icipope icakuti bonse abamano mu Babiloni bese banondolwele umwalolele iciloto.

english: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told them the dream, but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.
translation: Ilyo abapendula na abacita ifyakusobela pamo na bamalele na bena Kaludea abamano nabebele iciloto candi nabo balifililwe ukucilondolola.

english: But at last, Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,
translation: Kumfwa ilintu Daniele, uwitwa Beliteshasa ishina lya mulungu wandi, aishile ku cinso candi namushimikile iciloto candi. Muli ena mwaliba umupashi wa milungu iyamushilo .

english: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.
translation: “Natile, ‘Iwe Beliteshasa we mukalamba wa bakapendula, ninjishiba ukuti umupashi wa milungu iyamushilo waba muli iwe kabili takuli icankaama icingakwansha. Ici e ciloto candi, londolola umo cilolele.’

english: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
translation: Ilintu imfumu Belishasa aleteeka, alitebete abacindami bakwe ikana limo (1,000) umutebeto wine wine no kunwa nabo umwangashi.

english: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.
translation: Ilintu namfumu aumfwile amashiwi ya mfumu pamo na bacindami bakwe, aingile mu muputule umwabelele umutebeto no kutila, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya! Witiina kabili wileka icinso cobe ukuwa.

english: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father, light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king, Nebuchadnezzar, your father—yes, the king, your father—made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers,
translation: Eko aba umuntu mu bufumu bobe uwakwata umupashi wa milungu iyamushilo. Mu nshita ya bawiso asangilwe ukukwata ubwishibilo no kucenjela pamo na mano ayapalana na mano ya milungu. Imfumu Nebukadinesa pali ilya nshita yamucitile ukuba umukalamba pa bantu abacita ifyakusobela na malele pamo ne fyakubuka na bena Kaludea abamano.

english: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”
translation: Uyo muntu Daniele, untu imfumu yainike Beliteshasa, asangilwe ukukwata amatontonkanyo na mano no bwishibilo bwakulondolola ifiloto, amapinda no kupwisha amafya. Kanshi utume abantu abakuleta Daniele, nao alaisa kulondolwela umo ifilembo filolele.”

english: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?
translation: Ecalenga Daniele alitilwe ku cinso ca mfumu, nayo yamwipwishe aiti, “Bushe niwe Daniele umo pali bankole abo tata imfumu afumishe ku calo ca Yuda?

english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.
translation: Niŋumfwa ukuti umupashi wa milungu iyamushilo waba muli iwe kabili walikwata ubwishibilo, ukucenjela na mano ayacilamo.

english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.
translation: Abamano pamo na bacita ifyakusobela baciletwa pakuti babelenge filembo no kunjeba umo fyalola, lelo nabafilwa ukulondolola umo filolele.

english: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”
translation: Nomba niŋumfwa ukuti iwe kuti walondolola umo filolele no kupwisha ubwafya. Nga cakuti wabelenga ifi filembo pamo no kunjeba umo filolele, ulefwikwa ilaya ilyakashikila no munyololo wa golide mu mukoshi kabili ukaba kateeka wacitatu mu bufumu.”

english: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
translation: Elyo Daniele ayaswike imfumu ati, “Kuti mwasunga ubupe bwenu, nangu mubupeele ku muntu umbi. Ukubelenga kwena nalabelenga no kumweba umo filolele.

english: “To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.
translation: “Mwe mfumu, Lesa uwapulamo apeele shinwe Nebukadinesa ubufumu ubukalamba, ubukata pamo no bucindami.

english: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.
translation: Pa mulandu wa bukateeka apeelwe, abantu ba mishobo yonse ne ndimi shonse balemucindika no kumutiina. Ali na maka yakupingwile mfwa nelyo umweo, ukusansabika nelyo ukucefya.

english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him, that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.
translation: Pa nshita Belishasa acili alenwa, atumine abakuleta ifipe fya golide na silifa ifyo wishi Nebukadinesa asendele ukufuma mwi Tempele ku Yerusalemu pakuti ena na bacindami bakwe na abakashi bakwe pamo na bambi abakashi bakwe abo ashaupile mu bwinga bese banwenemo.

english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.
translation: Lelo ilintu umutima wakwe waishile ba uwaumalala ku mulandu wa cilumba, Lesa alimutamfishe pa bufumu no bucindami bwakwe bwalipwile.

english: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.
translation: Lesa alimutamfishe ukufuma pa bantu no kumupeela amano ya nama, aikele na bapunda ba mpanga. Kabili alelya icani nge ŋombe, no mubili wakwe walebomba ku mume wa mu mulu, mpaka ilintu asumine ukuti Lesa Uwapulamo e wamaka pa bufumu bwa bantu kabili alabupeela ku muntu uo atemenwe.

english: “You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,
translation: “Lelo imwe, mwe Belishasa, umwana wakwe, nelyo mwalishiba fyonse ifi, tamwaicefya.

english: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, or hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways.
translation: Namusuula Imfumu ya mu mulu ico mwabuulile ifipe fya mwi Tempele lyakwe, elyo imwe pamo na bacindami benu, abakashi benu pamo na bambi abakashi benu abo ashaupile mu bwinga mwalanwenamo. Mwatendeka no kulumbanya imilungu ya silifa ne ya golide ne ya mukuba ne ya cela ne ya fimuti pamo ne ya mabwe, iyishimona, ukumfwa nelyo kwishiba. Tamwacindike Lesa uulama ubumi bwenu no kumona fyonse ifyo mucita.

english: Then the part of the hand was sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.
translation: Ecilengele atume icisansa icacilalemba ifilembo.

english: “This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’
translation: “Ifi e filembo ifilembelwe:

english: “This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.
translation: “Nomu emo filolele. MENE ni mpendwa, ekutila Lesa napenda inshiku sha buteeko bwenu kabili nashipwisha.

english: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.
translation: TEKELE cipimo, ekutila namupimwa no kusangwa uwapepuka.

english: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”
translation: PARISINI ciputulwa, ekutila ubufumu bwenu nabwakanika nabupeelwa ku bena Media na bena Pesia.”

english: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
translation: Pali ilya ine nshita Belishasa akonkomeshe ukuti Daniele afwikwe ilaya ilyakashikila no munyololo wa golide mu mukoshi wakwe no kumupeela bukateeka bwacitatu mu bufumu.

english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.
translation: Elyo baletele inkombo sha golide ne sha silifa ishafumine mwi Tempele, iŋanda yakwa Lesa ku Yerusalemu, elyo imfumu, abacindami bakwe, abakashi bakwe pamo na bambi abakashi bakwe abo ashaupile mu bwinga batampa no kunwenamo.

english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.
translation: Ubushiku bwine bulya Belishasa imfumu ya bena Kaludea alipaiwe,

english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
translation: Ilyo balenwa umwangashi batashishe ne milungu yabo iya golide, iya silifa, iya cela, iya fimuti ne ya mabwe.

english: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
translation: Ilya ine nshita kwamoneke icisansa ca muntu cilelemba pa cibumba apalungatene na pa ncende apo inyali yalesanika mwisano ninshi imfumu ilemona icisansa cilelemba.

english: Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and his knees struck one against another.
translation: Icinso ca mfumu caliwile na matontonkanyo yasalangana ne mfyufyu sha mu musana shalasokona na makufi yalapumana.

english: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing and shows me its interpretation shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”
translation: Elyo imfumu yabilikishe pakwita abacita ifyakusobela na bamalele pamo na bapendula abena Kaludea no kutila kuli bena, “Umuntu uuli onse pali imwe nga cakuti abelenga ifi filembo no kunjeba umo filolele, alefwikwa ilaya ilyakashikila no munyololo wa golide mu mukoshi wakwe kabili alaba kateeka uwacitatu mu bufumu.”

english: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.
translation: Abamano bonse aba mfumu balishile lelo balifililwe ukubelenga ifilembo pa cibumba nelyo ukulondolwela imfumu umo fyalolele.

english: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.
translation: Umwenso waikete imfumu ne cinso caiko cawile ukucilamo, kabili abacindami bakwe calibapeseshe amano.

english: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;
translation: Calisansamwishe Dariusi ukusonta abalashi umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120) abakumwafwako ukuteeka mu bufumu.

english: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.
translation: Ilintu Daniele aumfwile ukuti imfumu naikakatika ici cipope, aile ku ŋanda yakwe, mu muputule uwa pamulu uwakwete insolokoto ishaloseshe ku Yerusalemu. Muli uyu muputule emo alefukama imiku itatu cila bushiku ukupepa no kulatotela Lesa wakwe pamo nga pe.

english: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
translation: Aba bantu baile pamo nge bumba no kusanga Daniele alepepa ukwipusha Lesa ukumwafwa.

english: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: “Haven’t you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?” The king answered, “This thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”
translation: Elyo baile ku mfumu no kutila kuli yena palwa cipope caiko abati, “Mulopwe, bushe tawakakatike apalembelwe ukuti pa nshiku amakumi yatatu (30) takuli umuntu ukulomba icintu ukufuma ku mulungu umbi nangu ku muntu kano iwe. Tawatile uukakaana ukunakila, akaposwa mu cilindi ca nkalamo?”

english: Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”
translation: Elyo batile ku mfumu, “Daniele umo uwa pali bankole aba mu bena Yuda we mfumu, talenakila iwe nangu icipope washika, aletwalilila ukupepa imiku itatu cila bushiku.”

english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.
translation: Ilintu imfumu yaumfwile, yalisakamikwe nganshi, kabili yafwaishe ukupokolola Daniele ukufuma muli uyu mulandu. Yaesha na maka mpaka no kufika icungulo.

english: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, “Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.”
translation: Aba bantu epakuya nge bumba ku mfumu no kuya landa abati, “Ibukisha we mfumu ukutila ukulingana na mafunde ya bena Media na bena Pesia takwaba umuntu nangu umo uwingatelula icipope ico imfumu ipeele.”

english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.”
translation: Ecalenga imfumu yapeela icipope icakuti Daniele bamulete no kumuposa mu cilindi ca nkalamo. Elyo imfumu yasosa kuli Daniele aiti, “Lesa obe untu ubombela lyonse akupusushe.”

english: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.
translation: Awe baleta icilibwe no kucilika pa mwinshi wa cilindi ca nkalamo. Elyo imfumu yaumapo inshimbi yakwe elyo ne sha bacilolo wakwe pakuti kwiba umuntu umo uwingalula nangu cimo pa mulandu wakwa Daniele.

english: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting. No musical instruments were brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.
translation: Elyo imfumu yabwelele kwisano no kwikala ukwabula ukulya kabili tayalele tulo.

english: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.
translation: Ku maca ya bushiku bwakonkelepo, imfumu yaima yaya ku cilindi ca nkalamo.

english: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.
translation: Abasontela bakangalila batatu, na umo pali aba ni Daniele. Aba ebaleangalila abalashi pakulesha ukuti ububi nangu bumo tabwishile pa mfumu.

english: When he came near to the den to Daniel, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?”
translation: Cilyafye yapalamina ku cilindi ca nkalamo umwali Daniele yalimwitile mwishiwi lya cililishi aiti, “Daniele, we mubomfi wakwa Lesa wamweo, bushe Lesa obe untu ubombela lyonse nakupokolola ku nkalamo?”

english: Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!
translation: Daniele alyaswike ati, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya.

english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”
translation: Lesa wandi acituma malaika kukwisala utunwa twa nkalamo, eico tashincenene pantu nshili na mulandu ku cinso cakwe, nelyofye ni ku cinso cobe nshicitile mulandu we mfumu.”

english: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
translation: Imfumu yali no buseko apakalamba kabili yaebele ukuti Daniele bamufumye mu cilindi ca nkalamo. Ilintu Daniele bamufumishe mu cilindi ca nkalamo, tasangilwe nangu kakwebululwa ku mubili wakwe pantu atetekele Lesa wakwe.

english: The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions—them, their children, and their wives; and the lions mauled them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they came to the bottom of the den.
translation: Kabili imfumu yasosele ukuti balya abasebelele Daniele no kumubepesha, pamo na bakashi babo na bana, baposwe mu cilindi ca nkalamo. Aba bantu kuti tabalafika na panshi ya cilindi, inkalamo shabemina shakokotaula na mafupa yabo bonse.

english: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages who dwell in all the earth: “Peace be multiplied to you.
translation: Elyo imfumu Dariusi yalembele ku bantu bonse pamo ne mishobo yonse na bantu ba ndimi shonse isha pano calo ponse aiti,

english: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end.
translation: “Nacite cipope icakuti, mu bufumu bwandi bonse, abantu balingile ukutiina no kucindika Lesa wakwa Daniele.

english: He delivers and rescues. He works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.”
translation: Alapokolola kabili alapususha,

english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
translation: Elyo Daniele ali uwashuka mu nshita Dariusi aleteeka pamo na mu nshita Sairasi umwina Pesia aleteeka.

english: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
translation: Elyo Daniele uyu aba uwaishibikwa ku mfumu ukucila bakangalila banankwe pamo na balashi bonse, pa mulandu wakuti mwali imibeele iyawamisha muli Daniele icakuti yalapanga no kumupeela ukwangalila ubufumu bonse.

english: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.
translation: Elyo bakangalila pamo na balashi balafwailisha umulandu wakuti bafyengeleshe Daniele mu mibombele yakwe iyabukangalila, lelo balifililwe ukusangamo icilubo ico ali umuntu uwacishinka uwabulamo ububi no mufulo.

english: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”
translation: Elyo batendeke ukwebana abati, “Tekuti tusange umulandu nelyo umo uwakufyengelapo uyu Daniele kanofye uukumine ku mipepele yakwa Lesa wakwe.”

english: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!
translation: Eico bakangalila na balashi baile nge bumba ku mfumu no kutila, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya, we mfumu Dariusi.

english: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
translation: Bakangalila ba mfumu, na balashi, na bamushika, na bapandamano pamo na bashicilye, bonse nabasuminishanya ukuti ushike icipope no kupatikisha abantu bonse cakuti kwiba umuntu nelyo umo uwakupepa ku mulungu umbi nangu muntu umbi pa nshiku amakumi yatatu (30), kanofye ukupepa iwe. Kumfwa umuntu nga cakuti asangwa mukukananakila, akaposwa mu cilindi ca nkalamo.

english: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”
translation: Nomba, we mfumu, ulembe no kufwatikapo pali ili funde pakuti likalulwa ukulingana na mafunde ya bena Media na bena Pesia.”

english: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.
translation: Elyo imfumu Dariusi yalembele no kufwatikapo pa cipope ico.

english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
translation: Mu mwaka wantanshi ilintu Belishasa imfumu ya Babiloni aleteeka, Daniele alilotele iciloto no kumona ifimonwa ilyo asendeme mu musengele wakwe. Neci ciloto alicilembele.

english: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him. Thousands of thousands ministered to him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The judgment was set. The books were opened.
translation: Umulonga wa mulilo walepita ukufuma kuli ena.

english: “I watched at that time because of the voice of the arrogant words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.
translation: Ubuso 5:11

english: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.
translation: “Mu cimonwa candi ubushiku namwenemo uwapala umwana wa muntu aleisa na makumbi ya mu mulu. Afikile ku Wakale nakale kabili balimupalamike napo ali.

english: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
translation: Ubuso 11:15

english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. “So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
translation: Nasukile naipusha umo pa bantu abaimininepo ukuti anondolwele umo iciloto calolele. Elyo anjebele umo iciloto calolele.

english: ‘These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who will arise out of the earth.
translation: Atile, ‘Filya ifinama fine fileimininako amabuteko ya shamfumu shine ishikabako pano isonde.

english: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’
translation: Abamushilo bakwa Lesa uwapulamo ebakapeelwa ubufumu kabili ebakalateeka pe na pe.’

english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;
translation: “Nomba nalefwaisha ukwishiba bwino pa mulandu wa cinama icabune icapusene ku fibiye, kabili icaletiinya nganshi ukucila fyonse. Cena cali na meno ya cela na mala ya mukuba kabili pakulya caleshetaula no kushonaula, na ku makasa yaciko calenyantaula fyonse ifyashala.

english: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.
translation: Daniele atile, “Mu ciloto candi ubushiku namwene imyela ine iya mu mulu yaletula monse monse no kupupa pali bemba mukalamba.

english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes and a mouth that spoke arrogantly, whose look was more stout than its fellows.
translation: Kabili nalefwaya ukwishiba bwino pa mulandu wa nsengo ikumi limo pamo pene na kalusengo akanono akamoneke apafumine insengo shitatu. Aka kalusengo akanono kakwete amenso na kanwa akalelanda ifyamataki.

english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,
