translation: Pa nshita nalelolesha, namwene aka kalusengo kabusha inkondo ku bamushilo bakwa Lesa mpaka babacimfya.

english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
translation: Elyo Uwakale nakale aishile peela ubupingushi no kupeela abamushilo ba wapulamo insambu ninshi inshita yakuti bakwate ubufumu naifika.

english: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces.
translation: “Pa mulandu wa cinama cabune atile, ‘Caimininako ubufumu bwabune ubukamoneka pesonde, bukapusana ku bufumu bumbi bonse, bukonaula isonde lyonse ukupitila mukulinyantaula pamo no kulishonaula.

english: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different from the former, and he will put down three kings.
translation: Insengo ikumi limo shaimininako imfumu ikumi limo ishikema muli ubu bufumu, panuma yaisho akalusengo akanono kaleimininako imfumu imbi iikapusanako kuli ishi ishantashi. Yena ikacimfyapo imfumu shitatu,

english: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.
translation: no kupontela Uwapulamo pamo no kucusha abamushilo bakwe pakuti ikapilibule inshita ishaimikwa. Ikanyantaula abamushilo pa mwaka umo, ne myaka ibili na umbi pakati.

english: “‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.
translation: Mako 13:26

english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’
translation: Luka 21:27

english: “Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”
translation: “Umu emwalola ciloto. Ine ne Daniele nalisakamikwe apakalamba mu matontonkanyo yandi icakuti ne cinso caliwile, lelo nasungila imilandu iyi mu mutima wandi.”

english: Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.
translation: Namwene ifinama fine ifyapusana cimo ne cinankwe filefuma muli bemba.

english: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man’s heart was given to it.
translation: “Icantanshi calemoneka nge nkalamo kabili cakwete amapindo nga kapumpe. Ilintu ncili ndelolesha, namwene amapindo yasusukako kabili casumbwilwe mu mulu icakuti caiminine ku molu yabili ngo muntu, elyo capeelwa umutima wa muntu.

english: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’
translation: “Kabili ku cinso candi kwamoneke cinama cabubili icapalile bea balicimishe lubali lumo, kabili calisumine imbafu shitatu ku kanwa kaciko. Caebelwe ukuti, ‘Ima ulye iminofu iingi.’

english: “After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird. The animal also had four heads; and dominion was given to it.
translation: “Kabili namwene cinama na cimbi icalemoneka nge mbwili. Panuma yaciko cakwete amapindo yane ayapalile aya cuni. Ici cinama cakwete imitwe ine kabili calipeelwe amaka yakuteeka.

english: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome, powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.
translation: “Panuma ya ifi, mu cimonwa candi namwene icinama icabune, cali icakusungusha no kutiinya, kabili cali icamaka nganshi. Cakwete ameno ya cela ayakulu ayo caleshetelako no kushonaula ifilyo, na ku makasa yaciko calenyantaula ifyashala. Cali icapusana ku finama ifi fitatu, kabili cakwete insengo ikumi.

english: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.
translation: “Kabili namwene ifipuna fyabufumu,

english: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
translation: Mu mwaka uwalenga butatu ilintu Belishasa imfumu yaleteeka, ine ne Daniele nalimwene icimonwa na cimbi ukukonka pali cilya icantanshi.

english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.
translation: Kalikulile icakuti kaile sansa ne fita fya mu mulu. Kaliponeshe ifita fimo ne ntanda shimo panshi elyo kafinyantaula.

english: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
translation: Kaisumbula no kuikusha pakuti kabe nga Kateeka wa fyonse ifya mu mulu, kalesha ifyakumutuulila amalambo cila bushiku, kabili ne cifulo cakwe icamushilo bacicimfya.

english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.
translation: Pa mulandu wakutalama, abantu abamushilo pamo na malambo ya cila bushiku fyapeelwe kuli aka kalusengo. Ecalengele aka kalusengo ukuba akashuka muli fyonse fyo kalecita, kabili ne cine caposelwe panshi.

english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”
translation: Elyo naumfwile malaika aleipusha malaika munankwe ati, “Bushe ici cimonwa icili pa mulandu wa malambo ya cila bushiku na pa mulandu wa fintu ifyabipisha ifyamuselu, no kucimfiwa kwa cifulo camushilo pamo no kunyantaula ifya mu mulu, cikapwa lilali?”

english: He said to me, “To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”
translation: Elyo umunankwe atile, “Pakapita amalambo aya cungulo pamo na ya lucelo amakana yabili ne myanda itatu (2,300), elyo icifulo camushilo cikashishiwa cipya cipya.”

english: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me someone with the appearance of a man.
translation: Ilintu ine ne Daniele, namwene ici cimonwa, no kufwaya ukwiluka pa mulandu wa bupilibulo bwa ici cimonwa, namwenefye apo nali paisa umo uwapala umuntu.

english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”
translation: Elyo naumfwile shiwi lya muntu ukufuma ku bushilya bwa mumana wa Ulai lyabilikishe aliti, “Gabriele londolwelako uyo muntu ubupilibulo bwa cimonwa.”

english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”
translation: Ilintu atendeke ukwisa apo nali nalitiinine kabili nawile panshi ubukupeme. Elyo asosa ati, “We mwana wa muntu, iluka ukuti ici cimonwa cilelanga ifintu cikaba pa kupwa kwa nshita.”

english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.
translation: Pa nshita alesosa ifi, naponene mu tulo utukalamba panshi apo nawile ubukupeme, elyo anjikata anjiminika.

english: He said, “Behold, I will make you know what will be in the latter time of the indignation, for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.
translation: Luka 1:19

english: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.
translation: Mu cimonwa napulikilwefye ndi mwilinga lya musumba wa Susa mu citungu ca Elamu ku mbali ya mumana wa Ulai.

english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
translation: Sukusuku uwakwata insengo shibili untu wacimona, aleimininako imfumu shibili isha Media pamo na Pesia.

english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
translation: Sawe aleimininako ubufumu bwa Cigiriki, elyo ulusengo pakati ka menso yakwe e mfumu yantanshi.

english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.
translation: Kumfwa shilya insengo shine ishamenene palya panukwike ulusengo lwantanshi shileimininako ishafumu shine ishikema mu luko lwakwe, lelo tashakakwate amaka ayalingana na maka ya mfumu yantanshi.

english: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding riddles, will stand up.
translation: “Ilintu ubufumu bwashiko bwakulasungamina ukupwa pa nshita ububi bwashiko bukacilamo, elyo kukema imfumu imo iyamataki kabili incenjeshi.

english: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.
translation: Ubulamba bwaiko bukalacililakofye, lelo te ku maka yaiko. Ikaba ne fyuma pamo ne shuko muli fyonse fintu ikalacita, kabili ikonaula abantu ababulamba pamo pene na bakwa Lesa abamushilo.

english: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes, but he will be broken without human hands.
translation: Ikaba incenjeshi pakucita amakwebo kabili ikaba ne cilumba. Ikalaipaya abantu abengi pa nshita bashenekele, lelo ilintu ikemina kateeka uwacila pali bakateeka bonse elyo bakayonaula ukwabula ukubomfya maka ya muntu

english: “The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.”
translation: Cilya cimonwa pa mulandu wa malambo aya cungulo na ya lucelo cacishinka, lelo ucisunge nge nkaama pantu pakuti cikafikilishiwe pakapita inshita.”

english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.
translation: Ine, ne Daniele nalinakwike kabili naponene mukulwala pa nshiku ishakupenda. Nasuka napuputuka no kubwelela ku milimo intu imfumu yampeele. Icimonwa cena calintiinishe, calimpapwishe pantu nshailwike umo calolele.

english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram which had two horns stood before the river. The two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
translation: Ilintu nainwine amenso, namwene sukusuku uwakwete insengo shibili ishitali naiminina ku mbali ya mumana. Ulusengo lumo lwali lutali ukucila ulubiye lelo ulwalepeshe elwalekeleshe ukumena.

english: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.
translation: Namwene uyu sukusuku aleti apunkila ku masamba, ku kapinda ka ku kuso na ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Awe takwali inama imbi iyingamulwisha nangu ukupusukako ku maka yakwe. Alecitafye ifintu alefwaya mpaka asukile akula nganshi.

english: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
translation: Ilintu nalesunguka, namwene sawe uwakwete ulusengo lumo ulukulu pakati ka menso yakwe, afuma ku masamba ukulalanya isonde lyonse ukwabula ukunyanta pa mushili.

english: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.
translation: Alungeme ulya sukusuku uwakwete insengo shibili untu namwene eminine kumbali ya mumana, no kubutukilako no bukali bwa maka yakwe.

english: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground and trampled on him. There was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.
translation: Namwene sawe asansa sukusuku na maka, amupunka no kumukontaula insengo shibili. Sukusuku takwete na maka ayakushansha. Bamupunkile panshi kuli sawe, amunyantaula ku makasa yakwe. Kabili takwali nelyo umo uwakupokololako sukusuku ukufuma ku maka akwete.

english: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.
translation: Sawe epakukwatisha amaka, nomba cilya akwatisha amaka ulusengo lwa bulamba bwakwe lwakontoka, elyo pamena shimbi shine ishawamisha ishalolele ku myela ine iya mu mulu.

english: Out of one of them came out a little horn which grew exceedingly great—toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.
translation: Kabili pa lusengo lumo ulwa pali ishi shine pamenene akalusengo akanono. Aka kalusengo kalitutumwike ukulemenena ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, na ku kabanga pamo na ku calo icawamisha ukucila ifyalo fyonse.

english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—
translation: Mu mwaka wantanshi ilintu Dariusi mwana Asuelusi umwina Media, aleteeka mu bufumu bwa bena Kaludea,

english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.
translation: Yere 25:11

english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.
translation: Walicita ifintu watupingile pamo ne ntungulushi shesu ishitutungulula. Walileta ishamo pali ifwe pamo na pa musumba wa Yerusalemu icakuti pano isonde tapaba umusumba uwashama nga Yerusalemu.

english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of the LORD our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.
translation: Ishamo lyonse ilyalembwa mu mafunde yakwa Mose lyaba pali ifwe, lelo tucili twafilwa ukucita icakukusansamusha we Yawe, Lesa wesu, tatuleka kubifya pamo na bucintomfwa.

english: Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.
translation: Eico Yawe tashinshikile ukuponesha ishamo pali ifwe pantu Yawe Lesa wesu mulungami muli fyonse ifyo acita, lelo ifwe twalifilwa ukumunakila.

english: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.
translation: “We Mfumu Lesa wesu, we wafumishe abantu bobe mu calo ca Egupto ukubomfya amaka yobe yantu abantu bacili baleibukisha, twalibembuka kabili twalibifya.

english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.
translation: We Mfumu, ukulingana no bulungami bobe, bwesha ubukali ne cipyu cobe pali Yerusalemu, umusumba kabili ulupili lobe ulwamushilo. Ifyakubifya fyesu pamo ne fyabupulumushi fya bashifwe, Yerusalemu na pa bantu bobe basangwike icakuwela ku bantu bonse abamumbali.

english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
translation: “Eico nomba we Lesa wesu wingakutika kwipepo no kupapata kwa mubomfi obe. Pa mulandu obe we mwine wingalenga icinso cobe ukubutuusha icifulo cobe icamushilo ico icashala amatololo.

english: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.
translation: Upepeke amatwi, we Lesa, no kumfwa ukupapata kwesu. Wisule amenso yobe umone ukubongoloka kwa musumba uwainikwa ishina lyobe. Tatulepepela pa mulandu wa kulungama kwesu, lelo ni pa mulandu wa luse lobe ulukalamba.

english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”
translation: We Yawe tukutike, we Yawe utweleleko, we Yawe utumfwe no kututulanyako. Wikokola we Lesa wesu, pa mulandu wa musumba obe na bantu bobe abainikwako ishina lyobe.”

english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
translation: mu mwaka wantanshi uwakuteeka kwakwe, ine ne Daniele nailwike ukufuma mu malembo ukuti, ukulingana ne shiwi lintu Yawe apeele kasesema Yeremia, Yerusalemu akashale cibolya pa myaka makumi cine lubali (70).

english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God—
translation: Ilyo ine naleyebelela ukubifya kwandi pamo no kubifya kwa bantu bandi abena Israeli kuli Yawe Lesa wandi pa mulandu wa lupili ulwamushilo.

english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.
translation: Ilyo ncili ndepepa, ninshi Gabriele, ulya namwene mu cimonwa capakubala, apupukile apo nali mukwangufyanya, cali ni pa nshita yakutuula ilambo lya cungulo.

english: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.
translation: Aishile kuli ine no kunjeba ati, “We Daniele, naisa mukukupeela amano nokwiluka.

english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.
translation: Lilya linefye watendeke ukupapata Lesa alikwaswike kabili efyo naisa mukukweba pantu uli muntu uo Lesa atemwisha. Eico umfwikishe ishiwi no kwiluka umulolele icimonwa.

english: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.
translation: “Imilungu amakumi cine lubali iya myaka (70) eyapiminwa abantu bobe pamo no musumba obe pakuti kwingaba ukupwisha ubusangu no kubifya, ukufuta pa fyabupulumushi, ukuleta ubulungami bwa pe no kufikilisha icimonwa no busesemo, elyo no kusuba uwamushilo icine cine.

english: “Know therefore and discern that from the going out of the commandment to restore and build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, the prince, will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.
translation: “Uteshe no kwiluka wiluke ifyakuti, ukufuma pa nshita yakumfwa imbila iyakubweseshapo no kukuula cipya cipya umusumba wa Yerusalemu mpaka kateeka uwasubwa akese, pakapita imilungu cine lubali . Ne milungu iyakuwamya imansa na malinga, milungu amakumi mutanda na ibili (62) . Ukakuulwa cipya cipya, ne misebo ikabamo na malinga yakabamo, lelo fikaba mu nshita iyabulanda.

english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.
translation: Pa mpela ya milungu amakumi mutanda na ibili (62) bakepaya uwasubwa ukuteeka, takakwete nangu cimo. Elyo ifita fya ntungulushi imbi iyamaka fikasansa umusumba no kuonaula pamo ne cifulo camushilo. Elintu impela yaiko ikesa nge lyeshi, ninshi inkondo iletwalilila pamo ne shamo nga mulya mwine Lesa apingwilile.

english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”
translation: Iyo ntungulushi iyamaka nomba ikapangana na bantu abengi icipangano icamaka pa mulungu umo , kabili ikalesha amalambo ne mituulo pa kati ka mulungu, elyo pa mulu we tempele pakaba icabunani kabili icabonaushi ukushintafye na pa nshita uukacibikapo akafwila ku mfwa iyo Lesa amupekanishisha.”

english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
translation: Eico ine ne Daniele napilibukile ku mfumu Lesa mukupapata ninshi nindeka no kulya, nimfwala insalu shabulanda no kuikuba imito.

english: I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,
translation: Napepele kuli Yawe Lesa wandi no kuyebelela nati,

english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.
translation: “Twalibembuka kabili twalibifya. Tuli babifi kabili twalikusangukila no kusuula amafunde yobe pamo ne fipope fyobe.

english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
translation: Tatwaba na cumfwila ku babomfi bobe bakasesema abasosele mwishina lyobe ku mfumu shesu na kuli bacilolo besu na kuli bashifwe pamo na ku bantu bonse aba mu calo.

english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
translation: We mfumu uli mulungami, lelo ifwe tuli ne nsoni ku cinso cobe bonse ifwe fwe bena Yuda, fwe bena Yerusalemu, fwe bena Israeli bonse, fwe bali mupepi na bakutali, fwe bali ku fyalo uko watusalanganisha, pa mulandu wakukufutuka uko twafutuka.

english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
translation: We Yawe, ifwe pamo ne mfumu shesu, na bacilolo besu na bashifwe tuli ne nsoni pantu twalibifya ukupitila mukukanaba ne cishinka kuli iwe.

english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.
translation: We mfumu Lesa wesu waba uwankumbu kabili uwelela nangu twakusangukila.

english: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
translation: “Na pa nshita ilya Yawe anjebele ati, ‘Pekanya amabwe ayapapatala yabili nga yalya ayapakubala, elyo wise kuli ine pa mulu wa lupili. Kabili upange ne mbokoshi iya fimuti.

english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.
translation: “Kanshi napwile inshiku amakumi yane (40) pa lupili, akasuba no bushiku, nga filya nacitile pakubala, nalyo line Yawe aliŋumfwile. Tacali bufwayo bwakwe ukumulofya.

english: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, ‘Kabiye, kabili ubatungulule mu nshila, pakuti bakengile no kupoka icalo ico nalaile ifikolwe fyabo ukubapeela.’”

english: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
translation: “Kanshi nomba we Israeli, cinshi Yawe Lesa obe afwaya ulecita? Ala, kuba na katiina kuli Yawe Lesa obe, ukwenda mu nshila shakwe, ukumutemwa, ukutumika Yawe Lesa obe no mutima obe onse no mweo obe onse,

english: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
translation: no kubaka amafunde ne fipope fyakwa Yawe ifyo ndekweba ilelo nga cikakuwamine.

english: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
translation: Nangu umulu pamo pene ne myulu ya mumulu, isonde na fyonse ifyabamo, fyonsefye fyakwa Yawe Lesa obe.

english: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
translation: Nomba Yawe abikile umutima pa fikolwe fyenu no kufitemwa, epakumusala imwe mwe ba mu ndupwa shabo, ukucila aba mishobo imbi ngefyo cili ukushinta ilelo.

english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.
translation: Kanshi imwe mulebeela Yawe, kabili mwilaba bankosa mitwe.

english: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.
translation: Pantu Yawe, Lesa wenu, ni Lesa wa milungu kabili ni Mfumu ya shamfumu, Lesa Mukulu, uwamaka, uwakukwatila akatiina, taba na mucishacinani, kabili tapoka mafisakanwa.

english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
translation: Acita umulinganya kuli bakashiwa na bamukamfwilwa, alitemwa na beni, eubapeela ifyakulya ne fyakufwala.

english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
translation: Kabili na imwe bene mulingile ukutemwa abeni, pantu na imwe mwali abeni mu Egupto.

english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
translation: Nkalemba pa mabwe amashiwi nga yalya nalembele pa mabwe yapakubala ayo watobele. Elyo ukayabike na mu mbokoshi.’

english: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
translation: Muleba na katiina kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, kabili eo muletumika. Mulekonena kuli ena no kulapa mulelapila mwishina lyakwe.

english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
translation: Mulemulumbanya, ni Lesa wenu, uwamucitile ifintu ifikalamba, ifipapwa fyakutiinya ifyo mwaimwenene na menso yenu.

english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
translation: Ifikolwe fyenu ifyaile ku Egupto fyalifye amakumi cine lubali (70) fyonse pamo. Nomba Yawe Lesa wenu namusandulula, mulifye nge ntanda sha mu mulu ku bwingi.”

english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakupanga imbokoshi ya mbao ya cimuti ca akasia, napekanya na mabwe ayapapatala yabili nga yalya ayapakubala. Nanina no lupili na mabwe ayapapatala yabili mu minwe yandi.

english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakulemba pali yalya mabwe amashiwi yamo yene nga yakubalilapo, e fyebo ikumi limo ifyo amupeele ilyo alebila kuli imwe ukufuma mu mulilo, bulya bushiku mwalongene ku lupili. Elyo Yawe ayapeela kuli ine.

english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.
translation: Kabili na ine epakwaluluka, natentemuka no lupili no kubika na mabwe ayapapatala mu mbokoshi intu napangile. Umo yacili na nomba, ngefyo Yawe ankonkomeshe.”

english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
translation: (Abena Israeli balifumine ku fishima fya bena Yaakani, baya na ku Mosera. Kulya kwine eko Aroni aya fwila, no kushiika eko bamushiikile. Umwana wakwe Eleasa ewamupyene pali bushimapepo.

english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
translation: Ukufuma kulya baya ku Gudigoda, kabili batwalilila no kuya ku Yotibata, icalo icabamo utumana utwingi.

english: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
translation: Pa nshita ilya Yawe aipatwilile aba mu luko lwa bena Levi ukulasenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe no kulabomba nga bashimapepo pa cinso cakwa Yawe no kulapaala amapaalo mwishina lyakwe. Ukufika na lelo ebabomba uyu mulimo.

english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)
translation: E mulandu wine abena Levi bashapeelelweko icakaniko nangu icishilano pakati ka bamunyina. Yawe e cishilano cabo, ngefyo Yawe Lesa wenu abebele.)

english: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Muletemwa Yawe Lesa wenu, mulekonka ifyo afwaya, amafunde, ifipope ne fyebo fyakwe.

english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;
translation: Icalo mwalayabukilamo no kucipoka, tacili nge calo ca Egupto ico mwafumako, uko mwalebyala imbuto no kushitapilila nganshi kwati ni mwibala lya musalu.

english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
translation: Nomba icalo mwalayabukilamo no kucipoka calo ca mpili na mawanga, umuloka imfula ukufuma mu mulu.

english: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.
translation: Calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu asunga. Amenso yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu lyonse epo yalolesha ukufuma ku kutampa kwa mwaka mpaka na ku mpela.

english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
translation: “Kanshi imwe nga mukalakonka amafunde bwino bwino ayo namupeela ilelo, ayakutemwa Yawe Lesa wenu no kulamubombela ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse,

english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
translation: lyena ninshi nkalamutumina imfula mu calo cenu ilyo ilekabilwa, pa mibundo na mu mainsa, pakuti mukalesombola iŋanu, umwangashi upya, na mafuta ya miolifa.

english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.
translation: Nkamesha ifyani mu mabala ifyakuti iŋombe shenu shikalelya, kabili na imwe mukalalya no kwikuta.

english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;
translation: Muleba abacenjela epali mwasangukila Yawe no kulapepa imilungu imbi no kulaifukamina.

english: and the LORD’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.
translation: Nga mukalacita ifyo, lyena ubukali bwakwa Yawe bukamwishila. Akesala ne myulu pakuti akaleshe imfula ukulaloka, no mushili ukakaane no kumesha ifisabo. Ninshi nemwe bene tamwakakokole ukuloba muli cilya calo cisuma Yawe akamupeela.

english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
translation: “Kanshi bikeni amashiwi yandi aya mu mitima yenu na mu mano yenu. Muleyakakila na ku maboko yenu, no kuyafwala pa mpumi shenu, nge fishibilo fyakwibukishishako.

english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
translation: Muleyasambilisha na ku bana benu. Muleyakomailapo ilyo mwikele pa mayanda yenu, na lintu muletandala mu misebo, na pakusendama kabili na lintu mwabuka mu tulo.

english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,
translation: Mwibukishe ilelo ukuti te bana benu bamwene no kwishiba ukusambilisha kwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, ubucindami bwakwe, ukuboko kwakwe ukwabulamba no kuboko kwakwe ukwatambalala,

english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;
translation: Muleyalemba na pa filu fya minshi ya mayanda yenu, na pa mpongolo shenu,

english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
translation: pakuti lyena inshiku shenu pamo ne sha bana benu shikabe ishingi ishakwikala muli cilya calo, ico Yawe alapile ukupeela ifikolwe fyenu, ukushinta napo umulu ukekalila pa mulu wa calo.

english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—
translation: “Nga mwalabaka amafunde yonse namupeela, ukutemwa Yawe Lesa wenu, mukwenda mu nshila shakwe shonse kabili no kukonena kuli ena,

english: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.
translation: lyena Yawe akafulumuna imishobo iyi yonse pa ntanshi yenu, kabili mukapokolola ifyalo ku mishobo ikalamba, iyamaka ukucila imwe.

english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.
translation: Impanga yonse umo mukalanyanta ikalaba yenu. Icalo cenu cikalunduluka ukufuma ku matololo ukufika na ku Lebanoni, kabili ukufuma ku mumana wa Yufurate ukuya fika na kuli bemba wa ku masamba.

english: No man will be able to stand before you. The LORD your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.
translation: Takwakabe uwakumwansha imwe, konsefye uko mukalaya. Yawe Lesa wenu akalenga abantu bonse ukulamutiina, ngefyo amulaile.

english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
translation: “Moneni, nabika ilelo pa ntanshi yenu ipaalo atemwa ukulapishiwa.

english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;
translation: Lipaalo, nga cakuti mwabeela amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu ayo namupeela ilelo.

english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.
translation: Ukuf 14:28

english: It shall happen, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.
translation: Ilyo Yawe Lesa wenu akamufisha mu calo ico mwalaingilamo mukupoka, mukabile ipaalo pa lupili lwa Gerisimu, elyo ukulapisha nako pa lupili lwa Ebali.

english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;
translation: ne fisungusho acitile, na fyonse ifyo acitile mukati ka calo ca Egupto, kuli Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto na ku calo cakwe conse.

english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
translation: Mwalishiba ukuti ishi mpili shibili shabela mwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani ku masamba ya musebo ukuwila akasuba, mupepi na ku miti ikalamba iya More mu calo ca balya abena Kenani abekala mu Araba apalungatana na Giligali.

english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.
You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
translation: mukalesakamana ukubeela amafunde ne fipope ifyo ndemupeela ilelo.”

english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how the LORD has destroyed them to this day;
translation: Mwibukishe ifyo Yawe acitile ifita fya bena Egupto, kumo kwine na bakabalwe babo na maceleta yabo, ifyo banwenene muli Bemba Wakashika ilyo bamusupile panuma, nefyo Yawe abalofya mpaka na lelo.

english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;
translation: Te bana benu bamwene ifyo Yawe amucitile mu matololo ilyo tamulati mwise pali ino ncende.

english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;
translation: Mwibukishe ifyo acitile kuli Datani na Abiramu, abana abaume bakwa Eliabu, uwa luko lwakwa Rubeni, ilyo umushili waceneme no kubamina kumo kwine ne ndupwa shabo, amatenti yabo na fyonse ifyo bakwete mu menso ya bena Israeli.

english: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD’s great work which he did.
translation: Lelo menso yenu yaimwenene ifintu fyonse ifyakupapa ifyo Yawe acita.”

english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;
translation: “Mulekonka amafunde yonse ayo nalamupeela ilelo, pakuti mukabe na maka ayakupoka icalo ico mwalaswa mwingilemo ilyo mwalayabuka Yordani.

english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translation: Kabili epakuti mukaye ikala inshita iyitali mu calo ico Yawe alaile ukupeela ifikolwe fyenu pamo na ba mu ndupwa shabo, icalo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci.

english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.
translation: “Kabili aya e mafunde ne fipope ifyo muli nokubaka bwino bwino mu calo ico Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu amupeela ukupoka, ilyo lyonse mukalaikalamo.

english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,
translation: Lelo muli nokwabuka umumana wa Yordani no kwikala mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela nge cacishilano, kabili akalenga mukatushe ku balwani benu abamushinguluka bonse epakuti mukekale umutelelwe.

english: then it shall happen that to the place which the LORD your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.
translation: Kanshi ku ncende Yawe Lesa wenu akasala nge cifulo cakwikalamo Ishina lyakwe, kulya eko mukalatwala fyonse ifyo namukonkomesha, amalambo ya cakoca, imituulo, ifyapekumi, ifyabupe fimbi ifyaibela na fyonse ifyo mwalaya ukupeela Yawe.

english: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
translation: Kabili kulya kwine eko mukalesansamuka pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, imwe, abana benu abaume na banakashi, ababomfi benu abaume na banakashi, na bena Levi abakalaikala mu misumba yenu, abashakwata icitungu nangu icacishilano cabo.

english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;
translation: Tecakwesha kulekela amalambo yenu ayakoca pa ncendefye yonse iyo mwatemwa.

english: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.
translation: Mukalalekelafye amalambo yakoca pa ncende imofye iya ba mu luko lwenu lumo iyo Yawe akasala, kulya kwine eko mukalekonka fyonse ifyo namukonkomesha.

english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.
translation: “Lelo kuti mwaipaya inama shenu mu musumba uuli onse, no kulya apo mulefwaila nga filya fine mulelya insebula nangu impombo ukulingana na mapaalo umo Yawe Lesa wenu amupeelela. Bonse abashasangululwa na basangululwa kuti balyako.

english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
translation: Nomba mwilalya mulopa, wena mukalewitila panshi nga menshi.

english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;
translation: Mwilalya mu misumba yenu icapekumi ca ŋanu shenu, umwangashi upya na mafuta, nangu na mabeli ya ŋombe na ya mbushi ne mpaanga shenu nangu conse ico mwalaya ukupeela ne fyabupe fyenu ifyakuitemenwa, nangu ifyabupe fimbi.

english: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand to.
translation: Lelo mukalelya fyonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pa ncende apo Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokusala. Mukalelya pamo, imwe, abana benu abaume na banakashi, ababomfi benu abaume na banakashi, na bena Levi abaikala mu misumba yenu. Muli nokusansamuka pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pa fintu fyonse mwabomba ne minwe yenu.

english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.
translation: Tecakwesha kulekelesha abena Levi pa nshita yonse mukekala mu calo cenu.

english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
translation: Mukonaule incende shonse ishaba pa mpili ishitali, pa tupili na pesamba lya cimuti conse icayandalala umo imishobo mupokolweleko icalo yalepepela imilungu yaiko.

english: When the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.
translation: “Ilyo Yawe Lesa wenu akalundako icalo cenu ngefyo amulaile, elyo na imwe mwaumfwa icikasha kabili mwasosa amuti, ‘tulefwaya inama,’ lyena kuti mwalya inama umo mulefwaila.

english: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.
translation: Nga cakuti incende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu asala nge cifulo cakwikalamo Ishina lyakwe ili ukutali nganshi, kuti mwaipayapo iŋombe nangu impaanga Yawe amupeela. Kabili ngefyo amukonkomeshe, mukalelya mu misumba yenu umo mulefwaila.

english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.
translation: Bonsefye abashasangululwa na basangululwa kuti balyako isho nama, nga filya fine mulya insebula nangu impombo.

english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.
translation: Amaf 15:23

english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
translation: Kanshi mwilalya mulopa. Wena mukalewitila panshi nga menshi.

english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.
translation: Mwikalalya mulopa pakuti ifintu fikamuwamine imwe pamo na bana benu. Pantu ninshi mukalacita icalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.
translation: Levi 7:26

english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the LORD your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the LORD your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.
translation: Mukalalekela amalambo yakoca pa bulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, fyonse inama no mulopa. Umulopa wa malambo yenu wena mukalewitila lubali lwa bulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, lelo inama yena mukalelya.”

english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in the LORD your God’s eyes.
translation: Mukalebeela bwino amafunde aya yonse ndemupeela pakuti ifintu fikamuwamine, imwe pamo na bana benu, pantu mukalacita icisuma kabili icalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,
translation: “Yawe Lesa wenu akonaula imishobo pa ntanshi yenu iyo mwalaya lwisha no kucimfya kabili mukabafulumunamo no kwikala mu calo cabo.

english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.
translation: Mukabongololemo ifibumbili fya malambo fyabo, mukatobaule amabwe yabo bacindikisha kabili mukoce inceshi sha Ashera, umulungu wabo, mu mulilo. Mukakomaule ifimpashanya fya milungu yabo, kabili mukalofye na mashina yatuko pali isho ncende.

english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
translation: Lelo panuma yakulofya imishobo pa ntanshi yenu, imwe mukacenjele mukukanawila mu citeyo cakwipusha pa milungu yabo, amuti, ‘Bushe iyi mishobo ipepa shani imilungu yaiko, pakuti na ifwe efyo tulecita?’

english: You shall not do so to the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.
translation: Imwe tecakwesha kulapepa Yawe Lesa wenu mu musango wabo, pantu mukupepa imilungu yabo, bena balacita ifintu ifingi ifyamuselu ifyo Yawe apata. Bena baloca na bana babo abaume na banakashi pakutuula amalambo ku milungu yabo.

english: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.
translation: “Tecakwesha kulapepa Yawe Lesa wenu mu musango bapepelamo.

english: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.
translation: Amaf 7:5

english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.
translation: Kuli ilya ncende eko mukalaleta amalambo yakoca, imituulo, ifya pa cekumi, ifyabupe fimbi ifyaibela, ifyabupe ifyo mukalalaya Yawe, ifyabupe ifyakuitemenwafye, amabeli ya ŋombe na ya mbushi ne mpaanga shenu.

english: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.
translation: Palya pene pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, epo imwe ne ndupwa shenu mukalelya no kusansamuka pa fintu fyonse ifyo mwabomba ne minwe yenu pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alimupaala.

english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;
translation: “Mwikalacita ngefi tucita kuno ilelo, cila muntu acitafye icamuwamina,

english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: apo tamulati mufike mu cifulo cakutuushamo icikaba icacishilano, ico Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokumupeela.

english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
translation: “Nga cakuti kasesema nangu kalota wa filoto umo aisa mwebako icishibilo cimo atemwa icisungusho cimo,

english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translation: Wakwipayafye ku mabwe, pantu alefwaya ukumutalusha kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha.

english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bonse bakomfwako, bakaba no mwenso. Takwakabe nangu umo uukabwekeshapo nakabili ukucita ico cintu icabipa.

english: If you hear about one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there, that
translation: “Nga mwaumfwa calandwa ukuti umusumba umo pa misumba yenu iyo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela ukwikalamo,

english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,
translation: ukuti abantu babi nabema pakati kenu no kulenga abantu aba mu musumba wabo ukupondoka no kusosa abati, ‘Natuleya kukupepa imilungu imbi, (imilungu iyo mushatala amwishiba),’

english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,
translation: ninshi mukalefwailisha bwino bwino umulandu. Kabili nga cacine ukuti ici cintu calicitika icishaibipila pakati kenu,

english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.
translation: mukalemona ukuti bonse abekala muli uyo musumba baipaiwa. Onauleni umusumba nakalya nakalya, pamo pene na bantu ne fitekwa.

english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.
translation: Ifitapwa fyonse ifya muli uyo musumba mukalefikolonganika pamo pakati ka lubansa lwa mu musumba, elyo no koca umusumba onse ne fitapwa fyonse mukufipeela kuli Lesa kukonaulwa . Ukashalafye ifitantala ifishakakuulwe nakabili.

english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,
translation: Tecakwesha kusangwa ne fintu ifili nokonaulwa mu minwe yenu, pakuti Yawe akaleke ubukali nokumubelela uluse. Ku luse lwakwe akalenga mukasande, ngefyo alaile ifikolwe fyenu,

english: when you listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in the LORD your God’s eyes.
translation: nga cakuti mulebeela Yawe Lesa wenu mukubaka amafunde ayo ndemupeela ilelo no kulacita ifyalungama pa cinso cakwe.”

english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”
translation: kabili nga icishibilo nangu icisungusho ico asoselepo caisa citika, elyo atila, ‘Kanshi nomba natulekonka imilungu imbi,’ iyo imwe mushatala amwishiba, kabili atila, ‘Natulepepa iyi ine milungu.’

english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
translation: Tecakwesha kumfwako kuli ayo mashiwi ya uyo kasesema nangu uyo kalota wa filoto. Ala ni Yawe Lesa wenu eulemwesha pakuti amone nga mwalimutemwa ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse.

english: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.
translation: Mulekonkafye Yawe Lesa wenu, kabili mulemukwatila akatiina. Mulemumfwila no kulasunga amafunde yakwe, mulemupepa no kukonena kuli ena.

english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
translation: Uyo kasesema nangu kalota wa filoto muli nokumwipaya, pantu alemweba ukutalamina Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu Egupto kabili ewamulubwile ukumufumya mu calo ca busha. Uyo muntu alefwaya ukumutalusha mu nshila iyo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomesha ukukonka. Kanshi mufwile ukufumya ububi pakati kenu.

english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;
translation: “Nga cakuti ni munonko, nangu umwana obe umwaume nangu umwanakashi nangu umukashi uo watemwa, nangu cibusa obe uo mwaampana nankwe, ewaisa kukutunka mu bumfisolo ati, ‘Natuleya kukupepa imilungu imbi,’ (imilungu iyo imwe nangu bashinwe bashatalile abeshiba,

english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—
translation: imilungu ya bantu abamushinguluka nangu abali ukutali, ukufuma uko icalo catampila, ukufika noko capela.)

english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;
translation: Tecakwesha kusumina nangu ukumfwako. Tewakukwatila luse nangu ukumulekafye nangu ukumucingilila.

english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.
translation: Cine cine mufwile ukumwipayafye! Iwe niwe wine ubalilepo ukumupola ilibwe, elyo na bambi nabo balemupolaula.

english: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Imwe muli bana bakwa Yawe Lesa wenu. Tecakwesha ukuitetaula mwe bene, nangu ukubeya inkuso , pa mulandu waufwile,

english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.
translation: Lelo consefye icishakwata tulebelebe na mamba tecakwesha kulya pantu cintu cakowela kuli imwe.

english: Of all clean birds you may eat.
translation: “Kuti mwalya icuni conse icishakowela.

english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
translation: Lelo ifi e fyuni ifyo mushili nakulya, kapumpe, ikubi likalamba ne kubi ilyafiita,

english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,
translation: bapungwa abali bonse, pumbwa, akapata makanga imisango yonse,

english: every raven of any kind,
translation: Tito 2:14

english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,
translation: imbuni, akambasa, isela ne nkoshi sha misango yonse,

english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
translation: akapululu kanono, icipululu, swelelele,

english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,
translation: intitimushi, ikubi lyabuuta, inondo,

english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.
translation: “Ifishishi fyonse ifipupuka, fintu fyakowela kuli imwe, tecakwesha ukulya.

english: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
translation: pantu imwe muli bantu bamushilo abakwa Yawe Lesa wenu. Yawe alimusala ukufuma mu bantufye bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse ukuba abantu bakwe abo acindamika.

english: Of all clean birds you may eat.
translation: Amaf 4:20

english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
translation: “Mwilalya fyonse mwasanga nafiifwila. Ifi fyena kuti mwapeela abenafyalo muleikala nabo mu musumba uuli onse, bena kuti balya, nangu kuti mwashitisha ku benafyalo. Pantu imwe muli bantu bamushilo abakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
translation: “Cila mwaka pafyo mukalasombola mu mabala yenu, mukalebuulapo icekumi pekumi limo.

english: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.
translation: Mukalelya icapekumi ca ŋanu shenu, umwangashi upya na mafuta, kabili ne beli lya ŋombe ne fitekwa fyenu fyonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pa ncende akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe, pakuti mukasambilile ukukwatila Yawe Lesa wenu akatiina inshita yonse.

english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which the LORD your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,
translation: Nomba nga ilya ncende yaba ukutali noko mwikala, icakuti mwafilwa no kusenda ifyekumi pafyo Yawe Lesa wenu amupaala, (pantu incende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe ili ukutali nganshi),

english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.
translation: lyena mulekabula ifyapekumi ne ndalama, elyo mukalesenda isho ndalama no kuya nasho ku ncende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu akasala.

english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
translation: Nomba mwikalaba kubaka abena Levi mukalaikala nabo mu misumba yenu, pantu tabaikwatila citungu nangu icacishilano cabo.

english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.
translation: Levi 19:28

english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
translation: pakuti abena Levi abashaikwatila citungu nangu icacishilano cabo, abenafyalo, bakashiwa na bamukamfwilwa abakalaikala mu misumba yenu baleisa mukupokako icakulalya conse balekabila epakuti Yawe Lesa wenu akalemupaala muli fyonse ifyo mukalabomba.”

english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukulya conse icamuselu.

english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
translation: Ishi e nama mulingile ukulya, iŋombe, impaanga, imbushi,

english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.
translation: Nomba pa nama ishibukula nangu ishapanduka ifibondo, pamo nga ingamila, kalulu nangu pati, mwilalya. Ishi nelyo shibukula, tashapanduka fibondo, nasho shintu shakowela kuli imwe.

english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.
translation: Mwilalya nkumba, pantu intu yakowela nangu yapanduka ifibondo, nomba taibukula ifyakulya iyoo. Tecakwesha kulya inama yaiko nangu ukukumya ku citumbi caiko.

english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
translation: Pet 2:9

english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Kabili pa mpela ya mwaka walenga cine lubali, uwakusuula ku nkongole.

english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.
translation: Mukalemupeelafye ukwabula ukuilishanya mu mitima yenu, lyena pa mulandu wa ifi, Yawe Lesa wenu akalamupaala muli fyonse ifyo mukalabomba na fyonse mwaikatako.

english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.
translation: Lyonsefye mu calo mukalaba na balanda. Kanshi e mulandu wine namukonkomesesha imwe ukulafungulula amaboko kuli bamunyinenwe, abalanda na bakabila mu calo cenu.”

english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
translation: “Nga cakuti Umuhibulu munobe, umwaume nangu umwanakashi, aishitisha ubusha kuli iwe, akubombela na pa myaka mutanda, mu mwaka walenga cine lubali ufwile ukumulekako abe umuntungwa.

english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.
translation: Kabili ilyo wamuleka ukuti abe umuntungwa, wikaleka aye iminwe nkutwa.

english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
translation: Ukamupeele ifyabupe ukwabula ukusalulula ukufuma pafyo Yawe Lesa obe akupaalilapo, impaanga, iŋanu no mwangashi.

english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.
translation: Mwibukishe ukuti na imwe bene mwali abasha mu calo ca Egupto, kabili Yawe Lesa wenu amulubula. Kanshi e mulandu wine na ine namupeelela ili funde ilelo.

english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti umusha obe asosa kuli iwe ati, ‘Nshilefwaya kuya,’ pantu alikutemwa, atemwa no lupwa lobe lwine, kabili ekala uwasansamuka,

english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.
translation: lyena ukabuule akakutulilako ukutwi, ukamushintilikishe ku cibi ca ŋanda no kumutula ukutwi kwakwe kumo. Ninshi aba umusha obe wape. Kabili no musha obe umwanakashi, nao wine efyakumucita.

english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.
translation: Wikalacimona ukwafya ukuleka umusha obe abe umuntungwa. Pantu imilimo akubombela pa myaka mutanda (6), kuti yalingana no muntu wancito uwingakubombela pa myaka itatu. Kanshi na iwe nga wacita ifi, lyena Yawe Lesa obe akakupaala mu fintufye fyonse ifyo ukalabomba.

english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
translation: “Amabeli yonse ayalume aya ŋombe shenu na ya fitekwa fyenu muleyapatwila Yawe Lesa wenu. Kanshi isho ŋombe mwikalaesha kushibomfya ku milimo, kabili ne mpaanga nasho mwikalashibeya masako.

english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.
translation: No musango wakusuulilamo ni uyu, umuntu onsefye uwakongwesha umwina Israeli munankwe tali nakupoka nkongole iyoo. Tali na kulipilwa ku mwina Israeli munankwe nangu ni ndume yakwe, pantu ni Yawe apingwile ukusuulako ku nkongole pali iyo nshita.

english: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.
translation: Cila mwaka imwe pamo na ba mu lupwa lwenu, mukaleshilya pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pa ncende iyo akasala.

english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti inama nga yalikwata akalema, nangu yalitulika amenso, nangu ilasunta, nangu yaba na kalema kambi akabipisha nganshi, yena tamuli nakulekela Yawe Lesa wenu ilambo.

english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.
translation: Inama ya musango uyo muli nokuilya mu misumba yenu. Bonse abasangululwa na bashasangululwa kuti balyako iyo nama, nga filya fine balya impombo nangu insebula.

english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
translation: Nomba mwikalalya kumo no mulopa, wena mukalewitila panshi nga menshi.”

english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.
translation: Umwinafyalo ena kuti wamupinda, lelo ufwile ukusuulako ku nkongole munonko akongola.

english: However there will be no poor with you (for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)
translation: “Yawe Lesa wenu akalamupaala nganshi mu calo ico ali nokumupeela kukuba icacishilano cenu. Eico pali imwe tapafwile ukuba umulanda

english: if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.
translation: nga cakuti mwalabeela Yawe Lesa wenu no kukonka bwino amafunde yonse ayo ndemupeela ilelo.

english: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu akalamupaala nga mulya mwine alaile. Nimwe mukalakongwesha imishobo iyingi, lelo imwe tamwakalekongola nangu kumo iyoo. Mukalateeka imishobo iyingi, lelo tapakabe mushobo nangu umo uwakumuteeka.

english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;
translation: “Nga cakuti mu musumba wenu umo uwa calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu alamupeela muli uulekabila, mwilaumya mitima nangu ukutunkanika amaboko kuli munyinenwe.

english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.
translation: Mukalefungulula amaboko, kabili mukuitemenwa, mukalemwashimisha fyonse ifyo alekabila.

english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to the LORD against you, and it be sin to you.
translation: Cenjeleni mukukanakwata itontonkanyo lyabipa ilyakuti, ‘Umwaka wa cine lubali, umwaka wakusuula ku nkongole naupalama,’ epakuti tamulangile umutima wabipa kuli munyinenwe uulekabila, mwakaana no kumupa nangu kamo. Kuti akuuta kuli Yawe pa mulandu wenu, na imwe mukasangwa no mulandu wa bubifi.

english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Mukalebaka umweshi wa Abibu no kusefya Ipasaka lyakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, pantu Abibu e mweshi amufumishemo mu calo ca Egupto pa nshita ya bushiku.

english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.
translation: Elyo mukalesefya inshikunkulu ya milungu, iyakucindikilamo Yawe Lesa wenu, pakumuletela umutuulo wakuitemenwafye ukulingana ne paalo ilyo amupaala.

english: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
translation: Kabili mukalesansamuka pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, pa ncende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe. Mukalesansamukila pamo imwe, abana benu abaume na banakashi, ababomfi benu abaume na banakashi, na bena Levi abaikala mu misumba yenu, kabili na benafyalo, bakashiwa, na bamukamfwilwa abo mwikala nabo.

english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.
translation: Muleibukisha ukuti mwali abasha mu calo ca Egupto, kanshi mulekonka bwino aya mafunde.”

english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.
translation: “Mulesefya inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe pa nshiku cine lubali ilyo mwapwisha ukututila iŋanu, elyo no kukama ifitwalo fya myangashi.

english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.
translation: Mukalesansamuka mu nshikunkulu shenu, imwe, abana benu abaume na banakashi, ababomfi benu abaume na banakashi, abena Levi, abenafyalo, bakashiwa na bamukamfwilwa abekala mu misumba yenu.

english: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty.
Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you.
translation: Cila muntu ali nokusenda icabupe ukulingana ngefyo Yawe Lesa wenu amupaala.”

english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
translation: “Mukasonte abapingushi na bacilolo ba cila luko mu misumba Yawe Lesa wenu akamupeela, ebakalapingwila abantu no mulinganya.

english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
translation: Bekalacita lufyengo pakupingwila, bekalacita mucishacinani, kabili bekalapoka mafisakanwa. Pantu amafisakanwa yapofwisha abamano amenso, kabili no kupondamika amashiwi ya balungami.

english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
translation: Mukaleleka ilambo nge Pasaka kuli Yawe Lesa wenu ilya nama ukufuma pa mpaanga nangu imbushi shenu pa ncende iyo Yawe akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe.

english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: Mukalecita umulinganya, umulinganya wekafye, epakuti muleenda abomi, mukapoke ne calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela.”

english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.
translation: “Nga mwakuulila Yawe Lesa wenu ubulambo, tecakwesha kushimpa mumbali uluceshi lwa cimuti ulwa mulungu Ashera.

english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.
translation: Kabili mwikalakuulapo luceshi lwa mabwe bacindikisha, pantu fyonse ifi Yawe Lesa wenu alifipata.

english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
translation: Mwikalalya iyo nama kumo ne mikate iyatutumuka, lelo mukalelya imikate iyishatutumuka pa nshiku cine lubali, e mikate ya mu bucushi, pantu mwafumine mu lubilo mu calo ca Egupto, epakuti inshiku shonse isha bumi bwenu mukaleibukisha inshita mwafumine mu Egupto.

english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.
translation: Pa nshiku cine lubali mwikalasangwa intutumushi mu calo cenu conse. Mwikalaleka inama mwalekela ilambo pa bushiku bwakubalilapo icungulo ishaleko mpaka ulucelo.

english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you;
translation: Levi 23:5-8

english: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.
translation: kanofye pa ncende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe. Epantu mukalalekela ilambo lye Pasaka mu cungulo, ilyo akasuba kawa, pakwibukisha inshita ilya ine mwafuminepo mu Egupto.

english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.
translation: Muli nokoca inama no kuilya pa ncende ine Yawe Lesa wenu akasala. Elyo akacelo mwabwelelamo ku matenti yenu.

english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.
translation: Pa nshiku mutanda mukalelya imikate iyishatutumuka, nomba pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali mukalelongana pamo pakucindika Yawe Lesa wenu, kabili mwikalabombapo imilimo iyoo.”

english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
translation: “Mukalependa imilungu cine lubali ukufuma ubushiku mwatampa ukulobolola iŋanu.

english: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.
translation: “Mwilalekela Yawe Lesa wenu ilambo lya ŋombe nangu impaanga iyalemana nangu iyaba na kalema akali konse, pantu fintu fyapatwa kuli Yawe.

english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.
translation: Mukalecita ukulingana nefyo ubupingushi buli pa ncende iyo Yawe akasala. Mube abacenjela mukucita fyonse ifyo bamwebele.

english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.
translation: Mukalecita ifintu ukulingana na mafunde bamufunda kabili no kukonka bwino ubupingushi. Mwikalafuma kufyo bamweba, ukuya ku kulyo nangu ku kuso.

english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.
translation: Umuntu onse uwacita imisuula pakukanaumfwila bakapingula nangu shimapepo uuletumika Yawe Lesa wenu, wena wakwipayafye. Kanshi efyo mufwile ukufumya ububi mu Israeli.

english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
translation: Kol 5:13

english: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”
translation: “Ilyo mukengila mu calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela, kabili mwacipoka, mwalaikalamo, elyo mukatile, ‘Katuikwatile imfumu iyakututeeka pamo nge mishobo imbi iyatushinguluka.’

english: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.
translation: Amaf 19:15

english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because the LORD has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”
translation: Mateo 18:16

english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.
translation: Ilyo aba pa bufumu, ali nokuilembela umwine mu citabo aya mafunde. Akayambule ukufuma mu citabo cisungwa na bashimapepo abena Levi.

english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;
translation: Timo 5:19
