english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume umo nangu umwanakashi umo, uwikala mu musumba uuli onse Yawe alamupeela, asangwa mukucita icabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pakonaula icipangano,

english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.
translation: Ukuf 22:20

english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,
translation: elyo mukukanakonka amafunde yandi apepa imilungu imbi, alatufukamina, nangu alapepa akasuba, umweshi nangu intanda sha mu mulu.

english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,
translation: Ilyo ici caishibikwa kuli imwe, lyena mukalefwailisha bwino umulandu. Nga cakuti cacine ico cintu cabipa calicitika mu Israeli,

english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.
translation: mukafumishe kunse ya mpongolo yenu uyo mwaume nangu umwanakashi, mukamulase amabwe mpakafye akafwe.

english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
translation: Umuntu pakumwipaya kano bakambone bali babili nangu batatu ebamushinina, nomba nga kambone ali umofye lyena takuli kumwipaya.

english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
translation: Bakambone ebafwile ukubalilapo ukumupola amabwe pakumwipaya, elyo bonse abantu bakakonkepo. Kanshi efyo mufwile ukufumya ububi pakati kenu.

english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.
translation: “Nga cakuti kwaba imilandu iyaletwa ku filye fyenu iyingamukosela ukupingula, kuti yaba yakwipaya umuntu, nangu palwa cuma ca muntu kumo ne nsambu shakwe, nangu palwa kucenana ifilonda, mukaletwala iyi milandu ku ncende iyo Yawe Lesa wenu akasala.

english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.
translation: Mukaleya kuli bashimapepo abena Levi na kuli kapingula uukabapo pali iyo nshita. Mukalebepusha, nabo bakalamweba ubupingushi.

english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Bashimapepo abena Levi, emukuti uluko lwakwa Levi lonse, bena tabakakwatemo citungu nangu icacishilano mu Israeli. Bena bakalalyafye imituulo na malambo yakoca ifikatuulwa kuli Yawe. Pantu ici e cacishilano cabo.

english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,
translation: Pekasangwa nangu umo pakati kenu uwakuleka umwana wakwe umwaume nangu umwanakashi nge lambo lyakoca mu mulilo, ababuka imbuko, abakuuta imipashi, abapendula, abaloshi,

english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
translation: abalanda amashiwi ya filayi, abepusha abawilwa nangu imipashi, atemwa abepusha imipashi ya bafwa.

english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD. Because of these abominations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.
translation: Onse uucita ifi fintu ifyamakankamike alipatwa kuli Yawe. Ni pa mulandu wa iyi micitile yamuselu, Yawe Lesa wenu akafulumwina ilya mishobo pa ntanshi yenu.

english: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.
translation: Kanshi imwe mufwile ukuba abapwililika pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you so to do.
translation: “Imishobo iyo imwe mwalapokolola icalo yumfwila ku bakuuta imipashi na kuli bakabuka wa mbuko. Nomba imwe, Yawe Lesa wenu alimubinda ukulacita ifi fintu.

english: The LORD your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
translation: Kanshi Yawe Lesa wenu akamwimisha kasesema nga ine ukufuma pali bamunyinenwe. Mukalemumfwila uyo wine.

english: This is according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again the LORD my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”
translation: Pantu ici eco mwalombele kuli Yawe Lesa wenu ku Holebu ubushiku mwalongene ilyo mwatile, ‘Tekuti tumfwe ishiwi lyakwa Yawe Lesa wesu nangufye ukumona umulilo ukalamba nakabili, pantu kuti twafwa.’

english: The LORD said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.
translation: “Kanshi Yawe epakunjeba ati, ‘Ifyo abo bantu balanda nafilungama.

english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.
translation: Ukuf 22:18

english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
translation: Nga cakuti umo akaana ukumfwila amashiwi kasesema akalanandilako, uyo muntu wena ine nkamupeela umulandu.

english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The LORD is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.
translation: Tabakakwate icacishilano muli bamunyina, lelo Yawe e cacishilano cabo.

english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”
You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?”
translation: “Limbi kuti mwasosa mwe bene amuti, ‘Kuti twaishiba shani amashiwi ayashisoselwe na Yawe?’

english: When a prophet speaks in the LORD’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.
translation: Imili 3:22

english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.
translation: “Ici e cakaniko cili nokupeelwa kuli bashimapepo ukufuma ku bantu abaleka cilume wa ŋombe nangu impaanga, ukuboko, inshetelo elyo ne fyamumala.

english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.
translation: Mukalebapeela ifisabo fyantanshi ifya ŋanu shenu no mwangashi upya na mafuta ya miolifa, elyo na masako ya mpaanga ayakubalilapo.

english: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the LORD’s name, him and his sons forever.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alibasala pamo ne ndupwa shabo ukufuma mu nko shenu shonse pakuti baleiminina no kubomba mwishina lyakwa Yawe inshiku shonse.

english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which the LORD shall choose,
translation: “Ngo mwina Levi afuma mu musumba wenu umo uwa mu Israeli umo ekala, aisa mukuitemenwa umwine ku ncende iyo Yawe akasala,

english: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before the LORD.
translation: kuti abomba umulimo wa bushimapepo mwishina lyakwa Yawe Lesa wakwe nga bena Levi bambi ababombela kulya kwine pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.
translation: Ali nokupeelwako ifyakaniko ukulinganafye na bashimapepo bambi, nangu engapokelela ulupiya lwafuma mukushitisha ifyuma fya lupwa.”

english: When you have come into the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.
translation: “Ilyo mukafika mu calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela, mwikalakonkelela imicitile iyapatwa iya mishobo ya kulya.

english: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Ilyo Yawe Lesa wenu akalofya imishobo ya bene ba calo ali nokumupeela, kabili ilyo mukabafulumunamo no kwikala mu misumba yabo na mu mayanda yabo,

english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.
translation: Mukalecita ici pakuti umulopa wakaele wikalasuma mu calo cenu, ico Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokumupeela nge cacishilano. Kabili epakuti mwikakwata mulandu wakusumya umulopa.

english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti umuntu alipata umubiye, kabili amubelamina, amusansa, amwipaya no kumwipaya, elyo abutukila ku musumba umo pali ilya itatu,

english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
translation: lyena abakalamba ba mu musumba wakwe bakatume abakuya mubwesha kuli ulya musumba no kwisa mulubwila kuli kalandula wa mulopa, pakuti nao amwipaye.

english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.
translation: Mwikalamukwatila luse. Kanshi mufwile ukufumya umulandu wakusumya umulopa wakaele mu Israeli, epakuti cikalemuwamina.

english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that the LORD your God gives you to possess.
translation: “Mwikalasesha amabwe ya mipaka ya banenu, iyapiminwe kale na bantu babalilepo mu calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokumupeela ukucipoka.”

english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.
translation: “Kambone umo tekuti ashinine umuntu uupeelwe umulandu uuli onse nangu icilubo ico nalimo acicita. Pakuti kube ukupeela umulandu, kano kwaba bakambone babili nangu batatu abakushininkisha.

english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
translation: Mateo 18:16

english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;
translation: Amaf 27:17

english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,
translation: Bakapingula bakafwailishe umulandu bwino. Kabili nga basanga ukuti kambone wabufi, alebepesha umunankwe,

english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
translation: Timo 5:19

english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess.
translation: mukapatulepo imisumba itatu iyaba pakati ka calo Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokumupeela ukucipoka.

english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
translation: Ilyo bonse bakomfwako, bakalatiina, kabili takwakabe nangu umo uukabwekeshapo ukucita nakabili icintu icabipa ifyo pakati kenu.

english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
translation: Mwikalakwata luse iyoo. Mukalelinganyafye ubumi pa bumi, ilinso pa linso, ilino pa lino, icisansa pa cisansa, ulukasa nalo pa lukasa.”

english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.
translation: Mukapangileko imisebo, kabili mukakanya mu fiputulwa fitatu icalo Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokumupeela nge cacishilano. Epakuti onse uwaipaya umuntu mubiye eko abutukila.

english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—
translation: Ili e funde pa muntu uwaipaya umuntu mubiye ukwabula umufulo kabili ukwabula impatila yakale, elyo abutukila kuli iyi misumba pakupususha ubumi bwakwe.

english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.
translation: Tutile, abantu babili nga baya mu mpanga mukuteta ifimuti, elyo pakusunsha isembe lilya aletema, lyasokoka, lyakoma no munankwe, afwa no kufwa. Uyo muntu kuti abutukila mu musumba wa musango uyu, lyena ninshi apusuka.

english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.
translation: Epali kalandula wa mulopa amukonka mu cipyu, amusanga pantu umusumba wakubutukilako uli ukutali nganshi, kabili amwipaya, nelyo ashilingile kufwa, nangu ulya muntu aipeye umunankwe ukwabula impatila yakale.

english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.
translation: E mulandu wine namukonkomesha ukuti mukwatepo imisumba itatu iyakubutukilako.

english: If the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;
translation: “Lesa akamupeela icalo conse ico alaile ifikolwe fyenu nga mwalakonka bwino amafunde yonse aya namukonkomesha ilelo, ukutemwa Yawe Lesa wenu no kulaenda lyonse mu nshila shakwe.

english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.
translation: Nomba nga Yawe Lesa wenu akushishako icalo cenu, ngefyo alaile no mulapo ku fikolwe fyenu, lyena mukapatulepo imisumba na imbi itatu.

english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
translation: Aya e mashiwi Mose aebele abena Israeli bonse, ilyo bali mu matololo mu Araba ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani. Bali mwiwanga lya Yordani mupepi na Sufu, pakati ka Parani na Tofeli, Labani, Haseloti na Disahabu.

english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu, namusandulula icakuti ilelo mufulile nge ntanda sha mu mulu.

english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
translation: Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu, amuleke musanduluke imiku ikana limo (1,000), kabili amupaale ngomo alaile!

english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
translation: Nomba bushe kwena kuti nasenda shani amafya yenu ne fisendo fyenu, elyo no kupusana kwenu, ine nekafye?

english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
translation: Kanshi saleni ukufuma mu nko shenu shonse lumo lumo abantu bamo abacenjela, abacindikwa, kabili abamano, pakuti ebo ncite bacilolo benu.’

english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
translation: Na imwe mwanjaswike amuti, ‘Ico walanda ukucita, ala cintu icisuma nganshi.’

english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakubuula intungulushi sha nko shenu ishamano kabili ishacindikwa, esho nasonta ukulamutungulula. Shimo shalatungulula abantu amakana, shimbi abantu mu myanda, shimbi abantu mu makumi yasano, shimbi nasho abantu mu makumi. Elyo nasonta na bacilolo bambi abakumona pa nko shenu shonse lumo lumo.

english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
translation: Napali ilya nshita, ine natile ku ntungulushi shenu, ‘Muleumfwa imilandu ilecitika pakati ka bamunyinenwe, elyo mulepingula bwino no mulinganya. Nangufye umulandu uli pakati ka bena Israeli beka beka nangufye ni pakati ka mwina Israeli no mwinafyalo.

english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
translation: Tecakwesha kuba na mucishacinani pakupingula umulandu. Bonse mulebalinganya nangu abe shani. Tekwesha kutiina muntu nelyo umo, pantu ubupingushi bwaba na Lesa. Muleleta umulandu onsefye uwamwansha kuli ine, naisa umfwa umo ulolele.’

english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
translation: Kabili na pa nshita ilya, nalimwebele fyonse ifyo mwali nokulacita.

english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
translation: “Nomba ngefyo Yawe Lesa wesu atukonkomeshe, twafumine ku Holebu no kuya ukulungatana ne calo ca mpili ica bena Amoli, mu matololo ayakalamba kabili ayakutiina icibi no kuya fika na ku Kadeshi Banea.

english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
translation: Ubulendo ukufuma ku Holebu no kuya ku Kadeshi Banea ukupita umusebo wa ku lupili lwa Seiri, lwendo lwa nshiku ikumi limo na bumo (11).

english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.
translation: Elyo natile kuli imwe, ‘Nomba mwafika mu calo ca mpili ica bena Amoli, ico Yawe Lesa wesu aletupeela.

english: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
translation: “Elyo imwe bonse mwaishile kuli ine no kusosa amuti, ‘Leka tutale tutume inengu, pakuti bakese twebako amashiwi palwa nshila iyingalinga ukupitamo, na palwa misumba ilimo, iyo tuli nokuyamo.’

english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
translation: Ine nacimwene ukuti naciwama, eico kanshi na ine nasalile abantu ikumi limo na babili (12) ukufuma kuli cila luko lwenu umuntu umo.

english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
translation: Nabo epakuya ku calo ca mpili, kabili baya fika na kwishika lya Eshikoli no kulengula.

english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”
translation: Ukuf 18:25

english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.
translation: “Lelo imwe tamwalefwaya ukuya muli cilya calo, mwasangukile ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomeshe.

english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.
translation: Mwaleisosha mu matenti yenu amuti, ‘Yawe alitupatafye, ico atufumishishe mu Egupto ni kukwisa tuposa mu minwe ya bena Amoli, pakuti batulofye.

english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
translation: Bushe ni kwi twingaya? Awe ifwe natwikatwa no mwenso. Bamunyinefwe nabatufuupula imitima, batile, “Abantu abekala muli cilya calo, bamaka kabili batali ukutucila. Bena bekala mu misumba iyikalamba iyakuulwa na malinga ayafika na mu mulu. Twamweneko na bena Anaki, ifipokapoka fya bantu.” ’

english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
translation: “Nomba ine namwebele nati, ‘Mwibatiina, kabili mwitutuma.

english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,
translation: Pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi uwalenga ikumi limo na umo (11), mu mwaka walenga amakumi yane (40) elyo Mose aebele abena Israeli fyonse ifyo Yawe amukonkomeshe pali bena.

english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu ewakulamutungulula, kabili ewakulamulwilako, nga filya fine mwaimwenene na menso yenu ifyo acitile mu calo ca Egupto.

english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
translation: Kabili nga filya fine mwayimwenene mu matololo ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu amusendele, nga filya wishi asenda umwana wakwe umwaume, mu nshilafye yonse mwaendelemo, mpaka ukwisa fika na pali cino cifulo.’

english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,
translation: Nomba nangu cali ifyo, nalyo line imwe tamwatetekele Yawe Lesa wenu,

english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
translation: “Ilyo Yawe aumfwile ukuilishanya kwenu, nao alifulilwe. Epakulapa ati,

english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
translation: ‘Tapali nangu umo pali aba bantu ba nkulo ibi uukengila mu calo icisuma ico nalaile ifikolwe fyenu.

english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”
translation: Kanofye Kalebu mwana Yefune, ena eukengilamo. Nkamupeela pamo na ba mu lupwa lwakwe icalo ico aile lengula, pantu alikonka Yawe no mutima wakwe onse.’

english: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
translation: Pa mulandu wa imwe, Yawe alinkalipile na ine wine no kutila, ‘Na iwe wine Mose tawakengilemo muli cilya calo.

english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
translation: Lelo kafwa obe, Yoshua mwana Nuni, ena eukengilamo. Mukoseleshe, pantu eukatungulula abena Israeli kukupoka icalo.

english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
translation: Kabili abana benu abanono, abashilaishiba ifibi ne fisuma, abo mwatile bakabasenda bunkole, ebakengila mu calo, ebo nkapeela icalo no kucipoka ebakacipoka.

english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
translation: Apa ninshi ni panuma yakucimfya imfumu Sihoni iya bena Amoli, iyaleteeka mu Heshiboni. Kabili pa Edilei acimfishepo Ogi, imfumu ya calo ca Bashani iyaleteeka mu Ashitaroti.

english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
translation: Nomba imwe alulukeni no kubwelelela mu matololo, konkeni umusebo walola kuli Bemba Wakashika .’

english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
translation: “Elyo imwe mwanjaswike amuti, ‘Natubifya kuli Yawe. Tuli nokuyafye ku bulwi, ngefyo Yawe Lesa wesu atukonkomeshe.’ Kanshi onse uwa muli imwe aipangeshe ne fyanso fyakwe nokuya ku bulwi, mwaleti cintu cayanguka ukunina mu calo ca mpili.

english: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
translation: Nomba Yawe epakunjeba ati, ‘Bebe beyanina kukulwa, pantu ine nshabe na imwe. Baleya mucimfya ku balwani benu.’

english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
translation: Ine nalimwebele ifyo Yawe anjebele, lelo imwe mwalikene ukumfwa. Mwatalamine ifunde lyakwa Yawe. Na ku cilumba cenu mwaya ingila na mu calo ca mpili.

english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
translation: Elyo abekalacalo ca mu Amoli bamwishilila nge nshimu, no kumukunkunika, kabili bamupumaula ukumufumya ku Seiri mpaka ku Homa.

english: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
translation: Kanshi na imwe mwabwelele no kulilila kuli Yawe, lelo taumfwile kulila kwenu, nangufye ukukutika kuli imwe iyoo.

english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
translation: “Eico kanshi, ecalengele ukuti mwikale ku Kadeshi Banea inshiku ishingi, pa nshita iyitali mwaikele kulya.”

english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
translation: Ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani mu calo ca Moabu eko Mose atendekele ukulondolola amafunde.

english: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
translation: “Yawe Lesa wesu atwebele pa lupili lwa Holebu ati, ‘Namwikalisha nganshi pali ulu lupili.

english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
translation: Kulululeni inkambi. Akuyeni mulungame mu calo ca bena Amoli, na mu ncende shonse isha bena mupalamano babo mu Araba, na mu mpili, na ku kapinda ka ku kuso, mu matololo ya Negebu, na mu lulamba lwa bemba, ukufika na mu calo ca bena Kenani na ku Lebanoni, ukufikafye na ku mumana uukalamba uwa Yufurate.

english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
translation: Moneni, nimupeela ici calo. Akuyeni mucipoke, pantu e calo Yawe alapile ukuti ali nokupeela ifikolwe fyenu Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, na ku ba mu ndupwa shabo abakakonkapo.’

english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
translation: “Na pa nshita ilya namwebele nati, ‘Cangafya ukulamutungulula nekafye.

english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Ilyo mukalaya ku nkondo kukulwisha abalwani benu, elyo mwamona bakabalwe na maceleta ne bumba lya fita ilikulu ukumucila, tecakwesha kubatiina. Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu Egupto, akalaba na imwe.

english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.
translation: “Nga mwalaya kukulwisha umusumba, abena musumba kuti mwabatumina amashiwi yakubepusha nga balefwaya icibote.

english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.
translation: Nga cakuti basumina, baisula ne mpongolo shabo, bonse bali nokubafye abasha benu, kabili bali nokulabombela imwe umulaasa.

english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
translation: Nomba nga bakaana icibote, babusha ne nkondo, ninshi mushinguluke uyo musumba.

english: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;
translation: Ilyo Yawe Lesa wenu alenga ukuti mupoke uyo musumba, imwe mukaleipaya bonse abaume ababamo.

english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.
translation: Nomba kuti mwaisendelamo abanakashi, abaice ne fitekwa, elyo na fyonse ifyaba muli uyo musumba nge fitapwa. Kuti mwalabomfya ifintu fyonse ifyo mwatapa ku balwani benu, pantu ni Yawe Lesa wenu ewamupeele.

english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.
translation: Ifi efyo mukalecita ku misumba yonse iyikaba ukutali na imwe, iyishili ya mishobo imbi mupepi.

english: But of the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;
translation: “Nomba mu misumba iyaba mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela nge cacishilano, mukaleipayamo fyonse ifipema.

english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the LORD your God has commanded you;
translation: Mukapeele bonsefye kukonaulwa, abena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Kenani, abena Peresi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi, ngefyo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomeshe.

english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against the LORD your God.
translation: Pantu limbi, kuti bamusambilishako ukukonka imisango yabo yonse iyabipisha iyakupepelamo imilungu yabo. Na imwe ninshi mwabifya kuli Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?
translation: “Ilyo mwashinguluka umusumba pa nshita iyitali, mwalwisha pakuti muupokolole, mwikalaonaula miti mukukomaulamo amasembe, pantu kuti mwalyako ifitwalo fyauko. Mwikalaitema iyoo. Bushe imiti ya mu mabala bantu abakuti mushinguluke?

english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,
translation: Ilyo tamulati mutendeke ukulwa, shimapepo akaleisa kukulanda ne fita.

english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
translation: Lelo kuti mwatema imiti iyo mwishibe ukuti teyafitwalo, kuti mwaibomfya ilyo muleshinga umusumba mulelwisha mpakafye mwaupoka.”

english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;
translation: Akalesosa ati, ‘Umfweni, mwebena Israeli! Ilelo muleya ku nkondo kukulwisha abalwani benu. Tecakwesha kubatiina nangu ukufupuka, mwikwata umwenso nangu ukutunsha imitima pa menso ya balwani benu.

english: for the LORD your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu muleya nankwe, akulamulwishishako kabili aleya lenga ukuti muye cimfya.’

english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
translation: “Elyo bakangalila ba fita fyankondo bakalanda ku fita ati, ‘Bushe palipo umuntu uukuulile iŋanda ipya, lelo tailapaalwa? Nabwelele kumwakwe, epali aya fwila mu nkondo, elyo no muntu umbi eo akalenge ikapaalwe.

english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.
translation: Bushe palipo umuntu uulimbile imyangashi mwibala, iyo talatampa kulyako? Nabwelele kumwakwe, epali aya fwila mu nkondo, elyo no muntu umbi eo akashale alelyako.

english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”
translation: Bushe palipo umuntu uwakobekela umwanakashi, uo ashilaupa? Nabwelele kumwakwe, epali aya fwila mu nkondo, elyo no muntu umbi eo akashale amuupa.’

english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”
translation: “Kabili bakangalila ba fita fyankondo bakalakonkanyapo ukweba ifita ati, ‘Bushe pano tuli palipo umuntu uuletiina nangu ukufupuka? Nga epo ali nabwelele kumwakwe, epali aya fupula abanankwe.’

english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.
translation: Nga bakangalila ba fita fyankondo bapwa ukulanda ku fita, bafwile ukusonta abakalamba ba fita.

english: If someone is found slain in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Nga cakuti mwasanga umuntu nabamwipaya, alele mu mpanga, mu calo ico Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela ukucipoka, nomba uwamwipaya teshibikwe.

english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,
translation: “Ilyo mwaya kukulwisha abalwani benu, na Yawe Lesa wenu alenga ukuti mucimfye mu nkondo no kusenda bankole.

english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,
translation: Nga wamonapo nkole umo umwanakashi umusuma nganshi uo watemwa, kuti wamubuula ukuba umukashi obe.

english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.
translation: Uyo mwanakashi umusende kumobe, abeye ne mishishi, asembe ne ngala,

english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
translation: elyo afuule ifyakufwala fya bunkole. Panuma yakwikala mu ŋanda umweshi utuntulu no kuloosha wishi na nyina, lyena kuti wamuupa waba umulume nao aba umukashi.

english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
translation: Nomba nga takusekeshe, lyena muleke aye konse uko engatemwa ukuya. Tauli na kumushitisha, nangu ukumucita ngo musha, pantu wamupatikishafye pakulasendama nankwe.

english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume umo ali na bakashi babili, atemwapo umo umbi iyoo, elyo bonse babili bamufyalila abana abaume. Elyo ibeli lyafyalwa mu mukashi ashatemwa.

english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;
translation: Ilyo uyo muntu alefwaya ukwakanya ifyuma ku bana, tafwile nakuba na mucishacinani, tafwile kupeela ifyuma fye beli ku mwana uwa mukashi uo atemwa.

english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.
translation: Pakupeela umwana wakwe uwe beli fyuma, alingile ukucishapo imiku ibili pali munyina. Nangu line tali mwana wa mu mukashi uo atemwisha. Pantu ibeli elyo ailangilepo amaka. Kanshi insambu ne cuma cine icabubeli, cakwe.

english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu umo alikwata umwana uwatalama kabili cintomfwa, umwana uushumfwila bafyashi bakwe, nangufye bamukande shani.

english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.
translation: Abafyashi bakwe, wishi na nyina bali nokumutwala ku ntungulushi sha mu musumba pa mpongolo ya musumba wakwe.

english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.
translation: Intungulushi shenu na bakapingula bali nokuya pima ubutali ukufuma apabelele icitumbi ukuya fika na ku misumba iyili mupepi.

english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
translation: Abafyashi balaeba intungulushi abati, ‘Uyu mwana wesu ni cintomfwa, kabili alitutalamina. Takonka nefyo tumweba kabili ni cakolwa.’

english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.
translation: Elyo abaume bonse aba mu musumba wenu bamupole amabwe imfwila. Lyena mukalapwisha ubo bubi pakati kenu. Umuntu onse mu calo ca Israeli ilyo akomfwako akalatiina.”

english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
translation: “Umuntu nga acita umulandu ukulu nganshi, bamwipailapo, bakulikila icitumbi cakwe na ku muti,

english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.
translation: icitumbi cakwe tacili nakulala ku cimuti iyoo. Mufwile ukucishiika ubo bwine bushiku, pantu umuntu uwakulikwa pa cimuti ninshi alitipwa kuli Lesa. Mukaleshiika ifitumbi epakukanakowesha icalo Yawe Lesa wenu ali mukumupeela.

english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.
translation: Kanshi intungulushi sha mu musumba uupalamishe pa ncende pali icitumbi shikabuule umusepela wa ŋombe iyikota, uushatala aubombapo nangu ukufwala ikoli mu mukoshi.

english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.
translation: Bakaleutwala mwishika umushatala amulimwa nangu ukubyalwamo kabili ukuli umumana uulepisha amenshi. Mwishika mwine mulya emo bakafunine uyo umusepela wa ŋombe umukoshi.

english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them the LORD your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in the LORD’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.
translation: Bashimapepo, abana baume bakwa Levi bakapalame, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alibasala pakuti ebo balebomba no kulapaala amapaalo mwishina lyakwa Yawe no kupingula imilandu yonse palwa fikansa na palwa kucenana.

english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
translation: Elyo intungulushi shonse isha mu musumba uupalamishe pa ncende pali icitumbi, shili nokusamba iminwe pa mulu wa musepela wa ŋombe uyo bafunine umukoshi mwishika,

english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
translation: no kulasosa ashiti, ‘Te minwe yesu yasumishe uyu mulopa, kabili na menso yesu tayamwene uko calecitika.

english: Forgive, LORD, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.
translation: Belela uluse abantu bobe abena Israeli abo walubula, we Yawe, elyo witupeelelapo mulandu pa mfwa ya muntu wakaele.’ Kabili no mulopa ukafutila pa fyabubifi.

english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.
translation: Kanshi efyo mukafumya pakati kenu umulandu wa kusumya konse ukwa mulopa wakaele, pantu namucita icalungama pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.
translation: “Nga wamona iŋombe atemwa impaanga iya mwina Israeli mubiyo ileendaukafye icende ende, wiilekafye, ulingile ukumutwalila.

english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
translation: “Pakulima, wikalima na pulao naukakila punda ne ŋombe mwikoli limo line.

english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
translation: “Wikalafwala nsalu iyapikulwa no bushishi bwa misango ibili ubwa masako no bwa butonge.

english: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.
translation: “Ku fisempe fyonse fine ifya nsalu shobe ukalebikako insenkebele.”

english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume aupa umwanakashi, kabili panuma yakusendama nankwe amupata,

english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”
translation: elyo amubepesha mufyo ashacita no kumutunganya ukukanaba nacisungu, ati, ‘Naupile uyu mukashana, lelo ilyo nasendeme nankwe, nshasangile icishininkisho ca bunacisungu bwakwe.’

english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.
translation: Ifi nga efyo caba, lyena wishi na nyina ba mukashana bali nokuleta icishininkisho ca bunacisungu bwakwe ku ntungulushi sha mu musumba pa mpongolo.

english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.
translation: Wishi kwa mukashana ali nokulanda ku ntungulushi ati, ‘Ine naufishe umwana wandi kuli uyu mwaume nomba namupata.

english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
translation: Elyo namutunganya no kusosa ukuti, “Ine nshasangile umwana wenu ukuba nacisungu.” Lelo ici e cakushininkishishako icisungu ca mwana wandi.’ Elyo abafyashi bakwe bakafungulule insalu pa cinso ca ntungulushi sha mu musumba.

english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.
translation: Elyo intungulushi sha mu musumba shikabuule uyu mwaume no kumukanda.

english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.
translation: Levi 19:19

english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.
translation: Ngo mwine teshibikwe atemwa ekala ukutali, uli nokuitwala kumobe. Ilyo umwine aisa alefwaya fwaya, uli nokumupeela.

english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,
translation: “Nomba, nga cakuti cacine, kabili takuli na cakushininkishishako ukuti umukashana ali ni nacisungu,

english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
translation: lyena kuti batwala uyo mukashana pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa wishi, epo abaume ba mu musumba wakwe bakamulase amabwe mpaka akafwe. Pantu nacita icamusebanya mu Israeli pakusendama no mwaume ilyo talati opwe, acili mu ŋanda yakwa wishi. Efyo mufwile ukufumya ububi pakati kenu.

english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
translation: “Nga cakuti mwasangilisha umwaume nasendama na muka mwine, bonse babili, umwaume uwasendama no mwanakashi elyo no mwanakashi wine bafwile ukufwa. Efyo mufwile ukufumya ububi pakati ka Israeli.

english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,
translation: “Nga cakuti mu musumba umwaume akumanya nacisungu uwakobekelwa, elyo asendama nankwe,

english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
translation: bonse babili mukalebatwala pa mpongolo ya musumba no kubalasaula amabwe mpaka bafwa. Pantu umukashana ali mu musumba, kabili tapundile mutuule, nao umwaume pantu aonaula icupo ca mwine. Efyo mufwile ukufumya ububi pakati kenu.

english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti umwaume mu mpanga emo akumanya umukashana uwakobekelwa, amwikata pa bukangalume no kulala nankwe, lyena umwaume eka uwacita ici euli nokufwa.

english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;
translation: Umukashana ena mwimucita nangu cimo, pantu tacitile bubifi ubwakumwipailapo. Uyu mulandu uli kwati muntu uwaimina umuntu mubiye no kumwipaya.

english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.
translation: Uyu mwaume asangile umukashana mu mpanga. Nangu line uyu umukashana uwakobekelwa apundile, takwali uwakumupokololako.

english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume akumanya nacisungu uushakobekelwa, amwikata ku bukangalume, alala nankwe elyo babasangilisha,

english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.
translation: ali nokulipila wishi kwa mukashana amashekeli ya silifa amakumi yasano (50). Afwile ukuupa umukashana pantu namonaula pakusendama nankwe. Kabili umwaume tafwile ukumuleka mpaka imfwa.

english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.
translation: Efyo uli nokucita nga wasanga punda, nangu icakufwala nangu icili conse ico umwina Israeli mubiyo alufishe. Wilasuulakofye iyoo.

english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.
translation: Ukuf 23:4

english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.
translation: “Abanakashi bekalafwala fyakufwala fya baume, abaume nabo bekalafwala fyakufwala fya banakashi. Pantu uyo onse uucita ifya uyu musango, camuselu pa menso yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.
translation: “Nga wasanga icisansala ca cuni mumbali ya musebo, nangu ku muti nangu panshi, na nyina nafukatila amani nangu utwana. Wikasenda nyina pamo no twana.

english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.
translation: Kuti wasendapofye utwana, nyina ena wamulekafye aya, epakuti cikakuwamine kabili ukaleikala inshiku ishingi.

english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.
translation: “Ilyo wakuula iŋanda iyipya, mumbali mukalekuulamo icibumba icakucingililako umutenge. Lyena umuntu nga apona no kufwa afwa, awe iwe tawakakwatilepo mulandu.

english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.
translation: “Wikalabyalamo mwibala lyobe imbuto sha misango ibili. Nga cakuti wacita ifi ninshi ifilimwa fya kuli ishi mbuto pamo pene ne fitwalo fyonse fya mwibala ili fili nokukowela.

english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Umuntu onse uo batungula nangu uo baputula ubwaume tafwile kulongana mu lukuta lwa bantu bakwa Yawe.

english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
translation: Nga cakuti umo pa baume akowela pa mulandu wakupemena panshi ku tulo ubushiku, alingile ukufumina kunse ya nkambi eko aya ikala.

english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
translation: Ilyo caba icungulo ali nokowa, akasuba cilya kawa lyena kuti abwelela ku nkambi.

english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
translation: “Mukasale incende imo kunse ya nkambi eko mukaleya ku cimbusu.

english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
translation: Pa fibombelo fyenu mulekwatapo icakwimbilako. Kabili ilyo mwayafwilisha, mukaleimba icilindi umwakushiika ubusali bwenu.

english: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alendauka mu nkambi pakumucingilila no kuposa abalwani benu mu minwe yenu. Inkambi yenu ili nokuba iyamushilo, pakuti Yawe elamona pakati kenu icintu conse icansoni icingalenga ukumutaluka.”

english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
translation: “Nga cakuti umusha abutukila kuli imwe mwimubweseshamo kuli shikulu wakwe.

english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
translation: Mulekeni ekale na imwe konse uko atemwa kabili mu musumba umwine alasala. Mwikalamucusha iyoo.

english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
translation: “Kwikalaba umwaume nangu umwanakashi umwina Israeli uwakuba cilende wa ku mfuba.

english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.
translation: Ulupiya ulo cilende umwaume nangu umwanakashi akwila telwakwesha kutwala mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pakufuta pafyo balaile, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alibapata bonse babili.

english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
translation: “Wikalafwaya kulundapo pafyo munonko akongola pa ndalama, ifyakulya nangu pa fintu fimbi ifyo wingamwenapo nga wakongwesha.

english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD’s assembly.
translation: “Umwana wa mu cupo icishasuminishiwa nangu aba mu lupwa lwakwe tabali nakulongana mu lukuta lwa bantu bakwa Yawe ukufika na pa nkulo iyalenga ikumi limo.

english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
translation: Umwinafyalo ena kuti alundapo pafyo akukongola, nomba umwina Israeli mubiyo ena iyoo, pakuti Yawe Lesa wenu akalemupaala muli fyonse ifyo mukalacita mu calo mwalaingilamo mukucipoka.

english: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
translation: “Nga cakuti walaya kuli Yawe Lesa obe, wikalashingashinga pakucita ico walaya. Pantu Yawe Lesa obe mu cinefye akacifwaya, kabili ninshi ukaba no mulandu wabubifi.

english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti wakaana ukulaya, ninshi taukwete mulandu.

english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
translation: Conse ico walanda, ushininkishe ukuti wacicita. Pantu walaile ukwabula ukupatikishiwa kuli Yawe Lesa obe, walandile na kanwa kobe.

english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
translation: “Nga cakuti waingila mwibala lya myangashi ilya mwina Israeli mubiyo, kuti walyamo ifitwalo fya myangashi apo utemenwe, nomba tecakwesha kulonga fimo mu cipe.

english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into the LORD’s assembly forever,
translation: “Takufwile ukuba umwina Amoni nangu umwina Moabu, nangu umukakonkanina aba mu nkulo shabo ukufika na pa nkulo iyalenga ikumi limo, abakasuminishiwa ukulongana mu lukuta lwakwa Yawe.

english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
translation: Pantu tabamusengele ne filyo na menshi mu bulendo bwenu ilyo mwafumine ku Egupto. Kabili mu calo ca Mesopotamia balipile Balamu mwana Beori, umwina Peto, pakuti amutipwile.

english: Nevertheless the LORD your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.
translation: Nomba Yawe Lesa wenu taumfwile kuli Balamu, ena epakwalula ukulapisha ukuba amapaalo, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alimutemwa.

english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
translation: Tecakwesha kupangana nabo icibusa inshiku sha bumi bwenu.

english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
translation: “Mwikalapata umwina Edomu pantu ni munyinenwe. Kabili mwikalapata umwina Egupto pantu mwaikele nga benafyalo mu calo cakwe.

english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.
translation: Abana babo bakafyalwa ukufuma pa nkulo yalenga butatu, bena kuti balalonganako mu lukuta lwa bantu bakwa Yawe.”

english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
translation: “Pa nshita ya nkondo na balwani benu, ilyo mukalaba mu nkambi, mukaletaluka kuli fyonse ifyakowela.

english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Nga cakuti umwaume aupa umwanakashi uushimusekeshe pantu amonamo kamo akabi, elyo alemba kalata wakumulekelapo, apeela no mwanakashi, amutamfya na mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.
translation: Iwe iminina panse no kulolela umwine uo wakongwesha eo ese akupeele.

english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu mulanda, wikaya kukusendama ilyo ucili ne cikatila mulandu.

english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.
translation: Kol 5:13

english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
translation: “Wikalacenjelela mubomfi uo waingisha incito umulanda kabili uukabila, nangu engaba mwina Israeli mubiyo, nangufye umwinafyalo uwikala mu musumba wenu umo.

english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.
translation: Cila bushiku ilyo akasuba takalawa uli nokumulipila, pantu mulanda alekabila ayo malipilo yene. Nga taulemulipila kuti akulilila kuli Yawe, nobe ninshi ukakwatilapo umulandu.

english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
translation: Ukuf 21:16

english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;
translation: “Mwikalapoka abenafyalo nangu bakashiwa insambu, nangu ukupokolola mukamfwilwa icakufimbana, pakuba icikatila mulandu.

english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
translation: Mukaleibukisha ukuti nemwe bene mwali abasha mu Egupto, kabili Yawe Lesa wenu ewamulubwile no kumufumyamo. E mulandu wine namukonkomesesha ukulacita ici.

english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
translation: Amaf 27:19

english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.
translation: Kabili nga cakuti afuma mu ŋanda yakwe aya upwa ku mwaume umbi,

english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
translation: Esek 18:20

english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
translation: Ilyo mwapwisha ukusaba ifitwalo fya myangashi mwibala lyenu, mwikalabwelelako no kuya saba utusheleko. Utusheleko twena mukalelekela abenafyalo, bakashiwa na bamukamfwilwa.

english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;
translation: no mulume wacibili nao amupata, kabili amulembela na kalata wakumulekelapo, amupeela, amutamfya na mu ŋanda yakwe, nangu nga cakuti uyu mulume wacibili afwa,

english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.
translation: Mako 10:4

english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume elyo opile, tafwile kuya ku nkondo nangu ukupeelwa umulimo umbi. Pa mwaka umo ali nokulaikalafye pa ŋanda pamwakwe, alesansamusha umukashi wakwe uo opile.

english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
translation: “Tecakwesha kubuula impelo shonse shibili nangu umwana wa mpelo ukuba icikatilo ca pa nkongole, pantu cimo no kubuula ubumi bwa muntu ukuba icikatilo.

english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.
translation: “Nga ni pa mulandu wa malwele ya fibashi , mukalesakamana ukulacita ngefyo bashimapepo abena Levi bakulamweba. Mufwile ukukonka bwino ifyo nabakonkomesesha.

english: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
translation: Muleibukisha ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu acitile kuli Miriamu mu nshila ilyo mwafumine mu Egupto.

english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.
translation: “Ilyo abantu babili bafilwa ukumfwana, bali nokutwala uyu umulandu ku cilye, na bakapingula bali nokuputula uyu umulandu. Uushili na mulandu bali nokumweba ukuti wakaele, umbi ena ali nokupeelwa umulandu.

english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”
translation: Mu calo ca Israeli ishina lya ulo lupwa lwa mwaume bakalalwita abati, ‘Ulupwa Lwakwa Mufulwa Lusapato.’ ”

english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,
translation: “Nga cakuti abaume babili balelwa, elyo muka umo pa balelwa aisa kukupokolola umulume wakwe ku ulemuma, aikata ku fyamfwalo fya uyo umbi,

english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.
translation: uyo mwanakashi mufwile ukumuputulako icisansa, tecakwesha kumubelela luse.

english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
translation: “Mwikalakwata fipimino fibili mu mufuko wenu, icafina ne cayanguka.

english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.
translation: Mwikalakwata mu ŋanda yenu ifipimo fya misango ibili, icikulu na kanono.

english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: Mukalekwata ifipimo ifyalingana kabili ifyacishinka, pakuti mukekale inshiku ishingi mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela.

english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alipata umuntu onse uucita ifi fintu mu bucenjeshi bwa uyu musango.

english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,
translation: “Mukaleibukisha ifintu abena Amaleki bamucitile mu nshila lilya mwafumine mu Egupto.

english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
translation: Timo 5:18

english: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.
translation: Mako 12:19

english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
translation: Uwamulandu nga bali nokumuma ifikoti, kapingula ali nokulalika uyo muntu panshi pakumuma ifikoti pa cinso cakwe, impendwa ukulingana no mulandu acitile.

english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.
translation: Nomba tabali nakumuma ifikoti ukucila pa makumi yane (40). Nga fyacilapo kuti munyinenwe asebanina pa menso yenu.

english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.
translation: “Wilakaka ŋombe ku kanwa ilyo ilenyantaula iŋanu pakushisokola.”

english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
translation: “Nga cakuti bamunyina bekala pamo, elyo umo afwa ukwabula ukufyalapo umwana umwaume, mukamfwilwa talingile kupwa ku muntu umbi uushili wa mu lupwa lwakwa wiba. Munyina wa mulume ali nokumusenda ukuba umukashi wakwe, alebomba ne milimo munyina alebomba.

english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.
translation: Umwana wantanshi umwaume uo umwanakashi akafyala, ali nokulaitwa ishina lya uyo uwafwa, munyina kwa wishi, pakuti ishina lyakwe likaloba mu Israeli.

english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”
translation: Nomba, nga cakuti munyina akaana ukupa uyo mwanakashi, ali nokuya ku bakalamba pa mpongolo ya musumba no kuya beba ati, ‘Munyina kwa mulume wandi nakaana ukubuula ishina lyakwa munyina mu Israeli. Taalemombela ifyo munyina alemombela.’

english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”
translation: Abakalamba ba musumba bakete uyu munyina no kulanshanya nankwe. Nga cakuti atwalilila ukusosa ukuti, ‘Nshilefwaya ukumuupa,’

english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”
translation: Kol 9:9

english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Ilyo mukengila mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela nge cacishilano, kabili mwacipoka nokulaikalamo,

english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.
translation: Eico nomba nakuletela ifisabo fyantanshi ifya mu mushili uo we Yawe wampeela.’ Ukateke umuseke pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa obe elyo ukamupepe no kumupepa.

english: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.
translation: Kanshi iwe na bena Levi na benafyalo abo mwikala nabo mukasansamukile capamo pa fintu ifisuma ifyo Yawe Lesa obe akupeela pamo na ba mu ŋanda yobe.

english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.
translation: Elyo ukasose kuli Yawe Lesa obe auti, ‘Ine nimfumya mu ŋanda yandi icipande camushilo kabili nincipeela ku bena Levi, ku benafyalo, bakashiwa na kuli bamukamfwilwa, ukulingana ngefyo wakonkomesha. Nshipulile amafunde yobe nangu ukulabapo ifunde limo.

english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.
translation: Ine nshalyapo nelyo kamo pa cipande camushilo ilyo naleloosha, nangu ukufumyapo kamo ilyo nali uwakowela, nangu ukutuulapo kamo ku bafwa. Nalibeela Yawe Lesa wandi. Nalicita na fyonse ifyo wankonkomesha.

english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
translation: Lolesha ukufuma ku mulu, icifulo cobe icamushilo uko waikala, kabili upaale na bantu bobe abena Israeli no mushili uo watupeela ngefyo walaile ku fikolwe fyesu no mulapo, icalo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci.’

english: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
translation: “Ubushiku bwe lelo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomesha ukulakonka amafunde ne fipope ifi. Mulefibaka bwino ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse.

english: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
translation: Namuisosela ilelo ukuti Yawe e Lesa wenu, mwakulaenda mu nshila shakwe, mwakulasunga ifyebo, ifipope na mafunde yakwe nokuti mwakulamubeela.

english: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
translation: Kabili Yawe nao nasosa ilelo ukuti muli bantu bakwe abo acindamika, nokuti muli nokulasunga amafunde yakwe yonse.

english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
translation: mukabuule ifisabo fyantanshi fimo pafyo mukasombola mu mushili wa mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela. Kabili mukafilonge na mu museke mukafitwale ku ncende Yawe Lesa wenu akasala nge cifulo ce shina lyakwe.

english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
translation: Elyo mukatile kuli shimapepo alipo pali iyo nshita, ‘Ine ilelo nasosa kuli Yawe Lesa wandi ukuti ninjisa mu calo ico Yawe alapile ku fikolwe fyesu ukuti akatupeela.’

english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.
translation: “Shimapepo akapoka umuseke mu minwe yenu no kuubika pa ntanshi ya bulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
translation: Elyo mukasose amashiwi aya pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu amuti, ‘Tata ali mwina Aramu, uwalelulumbafye. Kabili aile kukwikala ku Egupto na bantu abanono, basuka basanduluka baba umushobo uukalamba, uwamaka.

english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
translation: Lelo abena Egupto baletusunga buluku buluku no kulenga ukuti tucule kukubomba imilimo yacibe.

english: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.
translation: Kanshi na ifwe epakulilila kuli Yawe Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu, na Yawe aumfwa ishiwi lyesu, kabili amona no bucushi bwesu, ukutitikishiwa ne milimo yacibe.

english: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakutufumya mu Egupto ku maka yakwe ayabulamba no kuboko kwakwe ukwatambalala, ku fipeshamano ne finjelengwe, na kufyakutiinya ifikalamba.

english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translation: Ewatuleta kuli cino cifulo kabili atupeela na cino calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci.

english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
translation: Mose pamo na bakalamba ba mu Israeli bakonkomeshe abantu ati, “Mulebaka amafunde yonse ayo namupeela ilelo.

english: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
translation: Mulebeela Yawe Lesa wenu no kulakonka amafunde ne fipope ifyo namupeela ilelo.”

english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku bwine bulya, Mose akonkomeshe abantu ati,

english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
translation: “Ilyo mukaabuka Yordani, ishi nko shikeminine pa lupili lwa Gerisimu no kupaala abantu. Ne nko ni ishi: Abena Simeoni, abena Levi, abena Yuda, abena Isaka, abena Yosefu na bena Benjamini.

english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
translation: Kabili ishi nko shena shikeminine pa lupili lwa Ebali pakulapisha abantu. Ne nko ni ishi: abena Rubeni, abena Gadi, abena Asheri, abena Sebuloni, abena Dani na bena Naftali.

english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
translation: Abena Levi bakekatishe pakwankula aya mashiwi, bakebe abena Israeli bonse abati,

english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu uubasa icakupashanya nangu ukwenga akalubi, akapangwa na maboko ya bantu, elyo no kulakapepa mu bumfisolo, icintu ico Yawe apata.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu uukasuula wishi na nyina.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu uukalenga impofu ukuluba inshila.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa uukalafyengelesha abenafyalo, bakashiwa nangu bamukamfwilwa.’

english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
translation: Ilyo mukaabuka Yordani no kwingila mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela, mukemike amabwe yamo ayakulu, elyo mukayamase.

english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa uukasendama na bamuka wishi pantu asebanya ubusanshi bwakwa wishi.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: Ukuf 22:21

english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa uukasendama na nkashi yakwe uwafyalwa kuli wishi nangu kuli nyina.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: Levi 18:23

english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa uukepaya umubiye nangu ni mu bumfisolo.’

english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translation: Ukuf 20:25

english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
translation: “‘Abe uwalapishiwa uukakaana ukubika umutima ku mafunde aya yonse no kukanayakonka.’

english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
translation: Mukalembepo pa mabwe amashiwi ya mafunde aya ilyo mukaabuka pakwingila mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela, icalo umufumfumuka umukaka no buci ngefyo Yawe Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu amulaile.

english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
translation: Kanshi ilyo mukaabuka Yordani, mukemike aya mabwe pa lupili lwa Ebali, ngefyo namukonkomesha ilelo, kabili nokuyamasa

english: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
