translation: Mukakuule palya pene ubulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu ubwa mabwe. Mwikabomfya icibombelo ca cela pali aya mabwe.

english: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
translation: Mukakuule ubulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wenu na mabwe ayashaputulwa ayatuntulu, epo mukatuulile amalambo yakocela Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.
translation: Palya pene epo mukalekele amalambo yakwampana, ukuyalya no kusansamuka pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
translation: Pali ayo mabwe mukemika, mukalembepo bwino bwino amashiwi ya mafunde aya.”

english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.
translation: Elyo Mose na bashimapepo abena Levi baebele Israeli onse ati, “Ikala tondolo, we Israeli, kabili umfwe! Imwe nomba mwaba abantu bakwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
translation: “Kabili nga cakuti mukalaumfwila Yawe Lesa wenu no kulakonka bwino amafunde yakwe yonse ayo ine namupeela ilelo, Yawe Lesa wenu akamucita umushobo ukalamba ukucila imishobo yonse iya pano isonde.

english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse pano isonde bakamona ukuti mwaitwa kwishina lyakwa Yawe, elyo nokutiina bakalamutiina.

english: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
translation: Yawe akamupeela ubukankala nganshi mu bufyashi bwa mwifumo lyenu, ifitekwa fyenu na mu fisabo fya mu mushili wenu mu calo alaile ifikolwe fyenu ukumupeela.

english: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
translation: Yawe akamwiswila umulu, umo atutila ifya bukankala bwakwe. Akalatuma imfula pa nshita yaiko, kabili akapaala ne milimo ya maboko yenu. Mukalaashimishako imishobo iyingi ifintu, lelo imwe tamwakaashime kantu ku mushobo nangu umo.

english: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
translation: Kanshi tecakwesha kupulapo ifunde nangu limo payo namupeela ilelo, ukwalukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso mukukonka imilungu imbi no kuitumika.

english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti mwakaana ukulaumfwila Yawe Lesa wenu, kabili mwakaana no kulakonka bwino amafunde ne fipope fyakwe fyonse ifyo ine ndemupeela ilelo, ukulapisha konse uku kukamwishila no kumucimfya.

english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
translation: “Mukalapishiwa mu musumba, kabili mukalapishiwa mu mpanga.

english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
translation: “Imiseke yenu ne fyakukasawilamo umufuba fili nokulapishiwa.

english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
translation: “Ubufyashi bwa mwifumo lyenu bukalapishiwa pamo ne fisabo fya mushili wenu, abana ba ŋombe shenu elyo na bana ba mpaanga shenu.

english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
translation: “Muli nokulapishiwa ilyo mukalaingila nelyo mukalafuma.

english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
translation: Amapaalo yonse aya yakesa pali imwe, kabili mukalaba nayo nga mwalapetamina Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
translation: “Yawe akatuma pali imwe ukulapishiwa, icimfulunganya elyo no kukalipilwa muli fyonse ifyo mukalacita ne minwe yenu, mpakafye mukonaike no kuloba bwangu pa mulandu wa bubi mwacita ubwakusuula Yawe.

english: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
translation: Yawe akamuletela icikuko ca malwele mpakafye akamulofye mu calo mwalaingila mukucipoka.

english: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
translation: Yawe akamulwalika amalwele ya ntandabwanga, cifimba ne mpepo. Akaleta ne cilala icikali no kukabisha no bulwele bwakukonkotanika amabula no kufufuma. Ifikuko fikaba pali imwe mpaka mukalobe.

english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
translation: Umulu ukakosa ngo mukuba, no mushili uo ukanyantapo ukaba nge cela.

english: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
translation: Yawe akaalula imfula ya calo cenu ukuba ulukungu no lufukutu, efikalafuma mu mulu mpakafye mukalobe.

english: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
translation: Yawe akalenga abalwani benu ukumucimfya. Pakuya kukubalwisha mukalatula ku ntungafye imo, lelo pakufulumuka lyena mukalasalanganina mu ntunga cine lubali. Kabili aba mu bufumu bonse ubwa pano isonde bakapapa no kumfwa umwenso.

english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
translation: Ifitumbi fyenu fikaba ifyakulya fya fyuni fya mu lwelele ne fiswango fya mu mpanga. Kabili takwakaleba nangu umo uwakufitamfyapo.

english: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
translation: Yawe akamulwalika ifipute fya ku Egupto elyo na bamumena, ifilonda fya pa nkanda ne fiseseya, amalwele ayashakaleposhiwa.

english: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
translation: Yawe akalamulwalika ubushilu, ubupofu no kufulungana kwa mano.

english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
translation: Nangu akasuba kali pakati ka mutwe, imwe mukalapulumpunta nge mpofu mu mfifi. Tamwakaleba ne shuko mu cintufye conse ico mukalacita. Cila bushiku, bakalamufyenga no kulamwibilafye pe, lelo takwakaleba nelyo umo uwakumupokololako.

english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
translation: “Mukapaalwa mu musumba kabili mukapaalwa na mu mpanga.

english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
translation: “Mukalakobekela abakashana bakuupa, lelo ni bambi bakababuula no kusendama nabo ku maka. Mukalakuula amayanda, lelo tamwakaleikalamo. Mukalabyala imyangashi, lelo tamwakatale amulyako fisabo fyaiko.

english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
translation: Bakalaipaila iŋombe shenu pa cinso cenu, lelo imwe tamwakalelyako. Bakalasenda bapunda benu ku maka no kubabwesha iyoo. Bakalapeela abalwani benu impaanga shenu, lelo takwakaleba uwakushipokololako.

english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
translation: Abana benu abaume na banakashi, bakalabapeela ku mushobo umbi, elyo cila bushiku mukalakalifyafye amenso pakuti mumone uko abana benu balebwela, lelo mukabulwa amaka yakucitapo cimo.

english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
translation: Abantu abo mushaishiba ebakalalya ifisabo ifikafuma mu mushili na mu maka yenu, lelo imwe mukalapelwapofye no kulaculilapo buluku buluku cila bushiku.

english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
translation: Ifintu ifyo mukalamona fikamupenya.

english: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
translation: Yawe akalamulwalika ifipute ifikali ku molu na mu makufi ifishakaleposhiwa ukufuma ku makasa ukushinta na ku mutwe.

english: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
translation: “Yawe akamutwala, imwe pamo ne mfumu mukasonta, ku mushobo umbi uo imwe nangu ifikolwe fyenu fishatala afishiba. Kulya eko mukalapepa imilungu imbi, iyapangwa ku fimuti na ku mabwe.

english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.
translation: Abakalamona bakapapa no kumfwa umwenso. Bakalamuwela nokumuseka ku mishobo yonse uko Yawe akamufulumwina.

english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
translation: “Mukalabyala imbuto ishingi mu mabala, lelo mukalasombola utunono pantu makanta akalya ifisabo fyenu.

english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
translation: Mukalima amabala ya myangashi no kuyasekwila, lelo tamwakanweko mwangashi nangu ukusombolako ifisabo, pantu ifinsenda fikalya.

english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
translation: “Ubufyashi bwa mwifumo lyenu bukaba ubwapaalwa pamo ne fisabo fya mu mushili wenu, abana ba fitekwa fyenu, abana ba ŋombe shenu elyo na bana ba mpaanga shenu.

english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
translation: Mukakwata imiti ya miolifa mu calo cenu conse, lelo tamwakengeko mafuta no kuyabomfya, pantu imiolifa ikalukuta.

english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
translation: Mukalakwata abana abaume na banakashi, lelo tamwakabe nabo pantu bakasendwa muli bunkole.

english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
translation: Makanta akonaula imiti yenu yonse ne filimwa fya mu mushili wenu onse.

english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
translation: “Abenafyalo abo muleikala nabo mu calo cenu bakalacindaminakofye, elyo imwe mwakulabwelelafye kunuma.

english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
translation: Bena ebakalamukongwesha, lelo imwe tamwakalebakongwesha. Bena bakaba imitwe, lelo imwe mukaba imicila.

english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
translation: “Ukulapisha konse uku kukesa pali imwe, kukamukonka no kumusanga mpaka mukalobe, pantu mwakene ukubeela Yawe Lesa wenu nokulakonka amafunde ne fipope amupeele.

english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
translation: Efikaba icakwishibilako ne cisungusho kuli imwe na ba mu ndupwa shenu pe na pe.

english: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
translation: Yawe alimupaalile muli fyonse, nomba imwe mwalifililwe ukumubombela ne mitima yenu yonse ne nsansa mu nshita ya bukankala.

english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
translation: Eico nomba mukalabombela abalwani Yawe akamutumina abakumulwisha, kabili ni mu nsala ne cilaka, mukusapula ne cipowe icishaibipila. Akamukulikila ikoli lya cela mu mikoshi mpaka akamulofye.

english: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
translation: Yawe akamuletela umushobo wakumulwisha ukufuma ukutali, ukufuma ku mpela ye sonde, nga kapumpe afukukila icintu, abantu abo mukafilwa ukutesha ululimi lwabo.

english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
translation: “Imiseke yenu ne fyakukashilamo imifuba fili nokupaalwa.

english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
translation: Mushobo wa bantu abakatama ifinso, uwabula umucinshi ku bakalamba kabili uwabula uluse ku baice.

english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
translation: Ebakesa onaula utwana twa fitekwa fyenu ne fisabo fya mu mushili wenu mpakafye mukalobe. Tabakamushileko iŋanu, nangu umwangashi upya, nangu amafuta nangu abana ba ŋombe nangu impaanga pa fitekwa fyenu, mpakafye na imwe bene mukalobelele.

english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.
translation: Bakashinguluka imisumba yenu yonse mu calo cenu mpaka amalinga ayashailepela ayo mwacetekelamo yakabongoloke. Bakashinguluka imisumba yonse mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu alamupeela.

english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
translation: “Pa mulandu wa bucushi abalwani benu bakamuletela ilyo bakamushinguluka, mukalalya abana ba mwifumo lyenu, umunofu wa bana benu abaume na banakashi abo Yawe Lesa wenu amupeela.

english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
translation: Kabili no mwaume wamutembo nganshi kabili uwanakilila pakati kenu, takakwatile munyina wakwe inkumbu nangufye umukashi wakwe uo atemwisha, nangu abana bakwe bashelepo.

english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
translation: Kabili takapeleko nangu umo umunofu wa bana abo alelya. Pantu e cakulya akashalafye naco, pa mulandu wa balwani abakashinguluka imisumba no bucushi bakamuletela.

english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
translation: Umwanakashi wamutembo nganshi kabili uwanakilila pakati kenu, icakuti tekuti anyante akatende kakwe panshi, takaakanyeko umulume wakwe uo atemwa no mwana wakwe umwaume, nangu umwanakashi,

english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
translation: icisa cabufyashi icikafuma mwifumo lyakwe na bana akafyala. Pantu akafwaya ukufilya mu bumfisolo ilyo abalwani bakashinguluka imisumba yenu no bucushi bakamuletela.

english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,
translation: “Nga cakuti tamulekonka bwino amashiwi ya mu mafunde aya, ayalembwa muli ici citabo, kabili tamulecindika ishina lyalulumbi ilyakupapa ilyakwa Yawe Lesa wenu,

english: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
translation: ninshi Yawe akamuletela ifikuko ifyakutiinya, imwe pamo na ba lupwa lwenu, ifinkunka ifyabipisha kabili ifishakapwe, amalwele ayabi kabili ayashakapole.

english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
translation: “Muli nokupaalwa ilyo mukalaingila, nelyo mukalafuma.

english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
translation: Akamuletela amalwele yonse aya ku Egupto, ayo mwatiinine, kabili tayakatale ayapwa.

english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
translation: Yawe akamuletela amalwele ya misango misango ne finkunka ifishatala afilembwa muli ici citabo ca mafunde, mpakafye mukalobelele.

english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
translation: Imwe mwe bafulisha nge ntanda sha mu mulu, banono bakashalapo abampendwafye. Pantu mwalikene ukumfwila Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
translation: Nga filya fine casekeshe Yawe ukuti mube abakankala no kumufusha mu mpendwa, kanshi efyo cikamusekesha ukumulofya no kumonaula. Mukanukulwa mu calo mwalaingilamo kukucipoka.

english: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
translation: “Elyo Yawe akamusalanganishisha pakati ka mishobo yonse, ukufuma ku mpela ya calo ukufika na ku mpela ibiye. Kulya kwine eko imwe mukalapepa imilungu imbi, imilungu iyabaswa ku fimuti na ku mabwe, uto imwe nangu ifikolwe fyenu fishatala afishiba.

english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
translation: Ilyo mukaba pakati ka mishobo imbi tamwakamone kutuusha, kabili na makasa yenu tayakakwate pakunyanta na pakutuusha. Kabili kulya kwine, eko Yawe akamupeela amano aye sakamiko, amenso ayanakuka ukupembelela no mutima uwabula isubilo.

english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
translation: Imikalile yenu ikaba iyakutwishika lyonse. Mukaba no mwenso akasuba no bushiku, ukwabula ukushininkisha palwa bumi bwenu.

english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
translation: Imitima yenu ikalaba iyabebuka ku fintu ukalatiina, na menso ku fintu yakalamona. Ulucelo mukalati, ‘Kanshi nga caciba icungulo,’ kabili icungulo naco amuti, ‘Kanshi nga caciba ulucelo!’

english: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
translation: Yawe akalamubweseshamo ku Egupto mu mato, ubulendo ubo ine namuleseshe. Kulya kwine imwe eko mukalaishitisha mwe bene ku balwani benu pakuti mube abasha babo abaume na banakashi, lelo takwakabe nangu umo uukafwaya ukumushita.”

english: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
translation: “Yawe akamupeela amaka yakucimfya abalwani benu nga bamwimina. Pakumulwisha bakatula ku ntungafye imo, lelo pakufulumuka lyena bakalasalanganina mu ntunga cine lubali.

english: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: “Yawe akatuma ipaalo pa matala yenu na pa cintu conse ico mukekatako ne minwe yenu. Yawe Lesa wenu akamupaala mu calo alamupeela.

english: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.
translation: “Yawe akamucita abantu bakwe abamushilo, ngefyo alaile no mulapo, nga mwalasunga amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu no kulaenda mu nshila shakwe.

english: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
translation: Aya e mashiwi ya cipangano Yawe akonkomeshe Mose ukupangana na bena Israeli mu calo ca Moabu, ukulunda pa cipangano ico apangene nabo ku Horebu.

english: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
translation: “Imwe bonse ilelo namwiminina pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, intungulushi shenu na bashimucindikwa, abakalamba, bacilolo na bantufye bambi bonse abena Israeli,

english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,
translation: pamo pene na bana benu, abakashi benu, na benafyalo abekala mu nkambi shenu, abamutebela inkuni no kumutapilako amenshi.

english: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,
translation: Namwiminina pano pakuti mupangane icipangano na Yawe Lesa wenu, icipangano Yawe alepangana na imwe no kucikaka no mulapo,

english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
translation: pakuti amusuminishe ilelo ukuba abantu bakwe, ukuti abe Lesa wenu ngefyo alaile ifikolwe fyenu Abrahamu, Isaki, na Yakobo.

english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,
translation: Ndepangana ici cipangano no mulapo waciko tekuli imwe mweka

english: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
translation: mwe beminine pano na ifwe ilelo pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wesu, lelo na bashili pano ilelo.

english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;
translation: “Imwe mwe bene mwalishiba ifyo twaleikala mu Egupto nefyo twapitile mu fyalo ilyo twaleisa kuno.

english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
translation: Mwalimwene pakati kabo ifimpashanya fyabo ifyapatwa no tulubi twa fimuti na mabwe, utwa silifa na golide.

english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
translation: Muleshininkisha ukuti tapali mwaume nangu umwanakashi, umukowa nangu uluko pali imwe mwe bali pano ilelo, uwakutalusha umutima wakwe ukufuma kuli Yawe Lesa wesu nokuya mukulapepa imilungu ya mishobo ilya. Mushininkishe ukuti peba mushila pakati kenu uufumya ubusungu ubwalula filya.

english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.
translation: Ilyo uyu umuntu aumfwa aya mashiwi ya uyu mulapo, elyo aipaala umwine kabili alatontonkanya ukuti, ‘Nkabafye umutende nangu ningatwalilila ukulakonka inshila yandi.’ Ici cikaleta ifinkunka pa mushili uwatapililwa na pa mushili uwauma wine.

english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
translation: Mose alonganika abena Israeli bonse, alabeba ati, “Amenso yenu yalimwene fyonse ifyo Yawe acitile mu Egupto kuli Farao, bacilolo bakwe bonse elyo na ku calo cakwe conse.

english: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.
translation: Yawe takatale afwaya ukubelela umuntu wa musango uyu uluse. Ubukali bwakwe ne cipyu fikemina uyu muntu. Ukulapisha konse ukwalembwa muli ici citabo kukamuponena, na Yawe akalofya ishina lya uyo muntu pano calo.

english: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,
translation: “Mu nkulo sha kuntanshi, abana benu abakamukonkapo elyo na benafyalo bakafuma mu fyalo fyakutali bakamona ifinkunka ifikapona pa calo na malwele ayo Yawe akacushishako icalo.

english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.
translation: Imili 8:23

english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
translation: Icite 19:24

english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
translation: Ubwasuko bwa bantu bukaba nifi, ‘Ni pa mulandu wakuti aba bantu baonawile icipangano cakwa Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo. Icipangano apangene nabo ilyo abafumishe mu calo ca Egupto.

english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.
translation: Baleitumika no kupepa imilungu imbi, kabili no kuifukamina, iyo bashatalile abeshiba, imilungu Yawe ashabapeele.

english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.
translation: Kanshi ecalengele icipyu cakwa Yawe cimine ici calo, icakuti aleta nokulapisha konse ukwalembwa muli ici citabo.

english: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
translation: Mu kukalipa kwakwe ukukalamba, kabili na mu cipyu cakwe, Yawe alibafumya mu calo cabo, abatamfisha mu calo cimbi, ngefi fine cili na nomba.’

english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
translation: Na menso yenu mwalimwene ifyamesho ifikalamba, ifishibilo fyacipeshamano ne fisungusho ifikalamba.

english: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
translation: Nomba ukushinta na pa bushiku bwa lelo, Yawe tamupeela amano yakwishiba nangu amenso ayamona nangu amatwi ayomfwa.

english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.
translation: Pa myaka amakumi yane (40) iyo namutungulula mu matololo, ifyakufwala fyenu tafyalepukapo nangu indyato shenu nasho tashalepukapo.

english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.
translation: Tamwalyapo mukate nangu ukunwa umwangashi nangu conse icikola. Nacitile ifi pakuti mwishibe ukuti nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
translation: Ilyo twafikile pali ino ncende, imfumu Sihoni iya ku Heshiboni ne mfumu Ogi iya Bashani, balishile kukutulwisha, nomba twalibacimfishe.

english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
translation: Roma 11:8

english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
translation: Mulebaka bwino amashiwi ya cipangano ici, epakuti mukabe abakankala mu fintu fyonse mwakulacita.

english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Kanshi na ifwe twalyalulwike no kulakonkafye umusebo wa mu matololo walola kuli Bemba Wakashika, ngefyo Yawe anjebele. Pa nshita iyitali twalelulumbafye mu calo ca mpili ica Seiri .

english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
translation: (Abena Emi ebaleikala kulya. Bali fipokapoka kabili abengi. Elyo bali abatali nga bena Anaki.

english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
translation: Nga bena Anaki nabo bene baleitwa abena Refaimu, nomba abena Moabu baleita abena Anaki ati bena Emi.

english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)
translation: Abena Hori kale ebaleikala mu calo ca Seiri, nomba aba mu lupwa lwakwa Esau babatamfyamo. Babalofya ukufuma pa cinso cabo, balaikala namo nga filya fine abena Israeli bafulumwine abalwani babo mu calo Yawe abapeele.)

english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
translation: “Elyo Yawe atile, ‘Nomba imeni no kwabuka ishika lya Seredi.’ Elyo twayabuka ishika nga fintu Yawe atukonkomeshe.

english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.
translation: Na panuma ya myaka amakumi yatatu na cine konse konse (38) ukutuula apo twaimine ku Kadeshi Banea ukushinta napo twayabukile ishika lya Seredi, ninshi ne nkulo yamalamba ya baume bonse ababulwi balipwa ukufwa pa nkambi nga mulya mwine Yawe alapile.

english: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
translation: Ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwali pali bena mpaka abalofyafye bonse mu nkambi.

english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
translation: “Nomba ilyo amalamba ya bantu babulwi yapwile ukufwa,

english: the LORD spoke to me, saying,
translation: Yawe epakunjeba ati,

english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
translation: ‘Ilelo mulepita mu citungu ca Moabu ku Ari.

english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
translation: Ilyo mukapalama ku bena Amoni, tecakwesha ukubalwisha nangu ukubacusha, pantu ine nshakamupeele icalo cabo, ici calo nacipeela ku ba mu lupwa lwakwa Loti.’

english: The LORD spoke to me, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe anjebele ati,

english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
translation: (Ici calo naco caishibikwe ukuti ca bena Refaimu, pantu ebaleikalamo kale, lelo abena Amoni balebeta abati bena Samusumimu.

english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,
translation: Bali abengi nganshi, abamaka kabili abatali nga bena Anaki. Nomba Yawe alibalofeshe ukufuma pa cinso ca bena Amoni, nabo babafulumuna mu calo ebalaikalamo.

english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.
translation: Efyo Yawe acitile na bena Edomu aba mu lupwa lwakwa Esau, abaleikala mu Seiri, ilyo alofeshe abena Holi ukufuma pa cinso cabo. Nabo abena Edomu bafulumuna abena Holi mu calo, ebalaikalamo ukufika na lelo.

english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)
translation: Elyo palwa bena Afimu abaleikala mu mishi ukufikafye na ku Gaza, abena Kafito abafumine ku Kafito , ebabalofeshe baikala na mu calo cabo.)

english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
translation: ‘Nomba imeni, mwabuke no mukonko wa Alinoni. Moneni, nimbika mu maboko yenu Sihoni umwina Amoli, imfumu ya mu Heshiboni, pamo pene ne calo cakwe. Muwililileni, mutampeko ukupoka icalo.

english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”
translation: Ukutampa lelo ndelenga imishobo yonse pano calo ilemutiina no kumukwatila umwenso. Bonse bakulaitutuminafye no kulilishika ilyo baumfwa ululumbi lwenu.’

english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
translation: “Ukufuma mu matololo ya Kedemoti, natumine inkombe ku mfumu Sihoni iya ku Heshiboni ishakuya mweba palwa cibote ukuti,

english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
translation: ‘Leka tupitemo mu calo cobe, twakulakonkafye inshila, tatwakapatukile ku kulyo nelyo ku kuso.

english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”
translation: pamo ngefyo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Esau abekala mu calo ca Seiri na bena Moabu abekala mu calo ca Ari, batusuminishe ukupita mu fyalo fyabo mpakafye twayabuka umumana wa Yordani, ukuya mu calo ico Yawe Lesa wesu ali nokutupeela.’

english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
translation: ‘Namukokola ukululumba mu calo ca mpili, nomba alukileni ku kapinda ka ku kuso.’

english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
translation: Nomba imfumu Sihoni iya ku Heshiboni atukaanya ukupitamo mu calo cakwe. Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu amukoseshe amano no kumutalamika umutima, pakuti amupose mu minwe yenu ngefi fine acita na nomba.

english: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
translation: Elyo Yawe epakunjeba ati, ‘Mona, nintendeka ukukulubwila Sihoni pamo ne calo cakwe. Kanshi nomba tendekeni ukupoka icalo cibe cenu.’

english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
translation: Ilyo Sihoni ne fita fyakwe fyonse baishile kukutulwisha mupepi no musumba wa Yahasi,

english: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
translation: Pali iyo nshita, twapoka imisumba yakwe yonse no kuipeela kukonaulwa , twaipaulula na bantu abalimo, abaume, abanakashi na baice. Takwali wapuswike nakalya.

english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
translation: Kanofye ifitekwa ne fitapwa fya mu misumba iyo twapokele, efyo twaibuulile nokusenda fwe bene.

english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.
translation: Yawe Lesa wesu ewalengele tupoke imisumba yonse ukutampila ku Aroeli ukukonka no mukonko wa Alinoni. Ukufuma ku musumba wa mukonko ukushinta na ku Gileadi, takwali musumba nangu umo uwatwanshishe.

english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.
translation: Icite 19:37

english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
translation: Imp 21:4

english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
translation: Tecakwesha kubalwisha, pantu ine nshakamupeele calo cabo, nangu pakunyantafye ulukasa. Pantu icalo ca mpili sha Seiri napeela kuli Esau ukuti cibe cakwe.

english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
translation: Ifyakulya na menshi fyena mukaleshita ne ndalama sha silifa.’

english: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu alimupaala muli fyonse ifyo mwabomba. Yawe alamusakamana ilyo mululumba mu matololo ayashaikulila nganshi. Pa myaka amakumi yane (40) iyi, Yawe Lesa wenu aba na imwe, elyo mulakwata na fyonse ifyo mukabila.

english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
translation: Icite 36:8

english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, ‘Tecakwesha kulwisha abena Moabu nangu ukubacusha, pantu ine nshakamupeele calo cabo. Pantu umusumba wa Ari napeela ku ba mu lupwa lwakwa Loti.’ ”

english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Ilyo aya mapaalo yonse no kulapisha konse uko mbikile pali imwe nga kwamufikila, elyo mukaleibukisha mu mitima yenu konse ku mishobo uko Yawe Lesa akamupashila.

english: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
translation: nga cakuti mwalabeela Yawe Lesa wenu no kulasunga ifyebo ne fipope ifyalembwa mu citabo ca mafunde no kubwelela kuli Yawe Lesa wenu ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse.

english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
translation: “Nomba ico ndemukonkomesha ilelo te funde lingamwafya kabili talili ukutali na imwe.

english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
translation: Talili mu mulu, icakuti mwingepusha amuti, ‘Bushe nani enganina mu mulu aye apoke no kwisa twebako, uleke tulelibeela?’

english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
translation: Kabili talili kwishilya lya bemba, icakuti mwingepusha amuti, ‘Bushe nani aleyabuka bemba, aye apoke no kwisa twebako pakuti tulelibeela?’

english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
translation: Iyoo, ishiwi lilifye mupepi na imwe. Lili mu kanwa kenu na mu mitima yenu pakuti mulelibeela.

english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
translation: “Moneni, nabika ku cinso cenu ilelo ubumi no bukankala, ukuloba ne mfwa.

english: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
translation: Pantu ilelo namukonkomesha ukutemwa Yawe Lesa wenu, ukulaenda mu nshila shakwe kabili no kulasunga amafunde yakwe, amalango yakwe ne fipope fyakwe. Lyena mukaba no bumi, kabili mukasanduluka, na Yawe Lesa wenu akamupaala mu calo mwalaingilamo no kucipoka.

english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,
translation: Lelo nga cakuti imitima yenu yatalama, mwakaana no kulabeela, kabili nga cakuti mwalakonkelela ukulafukamina no kupepa imilungu imbi,

english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
translation: ine ndemweba ilelo ukuti cine cine mukaloba. Tamwakakokolemo muli cilya calo mwalaabukila Yordani ukwingilamo no kucipoka.

english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
translation: Ilelo naita umulu ne calo ukuba bakambone bandi pali imwe ukuti nabika pa cinso cenu ubumi ne mfwa, amapaalo no kulapisha. Nomba salenipo ubumi pakuti imwe na bana benu mukabe abomi.

english: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
translation: Kabili imwe na bana benu kuti mwabwelela kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, no kulamubeela ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse ukulingana na fyonse ifyo namukonkomesha ilelo.

english: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
translation: Muletemwa Yawe Lesa wenu, muleumfwa kwishiwi lyakwe kabili eo mulekonenamo. Pantu Yawe e bumi bwenu, kabili akamupeela ukwikala imyaka iyingi mu calo ico alaile ifikolwe fyenu, Abrahamu, Isaki, na Yakobo.”

english: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
translation: Elyo Yawe Lesa wenu akamukwatila uluse no kumubwesesha ishuko lyenu, elyo nokumubwesha ukufuma mu mishobo amupashilemo.

english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
translation: Nangufye cakuti mwasalanganina ukwapelela isonde pesamba lya kasuba, ukufuma kulya Yawe Lesa wenu akamubwesha no kumukolonganya pamo.

english: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu akamubwesha mu calo icali ca fikolwe fyenu no kucipoka cikabe cenu. Kabili akamulenga ukuba abakankala no kusanda ukucila pa fikolwe fyenu.

english: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu akasembulula imitima yenu, ne mitima ya ndupwa shenu, pakuti mukalemutemwa ne mitima yenu yonse ne myeo yenu yonse, elyo mukaba no bumi.

english: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu akalwila ukulapisha konse pa balwani benu abamupata no kumucusha.

english: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
translation: Nakabili imwe mukalaumfwila no kulakonka amafunde yakwe yonse ayo nalamupeela ilelo.

english: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,
translation: Elyo Yawe Lesa wenu akamulenga ukuba abakankala mu fintu fyonse mukalabomba ne minwe yenu na mu bufyashi bwa mu mafumo yenu, abana ba fitekwa fyenu elyo ne fisabo fya mushili wenu. Yawe Lesa wenu akasekela muli imwe no kumulenga ukuba abakankala ngefyo asekele mu fikolwe fyenu,

english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
translation: Elyo Mose aile landa ku bena Israeli bonse amashiwi aya ati,

english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,
translation: Elyo Mose abakonkomesha ati, “Pa mpela ya cila mwaka walenga cine lubali, mu mwaka wakusuula ku nkongole, pa nshikunkulu ya Nsakwe,

english: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
translation: ilyo abena Israeli bonse baisa mukumonekela ku cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, pa ncende iyo akasala, mukalebelenga aya mafunde pa cinso cabo ilyo balekutika.

english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,
and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Mona shapalama inshiku shobe ishakufwa, ita Yoshua, mwise kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, uko ndi nokumupeelela imilimo.” Kanshi Mose na Yoshua epakuya iminina kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.
translation: Elyo Yawe nao epakumonekela pe Tenti mu ntumba ye kumbi, elyo intumba ye kumbi yaiminine lwa pa mwinshi we Tenti.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Iwe uli nokuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe. Lelo aba bantu tabakakokole balampondokela mukuikowesha muli bucilende bwakupepa imilungu ya benafyalo iya mu calo balaingilamo. Bali nokumpondokela nokonaula icipangano ico twapangene nabo.

english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’
translation: Pali ubo bushiku ine nkabafulilwa no kubasuulako. Nkafisa icinso candi uko bali, elyo bakaloba. Ifinkunka ifingi fikabaponena, na mafya ayengi yakabeshila, kabili pa bushiku bulya bakepusha abati, ‘Bushe ifi finkunka tafitufikile pa mulandu wakuti Lesa natusenguka?’

english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
translation: Mu cinefye nkafisa icinso candi pali bulya bushiku pa mulandu wa kubifya kwabo ukwakupilibukila ku milungu imbi.

english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
translation: “Nomba ilembeleni ulu lwimbo mwe bene. Kabili iwe Mose, ulusambilishe na ku bena Israeli elyo balwimbe no kulwimba pakuti lukabe e lukambone lwandi pali bena.

english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
translation: “Ine nomba ndi ne myaka umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120) kabili nshikwete maka yakumutungulula. Yawe nanjeba ukuti, ‘Tawakabuke mumana wa Yordani.’

english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
translation: Ilyo nkabatwala mu calo umufumfumuka umukaka no buci, icalo nalaile no mulapo ku fikolwe fyabo, kabili ilyo balya baikuta no kwina baina, bakapilibukilila ku milungu imbi no kuipepa, bakankaana, bakonaula ne cipangano candi.

english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”
So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
translation: Kanshi Mose ubo bwine bushiku epakulemba ulu lwimbo no kulusambilisha ku bena Israeli.

english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”
translation: Yawe akonkomesha Yoshua mwana Nuni ati, “Iwe shipa, kabili ukose pantu niwe ukatungulula abana bakwa Israeli mu calo nabalaile no mulapo, kabili ine wine nkalaba na iwe.”

english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
translation: Panuma Mose apwile ukulemba amashiwi mu citabo ca mafunde aya, ukufuma kukwamba mpaka na kumpela,

english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,
translation: akonkomeshe abena Levi abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe ati,

english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.
translation: “Sendeni ici citabo ca mafunde, muye cibika lubali lwa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu. Palya pene epo cikalaikala nga cikambone icakumushinina.

english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?
translation: Pantu nalishiba bucisanguka na bunkosamitwe bwenu. Nga cakuti kuti mwasangukila Yawe ilyo ncili umumi kabili pamo na imwe, palibufi nga nafwa!

english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
translation: Longanikeni pa cinso candi abakalamba bonse aba nko shenu na bacilolo bonse, pakuti nande aya mashiwi ninshi balekutika elyo njite umulu ne calo fibe efyakubashinina.

english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”
translation: Pantu ninjishiba ukuti pa numa ya mfwa yandi namwishiba bwino ifyo mukailufyanya kabili no kufuma kufyo namukonkomesha. Mu nshiku ishikesa, ifinkunka fikamuponena pantu mukacita ifyabipa pa menso yakwa Yawe no kumulenga akalipe pa mulandu wa ifyo iminwe yenu yapanga.”

english: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu umwine eukamutangilila pakwabuka. Akalofya iyi mishobo ili ku ntanshi yenu, kabili mukapoka ne calo cabo. Yoshua nao eukamutangilila ukwabuka ngefyo Yawe asosele.

english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
translation: Elyo Mose asosele amashiwi ya lwimbo ulu ukufuma pakwamba mpaka pa mpela, ninshi ibumba lyonse ilya bena Israeli lilekutika.

english: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
translation: Kabili Yawe akabacita ngefyo acitile kuli Sihoni na Ogi, imfumu sha bena Amoli, abo alofeshe pamo ne calo cabo.

english: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
translation: Yawe akabaposa mu minwe yenu, elyo muli nokubacita ngefyo namukonkomeshe.

english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
translation: Mukose kabili mushipe. Mwitiina nangu ukukwata umwenso pa mulandu wabo, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu akulaba na imwe, takamushe nangu ukumulekelesha.”

english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.
translation: Elyo Mose aita Yoshua pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse alamweba ati, “Kosa kabili ushipe, pantu ufwile ukuya na aba bantu mu calo ico Yawe alapile ku fikolwe fyabo ukubapeela. Kabili ufwile ukucakanya pakati kabo nge cacishilano cabo.

english: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
translation: Yawe umwine ewakulakutangilila, kabili akulaba nobe. Takakushe nangu ukukulekelesha. Tecakwesha kutiina kabili tecakwesha kunenuka iyoo.”

english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakulemba aya mafunde kabili ayapeela kuli bashimapepo, bamwana Levi abaume, abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, elyo na ku bakalamba bonse aba mu Israeli.

english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
translation: Umfweni mwe myulu, na ine nalalanda,

english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
translation: Mu calo ca matololo emo asangile Yakobo,

english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
translation: kwati ni kapumpe uulesunga icisansala cakwe

english: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
translation: Yawe ekafye ewamutungulwile,

english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
translation: Alenga Yakobo ukunina pa ncende ishasansuka pa calo,

english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
translation: no mukaka uwatikama no wasongoloka uwalefuma ku fitekwa,

english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
translation: Fili 2:15

english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
translation: Balengele Yawe ukuba no bufuba pa mulandu wa milungu yabo iya benafyalo,

english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
translation: Baletuula amalambo ku mipashi iyakowela, iyishali imilungu,

english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
translation: Mwasuulile Icilibwe, icali Shinwe.

english: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
translation: Ilyo Yawe amwene ifi, abakaana,

english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
translation: Lekeni ukufunda kwandi kuloke nge mfula,

english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
translation: Banengele ukuba no bufuba pa mulandu wa cishili umulungu,

english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
“I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
translation: “Nkatulika ifinkunka pali bena,

english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
translation: Nkabaletela icipowe icakubapwa

english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
translation: Panse ulupanga lukalenga ukufwilwa abana,

english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
translation: Imili 17:26

english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”
translation: Lelo natiinine ukusonsomba kwa balwani,

english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
translation: Umushobo uyu tawakwata mano,

english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
translation: Nga cakutilafye bali bamano kabili kuti baishiba umo cilolele ici

english: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
translation: Ine nkalasabankanya ishina lyakwa Yawe.

english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?
translation: Bushe umuntu umo kuti afulumuna shani abantu ikana limo (1,000),

english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
translation: Pantu ilibwe lyabo talyaba nge Cilibwe cesu,

english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
translation: Umwangashi wabo ufuma ku mwangashi wa ku Sodoma,

english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
translation: Umwangashi wabo busungu bwa nsoka,

english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
translation: “Bushe nshabika ifi mu butala,

english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
translation: Ne mwine wacilandushi nine, kabili nkabakanda.

english: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
translation: Yawe akapokolola abantu bakwe,

english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
translation: Amalu 106:37

english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
translation: Imilungu ili kwi iyalelya amafuta ya malambo yabo,

english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
translation: “Moneni nomba ukuti ine wine nine Lesa.

english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
translation: Ena e cilibwe, ne milimo yakwe yaba iyapwililika,

english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
translation: Naimya ukuboko kwandi mu mulu no kusosa ukuti,

english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
translation: ilyo nanona ulupanga lwandi ulwabeka,

english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
translation: Nkalenga imifwi yandi ikaletona imilopa,

english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
translation: Sansamukeni, mwe mishobo pamo na bantu bakwe.

english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
translation: Mose baishile na Yoshua mwana Nuni no kulanda amashiwi yonse aya ulu lwimbo ninshi abantu baleumfwa.

english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
translation: Ilyo Mose apwile ukusosa amashiwi yonse aya ku bena Israeli bonse,

english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
translation: atile kuli bena, “Mulebika mu mitima amashiwi yonse ayo nasosa mu cine ilelo, pakuti mulekonkomesha abana benu ukulabeela bwino amashiwi yonse aya mafunde aya.

english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
translation: Te mashiwi yafyefye kuli imwe, e bumi bwenu. Muli yena emo mukekala inshiku ishingi mu calo mwalayabukila Yordani mukucipoka.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku bumo bwine Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
translation: “Nina ulupili lwa Nebo, ulwa mu mpili sha Abarimu, mu calo ca Moabu, ukulungatana no musumba wa Yeriko, utambe icalo ca Kenani, ico ine nalapeela abena Israeli ukuba icuma cabo.

english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
translation: Bena bacitile ifyalubana ku nsoni shabo,

english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
translation: Pali lulya lwine lupili walanina epo uleya fwila no kuya lala ukwalala abantu bobe, nga filya fine munonko Aroni afwilile pa lupili lwa Hori no kuya lala ukwalala abantu bakwe.

english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
translation: Pantu imwe bonse babili tamwancetekele pa cinso ca bena Israeli pa cishima ca ku Meriba Kadeshi mu matololo ya Sini, kabili pantu tamwalangile ukuti ndi wamushilo pa cinso ca bena Israeli.

english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
translation: Eico ulemonakofye cilya calo akatalamukila, tawakengilemo mu calo ndepeela abena Israeli.”

english: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
translation: Bushe uyu e musango mwingatashishamo Yawe,

english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
translation: Ibukisheni inshiku shakale ishapita,

english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
translation: Ilyo Lesa Mukulu apeele imishobo ifyacishilano fyabo,

english: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
translation: Pantu icakaniko cakwa Yawe bantu bakwe,

english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
translation: Ili e paalo Mose umuntu wakwa Lesa apaalile abana bakwa Israeli ilyo talafwa.

english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
translation: Eufunda ifipope fyobe kuli Yakobo

english: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
translation: We Yawe, paala ukucenjela kwakwe konse,

english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
translation: Palwakwa Benjamini atile,

english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
translation: ku fyawamisha ifileta akasuba

english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
translation: ku fisabo ifyawamisha ifya mu mpili shakale,

english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
translation: ku fyabupe ifyawamisha ifya mu calo na fyonse ifyaisulamo,

english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
translation: Mu bucindami ali kwati libeli lya cilume wa ŋombe,

english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
translation: Palwakwa Sebuloni atile,

english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
translation: Bakalaita abantu ku mpili,

english: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
translation: Atile,

english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
translation: Palwakwa Gadi atile,

english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”
translation: Ena aisalilepo icalo cawamisha,

english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
translation: Palwakwa Dani atile,

english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
translation: Palwakwa Naftali atile,

english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
translation: Palwakwa Asheri atile,

english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
translation: Ifyakukakila impongolo fikaba fya fyela no mukuba,

english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
translation: “Takwaba nangu umo uwaba nga Lesa wa ku Yeshuruni,

english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
translation: Lesa wa pe na pe e cubo cobe,

english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
translation: Kanshi Israeli akaikalila umutelelwe umwine ekafye.

english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
translation: Walishuka iwe we Israeli!

english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
translation: Cine cine niwe we watemwa abantu,

english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
translation: amafunde ayo Mose atupeela,

english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
translation: Ewali Imfumu mu Yeshuruni,

english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
translation: “Lekeni Rubeni abe umumi kabili efwa,

english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
translation: Kabili ifi efyo alandile pali Yuda,

english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
translation: Palwakwa Levi atile,

english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
translation: Palwakwa wishi na nyina atile,

english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
translation: Elyo Mose aninine ulupili lwa Nebo ukufuma ku mawanga ya Moabu ukufikafye na pa mulu wa lupili lwa Pisiga, ukulungatana no musumba wa Yeriko. Kulya kwine eko Yawe amulangile icalo conse, ukutendekela ku Gileadi no kufika ku Dani,

english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
translation: Ukufuma lilya line, takwatala akuba kasesema nangu umo mu Israeli uwaba nga Mose uo Yawe aishibe no kuloleshanya nankwe amenso.

english: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
translation: Ukuf 33:11

english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
translation: Kabili takwaba kasesema nangu umo uwatala acita ifintu ifyamaka kabili ifyakutiinya nga filya Mose alecita pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse.

english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,
translation: icalo conse icakwa Naftali, ne fitungu fyakwa Efulemu na Manase, icalo conse icakwa Yuda ukuya fikafye na kuli bemba wa ku masamba,

english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
translation: ku matololo ya Negebu ne citungu conse ukufuma kwishika lya Yeriko, umusumba wa Tuncindu, no kufika ku Sowa.

english: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Ici e calo nalaile no mulapo kuli Abrahamu, Isaki, na Yakobo ilyo natile nkacipeela ku ndupwa shabo. Nkulengele ukuti iwe ucimonekofye na menso yobe, lelo tawakaabukilemo no kwingilamo.”

english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.
translation: Kanshi Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe, epakufwila mulya mu Moabu, nge shiwi Yawe asosele.

english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
translation: Yawe nao amushiika mu Moabu, mwishika ukulungatana na Beti Peori. Lelo ukushinta na nomba tapaba uwaishiba apabela uluputa lwakwe.

english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
translation: Icite 12:7

english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
translation: Abena Israeli bamulooseshe mu mawanga ya Moabu inshiku amakumi yatatu (30), mpakafye inshita yakuloosha no kulila yapwa.

english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Nomba Yoshua mwana Nuni aisushiwa no Mupashi wamano, pantu Mose alimutambalikilepo amaboko. Kanshi abena Israeli epakulaumfwila Yoshua, kabili nao alecitafye ifyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Kabili twalyalulwike, twakonka no musebo walola ku Bashani. Kanshi imfumu Ogi iya ku Bashani ne fita fyaiko fyonse, baisa mukutulwisha ilyo batukumenye ku Edelei.

english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translation: “Twapoka ne misumba yonse iya mu calo cabatama, na Gileadi yonse, Bashani onse no kuya fikafye ku Saleka na ku Edelei, imisumba ya mu calo cakwa Ogi mu Bashani.”

english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
translation: (Ogi eka, imfumu ya Bashani, ewashelepo pa bena Refaimu. Ne mbokoshi ya citumbi cakwe yali iye libwe, na mubwipi yali bamita babili, elyo mubutali bamita bane na citika . Ukushinta na lelo epo icili mu musumba wa bena Amoni mu Laba.)

english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
translation: “Pa calo twapokele pa nshita ilya, napeele ku bena Rubeni na bena Gadi icitungu ukutendekela mu musumba wa Aroeli ku kapinda ka ku kuso mupepi no mukonko wa Alinoni, no kulundako iciputulwa ca calo ca mpili ica Gileadi, kumo kwine ne misumba yaciko.

english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
translation: Citika wa luko lwakwa Manase naupeele icitungu icasheleko ku calo ca Gileadi, nabikapo ne calo conse icakwa Ogi imfumu ya Bashani.” (Icalo conse ica Agobu mu Bashani caishibikwe ukuti e calo ca bena Refaimu.

english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
translation: Yaili, uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Manase, apokele icalo conse ica Agobu, ukuya fika na mu mupaka wa bena Geshuri no wa bena Maaka. Ici calo conse cainikwe ishina lyakwe, ukufika na lelo citwa Hafoti Yairi.)

english: I gave Gilead to Machir.
translation: “Kabili napeele Gileadi kuli Makiri.

english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
translation: Lelo napeele ku bena Rubeni na bena Gadi icitungu ukutendekela ku Gileadi ukuya shinta na ku mukonko wa Alinoni, umupaka wabela pakati ka mukonko, elyo no kufika ku mumana wa Yaboku, uwapakanya na bena Amoni.

english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
translation: Ku masamba umupaka wali mumana wa Yordani mu Araba, ukufuma ku Kinereti ukufika kuli bemba wa Araba, bemba wa Mucele, ukuya shintafye mwisamba lya lupili lwa Pisiga.

english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
