translation: “Elyo pa nshita ine ilya namukonkomeshe nati, ‘Yawe Lesa wenu namupeela ici calo ukuti cibe cenu. Nomba abaume bonse amalamba nabaipangashe ifyanso fyabulwi, babukile kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani, batangilile bamunyinenwe bambi abena Israeli.

english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
translation: Kanofye abakashi benu na bana benu ebali nokushala mu misumba namupeela pamo ne fitekwa fyenu, (ninjishiba namukwata ifitekwa ifingi),

english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
translation: Yawe epakunjeba ati, ‘Wimutiina, pantu nimupeela mu minwe yobe, kumo kwine ne fita fyakwe fyonse, pamo ne calo cakwe cine. Umucite filya wacitile Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli uwaleteeka mu Heshiboni.’

english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
translation: mpakafye Yawe akapeele na bamunyinenwe ukutuusha pamo nga imwe. Bakaikwatile nabo icalo ico Yawe Lesa wenu akabapeela kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani. Lyena elyo mukabwelela cila umo ku citungu cakwe ico namupeela.’

english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
translation: “Elyo pa nshita ilya nakonkomeshe Yoshua nati, ‘Nauimwena na menso yobe we mwine fyonse ifyo Yawe Lesa obe acitile kuli shilya mfumu shibili. Yawe akalacita cimo cine ku shamfumu shonse isha uko muleya.

english: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”
translation: Tecakwesha kushitiina, pantu Yawe Lesa obe e ukalakulwishishako.’

english: I begged GOD at that time, saying,
translation: “Kabili pali ilya nshita napapete Yawe nati,

english: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
translation: ‘We Mfumu Yawe, walitampa ukulanga umubomfi obe ubulamba bobe na maka ya kuboko kobe. Bushe mulungu nshi umbi mu mulu na pano isonde uwingacita ifyabulamba ifyo iwe ucita?

english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
translation: Leka njabuke umumana nje moneko icalo cisuma icili kwishilya lya Yordani, icalo cisuma ica mpili na Lebanoni.’

english: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
translation: Pa mulandu wa imwe Yawe alimfulilwe, kabili tewakumfwa ifyo nalelanda, ati nokuti, ‘Walanda fyafula. Kabili wibwekeshapo kulanda pali uyu umulandu!

english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
translation: Kabiye pa mulu wa lupili lwa Pisiga, ulolekeshe ku kapinda ka ku kuso, na ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, ku kabanga na ku masamba. Ulolekeshe bwino ifyo uleya mona, pantu iwe tawayabuke mumana wa Yordani.

english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
translation: Kanshi upeele Yoshua imilimo, umukoseleshe no kumucincisha, pantu euli nokutungulula aba bantu pakwabuka, kabili eukalenga nokuti bakapoke cilya calo, ico iwe walatamba.’

english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
translation: “Kanshi ifwe epakwikala mwishika mupepi no musumba wa Beti Peori.”

english: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
translation: “Kanshi Yawe Lesa wesu nao epakutupeela Ogi imfumu ya ku Bashani ne fita fyakwe fine fyonse. Twabepaya bonsefye, ukwabula ukushapo nangu umo uwakupusuka.

english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translation: Pa nshita ilya twapokele ne misumba yakwe yonsefye. Takwashele musumba nelyo umo uo tushapokele pa misumba amakumi mutanda (60) ne citungu conse ica Agobu ico imfumu Ogi iya mu Bashani yaleteeka.

english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
translation: Yonse iyi misumba yali na malinga ayatali ne mpongolo ne mipilikisho yakwisalilako, kabili kwali ne mishi imbi iyingi iyishakwete malinga.

english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
translation: Elyo na ifwe epakupeela imisumba yonse kukonaulwa , nga filya twacitile Sihoni imfumu ya Heshiboni. Twaonaula imisumba yonse no kwipaya abantu balimo abaume, abanakashi na baice.

english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
translation: Lelo ifitekwa ne fitapwa ukufuma mu misumba yabo fyena twalifisendele fwe bene.

english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
translation: “Kanshi pa nshita ilya efyo twapokele ifyalo fya shamfumu ishi shibili isha bena Amoli lubali lwa ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani, ukutendeka ku mukonko wa Alinoni ukushinta na ku lupili lwa Hemoni.”

english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
translation: (Abena Sidoni beta ulupili lwa Hemoni ukuti lupili lwa Sirioni, abena Amoli nabo balwita ukuti lupili lwa Seni.)

english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.
translation: Elyo Mose alaeba abantu ati, “Nomba mwe bena Israeli, umfwikisheni ifipope na mafunde ndemufunda. Mulekonka fyonse pakuti mukaleyenda abomi, mukengile, mukapoke ne calo ico Yawe, Lesa wa bashinwe ali mukumupeela.

english: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
translation: Ibukisheni ubushiku mwaiminine pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu ku Holebu, lilya anjebele ati, ‘Longanika abantu pa cinso candi pakuti bomfwe amashiwi yandi, basambilile ukunkwatila akatiina ilyo bacili abomi pano calo no kusambilishako abana babo.’

english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
translation: “Na imwe mwalipaleme, mwaiminina mwisamba lya lupili ulwalebilima umulilo uwalefika na ku mulu, ulu lupili lwakupilwe ne ntumba ya cushi icafiita fititi.

english: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakulanda kuli imwe ukufuma mu mulilo. Mwaumfwile uko alelanda amashiwi, lelo tamwamumwene mu musango uuli onse. Mwaumfwilefye ishiwi epela.

english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
translation: Alimwebele icipangano ico mwapangene nankwe, ifi e fyebo ikumi ifyo amukonkomeshe ukulakonka, kabili afilemba na pa mabwe ayapapatala yabili.

english: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
translation: Kabili Yawe ankonkomeshe pali ilya nshita ukuti mfunde ifipope na mafunde muli nokulakonka mu calo ico mwalapoka nga mwayabuka Yordani.”

english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
translation: “Ubushiku Yawe alandile na imwe ukufuma mu mulilo pa lupili lwa Holebu, tamwamumwene mu musango uuli onse. Kanshi cenjeleni, muleisunga bwino

english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
translation: nangu icapala inama yonse pano calo, nangu icuni icipupuka mu lwelele,

english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
translation: Ubuso 22:18

english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
translation: Kabili nga mwapunamina mu mulu, mwamona akasuba, umweshi ne ntanda, ifitafye fyonse ifyaba mu mulu , mwilatunkwa ukufifukamina nangu ukupepa ifintu ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu ayakanya abantu ba mishobo yonse iyaba pano calo.

english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
translation: Pafyo ine ndemukonkomesha, tecakwesha kulundapo nelyo ukufumyapo fimo. Lelo mulesunga amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu ayo ndemupeela.

english: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
translation: Lelo imwe ni Yawe ewamubuulile no kumufumya mwilungu lya mulilo, mu Egupto, pakuti mube abantu bakwe ngefi fine mwaba ukushinta na lelo.

english: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;
translation: Nomba ni pa mulandu wenu Yawe amfulilwe, alapa nokuti nshakabukeko umumana wa Yordani no kwingila muli cilya calo cisuma Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeela nge cacishilano cenu.

english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
translation: Ine ndefwila muli cino calo, nshakabuke mumana wa Yordani. Lelo imwe muli mukwabuka, mukaya poka na cilya calo cisuma.

english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
translation: Roma 1:23

english: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu, mulilo uoca fyonse, kabili ni Lesa uwabufuba.

english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
translation: “Panuma yakukwata abana na beshikulu, mwakokola muli cilya calo, nga cakuti mwailufyanya no kupanga akalubi akali konse, ukucita icabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu no kulenga akalipe,

english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
translation: naita umulu ne calo nga bakambone pali imwe mu bushiku bwe lelo ukuti mukalobe bwangu ukufuma mu calo ico muleyabukila umumana wa Yordani mukuya cipoka. Tamwakekalemo inshita iyitali lelo mukalobelelafye.

english: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.
translation: Yawe akamusalanganishisha mu bantu bambi, elyo pali imwe pakashalafye impendwa inono mu mishobo Yawe akamutwalamo.

english: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
translation: Bahi 12:29

english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
translation: Mwalimwene na menso yenu mwe bene ifyo Yawe acitile pa Baali Peori. Yawe Lesa wenu alilofeshe bonse abapepeleko umulungu Baali wa ku Peori.

english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.
translation: Ilyo mukaba mu macushi na fyonse ifi nga fyamufikila, elyo pakulekelesha mukabwelela kuli Yawe Lesa wenu no kumupetamina.

english: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu ena ni Lesa waluse. Takamulekeleshe nangu ukumulofya nangu ukulaba icipangano ico apangene ne fikolwe fyenu no mulapo.

english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
translation: “Nomba ipusheni pa nshiku shakale ilyo tamulabako, ukufuma pa bushiku ilyo Lesa abumbile umuntu pano isonde, ipusheni ukufuma ku mpela ya mulu ukufika na ku mpela ibiye. Bushe kwalitala akucitika icintu nangu cimo icacindama ifi? Bushe kwatala akumfwika icintu ca uyu musango?

english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
translation: Bushe bantu nshi abaumfwa ishiwi lya mulungu uko ulelanda ukufuma mu mulilo, nga filya imwe mwaumfwile, nomba mucili abomi?

english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
translation: Bushe kwalitala akuba mulungu uwaeshako ukuibuulila umushobo umo ukufuma mu mushobo umbi ku fyakwesha, ku fishibilo fyakupapa ne fipeshamano, ku nkondo, ku kuboko kwabulamba no kuboko ukwatambalala nangu ne fyakutiinya ifikalamba nge fintu fyonse ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu acitile pa menso yenu mu Egupto?

english: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.
translation: Mwalangilwe ifi fyonse pakuti mwishibe ukuti Yawe e Lesa ekafye, takwaba na umbi iyoo.

english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
translation: Amaf 28:36

english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
translation: Pa mulandu wakutemwa ifikolwe fyenu no kusala indupwa shabo ishakonkelepo, amufumishe mu Egupto mukuba na imwe na ku maka yakwe ayakalamba.

english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
translation: Kabili pakumutemwa atamfishe imishobo iyikalamba iyamaka ukumucila, pakuti amwingishe mu calo cabo no kumupeela nge cacishilano ngefi fine cili nomba.

english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
translation: Eico mucishibe ilelo, mucibike na mu mitima yenu icakuti Yawe e Lesa ekafye uwa mu mulu na pano isonde, takwaba na umbi iyoo.

english: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.
translation: Nomba mwe bapetamine Yawe Lesa wenu mucili abomi ukufika na lelo.

english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.
translation: Mulesunga ifipope na mafunde yonse ayo namupeela lelo pakuti cikamuwamine imwe na bana benu, elyo mukatwalilila ukwikala pe mu calo Yawe Lesa wenu ali mukumupeela pakuti cibe cenu pe.”

english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
translation: Kanshi Mose asontele imisumba itatu ku kabanga ka Yordani,

english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
translation: iyakubutukilako nga cakuti umuntu aipaya umuntu mubiye ukushili ku mufulo. Kuti abutukila ku musumba wa musango uyu, pakupususha umweo wakwe.

english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
translation: Abena Rubeni babapeela umusumba wa Beseri, uwaba mu matololo yabatama, abena Gadi babapeela umusumba wa Ramoti uwa mu Gileadi, elyo abena Manase babapeela umusumba wa Golani uwaba mu Bashani.

english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
translation: Aya e mafunde Mose apeele abana bakwa Israeli.

english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
translation: Abapeele amafunde, ifipope ne fyebo, ilyo abana bakwa Israeli bafumine ku Egupto,

english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
translation: ninshi bacili ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani, mwishika lyalungatana no musumba wa Beti Peori, mu calo ca mfumu Sihoni, iyaleteeka abena Amoli mu Heshiboni. Mose na bana bakwa Israeli balimucimfishe ilyo bafumine ku Egupto.

english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
translation: Bapokele icalo cakwe ne calo cakwa Ogi imfumu ya Bashani. Ishi mfumu shibili isha bena Amoli shaleikala lwa ku kabanga ka Yordani.

english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Zion (also called Hermon),
translation: Bapokele icalo ukufuma mu musumba wa Aroeli, uwaba mu lulamba lwa mukonko wa Alinoni, ukufika na ku lupili lwa Sirioni, (ulu e lupili lwa Hemoni),

english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
translation: ukubikapofye ne citungu ca Araba ku kabanga ka Yordani, ukushinta na kuli bemba wa Araba, mwisamba lya lupili lwa Pisiga.

english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
translation: “Moneni, nimufunda ifipope na mafunde ngefyo umwine Yawe Lesa wandi ankonkomeshe. Pakuti mukaleyakonka mu calo ico mwalaingilamo pakuti mucipoke.

english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
translation: Mukaleyasunga bwino bwino, pakuti aba mishobo ya benafyalo bakalemona ukuti imwe muli bamano kabili abacumfwila. Abakomfwako fyonse ifi, bakalatila, ‘Cine cine uyu mushobo ukalamba wamano kabili uwacumfwila!’

english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?
translation: “Bushe mushobo nshi na umbi, nangu wingakula shani, uwaba ne milungu mupepi ngefi ifwe Yawe Lesa wesu atupalama ilyo tumwita?

english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
translation: Kabili mushobo nshi na umbi, nangu wingakula shani, uwakwata ifipope na mafunde ayalungama ngaya namupeela ilelo?

english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
translation: Kanshi mulecenjela no kuisunga bwino pakuti mwikalaba ifintu mwamona na menso yenu nangu ukuleka fifume mu mitima ilyo muli abomi pano calo. Mukasambilisheko abana benu na bana babo abakakonkapo.

english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
translation: Mose aitile abena Israeli bonse, elyo asosa ati, “We Israeli umfwa ifipope na mafunde nalakweba ayo walaumfwa ilelo, uyeshibe kabili uleyasunga.

english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
translation: Lelo ndalanga icitemwiko icishipwa ku nkulo amakana na makana isha bantu abantemwa, abasunga na mafunde yandi.

english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
translation: “‘Wilalumbula ishina lyakwa Yawe Lesa obe apafye, pantu Yawe takalekepofye uyo onse uulumbula ishina lyakwe apafye.

english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
translation: Levi 19:12

english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
translation: Ulebomba mu nshiku mutanda kabili emo ulebomba imilimo yobe yonse,

english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
translation: lelo ubushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwena Lisabata lyakwa Yawe Lesa obe. Wilabombamo mulimo uuli onse, we mwine, nelyo bamwano abaume na banakashi, nelyo ababomfi abaume atemwa na banakashi, nelyo iŋombe nangu kabalwe nangufye icitekwa icili conse, nelyo abenafyalo wikala nabo, pakuti umubomfi umwaume no mwanakashi batushe pamo nga iwe wine.

english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
“Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: “‘Ulecindika wiso na noko, ngefyo Yawe Lesa obe akukonkomeshe. Lyena ukekala inshiku ishingi kabili cikakuwamina mu calo Yawe Lesa obe alakupeela.

english: “You shall not murder.
translation: “‘Wilaipaya.

english: “You shall not commit adultery.
The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
translation: Yawe Lesa wesu apangene na ifwe icipangano pa lupili lwa Holebu.

english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
translation: Luka 18:20

english: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
translation: “Aya e mafunde Yawe abilile ne shiwi likalamba kwibumba lyonse palya pa lupili ukufuma mu mulilo, mwikumbi na mu mfifi iyafiita fititi. Apeele aya mafunde ukwabula ukulandapo na yambi. Elyo alemba na mafunde pa mabwe ayapapatala yabili no kumpeela.

english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
translation: Kabili mwanjebele amuti, ‘Yawe Lesa wesu natulanga ifwe ubucindami no kupulama kwakwe, kabili natuyumfwila ishiwi lyakwe ililefuma mu mulilo! Ilelo twaimwena ukuti umuntu kanshi kuti aba umumi nangu Lesa alanda nankwe.

english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
translation: Nga nomba cinshi twalafwila? Uyu mulilo ushaikulila uletulofya, kabili nga cakuti twatwalilila ukumfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe Lesa wesu tulefwa.

english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
translation: Bushe kwatala akuba umuntunse uwaumfwapo uko Lesa umumi alelanda ukufuma mu mulilo, nga ifwe, kabili ashala umumi?

english: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
translation: Mateo 5:27

english: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
translation: “Yawe alimumfwile ilyo mwalandile kuli ine, elyo anjeba ati, ‘Niŋumfwa ifyo abantu balandile kuli iwe. Fyonse fintu balandile nabalungika.

english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
translation: Iyee, nga kuti cawama bakwata imitima yakuntiina no kubaka amafunde yandi inshiku shonse pakuti cikabawamine pamo na bana babo bene pe na pe!

english: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
translation: Te fikolwe fyeka Yawe apangene nabo icipangano, lelo na ifwe bene, na bonse fwe bacili abomi ilelo.

english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
translation: Kabiye, uye beba babwelele ku matenti yabo.

english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
translation: Nomba iwe, shala kuno na ine, pakuti nkupeele amafunde yonse, amalango ne fipope ifyakuya bafunda, pakuti bakalefikonka mu calo ico nkabapeela ukupoka.’

english: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
translation: “Kanshi cenjeleni mukucita ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomesha. Tecakwesha ukupilibukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso.

english: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
translation: Muleendela mu nshila shonse isho Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomeshe pakuti mukabe abomi, cikamuwamine, mukekale ne nshiku ishingi mu calo ico mukaya poka.”

english: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
translation: Yawe alandile na imwe pa lupili, ukufuma mu mulilo, ninshi namuloshanya amenso.

english: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
translation: Pali ilya nshita naiminine pakati, uku ni Yawe na imwe lubali lumbi, pakuti ndemweba ifilelanda Yawe. Pantu imwe tamwaile pa mulu wa lupili ico mwaletiina umulilo.

english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translation: ‘Nine Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha.

english: “You shall have no other gods before me.
translation: “‘Wilaba ne milungu imbi kanofye ine.

english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
translation: “‘Wilaipangila kalubi nangu icintu conse icakupashanya icaba mu mulu umutali, nangu icaba pano isonde, nangu icaba mu menshi pesamba lya calo.

english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
translation: Wilafukamina utulubi nangu ukutupepa. Pantu ine ne Yawe Lesa obe, ndi Lesa wabufuba, nkanda abana pa bubifi bwa bashibo ukufika na ku nkulo yalenga butatu ne yalenga bune iya bampata.

english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Aya e mafunde, amalango ne fipope ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu ankonkomeshe ukumufunda, ukuti mukaleyabaka mu calo ico mwalaswa mwabukilemo mwishilya lya Yordani pakucipoka.

english: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
translation: “Kabili Yawe Lesa wenu akamufisha mu calo alaile ifikolwe fyenu Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, ukuti akamupeela imwe icalo ca misumba ikalamba, kabili iyikankala, iyo imwe mushakuula.

english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
translation: Akamupeela amayanda ayaisulamo ifintu ifisuma fyonse ifyo imwe mushabikamo, ifishima ifyo imwe mushaimba, amabala ya myangashi na ya miolifa ayalimwa ayo imwe mushalimba. Nomba ilyo mukalalya nokwikuta mwaikuta,

english: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translation: cenjeleni, tecakwesha ukulaba Yawe, uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha.

english: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
translation: Icite 28:13

english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
translation: Mwikalakonka milungu imbi, iya bantu bambi abakaba mumbali.

english: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu, uo mwaba nankwe ni Lesa wabufuba, no bukali bwakwe bukamwishila ngo mulilo, kabili akamulofya mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.

english: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
translation: “Mwilaesha Yawe Lesa wenu nga filya mwacitile ku Masa.

english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
translation: Mumone ukuti mwabaka amafunde, ifyebo ne fipope ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu amupeela.

english: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.
translation: mukufulumunamo abalwani pa cinso cenu nga mulya mwine Yawe asosele.

english: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
translation: Ndemufunda pakuti imwe pamo na bana benu na bana babo mukaleba na katiina kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, mukubaka ifipope na mafunde ayo namupeela pakuti mukekale ne nsansa inshita iyitali.

english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”
translation: “Mu nshiku sha kuntanshi umwana obe nga akwipusha ati, ‘Bushe calola mwi ici Yawe Lesa wesu amukonkomeshe ukulakonka amafunde, ifyebo ne fipope fyakwe?’

english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
translation: Kuti mwamweba ati, ‘Ifwe twali abasha bakwa Farao mu Egupto, nomba Yawe atufumishe mu Egupto ku kuboko kwakwe ukwabulamba.

english: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
translation: Twalimwene na menso yesu uko Yawe alecita ifipeshamano ne finjelengwe ifikalamba kabili ifyabipisha pa bena Egupto na Farao kumo na ba ŋanda yakwe yonse.

english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
translation: Lelo atufumyako no kutuleta kuno, atupeela na cino calo alaile no mulapo ku fikolwe fyesu.

english: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
translation: Yawe alitukonkomeshe ukulabeela ifipope ifi fyonse, no kukwatila Yawe Lesa wesu akatiina pakuti cikatuwamine lyonse, tuleenda abomi, ngefi fine cili ilelo.

english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”
translation: Kabili nga twalabeela amafunde aya pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wesu ngefyo atukonkomesha, cikaba e bololoke bwesu.’”

english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
translation: Umfwa we Israeli, kabili ucenjele ukubeela pakuti cikuwamine kabili epakuti mukasande nganshi mu calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci. Nga mulya mwine Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu amulaile.

english: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.
translation: “Umfwa we Israeli! Yawe Lesa wesu, e Yawe ekafye.

english: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
translation: Uletemwa Yawe Lesa obe no mutima obe onse, no mweo obe onse, na maka yobe yonse.

english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
translation: Aya mafunde nakupeela lelo uleyabaka.

english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
translation: Uleyafunda na ku bana bobe. Muleyakomailapo ilyo mwikele pamyenu, kabili nelyo muleenda pa musebo, na pakusendama, kabili na lintu mwabuka mu tulo.

english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
translation: Muleyakakila pakuyafwala pa mpumi shenu na pa maboko yenu, pantu e cishibilo cakumwibukishako.

english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
translation: Ukuf 13:9

english: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Ilyo Yawe Lesa wenu akamutwala mu calo ico mukengilamo kukucipoka, akatamfyamo imishobo ya bantu iyingi. Akatamfyamo imishobo cine lubali iyikalamba kabili iyamaka ukumucila imwe, abena Hiti, abena Girigashi, abena Amoli, abena Kenani, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi.

english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
translation: Nomba

english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
translation: “Kanshi mulebaka amafunde, amalango ne fipope ifyo namupeela ilelo.”

english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
translation: Tito 2:14

english: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
translation: Yawe akatalusha ubulwele bonse uko muli. Takaleke amalwele ayabipisha yakamwishile nga yalya mwamwene ku Egupto, lelo yena eyo akaletela abalwani benu bonse.

english: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
translation: Mufwile ukulofya abantu bonsefye abo Yawe Lesa wenu aposa mu minwe yenu. Mwikalabakwatila luse, mwikalapepa milungu yabo pantu cikaba citeyo kuli imwe.

english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
translation: “Limbi kuti mwasosa amuti, ‘Iyi mishobo naitucila amaka ifwe. Nga kuti twabatamfya shani mu calo?’

english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
translation: Imili 13:19

english: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
translation: Kabili nga Yawe Lesa wenu abaposa mu minwe yenu no kubacimfya mwabacimfya, mukapeela bonsefye kukonaulwa . Tecakwesha kupangana nabo bucibusa, kabili takuli kubabelela luse.

english: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
translation: Amaf 4:20

english: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
translation: Mwikalabatiina aba bantu, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu, uwaba na imwe, ena mukulu kabili ni Lesa wakutiina.

english: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
translation: Yawe Lesa wenu akalatamfya iyi mishobo pa ntanshi yenu panono panono. Tamwakasuminishiwe ukulofya bonse pa mukufye umo, pantu nga mwacita ifyo, ifinama fya mpanga fikasanda no kulamucusha.

english: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
translation: Nomba Yawe Lesa wenu akabaposa uko muli, akabafulunganya amano mpakafye bakalobe.

english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.
translation: Ukuf 23:24

english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
translation: Mukaleoca ifimpashanya fya milungu yabo mu mulilo. Mwikalakumbwa silifa nangu golide uo bakambatikako. Tecakwesha kuusenda. Nga mwacita ico, ninshi mwaibika mu citeyo. Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alifipata.

english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
translation: Kabili mwikengisha icintu icapatwa mu mayanda yenu, pantu imwe pamo nga cena mukapatulwa kukonaulwa. Kanshi na imwe bene muli nokucipatafye pantu capatwilwa kukonaulwa.”

english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
translation: Mwikalaupana nabo. Mwikalaleka abana benu abanakashi bakaleupilwako, nangu abana benu abaume bakaleupilako.

english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
translation: Pantu bakafumya abana benu mukulankonka no kuya mukutumika imilungu imbi. Ninshi ubukali bwakwa Yawe bukamwimina no kumulofya bwangu.

english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
translation: Ifi efyo muli nokubacita. Mukabongolole ifibumbili fya malambo fyabo, mukatobolole na mabwe yabo bacindikisha, mukaputaule ne nceshi sha Ashera umulungu wabo, elyo mukoce no tulubi twabo mu mulilo.

english: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
translation: Pantu imwe muli bantu bamushilo abakwa Yawe Lesa wenu. Yawe Lesa wenu, alimupatula ku bantu bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse, nimwefye aisalila ukuba abantu bakwe abo acindamika.

english: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
translation: “Yawe tamutemenwe no kumusala pantu mwacilile abantu ba mu mishobo imbi ku bwingi, lelo nimwe mwacepeshepo pa mishobo ya bantu yonse.

english: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
translation: Lelo nico Yawe alimutemwa, alisunga no mulapo alaile ku fikolwe fyenu, ecalenga ukuti amupusushe ku kuboko kwa bulamba bwakwe, amulubule mu calo ca busha, amufumye na mu minwe yakwa Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto.

english: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
translation: Pet 2:9

english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Mulecenjela pakukonka amafunde yonse ndemupeela ilelo pakuti muleenda abomi, mulesanda, mukengile no kupoka icalo ico Yawe alaile no mulapo ku fikolwe fyenu.

english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
translation: Ilyo mukalalya no kulaikuta, mukalepaala Yawe Lesa wenu na matotelo pa mulandu wa busuma bwa calo ico amupeela.

english: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
translation: “Mulecenjela epali mwalaba Yawe Lesa wenu, mwafilwa ukulakonka amafunde, ifyebo ne fipope ifyo namupeela ilelo.

english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;
translation: Pantu limbi ilyo mwalya no kwikuta, mwakuula na mayanda ayasuma, mwaikala na bwino,

english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
translation: kabili ilyo imikuni ya ŋombe ne mbushi ne mpaanga shenu shafulisha, silifa na golide wenu yafulilako, elyo na fyonse ifyo mwakwata fyafulilako,

english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
translation: lyena imitima yenu ikaba ne cilumba, mukalaba kuli Yawe Lesa wenu uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha.

english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
translation: Ewamutungulwile muli yalya matololo ayakalamba kabili ayakutiina, cilya calo ca cilaka umushali amenshi, umwali nsoka shabusungu na bakaliŋongo. Emo amufumishe amenshi mu cilibwe icakosa.

english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
translation: Amupeele maana mu matololo pakuti mulye, icakulya ico ifikolwe fyenu fishaishibe. Pakumunasha no kumwesha, alefwaya ukuti pakulekelesha cikamuwamine.

english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
translation: Limbi kuti mwasosa ati, ‘Amaka yandi no bulamba bwa kuboko kwandi efyandetela ubu bukankala.’

english: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
translation: Nomba muleibukisha Yawe Lesa wenu, pantu ewamupeela amaka ayakumona ubukankala. Ico acitila ifyo ni pakuti abe uwacishinka palwa cipangano apangene ne fikolwe fyenu, ngefyo cili ilelo.

english: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
translation: Nga cakuti mwalaba Yawe Lesa wenu, mwakonka ne milungu imbi, mwalaipepa no kuifukamina, ndemusokako ine lelo ukuti cine cine muli nokuloba.

english: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
translation: Muleibukisha ifintu Yawe Lesa wenu amutungulwile pa lwendo ulutali mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane (40) pakuti amunashe, amweshe, eshibe ifili mu mitima yenu no kumona nga kuti mwabaka amafunde yakwe.

english: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
translation: Nga mwakaana ukubeela Yawe Lesa wenu, na imwe bene mukalobafye nge mishobo imbi ilya Yawe alofeshe mu menso yenu.”

english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.
translation: Alimunashishe, amuleka ukuti mumfwe insala elyo kabili amupeela na maana, icakulya ico imwe ne fikolwe fyenu mushaishibe, pakuti amulange ukuti te cakulya ceka cilenga umuntu aleenda umumi, lelo lishiwi lyonse ilifuma ku kanwa kakwa Yawe.

english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
translation: Mateo 4:4

english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
translation: Mwishibe kanshi mu mitima yenu ukuti, Yawe Lesa wenu alamufunda nga filya umuntu afunda umwana wakwe umwaume.

english: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
translation: Mulebaka amafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, mulekonka mu nshila shakwe no kulamucindika.

english: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu alemwingisha mu calo icisuma umwaba imimana, ifishiba fya menshi no tumfukumfuku twa menshi ayapita mu mawanga na mu mpili.

english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
translation: Icalo umwaba iŋanu, bale, imyangashi, imikunyu, amateke, amafuta ya miolifa no buci.

english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
translation: Icalo umushakatale amubula icakulya kabili umo mushakakabile kantu nelyo kamo. Icalo umo amabwe yaba aya fyela kabili na mu mpili kuti mwaimbamo umukuba.

english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,
translation: Kabili Mose atile, “Nomba umfwa we Israeli, uli mupepi no kwabuka umumana wa Yordani no kuya poka icalo umwikala imishobo iyikalamba, kabili iyamaka ukucila iwe, iyaba ne misumba ikalamba na malinga ayatali ayalola na mumulu.

english: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
translation: Yawe epakumpeela amabwe ayapapatala yabili apalembele ukuboko kwakwa Lesa. Pa mabwe ayapapatala palembelwe ifyebo fyonse ifyo Yawe abilile kuli imwe ukufuma mu mulilo pa bushiku mwalongene ku lupili.

english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
translation: Panuma ya nshiku amakumi yane (40), akasuba no bushiku, Yawe epakumpeela amabwe ayapapatala yabili apalembelwe icipangano.

english: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, ‘Endesha ukubwelelamo nombalinefye, pantu abantu bobe abo wafumishe mu Egupto nabalubana. Tabakokwele kupatuka mufyo nabakonkomesha, nabaipangila akalubi ka cela.’

english: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
translation: “Kabili Yawe epakunjeba ati, ‘Nimona ukuti aba bantu ni bankosa mitwe icine cine!

english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”
translation: Ndekafye mbalofye pakuti mfuute ne shina lyabo pano calo. Elyo iwe nkakulenga ukaba umushobo uwamaka kabili uukalamba ukubacila.’

english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
translation: “Kanshi na ine epakupilibuka natentemuka ulupili, ninsenda na mabwe ayapapatala yabili aya cipangano mu minwe yandi, ilyo ninshi ulupili lulebilimafye umulilo.

english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.
translation: Ilyo naloleshe, namwene ukuti namubifya kuli Yawe Lesa wenu. Mwaipangile icilubi ca ciponti ca ŋombe ica golide. Tamwakokwele kupula mwifunde ilyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.
translation: Na ine epakubuula amabwe ayapapatala yabili ayali mu minwe yandi nayaposa, nayatobaula no kutobaula na pa cinso cenu.

english: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
translation: Ukuf 24:18

english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.
translation: Ine natiinine ubukali ne cipyu cakwa Yawe, pantu alikalipe nganshi, kwempefye no kumulofya. Lelo nakabili Yawe aliŋumfwile.

english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
translation: Abantu babamo batali kabili abamaka, abena Anaki! Mwalibeshiba no kumfwa ifyo casoswa ukuti, ‘Nga nani engalwisha abena Anaki?’

english: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
translation: Kabili Yawe alifulilwe Aroni nganshi kwempefye no kumulofya, lelo pa nshita ine ilya nao wine nalimupapatileko.

english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.
translation: Bahi 12:21

english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.
translation: “Kabili mwalengele Yawe akalipe ilyo mwali ku Tabera, na ku Masa, na ku Kibroti Hatafa.

english: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.
translation: Kabili na ku Kadeshi Banea ilyo Yawe amutumine amwebele ati, ‘Kabiyeni muye poka icalo namupeela.’ Nako kwine mwalitalamine ifyo Yawe Lesa wenu amukonkomeshe. Tamwamucetekele nangu ukumubeela.

english: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
translation: Mulatalamina Yawe ukufumafye apo namwishibila.

english: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
translation: “Kanshi nalele ubukupeme pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa nshiku amakumi yane (40), akasuba no bushiku, pantu Yawe atile ali nokumulofya.

english: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
translation: Amaf 1:26

english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,
translation: Ibukisha ababomfi bobe, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Wilolesha pali bucintomfwa bwa aba bantu na ku bubi bwabo na kufyo babifishe.

english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
translation: Epali abena Egupto balasosa abati, “Pantu Yawe alifilwa ukubatwala mu calo abalaile, kabili alibapata, eco abasendele mu matololo pakuti abepaye.”

english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”
translation: Bahi 12:29

english: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.
translation: Kanshi mwishibe ilelo ukuti Yawe Lesa wenu eumutangilila ngo mulilo wabonaushi. Akabacimfya no kubalofya, na imwe mukabatamfya no kubalofya mukwangufyanya, ngefyo Yawe amulaile.

english: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.
translation: Icite 6:4

english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
translation: Te pa mulandu wa bulungami bwenu nangu bucishinka bwenu eco mwalapokela icalo, lelo Yawe Lesa wenu akatamfyamo iyi mishobo pa ntanshi yenu pa mulandu wa bubifi bwabo pakufikilisha icilayo ico alaile ifikolwe fyenu Abrahamu, Isaki, na Yakobo.

english: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.
translation: Kanshi mwishibe nomba ukuti, te pa mulandu wakuba abalungami eco Yawe Lesa wenu alemupeelela icalo icisuma ukucipoka, pantu na imwe bene muli nkosamitwe.

english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
translation: “Muleibukisha no kukanalaba ifyo mwalengele Yawe Lesa wenu akalipe mu matololo. Ukutulafye pa bushiku mwafumine mu Egupto mpaka nelyo mwafikile pano, mwabafye abatalamina Yawe.

english: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.
translation: Na ku Holebu mwalengele Yawe akalipe nganshi kwempefye no kumulofya.

english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
translation: Ilyo naile pa mulu wa lupili kukupoka amabwe ayapapatala apalembelwe icipangano ico Yawe apangene na imwe, naikelepo inshiku amakumi yane (40), akasuba no bushiku, nshalelya nangu kamo nangu ukunwa amenshi.

english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
translation: Nga filya balunshi abafwa bonaula umusukupala utuntulu uwa mafuta ya kacena akasuma,

english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
translation: Isembe lyobe nga nalifuupa, no kulinona taulinonene,

english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.
translation: Insoka nga yasuma ilyo tabalati bailafye

english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
translation: Umuntu wamano imilandile yakwe ilamucindamika,

english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
translation: Icipumbu cena cipumininapofye ukulanda ifyabupuba,

english: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?
translation: pantu icipumbu cena cilafusha amashiwi.

english: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
translation: Amalu 7:15

english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
translation: Icalo cilashama nga cateekwa ku mfumu iyaice,

english: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
translation: Icalo cilashuka nga cateekwa ku mfumu iyacindama,

english: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.
translation: Umunaŋani alafilwa ukusomena umutenge wa ŋanda yakwe,

english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.
translation: Amalila yalasekesha umuntu,

english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
translation: Umuntu wamano umutima wakwe umulosha kukucita ifyalungama,

english: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.
translation: Wilatuka imfumu nangufye ni mu mutima obe,

english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
translation: Ilyo cileenda mu musebo, imyendele yaciko ilalubana,

english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
translation: Kateeka nga akufulilwa, wilaleka mulimo obe,

english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
translation: Paliba ububifi ubo namona pano isonde, ubo bakateeka bacita.

english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
translation: Ifipumbu fya bantu filapeelwa imilimo iyingi iyacindama, lelo abakankala bena babapeelafye imilimo iyasaluka.

english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
translation: Ine naliimwena uko abasha baleendela pali bakabalwe, ninshi abana ba mfumu bena baleendafye panshi kwati basha.

english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
translation: Uwaimba icilindi, kuti mu cilindi mwine awilamo.

english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
translation: Uusona amabwe, kuti amabwe yene yamucena.

english: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.
translation: Uleishiba ubusuma bwakupeela,

english: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
translation: Eico wilalekafye nelyo cimo cilekusakamika,

english: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.
translation: Uleakanya icuma cobe ku bantu cine lubali nangu cine konse konse,

english: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.
translation: Ikumbi lya mfula nga lyateka,

english: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
translation: We muntu nga walalolela ukuti umwela uleke ukupuupa, tawakatande.

english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.
translation: Nga filya tawaishiba inshila umupita umwela,

english: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.
translation: Uletanda imbuto shobe ulucelo,

english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.
translation: Ulubuuto lwaliwama,

english: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.
translation: Nangu wingakokola imyaka iyingi pano calo, ulesansamuka pa myaka yonse iyo waikalapo. Nomba uleibukisha ukuti inshiku shakwikala mu mfifi shena eshikafulishapo. Fyonse ifikakonkapo kuicushafye.

english: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
translation: Ulesansamuka we mulumendo mu bwaice bobe.

english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”
translation: Uleibukisha Kabumba mu nshiku sha bwaice bobe,

english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
translation: Kafundisha alifwailishe bwino amashiwi ayalinga, nefyo alembele fyali ifyalungama kabili ifyacishinka.

english: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
translation: Insoselo sha bantu bamano shaba ishatwa nge cimuti icasongoka. Insoselo shabo shaba nge nsunga ishapampaminwa kabili ishaikashiwa, ishafuma kuli kacema umo mpo.

english: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
translation: We mwana wandi ulecenjela ku fyakulundwako kuli ifi. Uleishiba nokuti imilimo yakulemba ifitabo taingapwa nakalya, no kusambilila apakalamba nako kulanasha umuntu.

english: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
translation: Kanshi fyonse nafyumfwika, ishiwi lyakusondwelela umulandu ni ili ilyakuti,

english: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
translation: Pantu Lesa akatupingula pali fyonsefye ifyo tucita,

english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;
translation: Lintu akasuba no lubuuto, umweshi ne ntanda tafilashiminina,

english: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,
translation: Ilyo bakasunga wa ŋanda bakatutuma,

english: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;
translation: Ilyo ifiibi fya ku musebo fyaisalwa,

english: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets;
translation: Ilyo abaume bakatiina ukunina apasanswike,

english: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,
translation: Kanshi uleibukisha kabumba obe ilyo umunyololo wa silifa taulaputuka,

english: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
translation: No mubili wabwelela kwiloba uko wafumine,

english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
translation: “Kuicushafye, kuicushafye.” Efyasosa Kafundisha.

english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti Kafundisha ali na mano, kanshi ena abikilepofye ukulafundako abantu ifyakukwata amano. Alepelulwila no kufwaya fwaya no kuwamya amapinda ayengi.

english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
translation: Amashiwi yakwa Kafundisha mwana Davidi, uwali imfumu mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, ni aya ayakuti,

english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
translation: Nangu bamo bengalatila abati,

english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.
translation: Apo nomba kushaba muntu uwibukisha ifyaliko kale,

english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
translation: Ine ne Kafundisha nali imfumu ya bena Israeli mu musumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
translation: Nalibikile umutima wandi kukuceceta na mano ifintu fyonse ifyaba pano isonde pakuti mfishibishe. Iye icisendo ukufina ico Lesa atwika pali ifwe fwe bantunse!

english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translation: Ine pano ndi nalimona fyonsefye ifyaba pano isonde. Mwe, ala fyonsefye kuicushafye! Cabafye kwati kutamfya inshiku.

english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
translation: We muntu teti ololole icaolobana,

english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”
translation: Ine pano ndi naletifye nati, “Bonsefye abantangilila pa bufumu bwa muno Yerusalemu, awe mwandi ine nimbacila amano. Ine nimfikapo apo umuntu engapela ukukwata amano, napo engapela ukwishiba ifintu.”

english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
translation: Kanshi efyo ine nabikishe umutima kukwishiba amano, elyo no kwishiba ubushilu no bupuba. Elyo kabinge nailuka ukuti kanshi naco cine cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku.

english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
translation: Pantu ukukwatisha amano, ekuleta ubulanda.

english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
translation: “Kuicushafye, ala kuicushafye!” ekusosa kwakwa Kafundisha, “Fyonse tafyakwata nefyo fipilibula. Muli fyonse kuicushafye.

english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
translation: Ni finshi umuntu engamwenamo mu milimo yakwe yonse iyo acucutikamo pano isonde ?”

english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
translation: Inkulo shilapita, kabinge paselela shimbi,

english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
translation: Akasuba kalatula, no kuwa kawa,

english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
translation: Umwela pakupuupa ulalola ku kapinda ka ku kulyo,

english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
translation: Imimana yonse iwila muli bemba,

english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
translation: Ifintu fyonsefye filatendusha,

english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.
translation: Icalipo, cikabapo na limbi line.

english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.
translation: Ine natontonkenye mu mutima wandi ukuti, “Cisuma nalaeshafye ukulaisansamusha, epakuti ndeumfwisha apapela insansa.” Nomba uyu musango, awe nao wine kuicushafye.

english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.
translation: Isham 10:10

english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
translation: Elyo kabinge caisa mu mano yandi icakutontonkanya palwa milimo yonse iyo nabombele, nefyo nacucutike pakuibomba, no kwiluka nailuka ukuti kanshi nayo ine yakuicushafye. E cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku, tapaba nelyo cimo ico umuntu engamwenapo pano isonde.

english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.
translation: Kanshi ine epakutampa ukulatontonkanya ifyo ukuba na mano kwaba, nefyo ubushilu bwaba, nefyo ubupuba nabo bwaba. Ni finshi fimbi uwapyana pa bufumu engacita ukucila pafyo abaliko kale pa bufumu bacitile?

english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.
translation: Namwene ukuti, kanshi amano yalicila ubupuba, ngefi fine ulubuuto lwacila imfifi ku busuma.

english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.
translation: Epakulatontonkanya mu mutima wandi nati, “Ifiponena ifipuba, na ine wine efikamponena. Nga kanshi amano yandi yanshi?” Elyo nasosele mu mutima nati, “Awe kanshi nefi fine kuicushafye.”

english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
translation: Takwaba nelyo umo uwibukisha abantu bamano, ne fipuba fine takwaba nelyo umo uufibukisha. Umo inshiku shabela, nefwe bene bonse bakatulabako. Nangu tube abamano atemwa ifipuba, ala bonsefye tukafwa.

english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translation: Kanshi ine epakupata imikalile ya muli buno ubumi, pantu fyonsefye ificitika pano isonde ine fyalintendusha. Fyonsefye kuicushafye, cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku.

english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
translation: Fyonsefye ifyo ine nabombele nefyo nacucutikile pano isonde, ine naliisa fipata, pantu nalishibe ukuti nkafishila impyani yandi.

english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
translation: Nani engeshiba nga cakuti impyani ikaba iyamano nangu ikaba icipuba? Lelo kwena ni mpyani eili nokubuula fyonse ifyo ine nabombele, fyonsefye ifyo ine naculile pano calo, no kufinonka ku mulandu wa mano yandi. Ala uyu musango nao wine kuicushafye.

english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
translation: Ine nalimona ukuti inseko bupubafye, no bwangashi nabo tabubomba akasuma nelyo kamo.

english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
translation: Kanshi umutima wandi epakulalanguluka pakumona ifyo nabombeshe no kuculisha pano isonde.

english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.
translation: Kuti we muntu wabomba na mano yobe yonse, wabomfya ukwishiba, no kucenjela nomba moneni ifintu fine ifi ulifye nokufishila umuntu umbi uushaficulile. Ala uyu musango nao wine kuicushafye, kabili tawalolamo nangu panono.

english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
translation: Imila 9:22-27

english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
translation: Icintu icingawamishapo ku muntu, ala kulya no kunwa, no kulilapo pafyo aleculila. Nomba ine nalilwike ukuti noyu wine musango ufuma mu maka yakwa Lesa.

english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
translation: Imila 29:25

english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translation: Umuntu uusansamusha Lesa, eo Lesa apeela amano, ukwishiba ne nsansa. Lelo umubifi ena Lesa alaleka alecululuka pakunonka no kutulumanika ifyuma, pakuti akafishile umuntu umbi uusansamusha Lesa. Ici naco kuicushafye, cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku.

english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.
translation: Ine nalyeseshe ukulaisansamusha no bwalwa pakuti ne muntu ndepemwinako. Ninshi mu mano yandi ndetilafye, “Ee mwandi, e musango wine wine uo abantu bafwile ukulasansamukilamo pa kashita akanono ako bekala pano isonde.”

english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
translation: Ine nalibombele imilimo iyikulu nganshi. Nalikuulile amayanda ayandi ne mwine, nalima na mabala ya myangashi.

english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
translation: Nalelima amabala, nalima ne fibela fya miti ya fitwalo, umo nalimbile imiti ya misango yonse iya fitwalo.

english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.
translation: Nalicitile ne fishiba fya menshi ifyakutapilila imiti iyo nalimine.

english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.
translation: Ine nalishitile abasha abaume na banakashi, nalikwetepo na basha abafyalilwe kumwandi. Nalikwete iŋombe ne mpaanga ishingi ukucila na pali bonse abantangilile ukwikala muno mu Yerusalemu.

english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.
translation: Kabili nalitulumanike silifa na golide ne fyuma nalefumya kuli bashamfumu aba mu fyalo naleteeka. Nalikwete iŋomba ishaume ne shanakashi ishakunsansamusha, nalikwete na bakashi abashaupilwe mu bwinga abengi abo umwaume afwile akumbwa ukukwata.

english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.
translation: Ine nalipuuleme ukucila na pali bambi bonse abantangilile ukwikala muno Yerusalemu, na mano yene ine naliyakwete.

english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
translation: Kwaliba inshita ku cintu conse,

english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
translation: Ee, ine pano mpelele nalimona umulimo uwakakata uo Lesa abika pali ifwe fwe bantunse.

english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
translation: Ifintufye fyonse Lesa alifilenga ukuba ifisuma mu nshita yafiko. Kabili alitupeela amano ayakwishiba inshita iyapita ne ya kuntanshi, nomba ifwe teti twiluke pa milimo iyo Lesa abomba ukutulafye ku ntendekelo ukufika na ku mpela

english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
translation: Na ine epakwiluka ukuti kanshi cawama umuntu alesansamuka no kulacita ifisuma pa nshita acili umumi.

english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
translation: Umuntu onse ali nokulya, ali nokunwa, ali nokusansamuka pali fyonse ifyo aleculila, ifi bupe bwakwa Lesa.

english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
translation: Ine nalishiba ukuti fyonsefye ifyo Lesa acita, ala fyakubelelela pe. Fwe bantu kuti twafilililwafye ukulundapo cimo nangufye ukufumyapo cimo. Ifyo Lesa acita fyakufwayafye ukuti abantu balemukwatila akatiina, epela.

english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
translation: Icabapo, na limbi line epo cali. Icikacitika limbi, na nombaline ecilecitika. Lesa akalenga ukuti ifyaliko kale fyaisa bako nakabili.
