english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
translation: Kabili pano isonde ine nalimwene ifintu ifyaibelako, icakuti apali nokulacitika umulinganya epacitika ifyabubifi, apali nokulacitika ifisuma epacitika ifyabubifi.

english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
translation: Na ine epakulatontonkanya mu mutima wandi nati, “Ni Lesa eukaputwila abalungami na babifi imilandu, pantu kwaliba inshita ku milandu yonse ne micitile yonse.”

english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
translation: Kabili nalatontonkanya nati, “Lesa aleesha abantu pakubalanga ukuti babafye cimo cine nge nama.”

english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.
translation: Ngefyo ifituponena fwe bantu, efiponena ne nama shine. Umuntu alafwa, ne nama nayo ilafwa. Umuntu ne nama fipemenafye camumo. Umuntu tacila nama, pantu ubumi bwa muntu no bwa nama bumo bwine. Fyonse ifi kuicushafye.

english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
translation: Kuli inshita yakufyalwa, ne nshita yakufwa,

english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
translation: Umuntu ne nama fiyafye kumo kwine. Ni kwiloba ekwafuma umuntu ne nama, no kubwelela eko umuntu ne nama fibwelela.

english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
translation: Nani uwingashininkisha ngo mweo wa muntu uya mu mulu, no mweo wa nama nga uya panshi mu mushili?

english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
translation: Kanshi ine epakwiluka ukuti kanshi icingawamishapo ku muntu, awe kulilapofye pafyo aleculila, takuli cimbi ico muntu engacitapo, pantu takuli umusango umbi uo muntu engeshibilamo ifikamwishila ilyo akafwa.

english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
translation: inshita yakwipaya, ne nshita yakundapa,

english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
translation: inshita iyakulila, ne nshita iyakusansamuka,

english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
translation: inshita yakupasa amabwe, ne nshita yakuyalonganika,

english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
translation: inshita yakufwaya, ne nshita yakulufya,

english: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
translation: inshita yakulepula, ne nshita yakubila,

english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
translation: inshita yakutemwa, ne nshita yakupata,

english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
translation: Bushe cinshi ico umubomfi amwenapo pa mulimo wakwe?

english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
translation: Kabili nalimwene nakabili ukucula ukucitika pano isonde.

english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
translation: Pantu umo nga awa, umunankwe kuti amwimyako.

english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
translation: Nakabili abantu babili nga basendama pamo, kuti bakaba,

english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
translation: We muntu nga uli weka, kuti icipondo cakwansha,

english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
translation: Umulumendo umupina uwamano awamishapo ukucila imfumu ya calo iyikote iyishakwata mano, iyishifwaya na kulapandwako mano.

english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
translation: Umulumendo umo kuti afuma mu cifungo, aba ni mfumu ya calo, elyo nakalimo kuti afyelwefye umulanda mu calo cine ici.

english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
translation: Ine namwene ukuti bonse abekala pano isonde bakonkele umulumendo uwapyene ubufumu.

english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translation: Nao nomba ewalatungulula abantu bakwe abashili bakupenda ku bwingi, lelo icabulanda inkulo yakonkelepo tayasekelele uyu uwapyene pa bufumu. Uyu musango nao wine kuicushafye, cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku.

english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
translation: Ine nakumbilwepo na bantu abafwa,

english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
translation: Nomba abashilafyalwa,

english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
translation: Nalimona nokuti icilenga abantu balebombesha pakumona ifintu, nico balafwaya ukukwatisha ifintu ukucila pa banabo bambi bonse. Ee, uyu musango nao wine ala kuicushafye, cimo cinefye no kutamfya inshiku.

english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
translation: Umuwelewele aikumbatafye,

english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
translation: Kuti cawamishapo ukukwatapo tunono no mutima nawikala,

english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
translation: Kabili ine nalimonapo pano isonde icintu na cimbi icakuicushafye.

english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
translation: Kuti wasanga umuntu aikalafye eka mpo, nao takwatapo mwana nangufye munyina. Ukubomba nako kabili abombafye pe, nomba ukuti ifyuma fyakwe fimuteke panshi, awe cena nakalya. Untu abula no kulaipusha umwine ati, “Nga kanshi nani uo ine ndeculila ifi ku milimo icakuti nalakaaninapo no kusansamuka?” Ala uyu musango nao wine kuicushafye, mikalilefye yabulanda.

english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
translation: Caliwamishapo ukuba babili, ukucila ukuba wekafye mpo.

english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
translation: Uletekanya nga waya ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Ulepalaminako pakuti uleumfwa, pantu e musango wawamishapo ukucila ukulatuula amalambo nge fiwelewele fya bantu ifishaishiba bubi ficita.

english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
translation: Uwatemwisha indalama tatila shafula,

english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
translation: We muntu nga wakwatisha ifyuma,

english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
translation: Utulo twa mubomfi twaliwama,

english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
translation: Elyo ubushiku atola umupamba ne fyuma fyaloba,

english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
translation: Muno calo fwe bantu tufyalwa ukwabula ifyakufwala,

english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
translation: Awe kwena ici cintu tacawama,

english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
translation: Amalu 49:17

english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
translation: E mulandu wine ine nasangila ukuti cawamapo, we muntu, ukulya no kunwa, no kulilapo pafyo uleculila pano isonde pa kashita ako Lesa akupeela, pantu takuli cimbi ico we muntu wingacitapo.

english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
translation: Kabili Lesa nga akupeela ifyuma we muntu, akuletela ne shuko, aleka nokuti ulesansamukilamo, uletotelafye Lesa no kulaliila pafyo uleculila pantu ninshi fyonse ifi bupe bwakwa Lesa.

english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
translation: Pakulandapo cimo kutala watontonkanya,

english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
translation: We muntu, nga wakwatisha amasakamiko,

english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
translation: Nga walaya Lesa icilayo, ulecita ifyo walaya, pantu Lesa tatemwa ifipumbu fya bantu. Ulecita ifyo walaya.

english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
translation: Cawamishapo ukukanalaya icilayo, ukucila ukulaya icilayo elyo kabili panuma wakaana ukucifikilisha.

english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?
translation: Wilaleka misosele yobe ilekutwala kukubifya, icakuti kabili limbi waya eba shimapepo auti, “Awe nalubilefye.” Nga cinshi icakuti Lesa akufulilwe pa mulandu wa misosele yobe, akonawilepo nefyo waibombela we mwine?

english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
translation: Kanshi nangu ulelotalota ifintu shani, nangu usosesose shani, fyonse kuicushafye. Iwe ulekwatilafye Lesa akatiina.

english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.
translation: Te cakupapa nga wamona uko ababuteeko balecusha abalanda mu calo, uko balekaana ukubalungikila imilandu yabo no kulabapeela insambu shabo. Uwa mu buteeko onse alikwatapo umukalamba wakwe umo uumwangalila, na bonse bene babili balikwatapo abakalamba babo bambi ababangalila.

english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
translation: Abekalacalo bonse balanonkelamo mu bukumu bwa calo. Elyo imfumu yena inonkela mu fisabo fya mu mabala.

english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
translation: Eko caba icintu icibi na cimbi ico ine namona pano isonde icicusha umuntu nganshi.

english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.
translation: Icintu consefye icabapo, calikwata ishina,

english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?
translation: We muntu nga ulefusha ifyebo mukusosa,

english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?
translation: Ngo muntu kuti aishiba shani icingamuwamina pano isonde pa kashita kanono ako ekalapo imikalile yakuicushafye, nayo imikalile batini iyakongolokafye nge cinshingwa? Muntu nshi engeshiba ifikacitika pano isonde panuma ya kufwa kwakwe?

english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
translation: Limo kuti we muntu Lesa akupeela ifyuma, akucita umukankala, akucindamika icakuti we muntu tapali nelyo cimo icikubulile. Lelo Lesa wine akaana ukuti ulilepo, elyo umbi umbifye ena ewaisa mukulalilapo. Ici cintu naco kuicushafye, kabili kwena bulanda bukali.

english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;
translation: Umuntu umo nangufye engafyala abana umwanda umo (100), akokola na pano calo, nomba nga tasekelemo mu fyuma fyakwe, kabili tashiikilwe no mucinshi, awe ninshi cawamishapo no kufyalwa akapopo.

english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.
translation: Akapopo kafyalwa ukwabula ukwishibikwa, kashiikwa mu mfifi, ne shina takakwata nakalya lilobela mu mfifi.

english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.
translation: Takakatale akamona akasuba, takakatale akeshibapo kantu, lelo ukutuusha kwena kalakushukila ukucila no muntu mukankala,

english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?
translation: uushatala alilapo pa fyuma fyakwe nangula engakokola pano calo imyaka amakana yabili (2,000). Bushe akapopo no mukankala tabaya kumo kwine?

english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
translation: Umuntu alacululuka pakubombela ukulya,

english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi cimbi ico umuntu wamano acilako umuwelewele wa muntu?

english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translation: Cawamishapo we muntu ukulasekelafye pa tuntu uto wakwata, ukucila ukulakabila ifyo ushakwata,

english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.
translation: Ukukwata ishina ilyamucinshi kwawamishapo

english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.
translation: We muntu wilaesha kulalanda auti,

english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
translation: Ukukwata amano yasuma kwawama ngo kushukila ubupyani,

english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.
translation: Nga filya indalama shipokololako umuntu,

english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?
translation: We muntu uleloleshafye ifyo Lesa acita.

english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.
translation: Inshita shonse nga shalaba bwino, iwe kulasansamukafye,

english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.
translation: Mu bumi bwandi ubwakuicushafye pano calo nalifundwamo ifingi. Kuti we muntu wamonafye umuntu musuma afwa mu busuma bwakwe, umuntu umubifi nao ashala akokola pa calo no kulakonkanyapo ukubifya.

english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
translation: Kanshi iwe wilacishamo ukuba umusuma,

english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
translation: Lelo kwena wilabifya ukucilamo,

english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
translation: Cisuma ukuti wikate kuli ici,

english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
translation: Yako 1:19

english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
translation: Cawamishapo ukuya ku ŋanda ukuli icililo

english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
translation: Pano calo tapaba umololoke nelyo umo uulungika lyonsefye ukwabula ukulufyana.

english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;
translation: Kabinge wilaposako mano kufyo abantu balanda,

english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.
translation: Elyo nobe wailuka mu mutima obe ukuti na iwe wine walitukapo abantu bambi.

english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
translation: Ifi fyonse ine nalifipima mu mano yandi, kanshi ine epakukabila ukukwata amano, nomba amano nayo yantaluka.

english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
translation: Nga nomba umuntu kuti atesha shani umwalola amano? Kwena mwandini cintu cayafya ico fwe bantu tushingatesha uko calola.

english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.
translation: Eico amano yandi yapilibukile kukwishiba, ukufwailisha ifintu no kwipusha ipusha palwa mano nomo ifintu fyalola, elyo no kwishiba ubuwelewele bwa bubifi no bushilu ubwaba mu bupuba.

english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.
translation: Kabinge nalisanga icintu icikali ukucila ne mfwa, ni ncenjeshi ya mwanakashi, uyo umutima wakwe citeyo, na maboko yakwe yafyenta ngo munyololo. Umuntu uusansamusha Lesa ena kuti afyombotokako kuli uyu mwanakashi, nomba umubifi ena alekatwa kuli uyu mwanakashi.

english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation
translation: Mona, ine ne Kafundisha wine wine ici eco nasanga pakusuntinkanya cimo ku cinankwe pakuti nsange umwalola ifintu.

english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.
translation: Lelo ico ncili ndefwailisha, nomba nshilacisanga, nico icakuti pa baume ikana limo (1,000) pena nalisangapo umo umololoke, nomba pali iyi mpendwa nshasangilepo umwanakashi nelyo umo.

english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
translation: Icintu cimofye ico ine nasanga nici, icakuti fwe bantu Lesa alitubumbafye abakaele, nomba nifwefye fwe bene tuifwailafye imisango iyingi.

english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.
translation: Ukulanguluka kwawamishapo ukucila inseko,

english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
translation: Umutima wa muntu wamano waba mu ŋanda ya ndosha,

english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.
translation: Cawamishapo ukumfwila umuntu wamano uukukalipila,

english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.
translation: Pantu inseko sha muntu umupumbu shaba nge myunga ilepolopoka peshiko,

english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
translation: Umutitikisha ulalula uwamano ukuba icipuba,

english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
translation: Impela ya mulandu yawamishapo ukucila ukutendeka kwa mulandu,

english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
translation: Wilafulwa bwangu mu mutima obe,

english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
translation: Nani uwaba ngo muntu uwamano?

english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.
translation: Ine naliimwena uko abantu ababifi baleshiikwa, abaleingila no kufuma mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa elyo balabalumbanya mu musumba mwine umo balya bantu balecitila ifibi. Uyu musango nao wine wakuicushafye.

english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
translation: Mulandu nshi abantu bashitiinina kulacita milandu? Nico abamilandu tababalimuna mukwangufyanya iyoo.

english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
translation: Nangula umuntu umubifi engalabifya libili libili, elyo nokuba no bumi ubwatantalila, kwena ine nalishiba ukuti abapetamina Lesa no kumukwatila akatiina cilabaletela ishuko ilyacililapo.

english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
translation: Nomba ico abantu ababifi tabakwatila Lesa akatiina nakalya, bena bakashama. Inshita yabo iyakwikala pano calo ikabafye nge cinshingwa.

english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
translation: Paliba imisango iyakuicushafye iyicitika pano isonde. Limo abantu abololoke balaponenwa ne shamo ilifwile lileponena abantu ababifi. Limbi wamona uko abantu babifi balekwata ishuko ilifwile elilekwata abantu abololoke. Ala uyu musango nao ine ntilafye misango yakuicushafye.

english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
translation: Na ine epakushininkisha ukuti kanshi umuntu ali nokulilapofye, pantu takwaba iciwamina umuntu pano isonde ukucila pakulya no kunwa, no kuisansamusha umwine. Pantu akasanga ukusekelela mu milimo yakwe mu nshiku shakwe shonse isho Lesa amupeela ishakwikala pano isonde.

english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
translation: Ilyo napeeleshe umutima wandi mukwishiba amano, na pakusambilila ifyo umuntu ekala, nefyo abomba pano isonde, icakuti na menso yakwe tayamona tulo ubwaca no bwaila,

english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
translation: elintu namwene fyonse ifyo Lesa acita. Tapaba ifyo umuntu engeshibapo pa ficitika mwisamba lya kasuba. Nangu umuntu engatulukusha shani mukufwailisha, lelo teti eshibe umo calola. Nangufye umuntu uwamano engatila nalishiba, lelo teti eshibe ukufikapo.

english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
translation: We muntu ulenakila ifyebo fya mfumu ya calo pa mulandu wa cilayo cobe kuli Lesa.

english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
translation: Wifuma bwangu ku mulola wa mfumu, kabili wiimina imfumu no kukomaila pa mulandu uushiweme, pantu imfumu ya calo kuti yacita ifyo itemenwe.

english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
translation: Imfumu ya calo ilanda na maka, teti pamoneke nelyo umo uwakuicilima nokuti, “Cinshi mwacitila ici?”

english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
translation: Uusunga ifyebo fyaiko alekala umutelelwe, kabinge umutima uleshiba umusango wakunakililamo ne nshita yakunakililapo.

english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
translation: Kwaliba inshita iyalinga iyakubombelapo umulimo onse, kabili kwaba no musango uwalinga uwakubombelamo umulimo onse, nelyo amafya ya muntu yamufulila.

english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
translation: Pali ifwe fwe bantu, tapaba nelyo umo uwaishiba ifikacitika kuntanshi, nga nani uwingatwebako ifili nokwisa?

english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.
translation: Takwaba muntu uwakwata amaka pa mweo wakwe kukuucingilila, eico takuli umuntu uwakwata amaka yakubutuka imfwa. Ngefyo takwaba uo basuminisha ukuleka imilimo pa nshita ya nkondo, efyo no bubifi tabwakapusushe ababucita nakalya.

english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.
translation: Ifi fyonse ine nalifishibe ilyo naletontonkanya pa mulandu wa fintu ificitika pano isonde, inshita imo ilyo abantu batitikisha abanabo kukuyonaula.

english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
translation: Ine nalitontonkenye nganshi pali ifi fyonse, nasanga nokuti uutungulula imicitile ya bantu abololoke na bamano ni Lesa, lelo tapaba nelyo umo uwishiba ifikamufikila kuntanshi nga kutemwa nangu ukupata.

english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
translation: Umulimo onsefye uo waikata, iwe uubombeshefye ilyo ucili na maka, pantu ku calo ca bafwa uko iwe uli nokuya, takwaba cakucitako, takwaba cakutontonkanyako, takwaba cakwishibako, na mano yene takwaba nakalya.

english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
translation: Pano isonde ine nalimonapo icintu na cimbi, naco nici. Ukucimfyanya mu lubilo tekwa babutukisha iyoo, inkondo nayo te ya bantu abamaka bekafye iyoo. Abamano telyonsefye bashukila icakulya iyoo, na bantu abacenjela telyonsefye bashukila ifyuma iyoo, na bantu abasambilila telyonsefye basekelelwa iyoo. Pantu akashita ne shuko fishila abantu bonse.

english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
translation: Nakuba takwaba umuntu uwishiba ilyo inshita yakwe ikafika. Nga filya fine isabi likatwa mwisumbu, nangu nga filya fine ifyuni fikatwa mu fiteyo, efyo na bantu bene baponenwa ne shamo ilisa mukupumikisha.

english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
translation: Pano isonde nalimonapo icilangililo cimo palwa mano ico namwene ukuti cikankala.

english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
translation: Kwaliko umusumba umo uunono uwaleikalamo abantu abanonofye. Elyo kwaishile ne mfumu imo iyamaka no kwisa uwililila yaushinguluka, yapekanya ne fyakututawilako amalinga yauko.

english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
translation: Muli uyo wine musumba mwalimo no mulanda umo uwamano uwaile nasha nasha imfumu, apususha no musumba ku mulandu wa mano yakwe. Lelo tamwali nelyo umo uwaposeleko amano kuli ulya mulanda.

english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakutila, “Cine cine amano yaliwamisha ukucila amaka.” Nomba amano ya mulanda abantu tabayaposako mano iyoo, abantu balasuula nefyo umulanda alesosa.

english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
translation: Cawamishapo ukukutika ku mashiwi ya bamano abalanda nabateka umutima,

english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
translation: Amano yalabomba bwino ukucila ifyanso fya nkondo,

english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
translation: Fyonse ifishila umuntu fimo fine, pantu ifiponena abakaele efiponena na babifi. Ifiponena abasuma efiponena na babi bene, ifiponena abashasangululwa efiponena na basangululwa bene. Ifiponena abapepa Lesa efiponena na bashipepa Lesa bene. Ifyo ciba ku muntu musuma efyo ciba na ku mubifi, ifyo ku walaya icilayo efyo ciba na ku uushilaileko wine.

english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
translation: Kwena ici cintu ecabipisha pali fyonse ificitika pano isonde, ifiponena bonsefye ala fimo fine. Mu mitima yabo mulafulisha ububi, abantu balakwatisha no bushilu mu nda shabo ilyo bacili abomi, na pakulekelesha imfwa yabasanga baya na ku balobe.

english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
translation: Umuntu onse uucili umumi pano isonde ena alaba ne subilo, pantu imbwa iyumi yawamishapo ukucila inkalamo iyafwa.

english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
translation: Pantu abomi balishiba ukuti bakafwa, lelo abafwa bena tabeshibapo kantu, tabalolelapo icilambu na cimbi pantu bena balilabwako.

english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
translation: Ukutemwa kwabo ne mpatila yabo no bufuba bwabo, fyonse fyaliloba kale. Tabakatale nakabili abakumako ku filecitika pano isonde nakalya.

english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
translation: Iwe we muntu ulelyafye icakulya cobe ne nsansa, no kulanwa umwangashi obe pakuti ulesansamuka, pantu imilimo yobe Lesa aliisekelela.

english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
translation: Mu nshita shonse ulefwala ifyabusaka ifyabuuta, kabili ulemoneka uwasansamuka, ulesuba na mafuta pa menso.

english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
translation: Uleikala ne nsansa no mukashi uo watemwa, mu nshiku shonse isha bumi bwakuicushafye isho ukekala pano isonde, mu nshiku shobe shonse ishakuicushafye. Pantu e cilambu cobe ico we muntu wapeelwa mu mikalile yobe iyakucululuka pano isonde.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
translation: Ine Paulo, Lesa kukufwaya kwakwefye anjita ukuba umusole wakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
translation: Ilyo inshita yalinga ikafika, elyo Lesa akafikilisha amapange yakwe. Akalonganya ifintu fyonse pamo, ifya mu mulu ne fya pano isonde ukuti Kristu eo alefiteeka fyonse.

english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
translation: Nico tuli muli Kristu ecalengele ukuti Lesa atusale tube abantu bakwe. Pantu Lesa atusobwela libela ukufumafye ku citendekelo, ukulingana na mapange yakwe. Lesa wena, mu fintu fyonse abomba umo alefwaila.

english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
translation: Kanshi ifwe fwe babalilapo ukutetekela muli Kristu, tulenge ukulumbanya ubucindami bwakwa Lesa.

english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
translation: Kabili muli Kristu, na imwe ilyo mwaumfwile amashiwi yacishinka, Imbila Nsuma iyakumupususha, no kusumina mwasumine muli Kristu, Lesa amupeele Mupashi Wamushilo uo alaile, icishibilo cakulanga ukuti muli bantu bakwa Lesa.

english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
translation: Kolo 1:14

english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
translation: Kanshi ecalenga ukuti, apo naumfwila palwa cisumino cenu mu Mfumu Yesu nefyo mwatemwa abamushilo bonse,

english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
translation: nshatala ndeka ukutasha Lesa pa mulandu wa imwe. Ndamwibukishako mu mapepo yandi.

english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
translation: Ndalomba na Lesa wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu, Shifwe mucindami, ukuti amupeele Mupashi uwakumupanda amano no kumusokolwela Lesa, pakuti mumwishibe.

english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
translation: Kabili ndalomba nokuti Mupashi amusanikile amano yenu, pakuti mwishibe isubilo Lesa amwitako. Ndalomba nokuti mwishibe ubucindami bwa mapaalo Lesa alaya abantu bakwe abamushilo.

english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
translation: Elyo ndalomba nokuti mwishibe nefyo amaka yakula ayabomba muli ifwe fwe basumina. Amaka ayabomba muli ifwe, maka yamo yene ayakalamba nganshi,

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende fyakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
translation: ayo abomfeshe pakubusha Kristu ku bafwa no kumuteka lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwe mu mulu.

english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
translation: Nomba alimucindamika, amupeela ubufumu ukucila pali bakateeka ba mu mulu bonse, ubuteko bonse, abamaka bonse ne shamfumu shonse. Alikwata ishina ilyalumbuka ukucila amashina yambi yonse ayalumbuka pali ino nshita ne nshita ikesa kuntanshi.

english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
translation: Lesa alenga Kristu ukuti acimfye fyonse. Lesa amupeela na ku lukuta ukuti abe e mutwe wa fintu fyonse.

english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
translation: Pantu ulukuta e mubili wakwa Kristu, umo aba uwapwililika. Kabili ni Kristu wine eulenga na fyonse fipwililike.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
translation: Natuletasha Lesa kabili Wishi wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu! Pantu, ico tuli muli Kristu, Lesa alitupaala ne paalo lyonse ukufuma ku mulu.

english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
translation: Ilyo Lesa talati abumbe icalo, ninshi alitusala ukuba abamushilo kabili abakaele pa cinso cakwe pa mulandu wakwa Kristu.

english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
translation: Lesa ku kutemwa kwakwe atusobwela libela ukuba abana bakwe pa mulandu wakwa Yesu Kristu. Ni ku kutemwafye umwine Lesa afwaile ifi.

english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.
translation: Kanshi natulelumbanya Lesa pa cikuuku cakwe icikalamba, ico umwine ku kufwayafye kwakwe atukwatila pa mulandu wakwa Mwane uo atemwisha.

english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
translation: Kristu alitulubula ku mulandu wa mfwa yakwe. Umulopa wakwe walenga nokuti tubelelwe uluse ku fyabubifi fyesu. We cikuuku cakwa Lesa nobe ulakula,

english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
translation: ico mu mano yakwe yonse na mu kwiluka kwakwe konse alenga ukuti tushukile.

english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
translation: Lesa alenga twishibe inkaama apangile umwine ukulingana no kutemwa kwakwe, iyo Kristu ali nokufikilisha.

english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
translation: Imwe kale mwalifwile pa mulandu wa bumpulamafunde no bubifi bwenu.

english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
translation: Ifwe tulifye fibumbwa fyakwa Lesa. Lesa alitubumba, fwe bali muli Kristu Yesu, pakuti tulebomba imilimo isuma iyo Lesa umwine atuteyanishishe kale ukuti tuli nokuibomba.

english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
translation: Imwe mwe Benafyalo muleibukisha ifyo mwali kale. Abayuda bamwita, “Abashasembululwa.” Abene bena baita ukuti tuli basembululwa ukulingana nefyo abaume bacita ku mibili yabo.

english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
translation: Mwibukishe ukuti pa nshita ilya tamwaishibe Kristu, mwali ukutali. Mwali abeni abashali ba mu mushobo wa bena Israeli. Imwe tamwakumine na ku fipangano umo Lesa alaile ifintu ali nokupeela abantu bakwe. Mwaleikala pano calo ukwabula isubilo kabili ukwabula Lesa.

english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
translation: Kolo 2:13

english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
translation: Pantu Kristu umwine atucita umushobo umo. Aleta icibote pakati ka Bayuda na Benafyalo. Ku mubili wakwe eko abongolwela icibumba icalebalekanya no kubapatanya.

english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
translation: Alilesha Amafunde yakwa Mose ne ntambi na fyonse ifyo yalekonkomesha. Acita ifi pakuti awikishanye iyi mishobo, elyo umwine kuli iyi mishobo ibili apangeko umushobo umo uupya uwacibote.

english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
translation: Kristu ku mfwa yakwe iya pa musalaba alyonaula ulupato ulwali pakati ka iyi mishobo. Kabili ku mfwa yakwe auminkanya imishobo iyi ibili ukuba umubili umo, aubwesesha na kuli Lesa.

english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
translation: Kristu aishile bila Imbila Nsuma yacibote ku bantu bonse, kuli imwe mwe Benafyalo mwe bali ukutali na Lesa, elyo na ku Bayuda bene abali mupepi na Lesa.

english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wakwa Kristu eco ifwe bonse Abayuda na Benafyalo twishila pa cinso cakwa Wishi ku bwafwilisho bwakwa Mupashi.

english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
translation: Kanshi eico nomba na imwe mwe Benafyalo tamuli beni nangu imitulatulafye iyoo. Na imwe nomba muli bakaya pamo na bamushilo, mulifye bantu ba mu lupwa lwakwa Lesa.

english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
translation: Pantu mu bumi bwenu mwalekonkelela imisango iyabipa iya pano calo. Mwalenakila na kateeka wa bufumu bwa mu lwelele, Ciwa uo na nombaline acili alebomba mu bantu abashipetamina Lesa.

english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
translation: Kolo 1:20

english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
translation: Ni Kristu umwine uo twaampana nankwe ewikasha icikuulwa conse no kuleka ukuti cikule, caluke itempele lyamushilo ilya Mfumu.

english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
translation: Na imwe bene mwe Benafyalo, Kristu uo mwaampana nankwe alamukuula pakuti mube iŋanda Lesa ekalamo ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwe.

english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
translation: Kwena bonse pa nshita imo na ifwe efyo twali. Twaikele mukukonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi, twalecitafye ifilefwaya imibili yesu na mano yesu. Kanshi mu buntunse bwesu pamo nga bantu bambi bonse, Lesa ali nokutukanda.

english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
translation: Lelo Lesa alikwatisha uluse, kabili alitutemwisha nganshi.

english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
translation: Eico ilyo twali abafwa ku mulandu wa kubifya kwesu, Lesa alengele tube abamweo pamo na Kristu. Ni ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa eko mwapusukila.

english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
translation: Kanshi pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, Lesa alitubusha pamo nankwe, pakuti twikale pamo na Kristu Yesu mu mulu.

english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
translation: Ico Lesa acitila ifyo, ni pakulanga ku myaka yonse iya kuntanshi ifyo icikuuku atukwatila cacilamo ku bukulu ico atutemwa pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
translation: Pantu ni ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa, ico mwasumina, eko mwapusukila. Ici cena bupefye bwakwa Lesa,

english: not of works, that no one would boast.
translation: te ku maka yenu iyoo. Kanshi tapali nangu umo uwakuitakisha pali ici.

english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
translation: Ni pa mulandu uyu, ine ne Paulo ndi mu cifungo ico mombela Kristu Yesu pa mulandu wenu mwe Benafyalo.

english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
translation: Epakuti nomba mukubomfya ulukuta lwakwe, bakateeka na bamaka bonse aba mu mulu beshibe amano yakwa Lesa aya misango ne misango.

english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: Lesa abomfya Kristu Yesu Imfumu yesu pakufikilisha aya mapange akwete ukufumafye na ku kale.

english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
translation: Nico tuli muli Kristu neco twamusumina, ecilenga ukuti tuye pa cinso cakwa Lesa natupama, kabili ukwabula ukutwishika.

english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
translation: Kanshi namupapata mwinenuka pali ico ndemuculila, ala fyonse ifi fyakumuletela ubucindami.

english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Kanshi eico mfukamina Shifwe,

english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
translation: uwinika ishina ulupwa lonse ulwa mu mulu na pano calo.

english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
translation: Ndelomba Lesa ukuti ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwe na ku bukankala bwa bucindami bwakwe mube abakosa mu mitima yenu.

english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
translation: Ndelomba nokuti ku cisumino mwakwata, Kristu aleikala mu mitima yenu nokuti emo icitemwiko cishimpwe cibe icakosa nganshi.

english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
translation: Epakuti imwe pamo na bamushilo bonse mumone ukuba na maka yakumfwikisha ubukulu, ubutali, ukusumbuka no kushika kwa citemwiko cakwa Kristu.

english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
translation: Ee, muli nokwishiba icitemwiko cakwa Kristu nangu amano yonse teti yomfwe apo capela. Lyena elyo mukesushiwamo ne mibeele yakwa Lesa yonse.

english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
translation: Kwena mwalyumfwa ifyo Lesa ku cikuuku cakwe ampeela uyu mulimo uwakumubombela.

english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
translation: Natulelumba Lesa uo amaka yakwe yabomba muli ifwe, kabili kuti abomba ne ficilile pafyo twingalomba nangu pafyo twingatontonkanya.

english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Kanshi inshita yonse mu lukuta na mukuba muli Kristu Yesu, Lesa nalelumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
translation: Ngefyo nembelepo kale panono, Lesa alinsokolwela pakuti njishibe inkaama ya mapange yakwe.

english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
translation: Nga mwabelenga ifyo nembelepo, kuti mwailuka pafyo naishiba pa nkaama yakwa Kristu.

english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
translation: Mu nkulo ishapita, abantu tabaishibe iyi nkaama. Lelo nomba Lesa alisokolola iyi nkaama ku maka yakwa Mupashi ku basole bakwe abamushilo na bakasesema.

english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
translation: Ne nkaama niyi iyakuti, pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma, Abenafyalo nabo balishukilako amapaalo yakwa Lesa pamo na Bayuda. Bonse pamo baba umubili umo, kabili mukuba muli Kristu Yesu balashukila ifyo Lesa alaya.

english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
translation: Lesa ku cikuuku cakwe alenga ukuti mbe umubomfi wa Mbila Nsuma, elyo ampeelako na maka yakwe ayabomba muli ine.

english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
translation: Abamushilo bonse balincila ukucindama. Nomba nine Lesa apeela icikuuku cakubila ku Benafyalo ifintu ifikankala ifyacipeshamano ifyaba mu Mbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu.

english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
translation: Ampeela no kulenga ukuti abantu beshibe ifyo ifya mu nkaama yakwe fili nokufikilishiwa. Lesa kabumba wa fintu fyonse alifishile ifyaba mu nkaama yakwe imyaka yonse iyi yapita.

english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
translation: Ine neo baposa mu cifungo pa mulandu wakubombela Imfumu, ndemupapata ukuti muleenda ne myendele iyalinga no bwite Lesa amwitako.

english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
translation: Lelo uyu waikile, euyu wine uwaninine apula acila ne myulu yonse pakuti akumanefye mu fintu fyonse.

english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
translation: Euyu wine apeela ubupe, bamo ukuba abasole, bambi ukuba bakasesema, bambi ukulabila Imbila Nsuma, bambi ukuba bakacema na bakafundisha.

english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
translation: Pakuti bonse pamo tukakwate icisumino cimo cine na mano yamo yene ayakwishiba Mwana Lesa. Lyena elyo tukakula, tukafike na ku ciimo cakwa Kristu.

english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
translation: Lyena ninshi twaleka ukuba abaice abasendwa na matamba uku noku, abasendwa no mwela konse uko wapuupila, emukutila abasendwa na mafunde ya ncenjeshi sha bantu. Aba ebongola abantu no kubatwala mu cilubo ku mano yabo ayabucenjeshi.

english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
translation: Lelo nga twalalanda ifyacishinka no mutima wakutemwana, lyena ninshi tukakula mu nshila shonse tukapalane na Kristu, umutwe wesu.

english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
translation: Ni muli uyu wine Kristu emo ifilundwa fyonse ifya mubili fyasuntinkana no kulundinkanina pamo. Elyo cila cilundwa naco cilabomba umulimo waciko pakuti umubili wikatane. Kabili lyena umubili onse ulakulilako no kukoselako mukutemwana.

english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
translation: Kanshi ndemweba no kumukonkomesha pa cinso ca Mfumu ukuti, mwilaenda ne myendele yabuwelewele nga bantu abashaishiba Lesa.

english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
translation: Amalu 68:18

english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
translation: Kolo 2:19

english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
translation: Muleicefya lyonse, mube abamutembo, muletekelana imitima. Muletemwana mukushipikishanya.

english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
translation: Nomba imwe tefyo mwasambilile pali Kristu iyoo.

english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
translation: Nga cacine cine mwalyumfwa pali Kristu, elyo kabili mwalifundwa ne fyacishinka pali Kristu!

english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
translation: Kanshi fuuleni imisango yenu iyakale. Muleke imikalile ya bumuntu bwenu ubwakale ubwa lunkumbwa ululebonaula.

english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
translation: Imitima yenu na mano yenu fisanguke ifipya.

english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
translation: Muli nokufwala bumuntu bupya, ubwabumbwa mu cata cakwa Lesa, pakuti ubumi bwenu bulemoneka icine cine ubwamushilo kabinge ubwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
translation: Kanshi, lekeni ubufi! Cila umo alelanda ifyacishinka ku munankwe, pantu ifwe bonse tuli filundwa fya mubili umo.

english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
translation: Nga cakuti mwafulwa, mwilaleka ukufulwa kwenu kumutwale kukubifya. Mwileka akasuba kawe mwikelefye mukufulwa.

english: and don’t give place to the devil.
translation: Mwilaleka Ciwa ashukile akashita kakumutwala mu ntunko.

english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
translation: Uwaleiba aleke ukulaiba. Atampe nomba ukubomba, pakuti aleisunga mukuibombela umwine, akwate ne fyakukumbusukako abalanda.

english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
translation: Mwilabomfya mashiwi yabi, lelo mulebomfyafye amashiwi yakubafwa, ayakubakosha, ayalingile pali iyo nshita, epakuti yaletele ipaalo ku baleumfwako.

english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
translation: Mulesakamana ukusunga icumfwano Mupashi amupeela mukwikala na banenu pamo mu mutende.

english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
translation: Mwilalenga Mupashi Wamushilo wakwa Lesa ukuba no bulanda. Pantu Mupashi uo mwakwata e cishibilo mwashininkishishako ukuti muli bantu bakwa Lesa, abo akalubula pali bulya Bushiku.

english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
translation: Mwilaba abasashila ku banenu, muleke icipyu no bukali. Mwilaotokela muntu nelyo umo nangu ukumubepesha. Mwilapata muntu nelyo umo.

english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
translation: Lelo muleba ne cilela, kabili abamutembo ku banenu. Mulebelela abanenu uluse, nga filya Lesa amubelela uluse pa mulandu wakwa Kristu.

english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
translation: Kwabafye umubili umo na Mupashi umo, nga filya fine kwabafye icakusubila cimo ico Lesa amwitako.

english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
translation: Kwabafye Imfumu imo, icisumino cimo no lubatisho lumo.

english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
translation: Kwabafye Lesa umo, kabili e Wishi wa bantu bonse. Wena alicila pali bonse, abomba muli bonse, aba na muli bonse.

english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
translation: Ifwe bonse umo umo, ukulingana nomo Kristu alefwaila ukupeela, twalipokelelako icikuuku cakwe.

english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
translation: Efyo casoswa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti,

english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
translation: Ngeci cakuti, “Alininine,” calola mwi? Calola mukuti, pakubala atalile aikila pesamba lya calo.

english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
translation: Kanshi apo muli bana bakwa Lesa abo atemwa, mulemupashanya.

english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
translation: Kanshi muleesha ukwishiba ifintu ifisansamusha Imfumu.

english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
translation: Muletaluka ku fintu fyaciwelewele ifyo bantu bacita mu mfifi. Imwe mulefileta pa lwalala.

english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
translation: Pantu ifyo bacita mu bumfisolo, fintu abantu bakwatilapo insoni nelyo ukufilandapo.

english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
translation: Pantu ifintu ifyo baleta ku lubuuto, fileshibikwa icine cine ifyo fyaba.

english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
translation: Icintu conse icasokolokela pa lwalala, caluka ulubuuto. Eco casoselwa ukuti,

english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
translation: Kanshi mulemona bwino bwino imyendele yenu mu bumi bwenu. Mwilaenda kwati ni mpelwamano, lelo muleenda nga bamano.

english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
translation: Mulebomfya bwino inshita yonse iyo mwashukila, pantu shino nshiku nashibipa.

english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
translation: Kolo 3:18

english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
translation: Esaya 26:19

english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
translation: Kabili muleenda abatemwana, nga filya Kristu atutemenwe, asukile aileka ilambo pa mulandu wesu, umutuulo uwa cena cisuma kuli Lesa.

english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
translation: Lyonse mulebomfya ishina lya Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu pakutasha Lesa Tata pa fintu fyonse atupeela.

english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
translation: Mulenakilana pa mulandu wakucindika Kristu.

english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
translation: Mwe bakashi, mulenakila abalume benu nga filya munakila Imfumu.

english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
translation: Pantu umulume e mutwe wa mukashi wakwe nga filya Kristu aba e mutwe wa lukuta. Elyo Kristu umwine e Mupusushi wa lukuta ulwaba e mubili wakwe.

english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
translation: Kanshi nga filya ulukuta lunakila Kristu, efyo abakashi nabo bali nokunakila abalume babo muli fyonse.

english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
translation: Mwe balume, na imwe muletemwa abakashi benu nga filya Kristu atemwa ulukuta, alekelapo no mweo wakwe.

english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
translation: Acita ifi, pakuti ulukuta lube ulwamushilo, ulwasangululwa mukusambika ku menshi na ku mashiwi yakwe.

english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
translation: Epakuti aikwatile umwine ulukuta ulwayemba, ulwabula akakumbe nangu imikoni nangu akabi konse, lelo ulwamushilo, ulwabula ubulema.

english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
translation: Efyo fine abalume bali nokutemwa abakashi babo nga filya fine batemwa imibili yabo. Umwaume uwatemwa umukashi wakwe ninshi aliitemwa umwine.

english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
translation: Tapatala apaba umuntu uwapata umubili wakwe. Lelo alaulisha no kuusunga bwino, nga filya fine Kristu acita ulukuta.

english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
translation: Apo imwe muli bamushilo bakwa Lesa, kuli imwe takuli nakumfwika ifyabulalelale nangu bucilende nangu ulunkumbwa lwa fyuma.

english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
translation: Pantu ifwe tuli filundwa fya mubili wakwe.

english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Kanshi eco umwaume ashiila wishi na nyina no kuminkana no mukashi wakwe, elyo aba babili baba umubili umo.”

english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
translation: Aya mashiwi yasokolola amashiwi ya nkaama ikalamba. Ine ŋumfwa ukuti yalola kuli Kristu na ku lukuta.

english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
translation: Kanshi na imwe bene nifyo fine. Umulume onse ali nokutemwa umukashi wakwe ngefyo aitemwa umwine. Elyo umukashi nao onse ali nokucindika umulume wakwe.

english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
translation: Imwe tamuli nakubomfya amashiwi yabi, amashiwi yabupuba, nangu ayabula umucinshi. Lelo imwe cilingilefye ukulatasha.

english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
translation: Kanshi mushininkishe ukuti umuntu cilalelale, impulumushi, no wa lunkumbwa lwa fyuma, pantu ici cena cimo no kupepa utulubi, takapyane Bufumu bwakwa Kristu na Lesa.

english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
translation: Mwilaleka muntu nelyo umo amubepaike ku mashiwi yaciwelewele, pantu ni pa mulandu wa ifi fintu eco ubukali bwakwa Lesa bwishila abantu abashimupetamina.

english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
translation: Kanshi aba bantu te bakwampana nabo.

english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
translation: Pantu kale mwali mu mfifi, lelo ico nomba muli bantu ba Mfumu, mwaba mu lubuuto. Kanshi nomba muleenda nga bantu abekala mu lubuuto.

english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
translation: Pantu ulubuuto lwena luletafye ifisuma fyeka fyeka, ubololoke ne cishinka.

english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
translation: Mwe bana, mulenakila abafyashi benu. Ifi efyo cilingile mulecita mukunakila Imfumu.

english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
translation: Pakulekelesha ndeti, mulekoselela mukwampana ne Mfumu na mu maka yaiko ayakalamba nganshi.

english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
translation: Fwaleni ifyanso fyakwa Lesa fyonse. Lyena elyo mukakosa mukulwisha ubucenjeshi bwabipa ubwakwa Ciwa.

english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
translation: Ukuf 20:12

english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
translation: Kanshi nomba ipangasheni ifyanso fyakwa Lesa, pakuti ilyo ubushiku bubi bukafika, mukamone ukwansha umulwani. Elyo na panuma yakumulwisha, mukashale abakosa.

english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
translation: Kanshi mube abakosa. Umushipi wakukaka mu musana, cishinka. Icela cakufimba pa cifuba, kuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
translation: Indyato shenu, kuba abaiteyanya kukubila Imbila Nsuma iyileta icibote.

english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
translation: Amaf 5:16

english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
translation: Mulepokelela ukupususha kwakwa Lesa kwati cimpompo cakufwala ku mutwe. Elyo mulepokelela amashiwi yakwa Lesa, e lupanga lwakwa Mupashi.

english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
translation: Mulepepa lyonsefye. Mulelomba Lesa alemwafwako. Lyonse ilyo mulepepa, muleleka Mupashi alemutungulula. Kanshi eico muli nokuba abaiteyanya, mwilatendwa iyoo, mulepepelako na bamushilo bonse.

english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
translation: Mulempepelako na ine pakuti Lesa alempeela amashiwi ndi nokulanda. Epakuti ndeba uwapama mukulanda ilyo ndelondolola inkaama ya Mbila Nsuma.

english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
translation: “Ulecindika wiso na noko.” Ici e cebo cakubalilapo icakwata ne cilayo icitila,

english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
translation: Kolo 3:20

english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
translation: Tukiko, munyinefwe uo twatemwisha, kabili umubomfi wine wine wa Mfumu, akesa mushimikila fyonse pali ine, epakuti mukeshibe ifyo ndi nefyo ndecita.

english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Lesa Tata ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu bengamupeela imwe bamunyinefwe bonse umutende, icitemwiko ne cisumino.

english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku cakwa Lesa cibe pali bonse, abatemwa Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu ne citemwiko icishipwa.

english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
translation: “Lyena ukashuka kabili ukekala inshiku ishingi pano calo.”

english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
translation: Mwe bashibo mwilalenga abana benu ukuti balefulwa. Ilyo mulebalela no kubakusha, mulebatungulula bwino no kubafunda ngefyo Imfumu ilefwaya.

english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
translation: Mwe basha, muleba no mucinshi na katiina ilyo mulenakila bashikulwinwe aba pano calo. Mulecita ifi no mutima wacishinka ngefyo mwinganakila Kristu.

english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
translation: Mwilacita ifyo ico balemumona, ico mulefwaya ukuti bamutashe, lelo mulebomba ne mitima yenu yonse ico efyo Lesa alefwaya, pantu muli basha bakwa Kristu.

english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
translation: Nangu bantufye, mulebabombela no mutima wansansa nga fintu mwingabombela Imfumu.

english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
translation: Mwishibe ukuti umuntu onse, abe umusha nangu umuntungwa, ni Mfumu eikamulambula pa mulimo onse uusuma untu abomba.

english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
translation: Kanshi na imwe mwe bashikulwibo, efyo mulecita abasha benu. Muleke ukulabatiinya. Mwishibe ukuti imwe bene na basha benu mwakwatafye Shikulwinwe umo wine mu mulu. Wena taba na mucishacinani.

english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.
translation: Imfumu Asuelusi apatikisha abantu ba mu calo conse na mu lulamba lwa bemba ukusonka umusonko.

english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
translation: Kanshi ificitwa fyakwe fyonse ifyabulamba na maka acitile, ne lyashi lyonse pafyo Modekai bamucindike no kumupeela icifulo ku mfumu Asuelusi, fyonse fyalilembwa mu citabo ca milandu ya mfumu sha ku Media na Pesia.

english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.
translation: Modekai Umuyuda ewakonkelepo ukucindama pa mfumu Asuelusi. Kabili ali na maka pa Bayuda, uwacindama no kutemwikwa ku bantu bakwe pantu acitile ifyakuwamina abantu bakwe no kulomba ifyakuwamina umushobo wakwe onse.

english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),
translation: Ifi fintu fyacitike mu nshiku shakwa Asuelusi , uwateekele mu fitungu umwanda umo na makumi yabili na cine lubali (127) ukutula ku India ukufika ku Kushi .

english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali ico imfumu yasansamuka pa mulandu wa mwangashi yalenwa, yaeba Meumani, Bisita, Habona, Bigita, Abagita, Seta na Kakasi, bamutungwi cine lubali abaletumika pa cinso ca mfumu Asuelusi,

english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.
translation: ukuya buula namfumu Fashiti pakuti ese nafwala icisote ca bunamfumu no kwisa ilanga ku bantu ifyo ayemba pantu ali umusuma nganshi.

english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.
translation: Nomba namfumu ena akaana amashiwi imfumu yatumine bamutungwi ukuya mweba. Pali ici, imfumu yafulilwe icibi, yalabilimafye ku cipyu.

english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;
translation: Elyo imfumu yalanda na bampandamano waiko, pantu cali musango baleputwilamo imilandu ukwitako abacenjela mukuputula imilandu.

english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),
translation: Abo imfumu yaishibishe nganshi ni aba: Kashena, Sheta, Adimata, Tashishi, Meresi, Marisena na Memukani, bacilolo cine lubali abafumine ku Pesia na Media abo imfumu yalemona libili libili, abaleikala pa fipuna ifya pantanshi ifyabufumu.

english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”
translation: Yasosa aiti, “Ukulingana ne funde, finshi twingacita pali ifi namfumu Fashiti akaana ukubeela amashiwi imfumu Asuelusi amutumine ukupitila muli bamutungwi?”

english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.
translation: Elyo Memukani, pa cinso ca mfumu na bacilolo, ayasuka ati, “Uyu namfumu Fashiti talufyenye ku mfumu yeka iyoo, lelo nalufyanya na kuli bacilolo bene na ku bantufye bonse abekala mu fitungu fyonse ifya mfumu Asuelusi.

english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’
translation: Pantu ificitile namfumu ilyo fyaishibikwa kuli banamayo bonse, kuti baleka ukumfwila abalume babo. Balasosa ukuti, ‘Apo imfumu Asuelusi alipeele icebo icakwita namfumu Fashiti ukwisa pa cinso caiko, lelo alikene.’

english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.
translation: Lelo line banamayo ba ku Pesia na Media abomfwile imibeele yakwa namfumu, balaeba bacilolo ba mfumu cimo cine. Kanshi imisuula ne cipyu fikatwalilila.

english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.
translation: Nga kuti casansamusha imfumu, kaileke balembe icebo mu mafunde ya bena Pesia na Media pakuti bekacalula ukuti, ‘Fashiti takatale amoneka nakabili pa cinso ca mfumu Asuelusi. Lekeni mfumu ipeele bunamfumu ku muntu uumucilile ubusuma.’

english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,
translation: Mu nshiku shilya imfumu Asuelusi ali pa cipuna cabufumu mu musumba wa Susa.

english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”
translation: Pakuti ilyo ici cebo ca mfumu cikeshibikwa mu calo cakwe conse icishaikulila, banamayo bonse bakalacindika abalume babo abakankala na balanda bene.”

english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
translation: Ili funde lyasekesha imfumu na bacilolo. Imfumu yacita ngomo mwine Memukani aipandileko amano.

english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.
translation: Atuma amakalata ku fitungu fyonse ifya bufumu bwakwe ukulingana no lulimi ulwaba muli cila citungu ukutila umwaume onse e mukalamba wa mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.
translation: Elyo mu mwaka walenga butatu uwa buteko bwakwe acitila bamushika na babomfi bakwe bonse imitebeto. Abakalamba ba fita fyakwe ifya ku Pesia na Media, elyo na bacilolo na bakankala aba mu fitungu eko bali.

english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.
translation: Kanshi alangisha ifyuma fya bufumu bwakwe ubwa lulumbi, ubucindami no bukata ubwa bufumu bwakwe, pa nshiku ukulingana umwanda umo na makumi cine konse konse (180).

english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.
translation: Panuma ya ishi inshiku, imfumu yacitila abantu bonse abali mu musumba ukalamba uwa Susa umutebeto uwa nshiku cine lubali, abakankala na balanda bene. Imitebeto iyi bapekanishishe mu lubansa ulwali mwibala lye sano lya mfumu.

english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.
translation: Esra 4:6

english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.
translation: Ifyakunwa fyena balefinwena mu tumakapu utwa golide, utwa misango iyalekana lekana, no mwangashi uwa kwisano walifulile kabili baliupeele ku bantufye bonse ukulingana no kufwaya kwa mfumu.

english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.
translation: Ukulingana ne fyakonkomeshe imfumu, abalalikwe bonse balipeelwe insambu ishakunwa ifyo batemenwe, pantu imfumu yaebele ababomfi ba kwisano ukupeela abantu fyonse ifyo cila muntu alefwaya ukunwa.

english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.
translation: Namfumu Fashiti nao apekanishisha banamayo imitebeto mwisano lya mfumu Asuelusi.

english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
translation: Panuma ya ifi fyonse, elyo icipyu ca mfumu Asuelusi capwa, aibukisha Fashiti paco acitile nefyo bamupingwile.

english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.
Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.
translation: Cila bushiku Modekai aleendauka mupepi no lubansa lwa ŋanda ya banakashi ba mfumu pakuti eshibe ifilecitika kuli Esta.

english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).
translation: Kanshi inshita yasuka yafika iyakuti cila mukashana aye ku mfumu Asuelusi. Ici cacitike panuma ya mweshi ikumi limo na ibili (12) ukulingana ne cebo ca banamayo. Imyeshi yakuipekanya yali ngefi: Imyeshi mutanda abakashana balesuba amafuta aya cinyamuti icanunka ubusaka muri, elyo imyeshi imbi mutanda mafuta yambi ayacena icisuma na fimbi ifyo banamayo balebomfya pakuiwamya.
