english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.
translation: Pebeli lyonse ilyakwa punda, muli nokupyanikishapo umwana wa mpaanga. Pakulilubula nga tamupyanikishepo umwana wa mpaanga pali punda ninshi mukamufune umukoshi. Mukalelubula abana benu bonse abaume amabeli.

english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translation: Nomba mu nshiku sha kuntanshi ngo mwana obe umwaume akwipusha umo cilolele, ukamwebe auti, ‘Yawe atufumishe no kuboko kwamaka mu calo ca Egupto umo twali abasha.

english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
translation: Ilyo Farao akaanininefye ukuleka fwe bena Israeli ukuti tuye, Yawe aipeye amabeli yonse mu Egupto, aya bantu naya nama. E mulandu wine ndekela amabeli yonse ayalume ilambo kuli Yawe, lelo ibeli lyonse pa bana bandi abaume ndalilubula.’

english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
translation: Ukusefya iyi nshikunkulu kukaba kuli imwe kwati cishibilo ca pa kuboko nangu icakukakila pa mpumi shenu. Pantu Yawe ewamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto no kuboko kwakwe ukwamaka.”

english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;
translation: Ilyo Farao alekele abena Israeli ukuti baleya, Lesa tabatungulwile mu nshila yakupita mu calo ca Bafilisiti, nangu yena yali iyipi. Pantu Lesa atile, “Nga cakuti kwaba inkondo, abantu kuti bayalula amano, babwelelamo na ku Egupto.”

english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Eico Lesa atungulwile abantu mu nshila iyashokela mu matololo ukulola kuli Bemba Wakashika. Abena Israeli bali abaipangasha ku bulwi ilyo bafumine mu calo ca Egupto.

english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”
“Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”
translation: “Usangulule ibeli lyonse ilyaume. Ibeli lyonse ilya mwifumo mu bena Israeli lyandi, libe lya muntu nangu ilya nama.”

english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
translation: Abena Israeli bafumine ku Sukoti, baya cita inkambi pa Etamu mupepi na kumpela ya matololo.

english: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:
translation: Mu nshita ya kasuba Yawe alebatangilila mu ntumba ye kumbi pakubalanga inshila. Mu nshita ya bushiku alebatangilila mu lubingu lwa mulilo pakubasanikila pakuti baleenda akasuba no bushiku.

english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
translation: Intumba ye kumbi akasuba nelyo ulubingu lwa mulilo ubushiku, tafyalefuma pa ntanshi ya bantu.

english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
translation: Elyo Mose aebele abantu ati, “Mukaleibukisha buno bushiku ubo mwafuminemo mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha. Pantu Yawe ewamufumishemo ku kuboko kwakwe ukwamaka. Kanshi mwilalyamo icintu conse icabamo intutumushi.

english: Today you go out in the month Abib.
translation: Mu bushiku bwa lelo ubwa mu mweshi Abibu, mwalafuma mu calo ca Egupto.

english: It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
translation: Ilyo Yawe akamufisha mu calo ca bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi, icalo alaile ifikolwe fyenu, icalo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci. Mukalesefyamo iyi nshikunkulu muli uno mweshi.

english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
translation: Mwikalalya mikate iyabamo intutumushi pa nshiku cine lubali. Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali epo mukalesefya inshikunkulu yakucindika Yawe.

english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.
translation: Mukalelya imikate iyabulamo intutumushi pa nshiku cine lubali, kabili pakati kenu tapafwile kumoneka intutumushi nangufye mu calo cenu conse.

english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
translation: Pali ubo bushiku ukebe umwana obe umwaume auti, ‘Ico ndecitila ifi ni pa mulandu wa fintu Yawe ancitile ilyo nalefuma mu calo ca Egupto.’

english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the LORD has brought you out of Egypt.
translation: Ukusefya iyi nshikunkulu kukaba kuli imwe kwati cishibilo ca pa kuboko kwenu nangu kwati cakwibukishishako pa mpumi shenu, epakuti amafunde yakwa Yawe yaleba pa tunwa twenu. Pantu Yawe amufumishe mu calo ca Egupto no kuboko kwakwe ukwamaka.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.
translation: Ilyo Farao apaleme, abena Israeli bati baloleshe, bamona abena Egupto balebakonka panuma. Awe, baiketwe no mwenso ukalamba, balakuuta na kuli Yawe.

english: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?
translation: Balailishanya kuli Mose abati, “Bushe mu Egupto tamwali inindi, e mulandu watuletela mu matololo ukuti emo twise tufwile? Finshi watucitila pakutufumya mu calo ca Egupto!

english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
translation: Bushe tatwakwebele ilyo twali mu Egupto ukuti utulekefye tulebombela abena Egupto? Ifwe cawamishapo ukubombela abena Egupto ukucila ukufwila muno mu matololo.”

english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.
translation: Mose nao ayasuka abantu ati, “Mwitiina! Shipeni, mwalamona uko Yawe alemupususha lelo. Aba bena Egupto mwamona ilelo tamwakatale amubamona nakabili.

english: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
translation: Yawe ewalamulwishishako. Imwe mwikalefye.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Cinshi ulekuutila kuli ine? Eba abena Israeli ukuti baleya kuntanshi.

english: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.
translation: Imya inkonto yobe, tambalika ukuboko kobe pali bemba pakuti amenshi yakanike, pakuti abena Israeli bapite muli bemba pa mushili uwauma.

english: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.
translation: Imili 13:17

english: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”
translation: Nga nailanga ukucindama pakucimfya Farao, amaceleta yakwe ne fita fyakwe ifya pali bakabalwe, lyena abena Egupto bakeshiba ukuti nine Yawe.”

english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Lesa uwaletungulula ifita fya bena Israeli afumine kuntanshi no kuselela kunuma. Kabili ne ntumba ye kumbi nayo yafuma kuntanshi yaselela kunuma,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli ukuti babwelelemo bacite inkambi ukulungatana na Pi Hairoti, pakati ka Migidoli na Bemba Wakashika. Bacite inkambi ukulungatana na Baali Sefoni.

english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.
translation: yaisa ba pakati ka fita fya bena Egupto ne fita fya bena Israeli. Ubushiku bonse yaletele mfifi, lelo ulubali lubiye yaletele ulubuuto. Kanshi ubushiku bonse bwapitilefye ukwabula ukuti ifita fipalamane.

english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
translation: Elyo Mose atambalikile ukuboko kwakwe pali bemba. Yawe alenga umwela wa ku kabanga uwakosa ukupupila pali bemba ubushiku bonse. No mwela waseshapo amenshi, pashala apauma. Awe na menshi yayakanikana.

english: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
translation: Kanshi na bena Israeli epakupita muli bemba pa mushili uwauma. Amenshi yali kwati cibumba ku kulyo na ku kuso kwabo.

english: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
translation: Abena Egupto pamo na bakabalwe bakwa Farao, amaceleta yakwe ne fita fya pali bakabalwe basupile abena Israeli no kubakonka muli bemba.

english: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
translation: Cilya bwalaya kukuca Yawe, mu lubingu lwa mulilo ne ntumba ye kumbi, aloleshe panshi pa fita fya bena Egupto no kufifulunganya.

english: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”
translation: Yawe alengele imipeto ya maceleta yabo ukukanaenda bwino, balecushiwa pakwenda. Elyo abena Egupto batile, “Natufulumuke abena Israeli! Pantu Yawe eulebalwilako pakulwisha Egupto.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Tambalikila ukuboko kobe pali bemba, pakuti amenshi yabwele yabunshe abena Egupto, amaceleta yabo ne fita fyabo ifya pali bakabalwe.”

english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
translation: Mose atambalikila ukuboko kwakwe pali bemba. Kabili cilya cabafye ku macaca, awe na menshi yabwelela umo yalepita. Abena Egupto cilya bati bafulumukeko, Yawe nao abaposa mu menshi.

english: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
translation: Amenshi yabwela umo yalepita, yabunsha na maceleta ne fita fya pali bakabalwe ne fita fyonse ifyakwa Farao ifyakonkele abena Israeli muli bemba. Awe tapapuswike nangu umo nakalya.

english: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
translation: Bahi 11:29

english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’
translation: Farao akatontonkanya ukuti abena Israeli balelulumbafye mu calo, pantu amatololo nayabacilikila.

english: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
translation: Muli ubo bushiku Yawe apuswishe abena Israeli mu minwe ya bena Egupto. Na bena Israeli bamwene ifitumbi fya bena Egupto mu lulamba lwa bemba.

english: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.
translation: Abena Israeli pakumona ifyo Yawe akwatisha amaka yantu alangile pakucimfya abena Egupto, abantu bakwatile Yawe akatiina, kabili bacetekele Yawe na Mose umubomfi wakwe.

english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.
translation: Nkalenga umutima wakwa Farao ukumalala, nao akabasupila. Na ine nkailenga ukucindama pakucimfya Farao ne fita fyakwe. Elyo na bena Egupto bakeshiba ukuti nine Yawe.” Kanshi abena Israeli bacitile umo babebele.

english: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”
translation: Nomba ilyo baebele imfumu ya calo ca Egupto ukuti abena Israeli nabafyuka, Farao na bacilolo bakwe bayalula amano pa bena Israeli. Kabili balaipushanya abati, “Cinshi ici twacita? Twaleka abena Israeli baya, baleka no kutubombela!”

english: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;
translation: Kanshi Farao epakupekanya iceleta lyakwe, asenda ne fita fyakwe.

english: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.
translation: Asendele amaceleta ayawamisha imyanda mutanda (600) na maceleta yonsefye aya mu Egupto, elyo cila celeta pali icita.

english: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.
translation: Yawe alenga umutima wakwa Farao ukumalala, nao epakusupila abena Israeli abaleya kupama kupama.

english: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
translation: Abena Egupto emukutila bakabalwe bonse abakwa Farao, amaceleta, ifita fyonse fya pali bakabalwe ne fita fya pa makasa basupila abena Israeli. Babasanga apo bacitile inkambi pa lulamba lwa Bemba Wakashika mupepi na Pi Hairoti apalungatana na Baali Sefoni.

english: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
translation: Elyo Mose pamo na bena Israeli baimbile Yawe ulwimbo abati,

english: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
translation: Lelo, we Yawe, ilyo wabaputa umupu obe,

english: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
translation: Nani, we Yawe, uwaba nga iwe pa milungu yonse?

english: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
translation: Watambalike ukuboko kobe kwa ku kulyo no mushili wabamina.

english: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
translation: Ku citemwiko cobe icishipwa watangilila abantu abo walubula.

english: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
translation: Imitundu ya bantu yaumfwa,

english: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
translation: Imfumu sha bena Edomu shatiina nganshi.

english: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, LORD, until the people you have purchased pass over.
translation: Baikatwa no mwenso uukalamba no kutiinisha nganshi.

english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
translation: Ulebengishamo nokuleka bekale pa lupili lobe,

english: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”
translation: We Yawe ukateeka imyaka ne myaka pe.”

english: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
translation: Abena Israeli bapitile muli bemba pa mushili uwauma. Lelo Yawe abweseshe amenshi no kwibisha bakabalwe bakwa Farao na maceleta ne fita fya pali bakabalwe ilyo baile muli bemba.

english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
translation: Yawe e maka yandi, kabili e lwimbo lwandi.

english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
translation: Elyo kasesema mwanakashi Miriamu nkashi yakwa Aroni abuula insombo alalisha, na banakashi bonse balamukonka panuma balelisha insombo, balecinda nokucinda.

english: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
translation: Miriamu asamuna no lwimbo ati,

english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
translation: Elyo Mose atungulwile abena Israeli ukufuma kuli Bemba Wakashika, baya mu matololo ya Shuri. Baendele mu matololo inshiku shitatu ukwabula ukusanga amenshi.

english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
translation: Ilyo bafikile ku Mara, amenshi ayali kulya yali ayalula. Kanshi bafililwe no kuyanwa. Ici ecalengele palya bapenike ishina lya Mara.

english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
translation: Elyo abantu balailishanya kuli Mose ati, “Bushe nomba tulenwa nshi?”

english: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
translation: Elyo Mose akuutile kuli Yawe, elyo Yawe nao amulanga icimuti cimo. Mose aciposa mu menshi, na menshi yaba ayasuma ayakunwa.

english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”
translation: Abebele ati, “Nga cakuti mwaba ne cumfwila kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe, ine ne Yawe Lesa wenu, nga mwalacita ifyalungama pa cinso cakwe, kabili mwalakonka na mafunde yakwe, no kusunga ifipope fyakwe fyonse, ninshi na ine nshakamuletele malwele yalya naletele abena Egupto, pantu nine Yawe uumundapa.”

english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
translation: Elyo baile ku Elimu, ukwali utumfukumfuku twa menshi ikumi na tubili (12) no tuncindu amakumi cine lubali (70). Kulya eko bacitile inkambi mupepi na menshi.

english: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.
translation: Yawe cita ca bulwi,

english: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
translation: “Yawe naposa muli bemba amaceleta yakwa Farao ne fita fyakwe,

english: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
translation: Amatenga ayashika nayabebisha.

english: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.
translation: “We Yawe ukuboko kobe kwa ku kulyo maka ayakupapisha,

english: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
translation: Ku kucindamisha kobe eko ucimfisha abalwani bobe,

english: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
translation: Wafumya umupu mu myona yobe na menshi yatuntumana,

english: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
translation: Umulwani epakutila, ‘Kambasupile, ndebasanga.

english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli lwafumine ku Elimu lwafika ku matololo ya Shini pa bushiku bwalengele ikumi na shisano ubwa mu mweshi wabubili, ukutula apo bafumine mu Egupto. Amatololo ya Shini yaba pakati ka Elimu na Sinai.

english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.
translation: Cilya Aroni acili alelanda ku lukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse, ulukuta lwalolesha ku matololo, awe apopene lwamona ubucindami bwakwa Yawe mwikumbi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
translation: Ukuf 14:12

english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
translation: Mu cungulo, inkwale shingi shaisa shakumana inkambi yonse, kabili ulucelocelo kwawile umume washinguluka inkambi yonse.

english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
translation: Ilyo umume wakuntika, pa mushili mu matololo pamoneke utuntu utwapapatala utwabuuta tuutu kwati bunga bwa mfula .

english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bamwene ifi, balaipushanya abati, “Nga utu nato ni tunshi? Pantu tatwishibe.” Mose epakubeba ati, “Uyu e mukate Yawe amupeela ukuti mulye.

english: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomeshe, ‘Umuntu onse ali nokukungubapo ukulingana no kulya kwakwe. Mulekunguba icipimo ca omeri umo icaisula ica cila muntu mwikala nao mwitenti lyenu.’”

english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
translation: Awe, abena Israeli balacita ifyo babebele, bamo balakunguba ifingi elyo bambi utunono.

english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
translation: Nomba cilya bapima mu cipimo ca omeri, basanga abacikunguba ifingi tafyaleshalapo, elyo abacikunguba utunono nabo bene tabalebulisha. Umuntu onse alekunguba ukulingana no kulya kwakwe.

english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
translation: Kabili Mose abebele ati, “Peba uwakushako nangu tumo ukufika mailo lucelo.”

english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
translation: Awe, ulukuta lonse lwa bena Israeli lwalailishanya kuli Mose na Aroni mu matololo.

english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.
translation: Lelo bamo bakeene ukumfwila Mose. Bashilepo fimo ukufika ulucelo, lelo mwali mititi fyatampile no kulanunka. Kanshi Mose epakubafulilwa.

english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
translation: Cila muntu alekunguba cila lucelo ukulingana no kulya kwakwe, lelo akasuba kaleti nga kakaba fyasunguluka.

english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga mutanda pena balekunguba ifyakulya fya nshiku shibili, cila muntu icipimo ca baomeri babili. Elyo intungulushi sha lukuta lwa bena Israeli shaisa shimikilako Mose uyu mulandu.

english: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”
translation: Nao Mose asheba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomeshe ukuti ubushiku bwa mailo bwakutuusha, Lisabata lyamushilo lyakwa Yawe. Kanshi mupange imikate intu mulefwaya ukupanga kabili mwipike nefyo mulefwaya ukwipika. Panuma yakulya musunge fyonse ifileshalapo mpaka mailo.”

english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
translation: Kanshi nabo bashilepo ifyakulya fimo mpaka ulucelo ngefyo Mose abakonkomeshe, ne cakulya tacalenunka nelyo ukubamo imititi.

english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.
translation: Mose epakubeba ati, “Ilelo nifi efyo mulelya pantu Lisabata lyakwa Yawe. Kanshi ilelo tamwasangeko nangu cimo pa mushili.

english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”
translation: Mu nshiku mutanda mukalekunguba ifyakulya, lelo pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali pe Sabata takwakaleba nelyo cimo.”

english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
translation: Nomba pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali abantu bamo bafumine kunse ya nkambi kukukunguba ifyakulya, lelo tabafisangileko iyoo.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Bushe mukaleka lilali ukukanasunga amafunde yandi nefyo ndemukonkomesha?

english: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
translation: Moneni! Yawe namupeela Isabata, e mulandu wine pa bushiku bwalenga mutanda akulamupeela icakulya ca nshiku shibili. Kanshi pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali umuntu onse ali nokuba apo ali. Kabili takuli nangu umo uwakufuma pamwakwe iyoo.”

english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
translation: Lwalabeba ati, “Kanshi Yawe nga atwipailefye mu Egupto. Pantu mwena twaleikala apali inongo sha nama no kulya ifyakulya ifingi apo tulefwaila. Nomba moneni mwatuleta muno mu matololo pakuti ibumba lyonse lifwe ku nsala.”

english: So the people rested on the seventh day.
translation: Eico kanshi abantu baletuusha pa bushiku ubwalenga cine lubali.

english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
translation: Yoani 6:31

english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
translation: Mose elyo abeba ati, “Yawe nakonkomesha ati, ‘Mubuule icipimo ca omeri umo uwa maana, musungilemo maana ya bana benu abakalafyalwa kuntanshi, epakuti nabo bakalemona icakulya ico nalemupeela ukuti mulelya mu matololo ilyo namufumishe mu calo ca Egupto.’”

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”
translation: Kanshi Mose aebele Aroni ati, “Buula umutondo, ubikemo icipimo ca omeri umo wa maana, elyo uuteke na pa cinso cakwa Yawe pakusungila abana benu kuntanshi.”

english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
translation: Ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose, pakusunga maana Aroni abika umutondo pantanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano.

english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
translation: Abena Israeli balile maana pa myaka amakumi yane (40) mpaka nelyo bafikile mu calo umwali abantu. Balile maana mpaka nelyo bafikile ku mupaka wa calo ca Kenani.

english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
translation: Omeri umo aleingila ikumi limo mu cipimo ca efa.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Nakulaponya icakulya ukufuma ku mulu nge mfula. Abantu bali nokulafumina kunse ya nkambi cila bushiku no kulonganya ifyakulya ifilingile ukulya pa bushiku bumo. Ifi efyo ndefwaya ukubesha, pakumona nga bakakonka amafunde yandi.

english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga mutanda pena bakalelonganika ifyakulya fya nshiku shibili.”

english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.
translation: Kanshi Mose na Aroni baebele abena Israeli bonse abati, “Icungulo mwalaishiba ukuti ni Yawe ewamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto.

english: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
translation: Mailo ulucelo mukamona ubucindami bwakwa Yawe, pantu naumfwa ifyo muleilishanya kuli ena. Nga ifwe tuli bani abakuti mwailishanyako?”

english: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”
translation: Kabili Mose abeba nokuti, “Mukeshiba ukuti ni Yawe, nga amupeela inama yakulya icungulo elyo ulucelo akamupeela umukate onse mukafwaya pa mulandu wakuti Yawe naumfwa ukuilishanya kwenu kuli ena. Nga ifwe tuli bani? Ala, tekuli ifwe muleilishanya lelo ni kuli Yawe.”

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
translation: Elyo Mose aebele Aroni ati, “Eba ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse utile, ‘Iseni pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pantu naumfwa ifyo muleilishanya.’”

english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
translation: Ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse lwafumine mu matololo ya Shini. Lwaleti lwafuma pali iyi ncende lwaya kuli imbi ukulingana ngefyo Yawe alelutungulula. Lwacitile inkambi pa Refidimu, nomba palya tapali menshi ayakuti abantu banwe.

english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua nao acitile ifyo Mose amukonkomeshe, alwisha na bena Amaleki. Mose, Aroni na Huri nabo banina pa mulu wa lupili.

english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
translation: Nomba Mose alati nga aimya amaboko yakwe mumulu, abena Israeli balacimfya abena Amaleki. Elyo nga aponya amaboko yakwe, abena Amaleki nabo ninshi balacimfya.

english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
translation: Ukuf 14:12

english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
translation: Kanshi efyo Yoshua acimfishe abena Amaleki ku lupanga.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati “Lemba ici cacitika mu citabo icipombwa pakuti bakalecibukisha, kabili ushininkishe ukuti Yoshua aumfwako pantu nkalofya abena Amaleki kabili tabakatale abebukishiwa pano isonde.”

english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.
translation: Mose epakukuulapo ubulambo abwita nokuti, “Yawe e luunga lwandi.”

english: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
translation: Pantu atile “Ukuboko kwandi kuli pa luunga lwakwa Yawe. Yawe ewakulalwisha pe abena Amaleki umukalakonkanina inkulo.”

english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”
translation: Balaumanya Mose abati, “Tupeele amenshi yakunwa.”

english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
translation: Nomba abantu baiketwe ne cilaka nganshi kulya, kanshi balailishanya na kuli Mose abati, “Cinshi watufumishe mu Egupto? Bushe ni kukwisa twipaila pamo na bana besu ne fitekwa fyesu ku cilaka?”

english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
translation: Elyo Mose akuuta kuli Yawe ati, “Bushe ncite shani naba bantu? Aba bantu balantoba amabwe.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Tangilila abantu. Usendepo na bakalamba ba mu bena Israeli bamo, kabili usende mu minwe yobe ne nkonto ilya waumine pa mumana wa Nailo elyo uleya.

english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
translation: Na ine ndeiminina ku ntanshi yobe pa cilibwe ca Holebu. Ume mu cilibwe, na menshi yakuti abantu banwe yalefumamo.” Awe Mose nao acita ifyo fine ilyo abakalamba ba bena Israeli balemonako.

english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”
translation: Mose ainike pa ncende palya Masaya na Meriba pantu palya epo abana bakwa Israeli bailishenye, kabili epo baeseshe Yawe ilyo batile, “Bushe Yawe aba na ifwe nangu iyoo?”

english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
translation: Elyo abena Amaleki baishile ku Refidimu kukulwisha abena Israeli.

english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
translation: Mose aebele Yoshua ati, “Salapo abaume bamo abakuti mukaye nabo kukulwa na bena Amaleki. Na ine mailo nkaya iminina pa lupili ninjikata inkonto yakwa Lesa mu minwe yandi.”

english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
translation: Yeturo shifyala Mose, shimapepo wa ku Midiani, aumfwile ifintu fyonse ifyo Lesa acitile Mose na bena Israeli nefyo Yawe abafumishe mu Egupto.

english: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
translation: Yeturo asosa nokuti, “Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe uwamupokolwele mu minwe yakwa Farao kabili uwamupokolwele na mu minwe ya bena Egupto!

english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
translation: Awe nomba naishiba ukuti kanshi Yawe alicila imilungu yonse pantu acitile ici ku balesunga abena Israeli buluku buluku.”

english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
translation: Elyo Yeturo shifyala Mose aleta ifye lambo lyakocela Lesa ne fya malambo yambi ayakulekela Lesa. Aroni nao aisa na bakalamba aba mu bena Israeli kukulya icakulya pamo na shifyala Mose pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Mose aikele pa cipuna cakupingwilapo abantu, na bantu baiminine ukumushinguluka ukutula ulucelo mpaka ne cungulo.

english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
translation: Ilyo Yeturo shifyala Mose amona ifyo Mose alebombela abantu, amwipusha ati, “Cinshi ulecitila ifi ku bantu? Mulandu nshi wikalilefye weka ulepingula ilyo abantu bonse aba beminine nabakushinguluka ukutula ulucelo mpaka ne cungulo?”

english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
translation: Nao Mose ayasuka shifyala ati, “Pantu abantu besa kuli ine kukubepushishako ubufwayo bwakwa Lesa.

english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
translation: Ilyo babikana ifikansa, besa kuli ine, na ine ndabaputwila ifikansa, kabili nenga nokuti beshibe ifipope na mafunde yakwa Lesa.”

english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
translation: Elyo Yeturo shifyala Mose amwebele ati, “Umusango ulebombelamo tauweme iyoo.

english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
translation: Iwe pamo na bantu abaleisa kuli iwe mwakulanaka nganshi. Uyu mulimo untu wakosa, teti ubombe weka iyoo.

english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
translation: Umfwa nomba kuli ine, nalakupandako amano, na Lesa engalaba na iwe. Iwe ufwile uleimininako abantu pa cinso cakwa Lesa no kubatwalilako imilandu yabo kuli Lesa.

english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
translation: Panuma, Mose alekele umukashi wakwe Sipora ukubwelelamo kuli wishi Yeturo. Yeturo nao apokelela mwane

english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
translation: Lelo usalepo pa bantu bonse abaume bamo abamano, kabili abakatiina kuli Lesa, abacishinka, abashifwaya na mafisakanwa. Aba ebo upeele umulimo wakutungulula abantu mu makana, mu myanda, mu makumi yasano elyo bambi nabo mu makumi.

english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
translation: Ebo uleke baleputula imilandu ya bantu lyonse, lelo abaisa ne milandu iyakosa balebaleta kuli iwe. Imilandu yonse iyanguka yena abene balepingula. Umulimo obe uyu uwakosa lyena ukangukako ukuubomba pantu bakulakwafwako.

english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
translation: Nga wacita ifi, kabili efyo Lesa akukonkomesha, tawakulanakisha nganshi, elyo na bantu aba bonse bakulabwelelamo kumwabo nabasansamuka.”

english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
translation: Awe Mose alyumfwile ifyamwebele shifyala Yeturo, no kuficita fyonse ifyo amwebele.

english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
translation: Asalilepo abaume bamo abamano pa bena Israeli bonse no kubacita intungulushi sha bantu, isha pa makana, isha pa myanda, isha pa makumi yasano elyo ne sha pa makumi.

english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
translation: Intungulushi shalaputwila na bantu imilandu yabo. Imilandu iyakosa shalatwala kuli Mose, lelo iyinono yena shalapingula ishine.

english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
translation: Elyo Yeturo ashalikepo shifyala Mose, abwelelamo na ku calo kumwabo.

english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
translation: pamo na bana bakwe abaume. Mose ainike umwana wakwe umo ishina lya Geshomu, pantu atile, “Ndi mweni mu calo ca bene.”

english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
translation: Umbi nao amwinike shina lya Eliese pantu atile, “Lesa wakwa tata ewangafwile no kumpususha ku lupanga lwakwa Farao.”

english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.
translation: Yeturo shifyala Mose aishile kuli Mose pamo na bamwana Mose na muka Mose, abakumenye mu matololo umo acitile nkambi mupepi no lupili lwakwa Lesa.

english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”
translation: Yeturo alilaishe amashiwi kuli Mose ati, “Ine Yeturo ne sofyala ndi mu nshila, ndeleta umukashi obe na bamwano bonse babili.”

english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
translation: Kanshi Mose afuma mukusengela shifyala, amufukamina no kumutomona pakumuposha. Cilya bapwa ukuposhanya baingila na mwitenti.

english: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
translation: Mose ashimikila shifyala fyonse ifyo Yawe acitile Farao na bena Egupto pa mulandu wa bena Israeli. Kabili amushimikila na mafya yonse abantu bapitilemo mu nshila elyo nefyo Yawe abapuswishe.

english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
translation: Yeturo asansamwike nganshi pakumfwa ifisuma fyonse fintu Yawe acitile abena Israeli pakubapokololako mu minwe ya bena Egupto.

english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
translation: Mu mweshi walenga itatu apo abena Israeli bafumine ku Egupto, ubushiku bwine ubo bafikile ku matololo ya Sinai.

english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
translation: Elyo pa bushiku ubwalenga shitatu bakaiteyanye, pantu pali ubu bushiku epo Yawe akekila pa lupili lwa Sinai pa cinso ca bantu bonse.

english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
translation: Ukacite umwakupelela abantu ukushingulusha ulupili. Ukabebe auti, ‘Mucenjele, mwinina lupili nangufye ukulukumya mwisamba. Umuntu onse uukakumya ku lupili ninshi wakwipayafye.

english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
translation: Uyo muntu ali nokulaswa amabwe nangu ukulaswa imifwi. Umuntu nelyo umo tali nakumwikatamo. Cibe muntu nangu ni nama kwipayafye.’ Kanofye ilyo ipenga lya lusengo lwa sukusuku lyalila ukutantalila lyena abantu kuti banina ulupili.”

english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
translation: Tito 2:14

english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
translation: Kabili Mose abebele ati, “Muiteyanye ku bushiku bwalenga shitatu. Mwikumana no mwanakashi.”

english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
translation: Ulucelo pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu, kwali ukupanta ne nkuba, ne kumbi ilyafiita fititi lyali pa lupili. Kabili kwali ne ciunda icikalamba ice penga. Abantu bonse abali mu nkambi balatutumafye ku mwenso.

english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
translation: Elyo Mose afumisha abantu kunse ya nkambi kukukumana na Lesa, nabo baya iminina mwisamba lya lupili.

english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
translation: Ilyo bafumine ku Refidimu baingile mu matololo ya Sinai no kucita inkambi mulya mwine apalungatene no lupili lwa Sinai.

english: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
translation: Awe Yawe aikila pa mulu wa lupili lwa Sinai, aita na Mose pa mulu wa lupili, na Mose epo aya.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
translation: Elyo Yawe amweba ati, “Tentemuka ulupili uye usoke abantu beciluka mupaka umwakupelela kukwisa kukuntamba ne Yawe, pantu ninshi abengi baleloba.

english: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”
translation: Na bashimapepo bene abapalama kuli Yawe baisangulule abene epali Yawe abakanda.”

english: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
translation: Mose ayasuka Yawe ati, “Abantu teti banine ulupili lwa Sinai pantu mwalitusokele ukuti tucite umwakupelela abantu ukushinguluka ulupili no kulupatula ukuba ulwamushilo.”

english: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”
translation: Yawe amwasuka ati, “Tentemuka ulupili, uye buula Aroni mwise nankwe kuno. Lelo bashimapepo na bantu bena beesha ukwisa kuli Yawe, pantu ninshi alebakanda.”

english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakutentemukila ku bantu, abeba nefyo Yawe asosele.

english: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
translation: Elyo Mose aninine aya kuli Lesa.

english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
translation: ‘Imwe mwe bene mwalimwene ifyo nacitile ku bena Egupto, kabili nefyo namusendele kwati ni pa mapindo yakwa kapumpe no kumuleta uko ndi.

english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;
translation: Nomba nga cakuti mwalanakila, mwalasunga ne cipangano candi, ninshi pa mishobo yonse nimwe mukaba abantu bandi abo nacindamika, nangu isonde lyonse lyaba lyandi.

english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
translation: Amaf 7:6

english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.
translation: Kanshi Mose abwelelamo alonganya na bakalamba ba bena Israeli, abeba na mashiwi yonse Yawe amukonkomeshe ukusosa.

english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse bayasuka capamo abati, “Twakulacita fyonse ifyo Yawe atweba.” Nao Mose epakuya fisha ifyo bayaswike kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.
translation: Pet 2:9

english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
translation: Aya e mashina ya bamwana Israeli abaume pamo ne ndupwa shabo shonse, abakonkele shibo Yakobo ku calo ca Egupto.

english: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
translation: Kanshi natubacenjelele epali balafulilako. Kabili nge nkondo yabuka kuti baisa twalukila, baba pamo na balwani besu, batulwisha, bafuma na mu calo baya.”

english: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
translation: Kanshi elyo basontele abakwangalila abasha. Balebapeela incito ishakosa pakubacusha. Bakuulile imfumu Farao imisumba ya matala Pitomu na Ramesesi.

english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
translation: Lelo nangu babikilepofye ukubacusha nganshi, abena Israeli bena balefulilakofye no kusalangana mu calo conse. Kanshi abena Egupto batampile kulatiina abena Israeli nganshi,

english: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
translation: no kulababomfya buluku buluku.

english: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
translation: Balengele ubumi bwabo ukubipa nganshi pa mulandu wa milimo ya lucu mukukandila iloba, mukutama amatafwali, ne milimo yonse iyalekana lekana iya mu mpanga. Mu milimo yabo yonse abena Egupto balebabomfya buluku buluku.

english: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
translation: Elyo imfumu ya Egupto yaebele banacimbusa babili Abahibulu Shifura na Pua ukuti,

english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
translation: “Ilyo muleyafwilisha banamayo Abahibulu ukupaapa, pa cakupaapilapo cine nga mwamona mwaume mumwipaye, nga mwanakashi mwimwipaya.”

english: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
translation: Imili 7:17

english: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
translation: Imili 7:18

english: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
translation: Imili 7:19

english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
translation: Rubeni, Simeoni, Levi, Yuda,

english: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
translation: Lesa nao epakulenga banacimbusa ukushuka. Abena Israeli bena elyo bacililako ukufula kabili baba abamaka nganshi.

english: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
translation: Pa mulandu wakutiina Lesa, nao Lesa alipeele banacimbusa abana.

english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
translation: Elyo Farao akonkomeshe abantu bakwe bonse ukuti, “Muleposa umwana mwaume onse uwafyalwa mu mumana wa Nailo. Lelo abana banakashi bena mwilabepaya iyoo.”

english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
translation: Isaka, Sebuloni, Benjamini,

english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
translation: Dani, Naftali, Gadi na Asheri.

english: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
translation: Bonse pamo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Yakobo bali amakumi cine lubali (70) . Yosefu mwana Yakobo wena iyo nshita ninshi ali mu Egupto.

english: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
translation: Nomba Yosefu na bamunyina bonse na ba muli ilya nkulo bonse balifwile.

english: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli bali no bufyashi, kabili no kufula bafulileko nganshi. Bafulishe icakuti bakumenefye konse mu Egupto, kabili bali abamaka nganshi.

english: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
translation: Icite 46:8-27

english: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
translation: Elyo iyi mfumu yaebele abantu baiko aiti, “Mwamona, aba bantu abena Israeli nabafulisha nganshi, kabili baliba abamaka nganshi ukutucila.

english: God spoke all these words, saying,
translation: Kabili Lesa asosele amashiwi yonse aya ati,

english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
translation: lelo ubushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwena Lisabata lyakwa Yawe, Lesa obe. Wilabombamo mulimo uuli onse, we mwine, nelyo bamwano abaume na abanakashi, nelyo ababomfi abaume atemwa abanakashi, nelyo ifitekwa fyobe, nelyo umweni wikala nankwe.

english: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
translation: Pantu mu nshiku mutanda emo Yawe apangile umulu ne sonde, bemba na fyonse ifyabamo, lelo atuushishe pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali. Eico Yawe apaalile ubushiku bwe Sabata no kubucita ubwamushilo.

english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
translation: Levi 19:12

english: “You shall not murder.
translation: “Wilaipaya.

english: “You shall not commit adultery.
translation: “Wilacita bucende.

english: “You shall not steal.
“You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
translation: Amaf 27:16

english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translation: “Nine Yawe, Lesa obe, uwakufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo wali umusha.

english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
translation: Luka 18:20

english: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
translation: Elyo Yawe alandile kuli Mose ati, “Eba abena Israeli ukuti namuimwena ifyo ine ne Yawe nandile kuli imwe ukufuma ku mulu.

english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
translation: Ukuf 20:23

english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
translation: Ukuf 23:24

english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
translation: Nga mwabomfya amabwe pakunkuulila ubulambo mwilabomfya amabwe ayabaswa, pantu nga mwabomfya icakubashilako ninshi ubulambo bukakowela.

english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
translation: Kabili pakuya ku bulambo mwilanina pa matabo, epali mwamoneka ubwamba.”

english: “You shall have no other gods before me.
translation: “Wilaba ne milungu imbi kanofye ine.

english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
translation: “Wilaipangila kalubi, nangu icintu conse icakupashanya icaba mu mulu umutali nangu icaba pano isonde nangu icaba mu menshi pesamba lya calo.

english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
translation: Wilafukamina utulubi nangu ukutupepa. Pantu ine ne Yawe, Lesa obe, ndi Lesa wabufuba. Nkanda abana pa bubifi bwa bashibo ukufika na ku nkulo yalenga butatu ne yalenga bune iya bampata.

english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
translation: “Wilalumbula ishina lyakwa Yawe Lesa obe apafye pantu Yawe takalekepofye uyo onse uulumbula ishina lyakwe apafye.

english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
translation: Aya e mafunde yakuti ubebe.

english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
translation: Nga cakuti aupilapo umwanakashi na umbi, tafwile kuleka ukulapeela umukashi wantanshi ifyakulya, ifyakufwala ne nsambu sha ku cupo.

english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
translation: Nga cakuti talecita ifi fintu fitatu, umwanakashi kuti alubuka ukwabula ukufuta indalama nangu shimo.”

english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
translation: Ukuf 20:13

english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
translation: Lelo umuntu nga apangila umunankwe no kumwipaya ku mumbo, ninshi mufumyenifye na ku bulambo bwandi no kumwipaya.

english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
translation: “Uyo onse uwauma wishi nangu nyina afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
translation: “Uyo onse uwaikata no kwiba umuntu, nangu amushitisha nangu ilyo bamwikata bamusanga acili noyu muntu, afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
translation: Levi 24:17

english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
translation: “Abantu nga baleumana elyo umo atoba umunankwe ilibwe nelyo amuma ikofi nomba tafwile lelo aba wakulalafye pa musengele,

english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
translation: uwamutobele teti apeelwe umulandu nga cakuti uwatobelwe aima alaendaukako ne nkonto panse. Lelo ali nokufuta uwacenenwe pa nshita amonawilile, no kumusakamana mpaka apolelelafye.

english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
translation: “Nga washita umusha Umuhibulu, afwile ukukubombela imyaka mutanda. Lelo mu mwaka walenga cine lubali ninshi alubuka mu busha apabula ukufutapo nelyo cimo.

english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu auma umusha wakwe umwaume nangu umwanakashi ku nkonto, no kufwa afwa apopene, uyo muntu afwile ukukandwa.

english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
translation: Mateo 5:21

english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
translation: “Nga cakuti abaume abalelwa bapunka umwanakashi uuli pa bukulu ne fumo lyapona, lelo tacenekwe, ninshi ulya amupunkile afwile afuta fyonse ifyo umulume apingula ne cilye nga casuminisha.

english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
translation: Lelo umwanakashi nga nacenekwa lyena ubupingushi ninshi bumi pa bumi,

english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
translation: ilinso pa linso, ilino pa lino, ukuboko pa kuboko, ulukasa pa lukasa,

english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
translation: ukoca pa koca, icilonda pa cilonda, icikwebululwa pa cikwebululwa.

english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu auma umusha wakwe umwaume nangu umwanakashi pa linso nalyo lyatulika, afwile ukuleka umusha abe umuntungwa pakumufuta pa linso lyakwe.

english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
translation: Elyo nga akuula ilino lya musha wakwe umwaume nangu umwanakashi, afwile ukuleka umusha abe umuntungwa pakumufuta pa lino lyakwe.”

english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
translation: “Nga cakuti iŋombe ilume nga yatunkula umuntu umwaume nangu umwanakashi ku nsengo no kufwa afwa, iyo ŋombe ifwile ukulaswa amabwe mpaka yafwa, kabili teyakulyako inama yaiko. Lelo umwine wa iyo ŋombe ilume tafwile kupeelwa mulandu.

english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti iyo ŋombe ilatunkula abantu ku nsengo, kabili no mwine wa ŋombe balimusokapo, lelo tasakamana kulaisungila mwitanga, elyo yaipaya umwaume nangu umwanakashi, iyo ŋombe ifwile ukulaswa amabwe mpaka yasuka yafwa, no mwine wa ŋombe wine afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
translation: Nga cakuti aisa mu busha talaupa, ninshi pakuya akaya eka. Lelo nga ali no mukashi pakwisa ninshi akaya nankwe.

english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti bamweba ukuti kupeela icifuta mulandu pakuti alubule umweo wakwe, lyena afwile ukupeela fyonse ifyo bamupingula.

english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
translation: Ili funde limo line lili nokukonkwa nga cakuti iŋombe yatunkula ku nsengo umulumendo nangu umukashana.

english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
translation: Nga cakuti iŋombe ilume yatunkula ku nsengo umusha umwaume nangu umwanakashi, umwine wa ŋombe afwile ukufuta umwine wa musha indalama sha mashekeli ya silifa amakumi yatatu (30), ne ŋombe ifwile ukulaswa amabwe mpaka yafwa.

english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu asha icilindi icacenama nangu aimba icilindi elyo acisha icacenama, elyo mwawila iŋombe nangu punda,

english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
translation: umwine wa cilindi afwile ukufuta pa citekwa. Afwile ukufuta umwine wa citekwa indalama, elyo nao asende inama iyafwa ibe yakwe.

english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
translation: “Nga cakuti cilume wa ŋombe acena cilume mubiye uwa mwine no kufwa afwa, abene ba isho ŋombe babili bafwile bashitisha iyo ŋombe ipeye iyinankwe no kwakana indalama elyo ne ŋombe iyifwile.

english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti calishibikwa ukuti iyo ŋombe ilatunkula ku nsengo, lelo umwine tasakamana kulaisungila mwitanga, lyena umwine afwile ukufuta iŋombe pa ŋombe. Elyo iŋombe iyifwile ibe yakwe.”

english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
translation: Nga cakuti shikulu wakwe ewamupeele umwanakashi wakuupa, nao amufyalila na bana abaume nangu abanakashi, umwanakashi na bana ninshi bakwa shikulu wakwe. Umwaume akayafye eka.

english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
translation: Lelo umusha nga ewatila, ‘Awe, ine nalitemwa shikulu pamo no mukashi wandi na bana bandi, nshilefwaya kulubuka mu busha,’

english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
translation: lyena shikulu wakwe akamulete pa cinso cakwa Lesa akamwiminike pa mwinshi nangu lwa pa cilu ca pa mwinshi, elyo akamutule ukutwi ku musumbo. Lyena akaba umusha wakwe mu bumi bwakwe bonse.

english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
translation: “Umuntu nga ashitisha umwana wakwe umwanakashi mu busha, pakulubuka mu busha wena teti alubuke nga filya abasha abaume balubuka.

english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
translation: Nga cakuti tasansamwishe shikulu uwamusalile ukuti abe umukashi wakwe, kuti amuleka alubuke lelo te ku benafyalo pantu namufyenga.

english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
translation: Nga cakuti asalila umwana wakwe umwaume uyu mwanakashi umusha, ninshi ali nokumupeela insambu shakuba ngo mwana wakwe umwanakashi.

english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu aiba iŋombe nangu impaanga, elyo aipaya nangu aishitisha, afwile ukufutilapo iŋombe shisano pa ŋombe imo, ne mpaanga shine pa mpaanga imo.

english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu apeela umwina mupalamano punda nangu iŋombe nangu impaanga nangu icitekwa cimbi pakuti amusungileko, elyo ico naco cafwa nangu cacenwa nangu bacifyusha ukwabula ukuti umuntu amoneko.

english: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
translation: Mukuputula uyu mulandu, uuli ne citekwa ali nokulapa kuli Yawe ukuti taibile munankwe icuma cakwe. Umwine wa citekwa ali nokusumina umulapo, kabili no kufuta takuli nokubako iyoo.

english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
translation: Lelo nga ewaibila umwina mupalamano icitekwa ninshi ali nokumufuta.

english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
translation: Nga cakuti icitekwa caiketwe ku ciswango, uwalecisunga ninshi afwile ukuleta ifisheleko pakushininkisha, nokufuta tafwile kufutilapo pa citekwa bepeye ku ciswango.

english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu ayashima icitekwa ca mwina mupalamano, naco cacenekwa nangu cafwa ilyo umwine waciko taliko, uwayashime afwile ukufutilapo cimbi.

english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti cacitika ilyo umwine wa citekwa epo ali, ninshi uwayashime tafwile kulipila. Nga cakuti icitekwa cakwe cali cakwashima ninshi indalama alipile pakwashima eshikaba ishakufutilapo.

english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume asembeleka umukashana nacisungu uushilakobekelwa no kusendama nankwe, afwile ukulipila impango elyo no kumuupa.

english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti wishi wa mukashana akaanininafye ukuti amuupe, lyena uyo muntu afwile ukulipilafye impango balipila pali nacisungu.

english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
translation: “Mwilaleka umwanakashi umuloshi ekale umumi.

english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
translation: “Umuntu onse uwalala ne nama afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
translation: “Nga cakuti umupupu asangwa aletoba iŋanda elyo uwamusanga amupuma mpaka afwa, uwamwipaya tafwile kupeelwa mulandu wamisoka.

english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
translation: “Ni Yawe eka eo uli nokulekele lambo. Uyo onse uwaleke lambo ku mulungu uuli onse, ninshi wakupeela kukonaulwafye.

english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
translation: Amaf 27:21

english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
translation: Mwilacusha mukamfwilwa nangu umwana wanshiwa onsefye.

english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
translation: Levi 18:23

english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
translation: Kabili nkamufulilwa nganshi no kumwipaya ku lupanga. Abakashi benu bakaba bamukamfwilwa kabili abana benu nabo bakabe abana banshiwa.

english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
translation: “Nga cakuti wakongwesha indalama ku mulanda umo uwa pa bantu bandi, wilacita filya balya abakongwesha indalama bacita. Wilamweba ukulalundapo insonsela.

english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
translation: Nga cakuti wapoka umubiyo icakufimbana pakuti cibe e cikatila umulandu, ufwile ukumubwesesha ilintu akasuba takalati kawe,

english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
translation: Levi 20:27

english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
translation: Amaf 22:28

english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
translation: “Mwilashingashinga ukutuulapo iŋanu shenu mwaseepa ishingi, na pa mafuta yenu ya miolifa no mwangashi.

english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti amwipaya ilyo akasuba katula, lyena akaba wamisoka.

english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
translation: Uli nokucita cimo cine ku ŋombe shobe ne mpaanga shobe. Amabeli ayalume yakabe kuli banyina inshiku cine lubali, elyo pa bwalenga cine konse konse mukayapeele kuli ine.

english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
translation: “Nga cakuti icitekwa ebile casangwa ukuti acili naco icabula ukufwa, nga ni ŋombe nangu punda nangu impaanga, afwile ukufutilapo inama shibili.

english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu alecemena ifitekwa fyakwe mu cilime nangu mwibala lya myangashi, nomba aleka fyafumamo fyaya lya mwibala lya mwine, uyo muntu afwile ukufutilapo ifisabo ifyawamisha pa fya mu cilime cakwe nangu pa fya mwibala lyakwe ilya myangashi.

english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu aoca umulilo nomba waya ulepya mu mpanga, waoca ne ŋanu batutila nangu isho bashilaseepa nangu ibala lyonse, uyo uocele umulilo afwile ukufutilapo fyonse.

english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu apeela umwina mupalamano indalama nangu ifipe kukumusungilako, elyo umupupu aisa fiba mu ŋanda ya muntu apeele ukumusungilako, uyo mupupu nga aishibikwa afwile ukubweseshapo fibili pali cimo.

english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.
translation: Umupupu nga tamoneke, umwine wa ŋanda afwile ukuletwa pa cinso cakwa Lesa pakwisa mona nga ewabuulila umunankwe ifipe.

english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
translation: “Abantu nga baleumanina icintu cimo icili nge ŋombe, punda, impaanga, icakufwala nangu icintu conse icaluba, elyo atila ati ici cintu candi, ninshi bonse babili bali nokuleta umulandu wabo pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Uo Lesa akasanga ali no mulandu, afwile ukubwesesha umwina mupalamano fibili pali cila cintu.

english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
translation: “Wilasabankanya amashiwi yabufi. Wilaafwilisha umuntu mubi pakuba kambone wabufi.

english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
translation: “Imyaka mutanda ukalelima amabala yobe no kulasombola.

english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
“Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
translation: “Ukalebomba imilimo yobe mu nshiku mutanda, lelo pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali pena ukaletuusha pakuti iŋombe yobe na punda obe fikaletuusha, elyo no musha uwafyalilwa mu ŋanda yobe no mweni bakalebwesha amaka.

english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
“You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
translation: “Mu mwaka umo ukalesefyamo inshikunkulu shitatu pakuncindika.

english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
