And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
translation: Ukuf 20:16

english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
“You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
translation: “Wilatuula mulopa we lambo kuli ine pamo pene na conse icilimo intutumushi. Kabili wikalaleka mafuta ya nama ishikalatuulwa kuli ine pali ishi nshikunkulu, yashale mpaka ukufika na ku lucelo.

english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
translation: Amaf 16:19

english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
translation: Wilakonkelela cintubwingi mukucita ifyabipa. Nga walapeela bukambone pakulubulula wilapondamika icishinka mukukonkelela icintubwingi.

english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
translation: Amaf 5:20

english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
translation: Ukuf 22:21

english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
translation: Malaika wandi akulakutangilila kuntanshi, akaya kufisha na mu calo ca bena Amoli, abena Hiti, abena Perisi, abena Kenani, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi kabili nkabalofyafye bonse.

english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
translation: Wilakunkwila imilungu yabo nelyo ukulaipepa, kabili wikakonkelela micitile yabo. Ufwile ukonaula imilungu yabo, kabili ukatobaule na mabwe bemika aya milungu yabo.

english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
translation: “Nkalenga umwenso wakutiina ine ukalekutangilila. Kabili nkalafulunganya abantu abo ukalalwisha. Nkalenga nokuti abalwani bonse balekufulumuka.

english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
translation: Nkatuma amalonda kuntanshi yobe kukufulumuna abena Hifi, abena Kenani na bena Hiti mu nshila yobe.

english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
translation: Ukuf 22:29

english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
translation: Wilawililila ku mulanda pakumulubulwisha umulandu wakwe.

english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
translation: Nomba nkabafulumunamo panono panono mpaka mukafule icakuti mukapoke icalo conse.

english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
translation: Kabili nkabika umupaka wa calo cobe ukutampila kuli Bemba Wakashika ukufika na kuli bemba wa Bafilisiti, kabili ukufuma ku matololo ukuya shinta ku mumana wa Yufurate. Nkalubwila mu minwe yobe abantu ba muli ici calo kabili ukabafulumunamo.

english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
translation: Wikapangana nabo icipangano nangu kupangana ne milungu yabo.

english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
“If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
translation: “Nga cakuti wasanga iŋombe nangu punda wa mulwani obe nafiluba, ufwile ukufibwesesha ku mwine.

english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
translation: Nga cakuti wamona punda wa muntu uwakupata nawa panshi ku mulandu wakufina kwa cipe cakwe, taufwile kumusha apo pene lelo ufwile ukumwafwako ukumwimya.

english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
translation: “Wilafulunganya bupingushi mukulubulwisha umulanda.

english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
translation: Uletaluka ku bupingushi bwalufyengo. Kabili wilaipaya muntu wakaele nangu umololoke, pantu uucita ifi ine nshakamubelele luse.

english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
translation: Wilapoka mafisakanwa, pantu amafisakanwa yalapofwisha no kulesha ukumona bwino kabili yalabifya ne milandu ya bantu abakaele.

english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
translation: “Wilacusha mweni. Mwalishiba ifyo ubweni bwaba, pantu na imwe mwali abeni mu calo ca Egupto.”

english: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Nina ulupili wise kuli ine pamo na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu na bakalamba ba bena Israeli amakumi cine lubali, mulempepa akatalamukila.

english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
translation: bamona na Lesa wa bena Israeli. Apo anyantile palemoneka kwati pantu pakubatilwe na mabwe ya safile, ayalengama ngo mulu.

english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
translation: Nomba Lesa taonawile ishi ntungulushi sha bena Israeli. Shalimwene Lesa, kabili shaliliile no kunwena pamo.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Nina ulupili wise kuli ine, eko utale wikale. Nalaisa kupeela amabwe yabili ayapapatala apo nembele amafunde nefyo nkonkomeshe ifyakufunda abantu.”

english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakwima na kafwa wakwe Yoshua, kabili Mose aya nina no lupili lwakwa Lesa.

english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
translation: Mose epakweba abakalamba ati, “Shaleni muletulolela pano pene mpaka napo tukabwelela kuli imwe. Muleshala na Aroni na Huri, kanshi onse uwapusana no mubiye afwile ukutwala umulandu kuli bena.”

english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
translation: Ilyo Mose aninine ulupili, awe ikumbi lyakupa ulupili.

english: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
translation: Kabili no bucindami bwakwa Yawe bwaisa ikala pa lupili lwa Sinai. Ikumbi lyakupile ulupili pa nshiku mutanda. Kabili pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali Yawe mukati ke kumbi aita Mose.

english: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
translation: Abena Israeli balemona ubucindami bwakwa Yawe kwati mulilo ulepya pa mulu wa lupili.

english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
translation: Mose anina ulupili aingila na mwikumbi. Aikele pa lupili inshiku amakumi yane (40), akasuba no bushiku.

english: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
translation: Lelo Mose eka eo apalame kuli Yawe, bambi bena beisa mupepi, kabili na bantu bene benina nankwe.”

english: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”
translation: Ilyo Mose aile eba abantu amashiwi na mafunde yonse ayakwa Yawe, abantu nabo bayasukila capamo bonse abati, “Fyonse ifyo Yawe asosele twakulacita.”

english: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation: Mose nao epakulemba fyonse ifyo Yawe asosele. Ubushiku bwakonkelepo abuka lucelocelo akuula ubulambo mwisamba lya lupili, aimikako na mabwe ikumi limo na yabili (12) ukulingana ne nko sha bena Israeli ikumi limo na shibili (12).

english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.
translation: Elyo atuma abalumendo abena Israeli, nabo batuula amalambo yakoca, kabili baipaya ne fiponti fya ŋombe shilume ishakutuula kuli Yawe amalambo yakwampana pamo.

english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
translation: Mose abuula umulopa wa nama awakanya pakati, umo aubika mu nweno elyo uubiye akana ku bulambo.

english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”
translation: Kabili abuula icitabo ca cipangano alabelengela abantu. Abantu nabo bayankula abati, “Twakulacita fyonse ifyo Yawe atweba ukulacita, kabili twakulabeela.”

english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”
translation: Elyo Mose nakabili abuula umulopa aukana pa bantu abeba ati, “Uyu e mulopa wa cipangano ico Yawe apangana na imwe ukulingana na mashiwi yonse aya.”

english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
translation: Mose, Aroni, Nadabu, Abihu na bakalamba ba bena Israeli amakumi cine lubali banina ulupili,

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
translation: Bakapange Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ku cimuti ca akasia. Mubutali ikalepe amakubiti yabili na citika, mubwipi kubiti umo na citika elyo ukuya mumulu namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
translation: Ukalambatike golide wine wine mukati na kunse ya mbokoshi kabili ukabikeko no mushingo wa golide ukushinguluka.

english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
translation: Ukapange imikobelo ine kuli golide uwalopolwa, kabili ukayengelele na ku mikonso ine iya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, ulubali lumo ibili no lubali lubiye nalo ibili.

english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
translation: Elyo ukabase ifimuti fyakupingilako ku cimuti ca akasia, ukalambatikeko na golide.

english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
translation: Ukapishe ifimuti fyakupingilako mu mikobelo ya ku mbali ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano pakupingilako Imbokoshi.

english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
translation: Ifimuti fyakupingilako fikaleba mu mikobelo ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, mwikalafifumyamo iyoo.

english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
translation: Mu Mbokoshi ukabikemo amabwe yabili ayapapatala apalembwa icipangano nkakupeela.

english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
translation: “Ukapangilepo ne Nkupiko ya golide wine wine, apakufutilwa ifyabubifi. Inkupiko mubutali ikabe amakubiti yabili na citika, elyo mubufumo namo kubiti umo .

english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
translation: Ukafulilepo na bamalaika babili aba golide abetwa bakerubi ku mpela shonse shibili sha nkupiko.

english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
translation: Ukapangilepo kerubi ku mpela imo, elyo na umbi ku mpela ibiye ya Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi. Ukengelele kerubi umo ku mpela imo umbi nao ku mpela ibiye iya Nkupiko pakuti fikabefye cimo.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli bansangwile umusangulo. Umpokele umusangulo ku muntu onse uyo uuli no mutima wakupeela.

english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
translation: Bakerubi bakabe na mapindo ayayansa ukulola mumulu ayacinga pa Nkupiko. Bakerubi bakaloshanye amenso, bakalelolesha pa Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi.

english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
translation: Mu Mbokoshi ya Cipangano ukabikemo amabwe ya cipangano yabili ayapapatala ayo nkakupeela, elyo ukakupikepo ne Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi.

english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
translation: Palya pene pa Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi, pakati ka bakerubi babili ababa pa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, epo tukalakumanina nobe, epo nkalakupeelela amafunde yandi yonse ayakweba abena Israeli.”

english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
translation: “Ukapange itebulo ku cimuti ca akasia. Mubutali likabe amakubiti yabili, mubufumo namo kubiti umo, elyo ukuya mumulu namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
translation: Ukalambatikeko na golide wine wine kabili ukabikeko no mushingo wa golide ukushinguluka.

english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
translation: Mu mpela ye tebulo ukashingulushemo imbao ishapapatala mubufumo ngo lupi lwa muntu. Ku mbao ukashingulusheko umushingo wa golide.

english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
translation: Kabili ukapange imikobelo ya golide ine, ukakake na ku matungi apabela imikonso ye tebulo.

english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
translation: Imikobelo yakupishamo ifimuti fyakupingilako itebulo ilingile ukubela mupepi ne mbao yapapatala.

english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
translation: Ukabase ifimuti fyakupingilako itebulo ku cimuti ca akasia, kabili ukalambatikeko na golide efyo mukalapingilako itebulo.

english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
translation: Ukapangilepo ne mbale elyo ne misambilo, inkunku ne nweno shakwitulwilako imituulo ya fyakunwa. Ifipe fyonse ifi ukafipange kuli golide wine wine.

english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
translation: Uyu e musangulo ufwile ukumpokela kuli bena: ni golide, silifa no mukuba,

english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
translation: Ukalebika imikate yakuba pa cinso candi pali ili tebulo pakuti ikaleba pa cinso candi inshita yonse.”

english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
translation: “Ukapange icakutekapo ifisaniko ica golide wine wine. Icikalilo caciko pamo no mukonso waciko ukafifule ku nondo. Tukapu utwapala amaluba ya alumondi, ifitutu na mabula ye luba line fili nokuba icintu cimo ne cikalilo.

english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
translation: Mu cakutekapo ifisaniko mukafuma imisambo mutanda, ku lubali lumo itatu ku lubali lubiye nako itatu.

english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
translation: Ku musambo umo kuli nokuba tukapu tutatu utwapala amaluba ya alumondi ayakwata ifitutu na mabula ye luba line. Elyo na pa musambo wakonkapo ukacita ifyo fine. Kabili na ku misambo mutanda iya cakutekapo ifisaniko napo ukacite ifyo fine.

english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
translation: Pa cakutekapo ifisaniko pali nokuba tukapu tune utwapala amaluba ya alumondi ayakwata ifitutu na mabula ye luba line.

english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
translation: Kabili ifitutu fye luba limo fili nokuba mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyapakubala, fimbi mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyakonkapo elyo fimbi mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyacitatu ngo mwabela imisambo mutanda iya cakutekapo ifisaniko.

english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
translation: Ifitutu ne misambo fili nokuba icintu cimofye ne cakutekapo ifisaniko ifyo bafula ku nondo ukufuma kuli golide wine wine.

english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
translation: Kabili ukapange ifisaniko cine lubali no kufibika pa cakutekapo ifisaniko pakuti fikalesanikila lwa pantanshi.

english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
translation: Ukapange ifyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto pamo no tubale utwasenama kuli golide wine wine.

english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
translation: Ukabomfye golide wine wine uwe talanta limo pakupanga icakutekapo ifisaniko ne fibombelo fyaciko fyonse.

english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
translation: no bushishi ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee, ne nsalu ishabuuta ubusaka, amasako ya mbushi,

english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
translation: Kabili mona ukafipange ukulingana nefyo nakulangile pa lupili.”

english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
translation: ne mpapa sha basukusuku ishatumpwa mu muti uwakashika, ne mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, ne mbao sha muti wa akasia,

english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
translation: na mafuta ya miolifa ayakusanika mu cisaniko, ne fya cena cisuma ifyakubika mu mafuta yakusuba na mu bubani ubwanunka ubusaka,

english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
translation: no tumabwe twa onikisi, no tumabwe twamutengo tumbi utwakubilila pa cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi na pali tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
translation: Kabili bakapange icifulo camushilo pakuti ndeikala nabo.

english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
translation: Mukapange Itenti lyakwa Lesa ne fipe fyaliko ukulingana nefyo nkakulanga.”

english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
translation: “Ukapange Itenti lyakwa Lesa ku nsalu ikumi limo ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka no bushishi bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee. Kabili pali isho nsalu ukapikwilepo bakerubi ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula.

english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
translation: Ukabike imikobelo amakumi yasano (50) ku mpela ya nsalu ulundinkenye, efyo ukacite na ku mpela ya nsalu shimbi ulundinkenye.

english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
translation: Kabili ukapange utwakukofyamo utwa mukuba amakumi yasano (50) pakulunda Itenti lyakwa Lesa ukuba icintu cimofye.

english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
translation: Icipande pakati ica nsalu she Tenti ishikalepapo cena ukacikopwele panuma ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
translation: Kabili insalu she Tenti mu mbali shonse shikapulako kubiti umo , kanshi icipande icikashalako mukacikopwele mu mbali ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa pakulifimba.

english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
translation: Ukapange icakufimba pe Tenti ku mpapa sha basukusuku, ukatumpe na mu muti uwakashikafye. Kabili ukapangilepo icakufimbapo na cimbi ku mpapa ishisuma ishatelela.”

english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
translation: “Ukapange impanda sha cimuti ca akasia ishakwimikilako Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
translation: Cila lupanda luli nokulepa amakubiti ikumi limo elyo mubufumo namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translation: Ku mpela ya cila lupanda ukabaseko utuntu tubili utwakulundinkanishishako ku lupanda lunankwe. Ifi efyo uli nokupanga impanda shonse isha kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ke Tenti lyakwa Lesa ukapangileko impanda amakumi yabili (20).

english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
translation: Kabili ukapange utwakwimikamo impanda amakumi yane (40) utwa silifa, kuli cila lupanda tubili emukuti kamo kali nokuba pesamba lya kakulundinkanishishako.

english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
translation: Insalu shonse shikalingane mubutali na mubwipi. Mubutali shikabe amakubiti amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28) elyo mubwipi namo amakubiti yane .

english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translation: elyo no twakwimikamo impanda utwa silifa amakumi yane (40), emukuti tubili pesamba lya cila lupanda.

english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
translation: Ku numa ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa lwa ku masamba ukapangileko impanda mutanda,

english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
translation: elyo mu matungi ya kunuma yabili aye Tenti lyakwa Lesa ukapangilemo impanda shibili.

english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
translation: Impanda sha mu matungi aya yabili shikabe shapapikana ukufuma panshi ukufika na pamulu pa mukobelo umo uwakushikasha. Efyo impanda sha mu matungi yonse yabili shikabe.

english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translation: Kanshi kukaba ne mpanda cine konse konse, no twakushimikamo utwa silifa ikumi na mutanda (16), emukuti tubili pesamba lya cila lupanda.

english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
translation: “Kabili ukapange imyalo ku cimuti ca akasia. Isano ikabe ya ku lubali lumo ku mpanda sha kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
translation: Imyalo imbi isano ikabe ku mpanda sha ku lubali lubiye, elyo na imbi isano ikabe ku mpanda sha ku numa ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa ku masamba lubali.

english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
translation: Umwalo wa pakati ka mpanda uli nokufuma ku lutwe lumo ukufika ku lubiye.

english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
translation: Ku mpanda ukalambatikeko golide, kabili ukapangileko ne mikobelo ya golide iyakwikasha imyalo. Ku myalo nako kwine ukalambatikeko golide.

english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
translation: Ukalundinkanye insalu shisano elyo na shimbi shisano nasho shine ukashilundinkanye.

english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
translation: Ukapange Itenti lyakwa Lesa nga fintu nakulangile pa lupili.

english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
translation: “Ukapange icisalu ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka na ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee. Umuntu uwacenjela nganshi akapikwilepo na bakerubi.

english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
translation: Ukakobeke ico cisalu ku mikofyo ya golide ku nceshi sha fimuti fya akasia ifyalambatikwako na golide. Kabili ukashimike mu twakushimikamo utwa silifa tune.

english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
translation: Ukakobeke ico cisalu ku mikofyo, elyo ukabike Mbokoshi ya Cipangano ku numa ya cisalu. Icisalu ecikalekanya Umuputule wamushilo ku Muputule wamushilo icine cine.

english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
translation: Pa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano ukabikepo Inkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi. Iyi Mbokoshi ikabe mu Muputule wamushilo icine cine.

english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
“You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
translation: “Pa mwinshi wakwingililapo mwi Tenti ukapangilepo icisalu ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka na ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee ifyapikulwa ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi.

english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
translation: Ukapange ne mikofyo ya ku cisalu iya golide, kabili ukabase ne nceshi shisano isha cimuti ca akasia ukalambatikeko na golide. Ukapange ne fyakwimikamo inceshi shisano ku mukuba uwalopolwa.”

english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
translation: Ku mpela ya nsalu ubalilepo ukulundinkanya ukabikeko imikobelo yacifufya konse konse mumbali yafiko lwa mubwipi, efyo ukacite na ku mpela ya nsalu shimbi ukalundinkanya.

english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
translation: Ku nsalu wacibalilapo ukulundinkanya ukabikeko imikobelo amakumi yasano (50), elyo na ku ibiye nako ukabikeko amakumi yasano (50), ne mikobelo ya fipande fyonse fibili ibe iyalungatana.

english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
translation: Elyo ukapanga no twakukofyamo twa golide amakumi yasano pakulunda ifyo fipande fibili, epakuti Itenti lyakwa Lesa lyaba icintu cimofye.

english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
translation: “Kabili ukapikule insalu ikumi na imo (11) ku masako ya mbushi ishakufimba kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
translation: Insalu shonse ikumi na imo (11) shikabe ishalingana mubutali na mubwipi. Mubutali shikabe amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30) elyo mubwipi namo amakubiti yane .

english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
translation: Ukalundinkanye insalu shisano shikabe cimo, elyo na shimbi mutanda nasho shikabe cimo. Ukapete insalu iyakulenga mutanda pabili kuntanshi ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
translation: “Ukapange ubulambo ku cimuti ca akasia. Bukabe ubwalingana mubutali na mubufumo. Bukabe amakubiti yasano mubutali na mubufumo, elyo ukuya mumulu namo amakubiti yatatu .

english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
translation: Kukabe ne nceshi amakumi yabili isha mukuba ne fyakushimikamo ifya mukuba amakumi yabili (20), lelo imikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi fikabe ifya silifa.

english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
translation: Ulubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso nako kwine lukabe amakubiti umwanda umo (100) mubutali, kabili ukakupeko insalu ishabuuta ubusaka. Kukabe ne nceshi sha mukuba ne fyakushimikamo fya mukuba amakumi yabili, lelo imikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi fikabe ifya silifa.

english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
translation: Ulubali lwa ku masamba ya lupango lwa lubansa lukabe amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) mubwipi , kabili ukakupeko insalu ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka. Kukabe ne nceshi ikumi limo ne fyakushimikamo ikumi limo.

english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
translation: Lwa ku kabanga ukutulila akasuba ulupango lwa lubansa lukabe amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) mubwipi.

english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translation: Ku lubali lumo ulwa pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa kukaba ne nsalu yakukupako iyalepa amakubiti ikumi limo na yasano (15) . Kukabe ne nceshi shitatu ne fyakushimikamo nafyo fitatu.

english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translation: Kabili ku lubali lubiye nako kwine kukabe inceshi shitatu ne fyakushimikamo nafyo fitatu ne nsalu yakukupako ilyalepa amakubiti ikumi limo na yasano (15).

english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
translation: Pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa ukabikepo icisalu icalepa amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) icabuuta ubusaka icapikulwa ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula. Cili nokukobekwa ku nceshi shine, ishaimikwa mu fyakushimikamo fine.

english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
translation: Inceshi sha lupango lwa lubansa shonse shikakwate utufyela twa ku nceshi utwa silifa ne mikobelo ya silifa elyo ne fyakushimikamo ifya mukuba.

english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
translation: Ulupango lwa lubansa lukabe amakubiti umwanda umo (100) mubutali, mubwipi namo amakubiti amakumi yabili na batatu (23) elyo ukuya mumulu namo amakubiti yasano . Kabili lukabe ne nsalu shakukupako ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka elyo ne fyakwimikamo ifya mukuba.

english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
translation: Ifipe fyonse ifyakubomfya mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa ku milimo iyalekana lekana yonse fikabe ifya mukuba, kumo kwine ne mpopo she Tenti ne sha lupango lwa lubansa.”

english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
translation: Ku matungi yane aya bulambo ukabikeko cile tungi ulusengo lumo, lelo insengo no bulambo fikabaswe ku cimuti cimo pakuti fikabe icintu cimofye. Kabili ku bulambo ukalambatikeko no mukuba.

english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
translation: “Ukakonkomeshe abena Israeli ukuleta amafuta ya miolifa ayalengama ayakusanika pakuti ifisaniko fikaleyakafye lyonse.

english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translation: Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakabike ifisaniko mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, fikaleyaka ukufuma icungulo ukufika ulucelo pa cinso candi ne Yawe. Fikaba kunse ya cisalu icikabela pantanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano. Ili lifunde lyakubelelela ku bena Israeli ilyo bali nokubaka mu nkulo shabo shonse ishikakonkapo.”

english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
translation: Ukapange ifyakubomfya ku bulambo fyonse ku mukuba. Inongo shakukushilapo imito ya mafuta, bafosholo, inweno, imitunkwilo ne fyakubikapo umulilo.

english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
translation: Ukapangilepo ica mukuba icafipunda ngo lunyungo. Ukapange ne mikobelo ya mukuba ine iyakwikasha ku matungi ya capikulwa.

english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
translation: Kabili ukabike icafipunda ngo lunyungo pesamba lye tabo lya bulambo pakuti cikafike pakati.

english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
translation: Ukabase ifimuti fya akasia ifyakupingilako ubulambo, ukalambatikeko no mukuba.

english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
translation: Ukalepisha ifyo fimuti fyakupingilako mu mikobelo ya ku mbali shibili sha bulambo pakubusenda.

english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
translation: Ukapange ubulambo bwa mbao ubwacenama pamulu nga fintu nakulangile pa lupili.”

english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
translation: “Ukabikeko ulupango ku lubansa lwa kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa. Ulubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo lukabe amakubiti umwanda umo (100) mubutali , kabili ukakupeko insalu ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka.

english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
translation: “Leka bakuletele munonko Aroni na bana bakwe abaume Nadabu, Abihu, Eleasa na Itama ukufuma mu bena Israeli pakuti balemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
translation: Ukayafukule ukulingana nomo bakonkanine mukufyalwa, pa libwe limo ukalembepo amashina mutanda, pa libiye napo mutanda.

english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
translation: Nga filya uwakufukula pa mabwe afukula ifilembo pa cifwatiko efyo na iwe ukafukule, ukalembe amashina ya bamwana Israeli pali ayo mabwe yabili. Elyo ukabikeko amabwe no twapikulwa na waya ya golide.

english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.
translation: Elyo ukekashe aya mabwe pa mishipi ya pa mabeya ya cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi, yabe mabwe yakwibukishishako bamwana Israeli. Ifi efyo Aroni akalasenda amashina yabo pa mabeya yakwe pa cinso cakwa Yawe pakuyebukisha.

english: You shall make settings of gold,
translation: Kabili ukapange utwapikulwa na waya ya golide,

english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
translation: ne minyololo ibili iya golide wine wine iyakoswa ngo mwando, elyo ukaikashe ku tupapatu twa twapikulwa na waya ya golide.”

english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
translation: “Ukabile tumba wa pa cifuba uwakwishibilako pakupingula. Umuntu uwacenjela nganshi eo akapikule. Tumba akabe nga efodi uwapikulwa ku bushishi ubwa golide no bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka.

english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
translation: Tumba nga apetwa pakati akalingana ukulepa monse mubutali na mubwipi, akalepe icisansa cimo monse monse.

english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
translation: Ukekashepo utumabwe twamutengo imitande ine. Mu mutande wantanshi muli nokuba akalibwe ka rubi na ka topasi na ka bereli,

english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
translation: Mu mutande wabubili muli nokuba akalibwe ka tokisi na ka safile na ka emeradi.

english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation: Mu mutande wabutatu muli nokuba akalibwe ka yasinti na ka agate na ka amefisiti,

english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
translation: Ukabilile munonko Aroni ifyakufwala fyamushilo ifyakumucindamika no kumuyemfya.

english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
translation: na mutande wabune muli nokuba akalibwe ka kirisaliti na ka onikisi na ka yasipeli. Uto tumabwe ukatubikeko no twapikulwa na waya ya golide.

english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
translation: Utumabwe tukabe ikumi na tubili (12). Pali cila kalibwe pakabe ishina lyakwa mwana Israeli limo, pakafukulwe kwati cifwatiko ishina limo ilya pa nko ikumi limo na shibili (12),

english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
translation: Ukapange utuminyololo twa golide wine wine utwapyatwa ngo mwando utwa kuli tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
translation: Kabili ukapangileko imikobelo ibili iya golide elyo ukaikashe ku mpela shibili isha tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
translation: Elyo ukakakile uto tuminyololo twa golide tubili ku mikobelo ya ku mpela sha tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
translation: Impela shimbi shibili isha tuminyololo ukashikakile ku fyapikulwa na waya ya golide. Kabili ukashikakile lwa pantanshi ku mishipi ibili iya pa mabeya ya cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi.

english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
translation: Elyo ukapange imikobelo ya golide ibili. Ukaikashe na ku mpela shibili ishabela lwa mukati ka tumba mupepi ne cakufwala ca efodi.

english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
translation: Ukapange imikobelo ya golide na imbi ibili. Ukaikashe mwisamba lya mishipi ibili iya pa mabeya iyabela pantanshi ya efodi, mupepi na lwa pamulu apalundinkanina efodi no mushipi wapikulwa bwino.

english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
translation: Ukakakile imikobelo ya tumba wa pa cifuba ku mikobelo ya efodi no mwando wa bushishi ubwacifufya ukulundinkanya na tumba wa pa cifuba, pakuti akalebela lwa pa mulu wa mushipi, pakulenga tumba ukuti elasela pali efodi.

english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
translation: “Ilyo lyonse Aroni akalaingila mu Muputule wamushilo, akalasendela amashina ya bamwana Israeli abaume pa mutima ayalembwa pali tumba uwakwishibilako pakupingula pakuti yakaleibukishiwa lyonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Ukebe abacenjela ukubila ifyakufwala bonse abo napeela amano yakubomba uyu mulimo ukuti bakabilile Aroni ifyakufwala pakumutuula pakuti alemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.
translation: Muli tumba wa pa cifuba uwakwishibilako pakupingula ukabikemo Urimu na Tumimu, pakuti fikaleba lwa pa mutima wakwa Aroni ilyo lyonse akalaisa pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Kanshi, Aroni akalasenda lyonse pa mutima wakwe ifibombelo ifyakubomfya pakupingula abena Israeli pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
translation: “Ukabile umwingila wakufwala mukati ka efodi ku nsalu yacifufyafye.

english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
translation: Mu mwingila ukashemo icipunda icakupishamo umutwe. Pa cipunda apakupisha umutwe ukapikulepo ukushinguluka pakulesha umwingila ukulepuka.

english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
translation: Ku mufukilo wa mwingila ukapikwilemo ifitwalo ifyapala amateke ku bushishi bwacifufya no bwakashikila elyo no bwakashika cee. Pakati ka fitwalo ifyapala mateke ukekashepo utunyenjele twa golide.

english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
translation: Ukafikonkanye ukushinguluka umufukilo wa mwingila onse utunyenjele twa golide ne teke ifyo fine.

english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.
translation: “Aroni akalefwala umwingila uyu pakubomba umulimo wa bushimapepo. Ukulila kwa tunyenjele kukalaumfwika nga aingila mu Muputule wamushilo pa cinso cakwa Yawe na pakufumamo, pakuti tafwile.

english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’
translation: “Ukapange akalilata ka golide wine wine, ukafukulepo ne filembo nga pa cifwatiko ifikatila ‘Uwamushilo kuli Yawe.’

english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
translation: Ukakakakilile akatambo kacifufya ku nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe. Kakalebela lwa pa mpumi ku nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe.

english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
translation: Kakalebela pa mpumi yakwa Aroni, kabili eukalasenda ifilubo fyonse ifikalaba mu mituulile ya mituulo yamushilo iyili yonse abena Israeli basangulula. Akalilata ka golide kali nokuba lyonse pa mpumi yakwa Aroni pakuti Yawe akalepokelela imituulo bakalatuula.

english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
translation: “Ukapikule ilaya ku bushishi ubwabuuta ubusaka, ne nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe nayo ku bushishi ubwabuuta ubusaka. Ilamba lyena likapikulwe ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi.

english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Ifi efyo bakamubilile: tumba wakufwala pa cifuba , icakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi, umwingila, ilaya ilitali ilyapikulwapo busaka busaka, insalu yakupomba ku mutwe elyo ne lamba lya nsalu. Bakabilile Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ifyakufwala ifi ifyamushilo pakuti bakalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
translation: “Bamwana Aroni nabo ukababilile imingila, amalamba ne nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe, pakuti bakalemoneka abacindama kabili abayemba.

english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Ilyo ukapwisha ukufwika munonko Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ifyo fyakufwala, elyo ukabasube amafuta no kubapeela bushimapepo. Ukabasangulule pakuti balemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
translation: Kabili ukababilile bakaputula ba mukati aba nsalu ishabuuta abakufuma mu musana ukufika na mu matanta pakuti bekalashala ubwamba.

english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
translation: Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakalefwala bakaputula ilyo lyonse balaingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo nangu ilyo balapalama ku bulambo kukubomba umulimo wa bushimapepo mu Muputule wamushilo, epakuti tabacitile icilubo, nokufwa bafwa. Ili likaba lifunde lyakubelelela kuli Aroni na ba lupwa lwakwe.”

english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
translation: Abacenjela muli uyu mulimo bakabomfye ubushishi bwa golide no bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee ne nsalu iyabuuta ubusaka.”

english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
translation: “Bakabile efodi icakufwala pa mulu wa mwingila wakwa shimapepo ku bushishi bwa golide no bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula.

english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
translation: Cikabe ne mikobelo ku mpela shibili iyakupisha pa mabeya pakucikaka.

english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
translation: Umushipi ukabe nga efodi uwapikulwa ubusaka ku bushishi bwa golide no bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka, kabili uwalundinkana kuli efodi.

english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
translation: Ukabuule amabwe ya onikisi yabili, ukafukulepo amashina ya bamwana Yakobo abaume ikumi limo na babili (12).

english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,
translation: “Ifi efyo uli nokucita kuli Aroni na bana bakwe abaume pakubasangulula pakuti bakalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo. Ukabuule iciponti na basukusuku babili ababula akalema.

english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
translation: “Ukalete ne ciponti pa ntanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, elyo Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakatambalikila amaboko yabo pa mutwe wa ciponti.

english: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Mukacipaile pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa mwinshi wakwingilila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.
translation: Ukabuule umulopa umo uwa ciponti icilume ukaushinge ku nsengo sha bulambo ku munwe. Umulopa ukashalapo onse ukawitile mwisamba lya bulambo.

english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
translation: Elyo ukabuule amafuta ayaba ku fya munda, fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, ne mfyo shonse shibili na mafuta ayabako, elyo ukafyoce pa bulambo.

english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.
translation: Lelo umunofu wa ciponti icilume, umukupo na fyonse ifili mu cifu na mu mala fyena ukaye fyocela kunse ya nkambi. E mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
translation: “Ukabuulepo sukusuku umo, na Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakatambalikepo amaboko yabo pa mutwe wakwe.

english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.
translation: Elyo ukamwipaye, ukabuule no mulopa wakwe, ukaukane ku mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
translation: Ukaputaule sukusuku fipimfya fipimfya, ukasamfye ne fya munda ne myendo, ukafibike pa fibiye pamo no mutwe.

english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Elyo ukoce sukusuku onse pa bulambo. Ili e lambo ilyakocela Yawe, ilya cena cisuma icimusekesha, umutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe.

english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
translation: “Ukabuule sukusuku na umbi, Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakatambalikepo amaboko yabo pa mutwe wakwe.

english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
translation: Kabili ku bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ukapangeko imikate iyabulamo intutumushi. Elyo ukapangeko utumikate utwasakanishiwamo na mafuta, no tumikate utwapapatala utwashingwako amafuta, tonse umwabula intutumushi.

english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
translation: Ukamwipaye, ukabuule no mulopa wakwe umo, ukashinge Aroni na bana bakwe abaume pa tulebelebe twa matwi ya ku kulyo kwabo, pa fikumo fya ku kulyo kwabo, na pa fikondo fikalamba fya ku kulyo. Elyo ukakane umulopa ukashalapo ku mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
translation: Elyo ukabuulepo umulopa umo uuli pa bulambo, na mafuta yamo ayakubasuba pakuba bashimapepo, ukakane pali Aroni na pa fyakufwala fyakwe, elyo na pa bana bakwe ne fyakufwala fyabo. Ninshi Aroni na bana bakwe pamo ne fyakufwala fyabo batuulwa kuli Lesa.

english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
translation: “Kabili kuli sukusuku uyu ukabuuleko amafuta, umucila, amafuta ya mu fya munda, fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, ne mfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako elyo no mwendo wa ku kulyo.

english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
translation: Mu museke wa mikate iyabulamo intutumushi iyili pa cinso cakwa Yawe ukabuulemo umukate umo na kamukate kamo akasakanishiwamo amafuta elyo na kamukate akapapatala.

english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translation: Ifyakulya fyonse ifyo ukafibike mu minwe yakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume, nabo bakafimishe mumulu ngo mutuulo wakutambika ukuti nafipeelwa kuli Yawe pa cinso cakwe.

english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Elyo kabili ukafibuule mu minwe, ukafyocele na pa bulambo pa mulu we lambo lyakoca. Ili e lambo lyakocela Yawe lya cena cisuma icimusekesha, umutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe.

english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.
translation: “Ukabuule icisao cakwa sukusuku uo ukepaya pakupeela Aroni bushimapepo, ukacimishe mumulu ngo mutuulo wakutambika pa cinso cakwa Yawe, elyo cikabe icakaniko cobe.

english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.
translation: Ukasangulule icisao no mwendo ifyakwa sukusuku ifikemishiwa mumulu ngo mutuulo wakutambika pakupeela bushimapepo, ukafituule pantu fyakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume.

english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.
translation: Ifi e fipande fili nokuba icakaniko cakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ifyo bali nokulapoka lyonse ku bena Israeli. E bupe ubukalafuma ku bena Israeli pafyo bakalatuula kuli Yawe, ukufuma pa mituulo yabo iyakwampana.

english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
translation: “Aroni nga afwa, ifyakufwala fyakwe ifyamushilo fikapeelwe ku bana bakwe abaume, efyakusubilwamo amafuta no kupeelelwamo bushimapepo.

english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
translation: Ukaibike mu museke no kuletela pamo ne ciponti na basukusuku babili.

english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.
translation: Umwana uwamupyana pali bushimapepo, akalefwala ifyo ifyakufwala pa nshiku cine lubali pakuya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo mukubomba mu Muputule wamushilo.

english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.
translation: “Ukabuule inama ya sukusuku iyakupeelelapo bushimapepo no kuipikila mu cifulo camushilo.

english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Aroni na bana bakwe bakalile inama ya sukusuku pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pamo no mukate ukaba mu museke.

english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.
translation: Bakalye ifyo fintu babomfeshe pakufuta pa bubifi bwabo ilyo balepeelwa amaka ya bushimapepo kabili no kusangululwa. Umuntu umbi nelyo umo tafwile kulyako kuli ifi pantu fyamushilo.

english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti inama ya sukusuku iyakupeelelapo bushimapepo nangu umukate fyashalapo ukufika ulucelo, mukafyocefye. Tamufwile kufilya, pantu fyamushilo.

english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.
translation: “Ukabombe umulimo wakupeela Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bushimapepo ukulingana ngefyo nakukonkomesha. Ukubapeela bushimapepo kukapwe inshiku cine lubali.

english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
translation: Cila bushiku ukaleleka cilume wa ŋombe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi pakufuta pa fyabubifi. Ukasangulule ubulambo ku mutuulo wa pa bubifi pakufuta pa fyabubifi. Kabili ukabusube amafuta pakubutuula.

english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
translation: Pa nshiku cine lubali ukaleleka pa bulambo ilambo lyakufuta pa fyabubifi no kubusangulula. Elyo ubulambo bukaba ubwamushilo nganshi, elyo na conse icakumyako cili nokuba icamushilo.”

english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
translation: “Ifi efyo uli nokutuula pa bulambo cila bushiku, lyonsefye ukaletuula ilambo lya bana ba mpaanga babili abali no mwaka umo.

english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;
translation: Ukaletuula umwana wa mpaanga umo ulucelo elyo umbi nao icungulo.

english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
translation: “Elyo ukalete Aroni na bana bakwe abaume pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kubasamba na menshi.

english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
translation: Pakutuula umwana wa mpaanga uwakubalilapo, ukatuulile pamo ne capekumi cimo ca cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwakasawilwamo amafuta ya miolifa ayalingana na pakati ka citika wa hini umo. Kabili ukatuule icipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini uwa mwangashi, umutuulo wa fyakunwa.

english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Ukaletuula ilambo lya mwana wa mpaanga uwabubili icungulo mu musango umo wine ngo lucelo pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa. E lambo lyakocela Yawe ilya cena cisuma icimusekesha.

english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.
translation: Mu nkulo shenu shonse mukaleleka ili lambo lyakoca inshita yonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Apopene epo ine nkalamukumanya no kulalanda na imwe.

english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
translation: Apo pene kabili epo nkalakumanya abena Israeli, no bucindami bwandi bukalenga icifulo kuba icamushilo.

english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Nkalenga Itenti Lyakukumaninamo pamo pene no bulambo ukuba ifyamushilo kabili nkalenga Aroni na bana bakwe ukuba abamushilo, pakuti bakalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
translation: Elyo nkacita icifulo candi pakati ka bena Israeli kabili nkaba Lesa wabo.

english: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
translation: Bakeshiba nokuti nine Yawe, Lesa wabo, uwabafumishe mu calo ca Egupto pakuti nkacite icifulo candi pakati kabo. Nine Yawe, Lesa wabo.”

english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
translation: Ukabuule ne fyakufwala, ukafwike Aroni ilaya, umwingila wakufwala mukati ka efodi wine, icakufwala ca efodi, na tumba wa pa cifuba .

english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
translation: Ukamupombe ne nsalu ya ku mutwe, ukakambatikepo na kalilata kamushilo.

english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
translation: Ukabuule amafuta yakumusuba pakuba shimapepo, ukayapongolwele pa mutwe wakwe pakumusuba.

english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
translation: “Ukalete na bana bakwe abaume, nabo ukabafwike imingila.

english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
translation: Kabili ukabafwike amalamba ya mu musana no kubapomba insalu ku mitwe. Bushimapepo bwabo bukaba ukukonkana umwabela ifunde lyakubelelela. Muli uyo musango emo ukapeelela Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bushimapepo.

english: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
translation: Umuntu umo uwa mu luko lwakwa Levi aupile umwanakashi wa mu luko lwakwe ulwa bwina Levi.

english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
translation: Panuma ilyo umwana akulileko, umwanakashi amubweseshe kuli mwana Farao umwanakashi. Nao umwana wa mfumu Farao amucitile umwana wakwe. Amwinike ne shina lya Mose, ati, “Pantu namwabwile mu menshi.”

english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
translation: Ilyo Mose akulile, ubushiku bumo aile ku bantu bakwe Abahibulu. Aya mona ifyo baleculisha mukubombesha. Kabili Mose amona uko umwina Egupto aleuma Umuhibulu munankwe.

english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
translation: Ilyo Mose aceba ceba, amona tapali muntu nelyo umo, aipaya umwina Egupto amufisa na mu musensenga.

english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo abwelelako, amona Abahibulu babili abaume balelwa. Elyo aeba uubalile umubiye ati, “Cinshi uleumina Umuhibulu mubiyo?”

english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
translation: Nao amwasuka ati, “Nga uwakucita kateeka na kaputula wa milandu yesu nani? Bushe ulefwaya ukunjipaya nga filya waipeye umwina Egupto?” Elyo Mose umwenso wamwikata, alatontonkanya nokuti, “Cine cinefye abantu nabeshiba ifyo nacitile.”

english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
translation: Farao pakumfwa uyu mulandu, alafwaya ukwipaya Mose, lelo Mose afulumuka Farao, aya ikala ku Midiani. Eko aikala panshi mupepi ne cishima ca menshi.

english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
translation: Nomba shimapepo wa ku Midiani ali na bana abanakashi cine lubali, awe baisa kukutapa amenshi no kwisusha amenshi mu milimba yakunweseshamo ifitekwa fyakwa shibo.

english: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
translation: Elyo kwaisa na bakacema bamo baisa batamfyapo. Lelo Mose aima abapokololako, apeela ne fitekwa fyabo amenshi.

english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
translation: Ilyo abakashana babwelela kuli shibo Reueli, nao abepusha ati, “Bushe cinshi mwabwelela bwangu lelo?”

english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Umwina Egupto umo ewacitupokololako kuli bakacema. Kabili acitutapilako amenshi no kupeelako ifitekwa fyesu amenshi.”

english: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi alimite, afyala no mwana umwaume. Pakumona ifyo umwana ali uwayemba, nyina amufishile pa myeshi itatu.

english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
translation: Imili 7:20

english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
translation: Imili 7:21

english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
translation: Sipora afyala no mwana umwaume, nao Mose amwinike ishina lya Geshomu, asosele ati, “Ine ndi mweni muli cino calo ca bene.”

english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
translation: Bahi 11:23

english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
translation: Bahi 11:24

english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.
translation: Kanshi Lesa alolesha abena Israeli, aishiba no bucushi bwabo.

english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
translation: Nomba ilyo afililwe ukutwalilila ukufisa umwana, abuulile ulupe lwa matete, ashingwilako amanenekela na mapula. Emo abika umwana, ayabika no lupe mu matete mu lulamba lwa mumana.

english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
translation: Nkashi wa mwana aiminina akatalamukila pakuti amone ifyalamucitikila.

english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
translation: Nomba umwana wakwa Farao umwanakashi aishile ku mumana kukowa. Ababomfi bakwe abakashana balatandala mu lulamba lwa mumana. Awe ati amone ulupe mu matete, atuma umubomfi wakwe umo mukashana ukuya luleta.

english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
translation: Cilya akupukulapo, amonamo umwana umwaume alelila. Uluse lwamwikata, asosa ati, “Uyu mwana, mwana wa muntu umo pa Bahibulu.”

english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
translation: Elyo nkashi ya ulya mwana aipusha mwana Farao umwanakashi ati, “Bushe nje mufwailako umwanakashi Umuhibulu uwakumonseshako umwana?”

english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
translation: Nao amwasuka ati, “Ale kabiye.” Awe umukashana aya senda na nyina kwa mwana.

english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
translation: Mwana Farao umwanakashi amweba ati, “Senda uyu mwana uye mukulaŋonseshako, na ine nakulakulipila.” Kanshi umwanakashi epakusenda umwana, aya mukulamonsha.

english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
translation: “Ukapange ubulambo bwakocelapo ububani ku mbao sha cimuti ca akasia.

english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”
translation: Umuku umo cila mwaka Aroni akalefutila pa nsengo sha bulambo. Uku kufuta pa fyabubifi ukwa cila mwaka kufwile ukucitwa no mulopa wa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ku nkulo shonse ishikakonkapo. Ubu bulambo bwamushilo nganshi kuli Yawe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.
translation: “Ilyo ukalapenda abena Israeli pakwishiba impendwa yabo, cila muntu akapeele icifuta mulandu kuli Yawe icakulubwilapo umweo wakwe ilyo apendwa, epakuti bekaponenwa ne cinkunka ilyo ukalabapenda.

english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.
translation: Umuntu onse uwapitila ku bapendelwe afwile ukupeela citika wa ndalama ya shekeli iyapimwa ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo. Shekeli imo yafina amagera amakumi yabili. Citika wa iyi ndalama, mutuulo wa kuli Yawe.

english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.
translation: Uyo onse uwapitila ku bapendelwe uuli ne myaka amakumi yabili nangu ukucilapo, ali nokupeela umutuulo kuli Yawe.

english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.
translation: Umukankala tali nakupeela ukucisha pa cipimo ca citika wa shekeli, elyo umupina nao tali nakupeela utunono utwabula ukufika pa cipimo, pakupeela umutuulo kuli Yawe uwakufutila imyeo yabo.

english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”
translation: Ukapoke isho ndalama ku bena Israeli ishakufuta pa fyabubifi, no kuubomfya ku milimo ya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Isho ndalama shikabe icakwibukisha abena Israeli pa cinso cakwa Yawe, eshakulubwilapo imyeo yabo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
translation: “Ukapange umusambilo wa mukuba elyo ne cakutekapo ica mukuba umwakusambila. Ukaciteke pakati ke Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no bulambo, ukabikemo na menshi.

english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
translation: Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bakalesamba muli aya menshi ku maboko na ku makasa.

english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
translation: Ubulambo bufwile ukuba ubwalingana monse monse mubutali na mubwipi kubiti umo, elyo ukufuma panshi ukufika pamulu bukalepe amakubiti yabili . Insengo sha ku bulambo shikabaswe ku cimuti cimo cine pakuti fikabe icintu cimofye.

english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Bakalesamba aya menshi ilyo lyonse balaingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo nelyo balapalamina ku bulambo kukubomba umulimo wakupeela umutuulo wakoca kuli Yawe, pakuti bekafwa.

english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
translation: Bakalesamba amaboko na makasa pakuti bekafwa. Ili likaba e funde lyakubelelela kuli Aroni na ba lupwa lwakwe ku nkulo shabo shonse ishikakonkapo.”

english: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
translation: “Ukabuule ifi ifyakwata akacena kasuma: muri wa menshi uwafina amakilo mutanda (6kg), kinamoni uwanunka ubusaka uwafina amakilo yatatu, na kane uwanunka ubusaka amakilo yatatu (3kg),

english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
translation: Mateo 17:24

english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
translation: Elyo mukaleyabomfya mukusuba Itenti Lyakukumaninamo, Imbokoshi ya Cipangano,

english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
translation: itebulo ne fibombelo fyaliko fyonse, icakutekapo ifisaniko pamo pene ne fibombelo fyaciko, ubulambo bwakocelapo ububani,

english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
translation: ubulambo bwakocelapo amalambo pamo pene ne fibombelo fyabuko fyonse, elyo na ku musambilo ne cakutekapo cauko.

english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
translation: Ukuf 37:29

english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
translation: Ukalambatikeko pamulu ponse, mumbali monse na ku nsengo sha bulambo golide wine wine. Ukapangileko no mushingo wa golide ukushinguluka.

english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Ukasube Aroni na bana bakwe abaume amafuta no kubasangulula pakuti bakalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
translation: Ukebe abena Israeli auti, ‘Aya yakaba amafuta yandi ayamushilo ayakusuba mu nkulo shenu shonse ishikakonkapo.

english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
translation: Tekwesha ukuyetila pa mubili wa muntu kabili tekwesha ukupanga amafuta ayapalako ayasakanishiwamo ne fintu fimo fine mu musango umo wine. Yena mafuta yamushilo, yakaleba ayamushilo na kuli imwe bene.

english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
translation: Onse uyo uukapanga amafuta ayapala nga aya, noyo uukasuba umuntu uushili shimapepo, wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.’”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
