translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Buula ifintu ifyanunka ubusaka, ifinyamuti fya sitakite, ifya onika, ifya galibanumu ne cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka, fyonse fikalingane ubwingi.

english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
translation: Ifi efyo ukafisakanye. Ukapangemo ububani nga filya ficita umuntu uwacenjela ukusakanya ifyanunka ubusaka. Mu bubani ukabikemo umucele, bukabe ubwasangululwa kabili ubwamushilo.

english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
translation: Ukabuulepo ububani bumo ukabupele ngo bunga, ukabubike na pa ntanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo umo nkalakukumanya. Ubu bubani bukaba kuli imwe ubwamushilo nganshi.

english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.
translation: Tekwesha ukupanga ububani bwenu ubwapalako ubwasakanishiwamo ne fintu fimo fine mu musango umo wine. Bwena mukabucite ububani bwamushilo kuli Yawe.

english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
translation: Onse uyo uukapanga ububani ubwapala nga bulya, pakuti aleumfwa ifyo bwanunkila ubusaka, wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.”

english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
translation: Ukapangileko ne mikobelo ya golide ibili iyakusendelako. Pesamba lya mushingo ku mbali shibili isha bulambo ishalolenkana, ukekasheko umukobelo umo umo umwakupisha ifimuti fyakupingilako.

english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
translation: Ukabase ifimuti fyakupingilako ku muti wa akasia, ukalambatikeko na golide.

english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
translation: Ukabike ubo bulambo pa ntanshi ya cisalu cakucinga ukuli Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, pa ntanshi ya Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi iyili pa mulu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, apo tukalakumanina.

english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
translation: Inshiku shonse ulucelo Aroni afwile akaleoca pa bulambo ububani ubwanunka ubusaka, ilyo aisa mukuwamya ifisaniko.

english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
translation: Kabili afwile akaleoca ububani ubwanunka ubusaka na mu cungulo, ilyo abwela mukusanika ifisaniko. Kanshi ukoca ububani kukalebako lyonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe mu nkulo shenu shonse.

english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
translation: Tekwesha ukocelapo pali buno bulambo ububani ubwaleshiwa nangu ilambo lyakoca nangu umutuulo wa cabunga. Kabili tekwesha ukwitilapo mutuulo onse uwa fyakunwa.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
translation: Elyo kabili bakapikule ifyakufwala ifyamushilo fyakwa Aroni shimapepo ne fya bana bakwe abaume fintu bakalafwala nga balabomba umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”
translation: Bakapange na mafuta yakusuba no bubani ubwanunka ubusaka ubwa mu Muputule wamushilo. Ifi fyonse bakafipange ukulingana nomo nakonkomeshe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
translation: “Ukebe abena Israeli auti, ‘Muli nokubaka Amasabata yandi pantu ici e cishibilo kuli ine na kuli imwe ne nkulo shenu shonse ukuti nine Yawe uumulenga kuti mube abamushilo.

english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
translation: Mulebaka ubushiku bwe Sabata pantu bushiku bwamushilo kuli imwe. Uyo onse uushilicindika, akepaiwe. Uyo onse uukabomba umulimo uuli onse pali ubu bushiku, wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.

english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
translation: Mukalebomba imilimo mu nshiku mutanda, lelo ubwalenga cine lubali bwena bushiku bwe Sabata ubwakutuushamofye ubwamushilo kuli Yawe. Uyo onse uukabombapo umulimo uuli onse pe Sabata akepaiwe.

english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
translation: Abena Israeli bakalebaka ubushiku bwe Sabata, bakalebusefya mu nkulo shabo shonse ishikakonkapo nge cipangano ca pe.

english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”
translation: Ubushiku bwe Sabata bukaba e cishibilo ca pe kuli ine na ku bena Israeli. Pantu mu nshiku mutanda emo Yawe acitile umulu ne sonde, elyo pa bushiku ubwalenga cine lubali epo alekele ukubomba atuusha.’”

english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
translation: Ilyo Lesa apwile ukulanda na Mose pa lupili lwa Sinai, amupeele amabwe yabili ayapapatala aya cipangano, ayo Lesa alembelepo ku munwe wakwe.

english: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
translation: “Mona ninsala Besaleli mwana Uri, umwishikulu wakwa Huri, uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
translation: Nimwisushamo Umupashi wakwa Lesa kabili nimupeela ukucenjela, amano yakwishiba ifyakupanga panga ifya misango yonse.

english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
translation: Akalaelenganya bwino mukupanga ifya golide ne fya silifa ne fya mukuba,

english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
translation: ukuputula amabwe no kuyekasha, ifyakubasa ifimuti, ne fyakupanga panga pakuti bakapange ifya misango yonse.

english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
translation: Kabili ninsonta na Oliabu umwana mwaume wakwa Aisamaki uwa mu luko lwakwa Dani, uwakwafwa Besaleli. Kabili nimpeela ukucenjela ku baishiba ifyakupanga panga pakuti bakapange ifintu fyonse nkukonkomeshe.

english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
translation: Bali nokupanga Itenti Lyakukumaninamo, Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ne Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi elyo ne fipe fyonse fimbi ifya mwi Tenti,

english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,
translation: itebulo ne fibombelo fyaliko, icakutekapo ifisaniko ca golide wine wine ne fibombelo fyaciko fyonse, ubulambo bwa bubani,

english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
translation: ubulambo bwakocelapo amalambo yakoca ne fibombelo fyabuko, umusambilo ne cakuutekapo.

english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
translation: Ilyo abantu bamwene ukuti Mose akokola nganshi pa lupili ukwabula ukubwela, baile longana kuli Aroni balamweba abati, “Ale tupangile imilungu yakuti iletutangilila, pantu tatwishibe icaponena ulya Mose uwatufumishe mu Egupto.”

english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
translation: Kanshi nomba ndekafye, nimbafulilwa nganshi ndebalofya. Elyo iwe nkakucita umushobo ukalamba.”

english: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
translation: Lelo Mose apapete Yawe, Lesa wakwe, ati, “Bushe cinshi we Yawe wafulilwa nganshi abantu bobe abo wafumishe mu calo ca Egupto ku bulamba bobe no kuboko kobe ukwamaka?

english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.
translation: Bushe abena Egupto teti batile, akwete amapange yabi eco abafumishe mu Egupto, pakuti akaye bepaila ku mpili no kubalofya mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse? Ala bwesha umutima, wileta ne cinkunka ico upangile ukucita abantu bobe.

english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
translation: Awe Yawe abweseshe umutima, kabili akaana no konaula abantu bakwe ngefyo apangile ukucita.

english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
translation: Mose apilibwike alatentemuka no lupili ninshi nasenda mu minwe yakwe amabwe yabili ayapapatala aya cipangano, apalembelwe amafunde ku mbali shonse shibili, kunuma elyo na kuntanshi.

english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
translation: Ilyo Yoshua aumfwa uko abantu balecita icongo, aeba Mose ati, “Ndeumfwa icongo ca lubuli mu nkambi.”

english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
translation: Mose ayasuka ati,

english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
translation: Nomba ilyo Mose apaleme ku nkambi no kumona iciponti ca ŋombe na balecinda, afulwa nganshi. Awe aposa na mabwe asendele mu minwe, ayatobaula no kutobaula lwa mwisamba lya lupili.

english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
translation: Aroni abaswike ati, “Fuuleni amasikiyo aya golide ku bakashi benu, ku bana benu abaume na banakashi, mulete kuli ine.”

english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
translation: Kabili abuula iciponti ca ŋombe ico bapangile, acoca mu mulilo. Elyo acipela caba ngo lukungu, anyunya pa menshi, anwesha na bena Israeli.

english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
translation: Elyo aipusha Aroni ati, “Bushe cinshi ico abantu bakucitile epakuti uleke bacite ububifi ubwakula ifi?”

english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
translation: Aroni nao ayaswike ati, “Ala we mfumu yandi wifulwa. Iwe walishiba ifyo aba bantu baobelwa kukubifya.

english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
translation: Banjebele abati, ‘Tatwishibe icaponena ulya Mose atufumishe mu Egupto. Kanshi tupangile imilungu iyakuti iletutangilila.’

english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
translation: Eco kanshi nabebele nati, ‘Onse uukwete ifisamo ifyakuiyemfya ifya golide afuule. Awe nabo bampeela, na ine nafiposa mu mulilo elyo mwafuma neci ciponti ca ŋombe.’”

english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),
translation: Mose amwene ukuti abantu nabafulungana, no walekele ukuti bafulungane ni Aroni, kabili na balwani babo balebaseka.

english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
translation: Mose epakuya iminina pa mpongolo ya nkambi, asosa ati, “Bonse abo abali ku lubali lwakwa Yawe nabese kuli ine.” Awe na bena Levi bonse balongana uko ali.

english: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
translation: Nao abeba ati, “Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, nasosa ati, ‘Umwaume onse apikile ulupanga, elyo mucilinganye inkambi ukufuma ku lutwe lumo muye fika ku lubiye no kubweluluka cila umo epaye munyina, icibusa cakwe elyo no mwina mupalamano wakwe.’”

english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
translation: Isham 12:28

english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”
translation: Elyo Mose asosa ati, “Imwe mu bushiku bwa lelo mwapatwilwa kuli Yawe, pantu namwipaya abana benu abaume na bamunyinenwe abaume kanshi eco Yawe amupaalila ubushiku bwa lelo.”

english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
translation: Awe abantu bonse epakufuula ku matwi amasikiyo aya golide, batwala na kuli Aroni.

english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Mose aebele abantu ati, “Namubifya apakalamba nganshi. Nomba ine nalaya nina ulupili kuli Yawe, nalimo kuti naya mufutilako pa kubifya kwenu.”

english: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakubwelela kuli Yawe amweba ati, “Iyee, aba bantu nababifya apakalamba nganshi. Nabaipangila abene imilungu ya golide.

english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
translation: Lelo nomba napapata, babeleleniko uluse pa bubifi bwabo. Lelo nga teifyo, ninshi ufuute ishina lyandi mu citabo walilemba.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
translation: Yawe nao ayasuka Mose ati, “Awe, uo ndefuuta mu citabo candi ni uyo onse uumbifishe.

english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
translation: Ale nomba kabiye katungulule abantu ku ncende nakwebele, na malaika wandi alekutungulula. Lelo ilyo inshita yakuti ine nkabakande ikafika, nkabakandilapo pali ubu bubifi bwabo.”

english: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
translation: Elyo Yawe aponeshe icikuko pa bantu pa mulandu wa fintu bacitile ku ciponti ca ŋombe cintu Aroni apangile.

english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
translation: Aroni nao afibuula afyengulula, apangamo icapala iciponti ca ŋombe. Elyo abantu basosa ati, “Iyi e milungu yobe we Israeli iyakufumishe mu Egupto!”

english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
translation: Ilyo Aroni amwene ifi, akuulile no bulambo pa ntanshi ya ciponti ca ŋombe ica golide, abila ne mbila ati, “Mailo kukabe inshikunkulu yakucindika Yawe.”

english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo abantu baimine ulucelocelo, balaleka amalambo yakoca, batuula ne mitulo yakwampana. Kabili baikele panshi balalya no kunwa elyo baima balayangala bubi bubi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
translation: Kol 10:7

english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
translation: Nabaluka bwangu bwangu ukufuma kufyo nabakonkomeshe, nabaipangila akalubi mu cipasho ca ciponti ca ŋombe. Balekafukamina no kukocela amalambo baleti nokuti, ‘Iyi e milungu yobe we Israeli iyakufumishe mu Egupto.’”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
translation: Yawe kabili aebele Mose ati, “Nimona, aba bantu ni bankosa mitwe.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Fumeni pali ino ncende iwe pamo na bantu abo wafumishe mu calo ca Egupto. Kabiyeni ku calo ico nalaile no mulapo kuli Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo ukuti nkacipeela ku ba mu lupwa lwenu.

english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
translation: Ilyo lyonse abantu bamona intumba ye kumbi yacinga pa mwinshi we tenti, baleiminina bonse cila umo pa mwinshi we tenti lyakwe no kupepa.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
translation: Yawe alelanda na Mose, ninshi nabaloshanya amenso, nga filya umuntu alanda na cibusa wakwe. Ilyo Mose alebwelela ku nkambi, umulumendo Yoshua mwana Nuni kalume wakwe wena aleshala mwitenti.

english: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
translation: Mose aebele Yawe ati, “Ulenjeba auti, ‘Tungulula aba bantu,’ lelo tawanjeba uo ukatuma tukaye nankwe. Kabili naulanda ukuti walinjishiba ne shina elyo nokuti ine nalikusekesha.

english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
translation: Kanshi ine nga nalikusekesha, nsambilisha imibeele yobe pakuti nkwishibe no kukusekesha. Wilaba nokuti uyu mushobo wa bantu bobe.”

english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
translation: Yawe ayasuka ati, “Ukubapo kwandi kwakulaya nobe kabili nakulakupeela ukutuusha.”

english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
translation: Elyo Mose amweba ati, “Nga cakuti ukubapo kobe takwakulaya na ifwe ninshi witufumya pano.

english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
translation: Bushe umuntu onse kuti aishiba shani ukuti ine nalikusekesha pamo na bantu bobe, kanofye nga cakuti twalaya na iwe? Ukubapo na ifwe kwena kukalalanga ukuti ine na bantu bobe twaliba abaibela ku bantu bambi bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
translation: Yawe nao aebele Mose ati, “Nkacita ico cine cintu iwe unombele ukucita, pantu iwe walinsekesha kabili nalikwishiba ne shina.”

english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
translation: Elyo Mose epakweba Yawe ati, “Napapata shi wingananga ubucindami bobe.”

english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
translation: Kabili Yawe amwasuka ati, “Nalaleka ubusuma bwandi bonse bupite pa cinso cobe, kabili ndebila ne shina lyandi pa cinso cobe ukuti nine Yawe. Ine mbelela uluse uo ndefwaya ukubelela uluse, nangulukila uo ndefwaya ukulangulukila.”

english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
translation: Nkatuma malaika uwakumutangilila elyo nkatamfya abena Kenani, abena Amoli, abena Hiti, abena Perisi, abena Hifi elyo na bena Yebusi.

english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
translation: Lelo Yawe amweba ati, “Teti iwe umone icinso candi, pantu takuli uwingamona ine no kuba umumi.”

english: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
translation: Kabili Yawe atila, “Mona, pano ine ndi pali incende mupepi apo wingeminina pa cilibwe.

english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;
translation: Ilyo ubucindami bwandi bwalaisa mukupita, ine ndeisa kubika mu lucengo lwa cilibwe, ndeisa kufimba no lupi lwandi mpaka mpitepo.

english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
translation: Elyo ndeisa fumyapo ulupi lwandi, pakuti wise umonekofye inuma yandi. Lelo icinso candi cena tacifwile ukumonwa.”

english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
translation: Kabiyeni ku calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci. Lelo ine nshaye na imwe, pantu muli bankosa mitwe epali namulofesha mu nshila.”

english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
translation: Ilyo abantu baumfwile aya mashiwi ayakali, bapumapo imisowa, kabili tapali nangu umo uwafwele nelyo cimo icakumuyemfya.

english: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
translation: Pantu Yawe aebele Mose ukweba abena Israeli ati, “Imwe muli bankosa mitwe, nga twaendele na imwe nangufye akashita akanono, ine kuti namulofya. Kanshi nomba fuuleni ifyakumuyemfya fyenu na ine ndepingula ifyakumucita.”

english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakufuula ifyakubayemfya fyabo pa lupili lwa Holebu, kabili tababalile abafifwala.

english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
translation: Nomba Mose alefumishe tenti kunse ya nkambi akatalamukila, eko alelimika. Aleita ili tenti “Itenti Lyakukumaninamo.” Uyo onse uulefwaya ukwipusha fimo kuli Yawe, eko aleya kuli ili Itenti Lyakukumaninamo ilyali kunse ya nkambi.

english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
translation: Ilyo lyonse Mose alefuma mwitenti, abantu bonse baleima baiminina pa minshi ya matenti yabo balelolesha Mose mpakafye aingila na mwitenti.

english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.
translation: Ilyo Mose aingila mwitenti, intumba ye kumbi yaisa cinga na pa mwinshi we tenti ilyo Yawe alelanda na Mose.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Basa amabwe yabili ayapapatala ayapala yalya yene ayantanshi, na ine nkalembapo amashiwi yalya yene yali pa mabwe yantanshi yantu watobele.

english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Ine napanga icipangano na iwe. Pa menso ya bantu bobe bonse epo ndi nokucitila ifipeshamano ifishatala aficitwa mu mushobo nangu umo uwa pano isonde. Abantu mwikala nabo bonse bakamona imilimo yakutiinya intu ine ne Yawe nkamucitila.

english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
translation: Mulesunga ifyo namukonkomesha mu bushiku bwa lelo. Ine nkamufulumwina abena Amoli, abena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi.

english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;
translation: Mukabe abacenjela, mwikalacita icipangano na bakaya ba mu calo muleyamo, pantu bakesa ba iciteyo kuli imwe.

english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;
translation: Mukabongolole ifibumbili fya malambo fyabo, mukatobolole na mabwe yabo bacindikisha, mukaputaule ne nceshi sha Ashera, umulungu wabo.

english: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
translation: Tecakwesha ukulapepa umulungu umbi, pantu ishina lyakwa Yawe ni Bufuba, ni Lesa wabufuba.

english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;
translation: Amalu 86:15

english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
translation: Kabili ilyo mwabuula abana babo abanakashi no kubofya ku bana benu abaume, elyo abo bana babo abanakashi balacita bucilende bwa mukupepa imilungu yabo, bakalenga na bana benu abaume ukulacita bucilende bwa mukupepa imilungu yabo.

english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
translation: Nehem 9:17

english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
“All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
translation: “Conse icabalilapo ukufyalwa kuli nyina candi, pamo pene na mabeli yonse ayalume ya fitekwa fyonse aya ŋombe nangu impaanga.

english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
translation: Ukaipekanye mailo ulucelo, kabili ukanine ulupili lwa Sinai mailo ulucelo, ukese kuli ine palya pene pa mulu wa lupili.

english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
translation: Ibeli lyakwa punda mukalilubule pakuleka umwana wa mpaanga. Nga tamulilubwile ninshi mukalifune umukoshi. Mukalelubula abana benu bonse abaume amabeli.

english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
translation: “Ulebomba mu nshiku mutanda shonse, lelo pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali pena ufwile ukutuusha. Nangufye ni mu nshita yakulima nangu ukulobolola ufwile ukutuusha.

english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
translation: “Ukalesefya inshikunkulu ya milungu mukutuula iŋanu shantanshi mwalobolola, ukalesefya ne nshikunkulu yakulonganika ifisabo pa kupwa kwa mwaka.

english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
translation: Imiku itatu cila mwaka abaume benu bonse bafwile ukwisa monekela pa cinso ca Mfumu Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli.

english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.
translation: Amaf 4:24

english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.
translation: “Wilantuula mulopa we lambo pamo pene na conse icilimo intutumushi. Kabili wikalaleka icipande ca nama ye lambo ye Pasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, cishale mpaka ukufika na ku lucelo.

english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Lemba aya mashiwi pantu ukulingana na ya mashiwi natupanga nobe icipangano pamo na bena Israeli bene.”

english: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
translation: Mose ali kulya pamo na Yawe inshiku amakumi yane (40) akasuba no bushiku, ukwabula ukulya umukate nangu ukunwa amenshi. Kabili alembele pa mabwe ayapapatala amashiwi ya cipangano, amafunde ikumi limo.

english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
translation: Ilyo Mose atentemwike ulupili lwa Sinai, ninshi nasenda amabwe ya cipangano yabili mu minwe yakwe, taishibe ukuti impumi yakwe ilebengeshima pantu acilanda na Lesa.

english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
translation: Wikaleka muntu nangu umo akakukonke nangu ukumonekela apali ponse pa lupili. Ne fitekwa fine ifinono ne fikulu fikalaliila mupepi no lupili.”

english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
translation: Aroni na bena Israeli bonse pakumona impumi yakwa Mose ilebengeshima, baiketwe no mwenso bafilwa no kumupalama.

english: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
translation: Lelo Mose epakubeta. Kanshi Aroni ne ntungulushi sha mu lukuta epakuya mupalama, nao alalanda nabo.

english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
translation: Panuma abena Israeli bonse baisa mupalamina, elyo abapeela amafunde yonse Yawe amwebele pa lupili lwa Sinai.

english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
translation: Ilyo Mose apwa ukulanda nabo, abuula insalu afimba na pa mpumi yakwe.

english: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
translation: Lelo lyonse ilyo Mose aingila mwi Tenti pa cinso cakwa Yawe kukulanda nankwe, lyena alefimbulapo insalu mpaka afumamo. Kabili aleti nga afumamo aleeba ulukuta lwa bena Israeli ifyo bamukonkomeshe.

english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
translation: Abena Israeli nabo balemona impumi yakwe nakabili ilebengeshima. Eco Mose alefimba pa mpumi yakwe mpaka ilyo akaya mukulanda na Yawe.

english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakubasa amabwe yabili ayapapatala ayali nga yalya yene ayantanshi. Kabili ulucelocelo aya nina no lupili lwa Sinai nga fintu Yawe amukonkomeshe, nasenda na mabwe yabili mu minwe yakwe.

english: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.
translation: Yawe nao aikile mwikumbi, aisa iminina nankwe apo ali, abila ne shina lyakwe ati nine Yawe.

english: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
translation: Kabili Yawe apitile pantanshi yakwa Mose alebilikisha ati, “Nine Yawe, nine Yawe, Lesa uwaluse ne cikuku, uushifulwa bwangu, uwacitemwiko icishipwa, kabili uwacishinka.

english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
translation: Ntwalilila ukulanga icitemwiko icishipwa ku makana na makana ya bantu, no kubabelela uluse pali bucisanguka, bumpulamafunde no bubifi. Lelo nshilekafye bampulamafunde ukwabula ukukandwa, ndakanda abana babo na beshikulu babo ukufika ku nkulo yalenga butatu ne yalenga bune, pa mulandu wa bubifi bwa bashibo.”

english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
translation: Amaf 5:9-10

english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.
translation: Mose alongenye ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli pamo, abeba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe amukonkomesha ukulacita.

english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:
translation: “Abo bonse muli imwe abacenjela mukupanga ifintu, bali nokwisa panga ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe akonkomesha.

english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
translation: Bakapange Itenti lyakwa Lesa, itenti line ne cakufimbako, imikofyo, impanda, imyalo, inceshi elyo no twakwimikamo impanda,

english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
translation: Ukuf 23:12

english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;
translation: elyo itebulo kumo kwine ne fimuti fyakulipingilako, ifibombelo fyaliko fyonse ne mikate yakuba pa cinso cakwa Lesa,

english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
translation: icakutekapo ifisaniko fyakupeela ulubuuto ne fibombelo fyaciko fyonse, ifisaniko kumo kwine na mafuta ya mu fisaniko,

english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
translation: kabili no bulambo bwakocelapo ububani ne fimuti fyakubupingila, amafuta yakusuba, ububani ubwanunka ubusaka ne cisalu ca pa mwinshi we Tenti lyakwa Lesa,

english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;
translation: elyo no bulambo bwakulekelapo amalambo yakoca ne ca mukuba icafipunda ngo lunyungo, pamo ne fimuti fyakubupingilako ne fibombelo fyabuko fyonse, umusambilo wa mukuba ne cakuutekapo,

english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
translation: insalu shakukupa ku lupango lwa lubansa, inceshi no twakushimikamo, elyo ne cisalu ca pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa,

english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;
translation: impopo sha kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa ne sha ku lupango lwa lubansa ne myando yashiko,

english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”
translation: insalu ishapikulwa ubusaka shakwa shimapepo ishakufwala ilyo alebomba mu Muputule wamushilo, shonse pamo ne nsalu shamushilo shakwa Aroni shimapepo ne sha bana bakwe abaume shakubombelamo umulimo wa bushimapepo.”

english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
translation: Mukalebomba imilimo mu nshiku mutanda, lelo ubushiku ubwalenga cine lubali bwena bukaleba ubwamushilo, Isabata lyakwa Yawe ilyakutuushamo. Uyo onse uukabombamo umulimo uuli onse akepaiwe.

english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
translation: Elyo ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse lwafumine apali Mose.

english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.
translation: Abo bonse abali no mutima wakupeela, abaume na banakashi cimo cine, baletele ifisamo ifyakuiyemfya ifya golide ifyalekana lekana: Imikofyo, amasikiyo, imbalaminwe elyo ne fyakuiyemfya. Umuntu onse kabili afipeele ngo mutuulo wa golide uwa cakutambika kuli Yawe.

english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
translation: Onse uwakwete ubushishi ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee, ne nsalu ishabuuta ubusaka, amasako ya mbushi, ne mpapa sha basukusuku ishatumpikwa mu muti uwakashika, ne mpapa ishisuma ishatelela aliletele.

english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
translation: Abo abakwete silifa nangu mukuba baliletele ngo mutuulo wakwa Yawe, kabili nabo bene abakwete imbao sha muti wa akasia ishingabomba ku mulimo uuli onse baliletele.

english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
translation: Abanakashi bonse abacenjela ukupyata ubushishi ku minwe baletele ubushishi bapyatile ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila, ubwakashika cee no bwabuuta ubusaka.

english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
translation: Elyo abanakashi bonse abali no mutima wakubomba kabili abacenjela nganshi bapyatile amasako ya mbushi.

english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;
translation: Intungulushi nasho shaletele utumabwe twa onikisi no tumabwe twamutengo tumbi utwakwikasha pali efodi na pali tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
translation: Kabili shaletele ifya cena icisuma na mafuta ya miolifa yakusanika mu cisaniko no kubika mu mafuta ya kusuba no kubika mu bubani ubwanunka ubusaka.

english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.
translation: Abena Israeli, abaume na banakashi, bonse abali no mutima wakupeela baletele kuli Yawe imituulo yakuitemenwa iyakubomfya ku milimo yonse Yawe akonkomeshe ukupitila muli Mose.

english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
translation: Mwikalakosha mulilo konse uko muleikala pa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
translation: Elyo Mose aebele abena Israeli ati, “Moneni, Yawe alisonta Besaleli mwana Uri, mwishikulu Huri uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
translation: Kabili alimwisushamo Umupashi wakwa Lesa, ukucenjela, ukwishiba elyo na mano yakupanga ifya misango yonse.

english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
translation: Akalaelenganya ifyakupanga bwino ifya golide ne fya silifa ne fya mukuba,

english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
translation: elyo ne fyakuputula amabwe no kuyekasha, ifyakubasa ifimuti ne fyakupanga panga ifya misango yonse.

english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
translation: Kabili Yawe alipeela bonse babili Besaleli na Oliabu mwana Aisamaki uwa mu luko lwakwa Dani amano yakufundako bambi.

english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
translation: Yawe alibesushamo amano ayakubomba imilimo iya misango yonse, ayakupanga panga ifintu, na ya belenganya umwakucitila ifintu, na ya bacenjela nganshi mu fyakupikula no bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee, na ya baishiba ifyakupikula ne nsalu ishabuuta ubusaka. Aba bonse e bantu abacenjela mu fyakupanga panga na mukwelenganya umwakucitila ifintu.”

english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
translation: Mose aeba ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomesha.

english: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
translation: Ukufuma pafyo mwakwata musangwilepo Yawe umutuulo. Uyo onse uuli no mutima wakupeela kuli Yawe umutuulo kuti aleta golide, silifa no mukuba,

english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
translation: kabili ubushishi ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee, insalu ishabuuta ubusaka, amasako ya mbushi,

english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
translation: impapa sha basukusuku ishatumpwa mu muti uwakashika, impapa ishisuma ishatelela, ne mbao sha muti wa akasia,

english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
translation: elyo na mafuta ya miolifa ayakusanika mu cisaniko, ne fya cena cisuma ifyakubika mu mafuta yakusuba na mu bubani ubwanunka ubusaka,

english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
translation: kabili no tumabwe twa onikisi elyo no tumabwe tumbi utwamutengo utwakubilila pa cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi na pakati ka tumba wa pa cifuba.”

english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
translation: “Eico Besaleli, Oliabu na bantu abo Yawe apeela amano no kucenjela mukubomba umulimo wakupanga icifulo camushilo, bakabombe uyu mulimo ukulingana ngefyo Yawe akonkomesha.”

english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
translation: Insalu shisano balishilundinkenye, elyo na shimbi shisano bashilundinkanya.

english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
translation: Elyo ku mpela ya nsalu babalilepo ukulundinkanya bapangileko imikobelo yacifufya konse konse mumbali yafiko lwa mubwipi, kabili efyo bacitile na ku mpela ya nsalu shimbi isho balundinkenye.

english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
translation: Ku nsalu babalilepo ukulundinkanya babikileko imikobelo amakumi yasano (50), elyo na ku ibiye nako babikileko imikobelo amakumi yasano (50). Imikobelo ya fipande fyonse fibili yali iyalungatana.

english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
translation: Kabili bapangile no twakukofyamo twa golide amakumi yasano (50), eto babomfeshe pakulundinkanya ifyo fipande fibili, epakuti Itenti lyakwa Lesa libe icintu cimofye.

english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
translation: Bapikwile ne nsalu ikumi na imo (11) ku masako ya mbushi ishakufimba kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
translation: Insalu shonse ikumi na imo shali ishalingana mubutali na mubwipi. Mubutali shali amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30) elyo mubwipi namo amakubiti yane .

english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
translation: Insalu shisano balundinkanya ukuba cimo, elyo na shimbi mutanda nasho balundinkanya cimo.

english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
translation: Kabili bapangileko imikobelo amakumi yasano (50) kumpela ya nsalu babalilepo ukulundinkanya, elyo bacitile na kumpela ya nsalu shimbi balundinkenye.

english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
translation: Bapangile utwakukofyamo utwa mukuba amakumi yasano (50) utwakulundinkanya ifipande fibili pakuti Itenti libe icintu cimofye.

english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
translation: Kabili bapangile icakufimba pe Tenti ku mpapa sha basukusuku no kushitumpa mu muti uwakashikafye. Kabili bapangilepo icakufimbapo na cimbi ku mpapa ishisuma ishatelela.

english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
translation: Elyo Mose aitile Besaleli, Oliabu na bantu bonse abacenjela abo Yawe apeele aya mano, abali no mutima wakuipeelesha kukwisa bomba umulimo.

english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
translation: Bapangileko impanda sha cimuti ca akasia ishakwimikilako Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
translation: Cila lupanda lwalepele amakubiti ikumi limo, elyo mubufumo namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
translation: Ku mpela ya cila lupanda babashileko utuntu tubili utwakulundinkanishishako ku lupanda lunankwe. Ifi efyo babashile impanda shonse ishe Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ke Tenti lyakwa Lesa babashileko impanda amakumi yabili.

english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
translation: Kabili bapangilemo no twakwimikamo impanda utwa silifa amakumi yane. Kuli cila lupanda tubili, emukuti kamo kali nokuba pesamba lya kakulundinkanishishako.

english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kuso ke Tenti lyakwa Lesa ku lubali lubiye babashileko impanda amakumi yabili (20).

english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translation: Kabili bapangile no twakwimikamo impanda utwa silifa amakumi yane (40), emukuti tubili pesamba lya cila lupanda.

english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
translation: Kunuma ye Tenti lwa ku masamba babashileko impanda mutanda,

english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
translation: elyo mu matungi ya kunuma yabili ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa namo babashilemo impanda shibili.

english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
translation: Impanda sha mu matungi aya yabili shali ishapapikana ukufuma panshi ukufika na pamulu pa mukobelo uwakushikasha. Impanda sha mu matungi yonse yabili efyo shali.

english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
translation: Mose abapeele umutuulo abena Israeli baletele uwakubomfya ku mulimo wakupanga icifulo camushilo. Awe abena Israeli abali no mutima wakupeela bakonkenyepofye ukuleta imituulo yakuitemenwa cila lucelo.

english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
translation: Kanshi kwali ne mpanda cine konse konse no twakushimikamo utwa silifa ikumi limo na mutanda (16), tubili pesamba lya cila lupanda.

english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
translation: Kabili babashile imyalo ku cimuti ca akasia. Isano yali lubali lumo ku mpanda sha kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
translation: Imyalo imbi isano yali ku lubali lubiye ulwe Tenti lyakwa Lesa, elyo na imbi isano yali ku mpanda sha kunuma ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa lwa ku masamba.

english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
translation: Bapanga umwalo wa pakati uwakucilinganya pa mpanda ukufuma ku lutwe lumo no kufika ku lubiye.

english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
translation: Ku mpanda shonse balambatikeko golide, kabili bapangile ne mikobelo ya golide umwakupisha imyalo, elyo na ku myalo iyine balambatikeko golide.

english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
translation: Bapikwile ne cisalu icakucingako ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka. Umuntu uwacenjela ukupikula apikwilemo na bakerubi.

english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
translation: Bacipangile inceshi shine ku cimuti ca akasia kabili balambatikeko na golide. Bapangileko ne mikofyo ya golide, kabili baengele no twakushimikamo utwa silifa tune.

english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
translation: Pa mwinshi wakwingililapo mwi Tenti, apikwililapo icisalu ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka na ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee. Umuntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula ewabombele.

english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
translation: Kabili babashile inceshi shisano, bapangileko ne mikofyo. Pa mulu wa nceshi balambatikepo golide elyo na ku tufyela twa ku nceshi. Bapangile ne fyakwimikamo inceshi shisano ifya mukuba.

english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
translation: Kanshi balya bantu bonse abacenjela mu fyakupanga panga, abalebomba umulimo wakupanga icifulo camushilo, bashile imilimo yabo

english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
translation: no kuya kuli Mose bamweba abati, “Ifintu abantu baleleta naficila pa filefwaikwa ku mulimo Yawe akonkomeshe.”

english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
translation: Elyo Mose akonkomeshe abantu, nabo basalanganya amashiwi mu nkambi yonse abati, “Kwiba umwaume nangu mwanakashi onse uwakupeela ifyamutuulo na fimbi ifyakupangila icifulo camushilo.” Abantu kanshi epakuleka ukulatwalilapo na fimbi,

english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
translation: pantu ifyo bapeele kale fyalicilile pa fyalefwaikwa ku mulimofye onse.

english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
translation: Abantu bonse abacenjeleseshe pali abo abalebomba, bapangile Itenti lyakwa Lesa ku nsalu ikumi ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka no bushishi bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee, kabili shapikwilwepo na bakerubi ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula.

english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
translation: Insalu shonse shali ishalingana mubutali na mubwipi. Mubutali shalepele amakubiti amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28) elyo mubwipi namo amakubiti yane .

english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
translation: Besaleli apangile Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ku cimuti ca akasia. Mubutali yali amakubiti yabili na citika, mubufumo kubiti umo na citika elyo ukuya mumulu namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
translation: Besaleli kabili apangile itebulo ku cimuti ca akasia. Mubutali lyali amakubiti yabili, mubufumo namo kubiti umo, elyo ukuya mumulu namo kubiti umo na citika .

english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
translation: Elyo alambatikeko na golide wine wine, kabili ashingulwisheko no mushingo wa golide.

english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
translation: Mu mpela ye tebulo ashingulwishemo imbao ishapapatala mubufumo ngo lupi lwa muntu. Ku mbao ashingulwishisheko umushingo wa golide.

english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
translation: Kabili apangile imikobelo ine kuli golide uwalopolwa, ayengelela na ku matungi apabela imikonso ye tebulo.

english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
translation: Imikobelo yakupishamo ifimuti fyakupingilako itebulo yabelele mupepi ne mbao yapapatala.

english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
translation: Abashile ifimuti fyakupingilako itebulo ku cimuti ca akasia, kabili alambatikeko na golide.

english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
translation: Kabili apangile ifipe fyakubomfya kwitebulo, imbale, utubale utwasenama, inkunku ne nweno ifyakwitulwilako imituulo ya fyakunwa. Ifipe fyonse ifi afipangile kuli golide wine wine.

english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
translation: Apangile ne cakutekapo ifisaniko ica golide wine wine. Icikalilo caciko pamo no mukonso waciko afifulilefye ku nondo. Tukapu utwapala amaluba ya alumondi ayakwata ifitutu na mabula ye luba line fili nokuba icintu cimofye ne cikalilo.

english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
translation: Icakutekapo ifisaniko cali ne misambo mutanda, ku lubali lumo itatu ku lubali lubiye nako itatu.

english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
translation: Ku musambo umo kwali tukapu tutatu utwapala amaluba ya alumondi ayakwata ifitutu na mabula ye luba line. Elyo na pa musambo wakonkelepo acita ifyo fine. Kabili na ku misambo mutanda iya cakutekapo ifisaniko napo acitile ifyo fine.

english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
translation: Alambatikeko na golide wine wine mukati na kunse, abikileko no mushingo wa golide ukushinguluka.

english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
translation: Pa cakutekapo ifisaniko pali tukapu tune utwapala amaluba ya alumondi ayakwata ifitutu na mabula ye luba line.

english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
translation: Kabili ifitutu fye luba limo fyali mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyapakubala, fimbi mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyakonkapo elyo fimbi mwisamba lya misambo ibili iyacitatu ngo mwabele imisambo mutanda iya cakutekapo ifisaniko.

english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
translation: Ifitutu pamo pene ne misambo fyali icintu cimofye ne cakutekapo ifisaniko ifyafulwa ku nondo kuli golide wine wine.

english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
translation: Apangile ifisaniko cine lubali pamo ne fyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto no tubale utwasenama kuli golide wine wine,

english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
translation: Apangile ne cakutekapo ifisaniko ne fibombelo fyaciko fyonse kuli golide wine wine uwe talanta limo .

english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
translation: Apangile ubulambo bwakocapo ububani ku cimuti ca akasia. Bwali ubwalingana monse monse mubutali na mubwipi kubiti umo, elyo ukufuma panshi ukufika pamulu bwali amakubiti yabili . Insengo no bulambo fyabashilwe ku cimuti cimo cine pakuti fibe icintu cimofye.

english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
translation: Alambatikeko golide wine wine pamulu ponse, mumbali monse na ku nsengo sha bulambo. Apangileko no mushingo wa golide ukushinguluka.

english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
translation: Apangileko ne mikobelo ya golide ibili. Pesamba lya mushingo ku mbali shibili sha bulambo ishalolenkene aikesheko imikobelo ibili umwakupisha ifimuti fyakupingilako.

english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
translation: Abashileko ne fimuti fyakupingilako ku cimuti ca akasia, alambatikeko na golide.

english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
translation: Apangile na mafuta yamushilo ayakusuba, no bubani ubwanunka ubusaka, ubwasakanishiwa ubusaka nga ku muntu uwacenjela ukusakanya ifyanunka ubusaka.

english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
translation: Apanga imikobelo ine kuli golide uwalopolwa no kuyengelela ku mikonso ine, ulubali lumo ibili no lubali lubiye nalo ibili.

english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
translation: Elyo abashile ifimuti fyakupingilako ku cimuti ca akasia kabili alambatikeko na golide.

english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
translation: Apishishe ifi fimuti mu mikobelo ya ku mbali ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano pakupingilako Imbokoshi.

english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
translation: Apangilepo ne Nkupiko ya golide wine wine apakufutilwa ifyabubifi. Mubutali yali amakubiti yabili na citika, elyo mubufumo namo kubiti umo .

english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
translation: Elyo afulilepo na bakerubi babili aba golide ku mpela shonse isha Nkupiko.

english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
translation: Umo amwengelele ku mpela imo elyo na umbi ku mpela ibiye. Abengelele ku mpela shibili isha Nkupiko pakuti bakerubi babefye cimo ne nkupiko.

english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
translation: Bakerubi bali na mapindo ayayansa ukulola mumulu ayacinga pa Nkupiko. Bakerubi baloshenye amenso, bali kwati balelolesha pa Nkupiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi.

english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
translation: Besaleli apangile no bulambo bwa malambo yakoca ku cimuti ca akasia. Bwali ubwalingana mubutali na mubufumo amakubiti yasano, elyo ukuya mumulu namo amakubiti yatatu .

english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
translation: Abikileko ne nceshi amakumi yabili (20) isha mukuba ne fyakushimikamo ifya mukuba amakumi yabili, ne mikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi ifya silifa.

english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
translation: Lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso nako kwine lwalepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100) . Kwali ne nceshi amakumi yabili isha mukuba ne fyakushimikamo ifya mukuba amakumi yabili, ne mikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi ifya silifa.

english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
translation: Lubali ku masamba lwalepele amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) . Kabili lwakupilweko ne nsalu, kwali ne nceshi ikumi limo ne fyakushimikamo ikumi limo, ne mikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi ifya silifa.

english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
translation: Lwa ku kabanga ukutulila akasuba, nako kwine lwalepele amakubiti amakumi yasano (50).

english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
translation: Ku lubali lumo ulwa ku mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa kwali nceshi shitatu ne fyakushimikamo nafyo fitatu ne nsalu yakupileko iyalepele amakubiti ikumi limo na yasano (15) .

english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translation: Kabili ku lubali lubiye lwa lupango lwa lubansa pa mwinshi kwali inceshi shitatu ne fyakushimikamo fitatu, ne nsalu yakupileko iyalepele amakubiti ikumi limo na yasano (15).

english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
translation: Insalu shakupile ku lupango lwa lubansa shonse shali ishabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka.

english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
translation: Ifyakwimikamo inceshi fyali ifya mukuba. Imikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi twali utwa silifa, elyo pa mulu wa nceshi alambatikepo silifa. Kanshi inceshi shonse isha ku lupango lwa lubansa shali no tufyela twa silifa.

english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
translation: Icisalu ca pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa capangilwe ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila, ubwakashika cee ne nsalu yabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka, cintu cabombelwe ku muntu uwacenjela ukupikula. Mubutali calepele amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) elyo, nge nsalu sha lupango lwa lubansa, cali amakubiti yasano ukulola mumulu .

english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
translation: Cakwete ne nceshi shine ne fyakushimikamo ifya mukuba nafyo fine. Imikofyo no tufyela twa ku nceshi fyali ifya silifa, elyo pa mulu wa nceshi alambatikepo silifa.

english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
translation: Apangile insengo mu matungi yane ya bulambo, cila lutungi no lusengo, afipanga ku cimuti cimo pakuti insengo no bulambo fikabe icintu cimofye. Kabili ku bulambo alambatikeko no mukuba.

english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
translation: Impopo shonse isha kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa pamo pene ne sha ku lubansa lwa ku cipango ukushinguluka shali isha mukuba.

english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
translation: Ifi e fintu fyonse babomfeshe pakupanga Itenti lyakwa Lesa, Itenti ilya cipangano. Mose akonkomeshe abena Levi ukufipenda, no walebangalila ni Itama mwana Aroni shimapapepo.

english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Besaleli mwana Uri umwishikulu wakwa Huri, uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda, ewapangile ifintufye fyonse Yawe akonkomeshe Mose ukupanga.

english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
translation: Besaleli ali na Oholiabu mwana Aisamaki uwa mu luko lwakwa Dani uwacenjela mu fyakupanga panga no kwelenganya umwakucitila ifintu, kabili uwacenjela mu fyakupikula no ubushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila, ubwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu yabuuta ubusaka.

english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
translation: Golide onsefye uo babomfeshe mu mulimo wakukuulila icifulo camushilo, ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo, afinine amatalanta amakumi yabili na pabula (29) pamo na mashekeli imyanda cine lubali na makumi yatatu (730) . Abantu bapeele uyu golide ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika.

english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
translation: Silifa balonganike ukufuma ku ba lukuta abapendelwe afinine amatalanta umwanda umo (100) na mashekeli ikana limo imyanda cine lubali na makumi cine lubali na yasano (1,775) ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo.

english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
translation: Umuntu apeele indalama beka umo, ekutila citika we shekeli iyapiminwe ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo iyo bonse abo abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo bali nokupeela nga bapendwa. Abaume abapendelwe bali amakana imyanda mutanda na makana yatatu, imyanda isano na makumi yasano (603,550).

english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
translation: Besaleli abomfeshe silifa uwafina amatalanta umwanda umo (100) pakwenga utwakwimikamo inceshi umwanda umo isha cifulo camushilo ne sha ku cisalu cakucinga. Ku kakwimikamo kamo alebomfya silifa uwafina italanta limo .

english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
translation: Kuli silifa uwashelepo uwafinine amashekeli ikana limo imyanda cine lubali na makumi cine lubali na yasano (1,775) apangileko imikofyo ya ku nceshi, alambatikeko na pa mulu wa nceshi, kabili apangileko no tufyela twa ku nceshi.

english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
translation: Umukuba uwafumine ku mutuulo wa cakutambika wafinine amatalanta amakumi cine lubali (70) na mashekeli amakana yabili ne myanda ine (2,400) .

english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
translation: Apangile ne fyakubomfya ku bulambo fyonse ku mukuba: Inongo, bafosholo, inweno, imitunkwilo ne fyakubikapo umulilo.

english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
translation: Abomfeshe umukuba kukupanga utwakwimikamo inceshi sha ku mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no bulambo bwa mukuba, icafipunda ngo lunyungo ica ku bulambo ica mukuba ne fibombelo fya ku bulambo fyonse,

english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
translation: elyo ne fyakwimikamo inceshi sha ku lupango lwa lubansa ne sha pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa ne mpopo sha kwi Itenti lyakwa Lesa shonse ne sha ku lubansa lonse ulwa cipango.

english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
translation: Kabili apangile ica mukuba icafipunda ngo lunyungo, acibikile pa lubango ulwa pakati ka bulambo ukufuma pamulu.

english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
translation: Apangile ne mikobelo ine ku mukuba uwalopolwa, ayengelele mu matungi yane ya pa cafipunda ngo lunyungo umwakupisha ifimuti fyakupingilako.

english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
translation: Abashile ifyakupingilako ku cimuti ca akasia, alambatikeko no mukuba.

english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
translation: Apishishe ne fimuti fyakupingilako mu mikobelo pakuti fileba mumbali ya bulambo pakubusenda. Apangile ubulambo bwa mbao ubwacenama.

english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Kabili Besaleli apangile umusambilo ne cakuutekapo ifyakufuma ku milolani ya mukuba iya banakashi balebombela pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
translation: Kabili apangileko no lubansa ku cipango ce Tenti lyakwa Lesa. Ulubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo lwalepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100) . Abikileko ne nsalu shabuuta ishapikulwa ubusaka.

english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Kabili Besaleli abilile ne fyakufwala ifyapikulwa no bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee ifyakubomfya ilyo balebomba mu Muputule wamushilo. Babilile ne fyakufwala fyamushilo fyakwa Aroni, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
translation: Kabili baikeshe pali tumba utumabwe twamutengo mu mitande ine. Mu mutande wantanshi babikilemo akalibwe ka rubi na ka topasi na ka bereli.

english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
translation: Mu mutanda wabubili babikilemo akalibwe ka tokisi na ka safile na ka emeradi.

english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation: Mu mutande wabutatu abikilemo akalibwe ka yasinti, aka agate na ka amefisiti.

english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
translation: Mu mutande wabune babikilemo akalibwe ka kirisaliti, aka onikisi na ka yasipeli. Uto tumabwe batubikileko no twapikulwa na waya ya golide.

english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
translation: Utumabwe twali ikumi limo na tubili (12). Kabili pali cila kalibwe pali ishina limo ilyakwa mwana Israeli. Cila kalibwe pafukwilwe kwati cifwatiko ishina limo pa nko ikumi limo na shibili (12) isha bena Israeli.

english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
translation: Bapangile no tuminyololo twa golide wine wine utwapyatwa ngo mwando utwa kuli tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
translation: Bapangile utwapikwilwe na waya ya golide tubili ne mikobelo ya golide ibili, no kwikasha imikobelo ku mpela shibili sha tumba wa pa cifuba.

english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
translation: Elyo bakakilile uto tuminyololo twa golide tubili ku mikobelo ya ku mpela sha tumba.

english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
translation: Impela shibili isha tuminyololo bashikakilile ku mikobelo ibili iya ku twapikwilwe na waya ya golide, kabili bashikakile lwa pantanshi ku mishipi ya pa mabeya iya efodi.

english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
translation: Elyo bapangile imikobelo ya golide ibili, baikeshe na ku mpela shimbi shibili ishabela lwa mukati ka tumba mupepi na efodi.

english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
translation: Apangile efodi icakufwala pa mulu wa mwingila ku bushishi bwa golide, ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee elyo ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka.

english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
translation: Kabili bapangile imikobelo ya golide na imbi ibili. Baikeshe mwisamba lya mishipi ya pa mabeya ya efodi lwa pantanshi mupepi na pa mulu wa palundikanina efodi no mushipi wapikulwa bwino.

english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Bakakile imikobelo ya tumba wa pa cifuba ku mikobelo ya efodi no mwando wa bushishi ubwacifufya pakuti tumba wa pa cifuba alebela pa mulu wa mushipi, talesela pali efodi, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
translation: Besaleli apangile no mwingila wakufwala mukati ka efodi uo bapikwile ku bushishi bwacifufya bweka bwekafye.

english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
translation: Pa cipunda cakupishishamo umutwe alipikwilepo ukushinguluka pakulesha umwingila ukulepuka.

english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
translation: Mu mufukilo wa mwingila bapikwililemo ifitwalo ifyapala amateke ku bushishi bwacifufya no bwakashikila elyo no bwakashika cee, na ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka.

english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
translation: Kabili bapangile no tunyenjele twa golide wine wine batwikasha na pakati ka fitwalo ifyapala amateke ukushinguluka umufukilo wa mwingila.

english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Ukushingulukafye umufukilo wa mwingila wakufwala pakubomba umulimo wa bushimapepo balepushanya apa kanyenjele apa icapala amateke ukushinguluka, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
translation: Kabili bapangile Aroni na bana bakwe abaume imingila ku nsalu ishabuuta ubusaka,
