english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
translation: ne nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe, ifisote fya nsalu ishabuuta ubusaka, pamo na bakaputula bamukati ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka.

english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Ilamba lyapikwilwe ku nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka na ku bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
translation: Bafulile utumalata twa golide utwayangukisha, elyo atusantaula twaba ngo bushishi. Batupikwila kumo no bushishi bwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee mu nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka ku muntu uwacenjele nganshi ukupikula.

english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.
translation: Bapangile akalilata ka golide wine wine akamushilo, bafukwilepo ne filembo nga pa cifwatiko ukuti, “Uwamushilo kuli Yawe”

english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo bakakakile ku katambo kacifufya no kukekasha ku nsalu yakupomba ku mutwe, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.
translation: Kanshi imilimo yonse iyakupanga Itenti lyakwa Lesa ilyakukumaninamo yalipwile. Abena Israeli bacitilefye fyonse ukulingana ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
translation: Kabili baletele kuli Mose Itenti lyakwa Lesa, itenti line pamo ne fibombelo fyaliko fyonse, imikofyo yaliko yonse, impanda, imyalo, inceshi no twakwimikamo,

english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
translation: icakufimba pe tenti ica mpapa sha basukusuku ishatumpwa mu muti uwakashika, ne ca mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, elyo ne cisalu ca pa mwinshi,

english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
translation: Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, ifimuti fyakupingilako fyaiko ne Nkupiko yaiko apakufutilwa ifyabubifi,

english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
translation: itebulo ne fibombelo fyaliko fyonse elyo ne mikate yakuba pa cinso cakwa Lesa,

english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
translation: icakutekapo ifisaniko ica golide wine wine ne fisaniko fyaciko, ifibombelo fyaciko fyonse elyo na mafuta yakusanika,

english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
translation: ubulambo bwa golide, amafuta yakusuba, ububani ubwanunka ubusaka elyo ne cisalu ca pa mwinshi we Tenti,

english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
translation: ubulambo bwa mukuba ne cafipunda ngo lunyungo cabuko ica mukuba, ifimuti fyakubupingilako ne fibombelo fyabuko fyonse, umusambilo elyo ne cakuutekapo,

english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
translation: Kuli efodi babilileko ne mikobelo ku mpela shibili iyakupisha pa mabeya pakucikakanya.

english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
translation: insalu sha ku lupango lwa lubansa, inceshi shaluko ne fyakushimikamo, icisalu ca pa mwinshi wa lupango lwa lubansa, imyando ne mpopo sha ku lupango lwa lubansa, elyo ne fintu fyonse ifyakubomfya mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa, Itenti lyakukumaninamo,

english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
translation: insalu ishapikulwa ubusaka shakufwala pakubomba mu Muputule wamushilo, pamo pene ne nsalu shamushilo ishakwa Aroni shimapepo ne sha bana bakwe abaume, ishakubombelamo umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
translation: Abena Israeli balibombele imilimo yonse ukulingana ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
translation: Elyo Mose alondele imilimo yonse amwene nokuti bacitile fyonse ngefyo umwine Yawe akonkomeshe. Kanshi nao Mose epakubapaala.

english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Umushipi wali nga efodi uwapikulwa ubusaka ku bushishi bwa golide, ubwacifufya, ubwakashikila no bwakashika cee ne nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka, kabili baulundinkenye kuli efodi pakuti fibefye ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
translation: Babikile ku mabwe ya onikisi utwapikulwa na waya ya golide kabili afukwilepo amashina ya bamwana Israeli abaume, kwati ni filya afukula ifilembo pa cifwatiko.

english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo aikeshe aya mabwe pa mishipi ya pa mabeya ya efodi pakuti yaleba ayakwibukishishapo bamwana Israeli, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
translation: Besaleli apikwile na tumba wa pa cifuba ku muntu uwacenjela nganshi ukupikula. Tumba amupikwile nga efodi ku bushishi bwa golide no bwacifufya no bwakashikila no bwakashika cee mu nsalu iyabuuta iyapikulwa ubusaka.

english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
translation: Tumba nga apetwa ali uwalingana mubutali na mubwipi, alepele icisansa cimo monse monse.

english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
translation: Nomba Mose alecema ifitekwa fyakwa shifyala Yeturo, shimapepo wa ku Midiani. Asenda ifitekwa, acilinganya mu matololo, afika na ku Holebu, ku lupili lwakwa Lesa.

english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
translation: Eico nomba isa nkutume kuli Farao kukufumya abantu bandi abena Israeli mu calo ca Egupto.”

english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
translation: Elyo Mose ayaswike Lesa ati, “Nga ine nine ani, uwakuti nje kuli Farao kukufumya abena Israeli mu Egupto?”

english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
translation: Lesa amwasuka ati, “Nkalaba na iwe. Kabili ici cikaba e cishibilo kuli iwe icakuti nine nkutumine. Ilyo ukafumya abantu mu Egupto mukapepela Lesa pali luno lupili.”

english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”
translation: Mose aebele Lesa ati, “Nga naya ku bena Israeli no kubeba ati, ‘Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu nantuma kuli imwe,’ nabo banjipusha abati, ‘Nge shina lyakwe ni nani?’ Bushe nkabasuka shani?”

english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
translation: Lesa ayasuka Mose ati, “Nine UWABAPO. Ukebe abena Israeli auti, ‘UWABAPO euntumine kuli imwe.’”

english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
translation: Lesa aeba Mose nakabili ati, “Webe abena Israeli auti, ‘Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki kabili Lesa wakwa Yakobo euntumine kuli imwe.’ Ili e shina lyandi ilya pe na pe ilyo inkulo shonse shikalanjibukishishako.

english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.
translation: “Kabiye kalonganike abakalamba ba bena Israeli ubebe auti, ‘Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo amonekele kuli ine, anjebele nokuti, “Nalisa mupempula namona nefyo abena Egupto bamucita.

english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
translation: Kabili nimpingula ukumufumya mu Egupto umo balemucusha, no kumutwala mu calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci. Abekalamo bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi.” ’

english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD, our God.’
translation: Abakalamba bakomfwa ifyo ukabeba. Elyo iwe na bakalamba ba bena Israeli mukaye ku mfumu ya Egupto, mukayebe ati, ‘Yawe, Lesa wa Bahibulu, alitukumanya. Eico nomba shi lekeni tuye ulwendo lwa nshiku shitatu mu matololo kukulekela Yawe Lesa wesu amalambo.’

english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
translation: Lelo kwena ninjishiba kuti, imfumu ya Egupto tayakasumine ukuti muye ukwabula ukupatikishiwa no kuboko kwamaka nganshi.

english: The LORD’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
translation: Kulya eko malaika wakwa Yawe amumonekele mu lubingu lwa mulilo ulwalebilima ukufuma mu cimpusa. Mose amona ukuti icimpusa cilebilima lelo tacilepya iyoo.

english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
translation: Nomba nkabomfya ukuboko kwandi ukwamaka nganshi, nkakanda abena Egupto ku fipeshamano fintu nkacita pakati kabo. Lyena panuma imfumu ikamulekamo mukaleya.

english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
translation: “Kabili nkalenga ukuti mukatemwikwe ku bena Egupto, epakuti ilyo mukalaya mwikaya iminwe nkutwa.

english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
translation: Umwanakashi onse umwina Israeli akalombe umwina mupalamano umwina Egupto na onse umwanakashi ekala nankwe mu ŋanda yakwe, ifya silifa na golide ne fyakufwala. Mukafwike abana benu abaume na banakashi. Kanshi efyo mukatapa ifyuma fya bena Egupto.”

english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
translation: Elyo atontonkanya ati, “Kampalameko, uleke ndoleshe icakupapusha ici namona, ico icimpusa cishipilile.”

english: When the LORD saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
translation: Ilyo Yawe amona ukuti Mose alapalama kukumona icimpusa, Lesa amwita ukufuma mu cimpusa ati, “Mose, Mose!” Nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi.”

english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
translation: Lesa amweba ati, “Wipalama kuno. Fuula insapato shobe pantu incende wimininepo ni ncende yamushilo.”

english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
translation: Elyo amweba nokuti, “Nine Lesa wakwa wiso, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki kabili Lesa wakwa Yakobo.” Elyo Mose afimba pa menso pantu aletiina ukulolesha Lesa.

english: The LORD said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
translation: Elyo Yawe asosa ati, “Ninjimwena ne mwine ifyo abantu bandi balecula nganshi mu Egupto. Niŋumfwa no kulila kwabo pa mulandu wa bakangalila wabo, kabili ninjishiba amacushi yabo.

english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
translation: Eico ninjika kukubapususha ku bena Egupto no kubafumya muli ici calo, mbatwale ku calo icafunda, icikalamba, icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci. Abekalamo bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi.

english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
translation: Niŋumfwa nomba ukulila kwa bena Israeli, nimona nefyo balebacusha ku bena Egupto.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
translation: Kabili ukasube amafuta ku bulambo bwakocelapo amalambo na ku fibombelo fyabuko fyonse. Efyo ukantuula ubulambo nabo bukaba ubwamushilo icine cine.

english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
translation: Ukasube no musambilo ne cakuutekapo no kufintuula.

english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
translation: “Elyo ukalete Aroni na bana bakwe abaume pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo ukabasambe na menshi.

english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translation: Ukafwike Aroni insalu shamushilo, ukamusube amafuta no kumutuula pakuti akalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
translation: Ukalete na bana bakwe abaume, ukabafwike ne mingila.

english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
translation: Nabo bene ukabasube amafuta nga filya wasubile shibo pakuti bakalemombela umulimo wa bushimapepo. Nga basubwa bakaba na bushimapepo bwa pe mu nkulo shabo shonse.”

english: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
translation: Awe Mose epakucita fyonse ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
translation: Pa bushiku bwapakubala mu mweshi wakubalilapo mu mwaka wabubili, baimike Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
translation: Mose aimike Itenti, abika utwakwimikamo, aimika impanda, abikako ne myalo, aimika ne nceshi.

english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo akupa insalu pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa, kabili pamulu afimbapo ne tenti lyakunse ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: “Ukemike Itenti lyakwa Lesa Ilyakukumaninamo, pa bushiku bwakubalilapo ubwa mweshi wakubalilapo.

english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
translation: Abuula na mabwe ya Cipangano yabili ayabika na mu Mbokoshi ya Cipangano. Apishisha ne fimuti fyakupingilako mu mikobelo ya Mbokoshi. Akupikapo ne Nkupiko ya kufutilwapo ifyabubifi.

english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo aleta ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa, akobeka ne cisalu cakucingako, elyo cacingilila ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
translation: Kabili Mose abika ne tebulo mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwe Tenti lyakwa Lesa, kunse ya cisalu cakucingako.

english: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Abikapo ne mikate yakuba pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
translation: Abikile ne cakutekapo ifisaniko mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, ukulungatana ne tebulo lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo kwe Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Abikapo ne fisaniko pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
translation: Abika no bulambo bwa golide wine wine mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo lwa pantanshi ya cisalu cakucingako.

english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Kabili afutumwinapo no bubani ubwanunka ubusaka ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
translation: Elyo akobeka ne cisalu ca pa mwinshi we Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Abika no bulambo bwakocelapo amalambo mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa mupepi no mwinshi wa pe Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Alekelapo ilambo lyakoca, atuulapo no mutuulo wa cabunga, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
translation: Ukabikemo ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano elyo ukacingeko icisalu ku Mbokoshi ya Cipangano.

english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
translation: Ukuf 25:30

english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
translation: Umu emo Mose na Aroni na bana bakwa Aroni balesamba iminwe na makasa.

english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Lyonse pakwingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo na pakupalama ku bulambo baletala basamba, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
translation: Elyo Mose acitile ulupango lwa lubansa ukushingulusha Itenti lyakwa Lesa no bulambo, kabili pa mwinshi wa lupango abikapo ne cisalu. Kanshi ifi efyo Mose apwishishishe imilimo yonse.

english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
translation: Elyo ikumbi lyakupile Itenti Lyakukumaninamo, no bucindami bwakwa Yawe bwaisula Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
translation: Awe Mose afilwa no kwingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pantu ikumbi lyalikelepo, elyo no bucindami bwakwa Yawe bwaiswile mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
translation: Nomba ikumbi nga talifuminepo tabaleima no kulaya mpakafye no bushiku likafumapo.

english: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
translation: Ikumbi lyakwa Yawe lyaleba pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa mu nshita ya kasuba, elyo mu nshita ya bushiku mwikumbi mwaleba umulilo, na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse baleumona mu nyendo shabo shonse.

english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
translation: Ukaletelemo itebulo kabili ukabikepo ne fibombelo fyaliko. Elyo ukaletelemo ne cakutekapo ifisaniko, ukabikepo ne fisaniko.

english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
translation: Ukabikemo no bulambo bwa golide bwakufutumwinapo ububani lwa pantanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano. Ukacinge ne nsalu pa mwinshi we Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Ubulambo bwakocelapo amalambo yakoca ukabubike mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
translation: Umusambilo ukaubike pakati, uku ubulambo bwakocelapo amalambo elyo uku nako Litenti Lyakukumaninamo. Ukabikemo na menshi.

english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
translation: Ukashingulusheko no lupango lwa lubansa, ukakobekepo ne cisalu pa mwinshi.

english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
translation: “Elyo ukabuule amafuta yakusuba, ukasube Itenti lyakwa Lesa na fyonse ifyabamo. Efyo ukantuula Itenti na fyonse ifyabamo, nalyo likaba ilyamushilo.

english: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
translation: Mose ayaswike ati, “Nga cakuti bakaana ukunsumina nelyo ukumfwa kuli ine, kabili basosa nokuti, ‘Yawe tamoneke kuli iwe?’”

english: Moses said to the LORD, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
translation: Elyo Mose aeba Yawe ati, “We Mfumu, ine nshaishiba bwino ukulanda, ukutulafye ku kale nangufye ukutula apo mulelandila na ine. Ine nalifina ululimi kabili ndalubantika pakulanda.”

english: The LORD said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, the LORD?
translation: Yawe nao amwasuka ati, “Bushe uwapeela umuntu akanwa nani? Nani alenga umuntu ukuti abe nkomamatwi nangu cibulu? Nani amulenga ukuti alemona nangu ukuti abe mpofu? Bushe teine, ne Yawe?

english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
translation: Kanshi nomba kabiye! Na ine nakulakwafwa ukulanda kabili nakulakweba nefyo uli nokulanda.”

english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
translation: Lelo Mose ayasuka ati, “We Mfumu, napapata tumeniko umbi.”

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
translation: Elyo Yawe afulilwa Mose nganshi, amweba ati, “Bushe tapali munonko Aroni umwina Levi? Nalishiba ukuti wena alalanda bwino. Kabili mona aleisa mukukukumanya. Akasansamuka nganshi pakukumona.

english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
translation: Kanshi eo ukalaeba amashiwi ali nokulanda. Nkalamwafwako bonse babili ukulanda, kabili nkalamulanga ne fyakucita.

english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
translation: Aroni eukalakulandilako ku bantu, eukaba kwati e kanwa kobe, elyo iwe ukaba kwati niwe Lesa wakwe.

english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
translation: Nomba senda inkonto iyo wikete mu minwe, eyo ukalacitilako ifisungusho.”

english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
translation: Kabili Mose alibwelele kuli Yeturo shifyala, amweba ati, “Napapata, lekeni mbwelelemo ku bantu bandi mu Egupto, njemona nga bacili abomi.” Yeturo amweba ati, “Kabiye, wende umutende.”

english: The LORD said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
translation: Ilintu Mose acili mu Midiani, Yawe amweba ati, “Bwelelamo ku Egupto pantu abo bonse balefwaya ukukwipaya balifwa.”

english: The LORD said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
translation: Yawe amwipusha ati, “Cinshi ico wikete mu minwe yobe?” Nao Mose ayasuka ati, “Ni nkonto.”

english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakubuula umukashi wakwe na bana bakwe abaume abaninika na pali punda, aya nabo ku Egupto. Kabili asenda ne nkonto yakwa Lesa mu minwe yakwe.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Ukaye cita ifisungusho fyonse nkupeele amaka yakucita pa cinso cakwa Farao nga wabwelelamo ku Egupto. Lelo nkalenga umutima wakwe ukumalala kabili takaleke na bantu ukuti baleya.

english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘The LORD says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
translation: Elyo ukebe Farao auti, ‘Yawe nasosa ati, Umwana wandi umwaume Israeli e beli lyandi.

english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”
translation: Ninkweba nati, shileka umwana wandi umwaume aleya kukumpepa, nomba naukaana. Eico nomba na ine ndi nokwipaya ibeli lyobe ilyaume.’”

english: On the way at a lodging place, the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him.
translation: Yawe afwaile ukwipaya Mose pa ndo apo amukumenye.

english: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
translation: Lelo Sipora abuula ilibwe ilyatwa asembulwilako ne nkanda ya ku mpela ya mubili wakwa mwane umwaume, akumya ne nkanda pa makasa yakwe no kweba Mose ati, “Cine cine uli mulume wandi uwa ku mulopa.”

english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
translation: Elyo Yawe alekamo Mose. Kabili umukashi wakwe amweba no kumweba ati, “Pa mulandu wakusembululwa, uli mulume wandi uwa ku mulopa.”

english: The LORD said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Aroni ati, “Kabiye uye ukumanye Mose mu matololo.” Nao Aroni aima aya mukumanya pa lupili lwakwa Lesa, amutomona pakumuposha.

english: Moses told Aaron all the LORD’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
translation: Elyo Mose ashimikilako Aroni ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe amutumine kukubeba, ne fisungusho fyonse ifintu amukonkomeshe ukuya cita.

english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
translation: Ukuf 12:29

english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
translation: Yawe amweba ati, “Posa inkonto panshi.” Mose aposa inkonto panshi, nayo yasanguka insoka. Mose abutukako.

english: Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
translation: Elyo Aroni abashimikila fyonse ifyo Yawe aebele Mose. Kabili Mose acita ne fisungusho fyonse pa cinso ca bantu.

english: The people believed, and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
translation: Abantu nabo basumina. Kabili pakumfwa ukuti Yawe nabasakamana no kumona ifyo balecululuka, bonse bakontama balapepa no kupepa.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
translation: Elyo Yawe amweba ati, “Tambika ukuboko kobe uikate ku busolo.” Mose atambika ukuboko kwakwe aikata na ku busolo. Insoka nayo kabili yasanguka inkonto mu minwe yakwe.

english: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Ukacite ifi pakuti bakasumine ukuti Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki kabili Lesa wakwa Yakobo alikumonekele.”

english: The LORD said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Pisha icisansa mu mwingila obe.” Mose apishamo. Cilya afumyamo icisansa cakwe amona cikumenefye fibashi, cibuutile na tuutu ngo bunga bwa mfula .

english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
translation: Lesa amweba nakabili ati, “Pisha icisansa cobe mu mwingila.” Apisha. Cilya acifumyamo, amona nacipola cilifye bwino ngo mubili wakwe onse.

english: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
translation: Yawe asosa ati, “Nga bakaana ukukusumina nangu ukutetekela icisungusho cantanshi, ninshi kuti basumina ici icabubili.

english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
translation: Nga bakaana ukusumina pa mulandu wa ifi fisungusho fibili, kabili bakaana no kumfwa ifyo ulebeba, ninshi ukatape amenshi mu mumana wa Nailo ukayetile panshi pa mushili uwauma. Amenshi yakasanguka umulopa panshi.”

english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”
translation: Panuma ya ifi Mose na Aroni baile kuli Farao bamweba abati, “Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli nasosa ati, ‘Leka abantu bandi baleya pakuti bakaye ncitila inshikunkulu mu matololo.’”

english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
translation: Elyo bakangalila ba bena Israeli na bakalamba babo pa milimo baya eba abena Israeli abati, “Farao asosa ati, ‘Ine naleka ukumupeela impimbili shakubomfya.

english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
translation: Kabiyeni muye ifwaila impimbili konse uko mwingashisanga, lelo icikongwani cenu cena tacili nakucefeshiwako nakalya.’”

english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakusalangana mpanga yonse mu calo ca Egupto mukutolelesha impimbili.

english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
translation: Bakangalila balabapatikisha abati, “Mupwishe icikongwani ca cila bushiku, filya mwalecita ilyo pali impimbili.”

english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
translation: Bakangalila bakwa Farao balepuma abakalamba ba milimo abena Israeli abo basalile, balebeba abati, “Cinshi ico mailo na lelo mushipwishishishe ukutama impendwa ya matafwali nga filya mwalecita kale?”

english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba milimo abena Israeli baya mukuilishanya kuli Farao abati, “Cinshi fwe babomfi bobe watucitila ifi?

english: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
translation: Ababomfi benu tababapeela impimbili, lelo baletweba ukutama amatafwali! Kabili ababomfi benu baboma no kuboma, lelo ici cilubo ca bantu benu.”

english: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
translation: Farao nao abasuka ati, “Muli banaŋani, e cine cine muli banaŋani! Tamufwaya kubomba e mulandu mulesosela amuti, ‘Leka tuye kukulekela Yawe ilambo.’

english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
translation: Kanshi nomba bwelelenimo ku milimo yenu! Tabakulamupeela impimbili, lelo mwakulatama impendwa ine ilya bamupimina iya matafwali.”

english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
translation: Abakalamba ba milimo abena Israeli baishiba ukuti bali mu bwafya pakubeba ati, “Lelo impendwa ya matafwali cila bushiku tayakacefeshiweko nakalya.”

english: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know the LORD, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”
translation: Farao ayasuka ati, “Nga Yawe ni nani uo ndi nokubeela no kuleka abena Israeli baleya? Nshimwishibe uyu Yawe, elyo nshaleke na bena Israeli ukuti baleya.”

english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.
translation: Pakufumako kuli Farao basanga Mose na Aroni balebalolela.

english: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba mulimo abena Israeli baeba Mose na Aroni abati, “Yawe engamulolekesha no kumukanda! Pantu nimwe mulengele ukuti Farao na bacilolo bakwe batupate. Nimwe mubikile ulupanga lwakutwipailako mu minwe yabo.”

english: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
translation: Elyo Mose aya kuli Yawe nakabili, asosa ati, “We Yawe, cinshi ulecushisha aba bantu? Bushe ici eco wantumine kuno?

english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
translation: Ukutulafye apo nailile kuli Farao kukumweba ifyo wantumine, Farao ena acushafye aba bantu. Na iwe tawalubula abantu bobe iyoo!”

english: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Lesa wa Bahibulu alitukumanya. Shi tusuminisheni ukuya ulwendo lwa nshiku shitatu mu matololo kukulekela Yawe, Lesa wesu, ilambo, epali atwipaya ku cikuko nangu ku lupanga.”

english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”
translation: Lelo imfumu ya calo ca Egupto yabeba ati, “Mose na Aroni, cinshi mulefumisha aba bantu ku milimo yabo? Bweleleni ku milimo yenu!”

english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
translation: Kabili Farao atila, “Moneni abantu mu calo nabafulisha, elyo na imwe mulebalesha ukubomba!”

english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
translation: Mu bushiku ubo bwine imfumu Farao yakonkomeshe bakangalila ba bena Israeli pamo na bakalamba babo pa milimo aiti,

english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
translation: “Mwilabapeela impimbili shakubomfya pakupanga amatafwali, muleleka baleifwaila abene.

english: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
translation: Lelo impendwa ya matafwali iyakutama cila bushiku yena mwicefyako, ibefye ilya ine iyakale. Banaŋani eco balecitila icongo abati, ‘Tulekeni tuye lekela Lesa wesu ilambo.’

english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
translation: Lekenifye aba bantu imilimo ibakosele, pakuti baleikalilafye ukubomba nganshi. Lyena tabakulakutika ku fyabufi.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Nomba ulemona ifyo ndecita kuli Farao. Pantu ku maka yandifye nkalenga ukuti akabaleke baleya. Pantu ku maka yandifye nkalenga ukuti akabatamfye mu calo cakwe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”
translation: Mose ayasuka Yawe ati, “Apo abena Israeli balikaana ukuŋumfwa, nga wena Farao kuti aŋumfwa shani, ine ne ushaishiba na kulanda bwino?”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
translation: Ifi e fikolwe fya ndupwa shabo. Abana baume bakwa Rubeni, ibeli lyakwa Israeli, ni aba: Anoki, Palu, Hesroni na Kami. Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa sha mu luko lwakwa Rubeni.

english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
translation: Abana abaume bakwa Simeoni ni aba: Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli, umwana wa mu mwanakashi umwina Kenani. Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa sha mu luko lwakwa Simeoni.

english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
translation: Aya e mashina ya bamwana Levi abaume ukukonka umo bafyalilwe, ni Geshomu, Koati na Merari. Levi aikele pano calo imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yatatu na cine lubali (137).

english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Koati bali ni Amuramu, Isa, Hebuloni na Usieli. Koati aikele pano calo imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yatatu na itatu (133).

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Merari bali ni Mali na Mushi. Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa sha mu luko lwakwa Levi ukukonka umo bafyalilwe.

english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.
translation: Kabili Lesa aebele Mose ati, “Nine Yawe.

english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
translation: Amuramu aupile Yokobedi nasenge, afyelemo Aroni na Mose. Amuramu aikele pano calo imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yatatu na cine lubali (137)

english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Isa bali ni Kora, Nefegi na Sikiri.

english: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
translation: Abana abaume bakwa Usieli ni Mishaeli, Elisafani na Sitiri.

english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translation: Aroni aupile Elisheba, mwana Aminadabu nkashi yakwa Nashoni. Afyelemo Nadabu, Abihu, Eleasa na Itama.

english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Kora bali ni Ashili, Elikana na Abiasafu. Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa sha mu mukowa wakwa Kora.

english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
translation: Eleasa, mwana Aroni, aupile umwana mwanakashi umo uwakwa Putieli. Afyelemo na Fineasi. Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa sha mu luko lwakwa Levi, ukukonka umo bafyalilwe.

english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
translation: Ni aba bene Mose na Aroni ebo Yawe aebele ati, “Kafumyeni indupwa shonse ne mikowa yonse iya bena Israeli mu Egupto mu mpuka shabo.”

english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
translation: Ni Mose na Aroni ebaebele Farao imfumu ya Egupto ukuti ileke abena Israeli bafume mu Egupto.

english: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
translation: Ilyo Yawe alandile kuli Mose mu calo ca Egupto,

english: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
translation: amwebele ati, “Ine nine Yawe. Webe Farao imfumu ya calo ca Egupto ifintu fyonse ifyo ndekweba.”

english: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
translation: Lelo Mose ayaswike Yawe ati, “Apo ine nshaishiba kulanda bwino, nga kanshi Farao kuti aumfwa shani kuli ine?”

english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
translation: Elyo kabili napangene nabo icipangano. Nabalaile ukubapeela icalo ca Kenani umo baleikala nga beni.

english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
translation: Elyo kabili niŋumfwa ukuilishanya kwa bena Israeli abo abena Egupto bateeka ubusha, kabili ninjibukisha ne cipangano twapangene nabo.

english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
translation: “Eico kanshi kebe abena Israeli auti, ‘Ine nine Yawe. Ndi nokumulubula ku milimo yabuluku iya bena Egupto kabili nkamufumya na mu busha. Nkamulubula no kuboko kwandi ukwamaka, kabili nkabakanda nganshi.

english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
translation: Nkamucita abantu abandi, na ine nkaba Lesa wenu. Elyo mukeshiba ukuti nine Yawe Lesa wenu uwamulubula ku milimo yabuluku iya bena Egupto.

english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”
translation: Nkamutwala na mu calo ico nalapile ukupeela kuli Abrahamu, kuli Isaki na kuli Yakobo. Nkacipeela kuli imwe cikabe icacishilano. Ine nine Yawe.’”

english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
translation: Mose aisa eba abena Israeli aya mashiwi, lelo balikene ukumumfwa ico bafupwike pa mulandu wakuculisha mu busha.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
translation: Yawe nao aeba Mose ati, “Mona ndekucita nga Lesa kuli Farao, munonko Aroni nao ndemucita kasesema obe.

english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
translation: Kanshi Mose na Aroni baya kuli Farao bacita nefyo Yawe abebele. Aroni aposa inkonto yakwe panshi pa cinso cakwa Farao na bacilolo bakwe, awe nayo yasanguka insoka.

english: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
translation: Farao nao aita abantu bakwe abamano na bakabuka, na bamalele nabo bacita ifyo fine.

english: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
translation: Cila umo aposa inkonto yakwe panshi, nasho shasanguka insoka. Lelo inkonto yakwa Aroni yaminaula inkonto shabo shonse.

english: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
translation: Nomba umutima wakwa Farao walifye uwaumalala, akaana no kumfwa kuli Mose na Aroni, nga filya fine Yawe asosele.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Umutima wakwa Farao ucili uwaumalala, alekaana nokuti abantu baye.

english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.
translation: Ukaye ulucelo kuli Farao ilyo aleya kwifwe. Ukasende ilya nkonto mu minwe yobe, ilya yasangwike insoka, ukalemulolela pa lulamba lwa mumana wa Nailo.

english: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”
translation: Elyo ukamwebe Farao auti, ‘Yawe, Lesa wa Bahibulu, antumine kukukweba ati, leka abantu bandi baleya pakuti bakaye mpepa mu matololo. Nomba iwe ukufika na nomba walikaana ukumfwa.’

english: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe asosele, ‘Ni kuli ici, eko iwe walanjishibila ukuti nine Yawe.’ Mona, pa menshi nalauma iyi nkonto njikete mu minwe, na menshi ya mu mumana wa Nailo yalasanguka umulopa.

english: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
translation: Isabi lyalafwa mu mumana wa Nailo, no mumana wakulanunka na bena Egupto bakulafilwa ukuya nwamo amenshi.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Eba Aroni auti, ‘Buula inkonto yobe, utambalike ukuboko kobe pa menshi yonse ayaba mu Egupto, aya mu mimana, aya mu mifolo, aya mu fishiba na ya mu fishima. Umulopa ukaba konsefye mu calo conse ca Egupto, mu mitondo ya fimuti na mu mitondo ya mabwe.’”

english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
translation: Wakulaeba Aroni fyonse ifyo nakukonkomesha, nao Aroni munonko euli nokweba Farao ukuti aleke abena Israeli bafume mu calo cakwe.

english: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
translation: Mose na Aroni bacita ifyo fine Yawe abebele. Aroni aimisha inkonto yakwe mu mulu, auma na pa menshi ya mu mumana wa Nailo, ninshi Farao na bacilolo bakwe baleloleshako. Awe na menshi yonse yasanguka umulopa.

english: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
translation: Isabi lyonse ilya mu mumana wa Nailo lyafwa, na menshi yalanunka nganshi icakuti abena Egupto balafilwa no kunwa amenshi ya mu Nailo. Umulopa wakumanafye mpanga yonse mu Egupto.

english: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
translation: Abamalele ba mu Egupto nabo bacita cimo cine ku malele yabo. Umutima wakwa Farao walifye uwaumalala, akaana no kumfwa kuli Mose na Aroni nga filya fine Yawe asosele.

english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
translation: Nomba Farao afumapo abwelela na kwisano kumwakwe, ukwabula ukusakamana nelyo cimo.

english: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
translation: Elyo abena Egupto bonse balaimba ifishima mu lulamba lwa mumana umwakuti basange amenshi yakunwa, pantu balifililwe ukunwa amenshi ya mu mumana.

english: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.
translation: Papitile nshiku cine lubali ukutula apo Yawe ayalwile amenshi ya mu mumana wa Nailo ukuba umulopa.

english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
translation: Lelo nkalenga umutima wakwa Farao ukumalala, kabili nangu nkacita ifisungusho ifingi ne finjelengwe ifingi mu Egupto,

english: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
translation: takamumfwe nakalya. Lelo nkabika ukuboko kwandi ukwamaka pali Egupto, kabili nkacita ifintu ifikali nganshi pakufumya impuka sha bantu bandi abena Israeli mu Egupto.

english: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
translation: Ilyo nkakanda abena Egupto no kufumya abena Israeli mu calo cabo, elyo abena Egupto bakeshiba ukuti ine ndi Yawe.”

english: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.
translation: Awe Mose na Aroni baya cita nefyo Yawe abebele.

english: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
translation: Ilyo baile kukulanda kuli Farao, Mose ali ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse (80), Aroni nao ali ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse na itatu (83).

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati,

english: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”
translation: “Farao nga amweba ati, ‘Citeni icisungusho,’ ukebe Aroni akabuule inkonto no kuiposa panshi pa cinso cakwa Farao, nayo ikasanguka insoka.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Kabiye kuli Farao umwebe auti, ‘Yawe asosa ati, leka abantu bandi baleya, pakuti bakaye mpepa.

english: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
translation: Farao amwasuka ati, “Mailo.” Mose amweba ati, “Cisuma cikabe ngefyo fine wasosa. Ukeshiba ukuti takwaba uwaba nga Yawe, Lesa wesu.

english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
translation: Ifyula fikataluka kuli iwe, kuli bacilolo bobe, ku bantu bobe na ku mayanda yenu. Fikashalafye mu mumana wa Nailo.”

english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.
translation: Ilyo Mose na Aroni bafuma kuli Farao, Mose alakuuta Yawe ukuti afumyepo ifyula aletele pali Farao.

english: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
translation: Yawe acitile ifyo Mose alombele. Ifyula ifyali mu mayanda, mu mansa na mu mpanga fyafwa.

english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
translation: Abena Egupto bafilonganya mu mina, ne calo canunka pipi.

english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
translation: Ilyo Farao amwene ukuti ifyula fyafwa, apemwina, umutima wakwe watwalilila ukumalala, akaana no kumfwa kuli Mose na Aroni nga filya fine Yawe asosele.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Eba Aroni ukuti atambike inkonto, ome panshi, no lukungu lonse ulwa mu calo ca Egupto lwalasanguka bamuŋwiŋwi.”

english: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
translation: Nabo bacita ifyo fine. Aroni atambalika ukuboko kwakwe ne nkonto yakwe, auma panshi, na bamuŋwiŋwi baisa pa bantu na pa nama. Kanshi ulukungu lonse ulwa pa mushili mu Egupto lwasanguka bamuŋwiŋwi.

english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.
translation: Abamalele nabo baesha ukuleta bamuŋwiŋwi ku malele yabo, lelo bafilililwafye. Bamuŋwiŋwi balabuba abantu ne nama.

english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
translation: Abamalele epakweba Farao abati, “Aya yena maka yakwa Lesa!” Lelo umutima wakwa Farao wali uwaumalala, akaana no kumfwa kuli Mose na Aroni nga filya fine Yawe asosele.

english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
translation: Nga tawabaleke ukuti baye, ndeleta icinkunka ca fyula, fikawa mu calo cobe conse.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
translation: Luka 11:20

english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
translation: Nga taulekele ukuti abantu bandi baleya, nkakutumina utusembele utwingi utwakububa iwe, bacilolo bobe na bantu bobe, kabili tukengila na mu mayanda yobe. Mu mayanda ya bena Egupto mukesula utusembele na pa mushili ponse apo baba.

english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.
translation: Nomba muli ubo bushiku, mu mpanga ya Gosheni umwaikala abantu bandi mwena tamwakabe tusembele. Nkacita ifi pakuti ukeshibe ukuti ine ne Yawe naba muli cino calo.

english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”
translation: Nkalekanya pa bantu bandi na bantu bobe. Icisungusho ici cikacitika mailo.’”

english: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
translation: Yawe acitile ifyo fine. Kwaishile amabumba ya tusembele utwingi nganshi, twaya ingila mwisano lyakwa Farao na mu mayanda ya bacilolo bakwe. Mu calo conse ca Egupto utusembele twaonawile impanga.

english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”
translation: Elyo Farao aitile Mose na Aroni abeba ati, “Kabiyeni mukulekela Lesa wenu amalambo muno mwine mu calo.”

english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?
translation: Mose nao amwasuka ati, “Ico cena tacilungeme pantu inama shintu tulekela Yawe Lesa wesu ilambo, abena Egupto bena balishipata. Kanshi nga bamona tulelekela Lesa wesu ilambo lya nama isho bapata, bushe tabakatwipaye mukutulasa amabwe?

english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”
translation: Tufwilefye ukuya ulwendo lwa nshiku shitatu mu matololo kukutuula Yawe, Lesa wesu, amalambo ukulingana nefyo atukonkomeshe.”

english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”
translation: Farao nao amweba ati, “Ndemuleka muye kukulekela Yawe, Lesa wenu, amalambo ku matololo cikulu tamwile kutali. Nomba mumpapatileko.”

english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
translation: Mu mumana wa Nailo mukesulafye ifyula paa. Kabili fikalafumamo no kuya kwisano lyobe na mu muputule usendamamo, na pa busanshi bobe, na mu mayanda ya bacilolo bobe, na pa bantu bobe, na mu mabuku yakocelamo umukate na mu fyakukasawilamo umufuba.

english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
translation: Fyakulatobaukila pali iwe, pa bantu bobe elyo na pali bacilolo bobe bonse.’”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Eba Aroni atambalike ukuboko kwakwe ne nkonto yakwe pa mimana, pa mifolo na pa fishiba, uleke ifyula fiwe mu calo ca Egupto.”

english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
translation: Nao Aroni atambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa menshi ya mu calo ca Egupto, awe ifyula fyafuma fyakumanafye icalo conse.

english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
translation: Lelo abamalele nabo bacitile ifyo fine ku malele yabo, balenga ifyula ukwisa pa calo.

english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
translation: Farao epakwita Mose na Aroni abeba ati, “Pepeni kuli Yawe afumye ifyula pali ine na pa bantu bandi, na ine nalaleka abantu benu baye kukulekela Yawe amalambo.”

english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
translation: Mose aeba Farao ati, “Cisuma, unjebe inshita ulefwaya ukuti nkakupepeleko iwe, bacilolo bobe na bantu bobe, pakuti ifyula fifume pali imwe na mu mayanda yenu, fikashalefye mu mumana wa Nailo mweka.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Kabiye kuli Farao umwebe ukuti ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa Bahibulu, asosa ati, ‘Leka abantu bandi baleya, pakuti baye mpepa.

english: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.
translation: Kanshi epakubuula imito ukufuma mwilungu, baya iminina pa cinso cakwa Farao. Mose aululwila imito mu mwela. Awe ifipute fyatumbile pa mibili ya bantu ne ya fitekwa, kabili fyasanguka ifilonda fya mafina.

english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.
translation: Abamalele bafililwe ukwisa kuli Mose pantu nabo bene ifipute fyalibatumbile nga filya fine fyatumbile bonse abena Egupto.

english: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.
translation: Lelo Yawe alengele ukumalala umutima wakwa Farao, kabili nga filya fine Yawe asosele, Farao akene ukumfwako kuli Mose na Aroni.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Mailo ulucelocelo ukaye kuli Farao ukamwebe auti, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa Bahibulu, asosa ati, leka abantu bandi baleya pakuti baye mpepa.

english: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
translation: Pantu ino nshita ndetuma ifikuko ifyabipisha nganshi pali iwe na bacilolo bobe, na pa bantu bobe. Elyo uleishiba nokuti takwaba nelyo umo uwaba nga ine mwisonde lyonsefye.

english: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;
translation: Kwena nga cakuti ine njimya ukuboko kwandi no kukanda iwe na bantu bobe ku cinkunka, nga mwalilobelelafye kale.

english: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,
translation: Ni pakukulanga amaka yandi eco nakubikila pa bufumu, kabili nokuti ishina lyandi lishibikwe isonde lyonse.

english: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
translation: Roma 9:17

english: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.
translation: Kanshi mu bushiku bwa mailo pa nshita nga ino ine nkalokesha imfula yacitalawe iya mabwe iyishatala ailoka mu Egupto ukutulafye apo ici calo catendekele ukufika na nomba.

english: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”
translation: Kanshi ubile imbila iyakutila ifitekwa fyenu fyonse ne fintu fimbi fyonse ifyaba mu mpanga mukafilete mu ncende umwakuuba imfula. Pantu umuntu onse ne nama yonse ifikaba mu mpanga ukwabula ukufileta umwakuuba imfula yacitalawe iya mabwe fikafwa.’”

english: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
translation: Nga wabakaanya ukuti baleya kabili watwalilila no kubasunga,

english: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.
translation: Bacilolo bakwa Farao, abo abaikatwa no mwenso pa mulandu we shiwi Yawe asosele, bayangufyanya ukuleta abasha babo ne fitekwa fyabo umwakuuba imfula.

english: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.
translation: Lelo abo abashaposeleko mano kwishiwi Yawe asosele, bashile abasha babo ne fitekwa fyabo mu mpanga.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Imisha ukuboko kobe mumulu, pakuti imfula yacitalawe iya mabwe ilokeshe mu calo conse ica Egupto. Yalalokela pa bantu, pa fitekwa elyo na pa filimwa fyonse mu mabala ya mu Egupto.”

english: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.
translation: Cilya Mose aimisha inkonto yakwe mumulu, Yawe aleta ukupanta ne mfula yacitalawe iya mabwe, ne nkuba yalaponena panshi. Awe Yawe alokeshe imfula ya mabwe mu calo ca Egupto.

english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
translation: Amabwe ya mfula yalapona, ne myele ya nkuba yalabyata. Takwatalile akuloka imfula yabipisha muli uyu musango mu calo conse ica Egupto ukutulafye apo umushobo wabo watendekele ukubako.

english: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.
translation: Imfula ya mabwe yaonawile ifintu fyonse ifyali mu mpanga mu calo conse ica Egupto, abantu ne nama kumo. Imfula ya mabwe yaonawile ifilimwa mu mabala, yakobaula ne fimuti mu mpanga.

english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
translation: Incendefye imfula ya mabwe ishalokelemo ni mu Gosheni umwaleikala abena Israeli.

english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
translation: Elyo Farao aitile Mose na Aroni aisa beba ati, “Uno muku wena nimbifya, Yawe nalungika, ine na bantu bandi nifwe tubifishe.

english: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”
translation: Papateni kuli Yawe pantu ukupanta ne mfula ya mabwe fyatucusha pafula. Na ine ndemulekako muleya kabili tamwaikale kabili muno iyoo.”

english: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.
translation: Mose nao amweba ati, “Nga nafumafye muno musumba, nalaya imya amaboko yandi pakupepa kuli Yawe. Ukupanta kuleleka ne mfula ya mabwe ilepwa, epakuti wishibe ukuti umwine we sonde lyonse ni Yawe.

english: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.
translation: ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kukaleta icinkunka pa fitekwa fyenu, pali bakabalwe, bapunda, ingamila, iŋombe, impaanga ne mbushi.

english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”
translation: Lelo ninjishiba ukuti iwe na bacilolo bobe tamulati mukwate akatiina kakwa Yawe Lesa nakalya.”

english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.
translation: Imfula yacitalawe iya mabwe yaonawile utumiti twa kolokondwe ne mbuto sha bale, pantu bale alitwele, na kolokondwe nao alibalwile.

english: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.
translation: Lelo iŋanu na masaka fyena tafyaonaike pantu tafipakula bwangu.

english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.
translation: Elyo Mose afumine kuli Farao, aya kunse ya musumba. Ayansa maboko yakwe pakupepa kuli Yawe. Awe ukupanta ne mfula ya mabwe fyaleka, kabili ne mfula yalekelelafye ukuloka pa calo.

english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
translation: Ilyo Farao amona ukuti imfula ya mabwe no kupanta fyaleka, abwekeshapo ukubifya nakabili. Farao na bacilolo bakwe imitima yabo yaumalala.

english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.
translation: Awe umutima wakwa Farao waumalala, alesha na bena Israeli ukuti baleya nga filya fine Yawe aebele Mose.

english: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”
translation: Lelo Yawe akalekanya pakati ka fitekwa fya bena Israeli na bena Egupto, lyena tapakafwe fitekwa nelyo fimo pa fya bena Israeli.’”

english: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”
translation: Yawe napingula inshita, kabili atile, “Ni mailo elyo nkacita ici mu calo.”

english: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Yawe acitile ifyo asosele. Ifitekwa fya bena Egupto fyonse fyalifwile lelo ifitekwa fya bena Israeli fyena tapafwile nelyo cimo.

english: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.
translation: Ilyo Farao atumine abantu kukumona ifyacitike. Nabo bamwebele ukuti tapali inama nangu imo iya mwina Israeli iyifwilepo. Lelo umutima wakwa Farao walifye waumalala, akaana nokuti aleke abantu baleya.

english: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati, “Kafokotoleni imito mwilungu mwisushe indupifye, elyo Mose aye ulwila mu mwela pa cinso cakwa Farao.

english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”
translation: Imito ikaba e lukungu pa calo conse ca Egupto. Kabili icalofye conse imito ikalenga abantu ne fitekwa ukulwala ifipute ifikalasanguka ifilonda fya mafina.”

english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
translation: Ilyo ine nainwine amenso pa lwelele ulwa pa mulu wa mitwe ya bakerubi, nalimwenepo icaba nge cipuna cabufumu icapangwa kwilibwe ilya safile.

english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
translation: Mukumoneka imipeto yonse ine yalifye iyapalana, kwati umo wapangilwa mukati ka mupeto unankwe.

english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.
translation: Bakerubi bena pakwenda kulungamafye ukuli konse mu tupinda tune ukulolele ifinso fyabo, ukwabula imipeto ukupilibukila uku noku. Bonse pamo bena kulungamafye konse uko imitwe yaloseshe, ukwabula ukwalukila kumbi.

english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.
translation: Kabili imibili yabo, ne numa shabo, ne minwe yabo, na mapindo yabo, kumo kwine ne mipeto yonse ine, fyonse fyaiswilemo amenso mu mbali shonse.

english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.
translation: Naumfwile ukuti imipeto baleita abati, “Imipeto iyibutukisha.”

english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.
translation: Bakerubi bonse umo umo bali ne finso fine. Icapakubala cali nge cinso icakwa kerubi, icabubili cali nge cinso ca muntu, icabutatu cali nge cinso ca nkalamo ne icabune cali nge cinso cakwa kapumpe.

english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
translation: Awe na bakerubi baima, baya na mu lwelele. Eifi fine ifyamweo ifyo namwene na ku mumana wa Keba.

english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.
translation: Ilyo bakerubi baleya, ninshi baleilafye camumo ne mipeto ine. Baleti nga bafungulula amapindo pakupupuka, ninshi ne mipeto ine kuiila pamo nabo.

english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
translation: Kumfwa bakerubi nga baiminina, nayo ninshi yaiminina, ilyo baima ninshi nayo yaima, pantu umupashi wa fyamweo wali mu mipeto.

english: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.
translation: Esek 1:18

english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
translation: Ilyo ncilii ndetamba, bakerubi epakufungulula amapindo yabo, bapupukila mu mulu ne mipeto yaimina kumo. Baya iminina pa ŋanda yakwa Yawe, pa mwinshi uwabela lwa ku kabanga, ninshi no bucindami bwakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli buli apo bali pa mulu wabo.

english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.
translation: Ubuso 4:2

english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
translation: Ifi e fyamweo ifyo namwene pesamba lyakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli ku mumana wa Keba. No kushininkisha nomba nashininkisha ukuti e bakerubi bene.

english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
translation: Bonse umo bali ne finso fine, na mapindo yane, na mwisamba lya mapindo yabo mwali ifyaba nge fisansa fya muntu.

english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
translation: Ifinso fyabo fyali cimo cine na filya fine namwene ku mumana wa Keba. Bonse umo baleya uko baloseshe ifinso fyabo.

english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
translation: Nomba ilyo aleyamo, bakerubi baiminine lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo lubali lwe Tempele, elyo ne kumbi lyaisula mu lubansa lwamukati.

english: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
translation: No bucindami bwakwa Yawe epakulafuma pa mulu wa bakerubi, no kulaya ku mwinshi we Tempele lyakwa Yawe. Ne kumbi lyaisula mwi Tempele icakuti no lubansa lwalabengeshimafye ku mulandu wa bucindami bwakwa Yawe.

english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
translation: Ubuso 8:5

english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.
translation: Cilya Yawe akonkomesha umuntu uwafwele insalu ishabusaka ishatelela ukuya lapula umulilo mu mipeto iyali mwisamba lya bakerubi, nao emo aya, aya iminina lubali lwa mupeto umo.

english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
translation: Elyo Kerubi umo aikata pa mulilo uwali apo bali, alapulapo umo aubika na mu ndupi sha muntu uwafwele insalu ishabusaka ishatelela. Nao epakusenda umulilo, afuma no kufuma.

english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.
translation: Bakerubi bonse umo umo nabakwata mwisamba lya mapindo yabo ifisansa nge fya muntu.

english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.
translation: Kabili nalolesha namona imipeto ine ku lubali lwa bakerubi, na cila mupeto wali ku lubali lwakwa Kerubi umo. Imipeto yalebengeshima kwati tumabwe twamutengo utwa kirisaliti

english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
translation: Umupashi walinjimishe no kuntwala ku mpongolo iyabela lwa ku kabanga ka ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Kulya kwine eko nasangile nabeminina abaume amakumi yabili na basano (25), ninshi pali na Yasania mwana Asuri, na Pelatia mwana Benaya, abo bene babili ebali intungulushi sha bantu.

english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Balamwipaila muno mwine ku lupanga, kabili nkamucitila ubupingushi na mu mipaka ya calo ca Israeli. Lyena elyo mwalashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.
