translation: Uno musumba tawabe inongo yenu iyoo nangu imwe ukuba inama muli iyi nongo. Ine nkamucitila ubupingushi mu mipaka ya calo ca Israeli.

english: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”
translation: Epakuti mushininkishe ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe, pantu tamukonka ifipope fyandi nangu ukusunga amafunde yandi. Lelo imwe mukonka imbela sha mishobo iyamushinguluka.’”

english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
translation: Nomba kutifye cilya ndesesema, awe Pelatia mwana Benaya apona panshi, no kufwa afwa. Na ine nakontamika icinso panshi ubukupeme, napunda ne shiwi ilikalamba nati, “Owe, we Mfumu Yawe, bushe walaipayafye abena Israeli bonse ukwabula ukushapo no wakushimika?”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine,

english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’
translation: aliti, “We mwana wa muntu, abantu abekashi ba mu Yerusalemu ebalanda palwa bamunonko na bantu bobe aba muli bunkole, aba mu ŋanda yonse iyakwa Israeli, abati, ‘Yawe alibatamfya, ne calo ici nomba capeelwa kuli ifwe kukuba icuma cesu.’

english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’
translation: “Kanshi uye ulande auti, ‘Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe asosa ifyakuti, nangu nabasalangenye ukutali pakati ka mishobo imbi na pakati ka fyalo, lelo pali ino nshita nine naba icifulo cabo icamushilo mu fyalo umo baya ikala.’

english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”
translation: “Kanshi sosa auti, ‘Ifi efintu Imfumu Yawe alesosa ati, nkabalonganya ukufuma mu mishobo na mu fyalo umo nabasalanganishisha no kubabwesesha icalo ca Israeli.

english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
translation: Bakabwelela muli ici calo kabili bakesa fumyamo fyonse ifyamakankamike no tulubi twamuselu.’

english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,
translation: Ine nkabapeela umutima umbi uwaololoka no kubika umupashi uupya muli bena. Nkafumya muli bena umutima wa libwe no kubikamo umutima uwa munofu.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;
translation: Yawe nao anjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, aba e bantu ababi, abapanda abantu amano ayakucita ifyabipa muli uno musumba.

english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation: Lyena bakalasunga amafunde yandi, no kulanakila ifipope fyandi fyonse bwino bwino. Lyena elyo bakaba abantu bandi, na ine nkaba Lesa wabo.

english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”
translation: Nomba abantu abatemwa ukulapepa ifimpashanya ifyabunani no tulubi utwamuselu, awe bena nkalabalimuna palwa micitile yabo. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
translation: Elyo bakerubi balitampile ukupupuka, ne mipeto ine yabakonka. Ubucindami bwakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli bwali pa mulu wabo.

english: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
translation: Ubucindami bwakwa Yawe epakufumamo mu musumba, bwaya iminina na pa lupili ulwabela lwa ku kabanga ka musumba.

english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
translation: Kabili mu cimonwa mwine Umupashi wakwa Yawe wanjimya, ambwekesha na kuli bankole banandi mu calo ca Babiloni, awe ne cimonwa e mipwile.

english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.
translation: Na ine epakulaebako bankole banandi ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe anangile.

english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
translation: Bena batila abati, ‘Bushe inshita yakukuula amayanda taili mupepi? Pantu uno musumba ulifye nge nongo iyakwipikamo, na ifwe tuli nga inama mukati kaiko. ’

english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”
translation: Kanshi iwe we mwana wa muntu, ala sesema pali bena, basesemene.”

english: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Yawe waikile pali ine no kwisa njeba ati, “Ifi efyasosa Yawe. Imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, ala ine nalishiba ifyo imwe mulanda, nefyo mutontonkanya ukucita.

english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”
translation: Imwe mwalipaulula abantu muli uno musumba, na mu misebo yauko mwaisulafye ifitumbi fya bantu.

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.
translation: “Eico kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe ilesosa, aiti, ‘Uno musumba waba ni nongo iyili peshiko, ne nama bantu abo mwaipaulula. Nomba ine nalamutamfyamo.

english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Imwe mulatiina ulupanga, no lupanga elo nalaletamo, efyasosa imfumu Yawe.

english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
translation: Nalamutamfyamo muli uno musumba, nalamuposa mu minwe ya benafyalo pakumukanda.

english: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’
translation: Eico iwe ubebe ifyo ine ne Mfumu Yawe nkwebele. Aya mashiwi ayakusoka cilolo uwateeka Yerusalemu, kabili eyakusoka na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse abaikalamo.

english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
translation: Ubebe ukuti ico cintu iwe ucitile e cishibilo icakubalanga icikabaponena, bakasendwa bunkole, bakabatamfisha na mu fyalo fimbi nge mbutushi.

english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
translation: Cilolo wa mfumu uubateeka akasenda icipe cakwe pa kubeya pa nshita kufiitile, pakufyuka akafumina pa cipunda ico bakatula mu cibumba. Akafimba na pa menso pakukanamona icalo uko akalaya.

english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
translation: Nomba uyo cilolo, ine nkamuteye isumbu lyandi, no kwikatwa emo akekatwa. Elyo nkamutwala ku musumba wa Babiloni mu calo ca bena Kaludea eko akaya fwila ukwabula ukumona uyo musumba.

english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
translation: Bashicilye bakwe, na bamupandako amano, na bamulinda, bonse nkabasalanganishisha monse monse, elyo nabo nkalabasapika pakufwaya ukubepaya.

english: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
translation: “Ilyo nkabasalanganishisha mu bantu ba mishobo imbi, na mu fyalo fimbi, lyena elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Kwena nkaleka bamo bamo bakapusukeko ku nkondo, ku cipowe na ku cikuko, epakuti umo mwine mu mishobo ya bantu umo bakekala, uleke bakashininkishe ububi bwa fintu ifyabunani ifyo bacita, kabili epakuti bakeshibe nokuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
translation: Mako 8:18

english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.
translation: Webe na bantu bonse mu calo ukuti Imfumu Yawe alesosa aya mashiwi ku bena Yerusalemu, na ku bacili baleikala mu calo ca Israeli. Bebe auti, ‘Mukalasokona pa nshita mukalalya, kabili mukalakanka ku mwenso pa nshita mukalanwa amenshi. Mu calo cenu tamwakashale akantu nangu kamo pa mulandu wa buluku bwa imwe bonse abaikalamo.

english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, iwe waikala na bantu abasangu. Amenso balikwata, nomba tabamona nakalya. Amatwi balikwata, nomba tabomfwa nakalya, pantu basangu ba bantu.

english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
translation: Imisumba umwaisula abantu paa ikonaulwa, ne calo cikasanguka amatololo. Elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Yere 5:21

english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, bushe cinshi ico aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli balandila libili libili ili ipinda palwa calo cabo ilyakutila, ‘Inshita ilepwafye, nokuti fimoneke ifyasobelwa, nakalya.’

english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
translation: Kanshi nomba iwe ubebe auti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe aiti, “Ili ipinda talyakatale alilandwa nakabili mu bena Israeli.”’ Ubebe auti, ‘Inshita naifikila, ne fyasobelwa fyonse balaswa bafishininkishe.’

english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
translation: “Kuba ŋanda yakwa Israeli takwakaleba nakabili ifimonwa fyabufi, nangufye ifyakusesema ififwile ukufulunganya abantu,

english: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: pantu ine ne Mfumu Yawe nine wine nkalalanda nabo, nefyo nkalabeba fikalacitika. Tacakapose na nshita iyoo. Imwe mwe basangu ba bantu, pa nshita ino ine imwe mucilipo, ine nkacita ifyo napanga ukucita. Nine ne mfumu Yawe nalanda.”

english: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli balelanda abati, ‘Ifimonwa fyonse na mashiwi ayo iwe usesema, ni palwa fintu ifikabako kuntanshi.’

english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Kanshi iwe ubebe ukuti ine ne Yawe ndetila nati, ‘Tapali amashiwi yandi ayali nokukokola, pantu fyonse fikacitika. Nine ne Mfumu Yawe nalanda.’”

english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
translation: “Kanshi iwe we mwana wa muntu, ale nomba kaka ifipe fyobe, ucite kwati uli mbutushi, elyo wime mu nshita ya kasuba. Uleke bonsefye bakumone uko uleima, bamone noko uleya. Nakalimo baleiluka no kwishiba nangu baba abasangu.

english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.
translation: Mu nshita ya kasuba ulongele ifipe fyobe pa bwelu, uficite kwati cifulukutu cilya cisenda bankole. Uleke bakumone ilyo uleima icungulo, wise ucite kwati uleya muli bunkole.

english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.
translation: Ilyo bakulatamba, utule icipunda mu cibumba ca ŋanda yobe, wimye icipe cobe, ucifumishe pa cipunda pene, no kufuma epo ufumine.

english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”
translation: Uleke bamoneko uko wakulaitwika icipe pa kubeya, wise ufume ilyo pafiita, ufimbe na pa menso, epakuti wiisa mona uko wakulaya. Pantu ndekulenga ukuba icilangililo ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli.”

english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakucita ifyo Yawe ankonkomeshe. Ilyo line nalonga ifipe fyandi mu nshita ya kasuba, naficita kwati cifulukutu icakuya naco muli bunkole. Elyo icungulo cilya pafiita natula icipunda mu cibumba ku minwe yandi, nafumya ne cipe, naitwika na pa kubeya, elyo ninshi no kumona abantu balemonako.

english: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu nshita ya lucelo kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
translation: Esaya 6:9-10

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.
translation: “Pantu aba bakasesema babepaikafye abantu ilyo babeba ukuti icibote ilyo kanshi takuli icibote. Ilyo abantu bakuula ilinga ne loba lya cisengafwafwa, moneni bakasesema bashingwilako iloba lya mpemba.

english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”
translation: Ilyo ilinga likawa elyo abantu bonse bakalaipusha abati, ‘Nge loba lya mpemba ilyo mwashingwilileko, lili kwi?’

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
translation: “Kanshi ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndesosa nati, ‘Mu cipyu candi, ine nkatuma icimwela ica cikuku, na mu bukali bwandi nkatuma imfula iyine yine iya mabwe pakwisa onaula ilinga.

english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Yere 6:14

english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—
translation: “Ilinga likamona apapela icipyu candi, kumo kwine na bashingwililako iloba lya mpemba. Elyo na ine nkamweba nati, ‘Tepapo, ilinga talilipo, na bashingwilileko iloba lya mpemba nabo bene nabaloba.’

english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Ebalya bene bakasesema ba bena Israeli, abalesesemena Yerusalemu ukuti natumona icibote ilyo kanshi taciliko, efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,
translation: “Nomba we mwana wa muntu, sosa ku bana banakashi aba bantu bobe abasesema ifyakuituntumbafye, kabasoke pafyo balecita.

english: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?
translation: Kabebe ukuti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Mwashama, mwe banakashi ba bantu mwe. Imwe nimwe mupanga imikano iyakuti mulefwala ku maboko, kabili nimwe mubila ifitambala umwaba ifishimba, ifyakuti mulefwala ku mitwe, pakuti mumone umwakwikatilila imyeo ya bantu. Imwe mufwayafye ukulaikata imyeo ya bantu bandi, pakuti mwe bene munonkelemo fimo.

english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’
translation: Imwe mulansebanya ku bantu bandi kulwa kufwayafye ukulamwenamo tubale tumo tumo, ne fimokolwa fya mikate fimo fimo. Imwe mulafwaya ukwipaya abantu abashilingile kufwa, mulapususha na bantu abashalinga kwikala pano calo. Imwe, awe mubepaikafye abantu bandi, nabo tepakutemwa ukulaumfwa ifyabufi.’

english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, kasoke bakasesema ba bena Israeli. Kebe abo bantu abasesema ifyakuituntumbafye, utile, ‘Umfweni imwe ifyo Yawe alesosa!’

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.
translation: “Kanshi ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndesosa nati, ‘Ine tepakupata imikano iyo mwikatilako imyeo ya bantu nge fyuni. Ine nkaiputaula ku maboko yenu, no kuleka abantu abo mwaikata imyeo yabo nge fyuni.

english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Ine nkalepaula ifitambala ku mitwe yenu, no kuleka abantu bandi bakapusunsukeko kuli imwe, kabili bekatala ababa mu minwe yenu nge nama shilya balunga. Ee, elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’

english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.
translation: “Pantu imwe ku bufi bwenu mulafupula abantu abalungami, abo nshaletela ubulanda. Mulaluminisha na bantu ababifi pakuti beleka myendele yabo iyabipa, epakuti bekapusuka.

english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Kanshi ifimonwa fyenu ifyabufi, awe nomba fyapwa, nefyo musobela ifyakubepa abantu nafyo fine nomba fyapwa. Ine nalapususha abantu bandi kuli imwe, elyo mwalashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
translation: “Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa. Mwashama, mwe fipumbu fya bakasesema imwe. Mwe bakasesema abakonkelela imipashi iyenu, nangu tamumwene nelyo cimo.

english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
translation: Mwe bena Israeli, ala bakasesema benu baba nga bamumbwe abekala mu fibolya.

english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.
translation: Tabalinda incende apo ilinga lyabo lyabongoloka, nangufye ukukuulililapo nakalya, pakutila ilinga likeminine ilyakosa ilyakwafwilisha aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli pa bushiku bwa bulwi bwakwa Yawe.

english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
translation: Ifimonwa fyabo te fyacine, nefyo basobela nafyo fine fyabufifye fyeka fyeka. Balasosa abati, ‘Yawe alesosa ukuti,’ ilyo Yawe ninshi teubatumine. Kabili balalolela pakuti amashiwi yafikilishiwe.

english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”
translation: Ine ndebeba nati, ‘Imwe ifyo fimonwa mumona, ala fyabufifye, kabili nefyo musobela, nafyo fine fyabufifye fyeka fyeka. Ilyo musosa ati, “Yawe eusosele,” libe ninshi teine nsosele.’

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alelanda ati, ‘Pa mulandu wakuti imwe musosafye ifyabufi, no kumona ifimonwa ifyabufi, na ine nomba namwalukila,’ efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
translation: Nalaswa nkande bakasesema, abo abamona ifimonwa ifyabufi, abasobela ne fyakubepaika abantu. Bena tabakasangwe mu cilye ca bantu bandi, na mashina yabo tayakalembwe pamo na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Aba bakasesema tabakatale abengila mu calo ca Israeli, elyo mukashininkisha ukuti nine Imfumu Yawe.

english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
translation: Abakalamba bamo bamo aba bena Israeli baliishile kuli ine, baisa ikala pa ntanshi yandi.

english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,
translation: Kasesema wine pamo pene no muntu uwile kukumwipusha, bonse babili ine nkabalimwina capamo pantu bonse ba mulandu.

english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: No mulandu nkalacitila ifyo, ni pakuti aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bakaleke ukulansangukila, bakaleke no kulaikowesha nakabili ku fyabubifi fyabo. Lyena bakalaba abantu abandifye, na ine wine nkalaba Lesa wabo. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe nalanda.”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti

english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, icalo cimo nga cacita ifyabubifi pakukanaba ne cishinka, ninshi nkafungulula ukuboko kwandi pali cena no konaula ifilyo fyaciko. Nkaletamo icipowe icikepaya abantu kumo kwine ne fitekwa.

english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nangufye balya bantu batatu, Noa na Daniele na Yobo bengekala muli ico calo, bukaele bwabo kuti bwapusushafye abene beka, epela. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—
translation: “Nangufye nga cakuti natuma ifiswango ifyakwipayamo abantu, ne calo casanswa no kusanguka amatololo kabili na bantu balafilwa no kupitamo pa mulandu wafiswango,

english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
translation: nangufye balya bantu batatu bengabamo, napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, ala kuti bafilwa ukupusushako nangufye abana babo abo baifyalila abaume nangu abanakashi. Abenefye kuti ebaipususha beka, epela, neco calo kuti cashalafye amatololo.

english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—
translation: “Nangufye nga cakuti mwaima inkondo muli ico calo elyo nati lekeni ulupanga lwipayemo abantu ne fitekwa fyabo.

english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.
translation: Kabili nangu balya bantu batatu bengaba muli ici calo, napali ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, teti babe na maka yakupusushapo abana babo nangu bamo, lelo abene beka kuti bapusuka.

english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—
translation: “Nga natuma icikuko muli ico calo, kabili mu kufulwa kwandi nasumya umulopa no kwipaya abantu abengi ne nama pamo.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli ine aliti

english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”
translation: Nangufye Noa na Daniele na Yobo bengekalamo, napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, ala kuti bafilwa ukupususha nangu abana babo abo baifyalila. Ukuwamyafye kwabo abene, kuti ekwabapususha abene beka, epela.

english: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!
translation: “Pantu ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ine nkaletela Yerusalemu ifinkunka fine ifyabipisha, ni nkondo, ne cipowe, ne fiswango, ne cikuko, efikesa ipaulula abantu kumo kwine ne fitekwa fyabo.

english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
translation: Lelo kukaba bamo abakapusukako, abana abaume na bana banakashi abakafumishiwamo mu musumba. Aba bakesa uko muli, elyo ilyo mukamona imibeele yabo ne micitile yabo, lyena mukashininkisha ukuti ifinkunka fyonse ifyo ndetele Yerusalemu, kanshi nafilolamo.

english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Mukatalalikwa imitima ilyo mukamona imibeele yabo ne micitile yabo elintu mukeshiba bwino ukuti kanshi umulandu epo waba uwalenga ukuti ncite Yerusalemu ifyo. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, aba baume balibika utulubi mu mitima yabo, kabili balibika ifyakupunwisha ifibi ku ntanshi yabo. Bushe bena baletontonkanya ukuti ine kuti nabasuka pafyo balenjipusha, mwa?

english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,
translation: “Kanshi iwe ubebeko ifyo ine ne Mfumu Yawe nalasosa, ulande auti, ‘Umwina Israeli onsefye uuletunkwa ukulapepa utulubi no kubika ifyakupunwisha ifibi kuntanshi yakwe, uyo muntu nga aya kuli kasesema umo kukwipushako fimo, awe ninshi nine wine ne Yawe nkamwasuka ukulingana no bwingi bwa tulubi twakwe.

english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’
translation: Nkacita ici pakuti nkanashe imitima ya bena Israeli abansangukila pa mulandu wa tulubi twabo tonse.’

english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.
translation: “Kanshi nomba eba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ifyo nalanda ukuti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, lapileni, suuleni no kukaana uto tulubi twenu utushaibipila.’

english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.
translation: Pantu umwina Israeli umo, nangufye umwinafyalo umo uwikala mu Israeli, nga aipatula kuli ine nangu ansangukila, alakumbwa ukulapepa utulubi mu mutima wakwe, abika ne cakuipununako pa cinso cakwe elyo aya kuli kasesema umo kukwipushako fimo, ena nine wine ne Yawe nkamwasuka.

english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Uyo muntu ine nkamwalukila, nkamucita icilangililo icakuti bambi bakamweneko kabili bakabasuula. Nkamufumya na mu bantu bandi. Elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi nine Yawe.

english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
translation: “Elyo uyo muntu nga asembelekapo kasesema umo pakuti amusesemene ifyabufi ninshi nine ne Yawe nasembeleka uyo kasesema. Uyo kasesema nkamwipaya no kumufumya pa bantu bandi abena Israeli.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, bushe finshi ifyo umwangashi wacilako umuti umbi onse uwa mu mpanga? Finshi ifyo umusambo wa mwangashi wacilako imiti ya mu mpanga?

english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
translation: Bushe ku cimuti ca mwangashi kuti umuntu apangako icintu cimo? Bushe kuti umuntu apangako ulupanda ulwa kukobekako ifintu fimo?

english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
translation: Icimuti ca mwangashi ala cawaminafye ukukosha umulilo. Impela shaciko shibili nga shapya, ninshi pakati cashalafye icishiki. Bushe kuti cabombapo umulimo na umbi?

english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
translation: Ilyo icimuti cishilapya, cibafye icabula umulimo. Pali bufi nga capya no kushala icishiki, ninshi lyena cacilako ukuba icabula umulimo.

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nga filya napeela icimuti ca umwangashi pa fimuti fya mu mpanga kukukosesha umulilo, na ine wine efyo nkacita abena Yerusalemu pakubalimuna.

english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
translation: Nkabafumyako amano, nangu bena bakapusuka ku mulilo, lelo nabo bene ni ku mulilo wine bakapya. Ilyo ine nkabafumyako amano, lyena elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Apo bena tababa na cishinka, kanshi na ine wine nkasangula icalo cabo ukuba amatololo.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
translation: Nakufwika ne fyakufwala ifyapikulwa, ne ndyato isha mpapa iyisuma nganshi, ne nsalu ishabusaka ishatelela kabili ne mingila iyaluma umutengo.

english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
translation: Nakufwika ne ifisamo ifyakuiyemfya. Nabika amakosa ku maboko yobe no bulungu mu mukoshi obe.

english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
translation: Nakupeela ne cakukobeka ku myona yobe, na masikiyo ku matwi yobe, ne ngala iyayemba iya ku mutwe obe.

english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
translation: Awe iwe wafwikilwe ifisamo fya golide na silifa, no kulafwala insalu ishatelela kabili ishabusaka. Walalya no mukate uwa bunga ubwapeleka, no buci, na mafuta ya miolifa, wasuka waba imbeka iyine yine, no kusanguka namfumu.

english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ululumbi lwa kuyemba kobe lwasuka lwafika na ku mishobo ya benafyalo. Ukuyemba kobe kwali ukwafikapo, pantu nine nakuyemfeshe ifyo. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
translation: “Nomba iwe wacetekelefye mu kuyemba kobe, no kulumbuka kobe kwakutwala ku bulalelale. Wacitile ubulalelale no muntufye onse uulepita.

english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.
translation: Walabuulapo insalu shobe shimo, no kulashisamika pa ncende ishakupepelapo, palya iwe walecitila bucilende ubushatala abubako, kabili tabwakatale abubako.

english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
translation: Walibuula ifisamo ifyakuiyemfya ifya golide na silifa, ifyo ine nakupeela pakuti uleisamika nafyo, iwe efyo wapangamo ifimpashanya ifya baume, pakuti efyo ulecita nafyo ubucende bobe.

english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
translation: Kabili walibuula insalu shobe ishapikulwa ubusaka isho ine nakupeela, nobe esho wafimba ifyo fimpashanya, kabili ulafituula na mafuta aya miolifa no bubani, ifyo ine nakupeela.

english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ine nalikupeela ifyakulya, no bunga ubwapeleka, na mafuta aya miolifa no buci, nomba iwe kabili efyo utuula utulubi pakututemuna. Ifi efyacitike, efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sokako Yerusalemu pa mulandu wa fintu ifyabunani ifyo acita.

english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
translation: “Kabili walibuula bamwano abaume na banakashi abo wamfyalila, iwe ebo watuula ilambo ku tulubi. Cinshi mba ushapelelafye pali bucilende bobe,

english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
translation: ukwabula ukumbuulila abana no kubatuula nge lambo lyakoca ku tulubi?

english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
translation: Pali iyi nshita yonse iyo waikalila bucilende, awe tawatala awibukisha ifyo wali ku bwaice ilyo wali ubwamba ukwabula ifyakufwala kabili walealanganafye mu mulopa.”

english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord GOD—
translation: “Washama, iwe washama, efyo asosa Imfumu Yawe, pantu ukulunda pa fibi fyonse ifyo ucita,

english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
translation: iwe walikuula incende ishasansama muli cila lubansa lwa musumba apakupepela utulubi no kulacitilapo ubucende.

english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
translation: Mu mbali ya misebo yonse walikuula incende ishasansama umo ukowesha ubusuma bobe, pantu umubili obe ulautwala lyonse ku muntu onse uwaisa kuli iwe, bwasuka na bucilende bobe bwalacililako.

english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
translation: Abena mupalamano banobe abena Egupto, ingulungani shakantu, iwe ebo usendama nabo, ala bucilende bobe nabucilamo, nabulenga nokuti ine mfulwe.

english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
translation: “Eico naimishe ukuboko kwandi pakuti nkukande, nacefyako ne fyakulya nakupimine. Nakuposele ku banakashi ba bena Filisiti abakupata abo waselawishe ku mukoshi palwa myendele yobe iyishaibipila.

english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
translation: Wasukile waba cilende na bena Asiria ukwabula ukutendwa, nomba nalyo line umutima obe tawaikele iyoo.

english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
translation: Kabili wafusha bucilende bobe na bena Kaludea, ulya mushobo wa bashimakwebo, nalyo line umutima obe tawaikele iyoo.

english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation: Eba Yerusalemu ukuti Imfumu Yawe alekweba ukuti iwe wafyelwe umwana mwanakashi mu calo ca Kenani. Wiso ali mwina Amoli, na noko nao ali mwina Hiti.

english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord GOD, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
translation: “We wamano ayanakuka, efyasosa Imfumu Yawe, ifyo fyonse ifyo ucita iwe eficita cilende uwakamuka.

english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
translation: Mu misebo yonse iwe wakuulilemo incende apakupepela utulubi no kulacitilapo bucilende mu ncende apasansama mu lubansa lonse lwa mu musumba. Kwena walipapusha pantu te ndalama ufwaya muli bucilende nga filya bacilende abaseeka bacita.

english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
translation: Iwe wabafye ngo mwanakashi uwasuula wiba, no kulacita ubucende na baume bambi.

english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
translation: Cilende onse alalipililwapo pali bucilende bwakwe. Nomba iwe caliibela, pantu iwe niwe upeela abaume bonse abakutemwa ifyabupe, kabili niwe ubatemuna pakuti balefuma mpanga yonse kukwisa mukulasendama nobe.

english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
translation: Kwena iwe waliibela kuli bacilende bambi, pantu takwaba mwaume uukusembeleka, kabinge iwe taulipililwapo kantu nakalya, nomba kabili iwe niwe ulebalipila.

english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear the LORD’s word:
translation: “Kanshi iwe cilende umfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe, pa mulandu wakuti walipongolwele ulunkumbwa lobe, wafuula ne nsalu shobe pakusendama na batemwikwa bobe, no kulaipaya bamwano pakubatuula ilambo ilyakupakisha utulubi,

english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
translation: kanshi na ine nomba nkalonganya na bonse abatemwikwa bobe abo watemwa nabo wapata. Nkabaleta bakese kushinguluka, elyo na ine nkakufuula ifyakufwala fyobe, ukashale ubwamba, uleke bakakutambe.

english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
translation: Nkakukanda ifikandwa abanakashi bacilende na basumya umulopa. Nkaleta pali iwe ubukali bwa mulopa ne cilandushi ca bukali bwandi ne ca bufuba bwandi.

english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
translation: Nkakulubwila mu minwe ya bacibusa obe, nabo bakapasa ifibumbili fyobe, bakonaula ne ncende shobe ishakupepelamo utulubi. Nabo bakakufuula ne fyakufwala fyobe, no kukupoka ne fyakuyemfya fyobe ifyamutengo, no kukusha ubwamba ukwabula ifyakufwala.

english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
translation: Ilyo wafyelwe, tabakuputwile umutoto, tabakusambile pakukuwamya, tabakushingile umucele, nangu ukukupomba mu nsalu nakalya.

english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
translation: “Bakakwimisha ibumba lya bantu pakuti bakakupole amabwe, no kukuputaula fipimfya fipimfya ku mpanga shabo.

english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
translation: Bakoca amayanda yobe, no kuleka amabumba ya banakashi yatambeko ifyo ulekandwa. Nkakupwisha bucilende bobe, tawakatale nakabili aupeela abatemwikwa bobe ifyabupe.

english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
translation: Ninshi ine nomba catalala, no mutima wandi waikala tondolo. Nshakatale mfulwa nakabili, nangu ukukwata ubufuba iyoo.

english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
translation: Iwe walilaba ifyo ine nalekutentemba ilyo wali akaice, nomba iwe unsonsombafye pakulacita ifintu ifyo fyonse. Eico na ine wine nkakuleka ukuti ukafute pali ifyo fyonse. Pa fintu fyonse ifyabunani ifyo ucita, nga mulandu nshi kabili walundilapo ne myendele yabulalelale? Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
translation: “Iwe Yerusalemu, ala abantu bakulakweba ili pinda abati, ‘Ifiba nyina, efiba no mwana umwanakashi.’

english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
translation: Esek 16:45

english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
translation: “Umukalamba obe nkashi mbiyo ni Samaria, ena pamo na bana bakwe baba lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Umwaice obe nkashi mbiyo ni Sodoma, ena pamo na bana bakwe aikalila lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
translation: Iwe tawapelelafye pakulabakonkelela na pakulapashanya imisango yabo iyabipisha, lelo mu micitile yobe yonse waliisa bipishapo ukubacila.

english: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ifyakuti, icine cine napalifye ine ne Mumi, nkashi mbiyo Sodoma kumo kwine na bana bakwe, awe tatalile abifya ngefi iwe ulebifya kumo kwine na bana bobe.

english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
translation: Kanshi ubu ebwali ububifi bwakwa nkashi nobe Sodoma. Ena na bamwane abanakashi baleitakisha pantu balikwatishe ifyakulya, no kulaikala ubwanalale, lelo kwena tabalesakamana kusunga abalanda na babusu.

english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
translation: Takwali wakuti akulangulukileko nangu ukukukwatila uluse lwakuti akucitilepo cimo pali ifyo fintu. Ilyo wafyelwe, abantu balikupatile icakuti basukile bakuposa mu mpanga, no kukusha insansalila.

english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
translation: Bali ne cilumba, bali abatalama, kabili balecita ne fintu ifyo ine napata, ecalengele kanshi ukuti na ine mbalofye, no kwishiba nobe wine walishiba.

english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
translation: “Ifibi ifyo Samaria alecita fyalicepapo pa fyabubifi ifyo iwe ucita. Iwe walimucila ukucita ifintu ifyabunani, ecalenga nokuti bankashi mbiyo bamonekepo abakaele.

english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
translation: Kanshi nomba iwe uli nokumfwa insoni. Pantu ifyabubifi fyobe fyalibipishapo pa fyabubifi fya bankashi mbiyo, icakuti bena bamonekapo abakaele. Kanshi nomba iwe insoni kashikwikate, kausebane, pantu niwe walenga ukuti bankashi mbiyo bamonekepo abololoke.”

english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Yerusalemu ati, “Ine nkabweseshamo Sodoma ubunonshi pamo na bana bakwe abakashana. Nkabweseshamo na Samaria ubunonshi na ena akashuke nakabili pamo na bana bakwe abakashana. Nobe wine Yerusalemu nkalenga ukuti ukashuke nakabili pamo nabo.

english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
translation: Ukalaumfwa insoni, kabili ukasebana pakuti nkashi mbiyo shikeshibe ifyo shakucila imisango isuma.

english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
translation: Nkashi mbiyo, Sodoma na bana bakwe abakashana pamo na Samaria na bana bakwe abakashana, bakashuka nakabili, kwena nobe wine ukashuka nakabili pamo pene na bana bobe abakashana.

english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
translation: Bushe iwe tewe waleseka Sodoma lilya walecita amataki,

english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
translation: ilyo ububi bobe bulya ucita bwali tabulasokoloka? Eico nomba balekuseka abana banakashi bakwa Edomu , ku bena mupalamano bonse elyo na ku bana banakashi ba bena Filisiti. Balikusuula na kuli bonse abakushinguluka.

english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.
translation: Niwe wailetelela we mwine pa mulandu wa fintu ifishaibipila kabili ifyabunani ifyo iwe ucita. Efyasosa Yawe.”

english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Iwe we Yerusalemu, ine nkakulimuna ukulingana pa fintu ifyo ucita, pantu iwe walisuula ifilayo ifyo walaya kabili walyonaula ne cipangano candi.

english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
translation: “Nomba ilyo ine napitilepo apo wali, namwene ulealanganafye mu mulopa. Nangu iwe walifye umulopa weka weka, awe ine nalikwebele nati, ‘Ba no bumi.’ Nangu iwe walifye umulopa weka weka, awe ine nalikwebele nati, ‘Ba no bumi.’

english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
translation: Nomba kwena ine nkebukisha icipangano ico napangene nobe ilyo wali umwaice, kabili nkapangana nobe icipangano icikabelelela pe.

english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
translation: Ukebukisha imyendele yobe no kumfwa insoni, ilyo ukapokelela umukalamba obe nkashi mbiyo pamo pene no mwaice obe nkashi mbiyo. Nkabapeela kuli iwe nga bamwano, lelo te mu cipangano nga cilya twapangana nobe.

english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;
translation: Nkapangana na iwe icipangano icipya, elyo na iwe ukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Ilyo tukawikishanya pamo pa mulandu wa fibi fyonse ifyo iwe ucita, elyo na iwe ukalafibukisha no kwikatwa insoni ishakukanafilandapo pantu walisebana. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakulakukusha ngo muti uulekula no kulelema mwibala. Walikulile no kuba umukalamba uwayemba nganshi. Na mabele yobe yasuka yatuntumana, no mushishi obe wasuka walepa, lelo iwe walifye ubwamba ukwabula ifyakufwala.

english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.
translation: “Limbi ilyo napitilepo nakabili, namwene ukuti inshita nomba naifika iyacitemwiko. Eico na ine epakukufimba icisempe ca nsalu yandi pakuti wiba ubwamba, kabili napanga umulapo no kwingila mu cipangano na iwe, nobe epakuba nomba uwandifye. Nine ne Mfumu Yawe ndelanda.

english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
translation: Ruti 3:9

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”
translation: Nangu umwangashi walimbwa, bushe ukatwalilila ukulakula nga baulimbula? Bushe tawakome ilyo umwela wa ku kabanga ukesa pupapo? Bushe tawakomine palya pene apo walekulila?’”

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
translation: “Ipusha abo basangu nga cakuti nabeluka umo ifi fintu filolele. Ubebe ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaishile ku Yerusalemu, yaisa senda imfumu ya mu Yerusalemu pamo na bacilolo baiko, yabatwala na ku musumba waiko ku Babiloni.

english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
translation: Yabuulapo no muntu umo uwa mu lupwa lwa mfumu, eo yapangana nankwe icipangano, yalapa nokuti tayakaconaule. Ilyo ninshi imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalisenda ne ntungulushi isha mu calo,

english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
translation: epakuti ubufumu bwabo bucepelwe amaka, bukafilwe no kwimina imfumu ya Babiloni, elyo ne cipangano cilesungwa bwino nga bekale mu cibote.

english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
“‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
translation: “Napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, iyo mfumu ikafwila ku Babiloni, pantu yasuula umulapo, kabili yaonaula ne cipangano ico yapangene ne mfumu ya ku Babiloni, iyamutekele pa cipuna cabufumu.

english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.
translation: Nangu Farao akwate ifita ifyamaka shani, awe nao wine kuti afilwa ukutuulako imfumu ilyo inkondo yabuka, nangu abena Yuda bengatuntumanika ifibumbili, no kwimba icilindi icashika pakubatebelela icakuti pafwila na bantu abengi.

english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
translation: Pantu iyo mfumu yasuula umulapo, kabili yaonaula ne cipangano. Ala teti ipusuke pa mulandu wakucita ifi fintu.

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, mu cine cine napalifye ine ne Mumi, iyo mfumu ine nkailimuna pa mulandu wakonaula icipangano, ico yalaile no mulapo ukuti ikalacisunga.

english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
translation: “We mwana wa muntu pika ubwile no kumina aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli umulumbe,

english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
translation: Iyo mfumu ine nkaiteya isumbu, no kwikatwa ikekatwamo. Nkaisenda no kuitwala ku Babiloni, no kuilimuna eko nkailimwina pa mulandu wakuntalamina.

english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’
translation: Ifita fyaiko fyonse ifyacenjelesha fikafwa ku nkondo, ne fikapusukako nkafisalanganishisha monse monse. Elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi nine ne Yawe ndemweba.”

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe aleti,

english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.
translation: Pa lupili lumo ulwalepesha nganshi mu Israeli epo nkaya limba,

english: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it.’”
translation: Elyo imiti yonse iya mu mpanga,

english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
translation: Ubebe auti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Patile akantu, kale kwaliko kapumpe umo umukulu, uwa mapindo ayakulu. Ali na masako ayasuma kabili ayabalala. Uyo kapumpe aile ku calo ca ku Lebanoni, aya ikata akamusambo ka cimuti ca keda,

english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
translation: atimpulapo aka pa kantongolilo atwala na ku calo ca bashimakwebo, no kuya limba mu musumba umo uwa basulwishi.

english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
translation: Kabili asenda imbuto shimo isha mu calo mulya, aya shibyala pamo apafunda, ngo mufinsa pa mbali ya menshi ayengi.

english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.
translation: Awe imbuto shamena, shalakula, no kuba umwangashi uwipi, uwaandala. Imisambo yauko yena yalalola mu mulu kuli kapumpe, ne mishila yauko panshi yalalepa. Kanshi umwangashi nao epakulacita amampanda, ne misambo yauko nayo yalafulilako no kufumba.

english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.
translation: “‘Kwaliko na kapumpe na umbi, nao umukulu nganshi, na mapindo ayakulu na masako ayengi. Kanshi uyo mwangashi nao epakulalosha imishila yauko kuli uyo kapumpe, kabili eko walosha ne misambo yauko pakuti utapililwe.

english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’
translation: Uyo mwangashi walimbilwe apafunda, apashalekama menshi, epakuti ulekwata imisambo, uletwala ifitwalo, no kuba umwangashi uwine wine.’

english: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.
translation: “Ubebe auti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Bushe uyu mwangashi ukatwalilila ukulaba palya pene apo walimbwa? Bushe tawakashulwe, no kukuntako ifitwalo, no kukontaulako imisambo, pakuleka amabula ayateku yakome? Kabili tacakafwaikwe umuntu uwamaka, nangu abantu abengi pakuunukula.

english: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
translation: “Pambi kuti muntu uyu alikwatapo mwane umwaume uwamisoka, uwipaya na bantu, uucita ifintu ifyo wishi ashatala acitapo.

english: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
translation: Pambi mwane kuti ena alalyako amalambo ayo balekela mu ncende isho bapepelamo mu mpili, alakowesha na bamukabene.

english: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
translation: Alatitikisha abalanda, aleba no kwiba, alakaana ukubwesesha uwa nkongole icikatila mulandu, alapepa utulubi no kucita ifyabunani.

english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
translation: Alapokelapo insonsela pa ndalama isho alekongwesha. Bushe umuntu wa uyu musango kuti aikala umumi? Awe iyoo, tekuti ekale umumi. Kuti afwa pa mulandu wakucita ifi fintu fyonse ifishaibipila. Kabili mwine winefye ewingailetelela imfwa, no mulopa wakwe ukaba pa mutwe wakwe.

english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,
translation: “Nomba uyu muntu nao nga alikwata umwana umwaume, ena alakaana ukulakonkelela mukucita ifyabubifi ifyalecita wishi,

english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,
translation: kabili alakaana ukulapepako utulubi twa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, alakaana no kulalyako amalambo ayo balekela mu ncende isho bapepelamo mu mpili, alakaana no kukowesha bamukabene,

english: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
translation: alakaana ukulacusha umuntu nangufye ukulaibila umo. Alabwesesha uwa nkongole icikatila mulandu, alapeelako abali ne nsala icakulya, no kwafwilishako abasapula.

english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.
translation: Alakaana ukulacita ifyabipa, alakaana ukulapokelapo insonsela pa ndalama isho alekongwesha, alanakila ifipope fyandi, no kulakonka amafunde yandi. Umwana wa uyu musango teti afwile pa bubi bwakwa wishi iyoo, ena mu cishinkafye akekala umumi.

english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
translation: Wishi umwine eukafwila pa bubifi bwakwe, pantu eucenjelela bambi, eubebila, no kulacita ifyabipa ku bantu banankwe.

english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
translation: “Lelo imwe mulepusha amuti, ‘Nga cinshi ico mwane ashingakandilwa palwa kubifya kwakwa wishi?’ Nico mwane alacita ifyalungama kabili ifisuma. Kabili ena alakonka bwino bwinofye ifipope fyandi fyonse, kanshi e mulandu wine ena akekalila umumi.

english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
translation: “Bushe lyalola mwi ili pinda ilyo abantu basosa mu calo ca Israeli? Basosa abati,

english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.
translation: Uukafwa, ala muntu uubifya. Umwana tali nakukandilwa pa kubifya kwakwa wishi iyoo, nangu wishi tali nakukandilwa pa kubifya kwakwa mwane. Umuntu mulungami akalambwilwapo pa kuwamya kwakwe, no muntu mubi nao akakandilwapo pa kubifya kwakwe umwine.

english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
translation: “Nomba, umuntu mubi nga aleka ukubifya, alakonka na mafunde yandi yonse, alacita ifyalungama kabili ifisuma, umuntu wa uyu musango takafwe iyo, akalaikala umumi.

english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
translation: Akabelelwa uluse pa fibi fyakwe fyonse, akalaikala umumi pa mulandu wa bulungami bwakwe, takafwe iyo.

english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
translation: Ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndeipusha nati, ‘Bushe imwe mutila ine ne Lesa ndasansamuka pakumona umuntu mubi uko alefwa, atini?’ Ala teifyo, ine natemwishapo ukumona uko umuntu mubi alapila, no kwikala umumi.

english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
translation: “Nomba umuntu mulungami nga aleka ukuwamya, atampafye ukulabifya, alacita ne fintu ifyabipisha ificitako abantu ababifi, bushe uyu muntu kuti alaikala umumi? Awe iyoo. Ne fisuma fyonse ifyo engacita, teti bebukishepo nelyo cimo. Pa mulandu wakukanaba uwacishinka kabili pa mulandu wa fyabubifi ifyo acita, lyena akafwa.

english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
translation: “Nomba imwe mulasosa amuti, ‘Ifyacita Yawe awe tafyalungama.’ Umfweni kuno, imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Kanshi imwe mutila umusango ine ncitilamo ifintu tawalungama batini? Bushe temisango yenu eishalungama?

english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
translation: Nga cakuti umololoke aleka ukuwamya alacita ifyabubifi, ala ninshi ni pa bubifi bwakwe epo akafwila pantu nacita ububifi.

english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
translation: Umuntu mubi nga aleka ukubifya, alacita ifyalungama kabili ifisuma, ninshi uyu muntu napususha ubumi bwakwe.

english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
translation: Pantu ninshi namona ububi bwa fintu ifyo alecita, kanshi nao epakufileka. Uyu muntu akekala umumi, takafwe iyoo.

english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
translation: Yere 31:29

english: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Mu cine cine napalifye ine ne Mumi ndetila, ili pinda tamwakalibwekeshepo ukulalilanda nakabili mu Israeli.

english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
translation: “Kanshi ecalenga mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ndemwebelapo, ukuti ine ne Mfumu Yawe nkamupingula bonse umo umo ukulingana nefyo mucita. Eico lapileni no kutaluka ku fibi fyonse ifyo mucita, lyena ninshi ifyabubifi fyenu tafyakamuletelele.

english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
translation: Lekeni ifibi fyonse ifyakale. Aluleni amano yenu ne mitima yenu. Ngeco mwalafwaila ukufwa cinshi, imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli?

english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
translation: Esek 18:32

english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
translation: Pantu umweo wa fintu fyonse mweo wandi, umweo wa mufyashi nangufye uwakwa mwane, yonsefye yandi. Umuntu uubifya, ala eukafwa.

english: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
translation: “Nga cakuti kuliko umuntu uwakaele, uucita ifyalungama kabili umufumacumi,

english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,
translation: uushipepako utulubi twa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli pa mpili elyo talyako na malambo ayo balekela imfuba sha mu mpili. Takowesha bamukabene, tasendama na mwanakashi uuli kumpepo.

english: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
translation: Tacenjelela muntu, nangufye ukumwibila icintu iyoo. Alabwesesha uwa nkongole icikatila mulandu, alapeelako abali ne nsala icakulya, no kufwikako abali ubwamba.

english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,
translation: Tapokelapo nsonsela pa ndalama isho akongwesha. Alakaana ukucita ifyabipa, alapingwila na bantu bwino bwino ilyo kuba ifikansa.

english: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Alanakila ifipope fyandi, no kukonka bwino bwino amafunde yandi. Umuntu wa uyu musango, e muntu wine umololoke, kabili eukekala umumi. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
translation: Ale buula ulwimbo lwandoosha ulwakuloosha abana baume ba mfumu aba bena Israeli.

english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
translation: “Noko ali ngo mwangashi mwibala lyobe,

english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
translation: Imisambo yauko yali iyakosa,

english: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.
translation: Nomba abantu bacifukushi bena baya ushula

english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
translation: Nomba walimbwa mu matololo,

english: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
translation: Elyo no mulilo wafuma ku musambo umo uukalamba

english: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
translation: Kabili utile,

english: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
translation: Yakushishe umwana umo uyo uwaishile ba inkalamo iyamaka,

english: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo nabo baumfwa,

english: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
translation: “Pakumona ukuti ifyo nankalamo alefwaya fyafulungana,

english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
translation: Cilya kafika pa ciimo icakuba inkalamo iyamaka,

english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
translation: Epakulawisha amalinga yabo,

english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
translation: Elyo abantu ba mishobo ya mu fyalo fya mumbali,

english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
translation: Baikoba ku finkobwe fyabo baibika na muli kasalanga,

english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu (30) mu mweshi walenga bune , pa bushiku bwalenga shisano, ine ne Esekieli nali na bankole banandi abena Yuda mu Babiloni, ku mumana wa Keba. Awe umulu waisuka, namona ne fimonwa fyakwa Lesa.

english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
translation: Isham 24:10

english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
translation: Ubuso 19:11

english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
translation: Fyonse cimo cimo fyalungeme uko fyaloseshe amenso, konse uko umupashi walola nafyo eko fyalola, tafyaleyalukila kumbi iyoo.

english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
translation: Mu kumoneka kwa ifi fyamweo fyali kwati mulilo wa mafito uuleyaka nangu ifisaniko ifileyaka no kupitana apo fyali, ukuya kuntanshi na kunuma. Umulilo wali wabengeshima kabili mwalefuma ukubyasha kwa nkuba.

english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
translation: Esek 10:14

english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
translation: Ilyo nalolesha pa fyamweo namona umupeto nawiminina pa mushili lubali ku fyamweo, umupeto umo ku camweo icali ne finso fine.

english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
translation: Ifi efyalemoneka ukupangwa kwa mipeto. Imipeto yalebengeshima nge libwe lyamutengo kirisaliti, yonse ine yalemonekafye umusango umo wine, kabili yonse umo yalemoneka kwati yapangilwa mu mupeto unankwe.

english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
translation: Imipeto yena pakwenda kulungamafye ukuli konse mu tupinda tune ukulolele imipeto, ukwabula ukupilibukila uku noku.

english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
translation: Ifingolongolo fya mipeto fyali ifyasansuka nganshi kabili ifyakusungusha, ne mipeto yonse yashingulwike na menso monse monse.

english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
translation: Cilya ifyamweo fyalaenda, imipeto nayo ninshi yalaenda. Nga fyaima panshi, ne mipeto ine ninshi yaima.

english: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
translation: Cali mu mwaka walenga isano ukufuma apo imfumu Yehoiyakini asendelwe muli bunkole, na pa bushiku bwalenga shisano mu mweshi.

english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
translation: Konse uko umupashi waleya nafyo eko fyaleya, ne mipeto ninshi kwima pamo nafyo fine, pantu umupashi wa fyamweo wali na mu mipeto ine.

english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
translation: Lyonsefye kuti ifyamweo nga fyalaenda nayo yalaenda, atemwa nga fyaiminina nayo yaiminina, atemwa nga fyaima panshi nayo imipeto yaima panshi, pantu umupashi wa fyamweo wali na mu mipeto ine.

english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
translation: Icayanshile pa mulu wa mitwe ya fyamweo calemoneka ngo lwelele, naco cali icabengeshima nge cilola kabili icakusungusha.

english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
translation: Mwisamba lya lwelele fyalifungulwile amapindo ya fiko no kusuntinkanya ku mapindo ya cinankwe, elyo na cila cimo cali na mapindo yabili ayafimbile umubili.

english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
translation: Ilyo ifyamweo fyaleenda, naumfwile iciunda ca mapindo ngo kupooma kwa menshi, kwati lishiwi lya Mwine wa maka yonse, kwati kubolokota kwa fita. Kutifye cilya fyaiminina fyaponya amapindo yafiko.
