english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
translation: Elyo kwafuma ishiwi pa mulu wa lwelele ulwali pa mulu wa mitwe yafiko, ilintu fyaiminine ninshi nafiponya na mapindo.

english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
translation: Pa mulu wa lwelele ulwali pa mulu wa mitwe yafiko pali icintu icalemoneka nge cipuna cabufumu, icapangilwe ne libwe ilya safile, no waikelepo alemoneka ngo muntu.

english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
translation: Ine namwene icalemoneka ngo musana wakwe ukufika ku mutwe alebengeshima nge cela pakati ka mulilo, elyo ukutula mu musana ukushinta na ku makasa yakwe alebeka ngo mulilo. No lubuuto ulwabekesha lwalimushingulwike.

english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
translation: Ulubuuto ulwamushingulwike lwali ngo mukolamfula mu makumbi pa bushiku bwa mfula, efyo ubucindami ubwamushingulwike bwalemoneka.

english: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
translation: Kulya ku calo ca bena Kaludea ku mumana wa Keba, eko ine ne Esekieli shimapepo mwana Busi naumfwilile uko Yawe alelanda kuli ine, no kuboko kwakwe kwali pali ine.

english: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
translation: Awe nalolesha namona umwela uwacikuku ulefuma ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Namona no mwele wa nkuba wabyata mwikumbi ilikalamba nganshi. Pakati ka mulilo palemoneka icabeeka nge cela.

english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
translation: Pakati namwene pali ifyapala ifyamweo fine. Nafyo mukumoneka fyalemoneka ngo muntu.

english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
translation: Ubuso 4:6

english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
translation: Amolu yafiko yali ayaololoka, fyali ne mondo kwati ni mondo shakwa cilume wa ŋombe, kabili fyalebengeshima ngo mukuba uwawamishiwa bwino.

english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
translation: Kabili mwisamba lya mapindo yafiko mu mbali shonse shine cimo cimo calikwetemo ifisansa nge fya muntu. Ifyamweo fyonse fine fyali ne finso na mapindo.

english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
translation: Imila 36:9-10

english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga cine lubali, pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi mu mweshi wabusano , elyo abakalamba bamo aba bena Israeli baishile pakuti bepusheko ifyo Yawe afwaya. Awe baikala na pa ntanshi yandi.

english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
translation: “‘Kanshi ecalengele na ine mbafumye mu Egupto no kubatwala mu matololo.

english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
translation: Nabapeele ne fipope fyandi, no kulenga beshibe amafunde yandi, pakuti bonse abalekonka ifi fintu emo balemwena ubumi.

english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
translation: Kabili nabapeele Amasabata ukuti yabe nge cishibilo ca cumfwano pakati kesu, icakubebukisha ukuti ine ne Yawe nine nabasangula ukuba abamushilo.

english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.
But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
translation: Lelo nabweseshe ukuboko kwandi, pantu nga naliiletele ishina lyandi insoni ku bantu ba mishobo abalemonako uko ine nalefumya aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli mu Egupto.

english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
translation: Kanshi na ine mu matololo mwine epakulapa ukuti ine nshakabatwale mu calo ico ine nabapeela, icalo icikankala icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci, icacila pa fyalo fimbi fyonse ku busuma.

english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
translation: Pantu balisuulile ifipope fyandi, balipulile na mafunde yandi, no kusuulila kumo na Masabata yandi yene. Imitima yabo yatemwishishepo ukulapepa utulubi twabo.

english: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.
translation: “‘Nomba nabalolesha luse luse, nakaana ukubalofya nangu ukubepaya mu matololo mwine.

english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
translation: Mu matololo mwine naeba abana babo nati, “Imwe, ala mwilakonkelela fyebo ifyo bashinwe bapangile, mwilakonkelela misango yabo, kabili mwilaikowesha ku tulubi twabo.

english: I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
translation: Ine nine Yawe Lesa wenu. Mulenakila amafunde yandi, no kulasunga ifipope fyandi.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
translation: Mulecindika Amasabata yandi, epakuti yaleba icishibilo ca cumfwano cesu, epakuti kabili muleibukisha ukuti ine nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
translation: “‘Nomba abana babo kabili balinsangukila. Bapula na mu mafunde yandi, bakaana no kulasunga ifipope fyandi bwino bwino, ififwile ukulaletela ubumi bonse abalefikonka. Basuulila kumo na Masabata yandi yene. Na ine epakufwaya ukupongolwela icipyu candi pali bena, no kufwaya ukubalimuna bukali bukali mulya mwine mu matololo.

english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
translation: Lelo nabweseshe ukuboko kwandi, pantu nga nalilengele ishina lyandi ukusebana ku bantu ba mishobo abalemonako uko ine nalebafumyamo.

english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,
translation: Nakabili mu matololo mwine nabwekeshapo no mulapo. Nalapa ukuti ine nkabapashila mu mishobo ya bantu bambi, nkabasalanganishisha mu fyalo fimbi.

english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
translation: Ico nacitile ifyo, nico balisuulile ifipope fyandi, balipulile amafunde yandi, balisuulile na Masabata yene, balapepa na tulya twine tulubi twa fikolwe fyabo.

english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.
translation: Kanshi na ine nomba nalekafye bapoke amafunde ayashali mafunde yene yene, ne fipope ifishali fipope fine fine, ifintu ifishifwile kulaleta ubumi.

english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.”’
“Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
translation: “Kanshi iwe we mwana wa muntu, eba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli auti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Mu musango umo wine emo na bashinwe bampontele pakunsangukila.

english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
translation: Ilyo nabatwele mu calo ico nalaile ukubapeela, ilyo bamwenemo utupili tonse utwasansama, ne miti yonse iyalelema, awe nabo kabili epo balatuulila amalambo. Balenga nokuti mfulwe pa mulandu wa malambo ayo baleocelapo, na pa mulandu wa mituulo ya fyakunwa iyo baletwalapo.’

english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’
translation: Na ine epakubepusha nati, ‘Nga shilya ncende shasansama isho muyako, bushe ni ncende sha musango nshi?’ Kanshi ishi ncende shitwa ati ‘Bama’, ukushinta na pali nomba.

english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, eba abakalamba ba bena Israeli auti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Bushe imwe mwishile kukwipusha ifyo ine mfwaya, batini? Napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, ine nshamusuminishe ukwipushapo nangu cimo palwa ine.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?
translation: “Kanshi nomba eba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli auti, ifi efyasosa Mfumu Yawe ati, ‘Bushe imwe mulandu nshi mucitila ifibi fimo finefye ifyo na bashinwe bene balecita? Cinshi ico imwe mukonkelela utulubi twabo utushaibipila?

english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you!
translation: Ilyo mucili muletuula imituulo imo ine, no kulatuula abana benu nge lambo lyakoca, mulaikowesha nemwe bene ku tulubi tumo twine ukufika na lino line. Nga kanshi nomba imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, ine kuti namusuminisha shani ukuti muleisa kukwipusha ifyo ine mfwaya? Napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, ala ine nshakalemusuminisha ukwisa kukwipusha ifyo ine mfwaya.

english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’
translation: Imwe mwalipanga mu mitima yenu ukuba nge mishobo ya benafyalo. Imwe mwalipanga ukuba nga bantu bambi abaikala mu fyalo fimbi, abapepa ifimuti na mabwe, lelo imwe, awe tacakabe ifyo nakalya.’

english: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.
translation: Levi 26:33

english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
translation: Nkamufumya ukufuma mu mishobo, no kumulonganika ukufuma mu fyalo umo mwasalanganine ku kuboko ukwamaka kabili ukwafunguluka elyo ne cipyu icikalamba.

english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
translation: Nkamutwala mu ‘Matololo ya bantu ba mishobo,’ kulya kwine eko tukamonana nenu pakumupingula.

english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nga filya fine mu matololo ya calo ca Egupto napeele bashinwe umulandu, na imwe bene efyo nkamupeela umulandu.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
translation: “Ine nkamupisha mwisamba lya nkonto yandi iyabukacema pakumupenda, kabili nkamubika mu cipangano cimo pakumubwesha.

english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: Nkapatulapo bacisanguka muli imwe abo abantalamina. Kwena nkabafumya mu fyalo umo bacili baleikala, nomba nshakaleke bakabwelele mu calo ca Israeli iyoo. Lyena elyo mukeshiba ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord GOD says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.
translation: Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Imwe bonse mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, aleni konkanyenipofye ukulapepa utulubi twenu. Nomba ine ndemweba ukuti kuntanshi mukalaŋumfwila, lyena tamwakabwekeshepo nakabili ukulasaalula ne shina lyandi mukulatuula utulubi twenu imituulo.”

english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.
translation: “Bushe iwe we mwana wa muntu, teti ubapingule? Bushe teti ubapingule? Ubebelepo ifintu ifyabunani ifyo bashibo bacitile.

english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.
translation: Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Pa lupili lwandi ulwamushilo, ulupili ulutali ulwakwa Israeli, mu calo cilya, epo imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse mukalantuulila, na ine nkalamusekelela. Palya pene epo nkalafwaya imituulo yenu ne fyabupe fyenu ifyasalwa pamo pene na malambo yenu ayamushilo.

english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
translation: Ilyo nkamufumya mu mishobo umo bamusalanganishisha, elyo nkamupokelela ngo bubani ubwanunka ubusaka. Nkamufumya na mu fyalo ifyo mwapashilwemo no kumulonganya elyo nkamulanga ubucindami bwandi ubwamushilo pa cinso ca mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.
translation: Ilyo nkamubwesesha mu calo ca Israeli, ico nalapile ukupeela ifikolwe fyenu, elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.
translation: Elyo mukalaibukisha ifintu fyonse ifyabunani ifyo imwe mucita, nefyo muikowesha mwe bene. Ku mikoshi yenu kukalaselauka pa mulandu wa fibi fyonse ifyo imwe mucita.

english: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe, ilyo nkamucitila ukulingana no bucindami bwe shina lyandi, tekulingana ne myendele yenu iyibi nangu imisango yenu iyalubana, awe.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: Tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am the LORD your God;’
translation: Kabili bebe auti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe aleti, pa bushiku ilyo nasalile Israeli, ine nalilaile bamwana Yakobo nalundapo no mulapo. Kabili mu Egupto ine naliisokolwele kuli bena, no kubeba nati, “Ine nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
translation: Ni pa bushiku bwine ubo elyo ine nabalaile, nalundapo no mulapo ukuti nkabafumya mu Egupto no kubatwala mu calo ico ine nabafwaile, icalo icikankala icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci, icacila pa fyalo fimbi fyonse ku busuma.

english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
translation: Ine nalibebele ukuposa utulubi twabo utushaibipila uto batemwa, nalibebele no kukanaikowesha ku milungu yabufi iya mu Egupto, pantu ine nine Yawe wenu.

english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.
translation: Nomba kabili bena bantalamina, bakaana no kuŋumfwila. Bakaana ukuposa utulubi twabo utushaibipila, bakaana no kufumya amano yabo ku milungu yabufi iya mu Egupto. Na ine epakufwaya ukupongolwela icipyu candi pali bena no kufwaya ukubalimuna bukali bukali mulya mwine mu Egupto.

english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Lelo nabweseshe ukuboko kwandi, pantu nga nalilengele ishina lyandi ukusebana pa cinso ca mishobo ya benafyalo iyo abena Israeli baleikala nayo, pantu ni pa cinso cabo epo ine naebele abena Israeli ukuti imwe nkamufumya muno mu calo ca Egupto.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.
translation: Nalunonwa pakuti luleipaya,

english: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’
translation: “‘Ulupanga nalupeelwa ukuwamishiwa,

english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.
translation: Kuuta inkuuta, kabili ikatishafye umusowa,

english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ukweshiwa kukesa mu cinefye, kabili nga mwakonkanya ukukana alula imisango yenu, bushe ifi fyonse tafyakamuponene?’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.
translation: “Kanshi nomba we mwana wa muntu, sesema. Kumpa ku minwe, uleke ulupanga lukome imiku ibili nangu itatu. Lupanga lwakwipailako, ulupanga lwakwipailako icine cine. Lwakulatula monse monse pakwisa.

english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.
translation: Epakuti imitima yabo ilekubauka ku mwenso, na balefwa babe abengi. Na pa mpongolo shonse isha musumba, ine ninteyapo ulupanga ulwakulapita ngo mwele wa nkuba ulwakulalolelafye ukwipaya.

english: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.
translation: We lupanga ulwanonwa ulekoma uku noku, ku kulyo na ku kuso. Komena konsefye uko ulepilibukila.

english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”
translation: Na ine nomba nalaomba amapi, no bukali bwandi bwalapwa. Nine Yawe nalanda.”

english: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, kashile inshila shibili umo ulupanga lwa mfumu ya ku Babiloni luli nokwisa pita no lupanga lwaiko. Isho nshila shonse shibili shili nokutampila mu calo cimo cinefye. Ubikepo ne cishibilo pa mampatu ya nshila.

english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
translation: “Iwe we mwana wa muntu, ale pilibuka, losha amenso ku Yerusalemu. Shobola incende isho abantu bapepelapo. Elyo sesemena icalo ca Israeli.

english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
translation: Ushile icakulanga ulupanga inshila iyakuya lwisha ku Raba wa bena Amoni na imbi iyakuya lwisha icalo cakwa Yuda no musumba we linga uwa Yerusalemu.

english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.
translation: Pantu imfumu ya ku Babiloni ikeminina pa mampatu ya musebo apakumanina imisebo ibili kukufwaya ulubuko. Ikapendula ku mifwi, epakuti ishibe inshila iyakukonka. Ikepusha utulubi, ikalengula ne libu lya nama iyo baipaile utulubi.

english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.
translation: Ala nomba imfumu yaikata ku kulyo umufwi uusontele ku Yerusalemu. Yalaya kukwimikako ifyakututawilako ilinga, yalaita ifita fyaiko pakuti fitampe inkondo. Yalaya imika ifyakututawilako impongolo, ne fyakututawilako ifibumbili, ne fyakwimbilako icilindi icashika pakutebelela umusumba.

english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.
translation: Kuli bena cikamoneka kwati te cishinka pa mulandu wa cumfwano ico bacita. Nomba akabebukisha pa bubi bwabo no kubasenda bunkole.

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.
translation: Ifyo ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndemweba imwe nifi ukuti bumpulamafunde bwenu nabwishibikwa. Bonse nabeshiba ukuti imwe muli no mulandu. Mulalanga ububi bwenu mu fintufye fyonse ifyo imwe mucita. Namukwata umulandu, na ine kanshi nalamuposa ku balwani benu.

english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
translation: “Nobe we cilolo we kateeka wa calo ca Israeli, we mubi wa muntu we, nobe wine nomba ubushiku bwalafika ubwakukukanda umupwilapo.

english: the Lord GOD says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
translation: Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe, ale fuula icisote cobe icabufumu. Iyo nsalu upombele ku mutwe, ale ifuule. Nomba ifintu fyonse fyaaluka. Abalanda ebo nomba balaba bakateeka. Na bakateeka balaba abalanda.

english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’
translation: Owe we bonaushi. We bonaushi nobe. Umusumba nalaucita icibolya. Nomba mpaka akasuke akese uo nasala ukuti eo akese cibuula ngo mwine uwacishinka, kuli ena eo nkapeela.”

english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema amashiwi yandi. Kafishe amashiwi ayo ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndeeba abena Amoni, abatukaula abena Israeli. Kabebe utile,

english: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
translation: Eba abena Amoni ukuti ifimonwa ifyo bamona, ala fyabufi, nokuti ifyo basobela, ala nafyo fine fyabufi. Abena Amoni bantu ababi, kabili ulupanga lwalafika pa mikoshi yabo, no bushiku bumo ubwalabeshilila ebwakukandilwapo umupwilapo.

english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
translation: Kabili landa ku calo ici utile, ‘Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ine nimufulilwa. Nkasomona ulupanga lwandi mu citubo no kwipaya bonse, abololoke na babifi bene kumo.

english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
translation: “Bwesesha ulupanga mu citubo caluko. Iwe nkakupingwila mu ncende ine umo wapangilwe, mu calo mwine umo wafyalilwe emo nkakupingwila.

english: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.
translation: Ilyo nkakwimina ngo lubingu lwa mulilo, elyo iwe ukomfwa apapela icipyu candi. Nkakuposa na ku bantu ababa nge fiswango ku bukali, ku bantu abaishiba ukonaula.

english: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, the LORD, have spoken it.”’”
translation: Iwe ukonaika ku mulilo nge nkuni. Umulopa obe ukasuumina mu calo cobe mwine, takwakamoneke nakabili uukalakwibukisha. Pantu nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.
translation: Nkalaipaya abololoke na babifi bonse pamo, eico ulupanga lwandi lukasomoka mu citubo no kwipaya bonse ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kuso na ka ku kulyo.

english: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’
translation: Epakuti abantu bonse bakashininkishe ukuti ine ne Yawe nine nsomwene ulupanga lwandi mu citubo, kabili talwakatale alubwelelamo iyoo.’

english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.
translation: “Kanshi we mwana wa muntu, akukoloma icikolomo pa menso yabo, ube no mutima uwalanguluka no bulanda ubukalamba nganshi.

english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Nga bakwipusha umulandu ulekolomena, ubasuke auti, ‘Mulandu wa lyashi ilileisa.’ Imitima yabo ikalakubauka ku mwenso uukabekata, na maboko yabo yakatompoka. Amano yabo yakapela, mu makufi yabo mukapomponteka. Ala cili mukwisa, mpakafye cikafikilishiwe.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema amashiwi yandi. Eba abantu ukuti ine ne Yawe ndetila nati,

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
translation: Muli iwe bamo balasendama na bamuka bashibo. Bamo balapatikisha abanakashi pakuti basendame nabo pa nshita abo banakashi bali kumpepo.

english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
translation: Bamo balasendama na bamukabene, bambi nabo balakowesha banafyalebo ukwabula ne nsoni, bambi basendama na bankashi shabo abafyalwafye kuli shibo umo wine.

english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ukuf 20:12

english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.
translation: “Wamona, nakumpa indupi shandi pa mulandu wa bupupu bobe no mulopa wasumya mukati kobe.

english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken it, and will do it.
translation: Ilyo ine nkakukanda, bushe iwe uleti ukayuminishako nangu ukushanshako? Nine ne Yawe ndelanda, no kucita ndi nokucita.

english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.
translation: Ine abantu bobe nkabasalanganishisha mu mishobo no kubasalanganya mu fyalo fyonse, ne fibi ifyo iwe ucita ine nkafilesha.

english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
translation: Amaf 5:16

english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ifyo ine mbamona, awe fyanangwafye fyabantu. Baba kwati ni munyela uwasakanamo no mukuba ne lata ne cela no mutofwe, filya fishala mwilungu ilyo silifa alopololwamo.

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
translation: Amaf 16:19

english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, bushe ulefwaya ukupingula umulandu wa musumba? Bushe ulefwaya ukupingula umusumba uwasuuminamo umulopa. Uwebelepo uyu musumba pa mulandu wa fintu fyonse ifyo ucita ifyabunani.

english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
translation: Nga filya fine babika mwilungu silifa no mukuba ne cela no mutofwe ne lata kukufyengulula, efyo nkamulonganika mu cipyu candi no bukali bwandi no kumwengulula nga filya fine umulilo mwilungu wengulula ifintu.

english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.’”
translation: Mukasungulukila mu Yerusalemu nga filya fine silifa asungulukila mwilungu, elyo mukeshiba ukuti nine ne Yawe namuponesha ubukali bwandi.’”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Nakabili ishiwi lyakwe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, eba icalo ukuti mwabafye nge calo umo imfula ishatalile ailoka, umo icipungufula cishatalile aciloka nangu ukusansamo ilyo nabafulilwe.

english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
translation: Ukuf 22:25

english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
translation: Bashimapepo balonaula amafunde yandi, kabili tabacindika na fintu fyandi ifyamushilo. Tabamona ifyamushilo ifyo fyalekana ne fishili ifyamushilo. Pakufunda tabalekanya ifintu ifikowesha abantu ne fishikowesha, kabili tabasakamana na Masabata yandi yene. E mulandu wine abena Israeli bashincindikila.

english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
translation: Abakalamba babuteeko nabo baba nge mimbulu iyiletakanya inama iyo ikete. Balepaya abantu no kusumya umulopa pakuti banonkelepo icuma.

english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
translation: Bakasesema nabo tabalandapo pali ubu bubi, babufisa kwati bantu baleshingula iloba ilyabuuta ku cibumba. Ifimonwa fyabo nafyo fyabufifye, nefyo basobela nafyo fine fyabufifye. Baimona kwati bantu abalelanda amashiwi ayafumine kuli ine ne Mfumu Yawe, nelyo nshibebele nelyo kamo.

english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
translation: Abekalacalo nabo balacita ulufyengo no bupupu. Balacusha abapina na balanda, balacusha abeni no kukanabacitila icilungeme.

english: You shall say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
translation: Kabili utile, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe aleti, iwe we musumba we uiletela ubupingushi, pantu iwe walipaya abantu bobe abengi, kabili iwe walikowela kukupepa utulubi.

english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
translation: Levi 19:30

english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Kanshi ine ndi nokupongolola icipyu candi pali bena, nkabonaula nga filya ficita umulilo, epakuti nkabalimune pa mulandu wa fintu ifyo bacita. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
translation: Umulandu wakwata wakwipaya abantu, no wakuikowesha ku tulubi uto waipangila we mwine. Eico kanshi ubushiku bwalakwishila, naulenga nokuti inshita yobe ipwe. Eico nkakulenga ukuti ukabe uwasebana ku bantu ba mishobo yonse imbi kabili uwasekwa ku bantu ba mu fyalo fimbi fyonse.

english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
translation: Ifyalo fyamupepi ne fyakutali fyakulakupumya pa mulandu wa kuipumbusha kobe, na kulwa cimfulunganya cobe.’

english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
translation: “Mona ifyo aba bacilolo bonse aba bena Israeli babomfya amaka yabo pakwipaya abantu.

english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
translation: Muli iwe we musumba tamwaba nelyo umo uucindika abafyashi bakwe. Muli iwe balatitikisha na beni, kabili ulafyenga bamukamfwilwa na bana banshiwa.

english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
translation: Taucindika fintu ifyamushilo, kabili tausunga na Masabata yandi.

english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
translation: Muli iwe mwaba ababukwakwa abaikalilafye ukusumya umulopa. Ni muli iwe emwaba abaliila pa mfuba sha pa mpili no kucita ifyamuselu.

english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
translation: Nabo basuka bamufuula, bamusha ubwamba, bamupoka bamwane abaume na banakashi, bamwipaya na ku lupanga. Awe na banakashi mpangafye yonse balamulandapo ilyo bamupeseshe.

english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
translation: “Nkashi nankwe Oliba nangu amweneko ifyo fyonse, awe wena alicililepo ukuba cimbi cimbifye, no bulalelale bwakwe bwalicilile no bwakwa nkashi nankwe Ohola.

english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
translation: Oliba alebilimafye kukutemwisha abena Asiria abali abalashi elyo ne ntungulushi sha fita ishabuteeko, na bashilika abalefwala insalu ishisuma, na bamushika abaleendela pali bakabalwe, aba bonse bali abalumendo abayemba beka beka.

english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.
translation: Na ine epakumona ukuti awe nao wine ubulalelale bwakwe bwabipisha, balinganafye no wamukalamba ku bubi.

english: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,
translation: Awe bucilende bwakwa Oliba bwalacililakofye asuka alatamba na baume abalengelwe pa cibumba, ifipasho fya bena Kaludea ifyo balengele mwilangi ilyakashika,

english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
translation: abaume abali ne mishipi iyakakwa mu misana yabo, ne nsalu ishapombwa ku mitwe yabo. Bonse balemoneka nge ntungulushi sha bashilika abena Babiloni abafuma ku calo ca Kaludea.

english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
translation: Kuti nga aloleshapo, awe no mutima munda walabilimafye kukushikumbwa, asuka nomba alatumina ne ntungulushi shine inkombe ku calo ica Kaludea.

english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.
translation: Abena Babiloni nabo epakulaisa kuli ena ku busanshi bwa citemwiko, na mu lwinso lwabo bamukowesha icakuti pakulekelesha nao asuka abatendwa.

english: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.
translation: Ilyo atwalilile na bucilende bwakwe, aleitakisha pa lwalala pali bucilende bwakwe, alefuula alelangisha no mubili wakwe. Na ine nasukile natendwa, nga filya fine natendelwe nkashi nankwe.

english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
translation: Awe nao elyo nomba acilililako ukulacita ubulalelale ubo atampilefye mu Egupto, ilyo ali umukashana.

english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, kale kwaliko abanakashi babili abafyelwe inda imo.

english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
translation: Kulya eko alatemwisha impusaushi sha baume ishali ne mibili ikulu nge ya bapunda, iyaluma ubushinso mukwitulula nge mfalashi.

english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.
translation: Iwe Oliba, ulefwaya nakabili ukulacita ubulalelale, nga filya walecita ilyo wali umukashana mu Egupto, umo abaume balekutonya amabele no kulakupampanta.

english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:
translation: “Kanshi we Oliba ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, iwe nautendwa balya bantu watemenwe, nomba ine nkalenga bakakufulilwe, no kukushinga bakese kushinguluka mpangafye yonse.

english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
translation: Abena Babiloni na bena Kaludea bonse, abena Pekodi, na bena Shoa, na bena Koa, na bena Asiria bonse, aba bonse bali abalumendo abayemba, bonse bali balashi elyo ne ntungulushi sha fita, abendela pali bakabalwe. Bonse bali abakalamba mu milimo yabuteko kabili abaleendela pali bakabalwe.

english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
translation: Pakwisa kusansa bakesa ne fyanso, amaceleta, ne fya mipeto fimbi elyo ne fita ifingi. Pakukushinguluka bakekatilila inkwela ishikalamba ne shinono, no kufwala ifimpompo. Nine nkabeba ukukupingula, nabo bakakupingula ukulingana ne fyebo fyabo.

english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.
translation: Nkaleka bakakutakanye ku cipyu candi, pantu ine ninkufulilwa. Bakakuteta imyona na matwi, bakepaya na bonse abakashalamo ku lupanga. Bakakupoka bamwano abaume na banakashi, bakaboce na mu mulilo.

english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.
translation: Bakakulepawila ifyakufwala, no kukufuula ifisamiko ifyayemba.

english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’
translation: Efyo ine nkakupwisha bucilende bobe, nkakupwisha ne myendele yobe imbi iyabipisha iyo wakwete ilyo wali mu Egupto. Tawakatale nakabili aufuluka nelyo ukwibukisha icalo cabo.

english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ine nkakutwala ku bantu abo iwe wapata, kabili abo watendwa.

english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
translation: Bakakupokafye fyonse ifyo wabombela, elyo kabili bakakushe ubwamba, pantu nabo bene balikupata. Bakakusha ukwabula ukufwala, epakuti ukaseebane pali bucilende bobe. Ubupulumushi bobe na bucilende

english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.
translation: Baikele mu calo ca Egupto, nomba ilyo bali abakashana, balecita ubulalelale baposele ifisungu fyabo, balebapampanta no kubatonya na mabele ku baume yasuka yakopoka.

english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.
translation: efikakuletelela, pantu walekumbwa imishobo pakucita nabo bucilende, twasuka no tulubi twabo twakukowesha.

english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’
translation: Walikonkelela imisango yakwa nkashi mbiyo, e mulandu wine na ine nkabika ulukombo lwakwa nkashi mbiyo mu minwe yobe.”

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘You will drink of your sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You will be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
translation: Ukakolwa no kwikatwa ubulanda,

english: You will even drink it and drain it out. You will gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear your breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
translation: Kabili ukalunwa no kufipilila,

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Apofye walindaba no kumfutatila, ukaculilapo pa bupusaushi na pali bucilende bobe.”

english: The LORD said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
translation: Kabili Yawe alinjebele ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe ulefwaya ukupingula Ohola na Oliba? Kanshi iwe bakalipile pa fintu ifyabunani ifyo bacita.

english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.
translation: Balyobelwa ku bucende no mulopa uli mu minwe yabo, balacita ubucende no tulubi twabo, balipaya abana abaume abo bafyele kuli ine. Balibuula abana bandi no kubatuula ilambo ilyakupakisha utulubi.

english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
translation: Teapo peka bapelela iyoo, balilundapo no kukowesha icifulo candi icamushilo, no konaula Amasabata yandi.

english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.
translation: Batile bashiipaya abana babo pakubatuula ilambo ku tulubi, ubo bwine bushiku balishile no kukowesha cifulo candi icamushilo. Nefi efyo bacita mu ŋanda yandi.

english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
translation: Uwamukalamba aleitwa Ohola, emukuti e Samaria wine, uwamwaice aleitwa Oliba, emukuti e Yerusalemu wine. Bonse babili nine nabopile, nabo bamfyalila na bana abaume na banakashi.

english: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,
translation: “Kabili balitumine inkombe ishakuya ita abaume abali ukutali, awe nabo baisa. Pakusembeleka abaume, abanakashi epakusamba, basuba na mafuta bapenta na ku menso, bafwala ne fyakuisamika ifyamutengo.

english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
translation: Baikala na pa musengele uusuma, bapalamika ne tebulo ilyo baanshikepo ubusaka. Babikapo ububani na mafuta ya miolifa, ifintu ifyali fyandi.

english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi ashingulwikwe ne bumba lya bamungulu abalecita icongo, elyo mu matololo mwafumine ibumba lya bacakolwa nabo bafwika na banakashi amakosa ku maboko, ne ngala ishayemba ku mitwe.

english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’
translation: Na ine epakulanda palwa uyo umwanakashi uo bucilende bwaonaula nati, nabatwalilile ukumubomfya muli bucilende, pantu ena efyo aba.

english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
translation: Na baume bacili baleya uko ali, kwati ni kuli cilende baleya. Efyo baya na kuli Ohola na Oliba.

english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
translation: Nomba abantu abololoke bakabapeela umulandu kulwa bucende bwabo, na kulwa bupondo bwabo, pantu balacita ubucende no kulaipaisha abantu.”

english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Kabakuutile ibumba lya bantu, uleke lise libatiinye libatape ne fyuma fyabo.

english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
translation: Leka ibumba libatobaule amabwe, no kubasansa no lupanga, bakepaye abana babo abaume na banakashi, no kubocela amayanda yabo.

english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
translation: Efyo ine nkapwisha ubupulumushi mu calo no kusoka abanakashi bonse ukukanacita ubucende, ngefi imwe mulecita.

english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Elyo na imwe mwe nkashi shibili, ine nkamulimuna pali bucilende bwenu, na pa bubifi bwenu ubwakupepa utulubi. Lyena mukashininkisha ukuti ine nine Mfumu Yawe.”

english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
translation: “Nomba Ohola nangu ali mukashi wandi, awe ena akonkanyapofye ukuba cilende, alabilimafye kukutemwisha bacibusa bakwe abaume abena Asiria abali abashilika,

english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
translation: abalefwala insalu ishacifufya, bali balashi elyo ne ntungulushi sha fita ishabuteeko. Nabo bonse bali abalumendo abayemba beka abaleendela pali bakabalwe.

english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.
translation: Ku bena Asiria bonse bashimucindikwa, eko Ohola aipeele ukucita nabo ubulalelale, bwasuka ubulalelale bwakwe bwamutwala na kukuikowesha mukulapepa utulubi twa bena Asiria.

english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.
translation: Abikilepofye ukulacita bulalelale ubo atampile mu Egupto, umo aposele icisungu cakwe. Abaume balesendama nankwe balemupampanta balemutonya amabele, no kulacitisha nankwe ifyabupusaushi.

english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakumulekamo, pakuti aleyangalila na bacibusa bakwe abena Asiria abo alefwaisha.

english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele pabula, pa bushiku ubwalenga ikumi mu mweshi we kumi ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.
translation: Kanshi leteni inkuni na shimbi.

english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.
translation: Ale nomba tekapo umupika weka weka pa musolilo,

english: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.
translation: Nomba nacifilikwa, pantu indalawa tashapwile shonse iyoo, nangu yatekelwe pa mulilo.

english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.
translation: Iwe imisango yobe iyabupusaushi yalikukowesha. Nangu ine njesha ukukuwamya, awe ushalafye umo wakowelela. Ukawamishiwafye ilyo ukomfwa apapela icipyu candi.’

english: “‘“I, the LORD, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Ine ne Yawe nalanda ukuti, ‘Inshita naifika iyakuti ncitepo cimo. Nshalekepofye iyoo, kabili nshalanguluke nangu ukumfwa uluse nakalya. Ndekukanda pafyo iwe ucita na pa mibeele yobe.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ine ndekupumikisha pakusenda umuntu uo watemwisha nganshi. Kanshi iwe tecakwesha kuilishanyapo, nangu ukupumapo umusowa, nangu ukulukushapo icilamba.

english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”
translation: Wileka bomfweko uko uleshinshimukila. Wifuula ne cimo ku mutwe, kabili wifuula nsapato shobe pakulanga ukuti uli ne cililo. Wifimba na pa kanwa, kabili wiesha kulya icakulya ico abantu balya pa cililo.”

english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
translation: Kanshi na ine ulucelocelo nalandile ku bantu, awe na cine icungulo umukashi wandi afwa no kufwa. Ulucelo ulwakonkelepo nacitilafye umo naebelwe.

english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
translation: Elyo abantu banjipusha abati, “Bushe tekuti utulondolwele umo ifi fintu filolele kuli ifwe?”

english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, lemba ifi pa bushiku bwa lelo, ni pali buno bushiku epo imfumu ya ku Babiloni iletampa ukutebelela Yerusalemu.

english: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kanshi na ine epakubasuka nati, “Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyacisa kuli ine aliti,

english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
translation: ‘Landa ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli utile, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ifyakuti, ine nalaswa nkoweshe icifulo candi icamushilo, ishintililo lyenu ilyo mutakishishamo, ilimulenga ukusansamuka pakuimona, kabili ukufuluka kwa mitima yenu. Abana benu abaume na banakashi abashala mu Yerusalemu, bakafwa ku nkondo.

english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
translation: Elyo nemwe mukacita ngefi fine ine ncitile. Tamwakafimbe na pa kanwa, kabili tamwakalye cakulya cilya mulya pa cililo.

english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
translation: Tamwakafuule ne cimo ku mitwe yenu, kabili tamwakafuule nsapato shenu, tamwakaleshinshimukila, nangufye ukupumapo imisowa. Mukondelapo palwa kubifya kwenu, no kulilishika kukaba pakati kenu.

english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”
translation: Esekieli akaba icilangililo kuli imwe, mukacitile ngomo mwine acitile. Ilyo ifi fintu fikacitika, elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi nine Mfumu Yawe.’”

english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—
translation: Kabili epakunjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, ine nkabapoka iŋanda yandi iyo bashintililamo kabili iyo basansamukilamo ilyo baleitamba no kulaipempula. Kabili nkabapoka na bana babo abaume na banakashi.

english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
translation: Ubushiku nkacita ifyo, nga pakapusunsukapo umo, uyo wine ninshi eukesa mushimikila umulandu.

english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: Iwe ukalanda neyo ine mbutushi, elyo ukutula pali ubo bwine bushiku nobe tawakatale auba cibulu nakabili. Kanshi iwe ukaba icishibilo, ni kuli iwe bakamwena no kwishibila ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.
translation: Eba ulu uluko lusangu ili pinda utile, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.
translation: Yere 52:4

english: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”
translation: Ubuulepo pa fitekwa iyatuulukisha.

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is in it, and whose rust hasn’t gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece without casting lots for it.
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe asosa ati, ‘Washama we musumba uusumya umulopa. Umusumba uuli ngo mupika wa ndalawa uushatala aukuuswa. Mupungulemo inama shonse, ukwabula ukushamo nelyo imo.

english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.
translation: Mwali ubupondo mu musumba uwakusumya umulopa. Umulopa tawalekonkolokela pa mushili apakuti ulukungu lwaushika iyoo, walekonkolokela pa mwalala we bwe.

english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”
translation: Na ine wine epo ngulekele ube, pakuti ulemoneka, kukwimya icipyu candi pakulandwilapo mu bukali.’

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: Ine nkapesha abena Moabu, elyo nabo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”
translation: Kabili ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Pa mulandu wakuti abena Edomu balandwile pa bena Yuda, no kuiletelela umulandu abene palwa cilandushi cabo,

english: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.
translation: Amosi 1:13-15

english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Abantu bandi abena Israeli ebakanandwilako abena Edomu, bakomfwikishe apapela ubukali bwandi ne cipyu candi. Elyo abena Edomu bakeshiba ifyo ciba ku bantu abo nacitapo icilandushi.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”
translation: Kabili ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Pa mulandu wakuti abena Filisiti bacitile icilandushi no kulandula no musaalula mu mitima yabo pa balwani babo, abo bapatana nabo nakale, no kufwaya ukubalofya kumpatilafye,

english: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
translation: cisuma, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nomba ndelanda ukuti nkabasansa abena Filisiti, no kubalofya nkabalofya. Nkalofya na bena Kereti, na bonsefye abashala mu lulamba lwa bemba.

english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
translation: Nkacita kuli bena icilandushi icikalamba no kubakanda apapela icipyu candi. Elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe, ilyo nkacita icilandushi pali bena.’”

english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, losha amenso ku bena Amoni, kaseseme pakubakalipila.

english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
translation: Kabebe auti, ‘Umfweni amashiwi yakwa Yawe umwine wa maka yonse ayakuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, imwe mwalisansamuka pakumona ifyo bakowesha icifulo candi icamushilo. Mwalitemwa pakumona ifyo icalo ca Israeli caonaika, na pakumona uko abena Yuda balesendwa bunkole.

english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti imwe mwalitemwa, na ine kanshi nkamupeela ku bantu ba mishobo iyaba mu matololo ya ku kabanga nge cikwatwa cabo. Mu calo cenu bakesa kuulamo insakwe, no kwikala emo bakaleikala. Bakesa mukulamuliila ifisabo, no kulamunwena umukaka.

english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: Umusumba wenu uwa Raba nkausangula itanga lya ngamila, ne calo cenu conse imwe mwe bena Amoni ine nkacisangula incende iyakucemenamo impaanga, epakuti mukashininkishe ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’

english: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
translation: “Pantu ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Imwe mulatota amapi no kulacinda ne nsansa pakuseka icalo ca Israeli no musaalula wa mu mitima yenu yonse.

english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: Cisuma, na ine kanshi nomba nkamuposa ku mishobo ya benafyalo, uleke ikamutape fyonse. Nkamulofyafye bonse, epakuti umutundu wenu ukalobe. Lyena elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’
translation: Sefa 2:8-11

english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
translation: Cisuma, na ine kanshi nkaleka ikasanswe imisumba iyilinda imipaka ya calo ca bena Moabu, no musumba wabo uwawamisha uwa Beti Yeshimoti, no wa Beti Meoni, no wa Kiriataimu.

english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi na umo, pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
translation: Walaisa kungwa no lukungu ulo bakabalwe balaisa mukulafutumuna. Icongo ca bakabalwe babo abatinta ifyakusendelamo ifipe, neca maceleta yene, ala calaisa tenkanya amalinga yobe, ilyo balaisa mukulapitila pa mpongolo sha musumba, uwalaisa shala icibolya.

english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
translation: Abendela pali bakabalwe balaisa mukulapitana mu misebo yobe, baleipayamo na bantu bobe ku lupanga. Inceshi shobe ishamaka shalaisa bongololwa.

english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
translation: Abalwani bobe balaisa kutapila ifyuma, kumo kwine ne fintu ifyo ushitisha. Balaisa bongolola amalinga yobe na mayanda yobe yene ayacindama. Balaisa sendapo amabwe ne myalo ne fibungulubwe fyonse, bakafiposa na muli bemba.

english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nalaleka pabefye umwalala we bwe, uwakuti abalondo balekanikapo amasumbu yabo. Iwe we musumba tawakabukululwe nakabili iyoo.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ku bena Turi ati, ‘Bushe abekala mu lulamba lwa bemba tabakatutume pakumfwa icongo ca kuwa kobe no kuteta kwa bacenenwe no kukoma kwa lupanga ifikacitwa kuli imwe?

english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
translation: Ishamfumu shonse ishateeka imishobo ya bantu abendauka pali bemba, shikema pa fipuna fyashiko, shikafuula imingila na malaya ayayemfiwa shikekala panshi no kulaikankilafye ku mwenso. Shikekatwa no mwenso pa mulandu wa fintu ifikakuponena, icakuti shikafilwa no kuleka ukulakanka.’

english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”
translation: Pakuloosha shikalakwimbila ulu lwimbo ashiti,

english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’
translation: Ubushiku waonaikamo ifyalo fya ku lulamba lwa bemba fileitutuminafye ku mwenso,

english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Iwe nalakwalula icibolya nga ilya misumba yaonaika, umushaikala muntu. Nalakwibisha petenga pali bemba.

english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, abantu ba mu musumba wa Turi balalanda ne nsansa abati, ‘Eya umusumba wa Yerusalemu uwaba inshila ya ku makwebo naubongoloka. Impongolo shauko shishelefye pwampwa, apo Yerusalemu acimbile, nomba nifwe twalaba abakankala.’

english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
translation: Nalakuposa mu nindi umwakuti uleikala pamo na bantu abaliko kale pano calo. Nalakubika panshi mu calo icaonaika, icaba icibolya ca pe, umwakuti uleikala pamo na bafwa. Tawakatale aubwelako pakwisa ikala nakabili na bomi iyoo.

english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”
therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
translation: Cisuma, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Imwe mwe bena Turi, ne mulwani wenu nomba nine. Ine nine nkemya abantu bambi aba mu mishobo iyingi pakuti bakese musansa imwe, bakesa nga filya amatamba ya muli bemba yacita.

english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
translation: Yoeli 3:4-8

english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
translation: Turi akasanguka incende apo abalondo bakalakanika amasumbu yabo, kabili akashalafye ifyo fine muli bemba.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo ebakatapa Turi,

english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
translation: na balya bene abantu abekala ku mulundu bakabepaila ku lupanga. Elyo abena Turi bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nalaswa ndete Nebukadinesa, imfumu ya ku Babiloni, imfumu ya shamfumu, ndemuleta kukusansa Turi. Aletulila ku kapinda ka ku kuso, aleisa ne fita ifingi nganshi pamo na bakabalwe, na maceleta, ne fita ifyendela pali bakabalwe.

english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
translation: Abantu abekala mu mishi iyafumamo iyabela pa mulundu, balefwa ku buta. Abalwani baleisa imba icilindi icashika pakulanga ifyo bakutebelele, bacite ne fibumbili, batantike ne nkwela ishakuubamo pakukulwisha iwe Turi.

english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
translation: Amosi 1:9-10

english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.
translation: “Abashilika ba ku Pesia, na ku Lidia na ku Puti, baishile mukulabombela pamo ne fita fyobe. Balekobeka inkwela shabo ne fisote fyabo mu musumba obe. Ebalengele nokuti ulumbuke.

english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.
translation: Abashilika ba ku Afadi na ku Heleke ebalelinda amalinga yobe, na bena Gamadi ebalelinda impungu shobe. Balekobeka inkwela shabo ku malinga yobe. Ebalengele nokuti ube uwapwililika kukuyemba.

english: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
translation: “Mwaleshitishanya amakwebo ya fintu na bena Tashishi. Pa fyuma fyobe ifishaifulila, iwe walemwenapo silifa, ne fyela, na malata, ne mitofwe.

english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
translation: Walecita amakwebo mu calo ca Yafani , na mu calo ca Tubali, na mu calo ca Mesheki, na mu fyuma fyobe walekabulamo abasha ne fintu ifya mukuba.

english: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
translation: Abena Beti Togama balekabula bakabalwe abakubomfya imilimo, na bakwendelapo mu nkondo, pamo pene na bapunda.

english: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
translation: Walecita amakwebo na bena Rodesi , na bantu ba mu fyalo ifingi ifya mu lulamba lwa bemba. Walebakabusha ifyuma fyobe, pakuti balekupeelelapo ameno ya nsofu na eboni iya mbao.

english: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
translation: Abena Aramu baleshita ifipe fyobe, pantu walepanga ifingi. Balekuletela utumabwe twamutengo twa tokisi kabili utwafitulukila, ne nsalu ishakashikila, ne shapikulwa mumbali, ne shatelela, na kolali, no tumabwe utukankala utwakashikila utwa rubi. Ifi fintu efyo baleshitamo ifyuma fyobe.

english: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
translation: “Abena Yuda na bena Israeli nabo bene mwaleshitana nabo ifyuma, bena balekuletela iŋanu ya ku Miniti, na makunyu, no buci, na mafuta ya miolifa, ne fintu ifyanunka ubusaka.

english: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
translation: Abena Damasiko baleshita ifipe fyobe ifingi, pantu ifyo walepanga fyalifulisha. Balekuletela ubwalwa bwa mwangashi uwalefuma ku Heliboni, na masako ya mpaanga ishabuuta aya ku Saha.

english: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
translation: Abena Dani na Bagiriki ukufuma ku Usali balekushitisha ne fyela ifyo balefula, ne fintu ifyanunka ubusaka kasia no mumfwemfwe, pakuti nobe ulebashitishako ifyuma fyobe.

english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ale nomba imba ulwimbo ulwakuloosha Turi.

english: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.
translation: Abena Dedani baleleta amalangeti yalya bekalapo abendela pali bakabalwe, nabo ni pakuti baleshitamo ifintu fyobe.

english: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
translation: Abena Arabia na bakateeka ba calo ca Keda, nabo baleisa no twana twa mpaanga, na basukusuku, ne mbushi, pakuti baleshitamo ifyuma fyobe.

english: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.
translation: Bashimakwebo ba ku Sheba na ba ku Rama baleisa ne fintu ifyanunka ubusaka nganshi, na mabwe ayamutengo na golide, nabo efintu baleshitamo ifyuma fyobe.

english: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
translation: Aba mu musumba wa Harani, no wa Kane, no wa Edeni, na bashimakwebo ba ku Sheba, na ba mu musumba wa Ashuri, no wa Kilimadi, aba bonse mwaleshitishanya nabo ifintu.

english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.
translation: Mu ncende shenu isha makwebo balekushitisha insalu ishikankala, ishakashikila, ne shapikulwa mumbali, ne fikuutulo ifyakunyantapo ifyabeka kabili ifyamindoloshi, ne myando iyakosa, ne fitabataba ifyamaka.

english: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
translation: Umulongo wa fimato ifikulu ifya ku Tashishi ewaletunta ifyuma fyobe.

english: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
translation: Abalekooba bakutwele pakati ka bemba,

english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.
translation: Ifyuma fyobe fyonse ne fyakukabushanya,

english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
translation: Ku nkuuta iyikalamba iya bakensha wa mato,

english: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,
translation: Na bonse abensha amato,

english: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
translation: Landa pali Tuti, ulya umusumba uwaba mu lulamba lwa bemba, uucita amakwebo na bantu abaikala mu lulamba lonse ulwa bemba. Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.
translation: Bonse niwe baleloosha nganshi,

english: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
translation: Nababeya ulukuso pakulanga ubulanda,

english: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’
translation: Ilyo balelila nokukuloosha, balekuloosesha mu lwimbo abati,
