english: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
translation: Ilyo walepatula ifyuma fyobe ifyamakwebo pali bemba,

english: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.
translation: Awe nomba naubongolokela pali bemba,

english: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.
translation: Abantu bonse abaikala mu lulamba lwa bemba bekelefye inkumbabulili

english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”
translation: Bashimakwebo ba mishobo ya benafyalo nabapapa pali iwe,

english: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
translation: Iwe apo waikala ni pali bemba.

english: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
translation: Imiti iyo balepwileko imbao ishakukupangilako yafumine ku Seni ,

english: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.
translation: Ifimuti fya oki ifya ku Bashani efyo babashileko inkafi shobe,

english: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
translation: Insalu shobe ishakukolelako umwela pakwensha

english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
translation: Bacoba bobe bantu bafumine mu musumba wa Sidoni no wa Afadi,

english: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.
translation: Abakalamba ba ku Gebali ne ncenshi shabo

english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: Ukafwa ngo ushasembululwa

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, lilila imfumu ya ku Turi ubulanda. Kayebe ukuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.
translation: Waikele mu Edeni mwibala lyakwa Lesa,

english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.
translation: Wasubilwe nga kerubi kalinda,

english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
translation: Imibeele yobe tayakwete ububi,

english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.
translation: Mukupekapeka kwa makwebo yobe ayengi

english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.
translation: Mu mutima obe waleitakisha pa busuma bobe,

english: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.
translation: Mu makwebo yobe ayabula icishinka no kubifya apakalamba

english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”
translation: Abantu ba mishobo imbi abakwishiba balepapafye,

english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, eba kateeka wa Turi ukuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.
translation: Kawebe ukuti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Nkakuletela icikuko,

english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
translation: “Pa mishobo yonse iyashinguluka aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, kabili iyabasuula, awe tapakabe nomba nelyo umo uukalabacusha nangufye ukubekatamo. Elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ine nkafumya aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli mu mishobo umo basalanganina, nkababwesesha na kumyabo, elyo ne mishobo yonse ikashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine ndi wamushilo. Aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bakekala mu calo cabo ico napeele umubomfi wandi Yakobo.

english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”
translation: Bakalaikalamo ukwabula ukutiina nelyo cimo. Bakalakuulamo amayanda, no kulalimamo imyangashi. Nkakanda abena mupalamano babo bonse ababasuulile, lyena abena Israeli bakalaikalila na ku matwi tondolo. Elyo bakeshiba ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe Lesa wabo.’”

english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.
translation: Bushe kuti wacila Daniele amano, mwa?

english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.
translation: Walinonka ifyuma ifingi ku mano yobe na ku bucenjeshi bobe.

english: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”
translation: Walicenjela mukucita amakwebo,

english: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe asosa ati,

english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.
translation: ine nkakuletela abenafyalo umushobo wa bantu abashaba na luse.

english: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
translation: Bakakuposa panshi ku nindi,

english: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
translation: Ilyo bakesa kwipaya,

english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi, pa bushiku ubwalenga ikumi limo na shibili (12), mu mweshi walenga ikumi, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
translation: Ala ine nomba ninkwalukila, ninjalukila ne milonga ya Nailo ine. Icalo ca Egupto nkacisangula amatololo kabili icaonaika umushaba kantu ukutula ku musumba wa Migidoli ukuyafye na ku musumba wa Siene, mpaka ukuya shintafye na mu mipaka ya calo ca Kushi .

english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.
translation: Tamwakatale amumoneka lukasa lwa muntu nangufye ulwa nama. Tamwakekale muntu nangufye inama pa myaka amakumi yane (40).

english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”
translation: Pa fyalo fyonse ifyo ine nasangula amatololo, icalo ca Egupto cena eco nkacishapo. Imisumba ya mu Egupto ikashala ifibolya pa myaka amakumi yane (40), nafyo ifibolya fikabipisha no kucila imisumba yonse iyaonaika. Abena Egupto nkabasalanganya, bakabutukila mu fyalo fyonse, no kulaikala na bantu ba mishobo imbi.

english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Imyaka amakumi yane (40) nga yapwa, elyo nkalonganya abena Egupto, nkabafumya mu bantu ba mishobo imbi umo nabasalanganishishe.

english: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
translation: Nkaleka bakekale mu Egupto, lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, mu ka calo ka Patirosi umo ifikolwe fyabo fyatuntwike. Emo bakakwatila ubufumu ubwacepesha nganshi.

english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.
translation: Pantu bukasaluka ukucila ubufumu bumbi bonse, kabili tabakatale abateekapo abantu ba mishobo imbi nakalya.

english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”’”
translation: Aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli tabakatale nakabili abaposako amano ku bena Egupto, cikabashinina aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ukuti kanshi balubilefye ilyo babikile amano ku bena Egupto. Kanshi elyo bakeshiba ukuti nine Imfumu Yawe.’”

english: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27), pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi wapakubala, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni nasansa umusumba wa Turi. Abashilika bakwe babombeshe na maka nganshi, icakuti ne mitwe yabo naikusulukako imishishi yonse, na mabeya yabo yonse yakusulukile kumo, lelo imfumu pamo na bashilika baiko bene baicuushishefye, tabamwenepo kantu nakalya.

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nalapeela imfumu Nebukadinesa icalo ca Egupto. Alatapa icalo, asende ne fyuma fyaciko fyonse, e malipilo ya fita fyakwe.

english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nalamupeela icalo ca Egupto, ekumulambula pa mulimo wakwe, pantu ifita fyakwe filamombela ine.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
translation: “Ifi fyonse nga fyafikila, ine nkakosha aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, nobe wine Esekieli nkaleka ukalelandila apakuti bonse bakalekumfwa, epakuti bakashininkishe ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: Speak and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has said, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’
translation: Kamusoke Farao ukuti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ine ndi mulwani obe nomba, iwe Farao imfumu ya ku Egupto, we cishimweshimwe, we ulala mu mumana. Iwe ulaitakisha auti, “Umumana wa Nailo mumana wandi, nine naupanga.”

english: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales.
translation: Ine nalaswa nkukofye icinkobwe mu nsekete shobe, ndeke ne sabi lya mu mumana obe lilefyantama mu maŋongwa yobe. Elyo nkulompwele na ku mulundu wa mumana wa Nailo, ninshi ne sabi nalifyantama mu maŋongwa yobe.

english: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.
translation: Nkakusha mu matololo, iwe pamo ne sabi lya mu milonga yobe. Ukaponena panshi no kushala insansalila, takwakabe uwakukwimya nangu ukukushiika. Nkakucita icakulya ca nama sha mpanga ne fyuni fya mu lwelele.

english: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
translation: Elyo abekala mu Egupto bonse bakeshiba ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”
translation: Ilyo balemwikata mu minwe yabo mwalesantauka, no kubacenaula amabeya yabo. Ilyo bashintilila pali imwe mwalefunika, mwalenga ne myendo yabo ukusokona.’

english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nkamuletela abalwani abakumwipaya ku lupanga, bakesa mwipaya bonse kumo kwine ne fitekwa.

english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD. “‘“Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’
translation: Icalo ca Egupto cikasanguka amatololo. Elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’

english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
translation: Atile kuli ine, “We mwana wa muntu ima. Iminina, nande nobe.”

english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
translation: Nao acipombolola pa menso yandi, na ine namona ukuti konse konse kuntu kwalembwa amashiwi ya misowa, no kuloosha no kushama.

english: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
translation: Ilyo acili alelanda, Umupashi waisa muli ine wanjiminika, kabili naumfwa alenjeba ati,

english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ine nalakutuma ku bena Israeli, kuli uyu mushobo uwansangukila, uucili na nomba walinsangukila. Bena na bashibo babafye abansangukila ukushinta na lelo.

english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
translation: Abantu ndekutumako ni bankosa mitwe kabili abaumalala imitima. Ukatile kuli bena auti, ‘Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa.’

english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
translation: Bena ni bacisanguka, kanshi nga cakuti baya tesha atemwa baya kaana ukumfwa, te mulandu, cikulufye baya ishiba ukuti kasesema umo alibasokele.

english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
translation: “Kanshi iwe we mwana wa muntu, wikaya batiina, wikalatiina nefyo bakaya mukulasosa. Bakakushinguluka nga bacilasa ne myunga, ne mikalile yobe ikaba kwati waikala na bakaliŋongo. Nomba iwe tecakwesha kutiina kufyo bakalakweba, wikalatiina na nkanshi isho bakalakutumbila, pantu ni ŋanda ya bacisanguka.

english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
translation: Iwe uli nokulabebafye amashiwi yandi, nangu bakayomfwe atemwa iyoo, pantu ni bacisanguka.

english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
translation: “Lelo iwe we mwana wa muntu, umfwa ifyo ine ndekweba. Tecakwesha ukunsangukila nga ilya ŋanda ya bacisanguka. Ale asama, ulye ico ine nalakupeela.”

english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
translation: Ilyo nati ndoleshe, namonafye ukuboko kulentambika icitabo icipombwa.

english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nkabula Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, nkamutume kukuya ipaulula cinkupiti wa bantu ba mu Egupto.

english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
translation: Ena akaya na bashilika bakwe abakalipisha pakuya onaula icalo. Bakaya sansa icalo ku lupanga, ne fitumbi fikalala ntangali ntangali mu calo.

english: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”
translation: Nkakamya umumana wa Nailo, nkaleka na bantu ababi ebo bakaleteeka icalo ca Egupto. Nkaleka abenafyalo bakese onaula icalo conse ica Egupto pamo na fyonse ifyabamo.’ Nine ne Yawe nalanda.

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
translation: “Ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndesosa ukuti nkonaula utulubi, nkapwishishisha ne milungu yabufi iyaba ku Memfisi. Mu Egupto, ala tamwakatale amuba nakabili umuntu na umbi uwakuteeka icalo, pantu abantu ababamo ine nkabaletela umwenso.

english: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.
translation: Nkonaula Patirosi uwabela mu Egupto lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, no kocamo umusumba wa Soani ulya wabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Nkakandamo no musumba ukalamba uwa Tebesi.

english: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No.
translation: Umusumba wa Pelusiumu uwakwatisha amalinga yamaka mu Egupto, ine nkauleka ukomfwishe apapela icipyu candi. Nkonaula abantu bonse aba mu Tebesi.

english: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime.
translation: Nkoca icalo ca Egupto, no musumba wa Pelusiumu ukashala ulekolomafye. Amalinga ya musumba wa Tebesi yakabongololwa, na mu musumba wa Memfisi mukaba ukulanguluka lyonse.

english: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.
translation: Abalumendo ba mu musumba wa Heliopolisi na ba mu musumba wa Bubasiti bakafwa ku nkondo, na bantu bambi bonse bakasendwa muli bunkole.

english: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself, when I break the yokes of Egypt there. The pride of her power will cease in her. As for her, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
translation: Mu Tapanesi mukafiita fititi ilyo nkonaula Egupto no kumupwisha ubulamba ubo aleitakishishapo. Mukaba icikutika mu Egupto, na bantu ba mu misumba yonse bakasendwa muli bunkole.

english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”’”
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo nkalimuna Egupto, elyo nabo bakeshiba ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu sesema kabili utile, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na umo (11), pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali mu mweshi wapakubala, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ine ninkontola ukuboko kwakwa Farao, imfumu ya Egupto. Takuli nangu umo uwakuti amukakileko, nangu uwakumubikilako akapekesa nakalya, pakuti amone ukupola no kukwata amaka nakabili ayakwikatilako ulupanga.

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ine ndi mulwani wakwa Farao, imfumu ya Egupto. Nalaya mukontola amaboko yakwe yonse yabili, ukuboko kulya kushele ukutuntulu, na kulya kwine kukontweke, no lupanga lwalaya lukuta mu minwe yakwe.

english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
translation: Abena Egupto nalaswa mbasalanganishishe mu mishobo na mu fyalo ifyalekana lekana.

english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.
translation: Elyo nkakoshe na maboko ya mfumu ya ku Babiloni, nkaifyambatike no lupanga lwandi. Lelo Farao ena, awe ndemukontaula amaboko, akaŋonta, no kufwa akafwila pa cinso ca mulwani wakwe.

english: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.
translation: Farao nkamupwisha amaka, imfumu ya ku Babiloni yena nkaikosha. Ilyo ine nkafumbatika imfumu ya ku Babiloni ulupanga lwandi, nayo ikalati nga yalupambula pakulwisha icalo ca Egupto, elyo abantu bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Nalaswa nsalanganishishe abena Egupto mu mishobo ne fyalo fya pano isonde. Elyo nabo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: For the day is near, even the LORD’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
translation: Pantu ubushiku nabupalama,

english: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.
translation: Mwalaba inkondo mu calo ca Egupto,

english: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”
translation: “Muli iyi nkondo mwalafwamo abashilika aba ku Kushi, na ba ku Puti, na ba ku Lidia, na ba ku Arabia, na ba ku Libya . Mwalafwamo na bantu bandi bene pamo penefye na bena Egupto.

english: “‘The LORD says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Bonse abapokololako icalo ca Egupto balafwila mu nkondo, ukutampilafye ku Migidoli ukufika ku Siene . Ibumba lyalulumbi ilya fita fya mu Egupto lyalaonaika.’ Efyasosa imfumu Yawe.

english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.
translation: Pa fyalo fyonse ifyasanguka amatololo, icalo ca Egupto cena ecalacilapo, ne misumba yaciko yalasangukafye ifibolya fyeka fyeka.

english: They will know that I am the LORD when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
translation: Ilyo ndesonteka umulilo mu Egupto, no kwipaya bonse abacipokololako, elyo abantu baleshininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
translation: “‘Pali bulya bushiku nkatuma inkombe na mato, shikaye tiinya abena Kushi mukubapumikishafye, nabo bakekatwa no mwenso pa bushiku bwakukanda Egupto. Pantu ubo bushiku nabupalama.’

english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi limo na umo (11), pa bushiku bwapakubala mu mweshi wabutatu, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,
translation: “Kanshi ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Pantu uyo muti walilepele icakuti wafika na mu makumbi, nomba ilyo walepelako elyo walecililako ukulakwata icilumba.

english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.
translation: Kanshi ine nomba uyo muti naupeele mu minwe ya ntungulushi iya mishobo ya benafyalo, eyo iucitile ukulingana no bubi bwaiko. Naliuposele,

english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.
translation: na benafyalo nabo abalulunkana baliuwishishe, no kuusha naulambalala apo pene. Imisambo yauko ikakobenkanina mu mpili shonse, na mu mikonko yonse mu calo apo yaponene. Abantu ba mishobo yonse aboba mu cintelelwe cauko bakafumamo, bakaye no kuya.

english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,
translation: Ifyuni fyonse fikesa tongama pali uyo muti uukawa, ne nama shonse isha mu mpanga shikesa mukulaendauka mu misambo yauko.

english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’
translation: Eico kanshi ukutula pali nomba, umuti onse nangu ukatapililwe shani, awe takwakabe nelyo umo uukalepa kabili ngoyo muti, ne cilumba icakuti na kantongolilo kauko kakapule mu makumbi. Pantu imiti yonse ili nokufwa, yakulafwafye nga bantu bambi bonse abenakufwa, ala yakulafwa no kuya nabo ku calo ca bafwa.’

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ubushiku uyo muti ukaya ku calo ca bafwa, ine nkaleka amenshi ya mu mimana iyashika ukuuloosha. Nkacilika imimana, nshakaleke ilya mimana iyingi ikalepongwela. Pa mulandu wa uyo muti, ine nkaleta imfifi pa lupili lwa Lebanoni, nkaleka ne miti yonse mu mpanga ikome.

english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
translation: Nalengele imishobo yonse ukuti itutume ku ciunda ca kuwa kwauko ilyo nauposele ku calo ca bafwa pamo nabo abaya ku nindi. Elyo imiti yonse iya mu Edeni, ne miti yonse iyapulama iya ku Lebanoni kabili iyitapililwa bwino ikatalalikwa kulya kwine panshi ya calo.

english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.
translation: Ikaya nankwe ku calo ca bafwa kukwikala pamo na bafwa kale, na bonse abaleikala mu cintelelwe ca uyu muti pakati ka mishobo ya benafyalo bakaya nao ku calo cabafwa, abafwile ku lupanga.’

english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord GOD.”
translation: “Uyo muti, ala ni Farao wine, imfumu ya Egupto, pamo na bantu bakwe abafulisha efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Mu Edeni tamwali muti uwalepeshe no kupulamisha ngoyo muti. Elyo nomba ukaposwa mu calo ca bafwa pamo pene ne miti ya mu Edeni, kukuya ikala pamo na bantu abashasembululwa, balya abafwile ku lupanga. Ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe.”

english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ala kebe Farao, imfumu ya Egupto, pamo pene na bantu bakwe abafulisha, uyetila auti,

english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.
translation: Mona iwe ndekupalanya ku muti wa keda uwalepesha ulya ukula mu Lebanoni,

english: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
translation: Amenshi eyalengele ukuti ulekula,

english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.
translation: Pa mulandu wakutapililwa bwino bwino,

english: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.
translation: Fyasuka ne fyuni fya misango yonse,

english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.
translation: Wali umuti uwayemba ku busuma,

english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.
translation: Mwibala lyakwa Lesa, tamwali umuti wa keda nelyo umo uwalepeshe ukulingana noyo muti.

english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’
translation: Icite 2:9

english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, “the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na ibili (12), pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi walenga ikumi na ibili (12) ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”
translation: Esaya 13:10

english: For the Lord GOD says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Iwe ukakumana no lupanga lwa mfumu ya ku Babiloni ikakulimuna.

english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.
translation: Ubuso 6:12-13

english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.
translation: Nkalofya ne fitekwa fyaciko ifyaba mu lulamba lwa mimana yaciko. Takwakashale bantu abakufundaula amenshi nakabili, nangufye fitekwa fine ifyakuyafundaula awe nafyo fine takwakabe.

english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nkaleka amenshi yaciko yakaleikala, yakalelengama, ne mimana ikaleipitilafye tondolo nga mafuta,’ efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Ilyo icalo ca Egupto nkacisangula amatololo, no kulofya bonse abaikalamo, elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: “Ala aya mashiwi ndebasoka yakasanguka ulwimbo lwa pa ndosha. Abanakashi ba mishobo ya benafyalo bakalalwimba pakuloosha icalo ca Egupto, kumo kwine na bantu baciko.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka uwalengele ikumi limo na ibili (12) , pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na isano (15), ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, pumapo umusowa uwakuloosha abena Egupto abashaifulila. Senda abena Egupto pamo na bantu ba mishobo iyacindama, ale batwale ku calo capanshi, ubatentemushishe pamo nabo abaya ku calo cabafwa.

english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
translation: Elyo uye beba auti,

english: ‘Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, “You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.”
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, kebe Farao, imfumu ya Egupto. Kamwebe amashiwi yandi aya ayakutila, ‘Pa bantu ba mishobo yonse, iwe niwe wabapofye nge nkalamo, lelo kwena iwe wabafye nga cishimweshimwe icikala mu menshi, icifundaukafye mu mumana. Amakasa yobe yalafundaula amenshi no kulamfya imimana.’

english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.
translation: “Bakawila pamo na bantu abakafwila mu nkondo. Moneni ulupanga nalupambulwa ulwakwipailako Egupto na bantu bonse abashaifulila.

english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.
translation: Kanshi ukufuma ku calo cabafwa impalume shonse isha fita shikalanda palwa bena Egupto pamo na balebafwako abati, ‘Ala aba baisa no kwisa lala pamo na bashasembulwa, abo abafwilile mu nkondo.’

english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,
translation: “Asiria ulya ali palya, ali pakati ka nindi sha bashilika bakwe bonse abafwilile ku lupanga,

english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.
translation: ne nindi shabo shibikwa pa ncende iyashika iya ku calo ca bafwa. Abashilika bakwe bonse bafwilile mu nkondo, ne nindi shabo shaposa inindi yakwe pakati. E aba bene bashilika bateekele icalo ca bomi ku kalili.

english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.
translation: Luka 21:25

english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.
translation: “Mesheki Tubali nao ali palya pakati ka nindi sha bashilika bakwe. Balya bonse bantu abashasembululwa, kabili ni balya bantu bafwile mu nkondo ku lupanga pantu ebalya bantu balecita impasase mu calo ca bomi.

english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
translation: Bushe bena tabalala apalala ababulwi abashasembululwa, abo bashiikile pamo ne fyanso fya nkondo, ne mitwe yabo yasaile pa mpanga shabo? No kukandwa kwa pa bubifi bwabo kwaba pa mafupa yabo nangu impasase shacitile aba ababulwi shali mu calo ca bomi.

english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.
translation: “Eico na iwe wine Farao, uli nokonaika no kuya lala pamo na bashasembululwa, balya abaipaiwe ku lupanga.

english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.
translation: Mateo 24:29

english: The Lord GOD says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ilyo abantu ba mishobo iyingi bakalongana pamo, ine nkakwikata mwisumbu, nkaleke bakakukululwile na ku mulundu.

english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
translation: “Intungulushi shonse isha ku kapinda ka ku kuso nasho shili kulya kwine, pamo na bena Sidoni bonse. Kale ebaletiinya abantu ba mishobo ku mulandu wa bulamba bwabo, lelo pali nomba baliya ne nsoni kulya ku calo ca bafwa, no kulala eko balala ukwabula ukusembululwa pamo na bafwile ku lupanga.

english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Ilyo Farao imfumu ya Egupto akabamona bonse, awe imfwa yakwe ikamutalalika umutima, pamo pene ne mfwa ine iya fita fyakwe fyonse ifyafwilile mu nkondo.

english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nangu ena namubomfeshe mukusalanganya umwenso mu calo ca bamweo lelo Farao ne fita fyakwe fyonse bali nokuya lala pamo na bashasembulwa abafwile ku nkondo.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
translation: Nkakufuntwila na pa mulundu, nkakufwanta na panshi, nkaleke ne fyuni fyonse pamo ne nama sha mpanga shonse fikakulye.

english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
translation: Icitumbi cobe nkacisalanganya pa mpili, na mafupa yobe yakesule paa mu mawanga, umo yakalalukutila.

english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.
translation: Umulopa obe ukakumana pa calo, nao ukakupa na pa mpili, mu mikonko monse mukesula iminofu yobe.

english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.
translation: Ilyo nkakonaula, nkafimba ulwelele no kushimya intanda. Nkafimba amakumbi pa kasuba, no mweshi nao tawakabalike.

english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nkashimya ifyengelo fyonsefye ifya mu mulu, nkakupa ne mfifi pa calo cobe conse.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.
translation: “Abantu ba mishobo iyingi bakalasakamana ilyo umulandu wakonaika kobe nkausalanganishisha mu fyalo, ifyo iwe ushatala aumfwapo ukuti eko fyaba.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, eba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ukuti imwe mulasosa amuti, ‘Ifwe, awe twalifinininwa na bumpulamafunde bwesu ne fyabubifi ifyo twacita. Natuya tulepwilapo pa mulandu wafiko, bushe kuti twaikala shani abomi?’

english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
translation: Bebe ukuti napalifye ine ne Mfumu Yawe Umumi ndeti, ‘Ala ine tacinsansamusha ukumona umuntu umubi uko alefwa. Ine nalitemwapo ukumona umuntu umubi uko aleleka ukubifya, pakuti aleikala umumi. Kanshi imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli lekeni imisango yenu iyibi, ala lekeni. Nga mulandu nshi mufwaila ukufwa mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli?’

english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, kanshi nomba eba abantu bobe ukuti umuntu umololoke nga abifya, ninshi filya ifisuma ifyo alecita kale tafyakamupusushe iyoo. Umuntu umubi nga aleka ukubifya, ninshi ububi bwakwe ubwakale tabwakamuletelele iyoo. Nao muntu umololoke nga abifya, awe ninshi takaleikala mumi nakalya.

english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.
translation: Ine nga nalaya ukupeela umuntu mololoke umo ubumi, nomba nao kabili alatetekela ubololoke bwakwe, elyo alabifya kabili, awe ine ninshi pa fisuma fyakwe ifyakale nshakebukishepo nelyo cimo. Akafwilafye pa bubi bwakwe.

english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,
translation: Nomba ine nga nasoka umubi ukuti ulefwa, nao aleka ukubifya, alacita ifisuma kabili ifyalungama,

english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.
translation: kanshi ntilefye, abwesha ifikatila mulandu pafyo akongweseshe, abwesha nefyo aibile, emukuti uyo muntu nga aleka ukubifya, alakonka ne fipope ifileta ubumi, ala ninshi takafwe iyoo, akalaikalafye umumi.

english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
translation: Ine nkamubelelako uluse ku fibi fyakwe fyonse ifyo acitile kale. Akalaikala umumi ku kuwamya kwakwe na ku kulungika kwakwe.

english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
translation: “Lelo abekalacalo banobe balasosa ukuti, ‘Ifyo Yawe acita, awe tafyalolamo.’ Ala nakalyafye, misangofye yabo eishalolamo.

english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.
translation: Umuntu umololoke nga aleka ukuwamya, atampa no kulabifya, ninshi akafwilapo.

english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
translation: Umuntu mubi nao nga aleka ukubifya kwakwe, alawamya no kulalungika, ninshi uyo muntu akapusuka.

english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, eba abantu bobe ukuti ilyo ine nkemya inkondo muli cino calo, na bantu ba ico calo balasalapo umuntu wabo umo pakuti eo abe kalinda wabo,

english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”
translation: Lelo imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli mulesosa ukuti ifyo ncita ine ne Yawe Lesa tafyalolamo, mwa? Ala bonsefye imwe ine nkamupingula cila umo ukulingana nefyo mucita.”

english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi na ibili (12), ninshi tucili muli bunkole, pa bushiku bwalenga shisano mu mweshi walenga ikumi, umuntu umo uwapusumwikemo mu Yerusalemu, aishile njeba ukuti nabapoka umusumba.

english: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
translation: Nomba icungulo, libe ulya muntu uwapuswike talafika, ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwali pali ine, kabili akakula na kanwa kandi libe talati afike kuli ine ulucelo. Ilyo Yawe akakwile akanwa kandi, nshatalile mba cibulu nakabili.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaisa kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, abantu abaikala mu misumba iyaonaika mu calo ca Israeli, bena balasosa abati, ‘Abrahamu alifye eka lilya apeelwe cino calo. Pali nomba ifwe natufula, kanshi nifwe bene twapeelwa icalo ukuba cesu.’

english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?
translation: “Cisuma bebelepo ukuti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Imwe mulalya inama iyabamo umulopa. Kabili mulapepa utulubi no kusumya umulopa, bushe imwe nimwe mwingapeelwa icalo?

english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’
translation: Mutetekela impanga shenu ishakulwilako. Mulacita ne fyabunani. Mulacita no bucende na bamukabene, bushe imwe nimwe mwingapeelwa icalo?’

english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
translation: “Bebe ukuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Napalifye ine ne Mumi ndeti, abashala mu fibolya bakafwa ku lupanga. Abaikala mu mpanga bakabalya ku nama sha mpanga. Abafisama mu malinga na mu ncengo sha mabwe bakafwa ku cikuko.

english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.
translation: Icalo ine nkacisangula amatololo. Amaka baitakisha, yakapwa. Impili sha mu Israeli shikasapa icakuti takwakalemoneka muntu uukalapitamo.

english: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’
translation: Ilyo nkalimuna abantu palwa kubifya kwabo, no kusangula icalo cabo amatololo, lyena elyo bakashininkisha ukuti ine nine Yawe.’”

english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
translation: uyo kalinda nga amona uko abalwani balepalama, alisha ipenga pakucenjeshako abantu bonse.

english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’
translation: “Nomba palwa iwe, we mwana wa muntu, abekalacalo balakulandapo ilyo bakumanina pa fibumba fya musumba, nangu ilyo bali pa minshi ya mayanda yabo. Balashinishanya abati, ‘Natuye umfwako amashiwi yafumine kuli Yawe.’

english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
translation: Kanshi abantu besa kuli iwe ngefyo bafwile ukwisa, no kwisa ikala pa ntanshi yobe nga bantu bandi mukumfwa ifyo ulelanda, lelo balafilwa ukuficita. Ku tunwa twabo balanda ukusumina kwati nabakutemwa lelo imitima yabo ikonkamofye ubunonshi.

english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
translation: Bena iwe bakumonafye nge ŋomba iyileimba inyimbo ishakutemuna, atemwa ngo muntu uulelisha bwino icilimba. Amashiwi yobe yonse balayomfwa, lelo ukuti baleyakonka, cena calyafya nganshi.

english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
translation: Nomba ilyo fikafikila ifyo iwe usosa, na mu cacine fikafikila, lyena elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi balikele na kasesema wine wine pakati kabo.”

english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
translation: Lelo umutu umo nga taposeleko mano nangu omfwile ipenga, ninshi ena umulopa wakwe ukaba pa mutwe wakwe abalwani nga baisa mwipaya.

english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.
translation: Ninshi ukufwa kwakwe kwakuiletelelafye umwine ku mufulo wakwe, pa mulandu wakukanasakamana ipenga kufyo balemucenjeshako. Pantu akwata amano, nga kuti afulumuka no kupusuka.

english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’
translation: Nomba kalinda nga amona abalwani uko baleisa, akaana ukuti alishe ipenga pakucenjeshako abantu, ninshi kuti abalwani baisa bapumikisha balofya no bumi bwa umo. Kwena uyu muntu akafwila pa bubifi bwakwe, lelo ni kalinda eo ine nkapeela umulandu, no mulopa wakwe ukaba pa mutwe wakwa kalinda.

english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
translation: “Kanshi iwe we mwana wa muntu, ine nomba nakucita kalinda wa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Niwe wakulabacenjeshako ifyo ine nakulakweba.

english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.
translation: Ine nga napingwilapo umubi umo ukufwa, elyo nobe taumusokeleko pakuti alule imisango yakwe, ninshi uyo mubi akafwila pa bubi bwakwe, lelo kwena niwe nkapeelelapo umulandu pa mfwa yakwe.

english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
translation: Nomba iwe nga wasoka umuntu mubi, elyo ena akaana ukuleka ukubifya, ninshi akafwilapo pa bubifi bwakwe, lelo iwe ukapususha ubumi bobe.”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ine nomba nasangukila bakacema, bena nomba baba abalwani bandi. Nkabapoka impaanga shandi, tabakatale abashicema nakabili iyoo. Bena nkabafyombotola impaanga shandi, nshakaleke bakaleshilyapo awe.’

english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ine ne Yawe Lesa ndemweba ukuti ine wine nine nkafwaya impaanga shandi, kabili nine wine nkashisunga.

english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
translation: Nga filya fine kacema asunga impaanga shakwe ishisalangene, efyo na ine ndi nokusunga impaanga shandi. Nkashipokolola konse uko shasalanganine pali bulya bushiku bwa cikutika ne mfifi.

english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
translation: Nkashifumya mu fyalo fya bantu ba mishobo iyalekana lekana. Nkashilonganika, nkashibweseshe na mu calo cashiko. Nkalashicemena mu mpili sha mu Israeli, ku mikonko, na mu ncende shonsefye ishaikalamo abantu.

english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
translation: Nkalashicemena umwaba umulemfwe usuma, mu mpili, na ku milonga, na mu ncende shonse isha mulemfwe ishaba mu calo ca mu Israeli. Emo shikalatuushisha mu mulemfwe usuma no kulya icani iciteku ku mpili sha mu Israeli.

english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Nine wine nkalacema impaanga shandi, kabili nine wine nkalashifwaila na pakuti shikaletuushisha.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
translation: “Ine nkaya ndafwaya impaanga ishaluba, nkalalondola ishilelubantika, nkalakakila ishileba ne filonda, nkalaundapa ishilwele, lelo ishatuluka ne shakosa nkashonaula. Nkacema umukuni mu mulinganya.

english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
translation: Bamo pali imwe balitendwa ukulya umulemfwe uwawamisha, balemenenafye nomba ukulanyantauka pafyo bashilya. Balitendwa ukunwa amenshi ayalengama, balemenenafye nomba ukulayafundaula.

english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
translation: Elyo impaanga shandi shimbi bushe eshili nokulalya ifyo imwe mulenyantaukapo, eshili nokulanwa amenshi ayo imwe mulefundaula.’

english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema no kusoka bakacema ba bena Israeli, useseme no kweba bakacema auti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, mwashama imwe mwe bakacema ba bena Israeli, mwe baisakamanafye. Bushe bakacema tabafwile ukusakamana impaanga?

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
translation: “Kanshi nomba ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndemweba ukuti ine nkapingula imwe mwe mpaanga ishaina, na imwe mwe shaonda.

english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
translation: Impaanga ishishakosoboka imwe mulashituna no kulashipunka ne nsengo shenu pakuti shilefuma pebumba.

english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
translation: Nine nkapususha impaanga shandi, nshakaleke bakaleshicusha nakabili. Nkapingula pakati ka mpaanga imo ne ibiye.

english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
translation: Nkabuula umubomfi wandi Davidi eo akabe kacema washiko umofye, no kushisunga eo akaleshisunga.

english: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.
translation: Ine ne Yawe nine nkalaba Lesa washiko, no mubomfi wandi Davidi eukalaba kateeka washiko. Efyasosa Yawe.

english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
translation: Nkapangana nabo icipangano icakuti icishininkisho ukuti shikalaikala umutelelwe. Mu calo nkafumyamo ifiswango fyonse, pakuti impaanga shandi shikaleiikalila ku matwi tondolo mu ncende umo shikalacemenwa, nangufye shisendame mu mutengo mwine.

english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
translation: “Nkalashipaala, nkaleka shikaleikala monse mu mbali ya lupili lwandi ulwamushilo. Nkalashilokesha imfula iyalinga pa nshita shikalaikabila.

english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
translation: Imiti ikalatwala ifitwalo, mu mabala mukalaba ifisabo, na bantu bonse umo umo bakalaiikalila mu fifulo fyabo ku matwi tondolo. Ilyo nkaputaula iminyololo iyo bakakako abantu bandi, no kubalubula ku babateeka ubusha, elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
translation: Imishobo ya benafyalo tayakabwekeshepo nakabili ukulabawililila, ne fiswango fine tafyakalebekata nakabili iyoo. Bakalaikala umutelelwe, takwakalemoneka wakubatiinya nakabili.

english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
translation: Mu mabala yabo ine nkalameshamo ifisabo ifine fine, na mu calo cabo ine nkapwishamo insala. Abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo tabakabwekeshepo ukubasuula.

english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
translation: Muipakisha umukaka washiko, mufwala ne nsalu ishabilwa na masako ya mpaanga shine, mulepayapo impaanga ishaina, no kulya mulalya, elyo nomba ukuti muleshisunga, awe kwena nakalya.

english: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine ne Yawe nine Lesa wabo, nokuti kanshi aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bantu bandi. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”
translation: “Nimwe mwe mpaanga shandi, umukuni wa mpaanga shandi, muli bantu bandi, na ine ndi Lesa wenu. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
translation: Imwe tamusunga mpaanga ishishilakosa, tamundapa ishalwala, tamukakila ishileba ne filonda, tamulondola ishilubantika, nangu ukuya mulafwaya ishileluba. Imwe mushitekela mu bukali no buluku, epela.

english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
translation: Impaanga shalisalangana, ne fiswango filashikata no kushilya, pa mulandu wakukanaba na bakacema abakushicema.

english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
translation: Ala e mulandu wine kanshi impaanga shandi shilulumbilafye pa tupili na pa mpili ishitali. Eco kanshi shasalanganinafye mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse, ukwabula nelyo umo uwakuti asakamaneko, nangufye ukweshako ukushifwaya fwaya.’

english: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
translation: “Kanshi nomba imwe mwe bakacema, umfweni ifyo ine ne Yawe nalamweba.

english: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
translation: Napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, pa mulandu wakuti impaanga shandi tashakwata kacema, shilekatwa no kuliwa ku fiswango elyo kabili na imwe bene mwe bakacema bandi tamweshako na kushilondola, pa mulandu wakuti mwaliisakamana mwe bene ukwabula ukuposa amano ku mpaanga shandi,

english: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
translation: eico umfweni kuli ine imwe mwe bakacema.

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,
translation: “‘Umushobo wa bena Yuda, no mushobo wa bena Israeli kumo kwine ne fyalo fyabo, iwe walisosele ukuti e fyuma fyobe ifili nokuba mu maboko yobe, nangu ine ne Yawe naba nabo.

english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
translation: Ine ndomfwa amashiwi yobe yonse ayamataki, ayakuti ulanda icilande lande pali ine. Ala ndomfwafye fyonse.’

english: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ilyo isonde lyonse lileyanga, ine nkakusangula amatololo.

english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Nga filya fine nobe wine wasansamwike pakumona icalo ca bantu bandi aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli uko caonaika, iwe Seiri we calo ca mpili, ala iwe we calo conse ica Edomu, ukashala amatololo. Elyo na bantu bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
translation: Mala 1:2-5

english: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
translation: kabili usose auti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati,

english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Imisumba yobe ine nkaicita ifibolya,

english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
translation: Esaya 34:5-17

english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.
translation: Kanshi napalifye ine ne Mumi, ne Mfumu Yawe ndeti, niwe nomba ukafwilapo, tawakamone pakulukuntila. Walikwata umulandu palwa bupondo bobe, no bupondo bobe tawakabukunte.

english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
translation: Pa mpili shobe ine nkafimbapo ifitumbi fya bantu, ne fitumbi fya bantu abakafwa mu nkondo fikakupa pa tupili tobe na mu mawanga na mu mikonko yobe mwine.

english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Ine nkakusangula amatololo ya pe, takwakamoneke nelyo umo uukalaikala nakabili mu misumba yobe. Elyo ukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema ku mpili sha mu Israeli kabili sosa auti, ‘Owe mwe mpili sha mu Israeli umfweni amashiwi yakwa Yawe.’

english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
translation: Ine nkamufusha mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse, mukaba abengi. Mukalaikala mu misumba, no kulabuukulula ifibolya.

english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Ine nkafusha abantu, nkafusha ne fitekwa fine. Mukafulilako ukucila ifyo mwali kale, kabinge mukalakwata na bana abengi. Nkaleka mukaleikalamo ngefyo mwaleikalamo kale, kabili nkaleka mukashuuke ifyo mushatalile amushuuka kale. Lyena elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”
translation: Imwe mwe mpili, ala ine nkabweseshamo abantu bandi abena Israeli kuno kuli imwe, pakuti bakalenyanta pa mushili wenu. Mukaba icuma cabo icacishilano, tamwakatale nakabili amwipaya abana babo iyoo.’

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Pantu abantu basosa ukuti imwe mwe mpili mulalya abantu, nokuti imwe mulepaya abana ba mushobo wenu,

english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: nomba ukufuma pali lelo imwe tamwakulalya abantu, nangu ukwipaila umushobo wenu abana.’ Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”
translation: ‘Ine nshilefwaya ukuti nakabili mukaleumfwa uko abantu ba mishobo balemutuka no kumuwela. Tamwakatale amusuulwa ku mishobo imbi nakalya, nangu kupunwisha umushobo wenu. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.’”

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Nakabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, pa nshita aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli baleikala mu calo cabo, awe balicikowesha ku mikalile yabo na ku micitile yabo. Kuli ine, imyendele yabo yali iyabunani kwati mwanakashi uuli kumpepo.

english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
translation: Ine napongolwele icipyu candi pali bena, pantu balisumyamo umulopa mu calo, no kucikowesha pa mulandu wakupepa utulubi.

english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
translation: Nalibapeele umulandu palwa mikalile yabo na palwa micitile yabo, no kubasalanganya nalibasalanganishishe mu fyalo fya mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Abalwani bakwa Israeli balacankwa abati, “Eeya. Shilya mpili shakale nomba cuma cesu.” ’

english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
translation: Elyo kabili konsefye uko baya, nako kwine tabancindika iyoo, pantu abantu balabalandapo abati, ‘Aba bantu mulemona bantu bakwa Yawe, lelo ebalya bantu abo atamfya mu calo ico abapeele.’

english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
translation: Ici cintu ine calilenga ukuti nsakamane palwa lulumbi lwandi, pantu aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli balindetele insoni pakati ka mishobo yonse uko baile.

english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
translation: “Kanshi nomba iwe Esekieli, eba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli aya mashiwi ayo ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndebeba nati, ‘Ifyo ine nalaswa ncite, te pa mulandu wa imwe iyoo, ine mpamfiwe palwa lulumbi lwandi, pantu imwe mwalindetela insoni ku mishobo yonse uko mwasalanganine.

english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
translation: Nga nalanga abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo ifyo ine naba Uwamushilo, nangula imwe mwandetele insoni kuli bena, lyena bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe,’ efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Kabili imwe nimwe nkaleka mukeshibishe imishobo ya benafyalo ukuti ine ndi Wamushilo.

english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
translation: Pantu ine nkamufumya ku mishobo ya benafyalo, na mu fyalo fimbi fyonse, no kumubwesesha mu calo cenu.

english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
translation: Ine nkamukana amenshi ayasuma kabili mukasanguluka. Ndi nokumusangulula ku fyakukowesha fyonse na ku tulubi tonse.

english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
translation: Ine nkamupeela umutima uupya kabili nkabikamo umupashi uupya muli imwe. Nkafumyamo umutima wa libwe muli imwe no kumupeela umutima wa munofu.

english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
translation: Kabili nkabika muli imwe Umupashi wandi, no kumulenga ukukonka ifipope fyandi no kuposa amano kukusunga amafunde yandi.

english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation: Mukalaikala mu calo ico ine napeele ifikolwe fyenu. Mukaba abantu abandifye, na ine nkaba Lesa uwenu.

english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
translation: Nkalamupususha ku fyamukowesha fyonse. Nkalenga ne ŋanu ukulafulisha, epakuti nakabili mwikalaponenwa ne cipowe.

english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”
translation: “Nomba sesema kabili utile, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ilyo abantu ba mishobo ya mumbali bapokele no kutapa impili sha mu Israeli, bonse balewela Israeli no kumulandila ifibi pamo no musaalula.’

english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
translation: Nkalaleka imiti yenu ikaletwalisha ifitwalo, no kulafusha ifisabo mu mabala yenu, epakuti mwikalaponenwa nakabili icipowe icakumuletela insoni ku bantu ba mishobo.

english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
translation: Elyo mukalaibukisha imyendele yenu iyibi iyakale, ne micitile yenu iyakale, elyo nomba na mwe bene mukaleipata pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyenu ne fyabunani fyenu.

english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ndefwaya mwishibe bwino ukuti ine nshilecita ifi fintu fyonse pa mulandu wenu iyoo. Ine ndefwayafye muleumfwa insoni, pantu mulaisebanya pa fintu ifyo imwe mucita. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.’

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
translation: “Kabili ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Pa bushiku nkamusangulula ku fyabubifi fyenu, elyo nkamuleka mukaleikala mu misumba yenu nakabili, no kumuleka mukakuule cipya cipya ifibolya.

english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
translation: Bonsefye abapita mu mabala yenu, balamona ifyo yasapilwa, nomba ine nkaleka mukalelimamo nakabili.

english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
translation: Elyo bonse bakalalanda abati, “Tambeni icalo icali kale amatololo, moneni nomba ifyo cili kwati libala lya Edeni. Ne misumba iyabongolweke kale no kutapwa, no kushala ifibolya, moneni nomba ifyo baikuulile cipya cipya, no kukuulililako amalinga, nefyo abantu nomba baleikalamo.”

english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”
translation: Elyo abantu ba mishobo iyaba mumbali abakashalapo, bakashininkisha ukuti nine ne Yawe nkuulile cipya cipya iyi misumba iyaonaike, no kubukulula amabala ayaonaike. Nine ne Yawe nalanda, no kucita efyo ine nkacita.

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
translation: “‘Kabili ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndesosa ukuti, nakabili nkaleka aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bakalemfwaya, pakuti ndebafwako. Nkaleka abantu babo bakafulishe nge mpaanga.

english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Abantu bakafulisha nge mikuni yakutuula ilambo pa bushiku bwa nshikunkulu ubwasontwa. Efyo imisumba iyaonaike ikesulamo amabumba ya bantu. Elyo abantu bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
translation: Kanshi nomba umfweni ishiwi lya Mfumu Yawe. ‘Ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndemweba imwe mwe mpili, na imwe mwe tupili, na imwe mwe mikonko, na imwe mwe mawanga, nemwe mwe ncende ishashala amatololo, na mwe misumba iyashala ifibolya, mwebo abantu ba mishobo ya mumbali yaonawile no kulawela.
