english: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
translation: Ine ne Mfumu Yawe ninkalipila nganshi abantu ba mishobo iyaba mumbali, palibufi Edomu ena eo ncishishepo. Abantu kulwa cilumba cabo ne misuula yabo balipoka icalo candi, ne ncende ishakucemenamo shalisanguka ishabo.

english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”
translation: “‘Kanshi niwe sesemena icalo ca Israeli amashiwi yandi, impili no tupili, imikonko na mashika, fyebe amashiwi yandi ayo ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndelanda cipyu cipyu kulwa bufuba, pantu filatukwa na bantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
translation: Ine ne Mfumu Yawe nasumbula ukuboko kwandi no kulapa ukuti bakasebana abantu ba mishobo iyaba mumbali.

english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
translation: “‘Mu mpili sha mu Israeli mwena mukalamena imiti nakabili, no kulatwalamo ifitwalo ifyakuti mukalelya imwe mwe bantu bandi abena Israeli, pantu mwalaswa mubwelele bwangu bwangu kumyenu.

english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.
translation: Ine ndi nenu, nalimusakamana kabili nkamukwatila uluse ndefwaisha ukuti mukalelima umushili wenu, no kulabyalamo imbuto.

english: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
translation: Ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwali pali ine elyo ansenda mu Mupashi wakwe, antwala na mwishika umwaiswile amafupa ya bantu.

english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakulasesema ngomo mwine akonkomeseshe. Awe no mupu waingila mu fitumbi, na bantu babuka, baiminina no kwiminina, nalyo ibumba lya bantu ilishaikulila ilya fita.

english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
translation: Elyo Yawe alanjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, aya mafupa e bantu bonse aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Bena batila, ‘Ifwe twalyuma umuswalalala, tatusubila kantu, twalilobelela.’

english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
translation: Kanshi sesemena abantu bandi amashiwi yandi, bebe ukuti ine ne Mfumu Yawe nkesula inindi shabo, nkabafumyamo no kubabwesesha mu calo ca Israeli.

english: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
translation: Inindi shabo isho abantu bandi bashiikwamo, ilyo ine nkashisula no kubafumyamo elyo mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”
translation: Ine nkamuputilishamo Umupashi wandi, nkamubwesesha no bumi, no kuleka mukaleikala mu calo cenu. Elyo no kushininkisha bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe nalanda, ala no kucita efyo ine nkacita. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ale buula inkonto iya cimuti, lembapo auti, ‘Ubufumu bwakwa Yuda no bwa bana bakwa Israeli abaikatana nankwe.’ Elyo kabili buula inkonto ya cimuti imbi, lembapo auti, ‘Icimuti cakwa Efulemu, icaba cakwa Yosefu, na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli yonse abaikatana nankwe.’

english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
translation: Elyo wikatanye inkonto shonse shibili mu minwe yobe, pakuti shibe kwati ni nkonto imo.

english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
translation: Ilyo abanobe balekwipusha umo ici cilolele,

english: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
translation: ubebe ukuti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nkabuula iyo nkonto yakwa Yosefu, iyaba mu minwe yakwa Efulemu, iyalembwapo inko sha bena Israeli ishikatana nao, no kuikakatanya pamo neyo nkonto ya bena Yuda. Nkashisangula inkonto imofye, kabili shikasanguka imo mu minwe yandi.’

english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
translation: Elyo Yawe ampisha mwishika, na ine namona ukuti muli amafupa ya bantu ayengi, kabili nayo ayauma umuswalala.

english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’
translation: “Ala iwe ikatanya inkonto isho shibili isho ulembelepofye, leka na bantu bashimone.

english: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
translation: Bebe ukuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Nkafumya abena Israeli mu mishobo ya bena mupalamano umo baya, nkabalonganya pamo, elyo nkababweseshe na mu calo cabo.

english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
translation: Nkabakumbinkanya pamo pakuti bakabe umushobo umo winefye mu calo, mu mpili sha Israeli. Bakakwata imfumu imofye iyikalabateeka. Tabakabe nakabili imishobo ibili, kabili no bufumu bwabo tabwakapatukane pabili iyoo

english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation: Tabakaleikowesha ku tulubi nakabili, nangu ukulaikowesha ku fyabipa ne ifyamakankamike. Nkalabapususha ku misango yabo yonse iyalelenga ukuti balebifya no kulansangukila. Nkabasangulula, nabo bakalaba abantu abandifye, na ine nkalaba Lesa uwabofye.’

english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.
translation: “Umubomfi wandi Davidi eukaba imfumu yabo. Bonse bakakwatafye kacema umo, bakalanakila amafunde yandi no kusunga ifipope fyandi.

english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.
translation: Bakalaikala mu calo ico napeele umubomfi wandi Yakobo, umo ne fikolwe fyabo fyaleikala. Emo abene bakalaikala pe pamo na bana babo bene, kumo kwine ne finshikulula fyabo fine. Umubomfi wandi Davidi eukalabateeka pe na pe.

english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
translation: Nkapangana nabo icipangano icamutende, icikaba icakubelelela pe. Nkabasandulula bakabe abengi, kabili ine nkasonta ne cifulo candi icamushilo mu calo cabo, no kubelelela emo cikabelelela pe.

english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation: Tukalaikalamo nabo, kabili ine nkalaba Lesa uwabofye, nabo bakalaba abantu abandifye.

english: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
translation: Ilyo nkasontamo icifulo candi icamushilo icikabelelela pe, elyo imishobo ya benafyalo ikashininkisha ukuti kanshi nine ne Yawe naipatwila ne mwine abena Israeli ukuti babe abamushilo.”

english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”
translation: Epakunjipusha ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe muli aya mafupa kuti mwabwelela ubumi nakabili?”

english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
translation: Elyo anjeba ati, “Sesemena aya mafupa amashiwi yandi. Uyebe auti, ‘Mwe mafupa ayauma umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ku mafupa ati, ine nkamuputilishamo umupu no kumubweseshamo ubumi.

english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
translation: Ine nalamubikako imishipa ne minofu elyo ne nkanda ifimbepo. Nalamuputilishamo umupu no kumubweseshamo ubumi. Elyo mwalashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.’”

english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakusesema ngomo bankonkomeseshe. Kuti ilyo ncili ndesesema, awe naumfwafye amafupa yalati mpampampa, yatampa no kulalundikana ifupa pe fupa.

english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
translation: Pa nshita ine iyo ndetamba, awe amafupa yaba ne mishipa, kwaba ne minofu, ne nkanda yafimbapo. Lelo tabalepema nakalya.

english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, sesemena umwela. Eba umwela ukuti ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Isa we mupu utule mu tupinda tune, wise upupile muli ifi fitumbi pakuti fibe no bumi nakabili.’”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Ndekweba iwe Gogi ukuti ilyo iyo nshita ikafika, iwe ukatampa ukulatontonkanya amapange ayabipa.

english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
translation: Ukalapanga ukusansa icalo icakaele, ico abantu baikalilamo ku matwi tondolo, mu mishi iyishakwata amalinga nangu imipindo elyo ne mpongolo ifyakuipokolwelamo abene.

english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’
translation: Ukatapa abantu abaikala mu misumba iyali kale ifibolya, ebalya bantu bafuma mu mishobo ya benafyalo no kulongana pamo, pantu nomba nabakwata ifitekwa ne fyuma, kabili no kwikala baikala pakati ka calo conse.

english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’
translation: Abena Sheba, na bena Dedani, na bashimakwebo ba ku Tashishi bakakwipusha abati, ‘Bushe ni kukutapa ifyuma wishile? Ico ulonganikile ifita, bushe ni kukutapa silifa, na golide, ne fitekwa, ne fyuma, elyo ukuya nafyo umupili, mwa?’

english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?
translation: “Kanshi we mwana wa muntu sesemena Gogi amashiwi ayakuti, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Pali bulya bushiku ilyo abantu bandi abena Israeli bakekala mu cibote, bushe cine cine tawakacishibe?

english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.
translation: Ukafuma uko kumobe ukutali ukushailepela, ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Ukese ne bumba ilikalamba ilya bashilika abapambana, abakafuma mu mishobo iyingi, bonse bakeshila pali bakabalwe babo.

english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”
translation: Elyo ukawililile abantu bandi abena Israeli, nga filya fine icimwela cicita pa calo. Ilyo iyo nshita ikafika, ine nkesa kutuma ukusansa icalo candi, epakuti nkalange abantu ba mishobo ifyo ine naba, kabili no kubalanga bumushilo pa cinso cabo ukupitila muli iwe.’

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Niwe nalelandapo mu nshita shakale, ilyo nalesobela ku babomfi bandi bakasesema aba mu calo ca Israeli, ukuti inshita imo nkaletapo umuntu umo uwakuti akese wililila icalo ca Israeli.

english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.
translation: Muli ubo bushiku ilyo Gogi akalwisha icalo ca Israeli, icipyu candi cikema.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,
translation: Pa mulandu wa kupimpa kwandi ne cipyu icikali, nalapa ukuti mukabe icinkukuma icikalamba mu calo ca Israeli.

english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema uloleshe Gogi pakumukalipila, ulya aba mu calo ca Magogi. E ntungulushi nkalamba iyateeka umushobo wa bena Mesheki no wa bena Tubali. Kamukalipile,

english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
translation: Isabi lya muli bemba, ifyuni fya mu lwelele, ne nama sha mu mpanga shonse, icibumbwa conse icikulika pa mushili, fikalaikankilafye kulwa mwenso, na bantu bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse nabo bene cikabafye cimo cine. Impili shikasholomoka, ifipuma fya mpili fikamokaika, na malinga yonse yakawishiwa panshi.

english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord GOD. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
translation: Nkaleta amasanso aya misango yonse pakutiinya Gogi. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe. Na bantu bonse bakemina bamunyina ne mpanga.

english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.
translation: Pakumulimuna ine nkamuletela icikuko, no kusumya umulopa. Nkapongolwela pali Gogi pamo ne fita fyakwe, na bantu ba mishobo iyingi abo akaba nabo, icipungufula, ne mfula ya mabwe, no musolilo, na bamunyela abamulilo.

english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”’
translation: Efyo ine nkalanga ubukulu bwandi nokuti ndi Wamushilo, nkaisokolola ku menso ya mishobo iyingi. Kabili elyo abantu bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
translation: no kumweba uye mweba ukuti ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ati, ‘We Gogi, we ntungulushi nkalamba ya bena Mesheki na bena Tubali, ninkwalukila, uli mulwani wandi nomba.

english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;
translation: Ine nkakupilibula, no kukutunga ifinkobwe mu nsekete shobe, pakuti nkakukululule pamo pene ne fita fyobe fyonse. Ine nkakukululula, nkakululula na bakabalwe bobe bonse na bonse abendelapo ne fyanso, ne bumba lyonse ilishaikulila ilya fita, ilyenda ne nkwela na mapanga.

english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
translation: Pesia, Kushi na Puti bonse bakaba nobe bakakwata inkwela no tumpompo.

english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.
translation: Nkakukululwila pamo ne calo ca Gomeri ne fita fyaciko, ne ca Beti Togama ica ku ncende ukutali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso pamo ne fita fyaciko fyonse, elyo na bantu bonse ababa na iwe.’

english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.
translation: “Kanshi we Gogi fwalila, upekanye ne fita fyobe fyonse pakuti fikubombele.

english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.
translation: Panuma ya nshiku ishingi mukalonganikwa. Ilyo pakapita imyaka iyingi, kukaba inshita imo ilyo ine nkakupeela icebo icakusansa icalo cimo, umo abantu baikala umutelelwe ico tamwaba inkondo, ukutulafye apo balonganine ukufuma mu mishobo imbi iyingi no kwisa fika ku mpili sha mu Israeli ishashele amatololo pa nshita ntali. Kwena aba abantu basendelwe ukufuma mu mishobo kabili baikalilafye nomba ku matwi tondolo.

english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”
translation: Iwe wine pamo ne fita fyobe, na bantu ba mishobo iyingi, mukema nge cimwela pakusansa icalo, kabili mukacikupa nge kumbi.”

english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, sesema pakukalipila Gogi utile, ‘Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ifyakuti, ine ninkwalukila iwe Gogi, we kateeka mukalamba wa bena Mesheki na bena Tubali.

english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Tabakaleteba nkuni mu mpanga ishakukosesha umulilo, nangu ukulatema ifimuti mu mitengo iyoo, pantu ifyanso ifikashala nsale nsale efyo bakalakosesha umulilo. Bakatapa ifyuma ku bantu bene balya ababatapile, elyo bakapokolola ifyuma ku babapokolwele.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.
translation: “Pali ubo bushiku ilyo ifi fyonse fikafika, ine nkapeela Gogi incende mu calo ca Israeli iyakuti akashiikwemo, nayo ikabela mwishika lya balendo, lubali lwa ku kabanga ka bemba , eikacilika inshila ya balendo, pantu emo Gogi akashiikwa pamo ne fita fyakwe fyonse. Ninshi ilyo ishika bakalalita abati, ‘Ishika lya Hamoni Gogi’.

english: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.
translation: Aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli cikasendela imyeshi cine lubali pakuti bakapwishe ukushiika ifitumbi no kusangulula icalo.

english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Abantu bonse mu calo bakalaafwana pakushiika ifitumbi, kabili bakacindikilwapo pa bushiku ine nkacimfya. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.
translation: Ilyo pakapita imyeshi cine lubali, kukaba abantu bamo abakasontwa pakuti bakakonkanyepo ukulapitana mu calo pakushiika ifitumbi fimbi ifikashalamo, epakuti bakamone ukucisangulula.

english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
translation: Ilyo abo bantu bakalapitana uku noku, nga basangapo ifupa limo ilya muntu, bakalabikapo icishibilo, epakuti abakushiika baya libuula, no kuya lishiika mwishika lya Hamoni Gogi.

english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’
translation: Kukaba no mushi umo uukalaitwa Hamona. Awe ninshi ne calo nomba cabafye icasangululwa.

english: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, ‘Ita ifyuni fyonse, ne nama shonse isha mpanga konse uko shili, fiite fise ipakishako ilambo lya maliila ilyo ndefipekanishisha. Kwalaba umusamwe uwine wine pa mpili sha mu Israeli apakuti filiile iminofu no kunwa umulopa.

english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
translation: Fili no kwisa lya ifitumbi fya bashilika, no kwisa nwa umulopa wa ntungulushi sha pesonde, pantu bonse nalabepaya nga basukusuku, ngo tupaanga, nga basawe, nangu nga bacilume wa ŋombe abaina ukufuma ku Bashani.

english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
translation: Pali ili lambo lintu ndefipekanisha, fili no kwisa lya ifyanona no kufimbilwa, no kunwa umulopa wabo mpakafye fikakolwe.

english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.
translation: Ndi nokukupilibula no kukulosha kumbi, nkakufumya uko ukutali ku kapinda ka ku kuso, nkakufishe na ku mpili sha mu Israeli.

english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord GOD.’
translation: Petebulo lyandi fileisa ikutapo bakabalwe na bendelapo, ne mpalume, ne fita fimbi fyonse ifilwa inkondo.’ Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
translation: “Abantu ba mishobo nkabalanga ifyo ine nacindama, kabili nkabalanga ifyo ine momfya amaka yandi pakupingula no kuboko kwandi uko nkabika pali bena.

english: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.
translation: Ukutula pali bulya bushiku elintu aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli nabo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe Lesa wabo.

english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
translation: Na bantu ba mishobo elyo nabo bakashininkisha ukuti ico aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli basendelwe bunkole ni pa mulandu wa bubifi bwabo, pantu tabali na cishinka kuli ine. Ine nalibafumisheko amano, naleka na balwani babekate, kabili bonse naleka bafwila mu nkondo.

english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.
translation: Ine nalibalingenye pafyo balecita, pantu bali abakowela kabili abapula amafunde, kanshi na ine epakubafumyako amano.”

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ati, “Kanshi nomba nkabwesha Yakobo ukufuma muli bunkole, kabili nkabelela aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli uluse nakabili, epakuti nkakwatile ishina lyandi ilyamushilo ubufuba.

english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid
translation: Elyo nakabili bakaleikala mu calo cabo ku matwi tondolo, ukwabula nangu umo uwakubasokosha, lyena bakasuka bakalabe kufyo baisebenye abene pakukanaba ne cishinka.

english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.
translation: Ilyo nkababwesha ukufuma ku mishobo, no kubalonganika ukufuma mu fyalo fya balwani babo, lyena nkasokolola ubucindami bwandi ukupitila muli bena pa cinso ca mishobo iyingi.

english: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.
translation: Elyo na bantu bandi bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe, Lesa wabo, pantu nine nabatwele muli bunkole ku mishobo ya benafyalo, elyo kabili nine wine nomba nkabalonganya no kubabwesesha mu calo cabo ukwabula ukushapo nelyo umo.

english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”
translation: Aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli nshakabasuuleko nakabili iyoo, pantu nkapongolwela Umupashi wandi pali bena.” Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
translation: Elyo nkakuume ku kuboko kobe ukwa ku kuso pakuti ukaponye ubuta bobe, pamo ne mifwi yobe iyo ukekata ku kulyo nayo ikaponene panshi.

english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.
translation: Ukafwila pa mpili sha mu Israeli, pamo pene ne fita fyobe na bantu bene aba mishobo imbi abo ukaba nabo. Nkaleka ne fyuni ne fiswango fikalelya ifitumbi fyenu.

english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Mukafwila pa mbilibili mu mpanga pantu nine nalanda, efyasosa Mfumu Yawe.

english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Mu calo ca Magogi, na mu lulamba lonse ulwa bemba umo abantu baikalila ku matwi tondolo, ine nkocamo umulilo, elyo na bantu bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
translation: “‘Nkalenga abantu bandi abena Israeli bakeshibe ishina lyandi ilyamushilo, nshakaleke bakalesebanya nakabili ishina lyandi ilyamushilo iyoo. Elyo ne mishobo ya benafyalo ikashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine ne Yawe, nine Wamushilo uwaba pakati ka bena Israeli.

english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord GOD. “This is the day about which I have spoken.
translation: Buli mukwisa, cine cine buli nokufika, efyasosa imfumu Yawe. Ubu e bushiku ubo nalelandapo.

english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;
translation: “‘Abantu abaikala mu misumba ya mu Israeli bakalaima, bakalaya mukulatola ifyanso ifikashala nsale nsale, pakuti bakalefyoca. Inkwela, ne fyakuicingililako, amata ne mifwi, ne nkonto na mafumo, bakaficita icininkwa ca mulilo icikalapya pa myaka cine lubali.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
translation: Kabili Yawe epakunjeba ati, “Iwe we mwana wa muntu, ale lya ico wapeelwa, ici citabo icipombwa, elyo uleya no kuya landa ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli.”

english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
translation: Kabili akonkanyapo ati, “Iwe we mwana wa muntu, ala umfwikishe bwino bwino, kabili usunge mu mutima obe amashiwi yonse ayo ndekweba.

english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”
translation: Kabiye nomba ku bantu ba mushobo obe abali muli bunkole no kuya beba ifyo ine ndekweba auti, ‘Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa,’ nangu bakaye kumfwila atemwa tabakumfwile.”

english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”
translation: Awe napulikilwafye Umupashi wanjimisha mu mulu, naumfwa ne shiwi limo lilepunda kunuma, kwati cinkukuma icikalamba nganshi kabili icakutiinya, lileti, “Yawe apaalwe na matotelo pa mulandu wa bucindami ubwaba mu cifulo cakwe.”

english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
translation: Naumfwa ne ciunda ca fyamweo uko filepumanya amapindo mu lwelele, ne congo camipeto mumbali cali kwati cinkukuma.

english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Lesa wanjimishe no kunsenda, nomba pakuya umutima wandi waisulamo ubukali ne cipyu lelo ukuboko ukwamaka ukwakwa Yawe kwali pali ine.

english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
translation: Nasuka nafika na kuli bankole abaleikala ku Tele Abibu mupepi na ku mumana wa Keba. Pakati kabo epo ine naikele panshi inshiku cine lubali, ilyo ninshi ncili uwapeshiwa amano.

english: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ilyo isho nshiku cine lubali shapwile, elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti.

english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, ine nakusonta ukuba kalinda wa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Kanshi nga waumfwa ndelanda elyo ulebasoka kufyo ine ndekweba.

english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
translation: Ine nga napingula umuntu umubi ukuti, ‘Cine cine iwe uli nokufwa,’ na iwe wakaana ukumusokako pakuti aleke imicitile yakwe iyibi, amone no kwikala umumi, ala ninshi uyo muntu umubi akafwa pa mulandu wa bubi bwakwe, lelo na iwe wine ukapeelelwapo umulandu pa mulopa wakwe.

english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
translation: Nomba nga wasoka umuntu umubi, nao akaana ukuleka ububi bwakwe, ninshi uyo umubi akafwa pa mulandu wa bubi bwakwe, lelo iwe ninshi wapususha umweo obe.

english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakwasama, nao andisha icitabo icipombwa nalya.

english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
translation: “Kabili umuntu uwakaele nga aleka ukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, no kutampa ukulacita ifibi, elyo na ine namuteya icitembo, ninshi nao wine akafwa iwe nga taumusokeleko. Uyo muntu akafwila pa bubi bwakwe, nshakebukishe na fyabulungami ifyo acitile, lelo iwe ukapeelelwapo umulandu pa mulopa wakwe.

english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
translation: Nomba nga wasokako umuntu uucita ifyo Lesa afwaya pakuti elabifya, nao akumfwa, talecita na fibi, uyo muntu ninshi akalaikalila umumi, na iwe wine ninshi wapususha umweo obe.”

english: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
translation: Ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwali pali ine kulya kwine elyo anjeba ati, “Ima, akuya kwiwanga, kulya eko ndeya landa na iwe.”

english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakwima, naya na kwiwanga, awe namona no bucindami bwakwa Yawe nga filya fine nabumwene ku mumana wa keba. Na ine nawa panshi ubukupeme.

english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
translation: Elyo Umupashi waisa muli ine nokunjiminika, anjeba ati, “Kabiye kaisalile mu ŋanda mumobe.

english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
translation: Kabili iwe we mwana wa muntu, baleya kukaka imyando. Ukakakwa mu myando epakuti ukalefilwa no kufumina ku bantu.

english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.
translation: Ine ndekulenga ube cibulu epakuti ulefilwa ukusoka abantu, wikalefye tondolo, ufilwe nokubakalipila nangu baba abasangu ba bantu.

english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
translation: Nomba ilyo nkalanda na iwe elintu nkakakula ululimi lobe, elyo iwe ukalebeba auti, ‘Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa.’ Uyo onse uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe, noyo onse uwakaana ukumfwa mulekefye abe ifyo fine pantu ni bacisanguka ba bantu.”

english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
translation: Elyo ati nokuti, “We mwana wa muntu, lya icitabo icipombwa no kwikuta, wikute.” Awe na ine nalya, naumfwa mu kanwa calowa kwati buci.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
translation: Elyo anjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, kabiye nomba ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, uye beba amashiwi yandi.

english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—
translation: Ine nshilekutuma ku bantu abalanda ululimi lumbi lumbi kabili ulwayafya iyoo, ine ni ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli eko ndekutuma.

english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
translation: Nga cakuti nakutuma ku bantu abalanda ululimi lumbi lumbifye kabili ulwayafya, abo na mashiwi yabo tekuti uyateshe, bena nga kuti baya kumfwa.

english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
translation: Nomba aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bena, awe tabakaye kumfwa iyoo, pantu na ine wine balikaana ukuŋumfwa. Bonse apo bapela, ni bankosa mitwe, kabili bantu abaumalala imitima.

english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
translation: Kanshi na ine nalalenga ukuti wikabanakila, kabili uli nokuba uwaumalala nga filya fine nabo baba.

english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
translation: Ubuso 10:9-10

english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, the LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.
translation: Ilyo twali muli bunkole, mu mwaka walengele amakumi yabili na isano (25), pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi ubwakutampa umwaka upya, ninshi e mwaka uwakulenga ikumi na ine (14) apo umusumba wa Yerusalemu waonaikile, pali bulya bwine ubushiku awe ine naumfwafye ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwaisa pali ine, no kunjimya kwanjimya, kwansenda.

english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
translation: Ubuso 21:10

english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
translation: Kabinge uyo muntu apima inshila mubufumo, asanga ukuti yakula amakubiti ikumi limo. Apakwingilila apo baleisala impongolo pakulile amakubiti ikumi limo na yatatu (13).

english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
translation: Pa miputule yonse iya bamalonda pali lwapantanshi utumalinga utwipi utwalepele kubiti umo. Iyo miputule iya bamalonda, ubukulu bwaiko monse monse yali amakubiti mutanda.

english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.
translation: Elyo kabili uyo muntu apima ifyo palepele ukufuma kunuma ya muputule umo, ukushinta na ku muputule unankwe ukucilinganya inshila iyakupitilamo, asanga ukuti patalukana amakubiti amakumi yabili na yasano (25).

english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
translation: Kabili apimine ifibumba fya muputule wakwingililapo ukushinguluka mukati, fyali amakubiti amakumi mutanda (60). Apimine ukufika pa muputule wa pa mwinshi ukulungatana no lubansa.

english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
translation: Ubuso 21:15

english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.
translation: Mu miputule ya bamalonda yonse pamo ne fibumba fyonse mwali insolokoto kunse na mukati pamo na mu muputule wa pa mwinshi. Pa fibumba fyamukati ifyalungatene ne nshila, palengelwe utuncindu.

english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.
translation: Uyo muntu kabili antwala mu lubansa lwakunse. Mwali imiputule amakumi yatatu (30) iyakuulilwe ukusuntinkana ne cibumba icashingulwike ulubansa, elyo ulubansa lwine lonse lwali ulwakubatilwa na mabwe ayapapatala bwino.

english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
translation: Aya mabwe ayapapatala yalambatikwe ku fibumba fyonse uku noku ukufika ku mpongolo iyali iyalinganaa mubutali na mulufumo. Ulo lubansa lwabelele lwa panshi.

english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
translation: Uyo muntu apimine ubutali bwa lubansa ukufuma ku mpongolo ya pesamba no kufika lwakunse ku lubansa lwamukati, amona ukuti palepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100) lwa ku kabanga cimo cine na ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.
translation: Mu cimonwa mwine Lesa antwala mu calo ca Israeli, aya nteka na pa lupili lumo ulutali. Awe namonafye lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso imitande ya mayanda ayali kwati musumba.

english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
translation: Elyo kabili apimine ubutali na mu bwipi bwa mpongolo iya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, iyakupitilapo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse.

english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
translation: Yali ne miputule itatu itatu iya bamalonda iyali ku mbali shonse ishaba malonda. Ifibumba pamo no muputule wa pa mwinshi fyali ifyalingana ne mpongolo yapakubala iyali ku kabanga. Mu butali bwafiko fyonse fyali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50), mubufumo fyonse fyali amakubiti amakumi yabili na yasano (25).

english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.
translation: Umuputule wa pa mwinshi, ne nsolokoto shauko, no tuncindu utwalengelwe pa fibumba, fyalifye cimo cine na filya fyali ku mpongolo ya ku kabanga. Kwaliko na matabo cine lubali ayakunininapo pakuya ku mpongolo, no muputule wa pa mwinshi wabelele kumpela ukulungatana no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse.

english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.
translation: Ukufuma ku mwinshi wa mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso, elyo ukucilinganya ulubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, kwaliko umwinshi umo uwa mpongolo uwakupitilapo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati, uyo mwinshi walifye ngoyo wine wali lubali lwa ku kabanga. Uyo muntu kanshi epakupima ifyo shatalukene isho mpongolo shibili, asanga ukuti pali amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
translation: Kabili alintwele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, ukwabelele impongolo na imbi. Awe nayo alaipima, amona ukuti ilingenefye ne mpongolo shimbi ku bukulu pamo ne miputule yashiko.

english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
translation: Mu miputule wa pa mwinshi uwa pali iyo mpongolo mwali insolokoto nga shilya shine shali mu miputule iya pa mpongolo shimbi. Ubutali bwa nshila bwali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50), mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti yabili na yasano (25).

english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
translation: Palipo na matabo cine lubali ayakunininapo pakuya ku mpongolo, no muputule wa pa mwinshi uwabelele kumpela ukulungatana no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse. No tuncindu twalilengelwe pa fibumba fyamukati ifyalungatene ne nshila.

english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
translation: Nako kwine kwaliko ne mpongolo iyakupitilapo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati iyabelele ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Awe nao alapima ifyo palepele ukufuma ku mpongolo imo ukuya shinta na ku ibiye iyakunse iyabelele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, amona ukuti palepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
translation: Kabili alimpishishe pa mpongolo iya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, anyingisha na mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati. Awe alapima ne mpongolo iyabelele lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, amona ukuti ilingenefye ne shinankwe ku bukulu.

english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
translation: Ne miputule ya bamalonda, ne fibumba fyamukati no muputule wa pa mwinshi, fyonse fyalingenefye ubukulu na filya fyali ku mpongolo shimbi. Impongolo pamo no muputule waiko uwa pa mwinshi fyali ne nsolokoto mu fibumba fyonse. Ubutali bwafiko bwali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50), mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti amakumi yabili na yasano (25).

english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
translation: Nao Lesa eko antwala, namonako no muntu umo uwalebengeshima ngo mukuba. Namona ali no mwando uwa kolokondwe ne tete ilyakupiminako, ninshi naiminina na pa mpongolo.

english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
translation: Imiputule ya pa mwinshi iyashingulwike ulubansa lwamukati ka mpongolo yali amakubiti amakumi yabili (25) mubutali, mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti yasano (5).

english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.
translation: Umuputule wa pa mwinshi walungatene no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse. Palilengelwe no tuncindu pa fibumba fyamukati ifyalungatene ne nshila. Palipo na matabo cine konse konse ayakunininapo pakuya kuli iyo mpongolo.

english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;
translation: Kabili alimpishishe pa mpongolo ya ku kabanga, antwala na mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati. Awe alapima ne mpongolo, amona ukuti ilingenefye ne shinankwe ubukulu.

english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
translation: Ne miputule iya bamalonda, no muputule wa pa mwinshi ne fibumba fine ifyamukati, fyonse fyalingenefye ubukulu na filya fine fyali ku mpongolo shimbi. Impongolo no muputule waiko uwa pa mwinshi fyali ne nsolokoto mu fibumba fyonse. Ne nshila yali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) mubutali, mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti yabili na yasano (25).

english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
translation: Umuputule wa pa mwinshi walungatene no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse. Palilengelwe no tuncindu pa fibumba fyamukati fyonse fibili, ifyalungatene ne nshila. Palipo na matabo cine konse konse, ayakunininapo pakuya kuli iyo mpongolo.

english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—
translation: Kabili antwele ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Awe alapima ne mpongolo, amona ukuti ilingenefye ne shinankwe ku bukulu.

english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.
translation: Nako kwine kwali imiputule iya bamalonda, ne fibumba fyamukati ifyalengelwepo utuncindu, no muputule wa pa mwinshi, ne nsolokoto mu fibumba fyonse. Ne nshila iyalipo yali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) mubutali, mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti amakumi yabili na yasano (25).

english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
translation: Umuputule wa pa mwinshi wa mpongolo walungatene no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse. Pa fibumba fyamukati fyonse fibili palilengelwe utuncindu. Palipo na matabo cine konse konse ayakunininapo pakuya kuli iyo mpongolo.

english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.
translation: Mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, mwalimo umuputule umo, pakuyamo kano ukupitila mu muputule wa pa mwinshi uwalungatene no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati. Emo balesambila ifitumbi fya nama isho baleoca pakushituula ilambo.

english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
translation: Mu muputule wa pa mwinshi mwali amatebulo yane, uku yabili, noku yabili. Pali ayo yene amatebulo epo baleipaila inama ishakutuula ilambo ilyakoca, nangu umutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi nangu umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi.

english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”
translation: Elyo uyo muntu alanjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, lolekesha bwino. Umfwa kuno, usunge bwino fyonse ifyo ine nalakulanga, pantu e mulandu wine bakuletele kuno. Kabili uli nokwebako aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli fyonse ifyo iwe ulemona.”

english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.
translation: Lwa ku cibumba ca panse ica muputule wa pa mwinshi napo pali amatebulo yane, uku yabili, noku yabili. Yabelele lwa mu nshila iyakwishila ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.
translation: Kanshi mukati ka muputule mwali amatebulo yane, panse napo yane, epa matebulo cine konse konse ayo baleipailapo inama isho bali nokutuula ilambo.

english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.
translation: Amatebulo yane ayo balepekanishishapo amalambo ayakoca, yapangilwe na mabwe ayasonwa, mubutali ukuya pamulu yalepele kubiti umo, mubufumo na mubutali mwena yali kubiti umo na citika. Ni pali ayo yene amatebulo epo balebika ifibombelo ifyakwipailako inama sha malambo.

english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.
translation: Kwali ne finkobwe ifyalepele nge cisansa ca lupi, ifyapampamikwe ukushinguluka icibumba. Pali aya yene amatebulo epo balebika inama shonse ishakutuula ilambo.

english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.
translation: Kunse ya mpongolo yamukati, mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati, lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, mwali imiputule ibili. Umuputule umo waloseshe ku kapinda ka ku kulyo kabili mwalimo no muputule unankwe lubali lwa ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, wena waloseshe ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.
translation: Elyo uyo muntu alanjeba ukuti uyu muputule uuloseshe ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, ewa bashimapepo ababomba mwi Tempele,

english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister to him.”
translation: na ulya uloseshe ku kapinda ka ku kuso, wena ewa bashimapepo ababomba ku bulambo. Aba e bana baume bakwa Sadoki, abo bekafye abena Levi abafwile ukupalamina kuli Yawe mukumubombela.

english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.
translation: Elyo apimine ulubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati, mubukulu lwali monse monse amakubiti umwanda umo (100). Ubulambo bwali lwa pantanshi ye Tempele.

english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
translation: Elyo kabili anyingisha mu muputule uwakwingililamo pakuya mwi Tempele. Awe alapima na pa bwingililo, mubwipi pa mbali shonse shibili palepele amakubiti yasano, kabili mubufumo amakubiti ikumi limo na yane (14), ne fibumba ifyalipo uku noku fyatikeme amakubiti yatatu.

english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
translation: Umuputule wa pa mwinshi wali mubutali amakubiti amakumi yabili (20), kabili mubufumo wali amakubiti ikumi limo na yabili (12), kabili walikwete na matabo ikumi limo ayakunininapo pakuyamo. Apakwingilila pali ne nceshi shibili, lumo uku, ulubiye nalo uku.

english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
translation: Ico ine namweneko, Litempele ilyali mukati ke linga. Uyo muntu nao aikete itete ilyalepele amakubiti ayakulu mutanda , cila kubiti uukulu walepele kubiti umo ukulundapo ne cisansa ca lupi . Alapiminako ne cibumba ce linga. Asanga ukuti mu butali ubwakuya pamulu icibumba calepa itete limo, umutika waciko nao waba itete limo.

english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.
translation: Elyo kabili alungama ku mpongolo iyabelele ku kabanga. Anina amatabo, alapima no mwinshi wa mpongolo, asanga ukuti walepele itete limo ukuya panshi.

english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
translation: Umuputule onse uwa bamalonda wali itete limo mubutali elyo ne tete limo mukucilinganya. Pakati ka miputule palepele amakubiti yasano. Umwinshi wa mpongolo uwabelele ukwakwingilila ukulungatana ne Tempele mupepi no muputule wa pa mwinshi wali itete limo.

english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
translation: Awe uyo muntu alapima uyo muputule uwapalamishe kwi Tempele,

english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
translation: asanga ukuti wali amakubiti cine konse konse, elyo ku mpela ya uyo muputule kwali ifibumba ifyatikeme amakubiti yabili.

english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.
translation: Kabili antwala mu muputule uwamushilo uwakunse, alapima ne nceshi sha fibumba nasho mubufumo shali amakubiti mutanda mu mbali shonse,

english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
translation: ubukulu bwaiko bwali amakubiti amakumi yabili (20). Iyo ncende yabelele pakati ka cibumbili na mayanda ayo bashimapepo balebomfya.

english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
translation: Kwaliko ne minshi iyakwingililapo pakuya mu miputule ukufuma pa ncende iyishalipo kantu, umo wabelele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, umbi nao wabelele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Icibumbili icakupitapo icasuntinkene ne ncende apashali kantu cali amakubiti yasano mubufumo ukushinguluka.

english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
translation: Kwaliko ne ŋanda imo iyalungatene ne Tempele lubali lwa ku masamba. Mubukulu yali amakubiti amakumi cine lubali (70), mubutali amakubiti amakumi pabula (90). Icibumba caiko catikeme amakubiti yasano.

english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;
translation: Uyo muntu alipimine Itempele lwakunse, nalyo lyalepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100). Ulubansa pamo ne ŋanda elyo ne fibumba fyaliko fyalepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
translation: Ukutula pa mpela ya lubansa, ukupita lwa ku kabanga na pa mwinshi we Tempele, ukuya fika na pa mpela ya iyo ine ncende, napo pene palepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,
translation: Uyo muntu alipimine ubutali bwa ŋanda iyalungatene no lubansa lwa kunuma ye Tempele, apimina kumo kwine ne fibumba fyaiko konse konse, amona ukuti nako kwine yali amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),
translation: fyena fyonse fyapampaminwemo imbao panshi na ku fibumba, ukuya fikafye na pa nsolokoto. Pa nsolokoto pali ne fyakufimbapo.

english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.
translation: Pa ncende iyali pamulu lwapanse apakwingilila mu muputule wamushilo uwamukati, elyo na pa fibumba mukukonkana ukushinguluka umuputule wamukati no wakunse wine,

english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,
translation: palilengelwe bakerubi no tuncindu. Paleti apa ni Kerubi, apa napo kancindu. Bakerubi bonse umo umo bali ne finso fibili fibili.

english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.
translation: Icinso ca muntu caloleshe lwa ku kancindu ku lubali lumo, elyo icinso ca nkalamo naco caloleshe ku kancindu ku lubali lubiye. Efyalengelwepo ukushinguluka icibumba conse ice Tempele,

english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
translation: apakwingilila pali amakubiti ikumi limo mubufumo, kabili umutika wa fibumba fyauko konse konse wali amakubiti yasano. Kabili apima no muputule uwamushilo wine uwakunse, mubutali wali amakubiti amakumi yane (40), na mubufumo wali amakubiti amakumi yabili (20).

english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.
translation: ukutampila panshi ukuya shinta na pafikile ifiibi, palengelwe bakerubi no tuncindu pa cibumba ca muputule wamushilo uwakunse.

english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.
translation: Amaingwe ya fiibi ifya muputule wakunse uwamushilo yalepele mubutali, kabili yali ayalingana naya muputule uwamushilo icine cine.

english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”
translation: Palipo no bulambo ubwa fimuti. Nabo bwalepele amakubiti yatatu ukufuma panshi, mubukulu bwali amakubiti yabili. Babukuulile ne fimuti petungi, panshi na mumbali. Elyo uyo muntu epakulanjeba ati, “Ili e tebulo ilyaba pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
translation: Apakwingilila ukuya mu muputule uwakunse uwamushilo pali ifiibi fibili, kabili palipo na fimbi fibili ifyakwingililapo pakuya mu muputule uwamushilo icine cine.

english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
translation: Ifyo fiibi fyali ifyaminkubili, ifyaleisukila uku noku.

english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.
translation: Pa fiibi fya muputule wakunse uwamushilo palengelwe bakerubi no tuncindu, nga filya fine cali na pa fibumba. Elyo kunse kwali no mutenge uwa mbao lwa pantanshi wa muputule wa pa mwinshi.

english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.
translation: Mu mbali ya uyo muputule wa pa mwinshi mwali insolokoto, na pa fibumba fyauko palilengelwepo utuncindu. No tumiputule utwali mu mbali ye Tempele twalikwete imitenge iya mbao lwa pantanshi.

english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
translation: Elyo aya mu muputule uwamushilo uwamukati alapima ne nceshi sha fibumba, ifibumba fya pa mwinshi fyena mubufumo fyali amakubiti yabili, apakwingilila napo pali amakubiti mutanda mubufumo, no mutika wa fibumba fya pa mwinshi konse konse wali amakubiti cine lubali.

english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
translation: Apima no muputule wamushilo uwamukati, mubutali wali amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) na mubufumo wali amakubiti amakumi yabili (20) ukucilinganya pa mpela ya muputule wamushilo. Elyo uyo muntu anjeba no kunjeba ati, “Uno muputule e wamushilo icine cine.”

english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
translation: Kabili apimine umutika wa cibumba cakunse ice Tempele, naco cali amakubiti mutanda. Elyo ukukonka ico cine cibumba conse ice Tempele, kwaliko umutande wa tumiputule utunono utwashintilileko, ubukulu bwatuko twali ni cikanga amakubiti yane.

english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.
translation: Imiputule yali ya ntunti shitatu, kabili pali utumiputule amakumi yatatu (30) pa ntunti imo, na pa ibiye na panshi ifyo fine. Umutika wa cibumba walikulileko lwa panshi elyo bashako ulucena apakushintilila ifibumba fya tumiputule twa pa ntunti ya pamulu, ukwabula ukwingisha ifyakushintililapo mu cibumba ce Tempele.

english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.
translation: Utu tumiputule twali utukuluko pa ntunti ya pamulu ukucila iya panshi. Kanshi icikulwa conse ukushinguluka Itempele cakuulilwe mu musango uwakuti imiputule ya pa ntunti ya pamulu yalikulileko nga mwaninika ukuya pa ntunti ya pamulu. Balikuulileko na matabo ukufuma panshi, ukupita pa ntunti ya pakati ukuya fika na pa ya pamulu.

english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
translation: Ine nalimweneko ne cibumbili icashingulwike Itempele. Casanseme itete limo, ekutila amakubiti mutanda, ukucila ulubansa, no kulingana napo bakuulile utumiputule mu mbali ye Tempele.

english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
translation: Icibumba cakunse ica uto tumiputule cali no mutika ukulingana pa makubiti yasano. Kwaliko ne ncende imo iyishalipo kantu, iyashingulwike Itempele,

english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
translation: Uyo muntu alintwele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, elyo antwala na ku miputule iyaloleshanya lubansa lwe Tempele, kabili iyaloleshanya ne linga line ilyakunse lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.
translation: Lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ake Tempele, kwaliko imiputule na imbi iyapalene neyo ine iyibiye, yalungatene ku lubansa lwe Tempele kabili yaloshenye ne linga lyakunse.

english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.
translation: Pa ntanshi ya miputule palipo inshila imo iyakupitamo, nga ilya ine yali lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Ubutali no bukulu bwaiko bwalingenefye no bwa inankwe, no musango bacitilemo, ne minshi ine iyakufuminapo yalifye cimo cine.

english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.
translation: Ifyali iminshi yauko, efyali ne minshi iyabelele lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Kwali no mwinshi uwabelele apatampile inshila yakupitamo iyakonkele icibumba icalolele ku kabanga ukwali ukwakwingilila.

english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
translation: Elyo uyo muntu alanjeba ati, “Iyi miputule iya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ne ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo iyalosha iminshi pa lubansa lwe Tempele yonse yaba iyamushilo. Bashimapepo abapalamina Yawe emo baliila amalambo ayamushilo nganshi. Pa mulandu wakuti iyi miputule yaba iyamushilo, kanshi emo bashimapepo bakulasungila ifintu ifyamushilo, ifili nge mituulo ya cabunga, umutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi, pamo ne mituulo yakufuta pa bubifi pantu ici cifulo camushilo.

english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”
translation: Ilyo bashimapepo baingila mukubomba mu cifulo camushilo, tabali nakufumina pa lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, kano batala basha muli iyi ine miputule ifyakufwala ifyamushilo ifyo bali bafwele ilyo bacilabombela Yawe. Elyo kabili bali nokulafwala insalu shimbi pakuya ku ncende uko abantu balongene.”

english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
translation: Uyo muntu atile ashipwa ukupima incende yamukati ke linga lye Tempele, elyo amfumishe pa mpongolo ya ku kabanga, alapima ulubansa ulwashinguluka ilinga.

english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.
translation: Abuula itete, alapima lubali lwa ku kabanga, amona ukuti palepele amakubiti imyanda isano (500).

english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.
translation: Apima na lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, asanga ukuti kwalepele amakubiti imyanda isano (500).

english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
translation: Kabili apima na lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, asanga ukuti kwalepele amakubiti imyanda isano (500).

english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
translation: Elyo kabili apima na lubali lwa ku masamba, asanga ukuti nako kwalepele amakubiti imyanda isano (500).

english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.
translation: Iŋanda ya iyi miputule mubutali yali amakubiti umwanda umo (100), mubufumo mwena yali amakubiti amakumi yasano (50).

english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
translation: Epakupima icibumba icacingilila ku mbali shonse shine ukushinguluka, calepele amakubiti imyanda isano (500), na mubufumo cali amakubiti imyanda isano icalekenye incende iyamushilo ne ishali yamushilo.

english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.
translation: Lubali lumo yalungatene no lubansa ulwalepele amakubiti amakumi yabili (20), ukukonka Itempele, lubali lubiye yalungatene no lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse ulwakubatilwe na mabwe ayapapatala. Yali ni ŋanda iya ntunti, iyakuulilwe pa fiputa fitatu ifyatuntikene nga matabo yatatu.

english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.
translation: Ku ntanshi ya miputule kwali inshila imo iyakupitamo, mu bukulu bwaiko yali amakubiti ikumi limo, mu butali bwaiko amakubiti umwanda umo (100). Iminshi iyakwingililapo yabelele ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.
translation: Imiputule pa ntunti ya pamulu, yalicepeleko pa miputule iya ntunti ya pakati na pa miputule ya panshi, pantu ifiputa fyaile filecepelako.

english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.
translation: Imiputule ya pa ntunti yabutatu tayatungililwe ne nceshi nga mayanda yambi, eico yali ayanono ukucila ayali pa ntunti ya panshi na pakati.

english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.
translation: Ku ŋanda ine kwali na kalilinga kamo akalungatene ne miputule, kalepele amakubiti amakumi yasano (50),

english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.
translation: no mutande wa miputule ya panshi nao walepele amakubiti amakumi yasano (50). Lelo umutande wa miputule uwali ku lubali lwa muputule wamushilo walepele amakubiti umwanda umo (100).

english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
translation: Ku mpela ya ŋanda lubali lwa ku kabanga, uko akalilinga katampile, kwaliko ne minshi iyakupitilapo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse.

english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.
translation: Uyo muntu kabili alintwele ku mpongolo iyalosha ku kabanga,

english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
translation: “Kanshi nobe we mwana wa muntu, ale akulondolwela aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli palwe Tempele, na palwa mikuulile yaliko, uleke bekatwe insoni pa mulandu wa micitile yabo iyabubifi.

english: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.
translation: Nga baikatwa insoni pafyo bacita, elyo ubalondolwele ifyo Itempele lyatantikwa, emukuti ifyo lyapiminwe pakulikuula, ifyaba iminshi iyakwingililamo ne yakufuminamo, ifyo Itempele limoneka, umusango fyonse fyatantikilwamo, kumo kwine na mafunde ne fipope fyaliko fyonse. Ubalembele ifyo fyonse, epakuti abene baleibelengela umusango fyonse fyatantikilwamo, bamone no kulakonka ifipope fyaliko fyonse.

english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
translation: Kanshi ifunde palwe Tempele nili, ilyakuti incendefye yonse pa mulu wa lupili, iyashinguluka Itempele, ala ni ncende iyamushilo nganshi. Ili e funde ilye Tempele.”

english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.
translation: Ifi e fipimo fya bulambo mu makubiti ayataliko, aya makubiti yalepele kubiti umo ukulundapo ne cisansa ca lupi . Apaimikwe ubulambo bonse pasanswike kubiti umo, mubufumo namo kubiti umo, kwali no mushingo ukushinguluka uwalingene ne cisansa ca lupi. Ifi efyalepele ubulambo ukufuma panshi.

english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.
translation: Ukutula apo ubulambo bwaimikwe ukufika na mu mushingo wa mwisamba bwali amakubiti yabili ukuya mumulu, mubufumo kubiti umo. Elyo ukufuma mu mushingo wa mwisamba ukufika na mu mushingo wa pamulu palepele amakubiti yane elyo mubufumo kubiti umo.

english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
translation: Pamulu epali ishiko ilyo baleocelapo amalambo ilyasanswike amakubiti yane, na pamulu weshiko pene patumpwike insengo shine.

english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.
translation: Ishiko lya pa bulambo lyali ilyalingana, monse monse lyali amakubiti ikumi limo na yabili mubutali na mubufumo.

english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”
translation: Incende ya pakati nayo yalilingene mubukulu, monse monse yali amakubiti ikumi limo na yane, no mushingo uwali citika wa kubiti, ne shinte ilyali kubiti umo ukushinguluka. Amatabo ayakuiila pa bulambo yabelele lubali lwa ku kabanga.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.
translation: Elyo alinjebele ati, “We mwana wa muntu, Imfumu Yawe asosa ukutila aya e mafunde bali nokukonka palwa bulambo. Pa bushiku bwine nga bapwa ukukuula ubulambo, pakutuula amalambo yakoca na pakukana umulopa wa nama ishikalatuulwa ilambo,

english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.
translation: mukapeela umusepela umo uwa ŋombe ilume ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi kuli bashimapepo abena Levi, bamwana Sadoki, abali nokulaisa apo ndi kukumombela. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.

english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
translation: awe namona no bucindami bwakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli uko buletula ku kabanga. Ishiwi lyakwa Lesa ninshi lileumfwika kwati ciunda ca kupooma kwa menshi, icalo naco ninshi cilebengeshimafye kulwa bucindami bwakwe.

english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.
translation: Muli nokubuulapo umulopa wakako, no kuushinga ku nsengo shine ishaba pa mulu wa bulambo, na ku matungi yane aya ncende ya pakati, na ku mishingo yonsefye. Kanshi efyo ukasangulula ubulambo no kubufutilako.

english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.
translation: Ukabuule cilume wa ŋombe no kuleka ilambo lya mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Ukamubuule ukamoce mu lubansa mwilinga lyakunse pa ncende iyasontwa, kunse ya ncende iyamushilo.

english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.
translation: “Elyo pa bushiku bwacibili mukabuulepo sawe umo uwabula akalema, mukatuule ilambo lyakwelelwa pa bubifi. Mukabuule no mulopa wakwe mukasangulwileko ubulambo, nga filya fine mukabalilapo ukucita kuli cilume wa ŋombe.

english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.
translation: Ico nga capwa, elyo mukabuule cilume wa ŋombe umo uwabula akalema, na sukusuku umo nao uwabula akalema,

english: You shall bring them near to the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.
translation: mukafilete fyonse kuli ine ne Yawe. Bashimapepo bakasansapo umucele, no kufituula nge lambo ilyakoca.

english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.
