translation: “Pa nshiku cine lubali muli nokulatuula inshiku shonse sawe umo, na cilume wa ŋombe nao umo, na sukusuku nao umo, ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Isho nama shonse shili nokuba ishabula akalema.

english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.
translation: Pa nshiku cine lubali bashimapepo bali nokufutilako ubulambo no kubusangulula efyo bakandubwila ubulambo pakubupekanya ukulabombelapo imilimo yabuko.

english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord GOD.”
translation: Isho nshiku nga shapwa, pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse nokuya kuntanshi elyo bashimapepo bali nokutampa ukulalekela pa bulambo amalambo yenu ayakoca, na malambo yenu ayakwampana. Elyo ninshi na ine nkalamusekelela imwe. Efyasosa Imfumu Yawe.”

english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
translation: Ico cimonwa califye nga cilya namwene ilyo Lesa aishile kukonaula umusumba wa Yerusalemu, kabili califye nga cilya namwene ku mumana wa Keba. Awe na ine epakuwa panshi ubukupeme.

english: The LORD’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
translation: No bucindami bwakwa Lesa epakupita pa mpongolo ya ku kabanga, bwaingila na mwi Tempele lyakwe.

english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the house.
translation: Kabili Umupashi wanjimya, wantwala mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati, awe namona nokuti ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bwaisula mwi Tempele.

english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.
translation: Ilyo uyo muntu acili naiminina apo nali, elyo naumfwa umo alelanda kuli ine ukufuma mwi Tempele,

english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;
translation: anjeba nokuti, “We mwana wa muntu, ala ni muno emwaba icipuna candi icabufumu kabili icifulo icakunyantapo amakasa yandi. Ni muno nakulaikala pe na bena Israeli. Aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli pamo ne shamfumu shabo tabakatale abakowesha ishina lyandi nakabili, pakucita ubucende bwakupepa imilungu, na pakulakuulila ishamfumu shabo ishafwa ifyakushibukishishako.

english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.
translation: Ishamfumu shabo pakukuula amayanda yashiko, shalepalamika iminshi yabo na maingwe ya fiibi fyabo mupepi ne minshi na maingwe ya fiibi fya ŋanda yandi, icakuti paleshalafye icibumba cimo icaletulekanya. Balekowesha ishina lyandi pakulacita ifintu ifyabunani, ecalengele ukuti na ine mbonaule ku cipyu.

english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.
translation: Lino lyena bali nokuleka ubucende bwakulapepa imilungu, bali nokonaula na filya bakuulile ishamfumu shabo ishafwa. Nga efyo bacita, awe ninshi na ine nakulaikalilila nabo pe.

english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
translation: Uyo muntu kabili alintwele ku mpongolo yakunse, lubali lwa ku kabanga ka ncende ye Tempele. Iyo mpongolo yali iyaisalwa,

english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.
translation: “Abena Levi abansangukile pamo na bena Israeli banabo bambi, kabili abapepeleko no tulubi, nabo bene bali nokukandilwapo.

english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
translation: Lelo kwena kuti balabomba umulimo wandi mu ŋanda yandi, uwakusunga impongolo, no kulabombamo imilimo imbi. Kuti balaipaya inama isho abantu baleleta pakushoca ilambo, ne shakuleka ilambo ilyakupapatila abantu, kabili bali nokulaba pa ncito iyakubombela abantu.

english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord GOD, “and they will bear their iniquity.
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wakuti ebaletungulula aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli amapepo ayakupepa utulubi, emukuti kanshi ebalebatwala kukulabifya, kanshi na ine nalapa ukuti balifye nokukandwa. Efyasosa imfumu Yawe.

english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.
translation: Tabafwile ukulapalama kuli ine nakabili pakumombela umulimo wabo uwa bushimapepo, tabafwile ukulapalama ku mituulo yamushilo iyapeelwa kuli ine, ifintu fyandi ifyaba ifyamushilo icine cine. Bakalaumfwa insoni pa micitile yabo iyabunani.

english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.
translation: Lelo ine nalabasonta ukulatungulula imilimo ya mwi Tempele no kulacita fyonse ifili nokulabombekamo.”

english: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: “Nomba, ilyo abena Israeli bambi bansangukile, bashimapepo abena Levi aba mu lupwa lwakwa Sadoki bena balikonkenye ukulamombela bwino mu ŋanda yandi. Kanshi aba bene ebakulamombela, ebakulaisa pa cinso candi kukulantuula amafuta ya malambo no mulopa wayako. Efyasosa imfumu Yawe.

english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.
translation: Bena bekafye ebakulaingila mu ŋanda yandi, no kulabomba petebulo lyandi mukumpyungila no kulatungulula amapepo mu ŋanda yandi.

english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
translation: Ilyo bakalaingilila pa mpongolo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati umwaba iŋanda yandi, bali nokulafwala insalu ishatelela. Tabali nakulafwala nsalu sha masako ya mpaanga pa nshita balebomba umulimo mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati, atemwa mukati ke Tempele.

english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.
translation: Bakalapomba insalu ishatelela ku mitwe yabo, no kufwala bakaputula abamukati aba nsalu ishatelela. Tabafwile ukufwala icili conse icikabalenga ukupiba ilibe.

english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.
translation: Pakufumina ku bantu abali mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, bali nokulatala bafuula ifyakufwala ifyo bali balebombelamo umulimo mu ŋanda yandi, no kufisha mu miputule iyamushilo. Bali nokulafwala insalu shimbi, epakuti insalu shabo ishamushilo tashisangulwile abantu ababakumya.

english: The LORD said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.
translation: elyo Yawe anjeba ati, “Iyi mpongolo yakulashalafye ifi fine iyaisalwa, tayakatale aiisulwa. Tapakengilile muntu nangu umo, pantu epo naingiliile ine ne Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli. Kanshi ili nokulashalafye iyaisalwa.

english: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
translation: “Bashimapepo tabali nakulabeya ulukuso, nangu ukulaleka imishishi yabo ilelepesha. Pa kubeya bali nokulaipifyakofye ukulingana ne cipimo icilingile.

english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.
translation: Bashimapepo tabali nakulanwa umwangashi ilyo baleingila mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati.

english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
translation: Bashimapepo tabali nakulaupa mukamfwilwa nangu umwanakashi uo balekana na wiba. Bali nokulaupafye umukashana umwina Israeli uushatala akuma ku mwaume, nangu ukuupa namfwilwa uwali muka shimapepo.

english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
translation: “Bashimapepo bali nokulafunda abantu pakuti abantu baleishiba ifintu ifyamushilo ne fishili fyamushilo, na pakuti baleishiba ifikowesha abantu ne fishibakowesha.

english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.
translation: Nga kwalabuka ifikansa, ni bashimapepo ebali nokulaputula umulandu, na pakuputula baleuputula ukulingana na mafunde yandi. Bashimapepo bali nokulacindika inshikunkulu shonse ishakumpepamo, ukulingana ne fipope fyandi na mafunde yandi, kabili bali nokulasunga Amasabata yandi ayamushilo.

english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
translation: “Bashimapepo bekalakumya citumbi ca muntu, pantu kuti balaikowesha, kanofye ninshi nga citumbi cakwa wishi nangu nyina, atemwa ica mwana wabo umwaume nangu mwanakashi, atemwa ica bamunyinabo nangu ica bankashi yabo abashaupwa, lyena kuti baikowesha.

english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.
translation: Nga umo aikowesha mu nshila iyi, ali nokusangululwa. Nga apwa ukusangululwa, pali nokupita inshiku cine lubali,

english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: elyo ninshi aye mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati umwaba iŋanda yandi. Atuule no mutuulo wakwe uwakwelelwa pa bubifi, awe ninshi lyena kuti alabomba imilimo nakabili mu ŋanda yandi.

english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.
translation: “Pa bena Israeli ni bashimapepofye beka ebashalekwatako impanga iyakuba icikwatwa cabo. Ne cikwatwa cabo nine winefye ne Lesa. Belapeelwako icuma icakuti baleikwatila, ne mwine wine nine nakulaba icuma cabo icakuti baleikwatila.

english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.
translation: Imituulo ya cabunga, ne mituulo iyakwelelwa pa bubifi, ne mituulo iyakufuta pa bubifi eyakulaba ifyakulya fya bashimapepo, kabili ebali nokulabuula ifintu fyonse ifyo abantu bakulampatwila mu calo ca Israeli.

english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”
translation: Nomba kateeka ena eka kuti aikalapo no kulya icakulya pa cinso candi. Ena pakwingila na pakufuma ali nokupitilapo mu muputule wa pa mwinshi uwabela lwa ku mpongolo.”

english: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
translation: Bashimapepo ebakulabuula ifisabo fyonse ifyakubalilapo ifyawamisha, ne fintu fyonse ifyakulatuulwa kuli ine. Bali nokulapeelako bashimapepo ubunga ubwapeleka ubwakubalilapo, epakuti ipaalo lyandi lileba mu mayanda yabo.

english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.
translation: Bashimapepo belalyako cuni icaifwila, nangufye inama iyaifwila, atemwa iyaipaiwa ne nama inankwe.

english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house; so I fell on my face.
translation: Uyo muntu kabili alimpishishe pa mpongolo iyabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso, antwala na kwi Tempele lubali lwa pantanshi. Awe na ine nalalolesha, namona ne Tempele lyakwa Yawe likumenefye ubucindami bwakwa Yawe. Na ine epakuwa panshi ubukupeme,

english: The LORD said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of the LORD’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.
translation: elyo nao Yawe alanjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, teka umutima, kabili uloleshe bwino no kumfwikisha ifyo ndekweba palwa fipope fyonse ifya pe Tempele lyakwa Yawe na mafunde yaliko. Ulemona bwino abafwile ukusuminishiwa ukwingilamo, elyo na bakuleshiwa ukwingila mu ncende yamushilo.

english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,
translation: “Abo bantu aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli abasangu, ubebe ukuti ine ne Mfumu Yawe nshabaleke nakabili balecita ifintu ifyabunani ngefi bacita.

english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.
translation: Balikowesha iŋanda yandi pakulaleka abenafyalo abashasembululwa, abantu abashinakila ine, ebo baleingilamo pa nshita balentuula ifyakulya, amafuta no mulopa. Balyonaula ne cipangano candi ku lwa micitile yabo yonse iyabipisha.

english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”
translation: Mu cifulo cakumombela imilimo yamushilo mu ŋanda yandi, bena basonta abenafyalo ebo balemombela.

english: The Lord GOD says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.
translation: “Kanshi ine ne Mfumu Yawe ndesosa ukuti umwinafyalo onse uushasembululwa umutima no mubili, tewakwesha kulaingila mu ŋanda yandi, nangula abefye umwinafyalo uwaisa ikala na bena Israeli.

english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to the LORD, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.
translation: “Ilyo mukalaakanya inko shonse imo imo impanga nge cikwatwa, mukampatwilako ine ne Yawe Lesa icitungu cimo icikaba icamushilo. Mubutali cili nokulepa amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , mubufumo mwena amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili (20,000) . Incende yonse ikalaba iyamushilo.

english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
translation: Bonsefye muli nokulakwata ifipimo ifyaba bwino. Muli nokulapiminako icipimo ca efa icalinga, ne cipimo ca bafa icalinga.

english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.
translation: Efa na bafa fifwile ukuba ifyalingana. Babafa ikumi ebalingana na homeri umo, elyo na ba efa ikumi ebalingana na homeri umo. Homeri e cipimo ecakulisha pali fyonse kabili ecakulingako.

english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
translation: Kanshi ifipimo fyenu fili nokulaba ifi, indalama ishekeli limo ikalingane na magera amakumi yabili (20). Amashekeli amakumi yabili (20) ukubikapo amashekeli amakumi yabili na yasano (25) elyo ukubikapo na yambi ikumi limo na yasano (15) eyo yakalingane ne ndalama ya mina imo.

english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,
translation: “Kanshi ici e cipimo ca mutuulo uyu uukankala uo muli nokulatuula. Pali homeri umo uwa ŋanu shenu ishasokolwa, muli nokulatuulapo akaputulwa kamo akalenga mutanda. Pali homeri umo uwa bale yenu iyatwiwa, muli nokulatuulapo akaputulwa kamo akalenga mutanda.

english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),
translation: Amafuta yakutuula ayakupimina mu bafa, yakaba cipimo capekumi ica mafuta ukufuma mu cipimo ca kori umo, umwingila babafa ikumi limo nangu ukulingana na homeri umo, pantu babafa ikumi limo eyalingana na homeri umo.

english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ku fitekwa fya bena Israeli, pa mpaanga imyanda ibili muli nokulatuulapo imo. Muli nokulaleta imituulo ya cabunga, ne mituulo ya fyakoca ne yakwampana, epakuti mulefuta pa fyabubifi fyenu. Efyasosa imfumu Yawe.

english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.
translation: “Abantu bonse mu calo, bali nokulatwala uyo mutuulo ukankala kuli kateeka wa mu Israeli.

english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”
translation: Elyo uyo kateeka nao eukalaba no mulimo uwakumona palwa nama ishikalaba nokulaocewa pakushileka ilambo, eukalamona na palwa mituulo ya cabunga ne ya fyakunwa, ifikalatuulilwako uluko lonse ulwa bena Israeli, pa nshikunkulu shonse, na pa kusefya ukumoneka kwa mweshi upya onse, na pa nshiku shonse ishe Sabata. Kanshi uyo kateeka eukalamona palwa mituulo ya pa fyabubifi, na palwa mituulo ya cabunga, na palwa mituulo ya malambo ayakoca, na palwa mituulo yakwampana, e mituulo iyakufuta pa fibi fya ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.
translation: Kabili Imfumu Yawe alisosele ati, “Pa bushiku ubwakutampa umweshi wantanshi, muli nokulabuula umusepela umo uwa ŋombe ilume uwabula akalema, mukaleutuula ilambo ilyakusangulwilako icifulo camushilo.

english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.
translation: Pa mulopa wa nama iyilekelwe ilambo palwa kubifya, shimapepo akalabuulapo umulopa umo, no kulaushinga ku maingwe ye tempele, na ku matungi yane ayaba pa mulu wa bulambo, na ku maingwe ya mpongolo ishakuiilapo mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati.

english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.
translation: Muli ico citungu muli nokubamo incende imo iyalingana ubukulu monse monse amakubiti imyanda isano (500) , eikabamo icifulo camushilo ice Tempele. Elyo mu mbali yaiko monse monse mukashala ulubansa ulukafunguluka amakubiti amakumi yasamo (50) .

english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.
translation: Efyo mukalecita na pa bushiku ubwalenga cine lubali ubwa uyo wine mweshi, ekufuta pa fyabubifi fya bantu bonse ifyo bashicitila ku mufulo nangu ifyo bacita mukukanaishiba. Efyo mukalasunga Itempele pakuti likaleba ilyamushilo.

english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
translation: Pa bushiku ubwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14) ubwa uyo wine mweshi wantanshi, elyo mukaletendeka ukulacindika Ipasaka , inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila. Bonse pa nshiku cine lubali bakalelyafye imikate iyishatutumuka.

english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.
translation: Pa bushiku ubwakutampilapo inshikunkulu, kateeka ali nokulaleta cilume umo uwa ŋombe, no kulamutuula ilambo palwa kubifya kwakwe, na palwa kubifya kwa bantu bakwe bonse.

english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.
translation: Pa nshiku shonse cine lubali isha nshikunkulu, kateeka ali nokulantuula ine ne Yawe Lesa bacilume wa ŋombe cine lubali ababula akalema, na basukusuku nabo cine lubali ababula akalema. Kabili pali isho shine nshiku, kateeka ali nokulatuula inshiku shonse sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
translation: Pali cilume onse uwa ŋombe uo cilolo ali nokutuula ilambo, ali nokulalundapo icipimo ca efa umo uwabunga, na mafutapo aya miolifa nayo icipimo ca hini umo. Efyo ali nokulalunda na pali sukusuku onse uo ali nokulatuula ilambo.

english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”
translation: “Pa nshikunkulu ya Nsakwe iyitampa pa bushiku ubwalenga ikumi na shisano (15), mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, pa nshiku shonse cine lubali, kateeka ali nokulatuula ayo yene amalambo ayakwelelwa pa fyabubifi, na malambo yakoca no mutuulo wa cabunga elyo na mafuta ya miolifa.”

english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.
translation: Ukufuma pali iyo ncende kukapimwa incende imo, mubutali ikabe amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , mubukulu mwena amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000) . Mukati emukaba icifulo icamushilo, ikaba ni ncende iyamushilo icine cine.

english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.
translation: E citungu cikaba icamushilo mu calo, icapatwilwa bashimapepo ababombela ne Yawe mu cifulo camushilo kabili abapalama kuli ne Yawe kukuntumika. Emukaba amayanda yabo, kabili eikaba incende iyamushilo iyikabamo iŋanda yandi iyamushilo.

english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.
translation: Kabili mukaba incende na imbi, nayo ine ikabe amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) mubutali, mubufumo mwena amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000) . Iyo ncende eikaba iya bena Levi abakalabomba imilimo mwi Tempele, emukuti emukaba imishi yabo iyo bakalaikalamo.

english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.
translation: Kabili kuli nokuba icitungu cimbi icakukuulamo umusumba, cili nokulepa mubufumo amakubiti amakana yasano (5,000) na mubutali mwena amakubiti (25,000) . Ico citungu cili nokubeela lubali lwa citungu icamushilo, kabili ico citungu ecikaba ica ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse.

english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.
translation: “Kateeka ali nokukwatako impanga ku mbali shonse shibili isha citungu ca mu ncende yonse iyamushilo na ku cikwatwa ca musumba. Cili nokuba mumbali pa ncende iyamushilo ne ya musumba mukulola ku lubali lwa ku masamba, elyo lubali lwa ku kabanga. Ukutula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga ukuya na ku wa ku masamba, cili nokulinganafye ubukulu nge fitungu fimbi ifikakwatako inko sha bena Israeli.

english: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”
translation: Kanshi e citungu ico kateeka akakwatako nao mu calo ca Israeli. Bakateeka abo nsonta tabakalecusha abantu kabili, lelo bakalaleka inko sha ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli nabo bakaleikwatila ifitungu mu calo.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Enough you, princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Imfumu Yawe alisosele ati, “Imwe mwe bakateeka ba bena Israeli, awe mwabifya pafula. Lekeni ubukakashi bwenu no mucusha wenu. Akuciteni ifyalungama, kwateni no mulinganya. Mwikabwekeshapo nakabili ukulatamfya abantu bandi mu mpanga shabo. Nine ne Mfumu Yawe ndemwebelapo.

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
translation: Ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ati, “Impongolo iyakwingililapo pakuya mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati ili nokulashala iyaisalwa pa nshiku mutanda isho mubombapo imilimo, lelo pa bushiku bwe Sabata na pa kumoneka kwa mweshi upya, pena elyo muli nokulaisula.

english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.
translation: Kateeka nao wine ali nokulaingila pamo na bantu pa nshita baleingila, no kulafuma ilyo nabo balefuma.

english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
translation: Pa nshikunkulu na pa nshiku isha mapepo ayakalamba, umutuulo wa cabunga ukalaba icipimo ca efa umo, ewakulunda pali kacilume wa ŋombe kamo, nangu pali sukusuku umo, nomba pa twana twa mpaanga pena uulepepa ali nokulundapo icipimo ca bunga apo umwine alefwaila. Elyo pa cipimo ca efa umo uwabunga, pali nokulalundwa na mafuta aya miolifa nayo icipimo ca hini umo.

english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.
translation: “Kateeka ilyo akalaitemenwafye ukuntuula ine ne Yawe ilambo, libe ilyakoca nangufye ilyakwampana, bakalemwiswila impongolo ya ku kabanga iyakwingililapo mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyamukati. Ali nokulaleka ilyo ilambo nga filya fine aba nokulacita pa bushiku bwe Sabata, elyo kabili bali nokulaisala iyo mpongolo ilyo kateeka afuma.”

english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.
translation: Kabili Yawe alisosele ati, “Inshiku shonse ulucelo, muli nokuntuula ne Yawe akana kampaanga kamo akabula akalema aka mwaka umo. Uyo mutuulo uli nokulatuulwa ulucelo inshiku shonse.

english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.
translation: Kabili iciputulwa icalenga mutanda ca cipimo ca efa ica bunga, ecili nokulatuulwa inshiku shonse, na mafuta aya miolifa umusukupala umo ayakukashila ubunga. Ifunde ilyakuntuula ine ne Yawe iyo mituulo, ala lili nokulakonkwa pe.

english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”
translation: Efyo akapaanga no bunga, na mafuta ya miolifa, pefye fili nokulatuulwa ulucelo inshiku shonse kuli ine ne Yawe.”

english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.
translation: Ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ati, “Kateeka nga apeelapo icikwatwa cimo ku mwana wakwe umo umwaume, ninshi ico icikwatwa caba cuma ca balupwa lwakwe, cili nokuba e cuma cabo ica cikwatwa.

english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.
translation: Nomba kateeka nga abuula icikwatwa cimo ica citungu cakwe, no kupeelapo umusha wakwe umo, lyena ninshi ico icikwatwa cili nokubwelela kuli kateeka wine, umwaka wakulubukamo nga wafika. Pantu ico cikwatwa e cuma cakwa kateekafye pamo na bamwane abaume, ebafwile ukulacikwata pe.

english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”
translation: Kateeka alileshiwa ukulapokolola icikwatwa ca bantu bambi. Ni mu cikwatwa cakwefye emo ali nokulapeela bamwane abaume utufitungu uto bengaba nokulaikwatila, epakuti talepokolola abantu bandi bamo ifyuma fyabo.”

english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.
translation: Elyo uyu muntu aisa mpisha pa mwinshi uwabelele ku lubali lwa mpongolo ya ku miputule iyali ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Iyo miputule yali e miputule iyamushilo iya bashimapepo. Elyo uyo muntu anangilila incende imo ku mpela iyabelele ku miputule lubali lwa ku masamba,

english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
translation: Kateeka ali nokwingila ukufuma kunse ukupitila pa mpongolo yakuya mu muputule wa pa mwinshi, elyo ali nokulaiminina lwa ku maingwe ya mpongolo pa nshita bashimapepo bakalaleka amalambo yakwe ayakoca, no mutuulo wakwe uwakwampana. Apo pene pa mpongolo epo kateeka ali nokulapepela, kabinge epo ali nokulafumina pakubwelelamo. Elyo impongolo yena ili nokulashala iyaisulwa ukufika ne cungulo.

english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”
translation: elyo anjeba ati, “Kuno eko bashimapepo bali nokulaipikila inama iyituulilwe ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi no wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi, kabili eko bakulapangila umukate ku mutuulo wa cabunga ubo abantu batuulile, epakuti kwilaba cintu nelyo cimo icilepatwilwa kuli Lesa ukutwalwa mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, pantu kuti casangulula abantu.”

english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
translation: Elyo kabili uyo muntu antwala mu lubansa lwa mwilinga lyakunse, ampisha na mu mpela shaluko shonse shine. Namona ukuti mwitungi lyonse ilya lubansa mwali akalubansa akanono,

english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.
translation: emukuti mu matungi yonse aya cibansa mwali utumansa utunono tune. Mubutali cila kalubansa kalepele amakubiti amakumi yane , mubufumo mwena kali amakubiti amakumi yatatu .

english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.
translation: Mu tulubansa tonse tune kuli cila lubali mwali akalilinga ka mabwe, na ku cibumba ca kalilinga lwa panshi ekwabelele amashiko ayakwipikapo.

english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”
translation: Uyo muntu nao elyo anjeba ati, “Eaya mashiko ayo ababomfi be Tempele bali nokulaipikapo amalambo ayo abantu baletuula.”

english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
translation: Pa nshiku shonse ishe Sabata na pa kumoneka kwa mweshi onse uupya, abantu bonse mu calo bali nokulainama pakupepa pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa mpongolo iyi ine.

english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwe Sabata, kateeka ali nokulandetela ine ne Yawe Lesa utupaanga utulume mutanda utwabula akalema, na sukusukupo umo nao uwabula akalema, e malambo ayakoca.

english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
translation: Pali uyo sukusuku umo, ali nokulalundapo icipimo ca efa umo uwabunga, nomba pa twana twa mpaanga pena ali nokulalundapo icipimo cabunga apo umwine alefwaila. Pa cipimo ca efa umo uwabunga, ali nokulalundapo na mafutapo aya miolifa nayo icipimo ca hini umo.

english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.
translation: Pa bushiku bwa mweshi upya, kateeka akalaleta kacilume wa ŋombe kamo akabula akalema, no twana twa mpaanga mutanda nato utwabula akalema, na sukusuku umo nao uwabula akalema.

english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
translation: Pali ako kacilume wa ŋombe kamo na pali uyo sukusuku umo, kateeka ali nokulalundapo icipimo ca efa umo uwabunga, nomba pa tupaanga tonse kamo kamo pena ali nokulalundapo icipimo cabunga apo umwine alefwaila. Kabili pa cipimo ca efa umo, ali nokulalundapo na mafuta aya miolifa nayo icipimo ca hini umo.

english: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.
translation: Ilyo kateeka aleingila, ali no kwingilila pa mpongolo ya muputule wa pa mwinshi, kabili no kufuma epo ali nokufumina.

english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.
translation: “Ilyo abantu bakalaisa pa nshikunkulu kukumpepa ine ne Yawe, abakalaingilila ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso bali nokulafumina ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ilyo bakalapwa ukumpepa. Abakalaingilila ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo nabo bali nokulafumina ku mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Kwikalaba muntu uwakufumina ku mpongolo iyo ali engilileko, bonsefye bali nokulapusanya.

english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.
translation: Kabili uyo muntu alintwele ku mwinshi we Tempele, elyo na ine naya monako amenshi ayaletula panshi lubali lwa pa mwinshi, no kulaya ku kabanga uko Itempele lyaloseshe amenso. Amenshi yalefumina lubali lwa ku kapinda ka kulyo ake Tempele kabili lwa ku kulyo kwa bulambo.

english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.
translation: Ukutampilafye pa lusonsa lwa Engedi, ukuya shintafye na ku lusonsa lwa Enegilaimu , mu lulamba lwauko mukalaba abalondo, emo bakalaanika na masumbu yabo. Mu mumana mukalaba isabi ilingi, nalyo ilya misango ne misango, nga filya fine lyaba muli bemba wa Meditelaneani.

english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.
translation: Nomba amenshi aya mu fishiba fyauko, na ya mu manika yauko, awe yena umumana tawakaleyalula kuba ayasuma iyoo, yena yakalabafye ayakwengela umucele.

english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”
translation: Konse konse ku lulamba lwauko kukalakula imiti iya misango yonse iyikalatwala ifitwalo. Amabula yaiko tayakaleuma nakalya, kabili iyo miti tayakatale aikuba ifitwalo. Imyeshi yonse mukalatwalamo ifitwalo ifipya, pantu ikalatapililwa na menshi ya mu mumana uwatula mu cifulo icamushilo. Imiti ikalatwala ifitwalo ifikalaba ifisuma kukulya, na mabula yaiko yakalabomba kukuundapilako abantu.”

english: The Lord GOD says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
translation: Ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ati, “Kuli nokuba imipaka mu calo ico inko ikumi na shibili (12) isha bena Israeli shikaputwila ifitungu fya cishilano cashiko. Uluko lwa bamwana Yosefu lwena luli nokuputwilwa icitungu na cimbi ukucila pa nko shinabo shimbi.

english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.
translation: Ine nalilapile ilyo nalaile ifikolwe fyenu ukuti ine nkafipeela cino calo, cikabe icuma cabo, kanshi mukacakane ukwabula ukucishanya, pakuti cikabe icuma cenu icakuti mukaleikwatila.

english: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;
translation: “Kanshi imipaka ili nokuba ifi,

english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
translation: elyo kabili ukuya pusha na pa musumba wa Belota no wa Sibiraimu, e misumba iyabela pakati ka calo ca Damasiko ne calo cinankwe ica Hamati, elyo no kuya shintafye na ku musumba wa Haseli Hatikoni uwabela mu mupaka wa calo ca Haulani.

english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
translation: Kanshi ku kapinda ka ku kuso, umupaka ukatampila kuli bemba wa Meditelaneani, ukucilinganya no musumba wa Hasari Enoni, ukuya shinta na ku kapinda ka ku kuso mu mupaka wa calo ca Damasiko, no wa calo ca Hamati.

english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.
translation: “Umupaka wa ku kabanga uli nokutampila pakati ka Damasiko na Haulani, elyo lwa ku masamba umumana wa Yordani eukaba umupaka wa calo ca Israeli, elyo ku kabanga umupaka ni Gileadi, ukuya shintafye na ku musumba wa Tama, ulya waba kuli bemba wa ku kabanga .

english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.
translation: “Umupaka wa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, ukutampila pa musumba wa Tama, ukalole na ku kashiba ka menshi aka Meribati Kadeshi, elyo uko kwine ukalambate na kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto, no kuya pelela kuli bemba wa Meditelaneani. Uyu eukaba umupaka wa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.
translation: Elyo kabili uyo muntu amfumisha panse ye linga lyakunse, ampisha pa mpongolo ya ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Alanshingulusha na panse ukuya fikafye na ku mpongolo iyabelele lwa ku kabanga, na menshi pakupita yalefuma ku mpongolo lubali lwa ku kulyo kwaiko.

english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
translation: “Umupaka wa ku masamba, ukakonka bemba wa Meditelaneani, ukuya shintafye na ku Lebo Hamati. Uyu eukaba umupaka wa ku masamba.

english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
translation: “Kanshi mukaakanya ici calo ukulingana ne nko sha bena Israeli.

english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
translation: Icalo cili nokuba icuma cenu. Abenafyalo abo mwikala nabo, abafyalila na bana babo mu calo cenu, nabo bene bali nokupeelwako ifitungu ilyo mukalaakanya icalo. Muli nokulabamonafye nga bena Israeli banenu, kanshi ilyo mukalaakanya inko sha bena Israeli icalo, nabo bene muli nokubaputwilako ifitungu ifyakuti nabo bakaleikwatila.

english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Mu ba luko lonse umo umweni aya ikala, mulya mwine emo mufwile ukumupeelako icishilano cakwe. Efyasosa imfumu Yawe.”

english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
translation: Elyo uyo muntu abuula itete lyakwe ilyakupiminako, awe alapima na kamulonga, aya alekapima uko kalolele ku kabanga, akapima amakubiti ikana limo , elyo anjeba ukuya mu menshi, amenshi nayo yapelelafye mu nkolokoso.

english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.
translation: Elyo kabili aya apima amakubiti na yambi ikana limo (1,000), nakabili anjeba ukuya mu menshi, apo pena amenshi yapelela mu makufi. Kabili aya alapima na yambi makubiti ikana limo (1,000), nakabili anjeba ukuya mu menshi, apo pena amenshi yafika mu musana.

english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.
translation: Nakabili aya alapima amakubiti na yambi ikana limo (1,000), uko kwena akamulonga kakwata itenga iline line, ilyakuti nafilwa no kuyapo. Uko kwena kwalishikile icibi, icakuti umuntu pakwabuka, kano ninshi aowafye.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
translation: Nao uyo muntu epakunjipusha ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe wafimona ifi fintu?”

english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
translation: kutifye cilya nafikako, awe namona konse konse ku lulamba kuli imiti iyingi.

english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
translation: Saka 14:8

english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
translation: Na konsefye uko uyu mumana ukalapita, kukalaba ifyabumi ifya misango yonse, ne sabi ilya misango yonse. Uyu mumana ukalaalula amenshi ya muli Bemba Wamfwa ukuba ayasuma, na konsefye uko ukalapita ukalaleta ubumi.

english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.
translation: Kabili Yawe alikonkenyepo ati, “Ishi e nko ukulingana na mashina yashiko.

english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.
translation: “Muli ico cine citungu icamushilo emukaba ne ncende imo iya bashimapepo. Ku kapinda ka ku kuso lubali na ka ku kulyo lubali, iyo ncende ili nokulepa amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , elyo ku kabanga lubali na ku masamba ili nokufunguluka amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000) . Iŋanda yandi ine ne Yawe Lesa, yena ili nokubela lwa pakati nankati ka iyo ine ncende.

english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
translation: Iyo ine ncende iyamushilo eili nokuba iya bashimapepo abalubwilwa ine, emukuti ni bamwana Sadoki abaume. Pantu bena balamombela bwino bwinofye, kabili bena tabacitileko ifyacitile abena Levi banabo, abakonkelele abena Israeli bambi mukulufyanya.

english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
translation: Kanshi bamwana Sadoki bena bali nokukwata incende iyi nge cabupe icaibela, kwena ili nokupalamana ne ncende ya bena Levi bambi, kabili iyi ncende eikaba iyamushilo icine cine.

english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.
translation: “Ukukonka mu ncende ya citungu ca bashimapepo, abena Levi bakapeelwe incende iyikalepa amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) mubutali, mubufumo namo amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000) . Conse pamo cili nokulela amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) mubutali, na mubufumo amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000).

english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.
translation: Icitungu icikapatwilwa ine ne Yawe ecili nokuwamishapo pali fimbi fyonse, kanshi incende shaciko teshakwesha kulashitisha, nangufye ukulashikabushamo cimo, nangufye ukulashipeelapo umuntu umo, pantu citungu camushilo, kabili umwine waciko nine ne Yawe.

english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.
translation: “Incende imbi iyikashalako, iyikaba mubufumo amakubiti amakana yasano (5,000) na mubutali namo amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , yena yacintubwingi, kuti abantu balaibomfya umo balefwaila. Kuti balaikalamo no kulaibomfya. Umusumba wena uli nokubela lwa pakati nankati ka iyo ncende.

english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
translation: Uyo musumba uli nokulingana ubukulu konse konse amakubiti amakana yane ne myanda isano (4,500) ku kuso na ku kulyo lubali, na ku kabanga na ku masamba lubali ukaba cimo cine.

english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.
translation: Elyo monse mu mbali ya musumba muli nokushalamo ulubansa ululi nokuba konse konse amakubiti imyanda yabili na makumi yasano (250) ku kuso na ku kulyo lubali, na ku kabanga na ku masamba lubali lukabe cimo cine.

english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.
translation: Incende lwa ku kabanga ishikalepa amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000) na lwa ku masamba nako amakubiti amakana ikumi limo (10,000), ishikashalako ilyo umusumba ukakuulwa mu ncende iyikasuntikana ne ncende iyamushilo, shena esho abena musumba bakalalimamo ifyakulya.

english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
translation: Onsefye uukalabomba ukufuma mu musumba, nangu abe wa mu luko nshi, ni muli isho shine ncende emo kuti alalimina ifyakulya.

english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Asheri luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Dani, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.
translation: Icitungu conse ico mukampatwila ine ne Yawe Lesa, cili nokulingana monse monse amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) . Mukapatulako incende iyamushilo nge cabupe icaibela pamo pene ne ncende iya musumba.”

english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.
translation: “Ilyo mukapwa ukumpatwila icitungu camushilo no kupima apakukuulila umusumba muli ico cine citungu icikafungululuka amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , impanga imbi yonse iyikashalako lubali lwa ku masamba ukuya shinta na kuli bemba, elyo ne ibiye iyikashalako lubali lwa ku kabanga ukuya shinta na ku mupaka wa uko kwine ku kabanga, isho mpanga eshikaba ifitungu ifyakwa kateeka. Incende iyamushilo, pamo pene ne ye Tempele fikaba pakati ka iyo ncende.

english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
translation: Icitungu ca bena Levi kumo kwine no musumba, fyonse fili nokubela muli iyo ine mpanga ya ntungulushi lwa pakati nankati. Iyo ine mpanga yakwa kateeka ili nokubela pakati ka citungu ico abena Yuda bakapeelwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ne citungu ico abena Benjamini bakapeelwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.”

english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo aka iyo ine mpanga eko inko shimbi shonse shili nokupeelwa ifitungu.

english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Simeoni luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Benjamini, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Isaka luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Simeoni, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Sebuloni luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Isaka, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Gadi luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Sebuloni, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo lubali lwa citungu ca bena Gadi, umupaka uli nokutampila mu musumba wa Tama, no kulola ku kashiba ka menshi aka Meriba Kadeshi, elyo uko kwine ukalambate na kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto, no kuya shintafye na kuli bemba wa Meditelaneani.”

english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.
translation: Ifi efyasosa imfumu Yawe ukuti, “Efyo mwe nko sha bena Israeli muli nokwakana ifitungu fya calo ifyo muli nokulaikwatila, kabili efyakushila na bana benu.”

english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Naftali luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Asheri, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;
translation: Kabili Yawe alikonkenyepo ati, “Ukutampila lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso akalepa amakubiti amakana yane ne myanda isano (4,500), impongolo ishakufuminapo mu musumba shikenikwa amashina ya nko sha bena Israeli.

english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
translation: “Impongolo shitatu ishabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso shikaitwa impongolo yakwa Rubeni, imbi impongolo yakwa Yuda, imbi nayo impongolo yakwa Levi.

english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kabanga akalepele amakubiti amakana yane ne myanda isano (4,500) kukaba impongolo shitatu. Imo ikalaitwa impongolo yakwa Yosefu, imbi impongolo yakwa Benjamini, imbi nayo impongolo yakwa Dani.

english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo akalepele amakubiti amakana yane ne myanda isano (4,500) kukaba impongolo shitatu. Imo ikalaitwa impongolo yakwa Simeoni, imbi impongolo yakwa Isaka, imbi nayo impongolo yakwa Sebuloni.

english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
translation: “Elyo ku kapinda ka ku masamba akalepele amakubiti amakana yane ne myanda isano (4,500) kukaba impongolo shitatu. Imo ikalaitwa impongolo yakwa Gadi, imbi ikalaitwa impongolo yakwa Asheri, imbi nayo impongolo yakwa Naftali.

english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘The LORD is there.’
translation: “Ubutali ubwakushinguluka umusumba bukaba amakubiti amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000) . Ukutampa ilyo line, umusumba bakalawita abati,

english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Manase luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Naftali, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Efulemu luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Manase, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Rubeni luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Efulemu, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.

english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
translation: “Uluko lwa bena Yuda luli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Rubeni, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga, ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba.”

english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.
translation: “Elyo kuli nokuba ne citungu cimo ku kulyo lubali lwa ca bena Yuda, icatula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba. Ici citungu muli nokumpatwila ine ne Lesa. Cili nokuba amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) , na mubutali ukutula ku mupaka wa ku kabanga ukuya shinta na mu mupaka uwabela ku masamba cili nokulingana ne fitungu ifyo inko shili nokupeelwa. Pakati nankati ka ico cine citungu epali nokukuulwa icifulo icamushilo icakwa Yawe.

english: “The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.
translation: Icitungu ico muli nokupatwila Yawe, cili nokuba amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) mubutali, mubufumo namo amakubiti amakana amakumi yabili (20,000) .

english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
translation: “Nomba we mwana wa muntu, buula injelwa iyapapatala ubike panshi ulengepo umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
translation: Pa bushiku bumo ukalalyafye akamokolwa kamo aka mukate akapimwa pa nshita nayo iyapimwa.

english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
translation: Kabili pa bushiku bumo ukalanwapofye inkombo shibili isha menshi, e cipimo cobe nakupeela pa nshita nayo iyapimwa epela.

english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
translation: Ukalelya ngefyo wingalya icakulya ca bale. Uli nokulabuula amafi ya bantu ayauma, eyo ukalekosesha umulilo, no kocelapo imikate yobe iyapapatala, kabili ukaleleka na bantu bonse balemonako.”

english: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati, “Ilyo nkasalanganya abena Israeli mu benafyalo, ala efyo bakalalya ifyakulya ifyakowela.”

english: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
translation: Kanshi na ine epakuilishanya nati, “Ala iyoo teifyo we Mfumu Yawe, ine nshatala ndya icaifwila, nangu icasantaulwa ku fiswango. Ukutulafye ku bwaice bwandi, awe ine nshatala ndya inama iyakowela.”

english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
translation: Lesa epakwasuka ati, “Cabafye bwino, ine nakusuminisha ukuti ukalebomfya citindi wa ŋombe, eo ukaleocela imikate mu cifulo ca mafi ya bantu.”

english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;
translation: Kabinge alundapo ati, “We mwana wa muntu, ine nkonaula ifyakulya mu matala ya mu Yerusalemu. Mu bulanda bwabo abantu bakalalya icakulya icapimwafye elyo bakalanwa amenshi nayo ayapimwa mukukabila.

english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
translation: Bakekala ukwabula icakulya na amenshi, pantu fikacepa. Bakafupuka pa menso ya banabo kabili bakondoloka palwa kubifya kwabo.”

english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.
translation: Ushingulusheko icilindi icashika pakulanga ifyo bautebelele. Uciteko ne cibumbili no kwimika inkambi shakuulwisha. Bika ne mpungu ishakulondelamo ne nsakwe, ne fyakubongolwelako.

english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
translation: Buula pani ya cela uibike pakati, iwe kuno lubali, umusumba nao kulya. Elyo uloshe amenso ku musumba pantu umusumba nautebelelwa, niwe wine uutebelele. Ici e cishibilo ukuti efyo cikaba na ku ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli.

english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
translation: “Ale nomba lala kabafu, ulalile lubali lwa ku kuso, elyo uibikepo pa mubili obe no bubifi bwa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Wakulalala apo pene no kuculila ububifi bwabo pa nshiku shonse ukalala kabeya.

english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
translation: Ine nakupeela impendwa sha nshiku ukulingana ne myaka ya bubifi bwabo. Kanshi ni pa nshiku imyanda itatu na makumi pabula (390) iwe ukalaculila ububifi bwa ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli.

english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
translation: Ilyo ukapwisha, ukalale kabafu nakabili, lyena ukalalile lubali lwa ku kulyo, elyo no bubifi bwa ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda nabo ukabufute pa nshiku amakumi yane (40), esho nakupeela emukuti ubushiku bumo pa mwaka umo.

english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
translation: “Upilibwile icinso cobe ku musumba wa Yerusalemu umone ifyo bautebelele, kabili ukwabula akantu mu minwe yobe, sesemena umusumba ishamo lyauko.

english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
translation: Ine nalakukaka imyando pakuti ulefilwa ukupilibukila uku noku, ukushintafye napo shikapwila inshiku shobe ishakucula.

english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
translation: “Kanshi nomba buulapo iŋanu na bale, na cilemba ne landa, na male elyo na masaka . Ufisakanye mu cipe cimo no kulafibomfya ukupangamo umukate obe. Pa nshiku imyanda itatu na makumi pabula (390) efyo ukalalya ilyo ukalala kabafu.

english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
translation: “Nomba we mwana wa muntu, ale buula ulupanga ulwatwa no kulubomfya ngo lwembe, ubeyeleko umushishi obe, pamo no mwefu obe. Ubuule umushishi obe, uupime pa cipimo no kuutulika mu tumina tutatu.

english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.
translation: Eico pa menso yobe Yerusalemu, bashibo bakalalya abana babo, na bana babo nabo bakalya bashibo. Ala nkakukanda iwe, na bakashalapo nabo bene nkabasalanganya mpanga yonse.”

english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.
translation: Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa ati, “Kanshi napalifye ine ne Mumi, apo walikowesha icifulo camushilo ku fipasho fya bunani ne fintu ifishaibipila ifyo iwe ucita, ine winefye nkafumyapo ishuko lyandi pali iwe. Nkakulimuna nshakakubeleleko uluse nangu ukukulekelela.

english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.
translation: Ibumba limo pali yatatu ilya bantu bobe likafwila ku cikuko na ku cipowe mukati mwine umo, limbi ilyabubili likafwila kunse ya musumba ku lupanga. Na limbi ilyabutatu nkalisalanganya mpanga yonse.

english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
translation: “Elyo ukomfwisha apapela icipyu candi. Nkalanga ubukali bwandi ukushintafye napo cikalinga no mulandu wapwa. Ilyo ifyo fyonse fikafika, lyena ukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine ne Yawe mu bufuba bwandi ubukali nalilandile ukuti nkalimuna bucisanguka bobe mu mulapo.

english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.
translation: Ine nkakusha icibolya kabili icakuwelwa pakati ka mishobo iyakushinguluka, pa cinso ca bonse abakalapitapo.

english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—
translation: Ilyo ine nkafulwa no kukufokela bukali bukali pakukulimuna no busungu bwabukali, abantu bonse aba mu mishobo iyakushinguluka ilyo bakalakumona bakalakusalula no kukuwela. Ukaba icakumwenako kabili icintu cimo icakutiinya, nine Yawe nalanda.

english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.
translation: Ilyo nkaposa imifwi yandi iyikali iya cipowe pali iwe, nkaiposa mukukonaula. Nkakuletela icipowe icikali, kabili nkacilika no kwakufuma ifyakulya.

english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”
translation: Nkakutumina icipowe, nkakutumina ne fiswango ifyakwipaya bamwano, epakuti ukashale ukwabula abana. Nkakuletela icikuko, ne mpasase no kukwimisha inkondo pakuti bakakwipaye, nine Yawe nalanda.”

english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
translation: Ilyo inshiku sha kutebelela kwa musumba shikapwa, ukaye oca akamwina kamo ku mulilo pakati ka musumba. Akamwina kambi ukakonaule ku lupanga pakushinguluka umusumba. Akamwina kambi aka cipande cabutatu ukakolwile mu mwela, pantu ine nkabakonka no lupanga ulwasomonwa.

english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.
translation: Ubuulepo umushishi umo, uukake ku cisempe ca nsalu yobe.

english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.
translation: Kabili ubuulepo umushishi na umbi umo, uupose mu mulilo, uleke upye. Apa pene epakafuma umulilo uukasalanganina ku ba ŋanda yonse iyakwa Israeli.”

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Mona, Yerusalemu uo nabika pakati nankati ka mishobo ne fyalo fimbi ifyamushinguluka monse monse.

english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
translation: Lelo Yerusalemu ena , awe alikaana mu bubi bwakwe ukulasunga amafunde ne fipope fyandi. Alibipisha ukucila ne mishobo ne fyalo fimbi ifyamushinguluka, ena alikaanininafye amafunde yandi kabili alikaana no kukonka ifipope fyandi.

english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa. Ubupondamishi bobe bwalicila ne mishobo iyakushinguluka kabili wakaana no kukonka ifipope fyandi nangu ukusunga amafunde yandi. Iwe tawakonka nelyo ifipope fya mishobo iyakushinguluka.

english: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe asosa ati nomba kankwebelepo ukuti na ine nakusangukila Yerusalemu. Kabili ndi nokukukanda pakabalika ninshi ne mishobo ya benafyalo ilemonako.

english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.
translation: Pa mulandu wa tulubi tobe utwamuselu, nkakulimuna iwe Yerusalemu ifyo nshatala nkulimunapo, kabili nshakatale mbwekeshapo ukucita ico.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’
translation: Bakeshiba ukuti ine nine Yawe, nokuti ifyo ine nabasokele tefyanseko iyoo.”

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
translation: Ifi efyo Imfumu Yawe alesosa ifyakuti, “Kumpeni mu minwe, inyanyantileni, elyo mutile, ‘Iye!’ Ala ni pa mulandu wa fibi fyonse ne fya bunani fyonse ifyo imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli mwacita efikalenga mukalefwa mu nkondo, ku cipowe na ku cikuko.

english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.
translation: Abakaba ukutali bakafwa ku cikuko, abakaba mupepi bena bakafwa ku nkondo. Abakashalapo bena bakafwa ku cipowe. Kanshi bakamona ifyo nkapwisha icipyu candi pali bena.

english: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.
translation: Ifitumbi fyabo fikabafye ntangali ntangali pakati ka tulubi twabo, na monsefye mu mbali ya fibumbili fyabo ifya malambo. Fikalala ntangali ntangali pa tupili tonse ututali, na pa mulu wa mpili shonse, na mwisamba lya miti yonse iyalelema, na mwisamba lya fimuti fyonse ifya oki ifikulu, emukuti ponsefye apo balelekela utulubi twabo amalambo ayakoca. Elyo bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine ndi Yawe.

english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Ine nkabatitikisha, nkonaula ne calo cabo. Nkacisangula amatololo, ukutampilafye ku matololo ya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, ukuya fikafye na ku musumba wa Ribula, lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso. Nshakashepo nelyo pamo apo aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli baikala. Lyena elyo bonse bakashininkisha ukuti ine nine Yawe.”

english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, lolesha ku mpili sha mu Israeli, kashisesemene amashiwi yandi.

english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
translation: Kabili utile, mwe impili sha mu Israeli umfweni ishiwi lya Mfumu Yawe. Ifi efyo ine ne Yawe ndeeba impili no tupili, imikonko na manika, ukuti ine nkesa no lupanga kuli imwe, kukonaula incende ishasansama isho abantu bapepelapo utulubi.

english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
translation: Ifibumbili fyenu ifya malambo fikabongololwa, nefyo mufutumwinapo ububani fikatobaulwa, kabili nkakomaula abantu benu pa ntanshi ya tulubi twine.

english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
translation: Nkaposa ifitumbi fya bena Israeli ntangali ntangali kuntanshi ya tulubi twabo, nkasalanganya na mafupa yenu mu mbali shonse isha fibumbili fya malambo.

english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
translation: Konse uko mukekala, imisumba yonse ikasanguka ifibolya, ne ncende umo bapepela utulubi shikonaika, ifibumbili fyenu ifya malambo fikonaikila kumo kwine no tulubi, ifyo mufutumwinapo ububani fikasansaika, na fyonse ifyo mupanga nafyo fikonaikilila.

english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
translation: Abantu benu bakalafwa ntangali ntangali pakati kenu, abakashalapo elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.

english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
translation: “Lelo bamo pakati kenu ine nkabapususha, pantu bamo nkaleka bakapusukeko ku lupanga ilyo mukasalanganina mu fyalo fya mishobo imbi.

english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
translation: Elyo, kulya kwine ku mishobo ya benafyalo uko bakabasenda bunkole, abakapusukako eko bakalanjibukishisha no kwishiba pafyo bankalifye ku micitile ya mitima yabo iyabupulumushi, pantu balimfumisheko amano, elyo nefyo bali no lwinso lwa tulubi, ine balinsuulile. Kwena bakalaiseka abene pa mulandu wa fibi ne fyabunani ifyo balecita.

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine ilyakuti,

english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
translation: “Ubushiku nabufika, nomba bwafika ubushiku ubwe shamo lyobe. Inkonto naipekanishiwa, pa mulandu wakuti icilumba nacikulisha.

english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
translation: Ubuluku nabukulisha busangwike inkonto yakukandilako abacita ifyabubifi. Takuli umuntu uukashala, pali ili bumba tapakashale nelyo umo, nangufye icuma nelyo icili conse icacindama.

english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
translation: Inshita naisa, no bushiku nabufika. Mwileka uushita asekelele, nangu uushitisha abe no bulanda, pantu icipyu cimine ibumba lyonse.

english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
translation: Kashitisha wa mpanga takaipoke nakabili ilyo bonse babili bacili abomi, pantu icimonwa ca pebumba lyonse tacakabweshiwe. Pa mulandu wa kubifya tapali nangu umo uukapususha ubumi bwakwe.

english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
translation: “Nangu balishe amapenga elyo na fyonse bafiteyanye, lelo tapabe nelyo umo uwakuya kukulwa inkondo, pantu icipyu candi cili pebumba lyonse.

english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
translation: Kunse kuli ulupanga, na mukati namo muli icipowe ne cikuko. Bonse abali mu mpanga balafwa ku lupanga, elyo na bonse abali mu musumba balefwa ku cikuko na ku cipowe.

english: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
translation: Bamo abakapusuka bakafulumukila ku mpili, no kuya mukulila nge nkunda isha mwishika palwa kubifya kwabo.

english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
translation: Bonsefye amaboko yabo yaletompoka, na mu makufi yabo mulepomponteka.

english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
