translation: Balefwala insalu shabulanda, kabili bakulaikankilafye ku mwenso. Balebeya imishishi ku mitwe yabo, no kulafulika amenso ku nsoni.

english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
translation: Silifa wabo bakulauposa mu misebo kwati fyabusali, pantu silifa na golide teti fibe ifyakubapokololako pa bushiku Yawe akaba ne cipyu. Tabakamone ukutuusha ku nsala nangu ukwikuta mu nda shabo. Pantu efintu fyalebatwala kukubifya.

english: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
translation: “We mwana wa muntu, efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ku calo ca bena Israeli aleti, nomba e mpela, e mpela ya calo mu tupinda tonse tune!

english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
translation: Kale baleitakisha pa mulandu wa fyakuyemfya fyabo ifyamutengo ifyo balebomfya ukupangamo ifipasho fyabo no tulubi twabo ifyabunani. E mulandu wine ndeyalwila ukuti ifi fintu fibe ifyabusali.

english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
translation: Ine ndeleka abenafyalo ebo bafitape, ndeleka ne mbifi sha bantu mu calo esho shibuule ifyuma fyabo no kufikowesha.

english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
translation: Ine ndefumyako icinso candi kuli bena, kabili bakulakowesha iŋanda yandi iyo nacindika, na bapupu bakulaingilamo no kuikowesha.

english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
translation: “Pekanyeni iminyololo, pantu mu calo muli ubupondo, na mu musumba mwiswilefye ubuluku.

english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
translation: Eco nalaletelamo abantu ababipisha aba mu mishobo ya benafyalo, uleke ebo bese mukulaikala mu mayanda yabo. Nalalenga abantu bamaka baleleka ukuituntumba, elyo bakese abakukowesha incende shabo isho bapepelamo.

english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
translation: Ilyo icimfulunganya cilebako, bena bakulafwaya icibote nomba awe tabakacimone iyoo.

english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
translation: Amashamo yakulakonkanafye pa yabiye, na maŋwiŋwi pa maŋwiŋwi yabiye. Bakulapapata kasesema pakuti alebebako ifili nokubako. Bashimapepo tabalemona mafunde yakufunda abantu, na bakalamba bene tabalemona ifyakubapandapo amano.

english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
translation: Imfumu yakulalooshafye, umwana waiko nao akakupwa ne langulushi lyakupelelwa, na bantu ba mu calo bakulaikankilafye ku mwenso. Ine ndebakanda ukulingana ne fintu ifyo bena bacita, kabili ine ndebapingwilafye ukulingana ne mibeele yabo. Lyena elyo bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
translation: Impela naisa pali imwe, nomba mwalamona ifyo ine mpesha abantu nga nafulwa. Pantu nalamupingula imwe ukulingana nefyo mucita, no kumulimuna pa fyabunani fyenu fyonse ifishaibipila.

english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
translation: Nshamupanye, kabili icine cinefye nshamulangulukile iyoo. Nalamulimuna pa micitile yenu pantu ifyabunani fili pakati kenu, epakuti mushininkishe ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe.”

english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe aleti, “Ala mwalaswa muponenwe no busanso ubushatala abumfwikapo, ebwalamwishila imwe.

english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
translation: Ala nomba impela yafika, nacipwa. Nomba impela naifika, imwe nomba lwapela.

english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
translation: Ubusanso nabwisa pali imwe mwe baikala muli cino calo. Inshita naipalama, ubushiku nabufika. Insansa isho mukwata pa mpili apo mupepela shapwa, nomba palaba utoloto.

english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
translation: Tapapite na kashita mwalamona ifyo nalamupesha imwe nga nafulwa no bukali bwandi bulepwila pali imwe. Ndemupingula ukulingana na pafyo mucita. Ndemulimuna pa fyabunani fyenu fyonse ifishaibipila.

english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.
translation: Nshamupanye, kabili nshamulangulukileko nelyo ukumulekelela iyoo. Nalamulimuna pa mulandu wa fintu ifyabunani ifyo imwe mucita, epakuti mushininkishe ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe, nokuti nine wine ndekanda.

english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.
translation: Mu mwaka uwalengele mutanda , mu mweshi walenga mutanda pa bushiku bwalenga shisano, ilyo nali mumwandi, tulelanda na bakalamba ba bena Yuda abaikele ku mulola wandi, awe napulikilwafye ukuboko kwa Mfumu Yawe kwanjikila.

english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakwingilamo. Awe ne cacine namonafye pa fibumba konse konse fyalilengwapo ifikulika, ne nama shimbi ishakowela, ne filubi fimbi ifyo aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli balepepa.

english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.
translation: Nasangamo pantanshi abakalamba amakumi cine lubali (70) aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, na pakati pali na Yasania mwana Shafani. Ninshi cila umo naikatilila ifyo alefutumwinapo ububani, no bubani ninshi bulefutumuka icushi.

english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”
translation: Epakunjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe wamona ifyo abakalamba ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli balecita muno mu bumfisolo? Bonse balepepela mu mfuba umwaba akalubi ka cila umo. Bena basosa ati, ‘Yawe tatumona iyoo. Yawe alifumyako amano kuli cino calo.’”

english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”
translation: Kabili Yawe anjeba ati, “Walamwenapo na fimbi ifyo bacita, ifyabunani ukucila na pali ifi.”

english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.
translation: Kanshi epakuntwala ku mwinshi wa mpongolo, iyabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ananga na banakashi abekele, ninshi baleloosha umulungu Tamusi.

english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
translation: Elyo anjipusha ati, “Bushe wacimona ici cintu we mwana wa muntu? Walamwenapo na fimbi ifyo bacita ifyabunani.”

english: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.
translation: Kanshi epakuntwala mukati ka lubansa lwa ŋanda yakwa Yawe no mwinshi uwakwingilila mu ncende iyamushilo pakati ka bulambo no mwinshi wine, epo naya sanga abaume ni cikanga amakumi yabili na basano (25). Ninshi nabafutatila Itempele lyakwa Yawe, nabalosha amenso ku kabanga, no kwinamika impumi shabo balepepa akasuba.

english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.
translation: Nao epakunjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe wacimona ici cimusango? Aba bantu ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda, ala tabakaleke kulacita ifi fintu fyonse ifyabunani ifyo umwene muno. Ebalengele nokuti kube ubuluku mu calo conse cino, no kutwalilila baletwalililafye ukunkalifya umutima. Lelo batila, ‘Tacili mulandu ukalamba, iyoo.’ Lolesha balebika umusambo wa cimuti ku myona yabo.

english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”
translation: Eico na ine nkabakanda, bakamone apapela icipyu candi. Takuli abo ilinso lyandi likashapo, nshakabalangulukilepo. Nangu bakeshe shani ukumpapata no kupundila mu matwi yandi, ine nshakatale mbomfwa nakalya.”

english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.
translation: Nalolesha mu mulu, namona cimo icalemoneka ngo muntu. Ukufuma mu musana waciko ukushinta na ku makasa cali ngo mulilo, ukufuma mu musana ukuya pamulu umubili walebengeshima ngo mukuba uwapukushika.

english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
translation: Kabili uyo muntu atambalika icalemoneka ngo kuboko, anjikata na ku mushishi wandi uwa ku mutwe. Umupashi wanjimisha pakati ka mulu ne sonde, elyo muli ifyo fine ifimonwa wansenda wantwala na ku Yerusalemu. Waya njishisha lwamukati ku mwinshi wa mpongolo yamukati, iya ku kapinda ka ku kuso mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, palya pabela icilubi icilenga ubufuba.

english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.
translation: Mulya mwine emo namona ubucindami bwakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli apulama, nga filya fine namumwene mwiwanga mu cimonwa.

english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
translation: Lesa epakunjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, lolesha ku kapinda ka ku kuso.” Awe na ine naloleshako, namona mupepi no bulambo ku mwinshi wa mpongolo, kuli icilubi icilenga ubufuba.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”
translation: Elyo anjeba ati, “We mwana wa muntu, bushe wamona ifyo aba bantu bacita? Tamba ifintu ifyabunani ifyo aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli bacita muno. Balintalusha mu ncende yandi iyamushilo. Lelo walamwenapo na fimbi ifyacilapo ku bunani.”

english: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
translation: Elyo kabili antwala ku mwinshi wa lubansa elyo nalolesha namona ne cipunda mu cibumba.

english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
translation: Ati nokuti, “We mwana wa muntu, sonsobola mu cibumba apa.” Na ine epakutulapo, namona umwinshi apakwingilila.

english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”
translation: Kabili anjeba ati, “Ingilamo, uye tambamo ifintu ifyabubifi ne fyansoni ifyo aba bantu balecitamo.”

english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
translation: Kabili ine nalyumfwile uko apundile mwishiwi likalamba ati, “Leteni bamalonda ba musumba, aleni iseni kuno. Cila muntu ese ne fyanso mu minwe yakwe.”

english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”
translation: Eico na ine wine ne Lesa nshashepo nangu umo, nshalangulukilepo muntu iyoo. Ine ndebacitafye ukulingana nefyo cila muntu acita.”

english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
translation: Elyo uyo muntu uwafwele insalu ishabusaka, uwakwete ne fyakulembelako, abwela na mashiwi ati, “Napwisha ukubomba ifyo mwali munkonkomeshe.”

english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
translation: Awe apopene abaume mutanda batula na ku mpongolo ya pamulu, iyabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso, bonse umo umo baisa ne fyanso ifikali, ninshi balipo no mwaume umo uwafwele insalu ishabusaka kabili ishatelela, wena ninshi nakwata ne fyakulembelako. Awe bonse baisa iminina lubali lwa ku bulambo bwa mukuba.

english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.
translation: Elyo ubucindami bwakwa Lesa wakwa Israeli bwafuma pa mulu wa bakerubi apo bwali, no kuya ku lubansa lwa ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Yawe epakwitapo uwafwele insalu ishabusaka uwakwete ne fyakulembelako, ati,

english: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
translation: “Kabiye, kapitane mu musumba onse uwa Yerusalemu, uye ulelemba icishibilo pa mpumi sha bantu bonse abalelanguluka no kulalila pa mulandu wa fyabunani ifi fyonse ifilecitika muli uno musumba.”

english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.
translation: Kabili naumfwa uko Lesa aleeba abo bambi ati, “Mukonkeni, pitaneni mu musumba, mwipayemo abantu. Tecakwesha kushapo nelyo umo, tekwesha ukulangulukila umuntu iyoo.

english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.
translation: Mwipayefye bonse abakote, abalumendo, abakashana, na banyinabo kumo kwine na bana babo. Nomba bonse abalembelwe icishibilo pa mpumi shabo, bena mwiesha kubakumyamo. Tampileni kuno kwine ku ncende yandi iyamushilo.” Kanshi nabo epakutampila pa bakalamba abaiminine ku ntanshi ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.
translation: Kanshi epakubeba ati, “Kowesheni ino ŋanda. Mu mansa yaiko isushenimo ifitumbi fya bantu. Aleni kabiyeni.” Kanshi nabo epakutampa ukwipaya abantu mu musumba.

english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”
translation: Ilyo baleipaya abantu, nashala njimininefye neka. Awe nawa nalosha icinso panshi nalalila nati, “We Mfumu Yawe, bushe kanshi uku ekufulilwa umusumba wa Yerusalemu, ukwakuti walaipayafye aba abena Israeli bonsefye muli cino calo?”

english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’
translation: Nao anjasuka ati, “Aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli na Yuda ala bali no mulandu, pantu balibifya apakalamba. Balipaulula abantu muli cino calo, kabili na muli uno musumba wine mwalisula ulufyengo. Bena batilafye abati, ‘Yawe alifumyako amano kuli cino calo cesu. Yawe tatumona iyoo.’

english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.
translation: Ilyo Esra alepepa, no kulomba ubwelelo pa fyabubifi bacitile, ninshi no kulila alelila kabili alala na panshi pantanshi ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa, ibumba ilikalamba ilya baume, abanakashi na baice aba mu Israeli bamushinguluka. Abantu nabo balila nganshi.

english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.
translation: Shimapepo Esra aima abeba ati, “Mwalipondweke, mwaupa na banakashi abenafyalo, kanshi mwalunda pa milandu ya bena Israeli.

english: Now therefore make confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”
translation: Kanshi nomba lapeni kuli Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu, no kucita ubufwayo bwakwe. Mupatukeko ukufuma ku bantu abenafyalo no kulekana na bakashi benu abenafyalo.”

english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.
translation: Elyo ulukuta lonse ulwalongene lwayasuka ne shiwi ilikalamba aluti, “Nacibe ifyo fine, tuli nokucita ifyo usosele.

english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
translation: Nomba abantu nabafula elyo na mainsa nayakosa nganshi, teti twiminine panse. Kabili umulimo uyu te wa bushiku bumo atemwa shibili pantu twalilufyanya apakalamba nganshi mu mulandu uyu.

english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”
translation: Lekeni intungulushi shesu shiminineko ulukuta. Lekeni mu misumba yesu yonse abaupa abanakashi abenafyalo bakese pa nshita yapimwa. Bakese na bakalamba na bapingushi aba cila musumba mpaka ubukali ubwakwa Lesa pali uyu mulandu bukafume apo tuli.”

english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
translation: Kwalifye Yonatani mwana Asaeli na Yaseya mwana Tikifa ebakeene uyu mulandu, elyo Meshulamu na Shabetai umwina Levi babatungilila.

english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
translation: Elyo abafumine mu busha bacita ifyo fine. Esra shimapepo asala abaume abakalamba ba ndupwa ukulingana ne ndupwa shabo, cila lupwa mwishina lyabo. Pa bushiku bwakutampa ubwa mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo, bonse baikala panshi pakulolekesha pali uyu mulandu.

english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
translation: Elyo ubushiku bwakutampa kwa mweshi wakubalilapo ninshi tabulati bupite bapwisha ukulanda na baume abaupile abanakashi abenafyalo.

english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
translation: Kanshi pasangilwe abana ba bashimapepo bamo abaupile abanakashi abenafyalo, Maaseya, Eliese, Yaribu na Gedalia. Aba ni bamo pa bana bakwa Yeshua umwana wakwa Yosadaki na bandume nankwe.

english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
translation: Balaya no kuleka abakashi babo no kuleka ilambo lyakufutila pa filubo fyabo, sukusuku ukufuma pa nama batekele.

english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
translation: Elyo Shekaniya umwana wakwa Yehieli, uwali umo pa bana bakwa Elamu, aeba Esra ati, “Twalyonaula icisumino muli Lesa wesu pakuupa abanakashi abeni abekalacalo. Nomba kuli isubilo ku bena Israeli nangu cibe ifi.

english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Imeri, ni Hanani na Sebadiya.

english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Harimu, ni Maaseya, Eliya, Shemai, Yehieli na Usia.

english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Pashuri, ni Elionai, Maaseya, Ishimaeli, Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa

english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation: Pa bana ba bena Levi, ni Yosabadi, Shimei, Kelaya (emukutila Kelita), Petaiya, Yuda na Eliese.

english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation: Pali bakemba, ni Eliashibu.

english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
translation: Pa bena Israeli na bambi, ni aba.

english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Elamu, ni Matania, Sakaria, Yehieli, Abudi, Yeremoti na Eliya.

english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Satu, ni Elionai, Eliashibu, Matania, Yeremoti, Sabadi na Asisa.

english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Bebai, ni Yehoanani, Hanania, Sabai na Atilai.

english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Bani, ni Meshulamu, Maluku, Adaia, Yashubu, Sheali na Yeremoti.

english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
translation: Kanshi nomba natupange icipangano na Lesa wesu pakutamfya bonse aba bakashi besu na bana babo ukulingana nefyo imfumu yandi na bantu abatiina ifyebo fyakwa Lesa batusokeleko. Natucite ifi ukulingana na Mafunde.

english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Pahati Moabu, ni Adena, Kela, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Besaleli, Binui na Manase.

english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
translation: Elyo pali bamwana Harimu, ni Eliese, Ishiya, Malikiya, Shemaiya, Shimeoni,

english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
translation: Benjamini, Maluku na Shemariya.

english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Hashumu, ni Matenai, Matata, Sabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremai, Manase na Shimei.

english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
translation: Pa bana bakwa Bani, ni Maadai, Amuramu, Ueli,

english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
translation: Benaya, Bedeiya, Kelui,

english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
translation: Faniya, Meremoti, Eliashibu,

english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,
translation: Matania, Matenai, na Yasu,

english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,
translation: Pa bana bakwa Binui, ni Bani, Shimei,

english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
translation: Shelemiya, Natani, Adaia,

english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”
translation: Ima kanshi pantu mulimo obe, na ifwe twakulakwafwako. Shipa, no kubomba ubombe.”

english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
translation: Makinadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
translation: Asareli, Shelemiya, Shemariya,

english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
translation: Shalumu, Amaria, na Yosefu.

english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.
translation: Pa bana bakwa Nebo, ni Yeli, Matitiya, Sabadi, Sebina, Yadai, Yoeli na Benaya.

english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.
translation: Aba bonse ebaupile abanakashi abenafyalo, kabili balibatamfishe pamo na bana babo.

english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.
translation: Elyo Esra aima, aeba ne ntungulushi sha bashimapepo na bena Levi na bena Israeli bonse ukulapa umulapo ukuti bakacitila ngomo mwine balandile. Kanshi balilapile.

english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.
translation: Elyo Esra afuma pantanshi ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa no kuya ku muputule wakwa Yehoanani mwana Eliashibu, eko asendeme bulya bushiku . Talile nangu cimo nangufye ukunwa amenshi pantu aleloosha pa mulandu wa busangu bwa bantu ababwelele mu busha.

english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;
translation: Kanshi bauma imbila mu calo conse ca bena Yuda na Yerusalemu ukuti bonse ababwelele mu busha balongane ku Yerusalemu.

english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.
translation: No muntu onse ushakese mu nshiku shitatu, ukulingana nefyo intungulushi na bakalamba bapingwile, kumupoka ifyuma fyakwe fyonse, elyo no kumufumya mu lukuta lwa babwelele mu busha.

english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.
translation: Kanshi bonse abantu, abena Yuda na Benjamini, balongana ku Yerusalemu mu nshiku shitatu. Cali mu mweshi walenga pabula, pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili (20) ubwa muli uyu wine mweshi. Elyo abantu bonse baikala mu lubansa pa ntanshi ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa, baletutuma pa mulandu wa fyacitike elyo ne mfula iyaliko.

english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
translation: Cali mu mwaka wakutendeka uwakuba pa bufumu bwakwa Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia, pakufikilisha ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyasosele kasesema Yeremia, Yawe aimishe umutima wakwa Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia ukuma imbila mu bufumu bwakwe no kuilemba ati,

english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
translation: Yere 25:11

english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
translation: “Ifi efyo Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia yasosa, ‘Yawe, Lesa uwaba mu mulu nampeela ifyalo fya shamfumu fyonse ifya pano isonde kabili nine asontele ukumukuulila iŋanda mu Yerusalemu iyaba mu Yuda.

english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.
translation: Na bonse abakwa Yawe pali imwe mwe bali pano, kuti mwabwelela ku Yerusalemu mu calo ca Yuda no kuya kuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli. Uyu e Lesa bapepa mu Yerusalemu.

english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”
translation: Umuntu onse Umuyuda uwapusuka muli bunkole ku Babiloni, pa ncende ponse apo aikala, abantu abaikala nankwe bafwile ukumupeelako silifa, golide, ifyuma ne fitekwa. Bamupeele kumo ne fyakutuula mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa iya mu Yerusalemu kukuitemenwafye umwine.’ ”

english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo abakalamba aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda na Benjamini, bashimapepo na bena Levi, na bonse abo Lesa akuntile ku mutima, baipekenye mukuya kuula cipya cipya iŋanda yakwa Yawe ilya mu Yerusalemu.

english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.
translation: Abena mupalamano babo balibafwileko pakubapeelako ifintu fimo ifyakubomfya ifili nga silifa, golide, ifyuma, ifitekwa ne fyabupe ifikankala pamo na fyonse ifyakutuula kukuitemenwafye.

english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;
translation: Elyo imfumu Sairasi abwesha ifipe fya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ifyo Nebukadinesa asendele ukufuma ku Yerusalemu no kufibika mu ŋanda yakupepelamo imilungu yakwe.

english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
translation: Kanshi Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia epakufipeela kuli kasunga wa fyuma Mitiredati, nao afipendela Sheshibasa cilolo wa Bayuda.

english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,
translation: Iyi e mpendwa yafiko:

english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;
translation: Aba e bantu ba mu citungu ababwelele mu calo cabo, ukufuma ku Babiloni uko Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni abasendele muli bunkole. Kanshi babwelele ku Yerusalemu pamo pene na ku Yuda, na cila muntu aya ku mushi kumwakwe.

english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.
translation: abana bakwa Bani bali imyanda mutanda amakumi yane na babili (642)

english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.
translation: abana bakwa Bebai imyanda mutanda na makumi yabili na batatu (623)

english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.
translation: abana bakwa Adonikamu bali imyanda mutanda, amakumi mutanda na mutanda (666)

english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

translation: Aba ebaishile na Serubabeli, Yeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Reelaya, Modekai, Bilishani, Misipari, Bigifai, Reumu na Baanaya.

english: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.
translation: abana baume bakwa Harimu bali ikana limo ne kumi limo na cine lubali (1,017)

english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.
translation: Abena Levi ni aba: Abana baume bakwa Yeshua na Kadimieli, abeshikulu bakwa Hodafiya, bali amakumi cine lubali na bane (74).

english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.
translation: Elyo bakemba abana bakwa Asafu bali umwanda umo na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (128).

english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.
translation: Bakalinda ba mpongolo nabo, bamwana Shalumu abana bakwa Ateri, abana bakwa Talimoni, abana bakwa Akubu, abana bakwa Hatita, abana bakwa Shobai, bonse pamo bali umwanda umo na makumi yatatu na pabula (139)

english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
translation: Ababomfi be Tempele ni aba: Abana baume bakwa Siha, abana baume bakwa Hasufa, abana baume bakwa Tabaoti,

english: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
translation: abana baume bakwa Kerosi, abana baume bakwa Siaha, abana baume bakwa Padoni,

english: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
translation: abana baume bakwa Lebanaya, abana baume bakwa Hagaba, abana baume bakwa Akubu,

english: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,
translation: abana baume bakwa Hagabu, abana baume bakwa Shalimai, abana baume bakwa Hanani,

english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
translation: abana baume bakwa Gideli, abana baume bakwa Gahari, abana baume bakwa Reaya,

english: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
translation: abana baume bakwa Resini, abana baume bakwa Nekoda, abana baume bakwa Gasamu,

english: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
translation: abana baume bakwa Usa, abana baume bakwa Pasea, abana baume bakwa Besai,

english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.
translation: abana bakwa Ara, imyanda cine lubali na makumi cine lubali na basano (775)

english: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,
translation: abana baume bakwa Asina, abana baume bakwa Meunimu, abana baume bakwa Nefisimu,

english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
translation: abana baume bakwa Bakibuku, abana baume bakwa Hakufa, abana baume bakwa Hahuri,

english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
translation: abana baume bakwa Basiluti, abana baume bakwa Meida, abana baume bakwa Hasha,

english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
translation: abana baume bakwa Bakosi, abana baume bakwa Sisera, abana baume bakwa Temaya,

english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
translation: abana baume bakwa Nesiya na bana baume bakwa Hatifa.

english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,
translation: Abana baume ba babomfi bakwa Solomoni ni aba: Abana baume bakwa Sotai, abana baume bakwa Hasofereti, abana baume bakwa Peruda,

english: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
translation: abana baume bakwa Yala, abana baume bakwa Dakoni, abana baume bakwa Giddeli,

english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.
translation: abana baume bakwa Shefatiya, abana baume bakwa Hatili, abana baume bakwa Pokereti Hasebaimu na bana baume bakwa Ami.

english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.
translation: Ababomfi be Tempele na bana baume ba babomfi bakwa Solomoni bonse pamo bali imyanda itatu na makumi pabula na babili (392).

english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
translation: Kabili aba, ebaninine ukufuma ku Tele Mela elyo na ku Tele Hasha, Kerubi, Adoni na ku Imeri, lelo calibanshishe ukulumbula uko amayanda ya bashibo yali, nangufye uko yatantikwe, nangu ukutilafye bena bali abena Israeli.

english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.
translation: Nehem 7:6-73

english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.
translation: Abana bakwa Delaiya, abana bakwa Tobia, abana bakwa Nekoda, bali imyanda mutanda amakumi yasano na babili (652).

english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
translation: Nomba kuli bashimapepo ni aba: Abana baume bakwa Hobaya, abana baume bakwa Hakosi elyo na bana baume bakwa Basilai uwabuulile umukashi wakwe ukufuma ku lupwa lwakwa Basilai umwina Gileadi no kwinikwako ishina limo line.

english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
translation: Aba ebo bafwailishe amashina ya fikolwe fyabo mu fitabo lelo tabafimwene, kanshi epakubafumya pa mulongo wa bashimapepo no kubapendela pa bashasangululwa.

english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.
translation: Umulashi wa calo apeele icebo icakuti takuli kulya icakulya camushilo mpakafye bakakwate shimapepo uukapendula ukubomfya Urimu na Tumimu.

english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
translation: Abana bonse ababwelele ukufuma mu busha bali amakana amakumi yane na yabili ne myanda itatu na makumi mutanda (42,360).

english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.
translation: Babwela pamo na babomfi abaume na banakashi abali amakana cine lubali ne myanda itatu na makumi yatatu na cine lubali (7,337), aba bena bali na bakemba abaume na banakashi imyanda ibili (200).

english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
translation: Bakabalwe babo bali imyanda cine lubali na makumi yatatu na mutanda (736). Imisepela ya bapunda bakwete imyanda ibili amakumi yane na basano (245),

english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
translation: ingamila shabo nasho shali imyanda ine amakumi yatatu na shisano (435), elyo bapunda bali amakana mutanda imyanda cine lubali na makumi yabili (6,720).

english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.
translation: Ilyo abali mu busha ku Babiloni bafika ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa iyali mu Yerusalemu, abakalamba ba ndupwa bamo batuula ifyabupe ifyakuitemenwa ifyakwafwilishako ukukuula iŋanda yakwa Lesa apo yakuulilwe kale.

english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
translation: Ukulingana na maka bakwete, bapeele indalama drakimasi amakana amakumi mutanda ne ikana limo (61,000) isha golide ne ndalama minasi amakana yasano (5,000) isha silifa , kabili ne fyakufwala ifya bashimapepo nafyo umwanda umo (100).

english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
translation: abana bakwa Elamu bali ikana limo imyanda ibili na makumi yasano na bane (1,254)

english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
translation: Bashimapepo, abena Levi, bakemba, bakalinda wa mpongolo na babomfi be Tempele baikele mu misumba yabo, na bena Israeli abashala nabo mu misumba yabo.

english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.
translation: abana bakwa Satu amakana pabula amakumi yane na basano (945)

english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.
translation: abana bakwa Sakai bali imyanda cine lubali na makumi mutanda (760)

english: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
translation: Ilyo umweshi walenga cine lubali wafikile, ninshi abena Israeli bonse balikala mu mishi yabo, elyo bonse balongene nga bana ba ŋanda imo ku Yerusalemu.

english: When the builders laid the foundation of the LORD’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, according to the directions of David king of Israel.
translation: Ilyo bakakuula bapwisha ukwimba umufula we Tempele lyakwa Yawe, bashimapepo baisa nabafwala ne fyakufwala fyabo, nabasenda na mapenga. Abena Levi bamwana Asafi nabo baisa nabasenda ne miwaya, baya ikala pa ncende yabo balalumbanya Yawe ukulingana nefyo Davidi imfumu ya bena Israeli asosele.

english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to the LORD, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the LORD’s house had been laid.
translation: Elyo baimba bonse capamo mukutasha no kutotela Yawe abati,

english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,
so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.
translation: Imila 5:13

english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
translation: Elyo Yeshua umwana mwaume uwakwa Yosadaki na bamunyina bashimapepo, na Serubabeli umwana mwaume wakwa Shealitieli na bamunyina, epakukuulila Lesa wa bena Israeli ubulambo bwakocelapo amalambo, ukulingana nefyo calembwa mu mafunde yakwa Mose umuntu wakwa Lesa.

english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
translation: Bakuula ubulambo pa mufula wa pa ncende iyakale nelyo baletiina abantu abaleikala kuli ilya incende, elyo batampa ukulatulilapo Yawe amalambo yakoca ulucelo ne cungulo.

english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;
translation: Balasefya ne nshikunkulu ya Nsakwe ukulingana nefyo calembwa. Cila bushiku baletuula amalambo yakoca ukukonka ne mpendwa iya fyalefwaikwa cila bushiku.

english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the LORD.
translation: Kabili balikonkenyepo ukuleka amalambo yakoca. Balundapo na ya mweshi upya, na ya nshikunkulu shimbi ishakupepelamo Yawe elyo ne mituulo cila muntu ali nokutuula kuli Yawe kukuitemenwafye.

english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD; but the foundation of the LORD’s temple was not yet laid.
translation: Ubushiku bwakutampa umweshi uwalenga cine lubali batampile ukutuula kuli Yawe amalambo yakoca nelyo bali tabalapwa ukwimba umufula wakukuulilapo Itempele lyakwa Yawe.

english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.
translation: Elyo bapeela indalama ku bakasona wa mabwe na bakabasa wa mbao. Bapeela ifyakulya ne fyakunwa na mafuta ya miolifa ku bena Sidoni na bena Turi. Bacitile ifi fyonse pakuti batwale imilando ya fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda pali bemba ukufuma ku Lebanoni ukutwala ku Yopa ukulingana ne nsambu bapeelwe kuli Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia.

english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of the LORD’s house.
translation: Mu mweshi wabubili uwa mu mwaka wabubili apo babwelele ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa mu Yerusalemu, Serubabeli umwana wakwa Shealitieli, elyo na Yeshua umwana wakwa Yosadaki batampako ukubomba pamo na bamunyinabo bonse bashimapepo na bena Levi abo bafumine nabo mu busha no kubwelelamo ku Yerusalemu. Kanshi basala abena Levi ukwambila pa myaka amakumi yabili (20) no kucilapo pakuti bangalile umulimo wakukuula iŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.
translation: Elyo Yeshua na bana bakwe pamo na bamunyina baikatana na Kadimieli na bamwane abaume abana bakwa Yuda pakwangalila umulimo wa mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, pamo na bana baume abakwa Henadadi na bana baume ba bena Levi na bamunyinabo.

english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to the LORD, the God of Israel,
translation: Ilyo abalwani ba bena Yuda na Benjamini baumfwile ukuti abantu abali mu busha nabatampa ukukuulila Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, Itempele,

english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.
translation: ne mishobo yonse iyo umuntu umo uwacindama kabili uwalulumbi Osinapa , atamfishe elyo baisa ikala mu Samaria na mu calo conse icabela kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate .”

english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River.
translation: Ifi efyali kalata batumine,

english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.
translation: Tulefwaya ukwishibishako imfumu ukuti Abayuda abali uko kale, abo pali nomba abaisa kuno mwesu ku Yerusalemu nabambako ukukuula cipya cipya ulya umusumba wabusangu kabili uwabubifi. Balekuula ifibumba no kuwamya imifula.

english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.
translation: Kabili nacilinga ukwishibisha imfumu ukuti umusumba nga wakuulwa nakabili, ne fibumba nga fyapwa, aba bantu tabakalepeela umutuulo nangu ukusonka imisonko iya misebo, nangu iya fipe ifilefuma ku ncende shimbi. Ici cikonaula icipao ca bashamfumu.

english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,
translation: Apo kwisano ekufuma imilile yesu, kabili teti tutemwe ukumona umusebanya ku mfumu, ecalenga ukuti tutume uyu kalata no kwishibisha imfumu.

english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.
translation: Mufwailishe ifyalembwa mu fitabo fya fikolwe, mwalasanga ukuti uyu musumba usangu, kabili wabonaushi ku mfumu na ku fitungu fimbi, elyo ni ncende iyabwafya ukufumafye nakale. Ecalenga nokuti baonaule.

english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.
translation: Tulefwaya ukuti imfumu ishibe ukutila umusumba nga wakuulwa cipya cipya ne fibumba fyakuulwa, ninshi amaka yobe ayakuteeka cilya citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate yapwa.”

english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.
translation: Elyo imfumu yatuma ubwasuko, aiti:

english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.
translation: Kalata mwantumine baliipilibwila mu lulimi lwesu no kumbelengela balimbelengela.

english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.
translation: Nalipeela icipope icakuti bafwailishe bwino palwa uyu mulandu, elyo natusanga nokuti abantu ba muli uyu musumba ukufumafye na kale baleimina no kutalamina imfumu. Uyu musango wabusangu ne micitile ibi fyalitwalilila ukucitwa muli uyu umusumba.

english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”
translation: baya kuli Serubabeli na bakalamba ba ndupwa sha bashibo, babeba abati, “Lekeni tukuule bonse Itempele pantu na ifwe bene tupepa Lesa wenu ngefyo mucita. Elyo tulamutuula na malambo ukutampafye pa nshita yakwa Esahadoni imfumu ya ku Asiria uwatuletele kuno.”

english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.
translation: Elyo kabili kwaliko imfumu ishamaka ishaleteeka mu Yerusalemu, ukufikafye na kwishilya lya mumana baleshipeela imituulo no kulasonka imisonko ya misebo nangu iya fipe ifilefuma ku ncende shimbi.

english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.
translation: Kanshi nomba mupeele icipope kuli abo bantu icakuti baleke ukubomba, pakutila umusumba wikuulwa nakabili mpakafye nkapingule.

english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
translation: Mucenjele mwifilwa ukucita ifi namweba pali uyu mulandu. Cinshi twingalekela ukuti ubonaushi bwabipa ifi bulecusha imfumu mukutwalilila.”

english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.
translation: Panumafye yakubelenga kalata uwafumine ku mfumu Atakisesi, Reumu na Shimushai kalemba na banabo bambi bwangu bwangu baya ku Yerusalemu ku Bayuda no kubalesha ku maka ukukuula.

english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”
translation: Nomba Serubabeli, Yeshua na bambi abakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Israeli bayasuka abati, “Ifwe tatulefwaya ukuti tukuule nenu iŋanda yakwa Lesa. Tukakuulila Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, Itempele fwe bene ukulingana nefyo Sairasi imfumu ya ku Pesia atukonkomeshe.”

english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.
translation: Elyo abekalacalo batampile ukunenuna abena Yuda no kubatiinya pakuti baleke ukukuula.

english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
translation: Elyo bapeela bashicilye amafisakanwa abakubemininako pakuti bafupule imilimo na mapange ya bena Yuda. Kabili batwalililafye ukulacita ifi pa nshita yonse yakwa Sairasi mfumu ya ku Pesia, mpakafye ne nshita Dariusi aishile ba imfumu ya ku Pesia.

english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation: Mu nshiku shakwa Asuelusi, ku kwambafye kwa bufumu bwakwe, balemba kalata wakupeela imilandu ku bekashi ba mu calo ca Yuda na Yerusalemu.

english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.
translation: Kabili mu nshiku shakwa Atakisesi, Bishilamu na Mitiredata na Tabeli na banankwe bonse balembela Atakisesi imfumu ya ku Pesia uyu kalata, alembelwe mu filembo fya lulimi lwa Aramaiki , na pakubelenga balemubelenga mu Ciaramaiki .

english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.
translation: Reumu umukalamba wa bashilika na Shimushai kalemba balemba kalata walupato pali Yerusalemu ku mfumu Atakisesi mu musango uyu.

english: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,
translation: “Ukufuma kuli Reumu umukalamba wa bashilika na Shimushai kalemba na banabo bambi, bakapingula wa milandu, abalashi, bacilolo, abakalamba, abena Ereki, aba ku Babiloni, abena Susa emukutila abena Elamu,

english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.
translation: Elyo bakasesema babili, Hagai na Sakaria umwana wakwa Ido, basesemena Abayuda abali mu calo ca Yuda na mu Yerusalemu mwishina lyakwa Lesa wa bena Israeli uwalebasunga.

english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.
translation: Twalibepwishe na mashina pakuti tulembe amashina ya bantu abalebatungulula no kukwishibisha.

english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
translation: Lelo batwaswike abati, ‘Tuli babomfi bakwa Lesa wa ku mulu na pesonde line. Tulekuula cipya cipya ino iŋanda iyo imfumu nkalamba iya bena Israeli yakuulile no kupwisha kalefye.

english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.
translation: Hagai 1:12

english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.
translation: Kwena mu mwaka wakubalilapo uwakwa Sairasi mfumu ya ku Babiloni, imfumu Sairasi apeele icebo icakukuula cipya cipya ino iŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.
translation: Elyo afumishe ne fipe ifya golide na silifa ifyali mwi sano lya ku Babiloni, ifya ŋanda yakwa Lesa fintu Nebukadinesa afumishe mwi Tempele lya ku Yerusalemu, ifi e fipe imfumu Sairasi apeele umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Sheshibasa, uo asontele ukuba umulashi wa citungu.

english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’
translation: Amwebele ukuti, “Senda ifi fintu uye fibika mwi Tempele lya ku Yerusalemu elyo lekeni ne ŋanda yakwa Lesa ikuulwe cipya cipya pa ncende yabelelepo.”

english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.
translation: Kanshi uyu Sheshibasa epakwisa imba umufula wa ŋanda yakwa Lesa mu Yerusalemu. Ukufuma ilya ine nshita mpaka na nomba iyi ŋanda icili ilekuulwa lelo tailati ipwe.’

english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”
Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.
translation: Kanshi Serubabeli mwana Shealitieli na Yeshua mwana Yosadaki baima no kwamba ukukuula iŋanda yakwa Lesa iyali mu Yerusalemu. Na bakasesema bonse babili bali nabo, balabafwilishako.

english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”
translation: Pali ilya nshita, Tatenai umulashi wa cilya citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana na Sheta Bosenai na banabo bambi baya uko balekuula no kubeba ati, “Nani amupeela insambu shakukuula nakabili iyi iŋanda pakuti mupwishishishe umulimo wakukuula ?”

english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.
translation: Bakonkanyapo no kwipusha amashina ya bantu abalekuula.

english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.
translation: Lelo amenso yakwa Lesa yali pa bakalamba ba Bayuda. Kanshi tababaleseshe ukukuula, balelolela ukuti imfumu ikaasuke kalata batumine.

english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.
translation: Saka 4:6-9

english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written: To Darius the king, all peace.
translation: Batumine amashiwi ku mfumu, umwalembelwe ifyakuti,

english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.
translation: Tulefwaya ukwishibisha imfumu ukuti twaliya ku citungu ca Bayuda, ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa mukulu. Twasangile abantu balekuula na mabwe ayakulu nganshi. Balebika ne mbao pa fibumba balekuula. Balebomba uyu mulimo bwino bwino kabili ucili uletwalilila.

english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”
translation: Kwena twalipwishe abakalamba no kubeba ukuti, ‘Nani amupeele insambu shakukuula nakabili ino ŋanda no kupwishishisha ici cikulwa?’

english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.
translation: Elyo imfumu Dariusi apeele icipope icakufwaya fwaya ifitabo umwalembwa imilandu ifyo basungile mu ŋanda ya fishilano ku Babiloni.

english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.
translation: Ifi ni pakutila balelekela Lesa wa ku mulu ilambo ilyakumusekesha. Elyo balepepelako ne mfumu pamo na bana baiko.

english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
translation: Kabili napeela icipope ukuti umuntu onse uwakaana ukukonka ici cebo, bafwile basomona umwalo wa ku ŋanda yakwe bakamwimye elyo no ukumusomekako. Pa mulandu wine uyu, iŋanda yakwe ifwile ukubongololwa no kushala umwina wa citantala.

english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.
translation: Lesa uwalenga ishina lyakwe likale kulya kwine engafumya pa cifulo imfumu no muntu onse uukafwaya ukupilibula ici nangu ukonaula iyi ŋanda yakwa Lesa mu Yerusalemu. Ine ne Dariusi napeela icipope ici, kabili mucikonke bwino bwino.”

english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.
translation: Elyo Tatenai umulashi wa citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana, na Sheta Bosenai na babomfi banabo bakonka icipope ca mfumu Dariusi bwino bwino kabili mukwangufyanya, ukulingana nefyo imfumu Dariusi yabebele.

english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
translation: Kanshi abakalamba ba Bayuda bakonkanyapo ukukuula bwino bwino ukupitila mufyo kasesema Hagai na Sakaria umwana mwaume wakwa Ido baseseme. Bapwisha ukukuula ukulingana nefyo Lesa wa bena Israeli abakonkomeshe, no kulingana ne cipope cakwa Sairasi, Dariusi na Atakisesi imfumu sha bena Pesia.

english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
translation: Iyi ŋanda yapwile pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu mu mweshi wa Adari mu mwaka walenga mutanda uwa buteko bwakwa Dariusi.

english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.
translation: Elyo kabili abena Israeli, bashimapepo, abena Levi na bonse ababwelele ukufuma muli bunkole, basefya inshikunkulu yakutuula iyi ŋanda yakwa Lesa ne nsansa.

english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
translation: Pakutuula iyi ŋanda kuli Lesa, bapeela ŋombe ishilume umwanda umo (100), basukusuku imyanda ibili (200), utwana twa mpaanga utulume imyanda ine (400). Umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi bwa bena Israeli bonse wali basawe ikumi limo na babili (12) ukulingana ne mpendwa ya nko sha bena Israeli.

english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.
translation: Elyo basonta bashimapepo ukulingana na mabumba yabo. Abena Levi nabo ukulingana nefyo batantama mukutumika Lesa mu Yerusalemu, ngefyo calembwa mu citabo cakwa Mose.

english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na bune (14) ubwa mu mweshi wapakubala, abafumine muli bunkole ku Babiloni basefya Ipasaka inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila.

english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:
translation: Kanshi basangile icitabo icipombwa mu musumba wa Ekabatana uwali mu citungu ca Media, ne fyalembelwepo nifi.

english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.
translation: Bashimapepo bonse na bena Levi bonse baisangulula no kubafye abakaele bonse. Baipaya abana ba mpaanga be lambo lye Pasaka ilyakupapatilako abantu bonse ababwelele ukufuma muli bunkole, no kupapatilako bashimapepo banabo pamo pene na bene.

english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, ate,
translation: Abena Israeli bonse abafumine muli bunkole balile umwana wa mpaanga pamo pene na bantufye bonse abaipatwile kukukanakonka intambi ishikowesha isha bantu ba mu calo pakuti bambe ukupepa Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because the LORD had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.
translation: Basefeshe ne nsansa inshikunkulu ya Mukate uushatutumuka pa nshiku cine lubali, pantu Yawe alibasansamwishe no kulenga ukuti umutima wa mfumu ya ku Asiria upilibuke pakuti ibafweko mu mulimo wakukuula iŋanda yakwa Lesa, Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits;
translation: “Amashiwi yakwibukisha: Mu mwaka wakubalilapo uwa bufumu bwakwe, Sairasi imfumu apeele icipope palwa ŋanda yakwa Lesa mu Yerusalemu ukuti, ‘Lekeni iyi ŋanda ikuulwe cipya cipya palya pene pa ncende yali kale, ibe kabili iyakulekelamo amalambo yakoca no kutuulapo imituulo. Mu butali bwakuya pamulu ifwile yaba amakubiti amakumi mutanda (60) mukabafu namo amakubiti amakumi mutanda (60).

english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.
translation: Bakabike ne mitika itatu iya mabwe ayakalamba no mutika wa mbao umo pamulu. Elyo indalama balingile ukubomfya mu mulimo uyu shifwile ukufuma ku cipao ca mfumu.

english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.
translation: Kanshi ne fipe fya golide na silifa ifya ŋanda yakwa Lesa ifyo Nebukadinesa afumishe mwi Tempele lya ku Yerusalemu, no kutwala ku Babiloni, fifwile fyabwelela pa ncende yafiko mwi Tempele lya ku Yerusalemu. Fifwile fyabikwa mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.’

english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.
translation: “Kanshi nomba, iwe Tatenai, umulashi wa citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana , na Sheta Bosenai na banenu bonse abalashi ba mu fitungu fya kwishilya lya mumana, talukeni kuli iyi ŋanda.

english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
translation: Mwiibikamo mu mulimo wakukuulila Lesa iŋanda. Mulekele umulashi wa Bayuda na bakalamba ba Bayuda ebo bakuule cipya cipya iyi ŋanda yakwa Lesa palya pene pa ncende yabelelepo.

english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.
translation: Kabili namupeela icipope pafyo mufwile ukucita ku bakalamba ba Bayuda abalekuula cipya cipya iŋanda yakwa Lesa. Indalama shonse muli nokupeela aba bantu abalekuula, mufumye ku cipao ca misonko ilya ifuma ku citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana pakuti umulimo uyu upwe ukwabula ukuposa inshita.

english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,
translation: Na fyonse ifyo balekabila ifili nga ifiponti fya ŋombe, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga ifyakocela Lesa wa ku mulu ilambo, ne ŋanu, umucele, umwangashi na mafuta ukulingana nefyo bashimapepo ba mu Yerusalemu babomfya, bafwile ukupeelwa cila bushiku ukwabula ukufilwa.

english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
translation: Panuma ya ifi fyonse, mu buteeko bwakwa Atakisesi imfumu ya ku Pesia, kwaishile umuntu umo Esra mwana Seraya, mwana Asariya, mwana Hilikiya,

english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the LORD’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
translation: Pantu Esra abikile umutima wakwe pakusambilila amafunde yakwa Yawe, ukulayakonka elyo no kufunda aya yene amafunde ne fipope ku bena Israeli.

english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of the LORD’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:
translation: Ifi efyali kalata imfumu Atakisesi apeele kuli Esra shimapepo, uwali ni kalemba kabili umuntu uwasambilila nganshi mu mafunde yakwa Yawe elyo na mu fipope fyonse ifyo apeele abena Israeli.

english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now
translation: “Atakisesi, imfumu ya shamfumu, kuli Esra shimapepo, kalemba wa mafunde yakwa Lesa wa mumulu, umutende ube nobe.

english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.
translation: Ine nomba napeela icipope icakuti umuntu onse umwina Israeli pamo pene na bashimapepo benu na bena Levi ababa mu calo candi ukuti abo abalefwaya ukuya ku Yerusalemu, kuti baya nobe.

english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,
translation: Pantu nautumwa ku mfumu pamo na bacilolo baiko cine lubali mukwipusha palwa Yuda na Yerusalemu ukulingana na mafunde yakwa Lesa wenu ayaba mu minwe yobe.

english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
translation: Elyo uli nokutwala silifa na golide, uo imfumu na bacilolo bakwe batuulafye mukuitemenwa kuli Lesa wa bena Israeli uo icifulo cakwe caba mu Yerusalemu.

english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.
translation: Ukasende na silifa na golide mukufumya ku citungu ca ku Babiloni, pamo ne fyabupe abantu na bashimapepo batuula Lesa kukuitemenwafye pa mulandu wa fya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wabo iyaba mu Yerusalemu.

english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
translation: Ukabomfye bwino bwino indalama ishi, mukushitamo iŋombe ishilume, basukusuku na bana ba mpaanga, pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa. Ifi efyo ukatuule pa bulambo bwa mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wenu iyaba mu Yerusalemu.

english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.
translation: “Elyo silifa na golide ifikashalapo kuti wabomfya mu musango iwe na Bayuda banobe mukamona ukuti naulingana no bufwayo bwakwa Lesa wenu.

english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo ifipe fyonse filya wapeelwa ukulabomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, ufitwale fyonse kulya kwine kuli Lesa wa ku Yerusalemu.

english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
translation: mwana Shalumu, mwana Sadoki, mwana Aitubu

english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.
translation: Nga kulekabilwa na fimbi ifyakubomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa obe kuti washita. Ukabomfye indalama sha mu cipao ca kwisano.

english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,
translation: “Ine ne mfumu Atakisesi napeela icipope kuli bakasunga ba cipao aba kwishilya lya mumana icakuti, ‘Mupekanye bwino no kupeela Esra, shimapepo na kalemba wa mafunde yakwa Lesa wa mu mulu, fyonse ifyo alemulomba.

english: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
translation: Alingile ukupeelwa ukulingana ne cipimo ca makilo amakana yatatu ne myanda ine (3,400 kg) aya silifa, amakilo amakana ikumi limo (10,000 kg) aya ŋanu, balita wa mwangashi amakana yabili ne myanda ibili (2,200), balita wa mafuta ya miolifa amakana yabili ne myanda ibili (2,200) no mucele ukulingana ne cipimo akafwaya.

english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
translation: Fyonse ifyo Lesa wa mumulu apingula palwa ŋanda yakwa Lesa wa mumulu mulemona ukuti nafikonkwa bwino bwino pakuti ubukali bwakwe bwikaponena pa mfumu na bana bakwe.

english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.
translation: Kabili mufwile ukwishiba ukuti tamwakwata amaka yakupatikisha bashimapepo bonse, abena Levi, bakemba, bakasunga wa mpongolo, ababomfi ba kwi Tempele nangu umubomfi onse uwa mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa ukupeela imitulo ku mulashi nangu ukusonka imisonko ya pa misebo nangu iya pa fipe.’

english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.
translation: “Na iwe Esra ukulingana na mano yakwa Lesa obe ayo akupeela, ukasale bakalubulwisha na bakaputula wa milandu pakuti balepingula abantu ba kwishilya lya mumana no mulinganya. Ukasale pa baishiba amafunde yakwa Lesa, elyo abashaishiba bena ukabafunde.

english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
translation: Uyo onse ukakaana ukukonka amafunde yakwa Lesa obe nangu aya mfumu, bamupingule ukwipaiwa, nangufye ukumutamfya mu calo, ukumupoka ifipe nangufye ukumukaka mu cifungo.”

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem;
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe Lesa wa fikolwe fyesu, uunashishe umutima wa mfumu Atakisesi pakuti apeele umucinshi ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe mu Yerusalemu mu musango uyu.

english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to the LORD my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.
translation: Na ine, Lesa nananga icikuku no luse pa cinso ca mfumu na bampandamano wakwe elyo na bacilolo ba mfumu ababulamba. Kanshi ndi uwakosa pantu ukuboko kwakwa Yawe Lesa wandi kuli pali ine. Ninonganika intungulushi ukufuma mu bena Israeli abakunshindika.

english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
translation: mwana Amariya, mwana Asariya, mwana Meraiyoti,

english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
translation: mwana Serahiya, mwana Usi, mwana Buki,

english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—
translation: mwana Abishua, mwana Fineasi, mwana Eleasa, mwana Aroni shimapepo mukalamba.

english: this Ezra went up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to the LORD his God’s hand on him.
translation: Uyu Esra aishile ukufuma ku Babiloni. Ali kalemba uwacenjela nganshi mu mafunde yakwa Mose ayo Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli abapeele. Elyo imfumu yalimupeele fyonse ifyo alombele pantu ukuboko kwakwa Yawe Lesa wakwe kwali pali ena.

english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli bamo na bashimapepo bamo, abena Levi, bakemba, bakalinda ba mpongolo na babomfi ba mwi Tempele, baima ukuya ku Yerusalemu mu mwaka walenga cine lubali uwa buteko bwa mfumu Atakisesi.

english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
translation: Esra afikile mu Yerusalemu mu mweshi walenga busano mu mwaka walenga cine lubali uwakuteeka pa bufumu.

english: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.
