translation: Atampile ubulendo bwakwe ubwakufuma ku Babiloni pa bushiku bwa kutampa kwa mweshi wakubalilapo. Elyo afika ku Yerusalemu pa bushiku bwa kutampa kwa mweshi uwalenga busano, pantu uluse lwakwa Lesa lwali pali ena.

english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
translation: Aba e bakalamba ba ndupwa abo twafumine nabo ku Babiloni ilyo imfumu Atakisesi aleteeka cilya calo, umo bakonkanine ngefi:

english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Bani, Shelomiti umwana wakwa Yosifia pamo na baume umwanda umo na makumi mutanda (160).

english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Bebai, Sakaria umwana wakwa Bebai pamo na baume amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28).

english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Asigadi, Yohanani umwana wakwa Hakatani pamo na baume umwanda umo ne kumi limo (110).

english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Adonikamu, abakulekelesha, amashina yabo ni aya. Elifeleti, Yeuli na Shemaiya na baume amakumi mutanda (60).

english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Bigifai, Utai na Saku pamo na baume amakumi cine lubali (70).

english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.
translation: Ine ne Esra nalongenye ibumba lyonse ilya bantu mupepi no mumana utwala amenshi ku Ahafa uko twaikele inshiku shitatu. Ilyo nalolekeshe, namwene ukuti mwibumba mwali bashimapepo nomba tamwali aba mu lupwa lwa bena Levi.

english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.
translation: Kanshi epakwita intungulushi, Eliese, Arieli, Shemaiya, Elinatani, Yaribu, Elinatani, Natani, Sakaria na Meshulamu, elyo na Yoaribu na Elinatani abantu abamano.

english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
translation: Nabatuma kuli Ido uwali intungulushi ya ku ncende ya Kasifiya. Nabeba ne fyakuya sosa kuli Ido na bandume nankwe, ababomfi be Tempele aba ku ncende ya Kasifiya ukuti batutumineko abantu bakwisa bomba mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu.

english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
translation: Ku luse lwakwa Lesa ulu atukwatila, batupeele umuntu uwamano nganshi umwana wakwa Maili, mwana Levi, umwishikulu wakwa Israeli, ishina lyakwe ni Sherebiya, na bamwane na ndume nankwe bonse pamo bali ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18).

english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
translation: Batumine na Hashabiya na Yeshaya bamwana Merari na bandume nankwe na bana babo, abaume abali amakumi yabili (20).

english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Fineasi, Geshoni.

english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.
translation: Baishile na babomfi be Tempele imyanda ibili na makumi yabili (220) abo Davidi na bacilolo bakwe basontele ukwafwako abena Levi. Aba bonse balibalembele na mashina.

english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.
translation: Kulya kwine ku mumana wa Ahafa ine ne Esra napeela icebo icakufunga icakulya pakuicefya kuli Lesa wesu na pakuilombela ifwe fwe bene, abana besu pamo ne fyuma fyesu pakuti tukwate ubulendo ubusuma.

english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”
translation: Ala nali ne nsoni shakulomba ku mfumu ibumba lya bashilika ne fita fya pali bakabalwe abakutupokololako ku balwani pa lwendo lwesu, pantu twalyebele imfumu ukuti, “Ukuboko kwakwa Lesa wesu kulapaala bonse abamufwaya, lelo amaka ya cipyu cakwe yaponena pa bamusangukila.”

english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.
translation: Kanshi twalifungile no kulomba Lesa pali uyu mulandu. Lesa nao alyumfwile ipepo lyesu.

english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
translation: Elyo nasala intungulushi sha bashimapepo ikumi limo na babili (12), Sherebiya, Hashabiya, na bamunyinabo abaume ikumi limo.

english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.
translation: Nabapimine silifa na golide ne fyakubomfya no mutuulo ifya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu uo imfumu, bacilolo bakwe, ababomfi bakwe abakalamba, na bena Israeli bonse abalipo batuulile.

english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,
translation: Elyo napima silifa no kubapeela amatalanta imyanda mutanda na makumi yasano (650) , ne fipe ifya silifa ifyalingana na matalanta umwanda umo (100) , elyo golide nao amatalanta umwanda umo (100) ,

english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.
translation: imbale nasho isha golide amakumi yabili (20) ifyafinine ukulingana ne ndalama dariki isha golide ikana limo (1,000) , ne fipe fibili ifikankala ifya mukuba ifyo bashingako ifyalemoneka kwati ni golide.

english: I said to them, “You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.
translation: Elyo nabeba ukuti, “Muli bamushilo kuli Yawe ne fipe fine fili ifyamushilo. Uyu silifa na golide wine twatuula mukuitemenwa kuli Yawe, Lesa wa fikolwe fyenu.

english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of the LORD’s house.”
translation: Nomba fisungeni bwino bwino mpakafye mukafipimine pa menso ya bashimapepo bacindami, abena Levi na bakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Israeli ku Yerusalemu mu miputule ya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.”

english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Shekaniya.

english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
translation: Kanshi bashimapepo na bena Levi epakubuula silifa, golide, ne fipe fyamushilo bafipima pakuti bakafitwale ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa mu Yerusalemu.

english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.
translation: Kanshi pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shibili (12) ubwa mu mweshi wakubalilapo, twafuma ku mumana wa Ahafa no kuya ku Yerusalemu. Lesa ali na ifwe, alitupuswishe ku balwani na ku fipondo pakutila fitwimina lintu tuli mu nshila.

english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.
translation: Twafikile ku Yerusalemu, eko twatuushishe pa nshiku shitatu.

english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shine, mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu mwine emo twapima silifa, golide ne fipe fyamushilo. Bafipima no kufipeela kuli shimapepo Meremoti mwana Uria, ninshi bali na Eleasa mwana Fineasi, kabili na bamwana Levi, Yosabada mwana Yeshua na Noadia mwana Binui.

english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.
translation: Fyonse balifipendele no kupima ifyo fyafinine, no kulemba fyonse.

english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.
translation: Pali iyi nshita bonse ababwelele mu busha ku Babiloni, batuula Lesa wa bena Israeli ilambo lyakoca. Batuula iŋombe ishilume ikumi limo na shibili (12) ukulingana ne mitundu ya bena Israeli, elyo na basukusuku amakumi pabula na mutanda (96), abana ba mpaanga nabo amakumi cine lubali na cine lubali (77), no mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi basawe ikumi limo na babili (12). Ifi fyonse fyali lilambo lyakoca kuli Lesa.

english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.
translation: Kabili batuma ifyebo fya mfumu kuli bacilolo wa mfumu na ku balashi ba ku citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana , nabo epakwafwilisha abantu ne ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Pahati Moabu, Eliehoenai umwana wakwa Serahia pamo na baume imyanda ibili (200).

english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Satu, Shekaniya umwana wakwa Yahasieli pamo na baume imyanda itatu (300).

english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Adini, Ebedi umwana wakwa Yonatani pamo na baume amakumi yasano (50).

english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Elamu, Yeshaya umwana wakwa Ataliya pamo na baume amakumi cine lubali (70).

english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Shefatiya, Sebadiya mwana Mikaeli pamo na baume amakumi cine konse konse (80).

english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Yoabu, Obadiya umwana wakwa Yehieli pamo na baume imyanda ibili ne kumi limo na cine konse konse (218).

english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation: Panuma ya ifi fyonse intungulushi shaisa kuli ine no kunjeba ashiti, “Abena Israeli pamo na bashimapepo na bena Levi tabaipatula ukufuma ku bekalacalo ne fyamusebanya fyabo, ukufuma ku bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Perisi, abena Yebusi, abena Amoni, abena Moabu, abena Egupto elyo na bena Amoli.

english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,
translation: “Nomba we Lesa wesu, cinshi twingalanda pali ici? Pantu natusuula amafunde yobe,

english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.
translation: ayo watupeele ukupitila mu babomfi bobe bakasesema ifyakutila, ‘Icalo muleingilamo no kucipoka calikowela ku fyabunani fya bantu bekalamo, ne misango iyamuselu yaisula muli ici calo ukufuma ku mpela ukushinta na ku mpela.

english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’
translation: Kanshi wileka abana bobe bopwe ku bana babo, nangu abana babo bopwe ku bana benu. Tecakwesha kupangana bucibusa na bantu aba pa nshita iyili yonse, epakuti mukabe na maka, no kulya ifilyo ifisuma ifya mu calo, nokucishiila abana benu pakuti bakacipyaninine umuyayaya.’

english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,
translation: Kanshi fyonse ifyatuponene fyatucitikile pa mulandu wa ficitwa fyesu ifibi no bubifi bwesu ubukalamba, lelo twamona ukuti iwe we Lesa wesu tawatukandile ukufikapo ukulingana no bubi bwesu, walengele ukuti fwe bamo tushalepo ngefi fine.

english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?
translation: Nomba, bushe kuti twaonaula amafunde yobe nakabili pa mulandu wakuupana na bantu abacita ifyabipisha ifi? Bushe teti utufulilwe mpakafye no kutulofya ukwabula ukushalapo nangu umo uwakupusuka?

english: LORD, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”
translation: We Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli uli mololoke pantu ifwe fwe balashi natupusuka ngefi tuli lelo. Kanshi mona, ifwe tuli pa cinso cobe no kubifya kwesu, eco tapali nangu umo uwingapama ukwiminina pa cinso cobe.”

english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”
translation: Pantu balyupile abana babo no kubofya ku bana babo. Kanshi umushobo uwasangululwa bausankanya no wa bekalacalo. Muli ubu butalami, bacilolo ne ntungulushi ebacililemo.”

english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.
translation: Ilyo naumfwile ifi nalepaula ifyakufwala fyandi, umwingila ne laya ilitali ilyapikulwa ubusaka, nanukulako umushishi ne myefu, naikala bulanda bulanda.

english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.
translation: Elyo bonse abali na katiina ku mashiwi yakwa Lesa wa bena Israeli, pa mulandu wa butalami bwa bantu ababwelele ukufuma ku busha, baisa nshinguluka ninshi ninjikala mu bulanda mpakafye inshita ye lambo lya cungulo.

english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God;
translation: Kanshi pa nshita ye lambo lya cungulo naima ukufuma mukufunga ukulya ne fyakufwala fyandi ifyalepauka, nafukama, natambika na maboko yandi kuli Yawe Lesa wandi,

english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.
translation: no kutila,

english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
translation: Ukufumafye ku nshita ya fikolwe fyesu ukushinta na pa bushiku bwa lelo, twaba mu bubifi ubukalamba. Kabili pa mulandu wa bubifi bwesu, ifwe pamo ne mfumu shesu na bashimapepo besu twalipeelwa ku minwe ya mfumu sha calo, ku lupanga, mu busha, ku bonaushi na ku nsoni ngefi fine cili lelo.

english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.
translation: “Lelo nomba pa kashita akanono, Yawe Lesa wesu nalanga uluse lwakwe pakutushilako abantu bamo, no kutupeelako incende iyamutende mu cifulo cakwe icamushilo, kabili nabutusha pa finso fyesu no kulenga tupuputulwe nelyo tucili mu busha panono.

english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
translation: Pantu twali abasha, nomba Lesa tatulekelesha mu busha bwesu. Atulanga icitemwiko icakubelelela pa cinso ca mfumu sha ku Pesia, atupeela ubumi ubupya pakuti tukuule iŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu, no kuwamya ifyaonaike, no kutupeela ilinga lyakutucingilila mu Yudeya na ku Yerusalemu.

english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
translation: Ine Paulo umusole. Nshaitwa nangu ukutumwa no muntu. Lelo ni Yesu Kristu na Lesa Wishi uwamubushishe ku bafwa ebanjita.

english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
translation: Bushe pakulanda ifi, ndefwaya ukuti abantu bansuminishe? Awe iyoo! Ndefwaya ukuti Lesa eo ansuminishe. Bushe ndefwayafye ukutemwikwa ku bantu? Ndafwayafye ukutemwikwa ku bantu, nga nshili musha wakwa Kristu!

english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ico ine ndefwaya ukuti mwishibe nici icakuti, Imbila Nsuma mbila, tayafuma ku bantu.

english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
translation: Nshaipokelela ukufuma ku muntu nelyo umo, nangu ukufundwa ku muntu nelyo umo. Ni Yesu Kristu umwine ewaisokolwele kuli ine.

english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
translation: Mwalyumfwa ifya pa bumi bwandi ilyo nalekonka imipepele ya Ciyuda. Nacushishe nganshi ulukuta lwakwa Lesa. Nalefwayafye no kululofya.

english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
translation: Nalicincile ukucila Abayuda banandi abengi aba nkulo yandi mukukonka imipepele ya Ciyuda. Kabili nalibacilile bonse ukukonka ifishilano fya fikolwe fyesu.

english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
translation: Lelo Lesa ku cikuuku cakwe ansalile ninshi nshilafyalwa, anjitile no kuba umubomfi wakwe.

english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
translation: Umwine wine ewatemenwe no kunsokolwela Mwane, epakuti mone no kubila Imbila Nsuma yakwe ku Benafyalo. Pa nshita ilya, nshaile nangu ku muntu nelyo umo pakuti ampandeko amano.

english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
translation: Kabili nshaile nangu ni ku Yerusalemu kwine kukumona abantangilile ukuba abasole, lelo naile ku calo ca Arabia. Ilyo nafumineko, nabwelele ku Damasiko.

english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
translation: Panuma ya myaka itatu elyo naile ku Yerusalemu kukumonana na Kefa. Naikele nankwe inshiku ikumi limo na shisano.

english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
translation: Nshamonene na musole umbi, kanofye Yakobo munyina wa Mfumu.

english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
translation: Ababwananyina bonse abo tuli nabo, pamo na ine wine twamulembela mwe nkuta sha mu Galatia.

english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
translation: Ndemweba pa menso yakwa Lesa, ifi ndemulembela fyacishinka, te fyabufi iyoo!

english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation: Elyo kabili naile ku calo ca Siria na Kilikia.

english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
translation: Inkuta sha mu Yudeya ishaba muli Kristu shena tashanjishibe no kumonana tatwamonanapo nasho.

english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
translation: Shaleumfwafye ifyo baleshishimikila abati, “Umuntu ulya uwaletucusha, nomba eulebila imbila ya cisumino iyo kale alefwaya ukulofya!”

english: So they glorified God in me.
translation: Nabo epakulalumbanya Lesa pa mulandu wa ine.

english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
translation: Kristu aliituula ilambo pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyesu, epakuti atulubule ku bubi bwa muli cino calo. Acita ifyo pantu efyo Lesa Shifwe alefwaya.

english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Lesa nalelumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
translation: Kwena namunsungusha! Pa nshitafye inono namusangukila Lesa uwamwitile pa mulandu wa cikuuku cakwa Kristu, mwapokelela ne mbila imbi.

english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
translation: Awe kwena, takwaba Mbila Nsuma na imbi. Nicofye kuli abantu bamo abalemufulunganya, balefwaya no kwalula Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu no kuilosha mumbi.

english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
translation: Lelo cibe nifwe nangu ni malaika ukufuma ku mulu nga aisa bila imbila imbi iyapusana ne Mbila Nsuma twabilile kuli imwe, ena uyo alapishiwe!

english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
translation: Twalimwebele kale, nomba nakabili nabwekeshapo, nga cakuti kwaba umuntu uwalabila imbila iyapusana neyo mwasuminamo, ena uyo alapishiwe!

english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
translation: Papitile imyaka ikumi limo na ine, elyo nabwelelemo ku Yerusalemu, lyena twali na Banaba. Kabili nalisendele na Tito.

english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
translation: Icintu cimo ico batulombele, cakuti tuleibukisha ukwafwa abalanda. Elyo ici cintu cena eco nasakamana nganshi ukubomba.

english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
translation: Ilyo Kefa aishile ku Antioki nalimukalipile pa bantu, pantu ali no mulandu.

english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
translation: Pantu ilyo abantu bafumine kuli Yakobo bali tabalati bese, Kefa aleliila pamo na bena Kristu Abenafyalo. Lelo ilyo aba bantu baishile, Kefa aleka ukulaliila pamo na Benafyalo, aipatulako. Pantu aletiina aba bantu ico bena balefwaya ukuti abena Kristu Abenafyalo nabo balesembululwa.

english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
translation: Abena Kristu Abayuda bambi nabo ku mulandu wa mwenso balakonkelela ubucenjeshi bwakwa Kefa. Banaba nao wine ku mulandu wa mwenso alacita ubucenjeshi bumo bwine.

english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
translation: Kanshi ilyo namona ukuti aba bantu tabali pa cishinka mukukonka mashiwi ya Mbila Nsuma, elyo naebele Kefa ninshi bonse epo bali nati, “Iwe uli Muyuda, nomba walekonka imikalile ya Benafyalo, tawalekonka iya Bayuda. Nga kanshi kuti walapatikisha shani Abenafyalo ukulaikala nga Bayuda?”

english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
translation: Ifwe twafyalwa Abayuda, tatuli Benafyalo ababifi.

english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
translation: Ifwe twalishiba ukuti umuntu taba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa pa mulandu wakusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, lelo ni mukuba ne cisumino muli Kristu Yesu. Kanshi na ifwe bene twasumine Kristu Yesu pakuti, mukuba ne cisumino muli Kristu, tumone ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, temukusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose. Pantu takwaba nangu umo uwingaba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, ico akonka Amafunde yakwa Mose.

english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
translation: Nomba ifwe nga tufwaya ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa mukusumina muli Kristu, kabili na ifwe batusanga ukuti tuli babifi, bushe ninshi calola mukuti ni Kristu eulelenga ukuti tube ababifi? Awe cakaana!

english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
translation: Nga cakuti nabwelela kukukuula ico naonawile, ninshi kuti calangafye ukuti ndi mpulamafunde.

english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
translation: Ukulingana no mwalola Amafunde yakwa Mose ine nalifwa, kanshi nshateekwa kabili naya mafunde. Eico naba nomba uwamweo pakuti ndebombela Lesa.

english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
translation: Ico nailileko, nico efyo Lesa ansokolwelele ukuti ndi nokuyako. Twalongene ne ntungulushi sha bena Kristu mu bumfisolo, umo nashilondolwelele amashiwi ya Mbila Nsuma mbila ku Benafyalo. Nshalefwaya ukuti imilimo ndebomba elyo neyo nabomba kale ikabe iyakuicushafye.

english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
translation: Roma 3:20

english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
translation: Nshilesuula cikuuku cakwa Lesa. Lelo nga cakuti umuntu kuti amona ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa mukusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, ninshi imfwa yakwa Kristu tayabomba nelyo cimo.

english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
translation: Tito uo nali nao nangu ena ali Mugiriki, tashamupatikishe ukuti asembululwe.

english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
translation: Lelo abantu bamo abaleilanga ukuba kwati bena Kristu banensu balafwaya ukuti asembululwe. Aba bantu baishile sokelela mwibumba lyesu nge nengu pakuti bafwailishe pa buntungwa twashukila pali ico twaba muli Kristu. Bena balefwaya ukututeeka mu busha.

english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
translation: Awe na ifwe twakaanininafye ukubanakila, pantu twalefwayafye ukuti tumusungile Imbila Nsuma yacine cine.

english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
translation: Lelo abo abalemoneka ukuba intungulushi, (nomba kwena ine nshabasakamene nakalya, pantu Lesa taba na mucishacinani) abo abamoneka ukuba intungulushi tabamwene neco balundilepo pafyo mfunda.

english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
translation: Lelo bamwenefye bwino ukuti Lesa alimpeela umulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma ku Benafyalo, nga filya fine apeela Petelo umulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma ku Bayuda.

english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
translation: Pantu ni Lesa umwine ku maka yakwe ewalenga ukuti mbe umusole ku Benafyalo, nga filya fine alengele Kefa ukuba umusole ku Bayuda.

english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
translation: Ishi ntungulushi Yakobo, Kefa na Yoani balishininkishe ukuti ni Lesa ku cikuuku cakwe ewampeela uyu mulimo. Awe ine na Banaba twalafunkana nabo mu minwe pakulanga ukuti bonse tulebombafye umulimo umo wine. Twaumfwana nokuti Banaba na ine twakulabomba pakati ka Benafyalo, elyo bena pakati ka Bayuda.

english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
translation: Mwe bena Galatia muli mpelwamano! Nani uwamufulungenye? Nalimulondolwela bwino no kumulangafye bwino ifyo Kristu atanikwe pa musalaba.

english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
translation: Abo bonse abashintilila pafyo babomba mukusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose balishama. Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu uushisunga ifyalembwa fyonse mu citabo ca Mafunde yakwa Mose.”

english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
translation: Lelo calishibikwafye bwino ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose tayalenga muntu nelyo umo ukuti abe uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Umololoke ena akulaba umumi pa mulandu wa citetekelo.”

english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
translation: Nomba Amafunde yakwa Mose tayashintilila pa citetekelo. Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Umuntu uukonka aya mafunde, ni ku mafunde akekalila umumi.”

english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
translation: Lelo Kristu alitulubula ukufuma ku citipu icaletele Amafunde yakwa Mose, ico Kristu umwine abuulile icitipu cesu abika pa mubili wakwe. Pantu calembwa ukuti, “Alitipwa umuntu uwakulikwa pa cimuti.”

english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
translation: Kristu Yesu acita ifi, pakuti Abenafyalo nabo bashukileko ipaalo Lesa alaile Abrahamu pa mulandu wakwa Kristu. Elyo lyena na ifwe fwe balesumina tulepokelela Mupashi Lesa alaya.

english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
translation: Bamunyinane, nalamupeela icilangililo ica mu bumi bwesu ubwa cila bushiku. Abantu babili nga basuminishanya, elyo no kupangana bapangana pa cintu cimo, tapali nangu umo wingonaula ico cipangano nangu ukulundapo icintu cimbi.

english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
translation: Nomba Lesa alaile ifilayo kuli Abrahamu na kuli umo pali ba lupwa lwakwe. Ifyalembwa tafitila, “Na kuli ba lupwa lobe,” kwati bantu abengi, lelo calembwa ukuti, “Na ku bufyashi bobe,” pakulanga ukuti muntu umofye, noyo muntu ni Kristu.

english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
translation: Kanshi umo nalosha ni umu, Lesa acitile icipangano na Abrahamu, alaya no kulacisunga. Kanshi emukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose ayo yaishile peelwa ilyo ninshi palipita imyaka imyanda amakumi yane na makumi yatatu (430), tekuti yafumyepo no konaula ico Lesa alaile.

english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
translation: Pantu ubupe ubo Lesa alaya ukupeela, nga apeelela pa mulandu wa Mafunde yakwa Mose, kanshi ninshi tapeela pa mulandu wa cilayo. Lelo nico Lesa amulaile, eco apeelele Abrahamu ubo bupe.

english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
translation: Nga kanshi Amafunde yakwa Mose ya mulimo nshi? Lesa apeele aya mafunde pakulanga ifyo umuntu abifya. Kabili yali nokubakofye mpaka uwa mu bufyashi bwakwa Abrahamu, uo Lesa alaile, akese. Lesa aebele bamalaika ukupeela amafunde yakwe ku muntu umo, ndubulwila, uwali pakati kakwa Lesa na bantu.

english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
translation: Nalamwipushafye icintu cimo, bushe mwapokele Mupashi Wamushilo ico mwalesunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, nangu nico mwaumfwile no kusumina Imbila Nsuma?

english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
translation: Ndubulwila tafwaikwa ukumfwa nga palifye umuntu umo, lelo Lesa abafye umo.

english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
translation: Bushe calola mukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose yalipusana nefyo Lesa alaya? Awe, nakalya. Pantu Amafunde yakwa Mose nga kuti yaletela abantu umweo, ninshi lyena ukukonka aya mafunde kuti kwalenga umuntu ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
translation: Lelo calembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti, abantu bonse aba pano isonde benakubifya. Epakuti abalesumina, balepoka ubupe ubo Lesa alaya, pali ico bali ne cisumino muli Yesu Kristu.

english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
translation: Ilyo inshita ya cisumino yali tailaisa, Amafunde yakwa Mose yatuteekele nga bafungwa, mpaka no kufika ilyo icisumino casokolokelepo.

english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
translation: Kanshi Amafunde yakwa Mose yali e kasunga wesu, mpaka no kwisa kwakwa Kristu. Lyena epakuti mukuba ne cisumino, tumoneke ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
translation: Nomba apo inshita ya cisumino yalisa, awe Amafunde yakwa Mose tekuti yabe kasunga wesu nakalya.

english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
translation: Amaf 27:26

english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
translation: Apo mwabatishiwa ukuti mube muli Kristu, kanshi nomba mwafwala Kristu umwine wine.

english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
translation: Kanshi nomba takwaba kapatulula kakuti uyu Muyuda noyu Mwinafyalo, uyu muntungwa noyu musha, uyu mwaume noyu mwanakashi. Awe apo bonse mwaliba muli Kristu, kanshi nomba mwabafye umo.

english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
translation: Nga mwaba abantu bakwa Kristu, ninshi lyena muli ba mu bufyashi bwakwa Abrahamu, kabili mukapoka nefyo Lesa alaya.

english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
translation: Bushe cine kupelwamano konse uko! Mwatampile na Mupashi wakwa Lesa, nomba mulefwaya ukupwishishisha na maka yenu ayabuntunse?

english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
translation: Bushe ninshi fyonse ifyo mwaculileko fyali fyafye? Nshilesubila ukuti fyali fyafye!

english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
translation: Ico Lesa amupeelela Mupashi no kulacita ifipeshamano uko muli, bushe nico musunga Amafunde yakwa Mose nangu nico mumfwa Imbila Nsuma elyo no kusumina mwasumina?

english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
translation: Umfweni ifyo Abrahamu acitile, “Abrahamu asumine Lesa, na pa mulandu wa cisumino cakwe, Lesa amumwene ukuti mololoke pa cinso cakwe.”

english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
translation: Kanshi mufwile ukwishiba ukuti abantu bacisumino e bana bene bene abakwa Abrahamu.

english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
translation: Amalembo Yamushilo yalisobele ukuti, Lesa akalenga Abenafyalo nabo ukuba abakaele pa mulandu wakusumina. Eico Lesa aebele Abrahamu mu Mbila Nsuma iyakuti, “Ni muli iwe emo imishobo yonse ikapaalilwa.”

english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
translation: Kanshi bonse abasumina balapaalwa nga filya Abrahamu apaalilwe ico asumine.

english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
translation: Ico ndesosa nici icakuti, umwana wakupyana wishi ilyo acili umwaice, nangu kwena e mwine wa fyuma fyonse, abafye ngo musha.

english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
translation: Mulacindikapo inshiku shimo, imyeshi imo, inshita shimo isha myaka, elyo ne myaka imo.

english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
translation: Awe ndi uwasakamana pali imwe ukuti nalimo naicushishefye pakumubombela!

english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ndemupapata mube ngefyo ine naba, pantu ine nalyalwike naba ngefyo imwe mwaba. Imwe tamwandufyenye nelyo cimo.

english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
translation: Muleibukisha icalengele umuku wapakubala ukuti njise kukubila Imbila Nsuma kuli imwe, nico nalwele.

english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
translation: Nangu cali icamukosela ku mulandu wa bulwele bwandi awe tamwansuulile nangu ukuntalukako. Lelo kabili mwampokelelefye ngefyo mwingapokelela malaika wakwa Lesa. Mwampokelelefye kwati ni Kristu Yesu wine.

english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
translation: Bushe pakumweba icishinka, epo ningabela umulwani wenu?

english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
translation: Abo bantu balelanga ukumusakamana nganshi, lelo ifyo balefwaya ukucita fibi. Ico balefwaya kumupatula kuli ine, pakuti ebo muposeko amano, mulebakonka.

english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
translation: Cintu icisuma ukulanga ukusakamana abantu, kumfwa nga ni pa cintu icisuma. Ici cena cacishinka lyonsefye, temukuti kanofye ilyo ndi na imwe.

english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
translation: Mwe bana bandi! Nakabili nimwe ndeculila ngo mwanakashi uukomenwe ne fumo. Ndecula pakuti mwaluke mukule mu mibeele yakwa Kristu.

english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
translation: Ali nokumfwila abalemusunga na baleyangalila ifyuma fyakwe mpaka inshita wishi apima ikafike.

english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
translation: Ala kuti natemwa ukuba na imwe pali ino nshita. Lyena kuti naishiba ifyakumweba, pantu ine namumpesha amano!

english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
translation: Kanjipushe abo pali imwe abafwaya ukuteekwa na Mafunde yakwa Mose. Bushe tamwaumfwa ifyo aya mafunde yasosa?

english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
translation: Aya mafunde yatila, Abrahamu ali na bana abaume babili. Umo nyina ali umusha, elyo umbi nyina ali umuntungwa.

english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
translation: Umwana Abrahamu afyele ku mwanakashi umusha, afyelwe nga ififyalwa abantu bonse, lelo umwana Abrahamu afyele ku mwanakashi umuntungwa, wena afyelwe ukulingana nefyo Lesa alaile.

english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
translation: Ifi fintu fyonse fili nomo filolele. Haga banakashi babili balelanga ifipangano fibili. Haga alanga icipangano ca pa lupili lwa Sinai, elyo na bana baciko abasha.

english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
translation: Haga aba kwati lupili lwa Sinai mu calo ca Arabia, kabili apala ku musumba wine uyu uulipo uwa Yerusalemu, pantu musha pamo pene na bamwane.

english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
translation: Lelo Yerusalemu wa mu mulu wena muntungwa, kabili e nyinefwe.

english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti,

english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
translation: Nomba imwe bamunyinane, pamo nga Isaki imwe muli bana ba cilayo cakwa Lesa.

english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
translation: Pa nshita ilya, umwana ulya wafyelwe nga filya fifyalwa abantu bonse, alecusha umwana uwafyelwe ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwa Lesa. Kanshi ifyo fine efilecitika na nomba.

english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
translation: E cimo cine na ifwe. Ilyo twali nga baice mukwishiba Lesa, na ifwe twateekelwe ubusha ne mipashi ya pano isonde.

english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
translation: Bushe Amalembo Yamushilo yatila shani? “Tamfya umwanakashi umusha pamo no mwana wakwe. Pantu ifyuma wishi akasha nga afwa, umwana wa musha tekuti nao apokeko pamo no mwana wa mwanakashi umuntungwa.”

english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
translation: Kanshi mwe bamunyinane, ifwe tuli bana ba mwanakashi umuntungwa, tatuli bana ba mwanakashi umusha iyoo.

english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
translation: Ilyo inshita Lesa apimine yafikile, elyo atumine Mwane. Aishile fyalwa ku mwanakashi, nao alekonka na Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
translation: Aishile kukulubula abo abateekelwe na Mafunde yakwa Mose, pakuti na ifwe tumone ukuba abana bakwa Lesa.

english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
translation: Pakulanga ukuti muli bana bakwe, Lesa alitutumina mu mitima yesu Mupashi wakwa Mwane. Uyu Mupashi eubilikisha ati, “Abba, Tata, Tata ee!”

english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
translation: Kanshi nomba tauli musha, uli mwana. Apo nomba uli mwana, kanshi akakupeela fyonse ifyo ateyanishisha bamwane.

english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
translation: Kale ilyo mushaishibe Lesa, mwalifye abasha ba fintu ifishili imilungu.

english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
translation: Nomba mwalishiba Lesa, nangu kantile Lesa wine nomba alimwishiba. Nga kanshi kuti mwabwelulukila shani ku fintufye ifinangwa ifishakwata maka? Bushe nakabili mulefwaya fimuteeke ubusha?

english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
translation: Ifwe tuli bantungwa bene bene, eco Kristu atulubwila. Kanshi kosenipofye, mwileka umuntu nangu umo amupose mwikoli lya busha nakabili.

english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
translation: Ine ndatetekela mu Mfumu ukuti tamwakabuule amafunde yambi, kanofye ayo namufunda, lelo uyo muntu uulemufulunganya, nangu engaba shani, Lesa akamukanda.

english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
translation: Nomba bamunyinane, nga na nomba ncili ndebila ukuti bonse bali nokusembululwa, nga cinshi bengalabikapofye ukulancusha? Ala aciba ifyo, ukubila pa macushi yakwa Kristu pa musalaba nga teti kulete impasase.

english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
translation: Kanshi abo bantu balemufulunganya, kuti cawama nokuti mukuisembulula bapitilisha baitungwilamo!

english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
translation: Lelo imwe bamunyinane, Lesa alimwita ukuba abantungwa. Nomba mwileka ubu buntungwa bumutwale kukukonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi. Lelo mwishibe ukulanga icitemwiko, cila umo mukubombela umunankwe.

english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
translation: Pantu Amafunde yonse ayakwa Mose yashinta muli ili funde ilyakuti, “Uletemwa umubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.”

english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
translation: Lelo nga mwalasumana elyo no kucenana, cenjeleni, limbi mukayonaula bonse.

english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
translation: Ifyo ndemweba nifi, muleenda abatungululwa na Mupashi, lyena tamwakulakonkelela ifyo ubuntunse bwenu bufwaya.

english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
translation: Pantu ififwaya ubuntunse bwesu fyalipusana nefyo Mupashi afwaya. Elyo ifyo Mupashi afwaya, nafyo fyalipusana ne fifwaya ubuntunse bwesu. Mupashi no buntunse filalwishanya. Kanshi eco mufililwa ukucita ifyo mulefwaya ukucita.

english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
translation: Levi 19:18

english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
translation: Nomba imicitile ibi iyabuntunse yalishibikwafye bwino. Niyi, bucilende, ubupulumushi, ubucende,

english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
translation: Umfweni! Ine ne Paulo ndemweba ukuti, nga mwasumina ukusembululwa, ninshi tamwamwenamo nelyo cimo mukusumina Kristu.

english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
translation: ukupepa utulubi, ubuloshi, ukupatana no kulaumana, ubufuba, icipyu, bukaitemwe, akapatulula no kukanaumfwana,

english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
translation: umufimbila, bucakolwa, ubulili, elyo na fimbi ifya uyu musango. Ndemusokako nakabili ngefyo namusokele kale ukuti abantu abacita ifi fintu tabakapyane Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
translation: Lelo Mupashi wena alenga icitemwiko, insansa, umutende, umutekatima, icilela, ukuwamya, ubufumacumi,

english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
translation: umutembo no kushipikisha. Takwaba ifunde nangu limo ililesha ifya musango uyu.

english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
translation: Abantu bakwa Kristu Yesu, bena balipaya ipamfya lyabuntunse no lunkumbwa lubi.

english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
translation: Apo Mupashi ewatupeela umweo, kanshi natuleenda na Mupashi.

english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
translation: Natuleke ukuitutumuna, nangu ukusonsombana, nangu umo ukulafimbila umunankwe.

english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
translation: Nakabili nabwekeshapo ukuti, uyo onse uwasumina ukusembululwa, ninshi ali nokusunga Amafunde yonse ayakwa Mose.

english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
translation: Imwe bonse mwe balefwaya ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa pa mulandu wakusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, mwalifuma kuli Kristu. Kabili mwaliitalusha na ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa.

english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
translation: Nomba ifwe ku maka yakwa Mupashi tulelolela no kusubila ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, pali ico twasumina.

english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
translation: Pantu kuli ifwe fwe baba muli Kristu, ukusembululwa takubomba nelyo cimo, elyo no kukanasembululwa nako kwine takubomba nelyo cimo. Icikalamba cisumino icibomba imilimo ya citemwiko.

english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
translation: Mwaleendafye bwino bwino. Nga nani uumucilingenye, amulesha ukulanakila icishinka?

english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
translation: Ico cena te Lesa uwamwita ewacita ico.

english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
translation: Intutumushi inono ilatutumuna umufuba onse.

english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, umo nga asangwa mu bubifi, mwe batungululwa na Mupashi mumwalulule afume mu bubifi. Lelo mube abamutembo mukumwalulula. Elyo na imwe bene muleisunga bwino, epali na imwe mwawila mu ntunko.

english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
translation: Kanshi ilyo tucili ne nshita, natulecita ifisuma ku bantu bonse, ukucilapo kuli bamunyinefwe mu cisumino.

english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
translation: Moneni ifilembo ubukulu ifyo nalalemba. Nine wine ndemulembela no kuboko kwandi!

english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
translation: Abo bantu abalemupatikisha ukusembululwa, balefwayafye ukutashiwa ku bantu. Ico balecitila ifyo, nico tabalefwaya kucushiwa pa mulandu wa musalaba wakwa Kristu.

english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
translation: Elyo na basembululwa bene tabasunga Mafunde yakwa Mose. Balefwaya ukuti imwe musembululwe pakuti baleitakishisha pali ico mwanakila ulutambi lwakusembululwa.

english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
translation: Kwena ine nshamona cakuitakishishapo kanofye umusalaba wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu. Pa mulandu wa musalaba wakwa Kristu, kuli ine ifyacalo fyaba kwati tafyabapo fyalifwa, elyo na ine nalifwa ku fyacalo.

english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
translation: Ukusembululwa kwafyefye, elyo no kukanasembululwa nako kwine kwafyefye, icikalamba kuba umuntu mupya.

english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
translation: Umutende no luse lwakwa Lesa fibe kuli bonse abakonka ici cebo, pamo pene na bena Israeli bakwa Lesa bonse!

english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
translation: Ukufuma pali nomba nshilefwaya umuntu ukulancusha. Pantu naliba ne mikofu pa mubili wandi iyilanga ukuti ndi muntu wakwa Yesu.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
translation: Bamunyinane, icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe bonse. Ameni.

english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
translation: Mulesendeshanya ifipe ifyafina, epakuti mulefikilisha amafunde yakwa Kristu.

english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
translation: Umo nga alaitunga ukuba cimo, mu nshita tali nelyo cimo, ninshi aleibepafye.

english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
translation: Cila muntu aleipingula pafyo alecita. Nga fisuma, lyena kuti aumfwa icilumba pafyo umwine acita, nomba tekulalinga ku milimo umunobe umbi alecita.

english: For each man will bear his own burden.
translation: Pantu cila muntu ali nokuibombela imilimo yakwe umwine.

english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
translation: Umuntu uulefundwa amashiwi yakwa Kristu, ali nokupeelako uulemufunda ifintu ifisuma pali fyonse ifyo akwata.

english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
translation: Mwilaibepa, Lesa tatumpikwa. Ico umuntu abyala, eco akalobolola.

english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
translation: Uubyala mufyo ubuntunse bwakwe bufwaya, ninshi akalobolola imfwa. Nomba nga abyala ifyo Mupashi afwaya, ninshi wena akalobolola umweo wape.

english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
translation: Kanshi twilatendwa ukucita ifisuma. Pantu kumfwa nga tatulenenuka, ninshi tukalobolola ifisabo pa nshita yafiko.

english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa ndupwa sha bana baume bakwa Noa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti. Panuma ya lyeshi bamwana Noa nabo balifyele abana abaume.

english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
translation: Imisumba iyo Nimurodi abalilepo ukuteeka ni Babiloni, Ereki, Akadi na Kaline. Iyi misumba yonse ya mu calo ca Shina .

english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
translation: Ilyo afumine muli ici calo ca Shina, aile ku Asiria, uko aile kuula umusumba wa Ninife, Rehoboti Iri na Kala,

english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
translation: elyo na Reseni, uwabela pakati ka Ninife na Kala, e musumba ukalamba.

english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation: Misraimu e cikolwe ca bena Ludi, abena Anamu, abena Lehabu, abena Nafutu,

english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
translation: abena Patulusi na bena Kaselu ukwatuntuka Abafilisiti elyo na bena Kafuto.

english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
translation: Kenani ewali wishi wakwa Sidoni, ibeli lyakwe, kabili ewali icikolwe ca bena Hiti,

english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
translation: abena Yebusi, abena Amoli, abena Girigashi,

english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
translation: abena Hifi, abena Aki, abena Sini,

english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
translation: abena Afadi, abena Semari na bena Hamati.

english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
translation: Kabili imipaka ya bena Kenani yatampile ukufuma ku Sidoni ukulola ku Gela ukufika na ku Gasa. Elyo kabili ukulola ku Sodoma, Gomora, Adima na Seboimu, ukufikafye na ku Lasha.

english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
translation: Bamwana Yafeti abaume ni Gomeri, Magogi, Madai, Yafani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.

english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
translation: Aba e bana baume bakwa Hamu mu mikowa yabo na mu ndimi shabo, mu mipaka na mu mishobo yabo.

english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
translation: Shemu umukalamba wakwa Yafeti nao alifyele abana abaume. Kabili Shemu e cikolwe ca bana baume bakwa Eberi.

english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
translation: Abana abaume abakwa Shemu ni Elamu, Ashuri, Afakisadi, Ludi na Aramu.

english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
translation: Abana abaume abakwa Aramu ni Usi, Huli, Geteri na Mesheki.

english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
translation: Afakisadi ewafyele Shela, elyo Shela nao afyele Eberi.

english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
translation: Eberi afyele abana abaume babili. Umo ishina lyakwe ni Pelegi, pantu ni mu nshita yakwe emo bayakenye isonde. Munyina ali ni Yokitani.

english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
translation: Yokitani afyele Alumodadi, Shelefu, Hasalimafeti, Yera,

english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
translation: Hadoramu, Usali, Dikila,

english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
translation: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,

english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
translation: Ofiri, Hafila na Yobabu. Aba bonse bana abaume abakwa Yokitani.

english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation: Bamwana Gomeri abaume ni Ashikenasi, Rifati na Togama.

english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
translation: Bonse aba baleikala mu citungu ca mpili icabelele ku kabanga ukufuma ku Mesha ukulola ku Sefali.

english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
translation: Aba e bana baume bakwa Shemu mu mikowa na mu ndimi shabo, mu mipaka na mu mishobo yabo.

english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
translation: Iyi e mikowa ya bana baume bakwa Noa ukukonka ifyo batantama mukufyalwa na mu mishobo yabo. Ni kuli aba bantu ekwafuma imishobo yasalanganina pano isonde panuma ya lyeshi.

english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation: Bamwana Yafani abaume ni Elisha, Tashishi, abena Kitimu na bena Rodanimu.

english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
translation: Ukufuma muli aba bantu emwatuntunka abasalanganina mu lulamba lwa bemba mu mipaka yabo, mu mikowa yabo na mu mishobo yabo, bonse umwabela indimi shabo.

english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
translation: Bamwana Hamu abaume ni Kushi, Misraimu, Puti na Kenani.

english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
translation: Bamwana Kushi abaume ni Seba, Hafila, Sabuta, Rama na Sabuteka. Bamwana Rama abaume ni Sheba na Dedani.

english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
translation: Kushi ali e wishi wakwa Nimurodi. Nimurodi ewabalilepo ukuba icita icamaka pano isonde.

english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.
translation: Nimurodi ali ni fundi uwamaka pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Kanshi ekwatula ne nsonselo yakuti, “Nga Nimurodi, fundi uwamaka pa cinso cakwa Yawe!”

english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
translation: Pesonde ponse palelandwafye ululimi lumo, kabili na mashiwi yalebomfiwa yamo yene.

english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
translation: Icite 10:10

english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Afakisadi, Shemu aikele imyaka imyanda isano (500), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
translation: Ilyo Afakisadi ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu na isano (35), afyele Shela.

english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Shela, Afakisadi aikele imyaka imyanda ine na itatu (403), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
translation: Ilyo Shela ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30), afyele Eberi.

english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Eberi, Shela aikele imyaka imyanda ine na itatu (403), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
translation: Ilyo Eberi ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu na ine (34), afyele Pelegi.

english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Pelegi, Eberi aikele imyaka imyanda ine na makumi yatatu (430), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
translation: Ilyo Pelegi ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30), afyele Reu.

english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Reu, Pelegi aikele imyaka imyanda ibili na pabula (209), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
translation: Ilyo abantu baselele no kulola lwa ku kabanga, basangile iwanga mu calo ca Shina, emo baikala.

english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
translation: Ilyo Reu ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu na ibili (32), afyele Serugi.

english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Serugi, Reu aikele imyaka imyanda ibili na cine lubali (207), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
translation: Ilyo Serugi ali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30), afyele Naho.

english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Naho, Serugi aikele imyaka imyanda ibili (200), alifyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
translation: Ilyo Naho ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na pabula (29), afyele Tera.

english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Tera, Naho aikele imyaka umwanda umo ikumi limo na pabula (119), alifyele abana na bambi abaume na banakashi.

english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
translation: Ilyo Tera ali ne myaka amakumi cine lubali (70), afyele Abramu, Naho na Harani.

english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa lupwa lwakwa Tera.

english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
translation: Harani afwilile mu Uri mu musumba afyalilwemo mu calo ca Kaludea, ninshi na wishi Tera acili umumi.

english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
translation: Abramu na Naho bonse babili balyupile. Abramu aupile Sarai. Naho nao aupile Milika mwana Harani. Uyu Harani ewafyele Milika na Isika.

english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
translation: Balalanshanya abati, “Iseni tutame amatafwali tuyoce na bwino.” Kanshi babomfeshe amatafwali mu nshita yakubomfya amabwe. Elyo babomfeshe amanenekela mu nshita yakubomfya indaka.

english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
translation: Lelo Sarai takwete mwana, pantu ali ni ŋumba.

english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
translation: Tera abuulile umwana wakwe Abramu, umwishikukulu wakwe Loti mwana Harani na nafyala Sarai, muka Abramu umwana wakwe, elyo bonse pamo bafumine mu musumba wa Uri mu calo ca Kaludea baile na ku calo ca Kenani. Nomba ilyo bafikile ku musumba wa Harani uko eko bacitile icifulo.

english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
translation: Tera ali ne myaka imyanda ibili na isano (205) ilyo afwilile mu musumba wa Harani.

english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
translation: Elyo batile, “Iseni tuikuulile fwe bene umusumba no lupungu mukati ulwakuti lukafike na ku mulu pakuti tukalumbuke, kabili twikasalanganina pesonde lyonse.”

english: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
translation: Lelo Yawe epakwika kukwisa mona umusumba no lupungu abantu balekuula.

english: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
translation: Elyo Yawe atile ati, “Moneni, nga cakuti aba bantu bali umutundu umo, kabili balelanda ululimi lumo batendeka ukucita ici, lyena pafyo bengatontonkanya tapakabe nelyo cimo ico bakafilwa ukucita.

english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
translation: Iseni, natwike tuye fulunganya ululimi lwabo pakuti belaumfwa umulolele ifyo umunankwe alelanda.”

english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
translation: Kanshi ukufuma kuli ilya ncende Yawe epakubasalanganishisha pesonde lyonse, baleka no kukuula umusumba.

english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
translation: Eco uyu musumba balewitila Babele, pantu ni muli uyu musumba emo Yawe afulunganishishe ululimi lwe sonde lyonse. Ukufuma muli uyu musumba, Yawe abasalanganishishe pesonde lyonse.

english: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
translation: Yawe aebele Abramu ati, “Fuma mu calo cobe, ku bantu bobe na ku ba mu ŋanda yakwa wiso, uye na ku calo nkakulanga.

english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
translation: Nomba icipowe caliponene mu calo, Abramu epakuya ku Egupto aya ikalako ngo mweni pantu icipowe calibipishe.

english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
translation: Ilyo ali mupepi no kwingila mu Egupto, aebele umukashi wakwe Sarai ati, “Nalishiba ukuti uli mwanakashi uwayemba.

english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.
translation: Ilyo abena Egupto baleya kumona, baleya tila, ‘Uyu mukashi wakwe.’ Elyo ine bakanjipaya, lelo iwe bakakusha umumi.

english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
translation: Ubebe auti, uli nkashi yandi, epakuti balensunga bwino kabili tabanjipaye pa mulandu wa iwe.”

english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
translation: Ilyo Abramu afikile mu Egupto, abena Egupto bamwene ukuti Sarai mwanakashi uwayemba nganshi mukumoneka.

english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
translation: Ilyo bacilolo bakwa Farao bamumwene, baya takisha ukuyemba kwakwe kuli Farao, elyo baisa bamutwala na kwisano lyakwe.

english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
translation: Gal 3:16

english: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
translation: Lelo Yawe aletele Farao na ba mu ŋanda mumwakwe amalwele ayabipisha pa mulandu wakwa Sarai muka Abramu.

english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
translation: Kanshi Farao epakwita Abramu, amwipusha ati, “Cinshi ici wacita kuli ine? Cinshi ushanjebele ukuti mukashi obe?

english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
translation: Cinshi wanjebele auti, ‘Ni nkashi yandi,’ walenga nokuti mubuule abe umukashi wandi? Kanshi nomba umukashi obe uyu, mubuule, uleya no kuya.”

english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
translation: Imili 7:2-3

english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
translation: Elyo Farao akonkomesha abantu bakwe pali Abramu. Nabo bamushindika, aya no mukashi wakwe na fyonse ifyo akwete.

english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
translation: Nkapaala abo abakakupaala,

english: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
translation: Kanshi Abramu epakuya ngefyo Yawe amwebele. Loti nao aile nankwe. Abramu ali ne myaka amakumi cine lubali (75) ilyo afumine ku Harani.

english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
translation: Abramu asendele umukashi wakwe Sarai na Loti mwana munyina. Asendele ifyuma fyonse anonkele mu Harani na basha bonse akwete. Bonse baima ukulaya ku calo ca Kenani, kabili basuka bafika.

english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
translation: Abramu apitile pakati ka cilya calo aya fika ukwabela icimuti icakosa ica oki ica More mu Shekemu. Pali ilya nshita abena Kenani ebali muli cilya calo.

english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
translation: Yawe amonekele kuli Abramu amweba ati, “Nkapeela ici calo ku bufyashi bobe.” Kanshi Abramu epakukuulila Yawe uwamumonekele ubulambo pa ncende ine iyo.

english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.
translation: Bahi 11:8

english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
translation: Kabili Abramu epakwima akonkanyapo ubulendo ukulaya ku matololo ya Negebu.

english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
translation: Kanshi ilyo Abramu afumine mu Egupto abwelele ku matololo ya Negebu, ali no mukashi wakwe na fyonse ifyo akwete, kabili Loti aile nankwe.

english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
translation: Loti ainuna amenso amona iwanga lyonse ilya Yordani ukuti mwaliba amenshi kwatifye ni mwibala lyakwa Yawe, nangu kwati mushili wa mu Egupto ukulola ku Soari. Ili cali ilyo Yawe ali talaonaula Sodoma na Gomora.

english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
translation: Kanshi aba bantu babili epakupatulukana. Loti asalapo umwine iwanga lyonse ilya Yordani, aima alungama na ku kabanga.

english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
translation: Abramu ashala aleikala mu calo ca Kenani elyo Loti aleikala mu musumba wa mwiwanga, kabili acitile inkambi yakwe mupepi no musumba wa Sodoma.

english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.
translation: Nomba abantu ba mu Sodoma bali ababi kabili balebifya nganshi kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
translation: Panuma yakupatukana kwakwa Loti na Abramu, Yawe aebele Abramu ati, “Inuna amenso, uloleshe ukufuma apo pene wiminine, ku kapinda ka kuso, ku kapinda ka kulyo, ku kabanga na ku masamba.

english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
translation: Icalo conse ici ulemona, nkacipeela kuli iwe na bana bobe.

english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
translation: Nkalenga ukuti abana bobe bakafule kwati lukungu lwa pano isonde. Nga cakuti umuntu kuti apenda ulukungu, ninshi lyena kuti apenda na bana bobe.

english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
translation: Ima, wende ukuya mubutali na mu bwipi bwa calo, pantu ni kuli iwe ndecipeela.”

english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.
translation: Kanshi Abramu epakusesha inkambi yakwe aya ikala mupepi ne miti ikulu iya oki iyakwa Mamure ku Hebuloni, kulya kwine eko akuulile Yawe ubulambo.

english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
translation: Abramu aba umukankala nganshi, akwata ifitekwa, silifa na golide.

english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
translation: Ukufuma ku Negebu, apitile mu ncende ishalekana lekana, asuka afika na ku Betele pa ncende imo pakati ka Betele na Ai, apo kale acitile inkambi yakwe,

english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.
translation: kabili apo akuulile ubulambo bwantanshi. Pali iyi incende epo Abramu apepele Yawe.

english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
translation: Nomba Loti uwaleendauka na Abramu nao alikwete imikuni ya mpaanga, imbushi ne ŋombe pamo na matenti.

english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.
translation: Lelo impanga baleikalapo yacepa ilyo bali pamo pantu icuma bakwete califulishe icakuti bafilwa no kwikala pamo.

english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
