translation: Bakacema ba fitekwa fyakwa Abramu balaumana na bakacema ba fitekwa fyakwa Loti. Pali iyo nshita ninshi abena Kenani na bena Perisi nabo bene baleikala muli ici calo.

english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
translation: Elyo Abramu aebele Loti ati, “Tatufwile ukulaumana iwe na ine, nangu bakacema bobe na bakacema bandi, pantu tuli ba mu lupwa lumo.

english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
translation: Bushe icalo conse ici tekuti cibe cobe? Natupatulukane, iwe nga uleya ku kuso, ine ninshi ndeya ku kulyo. Elyo nga cakuti iwe uleya ku kulyo, ine ninshi ndeya ku kuso.”

english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
translation: Mu nshiku shilya Amurafeli imfumu ya ku Shina , Arioki imfumu ya ku Elasari, Kedolaomeri imfumu ya ku Elamu na Tida imfumu ya ku Goimu,

english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.
translation: Nomba mwishika lya Sidimu mwali ifilindi ifingi ifya manenekela. Ilyo imfumu ya ku Sodoma ne ya ku Gomora shafulumwike, shawilile mu filindi, lelo shimbi shena shafulumukile ku mpili.

english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
translation: Imfumu shilya shimbi shine (4) epakutapa ifyuma fyonse ne fyakulya fyonse ifya mu Sodoma na Gomora, shaya no kuya.

english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
translation: Kabili shasendele Loti, mwana munyina Abramu ne fyuma fyakwe, pantu aleikala mu Sodoma.

english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.
translation: Elyo umo uwapusunswikeko aisa shimikilako Abramu Umuhibulu. Abramu aleikala mupepi ne miti ikulu iya oki iyakwa Mamure umwina Amoli, munyina wakwa Eshikoli na Aneri, elyo aba bonse balipangene ukulaafwana na Abramu.

english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.
translation: Ilyo Abramu aumfwile ukuti Loti lupwa lwakwe nabamusenda bunkole, Abramu aimishe ababomfi imyanda itatu ikumi limo na cine konse konse (318), abafyalilwe mu ŋanda yakwe, abasambilile ifyabulwi, basupila bashamfumu ukufika ku Dani.

english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
translation: Mu nshita ya bushiku Abramu ayakenye abantu bakwe pakubalwisha, babacimfya no kubasupila mpaka na ku Hoba, lubali lwa ku kapinda ka kuso ka Damasiko.

english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
translation: Apokolwele ifyuma fyonse batapile abwesha na lupwa lwakwe Loti ne fyuma fyakwe, pamo pene na banakashi na bantu bambi.

english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
translation: Ilyo Abramu abwelulwike kukucimfya imfumu Kedolaomeri ne shamfumu shali nankwe, imfumu ya mu Sodoma yaishile mukumukumanya mwishika lya Shafe ilyo batila ishika lya mfumu.

english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
translation: Elyo Melikisedeki imfumu ya ku Salemu aletele umukate no mwangashi. Ali shimapepo wakwa Lesa Umupulami.

english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
translation: Apaalile Abramu ati,

english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
translation: baile mukulwisha Bera imfumu ya ku Sodoma, Berisha imfumu ya ku Gomora, Shinabu imfumu ya ku Adima, Shemeberi imfumu ya ku Seboimu ne mfumu ya ku Bela, emukutila Soari.

english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
translation: Kabili napaalwe Lesa Umupulami,

english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
translation: Elyo imfumu ya mu Sodoma yaebele Abramu aiti, “Ifintu fyonse ifyo utapile sunga, lelo mbwesesha abantu.”

english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
translation: Lelo Abramu aebele imfumu ya mu Sodoma ati, “Naimya ukuboko kwandi kuli Yawe, Lesa Umupulami, Kabumba wa mulu ne sonde, kabili nalilapa

english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
translation: ukuti pa fintu fyobe fyonse ine nshakabuulepo nelyo cimo nangufye bushishi nangufye ni ntambo sha ndyato shobe. Epakuti wikatala ausosa ati, ‘Nine nalenga ukuti Abramu abe umukankala.’

english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
translation: Ine nshabuulepofye nelyo cimo kanofye ifyo abantu bandi balile elyo ne cakaniko ca bantu naile nabo Aneri, Eshikoli na Mamure. Leka babuulepo icakaniko cabo.”

english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
translation: Ishi mfumu shonse ishakonkapo shisano shalyumfwene no kulonganya ifita fyashiko mwishika lya Sidimu, emukutila Bemba wa Mucele.

english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
translation: Pa myaka ikumi limo na ibili (12) ishi mfumu shateekelwe na Kedolaomeri, lelo mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na itatu (13) shalimusangukile.

english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
translation: Mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na ine (14) Kedolaomeri pamo ne mfumu aleumfwana nasho baile cimfya abena Refaimu mu Ashitaloti Kanaimu, abena Susi mu Hamu, abena Emi mu Shafe Kiriataimu,

english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
translation: elyo na bena Hori mu calo ca mpili ica mu Seiri, ukufikafye na ku Elu Parani mupepi na ku matololo.

english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
translation: Elyo bayaluluka, baya na ku Eni Mishipati, (emukutila ni Kadeshi), kabili bacimfishe icalo conse ica bena Amaleki na bena Amoli abaleikala mu Hasasoni Tama.

english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
translation: Elyo imfumu ya mu Sodoma, imfumu ya mu Gomora, imfumu ya mu Adama, imfumu ya mu Seboimu, ne mfumu ya mu Bela (emukutila Soari), balimine no kuya tantamika ifita fyabo mwishika lya Sidimu

english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
translation: kukulwisha Kedolaomeri imfumu ya mu Elamu, Tida imfumu ya mu Goimu, Amurafeli imfumu ya mu Shina na Arioki imfumu ya mu Elasari. Kanshi emukutila imfumu shine (4) shalelwisha imfumu shisano (5).

english: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
translation: Panuma ya ifi fintu, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Abramu mu cimonwa aliti,

english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
translation: Abramu epakuya letela Yawe ifi fyonse, afiputula pakati, cila cipandwa acibika icalolenkana ne cibiye. Ifyuni fyena tafiputwile pakati.

english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
translation: Elyo amakubi yawila pa fitumbi fya nama ne fyuni, lelo Abramu afitamfyapo.

english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
translation: Bahi 11:12

english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
translation: Lelo nkakanda uyo mushobo ukabateeka ubusha. Elyo panuma bakafumamo nabasenda ifyuma ifingi.

english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
translation: Lelo iwe ukaya mu cibote ukwaba ifikolwe fyobe, kabili bakakushiika mu bukote bwine bwine.

english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
translation: Mu nkulo yalenga shine, elyo aba mu lupwa lobe bakabwelela muli cino calo pantu ububi bwa bena Amoli tabulati bubipishe ukufikapo.”

english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kawa no kufiita kwafiita, elyo kwamoneka inongo umulefuuka icushi no lubingu lulebilima, fyapita pakati ka fipande fya nama.

english: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
translation: Roma 4:18

english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
translation: icalo ca bena Keni, ica bena Kenasi, ica bena Kadimo,

english: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
translation: Lelo Abramu ayaswike ati, “We Mfumu Yawe, cinshi wingampeela apo nshakwata mwana, elyo uukapyana icuma candi ni Eliese umwina Damasiko?”

english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
translation: ica bena Amoli, ica bena Kenani ica bena Girigashi ne ca bena Yebusi.”

english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
translation: Kabili Abramu atile, “Mona tawampeela abana. Kanshi mushafye uwa mu ŋanda mumwandi eukaba impyani yandi.”

english: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Abramu aliti, “Uyu muntu takabe impyani yobe, lelo umwana uo ukaifyalila eukaba impyani yobe.”

english: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”
translation: Elyo Yawe amufumisha panse alamweba ati, “Lolesha mu mulu, upende intanda nga kuti washipenda.” Elyo Yawe amweba nokuti, “Ifi fine efikaba na bana bobe.”

english: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.
translation: Abramu atetekele Yawe, na Yawe pali ici amumwene ukuti mololoke pa cinso cakwe.

english: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
translation: Yawe amwebele nokuti, “Nine Yawe uwakufumishe mu musumba wa Uri uwa bena Kaludea pakuti nkupeele ici calo cibe cobe.”

english: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
translation: Nomba Abramu ayaswike ati, “We Mfumu Yawe, nga ine kuti naishiba shani ukuti ici calo cikaba candi?”

english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakumweba ati, “Ndetela umusepela wa ŋombe ikota iya myaka itatu, imbushi ikota iya myaka itatu, sukusuku uwa myaka itatu, pamo pene ne cipele cimo na kabondo ka nkunda.”

english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
translation: Nomba Abramu takweteko mwana ku mukashi wakwe Sarai. Lelo Sarai alikwete umukashana umusha ishina lyakwe ni Haga umwina Egupto.

english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
translation: Malaika alundapo ukumweba ati, “Nkasandulula nganshi aba mu lupwa lobe, takwakabe wakubapenda ku bwingi.”

english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.
translation: Kabili malaika wakwa Yawe amweba nokuti,

english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”
translation: Umwana obe akaba nga punda wa mpanga.

english: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
translation: Elyo Haga ainika Yawe uwalandile nankwe ishina ati, “Niwe Lesa uumona ine,” pantu atile, “Nimona Lesa uumona.”

english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
translation: Kanshi eico bainikila icishima icabela pakati ka Kadeshi na Beredi abati Bere Lai Roi, emukutila “Icishima ca Wabumi uumona ine.”

english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
translation: Kanshi Haga asukile afyalila Abramu umwana umwaume, nao Abramu ainika umwana Haga afyele ishina lya Ishimaeli.

english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
translation: Abramu ali ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse na mutanda (86) ilyo Haga amufyalile Ishimaeli.

english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
translation: Kanshi Sarai aebele Abramu ati, “Mona, Yawe alintana ubufyashi, kanshi kabiye usendame no musha wandi umukashana, nalimo kuti amfyalilako abana.” Abramu nao asuminisha ifyalandile Sarai.

english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
translation: Panuma Abramu aikala imyaka ikumi limo (10) mu Kenani, elyo Sarai abuulile umusha wakwe umukashana Haga umwina Egupto, amupeela na kuli wiba Abramu pakuti abe umukashi wakwe.

english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
translation: Abramu epakusendama na Haga nao aba na pabukulu. Ilyo Haga amwene ukuti ali pabukulu, ayamba ukusuula nakulu.

english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”
translation: Elyo Sarai aebele Abramu ati, “Iyi misuula Haga ankwatile ibe pali iwe. Nine nakupeele uyu musha wandi umukashana, lelo apo amwene ukuti ali pabukulu nansuula. Yawe engapingula pakati ka iwe na ine.”

english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
translation: Abramu epakweba Sarai ati, “Umusha obe ali mu minwe yobe, umucitile conse ico ulemona ukuti nacilungama.” Kanshi Sarai epakulacusha Haga, elyo Haga nao amufulumuka.

english: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
translation: Malaika wakwa Yawe asangile Haga mu matololo mupepi na kamfukumfuku akabelele mu mbali ya musebo walolele ku Shuri.

english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
translation: Malaika epakusosa ati, “Haga we musha wakwa Sarai, ni kwi wafuma kabili uleya kwi?” Haga amwasuka ati, “Ndefulumuka kuli mama Sarai.”

english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
translation: Elyo Malaika wakwa Yawe amweba ati, “Bwelelamo kuli nokokulu, ulemupetamina.”

english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
translation: Ilyo Abramu afikile pa myaka amakumi pabula na pabula (99), Yawe alimumonekele, amweba ati, “Nine Lesa Umwine wa maka yonse. Uleenda pa cinso candi nokuba uwabula icilubo.

english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
translation: Ici e cipangano candi na iwe na ba mu lupwa lobe abakakonkapo. Icipangano mwakulasunga nici, umwaume onse uo muleikala nankwe ali nokusembululwa.

english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
translation: Roma 4:11

english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
translation: Kanshi umukakonkanina inkulo shenu, umwaume onse uwikala pakati kenu, nga aba ne inshiku cine konse konse (8) apo afyalilwa, ali nokusembululwa. Cibe umwana obe umwaume nangu umubomfi onse umwaume uwafyalilwa mu ŋanda yobe nangu uwakuti wamushitafye ku benafyalo, te wa mu lupwa lobe, bonse bali nokusembululwa.

english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
translation: Umubomfi umwaume uwafyalwa mu ŋanda yobe nangu wakushitafye ne ndalama shobe, bonse bafwile ukusembululwa. Icipangano candi ku mibili yenu cili nokuba icipangano ca pe.

english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
translation: Umwaume onse uushasembululwa, uo bashasembulula inkanda ya ku mpela ya bwaume, wakutamfyafye afume ku bantu bandi. Pantu naonaula icipangano candi.”

english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.
translation: Kabili Lesa aebele Abrahamu ati, “Palwakwa Sarai umukashi obe, nomba tawakulamwita Sarai, ishina lyakwe lili nokuba ni Sara.

english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
translation: Ine nkapaala Sara, kabili nkalenga Sara akakufyalile umwana umwaume. Ine nkamupaala pakuti akabe nyina wa mishobo. Bashamfumu ba bantu bakafuma muli ena.”

english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
translation: Roma 4:17

english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
translation: Kanshi Abrahamu epakweba Lesa ati, “Shi mwingalekafye Ishimaeli aleba uwapaalwa pa cinso cenu!”

english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
translation: Lelo Lesa amweba ati, “Awe iyoo, umukashi obe Sara akakufyalila umwana umwaume na iwe ukamwinika ishina lya Isaki. Kabili nkapangana nankwe icipangano icakubelelela na ba mu lupwa lwakwe abakamukonkapo.

english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
translation: Nkafikilisha icipangano candi pakati ka iwe na ine, kabili nkafusha ubufyashi bobe nganshi.”

english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
translation: Niŋumfwa nefyo walanda pali Ishimaeli. Cine cine nkamupaala. Kabili nkamupeelesha ubufyashi, na ba mu lupwa lwakwe bakafula nganshi. Akaba wishi wa bakateeka ikumi limo na babili (12). Nkalenga no lupwa lwakwe ukuba umushobo uukalamba.

english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
translation: Lelo nkapangana icipangano candi na Isaki uo Sara akakufyalila uyu mwaka uleisa pa nshita ino ine.”

english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
translation: Ilyo Lesa apwa ukulanda na Abrahamu, afumapo.

english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
translation: Pali bulya bwine bushiku, Abrahamu abuulile umwana wakwe Ishimaeli, umwaume onse uwa mu ŋanda yakwe, abasha bafyalilwe mumwakwe nangu abo ashitile ne ndalama, abasembulula inkanda ya ku mpela ya bwaume, ngefyo Lesa amwebele.

english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
translation: Abrahamu asembulwilwe ilyo ali ne myaka amakumi pabula na pabula (99).

english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
translation: Elyo mwane Ishimaeli ena asembulwilwe ilyo ali ne myaka ikumi limo na itatu (13).

english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
translation: Abrahamu no mwana wakwe Ishimaeli bonse babili basembulwilwefye ubushiku bumo bwine.

english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
translation: Abaume bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Abrahamu, abasha abafyalilwe mumwakwe nabo bonse abo ashitile ku beni, basembulwilwe ubushiku bumo pamo na Abrahamu.

english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
translation: Abramu awa ubukupeme, elyo Lesa asosa ati,

english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
translation: “Kanshi ici e cipangano candi na iwe, icakuti ukaba icikolwe ca mishobo iyingi.

english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
translation: Nomba tawakulaitwa Abramu, ishina lyobe nomba niwe Abrahamu pantu ninkucita icikolwe ca mishobo iyingi.

english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
translation: Nkakupeelesha ubufyashi. Kuli iwe kukafuma imishobo iyingi, kabili kuli iwe kukafuma na bashamfumu.”

english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
translation: “Icipangano nkapangana nobe na ba mu lupwa lobe abakakonkapo umukonkanina inkulo, cikaba cakubelelela. Nkaba Lesa obe kabili nkalaba Lesa wa ba mu lupwa lobe abakakonkapo pali iwe.

english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
translation: Icalo conse ica Kenani umo ucili umweni, nkacipeela kuli iwe na ku ba mu lupwa lobe abali nokukukonkapo, cikabe cenu pe. Elyo na ine nkaba Lesa wabo.”

english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
translation: Kabili Lesa aebele Abrahamu ati, “Elyo na imwe, mufwile ukusunga icipangano candi, iwe na ba mu lupwa lobe abakakonkapo umukonkanina inkulo.

english: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
translation: Yawe amonekele kuli Abrahamu mupepi ne miti ikulu iya oki iyakwa Mamure ilyo aikele pa mwinshi we tenti lyakwe ninshi akasuba nakabalikisha nganshi.

english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
translation: Elyo umo pa beni bakwe asosa ati, “Icine cine uyu mwaka uleisa nga pa nshita ino ine nkesa kupempula, kabili umukashi obe Sara akaba no mwana umwaume.” Kanshi Sara ali pa mwinshi we tenti ilyali kunuma yakwa Abrahamu alekutika.

english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
translation: Abrahamu na Sara bali abakote ne myaka iyingi nganshi. Sara nao inshita yakufyala ninshi yalipita.

english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
translation: Kanshi Sara epakuseka uko ali eka, pantu aletontonkanya ati, “Ilyo ninakuka na shikulu nao mukote, bushe nine ningaibika nakabili mu fyakuisansamusha!”

english: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Abrahamu ati, “Cinshi ico Sara asekela no kusosa ukuti, ‘Bushe cine cine nine ningakwata umwana nomba ilyo ndi umukote?’

english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
translation: Bushe kwaliba icintu ico Yawe engafilwa? Uyu mwaka uleisa pa nshita ilya nandilepo nkabwela nakabili, elyo Sara akaba no mwana umwaume.”

english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
translation: Sara ico aumfwa umwenso, abepa ati “Awe ine nshaciseka.” Lelo Yawe amweba ati, “Ee waciba nuseka.”

english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
translation: Ilyo balya bantu baimine ukuti baleya, ico bali apasansama, baloleshe lwa panshi ku Sodoma. Abrahamu nao aya alebashindika.

english: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
translation: Elyo Yawe asosa ati, “Bushe mfise kuli Abrahamu ifyo nalacita?

english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
translation: Pantu Abrahamu akaba umushobo ukalamba kabili uwamaka. Kabili imishobo yonse iya pano isonde ikapaalilwa muli ena.

english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
translation: Pantu nalimusala pakuti akalange abana bakwe na ba mu ŋanda yakwe abakamukonkapo ukulakonka inshila yakwa Yawe, mukucita ifyalungama no kuba no mulinganya, pakuti Yawe akacitile Abrahamu ifyo amulaya.”

english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
translation: Cilya ainuna amenso, amona abaume batatu beminine mupepi napo ali. Ilyo abamona afuma ulubilo pa mwinshi we tenti lyakwe aya kukubakumanya, elyo akontamina panshi,

english: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
translation: Elyo Yawe atila, “Ukuilishanya kwa pali Sodoma na Gomora nakukulisha nganshi, no bubifi bulimo nabubipisha nganshi,

english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
translation: eco nalailako kukumona ifyo bacita nga nafibipa ukulingana no kuilishanya kwafika kuli ine. Elyo nga teifyo, ndeya ishiba.”

english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
translation: Elyo balya bantu bapilibuka, balaya lwa ku Sodoma, lelo Abrahamu ena ashala naiminina pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
translation: Elyo Abrahamu apalama, aipusha Yawe ati, “Bushe cine cine walaonaula abalungami pamo na babifi?

english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
translation: Bushe nga cakuti mu musumba mulimo abantu abalungami amakumi yasano (50), bushe uleonaula umusumba? Bushe tekuti uleke ube pa mulandu wa aba bantu abalungami abalimo amakumi yasano (50)?

english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
translation: Nacitaluke kuli iwe ukucita ica musango uyu, ukwipaya abalungami pamo na babi, teti ucitile abalungami cimo cine na babi. Nacitaluke kuli iwe! Bushe kapingula we sonde lyonse tali nakucita mulinganya?”

english: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
translation: Yawe amwasuka ati, “Nga nasanga mu musumba wa Sodoma muli abantu abalungami amakumi yasano (50), nshaye onaula musumba pa mulandu wabo.”

english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
translation: Abrahamu asosele nakabili ati, “Ine ne ulifye ulukungu, kabili imito, nine napama ukulanda ku Mfumu,

english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
translation: bushe nga cakuti pa balungami amakumi yasano (50) pabulilafye basano, bushe kuti waonaula umusumba pa mulandu wakuti pabulila abantu abalungami basano?” Yawe ayasuka ati, “Iyoo tekuti ngonaule musumba nga nasangamo abantu abalungami amakumi yane na basano (45).”

english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
translation: Abrahamu asosa nakabili ati, “Nga cakuti mwasangamofye amakumi yane (40)?” Yawe ayasuka ati, “Tekuti ngonaule musumba pa mulandu wa makumi yane (40).”

english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
translation: asosa ati, “We mfumu napapata, nga cingamusekesha, wipitafye pa mubomfi obe.

english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
translation: Kabili Abrahamu ati, “We Mfumu wifulwa, nalalanda nakabili. Nga cakuti mwasangwafye amakumi yatatu (30)?” Yawe amwasuka ati, “Tekuti ngonaule musumba nga cakuti nasangamo amakumi yatatu (30).”

english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
translation: Abrahamu asosa ati, “Apo nomba nimpama ukulanda ku Mfumu, nga cakuti mwasangwafye amakumi yabili (20)?” Yawe amwasuka ati, “Pa mulandu wa abo amakumi yabili (20) tekuti ngonaule musumba.”

english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
translation: Kabili Abrahamu asosa ati, “Nga cakuti Imfumu tayafulwe, kanjipushekofye umuku umo uwakulekelesha, nga cakuti mwasangwafye ikumi limo epela?” Yawe amwasuka ati, “Pa mulandu wa abo ikumi limo tekuti ngonaule musumba.”

english: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
translation: Cilya Yawe apwa ukulanda na Abrahamu, aya no kuya, Abrahamu nao abwelamo kumwakwe.

english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
translation: Lekeni balete utumenshi utwakusamba ku makasa yenu, elyo mutuusheko mwisamba lya muti.

english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
translation: Lekeni muleteleko utwakulya, pakuti mubweshe amaka, lyena elyo mukonkanyepo ubulendo bwenu, pantu mwaisa pita pa mubomfi wenu.” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Cisuma, cita ifyo fine walanda.”

english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
translation: Kanshi Abrahamu aile bwangu bwangu mwitenti kuli Sara, amweba ati, “Endesha, buula ifikopo fitatu ifya bunga ubwapeleka bwino, ukasawile elyo upangeko imikate.”

english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
translation: Elyo abutukila ukwali iŋombe, asalapo iciponti icisuma kabili icanakilila, acipeela na ku mubomfi. Umubomfi nao bwangu bwangu acipekanya.

english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu abuula umukaka uwatimba no wasongoloka ne nama apekenye, afiteka napo bali. Ilyo balelya Abrahamu aiminine mupepi nabo mwisamba lya muti.

english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
translation: Abo bantu bamwipushe abati, “Bushe Sara umukashi obe ali kwi?” Abrahamu abasuka ati, “Ali mwitenti.”

english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
translation: Bamalaika balya babili bafikile icungulo mu Sodoma, Loti aikele pa mpongolo ya musumba. Cilya abamona, Loti aima, aya na kukubakumanya, abafukamina, akontamina panshi.

english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
translation: Lelo balya bantu babili abali mukati, bafumya amaboko batintila Loti mu ŋanda, baisalako ne ciibi.

english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
translation: Kabili baleta akafifi pa menso ya bantu abali pa mwinshi wa ŋanda, abaice na bakalamba, icakuti bafilwa no kusanga apali iciibi.

english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
translation: Balya bantu babili baebele Loti abati, “Bushe nukwatamo abantu bobe bambi muli uno musumba, basofyala, nangu abana bobe abaume na banakashi, nangu aba mu lupwa lobe bambi? Bafumyemo muli uno musumba

english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”
translation: pantu twalaonaula ino ncende. Ukuilishanya pa bantu ba mu musumba uyu kuli Yawe nakukula, eico Yawe atutumine kukonaula umusumba.”

english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
translation: Kanshi Loti epakufuma, ayalanda na bashifyala abakobekele bamwane, abeba ati, “Endesheni, fumeni muno musumba, pantu Yawe alaonaula uno musumba.” Lelo bashifyala bena balatontonkanya ukuti alesekafye.

english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
translation: Ilyo cafikile ku macaca, bamalaika balacincisha Loti abati, “Ala endesha! Senda umukashi obe na bamwano babili abakashana abali pano, epali na imwe mwalobela kumo ilyo umusumba walakandwa.”

english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
translation: Ilyo alashingashinga, balya bantu babili epakwikata Loti no mukashi wakwe na bamwane babili abakashana pa maboko babafumisha na kunse ya musumba, pantu Yawe alibomfwilile uluse.

english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
translation: Ilyo babafumisha kunse ya musumba, umo pali balya abeba ati, “Butukeni mwalafwa! Tecakwesha ukucebukila kunuma, nangu ukwiminina pa ncende imo mwiwanga! Butukilenifye ku mpili, epali na imwe mwalobelamo.”

english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
translation: Isham 6:18

english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
translation: Umubomfi wenu nasanga uluse pa cinso cenu kabili namunanga icikuku icikalamba pakupususha ubumi bwandi. Lelo ku mpili kwena teti mbutukileko, pantu ndefwa nshilafikako nge cinkunka ici cafika.

english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
translation: Loti abeba ati, “Mwe mfumu shandi, shimwingesa ku ŋanda ya mubomfi wenu, eko musendame, musambe na ku makasa. Elyo mailo lucelocelo kuti mwatola ubulendo bwenu mwalaya.” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Awe, ifwe tulesendamafye panse.”

english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
translation: Moneni umusumba uyu mupepi, eko mbutukile, kabili musumba uunono. Lekeni eko mbutukile, kamusumbafye akanono, teifyo fine? E mulandu betila aka kamusumba Sowa. Lyena ninshi ndepusuka.”

english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
translation: Umo pali balya amwasuka ati, “Cisuma kanshi, neci cine walomba nakusuminisha. Akamusumba walandapo kena nshakonaule iyoo.

english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
translation: Loti afikile mu Sowa ninshi akasuba nakatula,

english: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.
translation: Elyo Yawe alokesha pali Sodoma na Gomora umulilo wa fyanunka nga maluti. Fyafumine kuli Yawe ku mulu.

english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
translation: Efyo Yawe aonawile iyi misumba, iwanga lyonse, abantu bonse abaleikala muli iyi misumba, elyo na fyonse ifyamenene mu mushili.

english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
translation: Lelo muka Loti acebukila kunuma, kabili asanguka impinda ya mucele.

english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, lucelocelofye, Abrahamu aima aya ku ncende iyo aimininepo pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
translation: Alolesha mwisamba lwa ku Sodoma na ku Gomora ne calo conse ice wanga, amona uko icushi cilefutumuka kwati cushi cilefuma mwilungu lya mulilo.

english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
translation: Kanshi ilyo Lesa aonawile imisumba ya mwiwanga, aibukishe Abrahamu, afumya na Loti mu busanso ubwaonawile imisumba Loti aleikalamo.

english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
translation: Lelo Loti apamfya nganshi icakuti basuka baya nankwe kabili baingila na mu ŋanda yakwe. Elyo abapekanishisha icakulya, abapangila imikate iyabulamo intutumushi, nabo balya.

english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
translation: Loti ali no mwenso wakwikala mu Sowa. Kanshi epakufuma mu Sowa, aya ikala ku mpili mu lucengo pamo na bamwane babili abanakashi.

english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
translation: Ubushiku bumo uwamukalamba aebele uwamwaice ati, “Batata nabakota, elyo mu calo conse tamuli umwaume nangu umo uwakutuupa ngefyo caba mu fyalo fyonse.

english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
translation: Luka 17:32

english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
translation: Kanshi cilya bwaila balenga shibo ukukolwa umwangashi. Elyo uwamukalamba epakuya lala na wishi. Lelo wishi taishibe ilyo aishile lala nangu ilyo afuminepo.

english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, uwamukalamba aebele uwamwaice ati, “Mailo ubushiku nalilala na batata. Kanshi na lelo ubushiku tubanwenshe umwangashi bakolwe, elyo na iwe uleya lala nabo pakuti ulupwa lwesu lukatwalilile ukupitila muli batata.”

english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
translation: Kanshi ilyo caba ubushiku, balenga wishi ukukolwa umwangashi. Elyo uwamwaice nao aya lala na wishi. Lelo wishi taishibe ilyo aishile kukulala nangu ilyo afuminepo.

english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
translation: Kanshi bamwana Loti bonse babili epakwimita kuli shibo.

english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
translation: Uwamukalamba asuka apaapa umwana umwaume, amwinika ne shina lya Moabu. Moabu e cikolwe ca bantu abo na lelo beta abena Moabu.

english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
translation: Uwamwaice nao asuka apaapa umwana umwaume, amwinika ne shina lya Ben Ami, nao e cikolwe ca bantu abo na lelo beta abena Amoni.

english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
translation: Ilyo abeni tabalati baye na kukusendama, abaume bonse ukufuma mu fitungu fyonse ifya musumba wa Sodoma, abaice na bakalamba, baisa shinguluka iŋanda.

english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
translation: Elyo balabilikisha kuli Loti abati, “Bushe abantu beshile kumobe muno bushiku bali kwi? Balete pano panse uleke tubembuke nabo.”

english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
translation: Loti epakufumina panse kukubakumanya, asha aisalako ne ciibi.

english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
translation: Abeba ati, “Iyoo bane, mwicita icabipa ifyo.

english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
translation: Moneni ninkwata abana bandi babili abakashana abashatala abakuma ku mwaume. Kanshi lekeni ebo muletele, elyo mwe bene mubacite ico mulefwaya. Lelo mwicita nelyo cimo kuli aba baume, pantu beni bandi na ine ndi nokubasunga bwino.”

english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Fumako!” Kabili batile, “Uyu muntu aisafye kuno ngo mweni, elyo nomba alefwaya no kulatupingula! Tulekucita icabipisha ukucila na pa beni bobe.” Elyo balasunkila Loti kunuma, basuka baba mupepi nokuti bapankule iciibi.

english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
translation: Pa citendekelo Lesa abumbile umulu ne sonde.

english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
translation: Lesa ainike umushili uwauma ati, “Umulundu.” Elyo amenshi ayalongene mu ncende imo ati, “Bemba.” Lesa amona nokuti naciwama.

english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
translation: Kabili Lesa atile, “Umulundu naupuuke ifimena ifya misango yonse, ifilimwa ifitwala imbuto mu misango yafiko, ne miti ya pesonde iyitwala ifitwalo fya mikoli mu misango yafiko.” Kanshi efyo cali.

english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
translation: Elyo pa mulundu papuuka ifimena ifya misango yonse, ifilimwa ifitwala imbuto mu misango yafiko, elyo ne miti ya pesonde iyitwala ifitwalo fya mikoli mu misango yafiko. Elyo Lesa amona nokuti naciwama.

english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
translation: Kabili bwaila, elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwalenga shitatu.

english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
translation: Kabili Lesa atile, “Mu mulu namube ifisaniko ifyakulekanya akasuba no bushiku, fibe ifyakwishibilako imyaka, inshita shalekana lekana mu myaka, elyo ne nshiku,

english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
translation: kabili fibe ifisaniko mu mulu ifyakuleta ulubuuto pesonde.” Kanshi efyo cali.

english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation: Lesa epakupanga ifisaniko fibili ifikalamba. Icisaniko cakulilepo cakuteeka akasuba, elyo icacepelepo cakuteeka ubushiku. Elyo apanga ne ntanda.

english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
translation: Ifisaniko Lesa afibika mu mulu pakuti fileleta ulubuuto pesonde,

english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
translation: fileteeka akasuba no bushiku, kabili filelekanya ulubuuto ne mfifi. Elyo Lesa amona ukuti naciwama.

english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
translation: Kabili bwaila, elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwalenga shine.

english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
translation: Isonde lyalifye icimfulumfulu, kabili tamwali kantu nelyo kamo. Imfifi yakupile pali bemba uwashika no mupashi wakwa Lesa waleshinguluka pa mulu wa menshi.

english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
translation: Kabili Lesa atile, “Mu menshi namulesenya ifibumbwa fyabumi, ne fyuni nafilepupuka mu lwelele pa mulu we sonde.”

english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
translation: Kanshi Lesa epakubumba ifibumbwa ifyabumi ifikalamba nganshi ifyaba muli bemba, ne fyabumi ifya misango yonse ifikala mu menshi ne fyuni ifya misango yonse. Elyo Lesa amona nokuti naciwama.

english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
translation: Lesa afipaala, asosa ati, “Fyalaneni, mufule, mwisule bemba, ne fyuni nafisande fifule pesonde.”

english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
translation: Kabili bwaila, elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwalenga shisano.

english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
translation: Kabili Lesa atile, “Pesonde napabe ifibumbwa fyabumi mu misango yafiko, ifitekwa, ifikulaika pa mushili ne nama sha mpanga imisango yonse.” Kanshi efyo cali.

english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
translation: Lesa epakupanga inama sha mpanga mu misango yashiko, ifitekwa nafyo mu misango yafiko, elyo na fyonse ifikulaika pa mushili mu misango yafiko. Elyo Lesa amona nokuti naciwama.

english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
translation: Elyo Lesa atile, “Natupange umuntu mu cata cesu, uwakupalana na ifwe. Baleteeka isabi lya mu menshi, ifyuni fya mu lwelele, ifitekwa, elyo ne fikulaika pa mushili fyonse.”

english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
translation: Kanshi Lesa epakubumba umuntu mu cata cakwe.

english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
translation: Lesa abapaala, elyo asosa ati, “Fyalaneni, mufule, mwisule pesonde no kupanasha. Muleteeka isabi lya mu menshi, ifyuni fya mu lwelele ne fyabumi fyonse ifyenda pa mushili.”

english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
translation: Elyo Lesa atile, “Namupeela ifilimwa fya mbuto fyonse pano isonde ne miti yonse iya fitwalo umwaba inseke, efili nokuba ifyakulya fyenu.

english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
translation: Elyo Lesa atile, “Nakube ulubuuto,” awe no kubuuta kwabuuta.

english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
translation: Kabili ku finama fya mpanga fyonse ifya pano isonde, ifyuni fya mu lwelele fyonse, ifikulaika pa mushili ne fyaba no bumi fyonse, nafipeela ifyani na mabula ya miti efyo fyakulalya.” Kanshi efyo cali.

english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
translation: Lesa amona ifintu fyonse ifyo apangile ukuti nafiwama nganshi. Kabili bwaila, elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwalenga mutanda.

english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
translation: Lesa amona nokuti ulubuuto lwawama. Elyo Lesa alekanya ulubuuto ne mfifi.

english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
translation: Lesa ainika ulubuuto, “Akasuba,” imfifi yena ainika, “Ubushiku.” Kabili bwaila elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwakubalilapo.

english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
translation: Kol 4:6

english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
translation: Lesa apanga ulwelele ulwakulekanya amenshi, yamo yaba pesamba, yambi pa mulu wa lwelele. Kanshi efyo cali.

english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
translation: Lesa ainika ulwelele “Umulu.” Kabili bwaila, elyo bwaisaca, e bushiku bwalenga shibili.

english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
translation: Kabili Lesa atile, “Amenshi ya mwisamba lya mulu nayalongane mu ncende imo, pakuti kube umushili uwauma.” Kanshi efyo cali.

english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
translation: Abrahamu afumine kulya ku Mamure aya ku citungu ca matololo ya Negebu. Aile ikala pakati ka Kadeshi na Shuri. Aikele mu Gerari ngo mweni.

english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
translation: Kabili Abimeleki aipusha Abrahamu ati, “Mulandu nshi wacitila ifi?”

english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
translation: Abrahamu ayasuka ati, “Ine naletontonkanya ukuti, kuno abantu tekuti bakwate akatiina kuli Lesa, kabili kuti banjipaila pa mukashi wandi.

english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
translation: Kwena cacine ni nkashi yandi, batata ebamufyele lelo bamayo tebamufyala. Kanshi ine nalimuupa, mukashi wandi.

english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
translation: Icite 12:13

english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
translation: Kanshi Abimeleki epakubuula impaanga ne ŋombe, abasha abaume na banakashi, apeela Abrahamu elyo amubwesesha na Sara umukashi wakwe.

english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
translation: Kabili Abimeleki aebele Abrahamu ati, “Mona conse ici calo candi, kuti waikala konse uko ulefwaya.”

english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”
translation: Kuli Sara, Abimeleki atile, “Mona napeela ndume yobe indalama sha mashekeli ya silifa ikana limo (1,000). Ubu bupe bwakulanga abantu bonse abo muli nabo ukuti tapali nelyo cimo ico walufyanya. Kanshi nomba bonse baishiba ukuti uli wakaele.”

english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu apepa kuli Lesa nao aposha Abimeleki no mwina mwakwe na basha bakwe abanakashi pakuti balekwata abana nakabili,

english: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
translation: pantu Yawe alisele ubufyashi ku banakashi bonse abali mu ŋanda yakwa Abimeleki, pali ico Abimeleki abuulile Sara, muka Abrahamu.

english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
translation: Ilyo Abrahamu ali mu Gerari, pali Sara umukashi wakwe atile, “Ni nkashi yandi.” Kanshi Abimeleki imfumu ya mu Gerari epakutuma abakuya buula Sara no kumuleta kumwakwe.

english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”
translation: Lelo ubushiku bumo Lesa amonekele Abimeleki mu ciloto, amweba ati, “Iwe walafwa pa mulandu wa uyu mwanakashi ubuulile, pantu alyupwa.”

english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
translation: Abimeleki kwena ali talati akumane na Sara. Kanshi Abimeleki epakusosa ati, “Bushe we Mfumu kuti walofya abantu ababula umulandu?

english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
translation: Bushe Abrahamu umwine tewanjeba ati, ‘Sara ni nkashi yandi?’ Bushe Sara umwine tewanjeba ati, ‘Abrahamu ni ndume yandi?’ Ine ncitile ici no mutima usuma, kabili ukwabula icilubo.”

english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.
translation: Elyo Lesa amwasuka mu ciloto ati, “Ninjishiba ukuti ucitile ici no mutima usuma. E mulandu wine na ine nengele ukuti wikumana na Sara, pantu nga naubifya kuli ine

english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
translation: Kanshi lucelocelo ubushiku bwakonkelepo Abimeleki alongenye ababomfi bakwe. Elyo abashimikilako no mulandu onse nabo baikatwa no mwenso nganshi.

english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
translation: Abimeleki epakwita Abrahamu, amweba ati, “Cinshi watucitila ifi? Cinshi nabifya kuli iwe pakuti ulete ishamo lyakula ifi pali ine ne calo candi? Ifintu wancita tafifwile ukucitika.”

english: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.
translation: Kanshi Yawe alangulukile Sara pamo ngefyo asosele. Kabili Yawe epakucitila Sara ico amulaile.

english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
translation: elyo Sara aeba Abrahamu ati, “Tamfya uyu mwanakashi umusha pamo no mwana wakwe, pantu uyu mwana wa musha tekuti akapokeko ifyuma ukasha pamo no mwana wandi Isaki.”

english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
translation: Bahi 11:11

english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
translation: Icite 17:12

english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
translation: Umwana wa musha nao nkalenga ukuti akabe umushobo uukalamba, pantu nao wine mwana obe.”

english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, lucelocelofye Abrahamu abuula icakulya ne nyambi umwali amenshi apeela Haga. Afibika pa kubeya kwakwa Haga, amweba no kuya pamo no mwana. Elyo Haga afumapo, aya alelulumba mu matololo ya Beresheba.

english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
translation: Ilyo amenshi yapwa mu nyambi, Haga asha alalika umwaice mu cimpusa.

english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
translation: Elyo afumapo aya ikala apataliko, pantu mu mutima wakwe aleti, “Nshilefwaya kumonako uko umwaice alefwa.” Elyo ati ekale nga filya, atampa ukulalila.

english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
translation: Lesa alyumfwile uko umwaice alelila. Elyo malaika wakwa Lesa abilikisha Haga ukufuma ku mulu amweba ati, “Haga cinshi cilekucusha? Witiina nelyo cimo. Lesa naumfwa ukulila kwa mwaice palya alele.

english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
translation: Bahi 11:18

english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
translation: Elyo Lesa aisula amenso yakwa Haga nao amona icishima ca menshi. Kanshi elyo ayako, aisusha amenshi mu nyambi, apeela no mwaice anwa.

english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
translation: Sara epakuba pabukulu, pa nshita ine ilya Lesa alaile epo Sara afyalile Abrahamu umwana umwaume ninshi Abrahamu mukote.

english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.
translation: Lesa alesunga umwaice ilyo alekula. Aleikala mu matololo, kabili ali fundi uwacenjela ukwipaya inama mukubomfya ubuta ne mifwi.

english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Ilyo aleikala mu matololo ya Parani, nyina amufwaila umwanakashi umwina Egupto, eo aupa.

english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
translation: Pa nshita ilya Abimeleki no mukalamba wa fita fyakwe Fikoli baishile kuli Abrahamu, bamweba abati, “Iwe Lesa aba nobe muli fyonse ifyo ucita.

english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation: Kanshi nomba lapa pa cinso cakwa Lesa ukuti, iwe tawakancenjeshe ine nelyo abana bandi nangu aba mu lupwa lwandi. Ulange uluse kuli ine na ku calo cino uleikalamo ngo mweni ngefyo ine nakulanga.”

english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
translation: Abrahamu epakusosa ati, “Ee, nalapa.”

english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu ailishenye kuli Abimeleki pa mulandu wa cishima ca menshi ico ababomfi bakwa Abimeleki bamupokele ku maka.

english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
translation: Icite 26:26

english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu abuula impaanga ne ŋombe apeela Abimeleki. Aba bantu babili epakupangana icipangano.

english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu apatula pa mukuni wa fitekwa utwana twa mpaanga utukota cine lubali.

english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”
Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
translation: Abrahamu nao epakwinika umwana umwaume uo Sara amufyalile ishina lya Isaki.

english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
translation: Abrahamu amwasuka ati, “Iwe buula utu twana twa mpaanga twandi utukota cine lubali, etwakwiminina bukambone ukuti nine naimba ici cishima.”

english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
translation: Kanshi eico iyi ncende baita Beresheba, pantu eko aba bantu babili balapile umulapo.

english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
translation: Ilyo bapwile ukupangana icipangano ku Beresheba, Abimeleki no mukalamba wa fita fyakwe Fikoli babwelelemo ku calo ca Bafilisiti,

english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.
translation: Abrahamu ena alimbile umuti wa tamarisiki mu Beresheba, epo alapepela Yawe, Lesa wa pe na pe.

english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
translation: Kabili Abrahamu aikele ngo mweni inshita iikalamba mu calo ca Bafilisiti.

english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
translation: Ilyo ubushiku bwalenga cine konse konse apo Isaki afyalilwe bwafikile, Abrahamu amusembulula ukukonka nefyo Lesa amukonkomeshe.

english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
translation: Abrahamu ali ne myaka yakufyalwa umwanda umo (100) ilyo mwane Isaki afyelwe.

english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
translation: Sara epakusosa ati, “Lesa nandetela inseko, elyo na onse uukomfwako akaseka pamo na ine.”

english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
translation: Kabili alundapo nokuti, “Nga nani ali nokweba Abrahamu ukuti Sara akonshapo abana? Lelo mu bukote bwakwe nimufyalila umwana.”

english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
translation: Imili 7:8

english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
translation: Lelo Sara amwene ukuti umwana wakwa Haga umwina Egupto uo afyele kuli Abrahamu, alayangala pamo na Isaki,

english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
translation: Nomba panuma ya ifi fintu, Lesa aeseshe Abrahamu. Lesa amwitile ati, “Abrahamu!” Abrahamu nao ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi!”

english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
translation: Elyo afungulula ukuboko, abuula umwele pakuti epaye mwane.

english: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
translation: Lelo malaika wakwa Yawe amwita ukufuma ku mulu ati, “Abrahamu, Abrahamu!” Abrahamu ayasuka ati, “Epo ndi!”

english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
translation: Malaika amweba ati, “Wiyipaya mwaice, wimucita nelyo cimo. Nomba naishiba ukuti walikwatila Lesa akatiina, pantu taukene ukundekela mwano, nao uwabafye umo mpo.”

english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
translation: Abrahamu ati acebukile kunuma, amona sukusuku naikatwa ku nsengo mwiteshi, eko alungama aya mubuula, eo alekela Lesa ilambo lyakoca pa malo yakwa mwane.

english: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”
translation: Kanshi Abrahamu epakwinika ilya ncende ishina ilyakuti, “Yawe alapeela.” Eico ukufika na lelo bapetila abati, “Pa lupili lwakwa Yawe alapeela.”

english: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
translation: Kabili malaika wakwa Yawe aita Abrahamu ukufuma ku mulu umuku wabubili,

english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
translation: amweba ati, “Yawe asosa ati, nalapa napo ndi, apo wacita ici cintu, taukene kundekela mwano, uwabafye umo mpo,

english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”
translation: Pantu iwe naubeela amashiwi yandi, imishobo yonse pano calo ikapaalilwa mu bufyashi bobe.”

english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu abwelela ku babomfi bakwe, bonse pamo babwelelamo ku Beresheba no kwikala eko aisa ikala.

english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
translation: Elyo Lesa amweba ati, “Buula mwano, umwana obe umo mpo, Isaki, uo watemwa, uye ku citungu ca Moriya. Uli nokuya muleka nge lambo lyakoca kulya kwine pa lupili lumo ulo nkakulanga.”

english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
translation: Panuma ya ifi fintu, Abrahamu aumfwile amashiwi yakuti, “Milika alikwata abana abaume kuli munonko Naho.

english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
translation: Yako 2:21

english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
translation: elyo ni Kesedi, Haso, Pilidashi, Yidilafu na Betueli.”

english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
translation: Uyu Betueli e wishi wakwa Rebeka. Aba bana abaume cine konse konse, e bana Milika afyele kuli Naho munyina kwa Abrahamu.

english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation: Elyo muli Reuma umukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga, Naho afyelemo abana abaume, Teba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Maaka.

english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
translation: Ilyo bwaishileca, lucelocelofye, Abrahamu ateyenye punda wakwe. Elyo abuula ababomfi bakwe babili na mwane Isaki. Ilyo aputaula inkuni ishingalinga ukocela ilambo, elyo aima alaya na ku ncende Lesa amulangilile.

english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu, Abrahamu alinwine amenso amona ilya ncende bamulangilile apatali.

english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”
translation: Elyo Abrahamu aebele ababomfi bakwe ati, “Imwe shaleni pano na punda. Ine no mwaice twaya kulya, tuye pepa elyo tulebwelela kuno kwine.”

english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
translation: Abrahamu abuula inkuni shakocela ilambo, atwika na mwane Isaki. Umwine ena asenda umulilo no mwele. Kabili bonse babili baima balaya.

english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
translation: Isaki elyo aipusha wishi Abrahamu ati, “Tata!” Abrahamu ayasuka ati, “Ni shani mwana wandi?” Isaki amweba ati, “Umulilo ne nkuni fyena epo fili, nga nomba umwana wa mpaanga uwakuleka ilambo lyakoca ali kwi?”

english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
translation: Abrahamu amwasuka ati, “Mwana wandi, Lesa umwine aletupeela umwana wa mpaanga uwakuleka ilambo lyakoca.” Bonse babili bakonkanyapo ukulaya.

english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
translation: Cilya bafika ku ncende Lesa amulangilile, Abrahamu akuulapo ubulambo, abikapo ne nkuni bwino bwino. Elyo akaka mwane Isaki, amulalika na pa mulu wa nkuni pa bulambo.

english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
translation: Sara aikele pano calo imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yabili na cine lubali (127).

english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
translation: Kanshi Efuloni umwina Hiti ali palya pene pa bantu bakwe. Elyo ayasuka Abrahamu ninshi na bena Hiti bonse abaishile ku mpongolo ya musumba wakwe baleumfwako.

english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
translation: Amweba ati, “Iyoo shikulu, umfwa kuli ine, nalakupeela ilya mpanga pamo pene no lucengo lwine ululimo. Nakupeela ilya mpanga pa cinso ca bantu bandi, kanshi shiikamo umuntu obe uufwile.”

english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
translation: Nakabili Abrahamu akontamina abekalacalo,

english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
translation: elyo aeba Efuloni ninshi abantu baleumfwako ati, “Nkutikeni nga kuti mwatemwa. Nalalipila umutengo impanga ili nokushitwapo. Iwe suminafye ukupoka indalama, pakuti ine nshiikemo umuntu wandi uufwile.”

english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
translation: Efuloni epakwasuka Abrahamu ati,

english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
translation: “Shikulu umfwa kuli ine, umutengo wa mpanga ni ndalama amashekeli ya silifa imyanda ine (400). Nomba pakati kesu, ngesho ndalama ni cinshi? Kashiikefye umuntu obe uufwile.”

english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
translation: Imili 7:16

english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
translation: Efyo kanshi impanga yakwa Efuloni ku Makipela, iyalungatene na Mamure, yayalwike impanga yakwa Abrahamu. Emukutila impanga no lucengo lwalimo, elyo ne miti yonse iyali mukati ka mipaka ya mpanga,

english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
translation: fyonse fyayalwike ifintu fyakwa Abrahamu pa cinso ca bena Hiti na bantu bonse abaliko pa mpongolo ya musumba.

english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapwa, Abrahamu epakushiika umukashi wakwe Sara mu lucengo ulwa mu mpanga ya Makipela ukulungatana na Mamure, uwabela ku Hebuloni, mu calo ca Kenani.

english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
translation: Afwilile ku Kiriati Aba, emukutila ku Hebuloni mu calo ca Kenani. Elyo Abrahamu aingile mukuloosha Sara, alalila umukashi wakwe.

english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
translation: Kanshi impanga no lucengo ulwalimo ifya bena Hiti, fyayaluka fyaba fyakwa Abrahamu umwakuti aleshiika abantu bakwe.

english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
translation: Elyo Abrahamu aimine, asha icitumbi ca mukashi wakwe, aya kukulanda na bena Hiti.

english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
translation: Abeba ati, “Ine kuno ndi mweni naisakofye. Kanshi nshitisheniko impanga kuno iyakuti ibe inshinshi umwakuti nje shiika umukashi wandi.”

english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
translation: Abena Hiti bayasuka Abrahamu abati,

english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
translation: “Shikulu! Umfwa kuli ifwe. Iwe uli kanabesa wamaka pakati kesu. Kanshi salapofye inindi iyiwamishe emo ushiike umuntu obe uyo afwile. Pali ifwe tapali nelyo umo uulekulesha ukushiika mu nindi yakwe uyo muntu obe afwile.”

english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
translation: Elyo Abrahamu aima, akontamina abekalacalo abena Hiti.

english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
translation: Abeba ati, “Kanshi umfweni nga mulefwaya ukuti nshiike umukashi wandi kuno, ninshi munandileko kuli Efuloni mwana Sohari

english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
translation: Bahi 11:9

english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
translation: Abrahamu asukile akula, akota nganshi. Yawe nao alimupaalile muli fyonse.

english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
translation: Elyo umubomfi abuulilepo ikumi limo pa ngamila shakwa shikulu wakwe Abrahamu aya no kuya. Asendele ne fintu ifyalekana lekana ifyawamishepo pa fintu shikulu wakwe akwete. Aima aya ku Aramu Naharaimu elyo alola na ku musumba wa Naho.

english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
translation: Cilya afika, aleka ingamila shafukama mupepi ne cishima, kunse ya musumba. Ilyo ninshi cali cungulo inshita abanakashi baya kukutapa amenshi.

english: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
translation: Elyo alapepa ati, “We Yawe, Lesa wakwa shikulu Abrahamu, shi wingancitila lelo ico nyendele. Langa uluse kuli shikulu Abrahamu.

english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
translation: Mona, ine njiminine kuno ku cishima, na bakashana ba mu musumba balaisa kukutapa amenshi.

english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
translation: Kanshi cibe ukuti umukashana uo ndeisa eba nati, ‘Sendamika umutondo obe uleke nwemo amenshi,’ nao nga aleisa sosa ati, ‘Nwamo, kabili nalapeela ne ngamila shobe nasho shine amenshi,’ ninshi eo nabe uo wasalila umubomfi obe Isaki. Kuli ici, eko ndeishibila ukuti naulanga uluse kuli shikulu wandi.”
