translation: Lelo nga fitekwa ifyanakuka, awe lyena Yakobo talebika misambo mu milimba. Kanshi mukucita ifyo, Labani akwatafye ifitekwa ifyanakuka, elyo Yakobo wena ifyatuuluka.

english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
translation: Ni muli uyu musango Yakobo asukile aba umukankala nganshi. Akwata imikuni ikalamba iya fitekwa, ababomfi abaume na banakashi, ingamila na bapunda.

english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
translation: Awe Bilua aba pabukulu, amufyalila no mwana umwaume.

english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
translation: Elyo Rakeli asosa ati, “Lesa nancitila umulinganya. Naumfwa ukupapata kwandi, nampeela no mwana umwaume.” Na pa mulandu wa ici epakumwinika ishina lya Dani.

english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
translation: Nakabili Bilua umusha wakwa Rakeli aba pabukulu, afyalila Yakobo umwana umwaume uwalengele babili.

english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
translation: Rakeli epakusosa ati, “Natulwishanya nganshi na nkashi nandi, no kucimfya nine ncimfishe.” Kanshi epakumwinika ishina lya Naftali.

english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
translation: Ilyo Leya amwene ukuti aleka ukufyala abana, abuula umusha wakwe Silipa, amupeela kuli Yakobo ukuti abe umukashi wakwe.

english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
translation: Yakobo aumfwile ukuti bamwana Labani balesosa abati, “Yakobo nabuula ifyuma fyonse shifwe akwete. Kabili ubukankala buntu akwete, abufumishe ku fintu fyakwa shifwe.”

english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
translation: “Pa nshita inama shitamfyanya, limo nalilotele iciloto. Muli ici ciloto namwene ukuti basawe baletamfya bali aba mindoloshi, bamo aba fisemba, bambi nabo abamabala.

english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
translation: Kabili muli ici ciloto malaika wakwa Lesa anjeba ati, ‘Yakobo!’ Na ine nayasuka nati, ‘Epo ndi.’

english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
translation: Malaika epakunjeba ati, ‘Inuna amenso, mona basawe bonse abaletamfya, bamo ba mindoloshi, bamo ba fisemba, elyo bambi ba mabala. Ncitile ifi pantu nalimona ifyo Labani akucitila.

english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
translation: Nine Lesa uwakumonekele ku Betele, kulya waimike ilibwe waitilapo amafuta, elyo wandaya ne cilayo. Kanshi nomba fuma muli cino calo bwangu, ubwelele ku calo kumwenu.’”

english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
translation: Elyo Rakeli na Leya bamwaswike abati, “Bushe ifwe tucili natukwata ifyakupokako pa fyuma fya cishilano fya batata?

english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
translation: Bushe ifwe tata tatumonafye nga benafyalo? Alitushitishafye kabili alilya ne mpango apokele pali ifwe.

english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
translation: Cine cine ifyuma Lesa apoka batata, nomba fyuma fyesu na bana besu. Eico citafye ifyo Lesa akwebele.”

english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
translation: Elyo Yakobo aninika abakashi bakwe na bamwane pa ngamila,

english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
translation: Ilyo Labani aile kukubeya impaanga, Rakeli ashele aiba utulubi utwali e milungu yakwa wishi iya pa ŋanda yakwe.

english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
translation: Elyo Yakobo amona ukuti Labani talemulolesha bwino nga kale.

english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
translation: Yakobo nao acenjelela Labani umwina Aramu, afyuka ukwabula ukumwebako.

english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
translation: Kanshi afyukile asenda ne fintu fyonse ifyo akwete, ayabuka no mumana wa Yufurate, alungama ku calo ca mpili isha mu Gileadi.

english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu baisa eba Labani ukuti Yakobo alifyuka.

english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
translation: Labani epakusenda ba lupwa lwakwe, bakonka Yakobo pa nshiku cine lubali, bamusanga mu calo ca mpili isha mu Gileadi.

english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
translation: Elyo ubushiku, Lesa amonekela Labani umwina Aramu mu ciloto, amweba ati, “Ucenjele, wiesha kulanda kuli Yakobo nelyo cimo, icisuma nangu icibi.”

english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
translation: Labani asangile Yakobo ninshi acita inkambi mu calo ca mpili sha mu Gileadi. Elyo Labani na ba lupwa lwakwe nabo bacita inkambi uko kwine.

english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
translation: Labani epakweba Yakobo ati, “Bushe cinshi ucitile ifi? Walincenjesha, kabili wasenda na bana bandi abanakashi kwati ni bankole ba mu nkondo.

english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
translation: Bushe cinshi wafyukile mu bumfisolo no kuncenjesha wancenjesha? Bushe cinshi ushanjebeleko? Ala nga nalikufishapo ne nsansa, tuleimba no kulisha insombo na maseese.

english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now have you done foolishly.
translation: Tawalekele nokuti ntomone abeshikulu bandi na bana bandi abanakashi pakubafishapo. Tamwali mano muco wacitile.

english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
translation: Ine ninkwata amaka yakukucitapo cimo icibi, lelo Lesa wakwa wiso anjebele ubushiku ati, ‘Ucenjele, wiesha kulanda kuli Yakobo nelyo cimo, icisuma nelyo icibi.’

english: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
translation: Yawe epakweba Yakobo ati, “Bwelelamo ku calo ca fikolwe fyobe na ba mu lupwa lobe, elyo na ine nakulaba na iwe.”

english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
translation: Kwena ico ufumineko nico walefuluka ukubwelela ku ŋanda yakwa wiso. Nomba cinshi waibile imilungu yandi?”

english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
translation: Yakobo ayasuka Labani ati, “Nali no mwenso, pantu naletontonkanya ukuti limbi kuti mwampoka abana benu abanakashi ku makafye.

english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwasanga umo ali ne milungu yenu, wena wakwipayafye. Kanshi fwayeni mwe bene pa cinso ca ba lupwa lwesu nga palipo icintu cenu cimo ico nsendele. Elyo nga epo cili, mucibuule.” Yakobo taishibe ukuti ni Rakeli ewaibile imilungu yakwa Labani.

english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
translation: Kanshi Labani epakuya mwitenti lyakwa Yakobo, na mwitenti lyakwa Leya, na mwitenti lya basha banakashi babili, lelo monse tatusangilemo iyoo. Ilyo afuma mwitenti lyakwa Leya, elyo aingila mwiteni lyakwa Rakeli.

english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
translation: Kanshi Rakeli ninshi nafumya tulubi ele tubika mu cakwikalapo pa ngamila kabili no kwikala ninshi epo ekele. Labani afwaya mu fipe fyonsefye, awe nokuti atusange nakalya.

english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
translation: Elyo Rakeli aebele wishi ati, “Mukwai mwimfulilwa ico nafilwa ukwiminina pa cinso cenu, ala nico ndi kumpepo.” Labani wena abikapofye ukulafwaya, lelo nokuti asange imilungu yakwe nakalya.

english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
translation: Yakobo afulwa, alaebaula Labani. Aipusha Labani ati, “Bushe mulandu nshi nacita? Bushe bubifi nshi nacita pakuti mulenunga nge nama?

english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
translation: Nomba apo mwafwaya mu fipe fyandi fyonse, bushe cipe cenu nshi musangilemo? Cibikeni pa cinso ca ba lupwa lwenu na ba lupwa lwandi uleke bapingule pali ifwe babili.

english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
translation: Twikele nenu imyaka amakumi yabili (20). Impaanga shenu ishikota ne mbushi shenu ishikota tashaleponya mafumo, kabili nshalilepo sukusuku nangu sawe nelyo umo pa mikuni yenu.

english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
translation: Ilyo ifiswango fyaleipayapo icitekwa cenu cimo, nshaleleta iyo nama ifwile kuli imwe, lelo nalepyanikishapofye icitekwa candi ne mwine. Kabili mwalenjeba no kufutilapo inama abantu baleiba akasuba nangu ubushiku.

english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
translation: Kanshi Yakobo atumine amashiwi kuli Rakeli na Leya ukuti bese mu mpanga ukwali ifitekwa fyakwe.

english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
translation: Kanshi akasuba nalepya ku cipuki, elyo ubushiku kututumafye ku mpepo ukwabula ukumona utulo. Ifi efyali ubumi bwandi.

english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
translation: Pa myaka yonse iyi amakumi yabili (20) twaikele na imwe, efyo ubumi bwandi bwali. Namubombele imyaka ikumi limo na ine (14) pa bana benu abanakashi babili. Kabili namucemene ifitekwa fyenu pa myaka mutanda (6), lelo mwabikilepofye ukwalula amalipilo yandi imiku ikumi limo.

english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
translation: Ukwabula ukuti Lesa wakwa tata, Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa uo tata Isaki atiina, abe na ine, awe ukwabula no kutwishika, nga mwantamfyafye nja iminwe nkutwa. Lelo Lesa alimona ifyo nacula nefyo nabombesha na maboko yandi, eico lelo ubushiku acimukalipilila.”

english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
translation: Labani ayasuka Yakobo ati, “Aba banakashi bana bandi, abana nabo bana bandi, elyo ne fitekwa fine nafyo fitekwa fyandi. Fyonse ifi ulemona fyandi. Nomba kwena finshi lelo ningacitila abana bandi nangu aba bana bafyala?

english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”
translation: Ale nomba, iwe na ine natucite icipangano pakuti cibe e cakushinina pakati kesu.”

english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
translation: Elyo Yakobo abuula ilibwe aliminika pakuti libe icakwibukishishako.

english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
translation: Kabili aeba ba lupwa lwakwe ati, “Longanyeni amabwe,” nabo babuula amabwe bayatulika umwina. Elyo balya icakulya mupepi no mwina wa mabwe.

english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
translation: Labani awinika ishina lya Yega Saduta, Yakobo wena awinika ishina lya Galedi.

english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
translation: Elyo Labani asosa ati, “Uyu mwina wa mabwe ewaba lelo icakutushinina iwe na ine.” Kanshi eico uyu mwina waleitilwa Galedi.

english: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
translation: Kabili apa pene paleitwa Misipa pantu Labani asosele ati, “Yawe engalatubebeta, iwe na ine ilyo tukaleka ukwikala pamo.

english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Nimona ukuti bawiso tabandolesha bwino nga filya cali kale. Lelo Lesa wa batata aba na ine.

english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
translation: Elyo kabili nga walacusha abana banakashi bandi nangu waupilapo abanakashi na bambi, nangu tapali umbi na ifwe, uli nokwibukisha ukuti kambone wesu pali iwe na ine ni Lesa.”

english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
translation: Labani alundapo ukweba Yakobo nokuti, “Mona umwina wa mabwe, mona ne libwe ili, ifi njiminike pakati ka iwe na ine.

english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
translation: Uyu mwina wa mabwe e kambone ne libwe ili e kambone ukuti ine nshakacile uyu mwina ukwisa uko uli kukukucusha, elyo na iwe tawakacile uyu mwina neli libwe ukwisa uko ndi kukuncusha.

english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
translation: Lesa wakwa Abrahamu na Lesa wakwa Naho, Lesa wa fikolwe fyabo akatupingule ifwe bonse babili.” Yakobo nao epakulapa mwishina lyakwa Lesa uo wishi Isaki atiina.

english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
translation: Yakobo atuula ne lambo kulya kwine ku calo ca mpili, kabili aitako na ba lupwa lwakwe ku mitebeto. Panuma yakulya, basendama uko kwine ubo bushiku.

english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
translation: Imwe namwishiba ukuti nalibombela bawiso na maka yandi yonse,

english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
translation: lelo bawiso balincenjesha pakwalula amalipilo yandi imiku ikumi. Lelo Lesa tabaleka ukuti bancitile icakungonawila umutende.

english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
translation: Nga cakuti basosa abati, ‘Ifitekwa ifya mabala efikaba amalipilo yobe, lyena ninshi ifitekwa fyonse fyalafyala utwana utwa mabala.’ Kabili nga cakuti basosa abati, ‘Ifitekwa fya mindoloshi efikaba amalipilo yobe,’ nalyo ninshi ifitekwa fyonse fyalafyala utwana utwa mindoloshi.

english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
translation: Kanshi Lesa napokolola bawiso ifitekwa, nomba afipeele kuli ine.

english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
translation: Yakobo nao alimine ukuya noko alungeme. Elyo bamalaika bakwa Lesa bamukumanya.

english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
translation: Ine nshilingile uluse lonse ulu wankwatile, no bufumacumi bonse ubo walanga ku mubomfi obe. Ilyo nayabwike uyu mumana wa Yordani, nalifye ne nkonto epela, lelo nomba ndi na mabumba yabili.

english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.
translation: Napapata, wingampususha kuli munyinane Esau. Pantu ine ndetiina, kuti aisa ndwisha, elyo aipaya banyina na bana babo.

english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
translation: Lelo walandile auti, ‘Ine nkamona ukuti fyonse fyakuwamina, elyo nkalenga nokuti aba mu lupwa lobe bakabe kwati musensenga wa kuli bemba, uo umuntu ashingapenda.’”

english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
translation: Yakobo ubo bushiku alele pali iyo ine ncende. Elyo pa fintu akwete, asalapo fimo ifyakupeela Esau munyina.

english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
translation: Abuulapo imbushi shikota imyanda ibili (200) na basawe amakumi yabili (20), impaanga ishikota imyanda ibili (200) na basukusuku amakumi yabili (20),

english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
translation: ingamila ishaleonsha no twana twashiko amakumi yatatu (30), iŋombe ishikota amakumi yane (40) na bacilume wa ŋombe ikumi limo, elyo na bapunda abakota amakumi yabili (20) na bapunda abalume nabo ikumi limo.

english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
translation: Elyo abikako ababomfi bakwe abakusunga cila mukuni. Kabili abeba ati, “Imwe tangileniko, muleshapo incende pakati ka mukuni umo no mukuni ubiye.”

english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
translation: Icite 22:17

english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
translation: Elyo uli nokusosa auti, ‘Ishi ni nama sha mubomfi obe Yakobo. Ishi nama e bupe atuma kuli iwe, we mfumu yandi Esau, kabili ali panuma aleisa.’”

english: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
translation: Efyo akonkomesha no mubomfi wabubili no wabutatu na bonse bambi abalecema imikuni ya fitekwa ati, “Muli nokulanda amashiwi yamo yene kuli Esau, ilyo mwamukumanya.

english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
translation: Ilyo abamona, asosa ati, “Iyi e nkambi ya fita fyakwa Lesa.” Kanshi epakwinika iyo ncende ishina lya Mahanaimu.

english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
translation: Kabili mushininkishe ukusosa amuti, ‘Umubomfi obe Yakobo ali panuma yesu aleisa.’” Pantu Yakobo aletontonkanya ukuti, “Ku bupe ubu ndetangisha, nkamunasha ku mutima. Elyo kuntanshi ilyo tukamonana nankwe, lyena nalimo kuti ampokelela.”

english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
translation: Kanshi ubupe bwakwa Yakobo epakutangila, lelo umwine ashala asendama ubo bushiku mu nkambi.

english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
translation: Ubo bwine bushiku Yakobo aima, abuula abakashi bakwe babili, abasha bakwe abanakashi babili na bana bakwe abaume ikumi limo na umo (11), elyo ayabuka umumana wa Yaboku.

english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
translation: Aleka bonse bayabuka umumana, panuma elyo ayabusha ifintu fyonse ifyo akwete.

english: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
translation: Kanshi Yakobo epakushala eka. Elyo bashashala no muntu mpakafye na ku macaca.

english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.
translation: Ilyo uyo muntu amona ukuti teti anshe Yakobo, uyo muntu epakuma Yakobo pa mfyufyu ya lutungu, awe no lutungu lwafyutuka ninshi bacili balelwishanya.

english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
translation: Elyo uyo muntu aebele Yakobo ati, “Leka ndeya, pantu nomba caba ku macaca.” Lelo Yakobo amwasuka ati, “Awe nshakuleke uye, kano ninshi ushe wampaala.”

english: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
translation: Uyo muntu aipusha Yakobo ati, “Bushe ishina lyobe niwe ani?” Yakobo ayasuka ati, “Nine Yakobo.”

english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
translation: Elyo uyo muntu asosa ati, “Nomba tawakulaitwa ishina lya Yakobo, lelo Israeli, pantu naulwishanyana na Lesa na bantu, kabili naubansha.”

english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.
translation: Yakobo amweba ati, “Napapata njebako ishina lyobe.” Nao amwasuka ati, “Cinshi uleipushisha ishina lyandi?” Awe apopene apaala na Yakobo.

english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
translation: Yakobo atangisha inkombe kuli Esau munyina mu mpanga ya Seiri, mu calo ca Edomu.

english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
translation: Kanshi Yakobo epakwinika iyo ncende ishina lya Penieli. Asosa ati, “Pantu natushimpana na Lesa amenso, elyo kabili ncili umumi.”

english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
translation: Yakobo afumine pa Penieli cilya akasuba kasansuka, kabili alesunta pakwenda ku mulandu wa lutungu lwakwe.

english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
translation: Kanshi ukufika na lelo abena Israeli tabalya mushipa washinta mu mfyufyu ya lutungu, pantu ni pa mushipa wa mfyufyu ya lutungu epo Yakobo auminwe.

english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
translation: Ashikonkomesha ati, “Ifi efyo muli nokulanda kuli shikulu Esau amuti, ‘Umubomfi obe Yakobo asosa ukuti, naleikala na Labani ngo mweni, kabili ili lyonse ukufika na nomba eko naleikala.

english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
translation: Nalikwata iŋombe na bapunda, impaanga ne mbushi, abasha abaume na banakashi. Kanshi natuma aya mashiwi kuli iwe shikulu wandi, pakuti unsekelele bwino.’”

english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”
translation: Ilyo inkombe shabwelele kuli Yakobo shasosa ashiti, “Twaile fika kuli munonko Esau. Kabili alifye mu nshila mukwisa kukumanya, ali na baume imyanda ine (400).”

english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
translation: Yakobo umwenso wamwikata, kabili asakamana. Kanshi ayakanya abantu mu mabumba yabili, impaanga ne mbushi ne ŋombe ne ngamila nasho acita ifyo fine.

english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
translation: Yakobo aletontonkanya ukuti, “Nga cakuti Esau aisa lwisha ibumba limo, ninshi ibumba libiye kuti lyapusuka.”

english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
translation: Elyo Yakobo apepele ati, “We Lesa wakwa tata Abrahamu, we Lesa wakwa tata Isaki, we Yawe we wanjebele auti, ‘Bwelelamo ku calo kumwenu, na kuli ba lupwa lobe, ine nkamona ukuti fyonse fyakuwamina.’

english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.
translation: Ilyo Yakobo ainwine amenso, amwene Esau aleisa ali na bantu bakwe imyanda ine (400). Kanshi Yakobo epakupatulula abana. Bamo abatwala kuli Leya, bambi kuli Rakeli na ku basha bakwe abanakashi babili.

english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
translation: Yakobo nao ati, “Iyoo, napapata, nga cakuti naunsekelela, poka ubupe bwandi. Pantu ine, pakumona impumi yobe, cili kwati ndemona impumi yakwa Lesa, pali ifi wampokelela bwino.

english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
translation: Kanshi napapata pokelela ubupe bakuletele, pantu Lesa ku luse lwakwe alimpeela fyonse ifyo nkabila.” Elyo Yakobo abikapofye ukupapata, asuka Esau apoka ubupe.

english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”
translation: Elyo Esau asosa ati, “Ale kanshi natutampeko ubulendo bwesu, twalaendela pamo.”

english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
translation: Lelo Yakobo amweba ati, “Shikulu nawishiba ukuti abana tabalakosa, kabili ine nine ndi nokusunga impaanga, imbushi ne ŋombe ishileonsha utwana. Elyo nga cakuti bashensha lunkwa lunkwa akasuba konse nangufye pa bushiku bumo, inama shonse ninshi shikafwa.

english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
translation: Kanshi shikulu, natangilekofye, na ine ne mubomfi wenu nakulaisa buce buce ukulingana napo ifitekwa fili pantanshi na bana bandi bakulaendela, mpaka nkese fika kuli iwe shikulu ku Seiri.”

english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
translation: Esau epakusosa ati, “Kanshi leka nkushileko abantu bamo abakwenda nabo.” Yakobo ayasuka ati, “Nga ico ulecitila ifyo cinshi? Ine ico ndefwayafye cakuti iwe shikulu unsekelele.”

english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
translation: Kanshi pali ubo bwine bushiku, Esau aima abwelelamo ku Seiri.

english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
translation: Lelo Yakobo wena aya ku Sukoti, eko aikuulila iŋanda, kabili akuulako ne misakuta umwakwikala ifitekwa fyakwe. Kanshi eco betila ilya ncende Sukoti.

english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
translation: Panuma ilyo Yakobo abwelele ukufuma ku Padani Aramu, afikilefye umutende ku musumba wa Shekemu mu calo ca Kenani. Acita ne nkambi mupepi no musumba.

english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
translation: Iyi mpanga acitilepo inkambi ashitile pa ndalama isha silifa umwanda umo (100) kuli bamwana Hamori wishi wakwa Shekemu.

english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
translation: Abika abasha bakwe abanakashi na bana babo pantanshi, elyo akonkeshapo Leya na bamwane, elyo Rakeli na Yosefu bena panuma.

english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
translation: Muli iyi ncende, emo akuula ubulambo, abwinika ne shina lya Eli Elohe Israeli.

english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
translation: Yakobo umwine ena abatangilila bonse. Cilya aya alepalama kuli munyina, afukama no kukontamina panshi imiku cine lubali (7).

english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
translation: Lelo Esau abutuka ulubilo kukumanya munyina. Amufukatila kabili amukumbatila no kumutomona pakumuposha. Na bonse babili balalila.

english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”
translation: Elyo Esau ainuna amenso amona abanakashi na bana babo, aipusha Yakobo ati, “Nga aba muli nabo ni bani?” Yakobo ayasuka ati, “Aba, bana abo Lesa, ku luse lwakwe, apeela umubomfi obe.”

english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
translation: Elyo abasha banakashi babili na bana babo bapalama kuli Esau, bakontamina panshi.

english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
translation: Elyo pakonka Leya na bamwane, nabo baisa mufukamina no kukontamina panshi. Pakulekelesha Yosefu na Rakeli nabo baisa fukamina Esau no kukontamina panshi.

english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
translation: Elyo Esau aipwishe Yakobo ati, “Bushe cinshi ulefwaya ukucita ne mikuni ya fitekwa filya nkumenye?” Yakobo amwasuka ati, “Ala shikulu ndefwaya ukuti munsekelele.”

english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
translation: Lelo Esau amweba ati, “Awe munyinane ine nalikwata ifitekwa ifingi. Iwe sungafye ifitekwa fyobe.”

english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
translation: Nomba Dina umwana umukashana uo Yakobo afyele muli Leya, aile alepempula abanakashi ba muli cilya calo.

english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
translation: Kuti mwaikala na ifwe konse uko mulefwaya muli cino calo. Muleikalamo kabili kuti mwakwata ne cuma pamo ne mpanga.”

english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
translation: Elyo Shekemu aebele wishi kwa Dina na bandume yakwe ati, “Nga cingamusekesha, ine nkamupeela conse ico mukalomba.

english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
translation: Mpingwilenifye impango pa mukashana, elyo no bukulu bwa bupe ndi nokuleta apo mutemenwe. Ine fyonse ifyo mulenjeba ndelipila, cikulufye mumpeele umukashana abe umukashi wandi.”

english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti Shekemu alibifishe nkashi yabo Dina, bamwana Yakobo bayasuka Shekemu na Hamori wishi mu bucenjeshi.

english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
translation: Babeba abati, “Awe ifwe teti tucite ica musango uyo. Ifwe tekuti tupeele nkashi yesu ku muntu uushasembululwa. Ico kuti caba icamusebanya nganshi kuli ifwe.

english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
translation: Ifwe pakuti twingasumina ukulaupana na imwe, kano bonse abaume benu balasembululwa.

english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
translation: Lyena tukalaufya abakashana besu kuli imwe, na ifwe tukalaupa abakashana benu. Elyo ninshi tukalaikala na imwe, tukabe umutundu umo na imwe.

english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
translation: Lelo nga mwakaana ukusembululwa, ninshi twalasenda nkashi yesu, tuleya.”

english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
translation: Amashiwi bamwana Yakobo abaume balandile yalisansamwishe Hamori na mwane Shekemu.

english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
translation: Umulumendo wena, bwangu bwangu acita nefyo bamwana Yakobo abaume balandile, pantu alitemenwe umukashana mwana Yakobo. Uyu mulumendo ewacindamishe pali bonse pa ba mu ŋanda yakwa Hamori wishi.

english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
translation: Shekemu mwana Hamori umwina Hifi uwaleteeka iyo ncende, ati amone umukashana amwikata, alala nankwe ku makafye.

english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
translation: Kanshi Hamori na mwane Shekemu balimine baya na ku mpongolo ya musumba kukushimikila abantu baleikala nabo mu musumba.

english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.
translation: Babeba abati, “Aba bantu, baliba bwino kuli ifwe. Natubaleke bekale mu calo cesu no kukwatamo icuma, pantu icalo cesu cikulu. Elyo kuti twalaupa abana babo abanakashi nabo balaupa abana besu abanakashi.

english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
translation: Lelo aba bantu bakasuminisha ukuti tuleikala nabo ngo mutundu umo, kulila abaume besu bonse basembululwa nga filya bena basembululwa.

english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
translation: Bushe ninshi ifitekwa fyabo, ifyuma fyabo ne nama shabo shonse, tafikaba fintu fyesu fyonse? Kanshi natusuminishanye nabo, lyena bakulaikala na ifwe.”

english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
translation: Awe abaume bonse aba mu musumba basuminisha Hamori na mwane Shekemu, na baume bonse aba mu musumba basembululwa no kusembululwa.

english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshiku shitatu, ninshi abaume bacili balekalipwa ku filonda fyakusembululwa, abana bakwa Yakobo abaume babili, Simeoni na Levi bandume yakwa Dina, babuula impanga shabo, baingila mu musumba, ninshi aba mu musumba tabenekele iyoo, baipaya na baume bonse.

english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
translation: Baipaya Hamori no mwana wakwe Shekemu ku lupanga. Elyo bafumya Dina mu ŋanda yakwa Shekemu baya no kuya.

english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
translation: Panuma yakwipaya aba bantu, abana bambi abakwa Yakobo baisa tapa umusumba uo babifishemo nkashi yabo.

english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
translation: Basenda impaanga shabo ne mbushi, iŋombe shabo na bapunda, elyo ne fintu fyabo fyonse bakwete mu musumba na mu mabala.

english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
translation: Basendafye ifyuma fyabo fyonse na bakashi babo na bana babo, elyo batapa na fyonse ifyali mu mayanda.

english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
translation: Kanshi umutima wakwa Shekemu walifye pali Dina mwana Yakobo. Atemwa nganshi umukashana, kabili alalanda nankwe amashiwi yakumunashanasha.

english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
translation: Elyo Yakobo aebele Simeoni na Levi ati, “Imwe, mwandetelelafye. Aba bantu bekala muli cino calo abena Kenani na bena Perisi bakampata nganshi. Ifwe tulifye abampendwa, elyo nga cakuti baikatana pamo, bandwisha, ine na ba mu ŋanda yandi tukaloba.”

english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
translation: Lelo bamwane, bamwasuka abati, “Bushe bali nokucita nkashi yesu kwati ni cilende?”

english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
translation: Elyo Shekemu aebele wishi Hamori ati, “Tata mbuulileniko uyu mukashana ukuba umukashi wandi.”

english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
translation: Ilyo Yakobo aumfwile ukuti mwane Dina nabamubifya, bamwane abaume bali mu mpanga balecema ifitekwa, kanshi tacitilepo nelyo cimo mpaka ilyo babwelele ku mushi.

english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
translation: Elyo Hamori wishi wakwa Shekemu afumine kukuya landa na Yakobo.

english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.
translation: Nomba bamwana Yakobo ilyo baumfwile ifyacitike, apopenefye bafuma mu mpanga babwela. Baumfwile ubulanda nganshi no kufulwa apakalamba, pantu Shekemu acitile icintu icamusebanya nganshi ku bena Israeli pakulala no mwana umwanakashi wakwa Yakobo. Acitile icintu icishifwile kucitika.

english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
translation: Lelo Hamori abeba ati, “Umwana wandi Shekemu aposele umutima wakwe pa mwana wenu umukashana. Ndemupapata mupeeni umukashana abe umukashi wakwe.

english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
translation: Lekenifye tuleupana. Imwe muleufya abana benu abanakashi kuli ifwe, na ifwe tuleufya abana besu abanakashi kuli imwe.

english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
translation: Elyo Lesa aebele Yakobo ati, “Akuya ku Betele eko uye ikala. Kulya kwine eko uli nokukuulila Lesa ubulambo, uwakumonekele ilyo walefulumuka munonko Esau.”

english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
translation: Lesa amwebele ati, “Ishina lyobe niwe Yakobo, lelo nomba tabakulakwita Yakobo, bakulakwita ishina lya Israeli. ”

english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
translation: Icalo napeele Abrahamu na Isaki, niwe wine napeela, kabili nkacipeela na ku ba mu lupwa lobe abakakukonkapo.”

english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
translation: Elyo Lesa afumapo, asha Yakobo pa ncende ine iyo alandile nankwe.

english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
translation: Yakobo wena abuulile ilibwe lyakwibukishishako, aliminika pa ncende ine iyo Lesa alandile nankwe. Elyo aitila pa libwe umutuulo wa fyakunwa, kabili aitilapo na mafuta.

english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
translation: Yakobo ainike incende Lesa alandilepo nankwe ishina lya Betele.

english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
translation: Yakobo na bantu ali nabo balifumine ku Betele. Ilyo baile balepalama ku Efulati, Rakeli akomwa ne fumo kabili lyalamucusha nganshi.

english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
translation: Kabili ilyo acili alecula nganshi pakupaapa, nacimbusa aebele Rakeli ati, “Witiina, pantu walapaapa umwana umwaume na umbi.”

english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
translation: Kanshi Rakeli afwa, bamushiika na mupepi ne nshila ya ku Efulati, e Betelemu wine.

english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
translation: Kanshi Yakobo epakweba aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe na bonse abali nankwe ati, “Poseni utulubi twa milungu ya benafyalo uto muli nato, kabili muisangulule, mufwale ne fyakufwala ifisuma.

english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
translation: Yakobo aiminike pa luputa lwakwa Rakeli ilibwe ilyakwibukishishako. Kabili ukufika na lelo, ili libwe ecakwishibilako uluputa lwakwa Rakeli.

english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
translation: Elyo Israeli akonkenyepo ulwendo lwakwe, acitile inkambi yakwe ukucila pa lupungu lwa Ederi.

english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
translation: Ilyo Israeli aleikala muli iyo mpanga, Rubeni aile lala na Bilua umukashi wakwa wishi uo ashaupile mu bwinga. Elyo Israeli alyumfwileko pali uyu mulandu.

english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
translation: Bamwana Leya, ni Rubeni ibeli lyakwa Yakobo, elyo Simeoni, Levi, Yuda, Isaka, na Sebuloni.

english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
translation: Bamwana Rakeli ni Yosefu na Benjamini.

english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
translation: Bamwana Bilua umusha wakwa Rakeli ni Dani na Naftali.

english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
translation: Bamwana Silipa umusha wakwa Leya, ni Gadi na Asheri. Aba e bana abaume abo Yakobo afyele ilyo ali mu calo ca Padani Aramu.

english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
translation: Kabili Yakobo alimine abwelelamo kumwabo kuli wishi Isaki ku Mamure, mupepi na Kiriati Aba, kabili e Hebuloni wine, uku Abrahamu na Isaki baleikala nga beni.

english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
translation: Icite 32:28

english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
translation: Isaki epakuleka umweo. Afwa nokufwa ninshi ali umukote uwa myaka iyingi, epakuya ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Elyo bamwane abaume Esau na Yakobo bamushiika.

english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
translation: Elyo twalaima tuninike ukuya ku Betele eko nkaya kuulila Lesa ubulambo. Lesa alengafwako lyonse ilyo nali mu mafya, kabili konse uko naleya aleba na ine.”

english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
translation: Kanshi nabo epakuleta kuli Yakobo utulubi twabo utwa benafyalo elyo no tumipeto twa ku matwi. Yakobo afishiika mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki ica ku Shekemu.

english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
translation: Elyo batendeka ukuya. Lelo takwali nelyo umo uwakubasupila, pantu umwenso ukufuma kuli Lesa waishile pa bantu abali mu misumba iyabashingulwike.

english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
translation: Yakobo na bantu bonse abali nankwe basuka bafika ku Lusi, e Betele wine mu calo ca Kenani.

english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
translation: Uku kwine eko Yakobo akuula ubulambo. Kabili ainika iyi ncende ishina lya Eli Betele pantu ni pali iyo ine ncende Lesa aisokolwelele kuli ena ilyo alefulumuka kuli munyina Esau.

english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
translation: Elyo Debora umuleshi wakwa Rebeka afwa. Batentemuka bamushiika mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki ica ku Betele. Kanshi epakwinika iyi ncende Aloni Bakuti.

english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
translation: Ilyo Yakobo abwelele ukufuma ku calo ca Padani Aramu, Lesa nakabili alimumonekele, no kupaala alimupaalile.

english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa lupwa lwakwa Esau, ishina limbi ni Edomu.

english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
translation: Aya e mashina ya bana baume bakwa Esau: Ni Elifasi, umwana umwaume uo Esau afyele mu mukashi wakwe Ada, elyo na Reueli, umwana umwaume uo afyele mu mukashi wakwe Basemati.

english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
translation: Abana abaume abakwa Efasi, ni Temani, Oma, Sefo, Gatamu na Kenasi.

english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
translation: Elifasi mwana Esau alikwetepo no mukashi uo ashaupile mu bwinga, ishina lyakwe ni Timuna umo afyele Amaleki. Aba e beshikulu abaume abakwa Ada muka Esau.

english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
translation: Abana abaume abo Reueli afyele ni Nahati, Sera, Shamaya na Misa. Aba e beshikulu bakwa Basemati muka Esau.

english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation: Abana abaume abo Esau afyele mu mukashi wakwe Olibama mwana Ane, kabili mwishikulu wakwa Sibeoni ni Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora.

english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
translation: Aba ebali ifikolwe fya mikowa pa ba mu lupwa lwakwa Esau. Pa bana abaume bakwa Elifasi, ibeli lyakwa Esau, abali fikolwe fya mikowa ni Temani, Oma, Sifo,

english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
translation: Kora, Gatamu na Amaleki. Aba ebali ifikolwe fya mikowa mu lupwa lwakwa Elifasi mu Edomu. Kabili bali beshikulu bakwa Ada.

english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
translation: Pa bana abaume abakwa Reueli mwana Esau, abali fikolwe fya mikowa ni Nahati, Sera, Shamaya na Misa. Aba ebali ifikolwe fya mikowa mu lupwa lwakwa Reueli mu Edomu. Kabili aba bali beshikulu bakwa Basemati muka Esau.

english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
translation: Pa bana abaume abo Esau afyele mu mukashi wakwe Olibama, abali ifikolwe fya mikowa ni Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Aba ebali ifikolwe fya mikowa ifya mu lupwa lwakwa Olibama muka Esau, kabili Olibama ali umwana umwanakashi wakwa Ane.

english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
translation: Aba bonse bali ba mu lupwa lwakwa Esau, ishina limbi Edomu, kabili bali e fikolwe fya mikowa yabo.

english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
translation: Esau aupile abanakashi abena Kenani. Aupile Ada mwana Eloni umwina Hiti, na Olibama mwana Ane, kabili umwishikulu wakwa Sibeoni umwina Hifi.

english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
translation: Aba e bana abaume abakwa Seiri umwina Hori, abaleikala muli cilya calo ni Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ane,

english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
translation: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Aba bonse ni bamwana Seiri abaleikala mu Edomu, e fikolwe fya mikowa ya bena Hori.

english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
translation: Bamwana Lotani abaume ni Hori na Homamu. Nkashi yakwe ena ali ni Timuna.

english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
translation: Bamwana Shobali abaume bali ni Alifani, Manaati, Ebali, Shefo na Onamu.

english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
translation: Bamwana Sibeoni abaume ni Aia na Ane. Uyu Ane eulya wasangile utumfukumfuku twa menshi yakaba mu matololo ilyo alecema bapunda bakwa Sibeoni wishi.

english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
translation: Bamwana Ane bena ni Dishoni na Olibama umwana mwanakashi wakwa Ane.

english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation: Bamwana Dishoni abaume ni Hemudani, Eshibani, Itirani na Kerani.

english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
translation: Bamwana Eseri abaume ni Biluani, Safani na Akani.

english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
translation: Bamwana Dishani abaume ni Usi na Arani.

english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
translation: Elyo abali fikolwe fya mikowa ya bena Hori ni Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ane,

english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
translation: Aupile na Basemati mwana Ishimaeli, kabili e nkashimbiye wakwa Nebaiyoti.

english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
translation: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Aba bantu e fikolwe fya mikowa yabo ukukonka ifyo bayakanikene mu calo ca Seiri.

english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
translation: Ishi e mfumu ishateekelepo mu calo ca Edomu lintu mu Israeli tamulati mube imfumu nangu imo.

english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
translation: Bela umwana umwaume wakwa Beori ali imfumu mu calo ca Edomu. Ishina lya musumba wakwe ni Dinaba.

english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Bela afwile, Yobabu mwana Sera uwafumine ku Bosira ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
translation: Icite 26:34

english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
translation: Ilyo Hushamu afwile, Hadadi mwana Bedadi uwacimfishe abena Midiani mu calo ca Moabu ewamupyene pa bufumu. Ainike umusumba wakwe ishina lya Afiti.

english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Hadadi afwile, Samula uwafumine ku Masireka, ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Samula afwile, Shauli uwafumine ku Rehoboti umusumba uwali pa mumana ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
translation: Ilyo Shauli afwile, Bali Hanani mwana Akibo ewamupyene pa bufumu.

english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
translation: Ilyo Bali Hanani mwana Akibo afwile, Hadadi ewamupyene pa bufumu. Ishina lya musumba wakwe ni Pau. Elyo ishina lya mukashi wakwe ni Metabeli, mwana Matiredi, kabili umwishikulu wakwa Mesabu.

english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
translation: Ada afyele kuli Esau, Elifasi. Basemati nao afyele Reueli,

english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
translation: Abali ifikolwe fya mu lupwa lwakwa Esau ukulingana na mashina ya mikowa yabo ne fitungu fyabo ni Timuna, Alifa, Yeteti,

english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
translation: Olibama, Elaya, Pinoni,

english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
translation: Kenasi, Temani, Mibisa,

english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
translation: Magidieli na Iramu. Kanshi aba e fikolwe fya mikowa ya mu Edomu ukulingana ne fifulo fyabo mu calo baikelemo. Esau wena e cikolwe ca bena Edomu bonse.

english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
translation: elyo Olibama afyele Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Aba e bana abaume Esau afyele mu calo ca Kenani.

english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
translation: Elyo Esau asendele abakashi bakwe, abana abaume na banakashi na bonse aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe, elyo ne fitekwa fyakwe ne nama shonse shimbi ne fintu fyonse anonkele mu calo ca Kenani. Esau epakuya ku calo cimbi icatalwike no kwali Yakobo munyina.

english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
translation: Ifintu bakwete fyalifulishe nganshi icakuti bafilwa ukulaikala pamo. Icalo baleikalamo casuka cacepa ku mulandu wa fitekwa fyabo.

english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
translation: Kanshi Esau, ishina limbi ni Edomu, epakuya ikala mu calo ca mpili isha mu Seiri.

english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
translation: Icite 28:9

english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
translation: Yakobo wena aleikala mu calo ca Kenani umo wishi aikele ngo mweni kale.

english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
translation: Ilyo ashimikilako wishi na bamunyina, wishi alamukalipila ati, “Bushe canshi ico ciloto ulotele, bushe cine cine ine na noko na bamunonko, nifwe tukese kukukwinamina?”

english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
translation: Bamunyina bena bamufimbila, lelo wishi ena aletontonkanyapo lyonse pali uyu mulandu.

english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
translation: Bamunyina kwa Yosefu baile ku Shekemu, eko balecemena ifitekwa fyakwa shibo.

english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
translation: Elyo Israeli aebele Yosefu ati, “Nawishiba ukuti bamunonko balecemena ifitekwa mupepi na ku Shekemu. Kanshi isa nkutumeko.” Yosefu nao ayasuka ati, “epo ndi.”

english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
translation: Israeli amweba ati, “Kanshi kabiyeko uye mona nga bamunonko bali umutende ne fitekwa nga fili bwino, elyo ukabwele ukese nshimikilako.” Israeli ali mwishika lya Hebuloni ilyo amutumine. Awe Yosefu asukile afika ku Shekemu.

english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
translation: Umuntu umo amusanga alelulumba mu mabala. Uyo muntu amwipusha ati, “Bushe finshi ulefwaya?”

english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
translation: Yosefu amwasuka ati, “Ni bamunyinane ebo ndefwaya. Bushe kuti mwanjebako uko balecemena ifitekwa?”

english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
translation: Umuntu ayasuka ati, “Kuno balifumako. Naumfwile balesosa abati, ‘Natuleya ku Dotani.’” Kanshi Yosefu epakuya ukwaile bamunyina, abasanga na ku Dotani.

english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
translation: Awe bamumona akatalamukila ilyo talati afike apo bali, bapangana ukumwipaya.

english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
translation: Balaebana abati, “Ala kalota wa filoto ulya aleisa.

english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa lupwa lwakwa Yakobo. Ilyo Yosefu ali akalumendo aka myaka ikumi limo na cine lubali (17), alecema ifitekwa pamo na bamunyina abaume bamwana Bilua na bamwana Silipa abakashi bakwa wishi. Kabili Yosefu aleisa kukushimikila shibo ifintu ifibi bamunyina balecita.

english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
translation: Aleni natumwipaye, tumupose na mu cilindi cimo pali ifi, elyo tukalande ukuti, ciswango e camulile. Lyena tukamona ifyo ifiloto fyakwe fikatumbula.”

english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
translation: Ilyo Rubeni aumfwile ifi, aesha ukupususha Yosefu kuli bamunyina. Abeba ati, “Awe ukumwipaya kwena iyoo.

english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
translation: Twilofya bumi bwakwe. Muposenifye mu cilindi ici kuno mu matololo, lelo mwimucita cibi nelyo cimo.” Rubeni ico asosele ifyo, nico alefwaya ukumupusushako, elyo amubweseshe kuli wishi.

english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;
translation: Kanshi cilya Yosefu afika kuli bamunyina, bamufuula umwingila uwayemba kabili uwa maboko ayatali uo afwele.

english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
translation: Elyo bamusenda baya muposa mu cilindi. Ico cilindi cali icauma, tamwali amenshi.

english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
translation: Ilyo baikele balelya icakulya, elyo bamona ibumba lya bena Ishimaeli abamakwebo balefuma ku Gileadi. Ingamila shabo shasendele ifipe ifyafina umwali ifinyamuti ifyanunka ubusaka, amafuta yakupangilako umuti, elyo ne finyamuti ifyanunka ubusaka muri ifyo balefitwala ku Egupto.

english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
translation: Yuda epakweba bamunyina ati, “Finshi tukamwenamo nga twaipaya munyinefwe, twafisa nokuti natumwipaya?

english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
translation: Kanshi natumushitishefye ku bena Ishimaeli, twimucita cibi nelyo cimo, kabili kwena ni munyinefwe, mulopa wesu.” Awe bamunyina bamusuminisha.

english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
translation: Kanshi cilya abena Midiani abamakwebo balepita, bamunyina bafumya Yosefu mu cilindi, bamushitisha pa ndalama sha silifa amashekeli amakumi yabili (20) ku bena Ishimaeli, nabo epakumusenda ku Egupto.

english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
translation: Ilyo Rubeni abwelelemo ku cilindi asanga ukuti Yosefu talimo. Kanshi alepaula insalu shakwe.

english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.
translation: Israeli alitemenwe Yosefu ukucila pali bamwane abaume bonse pantu amufyele mu bukote. Eico amubilile umwingila uwayemba, kabili uwa maboko ayatali.

english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
translation: Elyo abwelelamo kuli bamunyina abeba ati, “Umwaice talimo mu cilindi! Bushe ine ndecita shani?”

english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
translation: Elyo baipaya imbushi, babuula no mwingila wakwa Yosefu, batumpika na mu mulopa.

english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”
translation: Babuula umwingila uwayemba uwa maboko ayatali bautwala kuli shibo. Bamweba abati, “Natusanga uyu mwingila. Ceceteni mumone nga mwingila wa mwana wenu?”

english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
translation: Israeli nao awishiba, ati, nokuti, “Ee mwingila wa mwana wandi! Iciswango cimo icikali nacimwipaya no kumulya nacimulya. Cine cinefye iciswango nacilepaula Yosefu.”

english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
translation: Elyo Yakobo alepula ifyakufwala fyakwe, afwala insalu shabulanda . Kabili amuloosha pa nshikufye ishingi.

english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
translation: Abana bakwe bonse abaume na banakashi baisa kukumutalalika umutima, lelo akaana ukutalalikwa. Abeba ati, “Ndekeni, nakulalooshafye mpaka nkaye ku calo ca bafwa, nkaye ku mwana wandi.” Kanshi efyo wishi alooseshe mwane Yosefu.

english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
translation: Mu nshita iyo, ninshi abena Midiani balishitisha Yosefu mu Egupto kuli Potifa cilolo umo uwakwa Farao uwali kangalila wa fita fyakulonda kwisano.

english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
translation: Ilyo bamunyina bamwene ukuti eo shibo atemenwe ukucila pali bonse, awe bamupata, kabili tekumusosha ne shiwi lisuma iyoo.

english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
translation: Ubushiku bumo, Yosefu alilotele iciloto. Ilyo ashimikileko bamunyina, awe bena elyo bacilileko ukumupata.

english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
translation: Abebele ati, “Umfweniko iciloto ndotele.

english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
translation: Twaciba tulekaka imyanshi ya ŋanu mwibala. Awe umwanshi wandi waima, waiminina. Elyo imyanshi yenu yashinguluka umwanshi wandi, yawinamina.”

english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
translation: Bamunyina bamweba abati, “Bushe iwe niwe ukaba imfumu yesu? Bushe iwe niwe ukalatuteeka mwa?” Kanshi bena epakumupata nganshi, pa mulandu wa ciloto cakwe na pafyo alandile.

english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
translation: Nakabili Yosefu alilotelele iciloto ashimikilako na bamunyina. Abeba ati, “Umfweniko, nacilota iciloto na cimbi. Ili lyena akasuba no mweshi ne ntanda ikumi limo na lumo fyacilanjinamina.”

english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
translation: Pa nshita ilya, Yuda alifumine kuli bamunyina, atentemuka aya kukwikala no muntu umo umwina Adulamu, ishina lyakwe ni Hira.

english: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.
translation: Ici cintu alecita tacasansamwishe Yawe. Kanshi Yawe epakumulenga ukuti nao afwe.

english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
translation: Yuda epakweba Tama nafyala ati, “Kanshi kuti waikala nga mukamfwilwa ifyo fine kumwenu kuli bawiso, mpaka umwana wandi Shela akakule.” Alandile ifyo, ico aletiina ukuti nalimo nao kuti afwa nga bamunyina, kanshi Tama epakuya aya ikala kuli bawishi.

english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
translation: Panuma ya nshita itali muka Yuda mwana Shua aisa fwa. Cilya inshita yakuloosha yapwa, Yuda epakwima aya ku Timuna ku bantu abalebeya impaanga shakwe amasako. Aile na cibusa wakwe Hira umwina Adulamu.

english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
translation: Ilyo abantu baeba Tama abati, “Sofyala alaya ku Timuna kukubeya impaanga shakwe,”

english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
translation: Tama afuula insalu shabumukamfwilwa, aifimba ne citambala pakuti eishibikwa. Elyo aikala pa mpongolo ya ku Enaimu iyabela ku musebo walola ku Timuna, pantu Tama alimwene ukuti nangu Shela nomba nakula, lelo Yuda tamuufishe kuli Shela pakuti abe umukashi wakwe.

english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
translation: Ilyo Yuda amwene Tama, wena alatontonkanya ukuti ni cilende, pantu Tama alifimbile ku menso yakwe.

english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
translation: Awe Yuda aya ukwali Tama mumbali ya musebo, pantu taishibe ukuti ni nafyala. Yuda amweba ati, “Ale, ndefwaya tulale nobe.” Nao Tama amwipusha ati, “Finshi ulempeela pakulala nobe?”

english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
translation: Yuda amwasuka ati, “Ndeya kutumina akana ka mbushi pa fitekwa fyandi.” Tama amwasuka ati, “Bushe tawampeeleko icintu cimo icakuba icikatilo, mpaka ukatume akabushi?”

english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
translation: Yuda ati, “Bushe cikatilo nshi ndekupeela?” Tama ayasuka ati, “Ni nshimbi yobe iyakufwatikilako no mwando waiko, elyo ne nkonto iyo mu minwe yobe.” Yuda apeela ifi fyonse kuli Tama, elyo alala nankwe. Kanshi Tama epakwimita pa mulandu wakulala na Yuda.

english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
translation: Elyo aimapo aya nokuya. Afuula icitambala cakwe, afwala nakabili insalu shabumukamfwilwa.

english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
translation: Kulya kuntu eko Yuda amwene umukashana mwana Shua umwina Kenani. Awe amuupa no kulala balala nankwe.

english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
translation: Yuda alibuulile akana ka mbushi akapeela kuli cibusa wakwe umwina Adulamu pakuti aye mupokela ku mwanakashi ifyo ashile nge cikatilo, lelo tamusangile.

english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
translation: Elyo aipusha abantu ba kulya kuntu ali ati, “Bushe ulya cilende wa ku mfuba aciba mu mbali ya musebo pa mpongolo ya ku Enaimu ali kwi?” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Awe kuno takwaba cilende wa ku mfuba.”

english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
translation: Kanshi cibusa wakwe abwelela kuli Yuda amweba ati, “Awe nshimusangile. Kabili na bantu bekala kulya kwine basosele abati ‘Kuno takwaba cilende wa ku mfuba.’”

english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
translation: Elyo Yuda asosa ati, “Kafisunge pantu kuti twasebaninapofye. Kabili nacimutumina akana ka mbushi, lelo tawacimusangakofye.”

english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
translation: Papitile nalimo imyeshi itatu, elyo baishile eba Yuda abati, “Nokofyala Tama ni cilende. Kabili ali ne fumo lya mu bulalelale.” Yuda epakusosa ati, “Mufumisheni panse mumoce afwe.”

english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
translation: Cilya balamufumisha panse Tama atuma amashiwi kuli shifyala Yuda ati, “Ili fumo ndi nalyo, lyafuma ku mwine wa ifi fintu. Moneni nga kuti mwamwishiba umwine wa nshimbi yakufwatikilako no mwando waiko elyo ne nkonto.”

english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
translation: Awe Yuda afishiba, asosa nokuti, “Tama nalungika ukucila ine, pantu nshamupeela mwana wandi Shela ukuti amuupe.” Kanshi tatalile alala na Tama nakabili.

english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
translation: Ilyo inshita yakupaapa yafikile, mwifumo lyakwa Tama mwali abana abaume babili, bampundu.

english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
translation: Ilyo acili pakupaapa, mpundu umo afumisha ukuboko panse. Nacimbusa abuula ubushishi ubwakashika cee akaka ku kuboko elyo asosa ati, “Uyu ewabalilapo ukufyalwa.”

english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
translation: Lelo umwana abweseshamo ukuboko na munyina ewaisa fuma. Nacimbusa epakusosa ati, “Yangu efyo waipekela apakufumina!” Kanshi epakumwimika ishina lya Peresi.

english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
translation: Umukashana asuka aba pabukulu, afyala no mwana umwaume. Yuda amwinika ne shina lya Ere.

english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
translation: Elyo munyina uwali no bushishi bwakashika cee ku kuboko nao afyalwa, wena bamwinika ishina lya Sera.

english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
translation: Kabili muka Yuda aba pabukulu, afyala no mwana umwaume. Wena amwinika ishina lya Onani.

english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
translation: Nakabili aisa fyala na umbi umwana umwaume, wena amwinika ishina lya Shela. Uyu mwana afyalilwe mu Kesibu.

english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
translation: Yuda afwaile Ere ibeli lyakwe umwanakashi wakuupa, ne shina lya mwanakashi ni Tama.

english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.
translation: Lelo Ere ibeli lyakwa Yuda alibifya pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kanshi Yawe epakumulenga ukuti afwe.

english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
translation: Elyo Yuda epakweba Onani ati, “Kabiye kuli bukwe bobe upyane munonko, pakuti ufikilishe umulimo obe uwakufyalilako munonko abana.”

english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
translation: Onani ico aishiba ukuti abana tabakabe abana bakwe kanshi lyonse ilyo alala na muka munyina alapemena panshi pakuti ekafyalila munyina bana.

english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
translation: Ilyo basendele Yosefu ku Egupto, Potifa umwina Egupto e wamushitile ku bena Ishimaeli abamuletele kulya. Potifa ali umo pa babomfi bakwa Farao, kabili ali kangalila wa fita fyalelonda kwisano.

english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
translation: Lelo nangu muka Potifa abikilepofye ukulansha Yosefu cila bushiku, Yosefu wena alekaana ukulala nankwe nangufye ukuba nankwe.

english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
translation: Nomba ubushiku bumo Yosefu aile mu ŋanda kukubombamo imilimo yakwe, elyo mu ŋanda tamwali mubomfi nelyo umo pa babomfi balebombamo.

english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
translation: Muka Potifa epakwikata Yosefu ku cakufwala, amweba ati, “Ale isa, tulale nobe.” Lelo Yosefu amusha ne cakufwala mu minwe, abutukila panse.

english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
translation: Ilyo muka Potifa amona ukuti Yosefu afulumukila panse, lelo asha icakufwala mu minwe yakwe,

english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
translation: muka Potifa aita ababomfi abalebomba mu ŋanda, alabeba ati, “Moneni, uyu Muhibulu bamuleta kuno kukutusebanya. Acisa muno pakuti tulale nankwe, na ine elyo napunda.

english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
translation: Ilyo aumfwa uko napundisha, elyo abutukila panse asha ne cakufwala cakwe apo ndi.”

english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
translation: Muka Potifa asungile icakufwala cakwa Yosefu mpaka nelyo shikulu wakwe abwelele kumwakwe.

english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
translation: Elyo umukashi amushimikila umulandu onse ati, “Ulya Muhibulu umusha waleta, acisa uko naciba kukunsebanya.

english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
translation: Lelo ilyo acumfwa uko napundisha, abutukila panse, asha ne cakufwala cakwe apo naciba.”

english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
translation: Ilyo shikulu wakwa Yosefu aumfwile ifyo umukashi amushimikile ati, “Ifi efyo umusha obe ancitile,” afulwa nganshi.

english: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
translation: Yawe aleba na Yosefu, elyo ali uwashuka muli fyonse alebomba. Kabili aleikala mu ŋanda yakwa shikulu wakwe umwina Egupto.
