translation: Kanshi Yosefu epakulanga wishi na bamunyina apakwikala mu calo ca Egupto. Ukulingana ne fyakonkomeshe Farao, Yosefu abapeela impanga iyawamishepo mu calo ca Egupto, abaputwila mu citungu ca Ramesesi.

english: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.
translation: Kabili Yosefu alapeela ifyakulya kuli wishi na bamunyina na ba lupwa bonse abakwa wishi ukulingana no bwingi bwa bana bakwete.

english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
translation: Nomba ifyakulya mu calo conse tamwali pantu icipowe calikulishe nganshi. Abantu mu calo ca Egupto na mu calo ca Kenani amaka yalacepelakofye ku mulandu wa cipowe.

english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
translation: Yosefu alelonganika indalama isho abantu ba mu Egupto na ba mu Kenani baleshitamo iŋanu. Kabili aletwala ishi ndalama kwisano kwa Farao.

english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
translation: Ilyo indalama abena Egupto na bena Kenani shapwile, abena Egupto bonse epakwisa kuli Yosefu, bamweba abati, “Tupeeleko ifyakulya. Bushe cinshi twingafwila na iwe ulemonako? Ifwe indalama nashipwa.”

english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
translation: Yosefu abasuka ati, “Apo indalama shipwile, kanshi akuleteni ifitekwa fyenu, twakulakabushanya ifitekwa fyenu ne fyakulya.”

english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
translation: Kanshi abantu nabo balaleta ifitekwa fyabo kuli Yosefu, bakabalwe, impaanga, imbushi, iŋombe na bapunda, elyo nao alebapeelelapo ifyakulya. Kanshi uyo mwaka onse wena alebapeela ifyakulya mukukabushanya nabo ne fitekwa fyabo.

english: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.
translation: Ilyo uyo mwaka wapwile, umwaka wakonkelepo abantu balishile kuli Yosefu, bamweba abati, “Shikulu tekuti tukufise, indalama ifwe shalipwa ne fitekwa fyesu niwe wakwata. Kanshi ifwe shikulu, tatukwete nelyo cimo icishele kanofye ifwe bene na mabala yesu.

english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”
translation: Cinshi twingalobela pamo na mabala yesu, na iwe ulemonako? Kanshi tushite na mabala yesu pa fyakulya uletupeela elyo ifwe tukaba abasha bakwa Farao na mabala yesu nao yakaba yakwe. Tupeeleko imbuto pakuti tube abomi twikafwa ku nsala na mabala yesu yelasapilwafye.”

english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
translation: Elyo Yosefu abuulapo bamunyina basano (5) abatwala kuli Farao.

english: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.
translation: Kanshi efyo Yosefu ashitile Farao amabala yonse mu calo ca Egupto. Umwina Egupto onse alishitishe amabala yakwe pantu icipowe calibipishe nganshi. Awe casuka icalo conse caba cuma cakwa Farao.

english: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
translation: Abantu bena Yosefu abacita abasha, ukutula ku mupaka umo wa Egupto ukufika na ku ubiye.

english: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.
translation: Amabala ya bashimapepo yena Yosefu tayashitile iyoo, pantu bashimapepo balepoka indalama bali nokupoka kuli Farao. Kanshi emo baleshita ifyakulya balekabila. Eico bashimapepo bena tabashitishe mabala yabo.

english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
translation: Elyo Yosefu aebele abantu ati, “Kanshi lelo nimushita pamo na mabala yenu, eico nomba muli bakwa Farao. Imbuto ishi mubyale mu mabala yenu.

english: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”
translation: Lelo ukulobolola nga kwaisa, mukabuula umufuko umo pa mifuko isano iya fisabo no kupeela kuli Farao. Lelo ifyo fisabo mukashala nafyo fyenu, fikabe e mbuto shakubyala mu mabala elyo kabili efikaba fyakulya fyenu mwe bene ne ndupwa shenu na bana benu.”

english: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
translation: Abantu bamwasuka abati, “Awe namupususha ubumi bwesu. Shikulu, nga twingasanga uluse pa cinso cenu, ifwe tukabafye abasha bakwa Farao.”

english: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
translation: Kanshi Yosefu epakupanga ifunde ilyabako ukufika na lelo ilyo abena Egupto bali nokulakonka. Ili funde lyakuti umwina Egupto onse ali nokupeela kuli Farao icipande cimo pa fipande fisano fya fisabo fyonse alobolola. Amabala ya bashimapepo yena eyashasangwike amabala yakwa Farao.

english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
translation: Abena Israeli baikele mu Egupto mu mpanga ya Gosheni. Muli iyi mpanga abena Israeli balinonkelemo ifyuma, kabili basanda, bafula nganshi.

english: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
translation: Yakobo aikele mu calo ca Egupto imyaka ikumi limo na cine lubali (17), kabili ali ne myaka yakufyalwa umwanda umo na makumi yane na cine lubali (147).

english: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
translation: Ilyo inshita ya kufwa kwakwa Israeli yapaleme, aitile mwane Yosefu, amweba ati, “Nga cingakusekesha, pisha ukuboko kobe mwisamba lye tanta lyandi ulape ukuti ukankwatila uluse ne cishinka. Wikanshiika muno Egupto.

english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”
translation: Farao aipusha bamunyina Yosefu ati, “Mulimo nshi mubomba?” Nabo bayasuka Farao abati, “Ababomfi bobe ni bakacema, pamofye nge fyali ifikolwe fyesu.”

english: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”
translation: Ilyo nkaya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyandi, mukamfumye muno mu Egupto mukaye nshiika ukwashiikwa ifikolwe fyandi.” Yosefu amweba ati, “Nkacita ngefyo mwalanda.”

english: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
translation: Israeli amweba ati, “Kanshi lapa.” Awe Yosefu nao alapa. Elyo Israeli akontamina ku mitwe ya busanshi bwakwe.

english: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
translation: Kabili bamweba nokuti, “Twishile kukwikala kuno nga beni, pantu mu Kenani muli icipowe icabipisha, na babomfi benu tabakwete kwakucemena ifitekwa. Kanshi twapapata lekeni ababomfi benu bekaleko mu Gosheni.”

english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.
translation: Farao epakweba Yosefu ati, “Bawiso na bamunonko beshile kuli iwe.

english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”
translation: Cino calo ca Egupto calo cobe, kanshi kuti waleka bawiso na bamunonko baikala mu mpanga iyawamishapo. Leka bekale mu Gosheni mwine. Kabili nga nawishiba ukuti palipo bamo abacenjela mukusunga ifitekwa, ubebe balensungilako ifitekwa fyandi.”

english: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
translation: Kabili Yosefu aile buula wishi, amutwala kuli Farao. Elyo Yakobo apaala Farao.

english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
translation: Farao aipusha Yakobo ati, “Bushe uli ne myaka inga?”

english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
translation: Yakobo ayasuka Farao ati, “Imyaka yandi iyakuseuluka ngo mweni pano isonde ili umwanda umo na makumi yatatu (130), nayo inono kabili iya macushi. Tekuti ilingane ne myaka iyakuseuluka kwa fikolwe fyandi.”

english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translation: Pati papite inshita elyo baishile eba Yosefu abati, “Bawiso balwele.” Elyo Yosefu abuula bamwane babili abaume, Manase na Efulemu, aya nabo.

english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
translation: Nomba Israeli alefifitilafye ku mulandu wa bukote, alemonafye panono. Kanshi Yosefu aleta bamwane abapalamika kuli wishi. Wishi nao abatomona pakubaposha, kabili abafukatila.

english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
translation: Elyo Israeli aeba Yosefu ati, “Nshalesubila nelyo panono ukumona icinso cobe nakabili, lelo nomba Lesa nalenga ukuti mone na bamwano bene.”

english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
translation: Elyo Yosefu afumya bamwane mu ceni cakwa Israeli, akontamina panshi.

english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
translation: Kabili Yosefu alibuulile bamwane bonse babili. Efulemu amupisha ku kulyo kwakwe pakuti alungatane no kuboko kwa kuso ukwakwa Israeli. Manase nao amupisha ku kuso kwakwe, pakuti alungatane no kuboko kwa kulyo ukwakwa Israeli. Elyo abapalamika kuli Israeli.

english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
translation: Lelo Israeli apusanya amaboko yakwe. Kanshi epakubika icisansa cakwe ica ku kulyo pa mutwe wakwa Efulemu, nangu ali e mwaice bantu. Elyo icisansa cakwe ica ku kuso cena acibika pa mutwe wakwa Manase nangu Manase ali e beli.

english: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
translation: Elyo apaala Yosefu ati,

english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
translation: Icite 5:16-19

english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
translation: Ilyo Yosefu amwene ukuti wishi abikile icisansa cakwe ica ku kulyo pa mutwe wakwa Efulemu, tacamusansamwishe iyoo. Kanshi epakwikata ukuboko kwakwa wishi ukuti akufumye pa mutwe wakwa Efulemu, elyo akubike pa mutwe wakwa Manase.

english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”
translation: Yosefu aeba wishi ati, “Iyoo tata, uyu e beli, eo mubike pa mutwe wakwe icisansa cenu ica ku kulyo.”

english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”
translation: Lelo wishi akaana ati, “Ninjishiba mwana wandi, ala ninjishiba. Manase nao wine akaba umushobo, kabili uukulu. Lelo kwena, uwamwaice Efulemu akacindamapo ukucila uwamukalamba. Kabili aba mu lupwa lwakwe bena bakaba imishobo iyingi.”

english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.
translation: Cilya baeba Yakobo abati, “Mwano Yosefu aisa kukukumona,” Israeli aikoselesha aikala na pa busanshi.

english: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.
translation: Kanshi epakubapaala ubo bwine bushiku ati,

english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
translation: Bahi 11:21

english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
translation: Lelo pafyo bamunonko bapoka, iwe nakulundilapo icalo ca lupili ico napokele ku lupanga lwandi no buta bwandi ku bena Amoli.”

english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
translation: Elyo Yakobo alaeba Yosefu ati, “Lesa Umwine wa maka yonse alimonekele ku Lusi mu calo ca Kenani, elyo no kumpaala alimpaalile.

english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
translation: Kabili anjebele nokuti, ‘Nkakulenga ukusanda no kufula. Nkakulenga ukuba ibumba lya mishobo iyingi. Kabili nkapeela ici calo ku bana bobe abali nokukukonkapo ukuti cikaleba icalo cabo lyonsefye.’

english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.
translation: Kanshi abana benu abaume babili abo wafyele muno Egupto nshilati njise kuno, nabo nomba bana bandi. Efulemu na Manase bakulaba abana bandi kwati nifi fyaba abana bandi Rubeni na Simeoni.

english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
translation: Lelo abana bambi abo wafyala panuma ya aba, bena bana bobe. Abo bena bakapokela ifyacishilano mu mashina ya bamunyina, Efulemu na Manase.

english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”
translation: Pantu naliketwe no bulanda ilyo nalefuma ku calo ca Padani Aramu. Ni pali ubo bulendo elyo Rakeli afwile ninshi tulifye mupepi na ku Efulata. Kanshi namushiikile kulya kwine mumbali ya musebo uwalola ku Efulata, e Betelemu wine.”

english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”
translation: Ilyo Israeli amwene bamwana Yosefu abaume, aipwishe ati, “Nga aba ni bani?”

english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”
translation: Yosefu aeba wishi ati, “Aba bana bandi Lesa ampeela kuno.” Elyo Israeli asosa ati, “Balete kuno uleke mbapaale.”

english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
translation: Elyo Yakobo aitile bamwane abaume, abeba ati, “Palameni kuno pakuti mwebeko ifili nokumufikila mu nshiku ishileisa.

english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
translation: Yuda tapakabe wakukupoka ubufumu,

english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
translation: Akalakakila umusepela wa punda wakwe ku mwangashi,

english: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
translation: Amenso yakwe yakakashikapo pa mwangashi,

english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
translation: “Sebuloni akalaikala mu lulamba lwa bemba,

english: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
translation: “Isaka ni punda uwakosa,

english: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
translation: Ilyo amona ukuti ni ncende isuma apakutuushisha,

english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
translation: “Dani akapingwila abantu bakwe,

english: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
translation: Dani akaba ni nsoka ya mumbali ya musebo,

english: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.
translation: “Ine mpembela ipusukilo lyobe, we Yawe.

english: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
translation: “Gadi, ibumba lya bapupu likamusansa,

english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
translation: “Mwe bamwana Yakobo, longaneni, mumfwe,

english: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
translation: “Asheri, ifyakulya fyakwe fikaba ifyanona,

english: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
translation: “Naftali, ni nsebula iyiyendelafye,

english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
translation: “Yosefu mwangashi uutwalisha,

english: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
translation: Aba mata bamulwishishe bukali bukali

english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
translation: Lelo ubuta bwakwe tabuteletenta,

english: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
translation: Pantu ni Lesa wakwa wiso eukwafwako iwe,

english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
translation: Amapaalo yakwa wiso yamaka

english: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
translation: “Benjamini, mumbulu ukali.

english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
translation: Kanshi aba bonse e fikolwe fya nko ikumi limo na shibili (12) isha bena Israeli. Kabili aya e mashiwi shibo Yakobo abebele ilyo alebapaala. Cila muntu apaalilwe ne paalo ilyamulingile.

english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
translation: Elyo Yakobo akonkomeshe bamwane ati, “Ine nomba nalaya ukwaba ifikolwe fyandi. Mukanshiike ukwalala ifikolwe fyandi mu lucengo ulwaba mwibala lyakwa Efuloni umwina Hiti.

english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
translation: “Rubeni, niwe beli lyandi,

english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
translation: Ulu lucengo lwaba mwibala lya Makipela mupepi na ku Mamure, mu calo ca Kenani. Abrahamu ashitile ulu lucengo pamo ne bala line kuli Efuloni umwina Hiti, pakuti akwate incende ya nshinshi.

english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
translation: Eko bashiika Abrahamu no mukashi wakwe Sara, kabili ekwashiikwa Isaki no mukashi wakwe Rebeka. Elyo na ine kulya kwine eko nashiika Leya.

english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
translation: Ibala no lucengo lwabamo fyashitilwe ku bena Hiti.”

english: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
translation: Cilya Yakobo apwa ukukonkomesha bamwane, abwesesha amakasa yakwe pa busanshi, aleka no mweo, aya ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe.

english: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
translation: Usunkana nga menshi pali bemba, lelo teiwe ukacindamisha,

english: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
translation: “Simeoni na Levi bana ba mano yamo yene,

english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
translation: Ine tekuti njibike mu mapange yabo.

english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
translation: Ubukali bwabo nabulapishiwa pantu bwacilamo,

english: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
translation: “Yuda, bamunonko bakalakutasha.

english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
translation: We Yuda, uli mwana wa nkalamo,

english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”
translation: Adamu akumene no mukashi wakwe Efa, nao aimita elyo apaapa umwana ishina lyakwe ni Kaini . Efa epakusosa ati, “Ku bwafwilisho bwakwa Yawe nimpokelela umwana umwaume.”

english: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
translation: Yawe amweba ati, “Cinshi ucitile? Umfwa! Umulopa wakwa munonko ulepunda kuli ine ukufuma ku mushili.

english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
translation: Nomba walapishiwa, kabili watamfiwa pa mushili upokelele umulopa wakwa munonko iminwe yobe isumishe.

english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
translation: Yoani 3:12

english: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
translation: Kaini epakweba Yawe ati, “Uku kukandwa kwankosela nganshi.

english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
translation: Ilelo wantamfya pa calo, kabili nshili na kumonekela pa cinso cobe. Nakulalulumbafye ukwabula ukutuusha pesonde, na onse uukankumanya akanjipaya.”

english: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
translation: Lelo Yawe amwasuka ati, “Awe iyoo. Nga cakuti umuntu aipaya Kaini, akacula ku cilandushi candi imiku cine lubali.” Kanshi Yawe epakubika icishibilo pali Kaini pakuti onse uwamukumanya tamwipeye.

english: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
translation: Kaini epakufuma pa cinso cakwa Yawe, aya ikala mu calo ca Nodi ku kabanga ka Edeni.

english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
translation: Kaini akumene no mukashi wakwe, nao aimita, elyo apaapa no mwana ishina lyakwe ni Enoki. Elyo Kaini akuula umusumba awinika ne shina lyakwa mwane Enoki.

english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
translation: Enoki ewafyele Iradi. Elyo Iradi e wishi wakwa Meuyaeli. Meuyaeli nao e wishi wakwa Metushaeli, elyo Metushaeli e wishi wakwa Lameki.

english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
translation: Lameki aupile abanakashi babili, umo ni Ada elyo umbi ni Sila.

english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
translation: Panuma Efa afyele umwana umwaume Abeli, munyina kwa Kaini. Abeli aleteka ifitekwa, Kaini ena ali mulimi.

english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
translation: Ada ewafyele Yabali. Yabali ali e cikolwe ca bantu abateka ifitekwa, kabili bekala mu matenti.

english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
translation: Munyina kwa Yabali, ishina lyakwe ni Yuba. Yuba e cikolwe ca bakalisha we seese no mutolilo.

english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
translation: Sila ewafyele Tuba Kaini. Tuba Kaini ewalefula ifibombelo fyalekana lekana ifya fyela no mukuba. Nkashi yakwa Tuba Kaini ali ni Naama.

english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
translation: Lameki aebele abakashi bakwe ati,

english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
translation: Bahi 12:24

english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
translation: Adamu akumene no mukashi wakwe nakabili, elyo Efa apaapa umwana umwaume amwinika ne shina lya Seti nokutila, “Lesa nampeelelapo umwana umwaume umbi pali Abeli uo Kaini aipeye.”

english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.
translation: Seti nao afyele umwana umwaume amwinika ne shina lya Enoshi. Ni pa nshita ine ilya elyo abantu batampile ukupepa Yawe.

english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
translation: Mu kuya kwa nshiku, Kaini aletele ifisabo fya mwibala lyakwe ngo mutuulo kuli Yawe.

english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,
translation: Lelo Abeli ena aletele ifyamafuta ya mabeli ya fitekwa fyakwe atuula kuli Yawe. Yawe asekelele muli Abeli no mutuulo wakwe,

english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
translation: lelo tasekelele muli Kaini no mutuulo wakwe. Kanshi Kaini epakufulwa nganshi, aponya ne cinso.

english: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
translation: Elyo Yawe epakweba Kaini ati, “Cinshi ufulilwe? Cinshi icinso cobe ciponene?

english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
translation: Bushe nga wacita icilungeme tekuti upokelelwe? Nomba nga taucitile icilungeme, ninshi ububi nabukulalilila pa mwinshi obe, bulefwaya iwe, lelo ufwile ukubucimfya.”

english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
translation: Elyo Kaini aebele munyina Abeli ati, “Natuleya mu mpanga.” Ilyo bacili mu mpanga, Kaini afukukila munyina amwipaya.

english: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
translation: Elyo Yawe aipusha Kaini ati, “Bushe munonko Abeli ali kwi?” Kaini ayasuka ati, “Nshishibe iyoo! Bushe nine kasunga wakwa munyinane?”

english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
translation: Elyo Yosefu akumbatile wishi alelila, amutomona pakuloosha.

english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
translation: Ilyo bafikile pa lubansa lwa Atadi ulo balepuminapo iŋanu ulwali mupepi na ku mumana wa Yordani, bateka icililo, baloosha apakalamba no kulila nganshi. Yosefu ateka icililo ca nshiku cine lubali pakuloosha wishi.

english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
translation: Ilyo abena Kenani abaleikala kulya bamona icililo batekele mu lubansa lwa Atadi ulwakupuminapo iŋanu, balasosa abati, “Abena Egupto nabateka icililo icikalamba nganshi.” Kanshi eico bainikile iyi ncende ishina lya Abeli Misraimu.

english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
translation: Kanshi bamwana Yakobo bacitile fyonse ngefyo shibo abakonkomeshe.

english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
translation: Balisendele icitumbi cakwe ku calo ca Kenani. Bacishiika na mu lucengo lwa mwibala lya Makipela mupepi na ku Mamure. E lucengo pamo pene ne bala Abrahamu ashitile kuli Efuloni umwina Hiti pakuti akwate incende ya nshinshi.

english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
translation: Panuma yakushiika wishi, Yosefu alibwelelemo ku Egupto pamo pene na bamunyina na bantu bambi bonse abaile nankwe kukushiika wishi.

english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
translation: Ilyo bamunyina kwa Yosefu bamwene ukuti shibo afwa, balalanda abati, “Cikaba shani nga cakuti Yosefu atupata, alafwaya no kuilandula pa fibi twamucitile?”

english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
translation: Imili 7:16

english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
translation: mukebe Yosefu amuti, ‘Nakupapata belela bamunonko uluse pa filubo bakulufyenye na pa bubi bacitile kuli iwe.’ Kanshi twapapata belela uluse ababomfi bakwa Lesa wa bawiso ububi bwabo.” Ilyo Yosefu apokelele aya mashiwi, awe alalila no kulila.

english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
translation: Elyo bamunyina baishile kuli Yosefu baiposa panshi, bamweba abati, “Ifwe tuli basha bobe.”

english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
translation: Lelo Yosefu abeba ati, “Iyoo, mwitiina. Bushe ine kuti naba pa malo yakwa Lesa?

english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
translation: Kabili Yosefu akonkomesha bashiŋanga abalemubombela ukuti bomike icitumbi cakwa wishi. Kanshi efyo bashiŋanga baumike icitumbi cakwa Israeli.

english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
translation: Kwena imwe mwali na mapange yakuncita icibi, lelo Lesa wena ali na mapange yakucita icisuma ukupususha ubumi bwa bantu abengi ngefi fine cilecitika nomba.

english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
translation: Kanshi mwilatiina nelyo cimo. Nine wine nakulamufwaila ifyakulya imwe na bana benu.” Efyo Yosefu abatekele imitima mukubalandila amashiwi ayasuma.

english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
translation: Yosefu aikele mu Egupto pamo pene na bonse ba lupwa lwakwa wishi. Aikele umumi imyaka umwanda umo ne kumi limo (110).

english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
translation: Yosefu amwene abana bakwa Efulemu na beshikulu bakwa Efulemu bene. Ilyo bamwana Makiri umwana wakwa Manase balefyalwa, Yosefu alebapokelela no kubateka pa molu yakwe.

english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
translation: Kabili Yosefu aebele bamunyina ati, “Ine nomba ndi mupepi nokufwa. Lelo Lesa cine cine akesa mupempula. Elyo akamufumya muli cino calo, akamutwale na ku calo alaile no mulapopo kuli Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.”

english: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
translation: Kabili Yosefu aebele bamwana Israeli ati, “Lapeni umulapo ukuti cine cine Lesa nga amupempula mukasenda amafupa yandi ukufuma kuno.”

english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
translation: Kanshi Yosefu afwile ninshi ali ne myaka umwanda umo ne kumi limo (110). Elyo panuma yakumika icitumbi cakwe, bacibikile mu mbokoshi ye libwe mu Egupto mwine.

english: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.
translation: Bashiŋanga pakumika icitumbi cakwa Israeli bapwile inshiku ishituntulu amakumi yane (40), pantu e nshiku balepwa pakumika icitumbi. Abena Egupto nabo bapwile inshiku amakumi cine lubali (70) balooshafye Israeli.

english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
translation: Ilyo inshiku shakuloosha Israeli shapwile, Yosefu aebele ababomfi ba kwisano kwa Farao ati, “Nga cingamusekesha, munandileko kuli Farao. Napapata, mumwebe amuti,

english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
translation: ‘Batata banengele ukuti ndape umulapo. Basosele ukuti, “Ine ndi mupepi nokufwa, kanshi ukanshiike mu nindi naimbile ne mwine, mu calo ca Kenani.” Kanshi lekeni nje nkaye shiika batata, elyo nkabwele.’”

english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
translation: Farao ayasuka ati, “Kanshi kabiye uye shiika bawiso, ngefyo walapile kuli bawiso.”

english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
translation: Yosefu kanshi alimine nokulaya kukushiika wishi. Ababomfi bonse bakwa Farao, bacilolo ba kwisano na bacilolo bonse aba mu Egupto balimine baya na Yosefu.

english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
translation: Aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yosefu na bamunyina na bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yakobo nabo baile nankwe. Abashele mu Gosheni bana babo, impaanga ne mbushi shabo ne ŋombe shabo.

english: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.
translation: Abantu ba maceleta na baninine pali bakabalwe nabo bene baile na Yosefu. Kanshi lyali ibumba ilikalamba nganshi.

english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa lupwa lwakwa Adamu.

english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Kenani, Enoshi aikele imyaka imyanda cine konse konse ikumi limo na isano (815), afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Enoshi aikele yali imyanda pabula na isano (905), elyo afwa.

english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
translation: Ilyo Kenani aikele imyaka amakumi cine lubali (70), elyo afyele Mahalale.

english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Mahalale, Kenani aikele imyaka imyanda cine konse konse na makumi yane (840), afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Kenani aikele yali imyanda pabula ne kumi limo (910), elyo afwa.

english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
translation: Ilyo Mahalale aikele imyaka amakumi mutanda na isano (65), afyele Yaledi.

english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Yaledi, Mahalale aikele imyaka imyanda cine konse konse na makumi yatatu (830), afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Mahalale aikele umumi yali imyanda cine konse konse amakumi pabula na isano (895), elyo afwa.

english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
translation: Ilyo Yaledi aikele imyaka umwanda umo amakumi mutanda na ibili (162), afyele Enoki.

english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Enoki, Yaledi aikele imyaka imyanda cine konse konse (800), afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
translation: Ababumbile umwaume no mwanakashi elyo abapaala. Ilyo ababumbile abetile nokuti, “Bantu.”

english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Yaledi aikele yali imyanda pabula amakumi mutanda na ibili (962), elyo afwa.

english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
translation: Ilyo Enoki aikele imyaka amakumi mutanda na isano (65), afyele Metusela.

english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Metusela, Enoki aendele na Lesa pa myaka imyanda itatu (300), kabili afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo iyo Enoki aikele yali imyanda itatu amakumi mutanda na isano (365).

english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
translation: Enoki aendele na Lesa, elyo alekele ukulamoneka, ico Lesa alimusendele.

english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
translation: Ilyo Metusela aikele imyaka umwanda umo amakumi cine konse konse na cine lubali (187), afyele Lameki.

english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Lameki, Metusela aikele imyaka imyanda cine lubali amakumi cine konse konse na ibili (782), kabili afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
translation: Icite 1:27-28

english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
translation: Ilyo Lameki aikele imyaka umwanda umo amakumi cine konse konse na ibili (182), afyele umwana umwaume.

english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
translation: Amwinike ishina lya Noa, asosa ati, “Uyu eukatuletela icitalaliko mu macushi yakubomba ne minwe yesu apo Yawe alilapisha umushili.”

english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
translation: Ilyo Adamu aikele imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yatatu (130) elyo afyele umwana umwaume uwamupala, uwaba mu cata cakwe, amwinika ne shina lya Seti.

english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Panuma ya kufyala Noa, Lameki aikele imyaka imyanda isano amakumi pabula na isano (595), kabili afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo iyo Lameki aikele yali imyanda cine lubali na makumi cine lubali na cine lubali (777), elyo afwa.

english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translation: Panuma Noa ali ne myaka imyanda isano (500), afyele Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.

english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Mateo 19:4

english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Adamu aikele umumi yali imyanda pabula na makumi yatatu (930), elyo afwa.

english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
translation: Mako 10:6

english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translation: Kabili panuma yakufyala Enoshi, Seti aikele umumi imyaka imyanda cine konse konse na cine lubali (807), afyele na bambi abana abaume na banakashi.

english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
translation: Imyaka yonse pamo Seti aikele yali imyanda pabula ne kumi limo na ibili (912), elyo afwa.

english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
translation: Ilyo Enoshi aikele imyaka amakumi pabula (90), afyele Kenani.

english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
translation: Ilyo abantu batendeke ukulafula pesonde, kabili balafyala na bana abanakashi,

english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translation: Noa ali na bana abaume batatu, Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.

english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
translation: Nomba isonde lyalubana pa cinso cakwa Lesa kabili pesonde paiswilefye icimfulunganya.

english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
translation: Lesa amona ifyo isonde lyalubana, pantu abantu bonse pesonde balubana mu mibeele yabo.

english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
translation: Kanshi Lesa epakweba Noa ati, “Ine nalaonaula abantu bonse, pantu isonde liswilemo icimfulunganya pa mulandu wabo. Icine cine ndebonaula bonse pamo ne sonde line.

english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
translation: Iwe uipangile icibwato ica mbao isha miti iyakosa iya saipulasi. Mukati ka cibwato upangemo imiputule. Elyo ushingule amanenekela mukati na kunse ya cibwato.

english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
translation: Ifi efyo uli nokupanga icibwato. Cili nokuba amakubiti imyanda itatu (300) mubutali, mubufumo mwena amakubiti amakumi yasano (50) elyo mukusumbuka namo amakubiti amakumi yatatu (30).

english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
translation: Ukapangilepo umutenge pa cibwato. Elyo mupepi no mutenge ukashemo insolokoto iyilepele kubiti umo ukushinguluka ubwato. Umwinshi ukaubike mu mbali ya cibwato. Ukapange icibwato ica fiputulwa fitatu ifyatuntikana, cimo panshi, cimo pakati elyo na cimo pamulu.

english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.
translation: Nalaleta ilyeshi pano isonde kukonaula conse icabumi pesamba lya mulu, conse icibumbwa icipema. Icintu conse pesonde cikaloba.

english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
translation: Nomba iwe nkapangana nobe icipangano candi. Iwe uli nokwingila mu cibwato pamo na bana bobe abaume, umukashi obe na bakashi ba bana bobe.

english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
translation: Uli nokwingisha mu cibwato ifyabumi fyonse fibili fibili, icilume ne cikota, pakuti ukafisunge ifituntulu.

english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
translation: abana baume bakwa Lesa bamona ukuti abana banakashi aba bantu bali abayemba. Kanshi epakulaupa onse uo umwine alefwaya.

english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.
translation: Pet 3:20

english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”
translation: Ukasende imisango yonse iya fyakulya fyonse ifili nokuliwa, ukafitutile nge fyakulya fyenu elyo nefyo mukaba nafyo.”

english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
translation: Noa epakucita fyonse ifyo Lesa amukonkomeshe.

english: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”
translation: Elyo Yawe atile, “Umupashi wandi tauli nakubelelela ukucushanya no muntu pantu mwinakufwa. Umuntu inshiku shakwe shili nokubafye imyaka umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120).”

english: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
translation: Banefilimu bali pesonde mu nshiku shilya elyo na panuma ilyo abana baume bakwa Lesa baleupa abana abanakashi ba bantu kabili bafyalamo na bana. Bali ni mpalume sha pakale, abantu abalumbwike nganshi.

english: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
translation: Yawe amona ukuti bwafulisha ububi bwa muntu pano isonde, elyo ne mitontonkanishishe mu mutima wakwe nayo ilolelefye lyonse ku bubi.

english: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
translation: Yawe alanguluka pali ico abumbile umuntu pesonde, no mutima wakwe wakalipa.

english: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
translation: Elyo Yawe asosa ati, “Ndi nokulofya ukufuma pano isonde umuntu uo nabumbile pamo pene ne nama, ifikulaika pa mushili ne fyuni fya mu lwelele. Pantu ninanguluka pakufibumba.”

english: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
translation: Lelo Noa asanga ukusekelelwa pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
translation: Ubu e butantiko bwa lupwa lwakwa Noa.

english: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Noa ati, “Ingila mu cibwato, iwe pamo no lupwa lobe lonse pantu ninkusanga ukuba umololoke muli ino nkulo.

english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
translation: Kabili panuma ya nshiku cine lubali (17) ne lyeshi lyaisa pesonde.

english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.
translation: Mu mwaka Noa afikile pa myaka imyanda mutanda (600), pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na cine lubali (17) mu mweshi wabubili, pali bulya bushiku epo utumfukumfuku twa bemba washika twalepwike elyo ne fipunda fyonse mu mulu fyaisuka.

english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
translation: Kabili imfula epakuloka pesonde akasuba no bushiku, inshiku amakumi yane (40).

english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
translation: Pali bulya bwine bushiku Noa, abana bakwe abaume Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti, no mukashi wakwe na bakashi ba bana bakwe batatu baingile mu cibwato.

english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
translation: Baingilemo ne misango yonse iya nama sha mpanga, imisango yonse iya fitekwa, imisango yonse iya fikulaika pa mushili, imisango yonse iya fyuni, elyo ne misango yonse iya fyakwata amapindo.

english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
translation: Kanshi fyonse ifyabumi fibili fibili, icilume ne cikota fyaingile na Noa mu cibwato.

english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.
translation: Kanshi inama ishaingile mu cibwato shali ishilume ne shikota mu misango yonse iya fyabumi ngefyo Lesa akonkomeshe Noa. Elyo Yawe amwisalila mu cibwato.

english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
translation: Pa nshiku amakumi yane, amenshi yakonkenyepofye ukufulilako pesonde. Kabili ilyo amenshi yasuka yafula, yaimya icibwato calaelela pamulu.

english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
translation: Amenshi yalafulilako ukwimina pa mulu we sonde ne cibwato calaelela pa menshi.

english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
translation: Kanshi amenshi yaima icine cine pa mulu we sonde icakuti ne mpili shonse ishalepa pesamba lya mulu shasukile shaibila.

english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
translation: Pa nama ishishakowela ubuule pali cila musango washiko ishilume cine lubali ne shikota nasho cine lubali. Pa nama ishakowela ubuule pali cila musango washiko inama shibili, iyilume ne ikota.

english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
translation: Amenshi yakonkenyepofye ukwima yasukile yacila pa mpili ishaibile mu menshi amakubiti ikumi limo na yasano (15).

english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
translation: Kanshi ifintu fyonse ifyabumi ifyenda pesonde fyaloba, ifyuni, ifitekwa, inama sha mpanga, fyonse ifikulaika pa mushili na bantu bonse.

english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
translation: Ifintu fyonse ifikala ku mulundu, ifipemena mu myona umupu wabumi fyafwa.

english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
translation: Kanshi Lesa aonawile pesonde ifintu fyonse ifyaba no bumi, umuntu, inama, ifikulaika pa mushili ne fyuni fya mu lwelele, fyonse alifyonawile pesonde. Abashelepofye ni Noa nabo ali nabo mu cibwato.

english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
translation: Ilyeshi lyaiswile pesonde inshiku umwanda umo na makumi yasano (150).

english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
translation: Kabili pa misango yonse iya fyuni, ubuule pali cila musango wafiko ifilume cine lubali ne fikota cine lubali. Uli nokucita ifi pakufisunga ifituntulu cila musango wafiko pesonde lyonse.

english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
translation: Kwashala inshiku cine lubali elyo nkalokesha imfula pesonde pa nshiku amakumi yane, ikalaloka akasuba no bushiku. Efyo nkonaula ifintu fyonse mpanga yonse pano isonde ifyo nabumbile.”

english: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.
translation: Kabili Noa acitile fyonse ifyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
translation: Noa ali ne myaka imyanda mutanda (600) ilyo ilyeshi lyaishile pesonde.

english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
translation: Noa, abana bakwe abaume, umukashi wakwe na bakashi ba bana bakwe baingile mu cibwato pakupusuka ku menshi ye lyeshi.

english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
translation: Inama shibili shibili ishishakowela ne shakowela, ifyuni ne fikulaika pa mushili fibili fibili mu musango wafiko,

english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
translation: icilume ne cikota, fyaisa kuli Noa, fyaingila mu cibwato ngefyo Lesa akonkomeshe Noa.

english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
translation: Lelo Lesa aibukishe Noa ne nama shonse isha mpanga ne fitekwa fyonse ifyali nankwe mu cibwato. Elyo aimya icimwela calapupa pesonde, na menshi yalacepa.

english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
translation: Noa apembelako na shimbi inshiku cine lubali elyo nakabili atuma inkunda ukufuma mu cibwato.

english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
translation: Ilyo inkunda yabwela mu cungulo, moneni ku mulomo waiko yabwela ili no lulembelya lwa miolifa! Elyo Noa aishiba ukuti kanshi amenshi nayakama pesonde.

english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
translation: Kabili Noa apembelako inshiku na shimbi cine lubali elyo nakabili atuma inkunda, lelo uyu muku wena tayabwelele iyoo.

english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
translation: Kanshi amenshi yakamine pesonde pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi mu mweshi wakubalilapo ilyo Noa ali ne myaka imyanda mutanda na umo (601). Elyo Noa afumyapo umutenge pa cibwato, amona nokuti umushili nauma.

english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na cine lubali (27) mu mweshi walenga ibili, lyena umushili waumafye ndi.

english: God spoke to Noah, saying,
translation: Elyo Lesa aebele Noa ati,

english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
translation: “Fuma mu cibwato, iwe no mukashi obe, abana bobe abaume na bakashi babo.

english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
translation: Fumya mu cibwato fyonse ifyabumi ifyo uli nafyo, ifyuni, inama na fyonse ifikulaika pa mushili, pakuti filefyalana, fisande, fifule nganshi pesonde.”

english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
translation: Kanshi Noa epakufuma mu cibwato pamo na bana bakwe abaume, umukashi wakwe na bakashi ba bana bakwe.

english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
translation: Inama shonse na fyonse ifikulaika pa mushili, ifyuni fyonse na fyonse ifyenda pesonde fyafuma mu cibwato mu misango yafiko.

english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
translation: Pali iyi nshita utumfukumfuku twali muli bemba washika ne fipunda fya mu mulu fyacilikwa, ne mfula yaleka ukuloka ukufuma mu mulu.

english: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
translation: Elyo Noa akuulile Yawe ubulambo, abuulapo inama shimo pa shishakowela ne fyuni ifishakowela, afituula nge lambo lyakoca pa bulambo.

english: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
translation: Yawe aumfwa ukuti cena icisuma icakusekesha, asosa mu mutima wakwe ati, “Nshakatale nakabili ndapisha umushili pa mulandu wa muntu, nangu imitontonkanishe ya mu mutima wakwe yabipa ukufuma ku bwaice bwakwe. Kanshi nshakatale mbwekeshapo nakabili ukonaula ifyabumi fyonse ngefi ncitile.

english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
translation: “Inshita yonse ilyo isonde likabako,

english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
translation: Amenshi pesonde yalakama buce buce. Panuma ya nshiku umwanda umo na makumi yasano (150) amenshi yasuka yacepa.

english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalengele ikumi limo na cine lubali (17), mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, elyo icibwato caya ikala pa mpili sha Ararati.

english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
translation: Amenshi yakonkenyepo ukukama mpaka na mu mweshi walenga ikumi. Elyo pa bushiku bwakubalilapo mu mweshi walenga ikumi, pa mulu wa mpili patampa ukumoneka.

english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
translation: Panuma ya nshiku amakumi yane (40), Noa aisula insolokoto apangile mu cibwato,

english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
translation: elyo atuma mwankole, alapupukafye, aleti aya kabili abwela mpaka nelyo amenshi yakamine pa mushili.

english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
translation: Kabili Noa atuma inkunda pakuti imone amenshi nga nayakama pa mushili.

english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
translation: Nomba inkunda yafilwa ukusanga apakwikala, pantu amenshi ninshi yalifye mpanga yonse pesonde. Kanshi inkunda epakubwelela kuli Noa mu cibwato. Noa nao epakutambika ukuboko, aikata inkunda, aingisha na mu cibwato umo ali.

english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
translation: Elyo Lesa apaalile Noa na bana bakwe abaume, abeba ati, “Fyalaneni, mufule, mwisushe isonde.

english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
translation: Ine napangana na imwe icipangano ukuti, ifyaba no bumi fyonse tafyakatale afyonaulwa ku menshi ye lyeshi nakabili. Kabili takwakatale akuba ilyeshi ilyakonaula isonde.”

english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
translation: Elyo Lesa atile, “Ici e cishibilo ca cipangano nalapangana na imwe na fyonse ifyabumi ifyo muli nafyo, icipangano cakulabako lyonse umukonkanina inkulo.

english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
translation: Ukuf 20:13

english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
translation: Ilyo lyonse nalonganika amakumbi pa mulu we sonde, no mukolamfula wamoneka mu makumbi,

english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
translation: nakulaibukisha icipangano candi napangana na imwe ne misango yonse iya fyabumi. Amenshi tayakabale nakabili ayaba ilyeshi ilyakonaula ifintu fyonse ifyabumi.

english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
translation: Ilyo lyonse umukolamfula ukalamoneka mu makumbi, ine nkalaumona no kwibukisha icipangano icakubelelela Lesa apangana ne misango yonse iya fyabumi pesonde.”

english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
translation: Elyo Lesa aeba Noa ati, “Ici e cishibilo ca cipangano ico ine napangana ne fyabumi fyonse pesonde.”

english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Noa abo afumine nabo mu cibwato ni Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti. (Hamu e wishi wakwa Kenani).

english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
translation: Aba ebali abana baume batatu abakwa Noa, ni kuli bena ekwatuntuka abantu bonse abasalanganina pesonde.

english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
translation: Inama shonse isha mpanga, ifyuni fyonse ifya mu lwelele, ifyabumi fyonse ifikulaika pa mushili ne sabi lyonse ilya muli bemba, fyakulamukwatila umwenso no kulamutiina. Ifi fyonse nafilubwila mu minwe yenu.

english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
translation: Noa ali mulimi, kabili ewabalilepo ukulima ibala lya myangashi.

english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
translation: Ilyo anweneko umwangashi, alikolelwe, elyo alala ubwamba mwitenti lyakwe.

english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
translation: Hamu wishi wakwa Kenani amwene ukuti wishi ali ubwamba, elyo aebako bamunyina babili abali panse.

english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
translation: Ilyo Noa umwangashi wamukololoka, elyo aumfwa nefyo umwana wakwe uwacepeshepo mu myaka amucitile,

english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
translation: Noa epakutila,

english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
translation: Levi 19:26

english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
translation: Lesa engalundako impanga ku calo cakwa Yafeti .

english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
translation: Icite 1:28

english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
translation: Icite 1:29-30

english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
translation: Fyonse ifyabumi ifyenda fikaba ifyakulya kuli imwe. Namupeela fyonse nga filya fine namupeele imisalu.

english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
translation: Lelo tamufwile ukulya inama umuli umulopa, pantu mu mulopa emwaba ubumi.

english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
translation: “Uyo onse uwasumya umulopa wa muntu,

english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
translation: “Nomba imwe, fyalaneni, musande, mufule nganshi pesonde no kufulilapo.”

english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
translation: Kabili Lesa aebele Noa na bana bakwe abaume ali nabo ati,

english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
translation: “Na ine nomba nalapangana na imwe icipangano pamo na ba mu ndupwa shenu abakafyalwa kuntanshi,

english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
translation: Amashiwi ayo Lesa asokolwele kuli kasesema Habakuku mu cimonwa ni aya.

english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.
translation: Abena Babiloni tepakusuula ishamfumu shimbi,

english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
translation: Ninshi elyo bafulumbana nga kankungwe,

english: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
translation: We Yawe, bushe tewe wabako ukufumafye ku citendekelo. Niwe Lesa wandi, we wamushilo wandi, tatwakafwe iyoo. We Yawe, niwe wasala abena Babiloni kukucita ubupingushi. We cilibwe icasansuka, niwe wabapeela no bulamba pakuti baletukanda.

english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
translation: Ala amenso yobe yaliwamisha, teti uyalekefye yalelolekesha ifyabipa, kabili tekuti iwe uletambakofye uko abantu balelufyanya. Nga nomba cinshi icakuti iwe wikalefye tondolo, pa nshita ababifi balelofya abantu ababacila mu bololoke?

english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
translation: Ngakuti walacita shani abantu kwati lisabi, kwati fishishi ifishakwata na wakufitungulula?

english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
translation: Abena Babiloni baleikata abantu kwati lisabi balefwampula ku malobo. Balebakulila mu masumbu, baleaula no tupundu pa bupalu bwabo.

english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
translation: E mulandu wine aba bantu bapepela amasumbu yabo, no kulayafutumwina ububani, pantu mu masumbu yabo balamwenamo ifintu ifisuma nganshi ne fyakulya ifyakubasansamusha.

english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
translation: Bushe kwena bakulakonkanyapofye ukulaikata no kufumya mwisumbu lyabo, no kulalofya abantu ba mishobo imbi ukwabula no luse, mwa?

english: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
translation: We Yawe, bushe nkafika lilali mukulomba ukuti ungafwe,

english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
translation: Bushe cinshi ico ulekele ndetamba imicitile iyabipa?

english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
translation: Pantu amafunde tayali na maka,

english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
translation: Elyo Yawe ayaswike ati,

english: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
translation: Naco nici. Ine nalaimya abena Kaludea ,

english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
translation: Bantu abatiinya kabili abakutiina,

english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
translation: Bakabalwe babo balicila pa mbwili ku lubilo,

english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.
translation: Ifita fishila ukucimfya no buluku,

english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
translation: Ine ne Habakuku nalanina ku lupungu lwandi ulo nondelapo, uleke ndelolela ifyo Yawe akanjeba ukusosa, nefyo akanjasuka pafyo njilishenye.

english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
translation: Ifyo mupanga ukulacita, efisebanya ulupwa lwenu, kabili muiletelelafye ilyo mulofya abantu ba mishobo iyingi.

english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
translation: Gal 3:11

english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
translation: Mwalishama imwe mwe bakuulila umusumba mukusumya umulopa, kabili ulufyengo lwenu elwalenga nokuti imwe mukuule.

english: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
translation: Bushe te Yawe umwine wa fita uwapingula ukuti ukucucutika kwa bantu ba mishobo imbi kukonaikilafye mu mulilo? Nokuti abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo babombela icafye?

english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
translation: Pantu abantu ba pano isonde ponse bakakwatisha amano ayakwishiba ifyo Yawe acindama, nga filya fine amenshi yaisula muli bemba.

english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
translation: Mwashama imwe mwe banwesha abanenu ifikola, mulapatikisha abanenu ukunwamo mu nkombo shenu basuka bakolwa, elyo nomba mwalabalengela ico bashele ubwamba.

english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
translation: Kuntanshi nimwe nomba mukasebaninapo, ukucindama kwenu kukapwa. Nimwe nomba mukanwa, no kushala ubwamba. Yawe akamunweshamo mu lukombo ululi ku kuboko kwakwe ukwa kulyo, no kucindama kwenu kukapwa, ni nsonifye nomba esho mukalaumfwa.

english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
translation: Roma 1:17

english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
translation: Nga kalubi nako ka mulimo nshi? Kantufye akapangwa no muntu, akashingamona no kumweba imwe ifyacishinka. Umuntu uukapanga, nao aicushafye pakulakatetekela, nako kene akalubi umulungu uo batiina kalafilwa no kulanda.

english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
translation: Mwalishama imwe mwe balaeba icimuti icabaswafye amuti, “Buuka!” Nangu ilibwe ilishilanda amuti, “Alamuka!” Bushe kuti akalubi ekafundapo umuntu cimo? Nangu kengelelwako silifa nangu golide, ala nakalya takapema, takakwata bumi iyoo.

english: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
translation: Yawe nao epakwasuka ifi ati, “Ifyo ine nalakusokolwela, walafilemba bwino bwino pa mabwe ayapapatala, kabili inkombe ya kulabelengela abantu yangufyanye ukupitamo.

english: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
translation: Nomba Yawe wena aba mwi Tempele lyakwe ilyamushilo. Abantu bonse aba pano isonde nabaleikala tondolo pa cinso cakwe.

english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
translation: Filembefye, pantu inshita icilipo pakuti fikacitike. Inshita iyo tayakakokole kufika, nefyo ine ndekulanga fikacitika icine cine. Nga caba kwati cakokola, te mulandu, iwe ulelolelafye, pantu cikacitika ukwabula ukukokola iyoo.

english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
translation: “Lemba ici icakutila, onse uushatambalala umutima wakwe takapusuke, lelo umololoke ena akulaba umumi pa mulandu wa citetekelo cakwe. ”

english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.
translation: Kabili ngefyo umuntu uukolelwe umwangashi abepwa no kufulunganishiwa, cimo cine na baba ne cilumba. Tabekala panshi nakalya, baba no lunkumbwa nge calo cabafwa kabili baba nge mfwa imunshikuta, tabatendwa nakalya. Eco balonganikila imishobo yonse no kwikata abantu bonse pakuti balebalila pa mitwe.

english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
translation: Cine cine abantu abaiketwe bakalukila abalebacimfya, bakalebatuka insele no kulabasuula. Bakalabeba abati, “Imwe mubuula ifintu ifishili fyenu, mwashama imwe. Bushe imwe mukaleka lilali ukulanonkela ifyuma mukucenjelela abalemukongola indalama?”

english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
translation: Imwe ala mukapulikilwafye bamwimina ku bankongole. Ala bakamwimina no kumutiinya icakuti mukaleitutuminafye ku mwenso. Ee, na imwe bakamutapa ifintu.

english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
translation: Imwe mwalitapa ifintu fya bantu ba mishobo iyingi, kanshi abantu bonse abashalapo nomba nabo nimwe bakatapa ifintu, pantu imwe mwalipaulula abantu ku buluku mu fyalo fyonse, mwalibonawila ne misumba yabo.

english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
translation: Alishama uunonkela aba ŋanda yakwe ifyuma fya mu lufyengo, pakuti abe uwa pamulu, epakuti aleikala bwino ukwabula ifibi ukumuponena.

english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
translation: Ipepo lyakwa kasesema Habakuku, ukukonka icinanda ca Shigionoti .

english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
translation: Impili shali shileitentelafye ku mwenso pakukumona,

english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
translation: Akasuba no mweshi fyali filifye shika mu mulu,

english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.
translation: Wacilinganya isonde lyonse mu cipyu,

english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.
translation: Wacisa kukupususha abantu bobe,

english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
translation: Mushika wa fita fyakwe, naumulashila kwifumo lyakwe line,

english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
translation: Waciba ulenyanta pali bemba na bakabalwe bobe,
