english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
translation: Ilyo naumfwa ifi fyonse, umutima wandi watutuma,

english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,
translation: Nangufye imikunyu tailebalula,

english: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
translation: awe ine nakulasekelela muli Yawe,

english: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
translation: Imfumu Yawe eumpeela amaka.

english: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.
translation: We Yawe, ine nalyumfwa ululumbi lobe,

english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
translation: Lesa afumine ku calo ca Temani,

english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
translation: Aisa alebengeshima nga kasuba akaletula,

english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
translation: Atangisha ukutuma icikuko,

english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
translation: Aleti nga aiminina, ninshi isonde lyalatenta,

english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
translation: Ine nacimona uko abena Kushani bacitiina,

english: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
translation: We Yawe, bushe mimana yali yalenga ukuti ufulwe?

english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
translation: Wacibuula ubuta bobe,

english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku ubwakutampa umweshi uwalenga mutanda , mu mwaka walengele ibili apo Dariusi abelele imfumu nkalamba iya calo ca Pesia, elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Hagai. Ili ishiwi lyali lyakuya eba umulashi wa calo uwaleitwa Serubabeli mwana Shealitieli, no kuya ebako shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua mwana Yehosadaki.

english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
translation: E mulandu wine imyulu ileseshe imfula ukuloka, no mushili nao wakaana ukumesha ifyakulya.

english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
translation: Nine naleta icilala pa calo, na pa tupili na mu mabala ya ŋanu, na mu mabala ya myangashi, na mu mabala ya miolifa, na ponsefye apalimwa ifisabo. Na bantu bene nine nabaletela icilala, kumo kwine ne fitekwa na pali fyonse ifyo mufwaya ukubomba.”

english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.
translation: Serubabeli mwana Shealitieli, na shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua mwana Yehosadaki, na bantu bonse abashelepo, epakumfwa no kubeela ishiwi lyakwa Yawe Lesa na mashiwi yakwa kasesema Hagai inkombe yakwa Yawe Lesa wabo. Na bantu epakukwatila Yawe akatiina.

english: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.
translation: Elyo Hagai inkombe yakwa Yawe aeba abantu amashiwi yakwa Yawe ayakutila, “Ine ne Yawe nakulaba nenu, efyasosa Yawe.”

english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
translation: Bautampile pa bushiku bwalengele amakumi yabili na shine (24), mu mweshi walenga mutanda, mu mwaka walenga ibili apo Dariusi abelele imfumu nkalamba iya calo ca Pesia.

english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “Aba bantu balesosa ukuti inshita tailafika iyakukuulilapo iŋanda yandi.”

english: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Hagai aliti,

english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
translation: “Bushe ino ni nshita iyakuti imwe muleikala mu mayanda ayakuulwa ubusaka, mwakupako ne mbao ku fibumba ilintu ine iŋanda yandi ilifye icitantala?”

english: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
translation: Eico kanshi Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Ala muletontonkanya bwino pa micitile yenu.

english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
translation: Mutila mwatanda imbuto ishingi elyo mwalobololamofye tunono. Mulakwata icakulya nomba tacifikapo icakuti muleikuta. Mulakwata umwangashi uwakunwa nomba taufikapo ukupwisha icilaka. Mulafwala ifyakufwala nomba tafifikapo icakuti filemukafya imibili. Kabili uubombela amalipilo, ifyo alipilwa afibika mwitumba ilyatulika.”

english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita alesosa aleti, “Muletontonkanyapo bwino pa micitile yenu.

english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
translation: Aleni kanshi nomba imeni, kabiyeni ku mpili muye fwayako ifimuti. Nkuulileni cipya cipya iŋanda yandi, na ine emo nkalasansamukila no kuilangamo ifyo ine nacindama ne Yawe.

english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
translation: Imwe mwalesubila ukulalobolola ifisabo ifingi, nomba mwalemonamofye utunono. Kabili ilyo mwaleleta utusabo ku mushi, ine naletululula. Mulandu nshi nalecitila ifyo? Mulandu wakuti iŋanda yandi ne Yawe umwine wa fita yabafye icitantala, pa nshita imwe bonse umo umo mulepekapeka pakukuula cila muntu iŋanda yakwe.

english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku bwalengele amakumi yabili na bumo (21), mu mweshi walenga cine lubali muli uyo wine mwaka, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Hagai aliti.

english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na shine (24), mu mweshi walenga pabula , mu mwaka walengele ibili apo Dariusi abelele imfumu nkalamba iya calo ca Pesia, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Hagai.

english: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, “Kepushe bashimapepo, bushe ifunde liletila shani?

english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”
translation: Esra 3:12

english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
translation: Elyo Hagai abepusha ati, “Nga nomba umuntu umo nga nakowela pa mulandu wakukumya icitumbi ca muntu, elyo uyo muntu akumya kuli ifyo fyakulya, bushe ninshi nafyo fine fyakowela?”

english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
translation: Elyo Hagai abeba ati, “Yawe alesosa ukuti na bantu ba uno mushobo efyo nabo bene baba, efyo fyaba ne fintu fine ifyo bacita, ne fintu fine ifyo batuula pa bulambo, ala nafyo fine fintu fyakowela.

english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.
translation: “Ala muletontonkanyapo bwino pa fintu ukufuma lelo no kuya kuntanshi. Tontonkanyeni ilyo mushilatampa kukuula Itempele lyandi, cali shani?

english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
translation: Umuntu nga aya pa mwina wa ŋanu uwa fipimo amakumi yabili (20), alesangapofye ifipimo ikumi limo. No waisa ku cakukaminamo umwangashi ukuti atapulemo ifipimo amakumi yasano (50), kutapulamofye amakumi yabili (20) epela.

english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.
translation: Ala nine Yawe nalemonawila fyonse ifyo mwaleesha ukulima, nine naletuma no mutonshi uwalelenga ukuti filefufuma, ne mfula yacitalawe iya mabwe iyalefisantaula, nomba nalyo line imwe tamwalelapila no kubwelela kuli ine nakalya. Efyasosa Yawe.

english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.
translation: Nomba pali buno bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na shine (24), muli uno mweshi walenga pabula apo mwapwila ukukuula umufula we Tempele lyandi ne Yawe, muletontonkanyapo bwino pa fintu ifilemucitikila.

english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”
translation: Tamuli iŋanu ishishele mu matala yenu, imyangashi tailatwala, pamo pene ne mikunyu, ne miteke, ne miolifa. Nomba ukufuma pali lelo ine nakulamupaala,”

english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
translation: “Eba Serubabeli mwana Shealitieli, umulashi wa calo ca Yuda, na shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua mwana Yehosadaki, na bantu abashalapo bonse ukuti ine ne Yawe ndetila nati,

english: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
translation: Pali ubo bwine bushiku bwalengele amakumi yabili na shine (24), muli uyo wine mweshi, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Hagai nakabili aliti,

english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.
translation: “Kebe Serubabeli umulashi wa calo ca Yuda, ukuti ine nalaswa ntenshe umulu ne sonde.

english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
translation: Ndewisha ifipuna fya shamfumu no konaula amaka ya shamfumu sha benafyalo. Nkapenuna amaceleta na bantu bene abendelapo, bakabalwe bakafwa, na bantu abendelapo bakalaipayana abene.

english: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
translation: Pali ubo bushiku, ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nkakubuula iwe Serubabeli we mubomfi wandi, we mwana mwaume wakwa Shealitieli. Ala niwefye ine ne Yawe nsalile kabili ndi nokukucita kwati ni nindaminwe yandi iya cikatilo. Nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.”

english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
translation: ‘Bushe apo muli, pacilipo bamo abaleibukisha ifyo iŋanda yandi iyakale yacindeme? Bushe iyi ŋanda mulekuula, imwe muleimona shani? Bushe mu menso yenu, tailemoneka nge yafyefye?

english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Lelo kwena iwe Serubabeli kosa, efyo nasosa ne Yawe. Shipa nobe we shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua, mwana Yehosadaki, koseni na imwe mwe bantu bonse ba cino calo, efyo nasosa ne Yawe. Akubombeni umulimo, pantu ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita ndi nenu.

english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
translation: Ilyo mwafumine mu calo ca Egupto, ine nalimulaile ukuti nkalaba nenu pe. Umupashi wandi waba mukati kenu, kanshi imwe mwilatiina iyoo.’”

english: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
translation: Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, “Tapakapite na nshita, ninshi natensha nakabili umulu ne sonde, na bemba no mulundu wine.

english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Ninshi ine napukanya na bantu ba mishobo yonse ne fisuma fyabo fyonse fikesa kuno nkese isusha ne ŋanda iyo ine ifyuma pa. Nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.

english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Silifa yandi na golide wine wandi. Nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.

english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
translation: Iyi ŋanda yandi iyipya ikacindama ukucila iyakale. Emo ine nkalapeela abantu bandi ishuko no mutende. Nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.”

english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
translation: Amafunde yakwa Mose yalifye icakwishibilako ifintu ifisuma ifyali nokwisa, lelo tayali e fintu fisuma fine iyoo. Eico kanshi amalambo ya mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, ayo baleka cila mwaka tekuti yalenge abantu abesa kukupepa Lesa ukuba abapwililika.

english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
translation: Pantu Yesu Kristu acitile ifyo Lesa alefwaya ukuti acite. Ifwe bonse twalisangululwa twalifuma ku bubifi ku maka ye lambo ilya mubili wakwe umwine, ilyo alekele umukufye umo mpo.

english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
translation: Kabili cila bushiku shimapepo onse Umuyuda alabomba imilimo yakwe, alatuula na malambo yamo yene imiku iyingi. Lelo aya malambo teti yafumye fyabubifi nakalya.

english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
translation: Nomba Kristu wena atuulile ilambo limo ilyakubelelela pe ilifumya ifyabubifi. Elyo nomba aya ikala lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa.

english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
translation: Eko nomba alolela mpaka Lesa akacite abalwani bakwe apakunyanta amakasa yakwe.

english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
translation: Ku maka ye lambo limo, Kristu alenga ukuti abantu abo asangulula, abafumya ku bubifi, babe abapwililika pe na pe.

english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
translation: Mupashi Wamushilo nao ni kambone wesu pali uyu mulandu. Pakubalilapo atila ati,

english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
translation: “Imfumu yasosa ukuti,

english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
translation: Kabili atila nokuti,

english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
translation: Apo Lesa abelela abantu uluse pa fyabubifi, kanshi ilambo ilya pa fyabubifi talilekabilwa.

english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, kanshi tapaba cakutulesha ukwingila mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine, apo Kristu alitufwilile.

english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
translation: Pantu abo bantu abesa kukupepa Lesa abalashininkisha ukuti ifyabubifi fyabo nafifuma, nga balileka ukutuula amalambo yonse, ico baleumfwa ukuti tabali na cabubifi nelyo cimo.

english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
translation: Kristu alitwiswila inshila ipya, inshila yamweo, iyapula na mu cisalu cakucingililako, ici calola mukuti, umubili wakwe.

english: and having a great priest over God’s house,
translation: Twalikwata Shimapepo uwacindama uwangalila iŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
translation: Kanshi natulepalamina kuli Lesa ne mitima iyacishinka ne cisumino nganshi. Natulekwata imitima iyasangululwa, na kampingu wa mitima yesu uwabula ububi, ne mibili yesu iyasambwa na menshi ayalengama.

english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
translation: Natuleikatisha mwisubilo ilyo tulumbula ukuti lyesu, pantu twalishininkisha ukuti Lesa talaya bufi.

english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
translation: Natuletontonkanya pafyo twingalacincishanya mukutemwana na mukucita ifisuma.

english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
translation: Twilashala kukulongana pamo, nga filya bamo bacita. Lelo mufwile ukulakoseleshanya, palibufi apo mulemona ukuti Ubushiku bwa Mfumu bwile bulepalama.

english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
translation: Pantu ifwe fwe bapokelela icishinka, nga cakuti ku mufulofye twakonkanyapo ukubifya, awe takwakabe lambo nelyo limo ilyakufumya ifyabubifi.

english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
translation: Awe lyena icikashalakofye, kulolela mwenso mwenso ukupingulwa ukukaba nokwisa no mulilo uukali uukonaula abo abapata Lesa.

english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
translation: Umuntu onse uwapula Amafunde yakwa Mose, nga bantu babili nangu batatu bapeela bukambone, ninshi kumwipayafye ukwabula uluse.

english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
translation: Nga kanshi ni shani umuntu uwasuula Umwana wakwa Lesa? Ni shani uyo muntu uumona ukuti cafyefye umulopa wa cipangano cakwa Lesa uwamusangulwile ukufuma ku bubifi? Ni shani umuntu uusaalula Mupashi wacikuuku? Kanshi tontonkanyenipo pafyo cikalinga uyu muntu ukukandwa icabipisha!

english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
translation: Lelo mukutuula amalambo, cilenga abantu ukwibukisha ifyabubifi fyabo cila mwaka.

english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
translation: Pantu twalishiba uwasosele ati, “Nine nkalandula, nine nkacita umulinganya.” Kabili atila nokuti, “Imfumu eikaputula imilandu ya bantu baiko.”

english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
translation: Ala cintu cakutiina icakwikatwa mu minwe yakwa Lesa wamweo.

english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
translation: Muleibukisha shilya nshiku shakale ilyo mwapokelele ulubuuto. Lyena mwalishangile nganshi no kulwisha na maka nangu mwalecula.

english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
translation: Yere 31:33

english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
translation: Yere 31:34

english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
translation: Mulekoselela ukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya elyo mukapokelela ifyo alaya.

english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
translation: Pantu,

english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
translation: Ukuf 29:38

english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
translation: Lelo ifwe tatuli bantu abafutatila kuli Lesa kabili no kuloba baliloba. Ifwe tuli bantu abasumina no kupusuka twalipusuka.

english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
translation: Pantu umulopa wa ŋombe ishilume no wa mbushi tekuti ufumye ifyabubifi nakalya, cakaana.

english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
translation: Eico Kristu pakwisa pano calo asosele ati,

english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
translation: Amalu 40:6-8

english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
translation: Na ine epakutila,

english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
translation: Ico abalilepo ukulanda, atile, “Amalambo ne mituulo, amalambo yakoca inama yonse, na malambo ya pa fyabubifi taufifwaya, kabili tafikusansamusha nakalya.” Amafunde yakwa Mose yena yalandile ukuti aya malambo yali nokutuulwa.

english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
translation: Kabili atile ati, “Mona naisa kukucita ifyo ufwaya.” Kanshi Kristu alifumyapo ilambo lyakale apyanikishapo ilambo ilyacibili.

english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
translation: Cisumino ecilenga tushininkishe ukupeelwa ifintu tusubila, tushininkishe nokuti ifintu tushimona eko fyaba.

english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
translation: Pantu Abrahamu alelolela umusumba. Fundi uwalengele ifyo umufula uli nokuba na kakuula wine wa musumba, ni Lesa.

english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Abrahamu akwate umwana nangu ali umukote nganshi, elyo Sara nao ali ni ŋumba. Wena alitetekele ukuti Lesa wacishinka, akasunga icilayo cakwe.

english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
translation: Kanshi ecalengele ukuti ku muntu umofye, nao kwati untu wafwa, kufume ba lupwa lwakwe abafula kwati ni ntanda sha mu mulu, kabili kwati musensenga wa pa lulamba lwa bemba uushingapendwa na kupendwa.

english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
translation: Icite 6:13-22

english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
translation: Abantu abalanda umusango uyu, balangafye bwino ukuti balefwaya icalo icakuti caba cabo.

english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
translation: Tabaletontonkanya pa calo ico bafuminemo pantu aciba ifyo nga balisangile inshila yakubwelelamo.

english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
translation: Lelo balefwaisha icalo iciwemepo, icalo ca ku mulu. Kanshi eco Lesa tomfwila nsoni ilyo balemwita ukuti ni Lesa wabo, pantu alibapekanishisha umusumba.

english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
translation: Lesa amwebele ati, “Ni kuli Isaki eko ukakwatila abantu ba mu lupwa lobe.”

english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
translation: Abrahamu aletontonkanya ati Lesa kuti abusha umuntu uwafwa. Cacine kuti mwasosa nokuti Abrahamu ali kwati untu wapokelele Isaki ukufuma ku bafwa.

english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wa cisumino epo Lesa atashishe ifikolwe fyesu.

english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Isaki apaale Yakobo na Esau pa fintu ifyali nokwisa kuntanshi.

english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
translation: Icite 5:21-24

english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti, Yosefu ilyo ali pakufwa, alande ukuti abana bakwa Israeli bakafuma mu Egupto, elyo na pafyo bali nokucita na mafupa yakwe.

english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti abafyashi bakwa Mose bamufise pa myeshi itatu ilyo afyelwe. Bamwene ukuti ali umwana umusuma nganshi, kanshi tabatiinine no kukanakonka ifunde imfumu yakonkomeshe.

english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
translation: Mose asalilepo ukucula pamo na bantu bakwa Lesa, ukucila ukubifya mukusansamuka pa kashita akanono.

english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
translation: Wena amwene ukuti umusaalula engacula pa mulandu wakwa Kristu wacindamapo ukucila ifyuma fyonse ifya mu Egupto, pantu ena aposele amenso yakwe ku cilambu ca kuntanshi.

english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
translation: Icite 35:27

english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Mose acite Pasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila. Akanine umulopa pa filu fya pa minshi ya mayanda pakuti malaika uwali nokwipaya, eipaya amabeli ya bana abaume aba bena Israeli.

english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
translation: Cisumino calengele abena Israeli babuke Bemba Wakashika kwati ni pa mushili uwauma ndi. Lelo abena Egupto bena ilyo baeseshe ukucita ifyo, bena babunda, banwena.

english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wa cisumino ecalenga twiluke ukuti ni Lesa ewabumbile icalo kwishiwi lyakwe. Kanshi emukuti ifimoneka fyatula ku fishimoneka.

english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
translation: Cisumino calengele amalinga ya musumba wa Yeriko ukuti yabongoloke, ilyo abena Israeli bashingulwike umusumba pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
translation: Icite 47:31

english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
translation: Finshi fimbi ifyo ningasosa? Awe tekuti nkwate inshita iyakulanda pali Gideoni, Baraki, Samsoni, Yefuta, Davidi, Samwele na pali bakasesema.

english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
translation: Aba bantu ku cisumino cabo bacimfishe ifyalo mu bulwi. Balecita ifyo Lesa afwaya, kabili bapokelele nefyo Lesa alaile. Balecilika no tunwa twa nkalamo.

english: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
translation: Baleshimya no mulilo uukali uulebilima no kupusunsuka ku lupanga ilyo balefwaya ukubepaya. Bali imbulwamaka, lelo bayalwike abamaka. Bayalwike abakosa mu nkondo, balecimfya ifita fya balwani.

english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
translation: Pa mulandu wa cisumino, abanakashi bapokelele ba lupwa lwabo ababushiwe ku bafwa. Bambi bena bakeene nokuti babalekemo, lelo bacushiwe nganshi mpaka ne mfwa, ico balefwaya ukuti bakashukuke no mweo uwawamapo ukucila.

english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
translation: Bambi nabo babacushishe mukubaseka no kuboma ifikoti, elyo bambi bena babakakile iminyololo no kubaposa mu cifungo.

english: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
translation: Balebepaya kukubalasa amabwe, bambi bena balebaputula pakati ne cela baputwilako imbao ico batila, soo. Elyo bambi nabo balebepaya ku lupanga. Bali abapina, baleendaukafye bafwele impapa sha mpaanga nangu imbushi, abantu abo basuulile no kulabacusha.

english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
translation: Aba bantu icalo tacabawamine. Baleseulukafye mu matololo na mu mpili kwati ni mbutushi, baleikala mu ncengo na mu mimba.

english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Abeli atuule Lesa ilambo ilyawamapo ukucila ilyakwa Kaini. Ni pa mulandu wa cisumino Lesa aebele Abeli ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe, ilyo amutashishe pa mulandu wa mituulo yakwe. Ku cisumino cakwe, Abeli nangu afwa, acili alelanda.

english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
translation: Pantu nifwe Lesa ateyanishishe ifyawamapo ukucila. Lesa ateyenye ukuti, pakuti babe abapwililika kano tuli nabo pamo.

english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
translation: Nico Enoki ali ne cisumino ecalengele nokuti efwa. Lelo Lesa amusendele umutuntulu ku mulu, tapali nangu umo uwakumumona pantu Lesa alimusendele. Pantu ilyo Enoki ali talasendwa, calishininkishiwa ukuti alesansamusha Lesa.

english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
translation: Amalu 33:6

english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Noa, ilyo Lesa amusokele pa fintu ifyali nokwisa kuntanshi ifyo ashamwene pa nshita ilya, akwate akatiina kuli Lesa, apangile no bwato pakupususha ulupwa lwakwe. Noa ku cisumino cakwe ashinine abantu ba cino calo, kabili apokelele ne palo lyakuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa ilyo Lesa apeela abantu abacisumino.

english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
translation: Cisumino calengele ukuti Abrahamu anakile Lesa uwamwitile ukuti ashe cilya calo aye ku calo ico Lesa alaile ukumupeela. Ashile icalo cakwe no kulaya uko ashaishibe.

english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
translation: Cisumino cakwe calengele ukuti ekale umweni mu calo Lesa amulaile. Aleikala mu matenti nga filya Isaki na Yakobo baleikala abo Lesa alaile icilayo cimo cine.

english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
translation: Nomba ifwe twalishingulukwa ne bumba ilikalamba ilya bakambone. Kanshi natuitalushe kuli fyonse ifitufinya na ku bubifi bwine ubutukakatilafye bwangu. Natuleshipikisha mukubutuka ulubilo batuteyanishisha.

english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
translation: Bashifwe bantu batukalipila pa kashita akanono ukulingana nefyo bamwene ukuti ecilingile. Lelo Lesa ena alatukalipila pakuti cituwamine, tukakume kukuba abamushilo nga ena.

english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
translation: Kanshi kosheni amaboko yenu ayanakuka na makufi yenu ayaletutuma.

english: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
translation: Mulinganye inshila umwakupita amakasa yenu, epakuti ayalemana yeicena, lelo pakuti yamone ukupola.

english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
translation: Lyonse mulefwaya ukwikala no muntu onse mu mutende no kuba abamushilo, pantu ukwabula ukuba uwamushilo, umuntu nelyo umo takamone Imfumu.

english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
translation: Mulecenjela pakuti umuntu nelyo umo elafutatila cikuuku cakwa Lesa. Mwileka nelyo umo aluke umushila uwalula, uwakuti cilya wakula walacusha abantu no kubakowesha.

english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
translation: Mwileka nelyo umo abe cilende nangu uushisakamana Lesa nga Esau, uwashitishe insambu shakwe ishakuba ibeli pakulya icakulya umukufye umo.

english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
translation: Yobo 5:17

english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
translation: Amaf 29:18

english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
translation: Kabili paleumfwika iciunda ce penga ne shiwi ilikalamba. Ilyo abantu baumfwile ishiwi, bapapete ukuti ishiwi lileke ukulanda.

english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
translation: Natuletonta amenso yesu pali Yesu uwalengele ukuti tube ne cisumino, kabili eulenga nokuti cibe icapwililika. Wena asuulile na ku mfwa yamusebanya iya pa musalaba, lelo aculile amacushi ya pa musalaba pa mulandu wa nsansa ishali nokumwishila kuntanshi. Awe nomba aikala lubali lwa ku kulyo kwa cipuna cabufumu icakwa Lesa.

english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
translation: Pantu abantu calibanshishe ukubeela icebo icasoselwe ukuti, “Nangu nga ni nama yakumya ku lupili, ninshi bali nokuipaya ku mabwe.”

english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
translation: Cacine icamoneke ku lupili cali cakutiinya nganshi icakuti na Mose wine asosele ati, “Umwenso wanjikata nalatutuma!”

english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
translation: Mwaisa ku lukuta lwa mabeli yakwa Lesa, ayo amashina yabo yalembwa mu mulu. Mwaisa kuli Lesa kaputula wa milandu ya bantu bonse, na ku mipashi ya bantu iyo Lesa alenga ukuba iyapwililika baba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
translation: Mwaisa kuli Yesu uwatuwikishanya na Lesa mu cipangano cipya. Mwaisa ku mulopa waitike uutusosela ifyawamapo ukucila umulopa wakwa Abeli.

english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
translation: Kanshi mulecenjela, mwilakaana kunakila uulelanda na imwe. Apo tapanishe abo bakeene ukunakila walebasokako pano isonde, palibufi takatupanye nga twasangukila uuletusoka ukufuma ku mulu!

english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
translation: Amap 4:26

english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
translation: Pakusosa ati, “Nakabili” cilelanga ukuti akafumya ifintu ifitenta, emukutila, ifibumbwa, epakuti ifishitenta fyena fikashale.

english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
translation: Kanshi natuletasha Lesa, pantu tulepokelela ubufumu ubushili bwakutenta. Kabili tulemupepa no mucinshi, abakatiina mu musango uufwile ukumusansamusha.

english: for our God is a consuming fire.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
translation: Muletontonkanya pafyo Yesu apitilemo. Wena aleshipikisha ilyo abantu babi bamupatile nganshi. Kanshi na imwe mwilanenuka, mwilafupuka.

english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
translation: Pantu mukulwisha ububifi, tamulalwisha icakuti bamwipailapo.

english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
translation: Bushe mwalilaba amashiwi yacikoseleshi ayo Lesa alanda kuli imwe bamwane ayakuti,

english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
translation: Pantu Imfumu ilakalipila abo yena yatemwa,

english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
translation: Muleshipikisha mu macushi, pantu ekufundwa. Ayo macushi yenu yalanga ukuti, Lesa alemulela nga abana bakwe. Bushe kwaliba umwana uo wishi ashikalipila?

english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
translation: Nga talemukalipila, ifyo akalipila abana bakwe bambi bonse, ninshi tamuli bana bakwe abene bene, muli nga bana ba mu bucende.

english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
translation: Nomba ifwe twalikwata abafyashi besu abantu, balatukalipila, no kubacindika tulabacindika pali ifyo. Palibufi tufwile ukunakila Shifwe wa mipashi yesu, pakuba abomi.

english: Let brotherly love continue.
translation: Mwilanenuka mukutemwana nga bamunyina.

english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
translation: Ifwe pa bulambo bwesu bashimapepo ababomba kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa tabakwata insambu shakulyako ifyelambo.

english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba asenda umulopa wa nama no kuutula ilambo lyakufuta pa fyabubifi mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine. Lelo ifitumbi fya nama fyena bafyocela kunse ya nkambi.

english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
translation: Kanshi eico Yesu nao afwilile kunse ya musumba, pakuti ku mulopa wakwe asangulule abantu babe abamushilo.

english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
translation: Kanshi na ifwe natuleya kuli Yesu kunse ya nkambi, elyo tulesenda umusebanya uo asendele.

english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
translation: Pantu pano calo tatwakwata musumba wakubelelela, lelo tulelolela umusumba uli nokwisa.

english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
translation: Ku maka yakwa Yesu, kanshi ukutasha kwesu lyonse nakuleba ilambo tulelekela Lesa, emukutila mashiwi ya bantu abalumbula icisumino cabo muli Yesu.

english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
translation: Mwilalaba ukucita ifisuma no kwafwako abanenu kufyo mukwete, pantu ifi e malambo yasansamusha Lesa.

english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
translation: Mulebeela intungulushi shenu, mulekonka nefyo shilemweba. Intungulushi shenu eshisakamana ukusunga imyeo yenu, kabili shikaba nokulubulula pali uyu mulimo. Nga mwalashibeela, shikabomba uyu mulimo ne nsansa. Nga teifyo, shikalabomba no bulanda, elyo ico cena tacakamuwamine.

english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
translation: Muletupepelako na ifwe. Ifwe natushininkisha tatwaba nelyo cimo icakusakamika kampingu wa mitima yesu, pantu lyonse tulaicindika mu myendele yesu.

english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
translation: Kanshi ndemupapata nganshi mulempepelako ukuti Lesa akambweseshe bwangu kuli imwe.

english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
translation: Mwilalaba ukusekelela abeni. Bamo abantu mukucita ifyo balisekelela bamalaika ukwabula ukwishiba.

english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
translation: Lesa alibusha ku bafwa Yesu Imfumu yesu. Uyu Yesu e kacema mukalamba wa mpaanga uo ku mulopa wakwe apangile icipangano cakubelelela.

english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Lesa wamutende engamupeela ifintu ifisuma fyonse ifyo mulekabila pakuti mulecita ifyo alefwaya, elyo na ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu, Lesa alebomba muli ifwe ifilemusansamusha. Kristu nalelumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane ndemupapata muteke imitima pakukutika kuli aya mashiwi ya cikoseleshi, pantu uyu kalata namulembela te mutali iyoo.

english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
translation: Ndefwaya mwishibe nokuti munyinefwe Timote balimufumya mu cifungo. Nga ayangufyanya ukwisa, ninshi tukaba nankwe pakwisa mumona.

english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
translation: Poshenipo intungulushi shenu shonse na bamushilo bonse. Bamunyinefwe abafuma ku Itali balemuposha.

english: Grace be with you all. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku cakwa Lesa cileba na imwe bonse.

english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
translation: Muleibukisha abali mu cifungo, muleimona kwati muli nabo mu cifungo. Muleibukisha abantu abo balecusha, muleimona kwati nimwe bene balecusha.

english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
translation: Bonse muli nokucindika icupo. Mwe balume na imwe mwe bakashi mube ne cishinka mu cupo cenu. Lesa akapingula abacita ubulalelale na babembuka.

english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
translation: Mu mikalile yenu mwilatemwa indalama, mulemona ifyo mukwete amuti nafitulinga. Pantu Lesa asosa ati,

english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
translation: Amaf 31:6

english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
translation: Muleibukisha intungulushi shenu ishamushimikile amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Muletontonkanya pafyo bacitile mu bumi bwabo, elyo mulebapashanya na mu cisumino bakwete.

english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation: Yesu Kristu wena abafye cimo cine, ifyo ali mailo, efyo ali na lelo, efyo akaba umuyayaya.

english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
translation: Mwileka amafunde yambi yambifye, kabili ayapusana pusana yamutwale kumbi kumbifye. Icawama, kupoka amaka ukufuma ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa, temukukonka amafunde ya pa fyakulya. Ayo mafunde tayabafwako nakalya abayakonka.

english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
translation: Kale Lesa atumine bakasesema, ebalelanda amashiwi yakwe ku fikolwe fyesu mu misango iyingi, kabili pa nshita ishalekana lekana.

english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
translation: Kabili atila nokuti,

english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
translation: Fyena fikaloba, lelo iwe ukabelelela pe.

english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
translation: Ukafifunga kwati mwingila,

english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
translation: Imila 17:13

english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
translation: Sam 7:14

english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
translation: Nomba muli ishi nshiku shakupelekeshako, alituma Mwane uwatulandila amashiwi yakwe. Ni ku maka yakwa Mwane, Lesa abumbila ifintu fyonse. Uyu wine Mwane eo Lesa asonta ukuti pakulekelesha akabe e mwine wa fintu fyonse.

english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
translation: Eo ukubengeshima kwa bucindami bwakwa Lesa kumonekelamo. Kabili aba e cata cakwa Lesa icapwililika. Eulenga nokuti ifintu fyonse fikonkanye ukubapo ku maka ye shiwi lyakwe. Ilyo apwile umulimo wakufumisha abantu ifyabubifi, elyo aya ikala mu mulu lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa uwa maka yonse.

english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
translation: Mwana Lesa alicila apakalamba pali bamalaika, nga filya fine ishina Lesa amupeele lyacila pa mashina yabo.

english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
translation: Pantu Lesa tatala ebapo umo pali bamalaika ati,

english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
translation: Kabili pakuleta Umwana wakwe ibeli muno calo, Lesa asosa ati,

english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
translation: Amalu 2:7

english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
translation: Lelo pali Mwane pena, Lesa atila ati,

english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
translation: Watemwa ifintu ifyalungama,

english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
translation: Kanshi eico tuli nokuposako amano nganshi kuli fyonse ifyo twaumfwa, epakuti twikesa sendwa na fimbi.

english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
translation: Kanshi Lesa uubumba ifintu fyonse kabili uo fyonse fibombela, alilungike pakulenga ukuti Yesu ku macushi aculile abe uwapwililika, epakuti alete bamwane abengi kukukwatako ubucindami bwakwe. Pantu ni Yesu eka eulenga abantu ukupusuka.

english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
translation: Yesu eusangulula abantu ukubafumya ku fyabubifi fyabo. Elyo umwine wine na bantu bene abasangululwa, bonse Shibo umo wine. Kanshi eico takwata nsoni shakubeta, bamunyina.

english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
translation: Asosa kuli Lesa ati,

english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
translation: Kabili atila nokuti, “Ni muli Lesa emo nakulatetekela.” Kabili asosa nokuti, “Moneni epo ndi, ine pamo na bana abo Lesa ampeela.”

english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
translation: Apo abo eta abana, bantu ababa no munofu no mulopa, kanshi Yesu nao ayalwike ngefyo baba, aba umuntu. Acitile ifi, pakuti ku mfwa yakwe onaule Ciwa, uwakwata amaka pa mfwa.

english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
translation: Elyo kabili epakuti alubule bonse abali abasha mu bumi bwabo bonse pa mulandu wakutiina imfwa.

english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
translation: Pantu kwena calishibikwafye bwino ukuti te bamalaika Yesu afwilishako, lelo ba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu.

english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
translation: Esaya 8:17-18

english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
translation: Apo Yesu umwine alitunkilwe no kucula, kanshi nomba kuti ayafwa bonse abaletunkwa.

english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
translation: Amashiwi bamalaika balandile, yali yacishinka. Elyo na onse uushaleyakonka nangu ukuyabeela, alekandilwapo ukulingana ne cilubo cakwe.

english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
translation: Nga kanshi ifwe kuti twafulumukila kwi, nga twasuula ipusukilo ilyakula ifi? Imfumu iyine eyabalilepo ukubila pali ili ipusukilo, elyo abo baumfwileko baishile landa kuli ifwe no kutushinina ukuti lyacishinka.

english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
translation: Kabili Lesa alibeminine bukambone ku fishibilo na ku fipeshamano ifya misango ne misango na ku finjelengwe alecita, elyo na pakubapeela ubupe bwakwa Mupashi Wamushilo ngomo alefwaila.

english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
translation: Lesa tasonta bamalaika ukuba bakateeka ba calo icili nokwisa, ico tulelandapo.

english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
translation: Lelo umo, pamo asosa ati,

english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
translation: Pa kashita akanono wamulengele ukuti abe

english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
translation: Elyo walenga na fyonse ukulamukunkwila.”

english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
translation: Lelo uo tumona ni Yesu, uo pa kashita kanono Lesa amulengele ukuti abe uwacepa pali bamalaika, epakuti ku cikuuku cakwa Lesa, Yesu afwilile umuntu onse. Nomba tumona Yesu ukuti pali ico atufwilile bamufwika icisote cabufumu ica mucinshi no bucindami.

english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane, mwe bamushilo, imwe ni Lesa ewamwita! Imwe mulebika amano pali Yesu, umusole kabili Shimapepo mukalamba wa mu cisumino cesu.

english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
translation: Kanshi eco nafulilwe ilya nkulo,

english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
translation: Kanshi nalifulilwe, nalapile no mulapo nati,

english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, mulecenjela, peba nelyo umo pali imwe uwa mutima ubi, kabili uwabula icisumino icakuti aifumya na kuli Lesa wamweo.

english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
translation: Mulekoseleshanya cila bushiku ilyo baleti, “Ni lelo,” epakuti nelyo umo pali imwe eumalala mutima no kubepwa no bubifi.

english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
translation: Pantu ifwe twalyampana na Kristu, kumfwa nga twaikatilila pa maka mukutetekela kwine twakwete ukufumafye pakutampa pene, mpaka na ku mpela.

english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
translation: Ngefyo calembwa ukuti,

english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
translation: Bantu nshi baumfwile ishiwi lyakwa Lesa, kabili bamusangukila? Bantu bonse balya Mose afumishe mu Egupto.

english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
translation: Nga ni bani balya Lesa afulilwe pa myaka amakumi yane? Bantu balya ababifishe ne fitumbi fyabo fyashele mu matololo.

english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
translation: Ni bani Lesa alelandapo ilyo alapile no mulapo ati, “Tapakabe nelyo umo uwakwingila mu ncende yandi iyakutuushamo,” bushe teabo bakeene ukubeela?

english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
translation: Kanshi twamona ukuti, ico abo bantu bafililwe ukwingila, nico bashasumine.

english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
translation: Ali uwapetamina Lesa uwamusontele ukubomba uyu mulimo, nga filya Mose ali uwapetama mu milimo yonse iya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
translation: Umuntu uwakuula iŋanda alacindikwa ukucila ne ŋanda ine. Efyo fine Yesu nao aliba nokucindikwa apakalamba ukucila Mose.

english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
translation: Cacine, iŋanda yonse uukuula muntu, lelo uwapanga fyonse ni Lesa.

english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
translation: Mose ali uwapetama mukubomba imilimo yonse mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Kabili ali kambone wa fintu Lesa ali nokwisa landa kuntanshi.

english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
translation: Lelo Kristu wena apo ni Mwane, apetaminafye pakusunga iŋanda yakwa Lesa. Nifwe iŋanda yakwa Lesa, kulila twaikatisha ukukoselela no kutetekela mufyo tusubila.

english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
translation: Kanshi Mupashi Wamushilo asosa ati,

english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
translation: mwiumalala mitima,

english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
translation: ilyo ifikolwe fyenu fyalenjesha no kunsonsomba,

english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
translation: Nomba apo icilayo cakutuusha ico Lesa alandapo epo cicili, kanshi natucenjele pakuti nelyo umo ekafilwa ukupokelela ukutusha batulaya.

english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
translation: Pantu uwaingila mukutuusha uko Lesa alaile, ninshi aleka ukubomba umulimo wakwe, nga filya Lesa alekele ukubomba umulimo wakwe.

english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
translation: Amalu 95:11

english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyamweo, kabili libomba na maka. Lyalitwa ukucila no lupanga ulwatwa kubili. Lilapitilila icakuti lyalekanya umweo no mupashi, lyalekanya no mwasuntanina amafupa ku bufyompo. Lilapelulula ififwaya ne fitontonkanya umutima wa muntu.

english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
translation: Tapaba nelyo cimo icafisama ku cinso cakwa Lesa. Ifibumbwa fyonse fyabafye pa lwalala, fyonse alafimona na menso yakwe. Kabili ni kuli uyu eko twaba nokulubulula pali fyonse ifyo tucita.

english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
translation: Kanshi natuleikatilila pa maka ku cisumino cesu ico twasuminamo. Pantu twalikwata Yesu, Mwana Lesa, Shimapepo mukalamba uwacindamisha uwapula mu myulu, aba na pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
translation: Shimapepo wesu mukalamba tewakuti afilwe ukumfwa uluse pa bunasha bwesu. Lelo Shimapepo wesu mukalamba twakwata, untu nao atunkilwe mu misango yonse nga ifwe, lelo wena tabifishe.

english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
translation: Kanshi natulepalama ku cipuna cakwa Lesa ukwaba icikuuku, ukwabula ukutwishika. Kulya eko twingapokelela uluse no kusanga icikuuku icakutwafwilisha pa nshita tulecikabila.

english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
translation: Pantu na ifwe twalyumfwa Imbila Nsuma, nga filya fine nabo baumfwile. Balyumfwile amashiwi ya Mbila, lelo tayababombele nelyo cimo, pantu nangu baumfwile, tabaipokelele ne cisumino.

english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
translation: Apo ifwe twasumina, tulengila mu ncende yakutuushamo. Efyo Lesa asosa ukuti,

english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
translation: Pantu pamo calembwa palwa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali ukuti, “Mu bushiku ubwalenga cine lubali Lesa alituushishe, aleka imilimo yakwe yonse.”

english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
translation: Uyu wine mulandu, aliulandapo nakabili ati,

english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
translation: Bamo kwena balengila mu ncende yakutuushamo. Lelo ababalilepo ukumfwa Imbila Nsuma tabaingile mu ncende yakutuusha, pantu balikeene ukubeela.

english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
translation: Ici ecalenga ukuti Lesa asale ubushiku bumbi, ubwitwa “Lelo line.” Ilyo papitile inshita iyitali, elyo Lesa aishile eba Davidi ukulanda nga mulya mwine amashiwi tulumbwile kale yasosa ukuti,

english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
translation: Nga cakuti Yoshua alipeele abantu incende yakutuushamo iyo Lesa abalaile, ninshi Lesa nga taishile landa nakabili pa bushiku bumbi.

english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
translation: Kanshi emukutila ukutuusha kwa pe Sabata kwashalilafye abantu bakwa Lesa.

english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba onse asalwa ukufuma pakati ka bantu. Kabili asontwa ukulaimininako abantu muli fyonse ifilolele kuli Lesa, ukulaleka amalambo no kutuula imituulo pa mulandu wa fyabubifi.

english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
translation: Lesa nao epakumusonta ukuba Shimapepo mukalamba, muli bushimapepo bwakwa Melikisedeki!

english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
translation: Pali uyu mulandu tulipo ne fyakulanda ifingi, lelo cintu icayafya ukumulondolwela, pantu mwalikosa imitwe, tamumfwa bwangu.

english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
translation: Kwena pa nshita ino nimwe mufwile ukuba bakafundisha, lelo ukufika na nomba mucili mulekabila uwakumufunda ifyakutampilakofye ukwishiba pa mashiwi yakwa Lesa. Mu nshita yakulalya icakulya icikosele, imwe mpaka na nomba mucili muleonka ibele.

english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
translation: Umuntu uucili aleonka ibele, ninshi acili akanya, talati eshibe ukusala ifili bwino ne fishili bwino.

english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
translation: Abalya icakulya icakosa bakalamba, pantu bena mukubomfya ifi fintu, basuka baishiba ukusobolola ifisuma ne fibi.

english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
translation: Apo umwine nao alomfwa ubunasha mu misango iyingi, kanshi kuti aba uwamutembo ku balecita ifyo bashishibe na ku balelufyanya.

english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
translation: Apo nao alomfwa ubunasha, kanshi ali nokulaleka amalambo te pa mulandufye wa fyabubifi fya bantu, lelo na pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyakwe umwine.

english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
translation: Tapaba nelyo umo uuibuulila umwine uyu mucinshi wakuba Shimapepo mukalamba kanofye uo Lesa aita, nga filya aitile Aroni.

english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
translation: Cimo cine, na Kristu wine taibuulilefye umwine umucinshi wakuba Shimapepo mukalamba. Lelo ni Lesa uwamwebele ati,

english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
translation: Elyo pambi napo Lesa asosele ati,

english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
translation: Levi 9:7

english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
translation: Yesu nangu ali ni Mwana Lesa, asambilile ukunakila Lesa ku macushi alecula.

english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
translation: Ilyo asukile aba uwapwililika, ayalwike intulo ye pusukilo lya pe na pe kuli bonse abamunakila.

english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
translation: Kanshi natubale tushe ifyo twasambilile pali Kristu ilyo twatampile, tubikefye amano pakwishiba amafunde ayalingile abakalamba. Twibwekeshapo nakabili amafundisho ayaba ngo mufula, ayakulapila no kutaluka ku fintu ifituletela imfwa na palwa kusumina muli Lesa.

english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
translation: Lesa taba na lufyengo. Ala tekuti alabe imilimo mwabomba nangu icitemwiko mwalanga pa mulandu wakwe mukwafwa abantu abamushilo abo na nomba mucili muleafwa.

english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
translation: Ico ifwe tufwaisha cakuti cila umo pali imwe abe uwacincila mpaka na ku mpela, epakuti fyonse ifyo musubila fikafikilishiwe icine cine.

english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
translation: Tatulefwaya imwe ukuti mube abanaŋani. Lelo tulefwaya ukuti imwe mube nga filya abantu bacisumino baba abamutekatima, epakuti mukapokelele ifyo Lesa alaya.

english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
translation: Ilyo Lesa alaile icilayo kuli Abrahamu, ailapilefye umwine pakulaya ico cilayo. Apo kushali umbi uwacindama ukumucila, abomfeshefye ishina lyakwe pakulaya icilayo cakwe.

english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
translation: Atile ati, “Nkakupaala nganshi, kabili nkasandulula na ba mu lupwa lobe.”

english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
translation: Abrahamu ali no mutekatima, asukile apokelela nefyo Lesa alaile.

english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
translation: Eico ku bantu abali nokupokelela ifyo alaile, Lesa alundilepo no mulapo kufyo alaile, pakuti bashininkishe ukuti takatale alula ifyo apangile ukucita.

english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
translation: Kanshi kwaba ifi fintu fibili ifishingalulwa, kabili pafyo Lesa ashingabepa bufi. Kanshi ifwe fwe babutukila kuli Lesa pakumona ukupusuka, tulakwata icikoseleshi nganshi no kwikatilila pa maka kwisubilo ilili kuntanshi.

english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
translation: Icisubilo twakwata mu bumi bwesu caba kwati cela icafina ico baposa pali bemba pakulesha ubwato ukulaenda. Ici cisubilo cesu cintu cakosa, kabili te cakuteletenta. Cena cipula mu cisalu cakucingililako, cafika na mu muputule wamushilo uwamukati.

english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
translation: Kabili twilabwekeshapo ukufunda palwa kubatishiwa, palwa kutambalikila amaboko, elyo na palwa kushukuka kwa bafwa na pakupingulwa kwa bantu bonse ukwakupelekeshako.

english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
translation: Pa mulandu wa ifwe, muli uyu muputule emo Yesu atutangilila ukwingila, kabili ayaluka Shimapepo mukalamba uwape, ukukonka na bushimapepo bwakwa Melikisedeki.

english: This will we do, if God permits.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo tuli nokucita, nga Lesa alefwaya.

english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
translation: Bushe abantu abasuula ku cisumino cabo, kuti bababwesha shani nakabili kukulapila? Aba bantu kale bali mu lubuuto lwakwa Lesa, bantu abalyako na ku bupe ubwafuma ku mulu, kabili bantu abapokelelako na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
translation: Aba bantu bena balyumfwako ifyo amashiwi yakwa Lesa yawama kabili balyumfwako ne fya pa maka ya nshita iyileisa.

english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
translation: Elyo nomba balisangukila icisumino cabo! Kanshi tekuti cibombe icakubabwesha nakabili. Pantu bena nakabili baletanika Umwana wakwa Lesa, no kulamusebanya pa lwalala.

english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
translation: Lesa eupaala umushili apo imfula iloka libili libili, wakusha ne filimwa pakuti abo abalimine balefibomfya.

english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
translation: Lelo umushili uumesha imyunga na bacilasa, wena wafyefye ulifye mukuya mwishamo lyakutipwilwa. Na pakulekelesha bakaocafye no mulilo.

english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
translation: Lelo bacibusa bandi nangu twalanda ifi, pali imwe twalishininkisha. Twalishiba ukuti imwe muli ne fintu ifiwemepo ifilingile ipusukilo.

english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
translation: Uyu Melikisedeki ali ni mfumu ya Salemu, kabili ali shimapepo wakwa Lesa mukulu. Akumenye Abrahamu amupaala no kumupaala, ninshi Abrahamu alebwela ku bulwi uko acimfishe imfumu.

english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
translation: Pantu ilyo Abrahamu akumenye Melikisedeki, ninshi Levi talafyalwa lelo ali muli Abrahamu icikolwe cakwe.

english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
translation: Pali bushimapepo bwa bena Levi, epashintilila Amafunde yakwa Mose ayo yapeelwe ku bena Israeli. Kanshi ifyo bushimapepo bwa bena Levi bwalebomba afiba ifyapwililika ninshi nga tacalekabilwa ukwisa kwa bushimapepo bumbi ubwaibela, ubushili ubwakwa Aroni, lelo bwakwa Melikisedeki.

english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
translation: Pantu kumfwa nga kwaba ukwalula bushimapepo, lyena ninshi na mafunde yene yali nokwaluka.

english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
translation: Elyo Imfumu yesu, iyo balandapo ifi fyonse ili iya mu luko lumbi, elyo mu luko lwaiko tamwali nelyo umo atalile abomba umulimo wa bushimapepo.

english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
translation: Calishibikwafye bwino ukuti Imfumu yesu yafyelwe mu luko lwakwa Yuda. Elyo ilyo Mose alandile pali bashimapepo, talandilepo pali ulu luko.

english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
translation: Uyu mulandu waishile ishibikwa bwino ukucilapo, ilyo kwaishile moneka Shimapepo uwaibela, uwaba nga Melikisedeki.

english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
translation: Uyu wena bamucita Shimapepo te mulandu wakukonka amafunde ne ntambi sha bantu, lelo ni ku maka ya mweo uushonaika.

english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
translation: Kanshi amafunde yakale yalisuulwa kabili tayalebomba nelyo cimo.

english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
translation: Pantu Amafunde yakwa Mose tekuti yalenge icintu nelyo cimo cibe icapwililika. Nomba pa malo ya mafunde, paisa isubilo ilyawamapo, ilyakutwafwa ukupalama kuli Lesa.

english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
translation: Abrahamu nao abuulile icintu cimo pekumi lyonse ilya fintu asendele, amupeela. Ishina lya Melikisedeki pakubala lyalola mukutila, “Imfumu yakaele,” elyo kabili ico ali ni mfumu ya Salemu, kanshi ishina yakwe lyalola na mukuti, “Imfumu yacibote.”

english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
translation: Teici ceka, Lesa alundapo no mulapo. Bambi bena, Lesa talapilepo mulapo ilyo abacitile bashimapepo.

english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
translation: Kanshi Yesu aba e cakushininkishishako icipangano icacilapo ukuwama.

english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
translation: Bashimapepo bambi bena balya bali abengi, pantu balifilwa ukukonkanyapo ukubomba umulimo wabo ico balefwa.

english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
translation: Lelo Yesu wena aba no mweo wakubelelela, kabili aba na bushimapepo bwakubelelela.

english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
translation: Eico kanshi wena aliba na maka yakupususha umupwilapo abantu abaleisa kuli ena pakufika kuli Lesa, pantu lyonse aikalilafye ukuba uwakutupapatilako kuli Lesa.

english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
translation: Yesu, kanshi e Shimapepo mukalamba untu tulingile ukukwata. Pantu wena wamushilo, taba na cilubo, wakaele, alipatulwa ku babifi kabili alicindikwa pakumusenda ukucila ne myulu yonse.

english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
translation: Yesu wena taba nga Bashimapepo bakalamba bambi. Takabila kuleka amalambo cila bushiku, pakubala pa fyabubifi fyakwe umwine elyo kabili na pa fyabubifi fya bantu. Ailekele ilambo umuku umo, ilyo aituulile umwine, no kupwa calipwa.
