english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
translation: Amafunde yakwa Mose yasonta abantu abanakuka ukuba Bashimapepo bakalamba. Lelo icilayo Lesa alaile no mulapopo, icaishile panuma ya Mafunde yakwa Mose, cena casonta Mwana Lesa, uo alenga ukuba uwapwililika pe na pe.

english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
translation: Takwata wishi nangu nyina nangu ifikolwe fyakwe, kabili tapaba bushiku afyelwemo nangu ilyo afwile. Aba kwati ni Mwana Lesa, ni shimapepo wape.

english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
translation: Kanshi mwamona ukuti Melikisedeki ali umuntu uwacindama nganshi. Abrahamu icikolwe cesu icalumbuka nao amupeele icintu cimo cimo pekumi lyonse ilya fintu atapile mu bulwi.

english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
translation: Elyo Amafunde yakwa Mose yakonkomeshe ukuti aba mu lupwa lwakwa Levi bashimapepo, bali nokulapoka ku bena Israeli icintu cimo pekumi lyonse. Kanshi emukutila, bapoka kuli bamunyina, nangu bamunyina nabo ba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu.

english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
translation: Melikisedeki wena tali wa mu lupwa lwakwa Levi, lelo apokele icintu cimo pekumi lyonse ukufuma kuli Abrahamu, elyo amupaala no kumupaala, umuntu uo Lesa alaile icilayo.

english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
translation: Cena ici te cakutwishika icakuti umukalamba eupaala umwaice.

english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
translation: Elyo nga ni bashimapepo bena, bantu abenakufwa, ebalepoka icintu cimo pekumi lyonse. Lelo Melikisedeki wena, amashiwi yakwa Lesa yasosa ukuti, aba umumi uwapokele icintu cimo pekumi lyonse.

english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
translation: Kanshi kuti twati apo Abrahamu apeele icintu cimo pekumi kuli Melikisedeki, Levi nao uupoka icintu cimo pekumi ku bena Israeli, ninshi nao alipeele icintu cimo pekumi kuli Melikisedeki.

english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
translation: Ico tulelandapofye nici icakuti ifwe twalikwata Shimapepo mukalamba uwa uyu musango. Aikala mu mulu lubali lwa ku kulyo kwa cipuna ca Mfumu iyacindama.

english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation: ‘Ici e cipangano nkapangana na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli,

english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
translation: Takwakabe nangu umo uwakufunda umwina mupalamano munankwe,

english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
translation: Pantu nkababelelako uluse pa bubi bwabo,

english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
translation: Ilyo Lesa alanda palwa cipangano cipya, ninshi icapakubala nacipwa tekuti cibombe kantu. Elyo icintu icakota no kusapuka casapuka, ninshi bwangu bwangu calobelela.

english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
translation: E Shimapepo mukalamba uutumika mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine, emukutila ni mwi Tenti lyacine cine ilyapangwa na Lesa, te muntu iyoo.

english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba onse asontwa pakuti aletuula imituulo, aleleka na malambo ya nama kuli Lesa. Kanshi na Shimapepo mukalamba wesu nao afwile ukutuula ifintu fimo.

english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
translation: Nomba alaikala pano calo, nga tekuti abe shimapepo nakalya, pantu ukulingana na Mafunde yakwa Mose epo bali bashimapepo abatuula Lesa ifyabupe.

english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
translation: Incende Yamushilo umo aba bashimapepo babomba, yabafye icimpashanya cakwishibilako Incende Yamushilo ine ine iya mu mulu. Efyo fine cali na kuli Mose. Ilyo Mose alefwaya ukutampa ukupanga Itenti lyakwa Lesa umwakwikala Imbokoshi ya cipangano, Lesa amwebele ati, “Uli nokumona ukuti fyonse ukafipange ukulingana nefyo nakulangile pa lupili.”

english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
translation: Lelo Yesu ena apeelwa umulimo wa bushimapepo uwacindamishapo ukucila imilimo yabo, pantu ne cipangano cine aleta pakati kakwa Lesa na bantu naco caliwamapo ukucila. Kabili cashintilila na mu filayo ifyawamapo ukucila.

english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
translation: Pantu mu cipangano capakubala fyonse afiba bwino, nga tekuti cifwaikwe ukukwata icabubili.

english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
translation: Pantu Lesa asangile icilubo ku bantu bakwe, ilyo asosele ati,

english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
translation: Cena tacakabe nge cipangano ico napangene na bashibo,

english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
translation: Icipangano cakubalilapo calikwete amafunde pafyo bali nokulapepa, kabili calikwete ne ncende pano calo iyakupepelamo.

english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
translation: Lelo Kristu alisa Shimapepo mukalamba wa fintu fisuma ifilipo ndakai. Itenti lyakwa Lesa Kristu ena atumikilamo calicilapo ukucindama, kabili calicilapo ukupwililika ku busuma. Ili Tenti lyena te muntu wapanga, kabili talili lya pa fintu ifyabumbwa pano calo.

english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
translation: Kristu aingile umukufye umo epela mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine. Kristu wena pakwingilamo tasendele mulopa wa mbushi no wa fiponti fya ŋombe, lelo asendele umulopa wakwe, epakutumwena ukulubuka kwamuyayaya.

english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
translation: Ukukonka ulutambi lwa Bayuda umulopa wa mbushi no wa ŋombe ishilume, elyo ne mito ya musepela wa ŋombe ilyo bafisansa pa bantu filasangulula abantu abakowela.

english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
translation: Apo ciba ifyo, palibufi umulopa wakwa Kristu! Ku maka yakwa Mupashi wa pe Kristu umwine aituulile kuli Lesa nge lambo ilyabula ubulema. Kanshi umulopa wakwe ulawamya kampingu wa mitima yesu pakuti tutaluke ku ficitwa ifileta imfwa, tuletumika na Lesa wamweo.

english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
translation: Ilyo kuli icilayo cakushila umuntu ifintu panuma yakufwa, cena cilefwaikwa ukushininkisha imfwa ya muntu uwalembele ico cilayo.

english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
translation: Pakubala Mose alefunda abantu amafunde yonse ayalembwa mu citabo ica mafunde. Elyo alebuula umulopa wa ŋombe ishilume no wa mbushi aleusakanya mu menshi. Elyo aleukana pa citabo ca Mafunde yakwa Mose na pa bantu, alebomfya umusambo wa hisopo lwena na masako ya mpaanga ayakashika.

english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
translation: Incende bapangile iyakupepelamo, Litenti lyakwa Lesa. Umuputule wakubalilapo uwa ili Tenti waleitwa Incende Yamushilo. Umu emwaleba icakutekapo icisaniko, ne tebulo ne mikate yatuulwa kuli Lesa.

english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
translation: Alesosa ati, “Uyu e mulopa wa cipangano ico Lesa alemukonkomesha ukulasunga.”

english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
translation: Kabili mu musango umo wine, Mose alekana umulopa kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa, alekana na pali fyonse ifyo balebomfya pakupepa.

english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
translation: Mu cacine ukulingana na Mafunde yakwa Mose, ni cikanga ifintu fyonse fyalesangululwafye no mulopa. Kabili elyo na mukubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi, kano baipaya cimo, pasuuma umulopa.

english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
translation: Ifi fintu cimpashanyafye ca fintu fine fine ifya mu mulu, kanshi fyena fyali nokusangululwa mu musango uyo wine. Nomba ifintu ifya mu mulu fyena fikabila amalambo ayacilapo pali aya.

english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
translation: Pantu Kristu taingile mu Ncende Yamushilo iyapangwa no muntu, iyakuti yaba iyakupashanyakofye ku Ncende Yamushilo iyacine cine. Awe, wena aingile mu mulufye mwine, pakuti pa mulandu wa ifwe alemonekela pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba wa Bayuda wena cila mwaka aleingila mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine, nasenda umulopa wa nama, lelo Kristu wena tengila mu Ncende Yamushilo ku mulu imiku iyingi.

english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
translation: Aciba ifyo, ukufuma apo icalo cabumbilwe Kristu nga aba nokucula imiku iyingi. Lelo pa nshita ino, ilyo cili mupepi no kupwa kwa nshita, alimoneka umuku umo calipwa nokwisa ileka ilambo pakufumya ububifi.

english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
translation: Umuntu onse aba nokufwa umuku umo, elyo panuma yakufwa Lesa amupingula.

english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
translation: Efyo fine, Kristu ailekele lambo umuku umo pakufumya ifyabubifi fya bantu abengi. Akesa moneka umuku wabubili, lyena te pa mulandu wakufumya ububifi, lelo ni kukupususha abo abalemulolela.

english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
translation: Panuma ya cisalu calecingililako kwali umuputule wabubili uwaleitwa Incende Yamushilo icine cine.

english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
translation: Muli iyi Ncende emwali ubulambo bwapangilwe na golide apo baleocela ububani, kabili emwali ne Mbokoshi ya cipangano iyakupilwefye yonse na golide. Mu Mbokoshi ya cipangano mwena emwali inongo ya golide umwali ubunga bwa mana. Kabili emwali ne nkonto yakwa Aroni ilya iyapukile amabula, elyo na amabwe ayapapatala apalembelwe amashiwi ya cipangano.

english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
translation: Pa mulu wa Mbokoshi ya cipangano pali ifimpashanya fibili fya bamalaika bakerubi abakulanga ubucindami bwakwa Lesa. Amapindo yabo yakupile pa mulu wa calecilika pa Mbokoshi ya cipangano apo baleita ukuti incende yakubelelwapo uluse ku fyabubifi. Lelo kwena ino taili nshita yakuti nalondolola fyonse bwino bwino.

english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
translation: Ilyo bapwile ukupekanya ifi fintu fyonse, bashimapepo nomba baleingila mu muputule wakubalilapo inshiku shonse kukubomba imilimo yabo.

english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
translation: Isham 8:7

english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
translation: Kuli ifi, Mupashi Wamushilo aletulangafye bwino ukuti inshila yakwingila mu Ncende Yamushilo icine cine tailaisuka, ilyo Itenti lyakwa Lesa ilyakubalilapo licilipo.

english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
translation: Ici cishibilo cakutulanga ifyo cili pali ino nshita. Kanshi ciletulangafye ukuti imituulo na malambo ya nama batuula kuli Lesa tekuti yawamye umupwilapo umutima wa muntu uupepa.

english: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
translation: Abena Israeli baba ngo mwangashi uwayanda uutwalisha ifisabo.

english: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.
translation: Ilyo nkafwaya, elyo nkesa mukukanda aba bana balufyengo,

english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.
translation: “Efulemu, kale ali ngo musepela wa ŋombe uyo banasha no kubelesha,

english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
translation: Tandeni ubulungami

english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
translation: Nomba imwe mubyalafye ububi,

english: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
translation: kanshi inkondo ikabuukila abantu benu,

english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
translation: Efyo cikaba na kuli imwe mwe bantu baba mu Betele,

english: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
translation: Mu mitima yabo tamwaba cishinka,

english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear the LORD; and the king, what can he do for us?”
translation: Aba bantu tabakakokole ukulaishinina abene,

english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
translation: Balanda amashiwi ya cisosesose,

english: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
translation: Abaikala mu musumba wa Samaria bakalakanka ku mwenso,

english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
translation: Bakakasenda, bakakatwala ku calo ca Asiria,

english: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Samaria na bena musumba bene bakasendwa,

english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
translation: Incende sha bubifi isho bacindika, isho shine abena Israeli bapepelamo utulubi shikonaulwa.

english: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
translation: “Bakakonka Yawe ilyo akabuluma nge nkalamo,

english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.
translation: Pakufuma mu calo ca Egupto, bakangufyanya no kwisa nge fyuni,

english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
translation: Nomba ilyo ine nacililemo ukubeta,

english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
translation: Kwena nine nalangilile abena Efulemu ukwamba ukwenda,

english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
translation: Nalebatungulula ku fikakilo fyaluse,

english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
translation: “Bakabwelela ku calo ca Egupto,

english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
translation: Mu misumba yabo mukaba inkondo,

english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
translation: Abantu bandi balikonenwa mukufwaya ukuntaluka

english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
translation: “Bushe ine kuti nakusha shani, we Efulemu?

english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
translation: Ine nshakakufokele mu cipyu,

english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
translation: “Abena Efulemu batamfya umwela,

english: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
translation: Nine nalelanda kuli bakasesema,

english: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.
translation: “Abantu balapepa utulubi ku Gileadi,

english: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
translation: Yakobo abutukile ku calo cabatama ica Aramu ,

english: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
translation: Yawe alitumine kasesema umo pakulubula Israeli mu busha bwa mu Egupto,

english: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
translation: Efulemu, awe tepakukalifya Yawe umutima.

english: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
translation: Yawe ali nokupeela Yuda umulandu,

english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
translation: Ninshi nyinabo acili nabemita, Yakobo aikete Esau Mpundu munankwe ku citende.

english: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—
translation: Kabili alilwile na malaika,

english: even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!
translation: ala ni Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
translation: Kanshi nomba imwe, bweleleni kuli Lesa wenu,

english: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
translation: Kabili Yawe alisosele ati,

english: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”
translation: Balalanda abati, ‘Ifwe tuli bakankala, natunonka ifyuma.

english: “But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
translation: “Ine nine Yawe Lesa wenu ne wamufumishe ku Egupto.

english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
translation: Ilyo Efulemu alelanda, baletutuma bonse,

english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
translation: Nga nomba imfumu yenu iyakumupususha ili kwi?

english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.
translation: Iwe we Efulemu, umufulo obe walilembwa,

english: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.
translation: Nyina nakomwe fumo, nomba kamwane takakwete amano,

english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.
translation: “Ala ine nshakabalubule ku calo ca bafwa.

english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of the LORD coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.
translation: Nangufye balulubale nga matete,

english: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’
translation: Na nombaline bacili balekonkanyapofye ukubifya,

english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.
translation: Ala kanshi aba bantu bakongoloka nga fubefube,

english: “Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
translation: Nine nalemusunga ilyo mwali mu matololo,

english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.
translation: Nomba cilya mwalya ifyo namupeele,

english: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
translation: Cisuma, kanshi ine nomba nkamwimina nge nkalamo,

english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.
translation: Nkamufukukila nge ciswango ca bea ico bapokolwele utwana.

english: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
translation: “Nkamukanda imwe mwe bena Israeli,

english: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
translation: Mwe bena Israeli, ala bweleleni kuli Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.
translation: Bweleleni kuli Yawe,

english: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
translation: Abena Asiria tabakwata maka yakutupusushako,

english: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
translation: “Ine nkalungika ubupondamishi bwabo,

english: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
translation: Nakulamima pali Israeli, nga filya umume ucita,

english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
translation: Utumisambo twakwe tukapuka,

english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
translation: Bakabwela mukwikala mu cintelelwe candi.

english: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
translation: We Efulemu, bushe mulimo nshi utulubi tukwete kuli ine?

english: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
translation: Abamano bali nokwishiba umo ifi filolele,

english: The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Hosea mwana Beri pa nshita icalo ca Yuda caleteekwa ne shamfumu Usia, Yotamu, Ahasi na Hesekia, nelyo Yeroboamu mwana Yoashi ateekele icalo ca Israeli.

english: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”
translation: Ilyo Yawe atampile ukulanda amashiwi kuli Hosea, Yawe amwebele ati, “Upa umwanakashi impulumushi ukafyalemo abana ba mu bupulumushi, pantu abantu bandi nababa impulumushi kabili nabansangukila, ine ne Yawe.”

english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
translation: Kanshi nao Hosea epakuupa umwanakashi umo, ishina lyakwe ni Gomeri mwana Dibulaimu. Asuka aba na pabukulu, apapa no mwana umwaume.

english: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.
translation: Yawe aeba Hosea ati, “Mwinike ishina lya Yesireli, pantu tapakokole ninshi ine nalimuna imfumu ya bena Israeli pa mulandu wa bupondo ubo Yehu wishi acitile kuli Yesireli. Ine nalaswa ndofye ubufumu bwa bena Israeli.

english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”
translation: Pali ilya ine nshita, ine ninshi napwisha amaka ya fita fya bena Israeli mwishika lya Yesireli.”

english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.
translation: Kabili Gomeri aimita apapa umwana na umbi, wena umwanakashi. Yawe aeba Hosea ati, “Mwinike ishina lya Lo Ruhama, emukutila munshilangulukilwa, pantu ine nomba nshakalangulukileko nakabili aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, kabili nshakababeleleko uluse nakabili iyoo.

english: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”
translation: Abena Yuda bena nkabalangulukilako, ine ne Yawe Lesa wabo nkabapususha, lelo kwena pakubapususha ine nshakemye nkondo iyoo, nshakabomfye lupanga, nangufye amata ne mifwi, nangufye bakabalwe na babendelapo bene, lelo nkabapususha ku maka yandi ne mwine.”

english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
translation: Ilyo Gomeri asumwine mwane Loruhama, nakabili aba pabukulu. Asuka apapa no mwana umwaume na umbi.

english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
translation: Yawe nao aeba Hosea ati, “Mwinike ishina lya Lo-Ami, emukuti te bantu bandi, pantu mwe bena Israeli nomba tamuli bantu bandi iyoo, na ine wine nomba nshili Lesa wenu iyoo.”

english: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
translation: Usose kuli bamunonko abaume auti, “Mwe bantu bandi, ” na kuli bankashi yobe utile, “Mwebo nalangulukila. ”

english: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.
translation: Pet 2:10

english: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
translation: Ine nkamupwisha insansa shilya akwata pa nshikunkulu shonse isha pa mwaka,

english: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.
translation: Ine nkamonawila imyangashi ne mikunyu, iyo asosa ati,

english: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me,” says the LORD.
translation: Nkamulimuna ukulingana pa nshiku isho andabileko,

english: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
translation: Kanshi ulya mwanakashi ine nkamusembeleka no kumutwala mu matololo, emo nkaya landa kuli ena amashiwi yamutembo.

english: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Ine nkamubwesesha amabala yakwe aya myangashi, ne shika lya Ako akausangula impongolo iyakulolelapo ifisuma. Emo akalanjasukila nga filya fine alenjasuka ilyo ali umukashana, pa nshita afumine mu calo ca Egupto.

english: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
translation: Efyasosa Yawe ati, “Pa bushiku bulya, ukalanjita ati, ‘Mulume wandi,’ tawakalenjita nakabili ati, ‘Shikulu wandi ,’ iyoo.

english: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
translation: Nkafumya mu kanwa kakwe amashina ya imilungu ba Baali, ine nshakaleke akalelumbula amashina yaiko nakabili iyoo.

english: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
translation: “Muli bulya bushiku, ine nkabapangila icipangano ne nama sha mpanga, ne fyuni fya mu lwelele, ne fikulika panshi. Nkafumya mu calo ifyanso fyonse ifili nge mpanga na mata, elyo ne nkondo ine, epakuti abantu bandi bakaleikala umutelelwe.

english: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
translation: “Nkakukobekela ukuba uwandi umuyayaya,

english: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
translation: Mwe bana bandi, aleni landeni kuli nyinenwe, mulande nankwe,

english: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.
translation: Ine nkakukobekela ukuba uwandi mu cishinka,

english: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says the LORD. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
translation: “Pa bushiku bulya, nkaasuka,”

english: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
translation: Isonde nalyo likaasuka iŋanu,

english: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”
translation: Abantu bandi ine nkabateeka mu calo,

english: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
translation: Nga talekele, ninshi ine nkamufuula akashale ubwamba,

english: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.
translation: Bamwane ine nshakabakwatile uluse,

english: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
translation: Nyinabo tali wacishinka,

english: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
translation: Eico ine nkasaka imyunga mu nshila yakwe.

english: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’
translation: Akalabutukila ku batemwikwa bakwe,

english: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
translation: Ulya mwanakashi taishiba ukuti nine nalemupeela iŋanu,

english: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
translation: Kanshi inshita yakulobolola ifisabo nga yafika,

english: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
translation: Yawe asosele kuli ine ati, “Kabiye nakabili, uye utemwe umwanakashi uwatemwikwa no mwaume umbi kabili uucili alecita ubupulumushi. Iwe ulemutemwafye ngefi fine na ine ne Yawe ncili ndetemwa abena Israeli, nangu kwena batwala amano yabo ku milungu iyo batemwa ukulatuula ifimamantwa fya fitwalo fya myangashi.”

english: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakulipila indalama amashekeli ya silifa ikumi limo na shisano (15) pakumushita, nalundapo na matepe amakumi yane (40) aya bale.

english: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”
translation: No kumweba namweba nati, “Iwe nomba wakulaikala na ine inshiku ishingi, kabili tecakwesha ukulacita ubupulumushi, nangu ukukwata umwaume wa pambali, na ine efyo nkaba kuli iwe”

english: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
translation: Pantu abena Israeli bali nokwikala inshiku ishingi ukwabula imfumu nangu kateeka, ukwabula ukutuulapo amalambo nangu ukukuula inceshi shakupepelapo, nangu icakufwala ca bashimapepo ica efodi nangufye ukukwata utulubi utwakupendwilako.

english: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
translation: Lelo kwena panuma, elyo abana bakwa Israeli bakabwela kuli Yawe Lesa wabo, na kuli Davidi imfumu yabo. Lyena bakalakwatila Yawe akatiina, no kulashukila ifyabupe fyakwe ifisuma mu nshiku shakupelekesha.

english: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
translation: Kutikeni kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe imwe mwe bena Israeli, pantu Lesa ali pakumupeela umulandu imwe bonse mwe bekala mu calo.

english: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.
translation: “Mukalalya nomba tamwakaleikuta nakalya.

english: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
translation: Umwangashi wakale no mwangashi upya,

english: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
translation: Bena baleya ku cimuti pakuti eco cilebapandako amano.

english: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
translation: Pa mpili epo balelekela amalambo,

english: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
translation: Lelo kwena ine nshakakande abana benu abanakashi ilyo bacita bucilende,

english: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’
translation: “Nangu imwe mwe bena Israeli mulecita bucilende,

english: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
translation: Apo abena Israeli baumalala ngo musepela wa ŋombe,

english: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
translation: Abena Efulemu nabakonena mu tulubi tulesa,

english: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
translation: Nangu umwangashi naupwa bena batwalililafye mukucita bucilende,

english: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
translation: Umwela ukali ukabolula nge mfula ya cikuuku,

english: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
translation: Abantu balelapa, no kubepa ubufi,

english: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
translation: E mulandu wine no mushili uleumina ndi,

english: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
translation: Imwe mulalufyanya mu nshita ya kasuba,

english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
translation: “Abantu bandi baleonaika pa mulandu wakukanaishiba.

english: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
translation: Ukulingana nefyo bashimapepo balefulilako,

english: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
translation: Ukubifya kwa bantu ekulebaletela ubukankala,

english: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
translation: Ala ifyo cikaba ku bantufye efyo cikaba na kuli bashimapepo,

english: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
translation: “Imwe bashimapepo, umfweni kuno.

english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
translation: Efulemu alacushiwa no kunyantililwa mu bupingushi,

english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
translation: Kuli Efulemu naba nge cishishi icilya insalu,

english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
translation: Ilyo Efulemu amwene ifyo amalwele yamwikete,

english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
translation: Pantu ine nkaba nge nkalamo kuli Efulemu.

english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
translation: Elyo nkabwelela ku cifulo candi,

english: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.
translation: Abansangukila bonse nabatwalilila ukwipaya,

english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
translation: Ine nalishiba ifyo abena Efulemu nefyo abena Israeli baba,

english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.
translation: “Ifibi ifyo abena Israeli bacita

english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
translation: Icilumba ca bena Israeli ecikabashinina,

english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
translation: “Nelyo balesenda impaanga shabo ne ŋombe shabo

english: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
translation: Abantu tababa na cishinka kuli Yawe,

english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
translation: “Lisheni intandala mu Gibea,

english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
translation: Ubushiku bwakukanda, Efulemu akashala icibolya,

english: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
translation: Abantu balandile abati,

english: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
translation: Mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli ine ndamona ifintu ifyabunani ifyo bacitako

english: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
translation: “Elyo nobe we Yuda,

english: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
translation: Pa nshiku shibili mukamona akatupuputula,

english: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
translation: Natuicefyefye,

english: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
translation: Yawe nao alibaswike ati,

english: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
translation: Eico nalimuputawile utupimfya kuli bakasesema,

english: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
translation: Ala ine mfwaya mulentemwa pe,

english: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
translation: Mu musumba wa Gileadi mwaisula bancita fibi,

english: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
translation: Nga filya ifipondo filalilila abantu,

english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
translation: “Kabili lyonse ilyo ine mfwaya ukuundapa abena Israeli,

english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.
translation: Kanshi icilumba ecileletelela abena Israeli.

english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
translation: Abena Efulemu baba nge nkunda iyishakwata mano kabili iyatumpa,

english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
translation: Lelo ilyo baleya, ine nakulabateya isumbu,

english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
translation: “Ala nabashama pa mulandu wakufuma uko ndi.

english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
translation: Tabalempapata ne mitima yabo yonse iyoo,

english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
translation: Nangu nine mbakansha no kubakosha,

english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
translation: Tabafwaya ukubwelela kuwapulamo,

english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
translation: Mu mano yabo tabatontonkanya nangu panono ukuti,

english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
translation: “Abantu balasansamusha imfumu yabo ku bucenjeshi bwabo ububi,

english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
translation: Bonsefye ni mpulumushi sha bantu.

english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ilyo imfumu ya calo yalesefya inshikunkulu,

english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
translation: Ilyo abantu balebapangila,

english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
translation: Epakulaipaya bakateeka babo,

english: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
translation: “Efulemu batobenkana ne mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
translation: Abeni nabamupoka amaka ukwabula ukwishiba.

english: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
translation: Nelyo balelipila abenafyalo,

english: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
translation: “Nelyo abena Efulemu balefusha ifibumbili fya malambo,

english: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
translation: Nangu aba bantu ine nabalembela amafunde ayashaifulila,

english: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
translation: Pa fyabupe fyandi ifya malambo,

english: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
translation: “Abena Israeli nabalaba Kabumba wabo

english: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’
translation: Nelyo abena Israeli balilila kuli ine abati,

english: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
translation: Abena Israeli balisuula ifintu ifisuma,

english: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
translation: “Abantu bandi abenefye beka ebasonta ishamfumu shakubateeka

english: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
translation: Ine nalipata cilya ciponti ca golide, ico mupepa mwe bena Samaria.

english: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
translation: Ni kabasa umo umwina Israeli ewapanga cilya cilubi ca ciponti,

english: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
translation: “Abena Israeli baletandafye umwela,

english: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
translation: Abena Israeli ala balibamina,

english: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
translation: Bataleme nga bapunda wa mpanga,

english: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
translation: Mwe bena Israeli mwilasekelela.

english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
translation: Ilyo nasangile abena Israeli

english: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
translation: Ukucindama kwakwa Efulemu kukapupuka nge cuni icapupuka no kuya,

english: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
translation: Nangu nga cakuti balafyalapo abana,

english: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
translation: Abana bakwa Efulemu ifyo mwene baletwalwa mukusantaulwa,

english: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
translation: Ubapeele we Yawe,

english: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
translation: Abena Efulemu bali ngo muti uwalokota uo imishila yauko yumine,

english: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
translation: Lesa uo ine mombela akatamfya abantu bakwe,

english: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
translation: Icipulilo ne cakukaminamo umwangashi tafyakabaliishe,

english: They won’t dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
translation: Abena Efulemu bakaleka ukulaikala muli cino calo cakwa Yawe,

english: They won’t pour out wine offerings to the LORD, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the LORD’s house.
translation: Bakaleka ukutuula imituulo ya mwangashi kuli Yawe,

english: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
translation: Bushe finshi mukalacita pa nshikunkulu shenu ishasontwa,

english: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
translation: Ilyo icinkunka cikesa, bakapashika.

english: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
translation: Ala inshita yakubakandilapo naifika,

english: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
translation: Kasesema e malonda wa bena Efulemu,

english: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
translation: Abantu balifye cimbi cimbi ku bubi,

english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees
translation: Mukacimona imwe, mwe bapanga amafunde ayashalolamo,

english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,
translation: Nine nalimuna ifyalo filya fipepa utulubi,

english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
translation: Nine naonaula Samaria kumo kwine no tulubi tonse utwalimo,

english: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.
translation: Nomba Yawe aletila ati, “Ine nga napwishishisha fyonse ifyo ndebomba pa lupili lwa Sioni na mu Yerusalemu, ine nkashitila imfumu ya Asiria palwa cilumba caiko na pa mataki yaiko,

english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
translation: Imishobo ya bantu bonse yali kwati cisansala ca koni,

english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
translation: Bushe isembe kuti lyasosa ukuti lyalicila uulibomfya?

english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
translation: Kanshi nomba Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita alaswa aletele abantu abaina ubulwele bwakondoloka.

english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
translation: Yawe uusanikila Israeli akasanguka umulilo.

english: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
translation: Imitengo umwaba imiti isuma, yonse kumo kwine na mabala yene fikapyafye nakalya nakalya,

english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
translation: Paleshalafye imiti iyancepela,

english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
translation: Mufwaya ukuti abalanda bapokwe insambu shabo shonse,

english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
translation: Inshita imo ikafika ilyo abena Israeli na ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo abakashalapo bakaleka ukulatetekela umutundu wa bantu uwapene ubalofye. Mu cine cine bakatetekela Yawe, Uwamushilo uwakwa Israeli.

english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
translation: Bamwana Yakobo abanonofye abakashalapo ebakabwelela kuli Lesa Wamaka.

english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
translation: Nangu abena Israeli bafulisha ngo musensenga wa mu lulamba lwa bemba, awe banonofye bakabwela, pantu ukuloba kwa bantu ukwapingulwa, kwamaka kabili kwamulinganya.

english: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
translation: Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita akaleta ubonaushi mu calo consefye, nga mulya mwine apangila ukucita.

english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
translation: Pantu pashalafye akashita akanono ninshi ine naleka ukulamufulilwa, elyo ninshi ni bena ebo nkalofya.

english: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
translation: Ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, nine nkabafopaula amembya, nga filya fine nacitile abena Midiani ku cilibwe ca Olebu. Ine nkatambalika umutambu wandi pali bemba nga filya fine nacitile mu Egupto.

english: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
translation: Roma 9:27

english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
translation: Ala abalwani balya bali pa Aiati.

english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
translation: Nabapita pa mupata, balesendama pa Geba.

english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
translation: Imwe mukacita shani ubushiku Lesa akamulimuna?

english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
translation: Pundisha we Mwana mwanakashi wa Galimu.

english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
translation: Abena Madimena nababutuka,

english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
translation: Abalwani lelo bali mu mushi wa Nobu,

english: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
translation: Moneni, Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita,

english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
translation: Yawe alababungula nge miti,

english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
translation: Imwe mukafwa ku nkondo,

english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
translation: Nine natumine abena Asiria pakuti basanse umushobo wa bantu abansuula, abankalifya umutima.

english: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
translation: Nomba imfumu ya bena Asiria yena tailuka ukuti nine njituma.

english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
translation: Yena ilaitakisha aiti,

english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
translation: Nine nacimfya umusumba wa Kalino no wa Kakemishi.

english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
translation: Pakapuka umusambo uuteku pa cishiki cakwa Yese,

english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
translation: Esaya 11:10

english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, Yawe nao ninshi elyo nakabili akasakatuka, no kubwesha abantu bakwe balya bashalapo mu Asiria, na mu Egupto, na mu Patirosi, na mu Kushi, na mu Elamu, na mu Babilonia , na mu Hamati, na balya bashala mu lulamba lwa bemba, na mu fishi fine.

english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
translation: Roma 15:12

english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.
translation: Ubufuba bwa bena Efulemu bukapwa,

english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
translation: Efe 6:14

english: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
translation: Yawe akemya umwela uwakaba,

english: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.
translation: No Mupashi wakwa Yawe ukekala pali ena,

english: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
translation: Insansa shakwe shikaba mukukwata akatiina kuli Yawe.

english: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
translation: Ena akalaputula imilandu ya balanda mu kulungika,

english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.
translation: Ubuso 5:5

english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
translation: Imimbulu ikalaikala umutelelwe pamo no mwana wa mpaanga,

english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
translation: Iŋombe shikalaliila pamo ne fiswango fya bea,

english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
translation: Tesa 2:8

english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
translation: Pa lupili lwandi ulwamushilo tapakaleba nangufye cimo icakucusha umuntu,

english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
translation: Muli ubo ubushiku ukemba no kutila,

english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
translation: Icine cine Lesa e pusukilo lyandi,

english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
translation: Mukusekelela ukukalamba mukalatapa amenshi mu fishima fye pusukilo.”

english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
translation: Kabili muli ubo bushiku mukemba amuti,

english: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
translation: Muleimbila Yawe, pantu ifyo acita fyakupapa.

english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
translation: Lekeni bonsefye abaikala mu Sioni bange, no kwimba baleimba,

english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
translation: Ifyo Esaya mwana Amosi amwene palwa musumba wa Babiloni, eifi.

english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
translation: Intanda shilya shaba lumo lumo, na shilya shine shatitikana pamo,

english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.
translation: Yawe alesosa ati,

english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
translation: Ubuso 6:12-13

english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
translation: Ine nkatensha umulu,

english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
translation: Abenafyalo abaikala mu Babiloni bakafulumukila mu fyalo fyabo,

english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
translation: Yoeli 1:15

english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
translation: Bakalaloleshakofye bulanda bulanda ilyo bakalafwanta panshi utwana twabo pakutwipaya,

english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe nkaluminisha abena Media pakuti bawililile Babiloni.

english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
translation: Bakepaya abalumendo bonse ku mifwi,

english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation: Ubuteeko bwa calo ca Babiloni ubwawamisha pa buteeko bwafyalo bumbi bonse,

english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
translation: Pa mulu wa lupili ulushabapo kantu, epo imisheni uluunga

english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
translation: Takwakatale akuba muntu uukekalamo nakabili.

english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
translation: Umusumba wa Babiloni walaswa ubefye incende umwakulaikala inama sha mu matololo,

english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
translation: Mu mpungu mwakulaumfwika ukulila kwa bacimbwi

english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
translation: Ee, Yawe naita abamushilo bakwe,

english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
translation: Umfweni icongo mu mpili,

english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
translation: Pakwisa filefuma mu fyalo fyakutali

english: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
translation: Pongomokeni imisowa pantu ubushiku bwakwa Yawe nabupalama!

english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
translation: E mulandu wine ukalenga ukuti mu maboko ya bantu mupomponteke,

english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
translation: Bakalaikankilafye ku mwenso,

english: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
translation: Ubushiku bwakwa Yawe buli mupepi,

english: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
translation: Yawe akalangulukilako abena Israeli, nakabili akabasala pakuti bakabe abantu abakwefye. Akalenga bakekale nakabili mu calo cabo, na benafyalo bakalaisa mukwikala nabo no kwikatana na ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo.

english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
translation: Shonse shilekweba ashiti,

english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
translation: Abantu baikalile ukulakucindika ne nyimbo sha mu maseese,

english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
translation: “Yangu ifyo wapona ukufuma mu mulu,

english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
translation: Iwe walepanga mu mutima waleti,

english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
translation: Ine nkanina apatali no kufika pa mulu wa makumbi.

english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
translation: Luka 10:15

english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,
translation: “Abakumona bakulakutamba,

english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
translation: Bushe teulya aonawile imisumba,

english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
translation: Ishamfumu shonse ishateekele pano isonde shalala mu lulumbi,

english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
translation: Nomba iwe tawakwatapo nindi,

english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo iyingi bakabuula abena Israeli, no kubatwala ku calo ico Yawe abapeele, kulya kwine eko na bantu ba iyo mishobo bakalateekwa ubusha, no kulabombela aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli. Abaikete kale abena Israeli bunkole, ebo abena Israeli nabo bakekata bunkole, na bena Israeli nomba ebakalateeka abo bantu abalebacusha kale.

english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
translation: Iwe tawakashiikwe nge fishiikwa ishamfumu shimbi,

english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
translation: “Aleni tampeniko ukwipaya abana abaume aba iyi mfumu.

english: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alisosele ati,

english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Mateo 11:23

english: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alilapile ati,

english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
translation: Ine nkalofya abena Asiria mu calo candi,

english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
translation: Efyo ine napanga ukucitila isonde lyonse,

english: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
translation: Ee, apo Yawe umwine wa fita apangile ukucita ifi,

english: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.
translation: Mu mwaka uo imfumu Ahasi yafwilemo, kwatulile amashiwi kuli Lesa ayakuti,

english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
translation: “Imwe mwe Bafilisiti, inkonto yalemufopaula naikontoka,

english: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
translation: Mu bushiku bulya Yawe akalenga imwe mwe bena Israeli mukaleipemena no kutuusha kukulunguluka no kubomba imilimo iyakosa.

english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
translation: Nomba abalanda abene bene ine ne Yawe nkalabasunga,

english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
translation: “Imwe mwe misumba yonse iya Bafilisiti, pumenipo imisowa, akukuuteni mutuule.

english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
translation: Nga kanshi ifwe tukasuka shani inkombe ishatwishila ukufuma ku mushobo wa Bafilisiti?

english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
translation: Ilyo cikaba ifyo, elyo na imwe mukalatumfya imfumu ya Babiloni amuti,

english: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
translation: Yawe nakontola inkonto ya babifi,

english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
translation: Inkonto iyi eyaleuma imitundu ya bantu mu cipyu

english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
translation: Awe nomba lino abantu isonde lyonse baleipemena,

english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
translation: Imiti ya paini ne ya keda iyalepesha iya ku Lebanoni ileanga ne nsansa palwa mfumu iyilobele,
