english: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
translation: “Icalo ca bafwa panshi ya calo cileyanga,

english: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa bena Moabu ni aya.

english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
translation: Abena Diboni baya kwitempele lyabo,

english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.
translation: Abantu mu misebo nabafwala insalu shabulanda,

english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
translation: Abena Heshiboni na bena Eleale balekuuta,

english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
translation: Umutima wandi ulelangulukilako Moabu.

english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
translation: Amenshi aya mu kamana ka Nimurimu nayakama,

english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
translation: Abantu baleabuka umukonko wa Mishingu pakufulumuka,

english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
translation: Ku mushi wa Diboni amenshi ya mu mumana uwabako yakashike cee ku mulopa,

english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
translation: Abena Moabu aba mu musumba wa Sela uwaba mu matololo babuulile utwana twa mpaanga,

english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
translation: Mu mabala ayali kale ayafunda,

english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
translation: Ine umutima wandi ulekalipa palwa calo ca Moabu,

english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
translation: Abena Moabu nangu baye mukupepa pali shilya ncende shakupepelapo bacindika mu mpili,

english: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.
translation: Efyo Yawe asobele kale palwa calo ca Moabu.

english: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
translation: Elyo kabili pali nomba Yawe nalyo alesosa ati, “Pa myaka itatufye, ninshi ifyuma fine fine ifya mu calo ca Moabu fyaloba. Pa bantu abengi ababamo pakashalafye abancepela, nabo bakabafye utufwanda tweka tweka.”

english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
translation: Abanakashi abena Moabu amano nayabapela,

english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
translation: Balaeba abena Yuda abati,

english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
translation: Lekeni fwe bena Moabu imbutushi twikaleko mu calo cenu.

english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
translation: elyo umo pa bana bakwa Davidi akaba imfumu,

english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
translation: Kwena twalyumfwa ifyo abena Moabu baba ne cilumba,

english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
translation: Abena Moabu bakulaloosha,

english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
translation: Amabala ya ku Heshiboni nayabonsa

english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
translation: Awe nomba nalililako imyangashi ya ku Sibuma,

english: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa musumba wa Damasiko ni aya. Yawe alisosele ati,

english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.
translation: Mwe bena Israeli, mwalilaba kuli Lesa uwamupususha,

english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
translation: elyo ifyo mwalimba lelo, nangu fingapuuka

english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
translation: Abantu ba mishobo iyamaka balebolokota,

english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
translation: Nangu imitundu ya bantu ishile nailulunkana nga matamba,

english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
translation: Pa nshita ya cungulo awe kwaba na kayofi!

english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
translation: Mu misumba ya ku Aroeli tamwakabe abantu.

english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Amosi 1:3-5

english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
translation: “Ubushiku bumo bwalaswa bufike,

english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.
translation: Cikaba nge bala ilyo batimpwilemo imitwe ya ŋanu,

english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Mukashalafye abantu abampendwa abakapusukamo,

english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, elyo abantu bakapilibukila kuli Kabumba wabo, Lesa Wamushilo uwakwa Israeli.

english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
translation: Ninshi nomba capwa baleka ukulasakamana ifibumbili fya malambo ifyo abene bakuula. Ninshi nomba basuulilapo ne fintu ifyo baipangila, ifili nge nceshi sha mulungu Ashera, ne fibumbili fine ifyakocelapo ububani.

english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, ninshi imisumba yabo iyamaka yashala insansalila, kabili ninshi yaba ifibolya nge misumba iyo abena Hifi na bena Amoli bashile insansalila, ilyo bafulumwike abana bakwa Israeli.

english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
translation: Ukacimona we calo umumfwika icongo cakupupuka kwa mapindo,

english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
translation: we utuma inkombe pali bemba,

english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!
translation: Umfweni imwe bonse mwe baikala pano isonde,

english: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
translation: Pantu Yawe nanjeba ine ne Esaya ati,

english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.
translation: Pantu nga filya fine ciba ilyo bashilati basabe ifitwalo ku myangashi,

english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.
translation: Ifitumbi fya bashilika babo fikashala filele nsale nsale,

english: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.
translation: Inshita imo ikafika, ilyo Yawe umwine wa fita akalapokelela imituulo,

english: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa calo ca Egupto ni aya.

english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.
translation: Bakapikula wa nsalu na balya abacenjela mu fyakupanga panga,

english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?
translation: Kwena intungulushi sha mu musumba wa Soani, ala shalitumpa,

english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.
translation: Iwe Farao nga abalekupandako amano bali kwi?

english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.
translation: Bacilolo ba mu Soani tababa na mano,

english: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
translation: Ni Yawe ewabapongolwela umupashi wa mano yacimfulumfulu,

english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.
translation: Mu Egupto tamulifye nangu umo uwakuti acitemo cimo pakwafwa icalo,

english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.
translation: Inshita imo ikafika ilyo abena Egupto bakaba nga banakashi. Bakalaikankilafye ku mwenso pakumona uko Yawe umwine wa fita apangwile ukuboko pakubalimuna.

english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.
translation: Abena Egupto bakalatiina icalo ca Yuda. Kuli onse uo bakalumbwilako icalo ca Yuda akatutuma pa mulandu wakwibukisha ishamo ilyo Yawe umwine wa fita apanga ukubaletela.

english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, ululimi lwa Cihibulu elo bakalalanda mu misumba isano iya mu Egupto. Abantu ababamo pakulapa bakalalumbula Yawe umwine wa fita. Umusumba wabo umo ukalaitwa Musumba wa Kasuba .

english: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, pakati ka calo ca Egupto bakakuulapo ubulambo bwakwa Yawe, na mu mipaka ya calo mukabamo icibumbili cimo ica mabwe, ico bakakuulila Yawe.

english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
translation: Ifyo fintu efikaba ifibukisho ifyakulenga ukwibukisha ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita aba mu Egupto, epakuti abantu nga basanswa no kukuuta Yawe mutuule, akabatuminapo umo uwakubapusushako no kubacingililako ku balwani babo.

english: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.
translation: Yawe akaisokolola umwine ku bena Egupto. Ilyo akacita ifyo, elyo nabo abantu bakeshiba Yawe icine cine, elyo bakalamupepa, no kulamutuula amalambo ne mituulo imbi. Elyo bakalamulaya ifilayo ifine fine, no kulacita ifyo balelaya.

english: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
translation: Yawe nangu akapumaula abena Egupto, iyoo kwena akabondapa. Elyo nabo bakabwelela kuli Yawe, nao elyo akomfwa imipapatile yabo, no kubondapa elyo akabondapa.

english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, kukaba umusebo umo uukulu uwakufuma mu Egupto no kuya fika na mu Asiria. Abantu ba muli ifyo fyalo fibili bakalaendeshanya, kabili abantu ba iyo mitundu ibili bakalapepela capamo.

english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, icalo ca Israeli cikaba icabutatu ku calo ca Egupto ne ca Asiria kukucindama, ne mitundu iyo itatu iya bantu ikalenga ukuti isonde lyonse likekale ilyapaalwa.

english: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita akapaala abantu ba ifyo fyalo ati, “Ine namupaala imwe mwe bena Egupto, mwe bantu bandi. Namupaala na imwe mwe bena Asiria, mwebo ine nabumba. Namupaala na imwe mwe bena Israeli, mwe bantu naisalila.”

english: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.
translation: Ine naya kukufulunganya ifyo abena Egupto bapekanya,

english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
translation: Nomba ine nkaleka imfumu imo iyikakashi, kabili iyikali, eyo ikateeke abena Egupto.

english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
translation: Amenshi ya mu mumana wa Nailo yakalacepelako,

english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
translation: Imilonga iyaitamo nayo ikalakaminako, no kutampa ukulanunka piipi.

english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
translation: pamo pene ne fyani fya mu lulamba lwa Nailo,

english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
translation: Abalondo bonse abaikalila ukwipaya isabi mu Nailo

english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
translation: Balya bapikula insalu ishawamisha bakalengwe nsoni,

english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
translation: Muli ici citabo emwaba ifyo Esaya mwana Amosi amwene palwa bena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu, pa milandu iyo Lesa asokolwele kuli Esaya pa nshita Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hesekia bateekele icalo ca Yuda.

english: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
translation: Umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe mwe ntungulushi sha bena Sodoma,

english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.
translation: Yawe alesosa ati,

english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
translation: Nani uwamweba ukulandetela ifyo fyonse ilyo mwisa kukulampepa?

english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.
translation: Lekeni ukundetela imituulo yenu iyabuwelewele,

english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
translation: Ine nomba nimpata inshikunkulu shenu isha mitebeto ya pa kumoneka kwa mweshi upya,

english: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
translation: Nangu mwimye amaboko yenu pakumpepa,

english: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
translation: Sambeni, isangululeni.

english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
translation: bikeni amano kukuwamya.

english: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ndeti, aleni tumfwane nomba.

english: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
translation: Nga mwalanakilafye ine,

english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for the LORD has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.
translation: “Mwe myulu umfweni, nobe we sonde kutika,

english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”
translation: Nomba nga mwakaana, mwantalamina,

english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.
translation: Amosi 5:21-22

english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
translation: Iwe Yerusalemu kale wali nga silifa,

english: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.
translation: Intungulushi shobe nashitalama, shampene na bapupu,

english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.
translation: Icite 19:24

english: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
translation: Ine nkamucitapo cimo imwe.

english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’
translation: Nkalamupeela intungulushi na bacilolo nga balya bene mwalekwata kale.

english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
translation: Sioni akalubulwa ku mulinganya,

english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
translation: Nomba umuntu onse uulebifya no kusangukila Yawe,

english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
translation: Roma 9:29

english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
translation: Iŋombe shileshiba uwashiteeka,

english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
translation: Mukalokota nga mabula ya cimuti ca oki icileuma,

english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
translation: Umuntu uwamaka akaba nge cani icaumisha

english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
translation: Iye! Mwe bantu ba mutundu uubifya,

english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
translation: Mulandu nshi mwabikilapofye ukulamusangukila?

english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.
translation: Ukutampila ku mutwe ukushinta na ku nkasa,

english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
translation: Icalo cenu nacisanguka amatololo,

english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
translation: Umwana mwanakashi Sioni ashelefye eka,

english: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita fyonse abula kutushilapo abakupusunsukako bamo bamo

english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
translation: Sagoni imfumu ya Asiria alipeele Taritani mushika wa fita fyakwe icebo cakusansa Ashidodi umusumba wa Bafilisiti, awe nao mushika ausansa no kuupoka.

english: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
translation: Muli iyo ine nshita Yawe aebele Esaya mwana Amosi ukufuula insalu shabulanda isho alefwala, no kufuula ne nsapato shakwe shine. Esaya nao te mukani, kanshi nao epakulaenda ubwamba, alaendafye ukwabula no kulafwala insapato.

english: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,
translation: Elyo Yawe asosele ati, “Nomba yaba imyaka itatu apo umubomfi wandi Esaya endela ubwamba no kukanafwala nsapato. Ici cintu e cishibilo ca fintu ifikaponena Egupto na Kushi.

english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
translation: Imfumu ya Asiria ikasenda bankole ubwamba abo ikekata muli ifyo fyalo fibili. Abaice na bakote bene bakalaenda ukwabula insapato, kabili bakalaenda ubwamba, na matako yabo yakabafye pa mbilibili, neco cintu cikaletela abena Egupto insoni.

english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
translation: Abatetekela icalo ca Kushi, na batakisha palwa calo ca Egupto, bakalaumfwa insoni pantu fikapwa ifyo babikako amano.

english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, abantu abekala mu lulamba lwa calo ca Filisiti bakalatilafye, ‘Moneni ifyo caba ku bantu abo kabili twaletetekela ukuti ebakalatupokololako ku mfumu ya ku Asiria. Nga ifwe nomba tukapusukila pi?’”

english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa calo ca Babiloni ni aya.

english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
translation: Mwe bantu bandi, imwe balimutwa nga filya batwa iŋanu,

english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa musumba wa Duma, ni aya.

english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
translation: Na malonda ayasuka ati,

english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa calo ca Arabia ni aya.

english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
translation: imwe mulepeelako abantu amenshi abaleisa ne cilaka uko muli.

english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
translation: Pantu abantu balefulumuka impanga ishatwa,

english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, “Pa mwakafye umo, ninshi ubukankala bwa mitundu ya bantu ba mu Keda bwapwilililafye.

english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
translation: Na pebumba lya bantu abacenjela ukuposa imifwi, ababa ifita fine fine ifya mu Keda, awe pakashalafye abampendwa. Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli nasosa.”

english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
translation: Ine ne Esaya nimona icimonwa cimo pa fintu ifyakutiinya icakutila,

english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.
translation: Ifyo ine mwene mu cimonwa nafindetela umwenso,

english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
translation: Amano yandi nayafulungana,

english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
translation: Mu cimonwa namwenefye bapekanya amaliila,

english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati,

english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
translation: Nga amona abantu baleisa pali bakabalwe, baleenda babili babili,

english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
translation: Malonda nao apunda ati,

english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
translation: Ala balya baleisa.

english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa mukonko wa Cimonwa ni aya.

english: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
translation: Mwapenda amayanda yonse aya mu Yerusalemu, mwatobapo na yamo pakuti mukwatepo amabwe ayakukuulila cipya cipya amalinga ya musumba.

english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.
translation: Mwaimba icishima lwa mukati ka malinga umwakuti muleikala amenshi ayaletula mu cishiba cakale. Lelo icakuti mupose amano kuli Lesa uwapekanya ifi fyonse ukutula na ku kale, no kulenga ukuti fibepo, awe cena nakalya.

english: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
translation: Eico muli ubo bushiku Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita alimwitile imwe pakuti mulelila,

english: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
translation: Lelo imwe mwaikalilefye ukulasekasekafye no kulasamwa.

english: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita asuka anjeba ati,

english: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
translation: Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita alinjebele ine ukuya kuli Shebina kangalila, mushika wa kwisano, no kuya mweba ukuti,

english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
translation: “Bushe iwe uitunga ukuba cinshi? Ni nsambu nshi iwe wakwata ishakuti uleibashila inindi mu cilibwe ca mu kapili, no kuimbila apakulala mu cilibwe icasumbuka?

english: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
translation: Imilimo iyo iwe ubomba, kwena intu yacindama, lelo Yawe ali nokukwikata no kukusukusa kumbi kumbifye, we muntu uwabulamba.

english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.
translation: “Akakubulunganika nga kafunda,

english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
translation: Yawe akakufumya pa mulimo obe,

english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
translation: Mu musumba onse muli akabolokoto,

english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
translation: Yawe umwine epakweba Shebina ati, “Ifyo fintu nga fyacitika, elyo ine nkatuma umuntu umo uwakuya buula umubomfi wandi Eliakimu mwana Hilikiya.

english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
translation: Eo ine nkesa fwika umwingila obe uwabucilolo, eo nkesa fwika no mushipi obe, no kumupeela amaka yonse ayabucilolo ayo iwe wakwata. Ena akalalela abena Yerusalemu na bena Yuda kwati ni shibo.

english: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
translation: Ine nkapeela kuli Eliakimu imfungulo sha ŋanda yabuteeko iyakwa Davidi. Akalati nga aisulamo, ninshi takuli umbi uwakwisalamo. Conse nga aisalamo, ninshi takuli umbi uwakwisulamo.

english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
translation: Ine nkamukosha ndii ngo lusunga, akaba uwacindama eo ulupwa lwakwe lukalamwenamo ubucindami.

english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
translation: Ubucindami bonse ubwa pa lupwa bukabikwa pali ena, ne finshikulula fyonse eo fikalalolekeshako. Bakalapeleela nge nongo nangu inweno isho bakobeka ku lusunga.

english: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”
translation: Ilyo cikaba ifyo, ulusunga nangu lukapampaminwa ndii, awe lukanenuka no kupona. Ne fipe fyonse ifikalashinindako nafyo ninshi emyonaikile.” Yawe umwine wa fita nasosa.

english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
translation: Intungulushi shobe shalifulumwike shonse pamo,

english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translation: Awe ndekeni ne mwine mwilandolesha, lekenifye ndile.

english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
translation: Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita alipekanya ubushiku ubwacimpungili,

english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
translation: Abashilika ba mu calo ca Elamu

english: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
translation: Mu ncende shenu ishawamisha isha mwishika

english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
translation: Kanshi amalinga ayakupokolwelako Yuda yalibongolweke.

english: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
translation: Mwalimwene umo amalinga ya Yerusalemu yabongolweke, mwasunga na menshi mu cishiba ca mwisamba.

english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
translation: Amashiwi ayasobelwe palwa musumba wa Turi ni aya.

english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
translation: Ucilinganye icalo cobe ngo mulonga wa Nailo,

english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
translation: Yawe napangwila ukuboko kwakwe pali bemba,

english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
translation: Iwe we Nacisungu mwana Sidoni, ala nacipwa,

english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
translation: Pumenipo imisowa, imwe mwe benda na mato ya ku Tashishi.

english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
translation: Inshita imo ikafika ilyo Turi akalabikwako pa myaka amakumi cine lubali (70), imyaka iyo imfumu imo ifwile yakokolapo pano calo. Iyo myaka amakumi cine lubali nga yapwa, elyo abantu bakalaimba Turi kwati ni cilende abati,

english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
translation: “Buula iseese lyobe, pitana mu musumba,

english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
translation: Iyo myaka amakumi cine lubali (70) nga yapwa, Yawe akaleka Turi alebomba nakabili umulimo wakwe uwakale uwabusulwishi, Turi wine akalaisulwisha ku fyalo ifya shamfumu shonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.

english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
translation: Lelo indalama isho akalamwenamo bakalashituula kuli Yawe. Tabakaleshitutila kumo iyoo, pantu bonse ababombela Yawe nisho ndalama esho bakalabuula pakushitamo ifyakulya ne fyakufwala ifyo bakalakabila.

english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.
translation: Kutumaneni mwe baikala pa lulamba lwa bemba,

english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
translation: Mwe banonkela mukwenda pali bemba,

english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
translation: Yoeli 3:4-8

english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
translation: Na bena Egupto bene bakacilimukila no kututuma ku mwenso,

english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
translation: Pumenipo imisowa, imwe mwe bena Tashishi.

english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
translation: Bushe uyu Turi e musumba wenu uwansansa,

english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
translation: Bushe nani apangile ukucita ifi kuli Turi, umusumba wa bashamfumu,

english: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
translation: Amosi 1:9-10

english: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
translation: Cenjeleni, Yawe akonaula isonde lyonse,

english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
translation: Fyonse mu musumba filifye icimfulumfulu,

english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
translation: Abantu balungumenefye mu misebo, balelila umwangashi.

english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
translation: Mu musumba mulifye ifitantala,

english: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
translation: Efyo cikaponena imishobo ya bantu bonse isonde lyonse.

english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
translation: Abakapusukapo bakalaimba ne nsansa.

english: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
translation: Na ba ku kabanga nabo bene bakalalumbanya Yawe.

english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
translation: Tukalaumfwa inyimbo ishikalafuma mu mpela ye sonde lyonse,

english: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
translation: Imwe mwe bantu ba pano isonde, ala mwapya,

english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation: Uulefulumuka icinkunka alewila mu bucinga,

english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
translation: Isonde lyonse lyalepauka,

english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
translation: Cikaba cimo cine kuli bashimapepo na ku bantu bene,

english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
translation: Isonde lyonse lyakulatalansuka ngo muntu uukolelwe ubwalwa,

english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
translation: Muli ubo bushiku, mu mulu mwine, Yawe akalimuna ifita fya mu mulu ifyamusangukila,

english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
translation: Lesa akatitikanya pamo ishamfumu shonse mu cimukanda cimo

english: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
translation: Pa mweshi pakafiita, akasuba nako kakaleka ukubalika,

english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
translation: Isonde lyonse likonaika, kabili tamwakashale kantu iyoo.

english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
translation: Ala isonde lilekaminwa no kulaumina,

english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
translation: Abantu nabakowesha isonde ku mulandu wakupula amafunde

english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
translation: Tepapa nomba Lesa natiipwila isonde pakuti lyonaike.

english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
translation: Imyangashi ilebonsa, no mwangashi nao nacafya pakuumona.

english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
translation: Insombo shansansa nashileka ukulila,

english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
translation: Abantu nomba tabaleimba nyimbo shansansa pa nshita balenwa umwangashi uukola

english: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
translation: We Yawe, ala niwe Lesa wandi,

english: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
translation: Ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kukatuusha pa lupili lwa Sioni, lelo abena Moabu bena bakanyantaulwapo, nga filya fine impimbili shinyantaulwapo muli citindi uuli mu mukanda.

english: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
translation: Bakalati baimya amaboko yabo, kwati bantu baleeshako ukowa, lelo Yawe ena akalabakumpila amaboko panshi pakubapwisha icilumba.

english: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
translation: Lesa akonaula amalinga yonse aya mu calo ca Moabu, akayawisha, kabili akayalangula panshi no kuyatobaula mu lukungu.

english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
translation: Pantu nausangula umusumba umwina wa fitantala,

english: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
translation: Eco na bantu ba mitundu yamaka bakulakulumbanya,

english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
translation: Pantu ni kuli iwe abalanda babutukila,

english: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
translation: elyo besa nge cipuki ica mu ciswebebe.

english: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
translation: Pali luno lupili lwa Sioni epo Yawe umwine wa fita akatebeta bwino abantu ba mitundu yonsefye iya pano isonde. Pakaba amaliila aya fyakulya ifyawamisha nganshi, inama ishisuma no mwangashi uwawamisha.

english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
translation: Ni pano pene epo akafumishapo ne cisalu icafimba abantu aba mitundu yonse, ne cisalu icakupa pa mishobo shonse.

english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
translation: Yawe akamina no konaula ne mfwa ine umuyayaya. Akakumuna ifilamba mu menso ya bantu bonse, na pesonde ponse akasebulula abantu bakwe insoni.

english: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
translation: Ilyo ifyo fintu fikacitika, elyo abantu bonse bakalatila abati, “Uyu e Lesa wesu, uo twalelolela ukuti atupusushe, e Yawe uyo twaletetekela. Ifwe twalemutetekela, e mulandu wine nomba tuleangila no kulasansamuka, pantu natupususha.”

english: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
translation: Pali ubo bushiku abantu ba mu calo ca Yuda bakemba ulwimbo ulu ulwakutila:

english: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.
translation: Nangu kwena iwe utentemba abantu ababifi,

english: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
translation: We Yawe nawimya ukuboko kobe,

english: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
translation: We Yawe niwe utuletela umutende,

english: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
translation: We Yawe, we Lesa wesu, nangu imfumu shimbi shalituteekapo,

english: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
translation: Pali nomba ishamfumu isho shalifwa,

english: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
translation: We Yawe naukusha umushobo wesu,

english: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
translation: We Yawe, mu kucucutika kwabo emo bakufwaile,

english: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.
translation: We Yawe, walileka tulekulilila,

english: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
translation: Twali nga fwe baimita no kukomwa amafumo,

english: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
translation: Abantu bobe abafwa, bakaba abomi nakabili,

english: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
translation: Isuleniko ifiibi fya pa mpongolo,

english: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
translation: Mwe bantu bandi, aleni ingileni mu mayanda yenu,

english: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
translation: Pantu Yawe afuma uko ekala,

english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
translation: We Yawe, abantu ababikisha amano kuli iwe,

english: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
translation: Ala muletetekela Yawe lyonsefye,

english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
translation: Alacefya abantu bacilumba abaisansabalika,

english: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
translation: Aleka amakasa yaunyantaule,

english: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
translation: We Yawe, ulalungika inshila ya bololoke,

english: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
translation: Cacine we Yawe, mukukonka amafunde yobe emo tukulolela,

english: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
translation: Ine ndakufuluka nganshi pa nshita ya bushiku,

english: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
translation: Pali ubo ubushiku Yawe akabuula ulupanga lwakwe ulukulu ulwatwa kabili ulwakosa, no kukanda cishimweshimwe ci Lefiatani , cilya cisoka icifulumuka pakwenda, icisoka cilya ci Lefiatani icifyongana. Akasalipa na cilya cimwansakabinga icaikala muli bemba.

english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
translation: Umusumba wa malinga ushelefye icibolya.

english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
translation: Imisambo ya miti nayuma, no kukontoka ilekontoka,

english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
translation: Pali ubo bushiku Yawe umwine ewalaisa pingula abantu bakwe abena Israeli, ukutampilafye ku lutwe lumo ulwa calo, ukuya shintafye na ku lutwe lunankwe, ukutendekelafye ku mumana wa Yufurate, ukuya pelelafye na ku kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto. Akamulonganya umo umo imwe bamwana Israeli.

english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, ipenga likalila ilyakwita abena Israeli bonse abalobelele mu calo ca Asiria, na babutukile ku calo ca Egupto. Bakabwela, bakesa mukulapepela Yawe mu Yerusalemu, pa lupili lwakwe ulwamushilo.

english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
translation: Pali ubo bushiku Yawe akalaimba palwe bala lyakwe ilisuma ilya mwangashi ati,

english: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
translation: “Nine ne Yawe uulisunga akasuba no bushiku,

english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
translation: Nindeka nomba ukulafulilwa ibala lya myangashi.

english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
translation: Nomba abalwani ba bantu bandi bena nga balefwaya ukulashina kuli ine,

english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
translation: Pali ubo bushiku Yakobo akashangatisha nge miti ya mishila,

english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
translation: Yawe talimuna mu bukali abena Israeli,

english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
translation: Yawe alilimwine abantu bakwe pakubatamfisha muli bunkole.

english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
translation: Ifyabubifi fya bena Israeli bamwana Yakobo tafyakabelelwe luse nakalya,

english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
translation: Yalishama amataki ya bacakolwa wa bena Efulemu.

english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
translation: Esaya ena pakufunda aikalilafye ati,

english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
translation: Cisuma balya nga tabalefwaya kulaumfwa kuli ine,

english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
translation: Nikuli balya bene Lesa atile, “Ici e cifulo cenu icakutuushapo,

english: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
translation: Eico Yawe alanda amashiwi kuli bena ati,

english: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
translation: Umfweni ifyo Yawe alesosa imwe mwe bantu bacilumba,

english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”
translation: Imwe mulaitakisha ukuti mwalyumfwana ne mfwa,

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
translation: Kanshi nomba Imfumu Yawe aletila ati,

english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
translation: Umulinganya ewalaba umwando uwakupiminako ubutali bwa mufula,

english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
translation: Icumfwano cenu ico imwe mwaumfwana ne mfwa, ala cikapwa,

english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
translation: Lyonsefye ilyo capita cikamwikata,

english: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
translation: Moneni, Yawe alipo na umo uwabulamba,

english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
translation: Cikaba nge pinda ilyatila,

english: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.
Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.
Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
translation: Imwe kutikeni kufyo ine ndesosa,

english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
translation: Bushe umulimi akonkanyapofye ukulima ukwabula ukubyala?

english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
translation: Umulimi onse atila nga apwa ukupekanya umushili,

english: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
translation: Umulimi alishiba bwino ifyakucita,

english: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
translation: Tabomfya icela icatwa pakupuma inseke sha busoshi,

english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.
translation: Tonaula ŋanu mukulashipulaula ukwabula ukuleka iyoo.

english: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
translation: Amano ayakucita ifi fyonse, ala yatula kuli Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
translation: Icitebo ca maluba icamataki ica bacakolwa wa bena Efulemu

english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
translation: Ukucindama kwa musumba wabo kulepwa,

english: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
translation: Pali ubo bushiku Yawe umwine wa fita ewalaisa ba kwati e ŋana ya maluba kabili iyalulumbi,

english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
translation: Abantu abaputula imilandu ya banabo ni Lesa ewaisa balangako umwalola umulinganya,

english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
translation: Na bakasesema bene kumo kwine na bashimapepo,

english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
translation: Amatebulo yabo umo bekala nayalamba yonse ku malushi,

english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
translation: Balailishanya abati, “Bushe ulya Esaya abo alefwaya ukufunda, ni bani?

english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
translation: Ukacimona iwe Arieli , iwe Arieli we musumba uo Davidi akuulilemo insakwe.

english: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
translation: Pantu Yawe nalenga ukuti imwe muleshipula,

english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
translation: Umulolele ifimonwa fyonse ifyo kasesema amona, imwe cakulakaana ukulamwebako. Umulolele ifimonwa imwe cikaba kwati ni kalata uwapetwa, uwaisalwa bwino bwino ne nshimbi. Nga wamutwala ku muntu umo uwaishiba ukubelenga pakuti eo akubelengeleko, uyo muntu kuti aya kwebafye ati, “Awe ine nafilwa, pantu kalata alikomenenwa ne nshimbi.”

english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
translation: Nga wamutwala ku muntu umo uushaishiba kubelenga, ena kuti aya kwebafye ati, “Awe ine nshaishiba kubelenga.”

english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”
translation: Kanshi ine nakulabapapusha ilyo nakulakonkanya ukulabalimuna.

english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”
translation: Bakacimona abantu abesha ukulafisa Yawe ifyo bapanga ukucita.

english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?
translation: Bena fyonse bafiloshafye mumbi mumbi.

english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
translation: Abantu balasosa ukuti apaba iteshi, teti pakokole kuba ibala,

english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
translation: Ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika,

english: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Kol 1:19

english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
translation: ninshi Lesa aisa kukonaula umusumba uwitwa “Arieli.”

english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
translation: Abankalwe bakaloba,

english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
translation: Lesa akalofya bonse ababepesha abanabo imilandu,

english: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
translation: Kanshi nomba efyo Yawe alanda palwa ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo, Lesa uwalubwile Abrahamu, aletila ati,

english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
translation: Pantu mukalamona abana benu abo ine nkalamupeela,

english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
translation: Abalubantika bakalakwata amano, na bantu abailishanya apo shicela

english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
translation: Ni Lesa eukesa tantika ifita fyakwe nge linga pakulibila umusumba,

english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
translation: Nomba iwe we Yerusalemu ukatelentenshiwa,

english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
translation: Iwe Yerusalemu, abalwani bobe bonse abakusansa bakolululwa ngo lukungu,

english: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
translation: ukapulikilwafye icibulukutu icamaka, ne cinkukuma, ne congo icikalamba,

english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
translation: Ifita fya bantu ba mishobo yonse ifiwililila umusumba wa Arieli,

english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
translation: Cikaba ngo muntu uulele utulo kulwa kufwa ulushile,

english: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
translation: Aleni mutiine kabili mupape.

english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
translation: Aya e mashiwi ayaishile kuli Esaya mwana Amosi, palwa bena Yuda na palwa bena Yerusalemu.

english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty.
translation: Yoeli 3:10

english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
translation: Ubushiku bumo buli mupepi ubo abacilumba bakakontamika ifinso panshi,

english: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—
translation: Pantu ni pali ubo bwine bushiku epo Yawe umwine wa fita

english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
translation: E bushiku akonawilapo ifimuti fyalepesha ifya keda ku Lebanoni,

english: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
translation: E bushiku akapashilapo impili shonse ishitali no tupili twine,

english: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
translation: Ubuso 6:15

english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
translation: E bushiku akabunshapo ne fimato fyamakwebo fyonse ifya ku Tashishi,

english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
translation: E bushiku ubo icilumba ca bantuse cikapwilapo

english: The idols shall utterly pass away.
translation: ninshi nomba no tulubi twalobelelafye tonse.

english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
translation: Abantu bakalafisama mu ncengo sha mu mpili,

english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
translation: Mu nshiku shakulekelesha,

english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,
translation: Ilyo ubo bushiku bukesa, abantu bena bakaposela imfuko no tususu

english: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
translation: Ilyo Yawe akesa tensha isonde,

english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
translation: Kanshi mwilatetekela bantunse. Ala benakufwa.

english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.
translation: Abantu abengi bakalaisa no kusosa abati,

english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
translation: Ena eukapingula imishobo yonse,

english: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.
translation: Kanshi imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo,

english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
translation: We Lesa, cine cine walilekelesha abantu bobe aba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo.

english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
translation: Mu calo cabo namufulisha silifa na golide,

english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
translation: Utulubi twiswile paa mu calo cabo,

english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
translation: Eico umuntu akacefiwa,

english: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says the LORD, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;
translation: Yawe nasosa ukuti,

english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
translation: Balalesha bakamona ukubalondolwela ifimonwa.

english: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”
translation: Ala imwe fumenifye mu nshila, mwilatucinga iyoo.

english: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,
translation: Lelo Uwamushilo uwakwa Israeli ena aletila ati,

english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
translation: ala imwe mwalikwata umulandu.

english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”
translation: Likasansaikafye lyonse kwati ni nongo ye bumba,

english: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
translation: Imfumu Yawe, Uwamushilo uwakwa Israeli, alesosa ukuti,

english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
translation: Mwatile, ‘Tukafulumuka abalwani besu pali bakabalwe ba lubilo.’

english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
translation: Imwe abantu benu ikana limo bakulafulumuka ilyo babatiinya ku mulwani wenu umo mpo,

english: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
translation: Nangu cakulaba ifyo, Yawe wena akulamulolela imwe pakuti alemupaala.

english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
translation: Elyo nao Esaya akonkenyepo ati, “Imwe mwe bena Sioni, mwe baikala mu Yerusalemu, tamwakalelila filamba nakabili iyoo. Yawe akaba no luse nga mwakuuta mutuule. Ilyo akomfwa lyena akamwasuka.

english: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!
translation: Bena babutukila ku Egupto pakuti balebafwako,

english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;
translation: Kwena nangu Yawe amulenge ukupita mu macushi na mafya nga filya mulya no kunwa cila bushiku, nomba kafundisha akalabapo pakumufunda. Takalefisama iyoo, nemwe ninshi nomba mukalamushimpamo na menso.

english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
translation: Nga mwalapumba mu nshila, no kulalola ku kulyo nangu ku kuso, mukalaumfwa ishiwi lyakwe lyamweba aliti, ‘Ala inshila ino kuno, eyo mukonke.’

english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
translation: Utulubi twenu tulya utwaengelelwako silifa na tulya utwaengelelwako golide, mukatubuula no kuya tuposa nga filya baposa ubusali, mukatila no kuti, ‘Kabiyeni uko, mwe finangwa mwe.’

english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
translation: “Na lyonsefye ilyo mukalabyala imbuto mu mabala yenu, Yawe akalaleta imfula iyakushimesha no kukusha ifikalamenamo, namo mukalafuma ifisabo ifine fine. Ne ŋombe shenu shikalakwata incende ishingi umwakuti shikaleliila umulemfwe.

english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
translation: Bacilume wa ŋombe shenu na bapunda benu, shilya nama muliminako amabala yenu, shikalalya icani icawamisha nganshi kabili icafulisha nganshi.

english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
translation: Ubushiku imisumba ya malinga ya balwani benu ikapokwa no kwipaululamo abantu abaikalamo, elyo mu mpili shonse na mu tupili tonse mukatumuka imilonga ya menshi.

english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
translation: Umweshi ukabalika nga kasuba, akasuba nako kakabalikisha ukucilamo. Ulubuuto lwa kako lukaba kwati lwa nshiku cine lubali elwabalikila capamo pa kasuba kamo kene. Ifi fyonse fikacitika ilyo Yawe akakakila no kuundapa ifilonda ifyo aletela abantu bakwe.”

english: Behold, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.
translation: Kabili Esaya atile ati,

english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.
translation: Pakwisa Lesa natuma umwela uuleisa nge lyeshi lya menshi

english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.
translation: “Lelo imwe mwe bantu bakwa Lesa, awe imwe mukalasansamuka, mukalaimba ne nyimbo nga shilya shine mwimba pa nshita ya bushiku, ilyo kuba inshikunkulu iyakucindikamo Lesa. Mwakulasansamuka nga balya bantu benda umulongo, ninshi na bamutolilo balelila pantanshi pakuya ku lupili lwakwa Yawe, icilibwe cakwa Israeli.

english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
translation: Ala Farao akabalenga ukusebana,

english: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
translation: Yawe akaleka abantu bonse bomfwe ishiwi lyakwe ilyakatama, akaleka bomfwe apapela ne cipyu cakwe. Kukaba ulubingu lwa mulilo, no kupanta, ne mfula yacitalawe, ne mfula ya mabwe.

english: For through the LORD’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.
translation: Abena Asiria bakulaikankilafye ku mwenso ilyo bakomfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe, no kumfwisha apapela ubukali bwakwe.

english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which the LORD will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.
translation: Lyonse ilyo Yawe akulabalimuna, abantu bakwe nabo elyo bakalisha insombo no kulisha amaseese. Ni Yawe umwine ewalaisa lwisha abena Asiria.

english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. The LORD’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
