translation: Ala ni kale bapekanya icininkwa ca mulilo umwakocela imfumu ya Asiria, mu mukanda uwashika kabili uukulu, ne nkuni shaisulamo pa. Ni Yawe eukesa putapo umupu wakwe uwaluma nga maluti uulebilima mukutimuna umulilo.”

english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
translation: Pantu nangu inkombe shabo shifikile kale ku musumba wa Soani,

english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”
translation: kwena abena Yuda bonse bakekatwe nsoni

english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.
translation: “Pa fiswango fya mu matololo ya Negebu,

english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
translation: Ifyo icalo ca Egupto cibafwilishako, awe fintufye ifyabuwelewele.

english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.
translation: Lesa alinjebele ine ukuti nembe mu citabo cimo imisango ya bantu,

english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD’s law;
translation: Pantu abantu pefye balatalamina Yawe,

english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek the LORD!
translation: Bakacimona abaya ku calo ca Egupto pakuti eco cilebafwako.

english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
translation: Lesa alishiba ifyakucita. Alaleta ifinkunka.

english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.
translation: Abena Egupto te balesa iyoo, bantufye.

english: For the LORD says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.
translation: Yawe nanjeba ine ati,

english: As birds hovering, so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”
translation: Nga filya fine icuni cilelemba pa cisansala pakusunga utwana twaciko,

english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Israeli, mwalibifya nganshi no kutalama. Kanshi nomba bweleleni kuli uyo mwapondokela.

english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.
translation: Pantu bulya ubushiku imwe bonse mukaposamo utulubi tushaibipila, uto imwe mwapangila na silifa na golide.

english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.
translation: “Elintu icalo ca Asiria cikonaika ku lupanga,

english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
translation: Imfumu yabo ikafulumuka, ninshi ileitutuminafye ku mwenso,

english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
translation: Limbi kukesa imfumu imo iyaba no mulinganya,

english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.
translation: Pali nomba muli mu bwanalale,

english: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
translation: Akukankeni ku mwenso imwe mwe baikala mu bwanalale,

english: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
translation: Ikumbateni amaboko pakulanguluka pa mabala ayafunda ayakonaika

english: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
translation: na palwa myunga iyikalakulila pamo,

english: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,
translation: Na kwisano kwine takwakabe muntu uukalaikalako,

english: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
translation: Lelo kwena Lesa akasuka atutumina Umupashi wakwe ukufuma mu mulu,

english: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
translation: Mu matololo mukalaikala umulinganya,

english: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
translation: Mukalaba icibote mu calo pa mulandu wakulungika,

english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
translation: Mu mayanda ya bantu banandi mukalaba icibote no mutelelwe,

english: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
translation: Nangu imitengo ikonaulwa ku mfula yacitalawe

english: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
translation: Nabo umo umo bakaba kwati ebakucingililako abantu ku mwela,

english: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
translation: abantu bonse bakalasansamuka nganshi

english: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
translation: Amenso ya bantu abamona yakalalola,

english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
translation: Abo abashiteeka imitima bakalakwata umucetekanya no kulaposa amano kufyo abantu bakalacita,

english: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
translation: Abantu tabakacindike abapumbu,

english: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
translation: Pantu icipumbu ca muntu cilandafye ifyabupumbu,

english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
translation: Ububifi bwalibipisha ubo icipumbu cicita,

english: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.
translation: Lelo umuntu umusuma ena mu mutima wakwe apangafye ukulacita ifintu ifyalolamo,

english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
translation: Umfweni kuno, mwe banakashi mwe baikala mu bwanalale,

english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
translation: Ukacimona iwe we watemwa ukonaula lelo iwe tapaba uwakonaulapo,

english: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
translation: Yawe alyebele abantu ati,

english: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
translation: Imwe mwimita imisungu,

english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
translation: Abantu ba mitundu yonse bakatulumana nge mina ya mito,

english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
translation: “Lekeni mwe baikala ukutali mumfweko ifyo ine nacita,

english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
translation: Ababifi ba mu Sioni baleikankilafye ku mwenso,

english: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
translation: Ala uukapusuka ni uyo uucita ifyalungama,

english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
translation: Uyu muntu eukalaenda ne shuko no kwikala umutelelwe,

english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
translation: Amenso yenu yakalamona imfumu mu kuyemba kwaiko,

english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
translation: Abalemutiinya kale, imwe mukalabebukishafye mu mutima amuti,

english: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
translation: Tamwakalemonapo nakabili abenafyalo aba miya,

english: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
translation: We Yawe, tubeleleko uluse,

english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
translation: Shiloleshenifye Sioni, uyu musumba uo tucindikamo inshikunkulu shesu ishakulumbanya Lesa.

english: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
translation: Yawe emo akalatulangila ubucindami bwakwe.

english: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.
translation: Pantu Yawe e kapingula wesu, uwatupeela amafunde.

english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
translation: Imyando ya mato ya balwani besu naikakuka,

english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
translation: Pa bantu bonse abaikala mu Sioni tapakabe nelyo umo uukalailishanya palwakulwala,

english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
translation: Ilyo iwe utulwilako, abantu ba mitundu imbi balafulumuka,

english: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
translation: Ifintu fyabo filalonganikwa, filatapwa no kusendwa filasendwa,

english: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
translation: Yawe alipuulama. Euteeka ne fintu fyonse.

english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.
translation: Eukalenga nokuti umutundu wa bantu ukaleikalila.

english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
translation: Umfweni uko impalume sha bantu shilekuuta mutuule.

english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
translation: Mu misebo namulalwa,

english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
translation: Icalo cileloosha no kucululuka.

english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.
translation: Palameni kuno, imwe mwe bantu ba mishobo yonse.

english: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.
translation: Icalo cakulapya ubushiku bonse na kasuba konse,

english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
translation: Ubuso 6:13-14

english: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.
translation: Emo inama sha mpanga shakulanyangala no kulaitana.

english: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.
translation: Emo ifipuululu fyakulapikwila ifisansala,

english: Search in the book of the LORD, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
translation: Fwayeni mu citabo icipombwa icakwa Yawe palwa ifi fintu ifipeema.

english: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.
translation: Ni Yawe ewalafyakanya icalo,

english: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.
translation: Yawe nafulilwa abantu ba mishobo yonse

english: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.
translation: Ifitumbi fyabo tafyakashiikwe iyoo,

english: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.
translation: Akasuba, no mweshi, ne ntanda,

english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.
translation: Asosa ati, “Napekanya ulupanga lwandi mu mulu,

english: The LORD’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
translation: Ulupanga lwakwa Yawe lwalakungafye umulopa wabo na mafuta yabo,

english: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.
For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
translation: E nshita iyo Yawe akapusushishapo Sioni,

english: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.
translation: Imimana ya mu Edomu yalasanguka amanenekela,

english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
translation: Kube ukwanga ku matololo na mu mpanga iyaumisha,

english: Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
translation: Na balubulwa abakwa Yawe bakafika ne nsansa mu Sioni,

english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.
translation: Ukubalula nga fyabalula elyo bakalaimba no kulapunda ne nsansa.

english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
translation: Koselesheniko abo mu maboko mwatompoka,

english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.
translation: Bonse abali no mwenso bebeni amuti,

english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
translation: Lyena impofu shakulamona,

english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
translation: Abalemana amolu bakulatomboka amabaka nge nsebula,

english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.
translation: Ulya musensenga uwakabisha walasanguka bemba,

english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.
translation: Kukaba umusebo uukulu,

english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
translation: Tamwakaleyangala nkalamo,

english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi na ine (14), apo Hesekia ateekele icalo ca Yuda, Senakeribu imfumu nkalamba iya bena Asiria alisanshile imisumba ya malinga yonse mu calo ca Yuda, no kuicimfya aliicimfishe.

english: Have I come up now without the LORD against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”
translation: Bushe iwe uletontonkanya ukuti ine naitendekafye pakwisa sansa icalo no kuconaula, ukwabula ukuti Yawe ansuminishe, mwa? Ala ni Yawe umwine ewanjeba ukwisa sansa cino calo no kuconaula.”

english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”
translation: Elyo Eliakimu, na Shebina, na Yoa, baeba uyu Rabushake abati, “Twapapata, landa kuli ifwe fwe babomfi bobe mu cilimi ca Ciaramaiki pantu tulomfwa. Wilanda kuli ifwe mu Cihibulu, pantu balya bonse abali pelinga ni kuno balekutika.”

english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”
translation: Nao Rabushake abankula ati, “Bushe imwe kumo kwine ne mfumu yenu muleti nimwefye mweka imfumu yandi intumineko pakwisa landa iyi milandu yonse, batini? Ala iyoo, ine ndeeba balya bantu bali pelinga, abo pamo na imwe muli nokulya amafi yenu no kunwa imisu yenu!”

english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
translation: Elyo uyu Rabushake kabili aiminina aololoka no kubilikisha mu Cihibulu ati, “Umfweni ishiwi lya mfumu nkalamba, imfumu ya ku Asiria! Ifi efyo imfumu yasosa aiti,

english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.
translation: Ilesosa aiti, ‘Imwe mwileka Hesekia amubepe, pantu takwata maka ayakumupususha iyoo.

english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’
translation: Mwileka Hesekia alemusembeleka ukutetekela muli Yawe nga alanda ukuti, “Yawe aletupokolola, uno musumba tawapeelwe mu minwe ya mfumu ya ku Asiria.”

english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
translation: Mwimumfwila Hesekia.’ Ifi efyo imfumu ya ku Asiria yasosa ifyakuti, ‘Lekeni tumfwane mu mutende, mwise mucimbefye kuli ine. Awe ninshi, na cila umo pali imwe ali nokulya kwibala lyakwe lya myangashi ne mikunyu, no kunwa amenshi ukufuma mu cishima cakwe,

english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
translation: mpaka nkese mubuula no kumutwala mu calo icabafye nge calo cenu. Icalo ica ŋanu no mwangashi upya. Icalo ica mikate na mabala ya myangashi.

english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?
translation: Mwileka Hesekia alemubepa pakulamweba ukutila “Yawe aletupokolola!” Bushe kwalibako umulungu wa mushobo uuli onse uwapokololako icalo cauko ukufuma ku kuboko kwa mfumu ya bena Asiria?

english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
translation: Nge milungu ya ku Hamati, ne ya ku Apadi, pali nomba ili kwi? Ne milungu ya ku Sefafaimu, nayo nomba ili kwi? Bushe yalipokolola Samaria ukufuma mu kuboko kwandi?

english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.
translation: Elyo Senakeribu abuula umukalamba wa mpuka ikalamba iya fita fyakwe, Rabushake, pamo ne bumba ilikalamba ilya fita, amukonkomesha ukufuma mu Lakishi, no kuya ku Yerusalemu kukuya tiinya imfumu Hesekia pakuti icimbe. Uyu mukalamba wa fita aya iminina mupepi no mulonga wa cishiba ca pamulu, icaba pa musebo wakuya kwi Bala lyakwa Kasamba ukwalebombela abantu abalecapa insalu.

english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”
translation: Bushe mulungu nshi pa milungu ya fyalo ifi fyonse uwatala aupusushako icalo cauko kuli ine? Nga nomba imwe cinshi ico muleelenganishisha ukuti Yawe akapusushako Yerusalemu ku kuboko kwandi?’”

english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”
translation: Lelo abantu baikalafye tondolo ukwabula ukuti bamwasuke, pantu imfumu yalikonkomeshe bonse aiti, “Mwimwasuka.”

english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
translation: Elyo Eliakimu mwana Hilikiya uwali mushika wa kwisano, Shebina kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano na Yoa mwana Asafu kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo, baya kuli Hesekia nabalepula insalu shabo, no kumulondolwela ifyo uyu Rabushake aciba alelanda.

english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.
translation: Elyo abena Yuda batatu baya ku mukalamba wa fita, umo ni Eliakimu umwana mwaume wakwa Hilikiya, uwali mushika wa kwisano, umbi ni Shebina uwali kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano, umunabo umbi nao ni Yoa umwana mwaume wakwa Asafu, kalemba wa fyalecitika mu calo.

english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
translation: Uyu Rabushake nao epakulabeba ati,

english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
translation: Bushe iwe uletontonkanya ukuti ukulandaukafye amashiwi yeka yeka auti e mano, nangu maka yakulwa inkondo, mwa? Bushe nani uyo wine washintililamo pakuti iwe unsangukile?

english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
translation: Mona, iwe ushintilile pali Egupto, uwaba nge nkoto ye tete iyalepauka iyakuti lilya umuntu ashintililako, yamucena mu minwe. Ifi efyo Farao imfumu ya bena Egupto aba. Kabili efyo acita na kuli bonse abashintilila kuli ena.

english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”
translation: Kabili nga wasosa kuli ine auti, “Ifwe tucetekele pali Yawe Lesa wesu,” bushe teuyo incende shakwe mu tupili ishakupepelamo elyo ne fibumbili fyakwe ifya malambo imfumu Hesekia aonawile? Elyo yaeba abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu aiti, “Muli nokulapepelafye pali ubu bulambo bumo mpo?” ’

english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
translation: “Kanshi isa nomba upangane na shikulu, imfumu ya ku Asiria. Ndi nokukupeela bakabalwe amakana yabili (2,000) nga wakwata abantu abakumanina abakuninapo!

english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
translation: Kuti wafulumuna shani cilolo umo uwacepesha pali bacilolo bakwa shikulu, ilyo washintilila pa bena Egupto ku maceleta na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe?

english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Hesekia yaumfwile ifi, yalepwile ifyakufwala fyaiko, yafwala insalu shabulanda elyo yaya ingila mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”
translation: “Mwebe Hesekia imfumu ya bena Yuda ukuti, ‘Wileka umulungu washintililamo ukubepe nga watila Yerusalemu tayapeelwe mu minwe ya mfumu ya bena Asiria.

english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?
translation: Mu cacine waliumfwa ifyo imfumu sha ku Asiria shacita ku fyalo fyonse, ukonaulafye fyonse. Elyo bushe iwe niwe walapusuka?

english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
translation: Nge milungu ya mishobo iyo iyaonawilwe ku fikolwe fyandi bushe yalibapokolweleko? Imilungu ya Gosani, Harani, Resefu na bantu ba ku Edeni abali mu Teli Asari.

english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
translation: Ili kwi imfumu ya ku Hamati, imfumu ya ku Apadi, imfumu ya ku musumba wa Sefafaimu nangu uwa ku Hena nangu Ifa?’”

english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.
translation: Hesekia apokele kalata ukufuma ku nkombe no kubelenga. Elyo aya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe, abuula na kalata, afungulula, abika na pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,
translation: Elyo Hesekia apepa kuli Yawe ati,

english: “LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
translation: “ We Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, we waikala pakati ka bakerubi. Iwe weka niwe Lesa pa bufumu bonse ubwa pano calo. Niwe wabumbile umulu ne calo.

english: Turn your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.
translation: Teya ukutwi, we Yawe, kabili umfwa. Isula amenso yobe, we Yawe, no kumona. Umfwa ku mashiwi yonse Senakeribu atumine ayakutuka Lesa uwamweo.

english: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
translation: “Cacine we Yawe ukuti imfumu sha bena Asiria shalofya abantu ba iyi mitundu yonse no konaula ifyalo fyabo.

english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
translation: Shaliposa imilungu yabo mu mulilo no kuyonaula. Nangu cali ukuti tayali milungu, lelo fyalifye ifya fimiti na mabwe fintu fyapangwa ne minwe ya bantu.

english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
translation: Kabili yabuula Eliakimu mushika wa kwisano, na Shebina kalemba mukalamba wa kwisano, na bakalamba ba bashimapepo, yabatuma na kuli kasesema Esaya mwana Amosi, ninshi bonse nabafwala insalu shabulanda.

english: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the LORD, even you only.”
translation: Kanshi nomba we Yawe, Lesa wesu, tupokololeko ukufuma mu minwe yakwe, pakuti ne shamfumu shonse pano calo shishibe ukuti iwefye weka niwe Lesa.”

english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
translation: Elyo Esaya mwana Amosi atuma amashiwi kuli Hesekia ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli asosa ukuti, ‘Pantu wapapata kuli ine pa mulandu wakwa Senakeribu, imfumu ya bena Asiria,

english: this is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
translation: Ukuf 25:22

english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Ninani uo watukile no kupontela?

english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.
translation: Ukupitila mu nkombe shobe emo utukile Imfumu insele shingi,

english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”
translation: Ninyimba ifishima mu fyalo fya kutali,

english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.
translation: “Bushe tawaumfwa ukuti nacipekenye ukufuma kale?

english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.
translation: Abantu babo amaka nayapwamo,

english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
translation: “Lelo nalishiba uko wikala,

english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
translation: Apo iwe waliitutumuna pali ine,

english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.
translation: Bamweba ati, “Ifi efyo Hesekia alanda ifyakuti, ‘Buno bushiku, bushiku bwakuculamo, bushiku bwakushobolwamo no bwakumfwamo insoni. Ifwe tulifye ngo mwanakashi uushikwete maka yakupapa ilyo inshita yakupapilapo imufikile.

english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
translation: Ici ecikaba icishibilo cobe, we Hesekia. Uno mwaka uli nokulya ifyaimenenafye, kabili umwaka wakonkapo ifikatwalako. Lelo mu mwaka walenga itatu ukabyale no kusombola, ukabyale imyangashi no kulya ifisabo fyaiko.

english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
translation: Kabili abakashalapo mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda, bakengishe imishila panshi nokwisa twala ifisabo pamulu.

english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.’
translation: Pantu mu Yerusalemu emukafuma abantu abakashalamo abomi, na pa lupili lwa Sioni pakafuma abakapusuka. Ukupimpa kwakwa Yawe umwine wa fita ekukacita ici.

english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
translation: “Eico ifi efyo Yawe alanda palwa mfumu ya ku Asiria. ‘Tayakengilemo muli uno musumba nangu ukulasamo umufwi muno. Tayakapalame naikata inkwela ku musumba, nangu ukutulamikako imiina ya maloba pakuushinga.

english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says the LORD.
translation: Inshila yaishilemo eyo ikabwelelamo. Muli uno musumba mwena tayaingilemo nakalya. Efyalanda Yawe.

english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”
translation: Ndecingilila uno musumba no kuupususha, pa mulandu wandi na pa mulandu wa cilayo ico ine nalaile umubomfi wandi Davidi.’”

english: Then the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
translation: Awe, malaika wakwa Yawe aya na mu nkambi ya fita fya bena Asiria, aipayamo ifita amakana umwanda umo na makana amakumi cine konse konse na yasano (185,000). Kutifye ulucelo cilya bwaca, awe abantu bamonafye ifitumbi fya bantu filelefye ntangali ntangali.

english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.
translation: Kanshi Senakeribu imfumu ya bena Asiria epakufuma mu nkambi nokubwelelamo. Abwelela ku Ninife eko aya ikala.

english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ninshi alepepa mwitempele lya mulungu wakwe Nisroki, abana bakwe abaume, Adarameleki na Sharesa, bamukoma ku lupanga, elyo babutukila ku calo ca ku Aralati. Elyo Esahadoni umwana wakwe umwaume amupyana pa bufumu.

english: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”
translation: Limbi kuti caba ukuti Yawe Lesa obe naumfwa amashiwi ya uyu Rabushake uo shikulu wakwe imfumu ya ku Asiria itumine kukutuka Lesa uwamweo. Elyo na pakuti Yawe Lesa obe akalipe pa mashiwi aya omfwile. Eico pepelako abashele abacili abomi.’ ”

english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
translation: Ilyo bacilolo ba mfumu Hesekia bafika kuli Esaya,

english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
translation: nao Esaya ababweseshamo ati, “Kebeni shikulwinwe ukuti ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti, ‘Wikwata umwenso pafyo umfwile, palwa mashiwi yakuntuka ayo ababomfi ba mfumu ya bena Asiria bakwebele.

english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”
translation: Umfwa, ine ndebika umupashi muli yena uulelenga ukuti yumfwepo fimo ifyamaŋwiŋwi, ifyalalenga nokuti ibwelelemo ku calo caiko, no kuleka eko nkaleka bakaye mwipaila ku lupanga.’”

english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
translation: Ilyo uyu Rabushake aumfwa ukuti imfumu yabo naifuma ku Lakishi, abwelelamo no kuya sanga imfumu ilelwa no musumba wa ku Libina.

english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
translation: Nomba Senakerubi apokelela amashiwi ayakuti Tiraka imfumu ya bena Kushi naifuma mukwisa mulwisha. Pakumfwa aya mashiwi atuma inkombe kuli Hesekia abakuyatila abati,

english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”
translation: Mu nshiku shine shilya, Hesekia alwala ubulwele ubwafwaile ukumwipaya. Kasesema Esaya mwana Amosi aya kuli ena amweba ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ati, ‘Ubangililile uipekanye bwino pantu ulefwa, tauli nakupola.’ ”

english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
translation: “Ilyo nafikile pa mushinku wa bukalamba natile,

english: I said, “I won’t see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
translation: Naletilafye awe ine nshakatale mona Yawe nakabili muli cino calo ca bomi,

english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
translation: Naletilafye ubumi bwandi bwapela, yaba e mipwile,

english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
translation: Nakutile bobuno, ninshi nalyo ndetusailafye,

english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”
translation: “Nalelila nga kamimbi,

english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
translation: “Nga ine finshi ningalandapo, apo we mwine nausosa.

english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.
translation: We Yawe, ni kuli ifi fintu abantu bekalila abomi,

english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
translation: Pa kucululuka kwandi pakaselela umutende,

english: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
translation: Ababa ku calo ca bafwa balafilwa ukukulumbanya,

english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
translation: Abomi, abomi bekafye, ebakulumbanya,

english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
translation: Hesekia nao epakupilibukila ku cibumba, alapapata kuli Yawe ati,

english: The LORD will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD’s house.
translation: “Yawe eukampususha.

english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
translation: Pantu Esaya alyebele abantu ukuti bacite icimamantwa ca makunyu, bacikakile na pa cipute icalwalike imfumu pakuti cipole.

english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD’s house?”
translation: Ninshi Hesekia nao alipwishe ati, “Bushe cishibilo nshi ico ine nalaishibilako ukuti ine nkakwata amaka ayakwenda no kuya ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe?”

english: and said, “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.
translation: “Nakulomba we Yawe, ibukisha ifyo nyenda pa cinso cobe mu cishinka na mu bololoke bwa mutima no kucita ifyawama pa cinso cobe.” Elyo kabili Hesekia alalila nganshi, tepakulila mwe.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Esaya aliti,

english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
translation: “Bwelela kuli Hesekia no kuya mweba ukuti Yawe aletila ati, ‘Ine ne Yawe Lesa wa cikolwe cobe Davidi, niŋumfwa ukupapata kobe, kabili nimona ne filamba fyobe. Cisuma, nakulundilako imyaka ikumi limo na isano (15) iyakuti ukekale pano calo.

english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.
translation: Kabili ine nkalakupokololako, no kupokololako uno musumba, ku kuboko kwa mfumu ya calo ca Asiria. Nkacingilila na uno wine umusumba.’ ”

english: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken.
translation: Esaya nao asosa ati, “Icishibilo ico Yawe alacita, icakukulanga ukuti alacita ifyo asosele, nici.

english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.
translation: Icinshingwa ici icili pa matabo ayo imfumu Ahasi yapangile, walamona uko Yawe alacibweseshamo kunuma, ciye iminina na petabo ilyalenga ikumi.” Awe icinshingwa caya cilebwelelamo, capita na pa matabo yambi, ukuya shinta na petabo ilyalenga ikumi.

english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:
translation: Hesekia imfumu ya Yuda ilyo apolele ku bulwele bwakwe, pakutotela Lesa yalishikile ulu lwimbo ati,

english: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.
translation: Pali iyo ine nshita imfumu ya Babiloni, ishina lyaiko ni Merodaki Baladani mwana Baladani, yalyumfwile ifyo imfumu Hesekia yalwele nefyo yapolele. Kanshi nao Melodaki epakutumina Hesekia kalata, abikapo ne fyabupe.

english: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.
translation: Hesekia nao atemwa, asekelela ne nkombe, ashilanga fyonse ifyali mu matala yakwe, silifa, golide ne fyanunka ubusuka, amafuta ayasuma, iŋanda ya fyanso fyakwe elyo na fyonse ifyali mu ŋanda yakutulilamo ifyuma. Mwisano lyakwe na mu calo cakwe conse tamwashele nelyo kamo ako Hesekia ashalangile inkombe.

english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
translation: Elyo Esaya kasesema aya ku mfumu Hesekia no kumwipusha ati, “Ni finshi balya bantu bacisosa, kabili ni kwisa bafumine?”

english: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”
translation: Kasesema aipusha ati, “Ni finshi bacimona mu ŋanda yobe iya mwisano?”

english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Armies:
translation: Esaya epakweba Hesekia ati, “Umfwa kuno ishiwi Yawe umwine wa fita alekweba.

english: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.
translation: Inshita ileisa ilyo ifintu fyonse mu ŋanda yobe iye sano, na fyonse ifyo ifikolwe fyenu fyatutile ukushinta ilelo fili nokusendwa ku Babiloni. Ala takwakashale nangu kamo, efyasosa Yawe.

english: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”
translation: Kabili na pali ba mu lupwa lobe, aba mubili no mulopa obe, abo waifyalila we mwine, bakasendapo bamo no kuya bacita bamutungwi abakubombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni kwisano lyaiko.”

english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
translation: Hesekia epakwiluka ukuti pa nshita akakokola pano calo, kanshi ena akulaikalilafye ku matwi tondolo, nao epakwasuka Esaya ati, “Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyo walanda lisuma.”

english: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;
translation: Nomba moneni. Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita alaswa apoke ifintu fyonse

english: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
translation: Eba abantu abalungami ukuti fyonse ifintu fikabawamina,

english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.
translation: Abantu ababifi bena bashama, pantu bena bakacimona,

english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.
translation: Abantu bandi babacushafye ku twaice,

english: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
translation: Yawe aikala pa cipuna cakwe icakuputwilapo imilandu,

english: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
translation: Yawe naita abakalamba ne ntungulushi ku cilye camilandu.

english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
translation: Imwe tamwakwata nsambu shakutitikisha abantu bandi,

english: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”
translation: Kanshi ine ne Yawe, nomba ndebalimuna,

english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,
translation: Pali ubo ubushiku Yawe akapokolola abanakashi ba mu Yerusalemu ifintu fyonse ifyo bamekelamo, filya fine bafwala ku makasa, na ku mitwe, na mu mikoshi,

english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,
translation: amasikiyo elyo na makosa. Elyo ku mitwe yabo akabafuulako insalu ishakuifimba pa menso

english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,
translation: ne mpalume ne fita,

english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,
translation: ne fisote. Akabapokolola ne mpinga isho bafwala ku molu, na mu misana no tumabotolo twa mafuta ya cena icisuma ne mikano.

english: the signet rings, the nose rings,
translation: Yawe akapokolola ne mbalaminwe, ne fipiini ifyo bafwala ku myona,

english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,
translation: ne fyakufwala fyabo ifikankala, ne finkutu fyabo, ne fikwembe fyabo, na batumba babo,

english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.
translation: ne filola fyabo, ne fitambala fyabo ifyatelela, na filya bapomba mu mikoshi, ne nsalu shabo isho bakobeka pa mabeya.

english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
translation: Mu cifulo ca kununkila akacena akasuma,

english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
translation: Abaume ba mu musumba wa Yerusalemu bakafwa ku lupanga,

english: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
translation: Mu mpongolo sha Sioni mwalaswa mube ukushinshimukila no kulapumapo imisowa,

english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.
translation: na bamushika wa fita amakumi yasano (50) ne ntungulushi,

english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
translation: Yawe akaleka utwaice ukuba intungulushi,

english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.
translation: Abantu bakalacushanya umuntu no muntu,

english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”
translation: Kukesa inshita ilyo aba mu lupwa lumo bakasalapo umuntu wabo umo no kumweba abati,

english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”
translation: Nomba pa nshita ilya ine nao akatila,

english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
translation: Abena Yerusalemu batalansuka,

english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.
translation: Imimonekele pa mpumi shabo eilebashinina.

english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
translation: Lesa wenu aletila ati,

english: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
translation: Esaya 62:11

english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
translation: Ubuso 22:12

english: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
translation: Bushe kwalitala akuba umuntu umo uwaishiba amano yakwa Yawe?

english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
translation: Nikuli ani uo Lesa apandako amano,

english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
translation: Esek 34:15

english: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
translation: Kol 2:16

english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
translation: Imishobo ya bantu bonse, ala Lesa aimonafye iyafye,

english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
translation: Yere 16:18

english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
translation: Lesa taba nga kalubi akapangwa na kabasa uwacenjela,

english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”
translation: Koselesheni Yerusalemu.

english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.
translation: Abantu abafilwa ukumona golide na silifa,

english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?
translation: Bushe kanshi imwe tamwaishiba?

english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,
translation: Ala cabumbilwe na ulya waikala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu pa mulu wa calo,

english: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
translation: Yoani 1:23

english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
translation: “Nani uo mwingampashanyako?

english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
translation: Tambeni umulu, ulolekesheni.

english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
translation: Nga nomba we Yakobo, cinshi ico uilishanishisha?

english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
translation: Bushe kanshi iwe tawaishiba?

english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
translation: Imili 17:29

english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
translation: Umfweni ishiwi ilyo lilebilikisha aliti,

english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
translation: Ngefyo na balumendo bene kuti amaka yabacepa, kuti banakuka,

english: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
translation: Nomba abatetekela Yawe,

english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
translation: Imikonko yonse ishikwe,

english: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”
translation: Lyena ninshi ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bukasokoloka,

english: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
translation: Ubuso 18:6

english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
translation: Icani ciloma, amaluba nayo yalabonsa,

english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
translation: Icani ciloma, amaluba nayo yalabonsa,

english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
translation: We wakubila, kanine pa lupili ulutali,

english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
translation: Lesa aletila ati,

english: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
translation: Kanshi imwe mwilatiina iyoo, pantu ine ndi nenu.

english: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
translation: “Abantu abakulamufulilwa bakulasebana,

english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
translation: Imwe mwakulati mwaeshako ukufwaya abalwani benu,

english: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
translation: Pantu nine Yawe Lesa wenu,

english: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Imwe mwe tufwanda tumwana Yakobo mwilatiina.

english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
translation: Ine nkamucita nge celeta ilyakupuulilako iŋanu,

english: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Mukalashiposa mu mwela,

english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
translation: “Ilyo abantu bandi bakalakabila amenshi,

english: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
translation: Nkacita imilonga pa mulu wa mpili apashaba nangu cimo,

english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
translation: Mu ciswebebe nkaleka mukalekula imiti iyo nkalimbamo,

english: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.
translation: “Bushe nani uwaimishe ilya mpalume lubali lwa ku kabanga,

english: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
translation: Epakuti abantu bakaleimwena,

english: Produce your cause,” says the LORD. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ne kateeka wakwa Yakobo ndetila nati,

english: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
translation: Iseni kuno, mwise musoselepo libela ifikabako kuntanshi.

english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
translation: Yako 2:23

english: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
translation: Lelo kwena tapali ico mwaba, ne milimo yenu yafyefye,

english: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.
translation: “Ine nkemya umuntu umo ukufuma ku kabanga uwita peshina lyandi.

english: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.
translation: Pali imwe, bushe nani uwatwebelepo libela,

english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
translation: Ala ninefye ne Yawe naebele kabela Sioni imilandu.

english: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.
translation: Kuti nga nalolesha pa milungu,

english: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
translation: Utulubi tonse, ala twabufifye,

english: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
translation: Impalume ilabasokota no kubabutusha ukwabula ubwafya,

english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
translation: Bushe kwena nani alenga ukuti cileba ifi?

english: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
translation: “Abantu ba mu fyalo fyakutali na baba mu lulamba lwa bemba, balimona ifyo ine nacita,

english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
translation: Abantu bonse balafwana no kulacincishanya,

english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.
translation: Uwaba kafula alakoselesha uwengulula golide.

english: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
translation: “Nomba iwe we Israeli, we mubomfi wandi,

english: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
translation: Ine nine namufumishe ku mpela ye sonde,

english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
translation: Imbileni Yawe ulwimbo ulupya,

english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
translation: Mako 1:11

english: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
translation: Abaikala mu fyalo fyakutali ku lulamba lwa bemba nabaletotela,

english: The LORD will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
translation: Yawe abilingana nge mpalume pakuya kukulwisha,

english: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
translation: Ine nkasangula impili no tupili ukuba ifiswebebe,

english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
translation: Abantu abapofula nkalabensha mu misebo iyo bashatala abendamo,

english: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
translation: Mateo 3:17

english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.
Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as the LORD’s servant?
translation: Bushe kwalibako umo uwapofula ukucila umubomfi wandi?

english: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
translation: Takalecita fikansa, takalepunda,

english: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.
translation: Mwe bena Israeli, mwaliimwenene ifintu ifingi nganshi,

english: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
translation: “Icinsekesha kabili ico mfwaila ne Yawe mu bulungami bwandi,

english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’
translation: Luka 3:22

english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”
translation: Kanshi nao epakupongolwela pali imwe icipyu cakwe conse,

english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
translation: Takafunaule itete ilyafwantwa,

english: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice in the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”
translation: Takasusuke, kabili takanenuke iyoo,

english: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,
translation: “ Ine ne Yawe, niwe naita mu bololoke,

english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
translation: Iwe ukaposha impofu, pakuti shikalemona,

english: “I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
translation: “Ine nine Yawe e shina lyandi.

english: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
translation: Ifintu ifyo nasobele kale, nomba efilecitika.

english: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
translation: Lelo nomba umfweni ifilesosa Yawe

english: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
translation: Yawe asosa ati, “Mwe bena Israeli, nimwe bakambone bandi,

english: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.
translation: Ine wine, nine Yawe,

english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says the LORD, “and I am God.
translation: Nine Yawe ne wasoselepo kabela ifili nokucitika,

english: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
translation: Ee ukufumafye ku kale nakale, ine ndi Lesa,

english: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
translation: Lesa Wamushilo uwakwa Israeli, Yawe kalubula wenu, aletila ati,

english: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
translation: Ine ndi Yawe, Lesa wenu Uwamushilo.

english: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ukuti,

english: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:
translation: Emo natwele ne bumba ilya fita ifyalulunkene,

english: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
translation: “Imwe, mwilaibukisha ifyacitike kale,

english: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
translation: Bikisheni amano ku fintu ifipya ifyo ine nalacita.

english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
translation: Ilyo iwe upita mu menshi ayashika,

english: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
translation: Ne nama shine isha mpanga shakulantotela,

english: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
translation: Aba e bantu abo ine naibumbila ne mwine,

english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
translation: Tamundetela mpaanga sha malambo ishakungocela,

english: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
translation: Imwe tamuposa ndalama shenu pakunshitilamo ububani iyoo,

english: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
translation: “Ine wine, nine Lesa uufuuta bumpulamafunde,

english: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
translation: Aleni natuteeke nenu icilye,

english: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
translation: Icikolwe cenu icantanshi calibifishe,

english: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
translation: Ni pa mulandu uyu nkasebanishisha bashimapepo benu.

english: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
translation: Pantu ne ukupusushako, nine ne Yawe Lesa wenu,

english: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
translation: Pantu iwe walicindama ku mano yandi,

english: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
translation: Kanshi iwe wilatunsha mutima iyoo,

english: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
translation: Ine nkeba aba ku kapinda ka ku kuso nati,

english: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
translation: Bonse abetilwa peshina lyandi,

english: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
translation: Iteni abantu bandi, bese ku cilye.

english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
translation: Longanikeni abantu ba mitundu yonse ku cilye,

english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
translation: “Umfwa kuno, we Yakobo umubomfi wandi,

english: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?
translation: Umuntu ukwenga icimpashanya ca cela elyo no kulacipepa kwati ni lesa, cine cine mulimo uwakuicushafye.

english: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.
translation: Na bantu bonse abacipepa, ninshi nabo bene bakasebana. Abenga no kupanga utulubi, ala bantufye, no kupela epo bapelela. Nabalongane bonse bese ku cilye, uleke bese bekatwe umwenso no kusebana basebane.

english: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.
translation: Esaya 48:12

english: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.
translation: Pambi Kabasa wa mbao kuti aya fwaya ifimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda, efyo aisa bomfya, pambi kuti asala icimuti ca oki, pambi icamwengele umo uwaba mu mutengo. Limbi kuti kabasa wine ewailimbila umwine umuti walepesha, wasuka nao wakula ilyo ulelokelelwa ne mfula.

english: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.
translation: Ku cimuti cimo cine, umuntu umo kuti aputulako icakukosesha umulilo, elyo kabili abuula icisheleko, abasamo na kalubi kamo. Kuti aputulako icakukosesha umulilo uwakonta, no wakufumbikamo umukate, elyo kabili abuula icisheleko, apangamo umulungu umo, no kupepa eo alapepa.

english: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”
translation: Kanshi ku cimuti cimo cine kuti aputulako icakukosesha umulilo, aocelapo ne nama, alya, no kutemwa atemwa. Ilyo aleonta umulilo, aletifye, “We mulilo nobe ubusuma. Eeya, awe nomba nakangabuka.”

english: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”
translation: Ubuso 1:17

english: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.
translation: Kwena aba bantu, iyoo ni mpelwamano, tabaishiba ifyo bacita. Balikutwa, tabamona kantu, ne mitima yabo yalifumbatwa.

english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”
translation: Abantu abapanga utulubi tabatontonkanya nelyo panono nakalya, tabakwata mano ayakumona ukuti, “Icimuti ico ine mputwileko nakoseshako umulilo, na pa mulilo waciko ine nimfumbikapo umukate, ningocapo ne nama, no kulya nindya. Elyo kabili icisheleko, bushe kuti eco ine napangamo icilubi icabunani, icakuti ine ndefukankilako, no kulacipepa, nacofye icimuti?”

english: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Nine nakubumba iwe,

english: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”
translation: Cimo cinefye no kulya imito. Amano yabo ayabupuba yabaloshafye kumbi kumbi. Tabeluka nakalya icakuti batile, “Ici cintu njikete mu minwe, bushe tecabufifye.”

english: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
translation: Ine nalikubelelako uluse ku bumpulamafunde bobe

english: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.
translation: “Iwe we mulu, akwaula utupundu twansansa,

english: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;
translation: Efyasosa Yawe Kalubula obe,

english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
translation: Nine mfulunganya ifisesema bakasesema babufi,

english: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’
translation: Nine mfikilisha ifisobela umubomfi wandi,

english: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’
translation: Nine nkamya bemba mukalamba ilyo namweba ukuti akame,

english: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”
translation: Njeba na Sairasi nati, ‘Iwe, uli mucemi wandi,

english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;
translation: Pantu mu calo icauma ndi ine nkaletamo amenshi,

english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
translation: Bonse bakalakula nge cani icilokelelwa bwino ne mfula,

english: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to the LORD,’ and honor the name of Israel.”
translation: Umo akatila, ‘Ine ndi muntu wakwa Yawe,’

english: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ne uteeka no kulubula imwe mwe bena Israeli,

english: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.
translation: Nani uuli nga ine? Kaeminine, alande,

english: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”
translation: Kanshi mwilatunsha mitima, mwitiina,

english: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.
translation: Abantu bonse abapanga utulubi, fipuba fyabantu, no tulubi twine uto aba bantu bacankilwa nganshi nato twine tunangwafye. Abantu abapepa iyi milungu, awe balikutwa, kabili fipubafye, no kusebana bakasebaninapo.
