english: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ku musubwa wakwe Sairasi ukuti,

english: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”
translation: Cabulanda ku mwana uwingapama ukweba wishi ati,

english: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!
translation: “Ine ne Yawe, Lesa Wamushilo uwakwa Israeli kabili kabumba wakwe,

english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.
translation: Ine neka nine nabumba isonde,

english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Nine wine nkemya Sairasi pakuti abombepo umulimo umo uwakulungika ifintu ifyo ine napanga mu mutima wandi.

english: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati,

english: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”
translation: Cine cine uli Lesa uwaifisa,

english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.
translation: Abapanga utulubi bonse bakasebana,

english: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli bena Yawe akabapususha,

english: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.
translation: Pantu efyo asosa Yawe uwabumbile umulu,

english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.
translation: Atila, “Nshilandila mu bumfisolo iyoo,

english: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.
translation: Nine wine nkaya ndekupekanishishako umwakuti ukalepita

english: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.
translation: Roma 9:20

english: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.
translation: Iseni muilondolwele umulandu wenu mu cilye,

english: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
translation: “Kanshi imwe mwe bantu bonse mwe ba pano isonde,

english: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.
translation: Nalapa, napalifye ine wine, nati,

english: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.
translation: Bonse bakalalanda pali ine abati,

english: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!
translation: Lelo ni muli Yawe emo bamwana Israeli bakabela abakaele,

english: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.
translation: Nkakupeela ifyuma ifyo batutila umwafisama

english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
translation: Ico ine nakusalila,

english: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
translation: Ine nine Yawe, takwaba na umbi iyoo,

english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.
translation: Ico ine nacitila ifi ni pakuti

english: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.
translation: Ine nine mpanga ulubuuto ne mfifi ine,

english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.
translation: “We mulu akuloka ubololoke nge mfula,

english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?
translation: “Cabulanda ku uumana na kabumba wakwe.

english: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.
translation: Akalubi ketwa Beli nakakontama,

english: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
translation: Ukutulafye na ku citendekelo,

english: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.
translation: Nketa kapumpe ukufuma ku kabanga,

english: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
translation: Umfweni kuno, mwe bantu bakosa imitwe,

english: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.
translation: Ala ubololoke bwandi ine nimbupalamika,

english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
translation: Bainama no kukontamina panshi,

english: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.
translation: “Umfweni kuno, mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo,

english: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
translation: Ala nine Lesa wenu, no kuba efyo nakulaba,

english: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
translation: “Nga nani mwingampalanyako, nangu ukuninganyako?

english: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.
translation: Abantu balafukumuna golide muli batumba babo,

english: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.
translation: Balawimya no kuusendela pa mabeya,

english: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
translation: “Ala muleibukisha uyu mulandu mwe babifi ba bantu mwe,

english: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
translation: Muleibukisha ifintu ifyacitike kale,

english: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.
translation: “Isa pano panshi, ikala mu lukungu,

english: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’
translation: “Iwe wacetekelafye mu kubifya kobe,

english: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.
translation: Nomba ishamo likakwishila,

english: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.
translation: “Ale akusunga amanga yobe ayashaifulila,

english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.
translation: Nangu abakukupandako amano bafula shani,

english: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.
translation: “Abo bantu bakabafye ngo tupimbili,

english: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.
translation: Efyo bakaba aba bantu kuli iwe,

english: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.
translation: Ale buula impelo, ulepela ubunga.

english: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”
translation: Epakuti ushale ubwamba,

english: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Umulubushi wesu Yawe, umwine wa fita e shina lyakwe,

english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.
translation: “Iwe kabelame umwafiita, kabili wikalefye tondolo,

english: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.
translation: Ine nalifulilwe abantu bandi,

english: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.
translation: Iwe mu mano yobe waleti, ‘Ine nkabelelela ukuba namfumu pe.’

english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’
translation: “Umfwa kuno, iwe we watemwa ukuliila pa calo,

english: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.
translation: Ala ayo mashamo yonse yabili ukapulikilwafye yakuponena,

english: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—
translation: “Umfweni kuno, imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo,

english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
translation: Nga filya fine silifa alopololwa mwilungu lya mulilo,

english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
translation: Ico ine ndecitila ifi ni pa mulandu wa ine ne mwine,

english: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
translation: “Umfwa kuno we Yakobo,

english: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.
translation: “Longaneni bonse, mwise mukutike.

english: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.
translation: Ine wine nine nalanda,

english: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.
translation: “Kanshi imwe palameni kuno,

english: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
translation: Ubuso 1:17

english: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
translation: Imwe amulabika umutima ku mafunde yandi,

english: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”
translation: Ubufyashi bobe nga bwafula ngo musensenga uwapeleka uushingapendwa,

english: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of Armies is his name.
translation: Kwena mulacankwa pakulaita amuti, ‘Ifwe tuli bena musumba wamushilo,’

english: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!”
translation: “Fumeni mu musumba wa Babiloni,

english: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.
translation: Ilyo Yawe alepisha abantu bakwe mu matololo,

english: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
translation: Yawe alisosa ati,

english: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.
translation: Kale ine nalesoselapo kabela ifili nokucitika,

english: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
translation: Pantu ine nalishiba ukuti imwe mwalikosa imitwe,

english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’
translation: Kanshi ine epakumwebelapo libela ifi fyonse,

english: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.
translation: “Ifi ifintu mwalifyumfwile kale, moneni fyalicitika,

english: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
translation: Ifi fintu fipya tafyaliko kale iyoo,

english: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
translation: Imwe tamwatala amumfwa kabili tamwatala amwishiba bwino,

english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.
translation: “Pa mulandu we shina lyandi,

english: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.
translation: Umfweni kuno, mwe bantu ba mishobo iya kutali,

english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.
translation: Tabakabale abomfwa insala nangu icilaka,

english: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.
translation: Ine nkacita impili shandi shonse ukuba umusebo,

english: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”
translation: Bahi 4:12

english: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
translation: Akwaula ne nsansa, iwe we mulu,

english: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
translation: Lelo Sioni ena atilafye,

english: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
translation: “Bushe umwanakashi kuti alabako ku kana kakwe akanya akaleonka?

english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
translation: Ubuso 1:16

english: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.
translation: Abana bobe abalaisa mukulakukuula cipya cipya bali mu nshila,

english: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says the LORD, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.
translation: Sansula amenso, uloleshe monse monse.

english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
translation: “Icalo cobe icali icaonaika kale,

english: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.
translation: Alenga na kanwa kandi ukuti kabe akatwa ngo lupanga,

english: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’
translation: Abana bobe abafyalilwe muli bunkole ilyo wali mu cililishi,

english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”
translation: Elyo nomba nobe ukaleiipusha we mwine mu mutima auti.

english: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe,

english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
translation: Bushe impalume kuti umo aipoka ifyo yatapa?

english: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.
translation: Yawe nao epakwasuka ati,

english: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
translation: Nkalenga abakucusha ukulya imibili yabo,

english: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”
translation: Anjeba no kunjeba ati,

english: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”
translation: Na ine nalyaswike nati,

english: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.
translation: Yere 1:5

english: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
translation: Yawe asosa ati,

english: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”
translation: Ifi efisosa Yawe. Kalubula kabili Uwamushilo uwakwa Israeli asosa kuli uyo abantu basuulisha nganshi, uo umushobo wa bantu wapatisha, uo ne shamfumu ishikali shateeka ubusha. Yawe asosa ati,

english: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,
translation: Yawe alesosa aletila,

english: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.
translation: Ukeba aba mu fifungo auti, ‘Fumeni.’

english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, abanakashi cine lubali bakasakatila umwaume umo no kulamweba abati,

english: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
translation: Pa bushiku bulya Umusambo wakwa Yawe ukawama no kucindama, ne fitwalo fya mu calo fikaba ifisuma kabili fikaba e cilumba no bucindami bwa bakapusuka mu Israeli.

english: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
translation: Bonsefye abakashalapo mu Sioni, ekutila mu Yerusalemu, abo Lesa asala ukushalapo, bakulaitwa abamushilo.

english: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
translation: Mu nshita iyo Imfumu ikasamba ubusali bwa bana banakashi ba mu Sioni, kabili akasamfya imilopa yonse iyasumine mu Yerusalemu. Akacita ifi ku mupashi wa bupingushi no wa mulilo.

english: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
translation: Elyo Yawe akesa lenga ikumbi ukushinguluka pa lupili lonse ulwa Sioni, na pali bonse abakalongana mu nshita ya kasuba elyo ubushiku kukaba icengelo ca mulilo wa lubingu ululebilima, pantu pa mulu wa fyonse pena pakaba ubucindami bwakwe.

english: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
translation: Ubucindami bwakwe ebukaba icintelelwe ku cikabilila pa musumba pa nshita ya kasuba, no kulenga ukuba incende iyakufisamamo, ne yakuubamo imfula ne cimwela.

english: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.
translation: Kanshi imwe bonse mwe bakwatila Yawe akatiina,

english: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.
translation: Nomba imwe bonse mwe bakosha umulilo,

english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.
translation: Cinshi pashasangilwe umuntu nelyo umo ilyo naishile?

english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”
translation: Ine ndafwika umulu ifyafiita,

english: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
translation: Yawe alimfunda ne mubomfi wakwe ifyakusosa,

english: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
translation: Yawe alimpeela amano ayakwiluka ifintu,

english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
translation: Inuma yandi nalipeele ku balempumaula.

english: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
translation: Pantu ni Mfumu Yawe eungafwa

english: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
translation: Lesa uwakunandilako ukuti ine ndi wakaele ali mupepi.

english: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.
translation: Ine ni Mfumu Yawe umwine eumpokako.

english: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek the LORD. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.
translation: “Umfweni kuli ine mwe bakonkelela ubololoke,

english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
translation: Bushe teiwe wine wakamishe amenshi ya muli bemba mwitenga ilyashika,

english: Those ransomed by the LORD will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
translation: Kanshi abantu abo walubula we Yawe bakabwela,

english: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
translation: Yawe nakabili aletila ati,

english: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?
translation: Kuti mwalaba shani Yawe uwamubumba,

english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.
translation: Bankole ababa mu fifungo, balaswa balubuke.

english: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. the LORD of Armies is his name.
translation: Pantu ine nine Yawe, Lesa wenu,

english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”
translation: Nalibika amashiwi yandi mu kanwa kobe,

english: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the LORD’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.
translation: Buuka, buuka iwe Yerusalemu, ale ima!

english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.
translation: Pa bana baume bonse abo wafyele

english: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.
translation: Lolesheni kuli shinwe Abrahamu,

english: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the LORD’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.
translation: Mu finshoko fyonse ifya misebo,

english: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
translation: Eico umfweni ici mwe bena Yerusalemu mwe balecula,

english: Your Lord GOD, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe, Lesa wenu,

english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”
translation: Nimbuula ulu lukombo no kulubika mu minwe ya bamucusha,

english: For the LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
translation: Cine cine Yawe akalangulukilako umusumba wa Sioni,

english: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.
translation: “Umfweni kuli ine, mwe bantu bandi,

english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.
translation: Ubulungami bwandi nabupalama,

english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
translation: Inwineni amenso yenu ku mulu,

english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.
For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”
translation: Pantu abo bantu icipelebesha ca bushiku cikabalya nge nsalu,

english: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?
translation: Buuka, buuka we kuboko kwakwa Yawe no kufwala amaka yobe,

english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.
translation: Buuka, buuka iwe Sioni, ale ima,

english: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translation: Yawe nalanga amaka yakwe ayamushilo

english: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry the LORD’s vessels.
translation: Endesheni imwe, fumenimo mu ncende ilya,

english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
translation: Uno muku wena tamwaime mu kampampa iyoo,

english: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—
translation: Lelo kwena abantu abengi balisungwike ilyo bamumwene,

english: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.
translation: Nahum 1:15

english: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!
translation: Ubuso 21:2

english: For the LORD says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”
translation: Yawe alemweba ati, “Imwe bamuposele mu busha ukwabula ukuti balombepo kamo. Kanshi muli nokulubulwafye ukwabula ukulipililapo akantu.”

english: For the Lord GOD says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.
translation: Pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe Lesa umwine wa maka yonse ati, “Kale mwe bantu bandi mwaikele mu bweni mu calo ca Egupto, mukulekelesha abena Asiria nabo balamuteeka buluku buluku, ukwabula no mulandu.”

english: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says the LORD, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says the LORD, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.
translation: Yawe nasosa ati, “Elyo pali nomba cili shani kuli ine pano apo abantu bandi balibasenda muli bunkole ukwabula ukulombapo kamo? Elyo abo bantu bamuteeka imwe, tepakuilumbanya no kulaitutubula, kabili akasuba konse basaalula ishina lyandi no kunsuula.

english: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”
translation: Nomba lino lyena, abantu bandi bakeshiba ishina lyandi, ukuti kanshi ine nine Yawe uwalandilepo libela, ee nine wine.”

english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
translation: Ala yaliyemba pa mpili amakasa ya baleta imbila nsuma,

english: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion.
translation: Umfweni, abalinda umusumba abo balepunda ne nsansa,

english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.
translation: Awileni capamo utupundu,

english: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?
translation: “Ngo wingasumina ifi fintu tuleshimika, nani?

english: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
translation: “Kwena ni Yawe ewafwaile umubomfi wakwe afwantwe no kucula icibi,

english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
translation: Epakuti amacushi yakwe yonse nga yapwa mu mweo wakwe akasansamuka nakabili.

english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
translation: E mulandu wine na ine nkamutekela apacindama pakati ka bacindami.

english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
translation: Ala ni Yawe umwine ewafwaile ukuti umubomfi wakwe akulile pa cinso cakwe,

english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
translation: Ifwe twalimusuulile, tatwamuposeleko na mano nakalya.

english: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
translation: “Cine cine alibuulile amacushi ayo twali nokuposwamo nifwe.

english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
translation: Lelo kwena ni pa mulandu wa bumpulamafunde bwesu ecalengele ukuti bamucenaule ifyo,

english: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
translation: Bonsefye ifwe twali nge mpaanga ishaluba,

english: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
translation: “Balemutintanya, balemucusha,

english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
translation: Balimwikete mu lufyengo, bamupeela umulandu,

english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
translation: Bapekenye inshinshi yakwe pamo pene ne ntalamisoka,

english: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says the LORD.
translation: “Aula utupundu no kwimba ulwimbo lwansansa, we wabafye iŋumba,

english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.
translation: Nangu impili shingaseshiwa no tupili twasholomoka,

english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
translation: “Owe, we musumba ulanda, we wasensenunwa ne cimwela,

english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
translation: Insonshi sha mayanda yobe ine nkashikuulila na mabwe yamutengo aya rubi,

english: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.
translation: Abantu bobe abaume bakafundwa kuli Yawe umwine,

english: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.
translation: Mu bololoke emo uli nokushimpwa.

english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.
translation: Bamo nga bakalakusansa awe ninshi teine nkalalenga iyoo,

english: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.
translation: “Wamona, ine nine nabumba kafula,

english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says the LORD.
translation: Lelo ifyanso fyonse ifyo bapanga pakukulwishishako, iwe fikakufilwa,

english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
translation: “Kushako itenti ilyo wikalamo.

english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.
translation: Pantu ukakushako imipaka yobe ku kuso na ku kulyo,

english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.
translation: “Wilatiina, pantu iwe tawakasebane na limbi,

english: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
translation: Pantu Kabumba obe akaba mwina mobe,

english: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
translation: Pantu Yawe ewakwita

english: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.
translation: “Ine nalikushile iwe pa kashita kamo no kukulekelesha,

english: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
translation: Ine nalikufulilwe no kukusha,

english: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
translation: “Pantu ici caba kuli ine nga mu nshiku shakwa Noa,

english: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
translation: “Imwe bonse mwe bacula ku cilaka,

english: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;
translation: “Nga filya fine imfula no bunga bwa mfula fitula mu mulu,

english: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
translation: efyo na mashiwi yandi yaba ayo ine nanda.

english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
translation: “Ala cine cinefye imwe mukafuma ne nsansa,

english: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for the LORD, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”
translation: Mulya mwaba imyunga pali nomba, mukalakula ifimuti fya paini,

english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.
translation: Nga mulandu nshi mwingalaposela impiya pa fintu ifishili fyakulya?

english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
translation: “Kutikeni kuno, imwe mwe bantu bandi, iseni kuno,

english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.
translation: Nine nasontele Davidi pakuti abe kambone ku bantu bonse,

english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”
translation: Kanshi nomba nimwe muketa imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
translation: Ubuso 21:6

english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.
translation: Imwe mwe babifi lekeni imisango yenu,

english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.
translation: “Pantu ifyo ine ntontonkanya tafyaba ngefyo imwe mutontonkanya iyoo,

english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
translation: “Ngefi fine umulu wasansuka ukucila icalo,

english: The LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
translation: Pantu intungulushi shonse ishaba no mulimo wakusoka abantu bandi,

english: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.
translation: Ishi ntungulushi shaba nge mbwa ishatemwisha ukulya

english: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”
translation: Basosa abati, “Iseni, katulete bane umwangashi,

english: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
translation: Akulaba uwapaalwa umuntu onse uucita ifi fintu,

english: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”
translation: “Umwinafyalo uwaisa ilunda kuli ine ne Yawe elatila ati,

english: For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
translation: Yawe aletila kuli bamutungwi,

english: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.
translation: ninshi ine nkamupeelapo cimo mu ŋanda yandi na mu fibumba fyaiko,

english: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,
translation: “Imwe mwe benafyalo, mwe baisa ilunda kuli ine ne Yawe,

english: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”
translation: Imwe nkamuleta ku lupili lwandi ulwamushilo,

english: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”
translation: Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa maka yonse, uulonganya bankole abena Israeli.

english: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.
translation: Iseni mwe fiswango fyonse ifya mu mpanga,

english: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.
translation: Abantu abololoke balafwa,

english: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
translation: Nangu munaka kulwa kufwaya fwaya imilungu,

english: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
translation: Nani uo imwe muletiina no kusakamikwako

english: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
translation: Nomba ine nalasosela pakabalika ifyaba imyendele yenu,

english: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
translation: Mwakulati nga mwakuuta mutuule,

english: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
translation: Kabili cikasoswa ukuti,

english: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
translation: Pantu efyo asosa uwasansama kabili uwapulama

english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
translation: Pantu nshakatwalilile ukubomanya,

english: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
translation: Ine nalibafulilwe pa mulandu wakuba no lwinso lwa fyabubifi.

english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
translation: Ine nalimona ifyo bacita, lelo kwena nkabondapa.

english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”
translation: Pa milomo ya bantu bakwe abaloosha nomba pakaba icitwalo cakulumbanya,

english: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
translation: Abantu abekala imikalile iyalungama,

english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
translation: Nomba ababifi bena baba nga bemba uusunkana,

english: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
translation: “Ababi, awe bena tabakamone mutende.”

english: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
translation: Lelo imwe iseni kuno mulubulule,

english: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,
translation: Nani uo muleseka imwe?

english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
translation: Imwe mwaliba abapimpa ukucita ifyalunkumbwa

english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
translation: Emo mutola amabwe ayatelela ayo mucindika ngo tulubi twenu,

english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
translation: Imwe muya pa mpili ishasansama epo mwaya bika imisengele yenu,

english: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made you a covenant with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
translation: Ku numa ya fiibi fyenu lwamukati ku maingwe,

english: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
translation: Imwe mutala mulenda amalendo no kusenda amafuta ya miolifa

english: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
translation: “Iwe pundishafye, wicilikila ishiwi,

english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
translation: nga mwalapeelako abali ne nsala icakulya,

english: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
translation: Lyena ninshi ne Yawe nkalamutungulula lyonsefye,

english: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.
translation: Mukalabuukulula ifibolya fyakale,

english: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of the LORD honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.
translation: awe ninshi lyena mukalakwata insansa isha kuli Yawe.

english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.
translation: Kwena balampepa inshiku shonse,

english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.
translation: Abantu batila abati,

english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.
translation: Ilyo muleka ukulya, ninshi kwaba ukulatintana,

english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
translation: Bushe uyu e musango wakuleka ukulya untu nasala?

english: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
translation: “Bushe teuyu musango wakuleka ukulya uo ine mfwaya?

english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?
translation: Abali ne nsala mulebapako icakulya,

english: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.
translation: Awe ninshi lyena icikuuku candi cikabengeshima pali imwe nge mibengelele ya kasuba akaletula,

english: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;
translation: Lyena mukalati nga mwanjita ne Yawe namwasuka.

english: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
translation: Moneni ukuboko kwakwa Yawe takwaipipa ukwakuti kufilwe ukumupususha imwe iyoo,

english: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.
translation: Tupampantilafye icibumba nge mpofu,

english: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.
translation: Bonse tubuluma nge fiswango fya bea,

english: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
translation: We Yawe, ifyakupula amafunde ifyo ifwe twacita kuli iwe, ala fingi.

english: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
translation: Ifwe twalikusangukila we Yawe, twalikufumyako amano,

english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.
translation: Umulinganya ifwe twaliuleka,

english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
translation: Lesa alasunguka pakumona ukuti takwaba nelyo umo uutulanyako abo balecusha.

english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
translation: Akulafwala ubulungami kwati e cakufwala cakwe icakucinga icifuba.

english: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.
translation: Akalimuna abalwani bakwe pakulinganya pafyo bacita,

english: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.
translation: Eico abantu bakatiina Yawe ukufuma ku masamba konse,

english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
translation: Ala, ifyabubifi fyenu efyamupaatula kuli Lesa wenu

english: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.
translation: Yawe aleeba abantu bakwe ati,

english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”
translation: “Elyo kabinge ine napangana nabo icipangano icakuti, ine pano ndi, namupeela Umupashi wandi na mashiwi yandi ayo nabika mu kanwa kenu. Kanshi imwe muli nokulayabeela, no kulafundako na bana benu na beshikulu benu ukufuma pali lelo ukushintafye no kukapela inshiku.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.
translation: Amaboko yenu yalikowela ku mulopa wa abo mwafyenga,

english: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
translation: Nga mwaya ku cilye, tapali uulubulwisha aba mulandu mu cishinka,

english: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
translation: Batota amani aya mafwafwa,

english: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.
translation: Ifyo bapikula teti nangu umo afwalwe nge nsalu iyoo,

english: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.
translation: Amakasa yabo lyonse yabutukila ukucita ifyabipa,

english: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.
translation: Bena tabaishiba inshila yamutende iyoo,

english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
translation: Twashininkisha ukuti ecalenga ukuti umulinganya ube ukutali na ifwe,

english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
translation: “Ine kanyimbile umutemwikwa wandi ulwimbo,

english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
translation: Mwibala lya myangashi ilikulile ba eka ikumi

english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
translation: Mukacimona imwe mwe babuuka lucelocelo no kutampa ukunwa ifikola,

english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
translation: Ilyo mucita inshikunkulu shenu imwe mulalisha amaseese ne nsango,

english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.
translation: Mwe bantu e mulandu wine balaswa bamusendele muli bunkole ukwabula ukwishiba.

english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.
translation: Icalo ca bafwa cilelolela, nacasamuna akanwa pakuti cibacibaule.

english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
translation: Abantu bonse bakasebana,

english: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita ena akalanga ubupulami bwakwe mu fintu ifyalungama ifyo acita,

english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
translation: Mu fitantala fya musumba emo abana ba mpaanga bakalaliila umulemfwe,

english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
translation: Mukacimona imwe, mwe baobelwa kukubifya,

english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”
translation: Imwe mulasosa amuti,

english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
translation: Alishiminepo, afumyamo na mabwe,

english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
translation: Mukacimona imwe, mwe bamintelengu,

english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
translation: Mukacimona imwe, mwe baimona ukuti mwalikwata amano,

english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
translation: Mukacimona imwe, mwe baitunga ukuti mwalikosa kukunwa umwangashi uukola.

english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
translation: Abalesangwa ne milandu bena imwe mulabaleka,

english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Eico, nga filya fine impimbili ne cani icauma fipya ku mulilo,

english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.
translation: Eico Yawe nafulilwa abantu bakwe,

english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.
translation: Yawe naimya icishibilo pakwita abantu ba mushobo uwa kutali.

english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,
translation: Tapali nangu umo uunakile kukwenda,

english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.
translation: Imifwi yabo intu yatwa,

english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.
translation: Ukubuluma kwabo kwaba ngo kwa nkalamo.

english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
translation: Nomba, imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu,

english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.
translation: Ubo bushiku nga bwafika, bakabulumina icalo ca Israeli

english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
translation: Bushe cinshi icashalako ico ine nafilwa ukubombela ibala lyandi?

english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
translation: Kanshi umfweni ifyo ine nomba nalacita ibala lyandi ilya myangashi.

english: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
translation: Nalaleka lisapilwe.

english: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.
translation: Ala ibala lya myangashi ilyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita ni ŋanda yakwa Israeli,

english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
translation: Mwashama imwe,

english: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
translation: Luka 20:9

english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!
translation: Ima iwe Sioni, akubengeshima nga kasuba pantu nalwisa ulubuuto lobe,

english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.
translation: Abenafyalo bakabuukulula amalinga yobe,

english: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.
translation: Inshiku shonse impongolo shobe shikalaba ishaisuka,

english: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
translation: Elyo abantu ba mishobo ne shamfumu shabo abakalakaana ukulakubombela,

english: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
translation: Imbao sha mipapa, ne sha mikula, ne sha paini,

english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Abana ba bantu abakucusha,

english: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
translation: Nangu abantu bakusuulile no kukupata

english: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
translation: Iwe ukalaonka ibele lya mishobo ya benafyalo pamo ne shamfumu shaiko,

english: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.
translation: Pa mukuba obe, ine nkapyanikishapo golide,

english: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
translation: Icongo cabuluku tacakaleumfwika nakabili mu calo cobe,

english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
translation: Te kasuba kakalakusanikilako ilyo bukalaca iyoo,

english: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.
translation: Pantu mona imfifi ikafimba pano isonde,

english: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.
translation: Akasuba kakulamubalikilafye lyonse ukwabula ukuwa,

english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
translation: Abantu bobe bakalabafye bonse abololoke,

english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”
translation: Nangu ulupwa lobe ulwaba ulwacepeshapo kabili ulwafyefye,

english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
translation: Imishobo ya benafyalo ikaileta ku lubuuto lobe,

english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.
translation: Sansula amenso, lolesha konse konse, umone.

english: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.
translation: Iwe wakulati nga walolesha, awe tepakutemwa,

english: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of the LORD.
translation: Ingamila shakulaisa imilongo,

english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.
translation: Impaanga shonse isha ku Keda ne sha ku Nebaiyoti

english: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
translation: Nga yalya mato yaleshunda nga makumbi,

english: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.
translation: Pantu ifyalo fya ku lulamba lwa pali bemba filenindila,

english: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,
translation: Umupashi wa Mfumu Yawe waba pali ine,

english: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
translation: Nayanga ne nsansa muli Yawe,

english: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
translation: Pantu ngefi fine umushili umesha imbuto

english: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
translation: Alintuma ine pakuti ndebilisha ukuti inshita nomba naifika

english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.
translation: pakuti mu Sioni ndetalalikamo no kulasansamushamo abalelilishika,

english: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.
translation: Mateo 5:4

english: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
translation: Mateo 11:5

english: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
translation: Elyo imwe mwakulaitwa bashimapepo bakwa Yawe,

english: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.
translation: Insoni shenu no kusaluka kwenu nafipwa,

english: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”
translation: Na bana ba mu bufyashi bwabo bakulalumbuka ku mishobo ya benafyalo,

english: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
translation: Awe ine, pali iwe we musumba wa Sioni, nshatalalepofye iyoo,

english: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu, aleni imeni fumineni pa minshi,

english: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”
translation: Lekeni beshibe ukuti Yawe alebilikisha ku bantu bonse pano isonde ati,

english: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.
translation: Ubuso 22:12

english: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo bakulamonako ifyo iwe ucita ifyalungama,

english: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
translation: Kuli Yawe, iwe ukaba nge ngala yabufumu iyayemba,

english: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
translation: Abantu nomba tabalekwita “Uwalekeleshiwa,”

english: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
translation: Pantu nga filya fine umulumendo abuula umukashana uushabala opwa eo aupa,

english: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,
translation: “Iwe Yerusalemu, pa malinga yobe ine nimbikapo bamalonda,

english: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
translation: Belaleka ine ndeiikalilafye,

english: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,
translation: Yawe nalapa umulapo wa kuboko kwakwe ukwa ku kulyo,

english: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
translation: Lelo imwe mwe balima iŋanu no kushiseepa,

english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”
translation: Nani ulya aletula ku musumba wa Bosira uwa mu calo ca Edomu?

english: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.
translation: Lelo bena balitalamine Yawe,

english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.
translation: baleendafye nge ŋombe ishileya ku nika ku mulemfwe.

english: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.
translation: We Yawe, uko ku mulu uko waikala mu cifulo cobe icamushilo,

english: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.
translation: Esaya 59:16

english: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
translation: We Yawe, nga cinshi ico utulekela tulepumba mu nshila shobe?

english: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
translation: Ifwe fwe bantu bobe twaikele mwisano lyobe ilyamushilo inshita inonofye,

english: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.
translation: Iwe uletucitafye kwati tewe watuteeka,

english: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?
translation: Mala 1:2-5

english: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.
translation: Yawe nao epakwasuka ati,

english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.
translation: Pantu ine namwene ukuti inshita nomba yafika iyakulimwinapo abalwani babo,

english: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.
translation: Esaya 34:5-17

english: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”
translation: Abantu ba mishobo yonse nalibanyantawile bukali bukali,

english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
translation: Yawe nao epakusosa ati,
