english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.
translation: Ku macushi yabo yonse nao aliculileko,

english: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
translation: Nga cinshi ico ushingalepwila umulu no kwisa panonshi?

english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
translation: Imisumba yobe iyamushilo nomba ilifye ifibolya,

english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
translation: Iŋanda yesu iyaba iyamushilo kabili iyalulumbi,

english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
translation: Nga filya umulilo ubilima mu cisonso,

english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
translation: Limbi iwe walishile cita ifintu ifyakutiinya nganshi ifyo ifwe tushaenekele,

english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
translation: Awe takwatala akuba muntu uwaumfwapo nangu uwailukapo nangu ukumonapo Lesa umo uwaba no bulamba nga iwe,

english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
translation: Iwe ulasekelela abomfwa insansa mukulacita ifyalungama,

english: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
translation: Bonsefye pano tupelele, tuli babifi,

english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
translation: Pali ifwe, tapaba nelyo umo uukupepa,

english: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
translation: Lelo kwena we Yawe, niwe Shifwe.

english: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
translation: Kol 2:9

english: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.
translation: Yawe nao epakwasuka,

english: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.
translation: Bakalacemena impaanga shabo mu Sharoni,

english: “But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;
translation: “Nomba imwe mwe bafumya amano kuli ine ne Yawe,

english: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
translation: Nkamupekanisha ukwipaiwa mu nkondo,

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.
translation: Eico ine ne Yawe namwebelapo imwe ukuti,

english: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.
translation: Ababomfi bandi bena bakalaimba inyimbo shansansa,

english: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,
translation: Abantu bandi abasalwa bakalabuula ishina lyenu,

english: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.
translation: Umuntu onse mu calo uukalalomba ipaalo,

english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
translation: “Mwamona, ine ndebumba umulu uupya

english: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
translation: Imwe lyonsefye muleanga ne nsansa pa fintu ifyo ine ndecita,

english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
translation: Na ine wine nakulasansamuka icibi pa mulandu wa Yerusalemu,

english: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
translation: Naletambalika amaboko yandi inshiku shonse

english: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.
translation: Roma 10:20

english: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
translation: Roma 10:21

english: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.
translation: Esaya 66:22

english: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.
translation: Bakulashuukilamo mu milimo yabo,

english: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.
translation: Umumbulu no mwana wa mpaanga fikamba ukulila pamo,

english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;
translation: Bena balankalifya umutima ku mufulo wabo.

english: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
translation: Baya mukwikala mu nshinshi na mu ncende ishafisama,

english: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.
translation: Elyo kabili aba bantu bene, ebeba abanabo abati,

english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom
translation: Moneni umulandu wabo walilembwa kale.

english: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”
translation: bonse ububifi bwenu no bwa fikolwe fyenu,” efyasosa Yawe.

english: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.
translation: Lelo kwena ine ne Yawe ndetila nati,

english: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.
translation: Nkasenamina abana bakwa Yakobo,

english: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;
translation: “Sansamukeni pamo na Yerusalemu,

english: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”
translation: Mwakulacankilwa ifisuma fyakwe,

english: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe,

english: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
translation: Ine nkalamutalalikila imwe mu Yerusalemu,

english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
translation: Ilyo imwe mukalamona ifi fintu,

english: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe nkeshila mu mulilo,

english: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.
translation: Abantu bonsefye pa calo abo ne Yawe nkasanga ne milandu,

english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ndetila nati, calapwa, kabili calapwilililafye kuli aba bantu baisangulula, abaya imilongo kukulapepa imilungu mu ncende isho baipekanishisha mu mabala. Calapwilililafye kuli aba bantu abalya iminofu ya nkumba, na bakwindi, ne fyakulya fimbi ifyabunani.

english: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.
translation: Ine nalishiba ifyo bena batontonkanya nefyo bacita. Ine nalaisa nonganye abantu ba mishobofye yonse ne ndimi shonse nabo bakesa mona ubucindami bwandi.

english: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
translation: Kabili nkabika icishibilo pakati kabo icakushininkisha ukuti kanshi nine ndebalimuna. Kwena nalaisa shapo bamo, nabo ndebatuma ku bantu ba mishobo ababa mu fyalo fyakutali iya ku lulamba lwa bemba, uko bena bashatala abomfwa palwa lulumbi lwandi, uko bena bashatala abamona ifyo ine nacindama, nefyo ine naba no bulamba. Nako e ku Tashishi , na ku Libya, na ku Ludia uko abantu bacenjelesha ukuposa imifwi, na ku Tubali, na ku calo ca Bagiriki . Ni kuli iyi mishobo ya benafyalo iyo balaya mukulashimikilako ifyo ine nacindama.

english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.
translation: Ala nine wine nabumba fyonse ifi.

english: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.
translation: Bakabwesha na banenu bonse, bakabafumya mu mishobo ya bantu bonse, no kwisa batuula ngo bupe kuli ine ne Yawe. Pakwisa ku lupili lwandi ulwamushilo mu Yerusalemu bakabaleta pali bakabalwe, pa maceleta, pa macila, pali bapunda, na pa ngamila. Cikabafye nga filya fine abena Israeli baleta imituulo yabo iya cabunga ku ŋanda yandi ne Yawe, ilyo besa nabasendela mu fipe ifyasanguluka.

english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
translation: Bamo pali abo bantu, ine ne Yawe nkabacita bashimapepo na bena Levi.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.
translation: Pa nshikunkulu ya kumoneka kwa mweshi onse uupya,

english: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
translation: “Pakubwelelamo bakulatamba ifitumbi fya bantu abansangukile. Imitiiti iyakulafilya tayakatale aifwa nakalya, no mulilo uwakulafyoca nao tawakatale aushima iyoo. Kabili bakaba icakuselausha ku bantu ba mitundu yonse.”

english: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
translation: “Abantu tepakutemwa ukucita ifyo abene balefwaya.

english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
translation: Kanshi na ine wine nakulabatoosha imipamba,

english: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.
translation: “Umfweni kuno ishiwi lyakwa Yawe,

english: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.
translation: Umfweni akabolokoto ako kaba mu musumba,

english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.
translation: “Umusumba wandi uwamushilo uli ngo mwanakashi uwafyala umwana umwaume apopenefye,

english: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.
translation: Bushe kwalitala akuba umuntu uwamonapo nangu ukumfwapo ica uyu musango?

english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.
translation: Nine Yawe ulenga ukuti cilepalamina icakuti abantu bandi balefyalilwapo,

english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
translation: Mu mwaka imfumu Usia yafwilemo, ine nalimwene Imfumu ine ine iya mu mulu. Yaikele pa cipuna caiko icabufumu icasansama, ninshi ne cakufwala caiko nacikumana mwi Tempele.

english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”
translation: Luka 8:10

english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
translation: Elyo na ine naipusha nati,

english: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
translation: Mako 4:12

english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
translation: Nangufye umo pa bali ikumi engashala mu calo,

english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
translation: Pa mulu waiko ninshi napeminina na Baselafi abalebengeshima, bonse umo umo bali na mapindo mutanda mutanda. Bonse umo umo bafimbile amapindo yabili pa menso yabo, elyo yabili nayo bafimbile amakasa yabo, elyo yambi yabili yena eyakupupukilako.

english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
translation: Ninshi balepokanina baleti,

english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
translation: Iciunda ca mashiwi yabo caletensha ne mifula ya pa mwinshi we Tempele, na mukati mwaiswile icushi.

english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”
translation: Na ine epakusosa nati, “Owe ne mulanda ine nafwa ee. Pantu ndi muntu uulanda ifibi pa kanwa kabili naikala na bantu nabo abalanda ifibi pa tunwa twabo. Awe lelo nafwa, pantu amenso yandi yamona Imfumu, Yawe umwine wa fita.”

english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
translation: Elyo umo pali Baselafi, aisa ne laka lya mulilo ilyo alapwile ku lumano pa bulambo.

english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
translation: Isham 15:7

english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
translation: Ubuso 4:8

english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
translation: Kanshi nao epakuntuma ati, “Kebe aba bantu utile,

english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
translation: Kwalibuukile inkondo ilyo imfumu Ahasi aleteeka icalo ca bena Yuda. Ahasi ali ni mwana Yotamu, kabili ali ni mwishikulu Usia. Awe Resini imfumu ya ku Siria, pamo na Peka imfumu ya bena Israeli uwali mwana Remaliya, basansa umusumba wa Yerusalemu, nomba bafilwa ukuucimfya.

english: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
translation: Nakabili Yawe alilandile kuli Ahasi ati,

english: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
translation: “Ipusha Yawe Lesa obe pakuti akulangepo icishibilo cimo. Naco cibe icakosa icashika nga ku mbo atemwa icayafya icalepa nga ku mulu.”

english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”
translation: Apali Ahasi wena ayasukafye ati, “Awe ndai, ine nshaipushepo cishibilo. Ine nshilefwaya kwesha Yawe.”

english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
translation: Elyo nao Esaya aposapo ishiwi ati, “Umfweni imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Davidi. Imwe mwalishiba ukuti ukutendusha abantu, cintu icabipa. Nga nomba cinshi kabili mulefwaila ukutendusha na Lesa wine?

english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
translation: Kanshi Yawe umwine ewalamulanga icishibilo cimo. Kukaba umukashana umo uukaba pabukulu. Nao akafyala umwana umwaume, uo akenika ishina lya Imanueli .

english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
translation: Akalalya umukaka no buci mpaka ilyo akeshiba ukukaana icibi no kusala icisuma.

english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
translation: Ilyo inshita ya uyu mwana ishilati ifike iyakukaana icibi no kusala icisuma, ninshi ifyalo fya shamfumu shibili ishikutiinya iwe Ahasi fyalishala amatololo.

english: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.
translation: “Iwe pamo na bantu bobe, kumo kwine no lupwa lobe lonse ulwabufumu, Yawe alaswa amufishe ku nshiku isha macushi, nayo ayashatala ayamoneka ukutula apo ubufumu bwa Efulemu bwapatulukene no bwa Yuda. Alaswa akukuutilile imfumu ya Asiria.

english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
translation: “Iyo nshita nga yafika, Yawe akalisha umunsoli pakwita abena Egupto, nabo bakesa nga balunshi, bakatula mu milonga iyawila mu mumana wa Nailo. Kabili akalishisha abena Asiria umunsoli, pakuti nabo bakese kubuuba nge nshimu ukutula mu calo cabo.

english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
translation: Bakesa kupa mu mikonko mu fimabwe, na mu ninga mu fimabwe, bakesa tebelela na mu fimpusa fyonse ifya myunga, no kukupa monse umwakucemena ifitekwa.

english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
translation: Elyo baletele umulandu ku ba ŋanda yakwa Davidi ukutila, “Ifita fya bena Siria nafyampana na bena Efulemu.” Eico imfumu pamo na bantu baiko bonse balitiinine, balaisokonenafye ku mwenso kwati miti ya mu mutengo iyilepukana ku mwela.

english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
translation: “Iyo nshita nga yafika, Yawe akaya kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate, kukuya buulako umuntu umo uwaishiba ukubeya, nao e mfumu ya Asiria. Nayo ikesa mubeya imishishi no bupipi pa mibili yenu, ikamubeya ne myefu ine.

english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.
translation: “Iyo nshita nga yafika, nangu umuntu umo akateekafye iŋombe imo iyikota, ne mpaanga shibili,

english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
translation: ifyo fitekwa fikalamuletela umukaka uwingi, icakuti takalekabila kantu. Bonse abakashalamo mu calo bakalanwa umukaka no kulalya ubuci.

english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.
translation: “Iyo nshita nga yafika, amabala yonse ayasuma umwaleba imyangashi ikana limo (1,000), na mwibala lyonse umwalefuma indalama amashekeli ya silifa ikana limo (1,000), yonse yakasapilwa ku myunga na bacilasa efikalamenamo.

english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
translation: Abantu bakalatiina ukulayamo, pakuyamo ninshi nabaipangasha amata ne mifwi. Ee, mu calo conse mukakumana imyunga na bacilasa.

english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
translation: Mu tupili tonse umo kale abantu balelima ifintu, mukasapilwa ku myunga iyikalamenamo pamo na bacilasa, takwakalemoneka muntu uukalayamo. Ikasangukafye ni mpanga umwakulishisha iŋombe ne mpaanga.”

english: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Esaya ati, “Buula Sheari Yashubu umwana obe umwaume, kabiye nankwe, mukumanye Ahasi. Muleya musanga mu musebo, mulekumanina palya bakacapa wa nsalu babombela, pa mpela ya munyangala ulya upitamo amenshi ya mu cishiba cabela pa mulundu.

english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
translation: Uye mucenjeshako auti, ‘Teka umutima, wilatiina kabili wilasakamana iyoo. Pantu icipyu ca mfumu Resini pamo na bantu baiko abena Siria, ne cipyu ca mfumu Peka, ala teti ficite umuntu nangu cimo. Abo bantu balifye nge cushi icilefutumuka ku tushishi tubili utulefuuka.

english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
translation: Isham 16:5

english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
translation: Filepanga afiti, “Natuye sansa icalo ca Yuda, tutiinye abantu baciko pakuti bawile uko tuli, epakuti tufumye Ahasi pa cipuna cabufumu, tubikepo mwana Tabeli.” ’

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
translation: “Lelo Imfumu Yawe nasosa ukuti, ico cintu tacakabale acicitika,

english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
translation: “Pantu icalo ca Siria tacacila Damasiko umusumba waciko amaka,

english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
translation: Icalo ca Efulemu tacacila musumba waciko wa Samaria amaka,

english: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
translation: Yawe alinjebele ati, “Buula icakulembapo cimo icikulu, ulembepo ifilembo ifikulu utile, ‘Maeri Shalali Hashi Basi’ .

english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
translation: Pekanyeni ifyo muli nokucita, lelo kwena tamwakaficite nakalya.

english: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
translation: Yawe alinsokele pa maka ine ne Esaya, kabili alinsokele ukuti nilakonkelela imisango iyo abantu bakwete.

english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.
translation: Alinjebele ati, “Iwe wilakonkelela mufyo abantu balecita, kabili tecakwesha kulatiina ifyo bena baletiina.

english: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
translation: Uleibukishafye ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita, ena wamushilo, kanshi eo uli nokulakwatila akatiina. Ena ekafye eo uli nokulatutuma.

english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
translation: Kanshi bengi bakulaipununako, no kuwa bakulawa. Bakulawa no kufunika bakulafunika. Ee, bakulaikatwa ku citeyo.”

english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
translation: “Ukakilile ubunte ubu, kabili ukonkomeshe amafunde aya mu basambi bandi.

english: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
translation: Yawe aliifisa ku ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo, lelo ine nalimutetekela, no kumulolela ine ndamulolela.

english: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
translation: “Moneni epo ndi, ine pamo na bana abo Yawe ampeela. Yawe umwine wa fita, uo icipuna cakwe icabufumu caba pa lupili lwa Sioni, nifwe abika ukuba ifishibilo kabili nge fyakumwenako kukushinina abena Israeli.

english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
translation: “Abantu nga balamweba ukwipusha imilandu ku bantu ababuka na bapendula, abalongofyanya pakulanda, nangu abatamantama pakulanda, ubaasuke auti, ‘Bushe abantu teti bepushe Lesa wabo? Mulandu nshi bengalaipushisha imilandu ya bomi ku mipashi ya bafwa?’

english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
translation: Unjitileko abantu abacishinka, shimapepo Ulia na Sakaria mwana Yeberekia, pakuti ebo bese babe bakambone bandi.”

english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
translation: Ku mafunde na kufyo Lesa amukonkomesha eko muloleshe, nga tabasosa ukulingana nefi ninshi tamwaba ulubuuto muli bena.”

english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,
translation: Abantu bakalalulumbafye mu calo, ilyo ninshi nabapelelwa, kabili ninshi nabafwa ulushile ku nsala. Pakuba ne insala ifyo, bakafulwa nganshi. No kupunamina kumulu, bakatuka imfumu yabo iyabateeka, bakatuke na Lesa wabo wine. Bakalati bapunamina mumulu,

english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
translation: elyo kabili balolesha amenso panshi, awe bakamonafye ubucushi bweka bweka ne mfifi no bunkukwa. Bakasunkilishiwa na mu mfifi iyikalamba.

english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
translation: Ilyo nasendeme no mukashi wandi, uwali kasesema wa mashiwi yakwa Lesa, awe aimita asuka afyala no mwana umwaume. Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, “Mwinike ishina lya Maeri Shalali Hashi Basi.

english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
translation: Pantu umwana akalati talaishiba nakutila, ‘Tata’ nangu ‘Mayo’, ninshi imfumu ya Asiria yalisenda kale ifyuma fyonse ifya Damasiko no kutapa Samaria onsefye.”

english: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,
translation: Yawe alinsoseshe nakabili,

english: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
translation: alanjeba ati, “Pa mulandu wakuti aba bantu nabakaana amenshi ya mu kamana ka Shiloa ayapitafye tondolo, na pa mulandu wakuti aba bantu balesekela pa fikaponena imfumu Resini, ne mfumu mwana Remaliya,

english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
translation: kanshi ine ne Yawe nalaya buula imfumu ya Asiria ne fita fyaiko fyonse, uleke ise isanse icalo ca Yuda. Abena Asiria bakulaisa nge lyeshi lya mu mumana wa Yufurate uupongwele.

english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.
translation: Baleisa pongwela nge lyeshi pa calo ca Yuda, amenshi yaleisa pelela mu mikoshi, no kubunsha icalo conse. Ukufunguluka kwa mapindo yakwe kukakupa icalo cobe we Imanueli .

english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
translation: “Icefyeni imwe mwe mishobo ya benafyalo kabili tiineni, mukafwantaulwa.

english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
translation: Lelo takwakabe ukufiitwa nakabili ngefyo cali kale mu nshita shakusuulwa. Kale Lesa alekele cisebane cilya citungu ca luko lwa bena Sebuloni no lwa bena Naftali, nomba kuntanshi akacicindamika ico citungu ukutampilafye mu nshila ya kuli bemba ukulola na ku kabanga mwishilya lya Yordani, na mu citungu ca Galile mwine umwaikala imitundu ya benafyalo.

english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
translation: “Nangu amayanda ya njelwa yawile, te mulandu,

english: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
translation: Kanshi, Yawe naimya no kukosha abalwani bakwa Resini kukubalwisha,

english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
translation: Abena Siria babelele lwa ku kabanga,

english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.
translation: Nomba abena Israeli, tabalalapila nangu kwena abalimwine,

english: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
translation: Eico kanshi nomba ni pa bushiku bumofye epo Yawe akalimuna intungulushi sha bena Israeli kumo na bantu bene.

english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
translation: Mateo 4:15

english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.
translation: Mateo 4:16

english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
translation: Eico kanshi pa balumendo bonse Yawe takalekepo nangu umo uwakuti akapusuke,

english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
translation: Ububi bwa bantu bulebilima ngo lubingu lwa mulilo,

english: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita nafulwa,

english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
translation: Abantu abaleenda mu mfifi,

english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:
translation: Bonsefye mu calo baletola tolafye utwakuti balelya,

english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
translation: We Yawe walibafushisha ishuko

english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
translation: Pantu naukontaula ikoli ilyalebafinya,

english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
translation: Ifimasapato fya bashilika ifyo bafwala mu bulwi,

english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
translation: Pantu kuli ifwe nakufyalwa umwana.

english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
translation: Amaka yakwe ayabufumu yakalacililakofye,

english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
translation: Yawe natuma amashiwi ayakali kuli Yakobo,

english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
translation: Abena Efulemu bonse, na bonse abekala mu musumba wa Samaria bakashininkisha ukuti efyo acitile.

english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
translation: Ine Yakobo, umusha wakwa Lesa ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu, namuposha bonse mwe nko ikumi limo na shibili isha bantu bakwa Lesa abasalangana icalo conse.

english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
translation: Umukankala uwabwananyina nao wine afwile ukumfwa bwino pali ico Lesa amupoka ubucindami. Pantu umukankala akalukuta nge luba lya cani.

english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
translation: Akasuba nga katula, katampa no kubalikisha, ukukaba kwakako kulenga icani ukuma. Amaluba ya cani yalalukuta no kuyemba kwaciko kwapwa. Mu musango umo wine efyo umukankala akonaulwa pa nshita apamfiwe na makwebo yakwe.

english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uushipikisha mu macushi. Pantu nga acimya amacushi, akapokelela icilambu camweo ico Lesa alaya abo abamutemwa.

english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
translation: Umo nga atunkwa elatontonkanya ukuti ni Lesa eulemutunka. Pantu Lesa teti atunkwe ne fyabipa, elyo umwine wine tatunka muntu.

english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
translation: Lelo umuntu atunkwa ilyo ulunkumbwa lwakwe lwamusembeleka no kumwikata.

english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
translation: Ulunkumbwa nga lwakula, luleta ububifi. Ububifi nga bwakula, ninshi buleta imfwa.

english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
translation: Ala mwilabepwa mwe bamunyinane!

english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
translation: Ifyabupe fyonse ifisuma ifyo tupokelela ne fyawamisha umupwilapo fifuma ku mulu. Fifuma kuli Lesa Tata uwabumba ifya mu mulu ifipeela ulubuuto. Muli wena tamwaba imfifi, taluka.

english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
translation: Lesa umwine kukufwaya kwakwe ewatufyele kwishiwi lyakwe ilyacishinka. Acita ifi pantu alefwaya ukuti tube abantanshi pa fibumbwa fyakwe fyonse.

english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
translation: Mwalishiba mwe bamunyinane mwe batemwikwa bandi ukuti, onse afwile ukwanguka ukumfwa, lelo uwatekanya pakulanda, kabili uushifulwa bwangu.

english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, amacushi ya misango ne misango nga yamwishila, mulemona ukuti lishuko nganshi!

english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
translation: Pantu icipyu ca muntu tacileta cisuma ico Lesa afwaya.

english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
translation: Kanshi lekeni ifyakowela fyonse ne misango ibi yonse mucili nayo. Mulenakila Lesa no kupokelela amashiwi yakwe ayo abyala mu mitima yenu ayaba na maka yakumupususha.

english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
translation: Mwilaibepa mukupelelafye pakumfwa amashiwi yakwe, lelo mulecita nefyo yalemweba.

english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
translation: Umuntu uumfwafye amashiwi lelo tacita ifyo yalemweba, aba kwati muntu uuilolesha pa menso mu mulolani.

english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
translation: Cilya apwa ukuilolesha afumapo, apopenefye alaba nefyo amoneka.

english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
translation: Lelo umuntu uulolekesha mwifunde ilyapwililika ilitulenga tube abantungwa, kabili akonkanyapo ukulinakila, tapelelafye mukumfwa alaba nako lelo alecita ifyo omfwa, ninshi Lesa akamupaala muli fyonse ifyo alecita.

english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
translation: Bushe utila ndi mwina Lesa? Nga waba cilandelande ninshi uibepafye no bwina Lesa bobe nabo bwafyefye.

english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
translation: Ubwina Lesa ubo Lesa Shifwe amona ukuti bwalipwililika ku busuma, kwafwa bakashiwa na bamukamfwilwa mufyo balekabila, no kuitalusha ku fyakowela fya pano calo.

english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
translation: Pantu mwalishiba ukuti ilyo icisumino cenu cileeshiwa ku macushi, ici cilenga ukushipikisha.

english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
translation: Ukushipikisha kwenu kuli nokumoneka nganshi mufyo mulebomba, epakuti muleba abapwililika lyonse, abashabulisha nelyo cimo.

english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
translation: Umo pali imwe nga takwete amano, alombe kuli Lesa ukuti amupeele. Lesa nao uupeelesha ne nsansa onse uwamulomba, akamupeela.

english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
translation: Lelo uyu wine ilyo alepepa, afwile ukuba ne cisumino, ukwabula ukutwishika. Pantu umuntu uutwishika, apala itamba ilya pali bemba ilitumpauka no kusendwafye konse uko umwela wapuupila.

english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
translation: Uyo muntu uwaba ifi, tafwile kutontonkanya ati Imfumu kuti yamupeela ico alomba.

english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
translation: Abafye uwabula ukushininkisha ifyo ali nokucita, imicitile yakwe yaluka alukafye.

english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
translation: Uwabwananyina umupina afwile ukumfwa bwino pali ico Lesa amucindamika.

english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, apo mwasumina mu Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu, Imfumu icindami, mwilaba na kapatulula.

english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
translation: Uyo onse uusunga amafunde yakwa Lesa yonse, nga apulafye muli limo, ninshi ali no mulandu kwati apulafye muli yonse.

english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
translation: Lesa ewapeele icebo cakuti, “Wilabembuka” ne cakuti, “Wilaipaya.” Kanshi nangu taubembwike, lelo ulepaya abantu, ninshi uli mpulamafunde.

english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
translation: Imilandile ne micitile yenu ileba nge ya bantu abapingulwa ne funde ililenga tube abantungwa.

english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, umo nga atila nalikwata icisumino nomba talebomba nelyo cimo, bushe ici cisumino kuti camuwamina shani? Bushe ici cisumino cakwe kuti camupususha?

english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
translation: Nomba nga cakuti munyinenwe, nangu nkashi yenu alisapula, elyo ne fyakulya takwete.

english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
translation: Bushe cikabawamina shani nga umo pali imwe abeba ati, “Mwende umutende, mulefwala mulekaba, mulelya muleikuta,” nga tamubapeele ifi fintu balekabila mu bumi bwabo?

english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
translation: Levi 19:18

english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
translation: Bushe wasumina ukuti kwabafye Lesa umo? Cisuma! Ne mipashi yakowela nayo yalisumina, kabili ilatutuma no kututuma ku mwenso.

english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
translation: Nga cakuti umukankala uufwele imbalaminwe ya golide ne nsalu shamutengo, nga aisa mu ŋanda mulongene, elyo no mupina uwasapula nao aisamo.

english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
translation: We cipumbu ca muntu we, bushe ulefwaya nkulange ukuti icisumino icabula imilimo isuma cafyefye?

english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
translation: Bushe cinshi calengele ukuti Abrahamu icikolwe cesu abe uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa? Ala ni pa milimo yakwe isuma, ilyo atuulile mwane Isaki pa bulambo pakuti amuleke ilambo.

english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
translation: Wamona ukuti cisumino ne milimo yakwe isuma fyabombele pamo. Milimo yakwe isuma yalengele ukuti icisumino cakwe cibe icapwililika.

english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
translation: Ne fyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo fyalifikilishiwa ifyakuti, “Abrahamu asumine Lesa, na pa mulandu wa cisumino cakwe, Lesa amumwene ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe.” Kabili eco Abrahamu aleitilwa ukuti ni cibusa wakwa Lesa.

english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
translation: Mwamona nomba ukuti, Lesa tamona muntu ukuti wakaele pa cinso cakwe pa mulandu wa cisuminofye ceka, lelo na pa mulandu wa milimo isuma.

english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
translation: Epamo pene na ku mwanakashi Rahabu cilende. Lesa amumwene ukuti wakaele pa cinso cakwe pafyo acitile. Apokelele inengu sha bena Israeli shibili, ashafwilishako no kufyuka mukubomfya inshila imbi.

english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
translation: Nga filya umubili wa muntu ufwa ilyo umupashi wafumamo, efyo ne cisumino ciba icafwa nga tacilebomba milimo isuma.

english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
translation: Nga mwapokelela bwino uufwele ubusaka, mwamweba amuti, “Ikaleni apa pa cipuna apaweme.” Umupina nao mwamweba amuti, “Keminine uko nangu ikala panshi mupepi na ine.”

english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
translation: Bushe ninshi te kapatulula mwacita? Bushe ninshi te mano yabi mwabomfya mukupingula?

english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
translation: Umfweni mwe bamunyinane mwe batemwikwa bandi! Lesa asala aba bantu, abo abantu ba pano calo batila bapina ukuba abakankala mu cisumino. Abasala ukupyana ubufumu ubo Lesa alaya abamutemwa.

english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
translation: Lelo imwe mulasausha abapina! Ni bani bushe bamufyengelesha no kumupatikisha ukuya ku filye? Bushe te bakankala!

english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
translation: Bushe te bakankala basaalula ishina ilicindami lyakwa Kristu ilyo mwainikweko?

english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
translation: Nga mulalungika, amulanakila icebo icikalamba icalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo icitila, “Uletemwa umubiyo ifyo waitemwa we mwine.”

english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
translation: Lelo nga mulacita akapatulula, ninshi mulabifya, kabili ukulingana na mafunde, ninshi muli bampulamafunde.

english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, pali imwe peba bakafundisha abengi. Pantu ifwe fwe bakafundisha, Lesa takabe na luse pakutupingula.

english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
translation: Mu kanwa kamo kene emufuma ukutasha no kulapisha. Bamunyinane ifi tefyo cilingile ukuba.

english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
translation: Mu kamfukumfuku kamo kene teti mufume amenshi ayasuma na yacicelecele.

english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
translation: Umukunyu, mwe bamunyinane, tekuti utwale ifitwalo fya muolifa, no mwangashi nao tekuti utwale amakunyu. Cimo na kamfukumfuku ka menshi yacicelecele tekuti kafumye amenshi ayasuma.

english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
translation: Ni ani pali imwe uwamano kabili uwacenjela? Uyo afwile ukulanga ukuti wamano kabili untu wacenjela ku micitile yakwe isuma mu fintu acita mu kuicefya ukwamano.

english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
translation: Lelo nga mwaba no mufimbila nganshi no kuisakamanafye mwe bene, ninshi mwilaibepa tapali cishinka cakuitakishishapo.

english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
translation: Amano ya uyu musango tekuli Lesa yafuma, mano ya pano calo yabuntunsefye, kabili yafuma ku mipashi yakowela.

english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
translation: Pantu uko kuli umufimbila no kuisakamanafye, ekuba ne cimfulunganya ne misango yonse iyabipa.

english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
translation: Lelo amano ayafuma kuli Lesa yena yaba ayapwililika, kabili yacibote, yamutembo no bufuke. Elyo kabili yakwatisha uluse, yacitafye ifisuma. Tayaba na mucishacinani, yaba pa cishinka.

english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
translation: Ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, e fisabo abalenga icibote balobolola ilyo babyala mu cibote.

english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
translation: Ifwe bonse ilingi tulalufyanya. Nomba umuntu nga talufyanya mufyo asosa, ninshi uyo aba uwapwililika. Kabili ninshi aba umuntu uwakwata amaka yakutungulula umubili wakwe onse.

english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
translation: Tubika icela mu kanwa kakwa kabalwe pakuti alecita ifyo tulefwaya. Nga twacita ifi tulenga kabalwe ukuya konse uko tulefwaya.

english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
translation: Tontonkanyeni pa cibwato icenda pali bemba. Nangu cikule shani, kabili nangu cisendwe ne cimwela icakosa shani, cipindululwafye kuli kanaosa akanono, no kuya konse uko kensha wa bwato alefwaya ukuti ciye.

english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
translation: Ululimi nalo efyo lwaba. Nangu lwaba akapande ka mubili akanono, lulailumbanya ukuti lucita ifyakupapa.

english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
translation: Ululimi nalo lwaba kwati mulilo. Pa filundwa fya mibili yesu, ululimi lwaba kwati calo icaisulamo ububi bonse, lusalanganya ububi mu mubili onse. Lutanda umulilo mu bumi bwesu bonse ubwa pano calo kabili lwena lufumya uyu mulilo ku mulilo wape.

english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
translation: Umuntu kuti ateeka inama sha mpaanga, ifyuni, ifikulika pa mushili ne sabi ukuba ifitekwa fya mu mushi. Nakuba no kuteeka tulafiteeka fyonse ifi.

english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
translation: Lelo takwaba winganasha ululimi. Lwena talupema pa bubi, lwaisulamo no busungu ubwipaya.

english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
translation: Ku lulimi tulalumbanishishako Imfumu kabili Shifwe, elyo kabili tulapishishako abantu banensu abo Lesa abumba mu cata cakwe.

english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
translation: Bushe ifilenga ukuti muleumana no kulalwa fifuma kwi? Bushe temukukonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi ululwisha mu mibili yenu?

english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
translation: Muleba abafuuka pa cinso ca Mfumu, nayo ikamusansabalika.

english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, mwilayambana. Uyo onse uwamba umubiye nangu ukumupeela umulandu, asuula amafunde yakwa Lesa nangu ukuyalengulula. Eico nga ulalengulula amafunde, ninshi tauyakonka iyoo, ulayalengululafye.

english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
translation: Ni Lesa ekafye eupeela amafunde no kupingula abantu. Kabili ni ekafye ewaba na maka yakupususha abantu nangu ukubalofya. Nga iwe uli ani uwakupingula umunobe?

english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
translation: Umfweni imwe mwe batila, “Lelo atemwa mailo tukaya ku musumba kantwa. Tukaya pwako umwaka umo. Tukalacita amakwebo no kunonkako indalama.”

english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
translation: Ukuf 34:14

english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
translation: Ifyo mulingile ukusosa nifi, “Imfumu nga ilefwaya tukaba abomi, tukacita fyakuti na fyakuti.”

english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
translation: Nomba imwe mucita icilumba no kulaitakisha. Amataki yonse aya musango uyu, yantu yabipa.

english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
translation: Eico kanshi umuntu onse uwaishiba ifisuma fintu afwile ukulacita, nomba talecita, ninshi alabifya.

english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
translation: Mulafwaya ukukwata ifintu nomba tamukwata, eco mwipailapo na bantu. Mufimbila ukukwata ifintu lelo tamufikwata, eco muumanina no kulalwilapo. Tamukwata ifyo mufwaya pantu tamufilomba kuli Lesa.

english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
translation: Ico mushipokelela ifintu ilyo mulomba, nico mulomba na mapange yabi. Mulomba ifintu fyakumusansamushafye mwe bene.

english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
translation: Mwe bantu basangukila Lesa mwe! Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti ukubikana bucibusa ne calo kuba umulwani wakwa Lesa? Uufwaya bucibusa ne calo aicita umulwani wakwa Lesa.

english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
translation: Mwilatontonkanya ukuti te fyacishinka ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ifitila, “Mupashi Lesa abika muli ifwe, alitutemwa, alatufubila no kutufubila.”

english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
translation: Lelo kwena Lesa icikuuku atukwatila calicilapo. Eico calembwa ukuti, “Lesa acincintila abacilumba, lelo abaicefya bena alabakwatila icikuuku.”

english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
translation: Kanshi mulenakila Lesa. Muleyansha Ciwa, nao akulamubutuka.

english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
translation: Mulepalama kuli Lesa, nao akulapalama kuli imwe. Sambeni iminwe yenu imwe mwe babi! Sangululeni imitima yenu mwe mfundabuteshi!

english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
translation: Beni no bulanda, lileni no kuloosha. Lekeni inseko shenu shaluke imisowa, ne nsansa shibe ubulanda.

english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
translation: Umfweni mwe bakankala. Akulileni ifilamba, mupumepo ne misowa pa mulandu wa macushi ayalamwishila.

english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane muleibukisha bakasesema abo Lesa atumine kukulanda amashiwi yakwe. Lekeni babe ifilangililo fyenu mukuteka umutima ilyo muli mu macushi.

english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
translation: Moneni balya baleshipikisha mu macushi, ebo tutila balishuka. Mwalyumfwa ukushipikisha kwakwa Yobo. Mwalishiba ifyo Imfumu yamulambwile pakulekelesha, pantu Imfumu yafulisha uluse ne cilela.

english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
translation: Bamunyinane ndemukonkomesha nganshi ukuti, mwilalapa mulapo pakulaya icilayo. Mwilalapa mulu, nelyo icalo, nelyofye umulapo umbi onse. Imwe muletilafye “Ee,” nga ni ee. “Iyoo,” nga ni iyoo. Epakuti Lesa ekamupeela umulandu.

english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
translation: Umo pali imwe nga ali mu macushi, nalepepa. Umo pali imwe nga ali ne nsansa, naembe inyimbo shakulumbanya Lesa.

english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
translation: No mulwele akapola ico abamupepelako bali ne cisumino. Imfumu ikamuposha no kumubelela uluse nga alibifya.

english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
translation: Kanshi muleebana ifyabubifi fyenu, no kulapepelana epakuti mulepola. Ipepo lya muntu uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa lyaliba na maka nganshi.

english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
translation: Eliya ali umuntufye nga ifwe. Alombele Lesa pa maka ukuti aleshe imfula ukuloka. Elyo na pa myaka itatu ne myeshi mutanda takwali mfula mu calo iyoo.

english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
translation: Aishile lomba nakabili, no mulu walokeshe imfula no mushili wameseshe ifisabo fyauko.

english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, umo pali imwe nga ayaluka, afuma na mu nshila yacishinka, elyo umbi amwalulula nakabili, ishibeni ici.

english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
translation: Ifyuma fyenu nafibola ne nsalu shenu nashiliwa ku fishishi.

english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
translation: Uyu muntu uwayalulula umubifi ukufuma ku mibeele yakwe ibi, ninshi akapususha ulya muntu ku mfwa kabili akafimba pa fyabubifi ifingi.

english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
translation: Golide na silifa nafiliwa ne ndalawa. Neshi ndalawa shikaba e kambone wakumushinina. Shikonaula umubili wenu kwati mulilo. Imwe namuituntumanikila ifyuma muli shino nshiku shakupelekeshako.

english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
translation: Moneni, tamulipila babomfi ba mu mabala yenu amalipilo yabo. Kutikeni kufyo baleilishanya! Imfumu umwine wa fita fyonse nayumfwa inkuuta sha abo balobolola ifisabo fyenu.

english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
translation: Mu bumi bwenu pano calo muposa indalama ishingi pa fyakuisansamusha no kuilemena mwe bene. Eico nomba namuinya kukupekanya ku bushiku bwakwipaiwa.

english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
translation: Nimwe mupingwila abantu abakaele ukufwa, no kubepaya mulabepaya, nabo tabakaanako nakalya.

english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ala muleteka umutima mpaka nelyo Imfumu ikabwela. Moneni ifyo umulimi ateka umutima pakulolela ifisabo fisuma fikule fipye mwibala lyakwe. Ateka umutima no kulolela imfula yakubalilapo ne yakulekelesha.

english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
translation: Eico kanshi na imwe muleteka umutima, mwilanenuka, pantu ubushiku bwa kwisa kwa Mfumu nabupalama.

english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
translation: Pali imwe bamunyinane, nelyo umo elaisosha pafyo umubiye acita, epakuti Lesa ekamupeela mulandu. Kaputula wamilandu napalama, ali pa mwinshi.

english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
translation: Panuma yakwa Abimeleki kwaimine Tola mwana Pua, uwali nao mwana Dodo umwina Isaka, mukupususha abena Israeli. Aikele mu Shamiri, mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu.

english: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli balilile kuli Yawe abati, “Ifwe natubifya nganshi pakusuula Lesa wesu no kulabombela imilungu ba Baali.”

english: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
translation: Nao Yawe aebele abena Israeli ati, “Bushe teine namulubwile ukufuma mu maboko ya bena Egupto, abena Amoli, abena Amoni na Bafilisiti?

english: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.
translation: Elyo abena Sidoni, abena Amaleki elyo na bena Maoni nabo balimutitikishe. Nalyo line mwalilile kuli ine pakuti mwafweko no kumulubula ukufuma mu maboko yabo.

english: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.
translation: Nomba imwe namunsuula no kulabombela imilungu imbi eico kanshi na ine nshakatale mupususha nakabili.

english: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”
translation: Kabiyenifye mukulilila ku milungu iyo mwe bene mwasala. Iyo ine eyo nomba muleke ilemupususha mu mafya yonse mwakulakwata.”

english: The children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli batile, “Ifwe natulufyanya. Tucitilenifye conse ico mwamona ukuti eciweme, nomba twapapata tupusushenikofye pali nomba.”

english: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
translation: Elyo bafumishe amano ku milungu ya benafyalo pakati kabo no kwamba ukulapepa Yawe, icakuti nao abomfwila ubulanda ifyo balecula.

english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.
translation: Kabili abena Amoni balikutene ku bulwi no kucita inkambi mu Gileadi, elyo abena Israeli nabo balilongene pamo no kucita inkambi pa Misipa.

english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
translation: Intungulushi sha bantu abena Gileadi batile kuli cila umo “Uyo onse uuleya tampilapo ukulwisha abena Amoni euli nokuba umutwe wa bonse abekashi ba mu Gileadi.”

english: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
translation: Atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yabili na itatu, no kufwa afwa. Kabili ashiikilwe ku Shamiri kwine.

english: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.
translation: Elyo pakonkele Yairi umwina Gileadi, nao atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yabili.

english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
translation: Yairi ali na bana amakumi yatatu (30) abaleendela pali bapunda amakumi yatatu (30). Aba bana baleyangalila imisumba amakumi yatatu (30) mu Gileadi, iyo mu nshiku sha lelo bayeta ati Hafoti Yairi.

english: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
translation: Ilyo Yairi afwile ashiikilwe mu Kamoni.

english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.
translation: Kabinge abena Israeli babwekeshepo ukubifya ku cinso cakwa Yawe. Batendeke ukulabombela imilungu ba Baali na ba Ashitoreti, elyo ne milungu ya bena Aramu, imilungu ya bena Sidoni, imilungu ya bena Moabu, imilungu ya bena Amoni elyo ne milungu ya Bafilisiti. Kanshi efyo balabile kuli Yawe, baleka no kumupepa,

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
translation: Ici calengele Yawe ukufulilwa abena Israeli icakuti abaposa na mu maboko ya Bafilisiti pamo na bena Amoni.

english: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
translation: Muli ulya mwaka balipeye no kucusha nganshi abana bakwa Israeli. Pa myaka ikumi limo na cine konse konse balicushishe abena Israeli abaleikalila ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani, mu calo ca bena Amoli icaba mu Gileadi.

english: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.
translation: Abena Amoni nabo bayabwike umumana wa Yordani kukulwisha abena Yuda, na bena Benjamini, pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Efulemu. Awe ubulanda bwalikulile nganshi ku bena Israeli.

english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.
translation: Nomba kwali umushilika uwapambana nganshi, ishina lyakwe ni Yefuta umwina Gileadi. Wishi ali ni Gileadi. Kabili nyina ali ni cilende.

english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”
translation: Bacilolo nabo batile, “Ala Yawe e kambone wesu. Ifwe cine cinefye tuli nokucita ifyo fine wasosa.”

english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.
translation: Elyo nomba Yefuta aile na bakalamba ba bena Gileadi. Kabili abekalamushi bamucitile ukuba intungulushi yabo, no kuba mukalamba wa fita pakati kabo. Kabili Yefuta abwekeshepo ukusosa amashiwi yonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ilyo ali mu Misipa.

english: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”
translation: Elyo Yefuta atumine inkombe ku mfumu ya bena Amoni mukuya ipusha ukuti, “Bushe cinshi ulefwaya kuli ifwe pakuti iwe usanse icalo cesu?”

english: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”
translation: Nayo imfumu ya bena Amoni yayaswike inkombe shakwa Yefuta, aiti, “Ilyo abena Israeli bafumine mu Egupto balipokolwele icalo candi, ukufumafye ku Alinoni ukufika na ku Yaboku ukuya shinta na ku mumana wa Yordani. Nomba ndetila, ubweshe ifyalo ifi mu mutende.”

english: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;
translation: Kabili Yefuta abwekeshepo ukutuma inkombe ku mfumu ya bena Amoni

english: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;
translation: no kuyeba ati, “Ifi efyo Yefuta asosa ati, ala abena Israeli tabapokelepo icalo ca Moabu iyoo, nangufye calo ca bena Amoni.

english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bafumine mu Egupto, baile pita ku matololo ya kuli Bemba Wakashika , baya fika na ku Kadeshi.

english: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.
translation: Elyo batumine inkombe ku mfumu ya bena Edomu no kutila, ‘Tulelomba ulusa lwakupita mu calo cobe,’ lelo imfumu ya bena Edomu yalibakenye. Kabili baile ku mfumu ya bena Moabu, nayo yine yalibakenye. Eico abena Israeli epakulaikalafye ku Kadeshi.

english: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
translation: “Icakonkelepo, abena Israeli baimine ukupita mu matololo no kulambata icalo ca Edomu na Moabu, ukupitila lubali lwa ku kabanga ka calo ca Moabu, no kucita inkambi kwishilya lya Alinoni. Abena Israeli tabaingile mu mpanga ya bena Moabu, pantu umumana wa Alinoni ewali e mupaka.

english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’
translation: Elyo abena Israeli batumine inkombe ku mfumu Sihoni iya bena Amoli uwaleteeka ku Heshiboni no kutila kuli ena, ‘Tulelomba ulusa lwakupita mu calo cobe, no kuya ku cifulo cesu.’

english: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”
translation: Muka Gileadi nao alikwete abana abaume. Ilyo bakulile, balitamfishe Yefuta no kumweba abati, “Iwe tawakabuuleko icakaniko ca cishilano mu lupwa lwesu pantu iwe wafyalwa mu mwanakashi umbi.”

english: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
translation: Sihoni ena tamwenemo icishinka mu bena Israeli mukubaleka bapite mu mpanga yabo. Kanshi ena epakulonganika abantu bakwe bonse no kuya cita inkambi ku Yahasi, kukulwisha abena Israeli.

english: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.
translation: Kanshi efyo abena Israeli bapokele no kwikala mu calo conse ica bena Amoli ukufuma ku Alinoni no kufika na ku Yaboku, kabili ukufuma ku matololo no kufika na ku Yordani.

english: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?
translation: “Apo nomba Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, nafulumuna abena Amoli ku ntanshi ya bantu bakwe abena Israeli bushe ni nsambu nshi iwe ukwete iyakucipokolola?

english: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever the LORD our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.
translation: Bushe tekuti upokolole ico umulungu wenu Kemoshi wapeela ukuba icikwatwa kuli imwe? Ngefyo na ifwe, bushe te nsambu shesu ukupoka conse ico Yawe Lesa wesu atupokolwela?

english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
translation: Bushe iwe waliwamapo ukucila Balaki mwana Sipo imfumu ya bena Moabu? Bushe ena alibalile aumanapo na bena Israeli, nangu ukulwa nabo?

english: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?
translation: Napapita imyaka imyanda itatu (300) apo abena Israeli baikalila mu Heshiboni na mu Aroe na mu mishi iya bashinguluka, elyo ne misumba yonse iya mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Alinoni. Bushe cinshi mushabapokele iyi mpanga lilya line?

english: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”
translation: Ine nshamulufyanyapo icintu nelyo cimo, lelo iwe wine niwe ulendufyanya mukulenga ukulwa na ine. Ala lekafye Yawe, umupingushi, eo apingule icakucita mu bushiku bwa lelo pakati ka bena Israeli elyo na bena Amoni.”

english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
translation: Lelo imfumu ya bena Amoni yakaana ukuposako amano ku mashiwi Yefuta amutumine.

english: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile pali Yefuta. Apitana monse mu bena Gileadi na bena Manase, apitana na mu Misipa ya ku Gileadi mpaka ukufika na ku bena Amoni.

english: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.
translation: Yefuta epakufulumuka ukufuma kuli bamunyina no kuya ikala mu calo ca Tobi. Kulya kwine aile ikala eko alonganike abantu abengi ifiwelewele abo ayambile ukubomba nabo mukutapa icuma.

english: Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
translation: Kabili Yefuta acitile umulapo kuli Yawe ati, “Nga cakutifye wampeela mu maboko yandi abena Amoni,

english: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”
translation: conse icikafuma mu ŋanda yandi no kwisa mukunkumanya ilyo nkabwela, ninshi nincimfya abena Amoni, cikaba cakwa Yawe. Kabili ine nkacituula nge lambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe.”

english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
translation: Elyo Yefuta ayabukile mukulwisha abena Amoni, na Yawe abapeele mu maboko yakwe.

english: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
translation: Abacimfishe ku maka ayakalamba no kubapokolola imisumba amakumi yabili ukufuma ku Aroe ukufikafye na ku Miniti mpaka na ku Abeli Kalamini. Abena Israeli balyanshishe abena Amoni, no kubacefya nganshi.

english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
translation: Elyo Yefuta abwelelamo kumwakwe ku Misipa, ne cacitike cakuti umwana wakwe umukashana ewafumine mukumusengela, alecinda nokulisha insombo! Ali e mwanafye wakwe. Takwetepo umwana umukashana nangu umwaume umbi.

english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I can’t go back.”
translation: Bwangu bwangufye ilyo amumwene, alepawile ifyakufwala fyakwe atampa no kulila ati, “Iye! We mwana wandi umukashana ee! Iwe wanenga ukuba no bulanda, kabili niwe cibe ifi! Ine nalilapa na kanwa kandi kuli Yawe nakabili teti ndapuluke amashiwi nalapilepo nakalya!”

english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”
translation: Umwana nao alyaswike wishi no kutila, “Tata wandi ee, iwe walilapa kuli Yawe. Ala citafye icintu conse ico walaya, pantu nomba moneni ukuti ni Yawe eukulandwilileko ku balwani benu, abena Amoni.”
