english: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”
translation: Kabili aebele wishi ati, “Nsuminisheniko icintu cimo nalalomba,” elyo atile, “Taleni ndekeni nje ndeendauka mu mpili pa myeshifye ibili no kulila pamo na banandi pantu ine nshakatale ngupwapo.”

english: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.
translation: Awe wishi atile, “Cisuma kuti waya.” Kabili amulekele aya pa myeshi ibili. Kanshi umukashana na banankwe baile ku mpili no kulila pantu takatale opwapo.

english: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel
translation: Panuma ya myeshi ibili abwelele kuli wishi, kabili wishi acitile ifintu alapile kuli Yawe. Awe umukashana afwilefye ukwabula ukuupwapo. Kanshi apa pene epafuma no lutambi lwa bena Israeli ulwakuti,

english: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshita, abena Amoni balwile na bena Israeli.

english: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
translation: cila mwaka abana abakashana bafwile ukuya mu mpanga inshiku shine mukulila umwana mwanakashi wakwa Yefuta umwina Gileadi.

english: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.
translation: Ilyo abena Amoni baimine ukulwisha abena Israeli, abakalamba ba mu Gileadi baile mukubuula Yefuta ukufuma ku calo ca Tobi.

english: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”
translation: Baya mweba ukuti, “Isa, natuleya pakuti ukaye ba umukalamba wa fita, epakuti tukalwishe abena Amoni bwino bwino.”

english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”
translation: Elyo nao Yefuta atile kuli bena, “Bushe teimwe mwampatile no kuntamfya mu ŋanda yakwa tata? Nga cinshi ico mwishile kuli ine nomba, ilyo mwakwata ubwafya?”

english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
translation: Nabo bacilolo batile kuli ena, “Uyu wine e mulandu twishile kuli iwe nomba. Ala natuleya bonse kukulwisha abena Amoni, pantu nomba iwe niwe uleya ba intungulushi pakati kesu fwe bekashi ba mu Gileadi.”

english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, will I be your head?”
translation: Yefuta epakweba abakalamba ba bena Gileadi ati, “Nga cakuti imwe mwansenda kukulwisha abena Amoni, na Yawe abapeela mu maboko yandi, bushe cacine nine nkaba intungulushi pakati kenu?”

english: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”
translation: Kabili abena Efulemu balongenye ifita fyabo, bayabukile na ku Safoni, no kuya eba Yefuta abati, “Nga kanshi cinshi wailile mukulwisha abena Amoni ukwabula ukuti utwiteko pakuti tuye bonse? Nomba ifwe twalakocela iŋanda pamo pene nobe.”

english: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.
translation: Ibisani ilyo afwile, ashiikilwe mu Betelemu.

english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
translation: Kabili uwamukonkelepo ni Eloni umwina Sebuloni, ewali mupingushi wa bena Israeli pa myaka ikumi limo (10).

english: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
translation: Elyo Eloni afwile, ashiikilwe mu musumba wa Aiyaloni mu calo cakwa Sebuloni.

english: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
translation: Kabili uwamukonkelepo ni Abidoni mwana Hileli, ukufuma ku Piratoni, ewatungulwile Israeli.

english: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
translation: Abidoni ali na bana amakumi yane (40) abaume, kabili abeshikulu nabo bali amakumi yatatu (30). Aba bonse baleendela pali bapunda amakumi cine lubali (70). Nao atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka cine konse konse.

english: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
translation: Ilyo nao Abidoni mwana Hileli umwina Piratoni afwile, ashiikilwe ku Piratoni mu calo cakwa Efulemu mu mpili sha calo ca bena Amaleki.

english: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.
translation: Elyo Yefuta atile kuli bena, “Ine pamo na bantu bandi twali no mulimo ukalamba nganshi uwakukankabula na bena Amoni. Kabili ilintu namwitile na imwe tamwaishile mpusushako ku maboko yabo.

english: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”
translation: Eico ilyo namwene ukuti imwe mwakaana ukungafwa, nshasakamene umweo wandi lelo nayabukile kukulwisha abena Amoni. Kabili Yawe nao ampeela amaka yakubacimfya. Kanshi nomba cinshi ico mwaishila ilelo mukuti mundwishe?”

english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”
translation: Elyo Yefuta nao alonganike abena Gileadi mukulwisha abena Efulemu. Elyo abena Gileadi bacimfishe abanabo pantu abena Efulemu batile, “Imwe mwe bena Gileadi mwafyukilefye mukati ka bena Efulemu na bena Manase.”

english: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”
translation: Abena Gileadi epakuya pokolola ifyabu fya mumana wa Yordani ifyakwabukilapo pakuya ku bena Efulemu. Kabili uyo onse uwapusuka wa mu bena Efulemu nga atila, “Ndefwaya ukwabuka.” Nabo abena Gileadi bali nokumwipusha ukuti, “Bushe iwe uli mwina Efulemu?” Elyo nao nga cakuti ayasuka atila, “Awe,”

english: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.
translation: elyo bali nokutila, “Cisuma sosa utile, ‘Shiboleti.’” Elyo nga asosa atila, “Siboleti,” pa mulandu wakukanalumbula bwino ili ishiwi, bali nokumwikata no kumwipaila palya pene pa fyabu fya mumana wa Yordani. Kanshi abantu ukulingana ne mpendwa amakana amakumi yane na yabili (42,000) aya bena Efulemu ebafwile pa nshita ilya inefye.

english: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.
translation: Yefuta ali mupingushi wa bena Israeli pa myaka mutanda. Elyo Yefuta uwali umwina Gileadi afwile, bamushiika na mu musumba wa Misipa mu Gileadi.

english: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Yefuta, Ibisani umwina Betelemu ewakonkelepo ukutungulula abena Israeli.

english: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.
translation: Akwete abana abaume amakumi yatatu (30), elyo na bana abanakashi amakumi yatatu (30) nabo bene. Aufishe abana bakwe abanakashi ku baume abashali ba mu mukowa wakwe. Abana bakwe abaume nabo abafwaile abakashana abashali ba mu mukowa wakwe amakumi yatatu (30) ebo baupile. Awe nao Ibisani atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka cine lubali.

english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
translation: Kabinge abena Israeli babwekeshepo ukubifya ku cinso cakwa Yawe, na Yawe epakubapeela mu maboko ya Bafilisiti pa myaka amakumi yane (40).

english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”
translation: Awe umwanakashi bwangu bwangufye abutwike no kuya eba umulume no kutila, “Ala ulya muntu amonekele kuli ine pali bulya bushiku naisa!”

english: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”
translation: Manoa nao alimine no kukonka umukashi. Ilyo afikile kuli uyu muntu, atile kuli ena, “Bushe niwe waishile landa no mukashi wandi?”

english: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”
translation: Elyo Manoa atile kuli ena, “Nomba ilyo amashiwi yobe yakesa fikilishiwa, cikaba shani ku musango no bumi bwa uyu mwana, kabili ni finshi akalacita?”

english: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.
translation: Elyo Malaika wakwa Yawe atile, “Conse ico naebele umukashi obe, eco afwilefye ukulacita.

english: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”
translation: Tafwile ukulalya icintu conse icili nokufuma ku myangashi, nangufye ukunwa umwangashi uulifye onse, nangu icikola conse nangu conse icakowela. Afwilefye ukulacita fyonse ifyo namukonkomeshe.”

english: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”
translation: Luka 1:15

english: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was the LORD’s angel.
translation: Nao malaika wakwa Yawe atile, “Ala nangufye imwe mwanteka, ine tekuti ndye icakulya cenu. Lelo nga mulefwaya ukupekanya umutuulo wa cakoca, utuuleni kuli Yawe.” Pantu Manoa ena taishibe ukuti ulya ali ni malaika wakwa Yawe.

english: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”
translation: Elyo Manoa aipwishe malaika wakwa Yawe ati, “Bushe ishina lyobe niwe nani? Pantu tulefwaya ilyo ishiwi lyobe likafikilishiwa tukakucindike.”

english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”
translation: Malaika wakwa Yawe nao atile, “Bushe mulandu nshi uleipushisha ishina lyandi? Ala lishina ilyankaama .”

english: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to the LORD. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.
translation: Elyo Manoa abuulile akabushi, pamo pene no mutuulo wa fyabunga, kabili apeele ilambo kuli Yawe mukufyocela pa mulu we libwe. Kabili Yawe nao acitile icipeshamano ninshi Manoa no mukashi wakwe balemona.

english: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
translation: Mu Sora mwali umuntu umo uwe shina lya Manoa, uwa mu luko lwa bena Dani. Manoa alyupile umwanakashi uwali iŋumba. Takwetepo mwana nelyo umo.

english: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, the LORD’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.
translation: Awe kutifye cilya ulubingu lwa mulilo lwalafuma pa bulambo no kulaya mumulu, malaika wakwa Yawe nao aninine mu lubingu lwa mulilo ukuya mumulu. Na pakumona ici, Manoa no mukashi wakwe bawile ubukupeme, bafisha ne mpumi shabo panshi.

english: But the LORD’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was the LORD’s angel.
translation: Awe ukufuma palya penefye malaika wakwa Yawe tabalile amonekela kuli Manoa no mukashi wakwe. Elyo Manoa ashininkishe ukuti kanshi ni malaika wakwa Yawe.

english: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”
translation: Elyo Manoa atile ku mukashi wakwe, “Ifwe tuli nokufwa, pantu natumona Lesa.”

english: But his wife said to him, “If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”
translation: Elintu umukashi wakwe atile, “Nga cakuti Yawe alefwaya ukutwipaya, awe nga tapokelele ilambo lyakoca no mutuulo wa cabunga ukufuma ku maboko yesu, kabili nga tatulangile ifintu fyonse ifi nangu ukutweba ifi fyonse batwebele.”

english: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
translation: Awe asukile umwanakashi apapa umwana umwaume, kabili amwinike ishina lya Samsoni. Umwana alakula, na Yawe amupaala.

english: The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Yawe watampile ukumucincisha ilyo acili aleikala mu Mane Dani pakati ka Sora na Eshitaoli.

english: The LORD’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe amonekele ku mwanakashi no kumweba ati, “Nangu iwe waba iŋumba kabili tawatala aukwatapo umwana, nomba uli nokwimita no kukwata umwana umwaume.

english: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;
translation: Eico nomba mona ukuti wilanwa umwangashi nangufye icikola conse. Kabili tecakwesha ukulya icakowela,

english: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”
translation: pantu iwe nomba uli nokwimita kabili ukafyala umwana umwaume. Tecakwesha ukumubeya ku mutwe wakwe, pantu uyu mwana akaba Munasiliti , emukutila uwapatulwa na Lesa ukufuma ku kufyalwa kwakwe. Kabili akatendeka ukufumya abena Israeli mu maboko ya Bafilisiti.”

english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;
translation: Elyo umwanakashi epakuya ku mulume wakwe no kuya mweba ati, “Umuntu umo uwakwa Lesa acisa kuli ine, elyo acilamoneka kwati ni malaika wakwa Lesa, uwakutiina nganshi. Ine nshacimwipusha uko acifuma kabili nao tacinjeba ne shina lyakwe.

english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”
translation: Nomba acinjeba ukuti, ‘Iwe uli nokwimita kabili ukafyala umwana umwaume. Eico nomba tecakwesha ukunwa umwangashi, nangu ukunwa icikola icili conse. Pantu uyu mulumendo akaba Umunasiliti wakwa Lesa ukufumafye ku kufyalwa kwakwe ukufika na ku bushiku bwa mfwa yakwe.’”

english: Then Manoah entreated the LORD, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”
translation: Elyo Manoa apepele kuli Yawe no kutila, “Napapata mwe Yawe, ine ndemulomba ukuti lekeni umuntu wakwa Lesa untu mwatumine kuli ifwe ese atufunde ifyo tuli nokucita pakusunga uyu mwana ali nokufyalwa.”

english: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.
translation: Lesa nao alyumfwile ukupapata kwakwa Manoa. Kabili na malaika wakwa Lesa alishile ku mwanakashi ilyo acili ku mabala. Manoa umulume wakwe ninshi talipo.

english: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.
translation: Inshita imo Samsoni aile ku Timuna no kumona kulya kwine umukashana Umufilisiti.

english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.
translation: Elyo wishi kwa Samsoni aile mukumona umwanakashi. Kabili Samsoni acitile amatebeto kulya kwine, pamo ngo lutambi ulo abalumendo abaleupa balecita.

english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
translation: Ilyo Samsoni aile monekela kulya, balimupeele abanankwe amakumi yatatu (30) abakwikala nankwe.

english: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;
translation: Elyo Samsoni abebele ati, “Lekeni mwebeko ubwile. Nga cakuti kuti mwanjeba ifyo cilepilibula mu nshikufye cine lubali isha mutebeto, ine nkamupeela insalu isha kolokondwe amakumi yatatu (30) ne nsalu shakufwala pa nshikunkulu nasho amakumi yatatu (30).

english: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.” They said to him, “Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti tamunjebele ifyo cilepilibula, nimwefye nomba mufwile ukumpeela insalu sha kolokondwe amakumi yatatu (30) elyo ne nsalu shakufwala pa nshikunkulu nasho amakumi yatatu (30).”

english: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.
translation: Samsoni nao atile,

english: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”
translation: Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga shine, batile kuli muka Samsoni, “We shisembeleka umulume obe pakuti atulondolweleko ifyo ubu bwile bulepilibula. Nga wakaana, tuli nokukoca pamo pene no lupwa lwakwa wiso, mukafwa. Bushe mwatwitile kuno mukwisa twibila?”

english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.” He said to her, “Behold, I haven’t told my father or my mother, so why should I tell you?”
translation: Elyo muka Samsoni akobwela umukoshi wakwe ku mulume no kulalila, no kutila, “Iwe kanshi walimpata! Iwe kanshi tawantemwa mu cine cine. Iwe walyeba abantu bandi ukwilula ubwile lelo ine tawanjeba ubwasuko.”

english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
translation: Awe umukashi nao abikilepofye ukulamulilila pa nshiku cine lubali isha mutebeto. Elintu pali ubu bwine bushiku bwakulenga cine lubali elyo amulondolwelele umo ubwile bwalolele, pantu alimupatikishe nganshi. Kabili nao elyo aile londolwela abantu bakwe umo ubwile bwalolele.

english: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”
translation: Ilyo akasuba kali takalawa pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwine, abekashi ba mu musumba batile kuli Samsoni,

english: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile na maka pali Samsoni. Awe aile na ku Ashikeloni, aya ipayako abantu amakumi yatatu (30) no kupokololako ifyuma fyabo. Abuulile ne fyakufwala fyabo no kutwalila balya bantu abailwile ubwile bwakwe. Kabili ninshi acili nafulwa nganshi, abwelele na ku ŋanda yakwa wishi.

english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife.”
translation: Ilyo abwelulwikeko, atile kuli wishi na nyina, “Ine ninja mona umukashana Umufilisiti mu Timuna. Eico nomba, kamubuuleni pantu eo ndefwaya ukuba umukashi wandi.”

english: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.
translation: Kabili umukashi wakwa Samsoni bamupeele na ku mubiye cibusa uwamupalamine pa bwinga bwakwe.

english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”
translation: Wishi na nyina batile, “Bushe mu lupwa lobe nangu pakati ka bantu bobe tapengaba umwanakashi uo wingopa? Cinshi ico wingaila ku Bafilisiti abashasembululwa eko waya fwaila umwanakashi wakuupa?”

english: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of the LORD; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.
translation: Abafyashi bakwe bena tabaishibe ukuti ifi fyonse fyali bupekanyo ukufuma kuli Yawe, uwalefwaya inshila imo iyakulwishishamo Abafilisiti. Pantu pali ilya nshita ebaleteeka abena Israeli.

english: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him.
translation: Elyo Samsoni pamo na wishi na nyina bonse pamo baile ku Timuna. Ilyo bafikile mupepi na ku mabala ya myangashi ya Timuna, ilyo linefye umusepela wa nkalamo wamubulumina.

english: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.
translation: Elyo Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile na maka pali Samsoni, icakuti alepawile inkalamo tupimfya tupimfya ku mabokofye, kwati ni filya engalepaula akana ka mbushi. Lelo taebeleko wishi nangu nyina ico acitile.

english: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.
translation: Awe Samsoni alitentemwike no kuya landa no mwanakashi, no kumutemwa.

english: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.
translation: Ilyo papitilepo inshiku shimo shimo, alibweleleko no kuya upa umukashana. Ilyo aile shoka mukumona icitumbi ca ilya nkalamo, asangile ukuti mu citumbi muli umwina wa nshimu no buci!

english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.
translation: Atapwilemo ubuci abika pa lupi no kuya alelya. Ilyo abwelele kuli wishi na nyina, alibapeeleko bumo, kabili nabo baliliile. Lelo tabebele ukuti afumishe mu citumbi ca nkalamo.

english: But after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat. He said, “I will go in to my wife’s room.” But her father wouldn’t allow him to go in.
translation: Panuma ya ifi fyonse ifyacitike, pa nshita yakusombola iŋanu, Samsoni abuulile akana ka mbushi no kuya mukutandalila umukashi wakwe. Elyo atile, “Kanje ingila ku muputule wa mukashi wandi.” Lelo shifyala amukanya ukuya ingilamo.

english: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.”
translation: Elyo abaume ba mu Yuda batile, “Bushe cinshi ico mwaishila mukutulwisha?”

english: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam’s rock, and said to Samson, “Don’t you know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?” He said to them, “As they did to me, so I have done to them.”
translation: Elyo abaume abena Yuda amakana yatatu (300) baile no kutentemukila ku lucengo lwa cilibwe ca Etamu, no kuya eba Samsoni abati, “Bushe iwe emukuti na nomba taulaishiba ukuti Abafilisiti ebatuteeka? Bushe finshi iwe ucitile ifi kuli ifwe?”

english: They said to him, “We have come down to bind you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines.” Samson said to them, “Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves.”
translation: Nabo batile kuli ena, “Ifwe twishile kuno pakuti tukukake elyo tukupeele mu maboko ya Bafilisiti.”

english: They spoke to him, saying, “No, but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands; but surely we will not kill you.” They bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.
translation: Nabo batile, “Iyoo, ifwe tulekukakafye no kukupeela mu maboko yabo. Ifwe tatwakwipaye.” Elyo bakakile Samsoni ne myando ibili iyipya, no kumufumya na mu lucengo mu cilibwe.

english: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.
translation: Cilya bafika ku Leyi, Abafilisiti baishile ne nsansa mukukumanya Samsoni. Elintu Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile na maka pali Samsoni. Awe ne myando iyali ku maboko yakwe yali kwati bushishi bwa kolokondwe ubwapya ku mulilo. Kabili na fyonse ifikakilo fyaliponene ifine fyeka ukufuma ku maboko yakwe.

english: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.
translation: Samsoni epakubuula icifupa ca meno icakwa punda icibishi, eco abomfya ukwipailako abantu abali ikana limo (1,000).

english: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni asosa ati,

english: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
translation: Ilyo Samsoni apwile ukusosa ifi, aposele icilifupa cakwa punda ukutali. Kabili neci cifulo cainikwe ishina lya Ramati Leyi .

english: He was very thirsty, and called on the LORD and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”
translation: Elyo Samsoni aiketwe ne cilaka nganshi, alilila na kuli Yawe no kutila, “We Mfumu niwe ulengele umubomfi obe ukucimfya apakalamba. Bushe ine nomba mfwefye ku cilaka, no kulenga mponene mu maboko ya bantu abashasembululwa?”

english: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.
translation: Kanshi Lesa nao epakulepula incende imo apafonkele mu Leyi, na menshi yafuma. Kabili ilyo Samsoni anwene, amaka yalibwelele muli ena, no kupuputuka. Ecalengele aka kamfukumfuku ukwinikwa ishina lya Eni Hakore , kabili ukufikafye na kuli nomba, emo kaba mu Leyi mwine.

english: Her father said, “I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead.”
translation: Shifyala atile, “Ine naishibe ukuti naumukaana umukashana, ecalengele no kutila ine mupeele ku mubiyo. Bushe umwaice wakwe tacilapo ukuwama? Bushe cinshi teti eo ubuule abe umukashi obe?”

english: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
translation: Kanshi Samsoni ali mupingushi wa bena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yabili (20), mu nshiku sha Bafilisiti.

english: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni atile kuli ena, “Ino nshita pa cilandushi conse ico nkacita ku Bafilisiti nshakakwate umulandu.”

english: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the middle between every two tails.
translation: Kanshi Samsoni epakuya mu mpanga no kuya ikata bamumbwe imyanda itatu (300), no kubakaka imicila babili babili. Kabili abikile icisaniko pakati ka micila iyo akakile ibili ibili.

english: When he had set the torches on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, and also the olive groves.
translation: Ilyo ayashishe ifisaniko no kuleka bamumbwe baleya mu mabala ya ŋanu ya Bafilisiti, aocele imyanshi bakakile iya ŋanu yonse iyaiminine, pamo pene na mabala ya myangashi, ne fimiti fya miolifa, fyonse fyapilile kumo.

english: Then the Philistines said, “Who has done this?” They said, “Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion.” The Philistines came up, and burned her and her father with fire.
translation: Elyo Abafilisiti batile, “Bushe nani umuntu uucitile ica musango uyu?” Elyo babeba ukuti, “Ni Samsoni shifyala wa mwina Timuna, pantu asangile umukashi wakwe balimupeela ku munankwe.” Elyo Abafilisiti baile no kocelela umwanakashi pamo pene na wishi, no kufwa bafwa.

english: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni epakubeba ati, “Apo imwe mwacita ica musango uyu, ine nalapa nshakaleke mpakafye nkalandule kuli imwe.”

english: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
translation: Awe alibasanshile bukali bukali no kwipaya abengi. Elyo atentemukile mwishika lya lupili no kuya ikala mu lucengo lwa cilibwe ca Etamu.

english: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
translation: Elyo Abafilisiti baile cita inkambi mu calo ca bena Yuda, no kuya sansa abena Leyi.

english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.
translation: Mu bushiku bumo Samsoni alile ku Gasa, uko aile mona umwanakashi umo cilende. Alimukonkele no kuya sendama nankwe.

english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”
translation: Elyo Delila atile kuli Samsoni, “Iwe kanshi untumfyafye no kumbepafye. Shi nomba njebafye ifyo bengakukaka.”

english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”
translation: Samsoni atile, “Nga cakuti umuntu uuli onsefye ankaka bwino bwino ku myando iyipya iyishabala aibomfiwapo, awe lyena ine kuti nanaka no kuba ngo muntu uuli onse.”

english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.
translation: Awe Delila abuulile imyando iyipya no kumukakilako. Ninshi Delila ali na baume bamo abafiseme mu muputule wa mukati ka ŋanda. Elyo atile kuli Samsoni, “Ala Abafilisiti bakwishila!” Awe Samsoni aputwile imyando ukufuma ku maboko yakwe kwati bushishifye.

english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”
translation: Elyo Delila atile kuli Samsoni, “Bushe na nomba ucili ulembepafye no kuntumfya? Ala, ine ndefwayafye unjebe ifyo bengakukaka.”

english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.
translation: Nomba ilyo acili mu tulo, Delila abuulile ifikuti apikwile mu mutwe wakwe, afipikanya nge sumbu no kufikasha elyo afipopela na ku lupopo. Elyo Delila atile kuli Samsoni, “Ala, Abafilisiti bakwishila!” Awe nao abukile mu tulo no kunukula akalupopo, no mushishi waishalilafye kwati tawapikwilwe.

english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”
translation: Elyo Delila atile kuli ena, “Nga kanshi kuti watila shani ukuti ‘walintemwa!’ ilyo umutima obe tawaba kuli ine? Uyu waba e muku walenga itatu uo umbepa no kumfisa ukunjeba inkaama yobe, uko wafumya amaka yakula ifi.”

english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.
translation: Awe Delila mu kupatikisha kwakwe akonkenyepofye ubushiku no bushiku ukulaipusha Samsoni, mpaka icifukushi caishile kuli Samsoni, alafwaisha no kufwa.

english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”
translation: Na pakulekelesha Samsoni mu cifukushi asukile asokolwela Delila inkaama yonsefye.

english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.
translation: Ilyo Delila amwene ukuti nomba namweba inkaama yonse, atumine amashiwi kuli bakateeka ba Bafilisiti no kutila, “Ala iseni nakabili, pantu Samsoni nomba nanjeba inkaama yonse.” Elyo nabo bakateeka ba Bafilisiti babwelulwike nabasenda ne ndalama sha silifa mu maboko yabo.

english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
translation: Elyo Delila alengele Samsoni asendama mu tulo pa makufi yakwe. Aitapo umwaume umo no kumweba ukuti abeye Samsoni umushishi untu apikwile cine lubali, na maka yakwe yayamba ukucepa. Elyo atendeka no kumucusha mpaka amaka yakwe yapwa.

english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”
translation: Ilyo abekashi ba mu Gasa babebele ukuti, “Samsoni ali kuno! Elyo bashingulwike incende, no kumulalilila mukumupembela ubushiku bonse pa mpongolo ya musumba. Takwali nelyo umo uwaselele mu nshita ya bushiku, bonse batilefye, ‘Ku maca elyo tuli nokumwipya.’ ”

english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that the LORD had departed from him.
translation: Elyo Delila atile kuli Samsoni, “Ala Abafilisiti bakwishila!” Abukile mu tulo no kutontonkanya ukuti, “Na lelo line ndeya nga filya fine ciba kale no kuipukumunafye ukwabula ubwafya.” Lelo taishibe ukuti Yawe namusha.

english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.
translation: Kabili Abafilisiti balimwikete no kumutonkola amenso, elyo bamutwala na ku Gasa. Baya bomfya iminyololo ya mukuba kukumukakilako, no kumubika kukulashingulusha icilibwe cakupelelako mu cifungo.

english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.
translation: Lelo umushishi wa mu mutwe wakwe watendeke ukulamena, panuma ya kumubeya.

english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”
translation: Nomba bakateeka ba Bafilisiti balongene mukutuula ilambo ilikankala ku mulungu wabo Dagoni elyo nokuti basangalale, pantu balandile ukuti, “Umulungu wesu nautupeela Samsoni, umulwani wesu, mu maboko yesu.”

english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”
translation: Nomba ilyo abantu bamwene Samsoni, batendeke ukutasha umulungu wabo no kutila, “Umulungu wesu nautupeela umulwani wesu mu maboko yesu, umuntu umo uwaonaula icalo cesu no kufusha imfwa mu kwipaulula kwa bantu besu.”

english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;
translation: Ilyo imitima yabo ninshi icili ne nsansa ishingi nganshi, batampile ukupunda abati, “Kaleteni Samsoni ese atusansamusheko.” Awe nabo baitile Samsoni ukufuma mu cifungo no kwisa mukwangala ku ntanshi yabo. Kabili bamwiminike pakati ka nceshi.

english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni aebele umubomfi uwamwikete pa kuboko kwakwe ati, “Ntwala pa ncende apabela inceshi ishaikasha itempele, pakuti eko nshintilile.”

english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.
translation: Nomba mwitempele mwali cinkupiti wa bantu, abaume na banakashi. Bakateeka bonse ba Bafilisiti nabo emo bali, elyo pa mutenge we tempele pali abantu ukulingana amakana yatatu (3,000), abaume na banakashi abaletamba kufyo Samsoni aleyangala.

english: Samson called to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni apepele kuli Yawe no kutila, “Mwe Mfumu Yawe, njibukisheniko. Mwe Lesa napapata nkoseleshenikofye uno wine muku. Kabili nengeni ukuti nandule ku Bafilisiti pa menso yandi yabili aya bantonkola.”

english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.
translation: Elyo Samsoni apalamine ku nceshi shibili isha pakati ishaikeshe ili tempele. Aikete ukuboko kwa kulyo kuli lumo elyo no kuboko kwa kuso kuli lumbi kabili ashintililako na maka ayakalamba nganshi.

english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.
translation: Lelo Samsoni asendeme ukufikafye inshita ya bushiku pakati. Elintu aishile ima no kwikata ifiibi fya ku mpongolo pamo pene ne nceshi shibili, no kufinukula fyonse kumo ne mipilikisho. Afisenda pa mabeya yakwe no kufitwala pa mulu wa lupili ulwalungatana na Hebuloni.

english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.
translation: Atile, “Lekeni nomba mfwile pamo na Bafilisiti!” Elyo asunkile na maka nganshi, ne tempele lyabongolokele pali bakateeka na bantu bonse abali mukati. Eico abafwilile pamo nankwe balifulishe ukucila abo aipeye ilyo ali umumi.

english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.
translation: Awe bamunyina pamo no lupwa lonse ulwakwa wishi baile kukusenda icitumbi cakwe. Baciletele no kucishiika pakati ka musumba wa Sola na Eshitaoli mu nindi yakwa wishi Manoa. Samsoni atungulwile abena Israeli pa myaka amakumi yabili.

english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshita, Samsoni batemwanene no mwanakashi umo uwaleikala mwishika lya Soreki, ishina lyakwe ali ni Delila.

english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”
translation: Elyo bakateeka ba Bafilisiti baile kuli ena nokutila, “Umone nga kuti wamusembeleka, akakulange inkaama ya maka yakwe nefyo twingamwansha pakuti twamukaka no kumupwisha. Elyo na ifwe cila muntu ali nokukupeela indalama amashekeli ikana limo no mwanda umo (1,100) isha silifa .”

english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”
translation: Awe nao Delila atile kuli Samsoni, “Shinjebako icalenga ukuti ukwate amaka ayakula ifi, kabili nefyo bengakukaka no kukucimfya.”

english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”
translation: Elyo Samsoni atile kuli Delila, “Nga cakuti umuntu uuli onsefye ankaka ne nshinga ishibishi cine lubali, ishishilauma, awe lyena kuti amaka yapwa nabafye ngo muntu uuli onse.”

english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
translation: Elyo bakateeka ba Bafilisiti baletele inshinga ishibishi cine lubali kabili ishishauma kuli Delila, nao esho abomfya ukumukakilako,

english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.
translation: ilyo ninshi Delila ali na baume bamo ababeleme mu muputule wa mukati ka mu ŋanda. Elyo atile kuli Samsoni, “Ala, Abafilisiti bakwishila!” Awe Samsoni aputwile inshinga kwati bushishi ubwakumya ku mulilo. Eico inkaama ya maka yakwe tayaishibikwe.

english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
translation: Nomba kwali umuntu umo uwe shina lya Mika, uwaleikala mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu.

english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.
translation: Elyo Mika atile kuli ena, “Twakulaikala bonse no kuba tata wandi kabili shimapepo wandi. Ndi nokulakupeela indalama amashekeli ya silifa ikumi limo pa mwaka. Nkalakufwika no kukuliisha.”

english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.
translation: Awe nao umwina Levi alisumine ukwikala nankwe. Kabili uyu mulumendo asangwikefye kwati ni umo uwa pa bana bakwe abaume.

english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
translation: Elyo Mika asontele uyu umwina Levi ukuba shimapepo wakwe, no kulaikala nankwe mu ŋanda mumwakwe

english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the LORD will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”
translation: Kabili Mika atile, “Nomba ine naishiba ukutila Yawe ali nokumpaala, apo nakwata uyu umwina Levi ukuba shimapepo wandi.”

english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May the LORD bless my son!”
translation: Kabili atile kuli nyina, “Pa mulandu wa ndalama ikana limo no mwanda umo (1,100) isha silifa isho bakwibile, kabili isho naumfwile ukuti walelapisha, ngefyo na ine wine nayumfwilile ne mwine, ala ine isho ndalama sha silifa, ndi nasho. Nine wine nasendele.”

english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”
translation: Ilyo abweseshe ishi indalama amashekeli ikana limo no mwanda umo (1,100) isha silifa kuli nyina, nao atile, “Ine ndelaya mu cine no kutambika indalama shandi isha silifa kuli Yawe pa mulandu wa mwana wandi, pakuti apangemo icimpashanya icakubasa ne caengwa. Kabili ine ndi nokucibwesesha kuli imwe.”

english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.
translation: Eico kanshi, ilyo abweseshemo ishi ndalama sha silifa kuli nyina, nao nyina abuulilepo indalama amashekeli ya silifa imyanda ibili (200) , no kushipeela kuli Kafula wa fyela fya silifa, nao panuma yakwengulula, apangamo icimpashanya icabaswa ne caengwa no kufibika mu ŋanda yakwa Mika.

english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
translation: Nomba uyu wine muntu Mika alikwete ne ŋanda yakupepelamo utulubi. Kabili alipangile icakufwala ca bushimapepo ica efodi no tulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda, elyo abuula no mwana wakwe umwaume umo amucita ukuba shimapepo.

english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
translation: Pantu mu nshiku shilya, abena Israeli tabakwete imfumu. Kanshi umuntu onse umwine aleicitilafye icili conse ico amona ukuti nacimulinga.

english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.
translation: Kwali no mulumendo uwafumine ku Betelemu mu calo cakwa Yuda, kabili ali wa mu luko wakwa Yuda. Uyu ali mwina Levi, umweni uwaleikala kulya.

english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.
translation: Uyu muntu ashile icifulo cakwe mu Betelemu mu calo ca Yuda no kuya alefwaya fwaya icifulo cimbi icakwikalapo. Ilyo acili pa lwendo, atulile pa ŋanda yakwa Mika mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu.

english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”
translation: Awe Mika atile kuli ena, “Bushe iwe wafuma kwi?”

english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.
translation: Mu nshiku shilya abena Israeli tabakwete imfumu. Kabili mu nshiku shilya uluko lwa bena Dani lwalefwaya fwaya icifulo icingaba icabofye icakulaikalamo. Pantu bena tabali tabalapeelwa icifulo ca cakaniko ca cishilano pakati ka nko sha bena Israeli.

english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth.”
translation: Kabili ilyo mukafika kulya, mukaya sanga abantu abashili bamutunganya. Icalo naco cikulu ico Lesa apeele mu maboko yenu. Mu calo umushaba ukukabila kantu nelyo kamo.”

english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
translation: Elyo abaume imyanda mutanda (600) aba mu luko lwakwa Dani, abaipangeshe ne fyanso fya bulwi, bafumine ku Sora na ku Eshitaoli no kuya ku bulwi.

english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.
translation: Ilyo bacili mu nshila bacitile inkambi pa Kiriati Yarimu mu calo cakwa Yuda. Uyu wine e mulandu ici cifulo icabela ku masamba ya Kiriati Yarimu bacitila Mane Dani ukufika no bushiku bwa lelo line.

english: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
translation: Kabili ukufuma kulya, batwalilile no kuya ku calo ca mpili cakwa Efulemu no kufika ku ŋanda yakwa Mika.

english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”
translation: Elyo balya bantu basano abaile mukulengula icalo ca Laishi batile kuli bamunyina, “Bushe imwe mwalishiba ukuti pali aya mayanda palibapo imo umwaba icakufwala ca bushimapepo ca efodi, utulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda, icimpashanya icabaswa ne cimpashanya icaengwa? Eico nomba tontonkanyenipo ico mwalacita.”

english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.
translation: Kanshi nabo epakwaluluka palya pene, no kuya ku ŋanda ya mulumendo umwina Levi ku cifulo cakwa Mika no kuya muposhapo.

english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.
translation: Ninshi abaume imyanda mutanda (600) abaipangeshe ku bulwi nabo beminine pa mwinshi wa mpongolo.

english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
translation: Balya abaume basano abaile lengula icalo baingile mu ŋanda no kusenda icimpashanya icabaswa ne cakufwala ca bushimapepo ca efodi, utulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda ne cimpashanya icaengwa, ninshi shimapepo na bantu imyanda mutanda (600) abaipangeshe ne fyabulwi beminine pa mwinshi wa mpongolo.

english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”
translation: Ilyo aba bantu baingile mu ŋanda mwa Mika no kubuulamo icimpashanya icabaswa ne cakufwala ca bushimapepo ca efodi, utulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda ne cimpashanya icaengwa, elyo shimapepo atile kuli bena, “Bushe ni finshi imwe mulecita?”

english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”
translation: Nabo batile, “Iwe talalafye tondolo! Tecakwesha ukusosa ishiwi nelyo limo. Tuleyafye bonse, no kuba tata kabili shimapepo wesu. Bushe te cisuma ukuti ulebombela uluko no lupwa lwa mu bena Israeli nga shimapepo, ukucila ukulabombela iŋanda ya muntu umo?”

english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
translation: Eico abena Dani batumine abantu basano abakalabana ukufuma pa mpendwa ya bantu babo ku Sora na ku Eshitaoli mukaya lengula icalo no kucifwailisha. Babebele ukuti, “Kabiyeni, kafwailisheni ici icalo!”

english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.
translation: Awe shimapepo nao alitemenwe nganshi. Abuulile icakufwala ca bushimapepo ca efodi, utulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda elyo ne cimpashanya icabaswa no kukonka aba bantu abena Dani.

english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.
translation: Elyo bayalulwike, no kutendeka ukuya. Batangisha abaice, ifitekwa ne fyuma fyabo pa ntanshi yabo.

english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.
translation: Kutifye cilya baendako panono ukufuma pa ŋanda yakwa Mika, abaume abaleikala mupepi ne ŋanda yakwa Mika balongene pamo no kusupila abena Dani.

english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”
translation: Elyo babilikisha abena Dani, nabo bapilibuka no kutila kuli Mika, “Bushe cinshi calenga ukuti mwise no mulongo wa bantu abafula ifi?”

english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”
translation: Mika nao atile, “Imwe namusenda imilungu iyo ne mwine naipangila, kabili namunsendela na shimapepo wandi, nomba ine ndeshala na cinshi? Nga kuti mwalaipusha shani ukuti, ‘Cinshi ico mwaishila no mulongo wa bantu abafula ifi?’”

english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”
translation: Elyo abena Dani batile kuli ena, “Iwe wilatalikana na ifwe, pantu limbi abantu nga bafulwa bwangu kuti bakulwisha, icakuti iwe no lupwa lobe kuti mwalufya ne myeo yenu.”

english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.
translation: Awe abena Dani bakonkenyepo ulwendo lwabo. Kabili ilyo Mika abamwene ukuti nabakwatisha amaka ukumucila, ayalulwikeko no kubwelelamo kumwakwe.

english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.
translation: Ilyo abena Dani basendele ifyo Mika apangile, pamo pene na shimapepo, baile ku Laishi ku bulwi ku bantu baikele umutende, kabili abashaletunganya nelyo cimo, no kuya basansa no kubepaya ku lupanga, babocela no musumba wabo.

english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.
translation: Takwali umuntu nelyo umo uwakubatulako, pantu baleikala ukutali nganshi ukufuma ku Sidoni, kabili tabakwete na cumfwano na bantu ba ku Aramu. Umusumba wabo wali mwishika ilya ku Beti Rehobu.

english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
translation: Uyu musumba bawinike Dani, ishina lya cikolwe cabo uwafyelwe kuli Israeli, nangu uyu umusumba kale waleitwa Laishi.

english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”
translation: Ninshi bali mupepi ne ŋanda yakwa Mika, baumfwile ishiwi lya mulumendo ukuti lya mwina Levi. Awe bashokele kuntu ali nokumwipusha abati, “Nga nani uwakuleta kuno? Kabili cinshi ico ulecita kuli cino cifulo? Mulimo nshi waishila kuno?”

english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.
translation: Awe abena Dani baimike ne cilubi icabaswa pakuti balecipepa. Elyo babuulile Yonatani mwana Geshomu, uwali mwana Mose pamo na bana bakwe abaume ukuba bashimapepo pakati ka luko lwa bena Dani ukufika na pa nshita babasendele muli bunkole.

english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.
translation: Kanshi batwalilile ukulabomfya utulubi uto Mika abashilile inshitafye yonse ilyo iŋanda yakwa Lesa yali mu Shilo.

english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”
translation: Nao atile kuli bena, “Mika alincitila ifingi, ndi mubomfi wakwe uwa malipilo, kabili ndi shimapepo wakwe.”

english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”
translation: Nabo batile kuli ena, “Twapapata twipushisheko kuli Lesa twishibe nga cakuti ulwendo lwesu luli nokuba ulweshuko.”

english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before the LORD.”
translation: Shimapepo nao atile, “Cisuma mwende umutende. Ulwendo lwenu luli ulwasuminishiwa kuli Yawe.”

english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.
translation: Elyo aba bantu basano baimine no kuya ku Laishi, no kuya sanga ukuti abantu baleikalafye mu mutelelwe, nga aba mu musumba wa Sidoni, abashitungwa kabi, abacingililwa bwino kabili abashalekabila icintu nangu cimo pano calo. Balitalwike ku bena Sidoni, kabili tabaleampana nangu umo.

english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”
translation: Kabili ilyo aba bantu basano babwelelemo ku Sora na ku Eshitaoli, bamunyinabo batile kuli bena, “Bushe mwasangile shani ifyo ifintu fili?”

english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.
translation: Nabo batile, “Iseni pakuti tukaye balwisha! Pantu natumona ukuti icalo cisuma nganshi. Bushe mwalaikalafye tamwacitepo nelyo cimo? Ala mwikokola ukuti tuye mukupokolola cilya icalo.

english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.
translation: Mu nshiku shilya, abena Israeli tabakwete imfumu. Nomba eko ali umwina Levi umo uwaikele mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu ukutali nganshi, abuulile umwanakashi umwina Betelemu mu calo cakwa Yuda, ukuba umukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga.

english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.
translation: Lelo tasumine ukusendama nakabili, aiminefye ukulungama ku Yebusi, emukutila ku Yerusalemu, pamo na bapunda ba fipe babili, no mukashi wakwe.

english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”
translation: Ilyo bafika mupepi no musumba wa Yebusi ilyo akasuba kaba kukuwa, umubomfi atile kuli shikulu wakwe, “Natupasuke tulole kulya ku musumba wa bena Yebusi, eko tusendame.”

english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”
translation: Lelo shikulu wakwe akaana ati, “Iyoo. Tekuti tuye mu musumba umbi umbifye, uo abantu babamo te bena Israeli. Twalayafye mpaka ukuya fika ku Gibea.”

english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”
translation: Elyo amweba nokuti, “Kosafye pakuti tweshe ukuya fika ku Gibea nangu ku Rama, no kuya sendama mu cifulo cimo kulya kwine.”

english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.
translation: Kanshi epakutwalililafye no lwendo lwabo, mpaka na kasuba kashima ilyo bapalama mupepi no musumba wa Gibea mu calo cakwa Benjamini.

english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.
translation: Kulya eko baiminine no kusendama. Baile no kuya ikala mu lubansa ulwabelele pakati ka musumba, lelo takwali umuntu nelyo umo uwabasendele kukuya sendama ku ŋanda kumwakwe.

english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.
translation: Mu cungulo cine cilya, umuntu umo umukote alefuma ku milimo ya mu mabala. Afumine ku calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu, nomba aleikala mu musumba wa Gibea. Emukutila abekashi ba muli ici cifulo bali bena Benjamini.

english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”
translation: Ilyo amwene abalendo pakati ka lubansa lwa musumba aile no kuya bepusha ati, “Bushe imwe, muleya kwi? Kabili ni kwisa mufumine?”

english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to the LORD’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.
translation: Nao umulendo ayasuka ati, “Ifwe tuli pa bulendo ukufuma ku Betelemu wa mu calo ca Yuda, tuleya ukutali ku calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu, eko twikala kabili eko nafumine na pakuya ku Betelemu mu calo ca bena Yuda. Nomba tuli pa lwendo lwakubwelelamo kumwesu lelo takuli umuntu nelyo umo uutusendeleko kukuya sendama kumwakwe.

english: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”
translation: Natukwatafye fyonse, impimbili ne fyakulya fya bapunda besu, no mukate no mwangashi, ifya ifwe fwe bene fwe babomfi benu, ine, umukashana no mulumendo untu tuli nankwe. Takuli icintu nelyo cimo, ico tulekabila.”

english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.
translation: Lelo uyu mukashana tali uwacetekelwa ku mulume wakwe iyoo. Ashile umulume wakwe no kubwelelamo kuli wishi ku Betelemu ku calo cakwa Yuda, no kuya ikala kulya imyeshi ine.

english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”
translation: Elyo umuntu umukote atile, “Umutende ube na imwe, mwapokelelwa ku ŋanda yandi, kabili ndemupeela fyonse ifyo mulekabila. Nombafye, tecakwesha ukusendama pakati ka lubansa lwa musumba.”

english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.
translation: Abap 1:21

english: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”
translation: Ilyo bacilifye balesansamuka, ifiwelewele fimo ifya baume fyafumine mu musumba no kushinguluka iŋanda. Bayambile ukulapumaula ku ciibi, no kulabilikisha ku mukote uwali umwine wa ŋanda no kutila, “Fumya uyo umwaume uwishile mumobe pakuti tulale nankwe.”

english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.
translation: Awe umukote asukile afumina panse, no kubeba ukuti, “Iyoo, mwe bacibusa bandi, tecakwesha ukucita ici cintu icabipa ifyo. Pantu uyu muntu mulendo wandi, te cisuma ukucita icamusebanya!

english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”
translation: Moneni, ine ninkwata umwana wandi umukashana nacisungu, elyo no mukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga, ebo lekeni mupeele pakuti mucite mwe bene fintu mulefwaya, lelo kuli uyu mwaume tecakwesha ukucitako icintu icamusebanya!”

english: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.
translation: Lelo ifi fibantu ifyaume fyalikene ukumfwa kuli uyu umukote. Elyo uyu umwina Levi abuulile umukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga no kumufumisha panse kuli bena, nabo basendeme nankwe kumaka no kumwangasha ubushiku bonse, mpaka bwaca ku macaca elyo bamulekele ukuya.

english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.
translation: Ilyo bwacele ulucelo uyu mwanakashi elyo abwelele ku ŋanda ukwali shikulu wakwe, no kuya wa pa mwinshi wa ŋanda no kulala palya pene mpakafye ilyo akasuba kabalike.

english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
translation: Ilyo shikulu wakwe abukile ulucelo, no kwisulako iciibi pakuti atampeko kulaya ulwendo lwakwe, amwene umukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga nalala, nawa mu mwinshi wa ŋanda natambalika na maboko yakwe mu mwinshi.

english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.
translation: Elyo amweba ukuti, “Ima, natuleya!” Lelo takwali bwasuko. Elyo amubikile pali punda wakwe, aima no kuya fika kumwakwe.

english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.
translation: Ilyo bafikile kumwabo abuulile umwele no kuputaula umukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga mu fipimfya fipimfya ukulingana ikumi limo na fibili (12), no kufituma mu ncende shonse isha bena Israeli.

english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
translation: Elyo umulume wakwe amukonkela kukumupapata pakuti engabweluluka. Ilyo aileko, ali no mubomfi wakwe na bapunda babili. Ilyo amumona, uyu mukashana amutwala mu ŋanda yakwa wishi. Kabili ilyo wishi amumona, amupokelela ne nsansa nganshi.

english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”
translation: Lelo abantu bonse abamweneko batile, “Awe icintu ca musango uyu tacabala acimoneka nangu ukucitika, nelyofye lintu abena Israeli bafumine mu calo ca Egupto. Tontonkanyeni! Pandishanyeni amano pali ici cintu pakuti twishibe ifyakucita.”

english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.
translation: Elyo shifyala, wishi wa mukashana, amupapatila ukuti ekale. Kanshi nao epakwikala nabo inshiku shitatu, balalya elyo no kunwa, kabili alaikala na kulya kwine.

english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shine, bonse babuukile lucelocelo elyo umwina Levi atendeka no kuipekanya pakuti aleya. Lelo wishi wa mukashana aeba shifyala ati, “Awe ubale ulye pakuti nga wakwata amaka, elyo lyena walaya.”

english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”
translation: Kanshi bonse babili epakwikala balalya no kunwena pamo. Na panuma wishi wa mukashana atile, “Nakupapata ukuti wiya, lelo usendame pakuti usansamuke we mwine.”

english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.
translation: Kanshi ilyo uyu muntu aipekanya ukuti eme aleya, shifyala kabili amunakilisha, nao abwela no kusendama.

english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.
translation: Ulucelocelo ubushiku bwalenga shisano, ilyo atile nomba kandeya, wishi wa mukashana nakabili amweba ati, “Awe ubale ulye. Kabili upembele akasuba kalukeko!” Kabili bonse babili baikala balalya nokunwena pamo.

english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”
translation: Kabili ilyo uyu muntu no mukashi wakwe uo ashaupile mu bwinga, no mubomfi wakwe, bati beme no kuya, kabili wishi wa mukashana abeba ati, “Nomba shimona akasuba kalaba ku cungulo, sendamenifye kuno kwine. Pantu nakawa kale akasuba elyo no bushiku buno nabupita. Ikalafye no kusangalala. Ulucelocelo mailo kuti waima no kuba pa lwendo lobe ulwakuya kumwenu.”

english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Yoshua, abena Israeli baipwishe Yawe abati, “Bushe ni bani abali nokubalilapo ukuya lwisha abena Kenani.”

english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
translation: Kabili batwalilile mu bulwi bwabo ku bena Kenani abaleikala mu musumba wa Hebuloni, uyu musumba kale waleitwa ati, “Kiriati Aba,” no kucimfya imfumu Sheshai na bantu baiko, imfumu Aimani na bantu baiko elyo ne mfumu Talimai na bantu baiko.

english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
translation: Ukufuma kulya, batwalilile mukulwisha abekashi ba mu Debi, uyu musumba kale waleitwa ukuti, “Kiriati Sefe.”

english: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
translation: Elyo Kalebu atile, “Ine ndi nokupeela umuntu onse uuli nokucimfya Kiriati Sefe ukuti eo akope umwana wandi umwanakashi Akisa.”

english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
translation: Nao ayaswike ati, “Tata ndefwaya mumpeeleko icilambu cimo icikankala. Apo ni mu matololo ya Negebu mwampeela impanga, mpeeleniko no tumfukumfuku twa menshi.” Elintu Kalebu wishi amupeeleko utumfukumfuku twa pa mulu wa lupili elyo no twa mwishika lya lupili.

english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
translation: Balupwa bakwa shifyala wakwa Mose, umwina Keni, bafumine mu musumba wa Tuncindu pamo na bantu bakwa Yuda no kuya ikala na bantu ba mu matololo yakwa Yuda aya mu Negebu mupepi na Aradi.

english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
translation: Elyo abena Yuda na bena Simeoni bamunyinabo baile bonse no kuya sansa abena Kenani abaleikala mu Sefati, baonaula no musumba onsefye. Elyo bainike noyu musumba abati ni Homa .

english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
translation: Abena Yuda kabili bapokolwele ne misumba itatu, Gasa, Ashikeloni elyo na Ekironi, ukubikapo ne fyalo fya cila musumba.

english: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
translation: Awe Yawe alyafwilishe abena Yuda kabili balicimfishe no kupokolola icalo ca ku mpili. Lelo balifililwe ukufulumuna abantu abaikala mu mawanga pa mulandu wa maceleta ayo bakwete yali aya fyela.

english: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
translation: Elyo Yawe ayaswike ati, “Bena Yuda ebalabalilapo. Pantu Ine nimpeela icalo mu maboko yabo.”

english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
translation: Pamo ngefyo Mose alaile, Hebuloni yapeelwe kuli Kalebu, elyo nao afulumunamo bamwana Anaki batatu.

english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
translation: Abena Benjamini balifililwe ukutamfya abena Yebusi abaleikala mu Yerusalemu, eico ukufika na lelo line abena Yebusi bacili baleikala pamo na bena Benjamini.

english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
translation: Nomba aba ŋanda yakwa Yosefu baile sansa umusumba wa Betele, kabili Yawe alibafwilisheko.

english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
translation: Aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yosefu batumine inengu ku Betele, uyu musumba kale waleitwa ukuti Lusi.

english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
translation: Ilyo inengu shamwene umuntu umo alefuma mu musumba, shamweba ashiti, “Tulangeko ifyo twingengila mu musumba, elyo na ifwe tuli nokulanga uluse kuli iwe.”

english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
translation: Nao epakubalangilila bwino ifyakwingila. Elyo baipeye abantu bonse mu musumba ku lupanga, no kushamofye uyu wine muntu pamo no lupwa lwakwe lonse.

english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
translation: Awe uyu muntu aile na ku calo ca bena Hiti, uko aile kuula umusumba no kuwinika ati ni Lusi. Kabili ifi fine efyo ucili uleitwa na lelo line.

english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
translation: Kabili abena Manase balifililwe ukufulumuna abena Beti Shani, nangu abena Tanaki, nangu abena Dori, nangu abena Ibileamu nangu abena Megido, pamo pene ne mishi iyabashingulwike. Pantu abena Kenani bakoselepofye ukulaikala muli cilya calo.

english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
translation: Lelo ilyo abena Israeli bakosele, batitikishe abena Kenani ukulabomba imilimo ya mulaasa, lelo ukubatamfya tababatamfishe iyoo.

english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
translation: Nangufye abena Kenani abaleikala mu musumba wa Gesa, abena Efulemu tababafulumwinemo muli uyu musumba, lelo batwalililefye ukwikala nabo.

english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
translation: Elyo abena Yuda baeba abena Simeoni bamunyinabo abati, “Natuleya bonse mu calo twapeelwa no kuya lwisha abena Kenani. Elyo panuma na ifwe tukamwafwako ukuya lwisha mu calo cenu ico mwapeelwa.” Awe abena Simeoni epakuya nabo.

english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
translation: Nangu na bena Sebuloni bene tabafulumwine abena Kenani abaleikala mu Kitiloni, nangu mu Naaloli, abo abashele pakati kabo, lelo babapeelefye umulimo wakubomba umulaasa.

english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
translation: Abena Asheri nabo tabafulumwinemo abaleikala mu Ako, nangu aba mu Sidoni, nangu mu Alabu, nangu mu Akisibu, nangu mu Eliba, nangu mu Afeki kabili nangu mu Reobu.

english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
translation: Na pa mulandu wa ici abena Asheri baikele pamo na bena Kenani, abali abakaya ba calo.

english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
translation: Abena Naftali nabo bene tabafulumwine abo bonse abaleikala mu Beti Shemeshi nangu mu Beti Anati, lelo baikele pamo na bena Kenani abali abakaya ba calo. Nomba bonse abaleikala mu Beti Shemeshi na mu Beti Anati, bena babapatikishe ukulabomba umulaasa kuli bena.

english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
translation: Kabili abena Amoli batamfishe abena Dani ku calo ca mpili no kubalesha ukulaisa ku mawanga.

english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
translation: Awe abena Amoli bena bakonkenyepofye ukulaikala mu fyalo fya mpili ifya Heresi, Aiyaloni na Shalibimu. Lelo ilyo aba ŋanda yakwa Yosefu baishile kwatisha amaka, babapatikisha no kulabomba umulaasa kuli bena.

english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
translation: Umupaka wa bena Amoli watulile pa mupokapoka wa Akarabimu, ukuya fika ku Sela elyo no kucilapo.

english: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
translation: Ilyo abena Yuda baile mukulwa, Yawe apeele mu minwe yabo abena Kenani na bena Perisi, kabili baipeye abantu ukulingana ne mpendwa amakana ikumi limo (10,000) ku Beseki.

english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
translation: Ni uku kwine ku Beseki eko basangile imfumu Adoni Beseki nao bamulwisha, elyo bacimfya na bena Kenani na bena Perisi.

english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
translation: Lelo Adoni Beseki wena alifulumwike, nomba balimukonkele no kuya mwikata, elyo bamuputaula ifikumo pamo pene ne fikondo.

english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
translation: Elyo Adoni Beseki atile, “Bakateeka amakumi cine lubali (70), abaali ne fikumo fyabo elyo ne fikondo fyabo ifikulu ifyaputulwako, ebaletola ifyakulya mwisamba lye tebulo lyandi.
