Nomba cakupapa pafyo Lesa nao ancita, pantu abwesesha kuli ine ifyo nacitile kuli bena.” Awe balimusendele no kumutwala ku Yerusalemu, no kufwa eko aile fwila.

english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
translation: Kabili abena Yuda balwishishe umusumba wa Yerusalemu no kuupoka. Baipeye abantu ku lupanga, basha baoca no musumba.

english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
translation: Panuma ya ifyo, abena Yuda baile kabili mukulwisha abena Kenani abaleikala mu calo ca mpili, ku matololo ya Negebu na bali mwishika lya mpili.

english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to the LORD at Mizpah.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bonse baimine ukufuma kuli Dani ukufikafye na ku Beresheba, kabili ukulundakofye ne calo ca Gileadi. Baishile pamo ngo muntu umo no kulongana pa cinso cakwa Yawe ku Misipa.

english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”
translation: Tuli nokubuulapo abantu ikumi limo ukufuma pali cila mwanda umo (100) uwa nko sha bena Israeli. Elyo umwanda umo (100) ukufuma pekana limo (1,000). Kabili ikana limo (1,000) ukufuma pa makana ikumi limo (10,000) abakulaleta ifyakulya ku fita fya nkondo. Kanshi ilyo ifita fikafika ku Gibea mu calo ca Benjamini, fikaya landula ukulingana no musebanya bacitile ku bena Israeli.”

english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
translation: Eico bonse abaume abena Israeli balongene pamo nga ba ŋanda imo, balifye pa cintu cimo icakuya lwisha uyu musumba.

english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?
translation: Elyo aba nko sha bena Israeli batumine abantu mu calo conse ica mutundu wakwa Benjamini no kutila, “Ngobu bubifi bwa musango nshi ubucitike pakati kenu?

english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.
translation: Eico nomba tupeeleni ifyo ifiwelewele fya bantu ifya bena Gibea, pakuti tubepaye no kufumya ububifi mukati ka bena Israeli.” Lelo abena Benjamini tebakumfwa ku babwananyina banabo abena Israeli iyoo.

english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
translation: Nabo abena Benjamini balonganike abantu pamo ukufuma mu misumba yabo yonse, no kwisa ku Gibea mukulwisha abena Israeli.

english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.
translation: Pali ubu bwine bushiku, abena Benjamini balongenye ifita ifyaishiba ukulwa ku lupanga amakana amakumi yabili na mutanda (26,000) ukufuma mu misumba yabo. Neyi mpendwa yakukanapendelako abena Gibea.

english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
translation: Pali ifi fine ifita fyonse pali imyanda cine lubali (700) abaume abasalilwe, abo abalebomfya amaboko yabo aya ku kuso. Cila muntu aletifye nga apima umushishi umo ku mutwe wa muntu ne lekeni, talepusa nakalya.

english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.
translation: Abena Israeli, ukufumyako abena Benjamini, nabo bali amakana imyanda ine (400,000) ifita fyacenjelesha kukulwa ku lupanga, bonsefye bali abaume babulwi.

english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” The LORD said, “Judah first.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baile ku Betele kukuya ipusha kuli Lesa abati, “Bushe ni nani uwa pali ifwe uuleba uwantanshi kukuya lwa na bena Benjamini?” Nao Yawe atile, “Abena Yuda ebalabalilapo ukuya”.

english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
translation: Awe ulucelo abena Israeli balimine no kuya cita inkambi mupepi no musumba wa Gibea.

english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.
translation: Intungulushi shonse isha bantu aba nko sha bena Israeli, nasho epo shali pali ici cilonganino ca bantu bakwa Lesa. Kabili ifita ifyaipangeshe impanga fyali amakana imyanda ine (400,000).

english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baile kukulwisha abena Benjamini no kutantika ifita fyabo ifyabulwi ukulungatana no musumba wa Gibea.

english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.
translation: Awe ifita fya bena Benjamini nafyo fyafumine mu musumba wa Gibea no kusansa abena Israeli no kwipaya ifita amakana amakumi yabili na yabili (22,000) pali bulya bushiku.

english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli baikoselesha umuntu no muntu. Kabili babwekeshepo ukutantika ifita fyabulwi umo fyatanteme pakabala ntanshi pa bushiku bayambile ukulwa.

english: The children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening; and they asked of the LORD, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” The LORD said, “Go up against him.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baile no kuya lila pa cinso cakwa Yawe mpakafye icungulo. Kabili baipwishe Yawe no kutila, “Bushe nakabili kuti twaya ku bulwi kukulwisha abena Benjamini, bamunyinefwe?” Nao Yawe atile, “Kabiyeni mubalwishe.”

english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
translation: Kabili abena Israeli bafikile mupepi na bena Benjamini mu bushiku bwalenga shibili.

english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.
translation: Abena Benjamini nabo baishile ukufuma ku Gibea pa bushiku bwalenga shibili kukubakumanya, baipeyepo na bambi abena Israeli ukulingana amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000), abo abaipangeshe bonse ne mpanga.

english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
translation: Abena Israeli bonse baile ku Betele, kabili kulya kwine baile mukulila pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Pali bulya bwine bushiku tabalile nelyo kamo mpakafye icungulo. Batuulile kuli Yawe amalambo ya cakoca, elyo no mutuulo wakwampana.

english: The children of Israel asked the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
translation: Kabili abena Israeli baipwishe Yawe pantu mu nshiku shilya Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Lesa eko yali.

english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” The LORD said, “Go up; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand.”
translation: Pantu mu nshiku shilya Fineasi mwana Eleasa, nao mwana Aroni, ewaletungulula amapepo pa ntanshi ya mbokoshi, elyo atile, “Bushe nakabili tuleya ku bulwi na bena Benjamini bamunyinefwe nangu twiyako?” Nao Yawe atile, “Kabiyeni, pantu mailo lyena nkabapeela mu maboko yenu.”

english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli babelamike ifita fyabulwi ukushinguluka umusumba wa Gibea.

english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”
translation: Awe abena Benjamini baumfwile ukuti abena Israeli nabaya ku Misipa. Elyo abena Israeli batile ku mwina Levi, “Twebeni ifyo ubu bubifi bwacitike.”

english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
translation: Awe pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu abena Israeli baile sansa abena Benjamini nabatantika ifita fyabulwi ukulungatana no musumba wa Gibea pamo ngefyo bacitile pakutendeka.

english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
translation: Ilyo nabo abena Benjamini bafumine mukuya bakumanya, babatwele ukutali, ukubatalusha ku musumba. Nga filya cali ku nshita sha kunuma, bayambile ukulaipaulula abena Israeli mu misebo, umbi uwalola ku Betele elyo umbi ku Gibea. Bambi abena Israeli babepaile mu mpanga ukufika pa mpendwa ya makumi yatatu (30).

english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”
translation: Abena Benjamini batampile ukutontonkanya ukuti, “Kwena twabacimfya ngefyo twacitile intanshi.” Lelo abena Israeli baletila, “Natufulumuke no kubatwala ukutali ku misebo ukufuma ku musumba.”

english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.
translation: Bonse abena Israeli bafumine pa cifulo cakulwilapo no kuya tantama ku Bali-Tama. Elyo abena Israeli ababelamine abanabo basokoloka lubali lwa ku masamba ya Gibea.

english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.
translation: Elyo ifita ifyasalilwe amakana ikumi limo (10,000) pa bena Israeli fyasanshile icabipisha abena Benjamini ku Gibea. Awe ubu bulwi bwalibipishe nganshi, icakuti na bena Benjamini bene tabaishibe nokuti icinkunka calabaponena.

english: The LORD struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.
translation: Awe Yawe acimfishe abena Benjamini pa cinso ca bena Israeli. Kabili pali bulya bwine bushiku, abena Israeli baipeye abena Benjamini ukufika na ku mpendwa ya makana amakumi yabili na yasano no mwanda umo (25,100). Bonse bali babulwi bwa mpanga.

english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.
translation: Elyo abena Benjamini epakumona ukuti nabacimfiwa.

english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.
translation: Ifita ifyabeleme nafyo fyapumikishe ukwingila mu musumba wa Gibea, no kuushinguluka. Fyaipaya na bantu bonse ku lupanga.

english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.
translation: Abena Israeli ababulwi balyumfwene ne fita ifyabeleme ukuti, bali nokufutumuna ikumbi ilikalamba nganshi ilya fyushi ukufuma mu musumba,

english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”
translation: elyo nomba ifita fyabulwi ifya bena Israeli fili nokupilibuka no kwamba ukulwa. Na pali iyi nshita ninshi abena Benjamini balyambileko ukulaipaulula abena Israeli ukufikafye na pa bantu amakumi yatatu (30). Pantu batontonkenye ukuti, “Ifwe tuli nokubacimfya ngefyo twabacimfishe ku bulwi bwantanshi.”

english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.
translation: Umwina Levi umulume wa mwanakashi baipeye, atile, “Ine no mukashi wandi uo nshaupile mu bwinga twaishile ku Gibea mu calo ca Benjamini twati eko tuye sendama.

english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.
translation: Lelo ilyo intumba ya cushi yatampile ukwimina mu mulu ukufuma mu musumba, abena Benjamini bapilibwike, kabili bamwene ne cushi cikumenefye umusumba onse, cilefutumukila mu mulu.

english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.
translation: Elyo nomba nabo abena Israeli bayalulwike mukusansa abalwani babo. Kabili abena Benjamini calibapeseshe amano, pantu baishibe ukuti nomba icinkunka nacibafikila.

english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.
translation: Kanshi ici ecalengele bafulumuke ku cinso ca bena Israeli no kulungama ku matololo. Lelo nalyo line ubulwi tabwapwile iyoo, pantu abena Israeli abalefuma ku misumba balekumanya abena Benjamini no kubepaya.

english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.
translation: Bashingulwike abena Benjamini no kubabutusha ulubilo no kubasangila apalungatene no musumba wa Gibea, lwa ku kabanga epo babakomawilile.

english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.
translation: Kanshi ifita fyacenjele icine cine ifya bena Benjamini ifyo baipeye fyali amakana ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18,000).

english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.
translation: Awe nelyo bayalulukile lwa ku matololo mu kufulumuka kwabo pakuti baye fisama ku cilibwe ca Limoni, nalyo line abena Israeli baipeyepo abantu amakana yasano (5,000), abo baleipaila mu misebo. Kabili batwalililefye ukukonka abena Benjamini mpaka na ku Gidomu. Kabili bakonkeshepo ukwipaya na bambi amakana yabili (2,000).

english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.
translation: Kabili pali bulya bwine bushiku amakana amakumi yabili na yasano (25,000) aya fita fya bena Benjamini ifyacenjela nganshi ku bulwi bwa mpanga efyo baipeye mu bulwi.

english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.
translation: Nomba abaume imyanda mutanda (600) ebabwelulwike no kufulumukila mu matololo ku cilibwe ca Rimoni, uko baile ikala imyeshi ine.

english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli babwelulukile abena Benjamini no kwipaya bonse abantu ba mu misumba ukubomfya impanga. Kabili takwashele citekwa nelyo cimo, nangufye akantu konse ako basangile balikonawile. Imishi yonse umo balepita, baleyoca no mulilo.

english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.
translation: Na mu nshita ya bushiku, abaume ba mu Gibea balinjimine no kushinguluka iŋanda nafikililemo, mukufwaya ukunjipaya. Elyo babuulile umwanakashi wandi no kusendama nankwe kumaka no kumwangashafye bushiku bonse mpaka no kufwa afwa.

english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
translation: Ine nalisendele uyu mwanakashi wandi, no kumuputaula mu fipimfya fipimfya, no kufituma kuli cila ncende shonse isha cakaniko ca cishilano ca bena Israeli, pantu aba bantu bacitile ishiku kabili icamusebanya ku bena Israeli.

english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”
translation: Eico nomba, imwe bonse mwe bena Israeli, muletipo shani, kabili pinguleni pano pene ifyakucita.”

english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.
translation: Awe abantu bonse baimine capamo nga bana aba ŋanda imo no kutila, “Tapabe nangu umo uwa pali ifwe uuleya kwitenti lyakwe. Kabili tapabe nangu umo uwa pali ifwe uuli nokubwelelamo ku ŋanda kumwakwe.

english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;
translation: Nomba ifi efyo tuli nokucita ku bena Gibea, ifwe tuli nokuya ku bulwi pamo ngefyo ulubuko lwatulangilila.

english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli balongene ku Misipa, balilapile ukuti, “Takwakabe umuntu nelyo umo, uwa muli ifwe, uuli nokuufya umwana umwanakashi ku mwaume umwina Benjamini.”

english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.
translation: Eico kanshi icilonganino catumine ifita amakana ikumi limo na yabili (12,000), abaswangana nganshi, no kubeba ati, “Kabiyeni ku bena Yabeshi Gileadi no kubepaya ku lupanga, ukubikakofye na banakashi pamo pene na bana bonse.

english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”
translation: Ifi efyo mulingile muye mucite. Muye peela umwaume onse kukonaulwa pamo no mwanakashi onse uushili nacisungu.”

english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
translation: Elyo baile sanga pa bekashi ba mu Yabeshi Gileadi abanakashi banacisungu imyanda ine (400) abashatala abalalapo no mwaume. Awe babasendele ku nkambi ku Shilo mu calo ca Kenani.

english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
translation: Elyo icilonganino catumine amashiwi yakulenga icibote pakati ka bena Benjamini abali ku cilibwe ca Rimoni.

english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.
translation: Kanshi abena Benjamini nabo epakubweluluka pa nshita ine ilya elyo baisa bapeela abanakashi abashelepo ilyo baipeye abantu ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi. Lelo aba abanakashi tabakumanine kuli bonse iyoo.

english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
translation: Awe abantu balangulukile abena Benjamini apakalamba, pantu Yawe asha icipunda icikalamba mu nko sha bena Israeli.

english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba cilonganino batile, “Calaba shani pakuti tufwaile abanakashi bakuupa ku bena Benjamini abashelepo, pantu abanakashi bonse mu bena Benjamini balipwa?”

english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
translation: Kabili batile, “Abena Benjamini abashalapo bafwile bakwata impyani pakuti uluko lwabo lwikalobelela mu bena Israeli.

english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”
translation: Lelo ifwe tatwingapeela abana besu abanakashi mukuupwa kuli bena, apo ifwe fwe bena Israeli twalicita umulapo uwakuti, ‘Abe uwalapishiwa umuntu onse uuli nokupeela umwanakashi wakuupa ku bena Benjamini.’

english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”
translation: Nomba moneni, kuli nokuba inshikunkulu yakwa Yawe ku Shilo, ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka Betele, kabili ku kabanga ka musebo wafuma ku Betele ukuya ku Shekemu, na ku masamba ya Lebona.”

english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.
translation: Elyo abantu baya ku Betele, eko baya ikala akasuba konse pa cinso cakwa Lesa mpaka icungulo. Basanswile amashiwi yabo no kulilishika ukukalamba.

english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,
translation: Kabili bakonkenyepo ukweba abena Benjamini abati, “Kabiyeni no kuya fisama mu mabala ya myangashi,

english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
translation: no kulolela. Kabili ilyo abakashana ba bena Shilo baisa no kwamba ukucinda, elyo nomba na imwe mukasokoloke mu mabala ya myangashi, elyo cila umo akaikatilepo umwanakashi wakuupa pa bakashana ba bena Shilo no kuya ku calo ca bena Benjamini.

english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”
translation: Lelo ilyo bashibo nangu bandume shabo bakesa mukulailishanya kuli ifwe, tuli nokubebafye ukuti, ‘Ala tubelelenikofye uluse kabili musuminishe, pantu tatwabasendele abanakashi bakuupa ilyo twali ku bulwi. Kabili imwe mulifye abakaele pantu teimwe mwe bene mwabapeele abana benu abakashana.’”

english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.
translation: Kanshi nabo abena Benjamini bacitile umo mwine baebelwe. Ilyofye abakashana bayambile ukucinda, cila umo aiketepo umo no kumusenda mukuba umukashi wakwe. Elyo babwelele na ku cifulo ca cishilano cabo no kukuula imisumba no kwikala emo balaikala.

english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.
translation: Na pa nshita ilya ine, abena Israeli basalanganine na mu fifulo fyabo, cila luko no mukowa wabo baile ku fifulo fya cishilano cabo.

english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
translation: Kabili pa nshita ilya, abena Israeli tabakwete imfumu. Eico cila muntu alecitafye icamuwamina mu menso yakwe.

english: They said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”
translation: Batile, “Mwe Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, bushe cinshi cabela ifi icakuti ilelo pabe uluko lumo ulushilipo ku bena Israeli?”

english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
translation: Ulucelo pa bushiku bwakonkelepo, abantu bakuulile ubulambo, no kutuula umutuulo we lambo lyakoca no wakwampana.

english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to the LORD?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to the LORD to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bayambile ukwipushanya abati, “Bushe ni bani abashishile kukulongana pa ba mu nko sha bena Israeli ku cilonganino icili ku cinso cakwa Yawe?” Pantu balilapile umulapo icine cine ukuti uyo onse ushakese kukulongana pa cinso cakwa Yawe ku Misipa, afwilefye ukwipaiwa.

english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.
translation: Eico nomba abena Israeli balangulukile bamunyinabo aba mu luko lwa bena Benjamini. Elyo batile, “Awe ilelo linefye uluko lumo ulwa bena Israeli naluputulwako.

english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”
translation: Bushe twalacita shani pakusanga abanakashi abakuti bakoope kuli aba abashalapo? Apo ifwe twalilapa umulapo kuli Yawe uwakuti tatwakapeele abana abakashana besu kukuupwa ku bena Benjamini.”

english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to the LORD to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.
translation: Kabili bayambile ukwipushanya abati, “Bushe palipo umuntu umo ukufuma mu nko sha bena Israeli uushishileko kuli ici cilonganino ku cinso cakwa Yawe ku Misipa?” Elyo basangile ukuti ku ba ku Yabeshi Gileadi emushali umuntu nelyo umo uwaishile ku nkambi kukulongana.

english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.
translation: Pantu ilyo bapendele abantu, basangile ukuti tapali umuntu nelyo umo uwa mu bekashi ba bena Yabeshi Gileadi uwalipo.

english: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.
translation: Nomba malaika wakwa Yawe afumine ku Giligali aya ku Bokimu no kuya landa ati, “Ine, nine namufumishe mu calo ca Egupto no kumuleta ku calo ico nalaile ukupeela kuli bashinwe. Kabili natile, ‘Nshakatale mfumyapo icipangano candi ico napangene nenu.

english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
translation: Ilyo aba nkulo ilya bonse bapwile ukufwa, baya no kwalala ifikolwe fyabo, imbi inkulo iyakonkelepo yena tayaishibe Yawe nangu ifyo acitiile abena Israeli.

english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bayambile ukulacita ifyabubifi ku cinso cakwa Yawe no kwamba ukulabombela imilungu ba Baali.

english: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.
They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
translation: Bacitile imisuula kuli Yawe no kwamba ukubombela imilungu ba Baali elyo ne milungu iyanakashi ba Ashitaroti .

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
translation: Eico Yawe afulilwe abena Israeli icalengele nokuti abapeele mu minwe ya balwani babo, ababatapile ifyuma fyabo. Kabili Yawe abaposele na mu minwe ya balwani babo mu nshilafye shonse, balafilwa no kulabacimfya.

english: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
translation: Eico ilyo lyonse baya ku bulwi, ukuboko kwakwa Yawe takwalebacingililako nakalya pakuti bengaba abakucimfya, ukulingana nga filya fine Yawe abasokele no kulapa kuli bena. Kanshi abena Israeli bali mu bulanda ubukulu nganshi.

english: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
translation: Elintu Yawe abemishe abapingushi, abayambile ukubapokololako ukufuma mu maboko ya baletapa ifyuma fyabo.

english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.
translation: Lelo nalyo line, balifililwe ukumfwa ku bapingushi babo, bena batwalililefye ukulacita bucilende bwabo ku milungu imbi no kulaipepa. Bena bafumine bwangu bwangu ku mbela ya fikolwe fyabo ifyalekonka amafunde yakwa Yawe. Balifililwe no kukonka mu mbela yafiko.

english: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
translation: Pantu ilyo lyonsefye Yawe aimishe abapingushi mukubafwa, ena aleba na ulya umupingushi. Kabili Yawe alebapususha ukufuma mu maboko ya balwani babo, ilyo lyonse umupingushi ali umumi pano calo. Pantu Yawe alebalangulukilako ilyo lyonse bali no bulanda kuli abo abalebacusha no kubatitikisha.

english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
translation: Nomba icalecitika, umupingushi uwalebatungulula nga afwa, abantu balebwelela ku misango iyabipisha ukucila na pa misango bashibo bacitileko iyakukonka imilungu imbi imbi, mukuibombela no kuipepa. Balefilililwafye ukuleka imicitile ya bubifi bwabo nangu imibeele imbi iyakumalala.

english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?
translation: Kabili na imwe bene, tecakwesha ukucita icipangano na bantu ba muli ici calo. Mukabongolole ifibumbili fya malambo fyabo.’ Lelo imwe mwalifilwa ukubaka amafunde yandi. Nomba moneni ico mwacita!

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,
translation: Eico kanshi ubukali bwakwa Yawe bwacilileko nganshi ku bena Israeli kabili asosa no kutila, “Pantu aba bantu nabafilwa ukubaka icipangano ico nacitile kuli bashibo kabili nabaleka ukumfwa kuli ine,

english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;
translation: ine nshakatale mfulumuna ku ntanshi yabo umushobo nangufye umo untu Yoshua ashile ilyo talafwa.

english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep the LORD’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”
translation: Ine ndi nokubomfya aba bantu kukwesha abena Israeli no kumona nga cakutila bali nokukonka inshila yakwa Yawe no kwendamo ngefyo bashibo bacitile.”

english: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
translation: Eico Yawe nao alekele neyi mishobo ikale. Tabatamfishemo pali ilya ine nshita mukubapeela mu maboko yakwa Yoshua iyoo.

english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”
translation: Eico nomba namweba ukuti, ‘Ine nshakafulumune iyi mitundu ku ntanshi yenu. Iyi mitundu ikaba imyunga iyikalamulasa mu mbalifye shonse, kabili imilungu yabo nayo eikaba iciteyo kuli imwe.’”

english: When the LORD’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.
translation: Ilyo malaika wakwa Yawe apwile ukulanda ifi fyonse ku bena Israeli bonse, awe abantu baikatishe amashiwi balalila.

english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD.
translation: Kabili bainike apa pa cifulo ati, “Bokimu” . Kabili apa pene epo batuulile kuli Yawe amalambo.

english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.
translation: Panuma ilyo Yoshua asalangenye abantu, abena Israeli bonse baile mukubuula impanga shabo ishapeelwe ukuba icakaniko ca cishilano cabo.

english: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel.
translation: Awe abantu babombele Yawe mu nshiku sha bumi bwakwa Yoshua, na mu nshiku sha bakalamba abatwalilile ukubomba panuma ya mfwa yakwe. Pantu aba bakalamba bena baliimwenene na menso yabo ifintu fyonse ifikalamba nganshi ifyo Yawe acitile ku bena Israeli.

english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
translation: Yoshua mwana Nuni, umubomfi wakwa Yawe, afwile ilyo ali ne myaka umwanda umo elyo ne kumi limo (110).

english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
translation: Kabili bamushiikile mu calo cakwe icacishilano ku Timinati Heresi, mu calo ca mpili shakwa Efulemu, ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka lupili lwa Gashi.

english: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
translation: Iyi e mishobo Yawe ashile iyakweseshako bonse abena Israeli abo abashabalile abalwako inkondo mu calo ca Kenani.

english: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
translation: Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile pali ena elyo nao atendeka no kulapingula pa bena Israeli. Aile na ku nkondo, kabili Yawe apeele Kushani Rishataimu imfumu ya mu Aramu mu maboko yakwa Otinieli, uyo uwamucimfishe.

english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
translation: Kanshi icalo conse caikele mu cibote pa myaka amakumi yane mpaka ilyo Otinieli mwana Kenasi afwile.

english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
translation: Kabili abena Israeli balibwekeshepo ukucita ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, na pa mulandu wa ifi fintu bacitile, Yawe abapeele mu maboko ya mfumu Egiloni, uwa mu Moabu.

english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
translation: Egiloni bauminkene pamo na bena Amoli elyo na bena Amaleki, baya lwisha no kucimfya abena Israeli, kabili bapokolwele no musumba wa Tuncindu .

english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
translation: Abena Israeli bateekelwe ubusha ku mfumu Egiloni iya mu Moabu pa myaka ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18).

english: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
translation: Lelo ilyo abena Israeli balilile kuli Yawe, nao abemishe uwakubalubula, Ehudi, uyo uwalebomfya ukuboko kwa ku kuso, mwana Gera umwina Benjamini. Uyu wine eo abena Israeli batumine ukubatwalila umusonko ku mfumu ya bena Moabu.

english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
translation: Nomba Ehudi alifulile ulupanga ulwatwa konse konse, ulwalepa mupepi na citika wa mita umo , alukakila ku lutungu lwakwe kwitanta lya ku kulyo mukati ka fyakufwala.

english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
translation: Awe atwele umusonko kuli Egiloni imfumu ya mu Moabu. Iyi mfumu yali iyaina nganshi.

english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
translation: Cilya Ehudi apwisha ukutuula umusonko, aeba abantu abasendele uyu musonko ukubwelelamo.

english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.
translation: Nomba ena abweluluka ilyo bafikafye ku tulubi twa mabwe mupepi na ku Giligali, nokwisa eba imfumu Egiloni ati, “Ine ndi ne lyashi lyankaama ilyakulanda nobe we Mfumu.” Nayo imfumu epakweba abantu aiti, “Lekeni icongo.” Awe na babomfi ba kwisano bonse abali nankwe, bafuma baya.

english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:
translation: Yawe acitile ifi pakusambilisha indupwa sha bena Israeli ishishaishibe ifyakulwa inkondo.

english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.
translation: Elyo Ehudi aya umo imfumu yaikele yeka mu muputule wa pamulu uwakupupwamo umwela, nokutila, “Ine ndi ne lyashi ilifumine kuli Lesa ukuti nkwebe.” Kanshi imfumu epakwima na pa cipuna yaikele.

english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
translation: Elyo Ehudi abuulila ulupanga ku kuboko kwakwe ukwa kuso ukufuma mu lutungu lwe tanta lya ku kulyo, no kulasa imfumu mu lufumo.

english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
translation: Icitubo ca lupanga naco cine caliingile pamo ne cilimi. Amafuta yacilikapo, kabili Ehudi tasomwene ulupanga. Ubusali nabo bwafumina na kunse.

english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
translation: Kanshi Ehudi epakufumina kunuma ya ŋanda , ninshi nasha naisala no kufunga ifiibi fyonse ifya pa muputule wa pamulu.

english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
translation: Panuma ninshi naya, ababomfi ba mfumu baisa sanga ifiibi fya muputule wa pamulu nafikomwa. Nabo batile, “Imfumu ifwile ili mu cimbusu ileyafwilisha.”

english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
translation: Kanshi epakwikala balapembela pa nshitafye iyitali mpaka cabapesha amano. Lelo ilyo bamwene ukuti teswileko ku ciibi ca muputule, babuulile imfungulo no kwisulako iciibi. Awe bamwene imfumu yabo naiwa panshi, naifwa.

english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.
translation: Ehudi afyukile ninshi bena bacili balepembela, aya acila na pa tulubi twa mabwe, afyukila na ku Seira.

english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
translation: Na lintu afikile kulya, aya lisha ipenga mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu, kabili abena Israeli baile pamo nankwe ukufuma mu calo ici ica mpili. Ehudi ewali e ntungulushi pakati kabo.

english: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Nkonkeni, pantu Yawe napeela abena Moabu, abalwani benu, mu maboko yenu.” Eico nabo balimukonkele, no kuyapokolola ifyabu fya mumana wa Yordani ifyalebomfya abena Moabu. Tabalesuminisha umuntu nelyo umo ukwabuka nakalya.

english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
translation: Pali iyo ine nshita baipeye ifita fyabulamba, ifyamaka fyeka fyeka, ifya bena Moabu ukulingana na makana ikumi limo (10,000), tapashele nelyo umo uwakufyuka.

english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
translation: Neyi imishobo yali ni bakateeka basano bonse aba bena Filisiti, bonse abena Kenani, abena Sidoni na bena Hifi abaleikala ku mpili sha ku Lebanoni ukufuma ku lupili lwa Baali Hemoni ukufika ku Lebo Hamati .

english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
translation: Pali bulya bwine bushiku abena Israeli bacimfishe abena Moabu bonse. Kabili ukutula pali ilya nshita, icalo caikele mu cibote imyaka amakumi cine konse konse (80).

english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
translation: Panuma yakwa Ehudi pakonkele Shamuga mwana Anati, uyo uwaipeye abena Filisiti imyanda mutanda (600). Abepeye ku musokofyo wakusokwelako iŋombe pakuti shileendesha. Nao wine alipuswisheko abena Israeli.

english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
translation: Aba bonse babashile mukwesha abena Israeli pakumona nga cakuti kuti banakila ifipope fyakwa Yawe ifyo akonkomeshe kuli bashibo, ukupitila muli Mose.

english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli baleikala pakati ka bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Perisi, abena Hifi elyo na bena Yebusi.

english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
translation: Baleupa abana banakashi ba iyi mitundu kabili no kuufya abana babo abanakashi ku bana abaume ba iyi mitundu, kabili balapepa ne milungu yabo.

english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
translation: Abena Israeli bacitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe no kulaba kuli Yawe Lesa wabo, no kulabombela utulubi tu Baali na tu Ashera.

english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
translation: Ecalengele ubukali bwakwa Yawe ukwisa pa bena Israeli, icakuti abaposa na mu maboko yakwa Kushani Rishataimu imfumu ya mu Aramu Naraimu , uko bateekelwe ubusha pa myaka cine konse konse.

english: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
translation: Lelo ilyo abena Israeli balilile kuli Yawe, nao abemishe uwakubalubula, Otinieli, mwana Kenasi umwaice wakwa Kalebu, uyo uwabalubwile.

english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, when Ehud was dead.
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Ehudi, abena Israeli nakabili balibwekeshepo ukucita ifyabipa ifyo Yawe ashalefwaya pa cinso cakwe.

english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
translation: Elyo Baraki aitile abena Sebuloni elyo na bena Naftali ifita amakana ikumi limo (10,000) ukwisa ku Kadeshi. Kabili na Debora wine ali nankwe.

english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.
translation: Nomba elyo Heberi umwina Keni apatwike ukufuma ku babiye abena Keni, aba lupwa lwa bena Hobabu shifyala kwa Mose, aimike Itenti lyakwe mu cimuti icikulu nganshi ica oki ku Sananimu mupepi na ku Kedeshi.

english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
translation: Ilyo baebele Sisera ukuti Baraki mwana Abinoamu ali ku lupili lwa Tabo,

english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.
translation: Sisera nao epakulonganika pamo amaceleta yakwe imyanda pabula (900) aya fyela, elyo na bantu bonse ukufuma ku Harosheti Ha Goimu ukufika ku mumana wa Kishoni.

english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
translation: Elyo Debora aebele Baraki ati, “Kabiye! Pantu ni mu bushiku bwa lelo Yawe apeele Sisera mu maboko yobe. Kabili mona Yawe nakutangilila.” Awe Baraki atentemwike ulupili lwa Tabo, ne fita amakana ikumi limo (10,000) nabamukonka panuma.

english: The LORD confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.
translation: Kutifye cilya Baraki apalama, Yawe acimfya Sisera na maceleta yakwe yonse pamo ne fita fyakwe fyonse ku lupanga. Awe Sisera epakusha iceleta lyakwe no kufulumuka ulubilo panshi.

english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.
translation: Baraki asupile amaceleta ne fita mpakafye na ku Harosheti Ha Goimu. Ifita fyakwa Sisera fyonse fyalifwile ku lupanga, tapashele nangu umo.

english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
translation: Sisera ena afulumukile ulubilo panshi kwitenti lyakwa Yaeli, muka Heberi umwina Keni, pantu pali ukumfwana pakati kakwa Yabini imfumu ya mu musumba wa Haso elyo no mukowa wakwa Heberi umwina Keni.

english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
translation: Awe Yaeli afumine panse mukukumanya Sisera no kumweba ati, “Iseni, we mfumu yandi, iseni muno mukati ke tenti. Witiina nelyo cimo.” Awe nao aingile mwitenti, amufimbilisha ne cisalu.

english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.
translation: Elyo Sisera atile, “Nafwa ku cilaka, napapata mpeelako amenshi.” Nao aiswile inyambi umwali umukaka, awe amupeela anwa, kabili amufimbilikisha ne cisalu.

english: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
translation: Eico kanshi Yawe nao abapeele mu maboko yakwa Yabini, imfumu ya bena Kenani, uwaleteeka ku Hasoli. Kabili umukalamba wa fita ali ni Sisera, uwaleikala mu Harosheti Ha Goimu.

english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”
translation: Elyo amweba ukuti, “Iminina pa mwinshi we tenti. Nga cakuti umo aisa kwipusha ati, ‘Bushe tamuli muntu muno?’ Utile, ‘iyoo.’”

english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.
translation: Lelo Yaeli, muka Heberi abuulile ulupopo lumo ulwe tenti ne nondo, no kuya alebendelela panono kuli Sisera, ninshi nalala mu tulo pantu alinakile. Awe amupopela ulupopo pa nsense ya kutwi nalo lwapulinkanya lwashimpa na panshi, no kufwa afwa.

english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.
translation: Cilya Baraki apalama ninshi eshile alesupila Sisera, Yaeli afumina panse mukuya mukumanya. Elyo atile, “Iseni, pakuti mulange umuntu uo imwe mulefwaya.” Nao epakwingila nankwe mwitenti, asanga Sisera nalala panshi nafwa, no lupopo nalushimpa pa nsense ya kutwi.

english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.
translation: Na pali bulya bwine bushiku Lesa alengele Yabini imfumu ya bena Kenani ukucimba ku bena Israeli.

english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baile balekoselakofye mukulwisha Yabini, imfumu ya bena Kenani, mpakafye bamwipaya.

english: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti alikwete amaceleta ya fyela imyanda pabula (900), no kucusha alecusha abena Israeli nganshi pa myaka amakumi yabili (20), nabo balilile kuli Yawe pakuti abafwe.

english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.
translation: Debora, kasesema mwanakashi, muka Lapidoti ewalepingula abena Israeli pa nshita ilya.

english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
translation: Wena aleikala mwisamba lya kancindu kakwa Debora pakati ka Rama na Betele mu Calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu. Kabili abena Israeli baleya kuli ena kukupingulwa.

english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
translation: Ubushiku bumo atumine abakuya ita Baraki mwana Abinoamu, ukufuma ku Kedeshi mu Naftali, no kumweba ati, “Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, nakukonkomesha iwe ukuti, ‘Kabiye, usende abaume amakana ikumi limo (10,000), abena Naftali na bena Sebuloni, ubatungulule ku lupili lwa Tabo.

english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”
translation: Ine ndi nokulenga Sisera umukalamba wa fita fya bena Yabini pamo na maceleta elyo ne fita fyakwe ukukwimina ku mumana wa Kishoni, lelo ndi nokufipeela mu maboko yobe.’”

english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
translation: Elyo Baraki atile kuli ena, “Cisuma nga cakuti twaya na iwe, na ine lyena ndi nokuya. Lelo nga cakuti wakaana ukuya ninshi na ine wine nshakayeko.”

english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
translation: Elyo Debora nao amwasuka ati, “Cisuma, ine tuli nokuya bonse. Nomba wishibe ukuti umucinshi wa bulendo ubu tauli nokuba obe, pantu Yawe ali nokupeela Sisera mu maboko ya mwanakashi.” Awe Debora na Baraki baima baya ku Kedeshi.

english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
translation: Na pali bulya bwine bushiku Debora pamo na Baraki mwana Abinoamu baimbile ulwimbo ulu ulwakuti,

english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
translation: “Imbeni imwe mwe bendela pali bapunda ababuuta,

english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the LORD’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then the LORD’s people went down to the gates.
translation: Kutikeni ku bemba ne nsansa ku mbali ya fishima fya menshi.

english: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
translation: ‘Buka, buka, iwe Debora!

english: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. The LORD came down for me against the mighty.
translation: “Elyo abantu abasheleko batentemukile ku bacindami,

english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
translation: Bafumine muli Efulemu,

english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
translation: Intungulushi sha bena Isaka ebali pamo na Debora.

english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi wikalile mu macinka,

english: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
translation: Gileadi aikele kwishilya lya Yordani.

english: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
translation: Abantu bakwa Sebuloni tabatiinine mfwa,

english: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
translation: “Imfumu shalishile, shatantama ku bulwi.

english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD!
translation: “Paaleni Yawe na matotelo! Pantu intungulushi nashitungulula Israeli,

english: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
translation: Ukufuma mu mulu intanda nasho shalalwisha,

english: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
translation: Umukuku wa mumana wa Kishoni walibasendele,

english: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
translation: Elyo inshindo sha bakabalwe shanyantaula umushili,

english: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the LORD’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
translation: “Malaika wakwa Yawe asosa ati, ‘Lapisheni Merosi,

english: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
translation: “Abe uwapaalwa ukucila mu banakashi bonse,

english: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
translation: Sisera alombele amenshi yakunwa, nomba ena amupeela umukaka,

english: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
translation: Atambika ukuboko kwakwe ukwa kuso pakwikata ulupopo lwe tenti,

english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
translation: Pa makasa yakwa Yaeli epo abotelele, awile no kulambalala.

english: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’
translation: “Nyina wakwa Sisera alengele pa nsolokoto,

english: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
translation: Abacenjeleshepo pa bakashana bakwe nabo bamwasuka ati,

english: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to the LORD. I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Umfweni ifi, imwe mwe shamfumu!

english: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’
translation: ‘Bushe tabasangile no kulaakanya ifyakutapa?

english: “So let all your enemies perish, LORD, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
translation: “Eico kanshi shilengeni bonse abalwani benu balobelele, mwe Yawe!

english: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
translation: “Mwe Yawe, ilyo mwafumine ku Seiri,

english: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.
translation: Impili shalisunkene pa cinso cakwa Yawe, umwine wa Sinai,

english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
translation: “Mu nshiku shakwa Shamuga mwana Anati,

english: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
translation: Ukwikala mu mishi kwalipwile,

english: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
translation: Ilyo basalile imilungu iyipya,

english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD!
translation: Umutima wandi naupilibukila ku bakalamba ba fita fya mu Israeli,

english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
translation: Nakabili abena Israeli balibwekeshepo ukucita ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, icalengele nokuti abapeele mu maboko ya bena Midiani pa myaka cine lubali.

english: I said to you, “I am the LORD your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”
translation: Nalimwebele nati, ‘Ine nine Yawe, Lesa wenu, tecakwesha ukulapepa imilungu ya bena Amoli, abo mwaikala mu calo cabo. Lelo tamwaumfwile kufyo namwebele.’”

english: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe aisa ikala mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki icali ku Ofira, no wali umwine wa ici cimuti ali ni Yoashi umwina Abiesa. Iyi nshita ninshi Gideoni umwana wakwe alesokola iŋanu mu ncende bakamina imyangashi pakuti apususheko iŋanu shimo ku bena Midiani.

english: The LORD’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
translation: Ilyo malaika wakwa Yawe amonekele kuli Gideoni, amwebele ati, “Yawe ali na iwe, we mpalume yabulamba.”

english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
translation: Elyo Gideoni ayaswike ati, “Nomba kanabesa, nga cakuti Yawe ali na ifwe, mulandu nshi ifi fyonse filecitikila kuli ifwe? Bushe fili kwi ifipeshamano fyakwe fyonse ifyo bashifwe batushimikile, ilyo batile, ‘Bushe te Yawe atufumishe mu calo ca ku Egupto?’ Lelo nomba Yawe natulekelesha no kutubika mu maboko ya bena Midiani.”

english: The LORD looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”
translation: Elyo Yawe apilibukile kuli ena no kutila, “Ima kabiye mu maka ukwete, no kuya pususha abena Israeli ukufuma mu maboko ya bena Midiani. Bushe teine ndekutuma?”

english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”
translation: Elyo nao Gideoni aipwishe ati, “Nomba kanabesa, ine kuti napususha shani abena Israeli? Ine umukowa wandi eushakwatisha amaka mu bena Manase, kabili ine, nine winefye wakulekelesha mu lupwa lwandi.”

english: The LORD said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”
translation: Yawe amweba ati, “Ine, ndi nokuba na iwe, kabili uli nokucimfya abena Midiani kwati nalimo alifye umuntu umo.”

english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.
translation: Gideoni ayaswike ati, “Nga cakuti ninsanga ububile mu menso yenu, ncitileniko icishibilo icakulanga ukuti icine cine nimwe mulelanda kuli ine.

english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”
translation: Napapata, mwifuma pano mpaka mbwele no kuleta umutuulo wandi, uwakuti ntuule ku cinso cenu.”

english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.
translation: Awe Gideoni aingile mu ŋanda, apekenya akana ka mbushi kabili abuula no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwa cipimo ca efa emo apanga umukate ushatutumuka. Abika inama mu cipe, no muto waiko nao mu lunweno, atwala fyonse no kuya tuula kuli ena mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki.

english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.
translation: Pantu abena Midiani bali na maka nganshi ayakucusha abena Israeli. Na pa mulandu wa ici abena Israeli balipekenye incende ishakuya belamako ishali mu mpili, mu mimba na mu ncengo.

english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.
translation: Elyo Malaika wakwa Lesa aebele Gideoni ati, “Twala inama pamo no mukate uushatutumuka, ufibike pa mulu wa cilibwe, elyo witilepo no muto.”

english: Then the LORD’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the LORD’s angel departed out of his sight.
translation: Elyo Malaika wakwa Yawe abuulile inkonto iyo akwete mu minwe yakwe, aishimpa pa nama elyo na pa mukate uushatutumuka. Awe apopenefye umulilo wafuma na mu cilibwe, waoca inama ne mikate. Kabili na malaika wakwa Yawe aongoloka no kuluba aluba.

english: Gideon saw that he was the LORD’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord GOD! Because I have seen the LORD’s angel face to face!”
translation: Elyo Gideoni ailwike ukuti aciba ni malaika wakwa Yawe, nao atile, “Yangu mwe Mfumu Yawe! Ine, nimona Malaika wakwa Yawe impumi ne mpumi!”

english: The LORD said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”
translation: Lelo Yawe nao atile kuli ena, “Umutende ube na iwe! Tecakwesha ukuba no mwenso. Iwe tauli nakufwa iyoo.”

english: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
translation: Awe Gideoni akuulile Yawe ubulambo pali ilya ncende no kulabwita ati, “Yawe wamutende.” Ubu ubulambo epo bucili ukufikafye na ku bushiku bwa lelo mu musumba wa Ofira uwa bena Abiesa.

english: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.
translation: Muli bulya bwine bushiku, Yawe atile kuli ena, “Buulapo cilume wa ŋombe uwabubili pa mukuni wakwa wiso, uulifye ne myaka cine lubali. Kabili uye bongolola no bulambo bulya wiso alepepelapo Baali. Uye uputaule no luceshi ulwa mulungu Ashera ulwabela pa mbali ya bulambo.

english: Then build an altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”
translation: Elyo iwe nomba ukakuulepo ubulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa obe ubusuma pa mulu wa ciputu pene. Ulingile ukubomfya inkuni sha luceshi ukaputaula ulwa mulungu Ashera mukutuula ilambo lyakwa cilume wa ŋombe uwacibili nge lambo lyakoca.”

english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.
translation: Elyo Gideoni abuulile ababomfi bakwe ikumi limo, no kubomba ifyo Yawe amwebele. Nomba pa mulandu wakutiina aba mu lupwa lwakwe, elyo na bekashi ba mu musumba, abombele uyu mulimo ubushiku, ukucila mu kasuba.

english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo mu nshita ya lucelo, ilyo abekala musumba babuukile, bamonafye ubulambo bwakwa Baali nabubongoloka! Kabili no luceshi ulwali mumbali nalo naluputaulwa, na cilume wa ŋombe uwacibili natuulwa ilambo pa bulambo ubwakuulilwe ubupya!

english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”
translation: Awe cila umo aipusha umunankwe ati, “Bushe ni nani uucitile ici cintu?” Na panuma yakufwailisha ifishinka fyonse, baumfwa ukuti ni Gideoni mwana Yoashi eucitile ici cintu.

english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
translation: Ilyo lyonse abena Israeli babyala imbuto mu mabala yabo, abena Midiani, abena Amaleki na bantu bambi abaleikala lwa ku kabanga baleisa mukubasansa no kubapokolola icalo.

english: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”
translation: Elintu abantu bonse aba mu musumba baile kuli Yoashi abati, “Fumya mwano. Ifwe tulemwipaya pantu naonaula ubulambo bwakwa Baali, aputaula no luceshi lwakwa Ashera ulwaimikwe kumbali.”

english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”
translation: Elyo nao Yoashi epakwasuka abamushingulwike ati, “Bushe nimwe muli nokulandilako Baali? Kabili bushe nimwe muli nokumulubulwilako? Uyo onse uulefwaya ukulandilako Baali ali nokwipaiwafye ilyo tabulaca na kuca! Nga cakuti Baali ni lesa, mumuleke umwine aipokolole pantu bulambo bwakwe bubongolweke.”

english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”
translation: Elyo Gideoni pali bulya bwinefye bushiku bayambile ukulamwita ati ni Yerubibaali, emukutila, “Lekeni Baali aipokolole umwine,” pantu naonaula ubulambo bwakwa Baali.

english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
translation: Elyo nomba bonse abena Midiani, abena Amaleki elyo na bekashi ba ku kabanga balongene pamo, no kwabuka umumana wa Yordani, bacita nkambi shabo mwishika lya Yesireli.

english: But the LORD’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.
translation: Awe Umupashi wakwa Yawe waishile pali Gideoni, nao alisha ipenga pakwita abena Abiesa pakuti bamukonke.

english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
translation: Atumine ne nkombe ku bena Manase iyakubeta pakuti nabo bamukonke ku bulwi. Kabili aita na bena Asheri, abena Sebuloni na bena Naftali, pakuti nabo bese mukwafwilisha ukulwisha abalwani.

english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,
translation: Elyo Gideoni atile kuli Lesa, “Pakuti mone ukuti uli nokupususha Israeli ukupitila mu maboko yandi pamo ngefyo walaile, mona,

english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”
translation: ine nalayansa impapa iyanyukwa pa lubansa lwakutwilapo. Nga cakuti ulucelo umume wabafye pa mpapa peka, elyo ulubansa lonse lwaba ulwauma, awe lyena ndi nokwishiba ukuti uli nokupususha Israeli ukupitila mu maboko yandi pamo ngefyo we mwine usosele.”

english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
translation: Kanshi ifi fine, efyo cali. Ubushiku bwakonkelepo ulucelocelo Gideoni abuuka, atampile ukulakama impapa, no kulakamina umume mu nsupa nayo yaisula.

english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”
translation: Elyo Gideoni atile kuli Lesa, “Wimfulilwa. Lekafye nkwipusheko nakabili. Nsuminisha mbwekeshepo njeshe ukwanshika impapa iyanyukwa pa lubansa. Iyi yena inshita, uleke pa mpapa iyanyukwa peka epo pabe apauma, lelo pa lubansa epo pakumane umume weka weka.”

english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.
translation: Balekuula inkambi shabo mulya mwine no kubonawila ifilime fyabo fyonse mpakafye na ku Gasa. Kabili takwaleba icitekwa nelyo cimo ico balesha ica bena Israeli, cibe ni mpaanga, nangu iŋombe, nangu ni bapunda.

english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
translation: Awe Lesa nao, efyo acitile. Pa mpapa iyanyukwa peka epali apauma. Ulubansa lonsefye lwakumene umume weka weka.

english: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.
translation: Pantu abene baleisa ne fitekwa fyabo na matenti yabo, kwati ni makanta ku bwingi. Kabili cali icayafya nganshi ukwishiba impendwa ya bantu pamo ne ngamila shabo, pantu baleisa mu calo mukuconaula.

english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.
translation: Kanshi abena Midiani efyo baposele abena Israeli mu bulanda ubukalamba, elyo nabo balilile kuli Yawe pakuti abafwe.

english: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian,
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli balilile kuli Yawe pakucushiwa na bena Midiani,

english: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.
translation: Yawe nao alibatumine kasesema, uyo uwatile, “Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli asosa, atila, ‘Nine namufumishe mu calo ca Egupto umo mwali abasha.

english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.
translation: Nine namupokolwele ukufuma ku maka ya bena Egupto, na ku maboko ya bonse abalemucusha. Nine nabafulumwine ku ntanshi yenu, no kumupeela icalo cabo.’

english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
translation: Lucelocelo Yerubibaali (emukutila Gideoni) ne fita fyakwe fyonse baile cita inkambi yabo pa kamfukumfuku kakwa Harodi. Elyo inkambi ya bena Midiani nayo yali ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwabo, mwishika mupepi no lupili lwa More.

english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti uletiina ukusansa, kabiye ku nkambi no mubomfi obe Pura,

english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.
translation: pantu panuma yakuya umfwa ifyo balelanda, lyena uleya koseleshiwa no kusansa inkambi.” Elyo ena na Pura umubomfi wakwe baile apasangwa abalinshi ba nkambi.

english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.
translation: Abena Midiani, abena Amaleki na bonse abekashi ba ku kabanga balongene mwishika nabakupa kwati ni makanta. Ne ngamila shabo teshakupenda ku bwingi, shafulile ngo munsensenga wa mu lulamba lwa bemba.

english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”
translation: Ilyo Gideoni afikile, asangile umuntu umo aleeba umunankwe ifyo alotele, no kutila, “Ine nacilota umukate wa bale uwabulungana uleisa ulekunkulukila mu nkambi ya bena Midiani. Uyu mukate waciya punka mwitenti na maka nganshi icakuti ne tenti lyawa lyapilibuka no kubongoloka.”

english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”
translation: Elyo umunankwe ayasuka ati, “Ici te cimbi iyoo ukucila pa lupanga lwakwa Gideoni mwana Yoashi, umwina Israeli. Lesa napeela abena Midiani ne nkambi yonse mu maboko yakwe.”

english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”
translation: Ilyo Gideoni aumfwile ici ciloto no musango umunankwe acilondolwelelemo, awile panshi ubukupeme no kupepa Yawe. Awe abwelele na ku nkambi ya bena Israeli no kubilisha ati, “Imeni! Ala Yawe napeela abena Midiani mu maboko yenu.”

english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
translation: Kabili ayakenye abantu imyanda itatu (300) mu mpuka shitatu. Elyo apeele amapenga mu maboko yacila umo ne mitondo umwabula amenshi elyo mukati ka mitondo emwali ifisaniko.

english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.
translation: Kabili atile kuli bena, “Moneni kuli ine. Mulenkonka mufyo ndecita efyo na imwe mulecita. Ilyo nafika ku mpela ya nkambi mufwile ukucita ifyo finefye nakulacita.

english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”
translation: Ilyo ine pamo na bonse abo tuli nabo twalisha amapenga yesu, elyo na imwe bonse ukushinguluka inkambi, mulishe amapenga yenu no kubilikisha amuti, ‘Fyakwa Yawe kabili fyakwa Gideoni.’”

english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.
translation: Awe Gideoni na bantu bakwe umwanda umo (100) abo ali nabo, bafikile ku mpela ya nkambi ku kwambafye kwa bushiku pakati, panuma ya balinshi ukupokeshanya pakulinda inkambi. Elyo balishishe amapenga yabo nokutobaula imitondo iyali mu minwe yabo.

english: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Gideoni ati, “Iwe uli ne fita ifingi nganshi, kabili tecalalenga ukuti mpeele abena Midiani mu maboko yabo. Pantu abena Israeli kuti bashala baleitakisha kuli ine ati maka yabo eyalengele bapusuke.

english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!”
translation: Kabili ilyo linefye aba mu mpuka shitatu balilishishe amapenga yabo no kutobaula imitondo. Baikete ifisaniko mu minwe yabo iya ku kuso elyo amapenga yakulisha mu maboko ya ku kulyo, no kubilikisha abati, “Ulupanga lwakwa Yawe no lupanga lwakwa Gideoni!”

english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.
translation: Kabili cila umo aiminine pa ncende apo ali, ukushinguluka inkambi yonse. Na bena Midiani bayamba ukufulumuka no kuya balelila ninshi balebutuka.

english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.
translation: Kabili ilyo balishishe amapenga imyanda itatu (300), Yawe alengele abantu mu nkambi yonse ukwalukila cila umo umo no kulakomana ku mpanga shabo. Neci calengele ifita ukufulumukila ku Beti Shita, ukulola ku Serera, ukufika na ku mupaka wa Abeli Mehola mupepi na Tabati.

english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.
translation: Kabili abena Israeli mu nko shonse baitilwe ukufuma ku bena Naftali, abena Asheri, elyo na bonse abena Manase balongene pamo no kukunkunika abena Midiani.

english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
translation: Gideoni epakutuma inkombe monse mu calo ca mpili ica bena Efulemu, no kutila, “Iseni, tentemukeni twise tulwishe abena Midiani no kubacilikila ku menshi yonse aya Yordani ilyo tabalafikako, ukushinta ku Beti Bara.” Awe bonse abantu abena Efulemu balishile, kabili batebelele incende yonse iya mumana wa Yordani, ukufikafye na ku Beti Bara.
