english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
translation: Kabili baiketepo ne ntungulushi sha fita shibili isha bena Midiani, Orebu elyo na Seebu. Baipaile Orebu pa cilibwe cakwa Orebu, elyo Seebu nao bamwipaile pa cifulo bakamina umwangashi, icakwa Seebu. Awe basupile abena Midiani kabili baletele ne mitwe yakwa Orebu na Seebu kuli Gideoni uwali kwishilya lya Yordani.

english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.
translation: Eico bila imbila ku fita fyonse utile, ‘Umuntu onse uuli no mwenso no kututuma nabwelelemo ku ŋanda, afumeko kuno ku lupili lwa Gileadi.’” Awe ifita amakana amakumi yabili na yabili (22,000) babwelelemo kumyabo. Abashelepo nabo bali amakana ikumi limo (10,000).

english: The LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”
translation: Kabili Yawe atile kuli Gideoni, “Awe na nombaline ifita ficili nafifulisha nganshi. Batwalefye ku menshi, eko nalaya kupatulwilako bamo. Nga cakuti natila, ‘Uyu ena afwile aya na iwe,’ uli nokuya nankwe. Lelo nga natila, ‘Uyu ena tafwile kuya na iwe, tauli nokuya nankwe.’”

english: So he brought down the people to the water; and the LORD said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”
translation: Awe Gideoni atwele ifita ku menshi. Elyo Yawe atile kuli ena, “Upatulule abantu abo bonse abalekabawila amenshi ku lulimi lwabo kwati ni mbwa ubabike ku lubali lumo, elyo abantu abo abalefukama panshi ilyo bakulanwa amenshi nabo ubabike ku lubali lumbi.”

english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.
translation: Abantu ukulingana ne myanda itatu (300) ebaletapwila amenshi ku lupi lwabo pakunwa. Lelo bonse abashala bafukeme panshi na makufi pakunwa amenshi.

english: The LORD said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”
translation: Elyo Yawe atile kuli Gideoni, “Ku bantu imyanda itatu (300) abacilakabawila amenshi pakunwa eko ndi nokumupusushishako, no kupeela Midiani mu maboko yenu. Leka bonse abashala babwelelemo, cila muntu ku cifulo cakwe.”

english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
translation: Amaf 20:8

english: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
translation: Mu nshita ine ilya iya bushiku, Yawe atile kuli Gideoni, “Ima, kabiye kasanse inkambi yabo, pantu ninjipeela mu maboko yobe.

english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
translation: Elyo abena Efulemu baipwishe Gideoni abati, “Bushe cinshi watucitila ifi? Mulandu nshi ushatwitileko ilyo mwaile mukulwisha abena Midiani?” Awe balimwebawile icabipisha.

english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.
translation: Nomba Seba na Salimuna bali mu Kakori pamo ne fita fya nkondo ukulingana na makana ikumi na yasano (15,000), bonse pamo abashele ku fita fyafumine ku bantu ba ku kabanga. Kanshi ifita fyonse ifyafwile ku lupanga fyali amakana umwanda umo na makumi yabili (120,000).

english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.
translation: Amalu 83:11

english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.
translation: Ishi mfumu shibili Seba na Salimuna isha ku Midiani shalifulumwike, nomba alibakonkele no kuyabekata, ne fita fyabo fyasalangana fyayafye nsale nsale.

english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
translation: Ilyo ubulwi bwapwile, Gideoni mwana Yoashi abwelele ukufuma ku bulwi ukupitilila ku mupokapoka wa Heresi.

english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.
translation: Mu nshila aikete umulumendo umwina Sukoti no kumwipusha, elyo umulumendo alembele panshi amashina amakumi cine lubali na cine lubali (77) aya bakalamba na bacilolo ba musumba wa Sukoti.

english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”
translation: Elyo Gideoni aile ku bena Sukoti no kutila, “Moneni Seba na Salimuna aba, abo mwansuliilepo no kutila, ‘Bushe Seba na Salimuna naubekata kale, bali mu minwe yobe pakuti ifwe tupeele imikate ku fita fyobe ifitembwike?’ ”

english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
translation: Elyo abuulile abakalamba ba mu musumba wa Sukoti no kuboma ifikoti ku membya ya myunga ya mu matololo na kuli nkololo.

english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
translation: Elyo abongolwele ulupungu lwa Penieli no kwipaya bonse abaume ba mu musumba.

english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”
translation: Kabili Gideoni aipwishe Seba na Salimuna ati, “Bushe abantu mwaipeye ku Tabo bali ba musango shani?”

english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”
translation: Elyo Gideoni abaswike no kutila, “Abo bali ni bamunyinane, abo twafyelwe nabo inda imo. Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, nalimo amubaleka amukanabepaya, na ine wine nga nshimwipeye.”

english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
translation: Nao Gideoni alibaswike ati, “Nga ine ico ncitile ni cinshi icakupalanya kufyo imwe mwacita? Bushe ukutolelesha kwa myangashi yakwa Efulemu takuwemepo ukucila ubusomboshi bonse ubwa myangashi yakwa Abiesa?

english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.
translation: Elintu apilibukile ku mwana wakwe ibeli, Yeta, no kutila, “Bepaye.” Nomba Yeta pa mulandu wakuti ali umwaice afilwa ukusomona ulupanga lwakwe, kabili ali no mwenso.

english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.
translation: Elyo Seba na Salimuna batile, “Isafye, utwipaye we mwine. Pantu ifyaba umwaume, efyo na maka yakwe yaba.” Awe Gideoni aimine no kubepaya kabili abuulile ne fyakubayemfya ifyo bakobeke mu mikoshi ya ngamila shabo.

english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”
translation: Na panuma ya ifi fyonse ifyacitike, abena Israeli batile kuli Gideoni, “Ututeeke niwe, no mwana obe pamo pene no mwishikulu obe, pantu niwe utupuswishe ifwe ku maboko ya bena Midiani.”

english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.”
translation: Lelo Gideoni abaswike ati, “Ine teti ndemuteeka imwe iyoo, nangufye mwana wandi wine takamuteeke iyoo, lelo Yawe umwine eukalamuteeka.”

english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
translation: Kabili atile, “Ine ndipofye ne cintu cimo ico ndelomba kuli imwe, icakuti umuntu no muntu ampeeleko icisamiko ca ku matwi ica golide, ukufuma pafyo mwatapa.” Ulu elwali ulutambi lwa bena Ishimaeli ulwakufwala amasikiyo aya golide.

english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.
translation: Awe nabo balyaswike batile, “Mu cinefye twalakupeela.” Elyo bayanshika icisalu epo cila umo aleposa amasikiyo yakwe ayo afumishe pafyo batapile.

english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.
translation: Kabili ukufina kwa aya masikiyo aya golide Gideoni alombele kwafikile amashekeli ikana limo ne myanda cine lubali (1,700) ukwabula ukupendelako ifyakuyemfya, ifisamo fyakufwala ku mukoshi ne nsalu ishakashikila ishalefwala imfumu sha mu Midiani nangu iminyololo iyo balefwika ingamila shabo mu mukoshi.

english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
translation: Awe Gideoni afibuulile, apangile icakufwala ca bushimapepo ica efodi no kucibika mu musumba wa Ofira, umusumba wakwe. Elyo bonse abena Israeli eko bakumukile no kulacipepa, bafumya na mano yabo kuli Yawe. Kabili ici cintu ecaishileba iciteyo kuli Gideoni pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo abena Midiani babacimfishe ku bena Israeli, kabili tabatalile abasalapuka nakabili. Eico kanshi mu bumi bwakwa Gideoni icalo caikele mu cibote pa myaka amakumi yane.

english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.
translation: Panuma ya ifi Yerubibaali mwana Yoashi abwelelemo ku mushi kumwabo kukwikala.

english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.
translation: Ala ni Lesa ewamupeele Orebu na Seebu, intungulushi sha fita isha bena Midiani, mu maboko yenu. Bushe ine, cinshi ningacita mukupalanya kufyo imwe mwacitile?” Awe pakumfwa aya mashiwi, babwesha imitima.

english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.
translation: Gideoni akwete abana abaume amakumi cine lubali (70), abana bakwefye pantu aupile abanakashi abengi.

english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
translation: Mu mukashi uo ashaupile mu bwinga, uwaleikala ku Shekemu, namo alikwetemo umwana mwaume, uo ainike ishina lya Abimeleki.

english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
translation: Awe Gideoni mwana Yoashi afwile pa myaka isuma nganshi iya mu bukote bwakwe. Kabili ashiikilwe mu nindi yakwa wishi Yoashi mu musumba wa Ofira uwa bena Abiesi.

english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.
translation: Awe tapapitile inshita apo Gideoni afwilile, abena Israeli kabili babwekeshepo ukulacita bucilende mukukonka imbela sha milungu ba Baali, icakuti bacita na Baali Beriti ukuba umulungu wabo.

english: The children of Israel didn’t remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
translation: Balilabile ukwibukisha Yawe, Lesa wabo, uyo uwabapuswishe ukufuma mu maboko ya balwani babo bonse mu mbali shonse.

english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.
translation: Kabili bafililwe no kulanga ukutasha ku lupwa lwakwa Yerubibaali, emukutila Gideoni, pa fintu ifisuma fyonse ifyo acitile abena Israeli.

english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
translation: Gideoni na bantu bakwe imyanda itatu (300), nelyo banakile batwalilile ukukunkunika abalwani babo, mpaka bafika ku mumana wa Yordani no kwabuka.

english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
translation: Elyo atile ku bantu ba mu musumba wa Sukoti, “Mpeeleleniko ifita fyandi imikate, pantu nabanakisha ku nsala, elyo ncili ndekunkunika Seba na Salimuna, imfumu sha ku Midiani.”

english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”
translation: Nomba bacilolo ba mu musumba wa Sukoti batile, “Bushe Seba na Salimuna naubekata kale bali mu minwe yobe pakuti ifwe tupeele imikate ku fita fyobe fya nkondo?”

english: Gideon said, “Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”
translation: Elyo Gideoni ayaswike ati, “Cisuma, nomba ilyo Yawe akapeela Seba na Salimuna mu maboko yandi, ine ndi nokwisa cenaula imibili yenu na membya ya myunga ya mu matololo na kuli nkololo.”

english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
translation: Awe alifuminepo aile ku Penieli, kabili nako kwine aile landa cimo cine, lelo nabo bene bayaswike ngefyo abantu ba ku Sukoti bayaswike.

english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
translation: Eico kanshi asosele ku bena Penieli ati, “Ilyo nkabweluluka panuma yakucimfya, nkesa bongolola ulu lupungu lwenu no kuluwisha panshi.”

english: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
translation: Abimeleki mwana Yerubibaali aile kuli ba lupwa lwakwa nyina ku Shekemu, no kuya beba pamo na ba mu mukowa wakwa nyina bonse ati,

english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
translation: “Icakonkelepo imiti yaebele umukunyu aiti, ‘Isa pakuti ube imfumu yesu.’

english: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
translation: “Nao umukunyu watile, ‘Bushe ine kuti naleka ukutwala ifitwalo ifisuma, kabili ifyalowa no kuba imfumu ya fimiti finandi?’

english: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
translation: “Elyo imiti yatile ku mwangashi, ‘Isa pakuti ube imfumu yesu.’

english: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
translation: “Nao umwangashi watile, ‘Bushe ine kuti nasha umulimo wandi uwakupanga umwangashi uusekesha yonse imilungu elyo na bantu, no kuya ba imfumu ya fimiti finandi?’

english: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’
translation: “Elyo pakulekelesha imiti yonse yatile ku cimuti ca myunga, ‘Isa pakuti ube imfumu yesu.’

english: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’
translation: “Naco icimuti ca myunga cayaswike imiti imbi aciti, ‘Nga cine cine mulefwaya ine mbe imfumu yenu, iseni mwikale mu cintelelwe candi. Lelo nga mwakaana, umulilo walafuma mu cimuti ca myunga no kwisa oca ifimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda ifyaba mu Lebanoni.’

english: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti ni mu cishinka kabili mu bufumacumi mwasontele Abimeleki ukuba imfumu, no kucita icalungama kuli Yerubibaali no lupwa lwakwe, no kumucitila icilingene nefyo abombele,

english: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;
translation: tontonkanyeni ifyo tata amulwishishe. Apeele umweo wakwe kukumupususha ukufuma ku maboko ya bena Midiani.

english: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);
translation: Nomba imwe ilelo namusangukila ulupwa lwakwa tata, mwamwipaila abana bakwe abaume amakumi cine lubali (70) pa cilibwe cimo cine, no kusonta Abimeleki, umwana uwafyalwa mu mukashana umusha, no kuba imfumu pa bena Shekemu, pantufye ni munyinenwe.

english: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;
translation: Kanshi ifyo mwacita ilelo nga fyacishinka kabili mu bufumacumi kuli Yerubibaali no lupwa lwakwe, ninshi Abimeleki abe ni nsansa shenu, kabili aleba uwakumusansamusha na imwe bene pamo.

english: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”
translation: “Shisoseni nokuti bomfwe abekashi bonse aba mu Shekemu mutile, ‘Bushe cinshi cawamapo kuli imwe ukuleka bonse bamwana Yerubibaali amakumi cine lubali (70) balemuteeka, nangu ukuteekwafye ku muntu umo?’ Ibukisheni, ine ndi wa mu mubili wenu, kabili umulopa wenu.”

english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”
translation: Lelo nga teifyo, lekeni umulilo ufume kuli Abimeleki no kwisa moca, mwe bena Shekemu na Beti Milo, kabili no koca Abimeleki wine.”

english: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
translation: Elyo Yotamu afulumwike, afyukila ku Bere. Aile ikala kulya kwine pakutiina munyina Abimeleki.

english: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.
translation: Abimeleki ateekele Israeli pa myaka itatu.

english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
translation: Lesa atumine umupashi ubifi pakati kakwa Abimeleki ne ntungulushi sha mu Shekemu, uwalengele ukuti shisangukile Abimeleki.

english: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.
translation: Lesa acitile ifi pakuti akande Abimeleki pa lufyengo acitile pamo na bena Shekemu abamwafwile ukwipaya bamwana Yerubaali amakumi cine lubali (70). Epakuti umulopa wabo ulandulwe pali munyinabo na bena Shekemu.

english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.
translation: Pa mulandu wa fyacitike, intungulushi sha mu Shekemu shatumine abaume pa mulu wa lupili no kufisamina Abimeleki elyo balapokolola abantu ifintu fyonse balesenda. Kabili aya mashiwi yonse baleyafisha kuli Abimeleki.

english: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
translation: Nomba ilyo Gali mwana Ebedi pamo na bamunyina bakuukile ku Shekemu, intungulushi sha mu Shekemu shalimucetekele nganshi.

english: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
translation: Nomba Gali na bamunyina baile mu mabala yabo no kuyaswamo ifitwalo fya myangashi, bakama no kukama, elyo bacita umutebeto mwitempele lya mulungu wabo. Baletipwila Abimeleki ilyo bacili balelya no kunwa.

english: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?
translation: Elyo Gali mwana Ebedi atile, “Bushe Abimeleki ni nani, kabili fwe bena Shekemu tuli ba nani abakuti ifwe tulemubombela? Bushe uyu te mwana Yerubibaali, elyo Sebuli teo e cilolo wakwe? Nomba twingalabombela abaume bakwa Hamo, wishi wakwa Shekemu, lelo mulandu nshi twingalabombela Abimeleki?

english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”
translation: Nga cakutifye aba bantu bapeelwe mu maboko yandi, awe Abimeleki nga nalimufumyapo. Kuti naebafye Abimeleki nati, ‘Longanika fyonse ifita fyobe, wise kuno tulwe!’”

english: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa nyina epakulanda amashiwi yonse no kumfwika ku ntungulushi sha mu Shekemu icakuti na bonse imitima yabo yapilibukila kuli ena, balanda no kutila, “Ni munyinefwe.”

english: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.
translation: Awe ilyo Sebuli kateeka wa musumba aumfwile ifyasosele Gali mwana Ebedi, alifulilwe nganshi.

english: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.
translation: Mukuicingililako atumine inkombe kuli Abimeleki ku Aruma no kutila, “Gali mwana Ebedi na bamunyina nabesa kuno ku Shekemu, uko bambile ukutunka abena musumba ukukusangukila.

english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.
translation: Eico kanshi, iwe na bantu bobe mwime ubushiku no kuya babelamina ku mabala.

english: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”
translation: Elyo ulucelocelo pa kutula kwa kasuba, mukeme no kushinguluka umusumba. Ilyo Gali pamo ne fita fyakwe bakema ukwisa mukumulwisha, awe ukacite conse ico amaboko yobe yali nokubacitila.”

english: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
translation: Kanshi nao Abimeleki pamo ne fita fyakwe fyonse epakwima ubushiku no kushinguluka umusumba, babelamina Shekemu mu mpuka shine.

english: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.
translation: Ilyo Gali mwana Ebedi afumine no kuya iminina pa mwinshi wa mpongolo ya musumba, Abimeleki ne fita fyakwe basokolweke pa cifulo apo bafiseme.

english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”
translation: Cilyafye Gali ati abamone, atile kuli Sebuli, “Mona, abantu balya baletentemuka ukufuma pa mulu wa mpili.”

english: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”
translation: Kabili Gali abwekeshepo ukulanda ati, “Mona, abantu balya baletentemuka ukufuma pa mupokapoka wa mpili. Kabili impuka imbi ilefuma ku lubali lwa nshila yafuma ku cimuti ca bakabuka.”

english: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”
translation: Elyo Sebuli atile kuli ena, “Ngo kuitakisha kobe kuli kwi? Bushe teiwe watile Abimeleki ni nani uwakuti ifwe tulemubombela? Bushe ifi te fita wasuulile? Eico kabiye nomba uye ubalwishe.”

english: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
translation: Kanshi Gali epakwimya intungulushi sha mu Shekemu no kulwisha Abimeleki.

english: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.
translation: Awe bamupeele indalama ukulingana na mashekeli amakumi cine lubali (70) isha silifa ukufuma mwitempele lyakwa Baali Beliti. Neshi ndalama Abimeleki ashibomfeshe mukukunkumba abantu abawelewele kabili abaonaika abasumine ukulamukonka.

english: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.
translation: Lelo Gali alifulumwike, na Abimeleki alimukonkele. Kabili abantu abengi balibepeye ilyo tabalafika na ku mwinshi wa mpongolo.

english: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
translation: Elyo Abimeleki abwelelemo ku Aruma no kwikala kulya kwine. Sebuli nao atamfya Gali na bamunyina ukufuma mu Shekemu.

english: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo abekashi ba mu musumba wa Shekemu balifumine baya mu mabala, elyo akasebo kaile fika kuli Abimeleki,

english: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.
translation: nao Abimeleki aimya ifita fyakwe, afyakanya mu mpuka shitatu, no kuya fisama mu mabala. Ilyo amwene abantu baleisa ukufuma mu musumba, alibemine no kubepaya.

english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.
translation: Nomba Abimeleki ne mpuka imo babutuka bwangu bwangu baya ikala pa mwinshi wa mpongolo, elyo impuka shimbi shibili shaimina abali mu mabala shabasansa no kubepaya bonse.

english: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.
translation: Abimeleki wena akasuba konsefye, aikalile ukulwisha abekashi ba mu musumba mpaka abacimfya no kubepaya bonse. Elyo abongolwele umusumba no kukubapo umucele.

english: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.
translation: Ilyo abekashi ba ku lupungu lwa Shekemu baumfwile icacitike, bonse baile mu muputule wa panshi we tempele lyakwa Eli Beriti.

english: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
translation: Lintu Abimeleki aumfwile ukuti eko belelongana,

english: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”
translation: ena pamo ne fita fyakwe baile ku lupili lwa Salimoni. Abuulile isembe no kutetelako imisambo ya fimiti, iyo asendele pa kubeya kwakwe. Aebele ne fita fyakwe ati, “Yangufyanyeni, citeni ifyo ine nacita!”

english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
translation: Cila muntu pa fita fyakwe atetele imisambo ya fimiti, no kumukonka. Babikile umwina onse uwa fimuti pa mwinshi wa muputule we tempele no kukoshapo umulilo ilyo abantu bacili mukati. Kanshi abantu bonse abali muli ulu lupungu lwa Shekemu, abali ikana limo (1,000) abaume na banakashi, bonse bafwilile mulya mwine.

english: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.
translation: Elyo aile ku mushi kuli wishi Yerubibaali ku Ofira no kuya ipaya bamunyina amakumi cine lubali (70) pelibwe limo line. Lelo Yotamu, kasuli wakwa Yerubibaali, ewapuswike pantu aile fisama.

english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
translation: Icakonkelepo, Abimeleki aile ku musumba wa Tebeshi no kuushinguluka mpaaka aupoka.

english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.
translation: Nomba mukati ka musumba mwali ulupungu ulwakosa, uko abantu bonse abaume na banakashi elyo ne ntungulushi sha mu musumba bafulumukile. Baisala pa mwinshi no kunina pa mulu wa lupungu.

english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
translation: Abimeleki ilyo aile ku lupungu, atendeke ukulwisha, mpaka afika pa mwinshi wa lupungu pakuti oce no mulilo.

english: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.
translation: Nomba umwanakashi umo amuponesha umwana wa mpelo pa mutwe no kumutobaula akapanga ka mutwe.

english: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”
translation: Bwangu bwangufye aitile uwalesenda ifyanso fyakwe, nokumweba ati, “Somona ulupanga lobe umpwililishe, epakuti bekasosa abati, ‘Mwanakashi ewamwipeye.’” Elyo kasenda wa fyanso fyakwe amupulinkenye ulupanga, no kufwa afwa.

english: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.
translation: Abena Israeli pakumona ukuti Abimeleki afwa, bonse balibwelelemo kumyabo.

english: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Lesa alandwile pa bubi ubo Abimeleki acitile kuli wishi, pakwipaya bamunyina amakumi cine lubali (70).

english: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.
translation: Kabili Lesa abweseshe ububi bonse ubwa bena Shekemu pa mitwe yabo. Icitipu cakwa Yotamu mwana Yerubibaali caishile pali bena.

english: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
translation: Elyo intungulushi shonse isha mu Shekemu na mu Beti Milo shalongene pa mbali ya cimuti ca oki pa luceshi lwa mu Shekemu kukuya sonta Abimeleki ukuba imfumu yabo.

english: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
translation: Ilyo Yotamu bamwebele pali uyu mulandu aninine pa mulu wa lupili lwa Gerisimu no kubilikisha ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, “Umfweni kuli ine, mwe bekashi ba mu Shekemu pakuti Lesa nao engomfwa kuli imwe.

english: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
translation: “Ubushiku bumo imiti yaile kukuya sonta imfumu yaiko. Elyo yaebele umuti wa miolifa aiti, ‘Tulefwaya ube imfumu yesu.’

english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
translation: “Nao umuolifa watile, ‘Bushe ine kuti naleka ukupanga amafuta yandi ayo bonse abantu ne milungu bancindikilako, pa mulandu wakubafye imfumu ya fimiti?’

english: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, house of Israel!
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli, umfweni amashiwi ayo Yawe alemweba.

english: But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.
translation: Nomba Yawe ena ni Lesa wacine cine,

english: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”
translation: Ubebe auti, “Imwe mwe bena Israeli, imilungu iyishabumbako mulu ne calo, ala ikonaulwa. Ikaleka no kulamoneka ponsefye pesonde na pesamba lya myulu.”

english: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.
translation: Ni Yawe ewabumba icalo ku makafye yakwe,

english: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.
translation: Eutila nga abulukuta mukupeela icebo,

english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
translation: Abantu bonse bawelewele,

english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
translation: Finangwafye, kabili imilimo yabuwelewele

english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.
translation: Lesa uwaba icakaniko cakwa Yakobo ena taba ifi iyoo,

english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu, mwe bashingulukwa ku balwani,

english: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”
translation: Pantu ndemusukusa kumbi,

english: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”
translation: Yangu nalishama pa mulandu wakuicena.

english: The LORD says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe alesosa ati,

english: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.
translation: Itenti lyandi nalyonaika,

english: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.
translation: “Bakacema balitumpa,

english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.
translation: Umfweni. Umulandu uyo uwaumfwika.

english: LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
translation: “We Yawe nalishiba ukuti takwaba muntunse nelyo umo uuisalila umwine umusango wakwikalilamo,

english: LORD, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.
translation: We Yawe, unsalapule, lelo ubomfye uluse lobe.

english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
translation: Ulete icipyu cobe pa bantu ba mishobo yonse abashakusumina,

english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.
translation: Imibeele ya aba bantu, yafyefye.

english: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.
translation: Bacengulwilako silifa na golide,

english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”
translation: Utu tulubi twabafye nge fintiinya,

english: There is no one like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is great in might.
translation: “We Yawe, takwaba nelyo umo uwaba nga iwe,

english: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.
translation: Nga nani uushingakukwatila akatiina,

english: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
translation: Bonse balitumpa, kabili fipubafye.

english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.
translation: Utulubi twabo baengulwilako silifa wa ku Tashishi,

english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Aya e mashiwi ayafumine kuli Yawe ayo aebele Yeremia ati,

english: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
translation: Nababwelela ku fya bubifi bwa fikolwe fyabo, abakene ukumfwa amashiwi yandi, balekonka nokubombela imilungu imbi. Aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda balyonaula icipangano ico ine napangene ne fikolwe fyabo.

english: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.
translation: Kanshi nomba ine ne Yawe ndesosa ukuti ndebaletela ifinkunka ifyo bashakafumemo. Bakulati nga bakuuta mutuule, awe na ine nshakulaumfwa nakalya.

english: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
translation: Elyo abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu bakulaya mukulilila ku milungu iyo bafutumwina ububani. Nomba ilya milungu yakulafilwa ukubapusushako ilyo ifi finkunka filebafikila.

english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’
translation: Imilungu iyo imwe mwe bena Yuda mwaba nayo, yalinganafye ne misumba yenu ku bwingi. Ne fibumbili ifyansoni ifyo mufutumwinapo Baali ububani ifyo mwakuula, nafyo ku bwingi fyalinganafye ne misebo ya mu Yerusalemu mwine.

english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.
translation: “Kanshi iwe Yeremia wiesha kupapatilako abo bantu, wiesha ukubalombelako icili conse, pantu nshakulabomfwa ilyo bakulakuuta mu nshita ya kucululuka kwabo.”

english: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati, “Finshi abantu abo ine natemwa, balecita mu ŋanda yandi, ilyo nabobelwa mukucita ifyabipa fyeka fyeka? Bushe baletontonkanya ukuti ukulaya ifilayo no kulatuula amalambo ya nama efingabapusushako ku busanso? Bushe e musango bengapusukilamo, mwa?

english: The LORD called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.
translation: Kale ine ne Yawe nalebeta umuti wa muolifa uwalelema amabula, uwakompa ku fitwalo ifisuma, nomba lino lyena ndelepuka nge nkuba, ndeoca amabuula yauko, nkontaule ne misambo ine iyauko.

english: For the LORD of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita ne walimbile aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda, nomba lino lyena nimpanga ukubasansa. Abene ebailetelele ishamo pa bubi bwabo, ebalengele ukuti ine mfulwe pantu bafutumwina Baali ububani.”

english: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
translation: Yawe alinsokolwelele amapange yabo, na ine naishiba, anangilila ne fyabipa ifyo balecita

english: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”
translation: Lelo ine nanakililefye nga kana ka mpaanga ako baletwala kukwipaya, no kwishiba ine nshaishibe ukuti nine balepangila ukucitapo cimo. Balesosa abati,

english: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
translation: “Umfwa kuno amashiwi ya ici cipangano. Webe abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu

english: But, LORD of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.
translation: We Yawe umwine wa fita,

english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in the LORD’s name, that you not die by our hand’—
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa Yawe ku baume ba mu mushi wa Anatoti, abalefwaya ukwipaya Yeremia, balimwebele abati, “Ifwe tulekwipaya ne minwe yesu, nga ulekonkanyapo ukulasesema mwishina lyakwa Yawe.”

english: therefore the LORD of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
translation: Kanshi Yawe umwine wa fita nao epakubalandapo ati, “Ine nkabakanda. Abalumendo babo bakafwa ku nkondo, abana babo abaume na banakashi bakafwa ku cipowe.

english: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”
translation: Ine ndi nokuponesha ububi pa baume ba mu Anatoti pa nshita yakukandwa kwabo, awe tapakabe nelyo umo uukapusukapo.”

english: and say to them, the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,
translation: ukuti ifi efyalanda Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli aletila, ‘Abe uwatipwa umuntufye onse ushibeela amashiwi ya ici cipangano.’

english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;
translation: Icipangano cimo cinefye ico napangene ne fikolwe fyenu, ilyo nabafumishe mu calo ca Egupto icali kwati lilungu lya mulilo umo ifikolwe fyenu fyalecula. Ine nalibebele ukulabeela na mashiwi yandi, no kulacita fyonse ifyo nabakonkomeshe, ukuti nga balambeela, ninshi bakaba abantu abandifye, na ine ninshi nkaba Lesa uwabo.

english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, LORD.”
translation: Kanshi ine epakufikilisha icilayo ico nalaile ifikolwe fyabo, icakubapeela icalo icikankala icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci, ico bekalamo pali nomba.”

english: The LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.
translation: Elyo Yawe kabili anjeba ati, “Kabiye mu misumba ya muno calo ca Yuda, uye na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu. Kabilemo imbila yandi, webe abantu ukumfwikisha bwino amashiwi ya ici cipangano, kabili ubebe no kulayakonka.

english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”
translation: Pantu ilyo ine nafumishe ifikolwe fyabo mu calo ca Egupto, nalibasokele nganshi palwa kubeela amashiwi yandi, ukushinta na lelo ine nabikapofye ukusoka aba abantu.

english: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”
translation: Lelo bena tebakumfwa nangu ukubikako amano nakalya. Bonsefye babikapofye ukumalala imitima no kubifya lyonse. Ine nalibakonkomeshe ukulabeela icipangano, nomba bena balikaana. Kanshi na ine eico mbaletele amashamo yonse ayalembwa mu cipangano.”

english: The LORD said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translation: Elyo Yawe kabili anjeba ati, “Abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu nabansangukila.

english: You are righteous, LORD, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?
translation: We Yawe, iwe lyonse uli mulungami nga naleta umulandu kuli iwe,

english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
translation: Bakacema abengi nabonaula ibala lyandi ilya myangashi,

english: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.
translation: Nabacisangula amatololo,

english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.
translation: Mu milundu yonse iya mu matololo abakonaula nabafika,

english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of the LORD’s fierce anger.”
translation: Abantu bandi bakulatanda iŋanu,

english: The LORD says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Kuli bonse bantu ababi abapalamana na bena Israeli, abo abonaula icalo ico ne mwine napeela abantu bandi abena Israeli, abo bantu ine nkabafumyamo mu fyalo fyabo, bakaba ngo muti uo banukula, nkafumyamo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda.

english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
translation: Abena mupalamano babo ilyo ine nkabatwala kumbi, elyo nkababelelako uluse. Imishobo ya bantu yonse umo umo ine nkaibwesesha mu fifulo ifya mu fyalo fyaiko.

english: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As the LORD lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.
translation: Abo bantu nga basekelela ipepo lya bantu bandi, no kulapa nga balalapa abati, ‘Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo,’ baleka no kulalapa Baali nga filya fine bafundileko na bantu bandi, ninshi lyena nabo bene bakapeelwa icifulo cimo pamo na bantu bandi.

english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says the LORD.
translation: Lelofye abantu ba mushobo umo nga tabakalembeela, awe lyena ninshi nkabafumyamo mu cifulo cabo, no kubalofya nkabalofya.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.
translation: Iwe niwe ubalimba nge miti, nabo bamena imishila,

english: But you, LORD, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
translation: Nomba ine we Yawe, walinjishiba,

english: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”
translation: Bushe icalo cikafika lilali mukuloosha,

english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?
translation: “Nga iwe Yeremia, ilyo ulebutuka na benda panshi,

english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.
translation: Ala na bamunonko bene, aba mu lupwa lobefye,

english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
translation: “Ine nomba nimfumyako amano ku bantu bandi,

english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.
translation: Abantu bandi abo ne mwine naisalila bali nge nkalamo mu mpanga,

english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.
translation: Bushe te bantu bandi abo ne mwine naisalila,

english: The LORD said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”
translation: Ifi efyo anjebele Yawe ine ne Yeremia ati, “Kashitepo insalu iyabusaka kabili iyatelela, eyo ukake mu musana, nomba wiesha kuitumpa mu menshi.”

english: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
translation: Aba bantu babi abakaana ukulabeela amashiwi yandi, abaumalala imitima, abakoselelafye ukulabifya, abapepa imilungu imbi imbi, no kubombela eyo babombela, nabo bene bakaba nga iyi ine insalu iyo umuntu ashingafwala nakabili.

english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says the LORD; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’
translation: Pantu ngefi fine umushipi wakukaka mu musana wa muntu wikata ku mubili, efyo na ine wine mfwaya ukuti aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli bonse na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda bonse balenjikatisha. Epakuti baleba abantu abandifye, abakulanumbanya no kulancindika, lelo abantu bandi bena tebakumfwa iyoo.

english: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’
translation: “Iwe Yeremia, eba abena Israeli ukuti, Ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, ‘Mu mitondo yonse besushemo umwangashi.’ Nabo nga bakwasuka abati, ‘Ala twalishiba ukuti mu mitondo yonse tuli nokwisushamo umwangashi.’

english: Then tell them, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
translation: Elyo nobe ubebe ukuti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ine ne Yawe nkanwensha abantu ba muli cino calo umwangashi, mpakafye bakakolwe, emukuti abo nkanwensha ni bashamfumu bamwana Davidi, na bashimapepo, na bakasesema, na bena Yerusalemu bonse.

english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says the LORD: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”
translation: Elyo ine nkabuula bashibo na bana babo nkalebapamanya nge mitondo. Ifi efyasosa Yawe. Ine nshakabalangulukileko, nshakomfwe no bulanda nangufye uluse nakalya, mpaka nkabalofye.’”

english: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for the LORD has spoken.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Israeli, lekeni icilumba.

english: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.
translation: Akucindikeni Yawe Lesa wenu,

english: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.
translation: Nomba nga tamwaumfwe,

english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati,

english: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.
translation: Imisumba ya mu matololo ya Negebu nabaisalako,

english: So I bought a belt according to the LORD’s word, and put it on my waist.
translation: Awe na ine nayashita insalu, ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe ankonkomeshe, nakaka na mu musana.

english: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu, sansuleni amenso mumone.

english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?
translation: Bushe mukatilapo shani ilyo bakamwalukila

english: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.
translation: Nga mukalaipusha mwe bene amuti,

english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
translation: Bushe umwina Kushi kuti ayalula inkanda yakwe?

english: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.
translation: Yawe asosa ati,

english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says the LORD, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”
translation: Ishamo likamuponena imwe,

english: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.
translation: Ine ne Yawe nkamufula imwe ifyakufwala,

english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”
translation: Ndamonako uko imwe mucita ifintu ifyabunani.

english: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying,
translation: Elyo kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine umuku wacibili aliti,

english: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”
translation: “Senda insalu ushitile iyo ufwele, uye ku mumana wa Yufurate uye uifise mu mulale wa cilibwe.”

english: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakuya ifisa ku Yufurate, ngefyo Yawe umwine ankonkomeshe.

english: After many days, the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
translation: Ilyo papitile inshiku ishingi elyo Yawe anjeba ukubwelela ku Yufurate, kukuya buula ilya nsalu anjebele ukuya fisa.

english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakuya ku Yufurate. Nalafwaya apo nafishile insalu, awe naisanga. Kuti nati ndoleshe, awe namonafye yalyonaika, teyakufwala nakabili iyoo.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “The LORD says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
translation: “Ifi fine efyo ine nkapwisha abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu icilumba cabo icishaikulila. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: This is the LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
translation: Ili e shiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyaishile kuli Yeremia pa mulandu wa cilala ilyakuti,

english: The LORD says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore the LORD does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”
translation: Yawe nao epakulandapo pali aba bantu ati, “Aba bantu balitemwisha ukumbutuka, baya mukululumbafye uko abene balefwaya. E mulandu wine na ine wine mbafumisheko amano. Nakulaibukisha ubulungani bwabo, no kubalimuna nine nkabalimuna pa mulandu wa kubifya kwabo.”

english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.
translation: Elyo kabili Yawe anjeba ne Yeremia ati, “Iwe tecakwesha kulampapata pakuti ntulanyeko aba bantu.

english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”
translation: Nangufye balekelepo ukulya, ine nshaumfwe inkuuta shabo, nshaposeko na mano, nangufye bantuule amalambo ayakoca ayasuma, ne mituulo imbi iya cabunga. Ine kubepayafye ku nkondo, na ku cipowe, na ku cikuko.”

english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”
translation: Elintu na ine ne Yeremia nasosa nati, “We mfumu Yawe, nawishiba ukuti bakasesema baleeba abantu ukuti takwakabe nkondo nangufye icipowe nakalya, pantu baleti iwe walilaya abantu ukuti bakulaikalilafye mu cibote muli cino calo.”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.
translation: Yawe ena pakunjasuka asosa ati, “Bakasesema bufifye balebepa pakusosa ukuti nine mbebele ifyakulanda. Tene nabatuma, tene nabapeela icebo, nangufye ine ukulanda nabo, awe. Ifimonwa ifyo bena babeba tekuli ine fyatula iyoo, fyabuwelewelefye ifyo balesobela, fintufye ifyo abene belenganya mu mano yabo.

english: Therefore the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.
translation: Ine ne Yawe ndekwebelapo ifyo ine nalaswa ncite kuli abo bakasesema abasesema mwishina lyandi, nelyo ine nshabatuma, abalanda nokuti tamwakabe nkondo, nangufye icipowe nakalya muli cino calo. Ala ine nkepaya aba bene bakasesema ku nkondo na ku cipowe.

english: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.
translation: Na bantu bene abo bakasesema baebako ifi fintu, nabo bene bakafwa ku nkondo na ku cipowe. Ifitumbi fyabo fikaposwa ntangali ntangali mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu, takwakamoneke na wakufishiika, nangu abakashi babo na bana babo abaume na bana babo abanakashi. Ee, ine nkabacitapo cimo pa bubifi bwabo.

english: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.
translation: “Iwe Yeremia, landa aya mashiwi ku bantu ayakuti,

english: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”
translation: Ndeti nga naya mu mpanga,

english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
translation: We Yawe Lesa, bushe nacipwa naukanininafye abena Yuda?

english: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.
translation: “Icalo ca Yuda cili mu malilo,

english: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.
translation: Ifwe twayebelela ububifi bwesu we Yawe,

english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.
translation: Pa mulandu we shina lyobe, witusuulakofye iyoo,

english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, the LORD our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.
translation: Pa milungu iyafyefye iya benafyalo tapaba nelyo umo uwingaleta imfula,

english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.
translation: Abakankala baletuma ababomfi babo kukuya batapilako amenshi,

english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.
translation: Umushili naulatauka imilale

english: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.
translation: Mu mpanga namo insebula naisha akana ako ifyele,

english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.
translation: Bapunda ba mpanga nabo balungemefye ku mpili,

english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, LORD; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.
translation: Elyo nasosa nati,

english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?
translation: Iwe niwefye tusubila ifwe fwe bena Israeli,

english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, LORD, are in the middle of us, and we are called by your name. Don’t leave us.
translation: Nga cinshi ico ubelele ngo muntu uo bapumikishafye,

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine ne Yeremia aliti, “Nangufye Mose na Samwele bengeminina pa cinso candi, no kubapapatilako kuli ine, awe ine teti nangulukileko aba bantu iyoo. Bena ubatamfyefye, ine nshilefwaya na kubamona pano ndi.

english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.
translation: Ubuso 13:10

english: The LORD said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?
translation: Teti pamoneke muntu uwingafuna icela, palibufi nga ni cilya cela cifuma ku kapinda ka ku kuso ico basakanyamo no mukuba.”

english: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.
I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”
translation: Nkaleka bakalebombela abalwani babo mu calo cimo ico abantu bandi bashaishiba, pantu icipyu candi cilebilima ngo mulilo, kabili tacakatale acileka kubilima iyoo.”

english: LORD, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.
translation: Elyo na ine nasosa nati,

english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD, God of Armies.
translation: Ilyo amashiwi yobe yamfikile naliyasekelele.

english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.
translation: Ine nshatala njikala mwibumba lya bantu abasekasekafye,

english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?
translation: Nga cinshi ico mbikilepofye ukulacula?

english: Therefore the LORD says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.
translation: Elyo Yawe nao ayasuka ati,

english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’
translation: Nga bakwipusha uko balefwaya ukuya, bebefye ifyo ine nsosele nati,

english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says the LORD.
translation: Ine nkakucita nge linga ilyamaka ilya mukuba,

english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”
translation: “Ine nkalakufyombotolako mu minwe ya bantu babi,

english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says the LORD: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.
translation: “Ee, nine ne Yawe mpingwile ifintu fine (4) ifyakubonaula. Bakabepaya ku lupanga, imbwa eshikalatakanya ifitumbi fyabo, ifyuni nafyo fikalalya ifitumbi fyabo elyo ne finama fya mpanga fikalalya ifikalashalako.

english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
translation: Abantu bonse aba pano isonde nkalenga bakaleitutuminafye ku mwenso pakumona ifi fintu, pa mulandu wa fintu ifibi ifyo Manase mwana Hesekia alecita mu Yerusalemu pa nshita aleteeka cino calo ca Yuda.

english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?
You have rejected me,” says the LORD. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.
translation: Nomba ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati,

english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.
translation: Mu mishi yonse iya muli cino calo,

english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.
translation: Bamukamfwilwa babo nabafula,

english: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says the LORD.
translation: Umwanakashi umo uwafyele bamwane cine lubali afwa umutombo,

english: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine ne Yeremia aliti,

english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says the LORD, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.
translation: Elyo iwe ulebasukafye ukuti ine ne Yawe ndetila nati, ‘Icilengele nico ifikolwe fyenu fyalinsangukile, fyalikonkelela imilungu imbi imbi no kulaipepa no kulaibombela. Fyalinsuulile, fyakaana no kulanakila amafunde yandi.

english: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.
translation: Nomba imwe namubipishapo pa fikolwe fyenu. Bonsefye apo mwapela mwalyumalala imitima, muli babi, mwalikaana no kulambeela.

english: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
translation: Kanshi nomba ine nalamufumyamo muli cino calo, nalamufwinta mu calo cimo ico imwe mushaishiba, ico ne fikolwe fyenu fine fishaishibe. Umo mwine emo mukalabombela imilungu imbi imbi akasuba no bushiku, no luse ine nshakamukwatile nakalya.’”

english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that it will no more be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
translation: “Lelo, inshita imo yalafika ilyo kushabe nelyo umo uwakulandapo ati, ‘Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Umumi uwafumishe abena Israeli mu calo ca Egupto.’

english: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.
translation: Pakulapa ine nomba bakulatilafye, ‘Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Umumi uwafumishe abena Israeli mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso, na mu fyalo fimbi fyonse umo ena abasalanganishe.’ Ee, ine nkababwesesha muli cino calo cabo, ico napeele ifikolwe fyabo.

english: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says the LORD, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
translation: “Moneni, ine ndeita abalondo abengi abakwisa ikata aba bantu nga filya fine bekata isabi. Elyo ndeita na balunshi abengi, abakwisa mukulabalunga nge nama mu mpili shonse na mu tupili tonse na mu ncengo sha mabwe mwine.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.
translation: “Ine ndamona fyonsefye ifyo bena bacita. Tapaba nelyo cimo icafisama kuli ine. Ifibi fyabo fyaba pa mulola wandi.

english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”
translation: Pa bubi bwabo na pa bulungani bwabo ine nkabakandilapo libili. Nabakowesha icalo candi ku tulubi utushakwata bumi nga filya fine ifitumbi fiba. Mu calo ico nabapeela, nabesushamo ifimpashanya fya milungu yabo iyabufi.”

english: LORD, my strength, my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth, and will say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.
translation: We Yawe, we cubo candi kabili niwe unkosha,

english: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”
translation: “Iwe wikopila muli cino calo, wikafyalilamo na bana.

english: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”
translation: Bushe umuntunse alikwatapo amaka ayakuipangila imilungu?

english: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.”
translation: “Eico kanshi ine ne Yawe Lesa,

english: For the LORD says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:
translation: Ine nalakwebelapo ifyalaswa fiponene abana abafyalilwa muli cino calo, ifikaponena na banamayo ababapapa na bawishi bene.

english: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”
translation: Bonse bali nokufwa ku malwele ayabipisha. Tapakabe wakubaloosha, no kushiikwa tabashiikwe. Bakulatulumanafye nge mina ya citindi. Bali nokufwa ku nkondo na ku cipowe, ne fitumbi fyabo fikaba e cakulya ca fyuni neca finama fya mpanga.”

english: For the LORD says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says the LORD, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe. “Iwe tekwesha kulaingila mu ŋanda umuli icililo. Tecakwesha ukulalangulukilako umuntu nelyo umo. Pantu ine nomba nshabaletele cibote, nimfumyapo amapaalo yandi no kutemwa kwandi kabili nshabacitileko uluse nakalya.

english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.
translation: Abakankala na balanda bene bali nokufwa muli cino calo, ukwabula no wakubashiika nangufye uwakubaloosha. Tamwabe no wakuitetaula umubili nangufye uwakubeya ulukuuso pakulanga ubulanda.

english: Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
translation: Uulefwilwa tali nakumonapo nelyo umo uwakumuletelako icakulya nangufye icakunwa pakumukoselesha. Nangufye uulefwilwa wishi atemwa nyina, ala nao wine takamonepo nelyo umo uwakumutalalikako umutima.

english: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”
translation: “Kabinge tekwesha kulaingila mu ŋanda umuli amalila, kukulyamo nangu kukunwamo pamo nabo.

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
translation: Umfwikishe ifyo ndesosa ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, ine ne Lesa wakwa Israeli. Ine muno muntu ndebaputukisha utupundu twansansa, na mashiwi yene aya bashibwinga naya banabwinga. Abantu ababa muno muntu bali nokusangwapo no kuimwena abene ifyalabaponena.

english: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Imwe mwe bena Yuda, ifibi fyenu nafilembwa ku kalembelo ka cela akabaswa kuli daimondi, nafilembwa mu mitima yenu, na pa nsengo sha fibumbili fya malambo.

english: “I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”
translation: Ine ne Yawe nine nengula ifitontonkanya umuntu,

english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.
translation: Umuntu uunonkela ifyuma mu musango wabipa,

english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
translation: Amalu 62:12

english: LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living waters.
translation: Yawe eo abena Israeli batetekela,

english: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
translation: We Yawe, wingamposhako,

english: Behold, they ask me, “Where is the LORD’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”
translation: Abantu balanjeba ine abati,

english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.
translation: We Yawe, awe ine nshabutuka imilimo yobe iya kucema,

english: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.
translation: Wilanenga ukuti ndetiina,

english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but don’t let me be disappointed. Let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
translation: Abancusha ine, ebo uletela insoni,

english: The LORD said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
translation: Yawe alandile kuli ine ne Yeremia ati, “Keminine pa mpongolo ilya beta ukuti Mpongolo ya bantu, iyo ishamfumu sha muno mu Yuda shipitilapo pakuya mu musumba na pakufumamo, elyo kabili uye na pa mpongolo shimbi shonse isha mu Yerusalemu.

english: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills.
translation: Ee, abana benu balebukisha ifibumbili fya malambo, ne nceshi ifyo mwakuulila Ashera umulungu uwanakashi, mwisamba lya miti yonse iyalelema, na pa mulu wa tupili,

english: Tell them, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
translation: Uye beba ukutila, ‘Umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe mwe bashamfumu ba mu calo ca Yuda nemwe bene mwe bena Yuda bonse na bambi bonse abaikala mu Yerusalemu, abapitila pali ishi mpongolo.

english: The LORD says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe. Mwilasenda icipe icafina pa bushiku bwe Sabata no kulacipisha pa mpongolo sha Yerusalemu,

english: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.
