translation: Mwilafumya mu mayanda yenu icipe icafina pa bushiku bwe sabata. Pa bushiku bwe Sabata mwilaesha ukulabombapo umulimo nelyo umo, pantu bushiku ubwashila, kanshi muli nokubusungafye nga mulya mwine nakonkomeshe ifikolwe fyenu.

english: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
translation: Ubuso 2:23

english: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says the LORD, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;
translation: “Nomba nga mwaumfwa no kulambela bwino bwino ne Yawe, nga mwaleka ukulapisha icipe icafina pa mpongolo sha uyu musumba pa bushiku bwe Sabata, nga mwaikalafye pa bushiku bwe Sabata, pantu bushiku ubwashila, kabili nga mwaleka ukulabombapo mulimo nelyofye umo,

english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.
translation: ninshi lyena bashamfumu na bacilolo babo bakulaingilila pa mpongolo sha Yerusalemu, bakulakwata na maka yabufumu ayo Davidi akwete. Ninshi lyena bakulaendela capamo na bena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu mu maceleta na pali bakabalwe, na mu musumba wa Yerusalemu pefye mwakulaisula abantu paa.

english: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD’s house.
translation: Na bantu bakulatula mu misumba ya muno calo ca Yuda na mu mishi iyashinguluka Yerusalemu. Bakulatula na mu citungu ca bena Benjamini, na mwishika lya mpili, na pa mpili pene, na ku matololo ya Negebu. Bakulaleta mu ŋanda yandi ne Yawe amalambo ayakoca, na malambo yambi, ne mituulo ya cabunga, no bubani, ne mituulo iyakuntotela.

english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”
translation: Nomba nga tamulembeela, mulakaana ukulaikalafye pa bushiku bwe Sabata, mulapisha ne fipe ifyafina pa mpongolo sha Yerusalemu pali ubu bushiku, awe ninshi ine nkoca impongolo sha Yerusalemu ku mulilo. Noyo mulilo ukoca amayanda ayacindama aya mu Yerusalemu, takwakamoneke nelyo umo uwakuushimya.”

english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.
translation: na pa mulu wa mpili ishikulu mu mpanga. Ine nkaleta abalwani benu pakuti bakese mutapa ifyuma fyenu ne fintu ifyo mwatutila. Ne cikalenga, mulandu wa fibi fyenu fyonse ifyo mucita mpanga yonse muli cino calo cenu.

english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”
translation: Mukafumamo muli cino calo ico ine namupeela ukuti cibe icuma cenu. Kabili nkaleka mukalebombela abalwani benu mu calo ico imwe mushaishiba, pantu ine icipyu cilebilima ngo mulilo uuleyaka lyonse.”

english: The LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from the LORD.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe alanda ifyakuti,

english: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
translation: Umuntu wa uyu musango aba nge cimpusa ca mu matololo,

english: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
translation: “Lelo umuntu uutetekela Yawe no kumusumina,

english: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
translation: Ena aba ngo muti uwalimbwa mupepi na menshi,

english: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
translation: “Nani uwingeshiba ifyaba umutima wa muntu?

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine ne Yeremia aliti:

english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.
translation: Nomba abantu ba uyo mushobo, atemwa aba muli ico calo nga balabifya, balakaana no kulambeela, ninshi ine kuti nalekafye, teti mbacitile ifisuma ifyo ningapanga ukubacitila.

english: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’
translation: Eico kanshi eba abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu ukuti, ifi efyasosa Yawe. ‘Ine ndemupekanishisha icinkunka, kabili nimukwatila amapange ayabi. Eico bwelulukeni ukufuma ku mibeele yenu iyibi, muwamye ne nshila shenu ne micitile yenu.’

english: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”
translation: Nomba abantu nabo baasukafye abati, ‘Ala nakalyafye. Nga cinshi? Ifwe bonse twakulaicitilafye ifyo tulefwaya, na cila muntu alecitafye ukulingana nefyo umutima wakwe uubi ulefwaya.’”

english: Therefore the LORD says: “Ask now among the nations, ‘Who has heard such things?’ The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
translation: Bushe ubunga bwa mfula bulabulwapo,

english: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,
translation: Awe abantu bandi bena ine balindabako,

english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.
translation: Icalo cabo balicisangula ukuba icaonaika,

english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
translation: Ngo mwela uufuma ku kabanga,

english: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”
translation: Abantu nabo balilandile abati, “Mwe, ala natumfwane, uleke tucitepo cimo pali Yeremia. Pantu ifwe tatwakatale atubulililwa bashimapepo abakutufunda amafunde, nangu abantu abamano abakutupandako nefwe amano, nangu bakasesema abakusesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Aleni natufwailishepo fimo mufyo alesosa ifyakumupelelapo umulandu, tuleke no kulaumfwa kufyo alelanda.”

english: Give heed to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakusosa nati,

english: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”
translation: “Kabiye tentemukila ku ŋanda ya ulya uupanga ifye bumba, kulya kwine eko ndeya kwebela amashiwi yandi.”

english: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
translation: Bushe ububi e cilambu ca pa busuma, mwa,

english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.
translation: Kwena uleke nomba abana babo bafwe ku cipowe,

english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.
translation: Betile abakwisa basansa,

english: Yet, LORD, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger.
translation: Lelo, we Yawe nawishiba fyonse,

english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.
translation: Awe na ine eko naya ku ŋanda yakwa kabumba, namusanga alebomba pa mupeto wakubumbilapo

english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
translation: Nao aletifye inongo iyo abumba, nga amona ukuti taiweme ninshi kuitobaula, akasamo ibumba nakabili, no kubumbamo icintu cimbi ico umwine alefwaya.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says the LORD. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
translation: “Bushe ine teti ncite kuli imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli ngefi fine uubumba alecita kwibumba, atiini? Ngefi fine ibumba liba mu minwe ya uulebumba, efyo na imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli mwaba mu minwe yandi.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,
translation: “Lyonsefye ine kuti napanga ukufulunganya, ukupasa atemwa ukulofya abantu ba mushobo umo, atemwa ubuteeko bwa calo cimo.

english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.
translation: Nomba abantu ba uyo mushobo, atemwa aba muli ico calo nga baleka ukubifya, ninshi ine kuti nabwesha umutima, teti mbacite icinkunka ico ningapanga ukubacita.

english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,
translation: Kabili lyonsefye ine kuti napanga ukusalapo abantu ba mushobo umo, no kubakusha, atemwa ukukusha ubuteko bwa calo cimo.

english: Thus said the LORD, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, “Kabiye kashitepo umutondo umo kuli kabumba wauko. Sendapo abakalamba bamo aba bantu na bashimapepo bamo abakalamba,

english: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,
translation: Isham 23:10

english: and shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
translation: anjeba nokuti ine mbebe ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita fyonse atile ati, “Ine nkonaula aba bantu, nkonaula noyu wine umusumba, ngefi fine iwe Yeremia watobaula umutondo, icakuti teti pabe no wakuulundinkanya nakabili iyoo. Na mu Tofeti mwine abantu bakulashiikamo abantu babo abakulafwa, pantu tabakulamona kumbi uko bakulabashiika.

english: This is what I will do to this place,” says the LORD, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.
translation: Efyo ine ndecita uyu musumba, na bantu bene abaikalamo. Ndeucita nga Tofeti.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”
translation: “Amayanda ya mu Yerusalemu, na mayanda ya bashamfumu ba muno calo ca Yuda, na mayanda yene yonse ayo bafutumwina ububani pa mitenge pakuti bulefutumukila ku fita fyonse fya mu mulu , apo batuulila ne milungu imbi imbi imituulo ya fyakunwa, ala yakakowela nga Tofeti.”

english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house, and said to all the people:
translation: Kanshi Yeremia epakufumako ku Tofeti, uko Yawe amutumine kukubila imbila yakwe. Awe aya iminina na mu lubansa lwamukati ulwa ŋanda yakwa Yawe, alaeba na bantu bonse

english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”
translation: ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli aletila ati, “Ine nalaletela uno musumba, ne mishi yonse iyaba mumbali, ifinkunka fyonse ifyo nasosele ukuleta, pantu imwe mwe bantu namutalama, tamulefwaya na kulaumfwa ifyo ine ndesosa.”

english: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.
translation: ufumine pa mpongolo imo iyo baleposako ifiinga, no kuya nabo ku mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu. Uko kwine eko uli nokuya bilila abantu imbila iyo ndi nokukweba ukubila.

english: Say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.
translation: Elyo ukasose auti, ‘Ala, umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe imwe mwe shamfumu sha muli cino calo ca Yuda, na imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu. Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli. Ine nalaswa ndete muli ino ncende icinkunka icakulawela na mu matwi ya bantu abakulaumfwako.

english: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,
translation: Icalalenga ukuti ncite ifyo, nico abantu bandi nabansangukila, nabakowesha ino ncende mukulalekela imilungu imbi imbi amalambo, imilungu iyo bashatala abeshiba, iyo ne fikolwe fyabo fishatalile afishiba, nangufye ishamfumu sha muno calo ca Yuda. Kabili baisushamo muli ino ncende umulopa wa bakaele,

english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.
translation: kabili nabakuulilamo Baali ifibumbili fye lambo ifyakocelapo abana babo nge lambo. Kabili ine na ku mano yandi tacatala acibako icakubapeela ifunde nangu icebo icakulaoca abana babo nge lambo.

english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, inshita imo yalafika ilyo abantu balaleka ukwita ino ncende abati, Tofeti, nangu umupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu. Ino ncende nomba bakulaita abati, Umupokapoka Wakwipailamo.

english: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.
translation: “‘Ni muno mwine emo ine nalaonawila amapange ya bena Yuda naya bena Yerusalemu. Ndeleka abalwani babo babacimfye mu nkondo, no kuleka bawile mu minwe ya bafwaya imyeo yabo. Ndeleka ifyuni ne finama fya mpanga efyo filelya ifitumbi fyabo.

english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
translation: Kabili uyu musumba ndeonaula icakuti bonse abakulapitapo baletiina no kulapapa pali fyonse ifyalauponena. Abakamona bakalawela no kuseka.

english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’
translation: Abantu abaikala muli uyu musumba, ine nalaleka balelya abana babo abaume na banakashi. Bakulalya na banabo kulwa kupelelwa ukwine kwine uko abalwani babo bakalenga basangwemo, pa nshita bakashinguluka umusumba pakufwaya ukubepaya.’”

english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
translation: Amashiwi yakwa Yeremia mwana Hilikiya, uwali umo pali bashimapepo abali mu mushi wa Anatoti mu citungu cakwa Benjamini.

english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
translation: Mona, pa bushiku bwa lelo ine nakulashika pa bantu ba mishobo,

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
translation: Elyo kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti, “Yeremia, bushe cinshi ico wamona?”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
translation: Yawe nao epa kunjasuka ati, “Ee, nifyo fine, walungika, pantu ine ndalolela pakuti mone ukuti ifyo nsosele fyafikilishiwa.”

english: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”
translation: Nakabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti, “Cinshi na cimbi ico wamona?”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
translation: Elyo Yawe nao anjeba ati, “Ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwine ekukafuma icinkunka icikesa ponena abantu bonse abekala muli cino calo.

english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
translation: Pantu nomba ine ne Yawe nalaita abantu aba mu shamfumu shonse isha ku kapinda ka ku kuso, efyasosa Yawe. Ishamfumu shabo cila imo ikesa teeka icipuna caiko icabufumu pa mpongolo ya musumba wa Yerusalemu, no kwisa shinguluka ilinga lyauko lyonse, no kushinguluka imisumba imbi iya mu calo ca Yuda.

english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
translation: Efyo nkapingula abantu bandi pa mulandu wa kubifya kwabo no kunsangukila, pakulafutumwina imilungu ububani, no kupepa utulubi uto abene baipangila.

english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
translation: “Nomba iwe ima ipekanye, kabiye no kubeba fyonse ifyo ine ndekukonkomesha. Tecakwesha ukubatiina iyoo, pantu ine kuti naisa kutiinya pa cinso cabo.

english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
translation: Mona, ubwa lelo nakucita ukuba umusumba we linga, kabili ukuba ulupanda lwa cela, kabili nge linga lya mukuba ilyakulwishanya ne calo conse, kukulwishanya ne shamfumu sha mu Yuda, pamo na bacilolo, na bashimapepo, na bantu bene kumo aba mu calo.

english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”
translation: Bakakulwisha lelo tabakakucimfye nakalya, pantu ine nakulaba nobe pakuti ndekupokololako.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia pa nshita Yosia umwana wa mfumu Amoni aleteeka icalo ca Yuda, mu mwaka walengele ikumi limo na itatu (13) apo abelele pa bufumu.

english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
translation: Nakabili Yawe alilandile kuli Yeremia pa nshita Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia ali pa bufumu bwakuteeka icalo ca Yuda. Elyo ukutula ilyo line alelanda kuli ena inshita ishingi, ukushintafye napo abena Yerusalemu basendelwe muli bunkole, mu mweshi walenga isano , mu mwaka walengele ikumi limo na umo (11) apo Sedekia mwana Yosia abelele pa bufumu bwakuteeka icalo ca Yuda.

english: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
translation: Imila 36:5-8

english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
translation: Na ine epakwasukapo nati, “Iyee we Yawe, awe ine nshaishiba kulanda, kabili ine ncilifye umwaice.”

english: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
translation: Lelo Yawe ena pakunjasuka atifye,

english: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
translation: Tecakwesha kulabatiina iyoo,

english: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
translation: Elyo kabinge Yawe atambika ukuboko, ankumya pa kanwa, anjeba nokuti,

english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the LORD’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
translation: Shimapepo Pashuri mwana Imeri ali kalinda mukalamba wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Nao alyumfwileko uko kasesema Yeremia alesobela ifi fintu.

english: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”
translation: Ine ndeumfwa uko abengi balenyamba,

english: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.
translation: Kwena we Yawe waba ku lubali lwandi,

english: But the LORD of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.
translation: We Yawe umwine wa fita, we upituluka mu cishinka ca bantu.

english: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
translation: Akwimbileni Yawe!

english: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
translation: Bube ubwatipwa ubushiku nafyelwepo.

english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.
translation: Natipwe uyo muntu uwasansamwishe tata apakalamba,

english: Let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,
translation: Uyo muntu kabefye nga ilya misumba,

english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.
translation: pantu uyo muntu tanjipaile mwifumo,

english: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
translation: Nga mulandu nshi ine nafyalilwe?

english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the LORD’s house.
translation: Kanshi Pashuri epakupuma Yeremia, amukaka ne minyololo, amubika na pa mpongolo yakwa Benjamini iyabela lwapa mulu wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.
translation: Ulucelo cilya Pashuri akakula Yeremia iminyololo, Yeremia nao alamweba ati, “Yawe takwinika iwe ishina lya Pashuri iyoo. Ishina lyobe ilyo akwinika lyakuti icakutiinya mpanga yonse .

english: For the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ‘Iwe Pashuri, ine nalaswa nkucite icakutiinya kuli we mwine na bacibusa bobe, wakulamonako na menso yobe uko abalwani bobe baleipaya bacibusa bobe bonse ku lupanga. Nalapeela icalo conse ica Yuda ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni, uukabasenda muli bunkole ku Babiloni, no kubepaya ku lupanga.

english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
translation: Nkaleka na balwani babo ukwisa tapa ifyuma fyonse ifyaba muli uyu musumba, na mu matuka yonse, na fyonse ifyamutengo ifyabamo, ne fyuma fyonse ifya shamfumu sha muno mu Yuda, ala fyonse bakesa fisenda no kufitwala ku Babiloni.

english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”
translation: Nobe wine Pashuri pamo no lupwa lobe lonse bakamwikata no kumusenda ku Babiloni. Uko kwine eko ukaya fwila, no kushiikwa pamo na bacibusa bobe bonse abo usesemena ifyabufi.’”

english: LORD, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.
translation: We Yawe, kanshi ine walimbepele,

english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because the LORD’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.
translation: Pantu lyonsefye ine nga ndelanda, awe ninshi ndepunda,

english: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
translation: Nomba nga nati, “Ine nshakulalumbula Yawe,

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
translation: Yawe alandile kuli Yeremia ilyo Sedekia atumine Pashuri mwana Malikia, na shimapepo Sefania mwana Maaseia, kuli Yeremia kukuya mwipusha abati,

english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says the LORD. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’
translation: Pantu nimpanga ukuti uyu musumba ine nshaupanye iyoo, ndeonaula. Ndelekela imfumu ya ku Babiloni pakuti eyo yoce uyu umusumba nakalya nakalya. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.”

english: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear the LORD’s word:
translation: “Nakabili kabiye kalande ku ŋanda yabufumu iya bena Yuda ukuti, umfweni amashiwi yakwa Yawe.

english: House of David, the LORD says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Davidi, ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain,’ says the LORD. ‘You that say, “Who would come down against us?” or, “Who would enter into our homes?”
translation: Ine ninkwalukila iwe we musumba wa Yerusalemu,

english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’”
translation: Nomba ine ne Yawe nkakulimuna ukulingana nefyo iwe ucita.

english: “Please inquire of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”
translation: “Mukwai, twipushisheniko kuli Yawe, pantu Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni natubushisha inkondo. Nakalimo Yawe kuti atucitilapo icipeshamano cakwe cimo pamo nga kale, no kulenga Nebukadinesa abwelelemo.”

english: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:
translation: Elyo Yeremia ayasuka ati, “Kebe Sedekia

english: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, ‘Ine ndebwesesha ifyanso fyabulwi ifyo fili mu minwe yenu, ifyo mulelwishishako imfumu ya ku Babiloni, pamo na bena Kaludea abashingulwike amalinga ya musumba. Ne fyanso fya fita fyakwa Sedekia nalafitulika umwina pakati ka musumba.

english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.
translation: Ne mwine nine nalamulwisha imwe ku kuboko ukwafunguluka kabili ukwamaka, mu bukali, mu cipyu no kufulwa ukukali nganshi.

english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.
translation: Bonsefye abaikala muli uyu musumba ine ndebepaya, abantu kumo kwine ne nama balefwa ku cikuko icabipisha nganshi.

english: Afterward,” says the LORD, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’
translation: Panuma ya ifi, ine nkapeela Sedekia imfumu ya calo cino ica Yuda, pamo na bacilolo bakwe, pamo pene na bantu abakapusukako ku cikuko na ku nkondo na ku cipowe, mu maboko yakwa Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni na mu maboko ya balwani babo, abalefwaya ukubepaya. Akabakomaula ku lupanga, takashepo nelyo umo nakalya, takabelelepo nelyo umo uluse nangufye ukulangulukilapo umo nakalya.’ Ifi efyasosa Yawe.”

english: “You shall say to this people, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Yeremia amashiwi na yambi ayakwebako abantu ayakutila, “Umfweni kuno. Ine ne Yawe ndefwaya pali ifi fibili imwe musalepo cimo, musalepo inshila iyalola ku bumi, atemwa musalepo inshila ibiye iyalola ku mfwa.

english: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.
translation: Onsefye uwaikala muli uyu musumba ali nokufwa ku nkondo, atemwa ku cipowe, nangu ku cikuko. Nomba onse uuleya cimba ku bena Kaludea balya bashingulwike uyu musumba, awe ena takafwe akaba nge citapwa ca mu nkondo, alepusukako umumi.

english: The LORD said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Kabiye ulungame kwisano lya mfumu iyileteeka icalo ca Yuda nokuya yeba iyi mbila iyakuti,

english: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yuda, mwilaloosha uufwile,

english: For the LORD says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.
translation: Pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe palwakwa Shalumu mwana Yosia, imfumu ya bena Yuda, uwali imfumu pa cifulo cakwa wishi Yosia uwafumine kuli ino ncende. “Ena takatale abwelela nakalya.

english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”
translation: Kulya kwine ku calo bamusendele bunkole, no kufwila eko akaya fwila. Cino calo takatale nakabili acishimpamo ilinso.”

english: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;
translation: Alishama umuntu uukuula isano lyakwe mu nshila ishishalungama,

english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.
translation: Alishama umuntu uutila ati,

english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
translation: Bushe, ukukuula iŋanda iya miti iya keda,

english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says the LORD.
translation: Abalanda na bapina alebaputwila bwino imilandu,

english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”
translation: Nomba amenso yobe no mutima obe

english: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Yawe asosa palwa mfumu Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia imfumu ya calo ca Yuda ukuti,

english: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”
translation: Ala akashiikwa nga punda,

english: ‘Hear the LORD’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.
translation: ‘Umfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe, we mfumu ya bena Yuda, we waikala pa cipuna cakwa Davidi, iwe pamo na bacilolo bobe, kumo kwine na bena Yerusalemu, abengilila pa mpongolo ishi.

english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.
translation: Kanine pa lupili lwa Lebanoni epo ulebilikisha,

english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.
translation: Yawe alikusokele iwe pa nshita wali ne shuko,

english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
translation: Icimwela cikolulula bakacema bobe bonse,

english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!
translation: Iwe we waikala mu ŋanda iyakuulilwa ne miti itali iya keda iyafuma ku Lebanoni,

english: “As I live,” says the LORD, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.
translation: Ilyo Konia mwana Yehoyakimu aleteeka icalo ca Yuda, Yawe amwebele ati, “Napalifye ine ne Mumi, iwe nangu wingabafye nge mbalaminwe yabufumu ku kulyo kwandi, ala kuti nakusotolako,

english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
translation: nkakuposa na mu minwe ya bantu abalefwaya ukukwipaya, balya bene bantu iwe utiinisha. Nkakuposa kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni na ku bashilika bakwe abena Kaludea.

english: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.
translation: Iwe pamo na noko ine ndemufwintila ku calo cimbi ico mushafyalilwamo, no kufwila imwe bonse babili eko mukafwila.

english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”
translation: Imwe tamwakatale amubwelela muli cino calo ico mufuluka ukubwelelako.”

english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?
translation: “Bushe kanshi ulya muntu Konia ali nge nongo iyitobeke, iyo baposele, iyo umuntu nelyo umo ashingafwaya, mwa? Nga nomba ena pamo na bamwane cinshi ico babafwintile mu calo ico bashaishiba?

english: O earth, earth, earth, hear the LORD’s word!
translation: “We calo, we calo, we calo we,

english: The LORD says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
translation: Ine ne Yawe ndemweba imwe ukulacita ifintu ifyalungama kabili ifyacishinka. Mulepokololako abantu abo incenjeshi shakantu shilecenjesha. Mwilacusha nangu ukucita ulukakala ku benafyalo nangu bakashiwa, nangu bamukamfwilwa, kabili mwilaipaya bakaele muli ino ncende.

english: The LORD says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.
translation: Nga mwalakonka bwino bwino ifyo ine ndemukonkomesha, awe ninshi bashamfumu abakupyana pa cipuna cakwa Davidi, pamo na bacilolo babo kumo kwine na bantu babo, bakulakonkanya ukulaingilila pa mpongolo she sano mu maceleta na pali bakabalwe.

english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says the LORD, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”
translation: Lelo nga mwakaana ukulambeela, ne Yawe ndemweba ukutila nalapa ukuti, napalifye ine, ili isano likabongoloka, pakashalafye ifitantala.’”

english: For the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.
translation: Pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe palwe sano lya mfumu ya bena Yuda.

english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
translation: Ine nkamutumina abakwisa monaula.

english: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this great city?’
translation: “Ilyo abantu ba mishobo iyingi bakalapitapo, bakalaipushanya abati, ‘Bushe kwena mulandu nshi walengele ukuti Yawe acite ifi kuli uyu musumba ukalamba?’

english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”
translation: Nabo elyo bakalaasuka abati, ‘Nico balya bantu balisuulile icipangano cakwa Yawe Lesa wabo, balepepa no kubombela imilungu imbi imbifye.’”

english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says the LORD.
translation: “Bakacimona bakacema abo abaleonaula umukuni wa bucemi bwandi no kuusalanganya nsale nsale.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;
translation: Pantu muli cino calo mwiswile abantu impulumushi,

english: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says the LORD.
translation: Yawe alesosa ati,

english: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.
translation: Na mu nshila mwine umo bapita mukatelela,

english: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
translation: “Ine ndamona ububi bwa bakasesema ba mu calo ca Samaria.

english: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”

Therefore the LORD of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita pali bakasesema ba mu Yerusalemu ati,

english: The LORD of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita pakweba abena Yerusalemu ati, “Ala imwe mwilaumfwako kufyo balya bakasesema balesesema, pantu bamupeela isubilo ilyabufi. Ifyo bamweba fyakwelenganyafye abene, te fintu ifyo ine mbeba iyoo.

english: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘The LORD has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’
translation: Balya bakasesema bakonkanyapo ukweba abantu abasuula ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ukuti, ‘Yawe asosa ati fyonse fikabafye bwino kuli imwe.’ Na bantu bonse abakonkelela ukumalala kwa mitima yabo ebo bena beba ukuti, ‘Takuli icibi icikamucitikila.’”

english: For who has stood in the council of the LORD, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?
translation: Pali balya bakasesema, tapaba nelyo umo uwaishiba inkaama shakwa Yawe nakalya. Tapaba nangula umo uwaumfwako nangu uwailuka amashiwi yakwe, tapaba nelyo umo uwakutikako nangu uwasakamanako kufyo Yawe asosa.

english: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.
translation: Ala icipyu cakwa Yawe cili nge cimwela icimine, cili nga kankungwe uuleshunda, akawila na pa mitwe ya bantu babi.

english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says the LORD.
translation: Eico ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli alesosa kuli bakacema abasunga abantu bakwe. “Namuleka umukuni wandi ukusalangana, tamuusakamene kabili mulekele ulelulumbafye. Ine nkamukanda pa mulandu wa bubifi mwacita,” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: The LORD’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.
translation: Icite 18:20

english: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.
translation: Yawe elyo asosa ati,

english: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
translation: Abeshiba inkaama shandi,

english: “Am I a God at hand,” says the LORD, “and not a God afar off?
translation: “Ine ndi Lesa uwaba mpanga yonse, ine nshaba mu ncende imofye yeka iyoo.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says the LORD. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says the LORD.
translation: “Umuntu teti abelame pamo apo ine ningafilwa ukumumona. Bushe imwe tamwaishiba ukuti ine nalikumana umulu ne sonde batiini?” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
translation: “Ine nalishiba ifilanda bakasesema abasesema ifyabufi mwishina lyandi. Basosa ukuti, ‘Ine nindota, ine nindota.’

english: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
translation: Bushe kwena balya bakasesema bakaleka lilali ukulabepa, no kulaelenganya ifintu mu mitima yabo?

english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.
translation: Bena batontonkanya ukuti ifiloto ifyo balondolola no kwebana, efikalenga ukuti abantu bakandabeko, nga filya fine ifikolwe fyabo fyalabile ishina lyandi no kulapepa Baali.

english: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says the LORD.
translation: Leka kasesema uulotelepo iciloto alondolole iciloto cakwefye, nomba kasesema uo ine njebelepo ishiwi lyandi leka asalanganye mu cishinka ishiwi lyandi. Bushe imisungu ne ŋanu nafilingana, mwa?

english: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says the LORD; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
translation: Bushe ine ishiwi lyandi talyaba ngo mulilo, nangu nge nondo iyitobaula ifimabwe?” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.
translation: “Ne mwine wine nine nomba nkakolonganya umukuni wandi uwashalapo, nkaufumya mu fyalo uko nausalanganishishe, nkaubweseshe na muno mwicinka lyauko. Uli nokusanda no kufulilako mu mpendwa.

english: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.
translation: “Kanshi nine ne Yawe nati ndelimuna balya bakasesema abebishanya amashiwi, no kulayasalanganya kwati mashiwi yandi.

english: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’
translation: Mona, ne Yawe ndelimuna bakasesema bene balya ababomfya indimi shabo elyo balelanda ukuti, ‘Ifi efyasosa Yawe.’

english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says the LORD, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says the LORD.
translation: Ine nimfulilwa bakasesema abasesema ifiloto ifyabufi,” efyasosa Yawe. “Balashimikilako abantu bandi ifiloto fyabo, no kubalufya ku bufi bwabo no kupusauka kwabo. Lelo ine tene nabatuma nangu ukubasonta, eico kanshi teti bacitepo nelyo cimo icakwafwilisha abantu,” efyasosa Yawe.

english: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from the LORD?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says the LORD.’
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele ati, “Umo mu bantu aba atemwa kasesema umo nangu shimapepo umo, nga akwipusha iwe Yeremia ati, ‘Bushe icisendo cakwa Yawe cinshi?’ Iwe mwasukefye auti, ‘Iwe wine niwe cisendo cakwa Yawe, no kukufuntula alaswa akufuntule panshi.’

english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ I will even punish that man and his household.
translation: Kabili nga cakuti kasesema, nangu shimapepo nangu umuntu uuli onse asosa ati, ‘Amashiwi yakwa Yawe, ala cisendo,’ ninshi ine nkamulimuna, nkalimuna na ba mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has the LORD answered?’ and, ‘What has the LORD said?’
translation: Ifi efyo mwakulalanda cila muntu ku munankwe nangu kuli munyina ifyakuti, ‘Bushe Yawe aswikepo finshi’ nangu ‘Bushe Yawe atilepo shani?’

english: You will mention the message from the LORD no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of Armies, our God.
translation: Eico nomba mwilabwekeshapo ukusosa amashiwi ayakuti, ‘Amashiwi yakwa Yawe, ala cisendo,’ pantu amashiwi ya muntu yene eyasanguka icisendo, eyalenga no kufulunganya amashiwi yakwa Lesa umumi, Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wesu.

english: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and, ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo mwakulalanda kuli kasesema amuti, ‘Bushe Yawe aswikepo finshi,’ nangu ‘Bushe Yawe atilepo shani?’

english: Although you say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ therefore the LORD says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from the LORD,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from the LORD,”
translation: Lelo nga mwalanda ukuti ifi efyasosa Yawe ifyakuti, ‘Amashiwi yakwa Yawe, ala cisendo,’ nomba pa mulandu wakuti mwalanda aya mashiwi ayakuti, ‘Amashiwi yakwa Yawe, ala cisendo,’ ilyo nalimwebele ukukanalanda,

english: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.
translation: cine cinefye ine nkesa bemya, nkabafwintila ukutali, uleke bakafume pa cinso candi. Bonse bene nkabafwintila ukutali kumo kwine no musumba wine, uyo ine nabapeele pamo ne fikolwe fyabo.

english: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says the LORD.
translation: Nkabika bakacema pakati kashiko abakalashisunga. Ninshi nomba tashakatale ashitiina nakabili nangu kututuma, kabili tapakalube nelyo imo.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”
translation: Kabili ine nkabasebanya, no kubaletela insoni isha pe, isho bashakatale abalaba nakalya.”

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati,

english: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: The LORD our righteousness.
translation: Ilyo yena ikaba pa bufumu,

english: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that they will no more say, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
translation: “Ee, ine ne Yawe ndesosa nati, inshita imo ikesa ilyo abantu pakulapa ine bakaleka ukulatila, ‘Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Umumi, uwafumishe abena Israeli mu calo ca Egupto.’

english: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”
translation: Pakulapa ine lyena bakalatilafye, ‘Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Umumi, uwafumishe aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso, na mu fyalo fimbi fyonse umo abasalanganisheko.’ Pantu nomba bakalaikalilafye nakabili mu calo cabo abene.”

english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD, and because of his holy words.
translation: Pa mulandu wa bakasesema asosa ati,

english: The LORD showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before the LORD’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
translation: Yawe alinangile imiseke ibili umwali amakunyu, neyo miseke yali pantanshi ye Tempele lyakwa Yawe. Ici cali panuma lintu Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni aikete Yekonia mwana Yehoyakimu, uwaleteeka icalo ca Yuda, pamo ne ntungulushi sha mu Yuda na balebasa ifyakubasabasa na balefula ifyakufulafula, ukubafumya mu Yerusalemu no kubasenda bonse muli bunkole ku Babiloni.

english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”
translation: Imila 36:10

english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
translation: Mu museke umo mwali amakunyu ayasuma nganshi, yalya yabangililapo ukupya. Nomba mu museke ubiye mwena mwalifye amakunyu ayabi nganshi, ayabola ayo umuntu ashingalya na kulya.

english: Then the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I said, “Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can’t be eaten.”
translation: Elyo Yawe anjipusha ati, “Yeremia, bushe finshi iwe wamona?”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kanshi ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, ‘Ndemona ukuti balya ine mfumishe muli cino calo ca Yuda, no kubatwala muli bunkole ku bena Kaludea , bali nga aya makunyu ayasuma.

english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
translation: Ine nakulabalinda no kubacitila ifisuma, kabili nkababwesesha na muli cino cine calo. Ine nkabakosha, nshakabonaule iyoo. Nkabalimba, nshakabanukule iyoo.

english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.
translation: Ine nkabapeela umutima wakwishiba ukuti nine Yawe. Elyo nabo bakaba abantu abandifye, na ine nkaba Lesa uwabofye, pantu bakabwelela kuli ine no mutima wabo onse.’

english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely the LORD says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
translation: “Elyo Sedekia imfumu ya cino calo ca Yuda, pamo na bacilolo na bashelemo mu Yerusalemu, abakashala muli cino calo pamo na bekala mu Egupto, bena ine ne Yawe nkabacitafye bonse nga aya makunyu ayabi, ayo umuntu ashingalya na kulya.

english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.
translation: Ine nkabaponesha ishamo ilyakuti likaletele na bantu ba mishobo yonse iya pano isonde umwenso. Abantu bambi bakalabashobola, bakalabawela no kulabasenteka. Na konsefye uko ine nkabasalanganishisha, bambi bakalabula ishina lyabo elyo bakalelumbula pakutipwila.

english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
translation: Ilyo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia ateekele icalo ca Yuda, mu mwaka walengele ine uwakuba pa bufumu, Yeremia alipokelele amashiwi kuli Yawe palwa bena Yuda bonse. Uyo wine mwaka ewali uwakubalilapo ilyo Nebukadinesa atampile ukuba imfumu ya ku Babiloni.

english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
translation: Utupundu twabo utwansansa no twakwanga, ine nkatupwisha. Nkapwisha ne nsansa sha bashibwinga na banabwinga, nkatalalika ne ciunda ca mabwe ayakupelelako, nkashimya no lubuuto lwa fisaniko fyabo.

english: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
translation: Cino calo conse calashala amatololo umwabula abakwilamo. Na bantu ba iyi mishobo yonse bakabombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni pa myaka amakumi cine lubali (70).

english: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says the LORD, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.
translation: Iyo myaka amakumi cine lubali (70) nga yapwa, elyo ine nkalimuna imfumu ya ku Babiloni kumo kwine na bantu ba ulya wine mushobo pa kubifya kwabo. Nkonaula cilya calo ca bena Kaludea no kucisha amatololo pe na pe.’ Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
translation: ‘Cilya calo nkacicita fyonse ifyo nacipangila, fyonsefye ifyalembwa muli ici citabo ifyo Yeremia aseseme palwa bantu ba mishobo yonse.

english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”
translation: Pantu abantu ba iyi mishobo nabo bene bakateekwapo ubusha ku bantu ba mishobo imbi iyingi na ku shamfumu ishikalamba, kabili nkabalimuna pakulinganya nefyo bacita nefyo bapanga abene.’”

english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.
translation: Ifi efyasosele Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli kuli ine ati, “Buula ulukombo ulu ululi mu minwe yandi ulo njiswishemo icipyu, kanweshemo abantu ba mishobo yonse abo ine nalakutumako.

english: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
translation: Ilyo balenwamo, bakulatalansuka, na mano yabo yalefulungana pa mulandu wa nkondo iyo nalababushisha.”

english: Then I took the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:
translation: Awe na ine napoka ulukombo mu minwe yakwa Yawe no kunwesha imishobo yonse iyo antumineko.

english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;
translation: Naya nweshamo abena Yerusalemu na bantu abaikala mu misumba yonse iya mu calo ca Yuda, kumo kwine ne shamfumu shabo na bacilolo babo bene, pakuti bonaike, bashale insansalila, pakuti bashale ifibolya, icintu icakutiinya, icakuwelwa no kutipwilako.

english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;
translation: Na bambi abo naile nweshamo ni Farao imfumu ya mu calo ca Egupto, na bacilolo bakwe, ne ntungulushi shakwe, na bena Egupto bonse,

english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:
translation: Kanshi Yeremia nao epakulabilila abena Yuda bonse na bena Yerusalemu bonse imbila iyakuti,

english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
translation: na benafyalo bonse abaikelemo. Kabili bambi ni bashamfumu aba mu calo ca Usi, ne shamfumu shonse ishali mu misumba ya mu calo ca Bafilisiti, emukuti imfumu ya mu Ashikeloni, ne ya mu Gasa, ne ya mu Ekironi, ne mfumu ya mu Ashidodi na bashelemo.

english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;
translation: Na bambi e bena Edomu bonse, na bena Moabu bonse, na bena Amoni bonse,

english: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
translation: ne ya mu musumba wa Dedani, ne ya mu musumba wa Tema, ne ya mu musumba wa Busi, nabalya bonse ababeya imisoso.

english: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
translation: Na shimbi ni shamfumu shonse isha mu Arabia, ne shamfumu shonse isha bantu ba mitundu yonse iyaikala mu matololo,

english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
translation: ne shamfumu shonse isha mu calo ca Simuri, ne sha mu calo ca Elami, ne sha mu calo ca Media,

english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.
translation: ne shamfumu shonse isha ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ishaba mupepi ne shaba ukutali kwine, ukulingana nomo shakonkanine. Abantu ba mishobo yonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse bali nokunwamo. Na pakulekelesha iyikanwamo ni mfumu ya ku Sheshaki, e ku Babiloni kwine.

english: “You shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’
translation: Sosa kuli bena auti, “Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli aleti, ‘Nweni, mukolwe no kuluka muleluka, musuke muwe, mufilwe no kwima pa mulandu wa nkondo iyo ine nalamubushisha.’

english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.
translation: Nga bakaana ukupoka ulukombo mu minwe yobe no kunwamo, iwe ubebefye ukuti ni Yawe umwine wa fita eusosele ukuti, ‘Ala, muli nokunwamofye!

english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of Armies.”’
translation: Moneni, apo ine ntendekelepo ukonaula umusumba uwitwa peshina lyandi, bushe imwe muletontonkanya ukuti mulepusukako? Awe nakalya, mukalimunwa, pantu ine ndeleta inkondo ku ba pano isonde bonse.’” Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the LORD’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.
translation: “Pa myaka amakumi yabili na itatu (23), ukutulafye mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na itatu (13) apo Yosia mwana Amosi atampile ukuteeka cino calo ca Yuda ukushintafye na lelo, Yawe alalanda kuli ine amashiwi ayo na ine nanda kuli imwe ifyo anjeba, lelo imwe mwalikaana ukumfwa.

english: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘The LORD will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
translation: “Iwe Yeremia uli nokusoka aba bantu pakusesema aya mashiwi yandi yonse ayo ine nandile. Uli nokweba aba bantu auti,

english: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says the LORD.”
translation: Iciunda ce shiwi lyakwe cikomfwika no kwapelela isonde,

english: The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”
translation: Kabili Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati,

english: The slain of the LORD will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.
translation: Pali ubo bushiku ifitumbi fya bantu abo Yawe alaswa epaye, fikalalafye ntangali ntangali ukuya shintafye no kwapelela isonde. Tapakamoneke no wakubaloosha, tapakamoneke no wakulonganya ifitumbi fyabo nangufye ukufishiika. Fyakulatulumanafye nge mina ya citindi.

english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.
translation: Yere 7:34

english: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.
translation: Abacemi tabakamone kwakubutukila,

english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for the LORD destroys their pasture.
translation: Umfweni ukukuuta kwa bacemi

english: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
translation: Ne calo icali icamutelelwe naconaulwa,

english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
translation: Yawe nafuma mu cifulo cakwe nge nkalamo,

english: The LORD has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),
translation: Imwe tamufwaya kumfwa nelyo ukuposako amano, nangu Yawe ena abikapofye ukulamutumina ababomfi bakwe bakasesema bonse.

english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”
translation: Mwilakonka imilungu imbi imbi nangufye ukulaipepa no kulaibombela. Mwilabilimuna ine umutima kulwa kupepa utulubi uto iminwe yenu yapanga. Na ine nshakamuletele ububi.’

english: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says the LORD, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”
translation: Lelo mwalikaana ukumfwa ifyo nsosa ne Yawe. Mwalimbilimuna umutima kulwa tulubi twenu uto iminwe yenu yapanga, utwalenga ukuti muiletelele mwe bene.

english: Therefore the LORD of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,
translation: “Kanshi nomba apo imwe mushifwaya kumfwa amashiwi yandi, ne Yawe umwine wa fita ndeti,

english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says the LORD, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
translation: ‘Ine nalaita abantu bonse aba ku kapinda ka ku kuso, nalaita no mubomfi wandi Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Nalaita abantu ba ilya mishobo pakuti bese basanse cino calo na bekalamo bene, bese basanse na bantu ba mishobo yonse iyaba mumbali yaciko. Nalabalofyafye nakalya nakalya no kubacita icakutiinya ne cakupapa kabili ifibolya ifya pe na pe. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:
translation: Ilyofye Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia ali pa bufumu ubwakuteeka icalo ca Yuda, ili shiwi lyafumine kuli Yawe aliti,

english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the LORD’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house.
translation: Bacilolo ba mu Yuda bati bomfwe ifi fintu, nabo bafuma kwisano, baya ikala na pa mpongolo ipya iyakwingililapo mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”
translation: Elyo bashimapepo na bakasesema balaeba bacilolo na bantu bambi bonse abati, “Uyu muntu nalinga ukupingula ukufwa, pantu ifyo alelanda, fyakupangilafye uno musumba. Nemwe bene namuyumfwila na matwi yenu.”

english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the LORD your God’s voice; then the LORD will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
translation: Kanshi imwe muli nokwalula imisango yenu ne micitile yenu, mulebeela na mashiwi yakwa Yawe Lesa wenu. Ninshi lyena Yawe akabwesha umutima, takamuletele icinkunka ico apanga ukumuletela.

english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
translation: Elyo ine, awe ndifye mu minwe yenu. Ncitenifye conse ico mulemona ukuti eciweme.

english: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”
translation: Lelo kwena mushininkishepo cimo icakuti nga mwanjipaya, ninshi imwe kumo kwine na bantu ba muli uno musumba mulekwatilapo umulandu uwakunjipaya ine ne wakaele, pantu ni Yawe euntumine ukwisa mweba imwe aya mashiwi mumfwile na matwi yenu.”

english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”
translation: Elyo bacilolo na bantu bambi baeba bashimapepo na bakasesema abati, “Uyu muntu kwena talingile kufwa iyoo, pantu pakwisa tweba alumbwile Yawe Lesa wesu ukuti cine cine eumutumine.”

english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,
translation: Elyo abakalamba bamo baima, balaeba abantu abalongenepo abati,

english: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “‘Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.’
translation: “Ilyo Hesekia aleteeka cino calo ca Yuda, kasesema Mika umwina Moresheti alyebeleko abantu bonse ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita fyonse aletila ati,

english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear the LORD, and entreat the favor of the LORD, and the LORD relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”
translation: “Hesekia uwaleteeka cino calo ca Yuda pamo na bantu bene tabaipeye Mika iyoo. Hesekia alitiinine Yawe, alamupapata no kumupapata pakuti amunakilishe. Na Yawe asuka abwesha umutima, akaana no kubaletela icinkunka ico apangile ukubaletela. Nomba ifwe tulefwayafye ukuiletelela fwe bene icinkunka icamaka nganshi.”

english: “The LORD says: ‘Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, keminine mu lubansa lwa mukati ulwa ku ŋanda yandi, na bantu bonse abaletula mu misumba ya muli cino calo ca Yuda, abaleisa kukupepa, ulebeba fyonsefye ifyo ine nakukonkomesha ukubeba. Tecakwesha ukushapo nangu cimo iyoo.

english: There was also a man who prophesied in the LORD’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
translation: Kwaliko no muntu umbi mwana Shemaia, ishina lyakwe ni Uria, uwafumine ku musumba wa Kiriati Yarimu, aliseseme pakusobela ishamo ilya uno musumba nelya bantu bene aba muli cino calo ngefyo Yeremia acitile.

english: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Yehoyakimu pamo na bashilika baiko bonse na bacilolo baiko bonse baumfwile ifyo Uria alandile, imfumu yafwaile ukumwipaya. Uria ena ati omfwe, aikatwa no mwenso, afulumukila na ku calo ca Egupto.

english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.
translation: Elyo imfumu Yehoyakimu yatuma Elinatani mwana Akibo pamo na bantu bambi ku Egupto, kukuya buula Uria.

english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
translation: Nabo baya fumya Uria mu Egupto, bamuleta na ku mfumu Yehoyakimu, nayo epakumwipaya no lupanga, yaposa ne citumbi cakwe mu nindi ya mu nshinshi ya bapabi.

english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
translation: Lelo Yeremia ena ishuko akwete nicofye alipo na umo uwakumusoselako, nao ni Aikamu mwana Shafani, eico ena tapeelwe ku bantu ukuti bamwipaye.

english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”
translation: Nalimo abantu kuti baumfwa, baleka ne misango yabo iyibi. Nga bacita ifyo, ine ninshi nkabwesha umutima, nshakabaponeshe icinkunka ico napanga ukubaponesha pa mulandu wa micitile yabo iyibi.”

english: You shall tell them, “The LORD says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,
translation: “Ubebe ukutila, ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ‘Nalamweba ifikacitika nga cakuti tamuleumfwila no kunakila amafunde yandi ayo ine namupeela,

english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”
translation: Kanshi nga tamulekonka ifi fintu balemweba, ninshi iyi ŋanda yandi iyakumpepelamo nkaicitafye nga filya fine nacitile ku Shilo. Kabili abantu ba mishobo pano isonde bakalabuula ishina lya uno musumba elyo bakalelumbula pakutipwila.’”

english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the LORD’s house.
translation: Bashimapepo na bakasesema na bantu bambi bonse balyumfwileko uko Yeremia alesosa fyonse ifi mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!
translation: Kutifye cilya Yeremia apwa ukusosa fyonsefye ifyo Yawe amukonkomeshe ukubeba, awe bashimapepo na bakasesema na bantu bene bambi baikata Yeremia, balapunda no kupunda abati, “Iwe ulefwa pali uyu mulandu!

english: Why have you prophesied in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in the LORD’s house.
translation: Cinshi ico iwe ulelumbwila ifi mwishina lyakwa Yawe, pakulalanda ukuti eukwebele ukuti ino ŋanda yakwe ikaba nga filya fyaba ku Shilo, nokuti uno musumba ukonaika ukashala amatololo, tamwakabe nelyo umo uukekalamo?” Abantu bonse epakushinga Yeremia mulya mwine mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Ilyofye Sedekia mwana Yosia atendeke ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda, ili shiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia.

english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.
translation: Ala imwe bamusesemenafye ifyabufi, kabili ebakaleka nokuti bambi bakese mufumyamo mu calo cenu, bakamutwale na kumbi kumbifye. Kwena ine nkamutamfyamo, no kuloba mukalobelapo.

english: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says the LORD; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”
I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
translation: Aya yene amashiwi yamo yene nalyebeleko imfumu Sedekia iyaleteeka icalo ca Yuda nati, “Iwe ala nakilafye imfumu ya ku Babiloni, akuibombela, ulebombela na bantu baiko, pantu lyena ninshi walaikala umumi.

english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
translation: Nga cinshi ico iwe pamo na bantu bobe mwingafwaila ukufwa ku nkondo, atemwa ku cipowe, atemwa ku cikuko? Pantu eifi fine fintu ifyo Yawe apanga ukuletela abantu ba mushobo onse uwakaana ukulabombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni.

english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.
translation: Iwe wilaumfwako kuli bakasesema abalekulesha ukubombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Ala fyabufifye balesesema kuli iwe.

english: For I have not sent them,” says the LORD, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”
translation: Yawe umwine ewasosa ukuti tewabatuma iyoo, bakubepafye pakulasesema mwishina lyakwe. E mulandu wine Yawe akakutamfisha muno muntu, no kukwipaila pamo na bakasesema abalekubepa mukusesema ifi fyonse.”

english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, the LORD says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of the LORD’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.
translation: Elyo kabili nalyebeleko bashimapepo na bantu bambi bonse nati, “Ifi efyasosa Yawe. Ala imwe mwilaumfwako kuli bakasesema benu abalemweba ukuti ifipe fya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe balaswa bafibweshe bwangu ukufuma ku Babiloni pantu bufifye balemubepa.

english: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?
translation: Mwilaumfwako mwe bantu mwe. Imwe akubombelenifye imfumu ya ku Babiloni, epakuti muleikala abomi. Nga mulandu nshi uno musumba wingasangukila amatololo?

english: But if they are prophets, and if the LORD’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of Armies, that the vessels which are left in the LORD’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.
For the LORD of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita alanda palwa inceshi no musambilo ne fyakutekapo ifipe na fimbipo ifyashele muli uyu musumba.

english: the LORD says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.
translation: Yawe anjeba ati, “Ipangile ikoli ku myando ne fimuti, no kulikakila mu mukoshi obe.

english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
