translation: Ifi fipe Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni tayafisendele ilyo yaikete Yekonia mwana Yehoyakimu imfumu ya bena Yuda, no kumusenda mu busha ku Babiloni ukumufumya mu Yerusalemu pamo pene na basambashi bakwe bonse aba mu calo ca Yuda na ba mu Yerusalemu.

english: yes, the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in the LORD’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:
translation: Kanshi imwe umfweni ifyo Yawe umwine wa fita Lesa wakwa Israeli alelanda palwa fipe ifyashalapo mu Yerusalemu mu ŋanda yakwe, ne fyashalapo mwisano lya mfumu ya mu Yuda na mu Yerusalemu.

english: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says the LORD; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”
translation: Ifyo fipe bakafibuula, bakafitwala na ku Babiloni no kwikala eko fikekala, ukushintafye napo ine nkafiposelako amano. Lyena elyo ine nkafibwesesha muno mu ncende. Efyasosa Yawe.”

english: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
translation: Elyo utume amashiwi ku mfumu ya ku Edomu, na ku mfumu ya ku Moabu, ne ya ku Amoni, ne ya ku Turi, ne ya ku Sidoni, ukupitila mu nkombe shashiko isho ishaishile ku Yerusalemu kukumona Sedekia imfumu ya mu Yuda.

english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:
translation: Ukonkomeshe inkombe pakuti shiye eba imfumu shabo ukutila, ‘Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli. Muye eba bakateeka benu aya mashiwi.

english: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.
translation: Ine ku maka yandi ayashaikulila na ku bulambafye bwandi, nine nabumba isonde na bantu ne nama ishaba mwisonde lyonse. Kabili ine kuti napeela onsefye uo ndefwaya ukupeela.

english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.
translation: Nomba nine wine mbuulile ifyalo fyonse ifi, no kufipeela ku mubomfi wandi Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Nine wine ndekele ne nama shine isha mpanga shilemubombela.

english: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo yonse bakulamubombela, bakalabombela na mwane wine umwaume, no mwishikulu wakwe wine, ukushintafye napo abantu ba mishobo yakwe bakacimbila. Elyo ninshi abantu ba mishobo iyingi ne shamfumu ishikalamba bakamucita umusha wabo.

english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says the LORD, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
translation: “‘Nomba abantu ba mushobo umo, atemwa aba bufumu bwa calo cimo, nga bakaana ukulabombela Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, nangufye ukulanakila amafunde yakwe, ninshi abantu ba uyo mushobo ine nkabalimuna pakubabushisha inkondo. Nkabaponesha icipowe, no kubaletela icikuko, elyo uyo mushobo nkaulofya ku kuboko kwakwa Nebukadinesa.

english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”
translation: Kanshi imwe mwilaumfwako kuli bakasesema benu, nangu kuli bakabuka benu, ku belula ifiloto atemwa ku fyakwipusha imipashi ya bantu abafwa, atemwa ku fyamalele yabofye, abamweba ukuti tamwakabombele imfumu ya ku Babiloni.

english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the LORD’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
translation: Muli uyo wine mwaka, emukuti mu mwaka walengele ine iya buteko bwakwa Sedekia ukuba imfumu ku calo ca Yuda, mu mweshi walenga isano, emo kasesema Hanania mwana Asuri, umwina Gibeoni, alandile kuli ine mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Ni pa cinso ca bashimapepo na bantu bambi bonse epo Hanania anjebele atile,

english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.
translation: Elyo Hanania akakula ikoli mu mukoshi wakwa Yeremia, alikontaula no kulikontaula.

english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “The LORD says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Cilya papita inshita apo Hanania akontawilile ikoli ilyali mu mukoshi wakwa Yeremia kasesema, elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘The LORD says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”
translation: “Kabiye kuli Hanania, no kuya mweba amashiwi ayakutila, ‘Yawe nasosa ukuti iwe walikwata amaka ayakukontaula ikoli lya fimuti, lelo ena alepyanikishapo ikoli lya cela.

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, asosa ukuti abantu ba iyi mishobo yonse alabakaka ikoli lya cela mu mikoshi yabo, uleke balebombela Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Nasosa ukuti ne nama sha mpanga shine nasho shakulabombela Nebukadinesa.’”

english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.
translation: Elyo kasesema Yeremia aeba Hanania ati, “Umfwa kuno iwe Hanania. Iwe Yawe tewakutuma iyoo, iwe ulelengafye ukuti aba bantu balesuminafye ifyabufi.

english: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against the LORD.’”
translation: Eico kanshi Yawe umwine alesosa ati, ‘Umfwa kuno. Nalaswa nkufumyepo mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse. Iwe walafwa muli uno wine mwaka, pantu niwe ulengele ukuti abantu batalamine Yawe.’”

english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
translation: Muli uyu wine mwaka, mu mweshi uwalenga cine lubali, awe kasesema Hanania afwa no kufwa.

english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, atile ati, ‘Ine ne Yawe nimputula ikoli lya mfumu ya ku Babiloni.

english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
translation: Pa myaka ibili ninshi nabwesesha muno calo ifipefye fyonse ifyafumine mu ŋanda ifyo Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni afumishe kuno no kutwala ku Babiloni.

english: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says the LORD; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”
translation: Na Yekonia wine mwana Yehoyakimu uwaleteeka cino calo ca Yuda, nao wine nkamubwesha pamo pene na bankole bonse abo bafumya muli cino calo ca Yuda no kubatwala ku Babiloni. Ala ine nimputula ikoli lya mfumu ya ku Babiloni. Efyasosa Yawe.’”

english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the LORD’s house,
translation: Elyo nao kasesema Yeremia alaeba kasesema Hanania pa cinso ca bashimapepo, na bantu bambi bonse abaiminine mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe ati,

english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the LORD do so. May the LORD perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.
translation: “Ameni , ala na ine wine kwena kuti natemwa. Ndetetekela ukuti efyo Yawe akacita. Ndetetekela ukuti Yawe akafikilisha fyonse ifyo iwe walanda, nokuti ku Babiloni akafumyako ifipe fyonse ifya mu ŋanda yakwe, no kufibwesesha muno calo pamo na bantu bonse abasendwa muli bunkole.

english: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
translation: Lelo kwena iwe Hanania umfwa ifyo ine nalakweba pamo pene na bantu bambi bonse abaleumfwako.

english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.
translation: Bakasesema abaliko ilyo ine na iwe wine tushilati tubeko, ala balisobele ukutula na ku kale ukuti kukaba inkondo, ne cinkunka, ne cikuko, ifikeshila ifyalo ifingi ifyateekwa ne shamfumu ishikalamba.

english: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.”
translation: Nomba kasesema uulesobela palwa cibote, pakushininkisha ukuti ni Yawe eumutumine, awe ena kanofye ifyo alesobela fyatala fyamoneka.”

english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,
translation: Kasesema Yeremia epakulemba kalata ukufuma mu Yerusalemu iyakuya ku bakalamba abashelepo pali bankole, na kuli bashimapepo, na kuli bakasesema, na ku bantu bonse abo Nebukadinesa aikete mu Yerusalemu no kubasenda muli bunkole ku Babiloni.

english: For the LORD says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
translation: Imila 36:10

english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
translation: Yere 25:11

english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
translation: Mukamfwaya, no kunsanga mukansanga, nga mwamfwaya ne mitima yenu yonse.

english: I will be found by you,” says the LORD, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says the LORD. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”
translation: Imwe mukansanga, na ine nkamubwesha muli cino calo cenu. Ine nkamufumya mu fyalo fyonse, na mu ncende shonsefye umo namusalanganishisha, nkamulonganika, nkamubwesesha na muli cino calo umo nalekele bamwikate no kumusenda muli bunkole.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: Because you have said, “The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”
translation: Imwe mwe bantu mulalanda ukuti uko kwine ku Babiloni mwalikwatako bakasesema abo Yawe amupeela.

english: the LORD says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe asosa palwa mfumu iyapyana pa cipuna cakwa Davidi, na palwa bantu abekala muli uno musumba, emukuti bamunyinenwe abashasendelweko muli bunkole nga imwe.

english: the LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.
translation: Cacine ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, “Ine nkababushisha inkondo, nkabaponesha icipowe no kubaletela icikuko, nkabasangulafye nga makunyu ayabola, ayo umuntu ashingalya nakalya.

english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
translation: Nkabemisha inkondo ne cipowe ne cikuko, kabili nkabalenga ukuba icakupapa ku fyalo fyonse ifya pano isonde, bakaba abatipwa, abakutiinya, abawelwa, kabili abasebana mukati ka mishobo yonse umo nkabasalanganisha.

english: because they have not listened to my words,” says the LORD, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says the LORD.
translation: Neci ni pa mulandu wakuti balikaana ukulakonka amashiwi yandi ayo ine nabikapofye ukulabeba,” efyasosa Yawe, “ayo mbatumina ukupitila mu babomfi bandi bakasesema.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),
translation: Alembele uyu kalata panuma ninshi imfumu Yekonia yalifuma mu Yerusalemu, pamo na nyina wa mfumu, kumo kwine na bamutungwi, ne ntungulushi sha mu calo ca Yuda ne sha mu Yerusalemu, na bantu abacenjela mu fyakubasabasa ne fyakufulafula.

english: Hear therefore the LORD’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
translation: Kanshi umfweni amashiwi yakwa Yawe imwe bonse mwe bankole mwebo nalekele bamwikate ukufuma mu Yerusalemu, no kumusenda ku Babiloni,

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.
translation: Imila 36:21

english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘The LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’
translation: Elyo abantu abo baikata mu Yerusalemu no kubasenda muli bunkole ku Babiloni, ilyo bakalatipwilapo umo, bena bakalatilafye, ‘Yawe iwe nakulimune nga filya fine alimwine Sedekia na Ahabu, abo imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaocele mu mulilo.’

english: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says the LORD.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti balicita ifyamusebanya mu Israeli, ukucita ubupulumushi na bakashi ba bena mupalamano, no kulabomfya ishina lyandi ukulanda amashiwi ayo nshabakonkomeshe. Nomba nalishiba, kabili nine kambone, efyasosa Yawe.”

english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,
translation: Eba Shemaia umwina Nelamu amashiwi aya.

english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita Lesa wakwa Israeli aleti, “Iwe Shemaia waitendekefye ukutuma kalata ku bena Yerusalemu bonse, na kuli shimapepo Sefania mwana Maaseya, na kuli bashimapepo bambi bonse, umo walembele auti,

english: “The LORD has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the LORD’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.
translation: ‘Yawe niwe Sefania abika pali bushimapepo, Yehoiyada ena alimusha, nomba niwe mubomfi mukalamba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe. Kanshi iwe waba no mulimo uwakumona ukuti ishilu lyonse ilileicita nga kasesema, iwe ulelikaka iminyololo, no kulibika mwikoli lya cela.

english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,
translation: Nga nomba cinshi ico iwe usha cilimina uyo Yeremia umwina Anatoti, uusesemena abantu kwati ni kasesema?

english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”
translation: Yeremia alilembela ifwe fwe bali ku Babiloni ukuti tukakokolako nganshi muli bunkole, eico tuli nokulakuula amayanda ayakwikalamo, no kulalima amabala, no kulalya ifyo tulelimako.’”

english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.
translation: Amaf 4:29

english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:
translation: Abasendele iyi kalata bali ni Elasa mwana Shafani na Gamalia mwana Hilikiya, abo Sedekia imfumu ya ku Yuda atumine kuli Nebukadinesa uwali imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Ne fyali muli iyi kalata fyali nifi.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia

english: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘The LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”
translation: ukutuma amashiwi kuli bankole bonse abali ku Babiloni, no kubebako amashiwi ayo Yawe umwine alandile pali Shemaia umwina Nelamu ayakutila, “Pantu Shemaia alemweba imwe amashiwi kwati ni kasesema nelyo tene namutuma nakalya, kabili ena nalenga nokuti imwe musuminefye ifyabufi,

english: therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says the LORD, “because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD.”’”
translation: eico ine ne Lesa ndetila, ala Shemaia nkamukanda, na bamwane bene nkabakandila kumo. Ena takashalepo no mwana nelyo umo uukasangwako kukushuukila ifisuma ifyo ine nkapeela abantu bandi, pantu ewasongelekanya abantu pakuti bansangukile.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita Lesa wakwa Israeli alesosa kuli bonse abo asendele ukufuma mu Yerusalemu no kubatwala na ku Babiloni, alemweba ati,

english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.
translation: “Mulekuula amayanda ayakwikalamo. Mulelima na mabala, no kulalya ifyo mulelima.

english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.
translation: Muleupana no kulafyala abana abaume na banakashi. Salileni abana benu abaume abakashana abakuti baleupana nabo, fwaileni na bana benu abanakashi abaume abakubopa, pakuti nabo balefyala abana abaume na banakashi pakuti mulesanduluka, mwilacepelako iyoo,

english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to the LORD for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”
translation: Kabili mulebombafye bwino imilimo iyakuwamya umusumba, uo ine namutwalako muli bunkole. Mulepepa kuli ine pakuti ine ndesenamina uyo musumba, pantu nga wakwata ishuko, nemwe bene ninshi e shuko lyenu.”

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
translation: Cacine ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita Lesa wakwa Israeli asosa ati, “Mwileka bakasesema na bakabuka abali pakati kenu ukulamubepa. Mwilaumfwa na ku filoto ifyo balota.

english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says the LORD.
translation: Bena bamwebafye ifyabufi ilyo basosa ukuti nine mbatumine. Ala ine nshabatuma nakalya.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.
translation: Kabiyeni ku cishi ca Saiprasi , muye imwena mwe bene,

english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.
translation: Bushe kwalitala akubako umushobo umo uwasangukilapo imilungu yabo,

english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says the LORD.
translation: Kanshi mwe myulu sungukeni,

english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.
translation: Imwe mwe bantu bandi mwalicita imilandu iyabipa ibili:

english: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive?
translation: “Bushe Israeli musha? Bushe afyelwe umusha?

english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.
translation: Abalwani balemubulumina nge nkalamo,

english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.
translation: Abena Memfisi pamo na bena Tapanesi,

english: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken the LORD your God, when he led you by the way?
translation: Imwe mwe bena Israeli,

english: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?
translation: Bushe finshi mwasangamo mukuya ku Egupto,

english: “Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing, that you have forsaken the LORD your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
translation: Ala ububi bwenu ebukamukanda imwe,

english: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
translation: “Kabiye uye ubile mu matwi ya bena Yerusalemu imbila yandi iyakuti, ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: “For long ago I broke off your yoke, and burst your bonds. You said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Israeli, ala ni kale mwafunine ikoli lyenu,

english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?
translation: Imwe namulimbile ngo mwangashi uwawamisha,

english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord GOD.
translation: Pantu nangu mwingasambila ne mito,

english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways,
translation: “Nga nomba imwe kuti mwakaana shani amuti,

english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.
translation: Imwe mwaba nga punda umukota uwa mpanga uwaishibila mu matololo,

english: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’
translation: Lelo imwe mwe bena Israeli mwileka kubutuka mpaka amakasa yenu yafuulwe indyato,

english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed— they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets,
translation: “Nga filya fine umupupu akwata insoni nga bamwikata,

english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’
translation: Mwe beba icimuti amuti, ‘Niwe tata,’

english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble, for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.
translation: Nge milungu yenu iya kwi,

english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Nga cinshi icilenga muleilishanya kuli ine?

english: Israel was holiness to the LORD, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says the LORD.”
translation: Mwe bena Israeli, mwali abantu abamushilo kuli ne Yawe,

english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
translation: “Naonawile amaka yandi pakukalipila abana benu,

english: Generation, consider the LORD’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?
translation: “Imwe mwe ba ino nkulo kutikeni bwino kwishiwi ine ne Yawe ndesosa.

english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
translation: Bushe umukashana kuti alaba ku fisamo fyakwe ifyakuyemfya,

english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.
translation: “Elyo kabili imwe mwalishiba bwino umwakusangila ifibusa fya pa mbali.

english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is because of all these things.
translation: Ifyakufwala fyenu fyalikantaana ku mulopa wa balanda abakaele,

english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
translation: ‘Awe ifwe tuli bakaele,

english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
translation: Nga cinshi ico imwe mufutukila bwangu bwangu?

english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won’t prosper with them.
translation: Nako kwine ku Egupto mukabwelako bulanda bulanda,

english: Hear the LORD’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!
translation: Kutikeni kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe, imwe bamwana Yakobo, mwe mikowa yonse iya mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli.

english: The LORD says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become worthless?
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: They didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’
translation: Tabaipwishe nokuti, ‘Nga Yawe ali kwi,

english: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
translation: Nasuka namufisha mu calo icafunda,

english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.
translation: Bashimapepo nabo ababula nokuti bepushe ati,

english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says the LORD, “and I will contend with your children’s children.
translation: “Kanshi ine namupeela umulandu nakabili, ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine ne Yeremia aliti,

english: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says the LORD. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
translation: “Kanshi Yakobo, we mubomfi wandi, wilatiina.

english: For I am with you, says the LORD, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
translation: Pantu ine nkaba nobe kabili nkakupususha, efyasosa Yawe.

english: For the LORD says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe,

english: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
translation: Takwaba nelyo umo uwakukupapatila iwe,

english: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.
translation: Abatemwikwa bobe balikulabako,

english: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
translation: Kanshi iwe wilailishanya palwa bucushi bobe,

english: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.
translation: Eico bonsefye abalekonaula,

english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says the LORD, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”
translation: Pantu ine nkaleka ubumi bobe bukapole,

english: The LORD says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.
translation: Yawe kabili aletila ati,

english: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
translation: Abantu abakekalamo bakalaimba inyimbo shakunumbanya,

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, ‘Fyonsefye ifyo ine nkweba, ufilembe mu citabo cimo,

english: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.
translation: Abana babo bakaba ngefyo bali kale,

english: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says the LORD.
translation: Mu mutundu wabo emukafuma uwakubateeka,

english: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.
translation: “Kabili mukaba abantu abandi,

english: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.
translation: “Moneni icimwela cakwa Yawe

english: The fierce anger of the LORD will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”
translation: Icipyu icikali cakwa Yawe tacakapwe

english: For, behold, the days come,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says the LORD. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”
translation: pantu inshita yalafika,’ efyasosa Yawe, ‘ilyo ine nalaleka abantu bandi abena Israeli na bena Yuda babwele nakabili. Nalababwesesha muli cino calo ico napeele ifikolwe fyabo, calaba nakabili icabofye.’ Efyasosa Yawe.”

english: These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
translation: Yawe alanda ku bena Israeli na bena Yuda amashiwi ayakuti,

english: For the LORD says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?
translation: Kanshi nomba taleni kutumaneni, mutontonkanyepo.

english: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it! It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.
translation: Yangu, ubushiku bwatoloto bwalaswa bufike,

english: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “Ubo bushiku ilyo bukafika, ine nkakontaula amakoli ayaba mu mikoshi yabo, kabili nkaputaula iminyololo, awe ninshi capwa tabakateekwe busha nakabili ku benafyalo.

english: but they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.
translation: Lelo bena bakalabombela ine ne Yawe, ne Lesa wabo, no kulabombela Davidi uo ine nkasonta ukuba imfumu yabo.

english: “At that time,” says the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Pali ilya nshita ine nkaba Lesa wa mikowa yonse iya bena Israeli, nabo bakaba abantu abandi.”

english: “Hear the LORD’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’
translation: “Imwe mwe bantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo,

english: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.
translation: Pantu ine ne Yawe nindubula bamwana Yakobo,

english: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of the LORD, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.
translation: Bakesa mukulaimba inyimbo shansansa pa lupili lwa Sioni,

english: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
translation: Elyo abakashana bakalacinda ne nsansa,

english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says the LORD.
translation: Bashimapepo ine nkalabekusha ifilyo ifishaiwamina,

english: The LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe aletila ati,

english: The LORD says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says the LORD. “They will come again from the land of the enemy.
There is hope for your latter end,” says the LORD. “Your children will come again to their own territory.
translation: Kanshi kuli subilo kuntanshi yobe,

english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are the LORD my God.
translation: Mateo 2:18

english: Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.’
translation: Panuma yakulubantika nalilapile,

english: The LORD says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says the LORD.
translation: “Bushe Efulemu te mwana wandi, kacele wandi,

english: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.
translation: “Bika ifishibilo ifyakwishibilako inshila,

english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”
translation: Bushe ukaleka lilali ukulashingashinga,

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘The LORD bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, aletila ati, “Ilyo ine nkabwesesha ukufuma muli bunkole bwabo abantu ba mu calo ca Yuda na mu misumba yaciko, bena bakalalanda nakabili abati,

english: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.
translation: Abantu bakalaikala muli cino calo ca Yuda mu misumba yonse iyabamo, pamo na balimi na bakacema abakalacemenamo ifitekwa fyabo.

english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”
translation: Pantu nkakoselesha abanakuka, nkekusha na bantu bonse abatembuka ku nsala.”

english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.
translation: Kanshi epakubuka mu tulo no kulolesha no tulo twandi twaliweme kuli ine.

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ndesosa ukuti, kukesa inshita imo ilyo mu calo ca Israeli neca Yuda nkesushamo ulubuto lwa bantu ne nama.

english: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says the LORD.
translation: Nga filya fine natekele umutima pakubanukaula, na pakubawisha, na pakubapasaula, na pakubonaula, na pakubashitila, efyo nkateka umutima na pakubasandulula na pakuba kosha pene. Efyasosa Yawe.

english: “In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
translation: Muli shilya nshiku, abantu tabakalelanda nakabili abati,

english: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
translation: Ku kale Yawe alemonekela Israeli akatalamukila,

english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.
translation: Lelo bonsefye abakalalya bamwelu ba myangashi, abo bene ebo ameno yabo yakalawa bonse. Umo umo bakalafwila palwa kubifya kwabo abene.”

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Moneni, inshiku shikesa ilyo ine nkapangana icipangano icipya na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli pamo na ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda.

english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says the LORD.
translation: Cena tacakabe nge cipangano ico napangene na bashibo, pa bushiku nabekete pa maboko pakubafumya mu calo ca Egupto. Bena balisuulile icipangano candi, nangu ine nali ngo mulume kuli bena.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the LORD: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
translation: “Lelo nomba ici e cipangano ico ine nkapangana na ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli ilyo isho nshiku shikapita, cena cikaba ifi. Ine ne Yawe ndesosa nati, nkabika amafunde yandi mu mano yabo, no kuyalemba mu mitima yabo. Elyo ine nkaba Lesa uwabo, nabo bakaba abantu abandi.

english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says the LORD, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”
translation: Takwakabe nangu umo uwakufunda umwina mupalamano munankwe, nangu uwakufunda munyina ati, ‘Ishiba Yawe,’ awe nakalya. Pantu bonse bakanjishiba, ukufumafye ku munono ukufikafye na ku mukalamba,” ifi efyasosa Yawe. “Pantu ine nkababelelako uluse ku fibi fyabo, ne fyabubifi fyabo ine nshalefibukisha nakalya.”

english: The LORD, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar— the LORD of Armies is his name, says:
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe uuleta akasuba

english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says the LORD, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: The LORD says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done,” says the LORD.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the city will be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.
translation: “Inshiku shikesa ilyo umusumba wandi onse ukakuulwa cipya cipya, ukutampilafye ku lupungu lwakwa Hananeli ukuya shinta na ku masamba ku mpongolo ya petungi.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.
translation: “Uko kwine ku masamba eko no mwando wakupiminako ukatula, ukaye na ku lupili lwa Garebu, ukalukile na ku Goa.

english: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.
translation: Nkankukuula nakabili, na iwe ukakuulwa,

english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to the LORD. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”
translation: Ulya mukonko onsefye uo baposamo ifitumbi ne fisoso, na mabala yonse ayaba ku mulu wa mukonko wa Kidironi, ukuya shintafye na ku mpongolo ya bakabalwe lubali lwa ku kabanga, fikapatwilwa kuli Yawe ukuba ifyamushilo. Umusumba tawakabale aubongololwa nangu ukonaulwa nakabili nakalya.”

english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.
translation: Ukalalima amabala ya myangashi nakabili

english: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to the LORD our God.’”
translation: “Ubushiku bumo bukafika ilyo bamalonda bakalapunda pa mpili sha mu calo ca Efulemu abati,

english: For the LORD says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’
translation: Kabili ifi efyasosa Yawe aletila ati,

english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.
translation: Moneni ine nkabafumya mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso,

english: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.
translation: Pakubwelela kuno, abantu bandi bakesa balelila,

english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
translation: Yawe alandile kuli Yeremia ili shiwi mu mwaka walengele ikumi apo Sedekia atampile ukuba imfumu ya calo ca Yuda, kabili e mwaka wine walengele ikumi na cine konse konse (18) apo Nebukadinesa atampile ukuteeka ku Babiloni.

english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.
translation: Nalemba na pali kalata ishina lyandi pakushininkisha umulandu, namupeta, naumapo ne nshimbi, naita na bakambone abakusangwako, awe napima ne ndalama pa cipimo.

english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;
translation: Elyo nabuula bakalata bonse babili abalipo ifyabukwebo bwesu, emukuti umo uwauminwepo inshimbi umwali icumfwano, elyo na kalata mubiye uwalipo amafunde palwa kushitishanya lelo ena tapetelwe iyoo,

english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.
translation: awe napeela bakalata bonse babili kuli Baruki mwana Neriya, Baruki wine e mwishikulu Maaseia. Namupeelela pa menso ya mufyala wandi Hanameli, na pa menso ya bakambone abalembelepo nabo amashina yabo pali bakalata ba fya bukwebo bwesu, na pa menso ya bena Yuda bonse abaikele panshi mu lubansa.

english: “I commanded Baruch before them, saying,
translation: Elyo pa menso yabo bonse naeba Baruki nati,

english: the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, ‘Nakupeela icebo icakubuula uyu kalata ominwepo inshimbi uwa bukwebo bwesu no kubuula kalata mubiye ushapetwa uulembelwepo fimo fine, no kuya babika mu kamutondo ke bumba pakuti bakasungwe pa nshita iyitali.’

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.’
translation: Pantu Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli nasosa ukuti, ‘Amayanda, ne filime, na mabala ya myangashi, fikalashitwa nakabili muli cino calo.’”

english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,
translation: Ilyo ine napwile ukupeela Baruki mwana Neriya bakalata ba fya bukwebo bwesu, nalilumbenye Yawe nati,

english: “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.
translation: “We Imfumu Yawe, niwe wabumba imyulu ne calo ku maka yobe na ku bulamba bobe ubushaikulila, iwe tapaba cakukwansha iyoo.

english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, the LORD of Armies is your name:
translation: Ulabelela abantu amakana na makana uluse, lelo kwena ulalimuna abantu pa mulandu wa kubifya kwa bashibo. Iwe uli Lesa Mukulu, kabili uli Lesa Wamaka, ne shina lyobe niwe Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;
translation: Ifyo iwe upanga ukucita, ala fyakupapa, nefyo iwe ucita, ala fyamaka. Iwe ulamonafye fyonse ifyo abantu bacita, kabili ulabalinganya bonse umo umo pa miikalile yabo na pa micitile yabo.

english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.
translation: Pali iyo ine nshita ninshi ifita fya mfumu ya ku Babiloni nafisansa umusumba wa Yerusalemu, na kasesema Yeremia ninshi balimwisalila kwisano mu lubansa lwa bakalinda ulwali kwisano lya mfumu ya mu Yuda.

english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;
translation: Niwe wacitile ifipeshamano ne finjelengwe mu calo ca Egupto. Na nombaline ucili uleficita ukushinta na pali buno bushiku bwine ku bena Israeli, na ku bantu ba mishobo imbi yonse, icakuti nomba no kwishibikwa nawishibikwa mpangafye yonse.

english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
translation: Pakufumya abantu bobe abena Israeli mu Egupto, wacitile ifishibilo ne fipeshamano, ku bulamba bobe na ku kuboko kobe ukwafunguluka, no kutiinya ukukalamba nganshi.

english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translation: Niwe wabapeele ne calo cino icikankala kabili icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci, nga mulya mwine walaile bashibo.

english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.
translation: Nomba ilyo baishile muli cino calo no kucipoka, bena balikene ukulakuumfwa, balakaana no kulakonka amafunde yobe. Pafyo wabakonkomeshe ukulacita, tabacitilepo nelyo cimo. E mulandu wine walenga nokuti ubaponeshe ifi finkunka fyonse.

english: “Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.
translation: “Tepapa nomba abena Kaludea nabatulamika ifimina fya maloba ukushinguluka umusumba pakuti baupoke, no kusansa nabausansa. Inkondo ne cipowe ne cikuko efyalalenga ukuti umusumba upokwe ku bena Kaludea abeshile mukuusansa. Nauimwena we Mfumu ukuti fyonsefye ifyo wasosa, awe nomba fyafikila.

english: You have said to me, Lord GOD, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”
translation: We Mfumu Yawe, niwe unkonkomeshe ukushita ibala pa menso ya bakambone, nangu kwena abena Kaludea balaswa bapoke uno musumba.”

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?
translation: “Mona, ine nine Yawe, Lesa wa bantu bonse. Tapaba nangu cimo ico ine ningafilwa ukucita.

english: Therefore the LORD says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.
translation: Kanshi ine ne Yawe efyo nsosa. Nalabuula uno musumba, mpeele Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, ku bena Kaludea, ebalaupoka.

english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.
translation: Abena Kaludea abalelwisha uno musumba, balaisa oca. Balaisa ocela kumo kwine na mayanda ayo abantu bandi bankalifishamo umutima pakulafutumwina Baali ububani pa mitenge yayako, no kulatuulilapo imilungu imbi imbi imituulo ya fyakunwa.

english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;
translation: Imfumu Sedekia emo yamufungilile ilyo yamusangile no mulandu uwakusesema no kubila mbila ukuti Yawe nasosa ati, “Ine nalaswa mpeele uno musumba mu minwe ya mfumu ya ku Babiloni, no kupoka ikesa upoka.

english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says the LORD.
translation: Umutundu wa bena Israeli na bena Yuda tabacitapo ifintu fimbi kanofye ukucita ifibi pa cinso candi ukufuma ku bwaice bwabo. Abena Israeli ine balankalifya umutima pa mulandu wa tulubi uto bapanga ne minwe yabo. Efyasosa Yawe

english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,
translation: Uno musumba walinkalifya umutima no kundetela icipyu ukutulafye apo wakuulilwa. Ine nomba mpangilefye ukuonaula,

english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translation: pa mulandu wa fibi fyonse ificitwa na bena Israeli na bena Yuda ifyankalifya umutima. Abaficita ni bashamfumu babo na bacilolo babo, na bashimapepo babo na bakasesema babo, na bantu ba muli cino calo ca Yuda, na bena Yerusalemu bene.

english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.
translation: Aba bantu ine balimfutatila, bakaana no kundolesha. Nangu ine nabikapofye ukulabafunda, awe bena bakaanininafye ndai ukulaŋumfwa no kuleka imisango yabo iyibi.

english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
translation: Na mu ŋanda yakumpepelamo iye shina lyandi iyo bankuulila, namo mwine balibikamo utulubi utwabunani, no kuikowesha balikowesha.

english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”
translation: Mu mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu balikuulilamo Baali ifibumbili fye lambo, apakocela abana babo abaume na banakashi pakulabatuula ilambo ku mulungu Moleki. Ine nshabapeela cebo cakucita ifi iyoo, kabili tacatala acisa na mu mano yandi, icakuti ntontonkanye ukuti aba bantu kuti bacitapo icintu cabipisha ifi, no kulenga abena Yuda balebifya.”

english: Now therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”
translation: Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, alisosele ati, “Yeremia, iwe naweba abantu ukuti inkondo ne cipowe ne cikuko efyalalenga ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni ipoke uno musumba, lelo kwena umfwa kuno ifyo ine nalalanda.

english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.
translation: Ine nkalonganya abantu, nkabafumya mu fyalo fyonse umo nabaposele cipyu cipyu kabili cikali cikali. Nkababwesesha kuno kwine, no kuleka bakaleikalila ku matwi tondolo.

english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation: Lyena bakalaba abantu abandifye, na ine nkalaba Lesa uwabo.

english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.
translation: Nkalenga bakalefwayafye no mutima umo icintu cimo ceka mu miikalile yabo, emukuti icakulankwatila akatiina lyonsefye, neci cintu cikalabawamina abene, cikalawamina na bana babo abakalabakonkapo.

english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;
translation: Nokuti Sedekia imfumu ya cino calo ca Yuda takamone pakupusukila ku bena Kaludea . Akaposwa ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni, bakashimpana nayo amenso, no kulanda nayo pa kanwa.

english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.
translation: Ine nkapangana nabo icipangano ca pe icakutila, ine nshakatale ndeka ukulabacitila ifisuma. Nkalenga nokuti bakalenkwatila akatiina mu mitima yabo, epakuti nabo bekatala abansangukila nakabili.

english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”
translation: Ine nkalasansamuka pakubabombela ifisuma, nkabika umutima wandi onse no mweo wandi onse pakubateeka muli cino calo, pakuti emo bakaleikalilila pe.”

english: For the LORD says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.
translation: Ici ecasosa Yawe ukutila, “Ngefi fine ndetele aba bantu ishamo ilishaikulila, efyo nkabaletela ne fintu fyonse ifisuma ifyo ine mbalaile.

english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’
translation: Iwe Yeremia nusosa ukuti cino calo cikaba nga matololo umushaikala bantu nangufye inama, nokuti abena Kaludea ebalacipoka, ee, lelo kwena amabala yakalashitwa nakabili muno muntu.

english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says the LORD.
translation: Abantu bakalayashita, na pali bakalata bakushitilapo abantu bakalalembapo amashina yabo pakushininkisha umulandu, bakalata bakalapetwa no kulaumwapo ne nshimbi, na bakambone nabo bakalalembapo amashina yabo. Noyu musango ukulacitika mu citungu ca bena Benjamini, na mu mishi iyashinguluka Yerusalemu, na mu misumba iya muli cino calo ca Yuda, na mu mishi ya mu calo ca mpili, na mu mishi ya mwishika lya mpili, na mu mishi ya mu matololo ya Negebu mwine, pantu ine nkabwesesha abantu ishuko muli cino calo cabo.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says the LORD, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”
translation: Nokuti Sedekia bakamusenda ku Babiloni, no kwikala eko akekala ukushintafye napo ine ne Yawe Lesa nkamukandila. Nangufye alwishe shani abena Kaludea, ala nakalya aleicushafye. Efyasosa Yawe.”

english: Jeremiah said, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Yeremia nao alilandile ati, “Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine

english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”
translation: ‘Hanameli mwana Shalumu nokolume alaswa ese uko uli, kukwisa kwipusha pakuti niwe ushite ibala lyakwe ilyo akwata ku Anatoti, pantu niwe wakwata ne nsambu yakulishita.’”

english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to the LORD’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “Then I knew that this was the LORD’s word.
translation: Ne cacine ukulinganafye nomo Yawe anjebele, awe na umufyala wandi aisa umo ndi mu lubansa lwa bakalinda, anjeba ati, “We, shita ibala lyandi lilya nakwata ku Anatoti mu citungu ca bena Benjamini, pantu iwe uli munyinanefye pakati, kabili niwe wakwata ne nsambu yakulishita ne yakulisunga. Ale shitafye.”

english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
translation: Kanshi na ine epakushita ibala kuli Hanameli umufyala wandi, namulipila ne ndalama isho ampingwile, indalama amashekeli ya silifa ikumi limo na cine lubali (17).

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,
translation: Ilyo Yeremia acili mu cifungo mu lubansa lwa bakalinda, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe yalimwishile umuku wacibili.

english: The LORD says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Cino calo abantu batila cili nga matololo umushikala abantu nangufye inama. Kwena ca cine, mu misumba ya muli cino calo ca Yuda, na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu, tamulemoneka muntu nangufye inama nakalya. Lelo muli ishi ncende shonse mukalaumfwika nakabili

english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Armies, for the LORD is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into the LORD’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says the LORD.
translation: utupundu twakwanga no twansansa. Mukalaumfwika na mashiwi ya bashibwinga na ya banabwinga. Ilyo abantu bakalaleta ku ŋanda yandi imitulo yakutotela, amashiwi yabo yakalaumfwika ilyo bakalaimba abati,

english: The LORD of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
translation: Kabili Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Muli cino calo icili nga matololo umushikala bantu nangufye inama, ala mu misumba yonse yaciko mukaba nakabili umulemfwe umwakuti bakacema bakalecemena impaanga shabo.

english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says the LORD.
translation: Imila 5:13

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati, “Inshiku shikesa ilyo ine nkafikilisha icilayo ico nalaile aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda.

english: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
translation: “Muli shilya shine nshiku na pali ilya ine nshita

english: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: The LORD our righteousness.”
translation: Shilya nshiku nga shafika, ninshi abena Yuda balubuka,

english: For the LORD says: “David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.
translation: Pantu ine ne Yawe nalaya ukuti pefye kukalaba mwana Davidi umo uwakuteeka nge mfumu ya ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli,

english: The Levitical priests won’t lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”
translation: kabili pefye kukalaba bashimapepo abena Levi abakwiminina pa cinso candi, no kulantuula amalambo ayakoca ne mitulo ya cabunga na malambo yambi yonse.”

english: The LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “The LORD who does it, the LORD who forms it to establish it—the LORD is his name, says:
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe uwapangile isonde, Yawe uwalibumbile nokulibika apo lyaikala, Yawe e shina lyakwe.

english: “The LORD says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time,
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ‘Nga cakuti kuti mwaonaula icipangano candi ku kasuba ne cipangano candi ku bushiku, pakuti akasuba no bushiku fileke ukulabombela pa nshita yafiko,

english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.
translation: ninshi ne cipangano candi no mubomfi wandi Davidi kuti caonaika, na mwane umwaume uwakumupyana pa bufumu akabula, ne cipangano napangene na babomfi bandi bashimapepo naco cine cikonaika.

english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”
translation: Ine nkafusha nganshi abana ba mubomfi wandi Davidi, na bashimapepo abena Levi abamombela, icakuti limbi pakubapenda cikabafye kwati muntu uuleeshako ukupenda intanda sha mu mulu, nangufye umusensenga wa mu lulamba lwa bemba.’”

english: The LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has the LORD cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”
translation: “Bushe iwe tauleumfwa ifilelanda abantu ukuti ine ne Yawe nindekelesha abena Israeli na bena Yuda, ishi ndupwa shibili isho ine nasalile? Ecilengele nokuti basuule abantu bandi, baleke no kulabamona ukuti nabo mushobo umo uwa bantu.”

english: The LORD says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Mbula kupanga ukucita icipangano ku kasuba no bushiku, no kupeela ifyebo ifyakuti isonde no mulu filekonka,

english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.”
translation: ninshi nkakaana bamwana Yakobo no mubomfi wandi Davidi. Ine nshakasalepo mwana Davidi nelyo umo uwakuti akaleteeka bamwana Abrahamu na bamwana Isaki na bamwana Yakobo. Pantu nkabweseshapo ishuko ku bantu bandi, kabili nkalababelelako no luse.”

english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
translation: Lilila kuli ine, na ine ndekwasuka, ndekwebako imilandu ikulu kabili iyankaama, iyo iwe ushaishiba.

english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:
translation: Pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli pa mulandu wa mayanda aya muno musumba elyo na ya kwisano lya mu Yuda ayo babongolola pakuipokololako ku babumbilika umushili kwilinga na ku bamulwisha ku lupanga.

english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,
translation: Abena Kaludea balaisa mukulwisha uno musumba balaisa isushamo ifitumbi fya bantu abo ndi nokwipaya ku bukali ne cipyu candi. Ndi nokufisa icinso candi kuli uno musumba pa mulandu wa fyabubifi ficitikamo.

english: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.
translation: “Lelo kwena nkaundapa no kubweseshamo ubumi. Nkondapa abantu bauko, nkabaletela icibote, no kuleka bakaleikala mu mutelelwe uwine wine.

english: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first.
translation: Nkabweseshamo ubunonshi mu calo ca Yuda na mu calo ca Israeli, nkalenga fikabukuluke, fikabe nga filya fine fyali kale.

english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.
translation: Abantu nkabasangulula ku fyabubifi fyabo ifyo babifishe kuli ine, nkababelelako uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo na kuli bucisanguka bwabo.

english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”
translation: Kabili uno musumba wa Yerusalemu ukalandetela insansa, no malumbo, no mucinshi. Na bantu ba mishobo yonse pano isonde bakalatiina no kulatutuma ku mwenso, ilyo bakalaumfwa ifintu fisuma ifyo nkalacitila abena Yerusalemu, ne shuko ilyo nkaletela uno musumba.”

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:
translation: Amashiwi yakwa Yawe ayaishile kuli Yeremia, ilyo Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni pamo ne fita fyakwe, ne fita fya fyalo fyonse fintu Nebukadinesa aleteeka na bantu ba mishobo yonse abo anashishe balelwisha umusumba wa Yerusalemu pamo pene ne misumba iyali mumbali.

english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,
translation: Kanshi abantu bonse pamo ne ntungulushi shabo abapangile ici cipangano epakusuminishanya ukulekamo mu basha babo abaume na banakashi, basuminishanya no kukanabateeka nakabili ubusha. Awe baumfwa, babapeela no buntungwa.

english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
translation: Nomba kabili panuma bapilibuka, bababwesha, babapatikisha no kubwelela nakabili mu busha.

english: Therefore the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying:
translation: “Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli, asosa ati, ‘Ine nalipangene icipangano na bashinwe ilyo nabafumishe mu calo ca Egupto no kubalubula mu busha. No kubeba ine nalibebele ukuti,

english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.
translation: mu mwaka walenga cine lubali, cila umo pali imwe afwile ukupeela ubuntungwa ku Muhibulu munankwe uwaishitishe mu busha kuli bena. Panuma yakubomba imyaka mutanda, mufwile mwamulekako aya. Lelo bashinwe tabaumfwile kuli ine nangu ukubeela amashiwi yandi nakalya.

english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;
translation: Ni nombaline mwalapile no kucita icalungama pa cinso candi. Mwalisuminishenye no kubilisha ukupeela Abahibulu banenu ubuntungwa, neci cipangano mwacicitile pa menso yandi mu ŋanda yandi iyo imwe mwankuulila.

english: but you turned and profaned my name, and every man caused his servant and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return. You brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.’”
translation: Nomba kabili mwaisa futuka, no kusuula ishina lyandi. Imwe bonse mwalibwesha abasha benu abaume na banakashi abo mwapeele ubuntungwa bwakuya konse uko balefwaya. Nomba namubapatikisha ukuti babwelele mu busha nakabili.

english: Therefore the LORD says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says the LORD, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:
translation: Lelo aba bantu balisuula ici cipangano ico bacitile pa cinso candi, bakaana no kucikonka. Kanshi na ine nomba nkacita aba bantu ngefi fine bacita cilume wa ŋombe uo baputula no kulapita pakati ka fipimfya fibili.

english: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.
translation: Bacilolo ba muli cino calo ca Yuda na ba mu Yerusalemu, na bamutungwi ba kwisano na bashimapepo, na bantu bonse aba muli cino calo, balipangana icipangano, na pakucicita balepita pakati ka fiputulwa fibili ifya cilume wa ŋombe uo bepaya no kumuputula pakati.

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, the LORD says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.
translation: Ifi efyo asosa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, “Kabiye kuli Sedekia imfumu ya Yuda, no kuya mweba amashiwi ayakuti, ‘Ine ne Yawe ndeleka imfumu ya ku Babiloni ipoke uno musumba, no kuoca.’ Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.
translation: Ine nkabaposa mu minwe ya balwani babo abafwaya ukubepaya. Ifyuni ne fiswango efikalya ifitumbi fyabo.

english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.
translation: Sedekia imfumu ya cino calo ca Yuda pamo na bacilolo bakwe, ine nkabaposa mu minwe ya balwani babo abafwaya ukubepaya. Ine nkabaposa ku fita fya mfumu ya ku Babiloni, ifitalile filekele ukulamulwisha.

english: Behold, I will command,” says the LORD, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
translation: Ine nkafipeela icebo, no kwisa kabili fikeshilila uno musumba. Fikesa usansa, fikaupoke, no kuoca ku mulilo. Imisumba ya muli cino calo ca Yuda ine nkaicita kwati matololo, tamwakekale muntu iyoo. Nine ne Yawe nalanda.’”

english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’
translation: ‘Nobe wine Sedekia tawapusukeko kuli Nebukadinesa. Uleikatwa, uleposwa na kuli Nebukadinesa. Uli nokuloleshanya amenso nankwe, no kulanda nankwe pa kanwa, elyo uli nokuya na ku Babiloni.

english: “Yet hear the LORD’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah. The LORD says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.
translation: Lelo, we mfumu Sedekia, umfwa ifyo ine ne Yawe ndelanda pali iwe. Iwe tawafwe ku nkondo iyoo.

english: You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says the LORD.”
translation: Iwe ukafwafye imfwa iyamutende. Kabili nga filya fine abantu balefutumuna ububani pakushiika ifikolwe fyobe ifyakutangilile pa bufumu, efintu nobe wine bakakufutumwina ububani pakukushiika. Pakukuloosha abantu bakalalila abati, “Oowe we mfumu yesu washa watuposa ee.”’ Ee, nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
translation: Kanshi nao kasesema Yeremia epakuya mu Yerusalemu, aya eba na Sedekia imfumu ya calo ca Yuda aya yene mashiwi yonse,

english: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.
translation: ninshi pali iyo ine nshita ne fita fya mfumu ya ku Babiloni filelwisha no musumba. Ifita fyaiko fimbi ninshi nafyo filelwisha Lakishi na Aseka, pantu nayo e misumbafye ibili iyamalinga iyashelepo mu calo ca Yuda.

english: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,
translation: Kabili Yawe alisosele kuli Yeremia, ilyo imfumu Sedekia yapangene na bena Yerusalemu bonse pakuti bapeele abasha babo ubuntungwa.

english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.
translation: Sedekia aumfwana nabo ukuti umuntufye onse ali nokupeela Umuhibulu munankwe ubuntungwa, emukuti Umuhibulu umusha umwaume atemwa umwanakashi, epakuti peshala nelyo umo uwakuteeka Umuyuda munankwe ubusha.

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,
translation: Ilyo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia ateekele icalo ca Yuda, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
translation: Ifwe twikalafye mu matenti. Ifwe tulabaka nganshi amashiwi yonse ayo icikolwe cesu Yonadabu atukonkomesha.

english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”
translation: Nomba ili Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni aishile kukulwisha cino calo, elyo twapingushenye ukwisa muno Yerusalemu, pakufulumuka ifita fya bena Kaludea ne fya bena Siria. Kanshi e mulandu wine ulengele ukuti twise twikale muno Yerusalemu.”

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says the LORD.
