translation: “Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli asosa ati, ‘Kebe abaume abena Yuda na bantu ba mu Yerusalemu ukuti, bushe tamwasambilileko nangu cimo pakuti mwambe ukulabeela amashiwi yandi, efyasosa Yawe.

english: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.
translation: Mwamona, bamwana Yonadabu mwana Rekabu balisunga icebo icakukananwa umwangashi, no kunwa tabanwa ukushinta na lelo, pantu balanakila icebo ico shibo abakonkomesha. Lelo imwe tamumbeela nakalya, nakansha ine ne wabikapofye ukulamweba ukwabula no kutendwa.

english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them. Then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers;’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.
The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’
translation: Tamumwene, aba mu lupwa lwakwa Yonadabu mwana Rekabu bena balasunga icebo ico cikolwe cabo cabapeele, nomba imwe tamufwaya kulambeela ine nakalya.

english: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”
translation: Kanshi ine ne Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita, ne Lesa wakwa Israeli, ndeti umfweni. Imwe mwe bena Yuda, na imwe bonse mwe bekala mu Yerusalemu, nkamuponesha ifinkunka fyonse ifyo nasosele ukuti nkacita. Neco nkacitila ifyo, nico ine natila ntinti ukulamweba, awe imwe tamumfwa, kabili tamunjasuka nakalya ilyo ine mwita.’”

english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’
translation: Nomba Yeremia epakweba aba mu lupwa lwakwa Rakebu ukuti, “Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, asosa ati, ‘Pa mulandu wakuti imwe mulasunga icebo ico Yonadabu icikolwe cenu amukonkomeshe, mulakonka na mafunde yakwe yonse, no kulacitafye fyonse ifyo amukonkomesha,

english: therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”
translation: kanshi ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, ne Lesa wakwa Israeli, nalaya ukuti Yonadabu mwana Rekabu akalakwatapo lyonse mwane umo umwaume uwakumombela.’”

english: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into the LORD’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”
translation: “Kabiye ku ba mu lupwa lwa bena Rekabu, uye landa nabo. Elyo wise nabo, ubengishe na mu muputule umo uwa mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, ubapeeleko no mwangashi, banwe.”

english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
translation: Na ine epakuya buula Yasania mwana Yeremia umwana wakwa Habasinia, na bamunyina, na bana bakwe abaume bonse, na bonse aba mu lupwa lwa bena Rekabu,

english: and I brought them into the LORD’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.
translation: naisa batwala na ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Nabengisha na mu muputule wa bamwana Hanani mwana Igidalia, umuntu wakwa Lesa. Uyo muputule wali mupepi no muputule wa bacilolo, pa mulu wa muputule wakwa Maaseya mwana Shalumu, kalinda mulakamba wa pa mpongolo sha ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, neither you nor your children, forever.
translation: Nomba bena baasuka abati, “Awe ifwe tatunwa mwangashi iyoo, pantu icikolwe cesu Yonadabu mwana Rekabu alitukonkomeshe ifwe pamo na bana besu ukukananwa umwangashi inshiku shonse.

english: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land in which you live as nomads.’
translation: Alitulesha no kulakuula amayanda, no kulalima amabala, no kulalimba imyangashi, nangufye ukufikwata. Alitukonkomesha ukulaikalafye mu matenti ukufikafye na pa kufwa kwesu, epakuti tuleikalilila pe mu calo umo twikala nga beni.

english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;
translation: Ifwe tulakonka bwino ici cebo ca cikolwe cesu Yonadabu mwana Rekabu umo atukonkomeseshe. Ifwe tatunwa nelyo limo umwangashi, na bakashi besu bene nabo tabanwa, pamo pene na bana besu abaume na banakashi.

english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;
translation: Ifwe tatukuula mayanda yakwikalamo, tatwakwata mabala ya myangashi nangu amabala ya filime fimbi ifyakutandamo imbuto.

english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ine apo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia atampile ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda, ili shiwi lyaishile kuli Yeremia ukufuma kuli Yawe aliti,

english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in the LORD’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house, in the ears of all the people.
translation: Elyo nao Baruki alababelengela amashiwi yonse ayali mu citabo icipombwa ayo Yeremia asosa, na bantu bonse balakutika kuli Baruki. Pakubelenga Baruki ali mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, mu muputule wakwa Gemaria mwana Shafani kalemba wa mfumu. Umuputule wakwe wabelele mu lubansa, lwa pamulu pa mpongolo ipya iyakwingililapo mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the LORD’s words,
translation: Mikaya mwana Gemaria, uwali mwana wakwa Shafani, ilyo aumfwa uko Baruki apwisha ukubelenga amashiwi yonse ayakwa Yawe ayali mu citabo,

english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
translation: atentemukila na kwisano mu muputule wakwa kalemba wa mfumu, umwalongene bacilolo bonse. Mwali Elishama kalemba wa mfumu, na Delaya mwana Shemaiya, na Elinatani mwana Akibo, na Gemaria mwana Shafani, na Sedekia mwana Hanania, na bacilolo bambi bonse.

english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
translation: Elyo Mikaya alabashimikilako amashiwi yonsefye ayo aciba omfwile kuli Baruki, ilyo ali alebelengela abantu nabo ninshi baleumfwa.

english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.
translation: Elyo bacilolo bonse babuula Yehudi mwana Netania, uwali mwana Shelemia, uwali mwana wakwa Kushi, bamutuma kuli Baruki kukuya mweba ukuti ese ne icitabo ico ali alebelengelamo abantu. Awe nao Baruki mwana Neriya abatwalila ne citabo ico ali naco.

english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.
translation: Elyo bacilolo nabo bamweba abati, “Ikala apa, utubelengeleko na ifwe ifili mu citabo.” Elyo nao Baruki atendeka ukubelenga.

english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”
translation: Kutifye cilya baumfwa aya mashiwi yonse, awe balaloleshanyafye mwenso mwenso, elyo baeba na Baruki abati, “Uyu mulandu ifwe tuli nokuufisha ku mfumu Yehoyakimu.”

english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”
translation: Elyo baipusha Baruki abati, “Iwe twebeko, bushe iwe cali shani pakuti ulembe ifi fyonse? Bushe ni Yeremia ewalekweba ifyakulemba?”

english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”
translation: Nao Baruki abasuka ati, “Ee, ni Yeremia ewalenjeba ukulemba aya mashiwi yonse, na ine epakuyalemba muli ici cine citabo kuli inki.”

english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”
translation: Elyo bacilolo baeba Baruki abati, “Iwe pamo na Yeremia kabelameni. Mwileka muntu nelyo umo eshibe uko muleya belama.”

english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.
translation: “Fwayapo icitabo icipombwa cimo, ulembemo fyonse ifyo ine nakweba iwe palwa bena Israeli na bena Yuda na palwa bantu ba mishobo yonse. Ulembemo ifyo ine nakweba, ukutulafye apo natampile ukulanda nobe ilyo Yosia ali imfumu ukushinta na lelo.

english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.
translation: Bacilolo bashile babika icitabo icipombwa mu muputule wakwa Elishama kalemba wa mfumu, baya na kwisano, baya shimikila ne mfumu amashiwi yonsefye.

english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.
translation: Elyo imfumu nayo yatuma Yehudi ukuya buula icitabo. Nao aya cibuula mu muputule wakwa Elishama, aisa mukulabelengela ne mfumu na bacilolo abaiminine mupepi nayo.

english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.
translation: Cali ni mu nshita yampepo, umweshi wa pabula, ninshi imfumu ileonta no mulilo mwisano lyaiko ilyo yalekukilamo mu nshita yampepo.

english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.
translation: Nomba Yehudi aletifye cilya apwa ukubelenga pa mapepala yatatu nangu yane, imfumu nayo ninshi yayaputulamo ku kamwele, yayaposa na pa mulilo. Yalacitafye ifyo fine casuka ne citabo consefye capwa ukupya.

english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.
translation: Imfumu na bacilolo baiko bonse nelyo baumfwile umulandu onse, awe tabaiketwe na mwenso, nangu ukulepula ifyakufwala fyabo pakulanga ukuti balapila nakalya.

english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.
translation: Nangu Elinatani na Delaya na Gemaria bapapete imfumu pakuti ioca icitabo, nakalya tayabaposeleko na mano iyoo.

english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but the LORD hid them.
translation: Elyo imfumu yakonkomesha Yerameli umwana wa mfumu, na Seraya mwana Ashrieli, na Shelemiya mwana Abudeli pakuti ebo bekate kalemba Baruki na kasesema Yeremia. Nomba Yawe nao abafisa.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Ilyo imfumu yaocele icitabo umwali amashiwi ayo Yeremia aebele Baruki ukulemba, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.
translation: “Fwailapo icitabo cimbi icipombwa, ulembemo na mashiwi yalya yenefye yonse ayali muli cilya citabo ico Yehoyakimu imfumu ya bena Yuda yaocele.”

english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘The LORD says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Yeremia ukweba imfumu Yehoyakimu amashiwi na yambi ayakutila, “Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, ‘Iwe walioca icitabo, kabili waliipusha Yeremia ico alembele ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni ikesa kukonaula cino calo, no kwisa ipaululamo abantu ababamo kumo kwine ne nama ishabamo.

english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”
translation: Abena Yuda nga baumfwa ifinkunka fyonse ifyo ine napanga ukubaponesha, nakalimo lyena kuti baleka imisango yabo iyibi, ninshi na ine kuti nababelelako uluse ku fyabupulumushi fyabo na ku fyabubifi fyabo.”

english: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
translation: Kanshi ine ne Yawe Lesa ndekweba iwe we Yehoyakimu imfumu ya bena Yuda ukuti, pali bamwano abaume tapakabe nelyo umo uukakupyana pa cipuna cakwa Davidi. Icitumbi cobe cikaposwa panse pa kasuba, na pa mpepo mu nshita ya bushiku.

english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”
translation: Ine nkakulimuna iwe, nkalimuna na bamwano pamo pene na bacilolo bobe, pa mulandu wa fyabupulumushi ifyo imwe bonse mucita. Imwe pamo pene na bena Yerusalemu na bena Yuda, tamumfwa nakalya, kanshi na ine nomba imwe bonsefye nkamuponesha ifinkunka fyonse ifyo nasosele ukuti nkacita.’”

english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.
translation: Elyo Yeremia afwayapo icitabo cimbi, apeela kalemba wakwe Baruki, nao Baruki alembamo amashiwi yonsefye ayo Yeremia alemweba ukulemba. Alembamo amashiwi yalya yene yonsefye ayali muli cilya citabo ico Yehoyakimu imfumu ya bena Yuda yaocele. Yeremia alundamo na mashiwi yambi ayengi aya musango umo wine.

english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the LORD’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.
translation: Kanshi Yeremia nao epakwita Baruki mwana Neriya, amweba nokuti alembe fyonse ifyo Yawe aebele Yeremia. Awe nao Baruki epakulalemba amashiwi yonse mu citabo.

english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into the LORD’s house.
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, the LORD’s words, in the ears of the people in the LORD’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.
translation: Kanshi niwe ndefwaya ukuti ukayemo pa bushiku bwakufunga ukulya, ukaye mukulaikatisha pakubelenga aya mashiwi ayali mu citabo, epakuti bakomfwe fyonsefye ifyo Yawe anjeba ine, umo mwine nkwebele ukuyalemba. Ukaye sala pa ncende pamo apakuti abantu bonse abakaba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe bakalekumfwa, pamo pene na bena Yuda bonse abakatula mu misumba yabo.

english: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will each return from his evil way; for the LORD has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”
translation: Kusuka nakalimo abantu bapapata Yawe, baleka ne misango yabo iyibi, pantu Yawe alipangila aba bantu ukubacitapo cimo mu bukali kabili mu cipyu.”

english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the LORD’s words in the LORD’s house.
translation: Kanshi nao Baruki mwana Neriya epakuya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, abelengela na bantu amashiwi yakwa Yawe ayali mu citabo icipombwa, ukulinganafye nomo kasesema Yeremia amwebele.

english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before the LORD.
translation: Ni mu mwaka walengele isano, mu mweshi walenga pabula, apo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia atampile ukuteeka icalo ca Yuda, abantu bonse abali mu Yerusalemu na bonsefye abafumine mu misumba ya mu Yuda balifungile ukulya ku cinso cakwa Yawe pa nshita iyasontelwe.

english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
translation: Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni alisontele Sedekia mwana Yosia ukuba pa bufumu ubwakuteeka icalo ca Yuda pa malo yakwa Konia mwana Yehoyakimu.

english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”
translation: Imila 36:10

english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
translation: Ifita fya bena Kaludea fyalifumineko ku musumba wa Yerusalemu, pantu ifita fyakwa Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto fyaishile filepalamina.

english: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.
translation: Kanshi Yeremia nao epakwima mu Yerusalemu, aya ku citungu ca bena Benjamini kukuya pokako icakaniko cakwe na bantu ba mu lupwa lwakwe.

english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”
translation: Nomba kutifye cilya afika pa mpongolo yakwa Benjamini, umukalamba wa bashilika uwalelondapo palya pene, ishina lyakwe ni Iriya mwana Shelemia kabili e mwishikulu wakwa Hanania, aikata kasesema Yeremia, ati nokuti, “Iwe ulefwaya ukufyukila ku bena Kaludea.”

english: Then Jeremiah said, “That is false! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans.” But he didn’t listen to him; so Irijah seized Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
translation: Yeremia nao ayasuka ati, “Awe iyoo. Ine nshilefyukila ku bena Kaludea nakalya.” Lelo ena tewakumfwa. Aikata Yeremia, amutwala na kuli bacilolo.

english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.
translation: Bacilolo nabo tepakufulilwa Yeremia, batala bamuma, elyo bamufungilila na mu ŋanda yakwa Yonatani kalemba wa mfumu. Iŋanda yakwe eyo basangwile icifungo.

english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,
translation: Yeremia bamubikile mu kamuputule ka panshi, no kukokola alikokwelemo inshita iitali.

english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from the LORD?” Jeremiah said, “There is.” He also said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”
translation: Isham 24:17

english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?
translation: Elyo Yeremia aipusha imfumu Sedekia ati, “Bushe kwena mulandu nshi ine nacitile kuli iwe, kuli bacilolo bobe, nangu kuli aba bantu, uwakuti iwe umposelepo mu cifungo?

english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?
translation: Nga bakasesema bobe balya bakwebele ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni tayakakulwishe, nangu ukulwisha cino calo, bena bali kwi?

english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to the LORD’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.
translation: Lelo nao wine Sedekia tanakile mashiwi ayo Yawe aleeba kasesema Yeremia ukuya mweba, na bacilolo bakwe na bantu bambi mu calo nabo bene califye cimo cine, tabaleposako na mano nakalya.

english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.”
translation: Kanshi nomba we mfumu mulopwe, wingomfwa ifyo ine ndekupapata. Kanabesa, ala wimbwesesha ku ŋanda kwa Yonatani kalemba obe, pantu icishinkafye eko nkaya fwila.”

english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
translation: Kanshi imfumu Sedekia nayo epakupeela icipope icakwisalila Yeremia mu lubansa lwa bakalinda, emo balamupeelela umukate umo cila bushiku pa nshiku shonse, uwalefuma uko balepangila imikate, ukushintafye napo imikate yapwiliile mu musumba. Kanshi Yeremia nao epakulaikala mu lubansa lwa bakalinda mwine.

english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to the LORD our God for us.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Sedekia yabuula Yehukali mwana Shelemia, na shimapepo Sefania mwana Maaseya, yabatuma kuli kasesema Yeremia. Nabo baya mwipusha abati, “Wingatupapatilako kuli Yawe Lesa wesu.”

english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.
translation: Pali iyo nshita ninshi Yeremia talaposwa mu cifungo, ninshi acili aleyendelafye no kulapitana mu bantu.

english: Pharaoh’s army had come out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
translation: Kabili pali iyo ine nshita ninshi ifita fyakwa Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto nafiima, na bena Kaludea abalelwisha umusumba wa Yerusalemu bati bomfwe, awe babwelelamo ukufuma ku Yerusalemu.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Yeremia aliti,

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli. Kebe imfumu ya bena Yuda iyacikutuma kukwisa njipusha, utile auti, ‘Ifita fyakwa Farao ifili mu nshila kukwisa kutulako, ala fyalabwelelamo kumwabo ku Egupto.

english: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.”’
translation: Ifita fya bena Kaludea fyena fili nokubwelulukila kuno no kwisa sansa uno musumba, fili no kwisa upoka no kuoca ku mulilo.’

english: “The LORD says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, mwilaibepa mwe bene no kutontonkanya ati, ‘Abena Kaludea capwa nabalala nabafumako kuno.’ Awe tefyo cili.

english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,
translation: Shefatiya mwana Matani, na Gedalia mwana Pashu, na Yukali mwana Shelemia, na Pashuri mwana Malikia, aba bonse balyumfwileko ifyo Yeremia aleeba abantu. Yeremia alebeba ukuti,

english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Sedekia nayo yaeba Ebedimeleki umwina Etiopia ukuti, pa bantu abali palya pene, abuulepo abantu amakumi yatatu (30) abakuya nabo kukufumya kasesema Yeremia mu cishima ilyo ashilati afwe.

english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
translation: Kanshi Ebedimeleki epakusenda abantu, aya nabo mu muputule umo uwa kwisano umo balesungila ifyakufwala. Abuulamo insalu ishikote ne fisamu ifyalepauka, afikakila na ku fimyando, aishisha na mu cishima umwali Yeremia.

english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.
translation: Elyo Ebedimeleki umwina Etiopia aeba Yeremia ati, “Isho insalu ishikote ne fisamu ifyalepauka fibike mu mapa, epakuti ifimyando fikucena.” Nao Yeremia efyo acita,

english: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
translation: awe nabo balamutintila pamulu ku fimyando, bamufumya na mu cishima. Yeremia nomba epakulasungwafye mu lubansa lwa bakalinda.

english: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in the LORD’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”
translation: Imfumu Sedekia yalitumine abakuya buula kasesema Yeremia, no kumuleta apo yali pa mpongolo yabutatu iyakwingililapo mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe. Elyo imfumu yaeba Yeremia ati, “Ine nalakwipushapo fimo, wiesha kufisapo nelyo cimo kuli ine.”

english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”
translation: Yeremia nao amwasuka ati, “Ine nga nakweba icishinka, iwe ulenjipaya, conse ine nga nakupandako amano, awe nalyo line tawaumfwe.”

english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As the LORD lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”
translation: Elyo imfumu Sedekia yalapa kuli Yeremia mu bumfisolo ati, “Mu cishinkafye icakwa Yawe Umumi uwatupeela buno bumi, ine nshakwipaye, kabili nshakupose ku bantu abalefwaya ukukwipaya nakalya.”

english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “The LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.
translation: Elyo Yeremia aeba Sedekia ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, atile ati, “Iwe Sedekia nga wacimba kuli bamushika ba mfumu ya ku Babiloni, ninshi lyena ukapusuka, ninshi na uno musumba tabakaoce iyoo. Iwe ukapusuka, no lupwa lobe lwine ninshi nalo lukapusuka.

english: But if you will not go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you won’t escape out of their hand.’”
translation: Lelo nga wakaana ukucimba kuli bacilolo ba mfumu ya ku Babiloni, awe lyena uno musumba Yawe akaleka abena Kaludea bakaupoke, no kuoca bakaoce, nobe wine tawakamone pakupusukila uko bali.”

english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”
translation: Imfumu Sedekia nayo yayasuka ati, “Ine ndetiinakofye Abayuda balya bafyukile ku bena Kaludea. Kuti limbi eko bamposa, no kuncusha kuti balancusha.”

english: “The LORD says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’
translation: “Yawe alesosa ati, ‘Onsefye uukashala muli uno musumba, akafwa ku nkondo atemwa ku cipowe nangu ku cikuko. Nomba onse uukafumamo no kuya cimba ku bena Kaludea, ena takafwe akaba nge citapwa ca mu nkondo, akashala umumi.’”

english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, the LORD’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.
translation: Yeremia nao ayasuka ati, “Iyoo tabakakuposeko nakalya. Ine nakupapata, iwe beelafye amashiwi yakwa Yawe ayo ine ndekweba, pantu ninshi lyena fyonsefye fikaba bwino kuli iwe, no kupusuka ninshi iwe ukapusuka.

english: But if you refuse to go out, this is the word that the LORD has shown me:
translation: Yawe nananga ine mu cimonwa ifikakuponena, kumfwa iwe nga wakaanininafye ukucimba.

english: ‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “Your familiar friends have turned on you, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away from you.”
translation: Wamona. Abanakashi bonse abashala mu ŋanda ya mfumu ya cino calo ca Yuda, balya balebafumya no kulabatwala kuli bamushika ba mfumu ya ku Babiloni. Umfwa ifyo balesosa ilyo baleya, baleti,

english: They will bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans. You won’t escape out of their hand, but will be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. You will cause this city to be burned with fire.’”
translation: Elyo kabili Yeremia asosa ati, “Abakashi bobe bonse na bamwano, bakabafumya mumobe, no kubatwala ku bena Kaludea, nobe wine tawakapusuke ukufuma ku maboko yabo. Imfumu ya ku Babiloni ikakwikata, no kukusenda muli bunkole, na uno wine musumba ukonaika ku mulilo.”

english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.
translation: Elyo Sedekia aeba Yeremia ati, “Wileka nelyo umo omfweko ifi twalanda, ninshi nobe wine tawafwe iyoo.

english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’
translation: Bacilolo nga baumfwa ukuti natulanda nobe, baleisa kwipusha baleti, ‘Twebe ifyo ulandile ku mfumu nefyo imfumu ine isosele. Nga taufishile nangu cimo kuli ifwe, ninshi lyena tatwakwipaye.’

english: then you shall tell them, ‘I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.’”
translation: Awe iwe wise ubebefye ukuti, ‘Ine nalepapatafye ku mfumu pakuti imbwesesha ku ŋanda yakwa Yonatani, epali eko naya fwila.’”

english: Then all the princes came to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they stopped speaking with him, for the matter was not perceived.
translation: Awe na cine bacilolo bonse baisa kuli Yeremia. Balamwipusha, nao abasukilafye umo imfumu yamwebele ukwasuka. Awe bafilwa ne cakucitapo, pantu tapali nelyo umo uwaumfwileko ifyo imfumu Sedekia yalelanda na Yeremia.

english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
translation: Nao Yeremia epakulasungwa mulya mwine mu lubansa lwa bakalinda ukushintafye no bushiku bapokele umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: The LORD says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’”
translation: Kabili Yeremia alebeba ukuti Yawe alisosa ati, “Uno musumba nkaleka ifita fya mfumu ya ku Babiloni fikaupoke.”

english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”
translation: Bacilolo nabo epakweba imfumu Sedekia abati, “Uyu muntu Yeremia wakwipayafye, pantu imilandile yakwe yalatompola ifita fya muli uno musumba, yalatompola na bantu bambi bonse abashelepo muli uno musumba. Uyu muntu talefwaya kwafwa bantu nakalya, lelo alefwayafye ubusanso ukubaponena.”

english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”
translation: Imfumu Sedekia nayo epakusosa ati, “Cisuma, kanshi mucitenipo cimo ico mulefwaya, ine teti muleshe imwe iyoo.”

english: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.
translation: Kanshi nabo epakubuula Yeremia, bamuposa na mu cishima cakwa Malikia umwana wa mfumu, icali mu lubansa lwine ulwa bakalinda. Babomfya intambo pakumwingisha panshi. Lelo mu cishima tamwali menshi iyoo, mwalifye amatipa. Awe emo nao Yeremia abwindila.

english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),
translation: Nomba mutungwi umo umwina Etiopia, ishina lyakwe ni Ebedimeleki uwalebomba kwisano, aumfwa ukuti nabaposa Yeremia mu cishima. Pali iyo ine nshita ninshi ne mfumu naiteka ne cilye pa mpongolo yakwa Benjamini.

english: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,
translation: Kanshi nao Ebedimeleki epakufuma kwisano, aya pa cilye, alaeba ne mfumu ati,

english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”
translation: “We mfumu, kanabesa, ici cintu aba bantu bacitile, awe cibi nganshi. Nabaposa kasesema Yeremia mu cishima, kabili emo akafwila ku nsala pantu mu musumba tamuli mukate uushelemo”

english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.
translation: Mu mwaka walengele pabula apo Sedekia atampile ukuteeka icalo ca Yuda, mu mweshi we kumi, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni aliishile ne fita fyakwe fyonse, aisa wililila no musumba wa Yerusalemu no kuushinguluka.

english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
translation: Mu calo ca Yuda Nebusaradani ashamofye abalanda bene bene, abashakwetemo icuma, asha abapeela amabala ya myangashi ne filime fimbi.

english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni alyebele Nebusaradani umukalamba wa fita fyakwe ukuti akonkomeshe abantu pa mulandu wakwa Yeremia atile ati,

english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”
translation: “Kabuule Yeremia, ulemusunga bwino. Tecakwesha kulamucusha iyoo, ulemucitilafye fyonse ifyo alefwaya.”

english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon
translation: Kanshi nao Nebusaradani pamo na Nebushasubani mushika mukalamba, na Negali Sheleseri nao mushika mukalamba, pamo na bamushika bakalamba bambi bonse aba mfumu ya ku Babiloni,

english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.
translation: epakutuma abakuya buula Yeremia, nabo baya mufumya na mu lubansa lwa bakalinda. Baeba na Gedalia mwana Aikamu, umwishikulu wakwa Shafani, pakuti eo alemusunga, amufishe na kumwabo umutende. Kanshi nao Yeremia epakulaikala ku bantu.

english: Now the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia ilyo bamufungile mu lubansa lwa bakalinda, no kumweba ati

english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.
translation: “Kebe Ebedimeleki umwina Etiopia ukuti ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, ne Lesa wakwa Israeli ndetila nati, ‘Ine te shuko nalaletela uno musumba iyoo, ala lishamofye elyo nalauletela, nga mulya mwine nasosele ukuti efyo nkacita. Ilyo ici cintu cilecitika, iwe Ebedimeleki ulesangwapo, no kuimwena uleimwena na menso yobe.

english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says the LORD; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.
translation: Nomba ine ne Yawe iwe ndekupokololako, tawaposwe ku bantu abo iwe utiina iyoo.

english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says the LORD.’”
translation: Ine ndekupususha, tabakwipaye ku lupanga iyoo, lelo uli nokuba nge citapwa ca mu nkondo, pantu ine walintetekela.’ Nine ne Yawe Lesa nalanda.”

english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi limo na umo (11) apo Sedekia aikalile pa bufumu, pa bushiku bwalenga pabula mu mweshi wabune, elyo na malinga ya ku musumba yabongolweke.

english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.
translation: Ilyo bapokele Yerusalemu, bamushika bakalamba aba mfumu ya ku Babiloni baliishile bonse, baisa ikala na pa mpongolo ya pakati nankati. Aba bamushika ni Negali Sheleseri umwina Samuga, na Nebo Salisekimu, na Negali Sheleseri umbi, na bamushikapo bambi bonse aba mfumu ya ku Babiloni.

english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.
translation: Sedekia imfumu ya calo ca Yuda pamo na bashilika bakwe bonse bati bamone ifyo caba, bafulumuka mu musumba pa nshita ya bushiku. Bakonka inshila iyaya kwibala lya mfumu, bapitila pa mpongolo iyabela lwa pakati ka malinga yabili, balola na ku mukonko wa Yordani.

english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
translation: Nomba ifita fya bena Kaludea fyakunkunika imfumu Sedekia, fyamwikatila mu mawanga ya Yeriko. Epakumwikata bunkole, bamutwala na kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, uwali mu mushi wa Ribula mu calo ca Hamati, emo na Nebukadinesa amupingwila umulandu.

english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.
translation: Ku Ribula kwine eko imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaipaila na bamwana Sedekia abaume, ninshi na Sedekia wine no kumona alemonako. Eko yaipaila na bacilolo bene bonse abena Yuda.

english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
translation: Elyo yatonkola na Sedekia amenso, yamukaka ne minyololo ya mukuba, yamutwala na ku Babiloni.

english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
translation: Pali iyo ine nshita, ninshi abena Kaludea naboca amayanda ya kwisano, na mayanda ya bantu, nababongolola na malinga yene aya ku Yerusalemu.

english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.
translation: Elyo Nebusaradani umukalamba wa fita aikata abantu bambi bonse abashelemo mu musumba, abasenda na muli bunkole ku Babiloni, pamo pene na bambi bonse abaile cimba uko ali.

english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says the LORD.
translation: Batila abati, “Umuntu nga aleka umukashi wakwe,

english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says the LORD.
translation: Lelo nangu cali ifyo inkashi nankwe nao Yuda uwabula icitetekelo nafilwa ukubwela no mutima wakwe onse kuli ine, pantu ukubwela kwakwe cali kubepafye. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.”

english: The LORD said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
translation: Elyo Yawe anjeba ati, “Israeli uushakwata icitetekelo awamapo ukucila Yuda intalangani ine ine.

english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says the LORD; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says the LORD. ‘I will not keep anger forever.
translation: Kanshi iwe kabiye ku kapinda ka ku kuso, kabile imbila kuli Israeli utile,

english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against the LORD your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says the LORD.
translation: Icikulu usumine ukuti walikwata umulandu,

english: “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
translation: “Imwe mwe bana ababula icisumino, ala bweleleni kuli ine, ifi efyasosa Yawe. Pantu ine ndi mwina mwenu. Muli cila mushi nkabuulamo umuntu umo, na muli cila mukowa nkabuulamo abantu babili, nkamuleta na ku Sioni.

english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
translation: Elyo nkamupeela abakumucema abaishiba ififwaya umutima wandi, abakalamutungulula na mano no mucetekanya.

english: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of the LORD’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe. Ilyo mukasanda mu calo, lyena ninshi abantu bakaleka no kulalanda palwa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano icakwa Yawe. Bakaleka no kutontonkanyapo nangu ukwibukishapo iyoo, tabakaleifuluka nangu ukupyanikishapo imbi nakalya.

english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The LORD’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the LORD’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, Yerusalemu bakalamwita abati, icipuna cabufumu icakwa Yawe, na bantu ba mishobo yonse emo bakalalongana pakucindika ishina lyakwa Yawe. Tabakalekonkelela ukumalala kwa mitima yabo iyabubifi.

english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.
translation: Pali iyo nshita aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda bakakumbinkana pamo na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli, bakalaendela pamo pakufuma ku calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso, no kwisa mu calo ico ine napeele ifikolwe fyenu pakuti cibe icacishilano pe.”

english: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’
translation: “Elyo nalandile nati,

english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.
translation: “Shiloleshafye apasansama, uimwene na we mwine!

english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says the LORD.
translation: Nga filya fine umwanakashi intalangani asangukila wiba,

english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God.
translation: Icongo ico caumfwika pamulu apasansama,

english: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are the LORD our God.
translation: “Bwelenifye imwe bonse mwe babula icisumino,

english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
translation: Cine cine ukupepa kwa tulubi pa mulu wa tupili,

english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
translation: “Ukutula ku bwaice bwesu imilungu ya nsoni eipwisha ifyakulya ifyo bashifwe baleculila, emukuti impaanga, iŋombe, abana abaume na banakashi.

english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed the LORD our God’s voice.”
translation: Natulala mu nsoni shesu, no kusebana kwesu kutufimbe. Pantu ifwe pamo na bashifwe twalibifya kuli Yawe Lesa wesu, ukutulafye ku bwaice bwesu ukufika na lelo line, kabili twalikaana no kulabeela Yawe Lesa wesu.”

english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.
translation: E mulandu wine ne mfula ishilelokela,

english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?
translation: Bushe te nombaline walenjita auti,

english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”
translation: bushe wakulamfulilwa pe na pe?

english: Moreover, the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.
translation: Ilyo imfumu Yosia aleteeka icalo ca Yuda, Yawe alandile kuli ine ati, “Bushe nobe walimona ifyo umwanakashi Israeli uwabula icisumino ampondokela? Aya mukunina pa mulu wa tupili, nokuya mwisamba lya miti yonse iyafumba emo alecitila bucilende.

english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
translation: Ine mu mano yandi natontonkenye nati, panuma yakucita ifi fyonse akabwelela kuli ine, lelo tabwelele iyoo, kabili Yuda nkashi nankwe uwabula icishinka nao aimwena ifi fintu.

english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.
translation: Kabili napeele intalantanshi Israeli kalata wakumulekelapo icupo pa mulandu wa bucilende bwakwe bonse, namutamfya no kumutamfya. Nomba namwene intalantanshi inkashi nankwe Yuda takwete katiina, nao ayacita bucilende,

english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.
translation: ukwabula nokuti alesakamana nakalya. Asuka Yuda akowesha ne calo, alacita bucilende ku mabwe ne fimuti.

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.
translation: Yawe alilandile kuli Yeremia, ilyo Nebusaradani mushika mukalamba wa fita amufumishe mu cifungo ku Rama. Ni ku Rama kwine eko batwele Yeremia, ninshi nakakwa iminyololo pamo na bantu bambi bonse aba mu Yerusalemu, na ba mu calo cine ica Yuda abo balesenda bunkole ku Babiloni.

english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”
translation: Ine pano ndi, nakulaikala muno mwine mu Misipa, nakulamusoselako ku bena Kaludea abakulaisa kuno. Lelo imwe mulonganike umwangashi, ifitwalo na mafuta ya miolifa, mwisushe imitondo yenu, muye mwikale na mu misumba iyo mwe bene mwapoka.”

english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,
translation: Abena Yuda bambi bonse abali mu calo ca Moabu, na mu ca Amoni na mu ca Edomu na mu fyalo fimbi, ninshi nabo balyumfwa ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalisuminisha ukuti abena Yuda bamo bashale nabekala mu calo cabo ica Yuda, nokuti yalisonta na Gedalia mwana Aikamu, mwishikulu Shafani, ukuba umulashi wabo.

english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.
translation: Kanshi abena Yuda aba bonse epakufuma umo basalanganine, babwelela na mu calo cabo ica Yuda. Baisa kuli Gedalia mu Misipa, balalonganya no mwangashi uwingi, ne fitwalo nafyo ifingi.

english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
translation: Elyo limbi Yoanani mwana Karea pamo ne ntungulushi sha bashilika abasalanganine mu mpanga, baisa kuli Gedalia mu Misipa.

english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.
translation: Balamweba abati, “Bushe iwe nawishiba ukuti Baalisi imfumu ya bena Amoni natuma Ishimaeli mwana Netania kukwisa kwipaya?” Lelo Gedalia mwana Aikamu ena tewakuti asumine nakalya.

english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”
translation: Elyo Yoanani mwana Karea aeba Gedalia mu bumfisolo mu Misipa mwine ati, “Leka nje njipaye Ishimaeli mwana Netania, tapabe nelyo umo uuleishiba uumwipeye. Ngeco twingamulekela ena akwipaye, cinshi? Ici cintu kuti casalanganya abena Yuda bonse abalongana uko uli, kabili na bena Yuda bonse abashalapo muli cino calo, kuti cabaposa mu bwafya.”

english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”
translation: Lelo Gedalia mwana Aikamu, ena ayasuka Yoanani mwana Karea ati, “Wiesha kucita ifyo pantu ifyo ulelanda pali Ishimaeli fyabufifye.”

english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God pronounced this evil on this place;
translation: Kanshi mushika mukalamba uwa fita epakutwala Yeremia eka lubali lumo, alamweba ati, “Yawe Lesa obe alipangile ukonaula cino calo,

english: and the LORD has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.
translation: no kufikilisha nafikilisha ifyo asosele ukuti efyo akacita. Fyonse ifi naficitika, pantu abantu bobe balibifya kuli Yawe, balikaana no kulamubeela.

english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”
translation: Nomba ine nalakukakula iminyololo ku maboko, no kukuleka nalakulekamo pakuti uleyendela we mwine. Nga ulefwaya tuye bonse ku Babiloni, cili kuli iwe, ine nkalakusungafye bwino. Conse nga taulefwaya ukuti tuye bonse ku Babiloni, naco cili kuli iwe. Wamona, icalo cino conse cikalamba, kuti we mwine wasalapo kumo uko utemenwe. Kuti wayafye konse uko we mwine ulefwaya ukuya.”

english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.
translation: Eico lintu Yeremia talapilibuka ukwamba ukuya, Nebusaradani epakumweba ati, “Ale kanshi bwelelamo kuli Gedalia mwana Aikamu, mwishikulu Shafani, uo imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalashike pakuti aleteeka imishi ya muli cino calo ca Yuda, pakuti eo muleikala nankwe pamo pene na bantu bambi, atemwa kuti waya ikala kumbi konse uko we mwine umwene ukuti ekukulingile.” Elyo Nebusaradani apeelako Yeremia ubupe, amupeela ne fyakulya, amulekamo no kumuleka pakuti umwine aleya.

english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.
translation: Yeremia nao epakuya kuli Gedalia mwana Aikamu, eo alaikala nankwe mu Misipa, pamo pene na bantu abashelepo mu calo ca Yuda.

english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,
translation: Ilyo abakalamba bonse aba fita ifya bena Yuda pamo na bashilika babo abasalanganine mu mpanga baumfwile ukuti imfumu ya ku Babiloni naisonta Gedalia mwana Aikamu ukuba umulashi wa calo, uwakuti alesungako na bantu abaume, banamayo na bana abo abashasendelweko muli bunkole ku Babiloni abantu abali abalanda abene bene mu calo,

english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.
translation: lyena ninshi baishile kuli Gedalia ku Misipa. Abaishile bali ni Ishimaeli mwana Netania, na Yoanani mwana Karea, na Seraya mwana Tanumeti, na bamwana Efai umwina Netofa, na Yesania umwina Maakayi pamo na bantu babo.

english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.
translation: Elyo Gedalia mwana Aikamu, mwishikulu Shafani, alapa umulapo wakubalaya, bena pamo na bantu babo, ati, “Napalifye ine, imwe ala mwitiina kucimba ku bena Kaludea. Ikalenifye muno mwine, mulebombela imfumu ya ku Babiloni, ninshi na fyonse fyakulabafye bwino uko muli.

english: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.
translation: Mu mweshi walenga cine lubali , Ishimaeli mwana Netania, mwishikulu Elishama, uwa mu lupwa lwabufumu kabili uwali umo pali bacilolo ba mfumu, alishile ku Misipa pamo na bantu ikumi limo kukumona Gedalia mwana Aikamu. Ilyo balelya icakulya pamo mu Misipa mwine,

english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.
translation: Elyo Ishimaeli mwana Netania abuula abana ba mfumu abanakashi, na bantu bambi abashelepo mu Misipa, abo Nebusaradani mushika mukalamba wa fita aebele Gedalia mwana Aikamu ukuti alebasunga, abasenda bunkole, alungama na ku calo ca bena Amoni.

english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
translation: Yoanani mwana Karea pamo ne ntungulushi sha fita ishali pamo nankwe, bati bomfwe ubupondo ubwacitile Ishimaeli mwana Netania,

english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
translation: awe baimya abantu babo bonse, baya mukumulwisha, baya musanga mupepi ne cishiba icikulu icaba ku Gibeoni.

english: Now when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.
translation: Cilyafye bankole bonse abo Ishimaeli asendele bamona Yoanani mwana Karea pamo ne ntungulushi sha fita, awe batemwa nganshi.

english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
translation: Kanshi bankole abo Ishimaeli aikete mu Misipa, nabo epakwaluluka babutukila na kuli Yoanani mwana Karea.

english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.
translation: Ishimaeli mwana Netania pamo na bantu bakwe cine konse konse bena babutuka, bafulumukila na mu calo ca bena Amoni.

english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.
translation: Elyo Yoanani mwana Karea, na bakalamba ba fita abo ali nabo, basenda abantu bonse abashele muli bunkole ukufuma ku Misipa, abo apokolwele ukufuma kuli Ishimaeli mwana Netania panuma yakusha aipaya Gedalia mwana Aikamu. Pa bantu aba pali abashilika, abanakashi, abaice na bamutungwi abo Yoanani afumishe ku Gibeoni.

english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt
translation: No kwima baima, kabili batala batubilishako ku Geruti Kimuhamu ukwali mupepi na Betelemu. Elyo kabili balapanga ukuya ku Egupto,

english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.
translation: pakubutuka abena Kaludea. Baletiina abena Kaludea, pantu Ishimaeli mwana Netania aliipeye Gedalia mwana Aikamu, uo imfumu ya ku Babiloni yasontele ukuba umulashi muli ico calo.

english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
translation: Ishimaeli mwana Netania pamo na bantu ikumi limo abo ali nabo, baima, babuula impanga shabo, baipaya na Gedalia mwana Aikamu, mwishikulu Shafani, uo imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalashike ukulateeka icalo.

english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.
translation: Kabili Ishimaeli aipaya na bena Yuda bonse abali na Gedalia mu Misipa, aipaila kumo na bashilika abena Kaludea abaliko.

english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo ukufuma apo baipaile Gedalia, ninshi no kwishibikwa tacilaishibikwa ukuti Gedalia nabamwipaya,

english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to the LORD’s house.
translation: awe kwaisa na baume amakumi cine konse konse (80), batula ku Shekemu na ku Shilo na ku Samaria. Baisa nababeya imyefu, nabalepaula ne nsalu shabo, nabaitetaula ne mibili yabo pakulanga ubulanda. Baisa nabasenda imitulo ya cabunga no bubani pakuti bafituule mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe.

english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”
translation: Ishimaeli mwana Netania nao afuma na mu Misipa, aya kukubasengela, ninshi napumapo no musowa. Cilya afika apo bali, abeba ati, “Aleni ingileni, mumonane na Gedalia mwana Aikamu.”

english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.
translation: Kutifye cilya baingila mu musumba, awe Ishimaeli mwana Netania pamo na bantu bakwe babepaya, baposa ne fitumbi fyabo mu cimukanda cimo.

english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.
translation: Nomba pali abo bene bantu, bambi ikumi limo bena baeba Ishimaeli abati, “Mukwai, ifwe mwitwipaya. Pantu ifwe natukwata iŋanu na male na mafuta ya miolifa no buci, no kufifisa twalififisa mu mpanga.” Kanshi bena epakubalekafye, ukwabula ukuti abepaye nga banabo.

english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (this was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.
translation: Icimukanda ico Ishimaeli aposelemo ifitumbi fya bantu bonse abo aipeye, cali icikulu. Ni mfumu Asa ewaimbile pakuti emo ileipokolwelako kuli Baasha imfumu ya calo ca Israeli. Ishimaeli aliciswishe ne fitumbi fya bantu abo aipeye.

english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,
translation: Elyo abakalamba bonse aba fita, ukubikapo na Yoanani mwana Karea, na Yesania mwana Hoshaya, baima na bantu bonse, abakalamba na banono,

english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.
translation: ‘Imwe nga muleikalilila muli cino calo ca Yuda, ine ninshi nkamukosha, nshakamonaule iyoo, nkamutekamo, nshakamulofye iyoo. Icinkunka ico ine namuletela, awe cilenangulusha.

english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says the LORD, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
translation: Imwe lekenifye ukulatiina imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Ala mwilatiina iyoo, pantu ine ndi nenu, ine nakulamupusushako no kulamupokololako kuli ena. Nine ne Yawe nalanda.

english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.
translation: Ine nkamubelelako uluse, nkalenga ne mfumu ine iya ku Babiloni ikamulangulukileko, ikamusuminishe no kulaikala muli cino calo cenu.’

english: “‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land,” so that you don’t obey the LORD your God’s voice,
translation: “Nomba imwe mwe bantu nga mwatalamina Yawe Lesa wenu, muletila, ‘Awe ifwe tatulefwaya kulaikala muli cino calo.

english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there we will dwell;”’
translation: Tulefwayafye ukuya ikala ku calo ca Egupto uko tushakalelwa nkondo, nangu ukumfwako ipenga ilyakulonganika abantu ku nkondo, uko tushakalecula na ku nsala.’

english: now therefore hear the LORD’s word, O remnant of Judah! The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,
translation: Nga cakuti mwalalanda ifi, mulandu wenu, lelo kwena imwe mwe bashalapo muno muntu mu Yuda, umfweni ifilesosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, aletila ati, ‘Imwe nga namupanga icine cine ukuya ikala ku Egupto,

english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.
translation: lyena inkondo ine iyo muletiina, ikamwimina kulya kwine ku Egupto, ne cipowe cine cikamukonka panuma kulya kwine ku Egupto, no kufwila ni ku Egupto kwine mukaya fwila.

english: So will it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence. None of them will remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.’
translation: Abantu bonse abapangile ukuya ikala ku Egupto, bakaya fwa ku nkondo atemwa ku cipowe nangu ku cikuko. Tapakayeshala nelyo umo, tapakabe nelyo umo uukapusukako ku cinkunka ico ine nkaya baponesha.’

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you, when you enter into Egypt; and you will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you will see this place no more.’
translation: “Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, aletila ati, ‘Ngefi fine naimine abena Yerusalemu mu bukali bwandi na mu cipyu candi, efyo nemwe bene nkamwimina nga mukaya ku calo ca Egupto. Abantu bambi bakalakuntafye imitwe pakumumona, bakalamuwela, bakalabuula ne shina lyenu elyo bakalelumbula pakutipwila. Cino calo imwe tamwakatale nakabili amucishimpamo ilinso nakalya.’”

english: “The LORD has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.
translation: Elyo kabinge Yeremia akonkanyapo ati, “Imwe mwe bantu mwe bashalapo muno muntu mu Yuda, Yawe alemulesha ukuya ku Egupto. Na ine wine ne Yeremia ndemusokako

english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to the LORD your God, even for all this remnant, for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes see us,
translation: baya eba kasesema Yeremia abati, “Wingomfwa ifyo ifwe tulekweba. Iwe tupapatileko kuli Yawe Lesa obe. Tupapatileko ifwe bonse fwe bashelepo. Kale twali abengi, nomba tushelefye abampendwa, no kuimwena nobe wine nauimwena.

english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to the LORD our God; and according to all that the LORD our God says, so declare to us, and we will do it.’
translation: ukuti, ala mwaliiletelele mwe bene, ilyo mwantumine kuli Yawe Lesa wesu, no kulanjeba amuti, ‘Tupapatileko kuli Yawe Lesa wesu. Kabili ukatwebefye fyonse ifyo alefwaya tucite, no kucita efyo tukacita.’

english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed the LORD your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.
translation: Ine lelo nimwebelapo fyonse, nomba imwe fyonsefye ifyo Yawe wesu antumine ukwisa mweba namufikaanininafye ndai.

english: Now therefore know certainly that you will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live.”
translation: Eico kanshi nomba mushininkishe ukuti ku calo uko mulefwaya ukuya ikala, uko kwine eko mukafwila ku nkondo atemwa ku cipowe nangu ku cikuko.”

english: that the LORD your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”
translation: Tupapatileko kuli Yawe Lesa obe pakuti atulange inshila iyo tuli nokulolamo, atulange nefyo tuli nokucita.”

english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to the LORD your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing the LORD answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”
translation: Kasesema Yeremia nao abasuka ati, “Mwalandafye bwino. Ine nalamupapatilako kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, ngomo mwine munjebele. No kumweba ine nkamwebako fyonse ifyo Yawe akasuka. Ine nshakamufisepo nelyo cimo iyoo.”

english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
translation: Kabili abantu baeba Yeremia abati, “Yawe e kambone wesu uwacine cine kabili uwacishinka, eukatushinina ifwe nga tatwakalebeela fyebo fyakwe fyonse ifyo Yawe Lesa obe akakweba ukuti wise utwebe.

english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.”
translation: Nangufye fikabe ifyakutusansamusha atemwa iyoo, te mulandu, ifwe tukalabeelafye Yawe Lesa wesu uo ifwe tulekutumako. Fyonse fikabafye bwino kuli ifwe nga twalabeela Yawe Lesa wesu.”

english: After ten days, the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshiku ikumi limo, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia.

english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
translation: Kanshi nao Yeremia epakwita Yoanani mwana Karea, na bakalamba bonse aba fita abo ali nabo, aitako na bantu bambi bonse abakalamba na banono.

english: and said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:
translation: Alabeba ati, “Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli uo mwantumineko pakuya mupapatilako atile ati,

english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of the LORD their God, with which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
translation: Ilyo Yeremia apwile ukulaeba abantu bonse amashiwi ayo Yawe Lesa wabo amutumine ukuya beba,

english: Tell them, the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
translation: Elyo iwe ubebe ukuti, Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, ati, ‘Ndeyabuula umubomfi wandi Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni. Icipuna cakwe icabufumu ndeisa citeeka pali aya yene mabwe nshiikile, ndeisa citapo ne cintamfu cabufumu.

english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.
translation: Nebukadinesa akesa cimfya icalo ca Egupto. Abantu abasontelwa ukufwa ku cikuko, Nebukadinesa akalenga bafwe ku cikuko, abasontelwa ukuya muli bunkole, akesa basenda muli bunkole, abasontelwa ukufwa ku nkondo, akesa bepaya ku nkondo.

english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.
translation: Akesa oca amatempele ya muno Egupto ayo bapepelamo imilungu yabo, elyo utulubi twabo akesa toca, atemwa akesa tusendafye. Nga filya fine kacema atola inda mu fyakufwala fyakwe, efyo ne mfumu ya ku Babiloni ileisa solosota icalo ca Egupto, elyo ikaye ilecinda na malaila pakubwelelamo kumwakwe.

english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”
translation: Ikesa tobaula inceshi sha mabwe ishamushilo, ishaba kwitempele ilyo bapepelamo akasuba ku Heliopolisi muno mwine mu Egupto. Ileisa oca na matempele ya milungu ya muno Egupto.’”

english: then Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely. The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You shall not go into Egypt to live there;’
translation: elyo Asariya mwana Hoshaya, na Yoanani mwana Karea, na bantu bambi bonse abacilumba, baeba Yeremia abati, “Ulebepafye ubufi iwe. Yawe Lesa wesu takutumine nakalya kukwisa tulesha ukuya ikala ku Egupto.

english: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon.”
translation: Ni Baruki mwana Neriya eukutunkilefye, epakuti abena Kaludea bakatwikate, bakatwipaye, atemwa bakatusende bunkole ku Babiloni.”

english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey the LORD’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.
translation: Kanshi Yoanani wine mwana Karea na bakalamba bonse aba fita na bantu bambi bonse, awe bakaana ukumfwa amashiwi yakwa Yawe, bakaana no kulaikala mu calo ica Yuda.

english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—
translation: Elyo Yoanani mwana Karea na bakalamba bonse aba fita basenda abantufye bonse abashelepo mu calo ca Yuda. Basendela kumo kwine na bantu bonse abafumine mu fyalo fya bantu ba mishobo yonse umo basalanganine.

english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
translation: Basenda abaume na banakashi na bana, pamo na bana ba mfumu abanakashi. Basendela kumo na bantu bonsefye abo Nebusaradani mushika mukalamba wa fita ashilile Gedalia mwana Aikamu, mwishikulu Shafani, pakuti eo alebasunga. Na kasesema wine Yeremia pamo na Baruki mwana Neriya babasendela kumo.

english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey the LORD’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.
translation: Bakaana ukubeela amashiwi yakwa Yawe, baima, balaya na ku calo ca Egupto, basuka bafika na mu musumba wa Tapanesi.

english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
translation: Mu Tapanesi mwine ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: “Take great stones in your hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.
translation: “Fwayapo amabwe yamo ayakulu, uye shiika mu lubansa, mwisamba lya matabo, palya bapitila pakwingila mu ŋanda yabuteeko iyaba muli uno musumba, ilya ifikililamo imfumu yabo Farao, uleke na bena Yuda bamoneko uko uleyashiika.

english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
translation: Yawe alilandile kuli Yeremia palwa bena Yuda bonse abaleikala mu calo ca Egupto mu musumba wa Migidoli no wa Tapanesi, no wa Memfisi na mu citungu ca Patirosi icabeela ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.’
translation: Elyo ukushinta na nomba imwe mwe bena Yuda tamwalapila nakalya. Tamwankwatila katiina iyoo, kabili tamukonka mafunde yandi ne fipope fyandi, ifyo ine namupeele imwe pamo ne fikolwe fyenu.”

english: “Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli ati, “Ine nomba nkamulofya imwe, nkonaula na bena Yuda bonse.

english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.
translation: Elyo abena Yuda abashalapo, abapangile ukwisa ikala muno Egupto, nkamona umusango wakubalofeshamo bonsefye muno mwine mu Egupto ku nkondo na ku cipowe. Bonsefye abakalamba na banono bene bakafwila muno Egupto, bakafwa ku nkondo atemwa ku cipowe. Abantu bakalapapafye pakumona, bakalabasuula, bakalabawela, bakalabuula ne shina lyabo elyo bakalelumbula pakutiipwila.

english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;
translation: Abaikala muno calo ca Egupto, ine nkabalimuna nga filya fine nalimwine Yerusalemu, nkababuushisha inkondo, nkabaletela icipowe ne cikuko.

english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”
translation: Pa bena Yuda abashalapo, abaisa ikala muno mu Egupto, tapakabe uukapusukapo nangu ukashalapo umumi. Tapakamoneke na wakubwelela ku calo ca Yuda, ico bafuluka ukuya ikalamo nakabili. Tapakabe wakubwelelamo kanofye bamo bamo abakuti bafyukilefye.”

english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
translation: Abaume bonse abaishibe ukuti abakashi babo balafutumwina imilungu imbi imbi ububani, elyo na banakashi bonsefye abasangilwepo, ukubikapofye na bena Yuda abaikele mu citungu ca Patirosi icaba mu Egupto, nalyo ibumba lya bantu ilikulu nganshi, kanshi abo bantu elyo baeba Yeremia abati,

english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in the LORD’s name, we will not listen to you.
translation: “Ifyo Yawe akutumine iwe ukutweba, ala ifwe twafikaana, tatwafyumfwe napa nakalya.
