english: But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.
translation: Ifwe twakulacitafye ifyo tukwebele ukuti efyo twakulacita, epela. Umulungu wesu namfumu wa mu mulu, ifwe eo twakulafutumwina ububani, twakulawitulwila ne mituulo ya fyakunwa, nga filya fine na bashifwe, pamo na bashamfumu besu na bacilolo besu balecita mu misumba ya mu calo ca Yuda na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu. Pantu lyena twalekwata ifyakulya ifingi, twalekwata ishuko, ne shamo talyaletuponena nakalya.

english: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.”
translation: Elyo ukutulafye apo twalekela ukufutumwina namfumu wa mu mulu ububani, no kuwitulwila imituulo ya fyakunwa, awe nomba ifintu fyalitubula, na bantu besu tepakufwa ku nkondo na ku cipowe.”

english: The women said, “When we burned incense to the queen of the sky and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”
translation: Abanakashi nabo ebakulundapo amashiwi abati, “Ilyo twalefutumuna ububani no kupanga imikate iyapalanako ne cipasho ca namfumu wa mu mulu, ne lintu twaleufutumwina ububani no kulawitulwila imituulo ya fyakunwa, bushe abalume besu nabo tabaletusuminisha?”

english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. Behold, today they are a desolation, and no man dwells in them,
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli alisosele ati, “Imwe mwe bena Yuda, mwaliimwena na menso yenu icinkunka ico naletele Yerusalemu, ne misumba imbi yonse iya mu calo ca Yuda. Na nombaline icilifye amatololo, takuli nelyo umo uwikalamo nakalya.

english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people—to the men and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,
translation: Cilya abantu bonse abaume na banakashi bapwa ukulanda ifi, elyo Yeremia abeba ati,

english: “The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t the LORD remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?
translation: “Palwa ububani ubo imwe mwalefutumuna mu misumba ya mu calo ca Yuda na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu, pamo ne fikolwe fyenu ne shamfumu shenu, na bacilolo benu na bantu bene bambi aba mu calo ca Yuda, bushe imwe muletontonkanya ukuti Yawe taishibepo nelyo cimo, atemwa muletila alilabako, batini?

english: Thus the LORD could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.
translation: Tepapa ukushinta na lelo icalo cenu calyonaika, tamwaba nelyo umo uwaikalamo. Abantu bambi bapapafye pakumona ifyo cili, ne shina lyaciko elyo balumbula no kubomfya pakutipwila, pantu Yawe asukile afilwa ukushipikisha imyendele yenu ne misango yenu iyabipisha.

english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”
translation: Ici cinkunka calimuponena imwe, ngefi fine cili ukushinta na pali lelo, pantu imwe mwalefutumwina imilungu imbi imbi ububani, mwalebifya na kuli Yawe Lesa. Mwalekaana no kulanakila amafunde yakwe, ne fyebo fyakwe, ne fipope fyakwe.”

english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear the LORD’s word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!
translation: Kabinge Yeremia akonkanyapo ukulaeba abantu bonse abaume na banakashi, ati, “Umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe, mwe bena Yuda aba mu Egupto. Lesa umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, asosa ati,

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.” “‘Establish then your vows, and perform your vows.’
translation: ‘Imwe mwe baume, palibufi nga nimwe mwe bakashi babo, mwalicita ifilayo ifine fine kuli kanamfumu ka mu mulu. Mwalilaya ukuti mwakulakafutumwina ububani, no kulaketulwila imituulo ya fyakunwa, nefi fine ifilayo imwe mulafisunga. Cisuma! Aleni akusungishenifye ifilayo fyenu! Akuketulwilenifye ifyakunwa!

english: “Therefore hear the LORD’s word, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by my great name,’ says the LORD, ‘that my name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord GOD lives.”
translation: Nomba kwena umfweni icilayo ico na ine ne Yawe namulaya imwe mwe bena Yuda, mwe baikala muno mu Egupto. Ala napalifye ine ne Yawe ne we shina ilikulu, nalapa ukuti pali baimwe ine nshakatale ndekapo nelyo umo uwakuti akalebula ishina lyandi, elyo akalelumbula pakulayapo icilayo cimo, ati, “Mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe Umumi.”

english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.
translation: Nakulamuceceta pakuti nkamuletele ishamo, ishuko lyena nakalyafye. Imwe mwe bena Yuda mwe baikala muno mu Egupto, mukafwa ku nkondo atemwa ku cipowe, mpakafye bonse mukapwe.

english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.
translation: Banono abakapusukako ku mfwa, ebakafuma muno Egupto, no kubwelela ku calo ca Yuda. Lyena elyo abakashalapo pa bena Yuda abaisa ikala muno mu Egupto elintu bakashininkishapo uwalanda ifyacishinka, nga nine atemwa nga nibo.

english: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’
translation: Neci e cishibilo namupeela icakuti ine ne Yawe nkamukandila imwe muno mwine, nokuti icilayo candi icakumulofya imwe cikacitika.

english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.
translation: Ico ine nacitile ifi, nico abantu abalimo balecita ifyabipa, basuka bankalifya no mutima. Balefutumwina imilungu imbi imbi ububani no kubombela eyo balebombela, nelyo nayo intu bashatalile abeshiba, nangufye nimwe bene, nangufye ifikolwe fyenu fine.

english: The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”
translation: Farao Hofula imfumu ya mu Egupto, ine nalamuposa ku balwani bakwe abafwaya ukumwipaya, nalamuposa nga filya fine naposele Sedekia imfumu ya calo ca Yuda kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, umulwani wakwe uwalefwaya ukumwipaya.’”

english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”
translation: Ine nabikilepofye ukulamutumina ababomfi bandi bonse bakasesema, nabo balemulesha ukucita ici cintu icabunani ico ine napatisha.

english: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.
translation: Nomba imwe tamwalefwaya kumfwa nangu ukuposako amano nakalya. Tamwalefwaya kuleka musango wenu uwakufutumwina imilungu imbi imbi ububani.

english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.’
translation: Kanshi na ine epakwimina mu bukali bwandi ne cipyu candi imisumba ya mu Yuda, ne misebo ya mu Yerusalemu, no kuyoca ku mulilo. Ee, yasangukafye amatololo, na bantu bapapafye pakumona ifyo caba ukushinta na lelo.

english: “Therefore now the LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the middle of Judah, to leave yourselves no one remaining,
translation: “Kanshi ine ne Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita, ne Lesa wakwa Israeli, ndemwipusha umulandu walenga ukuti imwe nomba muiletelele icinkunka icakula ifi. Bushe imwe mulefwaya ukuiletelela ukwakuti mupatukeko ukufuma ku Bayuda abaume na banakashi, abaice no tunya, icakuti pali imwe pekashala nelyo umo, batini?

english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
translation: Ngeco imwe mulenkalifisha cinshi kulwa tulubi twenu, na kulwa kufutumwina imilungu imbi imbi ububani muli cino calo ca Egupto umo mwaisa mukwikala? Bushe pakulacita ifi mulefwayafye ukuilofya mwe bene, icakuti abantu ba mishobo yonse pano isonde bakalemuwela, bakalebuula ne shina lyenu, elyo bakalelumbula pakutiipwila, mwa?

english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation: Ifibi fyonse ifyo ifikolwe fyenu fyalecita, ifyo ne shamfumu sha mu Yuda shalecitako pamo na bakashi bashiko, ifyo nemwe bene mwalecitako pamo na bakashi benu mu calo ca Yuda na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu, bushe apa pene epo mufilabile, batini?

english: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,
translation: Ni mu mwaka walengele ine, apo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia atampile ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda, emo Baruki mwana Neriya alembele mu katabo kamo amashiwi yonse ayo Yeremia alemweba ukulemba. Elyo kasesema Yeremia aebele Baruki ati,

english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli kuli iwe we Baruki.

english: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’
translation: Iwe uletila auti, ‘Awe ine nomba naleka. Pantu Yawe nanundilapo amacushi na yambi. Ine ni mfwafye kukuteta, ndefilwa no kumona apakupemwinako.’”

english: “You shall tell him, the LORD says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.
translation: Kanshi Yawe nao epakweba Yeremia ukuti, “Eba Baruki ukutila, ‘Ine ne Yawe ndebongolola ifyo nakuulile, ndenukaula nefyo nalimbile. Ee, efyo nalacita icalofye conse.

english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says the LORD, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”
translation: Imila 36:5-7

english: The LORD’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyaishile kuli kasesema Yeremia palwa mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: For that day is of the Lord, GOD of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
translation: “Buno bushiku, e bushiku bwakwa Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.
translation: We nacisungu mwana Egupto kabiye ku Gileadi,

english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”
translation: Abantu ba mishobo yonse nabomfwa ifyo imwe musebene,

english: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt:
translation: Ili e shiwi Yawe aebele kasesema Yeremia, ilyo Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni aishile kukulwisha icalo ca Egupto.

english: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’
translation: “Umeni imbila mu mishi ya mu Egupto,

english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because the LORD pushed them.
translation: Ngeco Apisi afulumukile cinshi?

english: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’
translation: Abashilika benu batalansuka, no kuwa nabawa.

english: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’
translation: Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto

english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.
translation: “Napalifye ine Umumi, efyasosa Imfumu,

english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Egupto,

english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
translation: Palwa calo ca Egupto, Yawe alandile pa mulandu wa fita fyakwa Farao Neko, imfumu ya calo ca Egupto, ifyo Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni acimfishe ku Kakemishi, mupepi no mumana wa Yufurate, mu mwaka walengele ine apo Yehoyakimu mwana Yosia atampile ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda. Atile ati,

english: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.
translation: “Egupto aba ngo musepela wa ŋombe uukota uwaina,

english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.
translation: Ne fita fya malipilo ifyo abena Egupto balemba incito yabushilika pakati kabo,

english: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.
translation: “Abena Egupto pakufulumuka balesakunya nge nsoka,

english: They will cut down her forest,” says the LORD, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.
translation: Abalwani baletemaula umutengo wa mu Egupto,

english: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”
translation: Umwana mwanakashi wa Egupto nasebana,

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, kabili aletila ati, “Mwalamona ifyo ine nalakanda Amoni, umulungu wa mu musumba wa Tebesi, nalakandila kumo kwine na Farao ne calo ca Egupto, ne milungu ilya ine iyabamo, kumo kwine ne ntungulushi ishabamo. Nalakanda Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto, pamo na bambi bene bonse abashinta umutima muli Farao.

english: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says the LORD.
translation: Ine ndebaposa ku bafwaya ukubepaya, kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni na kuli bacilolo bakwe. Lelo kwena kuntanshi abantu bakekala nakabili mu Egupto nge nshiku shakale. Nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
translation: “Imwe mwe bana ba mubomfi wandi Yakobo,

english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says the LORD, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
translation: Mwilatunsha mitima, imwe mwe bana ba mubomfi wandi Yakobo,

english: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!
translation: “Mwe fita fya bena Egupto,

english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.
translation: Pekanyeni bakabalwe benu, ninenipo.

english: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says the LORD.
translation: Elyo kabili Yawe aipusha ati,

english: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.
translation: Abalubilo nabafilwa ukwakufulumukila,

english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?
translation: “Nani ulya aletulumana ngo mumana wa Nailo,

english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’
translation: Ala ni Egupto euletumbana ngo mumana wa Nailo,

english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.
translation: Imeni mwe bakabalwe,

english: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
translation: Ilyo Farao imfumu ya mu Egupto ali talati asanse umusumba wa Gasa, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Yeremia palwa Bafilisiti.

english: The LORD says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,
translation: Bakulaumfwa inshindo sha bakabalwe,

english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
translation: Yoeli 3:4-8

english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?
translation: Saka 9:5-7

english: “‘You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’
translation: Amosi 1:6-8

english: “How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”
translation: Nga kuti lwatuushako shani,

english: Of Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.
translation: Palwa calo ca Moabu, Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, alilandilepo ati,

english: “Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

“Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.
translation: “Kanshi nomba kwalaisa inshiku shimo, ilyo ine ne Yawe nalatuma abakwisa itila icalo ca Moabu nga filya betila umwangashi. Tamwaise shala kantu mu mitondo yaciko iya mwangashi, ne mitondo ine balaisa itobaula.

english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
translation: Elyo abena Moabu baleikatwa ne nsoni pa mulandu wakwa Kemoshi umulungu wabo, nga filya fine aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli baiketwe ne nsoni ku Betele pa mulandu wa mulungu wabo, uo bashintilemo imitima.

english: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?
translation: “Mwe bena Moabu,

english: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.
translation: Icalo ca Moabu cili nokonaika pamo pene ne misumba yaciko,

english: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.
translation: Ishamo lya calo ca Moabu lyapalamina,

english: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’
translation: Akuloosheni aba bantu

english: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.
translation: “Imwe mwe baikala mu mushi wa Diboni,

english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’
translation: Mwe baikala mu mushi wa Aroeli,

english: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.
translation: Ukulumbuka kwa calo ca Moabu nakupwa.

english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
translation: Ala icalo ca Moabu nacisebana, pantu naconaika,

english: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,
translation: “Inshita naifika iyakupingwilapo imisumba iyaba mu calo icabatama neyi misumba ni Holoni, na Yasa, na Mefati,

english: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,
translation: na Diboni, na Nebo, na Beti Dibulataimu,

english: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,
translation: no musumba wa Kiriataimu, ne misumba ya Beti Gamuli, na Beti Meoni,

english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
translation: na Kerioti, no musumba wa Bosira. Inshita naifika iyakupingwilapo ne misumba yonse ya mu calo ca Moabu, iyakutali ne yamupepi.

english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says the LORD.
translation: Ubulamba bwa bena Moabu nababupwisha, amaka yabo nayapela. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.
translation: “Lengeni abena Moabu bakolwe, pantu balintalamina ine ne Yawe. Abena Moabu bakulaalanganafye mu malushi yabo, na bantu bambi bakulabawela.

english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
translation: Bushe temwe mwalewela abena Israeli? Bushe mwasangilishe bali pamo na bapupu, icakuti lyonse ilyo mwalebalandapo, mwalekuntafye imitwe pakubasuula?

english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Moabu, aleni fumenimo mu misumba yenu.

english: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.
translation: “Abena Moabu, ala tepacilumba mwe.

english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
translation: “Umfweni ifyo abena Holonaimu balekuuta, baleti,

english: I know his wrath,” says the LORD, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
translation: Ine ne Yawe nalishiba icilumba cabo.

english: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
translation: Awe kanshi ine kandelooshafye abena Moabu bonse,

english: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.
translation: Ine nakulaloosha abena Sibuma,

english: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.
translation: Mu calo ca mufundo ica Moabu,

english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.
translation: “Abena Heshiboni na bena Eleale baleloosha, ne misowa yabo ileumfwika na ku musumba wa Yahasi, na bena Soa nabo baleyumfwa. Ileumfwika na ku mushi wa Holonaimu, ukuya fikafye na ku misokolo ya Egilati Shelishiya, pantu no mumana wa Nimurimu nao naukama.

english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
translation: Ine ne Yawe Lesa ndepesha abena Moabu, pakuti cipwe icakutuula amalambo yakoca mu ncende ishasansama ne cakufutumwina milungu yabo ububani. Ee, nine ne Yawe ndelanda.

english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.
translation: “Eico ine ndelililakofye Moabu, na bantu bene abena Kiri Haleseti, ndi kwati muntu uulelisha ulwimbo lwa malilo muli mutolilo, pantu ifintu fyonse ifyo bali nafyo, nafiloba.

english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
translation: Abaume bonse nababeya inkuso ne myefu pakulanga ubulanda. Nabaitetaula bonse ku minwe, kabili bonse nabafwala insalu shabulanda.

english: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says the LORD.
translation: Pa mitenge ya mayanda yonse aya mu Moabu paleumfwikafye imisowa, na mu mansa shonse misowafye yeka ilimo, pantu ine ningonaula Moabu, kwati mutondo ntobawile uo umuntu nangu umo ashilefwaya. Nine ne Yawe ndelanda.

english: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”
translation: Yangu ifyo icalo ca Moabu caonaika ee! We misowa nobe! Ee, icalo ca Moabu casebana. Nacisanguka icasebana, na bantu ba mishobo yonse iyacishinguluka baleciwelafye.”

english: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
translation: Icalo ca Moabu naconaika,

english: For the LORD says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
translation: Pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
translation: Bakapoka imisumba,

english: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD.
translation: Abena Moabu bakaloba,

english: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says the LORD.
translation: Icintiinya, na macinga, ne fiteyo,

english: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.
translation: “Uukafulumuka icintiinya, akawila mu bucinga,

english: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
translation: “Imbutushi ishishimwene kwakulola,

english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.
translation: We bulanda nobe ku bena Moabu.

english: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
translation: “Kwena mu nshiku ishikesa nkabweseshamo ubunonshi muli cino calo ca Moabu.

english: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.
translation: Umfweni ifyo bele balelila,

english: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.
translation: ‘Mwe, mwalafwa, butukishenifye.

english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
translation: “Mwe bena Moabu mwashintile imitima mufyo mwacita,

english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.
Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.
translation: Peeleni amapindo kuli Moabu,

english: Of the children of Ammon. The LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?
translation: Palwa bena Amoni, ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.
translation: Nomba bamwana Esau, awe ine nimbapokafye tonse,

english: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: For the LORD says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.
For I have sworn by myself,” says the LORD, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”
translation: Amosi 1:13-15

english: I have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”
translation: Elyo nao Yeremia epakulanda ati, “Ine nimpokelelapo amashiwi ukufuma kuli Yawe. Yawe natuma inkombe imo iyile eba abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo ileti,

english: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
translation: Umushobo obe we Edomu ndi nokuucefya,

english: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
translation: Ubukali bobe ubutiinya abantu,

english: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.
translation: “Icalo ca Edomu calaonaika, icakuti abantu bonse abakulapitamo bakulatiina, bakulaseka no kulakunta imitwe pakumona fyonse ifyalaciponena.

english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.
translation: Nga filya fine cali kuli Sodoma na Gomora, ilyo ilya misumba yawile kumo kwine ne mishi iyali mumbali, ala efyo calaba na ku calo ca Edomu cine. Tamwakatale amwikalamo umuntu, nangufye umwana wa muntu ukusangwamo. Nine ne Yawe ndelanda.

english: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”
translation: Pakwisa, ine ndeisa nge nkalamo iyalompoka mu mushitu wa Yordani, pakuya ku mulemfwe uko abantu bacemena ifitekwa, elyo mpumikishe abena Edomu, mbafulumune na mu calo cabo. Elyo nkasalapo umo uo ne mwine nkatemwa, pakuti eo akaleteeka abantu ba uyu mushobo. Nga ine uo benganingako nani? Ngo wingandubulwisha ine nani? Mucemi nshi uwingancilima ine?

english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says the LORD.
translation: Cisuma, lelo kwena kwalaisa inshiku ilyo ine nalaleka abena musumba wa Raba bomfwe inkuuta sha nkondo. Ulya musumba wa bena Amoni walaba icibolya, ne mishi yauko yalatutaika ku mulilo. Elyo abena Israeli nabo balapokolola icalo cabo kuli balya bene babapokele. Nine ne Yawe Lesa ndelanda.

english: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
translation: Kanshi imwe kutikenifye kufyo ine ne Yawe napangila abena Edomu, na kufyo ine ndefwaya ukucita abantu abaikala mu musumba wa Temani. Na bana babo bene bakulabakuluntanya pakubasenda, na bantu bonse bakulapapafye.

english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
translation: Ilyo icalo ca Edomu cikawa, calaisa cita umukunto uwalaisa tensha ne sonde lyonse, ne nkuuta sha bantu shakulaumfwika na kuli Bemba Wakashika.

english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
translation: Abalwani balasansa umusumba wa Bosira, nga filya fine kapumpe uuli mu mulu apatali ekila paco amona panshi. Pali ubo bushiku imitima ya bashilika ba mu calo ca Edomu bakekatwa umwenso ngo mutima wa mwanakashi uukomenwe ifumo.”

english: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.
translation: Palwa musumba wa Damasiko, Yawe alanda ati,

english: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?
translation: Yangu ifyo ulya musumba uwalumbuka washala icibolya,

english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Ee, pali ubo bushiku abalumendo ababamo pamo pene na bashilika ababamo,

english: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”
translation: Ine nkoca amalinga ya musumba wa Damasiko,

english: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, The LORD says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.
They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’
translation: Mubatape amatenti yabo, ne fitekwa fyabo,

english: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
translation: “Pumenipo imisowa imwe mwe bena Heshiboni,

english: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says the LORD; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Hasoli, ine ne Yawe Lesa ndemusokako ukuti mufulumuke, muye fisama, pantu Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni namupangila imwe, napekanya ne fyakumucitila.

english: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says the LORD; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe ndetila, mwe bena Babiloni imeni muye lwisha balya bantu baiikalila ku matwi tondolo, abashisakamana kantu nelyo kamo. Umusumba wabo tawakwata mpongolo, nangufye imipilikisho, kabili tawakwata na bakuulonda.

english: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says the LORD.
translation: Muye tapa ingamila shabo, ne fitekwa fyabo fyonse. Balya bantu babeya inkuso, ine ndebasalanganishisha monse monse, ne finkunka ndebaletela filefuma mpanga yonse. Ee, nine ne Yawe nalanda.

english: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”
translation: “Umusumba wa Hasoli wakulaba pe icibolya,

english: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
translation: Ilyofye Sedekia atampile ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda, ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Yeremia palwa calo ca Elamu.

english: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alisosele ati “Ine nkepaya abena Elamu, balya bantu abacenjela ukuposa imifwi, abalenga ukuti icalo ca Elamu cikwatishe amaka.

english: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.
translation: Ine nkemya icimwela icikatula monse monse, no kulapukanya abena Elamu, kabili nkalenga bakasalangane konse konse, icakuti tapakashale calo nangu cimo ico bashakayeko.

english: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.
translation: Ine nkabaletela umwenso pakuti bakatiine abalwani babo abafwaya ukubepaya. Nkabalofya mu bukali, nkabakuutilila ne fita ifyakuti fikese balofyafye nakalya nakalya. Nine ne Yawe ndelanda.

english: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says the LORD.
translation: Ine nkalofya ishamfumu sha mu calo ca Elamu kumo kwine na bacilolo ababamo, elyo nkateekemo ne cipuna candi icabufumu.

english: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says the LORD.”
translation: “Kwena mu nshiku ishikesa ine nkabweseshamo abena Elamu ubunonshi. Ee, nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’
translation: Cinshi ico muleitakishisha pa mulandu wa mawanga yenu?

english: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.
translation: “Cenjeleni, ine nkamuletela umwenso ukufuma kuli bonse abamushinguluka. Imwe bonse bakamufulumuna. Tapakamoneke nelyo umo uwakuti akalonganye abafyuka nakabili iyoo. Nine ne Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita nalanda.

english: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says the LORD.
translation: “Kwena mu nshiku ishikesa ine nkabweseshamo ubunonshi bwa bena Amoni. Nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: Of Edom, the LORD of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
translation: Palwa bena Edomu, Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati,

english: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.
translation: Sefa 2:8-11

english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?
translation: Nga cakuti abakusombola baisa kuli iwe,

english: “If you will return, Israel,” says the LORD, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;
translation: Yawe alelanda ukuti,

english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”
translation: Elyo ine nasosa nati, “Yangu we Mfumu Yawe, cine cine walibepa apakalamba aba bantu pamo na bena Yerusalemu. Pantu wasosele auti, ‘Imwe mwakulaikala mu cibote,’ nomba ulupanga ulu lusontele pa mikoshi.”

english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.
translation: Pali ilya nshita, aba bantu pamo na bena Yerusalemu ine ne Yawe Lesa nkabeba nati, “Ala umwela uwakabisha ulya uletula mu matololo, nao uleishilila imwe mwe bantu bandi. Tawaise mukulamwela nga filya ucita pakwela iŋanu, nangu ukumusangulula iyoo.

english: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”
translation: Ala mwela uwamaka nganshi uwishila peshiwi nakonkomeshe. Eico nomba nine wine ndepingula abantu bandi.”

english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.
translation: Moneni umonaushi ulya aleisa nga makumbi,

english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu,

english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:
translation: Pantu ishiwi lilebilikisha ukufuma mu citungu cakwa Dani,

english: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.
translation: Lileti, “Sokeniko imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says the LORD.
translation: Balaisa shinga icalo ca Yuda, kwati bantu balelinda ibala,

english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”
translation: “Mwe bena Yuda nimwe mwe bene mwailetelela pa mibeele yenu,

english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
translation: Yangu we bucushi nobe ulakuula,

english: and you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”
translation: kabili nga mwalapa mu cishinka, mu bololoke na mu bulungami,

english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
translation: Ifinkunka filekonkanafye,

english: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
translation: Bushe ni lilali nkaleka ukulamonako uko balelwa inkondo,

english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”
translation: Yawe nao epakusosa ati,

english: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
translation: Ine ne Yeremia naliloleshe pa calo,

english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
translation: Nalolesha impili, namona shiletenta,

english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
translation: Nalolesha namona ukuti takuli bantu,

english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of the LORD, before his fierce anger.
translation: Nalolesha namona ukuti icalo icibamo ifitwalo cisangwike amatololo,

english: For the LORD says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
translation: Ifi efilesosa Yawe ati,

english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”
translation: Eico icalo cikaloosha,

english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.
translation: Ilyo bakomfwa icongo ca bantu abendela pali bakabalwe,

english: For the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
translation: Elyo kabili Yawe aeba abena Yuda na bena Israeli ati,

english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.
translation: Bushe iwe we wafunshika, finshi ulecita?

english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”
translation: Ine naumfwa inkuuta,

english: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
translation: Isembululeni pa mulandu wakwa Yawe,

english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’
translation: “Ishibisheni abena Yuda no kubilisha mu Yerusalemu mutile,

english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
translation: Imikeni icishibilo icakulangilila inshila iyakuya ku Sioni.

english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.
translation: Inkalamo naibuuka, ifumine umo ibelama,

english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of the LORD hasn’t turned back from us.
translation: Kanshi imwe fwalenifye insalu shabulanda,

english: “It will happen at that day,” says the LORD, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”
translation: “Pali ubo bushiku,” ifi efyasosa Yawe, “Imisana ya bashamfumu ne ya bacilolo ikaputuka. Bashimapepo bakalakankafye ku mwenso, bakasesema nabo amano yakabapela.”

english: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
translation: Yawe alyebele kasesema Yeremia palwa musumba wa Babiloni, na palwa calo ca bena Kaludea ati,

english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says the LORD.
translation: Ne calo cine ica Kaludea calatapwa, na balacitapa balesendafye fyonse ifyo bakulafwaya ukusenda. Nine ne Yawe nalanda.”

english: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Babiloni,

english: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
translation: ala nyinenwe alesebana apakalamba,

english: Because of the LORD’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
translation: Pa mulandu wa cipyu candi ine ne Yawe Lesa,

english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.
translation: “Tantameni, mushinguluke umusumba wa Babiloni,

english: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of the LORD. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.
translation: Weleni umusumba, umo monse muli mu mbali yauko.

english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.
translation: Tecakwesha kutandamo mbuto mu calo ca Babiloni,

english: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”
translation: “Israeli aba nge mpaanga iyilungwa no kupaswa ku nkalamo. Pakubala ni mfumu ya bena Asiria eyabalilepo ukumonaula, elyo kabili Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni nao aya mutobaula amafupa yakwe.

english: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
translation: Eico ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, ne Lesa wakwa Israeli, ndelimuna imfumu ya ku Babiloni, ndimune ne calo caiko, nga filya fine nalimwine imfumu ya bena Asiria.

english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
translation: Ine nkabwesesha Israeli ku calo cakwe. Akalalya icakulya cilya cikula pa lupili lwa Kameli na mu citungu ca Bashani, kabili akalalya na fyonsefye ifyo akalatemwa, filya fintu fikula pa tupili twa mu citungu cakwa Efulemu na mu citungu ca Gileadi.

english: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’
translation: “Umineni abantu ba mishobo imbila.

english: In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ukuti, ‘Muli shilya nshiku, ilyo ilya nshita ikafika, kukafwaikwa ukwishiba ububi bwakwa Israeli nomba tabwakabepo, no bubifi bwakwa Yuda, nomba tabwakasangwepo pantu abantu abo ine nkashapo, nkababelela uluse.’”

english: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says the LORD, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.
translation: “Aleni sanseni abena Merataimu

english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
translation: Intulubundi sha nkondo shileumfwika mu calo,

english: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
translation: Babiloni ali nge nondo iyaletobaula isonde lyonse,

english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against the LORD.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Babiloni namwikatwa ku citeyo,

english: The LORD has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
translation: Ne Yawe ninjisulamo mulya natutila ifyanso fyandi,

english: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.
translation: Aleni cisanseni monse monse,

english: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.
translation: Ipayeni abashilika babo bonse,

english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
translation: Imbutushi ishilefulumuka mu calo ca Babiloni no kwisa mu Sioni, umfweni isho shileshimika ifyo Yawe Lesa wesu alandwile abena Babiloni, pafyo baishile cita Itempele lyakwe.

english: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
translation: “Iteni abacenjela ukuposa imifwi, bese balwishe Babiloni. Itenifye bonse abaishiba ukukana amata. Mushinguluke umusumba, mwileka papusuke nelyo umo. Landuleni abena Babiloni pali fyonse ifyo balecita. Bacitenifye nga filya fine nabo balecita bambi, pantu balacita icilumba kuli ine ne Yawe Lesa, ne Wamushilo wakwa Israeli.

english: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.
translation: “Abantu ba mushobo umo uwabela lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, bakesa wililila icalo ca Babiloni, no kucisha amatololo. Abantu bakabutukamo kumo kwine ne nama, takwakabe umuntu uukekalamo nakalya.”

english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD.
translation: Kanshi abalumendo ababamo balafwila mu misebo ya mu musumba, na bashilika babo bonse ninshi baloba pali ubo bushiku. Nine ne Yawe ndelanda.

english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Babiloni mwalikwatisha icilumba,

english: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”
translation: Imwe mwe bantu ba mushobo wacilumba mwakulatalansuka,

english: The LORD of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.
translation: Elyo kabili Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Abena Israeli na bena Yuda tepakubacusha. Bonse ababasenda muli bunkole balibakonenamo, tabafwaya na kubalekamo nakalya.

english: Their Redeemer is strong. The LORD of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
translation: Nomba epo naba ne wabulamba, ne wakubalubulako, ne witwa Yawe umwine wa fita. Nine nalabatulanyako, no kuleka abantu baleikalila pano isonde ku matwi tondolo, abena Babiloni bena lishamofye elyo nalabaletela.”

english: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says the LORD, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.
translation: Balafwa lelo bakabuka babo ababufi,

english: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.
translation: Ipayeni bakabalwe babo,

english: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.
translation: Lekeni mu calo mulatauke imilale,

english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.
translation: “Eico kanshi mu musumba wa Babiloni mwakulaikalafye impaka na bamumbwe ne fipululu. Tamwakatale amwikala muntunse nelyo limo, takwakabe muntu uukasangwamo nakabili.

english: “In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek the LORD their God.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Muli shilya nshiku ilyo iyo inshita ikafika, abena Israeli pamo na bena Yuda bakabwela balelila, bakesa balemfwaya ine ne Yawe Lesa wabo.

english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.
translation: Nga filya fine cali ilyo ine naonawile Sodoma na Gomora kumo kwine ne mishi iyali mumbali, efyo nalacita na Babiloni wine. Tamwakatale amwikalamo umuntu, nangufye umwana wa muntu ukusangwamo. Nine ne Yawe Lesa nalanda.

english: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
translation: “Moneni! Umulongo wa bashilika uli mukwisa, uletula ku calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso,

english: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.
translation: Bali na mata na mafumo,

english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.
translation: Pakumfwa umulandu, imfumu ya mu Babiloni mu maboko mwatalala na tondolo.

english: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”
translation: “Pakwisa, ine ne Yawe Lesa ndeisa nge nkalamo iyalompoka mu mushitu wa Yordani, pakuya ku mulemfwe uko abantu bacemena ifitekwa, elyo mpumikishe abena Babiloni, mbafulumune na mu musumba wabo. Elyo nkasalapo umo uo ne mwine nkatemwa, pakuti eo akaleteeka abantu ba uyu mushobo. Nga ine uo benganingako nani? Ngo wingandubulwisha ine nani? Mucemi nshi uwingancilima ine?

english: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
translation: Kanshi imwe kutikenifye kufyo ine ne Yawe napangila umusumba wa Babiloni, na kufyo ine ndefwaya ukucita icalo ca bena Kaludea. Ee, na bana babo bene bakulabakululula pakubasenda, na bantu bonse bakulapapafye.

english: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.
translation: Ilyo umusumba wa Babiloni walawa, walaisa cita umukunto uwalaisa tensha ne sonde lyonse, na bantu ba mishobo imbi bakulaumfwa inkuuta sha bena Babiloni.”

english: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’
translation: Bakepusha inshila iyalola ku Sioni, no kulungama eko bakalungama bakalasosa abati, ‘Tuleyeni tuilunde kuli Yawe, no kupangana nankwe icipangano ca pe icishakatale acilabwa.’

english: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.
translation: “Abantu bandi baba nge mpaanga ishaluba, isho bakacema balekafye shilelulumba mu mpili. Bendaukafye nge mpaanga ishitila shafuma mu lupili lumo kabili shaya mu lupili lunankwe, shasuka shaluba no kwabela umushi washiko.

english: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of righteousness, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
translation: Bonse abashikumanya, balashisansa. Abalwani babo balalanda abati, ‘Ifwe tatuli na mulandu pantu balibifya kuli Yawe umucemi wabo uwacishinka. Yawe uo ifikolwe fyabo fyasubilemo.’

english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
translation: “Imwe mwe bena Israeli, fulumukenimo mu Babiloni. Fumenimo mu calo ca bena Kaludea. Nimwe balilenipo ukufumamo ngefyo basawe batangilila umukuni.

english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.
translation: Ine nalakuwisha ibumba limo ilya bantu ba mishobo iyamaka iyabela lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, pakuti bawililile Babiloni. Abo bantu balaisa shinguluka umusumba, no kuupoka baleupoka. Bena baposa imifwi nga bafundi wa nama abene bene, abashipusa ico bapimine ukulasa.

english: The LORD says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: ‘The LORD has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.’
translation: Eya. Tepapa Yawe alitupokokolola.

english: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! The LORD has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
translation: Aleni noneni imifwi,

english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for the LORD has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
translation: Peeleni icishibilo icakusansa amalinga ya musumba wa Babiloni.

english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.
translation: Mu Babiloni mwaba imimana iyingi,

english: The LORD of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alilapa ati, “Napalifye ine, nalapa ukuti ine nkaletela Babiloni abantu ababa nga makanta ku bwingi, nabo bakawelesha pakukucimfya.”

english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.
translation: Ni Yawe ewabumba icalo ku makafye yakwe,

english: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.
translation: Eutila nga abulukuta mukupeela icebo,

english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
translation: Abantu bonse bawelewele kabili tababa na mano,

english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.
translation: Finangwafye, kabili imilimo yabuwelewele

english: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.
translation: Lesa uwaba icakaniko cakwa Yakobo ena taba ifi iyoo,

english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.
translation: Nalatuma abenafyalo abakululula Babiloni,

english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.
translation: Yawe alanda ukuti,

english: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.
translation: Niwe nalepaminako bakabalwe, na baleendelapo bene,

english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.
translation: Niwe naleipailako abaume na banakashi bene,

english: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.
translation: Niwe naleipailako bakacema ne mpaanga shabo shine,

english: “I will render to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says the LORD.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Mwalamonako uko ine nalalinganya Babiloni na bena Kaludea bene pa fibi fyonse ifyo bacitile mu Sioni pa menso yenu.

english: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says the LORD, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.
translation: “Babiloni, iwe waba ngo lupili ulonaula icalo conse, ine nomba nakwalukila, uli mulwani wandi. Ine nkakwikatisha nkakufumya apo pamulu pa fimabwe, ndi nokukuposa panshi, nkakusangule ulupili ulwapya ku mulilo.

english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says the LORD.
translation: Pa fitantala fyobe tapakabe uukabuulapo ilibwe lyakukuulila pa cifutu, nangu ilibwe lyakukuulila mu mufula, pantu uli nokubafye icibolya ca pe na pe. Nine ne Yawe Lesa nalanda.”

english: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!
translation: “Peeleni icishibilo mu calo icakusanshilapo.

english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!
translation: Mukungule ne shamfumu sha bena Media,

english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of the LORD against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
translation: Icalo conse ciletenta ku mwenso,

english: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!
translation: Mwileka abashilika ba bena Babiloni bakane mu mata yabo,

english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.
translation: Ifita fya bena Babiloni fyaleka ukulwa inkondo,

english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.
translation: Uwalubilo abutuka ukufika pa walubilo munankwe,

english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”
translation: Nokuti abalwani nabapoka ifyabu fya pa mumana,

english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”
translation: Umwana mwanakashi Babiloni aba ngo mubansa wakupulilapo,

english: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.
translation: Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni nasantaula Yerusalemu

english: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.
translation: “Lekeni ulukakala ulo abena Babiloni bacitile kuli ifwe lube pali bena.”

english: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.
translation: Kanshi Yawe asosa ati,

english: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
translation: Elyo umusumba wa Babiloni ukasanguka icibolya,

english: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.
translation: Abena Babiloni babuluma capamo nge nkalamo,

english: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the LORD.
translation: Ilyo balekabila ukulya,

english: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.
translation: Lekeni balaswe bafwile na mu calo cabo cine ica bena Kaludea,

english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.
translation: Nkabasenda nga bana ba mpaanga,

english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
translation: “Owe Babiloni napokwa,

english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
translation: Bemba naimina Babiloni,

english: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.
translation: Imisumba ya ku Babiloni ishele ifibolya,

english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.
translation: Ine nalalimuna Beli, cilya cilubi cilesa ca mu Babiloni,

english: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from the LORD’s fierce anger.
translation: “Fulumukenimo imwe mwe bantu bandi.

english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
translation: Mwifupuka iyoo,

english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.
translation: Eico kanshi mwalamona ukuti inshita imo yalafika,

english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says the LORD.
translation: Elyo fyonse ifyaba mu mulu na pano isonde fyakulayanga ne nsansa,

english: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.
translation: “Babiloni alipaulula abantu ba pano isonde ponse,

english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by the LORD of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Ine ne Lesa ne Yawe umwine wa fita

english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember the LORD from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”
translation: “Mwe bantu bandi mwe baba mu Babiloni,

english: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.”
translation: Imwe mulasosa amuti,

english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.
translation: “Kanshi ine ne Yawe ndesosa ukuti,

english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says the LORD.
translation: Babiloni nangu enganina mu mulu mumbi mumbi,

english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
translation: Umfweni inkuuta mu Babiloni,

english: For the LORD lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.
translation: Yawe aleonaula Babiloni,

english: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for the LORD is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.
translation: Ifyakonaula Babiloni fili mukwisa,

english: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.
translation: “Bacilolo ababamo ine nalabapeela ifyakuti fibakole,

english: The LORD of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”
translation: Amalinga ya Babiloni ayatikamisha yalabongoloka,

english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.
translation: Aya e mashiwi Yeremia kasesema akonkomeshe Seraya mwana Neriya, mwishikulu Maseya, ilyo baile ku Babiloni na Sedekia imfumu ya calo ca Yuda, mu mwaka walengele ine ukufuma apo Sedekia atampile ukulateeka icalo ca Yuda. Seraya ali ni mushika wa pa bulendo.

english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of the LORD’s vengeance. He will render to her a recompense.
translation: Fulumukenimo mu Babiloni.

english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
translation: Yeremia alilembele mu katabo kamo ifinkunka fonse ifili nokuponena Babiloni, alilembelemo ne milandu imbi yonse palwa Babiloni.

english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,
translation: Alyebele Seraya ati, “Nga wafika ku Babiloni, iwe ukaposeko amano kuli aya mashiwi yonse ayalembelwe, kabili ukaye mukulaikatisha pakubelengela abantu.

english: and say, ‘LORD, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’
translation: Elyo kabili ukakonkanyepo no kupepa auti, ‘We Yawe, niwe wasosele ukuti uli nokonaula ino ncende, pakuti mwikalaikalafye nelyo cimo icipema, nangufye abantu atemwa inama, nokuti ino ncende ikasanguka amatololo ya pe.’

english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.
translation: Seraya, iwe nga wapwa ukubelengela abantu amashiwi yonse ayali muli aka katabo, elyo ukabuule akatabo kene, ukakakakile ku libwe limo, ukakapose na pa mumana wa Yufurate,

english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
translation: ukatile nokuti, ‘Efyo cikaba na kuli Babiloni. Akaloba, takabukuluke na limbi nakalya, pa mulandu wa finkunka ifyo Yawe alamuletela.’”

english: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.
translation: Babiloni ali ngo lukombo lwa golide ulo Yawe aikete mu minwe,

english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.
translation: Babiloni awafye mukwangufyanya, no konaika naonaika.

english: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
translation: Elyo abeni abaikalamo nabo epakwasuka abati,

english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
translation: Sedekia ali ne myaka amakumi yabili na umo (21) ilyo atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu, kabili ateekele mu Yerusalemu imyaka ikumi limo na umo (11). Nyina ishina lyakwe ali ni Hamutali, mwana Yeremia uwafumine ku Libina.

english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
translation: Ku Ribula kwine eko imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaipaila na bamwana Sedekia abaume, ninshi na Sedekia wine no kumona alemonako. Eko yaipaila na bacilolo bonse aba mu calo ca Yuda.

english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.
translation: Elyo yatonkola Sedekia amenso, yamukaka ne minyololo ya mukuba, yamutwala na ku Babiloni. Mu Babiloni Sedekia aikele mu cifungo ukushintafye no bushiku afwililepo.

english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo mu mweshi walenga isano, mu mwaka walenga ikumi limo na pabula (19) apo Nebukadinesa atampile ukuteeka pa bufumu mu Babiloni, elintu Nebusaradani aingile mu musumba wa Yerusalemu. Uyu Nebusaradani ali ni shicilye wa mfumu, kabili ewali mushika mukalamba uwa fita fyaiko.

english: He burned the LORD’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.
translation: Esek 12:13

english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.
