translation: Ifita fyonse ifya bena Kaludea ifyali no mukalamba wa bakalinda ba mfumu batobaula na malinga ayashingulwike umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
translation: Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda wa mfumu asenda muli bunkole abantu bamo abalanda na bonse abashele mu musumba, pamo pene na bantu abafyukile ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni. Asendela kumo na bantu abacenjela mu fyakutukuta tukuta.

english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.
translation: Lelo Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda ashako abekalacalo bamo abalanda nganshi abakuti balesunga imyangashi elyo no kulalima amabala.

english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.
translation: Abena Kaludea batobaula inceshi sha mukuba, ne fyakuteekapo ifyashinguluka elyo ne cakusambilamo ca mukuba ifyali mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, basenda no mukuba onse ku Babiloni.

english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
translation: Kabili basenda imipika, bafosholo, ifyakukushilamo imito, ifyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto, imbale elyo na fyonse ifipe fya mukuba ifyo balebomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.
translation: Umukalamba wa bakalinda wa mfumu asendafye fyonse ifyapangilwe na golide na silifa, emukuti utubale utunono, ne mbabula, ne mbale ishikulu umwalesumina umulopa wa nama sha malambo, ne fyakukushilapo imito, ne fyakutekapo amalampi, ne mbale sha bubani, ne fyakwitulwilako imituulo ya fyakunwa.

english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
translation: Sedekia alecita ifintu ifyabipa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, nga filya fine ne mfumu Yehoyakimu yalecita.

english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for the LORD’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.
translation: Asenda umukuba wa ku nceshi shibili, icakusambilamo ne fimpashanya fya bacilume ba ŋombe ikumi na babili (12) abalecikatilila, ne fyakutekapo ifyashinguluka ifyo Solomoni apangile ifya mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe, fyena fyalicililemo ukufina kanshi balifililwe no kufipima.

english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.
translation: Esek 33:21

english: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.
translation: Pa mulu wa luceshi lumo pali umutwe wa mukuba uwalepele amakubiti yasano elyo mu mbali ya mutwe mwali umushingo uo baengelelemo amateke ukushinguluka. Uluceshi lubiye pamo na mateke yaluko fyalifye cimo cine.

english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.
translation: Kwali amateke amakumi pabula na mutanda (96) ayaleselela mumbali, amateke yonse pamo ayashingulwike icapikulwa yali umwanda umo (100).

english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,
translation: Kabili Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda asenda Seraya shimapepo mukalamba, Sefania shimapepo wamukonkelepo na bakalinda wa pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe batatu ukuba abafungwa.

english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.
translation: Ku bashelepo mu musumba, asenda uwaletungulula ifita elyo na bampandamano cine lubali aba kwisano. Asenda na kalemba uwali cilolo mukalamba wa bashilika ba nkondo uwalesunga imilandu ya bulwi elyo na bambi abaume amakumi mutanda (60) abasangilwe mu musumba.

english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
translation: Awe Nebusaradani umukalamba wa bakalinda abatwala bonse ku mfumu ya ku Babiloni iyali mu mushi wa Ribula.

english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
translation: Kulya kwine ku Ribula, mu calo ca ku Hamati, eko imfumu yabepaila. Kanshi efyo abena Yuda baile muli bunkole, ukutali ne calo cabo.

english: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;
translation: Impendwa ya bantu abo Nebukadinesa asendele muli bunkole eiyi.

english: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ikumi limo na cine konse konse (18) apo Nebukadinesa abelele pa bufumu, mu Yerusalemu asendelemo abantu imyanda cine konse konse na makumi yatatu na babili (832).

english: For through the LORD’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wakuti Yawe alifulilwe, ecalengele fyonse ifi ficitike kuli Yerusalemu na kuli Yuda, na pakulekelesha abafumya pa cinso cakwe.

english: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.
translation: Mu mwaka walengele amakumi yabili na itatu (23) apo Nebukadinesa aikalile pa bufumu, Nebusaradani asendele Abayuda imyanda cine lubali na makumi yane na basano (745).

english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na cine lubali (37) apo basendele Yehoiyakini imfumu ya bena Yuda muli bunkole, pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na busano (25) mu mweshi we kumi limo na ibili (12), emo imfumu Efili Merodaki atendeke ukuteeka pa bufumu bwa bena Babiloni. Abelela Yehoiyakini uluse, amufumya na mu cifungo.

english: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
translation: Efili Melodaki alemutentemba, alimupeele ne cipuna icacindamisha pa fipuna fya shamfumu shimbi shonse ishali pamo na Yehoiyakini muli bunkole mu Babiloni.

english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.
translation: Kanshi Yehoiyakini epakufula ifyakufwala fya mu cifungo, elyo na mu nshiku shonse isha bumi bwakwe lyonse alalya kwisano lya mfumu.

english: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
translation: Inshiku shonse ukushinta napo afwilile, imfumu ya ku Babiloni yalemupeelafye fyonse ifyo alekabila cila bushiku.

english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.
translation: Kanshi mu mwaka walenga pabula uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Sedekia, pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo, Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni yaima mukuya lwisha Yerusalemu ne fita fyakwe fyonse. Fyakuula inkambi kunse ya musumba elyo bashingulusha imina ya maloba ne fintu fimbi ifyakubomfya pakupokolola umusumba.

english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
translation: Ifita fyashingulwike umusumba ukufika pa mwaka we kumi limo na umo (11) uwa pa bufumu bwakwa Sedekia.

english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga pabula mu mweshi walenga bune, insala mu musumba yakulisha icakuti abantu balafilwa no kumona icakulya.

english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,
translation: Amalinga ya ku musumba epakulabongoloka. Pakumona ifi, imfumu Sedekia na bashilika bonse aba mu musumba bena bafulumuka ubushiku, ninshi na bena Kaludea nabashinguluka umusumba. Bakonka inshila iyalola kwibala lya mfumu, bapitila pa mpongolo iyaba pakati ka fibumba fibili, balola na ku Araba.

english: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
translation: Nomba ifita fya bena Kaludea fyakunkunika imfumu Sedekia, mpaka fyamwikatila mu mawanga ya Yeriko, na bashilika bakwe bonse ninshi basalangana ukufuma kuli ena.

english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
translation: Fyati fikate imfumu, awe fyaitwala na kuli Nebukadinesa imfumu ya ku Babiloni, ilyo ninshi wena ali ku mushi wa Ribula mu calo ca Hamati, uko kwine eko na Nebukadinesa apingwila Sedekia umulandu.

english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu,

english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not the LORD’s.
translation: “Kabiyeni mu mabala yabo aya myangashi no kuyonaula,

english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says the LORD.
translation: Pantu aba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli na ba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda balinsangukila.”

english: They have denied the LORD, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
translation: Abantu balilanda ifyabufi pali Yawe.

english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
translation: Kabili balasosa abati, “Bakasesema babafye ngo mupu,

english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
translation: Eico Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita alanda ukuti,

english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says the LORD. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
translation: E bantu abacenjela ukuposa imifwi pakwipaya,

english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.
translation: Bakesa onaula ifyo mukasombola ne fyakulya fyenu fimbi.

english: “But even in those days,” says the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Lelo nangu ni muli isho shine nshiku, awe nshakapwishishishe ukonaula abantu bandi iyoo.

english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
translation: Ilyo abantu bakakwipusha abati, ‘Nga cinshi ico Yawe Lesa wesu atucitile ifi fyonse?’ Iwe ukabasukefye auti, ‘Ngefi fine imwe mwapondokela Yawe, mwalapepa ne milungu iya benafyalo muli cino calo cenu, efyo na imwe bene mukaya mukulabombela abenafyalo mu calo icishili cenu.’”

english: Though they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
translation: Nangu mulanda pakulapa amuti,

english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
translation: Kebe aba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo, kabilishe ku bena Yuda utile,

english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
translation: “Kutikeni kuno mwe batumpa kabili mwe mpelwamano sha bantu.

english: Don’t you fear me?’ says the LORD; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’
translation: Bushe cinshi ico imwe mushankwatila akatiina?”

english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
translation: Nomba imwe mwe bantu, mwakwata imitima iyatalama kabili iya busangu.

english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’
translation: Imwe mu mitima yenu tamusosa nokuti,

english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
translation: Nomba imwe ifyabupulumushi fyenu efyalenga ifi fintu ukumutaluka,

english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
translation: “Pali imwe bene mwe bantu bandi epo bali ababifi,

english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
translation: Nga filya fine umupalu esusha ifyuni muli kasalanga wakwe,

english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.
translation: Ecalenga ukuti babe abaina kabili abatelela imibili.

english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
translation: Bushe teti mbalimune pa mulandu wa ifi fintu?

english: O LORD, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
translation: We Yawe bushe amenso yobe tayafwaya ukumona icishinka?

english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.
translation: “Icintu icabunani, kabili icakupapusha,

english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
translation: Bakasesema balesesemafye ifyabufi,

english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the LORD’s way, nor the law of their God.
translation: Elyo ine natontonkanya nati,

english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of the LORD, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
translation: Kanshi ine ndeya ku bantu ababatungulula,

english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
translation: Eico inkalamo ikafumina mu mutengo,

english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
translation: “Kuti namubelela shani uluse?

english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
translation: Baba nga bakabalwe abaina,

english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
translation: Bushe ine teti mbakandilepo pali ifi fintu, mwa?”

english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Benjamini, fulumukileni kumo ukwakupusukila!

english: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the LORD’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.
translation: Na ine epakwasukako nati,

english: Therefore I am full of the LORD’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.
translation: Eico icipyu cakwa Yawe ciswile muli ine,

english: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD.”
translation: Amayanda yabo yakapeelwa kuli bambi,

english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.
translation: “Pantu abakalamba na banono bene,

english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
translation: Bakakila abantu bandi ifilonda,

english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says the LORD.
translation: Bushe baleumfwa insoni,

english: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe alesosa ati,

english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’
translation: Elyo Yawe abeba ati,

english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.
translation: Kanshi Yawe nao epakusosa ati,

english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
translation: Umfweni mwe ba pano isonde bonse,

english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
translation: Ndi nokonaula umwana mwanakashi Sioni,

english: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
translation: Nga bulya ububani fulankinisenshi bafumya ku Sheba bwanshi kuli ine?

english: Therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”
translation: Eico kanshi ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: The LORD says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe,

english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”
translation: Balya baleisa nabaipangasha amata na mafumo yabo,

english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
translation: Abena Yerusalemu nabo epakwasuka abati,

english: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.
translation: Tuletiina no kulafumina mu mpanga,

english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
translation: “Imwe mwe bantu bandi, fwaleni insalu shabulanda,

english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
translation: “Niwe nabika ukuba uwakwesha abantu bandi,

english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
translation: Bonse bene basangu abaumalala nganshi,

english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
translation: Nangu bengafukuta umuuba shani pakuti incelo ikabishe,

english: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”
translation: Bakacema ne mikuni yabo bakamwishilila,

english: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
translation: Abantu bandi bene bakulaitwa silifa iyasuulwako,

english: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
translation: Bakesa tila, “Ipekanyeni kukulwisha Yerusalemu.

english: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”
translation: Imwe iteyanyeni. Tuyelwisha Yerusalemu ubushiku,

english: For the LORD of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati,

english: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.
translation: Nga filya fine mu cishima mufukauka amenshi cila nshita no kukanaleka,

english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”
translation: Cenjela iwe we Yerusalemu,

english: The LORD of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati,

english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Yeremia aliti,

english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
translation: Elyo mwaisa iminina pa cinso candi muli ino ŋanda yandi, iyainikwa peshina lyandi, mwalati nokuti, “Nomba twapusuka,” elyo kabinge mwaya konkanyapo ukulacita ifyabunani ifi fyonse ifyo napata.

english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.
translation: Bushe imwe mutila ino ŋanda yandi iyapeelwa ishina lyandi yakubelamamo abapupu, batini? Ala ine ndaimwena ifyo imwe mucita.’ Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
translation: “Muletala mwaya ku musumba wa Shilo, kuli ilya ncende nabalilepo ukusala ukuti epo abantu bandi balempepela, pakuti mwaya imwena mwe bene ifyo ine nacitilepo pa bubi bwa bantu bandi abena Israeli.

english: Now, because you have done all these works,” says the LORD, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;
translation: Imwe mulacita ifi fibi fyonse ifyo ine numbwile. Nangu ine ndamusokako libili libili, awe imwe mulakaana ukumfwa, mulakaaninapo no kunjasuka nga ndemwita. Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
translation: Kanshi nomba ino ŋanda yandi iyo imwe mwashintamo imitima, ine nkaicita fimo fine nga filya nacitile ku Shilo. Muli ino ncende iyo ine namupeela imwe, iyo napeele na bashinwe bene.

english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.
translation: Nkamutamfya pa cinso candi, nga filya fine nacitile na bamunyinenwe bonse aba mu luko lwakwa Efulemu.”

english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
translation: “Iwe Yeremia, ala wilapapatilako aba bantu. Wilabalililako, nangu ukulabapepelako iyoo, wilabapapatilako uko ndi, pantu ine nshakulakumfwa.

english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation: Bushe iwe taulemona ifintu balecita mu misumba ya muli cino calo ca Yuda, na mu misebo ya mu Yerusalemu?

english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
translation: Abaice ebaleteba inkuni, abaume ebalekosha umulilo, abanakashi nabo ebalekasa umufuba uwakupangila umulungu imikate, ako abene beta abati, e namfumu wa mu mulu. Kabili aba bantu ebatuula ne milungu imbi umutuulo wa fyakunwa, pakunkalifyafye umutima.

english: Do they provoke me to anger?” says the LORD. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
translation: Elyo bushe kwena nine bakalifya umutima?” Ifi efyasosa Yawe. “Bailetelelafye abene no kuisebanya.”

english: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”
translation: “Keminine pa mpongolo ya ŋanda yakwa Yawe, uye mukulabila imbila yakwe auti, ‘Umfweni ishiwi lyakwa Yawe imwe mwe bena Yuda bonse, mwe bengilila pali ino mpongolo pakuya kukupepa Yawe.’

english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”
translation: Eico ifi efyasosa Imfumu Yawe ati, “Nkalacita icipyu candi no bukali bwandi pali ino ncende. Abantu kumo kwine ne nama, imiti ya ku mabala kumo kwine ne fisabo fya ku mushili, ala fikabilima ku mulilo, no wakuushimya takwakabe.”

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli, asosa ati, “Mulelyafye amalambo yenu ayakoca pamo na malambo yambi, mulelya inama mwe bene.

english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;
translation: Pantu ilyo ine nafumishe ifikolwe fyenu mu calo ca Egupto, nshafipeele cebo palwa malambo ayakoca, na palwa malambo yambi yene.

english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
translation: Lelo nalibapeele ici cipope icakumbeela, pakuti ine ndeba Lesa wabo, nabo baleba abantu abandifye. Kabili bashinwe ine nalibebele ukulaenda mu mibeele iyo ine nabakonkomeshe, epakuti ifintu fileba bwino uko bali.

english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
translation: Nomba bena tebakumbeela nakalya, kabili tebakuposako na mano iyoo. Bena kutalamafye, no kulakonkelela ifya lunkumbwa lwa mitima yabo iyibi, kanshi epakulaya balebipilakofye.

english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
translation: Ukufumafye pa bushiku ubo bashinwe bafuminepo mu Egupto ukushinta na pali buno bushiku, ine nabikapofye ukulatuma ababomfi bandi bakasesema.

english: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
translation: Lelo tamwaumfwile kuli ine nangu ukuposako amano nakalya. Imwe mwakosafye ndii, mwalicila na pa fikolwe fyenu kukubifya.

english: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
translation: “Kanshi iwe ukabebe aya mashiwi yonse, lelo tabakomfwe iyoo. Ukabete, nomba awe tabakakwasuke iyoo.

english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
translation: Eico, iwe ukabebe auti, ‘Umushobo wenu imwe walikaana ukulabeela Yawe Lesa wenu, kabili walikaana ukuti Yawe aleulungika. Imwe icishinka calipwa. Mwalileka no kucilandapo.’

english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
translation: “Akuloosheni imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu,

english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita, Lesa wakwa Israeli aletila ati, ‘Imwe wamyeni imyendele yenu ne micitile yenu, lyena ninshi na ine nakulaleka muleikalilila muli ino ncende.

english: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says the LORD. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
translation: “Pantu abena Yuda nabacita icintu icibi. Utulubi twabo uto ine napatisha, bena etuntu babikile mu ŋanda iyitwa peshina lyandi, no kuikowesha nabaikowesha.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.
translation: “Mu mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu nabakuulamo ubulambo ubo baleita Tofeti, epakuti epo baleocela abana babo abaume na banakashi pakubaleka ilambo. Tene nabakonkomeshe ukulacita ifi, awe, kabili na ku mano yandi ine tacabako nakalya.”

english: Therefore behold, the days come”, says the LORD, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe. “Eico cenjeleni pantu inshita imo ikafika ilyo cikapwa icakulumbula ishina lya Tofeti, nangu ilya mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu. Ulya mupokapoka ukalaitwa Umupokapoka Wakwipailamo, pantu mu mupokapoka umwaba Tofeti bakashiikamo abantu icakuti ne ncende ikacepe.

english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.
translation: Ifitumbi fya bantu fikaba e cakulya ca fyuni neca finama fyampanga, no wakufitamfyapo takamoneke nakalya.

english: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”
translation: Mu misumba ya muno calo ca Yuda na mu misebo ine iya mu Yerusalemu, ine nshakaleke mukaleumfwika nakabili utupundu twansansa, nangufye amashiwi ya bashibwinga naya banabwinga. Icalo cikasanguka amatololo.”

english: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’
translation: Lekeni ukulasumina amashiwi yabufi ayakutila, “Lino Litempele lyakwa Yawe, lino Litempele lyakwa Yawe, ala lino Litempele lyakwa Yawe.”

english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
translation: “‘Pantu nga mwawamya imyendele yenu ne micitile yenu, kabili mwaleka ukulafyenga abanenu,

english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,
translation: mwaleka no kulafyenga abenafyalo, na bakashiwa, na bamukamfwilwa, mwaleka no kulaipaya abakaele muli ino ncende, mwaleka no kulapepa imilungu, pantu uyo musango imwe ukamuletelela.

english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.
translation: Nga mwafileka, ninshi ine nakulaleka muleikalilila muli cino calo, ico ine napeele ifikolwe fyenu pakuti emo bakaleikala pe na pe.

english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
translation: “‘Mwamona, imwe mucetekelafye mu mashiwi ayabufi kabili ayafye.

english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
translation: Bushe kuti mwatala mwaiba, mwaipaya abantu, mwacita ubupulumushi, mwalapa ubufi, mwafutumwina Baali ububani, kabili mwapepa ne milungu iyo mushaishiba nefyo yaba.

english: “At that time,” says the LORD, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.
translation: “Pali iyo nshita amafupa ya bashamfumu, na ya bacilolo ba mu calo ca Yuda, kumo kwine na ya bashimapepo, na ya bakasesema, na ya bena Yerusalemu bambi bene, yakashulwa mu nindi shabo.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe.

english: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.
translation: Kanshi ine nomba nkabuula abakashi babo,

english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.
translation: Bakakila ifilonda fya bantu bandi,

english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says the LORD.
“‘I will utterly consume them, says the LORD. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”
translation: “Ine ne Yawe nkalofya bonse abantu bandi,

english: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for the LORD our God has put us to silence, and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
translation: Abantu bakwa Lesa nabo epakulaipushanya abati,

english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
translation: Ifwe twalelolela ukulaikala mu cibote,

english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell therein.”
translation: “Natumfwa uko bakabalwe ba balwani besu balelila,

english: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says the LORD.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Moneni.

english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.
translation: Owe, ubulanda ine bwankulila,

english: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t the LORD in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?” “Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign idols?”
translation: Kutikeni ku kulila kwa bantu bandi,

english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
translation: “Ayo mafupa bakayashafye insansalila pa kasuba, mu mweshi, na mu lubuuto lwa ntanda shonse isha mu mulu, pantu efintu bena batemenwe, efyo balebombela, efyo balepandako amano, no kupepa efyo balepepa. Amafupa yabo tabakayalonganye pamo no kuyashiika iyoo, yakashalafye ifyo fine pa mushili nga citindi.

english: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
translation: Abantu nabo epakukuuta abati,

english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.
translation: Ine cilenkalipa nganshi mu mutima,

english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
translation: Bushe mu calo ca Gileadi umuti walipwamo?

english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Na bantu bambi bonse aba iyi nkulo iyabipa, abakashala abaleikala uko ine nkabasalanganya, bakalafwaishapo ukufwa ukucila ukwikala no mweo.” Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?
translation: “Iwe Yeremia, ubebe ukuti, ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.
translation: Nga cinshi ico imwe mwe bantu bandi mupumbile inshila?

english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.
translation: Ine ndakutikisha nganshi,

english: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know the LORD’s law.
translation: Ngefyo na kabaso wine mu lwelele alishiba inshita yakubwelelapo,

english: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and the LORD’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.
translation: “Nga kuti mwatila shani,

english: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected the LORD’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?
translation: Abantu abamano bakalengwa insoni,

english: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
translation: Nga caliweme umutwe wandi, auba nge cishima ca menshi,

english: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.
translation: Elyo ine nasosa nati, “Awe nakulaloosha impili,

english: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
translation: Yawe nao epakusosa ati,

english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?
translation: Nani uukwetepo amano ayakutesha umo ici cintu cilolele? Nani uo Yawe alondolwelako, pakuti nao amone ukulondolwelako bambi? Nga mulandu nshi icalo caonaikila nkuma ndi kwati matololo, icakuti takuli nelyo umo uwakupitamo?

english: The LORD says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,
translation: Elyo Yawe nao ayasuka ati, “Icilengele ukuti cibe ifi, nico abantu bandi balisuula amafunde yandi ayo ine nabapeela. Tabambeela iyoo, tabacita ifyo ine nabeba ukulacita.

english: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”
translation: Lelo bena bakonka ukumalala kwa mitima yabo, batwalilila nokupepa imilungu ba Baali, nga mulya mwine bashibo babafundile.

english: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
translation: Eico kanshi ifi efyo nalacita ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, ine ne Lesa wakwa Israeli. Ine nalaliisha abantu bandi ifyalula, nalabanwensha na menshi umuli umunwena.

english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”
translation: Ine ndebasalanganya ukuya mu bantu ba mishobo iyo bashaishiba, iyo ne fikolwe fyabo fine fishaishibe, kabili nkabemisha inkondo pakuti nkabalofyefye nakalya nakalya.”

english: The LORD of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alesosa ifi ati,

english: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.
translation: Abantu nabo bayasukapo abati,

english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’”
translation: Umfweni imisowa ya bantu mu Sioni abo baleti,

english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
translation: Lelo kwena ine kuti natemwishapo ukusangapo incende imo mu matololo,

english: Yet hear the LORD’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.
translation: Elyo ine nasosa nati,

english: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.
translation: imfwa itwingilile mu mawindo yesu,

english: Speak, “The LORD says, “‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’”
translation: Ifitumbi fya bantu fyalaba ntangali ntangali,

english: The LORD says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches.
translation: Kabili ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness in the earth, for I delight in these things,” says the LORD.
translation: Lelo umuntu onse uulefwaya ukulaitakisha,

english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:
translation: Kabili Yawe asosa ati, “Inshita imo ikesa ilyo ine nkakanda abantu bonse abasembululwafye imibili, lelo tabasembululwa imitima nakalya.

english: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says the LORD.
translation: “Bena batintimuna ululimi lwabo ngo ulefona ubuta pakubepa ubufi,

english: “Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer.
translation: “Cila umo acenjele ku munankwe,

english: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity.
translation: Bonse babepanafye ubufi na banabo,

english: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says the LORD.
translation: Babikapofye ukulabepa ubufi,

english: Therefore the LORD of Armies says, “Behold, I will melt them and test them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?
translation: Eico Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati,

english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.
translation: Indimi shabo shaba nge mifwi iyabulembe,

english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?
translation: Bushe ine nshabakande pa mulandu wa ifi fintu?

english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine, umuntu uushingilila mwicinka lya mpaanga pa mwinshi, lelo aninina pa mbilibili, ninshi mupupu, kabili cipondo.

english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
translation: Umupupu teshila cimbi kanofye ukwiba, ukwipaya no konaula. Ine ico naishila ni kukupeela umweo nokuti bakwatishe umweo.

english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
translation: “Ine ndi kacema musuma. Kacema musuma ni uyo uuleka umweo wakwe pa mpaanga shakwe.

english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
translation: Uwancito, ico tali kacema, kabili te mwine wa mpaanga, ilyo amona umumbulu uleisa, abutuka, asha impaanga sheka. Elyo umumbulu wafukukila impaanga, washisalanganya.

english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
translation: Uwancito abutuka ico wancitofye, tasakamene impaanga.

english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
translation: Ine ndi kacema musuma. Nalishiba impaanga shandi ne mpaanga shandi nasho shalinjishiba.

english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
translation: Kanshi nga filya fine Tata anjishiba na ine nalishiba Tata. Eco na ine ndekela umweo wandi pa mpaanga shandi.

english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
translation: Nalikwata impaanga na shimbi, ishishilati shibe muli lino icinka. Nasho shine ndi nokushiletamo, shili nokumfwa ishiwi lyandi. Epakuti kukabefye umukuni umo na kacema nao umo.

english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
translation: Tata alintemwa, pantu ndeleka umweo wandi, elyo nakabili nkaubuule.

english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
translation: Tapali nelyo umo uulempoka umweo wandi. Awe iyoo, ni ku kutemwafye kwandi ndeleka umweo wandi. Nalikwata amaka yakuulekamo. Nalikwata na maka yakuubuula nakabili. Ici e cebo Tata ampeele.”

english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
translation: Awe Abayuda nakabili bapusana pa mulandu wa aya mashiwi.

english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
translation: Uwingilila pa mwinshi e kacema wa mpaanga.

english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
translation: Abengi balasosa abati, “Aliba no mupashi wakowela! Alipena! Bushe ewakumfwako?”

english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
translation: Bambi bena balati, “Awe ifi tefilanda umuntu uwaba no mupashi wakowela! Bushe mupashi wakowela kuti waposha ubupofu?”

english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
translation: Cali mu nshita yamibundo. Ku Yerusalemu kwali Inshikunkulu yakwibukisha Ukusangululwa kwe Tempele .

english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
translation: Yesu aletandala mu ncende ye Tempele, iyo baleti, “Lukungu lwakwa Solomoni.”

english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
translation: Abayuda baisa mushinguluka balamweba abati, “Bushe ukaleka lilali ukutumika imitima? Nga niwe Kristu, twebe, twishibe!”

english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nalimweba, nomba tamusumina. Imilimo momba ku maka yakwa Tata einjebela.

english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
translation: Nomba imwe tamusumina, ico mushili mpaanga shandi.

english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
translation: Impaanga shandi shilomfwa ishiwi lyandi. Nalishishiba, nasho shilankonka.

english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
translation: Ine ndashipeela umweo wape, kabili tashakalobe nakalya. Takwakabe nelyo umo uwakushifyombotola mu minwe yandi.

english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
translation: Tata uwashimpeela, wa maka ukucila bonse. Teti pabe nelyo umo uwakushifyombotola mu minwe yakwa Tata.

english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
translation: Kalinda alamwiswila iciibi ca pecinka, aingila. Impaanga shilomfwa ishiwi lyakwe ilyo aleita impaanga shakwe mu mashina. Elyo ashifumisha panse.

english: I and the Father are one.”
translation: Tata na ine twabafye umo.”

english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
translation: Elyo Abayuda batola amabwe balafwaya ukumulasa.

english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
translation: Yesu epakubeba ati, “Mwalimona imilimo ikankala iyingi iyo Tata ampeela ukubomba. Bushe mulimo nshi pali iyi uo mulefwailapo ukundasa amabwe?”

english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
translation: Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Tatulefwaya kukulasa amabwe pa milimo isuma ubomba, lelo ni pa musaalula obe kuli Lesa. Pantu iwe we muntufye niwe uleitunga ukuba Lesa.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe tacalembwa mu Mafunde yakwa Mose ukuti, ‘Lesa atila, muli milungu?’

english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
translation: Nga kanshi apo Lesa aeba aba bantu abo ishiwi lyakwe lyafikileko ukuti muli milungu, elyo Amalembo Yamushilo tayali yakutwishika.

english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
translation: Nga ine neo Tata aisalila umwine, antuma na pano isonde, bushe nine mwingatila amuti, asaalula Lesa, ico nasosa ukuti, ‘Ndi Mwana Lesa?’

english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
translation: Mwilansumina kumfwa nga nshilebomba milimo yakwa Tata.

english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
translation: Lelo nga ndabomba imilimo yakwa Tata, ninshi nangu mushinsumine, sumineni kanshi mu milimo momba. Mushininkishe nokuti Tata aba muli ine na ine naba muli Tata.”

english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
translation: Nakabili balafwaya ukumwikata, nomba abapusumuka.

english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
translation: Ilyo ashifumisha shonse panse, ashitangilila. Elyo impaanga nasho shalamukonka, pantu shalishiba ishiwi lyakwe.

english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
translation: Elyo Yesu ayabukila kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani, kulya kwine Yoani atampile ukulabatisha eko aya ikala.

english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
translation: Abantu abengi balaisa uko ali. Balasosa abati, “Yoani kwena tabalile acita icishibilo, lelo fyonse ifyo asosele pali uyu muntu fyacishinka.”

english: Many believed in him there.
translation: Awe na bengi bamusumina.

english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
translation: Tashikonka muntu umbi nakalya. Umuntu umbi shilamubutuka, pantu tashishibe ishiwi lyakwe.”

english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
translation: Ni Yesu wabomine uyu mulumbe. Lelo tabaumfwile umo walolele.

english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
translation: Yesu alabeba nakabili ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, nine mwinshi we cinka lya mpaanga.

english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
translation: Bonse ababalilepo ukwisa bena bapupu kabili fipondo, lelo impaanga tashabomfwile.

english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
translation: Nine mwinshi. Onse uwingilila pali ine akapusuka. Akalaingila no kufuma apo atemenwe, kabili akulasanga icakulya.

english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
translation: Kwaliko umuntu umo umulwele ishina lyakwe ni Lasalo. Aleikala mu Betani, umushi umo Maria na nkashimbiye Malita baleikala.

english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
translation: Lelo nga alaenda ubushiku, ninshi kuti aipununa, pantu tali na lubuuto.”

english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
translation: Yesu ati asose ifi elyo aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Lasalo cibusa wesu nalala utulo, lelo nalaya mubusha.”

english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
translation: Abasambi bamwasuka abati, “We Mfumu nga alifye mu tulo, ninshi alaba bwino.”

english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
translation: Yesu aloseshe mukutila, Lasalo nafwa. Nomba abasambi bena baletontonkanya ukuti, alelanda pakulala utulo twafye.

english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
translation: Elyo Yesu alandafye apabuuta tuutu ati, “Lasalo nafwa.

english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
translation: Lelo ine ico nshaliko ninsansamuka pa mulandu wenu. Pantu lyena mukasumina. Nomba natuleyako.”

english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
translation: Toma uo baleita Mpundu, alaeba abasambi banankwe ati, “Natuleya nankwe na ifwe bene, tuye fwa nankwe!”

english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
translation: Cilya Yesu afika ku Betani, asanga ukuti Lasalo balimushika papita ne nshiku shine.

english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
translation: Ukufuma ku Betani ukufika ku Yerusalemu pabafye imilundu itatu.

english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
translation: Kanshi na ba mu Yudeya abengi balishile kuli Malita na Maria kukubatalalikako imitima pa mulandu wa mfwa yakwa ndume yabo.

english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
translation: Uyu Maria eulya wakonkomwenene amafuta ya cena cisuma pa makasa ya Mfumu, kabili alayafuuta na ku mishishi yakwe. Kanshi ni ndume yakwe Lasalo ewalwele.

english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation: Ilyo Malita aumfwa ukuti Yesu aleisa, afuma aya kukumukumanya. Maria ena ashala naikala mu ŋanda.

english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
translation: Malita alaeba Yesu ati, “We Mfumu aubapo, ndume yandi nga tafwile!

english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
translation: Lelo ninjishiba ukuti na nombaline Lesa kuti akupeela conse ico wingamulomba.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Ndume yobe alabuuka nakabili.”

english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
translation: Malita amwasuka ati, “Ninjishiba akabuuka pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako.”

english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Nine cishukuko kabili nine mweo. Uwasumina ine nangu engafwa, akaba uwamweo.

english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
translation: Elyo na onse umumi uwansumina, takafwe nakalya. Bushe wasumina ici?”

english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
translation: Malita amwasuka ati, “Ee, we Mfumu, nasumina ukuti niwe Kristu, Umwana wakwa Lesa, uo Lesa atuma ukwisa pano isonde.”

english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
translation: Cilya asosa ifi, Malita abwelelamo aya ita nkashimbiye Maria. Amutotosha ati, “Kafundisha ali kuno alekwita.”

english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
translation: Maria cilya aumfwa ifi, aima bwangu bwangu, alaya noko ali.

english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
translation: Bankashi bakwa Lasalo ebatumine amashiwi kuli Yesu abati, “We Mfumu umutemwikwa obe mulwele.”

english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
translation: Yesu ninshi talati afike mu mushi, acilifye pa ncende ine apo Malita amukumanishishe.

english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
translation: Awe Abayuda abali na Maria mu ŋanda balemutalalika umutima, cilya bamona uko aima bwangu bwangu afuma, bamukonka. Bena balatontonkanya ukuti alaya ku nindi kukuloosha.

english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
translation: Maria afika apali Yesu, cilya amona Yesu amufukamina. Alamweba ati, “We Mfumu aubapo, ndume yandi nga tafwile!”

english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
translation: Ilyo Yesu amona uko alelila, na Bayuda bamukonkele nabo balelila, Yesu aumfwa ubulanda, no luse lwamwikata.

english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
translation: Elyo aipusha ati, “Bushe ni kwi uko mwamushika?” Bamwasuka abati, “We Mfumu, isa somone.”

english: Jesus wept.
translation: Awe Yesu alalila.

english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
translation: Abayuda balasosa abati, “Moneni ifyo amutemenwe!”

english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
translation: Nomba bamo balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu aposeshe impofu, nga kanshi cinshi ashaleseshe ukuti Lasalo efwa?”

english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
translation: Elyo Yesu nakabili aumfwa ubulanda nganshi, alaya na ku nindi. Inindi yena yali ni ninga ne cilibwe nabacilika pa mwinshi.

english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Fumyenipo icilibwe!” Malita nkashi ya wafwile amweba ati, “We Mfumu, alenunka, pantu papita inshiku shine apo afwila.”

english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
translation: Ilyo Yesu aumfwa ifi, asosa ati, “Ubu bulwele tabwapelele pa mfwa. Lelo bwakuletela Lesa ubucindami, elyo no Mwana wakwa Lesa nao acindamikilweko.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bushe nshikwebele nati, ‘Nga wasumina ulemona ubucindami bwakwa Lesa?’ ”

english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
translation: Awe bafumyapo icilibwe. Elyo Yesu apunamina mu mulu asosa ati, “Tata nakutasha pantu waŋumfwa.

english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
translation: Kwena ine nalishiba ukuti lyonsefye ulaŋumfwa. Lelo nalanda ifyo pa mulandu we bumba ili linshingulwike, pakuti lisumine ukuti niwe wantuma.”

english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation: Ati asose ifi, elyo Yesu amwita aikatisha ishiwi ati, “Lasalo fumina panonse.”

english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
translation: Awe uwafwile afuma. Ifisansa na makasa nafipombwa no tusalu. Pa menso pena pakakilwe icitambala. Yesu abeba ati, “Mukakuleni muleke aleya.”

english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
translation: Aba mu Yudeya abengi abaishile kukuloosha kuli Maria, ilyo bamona ifyo Yesu acita, bamusumina.

english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
translation: Lelo bamo bena baya ku Bafalise, baya bashimikilako ifyo Yesu acitile.

english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
translation: Kanshi bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise epakuteka icilye. Balasosa ati, “Tulecita shani? Uyu muntu alecita ifishibilo ifingi!

english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
translation: Nga twaleka ukuti akonkanyepofye ifi fine, ninshi bonsefye bakamusumina. Elyo Abena Roma bakesa, bakonaula Itempele no mushobo wesu!”

english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
translation: Umunabo umo, Kaifa, uwali Shimapepo mukalamba muli uyo mwaka, abeba ati, “Imwe tamwishibe nelyo cimo!

english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
translation: Yesu alitemenwe Malita na nkashimbiye na Lasalo.

english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
translation: Bushe tamwishibe ukuti cawamapo umuntu umo afwila abantu ukucila ukuti umushobo onse waonaika?”

english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
translation: Te pa mutwefye wakwe asosele aya mashiwi. Lelo ico ali Shimapepo mukalamba wa muli uyo mwaka, asesemefye ukuti Yesu ali nokufwila umushobo wa Bayuda.

english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
translation: Kabili te mushobo wa Bayuda beka. Lelo nokuti akalonganike abantu bakwa Lesa monse umo basalanganina, ukuti babefye ulupwa lumo.

english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
translation: Ukufuma ubo bushiku Abayuda balapangana ifyakwipaya Yesu.

english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
translation: Kanshi Yesu nao nomba taleenda pa lwalala mu Bayuda. Lelo afumako aya ku musumba baleti Efulaimu ku calo ca mupepi na matololo, eko aya ikala na basambi bakwe.

english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
translation: Kanshi Ipasaka inshikunkulu ya Bayuda iya Cakucilila yali mupepi. Abantu abengi epakulafuma mu mishi baleya ku Yerusalemu pakuti baye sangululwa ilyo Ipasaka talilafika.

english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
translation: Awe balafwaya Yesu. Balaipushanya ninshi nabalongana mwi Tempele ati, “Bushe muleti shani? Bushe ninshi takese ku nshikunkulu?”

english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
translation: Nomba bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise bakonkomeshe abantu ukuti, nga kwaba uwaishiba uko Yesu ali, ali nokubeshibisha pakuti baye mwikata.

english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
translation: Lelo ilyo aumfwa ukuti Lasalo mulwele, ashala mu ncende ilya ine na shimbi inshiku shibili.

english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
translation: Elyo aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Natubwelele ku Yudeya.”

english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
translation: Abasambi bakwe bamweba abati, “Kafundisha, tapalati papite na nshita apo Abayuda balefwaya ukukulasa amabwe. Bushe nakabili eko ulebwelela?”

english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Bushe mu kasuba kamo tamwaba insa ikumi limo na shibili? Umuntu uuleenda akasuba taipununa, pantu alamona ulubuuto lwa ba pano isonde.

english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
translation: Ilyo kwashelefye inshiku mutanda kwi Pasaka inshikunkulu iya Cakucilila, Yesu aile ku Betani ukwaleikala Lasalo, uo abushishe ku bafwa.

english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami epakupanga ukwipaya na Lasalo wine.

english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
translation: Pantu Abayuda abengi balebasangukila, balesumina na Yesu pa mulandu wakwa Lasalo.

english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkapo ibumba ilikalamba ilya bantu baishile ku nshikunkulu, lyaumfwa ukuti Yesu ali mu nshila aleisa ku Yerusalemu.

english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
translation: Balakontola imisambo ya tuncindu, bamukonkela balepunda abati, “Hosana, nakalebalika! Lesa apaale uyu waisa uo Imfumu yatuma! Lesa apaale Imfumu ya bena Israeli!”

english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
translation: Yesu asanga umwana wa punda, epo aikala. Ngefyo calembwa ukuti,

english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
translation: “Witiina iwe we mwana mwanakashi Sioni,

english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
translation: Pa nshita iyi abasambi tabaishibe umo calolele. Lelo ilyo Yesu aishile shukuka ku bafwa, elyo abasambi baibukishe ukuti, ifi fyonse bamucitile fintu fyalembelwe pali ena.

english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
translation: Kanshi abantu basangilweko ilyo Yesu aitile Lasalo ukufuma mu nindi, amubusha na kubafwa, bena babikilepofye ukulashimika ili lyashi.

english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
translation: Ecalengele nokuti abantu abengi bese kukumusengela, ico baumfwile ici cishibilo Yesu acitile.

english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
translation: Elyo Abafalise balalanshanya abati, “Tamumwene, tapali neco tulecita! Abantu bonse nomba eo balekonka!”

english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
translation: Awe bamutebeta icakulya. Malita ewaleyafwilisha mukupeela icakulya. Lasalo ena ninshi ali pa balelya na Yesu.

english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
translation: Abagiriki bamo baninike ukuya pali abo baile kukupepa ku nshikunkulu.

english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
translation: Awe baisa ukwali Filipo umwina Betisaida umusumba mu calo ca Galile. Bamwipusha abati, “Mukwai ala tulefwaya ukumona Yesu.”

english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
translation: Filipo aya eba Andele, elyo bonse babili baya kuli Yesu baya mweba.

english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nomba inshita yafika iyakusokolola ubucindami bwa Mwana wa muntu.

english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine ukuti uluseke lwa ŋanu lushalafye lumo mpo, kanofye nga lwaponena mu mushili no kufwa lwafwa. Lyena nga lwafwa, elyo lutwala ifisabo ifingi.

english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
translation: Uulefwaya ukuba umubomfi wandi, ali nokulankonka. Epakuti uko ndi, no mubomfi wandi nao eko akabe. Kabili Tata akacindamika onse umubomfi wandi.

english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
translation: “Umutima wandi waikatwa ubulanda, nampo nga ntile shani? Bushe ntile, ‘Tata shi wingampususha kuli aya macushi?’ Nomba ni pa mulandu wa macushi yene aya eco naishila.

english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
translation: Tata, cindika ishina lyobe!” Elyo ishiwi lyaumfwika ukufuma ku mulu aliti, “Nalilicindika, elyo nakabili nkalalicindika.”

english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
translation: Ibumba ilyalipo cilya lyaumfwa ifi, lyasosa aliti, “Cabulukuta!” Bambi bena balasosa abati, “Ni malaika ewalanda nankwe!”

english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
translation: Elyo Maria aisamo nasenda ibotolo umwali amafuta aya mutengo ukalamba nganshi, kabili aya cena cisuma ayaleitwa nardi. Ayakonkomwena pa makasa yakwa Yesu. Elyo alafuta amakasa ku mishishi yakwe. Awe iŋanda yonse yaisulafye icena cisuma ica mafuta.

english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Te pa mulandu wandi mwaumfwila ishiwi, ni pa mulandu wenu.

english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
translation: Nomba ino e nshita abantu ba pano calo bali nokupingulwa. Ino kanshi e nshita kateeka wa ba pano calo ali nokuposwa kunse.

english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
translation: Nomba ine ilyo nkemikwa pa musalaba ninshi nkatintila abantu bonse bakese kuli ine.”

english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
translation: Ico alandile ifi, ni pakulanga umusango wa mfwa iyo ali nokufwa.

english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation: Ibumba lyamwasuka aliti, “Amafunde yakwa Mose yatweba ukuti Kristu ali nokubelelela pe. Nga kanshi iwe watila shani ukuti bakemika Umwana wa muntu pa musalaba? Ngoyo Umwana wa muntu nani?”

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Mucili no lubuuto pa nshitafye inono. Kanshi akwendeni ilyo mucili no lubuuto, epali mwakupwa ne mfifi. Umuntu uuleenda mu mfifi teshiba uko aleya.

english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
translation: Ilyo mucili no lubuuto, sumineni mu lubuuto, lyena mukaba abana ba lubuuto.” Cilya Yesu apwa ukusosa ifi, afumapo aya belama.

english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
translation: Abayuda bena nangu baleimwena ifishibilo ifingi Yesu alecita, awe nalyo line tabamusumine nakalya.

english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
translation: Kanshi epakufikilisha ifyasosa kasesema Esaya ati,

english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
translation: Na cine tekuti basumine, pantu kasesema Esaya atila nokuti,

english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
translation: Umusambi wakwa Yesu umo, Yuda wa ku Kelyoti, uwali nokumuposa ku balwani, asosa ati,

english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
translation: “Lesa alibapofwisha amenso yabo,

english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
translation: Esaya alanda ifi pali Yesu, ico amwene ubucindami bwakwa Yesu, eco asoselepo.

english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
translation: Lelo kwena na pa ntungulushi sha Bayuda pene palifye abengi abasumine Yesu. Lelo umulandu wakutiina Abafalise, balefilwa ukuisokolola. Pantu baletiina ukuti bakabatamfya, tabakaleisa mu sinagoga.

english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
translation: Kanshi basakamene ukucindikwa na bantu ukucila ukucindikwa na Lesa.

english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
translation: Yesu elyo aikatisha ishiwi asosa ati, “Uwasumina muli ine, teine neka asumina, lelo asumina na mu wantuma.

english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
translation: Elyo uwamona ine, ninshi amona no wantuma.

english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
translation: Ine naisa pano isonde ukuba ulubuuto ku bantu. Kanshi onse uwasumina tekala mu mfifi.

english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
translation: Onse uwaumfwa amashiwi yandi lelo akaana ukulayasunga, teine nkamupeela umulandu. Ine nshaisa pano isonde kukupeela aba pano isonde umulandu, awe naisa kukubapususha.

english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
translation: Onse uwansuula, akaana no kupokelela amashiwi yandi, eko ali uwakumupeela umulandu. Amashiwi yene mweba, eyakamupeela umulandu pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako!

english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
translation: Pantu ifyo mweba te fya pa mutwe wandi iyoo. Tata uwantuma, ewankonkomesha ifyakulanda ne nshila yakulandilamo.

english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
translation: “Cinshi ico aya mafuta bashishitishe pa ndalama imyanda itatu, elyo bashipeela na ku balanda?”

english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
translation: Kabili nalishiba ukuti ifyebo fyakwe fipeela umweo wape. Kanshi ifyo nanda, fintu Tata anjeba ukusosa.”

english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
translation: Ico alandile ifi, teico asakamene abalanda, lelo nico ali ni mpupu. Ewali kasunga wa cikwama ca ndalama, kabili aleibapo isho balebikamo.

english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Muleke umwine. Ala nabomba, epakupekanya ubushiku bwakushiikwa kwandi.

english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
translation: Abalanda mwakulaba nabo lyonse, lelo tatwakabe na imwe lyonse.”
