english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
translation: Abayuda abengi ilyo baumfwa ukuti Yesu ali ku Betani, eko baya. Ico bailile, tekumonafye Yesu, lelo nokuti bamone Lasalo uo Yesu abushishe ku bafwa.

english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
translation: Pa bushiku bwakulalila Ipasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, Yesu aishibe ukuti inshita yakwe naifika iyakufuma pano isonde no kubwelelamo kuli Wishi. Lyonse alitemenwe abantu aba pano isonde, nomba alefwaya ukubalanga icitemwiko cakwe conse ukufikapo.

english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Umuntu uowele ninshi nasamba umubili onse, takabila kusamba, kanofye ninshi amakasa. Mulifye bwino tamuli na fiko, nomba te bonse.”

english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
translation: Pantu Yesu alishibe uwali nokumuposa ku balwani. Eico alandile ati, “Nomba te bonse bashili na fiko.”

english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
translation: Cilya Yesu apwa ukusamba amakasa ya basambi, abuula icakufimbana afwala, abwelela na pa ncende acikala. Alaipusha abasambi bakwe ati, “Bushe namutesha ico nacita umo cilolele?

english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
translation: Munjita amuti, ‘Kafundisha’ kabili na ‘We Mfumu.’ Ee, cine cine mulalungika, pantu e fintu naba.

english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
translation: Nomba apo ine ne Mfumu kabili Kafundisha namusamba amakasa, na imwe mulesambana amakasa.

english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
translation: Namupeela icilangililo, pakuti na imwe mulecita ifyo namucitila.

english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, umusha tacindama ukucila shikulu wakwe. Elyo inkombe taicindama ukucila uuitumine.

english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
translation: Nomba apo mwaishiba ifi, ala mukalasansamuka, kumfwa nga mwalaficita.

english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
translation: “Teimwe bonse ndeeba iyoo, ne mwine nalishiba abo naisalila. Lelo Amalembo Yamushilo yali nokufikilishiwa ayatila, ‘Umuntu uo tulyafye nankwe icipe cimo ewansangukila.’

english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
translation: Kanshi nomba namweba libela ilyo tacilafikila, pakuti ilyo cikafikila, mukasumine ukuti cine cine nine wine.

english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
translation: Ilyo bali pakulya umulalilo, ninshi Ciwa natunka Yuda wa ku Kelyoti mwana Simoni ukuti apose Yesu ku balwani.

english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, uwasekelela uo natuma, ninshi nine asekelela. Elyo nao uwansekelela, ninshi asekelela uwantuma.”

english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwa ukulanda ifi, awe umutima wakwe waikatwa ubulanda. Elyo asosa pa bwelu ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, umo pali imwe alamposa ku balwani.”

english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
translation: Abasambi balaloleshanya, ico bashishibe uo aleeba.

english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
translation: Umusambi wakwe umo uo Yesu atemenwe, aikele mupepi na Yesu.

english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
translation: Simoni Petelo amucebula, amweba ati, “Ipusha Imfumu, uo aleeba.”

english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
translation: Kanshi nao ashintilila pa cifuba cakwa Yesu. Amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu, bushe nani?”

english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Uo nalapeela akapandwa ka mukate aka nalatumpa mu lunweno, euyo wine.” Awe Yesu abuula na kapandwa ka mukate atumpika mu lunweno, apeela Yuda wa ku Kelyoti, mwana Simoni.

english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
translation: Apopenefye cilya Yuda apoka akamukate, na Satana aingila mu mutima wakwe. Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Ale, ico ulefwaya ukucita, cita bwangu.”

english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
translation: Nomba abali na Yesu pakulya, bena tabaishibe ico asosele ifi.

english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
translation: Luka 6:29

english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
translation: Yesu ena ninshi naishiba ukuti Wishi alimupeela amaka pa fintu fyonse, nokuti afuma kuli Lesa kabili ni kuli Lesa alebwelela.

english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
translation: Awe Yuda apoka akamukate, apopene afumina na panse. Elyo ninshi nabwila nokwila.

english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
translation: Cilyafye Yuda afumamo, Yesu alasosa ati, “Nomba Umwana wa muntu alacindamikwa. Kabili ni muli ena Lesa nao alacindamikilwa.

english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
translation: Apo kanshi Lesa alacindamikilwa muli Mwane, ninshi Lesa nao akacindamika Mwane no bucindami aikwatila umwine. Kabili alamucindamikafye nombaline.

english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
translation: Mwe bana bandi, nalaikalafye na imwe akashita akanono. Mukalamfwaya lelo ngefyo naebele Abayuda, na imwe efyo nalamweba, ‘Uko ndeya imwe teti mwiseko.’

english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
translation: Namupeela icebo cipya, nati, ‘Muletemwana.’ Muli nokulatemwana nga filya ine namutemwa.

english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
translation: Nga mwalatemwana, elyo bonse bakamwishiba ukuti muli basambi bandi.”

english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
translation: Simoni Petelo amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu ni kwi uleya?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Uko ndeya, iwe tekuti ukonke pali nomba, ukakonka limbi.”

english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
translation: Petelo amwipusha ati, “Ngeco tekuti nkukonkele pali nomba cinshi? Ine kuti naleka umweo wandi pali iwe!”

english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bushe cine cine kuti waleka umweo obe pali ine? Ndekweba icine cine, ilyo mukolwe talalila, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.

english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation: Elyo Yesu aima pakulya. Afumyako icakufimbana. Abuula insalu yakukumwinako amenshi akaka mu musana.

english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
translation: Elyo aitila amenshi mu musambilo, atampa no kulasamba amakasa ya basambi bakwe. Elyo alayakumuna na ku nsalu akakile mu musana.

english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
translation: Aisa kuli Simoni Petelo. Petelo amweba ati, “We Mfumu, bushe niwe unsambe amakasa?”

english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Pa nshita ino tawishibe ico ndecita, ukeshiba limbi.”

english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
translation: Petelo ayasuka ati, “Awe tawakatale aunsamba amakasa nakalya!” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Kumfwa nga nshikusambile amakasa ninshi tawakatale auba na ine.”

english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
translation: Simoni Petelo amwasuka ati, “Kanshi we Mfumu winsambafye amakasa, unsambe iminwe no mutwe wine!”

english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
translation: “Mwilaenda ne mitima iyasakamana. Muletetekela muli Lesa, elyo muletetekela na muli ine.

english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
translation: Bushe kanshi tawasumina ukuti ine naba muli Tata, elyo na Tata nao aba muli ine? Amashiwi mweba, ala te ya pa mutwe wandifye iyoo. Ni Tata uwaba muli ine, eubomba imilimo yakwe.

english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
translation: Suminenifye ifyo ndemweba nati, ‘Tata aba muli ine, na ine naba muli Tata.’ Nga teifyo, ninshi sumineni pa mulandu wa milimo ndebomba.

english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, uwasumina ine akalacita ifyo ndecita. Akalacita ne fintu ificililepo, pantu ndeya kuli Tata.

english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
translation: Kabili conse ico mwalomba ico muli basambi bandi, akalamupeela, epakuti ubucindami bwakwa Tata bumonekele muli Mwane.

english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
translation: Kanshi conse ico mwingalomba ico muli basambi bandi, nkalamupeela.

english: If you love me, keep my commandments.
translation: “Nga mwalintemwa, mulesunga amafunde yandi.

english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
translation: Ine nkalomba Tata, nao akamupeele kafwa umbi, uo mukalaba nankwe lyonse pe.

english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
translation: Ni Mupashi wacishinka. Abantu ba pano calo balifilwa ukumupokelela, pantu tabamumona nelyo ukumwishiba. Nomba imwe mwalimwishiba, ico mwaba nankwe kabili akaba muli imwe.

english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
translation: “Nshakamushe nga bakashiwa nakalya, nkabwela kuli imwe.

english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
translation: Kwashala akashita akanono, abantu ba pano calo tabakalemona, lelo imwe mukalamona. Pantu ndi mumi, na imwe mukaba abomi.

english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
translation: Mu ŋanda mwa Tata mwaba ififulo fyakwikalamo ifingi. Amukaanaba, nga nalimweba. Kanshi ndeya kukumupekanishisha icifulo.

english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
translation: Muli ubo bushiku lyena mukeshiba ukuti naba muli Tata, na imwe mwaba muli ine, na ine naba muli imwe.

english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
translation: “Uyo onse uupokelela amafunde yandi no kulayasunga, uyo ewantemwa. Uyo uwantemwa, Tata nao akamutemwa. Na ine nkamutemwa, kabili eo nkaisokololako.”

english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
translation: Elyo Yuda, nomba teulya uwa ku Kelyoti, amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu, nga caba shani icakuti ukaisokolole kuli ifwe, nomba ku bantu ba pano calo bena nakalya?”

english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Umuntu onse uwantemwa, alasunga amashiwi yandi. Tata akamutemwa. Elyo Tata na ine tukesa kuli wena, no kwikala muli ena.

english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
translation: Uyo onse uushantemwa, tasunga mashiwi yandi. Amashiwi ayo mwaumfwa, te ya pa mutwe wandi. Lelo mashiwi yakwa Tata uwantuma.

english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
translation: Namweba ifi fintu ilyo tucili na imwe.

english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
translation: Nomba Kafwa, Mupashi Wamushilo, uo Tata akamutumina ico muli basambi bandi, akesa mufunda fyonse. Kabili akamwafwa na mukwibukisha fyonse ifyo namweba.

english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
translation: “Umutende namushila, mutende wa mu mutima wandi eo namupeela. Nshilemupeela mutende uo abantu ba pano calo bapeela. Mwilaenda abasakamana kabili mwilaba na mwenso.

english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
translation: Namumfwa ifyo mwebele nati, ‘Ndeya, lelo kabili nkabwela kuli imwe.’ Amuntemwa nga namusansamuka ico ndeya kuli Tata, pantu Tata alicindama ukucila pali ine.

english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
translation: Kanshi nomba namwebelapo libela ilyo cishilafikila, pakuti ilyo cikafikila, mukasumine.

english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
translation: Kanshi nga naya mupekanishisha incende, nkabwela nkese musenda. Epakuti uko ndi, eko na imwe bene mukabe.

english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
translation: Awe nshatantalishe kulanda na imwe, pantu kateeka wa ba pano calo alaisa. Pali ine takwatapo maka nakalya.

english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
translation: Nomba abantu ba pano calo bali nokwishiba ukuti nalitemwa Tata, kabili ncitafye fyonse ifyo Tata ankonkomesha.

english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
translation: Uko ndeya, inshila mwaliishiba.”

english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
translation: Toma amwasuka ati, “We Mfumu, tatwishibe uko uleya. Nga kanshi kuti twaishiba shani inshila ya uko uleya?”

english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nine nshila, nine cishinka, nine mweo. Teti kube nangu umo uwingesa kuli Tata, kano apita kuli ine.

english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
translation: Amunjishiba, nga kuti mwaishiba na Tata. Ukufuma pali nomba namumwishiba no kumumona namumumona.”

english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
translation: Filipo amweba ati, “We Mfumu, tulangefye Wiso, nga tupeme.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Inshita ubutali twaba na imwe Filipo, kanshi tawanjishiba nakalya? Ala onse uwamona ine, ninshi namona na Tata. Nga kanshi wasosa shani auti, ‘Tulange Wiso?’

english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
translation: “Ine nine mwangashi wine wine, elyo Tata wena e mulimi.

english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
translation: Nga mwalasunga amafunde yandi, ninshi mwakulaikala mu citemwiko candi, nga ifi ine njikalilila mu citemwiko cakwa Tata ico nsunga amafunde yakwe.

english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
translation: “Kanshi namweba ifi pakuti na imwe mube ne nsansa shandi. Elyo ne nsansa shenu shibe ishapwililika.

english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
translation: Ifunde lyandi nili, muletemwana ngefi ine namutemwa.

english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
translation: Tapaba umuntu uwatemwa umunankwe ukucila pali uyo waleka umweo wakwe pali bacibusa bakwe.

english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
translation: Kanshi imwe muli bacibusa bandi, kumfwa nga mulekonka ifyo namukonkomesha.

english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
translation: Nomba nshakulamwita ababomfi bandi, pantu umubomfi teshiba ifilecita shikulu wakwe. Lelo nakulamwita bacibusa, pantu nalimwishibisha fyonse ifyo Tata anjeba.

english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
translation: Teimwe mwansala iyoo, nine namusala. Kabili namutuma nokuti muye muletwala ifitwalo, nefi fitwalo fyakubelelela. Lyena Tata akalamupeela conse ico mwamulomba ico muli basambi bandi.

english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
translation: Ico ndemukonkomesha cakuti, ‘Muletemwana.’

english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
translation: “Nga bantu ba pano calo bamupata, mukaleibukisha ukuti nine babalilepo ukupata.

english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
translation: Amuba nga bantu ba pano calo, lyena nga bantu ba pano calo kuti bamutemwa, pantu muli ifyo baba. Lelo nalimusala ukufuma mu bantu ba pano calo, kanshi eco abantu ba pano calo bamupatila, pantu nomba tamuli ngefyo baba.

english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
translation: Alaputulako imisambo yonse iyishitwala fitwalo. Elyo umusambo onse uuletwala ifitwalo, alautungwila bwino bwino pakuti uletwalisha.

english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
translation: Ibukisheni ifyo namwebele, ‘Umubomfi tacindama ukucila shikulu wakwe.’ Apo ine balancusha, na imwe bene bakalamucusha. Abalasunga ifyo ndemufunda, nga kuti basunga nefyo mukalabafunda.

english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
translation: Ico bakalamucitila ifyo, nico muli basambi bandi. Pantu tabaishiba no wantuma.

english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation: Nkanaisa no kubeba, nga tekuti batile tatwakwata umulandu wa bubifi. Awe nomba tapaba kabepesho kakutila tababa na bubifi.

english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
translation: Uwapata ine, ninshi apata na Tata wine.

english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
translation: Nkanabomba imilimo pakati kabo iyo muntu ashatala abomba, lyena nga teti bakwate ububifi. Lelo baliimona, nomba kabili baletupata, ine wine na Tata.

english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
translation: Lelo ici cena kufikilishafye icalembwa mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, ‘Bampatafye apabula umulandu.’

english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
translation: “Kafwa akesa, Mupashi wacishinka, akafuma kuli Tata. Nine wine nkamutuma ukufuma kuli Tata, eukesa ba kambone wandi.

english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation: Na imwe bene muli nokuba bakambone bandi, pantu twaba na imwe ukufumafye apo natampile.

english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
translation: Imwe namuwamishiwa pa mashiwi aya namweba.

english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
translation: Mwikalilile muli ine, na ine nakulaikalilila muli imwe. Umusambo uwine weka tekuti utwale ifitwalo kano uli ku mwangashi. E cimo cine na imwe, nga tamwikalilile muli ine, ninshi teti mutwale ifitwalo.

english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
translation: “Ine nine mwangashi, imwe muli misambo. Uwaikalilila muli ine, na ine muli ena, uyu eutwala ifitwalo ifingi. Pantu ukwabula ine, imwe teti mucite nelyo cimo.

english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
translation: Uyo onse uwafilwa ukwikalilila muli ine, aba nge misambo iyo baposa no kuma yauma. Iyo misambo balailonganya baiposa na mu mulilo, emo yalapya.

english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
translation: Nga mwaikalilila muli ine na mashiwi yandi yaikalilila muli imwe, lyena kuti mwalomba conse ico mulefwaya, no kupeelwa mukapeelwa.

english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
translation: Ni mukutwala ifitwalo ifingi, emo Tata acindikilwa, pantu na imwe mwaba abasambi bandi.

english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
translation: Nalimutemwa nga filya fine Tata antemwa. Kanshi mwikalilile mu citemwiko candi.

english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
translation: “Ico namwebela ifi, ni pakuti mwikalufya cisumino cenu.

english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
translation: Akabashinina pa mulandu wakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, pantu ndeya kuli Tata elyo tamwakamone nakabili.

english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
translation: Pa mulandu wa bupingushi, pantu kateeka wa ba pano calo alipeelwa umulandu kale.

english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
translation: “Nali ne fyakumwebafye ifingi, lelo pali nomba teti mufiteshe.

english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
translation: Nomba ilyo Mupashi wacishinka akesa, akamutungulula mu fyacishinka fyonse. Pantu ifyo akalalanda te fya pa mutwe wakwe, lelo akalalandafye ifyo aumfwa. Kabili akamushimikila ne fintu ifili nokwisa.

english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
translation: Akalancindika, pantu fyonse ifyo akalamweba, fikalafuma kuli ine.

english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
translation: Fyonse ifyo Tata akwata, fyandi. Kanshi eico namwebela nati, fyonse ifyo Mupashi akalamweba, fikalafuma kuli ine.

english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
translation: “Pa kashita akanono tamwalemona, kabili pa kashita akanono elyo mukalamona.”

english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
translation: Abasambi bakwe bamo balaipushanya abati, “Nga ici naco calola mwi? Atila ati, ‘Pa kashita akanono tamwalemona, elyo kabili pa kashita akanono mukamona.’ Kabili ati nokuti, ‘Pantu ndeya kuli Tata?’ ”

english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
translation: Balaipushanya abati, “Nga aka ‘kashita akanono’ calola mwi? Tatwishibe umo alosha?”

english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
translation: Yesu aishiba ukuti balefwaya ukumwipusha. Abeba ati, “Muleipushanya ici natila, ‘Pa kashita akanono tamwalemona’, kabili ‘pa kashita akanono mukamona?’

english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
translation: Bakamutamfya, tamwakaleingila mu masinagoga. Kabili inshita ikesa ilyo onse uukamwipaya akalatontonkanya ukuti, alebombela Lesa.

english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, mukalalila no kulaloosha, lelo abantu ba pano calo bena bakalasansamuka. Imwe mukaba no bulanda, lelo ubulanda bukaluka insansa.

english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
translation: Umwanakashi uuli pakupapa alacuula, pantu inshita ya bucushi yafika. Nomba ilyo apapa umwana, alaba na ku bucushi. Alasansamukafye ico umuntu afyalwa pano calo.

english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
translation: Yoani 9:22

english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
translation: “Ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika, tamwakalenjipusha pa cintu nelyo cimo. Ndemweba icine cine, Tata akamupeela conse ico mwamulomba ico muli basambi bandi.

english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
translation: Ukufika pali nomba, tamulomba Tata icintu nelyo cimo ico muli basambi bandi. Akulombeni, mwakulapeelwa, elyo mukaba ne nsansa ishapwililika.

english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
translation: “Kanshi nalemweba ifi fintu mu mapinda. Lelo inshita ikafika ilyo nshakalebomfya mapinda pakumulandila. Lelo nkalamulandila pali Tata ukwabula ukushoka.

english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
translation: Ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika, lyena mukalalomba Tata ico muli basambi bandi. Nshilemweba ukuti nkalamulombela kuli Tata,

english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
translation: awe iyoo, pantu Tata umwine nao alimutemwa. Alimutemwa, ico na imwe mwalintemwa. Kabili mwalisumina nokuti ni kuli Lesa eko nafuma.

english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
translation: Nafuma kuli Tata, naisa na pano isonde. Nomba ndefuma pano isonde, ndebwelelamo kuli Tata.”

english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
translation: Elyo abasambi bakwe bamweba abati, “Eya, nomba walalandafye bwino ukwabula ukushoka, taulelandila mu mapinda.

english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
translation: Ico bakalacitila ifyo, nico bashaishiba Tata nangu ine wine.

english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
translation: Nomba twaishiba ukuti walishiba fyonse. Kabili ici calenga nokuti tusumine ukuti wafuma kuli Lesa.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nomba mwasumina mwa?

english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
translation: Ala inshita yalaisa, no kwisa naisa, ilyo bonse mulepashika, mulensha. Cila umo alabutukila kumwakwe. Lelo nshiba neka, pantu tuba na Tata.

english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
translation: Kanshi namweba ifi, epakuti mukuba na ine mukwate insansa. Pano calo mukalacula, lelo muleshipa, nalicimfya ifya calo.”

english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
translation: Lelo namweba ifi fintu, pakuti inshita yafiko nga yafika, mukebukishe ukuti alitwebele. Nshamwebele ifi pakutampafye pene, pantu twali tucili na imwe.

english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
translation: “Nomba nalaya ku wantumine. Lelo tapali nelyo umo uulenjipusha ati, ‘Bushe uleya kwi?’

english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
translation: Nomba ico namweba ifi, mu mitima yenu mwaisula ubulanda.

english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
translation: Kanshi ndemweba icine cine ukuti cikamuwamina nga naya. Pantu nga nshile, ninshi Kafwa takese kuli imwe. Lelo nga naya, ninshi nkaya mutuma kuli imwe.

english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
translation: Nomba ilyo akesa, akesa shinina abantu ba pano calo ifyo baluba pa mulandu wa bubifi, na pa mulandu wakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, na pa mulandu wa bupingushi.

english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
translation: Pa mulandu wa bubifi, pantu balikaana ukunsumina.

english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
translation: Cilya Yesu apwa ukusosa ifi, apunamina mu mulu, alasosa ati, “Tata, inshita yafika. Cindika Mwano, pakuti Mwano nao akucindike.

english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
translation: Elyo fyonse ifyo nakwata, fyobe. Kabili fyonse ifyo wakwata, fyandi. Elyo kabili ni muli aba bantu emo wasokolwela ubucindami bwandi.

english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
translation: Ine nomba nalaisa kuli iwe. Nalafuma pano isonde. Nomba aba bena bacili pano isonde. We Tata Wamushilo ubasunge na maka yobe ayo wampeela. Epakuti ifi twaba umo, nabo babefye umo.

english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
translation: Ilyo tucili nabo pano calo, ndabacingilila no kubasunga na maka yobe ayo wampeela. Ndabacingilila, tapaloba nelyo umo, kanofye umwina kuloba. Epakufikilisha ifyalembwa mu Mashiwi yobe.

english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
translation: Nomba nalaisa kuli iwe. Nasosa ifi fintu ilyo ncili pano isonde, epakuti nabo bakwate insansa shandi ishapwililika.

english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
translation: Nalibashimikila amashiwi yobe. Nomba abantu ba pano calo balibapata. Pantu tabali ba pano calo, nga ifi ine nshaba wa pano calo.

english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
translation: Nshilelomba ukuti ubafumye pano isonde iyoo. Lelo ndelombafye ukuti ulebacingililako ku mubi.

english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
translation: Ngefi ine nshaba wa pano calo, kanshi nabo tabali ba pano calo.

english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
translation: Ishiwi lyobe e cishinka cine. Kanshi balule ku cishinka cobe pakuti baituule onse kuli iwe babe bobe.

english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
translation: Filya wantuma pano calo, efyo na ine nabatuma mu calo.

english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wa aba bene eco naituulila onse kuli iwe, epakuti nabo bene baituule onse mu cishinka kuli iwe.

english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
translation: Pantu walimupeela amaka yakuteeka abantu bonse. Epakuti nao apeele umweo wa pe kuli abo bonse abo wamupeela.

english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
translation: “Teaba bene beka ebo ndepepelako, lelo ndepepelako na bonse abo abakasumina muli ine pakumfwa amashiwi yabo.

english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
translation: Tata, cawama bonse babafye umo. Filya waba muli ine, na ine naba muli iwe, efyo nabo babe muli ifwe. Epakuti na bantu ba pano calo bakasumine ukuti niwe wantuma.

english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
translation: Nalibapeelako ubucindami ubo wampeele, pakuti nabo babe umo ngefi twaba umo.

english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
translation: Ine mbe muli bena, elyo na iwe muli ine. Lyena bakabafye umutima umo umupwilapo. Epakuti na bantu ba pano calo bakeshibe ukuti niwe wantuma. Kabili bakeshibe nokuti walibatemwa nga filya fine wantemwa.

english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
translation: “Tata, ndefwaya ukuti abo wampeela bakabe na ine uko naba. Epakuti bakamone ubucindami bwandi, ubo wampeele. Pantu iwe walintemenwe, ninshi ne calo tacilabako.

english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
translation: Tata, we mololoke wine wine, abantu ba pano calo tabakwishiba, lelo ine nalikwishiba. Elyo aba nabo balishiba ukuti niwe wantuma.

english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
translation: Nalikusokolola kuli aba bantu, kabili ndekonkanyapofye ukulakusokolola. Epakuti nabo baleba ne citemwiko ico wankwatila, elyo na ine ndeikala muli bena.”

english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
translation: Nomba umweo wa pe waba mukukwishiba iwe wine, Lesa wine wine uwaba eka, no kwishiba Yesu Kristu uo watuma.

english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
translation: Ine nalikucindika pano isonde pantu nimpwisha umulimo wampeela ukubomba.

english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
translation: Kanshi nomba Tata, ncindamika pa cinso cobe, nga filya fine nacindeme ninshi ne calo tacilabako.

english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
translation: “Nalikusokolola ku bantu abo wampeela ukufuma mu ba pano calo. Bena bantu bobe, nomba walibampeela. Elyo balisunga na mashiwi yobe.

english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
translation: Nomba balishiba ukuti fyonse ifyo wampeela fyafuma kuli iwe.

english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
translation: Pantu nalibashimikila amashiwi wanjeba, elyo nabo baliyapokelela. Balishininkisha nokuti ni kuli iwe nafuma. Elyo balisumina nokuti niwe wantuma.

english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
translation: “Kanshi ebo ndepepelako. Nshilepepelako abantu aba pano calo iyoo. Kanofye aba bene wampeela, pantu bantu bobe.

english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwile ukupepa, aima na basambi bakwe, bayabuka no mukonko wa Kidironi. Aingila mwibala lyali kulya kwine, pamo na basambi bakwe.

english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
translation: Elyo Simoni Petelo, uwali no lupanga, alusomona, akoma umusha wakwa Shimapepo mukalamba. Amusempako ukutwi kwa ku kulyo. Uyu musha ishina lyakwe ni Maliki.

english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
translation: Yesu epakweba Petelo ati, “Bwesesha ulupanga lobe mu citubo. Bushe kuti nakaana shani ubucushi ubo Tata ampeela?”

english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
translation: Elyo impuka ya fita fya bena Roma pamo no mukalamba wabo ne fita fyakulinda Itempele fyaikata Yesu, fyamukaka.

english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
translation: Babalilapo ukumutwala kuli Anasi. Uyu Anasi ali shifyala kwa Kayafa. Elyo Kayafa nao ewali Shimapepo mukalamba muli uyo mwaka.

english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
translation: Ni uyu wine Kayafa ewapandile Abayuda amano ati, “Cawama umuntu umo ewafwila abantu.”

english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
translation: Simoni Petelo elyo no musambi umbi bena bakonkele Yesu. Uyu musambi umbi wena alishibikwe kuli Shimapepo mukalamba. Kanshi ena aingila pamo na Yesu mu lubansa lwe sano lyakwa Shimapepo mukalamba.

english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
translation: Petelo ena ashala naiminina panse lwa pa mwinshi. Umusambi umbi ulya uwaishibikwe kuli Shimapepo mukalamba, afumina panse. Alanda no mukashana uwalelinda impongolo. Aingisha na Petelo mukati.

english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
translation: Umukashana uwalelinda impongolo aeba Petelo ati, “Bushe iwe tauli umo pa basambi ba ulya muntu?” Petelo ayasuka ati, “Awe, iyoo!”

english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
translation: Ico kwali impepo, abasha ne fita fyakulinda Itempele bakosha umulilo wa malasha, balaonta. Kanshi Petelo nao aya iminina apo bali, alaontako.

english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba elyo aipusha Yesu palwa basambi bakwe na pa mifundile yakwe.

english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
translation: Yuda uwali nokumuposa ku balwani, nao alishibeko, pantu ilingi line Yesu na basambi bakwe eko baleya mukukumanina.

english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ine nalelanda ku bantu pa lwalala. Lyonse nalefunda mu masinagoga na mwi Tempele umo Abayuda bonse balongana. Nshalandapo nangu cimo mu bumfisolo.

english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
translation: Kanshi cinshi ico ulenjipushisha? Ipusha abo baleumfwa ifyo nalelanda. Nabeshiba ifyo nalesosa.”

english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
translation: Yesu cilya alanda ifi, icita cimo pa fita fyakulinda Itempele, icali mupepi, catoba Yesu ulupi pa menso, casosa aciti, “Bushe iwe, ifyo efyakwasuka Shimapepo mukalamba?”

english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nga nalandapo cimo icibipile, njeba kanshi ico nabifya. Lelo nga nandile icishinka, cinshi ico wangumina?”

english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
translation: Elyo Anasi atuma Yesu, umo mwine akakilwe, kuli Kayafa, Shimapepo mukalamba.

english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
translation: Petelo ninshi wena eminine palya pene aleonta umulilo. Elyo bamo balamwipusha abati, “Bushe iwe, na iwe tauli umo pa basambi bakwe?” Petelo akaana ati, “Ine teine.”

english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
translation: Umusha umo uwakwa Shimapepo mukalamba, lupwa lwa muntu ulya Petelo acisempako ukutwi, alamwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe nshacikumona muli na Yesu mwibala?”

english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
translation: Awe nakabili Petelo akaana. Elyo apopene na mukolwe alila nokulila.

english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
translation: Lucelocelofye bafumishe Yesu kwa Kayafa, bamutwala na kwisano lya mulashi Pilato. Abayuda bena bakaana ukwingila mwisano lya mulashi, ico baletiina ukukowela, pantu ninshi teti balyeko Ipasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila.

english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
translation: Pilato epakufumina panse apo bali. Alabepusha ati, “Bushe milandu nshi akwete iyo mwamuletela kuno?”

english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
translation: Kanshi Yuda nao aisa kwibala. Aisa ne mpuka ya fita fya bena Roma pamo ne fita fyalelinda Itempele ifyo bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise batumine. Ifita fyena fyaisa nafisenda ifyanso ne fisaniko ne myenge.

english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
translation: Bamwasuka abati, “Akaanakwata mulandu, nga tekuti tumulete kuli iwe.”

english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
translation: Pilato epakubeba ati, “Kanshi musendeni mwe bene, muye mupingula ukulingana na mafunde yenu.” Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatwasuminishiwa ukwipaya umuntu.”

english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
translation: Ici cali cakufikilisha amashiwi Yesu asosele, pakulanga umusango wa mfwa ali nokufwa.

english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
translation: Pilato epakubwelela mwisano. Elyo aita Yesu alamwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe niwe Mfumu ya Bayuda?”

english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Bushe ifi uleipushishafye we mwine, nangu kuliko bambi abakushimikile pali ine?”

english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
translation: Pilato ayasuka ati, “Bushe ine ndi Muyuda? Bantu bobe na bashimapepo bacindami ebakuletele kuli ine. Finshi wacita?”

english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Ubufumu bwandi tabuli bwa pano calo. Ubufumu bwandi abuba bwa pano calo, abantu bandi nga kuti bandwilako pakuti niposwa ku Bayuda. Nomba Ubufumu bwandi tabuli bwa pano calo iyoo.”

english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
translation: Pilato elyo asosa ati, “Bushe kanshi uli mfumu?” Yesu ayasuka ati, “Niwe wasosa ukuti ndi mfumu. Umulandu nafyalilwa no kwisa pano isonde, ni pakuti mbe kambone ku fyacishinka. Onse uwaba ne cishinka alakutika kwishiwi lyandi.”

english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
translation: Elyo Pilato aipusha ati, “Nga icishinka cinshi?”

english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
translation: Lelo ukulingana no lutambi lwenu naba nokumukakwilapo umufungwa umo ku nshikunkulu ye Pasaka. Bushe mulefwaya ukuti mukakwile imfumu ya Bayuda?”

english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
translation: Yesu ena ninshi naishiba fyonse ifili nokumuponena. Kanshi aisa kukubakumanya. Abepusha ati, “Nani mulefwaya?”

english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
translation: Awe balapunda abati, “Uyu ena teo! Tulefwaya Balaba!” Uyu Balaba ali cipondo.

english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ni Yesu umwina Nasaleti.” Yesu abeba ati, “Nine wine.” Yuda uwaposele Yesu ku balwani, ninshi naiminina pamo ne fita.

english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
translation: Cilya Yesu abeba ati, “Nine wine,” ifita fyabwelela cimfutyanuma, fyawa panshi.

english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
translation: Yesu nakabili abepusha ati, “Bushe nani mulefwaya?” Nabo abati, “Ni Yesu umwina Nasaleti.”

english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nimweba nati, ala ‘Nine.’ Nga nine mulefwaya, lekeni abasambi bandi baleya.”

english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
translation: Aya mashiwi yali yakufikilishafye ifyo asosele ati, “Tata pa bantu wampeela, nshalufyapo nelyo umo.”

english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
translation: Pilato elyo abuulile Yesu, aebele ne fita fyakwe ukumuma ifikoti.

english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
translation: Pilato amweba ati, “Bushe wakaana ukunjasuka mwa? Tawishibe ukuti ine ninkwata amaka yakukulekamo nangu ayakukutanika?”

english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ukwabula ukuti Lesa akupeele ayo maka, nga tekuti ukwate amaka pali ine nakalya. Eico kanshi umuntu uwamposa kuli iwe, wena nabifya ukucilapo.”

english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
translation: Ilyo Pilato aumfwa ifi, alafwaya nokuti amulekemo. Lelo Abayuda balapunda abati, “Nga wamulekamo, ninshi tauli cibusa wakwa Kesalo! Onse uwatila ati, ‘Ndi mfumu,’ ninshi mulwani wakwa Kesalo.”

english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
translation: Pilato ati omfwe aya mashiwi, afumisha Yesu panse. Aikala na pa cipuna cakupingwilapo icali mu ncende iyo batila, “Umo bakubatila amabwe panshi.” Mu Cihibulu baita, “Gabata.”

english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
translation: Cali pa bushiku bwakupekanya Ipasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, ninshi akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe, pa nshita ya 12:00. Pilato aeba Abayuda ati, “Moneni imfumu yenu iyi!”

english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
translation: Nabo balapundafye abati, “Mwipayeni, mwipayeni mumutanike.” Pilato abeba ati, “Bushe ntanike imfumu yenu?” Bashimapepo bacindami bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatwakwata mfumu imbi kanofye Kesalo!”

english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
translation: Elyo Pilato abalubwila Yesu ukuti baye mutanika.

english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
translation: Yesu umwine aya nasenda umusalaba. Bafika na pa ncende batila, “Pa cipanga.” Mu Cihibulu batila, “Gologota.”

english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
translation: Pa ncende ine iyi, epo bamutanikila. Batanikilapo na bambi babili, umo ku kulyo, umbi ku kuso, elyo Yesu ena pakati.

english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
translation: Pilato alemba icishibilo. Acipampamina na pa mulu wa musalaba. Alembelepo ati, “Yesu umwina Nasaleti, Imfumu ya Bayuda.”

english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
translation: Awe ifita fyalema iŋana ya myunga, fyamufwika ku mutwe. Fyamufwika no mwingila uwakashika.

english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
translation: Ico pa ncende batanikilepo Yesu pali mupepi no musumba, Abayuda abengi balibelengelepo. Icishibilo cena calembelwe mu Cihibulu, mu Cilatini na mu Cigiriki.

english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami ba Bayuda epakweba Pilato abati, “Wilembapo ukuti Imfumu ya Bayuda. Lelo utile, ‘Uyu muntu aleti, Ndi mfumu ya Bayuda.’ ”

english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
translation: Pilato abasuka ati, “Ico nalemba, ninshi nindala ninemba.”

english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
translation: Cilya ifita fyatanika Yesu, elyo fyabuula ifyakufwala fyakwe. Fyayakanya pane. Cila cita cabuulapo icipande cimo. Elyo ifita fyabuula no mwingila. Uyu mwingila wena wa munkulinkuli, uwapikulwa ukwabula no mulundo.

english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
translation: Ifita fyalalanshanya afiti, “Awe umwingila wena twilepula. Natupendulefye, tumone uo cilewila, ninshi eulebuula.” Ifi fyacitike pakufikilisha ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ayakuti,

english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
translation: Mupepi no musalaba wakwa Yesu, paiminine nyina na nkashimbiye, Maria muka Kolopa, elyo na Maria Mandalena.

english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
translation: Yesu elyo amona nyina no musambi atemenwe nabeminina. Aeba nyina ati, “Mayo, uyu mwana wenu.”

english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
translation: Elyo aeba umusambi wakwe ati, “Aba e banoko.” Ukufuma palya pene umusambi asenda Maria alaikala kumwakwe.

english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
translation: Yesu ico aishiba ukuti nomba fyonse fyapwililika, kanshi pakufikilisha ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo, asosa ati, “Nafwa icilaka!”

english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
translation: Palipo no lunweno ulwaisulamo umwangashi uwakantuka. Elyo babuula umwepu bautumpika na mu mwangashi uwakantuka. Batunga umwepu kwitete. Elyo bamutambika ku kanwa.

english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
translation: Elyo ifita fyalaisa uko ali. Filesosa afiti, “Tupole mulopwe, we mfumu ya Bayuda!” Elyo filemuma ne ndupi pa menso.

english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
translation: Cilya Yesu anwako umwangashi wakantuka, asosa ati, “Nomba capwa.” Awe akobola no mukoshi, aleka no mweo.

english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
translation: Kanshi cali ni pa bushiku bwakupekanya Ipasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila. Abayuda tabalefwaya ukuti ifitumbi fishale pa misalaba. Pantu ubu bushiku bwe Sabata bwali ni nshikunkulu ikalamba. Kanshi Abayuda epakulomba Pilato ukuti bafunaule amolu ya batanikwe, bafumyepo ne fitumbi pa misalaba.

english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
translation: Ifita fyaisa, fyafunaula pakubala amolu ya fipondo fibili ifyatanikwe pamo na Yesu.

english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
translation: Cilya baisa kuli Yesu, basanga ena nafwa kale. Kanshi wena tabamufunawile amolu.

english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
translation: Lelo icita cimo, camulasa ifumo mu lubafu. Awe apopene mu lubafu mwasuuma umulopa na menshi.

english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
translation: Uwapeela bukambone pali ici, untu walemonako, eico na bukambone bwakwe bwacishinka. Naishiba ukuti ifyo ashimika fyacishinka, epakuti na imwe musumine.

english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
translation: Ifi fintu fyacitike pakufikilisha ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti,

english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
translation: Kabili kuli na fimbi ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti,

english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, Yosefu umwina Alimateya, aile lomba Pilato ukuti amusuminishe ukufumyapo icitumbi cakwa Yesu. Yosefu ali umusambi wakwa Yesu, lelo ni mu bumfisolo ico aletiina Abayuda. Pilato amusuminisha. Kanshi epakwisa buula icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
translation: Nikodemo nao aisako aleta imiti iyanunka ubusaka, muri na matembusha, iyakusuba icitumbi. Iyi miti yafinine amakilo amakumi yane na yasano (45Kg). Nikodemo eulya waishile ubushiku umuku wakubalilapo ukwisa kuli Yesu.

english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
translation: Pilato afumina panse nakabili. Alaeba Abayuda ati, “Moneni, nalafumisha Yesu pano panse, pakuti mwishibe ukuti ine nshimusangile na mulandu nelyo umo.”

english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
translation: Elyo aba bantu babili babuula icitumbi cakwa Yesu, bacisuba na mafuta ya cena cisuma. Elyo bacipomba mu nsalu, ukulingana no lutambi lwa mishikile ya Bayuda.

english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
translation: Ku ncende batanikile Yesu kwali ibala mupepi. Elyo mwibala line ili mwalimo inindi ipya umo bashatalile abashikamo umuntu.

english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
translation: Kanshi emo babika icitumbi cakwa Yesu, pantu cali pa bushiku bwa Bayuda ubwakupekanya ubushiku bwe Sabata, elyo nakabili neco inindi yali mupepi.

english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
translation: Elyo Yesu afumina panse, ali ne ŋana ya myunga ku mutwe, nafwala no mwingila uwakashika. Pilato abeba ati, “Moneni! Umuntu uyu!”

english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
translation: Cilya bashimapepo bacindami ne fita fyakulinda Itempele bamumona balapunda abati, “Mutanikeni, mutanikenifye!” Pilato abeba ati, “Kanshi musendeni mwe bene muye mutanika. Ine nshimusangile na mulandu nelyo umo.”

english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
translation: Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe twalikwata ifunde, elyo no kukonka ili funde ali nokufwa, pantu aletila, ‘Nine Mwana Lesa!’ ”

english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
translation: Pilato ati omfwe aya mashiwi, umwenso wamwikata nganshi.

english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
translation: Elyo abwelela mwisano, alaipusha Yesu ati, “Bushe ni kwi wafuma?” Lelo Yesu wena no kumwasuka nakalya.

english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
translation: Ukufumafye ku citendekelo, Lishiwi eko ali. Lishiwi ali pamo na Lesa. Kabili Lishiwi ali ni Lesa.

english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
translation: Lishiwi ali pano isonde. Ni muli Lishiwi Lesa abumbile isonde. Nomba abantu ba pano sonde tabamwishibe.

english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
translation: Lishiwi aishile mu calo cakwe, nomba abantu bakwe tabamupokelele.

english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
translation: Lelo bonse abamupokelela, bamusumina no kumusumina, ena abapeela amaka yakuba abana bakwa Lesa.

english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
translation: Baba abana bakwa Lesa te mu musango wabumuntu, nangu ukufwaya kwa bantu, nangu ukufwaya kwa mwaume, awe iyoo, ni Lesa fye umwine ku maka yakwe.

english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
translation: Awe Lishiwi aishile aluka umuntu. Aisa ikala na ifwe. Twalimona ubucindami bwakwe. Ubucindami bwa Mwana uwabafye umo mpo, ubo apoka ukufuma kuli Wishi. Alikwatisha icikuuku ne cishinka.

english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
translation: Yoani alimwiminine bukambone ilyo alebila ati, “Euyu naleeba nati, uukankonka panuma, alicila ine. Pantu ine nshilabako ninshi wena eko aba!”

english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
translation: Nico wacikuuku nganshi eco na ifwe bonse tushukilako amapaalo na mapaalo.

english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
translation: Mose ewaletele amafunde, lelo icikuuku ne cishinka fyena ni Yesu Kristu ewaleta.

english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
translation: Takwaba nangu umo uwatala amona Lesa, kanofye Mwane umo mpo, Lesa wine uwikala mu ceni cakwa Wishi, ewaisa musokolola.

english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
translation: Ubu e bukambone bwakwa Yoani. Abayuda ba mu Yerusalemu batile ilyo batuma bashimapepo na bena Levi kuli Yoani, baisa kukumwipusha abati, “Bushe niwe ani?”

english: The same was in the beginning with God.
translation: Lishiwi ali pamo na Lesa ukufumafye ku citendekelo.

english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
translation: Yoani tafishile, ayasukafye apabuuta tuutu ati, “Ine nshili Kristu.”

english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
translation: Elyo bamwipusha abati, “Kanshi niwe ani? Bushe niwe Eliya?” Yoani ati, “Awe ine tene.” “Bushe niwe ulya kasesema?” Yoani abasuka ati, “Awe iyoo.”

english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
translation: Kabili bamwipusha abati, “Kanshi niwe ani? Tuli nokuya eba abatutumine ifyo uleyasuka. Nga kanshi we mwine uletila niwe ani?”

english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
translation: Yoani ayasuka ati, “Ngomo kasesema Esaya alandile,

english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
translation: Nomba Abafalise nabo batumako inkombe.

english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
translation: Inkombe shaipusha Yoani ashiti, “Nga kanshi cinshi ico ubatishisha nga tauli Kristu nangu Eliya nangu ulya kasesema?”

english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
translation: Yoani abasuka ati, “Ine mbatisha ku menshi. Nomba apo muli palipo umo uo mushishibe.

english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
translation: Akesa panuma yandi. Elyo ine nshilingile no kukakula inshinga sha ndyato shakwe.”

english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
translation: Ifi fyonse fyacitike mu Betani uko Yoani alebatisha, lubali lwa kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani.

english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, Yoani amwene Yesu aleisa uko ali, asosa ati, “Ala uyu, e Mwana wa mpaanga wakwa Lesa, uufumya ububifi bwa ba pano isonde.

english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
translation: Ni kuli Lishiwi Lesa abumbile ifintu fyonse. Tapaba nelyo cimo ico Lesa abumba ukwabula Lishiwi.

english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
translation: Kanshi uyu eo nalelandapo, ilyo naleti, ‘Umuntu alaisa panuma yandi. Alicindama ukuncila. Pantu ine nshilati mbeko ninshi wena eko aba.’

english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
translation: Na ine wine nshamwishibe. Lelo umulandu naishile kukubatisha na menshi, ni pakuti asokoloke ku bena Israeli.”

english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
translation: Kabili Yoani alanda muli bukambone bwakwe ati, “Namwene Mupashi aleika ukufuma ku mulu kwati ni nkunda, aisa ikalilila pali Yesu.

english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
translation: Na ine nshamwishibe nakalya. Lelo uwantumine kukubatisha ku menshi, anjebele ati, ‘Uo ukamona Mupashi amwikila, aisa ikalilila pali ena, uyo eukalabatisha kuli Mupashi.’

english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
translation: Ee, naliimwena no kushininkisha ukuti, uyu e Mwana wakwa Lesa.”

english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, Yoani kabili ali palya pene na basambi bakwe babili.

english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
translation: Cilya Yesu alepita, Yoani amumona, alasosa ati, “Moneni, Umwana wa mpaanga wakwa Lesa!”

english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
translation: Abasambi aba babili bati bomfwe ifyo Yoani alanda, baya kuli Yesu balamukonka.

english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
translation: Yesu acebukila kunuma, amona balemukonka. Abepusha ati, “Cinshi mulefwaya?” Bamwasuka abati, “Rabi, (emukutila ‘Kafundisha,’) bushe ni kwi wikala?”

english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
translation: Nao Yesu abasuka ati, “Iseni, mumone!” Awe nabo baya mona uko aleikala. Baikala nankwe ubo bushiku, cali mupepi na lilya akasuba kalasumbila kukuwa pa nshita ya 16:00:

english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
translation: Muli Lishiwi mwaba umweo, noyu mweo waba ulubuuto ku bantu.

english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
translation: Pali aba babili abaumfwile ifyo Yoani alelanda, bakonka na Yesu, umo ni Andele munyina kwa Simoni Petelo.

english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
translation: Icakubalilapofye Andele acitile, kuya alefwaya Simoni munyina. Amweba ati, “Natusanga Mesia,” emukutila Kristu.

english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
translation: Elyo aleta Simoni kuli Yesu. Yesu amulolesha, asosa ati, “Niwe Simoni mwana Yoani. Nomba wakulaitwa Kefa, ekutila ‘Petelo.’ ”

english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, Yesu apangile ukuya ku Galile. Awe cilya asanga Filipo, amweba ati, “Nkonka.”

english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
translation: Filipo ali umwina Betisaida umusumba umwaleikala Andele na Petelo.

english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
translation: Elyo Filipo aya sanga Natanaeli. Alamweba ati, “Natusanga uo Mose alembapo mu mafunde kabili eo na bakasesema balembapo. Ala ni Yesu wa ku Nasaleti, mwana Yosefu.”

english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
translation: Natanaeli amweba ati, “Bushe ku Nasaleti nako kuti kwafuma icintu icisuma?” Filipo amwasuka ati, “Isa, so imwene.”

english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
translation: Yesu cilya amona Natanaeli uko aleisa, alamulandapo ati, “Ala uyu e mwina Israeli wine wine uushaba na bufi.”

english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
translation: Natanaeli epakwipusha Yesu ati, “Nga mwanjishiba shani?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nacikumona lilya wali wikele mwisamba lya mukunyu ninshi Filipo talati akwite.”

english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
translation: Natanaeli amwasuka ati, “Kafundisha, uli Mwana wakwa Lesa, uli Mfumu ya bena Israeli!”

english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
translation: Ulubuuto lusanika mu mfifi, pantu imfifi yalifilwa ukulushimya.

english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bushe wasumina icofye nakweba ati, ‘Nacikumona mwisamba lya mukunyu?’ Ala ukamona ifintu ifyacila pali ici.”

english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
translation: Elyo alundapo ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, mukamona umulu wacenama, na bamalaika bakwa Lesa balenina no kwika apali Umwana wa muntu!”

english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
translation: Lesa atumine umuntu, ishina lyakwe ni Yoani.

english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
translation: Yoani epakwisa nga kambone, pakuti apeele bukambone pa lubuuto. Epakuti bonse abalemumfwa basumine.

english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
translation: Yoani wena tali lubuuto. Lelo aishile pakupeela bukambone ku lubuuto.

english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
translation: Lishiwi ewali e lubuuto lwacine cine. Ewaisa pano isonde kukusanikila umuntu onse.

english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
translation: Lucelocelo pa bushiku bwakutampa umulungu ninshi kuciliko akafifi, Maria Mandalena aile ku nindi. Amona nokuti icilibwe nabacifumyapo pa mwinshi wa nindi.

english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
translation: Elyo aba basambi babwelelamo ku musumba.

english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
translation: Maria wena ninshi eminine kunse ya nindi, alelila. Ilyo acili alelila, ainama pakuti aloleshe mu nindi.

english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
translation: Awe amonamo bamalaika babili bafwele insalu ishabuuta, bekele apo balalike icitumbi cakwa Yesu. Umo ku mitwe elyo umbi ku ntambalilo.

english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
translation: Bamalaika bamwipusha abati, “We mayo, cinshi ulelilila?” Nao abasuka ati, “Nabasenda Imfumu yandi, nshishibe noko baibikile!”

english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
translation: Ilyo Maria asosa ifi, apilibuka amona na Yesu naiminina. Nomba taishibe ukuti ni Yesu.

english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
translation: Yesu amwipusha ati, “Mayo cinshi ulelilila? Bushe nani ulefwaya?” Maria ena ico aletontonkanya ati mulimi wa mwibala, amweba ati, “Mukwai nga nimwe mumusendele, njebeni uko mumubikile, na ine nalaya mubuula.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
translation: Yesu elyo amwita ati, “Maria!” Maria nao apilibuka, amwasukila mu Cihibulu ati, “Raboni!” Ici calola mukuti, “Kafundisha.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Leka ukunjikata, pantu nshilabwelelamo kuli Tata. Nomba kabiye kuli bamunyinane ubebe auti, Yesu aleti, ‘Nalabwelelamo kuli Tata, na imwe ni Shinwe, ni Lesa wandi, na imwe ni Lesa wenu.’ ”

english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
translation: Maria Mandalena epakuya ku basambi. Alabeba ati, “Nimona Imfumu.” Elyo alabashimikila na fyonse ifyo Yesu amwebele.

english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
translation: Pa nshiku ya Mulungu ine iyo, icungulo bushiku, ku mulandu wakutiina Abayuda, abasambi balongene mu ŋanda nabesalako ne fiibi. Elyo Yesu aisa iminina apo bali, abeba ati, “Umutende ube na imwe!”

english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
translation: Awe abwelelamo ulubilo kuli Simoni Petelo na ku musambi umbi ulya Yesu atemenwe. Abeba ati, “Nabafumya Imfumu mu nindi, tatwishibe noko baibikile!”

english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
translation: Ati asose ifi, elyo abalanga indupi shakwe na mu lubafu lwakwe. Awe abasambi basansamuka nganshi pakumona Imfumu.

english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
translation: Yesu abwekeshapo nakabili ukubeba ati, “Umutende ube na imwe! Filya Tata antuma, efyo na ine namutuma.”

english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
translation: Ati asose ifi, abaputilisha umupu, abeba ati, “Pokeni Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
translation: Nga mwabelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi fyakwe, ninshi nabelelwa uluse. Nga mwakaana ukubelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi fyakwe, ninshi tabelelwe luse.”

english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
translation: Toma umo pa basole ikumi na babili, uo baleti, Mpundu, wena talipo ilyo Yesu aishile.

english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
translation: Elyo abasambi bambi balamushimikila abati, “Ifwe natumona Imfumu.” Lelo Toma abasuka ati, “Ine pakusumina kanofye namona ifibala fya nsunga mu ndupi shakwe, nashimpa no munwe wandi pa fibala, nabika ne minwe yandi mu lubafu lwakwe, nga teifyo ninshi nshasumine.”

english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
translation: Pati papite umulungu umo, abasambi nakabili bali mu ŋanda, Toma nao lyena ali nabo pamo. Yesu aisamo ninshi ifiibi nafisalwa. Aiminina napo bali, asosa ati, “Umutende ube na imwe!”

english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
translation: Elyo aeba Toma ati, “Shimpa umunwe obe apa, lolesha na mu ndupi shandi. Buula iminwe yobe wikate na mu lubafu lwandi. Nomba leka ukutwishika, suminafye!”

english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
translation: Toma epakwasuka ati, “We Mfumu yandi, we Lesa wandi!”

english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
