translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Wasumina ico wamona. Ala abashuka ni abo bantu abasumina nelyo bashimwene.”

english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
translation: Kanshi Petelo no musambi umbi ulya baima, balaya ku nindi.

english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
translation: Yesu acitilefye ifishibilo ifingi pa cinso ca basambi bakwe ifishalembwa muli ici citabo.

english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
translation: Ifi fyena fyalilembwa pakuti musumine ukuti Yesu e Kristu, Mwana Lesa. Elyo na imwe nga mwamusumina, mumone ukukwata umweo.

english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
translation: Balabutukilafye capamo. Lelo umusambi umbi ulya, acisha Petelo ulubilo abalilapo no kufika ku nindi.

english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
translation: Ati enaminemo, amona insalu shili panshi. Nomba taingilemo iyoo.

english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
translation: Simoni Petelo uwalemukonka lutonuma, nao afika. Wena apopene aingila mu nindi. Amona ne nsalu shili panshi.

english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
translation: Amona ne nsalu intu bapombele Yesu ku mutwe. Yena yali iyapetwa, tayali pamo ne nsalu shimbi.

english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
translation: Elyo umusambi umbi ulya abalilepo ukufika ku nindi, nao aingilamo. Ati amone ifi, asumina.

english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
translation: Pantu pali iyi nshita, ninshi tabalaumfwa umwalola ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti, “Kristu ali nokushukuka ku bafwa.”

english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, Yesu nakabili amonekele ku basambi bakwe kuli bemba wa Tibelia. Kanshi cali nifi.

english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Letenipo isabi limo pali ilyo isabi mwaipaya nombaline.”

english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
translation: Simoni Petelo epakuya mu bwato. Alakulila isumbu ku mulundu, umwiswile ifimasabi ifikulu fyeka fyeka, umwanda umo na makumi yasano na fitatu (153). Nangu ifimasabi fyafulile ifi, isumbu lyena talyalepwike.

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Iseni mwikule.” Pa basambi tapali nangu umo uwapamine ukumwipusha ati, “Bushe niwani?” Balishibe ukuti ni Mfumu.

english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
translation: Elyo Yesu aya buula umukate abapeela, ne sabi nalyo abapeela.

english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
translation: Uyu e muku wabutatu Yesu amonekele ku basambi bakwe, panuma yakushukuka ku bafwa.

english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
translation: Cilya bapwa ukulya, Yesu aipusha Simoni Petelo ati, “Simoni mwana Yoani, bushe walintemwa ukucila aba?” Petelo amwasuka ati, “Ee we Mfumu, walishiba ukuti nalikutemwa.” Yesu amweba ati, “Ulecema abana ba mpaanga shandi.”

english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
translation: Yesu amwipusha umuku wabubili ati, “Simoni mwana Yoani, bushe walintemwa?” Nao amwasuka ati, “Ee we Mfumu, walishiba ukuti nalikutemwa.” Yesu amweba ati, “Ulecema impaanga shandi.”

english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
translation: Yesu amwipusha umuku wabutatu ati, “Simoni mwana Yoani, bushe walintemwa?” Awe Petelo camusakamika ico Yesu amwipusha umuku wabutatu ati, “Bushe walintemwa?” Kanshi amweba ati, “We Mfumu, iwe walishiba ifintu fyonse. Walishiba ukuti nalikutemwa!” Yesu amweba ati, “Ulecema impaanga shandi.

english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
translation: Ndekweba icine cine, ilyo wali umulumendo walesamwina ifyakufwala no kuya konse uko ulefwaya. Lelo ilyo ukakota, lyena ukatambalika amaboko. Elyo umbi eukakufwika no kukutwala uko ushilefwaya.”

english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
translation: Mukulanda ifi, Yesu alelanga umusango wa mfwa untu Petelo ali nokufwa no kucindikilako Lesa. Cilya apwa ukulanda ifi, elyo aeba Petelo ati, “Nkonka.”

english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
translation: Simoni Petelo, Toma uo baleti, Mpundu, Natanaeli umwina Kana mu calo ca Galile, bamwana Sebede, elyo na basambi bakwa Yesu bambi babili balongene pamo.

english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation: Petelo elyo apilibukila kunuma, amona no musambi umbi ulya Yesu atemenwe alekonka. Uyu musambi eulya wine washintilile pa cifuba cakwa Yesu ilyo balelya umulalilo, uwaipwishe Yesu ati, “We Mfumu, nga nani alekuposa ku balwani?”

english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
translation: Ilyo Petelo amumona aipusha Yesu ati, “Nga uyo wena ni shani?”

english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nga ndefwaya ukuti abe umumi mpaka nkabwele, bushe uyo mulandu obe? Ala iwe nkonkafye!”

english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
translation: Kanshi ecalengele nokuti ilyashi lisalangane mu basambi bakwa Yesu ukuti uyu musambi wena takafwe. Lelo Yesu talandile ukuti ulya musambi takafwe. Awe atile, “Nga ndefwaya ukuti abe umumi mpaka nkabwele, bushe uyo mulandu obe?”

english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
translation: Uyu musambi e kambone pali ifi fintu fyonse. Kabili no kulemba ewafilemba. Twalishiba nokuti bukambone bwakwe bwacishinka.

english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
translation: Kwaliba na fimbi ifintu ifingi ifyo Yesu acitile. Ine ndemona ukuti, fyonse ifyo Yesu acitile afilembwa nga tekuti pabe incende pano isonde apakubika ifitabo fingalembwa.

english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
translation: Simoni Petelo abeba ati, “Ine nalaya kukwipaya isabi.” Nabo bamweba abati, “Twalayafye bonse.” Awe baya, baingila na mu bwato. Nomba ubo bushiku tabaipeye nangu kamo.

english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
translation: Cilya bwaca lucelocelofye, Yesu aisa iminina pa lulamba lwa bemba. Nomba abasambi tabaishibe nakalya ukuti ni Yesu.

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
translation: Yesu abepusha ati, “Mwe bana, bushe tamwipeye isabi nangu limo?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Awe iyoo.”

english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Teyeni isumbu lyenu lubali lwa ku kulyo kwa bwato, lyena mwalaipaya.” Awe bateya ne sumbu. Ifimasabi ifingi nganshi fyaikatwa, icakuti bafilwa no kutintila isumbu ku bwato.

english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
translation: Elyo umusambi umbi ulya Yesu atemenwe, aeba Petelo ati, “Ala ni Mfumu!” Simoni Petelo cilya aumfwa ukuti ni Mfumu, abuula icakufimbana akaka mu musana, pantu alisamwinine. Awe aiposa na pali bemba.

english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
translation: Abasambi bambi bena baisa mu bwato, baletinta isumbu ilyaisulamo ifimasabi. Tabali patali ukufuma ku mulundu, palifye cikanga intampulo umwanda umo.

english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
translation: Ilyo bafika ku mulundu, bamona isabi lilepya pa mulilo wa malasha, elyo no mukate.

english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
translation: Awe ilyo papitile inshiku shibili, mu bwashitatu kwali ubwinga mu Kana mu calo ca Galile. Nyina kwa Yesu nao eko ali.

english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
translation: “Umuntu onse abalilapo ukupeela umwangashi uuwamishepo. Ilyo abantu betilwe banwa nganshi, elyo aleta umwangashi uushiwamishe. Nomba iwe nausunga umwangashi uuwamishe ukufika na nomba!”

english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
translation: Ici e cishibilo Yesu abalilepo ukucita. Acicitile mu Kana umushi wa mu Galile. Awe asokolola ubucindami bwakwe, na basambi bakwe epakumusumina.

english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
translation: Panuma ya ifi, Yesu na nyina na bamunyina na basambi bakwe batentemukila ku Kapenamu. Nomba baya ikalako inshikufye shinono.

english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
translation: Cilya Ipasaka inshikunkulu ya Bayuda iya Cakucilila yapalama, Yesu aninika ukuya ku Yerusalemu.

english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
translation: Mwi Tempele, asangamo abantu abaleshitisha iŋombe, impaanga ne nkunda, na bambi nabekala balekabushanya indalama.

english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
translation: Awe abuula imyando apangako icikoti. Elyo alatamfisha bonse panse ye Tempele, impaanga ne ŋombe shine. Alapenaula amatebulo ya balekabushanya indalama, ne ndalama shapasangana.

english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
translation: Abaleshitisha inkunda bena abeba ati, “Fifumyeni muno! Tamuli nakusangula iŋanda yakwa Tata icisankano!”

english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
translation: Elyo abasambi baibukisha ifyalembwa ifyakuti, “Icitemwiko cakutemwisha isano lyobe, we Lesa cikanjipaya.”

english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
translation: Abayuda bena bamwipusha abati, “Bushe cishibilo nshi wingacita icingatulanga ukuti, walikwata amaka yakucita ifi wacita?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bongololeni ili Tempele, na ine nkalikuula mu nshiku shitatu.”

english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
translation: Yesu na basambi bakwe nabo balibalalike ku bwinga.

english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
translation: Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Bapwile imyaka amakumi yane na mutanda pakukuula ili Tempele. Elyo iwe niwe wingalikuula mu nshikufye shitatu?”

english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
translation: Lelo Tempele Yesu alelandapo, mubili wakwe.

english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
translation: Kanshi ilyo aisa shukuka ku bafwa, abasambi bakwe epakwibukisha ifyo abashimikileko pali uyu mulandu. Awe basumina ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo, na mashiwi Yesu abebele.

english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
translation: Nomba mu nshikunkulu ye Pasaka, ilyo Yesu ali mu Yerusalemu, awe abantu abengi bamusumina, ico bamona ifishibilo alecita.

english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
translation: Nomba Yesu umwine tabacetekele iyoo, pantu alibeshibe bonse.

english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
translation: Kabili talekabila ukuti kube uwakumweba ifyo abantu baba, pantu umwine wine alishiba ifyaba mu mitima ya bantu.

english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
translation: Kanshi ilyo umwangashi wapwa, nyina kwa Yesu aisa mweba ati, “Wapwa umwangashi onse.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
translation: Nomba Yesu ayasuka ati, “Mayo, nga mulenjipushisha nshi? Inshita yandi tailafikila.”

english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
translation: Nyina kwa Yesu ena aeba ababomfi ati, “Mucite fyonse ifyo alemweba.”

english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
translation: Palipo imitondo ya mabwe mutanda iya menshi pakukonka ulutambi lwa Bayuda ulwakusamba pakuisangulula. Cila mutondo kuti mwaingila amatepe ya menshi yane nangu yasano.

english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba ababomfi ati, “Isusheni amenshi muli iyi mitondo.” Awe baisusha amenshi mu mitondo ukufikafye na pamulu.

english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Tapulenimo, twalileni umukalamba wa bwinga.” Awe efyo bacita.

english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
translation: Awe umukalamba wa bwinga atapulamo amenshi ayalwike umwangashi. Wena ninshi teshibe uko umwangashi wafuma, lelo ababomfi abatapile amenshi bena ninshi nabeshiba. Kanshi epakwita shibwinga alamweba ati,

english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
translation: Kwali umuntu umo Umufalise, kabili intungulushi mu Bayuda, ishina lyakwe ni Nikodemo.

english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Iwe uli kafundisha mu Israeli, bushe niwe ushingeshiba ifi fintu?

english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
translation: Ndekweba mu cine cine, ifwe tulanda ifyo twaishiba, kabili tupeela bukambone pafyo twamona. Nomba imwe tamusumina bukambone bwesu.

english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
translation: Tamusumina ilyo ndemweba ifya pano calo, palibufi kuti mwasumina shani ilyo namweba pa fya ku mulu?

english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
translation: Tapaba uwaya ku mulu, kanofye Umwana wa muntu uwaika ukufuma ku mulu.

english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
translation: “Kanshi nga filya Mose aimike insoka mu matololo, efyo no Mwana wa muntu ali nao nokwimikwa pa musalaba.

english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
translation: Pakuti onse uwamusumina akwate umweo wape.

english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
translation: Pantu Lesa alitemwisha aba pano isonde. Abapeela na Mwane uwabafye umo mpo. Pakuti onse uwamusumina, ekaloba, lelo akwate umweo wape.

english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
translation: Pantu Lesa tatuma Mwane pano isonde kukupeela aba pano isonde umulandu, lelo ni pakuti abapusushe bonse.

english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
translation: “Uusumina Mwane takapeelwe mulandu. Lelo uwakaana ukumusumina wena alipeelwa umulandu libela, pantu akaana ukusumina muli Mwana Lesa uwabafye umo mpo.

english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
translation: Kanshi ubupingushi bwaba nifi, ulubuuto nalwisa pano isonde, nomba abantu batemwapo imfifi ukucila ulubuuto, pantu ifintu bacita fyalibipa.

english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
translation: Uyu muntu aisa ubushiku kuli Yesu, alamweba ati, “Kafundisha, ifwe twalishiba ukuti ni Lesa ewakutuma kukwisa tufunda. Pantu tapaba nangu umo uwingacita ifishibilo ifyo ulecita, kano Lesa ali nankwe.”

english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
translation: Onse uubifya alapata ulubuuto, tekuti ese ku lubuuto, pantu tafwaya ukuti ifintu acita ifyabipa fimoneke.

english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
translation: Lelo umuntu uutungululwa ne fyacishinka mu bumi bwakwe, wena alesa ku lubuuto, epakuti cimoneke kuli bonse ukuti imicitile yakwe ya bwina Lesa.”

english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
translation: Kabili Yesu na basambi bakwe baile mu calo ca Yudeya. Baikalamo akashita kanono, balebatisha.

english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
translation: Yoani nao alebatisha ku Enoni mupepi na ku Salimu, ico ekwali amenshi ayengi. Abantu nabo eko balaisa kukubatishiwa.

english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
translation: Pali iyi inshita ninshi Yoani talati aposwe mu cifungo.

english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
translation: Abasambi bakwa Yoani bamo balabikana ifikansa no Muyuda umo palwa kusangululwa.

english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
translation: Elyo baya kuli Yoani balamweba abati, “Kafundisha, ulya muntu mwali nao kwishilya lya Yordani, uo wapeelelepo bukambone, nomba nao alebatisha. Elyo na bantu bonse eko baleya.”

english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
translation: Yoani abasuka ati, “Umuntu teti akwate nelyo cimo kano Lesa amupeela.

english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
translation: Imwe bene nimwe bakambone bandi. Nasosele nati, ‘Ine nshili Kristu iyoo. Ine Lesa antumafye kukumusobela.’

english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
translation: Umwine wakwa nabwinga ni shibwinga. Cibusa wakwa shibwinga, uwiminina alekutika, ena asansamukafye pakumfwa ishiwi lyakwa shibwinga. Kanshi ishi e nsansa shandi, kabili nomba nashipwililika.

english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ndekweba icine cine umuntu teti engile mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, kano afyalwa nakabili.”

english: He must increase, but I must decrease.
translation: Kanshi Kristu ali nokulalumbukilako elyo ine ndi nokulacepelako.”

english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
translation: Uyu uwafuma ku mulu, alicila pali bonse. Elyo onse uwa pano calo, mwina calo, kabili alandafye ifyacalo. Lelo uwafuma ku mulu alicila bonse.

english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
translation: Wena ni kambone pa fintu amona no kumfwa, nomba tapaba uusekelela bukambone bwakwe.

english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
translation: Umuntu onse uusekelela bukambone bwakwe, alashininkisha ukuti Lesa mufumacumi.

english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
translation: Uo Lesa atuma alanda amashiwi yakwa Lesa, pantu Lesa alimupeelesha nganshi Mupashi wakwe.

english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
translation: Wishi alitemwa Mwane, kabili alimupeela amaka pali fyonse.

english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
translation: Onse uwasumina Mwana Lesa alakwata umweo wape. Lelo onse uushasumina Mwana Lesa takamone umweo, pantu icipyu cakwa Lesa caba pali wena.

english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
translation: Nikodemo amwipusha ati, “Nga kanshi umuntu umukalamba kuti afyalwa shani nakabili? Bushe kuti aingila mwifumo lyakwa nyina, pakuti afyalwe nakabili?”

english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ndekweba icine cine, tapaba nangu umo uwingengila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa kano afyalwa ku menshi na kuli Mupashi.

english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
translation: Icifyalwa ku mubili, mubili, ne cifyalwa kuli Mupashi, mupashi.

english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
translation: Kanshi wisunguka ico nakweba nati, bonse muli nokufyalwa nakabili.

english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
translation: Umwela upuupila uko utemenwe. Iwe ulomfwa uko umwela ulepuupa, lelo tawishiba uko ulefuma noko uleya. Ifi efyo ciba pakuti umuntu afyalwe nakabili kuli Mupashi.”

english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
translation: Nikodemo epakwipusha ati, “Nge ca musango uyu kuti cacitika shani?”

english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
translation: Abafalise baumfwile ukuti Yesu nacila Yoani ukukwata abasambi no kubatisha abengi.

english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ala awishiba ubupe bwakwa Lesa, no ulekulomba amenshi yakunwa, nga niwe umulombele, nao nga kuti akupeela amenshi yakupeela umweo.”

english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
translation: Umwanakashi amwasuka ati, “Mukwai, tamukwete ne cakutapilako amenshi, elyo ne cishima naco cintu cashika. Nga kanshi mulefumya kwi amenshi yakupeela umweo?

english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
translation: Icikolwe cesu Yakobo ewatupeela ici cishima. Umwine wine pamo na bamwane ne fitekwa fyakwe balenwa muli ici cishima. Bushe imwe muleti namucila pali Yakobo?”

english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Uyo onse uunwa aya menshi akomfwa icilaka nakabili.

english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
translation: Lelo uyo onse uukanwa amenshi nkapeela, takomfwe cilaka nakabili. Pantu amenshi nkamupeela yakaluka mu nda yakwe akamfukumfuku ka menshi yakupeela umweo, yakamupeela no mweo wape.”

english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
translation: Umwanakashi ati, “Mukwai, mpeeleniko ayo menshi! Epakuti nilaumfwa icilaka nakabili, nilaisa lyonse kukutapa amenshi.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Kabiye kete umulume obe, wise nankwe kuno.”

english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
translation: Umwanakashi amwasuka ati, “Nshakwata mulume.” Yesu aeba umwanakashi ati, “Ee, walungika pakusosa auti, ‘Nshakwata mulume.’

english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
translation: Pantu waupwa ku baume basano, elyo noyu wine uli nao, tali mulume obe. Ico walanda cacishinka.”

english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
translation: Umwanakashi ati, “Mukwai, namona ukuti muli kasesema.

english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
translation: Kwena Yesu umwine talebatisha, lelo basambi bakwe ebalebatisha.

english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
translation: Ifikolwe fyesu fyalepepa Lesa pali ulu lupili. Nomba imwe mwe Bayuda mutila, incende umo abantu bali nokupepela Lesa ni mu Yerusalemu.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Mayo, ala nsumina, inshita ikesa ilyo mushakalepepela Tata pali ulu lupili nangu mu Yerusalemu.

english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Samaria tamwaishiba ico mupepa. Nomba ifwe fwe Bayuda twalishiba uo tupepa, pantu ukupusuka kuli nokufuma ku Bayuda.

english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
translation: Kwena inshita ikesa, no kufika naifika, ilyo bakapepa bene bene bakalapepa Tata mu mupashi na mu cishinka. Aba e bakapepa Tata afwaya.

english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
translation: Umwanakashi aeba Yesu ati, “Nalishiba ukuti Mesia, uo batila Kristu ali nokwisa. Ilyo akesa, akesa tweba fyonse.”

english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nine wine, uo mulelanda nankwe.”

english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
translation: Awe apopene abasambi bakwa Yesu bafika. Bapapa pakumona ukuti Yesu alelanda no mwanakashi. Lelo tapali nangu umo uwamwipwishe ati, “Finshi ulefwaya?” nangu “Finshi ulelandila no mwanakashi?”

english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
translation: Awe umwanakashi asha umutondo wakwe, abwelelamo ku musumba. Elyo alaeba abantu ati,

english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
translation: “Iseni mumone umuntu uwanjeba fyonse ifyo nacita. Bushe ninshi teo e Kristu?”

english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
translation: Kanshi Yesu ati omfwe ifi, afuma mu Yudeya abwelela nakabili mu Galile.

english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
translation: Awe abantu bonse bafuma mu musumba, balaya ukwali Yesu.

english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
translation: Ilyo ninshi abasambi bena babikilepofye ukweba Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, ala lyenipo icakulya!”

english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
translation: Yosh 24:32

english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
translation: Elyo abasambi balaipushanya abati, “Bushe nalimo kuliko umo uumuletele icakulya?”

english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Icakulya candi kucita ifyo uwantuma afwaya, no kupwishishisha umulimo wakwe.

english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
translation: “Bushe tamutila amuti, ‘Kwashala imyeshi ine, ninshi ulwakulobolola lwafika?’ Lelo ine namweba, lolesheni mumone mu mabala, ifisabo nafipya ifyakulobolola!

english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
translation: No wakulobolola alepoka amalipilo yakwe, alelonganya ifisabo ifyakuleta mu mweo wape. Epakuti uubyala no ulobolola basansamukile pamo.

english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
translation: Kanshi insoselo yakuti, ‘Uubyala ni umbi, no ulobolola nao ni umbi’, yalolamo.

english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
translation: Pantu imwe namutuma kukulobolola mu mabala ayo imwe mushalimine. Bambi ebalimine, elyo imwe mulelobolola ifisabo fya milimo yabo.”

english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
translation: Abena Samaria abengi aba muli uyu musumba basumina Yesu, ico uyu mwanakashi abebele ati, “Anjebele fyonse ifyo nacita.”

english: He needed to pass through Samaria.
translation: Pakubwelelamo, ali nokupita mu Samaria.

english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
translation: Elyo abena Samaria baisa kuli Yesu balamupapata ukuti ekale nabo. Awe Yesu epakwikala nabo inshiku shibili.

english: Many more believed because of his word.
translation: Awe na bambi abengi basumina pa mulandu wa mashiwi Yesu alebalandila.

english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
translation: Balaeba no mwanakashi abati, “Nomba natusumina, te mulandu wa pali ifyo watwebele, awe natuyumfwila fwe bene. Kabili natushininkisha ukuti uyu e Mupusushi wa ba pano isonde.”

english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
translation: Cilya papitile inshiku shibili, elyo Yesu afumineko aya ku Galile.

english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
translation: Yesu umwine asosele ati, “Kasesema tacindikwa ku ba mu calo cakwe.”

english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
translation: Ilyo afika mu Galile, abena Galile bamupokelela bwino bwino. Pantu nabo baliile ku nshikunkulu ye Pasaka, Icakucilila, ku Yerusalemu. Kabili baliimwenene nefyo acitile ku nshikunkulu.

english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
translation: Kabili Yesu abwelela ku Kana wa mu Galile, uko asangwile amenshi umwangashi. Kwaliko na mushika wa mfumu, uwali no mwana umwaume umulwele ku Kapenamu.

english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
translation: Cilya aumfwa ukuti Yesu nafuma ku Yudeya naisa ku Galile, awe aya uko ali. Alamupapata ukuti aye posha mwane uwali mupepi ne mfwa.

english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Kanshi nga tamumwene ifishibilo ne finjelengwe, ninshi teti musumine.”

english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
translation: Mushika wa mfumu amweba ati, “Mukwai shi iseni, lintu umwana wandi talafwa.”

english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
translation: Kanshi ilyo aleya, afika ku musumba umo uwa mu Samaria uwitwa Sika. Uyu musumba waba mupepi ne mpanga iyo Yakobo apeele mwane Yosefu.

english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Kabiye, mwano tafwe.” Awe mushika asumina amashiwi yakwa Yesu, aya no kuya.

english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
translation: Kanshi ilyo aleya kumwakwe, abasha bakwe bamukonkela, balamweba abati, “Mwano napola.”

english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
translation: Elyo abepusha inshita mwane atampile ukuba bwino. Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Impepo yamulekele mailo cilya akasuba kapilibuka pa nshita ya 13:00.”

english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
translation: Elyo wishi ashininkisha ukuti ni pa nshita ine ilya Yesu amwebelepo ukuti, “Mwano tafwe.” Awe umwine wine asumina pamo na bonse aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe.

english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
translation: Ici e cishibilo icabubili ico Yesu acitile ilyo nakabili abwelele ku Galile ukufuma ku Yudeya.

english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
translation: Emwaba ne cishima cakwa Yakobo. Yesu, ico anaka ku lwendo, aikala mupepi ne cishima. Akasuba ninshi kalafika pakati ka mutwe, pa nshita ya 12:00.

english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
translation: Elyo umwanakashi umo umwina Samaria aisa kukutapa amenshi. Yesu amweba ati, “Mpeelako amenshi nwe.”

english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
translation: Abasambi bakwe bena ninshi nabaya ku musumba kukushita ifyakulya.

english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
translation: Umwanakashi umwina Samaria amwasuka ati, “Iwe uli Muyuda na ine ndi mwina Samaria. Nga kanshi kuti wanomba shani amenshi yakunwa?” Pantu Abayuda tabasankana na bena Samaria.

english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
translation: Patile ilyo papita inshita, Yesu aninika ukuya ku Yerusalemu, ico kwali inshikunkulu ya Bayuda.

english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
translation: Abayuda balaeba umuntu uwapolele abati, “Lelo bushiku bwe Sabata, calileshiwa ukusenda umusengele obe.”

english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Umuntu uumposeshe eunjebele ati, ‘Buula umusengele obe akuya.’ ”

english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
translation: Bamwipusha abati, “Nga ni nani uyo muntu, ukwebele ati, ‘Buula umusengele obe akuya?’ ”

english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
translation: Lelo umuntu uupolele teshibe uumuposeshe, pantu Yesu ninshi nafumapo alubile mwibumba ilyalipo.

english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
translation: Kabili panuma Yesu amusanga mwi Tempele. Alamweba ati, “Mona, nomba naupola kanshi uleke ukubifya, pantu limbi icabipishapo cikakuponena.”

english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
translation: Umuntu epakufumapo, aya eba na Bayuda ati, “Ala ni Yesu eumposeshe.”

english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
translation: Nico Yesu alecita ifintu fya musango uyo pa bushiku bwe Sabata, eco Abayuda batampile ukulamucusha.

english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Tata abombafye lyonse, kanshi na ine ndi nokulabomba.”

english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
translation: Abayuda epakulafwaisha nganshi ukumwipaya, pali ico asosele ifi. Kanshi teicofye talesakamana ukusunga ubushiku bwe Sabata, lelo alelanda nokuti, “Lesa ni Tata.” Ici calelanga ukuti, aleilinganya na Lesa.

english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
translation: Nehem 13:19

english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
translation: Mu Yerusalemu mupepi na ku Mpongolo ya Mpanga, kwali icishiba, mu Cihibulu citwa Betisata, icakwete inkungu shisano.

english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
translation: Pantu Wishi alitemwa Mwane, alanga na Mwane ifyo acita. Kabili imwe mukalasunguka, akalanga na Mwane ukucita ificilile na pali ifi.

english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
translation: Kabili Wishi tapingula muntu nelyo umo, lelo apeela Mwane amaka yonse ayakupingula.

english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
translation: Epakuti filya fine bacindika Wishi, efyo bonse balecindika Mwane. Kanshi onse uwakaana ukucindika Mwane ninshi akaana no kucindika Wishi uwamutuma.

english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine, onse uumfwa amashiwi yandi, asumina na mu wantuma, eukwata umweo wape. Uyu ena tapingulwa, pantu alifuma ku mfwa, alisa ku mweo.

english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, inshita ikesa, ala no kwisa naisa, ilyo abafwa bakomfwa ishiwi lya Mwana wakwa Lesa. Elyo na bakalyumfwa bakaba no mweo.

english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
translation: Kanshi nga filya fine Wishi aba e ntulo ya mweo, efyo alenga na Mwane ukuba intulo ya mweo.

english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
translation: Kabili alipeela na Mwane amaka yakupingula, pantu e Mwana wa muntu.

english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
translation: Kanshi imwe mwisunguka pali ifi. Ala inshita ikesa ilyo abafwa bakafuma mu nindi shabo pakumfwa ishiwi lyakwe.

english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
translation: Elyo abo abalecita ifisuma, bakashukuka no kuba abomi. Abalecita ifibi bena, bakashukuka nokukandwa.

english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
translation: Muli ishi nkungu mwalelala abalwele abengi, impofu, ifilema ne fite. [3b Balelolela ukufundaulwa kwa menshi.

english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
translation: “Ine ne mwine teti ncite kantu pa mutwe wandifye. Ine mpingwilafye umo naumfwila. Elyo ifyo mpingula fintu fyalungama. Pantu ine nshifwaya kucitafye ifyo ndefwaya, lelo kano ififwaya uwantuma.

english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
translation: Ine nga nalapeela bukambone pali ine ne mwine, ninshi bukambone bwandi bwafyefye.

english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
translation: Nomba eko ali umbi uwakupeela bukambone pali ine. Kabili nalishiba ukuti bukambone bwakwe pali ine bwacishinka.

english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
translation: Mwatumine inkombe kuli Yoani, nao amwebele ifyacishinka pali ine.

english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
translation: Kwena ine nshikabila bukambone bwa muntu, lelo nalanda ifi ni pakuti mukamone ukupusuka.

english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
translation: Yoani ali nge cisaniko icileyaka, icabeka, na imwe pali ako kashita mwalesekela mufyo alemweba.

english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
translation: Nomba bukambone bwandi bwena, bwacila apakalamba bukambone bwakwa Yoani. Pantu umulimo wine Tata ampeela ukubomba, uo ndebomba, eumpeela bukambone ukuti ni Tata ewantuma.

english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
translation: Elyo na Tata wine uwantuma, nao ni kambone wandi. Tamwatala amumfwa ishiwi lyakwe, kabili tamwatala amumona icinso cakwe.

english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
translation: Kanshi na mashiwi yakwe tayekala mu mitima yenu, pantu tamwasumina uo atuma.

english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
translation: Mubelenga nganshi ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo, pantu imwe mutontonkanya ukuti emwaba umweo wape. Nomba aya yene Malembo Yamushilo yalandafye pali ine.

english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
translation: Pantu mu nshita mu nshita malaika wa Mfumu aleikila mu cishiba kukufundaula amenshi. Elyo na onse uwabalilapo ukwingila mu cishiba, alepola ku bulwelefye buli bonse.]

english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
translation: Lelo imwe tamufwaya ukwisa kuli ine pakuti mukwate umweo.

english: I don’t receive glory from men.
translation: “Ine nshifwaya ukuti abantu balenumbanya.

english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
translation: Lelo ine nalimwishiba. Tamwatemwa Lesa nakalya.

english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
translation: Ico naishila, nico Tata ewantuma, nomba imwe tamwampokelela. Nomba umbi nga aishilafye umwine ku maka yakwe, wena kuti mwamupokelela.

english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
translation: Nga kanshi kuti mwansumina shani? Imwe bonse mufwayafye ukuti abanenu balemulumbanya. Tamusakamana kuti Lesa uwabafye umo mpo eo alemulumbanya.

english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
translation: Kanshi mwilatontonkanya ukuti nine nkamwebelela kuli Tata. Awe, ni Mose uyu wine mwatetekelamo, eukamwebelela.

english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
translation: Mu cine amusumina Mose, na ine wine nga mwalinsumina. Pantu ni pali ine wine epo alemba.

english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
translation: Nomba apo mushasumina ifyo alemba, nga kuti mwasumina shani ifyo ndemweba?”

english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
translation: Ku cishiba kwali umuntu uwalwele pa myaka amakumi yatatu na cine konse konse (38).

english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
translation: Cilya Yesu amona uyu muntu walwele, aishiba ukuti ni kale alwala, Yesu epakumwipusha ati, “Bushe ulefwaya ukupola?”

english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
translation: Umulwele amwasuka ati, “Mukwai ine nshakwata wakungafwako ukwingila mu cishiba ilyo malaika afundaula amenshi. Ntila lyonse ilyo ndefwaya ukwingilamo, umbi ninshi naingilamo kale.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Ima, buula umusengele obe, akuya.”

english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
translation: Apopene no muntu apola, abuula umusengele wakwe alaya.

english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, elyo Yesu ayabukile kwishilya lya bemba wa Galile, uo beta nokuti bemba wa Tibelia.

english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ebeni abantu bekale panshi.” Pali iyi ncende pali icani icingi. Awe abantu epo baikala. Abaume bali cikanga amakana yasano.

english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
translation: Elyo Yesu abuula imikate atasha Lesa. Elyo balayakanya abantu abekele, balabapeela ukulingana napo balefwaila. Isabi nalyo bacita ifyo fine.

english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
translation: Awe bonse balya baikuta. Elyo Yesu aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Longanyeni ifipandwa fyashalako, mwileka fyonaike.”

english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
translation: Awe balonganya ifipandwa fyasheleko ku mikate isano iyo abantu balile, baisusha imiseke ikumi limo na ibili.

english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
translation: Abantu cilya bamona ici cishibilo Yesu acita, balasosa abati, “Ala cine cine uyu e kasesema ali nokwisa pano isonde!”

english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
translation: Yesu ati amone ukuti balafwaya ukwisa musenda no kumupatikisha pakuti abe imfumu, afumako, aya eka ku lupili.

english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
translation: Cilya caba icungulo, abasambi bakwe batentemukile kuli bemba.

english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
translation: Baingila mu bwato, balaya na kwishilya ku Kapenamu. Bwasuka bwaila, ninshi Yesu talati ese uko bali.

english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
translation: Kanshi kwali icimwela ca maka cilepuupa, caimya na matamba ayakalamba.

english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
translation: Ilyo abasambi baoba ubwato intamfu ingalingana ne milundu isano nangu mutanda, elyo bamona Yesu aleenda pa menshi, aleisa ku bwato. Awe batiina nganshi.

english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
translation: Ibumba lya bantu ilikalamba lyamukonka, ico lyalemona ifishibilo alecita pakuposha abalwele.

english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ala nine, mwitiina!”

english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
translation: Lyena abasambi balafwaya ukumuninika mu bwato, lelo apopene ubwato bwafika ku mulundu pa ncende balungeme.

english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo ibumba lya bantu balya abashele kulya kwine lyashininkishe ukuti kwalifye ubwato bumo epela. Kabili Yesu taingile mu bwato pamo na basambi bakwe, lelo bailefye beka.

english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
translation: Amato yamo yafumine ku Tibelia, yaisa shika mupepi napo Imfumu yatashishe Lesa pa mikate na bantu balyako.

english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
translation: Ilyo abantu bamona ukuti Yesu talimo, nangu abasambi bakwe bene, awe baingila muli aya mato, baya balemufwaya ku Kapenamu.

english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
translation: Cilya bamusanga kwishilya lya bemba, balamwipusha abati, “Kafundisha nga waishile kuno lilali?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, ico mulemfwaila teico mwamwene ifishibilo iyoo, lelo nico mwalile imikate, mwaikuta.

english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
translation: Mwilabombela icakulya icishili cakubelelela. Ala akubombeleni icakulya icakupeela umweo wape, ico Umwana wa muntu akamupeela. Pantu Lesa Wishi umwine eo asuminisha.”

english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
translation: Elyo abantu bamwipusha abati, “Nga kanshi tuli nokucita finshi pakubomba imilimo Lesa afwaya?”

english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Imilimo Lesa afwaya ukuti mucite, kusumina muli uyo atuma.”

english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
translation: Yesu anina ulupili, epo aikala na basambi bakwe.

english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
translation: Nabo bamwipusha abati, “Bushe cishibilo nshi wingacita tucimone na ifwe tukusumine? Finshi wingacita?

english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
translation: Ifikolwe fyesu fyalile mana mu matololo. Efyo calembwa ukuti ‘Abapeele umukate wakulya ukufuma ku mulu.’ ”

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, Mose tewamupeele umukate ukufuma ku mulu, lelo ni Tata eumupeela umukate wacine cine uwafuma ku mulu.

english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
translation: Pantu umukate wakwa Lesa ni uyu uwaika ukufuma ku mulu, no kwisa peela aba pano isonde umweo.”

english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
translation: Abantu bamweba abati, “Mukwai, kanshi muletupeela uyo mukate lyonsefye.”

english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nine mukate wamweo. Uyo uwaisa kuli ine takatale omfwa insala nakalya. Uyo uwasumina muli ine takatale omfwa icilaka nakalya.

english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
translation: “Lelo ngefyo namweba, imwe ine mwalimona, nomba tamusumina.

english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
translation: Abo bonse abo Tata ampeela bakulaisa kuli ine. Elyo ine nshakatale ntamfya onse uwaisa kuli ine.

english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
translation: Pantu ico naishila ukufuma ku mulu tekukucita ifyo ndefwaya ne mwine, awe iyoo, kucita ififwaya uwantuma.

english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
translation: Ne fifwaya uwantuma nifi, ukuti nikalufyapo nelyo umo pabo ampeela. Lelo nkababushe bonse pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako.

english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
translation: Kanshi califye mupepi ne Pasaka inshikunkulu ya Bayuda iya Cakucilila.

english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
translation: Pantu ico Tata afwaya nici icakuti, onse uwamona Mwane no kumusumina, akwate umweo wape. Eo na ine nkabusha pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako.”

english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
translation: Abayuda epakulailishanya pali ico asosa ati, “Ine nine mukate uwaika ukufuma ku mulu.”

english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
translation: Balasosa abati, “Bushe uyu te Yesu, mwana Yosefu? Twalishiba wishi na nyina. Nga kanshi nomba alasosa shani ati naika ukufuma ku mulu?”

english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Lekenifye ukulailishanya.

english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
translation: Ala tapaba nangu umo uwingesa kuli ine, kano Tata uwantuma ewamuleta. Elyo na ine nkamubusha pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako.

english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
translation: Umo pali bakasesema alemba ati, ‘Lesa eukalafunda bonse.’ Na uyo onse uumfwa no kufundwa kuli Tata, esa kuli ine.

english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
translation: Nshiletila kwaliba uwamona Tata. Awe uwamona Tata, ni uyofye eka uwafuma kuli Lesa.

english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine, onse uwasumina, eukwata umweo wape.

english: I am the bread of life.
translation: Ine nine mukate wamweo.

english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
translation: Ifikolwe fyenu fyalile mana mu matololo, nomba fyalifwa.

english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
translation: Cilya ibumba lya bantu lileisa uko ali, elyo aipusha Filipo ati, “Bushe ni kwi twingashita imikate iyakuti abantu balye?”

english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
translation: Lelo uyu e mukate uwaika ku mulu, uwakuti umuntu nga aulya ninshi tewakufwa nakalya.

english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
translation: Nine mukate wamweo uwaika ku mulu. Elyo onse uulya uyu mukate, akabelelela uwamweo pe. Umukate nkamupeela, mubili wandi uwakupeela aba pano isonde umweo.”

english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
translation: Abayuda elyo batampa ukubikana ifikansa abati, “Nga uyu muntu kuti atupeela shani umubili wakwe eo tulelya?”

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine ukuti, nga tamulelya umubili wa Mwana wa muntu no kunwa umulopa wakwe, ninshi imwe tamwakakwate mweo.

english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
translation: Uyo onse uulya umubili wandi no kunwa umulopa wandi, akwata umweo wape. Kabili eo nkabusha pa bushiku bwakupelekeshako.

english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
translation: Pantu umubili wandi cakulya cacine cine, elyo no mulopa wandi e cakunwa cacine cine.

english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
translation: Uyo onse uulya umubili wandi no kunwa umulopa wandi aikala na ine, na ine naikala nankwe.

english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
translation: Kanshi nga filya Tata wamweo uwantuma, anenga ukuba uwamweo, efyo na uyo uundya nkamulenga ukuba uwamweo.

english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
translation: Kanshi uyu e mukate uwaika ku mulu. Te cimo na ulya mukate ifikolwe fyenu fyalile, kabili fyalifwa. Uulya uyu mukate, akenda uwamweo pe.”

english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
translation: Yesu asosele ifi ilyo alefunda mu sinagoga mu Kapenamu.

english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
translation: Asosele ifi kukumweshafye, lelo umwine alishibe ifyo ali nokucita.

english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
translation: Abasambi bakwa Yesu abengi ilyo baumfwa ifyo Yesu alanda, balasosa abati, “Awe ukufunda uku kwakosa nganshi. Nga nani engasumina?”

english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
translation: Yesu aishiba ukuti abasambi bakwe balailishanya pali ifyo alanda. Alabeba ati, “Bushe ifyo nalanda efyanenuna icisumino cenu?

english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
translation: Nga cikaba shani nga mwamona Umwana wa muntu alenina alebwelela uko aikele kale?

english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
translation: Ni Mupashi eupeela umweo, umuntu wena tabomba kantu. Amashiwi ayo namweba, ala mupashi kabili mweo.

english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
translation: Nomba pali imwe bamo tabasumina.” Pantu ukufumafye ilyo atampile ukufunda, Yesu alishibe abashakasumine no wali nokumuposa ku balwani.

english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
translation: Elyo akonkanyapo nokuti, “E mulandu wine mwebele nati, teti pabe nangu umo uwingesa kuli ine kano Tata ewamutungulula.”

english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
translation: Pakumfwa ifi abasambi bakwa Yesu abengi bamusangukila, baleka ukulaenda nankwe.

english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
translation: Elyo Yesu aipusha abasole bakwe ikumi limo na babili ati, “Nga imwe, bushe na imwe mulefwaya ukuya?”

english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
translation: Simoni Petelo amwasuka ati, “We Mfumu ni kuli ani twingaya? Ala niwe wakwata amashiwi yapeela umweo wape.

english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
translation: Kabili nomba twalisumina no kwishiba ukuti uli Wamushilo uwafuma kuli Lesa.”

english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
translation: Filipo amwasuka ati, “Pakutifye cila umo akwateko akapandwa, kano ninshi mwashita imikate ya pa ndalama imyanda ibili.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Bushe tene namusalile imwe bonse ikumi limo na babili? Nomba pali imwe umo ni Ciwa!”

english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
translation: Kanshi aloseshe kuli Yuda mwana Simoni uwa ku Kelyoti. Pantu nangu ali umo pa basole ikumi limo na babili, lelo ewali nokumuposa ku balwani.

english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
translation: Umusambi wakwe umo, Andele, munyina kwa Simoni Petelo, aeba Yesu ati,

english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
translation: “Kuno kuliko akalumendo kakwete imikate isano ne sabi libili. Nomba kuti fyabomba nshi ku bantu bafula ifi?”

english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
translation: Panuma ya ifi, Yesu ashala alepitana mu Galile. Talefwaya ukupita mu Yudeya, pantu Abayuda balefwaya ukumwipaya.

english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
translation: Ilyo bamunyina kwa Yesu baya ku nshikunkulu, Yesu panuma ashala aima aya nao ku nshikunkulu. Lelo kwena te pa lwalala, ailekofye mu bumfisolo.

english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
translation: Pa nshikunkulu Abayuda balamufwaya. Balaipusha abati, “Bushe ulya muntu ali kwi?”

english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
translation: Nomba abantu mwibumba bena baikalilafye ukulatotoshanya pali Yesu. Bamo balasosa abati, “Kwena muntu musuma.” Bambi bena balati, “Awe, abepaikafye abantu.”

english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
translation: Amaf 16:13

english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
translation: Cilya cafika pakati kakusefya inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe, Yesu aya mwi Tempele atampa no kulafunda.

english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
translation: Abayuda bapapa nganshi. Balasosa abati, “Nga uyu muntu aishiba shani ifi fyonse uushatala asambilila?”

english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ine ifyo mfunda te fya pa mutwe wandi iyoo, fifuma ku wantuma.

english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
translation: Onse uufwaya ukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, eukeshiba ifyo mfunda ukuti fifuma kuli Lesa, nangu nga fya pa mutwe wandi.

english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
translation: Umuntu onse uulandafye ifya pa mutwe wakwe, ninshi aifwailafye umucinshi umwine. Lelo uufwaya umucinshi wa wamutuma, wena wacishinka, taba na bufi mu mutima wakwe.

english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
translation: Bushe Amafunde yakwa Mose, te Mose ewamupeele? Nomba pali imwe tapaba nelyo umo uuyakonka. Nga cinshi ico mulefwaila ukunjipaila?”

english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
translation: Inshikunkulu ya Bayuda iya Nsakwe yali mupepi.

english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
translation: Ibumba lyamwasuka aliti, “Iwe waba no mupashi uwakowela! Nga nani uulefwaya ukukwipaya?”

english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nacitilepo icipeshamano cimo, elyo imwe bonse no kupapa mwalipapile.

english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
translation: Mose amupeele ifunde lyakusembululwa. Lelo ukusembululwa kwena te Mose watampile, fikolwe fyenu. Kanshi nomba musembulula umuntu na pa bushiku bwe Sabata.

english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
translation: Nomba ilyo basembulula umuntu pa bushiku bwe Sabata pakukonka Amafunde yakwa Mose tabonaula bushiku bwe Sabata. Nga kanshi cinshi mwamfulilwa ico naposha umuntu pa bushiku bwe Sabata?

english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
translation: Kanshi mwilapingwilafye ukukonka imimonekele ya cintu iyoo, mulepingwila mu cishinka.”

english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
translation: Abantu bamo aba mu Yerusalemu balesosa abati, “Bushe uyu muntu teo balefwaya ukwipaya?

english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
translation: Nomba uyu aleilandilafye pa lwalala, tapali no wakumulesha. Bushe emukuti ne ntungulushi shine nasho nashishiba nomba ukuti uyu wine e Kristu?

english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
translation: Lelo ifwe uyu twalishiba uko afuma, Kristu wena ilyo akesa tapakabe wakwishiba uko afuma.”

english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alefunda mwi Tempele, aikatishe ishiwi ati, “Bushe cine cine mwalinjishiba, mwalishiba noko nafuma? Nomba ine nshaishilafye pa mutwe wandi. Uwantuma wena wacishinka. Imwe tamwamwishiba.

english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
translation: Lelo ine nalimwishiba, pantu eko nafuma, kabili ewantuma.”

english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
translation: Elyo bamunyina bakwa Yesu balamweba abati, “Ala fuma kuno, kabiye ku Yudeya, pakuti abasambi bobe balemona ifintu fyonse ifi ulecita.

english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
translation: Awe balafwaya ukumwikata. Nomba tapali wamwiketemo, ico inshita yakumwikatilapo yali tailafikila.

english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
translation: Abantu abengi mwibumba bena bamusumina. Balasosa nokuti, “Bushe Kristu wena ilyo akesa, bushe akesa cita ifishibilo ifingi ukucila ifyo uyu muntu alecita?”

english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
translation: Abafalise cilya baumfwa uko abantu mwibumba baletotoshanya ifi pali Yesu, bena pamo na bashimapepo bacindami batuma ifita ifyalelinda Itempele kukumwikata.

english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
translation: Yesu asosa ati, “Nkekala na imwe akashita kanono, elyo panuma nkabwelelamo ku wantuma.

english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
translation: Levi 23:34

english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
translation: Abayuda balalanshanya abati, “Ni kwi uko kwine aleya, ukwakuti ifwe tukafilwe ukumusanga? Bushe ninshi akaya ku Bagiriki, uko abanensu basalanganina no kuya kukufunda Abagiriki?

english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
translation: Nga kanshi alosha mwi pakusosa ati, ‘Mukalamfwaya nomba tamwakansange.’ Kabili ati, ‘Uko naba, imwe tekuti mwiseko?’ ”

english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
translation: Ubushiku bwakulekelesha ubwa nshikunkulu ya Nsakwe, ebwali ubwacindamisha nganshi. Awe Yesu aiminina aikatisha ishiwi alasosa ati, “Onse uuli ne cilaka ese kuli ine, anwe.

english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
translation: Mu Malembo Yamushilo calembwa ukuti, ‘Onse uwansumina, mu nda yakwe mukalatuntumuka imilonga ya menshi yakupeela umweo.’ ”

english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
translation: Yesu pakulanda ifi, aloseshe kuli Mupashi uo abakamusumina bali nokupoka. Pali iyo nshita ninshi Mupashi ali talapeelwa, pantu Yesu ali talacindamikwa.

english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
translation: Tapaba nangu umo uulefwaya ukulumbuka ku bantu kabili alacita ifintu mu bumfisolo. Apo ulecita ifi fintu, leka kanshi abantu bonse bakwishibe!”

english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
translation: Ilyo abantu baumfwa ifyo Yesu asosa, bamo balalanda abati, “Cine cine uyu muntu e kasesema wine!”

english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
translation: Bambi nabo balati, “Ala uyu e Kristu wine!” Bambi nabo balasosa abati, “Iyoo, bushe Kristu kuti afuma ku Galile?

english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
translation: Bushe Amalembo Yamushilo tayatila ayati, Kristu ali nokuba uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi, kabili akafyalilwa ku Betelemu, umusumba umwafumine Davidi.”

english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakupusana pa mulandu wakwa Yesu.

english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
translation: Bamo balafwaya ukumwikata lelo tapali wamwiketemo.

english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
translation: Awe ifita fya kwi Tempele fyabwelelamo kuli bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise. Nabo baipusha ifita abati, “Cinshi mushimwikatile no kumuleta kuno?”

english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
translation: Ifita fyabasuka afiti, “Takwatala akuba uulanda ngoyu muntu.”

english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
translation: Abafalise balabeba abati, “Bushe na imwe kanshi mwaya bepwa?

english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
translation: Bushe mwalyumfwako ukuti umo pa ntungulushi nangu umo pa Bafalise alimusumina?

english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
translation: Nomba ili bumba talyaishiba na Mafunde yakwa Mose, ala lyalilapishiwa!”

english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
translation: Pantu mu cacine, na bamunyina bene tabamusumine nakalya.

english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
translation: Nomba umunabo umo Nikodemo, ulya waishile kale kuli Yesu, alabeba ati,

english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
translation: “Bushe amafunde yesu yalisuminisha ukupeela umulandu ku muntu uo mushilaumfwa mulandu wakwe no kwishiba ifyo alecita?”

english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
translation: Bamwasuka abati, “Bushe na iwe uli mwina Galile? Belenga bwino Amalembo Yamushilo, ulesanga ukuti ku Galile takufuma kasesema.” [

english: Everyone went to his own house,
translation: Awe cila muntu aima aya kumwakwe.

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Inshita yakuyako iyilingile kuli ine tailafika. Kuli imwe inshita yonse yalilinga.

english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
translation: Imwe abantu ba pano calo tekuti bamupate, lelo ine balimpata. Pantu nabikapofye ukubashinina ukuti ifyo bacita fyalibipa.

english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
translation: Imwe kabiyeni ku nshikunkulu. Ine nshileyako kuli iyi nshikunkulu, pantu inshita yakuyako iyilingile kuli ine tailafika.”

english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
translation: Ati abebe ifi, awe wena ashala mu Galile.

english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
translation: Yesu ena afuminepo aya ku lupili lwa Miolifa.

english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
translation: Levi 20:10

english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Tapali nangu umo mukwai.” Yesu amweba ati, “Kanshi na ine nshilekupeela umulandu. Kabiye wikabwekeshapo ukubifya nakabili.”]

english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
translation: Yesu aebele abantu nakabili ati, “Nine lubuuto lwa ba pano isonde. Uyo onse uunkonka takatale enda mu mfifi, lelo akakwata ulubuuto ulupeela umweo.”

english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
translation: Abafalise epakumweba abati, “Iwe ulepeela bukambone pali iwe we mwine, bukambone bobe ninshi bwafyefye.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
translation: Mateo 5:14

english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
translation: Imwe mupingulafye no bupingushi bwabuntunse. Ine nshipingula nelyo umo.

english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti ningapingula, ubupingushi bwandi kuti bwaba bwacishinka, pantu nshiba neka iyoo. Tuba lyonse na Tata uwantuma.

english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
translation: Mu Mafunde yakwa Mose calembwa ukuti bukambone bwacishinka kano abantu babili basuminishanya.

english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
translation: Ine ndepeela bukambone pali ine ne mwine, elyo Tata uwantuma nao e kambone wandi.”

english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
translation: Elyo bamwipusha abati, “Nga wiso ali kwi?” Yesu abasuka ati, “Ine tamwanjishiba, nelyo ni Tata wine nao tamwamwishiba. Ine amunjishiba na Tata wine nao nga mwalimwishiba.”

english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
translation: Kabili lucelocelo abwelela kwi Tempele. Awe abantu balalongana umo ali. Elyo aikala atampa no kulabafunda.

english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
translation: Yesu asosele ifi fyonse ilyo alefunda mwi Tempele, mu muputule wa cipao. Tapali wamwikete ico inshita yakumwikatilapo yali tailafikila.

english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
translation: Kabili Yesu abebele ati, “Ine ndi nokuya. Elyo mukalamfwaya, nomba mukafwila mu fyabubifi fyenu. Uko ndi nokuya imwe teti mwiseko.”
