english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
translation: Abayuda balalanshanya abati, “Atila ati, ‘Uko ndi nokuya teti mwiseko.’ Bushe calola mukutila akaipaya umwine?”

english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Imwe muli ba muli cino calo, ine nafuma ku mulu. Imwe muli ba pano calo, ine nshili wa pano calo.

english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
translation: Amaf 22:24

english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
translation: Elyo bamwipusha abati, “Nga niwe ani?” Yesu abasuka ati, “Nimweba kale ifyo naba.

english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
translation: Kwena pali imwe ninkwatafye ifingi ifyakulandapo no kumupeelelapo umulandu. Kabili uwantuma, wacishinka, nefyo naumfwa kuli ena efyo ndeeba abantu ba pano calo.”

english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
translation: Awe tabailwike nakalya ukuti alebeba pali Wishi.

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
translation: Kanshi Yesu abeba ati, “Ilyo mukemika Umwana wa muntu pa musalaba, elyo mukeshiba ukuti e ine wine. Mukeshiba nokuti nshicita nelyo cimo pa mutwe wandifye, lelo ifyo nsosa, fintu Tata amfunda.

english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
translation: Kabili lyonse tuba no wantuma, tansha neka iyoo, pantu lyonse ncita ifimusansamusha.”

english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise elyo baleta umwanakashi umo uo basangilishe mu lubembu. Bamwiminika na mu lwalala.

english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
translation: Abantu abengi pakumfwa ifyo Yesu alesosa, bamusumina.

english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
translation: Elyo Yesu alaeba Abayuda abamusumine ati, “Ukumfwa nga mwalabeela amashiwi yandi, lyena ninshi icine cine muli basambi bandi.

english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
translation: Mukeshiba icishinka, elyo ne cishinka cikamulenga ukuba abantungwa.”

english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tuli ba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu. Kabili tatwatala atuba abasha ba muntu nelyo umo. Nga kanshi walosha mwi, ico watila auti, ‘Mukaba abantungwa?’ ”

english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, umuntu onse uubifya, ninshi musha wa bubifi.

english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
translation: Ubwikashi bwa musha mu lupwa tebwape, uwikalilila mu lupwa pe, mwana.

english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
translation: Kanshi Umwana nga ewamulubula, ninshi mukaba icine cine abantungwa.

english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
translation: Ninjishiba ukuti muli ba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu. Nomba kabili mulefwaya ukunjipaya, pantu tamwasumina mashiwi yandi.

english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
translation: Ine mweba ifyo namona kuli Tata, nomba na imwe mucita ifyo mwaumfwa kuli shinwe.”

english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
translation: Bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe shifwe ni Abrahamu.” Yesu abeba ati, “Amuba bana bakwa Abrahamu, nga mucita ifyo Abrahamu alecita.

english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
translation: Baeba Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, uyu mwanakashi nabamusangilisha alecita ulubembu.

english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
translation: Lelo kwena mulefwaya ukunjipaya, icofye ndemweba ifyacishinka ifyo naumfwa kuli Lesa. Ifyo tefyo Abrahamu alecita.

english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
translation: Imwe mulecita ifyo shinwe acita.” Bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatuli bana ba mu bucende. Ifwe twakwata shifwe umofye ni Lesa.”

english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Lesa cine aba e Shinwe, nga mwalintemwa. Pantu nafuma kuli Lesa, nomba tuli na imwe. Ine nshaishila pa mutwe wandi iyoo, ni Lesa ewantuma.

english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
translation: Cinshi ico mushumfwila ifyo nsosa? Ala nico mushifwaya kutesha mashiwi yandi.

english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
translation: Imwe shinwe ni Ciwa. Kabili mufwayafye ukucita ifyo shinwe afwaya. Ukufumafye na ku kale aba cipondo. Kabili tatala akonka ifyacishinka, pantu taba na cishinka. Wena nga alebepa, ninshi alelandafye ifyo afwile ukulanda. Pantu wabufi, kabili e cibinda wa bufi bonse.

english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
translation: Nomba ine nanda icishinka, kanshi eco imwe mushinsuminina.

english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
translation: Bushe nani pali imwe enganshinina ukuti nalitala ncitapo ububifi? Nomba ifyo mweba nga fyacishinka, cinshi kanshi mushinsuminina?

english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
translation: Umuntu wakwa Lesa alomfwa amashiwi yakwa Lesa. Umulandu mushumfwila nico mushili bantu bakwa Lesa.”

english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
translation: Abayuda epakwasuka Yesu abati, “Bushe cine cine tatulungika mukutila, uli mwina Samaria, kabili waliba no mupashi wakowela?”

english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Awe nshaba na mupashi wakowela iyoo. Ine ndacindika Tata, lelo imwe tamuncindika.

english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
translation: Mu Mafunde, Mose atukonkomesha ukwipaya abanakashi ba uyu musango ku mabwe. Nga iwe, uletipo shani?”

english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
translation: Ine nshiifwailafye ne mwine umucinshi. Lelo eko ali umo uumfwaila umucinshi, kabili uyu eupingula.

english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, uyo onse uusunga amashiwi yandi takafwe nakalya.”

english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
translation: Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Nomba elyo twashininkisha ukuti waba no mupashi wakowela. Abrahamu alifwa, bakasesema nabo balifwa. Elyo iwe auti, ‘Uusunga amashiwi yandi takafwe nakalya.’

english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
translation: Icikolwe cesu Abrahamu alifwa. Bushe iwe naucila Abrahamu? Elyo bakasesema nabo balifwa. Bushe uleitunga nshi iwe?”

english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ine nga ndaicindika ne mwine, umucinshi wandi nga wafyefye. Ine uuncindika ni Tata, uo imwe mutila, e Lesa wenu.

english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
translation: Nomba imwe tamwamwishiba, ine nalimwishiba. Ine nga cakuti natila nshamwishiba, ninshi na ine kuti naba uwabufi nga imwe. Nomba nalimwishiba nsunga na mashiwi yakwe.

english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
translation: Shinwe Abrahamu alyangile ico ali nokumona ubushiku bwa kwisa kwandi. Alibumwene, asansamuka no kusansamuka.”

english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
translation: Abayuda bamwasuka abati, “Taulafika ne myaka amakumi yasano, bushe niwe wingamona Abrahamu?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine Abrahamu talati abeko, ninshi ine eko naba.”

english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
translation: Abayuda epakulatola amabwe pakuti bamulase. Yesu ena afyefyetuka afuma na mu lubansa lwe Tempele.

english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
translation: Basosele ifi pakuti bakwate umwakumwikatila, eico balefwailisha imilandu. Lelo Yesu ainama atampa no kulemba panshi ku munwe.

english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
translation: Cilya babikapofye ukumwipusha, Yesu ainuka, abeba ati, “Pali imwe bonse uushatala abifya, nabalilepo ukumulasa ilibwe.”

english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
translation: Awe kabili ainama, alalemba panshi.

english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
translation: Bati bomfwe ifyo, balafumapo umo umo, abakalamba ebabalilepo. Yesu asuka ashalafye eka no mwanakashi, ninshi umwanakashi ashele eminine palya pene.

english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
translation: Awe ilyo Yesu alepita, amwene umuntu uwafyelwe impofu.

english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
translation: Elyo bamwipusha abati, “Nga kanshi caba shani ukuti nomba ulelolesha?”

english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Umuntu umo, ishina lyakwe baleti ni Yesu, acikasawila iloba. Anshinga pa menso. Elyo anjeba ati, ‘Kabiye, uye samba mu cishiba ca Siloamu.’ Kanshi na ine eko naciya, naya samba. Awe natampa no kulalolesha.”

english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
translation: Abantu bamwipusha abati, “Ali kwi?” Nao abasuka ati, “Nshishibe.”

english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
translation: Elyo abantu basenda umuntu wali mpofu bamutwala ku Bafalise.

english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
translation: Kanshi cali ni pa bushiku bwe Sabata ilyo Yesu akasawile iloba, aposha ne mpofu amenso.

english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
translation: Elyo Abafalise bamwipusha ifyo apolele ku bupofu. Nao abeba ati, “Acinshinga iloba pa menso, elyo naya samba, epakulalolesha.”

english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
translation: Abafalise bamo balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu tafuma kuli Lesa, pantu tasunga bushiku bwe Sabata.” Bambi bena nabo balati, “Bushe umubifi, kuti acita ifishibilo ifya musango uyu?” Awe paba nokupusana pakati kabo.

english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
translation: Abafalise baipusha nakabili umuntu wapolele abati, “Nga iwe uletipo shani pali uyu muntu akuposeshe?” Nao abasuka ati, “Ni kasesema.”

english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
translation: Lelo Abayuda bakaanininafye ukusumina ukuti uyu muntu ali mpofu, nomba napola alelolesha. Basuka baita abafyashi ba uyu muntu.

english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
translation: Babepusha abati, “Bushe uyu mwana wenu? Bushe euyu muleti afyelwe impofu? Nga kanshi ni shani alelolesha nomba?”

english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
translation: Abasambi bakwe balamwipusha abati, “Kafundisha, bushe nani wabifishe pakuti afyalwe impofu? Bushe mwine wine, nalimo bafyashi bakwe?”

english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
translation: Abafyashi bakwe bayasuka abati, “Natwishiba ukuti mwana wesu. Kabili natwishiba nokuti afyelwe impofu.

english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
translation: Lelo tatwishibe ifyo cali pakuti alelolesha, nangu uumuposeshe ubupofu. Mwipusheni, mukalamba, alaisosela umwine.”

english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
translation: Abafyashi bakwe ico balandile ifyo, nico baletiina Abayuda. Abayuda balyumfwanene ukuti nga twaumfwa umo alesosa ukuti Yesu e Kristu, ninshi tuli nokumutamfya tali nakulaisa mu sinagoga.

english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
translation: Kanshi eico abafyashi bakwe basosele abati, “Mwipusheni, mukalamba.”

english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
translation: Abafalise nakabili baita umuntu wapolele ubupofu. Bamweba abati, “Lapa Lesa, ulande icishinka! Ifwe natwishiba ukuti uyu muntu mubifi.”

english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
translation: Wena ayasuka ati, “Nga mubifi nangu iyoo, ico nshishibe. Ine ico njishibe cakuti nali mpofu nomba ndelolesha.”

english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
translation: Bamwipusha abati, “Bushe acicita shani? Bushe akuposeshe shani ubupofu?”

english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
translation: Abasuka ati, “Nimweba kale, nomba tamulefwaya kumfwa. Cinshi mulefwaila ukuti mbwekeshepo mumfwe nakabili? Bushe na imwe mulefwaya ukuba abasambi bakwe?”

english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
translation: Awe Abafalise balamutukaula, balamweba abati, “Iwe uli musambi wa uyo muntu. Ifwe tuli basambi bakwa Mose.

english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
translation: Ifwe twaishiba ukuti Lesa alilandile kuli Mose. Lelo uyu muntu wena tatwaishiba noko afuma!”

english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Uyu muntu tabifishe, na bafyashi bakwe bene tababifishe iyoo. Lelo afyelwe impofu pakuti ukubomba kwa maka yakwa Lesa kumonekele muli uyu muntu.

english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
translation: Umuntu waposhiwe ayasuka ati, “Ici cena cakupapa! Tamwishibe uko afuma? Kabili namposha no bupofu bwandi!

english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti Lesa tomfwa ababifi. Omfwa abantu abamucindika, abacita ifyo afwaya.

english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
translation: Ukufumafye apo Lesa abumbile isonde, tacatala acumfwika ukuti umuntu aposha amenso ya muntu uwafyalwa impofu.

english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
translation: Ngoyu muntu tafuma kuli Lesa, tekuti acite nelyo cimo.”

english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
translation: Abafalise bamwasuka abati, “Iwe wafyalilwe mu bubifi, no kukula emo wakulila. Bushe niwe ulefwaya ukulatufunda?” Awe bamutamfya, tali nakulaisa mu sinagoga.

english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
translation: Ilyo Yesu aumfwa ukuti nabamutamfya, awe aya uko ali, amusanga. Amwipusha ati, “Bushe wasumina Umwana wa muntu?”

english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
translation: Umuntu nao amwasuka ati, “Bushe nani uyo wine mukwai? Nabanjebe pakuti musumine.”

english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Naumumona, ni uyu wine ulelanda nankwe.”

english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
translation: Elyo umuntu asosa ati, “We Mfumu, nasumina.” Awe amufukamina, amupakata.

english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
translation: Elyo Yesu asosa ati, “Ico naishila pano isonde kupingula, ukuti impofu shilelolesha, elyo abalolesha nabo bapofule.”

english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
translation: Ilyo kucili akasuba tuli nokubomba imilimo ya wantuma. Ubushiku bwalaisa ilyo umuntu ashingabomba nelyo cimo.

english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
translation: Abafalise bamo abali nankwe ilyo baumfwa ifi bamwipusha abati, “Kwena ifwe tatuli mpofu!”

english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Amuba impofu nga tamwakwata mulandu. Nomba apo mutila amuti, ‘Tulalolesha,’ kanshi mwaliba no mulandu.”

english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
translation: Ilyo ncili pano isonde, nine lubuuto lwa ba pano isonde.”

english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
translation: Cilya Yesu asosa ifi, afwisa amate panshi. Akasawila iloba na mate. Elyo ashinga iloba pa menso ya mpofu.

english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
translation: Ayeba ati, “Kabiye, kasambe mu cishiba ca Siloamu.” Ili shiwi lyalola mukutila “Uwatumwa.” Awe aya asamba na pa menso, abwela alelolesha.

english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
translation: Elyo abena mupalamano na balemumona uko alelomba, balasosa abati, “Bushe uyu muntu teuyu aleikala alelomba?”

english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
translation: Bamo balasosa abati, “Ee, ni uyu wine.” Bambi bena abati, “Awe iyoo, bapalanafye.” Elyo umwine ati, “Ala nine wine.”

english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
translation: “Apo ine nintendwa ukuba umumi, nakulailishanyafye.

english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
translation: Bushe tewe wampongolwele ngo mukaka,

english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
translation: Niwe wamfwikile iminofu, wafimbapo ne nkanda,

english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
translation: Epakumpeela umweo, wananga ne citemwiko cobe icishiputuka,

english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
translation: “Nomba ifi fintu walififisa mu mutima obe,

english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
translation: Nga nabifya kuti wamona,

english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
translation: Nga nalibifya ishamo limponene,

english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
translation: Pantu njinuna umutwe no kuisansabalika nga wanunga nge nkalamo,

english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
translation: Waletelapo bakambone abakunshinina na bambi,

english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
translation: “Bushe cinshi walengele ukuti mfyalwe?

english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
translation: nga nabafye ngo muntu uushatalile abapo,

english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
translation: Ndeeba Lesa nati, wimpeela umulandu,

english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
translation: Bushe inshiku sha bumi bwandi tashishelefye ishinono?

english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
translation: ilyo nshilaya ku cifulo uko nshakabwele,

english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
translation: ku calo ca mfifi iyafiita fititi,

english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
translation: Bushe cisuma ukuncusha,

english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
translation: Bushe wakwata amenso ya bantu?

english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
translation: Bushe inshiku shobe shilapwa ngefi isha bantu shipwa,

english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
translation: pakuti ulefwaya fwaya ukumona ifyabupulumushi fyandi,

english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
translation: Nelyo walishiba ukuti ine nshili mubifi,

english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
translation: “Iminwe yobe eyamumbile no kumpanga bwino bwino,

english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
translation: Ibukisha we Lesa ukuti wampangile ukufuma kwiloba,

english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
translation: Elyo Sofari umwina Namati alandapo ati,

english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
translation: Lesa nga aima, aisa alonganika abantu no kubesalila na mu cifungo,

english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
translation: Pantu Lesa ena alishiba abantu abashaba na cishinka,

english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
translation: Lelo umuntu uushakwata amano akelukafye,

english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
translation: “Yobo shi wingalungamika umutima obe,

english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
translation: Leka ukucita ifyabipa,

english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
translation: Ninshi lyena kuti wainuna amenso yobe ukwabula insoni,

english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
translation: Lyena ninshi ukalabako ku macushi yobe,

english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
translation: Elyo imikalile yobe ikabalika kwati kubalika kwa kasuba ilyo kali pakati ka mutwe.

english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
translation: Ukakwata icicetekelo pantu ukaba ne subilo,

english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
translation: Elyo nga wasendama, uletuusha, takwakabe icakukupumfyanya.

english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
translation: “Bushe kuti twakaana shani ukwasukako ku mashiwi yafula ifi?

english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
translation: Lelo amenso ya babifya yakafilwa ukumona,

english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
translation: Bushe uletontonkanya ukuti ukulanda kobe we Yobo ekwingatulesha ukusosapo mwa?

english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
translation: Pantu iwe ulesosa ukuti, ‘Ine nkonka amafunde ayacine cine,

english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
translation: Nomba nga cakuti Lesa nao alanda,

english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
translation: Elyo nga kuti akweba inkaama sha mano yakwe,

english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
translation: “Bushe iwe kuti wapikulula ubwile bwakwa Lesa mwa,

english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
translation: Amano yakwe yasansama ukucila imyulu, finshi wingacita?

english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
translation: Icipimo cayako calicila icalo ku bukulu,

english: Then Job answered,
translation: Elyo Yobo nao ayasuka ati,

english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
translation: Ubumi bwa fintu fyonse ifipema bwaba mu minwe yakwa Lesa,

english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
translation: Bushe te kutwi kusobolola amashiwi,

english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
translation: Abakote ebasangwa na mano,

english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
translation: “Nomba Lesa ewaba na mano na maka

english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
translation: Ico abongolola tapali nangu umo uwingacikuula nakabili,

english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
translation: Nga alesha imfula ukuloka ninshi kwaba icilala,

english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
translation: Lesa ewakwata amaka na mano,

english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
translation: Apoka bampandamano amano,

english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
translation: Eupoka bashamfumu ubufumu bwabo,

english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
translation: Eupoka bashimapepo tonse uto bakwata,

english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
translation: “Kwena muli bantu bamano,

english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
translation: Alakomeka na mashiwi ya bacenjela mukulanda.

english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
translation: Alenga bakateeka ukusuulwa,

english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
translation: Eusokolola ifyafisama mu mfifi ikalamba,

english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
translation: Eupalamika imishobo ya bantu, kabili no kuyonaula.

english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
translation: Afulunganya amano ya ntungulushi ishaba pano isonde,

english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
translation: Shilepulumpunta mu mfifi ukwabula ulubuuto,

english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
translation: Ala kwena na ine wine ndi wamano nga imwe bene.

english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
translation: “Ine ninsanguka uwakusekwa ku banandi.

english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
translation: Abashikwete ubwafya batontonkanya ukuti uwashama ali nokusuulwa,

english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
translation: Pa matenti ya bapupu epali umutende,

english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
translation: “Nomba ipusheni inama, shilemufundako,

english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
translation: Nangu ipusheni ifimena pa mushili, filemufundako,

english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,
translation: Pali ifi fyonse nani uushaishiba ukuti,

english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
translation: “Ala moneni, fyonse ifi ilinso lyandi lyalifimonapo,

english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
translation: Ala Lesa akamukalipila,

english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
translation: Bushe ubucindami bwakwa Lesa tabumutiinya,

english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
translation: Amapinda yenu ala mapinda ya mito,

english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
translation: “Talaleni lekeni na ine nkwate inshita iyakuilandila,

english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
translation: Nshikene, nomba bushe mulandu nshi ndebikila umweo wandi mu bwafya pakulanda?

english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
translation: Lesa nga alefwaya ukunjipaya kuti anjipaya,

english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
translation: Ici ecikampususha pantu nalishiba ukuti,

english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
translation: Mumfwe bwino bwino amashiwi yandi,

english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
translation: Moneni ninjipekanya nganshi ukulubulula umulandu wandi,

english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
translation: Nani engampeela umulandu,

english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
translation: Ifintu mwaishiba na ine nalifishiba,

english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
translation: “Nomba ndelomba ifintu fibili,

english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
translation: Fumya ukuboko kobe pali ine,

english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
translation: Elyo lyena nga wanjita ndeisa,

english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
translation: Bushe ifyabupulumushi ne fyabubifi nacita fyaba finga?

english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
translation: Cinshi wafishila icinso cobe kuli ine,

english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
translation: Bushe kuti watiinya ibuula ilileululuka mu mwela,

english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
translation: Wampingula buluku buluku,

english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
translation: Wabika amolu yandi mwikoli,

english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
translation: Efyo no bumi bwa muntu bonaikafye nge cintu icilebola,

english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
translation: Lelo ine ndefwaya ukulanda no Mwine wa maka yonse,

english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
translation: Pantu imwe mulebepekesha ukulanda icishinka kanshi muli babufi,

english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
translation: Shi talalenifye tondolo,

english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
translation: Umfweni kanshi kufyo nalatantika umulandu wandi,

english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
translation: “Bushe cinshi mulebepela ubufi mwishina lyakwa Lesa?

english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
translation: Bushe mulefwaya ukuwila ku lubali lwakwe?

english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
translation: Bushe imwe muleti kuti camuwamina nga amuceceta ifyo ubumi bwenu bwaba?

english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
translation: “Umuntu onse uwafyalwa ku mwanakashi, ekalafye inshita inono pa calo,

english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
translation: Nomba umuntu nga afwa, ninshi afwililila no kumushiika bamushiika.

english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
translation: Nga filya fine amenshi ya muli bemba yakama no kucepa,

english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
translation: abantu balafwa nokwima tabema,

english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
translation: “Iyee, kanshi nga wamfishilefye ku calo ca bafwa,

english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
translation: Umuntu nga afwa, bushe kuti aba umumi nakabili?

english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
translation: Lyena nga wanjita nkasuka,

english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
translation: Lyena kuti walalengula imyendele yandi yonse,

english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
translation: Ne fyabubifi fyandi ukafisalila mu cola,

english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
translation: “Nomba nga filya fine ulupili lusholomoka lwasuka lwabongoloka,

english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
translation: filya fine amenshi yakuusa amabwe,

english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
translation: Atila abalula nge luba kabili abonsa,

english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
translation: Pakulekelesha umuntu wamucimfya, apita no kuya aya,

english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
translation: Abana bakwe abaume nga bashala bacindikwa, teti eshibe,

english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
translation: Ena omfwafye ubukali mu mubili wakwe,

english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
translation: Bushe kuti watontomesha amenso yobe pa muntu uwaba ifi?

english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
translation: Nani engafumya icasanguluka ku cakowela?

english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
translation: Apo inshiku sha muntu shalipendwa,

english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
translation: Fumyapo amenso pa muntu uleke aikalile,

english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
translation: “Umuti wena walikwata isubilo,

english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
translation: Imishila yauko nangu ingakota shani,

english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
translation: kuti walemuka nga waumfwa umutonshi,

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
translation: Elyo Elifasi umwina Temani ayaswike ati,

english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
translation: Pali baifwe pali abakalamba abamfwi, abali ne myaka iyingi,

english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
translation: Bushe wasuula ukutalalika kwakwa Lesa,

english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
translation: Cinshi umutima obe ukoseele ifi?

english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
translation: icakuti no mutima obe wafulilwa Lesa,

english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
translation: Bushe muntu nshi uwingaba uwakaele?

english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
translation: Lesa nga tacetekela abamushilo bakwe,

english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
translation: palibufi umuntunse uwabipisha, uwakowela,

english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
translation: “Nga wakutika kuli ine nalakweba,

english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
translation: ifishilano ifya bamano,

english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
translation: Abo beka ebapeelwe icalo

english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
translation: “Bushe umuntu wamano kuti ayasukako ku mashiwi ayabuwelewele,

english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
translation: Ubumi bwa muntu umubi bwaba bwakucula inshiku shonse,

english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
translation: Iciunda cakutiinya caumfwika mu matwi ya mubi,

english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
translation: Tasubila ukuti akafumamo mu mfifi,

english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
translation: Akalulumba mpanga yonse mukufwaya ifyakulya, no kutila, ‘Ifyakulya fili kwi?’

english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
translation: Ubulanda no bucushi nafimwishila,

english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
translation: Pantu emishe ukuboko kwakwe kukulwisha Lesa,

english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
translation: Napama ukulwisha Lesa,

english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
translation: Pantu ali uwaina na masaya yaletenta,

english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
translation: “Akekala mu fibolya fya misumba,

english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
translation: Takatale aba umukankala,

english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
translation: Bushe kuti afwaya ukulanda amashiwi ayacabecabe,

english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
translation: Takatale afuma mu mfifi,

english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
translation: Elaibepa pakucetekela mu fyafye,

english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
translation: Ifi efikamucitikila mu bumi bwakwe,

english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
translation: Akaba ngo mwangashi uulelukusha ifipompo,

english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
translation: Pantu uluko ulushisumina Lesa talusanduluka,

english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
translation: Bakemita ububi, no kufyala ishamo,

english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
translation: Cinshi iwe Yobo wafumisha akatiina ka kuli Lesa mu mano yobe,

english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
translation: Ububi bwaba mu mutima obe ebwalenga ukuti akanwa kobe kalande ifi,

english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
translation: Akanwa kobe ekakushinina, teine iyoo.

english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
translation: “Bushe niwe wabalilepo ukufyalwa pa bantu bonse mwa?

english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
translation: Bushe ulomfwako ubupingushi bwa mu cilye cakwa Lesa?

english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
translation: Finshi waishiba ifyo ifwe tushaishiba?

english: Then Job answered,
translation: Elyo Yobo ayasuka ati,

english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
translation: Nabanjasamwina utunwa twabo pakungwela,

english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
translation: Lesa namposa mu minwe ya bantu ababifi,

english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
translation: Ne mwine naleikalafye bwino, aisa nsansaula,

english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
translation: Nandasaula imifwi ukufuma mu tupinda tonse.

english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
translation: Nandasaula imiku ne miku,

english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
translation: Ninsuka nimbila ne nsalu shabulanda, esho ndefwala,

english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
translation: Amenso yandi nayasuka nayakashika na cee kukulila ifilamba,

english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
translation: Nangu line mu minwe yandi tamwaba lufyengo,

english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
translation: “We calo wishiika umulopa wandi,

english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
translation: Na nombaline kambone wandi aba mu mulu,

english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
translation: “Nalyumfwa ifintu ifingi ifya musango uyu,

english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
translation: Kebela wandi e cibusa wandi,

english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
translation: Kebela eusoseleko umuntu kuli Lesa,

english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
translation: “Kushelefye imyaka inono,

english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
translation: Bushe mukaleka lilali ukulanda amashiwi yenu ayaba ngo mwela weka weka?

english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
translation: Pantu na ine wine kuti nalanda amashiwi yamo yene,

english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
translation: Kuti nalanda amashiwi yakumukoselesha,

english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
translation: “Nomba nga nalanda, ubucushi bwandi tabutalele iyoo,

english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
translation: Cine cine we Lesa naungonaula,

english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
translation: Elyo kabili naunkaka, cili kwati e cikambone cakunshinina,

english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
translation: Lesa alencusha mu cipyu cakwe, nandepaula,

english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
translation: “Umupashi wandi naonaika,

english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
translation: “Nomba imwe konkanyenipo, bwekeshenipo bonsefye,

english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
translation: Inshiku shandi nashipita, amapange yandi nayonaika,

english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
translation: Bapilibula ubushiku ukuba akasuba.

english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
translation: Bushe ine isubilo lyandi nga kwikala ku calo ca bafwa,

english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
translation: nga naeba inindi ukuti, ‘E tata,’

english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
translation: ninshi icisubilo candi cili kwi?

english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
translation: Bushe nkaya nafyo ku calo ca bafwa,

english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
translation: Cine cine abakuntumfya nabanshinguluka,

english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
translation: “Ngafwako we Lesa no kumpeela ico ufwaya

english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
translation: Pantu naubomika imitima teti beshibe,

english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
translation: Uwabepa umunankwe pakumwenamo ubunonshi,

english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
translation: “Lesa nansangula ngo mulumbe ku bantu,

english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
translation: Amenso yandi nayanaka ku mulandu wa macushi,

english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
translation: Ici, cakupapa ku bololoke,

english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
translation: Kabili abalungami bena nabatwalilila mu nshila shabo,

english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
translation: Elyo Biludadi umwina Shuha ayasuka ati,

english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
translation: Intambo iyakumwikata ifishilwe mu mushili,

english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
translation: Ifyakumutiinya fyalimutengamina konse konse,

english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
translation: Ubonaushi bulemulolela,

english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
translation: Ubulwele bulalya inkanda yakwe,

english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
translation: Nabamukululula ukumufumya mwitenti lyakwe ilyo acetekelamo,

english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
translation: Mwitenti lyakwe tamwakashale icintu nelyo cimo,

english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
translation: Imishila yakwe panshi nayuma,

english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
translation: Yobo 21:17

english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
translation: Bakamufumya mu lubuuto no kumuposa mu mfifi,

english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
translation: Takashe umwana nangufye icinshikulula mu luko lwakwe,

english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
translation: “Bushe iwe Yobo uleleka lilali amashiwi yakusabaila?

english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
translation: Abantu ba ku masamba bakasunguka pakumona ishamo lya uyu muntu,

english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
translation: Ee, ili eshamo iliponena pa ŋanda ya muntu umubifi,

english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
translation: Cinshi uletumwena nge nama?

english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
translation: Nelyo uleilepula we mwine ku cipyu cobe,

english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
translation: “Ala cishinka ulubuuto lwa muntu umubi lulashima,

english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
translation: Ulubuuto mwi tenti lyakwe lulashima,

english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
translation: Uwaleenda ne ntampulo ishamaka kale nomba aleongolokafye,

english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
translation: Pantu amakasa yakwe umwine eyamutwala mukwikatwa mwisumbu,

english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
translation: Iciteyo camwikatila ku citende cakwe,

english: Then Job answered,
translation: Elyo Yobo nao ayasuka no kutila,

english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
translation: Nangonaula mu mbalifye shonse, tapali ico ndi,

english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
translation: Alinjimisha ubukali bwakwe,

english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
translation: Ifita fyakwe ifyamaka nafimpalamina,

english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
translation: “Lesa alintalusha kuli bamunyinane,

english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
translation: Balupwa lwandi nabantaluka,

english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
translation: Abeni nalepokelela na babomfi bandi abakashana balemona ine ngo mweni,

english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
translation: Nga naita umubomfi wandi, tewakunjasuka nakalya,

english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
translation: Ku mukashi wandi nako umupu wandi ulenunka pipi,

english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
translation: No twaice twine natunsuula,

english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
translation: Abanandi bonse nabampata,

english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
translation: “Bushe mukaleka lilali ukuncusha,

english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
translation: Niŋonda, nshelefye amafupa yeka yeka,

english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
translation: “Nangulukeniko mwe bacibusa wandi,

english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
translation: Cinshi mulencushisha ifi ngefyo Lesa alencusha?

english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
translation: “Iyee, nga kuti yalembwa amashiwi yandi!

english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
translation: Yalembwa ku cilembelo ca cela na ku mutofwe,

english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
translation: Nomba ine, naishiba ukuti ndubulwila wandi aba umumi,

english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
translation: Nangu panuma inkanda yandi yaonaika kuli ubu bulwele,

english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
translation: Ine eo nkamona na menso yandi aya,

english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
translation: “Nga mwalanda amuti, ‘Twalamucusha nganshi,

english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
translation: Mufwile ukutiina ulupanga mwe bene,

english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
translation: Namuntukaula imiku ikumi,

english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
translation: Nga cakuti ine nalilufyanya,

english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
translation: Nga cakuti imwe mwalaitutumuna pali ine,

english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
translation: mwishibe ukuti ni Lesa ewanjilikisha.

english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
translation: “Ine nangufye nailishanya pa bunkalwe bancita,

english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
translation: Lesa alinjisalila inshila, kanshi teti mone na pakupita.

english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
translation: Alimpokolola ubucindami bwandi,

english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.
translation: Kwaliko umuntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Yobo. Aleikala mu calo ico beta Usi . Uyu muntu ali uwakaele, umololoke kabili uutiina Lesa, talefwaya ukucita ifyabipa.

english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
translation: Ubuso 12:10

english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”
translation: Nomba fungulula ukuboko kobe no kwikata pa fyuma fyakwe fyonse, alekulapisha pa menso yobe.”

english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Satana ati. “Cisuma kanshi nabika fyonse ifyo akwata mu minwe yobe, nomba umwine ena wimwikatamo.” Satana epakufuma pa cinso cakwa Yawe, aya no kuya.

english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
translation: Ubushiku bumo cilya abana bakwa Yobo abaume na banakashi balelya no kunwa umwangashi mu ŋanda ya mukalamba wabo umwaume,

english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,
translation: inkombe yafika kuli Yobo yamweba aiti, “Twacilalima ne ŋombe, bapunda nabo baciba balelya pambali mupepi,

english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
translation: elyo abena Saba bacisa fukukila ifitekwa, bafisenda no kufisenda fyonse. Nabepaya na babomfi bobe ku lulimi lwa lupanga. Ninefye neka mpuswike mukwisa kushimikila ificitike.”

english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
translation: Acili alelanda ifi, no kupwisha talapwisha, inkombe imbi nayo yafika yasosa aiti, “Inkuba yakwa Lesa ukufuma ku mulu naipona no koca impaanga na babomfi no kubepaya. Ninefye neka mpuswike mukwisa kushimikilako ificitike.”

english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
translation: Acili alelanda ifi, na imbi inkombe yafika aiti, “Abena Kaludea bapangile amabumba yatatu no kufukukila ingamila no kushisenda shonse, baipaya na babomfi ku lulimi lwa lupanga. Ninefye neka mpuswike mukwisa kushimikilako ificitike.”

english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
translation: Acili alelanda na imbi inkombe yafika aiti, “Abana bobe abaume na banakashi bacilalya no kunwa umwangashi mu ŋanda ya mukalamba wabo umwaume.

english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”
translation: Elyo mu kashita akanonofye kwacima umwela uukalamba ukufuma mu matololo no kwisa uma amatungi yane aya ŋanda no kubongolokela pa baice, no kufwa nabafwa. Ninefye neka mpuswike mukwisa kushimikilako ificitike.”

english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
translation: Afyele abana abaume cine lubali na bana abanakashi nabo batatu.

english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
translation: Elyo Yobo aiminina, alepula umwingila wakwe, abeya no mushishi ku mutwe, awa panshi no kupepa ati,

english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”
translation: “Naishile ubwamba ukufuma munda muli mayo, kabili nkabwelelamo ubwamba uko nafumine. Yawe alipeele kabili Yawe napoka, nalipaalwe na matotelo ishina lyakwa Yawe.”

english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.
translation: Muli ifi fyonse Yobo tabifishe, tasosele nangu cimo icakupontela Lesa.

english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
translation: Akwete impaanga amakana cine lubali (7,000), ingamila amakana yatatu (3,000), iŋombe shakulima imyanda isano (500), na bapunda abakota imyanda isano (500). Kabili alikwete ababomfi abengi nganshi. Uyu muntu alicilile abantu bonse aba ku kabanga ubukankala.

english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
translation: Abana bakwa Yobo abaume babeleshe ukucita imitebeto cila muntu kumwakwe no kwitako abanankwe, kabili balelekanina. Elyo baleitako na bankashi yabo balya batatu mu kulya no kunwa nabo pamo.

english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.
translation: Kanshi cali ifi, inshiku shakusefya nga shapwa Yobo alebeta no kubasangulula. Elyo kacelocelo alebuuka aya mukutuula ilambo lyakoca ukulingana ne mpendwa ya bana bakwe bonse. Pantu aletontonkanya ukuti, “Limbi kuti abana bandi babifya no kupontela Lesa mu mitima yabo.” Efyo alecita lyonse.

english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.
translation: Kanshi kwali ubushiku bumo ilyo abana baume bakwa Lesa aba ku mulu baile longana pa cinso cakwa Yawe, Satana nao ali nabo.

english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aipusha Satana ati, “Wafuma kwisa?” Satana nao ayasuka Yawe ati, “Nacilaendaukafye nafuma uku naya uku, nacilalulumbafye mu calo.”

english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”
translation: Yawe akonkanyapo ati, “Bushe wacimumona umubomfi wandi Yobo ifyo aba? Tapaba pa calo uwalingana nankwe, muntu uwakaele, umololoke kabili uutiina Lesa no kutaluka kukucita ifyabipa.”

english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
translation: Satana epakwasuka Yawe ati, “Bushe Yobo atiina tiinafye Lesa apabula nangu cimo?

english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
translation: Elyo Sofari umwina Namati ayasuka ati,

english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
translation: Abana bakwe ebakalomba uluse ku balanda,

english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
translation: Amafupa yakwe ayaisulamo amaka ya bulumendo,

english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
translation: “Nangu ububi bwalowa mu kanwa kakwe,

english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,
translation: nangu tafwaya no kubufwisa,

english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
translation: ifilyo mu cifu cakwe nafisasa,

english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
translation: Akaluka ifyuma acibawile,

english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
translation: Akonka ubusungu bwa ngoshe,

english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
translation: Takatale alolesha pa mimana,

english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
translation: Akabwesha conse ico anonkele no kuculila,

english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
translation: Pantu atitikisha abalanda no kulenga ukuti babe abapina,

english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
translation: “Ifyo walanda Yobo fyankalifya umutima,

english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
translation: “Ulunkumbwa lwakwe ulubi talupwa iyoo,

english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
translation: Tashapo utwakulya nelyo tumo,

english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
translation: Pa nshita akwatisha ifyuma ifingi, elyo ubupina bukamwikata,

english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
translation: Ilyo aisusha ulufumo lwakwe no kwikuta,

english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
translation: Nangu engabutuka icanso ca cela,

english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
translation: Umufwi uwamulasa ulapulila panuma,

english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
translation: Imfifi ikulu ilelolela ukukupa ifyuma fyakwe,

english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
translation: Imyulu ikasokolola ububi bwakwe,

english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
translation: Ilyeshi likasenda fyonse ifyaba mu ŋanda yakwe,

english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
translation: Ifi efyaba ishamo Lesa aletela umuntu umubifi,

english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
translation: Amashiwi naumfwa yamusaalula yamponya na pa musao,

english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
translation: “Bushe tawaishiba ifyo caba ukufumafye na kale,

english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
translation: ukuti umucinshi wa muntu umubifi tautwalilila,

english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
translation: Nangu ubukankala bwakwe bwinganina bwafika na mu mulu,

english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
translation: ala nakalya wakuposafye, aposwafye ngo busali bwakwe.

english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
translation: Akapita nge ciloto, takamoneke,

english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
translation: Ilinso ilyalemumona talyakatale alimumona nakabili,

english: Then Job answered,
translation: Elyo Yobo nao ayasuka ati.

english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
translation: Iŋombe shabo ishilume shalikwata amaka yabufyashi,

english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
translation: Abana babo abaice baifuminafye no kulayangililafye mu lubansa nge mpaanga,

english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
translation: Balemba inyimbo no kulisha insombo na maseese,

english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
translation: Inshiku shabo pa calo shabafye ishansansa,

english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
translation: Aba bantu beba Lesa abati,

english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
translation: Ngo Mwine wa maka yonse finshi ali pakuti tulemutumika,

english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
translation: Bena batila ishuko lyaba mu minwe yabo,

english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
translation: “Bushe mulamona ilingi uko icisaniko ca babifi cishima?

english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
translation: Bushe miku inga mwamona ababifi baleululwa mu mwela nge mpimbili,

english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
translation: Imwe mulesosa ati, ‘Lesa alakanda abana pa mulandu wa kubifya kwa bashibo.’

english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
translation: “Kutikeni bwino bwino ku mashiwi yandi,

english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
translation: Lekeni umwine aimwene na menso yakwe uko Lesa alemukanda,

english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
translation: Bushe umubifi, inshiku shakwe nga shapwa, afika pa kufwa,

english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
translation: “Bushe umuntunse kuti apanda Lesa amano,

english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
translation: Limo umuntu afwafye ilyo acili na maka ayengi,

english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
translation: Ninshi acilifye no mubili uwamaka,

english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
translation: Umbi nao afwa ne cililishi mu mutima,

english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
translation: Lelo nangu cibe ifyo, bonse bafwila mu nshila imo ine,

english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
translation: “Nomba ine ninjishiba ifili mu mano yenu,

english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
translation: Imwe mulesosa amuti, ‘Bushe ili kwi iŋanda ya mukankala,

english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
translation: Bushe imwe emukuti tamwatala amwipushapo abalendo,

english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
translation: Ntekeleni no mutima nande,

english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
translation: Ala umubifi alasungwa ukufika na ku bushiku bwakukandwa,

english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
translation: Lelo kwena takuba umuntu nelyo umo uuya mukusosha umubifi,

english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
translation: Ilyo bamusenda kukumushiika,

english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
translation: No mushili wa mwishika ulomfwika bwino kuli ena,

english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
translation: Nga imwe kuti mwantalalikako shani ku mashiwi yenu ayabulamo amano?

english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
translation: Bushe ine ni ku muntunse ndeilishanya?

english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
translation: Ndolesheni mu menso ifyo ndi,

english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
translation: Nga natontonkanya pali ici icamponena,

english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
translation: Cinshi ababi bakokwela pa calo?

english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
translation: Ababi bena abana babo bakulila pa cinso cabo,

english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
translation: Amayanda yabo yekala mu cibote,

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
translation: Elyo Elifasi umwina Temani ayasuka Yobo ati,

english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
translation: E mulandu ulengele ifiteyo fikushinguluke,

english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
translation: Ecilengele ukuti pa menso yobe pafiite fititi,

english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
translation: “Bushe Lesa taikala apatali nganshi mu mulu?

english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
translation: Nomba iwe utila, ‘Ni finshi Lesa engeshiba?

english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
translation: Amakumbi ayatikama yalimufimba, eco tatumwena,

english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
translation: Bushe iwe ulefwaya ukusunga imibeele yakale,

english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
translation: Basendelwe ninshi inshita yabo tailafika,

english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
translation: Balya bantu babi baebele Lesa abati, ‘Tutaluke,

english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
translation: Lelo nangu cali ifi, ni Lesa ewaiswishe ifisuma mu mayanda yabo,

english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
translation: “Abalungami balasansamuka pakumona uko balya abantu babi balebakanda,

english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
translation: “ Bushe umuntunse busuma nshi engakwata kuli Lesa?

english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
translation: ‘Ala cacine abalwani besu nabonaika,

english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
translation: “Eico iwe nakilafye kuli Lesa, ukwate umutende,

english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
translation: Usekelele amafunde ayo alekupeela,

english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
translation: Nga wabwelela ku Mwine wa maka yonse nauicefya,

english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
translation: kabili nga wasuula golide obe kwati lukungu,

english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
translation: awe lyena Umwine wa maka yonse eukaba golide yobe,

english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
translation: Kabili Umwine wa maka yonse eukaba insansa shobe,

english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
translation: Lyena ukalati nga wamupepa, nao akumfwa,

english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
translation: Ukalakwata ishuko pa milimo yonse iyo ukalabomba,

english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
translation: Pa bantu abaponena mu mafya, utila, ‘Bafwilishe!’

english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
translation: Nga fisuma nshi Umwine wa maka yonse engasanga mu kulungamika kobe?

english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
translation: Lesa kuti apususha nangu uushili wakaele,

english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
translation: “Bushe uletontonkanya ukuti ni pa mulandu wakuti walimukwatila akatiina,

english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
translation: Bushe te pa mulandu wa bubifi bobe,

english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
translation: Yobo 35:6-8

english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
translation: Abalekwata icilaka iwe walebatana amenshi,

english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
translation: nangu wali umuntu umukankala uwakwete ne mpanga,

english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
translation: Waleleka bamukamfwilwa ukubwelelamo ukwabula nangu cimo,

english: Then Job answered,
translation: Elyo Yobo nao epakwasuka ati,

english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
translation: Lelo kwena, Lesa alishiba imyendele yandi yonse,

english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
translation: Amakasa yandi yendafye mwishinda lyakwe,

english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
translation: Ine ndasunga pe amafunde ayo anjeba,

english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
translation: “Lelo Lesa nga apingula ukucita icintu icili conse, bushe nani uwingamulesha?

english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
translation: Nalishiba ukuti Lesa akancitila ifyo umwine apekanya ukucita,

english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
translation: Ni pali ici ntiinina ukuya iminina ku cinso cakwe,

english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
translation: Ni Lesa eulenga umutima wandi ukufunshika,

english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
translation: Lelo imfifi taimpeseshe amano iyoo,

english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
translation: “Ala na lelo line ncilifye uwailishanya apakalamba,

english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
translation: Nga cakutifye ine njishiba ukwakuti ningamusanga,

english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
translation: Ala nga kuti naya ilubulwila,

english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
translation: Kuti naya yumfwila ifyo Lesa umwine enganjasuka,

english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
translation: Bushe kuti Lesa aya bomfya amaka yakwe pakuncincintila?

english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
translation: Kuti amona ati, ‘Uyu muntu wacishinka ndelubulwisha,’

english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
translation: “Ntila nga naya ku kabanga Lesa tabako,

english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
translation: Conse nga naya ndemufwaila ku kapinda ka ku kuso, nshimusanga,

english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
translation: “Nga cinshi Umwine wa maka yonse ashapimina inshita yakupingwilapo,
