translation: Na umbi uwasheleko ni Ogi, imfumu ya mu musumba wa Bashani, e umo uwa mu bena Refaimu uwaleteeka mu Ashitaroti elyo na mu Edelei.

english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
translation: Ewaleteeka no lupili lwine lwa Hemoni, Saleka, elyo na mu Bashani monse, mpakafye na ku mupaka wa bena Geshuri na Maakati, elyo no kufika pakati ka calo ca Gileadi no kuya fika ku mupaka wa Sihoni, imfumu ya bena Heshiboni.

english: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translation: Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe pamo na bena Israeli ebacimfishe isho mfumu. Kabili Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe apeele ne calo cabo ku bena Rubeni, ku bena Gadi na kuli citika wa luko lwa bena Manase, baba e bene.

english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
translation: Kanshi ishi e mfumu isho Yoshua na bena Israeli bacimfishe ishaleikala kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani ukufuma ku musumba wa Baali Gadi kwishika lya Lebanoni ukufika ku lupili lwa Halaki, ulwaiminina ukufika ku Seiri. Ifyalo fyabo ifyo Yoshua apeele abena Israeli, ukulingana na cila luko umo babelele, nifi:

english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
translation: Icalo ca mpili, icalo ca mwishika, icalo ca Araba, icalo ca mu mutentemuko wa mpili, icalo ca mu matololo elyo neca Negebu, ifyalo fya bena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Kenani, abena Perisi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi.

english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
translation: Imfumu ya mu Yeriko imo,

english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. The LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
translation: Ilyo Yoshua akotele nganshi, akwata imyaka iyingi, Yawe amwebele ati, “Naukota ne myaka naifula, kabili nakushala incende ya calo iyikulu nganshi, iyo ishilapokwa.

english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
translation: Kabili abashilile ne misumba yonse iyo Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli, uwali imfumu ya mu Heshiboni ukuya fikafye na ku mupaka wa bena Amoni.

english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
translation: Elyo kuli ici cine calo, kwalundilwe na Gileadi ne calo ca bena Geshuri na bena Maakati, bonse aba ku lupili lwa Hemoni, ne calo ca Bashani ukushinta na ku Saleka.

english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
translation: Amaf 3:12

english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli tabafulumwinemo abena Geshuri na bena Maakati, bena batwalililafye ukulaikala pamo na bena Israeli ukufika no bushiku bwa lelo.

english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
translation: Kanofye uluko lwakwa Levi lwena Mose talupeeleko icakaniko ca cishilano ca calo. Pantu abena Levi bena imituulo ye lambo iyakoca iyo baletuula kuli Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, yena eyali icakaniko cacishilano cabo, pamo ngefyo Lesa abalaile.

english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
translation: Ifi efyo Mose ayakenye icalo ku luko lwakwa Rubeni, umwabelele imikowa yabo:

english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
translation: Icalo cafumine ku Aroeli iyabela mu lulamba lwa mukonko wa Alinoni, no musumba pakati nankati ka mukonko no kubikako ne calo conse icabatama ica Medeba,

english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
translation: ukufika ku Heshiboni ne misumba yonse iyaciko iyaba apabatama, ukusanshako Diboni, Bamoti Baali, Beti Baali Meoni,

english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
translation: Yahasi, Kedemoti, Mefati,

english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
translation: Kiriataimu, Sibuma, Sereti Shaha pa lupili lwa mwishika,

english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
translation: Iyi e ncende iyisheleko: Yonsefye impanga ya bena Filisiti elyo na bena Geshuri,

english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
translation: Beti Peori, imitentemuko ya Pisiga, na Beti Yeshimoti.

english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
translation: Ekutila misumba yonse iyaba apabatama, elyo ne calo conse cakwa Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli, uwali imfumu mu Heshiboni, ulya Mose acimfishe pamo pene na bashamfumu ba bena Midiani, Efi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba, na bashamfumu banono abaleikala muli cilya calo.

english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
translation: Ukusansha kubo baipeye mu bulwi ku bena Israeli, pali Balamu umwana mwaume wakwa Beori, uwali ŋanga iyalebuka.

english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
translation: Umumana wa Yordani ewali e mupaka wa calo ca bena Rubeni. Imisumba pamo ne mishi yabo eyali e cishilano ca bena Rubeni, mu ndupwa shabo umo babelele.

english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
translation: Ifi efyo Mose ayakenye icalo ku luko lwakwa Gadi, umwabelele indupwa shabo:

english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
translation: Icalo ca Yaseri, ne misumba yonse iya mu Gileadi, elyo na citika wa calo ca bena Amoni ukufikafye na ku Aroeli iyabeela mupepi na ku Raba.

english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
translation: Kabili ukufuma ku Heshiboni ukufikafye na ku Ramati Misipa na Betonimu. Elyo kabili ukufuma ku Manaimu ukufikafye na ku mupaka wa calo ca Debi.

english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
translation: Elyo na mwishika Beti Haramu, Beti Nimura, Sukoti na Safoni elyo ne calo icasheleko ica Sihoni imfumu mu Heshiboni, umumana wa Yordani ewali umupaka wa calo consefye ukufika na ku mpela ya bemba wa Kinereti uwali kwishilya.

english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
translation: Kanshi ici calo kumo kwine ne misumba ne mishi yaciko, efyali cakaniko ca cishilano ca bena Gadi, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
translation: Ifi efyo Mose ayakenye icalo kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, nabo ecali icakaniko ca citika wa bana bakwa Manase umwabelele indupwa shabo:

english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
translation: itulilefye ku mumana wa Shihori ku kabanga ka calo ca Egupto ukuya fika na ku mupaka wa Ekironi ku kapinda ka ku kuso, icalo ico baletila ca bena Kenani. Intungulushi isha Bafilisiti ishaleteeka ici calo shali shisano. Imo yaleteeka mu Gasa, imbi mu Ashidodi, imbi mu Ashikeloni, imbi mu Gati elyo imbi mu Ekironi. Imbi ncende iyisheleko ni mpanga ya bena Afi,

english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
translation: Icalo catendekelefye ukufuma ku Manaimu ukubikako icitungu conse ica Bashani ne calo conse icakwa Ogi imfumu ya ku Bashani, ne misumba iyakwa Yairi mu Bashani mwine amakumi mutanda,

english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
translation: elyo citika wa calo ca Gileadi, Ashitaroti elyo na Edelei, imisumba yakwa Ogi imfumu ya mu Bashani. Ici e calo capeelwe kuli bamwana Makiri, uwali umwana mwaume wakwa Manase. Capeelwe kuli citika wa bamwana Makiri, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
translation: Ifi e fyalo ifyo Mose ayakenye ukuba icishilano ilyo ali mu mawanga ya Moabu, kwishilya lya Yordani, ku kabanga ka Yeriko.

english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
translation: iya ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, na yonse impanga ya bena Kenani, elyo na Meara icalo ca bena Sidoni no kufikafye ku Afeki, ku mupaka wa bena Amoli.

english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
translation: Elyo incende yonse iya bena Gebali, na yonse mpanga ya bena Lebanoni ukuyafye lwa ku kabanga ukufuma ku Baali Gadi mwisamba lya lupili lwa Hemoni ukuyafye mpaka ku Lebo Hamati .

english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
translation: Bonse abekala mu calo ca mpili ukufumafye ku Lebanoni ukufika ku Misilefoti Maimu, bonsefye abena Sidoni, Ine wine ne mwine nkabafulumuna ukufuma pa ntanshi ya bena Israeli. Umone ukuti ici calo cayakanishiwa bwino ku bena Israeli nge cacishilano, pamo ngefyo nakwebele ukucita.

english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
translation: Eico nomba cakanye ku nko pabula kukuba icakaniko ca cishilano cashiko, elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase nalo ulupeeleko.”

english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:
translation: Elyo umbi citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, abena Rubeni na bena Gadi bapeelwe iciputulwa cimbi kwishilya lya Yordani ku kabanga ngefyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe abapeele kukuba icakaniko ca cishilano cabo.

english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
translation: Abashilile icalo ukufuma ku Aroeli icaba mu lulamba lwa mukonko wa Alinoni, no musumba pakati nankati ka mukonko no kubikako, ne calo conse icabatama ica Medeba no kuya shinta na ku Diboni.

english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
translation: Nomba ishi e ncende ishapeelwe ku bena Israeli nge cakaniko ca cishilano cabo mu calo ca Kenani, ico Eleasa shimapepo, Yoshua umwana mwaume wakwa Nuni ne ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha nko sha bena Israeli bayakenye.

english: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.
translation: Eico nomba, pamo ngefyo wamona, Yawe ansunga ukuba uwamweo pa myaka amakumi yane na isano (45) ukufuma inshita Yawe asosele ifi kuli Mose. Cali lintu abena Israeli baleendauka mu matololo. Eico mona ine ilelo ndi ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse na isano (85)!

english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.
translation: Na lelo line ine ncili uwamaka nga filya fine nali mu bushiku Mose antuminemo. Na ndakai line ncili na maka yakuya ku bulwi no kubwela, ngefyo nali pali ilya inshita.

english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”
Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.
Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
translation: Ishina lyakale ilya Hebuloni ni Kiriati Ariba, pantu Ariba ali umuntu uwacindamisha pakati ka bena Anakimu. Kabili mu calo ubulwi bwalipwile, mwabafye tondolo.

english: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
translation: Ifyakaniko fya cishilano cabo fyapeelwe ukulingana no kupendula ku nko pabula elyo na citika wa luko lumo, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
translation: Inko shibili na citika wa luko lumo, Mose abapeele icakaniko ca cishilano icalo icabela kwishilya lya Yordani, lelo abena Levi bena tabakenyeko ici cakaniko ca cishilano ca calo pakati kabo.

english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
translation: Pantu abana bakwa Yosefu abaume bali inko shibili, ulwakwa Manase no lwakwa Efulemu. Abena Levi tabapokeleko icakaniko ca mpanga, kanofye imisumba yakwikalamo ne fitungu fyakucemenamo imikuni ya ŋombe, imbushi ne mpaanga shabo.

english: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakwakana icalo ukulingana nomo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.
translation: Nomba abantu aba mu luko lwakwa Yuda baile kuli Yoshua ku Giligali, elyo Kalebu mwana Yefune umwina Kenasi atile kuli ena, “Nawishiba ifyo Yawe aebele Mose umuntu wakwa Lesa ku Kadeshi Banea pa mulandu obe elyo na ine.

english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
translation: Ine nali ne myaka amakumi yane iyakufyalwa lintu Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe antumine ukufuma ku Kadeshi Banea mukufwailisha no kulengula icalo. Elyo na ine ilyo nabwelulwikeko, namuletele akasebo ukulingana nefyo naile sanga.

english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
translation: Nomba bamunyinane abo naile nabo, banenwine abantu nokulenga baba no mwenso. Lelo ine nakonkelefye no mutima onse ifyo Yawe Lesa wandi anjebele ukucita.

english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
translation: Eico kanshi pali bulya bushiku bwine, Mose alapile umulapo kuli ine ati, ‘Icalo ico waile nyantamo amakasa yobe cili nokuba icakaniko ca cishilano cobe pamo pene na bana bobe pe na pe. Pantu walikonka no mutima obe onse ifyo Yawe Lesa wandi afwaya.’

english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
translation: Icitungu icapendwilwe capeelwe ku ba mu luko lwakwa Yuda, umwabelele ndupwa shabo, caile shintafye na ku mupaka wa Edomu na ku matololo ya Sini mupepi pepifye na kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
translation: Kabili ukufuma ku Bala, washokela ku masamba ku lupili lwa Seiri, elyo no kulambata mu mbali ya lupili lwa Yelimu, emukutila Kesaloni, ku kapinda ka ku kuso no kutwalilila ukuya ku Beti Shemeshi, ukwabukila ku Timuna.

english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
translation: Umupaka kabili waya ku mutentemuko wa lupili lwa Ekironi ku kapinda ka ku kuso no kwalukila ku Shikeroni no kucilinganya ulupili lwa Bala no kuya fika ku Yabineli. Uyu mupaka wapelele muli bemba.

english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
translation: Umupaka wa ku masamba wali lulamba lwa Bemba Mukulu wine. Iyi e mipaka iyashingulwike abantu bakwa Yuda ukulingana ne ndupwa shabo.

english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
translation: Ukulingana nefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Yoshua, icipande cimo ica calo cakwa Yuda calipeelwe kuli Kalebu umwana mwaume wakwa Yefune. Amupeele Kiriati Ariba, emukutila Hebuloni. Ariba ali ni wishi wakwa Anaki.

english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
translation: Kabili Kalebu afulumwine ukufuma ku Hebuloni bamwana Anaki batatu: Sheshai, Aimani elyo na Talimai.

english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
translation: Kabili aimine no kuya lwisha abantu abaleikala mu Debi, kale uyu musumba waleitwa Kiriati Sefe.

english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
translation: Elyo Kalebu atile “Nkapeela umwana wandi umwanakashi Akisa kukuba umukashi ku mwaume onse uukalwisha no kupoka umusumba wa Kiriati Sefe.”

english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
translation: Awe Otinieli umwana mwaume wakwa Kenasi, munyina wakwa Kalebu wine, ewapokele uyu musumba. Nao Kalebu epakumupeela umwana wakwe umwanakashi Akisa ukuba umukashi wakwe.

english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
translation: Ubushiku ilyo Akisa akuukile, Otinieli amupamfya ukulombako wishi incende yakulimamo. Awe ilyo aikilafye pali punda, Kalebu wishi amwipusha ati, “Bushe cinshi ulefwaya nkucitile?”

english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
translation: Nao mwane ayasuka ati, “Tata ndefwaya mumpeeleko icilambu cimo icikankala. Apo ni mu matololo ya Negebu mwampeela impanga, mpeeleniko no tumfukumfuku twa menshi.” Nao wishi Kalebu epakumupeela utumfukumfuku twa pa mulu wa lupili elyo no twa mwishika.

english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;
translation: Uyu mupaka wabo uwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, watampile ukufuma pa mpela ya Bemba Wamucele, ukutampa petenga lya bemba uwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
translation: Abap 1:20

english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
translation: Yosh 11:21

english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
translation: Kina, Dinona, Adada,

english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
translation: Kadeshi, Hasoli, Itinani,

english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
translation: Sifu, Telemu, Bealoti,

english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),
translation: Hasoli Hadata, Kerioti Hesroni, emukutila Hasoli,

english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
translation: Amami, Shema, Molada,

english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
translation: Hazali Gada, Heshiboni, Betipeleti,

english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
translation: Hasa Shuali, Beresheba, Bisiotiya

english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
translation: Baala, Imu, Esemu,

english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
translation: Waile abukila ku kapinda ka ku kulyo pa mupaka wa Akilabimu ukutwalilila ukufika na ku Sini. Kabili wayafye na ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ka Kadeshi Banea. Elyo uyu mupaka wapitilila Hesroni ukwisa ku Adali no kushokela ku Kaka.

english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
translation: Elitoladi, Kesili, Homa,

english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
translation: Sikilagi, Madimana, Sansana,

english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
translation: Labaoti, Shilihimu, Aini, pamo na Rimoni, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali amakumi yabili na pabula (29).

english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
translation: Sanoa, Eni Ganimu, Tapua, Enamu,

english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
translation: Yamuti, Adulamu, Sokoyo, Aseka,

english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
translation: Shaaraimu, Aditaimu, Gedera pamo pene na Gederotaimu, yonse imisumba pamo pene ne mishi yabo yali ikumi limo na ine.

english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
translation: Imisumba na imbi ni Senani, Hadashah, Migidoli Gadi,

english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
translation: Dileani, Misipa, Yokiteli,

english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
translation: Lakishi, Bosikati, Egiloni,

english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
translation: Kabili waile na ku Asimoni no kusuntinkana na kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto, ukuya pelela kuli bemba. Uyu ewali e mupaka wabo uwabelele ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,
translation: Kaboni, Lamamu, Kitilishi,

english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
translation: Gedaloti, Beti Dagoni, Nama, elyo na Makeda, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali ikumi limo na mutanda (16).

english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
translation: Imisumba na imbi ni Libina, Eta, Ashani,

english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
translation: Ifuta, Ashina, Nesibi,

english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
translation: Keila Akisibi na Malesha, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali pabula.

english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
translation: Na imbi misumba ni Ekironi, amaboma ne mishi yauko,

english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
translation: ukufuma ku masamba ya Ekironi, ukulola kuli bemba na yonse incende ya Ashidodi, ukulundako ne mishi yauko.

english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.
translation: Imisumba na imbi ni Ashidodi, amaboma ne mishi yauko, Gasa, amaboma ne mishi yauko ukuya fikafye na ku kamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto no kukonka ululamba lwa Bemba Mukulu.

english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
translation: Mu calo ca mpili namo mwali imisumba na imbi: Shami, Yati, Soko,

english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),
translation: Dana, Kiriati Sana, emukutila Debi,

english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
translation: Ku kabanga nako umupaka ni Bemba Wamucele, ukuya fikafye napo umumana wa Yordani wawila muli bemba. Elyo umupaka wa ku kapinda ka ku kuso nao wayambile ukufuma pa musoso wa bemba pa mawilo ya mumana wa Yordani.

english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
translation: Anabi, Eshitemo, Animu,

english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
translation: Gosheni, Holoni na Gilo, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali ikumi limo na umo (11).

english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
translation: Kabili mwali na Alabu, Duma, Eshani,

english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
translation: Yanimu, Beti Tapua, Afeka,

english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
translation: Humita, Kiriati Ariba, emukutila Hebuloni, na Siori, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali pabula.

english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,
translation: Kabili mwali na Maoni, Kameli, Sifu, Yuta,

english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
translation: Yesireli, Yokideamu, Sanoa,

english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
translation: Kaini, Gibea na Timuna, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali ikumi limo.

english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
translation: Na imbi imisumba yali ni Halihuli, Beti Suli, Gedori,

english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
translation: Malati, Beti Anoti na Elitekoni, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali mutanda.

english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
translation: Uyu mupaka nao walipitilile mpakafye na ku Beti Hogula no kufika ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka Beti Araba ku Cilibwe cakwa Boani mwana Rubeni.

english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
translation: Umusumba wa Kiriati Bali, uo batila, Kiriati Yelimu na Raba, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali ibili.

english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
translation: Mu matololo namo mwali imisumba na imbi, Beti Araba, Midini, Sekaka,

english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
translation: Nibushani, Umusumba wa mucele, na Eni Gedi, yonse imisumba ne mishi yabo yali mutanda.

english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
translation: Nomba abena Yuda balifililwe ukutamfya abena Yebusi, abaleikala mu Yerusalemu. Eico ukufika no bushiku bwa lelo, abena Yebusi bacili baleikala na bena Yuda mu Yerusalemu mwine.

english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
translation: Kabili umupaka waya ku Debi ukufuma kwishika lya Ako no kushokela ku kapinda ka ku kuso ku Giligali, uwalungatana no mupokapoka wa Adumimu uwabela ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ka mukonko. Kabili umupaka wapitilila ukuya ku tumfukumfuku twa menshi twa Eni Shemeshi ukuya pelela pa Eni Rogeli

english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
translation: Elyo kabili umupaka wanina ukufuma mu mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu ukukonka ku kapinda ka ku kulyo mwisamba lya lupili lwa musumba wa Yebusi, emukutila Yerusalemu. Ukufuma kulya, umupaka waisa ninika pa mulu wa lupili lwa ku masamba ya mupokapoka wa Hinomu, ku mpela ye shika lya Refaimu, lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);
translation: Elyo kabili ukufuma pa mulu wa lupili, umupaka washokela ku kamfukumfuku ka menshi ya Nefutoa, ukwisa fumina ku misumba ya lupili lwa Efuloni no kupitilila ukuya ku Bala, emukutila ku Kiriati Yarimu.

english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
translation: Umupaka wa citungu capeelwe ku bana bakwa Yosefu wayambile ku mumana wa Yordani ku Yeriko, lwa ku kabanga ku menshi ya Yeriko, no kuninika ukufuma kulya ukupita mu matololo ukuya ku calo ca mpili sha Betele.

english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
translation: Na muli ici calo tabatamfishemo abena Kenani abaleikala mu Gesa. Na mu bushiku bwe lelo bwine abena Kenani bekalafye pakati ka bena Efulemu, lelo baba mukubomba umulaasa.

english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
translation: Uyu mupaka watwalilile ukufuma ku Betele, emukutila Lusi, ukwabukila ku calo ca bena Aki mu Ataloti.

english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.
translation: Kabili watentemukile lwa ku masamba ku mupaka wa calo ca bena Yafuleti no kuya fikafye na ku mupaka wa mwishika lya Beti Haloni no kushinta ku Gesa, wayapelela na muli bemba.

english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
translation: Kanshi ici e calo Manase na Efulemu bamwana Yosefu bapokelele ukuba icakaniko ca cishilano cabo.

english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.
translation: Kanshi ici ecali icalo ca bamwana Efulemu, umwabelele indupwa shabo. Umupaka wa cakaniko ca cishilano cabo watendekele ku Ataloti Ada ku kabanga ukuya pa mulu wa Beti Oloni,

english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.
translation: no kupitilila ukuya fika kuli bemba. Kabili ukufuma ku Mikimetati lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso no kushokela ku kabanga walungama ku Tanati Shilo, ukupita lubali ku Yanoa lwa ku kabanga.

english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
translation: Elyo kabili watentemukile ukufuma ku Yanoa ukuya ku Ataloti na ku Nala, mpaka ukufika ku Yeriko no kwisa tuntukila ku Yordani.

english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
translation: Ukufuma ku Tapua, umupaka waile ku masamba ku mumana wa Kana no kuya shinta kuli bemba. Ici e cakaniko ca cishilano ica luko lwa bana bakwa Efulemu, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
translation: Elyo kabili kwalundilwe ne misumba yonsefye ne mishi yabo iyali mu mbali iyapatwililwe ku bena Efulemu mukati ka cakaniko ca cishilano ca bena Manase.

english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
translation: Kabili ici ecali icitungu icapeelwe ku luko lwakwa Manase, nge beli lyakwa Yosefu, kuli Makiri nao uwali ibeli lyakwa Manase kabili cikolwe ca bena Gileadi. Bapeelwe icalo ca Gileadi ne ca Bashani pa mulandu wakuti abena Makiri bali fita fyabulwi nganshi.

english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo kwali icalo cakwa Efulemu, ku kapinda ka ku kuso nako kwali icalo cakwa Manase. Icalo cakwa Manase cashintilefye na muli bemba no kuba e mupaka pakati ka Asheri ku kapinda ka ku kuso elyo ku kabanga nako ni Isaka.

english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
translation: Mu calo cakwa Isaka na Asheri, Manase namo alikwetemo Beti Shani ne mishi yauko, Ibuleamu ne mishi yauko, abantu abaleikala mu Dori ne mishi yauko . Elyo akwete na bantu baleikala mu Eni Dori na mu mishi yauko, na baleikala mu Tana na mu mishi yauko, na ba mu Megido na mu tumishi twauko elyo no walenga itatu ni Nafoti.

english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
translation: Lelo abena Manase balifililwe ukupoka iyi misumba, pantu abena Kenani bakoselepofye ukulaikala muli cilya calo.

english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
translation: Eico, ilyo abena Israeli bakosele nganshi, babikile abena Kenani kukubomba umulimo wa mulaasa. Nalyo line tababatamfishe nangu panono.

english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”
translation: Elyo ulupwa lwakwa Yosefu baebele Yoshua abati, “Bushe cinshi watupeelela iciputulwa cimofye ica cakaniko ca cishilano panuma yakupendula? Ifwe tuli bengi nganshi kabili Yawe alitupaala.”

english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
translation: Nao Yoshua epakubasuka ati, “Imwe nga cakuti muli bengi nganshi, ne calo cakwa Efulemu ica mu mpili naco nacicepesha kukwikalamo, imwe mufwilefye ukuya mu mutengo no kwamba ukuwamya mwe bene apakwikala mu calo ca bena Perisi na bena Refaimu.”

english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
translation: Elyo ulupwa lwakwa Yosefu nalo lwayaswike aluti, “Awe mukwai, icalo ca mpili ifwe teti citukumane, kabili abantu bonse abena Kenani abekala mu cinika bonse balikwata amaceleta ya fyela bonse abekala mu Beti Shani na mu mishi yauko mumbali, elyo na bonse abaikala mwishika lya Yesireli.”

english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
translation: Elyo Yoshua aebele aba ŋanda yakwa Yosefu ukufika ku ba ŋanda yakwa Efulemu na Manase ati, “Icine cine imwe muli bengi nganshi kabili aba maka nganshi. Tamwakakwatefye iciputulwa icapendwilwe cimo iyoo,

english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
translation: lelo icalo ica mpili naco cili nokuba cenu. Nangu cabamo imiti nomba ciwamyenifye, cili nokuba icakaniko ca cishilano cenu, ukufika na ku mipaka yakutali, cikaba cenu nangufye abena Kenani bengakwata amaceleta ya fyela no kuba abakosa. Kuti mwabatamfyamo.”

english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
translation: Kanshi abana abaume bambi abakwa Manase nabo bapeelwe impanga umwabela indupwa shabo: Abana bakwa Abiesa, na bakwa Heleki, na bakwa Asirieli, na bakwa Shekemu, na bakwa Heferi pamo pene na bakwa Shemida. Aba e bana baume bakwa Manase mwana Yosefu ukulingana ne ndupwa shabo.

english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translation: Nomba Selofeadi umwana mwaume wakwa Heferi mwana Gileadi, mwana Makiri, nao uwali umwana mwaume wakwa Manase, wena takwetepo abana abaume lelo alifye na bana abanakashi beka beka. Aba bana abanakashi amashina yabo yali ni Mala, Nao, Hogila, Milika elyo na Tisa.

english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
translation: Awe bonse baile kuli shimapepo Eleasa na Yoshua mwana Nuni elyo na ku ntungulushi no kuyatila, “Yawe alikonkomeshe Mose ukutupeelako icakaniko ca cishilano pamo na bandume shesu.” Eico Yoshua nao alibapeele icakaniko ca cishilano ukulinganafye na bandume shabo muli wishi umo, ukulingana ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe.

english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
translation: Kanshi abena Manase bapeelwe ifiputulwa ikumi limo ifya calo ukwabula ukubikako icalo ca Gileadi ne ca Bashani ifyabela kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani.

english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
translation: Pantu bamwana Manase abanakashi aba mu luko lwakwe balipeelweko icakaniko ca cishilano pamo ne ndume shabo. Eico kanshi icalo ca Gileadi icasheleko naco cali ca bana bambi abasheleko abakwa Manase.

english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
translation: Icalo cakwa Manase catampile ukufuma ku Asheri no kuya fika ku Mikimetati icali ku kabanga ka Shekemu. Umupaka walalenye ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kuso ukuya kuminkanyako na bekashi ba mu Eni Tapua.

english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
translation: Manase akwete icalo ca Tapua, lelo umusumba wine uwa Tapua mu mupaka wakwa Manase wali wa bena Efulemu.

english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
translation: Elyo kabili umupaka watwalilile ukulola ku kapinda ka kulyo ku mumana wa Kana. Uku nako kwaliko imisumba iya bena Efulemu iyashintene ne misumba ya bena Manase, lelo umupaka wa bena Manase wakonkele ku kapinda ka ku kuso aka mumana no kuya pelela kuli bemba.

english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
translation: Kabili ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli lwalongene ku Shilo no kwimika Itenti lyakukumaninamo kulya kwine, pantu icalo cali mu maboko yabo.

english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
translation: Yoshua nao epakubapendwilako mu Shilo pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Elyo ayakenye ne calo ku bena Israeli ukulingana nomo inko shabo shabelele.

english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
translation: Icitungu icakubalilapo icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Benjamini, umwabelele indupwa shabo. Icalo babapeele cali pakati ka nko sha Bayuda ne shakwa Yosefu.

english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
translation: Ku kapinda ka ku kuso umupaka watampila ku mumana wa Yordani, wapitilila ukuya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ku mutentemuko wa Yeriko no kulola ku masamba ku calo ca mpili, kabili waisa tuntukila ku matololo ya Beti Afeni.

english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
translation: Ukufuma uku, umupaka wayabukila ku kapinda ka ku kulyo no kutentemukila ku Lusi, emukutila Betele, no kuya lwa panshi ku Ataloti Ada elyo na ku lupili lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo mwishika lya Beti Horoni.

english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
translation: Ukufuma pa lupili ulwalungatana na Beti Horoni lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, umupaka washokele ku kapinda ka ku kuso lwa ku masamba no kutuntukila ku Kiriati Bali, emukutila Kiriati Yarimu, umusumba wa bana bakwa Yuda. Kanshi e lubali lwa ku masamba.

english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
translation: Lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, umupaka watampile pa mpela ya Kiriati Yarimu, ukuya ku masamba. Kabili umupaka waisa tuntukila ku kamfukumfuku ka menshi ya Nefutoa.

english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
translation: Umupaka kabili waikila ku mutentemuko wa lupili ukulungatana no mupokapoka wa Beni Hinomu, ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwishilya lye shika lya Refaimu. Kabili watwalilile ukuya panshi ya mupokapoka wa Hinomu, ukukonkafye umutentemuko wa musumba wa Yebusi no kuya shinta ku Eni Rogeli.

english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
translation: Walola ku kapinda ka ku kuso no kuya ku Eni Shemeshi, watuntukila ku Geliloti iyalungatana no mupokapoka wa Adumimu no kupitilila ukuya ku Cilibwe cakwa Boani, mwana Rubeni.

english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
translation: Kabili walambata Beti Araba ku kapinda ka ku kuso no kutentemukila panshi ku Araba.

english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
translation: Elyo kabili umupaka walolele ku mutentemuko wa ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwa Beti Hogila no kutuntukila kuli Bemba Wamucele ku kapinda ka ku kuso, pa mawilo ya mumana wa Yordani ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Uyu ewali umupaka wa calo cabo uwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
translation: Kuli ilya ncende kwashele aba nko cine lubali isha bena Israeli abashali tabalapeelwako icakaniko ca cishilano cabo.

english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
translation: Umumana wa Yordani nao ewali e mupaka lubali lwa ku kabanga. Iyi e mipaka ya luko lwakwa Benjamini umwabela indupwa shabo ukulingana no mwapelele imipaka ukushinguluka.

english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
translation: Nomba imisumba ya luko lwakwa Benjamini umwabelele ndupwa shabo yali ni Yeriko, Beti Hogila, Emeki Kesis,

english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
translation: Beti Araba, Semaraimu, Betele,

english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
translation: Afimu, Pala, Ofala,

english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
translation: Kefa Amoni, Ofini na Geba. Imisumba yali ikumi limo na ibili ne mishi yaiko.

english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
translation: Kabili Gibeoni, Rama, Beloti,

english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
translation: Misipa, Kefila, Mosa,

english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
translation: Rekemu, Ilipeli, Tala,

english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
translation: Sela, Aelefa, no musumba wa Yebusi, emukutila Yerusalemu, Gibea na Kiriati. Imisumba yali ikumi limo na ine, elyo ne mishi yaiko. Ici ecali icakaniko ca cishilano ca bamwana Benjamini ne mikowa yabo.

english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
translation: Eico Yoshua atile ku bena Israeli, “Bushe mukafika lilali mukupembela ilyo mukatampa ukupoka icalo ico Yawe, Lesa wa bashinwe, amupeela?

english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
translation: Kanshi saleni ukufuma muli cila luko abantu batatu, pakuti mbatume bakaye pitana mu calo conse mukuya lemba ifyo caba nefyo bali nokucakana. Elyo nomba bali nokubwelela kuli ine.

english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
translation: Mulingile ukwakanya icalo mu fiputulwa cine lubali. Icalo cakwa Yuda cili nokushala filya fine ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, elyo aba ŋanda yakwa Yosefu nabo bakaba mu calo cabo icabela ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
translation: Panuma yakulemba bwino bwino iyi mipaka cine lubali ya ici calo, mukalete kuli ine elyo na ine nkamupendwilako pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wesu.

english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
translation: Pantu abena Levi bena tabakapeelweko iciputulwa ca muli ici calo cenu, pa mulandu wakuti bena icakaniko ca cishilano cabo, ca bushimapepo bwakubombela Yawe. Kabili Gadi, Rubeni, elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bena balipokelela kale icakaniko ca cishilano cabo ku lubali lwa ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani. Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe ewabapeele ici calo.”

english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”
translation: Awe abaume baya mukulengula icalo ico Yoshua abebele ukuyako ati, “Kabiyeni no kuya pitana mu calo elyo no kulemba ifyo muli nokuya sanga muli ici calo. Elyo mukabwele kuli ine. Kabili ine nkalamupendwilako kuno kwine ku Shilo pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
translation: Nabo abantu epakwima no kulapitana mu calo conse. Kabili balembele mu citabo fyonse ifyo basangile mu musumba no musumba, mu fiputulwa cine lubali. Babwelelemo na kuli Yoshua ku nkambi ku Shilo

english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
translation: Icitungu cabubili icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Simeoni, umwabelele indupwa shabo. Icalo ca cakaniko ca cishilano cabo cali pakati ka calo ca bamwana Yuda.

english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
translation: Icitungu cabutatu icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Sebuloni, umwabelele indupwa shabo. Umupaka wa cakaniko ca cishilano cabo waile fikafye na ku Salidi.

english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
translation: Ukuya lwa ku masamba, umupaka wailefika ku Malala wayaikata Dabesheti no kupalamina mupepi no mumana wa Yokineamu.

english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
translation: Waishile yalukila na ku kabanga, ukufuma ku Salidi uko akasuba katulila ukuya fika ku calo ca Kisiloti Tabo no kupitilila ukuya ku Dabelati ukufikafye na ku Yafiya.

english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
translation: Kabili watwalilile ukuya ku kabanga, mpakafye na ku Gati Heferi ku Eti Kasini, uyu mupaka watuntukile Palimoni no kwalukila ku Nea.

english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
translation: Kulya nako umupaka washokela ku kapinda ka ku kuso ku Hanatoni, wapelela na kwishilya lya Ifitaeli.

english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
translation: Imisumba iyalundilweko ni Katati, Nahalali, Shimuroni, Idala elyo na Betelemu. Kwali ne misumba ikumi limo na ibili pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
translation: Iyi misumba ne mishi yaiko eyali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca bana bakwa Sebuloni, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
translation: Icitungu cabune icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Isaka umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
translation: Icalo cabo cafikile ku Yesireli elyo no kulundapo na imbi misumba yabikilweko ni Kesuloti, Shunemu,

english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
translation: Afalaimu, Shioni, Anahalati,

english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
translation: Casanshisheko na Beresheba, nangu Sheba, Molada,

english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
translation: Rabiti, Kishioni, Ebesi,

english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
translation: Remeti, Eni Ganimu, Eni Hada na Beti Pasesi.

english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
translation: Umupaka wapitile ku Tabo, Shahasuma na Beti Shemeshi no kuya pelela ku mumana wa Yordani. Muli ici calo mwali imisumba ikumi limo na mutanda (16) pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
translation: Neyi misumba pamo ne mishi yaiko efyali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca luko lwakwa Isaka, umwabela indupwa shabo.

english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
translation: Icitungu cabusano icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Asheri, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
translation: Icalo cabo calundilweko ne misumba na imbi: Helikati, Hali, Beteni, Akishafu,

english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
translation: Alameleki, Amadi elyo na Mishali. Ku masamba umupaka wafikile ku Kameli na mu mumana wa Shioli Libinati.

english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
translation: Kabili umupaka washokele ku kabanga ku Beti Dagoni, waya fika ku Sebuloni na kwishika lya Ifitaeli no kulungama ku kapinda ka ku kuso ukulungatana na Beti Emeki na Neyele, ukupitilila pa Kabuli iyabela ku kuso.

english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
translation: Imila 4:28-33

english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
translation: Kabili uyu mupaka wabwelulukile ku Rama no kuya ku musumba we linga lya Turi no kushokela ku Hosa, waya tuntukila kuli bemba . Mu mupaka mwali na Mahalebu, Akisibi,

english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
translation: Hasa Shuali, Bala, Esemu,

english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
translation: Uma, Afeki na Rehobi. Imisumba yali amakumi yabili na ibili (22) pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
translation: Iyi misumba ne mishi yaiko eyali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca luko lwakwa Asheri, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
translation: Icitungu ca mutanda icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Naftali, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
translation: Umupaka wa calo cabo wafumine ku Helefi na pa cimuti icikulu nganshi ica oki icali mu Sananimu, wapita mu Adami Nekebi na Yabineli ukufika ku Lakumu no kuya shinta ku mumana wa Yordani.

english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
translation: Umupaka walungeme ku masamba ukupita mu Asinoti Tabo no kutuntukila ku Hukoki. Waisa lambata Sebuloni ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, Asheri nao ku masamba, waisa pelela pa Yuda lwa ku mumana wa Yordani wabela ku kabanga.

english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
translation: Elyo imisumba ya malinga nayo yali ni Sidimu, Seli, Hamati, Rakati, Kinereti,

english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
translation: Adama, Rama, Haso,

english: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
translation: Kedeshi, Edilei, Eni Haso,

english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
translation: Iloni, Migidali Eli, Horemu, Beti Anati elyo na Beti Shemeshi. Imisumba yali ikumi limo na pabula (29) pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
translation: Iyi misumba ne mishi yaiko yali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca luko lwakwa Naftali, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
translation: Elitoladi, Betihuri, Homa,

english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
translation: Icitungu calenga cine lubali icapendwilwe capeelwe ku luko lwakwa Dani, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
translation: Icalo ca cakaniko ca cishilano cabo calundilweko ne misumba na imbi: Sora, Eshitaoli, Ili Shemeshi,

english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
translation: Shalabini, Aiyaloni, Yefila,

english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
translation: Eloni, Timuna Ekironi,

english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
translation: Eliteke, Kibetoni, Baalati,

english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
translation: Yehudi, Bene Beraki, Gati Rimoni,

english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
translation: Me Yakoni na Rakoni, ne ncende yonse iyalungatene na Yopa.

english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
translation: Nomba abena Dani balishombweke pakupoka icalo cabo, eico baile lwisha Leshemu baipaya na bantu abalimo, no kwikala emo balaikala. Baikele muli uyu musumba no kwalula ishina lya uyu musumba bawinika na Dani, nge shina lya kwibukishishapo Dani icikolwe cabo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
translation: Iyi e misumba ne mishi yaiko iyali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca luko lwakwa Dani, umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.
translation: Ilyo bapwile ukwakanya icalo mufitungu mufitungu, abena Israeli bapeele Yoshua mwana Nuni icakaniko ca cishilano pakati kabo,

english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
translation: Sikilagi, Beti Makaboti, Hasa Susa,

english: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
translation: pamo ngefyo Yawe abakonkomeshe ukucita. Bamupeele umusumba uo umwine aipwishe. Noyu musumba wali ni Timunati Sera, mu calo ca mpili ca bena Efulemu, emo akuulile umusumba alaikalamo.

english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
translation: Kanshi ifi e fyalo ifyo Eleasa shimapepo, Yoshua mwana Nuni ne ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha nko sha bena Israeli bayakenye ifitungu mu Shilo, panuma yakupendula pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa mwinshi we Tenti lyakukumaninamo. Kabili apa pene epapwilile ukwakanya icalo ici.

english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
translation: Beti Labaoti na Shaluheni. Imisumba yali ikumi limo na itatu (13) pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
translation: Imisumba na imbi ni Aini, Rimoni, Eta na Ashani. Imisumba yali ine, pamo ne mishi yaiko.

english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
translation: Elyo imishi yonsefye iyashinguluka iyi misumba ukufikafye na ku Baalati Bele na Rama mu Negebu. Kanshi ici e cakaniko ca cishilano ca luko lwakwa Simeoni umwabelele indupwa shabo.

english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
translation: Icalo ca cakaniko ca cishilano ca bamwana Simeoni caputwilwe ukufuma ku calo ca bana bakwa Yuda, pantu icalo ca bana bakwa Yuda calicilile kufyo bali nokukwata. Eico abana bakwa Simeoni bapeelwe icakaniko cabo mulya mwine mukati ka calo cakwa Yuda.

english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
translation: Panuma ya mfwa yakwa Mose, umubomfi wakwa Yawe, Yawe aebele Yoshua umwana mwaume wakwa Nuni, kafwa wakwa Mose, ati,

english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
translation: Elyo Yoshua apeele icipope kuli bacilolo ba bantu ati,

english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess.’”
translation: “Pitaneni monse mu nkambi no kweba abantu bonse ukuti, ‘Mupekanye ifyakulya, pantu kwashalafye inshiku shitatu ninshi mwayabuka umumana wa Yordani no kuya poka icalo ico Yawe Lesa wenu amupeela ukuba icalo cenu.’”

english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,
translation: Lelo ku bena Rubeni na bena Gadi kabili na citika wa luko lwa bena Manase, Yoshua atile,

english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.
translation: “Ibukisheni amashiwi ayo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe amukonkomeshe ayakuti, ‘Yawe Lesa wenu, nimwe akapeela iyi mpanga no kutuusha emo mukalatuusha.’

english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them
translation: Abakashi benu, abana benu ne fitekwa fyonse fili nokushala mu mpanga iyo Mose apeele kuli imwe iya ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka mumana wa Yordani. Lelo kuli imwe bonse mwe babulwi abaume, mwe baipangasha ifyanso fyakulwilako, nimwe mufwile ukubalilapo ukwabuka umumana, ilyo bamunyinenwe tabalati babuke. Nimwe mufwile ukubafwilishako,

english: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”
translation: mpakafye nabo bene Yawe akabapeele ukutuusha, ngefyo acita kuli imwe. Nabo bene bakapoke icalo ico Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokubapeela. Elyo panuma ya ifyo, muli nokubwelelamo no kuya ikala mu calo cenu, ico Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe amupeele lwa ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani, ukufumina akasuba.”

english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
translation: Nabo bayasuka Yoshua abati, “Conse ico watukonkomesha ukucita, twakulacita, kabili konse uko watutuma ukuya twakulaya.

english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
translation: Twakulakubeela pamo ngefyo twalebeela Mose. Cikulufye, Yawe Lesa obe aleba na iwe nga filya fine aleba na Mose.

english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”
“Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.
translation: “Umubomfi wandi Mose nafwa. Eico kanshi nomba ima, iwe na bantu aba bonse, ipekanyeni mwabuke umumana wa Yordani no kuya mu calo ico nalapeela abena Israeli.

english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
translation: Ndi nokumupeela icifulo conse apo mukanyanta amakasa yenu, pamo ngefyo nalaile Mose.

english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
translation: Icalo cenu cikatampila ukufuma ku matololo ukufika na ku Lebanoni, kabili ukufuma ku mumana ukalamba uwa Yufurate, ne calo conse ca bena Hiti, mpaka no kufika kuli bemba mukalamba uwabela ku kapinda ka ku masamba.

english: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
translation: Takuli nangu umo uukaba na maka yakukulwisha, mu nshiku shonse isha mweo obe. Pamo nga filya fine naleba na Mose, efyo nakulaba na iwe. Nshakatale nkusha weka nangufye panono, lelo nkalaba na iwe lyonsefye.

english: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
translation: Amaf 31:6

english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
translation: Eico, kosafye kabili ushipe nganshi, ulekonka no kubeela bwino bwino amafunde yonse ayo umubomfi wandi Mose akukonkomeshe. Tecakwesha ukubwelela inuma, nangufye ukwalukila ku kulyo nangu ku kuso, epakuti ukaleshuka muli fyonse ifyo ukalacita konse uko waya.

english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
translation: Tecakwesha ukulaba icitabo ca Mafunde ukuti cikalefuma pa kanwa kobe. Lelo ukaletontonkanyapo akasuba no bushiku, epakuti ulekonka bwino fyonse ifyalembwamo. Elyo lyena ukashuka mufyo ukalabomba no kufikilisha bwino mu milimo ukalabomba.

english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
translation: Bushe nshikukonkomeshe? Iwe ukosefye kabili ube uwashipa? Tecakwesha ukuba no mwenso. Kabili tecakwesha ukubwelela inuma, pantu Yawe Lesa obe akulaba na iwe konse uko wakulaya.”

english: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Yoshua ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,
translation: “Eba abena Israeli ukuti basale imisumba yakufisamamo pamo ngefyo namukonkomeshe ukupitila muli Mose.

english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
translation: Emukutila umuntu onse uwaipaya umuntu munankwe mukukanaishiba nangu mukupumbilafye, eko ali nokufulumukila kukupusuka ku bantu abalefwaya icilandushi ca mulopa.

english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.
translation: Ilyo uyu muntu afulumukila kuli umo uwa muli iyi misumba, alingile aya iminina pa mpongolo ya musumba no kutuula umulandu onse kuli bacilolo ba musumba. Elyo lyena bali nokumusuminisha ukwingila mu musumba wabo no kumupeela icifulo apo ali nokulaikala nabo.

english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.
translation: Lelo uwacilandushi ca mulopa nga amusupila nalyo line bacilolo tabafwile kumulekelamo, pantu aipeye umwina mupalamano wakwe mukukanaishiba, kabili tapali lupato pakati kabo iyoo.

english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
translation: Kanshi epakusonta umusumba wa Kedeshi mu Galile mu calo ca mpili cakwa Naftali, Shekemu mu calo ca mpili cakwa Efulemu, na Kiriati Ariba emukutila Hebuloni mu calo ca mpili cakwa Yuda.

english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
translation: Lubali lwa ku kabanga ka mumana wa Yordani apalungatana na Yeriko basonteleko umusumba wa Besa uwaba mu matololo mu calo cabatama uwa mu luko lwakwa Rubeni, Ramoti mu Gileadi mu luko lwakwa Gadi, na Golani mu Bashani mu luko lwakwa Manase.

english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.
translation: Kanshi umuntu onse umwina Israeli nangufye umwinafyalo uo baleikala pamo nabo, uwaipaya umuntu mukukanaishiba, afwile afulumukila kuli iyi ine misumba yasontwa pakuti bemwipaya ku bantu abalefwaya ukulandula pa muntu wabo uo aipeye, kabili akwate ne nshita yakwiminina kukupingulwa ne cintubwingi.

english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
translation: Elyo intungulushi sha ndupwa shakwa Levi shaile kuli shimapepo Eleasa, Yoshua mwana Nuni na ku ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha nko sha bena Israeli.

english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
translation: Iyi misumba yapeelwe ku ba lupwa lwakwa Aroni, abafumine ku mikowa yakwa Koati uwa mu bena Levi, pantu ukupendula kwantanshi ebo kwawilile.

english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.
translation: Babapeele Kiriati Ariba, emukutila Hebuloni, pamo ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo mu calo ca mpili icakwa Yuda. Ariba ali e wishi wakwa Anaki.

english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
translation: Lelo amabala ne mishi iyashingulwike umusumba, fyena fyapeelwe kuli Kalebu mwana Yefune ukuti cibe icuma cakwe.

english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,
translation: Eico kanshi aba lupwa lwakwa shimapepo Aroni nabo bapeelwe Hebuloni umusumba wakufisamamo ku muntu uo batila naipaya umubiye, pamo na Libina,

english: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
translation: Yatiri, Eshitemoa,

english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
translation: Holoni, Debi,

english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.
translation: Aini, Yuta elyo na Beti Shemeshi, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Imisumba yali pabula ukufumya kuli ishi nko shibili.

english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Benjamini nako babapeeleko Gibeoni, Geba,

english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Anatoti elyo na Alimoni, ukusanshako ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
translation: Kanshi imisumba yonse iya bashimapepo, aba lupwa lwakwa Aroni, yali ikumi limo na itatu, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo.

english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”
translation: Baya ku Shilo mu Kenani no kutila kuli bena, “Yawe akonkomeshe ukupitila muli Mose ukuti, ‘Muli nokutupeelako imisumba yakwikalamo, umuli ifitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyesu, nge cakaniko ca cishilano cesu.’”

english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translation: Kabili imikowa iyasheleko iyakwa Koati iya bena Levi yapeelwe ifitungu fya misumba fyapendwilwe ukufuma ku ncende ya luko lwakwa Efulemu.

english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
translation: Mu calo ca mpili icakwa Efulemu, bapeelwemo umusumba wa Shekemu, umusumba wakufisamamo ku muntu uo batila naipaya umubiye, elyo na Gesa,

english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Kibisaimu na Beti Horoni, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
translation: Kabili ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Dani bapeelwe Eliteke, Gibetoni,

english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Aiyaloni na Gati Rimoni pamo ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
translation: Ukufuma kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bapeelwe Tanaki na Gati Rimoni, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ibili.

english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
translation: Kanshi yonse imisumba iyi ikumi limo ne fitungu fyonse ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo yalipeelwe ku mikowa iyasheleko iyakwa Koati.

english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
translation: Kabili imikowa ya bena Levi abakwa Geshoni nabo bapeelwe ukufuma kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, Golani mu Bashani, umusumba wakufisamamo ku muntu uo batila naipaya umubiye, na Beshitera, pamo pene ne fitungu fyonse ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ibili.

english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Isaka nako bapeelweko Kishoni, Dabelati,

english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Yamuti na Eni Ganimu, pamo pene ne fitungu fyonse ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakupeelako abena Levi imisumba elyo ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa ukufuma mu fyakaniko fyabo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe.

english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Asheri nako bapeelweko Mishali, Abidoni,

english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Helikati na Rehobi, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Naftali nako bapeelweko Kedeshi wa ku Galile, umusumba wakufisamamo ku muntu uo batila naipaya umubiye, Hamoti Dori elyo na Katani, pamo pene ne fitungu fyonse ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali itatu.

english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
translation: Kanshi imisumba yonse iya mikowa yakwa Geshoni yali ikumi limo na itatu, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo.

english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
translation: Kabili imikowa ya bena Melali iyasheleko ku bena Levi nayo yapeelwe ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Sebuloni imisumba ya Yokineamu, Kata,

english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Dimuna elyo Naalali, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Rubeni, nako bapeelweko imisumba ya Besa, Yahasi,

english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
translation: Kedemoti na Mefati, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali ine.

english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
translation: Ukufuma ku luko lwakwa Gadi, nako bapeelweko Ramoti mu Gileadi, umusumba wakufisamamo ku muntu uo batila naipaya umubiye, Manaimu,

english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.
translation: Heshiboni na Yaseri, pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo. Iyi misumba yali yonse pamo ine.

english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
translation: Icantanshi bacitile, bapendwile pakwishiba ifitungu bali nokupeela abena Koati, umwabelele indupwa shabo. Abena Levi abali balupwa bakwa Aroni shimapepo bapeelwe icitungu ca misumba ikumi limo na itatu, ukufumya ku nko shakwa Yuda, Simeoni na Benjamini.

english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
