translation: Yonse imisumba iyapeelwe ku mikowa yakwa Melali abasheleko ku bena Levi yali imisumba ikumi limo na ibili.

english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
translation: Eico kanshi, imisumba ya bena Levi iyali mu calo ca bena Israeli yali yonse pamo amakumi yane na cine konse konse (48), pamo pene ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo.

english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.
translation: Cila musumba waliikwatile incende iyashinguluka iyakucemenamo ifitekwa. Kanshi ifi fine efyo cali ku misumba iyi yonse.

english: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
translation: Efyo Yawe apeele icalo conse ku bena Israeli, ico alapile ukupeela kuli bashibo, kabili nabo balibuulile ici calo no kulaikalamo.

english: The LORD gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
translation: Kabili Yawe alekele ukuti baletuusha mu nshilafye shonse, pamo ngefyo alapile kuli bashibo. Takwatalile akuba umuntu nangu umo uwa mu balwani babo uwakubemina, pantu Yawe alipeele bonse abalwani babo mu minwe yabo.

english: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
translation: Pa fintu fyonse ifisuma ifyo Yawe alaile aba ŋanda yakwa Israeli tapashele nangu cimo icishafikilishiwe. Fyonse fyalifikilishiwe.

english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translation: Lelo bonse aba lupwa lwakwa Koati abasheleko, bena bapeelwe ifitungu fya misumba ikumi limo, ukufumya ku mikowa ya nko shakwa Efulemu, Dani elyo na kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase.

english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
translation: Aba lupwa lwakwa Geshoni nabo bapeelwe ifitungu fya misumba ikumi limo na itatu, ukufumya ku mikowa ya nko shakwa Isaka, Asheri, Naftali, elyo na kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase mu Bashani.

english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
translation: Ku ba lupwa lwakwa Melali nabo, umwabelele indupwa shabo, bapeelwe imisumba ikumi limo na ibili ukufumya ku nko shakwa Rubeni, Gadi na Sebuloni.

english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo abena Israeli bapeele ifitungu fya misumba ku bena Levi pamo pene ne fitungu fyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe ukupitila muli Mose.

english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
translation: Ukufumafye ku nko shakwa Yuda na Simeoni bapeele ifitungu fya misumba iyi mu mashina.

english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
translation: Elyo Yoshua aitile abena Rubeni, abena Gadi elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase,

english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.
translation: Ilyo bafikile ku Geliloti mupepi no mumana wa Yordani mu calo ca Kenani, abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bakuulile ubulambo ubukulu nganshi mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Yordani.

english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”
translation: Nomba ilyo abena Israeli baumfwile ukuti, abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase nabakuula ubulambo mu mupaka wa calo ca Kenani ku Gililoti mupepi no mumana wa Yordani, ku lubali lwa bena Israeli banabo,

english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.
The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.
translation: Elintu abena Israeli batumine Fineasi mwana Eleasa, shimapepo, ku calo ca Gileadi ku bena Rubeni, ku bena Gadi elyo na kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase.

english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.
translation: Batumine pamo ne ntungulushi ikumi limo, intungulushi imo imo ukufuma mu ba nko sha bena Israeli.

english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,
translation: Awe ilyo baile ku Gileadi ku bena Rubeni, ku bena Gadi elyo na kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, batile kuli bena,

english: “The whole congregation of the LORD says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against the LORD?
translation: “Lonse ulukuta lwakwa Yawe nalututuma mukumweba ukuti, ‘Bushe imwe, ubu busangu bwakusangukila Lesa wakwa Israeli bwalola mwi? Bushe kuti mwabwelela shani kunuma ukufuma kuli Yawe no kuikuulila mwe bene ubulambo bwakusangukila Lesa ilelo?

english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD,
translation: Bushe ububifi twabifishe ku Peori ubo tatulaisangululako ukufika no bwa lelo, tebukulu? Nelyo kwaliponene icikuko pa lukuta lwakwa Yawe,

english: that you must turn away today from following the LORD? It will be, since you rebel today against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
translation: bushe na imwe ilelo muletaluka kukukonka Yawe? Nga mwasangukila Yawe ilelo, mailo ubukali bwakwe buli nokuba pa lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli.

english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than the LORD our God’s altar.
translation: Nga cakutila icalo mwakwata cintu cakowela, isenifye tuleikala nenu bonse pamo mu calo umwaba Itenti lyakwa Yawe. Lelo tamufwile ukusangukila Yawe nangu nifwe bene, mukuikuulila ubulambo, ukucila pa bulambo bwakwa Yawe, Lesa wesu.

english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
translation: no kubeba ati, “Imwe namubomba bwino fyonse ifyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe amukonkomeshe, kabili mwalinakila ine muli fyonse ifyo namukonkomeshe ukucita.

english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”
Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
translation: Elyo abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bayaswike no kweba intungulushi sha nko shakwa Israeli abati,

english: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against the LORD (don’t save us today),
translation: “Uwamakafye, Lesa, Yawe! Uwamakafye, Lesa, Yawe! Alishiba! Kabili na Israeli wine lekeni eshibe! Nga cakutifye twacitile ifi mukusangukila Yawe, nangu mukukanabeela Yawe, awe mwishapofye nangu umo, tulofyeni bonse ilelo line.

english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let the LORD himself require it.
translation: Nga cakutila twaikuulila ubu bulambo mukufuma ku cinso cakwa Yawe no kulatuula umutuulo wa cakoca nangu mituulo ya cabunga, nangu umutuulo wakwampana, nangu umutuulo wamutende, natukande.

english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?
translation: Iyo, ifwe twakuulile ubulambo mukutiina ukuti bushiku bumo indupwa shenu bali nokwipusha indupwa shesu ukuti, ‘Bushe lubali nshi mwakweteko kuli Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli?

english: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
translation: Yawe apanga umumana wa Yordani, ukuba umupaka pakati kesu elyo na imwe, imwe mwe bena Rubeni na bena Gadi! Ala imwe tamukwete icakaniko muli Yawe.’ Eico indupwa shenu imwe kuti shaisa lenga indupwa shesu ukuleka ukukwata akatiina kuli Yawe.

english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;
translation: Kanshi ici cine, ecalengele twasosele ukuti, ‘Natuipekanye, natukuule ubulambo.’ Ubu bulambo tabwali bwafye lambo lya cakoca, nangu amalambo yambi iyoo.

english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in the LORD.’
translation: Lelo ku lubali lumbi kuti twatila, ici cili nokuba e kambone wa pakati kesu na imwe, elyo ne nkulo ishili nokulatukonkapo. Nokuti ifwe tuli nokulapepafye Yawe mwi Tenti lyakwe na malambo ya cakoca, amalambo yambi elyo no mutuulo wakwampana. Elyo lyena kuntanshi indupwa shenu tashakabe ishakusosa ku ndupwa shesu ukuti, ‘Imwe tamukwete icakaniko kuli Yawe.’

english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of the LORD’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’
translation: Eico twatile, ‘Nga cakuti baisa sosa ifi kuli ifwe, nangufye ku ndupwa shesu ishikatukonkapo, tuli nokubasuka ukutila, “Moneni ici cikulwa ca bulambo bwakwa Yawe, ico bashifwe bakuulile, teca mutuulo wa cakoca nangu amalambo, lelo nga cikambone pakati kesu elyo na imwe.” ’

english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn away today from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides the LORD our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”
translation: Cakutali nganshi ukufuma kuli ifwe ukusangukila Yawe no kubwelela inuma mu bushiku bwa lelo mukukuula ubulambo bwa malambo ya cakoca, imituulo ya cabunga elyo na malambo yambi, ukucila pa bulambo bwakwa Yawe Lesa wesu, ubwaba mu cifulo camushilo mwi Tenti lyakwe.”

english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God.
translation: Pa nshita iyitali nganshi, ukufika na pa kalelo line, tamwatala amulekelesha bamunyinenwe, lelo imwe mwalebombafye imilimo Yawe, Lesa wenu, apeele kuli imwe.

english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.
translation: Nomba ilyo Fineasi shimapepo na bacilolo ba lukuta lwa bena Israeli abali e ntungulushi mu mikowa ya bena Israeli baumfwile ifyo abena Rubeni, abena Gadi elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase basosele, awe balitemenwe.

english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD’s hand.”
translation: Kabili Fineasi mwana Eleasa, shimapepo, atile ku bena Rubeni, ku bena Gadi na ku bena Manase, “Ilelo twaishiba ukuti Yawe ali pakati kesu, pantu imwe tamwasangukila Yawe mu micitile yenu. Moneni nomba namupususha abena Israeli ku bukali bwakwa Yawe.”

english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
translation: Elyo Fineasi mwana Eleasa shimapepo pamo ne ntungulushi babwelele ku Kenani ukufuma uko baile kukumona abena Rubeni na bena Gadi ku Gileadi no kuya fisha akasebo ku bena Israeli.

english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.
translation: Awe balitemenwe nganshi pakumfwa aka akasebo, kabili batashishe Lesa. Takwali kulandapo nakabili pa mulandu wa kubalwisha no kupoka icalo ico abena Rubeni na bena Gadi baleikalamo.

english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”
translation: Elyo abena Rubeni na bena Gadi bapeele ishina lya bulambo bakuulile abati, “Ni Bukambone pakati kesu ukuti Yawe e Lesa wine.”

english: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.
translation: Nomba Yawe, Lesa wenu, napeela bamunyinenwe ukutuusha pamo ngefyo alaile. Eico nomba bweleleni kumwenu mu calo ico Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe amupeele kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani.

english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
translation: Lelo mube abakusunga ifipope na mafunde Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe amupeele. Muletemwa Yawe Lesa wenu no kwenda mu nshila yakwe lyonse, no kulabeela ifipope fyakwe no kwikatisha ukumubombela no mutima wenu onse no mweo wenu onse.”

english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.
translation: Elyo Yoshua abapaalile no kubeba ukuti baleya, awe nabo baile na kumwabo.

english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,
translation: Kabili kuli citika wa luko lwakwa Manase, Mose apeele icalo cabo mu Bashani, elyo kuli citika ubiye Yoshua apeele icalo icabela ku masamba ya mumana wa Yordani muli bamunyina. Ilyo Yoshua abebele ukuti baleya, alibapaalile

english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”
translation: nokutila kuli bena, “Imwe bwelelenimo kumwenu ne fyuma ifingi nganshi, ifitekwa fya mikuni ya ŋombe, silifa, golide, umukuba, ifyela ifyamutengo elyo ne mitumba ya nsalu iyingi nganshi, elyo mwakanyeko bamunyinenwe ifintu fyonse ifyo mwatapile ku balwani benu.”

english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
translation: Awe abena Rubeni, abena Gadi elyo na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase bashile abena Israeli banabo ku Shilo mu calo ca Kenani no kubwelelamo ku Gileadi, ku calo cabo ico banonkele ukulingana nefyo Yawe akonkomeshe ukupitila muli Mose.

english: After many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,
translation: Palipitile inshita iyitali apo Yawe apeelele abena Israeli ukutuusha ukufuma ku balwani babo bonse ababashingulwike. Yoshua pali iyi nshita ninshi nakota, ne myaka yalisenselele nganshi.

english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
translation: Umo pali imwe kuti alwisha abalwani ikana limo, pantu Yawe Lesa wenu eumulwishishako, pamo ngefyo alaile.

english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.
translation: Eico kanshi mufwilefye ukusakamana nganshi ukutemwa Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;
translation: Lelo nga mwayalukila kumbi no kwampana na aba bantu abashala kuli iyi mishobo, nangu ukulaupana nabo,

english: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
translation: awe mulingile ukwishiba bwino ukuti Yawe, Lesa wenu, takatale afulumuna iyi mishobo kuntanshi yenu. Na mukukanacita ifyo, iyi mishobo ili nokuba inkose kabili ifiteyo fyenu, amembya yakumulopawilako mu numa shenu, kabili imyunga ya mu menso yenu, mpakafye mukasuke mukalobe ukufuma muli ici calo icisuma, ico Yawe Lesa wenu amupeela.

english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.
translation: “Nomba ine ndi mupepi no kuya mu nshila iyiyamo aba pano isonde bonse. Imwe namwishiba bwino mu mitima yenu kabili na mu bumi bwenu ukuti tapali nangufye cimo pa fintu ifisuma fyalaile Yawe, Lesa wenu, ifyo apeele kuli imwe icishafikilishiwa. Ubulayo bonsefye bwalifikilishiwe. Tapaba nangu cimo icafilikwa.

english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,
translation: Pamo ngefyo ifisuma fyonse Yawe Lesa wenu alaile fyaba ifyacine, efyo Yawe ali nokuleta pali imwe ububifi ubo amusokeleko, mpaka mukalobe bonse ukufuma muli ici calo icisuma apeela kuli imwe.

english: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then the LORD’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
translation: Naco nga mwaonaula icipangano cakwa Yawe, Lesa wenu, ico amukonkomeshe ukusunga, no kuya mukubombela imilungu imbi no kulaifukamina, lyena ubukali bwakwa Yawe buli nokumoca, kabili mukalobafye bwangu bwangu ukufuma mu calo ici icisuma ico amupeela.”

english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.
translation: Elyo Yoshua alonganike abena Israeli bonse, abakalamba pamo ne ntungulushi shabo, bakapingula wa milandu babo elyo na bashimucindikwa, no kubeba ati, “Ine ninkota kabili ninsenselela nganshi mu myaka.

english: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.
translation: Imwe mwe bene mwaliimwena na menso yenu ifintu fyonse ifyo Yawe, Lesa wenu, acita ku mishobo iyi yonse pa mulandu wenu. Ala ni Yawe, Lesa wenu, e walemulwilako.

english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
translation: Ibukisheni ukuti nimwakanya ifyalo ifi ifisheleko nge cakaniko ca cishilano ca nko shenu, pamo ne mishobo yonse intu nacimfishe ukufumafye ku mumana wa Yordani ukufika kuli Bemba Mukulu uwabela ukuwila akasuba.

english: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as the LORD your God spoke to you.
translation: Ala Yawe, Lesa wenu umwine ali nokubafulumuna ukufuma kuli imwe. Lesa ali nokubatalusha ku cinso cenu, epakuti mukapoke icalo cabo, pamo ngefyo Yawe Lesa wenu amulaile.

english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;
translation: Kanshi mube abakosa nganshi. Mube abasakamana nganshi ukubeela fyonse ifyalembwa mu citabo ca mafunde yakwa Mose, ukwabula ukwalukila lubali lwa ku kulyo nangu lwa ku kuso.

english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;
translation: Tecakwesha ukulaampana neyi mishobo iyo mwashala nayo pakati kenu. Tecakwesha nangufye panono ukulalumbula amashina ya milungu yabo, nangufye ilyo mulelapa. Tamufwile ukulaibombela, nangufye ukulaifukamina.

english: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
translation: Lelo mufwilefye ukushangila kuli Yawe Lesa wenu, pamo ngefyo mwaba na nombaline.

english: “For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.
translation: Pantu Yawe alifulumuna ku ntanshi yenu imishobo iyikalamba nganshi kabili iyamaka, ukufika nobwa lelo takwatala akuba nelyo umo uwamwansha.

english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
translation: Elyo Yoshua alongenye inko shonse isha bena Israeli ku Shekemu. Aitile abakalamba, intungulushi, bakapingula ba mulandu elyo na bacilolo ba bena Israeli no kwisa ituula abene ku cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
translation: Lelo ine nshaumfwile kuli Balamu, nao epakumupaala, na ine namupokolola na ku maboko yakwe.

english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
translation: Elyo mwayabwike umumana wa Yordani no kufika ku Yeriko. Abekashi ba mu musumba wa Yeriko balimulwishishe, pamo nge fyacitile abena Amoli, abena Perisi, abena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Girigashi, abena Hifi na bena Yebusi, lelo nalyo line nabapeele mu maboko yenu.

english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
translation: Nine natumine amalonda kukumutangilila, ayafulumwine imfumu shibili isha bena Amoli. Tamwailwishishe mwe bene ku lupanga lwenu nangu buta.

english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
translation: Eico ine, nalimupeele icalo ico mushaculile pamo pene ne misumba iyo mushaikuulile. Kabili emo mwikala no kulalya ifisabo fya myangashi, ne fya miolifa, ifyo mushalimbile.’”

english: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.

If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”
translation: Lelo ngo kubombela Yawe camoneka ukukosa kuli imwe, kanshi saleni mwe bene buno bwine ubushiku untu muli nokulabombela, nampo nga milungu ya fikolwe fyenu iyo fyabombele ilyo fyali kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani nangu imilungu ya bena Amoli, abo nomba imwe muleikala mu calo cabo. Lelo ine na ba mu ŋanda yandi, tulifye nokulabombela Yawe.”

english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
translation: Elyo abantu nabo bayaswike abati, “Awe, ifyo tefyo! Tatwakatale atusuula Yawe no kubombela imilungu imbi, nakalya!

english: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
translation: Pantu ni Yawe Lesa wesu umwine ewatufumishe pamo ne fikolwe fyesu mu calo ca Egupto, mu calo ca busha, kabili ewacitile ne fishibilo ifikulu nganshi ifyo twaimwenene na menso yesu. Ni Yawe ewaletucingilila pa lwendo lwesu lonse na mu mishobo yonse intu twalepitamo mu lwendo lwesu.

english: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”
translation: Kabili Yawe afulumwine yonse imishobo kuntanshi yesu, ukusanshakofye na bena Amoli, abali abene ba calo. Eico na ifwe bene tulifye nokulabombela Yawe, pantu ena e Lesa wesu.”

english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
translation: Elyo Yoshua aeba abantu ati, “Imwe mukafilwa ukubombela Yawe, pantu ena ni Lesa wamushilo. Ni Lesa wabufuba. Wena takamubelele uluse nga mwamusangukila no kulacita ububifi.

english: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.
translation: Awe Yoshua aeba abantu bonse ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, asosa ati, ‘Ukufumafye kale na kale, ifikolwe fyenu, ukubikakofye na Tera wishi wakwa Abrahamu na Naho, baikele kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate, kabili fyalepepa imilungu imbi.

english: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”
translation: Amaf 7:20

english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”
Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”
translation: Elyo Yoshua nao atile, “Nimwe mwe bene mwaibela bukambone ukuti namusala ukulabombela Yawe.” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ee tuli bakambone fwe bene.”

english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
translation: Elyo Yoshua abeba ati, “Kanshi nomba poseni ukutali imilungu imbi iyo mwaba nayo no kwimya imitima yenu kuli Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli.”

english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”
So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
translation: Na pa bushiku bwine bulya Yoshua acitile icipangano na bantu, kabili kulya kwine ku Shekemu apeele kuli bena ifipope elyo na mafunde.

english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
translation: Elyo Yoshua alembele aya mashiwi mu citabo ca mafunde yakwa Lesa. Epakubuula icilibwe icikulu nganshi acimika mwisamba lya cimuti ca oki, mupepi ne cifulo camushilo icakwa Yawe.

english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”
translation: Icite 11:27

english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
translation: Ukuf 23:28

english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
translation: Panuma ya ifi fintu, Yoshua mwana Nuni, umubomfi wakwa Yawe, alifwile ilyo ali ne myaka umwanda umo ne kumi limo.

english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.
translation: Lelo ine nabuulile shinwe Abrahamu, namufumya kwishilya lya mumana wa Yufurate no kumutungulula monse mu calo ca Kenani no kumupeela ulupwa ulwingi. Namupeela no mwana Isaki,

english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
translation: Elyo bamushiikile na mu calo cakwe icacishilano, ku Timunati Sera mu calo ca mpili shakwa Efulemu, ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka lupili lwa Gashi.

english: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.
translation: Abena Israeli babombele Yawe mu nshiku shonse ishakwa Yoshua, ne nshiku shonse isho intungulushi ishashele panuma ya mfwa yakwe shaikele pa calo, kabili ishaishibe bwino ifyo Yawe acitile abena Israeli.

english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
translation: Nomba amafupa yakwa Yosefu, ayo abena Israeli bafumishe ku Egupto, bayashiikile ku Shekemu mu mpanga iyo Yakobo ashitile ukulingana ne ndalama umwanda umo isha silifa, ukufuma kuli bamwana Hamori, wishi wakwa Shekemu. Ici nomba cali e cakaniko ca cishilano ca lupwa lwakwa Yosefu.

english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
translation: Kabili Eleasa mwana Aroni nao alifwile no kuya mushiika ku Gibea, ku musumba uwapeelwe ku mwana wakwe Fineasi, mu calo ca mpili cakwa Efulemu.

english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
translation: na Isaki nao namupeele abana bakwe Yakobo na Esau. Kabili napeele Esau icalo ca mpili ica Seiri, lelo Yakobo wena na bana baume bakwe baile ku calo ca Egupto.

english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
translation: Amaf 2:5

english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.
translation: Ilyo nafumishe ifikolwe fyenu mu Egupto, mwaishile kuli bemba. Abena Egupto basupile abafyashi benu na maceleta yabo, pamo na bali pali bakabalwe no kuya bafisha kuli Bemba Wakashika .

english: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
translation: Nabo bakuutile kuli Yawe pakuti abafwe, Yawe abikile imfifi pakati kenu elyo na bena Egupto. Elyo aletele amenshi pali bene no kubebisha. Kabili imwe mwaliimwenene na menso yenu ifyo nacitile ku bena Egupto. Na imwe mwaikele mu matololo pa nshita ikalamba.

english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
translation: Ilyo Balaki mwana Sipo, imfumu ya mu calo ca Moabu, atendeke ukulaiteyanya palwa kulwisha abena Israeli, atumine amashiwi kuli Balamu mwana Beori pakuti ese amulapishe.

english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.
translation: Kabili Yoshua umwana mwaume wakwa Nuni atumine mu bumfisolo inengu shibili ukufuma mu Shitimu no kusheba ati, “Kabiyeni, mumone icalo, makamaka ku musumba wa Yeriko.” Nabo baliile no kuya fikilila pa ŋanda ya mwanakashi umo uwali cilende ishina lyakwe Rahabu, epo balaikala.

english: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
translation: Twalyumfwa ifyo Yawe akamishe amenshi muli Bemba Wakashika, ilyo mwafumine mu calo ca Egupto. Twalyumfwa nefyo mwacitile kuli Sihoni pamo na Ogi, imfumu shibili isha bena Amoli, kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani, abo imwe mwapeele kukonaulwa mukubalofya nakalya nakalya.

english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.
translation: Eico ilyo twaumfwile ifi, awe ne mitima yesu yalifumine, kabili pali ifwe tapali nelyo umo uwashele uwashipa. Pantu Yawe, Lesa wenu, e Lesa mu mulu na pano isonde ponse.

english: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;
translation: Eico kanshi, ndemupapata ukuti mulaye kuli ine muli Yawe ukuti muli nokulanga uluse ku ba lupwa lwandi, pamo ngefyo na ine nangile uluse kuli imwe. Mpeeleni icishibilo cacine cine,

english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”
translation: icakuti muli nokupususha imyeo ya batata, bamayo, bandume yandi pamo na bankashi nandi. Kabili mukapususha ne ndupwa shesu shonse, no kupususha imyeo yesu ku mfwa!”

english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when the LORD gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”
translation: Inengu epakumwasuka ati, “Iwe nga wafwa, na ifwe bene kufwa.” Kabili shatile, “Icikulu tausokolwele umulandu twaisa mukucita, ifwe tuli nokwisa kusunga ilya nshita ilyo Yawe akatupeela icalo cino.”

english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.
translation: Elyo Rahabu afumishe inengu ku ntambo pa windo, pantu iŋanda yakwe iyo aleikalamo yasuntinkene ne cibumba ce linga lya musumba.

english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”
translation: Abeba nokuti, “Lungamenifye ku mpili epakuti aba bantu balemufwaya bemusanga. Muye fisama kulya kwine pa nshiku shitatu mpaka aba bantu bakabwele, elyo lyena kuti mwakonkanyapo ubulendo.”

english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.
translation: Elyo inengu shaeba Rahabu ashiti, “Uyu mulapo watwebele ukulaya tukafikilishafye nga cakuti,

english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
translation: ilyo tukafika mu calo cino ukakake uyu mwando wakashika watwishisheko pa windo, kabili elyo ukalete bawiso na banoko, bandume yobe na balupwa bobe bonse bakese muno ŋanda yobe.

english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.
translation: Elyo cikaba ukuti umuntu umo nga afumina panse ya ŋanda yobe no kuya mu musebo, umulopa wakwe uli nokuba pa mutwe wakwe umwine. Tawakabe mulandu wesu nakalya. Lelo kuli uyo onse uuli mu ŋanda yobe pamo na iwe, umulopa wakwe uli nokuba pa mitwe yesu nga cakuti kwaba abamwipaya.

english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”
translation: Imfumu ya mu musumba wa Yeriko baliyebele abati, “Mona! Abantu bamo abena Israeli nabesa kuno mu bushiku mukwisa lengula cino calo.”

english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti wasokolola icintu twaishila kuno, ninshi lyena twalubuka ku mulapo watulenga ukuti tulape.”

english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.
translation: Ukuf 14:21

english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.
translation: Ilyo baile balungeme ku mpili, eko baya ikala inshiku shitatu, mpakafye abantu abalebafwaya babwelelamo ilyo banakile ukubafwaya monse mu misebo ukwabula ukubamona.

english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.
translation: Elyo ishi inengu shibili shatentemwike ulupili no kwabuka umumana ukubwelelamo kuli Yoshua mwana Nuni no kumweba fyonse ifyabacitikile.

english: They said to Joshua, “Truly the LORD has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
translation: Shamwebele ashiti, “Icine cine Yawe napeela icalo conse mu maboko yesu, pantu abantu ba mu calo ici, baleitutuminafye pa mulandu wakutiina ifwe.”

english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”
translation: Elyo imfumu ya mu Yeriko yatuma amashiwi kuli Rahabu ayakutila, “Fumisha panse abaume beshile kumobe abaleikala mu ŋanda yobe, pantu abo bantu baisa kuno mukulengula icalo cesu conse!”

english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.
translation: Lelo uyu mwanakashi abuulile aba bantu babili no kubafisa. Elyo atile, “Ee, abaume aba baishile kuli ine, nomba ine nshaishibe uko bafumine.

english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”
translation: Elyo lilya paya palefitulukila, mupepi ne nshita yakwisalilapo umwinshi wa mpongolo, aba bantu elyo baile. Eico nshishibe ne nshila beleko. Kanshi angufyanyeni bwangu mubakonke, limbi kuti mwabasanga.”

english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
translation: Kanshi ninshi uyu mwanakashi abafishile pa mutenge mwisamba lya mwina wa bukonge uo alongele palya pa mutenge.

english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
translation: Kanshi abaume abo imfumu yatumine epakukonka inengu mu musebo uwalola ku cabu ca mumana wa Yordani. Elyo cilyafye abakukonka inengu bafuma, baisala na pa mwinshi wa mpongolo.

english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.
translation: Ilyo inengu tashilati shisendame, Rahabu aya apo bali pa mutenge wa ŋanda,

english: She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
translation: no kubeba ati, “Ine nalishiba ukuti Yawe alimupeela icalo ici, kabili tulemutiina nganshi. Eico na bonse abekashi ba muli cino calo baleitutuminafye ku mwenso pa mulandu wenu.

english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
translation: Awe ulucelocelo Yoshua na bena Israeli bonse bafumine mu Shitimu no kulungama ku Yordani, uko baile cita inkambi ilyo tabalayabuka umumana wa Yordani.

english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.
translation: Kabili ifi efyo mwalaishibilako ukuti Lesa wamweo ali pakati kenu, kabili kuntanshi yenu ali nokutalusha abena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Hifi, abena Perisi, abena Girigashi, abena Amoli na bena Yebusi.

english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.
translation: Moneni ukuti Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ca Mfumu ye sonde lyonse ili nokubalilapo ukwabuka umumana wa Yordani.

english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
translation: Eico kanshi, saleni abaume ikumi limo na babili ukufuma muli cila luko.

english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”
translation: Kabili ilyo linefye bashimapepo bakusenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe, Imfumu ye sonde lyonse, balanyanta inkasa shabo mu mumana wa Yordani, na menshi ayatentemukila ukwasuluka ukufuma ku mulundu yaleleka ukwenda no kupanga umwina kwati lupili.”

english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,
translation: Kanshi ilyo abantu bapangulwile amatenti yabo no kuya kukwabuka umumana wa Yordani, ninshi bashimapepo abasenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano nabatangilila abantu.

english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
translation: Nomba iyi yali ni nshita umumana wisula no kupoosa amenshi, mu nshiku shakulobolola. Elyo cilya abakusenda Imbokoshi bafika ku Yordani, banyanta na mu menshi mu mbali ya mumana,

english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.
translation: amenshi yonse ayalefuma ku mulundu, ku mulu wa mumana, yalekele ukupita. Awe yatulumanafye umwina ukulolafye ukutali ku musumba uo beta Adamu, uwali mupepi na Saretani, yapatulukana na yaleya kwisamba lya Bemba Wamucele, bemba wa Araba. Kanshi abantu bayabukile apalungatene no musumba wa Yeriko.

english: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
translation: Bashimapepo abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, baiminina apauma ndi pakati ka mumana wa Yordani, ilyo abena Israeli balepitafye mpaka umushobo onsefye wapwa ukwabuka apauma.

english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;
translation: Panuma ya nshiku shitatu, abakalamba ba fita bapitana mu nkambi monse,

english: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.
translation: balaeba abantu ifyebo abati, “Ilyo lyonse mwamona bashimapepo abena Levi nabasenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, mufwile na imwe bonse mukeme no kukonka.

english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”
translation: Ili lyena elyo mukeshiba inshila muli nokuyamo, pantu tamwatala amwishiba iyi inshila kale. Lelo mu kwenda kwenu mufwile ukubelako apatali ukulingana ne ntamfu ikana limo pakufika apabelele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano. Tecakwesha ukuba mupepi ne Mbokoshi ya Cipangano.”

english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
translation: Elyo Yoshua aebele abantu ukutila, “Isangululeni mwe bene, pantu mailo Yawe ali nokucita ifipeshamano pakati kenu.”

english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
translation: Kabili Yoshua aebele bashimapepo ukuti, “Sendeni Imbokoshi ya Cipangano no kutangilila abantu kuntanshi.” Ifi fine efyo bacitile, basendele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano no kutangilila abantu kuntanshi.

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Yoshua ati, “Ilelo line ine ndetampa ukukucindamika pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse, pakuti beshibe ukuti ine nakulaba na iwe lyonse ngefyo naleba na Mose.

english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”
translation: Ukonkomeshe bashimapepo abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ukuti, ‘Ilyo mwalafika mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Yordani muye iminina mu menshi ya mumbali ya mumana.’”

english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of the LORD your God.”
When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
translation: Ilyo umushobo onse wapwile ukwabuka umumana wa Yordani, Yawe asosele kuli Yoshua ati,

english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.
translation: Nomba bashimapepo bena abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano bashele nabeminina palya pene pakati ka mumana wa Yordani, mpakafye fyonse ifyo Yawe akonkomeshe Yoshua abantu baficita, mu nshila iyo Mose akonkomeseshemo Yoshua. Awe abantu bayangufyanya pakwabuka umumana.

english: When all the people had completely crossed over, the LORD’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.
translation: Ilyo abantu bonse bapwile ukwabuka umumana, Imbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe pamo pene na bashimapepo, nabo bayabuka baisa tangilila na bantu.

english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.
translation: Abaume abena Rubeni, abena Gadi na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase nabo bayabuka ninshi abena Israeli tabalayabuka, elyo bena ninshi nabaipangasha ne fyanso fya bulwi, ukulingana nefyo Mose abebele.

english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before the LORD to battle, to the plains of Jericho.
translation: Abayabwike umumana bali amakana amakumi yane (40,000) ninshi nabasenda ne fyanso fya bulwi pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Balungeme ku mawanga ya musumba wa Yeriko ku bulwi.

english: On that day, the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
translation: Pali ubu bwine bushiku, Yawe asumbwile Yoshua pa cinso ca bena Israeli bonse. Kabili apeelwe umucinshi nganshi mu nshiku shonse isha mweo wakwe, pamofye ngefyo bacindike Mose.

english: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Yoshua ati,

english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”
translation: “Konkomesha bashimapepo abasenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano ukufuma mu mumana wa Yordani.”

english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”
translation: Nao Yoshua akonkomeshe bashimapepo ati, “Fumenimo mu mumana wa Yordani.”

english: When the priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.
translation: Elyo bashimapepo bafuma mu mumana nabasenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe. Tapapitile ne nshita, batilefye bashifumya inkasa shabo mu mumana wa Yordani, amenshi yayamba no kulapita umo yalepita, no mumana wapoosa no kupoosa ngefyo wali nakale.

english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo ubwa mweshi wakubalilapo elyo abantu bafumine pa mumana wa Yordani no kuya cita inkambi ku Giligali ku mupaka ku kabanga ka Yeriko.

english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,
translation: “Sala abaume ikumi limo na babili. Muli cila luko usalemo umuntu umo.

english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.
translation: Kabili amabwe yalya ikumi limo na yabili yantu bafumishe ku mumana wa Yordani, Yoshua ayemike ku Giligali.

english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’
translation: Elyo aebele abena Israeli ati, “Umuya inshiku ilyo abana benu bakalaipusha bashibo abati ‘Nga aya mabwe yanshi?’

english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
translation: Mukalabasuka amuti, ‘Abena Israeli bayabwike umumana wa Yordani apauma.’

english: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa wenu akamishe amenshi yonse mu mumana wa Yordani kuntanshi yenu, mpakafye mwayabuka, nga filya fine acitile kuli Bemba Wakashika ilyo akamishe amenshi pantanshi yesu, mpakafye bonse twayabuka.

english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear the LORD your God forever.’”
translation: Ala Yawe acitile ifi pakulenga abantu bonse aba pano isonde beshibe ukuti ukuboko kwakwe kwamaka nganshi, elyo na imwe bene muleba abakatiina lyonsefye kuli Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”
translation: Elyo ubakonkomeshe auti, ‘Kabiyeni pakati ka mumana wa Yordani, palya pene peminine bashimapepo. Cila umo aye abuulepo ilibwe limo. Musende muye nayo ku nsakwe uko muleya sendama.’”

english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.
translation: Elyo Yoshua aitile abantu abaume ikumi limo na babili abo asalile ukufuma muli cila luko lwa bena Israeli,

english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;
translation: alabeba ati, “Kabiyeni ku ntanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe Lesa wenu, pakati ka mumana wa Yordani. Elyo cila muntu abuule ilibwe no kusenda pa kubeya kwakwe, ukulingana ne mpendwa ya nko sha bena Israeli.

english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’
translation: Aya mabwe yakaba icishibilo pakati kenu. Eico ilyo abana benu bakalamwipusha abati, ‘Nga aya mabwe yanshi?’

english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the LORD’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”
translation: Mukalabasuka amuti, ‘Amenshi ya mumana wa Yordani yalipatulwilwe pa mulandu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe. Ilyo yayabwike umumana wa Yordani, amenshi yalekele ukupita, mwabafye umwauma.’ Eico kanshi, aya mabwe yaba ya cibukisho ku bena Israeli pe na pe.”

english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakucita ifyo Yoshua abakonkomeshe. Bailebuula amabwe ikumi limo na yabili pakati ka mumana wa Yordani, ukulingana ne mpendwa ya nko sha bena Israeli, pamo ngefyo Yawe aebele Yoshua. Nabo epakuyasenda baya nayo ku nkambi, no kuya yabika panshi.

english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.
translation: Elyo Yoshua kabili aimike amabwe na yambi ikumi limo na yabili pakati ka mumana wa Yordani, palya penefye apo bashimapepo abasendele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano baiminine. Aya mabwe na lelo linefye epo yaba.

english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.
translation: Nomba caishile ba ukuti ishamfumu shonse isha bena Amoli ishaleikala lwa ku masamba ya mumana wa Yordani, ne shamfumu shonse isha bena Kenani ishabela mu lulamba lwa bemba, shaumfwile ukuti Yawe alikamishe umumana wa Yordani pantanshi ya bena Israeli, mpakafye ifwe bonse twayabuka. Na pakumfwa ifyo, awe imitima yashiko yatompoka, kabili tashali na maka yakushipa mukuya lwisha abena Israeli.

english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli baikele ku Giligali mu mawanga ya ku Yeriko basefeshe inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila iye Pasaka, pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14) mu nshita ya cungulo.

english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.
translation: Elyo pali ubo bwine bushiku ubwakonkelepo epo balile ifisabo fimo ifya mu calo cilya, pamo ngo mukate uushatutumuka elyo ne fyakusalula.

english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
translation: Ukutulafye ilyo line balile ifilyo fya mu calo ici, elyo na maana yalekele ukupona. Kabili maana tayabalile aipona ku bena Israeli, lelo pa mwaka onse balelyakofye ifyakulya fya mu calo ici ica Kenani.

english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”
translation: Ilyo Yoshua ali mupepi na Yeriko, ainwine amenso no kumona umuntu naiminina ku ntanshi yakwe naikata ulupanga mu minwe yakwe. Yoshua nao epakumulungama aya mwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe uli muntu wesu, nangu uli wa ku balwani besu?”

english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of the LORD’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Iyoo, lelo ine naisa ngo mukalamba wa fita fyakwa Yawe.” Elyo Yoshua awa panshi ubukupeme no mucinshi uukalamba, no kumwipusha ati, “Bushe mashiwi nshi Imfumu ikwete ku mubomfi waiko?”

english: The prince of the LORD’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.
translation: Nao umukalamba wa fita fyakwa Yawe amweba ati, “Fuula insapato shobe, pantu icifulo wimininepo camushilo.” Na Yoshua acitile ifyo aebelwe.

english: At that time, the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”
translation: Pali ilya inshita Yawe aebele Yoshua ati, “Panga imyele ya mabwe no kusembulula abena Israeli abashasembululwa.”

english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
translation: Awe Yoshua acitile ifyo aebelwe no kupanga imyele ya mabwe, kabili asembulwile abena Israeli ku Gibeati Haaraloti.

english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.
translation: Umulandu walengele Yoshua ukubasembulula wali wakuti, bonse abo abafumine mu calo ca Egupto, bonse abaume abengalwa inkondo, bafwilile mu nshila mu matololo panuma yakufuma mu Egupto.

english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.
translation: Pantu abafumine mu Egupto bonse, abaume balisembulwilwe. Lelo abantu bonse abaume abafyalilwe mu nshila mu matololo bena bali tabalasembululwa.

english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice. The LORD swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translation: Eico abena Israeli baleendauka mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane mpakafye bonse abaume abengalwa inkondo bafwila mu matololo, panuma yakusangukila Yawe. Ni kuli aba Yawe alapile no kubeba ukuti tabakatale abamona icalo cabulayo ico alaile ukupeela kuli bashibo, icalo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci.

english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.
translation: Eico Yoshua apyanikishepo abana babo mu fifulo fyabo. Aba bene abana babo ebo Yoshua asembulwile. Ico abasembulwilile, nico ilyo bali mu matololo bali tabalasembululwa.

english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.
translation: Panuma yakupwa ukusembulula abali nokusembululwa bonse, baikele palya pene pa nkambi mpakafye ifilonda fyapola.

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Yoshua ati, “Ilelo line nimfumya pali imwe umusebanya mwafuma nao mu calo ca Egupto.” Eico ilya ncende itilwa Giligali ukufika na lelo.

english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
translation: Nomba umusumba wa Yeriko wali uwaisalwa nganshi pa mulandu wakutiina abena Israeli. Takwali muntu nelyo umo uwakufumamo, kabili takwali muntu nelyo umo uwakwingilamo.

english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”
translation: Lelo Yoshua akonkomesha abantu ati, “Tecakwesha ukupunda ishiwi lya bulwi, tecakwesha ukwimya amashiwi yenu, tecakwesha ukusosa ishiwi nelyo limo mpakafye pa bushiku ilyo nkamweba ukupunda, elyo lyena mukapunda!”

english: So he caused the LORD’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua epakuleka bashimapepo basenda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe bashinguluka nayo umusumba umuku umo. Elyo babwelela ku nkambi eko basendama.

english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the LORD’s ark.
translation: Yoshua abuuka ulucelo, elyo na bashimapepo nabo basenda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe.

english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the LORD’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after the LORD’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.
translation: Bashimapepo cine lubali aba mapenga ya nsengo sha basukusuku ebaletangilila Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe, mukwenda kwabo balelisha na mapenga. Elintu ninshi ifita fyankondo nafyo fili kuntanshi, elyo abalinshi nabo ebaleshalila balekonka panuma ya balesenda Imbokoshi yakwa Yawe, ninshi batwalililefye ukulisha amapenga.

english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.
translation: Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga shibili baile baleenda ukushinguluka umusumba umuku umo no kubwelela ku nkambi. Bacitile ifi pa nshiku mutanda.

english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.
translation: Nomba pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, baima lucelocelo no kwenda ukushinguluka umusumba imiku cine lubali mu musango umo wine. Nomba ni ubu bwine bushiku bweka bashingulwike umusumba imiku cine lubali.

english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for the LORD has given you the city!
translation: Pa muku walenga cine lubali bashimapepo balisha amapenga, na Yoshua aeba abantu ati, “Pundeni, pantu Yawe namupeela umusumba.

english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to the LORD. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
translation: Nomba umusumba na fyonse ifilimo fili nokupeelwa kuli Yawe ukuti fyonaulwe. Kanofye Rahabu cilende, pamo nabo ekala nabo mu ŋanda yakwe eukaba no mweo. Pantu afishile inengu isho twatumine.

english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.
translation: Eico kanshi imwe muisunge bwino ku fintu ifyapeelwa kukonaulwa , epakuti tamuiletelele no konaulwa pakuibuulilapo icintu conse mwe bene. Pantu limbi kuti mwalenga inkambi ya bena Israeli ukonaika, kabili nokuleta ubusanso ku nkambi.

english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD. They shall come into the LORD’s treasury.”
translation: Lelo silifa na golide yonse ne fipe ifya mukuba ne fya fyela fyena fyamushilo kuli Yawe, kabili fifwile ukufibika mu cipao cakwa Yawe.”

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Yoshua ati, “Mona, ine nimpeela Yeriko mu maboko yobe, elyo ne mfumu ine pamo pene ne mpalume sha baume ba bulwi bonse.

english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakuwelesha, elyo bashimapepo nabo balisha amapenga. Nomba lilya iciunda ca mapenga caumfwika, abantu epakuwelesha apakalamba ne cibumba ce linga lya musumba capona panshi. Kanshi umuntu uuli onse aninine apalungatene nankwe no kwingila mu musumba mpaka baupoka.

english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
translation: Bapeela kuli Yawe umusumba onse kukuonaula, baonaula ku lupanga fyonse ifyali mu musumba, abaume na banakashi, abakalamba na baice, iŋombe, impaanga pamo na bakabalwe.

english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”
translation: Kabili Yoshua aebele abaume babili abali inengu sha calo ici ati, “Kabiyeni mu ŋanda yakwa cilende no kuya mufumyamo pamo pene na bantu bakwe, ukulingana no mulapo mwacitile kuli ena.”

english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.
translation: Awe aba balumendo inengu baingile mu ŋanda no kufumya Rahabu, wishi na nyina, bandume yakwe elyo na bonse abo ali nabo. Bonsefye babasenda no kuya babika mu cifulo cimbi, kunse ya nkambi sha bena Israeli.

english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
translation: Elyo baoca no musumba onsefye, pamo pene na fyonse ifyalimo. Bapuswishekofye silifa, golide ne fipe ifya mukuba ne fya fyela, fyena bafibika mu cipao ca mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe.

english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
translation: Lelo Rahabu uwali cilende elyo na ba mu ŋanda yakwa wishi na bonse abo ali nabo Yoshua tafyonawile. Eico ukushinta na pa bushiku bwe lelo, abantu bakwa Rahabu baikala mu calo ca bena Israeli pa mulandu wakuti ewafishile inengu batumine ku Yeriko.

english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before the LORD who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”
translation: Pa nshita ilya Yoshua alanda umulapo wakuti, “Abe uwalapishiwa pa cinso cakwa Yawe umuntu onse uukesha ukukuula uyu musumba wa Yeriko.

english: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.
translation: Kanshi lyonsefye Yawe ali na Yoshua, elyo no lulumbi lwakwe lwakumene icalo conse.

english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.
translation: Kanshi iwe ne fita fyankondo fyonse mwakulaenda ukushinguluka umusumba umuku umo. Mukacite ifi pa nshiku mutanda.

english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
translation: Mulingile ukuba na bashimapepo cine lubali bakatangilile Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, balelisha amapenga ya nsengo sha basukusuku. Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali mukashinguluke umusumba imiku cine lubali, ninshi bashimapepo balelisha amapenga.

english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”
translation: Ilyo bakaputa mu lusengo lwakwa sukusuku, nga mwaumfwa no kutwalilila kwa ciunda ca kulisha kwa mapenga, elyo lyena abantu bonse bakapundishe apakalamba. Apopenefye ne linga lya musumba likaiwilafye iline, na bantu bonse bakeme apalungatene na cila muntu no kwingila mu musumba.”

english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the LORD’s ark.”
translation: Kanshi Yoshua mwana Nuni epakwita bashimapepo no kubeba ati, “Sendeni Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, kabili bashimapepo cine lubali batangile ku ntanshi ya Mbokoshi yakwa Yawe balelisha na mapenga.”

english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before the LORD’s ark.”
translation: Elyo kabili aeba abantu ati, “Akwendeni! Muleshinguluka umusumba, ifita fyankondo fibe pa ntanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe.”

english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of the LORD’s covenant followed them.
translation: Cilyafye Yoshua apwisha ukulanda ku bantu, bashimapepo cine lubali abasendele amapenga ya nsengo sha basukusuku pa cinso cakwa Yawe batangila, balelisha na mapenga yabo, elyo pakonka na basendele Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe.

english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.
translation: Ifita fyankondo fyena efyali pa ntanshi ya bashimapepo abalelisha amapenga elyo abalinshi nabo ebaleshalila balekonka panuma ya balesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, ninshi bashimapepo batwalililefye ukulisha amapenga.

english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against the children of Israel.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli bakene ukumfwa ifyo Yawe akonkomeshe ifyakukanasenda icintu nelyo cimo ukufuma mu musumba pa fintu ifyapeelwa kukonaulwa. Nomba Akani umwana mwaume wakwa Kami, umwishikulu wakwa Sabidi, nao uwali mwana Sera uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda, ena ewabuulilepo ifintu fimo pa fyapeelwa ukonaulwa. Ecalengele ukuti Yawe afulilwe abena Israeli.

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?
translation: Yawe nao atile, “Iminina! Cinshi ico ulalile ubukupeme?

english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.
translation: Israeli nabifya no kupula mu cipangano ico nabakonkomeshe ukusunga. Nababuulapo ifintu fimo pa fyapeelwa kukonaulwa, nabafiiba, nababepa no bufi kabili bafifisa na mu fipe fyabo.

english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.
translation: Uyu e mulandu ulengele ukuti abena Israeli babacimfye ku balwani babo, eco bakulafutatila abalwani babo no kubutuka pantu nabailetelela ukuti bonaulwe. Na ine nomba nshakatale mba na imwe nakabili iyoo, kanofye mukonaule ifintu fyonse mucili nafyo ifyo namwebele ukonaula.

english: Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, “There is a devoted thing among you, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you.”
translation: Ima kabiye usangulule abantu no kubeba ukuti, ‘Isangululeni mwe bene mukuipekanya pa fya bushiku bwa mailo,’ pantu ifi efyasosa Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli ukuti, ‘Mukati kenu imwe mwe bena Israeli muli ifintu fimo ifyapeelwa kukonaulwa. Muli nokufilwa ukulwa na balwani benu nga cakuti tamonawile ifi fintu no kufifumya pakati kenu.’

english: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which the LORD selects shall come near by families. The family which the LORD selects shall come near by households. The household which the LORD selects shall come near man by man.
translation: Eico ulucelo mukaleisa cila luko kuli ine. Uluko ulo Yawe akasonta, lukaleisa cila lupwa kuntanshi. No lupwa ulo Yawe akasonta lukaleisa cila ŋanda. Elyo cila ŋanda iyo Yawe akasonta ikaleisa kuntanshi umuntu no muntu.

english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed the LORD’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”
translation: Nomba uyo onse uwaikatwa ne fintu ifyapeelwa kukonaulwa, ali nokocewafye mu mulilo pamo pene ne fintu fyonse ifyo akwata. Pantu uyu muntu alyonaula icipangano cakwa Yawe, kabili alicita icamusebanya mu Israeli.”

english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.
translation: Ulucelo lwakonkelepo, Yoshua aeba abena Israeli ukulaisa kuntanshi uluko no luko. Awe uluko lwakwa Yuda elwasontelwe ukwisa kuntanshi.

english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.
translation: Elyo indupwa shakwa Yuda eshaishile kuntanshi no lupwa lwakwa Sera elwasontelwe. Elyo ulupwa lwakwa Sera elwalaisa cila ŋanda, na Sabidi elwasontelwe.

english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.
translation: Kabili Yoshua apalamike aba mu ŋanda yakwe kuntanshi umuntu no muntu, elyo Akani umwana mwaume wakwa Kami, nao mwana Sabidi, nao uwali umwana wakwa Sera uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda, ewasalilwe.

english: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”
translation: Elintu Yoshua aeba Akani ati, “We mwana wandi, nakulomba ulepeela umucinshi kuli Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli, kabili ulemulumba. Eico kanshi, njeba ifyo wacitile. Tecakwesha ukumfisa akantu nelyo kamo.”

english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The men went up and spied out Ai.
translation: Nomba Yoshua epakutuma abaume bamo ukufuma ku Yeriko no kuya ku Ai, iyaba mupepi na Beti Afeni iyaba ku kabanga ka Betele, no kubeba ukuti, “Kamoneni icalo pamo nge nengu.” Kanshi nabo baliile no kuya mona icalo ici nge nengu mu Ai.

english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.
translation: Nao Akani ayaswike ati, “Ee icine cine, nine nabifishe kuli Yawe, Lesa wa bena Israeli. Nefyo nacitile nifi.

english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”
translation: Ilyo namwene mu fyakutapa umwingila usuma uwa ku Shina ne ndalama sha silifa amashekeli imyanda ibili elyo ne cipimfya ca golide icafina ukucilako citika wa kilo, elyo nafikumbilwe no kubuula. Fyonse ifi fintu, nafifishile mwi tenti lyandi, emo nafishiika panshi, pamo pene na silifa ewaba panshi ya fibiye.”

english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.
translation: Awe Yoshua epakutumako inkombe nabo bailefye ulubilo kwi tenti. Elyo cine cine umwingila usuma, pamo pene na silifa panshi, fyafishilwe mwi tenti lyakwe.

english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before the LORD.
translation: Basendele fyonse ifyali mwi tenti, bafileta na kuli Yoshua na bena Israeli bonse, elyo no kufilangisha pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.
translation: Awe Yoshua na bena Israeli bonse, babuulile Akani, umwana mwaume wakwa Sera, silifa, umwingila, ifipimfya fya golide, abana bakwe abaume na banakashi, iŋombe shakwe, bapunda, pamo pene ne mpaanga, itenti lyakwe elyo ne fintu fyonse akwete bafisenda kwishika lya Ako.

english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? The LORD will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.
translation: Elyo Yoshua aebele Akani ati, “Kanshi cinshi ico iwe uletele ubusanso ubushaibipila pali ifwe? Yawe nao nomba alakuletela ubusanso ilelo linefye.” Elyo bonse abena Israeli bamutobele amabwe. Kabili panuma yakubatobaula amabwe, baboca na mu mulilo.

english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. The LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.
translation: Elyo pali Akani batulikapo no mwina wa mabwe uukalamba, uyo uucilipo na pa bushiku bwa lelo bwine. Panuma ya ifi, Yawe aleka no bukali. E mulandu wine betila palya pantu ukuti “ishika lya Ako ” ukufika na ku nshita ine ino.

english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”
translation: Ilyo inengu shabwelelemo kuli Yoshua shamwebele ashiti, “Wileka abantu bonse baye mukulwisha abena Ai, iyoo, lelo tumenikofye abaume amakana yabili (2,000) nangu yatatu (3,000) abakuya lwisha abena Ai. Kabili mwicusha bantu bonse ukuyako, pantu kulifye abantu abanono mu musumba.”

english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.
translation: Kanshi epakutumako abaume amakana yatatu (3,000). Lelo baile bafulumuna ku bena Ai.

english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.
translation: Kabili abena Ai baipeyepo na bantu ukulingana na makumi yatatu na mutanda (36).
