Babatamfishe ukufumafye pa mpongolo ya musumba no kuya bafisha ku fimabwe fya ku mapili, uku kwine eko baile bakomawila pa nshila yakutentemuka. Awe ne mitima ya bena Israeli yatompweke no kutalala tondolo nga menshi.

english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before the LORD’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
translation: Elyo Yoshua alepwile ifyakufwala fyakwe, kabili awile panshi ubukupeme ku cinso ca Mbokoshi ya Cipangano iyakwa Yawe ukushinta ne nshita ya cungulo. Ena pamo na bacilolo ba bena Israeli nabo bacitile cimo cine. Bena ninshi nabaikuba no lukungu mu mitwe yabo.

english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord GOD, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!
translation: Elintu Yoshua atile, “Iye, we Mfumu Lesa, cinshi ico wayabushishe aba bantu umumana wa Yordani no kutuleta ku minwe ya bena Amoli mukutulofya? Iye, ala nga fwe bene catulingile ukwikala kulya kwine lubali lwa mumana wa Yordani!

english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?
translation: Owe, we Mfumu yandi, nga kanshi cinshi ine ningasosa, pantu nomba abena Israeli nababafulumuna ku balwani babo?

english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”
translation: Abena Kenani na bantu bambi aba mu calo ilyo bakomfwa uyu mulandu, nabo bene bakatwimina no kutulofya. Kabili ne shina lyesu lili nokufumishiwa pano isonde. Bushe nomba we Mfumu ukacitapo shani pa mulandu wa bucindami bwe shina lyobe?”

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Yoshua ati, “Tecakwesha ukuba no mwenso kabili tecakwesha ukunenuka. Buulafye ifita fyonse no kuya bonse ku musumba wa Ai. Pantu ine, ne Yawe nimpeela mu maboko yobe imfumu ya mu musumba wa Ai, abantu bakwe, umusumba pamo pene ne calo cakwe conse.

english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, Yoshua abuuka kacelocelo alonganika na bantu. Elyo pakuya ku Ai, umwine na bacilolo ba bena Israeli ebatangila pantanshi.

english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.
translation: Fyonse ifita ifyali pamo na Yoshua fyaya fileenda kabili fyafikile mupepi no musumba no kupitila kuntanshi yauko. Elyo fyacitile ne nkambi ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka musumba wa Ai, apali no mupokapoka pakati kabo elyo no musumba.

english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
translation: Elyo Yoshua abuulapo ifita ni cikanga na makana yasano (5,000) abafisa pakati ka Betele na Ai, ku masamba ya musumba.

english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.
translation: Elyo abantu bacitile inkambi yabo ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka musumba, abafiseme nabo bali ku masamba yauko. Ninshi balifye abaipekanya nganshi. Yoshua mu bushiku bulya ashele alinda mu mupokapoka.

english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.
translation: Ilyo imfumu ya mu musumba wa Ai yaumfwile ifi, yena pamo na bantu bonse aba mu musumba basakatuka lucelocelo no kwima mukukumanya abena Israeli kukulwa, pa cifulo icalungatene na matololo ya Araba pantanshi ye wanga. Nomba imfumu ya mu musumba tayaishibe ukuti ifita fimo nafiibelamina ku numa ya musumba.

english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
translation: Elyo Yoshua na bena Israeli bonse bacita kwati bafulumuka, na balwani babo babakonka panuma. Nabo bafulumukila ku nshila ya ku matololo.

english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
translation: Abekala musumba bonse bakutene no kukunkunika abena Israeli no kubatamfishafye ukutali ukufuma ku musumba wa Ai. Kanshi ilyo balebutusha Yoshua na bantu bakwe, kanshi ninshi ekutaluka baletaluka ku musumba.

english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
translation: Mu misumba Ai na Betele tamwashele umwaume nelyo umo uushafumine mukukunkunika abena Israeli. Umusumba wa Ai, washelefye uwaisuka ilyo bonse bakunkunike abena Israeli.

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.” Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Yoshua ati, “Sonta ifumo ilili mu minwe yobe ku musumba wa Ai, pantu nalaupeela mu minwe yobe.” Awe nao Yoshua epakucita ifyo Yawe amwebele.

english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.
translation: Bwangu bwangu cilyafye aimya ukuboko, ifita ifyafiseme fyaima napo fyafiseme no kubutukila mu musumba. Fyaingila no kuupoka elyo mukwangufyanya fyaoca no koca.

english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”
translation: Ifyo uli nokucita ku musumba wa Ai ne mfumu yauko ni filya fine wacitile ku musumba wa Yeriko ne mfumu yauko. Lelo uno muku, kuti mwasenda fyonse ifintu mukatapa pamo ne fitekwa ukuti fikabe fyenu. Bika ifita fyakulalilila kunuma ya musumba.”

english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.
translation: Abena Ai bati baloleshe kunuma, bamona umusumba ulefutumuka icushi. Awe abena Ai ukwakubutukila kwabula, pantu abena Israeli abo balebutusha ukuya ku matololo nabo bayaluluka mukukumanya abalwani babo.

english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.
translation: Ilyo Yoshua na bantu bonse bamwene ukuti abanabo abafiseme nabapoka umusumba, kabili no musumba ulefutumuka icushi, epakubweluluka baisa ipaya abena Ai.

english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
translation: Kabili ifita fimo pa fyafiseme ifyali mu musumba, fyafumine no kuya lwisha abena Ai pakuti bababike pakati ka bena Israeli, bambi uku, bambi nabo uku. Awe abena Israeli bakomawile abena Ai bonse, takwashele nelyo umo.

english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.
translation: Lelo kwashelefye imfumu yabo iyo baikete no kuitwala kuli Yoshua.

english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bapwishishe ukwipaya abena Ai abali mu mapanga na mu matololo umo babutukile, no kumona ukuti tapali nelyo umo uwashele, elyo abena Israeli bonse babwelele ku musumba wa Ai no kuya pwililisha abashelemo.

english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.
translation: Abantu bonse abaume na banakashi abafwile mu musumba wa Ai bali bonse pamo amakana ikumi limo na yabili (12,000).

english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
translation: Pantu Yoshua nao aikatililefye ifumo mu kuboko kwakwe, umo mwinefye asontele ku musumba wa Ai, mpaka apeela abantu bonse abaleikala mu Ai kukonaulwa .

english: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to the LORD’s word which he commanded Joshua.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli balisendele iŋombe ne fyapeelwe ukutapwa muli ulya musumba ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe akonkomeshe Yoshua.

english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua epakoca umusumba wa Ai no kuucita umwina wa citantala camuyayaya, icifulo icabafye ceka ifyo fine ukufika no bwa lelo line.

english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.
translation: Kabili Yoshua akulika imfumu ya Ai ku cimuti, no kumusha eko amushile mpakafye ku nshita ya cungulo. Ilyo akasuba kawa, Yoshua aeba abantu ukukulukula icitumbi ku cimuti no kuciposa panshi pa mwinshi wakwingilila mu musumba. Batulikapo no mwina wa mabwe uukalamba, uucilipo na mu bushiku bwa lelo line.

english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua pamo pene ne fita epakwima, balungama na ku Ai ku bulwi. Yoshua asalilepo impalume sha fita ishaswangana amakana amakumi yatatu (30,000) no kubatuma pakati ka bushiku.

english: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,
translation: Kabili nomba Yoshua akuulile pa mulu wa lupili lwa Ebali ubulambo bwakwa Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli,

english: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings.
translation: pamo ngefyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe akonkomeshe abena Israeli. Akuulile ukulingana nefyo calembwa mu citabo ca Mafunde yakwa Mose ukuti, “Icibumba ca bulambo cifwile ukukuulilwa na mabwe ayashakomaulwamo ne cela, yalingile yabafye ayatuntulu.” Apa epo baletuulila umutuulo we lambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe kabili no mutuulo we lambo lyakwampana.

english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
translation: Elyo kabili Yoshua, pa cinso ca bena Israeli, ayambwilile pa mabwe amafunde yantu Mose alembele.

english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the LORD’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.
translation: Abena Israeli bonse, abeni pamo pene na bakaya, abakalamba babo, bacilolo elyo na bakaputula wa milandu babo, baiminine ku mbali shonse isha Mbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe, baloseshe amenso kuli bashimapepo abena Levi abalesenda Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe. Citika wa bamo baiminine pantanshi ya lupili lwa Gerisimu, bambi nabo pantanshi ya lupili lwa Ebali ngefyo Mose umubomfi wakwa Yawe akonkomeshe kale ukucita pakupaala abena Israeli.

english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
translation: Na pa numa ya ifi fyonse, Yoshua abelengele yonse amashiwi ya Mafunde, amashiwi ya mapaalo elyo na mashiwi ya kulapisha ngefyo calembwa mu citabo ca Mafunde.

english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.
translation: Kwena takwashele ishiwi mu mashiwi yonse ayo Mose akonkomeshe yantu Yoshua tabelengele ku lukuta lwa bena Israeli, ukusanshakofye na banamayo na bana bonse, elyo na ku beni abaleikala pakati kabo.

english: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.
translation: Elyo abakonkomesha ati, “Umfweni bwino bwino. Muye ibelamina ku numa ya musumba pakuti muupoke. Tecakwesha ukutaluka ku musumba. Kabili imwe bonse mufwile ukuba abaiteyanya.

english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.
translation: Ine pamo na bonse abo tuli nabo twakulapalamina ku musumba. Nomba ilyo abalwani bakesa tufumina, pamo ngefyo bacitile intanshi, ifwe tuli nokubafulumuka.

english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,
translation: Nabo bali nokutukonka mpakafye tukasuke atubatalusha ukufuma ku musumba. Elyo bena bakatila, ‘Batubutuka, nga filya fine bacitile intanshi.’ Eico ilyo tukafulumuka,

english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
translation: elintu nomba na imwe mukeme apo mukabelama no kupoka umusumba. Na Yawe Lesa wenu ali nokuupeela mu maboko yenu.

english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to the LORD’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”
translation: Ilyo mukapoka umusumba, mukaoce. Mufwilefye ukucita ukulingana ne cebo cakwa Yawe. Nefi fine efyo mukacite pantu nine nkonkomeshe.”

english: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua epakubatuma baya ku ncende yakubelaminapo mukupembela iyali pakati ka Betele na Ai, lwa ku masamba ya Ai. Lelo Yoshua ali na bantu pa nkambi ubushiku bulya bwine.

english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it
translation: Nomba ilyo imfumu shonse ishaleikala kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani, ne shaleikala mu calo ca mpili ne shaleikala mwisamba elyo na mu lulamba lwa Bemba Mukulu no kushintafye na ku Lebanoni shaumfwile ifi, shonse shaikatene pamo. Ishi shamfumu sha bena Hiti, abena Amoli, abena Kenani, abena Perisi, abena Hifi elyo na bena Yebusi

english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
translation: Kabili na fyonse fintu acitile ku mfumu shibili isha bena Amoli abekala kwishilya lya Yordani, kuli Sihoni imfumu ya bena Heshiboni na kuli Ogi imfumu ya bena Bashani, uwaleikala mu Ashitaloti.

english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’
translation: Kanshi eico abakalamba besu elyo na bonse abekala mu calo cesu batile kuli ifwe, ‘Musende ifyakulya fya pa bulendo bwenu no kuya kumanya abanensu, kabili mukayetila kuli bena, “Ifwe tuli babomfi benu. Eico tupange icipangano pakati kesu.” ’

english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”
translation: Kabili ilyo twabikile imyangashi no kwisusha ishi inyambi, awe shalifye ishipya, nomba shi moneni ifyo inyambi shilepawike. Kabili ifyakufwala fyesu nafyo pamo ne ndyato shine, nafilepauka pa mulandu wa bulendo ukulepesha.”

english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from the LORD’s mouth.
translation: Abena Israeli epakuibuulilapo ifilyo abene ukwabula ukwipusha ukulanda kwakwa Yawe.

english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.
translation: Yoshua epakucita icipangano camutende na ba bantu abena Gibeoni no kulaikala nabo pamo, kabili abakalamba be bumba lya bantu bonse babikapo no mulapo.

english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.
translation: Cilya papitafye inshiku shitatu apo bapangile icipangano na bena Gibeoni, awe mukwai abena Israeli baumfwa ifyo kanshi aba bantu bena mupalamanofye, bekala mupepifye nabo.

english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli epakwima, baenda inshiku shitatu, bafika na ku misumba yabo iya Gibeoni, Kefira, Beroti na Kiriati Yarimu.

english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli tababalwishishe iyoo, pantu abakalamba ba lukuta balibikilepo umulapo kuli Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli. Elintu ulukuta lwayambile ukuilishanya ku bakalamba babo.

english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.
translation: Elyo abakalamba nabo babasuka ukuti, “Twalipangana nabo, kabili no kulapa kuli Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli, eico kanshi tatufwile ukubekatamo pali ino nshita.

english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
translation: shali no mutima umo mukulwisha Yoshua na bena Israeli.

english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”
translation: Ifi efyo tuli nokucita pali kano kashita kuli bena, tuli nokubalekafye baleikala, pakuti ubukali bwakwa Lesa bwikaba pali ifwe bonse mukonaula umulapo twalapile kuli bena.”

english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.
Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?
translation: Elyo Yoshua atumine abakuya ita abena Gibeoni, nao aisa beba ati, “Bushe cinshi mwatubepele nokutila, ‘Twikala ukutali nganshi ukutaluka kuno,’ ilyo imwe mwikalafye mupepi na ifwe?

english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”
translation: Ala nomba imwe mwalapishiwa. Tamwakatale amuleka ukuba abasha abakulatapa amenshi no kulateba inkuni mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wandi.”

english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how the LORD your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
translation: Abena Gibeoni nabo bayasuka Yoshua abati, “Ababomfi benu balyumfwilefye bwino bwino ifyo Yawe, Lesa wenu, akonkomeshe umubomfi wakwe Mose ukuti akamupeela icalo conse no kwipaya bonse abekashi ba muli ici calo ilyo talamufishamo. Eico na ifwe twatiinine ukwisa fwa, e mulandu wine twacitile ifi fyonse.

english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”
translation: Eco nomba ifwe, tulifye mu maboko yenu. Tucitileni ico conse mwamona ukuti cisuma, kabili icalungama ku cinso cenu.”

english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.
translation: Kanshi Yoshua nao epakubapususha ku bena Israeli, no kubepaya tababepeye.

english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for the LORD’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.
translation: Ukufumafye pali bulya bwine bushiku Yoshua apeele abena Gibeoni umulimo wakutebela abena Israeli inkuni, elyo nokulabatapila amenshi. Kabili abebele nokulateba inkuni sha pa bulambo no kulatapa amenshi pa cifulo ico bali nokusonta icakwa Yawe. Ifi fine efyo baba na mu bushiku bwa lelo line.

english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
translation: Lelo ilyo abena Gibeoni baumfwile ifyo Yoshua acitile ku Yeriko na ku Ai,

english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,
translation: bacita ubucenjeshi. Baya kuli Yoshua nga batuminwe, balonga pali bapunda babo imifuko ikote iya fyakulya, elyo ne nyambi sha myangashi ishalepauka kabili ne milundo yakubilabila.

english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
translation: Bafwele ifisamu elyo ne ndyato ishafikamba fikamba ku makasa yabo. Umukate onse untu basendele wali uwakosa, kabili uwamokaulwa.

english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”
translation: Elyo baya kuli Yoshua ku nkambi ya ku Giligali, balamweba pamo na bena Israeli abati, “Ifwe tufumine ku calo ca kutali. Kanshi panga icipangano na ifwe.”

english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli batile ku bena Hifi ati, “Limbi imwe mwikalafye mupepi na ifwe, nga kanshi kuti twacita shani icipangano na imwe?”

english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”
translation: Nabo baeba Yoshua abati, “Ala ifwe tuli babomfi bobefye.” Nomba Yoshua nao abepusha ati “Bushe nimwe bani kabili ni kwi mufumine?”

english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of the LORD your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,
translation: Nabo bayaswike abati, “Mukwai ababomfi benu bafumine ku calo ca kutali nganshi pa mulandu wakumfwa ululumbi lwakwa Yawe, Lesa wenu. Twalyumfwa na pali fyonse ifyo acitile mu calo ca Egupto.

english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
translation: Ine Yuda ne musha wakwa Yesu Kristu kabili munyina Yakobo, namulembela imwe mwebo Lesa aita, imwe mwebo Lesa Shifwe atemwa, kabili mwebo Yesu Kristu asunga.

english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
translation: Nomba aba bantu bena balanda no musaalula pa fintu ifyo bashumfwile umo filolele. Elyo ifintu baishiba mu musango inama ishabula amano shishibilamo ifintu, ifyo fine efilebonaula.

english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
translation: Aba bantu bakacimona! Pantu bakonka imisango yakwa Kaini. Pa mulandufye wa ndalama, baiposa mu cilubo cacitile Balamu. Kanshi nabo balisangukila Lesa nga filya Kora acitile, eico pamo pene nga Kora nabo bakonaulwa.

english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
translation: Aba bantu baba kwati matoni ya fiko pa nsalu, ilyo muli pakulya icakulya cakulanga ukutemwana. Baisakamanafye ukuipakisha ukwabula insoni. Baisakamanafye abene beka. Baba kwati makumbi yalesendwa no mwela ukwabula ukulokesha imfula. Baba kwati miti iyishitwala fitwalo na pa nshita ine ifwile ukutwala, yena iyo miti nga baishula kumo ne mishila, lyena ninshi yafwa libili.

english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
translation: Enoki uwa mu nkulo yalengele cine lubali ukufuma pali Adamu, aseseme pali aba bantu ati, “Moneni, Imfumu ikesa na bamalaika baiko abamushilo amakana na makana.

english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
translation: Ikesa kukupingula abantu bonse. Ikesa kanda ababifya pa fibi fyonse ifyo bacita mu kubifya kwabo. Ikesa kanda ababifya bonse pa mashiwi yonse ayabi balandile pali Lesa!”

english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
translation: Aba bantu bailishanyafye lyonse no kwebaula abantu bambi. Bakonkelelafye ulunkumbwa lwabo. Baishibafye ukuitakisha no kusembeleka abantu pakuti bamwenemo ifyo balefwaya.

english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Lelo imwe mwe bacibusa bandi muleibukisha ifyo abasole ba Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu bamwebele kale.

english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
translation: Icite 5:18

english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
translation: Abantu ba uyu musango abaleta ukupatulukana, bakonkelelafye ifyabuntunse, tababa na Mupashi wakwa Lesa.

english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
translation: Lesa engamukwatila uluse ulwingi, alemupeelesha umutende, ne citemwiko cakwe cibe na imwe.

english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
translation: Lelo imwe, mwe bacibusa bandi muleshangila no kulakoselako mu cisumino cenu icamushilo, mulepepa mukwampana na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
translation: Mulelangulukila abo abacili baletwishika.

english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
translation: Mulepusushako bamo mukubasompola ukufuma mu mulilo. Bambi bena mulebakwatila uluse no mwensopo. Lelo muletaluka ku fyakufwala fyabo ifyakowela ku bubifi bwabo ubwa lunkumbwa lubi.

english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
translation: Lesa nacindikwe uwaba na maka yakumubaka pakuti mwiwila mu fibi. Kabili aba na maka yakumuleta pa cinso cakwe icacindama ababula akabi nangu kamo, abansansa nganshi.

english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
translation: Lesa uwabafye umo mpo, uwatupususha pa mulandu wakwa Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu, eco kanshi nalecindikwa, abe no bufumu, amaka no kulateeka, ukufuma kale ilyo isonde talilabako, na pali nomba ne myaka pe na pe! Ameni.

english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
translation: Mwe batemwikwa bandi! Ala nalefwaisha nganshi ukumulembelako pepusukilo twashukila bonse. Nasangile ukuti cilefwaikwa ukumukoselesha pakuti mulelwila icisumino ico Lesa apeela umupwilapo ku bantu bamushilo.

english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
translation: Pantu abantu bamo abashapetamina Lesa baisa pakati kesu mu bumfisolo. Aba bantu bafulunganya amashiwi aya pa cikuuku cakwa Lesa no kuyalosha ku bulalelale. Elyo basuula na Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu kabili Shikulwifwe uwabafye umo. Aba bantu ebo ukupingulwa kwabo kwalembelwepo na kalefye.

english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
translation: Pantu nangu kwena mwaishiba ifi fintu fyonse kale, lelo ndefwaya ukumwibukishako ifyo Imfumu yalubwile abena Israeli ukufuma mu calo ca Egupto, elyo panuma abashasumine yalibonawile.

english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
translation: Ibukisheni bamalaika balya abashasungile amaka yabo ayakuteeka, lelo bashile ne fifulo fyabo fine. Aba bena, Lesa abakakila ne minyololo ya pe iyishiputuka mu ncende umwafiita fititi mpaka no bushiku bwakukandwa.

english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
translation: Ibukisheni Sodoma na Gomora, ne misumba imbi iyapalemeko. Mu musango umo wine, abantu ba muli iyo misumba balecita ubulalelale ne misango imbi imbifye iyakulungana. Abo bantu Lesa alibaposa mu mulilo wape, pakuti babe icilangililo kuli bonse.

english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
translation: Kabili mu musango umo wine, aba bantu balalota ifiloto ifilenga ukuti balebifya ne mibili yabo. Basuula na maka ayakuteeka, elyo basaalula na bamalaika ba mu mulu.

english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
translation: Nangu ni malaika Mikaeli umukalamba wa bamalaika, ilyo baleumanina icitumbi cakwa Mose na Ciwa, tabomfeshe mashiwi yamusaalula pakumushinina. Lelo asoselefye ati “Imfumu ikakukanda!”

english: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!
translation: Yangu ifyo we musumba wa Yerusalemu utalele tondolo,

english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.
translation: Abalwani nabamupoka ifyuma fyakwe fyonse.

english: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, LORD, and see, for I have become despised.”
translation: Abena Yerusalemu baletusailafye,

english: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which the LORD has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
translation: “Shilolesheni mwe balepita, bushe tacilemusakamika?

english: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.
translation: “Yawe aliponya umulilo ukufuma ku mulu,

english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
translation: “Ifyabubifi fyandi alifikaka nge koli,

english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.
translation: “Abashilika bonse ababulamba pakati kandi,

english: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”
translation: “Ifi fintu efilengele ukuti ndeloosha,

english: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. The LORD has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.
translation: Sioni ayansa amaboko yakwe,

english: “The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
translation: “Yawe nalungika,

english: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
translation: “Nalitile abatemwikwa bandi,

english: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.
translation: Umusumba ulelilafye bushiku bonse ngo mwanakashi uwikala inkumbabulili,

english: “Look, LORD; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.
translation: “Wingalolesha we Yawe ifyo ndecula mu mutima wandi,

english: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.
translation: “Abantu nabomfwa uko ndeteta no kuilishanya,

english: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
translation: “We Yawe, nabo ubalubulwishe pa bubifi bwabo bonse,

english: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
translation: Yuda nabamusenda bunkole mukuya mukucula,

english: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
translation: Mu misebo yonse iya ku Sioni muli imisowa,

english: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.
translation: Abalwani nabapoka umusumba,

english: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.
translation: Ululumbi lonse nalupwa ku mwana mwanakashi Sioni.

english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.
translation: Mu nshiku sha bulanda na macushi

english: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
translation: Kwena Yerusalemu alibifya apakalamba nganshi,

english: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, LORD, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”
translation: Ukukowela kwakwe kwalemoneka ku nsalu shakwe,

english: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
translation: Yangu we mfifi nobe ulakula,

english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
translation: Abakalamba ba mu mwana mwanakashi Sioni nomba baleikalafye panshi,

english: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
translation: Awe ine na mu menso namwingila kulwakulila,

english: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
translation: Abana nga balelilila kuli banyinabo batila,

english: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
translation: Finshi ifyo ine ningalanda pali iwe,

english: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
translation: Ifimonwa ifyo bakasesema bobe balekwebako,

english: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”
translation: Bonse abapitapo balakusonta iminwe,

english: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”
translation: Abalwani bobe bonse balekuwela,

english: The LORD has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
translation: Yawe nasuka nacita ifyo apangile ukucita,

english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
translation: Ikatisheni ukulilila Imfumu,

english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
translation: Pa nshita ya bushiku buuka wambeko ukulila,

english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
translation: Imfumu nayonaula imishi yonse iya bamwana Yakobo ukwabula no luse.

english: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
translation: Shilolesha we Yawe, umone.

english: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.
translation: Abaice na bakote balya batambalele mu misebo, nabafwa.

english: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.
translation: Nga filya beta abakwisa ku malila efyo waitile abalwani bandi,

english: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.
translation: Ku cipyu caiko Imfumu naipwisha amaka yakwa Israeli ayo alemekelamo,

english: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.
translation: Imfumu naitinta mu buta kwati mulwani,

english: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.
translation: Imfumu isangwike kwati mulwani wabo,

english: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. The LORD has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.
translation: Yawe naonaulafye nakalya nakalya iŋanda yakwe kwati libala

english: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the LORD’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
translation: Imfumu nomba naifumyako na mano ku bulambo bwaiko,

english: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.
translation: Ni kale Yawe apangile ukubongolola amalinga ya mwana mwanakashi Sioni.

english: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
translation: Impongolo nashonaika, shishikeme na mu fibungulubwe,

english: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
translation: Ine pano ndi, nalishiba ifyo Yawe akanda umuntu.

english: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
translation: Ambelamine nge ciswango ca bea,

english: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
translation: Amfumishe mu musebo, ayansantaula,

english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
translation: Ali akana mu buta bwakwe,

english: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
translation: Nandasa mu mutima,

english: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
translation: Nsangwikefye icakuwela ku bantu ba mitundu yonse,

english: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
translation: Andishishe ifinkolwankolwa,

english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
translation: Ali alenshiba impumi panshi,

english: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
translation: Ine nomba nimpokwa umutende,

english: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
translation: Eco ndelandila nati, “Awe ine nomba umucinshi wandi naupwa,

english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
translation: Ndeti nga nalatontonkanya pafyo ndecula, na pafyo ndeseuluka,

english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
translation: Alintamfishe no kuleka nalaenda mu cifulo

english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
translation: Ici cintu ecilemfupula umutima lyonsefye

english: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
translation: Lelo kwena pali cimo ico ndeibukisha,

english: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
translation: Icakuti icitemwiko cakwa Yawe tacipwa eco tushafwila,

english: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
translation: Apo shicela alalanga cipya cipya icikuuku no luse,

english: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
translation: Naisosha ne mwine nati,

english: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
translation: Yawe musuma kuli bonsefye abamutetekela,

english: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
translation: Kanshi caliwama umuntu ukulateka umutima,

english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
translation: Cisuma nganshi umuntu ukulateka umutima,

english: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
translation: Ilyo Yawe aletelapo umuntu ubucushi, aletala aikala eka,

english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
translation: Elailishanya iyoo,

english: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
translation: Nine neka alelwisha lyonse,

english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
translation: Aleke uulefwaya ukumuma pesaya amumefye

english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
translation: Ala Imfumu yaba no luse,

english: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
translation: Nangufye pambi ingamukanda, ilamulangulukilako,

english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
translation: Pantu te ku kutemwa kwaiko icushisha

english: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
translation: Ukunyantilila ababa mu cifungo pano isonde ponse,

english: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
translation: Ukukanapeela muntu insambu isho Lesa Mukulu umwine amupeela,

english: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
translation: Ukupondamikila umuntu umulandu mu cilye,

english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
translation: Nani uwingalandapo cimo, no kucitika cacitika,

english: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
translation: Bushe te ku kanwa kakwa Lesa Mukulu

english: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
translation: Nga cinshi umuntu umwinakufwa engalailishanishisha,

english: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
translation: Anshilefye imisakalala,

english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
translation: Ala natuletontonkanyapo pa mibeele yesu no kuyesha,

english: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
translation: Natulelosha imitima yesu na maboko yesu ku mulu kuli Lesa,

english: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
translation: “We Yawe, ala ifwe twalibifya,

english: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
translation: “Waliifimbilisha ne cipyu icikalamba no kutukunkunika,

english: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
translation: Waliifimbilisha ne kumbi ilyatikama,

english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
translation: Ee, nautusangula icishala kabili ifisoso,

english: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
translation: “Abalwani besu bonse baletutuka,

english: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
translation: Ifyakutiinya ne fyakutuwisha nafitutengamina,

english: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translation: Mu menso yandi mulekonkoloka ifilamba nga menshi,

english: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
translation: Mu menso yandi tamwaleke kulalukuta filamba,

english: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
translation: Anjisalile mu cifungo,

english: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.
translation: mpakafye we Yawe ku mulu ukatulolekeshepo,

english: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
translation: Umutima wandi ulecula,

english: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
translation: Abali kale abalwani bandi apabula umulandu,

english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
translation: Bamposele umutuntulu mu cilindi,

english: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
translation: Amenshi nayo yaisa yalafika na ku mutwe,

english: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.
translation: Mu cilindi mwine umwashika nganshi,

english: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
translation: Nobe waŋumfwa ilyo ndekupapata ukuti umfwe inkuuta yandi,

english: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
translation: Wapaleme mupepi na ine ilyo nalekulilila,

english: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
translation: “Waisa ndubulwilako we Mfumu,

english: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
translation: We Yawe, walishiba ifyo ine bamfyenga,

english: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
translation: Anengele ukulaikala umwafiita fititi,

english: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
translation: Walimona ifyo bailandula,

english: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,
translation: “We Yawe, naumfwa insele balentuka,

english: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
translation: Akasuba konse nine abalwani bandi baleyamba

english: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
translation: Mona ilyo bekele nangu ilyo beminine,

english: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.
translation: “We Yawe, ale balimune,

english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
translation: Lekafye imitima yabo ikose ndi,

english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
translation: Ala ubakunkunike mu cipyu ca bukali bobe,

english: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
translation: Anshingulwishe ilinga ilyakuti ine nafilwa no kufulumukamo,

english: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
translation: Nangu napundile no kukuuta mutuule,

english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
translation: Nancilikila inshila ku mabwe ayabaswa ayakulu,

english: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
translation: Yangu ifyo golide apwa ubukankala,

english: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translation: Nangu abanakashi baba ne cikuku,

english: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
translation: Yawe nalanga apapela icipyu cakwe,

english: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
translation: Pali bashamfumu bonse aba pano isonde,

english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.
translation: Nomba lino efyo cicitike pa mulandu wa bubifi bwa bakasesema,

english: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
translation: Bena balepulumpuntafye mu misebo nga abantu abapofwile,

english: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”
translation: Abantu nabo ninshi kulabasoweshafye abati,

english: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
translation: Ni Yawe umwine ewabapasa,

english: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
translation: Twalelolela nganshi abakutwafwa,

english: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
translation: Abalwani besu epakulatulonda nkola nkola,

english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
translation: Elyo abalwani besu bali abalubilo nganshi,

english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
translation: Abalumendo ba mu Sioni abacindeme nga golide wine wine,

english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
translation: Kateeka wesu uwasubwa na Yawe, uyo ifwe tupeemamo,

english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.
translation: Akucankwenifye, mulesekesha ne nseko,

english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
translation: We mwana mwanakashi Sioni, ukukanda kobe kukapwa,

english: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
translation: Ngefyo na bamumbwe bene balonsha utwana twabo ibele,

english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
translation: Indimi sha twana twabo utunya

english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
translation: Abantu abalelya kale ifyakulya ifine fine,

english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
translation: Ukukandwa kwa bantu bandi nakucila ukukandwa kwa Sodoma,

english: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
translation: Bacilolo ba mfumu babuutile ukucila umukaka,

english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.
translation: Nomba lino, awe tebakwishiba mu misebo,

english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
translation: Abafwile ku nkondo bena caliwamapo

english: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
translation: We Yawe, ibukisha ici cintu icatuponena,

english: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
translation: Inkanda ya mibili yesu ikabile nge buku,

english: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
translation: Balebembuka na banakashi besu ababa mu Sioni kumaka,

english: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
translation: Pakukulika bacilolo ba mfumu, balebakakila ku maboko yabo,

english: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
translation: Abalumendo besu balebacusha ukulapela ubunga,

english: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
translation: Abakote nabaleka ukulalongana pa mpongolo ya musumba,

english: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
translation: Imitima yesu tailesansamuka nakalya.

english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
translation: Icilongwe cesu icabufumu nacifulika ku mutwe ciponene panshi,

english: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
translation: E mulandu wine ne mitima yesu inakile,

english: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
translation: Pantu pa lupili lwa Sioni pashelefye icibolya ceka,

english: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
translation: Kwena iwe we Yawe, ala uli Kateeka wa pe na pe,

english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
translation: Abantu bambi bambifye ebatupokele icabupyani cesu,

english: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
translation: Nomba mulandu nshi ifwe watulabililako pa nshita iyalepa ifi,

english: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
translation: Wingatubweshafye we Yawe, uleke tubwelele kuli iwe,

english: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
translation: Kanofye nga walitusuulililakofye no kutukaana,

english: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
translation: Bashifwe nababepaya ku balwani,

english: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
translation: Amenshi yakunwa ayesufye, nomba eyo tuleshita ne ndalama,

english: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
translation: Abalwani besu abatubutusha bali pa numa yesu,

english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
translation: Twalangile ukucimba ku bena Egupto na ku bena Asiria,

english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
translation: Kwena bashifwe balibifishe, pali ndakai tabalipo iyoo,

english: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
translation: Abasha nomba ebaletuteeka, batini,

english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
translation: Pakumona icakulya, nomba tuleya mukulacifwaya mu matololo,

english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.
translation: Bamwana Aroni abaume Nadabu na Abihu babuula cila muntu icifukilisho cakwe, babikamo umulilo, basanshamo no bubani, baya tuula umulilo uushasuminishiwa kuli Yawe ukupusana nefyo abakonkomeshe.

english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
translation: Mufwile no kulalekanya ku fintu fyamushilo elyo ne fishili fyamushilo, pakati ka fintu ifishasangululwa elyo ne fyasangululwa.

english: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”
translation: Kabili mufwile ukufunda abena Israeli amafundefye yonse ayo ine ne Yawe napeele ukupitila muli Mose.”

english: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;
translation: Mose aeba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume abashalapo, Eleasa na Itama, ati, “Buuleni umutuulo wa cabunga uwashalapo ku mutuulo wakwa Yawe uwa cakoca, mupekanye umwabula intutumushi no kuuliila pa mbali ya bulambo, pantu wena wamushilo nganshi.

english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.
translation: Muuliilefye mu ncende yamushilo pantu iwe na bana bobe abaume, e ciputulwa mwapeelwa ku fya mutuulo wakwa Yawe uwa cakoca. Ifi efyo Yawe ankonkomesha.

english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”
translation: Umwendo uwacituulwa ne cisao icacitambikwa, fifwile ukuletwa pamo na mafuta ya mutuulo wacakoca fitambikwe kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika. Ici cili nokulacitika lyonse kukuba icakaniko cobe pamo na bana bobe, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.”

english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,
translation: Elyo kabili Mose aipusha palwa mbushi ya mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, awe asanga ukuti nabayoca kale. Epakufulilwa Eleasa na Itama, abana baume bakwa Aroni abashelepo, elyo aipusha ati,

english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
translation: “Bushe cinshi mushililile umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi mu cifulo camushilo? Ala uyu mutuulo wamushilo nganshi. Wapeelwe kuli imwe ukusendelako imilandu ya lukuta lwa bena Israeli ukubafutilako pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”
translation: Apo umulopa wa ili lambo tautwelwe mukati ka cifulo camushilo, nga mwaciliilafye iyi mbushi mu cifulo camushilo, pamo ngefyo nakonkomesha.”

english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”
translation: Lelo Aroni ayasuka Mose ati, “Wamona ilelo line abantu bacilekela Yawe umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwabo elyo ne lambo lyakoca, kabili ifi fine efintu fincitikile ine. Nomba ine ndya umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi ilelo, bushe Yawe nga acitemwa?”

english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
translation: Awe apopene, kwafuma no mulilo ku cinso cakwa Yawe waboca, bafwila na palya penefye pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
translation: Ilyo Mose aumfwa ifi, camuwamina.

english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.
translation: Mose epakweba Aroni ati, “Umu emo Yawe aloseshe ilyo atile, ‘Muli abo abampalama, nkailanga uwamushilo, pa cinso ca bantu bonse nkaba nokucindikwa.’” Aroni aikalafye tondolo.

english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
translation: Elyo Mose aita Mishaeli na Elisafani, abana baume bakwa Usieli nalume wakwa Aroni no kubeba ati, “Iseni kuno sendeni imibili ya bafyala benu, muitwale kunse ya nkambi, ukutaluka ku ntanshi ya cifulo camushilo.”

english: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
translation: Nabo baisa no kusenda iyi mibili ya bafwa, ninshi icili mu mingila, baitwala na panse ya nkambi, pamo ngefyo Mose abebele.

english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.
translation: Kabili Mose aeba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume, Eleasa na Itama ati, “Tecakwesha ukulekelesha imishishi yenu mukukanasakula, kabili tecakwesha ukulepaula ifyakufwala fyenu. Nga efyo mwacita, ninshi muli nokufwa, na Yawe alefulilwa ulukuta lonse. Lelo indupwa shenu shonse ne ŋanda yonse ya bena Israeli, ebali nokuloosha abo Yawe ocele ku mulilo atumine.

english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.
translation: Imwe tecakwesha ukufuma pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, epali mwafwa, pantu amafuta yakusuba ayakwa Yawe mwasubwa mucili nayo.” Awe nabo bakonkafye ifyo Mose abeba.

english: Then the LORD said to Aaron,
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Aroni ati,

english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
translation: “Iwe na bana bobe abaume tecakwesha ukunwa umwangashi nangufye conse icikola lyonse ilyo mwaingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, nga mwacita ifyo mukafwa. Ici e cipope camuyayaya icili nokukonkwa umukakonkanina inkulo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose na Aroni ati,

english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
translation: Lelo conse icishili na tulebelebe nangu amamba ica mu menshi mu mimana nangu muli bemba, nangufye cintu conse icisenya icamweo muli fyonse ifya mu menshi, fyena ifi talukeniko.

english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.
translation: Kanshi apo mwakulataluka kuli ifi fintu, tecakwesha ukulyako umunofu wafiko, ne fitumbi fyafiko muletalukako.

english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
translation: Icintu conse icisangwa mu menshi icamweo icishakwata tulebelebe na mamba cena mufwile ukutalukako.

english: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
translation: “Kabili ifi e fyuni mufwile ukutalukako no kukanalya. Ifyakutalukako nifi: kapumpe, ikubi likalamba ne kubi ilyafiita,

english: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
translation: akapata makanga na bapungwa abali bonse

english: any kind of raven,
translation: na bamwankole ba misango yonse,

english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
translation: imbuni, akambasa, isela ne nkoshi sha misango yonse,

english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
translation: akapululu kanono, inondo, icipululu,

english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
translation: swelelele, intitimushi, ikubi lyabuuta,

english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
translation: icipansankola, inkoba isha misango misango na pupute elyo na kasusu.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
translation: “Soseni ku bena Israeli mutile, ‘Pa nama shonse ishikala ku mulundu, isho mwingalya nishi.

english: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
translation: “Kabili ifishishi fyonse ifipupuka no kwendela ku molu yane, fyena imwe muletalukako.

english: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
translation: Kwena eko fili fimo ifyakwata amapindo ifyendela ku molu yonse yane ifyo mwingalya. Ifi fyena fyalikwata amolu ya mpingu ayakutolokelako pa mushili.

english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.
translation: Muli ifi, ifyo mwakulalya mu misango yonse ni makanta, inyense na kapuma ne nshonkonono.

english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
translation: Lelo utushishi tonse utwakwata na molu yane, imwe muletalukako.

english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Eico na imwe mukaikowesha kuli ifi nga mwalaikatako. Uyo onse ukakumya ku fyafwa fyonse, nao akaba uwakowela ukufika ne cungulo.

english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kabili uyo onse uukasenda icafwa, afwile asamba insalu shakwe, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela ukufika ne nshita ya cungulo.

english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
translation: “Kabili inama shonse ishapanduka ifibondo ukwabula ukupwililika, nangu ishishibukula fyakulya, shintu shakowela kuli imwe. Eico uyo onse uwaikatakofye kuli yonse iyafwa, nao akaba uwakowela.

english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Muli ishi nama shonse ishendela ku molu yane, isho ishendela ku fisansa, shena shintu shakowela kuli imwe. Eico uyo onse uwaikatakofye ku fitumbi akakowela ukufika ne nshita ya cungulo.

english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.
translation: Kabili uyo onse uwasenda ifitumbi fyashiko, afwile asamba insalu shakwe, nao akakowela ukufika ne nshita ya cungulo. Fyonse nafyo fine fintu fyakowela kuli imwe.

english: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
translation: “Ku nama shonse ishenda pa mushili, isho ishakowela kuli imwe nishi: Imfuko, impuku, ne mbulo shonse mu misango yashiko,

english: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
translation: Mulelya inama ishapwililika ukupanduka ifibondo, elyo ishibukula ifyakulya.’

english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
translation: kolokombwa, insamba, mulinso, lufwinyemba.

english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kuli ifi fyonse ifikulika pa mushili, fyena fintu fyakowela. Uyo onse uwaikatako ku citumbi caciko, ali nokuba uwakowela ukufika ne nshita ya cungulo.

english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.
translation: Ilyo lyonse cimo pali ifi fyafwa caponena pa cintu cimo, ico umusango cibombelamo cibe cintu capangwa ku cikutulo, ku cimuti, insalu, ku mukupo, ico cipe mucibike mu menshi, ici cipe cintu cakowela ukufikafye ne nshita ya cungulo, elyo cilesangululwa.

english: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.
translation: Lelo cimo pali ifi nga caponena ku cipe ce bumba, ninshi fyonse ifilimo nafyo fine fyakowela, ici cipe ce bumba cakutobafye.

english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
translation: Icakulya conse icikwete amenshi ayafumine muli ico cipe ce bumba, naco cine cintu cakowela. Ne cakunwa cine icafumamo, naco cintu cakowela.

english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
translation: Ponsefye apo ifitumbi fyaponena napo pene ninshi pakowela, pabe ni pebuku, na pamo ni pa nongo yakwipikapo. Fifwile ukufitoba fyonse, pantu fyasanguka ifyakowela, kabili nomba fyaba ifyakowela kuli imwe.

english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.
translation: Lelo kwena akamfukumfuku ka menshi nangu icishima ca menshi, fyena fintu fyasangululwa. Nomba uyo onse uwaikata ku fitumbi wena ninshi akowela.

english: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
translation: Nga cakuti icitumbi caponena pa mbuto shakubyala, shena shileshala ishasangululwa.

english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
translation: Lelo nalyo line nga cakutila namwitilapo amenshi pa mbuto, elyo paponena icitumbi nalyo line kuli imwe, shintu shakowela.

english: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Inama imo pasho mulya nga yaifwila, uyo onse uwaikatako ku citumbi caiko wena ninshi akowela mpaka ukufika ne cungulo.

english: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
translation: “Kuli inama shimo ishibukula nangu ishapanduka ifibondo isho mushilingile ukulalya. Ingamila nangu ibukula ifyakulya tayaba na fibondo ifyapanduka. Iyi yena, tayasangululwa kuli imwe, teti mulye.

english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Na uyo onse uwalyakofye ku nama iyaifwila, afwile asamba insalu shakwe kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka inshita ya cungulo. Na uyo onse uwasenda icitumbi afwile ukusamba insalu shakwe, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka ne cungulo.

english: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
translation: “Icintu conse icisenya pa mushili cena cakutalukako, tecakwesha ukulyako.

english: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
translation: Mwilalya ne cintu conse icikulika, nangufye cikulikila pefumo nangu icenda na molu yane nangu icakwatafye amolu ayengi, fyena fyakutalukako.

english: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
translation: Mwilaikowesha mwe bene kuli ifi fintu. Mwiilenga ukuba abakowela mwe bene kuli ifi fintu, nangu fyena ukumukowesha.

english: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.
translation: Ine nine Yawe Lesa wenu. Eico kanshi isangululeni no kuba abamushilo, pantu ine ndi wamushilo. Kabili mwilaikowesha mwe bene ku cikulika conse pa mushili.

english: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
translation: Ine nine Yawe uwamufumya imwe mu Egupto no kuba Lesa wenu. Eico kanshi beni abamushilo pantu ine ndi wamushilo.

english: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
translation: “Kanshi aya e mafunde yakukonka palwa nama, ifyuni ne fintu fyonse ifyabumi ifikala mu menshi ne fintu fyonse ifikulika pa mushili.

english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”
translation: Mulelekanya pa fintu ifyakowela ne fishili fyakowela, pa fintu ifyabumi ifyo muli nokulalya nefyo mushifwile ukulya.”

english: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
translation: Imbi inama iyibukula ifyakulya, ni pati nao wine tapanduka ifibondo. Nayo teyakulya pantu intu yakowela.

english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
translation: Kalulu nangu abukula ifyakulya tapanduka ifibondo, nao wine alikowela.

english: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
translation: Inkumba nangu yaba ne fibondo ifyapanduka, teyakulya intu yakowela pantu taibukula.

english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
translation: Tamufwile ukulya ishi nama nangufye ukukumya ku fitumbi fyashiko, shena shintu shakowela.

english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
translation: “Pali fyonse ifikala mu menshi muli babemba ne mimana kuti mwalaya fyonse ifyakwata utulebelebe na mamba.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.
translation: “Sosa ku bena Israeli auti, ‘Umwanakashi nga aba pa bukulu no kupapa umwana umwaume, ninshi aba uwakowela pa nshikufye cine lubali, nga filya fine ciba nga aba kumpepo.

english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
translation: Na pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, umwana ali nokusembululwa.

english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.
translation: Elyo umwanakashi ali nokupembela pa nshiku amakumi yatatu na shitatu (33), pakuti asangululwe no mulopa wakwe uwamishiwe. Talingile ukwikata ku cintu nelyo cimo icili icamushilo, nangufye kwingila mu cifulo camushilo mpakafye inshiku shakusangululwa shapwa.

english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti apapa umwana umwanakashi, lyena cili nokusendafye imilungu ibili umwanakashi alifye uwakowela, nga filya fine aba nga ali kumpepo. Elyo ali nokupembela pa nshiku amakumi mutanda na mutanda (66), pakuti asangululwe no mulopa wakwe uwamishiwe.’

english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.
