translation: “Inshiku shakwe ishakusanguluka nga shapwa isho apapilepo umwana umwaume nangu umwanakashi, alingile ukuleta kuli shimapepo pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo umwana wa mpaanga uwa mwaka umo nge lambo lya cakoca, ukubikapo na kabondo ka nkunda nangu icipele ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokumutuulilako kuli Yawe pakumufutilako, elyo lyena ali nokuba uwasanguluka kukufumishiwa kwa mulopa. Aya e mafunde ya pa mwanakashi onse uwapapa umwana umwaume nangu umwanakashi.

english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”
translation: “Nga cakuti umwanakashi uyu takwete umwana wa mpaanga, ninshi afwile ukuletafye utubondo twa nkunda tubili, nangu utwana twa fipele tubili, kamo ke lambo lya cakoca, kambi nako ka mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokutuulilamo ilambo lyakufuta pa fyamukowesha, nao lyena akasangululwa.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose na Aroni ati,

english: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokumupima bwino bwino. Nga asanga ukuti pa nkanda apafimbile napabuuta elyo na mapipi nayo nayabuuta, no kumona ukuti pali icilonda apafimbile,

english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.
translation: awe ubu bulwele bwankanda ubushiputuka, na shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Kabili talingile no kumusunga eka pa nshiku shakulolela iyoo, pantu ninshi wena alikowela nakale.

english: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,
translation: “Nga cakuti ubulwele bwakumana umubili onse, ukutendekela ku makasa ukufika na ku mutwe, shimapepo ali nokuya no kumuceceta nakabili.

english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.
translation: Nga asanga ukuti cine cine ubulwele nabukumana umubili onse, ninshi shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nasanguluka apo ubulwele tabuli bwa lwambu. Pa mulandu wakuti inkanda ya mubili wakwe onse nayaluka iyabuuta, kanshi nomba uyu muntu untu asanguluka.

english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
translation: Nomba ilyo lyonse icilonda icipya capuka pa mubili wakwe, uyu muntu aba uwakowela.

english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.
translation: Kabili ilyo lyonse shimapepo amona ici cilonda icipya icamupuka, ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Pantu icilonda akwata camukowesha, kabili bulwele ubwambukila.

english: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.
translation: Lelo ici cilonda icibishi nga cayaluka icabuuta, uyu muntu afwile aya kuli shimapepo kabili.

english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokumuceceta bwino bwino. Nga amona icilonda cine cine cili icabuutuluka, shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nasanguluka. Tali nomba uwakowela iyoo.

english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu umo icipute capuka pa mubili wakwe no kupola capola,

english: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.
translation: elyo apo pene apali icipute pafimba, no kubuutuluka pabuutuluka, nangu pakashikila no kubuuta paba no tupumba, uyu muntu ali nokuya kuli shimapepo.

english: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
translation: “Umuntu umo nga alafimba, nangu akwata utupumba twalamufuluma pa mubili, nangu pa nkanda yakwe palasebeka ifiletwala ku fibashi ifyambukila, afwile aletwa kuli shimapepo Aroni nangufye kuli umo uwa mu bana bakwe abaume, uuli ni shimapepo.

english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokumuceceta. Nga asanga ukuti ubulwele bwalingila kale mu mubili no bupipi nabubuutuluka, shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ubulwele ubwa lwambu ubo akwete bufuminefye pantu pali icipute.

english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti ilyo shimapepo amuceceta, asanga tapali ubupipi ubwabuuta, kabili icilonda tacili icakashika lelo naceluka, lyena shimapepo ali nokumusunga eka mu cifulo pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti ubulwele bwalalundulukilakofye, lyena shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ubulwele bwakwe bwa lwambu.

english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
translation: Icilonda nga tacilundulwike no kukumana monse monse mu mubili, awe ninshi cibalafye ca cipute, na shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nasanguluka.

english: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu umo apya umulilo, elyo apo apya pakashikila no kubuutulukila, nangu pabuutuluka no kutukuma,

english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
translation: shimapepo ali nokuceceta uyu muntu. Nga asanga ukuti amapipi yalipo nayabuuta, kabili napatobonkela, lyena ninshi bulwele ubwambukila ebufumine apo acipya. Shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ubulwele akwete bwankanda ubwambukila.

english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
translation: Nomba amapipi ayalipo nga tayali ayabuuta no kutobonkela nako tapatobonkele ne cilonda naco naceluka, lyena shimapepo ali nokusunga uyu muntu eka mu cifulo pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
translation: Panuma ya nshiku cine lubali, shimapepo ali nokuceceta uyu muntu. Nga amona ukuti ubulwele bwakwe bulesalangana mu mubili onse, shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ubulwele bwakwe ubu ubwankanda, bwa lwambu.

english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.
translation: Lelo, kwena icilonda nga cilifye umo cabela, no bulwele tabulundulwike lelo cabako bwino, kabili apacipya tapafimbile, lyena shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nasanguluka. Ico akwete, cibalafye ca cilonda icakupya ku mulilo.

english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume nangu umwanakashi ali ne cilonda mu mutwe, nangu ku kalefulefu,

english: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokupima icilonda bwino bwino kuli uyu muntu. Nga asanga no kumona ukuti amapipi ayali pa cilonda nayabuuta, ne cilonda nacipitilila mu nkanda, ninshi bulwele bwankanda ubwambukila. Shimapepo nga apwa ukupima bwino bwino uyu muntu, ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela.

english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
translation: shimapepo ali nokuceceta ici cilonda. Nga camoneka ukuti apo apali ici cilonda napatobonkela, elyo no bupipi nabo buli ubwa mutuntula kabili ubwaswaluluka, shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ici ciseseya, kabili ca bulwele ubwambukila ubwa ku mutwe na ku kalefulefu.

english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.
translation: Lelo shimapepo ali nokuceceta ici cilonda, nga amona ifyo tacitobonkele no bupipi bwafiita tacikwete, lyena shimapepo ali nokubika uyu mulwele eka pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,
translation: Na pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali nga bwafika, shimapepo kabili ali nokuceceta ici cilonda. Nga ici ciseseya tacilundulwike no bupipi nabo tabusangwike ubwa mutuntula no kutobonkela nga tacitobonkele,

english: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.
translation: uyu mulwele ninshi bali nokumubeya umushishifye onse ukushinguluka icilonda ukushafye pa cilonda peka. Elyo shimapepo ali nokusunga uyu mulwele eka pa nshiku na shimbi cine lubali.

english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.
translation: Kabili ishi nshiku nga shapwa, ali nokuceceta no kumona bwino bwino ici cilonda ifyo cili. Nga tacilundulwike no kutobonkela, lyena shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu mulwele nasanguluka. Kabili alingile nokusamba insalu shakwe no kusangululwa ninshi asanguluka.

english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
translation: Nomba nga cakuti icilonda calunduluka ilyo naebwa kale ati, nasangululwa,

english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
translation: ninshi shimapepo ali nokumuceceta nakabili. Icilonda nga cakuti calilundulukako, shimapepo tali nakubika amano kukumona imishishi ya mutuntula. Uyu muntu alikowelafye.

english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.
translation: Nga cakuti nalimo shimapepo amona ifyo icilonda tacilundulwike cilifye umo cabela, elyo no mushishi uwafiita naumenapo, ninshi icilonda nacipola. Nao wine umulwele ninshi asanguluka, elyo shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti nomba uyu muntu nasanguluka.

english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,
translation: “Ngo mwaume napamo umwanakashi akwata ubulwele bwa cisongo pa mubili wakwe,

english: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.
translation: shimapepo alingile ukumuceceta bwino bwino. Nga amona ukuti ifibala fili eyefilyako mukubuutulukila, ubu bulwele ninshi tabulaba na busanso, tupumbafye etulemutumba pa mubili. Uyu muntu, untu wasangululwa.

english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.
translation: Nga cakuti pa nkanda apalesebeka pabuuta nomba icilonda tacipitilile mu nkanda, na mapipi nayo ayalipo tayalwike ayabuuta, shimapepo ali nokutalusha uyu muntu umulwele ku babiye pa nshikufye cine lubali.

english: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.
translation: “Ngo muntu umushishi wapwa ukunukuka ukushinguluka umutwe wakwe, ashala ne pala, ninshi untu wasangululwa.

english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.
translation: Nga cakuti umushishi waseseka lwa ku mpumi eko ili ipala lyabelafye, nalyo line ninshi untu wasangululwa.

english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti uyu umuntu pepala palemoneka icilonda icakashikila no kubuutuluka nangu ni pa mpumi pene, awe ninshi ali no bulwele ubwa lwambu ubwa fibashi.

english: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,
translation: Shimapepo ali nokumuceceta uyu muntu. Kabili nga amona ukuti icilonda icifimbile mu mutwe wakwe nangu pa mpumi cili icakashikila no kubuutuluka nga ca bulwele bwambukila ubwankanda,

english: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.
translation: uyu muntu mulwele, kabili untu wakowela. Shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela, pantu mu mutwe wakwe muli ifilonda.

english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
translation: “Umuntu uulwele ubu bulwele ubwambukila wena ali nokufwalafye insalu ishalepauka. Imishishi yakwe mu mutwe taili nakusakulwa, ali nokufimba pa kanwa no kulapunda ati, ‘Uushasangululwa! Uushasangululwa!’

english: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.
translation: Uyu muntu ali nokuba uushasangululwa mpakafye apo ubulwele bwakwe bukapolela. Kabili ali nokwikalafye ku nse ya nkambi.”

english: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
translation: “Nga cakuti insalu isho umulwele afwala shili ishakowela no kufufuma, nangu shibe sha butonge, nangu shibe ishatelela,

english: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;
translation: yonse insalu iyapikulwa nangu ibe iyabilwa no kutelela bwino nangufye ya butonge, yonse impapa iyanyukwa bwino, nangufye icili conse icapangilwa ne mpapa,

english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.
translation: nga cakuti icisemba mu fyakufwala, nangufye ni mpapa, nangufye icapikulwa, nangufye icabilwa bwino no kutelela, nangufye conse icapangilwa ne mpapa, icili icakatapa katapa nangu ukukashikila, ala ninshi ubulwele ubu bwankanda, bulingile ukulanga shimapepo.

english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.
translation: Shimapepo kabili panuma ya nshiku cine lubali, ali nokumupima bwino bwino. Nga asanga ukuti ifilonda fya uyu muntu filifye umo fyabela, kabili tafilundulukile mu nkanda yakwe, ali nokumusunga ifi fine pa nshiku na shimbi cine lubali.

english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokuceceta no kumona ifyo cifufwime no kucifumya pa fibiye ukucibika ceka pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.
translation: Ubushiku bwa cine lubali nga bwafika, ali nokuciceceta, nga amona ukuti ukufufuma kucili kuletwalilila ku fyakufwala, nangu ku capikulwa no kubilwa bwino, icampapa, nangufye icibomfeshiwa mu nshila shimbi, awe ici cintu cena bonaushi bwa kufufuma kwa bulwele bwambukila. Ici cipe cena cintu cakowela.

english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.
translation: Kanshi shimapepo afwile ukucocafye ici cakufwala, nangufye conse icapikulwa no kubilwa bwino, conse ica butonge icatelela, ica mpapa yanyukwa bwino, lelo caba icakowela pa mulandu wakufufuma, cena cifwilefye ukocewa.

english: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti shimapepo aceceta ici cintu, asanga ukufufuma takupitilile ku fyakufwala, nangu ku cilifye conse icapikulwa no kubilwa nangu ni mpapa iyanyukwa,

english: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.
translation: shimapepo ali nokupeela icipope cakuti ici cintu icakowela cifwile ukucapwa no kucisunga ceka pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.
translation: Elyo panuma ya nshiku cine lubali, ali nokuciceceta. Nga asanga ukuti ukufufuma takwalwike mu mimonekele, nelyo tacipitilile mukufufuma, nalyo line cicili icakowela. Coceni no mulilo, nangufye ulubali lumo elufufwime nelyo cisempe ku lubali lubiye.

english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;
translation: Lelo nga ilyo shimapepo aceceta ici cintu, asanga ukuti ukufufuma takutwalilile panuma yakusamba ici cipe, lyena ali nokulepulapo ici citatilo pa cakufwala cakwe, nangu ni pa mpapa yanyukwa nangufye ni pa cintu conse icapikulwa no kubilwa bwino.

english: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti ukufufuma kwa cakufwala kwayamba nakabili, nangu ni ku fyapikulwa bwino no kubilwa, nangu cipe ca mpapa iyanyukwa, elyo nafyo fine fyatampa ukutwalilila ukufufuma, awe fyonse fyakocafye mu mulilo.

english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”
translation: Icakufwala, insalu shapikulwa ne shabilwa bwino nangufye cipe ca mpapa iyanyukwa, ico bacapile no kufufuma nakupwa, nakabili fifwile ukubwekeshapo ukuficapa, lyena ninshi fyasangululwa.”

english: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
translation: Kanshi aya e mafunde yakukonka pa mulandu wa fyakufwala nga fyalafufuma. Nangufye cibe cakufwala capikulwa na masako, nangu insalu iyatelela bwino bwino nga nafikwata ifisemba fyakufufuma nangu ku cipe conse icapangilwa ne mpapa iyanyukwa, fibe fintu fyasangululwa nangufye ifyakowela.

english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
translation: Elyo kabili panuma ya nshiku na shimbi cine lubali, shimapepo ali nokumupima uyu muntu. Lelo nga asanga nalyo line ubulwele tabulundulwike nabucepa, lyena shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti alifye bwino, takowela, tupumbafye twamufulwime. Uyu muntu afwile asamba ifyakufwala fyakwe, ninshi asangululwa.

english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
translation: Nomba panuma yakwa shimapepo ilyo amweba ati nasangululwa, utupumba twafulwime twalalunduluka, afwile kabili aya kuli shimapepo.

english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokumupima bwino bwino nakabili. Nga cakuti asanga ubulwele nabulunduluka mu nkanda, shimapepo ali nokusosa ukuti uyu muntu nakowela. Ubulwele bwakwe bulambukila.

english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;
translation: “Ngo muntu umo alwala ubulwele ubwambukila ubwankanda, ali nokutwalwa kuli shimapepo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
translation: “Pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, uyu muntu uwasangululwa ali nokuleta utwana twa mpaanga tubili utulume na kakota kamo aka mwaka umo utushaba na kalema. Afwile abikapo ne fyapekumi fitatu fya cipimo ca efa umo ifya bunga ubwapeleka bwino bwino ubwa ŋanu kabili ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta, ukuba umutuulo wa cabunga. Aya mafuta yafwile yaisula umusukupala umo.

english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Shimapepo uusangile uyu muntu ukuti nasangululwa, ali nokutwala uyu muntu ne mituulo yakwe no kufituula kuli Yawe pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokubuulapo akana ka mpaanga kamo akalume aka mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Ali nokubikapo no musukupala umo uwa mafuta, elyo no kuya fituula kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika.

english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokwipaila akana ka mpaanga pa ncende iyamushilo apo bepaila inama sha mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi ne lambo lyakoca. Umutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi cimo nge fyaba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, ifi fyonse fyakwa shimapepo. Kabili fintu ifyamushilo nganshi.

english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
translation: Luka 5:14

english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
translation: Kabili shimapepo ali nokubuulamo amafuta mu musukupala no kwitulwila pa lupi lwakwe ulwa ku kuboko kwa ku kuso.

english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
translation: Elyo shimapepo atumpike umunwe wakwe uwa ku kulyo uyu wakonkapo icikumo mu mafuta ayali pa lupi. Umulopa uli ku munwe, aukane imiku cine lubali pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.
translation: Kabili ali nokubuulapo amafuta yamo pa yashele pa lupi lwakwe no kuyashinga ku kalebelebe ka ku kutwi kwa ku kulyo ukwa uyu muntu uulesangululwa. Yambi amafuta ali nokuyashinga ku cikumo ca kuboko kwa ku kulyo, elyo na ku cikondo cikalamba ca lukasa lwa ku kulyo. Aya mafuta afwile ukubika pa mulu wa mulopa wa mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi.

english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
translation: Amafuta yonse ayashala pa lupi lwakwa shimapepo, yali nokubikwa pa mutwe wa muntu uulesangululwa. Ici ecilenga ukuwikishanya pakati ka muntu uulesangululwa na Yawe.

english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;
translation: “Elyo kabili shimapepo ali nokuleka umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Uyu mutuulo wakwimininako umuntu uyu uwakowela pakuti abe uwasangululwa ku fyamukowesha. Na panuma ya ifi, shimapepo ali nokwipaya inama ye lambo lyakoca,

english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,
translation: “Aya e mafunde yakukonka umulwele walwala amalwele yankanda ayambukila ilyo lyonse aleleka umutuulo wakusangululwa kuli shimapepo.

english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
translation: no kuyatuula pa bulambo, pamo pene no mutuulo wa cabunga, kukulenga uyu mulwele abe uwasangululwa.

english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;
translation: “Nga cakuti uyu muntu mulanda, takwete ifi fyonse, ninshi alifye nokuleta akana ka mpaanga kamo akalume ngo mutuulo wakutambika pakufuta pa fyabubifi, eko ali nokutuula ilambo ilikankala kuli Yawe. Kabili uyu muntu, ali nokubikapo icapekumi cimo ca cipimo ca efa icabunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino, kabili ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta no kutuula uyu mutuulo wa cabunga pamo no musukupala umo uwa mafuta,

english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
translation: no twana twa fipele tubili nangu utubondo twa nkunda tubili ifyo engakwatapo, kamo ka mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo kambi nako ke lambo lyakoca.

english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.
translation: “Pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse uyu muntu alingile aleta ifi fyonse kuli shimapepo kukumusangulwilako pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo ku cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokubuula umwana wa mpaanga wa mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, pamo pene no musukupala wa mafuta, nokufimisha mumulu ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika kuli Yawe.

english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokwipaya akana ka mpaanga akakutuula umutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi no kubuulako umulopa umo no kuushinga ku kalebelebe ka ku kutwi kwa kulyo ukwa muntu uuli nokusangululwa. Kabili nao aushinge ku cikumo ca kuboko kwa ku kulyo elyo na ku cikondo cikalamba ca lukasa lwa ku kulyo.

english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;
translation: Elyo kabili abike amafuta mu lupi lwakwe ulwa ku kuso,

english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.
translation: elyo mukubomfya umunwe wakonkapo icikumo uwa ku kulyo, atumpike umunwe mu mafuta no kukana imiku cine lubali pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.
translation: Amafuta yamo ayali mu lupi ali nokusuba umo mwine acisuba pakubala umulopa uwa mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, ku kalebelebe ka ku kutwi kwa ku kulyo ku muntu uulesangululwa, na ku cikumo ca ku kuboko kwa ku kulyo, elyo na ku cikondo cikalamba ca lukasa lwa ku kulyo.

english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
translation: Amafuta yonse ayashala mu lupi, shimapepo ali nokuyabika pa mutwe wa muntu uulesangululwa pakumufutilako kuli Yawe.

english: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,
translation: Eico, shimapepo ali nokuya kunse ya nkambi ukuli uyu mulwele no kumuceceta bwino bwino. Nga cakuti amona ukuti napolafye bwino bwino ku bulwele bwankanda ubwambukila,

english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,
translation: Elyo nomba shimapepo ali nokutuulapo akana kamo ka cipele, nangu akabondo ka nkunda, ngeto akwetepofye.

english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”
translation: Elyo ukulingana napo akwatile, kamo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo kambi nako nge lambo lyakoca, pamo pene no mutuulo wa cabunga. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokufutilako uulesangululwa pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.
translation: Kanshi aya e mafunde yakukonka ku muntu onse uwalwala ubulwele ubwambukila ubwankanda, nga takwete mutuulo wakuti bamusangulwilepo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose na Aroni ati,

english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,
translation: “Ilyo mukengila mu calo ca Kenani, ico ine nalamupeela ukuba icuma cenu, kabili nga nabika ukufufuma ukulunduluka mu mayanda yenu,

english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’
translation: umwine wa ŋanda iyi ali nokweba shimapepo ukuti, ‘Ine nimona ifilemoneka kwati kufufuma mu ŋanda yandi.’

english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
translation: Shimapepo ilyo talati aye kukumona ifyo iyi ŋanda ifufwime, ali nokukonkomesha ukuti bafumyemo ifipe ifili ifyafufuma muli iyi ŋanda, epali bafilumbula ukuba ifyakowela nga bafileka umo mwine. Eico na panuma ya ifi, shimapepo ali nokuya kuli iyi ŋanda nokumona ifyo ili.

english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,
translation: Ali nokumona bwino ifyo icibumba cifufwime. Nga amona icibumba cili icakatapa katapa nangu icakashikila umo citobonkele ukucila ifyo icibumba cili nokuba kunse,

english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
translation: ninshi shimapepo ali nokufumina panse ya ŋanda, no kusha aisala ilya ŋanda pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, shimapepo ali nokubwelelamo no kuya mona bwino bwino ifili iyi ŋanda. Nga amona ukufufuma nakulunduluka ku cibumba konse,

english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
translation: Mateo 8:4

english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.
translation: ali nokubakonkomesha ukufumya amabwe yonse ayafufwime no kuyaposa kunse ya musumba uko baposa ifyakowela fyonse.

english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.
translation: Afwile ukumona ukuti icibumba conse ica mukati ka ŋanda capalwa, na fyonse ifimaloba ifyo bapalile, bafwile ukuya fiposa ku ncende uko baposako ifyakowela kunse ya musumba.

english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
translation: Elyo bali nokubuula amabwe yambi no kuyapyanikishapo elintu bashingule cipya cipya icibumba.

english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,
translation: “Nga cakuti ukufufuma takupwile muli iyi ŋanda panuma yakufumyako amabwe no kupala kwa cibumba elyo no kushingwililako iloba limbi,

english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.
translation: Mako 1:44

english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.
translation: Iyi ŋanda ili nokuba yakubongololafye yonse, elyo amabwe yaiko, imbao elyo ne loba lyonse bamashileko iyi ŋanda bali nokufifumisha kunse ya musumba, no kuya fiposa ku ncende iyakowela.

english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kanshi umuntu onse uwaingila muli iyi ŋanda ilyo icili iyaisalwa, ali nokukowela mpakafye inshita ya cungulo.

english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
translation: Kabili no muntu onse uwasendamamo nangufye ukulilamo ifyakulya, afwile ukuya capa ifyakufwala fyakwe.

english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
translation: “Lelo nga cakuti shimapepo ayamona iyi ŋanda ukuti ilifye bwino, ukufufuma takutwalilile panuma yakuishingula cipya cipya, ali nokusosa ukuti iyi ŋanda naisangululwa, pantu ukufufuma nakupwa.

english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
translation: Pakusangulula iyi ŋanda shimapepo ali nokubuula ifyuni fibili, icimuti icalepesha ica keda, akasalu akakashikila elyo no tumisambo twa hisopo.

english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokukonkomesha uyu uwikete ifyuni ukuti epaile cimo pa mbale ye bumba umuli amenshi ayasuma.

english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokwipaila icuni cimo pa nongo ye bumba umuli amenshi ayalengama.

english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
translation: Elyo ali nokubuula ulukuni lwa keda, utumisambo twa hisopo, ubushishi bwakashika ce elyo ne cuni icili no mweo no kufitumpika mu mulopa wa cuni bacipaya na mu menshi ayalengama elyo nokukana ku ŋanda imiku cine lubali.

english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;
translation: Shimapepo ali nokusangulula iŋanda ku mulopa wa cuni, amenshi ayalengama, icuni icamweo, ulukuni lwa keda, utumisambo twa hisopo elyo no bushishi bwakashika ce.

english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”
translation: Panuma ya ifi fyonse shimapepo nomba ali nokuleka icuni icili icituntulu cileya mu mpanga. Na muli uyu musango, emo shimapepo ali nokufutilako iyi ŋanda, nayo ninshi yasangululwa.”

english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,
translation: Kanshi aya e mafunde yakukonka palwa malwele ya nkanda ayambukila, ifiseseya,

english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,
translation: ukufufuma kwa nsalu nangu iŋanda,

english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;
translation: nangu ukulafimba, ifipumba pa mubili, nangu ukusebeka pa nkanda,

english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.
translation: pakulangilila ukuti icintu calisangululwa nangu cintu cakowela. Aya e mafunde palwa malwele ya nkanda ayambukila elyo no kufufuma.

english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
translation: Ali nokusenda ici coni icituntulu icishelepo, icimuti icalepesha ica keda, akasalu akakashikila no tumisambo twa hisopo no kufitumpika mu mulopa wa coni bacipaila pa menshi ayasuma.

english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.
translation: Elyo shimapepo akane umulopa pa muntu uyu uulesangululwa imiku cine lubali no kusosa ukuti uyu muntu nasangululwa ku bulwele bwankanda ubwambukila. Shimapepo epakuleka icuni icituntulu ukuti cileya mu mpanga.

english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
translation: Umuntu uulesangululwa ali nokusamba ifyakufwala fyakwe, ali nokubeya umushishi no kowa, lyena ninshi asangululwa. Na panuma yakucita ifi fyonse, lyena ninshi kuti abwelela mu nkambi, lelo tali nakwingila mwi tenti lyakwe mpaka pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, uyu muntu ali nokubeya umushishi nakabili. Umushishifye onse ku mutwe, umwefu, inkopyo ku menso shonse, elyo no bupipi umubilifye onse ali nokufibeya. Kabili ali nokucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse, lyena ninshi aba uwasangululwa.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose na Aroni ati,

english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kabili uyo onse uwaikata kuli ico uyu muntu acikalapo, aba uwakowela mpaka icungulo. Elyo noyo onse uwasenda icintu conse ico acikalapo, afwile acapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Uyo onse uo umuntu umubili wakwe ulepompa, nga aikata umuntu ukwabula ukusamba ku minwe yakwe na menshi, afwile ukucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
translation: “Inongo ye bumba iyaikatwako no muntu uo umubili wakwe ulepompa, ifwile ukutobwa. Kabili icipe conse icapangilwa ne cimuti, cifwile ukucisamba bwino bwino.

english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
translation: “Nga cakuti uyu muntu uo umubili wakwe ulepompa apola, ali nokulolela pa nshiku cine lubali, epakusangululwa ku bulwele bwakwe. Lyena ali nokusamba ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi ayalepita, ninshi aba uwasangululwa.

english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.
translation: Na pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, afwile abuula utupele tubili nangu utubondo twa nkunda no kwisa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, no kufipeela kuli shimapepo.

english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokufituula ilambo, icuni cimo ukuba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, cimbi naco ce lambo lyakoca. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokufutilako uyu muntu kuli Yawe pa mulandu wa kupompa kwa mubili wakwe.

english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Umuntu onse umwaume nga apemena panshi, afwile acapafye fyonse ifyakufwala na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Eico kanshi, icintu consefye ica nsalu nangu ica mpapa ico uyu muntu apemenepo, cifwile ukucapwa na menshi, kabili cili icakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kabili nga cakuti umwaume nga asendama no mwanakashi, kabili apema no kupema, bonse babili bafwile ukusamba na menshi. Aba bantu ninshi baba abakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Umwanakashi nga aba kumpepo, ukukowela kwakwe kuli nokuba inshiku cine lubali, kabili noyo onse uwamwikatamo ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
translation: “Ebeni abena Israeli no kutila kuli bena, ‘Umwaume onse nga ku mubili wakwe kulepompa, ninshi ukupompa kwakwe kuntu kwakowela.

english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
translation: “Icintu conse ico uyu mwanakashi alalapo ilyo acili kumpepo naco cine ninshi cakowela, kabili na conse icintu ico aikalapo, naco cine ninshi cakowela.

english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Eico kanshi, uyo onse uwaikata ku busanshi bwakwe, acape ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Noyo onse uwaikata ku cintu ico ekelepo, afwile acapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Nangu cibefye busanshi nelyo icintu conse ico ekelepo, ilyo lyonse umbi umuntu aikatako, ninshi akowela mpakafye icungulo.

english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.
translation: “Eico kanshi, umwaume onse nga asendama nankwe ilyo acili kumpepo, nao wine ninshi aba uwakowela pa nshiku cine lubali. Ubusanshi bonse ubo asendamapo ninshi bwakowela.

english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.
translation: “Umwanakashi nga alapompa pa nshiku ishingi pa nshita ashili kumpepo nangu ukupompa kwakwe kwapitilila ilyo aba kumpepo, ali nokuba uwakowela lintu atwalilila ukupompa, nga filya fine ciba lyonse ilyo aba kumpepo.

english: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
translation: Ubusanshi bonse asendamapo ilyo ukupompa kwatwalilila, ninshi buntu bwakowela nga filya fine ubusanshi bwakwe buba ilyo ali kumpepo. Na conse icintu aikalapo, ninshi cakowela nga filya fine ciba ilyo ali kumpepo.

english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Umuntu onse uwaikata kuli ifi fintu, nao wine ninshi akowela. Afwile ukusamba ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
translation: “Ilyo uyu mwanakashi asanguluka, ukupompa kwapwa, ali nokulolela pa nshiku cine lubali. Panuma ya ifyo uyu mwanakashi ninshi aba uwasangululwa.

english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, uyu mwanakashi ali nokubuula utupele tubili nangu utubondo twa nkunda tubili no kutwala kuli shimapepo pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
translation: Umubili wakwe nangufye utwalilile ukupompa, nangufye wacilika nalyo line ninshi untu wakowela. Ifi efyo ukupompa kwa mubili wakwe kuli nokumulenga ukuba uwakowela.’

english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokutuulapo kamo, ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, kambi nako nge lambo lya cakoca. Na muli uyu musango emo shimapepo ali nokufutilako uyu mwanakashi kuli Yawe pa mulandu wa kukowela kwakwe palwa kupompa.

english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”
translation: “Kanshi muli nokutalusha abena Israeli ku fintu ifingabalenga ukuba abakowela, epakuti tabafwilile mu kukowela kwabo pakukowesha Itenti lyandi ilyaba pakati kabo.”

english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;
translation: Aya e mafunde yakukonka ku mwaume uo umubili wakwe ulepompa, onse uwakowela pakupemena panshi,

english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
translation: ku mwanakashi uuli kumpepo, umwaume nangu umwanakashi uo umubili wakwe ulepompa na ku mwaume uwasendama no mwanakashi uwakowela.

english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.
translation: “Ubusanshi bonse ubo uyu muntu uulepompa asendamapo, nabo bwine buli nokuba ubwakowela, ne cipuna conse ico ekalapo naco cine cintu cakowela.

english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Umuntu onse uwaikata ku busanshi bwakwe afwile acapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Kabili uyo onse uwaikala apo uyu muntu uulepompa acikala, nao wine afwile acapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: “Umuntu onse uwaikata kuli uyu muntu uo umubili wakwe ulepompa, afwile acapa ifyakufyala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo.

english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translation: Nalimo nga cakuti umuntu uo umubili wakwe ulepompa asaka umuntu umo amate, uyu muntu asakile amate nga ali uwasangululwa, ninshi uyu muntu aba uwakowela. Afwilefye ukucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpakafye icungulo.

english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
translation: “Icintu conse ico uyu muntu uo umubili wakwe ulepompa aikalapo pa lwendo naco cine ninshi cakowela.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;
translation: Yawe aebele Mose panuma ya mfwa ya bana baume bakwa Aroni ilyo bapalamine ku cinso cakwa Yawe ati,

english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
translation: Lelo imbushi iyo ukupendula kwawila kuli Asaseli, yena ali nokuileta iyituntulu ku cinso cakwa Yawe, mukufutilako pa fyabubifi no kuitamfisha mu matololo kuli Asaseli.

english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
translation: “Aroni ali nokuleka cilume wa ŋombe umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwakwe mukuifutila kuli Yawe umwine pamo pene na ba ŋanda yakwe. Kabili ali nokwipaya uyu cilume wa ŋombe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
translation: Ali nokubuula icifukilisho icaisulapo amalasha ya mulilo ukufuma pa bulambo pa cinso cakwa Yawe no bubani indupi shibili no kutwala kunuma ya cisalu icacingako umuputule wamushilo icine cine.

english: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.
translation: Ali nokubika ububani pa mulilo ukuba icakusekesha Yawe. Elyo nomba icushi ca bubani cili nokufisa Inkupiko apakufutilwapo ifyabubifi iyili pa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, epakuti tafwile.

english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
translation: Aroni ali nokutumpika umunwe wakwe mu mulopa wakwa cilume wa ŋombe no kuukana pa Nkupiko ya Mbokoshi apakufutilwapo ifyabubifi. Elyo na umbi ali nokuukana imiku cine lubali pantanshi ya Nkupiko apakufutilwapo ifyabubifi.

english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
translation: “Elyo lyena Aroni ali nokwipaya imbushi ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwa bantu no kutwala umulopa waiko kunuma ya cisalu icicingako Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, kabili umulopa wine uyu ali nokuubomfya filya fine acibomfya umulopa wakwa cilume wa ŋombe. Ali nokuukana ku Nkupiko ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano elyo na kuntanshi kwine.

english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.
translation: Kanshi na mu nshila iyi, emo ali nokufutilako icifulo camushilo icine cine pa mulandu wa kukowela na bucisanguka bwa bena Israeli mu musango onse uo babifishamo. Aroni ali nokucita cimo cine na kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo ilyaba pakati ka nkambi yabo ilyo bakowela.

english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
translation: Takuli muntu nelyo umo uwakuba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pa nshita Aroni aingilamo mukufuta mu cifulo camushilo, kanofye ilyo afumamo panuma yakuifutilako umwine eka elyo na ba ŋanda yakwe pamo pene no lukuta lonse lwa bena Israeli.

english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
translation: “Kabili ali nokufuma no kuya ku bulambo pa cinso cakwa Yawe no mulopa umo uwakwa cilume wa ŋombe na umo uwa mbushi no kuushinga ku nsengo shonse isha bulambo pakubusangulula.

english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
translation: Bahi 6:19

english: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.
translation: “Eba munonko Aroni ukuti elaisa mu muputule wamushilo icine cine pa nshita iyo umwine alefwailapo ukwishila kunuma ya cisalu cacingako pa ntanshi ya Nkupiko apakufutilwapo ifyabubi iyaba pa mulu wa Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, limbi kuti afwa. Pantu ine nakulamonekela mwikumbi pa mulu wa Nkupiko ya Mbokoshi apakufutilwapo ifyabubifi.

english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
translation: “Ilyo Aroni apwisha ukufutilako Umuputule wamushilo icine cine, Itenti Lyakukumaninamo pamo pene no bulambo, ali nokuleta nomba imbushi iyituntulu.

english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.
translation: Aroni ali nokutambalikilapo amaboko yakwe pa mutwe wa mbushi iyituntulu no kulumbula ifibi fyonse na bucisanguka bwa bena Israeli, ububifi bwabo bonse, no kufitulika fyonse pa mutwe wa mbushi. Elyo nomba panuma ya ifi fyonse, ali nokubuula iyi mbushi nokuitamfisha mu matololo ku muntu umo uwasontwa ukubomba uyu mulimo.

english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
translation: Imbushi ine iyi eili nokusenda ububifi bonse mu ncende umushaba bantu, na uyu muntu uwasalwa ukusenda iyi mbushi ali nokuileka ukuya mu matololo.

english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
translation: “Elyo Aroni ali nokuya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kufuula ifyakufwala fya bushimapepo, ifyo acifwala pakwingila mu Muputule wamushilo icine cine, no kufisha mulya mwine mwi Tenti.

english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
translation: Aroni ali nokowa umubili onse na menshi mu ncende yamushilo elyo nokufwala ifyakufwala fyakwe. Nga apwisha ukufwala, ali nokuya panse mukuleka ilambo lyakoca ilyakwefye umwine ne lambo lyakoca ilya bantu bonse, mukuifutilako umwine elyo na bantu bonse.

english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
translation: Kabili ali nokoca aya mafuta pa bulambo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi.

english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
translation: “Uyu muntu uwasendele imbushi no kuya ileka ileya kuli Asaseli, ali nokucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi. Elyo nomba kuti aingila mu nkambi.

english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.
translation: Cilume wa ŋombe pamo pene ne mbushi ifyalekelwe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, no mulopa wafiko watwalwa mu Muputule wamushilo icine cine nga ifyakuifutilako kuli Yawe, fifwile ukufifumisha kunse ya nkambi. Imikupo yafiko, iminofu ne fya mu mala fyonse fili nokocewa.

english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
translation: Umuntu uwaoca ifi fyonse afwile ukucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi. Elyo nomba panuma kuti aingila mu nkambi.”

english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;
translation: Kabili Yawe akonkomesha ukuti, “Ili e funde mufwile mulekonka lyonsefye. Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, mufwile ukuikanya no kukanabombamo imilimo yonse, imwe mwe bene, umwikalacalo nangu umweni uo mwikala nankwe.

english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
translation: “Ifi efyo Aroni afwile ukulaingila mu cifulo camushilo. Ali nokuleta iciponti ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi elyo na sukusuku nge lambo lya cakoca.

english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
translation: Pantu pa bushiku bwine ubu, ebo muli nokufutilwako kuli Yawe pa bubifi bwenu pakuti musangululwe. Muli iyi nshila muli nokuba abasangululwa ku cinso cakwa Yawe, ukufuma ku bubifi bwenu bonse.

english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
translation: Ubu bushiku bwe Sabata ubwakutuusha no kuikanya, bwakuishishamo mwe bene. Ici e cipope camuyayaya ico mufwile ukulakonka.

english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
translation: Shimapepo uwasubwa kabili uwalashikwa kukuba shimapepo, uwapeelwa na maka ayakuba pa malo yakwa wishi, eulifye nokufutilako abantu bonse kuli Yawe. Ali nokufwala ifyakufwala fya bushimapepo,

english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
translation: no kufutilako icifulo camushilo, Itenti Lyakukumaninamo, pamo pene no bulambo, na bashimapepo bonse, elyo na bantu bonse aba lukuta.

english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: “Ili lili nokuba e funde ilyamuyayaya kuli imwe, ilyakufutilako umuku umo mu mwaka pa bubifi bonsefye ubwa bena Israeli.”

english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.
translation: Ali nokufwala umwingila wamushilo uwatelela na kaputula wa nsalu iyatelela mukati. Ali nokukaka ilamba lya nsalu iyatelela mu musana no kupomba insalu iyatelela ku mutwe. Fyonse ifi ifyakufwala, fyamushilo. Eico intanshi talafwala, alingile ukowa umubili onse na menshi.

english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
translation: Kabili ku lukuta lwa bena Israeli kuli nokufuma imbushi ishilume shibili isha mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo na sukusuku umo we lambo lya cakoca.

english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
translation: “Aroni nao ali nokutuula cilume wa ŋombe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, pakuifutila umwine na ba ŋanda yakwe.

english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
translation: Elyo apendule no kumona ifyo ishi mbushi shibili shili nokwakanishiwa. Ukupendula kumo kube kwakwa Yawe elyo kumbi nako kuli Asaseli .

english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.
translation: Aroni ali nokuleta imbushi iyo ukupendula kwawila kuli Yawe no kuileka ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe atile kuli Mose,

english: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
translation: “Uyo onse umwina Israeli nangufye mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe uulya umulopa onse, Yawe ali nokumupeela umulandu pakulya umulopa kabili ena wakutamfyafye mwibumba lya bantu bakwe.

english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
translation: Pantu ubumi bwa cibumbwa conse bwaba mu mulopa, kabili eico ngupeelela kuli imwe ukuba icakumufutilako pa bulambo. Ala mulopa eufutilako ubumi bwa muntu.

english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
translation: Eico ndeeba abena Israeli ukuti, ‘Takuli umuntu nelyo umo uufwile ukulya umulopa, nangu umwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe.’

english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
translation: “Umwina Israeli onse, nangufye mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe, uwaipaya inama nangufye icuni ico abantu balya, afwile asumisha umulopa panshi no kushiikapo ne loba.

english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
translation: Pantu ubumi bwa cintu conse icamweo bwaba mu mulopa. Uyu wine e mulandu naebela abana ba Israeli ukuti, ‘Tamufwile ukulya umulopa wa camweo conse, pantu ubumi bwa cintu conse bwaba mu mulopa.’ Eico na onse uwalya umulopa, wakutamfyafye mwibumba lya bantu bakwe.

english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
translation: “Uyo onse umwikalacalo nangufye mwinafyalo uwalya inama iyaifwila, nangu iyaikatwa ku fiswango, afwile acapa insalu shakwe no kowa umubili onse na menshi, kabili ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka icungulo, elyo ninshi engaba uwasangululwa.

english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
translation: Amaf 12:16

english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:
translation: “Eba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume na bonse abena Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomeshe ifyakutila,

english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
translation: onse umwina Israeli uwaipaya iŋombe nangu impaanga nangu imbushi, mu nkambi nangu kunse ya nkambi,

english: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.
translation: ukwabula ukuti ailete pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kupeela ngo mutuulo kuli Yawe, pantanshi ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa, uyo muntu ninshi ali no mulandu wakusumya umulopa. Nasumya umulopa, eico ena uyu wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.

english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
translation: Ifi emukutila abena Israeli baleke ukuleta inama isho bepaile kumbi ukuba ishe lambo, lelo baleleta inama she lambo lyakwa Yawe pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo kuli shimapepo no kwisa fituula nge lambo lya mutuulo wakwampana.

english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokukana umulopa ku bulambo bwakwa Yawe, pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, no koca amafuta ukuba umutuulo wa cena icisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’
translation: Ifi ni pakuti tabafwile kabili ukutuula imituulo imbi iya malambo ku tulubi twa mbushi uto baicitileko bucilende pakutukonka. Ili e funde lyamuyayaya kuli bena na ku nkulo shonse ishili nokukonkapo.’

english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
translation: “Sosa kuli bene auti, ‘Uyo onse umwina Israeli nangufye mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe, nga atuula ilambo lyakoca, nangu ilambo limbifye,

english: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.
translation: nomba nga taletele ifi ku mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kutuula ili lambo kuli Yawe, uyo muntu wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.’

english: The LORD said to Moses,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama no mwishikulu obe umwana wa mwana obe umwaume, nangufye mwishikulu obe umwana wa mwana obe umwanakashi. Ici cikaleta umusebanya kuli iwe.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
“‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
translation: Gal 3:12

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama na bamunyina ba banoko. Aba bena nabo e bamunyina ba banoko icine cine.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama na bamuka bamunyina wa bawiso. Ala aba bena nabo, ni banoko.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama na nokofyala, umukashi wa mwana obe umwaume. Ala uyu wena mukashi wa mwana obe umwaume, tecakwesha ukusendama nankwe.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama no mukashi wakwa munonko bukwe bobe. Ici cikaleta umusebanya kuli munonko.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.
translation: Levi 20:17

english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukubuula munyina wa mukashi obe, bukwe bobe, ukuba umukashi umbi no kusendama nankwe ilyo umukashi obe acili umumi.

english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
“Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.
translation: “Eba abana ba Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukubuula abana benu ukuti ebo muletuulilapo umulungu Moleki ilambo, pantu tamufwile kusebanya ishina lyakwa Lesa wenu. Ine nine Yawe.

english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
translation: Amaf 27:22

english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
translation: Amaf 27:23

english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukuikowesha mu nshila sha misango iyi. Pantu iyi ine e misango iyakoweseshe imishobo ya bantu bonse, abo ndetamfya ku cinso cenu.

english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
translation: Kanshi ne calo casangwike icakowela, eico nacikandile pa mulandu wa bubifi bwaciko. Kabili ici calengele nokuti ne calo cine cibakaane no kubatamfya.

english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you
translation: Nomba imwe mufwile mulebaka amafunde yandi ne fipope fyandi. Tamufwile kucita ifyamakankamike, imwe bonse abafyalilwa mu calo pamo pene na beni abo mwaikala nabo.

english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
translation: Ifi fintu fyonse fyacitilwe na bantu abaikele mu calo ici ilyo imwe tamulaisamo. Ici calo elyo cakowelele.

english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
translation: Luka 10:28

english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
translation: Nehem 9:29

english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
translation: Imwe nomba mwilacita nga filya ficita abena Egupto kulya mwaikele, kabili tecakwesha ukulacita ifintu nga filya bacita mu calo ca Kenani uko ndemutwala. Mwilakonka imicitile yabo.

english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”
translation: Amaf 22:30

english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
translation: Mufwilefye ukulabeela amafunde yandi no kucita ifyo mfwaya. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.
translation: Mulebaka ifyo ine mfwaya na mafunde yandi yonse, pantu umuntu uubeela aya mafunde, ni ku mafunde akekalila umumi. Nine Yawe.’

english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
translation: “Umuntu onse talingile ukusendama no wa mu lupwa lwakwe nelyo umo. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusebanya wiso mukusendama na noko. Uyu wena ni noko. Wiyesha ukusendama nankwe.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama na bambi bamukawiso, ninshi wasebanya bawiso.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.
translation: Esek 18:9

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
translation: Tecakwesha ukuya mwibala lya myangashi umuku wacibili mukutola no kusaba ifitwalo fya myangashi ifyashele. Ifi fyonse filekeleni abalanda pamo na benafyalo. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.
translation: “Mwilaiba.

english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
translation: Amaf 5:12

english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
translation: “Wilaliila umunobe pa mutwe nangu ukumwibila.

english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
“‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
translation: Amaf 27:15

english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
translation: Pet 1:16

english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
translation: Amaf 27:18

english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
translation: “Eba ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli ukutila kuli bena, ‘Muleisunga mukuba abamushilo, pantu ine, ne Yawe Lesa wenu, ndi wamushilo.’

english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
translation: “Nga cakuti umwaume umo asendama no mwanakashi uucili umusha, uo balaya ku mwaume umbi, lelo uyu mukashana talati alubulwe nangu ukuba umuntungwa, balingile ukupeelwa umulandu no kukandwa. Lelo nangu cibe ifi, tabalingile ukupingulwa ukufwa iyoo, pantu uyu mukashana umusha talaba umuntungwa.

english: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
translation: Lelo umwaume afwile ukuleta sukusuku pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi kuli Yawe.

english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
translation: Levi 23:22

english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
translation: Ukuf 20:23

english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga bune, fyonse ifitwalo fili nokuba ifyamushilo, ifya mutuulo wakutashishako Yawe.

english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.
translation: Lelo mu mwaka walenga busano, lyena na imwe muli nokulyako ifitwalo. Na muli uyu musango ubusomboshi bwenu buli nokufulilako. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukulya inama iyicilimo no mulopa. Tecakwesha ukulabuka nangufye ukulowa.

english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
translation: Luka 10:27

english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukulatetaula imibili yenu umuntu nga afwa, nangu ukuikomaula inembo pa mubili. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
