translation: “Tecakwesha ukusebanya abana benu abanakashi mukubacita bacilende, pantu nga mwacita ifyo icalo cikesulamo bacilende beka beka no bubifi.

english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
translation: “Onsefye uwa muli imwe afwile ukulacindika nyina pamo na wishi, kabili afwile ukulabaka ne nshiku shandi ishe Sabata . Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.
translation: “Mulingile ukulasunga no kucindika inshiku shandi she Sabata. Mulecindika ne cifulo candi icamushilo. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
translation: Mako 12:31

english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
translation: “Mufwile lyonse ukuicefya apali abakalamba. Langeni umucinshi ku bamucilile no kukwatila Lesa wenu akatiina. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
translation: Mateo 5:33

english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
translation: Umweni uo muleikala nankwe aleba ngo wafyalilwa mu calo mumwenu. Mulemutemwa ngefyo mwaitemwa, pantu na imwe bene mwali abeni mu calo ca Egupto. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
translation: “Mwilacita bucenjeshi ilyo mulepimina abanenu ifintu mu ntamfu, mukufina na mu bwingi.

english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
translation: Bomfyeni ifipimo fyacine cine ne fyakupiminako ifyacishinka. Efa uwacishinka na hini uwacishinka. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto.

english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”
translation: Bakeni amafunde yandi yonse ne fipope fyandi fyonse, no kufikonka. Nine Yawe.”

english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
translation: “Tecakwesha nangu panono ukufuma ku cinso candi no kuya mukupepa utulubi utwaengwa ne fyela, imilungu mwaipangila mwe bene. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
translation: “Ilyo mwalatuula umutuulo we lambo lyakwampana kuli Yawe, mulingile ukutuula mu musango namukonkomeshe ukutuulilamo ilambo lyakwampana, pakuti ilambo lyenu libe ilyapokelelwa.

english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
translation: Ubushiku bwine ilambo lyatuulilwapo elyo mufwile ukulya, nangu mu bushiku bwakonkapo. Ilambo lyonse ilyashalapo ukufika pa bushiku bwakulenga shitatu, lifwilefye ukocewa.

english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwalyako kamo pali ubu bwine bushiku bwacitatu, awe ninshi ili lambo lyaba ilyakowela, no kupokelelwa teti lipokelelwe.

english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
translation: Ukuf 20:8

english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
translation: “Ilyo lyonse mwalasombola ifilyo mu mabala yenu, tecakwesha ukusombola ukufika na mu mpela ya mabala yenu, nangufye ukusolosota tonse mu busomboshi bwenu.

english: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
translation: Yawe aitile Mose ukufuma mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, alamupeela ifikomo ati,

english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
translation: “Ngo mutuulo alepeela uli lilambo lyakoca ilyafuma pa mukuni wa mpaanga, nangu ukufuma pa mbushi, ifwile yaba iyilume iyabula akalema.

english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
translation: Uuletele nama ye lambo afwile aipaila ku kapinda ka ku kuso ka bulambo pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Bashimapepo bamwana Aroni abaume bali nokukana umulopa waiko mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,
translation: Ilyo uyu muntu apwisha ukuputaula iyi nama, shimapepo ali nokubika ifipimfya fyonse pa cininkwa ca mulilo wa nkuni icili pa bulambo, kumo kwine no mutwe na mafuta.

english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Kabili ifya munda fyonse, pamo pene na molu afisambe na menshi, elyo shimapepo afilonganike pamo no kufyocela pa bulambo. Nili line ilambo lyakoca, e mutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe, uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.
translation: “Ngo mutuulo alepeela kuli Yawe uli lilambo lyakoca ilya cuni, alingile ukutuula icipele nangu utubondo twa nkunda.

english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
translation: Shimapepo ali nokucileta ku bulambo, acinyongotola no kucocela pa bulambo. Umulopa waciko auleke ukonkolokele mumbali ya bulambo.

english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
translation: Uyu shimapepo, nafumye icituka na fyonse ifilimo elyo na masako no kufiposa ku kabanga ka bulambo uko betila imito.

english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Kabili ali nokucipansa pakati, tekufumyako amapindo iyoo. Lyena shimapepo ali nokucoca pa mulilo wa bulambo. Ili e lambo lyakoca, e mutuulo wa cakoca, uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.”

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.
translation: “Sosa ku bena Israeli utile, ‘Umuntu onse ilyo aleleta umutuulo kuli Yawe, nabuulepo ica mu fitekwa fyakwe, iŋombe, impaanga nangu imbushi.’

english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
translation: “Ngo mutuulo uli lilambo lyakoca ilya ŋombe, afwile apeela iyilume iyabula akalema. Ali nokuileta pa mpongolo ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, lyena elyo Yawe ali nokupokelela.

english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
translation: Kabili natambalike ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe we lambo lyakoca, elyo lyena lili nokupokelelwa nge cakufutilwako pa bubifi bwakwe.

english: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo panuma yakwipaya cilume wa ŋombe pa cinso cakwa Yawe, bashimapepo bamwana Aroni abaume babuule umulopa no kulakana mu mbali shonse isha bulambo ku mpongolo ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
translation: Uuletele inama ye lambo lyakoca, afwile ukufunda no kuiputaula mu fipimfya finono finono.

english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;
translation: Bamwana Aroni shimapepo abaume bali nokukosha umulilo pa bulambo no kupekanya inkuni shakukoseshapo.

english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
translation: Bamwana Aroni abaume bashimapepo bali nokubikapo ifipimfya elyo no mutwe ne fya mafuta pa cininkwa ca mulilo wa nkuni icili pa bulambo.

english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Kabili ifya munda fyonse pamo pene na molu afisamfye no kufyocela pamo pa bulambo kuli shimapepo. Nili line ilambo lyakoca, e mutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe, uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
translation: Mako 7:10

english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
translation: “Umwaume onse uwasendama na muka wishi, ninshi asebanya wishi. Eico bonse umwaume no mwanakashi wine, bafwile ukwipaiwa. Umulopa wabo ukaba pa mitwe yabo.

english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
translation: “Umwaume onse uwasendama na nafyala, umukashi wa mwana wakwe, bonse babili bafwile ukwipaiwa. Pantu icintu bacita, lishiku. Umulopa wabo ukaba pa mitwe yabo.

english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
translation: “Kabili umwaume nga asendama no mwaume mubiye, ifyo balala no mwanakashi, bonse babili ninshi bacita icamuselu. Eico bonse bafwile ukwipaiwa. Umulopa wabo ukaba pa mitwe yabo.

english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
translation: Ukuf 20:14

english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
translation: “Umwaume onse uwasendama ne citekwa, afwilefye ukwipaiwa. Kabili ici citekwa cifwile naco ukucipaya.

english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
translation: “Umwanakashi onse nga apalama ku citekwa conse kukusendama naco, ipayeni umwanakashi pamo pene ne citekwa. Umulopa uli nokuba pa mutwe wa muntu ne citekwa cine.

english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.
translation: Ukuf 21:17

english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
translation: Amaf 5:18

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukusendama na bamunyina banoko nangufye ni banokosenge, pantu ici kuti casebanya uwa mu lupwa. Eico bonse babili bali nokupeelwa umulandu.

english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli utile, ‘Umwina Israeli onse nangufye umwinafyalo onse uwikala mu Israeli uwatuula umwana wakwe ku mulungu Moleki, afwile ukwipaiwa. Ibumba lya bantu lili nokumutobaula amabwe.

english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.
translation: Levi 18:20

english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
translation: Levi 18:21

english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
translation: “Mulebaka amafunde yandi yonse ne fipope fyandi fyonse no kufikonka, epakuti icalo ico ndemutwalamo ciikaya mutamfya.

english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
translation: Amaf 27:23

english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
translation: “Lelo ine namwebele ukuti, ‘Muli nokubuula icalo cabo. Nkacipeela kuli imwe kukuba icuma cenu, icalo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci.’ Nine Yawe Lesa wenu, elyo nine namupatula ukufuma ku mitundu imbi.

english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.
translation: “Eico kanshi mufwile ukulalekanya inama ishasangululwa ne shakowela, kabili ne fyuni ifyasangululwa ne fyakowela. Tecakwesha ukuikowesha ku nama yonse, nangu icuni, nangufye icintu conse icisenya pa mushili, emukutila fyonse ifyo napatula ukuti fintu ifishasangululwa kuli imwe.

english: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
translation: Mufwile ukuba abamushilo kuli ine pantu ine ne Yawe ndi wamushilo, kabili nalimupatula ukufuma ku mitundu imbi pakuti mubefye abantu bandi.

english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
translation: “Umwaume onse nangu umwanakashi onse uubuka nangu uubomba ne mipashi afwile ukwipaiwa. Mulingile ukubatobafye amabwe. No mulopa wabo uli nokuba pa mitwe yabo.”

english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
translation: Nkafutatila uyu muntu, kabili nkamutamfya na pebumba lya bantu bakwe. Pakutuula umwana wakwe ku mulungu Moleki, asebanya icifulo candi ne shina lyandi ilyamushilo.

english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
translation: Nga cakuti ibumba lya bantu lyasuula umulandu uo uyu muntu acita pakutuula umwana wakwe kuli Moleki no kufilwa ukuti bamwipaye,

english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.
translation: ine nkamufutatila pamo no lupwa lwakwe, elyo nkamutamfya pebumba lya bantu bakwe bonse, pamo pene na bonse abakonkelela bucilende bwakupepa kuli Moleki.’

english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.
translation: “Nkafutatila uyo onse uukangalukila no kuya kuli bakabuka nangu ababomba ne mipashi, no kucita nabo bucilende bwakukonka ifyo bacita, kabili ndi nokumutamfya pebumba lya bantu bakwe.

english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.
translation: Muleba abasanguluka no kuba abamushilo, pantu nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
translation: Mulebaka amafunde yandi no kuyakonka. Nine Yawe ne umulenga ukuba abamushilo.

english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu alapisha wishi nangufye ni nyina, wena uyo afwile ukwipaiwa. Pa mulandu wakuti nalapisha wishi nangu nyina, umulopa wakwe ukaba pa mutwe wakwe.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,
translation: Yawe atile kuli Mose, “Eba bashimapepo, abana baume bakwa Aroni, no kutila kuli bena, ‘Shimapepo tafwile ukuikowesha umwine eka pakupalama ku citumbi ca muntu wakwe uwafwa.

english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.
translation: “Shimapepo mukalamba umo pali bamunyina, uwasubwa pakwitilwa amafuta pa mutwe, kabili uwatambalikilwapo amaboko pakuti alefwala ifyakufwala fya bushimapepo, tafwile kuleka umushishi mu mutwe wakwe ukwabula ukusakula, nangufye ukulepaula ifyakufwala fyakwe pakulanga ukuti ali ne cililo.

english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
translation: Tafwile ukufika apali umuntu wafwa. Tafwile ukuikowesha umwine iyoo, nangu cibefye ni wishi nangu nyina ebafwile.

english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.
translation: Kabili tafwile nakufuma mu cifulo camushilo cakwa Lesa wakwe nangu ukucikowesha, pantu uyu shimapepo untu watuulwa ku mulimo wakwa Lesa wakwe mukusubwa amafuta. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
translation: “Shimapepo mukalamba afwile ukuupa umwanakashi uushatala asendamapo no mwaume.

english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
translation: Kabili tafwile kuupa mukamfwilwa, nangu uwalekwapo ku mwaume umbi, nangufye umwanakashi uwaikowesha muli bucilende, lelo ali nokubafye uushakuma ku mwaume, uwa mu bantu bakwe.

english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”
translation: Lyena takakoweshe abana bakwe mu bantu bakwe. Nine Yawe, ne ulenga ukuti abe uwamushilo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe atile kuli Mose,

english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
translation: “Eba Aroni no kutila, ‘Umukonkanina inkulo, tapali umuntu nelyo umo nga cakuti aba na kalema uwakupalama mukutuula icakulya cakwa Lesa wakwe.

english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
translation: Tapali nelyo umo uwakwisa mupepi uwakwata akalema: Impofu, icilema, uwaonaika pa menso nangu uwalemana mu nshila iyili yonse,

english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
translation: uwalemana ulukasa nangu ukuboko,

english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
translation: Kanofye nga wa mu lupwa, pamo nga nyina, wishi, umwana wakwe umwaume nangu umwanakashi, ndumenankwe

english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
translation: uwaŋongo nangu intuse, uwalemana ilinso, uwafilonda fifuma amenshi nangu mutungwi.

english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
translation: Tapali uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni uuli na kalema uwakupalama no kutuula umutuulo wa cakoca kuli ine ne Yawe. Ali na kalema, eico tafwile ukupalama kuli Lesa wakwe no kupeela umutuulo wa cakulya cakwa Lesa wakwe.

english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
translation: Lelo kuti alya icakulya icamushilo nganshi icakwa Lesa wakwe pamo pene ne camushilofye.

english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti wena muntu wakalema, tafwile ukupalama ku cisalu icacingako nangu ku bulambo pantu kuti asaalula icifulo camushilo. Nine Yawe ne ulenga ukuti babe abamushilo.’”

english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
translation: Awe Mose epakweba Aroni ifi fyonse pamo na bana bakwe abaume na bena Israeli bonse.

english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
translation: nangu nkashi yakwe uo bafyalwa nankwe kabili uushatala opwapo uo asunga, kuli aba wena kuti aikowesha.

english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
translation: Tafwile ukuikowesha umwine pakuya ku cililo ca ba mu lupwa lwa uko aupila pantu kuti aba uwakowela.’

english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
translation: “Bashimapepo bonse tabafwile kubeya imishishi ya mu mitwe yabo, nelyo ukubeya umwefu ukushinguluka akanwa, nelyo ukuitetaula umubili onse .

english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.
translation: Bafwile ukuba abamushilo kuli Lesa wabo kabili tabafwile kusebanya ishina lyakwa Lesa wabo iyoo. Pantu batuula umutuulo wacakoca kuli Yawe, icakulya cakwa Lesa wabo, eico bafwile baba abamushilo.

english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
translation: “Bashimapepo tabalingile ukuupa abanakashi abakoweshiwa muli bucilende nangu abanakashi abo balekapo, pantu bashimapepo bamushilo kuli Lesa wabo.

english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
translation: Bamoneni ukuti bamushilo, pantu ebatuula icakulya cakwa Lesa wenu. Eico bamoneni abamushilo pantu nine Yawe ne umulenga ukuba abamushilo pantu ndi wamushilo.

english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
translation: “Mwana shimapepo umwanakashi nga cakuti ailenga ukukanaba uwamushilo mukuba cilende, ninshi asebanya wishi. Uyu mwana wena, afwilefye ukocewa mu mulilo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe atile kuli Mose,

english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
translation: “Umuntu onse uushili wa mu lupwa lwa bushimapepo tali nakulyako umutuulo wamushilo. Nangufye mweni wine uwakwa shimapepo no mubomfifye wakwe wine tali nakulyako.

english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
translation: Lelo shimapepo nga cakuti ashita umusha no lupiya lwakwefye, nangu nga cakuti mu ŋanda mumwakwe emo umusha afyalilwa, uyu musha wena kuti alyako ifyakulya fyakwe.

english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
translation: Umwana umwanakashi uwakwa shimapepo nga aupwa ku mwaume uushili shimapepo, tali nakulyako ku musangulo wamushilo onse.

english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
translation: Lelo uyu mwana umwanakashi wakwa shimapepo nga aba mukamfwilwa, nangu nga bamulekafye nomba takwete bana, elyo abwelela kuli wishi mukwikala nga lilya ali umusepela, awe lyena kuti ayamba ukulyako ifilyo fyakwa wishi. Lelo umuntu uushasuminishiwa kulyako uyu mutuulo wa fyakulya fyamushilo, wena tafwile ukulyako.

english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
translation: “Umuntu uuli onse nga cakuti alya icakulya ca mutuulo icamushilo mukukanaishiba, afwile ukubwesesha shimapepo uyo mutuulo wamushilo alile. Kabili ali nokulundapo icacisano pa cintu conse ico alile.

english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,
translation: Bashimapepo tabafwile ukusaalula imituulo yamushilo iyo abena Israeli batuula kuli Yawe

english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
translation: pakusuminisha abantu ukulalya kuli iyi mituulo yamushilo, no kulenga ukuti bakwatilapo imilandu iyo bali nokufutilapo. Nine Yawe, ne ulenga ukuti babe abamushilo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe atile kuli Mose,

english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:
translation: “Eba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume na bena Israeli bonse utile kuli bena, ‘Nga cakuti umo uwa pali imwe, abe umwina Israeli nangu umweni uo mwikala nankwe mu calo ca Israeli, nga apeela icabupe ce lambo lyakoca kuli Yawe, ilambo lyakufikilisha umulapo nangu ilyakuitemenwafye umwine,

english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
translation: afwile ukupeela inama iyilume iyabula akalema ukufuma pa mukuni wakwe uwa ŋombe, impaanga nangu imbushi pakuti fipokelelwe mukumwimininako.

english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.
translation: “Eba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ukuti balesunga no mucinshi imituulo yonse iyamushilo iyo abena Israeli bantuula ne Yawe ukuti tabasebenye ishina lyandi ilyamushilo. Nine Yawe.

english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
translation: Tecakwesha ukuleta conse icili na kalema, pantu tacakapokelelwe mukumwimininako.

english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
translation: Ilyo lyonse umuntu aleta ice lambo lyakwe ukufuma pa mukuni wa ŋombe nangu impaanga kukuba umutuulo wakwampana kuli Yawe, kukufikilisha umulapo nangu umutuulo wakuitemenwa, ninshi inama ya mutuulo we lambo ifwile ukuba iyabula akalema akali konse pakuti ipokelelwe.

english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.
translation: Tecakwesha ukutuula inama ye lambo iyishimona, iyacenwa nangu iyafunika, yonse iyakwata ifipumba, iya filonda ifyatukila nangu ifilesuma. Tecakwesha ukubika ishi nama pa bulambo nge lambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe.

english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
translation: Nalimo kuti mwatuula inama ye lambo lyakuitemenwa iŋombe nangu impaanga iyatusa, atemwa iyalemana mu musango uli onse lelo talili nakupokelelwa nge cakufikilishapo umulapo.

english: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
translation: Tecakwesha ukutuula kuli Yawe inama ilume iyo intoyo shakwebululwa, ishatinaulwa, ishalepulwa nangu ukuputulwa. Tamufwile ukucita ifi mu calo cenu.

english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
translation: Kabili tamufwile kulapoka inama sha musango uyu ukufuma ku benafyalo no kushituula ngo mutuulo wa fyakulya kuli Lesa wenu. Tafyakapokelelwe mukumwimininako pantu fyalibamo no bulema.’”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: “Ilyo lyonse iŋombe, impaanga, nangu imbushi yafyalwa, ifwile ukuba na nyina pa nshiku cine lubali. Elyo ukufuma pa bushiku bwa cine konse konse no kuya kuntanshi, awe lyena naisuminishiwa ukuba umutuulo we lambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe.

english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
translation: Tecakwesha ukwipaya iŋombe atemwa impaanga no twana twashiko mu bushiku bumo bwine.

english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
translation: “Ilyo lyonse muletuula umutuulo wakutotela kuli Yawe, utuuleni mu nshila yakuti ukapokelelwe mukumwimininako.

english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.
translation: Bebe auti, ‘Mu nkulo ishili nokukonkapo, umuntu onse uwa mu lupwa lwenu nga tali uwasangululwa elyo aisa palama mupepi ne mituulo yamushilo iyo abena Israeli batuula kuli Yawe, uyu muntu wakutamfyafye ku cinso candi. Nine Yawe.’

english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
translation: Ufwile ukuliwa pa bushiku bwine ubo mwautuula. Tewakushako nangu kamo mpaka ulucelo. Nine Yawe.

english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
translation: Tecakwesha ukusebanya ishina lyandi ilyamushilo. Mfwile ukwishibikwa kuli imwe mwe bena Israeli ukuti ine ndi wamushilo. Nine Yawe, ne ulenga ukuti mube abamushilo,

english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
translation: kabili uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto no kuba Lesa wenu. Nine Yawe.”

english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
translation: “Umuntu onse uwa mu luko lwakwa Aroni nga alilwala ubulwele bwankanda ubwambukila, nangu uupompa, uyu wena tafwile ukulya ifilyo fya mutuulo wamushilo, mpakafye ilyo asangululwa. Kabili akaba uwakowela nga aikata ku cikoweshiwe ne citumbi nangu ku mwaume onse upemene panshi.

english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
translation: Akaba uwakowela nga akumya ku cikulika panshi conse, nangufye akumya ku muntu onse uwingamulenga ukuba uwakowela, mu musango onse uo icamukowesha cingabelamo.

english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
translation: Umuntu uwakumyako kuli ifi, ali nokuba uwakowela mpaka inshita ya cungulo. Tafwile kulyako mutuulo wamushilo mpaka asamba umubili onse na menshi.

english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kawa, uyu muntu ninshi asangululwa. Na panuma yakusangululwa lyena ali ne nsambu yakulyako umutuulo wa fyakulya fyamushilo, pantu nomba fyaba fyakulya fyakwe.

english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
translation: Tafwile kulya icaifwila, nelyo inama iyaipaiwa ne finama fibiye ifya mpanga. Nga acita ifyo ninshi aikowesha umwine pa mulandu wakulyako. Nine Yawe.

english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
translation: “Bashimapepo bonse bali nokucita ifyo nabakonkomesha epakuti bekaba mu milandu no kufwila mu cifulo camushilo pa mulandu wakusuula amafunde yandi. Nine Yawe uubalenga ukuba abamushilo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Ilyo mukengila mu calo ico ine ndi nokumupeela, no kwamba ukulobolola iŋanu, mukalete kuli shimapepo umwanshi wa ŋanu mukabalilapo ukulobolola.

english: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokutambika uyu mwanshi kuli Yawe pakuti upokelelwe mukumwimininako. Shimapepo ali nokuutambika pa bushiku ilyo Isabata lyapita.

english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
translation: Mufwile ukuutuula pamo pene no mutuulo wa cabunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwa twapekumi tubili twa ku cipimo ca efa , kabili ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa, umutuulo we lambo lya cakoca ica cena cisuma icakusekesha Yawe. Kabili umutuulo wa cakunwa ufwile ukuba icipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini wa mwangashi.

english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
translation: Ukuf 23:16

english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
translation: Ukufumafye konse uko mukekala, cila muntu alingile ukuleta imikate ibili iyapangilwa no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwapangilwa ku twapekumi tubili utwa ku cipimo ca efa, kabili umwaba intutumushi. Uyu e mutuulo wakutambika uwa fisabo fyantanshi kuli Yawe.

english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
translation: Kabili muli nokutuula sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, no twana twa mpaanga tubili utwa mwaka umo ngo mutuulo wakwampana.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Ishi ni nshikunkulu shakwa Yawe ishasontwa mukulongana kwamushilo.’ Neshi nshiku shaba ifi:

english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokutambika utwana twa mpaanga tubili kuli Yawe, pamo pene no mukate wa fitwalo fyantanshi, ngo mutuulo wakutambika. Ifi fyonse mutuulo wamushilo kuli Yawe uwakwa shimapepo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli utile, ‘Pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi walenga cine lubali, mufwile ukulatuushamo no kukwatamo ukulongana kwamushilo, na mapenga yali nokulalila pakusefya.

english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
translation: Tecakwesha ukulabombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku, kanofye ukutuula ilambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe.’”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: “Ubushiku bwalenga ikumi limo mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, e bushiku bwakufuta pa fyabubifi. Mulingile ukukwata ukulongana kwamushilo no kuikanya. Mutuule ilambo lya cakoca kuli Yawe.

english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
translation: Tecakwesha ukubomba umulimo nelyo umo pali ubu bushiku, pantu ubu bushiku bwakufuta pa fyabubifi, ilyo bamufutilako kuli Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
“‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
translation: “Kwabafye inshiku mutanda isho mwingabombamo imilimo, lelo ubushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwena bushiku bwe Sabata ubwakutuusha, ubushiku bwa kulongana kwamushilo. Tamufwile kubombamo umulimo nelyo umo. Konsefye uko mwaikala, bushiku bwe Sabata kuli Yawe.

english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
translation: Ndi nokonaula umuntu onse uwa mu bantu bakwe uyo uwabomba umulimo pali ubu bushiku.

english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
translation: Tamulingile kubombapo umulimo nangufye panono. Ili lifunde lyamuyayaya ilili nokukonkwa umukakonkanina inkulo, uko konse mukekala.

english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
translation: Ubu bukaba bushiku bwenu bwakutuusha bwe Sabata, kabili mufwile no kuikanya mwe bene. Cili nokubafye ukufuma icungulo pa bushiku bwalenga pabula ubwa mweshi wine uyu ukufika na ku cungulo icili nokukonkapo, mufwile ukubaka ili Sabata lyenu.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli utile, ‘Pa bushiku bwe kumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi wa cine lubali ninshi inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe kuli Yawe yatampa kabili ili nokupwisha inshiku cine lubali.

english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
translation: Ubushiku bwakutampilapo, bushiku bwa kulongana kwamushilo. Muli ubu bushiku tecakwesha ukulabombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku.

english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
translation: Pa nshiku cine lubali mukaletuula kuli Yawe ilambo lya cakoca. Kabili pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse mukalekwata ukulongana kwamushilo no kutuula kuli Yawe ilambo lya cakoca. Uku kuli nokuba ekulongana kwa kwisalila. Tecakwesha ukubombapo umulimo wa cila bushiku nangu umo.’

english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
translation: “Kanshi ishi e nshikunkulu isho Yawe asonta, isho mulingile ukubila ngo kulongana kwamushilo. Pakulongana muleleta kuli Yawe imituulo yakoca, amalambo ya cakoca, imituulo ya cabunga, amalambo ne fyakunwa nge mituulo iyifwaikwa cila bushiku.

english: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
translation: Iyi mituulo yonse, yakulundafye pa mituulo ituulwa kuli Yawe pa nshiku sha Masabata, kabili ukulunda pa fyabupe fyenu, na pali conse ico mwalaya pamo pene no mutuulo wakuitemenwa uo mutuula kuli Yawe.

english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
translation: “Eico ukwamba pa bushiku bwe kumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi wa cine lubali, panuma yakusombola ifilyo mu mabala, mulesefya iyi nshikunkulu yakwa Yawe pa nshiku cine lubali. Ubushiku bwakubalilapo, bushiku bwakutuusha, kabili ubushiku bwa cine konse konse nabo bwine bushiku bwakutuushamo.

english: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
translation: “Ishi ni nshikunkulu ishasontwa ishakwa Yawe, isha kulongana kwamushilo, isho mulingile ukulabila pa nshita ishasontwa.

english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
translation: Pa bushiku bwine bwakubalilapo, mukalesaba ifitwalo ifyawamisha ukufuma ku fimiti. Mukaleteta utuncindu, amabula ya miti iyafumba ne misambo ya miti ya ku mumana, no kulasansamuka pa cinso cakwa Yawe Lesa wenu pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
translation: Mukalesefya ici nge nshikunkulu kuli Yawe pa nshiku cine lubali cila mwaka. Ili lifunde lyamuyayaya ilili nokukonkwa umukakonkanina inkulo. Eico mulesefya mu mweshi wa cine lubali.

english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
translation: Kabili muli nokulaikala mu nsakwe pa nshiku cine lubali. Abena Israeli bonse bali nokwikala mu nsakwe,

english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
translation: epakuti abana benu abakamukonkapo bakeshibe ukuti nine nalengele abena Israeli ukwikala mu nsakwe, ilyo nabafumishe mu calo ca Egupto. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
translation: Kanshi efyo Mose aebele abena Israeli pa nshikunkulu shasontwa ishakwa Yawe.

english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
translation: “Ipasaka lyakwa Yawe, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, litendeka cilya akasuba kawa pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14), mu mweshi wantanshi.

english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
translation: Lelo mu bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shisano (15), mu mweshi wine uyo, e bushiku bwakutendekelapo inshikunkulu yakwa Yawe iya mikate iyishatutumuka. Eico mu nshiku cine lubali mufwile ukulalya imikate iyishatutumuka.

english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
translation: Pa bushiku bwantanshi mukakwata ukulongana kwamushilo, kabili mwikalabombapo imilimo ya cila bushiku.

english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebelele Mose ati,

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
translation: Nomba kwali umwaume, nyina ali umwina Israeli, wishi nao ali umwina Egupto. Afumine mu ŋanda yakwe pakati ka bana ba Israeli no kuya mukulwa no mwina Israeli mukati ka nkambi.

english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
translation: Elyo uyu mwana wa mwanakashi umwina Israeli asaalwile Yawe icine cine ilyo atukile ishina lyakwe. Awe abantu bamutwele kuli Mose. Ishina lyakwa nyina ni Shelomiti, umwana mwanakashi wakwa Dibili uwa mu luko lwakwa Dani.

english: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
translation: Elyo bamubikile mukulindwa mpaka bakomfwe ifyo Yawe akabeba ukucita.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
translation: “Fumyeni uyo muntu wamusaalula kunse ya nkambi. Kabili lekeni onse uumfwileko ku musaalula atambike amaboko yakwe pa mutwe wakwe no kuleka nomba ulukuta lonse lumutobe amabwe.

english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
translation: Elyo webe na bena Israeli utile, ‘Umuntu onse uwatuka Lesa wakwe, alifye nokupeelwa umulandu.

english: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
translation: Umuntu onse uwasaalula ishina lyakwa Yawe afwilefye ukwipaiwa. Ulukuta lonse luli nokumulasa amabwe. Nelyo abefye umweni nangufye umwina Israeli, ali nokufwa nga cakuti asaalula ishina lyakwa Yawe.’

english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
translation: “Umuntu uuli onse nga cakuti aipaya umuntu munankwe, nao wine bafwile ukumwipaya.

english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
translation: Uyo onse uwaipaya icitekwa ca munankwe, afwile ukupyanikishapo cimbi. Umweo pa mweo.

english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
translation: “Umuntu uuli onse nga cakuti acena umunankwe, ifyo fine acita ku munankwe efyo nao afwile bamucitila.

english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
translation: “Konkomesha abena Israeli pakuti baleleta amafuta kuli iwe ayo bengulula ku miolifa ayalengama, pakuleka ulubuuto lwa fisaniko lutwalilile ukulayaka.

english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
translation: Nga akontwele umunankwe ifupa, nao wine bali nokumukontola ifupa, nga linso nao wine ninshi linso line, nga lino nao wine ninshi lino line. Ifyo fine umusango acenenamo umunankwe, efyo nao wine bali nokumucena.

english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
translation: Amaf 19:21

english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
translation: Ala mufwilefye ukukwata ifunde limo line, umweni wa mu calo no mwina Israeli wine. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
translation: Kunse ya cisalu cakucinga ku Mbokoshi ya Cipangano mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, Aroni akalamona ukuti ifisaniko fili nokutwalilila ukwaka ifyo fine pa cinso cakwa Yawe ukufuma icungulo mpakafye ulucelo. Ili lifunde lyamuyayaya ilili nokukonkwa umukakonkanina inkulo shenu.

english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
translation: Ifi fisaniko ifyaba pa cakutekapo ica golide wine wine pa cinso cakwa Yawe, fifwile ukusungwa bwino no kulayaka pe mukutwalilila.”

english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Buula ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino no kupangako imikate ikumi limo na ibili. Cila mukate ulebomfya utwapekumi tubili ku cipimo ca efa utwa bunga.

english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
translation: Iyi mikate mukalebika mu mitande ibili pamulu we tebulo ilyapangilwa na golide wine wine pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Cila mutande muleba imikate mutanda.

english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Pa mutande onse ulebikapo icinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icisuma icine cine, nge ciputulwa ca cibukisho cakwimininako umukate, kabili kukuba umutuulo wakutuula kuli Yawe uwa cakoca.

english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translation: Uyu mukate Aroni ali nokuubika pa cinso cakwa Yawe lyonsefye cila bushiku bwe Sabata, mukwimininako abena Israeli nge cipangano camuyayaya.

english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
translation: Ifi fyonse fili nokuba ifyakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume lyonsefye, kabili bali nokufilila mu ncende iyamushilo. Cili nokuba ifi pantu fyamushilo nganshi pa fyakaniko fyonse ifyo bapeelwa pa mituulo iyituulwa kuli Yawe iya fyakoca.”

english: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
translation: Yawe alandile kuli Mose pa lupili lwa Sinai ati,

english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
translation: Mukaleshisha umwaka walenga amakumi yasano no kulashimikila icebo cakulubuka mu calofye conse ku bekashi abekalamo. Uyu uli nokuba e mwaka wakusefya kuli imwe. Onsefye umuntu ali nokubwelelamo ku mpanga ya fikolwe fyakwe kabili na ku lupwa lwakwe.

english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
translation: Umwaka walenga amakumi yasano kuli imwe wakusefya. Muli uyu mwaka tecakwesha ukubyalamo nangu ukusombola fyonse ifilyo ifyaimenena ifine, nangu ukusaba ku myangashi mushatungwilile.

english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
translation: Pantu umwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya, mwaka wamushilo kuli imwe. Mufwile ukulyafye ifisabo ifili nokufuma mu mabala.

english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
translation: “Muli uyu mwaka wakusefya, umuntu onsefye ali nokubwelelamo ku mpanga ya fikolwe fyakwe.

english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
translation: “Nga cakutila washita impanga ku mwikalacalo munobe, nangu washitisha kuli ena, tecakwesha ukufyengana.

english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
translation: Uli nokushita iyi mpanga ku mubiyo pakumona imyaka yapitapo ilyo umwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya wapitile. Kabili ali nokushitisha iyi mpanga pakumona imyaka iyashalako iyakulobololamo ifisabo mu mabala.

english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
translation: Nga cakuti imyaka yashalako ingi, ufwile lyena walundako umutengo. Kabili nge myaka yashalako inono, ufwile nalyo line ukucefyako umutengo, pantu icintu ico uyu muntu alekushitisha te mpanga iyoo, lelo fisabo ifyo akakushamo pa myaka yashalako.

english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
translation: Tecakwesha ukulafyengana, lelo mulekwata akatiina kuli Lesa wenu. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
translation: “Mulingile ukukonka amafunde yandi no kusakamana ukubeela ifipope fyandi fyonse, lyena elyo mukekala umutelelwe mu calo.

english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
translation: No mushili wabamo ukalatwala ifitwalo fisuma, mukalalya no kwikuta kabili mukalaikala umutelelwe mu calo.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Ilyo mukengila mu calo ico ndepeela kuli imwe, icalo conse cifwile ukutuusha mukusunga Isabata lyakwa Yawe.

english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
translation: “Limo kuti mwaipusha, ‘Nga tukalalya nshi muli uyu mwaka walenga cine lubali, nga cakutila tatubyele mbuto nangu ukulobolola ifisabo?’

english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
translation: Ine, ne Yawe, nkapaala icalo ici pa myaka mutanda pakuti cikakwate ifilyo ifingi pa myaka itatu.

english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
translation: Ilyo mukalabyala ifisabo mu mwaka walenga cine konse konse, mukalalya ifyo mwasombwele mu mwaka walenga mutanda, mpakafye ilyo mukakwata ukulobolola mu mwaka walenga pabula.”

english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Tecakwesha ukushitisha impanga ukuba iya umbi pe, pantu iyi mpanga yandi, imwe mulifye abeni abasuminishiwa ukwikalamofye.

english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
translation: Impanga yonse iyo mwapeelwa nge cikwatwa, mufwile ukupekanya ifyakulubula iyi mpanga.

english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
translation: Nga cakuti umwina Israeli munenu umo aba umulanda elyo ashitishako impanga yakwe, uwa mu lupwa uupaleme afwile aisa lubula iyi mpanga.

english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
translation: Nga cakuti nalimo takwetepo nelyo umo uwakumwafwilisha mukulubula iyi mpanga, lelo umwine eka nga aisa ba ne cuma icakuti ailubwilamo,

english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
translation: ali nokupenda imyaka iyo impanga yali nokushala mu minwe ya washitile. Kabili ali nokulipila indalama ukulingana ne myaka iyashala ku mwaka wakusefya. Awe lyena uyu uwali e mwine wa mpanga kale, kuti abwelela mu mpanga yakwe.

english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti, takwete ifyuma fyakulubwilamo impanga iyi, awe ili nokubafye mu minwe ya uyu wine muntu uwaishitile mpaka umwaka walenga amakumi yasano wakusefya ukafike. Impanga ili nokubwelela ku mwine mu mwakafye wakusefya, elyo uyu muntu uwashitishe akabwelela mu mpanga yakwe.

english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu ashitisha iŋanda iyaba mwilinga lya musumba, ali nokukwata insambu yakuilubula umwaka umo uutuntulu nga wapwa ukufuma apo aishitishishe. Mu nshita ilya ine, lyena kuti alubula iyi ŋanda.

english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
translation: Pa myaka mutanda mulebyala imbuto mu mabala yenu. Kabili pa myaka mutanda ine, mufwile ukutungwila ifimuti fya myangashi mu mabala yenu no kusombola ifisabo fyenu.

english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti talubwile iyi ŋanda, ilyo uyu mwaka utuntulu taulapita, iyi ŋanda iyaba mwilinga lya musumba ili nokuba nomba iyakwa kashita no lupwa lwakwe umukakonkanina inkulo, ninshi capwa. Tali nakuibwesesha ku mwine nangufye umwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya ukafike.

english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
translation: Lelo amayanda aya mu mishi ukushashinguluka amalinga, yena yali nokulolekeshiwapo nga yaba mu mpangafye ya calo. Yonse aya mayanda yali nokulubulwa. Yonse aya mayanda kuti yalubulwa, kuti yabwelela ku bene mu mwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya.

english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.
translation: Lelo abena Levi nabakwata insambu shakulubula amayanda yabo mu misumba yabo yonse iyo bapeelwa.

english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
translation: Eico kanshi icuma ca mwina Levi cena calisuminishiwa ukucilubula, emukutila iŋanda iyashitishiwa mu musumba uuli onse untu bapeelwa ili nokubweseshiwa mu mwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya, pantu amayanda ayaba mu misumba ya bena Levi fyuma fyabo ifyaba pakati ka bana ba Israeli.

english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
translation: Lelo incende shakucemenamo ifitekwa ishashinguluka imisumba yabo tashifwile kushitishiwa, pantu shena fyuma fyabo ifya pe na pe.”

english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
translation: “Nga cakuti umwina Israeli munenu umo aba umulanda kabili afilwa ukuisunga umwine pakati kenu, mwafweniko ngefyo mwafwilisha umwinafyalo uwikala pakati kenu, pakuti nao atwalilile ukwikala pakati kenu.

english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
translation: Tecakwesha ukupoka ukufuma kuli ena nsonsela iyili yonse, lelo mube na katiina ka kuli Lesa pakuti uyu mwikalacalo munenu atwalilile ukwikala pakati kenu.

english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
translation: Tecakwesha ukumukongwesha indalama pakuti akalundepo kansonsela ilyo akabwesha, nangufye ukumushitisha ifyakulya pakuti mumwenepo akantu kamo.

english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
translation: Nine Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumya mu calo ca Egupto no kumupeela impanga ya calo ca Kenani nokuti mbe Lesa wenu.”

english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
translation: “Nga cakuti umo pa bekalacalo banenu aba umulanda pakati kenu, kabili aishitisha umwine kuli imwe, tecakwesha ukumuleka ukubomba ngo musha.

english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
translation: Lelo mu mwaka walenga cine lubali, icalo cifwile ukukwata ukutuusha umwaka onse uwe Sabata, nge Sabata lyakwa Yawe. Tecakwesha ukubyala amabala yenu, nangufye ukutungwila ifimuti fya myangashi yenu.

english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
translation: Mufwilefye ukumubomfya ngo mubomfi wa malipilo, nangu filya mubomfya umweni uo mwikala nankwe. Ali nokulamubombela mpakafye mu mwaka walenga amakumi yasano (50) uwakusefya.

english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
translation: Lyena uyu muntu pamo na bana bakwe ali nokulekelwako no kubwelelamo ku ba lupwa ku mpanga sha bashibo.

english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
translation: Pantu abena Israeli babomfi bandi, abo nafumishe mu calo ca Egupto, tabafwile kushitishiwa nga basha iyoo.

english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
translation: Tecakwesha ukulabasunga buluku buluku, lelo mube na katiina kuli Lesa wenu.

english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
translation: “Abasha benu abaume na banakashi abo mwingakwata, kuti bafuma ku mishobo iyo iyamushinguluka iyishaishiba Lesa. Uko eko mwingashita abasha abaume na abanakashi.

english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
translation: Kabili kuti mwashita abasha bamo ukufuma mu benafyalo abo mwikala nabo, pamo na ba mu lupwa lwabo abafyalilwa mu calo cenu. Aba bene ebengaba ifyuma fyenu.

english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
translation: Kabili kuti mwabashila na ku bana benu nge fyuma fyacishilano no kubacita abasha mpaka ne mfwa yabo. Lelo tamufwile kusunga buluku buluku abena Israeli banenu.

english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
translation: “Umwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe nga aisa ba umukankala, elyo umo umwina Israeli munenu aisa ba umulanda no kuishitisha ku mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe, nangufye kuli lupwa lwa aba benafyalo,

english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
translation: uyu muntu ali ne nsambu yakuilubula umwine panuma yakuishitisha umwine. Na umo uwa muli bamunyina kuti amulubula,

english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
translation: nangu ni nalume, umufyala wakwe nangufye onse lupwa lwakwe uwa mu mukowa wakwe kuti amulubula. Nga cakuti umwine akwata ifyakuilubwilapo, afwile ailubula umwine.

english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
translation: Tecakwesha no kusombola icintu nelyo cimo icikaimenenafye icine, nangu ukulobolola imyangashi iyo mushatungwilile. Pantu ukaba mwaka wakutuusha kwa mpanga.

english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
translation: Umwine no wamushitile bakapende imyaka ukufuma apo aishitishe ukufika ku mwaka walenga amakumi yasano (50) uwakusefyamo. Umutengo wakulubwilwamo uli nokulingana na malipilo ya mubomfi uwacibalo, ukukonka ne myaka ine iyo.

english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
translation: Nga cakuti imyaka yashalako yafula, uyu muntu afwilefye ukulipila ifyuma ukulingana ne myaka yashalako pakuti alubulwe.

english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti imyaka yashalako inono apo mwaka wakusefya taulafika, alifye nokulinganya umutengo wakuilubula ne myaka yashalako.

english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
translation: Alingile ukusungwa ngo mubomfi wamalipilo cila mwaka. Mushininkishe ukuti shikulu wakwe talemusunga buluku buluku.

english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.
translation: Nangu cingati uyu muntu talubwike muli ishi nshila shonse, wena pamo na bana bakwe bafwilefye ukulekelwako mu mwaka wakusefya nga wafika,

english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
translation: pantu abena Israeli babomfi bandi. Bena, babomfi bandi abo nafumishe ku calo ca Egupto. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
translation: Conse icaimenena mu mabala yenu mu mwaka wakutuusha uwe Sabata, ecikaba icilyo cenu bonse, ababomfi benu abaume na babomfi benu abanakashi, na ku babomfi bamalipilo, pamo pene na ku mweni uo mwikala nankwe.

english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
translation: Kabili na ku fitekwa fyenu fine pamo pene na ku nama sha mu mpanga yenu, conse icikafuma muli iyi mpanga ecikaba icakulya cenu.’”

english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Ukalependa Amasabata cine lubali aya myaka, emukutila imyaka cine lubali imiku cine lubali, epakuti amasabata cine lubali yakalingane ne myaka amakumi yane na pabula (49).

english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
translation: Lyena ubushiku bwalenga ikumi mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, mukalishe ipenga, likomfwike konse konse. Pa bushiku ubu ubwakufuta pa fyabubifi, mukalishe ipenga mpangafye yonse mu calo cenu.

english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
translation: “Tecakwesha ukulapanga utulubi, nangu ukwimika icintu conse ukuba icimpashanya, nangu ukusangula ilibwe ukuba ilyamushilo. Kabili tecakwesha ukwimika ilibwe ilyabaswa bwino mu calo cenu no kulifukamina mukulipepa. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.

english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
translation: Mukalalya ifilyo mwatutile umwaka wapita ilyo mukalafitutulula mu matala yenu no kusha incende ya busomboshi ubupya.

english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
translation: Elyo nkabika ne cifulo candi pakati kenu, kabili nshakamutendwe nakalya.

english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation: Lyonse nkalaba na imwe no kuba Lesa wenu, na imwe mukaba abantu bandi.

english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
translation: Nine Yawe Lesa wenu uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto pakuti mwiba abasha nakabili ku bena Egupto. Nine naputawile ifikakilo fya makoli ya busha bwenu no kulenga ukuti muleyendelafye.

english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
translation: “Nomba nga cakuti mwakaana ukumbeela no kukonka amafunde yandi yonse aya namukonkomesha,

english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
translation: elyo nga cakuti mwakaana no kunakila amafunde yandi, mwasuula ne fyebo pamo ne fipope fyandi no konaula icipangano candi,

english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
translation: Kol 6:16

english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
translation: Nkamwalukila pakuti abalwani benu bakamucimfye. Abamupata ebakalamuteeka. Kabili mukalaibutukilafye nangu tapali nelyo umo uulemubutusha.

english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
translation: “Nga cakuti na panuma yakucita ifi fyonse tamunakile, lyena ndi nokumukanda pa bubifi bwenu pa miku ukucila cine lubali.

english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
translation: Ine, ne Yawe nkamupwisha icilumba. Kabili nkalenga umulu ukuba kwati cela, no mushili nao ukukosa ngo mukuba kukuuma.

english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.
translation: “Mulebaka Amasabata yandi, kabili mulecindika icifulo candi icamushilo. Nine Yawe.

english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
translation: Amaka mukalabomfya mu milimo yenu yakaba yakuicushafye, pantu umushili wenu tawakatale aumesha ifisabo fyauko, nangufye ifimiti fya mu mpanga tafyakatwale.

english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
translation: “Nalyo line imwe nga mwatwalililafye ukutalama no kukanaumfwa, ndi nokulundapo na fimbi ifikuko imiku cine lubali ukucilapo ukulingana no bubifi bwenu.

english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
translation: Nkatuma ifiswango fya mpanga ukumwimina, ifili nokwisa ipaya abana benu elyo nokonaula ifitekwa fyenu. Fili nokulenga ukuti mukacepe mu mpendwa icakuti ne misebo yenu tamwakabe bakupitamo.

english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
translation: “Nalyo line ifi fyonse nga tafimwalulwile, lelo mwatwalililafye mukuntalamina,

english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
translation: na ine wine nomba ndi nokumutalamina, nkamwalukila no kumukanda pa bubifi bwenu imiku cine lubali ukucilapo.

english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
translation: Kabili nkaleta pali imwe ulupanga ulwacilandushi pa mulandu wakonaula icipangano candi. Elyo nga mukalabutukila mu misumba yenu kukupusuka, namo mwine nkamutumina ifikuko no kumuposa mu minwe ya balwani.

english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
translation: Ilyo ndi nokucefyako impendwa ya mikate mulya, banamayo ikumi limo bakabomfya ibuku limo pakupanga umukate. Bakalamupimina umukate wakupoka pakuti nga mwalya tamwikwite.

english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
translation: “Nalyo line ine nga nacita ifi fyonse tamuŋumfwile, lelo mwatwalililafye ukuntalamina,

english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
translation: lyena nkamutalamina kabili nkamukanda pa bubifi bwenu pa miku cine lubali ukucilapo.

english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
translation: Mukaba ne cipowe icikalamba icakuti mukalelya imibili ya bana benu abaume ne mibili ya bana benu abanakashi.

english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
translation: “Nga mwalakonka amafunde yandi no kulabeela ifipope fyandi,

english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
translation: Ndi nokonaula incende shenu ishakupepelamo isho mwacindamika no kubongolola ifibumbili fya malambo fyenu ifyakufutumwinapo ububani. Nkatulika ifitumbi fyenu pa mulu wa tulubi twenu utushipema, kabili nkamusuula.

english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
translation: Nkalenga imisumba yenu ukuba ifibolya no konaula ififulo fyenu ifyamushilo, kabili nshakatale mpokelela icena canunka ubusaka ica mituulo yenu.

english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.
translation: Nkonaula icalo cenu, icakuti abalwani benu abakesa ikalamo bakalepapafye.

english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
translation: Ine nkamulenga ukusalanganina mu mishobo iyalekana lekana. Kabili nkaleta pali imwe ulupanga no kumulimuna bonse. Icalo cenu cikonaulwa, ne misumba yenu yonse ili nokusangulwa ifibolya.

english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
translation: Elyo lyena icalo cikashala cilesekela mu Masabata imyaka yonse mu nshita cikashala icatalalilwa, ilyo na imwe mukaba mu calo ca balwani benu. Ili elyo icalo cikekala no kubaka Amasabata yaciko.

english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
translation: Pantu pa nshita yonse ilyo icalo cikatalalilwa, cikatuusha mu Masabata mu musango tacatalile acituusha ilyo mwaikelemo.

english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
translation: “Bonse abakashalapo aba muli imwe, nkabalenga ukuba no mwenso mu mitima yabo ilyo bali mu calo ca balwani babo, icakuti nga baumfwafye umwela waponya ibula ku cimuti, balaibutukilafye. Bali nokubutuka kwati bantu bapusuka ku lupanga. Kabili bali nokulaiwilafye nangu tapali muntu nelyo umo uulebatamfya.

english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
translation: Bakalainyantaulafye no kuipununa kwati balefulumuka ku lupanga, nangu tapali uulebabutusha. Eico pali iyi nshita mukafilwa no kulwisha abalwani benu.

english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
translation: Ala kwena, mukalobelelafye pakati ka mishobo. Mu calo ca balwani benu emo mukalobelela, no kushiikwa.

english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
translation: Pali imwe abakapusunsukako mu calo ca balwani benu bakaloba pa mulandu wa bubifi bwabo na pa mulandu wa bubifi bwa bashibo.

english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
translation: ine nkalamutumina imfula pa nshita iyalinga no kuleka umushili ukakwate ifisabo fisuma ne miti ikaletwala ifisabo ifisuma.

english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,
translation: “Lelo nga cakuti bakayebelela no kupapata pa bubifi bwabo, na pa bubifi bwa bashibo ubo bacitile ubwa kunsangukila no kuntalamina,

english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,
translation: icalengele na ine mbatalamine no kubatuma mu calo ca balwani babo, nga cakuti bayalula imitima yabo no kubwelulukila kuli ine no kufuta pa bubifi bwabo,

english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
translation: awe na ine lyena nkebukisha icipangano candi ico nacitile kuli Yakobo, Isaki na Abrahamu. Kabili ndi nokwibukisha ne calo cenu cine.

english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
