translation: Icalo cena cili nokushala pakuti cikasekele Amasabata pantu cikaba amatololo. Bali nokukandwa pa mulandu wakusangukila amafunde yandi ne Yawe, pamo pene no kusuula ifipope fyandi.

english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
translation: Lelo nangu cibe ifyo fine, ilyo aba bantu bacili mu calo ca balwani babo nshakabalekeleshe iyoo, nangufye ukubonaula umupwilapo, ninshi naonaula icipangano candi ico napangene nabo. Nine Yawe Lesa wabo.

english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”
translation: Kabili pa mulandu wabo wine, ndi nokwibukisha ne cipangano nacitile kuli bashibo, abo nafumishe mu calo ca Egupto pa cinso ca mishobo, pakuti mbe Lesa wabo. Nine Yawe.”

english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
translation: Kanshi aya e mafunde, ifipope kabili ne fikomo ifyo Yawe abikile pakati kakwe na bena Israeli ukupitila muli Mose ku lupili lwa Sinai.

english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
translation: Ukusokola kwenu ukwa ŋanu kuli nokutwalilila mpaka inshita yakusombola umwangashi, nako ukusombola kwa mwanganshi kuli nokutwalilila mpaka ilyo mukatampa ukubyala amabala yenu. Elyo mukalalya icilyo conse mukalafwaya ukulya, no kwikala umutelelwe mu calo cenu.

english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
translation: “Ine, ne Yawe nkaleka mukaleikala umutende mu calo cenu, kabili mukalasendama utulo ukwabula ico mukalatiina. Ine nkafumya shonse inama ishabipa mu calo cenu, kabili tamwakatale amuba ubulwi.

english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
translation: Imwe mukalafulumuna abalwani benu, kabili mukalabepaya no kubacimfya.

english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
translation: Basano muli imwe bakafulumuna abali umwanda umo (100). Abali umwanda umo (100) bakafulumuna abali imyanda ikumi limo (1,000). Elyo abalwani benu mukalabepaya no kubacimfya.

english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
translation: “Ine nkamutulanyako ku balwani benu no kumulenga ukuti mukasandane no kufula mu mpendwa. Kabili ine nkabaka icipangano candi na imwe.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.
translation: Tafwile kukabusha no kutwalilamo inama imbi iyoo, nangu kukabulamo imbi iyibi no kumupeela iyisuma nangu iyisuma no kupeelelamo iyibi. Nga acita ifyo, ninshi inama shonse shibili shaba shamushilo.

english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;
translation: Kabili ico alaya nga cintu icakowela icishingapokelelwa ngo mutuulo kuli Yawe, iyo nama ifwile ukutwalwa kuli shimapepo.

english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
translation: Shimapepo nao euli nokupima iyi nama nga isuma nangu ibi. Umutengo onse shimapepo engapingula, uyo wine euli nokushitilwapo iyi nama.

english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti umwine uwatuula alefwaya ukulubula iyi nama, alingile ukulundapo na kansonsela ka ndalama imo muli cila shisano pa mutengo bali nokushitishishapo inama.

english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
translation: “Umuntu nga apeela iŋanda yakwe kuli Yawe ukuba iyamushilo, shimapepo euli nokupima iyi ŋanda nga isuma nangu ibi. Umutengo onse shimapepo ali nokubika, euyo winefye.

english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti umuntu uupeele iyi ŋanda alefwaya ukubwesha, alingile ukulundapo kansonsela ka ndalama imo muli cila shisano pa mutengo bali nokushitishishapo iyi ŋanda, lyena kuti yabwelela kuli ena.

english: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
translation: “Umuntu nga apeelako iciputulwa cimo ica mpanga ya lupwa lwakwe kuli Yawe, umutengo wa iyi mpanga uli nokulingana ne mbuto sha bale shingabyalwamo, emukutila indalama amashekeli amakumi yasano isha silifa pali homeri imo pa mbuto sha bale.

english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
translation: Nga cakuti apeela kuli Yawe mu mwaka wakusefya, umutengo wa ili ibala uo bapingula uli nokuba ifyo fine ukwabula ukuutelusha.

english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti apeela ibala lyakwe kuli Yawe panuma ya mwaka wakusefya, lyena shimapepo ali nokupingula umutengo ukulingana ne myaka yashalako mpaka umwaka wakusefya ukafike, kabili ali nokucefyako umutengo.

english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
translation: Lelo umuntu uwapeele ibala nga alefwaya ukulibwesha, alingile ukulundapo kansonsela ka ndalama imo muli cila shisano pa mutengo bali nokushitishishapo ibala, elyo nomba ili ibala lili nokubwelela kuli ena.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,
translation: “Eba abena Israeli nokutila kuli bena, ‘Nga cakuti umuntu alaya icilayo icaibela icakutuula abantu babiye kuli Yawe, mukupeela icintu cimo ico umutengo waciko ulingene nowo bengashitilapo umuntu.

english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
translation: Uyu muntu nga cakuti takwete icakulubwilako ili ibala, nangufye ashitisha ku muntu umbi, ili ibala talyakatale alilubulwa alibwesha no kuba ibala lyakwe ninshi capwa.

english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
translation: Eico ili ibala ilyo likalubulwa mu mwaka wakusefya nga wafika, lili nokuba ilyamushilo. Likaba libala lyakwa Yawe, kabili likapeelwa na kuli bashimapepo nge cuma cabo.

english: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu apeela ibala kuli Yawe ilyo ashita, ilishili ibala lya ciputulwa ca mpanga ya lupwa,

english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.
translation: shimapepo ali nokupingula umutengo ukulingana ne myaka yashalako kukusefya umwaka walenga amakumi yasano. Kabili umuntu uuleshita ali nokuleta indalama shonse pali ubu bwine bushiku, nge cintu cimo icamushilo kuli Yawe.

english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
translation: Mu mwaka walenga amakumi yasano uwakusefya, ibala lili nokubwelela ku mwine uwashitishe, uwali umwine wa mpanga pakubala.

english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
translation: “Imitengo yonse ilingile ukuba nge mitengo ya mashekeli ya mu cifulo camushilo, amagera amakumi yabili (20) kuli shekeli imo.

english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.
translation: “Takuli umuntu nangu umo uufwile ukupeela amabeli ya fitekwa fya nama, pantu ifi fyena fyakwa Yawe. Nangu fingaba ukuti ni ŋombe nangufye impaanga, fyonse fyakwa Yawe.

english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
translation: Lelo nga citekwa icakowela, cena umwine kuti acibwesha pa mutengo uwasuminishiwa no kulundapo indalama imo muli cila shisano. Lelo nga takwete impiya shakulubwila, lyena cili nokushitishiwa pa mutengo uwasuminishiwa.

english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.
translation: “Takuli icintu nelyo cimo pafyo umuntu akwata nangu ico apeela kuli Yawe kukucilofya icingashitishiwa nangu ukulubulwa, cibefye nangu muntu wine, nangu inama, nangu impanga ya lupwa. Conse icapeelwa kukonaulwa, cena camushilo nganshi kuli Yawe.

english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.
translation: Takuli umuntu nelyo umo uyo uwapeelwa kukonaulwa uwingalubulwa, lelo afwile ukwipaiwafye.

english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
translation: Umwaume uuli pakati ka myaka amakumi yabili (20) nokufika pa myaka amakumi mutanda (60), indalama shili nokuba amashekeli amakumi yasano (50) sha silifa ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo.

english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.
translation: “Icapekumi conse ica mu busomboshi bonse, nalimo ni mbuto ishikafuma mu mabala yenu, nangu ifisabo fya ku miti, fyena fyonse mutuulo kuli Yawe. Kabili fyamushilo kuli Yawe.

english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu alubula icintu conse icapekumi, ali nokulundapo kansonsela ka ndalama imo muli cila shisano ukulingana no mutengo bali nokushitishishapo.

english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.
translation: Kabili icapekumi conse pa mukuni wa ŋombe no wa mpaanga, inama yonse iyalenga ikumi limo, iyo iyapita mwisamba lya nkonto ku mucemi, ili nokuba iyamushilo kuli Yawe.

english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”
translation: Umwine wa fitekwa talingile kupatulula ifitekwa pakuti asalepo icisuma ukufuma pa fishili bwino elyo apyanikishepo iyisuma. Nga cakuti apyanikishapo cimbi, fyonse ifi ifitekwa tafili nakulubulwa, nomba fyonse fyaba ifyamushilo kuli Yawe.”

english: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
translation: Ifi fyonse e fipope ifyo Yawe apeele Mose ku lupili lwa Sinai, pakuti efyo abena Israeli bakalekonka.

english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwanakashi, umutengo wakwe wena kumulinganyafye ne ndalama amashekeli amakumi yatatu (30).

english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu ali pakati ka myaka isano no kufika pa myaka amakumi yabili (20), umwaume umutengo wakwe ni ndalama amashekeli amakumi yabili (20), elyo umwanakashi nao ni pa ndalama amashekeli ikumi limo (10).

english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
translation: Kabili nga cakuti mwana mwaume uwa mweshi umo ukufika pa myaka isano, umutengo wakwe ni ndalama amashekeli yasano ya silifa. Kabili umutengo wa mwanakashi nao ni ndalama amashekeli yatatu ya silifa.

english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
translation: Elyo nga muntu uuli pakati ka myaka amakumi mutanda no kucilapo, umutengo wa mwaume onse ni ndalama amashekeli ikumi limo na yasano (15). Lelo nga mwanakashi wena, ni ndalama amashekeli ikumi limo.’

english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu uwalaya icilayo mulanda nganshi kabili teti alipile icipendo capimwa, afwile ukutwala umuntu alaile kuli shimapepo uuli nokubika umutengo wakupeela, ukulingana nefyo umuntu uwalaya icilayo engapeela.

english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.
translation: “Nga cakuti uyu muntu alaya ukupeela icitekwa ca nama icingasuminishiwa ngo mutuulo kuli Yawe, iyi inama iyapeelwa kuli Yawe ninshi yaba iyamushilo.

english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
translation: “Umuntu nga alefwaya ukuleta umutuulo wa cabunga kuli Yawe, umutuulo wakwe ufwile ukuba ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino. Pa bunga alingile ukwitilapo amafuta, apupilepo ne cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka.

english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
translation: Umutuulo wa cabunga onse uwashalapo, wakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume. Uyu mutuulo wamushilo nganshi uwaletuulwa kuli Yawe, uwa cakoca.

english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: “Mu mutuulo wa cabunga onse uo muletuula kuli Yawe, tamufwile kubikamo icitutumushi, pantu tamwakatale amocela icitutumushi no buci mu mutuulo mutuula kuli Yawe uwa cakoca.

english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
translation: Ifi mulefileta kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa fisabo fyakubalilapo lelo fyena tafili fyakutuula pa bulambo nge cakusekesha ku cena cisuma.

english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
translation: Mu mutuulo wa cabunga onse, ulebikamo umucele. Tecakwesha ukulaba ukubika uyu mucele wa cipangano cakwa Lesa obe mu mutuulo obe uwa cabunga. Kabili lundapo umucele pa mutuulo obe onse.

english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
translation: “Nga mutuulo wa fisabo fyakubalilapo kuli Yawe uwa fya nseke, tuuleni inseke ishasokolwa nangu imitwe ya nseke ishaocewa.

english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.
translation: Sansheniko amafuta pamo pene ne cinyamuti icanunka ubusaka ica fulankinisenshi. Uyu e mutuulo wa cabunga.

english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokocapo icipande ca cibukisho ica ŋanu icapeleka bwino na mafutamo, elyo no kubikamo icinyamuti conse ica fulankinisenshi nge ca mutuulo kuli Yawe uwa cakoca.”

english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Kabili atwale ifi fyonse kuli bashimapepo bamwana Aroni abaume. Elyo shimapepo ali nokubuula ulupi lwa bunga bwa ŋanu, na mafuta ne cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi conse no kufyocela pamo pa bulambo mukuba icibukisho ca mutuulo wa cakoca, uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
translation: Umutuulo wa cabunga onse uwashalapo wakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume. Uyu mutuulo, wamushilo nganshi uwakupeela kuli Yawe uwa cakoca.

english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
translation: “Nga uletuula umutuulo wa cabunga uwaocewa mwibuku, ufwile ukupangila no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino no kupangako imikate umushaba citutumushi, umwasanshiwafye na mafuta ya miolifa, nangu ukupangako utumikate tunono utwapapatala utwashingwako na mafuta.

english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
translation: Nga ulepanga umukate wa mutuulo wa cabunga mukubomfya ilata lyakocelapo, ulingile ukupangila ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino, ishasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa, kabili umushaba icitutumushi.

english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
translation: Mokaula uyu mukate no kwitilapo amafuta. Uyu e mutuulo wa cabunga.

english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
translation: Ngo mutuulo wa cabunga upangilwe mu cakupangilamo, ufwile wapangwa no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino umwasanshiwa na mafuta.

english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
translation: Uli nokuleta kuli Yawe umutuulo wa cabunga uwapekanishiwa muli uyu musango. Ukese leta kuli shimapepo elyo ena euli nokutwala ku bulambo.

english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokubuulapo akaputulwa pa mutuulo wa cabunga ukuba e cibukisho, no kocela pa bulambo ngo mutuulo wa cakoca, uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.
translation: “Umuntu nga alepeela umutuulo wakwampana, elyo atuula icitekwa ca pa mukuni wakwe, nalimo cilume nangu cikota, ico ali nokutuula kuli Yawe cifwile caba icabula akalema.

english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
translation: imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako mupepi no musana na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, efyo ali nokukambatwila pamo ne mfyo.

english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.
“‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
translation: “Nga cakuti umutuulo wakwe ni mbushi, afwile aleta pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
translation: Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa mbushi nokuipaila pantanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Elyo bamwana Aroni abaume bakane umulopa waiko mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
translation: Ukufuma ku mutuulo uyu, eko akafumya icakupeela umutuulo ice lambo lyakoca kuli Yawe: amafuta yonse ayalambatila ku fya munda na mafuta yonse ayaba munda,

english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
translation: imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako mupepi no musana na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, efyo ali nokufifumisha pamo ne mfyo.

english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.
translation: “Shimapepo ali nokoca pa bulambo nge cakulya ce lambo lya cakoca icakusekesha ku cena cisuma. Lelo fyonse ifyamafuta, fyakwa Yawe.

english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
translation: “Ili lifunde ilyamuyayaya ilili nokukonkwa umukakonkanina inkulo shonse ishili nokulakonkapo, uko konse mukaba. Mwikalalya amafuta nangu umulopa.”

english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
translation: Natambalike ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa nama ya mutuulo wakwe nokuipaila pa mwinshi wa mpongolo ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Elyo bamwana Aroni abaume bashimapepo bali nokukana umulopa mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
translation: Kabili atuule icipande ce lambo lyakwampana ukuba umutuulo wacakoca kuli Yawe, emukutila amafuta yonse ayalambatila ku fya munda pamo na yonse ayaba munda,

english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
translation: imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako mupepi no musana na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, efyo ali nokukambatwila pamo ne mfyo.

english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Bamwana Aroni abaume bali nokocela fyonse ifi pa bulambo, pa mulu we lambo lyakoca ilili pa cininkwa ca mulilo wa nkuni, ngo mutuulo wa cakoca uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu atuula impaanga nangu imbushi imo iya mu mukuni wakwe ukuba umutuulo wakwampana kuli Yawe, alingile atuula iyilume nelyo iyikota iyabula akalema.

english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;
translation: Nga atuula umwana wa mpaanga, alingile amupalamika ku cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
translation: Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa mutuulo no kuipaila pantanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Elyo bamwana Aroni abaume bakane umulopa wa mwana wa mpaanga mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
translation: Ukufuma ku mutuulo uwakwampana, nabuuleko umutuulo wakwa Yawe uwa cakoca. Nabuuleko ica mafuta, ne camucila icishainonena ico baputulako apo calundana ku musana, na mafuta yonse ayalambatila ku fya munda pamo na yonse ayaba munda,

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
translation: pamo ngefyo bafumya amafuta ku mutuulo wa ŋombe yaocewa uwakwampana. Elyo shimapepo ali nokufyocela pa mulu wa bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca.

english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung
translation: Nomba umukupo wakwa cilume wa ŋombe ne minofu yakwe, pamo pene no mutwe na molu yene, ifya munda pamo ne cifulu,

english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.
translation: emukutila fyonse ifyashala kuli uyu cilume wa ŋombe, afibuule no kufifumisha kunse ya nkambi, ku cifulo icasangululwa, ico betilako imito no koca mu cininkwa ca mulilo pa mwina wa mito.’

english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;
translation: “Nga cakuti ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli lwacita icabubifi cimo mukukanaishiba ico Yawe alesha mu mafunde yakwe, nangufye ulukuta talwishibe umo umulandu ulolele, nalyo line mulandu.

english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Ilyo ububifi bacitile bwaishibikwa, ulukuta luli nokuletafye iciponti ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Bali nokumuleta kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.
translation: Abakalamba ba lukuta bali nokutambalika amaboko yabo pa mutwe wakwa cilume wa ŋombe pa cinso cakwa Yawe elyo nokumwipaya.

english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo shimapepo uwasubwa ali nokusendapo umulopa umo uwa cilume wa ŋombe mukati ke Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil.
translation: Atumpike umunwe mu mulopa no kukana imiku cine lubali pa cinso cakwa Yawe kuntanshi ya cisalu icicinga ku muputule wamushilo.

english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Umulopa umbi aushinge ku nsengo sha bulambo pa cinso cakwa Yawe mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Kabili umulopa uwashalapo ali nokuwitila mwisamba lya bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca pa mpongolo ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.
translation: Shimapepo, ali nokufumya amafuta yonse kuli cilume wa ŋombe no kuyocela pa bulambo.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,
translation: “Eba abena Israeli ukuti, ‘Ngo muntu umo abifya mukukanaishiba, acita ifyo Yawe alesha mu mafunde yakwe, mukalekonka ifi.

english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
translation: Ifi efyo alingile ukucita kuli cilume wa ŋombe uyu, nga fintu engacita kuli cilume wa ŋombe uwa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokutuulilamo ilambo lyakufuta pa fyabubifi fyabo, nabo bakelelwa.

english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokufumisha cilume wa ŋombe kunse ya nkambi no kumoca nga fintu aocele cilume wa ŋombe uwantanshi. Kanshi uyu e mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwe bumba lyonse.

english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.
translation: Eico kanshi ngoyu mulandu acita waishibikwa kuli ena, ali nokuleta umutuulo wa mbushi iyilume iyabula akalema.

english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.
translation: Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa mbushi no kuipaila pa cinso cakwa Yawe pa ncende ye lambo lyakoca. Uyu e mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
translation: Kabili shimapepo ali nokutumpika umunwe wakwe mu mulopa wa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, nokushinga ku nsengo sha ku bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca no kwitila umulopa uushele mwisamba lya bulambo.

english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.
translation: Ifi efyo alingile ukucita ukoca amafuta yonse pa bulambo pamo nga fintu engacita ku mafuta ya mutuulo wakwampana. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokutuulilamo umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi pa mulandu wa bubifi bwa iyi ntungulushi, nayo ikelelwa.

english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.
translation: Uyu muntu nga aishibishiwa ukuti nabifya, alingile ukuleta umutuulo wa pa bubifi acitile, imbushi iyikota iyabula akalema.

english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
translation: Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi no kwipaila pa ncende iyo bepailapo ilambo lyakoca.

english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering.
translation: “‘Nga ni shimapepo uwasubwa ewacita ubu bubifi no kulenga na bambi abantu balebifya, alingilefye ukuleta iciponti kuli Yawe no kufuta umulandu onse. Alingile ukuleta icabula akalema ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi acita.

english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokubuulapo umulopa ku munwe no kushinga ku nsengo sha bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca, kabili ali nokwitila umulopa ushelepo mwisamba lya bulambo.

english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
translation: Ali nokufumyako yonse amafuta, pamo ngefyo amafuta yafumishiwa ku mutuulo wakwampana, elyo shimapepo ali nokufyoca pa bulambo ngo mutuulo uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokutuulilamo umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi pa mulandu wa cabubifi cakwe, nao akelelwa.

english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.
translation: “Kabili nga aleta umwana wa mpaanga ukuba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, alingile ukuleta iyikota iyabula akalema.

english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
translation: Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo ali nokuipaila pa ncende iyo bepailapo ilambo lyakoca.

english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
translation: Elyo shimapepo ali nokubuulapo umulopa pa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi ku munwe no kushinga ku nsengo sha ku bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca. Umulopa washalapo ali nokuwitila mwisamba lya bulambo.

english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.
translation: Ali nokufumyako yonse amafuta, pamo ngefyo amafuta ya mwana wa mpaanga yafumishiwa ku mutuulo wakwampana, elyo shimapepo ali nokufyocela pa bulambo pamo ne mituulo ya kuli Yawe. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokutuulilamo umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi acitile, ninshi uyu muntu akelelwa.”

english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before the LORD.
translation: Nalete uyu cilume wa ŋombe ku mpongolo ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Ali nokutambalika ukuboko kwakwe pa mutwe wa ciponti no kucipaila pa menso yakwa Yawe.

english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo shimapepo uwasubwa na mafuta, ali nokusendako umulopa umo uwa cilume wa ŋombe nokutwala mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.
translation: Natumpike umunwe mu mulopa no kukana imiku cine lubali pa cinso cakwa Yawe kuntanshi ya cisalu icicinga ku cifulo camushilo.

english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo shimapepo akashinge umulopa ku nsengo sha bulambo bocelapo ububani ubwanunka ubusaka, ubwaba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Kabili umulopa onse uwashalapo uwakwa cilume wa ŋombe, shimapepo ali nokuwitila mwisamba lya bulambo bwe lambo lyakoca pa mpongolo iye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
translation: Ali nokufumya yonse amafuta kuli cilume wa ŋombe ya mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo na mafuta ayatabilila ifya munda, nangufye conse icakambatilako kuli fyene,

english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,
translation: imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako mupepi no musana, elyo na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, nafyo fine ali nokufifumisha kumo kwine ne mfyo,

english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
translation: “Umuntu nga abifya pakukanapeela bukambone ukulingana no mulandu aumfwile, nangu paco amwene, ninshi ali no mulandu kabili ali nokukandwa.

english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
translation: Elyo nomba shimapepo ali nokutuula akapele nangu akabondo kashele nge lambo lyakoca ukulingana na mafunde. Shimapepo ali nokumutuulilako umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi, nao akelelwa.

english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu afilwa ukumona utupele tubili nangu utubondo twa nkunda tubili, ninshi alingile ukuleta icapekumi ca cipimo ca efa umo ica bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Tafwile kusanshako amafuta nangu icinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka, pantu uyu mutuulo wa kulapila pa bubifi.

english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.
translation: Alingile nokuleta kuli shimapepo, nao ali nokubuulapofye mu lupi kukuba icipande ca cibukisho, elyo ali nokubocela pa bulambo pamo ne mituulo yakoca iya kuli Yawe. Uyu mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”
translation: “Ifi efyo shimapepo ali nokumutuulilako umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi, ninshi uyu muntu akelelwa. Umutuulo uwashalapo, uli nokuba uwakwa shimapepo nga filya ciba pa mutuulo wa cabunga.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.
translation: “Ilyo lyonse umuntu alufyanya acita ne cabubifi mukukanaishiba muli fyonse ifyamushilo ifyakwa Yawe, ali nokuleta kuli Yawe icifuta mulandu pamo nga sukusuku wa pa mukuni wakwe, uushaba na kalema, kabili uwalingana no mutengo wa kufina kwa silifa pa cipimo ca shekeli wa cifulo camushilo. Uyu mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi.

english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.
translation: Uyu muntu ali nokubwekeshapo ifyo ashatuulile kabili alundepo cimo muli cila fisano ukulingana ne cipimo casuminishiwa no kupeela kuli shimapepo. Shimapepo ali nokumutuulilako sukusuku ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, ninshi uyu muntu akelelwa.

english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu abifya no kucita ifyo Yawe ashifwaya mu mafunde yakwe, nangufye acitile mukukanaishiba, nalyo line ninshi ali no mulandu kabili ali nokukandwa.

english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.
translation: Ali nokuleta kuli shimapepo sukusuku wa pa mukuni wakwe, uwabula akalema, uwamutengo uwalingango mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Iyi e nshila shimapepo ali nokumufutilako pa cilubo acitile mukukanaishiba, ninshi uyu muntu akelelwa.

english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”
translation: “Uyu e mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi pantu uyu muntu aliba no mulandu pakucita icilubo kuli Yawe.”

english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.
translation: “Nangu umuntu akumya ku fyakowela, nalimo ni nama ya mpanga iyaifwila, citekwa icaifwila, conse icikulika pa mushili, nangu cibefye teshibe, nao wine ninshi aba uwakowela kabili ali no mulandu.

english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.
translation: “Nangu umuntu akumya ku fyakowela fyabumuntu na kuli conse icingamulenga ukuba uwakowela, nangu cibefye teshibe, lelo nga aisa ishiba, uyu muntu ali nokuba no mulandu.

english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.
translation: “Nangu uyu muntu mukuilekelesha mukulanda, alapa umulapo kukubomba icintu cimo, na pamo icibi nangu icisuma, mu nshilafye yonse iyo mu kuilekelesha kwakwe engalapilamo, nangu cibefye teshibe, muli iyi micitile yena ilyo lyonse aishiba, ali nokuba no mulandu.

english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;
translation: “Ilyo lyonse umuntu acita umulandu umo pali iyi tulumbwile, alingile ukuisosela umwine ububifi acitile.

english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
translation: Uyu muntu pa bubifi acitile, ali nokuleta kuli Yawe akana ka mpaanga akakota nangufye imbushi ukufuma pa mukuni wakwe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi acitile. Shimapepo ali nokumutuulilako umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi.

english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu takwete umwana wa mpaanga ali nokuleta utupele tubili nangu utubondo twa nkunda tubili kuli Yawe icifuta mulandu pa bubifi acita. Kamo ka mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi acitile elyo na kambi ke lambo lyakoca.

english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.
translation: Ali nokuleta kuli shimapepo tonse uuli nokututuula, abalilepo kamo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi. Shimapepo ali nokunyongotolafye umukoshi, ukwabula ukufumyako umutwe.

english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
translation: Umulopa wa uyu mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, shimapepo ali nokuukana mu mbali ya bulambo, elyo umbi uwashala uli nokupongolwelwa mwisamba lya bulambo. Uyu e mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
translation: Elyo Shimapepo ali nokufwala umwingila wa nsalu iyatelela elyo na kaputula wa nsalu iyatelela mukati ka mwingila no kukusa imito ye lambo lyakoca ilipiile ku bulambo no kuibika mu mbali ya bulambo.

english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
translation: Elyo ali nokufuula ifi fyakufwala no kufwala fimbi pakutwala imito kunse ya nkambi ku ncende iyasangululwa.

english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
translation: Umulilo wa pa bulambo uli nokulaaka lyonse, taufwile kushima iyoo. Ulucelo lyonse shimapepo ali nokubikapo inkuni no kupekanya ilambo lyakoca pa mulilo no kocapo amafuta ya mutuulo wakwampana.

english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
translation: Umulilo wena ufwile ukulayaka lyonse pa bulambo, taufwile kushima iyoo.

english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
translation: “Aya nayo e mafunde yakukonka pakutuula umutuulo wa cabunga. Bamwana Aroni abaume, ebakulaleta uyu mutuulo ku cinso cakwa Yawe kuntanshi ya bulambo.

english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.
translation: Elyo Shimapepo ali nokubuulapo ulupi lwa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino na mafutamo, pamo pene ne cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka conse, pamo pene no kufyocela pamo pa bulambo nge cipande ca cibukisho ica cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Ifyashalapo, Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bali nokulya, lelo bafwile ukulya umwabula intutumushi mu ncende yamushilo. Bafwile ukuliila mu lubansa lwe Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.
translation: Pakupanga umukate tabafwile ukubikamo intutumushi. Nabapeela ifi ifya pa mituulo yandi iya cakoca cibe cabo. Ifi filyo, ala, fyamushilo nganshi pamo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi elyo no mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi.

english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”
translation: Umwaume onse uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni ali nokulyako. Ici e cipande cakwe pa mutuulo kuli Yawe uwa cakoca icili nokutwalilila ku nkulo shonse. Na conse icili nokukumyako, cili nokuba icamushilo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,
translation: “Umuntu nga abifya mukukanaba uwacishinka kuli Yawe kufyo acenjesha umunankwe pa fintu asekesheko nangu ukumusungilako nangu ukumwibila, nangu amubepa.

english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.
translation: “Uyu e mutuulo Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bafwile ukutuula kuli Yawe pa bushiku bwakusubwa. Bali nokulatuula icapekumi cimo ca cipimo ca efa ca bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino pamo ngo mutuulo wa cabunga uo batuula lyonse. Bali nokubwakanya pakati no kutuula bumo ulucelo, na bumbi nabo icungulo.

english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Bali nokusankanya ubunga na mafuta pakukandawila no koca pelata lyakocelapo no kutuula ngo mutuulo wa cabunga uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.
translation: Umwana mwaume onse uwakwa Aroni uuli nokupyana nga shimapepo uwasubwa, euli nokupekanya uyu mutuulo kuli Yawe lyonsefye. Onsefye umutuulo, wakocela Yawe epela.

english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”
translation: Umutuulo wa cabunga onse uo shimapepo atuula, ulingile ukuocafye umupwilapo. Tecakwesha ukulyako.”

english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—
translation: Nangu ngo muntu umo atola icintu icilubile nomba akaana ati teutolele, nangu alapa umulapo wabufi, nangu acita ifyabubifi ifyo abantu bengacita,

english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,
translation: nangu abifya muli uyu musango uwa bucenjeshi, alingile ukubwesha ifi fintu aibile nangu asendele mu bucenjeshi nangufye ni filya fine umunankwe asekesheko, na filya fine atolele,

english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.
He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.
translation: Nge cifuta mulandu alete kuli shimapepo, emukutila kuli Yawe, umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi, ukufuma pa mukuni wakwe, sukusuku uwabula akalema, uwa mutengo uwalinga.

english: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
translation: “Eba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ifyebo ifi, pakuti efyo balekonka ilyo lyonse baleka ilambo lyakoca. Ilambo lyakoca lili nokubafye pa bulambo ubushiku bonse pa cininkwa ca mulilo mpaka bwaca.

english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.
translation: “Aya e mafunde yakukonka pakutuula umutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, icili icamushilo nganshi.

english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
translation: Kabili umutuulo wa cabunga onse uwasakaniwamo na mafuta, nangu wauma, fyonse fya bana baume bakwa Aroni cila umo ukulingana ngo munankwe.”

english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:
translation: “Aya e mafunde yakukonka pakutuula umutuulo wakwampana uo umuntu onse ali nokutuula kuli Yawe.

english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
translation: “Umuntu nga atuula umutuulo wakulanga ukutotela, afwile atuulila capamo ne mituulo yakutotela iya mikate umwabula intutumushi lelo utwashingwako na mafuta, kabili ne mikate iyapapatala umwakandawilwa na mafuta, kabili ne mikate iyapangwa no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino umwasanshiwafye na mafuta.

english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.
translation: Ukukonka pa mutuulo wakwampana uwakutotela, ali nokulundapo umutuulo wa mikate iyatutumuka.

english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
translation: Ali nokutuulapo cila umo ngo musangulo kuli Yawe. Uyu musangulo wakwa shimapepo uukana umulopa wa mituulo yakwampana ku bulambo.

english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
translation: Inama ya mutuulo wakwampana kabili iyakutotela, ifwile ukuliwa mu bushiku bwine ubo ipeelelwepo ngo mutuulo we lambo. Tafwile kushako nelyo kamo mpaka ukufika ulucelo.

english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,
translation: “Nga cakuti umutuulo we lambo lya muntu wa cilayo nangu wakuitemenwafye, ninshi uyo mutuulo we lambo ufwile ukuliwafye ubo bwine bushiku wapeelelwapo. Lelo nga cakuti pashala fimo, kuti fyaliwa ubushiku bwakonkapo.

english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
translation: Umunofu wa nama nga washalako ku mutuulo mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu, wakocafye.

english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
translation: Nga cakuti uyu mutuulo wakwampana waliwa mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu, umutuulo wa muntu uyu teti Yawe aupokelele. Elyo tawakapendelwe ukuba ku mulingo wakwe, lelo untu wakowela, no muntu uukalyako akakandwa.

english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;
translation: “Umunofu wa nama onse uwakumya ku cintu icakowela, tewakwesha ukulya, wena wakocafye. Lelo inama imbi umuntu onse uwasangululwa wena kuti alyako iyo inama.

english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
translation: Umutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi uli nokwipaiwa pa ncende iyo bepailapo ilambo lyakoca. Elyo umulopa wena bali nokuukana mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu uushasangululwa alyako ku nama ya mutuulo wakwampana uwakwa Yawe, uyo muntu wakutamfyafye mu mushobo wa bantu bakwe.

english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
translation: Kabili umuntu onse uwakumya ku cintu icili conse icakowela ica muntu nangu inama iyakowela nangufye icintu icili conse icakowela, nomba aisa lyako inama ya mutuulo wakwampana uwakwa Yawe, ninshi uyu muntu wakutamfyafye mu mushobo wa bantu bakwe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli utile, ‘Imwe mwilalya conse ica mafuta ya nama ya ŋombe, impaanga nangufye ya mbushi.

english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
translation: Kabili tecakwesha ukulya mafuta ya nama yonsefye iyaifwila, nangufye iyaikatwa ku finama fya mpanga, lelo kuti yabomfeshiwa ku milimo imbi.

english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
translation: Umuntu onse uwalya amafuta ya nama iyo batuulile kuli Yawe iya cakoca, wakutamfyafye mu mushobo wa bantu bakwe.

english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
translation: Konsefye uko mukekala, tecakwesha ukulalya umulopa wa cuni icili conse nangufye uwa nama iyili yonse.

english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
translation: Umuntu onse uwalya umulopa, uyu wena wakutamfyafye mu mushobo wa bantu bakwe.’”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli utile, ‘Uyo onse uuletuula umutuulo wakwampana kuli Yawe, alingile ukuleta iciputulwa ca nama ye lambo kuli Yawe.

english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
translation: Yonse amafuta yali nokutuulwa, aya ku mucila na yatabilila ku fya munda,

english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
translation: Alingile ukuiletelafye umwine uyu mutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe. Ali nokuleta ifyamafuta pamo ne cisao elyo atambike icisao kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika.

english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokoca amafuta pa bulambo, lelo icisao cena cakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume.

english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
translation: Ku mutuulo we lambo lyakwampana, umwendo wa ku kulyo uli nokupeelwa kuli shimapepo ngo musangulo.

english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
translation: Mwana Aroni umwaume uwatuula umulopa na mafuta nge fya mutuulo wakwampana, afwile apeelwa umwendo wa ku kulyo nge cipande cakwe.

english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
translation: Ukufuma ku mutuulo wakwampana wa bena Israeli, nabuulako inama ya cisao icitambikwe, no mwendo uupeelwe no kufipeela kuli Aroni shimapepo na bana baume bakwe nge fipande fyabo ifya nshiku shonse ukufuma ku mutuulo wa bena Israeli.’

english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;
translation: “Ici cili cipande ca mutuulo wa cakoca icipeelwa kuli Yawe ico Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bapeelwe mu bushiku bapalamikwemo mukutumika Yawe nga bashimapepo.

english: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
translation: Pa bushiku basubilwe, Yawe akonkomeshe ukuti abena Israeli babapeele ifi nge fipande fyabo ukulingana nomo inkulo sha bantu ba mu Israeli shili nokukonkanina.”

english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings
translation: Kanshi aya, e mafunde yakukonka ilyo ilambo lyakoca liletuulwa, na pa mutuulo wa cabunga, na pa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, na pa mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, na pa mutuulo wa pakusubwa bushimapepo elyo na pa mutuulo wakwampana.

english: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
translation: Yawe ewapeele Mose aya mafunde pa lupili lwa Sinai, pa bushiku akonkomeshe abena Israeli ukulatuula umutuulo kuli Yawe mu matololo ya Sinai.

english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;
translation: imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako mupepi no musana na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu, fyonse fili nokufumishiwa pamo pene ne mfyo.

english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokocela fyonse pa bulambo ngo mutuulo wacakoca kuli Yawe. Uyu e mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi.

english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
translation: Umwaume onse uwa muli bashimapepo euli nokulyako uyu mutuulo. Lelo bali nokuuliila mu ncende imo iyamushilo, pantu uyu mutuulo wamushilo nganshi.

english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
translation: “Ifunde limo line e lyakukonka pa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi elyo no mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Umutuulo washalapo pakubafutilako wakwa shimapepo.

english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
translation: Umukupo uushele ku nama ye lambo lyakoca ilya uuli onse, uli nokuba wakwa shimapepo wine.

english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
translation: Umutuulo onse uwa cabunga uo baoca mwibuku nangu basalula pali pani, nangu baocela pelata lyakocelapo, fyonse fyakwa shimapepo uulebomba ku bulambo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe asosele kuli Mose ati,

english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.
translation: Elyo Mose abuula amafuta yakusuba no kusuba Itenti lyakwa Lesa ne fipe fyonse ifyalimo pakuti fibe ifyamushilo.

english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.
translation: Kabili akana amafuta yamo ku bulambo imiku cine lubali, asuba amafuta ku bulambo pamo pene na ku fibombelo fyonse na ku musambilo neco bakatekapo, epakulenga fibe fyamushilo.

english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
translation: Epakubuula amafuta yakusuba no kwitulwila pa mutwe wakwa Aroni no kumusuba pakuti abe uwamushilo.

english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo Mose apalamike bamwana Aroni abaume, abafwika imingila, abakaka na malamba mu misana, abapomba insalu ku mitwe, pamo ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
translation: Kabili Mose aleta iciponti ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi. Elyo Aroni na bana bakwe abaume batambalika amaboko yabo pa mutwe wa ciponti ca ŋombe.

english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
translation: Elyo Mose nao aipaya iciponti ca ŋombe, abuulapo no mulopa elyo atumpa umunwe wakwe mu mulopa, aushinga na ku nsengo sha pa bulambo pa kusangulula ubulambo. Umulopa washala aupongolwela mwisamba lya bulambo. Ifi efyo Mose asangulwile ubulambo pakufutilako pa bubifi.

english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
translation: Mose kabili abuula amafuta yonse ayatabilila ifya munda na fyonse ifyalambatila ku libu lya ciponti, ne mfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako, no kufyocela pamo pa bulambo.

english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Abuula fyonse ifyashala, impapa, iminofu ne fya mu mala fine, aya fyocela kunse ya nkambi, pamo ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
translation: Kabili apalamika sukusuku uwe lambo lya cakoca, nao Aroni na bana abaume batambalikilapo amaboko pa mutwe wakwa sukusuku.

english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
translation: Nao Mose epakwipaya uyu sukusuku no kukana umulopa mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
translation: “Leta Aroni na bana bakwe abaume, ifyakufwala fya bashimapepo, amafuta yakusuba, iciponti ica mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, basukusuku babili elyo no museke umo uwa mikate iyishatutumuka.

english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
translation: Aputaula inama fipimfya fipimfya, no koca umutwe, ifipimfya fyonse pamo na mafuta.

english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Asamfya ifya munda ne myendo na menshi no kocela sukusuku onse pa bulambo nge lambo lyakoca, ilya cena cisuma icakusekesha ngo mutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
translation: Elyo kabili Mose abuula sukusuku wacibili, uyu wena ali mutuulo wa pakusubwa, na Aroni na bana bakwe abaume batambalikilapo amaboko yabo pa mutwe.

english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
translation: Mose nao aipaya uyu sukusuku no kubuula umulopa umo, aushinga ku kalebelebe ka kutwi kwa ku kulyo kwakwa Aroni na ku cikumo ca ku kulyo, elyo na ku cikondo icikalamba ica lukasa lwa ku kulyo.

english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
translation: Mose elyo apalamika abana baume bakwa Aroni, nabo bene abashinga umulopa ku tulebelebe twa matwi yabo aya ku kulyo, ku fikumo fyabo ifya ku kulyo na ku fikondo fikalamba ifya ku kulyo kwa makasa yabo. Kabili akana no mulopa uwashelepo mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
translation: Abuula amafuta no mucila uwanona, elyo na mafuta yonsefye aya fya munda, fyonse ifyatabilila ku libu, imfyo shonse shibili na mafuta yabako elyo no mwendo wa ku kulyo.

english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
translation: Ukufuma mu museke uwa mikate iyishatutumuka, uwali ku cinso cakwa Yawe, abuulamo umukate umo na kamukate kamo akasakanishiwamo amafuta elyo na kamukate akapapatala, afibika pa mafuta kabili pa mwendo wa ku kulyo uwakwa sukusuku.

english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translation: Mose abuula fyonse ifi, abika mu minwe yakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume nabo bakafimishe mumulu ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika kuli Yawe.

english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Elyo Mose afipoka ukufuma ku maboko yabo no kufyocela fyonse pa bulambo pa mulu we lambo lyakoca ngo mutuulo wa cakoca kuli Yawe, umutuulo uwakusubwa uwa cena cisuma icimusekesha.

english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo kabili Mose abuula inama ya cisao, icipande cakwe kuli sukusuku, kabili aimisha mumulu ngo mutuulo wakutambika pa cinso cakwa Yawe pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”
translation: Kabili ulonganike ulukuta lonse pa mwinshi wa mpongolo kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.”

english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
translation: Elyo kabili Mose abuula amafuta yakusuba no mulopa umo ukufuma pa bulambo, afikana pali Aroni ne fyakufwala fyakwe elyo na pa bana bakwe abaume na ku fyakufwala fyabo. Kanshi efyo Aroni ashishiwe pamo ne fyakufwala fyakwe na bana bakwe abaume ne fyakufwala fyabo.

english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
translation: Mose kabili epakweba Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ukuti, “Ipikileni inama pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kuiliilafye palya pene ne mikate ukufuma mu museke wa mituulo iyipeelwa pakusubwa bushimapepo, pamo ngefyo nakonkomesha ukuti, ‘Aroni na bana bakwe abaume, efyo bafwile ukulya.’

english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
translation: Elyo inama no mukate ifyashalapo moce.

english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
translation: Mwilafuma, pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pa nshiku cine lubali mpakafye inshiku sha kusubwa shenu shikapwe pantu ukusubwa kwenu kukapwa inshiku cine lubali.

english: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
translation: Icacitwa lelo, ni Yawe akonkomeshe pakumufutilako pa bubifi.

english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
translation: Mufwilefye ukwikala pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, akasuba no bushiku pa nshiku cine lubali, no kukonka ifyo Yawe afwaya lyena tamwakafwe, pantu ifi efyo bankonkomeshe.”

english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.
translation: Awe Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bacitile fintu fyonse ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Awe Mose acitilafye umo Yawe amukonkomeshe, ne bumba lya bantu balongene pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo,

english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”
translation: Mose alaeba ulukuta ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe ankonkomeshe ukucita.”

english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
translation: Elyo Mose apalamika Aroni na bana bakwe abaume kuntanshi no kubasamba na menshi.

english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.
translation: Mose afwika Aroni ilaya, amukaka ilamba mu musana. Amufwika umwingila, elyo amufwika ne cakufwala ca pa mulu wa mwingila ica efodi, acikakila mu musana no mushipi uwapikulwa busaka busaka.

english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.
translation: Amufwika na tumba pa cifuba, abikamo no tumabwe, Urimu na Tumimu.

english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Akaka ne nsalu ku mutwe wakwa Aroni, akakilapo na kalilata ka golide wine wine akamushilo pamo ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
translation: Nomba pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, Mose aita Aroni na bana bakwe abaume elyo na bakalamba ba bena Israeli.

english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Pa bulambo aocelapo na mafuta, imfyo shonse shibili na fyonse ifyatabilila ku libu. Fyonse ifi fyafumine pa mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
translation: Lelo inama yonse kumo kwine ne mpapa, fyena aya fyocela kunse ya nkambi.

english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
translation: Elyo kabili Aroni aipaya ne nama ya mutuulo we lambo lyakoca. Abana bakwe abaume bamutambika umulopa, nao aukanawila ku mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
translation: Kabili batambika kuli ena icipimfya cimo cimo ice lambo lyakoca, ukubikapo ne camutwe no kufyocela fyonse pamo pa bulambo.

english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
translation: Awe asamfya fyonse ifya munda ne myendo no kufyocela pa mulu we lambo lyakoca pa bulambo.

english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
translation: Aroni nomba aleta umutuulo wali nokuba uwa pa bantu. Abuula imbushi ukuba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwa bantu, aipaya, aituula ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi nga filya fine acicita pakubala.

english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
translation: Kabili aleta inama ye lambo lyakoca no kutuula ukulingana ne nshila yakulilekelamo.

english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
translation: Aletele kabili umutuulo wa cabunga, abuulapo ulupi lumo pa fya mutuulo wine, aocela pa bulambo ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila lucelo.

english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;
translation: Aipaya na cilume wa ŋombe elyo na sukusuku, atuulila na bantu ngo mutuulo wakwampana. Abana bakwe abaume bamupeela umulopa, nao aukanawila mu mbali shonse isha bulambo.

english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;
translation: Aroni abuula amafuta yakwa cilume wa ŋombe na sukusuku, imicila iyanona, ne fya mafuta ayalambatila ku fya munda ne mfyo shonse na fyonse ifyalambatila ku mabu.

english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.
translation: Mose asosa kuli Aroni ati, “Buula iciponti nge lambo lya pa bubifi bobe elyo na sukusuku nge lambo lyobe lyakoca, fyonse ifyabula akalema, no kutuula kuli Yawe.

english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.
translation: Ifi fyonse afibika pa mulu wa cisao elyo Aroni aocela amafuta pa bulambo.

english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.
translation: Elyo Aroni atambika icisao no mwendo wa ku kulyo kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika kuli Yawe, ngefyo Mose akonkomeshe.

english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
translation: Elyo nomba Aroni atambalika amaboko yakwe pa bantu no kubapaala. Panuma ya kutuula umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, ilambo lya cakoca elyo no mutuulo wakwampana, aikila na panshi.

english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.
translation: Elyo Mose na Aroni nomba baya ingila na mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Cilya bafumamo, bapaala abantu, no bucindami bwakwa Yawe bwamoneka ku bantu bonsefye.

english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
translation: Awe apopene, kwafuma no mulilo ku cinso cakwa Yawe waoca ilambo pamo pene na mafuta ayali pa bulambo. Abantu bonse pakumona ifi, balapunda ne nsansa, bawa bonse panshi ubukupeme.

english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
translation: Elyo eba abena Israeli auti, ‘Buulenipo sawe umo ukuba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, iciponti ca ŋombe no mwana wa mpaanga fyonse ifyakumanya umwaka umo umo ifyabula akalema fibe ifye lambo lyakoca.

english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”
translation: Kabili buulenipo cilume wa ŋombe na sukusuku ngo mutuulo wakwampana uwe lambo kuli Yawe, pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga uwasanshiwamo na mafuta. Pantu ilelo line, Yawe alemoneka kuli imwe.’”

english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.
translation: Elyo baleta ifintu fyonse ifyo Mose akonkomeshe kuntanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, no lukuta lonse lwapalama lwaiminina na ku cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”
translation: Mose alabeba ati, “Ici eco Yawe ankonkomeshe ukuti mulecita, pakuti mumone ubucindami bwakwa Yawe.”

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”
translation: Kabili Mose aeba Aroni ati, “Palama ku bulambo no kuleka umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bobe, pamo ne lambo lyakoca, pakuti ufute pa bubifi bobe nobwa bantu. Uleke ilambo lya pa bantu no kubafutilako ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe.”

english: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
translation: Awe Aroni apalama ku bulambo, aipaya ne ciponti ca ŋombe kukuba umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi bwakwe.

english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;
