translation: Abana bakwe abaume epakumuletela umulopa, nao atumpikamo umunwe wakwe, ashinga na ku nsengo sha bulambo. Onse umulopa washala, awitila mwisamba lya bulambo.

english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
translation: Kabili Imfumu Yesu yasontele abasambi na bambi amakumi cine lubali na babili (72). Yabatuma babili babili, ukuti baitangilile ukuya mu misumba yonse na mu ncende shonse umo iyine yali nokupita.

english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
translation: Nomba umusumba onse mwaingilamo na bantu tabamusekelele, mufumine mu mansa. Musose amuti,

english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
translation: ‘No lukungu lwine lwa mu musumba wenu ulukungile ku makasa yesu nalo lwine twamukuntila. Nomba kwena mwishibe ukuti, Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa nabupalama.’

english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
translation: Ndemweba ukuti, pali bulya bushiku bwabupingushi, Lesa akakanda ulya musumba ukucila na pali Sodoma.

english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
translation: “Ukacimona Kolasini! Ukacimona nobe Betisaida! Pantu ifipeshamano fyacitilwe muli imwe, efyo aficitwa mu Turi na mu Sidoni, awe nga ni kale balapile no kupilibuka mukufwala insalu shabulanda no kuikuba imito.

english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
translation: Kol 9:14

english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
translation: Mateo 10:15

english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
translation: Kabili Yesu ati, “Uumfwa imwe, ninshi nine omfwa. Uwamusuula imwe, ninshi nine asuula. Elyo uwasuula ine, ninshi asuula no wantuma.”

english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
translation: Awe abasambi balya amakumi cine lubali na babili, babwelele baleyangafye ku nsansa. Balaeba Yesu abati, “We Mfumu, ala ne mipashi yakowela yalecimba nga twalumbula ishina lyobe.”

english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
translation: Timo 5:18

english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
translation: Moneni, imwe nalimupeela amaka ayakunyanta pa nsoka na pali bakaliŋongo na yakwansha ubulamba bonse ubwa mulwani. Takuli ne cingamucita akabi nakalya.

english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
translation: Yabeba aiti, “Ifyakulobolola fyena fingi, lelo ababomfi bakulobolola bena banono. Kanshi akulombeni umwine fisabo atume ababomfi na bambi abakumulobolwelako.

english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
translation: Nomba mwilasansamukafye pali ico imipashi yakowela ilecimba kuli imwe, lelo mulesansamuka pali ico amashina yenu nayalembwa mu mulu.”

english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
translation: Kabili pa nshita ine iyo, elyo Mupashi Wamushilo alengele Yesu ukusansamuka, alasosa ati, “Nakutasha Tata, we Mfumu ya mulu ne calo, pantu ifi fintu walififisa ku bamano na ku bacenjela, wafisokolola ku bantu bafye. Ee, Tata pantu we mwine efyo wafwaile ukucita.

english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
translation: Tata alimpeela fyonse. Tapaba nangu umo uwaishiba Mwane, kano Wishi. Kabili tapaba waishiba Wishi, kano Mwane, elyo na bonse abo Mwane atemwa ukusokolwela.”

english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
translation: Kabili uko bali beka Yesu apilibukila ku basambi bakwe alabeba ati, “Yalishuka amenso yenu ayalemona ifintu mulemona!

english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
translation: Awe kafundisha wamafunde umo, aiminine, alemwesha ati, “Kafundisha, bushe ni finshi ndi nokucita pakumona umweo wape?”

english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bushe finshi fyalembwa mu Mafunde yakwa Mose? Finshi ubelengamo?”

english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Uletemwa Imfumu Lesa obe no mutima obe onse, no mweo obe onse, na maka yobe yonse, na mano yobe yonse. Kabili uletemwa no mubiyo, ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.”

english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Wayasukafye bwino. Kanshi ulecita ifyo fine, lyena ukamona umweo.”

english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
translation: Nomba kafundisha wamafunde ico alefwaya ukuiwaminisha, aipusha Yesu ati, “Ngo munandi nani?”

english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
translation: Kabiyeni, namutuma nga bana ba mpaanga pakati ka mimbulu.

english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
translation: Mukumwasuka Yesu ena atila ati, “Umuntu umo afumine ku Yerusalemu aleya ku Yeriko. Mu nshila abapupu bamusansa. Bamupokolola fyonse ifyo akwete. Elyo bamupumaula, baya, bamusha impondo.

english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
translation: Kanshi califye nkuma, shimapepo umo nao aleya mu nshila imo ine. Nomba ilyo amona uyu muntu, wena alambata, apita lubali, alaya.

english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
translation: Kanshi umwina Levi nao acita ifyo fine. Nao atile ashifika pali iyi ncende, amona umuntu uwapuminwe, alambata, apita alaya.

english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
translation: Nomba umwina Samaria uwali pa bulendo, ilyo afika pa muntu uwapuminwe, cilya amona uyu muntu, uluse lwamwikata.

english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
translation: Aya apo ali. Abuula amafuta no mwangashi aitila pa filonda, elyo alafikakila. Kabili amuteka pa nama yakwe, amutwala na ku ŋanda ya beni alamutensha.

english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkapo, abuula indalama sha silifa shibili, apeela no mwine ŋanda. Amweba ati, ‘Ulemutensha bwino. Kabili indalama shonse ukaposapo, pakubwela nkesa kubwesesha.’ ”

english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
translation: Nomba iwe pali aba batatu uo uletila e mubiye wa uyu muntu uwasanshilwe na bapupu nani?

english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Ni uyo wamucitile uluse.” Yesu epakumweba ati, “Kabiye na iwe ulecita ifyo fine.”

english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
translation: Kabili ilyo Yesu na basambi bakwe bacili baleya pa bulendo, bafikile ku mushi umo. Elyo umwanakashi umo ishina lyakwe ni Malita, amupokelela kumwakwe.

english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
translation: Malita ali na nkashimbiye ishina lyakwe ni Maria, ena aikala mupepi ne Mfumu pamo na basambi bakwe, alekutika kufyo ilelanda.

english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
translation: Mwilasenda cikwama, nangu icola, nangu ni ndyato. Ilyo muleya mu nshila, mwilaposha nelyo umo.

english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
translation: Malita wena alepitanafye mukupekanya ifyakubatebeta. Awe asuka aisa kuli Yesu alamweba ati, “We Mfumu, bushe tausakamene ukuti nkashi nandi andekelefye neka mukupekanya? Mwebeni ese angafweko!”

english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
translation: Nomba Imfumu yamwasuka aiti, “Malita, Malita ee, ala ulepitana no kusakamikwa ne fintu ifingi.

english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
translation: Lelo cintufye cimo ecilefwaikwa. Maria ena nasala iciwemepo. Kabili takwakabe uwakumupokolola.”

english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
translation: Elyo mu ŋanda yonse iyo mwaingilamo, muletala mwasosa amuti, ‘Umutende ube muli ino ŋanda!’

english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
translation: Na cine ngo muntu wamutende ewikalamo, umutende wenu ulemwishila. Nomba nga teifyo, ninshi ulemubwelela.

english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
translation: Muleikala mu ŋanda imo ine. Mulelya no kunwa ifyo bamupeela, pantu umubomfi afwile ukupeelwa amalipilo yakwe. Mwilasela ukufuma muli iyi ŋanda ukuya ku ŋanda imbi.

english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
translation: Kabili mu musumba onse umo mwaingila, na bantu bamupokelela, mulelya ifyo bamuletela.

english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
translation: Muleposha na balwele abalimo. Mulebeba nokuti, ‘Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa nabumupalama.’

english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
translation: Ubushiku bumo Yesu alepepa mu ncende imo. Ilyo alekele ukupepa, umusambi wakwe umo amwebelea ati, “We Mfumu tufunde ukupepa, ngefyo Yoani afundile abasambi bakwe.”

english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
translation: Pantu onse uulomba, alapeelwa. Uufwaya, alasanga. Elyo uukonkonsha, nao balamwiswila.

english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
translation: Nga nani pali imwe mwe bashibo engapeela mwane insoka, nga amulomba isabi?

english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
translation: Nangu nga cakuti amulomba ilini, bushe kuti mwamupeela kaliŋongo?

english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
translation: Nga kanshi apo imwe mwe baba ababi, mwaishiba ukupeela abana benu ifintu ifisuma. Palibufi Shinwe wa mu mulu, akapeela Mupashi Wamushilo kuli bonse abamulomba.”

english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
translation: Kabili Yesu aletamfya umupashi wakowela uwalengele uyu muntu ukuba cibulu. Cilya umupashi wakowela wafumamo no muntu uwali cibulu alalanda. Awe abantu balapapafye.

english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
translation: Nomba bamo bena balasosa abati, “Ni ku maka yakwa Belesebu, umukalamba wa mipashi yakowela eko atamfisha imipashi yakowela.”

english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
translation: Bambi bena pakumwesha balamwipusha ukuti acitepo icipeshamano icakulanga ukuti aba na Lesa.

english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya, abeba ati, “Ubuteko bonse umwaba ukulwishanya abene ninshi bukonaika. Elyo aba mu ŋanda imo kumfwa nga mwaba ukulwishanya ninshi tekuti batwalilile.

english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
translation: Nga kanshi Satana nga alailwisha umwine, bushe kuti ubuteko bwakwe bwatwalilila shani? Pantu imwe mulesosa ukuti, ni ku maka yakwa Belesebu eko ntamfisha imipashi yakowela.

english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
translation: Nga kanshi ine nga ntamfya imipashi yakowela ku maka yakwa Belesebu, nga abasambi benu bena, baitamfya ku maka yakwani? Kanshi ebakumupingula.

english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
translation: Yesu elyo abeba ati, “Ilyo mulepepa, mulesosa amuti,

english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
translation: Lelo nga ni ku maka yakwa Lesa eko ntamfisha imipashi yakowela, ninshi Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa nabufika uko muli.

english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
translation: Nomba wamaka nasakalala ne fyanso mu minwe, alelinda iŋanda yakwe, awe tapali nangu cimo cingacitika ku fyuma fyakwe.

english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
translation: Nomba uwamucila amaka nga aisa mulwisha, amucimfya no kumucimfya. Lyena kuti amupoka ne fyanso ashintililamo ayakanya ne fyuma fyakwe.

english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
translation: Uushaba na ine ninshi mulwani. Uushibomba na ine mukulonganya, alasalanganya.

english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
translation: “Ilyo umupashi wakowela wafuma mu muntu, waya ulelulumba mu matololo umwabula amenshi, ulefwaya apakutuusha, nomba nokuti upamone nakalya. Elyo wasosa auti, ‘Kambwelelefye ku ŋanda yandi uko mfumine.’

english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
translation: Cilya wafikamo, wasanga nabapyanga nabamusamika.

english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
translation: Awe waya isa ne mipashi yakowela imbi cine lubali iyabipisha ukuucila. Elyo yaisa ingilamo emo yaikala. Awe nomba imibeele ya bumi bwa muntu iya pakulekelesha yabipishapo ukucila ifyo cali kale.”

english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alelanda ifi, umwanakashi umo mwibumba asanswile ishiwi asosa ati, “Lyalishuka ifumo ilyakusendele, na mabele waonkeleko!”

english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
translation: Nao ayasuka ati, “Palibufi abomfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa no kulisunga balisunga, ala ebashuka.”

english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
translation: Ilyo amabumba yafulileko, Yesu ayebele ati, “Iyi nkulo, ni nkulo ibi. Ilefwaya icishibilo cacipeshamano. Nomba tayakamone icishibilo nakalya, kanofye ninshi icakwa Yona.

english: Give us day by day our daily bread.
translation: Uletupeela cila bushiku icakulya cesu tulekabila.

english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
translation: Kanshi nga filya Yona amoneke ukuba icishibilo cacipeshamano ku bena Ninife, efyo no Mwana wa muntu akaba kuli ino nkulo.

english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
translation: Pa bushiku bwabupingushi, namfumu wa ku Sheba akemina abantu ba ino nkulo no kubapeela umulandu. Pantu wena afumine ku mpela ya calo, kukwisa umfwa amano yakwa Solomoni. Nomba pano palipo uwacila Solomoni!

english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
translation: Pa bushiku bwabupingushi, abena Ninife bakemina abantu ba ino nkulo no kubapeela umulandu. Pantu bena balilapile no kupilibuka ilyo Yona abilile imbila kumwabo. Nomba pano palipo uwacila Yona!

english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
translation: “Tapaba nangu umo uusanika icisaniko, kabili acibika ukwafisama, nangu acikupikila mu nongo. Lelo bacibika apasansama, pakuti abantu baleingila umwabuuta.

english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
translation: Icisaniko ca mubili obe, linso. Amenso yobe nga yatuntulu, ninshi umubili obe onse uli mu lubuuto. Lelo amenso yobe nga yalwele, ninshi umubili obe onse uli mu mfifi.

english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
translation: Kanshi ulemona ukuti ulubuuto lobe lwiyaluka imfifi.

english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
translation: Kanshi umubili obe onse nga uli mu lubuuto, tamuli mfifi nelyo panono. Awe ninshi lyena uli mu lubuuto lweka lweka, kwati ni filya ulubuuto lwa cisaniko nga lwakusanikila.”

english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
translation: Cilya Yesu alekafye ukulanda, Umufalise umo amwitile ukuti aye lya kumwakwe. Awe Yesu aingila, aikala, balalya no kulya.

english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
translation: Umufalise asunguka pakumona ukuti, Yesu alalya ukwabula ukuti abalilepo ukusamba iminwe.

english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
translation: Nomba Imfumu yamweba aiti, “Imwe, mwe Bafalise, muwamya inkombo ne mbale kunse, lelo mu mitima yenu mwaisula ubulili no bukakashi.

english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
translation: Uletubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyesu,

english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
translation: Mwe fipumbu mwe, bushe uwabumbile kunse tewabumbile na mukati mwine?

english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
translation: Ala mulekumbusukako abalanda pafyo mwakwata, lyena na fyonse fyakulaba ifyakaele.

english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
translation: “Lelo imwe mukacimona mwe Bafalise! Mwe batuula cimo pekumi lyonse na pa misalufye iyakuwamya ifyakulya. Lelo mwalisuulako kukucita umulinganya no kutemwa Lesa. Ifi efyo mwaba nokucita, elyo na fimbi fine tamuli nakufisuulako.

english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe Bafalise! Pantu mwatemwa ifipuna ificindamishepo mu masinagoga, nokuti abantu balemuposha mu mansa sha fisankano!

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
translation: Mukacimona imwe! Pantu mwaba nge mputa sha pa nindi sha bantu ishaloba, isho abantu bendapo ukwabula ukwishiba.”

english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
translation: Elyo kafundisha wamafunde umo amweba ati, “Kafundisha, mukulanda ifyo, na ifwe bene watusaalula.”

english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
translation: Nao Yesu ati, “Na imwe bene bakafundisha bamafunde, mukacimona! Pantu mutwika abantu ifipe ifyafina, ifyo imwe mwe bene mushingatenshamo nelyo panono.

english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
translation: Mukacimona na imwe! Mukuulilila inindi sha bakasesema abo ifikolwe fyenu fyaipeye.

english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
translation: Kanshi muli bakambone, kabili no kusuminisha mwalisuminisha ifyo ifikolwe fyenu fyacitile. Bena balibepeye, elyo imwe mwalakuulilila ne nindi shabo.

english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
translation: Kanshi amano yakwa Lesa epakutila, ‘Nakulabatumina bakasesema na basole. Bamo bakulabepaya, bambi nabo bakulabacusha.’

english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
translation: Kabili Yesu alabeba ati, “Pali imwe umo nga alikwata cibusa wakwe, elyo aisa ubushiku pakati, alamweba ati, ‘Mune, njashimako imikate itatu.

english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
translation: Epakuti ino nkulo ikakandwe pa mulandu wakwipaya bakasesema ukufuma apo isonde lyatendekele.

english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
translation: Emukutila ukufuma pa mfwa yakwa Abeli, ukufika na ku mfwa yakwa Sakaria, uo baipaile mwi Tempele, lubali lwa pa ntanshi ya bulambo bwakwa Lesa. Ndemweba icine cine abantu ba ino nkulo bali nokukandwa pali ifi fyonse.

english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
translation: “Mukacimona mwe bakafundisha bamafunde! Pantu mwalipokolola abantu ulufungulo lwa mu ŋanda ya mano! Imwe mwe bene tamwingilamo, elyo mwalesha na bambi abalefwaya ukwingilamo!”

english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
translation: Ilyo Yesu afuma mu ŋanda, bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise balamupamfya nganshi mukulanda, balefwaya ukuti alande pa fintu ifingi.

english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
translation: Balefwailisha icakuti bengamwikatilapo mukulanda.

english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
translation: Cibusa wandi uuli pa bulendo afika, elyo nshikwete nangu kamo akakuti mupeele alye.’

english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
translation: Nomba uuli mu ŋanda amwasuka ati, ‘Wilancusha. Icibi ninjisala. Abana bandi na ine wine natulala. Kanshi tekuti njime njise nkupeele.’

english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
translation: Ndemweba ukuti, nangu ashingema no kumupeela ico ni cibusa wakwe, lelo ku mulandu wa mukosela wakwe, kuti aima amupeela na fyonse ifyo alefwaya.

english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
translation: “Kanshi na ine ndemweba nati, akulombeni, bakulamupeela. Akufwayeni, na imwe mwakulasanga. Akukonkonsheni, bakulamwiswila.

english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
translation: Elyo pa nshita iyo ine kwaishile longana amabumba ya bantu imyandamishila, icakuti balanyantanafye. Yesu elyo abalilepo ukulaeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Mulecenjela ku ntutumushi ya Bafalise, emukutila, kuli bumfundabuteshi bwabo.

english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
translation: “Elyo kabili onse uwasosa amashiwi yamusaalula pa Mwana wa muntu, akabelelwa uluse. Lelo uwasosa amashiwi yamusaalula pali Mupashi Wamushilo, takabelelwe uluse nakalya.

english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;
translation: “Kanshi ilyo bakalamutwala kukulubulula mu masinagoga, kuli bashamfumu na ku ba mu buteko, mwikalasakamana pakuipokololako, nangu pafyo muli nokusosa.

english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
translation: Ala Mupashi Wamushilo akamulangilila pa nshita ine iyo ifyo muli nokusosa.”

english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
translation: Elyo umuntu umo mwibumba aebele Yesu ati, “Kafundisha, eba munyinane anjakanyeko icuma shifwe atushilile ilyo alefwa.”

english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “We muntu we, nga nani wasonta ine ukuba kapingula nangu kaakanya wa fyuma fyenu?”

english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Mulecenjela, muleisunga ku mukonkelelo wakukwatisha ifyuma. Pantu umweo wa muntu, tawaba mukukwatisha ifyuma ifingi.”

english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
translation: Elyo abomina umulumbe uyu ati, “Kwaliko umuntu umo umukankala, uo mwibala lyakwe mwali ifisabo ifingi.

english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
translation: Elyo alatontonkanya mu mutima wakwe ati, ‘Bushe ndecita shani? Nshikwete mwakututila ifisabo fyandi.’

english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
translation: Kabili atila ati, ‘Naishiba ifyo ndi nokucita. Nkakuululula amatala yandi, elyo nkakuulepo ayakulileko. Emo nkatutila ifisabo fyandi fyonse ne fyuma fyandi.

english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’
translation: Awe lyena nkaieba nokuti, eya mwandi, naukwata ifintu ifisuma ifingi. Kanshi nomba kwikalafye, ukulya, ukunwa no kulaipakisha!’

english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
translation: Pantu takwaba nangu cimo icabelama, icishakasokoloke. Nangu icafisama, icishakeshibikwe.

english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
translation: Nomba Lesa amweba ati, ‘We cipumbu we! Mu bushiku bwine buno ndeisa kupoka umweo. Nga kanshi ifintu watutila fikaba fyakwani?’

english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo cikaba ku muntu onse uuituntumikila ifyuma, nomba Lesa ena aishiba ukuti mupina.”

english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
translation: Kabili Yesu aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Kanshi eico ndemweba, mwilasakamikwa palwa bumi bwenu amuti, ‘Bushe tulelya nshi?’ Nangu ni palwa mubili wenu ukuti ‘Bushe finshi tulefwala?’

english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
translation: Pantu ubumi bwenu bwalicindama ukucila ifyakulya. Elyo no mubili walicindama ukucila ifyakufwala.

english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
translation: Shimoneni bamwankole, bena tabatanda nelyo ukuseepa. Tabakwata mwakututila nelyo amatala, lelo Lesa alabalisha. Nga palibufi imwe mwalicindama nganshi ukucila ifyuni.

english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
translation: Bushe nani pali imwe nangu engasakamikwa shani, engailundilako inshiku sha bumi bwakwe?

english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
translation: Kanshi apo mufilwa ukucita ifintu ifyacepesha ngefi, nga kanshi kuti mwasakamikwa shani pali fimbi?

english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
translation: Shimoneni amaluba ifyo yakula. Tayabomba nangu ukupikula insalu shakufwala. Lelo ine ndemweba, na Solomoni wine nangu ali umukankala nganshi, tatalile afwala insalu ishayemba nga aya maluba.

english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
translation: Apo Lesa afwika ifi amaluba ya mu mpanga ayakuti yalipo lelo, bwaisaca bayaposa mu mulilo, bushe imwe nimwe ashingasakamana ukufwika, mwe ba cisumino cinono?

english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
translation: Kanshi imwe mwilasakamana amuti, ‘Bushe tulelya nshi nangu tulenwa nshi? Iyoo mwilasakamikwa.’

english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
translation: Eico kanshi ifyo mwalanda mu mfifi, fikomfwika pa bwelu. Elyo ifyo mwatotoshanya mu ŋanda, bakafyalasha kuli bonse.

english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
translation: Ifi fyonse efisakamika imitima ya bantu ba pano calo abashaishiba Lesa. Nomba imwe Shinwe alishiba ukuti mulafikabila.

english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
translation: Kanshi mutale musakamane ukufwaya Ubufumu bwakwe, elyo nefi fine fyonse akamubikilapo.

english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
translation: “Mwilatunsha mitima mwe kabungwe kandi! Pantu Shinwe alitemwa nganshi ukuti mube nankwe mu Bufumu.

english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
translation: Muleshitisha ifyuma fyenu, elyo mulekumbusukako abalanda. Muleipekanishisha ifikwama ifishakasapuke. Mulebika icuma cenu mu mulu umo cishingonaika, uko abapupu bashingafika, elyo no tushishi twakuconaula takwaba.

english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
translation: Pantu ukuli icuma cobe, ekuba no mutima obe wine.

english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
translation: “Mulefwalila, ne fisaniko fileyaka mu minwe.

english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
translation: Muleba nga bantu abalelolela shikulwibo ukuti abwele ku bwinga. Pakuti nga afika, cilya akonkonsha, apopene bamwiswilako.

english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.
translation: Balishuka abo basha, abo shikulwibo ilyo abwela, abasanga balelola. Ndemweba icine cine ukuti, shikulwibo akabateka kukulya. Akafwala insalu shakutebetelamo no kulabatangata.

english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.
translation: Nangu nga cakuti aisa pakati ka bushiku, nangufye ku macaca, nga shikulwibo asanga balelola, awe ninshi balishuka.

english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
translation: Cena ici muli nokushininkisha ukuti, umwine ŋanda nga cakuti aishiba inshita iyo umupupu aleishilapo, nga tekuti aleke umupupu amwingilile ebe mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
translation: “Kabili ndemweba imwe bacibusa bandi, mwilatiina abepaya umubili, elyo panuma ya ifyo teti bacite cimbi nelyo cimo.

english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
translation: Eico kanshi na imwe muli nokuba abaiteyanya, pantu Umwana wa muntu akesa pa nshita mushenekele.”

english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
translation: Elyo Petelo amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu, bushe nifwe waumina uyu mulumbe, nangu ni kuli bonsefye?”

english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
translation: Imfumu nayo yamwasuka aiti, “Bushe ali kwi kangalila wacishinka, kabili uwamano, uwakuti shikulu wakwe amupeela ukwangalila abanankwe, alebapeela icipande cabo ica cakulya pa nshita iyilingile?

english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
translation: Alishuka uyo musha, uo shikulu wakwe nga abwela, akasanga alebombela umo mwine.

english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, shikulu wakwe akamucita kangalila wa fyuma fyakwe fyonse.

english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,
translation: Lelo uyo musha, ena nga atila ati, ‘Shikulu akokola ukwisa.’ Elyo atendeka ukulapuma abasha abaume na banakashi, no kulalya no kulanwa alekolwa.

english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
translation: Ala shikulu wa uyu musha akesa pa bushiku ashenekele, pa nshita ashishibe. Shikulu wakwe akamukanda, akamuposa uko akaya cimona pamo na bampulamafunde.

english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
translation: “Umusha uwakuti naishiba ifyo shikulu wakwe alefwaya, lelo taipekenye kuficita nangu talefwayafye ukucita, wena bakamuma ifikoti ifingi.

english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
translation: Lelo uushishibe, nomba acitapo ififwile bamukandilapo, wena bakamuma ifikoti ifinono. Umuntu onse uwapeelwa ifingi, bakalondolako ifingi. Elyo na uo baseekeshako ifingi, bakalondolapo ificililepo.

english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
translation: “Naisa kukuposa umulilo pano isonde, kabili autampa ukulapya nga kuti cawama!

english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
translation: Kanshi ndemweba uo muli nokulatiina. Muletiina Lesa, uwakuti nga aipaya, alikwata na maka yakuposa mu mulilo wape. Ee, wena ndemweba mulemutiina.

english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
translation: Ndi nokubatishiwa ulubatisho, kabili ndi uwapamfiwa nganshi ukuti cipwilemo limo.

english: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
translation: Bushe muleti naisa pano calo kukuleta icibote? Awe iyoo, ndemweba icine naisa kukuleta ukupusana.

english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
translation: Pantu ukufuma pali nomba, mu ŋanda imo umwaba abantu basano, batatu bakapusana na banabo babili. Elyo aba babili bakapusana na banabo balya batatu.

english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
translation: Wishi akapusana na mwane umwaume, umwana umwaume akapusana na wishi. Nyina akapusana na mwane umwanakashi, umwana umwanakashi akapusana na nyina. Nyina fyala akapusana na nafyala, elyo nafyala nao akapusana na nyina fyala.”

english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
translation: Kabili Yesu aebele amabumba ya bantu ati, “Imwe mutila nga mwamona ikumbi lyateka lwa ku masamba, apopene musosa amuti, ‘Imfula yalaisa,’ na cine ileisa.

english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
translation: Elyo kabili mutila nga mwamona umwela ulepuupa, ulefuma ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, musosa amuti, ‘Kuleba icipuki,’ na cine efyo ciba.

english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
translation: Mwe babwilikandimi mwe! Mwalishiba ukwilula ifimoneka pano calo no mulu. Nga kanshi kuti mwafilwa shani ukwilula ifilemoneka muli ino nshita?

english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
translation: “Ngeco imwe mwe bene mushipingwila mu mano ukucita icilungeme cinshi?

english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
translation: Kanshi ilyo muleya ku cilye camilandu no muntu uukupeele umulandu, ilyo mucili muleya mu nshila, weshe ukuti mumfwane nankwe cipwile apopene. Pantu limbi kuti akutwala kuli kaputula wamilandu. Elyo kaputula wamilandu nao akutwala kuli kapokola. Kapokola nao akuposa mu cifungo.

english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
translation: Ndekweba, tawakafumemo, mpakafye ukapwishishishe ukufuta na kandalama akakupelekeshako.”

english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
translation: “Bushe tuncelelya tusano tatushitwa pa ndalama shibili? Nomba Lesa talabapo nelyo kamo.

english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
translation: Elyo ne mishishi ya ku mitwe yenu ine, yonse intu yapendwa. Kanshi mwilaba na mwenso, imwe mwalicindama ukucila tuncelelya utwingi.

english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
translation: “Umuntu onse uushitiina kunumbula pa bantu ukuti muntu wandi, Umwana wa muntu nao takatiine kumulumbula pa cinso ca bamalaika bakwa Lesa.

english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
translation: Lelo uyo uukankaana pa bantu, nao Umwana wa muntu akamukaana pa cinso ca bamalaika bakwa Lesa.

english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
translation: Pa nshita ine iyo, abantu bamo abalipo baleshimikila Yesu ifyo Pilato aipeye abena Galile pa nshita baletuula Lesa amalambo.

english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
translation: Pa bushiku bwe Sabata bumo, Yesu alefunda mu sinagoga.

english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
translation: Kanshi mwalimo no mwanakashi umo umulwele, ico ali no mupashi wakowela pa myaka ikumi limo na cine konse konse. Aleendafye uwakongama, tewakuti ololoke nakalya.

english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
translation: Cilya Yesu amumona, amwita ukuti ese kuntanshi. Elyo amweba ati, “Mayo, wapusuka ku bulwele bobe.”

english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
translation: Yesu elyo amutambalikilapo amaboko, awe apopene aololoka, alalumbanya na Lesa.

english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
translation: Intungulushi ya mu sinagoga yena yafulwa ico Yesu aposha umuntu pa bushiku bwe Sabata. Intungulushi yalaeba abantu aiti, “Paba inshiku mutanda isho muli nokubombamo imilimo. Muleisa kukundapwa muli isho nshiku, pa bushiku bwe Sabata pena tepo.”

english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
translation: Imfumu epakumwasuka aiti, “Mwe mfundabuteshi mwe! Nani pali imwe uushiswila ŋombe nangu punda pa bushiku bwe Sabata no kufitwala kukunwa amenshi?

english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
translation: Nomba uyu mwanakashi, umwana wakwa Abrahamu, akakwa na Satana pa myaka ikumi limo na cine konse konse. Bushe ena tekuti akakulwe kuli uyu munyololo pa bushiku bwe Sabata!”

english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
translation: Yesu cilya asosa ifi, awe abalwani bakwe bonse baikatwa ne nsoni. Abantu bena basansamuka nganshi pa fintu fisuma fyonse Yesu alecita.

english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
translation: Elyo Yesu asosa ati, “Bushe Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bwapalana kuli cinshi? Cintu nshi ningabupalanyako?

english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
translation: Bwaba nga kalubuto ka lubanga, ako umuntu abuula, akabyala mwibala lyakwe. Ilyo kakula, kasuka kabafye umuti uwakuti ne fyuni fyaisa mukwikala mu misambo yauko.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nomba imwe bushe muleti ico abo bena Galile babepaile ifyo, nico babi ukucila abena Galile bambi bonse?

english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
translation: Kabili Yesu asosa ati, “Bushe Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa kuti nabupalanya kuli nshi?

english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
translation: Bwaba nge ntutumushi iyo umwanakashi abuula, akasawila mu fipimo fitatu ifya bunga mpaka umufuba watutumuka.”

english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
translation: Yesu ali pa bulendo bwakuya ku Yerusalemu. Mu misumba na mu mishi alepita, alefundamo abantu.

english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
translation: Umuntu umo amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu, bushe abakapusuka banono?” Nao Yesu abeba ati,

english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
translation: “Muleipatikisha pakwingilila pa mwinshi uwafyendenkana. Pantu ndemweba, abantu bakafwaya ukwingila, nomba bakafilwa.

english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
translation: “Pantu ilyo umwine ŋanda aima, aisalako ne ciibi, lyena mukashala namwiminina panse. Elyo mukalekonkonsha ku ciibi amuti, ‘We Mfumu, twiswileko.’ Nao akamwasuka ati, ‘Ine nshishibe uko mwafuma!’

english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
translation: Elyo mukatendeka ukusosa amuti, ‘Ala, twalelya no kunwa nobe, kabili walefunda na mu misebo ya misumba yesu.’

english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
translation: Nomba akasuka ati, ‘Ine nshishibe uko mwafuma! Fumeni apa mwe babi ba bantu mwe!’

english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
translation: Elyo mukamona Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo na bakasesema bonse mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa. Nomba imwe ninshi nabamuposa kunse ukukaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.

english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
translation: Abantu bakafuma ku kabanga na ku masamba, ku kapinda ka ku kulyo na ka ku kuso, bakesa andama pa mitebeto ya mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
translation: Ndemweba teifyo iyoo! Lelo na imwe bene nga tamulapile no kupilibuka, ninshi na imwe bene mukaloba ifyo fine.

english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
translation: Ee, na pali ndakai epo bali abakulekelesha abakesa ba abantanshi, na bali abantanshi pali ndakai, ebakesa ba abakulekelesha.”

english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
translation: Pa nshita ine iyo Abafalise bamo baishile kuli Yesu. Balamweba abati, “Ala fuma kuno, uye kumbi pantu Herodi alefwaya ukukwipaya.”

english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Kabiyeni muye eba uyo mumbwe amuti, ‘Ala, lelo na mailo ndi nokulatamfya imipashi yakowela no kulaposha abalwele. Pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu ninshi napwililila imilimo yandi.’

english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
translation: Nomba kwena lelo na mailo na bulya bushiku ndi nokukonkanyapo ulwendo lwandi. Pantu ni mu Yerusalemu fye mweka, emo calinga ukuti baipaila kasesema.

english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
translation: Yerusalemu, we Yerusalemu, we wipaya bakasesema no kwipaya ku mabwe inkombe Lesa akutumina! Yangu imiku ubwingi iyo nalefwaya ukulonganya bamwano, nga filya nankoko afukatila tumwane mu mapindo, nomba tawalefwaya.

english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
translation: Mona, iŋanda yobe ikakushalila icipompa! Lelo ndekweba nati ine tawakamone nakabili, mpaka ilyo ukasosa auti, ‘Napaalwe uyu waisa uo Imfumu yatuma.’ ”

english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
translation: Nangu balya ikumi limo na cine konse konse, abo ulupungu lwa mu Siloamu lwawilile no kubepaya, bushe muleti bali ababi ukucila bambi bonse abaleikala mu Yerusalemu?

english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
translation: Ndemweba teifyo iyoo! Lelo na imwe bene nga tamulapile no kupilibuka, ninshi na imwe bene mukaloba ifyo fine.”

english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
translation: Kabili Yesu abomine umulumbe uyu ati, “Umuntu umo ali no mukunyu uo alimbile mwibala lyakwe ilya myangashi. Awe aisa alefwayako ifitwalo, nomba asanga takuli.

english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’
translation: Elyo alaeba umulimi wa mwibala lya myangashi ati, ‘Mona, nomba imyaka yaba itatu njisa kukufwaya ifitwalo kuli uyu mukunyu, lelo nshisanga nelyo kamo. Uteme! Nga cinshi wingalaonawilafye umushili?’

english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
translation: Umulimi nao amwasuka ati, ‘Mukwai, lekeni ushale na umo mwaka. Nkashimaula mumbali, nkabikamo no mufundo.

english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
translation: Nalimo kusuka watwala uyu mwaka uleisa. Lelo nga tautwele awe ninshi lyena kuutemafye.’ ”

english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
translation: Pa bushiku bwe Sabata bumo, Yesu aile kukulya icakulya ku ŋanda ya mukalamba umo uwa Bafalise. Awe bonse abali mu ŋanda balabesha Yesu.

english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
translation: Kanshi ilyo bakwita, uye ikala pa ncende iyakupelekeshako. Elyo uumwitile nga aisa, aisa kweba ati, ‘Mune, shiselela palya pa ncende iyicindemepo.’ Awe lyena ukamoneka uwacindama kuli abo muli nabo pa mitebeto.

english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
translation: Pantu uyo onse uuikusha, bakamucefya, no uicefya, bakamusansabalika.”

english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
translation: Kabili Yesu alaeba uumwitile ku cakulya ati, “Kanshi ilyo wateyanya imitebeto iya kasuba nangu iya cungulo, wilaita bacibusa bobe nangu bamunonko nangu ba lupwa lobe nangu abena mupalamano abakankala. Pantu nabo limbi kuti baisa kwita, lyena ninshi bakufutilapo.

english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
translation: Kanshi ilyo wacita imitebeto, uleitako abalanda, abalemana, abasunta ne mpofu.

english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
translation: Lyena Lesa akakupaala, pantu tabakwete cakukufutilapo. Kabili ukalambwilwapo pakushukuka kwa bantu abafwile abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.”

english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
translation: Elyo umuntu umo uwali pamo na Yesu pakulya, ilyo aumfwile ifi, aebele Yesu ati, “Alishuka umuntu uukalyako imitebeto ya mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa!”

english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Umuntu umo acitile imitebeto ikalamba, kabili aitako na bantu abengi.

english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
translation: Ilyo inshita ya mitebeto yafika, atuma umusha wakwe kukuya eba abaitilwe ukuti, iseni, fyonse nafipekanishiwa.

english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
translation: Awe bonse umo umo balasoselafye mumo mwine abati, ‘Banjeleleko nafilwa.’ Uwakubalilapo aeba umusha ati, ‘Ine ninshita ibala. Kanshi nalaya kukulimona. Napapata banjeleleko nshaiseko.’

english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
translation: Umbi nao asosa ati, ‘Ninshita amakoli ya ŋombe yasano. Nalaya kukuyesha. Kanshi napapata banjeleleko nshaiseko.’

english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
translation: Kanshi Yesu aikele nalungatana no muntu uwalwele ulusuku.

english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
translation: Umbi nao asosa ati, ‘Kwena ine elyo ngupile, kanshi nafilwa ukwisa.’

english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
translation: Umusha epakubwela aisa shimikila shikulu wakwe ifi fyonse. Awe umwine ŋanda afulwa nganshi. Elyo aeba umusha wakwe ati, ‘Endesha akuya mu misebo ikalamba, na mu misebo inono ya mu musumba, ulete abalanda, abalemana, impofu na basunta.’

english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
translation: Umusha aisa sosa ati, ‘Mukwai, fyonse nacita ngomo banjebele, lelo emo icili ncende.’

english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
translation: Shikulu wakwe aeba umusha ati, ‘Kabiyefye na mu misebo ya mumbali, na mu tushila twa mu mabala, ulepatikisha abantu ukuti bengilemo, uleke ŋanda yandi isule.

english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”
translation: Ndemweba ukuti, pali balya baitilwe, tapali nelyo umo uwakulyako imitebeto yandi.’ ”

english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
translation: Ilyo Yesu aleya, ali pamo na mabumba ya bantu ayakalamba. Elyo apilibukile ku bantu, alabeba ati,

english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
translation: “Uyo onse uwaisa kuli ine, tekuti abe umusambi wandi nga afilwa ukutemwa ine ukucila wishi na nyina, umukashi wakwe na bamwane, bamunyina na bankashi yakwe, elyo no bumi bwakwe bwine.

english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
translation: Umuntu onse uushisenda musalaba wakwe no kulankonka tekuti abe umusambi wandi.

english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
translation: Bushe nani pali imwe, nga alefwaya ukukuula ulupungu, ashingatala aikala, alapenda ifikaposwapo, pakuti amone nga nafikumanina pakupwisha ulupungu?

english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
translation: Pantu limbi kuti aimbafye umufula, kabili afilwa ukupwisha. Lyena abalemonako batampa ukulamuseka.

english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
translation: Yesu elyo aipusha bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise ati, “Bushe calisuminishiwa ukuposha umuntu pa bushiku bwe Sabata nangu iyoo?”

english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’
translation: Balati, ‘Uyu muntu alitampile ukukuula, nomba alifilwa ukupwisha!’

english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
translation: Nangu bushe ni mfumu nshi iyakuti ikwete ifita amakana ikumi limo, nomba ilefwaya ukuya kukulwisha imfumu ibiye iyili ne fita amakana amakumi yabili. Bushe tekuti itale ikale panshi, no kutontonkanya nga kuti yaya kumanya imfumu ileisa kukuilwisha?

english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.
translation: Nga yati, ‘Awe nafilwa.’ Ninshi kuti yatuma inkombe, ilyo imfumu ibiye icili ukutali, pakuti bomfwane pa mulandu wa cibote.

english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
translation: Kanshi e cimo cine na kuli imwe, umuntu onse uwafilwa ukusuula kuli fyonse ifyo akwata, kuti afilwa ukuba umusambi wandi.

english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
translation: “Umucele waliwama. Nomba umucele nga wafumuka, kuti waloweshiwa shani nakabili?

english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translation: Awe wakuposafye, tekuti uwamine nelyo mushili nelyo ni citindi. Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!”

english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
translation: Awe bena batalalafye tondolo. Elyo Yesu abuula umulwele, amuposha, amuleka nokuti aleya.

english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
translation: Kabinge alabeba ati, “Nani pali imwe nga mwane awila mu cishima, nangufye ni ŋombe, ashingamufumyamo apopene nangu ni pa bushiku bwe Sabata?”

english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
translation: Awe bena bafilwa ukwasukapo nelyo cimo.

english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
translation: Yesu cilya amona ukuti abetilwe balaisalila incende ishacindama, alabeba mu mulumbe ati,

english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
translation: “Umuntu umo nga akwita ku mitebeto ya bwinga, wilaya kukwikala pa ncende iyacindama. Epali naita uucindeme ukukucila,

english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
translation: kabili uumwitile bonse, aisa kweba ati, ‘Fumapo, uyu eo ekalepo.’ Elyo lyena ninshi uleselapo ne nsoni nganshi ukuya ikala ku ncende yakupelekeshako.

english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
translation: Bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde baishile longana kuli Yesu, balefwaya ukumumfwa.

english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
translation: Efyo fine na ine ndemweba, bamalaika bakwa Lesa balasansamuka umubifi umo nga alapila no kupilibuka.”

english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
translation: Kabili alasosa ati, “Kwaliko umuntu umo uwali na bana abaume babili.

english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.
translation: Uwamwaice aeba wishi ati, ‘Tata, twakanyeni icuma, ine mumpeele icipande candi ico mwaba nokunshila.’ Nao shibo epakubakanya ifyuma.

english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
translation: Pati papitepo inshiku shinono, uwamwaice alonganya fyonse ifyo akwete. Elyo aima aya na ku calo ukutali, eko aya posaika ifyuma fyakwe mu mikalile yabuwelewele.

english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
translation: Cilya aposaika ifyuma fyakwe fyonse, muli cilya calo mwapona icipowe icabipisha. Elyo atampa ukucula ico ashikwete nelyo kamo.

english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
translation: Epakuya ingila incito ku muntu umo uwa muli cilya calo. Nao amutuma kwibala lyakwe kukulacema inkumba.

english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
translation: Uwamwaice alekumbwa ukulyako ifikapa ifyo inkumba shalelya. Nomba takwali nangu umo uwakumupako.

english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
translation: Yasuka amano yabwela. Elyo atila ati, ‘Mumone abancito ubwingi tata akwata, lelo balalya baikuta fyashalanapo. Nomba ine kuno ndefwa ku nsala.

english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
translation: Awe ine ndeima ndebwelelamo kuli tata. Ndeya mweba nati: Tata nalibifya kuli Lesa na kuli imwe bene.

english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
translation: Nomba nshilingile ukuti mulenjita umwana wenu iyoo. Muncitefye ngo mubomfi wancito.’

english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
translation: Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde balaisosha. Balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu asekelela bampulamafunde no kulya alya nabo.”

english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.
translation: Awe aima alaya na kuli wishi.

english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
translation: Elyo mwane asosa ati, ‘Tata, nalibifya kuli Lesa na kuli imwe bene. Awe nomba nshilingile ukuti mulenjita umwana wenu.’

english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
translation: Lelo wishi wena aeba abasha bakwe ati, ‘Endesheni, leteni umwingila uwawamisha mumufwike. Mumufwike ne mbalaminwe ku minwe ne ndyato ku makasa.

english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;
translation: Mulete ne ciponti ca ŋombe icaina, mucipaye, uleke tulye tusansamuke.

english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
translation: Pantu uyu mwana wandi alifwile, nomba nabuuka, alilubile nomba nalondoka.’ Awe batampa na malila.

english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
translation: “Umwana mukalamba wena ninshi ali kwibala. Nomba cilya alapalama ku ŋanda aumfwa inyimbo noko balecinda.

english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.
translation: Elyo aitapo umusha umo alamwipusha ne ciliko.

english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
translation: Umusha nao amwasuka ati, ‘Munonko nabwela. Elyo bawiso nabepaya ne ciponti ca ŋombe icaina, pantu abwela umutuntulu kabili uwamutende.’

english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.
translation: Awe uwamukalamba afulwa, akaana no kwingilamo. Elyo wishi afuma alamupapata.

english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
translation: Nomba uwamukalamba ayasuka wishi ati, ‘Moneni imyaka ubwingi iyo namubombela ngo musha, kabili nshatala mpula mu mafunde yenu. Nomba imwe tamwatala amumpeela nangu akana ka mbushi, pakuti na ine nacita imitebeto twasansamuka na bacibusa bandi!

english: He told them this parable:
translation: Elyo Yesu abomina uyu mulumbe ati,

english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
translation: Lelo ilyo umwana wenu uyu abwela, panuma yakonaula ifyuma fyenu kuli bacilende, wena mwamwipaila iciponti ca ŋombe icaina.’

english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
translation: Wishi amweba ati, ‘Mwana wandi, iwe lyonse twaba nobe, ne fintu fyandi fyonse fintu fyobe.

english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
translation: Nomba kwena nacilinga ukuti tusansamuke, twangalile pamo, pantu munonko alifwile, kabili nabuuka. Alilubile, nomba nalondoka.’ ”

english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
translation: “Bushe nani pali imwe uwakuti nakwata impaanga umwanda umo (100), nga alufyapo imo, ashingasha impaanga amakumi pabula na pabula (99) mu mpanga, aya alefwaya iyilubile mpakafye aisange?

english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
translation: Elyo nga aisanga, kuti asansamuka aibika na pa mabeya.

english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
translation: Ilyo afika kumwakwe, kuti alonganya bacibusa bakwe na bena mupalamano bakwe. Abeba ati, ‘Ala iseni tusansamuke, ninsanga impaanga yandi iyalubile.’

english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
translation: Ine ndemweba ukuti nifyo fine mu mulu mukaba ukusansamuka pa mubifi umo uwalapila no kupilibuka, ukucila pa bantu bakaele amakumi pabula na pabula (99) abashikabila ukulapila.

english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
translation: “Nangu umwanakashi nga alikwata indalama sha silifa ikumi limo, nomba alufyapo imo, bushe tekuti asanike icisaniko, apyange na mu ŋanda, afwailishe bwino bwino mpaka aisange?

english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’
translation: Elyo nga aisanga, kuti alonganya bacibusa bakwe na bena mupalamano. Elyo abeba ati, ‘Ala sansamukeni pamo na ine, pantu ninsanga indalama nalufishe!’

english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
translation: Kabili Yesu aumine abasambi bakwe umulumbe na umbi ati, “Kwaliko umuntu umukankala uwakwete mushika. Nomba abantu baebele umukankala abati, ‘Mushika obe alekonawila ifyuma.’

english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
translation: Umuntu uwakuti bamucetekela pa fintu ifinono, kuti bamucetekela na mu fifulileko. Umuntu uo bashingacetekela mu finono, teti bamucetekele na pa fingi pene.

english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
translation: Kanshi nga tabalemucetekela mu fyuma fya pano calo nga nani engamucetekela pa fyuma fyacine cine?

english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
translation: Nga tabalemucetekela pa fyuma fya bene, nga nani akamupeela ifyuma ifyakuti fikabe fyenu?

english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
translation: Umubomfi umo tekuti abe umusha wa bashikulu wakwe babili. Pantu kuti apatapo umo, umbi amutemwa. Nangu auminina kuli umo, umbi amusuula. Na imwe kuti mwafilwa ukuba abasha bakwa Lesa, elyo kabili abasha ba ndalama.”

english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
translation: Abafalise, ico batemenwe indalama, ilyo baumfwa ifi, balaseka Yesu.

english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
translation: Nao Yesu alabeba ati, “Imwe mulaiwaminisha pa menso ya bantu, nomba Lesa alishiba imitima yenu. Pantu ico abantu bamona ukuti ecacindama, Lesa ena acimona ukuti cafyefye.

english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
translation: “Ukufika pali Yoani Kabatisha, balefunda Amafunde yakwa Mose nefyo bakasesema balembele. Lelo ukufuma pali Yoani, ni Mbila Nsuma ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa eibilwa. Elyo na bonse abaleingilamo, balelwishafye.

english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
translation: Ala cayangukapo umulu ne calo ukonaika, ukucila ukuti akalitoni kamo aka mu Mafunde yakwa Mose kaonaika.

english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
translation: “Uyo onse uwaleka umukashi wakwe aupa na umbi, ninshi lubembu acita. Elyo noyo uwaupa umwanakashi uo umulume aleka, nao lubembu acita.

english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
translation: “Kwaliko umuntu umukankala, lyonse alefwala insalu ishakashikila ne shabuuta ishamutengo nganshi. Kabili alelyafye ifyakuipakisha cila bushiku.

english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
translation: Nao epakwita mushika wakwe amweba ati, ‘Finshi ifi ndeumfwa pali iwe? Londolola pafyo usunga ifyuma fyandi, pantu tauli nakuba mushika wakulansungila ifyuma fyandi nakabili.’

english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
translation: Elyo pa mpongolo iya uyu mukankala, palelala umuntu umo umulanda, uwali ne filonda umubili onse, ishina lyakwe ni Lasalo.

english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
translation: Alekabila ukulyako ifyo umukankala alefilwa panuma yakulya. Imbwa shena shaleisa shilemumyangila ifilonda.

english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
translation: Awe umulanda afwa. Bamalaika baisa musenda, baya mubika mu ceni cakwa Abrahamu. Awe umukankala nao afwa, no kushiika bamushiika.

english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
translation: Mu cifulo ca bafwa, umo umukankala alecula nganshi, ati enune amenso, amona Abrahamu ukutalifye ali na Lasalo mu ceni cakwe.

english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
translation: Elyo alabilikisha ati, ‘Tata Abrahamu, shi winganangulukilako! Tuma Lasalo atumpike impela ya munwe wakwe mu menshi, ese antalalikeko ululimi. Ala ndeculisha nganshi muli uno mulilo.’

english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.
translation: Abrahamu amwasuka ati, ‘We mwana, ibukisha ilyo wali umumi, ifyo walepokelela ifintu ifisuma, lelo Lasalo wena fibi fyeka fyeka. Kanshi nomba alesansamuka, na iwe nomba ulecula.

english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
translation: Kabili teici ceka iyoo, pakati ka ifwe na imwe, paliba umuyenge ukalamba, pakuti abali kuno abalefwaya ukwisa uko muli teti bapite. Elyo abali uko muli, nabo teti bese kuno.’

english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—
translation: Nao umukankala asosa ati, ‘Kanshi tata nakupapata, tuma Lasalo kuli ba lupwa lwandi.

english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
translation: Pantu nalikwata bamunyinane abaume basano, uleke aye abasoke, pakuti bekesa kuli ino ncende yabucushi.’

english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
translation: Abrahamu ayasuka ati, ‘Balikwata ifyo Mose na bakasesema balemba, kanshi efyo baleumfwikisha.’

english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
translation: Elyo mushika alatontonkanya mu mutima wakwe ati, ‘Ndecita shani apo shikulu alampoka bumushika? Amaka yakulima nshakwata, elyo ukupula nako insoni shikanjikata.

english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
translation: Nao umukankala ayasuka ati, ‘Iyoo, tata Abrahamu, ala nga cakuti umo pa bafwa aya uko bali, kuti balapila no kupilibuka.’

english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
translation: Abrahamu amweba ati, ‘Nga cakuti tabomfwile Mose na bakasesema, nangu uwafwa engabuuka nalyo line teti abanashe nakalya.’ ”

english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
translation: Naishiba ifyo ndi nokucita pakuti nga bantamfya pa ncito, abantu bakansekelele mumwabo.’

english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
translation: Awe alaita umo umo abali ne nkongole kuli shikulu wakwe. Aipusha uwakubalilapo ati, ‘Finshi wakongola kuli shikulu?’

english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
translation: Nao amwasuka ati, ‘Nakongola amatepe ya mafuta umwanda umo.’ Mushika amweba ati, ‘Buula kalata obe, ikala, lembapo bwangu bwangu amatepe amakumi yasano.’

english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
translation: Elyo mushika aipusha na umbi ati, ‘Nga iwe wakongola shani?’ Nao ayasuka ati, ‘Imifuko ya ŋanu umwanda umo.’ Mushika amweba ati, ‘Ale buula kalata obe, lembapo amakumi cine konse konse.’

english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
translation: Shikulu wakwe atasha mushika wakwe incenjeshi, ico abomfeshe amano yabucenjeshi pakuisunga. Pantu abantu ba cino calo balicenjelapo mukwishiba ifyakwikala na banabo ukucila abana ba lubuuto.”

english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
translation: Kabili Yesu alabeba ati, “Muleikwatila ifibusa ku fyuma ifya pano calo, pakuti ilyo fikapwa bakamusekelele mu cifulo cape.

english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
translation: Kabili Yesu aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Kwena ifyakulenga abantu ukubifya fyena fyaba nokubako. Lelo uyo uwalenga umunankwe ukubifya, wena akacimona.

english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
translation: Kanshi na imwe nifyo fine. Ilyo mwacita ifyo bamwebele ukucita, mulesosafye amuti, ‘Tuli bashafye, tucitilefye ifyo twaba nokucita.’ ”

english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
translation: Pa bulendo bwakuya ku Yerusalemu, Yesu alekonka umupaka wa calo ca Samaria neca Galile.

english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
translation: Ilyo alaingila mu mushi umo, awe abafibashi ikumi limo baisa kukumukumanya. Baiminina akatalamukila.

english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
translation: Elyo balabilikisha abati, “Yesu, Shikulu shi wingatulangulukilako!”

english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
translation: Yesu cilya abamona, abeba ati, “Kabiyeni, muye ilanga kuli bashimapepo.” Awe cilya baleya, bapola.

english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
translation: Umo pali aba ikumi, ilyo amona ukuti apola, abweluluka, alepunda ne shiwi likalamba, alelumbanya Lesa.

english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
translation: Aisa fukama apali Yesu, alamutasha. Kanshi uyu muntu ali umwina Samaria.

english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
translation: Elyo Yesu asosa ati, “Bushe tabapolele bonse ikumi? Nga bambi pabula bali kwi?

english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
translation: Bushe tapali nangu umo uwakusakamana no kwisa tasha Lesa kanofye uyu Mwinafyalo?”

english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Ima, kabiye, icisumino cobe ecakuposha.”

english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
