translation: Nomba uwalenga ukuti kamo pali utu twaice ukubifya, kuti camuwamina ukumukulikila mu mukoshi icilibwe icafina icakupelelako no kumuposa muli bemba.

english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
translation: Abafalise bamo baipwishe Yesu abati, “Bushe Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bukesa lilali?” Nao abasuka ati, “Ukwisa kwa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa te cintu ico wingamona na menso.

english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
translation: Kabili takwakabe nelyo umo uwakutila ati, ‘Ala ubu buli kuno!’ Nangu, ‘Ala bulya kulya!’ Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa muli nabo pakati kenu.”

english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
translation: Yesu alaeba abasambi ati, “Inshita ikesa ilyo mukalafwaya ukumonapo ubushiku bumo pa nshiku sha Mwana wa muntu. Lelo tamwakabumone nakalya.

english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
translation: Abantu bakalamweba abati, ‘Ala uyu kuno!’ nangu, ‘Ala ulya kulya!’ Mwikema no kulayako.

english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
translation: Pantu Umwana wa muntu pa bushiku bwakwe, akaba kwati mwele wa nkuba uutila nga wabyata, wasanikilafye umulu onse.

english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
translation: Lelo pakubala Umwana wa muntu ali nokucula nganshi, elyo nokusuulwa na bantu ba ino nkulo.

english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
translation: Nga filya cali mu nshiku shakwa Noa, efyo cikaba na mu nshiku sha Mwana wa muntu.

english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
translation: Abantu balelya, no kunwa balenwa, baleupa no kuupwa, mpaka no kufikafye ku bushiku Noa aingile mu cibwato. Elyo ilyeshi lyaisa, lyabalofya bonse.

english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
translation: Epamo nga filya cali mu nshiku shakwa Loti. Abantu balelya no kunwa, baleshita no kushitisha, balelima no kukuula.

english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
translation: Lelo ubushiku Loti afumine mu Sodoma, mwashele mwaloka amabwe ya mulilo, yabalofyafye bonse.

english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
translation: Kanshi cenjeleni!

english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
translation: Ifi fine efyo cikaba pa bushiku Umwana wa muntu akasokoloka.

english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
translation: “Pali ubo bushiku, uukaba pa mutenge wa ŋanda, ekeka kukuya buula ifintu fyakwe mu ŋanda. Eifyo fine na ku ukaba mu mabala, ekabwela kufyo ashile.

english: Remember Lot’s wife!
translation: Ibukisheni muka Loti!

english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
translation: Uyo onse uufwaya ukusunga umweo wakwe, akaulofya. Lelo uulofya umweo wakwe, eukausunga.

english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
translation: Ndemweba nati, abaume babili bakaba mu tulo pa musengele, umo akasendwapo, umbi akashala.

english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
translation: Abanakashi babili bakalapela bonse pamo, umo akasendwapo, umbi akashala.”

english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
translation: Elyo abasambi bamwipusha abati, “Ni kwi, we Mfumu?” Yesu abasuka ati, “Uko konse ukuba icitumbi, eko na makubi yalongana.”

english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
translation: Nga cakuti akulufyanya imiku cine lubali mu bushiku bumo, elyo kabili abwela imiku cine lubali aleti, ‘Nalapila no kupilibuka,’ ninshi uli nokumubelelako uluse.”

english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
translation: Abasole baeba Imfumu abati, “Tulundileniko icisumino!”

english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
translation: Imfumu yayasuka aiti, “Amuba ne cisumino icili nga kalubuto ka lubanga, kuti mwaeba uyu muti amuti, ‘Ale inukule uye ilimba muli bemba.’ Na cine kuti wamubeela.

english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
translation: “Umo pali imwe nga alikwata umusha uulima mwibala nangu uucema impaanga, ilyo uyu muntu abwela ku mabala, bushe kuti amweba ati, ‘Isa bwangu, ikala, akulya?’

english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
translation: Bushe tekuti amwebe ati, ‘Mpekanishisha icakulya ca mulalilo? Samwina ifyakufwala undetele ifyakulya, elyo upembele mpaka mpwe ukulya no kunwa. Elyo na iwe walalya no kunwa.’

english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
translation: Bushe uyu muntu ali nokutasha umusha pantu acita ifyo amwebele?

english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,
translation: Kabili Yesu aumine abantu umulumbe, uwakubalanga ukuti bali nokulapepa lyonse ukwabula ukunenuka.

english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
translation: “Abantu babili baninike ukuya mwi Tempele kukupepa, umo Mufalise, umbi ni kasonkesha wamusonko.

english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
translation: Umufalise aiminina alapepa mu mutima wakwe ati, ‘We Lesa nakutasha pantu nshaba nga abantu bambi, abapupu, abalufyengo, abacende, nangu ifi fyaba uyu kasonkesha wamusonko.

english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
translation: Ndafunga ukulya imiku ibili cila mulungu. Elyo ndatuula cimo pekumi lyonse pafyo nonka.’

english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
translation: Kasonkesha wena aiminina akatalamukila. Afilwa no kwinwina amenso ku mulu, alayumafye pa cifuba ati, ‘We Lesa, mbelelako uluse ne mubifi.’

english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
translation: Ndemweba ukuti uyu muntu kasonkesha abwelele kumwakwe nalengwa ukuba uwakaele, umunankwe wena iyoo. Pantu uyo onse uuikusha, bakamucefya, no uicefya bakamusansabalika.”

english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
translation: Awe abantu baletele utwaice kuli Yesu pakuti atukumye. Nomba cilya abasambi bamona, balabakalipila.

english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
translation: Yesu ati, “Lekeni utwaice twise uko ndi, mwitulesha iyoo. Pantu ababa ngotu twaice e bene ba Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, umuntu onse uushipokelela Bufumu bwakwa Lesa nga kaice, takengilemo nakalya.”

english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
translation: Umuntu umo umucindami aipwishe Yesu ati, “Kafundisha musuma, bushe ni finshi ndi nokucita pakumona umweo wape?”

english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Cinshi ico wanjebela ukuti ndi musuma? Takwaba musuma nelyo umo, kanofye Lesa eka.

english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
translation: Alabeba ati, “Kwaliko kapingula wamilandu mu musumba umo, uushaletiina Lesa nangu ukusakamana umuntu.

english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
translation: Walishiba amafunde ayatila, ‘Wilabembuka, wilaipaya, wilaiba, wilabepesha, ulecindika wiso na noko.’ ”

english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
translation: Nao asosa ati, “Ifi fyonse ndafikonka ukufumafye ku bwaice bwandi.”

english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
translation: Yesu cilya aumfwa ifi, amweba ati, “Wabulishapofye icintu cimo. Kashitishe fyonse ifyo wakwata. Upeele ne ndalama ku balanda. Lyena ninshi ukakwata icuma mu mulu, elyo wise unkonke.”

english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
translation: Awe wena pakumfwa ifi aikatwa no bulanda, pantu ali uwacuma nganshi.

english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
translation: Yesu amulolesha, asosa ati, “Yangu ifyo cayafya ku bafyuma ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa!

english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Ala cayangukapo ingamila ukupula mu linso lya nshindano, ukucila uwafyuma ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
translation: Abaleumfwako balasosa abati, “Nga kanshi nani engapusuka?”

english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Ico abantu bafilililwafye ukucita, Lesa ena kuti acicita.”

english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
translation: Petelo aeba Yesu ati, “Mona, ifwe twalisha ifyuma fyesu fyonse, twalikukonka.”

english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine takwaba umuntu nelyo umo uwasha iŋanda, nangu umukashi, nangu bamunyina, nangu abafyashi, nangu abana pa mulandu wa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa,

english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
translation: Kabili muli uyo wine musumba mwalimo mukamfwilwa umo. Aleisa libili libili kuli kapingula wamilandu alemweba ati, ‘Ungafweko ukuti umulandu ku mulwani wandi ungwamine.’

english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
translation: uushakapokelepo imikufye iyingi ukucilapo pali fyonse akwata pa nshita ya nomba. Elyo mu nshita ikesa akamona umweo wape.”

english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
translation: Elyo Yesu asendele abasole ikumi limo na babili beka. Alabeba ati, “Moneni, twalaya ku Yerusalemu. Elyo fyonse ifyo bakasesema balemba pa Mwana wa muntu fili nokufikilishiwa.

english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
translation: Pantu akaposwa mu minwe ya Benafyalo. Bakamuseka, bakamucusha no kulamusaka amate.

english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
translation: Kabili bakamuma ifikoti no kumwipaya. Elyo ubushiku bwalenga shitatu, akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
translation: Nomba abasole tabateseshe amashiwi Yesu alandile umo yalolele. Calyanshishe ukuyomfwa. Tabailwike nelyo panono pafyo alandile.

english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
translation: Yesu ilyo apaleme ku Yeriko, kwali impofu imo iyaikele mumbali ya nshila, yalelomba.

english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
translation: Cilya yaumfwa uko ibumba lilepita, yaipusha iciliko.

english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
translation: Abantu bayeba abati, “Ni Yesu wa ku Nasaleti eulepita.”

english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
translation: Elyo impofu yabilikisha aiti, “Yesu mwana Davidi, shi winganangulukilako!”

english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
translation: Abali pantanshi balaikalipila, balayeba ukuti italale. Lelo yena elyo yacila ukupunda aiti, “Mwana Davidi, shi winganangulukilako.”

english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
translation: Kwena palipitile inshita kapingula wamilandu akaanafye. Lelo pakulekelesha asuka alatontonkanya mu mutima wakwe ati, ‘Kwena nshitiina Lesa kabili nshasakamana muntu.

english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
translation: Awe Yesu aiminina, aeba na bantu ukuti balete impofu uko ali. Cilya impofu yapalama, Yesu aipusha ati,

english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
translation: “Cinshi ulefwaya ukuti nkucitile?” Nayo aiti, “We Mfumu, ndefwaya ukulalolesha.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
translation: Yesu nao ayeba ati, “Kanshi akulolesha. Icisumino cobe ecakuposha.”

english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
translation: Awe apopene alalolesha alakonka na Yesu, alelumbanya Lesa. Abantu bonse nabo cilya bamona icacitika, balalumbanya Lesa.

english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
translation: Lelo uyu mukamfwilwa umupampamina wacilamo. Ndi nokuputwila umulandu ngomo alefwaila, epakuti aleke ukwisa mukunkalifya umutwe.’ ”

english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
translation: Elyo Imfumu yasosa aiti, “Mwaumfwa ifyo uyu kapingula walufyengo asosa?

english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
translation: Nga Lesa wena kuti akaana shani ukutulanya abantu bakwe, abamulilila ubwaca no bwaila? Bushe kuti alashingashinga pakubafwilisha?

english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
translation: Awe, ndemweba ukuti, akabatulanyafye bwangu bwangu mu bupingushi bwakwe. Nomba ilyo Umwana wa muntu akabwela, bushe akesa sanga abantu abacisumino pano calo?”

english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:
translation: Kabili Yesu aumine umulumbe ku bantu bamo abaleitunga ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, balesuula na bambi bonse, ati,

english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
translation: Ilyo Yesu aingile mu Yeriko, alecilinganya no musumba,

english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
translation: Ala Umwana wa muntu aisa kukulondola no kupususha abaluba.”

english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
translation: Ilyo abantu balekutika kufyo Yesu alelanda, ninshi alapalama ku Yerusalemu. Abantu bena balatontonkanya ukuti Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bwalaisa apopene.

english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
translation: Yesu epakubomina umulumbe uyu ati, “Umuntu umo uwa ku bufumu, aile ku calo cimo ukutali, pakuti baye mupeela ubufumu elyo panuma akabwele.

english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
translation: Talati eme, aita abasha bakwe ikumi limo. Abapeela cila umo indalama ikumi limo. Abeba ati, ‘Muleshibomfya mukucita amakwebo, mpaka nkabwele.’

english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
translation: Nomba abekashi ba mu calo cakwe balimupatile. Bamutumina ne nkombe uko aile abati, ‘Tatulefwaya uyo muntu ukuba imfumu yesu.’

english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
translation: “Ilyo uyu muntu bamupeela ubufumu, abweluluka. Aisa ita abasha bakwe abo apeele indalama, pakuti amone ifyo bamwenenepo mu makwebo yabo.

english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
translation: Uwakubalilapo aisa asosa ati, ‘Kanabesa, indalama shenu nalimwenapo indalama na shimbi ikumi limo.’

english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
translation: Imfumu yamweba aiti, ‘Mwabombeni! We musha musuma! Apo walanga ukuti uli wacishinka na mu tunono, na ine ndekulashika, uleteeka imisumba ikumi.’

english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
translation: Uwabubili aisa, nao asosa ati, ‘Kanabesa, indalama shenu nalimwenapo indalama shisano.’

english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
translation: Nao Imfumu yamweba aiti, ‘Nakulashika pa misumba isano.’

english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
translation: awe paisa no muntu umo ishina lyakwe ni Sakeyo. Ali umukankala, kabili ewali umukalamba wa bakasonkesha bamusonko.

english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
translation: Elyo umbi umusha aisa, asosa ati, ‘Kanabesa, indalama shobe ishi. Nalisunga, nafisa mu citambala.

english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
translation: Nalekutiina, pantu uli muntu wayafya. Ubuula ne cintu icishili cobe, useepa nefyo ushatanda.’

english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
translation: Imfumu yamweba aiti, ‘We musha mubi we! Ku mashiwi walanda yene, eko nalakupeelela umulandu. Bushe iwe walishiba ukuti ndi muntu uwayafya, mbuula ne cintu icishili candi, nseepa nefyo nshatanda?

english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi ushabikile indalama kulya babikisha indalama, pakuti ilyo nabwela naisa fumyako na kambikilapo.’

english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
translation: Elyo imfumu yaeba abemininepo aiti, ‘Mupokeni indalama, mupeele noyo ukwete indalama ikumi limo.’

english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
translation: Abantu baeba imfumu abati, ‘Ala nakwata indalama ikumi!’

english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
translation: Imfumu yabeba aiti, ‘Onse uwakwata akapeelelwapo na fimbi, lelo uushakwata bakamupoka noto akwata.

english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
translation: Nomba abalwani bandi bena, abo bashalefwaya ukuti mbe imfumu yabo, baleteni pano, mubepaile pa cinso candi.’ ”

english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
translation: Yesu cilya apwa ukulanda ifi, awe atangila balaninika ukulola ku Yerusalemu.

english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
translation: Cilya apaleme ku Betani na Betifage, mupepi no lupili lwa Miolifa, Yesu atuminepo abasambi babili.

english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
translation: Alafwaya ukumona Yesu ifyo aba. Nomba afilwa, ku mulandu we bumba, elyo no mulandu wa ciimo pantu ali umwipi.

english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.
translation: Abeba ati, “Kabiyeni pa mushi ulya pantanshi. Pakwingilafye pene muleya sanga umwana wa punda nakulikwa, uo umuntu ashatala aninapo. Mumukakule, mumulete kuno.

english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
translation: Umo nga amwipusha ati, ‘Cinshi ico mwalakakwila umwana wa punda?’ Muye sosa amuti, ‘Ni Mfumu eilemufwaya.’ ”

english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.
translation: Awe abatuminwe baima, baya sanga fyonse umo Yesu abebele.

english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
translation: Cilya balakakula umwana wa punda, abene babepusha abati, “Cinshi ico mwalakakwila umwana wa punda?”

english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Ni Mfumu eilemufwaya.”

english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.
translation: Awe baleta umwana wa punda kuli Yesu. Bayanshikapo ne nsalu shabo, elyo baninikapo Yesu.

english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
translation: Ilyo aleya, abantu bena balayansa insalu shabo mu nshila.

english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
translation: Nomba cilya aya alapalama ku mutentemuko wa lupili lwa Miolifa, elyo ibumba ilikalamba ilya basambi lyatampa ukulapunda, lilelumbanya Lesa ne nsansa pa fipeshamano fyonse lyamwene.

english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
translation: Lyalati, “Naipaalwe Imfumu iyi yaisa iyo Lesa atuma! Icibote mu mulu, na malumbo kuli Lesa Mukulu!”

english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
translation: Abafalise bamo abali mwibumba, balaeba Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, lesha abasambi bobe!”

english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
translation: Kanshi epakubutukila kuntanshi mu nshila Yesu ali nokupita. Anina umukunyu pakuti amone Yesu.

english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba nga baleka, ninshi amabwe eyakulapunda.”

english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
translation: Ilyo Yesu apaleme ku musumba, ati aumone, alaulilila ifilamba.

english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
translation: Alasosa ati, “Iwe Yerusalemu, mbafye mu kalelo awiluka pa fingakuletela icibote, nomba fyalifisama ku menso yobe!

english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
translation: Ala inshiku shikakufikila ilyo abalwani bobe bakakushingulusha impembwe. Bakakushinguluka no kukucilikila monse monse.

english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
translation: Bakakuwisha panshi, no kwipaya abantu bobe bonse. Mu fikuulwa fyobe tapakabe ilibwe ilyakushala pa mulu wa libiye. Ne cikalenga nico wakeene ukwishiba inshita Lesa alekupempula.”

english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
translation: Kabili Yesu aingile mwi Tempele. Elyo atampile ukulatamfisha panse abaleshitishamo.

english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
translation: Alabeba ati, “Calilembwa ukuti, ‘Iŋanda yandi ikaba ni ŋanda ya mapepo,’ lelo imwe mwaisangula icifulo ca bapupu.”

english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
translation: Awe Yesu ena alafundafye cila bushiku mwi Tempele. Bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde ne ntungulushi sha bantu bena balafwaya ukumwipaya.

english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
translation: Nomba bafilwa ifyakucita, pantu abantu bonse balemumfwa nabolika na matwi.

english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
translation: Cilya Yesu afika pali iyo ncende, apunamina ku muti, amweba ati, “Sakeyo, ika bwangu! Pantu lelo ni kumobe eko ndefikila.”

english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
translation: Awe Sakeyo aikafye bwangu bwangu amupokelela ne nsansa.

english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
translation: Abantu bonse bati bamone ifi, balaisosha abati, “Alaya fikila ku mubifi.”

english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
translation: Nomba Sakeyo wena aiminina, aeba Imfumu ati, “We Mfumu nalapeela ku balanda ifyuma fyandi pakati. Kabili nga nalifyengeleshapo umuntu pa cintu cimo, ndemufutilapo imiku ine pali ico cintu.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Ilelo line ipusukilo lyaisa muli ino iŋanda, pantu uyu muntu nao wine mwana wakwa Abrahamu.

english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
translation: Mukwai, ba Teofili! Abantu abengi balyesha ukulemba pakuti balondolole ifintu ifyacitika pakati kesu.

english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
translation: Ilyo Sakaria ali mukati alefutumwina Lesa ububani, ninshi abantu bali kunse balepepa.

english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
translation: Elyo malaika wa Mfumu amumonekela, aisa iminina lubali lwa ku kulyo kwa bulambo bwakufutumwinapo ububani.

english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
translation: Sakaria ati amone malaika, umutima wafuma, no mwenso wamwikata.

english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
translation: Elyo malaika amweba ati, “Sakaria witiina, ala Lesa alyumfwa ipepo lyobe. Elisabeti umukashi obe akakufyalila umwana umwaume, ukamwinika ne shina lya Yoani.

english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
translation: Kabili ukasansamuka no kwanga, na bantu abengi nabo bakasansamuka pa kufyalwa kwakwe.

english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
translation: Pantu akaba umucindami pa menso yakwa Lesa. Takalenwa mwangashi nangufye ubwalwa bumbi bonse. Kabili akesulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo ninshi acili mwifumo lyakwa nyina.

english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
translation: Kabinge, akabwesesha abena Israeli abengi ku Mfumu Lesa wabo.

english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
translation: Akakwata amano na maka nga kasesema Eliya. Akatangilila Imfumu kukupekanya abantu bakuibombela. Akawikishanya abafyashi na bana. Akalula bacintomfwa ukukwata amano yene yene aya bantu abololoke.”

english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
translation: Sakaria epakwipusha malaika ati, “Nga kuti naishiba shani ifyo wasosa? Ine ndi mukote, elyo umukashi wandi nao nomba nakula.”

english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
translation: Malaika amweba ati, “Nine Gabriele. Njiminina lyonse pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Ine bantumine kukulanda nobe, no kukushimikila ili lyashi lisuma.

english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
translation: Abantu batushimikila, bantu abaliko pakutampafye pene, abaimwenene na menso yabo, kabili abaipeele na kukufunda ishiwi lya Mfumu.

english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
translation: Mona walaba cibulu, tawakulalanda. Ukesa landafye ilyo ifi fintu fikafikila. Pantu tausumine amashiwi yandi, ayali nokufikilishiwa pa nshita iyalinga.”

english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
translation: Ilyo aisa fumamo, awe Sakaria afilwa ukulanda na bantu. Elyo abantu baishiba ukuti Sakaria namonekelwa ne cimonwa mwi Tempele. Awe nomba alabacebulafye, ico ali cibulu.

english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
translation: Ilyo inshiku shapwa ishakutumika Lesa mwi Tempele, awe abwelelamo kumwakwe.

english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
translation: Pati papite inshita, umukashi wakwe Elisabeti aimita. Aleka no kumonekela ku bantu pa myeshi isano.

english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
translation: Alasosa ati, “Imfumu nainangulukilako na ine. Nainsebulula insoni ku bantu.”

english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
translation: Mu mweshi walenga mutanda ukufuma apo Elisabeti aimitile, Lesa atumine malaika Gabriele ku musumba umo uwa mu Galile, ishina lyauko ni Nasaleti.

english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
translation: Amutuma ku mukashana umo ushakuma ku mwaume, uwakobekelwe kuli Yosefu, uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi. Ishina lya mukashana ni Maria.

english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
translation: Malaika aingila umwali Maria, amweba ati, “Mwapoleni we wasenaminwa apakalamba nganshi! Imfumu yaba na iwe!”

english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
translation: Pakumfwa aya mashiwi, Maria camusakamika nganshi, alatontonkanya nokuti, “Nga uku kuposha kwalola mwi?”

english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
translation: Kanshi apo na ine nalipitulukamo muli fyonse bwino bwino pa nshita iyitali, eico we Teofili we mucindami wine wine, na ine nimona ukuti ndi nokumulembela fyonse umo fyakonkanina.

english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
translation: Malaika amweba ati, “Witiina Maria, Lesa alikusenamina.

english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
translation: Ala walaimita, ukafyala no mwana umwaume, ukamwinika ne shina lya Yesu.

english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
translation: Akaba uwacindama, kabili akalaitwa Mwana Lesa Mukulu. Imfumu Lesa ikamupeela ubufumu bwa cikolwe cakwe Davidi.

english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
translation: Akaba imfumu iyakuteeka lyonse aba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo, no bufumu bwakwe tabwakapwe!”

english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
translation: Maria elyo aipusha malaika ati, “Nomba ifi, bushe kuti fyacitika shani, apo ine nshaishiba mwaume?”

english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
translation: Malaika amwasuka ati, “Mupashi Wamushilo alaisa pali iwe, na Lesa Mukulu akakukubanya na maka yakwe. Eico umwana ukafyala akaba uwamushilo. Akalaitwa Mwana Lesa.

english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
translation: Ngefyo na Elisabeti lupwa lobe, uo abantu baleti ni ŋumba, nao ali pabukulu mu bukote bwakwe, na uno mweshi ewalenga mutanda.

english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
translation: Pantu takwaba nelyo cimo ico Lesa engafilwa.”

english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
translation: Maria epakusosa ati, “Cisuma, ine ndi musha wa Mfumu. Lesa engacitila ngomo mwine walandila.” Elyo malaika amusha, aya.

english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
translation: Mu nshiku shine isho, Maria aimine, aile bwangu bwangu ku musumba umo uwa mu mpili isha mu calo ca Yudeya.

english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
translation: Epakuti mushininkishe ukuti fyonse ifyo mwafundwa fyacishinka.

english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
translation: Aingila mu ŋanda mwa Sakaria, aposha na Elisabeti.

english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation: Elisabeti ati ashumfwafye uko Maria alemuposha, umwana alayanga mwifumo lyakwe. Elisabeti epakwisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
translation: Elyo aikatisha ishiwi asosa ati, “Maria, walisenaminwa pa banakashi bonse, no mwana ali mwifumo lyobe alisenaminwa!

english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
translation: Nga nashuka shani icakuti nyina wa Mfumu yandi ese kuli ine?

english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
translation: Pantufye ilyo naumfwa ukuposha kobe, umwana mwifumo lyandi alayanga ne nsansa.

english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
translation: Ee, cine cine walishuka we wasumine ifyo Imfumu yakwebele ukuti fili nokucitika!”

english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
translation: Maria epakutila ati,

english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
translation: No mweo wandi uleyanga muli Lesa Umupusushi wandi.

english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
translation: Pantu alinjibukisha ne musha wakwe, ne wafye!

english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
translation: Pantu uwamaka yonse ancitila ifyakupapa.

english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
translation: Ilyo Herodi ali pa bufumu mu Yudeya, kwaliko shimapepo umo, ishina lyakwe ni Sakaria, uwa mu mukowa wakwa shimapepo Abiya. Umukashi wakwe Elisabeti nao ali wa mu mukowa wakwa shimapepo Aroni.

english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
translation: Kabili umukonkanina inkulo

english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
translation: Alicita ifyamaka no kuboko kwakwe.

english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
translation: Alisamununa bashamfumu pa fipuna fyabo.

english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
translation: Abansala alibekusha ifisuma,

english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
translation: Alitulanya Israeli umubomfi wakwe,

english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
translation: Ulo alaile ifikolwe fyesu Abrahamu

english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
translation: Maria aikele na Elisabeti cikanga imyeshi itatu, elyo abwelelamo kumwakwe.

english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
translation: Awe inshiku shakupaapa shasuka shakumana, Elisabeti epakupaapa umwana umwaume.

english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
translation: Ilyo abena mupalamano na ba lupwa lwakwe baumfwa ukuti Imfumu naimulangulukilako apakalamba, baisa kukusansamuka pamo nankwe.

english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
translation: Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse, baya kukusembulula umwana. Balafwaya ukuti bamwinike ishina lyakwa wishi Sakaria.

english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
translation: Bonse babili bali abololoke pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Balekonka ifyebo na mafunde yonse aya Mfumu ukwabula icilubo.

english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
translation: Lelo nyina asosa ati, “Awe iyoo, alainikwa ishina lya Yoani.”

english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
translation: Elyo baeba nyina abati, “Tapaba nelyo umo pali ba lupwa lwenu uwainikwa ili shina!”

english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
translation: Kanshi balalembula wishi pakumwipusha ishina ilyo alefwaya ukwinika mwane.

english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
translation: Sakaria nao alomba icakulembapo, alembapo ati, “Ishina lyakwe ni Yoani.” Awe bonse balapapafye.

english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
translation: Awe apopene akanwa kakwe no lulimi lwakwe fyakakuka, alalanda, alalumbanya na Lesa.

english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
translation: Awe abena mupalamano bonse baikatwa no mwenso. Kabili ifi fintu nomba fyabafye e lyashi abantu ba mu calo ca mpili ca mu Yudeya balalandapo.

english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
translation: Na bantu bonse abaleumfwako balatontonkanya mu mitima yabo abati, “Nampo ngoyu mwana akaba shani? Pantu Lesa kwena ali noyu mwana!”

english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
translation: Elyo Sakaria wishi wakwa Yoani aisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo, alasesema ati,

english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
translation: “Napaalwe na matotelo Imfumu, Lesa wa bena Israeli!

english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
translation: Natuletela Umupusushi wamaka,

english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
translation: Nomba tabakwete mwana ico Elisabeti ali ni ŋumba. Kabili bonse babili bali abakote.

english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
translation: Umo mwine alengele kale bakasesema bakwe bamushilo batwebe ukuti,

english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
translation: ‘Nkamupususha ku balwani benu bonse

english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
translation: Efyo nkalanga uluse nalaile ifikolwe fyenu,

english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
translation: Icilayo alaile no mulapopo kuli Abrahamu icikolwe cesu,

english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
translation: ukuti akatupokololako ku balwani besu,

english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
translation: Tulemutumika lyonse pa cinso cakwe,

english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
translation: Elyo na iwe we mwana wandi,

english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
translation: Uli nokwishibisha abantu ukuti ukupusuka kwabo

english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
translation: Pantu Lesa wesu waluse ne cikuuku,

english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
translation: Alasanikila abantu abekala mu mfifi,

english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
translation: Nomba ilyo cafikile impuka yakwa Sakaria ukubomba umulimo wa bushimapepo, Sakaria ewalebombela Lesa.

english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
translation: Umwana wena alekulilako mu cimo na mu mano. Ukwikala kwena, aleikala mu matololo mpaka no bushiku aishile isokolola ku bena Israeli.

english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
translation: Bashimapepo bali no lutambi lwakupendula pakusala imilimo cila umo ali nokubomba. Kanshi ubo bushiku cawilile Sakaria ukuti eo aye futumwina Lesa ububani mwi Tempele.

english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
translation: Ubushiku bumo, cilya Yesu alefunda abantu no kubila Imbila Nsuma mwi Tempele, bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde na bakalamba, baishile kuli Yesu.

english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.
translation: Cilya ulwakulobolola ifisabo lwafika, atuma umusha ku balimi pakuti ese bamupeeleko ifisabo fimo ifya mwibala lyakwe ilya myangashi. Nomba abalimi bena bamupumaula, bamutamfya aya iminwe nkutwa.

english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
translation: Kabili umwine ibala atumako umusha na umbi. Abalimi nabo bamupumaula no kumusebanya icabipisha nganshi. Elyo bamuleka, abwelelamo iminwe nkutwa.

english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.
translation: Kabili atumako uwabutatu. Uyu wena bamucenaula, bamuposa na kunse ye bala.

english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
translation: Umwine we bala epakutila ati, ‘Ndecita shani? Nalatumakofye umwana wandi uo natemwa, nalimo wena baleya mucindika.’

english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
translation: Lelo abalimi bati bamumone, balaebana abati, ‘Ala impyani iyi. Aleni iseni tuipaye, ne bala likaba lyesu.’

english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
translation: Awe bamuposa na kunse ye bala lya myangashi bamwipaya.”

english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”
translation: Akalofya abo balimi, akaseekesha ne bala lya myangashi kuli bambi.” Ilyo baumfwa ifi, balasosa abati, “Awe ico cena teco!”

english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?
translation: Yesu abalolekesha elyo asosa ati, “Nga kanshi calola kwi ici calembwa icakuti,

english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
translation: Umuntu onse uukaponena pali ili libwe, akafunaika, elyo na onse uo lyaponena likamushonaula.”

english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde balafwaya ukwikata Yesu apopenefye, ico bailuka ukuti muli uyu mulumbe, ebo Yesu alelandapo. Nomba batiina abantu.

english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
translation: Balamwipusha abati, “Twebeko, bushe ni ku maka nshi ucitilako ifi fintu? Nangu bushe uwakupeela aya amaka nani?”

english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
translation: Kanshi balalindila inshita iyilingile. Elyo batuma abantu kuli Yesu abakuilanga ukuba abacishinka. Lelo bali nokulengula amashiwi Yesu alesosa, pakuti bamwikatilepo no kumuposa mu minwe ya buteko bwa mulashi.

english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
translation: Kanshi balaipusha Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, natwishiba ukuti ulanda no kufunda ifyalungama. Kabili tawaba na kapatulula, lelo ufunda fyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya mu cishinka.

english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
translation: Amalu 118:22

english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ubucenjeshi bwabo, abeba ati,

english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
translation: “Nangeniko indalama imo. Bushe uyu balengapo nefi fyalembwapo fyakwani?”

english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Fyakwa Kesalo.” Yesu abeba ati, “Kanshi akupeeleni Kesalo ifyakwa Kesalo. Elyo akupeeleni Lesa ifyakwa Lesa.”

english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
translation: Awe bafilwa ukusanga icakumwikatilapo pafyo alandile pa bantu. Lelo balapapafye imyasukile yakwe, baikalafye tondolo.

english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
translation: Abasaduki bamo baisa kuli Yesu. Abasaduki bena batila, takwaba kushukuka kwa bafwa. Balaipusha Yesu abati,

english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.
translation: “Kafundisha, Mose atulembele amafunde ati, ‘Umuntu nga afwilwa munyina uwasha umukashi nomba tafyelemo abana, ninshi uyu muntu ali nokuupa mukamfwilwa pakuti afyalileko munyina abana.’

english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
translation: Nomba kwaliko bamunyina cine lubali, abaume beka beka. Umukalamba wabo ewabalilepo ukuupa umwanakashi, lelo afwa ukwabula ukufyala abana.

english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Na ine nalamwipushapo icipusho cimo, munjebeko.

english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
translation: Uwabubili

english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
translation: no wabutatu bamupyana. Nomba nabo lumo lwine, mpakafye bonse cine lubali bafwa, ukwabula ukufyalamo abana.

english: Afterward the woman also died.
translation: Elyo pakulekelesha nao umwanakashi asuka afwa.

english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
translation: Nomba pakushukuka kwa bafwa, bushe kanshi umwanakashi akaba mukashi wakwani, apo aupilwe kuli bonse cine lubali?”

english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Abantu ba ino nshita, balopa no kuupwa.

english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
translation: Lelo abo balingile ukubako muli ilya nshita ikesa no kushukuka ku bafwa, bena tabakaleupa nelyo ukulaupwa.

english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
translation: Bena tabakalefwa. Pantu bakabafye nga bamalaika. Kabili bena bakwa Lesa, ico balishukuka ku bafwa.

english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wakubuuka ku bafwa, na Mose alitulanga mufyo alemba pa cimpusa calebilima, umo aita Imfumu ati, ‘Ni Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki, Lesa wakwa Yakobo!’

english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
translation: Kanshi ni Lesa wa bomi, te Lesa wa bafwa iyoo. Pantu kuli Lesa kwena bonse bomi.”

english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde bamo balasosa abati, “Kafundisha, ee, kwena wayasuka bwino!”

english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
translation: Bushe ulubatisho lwakwa Yoani, lwafumine ku mulu nangu ni ku bantu?”

english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
translation: Kanshi nomba tapali no wakupama ukwipusha Yesu na fimbi.

english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
translation: Elyo Yesu abepwishe ati, “Bushe cinshi ico abantu basosela ukuti, Kristu ni mwana Davidi?

english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
translation: Nomba Davidi umwine mu citabo ca Malumbo atila ati,

english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
translation: mpaka abalwani bobe nkabacite

english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
translation: “Nga kanshi apo Davidi aita Kristu ati ni ‘Mfumu,’ bushe kanshi Kristu kuti aba shani mwane?”

english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba abasambi bakwe, ninshi abantu bonse balekutika, ati,

english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
translation: “Cenjeleni kuli bakafundisha bamafunde, abatemwa ukwendauka nabafwala imingila iyitali. Kabili batemwa nokuti abantu balebaposha mu mansa sha fisankano. Mu masinagoga, batemwa ukusala ifipuna ificindamishe. Elyo no kuli amalila nako basala ifipuna fyamucinshi.

english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
translation: Aba ebalila bamukamfwilwa ifyuma fyabo. Kabili batemwa ukuilanga mukupepa amapepo ayatali. Ala aba bantu ebo Lesa akakandisha ukucila.”

english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
translation: Awe balapingushanya abati, “Nga twatila lwafumine ku mulu, ninshi aletweba ati, ‘Ngeco mushasuminine cinshi?’

english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
translation: Conse nga twatila, ‘Ni ku bantu,’ ninshi abantu baletwipaya ku mabwe, pantu balishininkisha ukuti Yoani ali ni kasesema.”

english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
translation: Kanshi epakwasuka Yesu abati, “Tatwishibe uko lwafumine.”

english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
translation: Yesu nao abasuka ati, “Kanshi na ine nshamwebe ukufuma amaka ncitilako ifi fintu.”

english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
translation: Elyo Yesu abomina umulumbe uyu ati, “Umuntu umo alilimine ibala lya myangashi, aliseekesha na ku balimi. Elyo aya mu fyalo pa nshitafye ikalamba.

english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
translation: Elyo Yesu ainuna amenso, amona abakankala uko baleposa ubupe bwabo mu cipao ce Tempele.

english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
translation: Kabili Yesu alabeba ati, “Umushobo umo ukemina umushobo ubiye, elyo ne mfumu imo ikemina imfumu ibiye.

english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
translation: Elyo kukaba ifikuko, ifipowe, ne finkukuma ifikalamba mu ncende ishalekana lekana. Kabili kukabako ifyakutiinya abantu ne finjelengwe mu mulu.

english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
translation: “Ilyo ifi fyonse fishilacitika, bakalamwikata no kulamucusha. Bakalamutwala ku masinagoga kukumulubulwisha no kumuposa mu fifungo. Bakalamutwala kuli bashamfumu na ku balashi pa mulandu wa ine.

english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
translation: Iyi eikaba e nshita iyakulanga ukuti muli bakambone bandi.

english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
translation: Mushininkishe mu mitima yenu ukuti, tamuli nakusakamana ifyakulanda pakuipokololako.

english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
translation: Pantu nine ne mwine nkalamupeela amashiwi aya mano ayakuti abalwani benu bakafilwa ukwasukapo nangu ukuyansha.

english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
translation: Elyo na bafyashi benu bene, na bamunyinenwe, na bantu benu, na bacibusa benu bakalamutwala ku cilye camilandu. Elyo bamo pali imwe bakabepaya.

english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
translation: Abantu bonse bakamupata pa mulandu wa ine.

english: And not a hair of your head will perish.
translation: Lelo tapakalobe nelyofye mushishi umo uwa ku mitwe yenu.

english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
translation: Mukushipikisha kwenu emo mukamwena umweo wacine cine.

english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
translation: Elyo amona mukamfwilwa umo aposamo utundalama tubili.

english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
translation: “Kanshi ilyo mukamona ifita fyashinguluka Yerusalemu, ninshi mukeshibe ukuti ukonaulwa kwa musumba kwapalama.

english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
translation: Elyo abakaba mu Yudeya bakafulumukile ku mpili. Elyo abakaba mukati ka musumba bakafumemo. Na bakaba mu mabala, bekabwelela mu musumba.

english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
translation: Pantu ishi nshiku shikaba ni nshiku shakukanda, ishakufikilisha fyonse ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.
translation: We shamo we ku banakashi abakaba pabukulu na bakalaonsha abana muli shilya nshiku! Pantu ubucushi ubukalamba bukesa pa calo na bantu bakakandwa nganshi.

english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
translation: Bamo bakabepaya ku lupanga, elyo bambi bakabasenda bunkole mu fyalo. Abenafyalo bakonaula Yerusalemu nakalya nakalya, mpaka inshita ya Benafyalo ikapite.

english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
translation: “Pa kasuba na pa mweshi na pa ntanda pakamoneka ifinjelengwe. Elyo imishobo ya pano calo nayo ikekatwa no mwenso ku mulandu wa kululuma kwa bemba no kusunkana kwa matamba.

english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
translation: Abantu bakafwa umutombo ku mwenso pakumona ifyalacitika pano calo. Pantu amaka ya ku mulu yakatenkana.

english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
translation: Elyo bakamona Umwana wa muntu aleisa mwikumbi na maka no bucindami nganshi.

english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
translation: Kanshi ilyo ifi fintu fikatampa ukulacitika, mukeminine, mukenune imitwe yenu, pantu ukulubuka kwenu ninshi kwapalama.”

english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
translation: Kabili Yesu abomina ipinda ati, “Ku mukunyu na ku mitifye yonse imbi eko mulemwena.

english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
translation: Yesu asosa ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, uyu mukamfwilwa umupina, aposamo ukucila bonse.

english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
translation: Itila nga yapuka ululembelya, ninshi mwaishiba ukuti amainsa yali mupepi.

english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
translation: Yoeli 2:31

english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine ukuti, ino nkulo tayakapite, ninshi fyonse fyalicitika.

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
translation: Umulu ne calo fikonaika, lelo amashiwi yandi yena tayakonaike iyoo.

english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
translation: “Muleikala abaibukila, epali imitima yenu yalemenena ku mikalile yabuwelewele, na kuli bucakolwa, na ku masakamiko ya bumi buno. Elyo ubo bushiku bwamupumikisha, mwaikatwa nga ku citeyo.

english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
translation: Pantu abantu bonse abaikala pano calo bakaponenwa nobo bushiku.

english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
translation: Kanshi mulelola, mulepepa lyonse, epakuti mukamone amaka yakupusuka kuli ifi fyonse ifili nokwisa. Elyo mukamone na maka yakwiminina pa cinso ca Mwana wa muntu.”

english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
translation: Cila bushiku Yesu alefunda mwi Tempele. Lelo cilya bwaila, alefumamo, aleya mukulala pa lupili ulo batila, ulwa Miolifa.

english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
translation: Elyo lucelocelo abantu bonse baleisa kukumumfwa mwi Tempele.

english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
translation: Pantu bonse abaposelemo, bafumishe pa fingi. Lelo uyu mukamfwilwa umupina, wena aposamo tonse uto akwete utwakulilamo.”

english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
translation: Elyo abantu bamo balelanda pe Tempele, abati, “Ifyo lyakuulwa na mabwe ayasuma! Ifyo lilesamikwa ku fyabupe fya bantu!” Yesu ena ati,

english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
translation: “Ifi fintu ifyo mulemona, ala inshiku shikesa, ilyo tapakashale libwe pa mulu wa libwe libiye, yakabongololwafye yonse.”

english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
translation: Elyo baipusha Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, bushe ifi fintu fikabako lilali? Nge cishibilo cakwishibilako ukuti ifi fintu fyalatampa cishibilo nshi?”

english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Cenjeleni mwikabepwa! Pantu abengi bakesa balesosa abati, ‘Nine Kristu,’ no kutila, ‘Inshita naipalama.’ Ala mwikabakonka!

english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
translation: Kabili ilyo mukalaumfwa inkondo ne fimfulunganya mwikalatunsha mitima. Pantu ifi fintu fili nokubalilapo ukucitika, lelo icalo cena tacakapwe apopene.”

english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
translation: Inshikunkulu iyakulyamo Imikate Ishatutumuka, iyo baleti Ipasaka nangu inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, yali mupepi.

english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Pakwingilafye mu musumba pene, muleya kumana no mwaume nasenda umutondo wa menshi. Muye mukonka mu ŋanda aleya ingila.

english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
translation: Muye eba umwine wa ŋanda amuti, ‘Kafundisha aleipusha ati, bushe umuputule uli kwi umwakuti njise ndile Ipasaka na basambi bandi?’

english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
translation: Nao alaya mulanga umuputule wa pamulu, uukulu, uwateyanishiwa. Umo mwine emo mupekanishishe.”

english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
translation: Awe baima baya sanga ne fintu fyonse ngomo Yesu abebele. Nabo epakupekanya ne Pasaka.

english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
translation: Ilyo inshita yafikile, elyo Yesu ayandeme na basole bakwe kukulya.

english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
translation: Elyo alabeba ati, “Ndefwaisha nganshi ukulya na imwe Ipasaka lino ilyo nshilati ncule.

english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Pantu ndemweba, nshakalyeko Ipasaka nakabili mpaka Ipasaka line line likafikilishiwe mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,
translation: Elyo Yesu abuula ulukombo, atasha Lesa, asosa ati, “Buuleni ici, nweniko bonse.

english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”
translation: Pantu ndemweba ukuti ukufuma nomba nshakanwe nakabili ifya ku fisabo fya myangashi, mpaka Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bukese.”

english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
translation: Kabili Yesu abuula umukate, atasha Lesa, aumokaula, apeela na basambi bakwe ati, “Uyu mubili wandi, uo nalapeela pa mulandu wa imwe. Mukalecita ifi pakunjibukisha.”

english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde ico baletiina abantu, balafwailisha inshila bengepailamo Yesu.

english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
translation: Mu musango umo wine ilyo bapwa ukulya umulalilo, Yesu abuula ulukombo, asosa ati, “Ulu lukombo e cipangano cipya ica mulopa wandi uulesuuma pa mulandu wa imwe.

english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
translation: Elyo kabili uulemposa wine tuli nao pano pakulya.

english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
translation: Ukuba kwena Umwana wa muntu alaya kukufwa umo mwine Lesa apekanishisha. Lelo umuntu uwalaposa Umwana wa muntu ena alishama!”

english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.
translation: Abasole epakutampa ukulaipushanya abati, “Bushe nani pali ifwe uwingafwaya ukucita ifyo?”

english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
translation: Elyo abasole balabikana ifikansa abati, “Umukalamba pali ifwe nani?”

english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
translation: Yesu alabeba ati, “Mu Benafyalo mwena imfumu shilomya ubufumu bwabo. Elyo na bakateeka bafwaya ukulaitwa bakafwa ba bantu.

english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
translation: Imwe tacili nakuba ifi iyoo. Umukalamba apo muli, abe kwati e mwaice. Elyo intungulushi nayo ibe kwati ewakutumika.

english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
translation: Nakabushe, nga nani wacindamapo? Bushe muntu uo baletumika ilyo ali pakulya, nangu muntu uulemutumika? Bushe teuyo baletumika ilyo ali pakulya? Nomba ine ndi pakati kenu nga uwakumutumika.

english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
translation: “Imwe nimwe tucululuka na imwe mu macushi yandi.

english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
translation: Nga filya Tata ampeela ubufumu, efyo na ine namupeela ubufumu.

english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.
translation: Elyo Satana aingile muli Yuda uo batila wa ku Kelyoti, umo pa basole ikumi limo na babili.

english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
translation: Kanshi mwakulaandama na ine pakulya na pakunwa mu Bufumu bwandi. Kabili mwakulaikala pa fipuna fyabufumu, muleputula imilandu ya nko ikumi limo na shibili isha bena Israeli.

english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
translation: “Simoni, Simoni ee! Ala Satana alefwaya ukumululusha nga filya bolulusha iŋanu.

english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
translation: Nomba iwe Simoni ine ninkupepelako pakuti icisumino cobe cinenuka. Epakuti ilyo ukabwelela kuli ine, na iwe ukalekoselesha bamunonko.”

english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
translation: Petelo aeba Yesu ati, “We Mfumu, ala ine na ku cifungo kwine kuti twayafye nobe, na kukufwafye kwine.”

english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Petelo, ine ndekweba, lelo line mukolwe talalila, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu ukuti walinjishiba.”

english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
translation: Kabili Yesu abepusha ati, “Lilya namutumine ukwabula ukusenda icikwama, nangu icola, nangu indyato, bushe mwalibulilwepo icintu cimo?” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Awe iyoo.”

english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Nomba lino lyena, uwakwata icikwama acisende pamo ne cola. Uushakwata lupanga, ashitishe insalu shakwe, ashitemo ulupanga.

english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”
translation: Pantu icalembwa pali ine cili nokufikila ukuti, ‘Apendelwe pa bampulamafunde.’ Ifyalembwa pali ine fyalafikilishiwa.”

english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
translation: Abasole epakweba Yesu abati, “We Mfumu, impanga ishi shibili.” Yesu abasuka ati, “Cisuma.”

english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
translation: Elyo Yesu afuminemo, aile na ku lupili lwa Miolifa, ngefyo alecita lyonse. Abasambi nabo bakonka.

english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
translation: Yuda aima aya kuli bashimapepo bacindami na ku bakalamba ba bakalinda we Tempele, pakuti omfwane nabo ifyo engabalubwila Yesu.

english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
translation: Cilya bafikako, Yesu alabeba ati, “Akupepeni, epakukanawila mu ntunko.”

english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
translation: Elyo Yesu atalukako ku basambi, aya akatalamukila, afukama, alapepa ati,

english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
translation: “Tata, nga ulefwaya mpokololako kuli ubu bucushi. Lelo ifyo ine ndefwaya tefyo, kano ifyo iwe ulefwaya.”

english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
translation: [Elyo malaika afuma ku mulu amumonekela, alamukoselesha.

english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
translation: Ilyo ubucushi bwamutitikisha nganshi, Yesu elyo aikatisha ukupepa. Amabe yakwe ayali nga mamata ya mulopa, yalatonena panshi.].

english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,
translation: Elyo Yesu aima apo alepepa, abwelela ku basambi. Asanga bali mu tulo ku mulandu wa bulanda.

english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Bushe muli mu tulo? Buukeni, mulepepa, epakukanawila mu ntunko.”

english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alelanda, kwaishile ibumba lya bantu. Yuda umo pa basole ikumi limo na babili, ninshi alebatungulula. Afika apali Yesu, amutomona pakumuposha.

english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Yuda, kanshi ni mukutomona emo waposela Umwana wa muntu?”

english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
translation: Ilyo abasambi bakwa Yesu bamona icalacitika, bamwipusha abati, “We Mfumu, bushe tubakome ku mpanga shesu?”

english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
translation: Awe nabo basansamuka, basuminishanya ukumupeela indalama.

english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
translation: Elyo umo akoma umusha wakwa Shimapepo mukalamba, amusempako ukutwi kwa ku kulyo.

english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.
translation: Yesu wena asosa ati, “Lekeni ifyo!” Elyo aikata ukutwi kwa muntu, amuposha.

english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
translation: Elyo Yesu alaeba bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba ba bakalinda we Tempele, na bakalamba abaishile kukumwikata ati, “Bushe ine ndi cipondo pakuti mwise ne mpanga ne nkonto?

english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
translation: Inshiku shonse naleba na imwe mwi Tempele tamwanjikete nakalya. Nomba iyi ni nshita yenu, iya maka ya mfifi.”

english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
translation: Ilyo baikata Yesu, bamusenda, bamuleta mu ŋanda mwa Shimapepo mukalamba. Petelo wena alekonka lutonuma.

english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
translation: Elyo bakosha umulilo pakati ka lubansa, epo baikala bonse balaonta. Petelo nao epo aisa ikala.

english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
translation: Ico Petelo ekele mu cengelo ca mulilo, umukashana umo umubomfi amumona, amulolekesha ati, “Uyu muntu nao baciba na Yesu.”

english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
translation: Petelo ena akaana ati, “We mayo we, ine uyo muntu nshimwishibe!”

english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
translation: Cilya papita akashita, umbi nao amumona, alamweba ati, “Na iwe uli munabo.” Petelo ena akaana ati, “We muntu we, ine teine.”

english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
translation: Elyo papita cikanga insa imo, umbi nao alamwebekesha ati, “Cine cine uyu muntu nao baciba na Yesu, pantu mwina Galile.”

english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
translation: Yuda nao asumina. Nomba alafwailishafye inshita ingalinga ukumuposelapo, ilyo kushili bantu.

english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
translation: Petelo amwasuka ati, “We muntu we, ine nshishibe ifyo ulelanda!” Awe pa nshita ine iyo Petelo alelanda, na mukolwe alila no kulila.

english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
translation: Awe Mfumu ilyo yapilibuka, yalolekesha na Petelo. Petelo elyo aibukisha ifyo Imfumu yacimweba aiti, “Lelo line ilyo mukolwe talalila, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.”

english: He went out, and wept bitterly.
translation: Elyo afumina panse alila nganshi.

english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
translation: Elyo abantu abalelinda Yesu, batampile ukulamuseka no kulamuma.

english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
translation: Elyo bamufimba pa menso, balamwipusha abati, “Sesema, nani akuma?”

english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
translation: Elyo balalanda na fimbi ifyakumusaalula.

english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
translation: Ilyo bwacele, abakalamba ba bantu na bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde batekele icilye cabo, baletelemo na Yesu.

english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
translation: Elyo balamweba abati, “Twebe, nga niwe Kristu!” Yesu nao abasuka ati, “Nga namweba, tamwasumine.

english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
translation: Elyo nga namwipusha, tamwanjasuke.

english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
translation: Lelo ukufuma pali nomba Umwana wa muntu akulaikala lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa Umwine wa maka yonse.”

english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
translation: Elyo ubushiku bwakulyamo Imikate Ishatutumuka bwafikile, e bushiku baleipayamo ilambo lye Pasaka.

english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
translation: Elyo bashicilye bonse baipusha abati, “Bushe kanshi iwe, niwe Mwana wakwa Lesa?” Yesu abasuka ati, “Ee, nifyo fine mwasosa.”

english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
translation: Elyo balasosa abati, “Bushe ico tulefwaila na bakambone na bambi cinshi? Twayumfwila fwe bene ifyo alanda!”

english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
translation: Yesu elyo atuma Petelo na Yoani ati, “Kabiyeni muye tupekanishisha ukwakuti tulile Ipasaka.”

english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
translation: Nabo bamwipusha abati, “Bushe ni kwi ulefwaya ukuti tuye kupekanishisha Ipasaka?”

english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
translation: Elyo bashicilye bonse baimine, batwele Yesu kuli Pilato.

english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde bena bemininefye pakumwebelela ifyakumupeelelapo umulandu.
