english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
translation: Elyo Herodi pamo ne fita fyakwe balaseka Yesu no kumucitila ifyamusaalula. Elyo bamufwika umwingila uwayemba nganshi, bamubweseshamo na kuli Pilato.

english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
translation: Awe ubu bwine bushiku Pilato na Herodi bayaluka baba ifibusa. Pantu kale tabaleumfwana, balipatene.

english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
translation: Pilato epakulonganya bashimapepo bacindami ne ntungulushi pamo na bantu bene.

english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
translation: Elyo alabeba ati, “Mundetele uyu muntu amuti, aletunka abantu ukuti bemine ubuteko. Ine nimulubulwisha pa menso yenu, nshisangile ukuti alicitapo umulandu pali iyo milandu mulemwebelela.

english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
translation: Elyo na Herodi wine tamusangile na mulandu ngefyo amubwesesha kuli ifwe. Kanshi uyu muntu tacita mulandu nelyo umo uwakumwipailapo.

english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
translation: Kanshi nalamumafye ifikoti, elyo no kumuleka aleya.”

english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
translation: [Pa nshikunkulu ye Pasaka, Pilato alebakakwilapo umufungwa umo.]

english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
translation: Awe bonse bapundila capamo abati, “Ipaya uyu muntu! Tukakwile Balaba!”

english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
translation: Uyu Balaba bamuposele mu cifungo pa mulandu wakusangwa mu fimfulunganya fyakulwisha ubuteko mu musumba na palwa kwipaya umuntu.

english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
translation: Elyo batampa ukulanda ifintu ifyakumupeelelapo umulandu abati, “Twasangile uyu muntu aletunka abantu ba mushobo wesu ukuti bemine ubuteko. Alalesha abantu ukusonka umusonko kuli Kesalo. Kabili alaita no kuita ati, ‘Nine Kristu Imfumu.’ ”

english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
translation: Pilato ico alefwaya ukukakula Yesu, alanda kwibumba nakabili.

english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
translation: Nomba bena balapundafye abati, “Mutanikeni! Mutanikenifye!”

english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
translation: Pilato abepusha umuku wabutatu ati, “Nga kanshi cinshi ico abifya? Ine nshisangile mulandu acita uwakumwipailapo. Kanshi nalamumafye ifikoti muleke aleya.”

english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
translation: Lelo bena babikapofye ukulapundisha abati, “Tulefwayafye Yesu atanikwe!” Awe no kupunda kwabo kwasuka kwanasha Pilato.

english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
translation: Pilato epakupingula ati, ico balefwaya nacicitike.

english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
translation: Awe abakakwila umuntu balefwaya, uo baposele mu cifungo pa mulandu wa cimfulunganya cakulwisha ubuteko na pakwipaya umuntu. Yesu ena Pilato abalubwila ukuti bamucite ifyo balefwaya.

english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.
translation: Ilyo balesenda Yesu, baikete umuntu umo uwalefuma mu mpanga, ishina lyakwe ni Simoni umwina Kurene. Bamutwika umusalaba, pakuti asendele lwa kunuma yakwa Yesu.

english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
translation: Ibumba ilikalamba ninshi lilemukonka, na banakashi bamo balemulilila, baleloosha.

english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
translation: Lelo Yesu ena abapilibukila alabeba ati, “Imwe mwe banakashi ba mu Yerusalemu mwilandilila, lelo muleililila mwe bene, mulelilila na bana benu.

english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
translation: Pantu kukesa inshiku ilyo bakalasosa abati, ‘Shalishuka iŋumba, yalishuka amafumo ayashatala ayapaapa mwana, na mabele ayashatala ayonsha!’

english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
translation: Pilato aipusha Yesu ati, “Bushe iwe niwe Mfumu ya Bayuda?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nausosa.”

english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
translation: Elyo bakalaeba impili abati, ‘Twilikisheni!’ no tupili bakalatulilila abati, ‘Tufiseniko!’

english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
translation: Nga kanshi apo bacita ifi ku muti uubishi nga ku wauma kwena cikaba shani?”

english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
translation: Ilyo baleya, basenda ne fipondo fibili ifyakuya ipaya pamo na Yesu.

english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
translation: Bati bafike pa ncende iyo beta, “Pa cipanga,” awe epo batanikila Yesu ne fipondo, cimo ku kulyo, cimbi naco ku kuso.

english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
translation: Elyo Yesu asosa ati, “Tata babeleleko uluse, pantu tabeshibe ifyo balecita.” Pakwakana ifyakufwala fyakwe, pena balapendula.

english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
translation: Abantu bena ninshi nabeminina baletamba. Lelo intungulushi shena shalamuseka, shalasosa ashiti, “Alepususha bambi. Kanshi naipusushe umwine, nga ni Kristu wakwa Lesa, Umusalwa wakwe!”

english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
translation: Abashilika nabo bene balamuseka. Elyo bapalama, bamupeela umwangashi uwakantuka.

english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation: Balasosa abati, “Nga uli mfumu ya Bayuda ipusushe we mwine.”

english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
translation: Pa mulu wa musalaba wakwe palembelwe ukuti, “Uyu e Mfumu ya Bayuda.”

english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
translation: Elyo icipondo cimo pa fyatanikwe calamusaalula aciti, “Bushe iwe tewe Kristu? Kanshi ipusushe, na ifwe bene utupusushe!”

english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
translation: Pilato elyo alaeba bashimapepo bacindami ne bumba lya bantu ati, “Ine nshisangile umulandu uyu muntu akwete.”

english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
translation: Nomba icipondo cibiye camukalipila. Calamweba aciti, “Bushe iwe tautiina Lesa, mona batupingwilile ukukandwa umusango umo wine.

english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
translation: Nomba ifwe nacilinga ukukandwa. Pantu ifwe tulekandilwa pa fintu twacita. Nomba uyu muntu talufyanyapo icibi nelyo cimo.”

english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
translation: Elyo aeba Yesu ati, “Ukanjibukishe ilyo ukalateeka mu bufumu bobe!”

english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
translation: Yesu aeba icipondo ati, “Ndekweba mu cine cine, lelo line tuleba nobe mu Cifulo Cansansa.”

english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
translation: Cilya akasuba kaile kalefika pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00, akasuba kalishimine! Imfifi yakupile icalo conse, ukufikafye na lilya kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00.

english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
translation: Awe icisalu balecinga mwi Tempele calepuka pakati.

english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
translation: Elyo Yesu apunda ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, “Tata, nalubwila umweo wandi mu minwe yobe!” Ati asose ifi, awe aleka no mweo.

english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo, cilya amona icacitika, alalumba Lesa, asosa nokuti, “Cine cine uyu muntu wakaele.”

english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
translation: Awe na mabumba ya bantu ayalongene kukutamba, ilyo yamona icacitika, yalabwelelamo kumwabo no bulanda, yaleyuma pa fifuba.

english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
translation: Lelo bacibusa bakwe bonse, na banakashi abalemukonka ukufuma ku Galile, bena ninshi beminine akatalamukila, balemonako ifi fyonse.

english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
translation: Nomba bena babikapofye ukusosa abati, “Uyu muntu aleleta icimfulunganya mu bantu mu Yudeya monse ku mifundile yakwe. Atampila ku Galile, nomba nasuka nafika na kuno.”

english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
translation: Elyo paishile umuntu umo umwina Alimateya, umusumba wa mu Yudeya, ne shina lyakwe ni Yosefu.

english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.
translation: Ali shicilye, umuntu umusuma kabili umololoke, nao alelolela Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa. Wena tasuminishe ku mapange na kufyo abanankwe bacitile.

english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
translation: Kanshi Yosefu epakuya kuli Pilato, aya lomba icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
translation: Ati asamune icitumbi, acipomba mu nsalu. Elyo abika icitumbi cakwa Yesu mu nindi iyo afukwile mu cilibwe, umo bashatalile ababika muntu.

english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
translation: Cali bushiku bwakupekanya, ninshi ubushiku bwe Sabata bulifye mukutendeka.

english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.
translation: Abanakashi nabo abaishile na Yesu ukufuma ku Galile, bakonka Yosefu. Bamona inindi nefyo Yosefu alalika icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
translation: Awe babwelulukako, balapekanya amafuta ya cena cisuma. Pakukonka Amafunde yakwa Mose, nabo pa bushiku bwe Sabata balatuusha.

english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
translation: Ilyo Pilato aumfwa ifi, aipusha ati, “Bushe uyu muntu mwina Galile?”

english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
translation: Pilato cilya aumfwa ukuti Yesu wa mu calo cakwa Herodi, amutuma kuli Herodi. Pantu Herodi pa nshita iyo, nao ali mu Yerusalemu.

english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
translation: Ilyo Herodi amona Yesu asansamuka nganshi. Ico ni kale atampile ukufwaya ukumona Yesu. Pantu alyumfwile ifintu ifingi pali Yesu. Kanshi alesubila ukumona uko Yesu alecita icishibilo cacipeshamano.

english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
translation: Awe alaipusha Yesu ifingi, lelo Yesu tewakwasukapo nelyo cimo.

english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
translation: Pa bushiku bwakutampa umulungu, ku macacafye, abanakashi babuulile amafuta ya cena cisuma bapekenye, baya na ku nindi.

english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
translation: Na banakashi abashimike ifi ku basole, ni Maria Mandalena, Yoana, Maria nyina kwa Yakobo, elyo na banakashi bambi.

english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
translation: Nomba abasole ilyo baumfwile ifi, bena baleti fyakusabailafye. Bakaana no kusumina ifyo abanakashi babebele.

english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
translation: Petelo wena aima abutukila na ku nindi. Ainamina mu nindi alolesha, awe amonafye insalu bapombelemo icitumbi. Awe abwelelamo ku mushi, camupesha amano pa ficitike.

english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
translation: Pali ubu bwine bushiku, abasambi babili abakwa Yesu bali mukuya ku mushi umo, uo baleti Emausi. Paba cikanga imilundu cine lubali ukufuma ku Yerusalemu.

english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
translation: Mu nshila balelanda pali fyonse ifyacitike.

english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
translation: Kanshi ilyo balelanshanya, no kwipushanya pali ifi fyonse, Yesu umwine nao abapalama, balaya nankwe.

english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
translation: Nomba amano yabo yalikupilwe, tabamwishibe nakalya.

english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
translation: Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe lyashi nshi mulelandapo ili muleenda?” Awe baiminina, na pa menso yabo palifye bulanda bulanda.

english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
translation: Elyo umo ishina lyakwe ni Kilopasi amwasuka ati, “Ukuba niwe mwenifye weka mu Yerusalemu uushishibe ifintu ifyacitika muli ishi nshiku?”

english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
translation: Yesu aipusha ati, “Nga fintu nshi?” Bamwasuka abati, “Ni pali Yesu umwina Nasaleti. Ku fintu alelanda nefyo alecita, alilanga pali Lesa na ku bantu bonse ukuti ni Kasesema uwamaka.

english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
translation: Basanga nabakunkulushapo icilibwe ukufuma pa nindi.

english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
translation: Lelo bashimapepo bacindami, ne ntungulushi shesu, balimuposa kuli Pilato pakuti amupingwile ukufwa, asuka amutanika.

english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
translation: Ifwe twaletetekela ukuti ewali nokulubula Israeli! Nomba teico ceka, lelo e bushiku bwalenga shitatu apo ifi fintu fyacitikila.

english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
translation: Kwena abanakashi bamo aba mwibumba lyesu bacisa tucilimusha, ilyo bacicelela ku nindi.

english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
translation: Nomba tabacisanga citumbi cakwe. Elyo babwela baisa tweba abati, bamalaika nababamonekela nababeba ukuti Yesu ali umumi.

english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
translation: Elyo abanensu bamo nabo baciya ku nindi. Bayasanga fyonse ngomo abanakashi bacisosela! Nomba Yesu umwine wena tabacimumona.”

english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Mwe mpelwamano mwe, mwafina imitima pakusumina fyonse ifyo bakasesema basosa!

english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
translation: Bushe teifyo fine cali nokuba, ukuti Kristu ali nokucula, epakuti amone ukwingila mu bucindami bwakwe?”

english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
translation: Elyo Yesu alabalondolwela fyonse ifyalembwa pali ena mu Malembo Yamushilo. Atampila kufyo Mose alemba, apituluka na muli bakasesema bonse.

english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
translation: Cilya bafika mupepi na ku mushi balungeme, Yesu ena aba nga uwalapitilila.

english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
translation: Elyo balamupapata abati, “Awe ikalafye kuno na ifwe, pantu bwalaila, na kasuba kaba kukuwa.” Awe Yesu aingila, aikala nabo.

english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
translation: Ilyo baingilamo, basanga icitumbi ca Mfumu Yesu tamuli.

english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
translation: Cilya bali pakulya, Yesu abuula umukate, aupaala, aumokaula, elyo abapeela.

english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
translation: Awe amano yabo yakupuluka, baishiba Yesu. Lelo Yesu ena aongoloka, bafilwa no kumumona.

english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
translation: Elyo balaebana abati, “Bushe imitima yesu tayacilacilimukila mu nda shesu, ilyo acilatulansha mu nshila, aletulondolwela na Malembo Yamushilo?”

english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
translation: Awe apopene baima babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu. Basanga abasole ikumi limo na umo na basambi bambi nabalongana pamo.

english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
translation: Abalongene balabeba abati, “Cine cine, Imfumu naishukuka ku bafwa, naimonekela na kuli Simoni!”

english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
translation: Nabo abafumine ku Emausi balabashimikila ifyacimoneka mu nshila, nefyo bacishiba Yesu ilyo amokaula umukate.

english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
translation: Ilyo bacili balelanda ifi, Yesu umwine aishile iminina apo bali. Abebele ati, “Umutende ube na imwe!”

english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
translation: Abasambi umwenso wabekata, batiina nganshi. Bena balatontonkanya ukuti, “Cipuku tulemona.”

english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ni shani imitima yafuma, mwalatwishika no kutwishika?

english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
translation: Moneni ndupi na makasa yandi, ala nine wine. Njikatenimo, ndolesheni, ala icipuku tacakwata minofu na mafupa ngefi mulemona ine nkwete.”

english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
translation: Awe cabapesha amano. Elyo apopene kwamoneka abaume babili bafwele insalu ishabengeshima, baiminina apo bali.

english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation: Cilya alanda ifi, elyo alabalanga indupi shakwe na makasa yakwe.

english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
translation: Abasambi ku mulandu wakusansamukisha, cabansha ukusumina, balasungukafye. Elyo Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe namukwatapo icakulya?”

english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
translation: Elyo bamupeela icipimfya ce sabi ilyaocewa.

english: He took them, and ate in front of them.
translation: Yesu abuula, alalya, ninshi nabo balemonako.

english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
translation: Yesu elyo alabeba ati, “Ilyo nali na imwe, nalimwebele ukuti, fyonse ifyalembwa pali ine mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, muli bakasesema na mu malumbo, fili nokufikilishiwa.”

english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
translation: Elyo alenga ukuti beluke mu mano yabo bomfwe ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
translation: Alabeba ati, “Kanshi efyo calembwa ukuti, Kristu ali nokucula, elyo mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu, akabuuka ku bafwa.

english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
translation: Kabili ukuti bali nokutampila mu Yerusalemu, ukuya balebila ku bantu ba mishobo yonse ifyo Kristu alefunda ukuti, bali nokulapila no kupilibuka pakubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo.

english: You are witnesses of these things.
translation: Imwe muli bakambone pali ifi fintu fyonse.

english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
translation: Kabili nkamutumina neco Tata alaya. Kanshi imwe mushale mu musumba, mpaka ilyo mukapoka amaka ukufuma ku mulu.”

english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
translation: Awe abanakashi umwenso wabekata, bainamina panshi. Elyo abaume babeba abati, “Cinshi mulefwaila umumi mu bafwa?

english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
translation: Kabili Yesu abafumishe mu musumba abasendele ku Betani. Elyo aimishe amaboko abapaala.

english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
translation: Ilyo line alebapaala, awe abasha, asendwa na ku mulu.

english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
translation: Awe nabo bamupakata. Elyo baima babwelela ku Yerusalemu ne nsansa ishingi.

english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
translation: Inshiku shonse baleikala mwi Tempele, balelumbanya Lesa.

english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
translation: Yesu muno talimo, nabuuka. Mwibukishe ifyo amwebele ilyo ali na imwe ku Galile.

english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
translation: Amwebele ati, ‘Umwana wa muntu ali nokuposwa mu minwe ya bantu ababi, bakamutanika, elyo mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu, akabuuka.’ ”

english: They remembered his words,
translation: Awe abanakashi epakwibukisha amashiwi Yesu abebele.

english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
translation: Cilya babweluluka ku nindi, awe baisa shimika ifi fyonse ku basole ikumi limo na umo, elyo na kuli bambi bonse.

english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
translation: Mu nshiku shine isho, Kesalo Angusito aumine imbila ukuti abantu bonse aba mu calo conse ica bena Roma bali nokulembwa no kupendwa.

english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
translation: Malaika elyo abeba ati, “Ala iyoo, mwitiina. Naisa kukumushimikila ilyashi ilisuma, ilyakusansamushafye bonse.

english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
translation: Ala lelo mu musumba wakwa Davidi, Umupusushi wenu nafyalwa, ni Kristu Imfumu!

english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
translation: Icakumwishibilako nici. Muleya sanga akamwana nabakapomba mu nsalu, nabakalalika mu mulimba.”

english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
translation: Elyo apopene kwamoneka ibumba ilikalamba ilya fita fya mu mulu pamo na malaika, balalumbanya Lesa abati,

english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
translation: “Natulumbe Lesa mu mulu!

english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
translation: Bamalaika cilya babasha babwelelamo ku mulu, bakacema balaebana abati, “Aleni natuleya ku Betelemu, tuye mona icicitikeko, ico Imfumu yaisa twishibishako.”

english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
translation: Awe bwangu bwangu eko baya. Baya sanga Maria na Yosefu, na kamwana nakalala mu mulimba.

english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
translation: Cilya bamona akamwana, awe nabo balashimika ifyo malaika abebele pali aka kamwana.

english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
translation: Na bonse abaleumfwako, balapapa pafyo bakacema balebashimikila.

english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
translation: Maria ena alasunga aya mashiwi yonse mu mutima wakwe no kulayatontonkanyapo.

english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation: Uku kupenda abantu, ekwali ukwakubalilapo ilyo Kwilino ali umulashi mu Siria.

english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
translation: Bakacema pakubwelelamo, balalumbanya no kutasha Lesa pa fintu fyonse ifyo bomfwile nefyo bamwene. Fyonse filifye ngomo malaika acibebela.

english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse apo afyalilwe, e bushiku bali nokumusembulwilapo. Elyo bamwinika ne shina lya Yesu, ishina malaika amwinike ninshi talati emitwe.

english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
translation: Kabinge cilya ubushiku bwakusangululwa bwafika, ukukonka Amafunde yakwa Mose, Yosefu na Maria epakutwala Yesu ku Yerusalemu kukumutuula kuli Lesa.

english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
translation: Pantu calembwa mu mafunde yakwa Lesa ukuti, “Umwana umwaume onse ibeli, ali nokulubwilwa ku Mfumu.”

english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
translation: Kabili Yosefu na Maria baya leka ilambo pakukonka ifyalembwa mu mafunde ya Mfumu ukuti, “Bakalaleta utubondo twa nkunda tubili, nangu utwana twa fipele tubili.”

english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
translation: Kanshi mu Yerusalemu mwalimo umuntu umo, ishina lyakwe ni Simeoni. Uyu muntu ali umololoke kabili uwapetamina Lesa. Alelolela inshita Lesa akalubula abena Israeli. Elyo na Mupashi Wamushilo ali nankwe.

english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
translation: Mupashi Wamushilo alimusokolwelele ukuti, takafwe kano akatale akamone Kristu.

english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
translation: Kanshi Mupashi Wamushilo amweba ukuti aye mwi Tempele. Awe ilyo line abafyashi nabo baletamo Yesu akanya, pakuti bamubombele fyonse ukulingana na Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,
translation: Elyo Simeoni abuula Yesu amupakatila, alatasha na Lesa ati,

english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
translation: “Nomba we Mfumu,

english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
translation: Na bonse baleya kukulembwa cila muntu ku musumba wa fikolwe fyakwe.

english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
translation: Pantu amenso yandi yamona uwakutupususha,

english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
translation: Luka 1:31

english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
translation: Abe ulubuuto lwakusanikila Abenafyalo,

english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
translation: Awe wishi na nyina bena balapapafye pafyo Simeoni alanda pali uyu mwana.

english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
translation: Elyo Simeoni abapaala, alaeba na Maria nyina kwa mwana ati, “Ulemona uyu mwana, ala akalenga ukuti abengi bakalobe, elyo na bengi bakapusuke mu bena Israeli. Ala, akaba icishibilo cakwa Lesa ico abantu abengi bakapusaninapo.

english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
translation: Lyena elyo fikasokoloka ifyo abengi batontonkanya mu mitima yabo. Elyo na iwe, ubucushi ubukalamba bukapulinkanya umutima obe ngo lupanga.”

english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
translation: Elyo kwaliko na kasesema umo umwanakashi, ishina lyakwe ni Ana, mwana Fanueli, uwa mu luko lwakwa Asheri. Ali umukote nganshi. Batile bashibofya ninshi acili umukashana, aikelefye no mulume wakwe imyaka cine lubali.

english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
translation: Ilyo umulume afwa, ashala aleikala umushimbe mpaka afika ne myaka amakumi cine konse konse na ine. Talefuma mwi Tempele, lelo aikalilefye ukubombela Lesa akasuba no bushiku, mukufunga ukulya na mukupepa.

english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
translation: Kanshi Ana nao aisamo pa nshita imo ine, alalumba na Lesa. Alalanda na pa mwana, alaebako bonse abalelolela ukuti Yerusalemu akalubulwe.

english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
translation: Yosefu na Maria ilyo bapwile ukucita fyonse ukulingana na mafunde ya Mfumu, elyo babwelelemo ku Galile, kumwabo, ku musumba wa Nasaleti.

english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,
translation: Kanshi Yosefu nao afuma ku Nasaleti mu calo ca Galile, aya ku calo ca Yudeya ku musumba wakwa Davidi, uwitwa Betelemu, pantu wa mu lupwa kabili wa mu mukowa wakwa Davidi.

english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
translation: Awe no mwana alakula, alekoselako. Amano nayo yalafulilako, na Lesa alemusenamina.

english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
translation: Cila mwaka abafyashi bakwa Yesu baleya ku Yerusalemu ku nshikunkulu ye Pasaka iya Cakucilila.

english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;
translation: Ilyo Yesu ali ne myaka ikumi limo na ibili, nalyo baya ku nshikunkulu ngefyo balecita lyonse.

english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
translation: Ilyo bapwa ukusefya inshikunkulu, pakubwelelamo, umwaice Yesu ashala mu Yerusalemu. Abafyashi bakwe tabaishibe nakalya.

english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
translation: Bena baleti, “Yesu ali na balendo banensu.” Basuka baenda ubulendo bwa bushiku bumo, elyo balamufwaya muli ba lupwa lwabo na beshibishi babo.

english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
translation: Nomba ico bafilwa ukumusanga, elyo babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu, baya balemufwaya.

english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
translation: Panuma yakumufwaya inshiku shitatu, elyo bamusanga mwi Tempele, ekele pamo na bakafundisha bamafunde alebakutika, alebepusha na mepusho.

english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
translation: Na bonse abaleumfwako balapapa amano yakwe ne myasukile yakwe.

english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
translation: Abafyashi bakwe cilya bamumona, awe cabapesha amano. Elyo nyina amweba ati, “We mwana, nga cinshi watucushisha ifi? Mona bawiso na ine tusakamene icibi ilyo tulekufwaya.”

english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nga cinshi mwacilamfwaila? Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti ndi nokuba mu ŋanda yakwa Tata?”

english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
translation: Yosefu aya kukulembwa na Maria uo akobekele, uwali pabukulu.

english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
translation: Nomba bena tabailwike pafyo alebeba.

english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
translation: Kabili Yesu aya nabo ku Nasaleti, alebanakila. Nomba nyina ena alesunga ifi fyonse mu mutima wakwe.

english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
translation: Yesu ena alekulilako mu mano na mu cimo. Elyo Lesa na bantu bene nabo balemutemwa.

english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
translation: Ilyo bacili ku Betelemu, awe ne nshita yakupaapa umwana yafikila.

english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
translation: Maria abeleka umwana umwaume. Amupomba mu nsalu, amulalika na mu mulimba, pantu tabasangilemo incende mu ŋanda ya beni.

english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
translation: Mu ncende ine ilya, mwali bakacema mu mpanga balelinda ifitekwa fyabo ubushiku.

english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
translation: Awe malaika wa Mfumu abamonekela, no bucindami bwa Mfumu bwalabengeshima apo bali. Bakacema epakwikatwa no mwenso.

english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
translation: Mu mwaka uwalenga ikumi limo na isano apo Tibeli Kesalo atampile ukulateeka ninshi Pontio Pilato ali umulashi mu Yudeya, Herodi wena ali imfumu mu Galile, Filipo munyina wena ali imfumu mu Idumea na Trakoniti, elyo Lusania ninshi wena ali imfumu mu Abilene.

english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
translation: Elyo amabumba yalamwipusha ayati, “Nga kanshi fintu nshi tuli nokucita?”

english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
translation: Yoani nao abasuka ati, “Uwakwata imingila ibili ali nokupeelako uushakwata. Elyo uwakwata icakulya nao ali nokucita ifyo fine.”

english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
translation: Awe bakasonkesha nabo baisa kukubatishiwa. Balamwipusha abati, “Kafundisha nga ifwe tuli nokucita nshi?”

english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
translation: Yoani abeba ati, “Mwilasonkesha ukucila pafyo bamupimina.”

english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
translation: Abashilika bamo nabo bamwipusha abati, “Nga ifwe bushe tuli nokucita nshi?” Nabo abeba ati, “Mwilapokolola cintu ku muntu nelyo umo ku maka, nangu ukumufyenga mukubomfya ubufi. Imwe mulesakamanafye ukupoka malipilo yenu.”

english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
translation: Mu mitima ya bantu epakwisa amatontonkanyo yakutila, nalimo Yoani kuti aba e Kristu wine.

english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
translation: Kanshi Yoani epakubeba bonse ati, “Ine ndebatishisha ku menshi. Lelo umo uwacindama ukuncila alaisa, na ine nshilingile na kukakula inshinga sha pa ndyato shakwe. Wena akamubatishisha kuli Mupashi Wamushilo na ku mulilo.

english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
translation: Ali no lupe lwakwelelako mu minwe yakwe. Akafumya imisungu pa lubansa. Akatutila iŋanu mu butala bwakwe. Imisungu yena akayoca mu mulilo uushishima!”

english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
translation: Kanshi muli aya mashiwi, na yambi ayo Yoani alekonkomesha abantu, alebila Imbila Nsuma.

english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
translation: Kabili Yoani alekalipila imfumu Herodi pali ico aupile Herodia muka munyina, na pa milandu imbi alecita.

english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
translation: Pali bushimapepo bukalamba ninshi pali Anasi na Kayafa. Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyafika kuli Yoani, mwana Sakaria mu matololo.

english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
translation: Nomba Herodi alundapo no kucita icabipisha, aposa Yoani mu cifungo.

english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
translation: Ilyo abantu babatishiwe bonse, elyo Yesu nao aishile batishiwa. Nomba ilyo alepepa, awe umulu waisuka.

english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
translation: Elyo Mupashi Wamushilo amwikila, alemoneka kwati ni nkunda. Awe ne shiwi lyafuma mu mulu aliti, “Iwe uli Mwana wandi, uo natemwa, niwe nsekelamo.”

english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
translation: Ilyo Yesu atampile umulimo wakubila imbila ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, ali ne myaka ni cikanga amakumi yatatu (30). Abantu bena baleti, ni mwana Yosefu, mwana Heli,

english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
translation: mwana Matati, mwana Levi, mwana Meliki, mwana Yanai, mwana Yosefu,

english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
translation: mwana Matatia, mwana Amosi, mwana Nahumu, mwana Esili, mwana Nagai,

english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
translation: mwana Mati, mwana Matatia, mwana Semeni, mwana Yoseki, mwana Yoda,

english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
translation: mwana Yoanani, mwana Resa, mwana Serubabeli, mwana Shealitieli, mwana Neli,

english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
translation: mwana Meliki, mwana Adi, mwana Kosamu, mwana Elimadamu, mwana Ere,

english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
translation: mwana Yoshua, mwana Eliese, mwana Yolimu, mwana Matati, mwana Levi,

english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
translation: Yoani aya alebila imbila mu calo conse ica ku mumana wa Yordani, aleti, “Lapileni no kupilibuka, mubatishiwe, na Lesa alemubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyenu.”

english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
translation: mwana Simeoni, mwana Yuda, mwana Yosefu, mwana Yonamu, mwana Eliakimu,

english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
translation: mwana Melea, mwana Mena, mwana Matata, mwana Natani, mwana Davidi,

english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
translation: mwana Yese, mwana Obedi, mwana Boasi, mwana Salimoni, mwana Nashoni,

english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
translation: mwana Aminadabu, mwana Adimini, mwana Ani, mwana Hesroni, mwana Peresi, mwana Yuda,

english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
translation: mwana Yakobo, mwana Isaki, mwana Abrahamu, mwana Tera, mwana Naho,

english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
translation: mwana Serugi, mwana Reu, mwana Pelegi, mwana Eberi, mwana Shela,

english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
translation: mwana Kenani, mwana Afakisadi, mwana Shemu, mwana Noa, mwana Lameki,

english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
translation: mwana Metusela, mwana Enoki, mwana Yaledi, mwana Mahalale, mwana Kenani,

english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
translation: mwana Enosi, mwana Seti, mwana Adamu, uwatulile kuli Lesa.

english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
translation: Ngomo kasesema Esaya alembele mu citabo cakwe ati,

english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
translation: Imikonko yonse ishiikwe,

english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
translation: Na bantu bonse bakamona ipusukilo lyakwa Lesa!’ ”

english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
translation: Elyo Yoani alaeba amabumba ya bantu baleisa kukubatishiwa ati, “Mwe bana ba nsoka mwe! Nga nani wamusoka ukubutuka ubukali bwakwa Lesa ubwalaisa?

english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
translation: Shikanshi akuciteni ifintu ifyakulanga ukuti namulapila. Mwitampa ukulatontonkanya amuti, tuli bana bakwa shifwe Abrahamu! Ine ndemweba nati, Lesa kuti ayalula aya mabwe ukuba abana bakwa Abrahamu!

english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”
translation: Lesa naimya isembe ilyakuputawilako imishila ya miti. Kanshi umuti onse uushitwala ifitwalo fisuma, akautema, akauposa na mu mulilo.”

english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
translation: Elyo Yesu afumine ku mumana wa Yordani, naisulamo na Mupashi Wamushilo, na Mupashi uyu, amutwala mu matololo.

english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
translation: Pantu calilembwa ukuti, ‘Lesa akakonkomesha bamalaika bakwe, ukuti bakusunge bwino.’

english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Calisoswa ukuti, Wilaesha Imfumu Lesa obe.”

english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
translation: Amaf 6:13

english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
translation: Yesu elyo abwelele ku Galile, ninshi ali na maka yakwa Mupashi. Ululumbi lwakwe lwena lwakumanafye icalo conse.

english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
translation: Bonse balemulumbanya pa mifundile yakwe mu masinagoga yabo.

english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
translation: Amaf 6:16

english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
translation: Bamupeela icitabo icipombwa icakwa kasesema Esaya. Cilya akupukula icitabo, asanga apo calembwa ukuti,

english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
translation: “Mupashi wa Mfumu aba pali ine,

english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
translation: No kubila umwaka Imfumu ikapusushamo abantu baiko.”

english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
translation: Mu matololo umo, emo Ciwa alamutunka inshiku amakumi yane. Mu nshiku ishi shonse talelya nelyo cimo. Kanshi ilyo shapwa, insala yamwikata.

english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
translation: Elyo Yesu akupika icitabo, apeela na kasunga elyo aikala. Abantu bonse mu sinagoga bamutontomesha amenso.

english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
translation: Elyo atampa ukubeba ati, “Kanshi ifi mwaumfwa nasoma, ilelo fyafikilishiwa ngefyo mwayumfwila.”

english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
translation: Awe bonse balasosa abati, “Alandafye bwino.” Kabili balapapa pa mashiwi yasuma alanda. Elyo balaipushanya abati, “Bushe uyu te mwana Yosefu?”

english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
translation: Yesu ena abasuka ati, “Cine cine mulefwaya ukulosha ili pinda kuli ine ilyakuti, ‘Shiŋanga yundape we mwine’. Cita na kuno kwine kumwenu ifintu twaumfwa wacita ku Kapenamu.”

english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
translation: Elyo Yesu akonkanyapo ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, takwaba kasesema nangu umo uo basekelela kumwabo.

english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
translation: Ndemweba nokuti, cacine mu Israeli mwali bamukamfwilwa abengi pa nshita yakwa Eliya, ilyo umulu wacilikwe pa myaka itatu ne myeshi mutanda, casuka ne cipowe icikalamba capona mu calo conse.

english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
translation: Lelo Eliya tatuminwe nangu kuli umo pali abo, kanofye kuli mukamfwilwa umo uwa mu Sarefati mu calo ca Sidoni.

english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
translation: Kabili pa nshita yakwa kasesema Elisha, mu Israeli mwalifye abafibashi abengi. Lelo tapali nangu umo uwaundepwe kanofye Namani umwina Siria.”

english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.
translation: Bonse abali mu sinagoga ilyo baumfwa ifi fintu, bafulwa nganshi.

english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
translation: Elyo baima, bamusenda kunse ya musumba. Bamutwala pa nembenembe ya lupili ulo umusumba wabo wakuulilwepo, pakuti bamusunke akunkulukile panshi.

english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
translation: Elyo Ciwa aeba Yesu ati, “Nga uli Mwana wakwa Lesa, eba ili libwe lisanguke umukate.”

english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
translation: Nomba Yesu afyefyetukila mwibumba apita, aya.

english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
translation: Elyo Yesu atentemwike aya ku Kapenamu, umusumba wa mu Galile. Pa bushiku bwe Sabata alafunda abantu.

english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
translation: Awe balapapa nganshi pa mifundile yakwe pantu amashiwi alefunda yali ayamaka.

english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
translation: Mu sinagoga mwali umuntu uwali no mupashi wakowela. Elyo uyu muntu alapunda ne shiwi ilikalamba ati,

english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
translation: “Ala! Cinshi ulefwaya kuli ifwe, iwe Yesu wa ku Nasaleti? Bushe waisa kukutulofya? Nalikwishiba iwe, uli Wamushilo uwafuma kuli Lesa!”

english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
translation: Lelo Yesu aukalipila ati, “Talala! Fuma muli uyu muntu!” Elyo umupashi wakowela wamuwisha panshi pa cinso ca bantu bonse, wamufumamo ukwabula ukumucena nelyo panono.

english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
translation: Awe abantu bonse balapapa, balaipushanya abati, “Ngeyi mifundile yaba shani? Pantu ku maka alekalipila imipashi yakowela, nayo ilefuma!”

english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
translation: Awe ululumbi lwakwe lwasalangana mpanga yonse muli cilya calo.

english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.
translation: Ilyo Yesu afumine mu sinagoga, aile ku ŋanda yakwa Simoni. Asanga nafyala Simoni nalwala impepo iyabipa nganshi. Elyo baipusha Yesu ukuti amwafwilishe.

english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
translation: Yesu aya aiminina apo ali, akalipila ne mpepo, awe impepo yamuleka. Elyo nao apopene aima alabatebeta no kubatebeta.

english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Calilembwa ukuti, umuntu takwatafye mweo mukulya icakulya.”

english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kalawa, abantu bonse abali na balwele abalecula ku malwele ayalekana lekana, balabaleta kuli Yesu. Yesu nao alatambalikila amaboko pali cila muntu, abaposha.

english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
translation: Imipashi yakowela nayo yalafuma mu bengi, ilepunda aiti, “Niwe Mwana wakwa Lesa!” Nao Yesu alaikalipila, ailesha no kulalanda pantu yalishibe ukuti, ni Kristu.

english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
translation: Cilyafye bwaca, Yesu afumineko, aile ku ncende ukwakuti ali eka. Elyo abantu baisa balemufwaya. Cilya bamusanga, balafwaya ukumulesha ukuti ebasha.

english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
translation: Nomba Yesu ena abasuka ati, “Ndi nokubila Imbila Nsuma ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa na mu misumba imbi ine, kabili eco natuminwa.”

english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
translation: Awe akonkanyapo ukulabila Imbila Nsuma mu masinagoga mu calo ca Yudeya.

english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
translation: Elyo Ciwa amutwala apasanseme, na pa kashitafye akanono amulanga ubufumu bonse ubwa pano calo.

english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.
translation: Amweba nokuti, “Ubufumu ubu bonse no bukankala ubwabamo ndekupeela, pantu balimpeela, na ine kuti napeela onse uo ntemenwe.

english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
translation: Kanshi nga wampakata, ninshi bonse bwalaba bobe.”

english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
translation: Nomba Yesu amwasuka ati, “Calilembwa ukuti, ‘Ulepepa Imfumu Lesa obe, kabili ekafye eo ulebombela.’ ”

english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
translation: Kabili Ciwa amutwala ku Yerusalemu, amwimika pamulu pa nembenembe ya mutenge we Tempele. Elyo aeba Yesu ati, “Nga uli Mwana wakwa Lesa, tolokela panshi.

english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ninshi Yesu aiminine mu lulamba lwa bemba wa Genasaleti, ibumba lya bantu lyena lyalemutitikisha ico lyalefwaya ukumfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa.

english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
translation: Bamwana Sebede, Yakobo na Yoani abalebomba na Simoni nabo lumo lwine. Yesu epakweba Simoni ati, “Iyoo, witiina, ukutula nomba wakulaba umulondo wa bantu.”

english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
translation: Awe cilya bafisha amato ku mulundu, basha fyonse balakonka na Yesu.

english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
translation: Yesu ilyo ali mu musumba umo, awe paishile umuntu umo uwalwele ifibashi umubili onse. Cilya amona Yesu, awa panshi ubukupeme alamupapata ati, “We Mfumu, nga nautemwa kuti wamposha.”

english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
translation: Yesu atambalika ukuboko amukumya ati, “cisuma nintemwa, pola!” Awe apopene ne fibashi fyapola.

english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amukonkomesha ati, “Wiebako umuntu nelyo umo. Lelo kabiye, uye ilanga kuli shimapepo. Uye utuule no mutuulo uo Mose amukonkomesha, pakuti cibashinine ukuti naupola.”

english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
translation: Ululumbi lwakwa Yesu lwalalundulukilakofye. Amabumba ya bantu ayakalamba yalalongana kukumfwa na kukuposhiwa ku malwele yabo.

english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
translation: Lelo Yesu ena ilingi alebasha, aya eka ukutalele kukupepa.

english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ilyo Yesu alefunda, pali Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde nabekala. Bafumine mu mishi yonse iya mu Galile na mu Yudeya na ku Yerusalemu. Yesu ena ali na maka yakwa Lesa ayakuposha abantu.

english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
translation: Elyo kwaisa abantu basendele icite cilele pa musengele. Balafwaya ukumwingisha mu ŋanda pakuti bamubike apali Yesu.

english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
translation: Nomba ico bafilwa ukusanga inshila yakumwingishishamo, ku mulandu we bumba, banina pa mutenge. Elyo batula icipunda, epo bamupishisha kumo no musengele, bamwishisha pakati apali Yesu.

english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
translation: Elyo amona amato yabili, yashikilwe mupepi no lulamba lwa bemba. Abalondo ninshi nabafumamo balesamba amasumbu yabo.

english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
translation: Yesu pakumona icisumino cabo asosa ati, “We mwana wabelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe.”

english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise balatontonkanya abati, “Muntu nshi uyu alelanda ifyamusaalula kuli Lesa? Nga nani engabelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi? Shikanofye Lesa eka”

english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
translation: Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya, abasuka ati, “Nga cinshi ico muletontonkanishisha ifyo mu mitima yenu?

english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
translation: Bushe cinshi icayangukapo, ukutila ‘Naubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe,’ nangu ukutila, ‘Ima akwenda?’

english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
translation: Kanshi lekeni mulange ukuti Umwana wa muntu alikwata amaka pano isonde ayakubelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi fyonse.” Elyo aeba icite ati, “Nakweba, ima, senda umusengele obe, akuya na kumobe.”

english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
translation: Awe apopene aima, ninshi na bonse balemonako. Abuula neco alelepo, alaya na kumwakwe, alelumbanya Lesa.

english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
translation: Awe bonse balapapafye, balalumbanya na Lesa. Kabili baikatwa no mwenso, balasosa abati, “Lelo twamona ifyakupapa!”

english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
translation: Elyo Yesu afuminemo, amwene kasonkesha wamusonko, ishina lyakwe ni Levi, ekele mu ŋanda yamusonko. Amweba ati, “Nkonka.”

english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
translation: Nao Levi epakusha fyonse, aima, alamukonka.

english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
translation: Elyo Levi atebeta Yesu imitebeto iyamucinshi mu ŋanda mumwakwe. Ilyo balelya, pali ne bumba ilikalamba ilya bakasonkesha bamusonko na bambipo.

english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
translation: Awe Yesu aingila mu bwato bumo, ubwato bwakwa Simoni. Amweba nokuti atalusheko cinono ukufuma ku mulundu. Emo aikala alafunda na bantu.

english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
translation: Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde balailishanya ku basambi bakwa Yesu abati, “Bushe cinshi mulelila no kunwena pamo na bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Abali umutende tabakabila shiŋanga iyoo, lelo kano abalwele.

english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
translation: Ine nshaisa kukwita abakaele, naisa kukwita ababifi pakuti balapile no kupilibuka.”

english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
translation: Elyo balaeba Yesu abati, “Abasambi bakwa Yoani balafunga ukulya libili libili, kabili balapepa, na basambi ba Bafalise nabo nifyo fine. Nomba abasambi bobe bena baikalilafye ukulya no kunwa.”

english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe kuti mwaleka inshindishi shakwa shibwinga ukufunga ukulya ilyo shicili na shibwinga?

english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
translation: Lelo inshita ikesa ilyo bakashipoka shibwinga. Lyena muli isho nshiku, elyo shikalafunga ukulya.”

english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
translation: Kabinge abomina ipinda ili ati, “Takwaba nangu umo uulepula icikamba ku nsalu ipya pakuti acibike pa nsalu iyikote. Nga acita ifyo ninshi alepula insalu ipya, elyo ne cikamba cine naco teti cilinge pa nsalu iyikote.

english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
translation: Kabili tababika umwangashi uushilabila mu nyambi ishikote. Nga bacita ifyo ninshi umwangashi uushilabila kuti walenga inyambi ukupuka, no mwangashi wapongoloka ne nyambi shaonaika.

english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.
translation: Lelo umwangashi uushilabila, bali nokubika mu nyambi ishipya.

english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
translation: Kabili takwaba nangu umo uwakuti atala anwa umwangashi uwapya afwaye ukunwa uushilabila. Awe, kuti ati, ‘Uwapya e usuma.’ ”

english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
translation: Cilya apwa ukulanda, Yesu aeba Simoni ati, “Twala ubwato apashikile, muteye na masumbu pakuti mwipaye isabi.”

english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
translation: Simoni ayasuka ati, “Shikulu, ala tuculilefye ubushiku bonse ukwabula ukwipaya nangu kamo. Nomba apo niwe wasosa, nalateya amasumbu.”

english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
translation: Bati bacite ifi, amasumbu yaikata isabi ilingi, kabili ni cikanga yalepuke.

english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
translation: Elyo balembula abanabo abali mu bwato bubiye ukuti bese babafweko. Awe nabo baisa. Elyo baisusha isabi mu mato, ni cikanga amato yabunde.

english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
translation: Simoni Petelo ati amone ifi, afukama apali Yesu ati, “Ntaluka we Mfumu, pantu ndi muntu mubi.”

english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
translation: Pantu Simoni pamo pene nabo ali nabo calibapeseshe amano pakumona isabi ubwingi baipaya.

english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ubwe Sabata, Yesu alepita mu mabala ya ŋanu. Awe abasambi bakwe batendeke ukulatimpula imisonso ya ŋanu, balefikina mu minwe yabo, balelya.

english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
translation: Elyo atandanya amenso pali bonse, aeba umuntu ati, “Fungulula icisansa cobe!” Awe nao afungulula icisansa cakwe, no kuba cabafye bwino.

english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
translation: Awe bena bafulwa icibi, balalanshanya na pafyo bengacita Yesu.

english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
translation: Mu nshiku shilya Yesu aile kukupepa pa lupili. Alolelefye bushiku bonse alepepa Lesa.

english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
translation: Cilya bwaca, aita abasambi bakwe. Asalapo ikumi limo na babili, bena alabeta abasole.

english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
translation: Ni Simoni uo ainike ishina lya Petelo, na Andele munyina, na Yakobo, na Yoani, na Filipo, na Batolomeo,

english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;
translation: na Mateo, na Toma, na Yakobo mwana Alufeyo, na Simoni Umuselote,

english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
translation: na Yuda mwana Yakobo, na Yuda uwa ku Kelyoti, uwaposele Yesu ku balwani.

english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
translation: Elyo atentemuka ulupili na basole, aya iminina pa ncende apabatama. Palipo ibumba ilikalamba ilya basambi bakwe. Elyo palipo na cinkupiti wa bantu ukufuma mu Yudeya monse, ku Yerusalemu, ku Turi na ku Sidoni imisumba ya mu lulamba lwa bemba.

english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
translation: Baishile kukumumfwa na kukundapwa amalwele yabo. Elyo na balecushiwa ku mipashi yakowela, balepola.

english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
translation: Abantu bonse balefwaya ukumukumya pantu amaka yakwe yalefuma no kubaposha bonse.

english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
translation: Abafalise bamo balabepusha abati, “Cinshi ico mulecitila icaleshiwa ukucita pa bushiku bwe Sabata?”

english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
translation: Elyo Yesu alolekeshe pa basambi bakwe, alabeba ati,

english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
translation: Mwalishuka imwe mwe bali ne nsala nomba,

english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
translation: “Mwalishuka imwe, abantu nga bamupata, no kumutamfya, no kumusebanya, no kumusaalula pa mulandu wa Mwana wa muntu.

english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
translation: Kanshi muli ubo bushiku mukaleyanga no kusansamuka, pantu icilambu cenu cikalamba mu mulu. Kabinge efyo ne fikolwe fyabo fyalecita bakasesema.

english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
translation: “Nomba mukacimona imwe mwe bakankala,

english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
translation: Amaf 23:25

english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
translation: Mukacimona imwe nga abantu balamutasha,

english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
translation: “Lelo ine ndemweba mwe balentesha nati, muletemwa abalwani benu, mulecita ifisuma ku bamupata.

english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
translation: Mulepaala abamulapisha, mulepepelako na bamucusha.

english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
translation: Umuntu uwakutoba ulupi pesaya limo, mupilibwile ne libiye line. Elyo umuntu uwakupoka icakufimbana, muleke asende no mwingila wine.

english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe tamwabelenga ifyo Davidi acitile, ilyo umwine wine pamo nabo ali nabo baiketwe ne nsala?

english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
translation: Umuntu onse uwakulomba icintu, ulemupeela. Elyo umo nga akusendela icintu cobe, wilamupinda.

english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
translation: Ifyo mulefwaya abantu bamucitile, na imwe efyo mulebacitila.

english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
translation: “Lelo nga mwatemwafye abamutemwa, cilambu nshi mwingamwenapo? Pantu na babi bene batemwa ababatemwa.

english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
translation: Elyo nga mwalacita ifisuma ku bamucitila ifisuma cilambu nshi mwingamwenapo? Na babi bene nabo efyo bacita.

english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
translation: Nga mwalakongwesha abo mulesubila ukuti bakamubwesesha, nga cilambu nshi mwingamwenapo? Na babi bene balakongweshanya, pakuti bakapoke nakabili ifyo fine bakongweshe.

english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
translation: Ala muletemwa abalwani benu. Mulebacitila ifisuma. Mulebakongwesha ukwabula ukusubila ukuti bakamubwesesha. Lyena icilambu cenu cikaba icikalamba. Kabili mukaba abana bakwa Lesa Mukulu, pantu wena wacikuuku ku bamiponto na ku babi bene.

english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
translation: Muleba abaluse nga filya Shinwe aba uwaluse.

english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
translation: “Mwilapingula abanenu, ninshi na imwe tabakamupingule. Mwilapeela muntu umulandu, ninshi na imwe tabakamupeele umulandu. Mulebelela abanenu uluse, na imwe lyena bakamubelela uluse.

english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
translation: Mulepeela, ninshi na imwe bakalamupeela. Bakamupeela no kumubikila mu ceni icipimo icaisula paa, icashindaika, icamupaasa. Pantu icipimo mupiminako abanenu, eco na imwe bakamupiminako.”

english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
translation: Kabili Yesu abikapo no kubomina ipinda ili ati, “Bushe impofu kuti yatungulula impofu ibiye? Bushe ninshi tekuti shonse shiwile mu cilindi?

english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
translation: Aingile mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, abuula ne mikate iyatuulilwe kuli Lesa, alya, apeelako nabo ali nabo. Iyi mikate abantu bambi tabasuminishiwe kulyako, kanofye bashimapepo beka.”

english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
translation: Umusambi tacila kafundisha wakwe. Nomba umusambi uwafundwa bwino bwino kuti aba nga kafundisha wakwe.

english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
translation: “Nga cinshi ulelolekesesha akapapala akali mu linso lyakwa munonko, tausakamana no kumona umulando uuli mu linso lyobe?

english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
translation: Nga kanshi kuti waeba shani munonko auti, ‘Munyinane, leka nkufule akapapala ako mu linso lyobe,’ mu nshita iwe we mwine taulemona umulando uuli mu linso lyobe? We mfundabuteshi we! Pakubala fumya umulando uuli mu linso lyobe, elyo walalolesha bwino pakufula akapapala akali mu linso lyakwa munonko.

english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
translation: “Tapaba umuti usuma uutwala ifitwalo ifibi, nangu umuti ubi uutwala ifitwalo ifisuma.

english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
translation: Pantu umuti onse bawishibila ku fitwalo fyauko. Abantu tabasaba makunyu ku myunga nangu ukusaba ifitwalo fya mwangashi kuli nkololo.

english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
translation: Umuntu umusuma afumya ifisuma fya mu cipao cakwe icisuma ica mutima wakwe. Umuntu umubi nao afumya ifibi mu cipao cakwe icibi. Pantu akanwa ka muntu kalanda ifyaisula mu mutima wakwe.

english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
translation: “Ngeco munjitila amuti, ‘We Mfumu we Mfumu,’ kabili tamucita ifyo ndemweba, bushe cinshi?

english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
translation: Nalamwebako uyo muntu uwisa kuli ine, uumfwa na mashiwi yandi, no kuyakonka alayakonka.

english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
translation: Ala, apala ku muntu uwakuti ilyo alakuula iŋanda, aimba umufula, afishafye na pa libwe. Ilyo umumana waisula, waposa, na menshi yalaisa yalapuma mu ŋanda, awe iŋanda teyakusunkana iyoo, pantu yakuulwa bwino.

english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
translation: Nomba uumfwa amashiwi yandi, akaana no kulayakonka iyoo, ena apala umuntu uwakuti akuula iŋanda pa mushili apabula umufula. Ala kuti cilya umumana waposa, amenshi yalapuma ku ŋanda, awe yawa, yabongoloka icabipisha!”

english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Ala Umwana wa muntu e mwine wa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
translation: Kabili pa bushiku bwe Sabata bumbi, Yesu aile ingila mu sinagoga, alefunda. Mwalimo no muntu uwali ne cisansa cakwe ica ku kulyo icalemana.

english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise balabesha Yesu ukuti bamone nga aleposha pa bushiku bwe Sabata. Balefwaisha ukusanga icakumupeelelapo umulandu.

english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya, aeba uwa cisansa calemana ati, “Ima, iminina apa pakati.” Awe nao aima, aiminina na pakati.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
