translation: Levi 24:9

english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
translation: Cilyafye Yesu apwa ukweba abantu fyonse ifyo alefwaya ukubeba, awe aingila mu Kapenamu.

english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
translation: Ilyo abantu atumine babwelelamo ku ŋanda, awe basanga umusha napola alifye bwino bwino.

english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
translation: Pati papite akashita, apopene Yesu aimine aile ku musumba wa Naini, ninshi ali na basambi bakwe ne bumba ilikalamba.

english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
translation: Nombafye cilya apalama ku mpongolo ya musumba, akumanya abantu balefumya umuntu uwafwa. Uyu mulumendo afyelwefye umo mpo, elyo nyina nao ni mukamfwilwa. Elyo ne bumbafye ilikalamba ilya bantu ba mu musumba lyali nankwe.

english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
translation: Imfumu cilya yamona uyu mukamfwilwa yaumfwa uluse. Yamweba aiti, “Leka ukulila.”

english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
translation: Awe yapalama, yaikata na ku busamba, na bamupingile nabo baiminina. Elyo yasosa aiti, “We mulumendo nakweba, buuka!”

english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
translation: Awe no muntu uwafwile aima aikala, atampa no kulalanda. Elyo Yesu amubuula amupeela na kuli nyina.

english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
translation: Awe bonse baikatwa no mwenso, balalumbanya na Lesa. Balasosa abati, “Kasesema mukalamba namonekela pakati kesu! Lesa naisa pempula abantu bakwe!”

english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
translation: Awe ululumbi lwakwa Yesu lwasalanganafye mpanga yonse mu Yudeya na mu fyalo fyonse ifya mumbali.

english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
translation: Awe abasambi bakwa Yoani Kabatisha baile mushimikilako ifi fyonse.

english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
translation: Elyo Yoani aitapo abasambi bakwe babili, abatuma kuli Yesu ati, “Bushe niwe uli nokwisa, nangu tuli nokulolela umbi?”

english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
translation: Kanshi umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo alikwete umusha uo atemenwe nganshi. Uyu mubomfi alilwele nganshi, alifye mupepi no kufwa.

english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
translation: Abasambi bakwa Yoani ilyo bafika kuli Yesu basosa abati, “Yoani Kabatisha ewatutuma kuli iwe, ati mumwipushe amuti, ‘Bushe niwe uli nokwisa, nangu tuli nokulolela umbi?’ ”

english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
translation: Kanshi pa nshita ine iyi Yesu aposha abantu abengi abalwele na balecushiwa ku ntenda shimbi na ku mipashi yakowela, aposha na bapofula abengi.

english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
translation: Elyo Yesu ayasuka inkombe shakwa Yoani ati, “Bwelelenimo kuli Yoani, muye mushimikila fyonse ifyo mumwene nefyo mumfwile. Ala impofu shilemona, abalemana baleenda, abafibashi balepola, abakoma amatwi baleumfwa, abafwa balebuuka, na balanda balebabila Imbila Nsuma.

english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
translation: Kabili alishuka umuntu uushitwishika pali ine.”

english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
translation: Cilya inkombe shakwa Yoani shabwelelamo, Yesu alalanda ku mabumba pali Yoani ati, “Bushe cinshi mwaile mona mu matololo? Bushe litete ilipungana ku mwela?

english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
translation: Kanshi cinshi mwaile kukumona? Bushe muntu uufwala insalu ishabusaka? Awe iyoo, abafwala insalu ishabusaka no kuipakisha bekala kwisano.

english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
translation: Nga kanshi ico mwaile mona cinshi? Bushe ni kasesema? Ee, cena ndemweba Yoani alicila na pali kasesema.

english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
translation: Eo calembwapo ukuti, ‘Mona nkatuma inkombe yandi iyakukutangilila, iyakukupekanishisha inshila.’

english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
translation: Ndemweba nati, pa bana ba bantu, tapaba uwacila Yoani. Lelo uwacepeshapo mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, ena alicilapo pali Yoani.”

english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
translation: Abantu bonse abalemumfwa, pamo pene na bakasonkesha bamusonko, abasumine ukubatishiwa kuli Yoani, balangile ukusumina ukuti ifyo Lesa afwaya cishinka.

english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
translation: Ilyo umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo aumfwako ifya pali Yesu, atumako abakalamba ba Bayuda, ukuti baye mwipusha ese aposhe umusha wakwe.

english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
translation: Nomba Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde pakukaana ukubatishiwa kuli Yoani, bena basuulile ifyo Lesa alefwaya ukubacitila.

english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
translation: Kabinge Yesu alundapo nokuti, “Abantu ba ino nkulo, bushe kuti nabapalanya kuli cinshi? Bushe bapala bani?

english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
translation: Baba nga baice abekele mu lubansa lwa cisankano, balebilikishanya na banabo baleti, ‘Natumulishisha bamutolilo, nokuti mucinde nakalya! Natwimba ulwimbo lwa malilo, nokuti mulooshe nakalya!’

english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
translation: Pantu Yoani atile aisa, talelya cakulya, talenwa umwangashi, imwe amuti, ‘Aba no mupashi wakowela.’

english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
translation: Elyo paisa Umwana wa muntu, wena alalya no kunwa, lyena mwalasosa amuti, ‘Moneni, uyu muntu umulili, ni cakolwa, kabili ni cibusa wa bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde!’

english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
translation: Nomba ificitwa fya mano yakwa Lesa filashinina ukuti yacine.”

english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
translation: Elyo Umufalise umo aitile Yesu kukulya nankwe. Awe Yesu aile aingila mu ŋanda ya Mufalise, aikala na pakulya.

english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
translation: Kanshi mu musumba mwali umwanakashi uwa misango ibi. Cilya aumfwa ukuti Yesu ali pakulya mu ŋanda ya Mufalise, aisa nasenda ibotolo umwali amafuta aya cena cisuma.

english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
translation: Awe aisa iminina lwa kunuma ku makasa yakwa Yesu, alalila. Ilyo alelila, ifilamba fyalaponena pa makasa yakwa Yesu. Elyo alakumuna ifilamba ku mishishi yakwe, alatomona pa makasa yakwa Yesu. Akonkomwenapo na mafuta ya cena cisuma, alamusuba.

english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
translation: Umufalise uwaitile Yesu ati amone ifi, alatontonkanya ati, “Uyu muntu aba ni kasesema, nga naishiba ifyaba uyu mwanakashi alemukumya, nga naishiba ukuti wa misango ibi.”

english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
translation: Nabo ilyo bafika kuli Yesu, balamupapata nganshi abati, “Uyu muntu calingafye umwafwilishe.

english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
translation: Yesu ena pakumwasuka amweba ati, “Simoni, ninkwatapo icakukweba.” Simoni nao ati, “Njebeni mwe Kafundisha!”

english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
translation: Yesu ati, “Kwaliko umuntu umo uwali na bantu babili abamukongwele indalama. Umo amukongwele indalama imyanda isano, elyo umbi ena amakumi yasano.

english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
translation: Nomba ico bafilwa ukumubwesesha, ababelela uluse bonse babili. Nomba pali aba babili, bushe nani engamutemwapo ukucila?”

english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
translation: Simoni ayasuka ati, “Ine ndemona ni uyo abelele uluse pa nkongole ishingi.” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Walungika.”

english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
translation: Elyo Yesu apilibukila ku mwanakashi, aeba Simoni ati, “Bushe wamona uyu mwanakashi? Ninjisa muno mumobe. Iwe taumpeele amenshi yakusamba amakasa yandi. Lelo ena natibinta ifilamba pa makasa yandi, kabili afifuta na ku mishishi yakwe.

english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
translation: Iwe taumposeshe mukutomona, lelo ena apo nyingilile mumobe talekele kutomona pa makasa yandi.

english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
translation: Iwe taunsubile mafuta ku mutwe, nomba ena nasuba amakasa yandi na mafuta yanunkila ubusaka.

english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
translation: Eico nakweba ukuti, pantu natemwisha, calanga ukuti nabelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyakwe ifingi. Lelo uwabelelwa uluse pa finono, no kutemwa kwakwe kunono.”

english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba umwanakashi ati, “Wabelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe.”

english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
translation: Elyo abantu ayandeme nabo pakulya, balalanshanya abati, “Muntu nshi uyu uwakutila alebelela abantu uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo?”

english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
translation: Pantu alitemwa umushobo wesu, kabili ewatukuulila na sinagoga.”

english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba umwanakashi ati, “Kabiye umutende, icisumino cobe ecakupususha.”

english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
translation: Yesu epakuya nabo. Cilya abafye mupepi ne ŋanda, umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo atuma bacibusa bakwe abakumweba ukuti, “We Mfumu, ala wicula. Ine nshilingile ukuti wise wingile mumwandi.

english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
translation: Uyu wine e mulandu ulengele ukuti mfilwe ukuiishila ne mwine. Lelo sosafye ishiwi, no mubomfi wandi alapola.

english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
translation: Pantu ine nalikwata abakalamba abanteeka, elyo na ine nalikwata ifita ifyo nteeka. Nga naeba umo nati, ‘Kabiye,’ nao aya. Nga naeba umbi nati, ‘Isa,’ nao aisa. Umusha wandi nga namweba nati, ‘Cita ici,’ awe acita.”

english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
translation: Yesu ati omfwe ifi, asunguka. Elyo apilibukila kwibumba lilemukonka, alyeba ati, “Ndemweba nshatala nsanga icisumino ca musango ngoyu na mu bena Israeli bene!”

english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
translation: Panuma ya ifi, kabili Yesu alepitana mu misumba na mu mishi alebila Imbila Nsuma ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa. Ali pamo na basole ikumi limo na babili.

english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
translation: Yesu nao abeba ati, “Imwe mwalipeelwa ukwishiba inkaama sha Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, bambi bena ni mu milumbe. Epakuti, nangu balelolesha lelo bemona, nangu bomfwe lelo beiluka.

english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
translation: “Kanshi umu emulolele uyu mulumbe. Imbuto lishiwi lyakwa Lesa.

english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
translation: Imbuto shaponene mumbali ya nshila e bantu abomfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa. Elyo Ciwa aisa, nao afumya ishiwi mu mitima yabo, pakuti besumina, bemona ukupusuka.

english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
translation: Ishaponene mu mushili wa nsakalabwe, e bantu abomfwa ishiwi, balipokelela ne nsansa. Nomba ico lyafilwa ukwanda imishila, basuminafye pa kashita akanono. Ilyo kwaisa intunko, banenuka.

english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
translation: Ishaponene mu myunga, e bantu abomfwa ishiwi, lelo umuila inshiku, isakamika, ifyuma no bwangashi bwa pano calo fyatusha ishiwi, lyafilwa no kutwala ifitwalo.

english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
translation: Nomba ishaponene mu mushili usuma, e bantu abomfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa no kulisunga ne mitima isuma, mu bufumacumi. Balemenena mwishiwi no kuibikilishapo basuka batwala ifitwalo.

english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
translation: “Tapaba muntu nelyo umo uusanika icisaniko, elyo acikupikila mu nongo, nangu acibika mwifungu lya busanshi. Awe kuti acibika apasanseme, pakuti bonse balaingila umwabuuta.

english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
translation: Pantu takwaba nelyo cimo icafisama icishakasokoloke. Kabili takwaba nelyo cimo icankaama icishakeshibikwe no kucileta pa bwelu.

english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
translation: Kanshi mulecenjela kufyo muleumfwa. Pantu umuntu uwakwata akapeelelwapo na fimbi. Elyo no ushakwata bakamupoka nefyo aitunga ukukwata.”

english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
translation: Elyo nyina na bamunyina bakwa Yesu baishile, nomba bafililwe ukufika apo ali ku mulandu we bumba.

english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
translation: Elyo na banakashi bamo abo atamfishemo imipashi yakowela no kubaposha ku malwele, nabo bali pamo nankwe. Ni Maria uwitwa Mandalena, uo Yesu atamfishemo imipashi yakowela cine lubali,

english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
translation: Kanshi bamweba abati, “Banoko na bamunonko bali panse, balefwaya ukukumona.”

english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
translation: Yesu ena abasuka ati, “Bamayo na bamunyinane ni abo abomfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa no kulikonka.”

english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.
translation: Ubushiku bumo Yesu aingilile mu bwato pamo na basambi bakwe. Elyo aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Natwabukile kwishilya lya bemba.” Awe baima balaya.

english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
translation: Ilyo baleya mu bwato, Yesu apona mu tulo. Awe icikuuku caima, cawila pali bemba. Amenshi yalaingila mu bwato, no bwato bwalafwaya ukubunda.

english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.
translation: Abasambi epakuya kuli Yesu, balamushibusha abati, “Shikulu, ala twafwa!” Elyo Yesu abuuka, akalipila icimwela ne fimatamba. Awe nafyo fyaleka, patalala na tondolo.

english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Nge cisumino cenu cili kwi?” Awe umwenso wabekata, balapapafye, baleipushanya abati, “Ngoyu nani, uwakuti akalipila icimwela na matamba, nafyo filemubeela?”

english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
translation: Bayashika ubwato mu calo ca bena Gerasa icalungatana ne calo ca Galile.

english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.
translation: Cilyafye Yesu afuma mu bwato, akumanya umuntu wa mu musumba uwali ne mipashi yakowela. Uyu muntu ni kale alekele ukufwala, kabili taleikala mu ŋanda lelo aleikala mu nshinshi.

english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”
translation: Cilya amona Yesu, alakuuta, awa na panshi apali Yesu. Elyo apunda ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, “Cinshi ulefwaya ukucita kuli ine, iwe Yesu we Mwana wakwa Lesa Mukulu? Ndekupapata wincusha!”

english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.
translation: Pantu Yesu aebele umupashi wakowela ukuti ufume mu muntu. Imikufye iyingi umupashi wakowela walemwikata. Elyo pakumusunga, balemukaka mu minyololo na mu makoli, nomba alefiputaula. Elyo umupashi wakowela nao walemutwala mu matololo.

english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
translation: elyo na Yoana muka Cusa mushika wakwa Herodi, na Susana, na bambipo abengi abaleyafwilisha mukusunga Yesu na basambi bakwe. Balebomfyafye ifintu fyabo abene.

english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
translation: Yesu amwipusha ati, “Ishina lyobe niwe ani?” Nao amwasuka ati, “Nine Mulalo.” Pantu uyu muntu imipashi yakowela yamwingilemo iyingi.

english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.
translation: Imipashi yakowela elyo yalapapata Yesu ukuti eitamfisha ku ncende yaiko.

english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.
translation: Kanshi mumbali ya lupili mwali no mukuni ukalamba uwa nkumba shalelya. Imipashi yakowela yalapapata Yesu ukuti aileke ingile mu nkumba. Yesu nao aisuminisha.

english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
translation: Awe imipashi yakowela yafuma mu muntu yaya ingila mu nkumba. Elyo umukuni wa nkumba wakunkunyala pa mukunkuluko, waipuupa muli bemba, wanwena no kunwena.

english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
translation: Bakacema cilya bamona ifyacitika, bafulumuka, baya shimika no mulandu mu musumba na mu mishi ya mumbali.

english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
translation: Abantu epakuya kukumona ificitike. Cilya bafika kuli Yesu, basanga umuntu umwafumine imipashi yakowela naikala lwa pa makasa yakwa Yesu. Basanga nafwala, na mano yonse nayabwela. Awe umwenso wabekata.

english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
translation: Abo abaimwenene, balashimikilako abantu ifyo uwali ne mipashi yakowela apolele.

english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.
translation: Abantu bonse aba mu calo ca Gerasa baikatwa no mwenso ukalamba, balalomba Yesu ukuti afume mu calo cabo. Yesu epakwingila mu bwato pakuti abwelelemo uko afumine.

english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
translation: Umuntu umwafumine imipashi yakowela alapapata Yesu ukuti akonke. Nomba Yesu amukaanya, amweba ati,

english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
translation: “Iyoo, bwelelamofye kumobe, uye shimika fyonse ifyo Lesa akucitile.” Awe afumako, aya aleshimika mu musumba fyonse ifyo Yesu amucitile.

english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:
translation: Elyo kwalongene ibumba ilikalamba. Abantu balafuma muli uyu musumba na muli uyu, balaisa kuli Yesu. Elyo Yesu abomina uyu mulumbe ati,

english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
translation: Nomba cilya Yesu abwelelemo, ibumba lyonse lyamusekelele, pantu bonse ninshi balemulolela.

english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,
translation: Elyo paisa umuntu umo, ishina lyakwe ni Yailo, ewali ntungulushi ya mu sinagoga. Afukama apali Yesu, alamupapata ukuti aye nankwe kumwakwe.

english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.
translation: Pantu ali no mwana umukashana umofye mpo, uwa myaka ikumi limo na ibili, uwali mupepifye no kufwa.

english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
translation: Elyo mwibumba mwalimo umwanakashi uwalwele umukunko pa myaka ikumi limo na ibili. Nomba bonse balifililwe ukumuposha.

english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi epakwisa lwa kunuma yakwa Yesu, akumya na ku nsenkebele sha nsalu yakwe. Awe apopene no mukunko waleka.

english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
translation: Elyo Yesu aipusha ati, “Nani uwankumya?” Ilyo bonse bakaana, elyo Petelo asosa ati, “Shikulu, ala amabumba yakushingulwike eyalekutitikisha.”

english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
translation: Lelo Yesu ena asosa ati, “Awe, umo nankumya. Pantu naumfwa ukuti amaka yamo yafuma muli ine.”

english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
translation: Elyo umwanakashi amona ukuti naishibikwa. Awe aisa fukama apali Yesu aletutumafye. Elyo pa cinso ca bantu bonse alashimikila Yesu icilengele ukuti amukumye nefyo apolele apopenefye.

english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “We mwana, icisumino cobe ecakuposha, kabiye umutende.”

english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alelanda, awe kwafuma umuntu umo ku ŋanda kwa Yailo intungulushi ya mu sinagoga. Alaeba Yailo ati, “Umwana obe umukashana nafwa. Kanshi lekafye Kafundisha abe.”

english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
translation: “Katanda aile kukutanda imbuto shakwe. Cilya alatanda, imbuto shimo shaponena mumbali ya nshila. Abantu bashinyantaula, ne fyuni fya mu mulu fyashikompaula.

english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
translation: Nomba Yesu aumfwa ifyo alelanda, aeba Yailo ati, “Iwe suminafye witiina, mwano alepola.”

english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.
translation: Cilya afika ku ŋanda, tasuminishe nangu umo ukuti bengile nankwe mu ŋanda, kanofye Petelo na Yoani na Yakobo, elyo na wishi na nyina kwa mwana.

english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
translation: Ninshi bonse mu ŋanda balelila, baleloosha. Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Lekeni ukulila, umukashana tafwile, alifye mu tulo.”

english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
translation: Awe bena balamuseka, ico bashininkishe ukuti nafwa.

english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”
translation: Yesu amwikata mu minwe, aikatisha ne shiwi ati, “We mwana buuka!”

english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
translation: Awe no bumi bwabwela, aima apopene. Yesu epakubeba ukuti bamupeeleko icakulya.

english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.
translation: Awe abafyashi ba mukashana cabapesha amano. Nomba Yesu ena abakonkomesha ukuti tabali nakwebako nelyo umo icicitike.

english: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
translation: Shimo shaponena mu mushili wa nsakalabwe. Nomba cilya shamena, awe shauma, ico pashali mutonshi.

english: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
translation: Imbuto shimbi shaponena mu myunga ne myunga yashitabilila, shatusa.

english: Other fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
translation: Shimbi shena shaponena mu mushili usuma. Awe shena shakula shatwala ne fisabo, cila lubuto umwanda umo.” Elyo Yesu aikatisha ishiwi asosa ati, “Uuli na matwi yakumfwa, naomfwe!”

english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
translation: Elyo abasambi baipusha Yesu umulolele uyu mulumbe.

english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
translation: Kabili Yesu alongenye abasole ikumi limo na babili. Abapeele amaka ne nsambu shakutamfya imipashi yakowela yonse no kuposha amalwele.

english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.
translation: Ilyo abasole babwelele, bashimikile Yesu fyonse ifyo bacitile. Yesu nao epakubasenda ukwakuti bali beka lwa ku musumba wa Betisaida.

english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
translation: Nomba cilya amabumba yaumfwako, yamukonka. Yesu nao ayasekelela, alayafunda na pa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa. Aposha na bonse abalekabila ukuposhiwa.

english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
translation: Cilya akasuba kaba kukuwa, abasole ikumi limo na babili baisa kuli Yesu. Balamweba abati, “Eba amabumba yaleya mu mishi ya mumbali na mu mitanda, pakuti yamone ukwakusendama ne cakulya. Pantu kuno tuli ni mu matololo.”

english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nimwe bapeeleni icakulya.” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tukwetepofye imikate isano ne sabi libili. Bushe nifwe tuli nokuya shitila aba bantu bonse ifyakulya?”

english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
translation: Pantu mwibumba mwali abaume ni cikanga amakana yasano. Yesu elyo aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Ebeni abantu bekale, mu mpuka imo mube abantu amakumi yasano.”

english: They did so, and made them all sit down.
translation: Awe efyo bacita na bantu baikala panshi.

english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
translation: Elyo Yesu abuula imikate isano ne sabi libili, alosha amenso ku mulu, atasha Lesa. Elyo amokaula imikate, apeela na basambi bakwe, pakuti baakanye abantu.

english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
translation: Awe abantu balya no kwikuta baikuta. Elyo abasambi balonganya ifipandwa fisheleko, baisusha imiseke ikumi limo na ibili.

english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
translation: Ubushiku bumo Yesu alepepa eka, ninshi abasambi bakwe nabo epo bali. Elyo abepwishe ati, “Bushe abantu batila nine ani?”

english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Bamo batila ni Yoani Kabatisha, bambi nabo batila ni Eliya, bambi bena batila ni kasesema pali bakasesema bakale uwabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
translation: Elyo abatuma kukubila imbila ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa no kuposha amalwele.

english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abepusha ati, “Nga imwe mutila nine ani?” Petelo ayasuka ati, “Niwe Kristu wakwa Lesa.”

english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,
translation: Yesu ena abakonkomesha ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo.”

english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
translation: Kabili alabeba ati, “Umwana wa muntu ali nokuculisha nganshi. Abakalamba na bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde bakamusuula no kumwipaya. Lelo mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
translation: Elyo Yesu alaeba bonse ati, “Umuntu nga alefwaya ukulankonka, aleikaanya umwine, alesenda no musalaba wakwe, elyo alenkonka.

english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.
translation: Pantu uyo onse uufwaya ukupususha umweo wakwe, akaulofya. Lelo uyo onse uulofya umweo wakwe pa mulandu wa ine, ena akaupususha.

english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?
translation: Bushe umuntu kuti amwenamo nshi, nga cakuti anonka ifyuma fyonse ifya calo, elyo aonaikilapo nangu alufishapo umweo wakwe?

english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
translation: Pantu onse uwakwatila ine insoni na mashiwi yandi, Umwana wa muntu nao akamukwatila insoni ilyo akesa mu bucindami bwakwe na mu bucindami bwakwa Wishi no bwa bamalaika bamushilo.

english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, bamo pali imwe mwe beminine pano, tabakafwe mpaka bakasuke bakamone Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
translation: Patile cilya papita inshiku cine konse konse apo alandile ifi, Yesu asendele Petelo na Yoani na Yakobo. Elyo anina nabo ulupili kukupepa.

english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
translation: Awe cilya alepepa, pa menso yakwe payaluka, ne nsalu shalabengeshimafye kukubuuta.

english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.
translation: Kabili abeba ati, “Pa lwendo mwilasenda nelyo cimo, nelyo ni nkonto, nelyo icola, nelyo icakulya, nelyo indalama. Mwilasenda imingila ibili.

english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
translation: Awe apopene abantu babili Mose na Eliya bamoneka no bucindami, balelanda na Yesu.

english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
translation: Balelanda pa mfwa Yesu ali nokufikilisha mu Yerusalemu.

english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.
translation: Petelo na banankwe baleshipula, lelo tabali mu tulo. Kanshi epakumona ubucindami bwakwa Yesu na bantu babili beminine nankwe.

english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
translation: Cilya aba bantu baba mukuya, Petelo aeba Yesu ati, “Shikulu, kuti cawama twaikala pano pene! Lekafye tupangepo insakwe shitatu, imo yobe, imbi yakwa Mose, elyo na imbi iyakwa Eliya.” Alesabailafye, taishibe nefyo alelanda.

english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
translation: Ilyo acili alelanda, paisa ikumbi lyabakupa mu cinshingwa. Ilyo ikumbi lyakupa apo bali, abasambi umwenso wabekata.

english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyafuma mwikumbi aliti, “Uyu e Mwana wandi, Umusalwa wandi, mulemumfwa.”

english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
translation: Nomba cilya ishiwi lyaleka ukulanda, awe bamona Yesu alifye eka. Abasambi pa nshita ilya tabalelandapo, kabili tabashimikileko nelyo umo pa fintu bamwene.

english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, ilyo baletentemuka ulupili, kwaisa ibumba ilikalamba kukubakumanya.

english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.
translation: Awe umuntu umo mwibumba alapunda ati, “Kafundisha! Nakupapata, lolesha pa mwana wandi umwaume, e mwanafye umo mpo nakwata.

english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
translation: Ala umupashi wakowela utila nga wamwikata, no kupunda alapunda apopene. Elyo walamufulumfunsha, alafumya ne fulo ku kanwa. Kabili taumuleka bwangu, lelo nga waisa muleka, ninshi umwana nanaka nganshi.

english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
translation: Elyo mu ŋanda yonse umo mwaingila, mwikale umo mwine mpaka nelyo mukafumamo.

english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
translation: Nacilomba abasambi bobe ukuti baufumyemo, nomba nabafilwa.”

english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
translation: Yesu epakwasuka ati, “Mwe nkulo yabula icisumino, iyaumalala imitima! Bushe ndi nokuba na imwe no kushipikisha mpaka lilali? Leta umwana obe kuno.”

english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
translation: Ilyo akalumendo kali mukwisa kuli Yesu, awe umupashi wakowela wakawisha panshi, walakafulumfunsha. Elyo Yesu akalipila umupashi wakowela, aposha na kalumendo, akabwesesha na kuli wishi.

english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
translation: Awe bonse balapapa ifyo Lesa aba na maka.

english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
translation: “Imwe mumfwikishe bwino aya mashiwi. Umwana wa muntu akaposwa mu minwe ya bantu.”

english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
translation: Nomba tabaumfwile umwalolele aya mashiwi. Bafililwe ukumfwa, ico yali yankaama. Kabili baletiina no kumwipusha pali aya mashiwi.

english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
translation: Elyo abasambi bakwa Yesu balebikana ifikansa palwa kwishiba umukalamba apo bali.

english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya, abula akaice, akeminika na lubali apo ali.

english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
translation: Elyo alabeba ati, “Umuntu onse uwasekelela akaice pa mulandu wa ine, ninshi nine asekelela. Kabili onse uwansekelela, ninshi asekelela no wantuma. Kanshi uwaicefya pali imwe bonse, e mukalamba.”

english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
translation: Elyo Yoani aebele Yesu ati, “Shikulu, twamwene umuntu umo alebomfya ishina lyobe pakutamfya imipashi yakowela. Lelo ifwe twalimulesha, pantu tatwaba nankwe pamo.”

english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
translation: Kabinge konse uko bakaana ukumusekelela, fumeni mu musumba wabo, mukunte no lukungu ku makasa yenu pakubashinina.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
translation: Yesu ena amweba ati, “Mwilamulesha, ala onse uushilemulwisha, ninshi munenu.”

english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
translation: Ilyo inshiku sha kubwelelamo ku mulu shalepalama, Yesu abikilefye nomba umutima wakwe pakuya ku Yerusalemu.

english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
translation: Elyo atuma inkombe ishakumutangilila. Awe ishi nkombe shaya ingila mu mushi umo uwa bena Samaria, pakuti shimupekanishishe ukwakufikilila.

english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
translation: Nomba abantu ba muli uyu mushi bakaana ukumupokelela, ico ali pa bulendo bwakuya ku Yerusalemu.

english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
translation: Ilyo abasambi bakwe Yakobo na Yoani bamona ifi, baipusha Yesu abati, “We Mfumu bushe ulefwaya tulombe umulilo ukufuma ku mulu wise uboce?”

english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
translation: Yesu ena apilibuka, alabakalipila.

english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
translation: Awe baima, baya na ku mushi umbi.

english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
translation: Cilya baleya mu nshila, umuntu umo aebele Yesu ati, “Nakulakukonka konse uko wakulaya.”

english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bamumbwe balikwata imimba, ifyuni fya mu mulu nafyo fyalikwata ifisansala. Lelo Umwana wa muntu wena takwata na pakusaila umutwe.”

english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
translation: Kabili Yesu aeba umbi ati, “Nkonka.” Nomba umuntu ati, “We Mfumu, leka ntale nje shiika batata.”

english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.
translation: Awe abasole baima, balapitana mu mishi balebila Imbila Nsuma, baleposha na balwele bonse uko baleya.

english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Leka abafwa baleshiika abafwa babo. Lelo iwe kabiye, uye ulebila imbila ya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
translation: Kabili umbi asosa ati, “We Mfumu nalaisa kukonka, lelo kantale nje shalikapo ba lupwa lwandi.”

english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Umuntu uwabuula ulukasu, alalima kabili alaceba kunuma, ninshi talingile Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
translation: Imfumu Herodi yati yumfwe ifyalecitika, fyaipeseshe amano. Pantu abantu bamo baleti, “Ni Yoani eubuukile ku bafwa.”

english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
translation: Bambi nabo baleti, “Ni Eliya eubwelele,” bambi nabo baleti, “Ala ni kasesema umo pali bakasesema bakale eushukwike ku bafwa.”

english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
translation: Herodi ena epakuti, “Yoani nalimuputulako umutwe. Nga kanshi uulecita ifi fintu ndeumfwa nani?” Kanshi Herodi alafwaisha ukumona Yesu.

english: A revelation, the LORD’s word to Israel by Malachi.
translation: Aya e mashiwi yakwa Yawe ayo atumine Malaki ukuya eba abena Israeli.

english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita aleti, “Ine kuti natemwa nganshi nga cakuti umunenu umo shimapepo aisalako ifiibi fye Tempele lyandi, pakuti tamuleisamo kukulakosha umulilo wacikoshekoshe pa bulambo bwandi. Ine nshimutemenwe imwe iyoo, ne mitulo yenu ine nshakulaipokelela ukufuma kuli imwe nakalya.

english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The LORD’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says the LORD of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says the LORD.
translation: Roma 9:13

english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says the LORD of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
translation: Ashama umuntu utila pakuntuula ilambo aisa ne nama iyalemana, ilyo pebumba lya fitekwa fyakwe nakwatapo inama imo iyisuma iyo alaya ukuntuula. Pantu ine ndi Mfumu nkalamba, na bantu ba mishobo yonse balikwatila ishina lyandi akatiina. Nine Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.”

english: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the LORD, “Yet I loved Jacob;
translation: Yawe alesosa ati, “Ala ine nalimutemwa imwe mwe bena Israeli. Nomba imwe mulanjipusha amuti, ‘Nga watutemwa shani?’”

english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
translation: lelo Esau ena nalimupata. Icalo ca mpili icakwa Esau ine naliconaula, nalicisangula ukuba icalo umwakuti muleikalafye bamumbwe.”

english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” the LORD of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom the LORD shows wrath forever.”
translation: Abena Edomu, emukuti bamwana Esau, nga balatila abati, “Nangu batonawila imishi, ala ifwe tukaikuula cipya cipya.”

english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “The LORD is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
translation: Esaya 34:5-17

english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’
translation: Imwe bashimapepo, Yawe umwine wa fita alemweba ati, “Umwana alacindika wishi, no mubomfi alatiina shikulu wakwe. Kanshi apo ine ndi shinwe, nga nomba imwe cinshi mushincindikila? Apo ine ndi shikulwinwe, nga nomba cinshi imwe mushintiinina? Mwe bashimapepo mwalisuula ishina lyandi. Elyo kabili mulanjipusha amuti, ‘Nga ifwe twasuula shani ishina lyobe?’

english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘The LORD’s table is contemptible.’

When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Ilyo imwe muleta inama iyapofula pakwisa ituula ilambo kuli ine, bushe imwe mutila amuti mulalungika, batini? Ilyo imwe muleta inama iyalemana nangu iyilwele, bushe imwe mutila amuti mulalungika, mwa? Nga mwatwalila umulashi wenu inama ya uyo musango, bushe kuti aya temwa no kumusekelela imwe?” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Eico nomba papateni pakuti Lesa atubeleleko uluse. Pantu nga mwaisa ne mituulo ya musango uyu mu maboko yenu, nga akaana ukumusekelela ninshi kuluba kwenu mwe bene. Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.
translation: Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita alanda ati, “Ine nomba ndemukonkomesha imwe mwe bashimapepo.

english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?
translation: Bushe ifwe bonse tatwaba na Shifwe umo wine? Bushe te Lesa umofye mpo uwatubumba? Nga nomba mulandu nshi tushumfwanina, icakuti twalasuulilapo ne cipangano ico Lesa apangene ne fikolwe fyesu?

english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.
The LORD will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to the LORD of Armies.
“This again you do: you cover the LORD’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.
translation: Kabili na cimbi ico imwe mucita, nici. Nimwe mulila ifilamba icakuti mwabomfya no bulambo bwakwa Yawe. Mulaloosha no kulashinshimukila pa mulandu wakuti Yawe alileka ukuposako amano ku malambo yenu nangu ukupokelela imituulo yenu ne nsansa, iyo mumutuula ku minwe yenu.

english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.
translation: No kwipusha mulepusha amuti, “Bushe kwena cinshi calenga?” Ala nico alishiba ukuti imwe mwalisangukila abakashi benu abo mwaupile mucili abalumendo. Ebo mwayampene nabo, nomba kabili mwalyonaula icilayo ico mwalayene nabo, nangu mwalaile Lesa ukuti ebo mwakulayampana nabo.

english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
translation: Bushe te Lesa amucitile umubili umo no mweo umo pamo pene nabo? Ngeco afwaya bushe cinshi? Ala ni pakuti tulekwata abana abakuba icine cine abantu bakwa Lesa. Kanshi muleisunga mu mitima yenu, pelaba nelyo umo uwakusangukila umukashi wakwe uo aupile acili umulumendo.

english: One who hates and divorces”, says the LORD, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says the LORD of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.
translation: Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli alesosa ati, “Ine nalipata ukulekana mu cupo, pantu umo nga acita ifyo, ninshi afyenga umukashi wakwe. Nine Yawe umwine wa fita ndelanda. Kanshi muleisunga mu mitima yenu, mwilasangukila bakashi benu.”

english: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’
translation: Imilandile yenu imwe naitendusha Yawe. Lelo imwe muleipusha amuti, “Nga ifwe tumutendwishe shani?”

english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says the LORD of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.
translation: Nga mwalakaana ukuŋumfwa kabili nga mwakaana ukulacindika ishina lyandi mu mitima yenu, ninshi ine ndi nokumulapisha. Ninshi ndi nokulapisha ne fintu fisuma fine ifyo imwe mushukila mu mulimo wenu uwa bushimapepo. Na mu cine nimfilapisha kale, pantu imwe tamuposako amano kukuncindika.

english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
translation: “Moneni, ine nkakalipila abana benu, nkamukantaika ubusali pa mpumi shenu, ubusali bwa nama shine isho mutuula amalambo, nkamuposa na kumbi ilyo ninshi namukantana nafyo.

english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Elyo mukashininkisha ukuti nine nakonkomesha aya mashiwi, pakuti icipangano candi ico napangana na Levi cilesungwa pa maka. Nine Yawe umwine wa fita nalanda.

english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.
translation: Ilyo ine napangene na Levi icipangano candi, icipangano ca mweo no mutende, no kumupeela nalimupeele epakuti alencindika. Awe nao alancindika, alakwatila ishina lyandi akatiina.

english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.
translation: Talefunda fyabufi iyoo, alefundafye ifyalungama. Ali uwacishinka, kabili uwa myendele yamutende pa menso yandi, aletalusha na bantu abengi ku fyabubifi.

english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies.
translation: “Pantu shimapepo ewaba no mulimo wakulanga abantu amano yene yene ayakunjishiba ine ne Lesa. Abantu bali nokulaya kuli shimapepo pakuya mukulasambililako ifyo ine mfwaya, pantu ena e nkombe yandi ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Nomba imwe mwe bashimapepo, awe mwalipatuka mu nshila iyalungama. Imifundile yenu nailenga ukuti abengi balebifya. Imwe namonaula icipangano ico ine napangene na Levi. Nine Yawe umwine wa fita ndemwebelapo.

english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.
translation: Kanshi nomba na ine nalaleka abantu bonse bamusuule kabili mube abafye, pantu imwe tamukonka inshila shandi, kabinge mulacita no mucishacinani ilyo mufunda abantu amafunde yandi.”

english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alesosa ati, “Moneni, ine nkatuma inkombe yandi iyakuntangilila, iyakumpekanishisha inshila. Ala Imfumu iyo mufwaya, mukapulikilwafye yaisa kwi Tempele lyaiko. Inkombe iyo imwe mufuluka, ikesa kukulumbilisha icipangano candi.”

english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.
translation: Mateo 11:10

english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Yoeli 2:11

english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Nehem 13:12

english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says the LORD. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Ifyo imwe mulanda pali ine, filankalifya umutima.

english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of Armies?
translation: Nico imwe mutila amuti, ‘Ukubombela Lesa, awe kuicushafye. Nga finshi ifyo ifwe tumwenamo mukulasunga amafunde yakwa Yawe umwine wa fita, na mukulaenda abafiitwa pakumulanga ukuti tulelanguluka pafyo tubifishe?

english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’
translation: Ukulingana nefyo ifwe tumona, tutila abacilumba balipaalwa. Elyo abacita ifyabubifi nabo balishuka, elyo abesha Lesa nabo balapusumuka.’”

english: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another; and the LORD listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name.
translation: Elyo abantu abakwatile Yawe akatiina balasoshanya, ninshi Yawe nao alekutika, aleumfwa nefyo balelanda. Elyo icitabo icipombwa icacibukisho calembelwe pa cinso cakwa Yawe ica mashina ya bantu abamukwatile akatiina no kucindika ishina lyakwe.

english: They shall be mine,” says the LORD of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.
translation: Ubuso 6:17

english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.
translation: Elintu nakabili mukashininkisha ifyo abantu abololoke baibela ku bantu ababifi, ifyo abantu abamombela baibela ku bantu abashimombela ine ne Lesa.”

english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;
translation: Mako 1:2

english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness.
translation: Akesa mukulalubulwisha ngo muntu uuleengulula no kuwaminisha silifa. Akesa wamya bamwana Levi nga filya fine bawaminisha silifa na golide. Elyo nabo nomba bakalatuula Yawe imituulo iya mu bololoke.

english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years.
translation: Imituulo iyo abena Yuda na bena Yerusalemu bakalatuula Yawe, elyo nao nomba akalasekelamo nga filya fine caleba kale mu myaka yakale.

english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “E mulandu ine nkesa kukumulubulwisha imwe, nkesa shinina bwangu bwangufye abantu ababuka, abacita ubucende, abalapa ubufi, abacenjelela ababomfi pakubalipila amalipilo yabo, abafyenga bamukamfwilwa na bana banshiwa, abafyenga na beni abenafyalo, kabili abashankwatila akatiina.”

english: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “Cine cine ine ne Yawe nshifutuka iyoo. E mulandu wine imwe bamwana Yakobo mushalobela.

english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’
translation: Ukufuma ku nshita ya fikolwe fyenu, imwe mwalipula mu mafunde yandi, tamuyakonka nakalya nga filya fine ne fikolwe fyenu fyalecita. Kanshi imwe bweleleni kuli ine, na ine ndi nokubwelela kuli imwe.”

english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.
translation: Eico na ine ndemwipusha nati, “Bushe umuntu kuti acenjesha ine ne Lesa? Ala nakalya, lelo kwena imwe mulancenjesha. Muncenjesha shani? Ni mukukanaleta icapekumi, na mukukanaleta imituulo.

english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.
translation: Mwashama imwe bonsefye, pantu umushobo wenu onsefye apo wapela ulancenjesha.

english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
translation: Awe Yesu aitile abasole bakwe ikumi limo na babili. Abapeela na maka yakutamfya imipashi yakowela na yakuposha amalwele yonse ne ntenda shonse.

english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
translation: Mwilasenda nelyo cola nangu imingila ibili, nangu indyato nelyo ni nkonto. Pantu umubomfi alilinga ukupeelwa ico alekabila.

english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
translation: “Kabili mu musumba uo mwaingilamo nangu umushi, fwayenimo umuntu uulingile ukufikilako. Eko mwikale mpaka napo mukafuminamo.

english: As you enter into the household, greet it.
translation: Ilyo mwaingila mu ŋanda, mulesosa amuti, ‘Umutende ube muli ino ŋanda.’

english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
translation: Muli iyo ŋanda nga bamupokelela bwino, lekeni umutende wenu wikalemo. Nomba nga tabamupokelele bwino, lekeni umutende wenu ubwelele uko muli.

english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
translation: Kabinge onse uwakaana ukumusekelela, nangu ukumfwa ku mashiwi yenu, mufume mu ŋanda yakwe, nelyo mu musumba wabo, mukunte no lukungu ku makasa yenu.

english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, pali bulya bushiku bwabupingushi, Lesa akakanda ulya musumba ukucila pali Sodoma na Gomora.

english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
translation: “Moneni namutuma nge mpaanga pakati ka mimbulu. Kanshi muleba abacenjela nge nsoka, kabili abafuuka imitima nge nkunda.

english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
translation: Mulecenjela ku bantu, pantu bakamutwala mu filye, no kumuma ifikoti mu masinagoga.

english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
translation: Kabili bakamutwala ku balashi na kuli bashamfumu pa mulandu wa ine, epakuti mukabe bakambone bandi kuli bena na ku Benafyalo.

english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
translation: Nomba ilyo bakalamutwalako, mwikalasakamana umwakuya landila nangu ifyakusosa. Ala mukalangililwa pa nshita ine iyo ifyo mukaba nokusosa.

english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
translation: Aya e mashina ya basole ikumi limo na babili. Umutanshi ni Simoni, ishina lyakwe limbi ni Petelo, elyo na munyina Andele, Yakobo mwana Sebede, na Yoani munyina,

english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
translation: Pantu teimwe mukalalanda, lelo ni Mupashi wakwa Shinwe eukalalandila muli imwe.

english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
translation: “Munyina akepaisha munyina, wishi nao mwane. Abana bakemina abafyashi babo no kubepaisha.

english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
translation: Abantu bonse bakamupata pa mulandu wa ine, lelo uukashipikisha mpaka na ku mpela, eukapusuka.

english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
translation: Nga balamucusha mu musumba umo, mubutukile kuli umbi. Ndemweba icine cine, ilyo mushilati mukumane imisumba yonse iya mu Israeli, ninshi Umwana wa muntu naisa.

english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
translation: “Umusambi tacila kafundisha wakwe, elyo umusha nao tacila shikulu wakwe.

english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
translation: Kuti calingafye umusambi ukuba nga kafundisha wakwe, elyo umusha nao nga shikulu wakwe. Apo baleita umwine ŋanda abati, ni Belesebu, palibufi aba mu ŋanda yakwe!

english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
translation: “Kanshi mwilatiina aba bantu. Pantu takwaba nangu cimo icabelama, icishakasokoloke. Nangu icafisama, icishakeshibikwe.

english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
translation: Ifyo ndemweba mu mfifi, imwe mukafisose pa bwelu. Ifyo bamutotosha mu kutwi, imwe mukalefyalasha kuli bonse.

english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
translation: Kabili mwilatiina abepaya umubili, lelo tekuti bepaye umupashi. Muletiina Lesa uwaba na maka yakulofya umupashi no mubili kumo mu mulilo wape.

english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
translation: Bushe tuncelelya tubili tatushitwa pa ndalama imo? Nomba pali uto tapaba nelyo kamo kaponena panshi ukwabula ukuti Shinwe eshibe.

english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
translation: Filipo na Batolomeo, Toma na Mateo kasonkesha wamusonko, Yakobo mwana Alufeyo na Tadeo,

english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
translation: Elyo ne mishishi ya ku mitwe yenu ine, yonse intu yapendwa.

english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
translation: Eico mwilaba na mwenso, imwe mwalicindama ukucila tuncelelya utwingi!

english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
translation: “Umuntu onse uushitiina kunumbula pa bantu ukuti muntu wandi, na ine nshakatiine kumulumbula pali Tata wa mu mulu.

english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
translation: Lelo uyo onse uukankaana pa bantu, na ine nkamukaana pali Tata wa mu mulu.

english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
translation: “Mwilatila ine naisa pano calo kukuletapo icibote. Awe iyoo, te cibote naletapo, ni nkondo.

english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
translation: Pantu naisa kukulwikanya umwana umwaume na wishi, umwana mwanakashi na nyina, elyo nafyala na nyinafyala.

english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
translation: Eico umuntu, aba mu ŋanda mumwakwe mwine, ebakaba abalwani bakwe.

english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
translation: “Uwatemwa wishi nelyo nyina ukucila ine talingile ukuba musambi wandi. Elyo no watemwa mwane umwaume nangu umwanakashi ukucila ine, nao talingile ukuba umusambi wandi.

english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.
translation: Na onse uushisenda musalaba wakwe no kulankonka, talingile ukuba musambi wandi.

english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
translation: Uyo uufwaya ukusunga umweo wakwe, akaulofya. Lelo uulofya umweo wakwe pali ine akausanga.

english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
translation: Simoni uwa mwibumba lya Baselote na Yuda wa ku Kelyoti uwaposele Yesu ku balwani.

english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
translation: “Uwasekelela imwe, ninshi nine asekelela. Elyo no wasekelela ine, ninshi asekelela uwantuma.

english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
translation: Uwasekelela kasesema, ico ni kasesema, akapokelapo icilambu cakwa kasesema. Uwasekelela umuntu umololoke, ico mololoke, akapokelapo icilambu ca muntu mololoke.

english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”
translation: Uwapeela kamo pali utu twaice ulukombo lwa menshi ayatalala ico kamusambi kandi, ndemweba icine cine, akapokelapo icilambu cakwe.”

english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
translation: Yesu elyo atuma abasole ikumi limo na babili, abakonkomesha ati, “Mwiya mu fyalo fya Benafyalo, na mu mishi ya bena Samaria mwilaingilamo.

english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
translation: Lelo mulungamefye ku mpaanga ishaluba isha mu bena Israeli!

english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
translation: Ilyo muleya, mulebilikisha amuti, ‘Ubufumu bwa mu mulu buli mupepi!’

english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
translation: Muleposha abalwele, mulebusha abafwa, muleposha na bafibashi, muletamfya ne mipashi yakowela. Mwapeelwafye ubu bupe, na imwe mulepeelafye.

english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
translation: Pa lwendo mwilasenda ndalama, isha misango yonse mu fikwama fyenu.

english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
translation: Ilyo Yesu atile ashipwafye ukufunda abasambi bakwe ikumi limo na babili, afuminepo, aya alafunda no kubila Imbila ya Bufumu bwa mu mulu mu misumba yabo.

english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
translation: Eo calembelwapo ukuti, ‘Mona, nkatuma inkombe yandi iyakukutangilila, iyakukupekanishisha inshila.’

english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, pa bana ba bantu tapatala apamoneka uwacila Yoani Kabatisha. Lelo ku baba mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu, nangu engacepa shani, alicila pali Yoani.

english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
translation: Ukufuma pali Yoani Kabatisha ukufika na pali nomba, Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba bwakulwila, na babulwila ebabupoka.

english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
translation: Ukufikafye na pali Yoani, Amafunde yakwa Mose na bakasesema bene bonse balesesemafye ifya pa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
translation: Nao Yoani nga mulefwaya ukusumina, e Eliya wine baebele ukuti ali nokwisa.

english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
translation: Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!

english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
translation: “Bushe inkulo ino kuti naipalanya kuli cinshi? Yaba nga baice abekele mu lubansa lwa cisankano, balebilikishanya na banabo baleti,

english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
translation: ‘Natumulishisha bamutolilo nokuti mucinde nakalya. Natwimba ulwimbo lwa malilo nokuti mulooshe nakalya.’

english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
translation: Pantu Yoani ilyo aishile, talelya nangu ukunwa, balatila, aba no mupashi wakowela.

english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
translation: Elyo paisa Umwana wa muntu, wena alalya no kunwa, lyena balasosa abati, ‘Moneni, uyu muntu mulili, kabili ni cakolwa, ni cibusa wa bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde!’ Nomba ificitwa fya mano yakwa Lesa filashinina ukuti yacine.”

english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
translation: Nomba Yoani ilyo ali mu cifungo, aumfwa ifyo Kristu alecita. Elyo atuma abasambi bakwe kukumwipusha ukuti,

english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
translation: Elyo Yesu atendeke ukwebaula imisumba umo acitile ifipeshamano ifingi, lelo abantu ba muli iyi misumba tabalapile no kupilibuka nakalya. Alayeba ati,

english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
translation: “Ukacimona Kolasini! Ukacimona nobe Betisaida! Pantu ifipeshamano fyacitilwe muli imwe, efyo aficitwa mu Turi na mu Sidoni, awe nga ni kale balapile no kupilibuka mukufwala insalu shabulanda no kuikuba imito!

english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
translation: Eico ndemweba nati, pali bulya bushiku bwakupingulwa, ubupingushi bwa pali Turi na Sidoni bukaba eyefilyako ukucila pali imwe.

english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.
translation: Mako 4:23

english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”
translation: Eico ndemweba ukuti pali bulya bushiku bwabupingushi, Lesa akakanda iwe Kapenamu ukucila pali Sodoma.”

english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
translation: Kabili pa nshita ine iyo, Yesu asosele ati, “Nakutasha Tata we Mfumu ya mulu ne calo, pantu ifi fintu walififisa ku bamano na ku bacenjela, wafisokolola ku bantu bafye.

english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
translation: Ee, Tata pantu we mwine efyo wafwaile ukucita.

english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
translation: “Tata alimpeela fyonse. Tapaba nangu umo waishiba Mwane, kano Wishi. Kabili tapaba waishiba Wishi, kano Mwane, elyo na bonse abo Mwane atemwa ukubasokolwela.

english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
translation: “Iseni kuli ine mwe bacucutika na mwe batitikishiwa, na ine ndemupeela ukutuusha.

english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
translation: Muleitwika ikoli lyandi, mulesambilila na kuli ine, pantu ndi wamutembo, nalifuuka no mutima. Lyena elyo mwakulaikala ne mitima tondolo.

english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
translation: “Bushe niwe uli nokwisa, nangu bushe tuli nokulolela umbi?”

english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
translation: Pantu ikoli lyandi talyayafya, ne cipe candi calyanguka.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bwelelenimo kuli Yoani, muye mushimikila ifyo muleumfwa nefyo mulemona.

english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
translation: Impofu shilemona, abalemana baleenda, abafibashi balepola, bankomamatwi baleumfwa, abafwa balebuuka, na balanda balebabilila Imbila Nsuma.

english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
translation: Kabili alishuka umuntu uushitwishika pali ine!”

english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
translation: Cilya abasambi bakwa Yoani babwelelamo, Yesu alalanda ku mabumba pali Yoani ati, “Bushe cinshi mwaile mukumona mu matololo? Bushe litete ilipungana ku mwela?

english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
translation: Kanshi cinshi mwaile kukumona? Bushe muntu uufwala insalu ishabusaka? Awe iyoo, abafwala insalu ishabusaka, bekala kwisano.

english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
translation: Nga kanshi ico mwaile kukumona cinshi? Bushe ni kasesema? Ee, cena ndemweba, Yoani alicila na pali kasesema.

english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
translation: Pa nshita ilya Yesu alepita mu mabala ya ŋanu pa bushiku bwe Sabata. Abasambi bakwe apo insala yabekata, batendeka ukulatimpula imisonso ya ŋanu, balalya.

english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
translation: Mwalimo no muntu uwa cisansa icalemana. Kanshi mwalimo bamo abalefwailisha apakuti bamupeelepo umulandu. Baipusha Yesu abati, “Bushe calisuminishiwa ukuposha umuntu pa bushiku bwe Sabata?”

english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?
