translation: Yesu ena abeba ati, “Nomba pali imwe umo nga alikwata impaanga imo, elyo nayo yawila mu cilindi pa bushiku bwe Sabata, bushe tekuti aifumyemo?

english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
translation: Ala umuntu alicindama ukucila impaanga! Kanshi calisuminishiwa ukucita ifisuma pa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Fungulula icisansa cobe.” Awe nao afungulula icisansa, no kuba cabafye bwino caba nge cibiye.

english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
translation: Elyo Abafalise bafumamo baya mukumfwana umwakwipaila Yesu.

english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
translation: Yesu ico aishiba aya mapange, afumako. Awe abantu abengi bamukonka, nao aposha abalwele bonse.

english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
translation: Abalesha ati, “mwilansokolola.”

english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
translation: Epakufikilisha ico kasesema Esaya asosele ati,

english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
translation: “ Moneni umubomfi wandi uyu, uo nasala.

english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
translation: Takalecita fikansa, nelyo ukupunda,

english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
translation: Abafalise bati bamone ifi balaeba Yesu abati, “Mona, abasambi bobe balecita icaleshiwa ukucita pa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
translation: Takafunaule itete ilyafwantwa,

english: In his name, the nations will hope.”
translation: Na Benafyalo bakalatetekela mwishina lyakwe.”

english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
translation: Elyo baletele kuli Yesu umuntu umo uwali mpofu, kabili cibulu, ico ali no mupashi wakowela. Awe Yesu amuposha, alalanda, alalolesha no kulolesha.

english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
translation: Abantu bonse balapapa abati, “Bushe uyu te mwana Davidi?”

english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
translation: Nomba Abafalise bati bomfwe, balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu atamfisha imipashi yakowela ku maka yakwa Belesebu umukalamba wa mipashi yakowela.”

english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya abeba ati, “Ubuteko bonse umwaba ukulwishanya abene, ninshi bukonaika. Elyo umusumba onse, nangu aba mu ŋanda imo, kumfwa nga mwaba ukulwishanya, ninshi tekuti batwalilile.

english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
translation: Kanshi Satana nga atamfya Satana, ninshi alailwisha umwine. Nga kanshi ninshi ubuteko bwakwe kuti bwatwalilila shani?

english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
translation: Nga kanshi ine nga ntamfya imipashi yakowela ku maka yakwa Belesebu, nga basambi benu bena baitamfya ku maka yakwani? Kanshi ebakumupingula.

english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
translation: Lelo nga ni ku maka yakwa Mupashi wakwa Lesa eko ntamfisha imipashi yakowela, ninshi Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa nabufika uko muli.

english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
translation: “Elyo kabili bushe umuntu kuti aingilila shani umuntu uwamaka mu ŋanda no kutapa ifyuma fyakwe, nga cakuti pakubala tabalilepo ukumukaka? Iyoo kano ninshi abala akaka uwamaka elyo engatapa ifyuma fyakwe.

english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe tamwabelenga ifyo Davidi acitile ilyo umwine wine pamo nabo ali nabo baiketwe ne nsala?

english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
translation: Uushaba na ine ninshi mulwani. Uushibomba na ine mukulonganya, alasalanganya.

english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
translation: Eico ndemweba nati, abantu kuti babelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo fyonse na ku musaalula onse bengacita kuli Lesa. Lelo uwasaalula Mupashi Wamushilo, takabelelwe luse nakalya.

english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.
translation: No wasosa amashiwi yamusaalula pa Mwana wa muntu, akabelelwa uluse. Lelo uwasosa amashiwi yamusaalula pali Mupashi Wamushilo takabelelwe luse, mu bumi bwa nomba nangu mu bwa kuntanshi.

english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
translation: “Nga mwakwata umuti uusuma ninshi ne fitwalo fileba ifisuma. Nga mwakwata umuti uubi, ninshi ne fitwalo filebipa. Pantu umuti bawishibila ku fitwalo fyauko.

english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
translation: Mwe bana ba nsoka mwe, nga kuti mwalanda shani ifisuma, mwe babi ba bantu? Pantu akanwa ka muntu kalanda ifyaisula umutima wakwe.

english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
translation: Umuntu musuma afumya ifisuma fya mu cipao cakwe cisuma. Umuntu mubi nao afumya ifibi ifya mu cipao cakwe icibi.

english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
translation: “Ndemweba nati, pa bushiku bwabupingushi cila muntu akaba nokulubulula peshiwi lyonse lyacisosesose.

english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
translation: Kanshi ni ku mashiwi yobe eko ukapingwilwa ukuti uli wakaele nangu uli no mulandu.”

english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
translation: Elyo bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise bamo balaeba Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, tulefwaya ucite icipeshamano icakukwishibilako.”

english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Iyi nkulo ibi, iyasangukila Lesa, ilefwaya icishibilo cacipeshamano! Nomba tayakamone icishibilo cimbi, kanofye ninshi icakwa kasesema Yona.

english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
translation: Aingile mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, elyo Davidi wine nabo ali nabo balile imikate iyatuulilwe kuli Lesa. Iyi mikate tabali na kulyako, pantu tacasuminishiwe, kanofye bashimapepo beka.

english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
translation: Pantu nga filya Yona ali mu nda ya cisabi inshiku shitatu, akasuba no bushiku, efyo no Mwana wa muntu akaba mukati ka mushili inshiku shitatu, akasuba no bushiku.

english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku bwabupingushi, abena Ninife bakemina abantu ba ino nkulo no kubapeela umulandu. Pantu bena balilapile no kupilibuka ilyo Yona abilile imbila. Nomba pano palipo uwacila Yona.

english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
translation: Pa bushiku bwabupingushi namfumu wa ku Sheba akemina abantu ba ino nkulo no kubapeela umulandu. Pantu wena afumine ku mpela ya calo, kukwisa umfwa amano yakwa Solomoni. Nomba pano palipo uwacila Solomoni.

english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
translation: “Ilyo umupashi wakowela wafuma mu muntu waya ulalulumba mu matololo umwabula amenshi, ulefwaya apakutuusha, nomba nokuti upamone nakalya.

english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
translation: Elyo wasosa auti, ‘Kambwelelefye ku ŋanda yandi uko mfumine.’ Cilya wafikamo wasanga tamuli kantu, nabapyanga nabamusamika.

english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
translation: Awe waya isa ne mipashi yakowela imbi cine lubali, iyabipisha ukuucila. Elyo yaisa ingilamo, emo yaikala. Awe nomba imibeele ya bumi bwa muntu iya pakulekelesha yabipishapo ukucila ifyo cali kale. Ifi fine efyo cikaba na kuli ino nkulo ibi.”

english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alelanda ku mabumba, nyina na bamunyina baishile baiminine panse, balefwaya ukuti balande nankwe.

english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
translation: Umuntu umo amweba ati, “Ala banoko na bamunonko bali panse, balefwaya ukulanda nobe.”

english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
translation: Nao Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nga bamayo ni bani, na bamunyinane nabo ni bani?”

english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
translation: Epakusonta ku basambi bakwe ati, “Ala moneni aba, e bamayo, kabili e bamunyinane!

english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
translation: Nangu bushe tamwabelenga mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, ifyo bashimapepo ba mwi Tempele bakaana ukusunga icebo ca pa bushiku bwe Sabata, ukwabula ukukwata icilubo?

english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
translation: Pantu onse uucita ifyo Tata wa mu mulu afwaya, e munyinane, e nkashi yandi, kabili e mayo.”

english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
translation: Kanshi ndemweba nati, pano palipo uwacila Itempele.

english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
translation: Ala amwishiba umwalola amashiwi yakutila, ‘Ine mfwaya uluse, ilambo lyena telyo,’ awe nga tamupeele mulandu ku bashikwete mulandu.

english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
translation: Pantu Umwana wa muntu e mwine wa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
translation: Ubushiku ubo bwine, Yesu ati afume mu ŋanda, aya ikala pa lulamba lwa bemba.

english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
translation: Elyo abasambi baisa kuli Yesu balamwipusha abati, “Ngeco mulelandila ku bantu mu milumbe cinshi?”

english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Imwe mwalipeelwa ukwishiba inkaama sha Bufumu bwa mu mulu, nomba bena nakalya.

english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
translation: Pantu uwakwata akapeelelwapo na fimbi, elyo akakwata ifingi. Lelo uushakwata, bakamupoka noto akwata.

english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
translation: E mulandu wine ndebalandila mu milumbe, pantu balalolesha lelo tabamona, balomfwa lelo tabatesha nelyo kwiluka tabeluka.

english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;
translation: Kanshi ni kuli aba bantu fyafikilishiwa ifyo kasesema Esaya aseseme ati,

english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
translation: Pantu imitima ya aba bantu yalikutwa.

english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
translation: “Nomba imwe, amenso yenu yalishuka pantu yalamona, na matwi yenu pantu yalomfwa!

english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine nati, bakasesema abengi na bantu abololoke abengi balefwaisha ukumona ifyo imwe mulemona, lelo tabafimwene nakalya. Balefwaisha ukumfwa ifyo imwe muleumfwa, lelo tabafyumfwile nakalya.

english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
translation: “Kanshi imwe umfweni umwalola umulumbe wakwa katanda wa mbuto.

english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
translation: Imbuto ishaponene mumbali ya nshila, e muntu onse uumfwa ishiwi lya Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, nomba tomfwile umo lilolele. Awe na Ciwa aisa senda icatandilwe mu mutima wakwe.

english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
translation: Elyo amabumba ayakalamba yaisa longana yamushinguluka. Eico pa mulandu wa mabumba, aingila mu bwato, emo aikala. Abantu bena bashala nabeminina pa lulamba.

english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
translation: Elyo ne shaponene mu mushili wa nsakalabwe, e muntu uumfwa ishiwi, apopene alipokelela ne nsansa.

english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
translation: Nomba lyaikalamofye akashita kanono, ico lyafilwa ukwanda imishila. Kanshi ilyo paisa ubwafya nangu amacushi pa mulandu we shiwi, awe bwangu bwangu anenuka.

english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
translation: Ishaponene mu myunga, e muntu uumfwa ishiwi, nomba isakamika lya fya pano calo, no mukonkelelo wa fyuma, fyatusha ishiwi lyafilwa no kutwala ifitwalo.

english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
translation: Lelo ishaponene mu mushili usuma, e muntu uumfwa ishiwi, ailuka no kwiluka. Epakutwala ifisabo apa umwanda umo (100), pambi amakumi mutanda (60) na pambi amakumi yatatu (30).”

english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
translation: Yesu kabili abomina umulumbe na umbi ati, “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu kuti twabupalanya ku muntu uwatandile imbuto shisuma mwibala lyakwe.

english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
translation: Awe kuti cilya abantu bonse bali mu tulo, umulwani wakwe aisa, atandamo amankumba mu ŋanu, aya no kuya.

english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
translation: Cilya imisonga yamena, yapakula no kupakula, elyo amankumba yamoneka.

english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
translation: Elyo abasha ba mwine ibala baisa uko ali, bamweba abati, ‘Mukwai bushe te mbuto shisuma mwatandile mwibala lyenu? Nga kanshi amankumba yafuma kwi?’

english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
translation: Nao abasuka ati, ‘Ala mulwani ewacita ici.’ Abasha nabo abati, ‘Bushe mulefwaya ukuti tuye finukaulamo?’

english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, ‘Awe iyoo, epali mukunukaula amankumba, mwanukwila kumo ne ŋanu.

english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
translation: Elyo alabeba ifintu ifingi mu milumbe ati,

english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
translation: Lekeni filekulila pamo mpaka ne nshita yakuseepa. Elyo pa nshita yakuseepa, nkeba abakuseepa nati, taleni longanyeni amankumba, muyakake mu myanshi, muyoce. Elyo mulonganye iŋanu, mushitutile mu butala bwandi.’ ”

english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,
translation: Kabili Yesu abomina umulumbe na umbi ati, “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba nga kalubuto ka lubanga, ako umuntu abuula, akabyala mwibala lyakwe.

english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
translation: Ekacepesha pa mbuto shonse, nomba ilyo kakula, kalacila pa fimpusa fyonse. Kabafye umuti, uwakuti ne fyuni fyaisa mukwikala mu misambo yauko.”

english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
translation: Yesu abomina umulumbe na umbi ati, “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba nge ntutumushi iyo umwanakashi abuula, akasawila mu fipimo fitatu ifya bunga, mpaka umufuba watutumuka.”

english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
translation: Fyonse ifi Yesu alelandila mu milumbe ku mabumba. Na mu cacine talelanda nangu cimo, kanofye mu milumbe.

english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
translation: Kanshi epakufikilisha ifyasosele kasesema ati,

english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
translation: Elyo Yesu ashile amabumba, aile na mu ŋanda. Awe abasambi bakwe baisa balamweba abati, “Twilwileko umulumbe wa mankumba mwibala.”

english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Katanda wa mbuto shisuma, Mwana wa muntu.

english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
translation: Ibala, lisonde line, ne mbuto shisuma, e bana ba Bufumu. Elyo amankumba, e bana bakwa Ciwa.

english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
translation: No mulwani uwatandile amankumba ni Ciwa. Inshita yakuseepa nayo, ni pa kupwa kwa calo. Elyo bakaseepa nabo ni bamalaika.

english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
translation: Cilya aletanda, imbuto shimo shaponena mumbali ya nshila, ne fyuni fyaisa shikompaula.

english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
translation: Kanshi nga filya banukaula amankumba, bayalonganya no kuyoca, efyo fine cikaba na pa kupwa kwa calo.

english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,
translation: Umwana wa muntu akatuma bamalaika bakwe, abakwisa fumya mu Bufumu bwakwe abalenga abanabo ukubifya ne mpulumushi shonse.

english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
translation: Bakabaposa mwilungu lya mulilo, emukaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.

english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
translation: Elyo abakaele bakalabengeshima nga kasuba mu Bufumu bwakwa Shibo. Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!

english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
translation: “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba nge cuma bafisa mwibala. Ilyo umuntu acitulila, acifisa nakabili. Elyo aya nasansamuka nganshi, ashitisha na fyonse ifyo akwata, ashita neli ibala.

english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
translation: “Nakabili Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba ngo muntu uwamakwebo uulefwaya ubulungu bwamutengo ubwayemba.

english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
translation: Nomba ati amone ubwamutengo nganshi, ayashitisha fyonse ifyo akwata, aisa shita nobu bulungu.

english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
translation: “Kabili Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwapala ku mukwau uo baposa muli bemba, waikata isabi ilya misango na misango.

english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
translation: Kuti cilya waisulamo isabi, abalondo baukulila ku mulundu. Elyo baikala balasala. Ilisuma balabika mu miseke, ilibi lyena balaposa.

english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
translation: Efyo cikaba na pa kupwa kwa calo. Bamalaika bakesa patulula ababi ukubafumya ku bantu abololoke.

english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
translation: Shimbi shaponena mu mushili wa nsakalabwe, umushali mushili wingi. Awe bwangu bwangu shamena, ico pashali mushili uwingi.

english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
translation: Ababi bakabaposa mwilungu lya mulilo, emukaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.”

english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe mwafitesha fyonse ifi?” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ee.”

english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
translation: Yesu elyo abeba ati, “Kanshi kafundisha wamafunde onse uwaba umusambi wa Bufumu bwa mu mulu, aba ngo mwine ŋanda, uufumya mu cipao cakwe ifipya ne fikote.”

english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwile ukubomina iyi milumbe, alifumineko.

english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
translation: Cilya afika ku musumba kumwabo, alafunda mu sinagoga. Abantu bena balapapa abati, “Nga aya mano, na aya maka yakucita ifipeshamano, uyu muntu afumya kwi?

english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
translation: Bushe uyu tali mwana kabasa wa mbao? Na nyina nao, bushe teuyu batila Maria? Elyo bamunyina, bushe te Yakobo na Yosefu na Simoni na Yuda?

english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
translation: Bankashi yakwe bushe teaba bonse twikala nabo? Nga kanshi uyu muntu ni kwi afumya ifi fyonse?”

english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
translation: Awe cabansha no kumusumina. Yesu wena abeba ati, “Kasesema kumbi balamucindika, kanofye ku ba mu calo cakwe, na ku ba mu ŋanda yakwe.”

english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
translation: Awe tacitileko ifipeshamano ifingi, pantu tabali na cisumino.

english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kabalika, shabonsa, shauma no kuma, ico shishali na mishila ine ine.

english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
translation: Shimbi shaponena mu myunga, ne myunga yati ikule, yashitabilila, shatusa.

english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
translation: Shimbi shena shaponena mu mushili usuma, shatwale fisabo. Shimo shatwala inseke umwanda umo (100), shimbi amakumi mutanda (60), shimbi amakumi yatatu (30).

english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translation: Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!”

english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
translation: Pali ilya nshita imfumu Herodi yaumfwile ululumbi lwa pali Yesu.

english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
translation: Awe baya putulako Yoani umutwe mu cifungo.

english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
translation: Elyo bauleta pa mbale, bapeela no mukashana, nao autwala na kuli nyina.

english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
translation: Abasambi bakwa Yoani baisa senda icitumbi, baya cishiika. Elyo baya shimika imfwa yakwe kuli Yesu.

english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
translation: Ilyo Yesu aumfwile uyu mulandu, alifumineko, aya no bwato ku matololo ukwakuti ali eka. Nomba amabumba yashumfwa ifi, yaisa ukufuma mu misumba, yakonka uko aleya pa makasa.

english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
translation: Yesu cilya afuma mu bwato, amona ibumba lya bantu ilikalamba. Awe abalangulukila, alaposha na balwele babo.

english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
translation: Cilya akasuba kaba kukuwa, abasambi baisa uko ali balamweba abati, “Kuno tuli ni ku matololo, kabili na kasuba kawa. Kanshi eba abantu baye mu mishi, baye ishitila ifyakulya.”

english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
translation: Yesu nao abeba ati, “Abantu nangu tabele, imwe nimwe bapeeleni icakulya.”

english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
translation: Bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe kuno tukwetefye imikate isano ne sabi libili.”

english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
translation: Yesu ati, “Kanshi findeteleni kuno.”

english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
translation: Elyo akonkomesha ukuti amabumba yekale pa fyani. Elyo abuula imikate isano ne sabi libili, alosha amenso ku mulu, alatasha Lesa. Elyo amokaula imikate, apeela na basambi bakwe nabo balapeela abantu.

english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
translation: Yalaeba na bacilolo aiti, “Ni Yoani Kabatisha eubuukile ku bafwa, eco akwatile aya amaka yakucita ifipeshamano.”

english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
translation: Awe bonse balya no kwikuta baikuta. Elyo abasambi balonganya ifipandwa fyasheleko, baisusha imiseke ikumi limo na ibili.

english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
translation: Ne mpendwa ya baume abalileko yali cikanga amakana yasano, ukwabula ukupendelako abanakashi na baice.

english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
translation: Apopene Yesu acincishe abasambi ukuti bengile mu bwato, batangile babukile kwishilya. Elyo umwine ena ashala alesalanganya amabumba.

english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
translation: Ilyo asalanganya amabumba, anina ulupili aya eka kukupepa. Cilya caba icungulo, ninshi Yesu ashelekofye eka.

english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
translation: Ubwato bwena ninshi bwafika apatali pali bemba, buletumpaukilafye ku mulandu wa matamba, ico bapindilwe no mwela.

english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
translation: Elyo lwa ku macaca Yesu alaisa uko bali, aleenda pali bemba.

english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
translation: Ilyo abasambi bamona aleenda pali bemba, batiina nganshi. Balasosa abati, “Cipuku!” Elyo balapunda ku mulandu wa mwenso.

english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
translation: Yesu apopene abeba ati, “Tekeni imitima! Ala nine! Mwitiina!”

english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
translation: Petelo amwasuka ati, “We Mfumu nga niwe, njeba njise uko uli ndeenda pa menshi.”

english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Ale isa!” Awe Petelo afuma mu bwato, alaya kuli Yesu, aleenda pa menshi.

english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
translation: Pantu Herodi aikete Yoani, amukaka, amuposa na mu cifungo, pa mulandu wakwa Herodia muka Filipo, munyina.

english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
translation: Nomba ico icimwela cakosa, atiina, atendeka no kwibila. Elyo alakuuta ati, “We Mfumu mpusushako!”

english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
translation: Apopene Yesu atambika ukuboko amwikata. Alamweba ati, “We muntu wa cisumino cinono, cinshi watwishikila?”

english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
translation: Awe cilya baingila mu bwato ne cimwela caleka.

english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
translation: Elyo abantu bali mu bwato balapakata Yesu abati, “Cine cine uli Mwana wakwa Lesa.”

english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
translation: Yesu na basambi ilyo bayabukile bemba, bafikile mu calo ca Genasaleti.

english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;
translation: Ilyo abantu ba muli iyi ncende bamwishiba, nabo baishibisha abantu ba mu mishi ya mumbali. Awe abantu balaleta abalwele bonse kuli Yesu.

english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
translation: Balamupapata ukuti, engaleka abalwele balekumyafye nangu ni ku nsenkebele sha nsalu shakwe. Awe na bonse abalekumyako balepola.

english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
translation: Yoani aleeba Herodi ati, “Calileshiwa ukuupa Herodia.”

english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
translation: Herodi alefwaya no kwipaya Yoani lelo aletiina abantu, ico bena baleti, ni kasesema.

english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
translation: Nomba cilya ubushiku bwakucindika ukufyalwa kwakwa Herodi bwafika, umukashana mwana Herodia aisa mu lwalala alacinda. Awe asansamusha Herodi nganshi.

english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
translation: Herodi nao alaya umukashana, alapa nokuti, “ndekupeela consefye ico ulenomba.”

english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
translation: Nao umukashana ico aya tunkwa na nyina, asosa ati, “Ndefwaya mumpeele lino linefye pa mbale umutwe wakwa Yoani Kabatisha!”

english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
translation: Awe imfumu yalanguluka, nomba pa mulandu wa mulapo na beni abo ili nabo, yakonkomesha ukuti bacitile umukashana ico alefwaya.

english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
translation: Elyo Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde bamo abafumine ku Yerusalemu baishile kuli Yesu, bamwipwishe abati,

english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
translation: Kabili Yesu aita ibumba alalyeba ati, “Kutikeni, mumfwikishe.

english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
translation: Te cintu cingila mu kanwa ecikowesha umuntu, lelo icintu cifuma mu kanwa ecikowesha umuntu.”

english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”
translation: Ukuf 20:12

english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
translation: Esaya 29:13

english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
translation: Basuulenikofye! Ni mpofu, abatungulula impofu shinabo. Impofu nga yalatungulula impofu ibiye, ninshi shonse kuti shawila mu cilindi.”

english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
translation: Elyo Petelo amweba ati, “Twilwileko uyu mulumbe.”

english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
translation: Amaf 5:16

english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?
translation: Bushe tekuti mumone ukuti conse icingila mu kanwa, cipita munda, elyo caisa fumina kunse?

english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.
translation: Lelo ifintu fifuma mu kanwa, fifuma mu mutima. Nefi fintu efikowesha umuntu.

english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
translation: Pantu ni mu mutima, emufuma imitontonkanishishe ibi, iyili nge misoka, ulubembu, bupulumushi, ubupupu, bukambone bwabufi, no musaalula kuli bambi.

english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
translation: “Cinshi ico abasambi bobe bashikonkela fishilano fya fikolwe fyesu? Pantu tabasamba minwe yabo ngefyo cilingile pakulya!”

english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
translation: Ifi efikowesha umuntu. Lelo ukulya ukwabula ukusamba ku minwe, takukowesha muntu nakalya.”

english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
translation: Elyo Yesu afuminepo, aile na ku calo ca Turi na Sidoni.

english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
translation: No mwanakashi umwina Kenani, uwa muli ici calo aisa kuli Yesu. Alabilikisha ati, “We Mfumu, Mwana Davidi, shi winganangulukilako! Ala umwana wandi umukashana, umupashi wakowela ulamucusha bubi bubi.”

english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
translation: Nomba Yesu wena tamwaswike nakalya. Elyo abasambi bakwe baisa, balamupapata abati, “Mwebe aleya! Pantu aletukonka, atukomya muno icongo.”

english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Ine natumwafye ku mpaanga ishaluba mu bena Israeli.”

english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
translation: Umwanakashi nao aisa fukama apali Yesu ati, “We Mfumu ngafwako!”

english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Tacilingile ukubuula icakulya ca bana no kuposela imbwa.”

english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
translation: Umwanakashi nao amwasuka ati, “Ee, kwena nifyo fine mukwai, lelo ne mbwa shine nasho shilalyako ubufungau ubupona kwitebulo lyakwa shikulu washiko.”

english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
translation: Elyo Yesu amwasuka ati, “We mayo we, icisumino cobe camaka! Nacicitikile umo mwine ulefwaila.” Awe pa nshita ine iyo no mwana wakwe apola.

english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.
translation: Awe Yesu afumineko, aile alekonka ululamba lwa bemba wa Galile. Elyo aninine ulupili, epo aikele.

english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
translation: Nao Yesu abasuka ati, “Ngeco imwe mupulila mu mafunde yakwa Lesa pa mulandu wa fishilano fyenu cinshi?

english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
translation: Awe amabumba yaisa apo ali yaleleta ifilema, impofu, abalesunta, bacibulu na bambi abengi aba malwele ayalekana lekana. Balebabika apali Yesu nao alabaposha.

english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
translation: Abantu pakumona uko bacibulu balelanda, abalesunta bali bwino, abalemana baleenda ne mpofu shilemona, balasunguka, balalumbanya na Lesa wa bena Israeli.

english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
translation: Kabili Yesu aitile abasambi bakwe alabeba ati, “Nalangulukila abantu, pantu nomba twaikala nabo inshiku shaba shitatu, elyo ne fyakulya tabakwete. Awe ine nshilefwaya ukuti babwelelemo ne nsala, epali bafwa ulushile mu nshila.”

english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
translation: Abasambi bakwe bamweba abati, “Nga muno matololo kuti twafumya kwi imikate iyakuti twalisha ibumba ilyakula ifi?”

english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
translation: Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe mukwetepo imikate inga?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Pali cine lubali, no tusabi tunono.”

english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba ibumba ukwikala panshi.

english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
translation: Kabinge abuula imikate cine lubali no tusabi, atasha Lesa. Elyo amokaula, apeela na basambi, abasambi nabo balapeela abantu.

english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
translation: Awe bonse balya no kwikuta baikuta. Elyo balonganya ifipandwa fyasheleko, baisusha imiseke cine lubali.

english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
translation: Kanshi abalileko bali abaume amakana yane ukwabula ukupendelako abanakashi na baice.

english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
translation: Elyo Yesu ati asalanganye amabumba, aingila mu bwato, ayabukila mu calo ca Magadani.

english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
translation: Pantu Lesa asosa ati, ‘Ulecindika wiso na noko,’ kabili atile nokuti, ‘Uwalapisha wishi nangu nyina, alingilefye ukumwipaya.’

english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
translation: Nomba imwe mutila, uyo onse uwaeba wishi nangu nyina ati, ‘Ifintu mfwile namupeela pakumwafwako, nimfituula kuli Lesa.’ Kanshi ninshi lyena mutila tali nakukonka icebo cakwafwa wishi na nyina!

english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
translation: Mukucita ifi, mulonaula icebo cakwa Lesa pa mulandu wa fishilano fyenu.

english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
translation: Mwe mfundabuteshi mwe! Cine cine Esaya alilungike ilyo aseseme pa mulandu wenu ati,

english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
translation: ‘Aba bantu bancindikafye pa kanwa,

english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
translation: Baicushafye pakumpepa.

english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
translation: Awe Abafalise na Basaduki baishile kuli Yesu kukumwesha. Bamulomba ukuti acitepo icipeshamano icakulanga ukuti aba na Lesa.

english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
translation: Kabili nelyo nalishishe abantu amakana yane ku mikate cine lubali, bushe mwaiswishe imiseke inga ku fipandwa fyasheleko?

english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi mushilukile ukuti te mikate naciba ndelandapo? Kanshi cenjeleni ku ntutumushi ya Bafalise na Basaduki!”

english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
translation: Elyo abasambi bailuka ukuti, intutumushi acilabasokako, te ntutumushi ya mukate iyoo, lelo ni ku mafunde ya Bafalise na Basaduki.

english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
translation: Elyo Yesu afikile mu calo mwabela umusumba wa Kesalia Filipi. Aipwishe abasambi bakwe ati, “Bushe abantu batila Umwana wa muntu nani?”

english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Bamo batila ni Yoani Kabatisha, bambi batila ni Eliya, elyo bambi nabo batila ni Yeremia, nangu umo pali bakasesema.”

english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
translation: Yesu nao abepusha ati, “Nga imwe, mutila nine ani?”

english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
translation: Elyo Simoni Petelo ayasuka ati, “Niwe Kristu, Umwana wakwa Lesa wamweo.”

english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Walishuka Simoni, mwana Yona! Pantu te muntu uwakusokolwela ici, ni Tata wa mu mulu.

english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
translation: Kanshi ine nakweba nati, niwe Petelo, nakabili pa cilibwe ici epo nkakuula ulukuta lwandi. Na maka ya mfwa tayakalucimfye nakalya.

english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
translation: Nkakupa ne mfungulo sha Bufumu bwa mu mulu. Conse ico walesha pano calo, ninshi na mu mulu caleshiwa. Na conse ico wasuminisha pano calo, ninshi na mu mulu casuminishiwa.”

english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ilyo kwaba icungulo, ku mulu nga kwakashika, mutila amuti, ‘Bukaca bwino.’

english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
translation: Elyo akonkomesha abasambi bakwe ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo ukuti nine Kristu.”

english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
translation: Ukutulafye lilya line, Yesu atampile ukulanda ku basambi bakwe apabuuta tuutu ati, “Ndi nokuya ku Yerusalemu, uko abakalamba, bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde bakaya ncusha nganshi. Bakaya njipaya, lelo ubushiku bwalenga shitatu nkabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
translation: Elyo Petelo amusenda pambali, alamukalipila ati, “Ico cena teco we Mfumu! Awe iyoo, ico tekuti cikucitikile.”

english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
translation: Elyo Yesu apilibukila kuli Petelo amweba ati, “Fuma apa we Satana we! Ulencilikila inshila. Pantu imitontonkanishishe yobe teyakwa Lesa, yabuntunsefye!”

english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
translation: Elyo Yesu aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Umuntu nga alefwaya ukulankonka, aleikaanya umwine, alesenda no musalaba wakwe, elyo alenkonka.

english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
translation: Pantu uyo onse uufwaya ukupususha umweo wakwe, akaulofya. Lelo uyo onse uulofya umweo wakwe pa mulandu wa ine, akausanga.

english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
translation: Bushe umuntu kuti amwenamo nshi, nga cakuti anonka ifyuma fyonse ifya pano calo, elyo alufishapo umweo wakwe? Nga cintu nshi umuntu engapeela icingalinga ukukabusha no mweo wakwe?

english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.
translation: Ala Umwana wa muntu alaswa ese no bucindami bwakwa Wishi pamo na bamalaika bakwe, pakwisa lambula bonse ukulingana ne micitile yabo.

english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, bamo pali imwe mwe beminine pano, tabakafwe mpaka bakasuke bakamona Umwana wa muntu uko aleisa no Bufumu bwakwe.”

english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
translation: Ulucelo lwena, nga ku mulu kwakashika, kwaba ne cikutuma, mutila, ‘Lelo kuleba icimwela.’ Mwalishiba ukwilula ifimoneka umulu, nomba mwafilwa ukwilula ifishibilo fya ino nshita!

english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.
translation: Iyi nkulo ibi kabili iyasangukila Lesa ilefwaya icishibilo cacipeshamano! Nomba tayakamone icishibilo nakalya, kanofye ninshi icishibilo cakwa Yona.” Awe Yesu abasha, afumapo.

english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
translation: Elyo abasambi bayabukile kwishilya, kanshi ninshi balilabile ukusenda imikate.

english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation: Yesu alabeba ati, “Mulecenjela no kulaisunga ku ntutumushi ya Bafalise na Basaduki.”

english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
translation: Nabo epakulalanshanya abati, “Nico tushisendele mikate.”

english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?
translation: Yesu nao ico eshibe ifyo balelanda, abeba ati, “Mwe bantu ba cisumino cinono, cinshi ico mulelanshanya amuti, ‘Nico tushikwete mikate?’

english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,
translation: Bushe kanshi na nomba tamulailuka? Bushe tamuleibukisha ifyo nalishishe abantu amakana yasano ku mikate isano? Bushe mwaiswishe imiseke inga ku fipandwa fyasheleko?

english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshiku mutanda, Yesu asendele Petelo na Yakobo na Yoani munyina, baile nina ulupili ulutali ukwakuti babefye beka.

english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
translation: Elyo abasambi baipusha Yesu abati, “Ngeco bakafundisha bamafunde basosela abati, ‘Eliya euli nokubalilapo ukwisa cinshi?’ ”

english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Kwena nifyo fine. Eliya ali nokwisa mona ukuti fyonse fili ngomo fifwile ukubela.

english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
translation: Lelo ndemweba nati, Eliya alisa kale. Nomba abantu tabamwishibe nakalya. Bena bamucitile umo balefwaila. Eifyo fine bakacusha no Mwana wa muntu.”

english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
translation: Elyo abasambi bailuka ukuti, ni pali Yoani Kabatisha epo Yesu alelanda.

english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
translation: Yesu na basambi balya batatu, babwelele kwibumba. Elyo kwaishile umuntu umo, aishile fukama apali Yesu, alamweba ati,

english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
translation: “We Mfumu, shi wingalangulukilako umwana wandi. Alipena, kabili acula nganshi. Imikufye iyingi alaponena mu mulilo, nangu mu menshi.

english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
translation: Nacimuleta ku basambi bobe, nomba nabafilwa ukumuposha.”

english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
translation: Mateo 3:17

english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
translation: Elyo Yesu akalipila umupashi wakowela. Awe nao wafuma mu kalumendo, nako ukupola kapola apopene.

english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
translation: Elyo abasambi baisa kuli Yesu, balamwipusha kumbali abati, “Nga ifwe cinshi twacifililwa ukuutamfya?”

english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
translation: Elyo Yesu ayaluka pa menso yabo. Impumi yakwe yalabengeshima nga kasuba. Ne nsalu shakwe shayaluka shalabekafye ngo lubuuto.

english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nico muli ba cisumino cinono. Ndemweba icine cine, amuba ne cisumino icili nga akalubuto ka lubanga, nga kuti mwaeba ulu lupili amuti, ‘Fuma apa selela kulya,’ nalo kuti lwasela. Teti kube nelyo cimo ico mwingafilwa.

english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”
translation: [Nomba tekuti mutamfye iciwa ca uyu musango, kanofye ku mapepo no kufunga ukulya].”

english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
translation: Ilyo Yesu na basambi bali pamo mu Galile, elyo Yesu alabeba ati, “Umwana wa muntu akaposwa mu minwe ya bantu.

english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
translation: Bakamwipaya, elyo ubushiku bwalenga shitatu akabuuka ku bafwa.” Awe abasambi baikalafye nkumbabulili.

english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
translation: Cilya Yesu na basambi bakwe bafikile mu musumba wa Kapenamu, bakalonganya wa musonko wa mwi Tempele baishile kuli Petelo, balamwipusha abati, “Bushe kafundisha wenu tasonka musonko we Tempele?”

english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
translation: Petelo abasuka ati, “Alasonka.” Elyo Petelo aingila mu ŋanda, Yesu ewabalilapo ukumweba ati, “Simoni, iwe uletipo shani? Bushe imfumu sha pano calo ni kuli bani shipoka umusonko no mutuulo? Bushe ni ku bana bashiko nangu ni ku bantu bafye?”

english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
translation: Nomba te mulandu, pakuti twileka aba bantu bafulwe, iwe akuya kuli bemba. Uye posa ubulobo muli bemba. Isabi walaya balilapo ukuloba, ulyasamune akanwa. Uleya sangamo indalama iyilingene no musonko wa mwi Tempele. Uye ubuule, ubapeele, usonkeleko ine na iwe wine.”

english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
translation: Awe apopene bamona Mose na Eliya balelanda na Yesu.

english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation: Elyo Petelo aeba Yesu ati, “We Mfumu, kuti cawama twaikala pano pene. Nga uulefwaya kuti napangapo insakwe shitatu, imo yobe, imbi iyakwa Mose, elyo na imbi iyakwa Eliya.”

english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
translation: Ilyo Petelo acili alelanda, awe ikumbi ilyabeka lyabakupa mu cinshingwa. Elyo ishiwi lyafuma mwikumbi aliti, “Uyu e mwana wandi uo natemwa, uo nsekelamo. Mulemumfwa.”

english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
translation: Cilya abasambi baumfwa ifi, bawa panshi ubukupeme ku mulandu wa kwikatwa no mwenso.

english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
translation: Amaf 2:7

english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
translation: Awe bati benune amenso, tabamwene nelyo umo, kanofye Yesu eka.

english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
translation: Ilyo baletentemuka ulupili, Yesu alebakonkomesha ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo pafyo mwacimona, kanofye ilyo Umwana wa muntu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
translation: Pa nshita iyo ine, abasambi baishile kuli Yesu, bamwipwisha abati, “Bushe umukalamba pali bonse mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu nani?”

english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
translation: “Moneni ukuti mwilasulapo nelyo kamo pali utu utwaice. Pantu ndemweba ukuti, bamalaika batuko ababa mu mulu bamonanafye pe na Tata wa mu mulu.

english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
translation: “Bushe imwe kuti mwatilapo shani? Umuntu nga cakuti alikwata impaanga umwanda umo (100), nomba alufyapo imo, bushe tekuti ashe ishi amakumi pabula na pabula (99) pa lupili aye alafwaya iyilubile?

english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, nga cakuti aisanga, ala kuti asansamukisha nganshi pali iyi mpaanga imo, ukucila na pali shilya shimbi amakumi pabula na pabula ishishilubile.

english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
translation: Eifyo fine na Shinwe wa mulu tafwaya ukuti palubepo kamo pali utu utwaice.

english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
translation: “Munonko nga akulufyanya uye mweba icilubo cakwe uko muli babili mwekafye. Nga akumfwa ninshi mwawikishanya na munonko.

english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
translation: Lelo nga akaana ukukumfwa ninshi sendako umuntu umo nangu babili, ngefyo Amalembo Yamushilo yatila, ‘Pakuti kube ukupeela umulandu uuli onse, kano kwaba bakambone babili nangu batatu abakushininkisha.’

english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
translation: Nga cakuti akaana ukubatesha nabo, lyena twala ku lukuta. Nga akaana no kumfwa ku lukuta, ninshi mumucite nga uushaishiba Lesa nangu kasonkesha.

english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine, conse ico mwalesha pano isonde, ninshi na ku mulu caleshiwa. Na conse ico mwasuminisha pano isonde, ninshi na ku mulu casuminishiwa.

english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
translation: “Kabili ndemweba nati, pali imwe babili nga mwasuminishanya pano calo mukulomba icintu, ninshi Tata wa mu mulu akamupeela.

english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
translation: Yesu epakwita akaice kamo, akeminika na mu lwalala.

english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
translation: Pantu uko babili nangu batatu balongana pa mulandu wa ine, ninshi na ine tuli nabo.”

english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
translation: Elyo Petelo aishile kuli Yesu, amwipusha ati, “We Mfumu miku inga ningabelela munyinane uluse nga andufyanya? Bushe kufika pa miku cine lubali?”

english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ine nshakwebe ukuti, kufika pa miku cine lubali. Lelo ndeti miku amakumi cine lubali imiku cine lubali.

english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
translation: Eico Ubufumu bwa mu mulu kuti twabupashanya ku mfumu iyalefwaya ukwishiba ifyo abasha baiko babomfeshe indalama shaiko.

english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
translation: Kuti cilya yatampa ukupitulukamo, bamuletela umusha umo uwamukongwele indalama imyandamishila.

english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
translation: Nomba ico uyu musha ashikwete ifyakuti afutilepo, imfumu yapingula ukumushitisha pamo no mukashi wakwe na bamwane na fyonse ifyo akwata, pakuti afute pa nkongole.

english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
translation: Awe umusha amufukamina, alamupapata ati, ‘Mulopwe bengampeelako akashita, nkamubwesesha fyonse.’

english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
translation: Awe imfumu yamulangulukila, yamuleka aleya, yasuula na ku nkongole.

english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
translation: Nomba uyu musha ashifumapofye, akumanya umusha munankwe uwamukongwele indalama umwanda umo. Awe amwikatisha, alamukama na pa mukoshi. Alamweba ati, ‘Mbwesesha ifyo wakongola!’

english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
translation: Umusha mubiye amufukamina alamupapata ati, ‘Mpeelako mune akashita, nkakubwesesha.’

english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: Elyo alabeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, nga tamwalwike no kuba ngo twaice, tamwakengile mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.

english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
translation: Lelo wena akaana ukusumina. Amuposa mu cifungo, mpaka akasuke akabweshe inkongole.

english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
translation: Abasha banankwe pakumona ifyacitika, cabapesha amano. Elyo baima baya shimikila imfumu yabo fyonse ificitike.

english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
translation: Imfumu yabo epakwita ulya musha kumwakwe. Yamweba aiti, ‘We mubi wa musha we! Ine nalisuulile ku nkongole shobe shonse shilya, ico wampapete.

english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
translation: Bushe na iwe tawaciba nakubelela umusha mubiyo uluse, nga filya ine nakubelele uluse?’

english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
translation: Awe imfumu yafulwa nganshi. Yamuposa mu cifungo umo bali nokumucusha mpaka akabweshe inkongole shakwe shonse.

english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
translation: Efyo na imwe Tata wa mu mulu akamucita kumfwa nga tamulebeleshanya uluse ne mitima yenu yonse.”

english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: Kanshi uwaicefya no kuba ngaka kaice, eukaba umukalamba pali bonse mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.

english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
translation: Umuntu onse uwasekelela akaice ngaka pa mulandu wa ine, ninshi nine asekelela.

english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.
translation: “Nomba uwalenga ukuti kamo pali utu utwaice utwasumina muli ine ukubifya, kuti camuwaminapo ukumukulikila mu mukoshi icilibwe icafina icakupelelako no kumuposa petenga muli bemba.

english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
translation: Bakacimona abantu ba pano calo abalenga abanabo ukubifya! Ukubifya kwena kwaba nokubako, lelo uwalenga umunankwe ukubifya, wena akacimona!

english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
translation: “Nga cakuti icisansa cobe nangu ulukasa lobe efyakulengesha ukubifya, ufiputuleko, ufipose no kutali! Cawamishapo ukwingila mu mweo wa pe na makunkutu, nangu icilema, ukucila ukuposwa mu mulilo wape ne fisansa fibili nangu amakasa yabili.

english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
translation: Ilinso lyobe nga elyakulengesha ukubifya, ulitonkole, ulifwinte no kutali! Cawamishapo ukwingila mu mweo wa pe ne linso limo, ukucila ukuposwa mu mulilo wa pe na menso yabili.

english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwile ukusosa aya mashiwi, afumine mu Galile, aile na ku calo ca Yudeya, kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani.

english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Te bonse bengapokelela aya mashiwi, kanofye kubo capeelwa.

english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
translation: Kwaliba abantu abashaba na maka yakuupa pantu efyo bafyalwa. Bambi ni bamutungwi ico abantu ebabacita ifyo. Bambi bena basala ukukanaupa pa mulandu wa Bufumu bwa mu mulu. Uwingapokelela aya mashiwi, nayapokelele.”

english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
translation: Abantu bamo baletele utwaice kuli Yesu, pakuti atutambalikilepo amaboko no kutupepelako. Nomba abasambi bena balakalipila abantu.

english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
translation: Yesu ena asosa ati, “Lekeni utwaice twise uko ndi, mwitulesha iyoo. Pantu ababa ngotu twaice, e bene ba Bufumu bwa mu mulu.”

english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
translation: Elyo atambalikilapo amaboko pa twaice, afumapo alaya.

english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
translation: Elyo kwaishile umuntu umo kuli Yesu, amwipwishe ati, “Kafundisha, fisuma nshi ndi nokucita pakumona umweo wape?”

english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Cinshi ico wanjipushisha pa mulandu wa busuma? Umusuma abafye umo mpo. Nga ulefwaya ukumona umweo ulekonka amafunde.”

english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
translation: Nao umuntu aipusha ati, “Mafunde nshi?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Wilaipaya, wilabembuka, wilaiba, wilabepa bufi,

english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
translation: ulecindika wiso na noko, uletemwa no mubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.”

english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
translation: Amabumba ya bantu ayakalamba yamukonka, nao kulya kwine alaposha na balwele.

english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
translation: Umulumendo ayasuka Yesu ati, “Ifi fyonse ndafikonka. Nga kanshi finshi fimbi ifyo ndi nokucita?”

english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nga ulefwaya ukuba uwapwililika, kabiye uye shitisha ifyo wakwata. Upeele ne ndalama ku balanda, lyena ninshi ukakwata icuma mu mulu. Elyo wise unkonke.”

english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
translation: Awe umulumendo ati omfwe aya mashiwi, aya alelanguluka, pantu ali ne fyuma ifingi.

english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
translation: Elyo Yesu aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, cintu cayafya ku wafyuma ukwingila mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.

english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Icite 2:24

english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
translation: Abasambi pakumfwa ifi basunguka nganshi. Balasosa abati, “Nga kanshi nani engapusuka?”

english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
translation: Yesu abalolesha, abeba ati, “Abantu bena kuti bafilililwafye, lelo Lesa ena tafilwa kantu.”

english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”
translation: Icite 1:27

english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, ilyo fyonse fikaluka cipya cipya, no Mwana wa muntu aisa ikala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu icacindama, elyo imwe mwe bamukonka, mukekala pa fipuna fyabufumu ikumi limo na fibili. Mukaleputula imilandu ya nko ikumi limo na shibili isha bena Israeli.

english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
translation: Na onse uwasha amayanda, nangu bamunyina, nangu inkashi, nangu wishi, nangu nyina, nangu abana, nangu amabala, pa mulandu wakukonka ine, akapokelapo pali conse umwanda umo. Elyo akakwata no mweo wape.

english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
translation: Abafalise bamo baisa kuli Yesu, balamwesha abati, “Bushe calisuminishiwa ukuti umwaume aleke umukashi wakwe pa mulandu cikulufye mulandu?”

english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
translation: Lelo abengi abantanshi, bakaba abakulekelesha, na bengi abakulekelesha, bakaba e bantanshi.

english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe tamwabelenga ukuti, Lesa uwabumbile abantu pa citendekelo, abumbile umwaume no mwanakashi!

english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
translation: Kabinge atile, ‘Kanshi eco umwaume ashiila wishi na nyina, no kuminkana no mukashi wakwe, elyo aba babili baba umubili umo.’

english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
translation: Kanshi nomba tabali babili, balifye umubili umo. Ico Lesa alundinkanya, umuntu ecilekanya.”

english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
translation: Abafalise nabo bamwipusha abati, “Nga kanshi cinshi ico Mose atupeelele ili ifunde ilyakuti, umwaume ali nokulemba kalata wakulekelapo umukashi wakwe, epakumutamfya?”

english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ico Mose amupeelele ulusa lwakuleka abakashi benu, mulandu wakumalala kwa mitima yenu. Lelo ukufuma ku citendekelo tacali ifi iyoo.

english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
translation: Nomba ine ndemweba nati, uwaleka umukashi wakwe, apashili mulandu wa bulalelale, aupa na umbi, ninshi lubembu acita.”

english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
translation: Umu emwakonkanine ifikolwe fyakwa Yesu Kristu, mwana Davidi, mwana Abrahamu.

english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
translation: Hesekia afyala Manase, Manase afyala Amoni, Amoni nao afyala Yosia.

english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
translation: Yosia afyala Yekonia na bamunyina, elyo babasenda bunkole ku Babiloni.

english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
translation: Panuma yakusendwa bunkole ku Babiloni Yekonia afyala Shealitieli, Shealitieli nao afyala Serubabeli.

english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
translation: Serubabeli nao afyala Abudi, Abudi afyala Eliakimu, Eliakimu nao afyala Aso.

english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
translation: Aso afyala Sadoki, Sadoki afyala Akimu, Akimu nao afyala Eliudi.

english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
translation: Eliudi afyala Eleasa, Eleasa afyala Matani, Matani nao afyala Yakobo.

english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
translation: Yakobo afyala Yosefu muka Maria. Maria ewafyele Yesu uo batila Kristu.

english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
translation: Kanshi inkulo shonse shaba nifi, ukufuma kuli Abrahamu ukufika kuli Davidi ni nkulo ikumi limo na shine. Kabili ukufuma kuli Davidi ukufika na kukusendwa bunkole ku Babiloni napo ni nkulo ikumi limo na shine. Elyo ukufuma ku busha bwa ku Babiloni ukufika na Kristu nalyo ni nkulo ikumi limo na shine.

english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
translation: Kanshi ukufyalwa kwakwa Yesu Kristu kwali nifi. Maria nyina wakwa Yesu akobekelwe kuli Yosefu. Lelo ilyo tabalati bekale nankwe, Maria asangwa ukuti ali pabukulu ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
translation: Nomba Yosefu umwina mwakwe ico ali umuntu umololoke talefwaya ukumusebanya, epakupanga ukumulekela mu bumfisolo.

english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
translation: Abrahamu afyele Isaki, Isaki afyala Yakobo, Yakobo nao afyala Yuda na bamunyina.

english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
translation: Ilyo acili aletontonkanya ifi, malaika wa Mfumu amumonekela mu ciloto. Alamweba ati, “Yosefu we mwana Davidi, witiina kusenda Maria kumobe ukuti abe umukashi obe. Ala pantu ico aimita, cafuma kuli Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
translation: Akafyala umwana umwaume, na iwe ukamwinika ishina lya Yesu, pantu eukapususha abantu bakwe ku fyabubifi fyabo.”

english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
translation: Ifi fyonse fyacitike pakufikilisha amashiwi ya Mfumu ayo kasesema asosele ati,

english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
translation: “Umukashana uushakuma ku mwaume akemita,

english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
translation: Kanshi ilyo Yosefu aisa buuka mu tulo, acita ngomo malaika wa Mfumu acimwebela. Asenda na Maria umukashi wakwe kumwakwe.

english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
translation: Nomba tabakumenepo mpaka Maria apaapa umwana umwaume. Yosefu nao amwinika ne shina lya Yesu.

english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
translation: Yuda afyala Peresi na Sera muli Tama. Peresi afyala Hesroni, Hesroni nao afyala Ramu.

english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
