translation: Ramu afyala Aminadabu, Aminadabu afyala Nashoni, Nashoni nao afyala Salimoni.

english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
translation: Salimoni afyala Boasi muli Rahabu, Boasi afyala Obedi muli Ruti, Obedi afyala Yese.

english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
translation: Yese afyala imfumu Davidi.

english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
translation: Solomoni afyala Reoboamu, Reoboamu afyala Abiya, Abiya nao afyala Asa.

english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
translation: Asa afyala Yehoshafati, Yehoshafati afyala Yoramu , Yoramu nao afyala Usia.

english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
translation: Usia afyala Yotamu, Yotamu afyala Ahashi, Ahashi nao afyala Hesekia.

english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
translation: “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu bwaba ngo mwine ibala, uwafumine lucelocelo kukufwaya abancito abakubomba mwibala lya myangashi.

english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
translation: Abacibalilapo ukwingila incito nabo baisa. Balesubila ukulipilwa ukucilapo. Nomba nabo balipilwafye amalipilo ya pa bushiku bumo.

english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
translation: Cilya balipilwa balailishanya ku mwine ibala lya myangashi abati,

english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
translation: ‘Abo aba pakulekelesha ababombafye insa imo, ebo watulinganya nabo? Nomba ifwe twacululuka mukubomba akasuba konse no kupya ku kasuba!’

english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
translation: Umwine ibala pakubasuka aebapo umo ati, ‘Mune nshikufyengele, bushe te malipilo ya pa bushiku bumo twacumfwana nobe?

english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
translation: Senda amalipilo yobe, akuya. Nine ne mwine ndefwaya ukulipila uyu wakulekelesha ngefyo nkulipile.

english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
translation: Bushe nshikwete nsambu shakubomfya icuma candi umusango ndefwailamo? Nangu, bushe mufimbilafye pa mulandu wa cikuuku candi?’

english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
translation: Eico kanshi abakulekelesha ebakaba abantanshi, elyo abantanshi nabo bakaba abakulekelesha.”

english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
translation: Yesu ali pa bulendo bwakuninika ukuya ku Yerusalemu, asendele abasambi bakwe ikumi limo na babili beka. Mu nshila alabeba ati,

english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
translation: “Moneni, twalaya ku Yerusalemu, elyo Umwana wa muntu alaya poswa kuli bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde. Balaya mupingwila ukufwa.

english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
translation: Balaya muposa mu minwe ya Benafyalo, nabo bakamuseka no kumuma ifikoti no kumutanika pa musalaba. Elyo ubushiku bwalenga shitatu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
translation: Baumfwana na bancito ukubalipila amalipilo ya pa bushiku bumo. Elyo abatuma na kwibala lyakwe ilya myangashi.

english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
translation: Elyo nyina wa bamwana Sebede aishile na bamwane kuli Yesu. Aisa fukama apali Yesu, alamulombako cimo.

english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”
translation: Yesu amwipusha ati, “Finshi ulefwaya?” Nao amweba ati, “Ndelomba ukuti usuminishe abana bandi aba babili ukuti, umo akaleikala ku kulyo kobe, umbi nao ku kuso kobe nga waba Imfumu.”

english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Tamwishibe ico mulelomba. Bushe kuti mwanwena mu lukombo lwamacushi ulo ndi nokunwenamo?” Bamwasuka abati, “Ee, kuti twacita.”

english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Ee, ukunwa kwena mukanwena mu lukombo lwandi, nomba ukwikala ku kulyo kwandi nangu ku kuso, teine mpeela. Ni Tata eupeela abo afipekanishisha.”

english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
translation: Ilyo abasambi balya bambi ikumi baumfwa ifi, bafulilwa aba bamunyina babili.

english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
translation: Yesu abeta bonse, alabeba ati, “Mwalishiba ukuti bashamfumu ba Benafyalo balomya ubufumu bwabo, na bakalamba babo nabo babateeka no mucusha.

english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
translation: Imwe tacili nakuba ifi iyoo. Pali imwe onse uulefwaya ukuba umukalamba, abe ewakumutumika.

english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
translation: Kabili onse uulefwaya ukuba uwantanshi, ali nokuba umusha wenu.

english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
translation: Ngefyo no Mwana wa muntu wine taisa pakuti bamutumike, lelo ni kukutumika, no kuleka umweo wakwe pakupususha abengi.”

english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
translation: Cilya Yesu na basambi bakwe balefuma mu Yeriko, ibumba ilikalamba lyalemukonka.

english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
translation: Kabili cilya akasuba kasansama, pa nshita ya 09:00, afuma asanga bambi nabeminina pa lubansa lwa cisankano baleambakalafye.

english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
translation: Impofu shibili ninshi shikele mumbali ya nshila. Ilyo shaumfwa ukuti ni Yesu eulepita, shalapunda ashiti, “We Mfumu, mwana Davidi, shi wingatulangulukilako!”

english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
translation: Elyo ibumba lyalashikalipila, lyalasheba ukuti shitalale. Lelo shena elyo shacishamo ukupunda ashiti, “We Mfumu, we mwana Davidi, shi wingatulangulukilako!”

english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation: Elyo Yesu aiminina, ashiita, alashipusha ati, “Finshi mulefwaya ukuti mucitile?”

english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”
translation: Shamwasuka ashiti, “We Mfumu tulefwaya ukulalolesha!”

english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
translation: Yesu uluse lwamwikata, ashikumya na pa menso. Awe apopene shalalolesha, shalamukonka no kumukonka.

english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
translation: Nabo abeba ati, ‘Na imwe kabiyeni kukubomba mwibala lyandi ilya myangashi. Ndeisa mupeela amalipilo ayalingile.’

english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
translation: Awe nabo eko baya. Kabili cilya akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe, pa nshita ya 12:00, na cilya akasuba kasendama, pa nshita ya 15:00, atumako na bambi.

english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
translation: Cilya akasuba kaya kukuwa, pa nshita ya 17:00, asanga na bambi bemininefye. Abepusha ati, ‘Ngeco mwimininefye pano akasuba konse muleambakalafye cinshi?’

english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
translation: Bamwasuka abati, ‘Nici pashili uwakutwingisha incito.’ Abeba ati, ‘Na imwe bene kabiyeni mukubomba mwibala lyandi ilya myangashi.’

english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
translation: “Cilya kwaba icungulo, umwine ibala lya myangashi aeba kangalila wa bancito ati, ‘Ita abancito ubapeele amalipilo yabo. Utampilepo abakulekelesha, elyo ulekeleshe na bacibalilapo.’

english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
translation: Abacingila incito cilya akasuba kaba kukuwa, pa nshita ya 17:00, baisa. Cila umo alipilwa amalipilo ya pa bushiku bumo.

english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
translation: Cilya Yesu na basambi bakwe baile balepalama ku Yerusalemu, bafikile na ku Betifage, ku lupili lwa Miolifa. Yesu atuma abasambi babili,

english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
translation: Ilyo Yesu aingila mu Yerusalemu, mu musumba onse mwakaba na see ku congo. Abantu balaipusha abati, “Nga uyu nani?”

english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
translation: Amabumba ya bantu bakonkele Yesu, yalayasuka ayati, “Uyu ni Yesu, kasesema uwafuma ku Nasaleti mu Galile.”

english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
translation: Ilyo Yesu aingile mwi Tempele, atamfishe panse bonse abaleshitamo na baleshitishamo ifintu. Kabili alapenaula amatebulo ya balekabushanya indalama, ne fipuna fya baleshitisha inkunda.

english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”
translation: Abeba ati, “Ala calembwa ukuti, ‘Iŋanda yandi ikalaitwa ukuti ni ŋanda ya mapepo’, lelo imwe muisangwile icifulo ca bapupu!”

english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
translation: Kabili impofu na balemana baisa kuli Yesu mwi Tempele, nao abaposha.

english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,
translation: Nomba bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde bafulwa nganshi pakumona ifipeshamano acita, elyo no kumfwa uko abaice balepunda mwi Tempele baleti, “Hosana, nakalebalika Mwana Davidi!”

english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”
translation: Epakwipusha Yesu abati, “Bushe tauleumfwa ifyo aba baice balesosa?” Yesu nao abasuka ati, “Ee, nintesha. Nomba bushe tamwabelenga ukuti, ‘Ku tunwa twa twaice no twa kwibele, eko waipekanishisha amalumbo yene yene?’ ”

english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.
translation: Awe afumapo, abasha, aya na ku musumba wa Betani, eko aya sendama.

english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
translation: Ulucelo ilyo Yesu alebwelela ku musumba wa Yerusalemu, insala yamwikete.

english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.
translation: Cilya amona umukunyu umo mumbali ya nshila, eko aya. Asangakofye amabula yeka yeka, takwatwala nangu kamo. Elyo aeba umuti ati, “We muti we, wikatala autwala ifitwalo nakabili!” Awe apopene no mukunyu wauma.

english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
translation: abeba ati, “Kabiyeni pa mushi ulya pantanshi. Pakwingilafye pene, muleya sanga punda nakulikwa pamo na kamwane. Mubakakule, mubandetele.

english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
translation: Abasambi bati bamone ifi, basunguka nganshi. Balasosa abati, “Nga kanshi umukunyu wauma shani apa pene?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, nga namusumina tamuletwishika nelyo panono, kuti mwacita ico nacita ku mukunyu. Kuti mwaeba nolu lupili amuti, ‘Fuma apa, uipose muli bemba’, no kucitika kuti cacitika.

english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
translation: Nga muli bacisumino, fyonse ifyo mwakulalomba mu mapepo mwakulapeelwa.”

english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation: Elyo Yesu aingilile mwi Tempele. Ilyo alefunda abantu, bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba ba bantu baisa kuli Yesu. Balamwipusha abati, “Bushe ni ku maka nshi ucitilako ifi fintu? Nga uwakupeela aya maka nani?”

english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Na ine nalamwipushapo icipusho cimo. Na imwe nga mwayasuka, na ine nalamwebako ukufuma amaka ayo ncitilako ifi fintu.

english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
translation: Conse nga twatila ni ku bantu lwafumine, awe abantu tabatupanye, pantu bonse balishininkisha ukuti Yoani ali ni kasesema.”

english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
translation: Kanshi epakwasuka Yesu abati, “Awe tatwishibe.” Yesu nao abeba ati, “Kanshi na ine nshamwebe ukufuma amaka ncitilako ifi fintu.”

english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
translation: “Nga imwe kuti mwatilapo shani? Kwaliko umuntu umo uwali na bana abaume babili. Uyu muntu aya ku wamukalamba, amweba ati, ‘We mwana, kabiye kukubomba lelo mwibala lyandi lya myangashi.’

english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
translation: Ena ayasuka ati, ‘Awe nshayeko.’ Nomba panuma ashala alanguluka, aya na kukubomba mwibala.

english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
translation: Nomba umo nga alafwaya ukumulesha, mumwebe amuti, ‘Imfumu eilebafwaya, kabili yalababwesha nombalinefye.’ ”

english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
translation: Kabili uyu muntu aya ku wamwaice, nao amweba cimo cine. Ena amwasuka ati, ‘Ee mukwai, nalaya.’ Lelo taileko iyoo.

english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
translation: Bushe pali aba babili, uwacitile ifyo wishi alefwaya nani?” Bamwasuka abati, “Wamukalamba.” Yesu abasuka ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, bakasonkesha bamusonko na bacilende balemutangilila ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
translation: Pantu Yoani ilyo aishile kukumulanga inshila yabololoke, tamwamusumine. Lelo bakasonkesha bamusonko na bacilende bena balimusumine. Kabili nelyo mwamwene ifi, awe nalyo line tamwalapile no kusumina Yoani.”

english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
translation: Yesu ati, “Umfweniko umulumbe na umbi. Kwaliko umuntu uwalimine ibala lya myangashi. Apindako ne linga, aimbilamo ne cakukaminamo umwangashi, akuulilamo no lupungu. Elyo aseekesha ibala lya myangashi ku balimi, ena aima aya pa bulendo.

english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
translation: Cilya ulwakulobolola ifisabo lwafika, atumako abasha ku balimi, pakuti bese bamupokeleko ifisabo fimo.

english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
translation: Nomba abalimi bena baikata abasha bakwe. Umo bamupumaula, umbi bamwipaya, elyo umbi nao bamulasaula amabwe.

english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
translation: Kabili atumako abasha na bambi abengi ukucila pa bantanshi. Nabo bene, abalimi babacita ngefyo bacitile ababiye.

english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
translation: Pakulekelesha atumako umwana wakwe ati, ‘Wena balaya mucindika.’

english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
translation: Lelo abalimi bashimona mwane, balaebana abati, ‘Impyani iyi! Aleni, iseni natuipaye, uleke nifwe tukamubuulile ibala.’

english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
translation: Awe bamwikata, bamuposa kunse ye bala lya myangashi, bamwipaya.

english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
translation: Kanshi ifi fyacitike pakufikilisha ifyasosele kasesema ati,

english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
translation: “Nomba umwine ibala lya myangashi nga abwela, bushe akesa bacita shani abo balimi?”

english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
translation: Bayasuka Yesu abati, “Abo bantu babi, umwine ibala akabonaula icabipisha. Akaseekesha ne bala lyakwe ku balimi bambi abakuti balemupeela ifisabo fyakwe pa nshita yakulobolola.”

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Bushe tamwatala amubelenga mu Malembo Yamushilo ayatila,

english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
translation: “Eico ndemweba nati, imwe bakamupoka Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bakabupeela na ku bantu abacita ubufwayo bwa Mfumu.

english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
translation: [Umuntu onse uukaponena pali ili libwe, akafunaika, na uo likaponena likamushonaula.]”

english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise, pakumfwa iyi milumbe, bailuka ukuti ebo alelandapo.

english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
translation: Balafwaya ukumwikata, nomba batiina amabumba ya bantu, pantu abantu bena baleti Yesu ni kasesema.

english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
translation: “Mwebe umwana mwanakashi Sioni amuti,

english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
translation: Awe abasambi baya citila ngomo Yesu abebele.

english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
translation: Baleta punda na kamwane. Elyo bayanshikapo insalu shabo na Yesu epo aikala.

english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
translation: Na bantu ibumba likalamba balayansa insalu shabo mu nshila. Elyo bambi bena balakontaula imisambo ya miti, balayansa mu nshila.

english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
translation: Saka 9:9

english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
translation: Yesu nakabili abalandile mu milumbe ati,

english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
translation: Awe abasha basalanganina mu misebo, balalonganya bonse ababi na basuma. Awe ne ŋanda ya bwinga yaisula abantu.

english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
translation: “Elyo imfumu yaisamo kukumona abalalikwe. Yaisa sangamo umuntu umo ushafwele insalu sha bwinga.

english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
translation: Elyo yamwipusha aiti, ‘Mune, nga wingile shani muno, ukwabula ukufwala insalu sha bwinga?’ Awe ena alifye tondolo.

english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
translation: Elyo imfumu yaeba ababomfi aiti, ‘Mukakeni amaboko na molu, mumupose panse mu mfifi, ukukalaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.’

english: For many are called, but few chosen.”
translation: Pantu abetwa bengi, lelo abasalwa banono.”

english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
translation: Elyo Abafalise baile kukupandana amano, pakuti bafwaye umwakumwikatila mu milandile yakwe.

english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
translation: Awe batuma abasambi babo na bena Herodi kuli Yesu. Bamweba abati, “Kafundisha, twalishiba ukuti uli mufumacumi, ufunda fyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya mu cishinka. Kabili tautiina muntu nelyo umo, pantu tawaba na kapatulula.

english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
translation: Kanshi twebeko ifyo iwe utontonkanya. Bushe calilinga ukulasonka umusonko kuli Kesalo nangu iyoo?”

english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
translation: Nomba Yesu ico eshibe imitontonkanishishe yabo ibi, abasuka ati, “Mwe mfundabuteshi mwe! Cinshi ico mulenjesesha?

english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
translation: Nangeni indalama mupeela ku musonko?” Awe nabo bamuletela imo.

english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
translation: “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu kuti twabupalanya ku mfumu iyacitile mwane imitebeto ya bwinga.

english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
translation: Elyo Yesu abepusha ati, “Ngoyu balengelepo nefi filembelwepo fyakwani?”

english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
translation: Nabo bayasuka abati, “Fyakwa Kesalo.” Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Eyo, kanshi akupeeleni Kesalo, ifyakwa Kesalo. Elyo akupeeleni Lesa, ifyakwa Lesa.”

english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
translation: Bati bomfwe ifi, awe balapapa. Kanshi epakumusha.

english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
translation: Ubushiku ubo bwine Abasaduki bamo baishile kuli Yesu. Abasaduki bena batila, “Takwaba kushukuka kwa bafwa.” Balaipusha Yesu abati,

english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
translation: “Kafundisha, Mose asosa ati, ‘Umuntu nga afwa, nomba tafyelepo abana, munyina ali nokuupa mukamfwilwa pakuti afyalileko munyina abana.’

english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
translation: Nomba kumwesu kwaliko bamunyina cine lubali, abaume beka beka. Umukalamba wabo ewabalilepo ukuupa, lelo afwa ukwabula ukufyalamo umwana. Epakushila munyina umukashi wakwe.

english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
translation: Uwabubili no wabutatu nabo bamuupa, nomba nabo lumo lwine, mpakafye bonse cine lubali bafwa ukwabula ukufyalamo abana.

english: After them all, the woman died.
translation: Elyo pakulekelesha nao umwanakashi asuka afwa.

english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
translation: Nomba pakushukuka kwa bafwa, bushe umwanakashi akaba umukashi wakwani pali aba bonse cine lubali aupilweko?”

english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Mwaliluba, pantu tamwaishiba Malembo Yamushilo, nangu amaka yakwa Lesa.

english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
translation: Awe yatuma abasha baiko ukuya eba abalalikwe ku bwinga. Nomba bakaana ukwisako.

english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
translation: Pantu ilyo abantu bakashukuka ku bafwa, tabakaleupa nangu ukulaupwa. Lelo bakaba nga bamalaika ba mu mulu.

english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
translation: Kabinge pa mulandu wakushukuka ku bafwa, bushe tamwabelenga ifyo Lesa umwine amweba ati,

english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
translation: ‘Nine Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki, Lesa wakwa Yakobo?’ Kanshi ni Lesa wa bomi, te Lesa wa bafwa iyoo.”

english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
translation: Ilyo amabumba yaumfwa ifi, yalapapa imifundile yakwe.

english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
translation: Ilyo Abafalise baumfwile ukuti Yesu aputula Abasaduki umulomo, nabo balilongene.

english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
translation: Elyo umunabo umo kafundisha wamafunde, alamwesha ati,

english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
translation: “Kafundisha ifunde ilyacilapo pa mafunde yonse ayakwa Lesa, lifunde nshi?”

english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “‘Uletemwa Imfumu Lesa obe no mutima obe onse, no mweo obe onse, na mano yobe yonse.’

english: This is the first and great commandment.
translation: Ili e funde ilyacila pali yonse, kabili elyakubalilapo.

english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
translation: Elyo ilyabubili ilyapalana neli line, lyakutila, ‘Uletemwa umubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.’

english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
translation: Elyo yatuma abasha bambi aiti, ‘Kebeni abalalikwe amuti, ala nimpekanya imitebeto yandi. Ninjipaya bacilume wa ŋombe ne ŋombe ishaina. Fyonse nafipekanishiwa, isenifye ku bwinga!’

english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
translation: Pali aya mafunde yabili, epashinta Amafunde yonse ayakwa Mose na fyonse ifyo bakasesema balembele.”

english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
translation: Ilyo acili na Bafalise abalongene, Yesu abepwishe ati, “Nga imwe mutontonkanya shani pali Kristu? Bushe mutila ni mwana ani?”

english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ni mwana Davidi.”

english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
translation: Yesu nao abeba ati, “Nga kanshi Davidi ilyo asanikilwe na Mupashi, amwitile shani ‘Imfumu?’ Ilyo atile ati,

english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?
translation: ‘Imfumu yaeba Imfumu yandi aiti,

english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
translation: Nga kanshi apo Davidi aita Kristu ati ni Mfumu, bushe Kristu kuti aba shani mwane?”

english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
translation: Awe tapali nangu umo uwakwasukapo. Ukufuma ubo bwine bushiku, tapali nangu umo uwakupama ukwipusha Yesu na fimbi.

english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
translation: Lelo abalalikwe ku bwinga tabasakamene. Umo aya ku mabala yakwe, umbi nao ku fya makwebo yakwe.

english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
translation: Bambi abalalikwe baikata abasha ba mfumu, balabacusha, babepaya.

english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
translation: Imfumu yafulwa nganshi. Yatumako ne fita fyaiko, fyaya ipaya filya fipondo, fyafyocela no musumba.

english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
translation: Elyo imfumu yaeba abasha baiko aiti, ‘Ubwinga nabupekanishiwa, lelo abalalikwe tabalingile.

english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
translation: Kanshi kabiyeni ku masansa ya misebo, bonse abo mulesanga mubete ku bwinga.’

english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
translation: Elyo Yesu aebele amabumba ya bantu na basambi bakwe ati,

english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
translation: Mwilaleka nelyo umo alemwita, ‘intungulushi,’ pantu mwakwatafye intungulushi imo, ni Kristu.

english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
translation: Umukalamba pali imwe bonse, afwile ukuba ewakutumika.

english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
translation: Pantu onse uuikusha, bakamucefya, no uicefya, bakamusansabalika.

english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Mwalisalila abantu pakuti beingila mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu. Mwe bene tamwingilamo, elyo mwalesha na bambi abalefwaya ukwingilamo.

english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
translation: [Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Muliila bamukamfwilwa ifyuma fyabo, kabili mwatemwa ukuilanga mukupepa amapepo ayatali. Mwandi Lesa akamukandisha ukucila!]

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Mupwa impanga ne mpanga, pali bemba na pa milundu, pakutifye munashe umo asumine mwipepo lyenu. Nomba ilyo asumina mwipepo lyenu, mulenga nokuti abipishepo no kucila, wakuyafye kukupya mu mulilo wa pe nga imwe!

english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe ntungulushi shapofula mwe! Mwe batila amuti, ‘Umuntu uwalapa ati, napali Tempele, ninshi tapali nelyo cimo. Lelo uwalapa ati, napali golide uwa mwi Tempele, wena ninshi ali nokufikilisha umulapo wakwe.’

english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
translation: Mwe mpelwamano mwe! Mwe mpofu mwe! Nga icacindamapo cinshi? Bushe ni golide, atemwa Litempele ililenga ukuti golide abe icintu catuulwa kuli Lesa?

english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
translation: Mwe mpofu mwe! Nga icacindamapo cinshi? Bushe mutuulo, atemwa bulambo bwakwa Lesa ubulenga ukuti umutuulo ube icintu catuulwa kuli Lesa?

english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
translation: “Bakafundisha bamafunde na Bafalise ebabuula amalo yakwa Mose.

english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
translation: Kanshi uwalapa ati, ‘Napali ubulambo bwakwa Lesa’, ninshi alapa ubulambo bwine na fyonse ifilipo.

english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
translation: Ilyo umuntu alapa ati, ‘Napali Itempele’, ninshi Litempele alapa, alapa na Lesa wine uwikalamo.

english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
translation: Kabili ilyo muntu alapa ati, ‘Napali umulu,’ ninshi alapa icipuna cakwa Lesa, alapa na Lesa wine uwikalapo.

english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe, mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Mwe batuula Lesa cimo pekumi lyonse, na pa misalufye iyakuwamya ifyakulya. Lelo mwalisuula ukukonka amafunde ayakalamba mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, ayali ngo mulinganya, uluse ne cishinka. Aya e mafunde mwaba nokukonka, elyo na yambi yene tamuli nakuyasuulako.

english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
translation: Mwe ntungulushi shapofula mwe! Mufwisa akashishi, lelo mucibula ingamila!

english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Muwamya inkombo ne mbale kunse, lelo mukati mwaisulafye ubulili no bukakashi.

english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
translation: We mpofu ya Mufalise we! Shitala wamya mukati ka lukombo ne mbale, elyo lyena na kunse kulewama.

english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Mwaba nge nindi bashingulako impemba, kunse shimoneka ishayemba, lelo mukati mwaisulamo amafupa ya bafwa, na fimbi fyonse ifyakowela.

english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
translation: Kanshi na imwe kunse mumoneka ku bantu, nga bantu abololoke, lelo mukati mwaisulamo ubufi no bubi bonse.

english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
translation: “Mukacimona, mwe bakafundisha bamafunde, na imwe mwe Bafalise, mwe mfundabuteshi! Mukuulilila inindi sha bakasesema no kuwaminisha inindi sha bantu abololoke.

english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
translation: Eico kanshi mulekonka no kucita fyonse ifyo balemweba. Nomba mwilabapashanya mu micitile yabo, pantu tabakonka ifyo bafunda.

english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
translation: Levi 27:30

english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
translation: Kanshi mwaliishinina ukuti, muli bana ba fipondo fyaipeye bakasesema!

english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
translation: Aleni kanshi, konkanyenipo mupwishishe umulimo ifikolwe fyenu fyatampile.

english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
translation: Mwe nsoka mwe, mwe bana ba nsoka mwe! Nga muleti mukapusuka shani ku bupingushi bwakuposwa mu mulilo wape?

english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
translation: Eico na ine nakulamutumina bakasesema na bamano na bakafundisha bamafunde. Pali aba bamo mwakulabepaya no kubatanika. Bambi bena mwakulaboma ifikoti mu masinagoga no kulabasapika muli uyu musumba na muli uyu.

english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
translation: Epakuti mukaponenwe ne shamo lyakusumya umulopa wa bakaele mwaipaya pano isonde. Ukufuma pa mfwa ya wakaele Abeli, ukufika na ku mfwa yakwa Sakaria mwana Balakiya, uo mwaipeye mwi Tempele lubali lwa pantanshi ya bulambo bwakwa Lesa.

english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, fyonse ifi fikaponena pa bantu ba ino nkulo.

english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
translation: “Yerusalemu, we Yerusalemu, we wipaya bakasesema no kwipaya ku mabwe inkombe Lesa akutumina! Yangu imiku ubwingi iyo nalefwaya ukulonganya bamwano, nga filya nankoko afukatila tumwane mu mapindo, nomba tawalefwaya.

english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
translation: Mona, iŋanda yobe ikakushalila icipompa!

english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
translation: Lelo ndekweba nati, ine tawakamone nakabili, mpaka ilyo ukasosa auti, ‘Napaalwe uyu waisa uo Imfumu yatuma.’ ”

english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
translation: Bakaka ifipe ifyafinisha, batwika na bantu ukusenda pa mabeya yabo. Nomba abene teti batenshemo nelyo panono.

english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
translation: Ifintu fyonse ifyo bacita, baficitafye pakuti abantu babatambe. Bena pakulanga ukunakila Lesa, mulya bakakila utupande tumo utwa Malembo Yamushilo, uto bakakila pa mpumi na pa maboko, balafikusha nganshi. Elyo ne nsenkebele sha nsalu shabo nasho bashilefya lefyafye.

english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
translation: Batemwa ifipuna ifyamucinshi pa malila, elyo ne ficindamishepo mu masinagoga.

english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
translation: Kabili batemwa ukuti abantu balebaposha mu mansa sha fisankano balebeta nokuti, ‘Bakafundisha.’

english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
translation: Nomba imwe, mwilaleka abantu balemwita kafundisha, pantu mwakwatafye kafundisha umo, ico imwe bonse muli bwananyina.

english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
translation: Ukuf 13:9

english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
translation: Yesu afumine mwi Tempele. Cilya aleya, abasambi bakwe bapalama, balefwaya ukuti amone ifyo Itempele lyakuulwa.

english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
translation: Elyo abengi bakasuula ku cisumino cabo. Abantu bakapatana no kulabepeshanya pakuposa umubiye.

english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
translation: Elyo kukesa bakasesema babufi abengi, bakalabepaika abengi.

english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
translation: Ico ububi bukafulisha, eico ne citemwiko cakutemwana cikacepa.

english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
translation: Lelo uukashipikisha mpaka na ku mpela, eukapusuka.

english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
translation: Kabili iyi Mbila Nsuma ya Bufumu ikatala ikabilwa pano isonde ponse, pakuti ipeele bukambone bwakushinina abantu ba mishobo yonse, elyo no kupwa kwa calo kukesa.

english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
translation: “Kanshi ilyo mukamona umupamba wabonaushi uo kasesema Daniele alandapo uli mwi Tempele, ‘uulebelenga naeluke’,

english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
translation: elyo abakaba mu Yudeya bakafulumukile ku mpili.

english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
translation: Uukaba pa mutenge wa ŋanda yakwe, ekeka kukuya buula ifintu fyakwe mu ŋanda.

english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
translation: Uukaba mwibala, ekabwela kukubuula insalu shakwe.

english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
translation: We shamo we ku banakashi abakaba pabukulu, na bakalaonsha abana muli shilya nshiku!

english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
translation: Yesu ena abeba ati, “Bushe nifi fikuulwa mulemona? Ndemweba icine cine, tapakashale libwe pa mulu wa libwe libiye. Yakabongololwafye yonse.”

english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,
translation: Mulelomba Lesa ukuti mwikafulumuka mu nshita yampepo, nangu pa bushiku bwe Sabata.

english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
translation: Pantu ukufumafye apo Lesa abumbile isonde ukufika na pali nomba, tapatala apaba, kabili takwakatale akuba ubucushi ubwabipisha ngobo.

english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
translation: Kabili Lesa akaanacefyako isho nshiku, nga tekuti kube umuntu nangu umo uwingapusuka. Lelo pa mulandu wa basalwa bakwe, isho nshiku Lesa alishicefyako.

english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.
translation: “Eico kanshi, umo nga amweba ati, ‘Moneni Kristu uyu ali kuno!’ nangu ‘Ulya ali kulya!’ mwikasumina.

english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
translation: Pantu kukamoneka ba Kristu babufi na bakasesema babufi. Bakalacita ifishibilo ne finjelengwe, ifyakuti bengabepaikilako na basalwa bene nga cingacitika.

english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
translation: Kanshi imwe namusokako libela.

english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
translation: “Eico nga bamweba abati, ‘Ala Kristu ulya mu matololo!’ mwikayako. Nangu nga batila, ‘Ala Kristu ulya ali mukati ka ŋanda!’ Mwikasumina.

english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
translation: Dan 9:27

english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
translation: “Uko konse ukuba icitumbi, eko na makubi yalongana.

english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
translation: “Ubucushi bwa nshiku shilya bukatila nga bwapita, apopene akasuba kakafiita, umweshi nao ukaleka ukubalika. Intanda nasho shikapona ku mulu na maka ya ku mulu yakatenkana.

english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
translation: Kabili cilya Yesu ekele pa lupili lwa Miolifa, abasambi balamwipusha ilyo bali nankwe beka, abati, “Twebeko, bushe ifi fintu fikabako lilali? Nga cishibilo nshi cikalanga ilyo ukesa nokuti icalo calapwa?”

english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
translation: Elyo ku mulu kukamoneka icakwishibilako Umwana wa muntu, na bantu ba pano calo bakaililila ubulanda. Elyo bakamona Umwana wa muntu uko aleisa mu makumbi na maka no bucindami nganshi.

english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
translation: “Kanshi ku mukunyu eko musambilile. Imisambo yauko itila nga yapuka ululembelya, ninshi mwaishiba ukuti amainsa yali mupepi.

english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.
translation: Eifyo fine na imwe nga mwamona ifi fintu fyonse fyalacitika, ninshi mukeshibe ukuti Kristu ali mupepi, alifye pa mwinshi.

english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine ukuti, ino nkulo tayakapite, ninshi ifi fintu fyonse fyalicitika.

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
translation: Umulu ne calo fikapita, lelo amashiwi yandi yena tayakapite iyoo.”

english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
translation: “Lelo tapaba uwaishiba ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika, nangu ni nshita ine. Bamalaika ba mu mulu tabaishiba, nangufye Umwana taishiba, kanofye Tata eka ewaishiba.

english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
translation: Kanshi nga filya cali mu nshiku shakwa Noa, efyo cikaba nelyo Umwana wa muntu akesa.

english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
translation: Ilyo ilyeshi talilati lise, abantu balelya no kunwa balenwa, baleupa no kuupwa, mpaka no kufikafye ku bushiku Noa aingile mu cibwato.

english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
translation: Abantu tabaenekele nelyo cimo mpaka ilyeshi lyaisa balofya bonse. Ifyo fine efyo cikaba na pa nshita ya kwisa kwa Mwana wa muntu.

english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
translation: Yesu epakubasuka ati, “Mulecenjela, pakuti umuntu nangu umo ekamubepaika.

english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
translation: Abaume babili bakaba mwibala, umo akasendwapo, umubiye akashala.

english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
translation: Abanakashi babili bakalapela ku libwe, umo akasendwapo, umubiye akashala.

english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
translation: Kanshi mulelola, pantu tamwaishiba ubushiku Imfumu yenu ikeshilapo.

english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
translation: Cena ici muli nokushininkisha ukuti, umwine ŋanda nga cakuti aishiba inshita ya bushiku ilyo umupupu aleishilapo, ala kuti alalola, tekuti aleke umupupu amwingilile ebe mu ŋanda yakwe.

english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
translation: Eico na imwe kanshi muli nokuba abaiteyanya, pantu Umwana wa muntu akesa pa nshita mushenekele.

english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
translation: “Bushe ali kwi umusha wacishinka, kabili uwamano, uwakuti shikulu wakwe amupeela ukwangalila abanankwe, alebapeela icakulya pa nshita iyilingile?

english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
translation: Alishuka uyu musha, uo shikulu wakwe akasanga alebombela umo mwine.

english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, shikulu wakwe akamucita kangalila wa fyuma fyakwe fyonse.

english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
translation: Lelo umusha umuwelewele, ena nga atila ati, ‘Shikulu akokola ukubwela,’

english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
translation: elyo atendeka ukulapuma abasha banankwe no kulalya no kunwa na bacakolwa.

english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
translation: Pantu abengi bakesa balesosa abati, ‘Nine Kristu’ kabili bakabepa abengi.

english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
translation: Ala shikulu wa uyu musha akesa pa bushiku ashenekele, pa nshita ashishibe.

english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
translation: Shikulu wakwe akamukanda, akamuposa uko akaya cimona pamo ne mfundabuteshi. Ekukaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.

english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
translation: Elyo mukalaumfwa inkondo ne ntulubundi sha nkondo, mwikasakamikwa. Ala ifi fintu fili nokucitika, lelo ukupwa kwa calo ninshi takulati.

english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
translation: Pantu umushobo umo ukemina umushobo ubiye, elyo ne mfumu imo ikemina imfumu ibiye. Kukaba ifipowe ne finkunkuma mu ncende ishalekana lekana.

english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
translation: Ifi fyonse fikabafye e citendekelo ca macushi.

english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
translation: Kabili bakamutwala ku bakumucusha no kumwipaya. Elyo ne mishobo yonse ikamupata pa mulandu wa ine.

english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
translation: “Ubufumu bwa mu mulu kuti twabupashanya ku bakashana ikumi limo. Batile bashibuula ifisaniko fyabo, baya balekonkela shibwinga.

english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
translation: Ilyo abakashana impelwamano baleya kukushita, awe na shibwinga ashala afika. Elyo abakashana bamano abaipekenye epakwingila pamo na shibwinga mu ŋanda ya bwinga. Awe ne ciibi baisalako.

english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
translation: “Elyo panuma abakashana balya bambi nabo baisa. Balasosa abati, ‘Mukwai! Mukwai! Shitwiswileniko!’

english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
translation: Nao shibwinga abasuka ati, ‘Cine cine ndemweba, imwe nshimwishibe.’

english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
translation: Kanshi muleikala abaibukila, pantu tamwaishiba ubushiku nangu inshita.”

english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
translation: Kabili Yesu alabeba ati, “Kanshi caba ngo muntu uuleya pa bulendo, atala aita abasha bakwe, abaseekesha ne fyuma fyakwe fyonse.

english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
translation: Umo amupeela indalama amakana yasano, umbi amakana yabili, umbi nao amupeela ikana limo. Abapeela ukulingana na maka yabo. Epakwima aya na pa bulendo.

english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
translation: Umuntu uwapokele indalama amakana yasano, alashibomfya apopene, amwenapo na shimbi amakana yasano.

english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
translation: Elyo uwapokele indalama amakana yabili, nao acita ifyo fine, amwenapo na shimbi amakana yabili.

english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
translation: Nomba uwapokele indalama ikana limo, wena aimba icilindi mu mushili, emo afisa indalama shakwa shikulu wakwe.

english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
translation: “Elyo pa nshita ntali shikulu wa abo basha asuka abwela. Aita na basha bakwe ukuti balondolole ifyo babomfya icuma cakwe.

english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
translation: Kanshi aba basano ni mpelwamano, elyo basano nabo bena bamano.

english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
translation: Uwapokele indalama amakana yasano aisa, aletelapo na shimbi amakana yasano. Asosa ati, ‘Shikulu, mwanseekeshe indalama amakana yasano, moneni nimwenapo na shimbi amakana yasano.’

english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
translation: Shikulu wakwe amweba ati, ‘Eya mwandi mwabombeni, we musha musuma, kabili uwacishinka! Walanga pa fintu ifinono ukuti uli wacishinka, na ine nalakupa ukwangalila ifingi. Kanshi isa wingile mulesansamuka pamo na sokulu.’

english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
translation: Elyo uwapokele indalama amakana yabili nao aisa. Alasosa ati, ‘Shikulu, ine mwanseekeshe indalama amakana yabili, moneni nimwenapo na shimbi amakana yabili.’

english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
translation: Shikulu wakwe amweba ati, ‘Eya mwandi, mwabombeni, we musha musuma kabili uwacishinka! Walanga pa fintu ifinono ukuti uli wacishinka, na ine nalakupa ukwangalila ifingi. Kanshi isa wingile mulesansamuka pamo na sokulu.’

english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
translation: Elyo paisa no wapokele indalama ikana limo. Alasosa ati, ‘Shikulu, iwe nalikwishiba ukuti uli muntu uwayafya, useepa noko ushatanda, ututila ne fisabo ushabyala.

english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
translation: Kanshi eco natiinine, epakufisa indalama shobe mu mushili! Ala icuma cobe ici, buula.’

english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
translation: Lelo Shikulu wakwe ena amwasuka ati, ‘We musha mubi we! Bushe iwe niwe waishiba ukuti nseepa uko nshatanda, kabili ntutila ne fisabo nshabyala?

english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
translation: Shikanshi nga wabikile indalama kulya babikisha indalama, pakuti ilyo nabwela naisa fumyako na kambikilapo.

english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
translation: Kanshi mupokeni indalama, mupeele uyo akwete indalama amakana ikumi limo.

english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
translation: Pantu umuntu onse uwakwata, akapeelelwapo na fimbi, pakuti akwate ifingi. Lelo uushakwata, bakamupoka noto akwata.

english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
translation: Abakashana impelwamano bena basenda ifisaniko fyabo, ukwabula ukusenda amafuta.

english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
translation: Nomba ici cinangwa camusha ciposeni kunse mu mfifi emwakulaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.’

english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
translation: “Ilyo Umwana wa muntu akesa no bucindami bwakwe, ali na bamalaika bakwe bonse, elyo akekala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu.

english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
translation: Elyo bakalonganika abantu ba mishobo yonse pantu ali. Elyo akalapatulula abantu nga filya kacema apatulula impaanga pakushifumya ku mbushi.

english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
translation: Akabika impaanga ku kulyo, imbushi shena ku kuso.

english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
translation: Elyo Imfumu ikeba abali ku kulyo aiti, ‘Iseni imwe, mwebo Tata asenamina! Iseni mukwate ubufumu ubo Tata amuteyanishisha ukufumafye apo isonde lyatendekele.

english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
translation: Pantu ilyo nali ne nsala, imwe mwalimpeeleko icakulya. Ilyo nali ne cilaka, imwe mwalimpeeleko amenshi yakunwa. Ilyo nali umweni, imwe mwalimpokelele.

english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’
translation: Ilyo nshakwete cakufwala, imwe mwalimpeele icakufwala. Ilyo nali umulwele, mwalimpempwile, nelyo nali mu cifungo mwalishile kukumona.’

english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?
translation: Elyo abantu abololoke bakamwasuka abati, ‘We Mfumu, nga ni lilali twakumwene uli ne nsala, twakupeela icakulya, nangu ilyo wali ne cilaka, twakupeela amenshi yakunwa?

english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?
translation: Ni lilali twakumwene umweni, twakupokelela, nangu ilyo ushakwete cakufwala, na ifwe twakupeela icakufwala?

english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’
translation: Ni lilali wali umulwele, nangu mu cifungo, na ifwe twaisa kupempula?’

english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
translation: Abamano bena basenda ifisaniko fyabo, na mafuta mu misashi yabo.

english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
translation: Imfumu elyo ikabasuka aiti, ‘Ndemweba icine cine, ukuti lyonse ilyo mwakumbuswike munyinane umo, nangu engacepa shani, ninshi nine wine mwakumbuswike.’

english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
translation: “Elyo Imfumu ikeba abali ku kuso aiti, ‘Fumeni apa, mwebalapishiwa! Kabiyeni ku mulilo wape, uo bapekanishisha Ciwa ne fiwa finankwe!

english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
translation: Pantu nali ne nsala, imwe tamwampeeleko icakulya. Nali ne cilaka, imwe tamwampeeleko amenshi yakunwa.

english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
translation: Ilyo nali umweni, imwe tamwampokelele. Ilyo nshakwete cakufwala, imwe tamwampeele cakufwala. Nali umulwele, nali na mu cifungo, imwe tamwampempwile.’

english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
translation: Elyo nabo bakasuka abati, ‘We Mfumu nga ni lilali twakumwene uli ne nsala, nangu uli ne cilaka, nangu umweni, nangu taukwete na cakufwala, nangu umulwele, nangu mu cifungo, na ifwe twakaana ukukwafwa?’

english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
translation: Imfumu ikabasuka ati, ‘Ndemweba icine cine, lyonse ilyo mwakeene ukwafwilisha umo pali aba nangu engacepesha shani, ninshi nine mwakeene ukwafwa.’

english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
translation: Elyo aba bakaya kukucula kwape, abololoke bena bakaya ku mweo wape.”

english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
translation: Nomba ico shibwinga akokola ukwisa, awe balashipula bonse, basuka bapona mu tulo.

english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
translation: “Nomba ubushiku pakati baumfwa utupundu ukuti, ‘Shibwinga uyo aisa, kamusengeleni.’

english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
translation: Elyo abakashana bonse babuuka balayasha ne fisaniko fyabo.

english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
translation: Abakashana impelwamano balaeba abamano abati, ‘Tupeniko amafuta, pantu ifwe ifisaniko fyesu fyalashima.’

english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
translation: Abamano babasuka abati, ‘Awe, tayakumane bonse ifwe na imwe. Kabiyenifye ku bashitisha amafuta, eko muyeishitila.’

english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwile ukulanda fyonse ifi, elyo aebele abasambi bakwe ati,

english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.
translation: Yesu ena ico eshibe ifyo balelanda, abeba ati, “Nga cinshi mwalasakamikila uyu mwanakashi? Ala namombela umulimo uusuma nganshi.

english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.
translation: Abalanda bena mwakulaba nabo lyonse, lelo ine tatwakabe na imwe lyonse.

english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi pakukonkomwena amafuta pa mubili wandi, ala alepekanya ukushiikwa kwandi.

english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, konse uko bakalashimika Imbila Nsuma pano isonde ponse, bakalashimika ne fyacita uyu mwanakashi pakumwibukisha.”

english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
translation: Elyo umo pa basole ikumi limo na babili, uo baleita Yuda wa ku Kelyoti, aimine aile kuli bashimapepo bacindami.

english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
translation: Alabepusha ati, “Bushe mukampeela nshi nga cakuti namuletela Yesu pakuti mumwikate?” Nabo epakumupendela indalama sha silifa amakumi yatatu (30), bamupeela.

english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
translation: Awe ukufuma palya pene Yuda alafwailishafye inshita ingalinga ukumuposelapo.

english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
translation: Pa bushiku bwakubalilapo ubwakulyamo Imikate Iyishatutumuka, abasambi baishile kuli Yesu bamwipusha abati, “Bushe ni kwi ulefwaya tuye tukupekanishishe ukwakulila Ipasaka ?”

english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Kabiyeni kuli kampanda ulya mu musumba. Mumwebe amuti, ‘Kafundisha atila, inshita yandi naipalama. Ni kumobe eko ndeliila Ipasaka, pamo na basambi bandi.’ ”

english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
translation: Awe abasambi bacita fyonse ngomo Yesu abebele, bapekanya ne Pasaka.

english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
translation: “Namwishiba ukuti kwashalafye inshiku shibili, ninshi twaingila mu nshikunkulu ye Pasaka. Elyo Umwana wa muntu bakamuposa pakuti bamutanike.”

english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
translation: Cilya kwaba icungulo, Yesu na basole ikumi limo na babili baandama pakulya.

english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
translation: Ilyo bacili pakulya, Yesu asosa ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, umo pali imwe alamposa ku balwani.”

english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
translation: Nabo baikatwa no bulanda, balaipusha Yesu umo umo abati, “Ndesubila teine we Mfumu?”

english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
translation: Yesu ayasuka ati, “Uo nalatumpika nankwe pamo iminwe mu mbale, eulemposa.

english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
translation: Ukuba kwena Umwana wa muntu alaya kukufwa, ngomo calembelwa. Lelo umuntu uwalaposa Umwana wa muntu, ena alishama. Uyu muntu akaanafyalwa nga kuti camuwamina.”

english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
translation: Yuda uwali nokumuposa nao aipusha ati, “Kwena teine we Kafundisha?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Eya, wailandila we mwine.”

english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
translation: Ilyo bali pakulya, Yesu abuulile umukate, atashishe Lesa, aumokawile, apeele na basambi bakwe ati, “Buuleni mulye. Uyu mubili wandi.”

english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
translation: Elyo abuula ulukombo, atasha Lesa, abapeela ati, “Nwenimo bonse.

english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
translation: Pantu uyu mulopa wandi uwa cipangano, uulesuumina pa bengi kukubafumisha ifyabubifi fyabo.

english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
translation: Ndemweba nshakanwe nakabili ifya ku fisabo fya myangashi, mpaka no bushiku bulya ilyo nkanwa na imwe umwangashi upya mu Bufumu bwakwa Tata.”

english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.
translation: Kanshi bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba ba bantu baya longana kwisano kwa Shimapepo mukalamba, uo baleti Kayafa.

english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
translation: Elyo cilya bapwa ukwimba ulwimbo, bafumamo baya na ku lupili lwa Miolifa.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
translation: Kabili Yesu elyo abebele ati, “Muli buno bushiku, imwe bonse mulembutuka. Pantu calembwa ukuti, ‘Nkakoma kacema no mukuni wa mpaanga ukapashika.’

english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
translation: Nomba ilyo nkabuuka ku bafwa nkamutangilila ku Galile.”

english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
translation: Elyo Petelo ayankula ati, “Nangufye bonse balekubutuka, awe ine iyoo nshakubutuke.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Ndekweba icine cine, lelo line buno bwine bushiku ilyo mukolwe talalila, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.”

english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
translation: Petelo nao amwasuka ati, “Ine nshakukaane nakalya, nga kufwa tulefwa nobe.” Na basambi bambi bonse nabo balasosafye cimo cine.

english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
translation: Elyo Yesu aile na basambi bakwe ku ncende iyo beta, Getisemani. Abebele ati, “Ikaleni pano, natala naya kulya kukupepa.”

english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
translation: Asendapo Petelo na bamwana Sebede babili, aya nabo. Elyo atampa ukumoneka uwasakamikwa, kabili uwabulanda.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
translation: Elyo aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Ine umutima wandi waikatwa no bulanda ni cikangafye mfwe. Shaleni pano, mulelola pamo na ine.”

english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
translation: Awe ati endeleleko cinono akatalamukila, awa panshi ubukupeme. Alapepa ati, “Tata wandi, mpokololako kuli ubu bucushi, nga nacilinga. Lelo ifyo ine ndefwaya tefyo, kano ifyo iwe ulefwaya.”

english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.
translation: Balaumfwana pafyo bengekata Yesu mu bucenjeshi no kumwipaya.

english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
translation: Kabinge abwelela ku basambi bakwe, asanga bali mu tulo. Elyo aeba Petelo ati, “Yangu mwe bantu mwe, bushe mwafilwafye ukulola na ine insa imofye?

english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
translation: Mulelola, no kupepa mulepepa, epakukanawila mu ntunko. Umutima wena ulefwaya, lelo umubili wena naunakuka.”

english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
translation: Kabili Yesu abwelelamo kukupepa umuku wabubili. Alapepa ati, “Tata wandi, nga cakuti teti umpokololeko kuli ubu bucushi, kanofye ncule, cisuma cita ico ulefwaya.”

english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
translation: Nakabili abwelela ku basambi, asanga bali mu tulo, pantu amenso yabo nayekatwa ku tulo.

english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
translation: Nakabili Yesu abasha aya kukupepa umuku wabutatu, alasosafye amashiwi yamo yene.

english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
translation: Elyo abwelela ku basambi, abeba ati, “Bushe kanshi na nomba mucili mu tulo, muletuusha? Moneni nomba inshita yapalama, ilyo Umwana wa muntu alaposwa mu minwe ya bantu babi.

english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
translation: Imeni, natuleya, uwakumposa alafika.”

english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alelanda, Yuda, umo uwa pa basole ikumi limo na babili, alifikile. Ali ne bumba lya bantu ilikalamba, nabaipangasha impaanga ne nkonto, bafuma kuli bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba ba bantu.

english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
translation: Uwakuposa Yesu wena, ninshi nabapeela icishibilo ati, “Uo nalaya tomona pakumuposha, euyo wine, mumwikate.”

english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
translation: Apopene cilya Yuda afika, alungama kuli Yesu, asosa ati, “Mwapoleni Kafundisha!” Elyo amutomona.

english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
translation: Balasosa abati, “Awe mu nshikunkulu mwena temo, epali kwaisa buuka icimfulunganya mu bantu.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Mune ale cita ico wishiile!” Awe abantu Yuda ali nabo bapalama, bafukukila na Yesu, bamwikata.

english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
translation: Elyo umo pa bali na Yesu, asomona ulupanga, akoma umusha wakwa Shimapepo mukalamba, amusempako ukutwi.

english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
translation: Yesu wena amweba ati, “Bwesesha ulupanga lobe mu citubo, pantu bonse ababomfya ulupanga, ni ku lupanga bakafwa.

english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
translation: Bushe iwe uleti tekuti nombe Tata angafweko? Ala kuti apopene atuma imilalo ya bamalaika ukucila amabumba ikumi limo na yabili.

english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
translation: Nga kanshi ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ukuti fili nokucitika, kuti fyafikilishiwa shani?”

english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
translation: Elyo pa nshita ine iyo, Yesu alaeba ibumba ati, “Bushe ine ndi cipondo pakuti mwise ne mpanga ne nkonto kukunjikata? Inshiku shonse naleikala mwi Tempele ndefunda, nokuti munjikate iyoo.

english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
translation: Lelo ifi fyonse fyalacitika, epakuti ifyalemba bakasesema fifikilishiwe.” Elyo abasambi bamusha eka, bafulumuka.

english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
translation: Abaikete Yesu epakumutwala kuli Kayafa, Shimapepo mukalamba, ukwalongene bakafundisha bamafunde na bakalamba.

english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
translation: Petelo wena alekonka lutonuma, asuka afika na mu lubansa lwe sano lyakwa Shimapepo mukalamba. Aingila mukati, aikala na pali ifita fye Tempele, pakuti amone uko umulandu ulepelela.

english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami bonse na bashicilye bene bonse balafwailisha bukambone bwabufi, pakuti bapingwilepo Yesu ukufwa.

english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
translation: Yesu ali mu Betani mu ŋanda yakwa Simoni Wafibashi.

english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
translation: Lelo bafilililwafye, nangu kwaishile bakambone babufi abengi. Awe kwasuka kwaisa bakambone babili.

english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
translation: Balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu aletila, nalikwata amaka yakubongolole Tempele, kabili kuti nalikuula pa nshiku shitatu.”

english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
translation: Shimapepo mukalamba elyo aiminina, aipusha Yesu ati, “Tauleyasuka nelyo cimo? Ngeyi milandu yonse aba bantu balekwebelela?”

english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
