translation: Nomba Yesu ena aikalafye tondolo. Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba aeba Yesu ati, “Nakweba na pali Lesa wamweo, twebe nga niwe Kristu Umwana wakwa Lesa.”

english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ee, nausosa. Kabili ndemweba ukuti, ukufuma pali nomba mukamona Umwana wa muntu naikala lwa ku kulyo kwa Mwine wa maka yonse. Elyo mukamona noko aleisa pa makumbi ya mu mulu!”

english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
translation: Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba alepula insalu shakwe, ati nokuti, “Asaalula Lesa! Bushe cinshi tulefwaila bakambone na bambi? Mwayumfwila mwe bene ifyo asaalula Lesa.

english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
translation: Bushe imwe muletipo shani?” Bayasuka abati, “Alingilefye ukufwa.”

english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
translation: Elyo balasaka Yesu amate pa menso, balemuma ne fimfunshi.

english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
translation: Bambi balamutoba amapi baleti, “Kristu, sesema, nani wakuma?”

english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
translation: Kanshi Petelo ena aikele panse pa lubansa, elyo umukashana umubomfi aishile apo ali. Amweba ati, “Na iwe waciba na Yesu umwina Galile.”

english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.
translation: Ilyo ali pakulya, mwaisa umwanakashi nasenda ibotolo umwali amafuta aya cena cisuma, aya mutengo ukalamba nganshi. Uyu mwanakashi akonkomwena na mafuta pa mutwe wakwa Yesu.

english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
translation: Awe Petelo akaana pa menso ya bantu bonse ati, “Ine nshishibe ico ulelandapo.”

english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
translation: Elyo Petelo afuma mu lubansa aya ku mpongolo. Umukashana umubomfi umbi amumona, alaeba na bantu abalipo ati, “Uyu muntu nao baciba na Yesu umwina Nasaleti.”

english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
translation: Awe nakabili Petelo akaana, alapa no kulapa ati, “Ine nshimwishibe uyo muntu.”

english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
translation: Cilya papita akashita, abemininepo bapalama apali Petelo, balamweba abati, “Cine cine uli munabo, pantu ne milandile yobe ine nayo ya bena Galile.”

english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
translation: Elyo Petelo atampa ukulaitipwila, alapa no kulapa ati, “Ine uyo muntu nshimwishibe iyoo!” Awe apopene na mukolwe alila no kulila.

english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
translation: Elyo Petelo aibukisha ifyo Yesu acimweba ati, “Ilyo mukolwe talalila, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.” Elyo afumina panse alila nganshi.

english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
translation: Abasambi bati bamone ifi, bafulwa, balasosa abati, “Ngobu bonaushi bwalola mwi?

english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”
translation: Aya mafuta nga kuti bashitisha pa ndalama ishingi nganshi, elyo bashipeela na ku balanda.”

english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
translation: Ilyo bwaca, bashimapepo bacindami bonse na bakalamba ba bantu batekele icilye, bapingushenye ukuti Yesu ali nokufwa.

english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
translation: Elyo bashitamo ibala lyakwa kabumba wa nongo, ngomo Imfumu yanjebele.”

english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
translation: Elyo baletele Yesu ku mulashi. Umulashi amwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe niwe mfumu ya Bayuda?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nausosa.”

english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
translation: Nomba ilyo bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba balamwebelela ifintu, awe Yesu wena tewakwasukapo kantu.

english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
translation: Elyo Pilato aipusha Yesu ati, “Bushe tauleumfwa ifintu bwingi balekwebelela?” Lelo Yesu wena no kwasuka nakalya.

english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
translation: Awe umulashi asunguka nganshi, pakumona ukuti Yesu taswikepo nelyo cimo pa fintu balemwebelela.

english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.
translation: Nomba cila nshikunkulu ya Cakucilila iye Pasaka, lyonse umulashi abelele ukubakakwilapo umufungwa umo, uo abantu balefwaya.

english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
translation: Kanshi pali iyo nshita kwaliko umufungwa umo ishina lyakwe Balaba uwaishibikwe nganshi kuli buntalamisoka.

english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
translation: Ilyo abantu balongana, Pilato alabepusha ati, “Bushe nani uo mulefwaya ukuti mukakwile, Balaba nangu Yesu uo batila Kristu?”

english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
translation: Pantu Pilato alishibe ukuti, ni ku mufimbilafye bamuletele Yesu.

english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
translation: Nomba ilyo Pilato ekele pa cipuna cakupingwilapo imilandu, umukashi amutumina amashiwi yakumweba ati, “Wiibika mu mulandu wa uyo muntu wakaele. Pantu lelo ubushiku mu ciloto nacicula nganshi pa mulandu wakwe.”

english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
translation: Awe bamukaka, bamusenda, bamutwala na ku mulashi Pilato.

english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
translation: Lelo bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba bena balasokawila ibumba lya bantu ukuti babakakwile Balaba, Yesu ena bamwipaye.

english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
translation: Umulashi abepusha ati, “Pali aba babili, bushe nani mulefwaya ukuti mukakwilepo?” Bayasuka abati, “Ni Balaba!”

english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
translation: Pilato abepusha ati, “Nga kanshi ndecita shani Yesu uo batila Kristu?” Bonse bayasuka abati, “Mutanikenifye!”

english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
translation: Pilato nao ati, “Nga kanshi cinshi ico abifya?” Nabo elyo bacishamo ukupunda abati, “Mutanikenifye!”

english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
translation: Pilato ashimona ukuti aleicushafye, kabili limbi palabuuka impasase, abuula amenshi, alasamba iminwe pa cinso ce bumba. Asosa ati, “Ine nshilimo mu mfwa ya uyu muntu! Mulandu wenu mwe bene!”

english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”
translation: Elyo abantu bonse bayasuka abati, “Ee, umulandu wa mfwa yakwe ube pali ifwe na pa bana besu!”

english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
translation: Elyo Pilato abakakwila Balaba. Abeba no kuma Yesu ifikoti, elyo abalubwila ukuti baye mutanika.

english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
translation: Elyo ifita fya mulashi fyatwele Yesu mukati ka lubansa lwa kwisano. Fyalonganike ne mpuka yonse ya fita, fyamushinguluka.

english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
translation: Fyamufula insalu shakwe, fyamufwika no mwingila uwakashika.

english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
translation: Elyo fyalema iŋana ya myunga, fyamufwika ku mutwe. Kabili fyamufumbatika itete ku kulyo. Elyo fyalamufukamina, fyalamupumya, fileti, “Tupole mulopwe, we mfumu ya Bayuda!”

english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
translation: Elyo Yuda uwaposele Yesu, ati amone ukuti bamupingwila ukufwa, alalanguluka. Abwesesha bashimapepo bacindami na bakalamba indalama sha silifa amakumi yatatu (30).

english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
translation: Kabinge fyalamusaka amate, elyo fyabuula itete fyalamufupaula ku mutwe.

english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
translation: Cilya fyaleka ukumupumya, fyamufula insalu yakashika, fyamufwika ne nsalu shakwe. Elyo fyamusenda, fyamutwala na kukumutanika.

english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
translation: Ilyo baleya, mu nshila bakumenye umuntu umwina Kurene, ishina lyakwe ni Simoni, eo bapatikishe ukuti asendeleko Yesu umusalaba.

english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
translation: Elyo basuka bafika na pa ncende iyo beta Gologota, emukutila, “Pa cipanga.”

english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
translation: Elyo bapeela Yesu umwangashi uo basanshishemo indusha ukuti anwe, lelo ati amyangeko, akaana ukunwa.

english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
translation: Cilya bamutanika, elyo balapendula pakwakana ifyakufwala fyakwe.

english: and they sat and watched him there.
translation: Elyo baikala panshi kulya kwine, balamulinda.

english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
translation: Lwa pa mulu wa mutwe wakwe ku cimuti ca musalaba, babikapo icalembwapo umulandu balemwipailapo ukuti, “Uyu ni Yesu Imfumu ya Bayuda.”

english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
translation: Elyo batanikapo ne fipondo fibili, cimo ku kulyo, cimbi naco ku kuso.

english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads
translation: Kanshi abantu abalepitapo, balemutuka, balekunta ne mitwe baleti,

english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
translation: Abeba ati, “Nimbifya pakulenga ukuti bepaye umuntu uwakaele!” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Bushe ifwe uyo mulandu wesu? Uyo mulandu obe we mwine!”

english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
translation: “Eya! Teiwe waleti nkabongolola Itempele, elyo nkalikuula mu nshiku shitatu! Kanshi ipusushe we mwine, nga uli Mwana wakwa Lesa, ika pa musalaba!”

english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
translation: Mu musango umo wine bashimapepo bacindami, bakafundisha bamafunde na bakalamba nabo balamuseka.

english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
translation: Balesosa baleti, “Alepususha bambi, nomba afilwa ukuipususha umwine! Apo ni Mfumu ya bena Israeli, naike ukufuma pa musalaba, uleke tusumine!

english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
translation: Atetekela muli Lesa, kanshi Lesa kamupusushe nga alimutemwa, kabili aleti ndi Mwana wakwa Lesa!”

english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
translation: Ne fipondo filya ifyatanikwe nankwe, nafyo fyalamusaalula.

english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
translation: Cilya akasuba kafika pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00, imfifi yakupile icalo conse, ukufikafye na lilya kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00.

english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
translation: Elyo lilya akasuba kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00, Yesu apunda ne shiwi likalamba ati, “Eloi, Eloi lama sabakatani?” Ekutila, “Lesa wandi, Lesa wandi, cinshi wandekelesesha?”

english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
translation: Elyo abantu bamo abaiminine mupepi baumfwa ifi, balasosa abati, “Uyu muntu aleita Eliya!”

english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
translation: Elyo umo abutuka ayabuula umwepu. Autumpika mu mwangashi uwakantuka. Elyo autunga kwitete, amutambika ukuti anwe.

english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
translation: Bambi bena balasosa abati, “Pembeleni, lekeni tumone nga Eliya alaisa mupususha!”

english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
translation: Yuda epakuya posa indalama mwi Tempele. Elyo afumako, ayaikulika.

english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
translation: Elyo Yesu apunda ne shiwi ilikalamba, aleka no mweo.

english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
translation: Apopene icisalu balecinga mwi Tempele calepuka pakati ukufuma pamulu ukufika na panshi. Elyo icalo calatenta, na mabwe yalalepauka.

english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
translation: Amabwe ya pa nindi yaisuka, na bamushilo abengi abafwile bashukuka.

english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
translation: Bafuma na mu nindi. Nomba panuma ya kushukuka kwakwa Yesu, aba bantu baisa mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, bamonekela na ku bengi.

english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
translation: Umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo, pamo pene ne fita ifyalelinda Yesu, bati bamone icinkukuma na fyonse ifyacitike, baikatwa no mwenso. Balasosa abati, “Cine cine uyu ni Mwana Lesa!”

english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
translation: Palipo na banakashi abengi akatalamukila, baletamba. Bafumine ku Galile, balekonka Yesu no kumutangata.

english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
translation: Pali aba palipo Maria Mandalena, Maria nyina kwa Yakobo na Yosefu, na nyina wa bamwana Sebede.

english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.
translation: Cilya caba ku cungulo, kwaishile umuntu umo umukankala umwina Alimateya, ishina lyakwe ni Yosefu. Uyu muntu nao ali musambi wakwa Yesu.

english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
translation: Kanshi aya kuli Pilato, aya mulomba icitumbi cakwa Yesu. Pilato nao aeba ukuti bamupeele.

english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
translation: Yosefu epakubuula icitumbi, acipomba na mu nsalu iyisuma.

english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami batola indalama abati, “Ishi ni ndalama shamisoka, amafunde yesu yalilesha ukushibika mu cipao ce Tempele.”

english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
translation: Acibika na mu nindi yakwe iyipya, iyo afukwile mu cilibwe. Elyo akunkulushishapo ilibwe likalamba pa mwinshi wa nindi, afumapo aya nokuya.

english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
translation: Maria Mandalena, na Maria mubiye, bena epo bali, nabekala apalungatene ne nindi.

english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
translation: Ilyo bwaisaca, ninshi ubushiku bwakupekanya ubushiku bwe Sabata nabupita, bashimapepo bacindami na Bafalise baya longana kwa Pilato.

english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
translation: Balamweba abati, “Kanabesa, natwibukisha ukuti ulya muntu wabufi ilyo acili umumi alandile ati, ‘Nkashukuka panuma ya nshiku shitatu.’

english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
translation: Kanshi konkomesheni ukuti kube abakulonda inindi mpaka na pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu. Pantu limbi kuti abasambi bakwe baisa mwiba, elyo abati, nashukuka ku bafwa. Ninshi ubu bufi bwa pakulekelesha bukabipisha ukucila ubwantanshi.”

english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
translation: Pilato abeba ati, “Kanshi sendeni abakulonda. Mumone ukuti balalinda bwino bwino ifyo mwishibe.”

english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
translation: Awe baya bakomenena inamba pa cilibwe ca pa nindi, bashapo na bakulonda.

english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
translation: Kanshi bati bapingushanye, babuula indalama, bashitamo ibala lya muntu uwalebumba inongo, umwakuti baleshiika abeni.

english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
translation: Eico ukufika na lelo ili bala balita, “Ibala lyamisoka.”

english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
translation: Kanshi epakufikilishiwa ifyo kasesema Yeremia asosele ati, “Babuulile indalama sha silifa amakumi yatatu (30) e mutengo abena Israeli bamo bamushitishishepo.

english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
translation: Ilyo ubushiku bwe Sabata bwapitile, cali na ku macaca ya bushiku bwakutampa umulungu, Maria Mandalena na Maria mubiye baile kukumona inindi.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Mwitiina, kabiyeni muye eba bamunyinane, ukuti baye ku Galile, eko tukesa monana nabo.”

english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
translation: Ilyo abanakashi baleya ku basambi, abalelonda bamo baile mu musumba, baya shimikila bashimapepo bacindami fyonse ificitike.

english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami balongana na bakalamba pakuti bomfwane ifyakucita. Awe bapeela abalelonda inindi indalama ishingi.

english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
translation: Babeba abati, “Mulesosa amuti, abasambi bakwe nabeba icitumbi ubushiku ilyo twaciba mu tulo.

english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
translation: Nangu nga cakuti umulashi aumfwako uyu mulandu, imwe mwisakamana nelyo cimo, ifwe tukamona ukuti fyonse fyaba bwino.”

english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
translation: Awe nabo abalelonda bapoka indalama, bacita nefyo babakonkomeshe. Kanshi ukufika na lelo, ili e lyashi lyasabankana ku Bayuda.

english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
translation: Elyo abasambi ikumi limo na umo baile ku Galile, ku lupili ulo Yesu abebele ukuyako.

english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
translation: Cilya bamumona, bawa panshi, balamupakata, lelo kwena bamo balatwishika.

english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
translation: Elyo Yesu apalama, alabeba ati, “Nalipeelwa amaka yonse mu mulu na pano isonde.

english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
translation: Kanshi kabiyeni muleyalula abantu ba mishobo yonse pakuti babe abasambi bandi. Mulebabatisha mwishina lyakwa Tata ne lya Mwana ne lyakwa Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
translation: Awe apopene icinkukuma icikalamba capita. Malaika wa Mfumu aika ukufuma ku mulu, aisa kunkulushapo ne cilibwe pa nindi, no kwikala epo aikala.

english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
translation: Mulebafunda ukulakonka fyonse ifyo namukonkomesha. Kabili nakulaba na imwe lyonse mpakafye na ku kupwa kwa calo.”

english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
translation: Pa menso yakwe palebengeshima ngo mwele wa mfula, elyo insalu shakwe shabuutafye tuutu ngo bunga bwa mfula .

english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
translation: Abalelonda umwenso wabekata, balatutumafye, bafwa umutombo.

english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
translation: Malaika alaeba abanakashi ati, “Mwitiina, ninjishiba ukuti mulefwaya Yesu, uo batanike.

english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
translation: Ala talimo muno, nabuuka ku bafwa nga filya fine asosele. Iseni mumone apo bamulalike.

english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
translation: Kanshi kabiyeni muye eba abasambi bakwe amuti, ‘Yesu nabuuka ku bafwa, kabili namutangilila ku Galile. Eko mukaya mumona!’ Efyo ine namweba.”

english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
translation: Awe abanakashi bafuma bwangu bwangu ku nindi nabasansamuka, nomba lubali no mwensomo. Baya balebutuka ulubilo kukuya shimikilako abasambi bakwa Yesu.

english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
translation: Awe apopene Yesu abakumanya abaposha ati, “Shimwapoleni!” Abanakashi epakupalama bafukatila amakasa yakwe balamupakata.

english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
translation: Kanshi Yesu afyalilwe ku Betelemu wa mu calo ca Yudeya pa nshita Herodi aleteeka ici calo. Abamano bamo bafumine ku kabanga, baisa ku Yerusalemu.

english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
translation: Cilya bamona ulutanda, basansamuka nganshi.

english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
translation: Elyo baingila mu ŋanda, bamona umwana na nyina Maria. Awe bafukama, balamupakata. Elyo bakakula ifyabupe fikankala basendele, bamutuula icela ca golide, ububani fulankinisenshi ne cinyamuti icanunka ubusaka muri.

english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
translation: Kabinge bati basokwe mu ciloto ukuti bebwelela kuli Herodi, batola inshila imbi, babwelelamo na kumyabo.

english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
translation: Cilya abamano abafumine ku kabanga baya, malaika wa Mfumu amonekela Yosefu mu ciloto, amweba ati, “Ima, buula umwana na nyina, butukila ku Egupto. Eko uli nokwikala mpaka nkakwebe, pantu Herodi alefwaya ukwipaya umwana.”

english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
translation: Nao Yosefu aima, abuula umwana na nyina ubushiku, alola ku Egupto.

english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
translation: Eko aikala mpaka ne mfwa yakwa Herodi. Kanshi epakufikilisha amashiwi ya Mfumu ayo kasesema asosele ati, “Naitile umwana wandi umwaume ukufuma mu Egupto.”

english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
translation: Elyo Herodi amwene ukuti abamano bamucenjelela, afulwa nganshi. Atuma mu Betelemu na mu mishi ya mumbali yonse abakwipaya abana abaume aba myaka ibili no kucepapo, ukulingana nomo aumfwilile palwa nshita ku bamano.

english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
translation: Epakufikilisha amashiwi ya mfumu ayo kasesema Yeremia asosele ati,

english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
translation: “Mu Rama mwaumfwika ishiwi lileshinshimukila,

english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
translation: Ilyo Herodi afwile, malaika wa Mfumu amonekele kuli Yosefu mu ciloto mu Egupto, amweba ati,

english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
translation: Balaipusha abati, “Bushe umwana uwafyalwa Imfumu ya Bayuda ali kwi? Twamwene ulutanda lwakwe ku kabanga, eico twaisa kukumupakata.”

english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
translation: “Ima, buula umwana na nyina, ubwelele ku calo ca Israeli. Pantu abalefwaya ukwipaya umwana nabafwa.”

english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
translation: Yosefu epakwima, abuula umwana na nyina, abwelela na ku calo ca Israeli.

english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
translation: Nomba ilyo aumfwa ukuti Akeleo euleteeka mu Yudeya pa malo yakwa wishi Herodi, atiina ukuyako. Elyo kabili bashimusokako mu ciloto, aya ku calo ca Galile.

english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
translation: Aya ikala na mu musumba uo batila Nasaleti. Kanshi epakufikilisha ifyasosele bakasesema ukuti, “Bakalamwita umwina Nasaleti.”

english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
translation: Imfumu Herodi pakumfwa ifyo, yasakamana nganshi, na bena Yerusalemu nabo lumo lwine.

english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
translation: Elyo Herodi alonganika bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde, alabepusha noko Kristu ali nokufyalilwa.

english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
translation: Nabo bamweba abati, “Ni mu Betelemu wa mu Yudeya. Pantu efyo na kasesema alemba ati,

english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
translation: ‘Na iwe Betelemu wa mu calo cakwa Yuda,

english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
translation: Elyo Herodi aita abantu bamano abafumine ku kabanga mu bumfisolo, alabepukisha na pa nshita ilyo ulutanda lwabamonekele.

english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
translation: Elyo abatuma ukuya ku Betelemu. Abeba ati, “Muye ipukisha bwino bwino palwa uyo mwana. Elyo nga mwamusanga, mukese njishibisha, pakuti na ine nkaye mupakata.”

english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
translation: Nabo bati bashumfwa ifyo ku mfumu, baima balaya. Awe ulutanda bamwene ku kabanga lwalabatangilila, lwasuka lwaisa iminina na pali umwana.

english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
translation: Mu nshiku shilya elyo Yoani Kabatisha aishile mu matololo ya Yudeya alebila ati,

english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
translation: Lesa naimya isembe ilyakuputawilako imishila ya miti. Kanshi umuti onse uushitwala ifitwalo ifisuma, akautema, akauposa na mu mulilo.

english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
translation: Ine ndemubatishisha ku menshi pakulanga ukuti namulapila no kupilibuka. Nomba uukankonka panuma, wena akamubatishisha kuli Mupashi Wamushilo na ku mulilo. Alicindama ukucila ine, nshilingile nangu ukusenda indyato shakwe.

english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
translation: Ali no lupe lwakwelelako mu minwe yakwe. Akafumya imisungu pa lubansa. Akatutila iŋanu mu butala bwakwe. Imisungu yena akayoca mu mulilo uushishima!”

english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
translation: Elyo Yesu afumine ku Galile aisa ku mumana wa Yordani, kuli Yoani kukubatishiwa.

english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
translation: Lelo Yoani atala amukaanya ati, “Nine mfwile ukubatishiwa kuli iwe, nomba niwe waisa kuli ine!”

english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Leka pali nomba ucite ifi fine, pantu efyo cilingile pakufikilisha fyonse ifyo Lesa alefwaya.” Elyo Yoani asumina.

english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
translation: Cilyafye Yesu abatishiwa, afuma mu menshi. Awe apopene no mulu waisuka. Elyo amona Mupashi wakwa Lesa aleika kwati ni nkunda, aisa ikala na pali Yesu.

english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
translation: Awe ne shiwi lyafuma mu mulu aliti, “Uyu e mwana wandi, uo natemwa, uo nsekelamo.”

english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
translation: “Lapileni no kupilibuka, pantu Ubufumu bwa mu mulu buli mupepi!”

english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
translation: Ala ni uyu wine kasesema Esaya alandapo ati,

english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
translation: Yoani alefwala insalu ishapikulwa na masako ya ngamila. Alekaka umushipi wa mpapa mu musana. Kabili ifilyo alelya ni makanta no buci bwa mu mpanga.

english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
translation: Elyo abantu ukufuma mu Yerusalemu na mu Yudeya monse na mu calofye conse ica Yordani balaisa uko ali.

english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
translation: Baleisosela ifyabubifi fyabo, elyo nao alebabatisha mu mumana wa Yordani.

english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
translation: Elyo Yoani ati amone Abafalise na Basaduki abengi baleisa kukubatishiwa, alabeba ati, “Mwe bana ba nsoka mwe! Nga nani amusoka ukubutuka ubukali bwakwa Lesa ubwalaisa?

english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
translation: Isham 1:8

english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
translation: Mwitampa ukulatontonkanya amuti, tuli bana bakwa shifwe Abrahamu. Ine ndemweba nati Lesa kuti ayalula aya mabwe ukuba abana bakwa Abrahamu.

english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
translation: Elyo Mupashi atwele Yesu ku matololo kukutunkwa na Ciwa.

english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
translation: Yesu epakumweba ati, “Fuma apa we Satana we! Pantu calilembwa ukuti, ‘Ulepepa Imfumu Lesa obe, kabili ekafye eo ulebombela.’ ”

english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
translation: Elyo Ciwa asha Yesu, na bamalaika baisa balamutumika.

english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
translation: Ilyo Yesu aumfwile ukuti Yoani nabamuposa mu cifungo, awe abwelele ku Galile.

english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
translation: Taile ikala ku Nasaleti, lelo aile ikala mu musumba wa Kapenamu uwabela mu lulamba lwa bemba, lwa mu mipaka ya Sebuloni na Naftali.

english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
translation: Kanshi epakufikilisha amashiwi yakwa kasesema Esaya ayakuti,

english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
translation: “We Sebuloni na we Naftali,

english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
translation: Amaf 6:16

english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
translation: Awe ukufuma apopene Yesu atampa ukubila ati, “Lapileni no kupilibuka, pantu Ubufumu bwa mu mulu buli mupepi!”

english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
translation: Kabili ilyo Yesu aleenda alekonka ululamba lwa bemba wa Galile, amwene ababwananyina babili, Simoni uo batila Petelo, na munyina Andele. Baleteya amasumbu muli bemba, ico bali balondo.

english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Nkonkeni, nkamucita abalondo ba bantu.”

english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
translation: Panuma yakufunga ukulya inshiku amakumi yane akasuba no bushiku, awe insala yamwikata.

english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
translation: Apopenefye, basha amasumbu yabo, balamukonka no kumukonka.

english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
translation: Kabili Yesu ati endeleleko cinono, amona na bambi ababwananyina babili, Yakobo na Yoani bamwana Sebede mu bwato, balelunda amasumbu yabo. Awe nabo abeta.

english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
translation: Apopene nabo basha ubwato na shibo balamukonka.

english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
translation: Elyo Yesu aile alapitana mu calo conse ica Galile. Alefunda mu masinagoga, alebila ne Mbila Nsuma iya Bufumu. Aleposha na bantu bonse abalecushiwa ku malwele na ku ntenda shonse.

english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
translation: Awe ululumbi lwakwe lwakumana mu calo ca Siria. Abantu epakulamuletela abalwele abalecushiwa ku malwele ya misango misango, abali ne mipashi yakowela, abalwele shinsa, na babulebe, nao bonse alabaposha.

english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
translation: Cinkupiti wa bantu ukufuma ku Galile, ku Dekapoli, ku Yerusalemu, ku Yudeya na kwishilya lya Yordani balamukonka.

english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
translation: Elyo Ciwa aisa kuli Yesu alamutunka ati, “Nga uli Mwana wakwa Lesa, eba aya mabwe yasanguke imikate.”

english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Calilembwa ukuti, ‘Umuntu takwatafye umweo mukulya icakulya, lelo na kwishiwi lyonse ilyo Lesa asosa.’ ”

english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
translation: Elyo Ciwa asenda Yesu amutwala ku Yerusalemu, umusumba wamushilo. Amwimika pa nembenembe ya mutenge we Tempele.

english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
translation: Amweba ati, “Nga uli Mwana wakwa Lesa tolokela panshi. Pantu calilembwa ukuti,

english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Na pambi calilembwa ukuti, ‘Wilaesha Imfumu Lesa obe.’ ”

english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
translation: Kabili Ciwa amutwala pa lupili ulutali nganshi, amulanga no bufumu bonse ubwa pano calo no bucindami bwabuko.

english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
translation: Amweba ati, “Fyonse ifi ndekupeela nga wakunkula wampakata.”

english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
translation: Nomba ilyo Yesu amwene amabumba, anina ulupili, aikala, na basambi bakwe baisa bamupalamina.

english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: Balishuka abaculila pa mulandu wakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya,

english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
translation: Mwalishuka nga abantu balamusaalula, balamucusha,

english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
translation: Mulesansamuka no kwanga,

english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
translation: “Nimwe mucele wa pano isonde. Nomba umucele nga wafumuka, kuti waloweshiwa shani nakabili? Awe tewakuwamina kantu, wakuposafye panse, na bantu balaunyantapo.

english: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
translation: “Nimwe lubuuto lwa ba pano isonde. Umusumba bakuula pa mulu wa lupili teti ukaane ukumoneka.

english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
translation: Tapaba nangu umo uusanika icisaniko, kabili acikupikilapo inongo. Awe bacibika apasansama pakuti cisanikile bonse abali mu ŋanda.

english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
translation: Efyo na imwe lekeni ulubuuto lwenu lulesanikila abantu, pakuti nga balamona imilimo yenu iyisuma, balelumbanya Shinwe wa mu mulu.”

english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
translation: “Mwilatila ine naisa kukonaula Amafunde yakwa Mose naya bakasesema, awe iyoo. Nshaisa kukonaula, lelo ni kukuyafikilisha.

english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
translation: Ndemweba mu cine cine, umulu ne calo fikonaika, lelo pa Mafunde yakwa Mose pena tapakonaike kacilembo nangu akalitoni kamo, mpaka fyonse fikafikilishiwe.

english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: Eico kanshi uyo onse uulalufyanya muli limo pali ayo mafunde nangu lingacepa shani, kabili alafunda abantu ukucita ifyo fine, wena akaba uwacepesha mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu. Lelo uulasunga ayo mafunde, alayafunda na ku bantu, wena akaba uwacindama mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.

english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
translation: Elyo atampa ukulabafunda ati,

english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: Eico namweba nati, ukuwamya kwenu nga takucilile ukwa Bafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde, ninshi tamwakengile mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.”

english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
translation: “Mwalyumfwa ifyo baebele aba pakale ukuti, ‘Wilaipaya. Uwaipaya, bafwile bamutwala kukulubulula.’

english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
translation: Nomba ine namweba nati, uyo onse uwafulilwa munyina, alingile bamutwala kukulubulula. Elyo uwaeba munyina ati, ‘We cinangwa we!’ wena bali nokumutwala ku cilye cikalamba. Lelo uwaeba munyina ati, ‘We ciwelewele ca muntu we’! Awe wena wakuposwafye mu mulilo wape.

english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
translation: Kanshi nga uletwala ubupe bobe bwakutuula ku bulambo bwakwa Lesa, elyo waibukisha ukuti munonko ali ne cintu ku mukoshi pali iwe,

english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
translation: tala sha ubupe bobe kulya kwine pantanshi ya bulambo. Pakubala kabiye muwikishanye na munonko, elyo wise utuule ubupe bobe.

english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
translation: “Mumfwane bwangu bwangu no mulwani obe, ilyo mucili muleya nankwe kukulubulula. Pantu limbi kuti aya akutwala kuli kaputula wamilandu, elyo kaputula wamilandu nao akutwala kuli kapokola, ena ninshi kukuposafye mu cifungo.

english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, tawakafumemo mpakafye ukapwishishishe ukufuta na kandalama kakupelekeshako.”

english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
translation: “Mwalyumfwa ifyo casoselwe ukuti, ‘Wilabembuka.’

english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
translation: Lelo ine namweba nati, uyo onse uwalolekesha umwanakashi no lunkumbwa lubi, ninshi nabembuka nankwe mu mutima wakwe.

english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
translation: Ilinso lyobe ilya ku kulyo nga elyakulengesha ukubifya, ulitonkole, ulifwinte no kutali. Cawamishapo ukulufya icilundwa cimo ica mubili obe, ukucila ukuleka umubili obe onse ukuposwa mu mulilo wape.

english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
translation: “Balishuka abapina mu mitima,

english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
translation: Elyo nga cisansa cobe ica ku kulyo cakulengesha ukubifya, uciputule, ucifwinte ukutali. Cawamishapo ukulufya icilundwa cimo ica mubili obe, ukucila ukuti umubili obe onse waya mukupya mu mulilo wape.”

english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
translation: “Kabili casoselwe ukuti, ‘Uwaleka umukashi wakwe, ali nokumupeela kalata wakumulekelapo.’

english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
translation: Lelo ine namweba nati, onse uwaleka umukashi wakwe ninshi amuposa mu lubembu, kano ninshi nga ni pa mulandu wa bulalelale. Elyo no waupa uo baleka nao ninshi lubembu acita.”

english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
translation: “Kabili mwalyumfwa ifyo baebele aba pakale ukuti, ‘Wilalapa bufi, lelo uli nokufikilisha ifyo walaya ku Mfumu.’

english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
translation: Lelo ine namweba nati, mwilalapa nelyo panono. Mwilalapa nangu umulu wine, pantu e cipuna cikatami cakwa Lesa.

english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
translation: Mwilalapa nangu icalo, pantu epo Lesa anyanta amakasa yakwe. Mwilalapa nangu Yerusalemu wine, pantu musumba wa Mfumu nkalamba.

english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
translation: Kabili wilalapa no mutwe obe wine, pantu iwe tawakwata amaka yakuti ulenge umushishi obe ubuute nangu ufiite.

english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
translation: Kanshi mulesosafye amuti, ‘ee’ nga ni ‘ee,’ nangu ‘iyoo’ nga ni ‘iyoo.’ Fimbi ifyacila pali ifi ninshi fyafuma kuli Satana.”

english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
translation: “Mwalyumfwa ifyo casoselwe ukuti, ‘Nga linso nao linso, nga lino nao lino.’

english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
translation: Lelo ine namweba nati, mwilalwishanya na muntu mubi. Umuntu nga akutoba ulupi pesaya lya ku kulyo, umupilibwile ne libiye line.

english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
translation: Balishuka abaloosha,

english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
translation: Umuntu nga akutwala ku cilye camilandu, alefwaya ukukupoka umwingila, muleke asende ne cakufimbana cine.

english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
translation: Umo nga akupatikisha ukuya nankwe umulundu umo, wende nankwe imilundu ibili.

english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
translation: Umo nga akulomba icintu, umupeele. Elyo no ulefwaya ukuti umwashime icintu, wimutana.”

english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
translation: “Mwalyumfwa ifyo casoselwe ukuti, ‘Uletemwa umubiyo, ulepata umulwani obe.’

english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
translation: Lelo ine namweba nati, muletemwa abalwani benu, mulepepelako na bamucusha.

english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
translation: Pantu lyena elyo mukaba abana bakwa Shinwe wa mu mulu. Ena alenga akasuba kakwe ukubalikila pa basuma na pa babi, elyo atuma ne mfula ukulokela pa bawamya na pa babifya pene.

english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
translation: Nga mwatemwafye abamutemwa, cilambu nshi mwingapokelapo? Bushe teficita na bakasonkesha?

english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
translation: Elyo nga muleposhafye bamunyinenwe beka beka, finshi mulecita ificililepo ifishicita bambi? Bushe tefyo na bashaishiba Lesa bacita?

english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
translation: Eico kanshi mube abapwililika ku busuma, nga filya Shinwe wa mu mulu aba uwapwililika ku busuma.”

english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
translation: Balishuka abamutembo,

english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
translation: Balishuka abansala ne cilaka icakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya,

english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
translation: Balishuka abaluse,

english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
translation: Balishuka abamitima yakaele,

english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
translation: Balishuka abalenga icumfwano,

english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
translation: “Moneni ukuti, mwilacita milimo isuma pa menso ya bantu pakutifye bamumone. Nga mwalacita ifyo ninshi tamwakamone cilambu kuli Shinwe wa mu mulu.

english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
translation: Ubufumu bobe bwise,

english: Give us today our daily bread.
translation: Utupeele lelo icakulya cesu tulekabila.

english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
translation: Uletubelelako uluse ku fintu tukubifya,

english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
translation: Wileka tuwile mu ntunko,

english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
translation: “Pantu nga mwalabelela abantu bambi uluse kufyo balemubifya, ninshi na imwe Shinwe wa mu mulu akamubelele uluse.

english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
translation: Lelo nga tamulebelele bantu bambi uluse pafyo balemubifya, Shinwe nao takamubelele uluse kufyo mubifya.”

english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
translation: “Kabili ilyo mulefunga ukulya, mwilaikala nkumbabulili nga filya ficita imfundabuteshi. Pantu bena balabwesha icinso pakuti abantu beshibe ukuti nabafunga ukulya. Namweba icine cine, aba bena nabapoka icilambu cabo conse.

english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
translation: Nomba iwe ilyo wafunga ukulya, usambe pa menso, usube na mafuta ku mutwe.

english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
translation: Epakuti abantu bambi beishiba ukuti naufunga ukulya, lelo cishibikwefye kuli Wiso uumona ificitika mu bumfisolo. Elyo Wiso nao uumona ificitwa mu bumfisolo, akakulambula.”

english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
translation: “Mwilatutila ifyuma pano isonde apo fyonaika ku ndalawa na ku fishishi, apo abapupu besa batoba iŋanda no kufiba.

english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
translation: “Kanshi nga wakumbusuka umulanda, wilaalasha ku bantu nga filya ficita imfundabuteshi mu masinagoga na mu misebo, pakuti abantu baleshitasha. Namweba icine cine, bena balipoka icilambu cabo conse.

english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
translation: Lelo muletutila ifyuma mu mulu, umo fishonaika ku fishishi nangu ku ndalawa, na bapupu bakutoba no kufiba, tamwaba.

english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
translation: Pantu ukuli icuma cobe, ekuba no mutima obe wine.”

english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
translation: “Icisaniko ca mubili obe, linso. Amenso yobe nga yatuntulu ninshi umubili obe onse uli mu lubuuto.

english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
translation: Lelo amenso yobe nga yalwele, ninshi umubili obe onse uli mu mfifi. Kanshi ulubuuto lwa muli iwe nga lwaba imfifi, bushe ninshi iyo te mfifi yacipeshamano!”

english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
translation: “Umuntu umo kuti afilwa ukuba umusha wa bashikulu wakwe babili. Pantu kuti apatapo umo, umbi amutemwa, nangu auminina kuli umo, umbi amusuula. Na imwe kuti mwafilwa ukuba abasha bakwa Lesa na basha ba ndalama.”

english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
translation: “Eico ndemweba, mwilasakamikwa palwa bumi bwenu ukuti, bushe tulelya nshi nangu tulenwa nshi? Nangu palwa mibili yenu ukuti finshi tulefwala? Bushe ubumi tabwacila pa fyakulya? Nangu umubili nao bushe tawacila pa fyakufwala?

english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
translation: Shimoneni ifyuni fya mu mulu. Fyena tafitanda, tafiseepa, nelyo ukututila mu matala iyoo, lelo Shinwe wa mu mulu alafilisha. Ala bushe imwe tamwalificila ukucindama?

english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
translation: Bushe nani pali imwe nangu engasakamikwa shani engailundilako inshiku sha bumi bwakwe?

english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
translation: “Ngeco musakamikilwa palwa fyakufwala cinshi? Shimoneni amaluba ya mu mpanga ifyo yakula. Tayabomba nangu ukupikula insalu shakufwala.

english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
translation: Lelo ine ndemweba, na Solomoni wine nangu ali umukankala nganshi, tatalile afwala insalu ishayemba nga aya maluba.

english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
translation: Nomba ilyo wakumbusuka umulanda, wileka ukuboko kwa ku kuso kwishibe icicitile ukuboko kobe kwa ku kulyo.

english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
translation: Apo Lesa afwika ifi amaluba ya mu mpanga ayakuti yalipo lelo, bwaisaca bayaposa mu mulilo, bushe imwe nimwe ashingasakamana ukufwika, mwe ba cisumino cinono?

english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
translation: Kanshi mwilasakamikwa amuti, ‘Bushe tulelya nshi? Bushe tulenwa nshi nangu bushe tulefwala nshi?’

english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
translation: Ifi fyonse efisakamika imitima ya bantu abashaishiba Lesa. Nomba imwe, Shinwe wa mu mulu alishiba ukuti mulakabila ifi fyonse.

english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
translation: Kanshi pakubala sakamaneni ukufwaya Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa no kucita ifyo afwaya, lyena na fyonse ifi fimbi akulamubikilapo.

english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
translation: Eico mwilasakamikwa pa bushiku bwa mailo, ubwa mailo nabo bukaisakamana. Ala cila bushiku bwaliba ne sakamika lyabuko.

english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
translation: Ubupe bobe buli nokuba mu bumfisolo. Elyo Wiso nao uumona ificitwa mu bumfisolo akakulambwilapo.”

english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
translation: “Kabili ilyo mulepepa, mwilapashanya imfundabuteshi. Pantu bena batemwa ukwiminina pakupepa mu masinagoga na mu masansa ya misebo mu misumba, pakuti abantu babamone. Aba bena ndemweba icine cine, balipoka icilambu cabo conse.

english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
translation: Nomba iwe ilyo walapepa, ingila mu muputule obe, wisaleko ne ciibi. Upepe kuli Wiso uuba no mwafisama. Elyo Wiso uumona umwafisama, akakulambula.

english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
translation: “Kabili mukupepa mwilasabaila fyakusabaila nge ficita abantu abashaishiba Lesa. Bena batila, mukufusha ifyakusosa, lyena elyo bengomfwika.

english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
translation: Mwilabapashanya, pantu Shinwe alishiba kale ifyo mukabila nelyo mushilati mumulombe.

english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
translation: Kanshi imwe mulepepa amuti;

english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
translation: “Mwilapingula banenu, epakuti na imwe bekamupingula.

english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
translation: Nangu nga alomba isabi, bushe kuti amupeela insoka?

english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
translation: Nga kanshi apo imwe mwe baba ababi, mwalishiba ukupeela abana benu ifintu ifisuma, palibufi Shinwe wa mu mulu, ala nao alapeela ifintu ifisuma kuli abo abamulomba.

english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
translation: “Eico kanshi fyonse ifyo mufwaya ukuti abantu balemucitila, na imwe efyo mulebacitila. Emwalola Amafunde yakwa Mose na ya bakasesema.

english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
translation: “Muleingila pa mwinshi uwafyendenkana. Pantu umwinshi ukulu ne nshila iyapabuka efitwala kukuloba, elyo na bapitamo bengi.

english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
translation: Lelo umwinshi uutwala ku mweo, untu wafyendenkana ne nshila nayo iyayafya, na baisanga nabo banono.

english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
translation: “Cenjeleni kuli bakasesema babufi besa kuli imwe abanakilila nge mpaanga, lelo mu cine cine mimbulu iyikali.

english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
translation: Ku ficitwa fyabo eko mwakulabeshibila. Bushe abantu basaba imyangashi ku myunga, nangu amakunyu kuli nkololo?

english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
translation: Eifyo fine umuti onse usuma utwala ifitwalo ifisuma, umuti ubi wena utwala ifitwalo ifibi.

english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
translation: Umuti usuma teti utwale ifitwalo ifibi, no muti ubi teti utwale ifitwalo ifisuma.

english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
translation: Umuti onse uushitwala ifitwalo fisuma, balautema, bauposa na mu mulilo.

english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
translation: Pantu umo mwine mupingwila abanenu, emo na imwe bakamupingwila. Elyo ne cipimo mupiminako abanenu eco na imwe bakamupiminako.

english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
translation: Kanshi ku ficitwa fyabo eko mwakulabeshibila.

english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
translation: “Teuyo onse uunjeba ati, ‘We Mfumu, we Mfumu,’ eukengila mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu, lelo kano uyo uucita ubufwayo bwakwa Tata wa mu mulu.

english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
translation: Ilyo ubushiku bulya bukafika, abengi bakalanjeba abati, ‘We Mfumu, we Mfumu! Bushe te ku maka yobe twalesesemena? Bushe te ku maka yobe twaletamfisha imipashi yakowela? Bushe te ku maka yobe twalecitila ifipeshamano ifingi?’

english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
translation: Elyo na ine nkabebelapofye nati, ‘Ine nshatala mwishiba. Fumeni apa mwe babi ba bantu mwe!’

english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
translation: “Kanshi umuntu onse uumfwa aya mashiwi yandi no kuyakonka alayakonka, apala umuntu uwamano uwakuulile iŋanda yakwe pa mwalala.

english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
translation: Ala kuti cilya imfula yalaloka, imimana yaisula yaposa, icimwela caima calakuuka capuma na kuli iyo ŋanda, awe teyakuwa iyoo. Pantu yakuulwa pa mwalala.

english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
translation: “Nomba uyo onse uumfwa amashiwi yandi aya, akaana no kulayakonka, apala icipumbu ca muntu icakuulile iŋanda yaciko pa musensenga.

english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
translation: Kuti cilya imfula yalaloka, imimana yaisula yaposa, icimwela caima calakuuka capuma na kuli iyo ŋanda, awe yawa, yabongoloka icabipisha.”

english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
translation: Ilyo Yesu apwile ukusosa aya mashiwi, amabumba yalapapa nganshi pa mifundile yakwe.

english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
translation: Pantu imifundile yakwe tayali nge ya bakafundisha bamafunde, wena alefunda nga uwakwata amaka.

english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
translation: Nga cinshi ulolekesesha akapapala akali mu linso lyakwa munonko, tausakamana no kumona umulando uuli mu linso lyobe.

english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
translation: Nga kanshi kuti waeba shani munonko auti, ‘Leka nkufule akapapala ako mu linso lyobe’, mu nshita na iwe uli no mulando mu linso lyobe?

english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
translation: We mfundabuteshi we! Pakubala fumya umulando uuli mu linso lyobe, elyo walalolesha bwino pakufula akapapala akali mu linso lyakwa munonko.

english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
translation: “Mwilapeela imbwa icamushilo, limbi kuti shamwalukila shamulepaula. Mwilaposela inkumba ubulungu bwenu ubwamutengo, pantu shena kuti shabunyantaulafye.

english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
translation: “Akulombeni mwakulapeelwa, akufwayeni mwakulasanga, akukonkonsheni bakulamwiswila.

english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
translation: Pantu onse uulomba alapeelwa, uufwaya alasanga, elyo nao uukonkonsha balamwiswila.

english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
translation: Nga nani pali imwe engapeela mwane ilibwe nga amulomba umukate?

english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
translation: Elyo Yesu atentemwike ulupili, na mabumba ayakalamba yalimukonkele.

english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
translation: Yesu ati omfwe ifi, asunguka. Elyo aeba abalemukonka ati, “Ndemweba mu cine cine, nshatala nsanga icisumino ca musango ngoyu na mu bena Israeli bene.

english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
translation: Eico namweba nati, abantu abengi bakafuma mpanga yonse pano isonde, bakesa ikala pakulya na Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo mu Bufumu bwa mu mulu.

english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
translation: Lelo abene ba Bufumu, bakaposwa panse mu mfifi, ukukaba imisowa no kusumanya ameno.”

english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo ati, “Kabiye, umo mwine usuminine emo cicitikile.” Awe no mubomfi wakwe pa nshita ine iyo apola.

english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
translation: Elyo Yesu aingile mu ŋanda mwa Petelo, asangile nafyala Petelo nalala, nalwala impepo.

english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
translation: Amukumya ku minwe, ne mpepo yamuleka. Awe aima alatebeta na Yesu.

english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
translation: Kabili cilya kwaba icungulo, abantu baleta kuli Yesu abantu abengi abali ne mipashi yakowela. Awe atamfya imipashi yakowela kwishiwi lyakwe lyeka. Aposha na balwele bonse.

english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
translation: Epakufikilisha ifyo kasesema Esaya asosele ati, “Ewabuula amacushi yesu, ewasenda na malwele yesu.”

english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
translation: Ilyo Yesu amwene ukuti amabumba ayakalamba yamushingulwike, aebele abasambi bakwe ukwabukila kwishilya lya bemba.

english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
translation: Elyo kafundisha wamafunde apalama amweba ati, “Kafundisha, nakulakukonka konse uko wakulaya.”

english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
translation: Awe uwafibashi umo aisa fukama apo ali ati, “We Mfumu nga nautemwa, kuti wamposha.”

english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bamumbwe balikwata imimba, ifyuni fya mu mulu nafyo fyalikwata ifisansala, lelo Umwana wa muntu wena takwata na pakusaila umutwe.”

english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
translation: Umusambi umbi amweba ati, “We Mfumu leka ntale nje shiika batata.”

english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Iwe nkonka, leka abafwa baleshiika abafwa babo.”

english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
translation: Elyo Yesu aingile mu bwato na basambi bakwe balimukonkele.

english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
translation: Awe apopene icikuuku ca maka nganshi caima pali bemba na matamba yalapumaula ku bwato. Ninshi Yesu wena ali mu tulo.

english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
translation: Abasambi epakuya kuli Yesu, balamushibusha abati, “We Mfumu tupusushe, twalafwa!”

english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Cinshi ico muletiinina, mwe ba cisumino cinono!” Elyo aiminina akalipila icimwela na matamba. Awe patalala na tondolo.

english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
translation: Awe abantu balapapa, balasosa abati, “Nga kanshi uyu muntu, muntu nshi, uwakuti icimwela na matamba filemubeela?”

english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
translation: Yesu afikile kwishilya lya bemba mu calo ca bena Gadala. Abantu babili abakwete imipashi yakowela bafuma mu nshinshi baisa kumanya Yesu. Aba bantu bali ne mipashi iyikali nganshi, icakuti tamwalepita muntu mu nshila ilya.

english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
translation: Awe balapunda abati, “We Mwana wakwa Lesa, finshi ulefwaya ukutucita? Bushe waisa kukutucusha ne nshita tailafika?”

english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
translation: Yesu atambalika ukuboko amukumya ati, “Cisuma nintemwa, pola!” Awe apopene ne fibashi fyakwe fyapola.

english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
translation: Kanshi akatalamukila napo bali, pali mukuni ukalamba uwa nkumba ishalelya.

english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
translation: Elyo imipashi yakowela yalapapata Yesu aiti, “Nga watutamfya, ninshi tutamfishe mu mukuni wa nkumba.”

english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
translation: Yesu ayeba ati, “Kabiyeni.” Awe nayo yafumamo, yaya na mu nkumba. Elyo umukuni onse wakunkunyala pa mukunkuluko, waipuupa muli bemba, wanwena no kunwena.

english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
translation: Bakacema ba nkumba bafulumuka baya mu musumba. Balashimika fyonse, ne ficitike ku bantu bali ne imipashi yakowela.

english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
translation: Awe abantu bonse mu musumba baya kukumanya Yesu. Cilya bamumona, balamupapata ukuti afume mu calo cabo.

english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Umfwa, wiyebako muntu nelyo umo. Lelo kabiye uilange kuli shimapepo, uye tuula no mutuulo uo Mose akonkomesha, uleke cibashinine ukuti naupola.”

english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
translation: Ilyo Yesu aingile mu Kapenamu, umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo aishile uko ali. Alamupapata ati,

english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
translation: “Mukwai, umubomfi wandi kumwandi alilwala ubulebe, alalafye, alacula nganshi.”

english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
translation: Yesu amweba ati, “Nalaisa muposha.”

english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
translation: Umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo amwasuka ati, “Awe we Mfumu, ine nshilingile ukuti wise wingile mumwandi. Ala sosafye ishiwi no mubomfi wandi alapola.

english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
translation: Pantu ine nalikwata abakalamba abanteeka elyo na ine nalikwata ifita ifyo nteeka. Nga naeba umo nati ‘Kabiye,’ nao aya. Nga naeba umbi nati ‘isa,’ nao aisa. Umusha wandi nga namweba nati, ‘Cita ici’, awe acita.”

english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
translation: Yesu aingile mu bwato, ayabwike bemba abwelela na ku musumba kumwakwe.

english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
translation: Nomba cilya Yesu ali pakulya mu ŋanda mwa Mateo, bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde abengi baisa mukulya pamo nankwe na basambi bakwe.

english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translation: Ilyo Abafalise bamona ifi, balaipusha abasambi bakwe abati, “Bushe cinshi kafundisha wenu alila pamo na bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde?”

english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
translation: Yesu ati ateshe ifyo, abeba ati, “Abali umutende tabakabila shiŋanga iyoo, kano abalwele.

english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
translation: Kanshi kabiyeni muye sanga umwalola Amalembo Yamushilo ayakuti, ‘Ine mfwaya uluse, ilambo lyena telyo.’ Ala ine nshaisa kukwita abakaele, kano ababifi.”

english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
translation: Elyo abasambi bakwa Yoani baishile kuli Yesu balamwipusha abati, “Ifwe na Bafalise tulafunga ukulya, nga basambi bobe bena cinshi bashifungila ukulya?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe inshindishi shakwa shibwinga kuti shaba no bulanda shani, ilyo shicili na shibwinga? Lelo inshita ikesa ilyo bakashipoka shibwinga, elyo ninshi lyena shikalafunga ukulya.

english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
translation: “Takwaba nelyo umo uubika icikamba cipya pa nsalu iyikote, pantu icikamba cipya kuti calepula insalu, ne cipunda cakulilako.

english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
translation: Eico tababika umwangashi uushilabila mu nyambi ishikote. Nga bacita ifyo, ninshi inyambi kuti shapuka, no mwangashi wapongoloka ne nyambi shaonaika. Lelo babika umwangashi uushilabila mu nyambi ishipya, epakupususha fyonse fibili.”

english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
translation: Ilyo Yesu acili alesosa ifi, awe paishile intungulushi imo iya Bayuda, yamufukamina, yalasosa aiti, “Umwana wandi umukashana afwafye nombaline. Shi wingesa mutambalikilapo ukuboko, pakuti abe umumi.”
