english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
translation: Awe Yesu aima amukonka pamo na basambi bakwe.

english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
translation: Elyo abantu bamo bamuletela icite icilele pa musengele. Yesu pakumona icisumino cabo, aeba icite ati, “Teka umutima mwana wandi, naubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe.”

english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
translation: Elyo umwanakashi uwalwele umukunko pa myaka ikumi limo na ibili, aisa lwa kunuma yakwa Yesu, akumya na ku nsenkebele sha nsalu yakwe.

english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
translation: Pantu mu mutima wakwe aleti, “Nga cakutifye nakumya ku nsalu shakwe, ninshi ndepola.”

english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
translation: Yesu ati apilibukile kunuma, amumona. Amweba ati, “We mwana, witiina, icisumino cobe ecakuposha.” Awe apopene no mwanakashi apola no kupola.

english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
translation: Cilya Yesu afika ku ŋanda ya ntungulushi, asangamo abalelisha bamutolilo ne bumba lya bantu abaleloosha.

english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
translation: Yesu asosa ati, “Fumeni muno! Umukashana tafwile, aleelefye utulo.” Awe bena balamuseka.

english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
translation: Cilya ibumba lya bantu lyafumina panse, Yesu aingila, aikata umukashana ku minwe. Awe no mukashana aima.

english: The report of this went out into all that land.
translation: No lulumbi lwa ici cintu lwasalangana muli cilya calo conse.

english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
translation: Ilyo Yesu afuminepo, impofu shibili shalemukonka shilebilikisha ashiti, “We Mwana Davidi, shi wingatulangulukilako!”

english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
translation: Awe cilya Yesu aingila mu ŋanda, nasho impofu shamukonka. Elyo Yesu alashipusha ati, “Bushe namusumina ukuti, kuti nacita ico mulelomba?” Nasho shayasuka ashiti, “Ee mukwai.”

english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
translation: Elyo ashikumya pa menso ati, “Nacicitikile umo mwine musuminine.”

english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde bamo balalanshanya abati, “Uyu muntu alesaalula Lesa.”

english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
translation: Awe na menso yabo yalalolesha. Elyo Yesu alabakonkomesha nganshi ati, “Moneni mwileka muntu nelyo umo eshibe.”

english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
translation: Nomba bena ilyo bafumamo, baya balashimika ifintu fyakupapa ifyo Yesu acitile muli cilya calo conse.

english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
translation: Ilyo aba bantu balafumapo, awe bambi baleta kuli Yesu umuntu umo cibulu, ico ali no mupashi wakowela.

english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
translation: Ilyo Yesu atamfya umupashi wakowela, umuntu uwali cibulu atampa ukulalanda. Amabumba yena yalapapafye ayati, “Awe mu Israeli tamwatala amumoneka icintu ica musango uyu!”

english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
translation: Nomba Abafalise bena balasosa abati, “Ni ku maka ya mukalamba wa mipashi yakowela eko atamfisha imipashi yakowela.”

english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
translation: Elyo Yesu aile alapitana mu misumba yonse na mu mishi, alefunda mu masinagoga. Alebila Imbila Nsuma ya Bufumu. Aleposha amalwele yonse ne ntenda shonse.

english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation: Kabili cilya amona amabumba alayalangulukila, pantu yalemoneka bulanda bulanda, ayalekeleshiwa kwati ni mpaanga ishabula kacema.

english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
translation: Elyo alaeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Ifyakulobolola fyena fingi, lelo ababomfi bakulobolola bena banono.

english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
translation: Kanshi akulombeni umwine fisabo, atume ababomfi na bambi abakumulobolwelako.”

english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
translation: Yesu ico eshibe ifyo baletontonkanya, abeba ati, “Ngeco muletontonkanishisha ifyabipa ifyo mu mitima yenu cinshi?

english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
translation: Bushe cinshi cayangukapo, kutila, ‘Naubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe,’ nangu ukutila, ‘Ima akwenda.’

english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
translation: Kanshi lekeni mulange ukuti, Umwana wa muntu alikwata amaka pano isonde ayakubelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi fyonse.” Elyo aeba icite ati, “Ima, senda umusengele obe akuya na kumobe!”

english: He arose and departed to his house.
translation: Awe nao aima, aya na kumwakwe.

english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
translation: Ilyo amabumba yamona ici, yaikatwa no mwenso, yalalumbanya Lesa uupeela abantu amaka ayakula ifi.

english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
translation: Ilyo Yesu afuminepo, amwene umuntu umo, ishina lyakwe ni Mateo, ekele mu ŋanda ya musonko. Amweba ati, “Nkonka.” Nao Mateo aima alamukonka.

english: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Mika, uwaikele mu mushi wa Moresheti, pa nshita Yotamu ateekele icalo ca Yuda, na pa nshita Ahasi nao akonkelepo ukuciteeka, na pa nshita Hesekia nao aciteekelepo. Yawe alisokolwelele Mika ifi fintu palwa musumba wa Samaria na palwa musumba wa Yerusalemu mu cimonwa.

english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
translation: Mwishimikilako balwani besu mu Gati,

english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu mushi wa Shafiri muleya muli bunkole,

english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
translation: Abena Maroti balenyongolokafye ku bukali,

english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
translation: Imwe mwe baikala mu musumba wa Lakishi,

english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
translation: Kanshi nomba imwe muli nokupeela umushi wa Moresheti Gati,

english: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Maresha, nkamuposa ku mulwani umo uukapoka umushi wenu.

english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
translation: Beyeni imishishi pakuloosha abana benu abo mwatemwisha,

english: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
translation: Umfweni kuno imwe mwe bantu ba mitundu yonse.

english: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
translation: Moneni, Yawe ulya alefuma mwisano lyakwe ilyamushilo,

english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
translation: Ilyo akulapitapo,

english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
translation: Ifi fyonse filecitika pantu abakwa Yakobo balipula amafunde,

english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
translation: E mulandu wine kanshi Yawe alesosela ati,

english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
translation: Tulya tulubi utwabamo utwamutengo tukasansaika tonse,

english: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
translation: Elyo Mika nao asosa ati,

english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
translation: Impumo sha bena Samaria teshakupola iyoo,

english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
translation: Bashama abantu abapanga ukucita ifyabipa,

english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
translation: Aleni imeni, akuyeni,

english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
translation: Nga kwaisa umuntu wabufi kabili incenjeshi,

english: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
translation: “Nomba ine mu cishinkafye nkamulonganya pamo,

english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
translation: Yawe eukabatungulwila inshila,

english: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
translation: Nga mabala balekumbwa,

english: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
translation: Eico Yawe alesosa ati,

english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, abantu bakamushikila ulwimbo lwakumushokesha,

english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
translation: Eico ilyo inshita ikafika iyakubweseshapo abantu bakwa Yawe icalo cabo,

english: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
translation: Bakasesema wabo balanda ukuti, “Wilasesema ifi kuli ifwe, iyoo!

english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
translation: Bushe kuti mwasosa ifi imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo?

english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
translation: Yawe nao epakwasukapo ati,

english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
translation: Imwe mulatamfya abanakashi ba bantu bandi mu mayanda yabo ayo abene batemwa,

english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
translation: Ine nalisosele nati,

english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
translation: Mwe bakuula Sioni ku mulopa walufyengo,

english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
translation: Bakateeka ba musumba bauteekelafye mukupokelela amafisakanwa,

english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
translation: Kanshi imwe nimwe bene mukalenga ukuti Sioni bakamulima nge bala,

english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
translation: Imwe mwalipata ifisuma,

english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
translation: Mulalya iminofu ya bantu bandi,

english: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
translation: Inshita imo ikafika ilyo bakalakuuta Yawe mutuule,

english: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati,

english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
translation: Eico bushiku bwenu nabupwa tamwakulakwatapo ne fimonwa,

english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
translation: Kanshi abasobela ifyakuntanshi bakabaseka,

english: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
translation: Nomba ine Yawe alimpeelesha amaka,

english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
translation: Umfweni kuno, mwe ntungulushi sha ba ŋanda yakwa Yakobo,

english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
translation: Mu nshiku shakulekelesha,

english: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
translation: Yoeli 3:10

english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
translation: Nomba, abantu ba mishobo iyingi nabalongana kukwisa kulwisha iwe.

english: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
translation: Kwena abantu ba iyi mitundu tabeshibe icili mu mano yakwa Yawe.

english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to the LORD, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;
translation: Esaya 2:2-4

english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
translation: Ena eukapingula imishobo iyingi,

english: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.
translation: Abantu bonse umo umo bakalaikalila ku matwi tondolo,

english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
translation: Nangu abantu ba mishobo yonse baleendela mwishina lya milungu yabo no kulaipepa,

english: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
translation: Abantu abalemana nkabacita ukuba abantu bandi abashalapo,

english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
translation: Na iwe we lupungu ulwakulondelapo impaanga,

english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?
translation: Nga mulandu nshi ulepundila ifi pakuloosha?

english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu, longanikeni ifita,

english: “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.
translation: Nkonaula imisumba iyaba muli cino calo cenu,

english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
translation: Nkonaula na manga yenu yonse,

english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
translation: Nkonaula utulubi twenu

english: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
translation: Nkabongolola inceshi sha mulungu Ashera ishaba muli cino calo cenu,

english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
translation: Lelo iwe Betelemu Efulata,

english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
translation: Eico kanshi Yawe akatala akalekeleshe abantu bakwe,

english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
translation: Elyo nao akeminina no kulacema abantu bakwe na maka ayakwatako Yawe,

english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
translation: Kabili eukaba umutende wabo.

english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
translation: Mateo 2:6

english: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.
translation: Abakwa Yakobo abakashalapo bakekala pakati ka mishobo iyingi,

english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
translation: Icite 10:8-11

english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
translation: Bakalwisha no kucimfya abalwani babo bonse,

english: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
translation: Umfweni ifyo Yawe alelanda pa bena Israeli.

english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
translation: Bushe ine kuti nabelela shani abo bantu uluse,

english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
translation: Abakankala ba mu musumba baba no buluku,

english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
translation: Kanshi ine nomba natampako ukulamukanda imwe,

english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
translation: Ukulya kwena mwakulalya, nomba tamwaleikuta nakalya,

english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
translation: Mwakulatanda iŋanu shenu,

english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”
translation: Imwe mukonkelelafye imisango ibi iya mfumu Omuri

english: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
translation: Imwe mwe mpili, mwe mifula ya pe iyaikasha isonde lyonse,

english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
translation: Ine nalimufumishe mu calo ca Egupto.

english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
translation: Mwe bantu bandi, ibukisheni ifyo Balaki imfumu ya bena Moabu apangile ukumucita,

english: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
translation: Bushe finshi ifyo ine ningatwalila Yawe wa mu mulu,

english: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
translation: Bushe Yawe kuti atemwa nga namutwalila basukusuku amakana na makana,

english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
translation: Awe iyoo, we muntu, Yawe alikwebelapo ifintu ifyawama.

english: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
translation: Yawe uyo alebilikisha abena musumba ati,

english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
translation: Awe ine nalishama mwe!

english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
translation: Abalwani bandi nabo bakamonako,

english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Yerusalemu, ubushiku bumo bukafika,

english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku abantu bakabwelela kuli iwe,

english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
translation: Lelo kwena isonde lyonse likasanguka amatololo,

english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
translation: We Yawe, wingalacema abantu bobe ku nkoto yobe,

english: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
translation: Nkamulanga ifipeshamano,

english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo bakaimwena,

english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.
translation: Bakalamyanga iloba nge nsoka,

english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
translation: Mulungu nshi uwalingana na iwe,

english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
translation: Ali nokubwekeshapo ukutucitila inkumbu,

english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
translation: Muli cino calo tamushele muntu wacishinka nelyo umo nakalya,

english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
translation: Uli nokulanga icishinka kuli Yakobo,

english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
translation: Bonsefye ni ncenjeshi shakantu kukucita ifyabipa.

english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
translation: Muli abo uwawamishapo aba nga nkololo,

english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
translation: Tecakwesha kulacetekela mwina mupalamano obe,

english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
translation: Muno nshiku umwana umwaume alecita wishi nge cipuba,

english: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
translation: Nomba ine nakulalolela Yawe.

english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
translation: Abalwani bandi belasamwa pali ine

english: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
translation: Apo ine nalibifya kuli Yawe,

english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
translation: Elyo Yesu afumine kuli ilya ncende, aile mu calo ca Yudeya na kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani. Kabili amabumba yalongana uko ali, elyo nao alabafunda nge fintu alecita lyonse.

english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
translation: Nomba ilyo bali mu ŋanda, abasambi bamwipusha nakabili pali uyu mulandu.

english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Umwaume uwaleka umukashi wakwe, aya upa na umbi, ninshi abembukila umukashi wakwe.

english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
translation: No mwanakashi nao nga afuma ku mulume wakwe, aya upwa ku mwaume umbi, ninshi nao lubembu acita.”

english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
translation: Abantu baleta utwaice pakuti atukumye, lelo abasambi balabakalipila.

english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
translation: Ilyo Yesu amona ifi, afulwa, abeba ati, “Lekeni utwaice twise uko ndi, mwitulesha iyoo. Pantu ababa ngotu twaice, e bene ba Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.

english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, umuntu onse uushipokelela Bufumu bwakwa Lesa nga kaice, takengilemo nakalya.”

english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
translation: Elyo Yesu afukatila utwaice, atutambalikilapo amaboko, atupaala.

english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
translation: Kabili Yesu aimine ubulendo, elyo umuntu aisa ulubilo amufukamina, amwipusha ati, “Kafundisha musuma, bushe ni finshi ndi nokucita pakumona umweo wape?”

english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Cinshi ico wanjebela ukuti ndi musuma? Takwaba musuma nelyo umo, kanofye Lesa eka.

english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
translation: Walishiba amafunde ayatila, ‘Wilaipaya, wilabembuka, wilaiba, wilabepesha babiyo, wilafinsha, ulecindika wiso na noko.’ ”

english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
translation: Abafalise bamo baisa uko ali balamwesha abati, “Bushe calisuminishiwa umwaume ukuleka umukashi wakwe?”

english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
translation: Nao amwasuka ati, “Kafundisha, ala ifi fyonse ndafikonka ukufumafye ku bwaice bwandi.”

english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
translation: Yesu amulolekesha, amutemwa. Amweba ati, “Wabulishapo cimo. Kabiye, kashitishe fyonse ifyo wakwata, upeele ne ndalama ku balanda, lyena ninshi ukakwata icuma mu mulu. Elyo wise unkonke.”

english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
translation: Ilyo aumfwa ifi, wena aikatwa no bulanda. Afuma aya alelanguluka, pantu ali ne fyuma ifingi.

english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”
translation: Elyo Yesu alatandanya amenso, aeba na basambi bakwe ati, “Yangu ifyo cayafya ku bakwata ifyuma ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa!”

english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
translation: Icite 2:24

english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Ala cayangukapo ingamila ukupula mu linso lya nshindano, ukucila uwafyuma ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
translation: Awe abasambi basunguka nganshi balaipushanya abati, “Nga kanshi nani engapusuka?”

english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
translation: Icite 1:27

english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”
translation: Petelo epakumweba ati, “Mona ifwe twalisha fyonse twalikukonka!”

english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Icine cine ndemweba, takuli nangu umo uwasha iŋanda, nangu bamunyina, nangu inkashi, nangu nyina, nangu wishi, nangu abana, nangu amabala pa mulandu wa ine no wa Mbila Nsuma,

english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Lifunde nshi Mose amwebele?”

english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
translation: uushakapokelepo mu nshita ya nomba imiku umwanda umo, amayanda na bamunyina, inkashi, abana, na mabala. Lelo kwena na macushipo. Elyo mu nshita ikesa akamona umweo wape.

english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
translation: Lelo abengi abantanshi bakaba abakulekelesha, na bakulekelesha bakaba e bantanshi.”

english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
translation: Mateo 5:32

english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
translation: Abeba ati, “Moneni, twalaya ku Yerusalemu, elyo Umwana wa muntu alaya poswa kuli bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde. Balaya mupingwila ukufwa no kumuposa mu minwe ya Benafyalo.

english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
translation: Bakamuseka, bakamusaka amate, bakamuma ifikoti no kumwipaya. Lelo panuma ya nshiku shitatu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
translation: Elyo Yakobo na Yoani bamwana Sebede baisa, bapalamina kuli Yesu. Bamweba abati, “Kafundisha, tulefwaya utucitile ico twalalomba.”

english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation: Nao abepusha ati, “Cinshi ico mulefwaya ukuti mucitile?”

english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Utusuminishe ukuti umo akaleikala ku kulyo kobe, umbi ku kuso kobe mu Bufumu bobe.”

english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
translation: Yesu abeba ati, “Tamwishibe ico mulelomba. Bushe kuti mwanwena mu lukombo lwa macushi ndi nokunwenamo, nangu bushe kuti mwabatishiwa ulubatisho lwa macushi ndi nokubatishiwako?”

english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ee kuti twacita.” Yesu abeba ati, “Ulukombo ndi nokunwenamo, na imwe elo mukanwenamo, no lubatisho ndi nokubatishiwako, na imwe elo mukabatishiwako.

english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
translation: Nabo abati, “Mose alisuminishe umwaume ukulemba kalata wakumulekelapo, epakumutamfya.”

english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
translation: Nomba ukwikala ku kulyo kwandi nangu ku kuso kwandi, teine mpeela, fya yabo Lesa afipekanishisha.”

english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
translation: Ilyo abasambi bambi ikumi limo baumfwa ifi, bafulilwa Yakobo na Yoani.

english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
translation: Yesu abeta bonse, alabeba ati, “Mwalishiba ukuti mu Benafyalo abo batila e bashamfumu, balomya ubufumu bwabo, na bakalamba babo nabo babateeka no mucusha.

english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
translation: Imwe tacili nakuba ifi iyoo. Lelo pali imwe, onse uulefwaya ukuba umukalamba, abe ewakumutumika.

english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
translation: Kabili onse uulefwaya ukuba uwantanshi, abe umusha wa bonse.

english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
translation: Pantu no Mwana wa muntu wine taisa pakuti bamutumike, lelo ni kukutumika no kuleka umweo wakwe pakupususha abengi.”

english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
translation: Awe bafikile ku Yeriko. Ilyo Yesu alafuma mu Yeriko pamo na basambi bakwe ne bumba ilikalamba, impofu Batimeo, emukuti mwana Timeo, ali mumbali ya nshila naikala alelomba.

english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
translation: Cilya aumfwa ukuti ni Yesu wa ku Nasaleti, atendeka ukupunda ati, “Yesu Mwana Davidi, shi winganangulukilako!”

english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
translation: Nomba abengi balaikalipila pakuti italale. Lelo yena elyo yacila ukupunda aiti, “We Mwana Davidi shi winganangulukilako!”

english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
translation: Awe Yesu aiminina abeba ati, “Mwiteni ese kuno.” Elyo nabo baita impofu, balayeba abati, “Teka umutima, ima, alekwita.”

english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
translation: Elyo Yesu abasuka ati, “Ico Mose amulembele ili ifunde, mulandu wakumalala kwa mitima yenu.

english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
translation: Awe yaposa icakufimbana caiko, yatoloka ibaka, yaya na kuli Yesu.

english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
translation: Yesu aipusha impofu ati, “Cinshi ico ulefwaya ukuti nkucitile?” Impofu yamweba aiti, “Kafundisha, ndefwaya ukulalolesha.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
translation: Elyo Yesu ayeba ati, “Kabiye icisumino cobe ecakuposha.” Awe apopene atendeka ukulolesha, alakonka na Yesu uko aleya.

english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
translation: Lelo pa citendekelo ilyo Lesa abumbile fyonse, abumbile umwaume no mwanakashi.

english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
translation: ‘Kanshi eco umwaume ashiila wishi na nyina no kuminkana no mukashi wakwe,

english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
translation: elyo aba babili baba umubili umo.’ Kanshi nomba tabali babili, balifye umubili umo.

english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
translation: Ico Lesa alundinkanya, umuntu ecilekanya.”

english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples
translation: Cilya Yesu na basambi bakwe baya balepalama ku Yerusalemu, bafika na pa Betifage na Betani mupepi no lupili lwa Miolifa. Yesu atuma abasambi bakwe babili, abeba ati,

english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
translation: Nabupaalwe ubufumu buleisa ubwakwa shifwe Davidi! Lumbanyeni Lesa Mukulu!”

english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
translation: Awe Yesu afika mu Yerusalemu aingila na mwi Tempele. Alolesha fyonse ifyalimo, nomba ico akasuba kalasumbila kukuwa, afumamo, aya ku Betani na basambi ikumi limo na babili.

english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo, ilyo balebwela ukufuma ku Betani, Yesu insala yamwikata.

english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
translation: Cilya amona umukunyu akatalamukila uli na mabula ayalelema, eko aya kukumona nga walitwala. Nomba cilya afikako, asangakofye amabula yeka yeka, pantu tayali nshita amakunyu yatwalilapo.

english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
translation: Elyo aeba umukunyu ati, “Kwikaba nelyo umo uwakulyako nakabili icitwalo kuli iwe.” Na basambi bakwe baleumfwa uko alesosa ifi.

english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
translation: Awe bafika mu Yerusalemu. Yesu aingila mwi Tempele, atendeka no kutamfisha panse abaleshitishamo na baleshita ifintu. Kabili alapenaula amatebulo ya balekabushanya indalama, ne fipuna fya baleshitisha inkunda.

english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
translation: Elyo alesha na bonse abalesenda ifipe ukupita mwi Tempele.

english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
translation: Kabili alabafunda, alabeba ati, “Bushe tacalembwa ukuti, ‘Iŋanda yandi ikalaitwa ukuti ni ŋanda iyakupepelamo abantu aba mishobo yonse?’ Nomba imwe mwaisangula icifulo ca bapupu!”

english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
translation: Kanshi bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde ilyo batesha ifi, balafwailisha inshila iyakuti bengamwipailamo. Pantu balemutiina ico abantu bonse balepapa imifundile yakwe.

english: When evening came, he went out of the city.
translation: Ilyo kwaba icungulo, awe afuma mu musumba.

english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.
translation: “Kabiyeni pa mushi ulya pantanshi. Kabili pakwingilafye pene muleya sanga umwana wa punda nakulikwa, uo umuntu ashatala aninapo. Mumukakule, mumulete kuno.

english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
translation: Nomba ilyo balepitapo ulucelo, bamona ukuti umukunyu nauma onse ukufikafye na ku mishila.

english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
translation: Elyo Petelo aibukisha. Aeba na Yesu ati, “Kafundisha, shimona ulya mukunyu walapishe nauma!”

english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Mube ne cisumino muli Lesa.

english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, umuntu nga aeba ulupili ulu ati, fuma apa uipose muli bemba, elyo no kutwishika taletwishika mu mutima wakwe, lelo nasumina ukuti ico alanda calacitika, ninshi cili nokucitika.

english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
translation: Eico kanshi ndemweba nati, fyonse ifyo mwingalomba mu mapepo, mwasumina nokuti namupeelwa, ninshi mukapeelwa.

english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
translation: Kabili babwelelamo ku Yerusalemu. Nomba ilyo Yesu aleendauka mwi Tempele, bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde na bakalamba baisa uko ali, balamwipusha abati,

english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
translation: “Bushe ni ku maka nshi ucitilako ifi fintu? Nangu nani wakupeela amaka yakucita ifi fintu?”

english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Na ine nalamwipushapo icipusho cimo. Nga mwanjasuka, elyo na ine nalamweba ukufuma amaka ncitilako ifi fintu.

english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
translation: Umo nga amwipusha ati, ‘Cinshi mwalakakwila umwana wa punda?’ Musose amuti, ‘Ni Mfumu eilemufwaya, kabili yalamubwesha nombalinefye.’ ”

english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
translation: Bushe ulubatisho lwakwa Yoani lwafumine ku mulu nangu ni ku bantu? Njasukeni.”

english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
translation: Awe balapingushanya abati, “Nga twatila lwafumine ku mulu, ninshi aletweba ati, ngeco mushamusuminine cinshi?

english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
translation: Conse nga twati ni ku bantu, awe abantu tabatupanye, pantu bonse balishininkisha ukuti Yoani ali kasesema icine cine.”

english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
translation: Kanshi epakwasuka Yesu abati, “Awe tatwishibe.” Yesu nao abeba ati, “Kanshi na ine nshamwebe ukufuma amaka ncitilako ifi fintu.”

english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
translation: Awe baima, baya sanga no mwana wa punda nabamukulikila pa mwinshi wa ŋanda panse mumbali ya musebo. Nomba cilya balakakula umwana wa punda,

english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
translation: abantu bamo abaimininepo balabepusha abati, “Cinshi ico mulecita, mulekakula umwana wa punda?”

english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
translation: Nabo bayasukafye ngomo Yesu acibebela, na bantu babaleka, balaya.

english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
translation: Awe baleta umwana wa punda kuli Yesu. Bayanshikapo ne nsalu shabo epo Yesu aikala.

english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
translation: Abantu abengi balayanshika insalu shabo mu nshila, elyo bambi nabo balayansa imisambo ya miti balekontola mu mpanga.

english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
translation: Abatangile na balekonka panuma balepunda abati, “Hosana, nakalebalika! Lesa apaale uyu waisa uo Imfumu yatuma!

english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
translation: Kabili Yesu atampa ukubomina imilumbe ati, “Umuntu umo alilimine ibala lya myangashi, apindako ne linga, aimbamo ne cakukaminamo umwangashi, akuulamo no lupungu. Elyo aseekesha ibala lya myangashi ku balimi, ena aima aya pa bulendo.

english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.
translation: Bushe tamwabelenga mu Malembo Yamushilo apo calembwa ukuti,

english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”
translation: Ifi efyo Imfumu yacita,

english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.
translation: Elyo balafwaya ukwikata Yesu, ico bailuka ukuti muli uyu mulumbe ebo alelandapo. Lelo batiina amabumba ya bantu, kanshi epakumusha, baya.

english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
translation: Kabili batumine Abafalise bamo na bena Herodi bamo kuli Yesu, abakuti bamone umwakumwikatila mu milandile yakwe.

english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
translation: Awe baisa uko ali, balamweba abati, “Kafundisha, twalishiba ukuti uli mufumacumi. Kabili tautiina muntu nelyo umo, pantu tawaba na kapatulula, lelo ufunda fyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya mu cishinka. Bushe calilinga ukulasonka umusonko kuli Kesalo nangu iyoo?

english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
translation: Bushe tulesonka nangu twilasonka?” Nomba Yesu ico eshibe ubucenjeshi bwabo, abeba ati, “Cinshi ico mulenjesesha? Leteni indalama monepo.”

english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
translation: Awe nabo bamuletela imo. Elyo abepusha ati, “Ngoyu balengelepo nefi ifyalembwapo fyakwani?” Bamwasuka abati, “Fyakwa Kesalo.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Kanshi akupeeleni Kesalo ifyakwa Kesalo, elyo akupeeleni Lesa ifyakwa Lesa.” Awe bapapa nganshi pafyo ayasuka.

english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,
translation: Elyo Abasaduki bamo baisa kuli Yesu. Abasaduki bena batila, “Takwaba kushukuka kwa bafwa.”

english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
translation: Balaipusha Yesu abati, “Kafundisha, ifwe Mose atulembele aya mashiwi ati, ‘Umuntu nga afwilwa munyina, uwasha umukashi nomba tafyelemo bana, ninshi uyu muntu ali nokuupa mukamfwilwa pakuti afyalileko munyina abana.’

english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
translation: Cilya ulwakulobolola ifisabo lwafika, umwine ibala atuma umusha wakwe ku balimi, pakuti ese amupokeleko ifisabo fimo pa fya mwibala lyakwe ilya myangashi.

english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
translation: Nomba kwaliko bamunyina abaume beka beka cine lubali. Umukalamba wabo ewabalilepo ukuupa umwanakashi, nomba afwafye ukwabula ukufyalamo umwana.

english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
translation: Uwacibili amupyana , lelo nao afwa ukwabula ukufyalamo umwana, no walenga batatu nao nifyo fine.

english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
translation: Nomba pakushukuka kwa bafwa, bushe akaba umukashi wakwani apo aupilwe kuli bonse cine lubali?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe teko ekuluba kwenu uko, pantu tamwaishiba Malembo Yamushilo, nangu amaka yakwe?

english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
translation: Pantu ilyo abantu bakabuuka ku bafwa, tabakaleupa nangu ukulaupwa, lelo bakaba nga bamalaika ba mu mulu.

english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wakubuuka ku bafwa, bushe tamwabelenga mu citabo cakwa Mose, pa mulandu wa cimpusa calebilima, ifyo Lesa aebele Mose ati, ‘Nine Lesa wakwa Abrahamu, Lesa wakwa Isaki, Lesa wakwa Yakobo?’

english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
translation: Kanshi ni Lesa wa bomi, te Lesa wa bafwa iyoo. Mwalilubafye apakalamba nganshi.”

english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
translation: Kafundisha wamafunde umo alyumfwileko uko balebikana ifikansa. Ilyo amona ukuti Yesu ayasuka bwino bwino, nao amwipusha ati, “Bushe ifunde ilyacila pa mafunde yonse lifunde nshi?”

english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ifunde ilyacilapo pali yonse nili ilyakutila, ‘Umfwa we Israeli, Imfumu Lesa wesu e Mfumu fye imo mpo epela.

english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
translation: Nomba bena bamwikata, bamupumaula, bamutamfya, aya iminwe nkutwa.

english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
translation: Na iwe uletemwa Imfumu Lesa obe no mutima obe onse, no mweo obe onse, na mano yobe yonse, na maka yobe yonse.’

english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
translation: Ifunde ilyakonkapo nili, ‘Uletemwa umubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.’ Takwaba ifunde limbi ilyacila pali aya.”

english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;
translation: Elyo kafundisha wamafunde amweba ati, “Kafundisha, wayasukafye bwino. Walungika mukusosa ukuti Lesa abafye umo, takwaba na umbi.

english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
translation: Kabili ukumutemwa no mutima obe onse, na mano yobe yonse, na maka yobe yonse, elyo no kutemwa umubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine, ifi fintu fyalicila amalambo yonse ayo balekela Lesa no kumocela.”

english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
translation: Cilya Yesu amona ukuti ayasukafye ifyamano, amweba ati, “Iwe uli mupepi no Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.” Awe nomba tapali nakabili uwakupama ukwipusha Yesu na fimbi.

english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
translation: Ilyo Yesu alefunda mwi Tempele, aipusha abantu ati, “Bushe cinshi ico bakafundisha bamafunde basosela abati, ‘Kristu ni Mwana Davidi?’

english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
translation: Ngefyo Davidi umwine ilyo asanikilwe na Mupashi Wamushilo asosele ati,

english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
translation: Nga kanshi apo Davidi umwine aita Kristu ati, ni Mfumu, bushe kanshi Kristu kuti aba shani mwane?” Na bantu ibumba ilikalamba basansamuka pakumfwa Yesu.

english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
translation: Elyo alabafunda ati, “Cenjeleni kuli bakafundisha bamafunde, abatemwa ukwendauka nabafwala imingila iyitali, nokuti abantu balebaposha mu mansa sha fisankano.

english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,
translation: Kabili basala ifipuna ificindamishepo mu sinagoga, elyo ne fipuna ifyamucinshi pa malila.

english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
translation: Kabili umwine ibala atumako umusha na umbi, lelo nao bamumaula ku mutwe no kumusebanya icabipisha nganshi.

english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
translation: Aba ebalila bamukamfwilwa ifyuma fyabo, kabili batemwa ukuilanga mukupepa amapepo ayatali. Ala aba bantu ebo Lesa akakandisha ukucila!”

english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
translation: Elyo Yesu aikala apalungatene ne cipao mwi Tempele. Alelolesha ifyo ibumba lya bantu lileposa indalama mu cipao. Abafyuma abengi baleposamo indalama ishingi.

english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
translation: Elyo paisa mukamfwilwa umo umupina, ena aposamo utundalama tubili.

english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
translation: Yesu aita abasambi bakwe, abeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine uyu mukamfwilwa umupina, aposamo ukucila bonse abaposelemo indalama mu cipao.

english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
translation: Pantu bonse abaposelemo indalama, bafumishe pa fingi, lelo uyu mukamfwilwa umupina wena aposamo tonse uto akwete utwakulilamo.”

english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
translation: Kabili atumako na umbi, wena bamwipaya. Kabili atuminekofye abengi, bamo babapumaula, bambi bena babepaya.

english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
translation: Asuka ashalafye no muntu umo umwana wakwe umwaume uo atemenwe nganshi. Pakulekelesha eo atumako ati, ‘Wena balaya mucindika.’

english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
translation: Lelo abalimi balaebana abati, ‘Ala impyani iyi. Aleni iseni tuipaye, ne bala likaba lyesu!’

english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
translation: Awe bamwikata, bamwipaya, bamuposa na kunse ye bala lya myangashi.”

english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
translation: Elyo Yesu aipusha ati, “Nga kanshi umwine ibala akacita shani? Akalofya abo balimi, akaseekesha ne bala lya myangashi kuli bambi.

english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
translation: Nomba cilya Yesu alefuma mwi Tempele, umusambi wakwe umo amwebele ati, “Kafundisha, shimona ifimabwe ubukulu! We fikuulwa ubusuma!”

english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
translation: Lelo ilyo ukupwa kwa calo takulafika, Imbila Nsuma ili nokubala yashimikilwa ku mishobo yonse.

english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
translation: Kabili ilyo bakalamwikata no kumusenda kukumulubulwisha, mwikalasakamana umwakuya landila. Mukalelandafye ifyo mwalangililwa pa nshita ine iyo, pantu temwe mukalalanda, lelo ni Mupashi Wamushilo eukalalanda.

english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
translation: Munyina akepaisha munyina, wishi nao mwane. Abana bakemina abafyashi babo no kubepaisha.

english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
translation: Abantu bonse bakamupata pa mulandu wa ine. Lelo uukashipikisha mpaka na ku mpela, eukapusuka.

english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
translation: “Ilyo mukamona umupamba wabonaushi, uli mu ncende ushili nakubamo, (uulebelenga naeluke) elyo abakaba mu Yudeya bakafulumukile ku mpili.

english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
translation: Uukaba pa mutenge wa ŋanda yakwe, ekeka ukuti aye buula ifintu fyakwe mu ŋanda.

english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
translation: Uukaba mwibala, ekabwela kukubuula insalu shakwe.

english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
translation: We shamo we ku banakashi abakaba pabukulu na bakalaonsha abana muli shilya nshiku!

english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.
translation: Mulelomba Lesa ukuti ifi fintu fiikacitika mu nshita yampepo.

english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
translation: Pantu ukufumafye apo Lesa abumbile icalo ukufika na pali nomba, tapatala apaba, kabili takwakatale akuba ubucushi ubwabipisha ngobo.

english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Bushe nifi fikuulwa fikalamba ulemona? Ala tapakashale libwe nangu limo pa mulu wa libiye, yakabongololwafye yonse.”

english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
translation: Kabili Imfumu aikaanacefyako isho nshiku, nga tekuti kube muntu nangu umo uwingapusuka. Lelo pa mulandu wa basalwa abo yaisalila iyine, yalicefyako isho nshiku.

english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
translation: “Elyo kabili umo nga amweba ati, ‘Moneni, Kristu uyu ali kuno, nangu moneni ulya ali kulya!’ mwikasumina.

english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
translation: Pantu kukamoneka bakristu babufi na bakasesema babufi. Bakalacita ifishibilo ne finjelengwe ifyakubepaikilako na basalwa nga cingacitika.

english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
translation: Kanshi imwe mube abailukila, namusokako libela.

english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
translation: “Nomba muli isho nshiku, ilyo ubo bucushi bukapita, elyo akasuba kakafiita, umweshi nao ukaleka ukubalika,

english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
translation: intanda nasho shikapona ku mulu, na maka ya mu mulu yakatenkana.

english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
translation: Elyo bakamona Umwana wa muntu uko aleisa mu makumbi na maka nganshi no bucindami.

english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
translation: Dan 9:27

english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
translation: “Kanshi ku mukunyu eko musambilile. Imisambo yauko itila nga yapuka ululembelya, ninshi mwaishiba ukuti amainsa yali mupepi.

english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
translation: Eifyo fine na imwe, nga mwamona ifi fintu fyalacitika, ninshi mukeshibe ukuti Kristu ali mupepi, alifye pa mwinshi.

english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
translation: Kabili cilya Yesu ekele pa lupili lwa Miolifa apalungatana ne Tempele, elyo Petelo, Yakobo, Yoani na Andele balamwipusha ilyo bali beka abati,

english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
translation: Ndemwebe cine cine ukuti, ino nkulo tayakapite, ninshi ifi fintu fyonse fyalicitika.

english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
translation: “Lelo tapaba uwaishiba ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika, nangu ni nshita ine. Bamalaika ba mu mulu tabaishiba, nangufye Umwana taishiba, kanofye Tata eka ewaishiba.

english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
translation: Mulecenjela mwikale abaiteyanya, pantu tamwishibe ilyo nshita ikafikila.

english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
translation: Caba ngo muntu uuleya pa bulendo, ilyo alasha iŋanda, apeela imilimo ku basha bakwe iyo bakulabomba cila muntu. Elyo akonkomesha malonda ukulalonda lyonse.

english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
translation: Kanshi mulelola, pantu tamwishibe ilyo umwine wa ŋanda akabwela. Nalimo ni ku cungulo, nangu pakati ka bushiku, nakalimo pali mukolwe wantanshi, nangu pa macaca.

english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
translation: Mulelola, epali amupumikisha, asanga muli mu tulo.

english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
translation: Ifyo ndemweba, ndeebafye bonse nati, mulelola!”

english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
translation: “Twebeko, bushe ifi fintu fikabako lilali? Elyo kabili cishibilo nshi tukeshibilako ukuti ifi fintu fyalafikila?”

english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
translation: Elyo Yesu atendeka ukubeba ati, “Mulecenjela pakuti umuntu nangu umo ekamubepaika.

english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
translation: Pantu abengi bakesa balesosa abati, ‘Nine Kristu,’ kabili bakabepa abengi.

english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
translation: Elyo mukomfwa inkondo ne ntulubundi sha nkondo, mwikasakamikwa. Ifi fintu fili nokucitika, lelo ukupwa kwa calo ninshi takulati.

english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
translation: Pantu umushobo umo ukemina umushobo ubiye, elyo ne mfumu imo ikemina imfumu ibiye. Kukaba ne finkukuma mu ncende ishalekana lekana, kabili kukaba ne fipowe. Ifi fyonse fikabafye icitendekelo ca macushi.

english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
translation: “Eico imwe mube abailukila. Pantu bakamutwala mu filye, kabili bakamuma ifikoti mu masinagoga. Bakamulubulwisha ku balashi na bashamfumu pa mulandu wa ine, pakuti mukabe bakambone bandi.

english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.
translation: Awe kwashelefye inshiku shibili kukusefya inshikunkulu ye Pasaka iya Cakucilila, ne nshikunkulu ya Mikate Ishatutumuka. Bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde balefwailisha ifyakwikata Yesu mu bucenjeshi, no kumwipaya.

english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
translation: Elyo Yuda wa ku Kelyoti, umo pa basole ikumi limo na babili, aile kuli bashimapepo bacindami, pakuti omfwane nabo ifyakuposa Yesu kuli bena.

english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
translation: Amaf 15:11

english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
translation: Ubushiku bwakubalilapo ubwakulyamo Imikate Ishatutumuka, ubo baleipayamo umwana wa mpaanga ukuba ilambo lye Pasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, abasambi baipwishe Yesu abati, “Bushe ni kwi ulefwaya tuye tukupekanishishe ukwakulila Ipasaka?”

english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,
translation: Elyo atumapo abasambi bakwe babili, abeba ati, “Kabiyeni mu musumba, muleya kumana no mwaume nasenda umutondo wa menshi. Muye mukonka na mu ŋanda aleya ingila.

english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
translation: Elyo muye eba umwine ŋanda amuti, ‘Kafundisha atila ati, bushe umuputule wandi uli kwi umwakuti njise ndile Ipasaka na basambi bandi?’

english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
translation: Nao alaya mulanga umuputule wa pamulu, uukulu, nabawansa, nauteyanishiwa. Umo mwine emo mutupekanishishe.”

english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
translation: Awe abasambi baima, baya mu musumba, baya sanga ne fintu fyonse ngomo Yesu abebele. Nabo epakupekanya ne Pasaka.

english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
translation: Cilya kwaba icungulo, Yesu na basambi ikumi limo na babili baya kulya kwine.

english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
translation: Ilyo bandeme pakulya, Yesu asosa ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, umo pali imwe uo tulelya nankwe alamposa ku balwani.”

english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
translation: Nabo baikatwa no bulanda, balamwipusha umo umo abati, “Bushe nine?”

english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
translation: Balasosa abati, “Awe mu nshikunkulu mwena temo, epali kwaisa buuka icimfulunganya mu bantu.”

english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Ni umo pali imwe ikumi limo na babili, uo nalatumpika nankwe pamo mu mbale.

english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
translation: Ukuba kwena Umwana wa muntu alaya kukufwa nga mulya mwine calembelwa. Lelo umuntu walaposa Umwana wa muntu, ena alishama! Uyu muntu akaanafyalwa nga kuti camuwamina!”

english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
translation: Ilyo bali pakulya, Yesu abuulile umukate, atasha Lesa, aumokaula, apeela na basambi bakwe ati, “Buuleni, uyu mubili wandi.”

english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
translation: Elyo abuula ulukombo, atasha Lesa, kabili abapeela bonse banwamo.

english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
translation: Abeba ati, “Uyu mulopa wandi uwa cipangano, uulesuuma pa mulandu wa bengi.

english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
translation: Namweba icine cine, nshakanwe nakabili ifya ku fisabo fya myangashi, mpaka no bushiku bulya ilyo nkanwa umwangashi upya mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa.”

english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
translation: Kabili cilya bapwa ukwimba ulwimbo, bafumamo, baya na ku lupili lwa Miolifa.

english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Imwe bonse mulembutuka. Pantu calilembwa ukuti, ‘Nkakoma kacema, ne mpaanga shikapashika!’

english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
translation: Nomba ilyo nkabuuka ku bafwa nkamutangilila ku Galile.”

english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
translation: Petelo epakumwankula ati, “Nelyo bonse balekubutuka, awe ine, iyoo!”

english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
translation: Yesu ali mu Betani mu ŋanda yakwa Simoni Wafibashi. Ilyo ali pakulya, mwaisa umwanakashi nasenda ibotolo umwali amafuta aya cena cisuma ayaleitwa nardi, aya mutengo ukalamba nganshi. Amokolapo inciliko pebotolo, akonkomwena na mafuta pa mutwe wakwa Yesu.

english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Ndekweba icine cine, lelo line, buno bwine bushiku, mukolwe talati alile imiku ibili, ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.”

english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
translation: Lelo Petelo abwekeshapo, alandikisha ati, “Ine, nshakukaane nakalya nga kufwa tulefwa nobe!” Awe na bambi bonse balandafye cimo cine.

english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
translation: Elyo Yesu na basambi bakwe baya ku ncende iyo beta Getisemani. Yesu abeba ati, “Ikaleni pano pa nshita ndepepa.”

english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
translation: Asendapo Petelo, Yakobo na Yoani, aya nabo. Elyo atampa ukulanguluka nganshi, no bulanda bwamwikata.

english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
translation: Kabili aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Ine umutima wandi waikatwa no bulanda ni cikangafye mfwe. Shaleni pano, mulelola.”

english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
translation: Awe ati endeleleko cinono akatalamukila, awa panshi, alapepa ukuti iyi inshita ingapitila ukutali nga cingalinga.

english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
translation: Asosa ati, “Abba, Tata, Tata ee, iwe ifintu fyonse kuti wacita, mpokololako kuli ubu bucushi. Lelo ifyo ine ndefwaya tefyo, kanofye ifyo iwe ulefwaya.”

english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
translation: Kabinge abwelela ku basambi bakwe, asanga bali mu tulo. Elyo aeba Petelo ati, “Simoni bushe naulala mwa? Bushe wafilwa ukulola pa nsa imofye?

english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
translation: Mulelola no kupepa mulepepa, epakukanawila mu ntunko. Umutima wena ulefwaya, lelo umubili wena naunakuka.”

english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
translation: Nakabili Yesu aya mukupepa, alasosafye amashiwi yamo yene.

english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
translation: Lelo bamo abalimo bafulwa, balaebana abati, “Cinshi balaonawila ifi amafuta?

english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
translation: Nakabili abwelela ku basambi, asanga bali mu tulo, pantu amenso yabo nayekatwa ku tulo, baluba ne cakumwasuka.

english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
translation: Kabili abwela umuku wabutatu, alabeba ati, “Bushe kanshi na nomba mucili mu tulo, muletuusha? Capwa! Inshita yafika! Moneni, Umwana wa muntu alaposwa mu minwe ya bantu babi.

english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
translation: Imeni, natuleya uwakumposa alafika!”

english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
