translation: Ilyo line ninshi Yesu acili alelanda, Yuda, umo uwa pa basole ikumi limo na babili afika. Aisa ne bumba lya bantu, nabaipangasha ne mpanga ne nkonto, bafuma kuli bashimapepo bacindami, bakafundisha bamafunde na bakalamba.

english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
translation: Uwakuposa Yesu wena ninshi nabapeela icishibilo ati, “Uo nalaya posha pa kumutomona euyo wine. Mumwikate no kumusopa bwino pakumusenda.”

english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
translation: Apopene cilya Yuda afika, alungama kuli Yesu, asosa ati, “Mwapoleni Kafundisha!” Elyo amutomona.

english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
translation: Awe bafukukila pali Yesu, bamwikata.

english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
translation: Elyo umo pa beminine mupepi asomona ulupanga, akoma umusha wakwa Shimapepo mukalamba amusempako ukutwi.

english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
translation: Elyo Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe ine ndi cipondo pakuti mwise ne mpanga ne nkonto kukunjikata?

english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
translation: Inshiku shonse twaleba na imwe ndefunda mwi Tempele, nokuti munjikate iyoo. Nomba cisuma, epakuti ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo fifikilishiwe.”

english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.
translation: Aya mafuta nga kuti bayashitisha pa ndalama ukucila imyanda itatu, elyo bashipeela na ku balanda.” Awe bailishanya nganshi pali uyu mwanakashi.

english: They all left him, and fled.
translation: Awe abasambi bakwe bonse bamusha eka bafulumuka.

english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
translation: Elyo pali umulumendo umo uwalekonka Yesu, afwelefye insalu yeka yeka. Wena ilyo bamwikata,

english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
translation: abapusumuka, asha insalu afulumuka ubwamba.

english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
translation: Awe basendele Yesu bamutwala kuli Shimapepo mukalamba. Elyo bashimapepo bacindami, abakalamba na bakafundisha bamafunde balongana bonse.

english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
translation: Petelo wena alekonka Yesu lutonuma, asuka aingila na mu lubansa lwe sano lyakwa Shimapepo mukalamba. Awe aikala na pekele ifita fya mwi Tempele, alaonta no mulilo.

english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami bonse na bashicilye bene bonse balafwailisha imilandu Yesu acita, pakuti bamupingwilepo ukufwa, lelo bafilililwafye.

english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
translation: Kwena pali bakambone babufi abengi abalandile ifingi ifyakubepesha Yesu. Lelo ifyo balelanda fyalepusana.

english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
translation: Kabili bambi nabo baiminina, balabepesha Yesu abati,

english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
translation: “Ifwe twalyumfwile uko alesosa ati, nkabongolole Tempele ilyakuulwa na bantu, elyo pa nshiku shitatu nkakuulapo limbi ilishakakuulwe na bantu.”

english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
translation: Lelo na pali uyu wine mulandu ifyo balesosa fyalipusene.

english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
translation: Yesu wena asosa ati, “Mulekeni! Cinshi ico mwalamusakamikila? Ala namombela umulimo usuma nganshi.

english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
translation: Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba aiminina mu lwalala aipusha Yesu ati, “Tauleyasuka nelyo cimo? Ngeyi milandu yonse aba bantu balekwebelela?”

english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
translation: Nomba Yesu wena aikalafye, no kwasukapo nakalya. Shimapepo mukalamba nakabili amwipusha ati, “Bushe niwe Kristu Umwana wakwa Lesa Umwinakulumbwa?”

english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
translation: Yesu amwasuka ati, “Ee nine wine. Kabili mukamona Umwana wa muntu naikala lwa ku kulyo kwa Mwine wa maka yonse, noko aleisa pa makumbi ya mu mulu.”

english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
translation: Elyo Shimapepo mukalamba alepula insalu shakwe, ati nokuti, “Bushe cinshi tulefwaila bakambone na bambi?

english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
translation: Mwayumfwila mwe bene ifyo asaalula Lesa! Nga imwe muletipo shani?” Awe bonse bapingula ukuti alingilefye ukufwa.

english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
translation: Elyo bamo batendeka ukumusaka amate, bamukaka insalu pa menso, balamututaulamo ififunshi baleti, “Sesema tumfwe, nani wakuma!” Ifita fya mwi Tempele nafyo fyamubula fyamuma nganshi.

english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
translation: Kanshi Petelo ali pa lubansa mwisamba. Elyo kwaisa umukashana umubomfi wakwa Shimapepo mukalamba.

english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
translation: Amona Petelo aleonta umulilo, amulolekesha, amweba ati, “Na iwe waciba pamo na Yesu umwina Nasaleti!”

english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
translation: Lelo wena akaana ati, “Ine nshishibe nangu ukumfwa ico ulelanda umo cilolele.” Petelo aya mu lukungu. Awe na mukolwe alila.

english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
translation: Ulya mukashana umubomfi, amumona nakabili atendeka ukulaeba abemininepo ati, “Uyu nao munabo.”

english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
translation: Abalanda bena mwakulaba nabo lyonse, kabili lyonse ilyo mulefwaya, kuti mwabafwilisha. Lelo ine tatwakabe na imwe lyonse.

english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
translation: Awe nakabili Petelo akaana. Kabili cilya papita akashita, abemininepo balaeba Petelo abati, “Cine cine uli munabo, pantu uli mwina Galile.”

english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
translation: Lelo ena atampa ukulaitipwila no kulapa ati, “Ine uyo muntu mulelandapo nshimwishibe iyoo!”

english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
translation: Awe apopene mukolwe alila umuku walenga ibili. Elyo Petelo aibukisha ifyo Yesu acimweba ati, “Ilyo mukolwe talalila umuku wabubili ninshi iwe naunkaana imiku itatu.” Awe atimuka na mu filamba, alalila no kulila.

english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi nabomba ukulingana nefyo engabomba. Nasuba umubili wandi libela pakuupekanya kukushiikwa.

english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
translation: Ndemweba icine cine, konse uko bakalashimika Imbila Nsuma pano isonde ponse, bakalashimika ne fyacita uyu mwanakashi, pakumwibukisha.”

english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
translation: Cilya bwaca ulucelo, bashimapepo bacindami, pamo na bakalamba, bakafundisha bamafunde na bashicilye bonse, balongene balepandana ifyakucita. Awe bakaka Yesu, bamusenda, bamutwala na kuli Pilato.

english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
translation: Pilato alishibe ukuti ni ku mufimbilafye bashimapepo bacindami bamuletele Yesu.

english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
translation: Nomba bashimapepo bacindami balasokawila ibumba ukuti lilombe Pilato abakakwile Balaba.

english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
translation: Pilato kabili abepusha ati, “Nga kanshi nalacita shani noyu mutila ni mfumu ya Bayuda?”

english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
translation: Nabo balapundafye abati, “Mutanikenifye!”

english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
translation: Pilato abepusha ati, “Nga kanshi cinshi ico abifya?” Nabo elyo bacishamo ukupunda abati, “Mutanikenifye!”

english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
translation: Kanshi Pilato ico alefwaya ukusansamusha ibumba, abakakwila Balaba. Abeba no kuma Yesu ifikoti, elyo abalubwila ukuti baye mutanika.

english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
translation: Elyo ifita fyatwala Yesu mukati ka lubansa lwa mwisano, fyalonganya ne mpuka yonse iya fita.

english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
translation: Fyamufwika umwingila wakashika, fyalema iŋana ya myunga, fyamufwika na ku mutwe.

english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
translation: Elyo fyatendeka ukulamuposha fileti, “Tupole Mulopwe, we mfumu ya Bayuda!”

english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
translation: Fyalamufupaula ne tete ku mutwe, fyalamusaka amate. Kabili fyalamufukamina pakumutotela.

english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
translation: Elyo Pilato amwipusha ati, “Bushe iwe niwe mfumu ya Bayuda?” Yesu amwasuka ati, “Nausosa.”

english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
translation: Ilyo fyaleka ukumupumya, fyamufuula umwingila wakashika, fyamufwika ne nsalu shakwe. Elyo fyamutwala kunse kukumutanika.

english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.
translation: Mu nshila bakumanya umuntu alepita ukufuma mu mpanga, Simoni umwina Kurene, wishi wakwa Alekisanda na Rufusi, eo bapatikisha ukumusendelako umusalaba.

english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
translation: Elyo batwala Yesu ku ncende iyo beta Gologota, emukutila, “Pa cipanga.”

english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
translation: Elyo bamupeela no mwangashi uo basakenyemo umuti muri, nomba akaana ukunwa.

english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
translation: Awe elyo bamutanika. Nomba pakwakana ifyakufwala fyakwe pena, balapendula pakumona ico cila muntu alebuulapo.

english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.
translation: Bamutanike cilya akasuba kasansama pa nshita ya 09:00.

english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
translation: Umulandu walembelwepo uo bamwipailepo wakuti, “Ni Mfumu ya Bayuda.”

english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
translation: Kabinge batanike pamo nankwe ifipondo fibili, cimo ku kulyo cimbi naco ku kuso.

english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
translation: Epakufikilisha ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo ayakuti, “Apendelwe pamo ne fipondo.”

english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
translation: Kanshi abantu abalepitapo balemutuka balekunta ne mitwe balati, “Eya! Tewe waleti, ‘nkabongolole Tempele, elyo nkalikuula mu nshiku shitatu?’

english: The chief priests accused him of many things.
translation: Bashimapepo bacindami bena balamwebelela imilandu iyingi.

english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
translation: Kanshi ipusushe we mwine, ika na pa musalaba!”

english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
translation: Lekeni Kristu Imfumu ya bena Israeli ike pa musalaba uleke tumone, tusumine!” Kabili nabo bene batanikwe nankwe, nabo balamusaalula.

english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
translation: Cilya akasuba kafikile pakati ka mutwe pa nshita ya 12:00, imfifi yakupile icalo conse, ukufikafye na lilya kasendeme pa nshita ya 15:00.

english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
translation: Elyo cilya akasuba kasendama pa nshita ya 15:00, Yesu apunda ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakatani?” Ekutila, “Lesa wandi, Lesa wandi, cinshi wandekelesesha?”

english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
translation: Elyo abantu bamo abaiminine mupepi ilyo baumfwa, balasosa abati, “Umfweni, aleita Eliya!”

english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
translation: Elyo umo abutuka, aya tumpika umwepu mu mwangashi uwakantuka, autunga na kwitete, amutambika ukuti anwe. Asosa nokuti, “Pembeleni, lekeni tumone Eliya nga alaisa mwishapo!”

english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
translation: Elyo Yesu apunda ishiwi ilikalamba aleka no mweo.

english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
translation: Awe icisalu balecinga mwi Tempele calepuka pakati, ukufuma pamulu ukufika na panshi.

english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
translation: Elyo umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo uwaiminine apalungatene na Yesu, pakumona umusango afwilamo, asosa ati, “Cine cine uyu muntu ni Mwana Lesa.”

english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
translation: Pilato nakabili aipusha Yesu ati, “Bushe tawayasukepo nelyo cimo? Mona imilandu ubwingi balekwebelela iwe!”

english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
translation: Kwali na banakashi bamo abaiminine akatalamukila baletamba. Pali aba, palipo Maria Mandalena, bambi ni Maria nyina wakwa Yakobo mwaice na Yose, elyo na Salome.

english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
translation: Aba banakashi ebalekonka Yesu no kumutangata ilyo ali mu Galile. Elyo kwalifye abanakashi abengi abaishile nankwe ku Yerusalemu.

english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
translation: Nomba bwali bushiku bwakupekanya, emukutila pa bushiku bwaletangilile Sabata.

english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
translation: Mu nshita ya cungulo kwaishile Yosefu wa ku Alimateya, shicilye umo uwacindikwe nganshi. Nao wine alelolela ukwisa kwa Bufumu bwakwa Lesa. Aya napama kuli Pilato, aya lomba icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
translation: Awe Pilato asunguka pakumfwa ukuti Yesu nafwa kale. Elyo aita umukalamba wa fita umwanda umo, alamwipusha nga cacine Yesu nafwa kale.

english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
translation: Ilyo aumfwa ku mukalamba wa fita umwanda umo ukuti nifyo fine, Pilato asuminisha ukupeela Yosefu icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
translation: Yosefu nao ashita insalu iyabuuta. Asamuna icitumbi cakwa Yesu, acipomba mu nsalu, acibika mu nindi iyo bafukwile mu cilibwe. Elyo akunkulushishapo ilibwe pa mwinshi wa nindi.

english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
translation: Maria Mandalena na Maria nyina wakwa Yose balemonako umo balemubika.

english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
translation: Lelo Yesu tewakwasukapo nelyo cimo. Awe Pilato camupesha amano.

english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
translation: Nomba cila nshikunkulu ye Pasaka iya Cakucilila, Pilato alebakakwilapo lyonse umufungwa umo uo abantu balefwaya.

english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
translation: Kanshi kwaliko umuntu umo uo baleita Balaba, uo baposele mu cifungo pamo na babiye ico baipeye abantu ilyo balelwisha ubuteko.

english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
translation: Elyo ibumba lyaisa kuli Pilato, lyalamulomba ukuti acite ifyo abacitila lyonse.

english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
translation: Pilato nao abepusha ati, “Bushe mulefwaya ukuti mukakwile imfumu ya Bayuda?”

english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
translation: Ilyo ubushiku bwe Sabata bwapitile, Maria Mandalena, Maria nyina wakwa Yakobo, na Salome bashitile amafuta ya cena icisuma pakuti baye basube icitumbi cakwa Yesu.

english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
translation: Nao epakuya shimikilako abo Yesu aleenda nabo abaleloosha no kulila.

english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
translation: Nomba bena nangu baumfwile kuli Maria Mandalena ukuti Yesu nakabili ali umumi elyo no kumumona namumona, nalyo line tabasumine.

english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
translation: Kabili panuma Yesu aisa monekela mu musango umbi ku basambi babili abaleya mu mpanga.

english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
translation: Awe nabo babwelelamo ku banabo no kuya bashimikilako, lelo nabo bene tababasumine nakalya.

english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
translation: Elyo pakulekelesha aisa monekela ku basole ikumi limo na umo, cilya bali pakulya. Alabebaula pa mulandu wakubulwa icisumino no kumalala kwa mitima yabo, pantu bakeene ukusumina abo abamumwene ilyo abuukile ku bafwa.

english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Kabiyeni mu fyalo fyonse, mulebila Imbila Nsuma ku bantu bonse.

english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
translation: Uwasumina no kubatishiwa abatishiwa, akapusuka. Lelo uwakaana ukusumina wena akaba no mulandu.

english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
translation: Elyo ne fishibilo fyacipeshamano ifyo abansumina bakalacita nifi, bakalatamfya imipashi yakowela pakubomfya ishina lyandi, bakalalanda na mu ndimi ishipya.

english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
translation: Kabili bakalaikata insoka, elyo nga banwa icakwipaya umuntu tacakalebacita nangu cimo. Bakalatambalikila na maboko yabo pa balwele, nabo bakalapola.”

english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
translation: Nomba ilyo Imfumu Yesu yapwa ukulanda nabo, yasendwa ku mulu eko yaya ikala lubali ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa.

english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
translation: Kanshi lucelocelofye ubushiku bwakutampa umulungu baya ku nindi ninshi elyofye akasuba katula.

english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
translation: Elyo abasambi bena basalangana baya balebila mpanga yonse. Imfumu nayo yalebomba nabo, yalekosha na mashiwi yabo ku fishibilo fyacipeshamano balecita.]

english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
translation: Balaipushanya abati, “Bushe nani aleya tukunkulushishako icilibwe ukufumya pa mwinshi wa nindi?”

english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
translation: Nomba bati baloleshe, bamona ukuti icilibwe icali icikalamba nganshi nabacikunkulushapo.

english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
translation: Cilya baingila mu nindi, bamona umulumendo ekele lubali lwa ku kulyo, afwele no mwingila uwabuuta. Awe batiina nganshi.

english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
translation: Nao abeba ati, “Mwitiina, mulefwaya Yesu umwina Nasaleti, uo batanike. Ala nabuuka, talimo muno. Moneni apo, epo bamulalike.

english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
translation: Nomba kabiyeni muye eba abasambi bakwe na Petelo ukuti, namutangilila ku Galile. Eko mukaya mumona nga filya fine amwebele.”

english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
translation: Awe abanakashi bafuma mu nindi, bafulumuka ulubilo, baletutumafye, nacibapesha amano. Kabili tabaebeleko muntu nelyo umo, ico bali no mwenso.

english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
translation: [Lucelocelo ubushiku bwakutampa umulungu ilyo Yesu abuukile ku bafwa, uo abalilepo ukumonekela ni Maria Mandalena, uo atamfishemo imipashi yakowela cine lubali.

english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
translation: Ici e citendekelo ca Mbila Nsuma iyakwa Yesu Kristu, Umwana wakwa Lesa.

english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
translation: Ashifumafye mu menshi no kwisa ku mulundu, amona umulu waisuka na Mupashi amwikila kwati ni nkunda.

english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
translation: Awe ne shiwi lyafuma mu mulu aliti, “Niwe Mwana wandi uo natemwa, niwe nsekelamo.”

english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
translation: Apopene Mupashi amusenda amutwala na ku matololo.

english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
translation: Mu matololo, aya ikalamo inshiku amakumi yane aletunkwa na Satana. Ali pamo ne fiswango, elyo na bamalaika balemutumika.

english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
translation: Ilyo Yoani bamuposele mu cifungo, Yesu aile ku calo ca Galile alebila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa.

english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
translation: Aletila, “Inshita naifika, Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa nabupalama, lapileni no kupilibuka, sumineni Imbila Nsuma.”

english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
translation: Kabili ilyo Yesu aleenda alekonka ululamba lwa bemba wa Galile amona Simoni na munyina Andele baleteya amasumbu muli bemba ico bali balondo.

english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Nkonkeni, nkamucita abalondo ba bantu.”

english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
translation: Apopenefye basha amasumbu yabo, balamukonka no kumukonka.

english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
translation: Kabili cilya Yesu aendelelako kuntanshi panono, amona bamwana Sebede, Yakobo na munyina Yoani, bali mu bwato balelunda amasumbu yabo.

english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
translation: Yatendeke ukulingana nefyo Esaya kasesema alembele ati,

english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
translation: Nabo bene abeta, apopene basha shibo Sebede mu bwato na babomfi bakwe, balamukonka.

english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
translation: Kabili baingila mu musumba wa Kapenamu. Elyo pa bushiku bwe Sabata, Yesu aingila mu sinagoga alafunda.

english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
translation: Awe abantu balapapa nganshi pa mifundile yakwe, pantu imifundile yakwe tayali nga iya bakafundisha bamafunde, wena alefunda nga uwakwata amaka.

english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
translation: Nomba mu sinagoga, mwalimo umuntu uwali no mupashi wakowela. Noyu muntu wa mupashi wakowela apunda ati,

english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
translation: “Cinshi ulefwaya kuli ifwe iwe Yesu wa ku Nasaleti? Bushe waisa kukutulofya? Nalikwishiba iwe, uli Wamushilo uwafuma kuli Lesa!”

english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
translation: Lelo Yesu aukalipila ati, “Talala! Fuma muli uyu muntu!”

english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
translation: Elyo umupashi wakowela walamufulumfunsha, wapunda ne shiwi ilikalamba, wamufumamo.

english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
translation: Abantu bonse balapapa, balaipushanya abati, “Bushe ici naco calola mwi? Iyi mifundile ipya! Pantu ku maka alekalipila imipashi yakowela nayo ilemubeela.”

english: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
translation: Awe bwangu bwangu ululumbi lwakwe lwasalanganina na mu calo conse ica Galile.

english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
translation: Kabili bashifumafye mu sinagoga, baya ku ŋanda yakwa Simoni na Andele. Bali pamo na Yakobo na Yoani.

english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
translation: Ishiwi lya ulebilikisha mu matololo lileti,

english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
translation: Nomba basanga nafyala Simoni nalala, nalwala impepo. Apopene baeba Yesu abati, “Nafyala Simoni mulwele.”

english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
translation: Awe Yesu aya apo alele, amwikata ku minwe amwimya. Apopene ne mpepo yamuleka, alabatebeta no kubatebeta.

english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
translation: Cilya kwaba icungulo, ilyo akasuba kawa, abantu balaleta kuli Yesu bonse abalwele, na bali ne mipashi yakowela.

english: All the city was gathered together at the door.
translation: Kabili na bantu bonse aba mu musumba balongana pa mwinshi.

english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
translation: Nao Yesu aposha abengi abali na malwele ya misango misango, atamfya ne mipashi yakowela iyingi mu bantu, kabili talekele mipashi yakowela ukulanda, pantu yalimwishibe.

english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
translation: Ku macaca Yesu abuuka, afuma mu ŋanda, aya ku ncende ukwakuti ali eka kukupepa.

english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
translation: Simoni na banankwe baima baya balemufwaya.

english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
translation: Ilyo bamusanga, bamweba abati, “Abantu bonse balekufwaya.”

english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
translation: Elyo Yesu abasuka ati, “Natuleya kumbi, ku mishi yamupepi, uleke nako nje nshimikileko, pantu eco naishila.”

english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
translation: Awe aya alapitana mu calo conse ica Galile, aleshimikila mu masinagoga, aletamfya ne mipashi yakowela.

english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
translation: Kanshi Yoani Kabatisha aishile mu matololo, alebila imbila ati, “Lapileni no kupilibuka, mubatishiwe, na Lesa alemubelela uluse ku fyabubifi fyenu.”

english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
translation: Umuntu uwafibashi aishile kuli Yesu afukama, alamupapata ati, “Nga nautemwa kuti wamposha.”

english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
translation: Yesu amulangulukila, elyo atambalika ukuboko, amukumya, amweba ati, “Cisuma, nintemwa, pola!”

english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
translation: Awe apopene ifibashi fyaloba, no kupola apola.

english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Kabiye lino linefye.” Amukonkomesha ati,

english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
translation: “Umfwa, wiebako umuntu nelyo umo. Lelo kabiye uilange kuli shimapepo, uye tuula no mutuulo uo Mose amukonkomesha, uleke cibashinine ukuti naupola.”

english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
translation: Lelo wena ashifumapofye, atendeka ukwalasha umulandu kuli bonse. Asuka Yesu alafilwa ukwingila mu mishi pa lwalala pa mulandu wa mabumba, lelo alaikalafye ukushaleikala bantu. Nomba nalyo line abantu baleisa uko ali ukufumafye mpanga yonse.

english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
translation: Elyo abantu bonse aba mu calo ca Yudeya, naba mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, balaya mukubatishiwa mu mumana wa Yordani baleisoselela ifyabubifi fyabo.

english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
translation: Yoani alefwala insalu ishapikulwa na masako ya ngamila. Alekaka no mushipi wa mpapa mu musana. Kabili ifilyo alelya, ni makanta no buci bwa mu mpanga.

english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
translation: Alebila ati, “Uwacindama ukuncila alakonka panuma uo ine nshilingile ukwinama no kukakula inshinga sha pa ndyato shakwe.”

english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
translation: Isham 1:8

english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
translation: Muli shilya nshiku Yesu afumine ku Nasaleti, umushi wa mu calo ca Galile, aisa batishiwa na kuli Yoani mu mumana wa Yordani.

english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
translation: Pati papite inshiku shinono, Yesu abwelele ku Kapenamu, kabili caumfwike ukuti nabwela ali mu ŋanda mumwakwe.

english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
translation: Kanshi lekeni mulange ukuti Umwana wa muntu alikwata amaka pano isonde ayakubelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi fyonse.” Elyo aeba icite ati,

english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
translation: “Nakweba, ima, senda umusengele obe, akuya kumobe.”

english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
translation: Awe aima apopene, abuula no musengele wakwe, afuma alaya no kuya, na bonse balatamba. Awe bonse balapapafye, balalumbanya Lesa abati, “Tatwatala atumona ica musango uyu.”

english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
translation: Awe Yesu afuma aya nakabili ku lulamba lwa bemba. Elyo ibumba lya bantu lyaisa uko ali, nao alabafunda.

english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
translation: Kabili ilyo aleya, amona Levi mwana Alufeyo ekele mu ŋanda ya musonko. Yesu amweba ati, “Nkonka.” Nao Levi aima, alamukonka.

english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
translation: Nomba cilya Yesu ali pakulya mu ŋanda mwa Levi, bakasonkesha bamusonko na bampulamafunde abengi baisa mukulya pamo na Yesu na basambi bakwe, pantu abantu abengi balemukonka.

english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
translation: Nomba ilyo bakafundisha bamafunde bamo abali na mwibumba lya Bafalise bamona ukuti Yesu alelya pamo na bampulamafunde na bakasonkesha, balaipusha abasambi bakwe abati, “Bushe cinshi ico Yesu alila no kunwena pamo na bakasonkesha na bampulamafunde?”

english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
translation: Ilyo Yesu aumfwa, abeba ati, “Abali umutende tabakabila shiŋanga iyoo, kano abalwele. Ine nshaisa mukwita abakaele, lelo ababifi.”

english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
translation: Ilyo abasambi bakwa Yoani na Bafalise balefunga ukulya, abantu bamo baile kuli Yesu bamwipwishe abati, “Abasambi bakwa Yoani na basambi ba Bafalise balafunga ukulya, nga abasambi bobe bena cinshi bashifungila ukulya?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Bushe inshindishi shakwa shibwinga kuti shafunga shani ukulya ilyo shicili na shibwinga? Awe iyoo! Inshita yonse ilyo shicili na shibwinga tekuti shifunge ukulya.

english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
translation: Elyo mwalongana abantu abengi nganshi icakuti tamwali ncende nakalya nangufye ni pa mwinshi pene, ninshi Yesu alefunda abantu ishiwi lyakwa Lesa.

english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
translation: Lelo inshita ikesa ilyo bakashipoka shibwinga, lyena muli isho nshiku elyo shikalafunga ukulya.

english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
translation: “Takwaba nelyo umo uubilila icikamba icipya pa nsalu iyikote, pantu nga acita ifi, icikamba cipya kuti calepula insalu, ne cipunda cakulilako.

english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
translation: Kabili takwaba nelyo umo uubika umwangashi uushilabila mu nyambi ishikote, nga bacita ifyo ninshi umwangashi kuti walenga inyambi ukupuka. Elyo umwangashi kuti waonaika ne nyambi nasho kuti shaonaikila kumo. Lelo umwangashi uushilabila baubika mu nyambi shipya.”

english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ubwe Sabata, Yesu alepita mu mabala ya ŋanu. Cilya baleya, abasambi bakwe batendeka ukulatimpula imisonso ya ŋanu.

english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
translation: Abafalise baeba Yesu abati, “Mona! nga cinshi ico abasambi bobe balecitila icaleshiwa pa bushiku bwe Sabata?”

english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
translation: Amaf 23:25

english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
translation: Aingile mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, ilyo Abiyata ali Shimapepo mukalamba, no kulya imikate iyatuulilwe kuli Lesa, iyo abantu bambi bashasuminishiwe kulyako kanofye bashimapepo beka. Kabili apeelako nabo ali nabo pamo.”

english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
translation: Kabili Yesu abeba ati, “Ni pa mulandu wa muntu ubushiku bwe Sabata bwabelako, lelo te pa mulandu wa bushiku bwe Sabata umuntu abelako.

english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
translation: Kanshi Umwana wa muntu e mwine wa bushiku bwe Sabata.”

english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
translation: Kabili kwaisa abantu bane, bapingile icite, bacileta kuli Yesu.

english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
translation: Ku mulandu we bumba, bafilwa ukumufisha apali Yesu. Basuka bafimbula umutenge lubali apabelele Yesu, pashala icipunda. Elyo pa cipunda pene epo baishisha umusengele apalele icite.

english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
translation: Yesu pakumona icisumino cabo, aeba icite ati, “Mwana wandi naubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe.”

english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
translation: Lelo bakafundisha bamafunde bamo abalipo balatontonkanya mu mitima yabo abati,

english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
translation: “Cinshi ico uyu muntu alandila ifi? Musaalula kuli Lesa! Nga nani engabelela umuntu uluse ku fyabubifi acita? Shikanofye Lesa eka.”

english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
translation: Nomba Yesu, ico eshibe mu mutima wakwe ifyo baletontonkanya, abepusha ati, “Cinshi muletontonkanisha ifi mu mitima yenu?

english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
translation: Bushe cinshi icayangukapo, ukweba icite ukutila, naubelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyobe, nangu ukutila, ima, buula umusengele obe akwenda?

english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
translation: Yesu nakabili aingile mu sinagoga, mwali no muntu uwa cisansa icalemana.

english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
translation: Nomba ico Yesu aposeshe abantu abengi abali na malwele ayalekana lekana, balasunkana pakulwila ukuti bamukumye.

english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
translation: Kabili lyonse ilyo imipashi yakowela yalemumona, yalewa panshi no kukuuta aiti, “Niwe Mwana wakwa Lesa!”

english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
translation: Nomba Yesu aleikalipila nganshi no kuilesha ati, “Mwilansokolola ku bantu.”

english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
translation: Kabili Yesu aninine ulupili, aitile abo umwine alefwaya, nabo baisa uko ali.

english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
translation: Asalapo ikumi limo na babili, abenika abasole, abeba ati, “Imwe twakulaba na imwe, nakulamutuma na kukushimikila,

english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
translation: kabili namupeela na maka ayakutamfya imipashi yakowela.”

english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
translation: Abantu ikumi limo na babili abo asalile ni aba, Simoni uo Yesu ainike ishina limbi ilya Petelo,

english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
translation: Yakobo na munyina Yoani bamwana Sebede, abo Yesu ainike ishina lya Boanerge, emukutila, “Abakalipa kwati ni nkuba,”

english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
translation: na Andele, na Filipo, na Batolomeo, na Mateo, na Toma na Yakobo mwana Alufeyo, na Tandeo, na Simoni uwa mwibumba lya Baselote,

english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
translation: na Yuda uwa ku Kelyoti ulya wine uwaposele Yesu ku balwani.

english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
translation: Awe balabesha Yesu ukuti bamone nga alemuposha pa bushiku bwe Sabata pakuti bamupeelelepo umulandu.

english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
translation: Yesu kabinge aile kumwakwe ne bumba ilikalamba lyaishile longana nakabili, calengele nokuti Yesu na basambi bafilwe ukulya icakulya.

english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
translation: Nomba ilyo ba lupwa lwakwe baumfwa, baya kukumufumyako, pantu baletila, “Napena.”

english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
translation: Bakafundisha bamafunde abafumine ku Yerusalemu batile abati, “Aba na Belesebu, kabili ni kuli uyu mukalamba wa mipashi yakowela eko atamfisha imipashi yakowela.”

english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
translation: Yesu epakwita abantu alabeba mu milumbe ati, “Bushe Satana kuti atamfya shani Satana munankwe?

english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
translation: Mu buteko bwa mfumu imo nga mwaba ukulwishanya, ninshi ubo buteko tekuti butwalilile.

english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
translation: Aba mu ŋanda imo nga balalwishanya abene beka, ninshi iyo ŋanda tekuti itwalilile.

english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
translation: Kanshi Satana nga alailwisha umwine, ninshi apatulukana, kuti afilwa ukutwalilila, lyena kuti yaba e mpela yakwe.

english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
translation: “Kabili tekuti pabe nangu umo uwingengila mu ŋanda ya wamaka no kutapa ifyuma fyakwe, kano ninshi abala akaka uwamaka, elyo engatapa ifyuma fyakwe.

english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
translation: “Ndemweba icine cine nati, abantu kuti babelelwa uluse ku fyabubifi fyabo bacita elyo na ku musaalula onse bengacita kuli Lesa.

english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
translation: Lelo uwasaalula Mupashi Wamushilo takabelelwe uluse nakalya, umulandu wakwe wakubelelela pe.”

english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
translation: Elyo Yesu aeba umuntu uwa cisansa calemana ati, “Ima, iminina apa pakati.”

english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
translation: Ico Yesu asosele aya mashiwi nico baletila abati, “Aba no mupashi wakowela.”

english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
translation: Elyo nyina na bamunyina bakwa Yesu bafika, baiminina panse batuma no wakumwita.

english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
translation: Kwali ibumba ilikalamba nalimushinguluka, elyo bamweba abati, “Ala banoko na bamunonko na bankashi yobe bali panse balekufwaya.”

english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nga bamayo ni bani? Bamunyinane nabo ni bani?”

english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
translation: Elyo alolesha pa bantu abekele nabamushinguluka ati, “Ala moneni, aba, e bamayo, kabili e bamunyinane!

english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
translation: Onse uucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, e munyinane, e nkashi yandi, kabili e mayo.”

english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
translation: Kabili abepusha ati, “Bushe calisuminishiwa ukucita icisuma pa bushiku bwe Sabata nangu ukucita icibi? Ukupususha ubumi nangu ukwipaya?” Lelo bena batalalafye tondolo.

english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
translation: Elyo alatandanya amenso bukali bukali, camukalipa pa mulandu wakumalala kwa mitima yabo. Epakweba umuntu ati, “Fungulula icisansa cobe.” Awe nao afungulula icisansa cakwe no kuba cabafye bwino.

english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
translation: Apopene Abafalise bafumamo, baya mukumfwana na bena Herodi pakuti bamone umwakumulofesha.

english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
translation: Yesu na basambi bakwe bafumineko, baya na ku lulamba lwa bemba wa Galile. Ibumba ilikalamba ukufuma mu Galile lyalamukonka. Kabili pali aba bantu, bamo bafumine ku Yudeya,

english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
translation: ku Yerusalemu, ku calo ca Idumeya, na ku calo ca kwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani elyo na mu ncende shimbi isha mumbali ya misumba ya Turi na Sidoni. Aba bantu baishile kuli Yesu ico baumfwile ifintu alecita.

english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
translation: Yesu ashimona ibumba lya bantu aeba abasambi bakwe ati, “Mpekanishisheniko ubwato, epali ibumba lyaisa ntitikisha.”

english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
translation: Nakabili Yesu atampile ukufunda pa lulamba lwa bemba. Elyo ibumba ilikalamba nganshi lyalongana lyamushinguluka. Elyo Yesu aingila mu bwato emo aikala pali bemba, abantu bonse bena bashala ku mulundu pa lulamba lwa bemba.

english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
translation: Nomba cilya Yesu ashala eka, abo abali nankwe pamo na basole ikumi limo na babili balamwipusha umulolele imilumbe.

english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Imwe mwalipeelwa ukumfwa inkaama sha Bufumu bwakwa Lesa, lelo ku ba kunse, fyonse bali nokufyumfwila mu milumbe.

english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
translation: Pakuti,

english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
translation: Kabili Yesu abeba ati, “Bushe tamumfwile umwalola uyu mulumbe? Nga kanshi imilumbe imbi yena mukayumfwa shani?

english: The farmer sows the word.
translation: Katanda ico atanda lishiwi lyakwa Lesa.

english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
translation: Imbuto ishaponene mumbali ya nshila, bantu batila baumfwa ishiwi, apopene Satana aisa fumya ne shiwi lyatandilwe mu mitima yabo.

english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
translation: Kabili abantu bambi baba nge mbuto ishaponene mu mushili wa nsakalabwe, e bantu abomfwa ishiwi, apopene balipokelela ne nsansa.

english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
translation: Nomba lyaikalamofye akashita akanono, ico lyafilwa ukwanda imishila. Kanshi ilyo paisa ubwafya nangu amacushi pa mulandu we shiwi, awe bwangu bwangu banenuka.

english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
translation: Bambi nabo baba nge mbuto ishaponene mu myunga.

english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
translation: Aba ebomfwa ishiwi, lelo isakamika lya fya pano calo, no mukonkelelo wa fyuma, no lunkumbwa lwa fintu fimbi, fyatusha ishiwi, lyafilwa no kutwala ifisabo.

english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
translation: Awe alabafunda ifintu ifingi mu milumbe, elyo na mu kufunda kwakwe alabeba ati,

english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
translation: Lelo bambi baba nge mbuto ishaponene mu mushili uusuma. Aba ebomfwa ishiwi no kulipokelela balipokelela, epakutwala ifisabo, bamo amakumi yatatu (30), bambi amakumi mutanda (60), bambi nabo umwanda umo (100).”

english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
translation: Kabili Yesu alabeba ati, “Bushe babula icisaniko pakuti bacikupikile mu nongo nangu ukucibika mwifungu? Bushe tekucibika apasanseme?

english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
translation: Pantu takwaba icafisama nelyo cimo icishakasokoloke, kabili takwaba icankaama nelyo cimo icishakaletwe pa bwelu.

english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translation: Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!”

english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
translation: Kabili Yesu abeba ati, “Muleposako amano ku fintu muleumfwa. Icipimo ico mupiminako abanenu, eco na imwe bakamupiminako, elyo no kucishapo.

english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
translation: Pantu uwakwata, akapeelelwapo na fimbi, lelo uushakwata, bakamupoka noto akwata.”

english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
translation: Kabinge abeba ati, “Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bwaba kwati muntu uwatanda imbuto mwibala.

english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
translation: Akasuba no bushiku, ilyo alelola nangu ilyo asendeme, imbuto shena shilemena no kukula, lelo wena teshiba ifyo shilemena no kukula.

english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
translation: Umushili wine eumesha imbuto. Umusonga eubalilapo, elyo pakonka umutwe, elyo ne nseke ishituntulu mu mutwe.

english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
translation: Nomba ilyo ifisabo fyapya, lyena acincila abuula umwele pantu inshita ya kuseepa yafika.”

english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.
translation: “Umfweni! Katanda wa mbuto aile kukutanda.

english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
translation: Kabili Yesu atila ati, “Bushe Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa kuti twabupalanya kuli cinshi? Kabili mulumbe nshi twingabomfya pakubulondolola?

english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
translation: Bwaba nga kalubuto ka lubanga, akacepesha pa mbuto shonse babyala mu mushili.

english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
translation: Lelo ilyo bakabyala, kalakula, kasuka kacila ne fimpusa fyonse, elyo kakwata ne misambo iyikalamba icakuti ne fyuni fya mu mulu fyaisa mukwikala mu cintelelwe cakako.”

english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
translation: Yesu alebeba ishiwi lyakwa Lesa mu milumbe iyingi iyi uyu musango, ukulingana nefyo bakwete amano yakutesha.

english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
translation: Talebeba nelyo cimo kano mu milumbe, lelo uko bali beka alelondolola fyonse ku basambi bakwe.

english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
translation: Nomba icungulo ubushiku bwine ubo, Yesu aebele abasambi bakwe ati, “Natwabukile kwishilya.”

english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
translation: Elyo bafuma pebumba, bamusendela mu bwato umo mwine ali. Kabili kwali amato na yambi ayali pamo no bwato ubo alimo.

english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
translation: Elyo kwaima icikuuku ica maka nganshi, na matamba yaima yalapuma mu bwato, na menshi yalaingilamo icakuti ni cikanga no bwato bwisule.

english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
translation: Yesu ninshi ali mu tulo ku cisolo ca bwato kunuma, nasaila na pa musao. Awe bamushibusha abati, “We Kafundisha bushe tausakamene ukuti twalafwa?”

english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
translation: Awe Yesu abuuka, akalipila ne cimwela, aeba na bemba ati, “Talala, ikala tondolo!” Apopene no mwela wapona, patalala na tondolo.

english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
translation: Cilya aletanda, imbuto shimo shaponena mumbali ya nshila, ne fyuni fyaisa shikompaula.

english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
translation: Elyo abepusha ati, “Bushe cinshi ico mwatiinina? Bushe kanshi na nomba tamulasumina?”

english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
translation: Awe baikatwa no mwenso ukalamba, elyo balaipushanya abati, “Ngoyu nani, uwakuti icimwela na bemba filemubeela?”

english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
translation: Shimbi shaponena mu mushili wa nsakalabwe umushali mushili wingi. Awe bwangu bwangu shamena ico pashali mushili wingi.

english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
translation: Ilyo akasuba kabalika shabonsa, shauma no kuma, ico shishali na mishila ine ine.

english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
translation: Shimbi shaponena mu myunga, ne myunga yati ikule, yashitabilila, shatusa, shafilwa no kutwala ifisabo.

english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
translation: Shimbi shena shaponena mu mushili usuma. Shamena, shakula, shatwala ne fisabo. Shimo shatwala amakumi yatatu (30), shimbi amakumi mutanda (60), shimbi shena umwanda umo (100).”

english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translation: Elyo Yesu asosa ati, “Uuli na matwi yakumfwa naomfwe!”

english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
translation: Awe basuka bafika kwishilya lya bemba mu calo ca bena Gerasa.

english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
translation: Kabili yalapapata Yesu apakalamba nganshi ukuti eitamfya muli cilya calo.

english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
translation: Nomba mumbali ya lupili mwali umukuni ukalamba uwa nkumba ishalelya.

english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
translation: Elyo imipashi yakowela yalapapata Yesu aiti, “Tutamfishe mu nkumba, emo tuye twingile.”

english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
translation: Nao aisuminisha. Elyo ne mipashi yakowela yafuma yaingila na mu nkumba. Awe no mukuni wa nkumba, cikangafye amakana yabili, wakunkunyala pa mukunkuluko, waipuupa na muli bemba, wanwena no kunwena.

english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
translation: Elyo bakacema ba nkumba bafulumuka, baya shimika no mulandu mu musumba na mu mishi ya mumbali. Abantu epakuya kukumona ificitike.

english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
translation: Ilyo bafika kuli Yesu, basanga umuntu uwali no mulalo wa mipashi yakowela naikala nafwala, na mano yonse nayabwela. Awe umwenso wabekata.

english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
translation: Abo abaimwenene balashimikilako abantu ificitike ku wali ne mipashi yakowela, na ku nkumba.

english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
translation: Elyo batendeka ukupapata Yesu ukuti afume mu calo cabo.

english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
translation: Ilyo Yesu alaingila mu bwato, ulya muntu atamfishemo imipashi yakowela alamupapata ukuti nao akonke.

english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
translation: Yesu amukaanya, lelo amweba ati, “Kabiye kumwenu ku bantu bobe, uye mukulabashimikilako fyonse ifyo Imfumu yakucitila nefyo yakumfwila uluse.”

english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
translation: Cilyafye Yesu afuma mu bwato, no muntu uwali ne mipashi yakowela uwaleikala mu nshinshi, aisa mukumukumanya.

english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
translation: Awe nao aya alashimika mu calo conse ica Dekapoli fyonse ifyo Yesu amucitile, na bantu bonse balapapa nganshi.

english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
translation: Elyo Yesu nakabili ayabukile kwishilya lya bemba mu bwato. Ibumba ilikalamba lyalongana lyamushinguluka ninshi acili pa lulamba lwa bemba.

english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
translation: Kwaisa no muntu umo, intungulushi ya mu sinagoga, ishina lyakwe ni Yailo. Ilyo amona Yesu, aisa mufukamina.

english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
translation: Alamupapata nganshi ati, “Akamwana kandi akakashana ni mfwafye. Shi wingesa katambalikilapo amaboko yobe, uleke kapole, kabe no bumi.”

english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
translation: Awe Yesu epakuya nankwe.

english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
translation: Elyo mwibumba mwalimo umwanakashi uwalwele umukunko pa myaka ikumi limo na ibili.

english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
translation: Aculile nganshi nangu bashiŋanga abengi baeseshe ukumuposha. Kabili aposele ifyuma fyakwe fyonse nokuti apole iyoo, ubulwele bwaleyafye ntanshi.

english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi alyumfwile ifyo balelanda pali Yesu. Kanshi epakwisa alepeka mwibumba, apalama na kuli Yesu kunuma, akumya na ku nsalu shakwe.

english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
translation: Pantu wena mu mutima wakwe aletila, “Nga nakumyafye nangu ni ku nsalu shakwe, ninshi ndepola.”

english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
translation: Awe apopene no mukunko waleka, aumfwa na mu mubili wakwe ukuti ubulwele bwakwe bwapola.

english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
translation: Uyu muntu aleikala mu nshinshi, kabili takwali nangu umo uwingamukaka nangufye ku minyololo ine.

english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
translation: Apopene Yesu aishiba mu mutima wakwe ukuti amaka yamo yafuma muli wena. Elyo acebukila kunuma mwibumba aipusha ati, “Nani uwankumya ku nsalu?”

english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
translation: Abasambi bamwasuka abati, “Bushe taumwene ibumba lilekutitikisha konse konse, kabili wipushe auti, ‘Uwankumya nani?’ ”

english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
translation: Lelo Yesu ena akonkanyapofye ukulolesha konse konse ukuti amone uumukumishe.

english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
translation: Awe umwanakashi alatutumafye ku mwenso, ico eshibe icimucitikile. Aisa mufukamina alondolola ne fishinka fyonse.

english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
translation: Nao Yesu amweba ati, “We mwana, icisumino cobe ecakuposha, kabiye umutende, upolelele na ku bulwele bobe.”

english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
translation: Ilyo acili alelanda, kwaisa abantu bamo ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Yailo, intungulushi ya mu sinagoga. Balamweba abati, “Umwana obe umukashana nafwa. Cinshi ulepamfisha kafundisha?”

english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
translation: Lelo Yesu wena no kuposako amano nakalya ku mashiwi ayo balelanda, aebafye intungulushi ya mu sinagoga ati, “Iwe suminafye witiina.”

english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
translation: Elyo alesha abantu bonse ukumukonka, asuminishafye Petelo na Yakobo na Yoani munyina kwa Yakobo.

english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
translation: Cilya bafika ku ŋanda ya ntungulushi ya mu sinagoga, Yesu asanga kukabile na see, abantu balelila no kuloosha.

english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
translation: Elyo aingila mu ŋanda abeba ati, “Cinshi mulekafisha ifi, no kulila imisowa? Umwana tafwile, alifye mu tulo.”

english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
translation: Pantu imiku iyingi balemukaka amaboko na makasa, lelo aleputula iminyololo balemukaka ku maboko, alefunaula ne fyela balemukaka ku makasa. Eico takwali nangu umo uwali na maka yakumunasha.

english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
translation: Awe bena balamuseka. Elyo abafumya bonse, abuula wishi na nyina na basambi bakwe abo ali nabo, aingila nabo umwali umwana.

english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
translation: Aikata no mwana ku minwe amweba ati, “Talita, kumi!” Calola mukutila, “We kakashana, nakweba nati buuka!”

english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
translation: Apopene akakashana kaima kalaenda no kwenda. Pantu kali ne myaka ikumi limo na ibili. Abantu pakumona ifi, cabapesha amano.

english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
translation: Elyo abakonkomesha nganshi ati, “Mwileka umuntu nangu umo eshibe ici cintu.” Kabili abeba ati, “Mupeeleniko icakulya.”

english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
translation: Kabili lyonsefye akasuba no bushiku aleendauka mu nshinshi na mu mpili, alekuuta, aleitetaula ku mabwe.

english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
translation: Nomba cilya amona Yesu akatalamukila abutukilako, amufukamina.

english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
translation: Apunda ne shiwi likalamba ati, “Cinshi ulefwaya kuli ine, iwe Yesu Mwana Lesa mukulu? Nakupapata na pali Lesa, wincusha!”

english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
translation: Ico asosele aya mashiwi, nico Yesu amwebele ati, “Fuma mu muntu we mupashi wakowela!”

english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amwipusha ati, “Ishina lyobe niwe ani?” Nao amwasuka ati, “Ishina lyandi nine Mulalo, pantu twabamo abengi.”

english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
translation: Elyo Yesu afumine ku ncende ilya, aile ku mushi kumwabo ali na basambi bakwe.

english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
translation: Kabili abeba ati, “Mu ŋanda yonse iyo mwaingilamo, mwikale umo mwine mpaka napo mukafumina muli iyo ncende.

english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
translation: Na konse uko bakaana ukumusekelela no kumumfwa, pakufumako mulekunta ulukungu ku makasa yenu pakubashinina.”

english: They went out and preached that people should repent.
translation: Awe baima, baya baleshimikila baletila, “Lapileni no kupilibuka!”

english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
translation: Baletamfya ne mipashi yakowela iyingi, kabili baleposha na balwele abengi pa kubasuba amafuta.

english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
translation: Kabili imfumu Herodi yaumfwile ululumbi lwakwa Yesu, pantu pa nshita iyi ishina lyakwe lyalilumbwike. Na bantu bamo baletila, “Yoani Kabatisha eubuukile ku bafwa, eco akwatile aya maka yakucita ifipeshamano.”

english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
translation: Bambi bena balati, “Ni Eliya.” Bambi nabo balati, “Ni kasesema, ali nga umo uwa pali bakasesema bakale.”

english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
translation: Lelo Herodi wena ashumfwa ifi, asosa ati, “Ni Yoani uo naputwileko umutwe eubuukile ku bafwa!”

english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
translation: Ni uyu wine Herodi ewatumine abakwikata Yoani ukuti bamukake no kumuposa mu cifungo pa mulandu wakwa Herodia muka Filipo, pantu Herodi aupile muka munyina Filipo.

english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
translation: Yoani aleeba Herodi ati, “Calileshiwa ukuupa muka munonko.”

english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
translation: Herodia epakufulilwa Yoani, alafwaya no kumwipaya. Nomba afilwa,

english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
translation: Ilyo ubushiku bwe Sabata bwafika, atampa no kufunda mu sinagoga, na bantu abengi abaleumfwako balapapa abati, “Ngoyu muntu aishiba shani ifi fyonse? Kabili nga amano apeelwa ya musango nshi? Na maka yakucita ifipeshamano ifya uyu musango yafuma kwi?

english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
translation: pantu Herodi aletiina Yoani, ico aishibe ukuti muntu umololoke kabili wamushilo, eico alemubaka bwino. Kabili lyonse ilyo Herodi alemumfwa, calemupesha amano nganshi, lelo kwena aletemwa ukumumfwa.

english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
translation: Bwasuka ubushiku ubwalinga bwamoneka. Pa bushiku bwakucindika ukufyalwa kwakwe, Herodi atebeta bacilolo bakwe, abakalamba ba fita fyakwe na basambashi ba mu Galile.

english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation: Elyo umukashana mwana Herodia aingilamo, alacinda. Awe asansamusha nganshi Herodi na bonse abo ali nabo pa mitebeto. Imfumu elyo yaeba umukashana aiti, “Lomba consefye ico utemenwe, ndekupeela.”

english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
translation: Yalapa no kulapa, yasosa aiti, “Conse ico ulelomba ndekupeela, nangufye kukwakanyako icalo candi pakati!”

english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
translation: Awe umukashana afuma, aya ipusha na nyina ati, “Bushe ico ningalomba cinshi?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Umutwe wakwa Yoani Kabatisha.”

english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
translation: Apopene umukashana aingila bwangu bwangu, aya ku mfumu, alomba ati, “Ndefwaya mumpeele lino linefye pa mbale umutwe wakwa Yoani Kabatisha!”

english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
translation: Awe imfumu yalanguluka nganshi, lelo pa mulandu wa mulapo na beni abo ili nabo, yafilwa ukumukaanya.

english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
translation: Apopene imfumu yatuma icita cimo aiti, “Kalete umutwe wakwa Yoani.” Naco icita, caya putula Yoani umutwe mu cifungo.

english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
translation: Cauleta pa mbale, capeela no mukashana, umukashana nao apeela nyina.

english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
translation: Ilyo abasambi bakwa Yoani baumfwa, baisa senda icitumbi cakwe, baya cishiika na mu nindi.

english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.
translation: Bushe uyu te kabasa wambao, mwana Maria, kabili bamunyina bushe te Yakobo na Yose na Yuda na Simoni? Bankashi yakwe bushe teaba bene twikala nabo kuno?” Awe cabansha no kumusumina.

english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
translation: Abasole babwelele kuli Yesu bamushimikile na fyonse ifyo bacitile, nefyo bafundile.

english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Twendeni ukutalele ukwakuti tube fweka, mutushe panono.” Pantu kwali abantu abengi abaleisa na balefumako, icakuti abasole tabakwete nangu ni nshita yakulya.

english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
translation: Elyo baya mu bwato ku matololo ukwakuti bali beka.

english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
translation: Ilyo baleya, abengi babamona babeshiba no kubeshiba. Elyo abantu bafuma mu misumba yonse, bapita ulubilo ku mulundu, ukuya kulya kwine baleya, babatangilila bena bafika bwangu.

english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
translation: Yesu cilya afuma mu bwato, amona ibumba lya bantu ilikalamba, epakubalangulukilako pantu bali nge mpaanga ishabula kacema. Elyo atendeka ukubafunda ifintu ifingi.

english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
translation: Cilya akasuba kaba kukuwa, abasambi bakwe baisa uko ali. Balamweba abati, “Kuno tuli ni ku matololo, kabili na kasuba kawa.

english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
translation: Kanshi eba abantu baye mu mitanda na mu mishi ya mumbali, baye ishitila ifyakulya.”

english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
translation: Yesu abasuka ati, “Nimwe bapeeleni icakulya.” Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Bushe tuye posa indalama imyanda ibili pa mikate iyakuti tubapeele balye?”

english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
translation: Elyo abepusha ati, “Bushe mukwetepo inga? Kamoneni.” Ilyo bashininkisha, bamweba abati, “Kuli imikate isano ne sabi libili.”

english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Lekeni abantu bekale mu mpuka mu mpuka pa mulemfwe.”

english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
