translation: Elyo Yesu abeba ati, “Kasesema kumbi balamucindika, kanofye ku ba mu calo cakwe, ku ba mu lupwa lwakwe, na ba mu ŋanda yakwe.”

english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
translation: Nabo baikala mu mpuka sha bantu umwanda umo ne sha bantu amakumi yasano.

english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
translation: Elyo Yesu abuula imikate isano ne sabi libili, alosha amenso ku mulu, atasha Lesa. Elyo amokaula imikate, apeela abasambi bakwe ukuti baakanye abantu. Ayakanya ne sabi libili kuli bonse.

english: They all ate and were filled.
translation: Awe bonse balya no kwikuta baikuta.

english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
translation: Elyo balonganya ifipandwa fyasheleko ku mikate ne sabi, fyaisula imiseke ikumi limo na ibili.

english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
translation: Impendwa ya baume abalileko imikate yali amakana yasano.

english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
translation: Apopene Yesu alacincisha abasambi bakwe ukuti bengile mu bwato, batangile babukile kwishilya, ku Betisaida. Elyo umwine ena ashala alesalanganya ibumba.

english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
translation: Ilyo abafishapo, anina ulupili aya kukupepa.

english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
translation: Cilya caba icungulo, ubwato buli pakati ka bemba, ninshi Yesu ena ashele eka ku mulundu.

english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
translation: Awe amona ukuti balecula pakoba, ico bapindilwe no mwela. Kanshi ku macaca Yesu aya uko bali aleenda pali bemba, aba nga uulepitilila.

english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
translation: Nomba ilyo abasambi bamona aleenda pali bemba, balakuuta, ico baletontonkanya ukuti, cipuku.

english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
translation: Awe afilwa ukucitako icipeshamano nangu cimo. Aposhakofye abalwele banono mukubatambalikilapo amaboko.

english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
translation: Awe bonse batiina nganshi ilyo bamumona. Lelo Yesu apopene abeba ati, “Tekeni imitima! Ala nine! Mwitiina.”

english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
translation: Elyo aingila mu bwato umo bali, no mwela waleka. Awe bonse cabapesha amano balapapa nganshi.

english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
translation: Pantu tabailwike bwino pa mulandu wa mikate, ku mulandu wakumalala kwa mitima yabo.

english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
translation: Yesu na basambi bayabukile bemba, bafika na mu calo ca Genasaleti, bakaka no bwato.

english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
translation: Bashifumafye mu bwato, apopene abantu baishiba Yesu.

english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.
translation: Elyo balapitana muli ici calo conse, balesenda abalwele pa misengele, balebatwala na konse uko bomfwile ukuti eko ali.

english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
translation: Konse uko aleya, mu mishi, mu misumba na mu mitanda, baleteka abalwele pa mansa sha fisankano. Balemupapata ukuti aleke balemukumyafye nangu ku nsenkebele sha nsalu shakwe. Elyo na bonse abalemukumyako, balepola.

english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
translation: Kabili asunguka pali ico bakaana ukumusumina. Elyo alapita mu mishi ya mumbali alefunda.

english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
translation: Kabili aita abasole ikumi limo na babili, alabatuma babili babili, abapeela na maka yakutamfya imipashi yakowela.

english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
translation: Kabili abakonkomesha ati, “Pa lwendo mulesendafye inkonto epela. Mwilasenda mukate nangu imbukuli nelyo indalama.

english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
translation: Indyato shena mulefwala, lelo mwilasenda imingila ibili.”

english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
translation: Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde bamo bafumine ku Yerusalemu, baisa longana ukwali Yesu.

english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
translation: Pantu Mose atile, ‘Ulecindika wiso na noko,’ kabili atile nokuti, ‘Uwalapisha wishi nangu nyina, alingilefye ukumwipaya.’

english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
translation: Nomba imwe mutila, umuntu nga aeba wishi nangu nyina ati, ‘Fintu mfwile namupeela pakumwafwako ni kolobani’, ekutila calituulwa kuli Lesa.

english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
translation: Ukuf 20:12

english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
translation: Esaya 29:13

english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
translation: Nakabili Yesu aita ibumba, alalyeba ati, “Kutikeni kuli ine imwe bonse, mumfwikishe.

english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
translation: Takwaba cintu nangu cimo icifuma kunse, icingengila mu nda ya muntu no kumukowesha. Kano ififuma mu mutima wa muntu efikowesha umuntu.”

english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
translation: Ilyo afuma pebumba aya ingila mu ŋanda, abasambi bakwe balamwipusha umulolele ipinda.

english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
translation: Nao abeba ati, “Bushe kanshi na imwe bene tamulailuka? Bushe tekuti mumone ukuti conse icifuma kunse no kwingila mu nda ya muntu tekuti cimukoweshe nakalya.

english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
translation: Pantu taciya mukwingila mu mutima wakwe, lelo ciya mu cifu, elyo panuma cafumina kunse.” Mukulanda ifi, Yesu asuminishe ukuti ifyakulya fyonse tafikowesha.

english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
translation: Elyo bamona ukuti abasambi bakwe bamo balelya ne minwe iyakowela, emukuti iyabula ukusamba.

english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
translation: Elyo akonkanyapo ati, “Ala icikowesha umuntu cintu cifuma mu muntu.

english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
translation: Pantu mukati ka mitima ya bantu, emufuma amatontonkanyo yabipa, ubulalelale, ubupupu, imisoka, ulubembu,

english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
translation: ulunkumbwa lwa fyuma, ubunkalwe, ubucenjeshi, bucilende, umufimbila, umusaalula, icilumba no buwelewele.

english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
translation: Ifibi fyonse ifi efifuma mu muntu, kabili efikowesha umuntu.”

english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
translation: Awe afumine ku ncende ilya, aima aya na ku calo umwali umusumba wa Turi. Aya ingila mu ŋanda imo, talefwaya nelyo umo ukuti eshibe uko afikilile, nomba cakaana, afilwa ukufisama.

english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
translation: Awe umwanakashi uwali na kamwane akakashana akali no mupashi wakowela, ashumfwafye ukuti Yesu naisa, apopene aisa, amufukamina.

english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi ali Mwinafyalo, umwina Sirofonisia. Elyo alapapata Yesu ukuti atamfye umupashi wakowela ufume mu mwana wakwe.

english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
translation: Nao amweba ati, “Pakubala kuleka abana balya baikuta, tacilingile ukubuula icakulya ca bana no kuposela imbwa.”

english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
translation: Nao umwanakashi amwasuka ati, “Kwena nifyo fine mukwai, lelo ne mbwa nasho shilalyako utubufungau twa bana, tulya tuleponena mwisamba lye tebulo.”

english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amweba ati, “Apo wayasuka umusango uyu, kabiye kumobe, umupashi wakowela naufuma mu mwana obe.”

english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
translation: Pantu Abafalise pamo pene na Bayuda banabo bonse tabalya nga tabasambile iminwe ukufika na munkonkoni, ekusunga ifishilano fya fikolwe fyabo.

english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
translation: Awe abwelelamo kumwakwe, asanga umwana nalala pa busanshi no mupashi wakowela naufumamo.

english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
translation: Elyo afumine mu calo umwali umusumba wa Turi, apita mu Sidoni, na mu calo ca Dekapoli, asuka afika na kuli bemba wa Galile.

english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
translation: Awe abantu bamo bamuletela nkomamatwi, uwali cibulu. Elyo balamupapata pakuti amutambalikilepo amaboko.

english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
translation: Awe amufumya pebumba, baya ukwakuti bali beka. Elyo aingisha iminwe yakwe mu matwi ya uyu muntu. Elyo afwisa amate amukumya nayo pa lulimi.

english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
translation: Kabili alosha amenso ku mulu, aisha no mweo, ati, “Efata,” emukuti, “Komoka.”

english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
translation: Awe apopene amatwi yakwe yakomoka, na kalimba akakakile ululimi lwakwe kaputuka, atampa no kulalandafye bwino.

english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
translation: Elyo Yesu abakonkomesha ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo.” Nomba atila ntinti ukubalesha, awe abantu nabo bashimikafye.

english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
translation: Kabili balepapisha nganshi abati, “Alecita fyonse bwino bwino! Alelenga bankomamatwi ukulaumfwa na bacibulu ukulalanda.”

english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
translation: Kabili nga bafuma ku cisankano, tabalya kano batala basamba. Kuliko na fimbi ifishilano ifingi ifyo bakonka, ifili nge misambile ya nkombo ne nongo ne fipe fya mukuba.

english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
translation: Kanshi Abafalise na bakafundisha bamafunde balamwipusha abati, “Cinshi ico abasambi bobe bashikonkela ifishilano fya fikolwe fyesu, bena balelya icakulya ne minwe iyakowela?”

english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Cine cine Esaya alilungike ilyo aseseme pali imwe mwe mfundabuteshi ngomo calembelwa ukuti,

english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
translation: Baicushafye pakumpepa,

english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
translation: “Imwe mwalisuula amafunde yakwa Lesa, mwalemenenafye ku fishilano fya bantu.”

english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
translation: Elyo abeba ati, “Mwaba ne nshila yabucenjeshi iyakusuulilamo amafunde yakwa Lesa, pakuti mulesunga ifishilano fyenu.

english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
translation: Muli shilya shine nshiku, nakabili kwaishile longana ibumba ilikalamba. Nomba tabakwete cakulya. Yesu epakwita abasambi bakwe alabeba ati,

english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
translation: Awe apopene aingila na basambi bakwe mu bwato, baya na ku calo ca Dalamanuta.

english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
translation: Kabili Abafalise balishile, batampa ukubikana ifikansa na Yesu kukumwesha. Balamweba ukuti acitepo icipeshamano cimo icakulanga kuti aba na Lesa.

english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
translation: Awe aisha no mweo nganshi mu mutima wakwe, ati, “Cinshi ico abantu ba ino nkulo balefwaila icishibilo cacipeshamano? Ndemweba icine cine abantu ba ino nkulo tabakamone cishibilo nakalya.”

english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
translation: Awe abasha, aingila na mu bwato, bayabukila na kwishilya.

english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
translation: Abasambi balilabile ukusenda imikate, balifye no mukate umo mu bwato epela.

english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
translation: Elyo Yesu alabasoka ati, “Mulecenjela, muleisopa ku ntutumushi ya Bafalise na ku yakwa Herodi.”

english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
translation: Nabo epakulalanshanya abati, “Ico alandila ifyo nico tushikwete mukate.”

english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
translation: Yesu nao aishiba ifyo balelanda, elyo abepusha ati, “Cinshi ico mulelandila amuti, tatukwete mukate? Bushe kanshi na nomba tamulatesha no kwiluka tamulailuka? Bushe kanshi imitima yenu icilifye iyaumalala?

english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
translation: Bushe kanshi mwaba na menso ayashimona na matwi ayashumfwa? Bushe kanshi tamwibukisha?

english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
translation: Ilyo namokawilile abantu amakana yasano imikate isano, bushe ifipandwa fyasheleko mwaiswishe imiseke inga?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Ikumi limo na ibili.”

english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
translation: “Nalangulukila aba bantu, pantu twaikala nabo nomba inshiku shaba shitatu, elyo ne cakulya tabakwete.

english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
translation: Kabili Yesu ati, “Nga ilyo namokawilile abantu amakana yane imikate cine lubali, bushe ifipandwa fyasheleko mwaiswishe imiseke inga?” Nabo bayasuka abati, “Cine lubali.”

english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
translation: Yere 5:21

english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
translation: Ilyo bafikile ku Betisaida, abantu bamo baletele impofu kuli Yesu. Balamupapata ukuti aikumye.

english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
translation: Yesu aikata impofu pa kuboko, aifumisha kunse ya mushi. Elyo aipaala amate pa menso, aitambalikilapo na maboko aipusha ati, “Bushe wamonapo cimo?”

english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”
translation: Umuntu ainuna amenso ati, “Namona abantu, nomba bali nge miti iyileendauka.”

english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
translation: Elyo nakabili amufimba pa menso ne cisansa cakwe. Elyo amenso yakwe yaisuka, atampa no kumona, alamona ifintu fyonse bwino bwino.

english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
translation: Yesu epakumweba ati, “Nomba iwe lungamafye kumobe, wibwelela muli uyu mushi.”

english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
translation: Yesu na basambi bakwe baimine baile ku mishi ya ku Kesalia Filipi. Mu nshila Yesu alaipusha abasambi bakwe ati, “Bushe abantu batila nine ani?”

english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”
translation: Nabo bamwasuka abati, “Bamo batila ni Yoani Kabatisha, bambi nabo batila ni Eliya, bambi nabo bena batila ulifye umo pali bakasesema.”

english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
translation: Elyo abepusha ati, “Nga imwe mutila nine ani?” Petelo amwasuka ati, “Niwe Kristu.”

english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
translation: Nga nati mbaleke babwelelemo kumwabo ne nsala, balefwa ulushile mu nshila, pantu bamo bafumine ukutali.”

english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
translation: Elyo abakonkomesha ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo ukuti nine Kristu.”

english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
translation: Kabili Yesu atendeka ukulabafunda ati, “Umwana wa muntu ali nokuculisha nganshi. Abakalamba na bashimapepo bacindami na bakafundisha bamafunde bakamusuula no kumwipaya. Lelo mu bushiku bwalenga shitatu akabuuka.”

english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
translation: Abalondolwela fyonse ifi bwino ukwabula ukufisa nangu kamo. Elyo Petelo amufumyapo, alamukalipila.

english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
translation: Nomba Yesu ena apilibuka, alolesha na pa basambi bakwe, alakalipila Petelo ati, “Kabiye uko we Satana we! Pantu imitontonkanishishe yobe teyakwa Lesa, yabuntunsefye!”

english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
translation: Elyo Yesu aita ibumba lya bantu pamo na basambi bakwe, alabeba ati, “Umuntu nga alefwaya ukulankonka, aleikaanya umwine, alesenda umusalaba wakwe, elyo alenkonka.

english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
translation: Pantu uyo onse uufwaya ukupususha umweo wakwe, akaulofya. Lelo uyo onse uulofya umweo wakwe pa mulandu wa ine na pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma, ena akaupususha.

english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
translation: Bushe umuntu kuti amwenamo nshi, nga cakuti anonka ifyuma fyonse ifya pano calo elyo alufishapo umweo wakwe?

english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
translation: Nga cintu nshi umuntu engapeela icingalinga ukukabusha no mweo wakwe?

english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
translation: Pantu onse uwakwatila ine nsoni na mashiwi yandi, muli ino nkulo ibi kabili iyatalama, Umwana wa muntu nao akamukwatila insoni ilyo akesa no bucindami bwakwa Wishi pamo na bamalaika bamushilo.”

english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
translation: Abasambi bakwe bamwasuka abati, “Bushe ni kwi muno matololo umuntu engafumya imikate iyakulisha aba bantu?”

english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
translation: Nao abepusha ati, “Bushe mukwetepo imikate inga?” Nabo abati, “Cine lubali.”

english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
translation: Elyo aeba ibumba ukwikala panshi. Abuula imikate cine lubali, atasha Lesa, elyo amokaula, apeela na basambi bakwe ukuti baakanye ibumba. Awe nabo efyo bacita.

english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
translation: Kabili bakwetepo no tusabi tumo utunono, nato ilyo atashishapo Lesa, aeba abasambi bakwe ukuti nato batwakanye ku bantu.

english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
translation: Awe balya no kwikuta baikuta. Elyo balonganya ifipandwa ifyasheleko, baisusha imiseke cine lubali.

english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
translation: Kanshi abalileko bali nalimo amakana yane. Elyo Yesu asalanganya abantu.

english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
translation: Elyo nakabili alabeba ati, “Ndemweba icine cine, bamo pali imwe, mwe beminine pano tabakafwe, mpaka bakasuke bakamone Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa uko buleisa na maka.”

english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
translation: Abasambi balisungile bwino uyu mulandu, lelo uko bali beka baleipushanya umulolele amashiwi ya “kubuuka ku bafwa.”

english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
translation: Elyo baipusha Yesu abati, “Ngeco bakafundisha bamafunde basosela abati, ‘Eliya euli nokubalilapo ukwisa’ cinshi?”

english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Kwena nifyo fine, Eliya ali nokubalilapo ukwisa nokwisa mona ukuti fyonse fili umo fifwile ukubeela. Nga nomba calembelwa nshi ukuti, Umwana wa muntu ali nokuculisha nganshi, kabili no kusuulwa?

english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
translation: Lelo ndemweba nati, Eliya alisa kale, na bantu bamucitile ngomo balefwaila, nga filya fine calembwa pa mulandu wakwe.”

english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
translation: Ilyo babwelela ku basambi bambi abashele, bamona ibumba ilikalamba nalibashinguluka, na bakafundisha bamafunde bamo balebikana nabo ifikansa.

english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
translation: Cilya abantu bamona Yesu, bonse basunguka nganshi, elyo babutuka ulubilo kukuya muposha.

english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
translation: Elyo aipusha abasambi bakwe ati, “Finshi ifyo mulebikaninapo nabo ifikansa?”

english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
translation: Kabili lyonse ilyo umwikata, ulamupama panshi ne fulo lyalafuma ku kanwa, alasenganya na meno, elyo no kumina aumina. Nacilomba abasambi bobe ukuti baufumyemo, nomba nabafilwa.”

english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
translation: Elyo Yesu nao ayasuka ati, “Mwe nkulo yabula icisumino mwe! Bushe tukaba na imwe mpaka lilali? Bushe ndi nokuba na imwe mpaka lilali? Leteni akalumendo kuno.”

english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
translation: Ilyo papitile inshiku mutanda, Yesu asendele Petelo na Yakobo na Yoani, baya nina ulupili ulutali ukwakuti babefye beka. Elyo ayaluka pa menso yabo.

english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
translation: Awe bakaleta kuli Yesu. Nomba umupashi wakowela ushimonafye Yesu, apopene walafulumfunsha akalumendo, wakaposa na panshi, kalafulukuta, ne fulo lyalafuma ku kanwa.

english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
translation: Elyo Yesu aipusha wishi ati, “Bushe apo camutampila, papita inshita shani?” Nao ayasuka ati, “Ukufumafye ku bwaice.

english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
translation: Kanshi ilingifye ulamuposa mu mulilo na mu menshi pakuti umwipaye. Lelo nga kuti wacitapo cimo, tulangulukileko, utwafweko!”

english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
translation: Elyo Yesu amwankula ati, “Auti, ‘nga kuti wacita?’ Ala umuntu wa cisumino kuti acita fyonse.”

english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
translation: Apopene wishi wa kalumendo apunda ati, “Nalisumina, shingafwakofye nkwatishe icisumino.”

english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
translation: Yesu cilya amona ibumba lyalabutukilako, akalipila umupashi wakowela ati, “We mupashi wakowela we, cinkomamatwi, cicibulu, nakweba fuma muli uyu muntu, wikatala aumwingilamo nakabili.”

english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
translation: Elyo umupashi wakowela walakafulumfunsha na maka, ulekuuta, epakufumamo. Akalumendo kashala nakalala kwati nakafwa, na bengi balasosa abati, “Afwa!”

english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
translation: Yesu wena akekata mu minwe, akemya, awe nako kaiminina.

english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
translation: Cilya Yesu aingila mu ŋanda, abasambi bakwe balamwipusha kumbali abati, “Bushe ifwe cinshi twacifililwa ukuutamfya?”

english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”
translation: Nao abasuka ati, “Umupashi wa musango uyu teti muutamfyemo kanofye ku mapepo [no kufunga ukulya].”

english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
translation: Ifyakufwala fyakwe fyabuuta tuutu, fyalabengeshimafye, fyabuutisha ukucila na pafyo umuntu pano calo engafibuutisha.

english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,
translation: Ilyo bafumine muli ilya ncende baya pita mu calo ca Galile. Yesu talefwaya ukuti abantu beshibe uko bali,

english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
translation: pantu alefunda abasambi bakwe. Alebeba ati, “Umwana wa muntu akaposwa mu minwe ya bantu, nabo bakamwipaya. Lelo panuma ya nshiku shitatu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
translation: Nomba tabaumfwile umwalolele aya mashiwi. Kabili baletiina no kumwipusha.

english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
translation: Awe bafikile ku Kapenamu. Ilyo bali mu ŋanda, Yesu abepusha ati, “Bushe cinshi mwacilabikaninapo ifikansa mu nshila?”

english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.
translation: Awe bena baikalafye tondolo, pantu mu nshila balebikana ifikansa abati, “Umukalamba pali ifwe bonse nani?”

english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
translation: Elyo Yesu aikala, aita na basambi ikumi limo na babili, alabeba ati, “Onse uulefwaya ukuba uwantanshi, afwile aicita uwakulekelesha kabili uwakutumika bonse.”

english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
translation: Elyo abuula akaice akeminika pa lwalala,

english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
translation: akafukatila, alabeba ati, “Umuntu onse uwasekelela akaice akali nga aka pa mulandu wa ine, ninshi nine asekelela. Kabili onse uwansekelela, tene asekelela, lelo asekelela uwantuma.”

english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
translation: Yoani aeba Yesu ati, “Kafundisha, twamwene umuntu umo alebomfya ishina lyobe pakutamfya imipashi yakowela, lelo ifwe twalimulesha, pantu tatwaba nankwe pamo.”

english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
translation: Lelo Yesu abeba ati, “Mwilamulesha, pantu takwaba nangu umo uucita icipeshamano mukubomfya ishina lyandi, kabili ese mukulalanda ifibi pali ine.

english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
translation: Elyo bamona Eliya na Mose balelanda na Yesu.

english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
translation: Pantu uyo onse uushitulwisha, ninshi munensu.

english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
translation: Uyo onse uwamupeela ulukombo lwa menshi, ico muli bena Kristu, ndemweba icine cine takabulwe icilambu cakwe.

english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
translation: “Nomba uwalenga ukuti kamo pali utu twaice utwansumina ukubifya, kuti camuwaminapo ukumukakila mu mukoshi icilibwe icafina icakupelelako, no kumuposa muli bemba.

english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
translation: Kabili icisansa cobe nga cakulengesha ukubifya, ciputuleko. Cawamishapo ukwingila mu mweo na makunkutu, ukucila ukuya ne fisansa fibili mu mulilo wape.

english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
translation: Kabili ulukasa lobe nga lwakulengesha ukubifya, uluputuleko. Cawamishapo ukwingila mu mweo icilema, ukucila ukuya na makasa yabili ku mulilo wape.

english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
translation: Kabili ilinso lyobe nga lyakulengesha ukubifya, litonkole. Cawamishapo ukwingila mu Bufumu bwakwa Lesa ne linso limo, ukucila ukuposwa na menso yabili mu mulilo wape,

english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
translation: umo ‘imititi yabo ishifwa, no mulilo ushishima.’

english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
translation: Nga filya balunga umucele mu fyakulya, efyo onse akalungwamo umulilo wa macushi.

english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation: Elyo Petelo aeba Yesu ati, “Kafundisha, kuti cawama twaikala pano pene. Lekafye tupangepo insakwe shitatu, imo yobe, imbi yakwa Mose, elyo na imbi iyakwa Eliya.”

english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
translation: Umucele waliwama, nomba nga wafumuka, bushe kuti waloweshiwa nanshi? Na mu bumi bwenu bwine mulebamo umucele, kabili muleikala na banenu umutende.”

english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
translation: Taishibe ifyo alesosa, pantu baliketwe no mwenso ukalamba.

english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
translation: Elyo paisa ikumbi lyabakupa na mu cinshingwa, na mwikumbi mwafuma ishiwi aliti, “Uyu e Mwana wandi, uo natemwa, mulemumfwa.”

english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
translation: Awe apopene bati bacebacebe, tabamwene nelyo umo, kanofye Yesu eka eo bashele nankwe.

english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
translation: Ilyo balatentemuka ulupili, Yesu alabakonkomesha ati, “Tecakwesha ukwebako umuntu nelyo umo pafyo mwacimona, kanofye ilyo Umwana wa muntu akabuuka ku bafwa.”

english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
translation: Muli ici citabo emwaba amashiwi aya pa fintu ifyo Nahumu umwina Elikoshi amwene mu cimonwa palwa musumba wa Ninife.

english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
translation: Nge myunga iyakobana,

english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
translation: Muli iwe we musumba wa Ninife emwafuma umuntu umo,

english: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
translation: Nomba Yawe ifyo aleeba abantu bakwe nifi, aleti,

english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”
translation: Yawe napeela icipope pa bena Ninife ati,

english: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.
translation: Yawe ni Lesa uwakwata ubufuba kabili alalandula,

english: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
translation: Yawe tafulwa bwangu, lelo kabili alikwatisha ubulamba,

english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.
translation: Alakalipila bemba no kumulenga ukukama,

english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
translation: Esaya 10:5-34

english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
translation: Yawe nga afulwa, nani uwingashanshako?

english: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
translation: Yawe, ala musuma,

english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
translation: Abalwani bakwe ena abapumikishafye nge lyeshi ilyamaka,

english: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
translation: Bushe imwe bubi nshi mulepanga ukucitila Yawe?

english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!
translation: Uwakukusansa aleisa kuli iwe we musumba wa Ninife.

english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
translation: Eya, umusumba wa Ninife bautapa, baubongolola no kuonaula.

english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
translation: Bushe nomba uli kwi umwimba uwakwikalako inkalamo,

english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
translation: Iyilume yaleti nga yaipaya inama,

english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “Moneni, ine nimwalukila. Nalaoca amaceleta yenu. Inkondo eikalofya utwana twenu utukalamo, na ine nkamupoka fyonse ifyo mwatapile bambi. Pano isonde ponse tapakatale apomfwika nakabili amashiwi ya nkombe shenu nakalya.”

english: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.
translation: Pantu Yawe alebweseshapo ululumbi lwakwa Yakobo,

english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
translation: Abashilika abalesansa imwe bali ne nkwela ishakashika,

english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
translation: Amaceleta yalya yalulunkanina mu misebo,

english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
translation: Baita ifita ifyasobolwa,

english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
translation: Impongolo ishabela ku mumana shilya shaisulwa,

english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
translation: Namfumu ulya basenda bunkole,

english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.
translation: Abantu balya baomoka mu Ninife,

english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
translation: Batapeni silifa.

english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.
translation: Washama we musumba wa fipondo,

english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
translation: Nomba abena Tebe nabo bene balibekete no kubasenda bunkole. Mu finshoko fya misebo ya mu Tebe emo utwana twabo baletunyankwila pakutwipaya. Abacindami abalimo babasendele mu minyololo, balecita ukupendula pakwakana abakankala babo kubabekete.

english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
translation: Nemwe bene mwe bena Ninife mukawa nga bantu abakolelwe ubwalwa. Mukafulumuka abalwani benu no kufisama.

english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
translation: Amalinga yenu yonse yakabafye nge mikunyu iliko amakunyu ayapya, icakuti umo nga apukunyako, ninshi ne fitwalo kulalukutila mu kanwa kakwe.

english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.
translation: Abashilika benu balifye nga banakashi, ne calo cenu tacikwete fyakuicingililako ku balwani benu. Imipilikisho ya mpongolo sha musumba wenu naitutaika ku mulilo.

english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
translation: Aleni bangilileni ukutapa amenshi ilyo abalwani benu bashilati bamulibile. Kosheni amalinga yenu. Akukandileni iloba ilyakutamamo amatafwali, fwayeni ifikombola.

english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.
translation: Nangu mucite ifyo, ala nalyo line mukatutaika ku mulilo, atemwa mukafwa ku nkondo. Mukapwa nge fisabo ifyo makanta alile.

english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
translation: Mwalifyala bashimakwebo abacila ne ntanda ku bwingi. Ndakai tabalipo, baliya, baya nga makanta uwansa amapindo yakwe no kupupukila kumbi panuma yakupulula no kulya fyonse.

english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
translation: Bacilolo benu bafula nga makanta, na bamushika benu nga makanta umwingi ulya uwikala ku fibumba ubushiku ilyo kuli impepo. Uwakuti cilya akasuba kabalika, ninshi apupuka, ukwabula nelyo umo uwakwishiba uko ele.

english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
translation: Iwe we mfumu we wateeka icalo ca Asiria, ala abalashi bobe nabafwa, bacilolo bobe abacindami nacipwa nabapona mu tulo uto bashakatale ababuukamo. Abantu bobe basalanganine pa mpili, takuli nelyo umo uwakubalonganya nakalya.

english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?
translation: Iwe teti kumoneke umuti uwakuti waposha ifilonda fyobe nakalya, ifilaso fyobe naficilamo, te fyakundapwa iyoo. Bonsefye abaleumfwako ifyo iwe cili, ala bakulaombafye indupi kulwa nsansa, pantu takwaba nelyo umo nakalya uo iwe ushateeka ku kalili.

english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
translation: Umfweni ifikoti ifyo filelulamo,

english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies
translation: Abendela pali bakabalwe balya bafulumbana,

english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
translation: Ne cilengele, nico ubulalelale bwalifulisha mu Ninife,

english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati,

english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
translation: Ine ndemusebanya imwe,

english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
translation: Abantu bonse abakulamumona bakulashintukila.

english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
translation: Iwe we musumba wa Ninife, bushe walicila umusumba wa Tebesi ku busuma? Ngefyo Tebesi nao wine ali mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Nailo, kabili washingulwikwe na Nailo wine uwali nge linga ilyakuipokolwelako. Amenshi eyali nge cibumba ca musumba.

english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.
translation: Icalo ca Kushi ne calo ca Egupto, emwali amaka yauko ayapelele pelelefye. Abena Puti, na bena Libia baleumfwana na bena Tebe.

english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
translation: Nomba aba e bantu abafwatikepo inshimbi elyo no kulembapo amashina yabo,

english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
translation: elyo na bamunyinabo:

english: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation: Mika, Rehobi na Hashabia,

english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation: Sakuri, Sherebia na Shebania,

english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation: Hodia, Bani elyo na Beninu.

english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation: Kabili intungulushi sha bantu nasho shali ni Paroshi, Pahati Moabu, Elamu, Satu na Bani,

english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation: Buni, Asigadi, na Bebayi,

english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation: Adoniya, Bigifai na Adini,

english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation: Ateri, Hesekia na Asuri,

english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation: Hodia, Hashumu, na Basayi,

english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,
translation: Harifu, Anatoti na Nebai,

english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
translation: Seraya, Asaria na Yeremia,

english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation: Magipyashi, Meshulamu na Hesiri,

english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation: Meshesabeli, Sadoki na Yadua,

english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation: Pelatiya, Hanani na Anania,

english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation: Hosheya, Hananiya na Hashuba,

english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation: Haloheshi, Piliha na Shobeki,

english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation: Rehumu, Hashabana na Maaseya,

english: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation: Ahiya, Hanani na Anani,

english: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.
translation: Maluki, Harimu elyo na Baanaya.

english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—
translation: Elyo pali na bantu bambi pamo nga bashimapepo, abena Levi, bakalinda wa mpongolo, bakemba, ababomfi be Tempele, na bonsefye abatalwike ku benafyalo pakukonka amafunde yakwa Yawe. Kabili bali pamo pene na bakashi babo pamo na bana babo abaume na banakashi bene. Bonsefye abali ne myaka yakucenjela no kwiluka ifintu abene.

english: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;
translation: Bauminkana pamo na bamunyinabo, abasambashi babo, ilyo balelaya pakuitipwila, na mukulapa ukukonka amafunde yakwa Lesa ayo apeele ku kanwa kakwa Mose umubomfi wakwa Lesa. Twasuminishanya capamo ukubeela bwino amafunde, ifipope na malango yonse ayakwa Yawe, Imfumu yesu.

english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
translation: Pashehuri, Amariya na Malikiya,

english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
translation: Twalapa ukukanaufya abana besu abanakashi ku bana ba benafyalo abatushinguluka, nangu ukufwaya abana babo ukuupwa ku bana besu abaume.

english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.
translation: Nga cakuti abantu mu calo baleta ifyakushitisha nangufye ifyakulya ifya misango misango, tatwakatale atushitako nga cakuti baleta pa bushiku bwe Sabata , nangufye ni pa bushiku bwamushilo bumbi. Eico kanshi lyonsefye ilyo umwaka wa cine lubali wafika, tuli nokuleka umushili ukubafye elyo no kufuuta ifyamisha fyonse.

english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:
translation: Kabili twaipeela ne fyebo ifyakuti cila mwaka twakulapeela ulupiya lumo ulwakwafwa mukubomba imilimo ya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu.

english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
translation: Twasumina ukupeela ifyakubomba ku mukate wakutuula, imituulo ya cabunga iya pe na pe, ilambo lya cakoca, imituulo ya pa Masabata, iya pa mweshi uupya, iyakubomfya pa nshikunkulu, kabili ku fyabupe ifyamushilo elyo na ku mituulo ya pa fyabubifi iyakufutila abena Israeli, elyo na pa fya milimo yonse iya pa ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu.

english: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on the LORD our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;
translation: Ifwe nga bashimapepo, abena Levi, elyo na bantu bonse natucita icipendwilo cakwishiba ifyo aba muli cila lupwa bali nokupeela inkuni ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu pa nshita iyasontwa mu mwaka no mwaka. Ishi ni nkuni shakukosha pa bulambo bwakwa Yawe, Lesa wesu, pamo ngefyo calembwa mu mafunde.

english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to the LORD’s house;
translation: Kabili twalaile ukulaleta ku ŋanda yakwa Yawe iŋanu shakubalilapo mukulobolola, pamo ne fitwalo fyakubalilapo ukupya fyonse.

english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
translation: Pamo ngefyo mu cine cinefye calembwa mu mafunde, twakulaleta amabeli ya bana besu pamo na mabeli ya ŋombe shesu, amabeli ya mbushi na ya mpaanga shesu no kufitwala ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu no kupeela kuli bashimapepo ababomba kulya kwine.

english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.
translation: Kabili tukatwalila bashimapepo mu miputule ya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu ifyawamisha mu fintu tupeela mu fitwalo fya muti onse, mu mwangashi upya na mu mafuta. Tukatwalila abena Levi icapekumi conse pafyo umushili ukabwesha. Pantu abena Levi ebapitamo abene mu misumba yonse iya bulimi bwesu mukupoka icapekumi.

english: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.
translation: Elyo shimapepo, umwana wakwa Aroni, akaya na bena Levi pakupoka icapekumi. Kabili abena Levi bakafumyapo ku fyapekumi icipande cimo pekumi limo no kutwala ku ŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu ku miputule yamukati, emukutila mu butala.

english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.
translation: Pantu abena Israeli na bena Levi bali nokulaleta ifya mutuulo wa nseke, uwa mwangashi upya no wa mafuta. Ifi fyonse fikaletwa ku miputule bafisungilako, nakabili uko bashimapepo na bakalinda ba ku mpongolo pamo na bakemba bekala. Kabili tatwakalekeleshe iŋanda yakwa Lesa wesu nakalya.

english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
translation: Hatushi, Shebania na Maluki,

english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
translation: Harimu, Meremoti na Obadia,

english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
translation: Daniele, Ginetoni na Baruki,

english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
translation: Meshulamu, Abiya na Miyamini,

english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
translation: Masia, Biligai elyo na Shemaiya.

english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
translation: Elyo ku bena Levi nabo ni Yeshua mwana Asania, elyo na Binui uwa mu lupwa lwa bena Henadadi, Kadimieli,

english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
translation: Nomba ilyo intungulushi sha bantu shaile ikala mu Yerusalemu, elyo abantu bonse bacitile ukubapendwilafye pakuti basale umo mu lupwa pa bali ikumi uwakwikala mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, icifulo camushilo. Lelo bonse abashala ukulingana ne mpendwa ya pabula bali nokutwalilila ukwikala mu misumba yabo iyo balefwaya.

english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
translation: Nga twaisa kuli bashimapepo:

english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
translation: Seraya umwana mwaume wakwa Hilikiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Meshulamu, umwana mwaume wakwa Sadoki, umwana mwaume wakwa Merayoti, umwana mwaume wakwa Ahitubi uwali e ntungulushi ya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
translation: Ababwananyina bambi ababombeleko imilimo kwi Tempele bali imyanda cine konse konse na makumi yabili na babili (822).

english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
translation: Ena pamo na bamunyina abali intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo bali imyanda ibili na makumi yane na babili (242).

english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
translation: Ababwananyina bakwe, amalamba yabo, bali umwanda umo na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (128). Kabili intungulushi yabo yali ni Sabudieli umwana mwaume wakwa Hagedolimu.

english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
translation: Mu lupwa lwa bena Levi:

english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
translation: Kabili Shabetai na Yosabadi bali ntungulushi shibili sha bena Levi ishalesakamana imilimo ya kunse ya ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
translation: Elyo kabili na Matania umwana mwaume wakwa Mika, umwana mwaume wakwa Sabidi, umwana mwaume wakwa Asafu uwaletungulula umulimo wa nyimbo shakutasha mu mapepo.

english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
translation: Abena Levi abali mu musumba bonse pamo bali imyanda ibili amakumi cine konse konse na bane (284).

english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
translation: Aba e bakalinda wa mpongolo:

english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
translation: Abantu nabo batashishe nganshi aba bonse abaume abaile ikala mu musumba wa Yerusalemu mukuitemenwa.

english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli, bashimapepo na bena Levi bambi abasheleko, baikele mu misumba yonse iya calo ca Yuda, cila muntu ku mpanga ya fikolwe fyakwe.

english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
translation: Ababomfi be Tempele baikele mu Ofeli na mu Siha, kabili Gishipa ewalebatungulula.

english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.
translation: Uwaletungulula abena Levi bonse mu Yerusalemu ni Usi umwana mwaume uwakwa Bani, umwana mwaume wakwa Hashabiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Matania uwali e mwana mwaume wakwa Mika. Usi ali ni umo mu ba lupwa lwakwa Asafu, abaletungulula bakemba ababomba mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
translation: Kwali icebo icafumine ku mfumu pali bakemba icakubapeela ifyo babapimine ifyalekabilwa cila bushiku.

english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
translation: Elyo Petaya umwana mwaume wakwa Meshesabeli, uwali umo mu ba lupwa lwakwa Sera, mu luko lwakwa Yuda, aleafwilisha imfumu mu milandu yonse iya bantu.

english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
translation: Kanshi palwa mishi na mabala yaiko, bamo Abayuda baikele mu Kiriati Aba mu mishi yali mumbali, mu Diboni ne mishi yauko elyo na mu Yekabiseli ne mishi yauko,

english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,
translation: na mu Yeshua, na mu Molada, na mu Beti Peleti,

english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,
translation: mu Hasari Shuali, mu Beresheba ne mishi yauko,

english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,
translation: mu Sikilagi, mu Mekona ne mishi yauko,

english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
translation: mu Eni Rimoni, mu Sora, mu Yamuti,

english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
translation: Ishi e ntungulushi sha mu fitungu fya calo ishaikala mu Yerusalemu na mu misumba ya bena Yuda. Nomba bamo abena Israeli, bashimapepo, abena Levi, ababomfi be tempele pamo na bana ba babomfi bakwa Solomoni baleikala mu misumba ya mu Yuda. Onse mu mpanga yakwe.

english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
translation: mu Sanoa na mu Adulamu ne mishi yaiko, mu Lakishi na mabala yalimo, no musumba wa Aseka ne mishi yauko. Kanshi baikele mu ncende ukufuma ku Beresheba ukufika mu mupokapoka wa Hinomu.

english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
translation: Abantu bakwa Benjamini abafumine ku Geba baikele mu Mikimashi, Aiya, Betele ne mishi yaiko,

english: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation: Anatoti, Nobu, Anania.

english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation: Hasoli, Rama, Gitaimu,

english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation: Hadidi, Seboimu, Nebalati,

english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
translation: Lodi na Ono, mwishika umwaleikala abantu abacenjela mu fyakupanga panga.

english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
translation: Impuka shimo isha bena Levi mu Yuda shaikele ku Benjamini.

english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
translation: Lelo abantu bambi abafumine mu lupwa lwakwa Yuda na Benjamini, bena baleikala mu Yerusalemu.

english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
translation: Kabili na umbi ni Maaseya umwana mwaume wakwa Baruki, umwana mwaume wakwa Koli Hose, umwana mwaume wakwa Hasaiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Adaiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Yoyaribu, umwana mwaume wakwa Sakaria, umwana mwaume uwa mwina Shiloni.

english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
translation: Eico bonse abana baume abakwa Peresi abaikele mu Yerusalemu bali imyanda ine na makumi mutanda na cine konse konse (468).

english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
translation: Elyo nakabili, aba ebali mu luko lwakwa Benjamini:

english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
translation: Elyo panuma yakwe ni Gabayi na Salayi elyo bonse pamo bafikile pa myanda pabula na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (928).

english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
translation: Elyo Yoeli umwana mwaume wakwa Sikiri ewalebangalila. Elyo Yuda nao, mwana Hasenuya ewali uwacibili mu musumba.

english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation: Aba e bashimapepo na bena Levi ababwelele na Serubabeli umwana mwaume uwakwa Shealitieli, na Yeshua:

english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,
translation: Kanshi Yeshua afyele Yoiakimu, Yoiakimu afyele Eliashibu, Eliashibu afyele Yoiyada.

english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.
translation: Yoiyada e wishi wakwa Yonatani nao e wishi wakwa Yadua.

english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
translation: Mu nshiku shakwa Yoiakimu bashimapepo abali abakalamba ba ndupwa sha bashimapepo ni aba:

english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
translation: Meshulamu uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Esra,

english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
translation: Yonatani uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Maluku,

english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
translation: Adena uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Harimu,

english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
translation: Sakaria uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Ido,

english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
translation: Sikiri uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Abiya,

english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
translation: Shamua uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Biliga,

english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
translation: Matenai uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Yoiaribu,

english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation: Amaria, Maluku, Hatushi,

english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
translation: Kalai uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Salai,

english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
translation: Hashabiya uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Hilikiya,

english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
translation: Mu nshiku shakwa Eliashibu, Yoiyada, Yoanani na Yadua amashina ya bakalamba mu ŋanda sha fikolwe fyabo yalilembwa, pamo pene na ya bakalamba ba bashimapepo, mpakafye na mu buteeko bwakwa Dariusi umwina Pesia.

english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
translation: Elyo abena Levi bena, abakalamba mu mayanda ya fikolwe fyabo balilembelwe mu citabo camilandu ukushintafye na pa nshiku shakwa Yoanani umwana mwaume wakwa Eliashibu.

english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.
translation: Intungulushi sha bena Levi shali ni Hashabiya, Sherebiya na Yeshua umwana mwaume uwakwa Kadimieli, na bamunyinabo nabo baleiminina nabaloleshanya nabo pakwimba inyimbo sha malumbo no kutasha, ukulingana na mafunde yakwa Davidi umuntu wakwa Lesa. Amabumba yaleimba yabili pa nshita imo, nabaloleshanya baleankulana.

english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.
translation: Elyo kwali na balelinda amayanda yakusungilamo ifipe, bakalinda wa mpongolo. Amashina yabo ni aya: Matania, Bakibukiya, Obadia, Meshulamu, Talimoni na Akubu.

english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.
translation: Ifi fyacitike mu nshiku shakwa Yoiakimu umwana mwaume wakwa Yeshua umwishikulu wakwa Yosadaki, na mu nshiku sha mulashi Nehemia na shimapepo kabili kalemba Esra.

english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.
translation: Kanshi ilyo nshita yafikile iyakuti batuule ilinga lya musumba wa mu Yerusalemu kuli Lesa, bafwaile abena Levi abali mu ncende shimbi no kubaleta ku Yerusalemu pakuti basefye ne nsansa, no kutasha konse mu nyimbo, imiwaya, amaseese ne nsango pakutuula ilinga.

english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;
translation: Elyo bakemba balongana pamo ukufuma mu ncende iyashingulwike Yerusalemu ne mishi ya bena Netofa.

english: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.
translation: Bambi bafumine ku Beti Giligali na ku ncende ya ku Geba na Asimafeti pantu bakemba bakuulile imishi yabo ukushinguluka Yerusalemu.

english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
translation: Shekaniya, Reumu, Meremoti,

english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
translation: Elyo bashimapepo na bena Levi baisangulula abene, basangulula na bantu, basangulula impongolo pamo ne linga.

english: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;
translation: Kanshi naeba intungulushi sha bena Yuda ukunina pa mulu we linga. Nasonta na mabumba ya bakemba yabili ayakulu ukuti yengile mu milongo ibili, limo ibumba lyaile ku kapinda ka ku kulyo kwe linga ku Mpongolo ya Fisoso.

english: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,
translation: Lilya bapita elyo pakonka Hoshaya ali na citika wa ntungulushi sha bena Yuda,

english: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
translation: pamo na Asariya, Esra, Meshulamu,

english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
translation: Yuda, Benjamini, Shemaiya na Yeremia,

english: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;
translation: na bana ba bashimapepo bamo bamo baisa na mapenga, ni Sakaria umwana mwaume wakwa Yonatani, umwana mwaume wakwa Shemaiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Mataniya, umwana mwaume wakwa Mikaiya, umwana mwaume wakwa Sakuri uwali umwana wakwa Asafu.

english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.
translation: Ba lupwa lwakwe bali ni Shemaiya, Asareli, Milalai, Gilalai, Mai, Netaneli, Yuda na Hanani abalelisha inyimbo pa filimba umo Davidi umuntu wakwa Lesa apekanishishe. Elyo Esra kalemba alibatangilile.

english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of David’s city, at the ascent of the wall, above David’s house, even to the water gate eastward.
translation: Cilya bafika pa Mpongolo ya Kamfukumfuku, banina amatabo ayalola ku musumba wakwa Davidi ukucila isano lyakwa Davidi, elyo balungama ku cibumba ca Mpongolo ya Menshi lubali lwa ku kabanga ka musumba.

english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,
translation: Ibumba limbi ilya bakemba lyalungama ku masamba. Na ine nalikonka panuma pamulu we linga, twali ne bumba lya bantu citika. Twaenda ukupita pa Lupungu lwa Malungu, ukulola kwilinga ilyamutika,

english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
translation: pa mulu wa Mpongolo yakwa Efulemu, ne Mpongolo yakwa Yeshana, Impongolo ye Sabi, na pa Lupungu lwa Hananeli, Ulupungu lwa Mwanda umo (100) ukushinta na ku Mpongolo ya Mpaanga. Twasuka twafika na ku Mpongolo yakwa Malonda.

english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation: Ido, Ginetoi, Abiya,

english: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;
translation: Elyo amabumba ya bakemba yabili ayakulumbanya Lesa yaiminina pa ncende shabo mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Na ine wine pamo na citika wa ntungulushi twali nasho twaimina,

english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
translation: twali pamo na bashimapepo abali na mapenga. Amashina yabo ni aya: Eliakimu, Maaseya, Miniamini, Mikaya, Elioenai, Sakaria na Hanania abali na mapenga,

english: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
translation: elyo pamo na Maaseya, Shemaiya, Eleasa, Usi, Yehoanani, Malikiya, Elamu, na Eseri. Bakemba baletungululwa na Yesiraya.

english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.
translation: Kanshi pali ubo bushiku batuula Lesa amalumbo ayengi nganshi no kusansamuka. Balisansamwike pantu Lesa ewabapeele ishi nsansa ishishaifulila. Banamayo pamo pene na bana balisansamwike. Ne ciunda ca nsansa ishali mu Yerusalemu caumfwikike ukutali nganshi.

english: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.
translation: Pa nshita ine ilya basonta abantu bashifwe abakwangalila amatala umo balesungila umutuulo wa ŋanda yakwa Lesa, ukulundapofye no mutuulo wa cekumi pamo ne fisabo fyakubalilapo. Aba bantu ebalelonganika ifyamutuulo ukufuma mu mabala ayashingulwike imisumba no kufibika mu matala, ukulingana ne fipimo fyakukonka amafunde palwa kupeela kuli bashimapepo na ku bena Levi, pantu abena Yuda balisekelemo mu milimo ya batumishi iyo bashimapepo na bena Levi balebomba.

english: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.
translation: Balebomba umulimo wakutumika Lesa no kusangulula. Bakemba na bakalinda wa mpongolo nabo bene efyo balecita ukulingana nefyo Davidi no mwana wakwe Solomoni babakonkomeshe.

english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
translation: Na kale line mu nshiku shakwa Davidi na Asafu kwali ntungulushi sha bakemba ne nyimbo shakulumbanya no kutatakula Lesa.

english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
translation: Kabili na mu nshiku shakwa Serubabeli na Nehemia, abena Israeli bonse baletuula ifyapimwa kuli bakemba na bakalinda wa mpongolo. Kabili balipatwileko umutuulo umo uwali wa bena Levi bambi, elyo na bena Levi bapatwilapo aba mu lupwa lwakwa Aroni.

english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation: Miyamini, Maadiya, Biliga

english: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation: Shemaiya, Yoaribu, Yedaya,

english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.
translation: Salu, Amoki, Hilikiya, Yedaya.

english: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.
translation: Abena Levi nabo ni Yeshua, Binui, Kadimieli, Sherebiya, Yuda na Matania uwali umukalamba wa bakatungulula wa nyimbo shakutasha pamo na bamunyinabo.

english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.
translation: Elyo Bakibukiya na Uni na bamunyinabo bena baleiminina nabaloleshanya amenso nabo ilyo baleimba.

english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,
translation: Pa bushiku ubo epo babelengele icitabo cakwa Mose pa lwalala mu matwi ya bantu. Bafikile apo calembwa ukuti tecakwesha ukusankana no mwina Amoni nangu umwina Moabu mu lukuta lwakwa Lesa,

english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.
translation: Kabili nalimwene nokuti icipande capekumi bali nokulapeela abena Levi, tabalebapeela, elyo nokuti abena Levi na bakemba abali no mulimo wakutumika mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa balileka ukubomba, babwelela na mukubomba mu mabala yabo.

english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
translation: Kanshi nakalipila intungulushi no kubepusha ukuti, “Cinshi iŋanda yakwa Lesa yabela iyalekeleshiwa?” Elyo nabalonganike pamo no kubabwekesha mu fifulo balipo nakale.

english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.
translation: Abena Yuda bonse epakuleta umutuulo wa cekumi uwabunga, umwangashi upya na mafuta mu miputule.

english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.
translation: Napeele Shelemiya shimapepo, Sadoki kalemba no mwina Levi uo baleita Pedaya umulimo uwakusunga imiputule yakusungilamo ifintu. Elyo Hanani umwana mwaume uwakwa Sakuri, umwishikulu wakwa Matania, namucita kafwa wabo, pantu aba bantu bali abacishinka. Elyo kabili wali mulimo wabo ukwakanya ifintu kuli bamunyina.

english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.
translation: Ulenjibukisha we Lesa wandi pali ici, wileka ifyo mombele mu bufumacumi palwa ŋanda yakwa Lesa wandi ne mipepele yakwe fyonaike.

english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.
translation: Muli shilya nshiku namwene abaume aba mu calo ca Bayuda balenyanta icakukaminamo umwangashi pa bushiku bwe Sabata. Kabili nabalonga iŋanu pali bakabalwe pamo no mwangashi ne fitwalo fya myangashi, imikunyu na fimbipo baleleta fyonse ifi mu Yerusalemu pe Sabata. Kanshi nabakalipila pakulashitisha ifyakulya pali ubu bushiku.

english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
translation: Kabili abaume abafumine ku Turi abaleikala mu Yerusalemu nabo baleleta isabi ne fintu fimbi ifyamakwebo no kushitisha mu Yerusalemu ku bantu ba mu calo ca Yuda pa bushiku bwe Sabata.
