english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?
translation: Elyo naebaula na basambashi ba mu calo ca Yuda natila, “Cinshi mulecitila icabipisha ifi, mwakowesha ubushiku bwe Sabata.

english: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”
translation: Bushe bashinwe tabacitile ica musango umo wine pakuti Lesa alete amafya pali ifwe no musumba? Kabili imwe mulelundako pakukowesha Isabata pakuti ubukali buponene Israeli.”

english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.
translation: Amaf 12:19

english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation: pantu aba bantu tabapokelele abana bakwa Israeli no kubapeela ifyakulya na menshi lelo balipile Balamu pakuti abatipwile. Nomba Lesa ena ayalula icitipu ukuba ipaalo.

english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.
translation: Limo limo bashimakwebo na bakashitisha ba fyakulya ifyalekana lekana balesendama kunse ya Yerusalemu.

english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.
translation: Elyo napeela abena Levi icebo icakuti baisangulule kabili baye mukulonda impongolo epakushininkisha ukuti Isabata lilesungwa muli bukaele.

english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;
translation: Kabili mu nshiku shine isho namwene ukuti Abayuda baupile banamayo ukufuma ku bena Ashidodi, abena Amoni na bena Moabu.

english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.
translation: Na bana bafyelwe muli ifi fyupo, citika balelanda icitundu ca bena Ashidodi, nangu ululimi lwa bantufye bambi. Tabaishibe no kulanda ululimi lwa Ciyuda nakalya.

english: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.
translation: Kanshi nabakalipila no kubatipwila. Nasuka naumapo nabamo no kubanukula umushishi. Nabeba nokuti bafwile balapa umulapo mwishina lyakwa Lesa ukuti, “Imwe tamwakatale amuufya abana benu abakashana ku bana ba muli iyi mitundu, nangu ukusuminisha abana benu abaume, nangu imwe bene, ukuupa abakashana ba mishobo imbi.

english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.
translation: Bushe te fyupo fya musango uyu efyalengele ukuti Solomoni mfumu ya bena Israeli acite icabubifi? Mu fyalo fyonse takwali imfumu iyali nga ena. Ali uwatemwikwa kuli Lesa, kabili Lesa amucitile imfumu ya calo ca Israeli conse. Nomba pa mulandu wa banamayo abafumine ku mishobo imbi ecalengele ukuti acite icabubifi.

english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”
translation: Nshilefwaya ukumfwa ukuti na imwe mwaibika mu misango iyi iyabipisha, nokutila mulesangukila Lesa wesu pakuupa banamayo abafuma ku mishobo imbi.”

english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.
translation: Umo pa bana bakwa Yehoiyada, umwishikulu wakwa Eliashibu shimapepo mukalamba, ali ni shifyala wakwa Sanibalati umwina Holo, nalimutamfishe ukufuma kuli ine.

english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
translation: Ibukisha aba bantu, we Lesa wandi, pantu balikowesha bushimapepo ne cipangano ca bushimapepo neca bwina Levi.

english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.
translation: Amaf 23:3-5

english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;
translation: Kanshi efyo nasangulwile bashimapepo na bena Levi kuli fyonse ifyafuma ku benafyalo, no kubapeela incito shabo, cila muntu no mulimo wakwe.

english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
translation: Nateyanya nokuti pa nshita ishapimwa baleleta umutuulo wa nkuni ne fitwalo fyakubalilapo.

english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,
translation: Ilyo ifi tafilati ficitike, Eliashibu shimapepo aleangalila imiputule balesungilamo ifintu mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa. Eliashibu ali wa mu lupwa lwakwa Tobia,

english: had prepared for him a great room, where before they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.
translation: kanshi apekanishishe Tobia umuputule uukalamba nganshi uo pakubala balebomfya ukubikamo umutuulo wa cabunga, icinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka, ne fipe fya mwi Tempele pamo pene ne cekumi icabunga, umwangashi upya na mafuta baletuula ukwafwilisha abena Levi, bakemba, bakalinda wa mpongolo, pamo nefyo batuula kuli bashimapepo.

english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,
translation: Ukuba kwena ilyo ifi fyonse fyalecitika nshali mu Yerusalemu iyoo, pantu mu mwaka walenga amakumi yatatu na ibili (32) uwa bufumu bwakwa Atakisesi imfumu ya ku Babiloni nalibwelelemo ku mfumu ku Babiloni kwine. Lelo panuma ya nshita nalilombele insambu ku mfumu nabwelulukila ku Yerusalemu.

english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.
translation: Elyo naishile umfwa icilubo Eliashibu acitile pakupeela Tobia umuputule mu lubansa lwa ŋanda yakwa Lesa.

english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.
translation: Nalifulilwe nganshi no kuposa panse ifipe fyakwa Tobia fyonse ifyali mu muputule.

english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.
translation: Elyo napeela icebo icakuti imiputule yonse isangululwe, no kubwekeshamo ifipe balebomfya mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, pamo pene ne mituulo ya cabunga ne cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka.

english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace,
translation: Aya e mashiwi yakwa Nehemia, mwana Hakaliya. Nomba cali mu mwaka uwalenga amakumi yabili (20) uwa mfumu Atakisesi, mu mweshi wa Kisilefu , ilyo nali mu musumba wa Susa.

english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.
translation: “Nomba aba e babomfi bobe, kabili abantu bobe abo wapususha na maka yobefye ayakosesha na ku kuboko kobe ukwamaka.

english: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.
translation: We Mfumu yandi, shileka ukutwi kobe kukutike kwipepo lya mubomfi obe, na ku mapepo ya babomfi bobe abatemwa ukucindika ishina lyobe. Shi napapata leka umubomfi obe abe uwashuka. Leka uyu muntu amusekelele.”

english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
translation: Hanani umo uwa muli bamunyinane, alishile ukufuma ku calo ca Yuda, bali na bantu bamo. Elyo nabepwishe pa mulandu wa Bayuda abashele no kupusuka kuli bunkole, kabili na pa musumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”
translation: Elyo nabo balyaswike no kutila, “Abalubwike muli bunkole, abashele muli ici calo, bali no bulanda ubukalamba no kwikatwa insoni nganshi. Icibumba ca Yerusalemu naco cine calibongoloka no kuponena panshi. Kabili ne mpongolo nasho, shalipya.”

english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,
translation: Ilyo naumfwile aya mashiwi, awe naikala na panshi no kulilafye. Nalooseshe nganshi pa nshiku ishingi. Nafungile ukulya, no kupepa kuli Lesa wa mu mulu.

english: and said, “I beg you, LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,
translation: Elyo nasosele nati,

english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.
translation: Shi wingateya ukutwi kobe no kwisula amenso yobe pakuti umfwe ipepo lyandi ne mubomfi obe. Ine, akasuba no bushiku, ndepapatila ababomfi bobe abena Israeli. Ndeyebelela pa fyabubifi fyonse ifyo ifwe fwe bena Israeli twabifya kuli iwe, ifyo na ine wine pamo na ba mu ŋanda yandi twabifyako.

english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.
translation: Twabombele ifintu mu bunasha bwalufyengo kuli iwe. Tatwakonkele nangufye panono amalango ne fipope nangu amafunde ifyo wapeele ku mubomfi obe Mose.

english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;
translation: “Nomba ibukisha amashiwi ayo waebele umubomfi obe Mose, ayakuti, ‘Nga cakuti mwansangukila, ndi nokumusalanganishisha mu mishobo ya benafyalo.

english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’
translation: Lelo nga cakuti mwabwelulukila kuli ine, no kubeela amafunde yandi, elyo nangufye cingaba cakuti abantu benu ababa muli bunkole baba ukutali, ine ndi nokubalonganika no kubafumya kulya no kubaleta ku cifulo icasalwa ukwikalamo ishina lyandi.’

english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.
translation: Kabili cali mu mweshi wa Nisani mu mwaka walenga amakumi yabili (20) iya bufumu bwakwa Atakisesi, ilyo bamuletele umwangashi, ine naubuula no kupeela ku mfumu. Nomba ine nshatalile moneka bulanda bulanda pa cinso caiko.

english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
translation: Ilyo Sanibalati umwina Horoni elyo na Tobia nga cilolo umwina Amoni bati bomfwe umulandu, bafulwa nganshi pakumfwa ukuti umuntu umo naisa mukwafwilisha abana bakwa Israeli.

english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
translation: Ilyo nafikile mu Yerusalemu, naikalamo ne nshiku shitatu.

english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.
I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.
translation: Kabili mu nshita ya bushiku napitile mu Mpongolo ya ku mukonko pa mwinshi ku Cishima ca Cisoka elyo na ku Mpongolo ya Fisoso. Natandalile ifibumba fya Yerusalemu ifyawile panshi ne mpongolo shafiko ishaonawilwe ku mulilo.

english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.
translation: Elyo naile na ku Mpongolo ya Kamfukumfuku na ku Cishiba ca Mfumu. Awe nshasangile inshila iyingapitapo kabalwe nanininepo.

english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.
translation: Kanshi mu nshita ine iya bushiku naile ndeenda mu mukonko no kulengula bwino ifyo ilinga lyali. Elyo na panuma ya ifi nalibwelulwike no kwingila kabili pa Mpongolo ya ku mukonko.

english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.
translation: Kwena bacilolo nabo bene tabaishibe uko naile nangu ifyo nacitile. Pantu nshali nshilaeba Abayuda, bashimapepo, bashimucindikwa, bacilolo elyo na bambi bonse abali nokubombako uyu mulimo.

english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”
translation: Elyo natile kuli bena, “Bushe namumona ubulanda tuli nabo? Mwamona Yerusalemu ishele icibolya elyo impongolo nasho shalipya ku mulilo. Aleni natukuule ilinga lya Yerusalemu cipya cipya, pakuti twisebana nakabili.”

english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
translation: Kabili nabebele na pa luse lwakwa Lesa wandi ulwangafwilisheko elyo na pa mashiwi ya mfumu yantu yanjebele.

english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”
translation: Imila 36:19

english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.
translation: Eico imfumu yatile kuli ine, “Bushe mulandu nshi impumi yobe ibelele no bulanda, ilyo taulwele? Ici tacili bulanda bwacimbi, lelo bulanda bwa ku mutima.”

english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”
translation: Elyo na ine nabaswike nati, “Lesa wa mu mulu umwine ali nokutupeela ishuko. Eico kanshi na ifwe fwe babomfi bakwe tuleima no kukuula. Lelo imwe tamuli na nsambu nangu icacishilano nangu icacibukisho mu Yerusalemu.”

english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”
translation: lelo naeba imfumu nati, “Shi imfumu naibe no bumi umuyayaya! Ngakuti nakaana shani ukuba no bulanda pa menso, apo umusumba uwabamo inshinshi sha fikolwe fyandi waba icibolya, ne mpongolo shauko shalyonaika ku mulilo.”

english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
translation: Imfumu yalanda kuli ine aiti, “Nga ico ulefwaya cinshi?”

english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”
translation: kabili nalanda na ku mfumu nati, “Nga cakuti casekesha imfumu kabili nga cakuti umubomfi wenu asanga ukusekelelwa ku cinso cenu, shi lekenifye nje ku Yuda ku musumba wa nshinshi sha fikolwe fyandi, pakuti nkaye kuula cipya cipya.”

english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.
translation: Elyo imfumu yasosa kuli ine, ninshi na namfumu ekele ku lubali lwaiko, aiti, “Bushe ulwendo lobe lukakokola shani? Kabili bushe ukabwela lilali?” Kanshi calisekeshe imfumu ukuntuma. Elyo na ine napekenye inshita iyalinga.

english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;
translation: Elyo na ine natile ku mfumu, “Nga cakuti casekesha imfumu, kuti bampeelako amakalata natwala ku balashi ba citungu ca kwishilya lya mumana , epakuti bansuminisha ukupitamo umutende, mpaka nkafike ku Yuda.

english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.
translation: Isham 25:8-10

english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
translation: Elyo naile ku balashi ba mu citungu ca mwishilya lya mumana, nabapeela amakalata ya mfumu. Pa nshita yakwima imfumu yampeela abakalamba ba bashilika na bashilika ba pali bakabalwe.

english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.
translation: Elyo shimapepo mukalamba Eliashibu na bamunyina abali bashimapepo baima bakuula Impongolo ya Mpaanga, baisangulula no kubika ifiibi mu ncende fyali nokubamo. Bakuulile ilinga ukufikafye na ku Lupungu lwa mwanda umo (100), elyo balisangulula no kulisangulula. Awe bakonkenyepo ukukuula mpaka na ku Lupungu lwa Hananeli.

english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
translation: Kabili uwabakonkelepo ni Yedaya umwana wakwa Harumafu uwawemye ilinga ilyali ku ntanshi ya ŋanda yakwe. Kabili uo bapalamene nankwe kukuwamya ilinga ni Hatushi, umwana mwaume wakwa Hashabiniya.

english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.
translation: Malikiya umwana wakwa Harimu elyo na Hashubu umwana mwaume wakwa Pahati Moabu nao awemye ulubali lunankwe, pamo pene no Lupungu lwa Malungu.

english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.
translation: Elyo kabili uwamukonkelepo ni Shalumu umwana mwaume wakwa Halohesha, intungulushi iya citika wa citungu ca Yerusalemu. Umwine pamo na bana bakwe abanakashi ebamwafwileko ukuwamya ilinga.

english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.
translation: Hanuni pamo na bekashi ba mu Sanoya nabo bayafwilishe ukuwamya Impongolo ya ku mukonko. Baliikuulile elyo baikasha ifiibi mu ncende yafiko elyo babika ne fyakukakilako ne mipilikisho. Elyo bakuula ne cibumba icalepa amakubiti ikana limo (1,000), ukufika na ku Mpongolo ya Fisoso.

english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
translation: Malichiya umwana mwaume wakwa Rekabu, intungulushi ya citungu ca Beti Hakeremu, ewawemye Impongolo ya Fisoso. Aliikuulile bwino elyo aikasha ifiibi mu ncende yafiko abika ne fyakukakilako ne mipilikisho.

english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.
translation: Shalumu umwana mwaume wakwa Koli Oose, intungulushi ya citika wa citungu ca Misipa, ewabombele mukuwamya umwinshi wa pa Mpongolo ya Kamfumfuku ka menshi. Akuula no kufimbapo, elyo aikasha ifiibi mu ncende yafiko, abika ne fyakukakilako ne mipilikisho. Kabili aliwemye no kukuula icibumba ca cishiba ca Shela icali mwibala lya mfumu, ukufikafye na ku matabo ayakutentemukapo ukufuma ku musumba wakwa Davidi.

english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.
translation: Uwamukonkele ni Nehemia umwana mwaume wakwa Asibuku, intungulushi ya citika wa citungu ca Beti Suri. Atampile ukuwamya ififulo ukufikafye na kuntanshi ya nshinshi shakwa Davidi, uko baimbile icishiba, elyo no kufika na ku Ŋanda ya Mpalume.

english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
translation: Elyo abamukonkelepo bena Levi, ebawemye ilinga. Baletungululwa na Rehumu, umwana mwaume wakwa Bani. Elyo uwamukonkelepo ni Hashabiya, intungulushi ya citika wa citungu ca Keila. Nao awemye fyonse ukulingana ne fyaonaike mu citungu cakwe.

english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.
translation: Pali ena pakonkele ababwananyina, abatungulwilwe na Bafayi umwana mwaume wakwa Henadadi, intungulushi ya citika wa citungu ca Keila icasheleko.

english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.
translation: Pakonkele na umbi pali ena, noyu ni Eseri umwana mwaume wakwa Yeshua, intungulushi ya mu Misipa. Uyu nao ewawemye cipya cipya icipande icabela kuntanshi ya lupili lwakuya fika ku ŋanda ya fyanso ulwabela ku cifutu ce linga.

english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
translation: Abapalamene nabo pakukuula bali bena Yeriko, elyo pakonka Sakuri mwana Imuri.

english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
translation: Balaki umwana mwaume wakwa Sabayi mu kucenjela kwakwe nao aliwemye incende imbi iyakufuma pa cifutu ukufika ukwakwingilila mu ŋanda yakwa Eliashibu shimapepo mukalamba.

english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
translation: Kabili uwakonkelepo ni Meremoti umwana mwaume wakwa Uriya uwali umwana mwaume wakwa Hakosi. Uyu nao ewawemye ifyaonaike ku ncende imbi ukufuma ku mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwa Eliashibu ukufikafye na ku mpela ya ŋanda ine iyakwa Eliashibu.

english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.
translation: Abakonkelepo ukuwamya iyi ncende ni bashimapepo, abo abafumine mu ncende iyashingulwike Yerusalemu.

english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.
translation: Elyo kabili abakonkelepo ni Benjamini na Hashubu. Nabo babombele uyu mulimo wakuwamya iyi ncende apalungatene na mayanda yabo. Kabili uwakonkelepo ali Asaria umwana mwaume wakwa Maaseya, umwana mwaume wakwa Ananiya. Nao abombele umulimo wakuwamya mupepi na pa ŋanda yakwe.

english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.
translation: Kabili panuma yakwe, Benuyi umwana mwaume wakwa Henadadi nao awemye incende imbi, ukufuma ku ŋanda yakwa Asaria ukupita ku cifutu ukushinta ku cinshoko.

english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.
translation: Palali umwana mwaume wakwa Usayi, nao awemye incende iyalungatana ku cifutu no lupungu, ukufuma ku ŋanda ya mfumu iya pamulu, iyali ulubansa lwa cifungo. Elyo kabili uwakonkelepo ni Pedaiya umwana mwaume wakwa Paroshi,

english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)
translation: elyo na babomfi be Tempele abaleikala pa mulu wa lupili lwa Ofeli. Aba nabo bonse babombele umulimo wakuwamya ilinga ukufika na ku Mpongolo ya Menshi, ukulungama lwa ku kabanga elyo na lwa ku lupungu lwafuma icofi.

english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.
translation: Kabili abakonkelepo, bena Tekoa. Aba bantu nabo babombele umulimo wakuwamya ulubali lubiye, ulwakufuma ku lupungu lwafuma icofi icikalamba ukuya fikafye na kwilinga lya Ofeli.

english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.
translation: Pa mulu wa Mpongolo ya Bakabalwe, bashimapepo napo pene baliwemyepo. Cila shimapepo alewamya apalungatana ne ŋanda yakwe.

english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.
translation: Elyo panuma yabo, Sadoki umwana mwaume wakwa Imeri, ena nao awemye ilinga ukulungatana ne ŋanda yakwe. Elyo uwakonkelepo ali ni Shemaiya umwana mwaume wakwa Shekaniya kasunga wa ku Mpongolo ya ku Kabanga uko alewamya.

english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
translation: Impongolo Yesabi yakuulilwe na bamwana Hasena. Babikile imyalo pa ncende yaiko, baikasha ifiibi mu ncende yafiko elyo babika ne fyakukakilako ne mipilikisho.

english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.
translation: Panuma yakwe pakonkele Hananiya umwana mwaume wakwa Shelemiya, elyo na Hanuni umwana mwaume uwalenga mutanda mu ŋanda yakwa Salafu, nabo bawemye ku lubali lumbi. Mupepi nabo pakonkele Meshulamu mwana Berekia uwawemye apalungatene ne ŋanda yakwe.

english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.
translation: Elyo no wamukonkelepo ni Malikiya, umo pali bakafula wa golide, ewabombele umulimo wakuwamya ilinga ukuya fikafye na ku ŋanda ukwaleikala ababomfi be Tempele pamo na bashimakwebo, apalungatene ne Mpongolo ya Hamifakadi , ukufika na ku muputule wa pamulu uwabela pa cifutu.

english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.
translation: Elyo kabili, pakati ka muputule wa pamulu uwabela pa cifutu, ukuya fikafye na pa Mwinshi wa Mpaanga, bakafula ba golide elyo na bamakwebo ebawemye mukukuula.

english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
translation: Meremoti mwana Uria nao uwali mwana Hakosi awemye iciputulwa cakonkelepo. Elyo no wamukonkelepo ali ni Meshulamu mwana Berekia, nao uwali umwana mwaume wakwa Meshasabeli, nao akonkelemofye alewamya. Elyo na umbi uwamukonkelepo ali ni Sadoki mwana Baana, nao wine alewamyafye ilinga umushaweme.

english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
translation: Iciputulwa cakonkelepo cabombelwe na baume abafumine ku Tekoa. Nomba abakalamba babo bena bakaana ukubomba no kubeela umulimo wa ntungulushi shabo.

english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
translation: Yehoada umwana mwaume wakwa Paseya elyo na Meshulamu umwana mwaume wakwa Besodeya, ebabombele umulimo wakuwamya Impongolo ya Yeshana . Babikile imyalo pa ncende yaiko, baikasha ifiibi mu ncende yafiko elyo babika ne fyakukakilako ne mipilikisho.

english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.
translation: Elyo ababakonkelepo kukuwamya ilinga bali ni Melatiya umwina Gibeoni, Yadoni umwina Meronoti, abaume ba ku Gibeoni na ku Misipa, abantu abateekelwe no mulashi wa citungu ca mwishilya lya mumana .

english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.
translation: Elyo uwabakonkelepo ukuwamya ilinga ni Usieli umwana mwaume wakwa Harhaya umo uwa pa balefula golide, ewakuulileko nao ilinga. Uwamukonkelepo ni Hananiya uwalepanga amafuta ayanunka ubusaka. Ebakuulile Yerusalemu ukufika na pa ncende apakulishe umutika wa cibumba.

english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
translation: Elyo nakabili uwakonkelepo kukuwamya ilinga ni Refaiya umwana mwaume wakwa Huri, uwali intungulushi ya citika wa citungu ca Yerusalemu.

english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
translation: Ilyo Sanibalati aumfwile ukuti tulekuula ilinga, akalipa no kufulwa icine cine. Kabili alatumfya na Bayuda.

english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”
translation: Elyo abena Yuda batile, “Amaka ya basenda ifintu nayapwa, elyo ifibungulubwe nafyo fyalifulisha. Nga kuti twakuula shani ili linga?”

english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”
translation: Kabili abalwani besu batile, “Intanshi ilyo tabalati beshibe nangu ukutumona, ifwe tuli nokuba kulya kwine pamo pene nabo. Elyo tuli nokubepaya, no mulimo uli nokufubalila.”

english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo cali ilyo Abayuda bamo abaleikala mupepi nabo baishile no kutweba ukulingana ne miku ikumi limo pali ici nokutila, “Ala konsefye uko mukapilibukila, bali nokutusansa.”

english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
translation: Elyo na ine nalashike abantu bamo umo ilinga talilapwa, umushali nangu cimo. Kabili nababikile mu ndupwa mu ndupwa ninshi bali ne fyanso fya mafumo, impanga na mata.

english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”
translation: Elyo naloleshe no kumona ifintu ifi, elyo naima no kweba abalashi, intungulushi elyo na kuli bambi abantu abaliko no kutila, “Mwikwata umwenso kuli bena. Ibukishenifye Yawe uuli impalume, elyo ewabafye uwakutiinya. Kabili mube abakulwishishako na bamunonko, abana abaume na bana abanakashi, abakashi benu elyo na mayanda yenu yene.”

english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.
translation: Ilyo abalwani besu baumfwile ukuti natwishiba amapange yabo, nokuti Lesa nafulunganya amapange yabo, lyena na ifwe bonse twalibwelele mukukuula ilinga, cila umo ku mulimo wakwe.

english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
translation: Ifi efyo cali ukufumafye ilya ine nshita, abantu bandi abali citika babombele kukukuula ilinga, elyo bambi nabo abali citika babuulile amafumo, inkwela, amata elyo ne fyakucinga umubili. Kabili ne ntungulushi nasho shaiminine kunuma ya Bayuda bonse,

english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.
translation: abo abalekuula ilinga. Elyo na bonse abalepalamika ifibombelo fyakukulila, balebomfya ukuboko kumo elyo ukuboko kumbi nako baikatilako ifyanso.

english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”
translation: Elyo asosa pa cinso ca banankwe na ku bashilika ba bena Samaria ati, “Cinshi aba Bayuda ababula amaka balecita? Bushe bakakuula cipya cipya ilinga? Bushe bakalatuula amalambo? Bushe bakacipwisha mu bushiku bumo? Bushe balesubila ukubwesesha amaka mu mabwe ayaocewa mu mulilo ayo bashula mu mina ya fitantala?”

english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
translation: Elyo Tobia umwina Amoni, uwali nankwe, atile, “Ala ici balekuula, nangufye ni mumbwe aninapo, awe mukwai kuti cabongoloka, nangufye bakuulile na mabwe cafyefye!”

english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.
translation: Umfwa we Lesa wesu ifyo batusuula. Ubabweseshe insele shabo pa mitwe yabo abene. Kabili bapeeleni ukuba icitapwa ku calo ca bunkole!

english: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
translation: Tecakwesha ukufimba pa mampulu yabo. Kabili tecakwesha ukufuuta ifyabubifi fyabo ifyo bacita, pantu nabatuka abalebomba imilimo yakukuula.

english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
translation: Kanshi twakuula ilinga mpaka twalifishafye na pakati ka butali bwaliko, pantu abantu abalebomba mukukuula bali abaikatana imitima mu mulimo wakukuula.

english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;
translation: Lelo Sanibalati, Tobia, Abaarabu, abena Amoni, elyo na bena Ashidodi ilyo baumfwile ukuti amalinga ya Yerusalemu yele yalecilikwa kabili ne fipata nafyo file filecilikwa, neci cabalengele ukufulwa nganshi.

english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.
translation: Elyo bonse baikatene pamo ukuti bese mukulwisha abena Yerusalemu no kulenga kube ifimfulunganya.

english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.
translation: Eico ifwe twapepele kuli Lesa wesu, no kubika bamalonda ba kasuba no bushiku abakubacinsha.

english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
translation: Nomba abaume na bakashi babo batampile ukuilishanya apakalamba, pa mulandu wa bamunyinabo Abayuda.

english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.
translation: Ala na ine wine pamo na babwananyina banandi pamo na babomfi bandi bene, tulabakongweshako ulupiya pamo ne ŋanu. Nomba lekeni ukulundapo kansosela.

english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”
translation: Mubabweseshe bwangu incende shabo umo balimina, amabala ya myangashi, amabala ya miolifa no mwaba amayanda yabo. Mubabweseshe na filya mwabapingwile ukulundapo pa misha yonse iya pa ndalama, iya pa ŋanu, iya pa mwangashi elyo na pa mafuta.”

english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.
translation: Intungulushi nasho epakulanda ashiti, “Tuli nokubwesha, kabili ifwe tatwakafwayeko akantu nelyo kamo akakulundapo kuli bena. Ifwe tuli nokubombafye ifyo mwasosa.”

english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. The people did according to this promise.
translation: Elyo nakunta ne cisempe ca mwingila wandi no kutila, “Ifi efyo Lesa akunte umuntu onse uushabake ishiwi ili. Shi Lesa namutamfye mu ŋanda yakwe na mu fyuma fyakwe fyonse! Ifi efyo akuntwe kabili eshala na kantu!” Elyo ibumba lyonse lyayasuka aliti, “Ameni! ” Elyo balumbanya na Yawe. Abantu nabo epakucita ukulingana ne cilayo ici.

english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.
translation: Ine nali umulashi wabo mu calo ca Yuda ukutampafye mu mwaka uwakulenga amakumi yabili (20) iya bufumu bwakwa Atakisesi, ukufika na mu mwaka uwalenga amakumi yatatu na ibili (32). Pa myaka yonse iyi, imyaka ikumi limo na ibili (12), ine nangufye ni bamunyinane bonse tatwatala atulyapo ifilyo fya bulashi.

english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.
translation: Lelo ku balashi babalilepo, abantangilile, bena balecusha abantu. Balepoka ku bantu umukate no mwangashi, mukulundapo ku ndalama amashekeli amakumi yane (40) aya silifa ayo balebasonkesha. Kabili na babomfi ba balashi nabo balecusha abantu. Nomba ine nshalecitako ifi, pantu naletiina Lesa.

english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.
translation: Ine mu nshita yakukonkelela ukubomba ifyo nshifwile kubomba, naiposele ne mwine kukuwamya ilinga ili. Bonse abantu bandi balelonganafye palya pene mukubomba umulimo. Eico kanshi, bonsefye ababomfi bandi tabashitilepo impanga nangu imo iyoo.

english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.
translation: Kabili abantu ukulingana no mwanda umo na makumi yasano (150), Abayuda elyo na bacilolo, twalelya pamo nabo petebulo lyandi, kabili efyo cali na kuli bonse abaleisa kuli ifwe ukufuma ku mishobo iyatushingulwike.

english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.
translation: Kanshi cila bushiku balempekanishisha cilume wa ŋombe umo elyo ne mpaanga mutanda ishalondoloka bwino. Kabili inkoko nasho ishisuma shalepekanishiwa cila bushiku. Elyo ukulingana ne nshiku ikumi limo, nalyo line kwaleba ukupekanya kwa myangashi iyalekana lekana. Nelyo cali ifi, ine nshatalile mfwaya ifilyo fya bulashi pantu aba bantu balecula ku mulimo uwakosa.

english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.
For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”
translation: Bamo pebumba nabo basosa abati, “Ifwe, abana besu abaume na bana besu abanakashi tuli bengi nganshi. Kanshi lekenifye tusendepo ifyakulya, epakuti tube abomi nga twalalya.”

english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”
translation: Kabili na bambi eko bali abatile, “Ifwe tuli na mabala yesu, amabala ya myangashi pamo na mayanda yesu ifyo tulepeela nge cikatilo pakukabulamo ifyakulya ifyakutupususha ku cipowe nga caisa.”

english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.
translation: Elyo kabili kwali abantu bamo abatile, “Ifwe pakulipila umusonko ku mfumu, uwa pa filime fyesu na pa mabala yesu aya myangashi twashimafye indalama.

english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”
translation: Lelo nangula twabafye cimo cine na bamunyinefwe, elyo umulopa nao umo wine no wa bamunyinefwe, elyo abana besu nabo bawama kwatifye bana babo, mu cine cine ifwe tulepatikisha abana besu abaume na banakashi kukuba abasha. Kabili bamo abana besu abanakashi nabasendwa na mu busha. Ala tatukwetepo na maka ayakuti twingabapususha nakalya. Pantu abantu bambi ebaba na mabala yesu aya myangashi pamo ne mpanga shesu.”

english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
translation: Ilyo ine naumfwile ukulilishika kwabo, elyo na mashiwi yonse, nalifulilwe icibi.

english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.
translation: Panuma yakutontonkanyapo nganshi mu mutima, awe nakalipila abasambashi elyo na bakateeka. Nabeba nati, “Onse uwa muli imwe alalundapo kansosela pakupoka ifyo mupeela bamunyinenwe.” Kanshi elyo naitile icilye ca bantu icikalamba icakubalubulwisha.

english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.
translation: Elyo natile kuli bena, “Bamunyinefwe Abayuda abashitishiwe ku mitundu ya bantu Abenafyalo, twalibalubula ukulingana na maka yesu. Nomba bushe nimwe mwalashitisha bamunyinenwe pakuti tukese balubula nakabili?” Elyo nabo balifye tondolo, tabamwene na cakusosapo.

english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
translation: Kabili natile, “Ico mulecita te cintu icisuma iyoo. Bushe tamulefwaya ukwenda mu katiina kakwa Lesa, pakuti Abenafyalo, abalwani besu, betuseka?

english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
translation: Nomba cali ukuti ilyo Sanibalati, Tobia, Geshomu Umuarabu, elyo na balwani besu bambi, baumfwile ukuti ninkuulako ilinga, elyo tapali napashele akapunda, nelyo nali nshilabika ifiibi mu minshi yakwingilila nangu ukufuminapo,

english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”
translation: Ubushiku bumo naile ku ŋanda yakwa Shemaiya umwana mwaume wakwa Delaya, umwana mwaume wakwa Mehetabelo, uwaisalilwe mu ŋanda. Anjeba nokutila, “Shi natuleya tukumane pamo mu ŋanda yakwa Lesa, iyili mwi Tempele, elyo twisaleko ne fiibi fya mwi Tempele mwine, pantu baleisa kwipaya. Icine cine ubushiku baleisa mukukwipaya.”

english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”
translation: Lelo na ine natile, “Bushe umuntu uwaba nga ine kuti abutuka? Nangu bushe umo uuli nga ine kuti aya mwi Tempele pakuti apusushe ubumi bwakwe? Awe tekuti njemo iyoo!”

english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
translation: Kwena nalishiba ukuti te Lesa amutumine ukulanda ifi, lelo ukuti ni Tobia pamo na Sanibalati ebamupeele amafisakanwa no kumutuma ukwisa nsembeleka.

english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
translation: Ico bamutumine ni pakuti ese antiinye mbe no mwenso, elyo mbifye pakucita ici, elyo panuma bakese mpeela ishina ilibi no kunsebanya.

english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”
translation: “We Lesa wandi ibukisha Tobia pamo na Sanibalati, ukulingana neyi imilimo yabo. Ibukisha na ulya kasesema mwanakashi Noadia elyo na bakasesema bambi abalefwaya ukulantiinya.”

english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.
translation: Kanshi ilinga lyapwile ukulikuula mu nshiku amakumi yasano na shibili (52), pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na shisano (25) ubwa mweshi wa Eluli .

english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
translation: Ilyo abalwani besu bonse baumfwile ifi, imishobo yonse iyashingulwike yali no mwenso. Kabili baisuulile nganshi abene, ico balishibe ukuti umulimo onse uwabombelwe wacitike ku maka yakwa Lesa epela.

english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
translation: Kabili mu nshiku shilya abasambashi ba bena Yuda batumine amakalata ayengi kuli Tobia. Elyo amakalata yambi nayo yalefuma kuli Tobia no kuya kuli bena.

english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.
translation: Pantu abengi mu calo ca Yuda balilayene nankwe, pantu ali ni shifyala wakwa Shekaniya umwana mwaume wakwa Ara. Kabili umwana wakwe umwaume Yehohanani aupile umwana mwanakashi wakwa Meshulamu umwana mwaume wakwa Berekiya.

english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
translation: Kabili baleta utusebo twakwe utusuma kuli ine, elyo no kumweba amashiwi nalelanda. Elyo Tobia nao aletuma no tusebo twacintiinya kuli ine.

english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.
translation: elyo Sanibalati na Geshomu nabo bantumina na mashiwi abati, “Isa bwangu tukumane bonse mu mushi umo uwabela mu nika ya Ono.” Lelo bena, baletontonkanya ukuncita ububi.

english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”
translation: Kanshi na ine epakubatumina inkombe nokutila, “Ine kuno ndi pa mulimo uukalamba nganshi, kanshi ine tekuti njise uko, iyoo. Cinshi ico umulimo wingafubalishiwa ilyo ine nafumako nokwisa uko muli?”

english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
translation: Lelo bena bakonkanyapo ukuntumina aya mashiwi pa miku ine, elyo na ine nalebasukafye mu musango umo wine.

english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,
translation: Elyo Sanibalati atumine umubomfi wakwe kuli ine kwati fintu acitile pakutampa. Amutumine pa muku uwalenga isano ne nkalata iyabula ukwisalwa mu maboko yakwe.

english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.
translation: Elyo mu nkalata mwalembelwe ifyakuti,

english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”
translation: Elyo kabili wasonta na bakasesema abakubila pali iwe mu Yerusalemu abati, ‘Abayuda baba ne mfumu.’ Nomba aya mashiwi yali nokubwelela ku mfumu. Eico kanshi isafye, tumfwane bonse.”

english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”
translation: Kanshi ine nalimutumine amashiwi ukutila, “Takuli ifintu ifili ngefi ulesosa ifilecitika. Ifi fyonse ulefyelenganyafye mu mutima obe.”

english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.
translation: Pantu bonse balefwaya ukuti tube no mwenso uwakutila, “Amaboko yabo yakanakuka kukubomba imilimo, tabakatale abaipwisha.” Na ine epakupepa nati, “Nomba mwe Lesa kosheni amaboko yandi.”

english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
translation: Nomba ilyo ilinga lyapwile ukukuulwa, elyo nabikamo ne fiibi bwino bwino mu ncende shafiko, nasonta na bakalinda wa mpongolo, bakemba, elyo abena Levi nabo basontwa ku mulimo wabo.

english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
translation: Ulupwa lwakwa Ara nabo bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yasano na babili (652).

english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
translation: Abana bakwa Pahati Moabu, abali abana bakwa Yeshua na Yoabu, bali amakana yabili ne myanda cine konse konse, ne kumi limo na cine konse konse (2,818).

english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
translation: Abana bakwa Elamu bali ikana limo ne myanda ibili na makumi yasano na bane (1,254).

english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
translation: Abana bakwa Satu bali imyanda cine konse konse na makumi yane na basano (845).

english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.
translation: Abana bakwa Sakayi bali imyanda cine lubali na makumi mutanda (760).

english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.
translation: Abana bakwa Binuyi bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yane na cine konse konse (648)

english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.
translation: Abana bakwa Bebai bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (628).

english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
translation: Abana bakwa Asigadi bali amakana yabili ne myanda itatu na makumi yabili na babili (2,322).

english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.
translation: Abana bakwa Adonikamu bali imyanda mutanda na makumi mutanda na cine lubali (667).

english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.
translation: Abana bakwa Bigifai bali amakana yabili na makumi mutanda na cine lubali (2,067).

english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.
translation: Elyo ine nasontele munyinane Hanani ukuba kangalila wa Yerusalemu, pamo na Hananiya uwali kangalila wa bashilika ba kwisano, pantu ali uwacishinka no kuba uwakutiina Lesa ukucila abantu bambi.

english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.
translation: Abana bakwa Adini bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yasano na basano (655).

english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
translation: Abana bakwa Ateri, muli Hesekia, bali amakumi pabula na cine konse konse (98).

english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.
translation: Abana bakwa Hashumu bali imyanda itatu na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (328).

english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.
translation: Abana bakwa Besai bali imyanda itatu na makumi yabili na bane (324).

english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.
translation: Abana bakwa Harifu bali umwanda umo ne kumi limo na babili (112).

english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.
translation: Abana bakwa Gibeoni bali amakumi pabula na basano (95).

english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.
translation: Abaume abaleikala mu Betelemu elyo na Netofa bali umwanda umo na makumi cine konse konse na cine konse konse (188).

english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.
translation: Abaume abaleikala mu Anatoti bali umwanda umo na makumi yabili na cine konse konse (128).

english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.
translation: Elyo nabo abena Beti Asimafeti nabo bali amakumi yane na babili (42).

english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.
translation: Abaume aba ku Kiriati Yarimu, Kefira na Beroti bali imyanda cine lubali na makumi yane na batatu (743).

english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
translation: Elyo nalandile kuli bena nati, “Mwilaisula impongolo sha mu Yerusalemu, kano ilyo akasuba katampa ukukaba. Kabili pa nshita bakalinda wa mpongolo bacili nabeminina pakulonda, bafwile ukulaisalako ifiibi no kupilikishako. Elyo musontemo na bekashi bamo aba mu Yerusalemu ukuba bakalinda, bamo pa ncende ishasontwa elyo bambi nabo pa ntanshi ya mayanda yabo.”

english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.
translation: Abaume ba ku Rama na bena Geba nabo bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yabili na umo (621).

english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.
translation: Elyo abaume ba ku Mikimasi nabo bali umwanda umo na makumi yabili na babili (122).

english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.
translation: Abaume abali ku Betele na bali ku Ai bali umwanda umo na makumi yabili na batatu (123).

english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.
translation: Abaume aba ku Nebo kumbi nabo abaume bali amakumi yasano na babili (52).

english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
translation: Elyo abaume ba ku Elamu kumbi nabo bali ikana limo ne myanda ibili na makumi yasano na bane (1,254).

english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.
translation: Abana abaume ba ku Harimu bali imyanda itatu na makumi yabili (320).

english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.
translation: Abana abaume ba ku Yeriko bali amakumi yatatu na makumi yane na basano (345).

english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.
translation: Abena Lodi, Hadidi na Ono bali nabo imyanda cine lubali na makumi yabili na umo (721).

english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.
translation: Elyo abena Sena nabo bali amakana yatatu ne myanda pabula na makumi yatatu (3,930).

english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.
translation: Bashimapepo bali ni aba:

english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.
translation: Nomba umusumba wali uwapabuka kabili uukalamba nganshi. Lelo abantu balimo abanono, kabili na mayanda yene yali tayalakuulwa.

english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Imeri bali ikana limo na makumi yasano na babili (1,052).

english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
translation: Bamwana Pashuri nabo bali ikana limo ne myanda ibili na makumi yane na cine lubali (1,247).

english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.
translation: Bamwana Harimu nabo bali ikana limo ne kumi limo na cine lubali (1,017).

english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.
translation: Abena Levi nabo abali abana baume bakwa Yeshua, abali mu lupwa lwakwa Kadimieli abafyelwe ukupitila mu bana baume bakwa Hodafiya, bonse bali amakumi cine lubali na bane (74).

english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.
translation: Bakemba nabo abali abana baume bakwa Asafu bali umwanda umo na makumi yane na cine konse konse (148).

english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.
translation: Bakalinda wa mpongolo abali abana bakwa Shalumu, bamwana Ateri, bamwana Talimoni, bamwana Akubu, bamwana Hatita, bamwana Shobai, bonse bali umwanda umo na makumi yatatu na cine konse konse (138).

english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
translation: Indupwa sha babomfi be Tempele shali ni aba:

english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
translation: abana baume bakwa Kerosi, abana baume bakwa Siya elyo na bana baume bakwa Padoni,

english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
translation: abana baume bakwa Lebana, abana baume bakwa Hagaba elyo na bana baume bakwa Salimayi,

english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
translation: abana baume bakwa Hanani, abana baume bakwa Gideli, elyo na bana baume bakwa Gahari,

english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:
translation: Kanshi Lesa wandi acibika mu mutima wandi ukuti nonganye abasambashi, bacilolo elyo na bekalacalo mukubalembesha ukulingana ne ndupwa shabo. Awe nasanga ne citabo ico balembelemo ababalilepo ukubwela ukulingana ne ndupwa shabo. Ifi efyo nasangile ifyalembelwemo.

english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
translation: abana baume bakwa Reayia, abana baume bakwa Resini, elyo na bana baume bakwa Nekoda,

english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,
translation: abana baume bakwa Gasamu, abana baume bakwa Usa, elyo na bana baume bakwa Pasea,

english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
translation: abana baume bakwa Besayi, abana baume bakwa Meunimu, elyo na bana baume bakwa Nefishusimu,

english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
translation: abana baume bakwa Bakibuku, abana baume bakwa Hakufa elyo na bana baume bakwa Hahuri,

english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
translation: abana baume bakwa Basiluti, abana baume bakwa Meida elyo na bana baume bakwa Hasha,

english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
translation: abana baume bakwa Bakosi, abana baume bakwa Sisera, elyo na bana baume bakwa Temaya,

english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.
translation: abana baume bakwa Nesiya, elyo na bana abaume bakwa Hatifa.

english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
translation: Abana baume ba babomfi bakwa Solomoni bali ni aba:

english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
translation: abana baume bakwa Yala, abana baume bakwa Dakoni elyo na bana baume bakwa Gideli,

english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.
translation: abana baume bakwa Shefatiya, abana baume bakwa Hatili, abana baume bakwa Pokereti Hasebaimu elyo na bana baume bakwa Amoni.

english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,
translation: Aba, e bantu abaikele mu citungu ca calo abaishile ukufuma muli bunkole, abantu abo imfumu Nebukadinesa iya mu Babiloni asendele. Babwelele ku Yerusalemu pamo pene na ku Yuda, cila muntu abwelele ku mushi kumwakwe.

english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.
translation: Elyo bonse ababomfi be Tempele pamo na bana baume ba babomfi bakwa Solomoni, bonse pamo bali imyanda itatu na makumi pabula na babili (392).

english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
translation: Kabili aba, ebaninine ukufuma ku Tele Mela elyo na ku Tele Hasha, Kerubi, Adoni na ku Imeri, lelo calibanshishe ukulumbula uko amayanda ya bashibo yali, nangufye uko yatantikwe, nangu ukutilafye bena bali abena Israeli.

english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.
translation: Abana baume bakwa Delaiya, abana baume bakwa Tobia, abana baume bakwa Nekoda bali imyanda mutanda na makumi yane na babili (642).

english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
translation: Nomba kuli bashimapepo ni aba: Abana baume bakwa Hobaya, abana baume bakwa Hakosi elyo na bana baume bakwa Basilai uwabuulile umukashi wakwe ukufuma ku lupwa lwakwa Basilai umwina Gileadi no kwinikwako ishina limo line.

english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
translation: Aba ebo bafwailishe amashina ya fikolwe fyabo mu fitabo lelo tabafimwene, kanshi epakubafumya pa mulongo wa bashimapepo no kubapendela pa bashasangululwa.

english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.
translation: Elyo umulashi wa ici calo nao apeele icebo icakuti takuli kulya icakulya camushilo mpakafye bakakwate shimapepo uukapendula ukubomfya Urimu na Tumimu.

english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
translation: Kanshi ulukuta lonse ulwabwelele ukufuma kuli bunkole lwali pamo amakana amakumi yane na yabili ne myanda itatu na makumi mutanda (42,360).

english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.
translation: Kabili ababomfi babo abaume na banakashi bambi bali amakana cine lubali ne myanda itatu na makumi yatatu na cine lubali (7,337). Balikwete na bakwimba inyimbo, abaume elyo na banakashi, abali imyanda ibili na makumi yane na yasano (245).

english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
translation: Imfalashi shabo shali imyanda cine lubali na makumi yatatu na mutanda (736). Elyo bakabalwe babo bali imyanda ibili na makumi yane na basano (245).

english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
translation: Ingamila nasho shali imyanda ine na makumi yatatu na shisano (435). Bapunda nabo amakana mutanda ne myanda cine lubali na makumi yabili (6,720).

english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
translation: Bonse baishile pamo na Serubabeli na Yeshua, Nehemia, Asariya, Ramiya, Nahamani, Modekai, Bilishani, Misipereti, Bigifai, Nehumu elyo na Baanaya.

english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.
translation: Elyo abakalamba bamo aba ndupwa batuulile ne fyabupe ifyakwafwilisha muli uyu mulimo. Umulashi wa calo ici, apeele ku mulimo wa cipao, indalama drakimasi ikana limo (1,000) isha golide , inweno nasho amakumi yasano (50) ne fyakufwala bashimapepo nafyo imyanda isano na makumi yatatu (530).

english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
translation: Bamo abakalamba ba mu ndupwa balepeela indalama drakimasi amakana amakumi yabili (20,000) isha golide , kabili indalama minasi amakana yabili ne myanda ibili (2,200) isha silifa .

english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.
translation: Elyo bambi abantu abashala baletele indalama drakimasi amakana amakumi yabili (20,000) isha golide pamo ne ndalama minasi amakana yabili (2,000) isha silifa . Kabili pali ne fyakufwala ifya bashimapepo nafyo amakumi mutanda na cine lubali (67).

english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
translation: Abana ba lupwa lwakwa Paroshi bali amakana yabili no mwanda umo na makumi cine lubali na babili (2,172).

english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.
translation: Abana bakwa Shefatiya nabo bali imyanda itatu na makumi cine lubali na babili (372).

english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
translation: abantu epakulongana pamo kwatifye muntu umo pa lwalala ku ntanshi ya Mpongolo ya Menshi. Elyo baeba Esra uwali ni kalemba ukuleta Icitabo ca mafunde yakwa Mose ico Lesa akonkomeshe ku bena Israeli.

english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
translation: Elyo Nehemia abeba nokuti, “Kabiyeni uko mulefwaya muye mulye ifisuma no kunwa ifyalowa elyo muye mupeko na bonse abo abashikwete ifyapekanishiwa libela. Pantu ubu bushiku buntu bwapaalwa ku mfumu. Tecakwesha ukuilishanya, pantu insansa shakwa Yawe e maka yenu.”

english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”
translation: Elyo abena Levi pakutalalika abantu bonse batile, “Talaleni imwe bonse pantu ubushiku buno bwamushilo, mwilalangulukamo.”

english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.
translation: Elyo nomba abantu bonse baya mukulya no kunwa, batuminako na banabo fimo fimo no kusansamuka apakalamba, pantu balyumfwile umwalolele imilandu babashimikileko.

english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.
translation: Nomba mu bushiku bwalenga shibili ubwa mweshi, abakalamba ba ndupwa shonse, pamo pene na bashimapepo elyo na bena Levi, bonse balongana kuli kalemba Esra. Ico balonganine pamo, ni mukumfwikisha bwino amashiwi ya mafunde.

english: They found written in the law how the LORD had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;
translation: Awe basanga mu mafunde ayapeelwe kuli Mose, mwalilembwa ukuti, “Abena Israeli bali nokulaikala mu nsakwe pa nshikunkulu ya mu mweshi walenga cine lubali.”

english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”
translation: Elyo bali nokuma imbila mu misumba yabo yonse elyo na mu Yerusalemu iyakuti, “Kabiyeni ku mpili elyo muye letako imisambo ya fimuti fya miolifa, imisambo ya miolifa ya mpanga, imiti ya muetulo, imisambo ya tuncindu elyo ne misambo ya fimuti ifya mabula yambi. Ifi fimuti fyakusakilamo insakwe pamo ngefyo calembwa.”

english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.
translation: Kanshi abantu epakuyako, bayasenda ifya mabula no kusakila insakwe cila umo pa mulu wa mutenge wa ŋanda yakwe, mu mansa sha mayanda yabo, na mu mansa sha ŋanda yakwa Lesa, na mu lubansa lwa ku Mpongolo ya Menshi, elyo na mu lubansa lwa ku Mpongolo yakwa Efulemu.

english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.
translation: Kanshi emukutila bonse abantu ababwelele ukufuma muli bunkole basakile insakwe no kwikalamo. Kabili bali abasansamuka pantu tacabalile acicitikapo ukufuma ku nshiku shakwa Yoshua mwana Nuni. Awe umuntu onsefye ali ne nsansa ishikalamba nganshi.

english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.
translation: Kabili cila bushiku, ukufuma pa bushiku bwantanshi ukufikafye na pa bushiku bwakulekelesha, Esra alebelenga icitabo ca mafunde yakwa Lesa. Elyo balesefya uyu mutebeto wa nsakwe pa nshiku cine lubali, elyo no bwalenga cine konse konse bacitile icilye camushilo, ukulingana nefyo calembwa.

english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
translation: Eico kanshi pa bushikufye ubwantanshi mu mweshi wakulenga cine lubali, shimapepo Esra aletele Icitabo ca mafunde uko abantu balongene abaume na banakashi elyo na onsefye uwingomfwa no kwiluka.

english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.
translation: Awe atampa no kubabelengela icitabo ca mafunde palya pene pa lwalala ku ntanshi ya Mpongolo ya Menshi, ninshi atampile ulucelo ukufikafye na kasuba pakati ka mutwe. Elyo abantu nabo abaume na banakashi, na bonse abengomfwa no kwiluka, bekelefye balekutika ku citabo ca mafunde.

english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
translation: Kanshi Esra kalemba uyu, ninshi eminine pa cintamba ca fimuti icakuulilwe umulimo wine uyu. Elyo abaiminine lwa ku kuboko kwakwe ukwa kulyo ni Matitiya, Shema, Anaiya, Uria, Hilikiya elyo na Maaseya. Elyo kabili na bambi abaiminine ku kuboko kwakwe ukwa ku kuso bali ni Pedaiya, Mishaeli, Malikiya, Hashumu, Hashibadana, Sakaria elyo na Meshulamu.

english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
translation: Elyo Esra aisula icitabo pa menso ya cintubwingi conse, pantu apo aiminine pali apasansuka ukucila umuntu onse. Cilya aisula icitabo, bonse abantu baiminina.

english: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
translation: Elyo Esra atotele Yawe, Lesa Mukulu, na bantu bonse baimisha amaboko yabo mu mulu, bayasuka abati, “Ameni! Ameni!” Kabili bainama no kupepa kuli Yawe, ninshi ifinso fyabo fikontamine panshi.

english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.
translation: Kanshi abena Levi, ekutila Yeshua, Bani, Sherebiya, Yamini, Akubu, Shabetayi, Hodiya, Maseiya, Kelita, Asariya, Yosabadi, Hanani na Pelaiya, baleafwailisha ukulondolwela abantu amafunde, ninshi abantu nabo bemininefye mu ncende shabo.

english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
translation: Kanshi ilyo balebelenga ukufuma mu citabo ca mafunde yakwa Lesa no kucilondolola bwino bwino, elyo bacipilibwile bwino bwino mukwafwa abantu ukuti bomfwe bwino umo cilolele mukucibelenga.

english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to the LORD your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.
translation: Kabili Nehemia, uwali mulashi, Esra shimapepo kabili kalemba, elyo na bena Levi abafundile abantu, batile ku bantu bonse, “Buno bushiku bwamushilo kuli Yawe, Lesa wenu. Tecakwesha ukulalooshamo nangufye ukulilishikamo.” Pantu abantu bonse balelila ilyo bakutika ku mashiwi ya mafunde.

english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.
translation: Nomba pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na shine (24), ubwa uyu wine umweshi, abena Israeli bakumene pamo no kufunga ukulya, bafwele ne nsalu shabulanda, elyo kabili bali no lukungu pa mitwe yabo

english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.
You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.
translation: Kabili iwe we mwine, wayakenye bemba pantanshi yabo. Baenda apaumine ndi, elyo na babakonkele bonse abalwani babo wabaposele petenga lya menshi, nge libwe mu menshi ayamaka.

english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.
translation: Walebatungulula mu ntumba ye kumbi mu kasuba, na mu nshita ya bushiku walebatungulula mu lubingu lwa mulilo pakubasanikila pakuti baleenda bwino mu nshila umo bali nokupita.

english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,
translation: “Waikile kabili pa lupili lwa Sinai no kulanda pamo nabo, ilyo wafumine ku mulu wabapeele ifyakubatungulula ifyacishinka nganshi pamo na mafunde yacine cine. Wabapeele kabili ifipope pamo na malango yasuma.

english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,
translation: Wabalengele ukwishiba Isabata lyobe ilyamushilo. Kabili wabakonkomeshe no kulabaka amalango pamo pene na mafunde ne fipope, ukupitila mu minwe ya mubomfi obe Mose.

english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.
translation: Pakutuusha insala yabo, walebapeela umukate uwafuma ku mulu. Kabili wabapeele na menshi ayafumine mu cilibwe pakuti banwe ilyo bali ne cilaka. Wabebele no kuya mukati ka calo no kucipoka, pantu walilapile ukucipeela kuli bena.

english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,
translation: “Nomba bena pamo na bashifwe ifikolwe fyesu bacita icilumba, baumalala, bakaana no kubeela amafunde yobe.

english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.
translation: Bakeene ukumfwa, balaba na ku fisungusho ifyo wacitile pakubapokolola. Lelo bena bakosha imitima yabo, mu busangu bwabo basala ne ntungulushi lintu bapangile ukubwelelamo ku Egupto ku busha bwabo. Nomba iwe waliba Lesa uubelela uluse icine cine, uwacikuuku kabili uwamutembo, uushifulwa bwangu lelo uwacitemwiko icingi. Eico tawabaposele,

english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.
translation: Mulya mu matololo tawabalekeleshe nakalya, pantu uluse lobe we Lesa lukalamba. Mu kasuba intumba ye kumbi tayafililwe ukubatungulula mu lwendo lwabo, elyo na mu bushiku intumba ya mulilo tayafililwe ukubalika mu nshila bali nokupitamo.

english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
translation: Elyo bonse abena Israeli baipatwile ku benafyalo bonse. Elyo baiminine no kuyebelela ku fyabubifi fyabo fyonse, nefyo bashibo babifishe.

english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
