translation: Kabili wabapeele Umupashi obe uusuma nganshi, uwakubasambilisha ifyo bafwile ukuba. Elyo kabili, tawakeenye ifyo wali nokubapeela pamo nga maana ukuti balelya, elyo na menshi yene ayakunwa, walibapeele ayakupwisha icilaka.

english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
translation: “Wabapeele ishamfumu elyo ne mishobo. Kabili wabapatulwile ukuti bekale mu fitungu mu fitungu. Bapoka ne calo cakwa Sihoni imfumu ya ku Heshiboni elyo ne calo ca mfumu Ogi uwa ku Bashani.

english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.
translation: Kabili wafushishe abana babo abaume kwati ni ntanda sha mu mulu. Kabili wabatwele na mu calo walaile kuli bashibo, ukwingilamo no kucipoka.

english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.
translation: Kanshi nabo abana babo baliingile no kupoka icalo. Kabili walengele na bekashi ba mu calo abena Kenani ukuba ne cumfwila. Wabapeele mu maboko yabo, abantu bonse pamo penefye ne shamfumu shabo shonse, pakuti bacite conse pamo icali mu mano yabo kuli bena.

english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
translation: Bapokele imisumba ya malinga pamo pene ne mpanga iyafunda nganshi. Kabili bapokele na mayanda ayaisulamo ifyuma fyonse. Bapoka ne fishima ifyaimbwa kabela, amabala ya myangashi, aya miolifa elyo ne miti ya fyakulya iyingi nganshi. Awe balelya no kwikuta, no kwina baina pakuipakisha ku fisuma fyobe ifyo wapeele.

english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.
translation: Ici calengele ubapose mu maboko ya balwani babo, nabo babacusha nganshi. Kabili pa mulandu wa bucushi ubu, bakuuta no musowa uukalamba kuli iwe. Ilyo wabomfwile kulya ku mulu, ku luse lobe ulushaikulila wabapeele abakubafwako, abakubapusushako ku minwe ya balwani babo.

english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,
translation: Cilyafye balaikala umutelelwe, babwekeshapo ukulabifya. Awe na iwe wabalekela na mu maboko ya balwani babo pakuti bacushiwe. Elyo kabili nabo bakuuta. Ilyo bakuutile, walyumfwile ukufuma ku mulu. Elyo kabili pa nshitafye ishingi walebafwa ukulingana no lusefye lobe we mwine.

english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.
translation: “Kabili ilyo wabasokele ukuti babwelele ku mafunde yobe, nomba bali abafilumba, bakaana no kumfwa ifyebo fyobe ifyo umuntu uufikonka engasangamo ubumi. Lelo bena batikinya amapeya yabo kukukanaumfwa kufyo wabebele, bakosha ne mikoshi, bakaana.

english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.
translation: Kanshi baiminine mu fifulo fyabo no kubelenga mu citabo ca mafunde yakwa Yawe Lesa wabo pa nsa shitatu isha kasuba. Kabili pa nsa shimbi shitatu isha kasuba elyo baleisosela amashiwi yakuyebelela. Bawile ubukupeme pa cinso cakwa Yawe, Lesa wabo.

english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
translation: Pa myaka iyingi walibatekela umutima, kabili ku Mupashi obe walebasoka ukupitila muli bakasesema bobe. Lelo tababakutike no kumfwa. Eico nomba wabapeele mu minwe ya bantu abalekana lekana mu fyalo.

english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.
translation: Icite 11:31

english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.
translation: “Eico nomba, we Lesa wesu, we wa maka yonse, waliba umukulu kabili uwakutiina, we ufikilisha icipangano cobe ne citemwiko icishipwa. Shi wisuula ubu bucushi ubo tucili nabo ifwe fwe bana bobe bonse, imfumu shesu, intungulushi shesu, bashimapepo besu, bakasesema besu, ifikolwe fyesu elyo na bantu besu bonse, ubucushi ubo twaculako ukutampa pa nshita ya shamfumu sha bena Asiria mpaka ukufika na ku bushiku bwa lelo.

english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.
translation: Kabili we mfumu iwe waliba umulungami pali conse icaisa pali ifwe, pantu ifyo ucita fyacishinka. Lelo fwe bene nifwe tucita ifyamusebanya.

english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.
translation: Nangufye ni bashamfumu besu nangu ni ntungulushi shesu, bashimapepo besu, pamo ne fikolwe fyesu, bonse bakene ukukonka amafunde yobe. Tabasakamene ifipope fyobe no kusoka kobe uko wacitile.

english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.
translation: Ilyo bali mu bufumu bwa ku calo cabo tabakupyungile, nelyo bali ne fisuma ifingi ifyo wabapeele mu calo icikulu ica mushili uwafunda. Tabapilibwike na ku micitile yabubifi nakalya.

english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.
translation: “Nomba mona ifwe na lelo tuli basha pantu balitucimfya. Mu calo cino icapeelwe ku fikolwe fyesu ukusekelelamo ku fisabo na ku fisuma ifyabamo, mona ifwe tuli abasha.

english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
translation: Ifisabo fyaciko fiwaminafye bashamfumu abo watupeela ukulatuteeka pa mulandu wa bubifi bwesu. Elyo kabili bacita ifyo batemenwe pa mibili yesu na pa fitekwa fyesu. Awe kwena ifwe twaikalilafye ubucushi bweka.

english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God.
translation: Elyo Yeshua, Bani, Kadimieli, Shebaniya, Buni, Sherebia, Bani elyo na Kenani, bonse ninshi beminine pa matabo ya bena Levi, balebilikisha ne shiwi ilikalamba kuli Yawe, Lesa wabo.

english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!
translation: Kabili abali abena Levi, Yeshua, Kadimieli, Bani, Hashabineya, Sherebia, Hodiya, Shebaniya elyo na Petaya batile, “Imeni no kupaala Yawe Lesa wenu na matotelo, uwabako ukufuma umuyayaya no kuya umuyayaya!

english: You are the LORD, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.
translation: Iwe wekafye niwe Yawe. Niwe wabumbile umulu pamo pene ne myulu ya mumulu pamo ne fita fyonse ifya mu mulu . Niwe wabumbile isonde na fyonse ifyabapo, na babemba bonse na fyonse ifyabamo. Niwe upeela umweo ku cintu conse. Ne fita fya mu mulu filakukontamina pakukupepa.

english: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
translation: We Yawe, niwe Lesa, niwe wasalile Abramu. Wamufumishe na mu musumba wa Uri wa bena Kaludea, wamupeela ne shina lyakutila niwe Abrahamu.

english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.
translation: Kabili wasangile umutima wakwe wakupetamina. Elyo wapangene nankwe icipangano icakupeela ku bana bakwe icalo ca bena Kenani, abena Hiti, abena Amoni, abena Perisi, abena Yebusi elyo na bena Girigashi. Iwe ulasunga no kufikilisha ifilayo fyobe ifyacishinka pantu uli mulungami.

english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
translation: “Walimwene ifyo ifikolwe fyesu fyaculile mu Egupto. Kabili walyumfwile nefyo balelilishika kuli Bemba Wakashika.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
translation: Kabili mukalelisha amapenga na pa nshita shenu ishakusansamuka, pa nshikunkulu ishasontwa, na pa nshikunkulu yakutampa umweshi upya. Mukalelisha amapenga pakuleka amalambo yakoca na pakupeela umutuulo wakwampana. Ifi fikaba ifyakumwibukishako kuli Yawe Lesa wenu. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.”

english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili (20), mu mweshi wabubili, mu mwaka walenga bubili, ikumbi lyalimine ukufuma pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa ilya Cipangano.

english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
translation: Abena Israeli nabo epakwima ukufuma pa nkambi ya mu matololo ya Sinai, balati bafuma apa baya pambi mpaka ikumbi lyaiminina mu matololo ya Parani.

english: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
translation: Baimine no kuya umuku wakubalilapo ukulingana nefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
translation: Aba mu ciputulwa ca nkambi yakwa Yuda ebabalilepo ukwima no luunga lwabo, baleba mu mpuka mu mpuka. Uwalebatungulula ni Nashoni mwana Aminadabu.

english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
translation: Netaneli mwana Sua, nao ewaletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Isaka,

english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
translation: kabili Eliabu mwana Eloni, nao aletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Sebuloni.

english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
translation: Elyo bapangulula Itenti lyakwa Lesa, abena Geshoni na bena Merari abalelisenda nabo baima.

english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
translation: Abalekonkapo ukwima ba mu ciputulwa ca nkambi yakwa Rubeni no luunga lwabo, mu mpuka mu mpuka. Uwalebatungulula ni Elisuli mwana Shedeuri.

english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
translation: Shelumieli mwana Sulishadai, ewaletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Simeoni,

english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.
translation: “Panga amapenga yabili aya silifa ayo bafulila ku nondo ayakwitilako ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli pamo no kubeshibishako pakufuma pa nkambi.

english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
translation: kabili Eliasafu mwana Deweli, nao ewaletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Gadi.

english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
translation: Elyo abena Koati baima, basenda ifyamushilo. Itenti lyakwa Lesa bali nokusanga naliimikwa kale libe tabalafika.

english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
translation: Abalekonkapo ukwima ba mu ciputulwa ca nkambi yakwa Efulemu no luunga lwabo, mu mpuka mu mpuka. Uwalebatungulula ni Elishama mwana Amiudi.

english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
translation: Gamalieli mwana Pedasuri, ewaletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Manase,

english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
translation: kabili Abidani mwana Gideoni, nao alatungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Benjamini.

english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
translation: Na pakulekelesha abaleshalila kunumafye ya bonse, ba mu ciputulwa ca nkambi yakwa Dani no luunga lwabo, nabo baima mu mpuka mu mpuka. Uwalebatungulula ni Aiesa mwana Amishadai.

english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
translation: Pafieli mwana Okirani, ewaletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Asheri,

english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
translation: kabili Aila mwana Enani, nao aletungulula impuka ya luko lwakwa Naftali.

english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo impuka sha bena Israeli shalekonkana pakwenda nga shafuma pa nkambi.

english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”
translation: Elyo Mose aebele Hobabu mwana Reueli umwina Midiani shifyala wakwa Mose ati, “Ifwe nomba twalaima ukuya ku ncende iyo Yawe atile, ‘Nkaipeela kuli imwe.’ Natuleya bonse na ifwe tukaya kucitila ubusuma, pantu Yawe alaya Israeli ifintu ifisuma.”

english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Nga balisha amapenga yonse yabili, ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse ninshi kwisa longana pantanshi yobe pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
translation: Hobabu nao ayaswike ati, “Awe, ine nshakonke, nalabwelelamofye ku calo candi, kabili ku bantu bandi.”

english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
translation: Lelo Mose nao atile, “Napapata wiya utushe iyoo. Niwe wishibe apo twingacita inkambi mu matololo, kabili iwe kuti waba amenso yesu.

english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”
translation: Nga cakuti iwe twaya nobe, ninshi ifwe tukaya kwakanyako ifisuma fyonse ifyo Yawe akatupeela.”

english: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
translation: Kanshi elyo baimine ukufuma pa lupili lwakwa Yawe, baendele inshiku shitatu. Muli ishi nshiku, Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe lyonse eyaleba pantanshi, pakufwaya incende iyo bengacitapo inkambi.

english: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
translation: Ikumbi lyakwa Yawe lyali pa mulu wabo mu nshita ya kasuba ilyo baimine ukufuma pa nkambi.

english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
translation: Ilyo lyonse Imbokoshi ya Cipangano yaleima Mose alesosa ati, “Ima, we Yawe! Abalwani bobe bengapasangana, na bakupata leka bafulumuke ku cinso cobe.”

english: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
translation: Kabili lyonsefye ilyo baletula Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, Mose alesosa ati, “Bwela, we Yawe ku mintapendwa ya makana yakwa Israeli.”

english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
translation: Nga limofye elyalila, ninshi intungulushi, abakalamba ba nko sha bena Israeli, eshili nokulongana pantanshi yobe.

english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
translation: Likalati ipenga nga lyalila, ninshi inko shacitile inkambi ku kabanga kwima ukufuma pa nkambi.

english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
translation: Ilyo kabili ipenga lyabubili lyalila inko shacitile inkambi shabela ku kapinda ka ku kulyo nasho shili nokufuma pa nkambi. Kanshi ukulisha kwe penga kukaba e cishibilo cakufuma pa nkambi.

english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
translation: Pakwita abantu bonse pamo mulelisha amapenga, lelo likalalila umusowa umo wine.

english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
translation: Bamwana Aroni abaume, bashimapepo, ebafwile ukulisha amapenga. Ili e funde muli nokukonka umukakonkanina inkulo shenu shonse.

english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
translation: Ilyo mwalalwa inkondo no mulwani wenu uukalamucusha mu calo cenu, mukaleikatisha ukulisha amapenga, na Yawe Lesa wenu akamwibukisha no kumupususha ku balwani benu.

english: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
translation: Kabili abantu bailishenye kuli Yawe mu matwi yakwe pa mulandu wa kucula kwabo. Nao Yawe pakumfwa, afulwa nganshi. Elyo umulilo ukufuma kuli Yawe wapile pali bena no koca imbali shimo isha ku mpela ya nkambi.

english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
translation: Mose aumfwile uko abantu balelila, cila lupwa pa mwinshi we tenti lyabo. Yawe abafulilwa nganshi, na Mose asakamana apakalamba.

english: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
translation: Aipusha Yawe ati, “Bushe cinshi waletela ubu bwafya pa mubomfi obe? Bushe cinshi ncitile icishikusekeshe, pakuti untwike icisendo icakula ifi ica bantu bonse aba?

english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
translation: Bushe nine naimite aba bantu bonse? Bushe nine nabafyele? Nga kanshi cinshi ico ulenjebela ukuti ndebasenda mu maboko yandi, nga filya umuleshi asenda akanya, ku calo ico walaile ifikolwe fyabo no mulapo?

english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
translation: Bushe ni kwi ningafumya inama shakulisha abantu bonse aba? Balelilila kuli ine abati, ‘Tupeele inama tulye!’

english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
translation: Ine nekafye teti mbasende abantu bonse aba, icisendo cafinisha kuli ine!

english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
translation: Ifi nga efyo ukalancita, ninshi unjipayefye nombaline. Nga waŋumfwilako uluse, uleke mfwefye, pakuti nipita mu bubi ubwakuti bungonaule.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Nonganikila abakalamba ba bena Israeli amakumi cine lubali (70), abo waishiba ukuti e ntungulushi sha bantu kabili babomfi babo. Ubalete kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo eko bese beminine pamo nobe.

english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
translation: Ine ndeika kukulanda na iwe kulya, kabili ndeisa buulapo amaka yamo aya Mupashi uo nabika pali iwe no kuyabika na pali bena. Ebakulakwafwako ukusenda icisendo ca bantu abo uli nabo, epakuti wilasenda ici cisendo weka.

english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
translation: Kebe abantu auti, muisangulule mwe bene pakuipekanya ku bushiku bwa mailo ilyo mukalya inama. Yawe alyumfwile ilyo mwalilile amuti, ‘Yangu nani aletupeela inama yakulya! Twali bwino mu Egupto!’ Nomba Yawe alamupeela inama iyakuti mulye.

english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
translation: Tamwakalyefye pa bushiku bumo, nangu pa nshiku shibili nangu shisano, nangu pa nshiku ikumi, nangu pa nshiku amakumi yabili,

english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.
translation: Elyo abantu balila mutuule kuli Mose. Nao Mose apepa kuli Yawe, awe no mulilo washima.

english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
translation: lelo umweshi umo uutuntulu, mpakafye inama shikalefumina na mu myona yenu, kabili shikamutendushe. Pantu imwe namusuula Yawe uwikala na imwe, kabili mwailishenye pa cinso cakwe amuti, ‘Bushe cinshi twafumine ku Egupto?’”

english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
translation: Mose nao aebele Yawe ati, “Pano ndi pakati ka bantu amakana imyanda mutanda (600,000) abaleenda pa makasa, elyo na iwe watila uli nokubapeela inama shakulyafye umweshi umo uutuntulu!

english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
translation: Bushe kuti baipaya iŋombe, imbushi ne mpaanga ishingabakumana bonse aba? Bushe nga babepaila isabi lyonse lya muli bemba kuti lyabakumana bonse aba?”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
translation: Yawe ayaswike Mose ati, “Bushe ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kwalipipisha? Nomba uli nokumona ico nalanda nga cili nokuba icishinka kuli iwe!”

english: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
translation: Elyo Mose afumine no kuya eba abantu ifyo Yawe amwebele. Akolonganya ne ntungulushi amakumi cine lubali (70), no kubemika ukushinguluka Itenti.

english: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
translation: Kanshi Yawe nao aikila mwikumbi no kulanda na Mose, abuula no Mupashi uwali pali Mose, aubika na pa ntungulushi amakumi cine lubali (70). Ilyo Umupashi waikala pali shena, shalasesema, lelo tashatalile ashisesema nakabili.

english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
translation: Lelo kwashele abaume babili mu nkambi, amashina yabo ni Elidadi na Medadi. Nabo bene bali pa mpendwa ya ntungulushi, nomba bena tabaile kwi Tenti. Nomba mulya mwine mu nkambi nabo Umupashi waishile pali bena, no kulasesema balasesema.

english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
translation: Umulumendo umo aile ulubilo kukweba Mose ati, “Elidadi na Medadi balesesema mu nkambi.”

english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
translation: Elyo Yoshua mwana Nuni, kafwilisha wakwa Mose mu milimo ukufumafye mu bulumendo bwakwe, alanda no kusosa ati, “Mose, we mfumu yandi, baleshefye!”

english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
translation: Nao Mose amwasuka ati, “Bushe iwe uli no bufuba palwa ine? Ala kuti natemwa bonse abantu bakwa Yawe baba bakasesema nga Yawe kuti abika Umupashi wakwe pali bena!”

english: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.
translation: Eco ilya ncende baitile Tabera, pantu umulilo wafumine kuli Yawe no kuboca.

english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
translation: Kanshi Mose ne ntungulushi sha bena Israeli epakubwelelamo ku nkambi.

english: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
translation: Elyo Yawe atumine umwela ukufuma pali bemba, wasenda inkwale ukushileta ku nkambi. Shashinguluka inkambi konse konse ukufika napo umuntu engenda ubushiku bumo uku noku, kabili ukuya mu mulu ukufuma pa mushili mita umo .

english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
translation: Kanshi akasuba konse no bushiku bonse kabili no bushiku bwakonkelepo abantu baile baleikatafye inkwale. Takwali uwafililwe ukulonganika inkwale ukufika pa cipimo ca bahomeri ikumi limo. Elyo bashikanika na mu mbali ya nkambi.

english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.
translation: Ilyo inama shali tashilapwa isho balelya, Yawe alibafulilwe abatumina icikuko icibi nganshi.

english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
translation: Nabo epakwinika ilya ncende ishina ukuti ni pa Kibroti Hatafa , pantu palya pene epo bashiikile abantu abalefwa ku cikasha.

english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
translation: Ukufuma ku Kibroti Hatafa abena Israeli baile cita inkambi ku Haseloti eko baikala.

english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
translation: Nomba abenafyalo abali mu bena Israeli balafwaisha ifyakulya fimbi. Abena Israeli nabo nakabili balalila abati, “Yangu ukwakumona inama shakulya!

english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
translation: Twaibukisha isabi twalelya ilishili lyakushita, kabili ne fibimbi, amameloni, amaliki, kanyense na galiki ifyo twalelya.

english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
translation: Nomba ifwe kwalifita na ku mukoshi, tatumona nangu cimo kanofye maana inshiku shonse!”

english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
translation: Maana ali nge nseke sha kolianda, kabili alemoneka nge cinyamuti.

english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
translation: Abantu baleya mukukusa, elyo bapela nangu ukutwa mwibende. Balemwipika mu nongo no kupangako imikate. Mukulya, aleumfwika ngo mukate bapangile ku mafuta ya miolifa.

english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
translation: Ilyo umume wawila pa nkambi ubushiku, elyo maana nao alepona.

english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
translation: Miriamu na Aroni baleisosha pali Mose pa mulandu wakuupa umwanakashi umwina Kushi, pantu ca cine aupile umwina Kushi.

english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
translation: Amaf 34:10

english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
translation: Ukuf 33:11

english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
translation: Wileka abe nga kapopo kafyalwa mwifumo lyakwa nyina no mubili uwaliwa lubali.”

english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
translation: Elyo Mose epakulilila kuli Yawe ati, “We Lesa, napapata muposhe!”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
translation: Yawe ayaswike ati, “Nga cakuti wishi amufwishile amate pa menso, bushe Miriamu nga tasebene inshiku cine lubali? Kanshi mwisalileni kunse ya nkambi pa nshiku cine lubali, na panuma elyo bakamubweshe.”

english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
translation: Elyo Miriamu baya mwisalila kunse ya nkambi pa nshiku cine lubali, na bena Israeli tabafumine pa nkambi mpaka Miriamu bamubwesha.

english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
translation: Panuma ya ifyo, elyo bafuma ku Haseloti, bayacita inkambi mu matololo ya Parani.

english: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
translation: Balalanda abati, “Bushe Yawe alandila muli Mose ekafye? Bushe talandila na muli ifwe bene?” Kabili Yawe nao aumfwa ifyo balelanda.

english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
translation: Nomba Mose ali umuntu uwafuuka nganshi ukucila abantu bonse mpanga yonse pano isonde lyonse.

english: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
translation: Apopene Yawe aebele Mose, Aroni na Miriamu ati, “Imwe bonse batatu iseni kunse kwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.” Elyo bonse batatu baya.

english: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
translation: Elyo Yawe epakwikila mu ntumba ye kumbi pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, epo aiminina no kwita Aroni na Miriamu. Ilyo bonse babili baile lwa pantanshi,

english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
translation: Yawe alabeba ati, “Nomba, umfweni amashiwi yandi! Nga kasesema wakwa Yawe ali pakati kenu, ndaisokolola kuli ena mu fimonwa, ndalanda nankwe mu filoto.

english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
translation: Nomba caibela ku mubomfi wandi Mose, wena wacishinka mu ŋanda yandi yonse.

english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
translation: Eico wena pakulanda nankwe tulamonana, tulanda apabuuta tuutu kabili te mu mapinda. Ena alimona ne cata candi ine ne Yawe! Nomba imwe cinshi mushatiinine ukuisosha pa mubomfi wandi Mose?”

english: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
translation: Yawe epakubafulilwa nganshi, kabili afumapo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
translation: Gadieli mwana Sodi, uwa mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni.

english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
translation: Gadi mwana Susi, uwa mu luko lwakwa Yosefu, e luko lwakwa Manase wine.

english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
translation: Amieli mwana Gemali, uwa mu luko lwakwa Dani.

english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
translation: Seturi mwana Mikaeli, uwa mu luko lwakwa Asheri.

english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
translation: Nabi mwana Fofisi, uwa mu luko lwakwa Naftali.

english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
translation: Geueli mwana Maki, uwa mu luko lwakwa Gadi.

english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
translation: Aya e mashina ya bantu Mose atumine kukulengula icalo ca Kenani. Mose elyo ainika Hoshea mwana Nuni, ishina lya Yoshua.

english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
translation: Pakubatuma kukulengula icalo ca Kenani, Mose abebele ati, “Muye mwingilile ku matololo ya Negebu, elyo muye na mu calo ca mpili.

english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
translation: Muye mona ifyo icalo caba, na bantu bekalamo nga balikosa nangu tabakosa, nga balifula nangu tabafula.

english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
translation: Bushe calo ca musango nshi baikalamo? Cisuma nangu cibi? Misumba ya musango shani baikalamo? Bushe, misumba ya malinga nangu iyoo?

english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
translation: “Salamo intungulushi imo imo ukufuma muli cila cikolwe ca luko, kabili ushitume nge nengu shiye lengula icalo ca Kenani, ico ndi nokupeela ku bena Israeli.”

english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
translation: Ngo mushili waba shani? Untu wafunda nangu iyoo? Nge miti, emo yaba nangu iyoo? Muyeshipafye, na pakubwela mukaleteko ne fisabo fimo ifikula muli cilya calo.” Cali pa nshita ifisabo fyantanshi ifya myangashi fitendekelapo ukufiluka.

english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
translation: Aba bantu baile no kulengula icalo ukutendekalafye ku matololo ya Sini no kuya shintafye na ku Rehobu, mupepi na ku Lebo Hamati .

english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
translation: Baingilile ku matololo ya Negebu elyo baisa na ku musumba wa Hebuloni, uko Ahimani, Sheshai na Talimai aba mu lupwa lwakwa Anaki baleikala. Umusumba wa Hebuloni wakuulilwe imyaka cine lubali ninshi umusumba wa Soani uwa mu calo ca Egupto taulakulwa.

english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
translation: Ilyo bafikile mwishika lya Eshikoli , eko bateta umusambo wa cisansangu ca myangashi icafina nganshi. Abantu babili ebacipinga pakucisenda ku mutembo. Basendako na mateke na makunyu.

english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
translation: Ico cine calenga nokuti iyi ncende bainike ne shina lye shika lya Eshikoli, pantu eko abena Israeli batetele icisansangu cilya ica myangashi.

english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
translation: Ilyo papwile inshiku amakumi yane (40), inengu shabweluluka kukulengula icalo.

english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
translation: Elyo baisa kuli Mose na Aroni, na ku lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli ku Kadeshi mu matololo ya Parani nokubashimikila ifyo bamwene. Babalanga ne fisabo baleteleko ukufuma kuli cilya calo.

english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
translation: Bashimikila Mose abati, “Twaile lengula icalo ico watutumineko, kabili cine cine mufumfumuka umukaka no buci, nefi e fisabo fyaciko.

english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
translation: Lelo abantu bekalamo, bena bamaka nganshi ne misumba yabo nayo ikalamba icine cine kabili ya malinga ayakosa. Kabili twamweneko na ba mu lupwa lwakwa Anaki.

english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
translation: Abena Amaleki ebekala mu Negebu, elyo abena Hiti, abena Yebusi na bena Amoli bekala mu calo ca mpili. Kabili abena Kenani bena bekalila mu lulamba lwa bemba na ku lulamba lwa mumana wa Yordani.”

english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
translation: Mose acita ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe, atuma intungulushi ukufuma ku matololo ya ku Parani. Bonsefye bali ni ntungulushi sha bena Israeli.

english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
translation: Kalebu atalalike abantu pa cinso cakwa Mose, “Tufwile ukuya poka cilya calo no kwikalamo pantu natukwata amaka yakuya cimfya.”

english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
translation: Lelo abantu abaile na Kalebu batile, “Ifwe tatukwete maka yakuya lwisha balya bantu. Abantu abekala muli cilya calo bamaka ukutucila.”

english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
translation: Elyo basalanganya ilyashi lyabufi ku bena Israeli pa mulandu wa calo cintu baile lengula. Batile, “Icalo twaile lengula, calo iconaula abantu bekalamo. Abantu bonse abo twamwene muli ici calo, bantu abalunduka nganshi.

english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
translation: Kabili twalimweneko na Banefilimu (Abana bakwa Anaki e bamo aba mu mutundu wa Banefilimu). Ifwe twalemonekafye kwati fipaso mu menso yesu, nabo bene efyo baletumona.”

english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
translation: Amashina yashiko ni aya. Shamua mwana Sakuri, uwa mu luko lwakwa Rubeni.

english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
translation: Shafati mwana Hori, uwa mu luko lwakwa Simeoni.

english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
translation: Kalebu mwana Yefune, uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
translation: Igali mwana Yosefu, uwa mu luko lwakwa Isaka.

english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
translation: Hoshea mwana Nuni, uwa mu luko lwakwa Efulemu.

english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
translation: Paliti mwana Rafu, uwa mu luko lwakwa Benjamini.

english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
translation: Ulukuta lonsefye ulwa bena Israeli lwapuminemo imisowa, lwalilile ubushiku bonse.

english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
translation: Lelo ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse lwalelanda pakubatoba amabwe. Elyo apopenefye abena Israeli bonse bamona ubucindami bwakwa Yawe pamulu we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Bushe aba bantu bakaleka lilali ukunsuula? Bushe ni lilali bakaleka ukukanancetekela, nangu nabacitile ifipeshamano ifingi?

english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
translation: Ine nkabaponesha icikuko no kubaposafye, lelo iwe nkakucita umushobo ukalamba, kabili uwamaka nganshi ukubacila.”

english: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
translation: Lelo Mose asosele kuli Yawe ati, “Nomba abena Egupto bali nokumfwa pali ici! Pantu ni ku maka yobe wafumishe aba bantu kuli bena!

english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
translation: Kabili bakebako abekala muli ici calo pali ici. Balya bantu balyumfwa kale ukuti iwe we Yawe waba naba bantu, ulamoneka ku cinso cabo, ne kumbi lyobe liba pa mulu wabo. Ulabatangilila mu ntumba ye kumbi akasuba, elyo ubushiku ubatangilila mu ntumba ya mulilo.

english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
translation: Nomba nga waipaya aba bantu bonse pa nshita imo, imitundu yonse iyaumfwa ululumbi lobe ikatila,

english: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
translation: Bahi 3:16

english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
translation: Kanshi nomba shilanga amaka yobe ukulingana ngefyo wasosele ilyo watile,

english: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
translation: Yawe tafulwa bwangu, kabili alikwatisha icitemwiko icishipwa. Abelela uluse pa bubifi na bucisanguka. Lelo tafilwa ukukanda abamilandu, akanda abana pa bubifi bwa bashibo ukufikafye na ku nkulo yalenga butatu elyo ne yalenga bune.

english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
translation: Kanshi ukulingana ne citemwiko icishipwa wakwatisha, belelako aba bantu uluse pa bubifi bwabo. Nga filya fine wababelela uluse ukutula apo bafumina ku Egupto ukufika na nomba.”

english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
translation: Bonsefye abena Israeli balailishanya kuli Mose na Aroni, abati, “Nga caliweme atufwila mu calo ca Egupto, nangu ukufwila muno mwine mu matololo!

english: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
translation: Yawe epakwasuka ati, “Ine nababelela uluse ngefyo walomba.

english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—
translation: Nomba, mu cine cine napalifye ne Mumi, no bucindami bwandi ne Yawe ubwakumana icalo conse,

english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
translation: pali aba bantu tapali nelyo umo uwamona ubucindami bwandi ne fipeshamano nacitile mu Egupto na mu matololo, lelo tabambeela kabili banjesha imiku ikumi limo,

english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
translation: tapali nelyo umo uukamona icalo nalaile no mulapo kuli bashibo. Onse uwansuula takacimone iyoo.

english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
translation: Kanofye umubomfi wandi Kalebu, uwaba no mutima uwaibela kabili alambeela no mutima onse. Ine nkamufisha mu calo aile lengula, na ba mu lupwa lwakwe bali nokubuula cilya calo cikabe icacishilano.

english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
translation: Nomba apo abena Amaleki na bena Kenani ebekala mu mawanga, mukabwelulukeko mailo no kulola ku matololo, mukalungame mu nshila yalola kuli Bemba Wakashika .”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati,

english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
translation: “Bushe ulu lukuta lubi lukaleka lilali ukuilishanya palwa ine? Ine niŋumfwa ifintu abena Israeli baleilishanyapo!

english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
translation: Kanshi mubebe amuti, ‘mu cine cine, napalifye ine ne Mumi, efyasosa Yawe, ndemucitilafye fyonse ukulingana ngefyo ŋumfwile musosele.

english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
translation: Bonsefye imwe mwe bali ne myaka yakufyalwa amakumi yabili (20) no kucilapo mwe bapendelwe, kabili mwe bailishenye pali ine, mukafwila muli yano matololo.

english: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
translation: Cinshi ico Yawe aletutwalila muli cilya calo kukufwilafye mu nkondo? Abakashi besu na bana bakabekata bunkole. Bushe teti ciwame ukuti ifwe twabwelelamo ku Egupto?”

english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translation: Tapakabe nangu umo pali imwe uukengila mu calo ico naimishepo ukuboko pakulapa ukumupeela kanofye Kalebu mwana Yefune na Yoshua mwana Nuni.

english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
translation: Lelo imwe mukafwila mu matololo.

english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
translation: Abana benu bakaba bakacema mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane (40). Bakulaculila pa mulandu wa bucintomfwa bwenu, mpaka no wakulekelesha muli imwe akafwile mu matololo.

english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
translation: Pa myaka amakumi yane (40), cila mwaka ukulingana ne nshiku amakumi yane (40) isho mwapwile pakulengula icalo, mwakulacula pa mulandu wa bubifi bwenu, kabili elyo mukeshiba ifyo ukunsangukila kwaba.’

english: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
translation: Nine Yawe nasosa, kabili mu cine cinefye efyo ndi nokucita kuli mwe lukuta lubi ulwaikatana pamo mukuilishanya pali ine. Bonsefye bakafwila muno mwine mu matololo, eikaba e mpela yabo.”

english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
translation: Imili 7:36

english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
translation: pa bufi bwabo balifwile ku cikuko pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
translation: Pa baile kukulengula icalo ikumi limo na babili (12), abapuswikekofye ni Yoshua mwana Nuni na Kalebu mwana Yefune.

english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
translation: Imili 7:39

english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
translation: Kabili balasoshanya abati, “Natusale intungulushi tubwelelemo na ku Egupto!”

english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”
translation: Kacelocelo ubushiku bwakonkelepo, baimine ukulola ku calo ca mpili. Basosa abati, “Cisuma natubifya! Kanshi natuleyafye ku cifulo Yawe atulaya.”

english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?
translation: Mose nao epakubeba ati, “Nga cinshi ico mulekaanina ukubeela Yawe? Muli nokufilwa!

english: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
translation: Mwiya nako pantu Yawe tali na imwe iyoo. Abalwani benu balemucimfya.

english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”
translation: Pantu abena Amaleki na bena Kenani baleya mulwisha no kumucimfya ku lupanga ico mwalisangukila Yawe. Apo Yawe tali na imwe, muleya fwa ku lupanga.”

english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
translation: Nomba bena babikilepofye ukuya ku calo ca mpili, lelo Imbokoshi ya Cipangano cakwa Yawe yashele mu nkambi pamo na Mose.

english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
translation: Elyo abena Amaleki na bena Kenani abaleikala muli cilya calo ca mpili, babekilila no kubasansa, babapumaula no kubatentemusha ulupili ukufikafye na ku Homa.

english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
translation: Elyo Mose na Aroni bawile ubukupeme pa cinso ca lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli ulwalongene.

english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
translation: Elyo Yoshua mwana Nuni na Kalebu mwana Yefune abali pa baile kukulengula icalo, balepaula ifyakufwala fyabo,

english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
translation: baeba no lukuta lonsefye ulwa bena Israeli abati, “Icalo twapitilemo kukulengula cisuma nganshi.

english: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
translation: Yawe nga asansamukila muli ifwe, akatutwala muli cilya calo no kucipeela kuli ifwe, icalo umufumfumuka umukaka no buci.

english: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”
translation: Nomba, mwisangukila Yawe. Kabili mwitiina balya bantu bekalamo pantu bena tukabaminafye. Icakubacingilila nacifuma pali bena, lelo Yawe ali na ifwe. Eico mwibatiina iyoo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Kabili ali nokuleta umutuulo wa cakunwa icipimo ca citika wa hini wa mwangashi pakuba umutuulo wakoca pa mulilo kukuba icena cisuma icakusansamusha Yawe.

english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
translation: Kanshi uyu e musango wakupekanishishamo cila iŋombe, sukusuku na kana ka mpaanga nangu aka mbushi.

english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
translation: Inama shakutuula ilambo nangu shingafula shani, mukalecita ifyo fine kuli cila imo.

english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Onsefye umukaya umwina Israeli ali nokucita ifi fintu pakuleta umutuulo wakoca pa mulilo, kukuba icena cisuma icakusansamusha Yawe.

english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.
translation: Pa mulandu wa nkulo shikesa, ilyo umwinafyalo nangu uuli onse uwikala na imwe atuula umutuulo wakoca pa mulilo, uwakuba icena cisuma icakusansamusha Yawe, nao wine afwilefye ukucita cimo cine ifyo na imwe mucita.

english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.
One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
translation: Amafunde ne fipope fikaba fimo fine kuli imwe na ku benafyalo abo mwikala nabo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli no kubeba auti, nga mwaingila mu calo ico ndi nokumutwalamo,

english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.
translation: kabili nga mwalalya icakulya ca muli ici calo, mukalefumyapo fimo ifyamutuulo kuli Yawe.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli, ubebe auti, nga mwaingila mu calo ndi nokumupeela pakuti emo mukaleikala,

english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
translation: Ku bunga bwenu ubwantanshi mukalepangako umukate no kuutuula nga filya fine mutuula umutuulo wa pa kupwa kwa kusokola iŋanu.

english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.
translation: Mu nkulo shenu shonse ishikakonkapo, mukaletuula umutuulo kuli Yawe ku mukate mukabalilapo ukupanga.

english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—
translation: Levi 24:22

english: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
translation: icipope conse ico Yawe apeele Mose ukufuma pa bushiku Yawe abapeele ukupita na mu nkulo shonse ishikakonkapo,

english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
translation: nga mwacita mukukanaishiba, no lukuta lonse talwishibe, lyena ninshi ulukuta lonse luli nokutuula iciponti ngo mutuulo wakoca uwakuba icena cisuma icakusekesha Yawe. Kabili mubikepo ne fifwaikwa pa mutuulo wa cabunga no wa cakunwa, elyo na sawe uwa mutuulo wa pa fyabubifi.

english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokufutilako ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli pa bubifi bwabo pakuti lubelelwe uluse, pantu ulukuta talwabifishe ku mufulo iyoo. Kabili batuula kuli Yawe umutuulo wakoca no wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi fyabo.

english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
translation: Ukuf 34:26

english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
translation: “Lelo ngo muntufye umo ewabifishe mukukanaishiba, ali nokutuula akabushi akakota aka mwaka umo, ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokufutilako uyo muntu pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pakuti abelelwe uluse pa fyabubifi fyakwe acitile mukukanaishiba. Kanshi nga bamufutilako, lyena ali nokubelelwa uluse.

english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
translation: Ili line funde limo line e lyakukonka umuntufye onse uwabifya mukukanaishiba, abe mwina Israeli umukaya nangu mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe.

english: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—
translation: mukaletuula Yawe amalambo yakoca ukufuma pa ŋombe nangu pa mukuni, ukuba icena cisuma icakusekesha Yawe, nangu umutuulo wakoca nangu amalambo ya pa mulandu wa filayo nangu aya bupe bwakuitemenwa, nangu imituulo ya pa nshikunkulu shenu.

english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
translation: “Nomba onse uwabifya ku mufulo, abe mukaya nangu mwinafyalo, ninshi asaalula Yawe. Uyu muntu wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi.

english: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
translation: Pantu asuula ishiwi lyakwa Yawe kabili apula amafunde ku mufulofye, uyo muntu cine cine mutamfyenifye, pantu ububi bwakwe buli pali ena.”

english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli bacili mu matololo, basangile umuntu umo aleteba inkuni pa bushiku bwe Sabata.

english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
translation: Na bamusangile aleteba inkuni bamutwala kuli Mose, Aroni na ku lukuta lonse.

english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
translation: Elyo bamusunga mukulolela ukupingulwa pantu tabaishibe icakumucita.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Uyu muntu wakwipayafye. Ulukuta lonse lumutobaule amabwe kunse ya nkambi.”

english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Kanshi ulukuta lwamufumisha kunse ya nkambi no kumutobaula amabwe afwa nokufwa, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli utile, ‘Ku fisempe fya nsalu shenu mulebililako insenkebele, kabili ku lusenkebele lumo lumo mulebikako umwando wacifufya, efyo mukalecita na mu nkulo shenu shonse ishikakonkapo.

english: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;
translation: Ilyo mukalamona insenkebele, shikalamwibukishako amafunde yakwa Yawe pakutila mukaleyakonka. Kabili epakuti mwikalakonkelela ulunkumbwa lwa ku mitima yenu nolwa menso yenu.

english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.
translation: Elyo uyo onse uwatuula umutuulo kuli Yawe, ali nokubikapo umutuulo wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino icapekumi cimo ca ku cipimo ca efa , ubwasanshiwamo ne cipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini wa mafuta ya miolifa.

english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
translation: Elyo mukalaibukisha no kulakonka amafunde yandi yonse, kabili mukalabafye abamushilo kuli Lesa wenu.

english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”
translation: Nine Yawe Lesa wenu, uwamufumishe mu calo ca Egupto kukuba Lesa wenu. Nine Yawe Lesa wenu.’”

english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
translation: Atuule ne cipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini wa mwangashi ngo mutuulo wa cakunwa ukulunda pa mutuulo na pelambo lyakoca ilya cila mwana wa mpaanga.

english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
translation: Pali sukusuku umo muli nokutuula umutuulo wa cabunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino utwapekumi tubili twa ku cipimo ca efa, ifyasanshiwamo ne cipimo mupepi na citika wa hini wa mafuta ya miolifa.

english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Atuule no mwangashi icipimo mupepi na citika wa hini ngo mutuulo wa cakunwa. Fituulwe ukuba icena cisuma icakusansamusha Yawe.

english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,
translation: Nga mwapekanya iŋombe ilume ngo mutuulo wa cakoca nangu ilambo, pa mulandu wa mulapo nangu mutuulo wakwampana kuli Yawe,

english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
translation: pa ŋombe muli nokulundapo umutuulo wa cabunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino utwapekumi tutatu twa ku cipimo ca efa, ubwasanshiwamo ne cipimo ca citika wa hini wa mafuta ya miolifa.

english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
translation: Kora mwana Isa, mwana Koati, mwana Levi, pamo na Datani na Abiramu bamwana Eliabu na Oni mwana Peleti, abantu ba mu luko lwa bena Rubeni, batalama,

english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
translation: Lesa alimupalamika uko ali, iwe pamo na bena Levi banobe. Nomba kabili mulefwaya mupokolole na bushimapepo bwine!

english: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
translation: Yuda 1:11

english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
translation: Elyo Mose aitile Datani na Abiramu, bamwana Eliabu. Lelo nabo bamwasuka abati, “Ifwe tatwaiseko iyoo!

english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
translation: Bushe tawasekelamo pakutufumya mu Egupto mu calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci, pakuti twise tufwile muno mu matololo? Kabili na nomba uleumya no bukalamba pali ifwe?

english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
translation: Kabili tawatutwala mu calo icifumfumukamo umukaka no buci nangu ukutupeela ifishilano fya filime na mabala ya myangashi. Bushe ulefwaya ukufimba aba bantu pa menso. Ifwe tatwaiseko iyoo!”

english: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
translation: Awe Mose afulwa nganshi, elyo aeba Yawe ati, “Wipokelela mutuulo wabo. Ine nshapokololapo nangufye ni punda ku muntu nelyo umo, kabili nshabifyapo muntu nelyo umo.”

english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
translation: Mose aebele Kora ati, “Iwe ne bumba lyobe lyonse, mukamonekela ku cinso cakwa Yawe mailo, iwe wine, ibumba lyobe elyo na Aroni.

english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”
translation: Cila umo umo akasende icifukilisho cakwe no kubikamo ububani, fyonse fikabe imyanda ibili na makumi yasano (250) no kuleta pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Iwe wine na Aroni mukailetele icifukilisho cila muntu.”

english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
translation: Kanshi bonse umo umo epakubuula icifukilisho cakwe, alapwilamo no mulilo, abikamo no bubani. Epakwiminina pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo na Mose pamo na Aroni.

english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. The LORD’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
translation: Ilyo Kora alongana no lukuta lonse mukukaanya Mose na Aroni pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bwamonekela ulukuta lonse.

english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
translation: elyo baimina Mose. Baima pamo ne ntungulushi imyanda ibili na makumi yasano (250) isha bena Israeli, ishaishibikwa ku lukuta, ishasontelwe ukulasangwa ku cilye.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati,

english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
translation: “Talukeni ku lukuta ulu, pakuti mbalofye nombaline.”

english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
translation: Lelo Mose na Aroni bena epakuwa ubukupeme balapapata abati, “We Lesa, Lesa wa mipashi ya bantu bonse, bushe kuti wafulilwa ulukuta lwa bantu bonse, umo nga ewabifya?”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
translation: “Eba ulukuta lutaluke ku matenti yakwa Kora, Datani na Abiramu.”

english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
translation: Elyo Mose aimine aya kuli Datani na Abiramu, ne ntungulushi sha bena Israeli shamukonka.

english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
translation: Elyo asoka ulukuta ati, “Talukeni ku matenti ya aba bantu ababi! Kabili mwikumya na ku cipe cabo nelyo cimo. Epali mwaisa sendelwa pamo pa mulandu wa bubi bwabo.”

english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
translation: Awe ibumba epakutaluka ku matenti yakwa Kora, Datani na Abiramu. Datani na Abiramu epakufumina panse baiminina pa mwinshi wa matenti yabo, pamo na bakashi na bana babo no twaice.

english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
translation: Elyo Mose atila, “Muli ici emo mwalaishibila ukuti Yawe ewantuma kukubomba ifintu fyonse ifi, kabili mwishibe ukuti te ku mano yandi mombela iyoo.

english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.
translation: Nga cakuti aba bantu bafwafye imfwa Lesa, ngefyo abantu bonse bafwa, awe ninshi Yawe tewantuma nakalya.

english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”
translation: Elyo balongana ibumba pali Mose na Aroni babakaanya abati, “Nomba mwacilamo! Ulukuta lonse lwamushilo, na onse uulimo, na Yawe ali pakati kabo. Nga cinshi ico muisansabalikila pebumba lya bantu bakwa Yawe?”

english: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”
translation: Lelo nga cakuti Yawe acita icintu cimo icipya icishatala acicitikapo, no mushili walepuka no kubamina pamo pene ne fintu fyabo fyonse, kabili baya abomi ku calo ca bafwa, ninshi muli nokwishiba ukuti aba bantu nabasuula Yawe.”

english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
translation: Ilyo apwile ukusosa fyonse ifi, umushili apo baiminine walepuka,

english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
translation: kabili wacenama no kubamina pamo pene ne ndupwa shabo, bonse abantu bakwa Kora ne fipe fyonse.

english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
translation: Baile abomi ku calo ca bafwa, pamo pene ne fipe fyabo fyonse. Umushili wabelikisha, baloba no kufuma pebumba.

english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
translation: Abena Israeli pakumfwa inkuuta shabo, bonse abali mumbali, bafulumuka no kupunda balepunda abati, “Naifwe bene umushili kuti watumina!”

english: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
translation: Kabili umulilo wafumine kuli Yawe no koca abaume imyanda ibili na makumi yasano (250) abaletuula ububani.

english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
translation: Ilyo Mose aumfwile ifi, awa panshi ubukupeme.

english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
translation: Elyo aeba Kora ne bumba lyonse ali nalyo ati, “Yawe mailo ulucelo akatulanga umuntu wakwe, kabili uwamushilo. Akalenga nokuti uyo muntu apalame mupepi na ena. Umuntu akasala eo akapalamika kuli ena

english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
translation: Iwe Kora ne bumba lya bantu bobe mukacite ifi. Mukabuule ififukilisho,

english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
translation: na mailo ulucelo mukalapwilemo umulilo, mukabikemo ububani pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Umuntu uo Yawe akasala, eukaba uwamushilo. Imwe, mwe bena Levi namucilamo!”

english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
translation: Mose kabili aebele Kora ati, “Nomba umfweni mwe bena Levi!

english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
translation: Bushe kanshi tamwasekelamo ico Lesa wakwa Israeli amupatula ku lukuta lwa bena Israeli, pakuti mupalame uko ali mukubomba umulimo wakwa Yawe mwi tenti lyakwe, kabili no kwiminina ku lukuta no kutumika pakati kabo?

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Bwekeshamo inkonto yakwa Aroni pantanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, pakuti ibe cibukisho ca basanguka. Elyo neci cikapwisha ukuisosha kwabo pali ine pakuti no kufwa bekafwa.”

english: Moses did so. As the LORD commanded him, so he did.
translation: Awe Mose nao acita ifyo fine ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baebele Mose abati, “Tuli nokufwa! Twaloba, natulobelelafye bonse!

english: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu umo apalama kwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe, ali nokufwa. Bushe bonse tuli nokufwa?”

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli, bakuletele inkonto ikumi limo na shibili, imo imo ukufuma ku ntungulushi ya luko lwa cila cikolwe. Ulembe ishina lya muntu pa mulu wa nkonto yakwe.

english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
translation: Pa nkonto ya bena Levi ulembepo ishina lyakwa Aroni. Pantu kufwile ukuba inkonto imo iya ntungulushi ya luko lwa cila cikolwe.

english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.
translation: Isho nkonto ulingile ukushibika mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, pantanshi ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano, palya nkumana na iwe.

english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
translation: Kabili inkonto ya muntu nkasala, ikalemuka. Elyo nkapwisha ukuilishanya kwa bena Israeli pali iwe.”

english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
translation: Awe Mose alandile na bena Israeli. Intungulushi shabo shamuletela inkonto ikumi limo na shibili, imo imo ukulingana ne nko sha fikolwe fyabo, iyakwa Aroni nayo epo yali.

english: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.
translation: Mose nao epakubika inkonto shonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe mwi Tenti lya cipangano.

english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo Mose aingile mwi Tenti lya cipangano, elyo amona inkonto yakwa Aroni iya ŋanda ya bena Levi nailemuka. Tekulemuka kwekafye, lelo no kufumya ululembelya no kubalula, naitwala ne fitwalo fya alimonde.

english: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakubuula inkonto shonse pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ashifumisha panse ku bena Israeli. Nabo bashimona, elyo cila muntu epakubuulapo inkonto yakwe.

english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
