translation: Yawe aebele Aroni ati, “Iwe, abana bobe abaume na ba mu lupwa lwakwa wiso, mukaba no mulandu nga mwafulunganya fimo mu cifulo camushilo. Iwe pamo na bamwano abaume mweka mukaba no mulandu nga mwafulunganyapo fimo muli bushimapepo.

english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
translation: Mulelya ifi fintu nge fyamushilo icine cine. Kabili baumefye balingile ukulyako. Mufwile ukufimona nge fyamushilo.

english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
translation: “Fimbi nafyo pa fyabupe ne mituulo nakupeela nifi. Icilifye conse icapatulwapo pa mutuulo wakutambika uwa bena Israeli, napeela ici ku bana bobe abaume na banakashi, nge ciputulwa cenu ica lyonse. Umuntu onse uwa mu ŋanda yobe nga ali uwasangululwa, kuti alyako.

english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD.
translation: “Ine nakupeela amafuta ya miolifa ayawamisha no mwangashi uwawamisha ne ŋanu, ifisabo fyabo fyantanshi ifyo bapeela kuli Yawe.

english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
translation: Fyonsefye ifisabo fyantanshi ifyo batuula Yawe fili nokuba fyobe. Umuntu onse uwa mu ŋanda yobe nga ali uwasangululwa, kuti alyako.

english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.
translation: “Ifintufye fyonse ifyo balubwilile Yawe mu calo ca Israeli fyobe.

english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to the LORD, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.
translation: “Abana amabeli ne nama amabeli, ifyo batuula Yawe, fyobe. Lelo ukalubule ibeli lya mwana umwaume nelyo inama ishilume ishakowela.

english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.
translation: Abana bakulalubulwa ilyo baba no mweshifye umo pa mutengo wapimwa, indalama amashekeli yasano aya silifa ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo icafina amagera amakumi yabili.

english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Lelo amabeli ya ŋombe, impaanga nangu imbushi, shena teshakwesha kulubula, pantu shamushilo. Wakulakana umulopa washiko ku bulambo. Kabili amafuta yashiko wakulaocela pa bulambo, ngo mutuulo wa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.
translation: Iminofu yashiko yena yobe pamo nge cisao ca mutuulo wakutambika no mwendo wa ku kulyo.

english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.
translation: Ulete abena Levi banobe ukufuma mu luko lwa cikolwe cobe ukuba na iwe, pakuti balekwafwilishako ilyo iwe na bamwano muletumika pantanshi ye Tenti lya cipangano.

english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
translation: Yawe aebele Aroni ati, “Iwe tawakakwatemo cacishilano mu calo cabo. Nangufye icakaniko tawakalekwatako pakati kabo. Pantu ine wine, nine cakaniko cobe ne cacishilano cobe pakati ka bena Israeli.”

english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.
translation: Abena Levi ebakulabomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo kabili ebakulaba no mulandu pali conse icalubanamo. Ili e funde lya pe umukakonkanina inkulo. Tabakaikwatile fyacishilano mu Israeli iyoo.

english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”
translation: Lelo, ine napeela abena Levi nge cacishilano ifyapekumi ifyo abena Israeli batuula kuli Yawe. E mulandu wine nalandila pali bena nati, ‘Tabali nakukwata icacishilano mu Israeli.’ ”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.
translation: “Landa ku bena Levi ubebe auti, ilyo mwapokelela icekumi ukufuma ku bena Israeli ico namupeela nge cacishilano, mufwile ukubuulapo icapekumi no kutuula kuli Yawe.

english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
translation: Umutuulo wenu uli nokubafye nga filya shibulimi atuula iŋanu shipya bafumya pa lubansa batwila, nangu umwangashi upya untu bafumya mu cikamino.

english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give the LORD’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.
translation: Levi 27:28

english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
translation: Ifyabupe fyonse bamupeela, mufumyepo iciputulwa icawamisha kabili icamushilo icine cine ukuba icakwa Yawe.

english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.
translation: Bali nokukutumika, kabili bali nokubomba imilimo yonse iya mwi Tenti lya cipangano. Lelo tabali nakupalama ku fipe ifyaba mu cifulo camushilo, nangu ku bulambo. Nga bacita ifyo, ninshi bonse iwe na bena mukafwa.

english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Iwe na ba ŋanda yobe kuti mwalya ifyashalapo konse uko muli, pantu e fya malipilo yenu pa mulimo mubomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
translation: Tamwakabe no mulandu nga mwatuula iciputulwa iciwamishepo. Epakuti mwikasaalula mituulo yamushilo iya bena Israeli, kabili tamwakafwe iyoo.”

english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.
translation: Bakulabomba na imwe, kabili bali nokulasunga Itenti Lyakukumaninamo no kubomba imilimo yonse iye Tenti. Kabili umuntu nangu umo talingile kupalama mupepi napo muli.

english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Nine winefye nasala aba mu lupwa lwa bena Levi banobe ukufuma pa bena Israeli nge cabupe kuli iwe. Kabili nabalubwila kuli Yawe, pakuti balebomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
translation: Lelo iwe pamo na bana bobe abaume, nimwe mwakulabomba imilimo yonse iyabushimapepo iya ku bulambo na mukati ka cisalu cakucingako. Ala nine nakupeela umulimo wa bushimapepo ngo bupe. Umuntu umbi uwaisa no kupalama ku cifulo camushilo afwilefye ukwipaiwa.”

english: The LORD spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.
translation: Yawe aebele Aroni ati, “Nine wine nakupeela insambu shakumona pa fyamutuulo upeelwa kuli ine. Imituulo yamushilo yonse abena Israeli bantuula nakupeela pamo na bana bobe abaume ukuba e ciputulwa cenu ico bakulamwakanyako lyonse.

english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
translation: Pa mituulo yamushilo icine cine iyo mushocele pa mulilo, imwe mwakulakwatapo iciputulwa. Pa fyabupe fyonse ifyo bandetela ngo mutuulo wamushilo icine cine, cibe imituulo ya cabunga, nangu imituulo yakwelelwa pa bubifi, nangu imituulo yakufuta pa fyabubifi, fyena ifi fyobe pamo na bana bobe abaume.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati,

english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
translation: No muntu uwakusa imito ya musepela wa ŋombe, ali nokucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe, kabili nao wine ali uwakowela ukufikafye ne cungulo. Ili likaba lifunde lyamuyayaya kuli bonse abena Israeli na benafyalo abo bakalaikala nabo.”

english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
translation: “Uyo onse uwakumya ku citumbi ca muntu uuli onse, akaba uwakowela pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
translation: Afwile ukuisangulula na menshi pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu no bwalenga cine lubali. Elyo akaba uwasangululwa. Lelo nga taisangulwile pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu no bwalenga cine lubali, akabafye uwakowela.

english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.
translation: Bahi 9:13

english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
translation: “Ili e funde lili nokukonkwa umuntu nga afwila mwi tenti. Uyo onse uwaingila mwi tenti na onse uuli mwi tenti, ali nokuba uwakowela pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.
translation: Kabili icipe conse icili apabula icakukupikapo, ninshi naco cine cili nokuba icakowela.

english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
translation: Onse uuli kunse uwakumya ku muntu baipaila ku lupanga, nangu uwafwafye ku mfwa Lesa, nangu kuli onse uwakumya kwifupa lya muntu, nangu uluputa lwa muntu, akaba uwakowela pa nshiku cine lubali.

english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.
translation: Ku muntu uwakowela, babuulepo imito ya ulya musepela wa ŋombe uwakashika bacoca pakufuta pa fyabubifi babike mu nongo elyo betilepo amenshi ayasuma.

english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
translation: Elyo umuntu uwasangululwa abuule utumisambo twa hisopo, atumpike mu menshi no kusansa kwi tenti na ku fipe fyonse, na bantu bonse abalimo. Kabili afwile ukusansa no wakumishe kwifupa lya muntu, nangu ku muntu baipeyefye, nangu ku wafwile imfwa Lesa nangu ku luputa lwa muntu.

english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
translation: Umuntu wasanguluka euli nokusansa uwakowela amenshi pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu na pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali. Kanshi pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwine amusangulula. Elyo umuntu uulesangululwa afwile ukucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe no kowa mu menshi. Na mu cungulo cine ico ninshi asangululwa.

english: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.
translation: “Ici ecilefwaikwa mwifunde ilyo Yawe akonkomesha. Ebeni abena Israeli ukuleta umusepela wa ŋombe iyikota uwakashika uwabula akalema nangu akabi kabili uushatala ausendapo ikoli.

english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.
translation: “Lelo umuntu wakowela nga akaana ukuisangulula, uyo muntu wakutamfyafye mwibumba, pantu akowesha icifulo camushilo cakwa Yawe. Apo menshi yakumusangulula tayasanshilwe pa mubili wakwe, ninshi ashala uwakowela.

english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
translation: Ili e funde lyabo ilyamuyayaya. Umuntu uulesansa amenshi yakusangululwa, nao wine afwile ukucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe. Elyo na onse uwaikata muli ayo menshi yakusangulula, ali nokuba uwakowela ukufikafye ne cungulo.

english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
translation: Icintu conse ico uwakowela aikatako, ninshi naco cakowela. Kabili na onse uwakumyako akowela ukufikafye ne cungulo.”

english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.
translation: Mupeele kuli Eleasa shimapepo. Ufumishiwe kunse ya nkambi no kuipaya pa menso yakwe.

english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.
translation: Elyo Eleasa shimapepo atumpike umunwe mu mulopa wauko, aukane imiku cine lubali ya kuntanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
translation: Ilyo Eleasa shimapepo alemonako, boce uyo musepela wa ŋombe kumo kwine ne mpapa no munofu no mulopa ne fya mu mala.

english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
translation: Shimapepo abuule ulusansu lwa cimuti icalepesha ica keda no tumisambo twa hisopo ne nsalu iyakashika cee, elyo afipose apalepya umusepela wa ŋombe.

english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Panuma ya ifyo, shimapepo acape ifyakufwala fyakwe, elyo nokowa na pa mubili wakwe na menshi. Lyena elyo ali nokubwelela ku nkambi. Lelo ali nokuba uwakowela ukufikafye ne cungulo.

english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
translation: Uyo muntu uuleoca umusepela wa ŋombe nao ali nokucapa ifyakufwala fyakwe, elyo no kowa pa mubili na menshi, kabili nao wine ali nokuba uwakowela ukufikafye ne cungulo.

english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
translation: Kabili umuntu uwasangululwa akuse imito ya musepela wa ŋombe, no kuya ibika mu ncende iyasanguluka kunse ya nkambi. Eko yakulasungilwa, pakuti ulukuta lwa bena Israeli luleibika mu menshi yakubomfya pakusangulula ifintu. Ici e cakusangulwilako ububifi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
translation: Pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi wabubili, mu mwaka wacibili apo abena Israeli bafumine mu calo ca Egupto, Yawe aebele Mose mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo mu matololo ya Sinai ati,

english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
translation: Ku bana bakwa Yosefu ni aba. Ku luko lwakwa Efulemu, ni Elishama mwana Amiudi. Ku luko lwakwa Manase, ni Gamalieli mwana Pedasuri.

english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Benjamini, ni Abidani mwana Gideoni.

english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Dani, Aiesa mwana Amishadai.

english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Asheri, ni Pagieli mwana Okirani.

english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Gadi, ni Eliasafu mwana Deueli.

english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Naftali, ni Aila mwana Enani.”

english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
translation: Aba e baume basalilwe ukufuma ku lukuta, ebali intungulushi sha mikowa ya fikolwe. Ebali abakalamba ba ndupwa sha fikolwe fya bena Israeli.

english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
translation: Mose na Aroni babuulile amashina ya aba bantu basontelwe,

english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.
translation: elyo balonganya ulukuta lwa bena Israeli bonse pamo, pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi wabubili. Kabili balemba na bantu bonse mu mikowa na mu ndupwa shabo. Balembele na mashina ya baume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) no kucilapo,

english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
translation: pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose. Kanshi efyo Mose apendele abantu mu matololo ya Sinai.

english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,
translation: “Penda ulukuta lonse lwa bena Israeli mu mikowa na mu ndupwa shabo. Mulembe amashina ya baume bonse, umo umo,

english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Rubeni, ibeli lyakwa Yakobo, abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Rubeni, bali amakana amakumi yane na mutanda ne myanda isano (46,500).

english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Simeoni, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Simeoni, bali amakana amakumi yasano na pabula ne myanda itatu (59,300).

english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Gadi, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Gadi, bali amakana amakumi yane na yasano ne myanda mutanda na makumi yasano (45,650).

english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Yuda, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Yuda, bali amakana amakumi cine lubali na yane ne myanda mutanda (74,600).

english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Isaka, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Isaka, bali amakana amakumi yasano na yane ne myanda ine (54,400).

english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
translation: abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abengalinga ukulwa inkondo. Iwe na Aroni uli nokubapendela mu mpuka mu mpuka bonse abaume abena Israeli.

english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni, bali amakana amakumi yasano na cine lubali ne myanda ine (57,400).

english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Ku bana bakwa Yosefu ni aba. Mu luko lwakwa Efulemu, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Efulemu, bali amakana amakumi yane ne myanda isano (40,500).

english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Manase, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Manase, bali amakana amakumi yatatu na yabili ne myanda ibili (32,200).

english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Benjamini, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Benjamini, bali amakana amakumi yatatu na yasano ne myanda ine (35,400).

english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Dani, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Dani, bali amakana amakumi mutanda na yabili ne myanda cine lubali (62,700).

english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
translation: Kuli cila luko mukabuuleko umwaume umo umukalamba wa lupwa lwakwe uwakumwafwako.

english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Asheri, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Asheri, bali amakana amakumi yane na limo ne myanda isano (41,500).

english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Naftali, bapendele abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo, babalemba amashina umo umo ukulingana ne mikowa ne ndupwa shabo.

english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
translation: Mu luko lwakwa Naftali, bali amakana amakumi yasano na yatatu ne myanda ine (53,400).

english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.
translation: Kanshi efyo bali abaume Mose na Aroni balembele. Babombele pamo ne ntungulushi sha bena Israeli ikumi limo na babili (12) ishaiminineko indupwa shashiko.

english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—
translation: Abena Israeli bonse pamo abaume abalembelwe mu ndupwa, abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abalingile ukulwa inkondo,

english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
translation: bonse pamo bali amakana imyanda mutanda na itatu ne myanda isano na makumi yasano (603,550).

english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.
translation: Nomba aba mu luko lwa bena Levi tabapendelwe pamo ne nko shimbi iyoo.

english: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Pantu Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
translation: “Wikapendelako uluko lwakwa Levi nangu ukusansha ku mpendwa ya nko shimbi isha bena Israeli.

english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
translation: Na mashina ya baume abakumwafwilishako ni aya. Ku luko lwakwa Rubeni, ni Elisuri mwana Shedeuri.

english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
translation: Lelo, abena Levi bena ubapeele umulimo wakusunga Itenti lya cipangano, kumo kwine ne fibombelo ne fipe fyonse ifyabamo. Bali nokulalisenda pamo ne fibombelo fyaliko no kulalisunga, kabili bakalacita ne nkambi shabo ukushinguluka Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
translation: Ilyo lyonse mwasesha inkambi, abena Levi ebakalapangulula Itenti lyakwa Lesa, kabili ebakalalimika ilyo mwaya cita inkambi kumbi. Uyo onse uushili mwina Levi uwapalamina kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa wena akepaiwefye.

english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
translation: Abena Israeli bakemike amatenti yabo mu mpuka mu mpuka, no muntu onse ali nokuba mwibumba lya mpuka ya luko lwakwe, apali uluunga lwakwe.

english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
translation: Lelo abena Levi bena bali nokwimika amatenti yabo ukushinguluka Itenti lya cipangano, pakuti balelicingilila kabili pakuti ubukali tabuponene pa lukuta lwa bena Israeli. Abena Levi ebali no mulimo wakusunga Itenti lya cipangano pa bena Israeli.”

english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli bacitile fyonse ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Simeoni, ni Shelumieli umwana wakwa Sulishadai.

english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Yuda, ni Nashoni mwana Aminadabu.

english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Isaka, ni Netaneli mwana Suali.

english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
translation: Ku luko lwakwa Sebuloni, ni Eliabu mwana Eloni.

english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
translation: Ulukuta lonse lwa bena Israeli lwafikile mu matololo ya Sini mu mweshi wantanshi, bakuula ne nkambi pa Kadeshi epo baikala. Kulya kwine ekwafwila na Miriamu no kushiikwa eko ashiikwa.

english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
translation: Mose na Aroni balonganike ibumba pantanshi ya cilibwe, elyo Mose abeba ati, “Umfweni imwe mwe bacisanguka! Bushe tumufumishe amenshi mu cilibwe ici?”

english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.
translation: Elyo Mose aimya inkonto mu mulu no kuma pa cilibwe imiku ibili. Amenshi yafumfumuka, no lukuta lwalanwa pamo ne fitekwa fyabo.

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
translation: Nomba Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati, “Pantu tamwacincetekela ukufikapo no kuncindika ngo wamushilo pa cinso ca bena Israeli, imwe tamwakengishe ibumba ili mu calo ico nabalaya ukubapeela.”

english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
translation: Aya e menshi ya ku Meriba, ku ncende kulya abena Israeli bailishenye pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kulya nao ailangile ukuti wamushilo pakati kabo.

english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
translation: Mose atumine inkombe ku mfumu ya bena Edomu, ukufuma ku Kadeshi, ukuya sosa ati, “Ifi efyo munonko Israeli asosa. Aleti mwalishibafye bwino amacushi yonse ayo twapitamo.

english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
translation: Ifikolwe fyesu fyaile ku Egupto uko twaikele imyaka iyingi. Abena Egupto balecusha ifikolwe fyesu, nefwe bene baletucusha.

english: When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.
translation: Ilyo na ifwe twakuutile kuli Yawe, nao alyumfwile inkuuta shesu, no kututumina malaika uwakutufumya mu Egupto. Nomba tuli pano pa Kadeshi, umusumba waba mu mupaka wa calo cobe.

english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”
translation: Twapapata tusuminisheni tupitekofye mu calo cenu. Ifwe tatwakapite mu filime, nangu mu mabala ya ŋanu, nangu ukunwa amenshi mu cishima icili conse. Tukakonkafye umusebo wa mfumu, ukwabula ukupasukila lwa ku kulyo nangufye lwa ku kuso mpaka tukafume mu calo cenu.”

english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
translation: Elyo Edomu abasuka ati, “Tamuli nakupita muno iyoo! Nga mwaesha ukupitamo, ifwe tukema ne fita no kwisa mulwisha ku lupanga.”

english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
translation: Kabili abena Israeli bayaswike abati, “Ala mukwai ifwe tukakonkafye umusebo ukalamba, elyo ifwe nangu ifitekwa fyesu nga fyanwa amenshi yenu mu fishima, ifwe bene ala ninshi tukalipila. Ico tulelombakofye kupita mu calo cenu pa makasa, te cimbi iyoo.”

english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
translation: Nomba kulya kuntu takwali menshi yakunwa. Elyo ulukuta lwalongana mukuilishanya pali Mose na Aroni.

english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
translation: Kabili bayasuka abati, “Tamuli nakupita muno iyoo!” Kanshi Edomu epakubemina ne bumba lya fita ilikalamba kabili ifyamaka nganshi.

english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
translation: Ico Edomu akaanya ukusuminisha Israeli ukupita mu calo cakwe, Israeli ayalulukako ukufuma kuli bena.

english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
translation: Ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonsefye lwalifumine mu musumba wa Kadeshi no kuya ku lupili lwa Hori.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni pa lupili lwa Hori, mupepi no mupaka wa Edomu, ati,

english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
translation: “Aroni ali nokuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Takengile mu calo napeela abena Israeli, apo bonse imwe babili mwasangukile icebo candi ku menshi ya Meriba.

english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
translation: Kanshi senda Aroni no mwana wakwe Eleasa, muye nabo pa mulu wa lupili lwa Hori.

english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”
translation: Uye fuula Aroni ifyakufwala fya bushimapepo no kufifwika ku mwana wakwe umwaume Eleasa, pantu Aroni ali nokuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyakwe. Kabili akafwila kulya kwine.”

english: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
translation: Mose nao acita ifyo Yawe amukonkomeshe. Baya na pa mulu wa lupili lwa Hori, ninshi no lukuta lonse lulemonako.

english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
translation: Awe Mose afuula Aroni ifyakufwala fya bushimapepo, afwika no mwana wakwe umwaume Eleasa. Palya pene pa mulu wa lupili epo Aroni afwila no kufwila. Elyo Mose na Eleasa batentemuka ulupili bafumako.

english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
translation: Ukuf 29:29

english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!
translation: Awe balaumanya Mose abati, “Kanshi nga caliwemepo ukufwila pamo na bamunyinefwe abafwile pa cinso cakwa Yawe!

english: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
translation: Bushe cinshi mwaletele ibumba lya bantu bakwa Yawe muno mu matololo, ukuti emo ifwe pamo ne fitekwa fyesu twise tufwile?

english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
translation: Bushe cinshi mwatufumisha mu calo ca Egupto no kutuleta muli ino ncende iyabipisha ifi? Muno tamwaba ŋanu na makunyu ne fitwalo fya myangashi na mateke. Kabili na menshi yakunwa nayo tamuli!”

english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.
translation: Elyo Mose na Aroni epakufuma pebumba baya pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, bawa panshi ubukupeme, elyo ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bwamonekela kuli bena.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
translation: “Buula inkonto, iwe na munonko Aroni mulonganike no lukuta lonse pamo. Pa menso yabo ulande ku cilibwe cilya, naco calafumfumuna amenshi. Walafumya amenshi mu cilibwe pakuti ulukuta lunwe pamo ne fitekwa fyabo.”

english: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakubuula inkonto iyali pa cinso cakwa Yawe ngefyo amukonkomeshe.

english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
translation: Ilyo imfumu ya bena Kenani iya ku Aradi, iyaleikala mu matololo ya Negebu, yaumfwile ukuti abena Israeli baleisa mu musebo walola ku Atarimu, yaya balwisha, yaikatapo na bamo bunkole.

english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
translation: Abena Israeli bakonkenyepo ulwendo, baya cita inkambi ku Oboti.

english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.
translation: Ilintu bafuma ku Oboti, baya cita inkambi mu Iye Abarimu, mu matololo yalolenkana na Moabu lwa ku kabanga.

english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
translation: Ukufuma palya baya cita inkambi mwishika lya Seredi.

english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
translation: Ilyo bafumapo, kabili bayacita inkambi lubali lwa kwishilya lya Alinoni, mu matololo yabela mu mupaka wa calo ca bena Amoli. Alinoni e mupaka wa Moabu, waba pakati ka Moabu ne calo ca bena Amoli.

english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
translation: Yoani 3:14

english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
translation: na mu mikonko ya mimana, iyalola ku musumba wa Ari, ukulola na ku mupaka wa Moabu.”

english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
translation: Kabili ukufuma apo balitwalilile basuka bafika na ku Bere, pa cishima apo Yawe aebele Mose ukuti, “Longanika abantu pamo, nalabapeela amenshi.”

english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
translation: Elyo abena Israeli baimbile ulwimbo ulu abati,

english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
translation: Icishima icaimbwa na bashamfumu,

english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
translation: Ukufuma ku Matana baya ku Nalieli, kabili ukufuma ku Nalieli baya na ku Bamoti.

english: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”
translation: Elyo abena Israeli balaile kuli Yawe abati, “Nga wapeela aba bantu mu minwe yesu, na ifwe tukapeela imisumba yabo kukonaulwa .”

english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
translation: Kabili ilyo bafuma ku Bamoti baya kwishika lya Moabu, uko ulupili lwa Pisiga lwalolenkana na matololo.

english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
translation: Abena Israeli batumine inkombe ku mfumu Sihoni iya bena Amoli abati,

english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”
translation: “Twapapata tusuminisheni tupitekofye mu calo cenu. Tatwakapasukile nangu kumo, kabili tatwakapite mu filime, nangu mu mabala ya ŋanu, nangu ukunwa amenshi mu cishima icili conse. Tukakonkafye umusebo wa mfumu, mpaka tukafume mu calo cenu.”

english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
translation: Lelo Sihoni akaana ukusuminisha abena Israeli ukupita mu calo cakwe. Alonganya ifita fyakwe fyonse, aya na mu matololo kukulwisha abena Israeli. Ilyo afika ku Yahasi, alwisha na bena Israeli.

english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
translation: Lelo abena Israeli bamulwisha ku lupanga no kumupokolola icalo ukutendekela ku mumana wa Alinoni ukufikafye na ku Yaboku, ukupelelafye na ku mupaka wa calo ca bena Amoni, pantu umupaka wa calo ca bena Amoni wali uwacingililwako.

english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
translation: Abena Israeli bapoka imisumba yonse iya bena Amoli, kumo kwine na Heshiboni ne mishi yonse iya mumbali, no kwikala emo balaikala.

english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
translation: Heshiboni wali musumba wa mfumu Sihoni iya bena Amoli, iyalwishishe imfumu ya bena Moabu no kupoka icalo caiko conse ukufika na ku Alinoni.

english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
translation: E mulandu wine iŋomba shimbila ashiti,

english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
translation: Umulilo wafuma mu Heshiboni,

english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
translation: Owe, akalanda kuli Moabu!

english: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
translation: Yawe abomfwa, abapeela na bena Kenani mu minwe yabo. Nabo abena Israeli balofeshe abena Kenani no konaula imisumba yabo. Eico icifulo ici cainikwa ne shina lya Homa.

english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
translation: Nomba twapoka ubufumu bwabo,

english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli baikele mu calo ca bena Amoli.

english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
translation: Panuma elyo Mose atumine inengu ku Yaseri. Abena Israeli bapokolwele imishi ya mumbali, no kufulumunamo abena Amoli abaleikalamo.

english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
translation: Elyo kabili abena Israeli bayaluluka, balaya no musebo walola ku Bashani. Kanshi Ogi imfumu ya ku Bashani ne fita fyaiko fyonse, yaya kukubakumanya mukubalwisha ku Edurei.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Wimutiina Ogi. Pantu nimupeela mu minwe yobe, kumo kwine ne fita fyakwe fyonse pamo ne calo cakwe cine. Umucite filya wacitile Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli, uwaleteeka mu Heshiboni.”

english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
translation: Abena Israeli baipaya Ogi na bana bakwe abaume, ne fita fyakwe fyonse. Takwapuswike nangu umo. Elyo bapoka ne calo cakwe.

english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
translation: Abena Israeli bafumine ku lupili lwa Hori, balaya inshila yaya kuli Bemba Wakashika pakuti balambe icalo ca Edomu. Nomba abantu basuka batendwa,

english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”
translation: balaisosha kuli Lesa na Mose abati, “Cinshi mwatufumisha mu Egupto, pakuti twise tufwile mu matololo? Tamwaba mukate! Tamwaba na menshi yene! Kabili tatulefwaya ici cakulya cabuwelewele!”

english: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
translation: Elyo Yawe abatumina insoka shabusungu, nasho shabasumaula, na bena Israeli abengi bafwa.

english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.
translation: Elyo abantu baisa kuli Mose balamweba abati, “Twalibifishe ilyo twailishenye kuli Yawe na kuli iwe. Kanshi iwe papata kuli Yawe pakuti afumye insoka kuli ifwe.” Mose nao epakupapatilako abantu kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Panga insoka ya mukuba no kuibika pa cimuti, pakuti onse uwasumwa nga aloleshapo aba no bumi.”

english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
translation: Kol 10:9

english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bakonkenyepo ulwendo lwabo baya ku mawanga ya ku Moabu, bacitako inkambi ukukonka ululamba lwa mumana wa Yordani, ukulolenkana na Yeriko.

english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
translation: Nao ayasuka Lesa ati, “Balaki mwana Sipori, imfumu ya ku Moabu euntumine amashiwi yakuti,

english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”
translation: Yuda 1:11

english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
translation: Lelo Lesa aeba Balamu ati, “Iwe wiesha kuya nabo. Kabili tecakwesha ukutipwila abo bantu pantu balipaalwa.”

english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”
translation: Ulucelo lwakonkapo Balamu ashibuka, aya eba intungulushi shakwa Balaki ati, “Bwekelenimo ku calo cenu, pantu Yawe nandesha ukuti tuleya bonse.”

english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
translation: Kanshi intungulushi sha bena Moabu epakubwelelamo, shaya eba Balaki ashiti, “Balamu nakaana ukwisa na ifwe.”

english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.
They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
translation: Shaya kuli Balamu, shamweba ashiti, “Ifi efyo Balaki mwana Sipori asosa aleti, wileka nangu cimo cikuleshe ukwisa kuli ine.

english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”
translation: Pantu nkakulambula ifikankala, kabili nkacita ne fintu fyonse ukanjeba. Napapata isa undapishisheko aba bantu.”

english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
translation: Lelo Balamu abasuka ati, “Nangufye Balaki engampeela isano lyakwe ilyaisulamo silifa na golide, teti ncite icintu nelyo cimo, icikulu nangu icinono, ukucila pafyo Yawe Lesa wandi ankonkomesha.

english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”
translation: Nomba na imwe bene sendameni ngefyo abanenu bacitile, pakuti ŋumfwilepo fimbi ifyo Yawe alenjeba.”

english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
translation: Nomba Balaki mwana Sipori amona ifyo abena Israeli bacitile abena Amoli.

english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”
translation: Bulya bushiku bwine, Yawe aishile kuli Balamu amweba ati, “Apo aba bantu beshile mukukwita, ima kabiye nabo, lelo ulecitafye ifyo nakweba.”

english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
translation: Ulucelo Balamu anina punda wakwe, akonka ne ntungulushi sha bena Moabu.

english: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
translation: Lelo Lesa alifulilwe nganshi ico akonkele. Na malaika wakwa Yawe aisa iminina mu musebo pakuti amuleshe ukupita. Balamu aninine pali punda wakwe, na babomfi bakwe babili nabamushindika.

english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
translation: Cilyafye punda amona malaika wakwa Yawe eminine mu musebo, ninshi naikata ulupanga mu minwe, afuma mu musebo no kuya mu mpanga. Balamu ena alauma punda pakuti abwelele pa musebo.

english: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe aya iminina apo inshila yacepele, pakati ka mabala ya myangashi ayali na malinga ya mabwe konse konse.

english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
translation: Ilyo punda amona malaika wakwa Yawe, aikusa kwilinga, afyenenkesha no lukasa lwakwa Balamu kwilinga. Balamu nao abwekeshapo ukuma punda.

english: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe aselela pantanshi apacepeshe, apashali ne ncende ya kwalukilapo ku kulyo nangu ku kuso.

english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
translation: Ilyo punda amona malaika wakwa Yawe, alala panshi mwisamba lyakwa Balamu. Nao Balamu afulwa nganshi, alafupaula punda ne nkonto yakwe.

english: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakwisula akanwa kakwa punda, nao asosa kuli Balamu ati, “Bushe cinshi ico ine nkucitile pakuti ungume ifi imiku itatu?”

english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
translation: Balamu epakwasuka punda ati, “Pantu iwe ulentumfya! Nkwata ulupanga mu minwe yandi nga nakwipaya nombalinefye.”

english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
translation: Abena Moabu baikatwa no mwenso ukalamba pantu abena Israeli balifulishe. Kanshi abena Moabu balatiina abena Israeli nganshi.

english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”
translation: Punda aeba Balamu ati, “Ine bushe nshili punda obe, uo iwe uninapo ukushinta na lelo? Bushe naliba mu musango wakucitapo ifi nacita kuli iwe?” Nao atile, “Iyoo.”

english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
translation: Elyo Yawe ashibula Balamu amenso no kuleka amone. Elyo amona malaika wakwa Yawe naiminina mu musebo no lupanga mu minwe. Balamu akontama, awa na panshi ubukupeme.

english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
translation: Malaika wakwa Yawe aipusha Balamu ati, “Bushe cinshi ico waumina ifi punda obe imiku itatu? Ine nine naisa kuno kukukulesha ukuya, pantu inshila yobe tailungeme pa cinso candi.

english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
translation: Punda ena acimona, ayaluluka mukutiina ine imiku yonse iyi itatu. Akaana kwaluluka, ine cine cine nga ninkwipaya, punda wena nga nashala.”

english: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”
translation: Balamu aeba malaika wakwa Yawe ati, “Ine nimbifya. Nshacishiba ukuti nimwe mwiminine mu musebo pakundesha ukuya. Nomba imwe nga tamulefwaya ukuti njeko, nalabwelelamofye.”

english: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
translation: Malaika wakwa Yawe aeba Balamu ati, “Akuya na bantu, nomba wikasosa kantu nelyo kamo, kanofye ico nakweba ukusosa.” Awe Balamu epakuya ne ntungulushi shakwa Balaki isho amutumine.

english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
translation: Ilyo Balaki aumfwile ukuti Balamu ali mu nshila, aima amukonkela ku musumba wa bena Moabu, uwabela mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Alinoni, pa mpela ya mupaka wa calo cakwe.

english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
translation: Balaki aeba Balamu ati, “Bushe nshatumine amashiwi ayakukwita pakuti wise bwangu? Cinshi tawaishile uko ndi? Bushe cine cine teti nkulambule?”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
translation: Balamu amwasuka ati, “Ala kwena nomba ninjisa. Bushe kuti nalandafye icili conse? Ine nakulalandafye ifyo Lesa anjeba ukulanda.”

english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
translation: Elyo Balamu na Balaki baima baya ku musumba wa Kiriati Husoti.

english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
translation: Abena Moabu baeba intungulushi sha bena Midiani abati, “Uyu cinkupiti wa bantu, alaonaula ifintu fyonse ifyo twakwata, nga filya iŋombe ilume ifulaula icani mu mpanga.” Kanshi Balaki mwana Sipori uwali mfumu ya bena Moabu pa nshita ilya,

english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
translation: Kanshi eko Balaki alekela amalambo ya ŋombe ne mpaanga, apeelako na Balamu ne ntungulushi isho ali nasho.

english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.
translation: Bwaisaca ulucelo Balaki alisendele Balamu ku Bamoti Baali, uko amwene bamo abena Israeli.

english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
translation: atuma inkombe shakuya ita Balamu mwana Beori uwaleikala mu Peto, mupepi no mumana wa Yufurate, uko Balamu afyalilwe. Balaki ati, “Umutundu wa bantu nawisa ukufuma ku Egupto, ukumene mpanga yonse pano calo lino kabili bekele mupepi na ine.

english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”
translation: Nomba isa undapishisheko aba bantu pantu nabancila amaka. Lyena nalimo ine kuti nabacimfya no kubafulumuna mu calo. Pantu ine nalishiba ukuti abantu abo iwe wapaala ninshi bapaalwa, nabo iwe walapisha ninshi balapishiwa.”

english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
translation: Intungulushi sha bena Moabu na bena Midiani shaima, shaya nashisenda ne fyakulipila pakubuka. Ilyo shafika kuli Balamu, shamweba ifyo Balaki asosele.

english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
translation: Imp 31:8

english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”
translation: Lesa aishile kuli Balamu no kumwipusha ati, “Bushe aba bantu uli nabo ni bani?”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
translation: Elyo Balamu asosele ati, “Nkuulileni ifibumbili fya malambo pano cine lubali no kupekanya iŋombe ishilume cine lubali, na basukusuku nabo cine lubali.”

english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
translation: Nani engapenda ulukungu lwakwa Yakobo?

english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
translation: Elyo Balaki aeba Balamu ati, “Cinshi iwe wancitila ine? Ico nkwitile kwisa lapisha abalwani bandi, lelo iwe taucitile nangu cimo. Ico wacitafye kubapaala epela!”

english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”
translation: Balamu ayasuka ati, “Ine ndi nokulandafye ifyo Yawe anjeba ukulanda.”

english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
translation: Kanshi Balaki atile kuli Balamu, “Twende bonse ku ncende imbi uko walaya bamwena. Kanshi walamonafye abanono te bonse iyoo. Kulya kwine eko uleya bandapishishako.”

english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
translation: Amusenda kwibala lya Sofimu, pa mulu wa lupili lwa Pisiga. Akuulapo ne fibumbili fya malambo cine lubali, elyo pali cila bulambo atuulapo cilume wa ŋombe umo na sukusuku umo.

english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
translation: Kabili Balamu aeba Balaki ati, “Imininina pano pene mupepi no mutuulo obe uwe lambo lyakoca, ilyo naya mukumonana na Yawe palya.”

english: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
translation: Yawe bakumene na Balamu, amufunda amashiwi ayakuti aye alande, elyo amweba nokuti, “Bwelelamo kuli Balaki pakuti uye mweba aya mashiwi.”

english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”
translation: Balamu abwelelemo, asanga Balaki ninshi eminine mupepi no mutuulo wakwe uwe lambo lyakoca ne ntungulushi sha bena Moabu. Balaki aipusha Balamu ati, “Finshi Yawe acilanda?”

english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
translation: Elyo Balamu alanda ubusesemo bwakwe,

english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
translation: Lesa te muntu uwakuti abepe,

english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
translation: Balaki acita ifyo Balamu amwebele, elyo bonse babili baleka ilambo lya ŋombe imo imo na sukusuku umo umo pali cila bulambo.

english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
translation: Ine nimpokelela icebo cakupaala.

english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
translation: Tamwenemo ishamo muli Yakobo,

english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
translation: Lesa ewabafumya mu calo ca Egupto.

english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
translation: Takuli bwanga bwakulowa Yakobo,

english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
translation: Aba bantu bema nge nkalamo ikota,

english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
translation: Elyo Balaki aebele Balamu ati, “Cisuma wibalapisha, nangu ukubapaala iyoo!”

english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”
translation: Balamu nao ayasuka ati, “Bushe nshakwebele ukuti ine ndi nokucitafye ifyo Yawe asosa?”

english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
translation: Elyo Balaki aebele Balamu ati, “Isa, leka nkutwale ku ncende imbi. Nalimo kwena calasansamusha Lesa pakuti akusuminishe ukundapishishako abena Israeli ukufuma kuli ilya ncende.”

english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
translation: Elyo Balaki asenda Balamu amutwala pa mulu wa lupili lwa Peori, ukulungatanafye ne ciswebebe.

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
translation: Balamu aeba Balaki ati, “Nkuulilako ifibumbili fya malambo cine lubali pano pene, mpekanishishako ne ŋombe ishilume cine lubali na basukusuku nabo cine lubali.”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
translation: Elyo Balamu aeba Balaki ati, “Iminina pano pene mupepi no mutuulo obe uwe lambo lyakoca, ine nalabala mfumepo. Limbi Yawe alefwaya ukunkumanya. Fyonse ifyo aleya njeba ndeisa kwebako.” Kanshi Balamu epakuya pa lupili apashali nelyo kamo.

english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
translation: Balaki nao acitila umo mwine Balamu asosele. Atuula ilambo lya ŋombe ilume imo na sukusuku umo pali cila bulambo.

english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
translation: Lesa akumana na Balamu, elyo Balamu amweba ati, “Nimpekanya ifibumbili fya malambo cine lubali, na pali cila bulambo nintuulapo ilambo lya ŋombe imo na sukusuku umo.”

english: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
translation: Yawe afunda Balamu amashiwi yakuti aye alande, elyo amweba nokuti, “Bwelelamo kuli Balaki pakuti uye mweba aya mashiwi.”

english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
translation: Balamu abwelela kuli Balaki, amusanga naiminina mupepi no mutuulo wakwe uwe lambo lyakoca ne ntungulushi sha bena Moabu shonse.

english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
translation: Balamu epakutampa ukusesema ati,

english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?
translation: Nga ine kuti nalapisha shani abo Lesa ashalapisha?

english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
translation: Pa mulu wa mpili apatali ndebamona,

english: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
translation: Nomba ilyo Balamu amwene ukuti nacisekesha Yawe ukuti apaale Israeli, taile kukufwaya ukubuka nga fintu acitile intanshi. Lelo alungamafye ku ciswebebe.

english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
translation: Elyo Balaki afulilwe Balamu. Aumanya indupi, aeba Balamu ati, “Nakwitile ukwisa lapisha abalwani bandi, lelo iwe ulebapaalafye uyu e muku walenga butatu.

english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”
translation: Nombalinefye akuya kumobe! Ine natile nkakulambula bwino, lelo Yawe ewakutanisha icilambu.”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
translation: Balamu ayasuka Balaki ati, “Bushe nshaebele inkombe watumine nati,

english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?
translation: ‘Nangufye Balaki engampeela isano lyakwe ilyaisulamo silifa na golide, ine teti ncite icintu nelyo cimo palwandi, icisuma nelyo icibi, icakucila peshiwi lyakwa Yawe. Ine mfwile ukulandafye ifyo Yawe alanda.’”

english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
translation: “Nomba nalabwelelamo ku bantu bandi, lelo isa, leka nkusokeko ifyo abena Israeli bali nokucita abantu bobe mu nshiku ishileisa.”

english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
translation: Elyo Balamu alanda ubusesemo bwakwe ati,

english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
translation: ubusesemo bwa muntu uumfwa amashiwi yakwa Lesa,

english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
translation: Ndemumona, lelo te nomba,

english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
translation: Edomu akacimfiwa,

english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
translation: Kateka akafuma muli Yakobo

english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
translation: Balamu ainuna amenso no kumona abena Israeli uko bacitile inkambi shabo mu luko mu luko. Elyo Umupashi wakwa Lesa waisa pali ena.

english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
translation: Kabili Balamu amona Amaleki, elyo alanda ubusesemo bwakwe ati,

english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
translation: Elyo Balamu amona abena Keni no kulanda ubusesemo bwakwe ati,

english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
translation: Lelo mwe bena Keni muli nokonaulwa ilyo

english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
translation: Kabili akonkanyapo ukulanda ubusesemo bwakwe ati,

english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
translation: Amato yakafuma ku lulamba lwa Kitimu,

english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
translation: Balamu aima abwelelamo na kumwakwe, na Balaki nao aya no kuya.

english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
translation: Kabili alanda ubusesemo bwakwe ati,

english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
translation: Ubusesemo bwa muntu uumfwa amashiwi yakwa Lesa,

english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
translation: Yangu ifyo amatenti yobe yawama we Yakobo,

english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
translation: Fyaba nga mashika ayatantalila,

english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
translation: Amenshi yakapongoloka ukufuma mu mbeketi shabo.

english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
translation: Lesa ewabafumya mu calo ca Egupto.

english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
translation: Uyu mutundu waba nge nkalamo ilume iyitambala no kulala,

english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
translation: Ilyo abena Israeli baikele mu Shitimu, abaume bamo batendeke ukulacita ubulalelale na banakashi abena Moabu,

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
translation: “Fineasi umwana mwaume wakwa Eleasa umwana mwaume wakwa Aroni shimapepo, atalusha ubukali bwandi pa bena Israeli. Pantu napamfiwa nga ne mwine wine pakuncindika pa kati kabo, epakuti mu kupamfiwa kwandi nibalofya.

english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
translation: Eico kanshi mwebeni ukuti ine nalapangana nankwe icipangano camutende.

english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
translation: Umwine pamo na ba mu lupwa lwakwe abakamukonkapo, bakakwata icipangano cakuba bashimapepo ba pe na pe, pantu alipamfiwe ukucindika Lesa wakwe, kabili ewafutila abena Israeli pa bubifi bwabo.”

english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
translation: Ishina lya mwina Israeli baipeye pamo no mwanakashi umwina Midiani, ni Simuri mwana Salu, intungulushi ya mu lupwa lwakwa Simeoni.

english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
translation: Kabili no mwanakashi umwina Midiani untu bakomene nao ali ni Kosibi mwana Suli, uwali intungulushi imo mu lupwa lwa bena Midiani.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;
translation: “Lwisheni abena Midiani nga balwani benu no kubepaya.

english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
translation: Pantu nabo bamucitile nga balwani benu pakumubepa pa fyali kuno ku Peori, pa mulandu wakwa nkashi yabo Kosibi, umwana umwanakashi wa ntungulushi ya bena Midiani, uo baipeye ilyo kwali icikuko kuno ku Peori.”

english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
translation: abaleita abaume ku malambo ayo baletuula imilungu yabo. Abantu balelyako ifyelambo, balepepako ne milungu.

english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli nabo epakuwila mukupepa Baali wa ku Peori. Yawe epakufulilwa Israeli.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”
translation: Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Buula intungulushi shonse isha aba bantu, ushipaye pa lwalala pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pakuti icipyu icikali icakwa Yawe cifume pa bena Israeli.”

english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
translation: Mose aeba abapingushi ba mu Israeli ati, “Umupingushi onse ali nokwipaya abo bonse abaume bakwe abailundanya mukupepa Baali wa ku Peori.”

english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo umwina Israeli umwaume aishile no mwanakashi umwina Midiani ku lupwa lwakwe, ninshi Mose no lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli balelila pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
translation: Ilyo Fineasi umwana umwaume wakwa Eleasa umwana umwaume uwakwa Aroni shimapepo amona ifi, ena afuma pa lukuta, abuula ifumo mu minwe yakwe,

english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
translation: akonka no mwina Israeli mwi tenti. Abapulinkanya ifumo bonse babili, lyapula mu mwaume umwina Israeli lyalasa no mwanakashi. Awe apopene ne cikuko caleka no kuleka icaleipaya abena Israeli.

english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
translation: Lelo abafwile ku cikuko bali amakana amakumi yabili na yane (24,000).

english: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
translation: Panuma ya cikuko Yawe aebele Mose na Eleasa umwana mwaume wakwa Aroni shimapepo ati,

english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
