translation: Umushili waliceneme no kubamina pamo pene na Kora, na bambi abalemukonka bene bafwile ilyo umulilo waipeye abantu imyanda ibili na makumi yasano (250). Kabili aba bantu bali cilangililo cakubasoka.

english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
translation: Lelo bamwana Kora tabafwile bonse iyoo.

english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Simeoni, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Nemueli mwali abena Nemueli. Muli Yamini mwali abena Yamini. Muli Yakini mwali abena Yakini.

english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
translation: Muli Sera mwali abena Sera. Muli Shauli mwali abena Shauli.

english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Simeoni, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yabili na yabili ne myanda ibili (22,200).

english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Gadi, mu ndupwa bali nifi. Muli Sefoni mwali abena Sefoni. Muli Hagi mwali abena Hagi. Muli Shuni mwali abena Shuni.

english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
translation: Muli Osini mwali abena Osini. Muli Eli mwali abena Eli.

english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
translation: Muli Arodi mwali abena Arodi. Muli Areli mwali abena Areli.

english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Gadi, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yane ne myanda isano (40,500).

english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
translation: Ere na Onani bali abana abaume abakwa Yuda, lelo bafwilile mu calo ca Kenani.

english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
translation: “Pendeni ulukuta lwa bena Israeli lonse mu ndupwa shabo. Bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, abengalinga ukuba ifita mu Israeli.”

english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Yuda mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Shela mwali abena Shela. Muli Peresi mwali abena Peresi. Muli Sera mwali abena Sera.

english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Peresi bali nifi. Muli Hesroni mwali abena Hesroni. Muli Hamuli mwali abena Hamuli.

english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Isaka, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Tola mwali abena Tola. Muli Pua mwali abena Pua.

english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
translation: Muli Yashubu mwali abena Yashubu. Muli Shimuroni mwali abena Shimuroni.

english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Isaka, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi mutanda na yane ne myanda itatu (64,300).

english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Seredi mwali abena Seredi. Muli Eloni mwali abena Eloni. Muli Yaleeli mwali abena Yaleeli.

english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi mutanda ne myanda isano (60,500).

english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
translation: Abana bakwa Yosefu, mu ndupwa shabo bali ni Manase na Efulemu.

english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Manase mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Makiri mwali abena Makiri. (Makiri e wishi wakwa Gileadi). Muli Gileadi mwali abena Gileadi.

english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
translation: Kanshi Mose na Eleasa shimapepo balanda nabo mu mawanga ya Moabu mupepi na Yordani, apalungatana na Yeriko, abati,

english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Gileadi bali nifi. Muli Ieseri mwali abena Ieseri. Muli Heleki mwali abena Heleki.

english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
translation: Muli Asirieli mwali abena Asirieli. Muli Shekemu mwali abena Shekemu.

english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
translation: Muli Shemida mwali abena Shemida. Muli Heferi mwali abena Heferi.

english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translation: (Selofeadi mwana Heferi takwete abana abaume, akwetefye abana abanakashi, amashina yabo ni Mala, Noa, Hogila, Milika na Tirisa).

english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Manase, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yasano na yabili ne myanda cine lubali (52,700).

english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Efulemu mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Shutela mwali abena Shutela. Muli Bekeri mwali abena Bekeri. Muli Tahani mwali abena Tahani.

english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Shutela bali nifi. Muli Erani mwali abena Erani.

english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Efulemu, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yatatu na yabili ne myanda isano (32,500). Aba e ba mu lupwa lwakwa Yosefu mu mikowa yabo.

english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Benjamini, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Bela mwali abena Bela. Muli Ashibeli mwali abena Ashibeli. Muli Ailamu mwali abena Ailamu.

english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
translation: Muli Shufamu mwali abena Shufamu. Muli Hufamu mwali abena Hufamu.

english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.
translation: “Pendeni abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili nangu ukucilapo, pamo ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.”

english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Bela, ukupitila muli Adi na Namani bali nifi. Muli Adi mwali abena Adi. Muli Namani mwali abena Namani.

english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Benjamini, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yane na yasano ne myanda mutanda (45,600).

english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Dani, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Shuhamu mwali abena Shuhamu. Ishi e ndupwa shakwa Dani.

english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
translation: Bonse bali abena Shuhamu, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi mutanda na yane ne myanda ine (64,400).

english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Asheri, mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Imuna mwali abena Imuna. Muli Ishifi mwali abena Ishifi. Muli Beriya mwali abena Beriya.

english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
translation: Kabili ukupitila mu ndupwa shakwa Beriya bali nifi. Muli Heberi mwali abena Heberi. Muli Malikieli mwali abena Malikieli.

english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
translation: Asheri alikwete umwana umwanakashi, ishina lyakwe ni Sera.

english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Asheri, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yasano na yatatu ne myanda ine (53,400).

english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Naftali mu ndupwa shabo bali nifi. Muli Yaseeli mwali abena Yaseeli. Muli Guni mwali abena Guni.

english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
translation: Muli Yeseri mwali abena Yeseri. Muli Shilemu mwali abena Shilemu.

english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Rubeni, ibeli lyakwa Israeli, mwali aba. Muli Hanoki mwali abena Hanoki. Muli Palu mwali abena Palu.

english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Naftali, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yane na yasano ne myanda ine (45,400).

english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
translation: Kanshi impendwa ya baume bonse pamo abena Israeli yali amakana imyanda mutanda na limo ne myanda cine lubali na makumi yatatu (601,730).

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
translation: “Ukakanye icalo kuli bonse ukulinganafye ne mpendwa ya mashina, pakuti cikabe icuma cabo icacishilano.

english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
translation: Ku luko lukalamba, ubapeele icalo icikulu. Kabili na ku luko lunono, ubapeele icalo icinono. Cila luko luli nokupoka icalo ukulingana ne mpendwa ya balembwa.

english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
translation: Uli nokushininkisha ukuti pakupeela icalo mupendule. Bali nokupeelwa icalo cabo ukulingana na mashina aya nko sha fikolwe fyabo.

english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
translation: Cila calo bali nokupendula pakucakanya pakati ka mpendwa ikalamba ne inono.”

english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
translation: Abena Levi, abapendelwe mu ndupwa shabo ni aba. Muli Geshoni mwali abena Geshoni. Muli Koati mwali abena Koati. Muli Merai mwali abena Merai.

english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
translation: Indupwa sha bena Levi shimbi nishi, abena Libini, abena Hebuloni, abena Mali, abena Mushi na bena Kora. (Koati ali ni wishi wakwa Amuramu)

english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
translation: Ishina lyakwa muka Amuramu ni Yokebedi, uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Levi, uwafyalilwe mu luko lwa bena Levi mu Egupto. Yokebedi kuli Amuramu afyeleko abana abaume bali ni Aroni na Mose, elyo na nkashi yabo Miriamu.

english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
translation: Muli Hesroni mwali abena Hesroni. Muli Kami mwali abena Kami.

english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translation: Aroni ali na bana abaume bane, ni Nadabu, Abihu, Eleasa na Itama.

english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
translation: Lelo Nadabu na Abihu balifwile ilyo batuulile Yawe umulilo uushili wamushilo.

english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
translation: Abena Levi bonse abaume abali no mweshi umo nangu ukucilapo, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yabili na yatatu (23,000). Aba bena tabapendelwe pamo na bambi abena Israeli, pantu mu calo tabakwetemo ciputulwa pakuti cingaba e cuma cabo ica cishilano.

english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
translation: Kanshi ishi e nko shonse ishapendelwe na Mose na Eleasa shimapepo, ilyo bapendele abena Israeli mu mawanga ya ku Moabu, mwishilya lya Yordani, ukulungatana na Yeriko.

english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
translation: Pa bena Israeli abo Mose na Aroni shimapepo bapendele mu matololo ya Sinai, tapashele nangu umo mwibumba ili.

english: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translation: Pantu Yawe alyebele balya bena Israeli ukuti bonse bakafwila mu matololo kabili takwali nangu umo uwashele, kanofye Kalebu mwana Yefune na Yoshua mwana Nuni.

english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
translation: Aba e ba mu luko lwakwa Rubeni, abapendelwe bali amakana amakumi yane na yatatu ne myanda cine lubali na makumi yatatu (43,730).

english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.
translation: Mwana Palu umwaume ali ni Eliabu.

english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;
translation: Bamwana Eliabu bali ni Nemueli, Datani na Abiramu. Aba bene Datani na Abiramu ebali intungulushi sha lukuta abasangukile Mose na Aroni, bawila na kuli Kora ne bumba lyakwe lilya lyasangukile Yawe.

english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translation: Abana abanakashi bakwa Selofeadi umwana mwaume wakwa Eferi, umwana mwaume wakwa Gileadi, umwana mwaume wakwa Makiri, umwana mwaume wakwa Manase, bali ba mu mikowa yakwa Manase umwana mwaume wakwa Yosefu. Amashina ya bana abanakashi bali ni Mala, Noa, Hogila, Milika na Tirisa.

english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
translation: Nga takwete bamunyina abaume, ninshi peeleni icuma ca cishilano kuli bamunyina abaume abakwa wishi.

english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”
translation: Nga wishi nao takwete bamunyina abaume, peeleni icuma ca cishilano kuli umo uwa mu lupwa, mu mukowa umo wine, nge cuma cakwe. Ili e funde lya bena Israeli ne cipope icakulakonkwa, ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.’”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati, “Kabiye pa mulu wa lupili lwa Abarimu, umone icalo ico mpeele abena Israeli.

english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
translation: Panuma yakucimona, na iwe wine uli nokuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe pamo nga munonko Aroni.

english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
translation: Pantu ilyo ulukuta lwansangukile pa menshi mu matololo ya Sini, imwe bonse babili mwakene ukubeela ifyo namukonkomeshe ngo wamushilo pa menso yabo.” (Aya yali menshi ya ku Meriba Kadeshi mu matololo ya ku Sini).

english: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
translation: Mose aebele Yawe ati,

english: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
translation: “Kanshi Yawe, Lesa wa mipashi ya bantu bonse, asonte umuntu pa lukuta ulu,

english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
translation: alebatangilila pakuya na pakubweluluka, umo uwakuti alebatungulula pakuya no kubabwesha, pakuti ulukuta lwa bantu bakwa Yawe lwiba nge mpaanga ishabula kacema.”

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
translation: Elyo Yawe aeba Mose ati, “Buula Yoshua umwana mwaume uwakwa Nuni, umuntu uwabamo Umupashi, umutambalikilepo ukuboko kobe.

english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
translation: Elyo uye mwiminika pantanshi yakwa Eleasa shimapepo no lukuta lonse, elyo umupeelele imilimo yobe pa menso yabo.

english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
translation: Baya iminina pantanshi yakwa Mose, Eleasa shimapepo na ku ntungulushi na ku lukuta lonse ku mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, basosa nokuti,

english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
translation: Umupeele amaka yobe yamo pakuti ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli lulemubeela.

english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
translation: Kabili akalaiminina ku cinso cakwa Eleasa shimapepo, uuli no kwipusha ifya bupingushi mukubomfya Urimu pa cinso cakwa Yawe. Mu kukonkomesha kwakwe, ena no lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli bali nokufuma, kabili mu kukonkomesha kwakwe bakabweluluka.”

english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
translation: Mose nao acita ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe. Abuula Yoshua amwimika pantanshi yakwa Eleasa shimapepo no lukuta lonse.

english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.
“Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
translation: Yosh 17:3

english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
translation: Bushe ico batata tabakwetepo abana abaume, eco ishina lingalobela mu lupwa lwabo? Tupeniko na ifwe icuma ukufuma pafyo mwapeela bamunyina batata.”

english: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
translation: Mose ena epakutwala umulandu wabo kuli Yawe,

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: elyo Yawe asosa kuli Mose ati,

english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
translation: “Ifilesosa bamwana Selofeadi abanakashi fyacine. Ufwile ukushininkisha ukuti wabapeela icuma nge ca cishilano cabo, ngefi fine wapeela bamunyina kwa shibo. Kabili nabo ubapeele icuma ica cishilano cakwa shibo.

english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
translation: Kabili landa ku bena Israeli ukuti, ‘Umuntu umo nga afwa takwetepo umwana umwaume, umwana wakwe umwanakashi kuti abuula icuma ca cishilano cakwe.

english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
translation: Nga takwete umwana umwanakashi, ninshi peeleni icuma ca cishilano kuli bamunyina abaume.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
translation: Ili e lambo lyakoca ilya pali cila Sabata, ukulunda pelambo lya cila bushiku, pamo no mutuulo wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,
translation: “Pa bushiku bonse ubwakutampa umweshi mukaletuula Yawe ilambo lyakoca ilya fiponti fya ŋombe ifilume fibili, sukusuku umo no twana twa mpaanga utulume cine lubali utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;
translation: Pali cila cilume wa ŋombe mukalentuulilapo utwapekumi tutatu twa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali sukusuku ifipimo fibili pekumi ifya efa wa bunga ubwapeleka bwino, ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa.

english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Pali cila kana ka mpaanga muli nokutuula icipimo pekumi ica efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Ifi fya malambo yakoca, umutuulo wa cena icisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
translation: Pali cila cilume wa ŋombe onse pafwile ukuba umutuulo wa fyakunwa, imisukupala ibili iya mwangashi. Pali sukusuku umusukupala umo uwa mwangashi. Pali cila kana ka mpaanga konse, citika wa musukupala umo uwa mwangashi. Uyu e mutuulo we lambo lyakoca cila mweshi, uuli nokucitwa cila mweshi upya mu mwaka onse.

english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
translation: Elyo pelambo lyakoca ilya nshiku shonse pamo no mutuulo wa fyakunwa, mulelundapo sawe ngo mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi kuli Yawe.

english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
translation: “Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14) mu mweshi wantanshi, pali nokulaba inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, Ipasaka lyakwa Yawe.

english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
translation: Kabili pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi wine uyu, kuli nokulaba inshikunkulu. Pa nshiku cine lubali mulelyafye imikate iyishatutumuka.

english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,
translation: Muli nokutuula Yawe ilambo lyakoca ilya fiponti fya ŋombe ifilume fibili, sukusuku umo no twana twa mpaanga utulume cine lubali utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
translation: “Peela icebo ici ku bena Israeli kabili ulande kuli bena auti, mulemona ukuti pa nshita yasontwa yonse mulentuula imituulo ya fyakulya fyakoca, iya cena cisuma icinsekesha.

english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
translation: Pali cila cilume wa ŋombe onse pekanyenipo utwapekumi tutatu utwa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ifyasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali sukusuku pekanyenipo utwapekumi tubili utwa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga.

english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
translation: Kabili pali cila kana ka mpaanga pa twana twa mpaanga cine lubali, pekanyenipo icapekumi cimo ica efa wa bunga.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
translation: Kabili mulundepo na sawe umo uwe lambo lya pa fyabubifi pakumufutilako.

english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
translation: Mwakulapekanya ifi ukulunda pa mutuulo we lambo lyakoca uwa cila lucelo.

english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
translation: Muli iyi nshila pa nshiku cine lubali mulepekanya icakulya ca mutuulo wakoca cila bushiku, umutuulo wa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe. Mulecita ifi pakulunda pa mutuulo wakoca no wa fyakunwa uwa lyonse.

english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali kuleba ukulongana kwamushilo, kabili tebwakwesha kubombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku.

english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
translation: “Pa bushiku bwa fisabo fyantanshi ilyo muletuula kuli Yawe umutuulo wa cabunga ubupya pa nshikunkulu ya milungu, kuleba ukulongana kwamushilo, kabili tekwesha kubombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku.

english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
translation: Muletuula ilambo lyakoca ilya fiponti fya ŋombe ifilume fibili, sukusuku umo no twana twa mpaanga utulume cine lubali utwa mwaka umo umo ngo mutuulo wa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
translation: Pali cila cilume wa ŋombe paleba umutuulo wa cabunga utwapekumi tutatu utwa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali sukusuku paleba utwapekumi tubili twa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga ubwapeleka bwino.

english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
translation: Elyo pali cila kana ka mpanga pa twana twa mpaanga cine lubali, capekumi cimo ica efa wa bunga.

english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
translation: Ulande kuli bena utile, uyu e mutuulo wa cakoca muli nokutuula kuli Yawe, utwana twa mpaanga tubili utwa mwaka umo umo, utwabula akalema, nge lambo lyakoca cila bushiku.

english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.
translation: Kabili mulundepo sawe umo uwakumufutilapo.

english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
translation: Mulepekanya ifi fyonse pamo no mutuulo wa fyakunwa, mukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku, no mutuulo wa cabunga. Mushininkishe bwino ukuti inama shonse tashikwete akalema.”

english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,
translation: Mulepekanya akana ka mpaanga kamo ulucelo, kambi nako icungulo,

english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
translation: pamo pene ne capekumi cimo ca ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino, ubwasanshiwamo ne cipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini umo ukufuma ku cikamino ca miolifa.

english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Ili e lambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku, ilyatendekele pa lupili lwa Sinai, ngo mutuulo wacakoca uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.
translation: Umutuulo wakulundapo uwa fyakunwa, cipimo ca pakati ka citika wa hini umo uwa fyakunwa ifyakantuka pali cila kana ka mpaanga. Muleitila umutuulo wa cakunwa kuli Yawe mu cifulo camushilo.

english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
translation: Mulepekanya akana ka mpaanga akabiye mu nshita ya cungulo, no kucita umusango umo wine ngo lucelo, pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa. Uyu mutuulo we lambo lyakoca uwa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe.

english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
translation: “Pa bushiku bwe Sabata, tuuleni utwana twa mpaanga tubili utuli no mwaka umo umo utwabula akalema, no bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino utwapekumi tubili twa ku cipimo ca efa ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta aya miolifa, no mutuulo wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
translation: Pa bushiku bwantanshi mu mweshi walenga cine lubali kuleba ukulongana kwamushilo, kabili tekwesha kubombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku. Bushiku bwenu ubwakulishamo amapenga.

english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
translation: Elyo pali cila kana ka mpanga pa twana twa mpaanga cine lubali, cipimo cimo pekumi ica efa wa bunga.

english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi, ukulunda pa mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi, ilambo lyakoca ilyacila bushiku pamo pene no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi walenga cine lubali, kukaleba ukulongana kwamushilo, kabili mwikabombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku. Mulesefya inshikunkulu pa nshiku cine lubali pakucindika Yawe.

english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;
translation: Muli nokutuula Yawe ilambo lyakoca ilya cena icisuma icakumusekesha. Ilambo lya fiponti fya ŋombe ifilume ikumi limo na fitatu (13), basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
translation: Pali cila ŋombe ilume pa ŋombe ishilume ikumi limo na shitatu (13) mupekanishishepo utwapekumi tutatu twa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali basukusuku babili, mupekanishishepo cila umo utwapekumi tubili twa kuli efa wa bunga.

english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
translation: Elyo pali cila kana ka mpaanga, pa twana twa mpaanga ikumi limo na tune (14), mupekanishishepo icipe cimo pekumi ica efa wa bunga.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translation: Ukuf 23:16

english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shibili, mupekanye ifiponti fya ŋombe ifilume ikumi limo na fibili (12), basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula ubulema.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo imituulo ya cabunga ne ya fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku pamo pene no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Ngo mutuulo wa cena cisuma icisekesha Yawe, pekanyeni ilambo lyakoca ilya ciponti ca ŋombe cimo icilume, sukusuku umo no twana twa mpaanga utulume cine lubali utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shitatu, mupekanye iŋombe ishilume ikumi limo na imo (11), basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo imituulo ya cabunga ne ya fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo imituulo ya cabunga ne ya fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga shisano, mupekanye iŋombe ishilume pabula, basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo umutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga mutanda mupekanye ŋombe ishilume cine konse konse, basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
translation: Pa ŋombe ilume, pekanishishenipo utwapekumi tutatu twa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali sukusuku paleba utwapekumi tubili twakuli efa wa bunga.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo umutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, mupekanye iŋombe ishilume cine lubali, basukusuku babili no twana twa mpaanga utulume ikumi limo na tune (14) utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
translation: Pa ŋombe ishilume, basukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo umutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse kuleba ukulongana kwamushilo mulelongana mukupepa, kabili mwikabombamo imilimo ya cila bushiku.

english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
translation: Levi 23:36

english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
translation: Pa ŋombe iyilume, sukusuku no twana twa mpaanga mupekanishishepo umutuulo wa cabunga ne fyakunwa ukulingana ne mpendwa yapimwa.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translation: Mubikepo na sawe umo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi ukulunda pelambo lyakoca ilya cila bushiku no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa fyakunwa.

english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
translation: Mukulunda pa filayo mwalaya ne mituulo yakuitemenwafye, mulepekanishisha Yawe fyonse ifi pa nshikunkulu shasontwa, ilyo muletuula amalambo yakoca, imituulo ya cabunga ne ya fyakunwa ne yakwampana.

english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
translation: Elyo pali cila kana ka mpanga pa twana twa mpaanga cine lubali, cipimo cimo pekumi ica efa wa bunga.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
translation: Mulundepo na sawe umo uwakumufutilapo.

english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
translation: Ifi fyonse fyakulundapofye pa malambo yakoca aya cila mweshi naya cila bushiku pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga no mutuulo wa fyakunwa ngefyo fyatantikwa. Ifi fyonse, mituulo yakoca iyakuletela Yawe iya cena cisuma icimusekesha.

english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo mu mweshi walenga cine lubali kuleba ukulongana kwamushilo. Mufwile ukuikaanya, mwilabombamo imilimo.

english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;
translation: Kabili muli nokutuula ilambo lyakoca ilya cena icisuma icisekesha Yawe, iciponti cimo, sukusuku umo no twana twa mpaanga utulume cine lubali utwa mwaka umo umo, fyonse ifyabula akalema.

english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
translation: Pa ŋombe ilume, pekanishishenipo utwapekumi tutatu utwa ku cipimo ca efa wa bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa. Pali sukusuku paleba utwapekumi tubili twa kuli efa wa bunga.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni ati,

english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kulyo lubali kukaba iciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Rubeni no luunga lwabo. Cikaba mu mpuka mu mpuka sha mikowa yabo. Intungulushi ya bena Rubeni ni Elisuri mwana Shedeuri.

english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yane na mutanda ne myanda isano (46,500).

english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Simeoni elukabakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Simeoni ni Shelumieli mwana Surishadai.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yasano na pabula ne myanda itatu (59,300).

english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Gadi elukakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Gadi ni Eliasafu mwana Reueli

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yane na yasano ne myanda mutanda na makumi yasano (45,650).

english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
translation: Abaume bonse abapendelwe mu ciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Rubeni, mu mpuka mu mpuka, bali amakana umwanda umo na makumi yasano na limo ne myanda ine na makumi yasano (151,450). Aba ebali nokukonka pa bantanshi nga bafuma pa nkambi balipo.

english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
translation: “Elyo abena Levi pakusenda Itenti Lyakukumaninamo bali nokulaendela pakati, kuntanshi kube amabumba yabili na kunuma nako kube amabumba yabili. Mulya mwine bakonkanina ukwikala mu nkambi, emo na pakwenda bali nokukonkanina. Impuka yonse ili nokuba pa ncende apali uluunga.

english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
translation: “Ku masamba ekukaba iciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Efulemu no luunga lwabo. Cikaba mu mpuka mu mpuka sha mikowa yabo. Intungulushi ya bena Efulemu ni Elishama mwana Amiudi.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yane ne myanda isano (40,500).

english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.
translation: “Abena Israeli bali nokulaimika amatenti yabo ukushinguluka Itenti Lyakukumaninamo pa nkambi, lelo bafwile ukutalushako amatenti yabo. Umuntu onse akabe mwibumba lya mpuka ya luko lwakwe akabike icishibilo ca luunga lwa luko pe tenti lyakwe.

english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Manase elukabakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Manase ni Gamalieli mwana Pedasuri.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yatatu na yabili ne myanda ibili (32,200).

english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Benjamini elukakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Benjamini ni Abidani mwana Gideoni.

english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yatatu na yasano ne myanda ine (35,400).

english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
translation: Abaume bonse abapendelwe mu ciputuluwa ca nkambi icakwa Efulemu, mu mpuka mu mpuka, bali amakana umwanda umo na cine konse konse no mwanda umo (108,100). Aba bantu ebafwile ukuba abacitatu nga bafuma pa nkambi balipo.

english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kuso lubali ekukaba iciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Dani no luunga lwabo. Cikaba mu mpuka mu mpuka sha mikowa yabo. Intungulushi ya bena Dani ni Ahieseri mwana Amishadai.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi mutanda na yabili ne myanda cine lubali (62,700).

english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Asheri elukabakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Asheri ni Pagieli mwana Okirani.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yane na limo ne myanda isano (41,500).

english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Naftali nao elukakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Naftali ni Aira mwana Enani.

english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
translation: “Ku kabanga kulya kutulila akasuba, kukaba iciputulwa ca nkambi cakwa Yuda no luunga lwabo. Cikaba mu mpuka mu mpuka sha mikowa yabo. Intungulushi ya bena Yuda ni Nashoni mwana Aminadabu.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yasano na yatatu ne myanda ine (53,400).

english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
translation: Abaume bonse abapendelwe mu ciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Dani, mu mpuka mu mpuka, bali amakana umwanda umo na makumi yasano na cine lubali ne myanda mutanda (157,600). Aba bantu ebali nokulaba abakulalekeleshako nga bafuma pa nkambi mu mikowa yabo pa ncende apali uluunga lwabo.”

english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
translation: Aba e bena Israeli bonse abapendelwe mu ndupwa shabo. Bonse aba bali mu fiputulwa fya nkambi mu mpuka mu mpuka kabili ne mpendwa yabo yali amakana imyanda mutanda na yatatu ne myanda isano na makumi yasano (603,550).

english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Nga filya fine Yawe akonkomeshe Mose, abena Levi bena tabapendelwe pamo na bena Israeli bambi.

english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli bacitile fyonse ifyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose. Baikele mu nkambi mu mpuka mu mpuka. Kabili na pakufuma pa nkambi cila muntu aleba mu mukowa wakwe ukulingana no lupwa lwakwe.

english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi cine lubali na yane ne myanda mutanda (74,600).

english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Isaka elukabakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Isaka ni Netaneli mwana Suari.

english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yasano na yane ne myanda ine (54,400).

english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
translation: “Uluko lwakwa Sebuloni elukakonkapo. Intungulushi ya bena Sebuloni ni Eliabu mwana Eloni.

english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
translation: Impendwa ye bumba lyakwe, bantu amakana amakumi yasano na cine lubali ne myanda ine (57,400).

english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
translation: Abaume bonse abapendelwe mu ciputulwa ca nkambi icakwa Yuda, mu mpuka mu mpuka, bali amakana umwanda umo na makumi cine konse konse na mutanda ne myanda ine (186,400). Aba bantu ebafwile ukuba pantanshi nga bafuma pa nkambi balipo.

english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.
translation: Mose aebele intungulushi sha nko sha bena Israeli ati, “Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomeshe.

english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
translation: “Nga cakuti umwanakashi uwaupwa, alaya icilayo nangu alapa ukucita icintu cimo,

english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
translation: kabili umulume aumfwako lelo tasosele nangu cimo kabili tamuleseshe, ninshi ifilayo fyonse alaile nangu ifyo alapile ukucita, ali nokufikilisha.

english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.
translation: Nomba umulume nga ewamukaanya lintu aumfwa umulapo nangu ifilayo fyakwe, ninshi tapali icikakonkwa. Pantu umulume wakwe ewamukaanya, kabili Yawe ali nokumubelelako uluse.

english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
translation: Umulume wakwe nakwata amaka yakusuminisha nangu ayakukaanya umulapo atemwa icilayo cakuikaanya.

english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.
translation: Lelo ngo mulume wakwe nga aumfwa umulapo, nga talandile nangu cimo ku mukashi wakwe ukufuma pa bushiku aumfwa, ninshi umulume wakwe nasuminisha icilayo atemwa umulapo, pantu talandilepo nangu kamo pa bushiku aumfwile.

english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
translation: Nomba nga cakuti umulume aisa kaana ilyo ubushiku aumfwililepo umulapo bwalipita, ninshi umulume eukaba no mulandu wa mukashi wakwe.”

english: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
translation: Aya e mafunde Yawe apeele kuli Mose, pa mulandu wa mulume no mukashi kabili na pa mulandu wakwa wishi no mwana umukashana uwikala mu ŋanda yakwa wishi.

english: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
translation: Ilyo umuntu alaya icilayo kuli Yawe nangu alapa ukucita cimo, tali nakufutuka ishiwi lyakwe, lelo conse ico alaile na kanwa kakwe, alingilefye ukucita.

english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
translation: “Umukashana nga alaya kuli Yawe, nangu alapa ukucita icintu cimo, ilyo acili aleikala mu ŋanda yakwa wishi,

english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
translation: na wishi aumfwa ico alaile nangu ico alapile ukucita, nomba wishi tamwebele nangu cimo, ninshi fyonse ifilayo nangu umulapo ube wa musango shani, ali nokufikilisha.

english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
translation: Lelo wishi ilyo aumfwa nga amukaanya, ninshi ifilayo fyonse alaile ne fintu fyonse alapile ukucita, tali nakuficita iyoo. Yawe akamubelela uluse ico wishi eumukenye.

english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
translation: Nga cakuti aupwa panuma ya kulaya icilayo nangu alapa ukwabula ukuti atale atontonkanye bwino,

english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
translation: kabili elyo umulume wakwe aumfwako, lelo tasosele nangu cimo, ninshi ifilayo fyonse alaile nangu ifyo alapile ukucita, ali nokufikilisha.

english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.
translation: Nomba umulume ilyo aumfwa amulesha no kumulesha, ninshi akaanya icilayo ico alaile nangu umulapo alapile ukwabula ukutontonkanya bwino, na Yawe akamubelela uluse.

english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
translation: “Mukamfwilwa, nangu umwanakashi uo wiba aleka, nga alaya icilayo nangu alapa, ena alingilefye ukusunga umulapo alapa.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
translation: Baoca imisumba yonse iya bena Midiani kumo kwine ne nkambi baleikalamo shonse.

english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
translation: Elyo basenda ifitapwa fyonse nefyo baonawile, pamo pene na bantu ne nama.

english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
translation: Elyo batwala bankole, ifyo baikete nefyo batapile, kuli Mose na Eleasa shimapepo no lukuta lwa bena Israeli pa nkambi yabo, mu mawanga ya Moabu mupepi na Yordani ukulungatana na Yeriko.

english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
translation: Mose, Eleasa shimapepo ne ntungulushi sha lukuta shonse bafumine kunse ya nkambi kukukumanya ifita.

english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
translation: Mose afulilwa bakangalila ba fita, abakalamba ba fita amakana na bakalamba ba fita imyanda ababwelele ku nkondo.

english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
translation: Abepusha ati, “Bushe namuleka bonse abanakashi ukuba abomi?

english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
translation: Banakashi bene ebakonkelele ifyo Balamu asosele, kabili ebalengele nokuti abena Israeli basangukile Yawe ku fyacitike ku Peori, pakuti kube ne cikuko pa lukuta lwa bantu bakwa Yawe.

english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
translation: Kanshi nomba ipayeni bonse abana abaume. Kabili mwipaye umwanakashi onse uwasendemapo no mwaume,

english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
translation: lelo muishilepofye abakashana abashatala abasendamapo na baume.

english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
translation: Bonse imwe mwe baipeyepo umuntu, nangu ukukumyakofye ku citumbi ca muntu uo bepeye, mwikalefye kunse ya nkambi pa nshiku cine lubali. Pa bushiku bwacitatu no bwa cine lubali muli nokuisangulula mwe bene pamo na bankole benu.

english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
translation: “Citila abena Israeli icilandushi pa bena Midiani. Panuma ya ifi elyo uli nokuya lala ukwalala ifikolwe fyobe.”

english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
translation: Muli nokusangulula ifyakufwala fyonse, ne fyapangwa ku mpapa fine fyonse, amasako ya mbushi nangu ifyapangwa ku cimuti.”

english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.
translation: Elyo Eleasa shimapepo aeba ifita ifyaile ku nkondo ati, “Ifi efifwaikwa mu mafunde ayo Yawe apeele Mose.

english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
translation: Golide, silifa, umukuba, icela, icikopo, mutofwe,

english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
translation: na conse icishingapya mu mulilo, muli nokufipisha mu mulilo, elyo fili nokusangululwa kukukowela. Lelo nafyo fine fili nokuposwa mu menshi yakusangulula. Elyo ifintu fyonse ifingapya mu mulilo muli nokufipisha mu menshi yalya yene.

english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
translation: Pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali, mukacape ifyakufwala fyenu, lyena mukasangululwa. Elyo nomba mukabwelela mu nkambi.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
translation: “Iwe na Eleasa shimapepo ne ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha lukuta, muli nokupenda abantu bonse ne nama ishatapilwe.

english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
translation: Akanyeni ifitapwa ku fita fyaile ku nkondo, elyo ifyashala mupeele ulukuta.

english: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
translation: Ukufuma ku fita fyalwile inkondo, mupatwileko Yawe umutuulo icintu cimo pa fintu imyanda isano, cibe ni pa bantu, iŋombe, bapunda, impaanga nangu imbushi.

english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.
translation: Mubuuleko ku cakaniko ca fita no kupeela Eleasa shimapepo, ukuba ciputulwa cakwa Yawe.

english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.
translation: Elyo Mose aebele abantu ati, “Peeleni ifita fimo ifyanso tuleya ku nkondo kukulwisha abena Midiani, tuye cita icilandushi cakwa Yawe pali bena.

english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
translation: Ukufuma ku cakaniko ca lukuta lwa bena Israeli, salenipo cimo pa fintu amakumi yasano, cibe ni pa bantu, iŋombe, bapunda, impaanga, imbushi nangu inama shimbi. Mupeele abena Levi, ababombela mwi Tenti lyakwa Yawe.”

english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Kanshi Mose na Eleasa shimapepo epakucitila umo Yawe akonkomeseshe Mose.

english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
translation: Ifyashele ukufuma ku fitapwa ifyo ifita fyaile ku nkondo fyasendele, fyali impaanga amakana imyanda mutanda, na makana amakumi cine lubali na yasano (675,000),

english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
translation: iŋombe shali amakana amakumi cine lubali na yabili (72,000),

english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
translation: bapunda bali amakana amakumi mutanda ne kana limo (61,000),

english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
translation: elyo abanakashi abashatalile abasendamapo no mwaume nabo bali amakana amakumi yatatu na yabili (32,000).

english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
translation: Citika wa ciputulwa catapilwe ico bapeele ifita fyaile ku nkondo, cali impaanga amakana imyanda itatu na makana amakumi yatatu na cine lubali ne myanda isano (337,500).

english: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
translation: Ishakutuula Yawe shali impaanga imyanda mutanda na makumi cine lubali na shisano (675).

english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.
translation: Ifita bafipeele iŋombe amakana amakumi yatatu na makanapo mutanda (36,000). Ishakutuula Yawe babuulilepo iŋombe amakumi cine lubali na shibili (72).

english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.
translation: Ifita bafipeele bapunda amakana amakumi yatatu ne myanda isano (30,500). Abakutuula Yawe babuulilepo bapunda amakumi mutanda na umo (61).

english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
translation: Cila luko lwa bena Israeli musalemo abakuya ku nkondo ikana limo limo (1,000).”

english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
translation: Ifita bafipeele abantu amakana ikumi na mutanda (16,000). Abakutuula Yawe babuulilepo abantu amakumi yatatu na babili (32).

english: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Mose epakupeela Eleasa shimapepo umutuulo wakwa Yawe ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
translation: Citika wa bena Israeli, uo Mose abapatwililepo ukufuma pa fita fyaile ku nkondo,

english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
translation: citika wa fyapeelwe ku lukuta ali impaanga amakana imyanda itatu na makumi yatatu na cine lubali ne myanda isano (337,500),

english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
translation: iŋombe shali amakana amakumi yatatu na makana mutanda (36,000),

english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
translation: bapunda bali amakana amakumi yatatu ne myanda isano (30,500),

english: and sixteen thousand persons),
translation: elyo abantu bali amakana ikumi na mutanda (16,000).

english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Ukufuma pali citika wa fyapeelwe ku lukuta lwa bena Israeli, Mose abuulapo umuntu umo pali cila makumi yasano aya bantu na pa nama napo imo, ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe, elyo apeela ku bena Levi, abalebombela mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
translation: Elyo abakalamba abali pakati ka fita fya nkondo, abakalamba ba fita amakana na bakalamba ba fita imyanda, baile kuli Mose,

english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
translation: balamweba abati, “Fwe babomfi bobe natupenda ifita twaletungulula tapali nangu umo uulubile.

english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
translation: Kanshi abena Israeli epakusala abantu abakuya ku nkondo, ikana limo limo ukufuma kuli cila luko, bonse pamo bali amakana ikumi limo na yabili (12,000).

english: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”
translation: Kanshi natuleta kuli Yawe umutuulo wa tuntu twa golide uto cila umo anonkele, amakosa, insambo, imbalaminwe na masikiyo, mukuifutilako pa fya bubifi bwesu pa cinso cakwa Yawe.”

english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
translation: Mose na Eleasa shimapepo bapoka kuli bena golide na conse icabashilwe.

english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
translation: Golide onse ukufuma ku bakalamba ba fita amakana na bakalamba ba fita imyanda uo Mose na Eleasa shimapepo batuulile kuli Yawe, afinine amashekeli amakana ikumi limo na mutanda ne myanda cine lubali na makumi yasano (16,750).

english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
translation: Cila cita caliibuulilepo icitapwa caciko.

english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
translation: Kanshi Mose na Eleasa shimapepo bapoka golide ku bakalamba ba fita amakana na bakalamba ba fita imyanda batwala mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, kukuba icibukisho ca bena Israeli pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
translation: Elyo Mose abatuma ku nkondo, ikana limo limo ukufuma kuli cila luko pamo na Fineasi umwana mwaume wakwa Eleasa shimapepo, aya nasenda ne fipe fya cifulo camushilo na mapenga ayakulisha pakubeshibisha.

english: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.
translation: Baimina abena Midiani ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose, baipaya na baume bonsefye.

english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
translation: Kabili baipaila kumo ne mfumu shisano isha bena Midiani, Efi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba. Kabili baipaya Balamu umwana mwaume wakwa Beori ku lupanga.

english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
translation: Abena Israeli basenda na banakashi abena Midiani muli bunkole na bana babo. Basenda ifyakutapa fyonse, iŋombe, imikuni ya mpaanga ne mbushi, ne fyuma.

english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
translation: Abena Rubeni na bena Gadi, abakwete iŋombe ne mpaanga ishingi, bamwene ifyalo fya ku Yaseri na Gileadi ukuti fisuma nganshi ukutekelamo ifitekwa.

english: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
translation: Yawe alifulilwe nganshi, ubo bushiku alapa noyu mulapo ati,

english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
translation: ‘Pantu aba bantu tabankonkele ne mitima yabo yonse, tapali nangu umo umwaume uuli ne myaka amakumi yabili (20) nangu ukucilapo, uwafumine mu Egupto, uukamona icalo nalaile mukulapa ukupeela Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.

english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
translation: Tapali nangu umo kanofye Kalebu mwana Yefune umwina Kenasi na Yoshua mwana Nuni, pantu bena balikonkele Yawe ne mitima yabo yonse.’

english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
translation: Yawe afulilwe abena Israeli, abalenga no kululumba mu matololo pa myaka amakumi yane, mpakafye inkulo ya balya bonse abacitile ifyabipa pa cinso cakwe yasuka yapwa.

english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
translation: Kabili moneni, mwe luko lubifi, mwaibika pa fifulo fya bashinwe, no kulenga Yawe alundepo ukufulilwa Israeli.

english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
translation: Nga cakuti mwataluka ukumfwila Yawe, nakabili line akabalekako aba bantu bonse mu matolo, kabili nimwe mukalenga ukuti bonaike.”

english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
translation: Elyo bapalamine kuli ena abati, “Tulefwaya tukuule amacinka ya fitekwa fyesu, ne misumba ya banakashi besu na bana.

english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
translation: Tatwakabwelele ku mayanda yesu, mpakafye umwina Israeli onse akapokelele ica cishilano cakwe.

english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
translation: Ifwe tatwakapokeko icacishilano pamo nabo mwishilya lya mumana wa Yordani, pantu ifwe ica cishilano cesu caba kuno bushilya ku kabanga ka Yordani.”

english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
translation: Elyo baya kuli Mose na Eleasa shimapepo ne ntungulushi sha lukuta, babeba abati,

english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
translation: Elyo Mose atile kuli bena, “Kuti mwabwelelamofye nga cakuti mwacita ici. Mwaipangasha mwe bene pa cinso cakwa Yawe ukuya ku bulwi,

english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
translation: kabili nga abaipangasha bonse mwaya abuka Yordani pa cinso cakwa Yawe, mpaka akafulumunemo abalwani bakwe

english: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
translation: no kucimfya cilya calo pa cinso cakwe, lyena kuti mwabwelelamo no kuba abakaele kuli Yawe na ku bena Israeli. Kabili ici calo cikaba cuma cenu pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
translation: Lelo nga mwafilwa ukucita ico mwalaya, ninshi mwabifya kuli Yawe. Elyo muli nokushininkisha ukuti ububifi bwenu buli nokuba pali imwe.

english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
translation: Kuuleni imisumba ya banakashi benu na bana, na macinka ya fitekwa, lelo mucite ico mulaile!”

english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
translation: Abena Gadi na bena Rubeni batile kuli Mose, “Ifwe fwe babomfi bobe tuli nokucita ifyo wakonkomesha we mfumu yesu.

english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”
translation: Lelo ababomfi benu, umwaume onsefye uipangeshe ku bulwi, ali no kwabuka mukulwisha pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pamo ngefyo wasosa we mfumu yesu.”

english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
translation: Elyo Mose apeele ifipope pali bena kuli Eleasa shimapepo na Yoshua mwana Nuni ne ntungulushi sha ndupwa sha nko sha bena Israeli.

english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
translation: Atile kuli bena, “Nga cakuti abena Gadi na bena Rubeni, umwaume onsefye uuipangeshe ku bulwi, ayabuka Yordani na imwe pa cinso cakwa Yawe, lyena ilyo mwapoka icalo, nemwe muli nokubapeela icalo ca Gileadi nge cuma cabo.

english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
translation: “Ataroti, Diboni, Yaseri, Nimura, Heshiboni, Eleale, Sebamu, Nebo na Beoni,

english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
translation: Lelo nga tababwike mumana nabaipangasha na imwe pamo, bafwilefye ukukwatako icitungu mu calo ca Kenani.”

english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
translation: Abena Gadi na bena Rubeni bayaswike abati, “Ababomfi benu bali nokucita ifyo Yawe alandile.

english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
translation: Tuli nokwabuka umumana ukuya mu calo ca Kenani pa cinso cakwa Yawe natuipangasha, lelo icuma ca cishilano cesu cikaba nici kuno kwishilya lya Yordani.”

english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
translation: Elyo Mose apeele ku bena Gadi, abena Rubeni na citika wa luko lwakwa Manase mwana Yosefu icalo cakwa Sihoni imfumu ya bena Amoli, ne calo cakwa Ogi imfumu ya bena Bashani. Icalo conse kumo kwine ne misumba yabamo, ne citungu ca mpanga yonse iyabashingulwike.

english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation: Abena Gadi bakuulile Diboni, Ataroti, Aroeli,

english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation: Atiroti Shofani, Yaseri, Yogebea,

english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
translation: Beti Nimura na Beti Harani, nge misumba yakuulililwako amalinga no kukuula amacinka ya fitekwa fyabo.

english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation: Abena Rubeni nakabili bakuula Heshiboni, Eleale na Kiriataimu,

english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
