translation: pamo pene na Nebo, Baali Meoni (aya mashina baliyalwile) na Sibuma. Imisumba imbi bakuulile baliinike amashina.

english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
translation: Aba mu lupwa lwakwa Makiri mwana Manase baile ku Gileadi, bapoka icalo no kufulumunamo abena Amoli abaleikalamo.

english: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
translation: icalo ico Yawe apokolwele pa cinso ca lukuta lwa bena Israeli nacilinga ukutekelamo ifitekwa, na babomfi benu nabakwata ifitekwa.”

english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
translation: Elyo Mose apeela Gileadi ku bena Makiri, aba mu lupwa lwakwa Manase, kabili eko balaikala.

english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
translation: Yairi uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Manase apokolola imishi yabo no kulaita ati Hafoti Yairi,

english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
translation: Kabili Noba nao apokolola Kenati ne mishi yali mumbali, no kulaita ati Noba, pamo nga fintu balemwita.

english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
translation: Batile, “Nga cakuti mwatulangulukilako, lekeni cino calo cipeelwe ku babomfi benu pakuti cibe icuma cesu. Mwituleka twabuke Yordani.”

english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
translation: Mose atile ku bena Gadi na bena Rubeni, “Bushe mulefwaya ukushala no kwikala kuno ilyo abanenu baleya ku nkondo?

english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
translation: Bushe cinshi ico muletompwela imitima ya bena Israeli pakuti beya mu calo Yawe abapeela?

english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
translation: Ifi fine efyo na bashinwe bacitile, ilyo nabatumine ukufuma ku Kadeshi Banea kukuya lengula icalo.

english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
translation: Panuma yakuya fika kwishika lya Eshikoli no kumona icalo, babwelele no kutompola imitima ya bena Israeli mukukanaingila mu calo Yawe abapeele.

english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
translation: Ifi efyo ukukonkana kwa lwendo lwa bena Israeli kwali ilyo bafumine mu Egupto impuka ne mpuka mukutungululwa na Mose elyo na Aroni.

english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Elimu, bacita inkambi mupepi na Bemba Wakashika .

english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
translation: Ilyo bafuma kuli Bemba Wakashika, baya cita inkambi mu matololo ya Shini.

english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku matololo ya Shini, bacita inkambi ku Dofuka.

english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Dofuka, bacita inkambi ku Alushi.

english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Alushi, bacita inkambi ku Refidimu, ukushali menshi yakunwa abantu.

english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Refidimu, bacita inkambi mu matololo ya Sinai.

english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku matololo ya Sinai, baya cita inkambi ku Kibroti Hatafa.

english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Kibroti Hatafa, baya cita inkambi ku Haseloti.

english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Haseloti, baya cita inkambi ku Ritima.

english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Ritima, baya cita inkambi ku Rimoni Peresi.

english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
translation: Mukukonkomeshiwa na Yawe, Mose alelemba ififulo baletuushamo mu lwendo lwabo. Kanshi ulwendo lwabo ukukonkana nomo baletuusha lwali ngefi.

english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Rimoni Peresi, baya cita inkambi ku Libina.

english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Libina, baya cita inkambi ku Risa.

english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Risa, baya cita inkambi ku Keelata.

english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Keelata, bacita inkambi ku lupili lwa Shefa.

english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku lupili lwa Shefa, baya cita inkambi ku Harada.

english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Harada, baya cita inkambi ku Makeloti.

english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Makeloti, baya cita inkambi ku Tahati.

english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Tahati, baya cita inkambi ku Tera.

english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Tera, baya cita inkambi ku Mitika.

english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Mitika, baya cita inkambi ku Hashimona.

english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
translation: Abena Israeli bafumine mu Ramesesi pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shisano (15) mu mweshi wantanshi, pa bushiku bwakonka pe Pasaka, inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila. Bafumine ne cilumba ilyo abena Egupto balemonako,

english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Hashimona, baya cita inkambi ku Moseroti.

english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Moseroti, baya cita inkambi ku bena Yaakani.

english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku bena Yaakani, bacita inkambi ku Hagidigadi.

english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Hagidigadi, bacita inkambi ku Yotibata.

english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Yotibata, bacita inkambi ku Aburona.

english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Aburona, bacita inkambi ku Esioni Geberi.

english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Esioni Geberi, bacita inkambi ku Kadeshi, mu matololo ya Sini.

english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Kadeshi, bacita inkambi ku lupili lwa Holi mu mupaka wa calo ca Edomu.

english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
translation: Yawe akonkomeshe Aroni shimapepo ukuya pa mulu wa lupili lwa Holi, epo aile fwila pa bushiku bwakutampa umweshi walenga isano, mu mwaka walenga amakumi yane apo abena Israeli bafumine ku Egupto.

english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
translation: Aroni ali ne myaka umwanda umo na makumi yabili na itatu (123), ilyo afwile pa lupili lwa Holi.

english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.
translation: ninshi bena baleshiika amabeli yabo yonse ayo Yawe aipeye pakati kabo. Pantu Yawe ninshi naleta ubupingushi pa milungu yabo.

english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
translation: Imfumu ya ku Aradi, iya bena Kenani iyaleikala ku matololo ya Negebu, yaumfwa ukuti abena Israeli baleisa.

english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku lupili lwa Holi, bacita inkambi ku Salimona.

english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Salimona, bacita inkambi ku Punoni.

english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Punoni, bacita inkambi ku Oboti.

english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Oboti, bacita inkambi ku Iye Habarimu mu mupaka wa Moabu.

english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Iye Habarimu, bacita inkambi ku Diboni Gadi.

english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Diboni Gadi, bacita inkambi ku Alimoni Dibilataimu.

english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Alimoi Dibilataimu, bacita inkambi mu mpili sha Habarimu mupepi na Nebo.

english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku mpili sha Habarimu, bacita inkambi mu mawanga ya Moabu mupepi no mumana wa Yordani, ukulungatana no musumba wa Yeriko.

english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
translation: Kulya kwine mu mawanga ya Moabu bacita inkambi mu lulamba lwa mumana wa Yordani ukufuma ku Beti Yeshimoti ukufika na ku Abeli Shitimu.

english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
translation: Abena Israeli bafuma mu musumba wa Ramesesi no kuya cita inkambi ku Sukoti.

english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli utile kuli bena, ‘Nga mwayabuka umumana wa Yordani, mwaya mu Kenani,

english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
translation: mufwile ukufulumunamo bonse abekalamo ku cinso cenu. Kabili monaule utulubi utwabaswa no twabumbwa, elyo mubongolole ne ncende shonse shakupepelamo isho bacindika.

english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
translation: Pokeni icalo, muleikalamo pantu nimupeela icalo ukuba cenu.

english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
translation: Pakwakana icalo mukalependula ukulingana ne nko shenu. Uluko ulukalamba mukalupeele impanga iyikalamba, no luko ulunono mukalupeele impanga inono. Conse icasuminishiwa pakupendula cikaba e cipande ca mpanga yabo. Yakaneni ukulingana ne nko sha fikolwe fyenu.

english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
translation: Lelo nga mwafilwa ukufulumunamo bonse abekalamo mu calo, abo mukashamo bakaba fyakumusonkola mu menso yenu, kabili nge myunga mu mbafu shenu. Bakalamucusha mu calo umo mukekala.

english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
translation: Elyo nomba na ine nkamucitila ifyo napanga ukubacitila.’”

english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
translation: Ilyo bafuma pa Sukoti, bacita inkambi ku Etamu, pa mpela ya matololo.

english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Etamu, bayalulukila ku Pi Hairoti ku kabanga ka Baali Sefoni, no kucita inkambi mupepi na Migidoli.

english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
translation: Bafuma ku Pi Hairoti bapita muli Bemba Wakashika baya mu matololo. Kabili ilyo baendele inshiku shitatu mu matololo ya Etamu, bacita inkambi pa Mara.

english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
translation: Ilyo bafuma ku Mara no kuya ku Elimu, uko ukwali utumfukumfuku ikumi limo na tubili (12) ne miti ya tuncindu amakumi cine lubali (70), kabili eko bacita inkambi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
translation: “Ku kabanga umupaka ukakonka ukufuma ku Hasa Enani, ukufika ku Shefamu.

english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
translation: Umupaka uli nokutentemuka ukufuma ku Shefamu mpaka ku Ribula, ku kabanga ka Aini no kutwalilila no mutentemuko ku kabanga ka bemba wa Kinereti.

english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
translation: Elyo umupaka uli nokutentemukila ku mumana wa Yordani no kupelela kuli Bemba Wamucele. Iyi eili nokuba impanga yenu, ne mipaka ya calo konse konse.”

english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
translation: Mose akonkomeshe abena Israeli ati, “Penduleni pakwakana ici calo nge ca cishilano. Yawe nalanda ukucipeela ku nko pabula na citika,

english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
translation: pantu indupwa sha luko lwakwa Rubeni no luko lwakwa Gadi no luko citika ulwakwa Manase, nabapoka ica cishilano cabo.

english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
translation: Ishi nko shibili na citika nashipoka ica cishilano cabo lwa ku kabanga ukutulila akasuba ku Yordani na Yeriko.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translation: “Aya e mashina ya baume bali nokwakanya icalo nge ca cishilano, Eleasa shimapepo na Yoshua umwana mwaume wakwa Nuni.

english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
translation: Elyo sontapo intungulushi imo muli cila luko iyakwafwilisha ukwakanya icalo.

english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
translation: Aya e mashina yabo, Kalebu umwana mwaume wakwa Yefune, uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
translation: “Konkomesha abena Israeli utile kuli bena, ilyo mukengila mu Kenani, icalo mwalapeelwa nge ca cishilano, imipaka ikaba nifi.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
translation: Shemueli umwana mwaume wakwa Amiudi, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Simeoni.

english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
translation: Elidadi umwana mwaume wakwa Kisiloni, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Benjamini.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
translation: Buki umwana mwaume wakwa Yogili, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Dani.

english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
translation: Hanieli Amieli umwana mwaume wakwa Efodi, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Manase umwana mwaume wakwa Yosefu.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
translation: Kemueli umwana mwaume wakwa Shipitani, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Efulemu umwana mwaume wakwa Yosefu.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
translation: Elisafani umwana mwaume wakwa Panaki, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
translation: Palitieli umwana mwaume wakwa Asani, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Isaka.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
translation: Ahiudi umwana mwaume wakwa Shelomi, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Asheri.

english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
translation: Pedaheli umwana mwaume wakwa Amiudi, intungulushi ukufuma mu luko lwakwa Naftali.”

english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
translation: Aba e baume Yawe akonkomeshe ukwakanya icalo ca cishilano ku bena Israeli mu calo ca Kenani.

english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
translation: Ukufuma ku kapinda ka ku kulyo, umupaka ukalundako na matololo ya Sini, ukukonkafye umwapakanina icalo ca Edomu. Ku kabanga, umupaka wa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ukutendekela ukufuma ku mpela ya Bemba Wamucele,

english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
translation: ukwabukila ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ka mupokapoka wa Sikopioni, ukuya ku Sini no kuya fika ku kapinda ka kulyo ka Kadeshi Banea. Elyo ukalola ku Hasa Ada, no kuya fika ku Asimoni,

english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
translation: uko ukabweluluka, mukukuminkanya akamana mainsa aka pa mupaka wa calo ca Egupto no kupelela kuli Bemba.

english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
translation: “Mupaka wenu uwa ku masamba uli nokuba lulamba lwa Bemba Mukalamba. Uyu e mupaka wenu ku masamba.

english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
translation: “Ku kapinda ka ku kuso kwenu umupaka ukakonka ukufuma kuli Bemba Mukalamba, ukufika ku lupili lwa Hori,

english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
translation: kabili ukufuma ku lupili lwa Hori mpaka ku Lebo Hamati . Elyo umupaka uli nokutwalilila ukufika na ku Sedadi,

english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
translation: na ku Sifuroni, no kuya pwila ku Hasa Enani. Uyu e mupaka wenu ku kapinda ka ku kuso.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
translation: Mu mawanga ya Moabu, mupepi no mumana wa Yordani ukulungatana na Yeriko, Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli utile kuli bena. Ilyo mukabuka umumana wa Yordani no kuya mu calo ca Kenani,

english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
translation: mukasale imisumba imo, imisumba umwakufisama umuntu nga aipaya umuntu mubiye ukushili ku mufulo, eko afulumukila.

english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
translation: Shikaba ni ncende shakufisamamo ukufuma ku wacilandushi, pakuti umuntu uuli no mulandu wakwipaya umuntu mubiye bemwipaya kano batala bamulubulwisha pa cinso ca lukuta.

english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
translation: Iyi misumba mutanda iyikapeelwa, ikaba misumba yenu iyakufisamamo,

english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
translation: Mukapeele imisumba itatu kwishilya lya Yordani, elyo imbi itatu ikabe mu calo ca Kenani nge misumba yakufisamamo.

english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
translation: Iyi misumba mutanda ikaba ni ncende shakufisamamo abena Israeli, abenafyalo na bantu bambi mwikala nabo pakuti umuntu, uwaipaya umubiye ukushili ku mufulo, kuti abutukila kulya kwine.

english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
translation: “Nomba, nga cakuti umuntu akoma umubiye ne cela pakuti afwe, ni ntalamisoka. Ntalamisoka afwile ukupingwilwa ukwipaiwa.

english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
translation: Nangu nga cakuti umuntu ali ne libwe mu minwe yakwe ilingepaya umuntu, ilyo atoba umuntu afwa, ninshi ni ntalamisoka. Ntalamisoka afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
translation: Nangu nga cakuti umuntu ali ne cimuti mu minwe yakwe icingepaya umuntu, ilyo abola umuntu afwa, ninshi ni ntalamisoka. Ntalamisoka afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
translation: Kalandula wa mulopa euli nokwipaya ntalamisoka. Nga amukumanya ali nokumwipaya.

english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.
translation: “Konkomesha abena Israeli ukupeelako abena Levi imisumba iyakwikalamo mu ca cishilano bali nokupeelwa. Kabili muli nokubapeela ne fitungu fyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo ukushinguluka imisumba.

english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,
translation: “Nga cakuti umuntu umo alipata umubiye, elyo amusunka nangu amusukushila icintu cimo ku mufulo pakuti afwe,

english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
translation: nangu amuma ikofi mu lupato pakuti afwe, ulya muntu ali no kwipaiwa pantu ni ntalamisoka. Kalandula wa mulopa ali nokwipaya ntalamisoka ilyo akamukumanya.

english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
translation: “Lelo nga cakuti ukwabula ulupato umuntu asunka umubiye mukupumikisha, nangu amusukushila icintu cimo,

english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
translation: nangu tamumwene, nga amulasa ilibwe ilingamwipaya no kufwa afwa, nomba ico tali mulwani wakwe, kabili tafwaile kumucena,

english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
translation: ulukuta lufwile ukupingula umulandu pakati kakwe na kalandula wa mulopa ukukonka na mafunde aya.

english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
translation: Ulukuta luli nokucingilila uwapeelwa umulandu wakwipaya umubiye kuli kalandula wa mulopa, no kumubweseshamo ku musumba wakufisamamo uko abutukile. Afwilefye ukwikalilila uko kwine mpaka shimapepo mukalamba alipo uwasubwa amafuta yamushilo akafwe.

english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,
translation: Lelo uuli no mulandu nga afuma mu mipaka ya musumba abutukileko,

english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
translation: elyo na kalandula wa mulopa amukumanya kunse ya musumba, kalandula wa mulopa kuti amwipaya, apabula ukukwata umulandu wakwipaya umuntu.

english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
translation: Uwamulandu afwile ukwikala mu musumba afisamamo, mpakafye napo shimapepo mukalamba akafwila, lyena kuti abwelelamo ku mpanga yakwe.

english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
translation: Aya e mafunde yenu ne fipope ifyo mwakulakonka umukakonkanina inkulo, konsefye uko mukalaikala.

english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
translation: Elyo bakakwata imisumba iyakwikalamo, pamo ne fitungu bakalacemenamo iŋombe, impaanga ne fitekwa fyabo fimbi.

english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.
translation: “Umuntu onse uwaipaya mubiye, ali nokwipaiwa nge ntalamisoka bakambone nga bamushinina. Lelo kambone nga alifye umo, tabali na kumwipaya iyoo.

english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
translation: Tecakwesha ukusumina ukupoka icakulubwilapo ntalamisoka uulingile ukufwa. Uyu ena mu cinefye afwile ukwipaiwa.

english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
“‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
translation: Tecakwesha kukowesha icalo muleikalamo. Ukusumya umulopa kulakowesha icalo, no kufutilako pa bubifi teti ficitike pali ici calo apo umulopa usumine, kanofye pa mulopa wa muntu uwasumishe umulopa.

english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
translation: Tecakwesha kukowesha calo umo mwikala, kabili emo na ine njikala. Pantu ine ne Yawe, njikala pakati ka bena Israeli.”

english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
translation: Ifitungu fyakucemenamo ifitekwa fyabo, ifyashinguluka imisumba iyo mulepeela abena Levi, fili nokutendekelafye kunse ye linga, monse monsefye fili nokulepa bamita imyanda ine na makumi yasano (450) .

english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
translation: Kunse ya musumba, mukapime bamita imyanda pabula (900) lubali ku kabanga, bamita imyanda pabula (900) lubali ku kulyo, bamita imyanda pabula (900) lubali ku masamba, bamita imyanda pabula (900) lubali ku kuso, ukubika umusumba pakati. Bakakwata ici citungu ngo mwakucemena ifitekwa fya muli iyi misumba.

english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
translation: “Imisumba mutanda muli nokupeela abena Levi ikaba misumba yakufisamamo nga cakuti umuntu aipaya umuntu mubiye. Kabili mukalundepo ne misumba imbi amakumi yane na ibili (42).

english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
translation: Yonse pamo iyo muli nokupeela abena Levi ili nokuba amakumi yane na cine konse konse (48), kumo kwine ne fitungu ifyakucemenamo ifitekwa.

english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
translation: Imisumba iyo muli nokupeela abena Levi, ukufuma ku mpanga ya calo ca bena Israeli, ili nokulinganafye no bukulu bwa citungu ico cila luko lukwete. Pokeniko imisumba iyingi ku nko ishikwete ikulu, lelo abakwete inono, muli nokufumyako inono.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
translation: Abakalamba ba lupwa lwa mu mikowa yakwa Gileadi, umwana mwaume wakwa Makiri, umwana mwaume wakwa Manase, abafumine mu luko lwakwa Yosefu, baile no kulanda kuli Mose ne ntungulushi na bakalamba ba ndupwa sha bena Israeli.

english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:
translation: Kanshi abana banakashi bakwa Selofeadi epakucita ifyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
translation: Abana banakashi bakwa Selofeadi, Mala, Tirisa, Hogila, Milika na Noa, baupile abafyala babo aba ku lubali lwa bashibo.

english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
translation: Baupilwa mu luko lwa ndupwa shakwa Manase umwana mwaume wakwa Yosefu, ne fyuma fyabo ifyacishilano fyaikalafye mu luko lwakwa shibo no mutundu wakwe.

english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
translation: Aya e mafunde ne fipope Yawe apeele Mose ku bena Israeli mu mawanga ya Moabu ku Yordani ukulungatana na Yeriko.

english: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
translation: Batile, “Ilyo Yawe akonkomeshe imfumu yandi ukupeela icalo nge cuma ca cishilano ku bena Israeli mukupendula, amukonkomeshe ukupeela icuma ca cishilano cakwa munyinefwe Selofeadi ku bana bakwe abanakashi.

english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti baupwa ku baume ba mu nko sha bena Israeli shimbi, lyena ninshi ifyuma fyabo fyafuma mu fyuma fya cishilano fya fikolwe fyesu no kusanshiwa ku fyuma fya luko bakopilwako. Emukutila icuma ca cishilano icapeelwe kuli ifwe cili nokupokwa.

english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
translation: Ilyo umwaka wakusefya ku bena Israeli ukafika, ifyuma fya cishilano fikalundwa ku fyuma fya nko bakopilwako, kabili ninshi capokwa ukufuma ku luko lwa fikolwe fyesu.”

english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
translation: Kanshi ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe amukonkomeshe, Mose nao apeela ici cipope ku bena Israeli. Atila, “Ifyo aba ndupwa sha luko lwakwa Yosefu balanda filifye bwino.

english: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe akonkomesha pa mulandu wa bana banakashi abakwa Selofeadi, bafwile ukuupwa ku muntu onse uo batemenwe, cikulufye wa mu mukowa wa luko lwakwa shibo.

english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
translation: Imp 27:7

english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
translation: Umwana umwanakashi onse uwapeelwa impanga mu luko lonse ulwa bena Israeli, afwile ukuupwa ku wa mu mukowa wa luko lwakwa wishi, pakuti bonse abena Israeli bakakwateko icuma ca cishilano ca bashibo.

english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
translation: Takuli icuma ca cishilano icikafuma ku luko ulu no kuya kuli lumbi iyoo. Pantu cila luko lwa bena Israeli lwakulaikwatilafye impanga bapeelwa ukuba iya cishilano.”

english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
translation: Ifi efyali ulupwa lwakwa Aroni na Mose pa nshita Yawe alandile na Mose pa lupili lwa Sinai.

english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
translation: Usonte Aroni na bana bakwe abaume kukubomba imilimo ya bushimapepo. Umuntu umbifye nga apalama ku milimo iyi wena akepaiwe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aebele Mose, ati,

english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,
translation: “Pa bena Israeli nimbuulapo abena Levi kukuba abandifye pa malo ye beli lyonse ilyaume ilyafyalwa mu bena Israeli. Bena aba baleba bandifye.

english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”
translation: Pantu abana abaume bonse amabeli ala bandi. Ilyo naipeye amabeli yonse aya mu calo ca Egupto, elyo naipatwilile kuli ne mwine ibeli lyonse ilya mu Israeli, ilya muntu ne lya citekwa, yonse yandi. Ine nine Yawe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose mu matololo ya Sinai, ati,

english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
translation: “Penda abena Levi mu ndupwa na mu mpuka shabo. Penda abaume bonse ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo no ukucilapo.”

english: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.
translation: Mose nao aya bapenda ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation: Levi ali na bana abaume batatu, Geshoni, Koati na Merari.

english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
translation: Geshoni ali na bana abaume babili, ni Libini na Shimei.

english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation: Bamwana Aroni abaume bali Nadabu, e beli, Abihu, Eleasa na Itama.

english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
translation: Merari ali na bana abaume babili, ni Mali na Mushi. Ishi e ndupwa sha bena Levi umwabelele amayanda ya bashibo.

english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
translation: Impendwa yonse pamo iya baume abapendelwe, ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo nangu ukucilapo, yali amakana cine lubali ne myanda isano (7,500).

english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
translation: Indupwa shakwa Geshoni shali nokwikalila ku masamba kunuma ye Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
translation: Intungulushi ya bena Geshoni ni Eliasafu mwana Laeli.

english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
translation: Imilimo abena Geshoni balebomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo: Kusunga Itenti lyakwa Lesa, icisalu cakukupa mukati ne cakunse, icakucinga pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo,

english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
translation: ifisalu fyakucingilila ulubansa ulwashinguluka Itenti lyakwa Lesa no bulambo, icisalu cakucinga pa mwinshi wa lubansa, imyando elyo na fyonse ifyakumine kuli iyi milimo.

english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
translation: Mu lupwa lwakwa Koati emwatuntuka abena Amuramu, abena Isirahiya, abena Hebuloni na bena Usieli. Ishi e ndupwa shakwa Koati.

english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
translation: Impendwa yonse pamo iya baume abena Koati abalebomba umulimo wakusunga icifulo camushilo, abapendelwe ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo no kucilapo, yali amakana cine konse konse ne myanda mutanda (8,600).

english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
translation: Indupwa shakwa Koati shali nokwikala ku kapinda ka ku kulyo ake Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
translation: Aya e mashina ya bamwana Aroni, ebasubilwe amafuta no kupeelwa bushimapepo.

english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
translation: Intungulushi ya bena Koati ni Elisafani, mwana Usieli.

english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
translation: Imilimo abena Koati balebomba, kusunga Imbokoshi ya Cipangano, itebulo, icakutekapo ifisaniko, ifibumbili fya malambo, ifipe bashimapepo balebomfya mu cifulo camushilo, icisalu na fyonse ifyakumine ku milimo balebomba.

english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
translation: Eleasa mwana shimapepo Aroni ewali intungulushi nkalamba ya bena Levi. Ewasontelwe uwakwangalila abalebomba umulimo wakusunga icifulo camushilo.

english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
translation: Mu lupwa lwakwa Merari emwatuntuka abena Mali na bena Mushi. Ishi eshali ndupwa sha bena Merari.

english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
translation: Impendwa yonse pamo iya baume, abapendelwe ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo nangu ukucilapo, yali amakana mutanda ne myanda ibili (6,200).

english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
translation: Indupwa sha bena Merari eshali nokwikalila ku kapinda ka ku kuso ake Tenti lyakwa Lesa, na Surieli mwana Abihaili ewali ntungulushi ya ishi ndupwa.

english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
translation: Ishi e ndupwa shasontelwe ukusunga impanda she Tenti lyakwa Lesa, imyalo, inceshi no twakushimpamo impanda, elyo ne fyakubomfya fyonse ne milimo yonse iyakumine ku mibomfeshe ya ifi fipe,

english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
translation: ukusunga inceshi sha cakucinga ulubansa lwe Tenti, ifyakukwikamo impanda, impopo ne myando.

english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
translation: Mose na Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bena mu nkambi bali nokulaikalila lwa ku kabanga ke Tenti lyakwa Lesa, pa ntanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo ku kabanga lubali. Ebali nokubomba umulimo wakusunga icifulo camushilo, ukubombelako abena Israeli. Umuntu umbi uwapalama ku cifulo camushilo akepaiwe.

english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
translation: Impendwa yonse pamo iya bena Levi abaume abapendelwe ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose na Aroni ukubapendela mu ndupwa, abaume bonse ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo nangu ukucilapo, yali amakana amakumi yabili (22,000).

english: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
translation: Lelo Nadabu na Abihu bafwilile pa cinso cakwa Yawe mu matololo ya Sinai, ilyo batuulile Yawe umulilo ushasuminishiwe. Tabakwete abana baume, kanshi Eleasa na Itama ebalebomba umulimo wa bushimapepo ilyo shibo Aroni ali talafwa.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose, ati, “Penda amabeli ya bena Israeli bonse abaume, ukutampila pa bali no mweshi umo no kucilapo, kabili ulembe na mashina yabo.

english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
translation: Na pa malo ya bana baume bonse abena Israeli amabeli ubikepo abena Levi ukuba abandi. Kabili naibuulila ifitekwa fya bena Levi pa malo ya mabeli yonse ya fitekwa ifya bena Israeli. Nine Yawe!”

english: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
translation: Awe Mose epakupenda amabeli abaume bonse ngefyo Yawe amukonkomeshe.

english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
translation: Impendwa yonse pamo iya baume amabeli abali no mweshi umo nangu ukucilapo, bali amakana amakumi yabili na yabili, imyanda ibili na makumi cine lubali na batatu (22,273).

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Kabili Yawe aeba Mose ati,

english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.
translation: “Nomba bika abena Levi pa malo ya mabeli yonse abaume abena Israeli, na pa mabeli ya fitekwa fya bena Israeli ubikepo ifya bena Levi. Ine, nine Yawe.

english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
translation: Apo kanshi abana abaume amabeli ya bena Israeli bacilako abena Levi imyanda ibili na makumi cine lubali na batatu (273), iwe Mose ulingile pakubalubula

english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);
translation: ukuleka impiya amashekeli yasano pali cila umo ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo icafina amagera amakumi yabili.

english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
translation: Kabili isho mpiya shakulubula abo bena Israeli abapulilepo upeele Aroni na bana bakwe abaume.”

english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
translation: Mose nao apokele impiya kuli balya bapulile pa mpendwa yalubwilwe na bena Levi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose, ati,

english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Neshi mpiya shakulubwila amabeli ashipeela kuli Aroni na bana bakwe abaume, ukulingana ne shiwi Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
translation: “Palamika aba luko lwa bena Levi no kubapeela kuli Aroni shimapepo, balemwafwako imilimo.

english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translation: Bafwile ukulaafwa Aroni imilimo ya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo pamo ne milimo ya lukuta lonse mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translation: Bali nokulasunga ifipe fyonse ifya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, kabili no kulabombelako na bena Israeli bonsefye imilimo bali nokubomba mwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translation: Ukalubwile abena Levi kuli Aroni na bana bakwe abaume. Bena e bena Israeli bapeelwafye onse kuli ena.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni, ati,

english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
translation: Elyo balepomba icakutekapo ifisaniko pamo pene ne fibombelo fyonse mu cakufimbapo ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, elyo babike na pa mitembo yakusendelapo.

english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
translation: “Pa bulambo bwa golide balefimbapo insalu yacifufya, balefimbapo ne cakufimbapo na cimbi ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, elyo babikeko ne fimuti fyakupingilako.

english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
translation: Balebuula ne fipe fyonse ifyo babomfya mu cifulo camushilo, no kufipomba mu nsalu yacifufya. Kabili balefimbako ne cakufimbapo na cimbi ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, babike na pa mitembo yakusendelapo.

english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
translation: Bali nokukusa imito pa bulambo bwa mukuba no kwansapo insalu iyakashikila.

english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
translation: Nga bayanshikapo, elyo babikapo ifipe fyonse ifyo babomfya ku bulambo, ifyakubikapo umulilo ne mitunkwilo na bafosholo ne misambilo. Elyo bali nokufimbapo ne cakufimbapo ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, elyo babikeko ne fimuti fyakupingilako.

english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Ilyo Aroni na bana bakwe abaume bapwisha umulimo wakukupilisha bwino icifulo camushilo pamo pene ne fipe fya mu cifulo camushilo, ninshi na bonse mwaipekanya ukukuuka pa nkambi, elyo abena Koati bali nokwisa fisenda. Lelo nabo bene tabafwile kwikata ku fipe fyamushilo, epali bafwa. Awe abena Koati ebakulasenda ifya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
translation: “Eleasa mwana Aroni shimapepo, ewakulamona pa mafuta ya mu fisaniko, ububani ubwanunka ubusaka, imituulo ya fyabunga na mafuta yakusuba. Ewakulamona pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa pamo ne filimo, icifulo camushilo pamo pene ne fibombelo fyamushilo ifisangwamo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose na Aroni, ati,

english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
translation: “Mwikaleka aba mu ndupwa shakwa Koati ukuti bakalobe ukufuma ku bena Levi.

english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
translation: “Pendeni abena Koati aba mu luko lwakwa Levi, mubapendele mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
translation: Lelo aba mu ndupwa shakwa Koati tabafwile kwingila mu cifulo camushilo kukumona uko bashimapepo balelonga ifipe fyamushilo, nangu pa nshitafye inono, pantu kuti bafwa.”

english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
translation: “Penda abena Geshoni aba mu luko lwakwa Levi, ubapendele mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Upende abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
translation: Iyi e milimo abena Geshoni bakalabomba pamo no kulasenda ifipe.

english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
translation: Ebakalasenda ifisalu fyakucinga kwi Itenti lyakwa Lesa, Itenti Lyakukumaninamo ne cakufimbako icamukati ne cakufimbapo cakunse ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, pamo pene ne fyakufimba pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
translation: Ebakalasenda ne fisalu fyakucinga ulubansa lwa kwi Tenti lyakwa Lesa no bulambo, icisalu cakucinga pa mwinshi wakwingililapo mu lubansa, imyando na fyonse ifibombelo ifyakubomfyafye muli iyi milimo. Abena Geshoni ebali nokubomba fyonse ifilefwaikwa kuli ifi fintu.

english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
translation: Imilimo bakalabomba yonse, cibe yakusenda ifipe nangu yakubombafye, Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ebo bakalebakonkomesha. Uli nokubalanga fyonse ifyo bali nokusenda.

english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translation: Iyi e milimo bakalabomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo aba mu ndupwa shakwa Geshoni. Itama mwana shimapepo Aroni ewakulabangalila mu milimo yabo.”

english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
translation: Yawe aebele Mose, ati, “Penda abena Merari, ubapendele mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Upende abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
translation: Abena Merari ebakalabomba umulimo wakusenda impanda shakwimikila Itenti Lyakukumaninamo ne myalo, inceshi no twakwimikamo impanda shakwimikila Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.
translation: Kabili ebakalasenda ne nceshi shakucinga ulubansa, ifyakwimikamo inceshi, impopo ne myando ne fipe fyakubomfya kuli uyu mulimo. Cila mwaume mumupeelele kabela ifipe ali nokusenda.

english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
translation: Iyi e milimo indupwa sha bena Merari shili nokulabomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Itama mwana shimapepo Aroni ewakulabangalila mu milimo yabo.”

english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
translation: Kanshi Mose na Aroni ne ntungulushi sha lukuta lwa bena Israeli epakupenda abena Koati, mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo,

english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
translation: impendwa yabo mu ndupwa mu ndupwa shabo yali amakana yabili ne myanda cine lubali na makumi yasano (2,750).

english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
translation: Kanshi iyi eyali e mpendwa ya bantu ba mu ndupwa sha bena Koati bonse, ababomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, abo Mose na Aroni bapendele ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
translation: Abena Geshoni nabo bapendelwe mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
translation: Abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo,

english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
translation: Umulimo wa bena Koati mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo wakusunga ifintu ifyamushilo nganshi.

english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
translation: impendwa mu ndupwa mu ndupwa shabo yali amakana yabili ne myanda mutanda na amakumi yatatu (2,630).

english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.
translation: Kanshi iyi eyali e mpendwa ya bantu bonse aba mu ndupwa sha bena Geshoni, abalebomba mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, abo Mose na Aroni bapendele ngefyo Yawe abakonkomeshe.

english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
translation: Abena Merari nabo bapendelwe mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
translation: Abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo,

english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
translation: impendwa yabo mu ndupwa mu ndupwa shabo yali amakana yatatu ne myanda ibili (3,200).

english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
translation: Kanshi iyi eyali e mpendwa ya bantu bonse aba mu ndupwa sha bena Merari, abo Mose na Aroni bapendele ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
translation: Kanshi Mose na Aroni ne ntungulushi sha bena Israeli bapendele bonsefye abena Levi, mu ndupwa na mu mayanda yabo.

english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
translation: Abaume bonse abali ne myaka amakumi yatatu (30) ukufika na ku makumi yasano (50), abalingile ukulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kusenda ifipe,

english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
translation: impendwa yabo yali amakana cine konse konse ne myanda isano na makumi cine konse konse (8,580).

english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose, umuntu onse alipeelwe umulimo wakubomba ne cipe icakusenda. Awe bonse balipendelwe ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
translation: Elyo kabili bafwile ukufimbapo ne cakufimbapo na cimbi ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, ne nsalu yacifufya pamulu, elyo babikeko ne fimuti fyakupingilako.

english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
translation: “Petebulo lya mikate yakuba pa cinso candi, baleansapo insalu iyacifufya, elyo babikepo imbale, inweno shakubikamo ububani ne nweno sha mituulo ne mitondo ya mituulo ya fyakunwa. Imikate yakubapo inshita yonse petebulo yena taifwile ukubulwapo.

english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
translation: Pali ifi balefimbapo insalu iyakashika pamulu, elyo kabili balefimbapo ne cakufimbapo na cimbi ica mpapa ishisuma ishatelela, elyo babikeko ne fimuti fyakupingilako.

english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
translation: “Balebuula insalu yacifufya, balefimba pa cakutekapo ifisaniko, kumo kwine ne fisaniko, ifyakushimishako nangu ukukushishako ulubuuto ne mbale sha mito. Kabili na pali fyonse ifisungilwamo amafuta yakusanikila.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ukuti,

english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”
translation: Ifyabupe fyamushilo fyonse ifyo umuntu atuula fyakwe, nomba ifyo apeela shimapepo fyena fyakwa shimapepo.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli no kubeba ukuti ngo mwanakashi apondokela umulume wakwe no kukanaba uwacishinka,

english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;
translation: alala no mwaume umbi mu bumfisolo, kabili ifyo acita tafishibikwe ku mulume, no kukowela kwakwe takwishibikwe ico kushali bakambone abamusangilishe,

english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.
translation: kanshi umwaume uyo ali nokutwala umukashi wakwe kuli shimapepo. Pakuya kuli shimapepo, ali nokusenda ubunga bwa mutuulo bwa bale icapekumi cimo ca ku cipimo ca efa , ubwa pa mulandu wa mukashi. Lelo tafwile ukwitilapo amafuta nangu ukubikapo icinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi icanunka ubusaka pa bunga, pantu mutuulo wa cabunga uwa mulandu wa bufuba kabili mutuulo wa cabunga uwa cibukisho pakuti icishinka cishibikwe.

english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.
translation: “Shimapepo nao ali nokubuula uyu mwanakashi no kumwiminika pa cinso cakwa Yawe.

english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
translation: Elyo shimapepo akabuule amenshi yamushilo no kuyabika mu mutondo we bumba, kabili akabikemo no lukungu lwa mukati ke Tenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
translation: Ilyo shimapepo aiminika umwanakashi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, ali nokukakula umushishi wa uyo mwanakashi, no kubika ubunga bwa mutuulo bwa cibukisho mu minwe ekate, ekutila umutuulo wa cabunga wa pa bufuba. Shimapepo nao ninshi naikata ulunweno lwa menshi ayakantuka ayaleta ukulapishiwa.

english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
translation: Elyo shimapepo akalenga umwanakashi ukulapa nokutila kuli ena, ‘Iwe nga cakuti tawapondweke no mwaume umbi talala nobe, nga tawabembwike no kuikowesha ilyo waliba no mulume obe, aya menshi ayakantuka ayaleta ukulapishiwa tayakuletele ubwafya nangu bumo.

english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.
translation: “Konkomesha abena Israeli ukulatamfya umuntu onse mu nkambi uwalwala ubulwele bonse ubwambukila pa nkanda, nangu uo umubili wakwe upompa amafina mu musangofye onse, nangu umuntu onse uwakowela mukukumya ku citumbi ca muntu.

english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
translation: Lelo, nga walipondoka walala no mwaume umbi no kuikowesha ilyo waliba no mulume obe,

english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;
translation: Yawe nalenge abantu bonse bakulapishe no kukuseluka. Nalenge icisa cabufyashi cobe cisalwe ne fumo lyobe lifimbe.

english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”
translation: Amenshi aya ayaleta ukulapishiwa nayengile mu mubili obe, ne fumo lyobe lifimbe ne cisa cabufyashi cobe cisalwe.’ Umwanakashi nao pakwasuka atile, ‘Ameni, cibe ifyo fine.’

english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.
translation: “Elyo shimapepo afwile ukulemba ishi ntipu mu citabo icipombwa, kabili akasambile amalembo alembele mu menshi ayakantuka.

english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
translation: Shimapepo akapeela umwanakashi amenshi yakantuka ayaleta ukulapishiwa, nayo yakamuletele ukukalipwa munda nganshi.

english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokupoka ubunga ku mwanakashi ubwa mutuulo wa bufuba, abutambike kuli Yawe no kubuleta ku bulambo.

english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
translation: Elyo abuulepo ulupi lumo ulwa bunga ngo mutuulo wacibukisho no kubocela pa bulambo, panuma ya ifi aleke umwanakashi anwe amenshi.

english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.
translation: Nga cakuti aliikowesha no kukanaba uwacishinka nga anwa amenshi ayaleta ukulapishiwa, lyena yakamulenga ukukalipwa nganshi, ifumo lyakwe likafimba ne cisa cakwe cikesalika. Uyu mwanakashi akaba uwalapishiwa mu bantu bakwe.

english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti uyu mwanakashi wakaele, no kuikowesha taikowesha, amenshi tayali nakumucita nangu kamo, cikalangwa ukuti wakaele, akafyala na bana.

english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
translation: “Kanshi ili e funde lya pa bufuba, ngo mwanakashi uwaupwa abembuka no kuikowesha ilyo aba no mulume,

english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”
translation: Muletamfya aba bantu bonse abakowela abaume na banakashi mu nkambi, epakuti belakowesha nkambi yabo, umo ine njikala pakati kenu.”

english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.
translation: nangu umwaume alatunganya umukashi wakwe no kuba no bufuba. Umwanakashi ali nokwimikwa pa cinso cakwa Yawe, na shimapepo ali nokucita kuli ena fyonse ukulingana ne funde ili line.

english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”
translation: Umwaume tali nakukwata mulandu nangu panono, nomba umwanakashi nga euli no mulandu wa bubifi, ena alingile ukukandwa pa bubifi bwakwe.”

english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
translation: Abena Israeli balyumfwilile no kutamfya bonse abakowela ukufuma pa nkambi. Bacitilefye umo mwine Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,
translation: “Eba abena Israeli ukuti, umwaume nangu umwanakashi onse nga abifya ku mubiye mu nshila iyili yonse pakukanaba uwacine kuli ine ne Yawe, ala ninshi aba no mulandu kuli ine.

english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
translation: Uyu muntu afwile ukuyebelela no kufuta pa bubifi acitile. Afwile kabili alundepo cimo ica pali fisano pali ifyo alefuta ifyakupeela umuntu abifishe.

english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.
translation: Lelo uyo muntu babifishe nga cakuti afwa elyo takwete ba lupwa bakufutako, ninshi umuntu uwabifya ali nokufuta kuli Yawe, ali nokupeela icakufuta kuli shimapepo, pamo pene na sukusuku uwakuleka ilambo lyakufuta pa fibi fyakwe.

english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
translation: Onse umutuulo wamushilo untu abena Israeli baleta kuli shimapepo wakulaba wakwe.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translation: Elyo pa bushiku bwalenga cine konse konse ali nokuleta utubondo twa nkunda tubili nangu utupele tubili kuli shimapepo pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.
translation: Shimapepo nao ali nokuleka kamo ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi, elyo kambi nako ilambo lyakoca pakufuta pa fyabubifi fyakwe, pantu alikowela pakuba apali icitumbi ca muntu. Pali bulya bushiku bwine, ali nokusangulula umushishi wakwe nakabili.

english: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
translation: Afwile ailubwila umwine kuli Yawe inshita yonse ilya aipatula, kabili afwile ukuleta na kana ka mpaanga akalume aka mwaka umo aka mutuulo wakufuta pa fyabubifi. Inshiku aipatwile kale tashakabe nelyo cimo pantu aisa kowela panuma yakuipatula.

english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,
translation: “Nomba ili e funde lyakukonka Umunasiliti inshita yakwe iyakuipatwila nga yapwa. Bafwile ukumuleta pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,
translation: Palya epo ali nokupeelela imituulo yakwe iyi kuli Yawe: Akana ka mpaanga akalume aka mwaka umo akabula akalema akakuleka ilambo lyakoca, akana ka mpaanga akakota aka mwaka umo akabula ubulema aka mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo na sukusuku umo uwabula ubulema uwakutuula umutuulo wakwampana pamo.

english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.
translation: Alundepo umutuulo wa cabunga no wa cakunwa, umuseke umo uwa mikate yabulamo intutumushi, no tumikate twapangwa ku bunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ya miolifa, elyo no tumikate twapapatala utwasubwako amafuta ya miolifa, pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga no wa cakunwa.

english: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
translation: “Shimapepo ali nokutuula fyonse ifi pa cinso cakwa Yawe kabili atuulile umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi ne lambo lyakoca.

english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.
translation: Ali nokutuula umutuulo wakwampana pamo no kutuula ilambo lya sukusuku kuli Yawe, umuseke umo uwa mikate iyabula intutumushi, umutuulo wa cabunga no wa cakunwa.

english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.
translation: Elyo pa mwinshi we Tenti Lyakukumaninamo Umunasiliti abeye imishishi apatwilile kuli Yawe no kuiposa mu mulilo apalepya umutuulo wakwampana pamo.

english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;
translation: “Umunasiliti nga apwisha ukubeya umushishi wakuipatwilapo, shimapepo ali nokubuula ukuboko kwakwa sukusuku uwaipikwa, elyo na mu museke namo abuulemo umukate umo uwatikama na kamukate kamo akapapatala, fyonse umwabula intutumushi, no kupeela Umunasiliti pakuti eo ekate.

english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
translation: “Landa ku bena Israeli no kubeba ukuti, umwaume nangu umwanakashi onse nga apanga icilayo icakuipatwila kuli Yawe ngo Munasiliti,

english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.
translation: Shimapepo ali nokutambika ifi fyonse kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wa cakutambika. Fyena fyamushilo ifyo shimapepofye eka ewingasendako pamo ne cisao icatambikwa ne tanta ilituulilwe. Panuma ya ifi, Umunasiliti kuti anwa umwangashi.

english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”
translation: “Kanshi ili e funde lya Munasiliti uwalaya icilayo kuli Yawe ukulingana no kupatulwa kwakwe, ukucilapo pafyo umwine engaitemenwa ukupeela. Afwile ukufikilisha ifyo alaile ukulingana ne funde lya bunasaliti.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
translation: “Webe Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ukuti, aya e mashiwi balebomfya pakupaala abena Israeli, baletila,

english: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.
translation: “Yawe alemupaala no kumubaka.

english: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
translation: Yawe alenge icinso cakwe cimusanikile, kabili amukwatile ne cikuuku.

english: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
translation: Yawe namulange icinso cakwe kabili amupeele no mutende.

english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”
translation: “Ifi efyo bakalalumbula ishina lyandi, ilyo balepaala abena Israeli, na ine kabili nkabapaala.”

english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
translation: afwile ukuleka ukunwa ubwalwa bwa mwangashi ne cakunwa conse icikola. Elanwa icakunwa nangu cimo icakantuka icakamwa ku myangashi nangu icikola ca fintu fimbi. Tafwile kunwa icakunwa ca fitwalo fya myangashi nangu kulya imyangashi iyauma nangu iyishauma.

english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.
translation: Apofye acili Munasiliti, talingile kulya icili conse icafuma ku mwangashi, inseke nangufye ifipapa.

english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
translation: “Uyu muntu pa nshiku shonsefye isha cilayo cakwe icakuipatula, tafwile ukubeya ku mutwe, umushishi nangu imyefu. Afwile ukuba wamushilo mpaka inshiku alaile ishakuipatwila kuli Yawe shapwa. Alingile ukuleka umushishi ne myefu yakwe yalakulafye.

english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.
translation: Inshita yonse iyo aipatwila kuli Yawe tali nakupalama ku citumbi ca muntu.
