english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
translation: Nangufye cakwa wishi nangu nyina, nangu indume yakwe nangu inkashi yakwe nga ebafwile, tafwile kuikowesha pa mulandu wabo. Pantu icishibilo cakumwishibilako ukuti aliipatwila kuli Lesa caba pa mutwe wakwe.

english: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.
translation: Yonse inshita iyo ailubwila kuli Yawe aba uwamushilo.

english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
translation: “Kabili nga cakuti umuntu afwa imfwa yakupumikishafye pa menso ya Munasiliti, ninshi umushishi alubwila kuli Yawe wakowela. Alingile ukubeya umushishi ne myefu pa bushiku bwalenga cine lubali bwa kusangulula kwakwe.

english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;
translation: Pa bushiku Mose apwile ukwimika Itenti lyakwa Lesa, alisuba amafuta no kulilubwila kuli Yawe pamo ne fipe fyonse ifyabamo. Mose kabili asubile no bulambo pamo ne fibombelo fyabuko fyonse no kufilubwila kuli Yawe.

english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.
translation: Ilyo ubulambo bwasubilwe amafuta elyo intungulushi shatwala umutuulo pantanshi yabuko pakubulubwila kuli Yawe.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”
translation: Yawe epakweba Mose ati, “Cila bushiku intungulushi imo ileleta umutuulo uwakulubwilapo kuli Yawe ubulambo.”

english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,
translation: Uwaishile tuula umutuulo pa bushiku bwantanshi ni Nashoni mwana Aminadabu uwa mu luko lwakwa Yuda.

english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
translation: Umutuulo atuulile ni mbale ya silifa iyafina kilo umo na citika, no musambilo umo uwa silifa uwafina ukucila citika wa kilo, ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo. Fyonse fibili fyaleba ifyaisulamo ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino, ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ngo mutuulo wa cabunga.

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
translation: Elyo atuulile ne mbale imo iya golide iyafina tumashekeli ikumi limo iyaisulamo ububani.

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
translation: Atuulile ne ciponti cimo, sukusuku umo na kana ka mpaanga kamo akalume akalifye no mwaka umo, ifyakuleka ilambo lyakoca.

english: one male goat for a sin offering;
translation: Atuulile na sawe umo uwakuleka umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi,

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
translation: Kabili pakupeela umutuulo wakwampana, atuulile iŋombe shibili ishilume, basukusuku basano, basawe basano no twana twa mpaanga utulume tusano utuli no mwaka umo. Kanshi uyu ewali umutuulo wakwa Nashoni, umwana umwaume wakwa Aminadabu.

english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.
translation: Pa bushiku bwacibili uwaishile tuula umutuulo ni Netaneli mwana Suari, intungulushi ya luko lwakwa Isaka.

english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
translation: Umutuulo atuulile ni mbale ya silifa iyafina kilo umo na citika, no musambilo umo wa silifa uwafina ukucila citika wa kilo, ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo. Fyonse fibili fyaleba ifyaisulamo ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino, ubwasanshiwamo na mafuta ngo mutuulo wa cabunga.

english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;
translation: Elyo abakalamba ba nko sha bena Israeli, intungulushi sha mayanda ya bashibo pamo nabo abaleangalila bonse abapendelwe, batuulile umutuulo.

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
translation: Elyo atuulile ne mbale imo iya golide iyafina amagramu umwanda umo ne kumi limo, iyaisulamo ububani.

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
translation: Atuulile ne ciponti cimo, sukusuku umo na kana ka mpaanga kamo akalume akalifye no mwaka umo, ifyakuleka ilambo lyakoca.

english: one male goat for a sin offering;
translation: Atuulile na sawe umo uwakuleka umutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi.

translation: Kabili pa bushiku bwe kumi limo na shibili (12) uwaishile tuula umutuulo ni Ahira mwana Enani intungulushi ya mu luko lwakwa Naftali.

english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;
translation: Iyi e mituulo intu intungulushi sha bena Israeli shatuulile pakulubwila Yawe ubulambo, ilyo babusubile amafuta. Batuulile imbale sha silifa ikumi limo na shibili (12), imisambilo ya silifa ikumi limo na ibili (12) ne mbale sha golide nasho ikumi limo na shibili (12).

english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
translation: Cila mbale ya silifa yafinine kilo umo na citika, elyo cila musambilo wafinine ukucila citika wa kilo. Fyonse pamo ifya silifa fyafinine amakilo amakumi yabili na cine konse konse (28), ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo.

english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;
translation: Cila mbale ya golide iyaisula ububani yafinine amagramu umwanda umo ne kumi limo ukulingana ne cipimo ca mu cifulo camushilo. Imbale shonse ikumi limo na shibili isha golide shafinine ukucila panono pali kilo umo.

english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
translation: Impendwa ya nama she lambo lyakoca yali ifiponti fya ŋombe ishilume ikumi limo na fibili (12), basukusuku ikumi limo na babili (12), utwana twa mpaanga utwa mwakafye umo umo utulume ikumi limo na tubili (12) pamo pene ne fyamituulo fya cabunga. Basawe ikumi limo na babili (12) bali ba mutuulo wakwelelwa pa fyabubifi.

english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.
translation: Impendwa ya nama shakoca ilambo lyakwampana yonse yali amakumi yabili na shine (24) aya bacilume wa ŋombe, basukusuku bali amakumi mutanda (60), basawe amakumi mutanda (60), utwana twa mpaanga ishilume isha mwaka umo umo nato twali amakumi mutanda (60). Iyi yali e mituulo yakulubwila ubulambo kuli Yawe panuma babusubile amafuta.

english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
translation: Ilyo Mose aingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo kukulanda na Yawe, aleumfwa ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lilelanda kuli ena ukufuma pa mulu wa Nkupiko ya Mbokoshi ya Cipangano apakufutilapo ifyabubifi, pakati ka bakerubi babili.

english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.
translation: Lelo Mose tapeeleko abena Koati nangu kamo pa maceleta ne ŋombe, pantu bena ebalesenda ifipe fyamushilo pa mabeya ngo mulimo wabo.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
translation: Ukalete abena Levi pa cinso cakwa Yawe, kabili na bena Israeli bakatambalikepo amaboko yabo pa mitwe yabo.

english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.
translation: Aroni akalubwile abena Levi kuli ine ne Yawe ngo mutuulo wakutambika untu abena Israeli bantuula. Epakuti balebomba imilimo yakwa Yawe.

english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
translation: Abena Levi nga batambalika amaboko pa mitwe ya bacilume wa ŋombe babili, umo ali nokutuulwa kuli Yawe ngo mutuulo wakwelelwa pa bubifi, elyo umbi nao nge lambo lyakoca ilyakufuta pa fyabubifi fya bena Levi.

english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.
translation: “Leka abena Levi beminine pantanshi yakwa Aroni na bana bakwe abaume no kubatuula ngo mutuulo wakutambika kuli Yawe.

english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
translation: Ifi efyo ukapatula abena Levi ukufuma ku bena Israeli bambi, na bena Levi bakaba bandi.

english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
translation: Nga wapwisha ukusangulula abena Levi no kubatuula ngo mutuulo wakutambika, elyo bakaleisa mukubomba umulimo wabo mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
translation: Bena mu bena Israeli ebafwile ukupeelwa onse kuli ine. Nalibacita abandi pa malo ya mabeli ya bana abaume aba mwanakashi onse umwina Israeli.

english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
translation: Ibeli lyonse ilyaume mu Israeli, umuntu nangu inama, lyandi. Ilyo naipeye amabeli yonse mu Egupto, nalibapatwila kuli ne mwine.

english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
translation: Lelo nalibuula abena Levi pa malo ya bana abaume bonse amabeli ya bena Israeli.

english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
translation: Pali bonse abena Israeli napeela abena Levi kuli Aroni na bana bakwe abaume ngo bupe, pakuti balebombela abena Israeli umulimo wa mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo. Kabili ebo balebafutilako pa filubo, pakutila icinkunka tacibaponene nga bapalama mupepi ne cifulo camushilo.”

english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
translation: “Landa na Aroni, umwebe auti, nga wateka ifisaniko cine lubali, ulefiteka apakuti ulubuuto lulesanikila kuntanshi ya cakutekapo ifisaniko.”

english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
translation: Mose, Aroni no lukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli bonse nabo bacitile abena Levi ngefyo Mose bamukonkomeshe kuli Yawe.

english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
translation: Abena Levi nabo baisangulula, bacapa ne fyakufwala fyabo. Elyo Aroni abatuula ngo mutuulo wakutambika ku cinso cakwa Yawe. Kabili abafutilako na pa filubo pakuti basangululwe.

english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
translation: Panuma ya ifi, abena Levi baingila mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo mukubomba imilimo yabo. Abalebangalila ni Aroni na bana bakwe abaume. Ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose, efyo bacitile abena Levi.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
translation: “Ifi efyo cili nokuba ku bena Levi. Abaume abali ne myaka amakumi yabili na isano (25) no kucilapo ebali nokulabombela mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo.

english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,
translation: Lelo bakalaleka ukubomba imilimo ya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo nga bafisha imyaka amakumi yasano (50).

english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”
translation: Nga baleka, kuti baleafwako abena Levi banabo ukulabomba imilimo ya mwi Tenti Lyakukumaninamo, lelo tabafwile ukubomba iyi milimo, bena kwafwakofye. Kanshi ifi efyo wakulaakanya abena Levi imilimo.”

english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translation: Aroni nao efyo acitile. Atekele ifisaniko apakuti filesanikila pantanshi ya cakutekapo ifisaniko ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.
translation: Ifi efyo icakutekapo ifisaniko capangilwe. Capangilwe na golide iyo bafulila ku nondo, ukufumafye pamulu apafulilwe amaluba no kufika na panshi. Icakutekapo ifisaniko capangilwe ukulingana nefyo Yawe alangile Mose.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
translation: “Buula abena Levi no kubapatula ku bena Israeli bonse, ubasangulule no kubasangulula.

english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
translation: Ucite ifi pakubasangulula. Ubasanse amenshi yakubasangulwila, bali nokubeya umubili onse elyo bacape ne fyakufwala fyabo, lyena ninshi baisangulula.

english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
translation: Babuule iciponti cimo, pamo no mutuulo wa cabunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino ubwasanshiwamo amafuta. Elyo babuule ne ciponti cabubili icakutuula umutuulo wakufuta pa bubifi.

english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
translation: Ukeminike abena Levi pa ntanshi ye Tenti Lyakukumaninamo no kulonganika ulukuta lonse ulwa bena Israeli bonse.

english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
translation: Mu matololo ya Sinai mu mweshi wakubalilapo, mu mwaka walenga bubili apo abena Israeli bafumine mu calo ca Egupto, Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.
translation: “Eba abena Israeli ati, umo pali imwe nangu pa bana benu nga aikowesha ico akumishe ku citumbi ca muntu, nangu ico ali kumbi pa bulendo, kuti nalyo line basefya inshikunkulu yakwa Yawe iye Pasaka.

english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
translation: Mu mweshi wabubili emo bafwile ukusefya pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14) cilya akasuba kawa. Bali nokulya umwana wa mpaanga, kumo ne mikate ishatutumuka ne misalu iyalula.

english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
translation: Beshapo nelyo kamo akakuti kafika ku ulucelo, nangu ukutoba amafupa ya nama tabafwile kutoba iyoo. Ilyo balesefya inshikunkulu ye Pasaka bakonke amafunde yonsefye.

english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
translation: Nomba umuntu nga ali uwasanguluka, kabili tali pa bulendo, lelo akaanafye ukusefya inshikunkulu ye Pasaka, uyo muntu wakutamfyafye mu bantu bandi, pantu akaana ukutuula umutuulo kuli Yawe pa nshita yapimwa. Uyo muntu ailetelelafye umwine ku bubifi bwakwe.

english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”
translation: Ngo mwinafyalo uo mwikala nankwe nao alefwaya ukusefyako inshikunkulu yakwa Yawe iye Pasaka, nasefyeko, lelo akonke amafunde ne fipope fya nshikunkulu yonsefye. Amafunde yakukonka mukakwate yamo yene ku muntu onse, nangu abe umwinafyalo nangu umukaya.”

english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
translation: Ubushiku Itenti lyakwa Lesa ilya Cipangano lyapwile ukwimikwa, ikumbi lyaishile likupa. Ukufuma icungulo ukufika ulucelo, ikumbi lyakupile Itenti lyalemoneka ngo mulilo.

english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
translation: Efyo kanshi catwalilile ukuba, akasuba ikumbi lyalelikupa elyo bushiku lyalemoneka ngo mulilo.

english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
translation: Lyonsefye ilyo ikumbi lyaima pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa, abena Israeli nabo balefuma pali ilya nkambi, kabili apo ikumbi lyaiminina, nabo epo bacita inkambi.

english: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
translation: Abena Israeli balekuuka pa nkambi ilyo Yawe abeba ukukuuka, kabili ilyo abeba ukucita inkambi balecita. Tabalefuma pa nkambi ikumbi nga nalikupa Itenti lyakwa Lesa.

english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.
translation: Ikumbi nga lyaikala pe Tenti lyakwa Lesa pa nshita itali, abena Israeli nabo baleikalafye pali iyo nkambi mukunakila ifyo Yawe abakonkomeshe.

english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
translation: “Uleke abena Israeli basefye Ipasaka , inshikunkulu ya Cakucilila, pa nshita yapimwa,

english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.
translation: Limo limo ikumbi lyaleikala pamulu we Tenti lyakwa Lesa inshiku ishinonofye. Yawe nga abakonkomesha ukuti bacite inkambi ninshi kucita, elyo kabili nga atila bafume pa nkambi ninshi kufumapo.

english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
translation: Inshita shimo ikumbi lyaleikalafye ukufuma icungulo ukufika ulucelo, kabili ilyo lyaima mu lucelo nabo baleima ukufuma pali iyo nkambi. Cibe bushiku nangu akasuba, inshita yonse ikumbi lyaima nabo ninshi kwima.

english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
translation: Ikumbi nga lyaikala pamulu we Tenti lyakwa Lesa inshiku shibili, nangu umweshi umo, nangu umwaka umo na bena Israeli nabo ninshi baleikala apo pene pa nkambi ukwabula ukuselapo. Nomba nge kumbi lyaima, nabo ninshi kufumapo.

english: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
translation: Balenakila ifyo Yawe abeba ukupitila muli Mose. Yawe nga abakonkomesha ukuti bacite inkambi ninshi kucita, elyo kabili nga Yawe abakonkomesha ukufuma pa nkambi ninshi kufumapo.

english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”
translation: Mukasefye pa nshita iyalinga pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine (14) mu mweshi wine uyu, ukutendekafye lilya akasuba kawa. Mukakonke amafunde ne fipope fya pa nshikunkulu ye Pasaka.”

english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.
translation: Kanshi Mose epakweba abantu ukuti basefye inshikunkulu ye Pasaka.

english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
translation: Abena Israeli epakusefya inshikunkulu ye Pasaka mu matololo ya Sinai lilya akasuba kawa, pa bushiku bwalenga ikumi limo na shine mu mweshi wakubalilapo. Abena Israeli bacitilefye fyonse ngefyo Yawe akonkomeshe Mose.

english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.
translation: Lelo abaume bamo tabasefesheko Ipasaka pali ubo bushiku pantu bali abakowela ico bakumishe ku citumbi ca muntu. Kanshi abo bantu epakuya kuli Mose na Aroni pa bushiku bwine bulya

english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
translation: no kumweba abati, “Ifwe tuli abakowela pantu natukumya ku citumbi ca muntu, nomba bushe cinshi batulesesha ukutuula umutuulo kuli Yawe pamo na bena Israeli banensu pa nshita yapimwa?”

english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”
translation: Mose abasuka ati, “Pembeleni muleke ŋumfwe ifyo Yawe alalanda pali imwe.”

english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
translation: Elyo Yawe aebele Mose ati,

english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
translation: Icimonwa cakwa Obadia. Ifi efyasosa Yawe palwa bena Edomu.

english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
translation: “Pantu iwe walefyenga no kwipaya bamunonko abena Yakobo,

english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
translation: Amosi 1:11-12

english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
translation: Iwe nga tawaingile mu musumba wa bantu bandi,

english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
translation: Iwe nga tawalelolela pa masansa ya nshila,

english: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
translation: “Ubushiku bwakwa Yawe buli mupepi,

english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
translation: Nga filya fine wanwene pa lupili lwandi ulwamushilo,

english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
translation: “Lelo pa lupili lwa Sioni pakaba bamo abakapusuka,

english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
translation: Iŋanda yakwa Yakobo ikaba mulilo uoca,

english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
translation: “Abena Israeli aba mu matololo ya Negebu

english: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
translation: Mala 1:2-5

english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.
translation: Ifita fya bena Israeli ifyaba muli bunkole

english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.
translation: Abena Israeli abacimfya bakanina ulupili lwa Sioni

english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
translation: Icilumba ca mu mutima obe calakubepa,

english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
translation: Nangu wingalelemba mumulu apatali kwati ni kapumpe,

english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
translation: Esaya 34:5-17

english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
translation: Lelo we Esau bali nokukushafye nakalya nakalya,

english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
“Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe ati, “Muli bulya ubushiku,

english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
translation: Impalume sha mu Temani shili nokutiina,

english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
translation: Ine Paulo, ndi mu cifungo pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu. Tuli na munyinefwe Timote.

english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
translation: Kanshi ndekupapata pa mwana wandi Onesimo, uo nafyele muno mwine mu cifungo pakumuleta mu cisumino.

english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
translation: Kale talekubombela nelyo cimo, lelo nomba aletubombela, iwe wine na ine.

english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
translation: Ndemubwesesha kuli iwe, uo natemwa no mutima wandi onse.

english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
translation: Kwena nalefwaya ukuti tuleikala nankwe kuno, pakuti alengafwilishako mu cifulo cobe ilyo ncili mu cifungo pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma.

english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
translation: Lelo kwena nshalefwaya ukucita nelyo cimo ukwabula iwe ukuti usuminishe. Lelo nalefwaya ukuti wangafwilishako kukutemwafye kobe, ukwabula ukupatikishiwa.

english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
translation: Nalimo ico Onesimo afumine kuli iwe pa nshita inono, ni pakuti ilyo abwela, ukaleikala nankwe inshita yonse.

english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
translation: Nomba tali mushafye epela, lelo nacilapo nganshi pa musha. Ine, ni munyinane uo natemwa. Ine nalimutemwa nganshi, palibufi iwe taukamutemwa no kucilapo, apo muntu munobe kabili uo mwampana nankwe mu Mfumu!

english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
translation: Eico, iwe nga utila ine ndi mubomfi munobe, kanshi umusekelele nga filya fine wingansekelela.

english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
translation: Nga alikulufyanyapo cimo, nangu alikongolapo cimo kuli iwe, ukandipilishe.

english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
translation: Ine wine Paulo nalalemba no kuboko kwandi ukuti, NKAKULIPILA. Lelo nshili nakukucinkulako ukuti inkongole shobe kuli ine, mweo obe we mwine uwa bwina Kristu.

english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
translation: Twalembela uyu kalata na ku lukuta ululongana mumobe, na kuli nkashi yesu Afia, na Akipo uulwa ubulwi bwa Mfumu pamo na ifwe.

english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
translation: Kanshi we munyinane, apo twaampana ne Mfumu, nakupapata ncitila ico ndelomba. Ala nsansamushako, ndi munonko muli Kristu.

english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
translation: Ine ilyo ndelemba ifi, nincetekela ukuti ukacita ico ndekulomba. Kabili ninjishiba nokuti ukacita ne ficililepo.

english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
translation: Elyo na cimbi nici, umpekanisheko umuputule. Pantu ndesubila ukuti Lesa akomfwa amapepo yenu bonse, kabinge akambwesesha na kuli imwe.

english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
translation: Epafula, uo tuli nao mu cifungo pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu, alekuposha.

english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
translation: Mako, Alistako, Dema na Luka, ababomfi banandi, nabo bakuposha.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe bonse.

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe na Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu fingalaba na imwe.

english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
translation: We munyinane Filemoni, ine ndatasha Lesa wandi lyonsefye ilyo ndekupepelako.

english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
translation: Pantu ndeumfwa palwa citemwiko cobe ne cisumino wakwata mu Mfumu Yesu na ku bamushilo bonse.

english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
translation: Ine mpepa ukuti ukwampana kwesu mu cisumino, kukalenga ukuti tumfwikishe ifisuma fyonse ifyo twashukila mu bumi bwesu ico twaampana na Kristu.

english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
translation: We munyinefwe, icitemwiko cobe calindetela insansa no kunkoseleshako, pantu nausansamusha abamushilo.

english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
translation: Kanshi eico apo uli munyinane muli Kristu, kuti napama ukukweba ifyo ufwile ukucita.

english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wakuti nalikutemwa, awe nalakupapatafye. Ine ne Paulo ne mukote, kabili ndi mu cifungo pa mulandu wakwa Kristu.

english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
translation: Ine Paulo na Timote, fwe basha bakwa Kristu Yesu, twamulembela imwe mwe bamushilo bonse aba mu Filipi, mwe baba muli Kristu Yesu pamo pene na bakangalila ba lukuta na badikoni.

english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
translation: Lyena mukeshiba bwino ifintu ifiwamishepo. Elyo pa Bushiku bwakwa Kristu mukaba abakaele ababula icilubo.

english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
translation: Mu bumi bwenu mukaba ne mibeele yonse iyo Lesa afwaya, iyo Yesu Kristu akalenga mukwate, pakuti mukalelumbanya no kulatasha Lesa.

english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
translation: Bamunyinane, ndefwaya mwishibe ukuti ifintu ifyamponena nafingafwa icine cine ukulundulula Imbila Nsuma.

english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
translation: Kanshi ifita fyonse ifilonda kuno isano na bantu bambi bonse nabeshiba ukuti ico bamposela mu cifungo nico ndi mubomfi wakwa Kristu.

english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
translation: Kabili ukuposwa kwandi mu cifungo nakulenga bamunyinefwe abengi ukuba abashipa, icakuti bali abapama tabalekwata na mwenso ukufunda amashiwi ya Mfumu.

english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
translation: Bamo kwena babila Kristu ku mulandu wa mufimbila ne fikansa, lelo bambi bena mulandu wakuba abantu abasuma.

english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
translation: Aba bantu basuma bena bacita ifyo ku mulandu wa citemwiko, pantu balishiba ukuti Lesa andeta muno pakuti mombe umulimo wakupokololako Imbila Nsuma.

english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
translation: Lelo balya bambi bena tababa na cishinka mukubila Kristu. Mwabafye umutima wabukaitemwe. Batontonkanyafye pakumfushishako amacushi ilyo ncili mu cifungo.

english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
translation: Ici cena te mulandu! Lelo icintu icikalamba cakuti nangu babombe no mutima usuma nangu ubi, balebila Kristu. Elyo ici cilenga ukuti mbe ne nsansa, kabili icine cine nkalasansamuka.

english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
translation: Pantu ninjishiba ukuti pa mulandu wa ici, elyo no mulandu wa mapepo yenu na ku bwafwilisho ubufuma kuli Mupashi wakwa Yesu Kristu, nkafuma mu cifungo.

english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
translation: Ico mfwaisha no kutetekela cakuti nikatala ŋumfwa insoni pa mulimo wandi. Lelo pa nshita yonse elyo ukucila pali ino ine nshita, nakulaba uwapama nganshi pakuti, ilyo ndi umumi nangu ndi mukufwa, ndeletela Kristu umucinshi mu bumi bwandi bonse.

english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
translation: Pantu kuli ine ubumi ni Kristu. Kabili imfwa yena ikandetela ificililepo.

english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
translation: Nomba nga cakuti ukwikala umumi nga kuti kwalenga nabomba imilimo ikankala, lyena nshishibe icakuti nsalepo.

english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
translation: Ifintu fibili filentinta mu bumi bwandi. Ndefwaisha nganshi ukufuma muli buno bumi no kuya ikala na Kristu. Ici cena cawamapo ukucila.

english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wa imwe, cilefwaikwa nganshi ukuti nshale pano calo umumi.

english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
translation: Ici cena ninshininkisha. Ninjishiba ukuti twakulaba nenu. Twakulaba na imwe bonse pakuti mukulileko mu cisumino, cilemuletela ne nsansa.

english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
translation: Epakuti ilyo nkabwelela nakabili kuli imwe, insansa mwakwata pakuba muli Kristu Yesu shikacilileko pa mulandu wa ine.

english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
translation: Kanshi icintu icikalamba mu bumi bwenu, kwikala ngefyo Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu ifwaya. Epakuti nangu cakuti naisa mupempula nangu cakuti nshishileko, lelo ndeumfwa ukuti mwaba abakosa nganshi, aba mutima umo. Kabili nokuti bonse pamo mufwayafye icintu cimo, ukulwisha capamo ukuti abantu basumine Imbila Nsuma.

english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
translation: Mwilatiina balwani benu, lelo lyonse muleba abashipa. Ici cikaba icilangililo cacine cine icakuti bena bakalobelela, lelo imwe mukapusuka. Uukacita fyonse ifi ni Lesa.

english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
translation: Pantu imwe mwalipeelwa ishuko pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, te lyakumusuminafye iyoo lelo ne lyakumuculila.

english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
translation: Ine ndatasha Lesa lyonsefye ilyo ntontonkanya pali imwe.

english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
translation: Kanshi na imwe nomba muli na ine mu bulwi. Ni bulya bulwi bumo bwine mwamwene ndelwa na kale, ebo bwine na nomba muleumfwa ncili ndelwa.

english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
translation: Kabili lyonse ilyo mupepelako imwe bonse, mpepa ne nsansa.

english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
translation: Pantu ukufumafye ubushiku bwakubalilapo ilyo mwaumfwile Imbila Nsuma ukufika na nomba, mwabikapofye ukungafwa mu mulimo wakubila Imbila Nsuma.

english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
translation: Kanshi nalishininkisha ukuti, Lesa uwatendeke uyu mulimo usuma muli imwe, akulakonkanyapofye ukuubomba mpaka no kuupwisha pa Bushiku bwakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
translation: Kabili lyonse nshimulaba, kanshi nacilinga nokuti ndetontonkanya ifi pali imwe. Pantu imwe bonse mwalikuma ku cikuuku ico Lesa ampeela, nelyo line ndi mu cifungo nangu ndepokololako no kushimpa Imbila Nsuma.

english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
translation: Lesa e kambone wandi. Ala ndamufuluka nganshi bonse, pantu nalimutemwa ne citemwiko Kristu umwine amukwatila.

english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
translation: Ndapepa nokuti icitemwiko cenu cilelundulukilakofye apakalamba mukukula, pamo pene na mu mano elyo na mukwiluka pa fintu.

english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
translation: Bushe ukuba muli Kristu kulamukosha? Bushe icitemwiko cakwa Kristu cilamukoselesha? Bushe mwalyampana na Mupashi? Bushe mwaliba no luse ne cilela ku banenu?

english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
translation: Epakuti peshina lyakwa Yesu, ifibumbwa fyonse mu mulu, pano calo ne fya pesamba lya calo filemufukamina.

english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
translation: Kabili pakulumbanya Lesa Wishi

english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
translation: Eico bamunyinane filya lyonse mwalenakila ilyo twali na imwe, efyo muli nokulanakila ukucilapo ico nomba nshili na imwe. Kanshi imwe mukonkanyepo ukulabomba umulimo we pusukilo lyenu na katiina no mwensopo.

english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
translation: Pantu ni Lesa lyonse eubomba muli imwe pakuti mulefwaya no kulacita ifyo umwine afwaya.

english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
translation: Mulecita fyonse ukwabula ukuilishanya nangu ifikansa.

english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
translation: Lyena mukaba abana bakwa Lesa abapwililika, ababula icilubo kabili abakaele, nangu mwikala mu nkulo ya bantu ababufi kabili ababi. Imwe muli nokuba ulubuuto pakati kabo, mulesanika kwati ni ntanda mu mulu.

english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
translation: Mulebashimikilako ishiwi ilipeela umweo. Nga efyo mwalacita, lyena nkaba ne cakumfwilapo icilumba pa Bushiku bwakwa Kristu. Pantu cikalanga ukuti mu kubutukisha kwandi no kuipamfya mukubomba, nshaicushishefye iyoo.

english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
translation: Kabili nga cakuti umweo wandi wapeelwa nge cakunwa icaitilwa pelambo ilyaba e mutuulo uo icisumino cenu cilekela Lesa, ala kuti nasansamuka no kwanga na imwe bonse pamo.

english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
translation: Kabili na imwe bene kuti mwasansamuka no kwanga pamo na ine.

english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
translation: Imfumu Yesu nga ilefwaya, nalaswa mutumine Timote bwangu bwangu. Pakuti nga naumfwa ifyo muli, na ine cikankoselesheko.

english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
translation: Kanshi akundeteleni insansa ishine shine mukuba na mano yamo yene, abatemwana, kabili ababombela pamo no mutima umo.

english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
translation: Kuno nshikweteko umbi uwakwata umutima uwakumusakamana icine cine nga ena.

english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
translation: Pantu cila muntu kuno asakamanafye ifintu fyakwe umwine, te fya pali Kristu Yesu nakalya.

english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
translation: Bonse mwalishiba ukuti Timote abafye bwino. Mwalishiba ifyo ena na ine tubombela pamo pa mulandu wa Mbila Nsuma kwati ni mwane na wishi.

english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
translation: Kanshi ndesubila nkamutuma bwangu kuli imwe, kumfwafye naishiba ifyo ifintu fili nokuba pali ine.

english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
translation: Na ine wine nincetekela mu Mfumu ukuti na ine wine nalaswa njisefye bwangu kuli imwe.

english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
translation: Kabili ntontonkanya ukuti cilefwaikwa natuma munyinane Epafulodito abwelele kuli imwe. Uyu wena mubomfi munandi kabili uulwa ubulwi bwa Mfumu pamo na ine, kabili eo mwatumine mukuleta ifyakungafwilishako.

english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
translation: Alefwaisha nganshi ukumumona bonse. Kabili ali uwasakamana nganshi ico mwaumfwile ukuti alilwele.

english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
translation: Ee, cacine alilwele, kabili alifye mupepi ne mfwa. Lelo Lesa alimulangulukilako, kwena teofye eka, lelo na ine wine, pantu alimpusushako na kuli bumbi ubulanda ubukalamba.

english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
translation: Eico ine napamfiwilwa ukumubwesha kuli imwe, pakuti nga mwamumona mukasansamuke nakabili, na ine lyena ninshi amasakamiko yakacepako.

english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
translation: Mumusekelele ne nsansa nganshi nga munyinenwe mu Mfumu. Mulecindika abantu ba musango ngoyu.

english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
translation: Mwilacita nelyo cimo pa mulandu wakuitemwa nangu ukuitutumuna ku cilumba, lelo muleicefya ku banenu, lyonse mulemona ukuti abanenu nabacilapo pafyo mwaba.

english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
translation: Pantu alifye mupepi ne mfwa pa mulandu wakubombela Kristu. Pakutifye angafwilisheko ne cafwilisho mushampeele ico mushalipo, tatiinine nangu ukulofya umweo wakwe.

english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
translation: Kabili mulemona ukuti mulecita ifyakuwamina abanenu, te fyakumuwaminafye mwe bene.

english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
translation: Fyonse ifyo mulecita, muleficita no mutima Kristu Yesu akwete!

english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
translation: Kristu wena nangu aba ni Lesa,

english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
translation: Lelo aisangwile uwafye,

english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
translation: Kabili apo ali ngo muntu, aliicefeshe,

english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
translation: Eico Lesa alimusansabalike ukucila pali fyonse,

english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
translation: Pakulekelesha bamunyinane ndeti, “Mulesansamuka ico mwaampana ne Mfumu.” Ine nshitendwa ukulamulembela pa fintu fimo fine ifyo namulembele kale. Ncita ifi pakumubaka.

english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
translation: Ico ndefwaishafye kwishiba Kristu na maka ya kushukuka kwakwe. Ndefwaisha ukwampana nankwe mu macushi aculileko na mu mfwa afwileko.

english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
translation: Pakuti na ine nkabushiwe umumi ukufuma ku bafwa.

english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
translation: Ine nshileitunga ukuti nalifikapo mukuba umusuma nangu ukuba uwapwililika. Lelo mbikapofye ukubutuka pakuti nkapoke icilambu pantu Kristu Yesu alimbuula ukuba umuntu wakwe.

english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
translation: Kwena bamunyinane ine nshiletontonkanya ukuti nalifika kukucipoka. Icintu cimo ico ncita, kulaba ku fyapita elyo ukubombesha na maka ukupoka ifili kuntanshi.

english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
translation: Kanshi ine mbutuka ukulungamafye apo bapima ukupelela pakuti mone ukupoka icilambu. Ici cilambu mweo wa mu mulu uo Lesa atwitako pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
translation: Ifwe bonse fwe bakula mu cisumino, iyi e mitontonkanishishe na ifwe tuli nokukwata. Lelo nga cakuti pa fintu fimo bamo pali imwe balatontonkanya ifyapusana nefi, Lesa akalenga ukuti mukafishibe bwino.

english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
translation: Lelo pa nshita ino natukonkanyepofye ukwikala ngomo twaishibila.

english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ala mulempashanya. Mulemona kuli abo bakonka imyendele yesu iyo twamulanga.

english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
translation: Imikufye iyingi nalimwebelepo, na lelo nalabwekeshapo, ndelila ne filamba. Epo bali abengi abo mu bumi bwabo baleikala nga balwani ba musalaba wakwa Kristu.

english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
translation: Uko aba bantu bakapelela ni kukulobelela, pantu amafumo yabo e mulungu wabo. Bena bomfwa icilumba pa fintu bafwile ukumfwilapo insoni, kabili amano yabo yabafye pa fintu fya pano calo.

english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
translation: Cenjeleni ku bantu bacita ifibi, cenjeleni kuli isho mbwa, cenjeleni kuli abo bantu abatila muli nokusembululwa.

english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
translation: Ifwe kumwesu ni ku mulu, kabili tulelolela nganshi Umupusushi wesu, Imfumu Yesu Kristu ukufuma ku mulu.

english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
translation: Akesa alula imibili yesu iyanakuka kabili iyinakufwa, akalenge ikapale umubili wakwe uwacindama. Akabomfya amaka ayalenga ukuti alete ifintu fyonse kukulamunakila.

english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
translation: Pantu nifwe twapokelela ukusembululwa kwacine cine, bena iyoo. Pantu ifwe ni Mupashi wakwa Lesa eututungulula mukupepa. Tulaitakisha pa mulandu wakuba na Kristu Yesu, tatucetekela mu ntambi shabuntunse.

english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
translation: Kwena na ine nga kuti nacetekela intambi shabuntunse. Nga kwingaba uwakutontonkanya palwa kucetekela intambi shabuntunse, ninshi nine ningacilapo ukutontonkanya ifyo.

english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
translation: Ine nasembulwilwe ilyo nali ne nshiku cine konse konse ishakufyalwa. Ine ndi wa mu mushobo wa bena Israeli, uluko lwandi lwa bena Benjamini. Ndi Muhibulu wine wine na bafyashi bandi bonse Bahibulu. Elyo nga ni kukukonka Amafunde yakwa Mose, ine ndi Mufalise.

english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
translation: Kabili nali uwacincila nganshi, ecalengele nokuti ndecusha ulukuta. Elyo nga kuba uwakaele ico umuntu alenakila Amafunde yakwa Mose, awe nshalipo na cilubo.

english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wakwa Kristu, ifintu ifyo nalemona ukuti fikankala kuli ine, nomba mfimona ukuti fyafyefye.

english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
translation: Teifi fyeka iyoo lelo, mona ifintu fyonse ukuti fyafyefye pa mulandu wa cintu ici icikankala icacilapo, icakwishiba Yesu Kristu Imfumu yandi. Pa mulandu wakwa Kristu nalisuulako kuli fyonse. Ifintu fyonse mfimonafye ifinangwa pakuti nshukile Kristu,

english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
translation: tuleba nankwe pamo. Nomba ine ne mwine nshaba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa pa mulandu wakunakila Amafunde yakwa Mose. Lelo nomba naba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa pa mulandu wakusumina muli Kristu. Uku kuba uwakaele kwafuma kuli Lesa, kabili kwashintilila pa cisumino.

english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
translation: Kanshi bamunyinane, ala nalimutemwa, kabili ndamufuluka nganshi. Ala mulansansamusha, kabili ndomfwa icilumba nganshi pali imwe. Bamunyinane mwe batemwikwa bandi, kanshi ifi efyo muli nokuba abakosa ico mwampana ne Mfumu.

english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
translation: Imfumu nailenga ukuti nsansamuke nganshi pantu panuma ya nshita iyikalamba, nakabili namukwata ishuko lyakulanga ukuti mwalinsakamana. Nshiletila mwalilekele ukunsakamana, lelo nicofye mushakwete ishuko lyakulanga ifyo.

english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
translation: Nshilelanda ifi ico nshikwete ifyo ndekabila. Ine calishibila ukwikala notu twine nkwete.

english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
translation: Nalishiba ifyo ukukabila kwaba, elyo nalishiba nefyo ukukwata ifingi nako kwaba. Nalisambilila inkaama yakubelesha ifyakwikala mu misango yonse, cibe ni mukukwata ifingi nangu ni mukukwata utunono.

english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
translation: Ine kuti nacita fyonse ku maka Kristu ampeela.

english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
translation: Lelo kwena mwawemye nganshi pakungafwa mu macushi yandi.

english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
translation: Imwe mwe bena Filipi mwalishibafye bwino ukuti ilyo nafumine ku Makedonia mu nshikufye shilya shine ilyo natampile ukubila Imbila Nsuma, tapali lukuta nelyo lumo ulwangafwileko, kanofye imwe nimwe twaampene na imwe mu fyakupeela na mu fyakupokelela.

english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
translation: Ilyo nali mu Tesalonika mwalintumine ifyakungafwako ifyo nalekabila ukucila na pa muku umo.

english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
translation: Kanshi nshilefwayafye ukulapokelela ubupe, lelo kuti nafwaya ukumona ukuti icipao cenu cilundulukilakofye.

english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
translation: Nalipokelela fyonse ifyo mwampeela, nomba naficilapo! Epafulodito alindetela ifya bupe bwenu fyonse, kanshi nomba ninkwata fyonse ifyo nalekabila. Ala ifya bupe bwenu fili kwati mutuulo uwa cena cisuma, kuli Lesa ilambo ilyo apokelela ne nsansa.

english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
translation: Kabili Lesa wandi mu bukankala bwa bucindami bwakwe akulamupeela fyonse ifyo mulekabila pa mulandu wakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
translation: Yuodia na Suntuke ndemupapata ukuti muleumfwana apo bonse mwaampana ne Mfumu.

english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation: Lesa wesu kabili Shifwe nalelumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
translation: Ndeposha abamushilo bonse, ababa muli Kristu Yesu. Bamunyinefwe ndi nabo kuno balemuposha.

english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
translation: Abamushilo bonse tuli nabo kuno balemuposha, elyo nabekala kwisano lyakwa Kesalo nabo bamuposha nganshi.

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe bonse.

english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
translation: Na iwe we mubomfi munandi icine cine, ndefwaya ukuti uleyafwilishako aba banamayo. Balibombesha nganshi pamo na ine mukusalanganya Imbila Nsuma, pamo na Kelementi na babomfi banandi bonse, abo amashina yabo yaba mu citabo cakwa Lesa ica bomi.

english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
translation: Lyonsefye mulesansamuka ico mwaampana ne Mfumu. Nabwekeshapo ukulanda nakabili, mulesansamuka!

english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
translation: Mube abamutembo kuli bonse. Imfumu ili mupepi.

english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
translation: Mwilasakamikwa ne cintu nelyo cimo, lelo mu fintu fyonse mulelomba Lesa mu mapepo no kumutasha pali fyonse ifyo mulekabila.

english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
translation: Elyo no mutende wakwe Lesa, uwacila amano ya bantu, ukasunga bwino bwino imitima yenu na mano yenu ico mwaba muli Kristu Yesu.

english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
translation: Pakulekelesha bamunyinane, mubike imitima yenu yonse pa fintu ifyacishinka ne fyakumutashishapo, ekutila ifyawamisha, ifyacindama, ifilolelemo, ifisuma nganshi, ifyo abantu bengatemwa ne fyakuleta umucinshi.

english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
translation: Mulecita ifintu ifyo mwasambilile kuli ine nefyo namufundile, fyonse ifyo nalelanda nefyo nalecita. Kabili na Lesa wamutende akulaba na imwe.

english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
translation: Amapinda yakwa Solomoni.

english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
translation: Umuntu uushinisha ku linso aletafye icimfulunganya

english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
translation: Akanwa ka mololoke ala kamfukumfuku kabumi,

english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
translation: Impatila ilenga ulubuli,

english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
translation: Abamano bena balanda ifyamano,

english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
translation: Abamano basungisha amano yabo,

english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
translation: Ifyuma fya mukankala e linga lyakwe ilyakosa ilimupokololako,

english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
translation: Icilambu ca muntu umololoke ala bumi,

english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
translation: Umuntu uumfwa ifyo balemufunda alekala umumi,

english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
translation: Umuntu afimba pa lupato lwakwe alalanda ifyabufi,

english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
translation: Mukulanda ifingi tamubula cilubo,

english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
translation: Ifyuma banonkela mukucita ulufyengo tafiwamina nelyo cimo,

english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
translation: Yako 5:20

english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
translation: Imilandile ya mololoke ala ifunda abengi,

english: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
translation: Amapaalo yakwa Yawe yaletela umuntu ubukankala,

english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
translation: Icipuba cisanga insansa mukucita icibi,

english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
translation: Umuntu mubi aponenwa ne shamo lintu atiinisha,

english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
translation: Icimwela nga capupa cilolulula umubi,

english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
translation: Nga filya inungo itapata mu meno,

english: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
translation: Ukuba na katiina kuli Yawe kulenga umuntu ukukokola pa calo,

english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
translation: Ifilolela umololoke ala ni nsansa sha pe,

english: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
translation: Yawe alacingilila abololoke abenda mu nshila yakwe,

english: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
translation: Yawe taleka umololoke alecula ne nsala,

english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
translation: Abololoke bena tabakatelentenshiwe,

english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
translation: Amashiwi ya bakaele yapeela amano,

english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
translation: Abololoke bena balishiba ifisuma ifyakulanda,

english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
translation: Ubunaŋani ala tabulisha kasuma iyoo,

english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
translation: Uututila ifilyo pa nshita iyalinga e mwana wamano,

english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
translation: Umololoke alapaalwa,

english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
translation: Ukwibukisha umololoke ala ciba lipalo,

english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
translation: Umuntu wamano alasekelela amafunde mu mutima wakwe,

english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
translation: Umuntu wa myendele isuma ekala umutelelwe,

english: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
translation: Yawe alipata icipimo abantu babomfya bucenjeshi bucenjeshi,

english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
translation: Umuntu mololoke nga ashuka, mu musumba muba insansa,

english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
translation: Umusumba ulapaalwa nga mwaikala abalungami,

english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
translation: Icipuba ca muntu cisaalula umunankwe,

english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
translation: Uwa mulomo tasunga nkaama nakalya,

english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
translation: Icalo icabula ubutungulushi, abantu balonaika,

english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
translation: Uulaya ukulipilila umubiye inkongole icine cine euculilamo,

english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
translation: Umwanakashi wacikuku ala alacindamikwa,

english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
translation: Umuntu waluse alamwenapo ifisuma,

english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
translation: Umuntu umubifi ena tashukila kasuma nakalya,

english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
translation: Umuntu uubikapofye ukucita ifyalungama alashukila ubumi,

english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
translation: Ilyo icilumba catangila, ala insoni eshikonkapo,

english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
translation: Yawe ena apata abalosha imitima ku fyabulungani,

english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
translation: Cishinkafye abantu ababifi bena bakakandwa,

english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
translation: Ala ukuyemba kwa mwanakashi mpelwamano

english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
translation: Ififwaya umololoke lyonse filabomba icisuma,

english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
translation: Umuntu kuti alepeela peelafye icuma cakwe, ninshi elyo alacililako ubukankala,

english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
translation: Umuntu kapekape alamona ishuko,

english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
translation: Abantu balatipwila uubika iŋanu shakwe pakuti akese shitisha pa mutengo uukulu,

english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
translation: Umuntu uubikapofye ukufwaya ifisuma ena alacindikwa,

english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
translation: Uutetekela mu fyuma fyakwe alailofya umwine,

english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
translation: Umuntu uuleta impatila pa lupwa lwakwe takalilepo kantu nelyo kamo,

english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
translation: Abantu abakaele balekala bwino pa mulandu wa bukaele bwabo,

english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
translation: Ifisabo fya mololoke cimuti cabumi,

english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
translation: Nga cakuti umololoke alapeelelwapo icilingene ne micitile yakwe pano isonde,

english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
translation: Ifyuma taficita kantu pa bushiku bwakukandwa,

english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
translation: Ubololoke bwa wakaele bulenga inshila yakwe ukutambalala,

english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
translation: Ubololoke bwa bakaele bulabalubulako,

english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
translation: Umubifi nga afwa, isubilo lyakwe lilapwa,

english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
translation: Umuntu umololoke alapusuka ku mafya,

english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
translation: Uushitiina Lesa, ku misosele yakwe onaula umunankwe,

english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
translation: Umuntu uwatemwa ukusalapulwa atemwa amano,

english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
translation: Umuntu umololoke alasakamana ifitekwa fyakwe,

english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
translation: Umulimi uubombesha alakwata ifyakulya ifingi,

english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
translation: Umubifi alakumbwa icuma ca balufyengo,

english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
translation: Umuntu umubifi bamwikatila ku milandile yakwe iyibi,

english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
translation: Umuntu alambulwa ukulingana ne misosele yakwe,

english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
translation: Iciwelewele ca muntu cilaitunga ukulungika,

english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
translation: Icipuba nga bacicitapo cimo cilasakatuka apopenefye,

english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
translation: Kambone wacishinka apeela ubunte bwaciine,

english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
translation: Amashiwi yacilandelande yalasa umuntu nge fumo,

english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
translation: Icishinka ala cilabelelela pe,

english: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
translation: Yawe alitemwa umuntu umusuma,

english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
translation: Mu mitima ya bapanga ububifi mubafye ubucenjeshi,

english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
translation: Ishamo taliponena pa bololoke iyoo,

english: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
translation: Yawe apata ababufi,

english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
translation: Umuntu uwacenjela tailangisha mano yakwe,

english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
translation: Ukuboko kwa ubombesha kulateeka,

english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
translation: Isakamika lipwisha umuntu insansa,

english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
translation: Umuntu umololoke alapandako ifibusa fyakwe amano,

english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
translation: Umunaŋani ena takatale ashukila ico afwaya nakalya,

english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
translation: Mu nshila yabololoke emwaba umweo,

english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
translation: Ububifi tabukosha muntu iyoo,

english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
translation: Umukashi wa mibeele isuma alapulamika wiba,

english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
translation: Amapange ya bololoke yena yalilungama,

english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
translation: Imilandile ya babifi fiteyo fyakusumya umulopa,

english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
translation: Abantu ababifi balafwa ukwabula ukushapo icishibilo,

english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
translation: Umuntu balamutasha ukulingana na mano akwata,

english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
translation: Cawamishapo ukuba umuntu wafye uuibombela umwine,

english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
translation: Umwana wamano alasumina kufyo wishi alemusalapula,

english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
translation: Icilumba cena cibushafye ifyongo,

english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
translation: Indalama shakunonkela mu nshila iyibi shilapwa,

english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
translation: Ico umuntu alelolela nga tacicitike, umutima ulatompoka,

english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
translation: Ukusuula ifyo balekufundako ekuiletelela,

english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
translation: Amafunde ya bantu abamano ala ni ntulo yabumi,

english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
translation: Amano yalenga umuntu ukucindikwa,

english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
translation: Umuntu uwacenjela abomfya amano,

english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
translation: Inkombe ibi iponena mu bwafya,

english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
translation: Uushifwaya kusalapulwa alaponena mu bulanda elyo ne nsoni,

english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
translation: Ala tepabusuma ukushukila icintu walekabila,

english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
translation: Umuntu musuma alambulwa pa milandile yakwe,

english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
translation: Umuntu uwenda na bamano nao alakwata amano,

english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
translation: Ishamo likonka uubifya,

english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
translation: Umuntu musuma alashila na beshikulu ifyuma,

english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
translation: Ibala lya mulanda kuti lyafumya ifisabo ifingi nganshi,

english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
translation: Umufyashi ashitola bwembya apata mwane,

english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
translation: Abololoke balalya no kwikuta,

english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
translation: Uusunga akanwa kakwe aisungila ubumi,

english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
translation: Umunaŋani ena tamona ico alefwaya,

english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
translation: Umololoke apata ubufi,

english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
translation: Ubololoke busungila umuntu ubucindami,

english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
translation: Abantu bamo bacita kwati bakankala, lelo bapina abene bene,

english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
translation: Ifyuma kuti fyalubula ubumi bwa mukankala,

english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
translation: Abololoke baba ngo lubuuto ululeaka bwino bwinofye,
