english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
translation: Umwanakashi uwamano alakuula iŋanda yakwe,

english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
translation: Icikalipa cumfwa umwine ku mutima wakwe,

english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
translation: Iŋanda ya mubi ilawa,

english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
translation: Kwaliba inshila iyimoneka kwati eisuma ku muntu,

english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
translation: Muli sekaseka emufuma lilalila,

english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
translation: Umuntu uwanenuka mu cisumino akalambwilwapo pa mibeele yakwe,

english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
translation: Imbulwamano yena isuminafye icisumine sumine,

english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
translation: Uwamano alatiina Yawe no kutaluka ku ntulubundi,

english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
translation: Uwaba ne cipyu acita ifyabupuba,

english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
translation: Imbulwamano shipeelwa ubupuba,

english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
translation: Abantu ababifi balakontama pa cinso ca basuma,

english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
translation: Umuntu uwenda mu cishinka ena eutiina Yawe,

english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
translation: Umulanda alasuulwa na ku bena mupalamano bakwe,

english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
translation: Umuntu uusuulisha umunankwe alabifya,

english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
translation: Bushe uupanga ifibi tekulubantika alubantikafye?

english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
translation: Mukubombesha monse mwaliba ukumwenamo,

english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
translation: Ubukankala bwa wamano e ngala yabo,

english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
translation: Amap 16:25

english: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
translation: Uwakwatila Yawe akatiina alikwata ishintililo ilyakosa,

english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
translation: Ukukwatila Yawe akatiina e ntulo yabumi

english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
translation: Ubucindami bwa mfumu kukwata abantu abengi,

english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
translation: Umuntu uuteeka umutima e wamano ayengi nganshi,

english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
translation: Imilandile ya cipuba ilenga umwine ukuiletelela,

english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
translation: Umutima wa muntu nga uli umutende, upeela ubumi ku mubili,

english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
translation: Umuntu uucusha umulanda cilanga ukuti acusha Kabumba wakwe,

english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
translation: Ilyo ubucushi bwaisa, ebwipaisha umuntu umubifi,

english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
translation: Umutima wa wacenjela e cifulo cituushamo amano,

english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
translation: Ubololoke ebusandulula umushobo,

english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
translation: Umubomfi wamano alitemwikwa ku mfumu,

english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
translation: Ukushaba ŋombe shakuliminako, ifilyo tafifula iyoo,

english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
translation: Kambone wacishinka tabepa bufi iyoo,

english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
translation: Umuntu uupumya aicushafye takatale amona amano,

english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
translation: Uletaluka ku ciwelewele ca muntu,

english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
translation: Amano ya wacenjela kutontonkanya pa myendele yakwe,

english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
translation: Ifipuba tafisakamana ukubelelwa luse pa fyabubifi,

english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
translation: Ukwasuka ukwafuka kubwesha icipyu,

english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
translation: Uupatuka mu nshila alolela ukukandwa icabipisha nganshi,

english: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
translation: Icalo ca bafwa no bonaushi fyaba pa bwelu pa cinso cakwa Yawe,

english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
translation: Uupumya tafwaya kwalululwa,

english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
translation: Umuntu uuli ne nsansa mu mutima alamoneka pa menso,

english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
translation: Umutima wamano ufwaisha ukwishiba ifyamano,

english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
translation: Inshiku shonse isha mulanda shalikosa,

english: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
translation: Ukukwata utunono no kukwatila Yawe akatiina kwaliwamishapo,

english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
translation: Ukutobela umusalu pamo na bakutemwa kwawamishapo,

english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
translation: Umuntu uufulwa bwangu alabusha ulubuli,

english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
translation: Inshila ya munaŋani yaba iyasapa ku myunga,

english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
translation: Imilandile ya wamano ilanga ukwishiba,

english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
translation: Umwana wamano asansamusha wishi,

english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
translation: Ubupumbu busansamusha umuntu uwabula amano,

english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
translation: Amapange tayafikilishiwa ukushili kupandwa amano,

english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
translation: Umuntu uwasuka amashiwi ayalolelemo alasekelela,

english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
translation: Umuntu wamano akonka inshila iyitwala ku bumi,

english: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
translation: Yawe alawisha iŋanda ya wacilumba,

english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
translation: Yawe apata amatontonkanyo ya babifi,

english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
translation: Uwalunkumbwa lwa fyuma aletelela ulupwa lwakwe,

english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
translation: Umuntu uwaololoka umutima alasala ifyakwasuka ifisuma,

english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
translation: Yawe alaitalusha ku babifi,

english: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
translation: Yawe alamona mpanga yonse,

english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
translation: Icinso icimoneka bwino cipeela insansa ku mutima,

english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
translation: Umuntu uukutika ku mashiwi yabumi ayakumusalapula,

english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
translation: Umuntu uusuula ukumusalapula aisuulafye umwine,

english: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
translation: Ukuba na katiina kuli Yawe ekusambilila amano,

english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
translation: Amashiwi yamutembo yaleta ubumi,

english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
translation: Icipuba cisuula amafunde yakwa wishi,

english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
translation: Mu ŋanda ya mololoke mulasungwa ifyuma ifingi nganshi,

english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
translation: Abamano balasalanganya amano yabo,

english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
translation: Ilambo lya babifi lilaselausha Yawe ku mukoshi,

english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
translation: Yawe alipata imyendele ya bantu ababifi,

english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
translation: Abantu balapanga ifyakucita mu mutima,

english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
translation: Kateeka wa bantu alalanda na maka yakwa Lesa,

english: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
translation: Yawe afwaya ifyakupiminako fileba ifyalungama,

english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
translation: Camuselu ku shamfumu ukucita ifyabubifi,

english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
translation: Bashamfumu batemwa abalanda ifishinka,

english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
translation: Imfumu nga yafulwa cilanga ukuti palefwa umo,

english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
translation: Pa cinso ca mfumu nga payanguka, palangilila ukuti pali ubumi,

english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
translation: Ala caliwamishapo ukukwata amano ukucila golide,

english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
translation: Abantu abakaele balataluka ku fibi,

english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
translation: Icilumba ecitangilila ukonaika,

english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
translation: Cawamishapo ukuicefya mu mupashi pamo na balanda,

english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
translation: Fyonse ifyo umuntu acita mu mano yakwe amona ukuti nafilolamo,

english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
translation: Umuntu uumfwa ifyo alefundwa alamona ifisuma,

english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
translation: Uwaba no mutima wamano etwa uwailuka,

english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
translation: Amano yakwiluka, e ntulo yabumi ku bayashukila,

english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
translation: Umutima wa muntu wamano ulenga ukucenjela mu misosele yakwe,

english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
translation: Amashiwi yamutembo yaba ngo luto lwa buci,

english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
translation: Kwaliba inshila iyimoneka kwati eisuma ku muntu,

english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
translation: Insala ni ndiminwa, ala tempulilwa iyoo,

english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
translation: Icinangwa ca muntu citeya ifyakucusha bambi,

english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
translation: Abantu babi balasongelekanya ulubuli,

english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
translation: Umuntu umunkalwe asembeleka umunankwe,

english: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
translation: Ulelekela Yawe fyonse ifyo ulecita,

english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
translation: Umuntu uushinisha umunankwe, ninshi aletontonkanyapo icibi cimo,

english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
translation: Ukumena imfwi ecilongwe ca mucinshi,

english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
translation: Ukuba uushifulwa bwangu cawamishapo ukucila ubulamba bwa mpalume ya bulwi,

english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
translation: Bapendwila mu ceni pali tumba uo bashimapepo bafwala,

english: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
translation: Conse ico Yawe abumba alicikwatila ico acibumbile,

english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
translation: Yawe alipatisha bonse abamitima yacilumba,

english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
translation: Ukupitila mu kutemwa na bucishinka ifyabubifi filafutilwa,

english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
translation: Yawe nga amona imyendele ya muntu yamusansamusha,

english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
translation: Ukukwata utunono mu bololoke kwawamapo,

english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
translation: Mu mutima umuntu alapekanya ifyakucita,

english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
translation: Ukulalila icimbala na ku matwi tondolo kwawamapo,

english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
translation: Umuntu uwamano alomfwa ukukalipilwa umukufye umo,

english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
translation: Umuntu mubi ena atontonkanyafye palwa cimfulunganya lyonse,

english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
translation: Ukukumanya iciswango ca bea ico bapokolola utwana kwalinga,

english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
translation: Ngo muntu abwesesha ububi pa busuma ubo bamucitile,

english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
translation: Ifikansa fitampafye panono nga akapunda akali mu mutondo,

english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
translation: Ukupeela uwamulandu insambu, no kupeela uwakaele umulandu,

english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
translation: Indalama mu minwe ya cipuba bushe shanshi?

english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
translation: Icibusa cena citemwafye lyonse,

english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
translation: Icipumbu ca muntu cilaiposa icine mu mulandu wakufutilako umunankwe,

english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
translation: Umuntu uwatemwa ukuumana atemwa ifyabubifi,

english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
translation: Umubomfi wamano kuti ateeka umwana uulenga insoni,

english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
translation: Umuntu wa mutima watalama tamona ishuko,

english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
translation: Ukufyala umwana icipuba cileta ubulanda,

english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
translation: Umutima uwansansa upeela umutende ku mubili,

english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
translation: Umuntu umubi alapoka amafisakanwa mu nkaama,

english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
translation: Umuntu uwacenjela atonta amenso pa mano,

english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
translation: Iciwelewele ca mwana cifiisha wishi ku mutima,

english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
translation: Ala te cisuma ukufyenga uwakaele,

english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
translation: Umuntu uwamano alashikatala pakulanda,

english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
translation: Ne cipuba cine nga cileikalako tondolo kuti batila camano,

english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.
translation: Ni mu mulilo emo bengulwila silifa mu cikopo, na golide mwilungu,

english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
translation: Umuntu mubi ateya amatwi ku lyashi lyabufi,

english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
translation: Umuntu uususha umulanda cilanga ukuti asusha kabumba wakwe,

english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
translation: Abakote balacankilwa mu beshikulu babo,

english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
translation: Imilandile iyacindama te ya bantu abapumbu,

english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
translation: Abantu abapeela amafisakanwa batontonkanya ukuti yalabomba nge cishimba,

english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
translation: Umuntu uusuula ku cilubo umunankwe amucita, akosha icitemwiko,

english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
translation: Umuntu uwikala eka acita ifyo atemenwe umwine,

english: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
translation: Ishina lyakwa Yawe lupungu ulwakosa,

english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
translation: Ifyuma fya mukankala lilinga lyakwe ilyakosa ilyakumupusushako,

english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
translation: Icilumba ecitwala umuntu kukonaika,

english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
translation: Umuntu uwankula talati omfwikishe euilanga ukuti cipumbufye,

english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
translation: Umutima wa muntu eushipikisha mu bulwele,

english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
translation: Umuntu wamano alacincila pakufwaisha ukulundapo amano yakwe,

english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
translation: Ubupe bwiswila inshila uupeela,

english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
translation: Uubalilapo ukulubulula mu cilye amoneka kwati ewalungika,

english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
translation: Ukupendula kupwisha ifikansa,

english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
translation: Munonko uo mwapusana nankwe cayafyapo ukumunasha,

english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
translation: Icipuba tacisakamana kumfwa icintu umo cilolele iyoo,

english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
translation: Ku milandile ya muntu kulenga umuntu ukwikuta,

english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
translation: Imfwa no bumi fyaba mu maka ya lulimi,

english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
translation: Umuntu uwasanga umukashi ninshi asanga icintu icisuma,

english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
translation: Umulanda alomba ukumulangulukilako,

english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
translation: Limo ifibusa nga fyafula bucibusa bulonaika,

english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
translation: Ukubifya ekubalilapo elyo pakonka ukusuulwa,

english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
translation: Amashiwi yafuma mu kanwa ka muntu litenga lya menshi,

english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
translation: Ala tacawama ukuwila ku lubali lwa muntu uubifishe,

english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
translation: Imilandile ya cipuba ileta ukukansana,

english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
translation: Akanwa ka cipuba kailetelela ukulobelapo,

english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
translation: Amashiwi yabukwakwa yalowa ngo twakusasula,

english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
translation: Umuntu umunaŋani pakubomba imilimo yakwe,

english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
translation: Umulanda uwa myendele isuma awamapo,

english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
translation: Ala tacalinga icipuba ukulaipakisha,

english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
translation: Umuntu wamano alailanga ukuba uwamutembo,

english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
translation: Ukufulwa kwa mfumu kwaba nge cilulumo ca nkalamo,

english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
translation: Icipuba ca mwana cishamika wishi,

english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
translation: Amayanda ne fyuma filapyanwa ukufuma ku bafyashi,

english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
translation: Ubulamu bwine bwine buponesha umuntu mu tulo twa mfwa,

english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
translation: Umuntu uusunga amafunde acingilila ubumi bwakwe,

english: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
translation: Uukumbusukako abalanda ni Yawe eo akongwesha,

english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
translation: Salapula umwana obe ilyo kucili isubilo,

english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
translation: Umuntu uufulwa bwangu muleke aifutile imilandu umwine,

english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
translation: Ukupupumina cimo ukwabula ukwishiba takwawama iyoo,

english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
translation: Ulekutika ku bantu abalekufundako amano,

english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
translation: Umuntu mu mutima wakwe muba amapange ayengi,

english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
translation: Ico umuntu afwaisha citemwiko icishipwa,

english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
translation: Ukuba na katiina kuli Yawe kutwala ku bumi,

english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
translation: Umunaŋani atumpa iminwe mu mbale,

english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
translation: Nga cakuti wakanda umuntu uupumya,

english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
translation: Uwibila wishi no kutamfya nyina,

english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
translation: Mwana wandi ilyo ukaleka ukukutika ku mafunde,

english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
translation: Kambone wabufi alasuusha ubupingushi,

english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
translation: Ubupingushi bwabikilwa abamiponto,

english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
translation: Ubupuba bwa muntu bulonaula ubumi bwakwe,

english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
translation: Bacibusa ba mukankala cani ca ku mutenge,

english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
translation: Kambone wabufi icishinkafye akalimunwa,

english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
translation: Abantu abengi balaipalamika ku mukankala,

english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
translation: Apo umulanda balamukankamba kuli ba lupwa lwakwe bonse,

english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
translation: Uyo onse uupoka amano atemwa umweo wakwe,

english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
translation: Kambone wabufi icishinkafye akalimunwa,

english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
translation: Amapinda yakwa Solomoni mwana Davidi,

english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
translation: Amalu 111:10

english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
translation: Nangu bakweba abati, “Ala isa kuno,

english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
translation: Ilyo bacili abomi, elyo tubacibaule kwati ni nindi,

english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
translation: Ee, tukakwata ifyuma ifyacindama,

english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
translation: Ale isa tuleenda bonse,

english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
translation: We mwana wandi, wilaenda pamo na bantu ba musango uyu,

english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
translation: Pantu amakasa yabo yabutukila mu fyabubifi,

english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
translation: Kuicushafye ukuteya ifyuni ulukose

english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
translation: Bena balalilila ukuilofya abene,

english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
translation: Pefye abapupu bafwila pa bupupu bwabo,

english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
translation: Aya e mapinda yakulenga ukwishiba no kusalapulwa

english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
translation: Amano yalebilikisha mu misebo ngo mwanakashi,

english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
translation: Uyo alebilikisha pa mpongolo ya musumba,

english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
translation: “Mwe mbulwamano imwe!

english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
translation: Kwena amulaumfwa kufyo ine nalemukalipila,

english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
translation: Nomba imwe mulakaana ukwisa ilyo ine mwita,

english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
translation: Pantu mwasuulile nefyo ine namusokele,

english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
translation: Kanshi na ine nkasekakofye ilyo mukaponenwa ne finkunka,

english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
translation: ilyo amashamo yalamwishila nge cimwela,

english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
translation: Yobo 28:28

english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
translation: Pantu bena bapata amano,

english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
translation: Epakuti yamufundako ukuba na mano mu mikalile,

english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
translation: Pantu tabafwaya kumfwa kufyo ine mbasokako,

english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
translation: Kanshi bakalalya ifitwalo fya mibeele yabo,

english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
translation: Isham 4:32

english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
translation: Lelo uyo onse uumfwa kuli ine akekala umutelelwe,

english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
translation: Imbulwamano kuti yashisalapula,

english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
translation: Lekeni aya mapinda abantu abamano bakutikeko,

english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
translation: Epakuti baletola amano mu mapinda na mu nsoselo,

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
translation: Ukukwatila Yawe akatiina e ntendekelo ya mano,

english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
translation: Umfwa we mwana wandi kufyo bawiso balekufunda,

english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
translation: Pantu ifyo balekufunda fikaba nge ngala ku mutwe obe,

english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
translation: Umwangashi ulafulunganya umuntu,

english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
translation: Ifipimo ifishili fyacishinka kabili no kupima bucenjeshi bucenjeshi,

english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
translation: Ne misango ya mwaice imonekela ku micitile yakwe,

english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
translation: Ala ni Yawe ewatupeela amenso yakumwenako,

english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
translation: Wilatemwisha utulo kuti limbi waisanga mu bupina,

english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
translation: Uushita alainongonya ati, “Tafiweme, tafiweme.”

english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
translation: Kwaliba golide no tumabwe utwauma umutengo utwingi,

english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
translation: Umuntu uwalaya ukufutilako umweni inkongole shakwe, mupokefye icakufwala cakwe,

english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
translation: Icakulya icapokelwa mu bucenjeshi, ala tepabusuma,

english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
translation: Tantika amapange yobe ilyo waipushako bambi,

english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
translation: Uwa mulomo tasunga nkaama nakalya,

english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
translation: Ukufulwa kwa mfumu kwaba nge cibulumo ca nkalamo,

english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
translation: Umuntu uwatipwila abafyashi bakwe,

english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
translation: Ifyuma ifinonkwa mukwangufyanya pakutendeka,

english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
translation: Wilatila auti, “Nkalandula pa bubi bancita.”

english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
translation: Ala Yawe alipata abantu abapima ifintu bucenjeshi bucenjeshi,

english: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
translation: Apo kanshi ni Yawe eututungulula mu kwenda kwesu,

english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
translation: Cilaba citeyo umuntu ukulaya Yawe cimo, ukwabula ukutontonkanya bwino,

english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
translation: Imfumu iyamano ilolululamo abantu imbifi,

english: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
translation: Kampingu wa mu muntu e cisaniko cakwa Yawe,

english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
translation: Ukutemwa ukushipwa ne cishinka filinda imfumu,

english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
translation: Ululumbi lwa balumendo maka yabo,

english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
translation: Ukutaluka ku lubuli kucindamika umuntu,

english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
translation: Ukumaulwa ne filonda kulafumyapo ukubifya,

english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
translation: Umunaŋani acita umulele ukulima pa mibundo,

english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
translation: Amapange ya mu mutima wa muntu litenga lya menshi,

english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
translation: Abantu abengi balaitakisha ukuti baba ne citemwiko icishipwa,

english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
translation: Umuntu umololoke enda mu bumi bwabukaele,

english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
translation: Ilyo imfumu yatekesha icilye camilandu,

english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
translation: Nani engatila ati, “Ine mu mutima wandi mulifye umwabuuta?

english: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
translation: Umutima wa mfumu waba ngo mumana wa menshi mu minwe yakwa Yawe,

english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
translation: Ababifi lyonsefye bafwaya ukucitapo cimo icabipa,

english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
translation: Nga bakanda uwamiya eko imbulwamano shimwena shasambilila no kusambilila.

english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
translation: Uwaololoka aleshiba iŋanda ya mubifi,

english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
translation: Uucilika mu matwi ilyo abalanda balemulilila,

english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
translation: Umuntu nga nakufulilwa umupeelepo icintu cimo,

english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
translation: Ilyo paba umulinganya abantu abololoke balasansamuka,

english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
translation: Umuntu uufuma mu nshila iyakwiluka,

english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
translation: Uukonkelela ubwangashi akaba umupina,

english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
translation: Umubifi asanguka icakulubwilako umololoke,

english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
translation: Cawama ukwikala mu matololo,

english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
translation: Fyonse ifyo umuntu acita mu nshila yakwe amona ati nafilolamo,

english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
translation: Mu ŋanda ya muntu uwamano alasunga bwino ifyakulya na mafuta,

english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
translation: Umuntu uukonkelela ubololoke ne citemwiko icishipwa,

english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
translation: Umuntu uwamano kuti asansa umusumba wa fita ifyabulamba

english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
translation: Umuntu uusunga akanwa no lulimi lwakwe,

english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
translation: Umuntu wacilumba kabili uwafikansa ishina lyakwe ni mpumya,

english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
translation: Ulunkumbwa elwipaisha umunaŋani,

english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
translation: Ena akasuba konse atontonkanyafye ukupeelwapo na fimbi,

english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
translation: Ilambo ababifi balekela Yawe lyena lilamuselausha ku mukoshi,

english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
translation: Kambone wabufi akalobelela,

english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
translation: Umuntu umubifi alakamuka pakuilanga ukuti e muntu wine wine,

english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
translation: Ukucita ifisuma ne fyalungama,

english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
translation: Tapali amano, tapali ukwiluka,

english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
translation: Pa bushiku bwa nkondo bapekanya bakabalwe aba ku bulwi,

english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
translation: Amenso ayalolesha bukali bukali, no mutima uwacilumba,

english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
translation: Ulepekanya bwino ifyo uli nokucita,

english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
translation: Ukunonka ifyuma mukubepa ubufi,

english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
translation: Ababi balailetelela imfwa kulwa bukakashi bwabo,

english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
translation: Abantu ba milandu inshila bakonka intu yanyongana,

english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
translation: Cawamapo ukwikala pa cifutu ca pa mutenge wa ŋanda,

english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
translation: Ishina ilyacindama lyawamapo ukucila ifyuma ifingi,

english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
translation: Tamfya uupumya ninshi no lubuli lwapwa,

english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
translation: Umuntu uwatemwa umutima uwakaele kabili uulanda ne shiwi lyacikuku,

english: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
translation: Amenso yakwa Yawe eyalinda amano,

english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
translation: Umunaŋani atila, “Panse pali nkalamo,”

english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.
translation: Akanwa ka mwanakashi cilende bucinga ubwashika,

english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
translation: Ubutumpe bukakatila mu mutima wa mwaice,

english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
translation: Umuntu uucusha abapina pakufusha icuma cakwe,

english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
translation: Teyamika amatwi, kabili uleumfwa ku mashiwi ya bamano,

english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
translation: Pantu cikawama ilyo ukayasunga mu mutima obe,

english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
translation: Ine ndefwaya ukuti iwe uletetekela Yawe,

english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.
translation: Icintu cimo ico umukankala no mupina bakwata icapalana nici,

english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
translation: Bushe nshakulembele insoselo amakumi yatatu (30),

english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
translation: Neshi nsoselo shakulakufundako ifyacishinka na mashiwi yacine cine,

english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
translation: Wilacusha abapina ico bapinafye,

english: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
translation: Pantu Yawe akabalubulwilako,

english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
translation: Wilaampana bucibusa na bantu abacipyu,

english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
translation: Epali wayambula imibeele yabo,

english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
translation: Wiibika pa bantu abafunkana mu minwe pakusuminishanya,

english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
translation: Pantu limbi nga wafilwa inshila yakulipililamo,

english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
translation: Wilaesha kutelula imipaka yakale iya citungu,

english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
translation: Bushe tawamona umuntu uwacincila mu milimo?

english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
translation: Umuntu uwamano alamona ubwafya no kubutaluka,

english: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.
translation: Ukuicefya no kuba na katiina kuli Yawe

english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
translation: Mu nshila ya mubifi mwaba imyunga ne fiteyo,

english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
translation: Ulelanga umwaice inshila yakwendelamo,

english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
translation: Abakankala ebateeka abalanda ubusha,

english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
translation: Uutanda ulufyengo ailetela impasase,

english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
translation: Umuntu uukumbusuka ababusu alapaalwa,

english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
translation: Nga ulelya icakulya na kateeka,

english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
translation: Wilasesha mipaka yakale iya citungu,

english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
translation: Pantu Ndubulwila wabo wamaka,

english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
translation: Ulebika umutima ku mano yakwishiba ifintu,

english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
translation: Wilafilwa ukukalipila umwaice,

english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
translation: Wilatiina ukumufyapa ubwembya,

english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
translation: We mwana wandi umutima obe nga wakwata amano,

english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
translation: No mutima wandi ukanga ne nsansa,

english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
translation: Wilakumbwa ababubifi mu mutima obe,

english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
translation: Lyena nga efyo wakulacita, awe ninshi walala washuka,

english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
translation: Umfwa kuno, we mwana wandi ala iwe uleiluka mu fintu,

english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
translation: Nga uli ne nsala iyakuluka umulopa,

english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;
translation: Iwe wilaenda na bacakolwa wa bwalwa,

english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
translation: Pantu bacakolwa na bakatubi baiposa abene mu bulanda,

english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
translation: Uleumfwa kuli bawiso abakufyele,

english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
translation: Icishinka, amano, ubupete, ukusalapuka,

english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
translation: Wishi wa mwana umololoke alasangalala,

english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
translation: Leka bawiso na banoko balecankwa,

english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
translation: We mwana wandi ulekonka bwino ifyo ine ndekweba,

english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
translation: Umwanakashi cilende no mukashi wa myendele ibi,

english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
translation: Bena ala balalilila abantu nga bapupu,

english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
translation: Bantu nshi bekala inkumbabulili?

english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
translation: Wilapupumina ifyakulya ifiwamishepo ifyo akutebete,

english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
translation: Ala bantu banwesha ubwalwa,

english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
translation: Wilakonkelela bwalwa nangu bwingalamoneka ubusuma,

english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
translation: Pakulekelesha kuti walaumfwa kwati usuminwe ne nsoka,

english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
translation: Na menso yobe yalamona ifyeni fimbi fimbifye,

english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
translation: Nomba walaumfwa ukusensenunwa

english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
translation: Ninshi no kusabaila alesabaila ati,

english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
translation: Wilacululuka pakuti umone ubukankala,

english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
translation: Ifyuma kuti wakwata nomba waluba napo file,

english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
translation: Wilalya ifyakulya fya muntu wabupapa,

english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
translation: Pantu muntu uutontonkanya lyonse pafyo aposelepo.

english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
translation: Ala kuti waluka na kapande ulile,

english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
translation: Wilalanda ifintu ku cipuba,

english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
translation: Wilakumbwa bantu abalebifya,

english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
translation: Nga watompoka ilyo ifintu fyakubipila,

english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
translation: Ulepokololako uo baletintanishisha kukuya mwipaya,

english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
translation: Nga walanda ati, “Ala kwena ifwe tatwaishibe nangu cimo,”

english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
translation: We mwana wandi ulelya ubuci pantu busuma,

english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
translation: Wishibe nokuti amano yalilowa mu mutima obe,

english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
translation: Wilabelamina umololoke pakuti umonawile iŋanda yakwe,

english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
translation: Pantu umololoke nelyo engawa imiku cine lubali, ena akema nakabili,

english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
translation: Wilasansamuka umulwani obe nga awa,

english: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
translation: Epali Yawe amona, kabili cabipa mu menso yakwe,

english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;
translation: Abantu ababifi wilabakwatila cinse iyoo,

english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.
translation: Pantu imitima yabo yelenganyafye ifimfulunganya,

english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
translation: Pantu umubifi alilala alishamininafye,

english: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
translation: We mwana wandi ulekwatila Yawe akatiina elyo no kutiina imfumu ya calo,

english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?
translation: Pantu kuti batumapo icakupumikisha icakukonaula,

english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
translation: Ishi nsoselo nasho shalesoswa na bamano.

english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
translation: Uyo onse uwaebela uubifishe ati, “Uli wakaele,”

english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
translation: Nomba bakaputula wa milandu abalimuna ababifya,

english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
translation: Ukwasuka ifyacishinka, kwaba ngo kutomona pa milomo.

english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
translation: Upwishe imilimo ya panse, elyo uuteyanya na mabala yene,

english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
translation: Wilaanguka ukuba kambone pa mwina mupalamano obe nga taushininkishe umulandu,

english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
translation: Wilasosa auti, “Eya, na ine wine nomba

english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
translation: Ala amano eyakuula iŋanda,

english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.
translation: Ine nalipitile pa malimino ya munaŋani,

english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
translation: kabili moneni ninshi na monsefye mwalimena imyunga,

english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
translation: Awe nalolekesha kufyo namwene na menso yandi,

english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
translation: Ukutubilishakofye panono,

english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
translation: elyo ubupina bukakwishila ngo mupupu,

english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
translation: Kabili kwishiba kwine ekulenga mu miputule ya ŋanda mwisule ifintu,

english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,
translation: Umuntu wamano alikwatisha ubulamba,

english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
translation: Pantu pakutendeka inkondo umuntu afwile atungululwa,

english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
translation: Amano yena ala yacila pafyo icipuba cingomfwa,

english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
translation: Umuntu upanga ukulacita ifibi,

english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
translation: Ifitontonkanya ifipuba ala fyabubififye,

english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
translation: Aya e mapinda na yambi ayakwa Solomoni imfumu, ayalembele bacilolo bakwa Hesekia imfumu uwateekele icalo ca Yuda.

english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
translation: Epali bambi baumfwako ukuti iwe kanshi tausunga nkaama,

english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
translation: Ishiwi ilyalandwa bwino,

english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
translation: Nga filya fyayemba utwakufwala ku matwi utwa golide,

english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
translation: Ifyaba ukutalala kwa bunga bwa mfula mu nshita yakuseepa,

english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
translation: Abantu abalaya ifyabupe ifyo bashipeela,

english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
translation: Uuteka umutima mukulanda kuti anasha kateeka,

english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
translation: Nga wasanga ubuci, lyapofye ubwalinga,

english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
translation: Wilaingila libili libili mu ŋanda ya mubiyo,

english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
translation: Uulandila umunankwe bukambone bwabufi,

english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
translation: Ukutetekela uwabufi pa nshita yabwafya,

english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
translation: Bucindami bwakwa Lesa umwine ukufisa umulandu,

english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
translation: Ukufuula ifyakufwala ilyo kuli impepo,

english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
translation: Umulwani obe nga ali ne nsala, iwe umupeeleko icakulya,

english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
translation: Pantu mukucita ifi uli nokulapwila umusolilo pa mutwe wakwe,

english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
translation: Nga filya fine umwela wa ku kabanga uleta imfula,

english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
translation: Cawamapo ukwikala pa cifutu ca pa mutenge wa ŋanda,

english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
translation: Nga menshi ayatalalisha ayatalalika umuntu ku mukoshi,

english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
translation: Nga menshi ayafundauka,

english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
translation: Ukulisha ubuci ukucila mu cipimo takwawama,

english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
translation: Umuntu uufilwa ukukanya umutima wakwe,

english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
translation: Nga filya fine umulu wasansuka, nangu nga filya fine icalo cashika,

english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
translation: Fumyamo bamunyela muli silifa,

english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
translation: Fumya babifi kwisano lya mfumu,

english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
translation: Tecakwesha kuicindamika pa cinso ca mfumu,

english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
translation: Pantu cawamishapo imfumu ine ukukweba ati, “Nina wise wikale apa apacindeme,”

english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
translation: Nga uli no mulandu no mubiyo, umfwanenifye nankwe,

english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
translation: Caba ngo bunga bwa mfula mu nshita ya lusuba,

english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
translation: Uwaingisha icipuba nangu uleipitilafye incito,

english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
translation: Icipuba cilabwekeshapo ukucita icabutumpe cimo cine,

english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
translation: Nga wamona uuitunga ukuba uwamano,

english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
translation: Umunaŋani atila, “Muli inkalamo mu musebo,

english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
translation: Nga filya fine iciibi cipilibuka mu fyela umo bacikwika,

english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
translation: Umunaŋani limo abomfya ubulamu icakuti nga atumpika iminwe mu mbale,

english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
translation: Umunaŋani alaitunga ukuba uwacenjela,

english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
translation: Ukuitumpika mu fikansa ushishibe napo fitampile,

english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
translation: Nge shilu ililefwinta ifishishi fya mulilo,

english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
translation: efyaba no muntu uubepa umunankwe ati,

english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
translation: Ifitipu filafilwa ukulya umuntu uwakaele,

english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
translation: Ukwabula inkuni umulilo ulashima,

english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
translation: Ifyaba amafito pa musolilo, ne nkuni pa mulilo,

english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
translation: Amashiwi yabukwakwa yalowa ngo twakusasula,

english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
translation: Ukutasha kwa pa kanwafye ilintu umutima uli uubi,

english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
translation: Umuntu walupato talanga lupato pakusembeleka umubiye,

english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
translation: Nangu asosa amashiwi yakusembeleka,

english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
translation: Limbi kuti afisa impatila,

english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
translation: Uwimba ubucinga no kuwila euwilamo,

english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
translation: Ululimi lwabufi lwapata abo lufyenga.

english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
translation: Icikoti calinga ukupindulwilako kabalwe,

english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
translation: Wilaasuka icipuba umwabela ubupuba bwaciko,

english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
translation: Uleasuka icipuba umwabela bupuba bwaciko,

english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
translation: Uutuma inkombe iyabula mano alaifyenga umwine,

english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translation: Ipinda mu kanwa ka fipuba,

english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
translation: Ukupeela icipuba ubucindami,

english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translation: Filya fyaba umunga mu minwe yakwa cakolwa,

english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
translation: Wilaitakisha pa fintu ifikabako mailo,

english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
translation: Wilalekelesha bacibusa bobe, nangufye bacibusa ba bawiso,

english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
translation: We mwana wandi ube na mano, lyena ninshi wakulasansamusha umutima wandi,

english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
translation: Umuntu uwamano alamona uko ubwafya bulefuma,

english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
translation: Umuntu uubilikisha lucelocelofye kukuya posha umunankwe amubusha na mu tulo,

english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
translation: Umukashi wa fikansa aba nge mfula

english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
translation: Ukumwalulula cimo no kwesha ukunasha umwela,

english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
translation: Icela cinoona icela cibiye,

english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
translation: Uusunga umukunyu alalyako amakunyu,

english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
translation: Nga filya fine impumi imoneka mu cilola,

english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
translation: Leka abantu bambi ebo bakutashe, nomba wiitasha we mwine,

english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
translation: Nga ifi fine imfwa no bonaushi fishatala afitendwa,

english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
translation: Ni mu mulilo emo bengulwila silifa mu cikopo, na golide mwilungu,

english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
translation: Nangu wingatwila icipuba mwibende,

english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,
translation: Cine cine shininkisha ukuti ifitekwa fyobe filesungwa bwino,

english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
translation: Pantu ifyuma tafibelelela iyoo,

english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
translation: Ilyo icani icauma cafumishiwapo mwishika lya mpili,

english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
translation: ninshi amasako ya mpaanga shobe we muntu ukapikulamo ifyakufwala,

english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
translation: Elyo ukakwata umukaka uwingi uwa mbushi,

english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
translation: Ilibwe lyalifina no mucanga nao cisendo icafina,

english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
translation: Ukufulwa kwabunkalwe, ne cipyu caba nge lyeshi,

english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
translation: Caliwamapo ukwebaula umuntu pa bwelu,

english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
translation: Cibusa obe nga akucena muli fimo umucetekele,

english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
translation: Uwikwite alasuula no buci,

english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
translation: Umuntu uuseulukafye asha ne ŋanda yakwe,

english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
translation: Amafuta ya kacena kasuma no bubani filasansamusha umutima,

english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
translation: Abantu ababifi bena balafulumuka na pashili abalebatamfya,

english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
translation: Uulanga umuntu uwakaele imisango ibi,

english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
translation: Umukankala lyonse aitunga ukuba uwamano,

english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
translation: Ilyo abololoke baba pa cambaso abantu bonse balanga ne nsansa,

english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
translation: Uufisa bumpulamafunde bwakwe takatale abelelwa uluse iyoo,

english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
translation: Umuntu uukwatila Yawe akatiina lyonsefye alishuka,

english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
translation: Nge nkalamo iyilebuluma nangu iciswango ca bea icileimina umuntu,

english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
translation: Kateeka uwabula amano alateeka abantu ku kalili,

english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
translation: Umuntu uo bashinina ubupondo,

english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
translation: Uwenda ne cishinka alapusuka,

english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
translation: Umulimi uubombesha alakwata ifyakulya ifingi,

english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
translation: Ilyo mu calo mwaba ubusangu bakateeka balafula,

english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
translation: Umuntu wacishinka alasenaminwa apakalambafye,

english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
translation: Akapatulula takawama kalibipa,

english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
translation: Umuntu uwabupapa alapamfiwa ukukwata ifyuma,

english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
translation: Uulesalapula umuntu bamutemwa panuma,

english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
translation: Onse uutila, “Ukwibila wishi nangu nyina tekubifya,”

english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
translation: Umuntu umulili aletafye ulubuli ne mpatila,

english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
translation: Umuntu uukonkelela ifya mu mutima wakwe ninshi cipuba,

english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
translation: Uukumbusukako abalanda, tabulililwa nakalya,

english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
translation: Ilyo ababifi baba pa cambaso, abantu balafisama,

english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
translation: Umuntu uteeka abapina ubusha,

english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
translation: Abashikonka amafunde ebatasha abantu ababifi,

english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
translation: Abantu ababi bena tabaishiba umwalola umulinganya,

english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
translation: Umulanda wa myendele isuma,

english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
translation: Umwana uusunga amafunde aleluka,

english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
translation: Uumwena ubukankala bwakwe mu lufyengo lwakulila bambi pali nsosela,

english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
translation: Uushifwaya kukonka mafunde,

english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
translation: Nkosamutwe uushumfwa kukusalapulwa nangu bamwebaula shani,

english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
translation: Indetamisoka shilapata umuntu wakaele,

english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
translation: Icipuba cilalanga apapela icipyu caciko,

english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
translation: Nga kateeka alaposa amano ku bufi,

english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
translation: Icintu cimo ico umukankala no mupina bakwata icapalana nici,

english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
translation: Kateeka uulangulukila abapina pakupingula imilandu,

english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
translation: Ukukapa abaice no kubasalapula, ala ekubapeela amano,

english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
translation: Ilyo ababifi babombesha no kufula elyo no bubifi bufulilako mu calo,

english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
translation: Ulesalapula mwano lyonse, nao akakuletela mutende,

english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
translation: Ukushaba icimonwa abantu balonaika tabengashipikisha,

english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
translation: Amashiwifye yeka tayasalapula mubomfi,

english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
translation: Ilyo abololoke bateeka icalo, abantu balacankwa ne nsansa,

english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
translation: Nga wamona umuntu wabwangu kanwa,

english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
translation: Nga walela umubomfi mu bulamu ukufuma ku bwaice,

english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
translation: Umuntu umukali alabusha ulubuli,

english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
translation: Icilumba cilasebanya umuntu,

english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
translation: Uwampana no mupupu aisangula akapondo umwine,

english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
translation: Uutiina abantu citeyo kuli ena,

english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
translation: Abengi bafwaya ukutemwikwa kuli bakateeka,

english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
translation: Umololoke alapata uushili wacishinka,

english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
translation: Umuntu uwatemwa amano aletela wishi insansa,

english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
translation: Kateeka uuposa amano pakucita umulinganya alateeka icalo mu cibote,

english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
translation: Umuntu uusembeleka umubiye,

english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
translation: Umuntu mubi ailetelelafye umwine ku bubi bwakwe,

english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
translation: Abololoke balasakamana umulinganya pa bapina,

english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
translation: Abantu abapumya babusha ulubuli mu musumba,

english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
translation: Uwamano nga aya ku cilye ne cipuba,

english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
translation: We mwana wandi, nga wapokelela amashiwi yandi,

english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
translation: Pantu amano yakaba mu mutima obe,

english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
translation: Ukucenjela ekukakucingilila,

english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
translation: Amano yakakupusushako ukufuma mu nshila sha babifi,

english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
translation: abaleka imikalile iyaololoka

english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
translation: Bena balasansamuka mukucita ifyabipa,

english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
translation: Ee, ni ncenjeshi sha bantu,

english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
translation: Amano yakakupususha ku mpulumushi ya mwanakashi,

english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
translation: uwasangukila mulume wa ku bukashana bwakwe,

english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
translation: Pantu iŋanda yakwe itwala ku mfwa,

english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
translation: Pa baume abaya kuli ena tapabwela nelyo umo nakalya,

english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
translation: kabili nga walateya amatwi yobe ku fyamano,

english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
translation: Kanshi iwe uleendela mu nshila sha bantu abasuma,
