english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
translation: Pantu abantu abololoke ebakalaikala muli cino calo,

english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
translation: Lelo ababi ba bantu tabakasangwemo muli ci calo,

english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
translation: kabili nga walomba ukwiluka,

english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
translation: kabili ulefwaishafye amano nga filya fine ufwaisha silifa,

english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
translation: elyo ninshi ukeshiba umo ukukwatila Yawe akatiina kwalola,

english: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
translation: Pantu uupeela amano ni Yawe,

english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
translation: Ukucimfya kwa bololoke kwaba muli ena,

english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
translation: Pantu eulinda inshila sha balungami,

english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
translation: Elyo ukeshiba ubulungami no mulinganya,

english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
translation: Amashiwi yakwa Aguri mwana Yake, umwina Masa aumine imbila atile,

english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
translation: “Wilaesha ukwamba umubomfi pali shikulu wakwe,

english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
translation: Eico kwaliba abantu abalapisha bawishi,

english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
translation: Eko baba abantu abaimona ukuba abantu abakaele,

english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
translation: Eko bali abantu abo amenso yalukuma mu mutwe,

english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
translation: Ni nkulo ya bantu abo ameno yatwa ngo lupanga,

english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
translation: “Umunsundu waba na bana abanakashi babili,

english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
translation: Icalo ca bafwa,

english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
translation: “Umwana uuseka wishi,

english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
translation: Kwaliba ifintu fitatu ifyampapusha nganshi,

english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
translation: Kapumpe ifyo alelemba mu mulu,

english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
translation: “Ine nine natumpisha pa bantu bonse,

english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
translation: “Eficita umwanakashi cilende,

english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
translation: “Kwaliba ifintu fitatu ifitutumya icalo,

english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
translation: Umusha uwaisa ba kateeka wa calo,

english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
translation: umwanakashi uushatemwikwa lelo alyupwa,

english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
translation: “Pano calo paba utuntu tune utwacepesha nganshi,

english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
translation: Etunyelele, nangu tushakwata bulamba bwine bwine,

english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
translation: Na bapati, nabo tabakwata bulamba,

english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
translation: Na makanta nangu takwata imfumu,

english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
translation: Na mulinso, kuti umuntu amwikata na mu minwe,

english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
translation: “Kwaba ifintu fitatu ifyenda ubusaka,

english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
translation: Ine nshasambilila na mano yene,

english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
translation: Ni nkalamo iyacila inama shimbi shonsefye ku maka,

english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
translation: na mukolwe, ilyo aletaasa pa nkota,

english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
translation: “We muntu ala kale nga walitumpile no kulacita imiya,

english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
translation: Pantu nga wapuka umukaka mufuma umukaka uwatikama uwa mafuta,

english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
translation: Bushe nani uwatala anina ku mulu elyo ayabwelako?

english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
translation: “Ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lyonse lyaba ilyacishinka,

english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
translation: Pa mashiwi yakwe mwilaesha ukulundapo na yambi,

english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
translation: “Ifintu fibili ifyo nakulomba we Yawe,

english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
translation: Talusha ubucenjeshi no bufi kuli ine,

english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
translation: Pantu epali nga nakwatisha ifintu limbi nakutalamina,

english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
translation: Amashiwi yakwa Lemueli imfumu ya bena Masa, ayo nyina alemucenjeshako.

english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
translation: Yangu ifyo cawama ukushukila umwanakashi wine wine pa ŋanda!

english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
translation: Wiba wakwe amucetekela nganshi,

english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
translation: Apo wiba aikalila pano calo,

english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
translation: Ena afwaya fwaya ubushishi bwa masako ya mpaanga, no bushishi ubwatelela,

english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
translation: Ena alafumya icakulya ukutali no kucileta pa ŋanda,

english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
translation: Ena abuka bushikushiku,

english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
translation: Ena kutala aceceta ibala elyo alishita,

english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
translation: Ena aba uwaswangana ku milimo,

english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
translation: Ena alamwenamo mu milimo yonse intu abomba,

english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
translation: Ena ku minwe apikula ubushishi,

english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
translation: “We mwana wandi, we mwana wa mwifumo lyandi,

english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
translation: Ena alafwilisha abapina,

english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
translation: Ena tatiina nangu kube impepo shani,

english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
translation: Ena alapikula ifyakufimbana,

english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
translation: Wiba wakwe alicindikwa mu mpongolo,

english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
translation: Ena alapikula insalu ishatelela ne mishipi,

english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
translation: Ena alikwata amaka na bantu bonse balamucindika,

english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
translation: Ne lintu alanda, awe alandafye ifyamano fyeka fyeka,

english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
translation: Alapikintika lyonse ku milimo ya ba pa ŋanda,

english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
translation: Ena abana bakwe balamucankilwa,

english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
translation: Alasosa ati, “Abanakashi abaupwa bena bengi, ee basuma mufyo bacita,

english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
translation: Iwe wilaesha konaula amaka yobe ku banakashi,

english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
translation: Ala ukuba uwayemba kutumpika umuntu,

english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
translation: Eya, mulemulumbanyafye pa fintu acita.

english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
translation: “Tecakwesha, we Lamueli,

english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
translation: Epali bakolwa, kabili balaba ifyakonkomeshiwa mu fipope,

english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
translation: Peeleni ubwalwa ku bantu abalefwa,

english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
translation: Bena leka ebo balenwa,

english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
translation: “Iwe ulelandila abantu abashingailandila abene.

english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
translation: Ulebasoselako, kabili ulepingula imilandu no mulinganya,

english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
translation: We mwana wandi, wilalaba ifyo nkufunda,

english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
translation: Elyo ninshi amatala yobe yakulaisula paa no kupala,

english: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
translation: We mwana wandi, wilasuula ukukalipila kwakwa Yawe,

english: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
translation: Pantu Yawe alakalipila abo ena atemwa,

english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uwasanga amano ,

english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
translation: Pantu amano yalicila pa bunonshi bwa silifa,

english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
translation: Amano yaliluma umutengo ukucila tumabwe twa rubi,

english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
translation: Roma 12:16

english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
translation: Yobo 5:17

english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
translation: Amano muti wabumi kuli abo abayekatilila,

english: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
translation: Ubuso 3:19

english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
translation: Pantu amafunde yandi yakakulenga ukuti ukakokole pano calo,

english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
translation: Ku mano yakwe alengele amatenga yalekane,

english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
translation: We mwana wandi, sunga umutima pa mano yasuma na pakwiluka,

english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
translation: Fyena fikaba bumi kuli iwe,

english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
translation: Lyena ukenda mu nshila yobe ukwabula icakutiina,

english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
translation: Ilyo waya kukusendama tawakaletiina kantu nelyo kamo,

english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
translation: Wilakwata umwenso wa masanso ayapumikishafye,

english: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
translation: Pantu isubilo lyobe likaba muli Yawe,

english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
translation: Wilakaana kupeela icisuma ku balekabila,

english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
translation: Nga ulingilefye ukwafwako umubiyo ilyo line,

english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
translation: Wilapangila ukucitapo cimo icibi ku mwina mupalamano obe,

english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
translation: Icitemwiko icishifilwa ne cishinka tefyakulekako iyoo,

english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
translation: Wilaumanya umuntu uushikwete umulandu nelyo umo,

english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
translation: Wilafimbila umuntu wabuluku,

english: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
translation: Pantu Yawe apata uubifya ku mufulo,

english: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
translation: Intipu shakwa Yawe shaba pa ŋanda ya mubi,

english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
translation: Abantu abamisuula alabasuula,

english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
translation: Abamano balacindikwa,

english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
translation: Lyena ukamona ukusekelelwa, kabili uwe shina ilisuma

english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
translation: Uletetekela muli Yawe no mutima obe onse,

english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
translation: Na lyonsefye mu nshila yobe uleibukisha Yawe,

english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
translation: Wilaitunga ukuba uwamano,

english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
translation: Nga walacita ifi, awe ninshi ukakwata ubumi busuma,

english: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
translation: Cindika Yawe mu fyuma fyobe,

english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
translation: Mwe bana bandi muleumfwa ifyo ine ne shinwe ndemufunda,

english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
translation: We mwana wandi, umfwa kuno ulesekelela ifyo ndesosa,

english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
translation: Ine nakulanga inshila yamano,

english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
translation: Nga walaenda na mano, takwakabe cakukucilikila inshila,

english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
translation: Lyonse uleibukisha amafunde yandi,

english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
translation: Iwe wilaingila umwenda ababifi,

english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
translation: Talukamo, wilaendamo nangu panono,

english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
translation: Pantu abantu babi pakumona utulo

english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
translation: Bena balya umukate wabubifi,

english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
translation: Imisango ikonka abalungami yena yaba ngo lubuuto lwa pa macaca,

english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
translation: Nomba inshila ya babifi yaba nge mfifi ya bushiku,

english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
translation: Ifyo ndemufunda ala fisuma,

english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
translation: We mwana wandi uleumfwa ifyo ine ndesosa,

english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
translation: Wileka yafume ku cinso cobe,

english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
translation: Pantu ku bantu bonse abayasunga

english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
translation: Pali fyonsefye, ulesunga umutima obe,

english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
translation: Wilaesha nelyo limo ukulalanda icintu icishili cacine cine,

english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
translation: Uleloleshafye kuntanshi,

english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
translation: Uleshininkisha ifyo ulecita,

english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
translation: Wilaalukila ku kuso nangu ku kulyo.

english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
translation: Ilyo nali umwana munono mu ŋanda ya batata,

english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
translation: batata balemfunda abati,

english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
translation: Tola amano , no kwiluka,

english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
translation: Wilasangukila amano, pantu eyakakusunga,

english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
translation: Amano ala cikankala, eico kwata amano,

english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
translation: Uletemwa amano, nayo yakakupalamika,

english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
translation: Yakakupeela icakuyemfya ica ku mutwe obe,

english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
translation: We mwana wandi bika umutima ku mano ndekupandako,

english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
translation: Epali na bantu bambi bambifye kuti baliila fyuma fyobe,

english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
translation: Kabinge na pa mpela ya bumi bobe walaŋonta,

english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
translation: Elyo ukatila ati, “Mulandu nshi nshaleumfwila kufyo balenjalulula?

english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
translation: Nakeene no kubeela bakafundisha bandi,

english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
translation: Kwashele panono ukuiletela ububi no bonaushi

english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
translation: Ulenwa amenshi ya mu cishima cobe we mwine,

english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
translation: Wileka insonsa shobe shifukaukile pa mbilibili,

english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
translation: Leka fibe fyobe we mwinefye weka,

english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
translation: Leka akamfukumfuku kobe kabe akapaalwa,

english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
translation: Ulya mwanakashi alepa umukoshi nge nkoba,

english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
translation: Epakuti uleishiba umwakwenda bwino,

english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
translation: We mwana wandi,

english: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
translation: Pantu Yawe alishibafye bwino imyendele ya muntu,

english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
translation: Ifibi ificita umuntu mubi ala fiteyo

english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
translation: No kufwa kwine eco akafwila pa mulandu wakufilwa ukulaikanya,

english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
translation: Pantu imilomo ya mwanakashi cilende, ala yalowa ngo buci,

english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
translation: Nomba pakulekelesha yalula nga malulu,

english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
translation: Amakasa yakwe yakakutwala ku mfwa,

english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
translation: Ena tatontonkanya pa nshila iyilosha ku bumi,

english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
translation: Nomba kanshi, mwe bana bandi kutikeni kuli ine,

english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
translation: Umwanakashi wa uyu musango wakutalukakofye,

english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
translation: Epali wapeela umucinshi obe kuli bambi,

english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
translation: We mwana wandi, nga walaya ukufutilako umubiyo imisha,

english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
translation: Ena atilafye, “Awe nkantale ntubilishekofye panono,

english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
translation: Elyo ubupina bukakwishila ngo mupupu,

english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
translation: Umuntu umuwelewele kabili umubi,

english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
translation: Pakubepa alashinisha ku menso,

english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
translation: Ena elenganya ububi no bucenjeshi mu mutima wakwe,

english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
translation: Eico icinkunka cikesa mupumikishafye bwangu bwangu,

english: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
translation: Kwaba ifintu mutanda ifyo Yawe apata,

english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
translation: Amenso yacilumba,

english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
translation: umutima uupanga ifyabipa,

english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
translation: na kambone uulanda ifyabufi,

english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
translation: nga waibika mu bwafya pa mashiwi walandile,

english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
translation: We mwana wandi, ulesunga amafunde ya bawiso,

english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
translation: Pefye ulesunga amafunde yonse mu mutima obe,

english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
translation: Yakulakutungulula ilyo wakulaenda,

english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
translation: Pantu aya mafunde ni nyali,

english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
translation: Eyakukupususha ku mpulumushi ya mwanakashi,

english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
translation: Iwe wilakumbwa ubusuma bwakwe mu mutima obe,

english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
translation: Pantu cilende ena kuti wamusembelekela pa mukate umofye,

english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
translation: Bushe umuntu kuti afukatila umulilo mu ceni cakwe,

english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
translation: Bushe umuntu kuti anyanta pa musolilo,

english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
translation: Ala e cimo cinefye ukusendama na muka mwine,

english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
translation: kanshi pakuipokako ucite ici we mwana wandi.

english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
translation: Abantu tabasusha mpupu nga cakuti aiba

english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
translation: Nomba kwena nga aikatwa,

english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
translation: Nomba umuntu uucita ubucende ena mano ashikwata,

english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
translation: Pantu umulume wakwe elyo ailanga ifyo afubila umukashi wakwe,

english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
translation: Tekuti asumine ukumufutilapo,

english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
translation: Wileka amenso yobe yamone utulo,

english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
translation: Ipusushekofye nge mpombo iyilefuma mwisumbu,

english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
translation: Lolesha ku kanyelele we muntu umunaŋani iwe,

english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
translation: Kena takakwata intungulushi,

english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
translation: Nomba ulusuba lonsefye kalonganya icakulya cakako no kututila,

english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
translation: Nomba we munaŋani wa muntu iwe,

english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
translation: We mwana wandi ulesunga amashiwi yandi,

english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
translation: Elyo uyu mwanakashi aisa kumanya noyu mulumendo,

english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi ala untu akamuka, ne nsoni nakalya,

english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
translation: Limbi kuti aiminina pa musebo, limbi mu lubansa,

english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
translation: Awe umwanakashi afukatila no mulumendo,

english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
translation: “Ine ninkwata umutuulo wakwampana pamo kumwandi,

english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
translation: Eico njishile ndekufwaya

english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
translation: Pa busanshi bwandi ninyanshikapo insalu ishisuma,

english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation: Nimpupilapo ne cinyamuti icanunka busaka muri,

english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
translation: Ala twende, tuleya! Tuye yangala mpaka ulucelo!

english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
translation: Pantu umulume wandi talipo iyoo,

english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
translation: Ulebaka ifyo ndekufunda pakuti uleenda umumi,

english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
translation: Alisenda ne cikwama ca ndalama ishingi,

english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
translation: Na mashiwi yakumubembeleka amutunka,

english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
translation: Apopene alakonka no mwanakashi,

english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
translation: mpaka umufwi wapulinkana mu libu.

english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
translation: Nomba kanshi mwe bana bandi umfweni kuli ine,

english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
translation: Imwe mwileka imitima yenu ipilibukile ku misango ya uyu mwanakashi,

english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
translation: Pantu abaume bengi abo aonaula,

english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
translation: Pantu iŋanda yakwe e nshila iyitwala ku calo ca bafwa,

english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
translation: Uleyekata mu minwe yobe,

english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
translation: Uleeba mano auti, “Niwe nkashi yandi,”

english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
translation: Efyakulakutalusha kuli cilende umwanakashi,

english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
translation: Ubushiku bumo pa nsolokoto ya ŋanda yandi,

english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
translation: Awe namona pa bantu abo inshiku shishilati shifunde,

english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
translation: Ena aleenda mu musebo mupepi ne cinshoko,

english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
translation: Cali icungulo pali muntungulya,

english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
translation: Mwe, bushe tamuleumfwa uko amano yalebilikisha ngo mwanakashi?

english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
translation: Mulesalapo amafunde yandi ukucila silifa,

english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
translation: Pantu mano alicila pa tumabwe utwamutengo utwa rubi,

english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
translation: “Ine nine mano, nine cibinda wakwilula ifintu,

english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
translation: Ukuba na katiina kuli Yawe, ekupata ifyabipa,

english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
translation: Ne upandako amano nine, kabili nine mpeela ukwiluka no kwishiba ifyakucita,

english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
translation: Nine nenga ishamfumu shileteeka ifyalo,

english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
translation: Nine nenga bakateeka bonse baleteeka ifyalo,

english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
translation: Ine ne mano nalitemwa abantemwa,

english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
translation: Ifyuma no bucindami nine nakwata,

english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
translation: Ifyo ine mpeela ala fyalicila pali golide wine wine uwawamishiwa bwino,

english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
translation: Mano eminine pa mulu wa kalupili, mupepi no musebo,

english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
translation: Abantemwa ine ndabapeela ifyuma,

english: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
translation: “Yawe ewalengele mbeko mu kutendeka kwa milimo yakwe,

english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
translation: Ukutulafye ku kale na kale ine ninshi nalisansabikwa,

english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
translation: Ine nafyelwe ilyo kushilati kube na bemba,

english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
translation: Ine nafyelwe ilyo kushilati kube ne mpili,

english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
translation: ilyo na Lesa ashilati abumbe icalo ne mpanga shine ishabamo,

english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
translation: Ine epo nali ilyo Lesa aandalike umulu,

english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
translation: Ilyo aandalike amakumbi mu lwelele,

english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
translation: Ne lintu apimine amenshi ya muli bemba imipaka,

english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
translation: Eminine lubali lwa pa mpongolo iyo bengililapo mu musumba,

english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
translation: Ala epo nali mupepifye nankwe,

english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
translation: Naleanga ne nsansa pa calo cakwe,

english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
translation: “Kanshi nomba mwe bana bandi umfweni kuno.

english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
translation: Mulekonka amafunde yandi no kuba na mano,

english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uumfwa kuli ine,

english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
translation: Pantu uwansanga ala ninshi asanga ubumi,

english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
translation: Lelo umuntu uwafilwa ukunsanga, ala ena ailetelelafye umwine,

english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
translation: “Kuli imwe bonse mwe bantu ala nimwe ndeita,

english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
translation: Mwe mbulwamano sha bantu imwe, ala salapukeni,

english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
translation: Umfweni kuno pantu ine ndemwebako ifintu ifisuma,

english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
translation: Pantu ifyo akanwa kandi kasosa fyacishinka,

english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
translation: Fyonsefye ifyo ine nanda fyalilungama,

english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
translation: Ku muntu uwiluka alamona ukuti fyonse ifyo nanda fyaba pa bwelu,

english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
translation: Amano yaliikuulila iŋanda yayako ngo mwanakashi

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
translation: Ukukwatila Yawe akatiina e ntendekelo ya mano,

english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
translation: Pantu ni muli ine emo shikafulilako inshiku shenu,

english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
translation: Nga wakwata amano ninshi na mano yobe yakakulambula,

english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
translation: Umwanakashi icipuba alikalauka,

english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
translation: Ekala pa mwinshi wa ŋanda yakwe,

english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
translation: elyo aleita abalepitapo, abalungemefye mu nshila shabo aleti,

english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
translation: “Lekeni imbulwamano shise kuno.”

english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
translation: “Amenshi yakwiba ala eyasuma.

english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
translation: Lelo tabeshiba nokuti abaya ku ŋanda yakwe baitwalafye ku mfwa,

english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
translation: Naipaya ne nama, nateyanya no mwangashi,

english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
translation: Natuma ababomfi bakwe abanakashi balebilikisha,

english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
translation: “Lekeni imbulwamano shise kuno.”

english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
translation: “Iseni mulye umukate wandi,

english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
translation: Fumeni mu nshila shenu ishakukanaishiba,

english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
translation: Nga wakalipila uupumya ninshi kutukwa ulefwaya.

english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
translation: Tecakwesha ukukalipila uupumya, ena akakupatilapo.

english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
translation: Funda uwamano, na mano yakwe yalafulilako,

english: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
translation: Imbileni Yawe mulemwawila utupundu pano isonde lyonse

english: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
translation: Bombeleni Yawe ne nsansa,

english: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
translation: Ishibeni ukuti Yawe e Lesa.

english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
translation: Ingileni mu mpongolo she sano lyakwe no kutotela,

english: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
translation: Pantu Yawe musuma, ne citemwiko cakwe camuyayaya.

english: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
translation: Nkalaimba palwa citemwiko icishifilwa no mulinganya.

english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
translation: Nkacenjela pakuti nkaleenda mu nshila yabukaele,

english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
translation: Ine nshakatale ndolekesha pa fyabipa.

english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
translation: Abantu ba mitima iyapondama bafwile babe ukutali,

english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
translation: Uyo onse uwamba umunankwe mu bumfisolo,

english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
translation: Ndalolesha amenso yandi pa bacishinka ba muli cino calo,

english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
translation: Umuntu uucita ubucenjeshi, tewakwikala mumwandi iyoo.

english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
translation: Inshiku shonse ine nkalakanda ababi bonse muli cino calo,

english: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
translation: We Yawe wingomfwa ipepo lyandi,

english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
translation: pa mulandu wa cipyu cobe no bukali bobe,

english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
translation: Inshiku shandi shili nge cinshingwa ca cungulo.

english: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
translation: Lelo we Yawe niwe uteeka pe,

english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
translation: Uli nokwima no kubelelako Sioni uluse,

english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
translation: Pantu ababomfi bobe balitemwa amabwe ya mu Sioni,

english: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo bakaba na katiina ke shina lyakwa Yawe,

english: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
translation: Pantu Yawe akakuula Sioni cipya cipya,

english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
translation: Akasuka ipepo lya bantu ababusu,

english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
translation: Lekeni ifi fintu filembwe ku nkulo ishikakonkapo,

english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
translation: Ukufuma mu cifulo cakwe icamushilo Yawe alolesha,

english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
translation: Wilafisa icinso cobe kuli ine ilyo ndi mu bucushi!

english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
translation: kukumfwa ifyo abafungwa baleteta,

english: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
translation: Kanshi abantu bakalalumba ishina lyakwa Yawe mu Sioni,

english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
translation: ilyo abantu ba mishobo yonse bakalongana pamo ne shamfumu kukupepa Yawe.

english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
translation: Yawe, mu bwikashi bwa mweo wandi ancitile akafwanda,

english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
translation: Elyo nasosa natila,

english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
translation: Pakutendeka niwe wabumbile icalo,

english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
translation: Fyena fikaloba, lelo iwe ukabelelela pe,

english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
translation: Lelo iwe lyonse wabafye umo wabela,

english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
translation: Abana ba babomfi bobe bakekala mu ceni cobe,

english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
translation: Pantu inshiku shandi shipwa nge cushi,

english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
translation: Ine no mutima nauma,

english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
translation: Ine tepakutetateta nganshi,

english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
translation: Ine ndifye nge cuni ca mu matololo,

english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
translation: Ine nshimona tulo,

english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
translation: Abalwani bandi balansenteka akasuba konse,

english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
translation: Imito eyasanguka icakulya candi ngo mukate,

english: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
translation: We mutima wandi paala Yawe na matotelo,

english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
translation: Kabili pakutulimuna talinganya pamo ngefyo tumubifya,

english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
translation: Nga filya fine umulu wasansama ukutaluka kwisonde,

english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
translation: Nga filya fine akabanga katalukana na masamba,

english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
translation: Nga filya fine shibo akwatila bamwane inkumbu,

english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
translation: Pantu alishiba ifyo twabumbwa,

english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
translation: Pantu ubumi bwa muntu bwaba nge cani,

english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
translation: Ilyo umwela waisa pupapo,

english: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
translation: Lelo icitemwiko cakwa Yawe ico akwatila abamutiina cena camuyayaya,

english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
translation: Abo e bantu abasunga icipangano cakwe,

english: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
translation: Yawe ewateeka mu mulu,

english: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
translation: We mutima wandi paala Yawe na matotelo,

english: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
translation: Mulepaala Yawe na matotelo imwe mwe bamalaika bakwe,

english: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
translation: Mulepaala Yawe na matotelo imwe mwe fita fyakwe fya mu mulu,

english: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
translation: Mulepaala Yawe na matotelo imwe mwe fibumbwa fyakwe,

english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
translation: Eukubelelako uluse kuli fyonse ubifya,

english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
translation: Eukubwesha ku milomo ya nindi,

english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
translation: Eukupeela ifintu ifisuma mu mikalile yobe,

english: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
translation: Yawe eucita umulinganya no mucetekanya

english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
translation: Alangile inshila shakwe kuli Mose,

english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
translation: Yawe waluse kabili wacikuku,

english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
translation: Ena tebaula pe iyoo,

english: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
translation: We mutima wandi paala Yawe na matotelo.

english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
translation: Wapanga no tumfukumfuku twa menshi,

english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
translation: Ne nama sha mpanga emo shinwa amenshi,

english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
translation: Ku miti ya mu lulamba lwa mimana eko ifyuni fipikwila ifisansala,

english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
translation: Ulatuma ne mfula iyifuma ku mulu pakulokelela mu mpili,

english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
translation: Ulamesha umulemfwe uwakuti iŋombe shilelya,

english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
translation: Ulaleta no mwangashi uwakusansamusha umutima wa muntu,

english: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
translation: Imiti yakwa Yawe ilalokelelwa bwino ku mfula,

english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
translation: Emo ifyuni fipikwila ifisansala fyafiko,

english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
translation: Ifibushi mabwe fikala mu mpili ishitali,

english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
translation: Umweshi nao wafwilisha abantu pakuti baleishiba ukwaluka kwa nshita,

english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
translation: We mwine ulaifimba ulubuuto nge cakufwala,

english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
translation: Ne mfifi niwe uileta, no kwila ninshi bwaila,

english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
translation: Inkalamo nasho shilabuluma pakwikata inama,

english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
translation: Akasuba nga katula ninshi shabwelelamo mu mateshi yashiko,

english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
translation: Kanshi abantu nabo elyo bafuma,

english: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
translation: Yangu we Yawe, ifintu ubwingi ifyo wabumbile!

english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
translation: Kwaba na bemba umukalamba uwapabukisha,

english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
translation: Na mato emo yapitana ukuya no kubwela,

english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
translation: Ifi fyonse niwe filoleshako

english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
translation: Ilyo ufipeela ifyakulya, nafyo filalonganika.

english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
translation: Nga wafifutatila, filakwata no mwenso,

english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
translation: Na pa menshi ya mu mulu epo wakuula umusumba obe,

english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
translation: Nga watuma no Mupashi obe, awe ninshi filabumbwa,

english: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
translation: Uleke ubucindami bwakwa Yawe bulebelelela pe!

english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
translation: Ena atila nga alolesha pesonde, lilaitentelafye,

english: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
translation: Nakulaimbila Yawe ukushinta napo ine nkafwila,

english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
translation: Uleke amatontonkanyo yandi yabe ayakumusekesha,

english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
translation: Uleke imbifi shilobelele shonse pano isonde,

english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
translation: Imyela eyo wacita ukuba inkombe yobe,

english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
translation: Walikasha isonde pa mufula waliko,

english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
translation: Walikupa isonde kuli bemba nge cakufwala,

english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
translation: Lelo ilyo wakalipe, amenshi yalibwelelemo,

english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
translation: Yatentemwike mpili, yaya yalakonka imikonko,

english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
translation: Waliyacitila umupaka uyo yashili nokuciluka,

english: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
translation: Akutoteleni Yawe! Mulekuuta peshina lyakwe.

english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
translation: Acifikilishepo kuli Yakobo ukuba icipope,

english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
translation: “Kuli iwe ine nkapeela icalo ca Kenani,

english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
translation: Ilyo aba bantu balifye abampendwa iyinono,

english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
translation: Abaleendauka ukufuma ku mushobo umo ukuya ku mushobo ubiye

english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
translation: Nomba Yawe tasuminishe nangu umo ukuti alebacusha,

english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
translation: Atile, “Kwiba uwakwikata mu basubwa bandi abo nasala,

english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
translation: Yawe atumine icipowe mu calo,

english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
translation: Kabili alitangisheko umuntu umo ni Yosefu,

english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
translation: Amolu yakwe yalifye filonda filonda ku minyololo iyo bamukakileko,

english: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
translation: Yasuka ne nshita asobele kale yafika,

english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
translation: Mulemwimbila, muleimba isha malumbo,

english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
translation: Elyo imfumu ya mu Egupto yatuma abakuya mukakula,

english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
translation: Yamucita umukalamba pa ba kwisano lyaiko,

english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
translation: Yosefu alefundako na bana bakwa Farao umo alefwaila,

english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
translation: Elyo Israeli aile ku Egupto,

english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
translation: Yawe epakubafusha nganshi,

english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
translation: Ecalengele na bena Egupto bapate abantu bakwe,

english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
translation: Kanshi epakutuma umubomfi wakwe Mose,

english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
translation: Bacitile ifipeshamano mu Egupto mwine,

english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
translation: Yawe atuma imfifi mu calo,

english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
translation: Amenshi ya mu mimana yabo ayasangula umulopa,

english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
translation: Mulesekelela mwishina lyakwe ilyamushilo.

english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
translation: Mu calo cabo conse mwaisulamo ifyula,

english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
translation: Ilyo Yawe alandile, awe no tushembele utwingi twaisa,

english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
translation: Imfula yayaluka ukuba iyacitalawe iya mabwe,

english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
translation: Aonaula ne myangashi ne mikunyu yabo,

english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
translation: Ilyo Yawe alandile, awe na makanta alakata,

english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
translation: Fyalya ifintu fyonse ifyamenene mu calo cabo,

english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
translation: Elyo Yawe aipaya amabeli mu calo ca Egupto,

english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
translation: Epakufumyamo abena Israeli,

english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
translation: Abena Egupto bena tepakutemwa pakumona uko abena Israeli baleya,

english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
translation: Yawe epakwansa ne kumbi pakubakupa,

english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
translation: Mulelolesha kuli Yawe na ku maka yakwe,

english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
translation: Ilyo bamulombele icakulya,

english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
translation: Alepwile icilibwe, mwafumfumuka amenshi,

english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
translation: Pantu alibukishe icilayo cakwe icamushilo,

english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Yawe afumishe abantu bakwe abaile balesekelela.

english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
translation: Aile bapeela ne fyalo fya ba mishobo imbi,

english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
translation: Epakuti balenakila amafunde yakwe,

english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
translation: Muleibukisha ifipeshamano ifyo acita,

english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
translation: Mwe bufyashi bwakwa Abrahamu umubomfi wakwa Yawe,

english: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
translation: Ena ni Yawe, e Lesa wesu.

english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
translation: Alebukisha icipangano cakwe umuyayaya,

english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
translation: E cipangano ico apangene na Abrahamu,

english: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
translation: Abapuswishe ku babapatile,

english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
translation: Esra 3:11

english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
translation: Elintu abantu basumine ifilayo fyakwa Yawe,

english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
translation: Imila 5:13

english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
translation: Mu matololo baikatwa no lunkumbwa,

english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
translation: Kanshi epakubapeela ifyo balekabila,

english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
translation: Mu matololo bena bafimbila Mose,

english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
translation: Elyo umushili walepwike wamina Datani,

english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
translation: No mulilo nao waimina abalebomfwila,

english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
translation: Pa lupili lwa Holebu bapanga icilubi ca ciponti ca ŋombe,

english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
translation: Nani engalanda pa fintu ifyakupapa ifyo Yawe acita,

english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
translation: Bakabwishe ubucindami bwakwa Yawe,

english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
translation: Balaba na kuli Lesa uwabapuswishe,

english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
translation: ne fipeshamano acitile mu calo ca Hamu,

english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakupanga ukubalofya.

english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
translation: Kwena bena balisuulile icalo cisuma,

english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
translation: Baikalilefye ukulailishanya mu matenti yabo,

english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
translation: Kanshi nao epakwimya ukuboko no kulapa kuli bena ukuti,

english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
translation: Ine nkasalanganya aba nko shenu mu benafyalo,

english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
translation: Baliikulike kwikoli lyakwa Baali uwa ku Peo,

english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
translation: Awe basuka babalamuna Yawe nao afulwa palwa micitile yabo iyibi,

english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
translation: Lelo Fineasi aisa ima, akanda abalufyenye,

english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
translation: Na pali ici alengelwe ukuba umololoke,

english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
translation: Kabili ku lulamba lwa menshi ya Meriba balikalifye Yawe,

english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
translation: Pantu basangukile Umupashi wakwa Lesa,

english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
translation: Imila 16:34

english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
translation: Lelo bena balaampana na benafyalo,

english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
translation: Balapepa no tulubi twabo,

english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
translation: Basukile balaipaya na bana babo abaume na banakashi,

english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
translation: Basumishe umulopa wa bakaele,

english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
translation: Imicitile yabo yalengele babe abakowela,

english: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
translation: We Yawe, ukanjibukisheko ilyo ukakumbusukako abantu bobe.

english: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
translation: Kanshi Yawe epakufulilwa abantu bakwe,

english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
translation: Epakubapeela mu minwe ya benafyalo,

english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
translation: Abalwani babo balabateekafye buluku buluku,

english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
translation: Imikufye iyingi Yawe alebalubula,

english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
translation: Lelo nangu caleba ifyo, Yawe alesakamana ku macushi yabo

english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
translation: Ni pa mulandu wabo epo aibukishishe icipangano cakwe,

english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
translation: Alelenga na bonse abalebasenda bunkole,

english: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
translation: Tupususheko, we Yawe we Lesa wesu,

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe Lesa wakwa Israeli

english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
translation: Amalu 100:5

english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
translation: Ifwe twalibifya nga filya fine ne fikolwe fyesu fyabifishe,

english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
translation: Bashifwe ilyo bali mu Egupto tabaposeleko amano ku fipeshamano fyobe.

english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
translation: Lelo ena alibapuswishe pa mulandu we shina lyakwe,

english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
translation: Aebawile Bemba Wakashika nao auma, no kukama akama.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Peeleni ukutasha kuli Yawe pantu ena musuma,

english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
translation: Bamo balikele umwafiita fititi elyo na mu malangulushi,

english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
translation: Pantu balitalamine amashiwi yakwa Lesa,

english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
translation: Ecalengele abapose mukubomba imilimo yacibe nganshi,

english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
translation: Kanshi epakupunda mutuule kuli Yawe mu macushi yabo,

english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
translation: Yawe epakubafumya mu mfifi na mu malangulushi,

english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
translation: Balekeni baletotela Yawe pa citemwiko cakwe icishipwa,

english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
translation: Pantu alapankula impongolo sha mukuba,

english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
translation: Bamo basangwike ifiwelewele pa mulandu wa bucisanguka bwabo,

english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
translation: Casuka ne cakulya cine calabaselaula ku mikoshi,

english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
translation: Kanshi epakukuuta mutuule kuli Yawe mu macushi yabo,

english: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
translation: Lekeni abo Yawe alubula balelanda aya mashiwi,

english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
translation: Atuma ishiwi, no kubondapa lyabondapa,

english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
translation: Ee, balekeni baletotela Yawe pa citemwiko cakwe icishipwa,

english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
translation: Balekeni balemutuulila amalambo yakutotela,

english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
translation: Bamo baleenda ne fimato pali bemba,

english: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
translation: Balemona ne milimo Yawe abomba,

english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
translation: Ena atila nga alanda,

english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
translation: Ne fimato nafyo epakulaimina mu mulu no kulaiteneka pa menshi,

english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
translation: Baletalansukafye no kulapungaila kwati bantu bakolelwe ubwalwa,

english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
translation: Kanshi epakukuuta mutuule kuli Yawe mu macushi yabo,

english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
translation: Mukatepentepe atalalika ne cimwela,

english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
translation: abo abwesha ukufuma mu fyalo,

english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
translation: Nabo tepakusansamuka ico bemba atalala tondolo,

english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
translation: Ee, balekeni baletotela Yawe pa citemwiko cakwe icishipwa,

english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
translation: Balekeni balemulumbilisha mu lukuta lwa cintubwingi,

english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
translation: Ayalwile imimana ukubafye amatololo,

english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
translation: Eusangula ne calo caumfwika ukuba ica cicele,

english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
translation: Eusangula amatololo ukuba ifishiba fya menshi,

english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
translation: Kulya eko atwele abantu abali ne nsala pakuti eko baleikala,

english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
translation: Batandile ne mbuto mu mabala,

english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
translation: Ena nao abapaala nabo balasanduluka nganshi,

english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
translation: Kanshi impendwa yabo yalicepeleko,

english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
translation: Bamo balelulumbafye mu matololo umushali nshila,

english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
translation: Alangile ukuti tasekele mu ntungulushi shabo,

english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
translation: Lelo abapina bena abapusushako mu bulanda bwabo,

english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
translation: Abantu abololoke pakumona ifi bena balasansamuka,

english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
translation: Ala mwe bamano, muletontonkanya pali ifi fintu,

english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
translation: Baculile nganshi ku nsala ne cilaka,

english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
translation: Kanshi epakupunda mutuule kuli Yawe mu macushi yabo,

english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
translation: Epakubatungulula mu nshila iyalungama

english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
translation: Ee, balekeni baletotela Yawe pa citemwiko cakwe icishipwa,

english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
translation: Pantu eupwisha ne cilaka ca bantu,

english: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
translation: We Lesa umutima wandi ulifye uwashipa,

english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
translation: Nga nani akantwala mu musumba we linga?

english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
translation: Bushe teiwe we Lesa watuposa?

english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
translation: Shi wingatwafwilishako ukulwisha abalwani,

english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
translation: Lesa nga aba ku lubali lwesu ninshi tulecimfya,

english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
translation: Ima we seese, na iwe we nsango,

english: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
translation: We Yawe, ine nakulakulumbanya pakati ka mishobo ya bantu,

english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
translation: Pantu icitemwiko cobe cikulu nganshi ukucila ne myulu,

english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
translation: Ube uwasumbulwa ukucila na pa myulu, we Lesa,

english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
translation: Tupususheko no kutwafwa ku maka ya kuboko kobe ukwa ku kulyo,

english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
translation: Amalu 57:7-11

english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
translation: Gileadi ena wandi, na Manase nao wine wandi,

english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
translation: Moabu ena e musambilo wandi,

english: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
translation: We Lesa, weo ine numbanya,

english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
translation: Kuti calinga bamwane baleseulukafye mukulapula,

english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
translation: Kuti cawama uwamukongweshako ese amupoke ifyuma fyakwe fyonsefye,

english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
translation: Kuti cawama pebafye nangu umo uwakumulangulukilako,

english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
translation: Kuti cawama aba mu luko lwakwe bakalobelelefye bonse nakalya nakalya,

english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
translation: Kuti cawama we Yawe, uleibukisha ifyabupulumushi fya fikolwe fyakwe,

english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
translation: Kuti cawama we Yawe, uleibukisha ifibi fyabo lyonsefye,

english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
translation: Pantu ena taletontonkanyapo ukucitila abantu bambi uluse,

english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
translation: Ena alitemenwe ukulatipwila bambi,

english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
translation: Ena afwale intipu nge cakufwala cakwe,

english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
translation: Lekeni shimukupilile nge nsalu afwala,

english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
translation: Pantu ababifi na bantu incenjeshi balelanda pali ine,

english: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
translation: Imili 1:20

english: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
translation: Lelo we Mfumu Yawe,

english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
translation: Pantu ine ndi mupina kabili nshikwete nangu kamo,

english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
translation: Ine ndefumapo nge cinshingwa ilyo akasuba kawa,

english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
translation: Amakufi yandi nayapomponteka pa mulandu wakufunga ukulya,

english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
translation: Ine nsangwikefye uwakuwelwa ku bampata,

english: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
translation: We Yawe, we Lesa wandi,

english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
translation: Uleke beshibe ukuti kuboko kobe, we Yawe, ekwacita ici.

english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
translation: Ilyo bena balendapisha,
