english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
translation: Uleke abalwani bandi basebane,

english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
translation: Balelanda ifintu ifyalupato pali ine,

english: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
translation: Na kanwa kandi nakulakutotela we Yawe,

english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
translation: Pantu wiminina kukupokololako umulanda,

english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
translation: Bena balenjimina nelyo ine kwena nabatemwa,

english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
translation: Ine kuti nga nabacitila ifisuma, bena bancitila ifyabipa.

english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
translation: Saleni umuntu imbifi eo amulubulwishe,

english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
translation: Lekeni bamusange no mulandu ilyo alelubulula,

english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
translation: Kuti calinga inshiku shakwe ishakwikala pano calo shicepeleko,

english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
translation: Kuti cawama abana bakwe ukushala bakashiwa,

english: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
translation: We Yawe, bushe mulandu nshi wiminina akatalamukila?

english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
translation: Alateyamina no kubotelela panshi pakufwailisha,

english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
translation: Mu mano yakwe, umubifi atila, “Yawe alilaba,

english: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
translation: Ala ima we Yawe,

english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
translation: Cinshi umubifi akwatila imisuula kuli Lesa,

english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
translation: Lelo we Yawe, ulamona amafya pamo no kulilishika,

english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
translation: Funa ukuboko kwa mubifi no kwa ushumfwa.

english: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
translation: Yawe ni mfumu pe na pe,

english: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
translation: We Yawe ulomfwa ukupapata kwa bantu abacucutika,

english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
translation: Ulacita umulinganya kuli bakashiwa na ku balecululuka

english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
translation: Mu mataki emo umubifi acushisha abalanda,

english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
translation: Umubifi alaitakisha pa fya lunkumbwa lwakwe

english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
translation: Mu cilumba cakwe, umubifi tafwaya Yawe,

english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
translation: Enda uwashuka lyonse mu micitile yakwe,

english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
translation: Mu mutima atila, “Takwaba icankutiinya,

english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
translation: Mu kanwa kakwe mufumafye intipu, ubufi pamo ne fyakutiinya,

english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
translation: Alabelama mu mbali ya nshila sha mu mishi,

english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
translation: Abelama pamo nga filya inkalamo ifisama,

english: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
translation: Yawe aebele imfumu yandi ati,

english: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
translation: Mu Sioni emo Yawe akalundulwila amaka yobe ayabufumu,

english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
translation: Abashilika bobe bakalaipeelesha mukukubeela pa bushiku bwa nkondo.

english: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
translation: Yawe alilapa umulapo uo takalapuluke atila,

english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
translation: Imfumu ili lwa ku kulyo kobe,

english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
translation: Ikapingula imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
translation: Imfumu ikanwa amenshi mu kamana akabela mu nshila,

english: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
translation: Ukukwatila Yawe akatiina, e ntendekelo ya mano,

english: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
translation: Ificitwa fyakwa Yawe fikulu nganshi,

english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
translation: Fyonse ifyo ena acita awe fintu fyacindama kabili fyabulamba,

english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
translation: Ena alenga lyonse tuleibukisha ifipapwa fyakwe.

english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
translation: Eupekanishisha icakulya bonse abamukwatila akatiina,

english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
translation: Ena alilanga abantu bakwe ifyo amaka yakwe yaba,

english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
translation: Imilimo ya maboko yakwe yacishinka kabili yamulinganya,

english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
translation: Yakubelelela pe na pe,

english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
translation: Ena apeele ukulubuka ku bantu bakwe,

english: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
translation: Umuntu umubifi nga amona ifi awe tepakufulwa,

english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
translation: Abana bakwe bakulaba impalume mu calo,

english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
translation: Icuma no bukankala fikaba mu ŋanda yakwe,

english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
translation: Nangu ni mu mfifi ulubuuto lulasanikila umololoke,

english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uwakwata umutima uwakupeela,

english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
translation: Pantu ena takabale atelentenshiwa nakalya,

english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
translation: Ena tatiina kubililwa imbila ibi,

english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
translation: Umutima wakwe walicingililwa, tatiina kantu nakalya,

english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
translation: Alisalanganya konse konse ifyakupeela abapina,

english: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
translation: Lekeni ishina lyakwa Yawe lipaalwe na matotelo

english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
translation: Ukutendekafye pa kutula kwa kasuba ukufika napo kawila,

english: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
translation: Yawe alisumbulwa ukucila pa bantu ba mishobo yonse pano isonde,

english: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
translation: Bushe nani uwingalingana na Yawe, Lesa wesu,

english: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
translation: Ena alenama pakulolesha,

english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
translation: Ena ewimya umulanda mu lukungu,

english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
translation: Epakuti baleikala pamo ne ntungulushi,

english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
translation: Ena ewacindamika iŋumba pa ŋanda yaiko,

english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
translation: Ilyo Israeli afumine mu Egupto,

english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
translation: elyo Yuda asangwile icifulo cakwa Lesa icamushilo,

english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
translation: Ilyo bemba amwene, alifulumwike,

english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
translation: Impili nasho shaletolauka amabaka nga basukusuku,

english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
translation: Cinshi ico iwe we bemba wafulumukile?

english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
translation: Nemwe mwe mpili, cinshi ico mwaletolaukila nga basukusuku?

english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
translation: We sonde tutuma pa cinso ca Mfumu,

english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
translation: Enafye ewasangwile icilibwe ukuba icishiba ca menshi,

english: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
translation: Tekuli ifwe, we Yawe, ala tekuli ifwe,

english: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Aroni, tetekeleni Yawe,

english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
translation: Imwe mwe bamukwatila akatiina, tetekeleni Yawe,

english: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
translation: Yawe alatwibukisha, kabili ifwe akatupaala.

english: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
translation: Ena akapaala bonse abakwatila Yawe akatiina,

english: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
translation: Yawe engamupeelesha ubufyashi,

english: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
translation: Yawe engalamupaala imwe,

english: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
translation: Yawe eka e mwine wa myulu,

english: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
translation: Ala abafwa tabalumbanya Yawe iyoo,

english: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
translation: Lelo nifwe fwe batuntulu nifwe tulepaala Yawe na matotelo,

english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
translation: Nga cinshi ico imishobo ingalaipushisha aiti,

english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
translation: Ala ifwe Lesa wesu aba mu mulu,

english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
translation: Lelo bena utulubi twabo filubi ifya silifa ne fya golide,

english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
translation: Utunwa twena fyalikwata lelo tafilanda nakalya,

english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
translation: Amatwi nayo fyalikwata, lelo tafyumfwa nakalya,

english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
translation: Iminwe fyalikwata, lelo tafipampanta nakalya,

english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
translation: Bonse abafipanga nabo bakaba nga fyena,

english: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli, tetekeleni Yawe,

english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
translation: Ine nalitemwa Yawe pantu alyumfwile kwishiwi lyandi,

english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
translation: Ine nalisumine, ecalengele nasosele nati,

english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
translation: Kabili ilyo ine amano yapelele nalisosele natilefye,

english: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
translation: Bushe finshi ningabwesesha kuli Yawe

english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
translation: Kol 4:13

english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
translation: Ine nkafikilisha ifilayo fyandi kuli Yawe,

english: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
translation: Imfwa ya bamushilo bakwa Yawe

english: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
translation: We Yawe, ala cine cine ine ndi mubomfi obe,

english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
translation: Ine nkatuula ilambo ilyakukutotela,

english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
translation: Ine nkafikilisha ifilayo fyandi kuli Yawe,

english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
translation: mu mansa sha ŋanda yakwa Yawe,

english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
translation: Pantu aliteele amatwi yakwe kuli ine,

english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
translation: Imyando ya mfwa yalimpombele,

english: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
translation: Kanshi epakwita peshina lyakwa Yawe nati,

english: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
translation: Yawe aliba ne cikuuku kabili mulungami.

english: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
translation: Yawe apokololako abaicefya mu mutima,

english: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
translation: Awe nomba pemwinako nakabili we mweo wandi,

english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
translation: Pantu we Yawe, naupusushako umweo wandi ukufuma ku mfwa,

english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
translation: Epakuti ndeenda pa cinso cakwa Yawe mu calo ca bomi.

english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
translation: Akulumbeni Yawe mwe mishobo yonse!

english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
translation: Pantu icitemwiko cakwe ico atukwatila cikalamba nganshi,

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Akutoteleni Yawe, pantu musuma,

english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
translation: Imishobo yonse yalinshingile,

english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
translation: Esra 3:11

english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
translation: Yanshingulwikefye kwati ni nshimu,

english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
translation: Imila 5:13

english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
translation: Ala Yawe e maka yandi kabili e lwimbo lwandi,

english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
translation: Umfweni utupundu twansansa no twakucimfya

english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
translation: Ukuboko kwa ku kulyo ukwakwa Yawe nakusumbulwa mu mulu.

english: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
translation: Ine nshafwe, lelo ndi umumi,

english: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
translation: Nangu Yawe ankandile nganshi,

english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
translation: Njiswileniko impongolo shabololoke,

english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Lekeni abena Israeli baletila,

english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
translation: Iyi e mpongolo yakwa Yawe,

english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
translation: Ine nkakupeela amatotelo, pantu ine walinjaswike.

english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
translation: Ilibwe ilyo bakakuula basuulile,

english: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
translation: Yawe ewacita ifi,

english: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
translation: Buno e bushiku ubo Yawe apanga,

english: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
translation: Wingatupusushako we Yawe twapapata!

english: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
translation: Abe uwapaalwa uyu waisa uo Yawe atuma.

english: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
translation: Yawe e Lesa,

english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
translation: Niwe Lesa wandi, kabili nakulakutotela,

english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Akutoteleni Yawe, pantu musuma,

english: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Lekeni na bantu abakwatila Yawe akatiina baletila,

english: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
translation: Amalu 100:5

english: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
translation: Yawe aba na ine, ine nshakatiine kantu nakalya.

english: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
translation: Yawe aba na ine, ena eungafwilishako,

english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
translation: Caliwama ukufisama muli Yawe,

english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
translation: Caliwama ukufisama muli Yawe,

english: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
translation: Balishuka abantu ababa abakaele mu micitile yabo,

english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
translation: Ine ndakufwaisha no mutima wandi onse,

english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
translation: Ine nalikwatisha amano ukucila na pa bakalamba,

english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
translation: Ine nalifumya amakasa mu nshila shabipa,

english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
translation: Ine ku fipope fyobe nshapatukako iyo,

english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
translation: Yangu, ifyo amashiwi yobe yalowa!

english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
translation: Ku malango yobe eko mpandwa amano,

english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
translation: Ishiwi lyobe ni nyali ku makasa yandi,

english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
translation: Ine nalilaile, nalundapo no mulapo natile,

english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.
translation: We Yawe, ala ine ndacula nganshi,

english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
translation: We Yawe pokelela amalumbo ya ku kanwa kandi ayakuitemenwa,

english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
translation: Nangu line imfwa yaba mupepi na ine lyonsefye,

english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
translation: Ine amafunde yobe ndayasunga mu mutima wandi,

english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
translation: Abantu ababifi balanteya ifiteyo,

english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
translation: Ifipope fyobe e cuma candi ica pe na pe,

english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
translation: Ee, nalosha umutima wandi mukulasunga ifipope fyobe,

english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
translation: Ine nalipata abantu ba mitima ibili,

english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
translation: Niwe mfisamamo, kabili niwe nkwela yandi,

english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
translation: Ntalukeni imwe mwe babifi ba bantu,

english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
translation: Ntungilila nga mulya mwine walaile pakuti ndeenda umumi,

english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
translation: Unjikatishefye lyena nalapusuka,

english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
translation: Bonse abashibeela ifipope fyobe ulabatamfula,

english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
translation: Ababifi pano isonde bonsefye ulabakululula nge fisoso,

english: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
translation: Ulumbanishiwe we Yawe,

english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
translation: Awe, umubili wandi ulatutuma pakukubela akatiina,

english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
translation: Ine nalicita ifyalungama, kabili ifisuma,

english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
translation: Umone ukuti wansunga ne mubomfi obe,

english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
translation: Amenso yandi ine nayanaka kukulolela ipusukilo lyobe,

english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
translation: Ne mubomfi obe ncitila ukulingana ne citemwiko cobe,

english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
translation: Ine ndi mubomfi obe, unenge ukwiluka,

english: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
translation: We Yawe, ala nomba e nshita yakucitapo cimo,

english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
translation: Pantu ine nalitemwisha amafunde yobe ukucila golide,

english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
translation: Kabili na pa mulandu wakuti nalimona ukuti amalango yobe yonse yasuma,

english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
translation: Ifipope fyobe ala fyaliwama,

english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
translation: Ne milomo yandi nakulashimika,

english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
translation: Imilondolwele ya mashiwi yobe ilansanikila,

english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
translation: Ine ndesula akanwa kandi no kupemekesha,

english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
translation: Pilibukila kuli ine no kunangulukilako,

english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
translation: Untungulule umwakwenda ukulingana ne shiwi lyobe,

english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
translation: Ndubula ine ku bantu balukakala,

english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
translation: Lenga icinso cobe cisanikile pali ne mubomfi obe,

english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
translation: Ifilamba filakonkoloka mu menso yandi,

english: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
translation: We Yawe uli mulungami,

english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
translation: Ifipope ifyo wapanga fyalilungama,

english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
translation: Umukoosha wandi eulendya,

english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
translation: Ine ndasansamuka ilyo nkonka amafunde yobe,

english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
translation: Ala ifilayo fyobe fyalisangwa ukuti cine cine fyacishinka nganshi,

english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
translation: Nangu ndi munono kabili uwasuulwa,

english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
translation: Ubulungami bobe bwa pe na pe,

english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
translation: Amacushi na masakamika nayamponena,

english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
translation: Ifisambilisho fyobe fyena fyaba inshiku shonse ifyalungama,

english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.
translation: We Yawe, ala ine nkuuta uko uli no mutima wandi onse,

english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
translation: Ine niwefye ndekuuta umpususheko,

english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
translation: Ine mbuka ku macaca, no kulalomba ubwafwilisho,

english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
translation: Ine ndolafye ubushiku bonse ukwabula utulo,

english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.
translation: Kutika kwishiwi lyandi ukulingana ne citemwiko cobe icishifilwa,

english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
translation: Ine nakulatontonkanya pa malango yobe,

english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
translation: Abo bantu abapanga ifyabipa nabapalamina,

english: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
translation: Nomba uli mupepi, we Yawe,

english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
translation: Ine nalishiba ukufuma ku kale ukuti ifisambilisho fyobe wafishimpa ifyakubelelela pe.

english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
translation: We Yawe, lolekesha pa macushi yandi no kumpokololako,

english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
translation: Ndubulwilako kabili umpususheko,

english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
translation: Ipusukilo lyena lyabafye ukutali na babifi,

english: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
translation: We Yawe, inkumbu shobe shalikulisha nganshi,

english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
translation: Abalwani abancusha balifulisha,

english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
translation: Ntila nga nalolesha pali bampulamafunde awe cilankalipa,

english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.
translation: Mona ifyo ine natemwa amalango yobe we Yawe,

english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
translation: Ifipope fyobe filansansamusha,

english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
translation: Yonsefye amashiwi yobe yacishinka,

english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
translation: Bakateeka balancushafye apabula umulandu,

english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
translation: Ine tepakusansamuka palwa cilayo cobe,

english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
translation: Ubufi ine nalibupata kabili nshibufwaya nakalya,

english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
translation: Ine ndakulumbanya imiku cine lubali pa bushiku bumo,

english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
translation: Abatemwisha amafunde yobe balikwatisha umutende,

english: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
translation: Ine ndolela ipusukilo lyobe we Yawe,

english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
translation: Ine ndabeela ifipope fyobe,

english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
translation: Ine ndabeela ifipope fyobe elyo ne fisambilisho fyobe,

english: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.
translation: We Yawe uleke inkuuta yandi ilefika kuli iwe,

english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
translation: Ulencitila ifintu ifisuma ne mubomfi obe,

english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
translation: Uleke ukupapata kwandi kwise uko uli,

english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
translation: Uleke imilomo yandi ikulumbanye icine cine,

english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
translation: Uleke ululimi lwandi lukwimbile ishiwi lyobe,

english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
translation: Uleke ukuboko kobe kwangufyanye ukungafwa,

english: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
translation: We Yawe ine ndolela ipusukilo lyobe,

english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
translation: Uleke ine mbe umumi pakuti ndekulumbanya,

english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
translation: Ee, ine ndubantika nge mpaanga iyaluba,

english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
translation: Isula amenso yandi pakuti ndemona ifyakupapa,

english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
translation: Pano calo ine ndi mulebeshi,

english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
translation: Balishuka abasunga ifyebo fyakwe,

english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
translation: Umweo wandi ulepwilila kukufuluka amafunde yobe inshita yonse.

english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
translation: Ulakalipila abamiya, ala bena balitipwa,

english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
translation: Mpusushako ku musebanya no kusuulwa,

english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
translation: Nangufye bakateeka bengantekela icilye no kumpingula,

english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
translation: Ifyebo fyobe efyansansamusha,

english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
translation: Ndi mupepi no kubwelela kwiloba,

english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
translation: Ine nalikwebele palwa myendele yandi, na iwe walinjasuka,

english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
translation: Leka ine ngumfwikishe ubufundisho bwa fipope fyobe,

english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
translation: Umupashi wandi naunakuka pa mulandu wabulanda,

english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
translation: Wileka ndekonkelela inshila shabucenjeshi,

english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
translation: Balishuka abashilufyanya nelyo cimo,

english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
translation: Ine nalisala inshila yacishinka,

english: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
translation: Ine nakonenafye ku fyebo fyobe we Yawe,

english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
translation: Ine nakulabutukila mu nshila ya mafunde yobe,

english: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
translation: We Yawe, unsambilishe ukukonka ifipope fyobe,

english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
translation: Unenge ukwiluka no kuleka ndesunga amafunde yobe,

english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
translation: Ulenangililako mu nshila ya fisambilisho fyobe,

english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
translation: Leka ine ndefwaisha ukubeela ifyebo fyobe,

english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
translation: Fumya amenso yandi ku fintu ifyabuwelewele,

english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
translation: Fikilisha amalayo yobe walaile umubomfi obe,

english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
translation: Mpusushako ku musebanya uo ntiina,

english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
translation: Walitupeela amafunde yobe,

english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
translation: Awe ine ndefulukafye ukulanakila ifipope fyobe,

english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
translation: We Yawe, leka ukutemwa kobe ukwapwililika kwise kuli ine,

english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
translation: Lyena nkamona ifyakwasuka abansenteka,

english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
translation: Wifumya mu kanwa kandi ishiwi ilyacishinka

english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
translation: Ine lyonse nakulabeela amalango yobe

english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
translation: Kabili ine nakulaenda mu buntungwa,

english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
translation: Ine nkalanda pa fisambilisho fyobe pa cinso ca shamfumu,

english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
translation: Ukubeela amafunde yobe ine kulansansamusha,

english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
translation: Ndesumbwila amaboko yandi ku mafunde yobe, ayo natemwa,

english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
translation: We Yawe ibukisha icilayo ico wandaile ine ne mubomfi obe,

english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
translation: Awe, kuti cawama imibeele yandi nga kuti yaba iyacishinka,

english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
translation: Icintekako umutima mu macushi nici icakuti,

english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
translation: Abamufimbila ine tepakuntumfya ukwabula uluse,

english: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
translation: Ine ntila nga naibukisha amafunde yobe ayakale nakale,

english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
translation: Icipyu ine cilanjikata nganshi,

english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
translation: Konsefye uko ine nja mukwikala,

english: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
translation: We Yawe, ubushiku bonse ndebukisha ishina lyobe,

english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
translation: Uyu e muteto wandi ncita,

english: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
translation: We Yawe, niwefye cakaniko candi,

english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
translation: Ine ndefwaisha icinso cobe no mutima wandi onse,

english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
translation: Ilyo ine ntontonkanya pa mibeele yandi,

english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
translation: Kanshi nga cakuti nalasakamana amafunde yobe yonse,

english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
translation: Ndeendesha kabili ine nshaposa inshita,

english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
translation: Nangufye abalwani bampombe mu ntambo,

english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
translation: Pa kati ka bushiku ine ndeema,

english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
translation: Ine ndi cibusa wa bantu bonse abakukwatila akatiina,

english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
translation: Isonde lyonse lyaisulamo icitemwiko cobe icishipwa, we Yawe,

english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
translation: Ncitila icisuma ne mubomfi obe

english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
translation: Unsambilisheko amano no bupingushi ubusuma,

english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
translation: Lintu nshilapita mukucula nalelubantika,

english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
translation: Kwena uli musuma, nefyo ucita ala fisuma,

english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
translation: Nangu abacilumba balembepesha ubufi,

english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya no mutima uwatambalala,

english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
translation: Mu mitima yabo tamwaba nkumbu no kulangulukila,

english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
translation: Califye bwino pakuti ine ncule ku macushi,

english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
translation: Amafunde ya ku kanwa kobe, ala yaliwamisha kuli ine,

english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
translation: Iminwe yobe eyamumbile no kulenga mbe fino ndi,

english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
translation: Leka abakukwatila akatiina balesansamuka pakumona ine,

english: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
translation: We Yawe, ala ine nalishiba ukuti amafunde yobe yalilungama,

english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
translation: Leka icitemwiko cobe icishipwa cilentalalikako umutima,

english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
translation: Leka inkumbu shobe shibe pali ine pakuti mbe umumi,

english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
translation: Leka abacilumba balengwe insoni,

english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
translation: Leka abakukwatila akatiina baleisa kuli ine,

english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
translation: Ine nakulabeela ifipope fyobe,

english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
translation: Leka umutima wandi ulenakila fipope fyobe,

english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
translation: Umupashi wandi ulecucutika pantu mfuluka ipusukilo lyobe,

english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
translation: Amenso yandi ine nayanaka kukulolela ifyo wandaile,

english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
translation: Nelyo ine naba kwati ni nyambi iyili mu cushi,

english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
translation: Bushe ne mubomfi obe nkalolela ukufika lilali?

english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
translation: Abacilumba balanyimbila amacinga ine,

english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
translation: Amafunde yobe yonse yacishinka,

english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
translation: Balifye mu pepi no kundofya ukumfumya pano calo,

english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
translation: Ulecingilila ubumi bwandi ukulingana no kutemwa kobe ukushipwa,

english: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
translation: We Yawe, ishiwi lyobe lya pe na pe,

english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
translation: Bushe umulumendo kuti aisunga shani uwakaele?

english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
translation: Icishinka cobe calibelelela umwakonkanina inkulo.

english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
translation: Ukushinta na lelo, yonse amafunde epo yaba,

english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
translation: Amafunde yobe ayakaana kulansansamusha,

english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
translation: Ine nshakatale ndaba ifipope fyobe,

english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
translation: Mpusushako pantu ine ndi obe,

english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
translation: Ababifi nabandalilila, balefwayafye ukundofya,

english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
translation: Ine nalishiba ukuti ku fintufye fyonse ifyapwililika kwaliba impela,

english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
translation: Yangu ifyo natemwa amafunde yobe!

english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
translation: Amafunde yobe eyampeela amano ukucila abalwani bandi,

english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
translation: Ine ndi uwamucetekanya ukucila pali bakafundisha bandi bonse,

english: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
translation: Ni muli Yawe emo mfisama,

english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
translation: Pantu ababifi nabalema amata yabo,

english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
translation: Nga cakuti umufula waonaika,

english: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
translation: Yawe aba mwi Tempele lyakwe ilyamushilo,

english: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
translation: Yawe alapima abantu abololoke,

english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
translation: Pa bantu ababifi akalokeshapo umulilo uwakabisha nganshi ne fyanunka nga maluti,

english: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
translation: Pantu Yawe mulungami,

english: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
translation: Ine ndilila kuli Yawe mu macushi yandi,

english: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
translation: We Yawe mpusushako ine ku babufi,

english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
translation: Bushe Lesa akamucita shani imwe?

english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
translation: Ala ni ku mifwi iya bashilika iyatwa eyo akamulimwinako,

english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
translation: Nalishama ine pakwikala mu Mesheki,

english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
translation: Awe, ine ninkokola nganshi ukwikala na bantu abapata icibote.

english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
translation: Ine ndi muntu uwatemwa icibote,

english: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
translation: Ine ndeinwina amenso yandi ku mpili,

english: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
translation: Ine ubwafwilisho bwandi bufumafye kuli Yawe,

english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
translation: Ena takaleke amakasa yobe ukushelela,

english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
translation: Cine cinefye, uusunga Israeli tashipula

english: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
translation: Yawe eukusunga iwe,

english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
translation: Akasuba takakakucite icibi ilyo kabalike,

english: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
translation: Yawe akulakubaka ku fibi fyonse,

english: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
translation: Yawe akulakubaka ilyo wakulafuma,

english: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
translation: Ine nalisekelele ilyo banjebele bati,

english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
translation: Amakasa yesu nayanyanta pa mpongolo shobe we Yerusalemu.

english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
translation: Yerusalemu wakuulwa ngo musumba,

english: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
translation: Kanshi eko inko shiya,

english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
translation: Mulya mwine emwaba ifipuna fyakuputwilamo imilandu,

english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
translation: Pepeleniko Yerusalemu pakuti mube icibote, mutile,

english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
translation: Namuleba icibote mukati ka malinga yobe,

english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
translation: Pa mulandufye wa bamunyinane na bacibusa bandi ine ndeti,

english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
translation: Pa mulandu wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe Lesa wesu,

english: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
translation: Awe ine njinwina amenso kuli iwe,

english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
translation: Mona, nga filya ababomfi abaume batonta amenso pa minwe ya bashikulwibo,

english: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
translation: Utubeleleko uluse we Yawe, utubeleleko uluse,

english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
translation: Ifwe natushipikisha nganshi mukushobolwa ku bacilumba,

english: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
translation: “Nga Yawe abula kuba ku lubali lwesu,”

english: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
translation: “Yawe abula kuba ku lubali lwesu

english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
translation: ilyo ubukali bwabo bwacililemo nganshi,

english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
translation: Ne lyeshi nalyo nga lyalitwibishe,

english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
translation: na matamba ayamaka nganshi nga yalitusendele.”

english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
translation: Natupaale Yawe na matotelo,

english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
translation: Ifwe twalipusuka

english: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
translation: Ee, ukwafwilishiwa kwesu kwaba mwishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
translation: Abatetekela muli Yawe baba ngo lupili lwa Sioni,

english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
translation: Nga filya fine impili shashinguluka Yerusalemu,

english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
translation: Inkonto ya bufumu bwa bantu ababi tayakatale aiteeka icalo icapeelwa ku bololoke,

english: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
translation: We Yawe, cita ifisuma kuli abo abacita ifisuma,

english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
translation: Lelo abantu abakonka imisango yabo iyabipa,

english: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
translation: Ilyo Yawe abweseshe ubukankala mu Sioni,

english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
translation: Elyo mu tunwa twesu mwaisula inseko,

english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
translation: Cine cine Yawe natucitila ifyakupapa nganshi,

english: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
translation: We Yawe, ubweshe ubukankala bwesu,

english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
translation: Abatanda mu filamba,

english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
translation: Abaya balelila ifilamba ilyo basendele imbuto mu cipe,

english: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
translation: Nga te Yawe alekuula iŋanda,

english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
translation: Ala kuicushafye ukubuka ulucelocelo,

english: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
translation: Abana abaume, bupe bwacishilano ukufuma kuli Yawe,

english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
translation: Nge mifwi iyili mu minwe ya mpalume

english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uwakwata imifwi iyingi iya uyu musango!

english: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
translation: Balishuka bonse ababa na katiina kuli Yawe,

english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
translation: Wakulalya ifisabo fya milimo ubomba,

english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
translation: Umukashi obe akalaba ngo mwangashi uwatwalisha mu ŋanda yobe,

english: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
translation: Ee, ifi efipaalwa umuntu uwaba na katiina kuli Yawe.

english: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
translation: Leka Yawe akupaale ukufuma ku Sioni,

english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
translation: kabili ukasuke ausangwako na ku beshikulu bobe.

english: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
translation: “Ukufumafye ku bulumendo bwandi aba bantu tepakuncusha nganshi.”

english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
translation: “Ukufumafye ku bulumendo bwandi aba bantu tepakuncusha,

english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
translation: Bashibulimi balisantaula inuma yandi,

english: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
translation: Lelo Yawe mulungami icine cine,

english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
translation: Uleke bonse abapata Sioni balengwe insoni,

english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
translation: Uleke babe nge cani pa mutenge,

english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
translation: icani ico kaseepa teti acibuule mu minwe yakwe,

english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
translation: Uleke abalepitapo besosa nokuti,

english: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
translation: Ungafweko ine we Yawe, pantu abamupetamina nomba tapali,

english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
translation: Abashala bonse babufi kuli umo no munankwe,

english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
translation: We Yawe wingafumyapo abantu babwilikandimi,

english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
translation: Bena batila, “Twakulalandila umo tulefwaila,

english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
translation: “Pa mulandu wa kucucutika kwa banaka

english: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
translation: Amashiwi Yawe alaya, mashiwi yacishinka.

english: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
translation: We Yawe wingatucingililako,

english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
translation: Pantu ababifi baleendaukafye mpanga yonse,

english: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
translation: We Yawe, ukufuma panshi ya mutima wandi niwefye ndelililako.

english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
translation: We Yawe umfwa inkuuta yandi,

english: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
translation: We Yawe aukana kulasuula ku fibi fyesu,

english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
translation: Lelo ni kuli iwe ekufuma ubwelelo pa fibi fyesu

english: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
translation: Ala ine ni Yawe eo ndolela, no mutima wandi eo ulolelapo,

english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
translation: Umutima wandi ulolelafye Yawe,

english: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
translation: We Israeli, bika isubilo muli Yawe,

english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
translation: Ena ekafye eukalubula abena Israeli ku fyabubifi fyabo fyonse.

english: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
translation: We Yawe, mu mutima wandi tamuli icilumba,

english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
translation: Lelo ine naliteka umutima, kabili watalala tondolo,

english: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
translation: Ee, we Israeli ulebika isubilo muli Yawe,

english: LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
translation: We Yawe, ibukisha Davidi,

english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
translation: Pa mulandufye wakwa Davidi umubomfi obe,

english: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
translation: Yawe alapile umulapo kuli Davidi,

english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
translation: Nga cakuti abana bobe abaume basunga icipangano candi,

english: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
translation: Pantu Yawe alisalapo Sioni,

english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
translation: Atile ati, “Pano pene epakaba icifulo candi icakutuushapo pe na pe,

english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
translation: Ine nkalapaala Sioni,

english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
translation: Ine nkafwika bashimapepo bakwe ne pusukilo,

english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
translation: “Pano pene epo ine nkalenga umwana umo uwakwa Davidi akabe mfumu,

english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
translation: Abalwani bakwe nkabalenga insoni,

english: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
translation: Alapile umulapo kuli Yawe,

english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
translation: “Ine nshakengile mu ŋanda yandi,

english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
translation: Ine nshakalale amenso yandi yamone utulo,

english: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
translation: kanofye ine nkatale nkafwaile Yawe icifulo,

english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
translation: Ala, twaumfwile mu Efrata uko balelumbula Imbokoshi ya Cipangano,

english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
translation: Aleni natuleya ku ncende yakwe iyakwikalamo,

english: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
translation: Ima, we Yawe, nokwisa ku cifulo cobe icakutuushishamo,

english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
translation: Uleke bashimapepo bobe bafwale ubulungami,

english: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
translation: Yangu ifyo cawama kabili cilasansamusha,

english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
translation: Ciba kwati mafuta ayacindama nganshi,

english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
translation: Ciba kwati mume wa Hemoni uulewa pa lupili lwa Sioni!

english: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
translation: Aleni lumbanyeni Yawe imwe bonse mwe babomfi bakwa Yawe,

english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
translation: Imyeni amaboko yenu mwisano lyakwe,

english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
translation: Muleke Yawe uwabumba umulu ne sonde,

english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
translation: Ewalofeshe imishobo ya mu fyalo ifingi,

english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
translation: Kwali Sihoni, imfumu ya bena Amoli,

english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
translation: Kabili ewapeele icalo cabo nge cuma cabupyani,

english: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
translation: Ne shina lyobe, we Yawe, ala lyakubelelela pe,

english: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
translation: Pantu Yawe akapokololako abantu bakwe,

english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
translation: Utulubi twa benafyalo, ala twena twabafye utwa silifa na golide,

english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
translation: Utunwa twena twalikwata lelo tatulanda nakalyafye,

english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
translation: Amatwi nayo twalikwata,

english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
translation: Abantu abatupanga nabo bakaba nga twena,

english: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
translation: Imwe mwe ba mu ŋanda yakwa Israeli, ala akupaaleni Yawe na matotelo,

english: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
translation: Imwe mwe babomba mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe,

english: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
translation: Imwe mwe bena Levi, akupaaleni Yawe na matotelo,

english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
translation: Akupaaleni Yawe na matotelo ukufuma mu Sioni,

english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
translation: Akulumbeni Yawe pantu Yawe musuma,

english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
translation: Pantu Yawe ewasala Yakobo ukuba uwakwe,

english: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
translation: Ine nalishiba ukuti Yawe mukalamba nganshi,

english: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
translation: Yawe ena acitafye fyonse ifyo alefwaya,

english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
translation: Eulenga amakumbi ukwima ukufuma ukwapelela isonde,

english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
translation: Mu Egupto ni Yawe ewalofeshe amabeli yonse,

english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
translation: We Egupto ni pa cinso cobe acitile ifipeshamano ne finjelengwe,

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Toteleni Yawe pantu ena musuma.

english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ena ewaipeye amabeli ya mu Egupto.

english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewafumishemo na bena Israeli mu Egupto.

english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ku maka yakwe no kuboko kwakwe ukwafunguluka.

english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewalekenye Bemba Wakashika pakati.

english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Uwayabwishe na bena Israeli pakati kauko.

english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: No kubunsha Farao ne fita fyakwe muli Bemba Wakashika.

english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Kuli ena uwatungulwile abantu bakwe mu matololo.

english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewaipeye ne shamfumu ishabulamba.

english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: No kwipaya ishamfumu ishalulumbi nganshi.

english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Aipeye Sihoni, imfumu ya bena Amoli.

english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Toteleni Lesa uwacila imilungu yonse.

english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Na Ogi imfumu ya Bashani.

english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewapeele ne calo cabo nge cuma cacishilano.

english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Icacishilano ku mubomfi wakwe Israeli.

english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Kuli ena uwaletwibukishako mu nshita ya macushi.

english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Atupuswishe ku balwani besu.

english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Eupeela ne fyakulya ku fibumbwa fyonse.

english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translation: Muletotela Lesa uwa mu mulu,

english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Toteleni mfumu iyacila ishamfumu shonse.

english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Kuli ena ekafye uucita ifyakupapusha.

english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ena ku mano yakwe ewapanga imyulu.

english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewashimpa isonde pali bemba.

english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Ewabumba ifisanika ifikulu nganshi.

english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Akasuba kalesanika pa nshita ya kasuba.

english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
translation: Umweshi ne ntanda filesanika ubushiku.

english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
translation: Ku mimana ya Babiloni eko ifwe twaikele no kulila,

english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
translation: Ku mishingu yali palya pene,

english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
translation: Kulya eko abatwikete bunkole batwipwishe ukubembilako inyimbo,

english: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
translation: Nga ifwe kuti twaimba shani inyimbo shakwa Yawe,

english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
translation: Ala nga cakuti ine nalaba kuli iwe we Yerusalemu,

english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
translation: Ululimi lwandi uleke lukakatile mu kanwa kandi,

english: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
translation: We Yawe, shiibukisha ifyacitile abena Edomu,

english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
translation: We Mwana mwanakashi wa Babiloni,

english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
translation: Ee, alishuka umuntu uukabula tumwano utunya,

english: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
translation: We Yawe, nakulakulumbanya no mutima wandi onse,

english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
translation: Ndekontamika icinso ukulosha kwi Tempele lyobe ilyamushilo,

english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
translation: Ilyo ine nakuutile mutuule, iwe walingaswike,

english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
translation: We Yawe uleke ishamfumu sha pano isonde shilekulumbanya shonse,

english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
translation: Uleke shileimba pa mulandu wa nshila shakwa Yawe,

english: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
translation: Nangu Yawe aba ku mulu ukutali,

english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
translation: Nangu ine nyenda mukati ka mafya,

english: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
translation: Ee, Yawe akafikilisha ubufwayo bwakwe pali ine,

english: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
translation: We Yawe, walimfwailisha kabili walinjishiba.

english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
translation: ala nako kwine niwe wingantungululako,

english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
translation: Ine nga nasosa ati, “Cine cine imfifi yalamfisako,

english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
translation: Awe ne mfifi ine tayafiite kuli iwe nakalya,

english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
translation: Niwe wabumba ifilundwa fyandi ifyamukati,

english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
translation: Ine nakulakulumbanya pantu walimumba mu musango uwakupapusha

english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
translation: Amafupa yandi tayafiseme kuli iwe,

english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
translation: Amenso yobe yalimwene ilyo nshilapangwa.

english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
translation: Yangu ifyo yawamisha amatontonkanyo yobe palwa ine, we Lesa,

english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
translation: Nga nati kanja pende,

english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
translation: Nga cakutifye kuti waipaya ababifi, we Yawe!

english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
translation: Uleshiba ilyo njikala nelyo njima,

english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
translation: Bena balanda ifyamusaalula pali iwe,

english: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
translation: Bushe we Yawe, ine nshapata abakupata?

english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
translation: Ine nalibapata umupwilapo,

english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
translation: We Yawe, nengula, wishibe ifyaba umutima wandi,

english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
translation: Umone nga muli ine mwaliba akabi nelyo kamo,

english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
translation: Ilyo ine nyenda nelyo nsendama, uleshiba,

english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
translation: Ilyo ine nshilati nande,

english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
translation: Iwe walincingilila kuntanshi na kunuma,

english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
translation: Umusango uo wanjishibilamo wakupapa, walimpesha amano,

english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
translation: Bushe ni kwi uko ine ningaya pakufulumuka Umupashi obe?

english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
translation: Nga nati kanje ku mulu,

english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
translation: Nga nati kampupuke ku macaca,

english: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
translation: Bushe kufika ku nshita nshi we Yawe uli nokundaba,

english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
translation: Bushe kufika lilali umutima wandi wakulacula ku matontonkanyo,

english: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
translation: We Yawe, Lesa wandi, unangulukileko no kunjasuka,

english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
translation: Epali na balwani bandi bayamba ukusosa abati “Natumucimfya.”

english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
translation: Lelo ine nacetekela mu kutemwa kobe ukushipwa,

english: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
translation: Nkalaimba kuli Yawe,

english: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
translation: We Yawe mpusushako ku bantu babi,

english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
translation: Uleke umusolilo ubaponene,

english: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
translation: Wileka ababufi baleikala muli cino calo,

english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
translation: Ine nalishiba ukuti Yawe alasoselako abalanda abafyengwa,

english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
translation: Roma 3:13

english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
translation: Bena lyonsefye bapanga ukucita ifyabipa mu mitima yabo,

english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
translation: Banona indimi shabo nge nsoka,

english: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
translation: We Yawe ulencingililako ukufuma ku maboko ya babifi,

english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
translation: Abantu bacilumba ine balinteya iciteyo,

english: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
translation: We Yawe, ine ndetila, “Niwefye Lesa wandi.”

english: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
translation: We Mfumu Yawe, umulubushi wandi uwamaka,

english: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
translation: We Yawe, wisuminisha ubufwayo bwa babifi ukuti bucitike,

english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
translation: Leka imitwe ya banshinguluka ikupwe na mafya ayafuma pa tunwa twabo.

english: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
translation: We Yawe niwe ndekuutako mutuule,

english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
translation: Leka ababifi ebo bekatwe mu masumbu yabo abene,

english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
translation: Uleka ipepo lyandi lise uko uli nge cushi ca bubani,

english: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
translation: We Yawe, ulesunga akanwa kandi,

english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
translation: Wileka umutima wandi ulelola ku fyabipa,

english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
translation: Umuntu mololoke angumemo pakuncenjeshako,

english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
translation: Bakateeka babo bakabafwinta mu mikonko,

english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
translation: Elyo bakasosa abati, “Nga filya shibulimi alepula umushili pakulima,

english: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
translation: Lelo ine ni pali iwe we mfumu Yawe natonta amenso yandi,

english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
translation: Ulensunga ku fiteyo ifyo banteya,

english: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
