translation: Na pa cinso cakwe epo ndeilishanishisha,

english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
translation: Ilyo umupashi wandi waba no mwenso,

english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
translation: Lolesha lwa ku kulyo kwandi umone,

english: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
translation: Ndekuuta kuli we Yawe nati,

english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
translation: Umfwa ifyo ine ndekuuta,

english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
translation: Undubuleko ukufuma mu cifungo,

english: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
translation: We Yawe umfwa ipepo lyandi,

english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
translation: Umfundeko ukulacita ifyo iwe ufwaya,

english: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
translation: We Yawe, pa mulandu we shina lyobe pususha ubumi bwandi,

english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
translation: Ee, ulofye abalwani bandi mu citemwiko cobe icishipwa,

english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
translation: Windubulwisha ine ne mubomfi obe,

english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
translation: Umulwani tepakuncusha,

english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
translation: Kanshi umupashi wandi naubulwa amaka,

english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
translation: Ine ndebukisha inshiku shakale,

english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
translation: Ine ni kuli iwe eko naimisha amaboko yandi,

english: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
translation: We Yawe endesha ukunjasuka,

english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
translation: Uleke ulucelo lulenjibukishako icitemwiko cobe icishipwa,

english: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
translation: We Yawe, mpusushako ku balwani bandi,

english: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
translation: Kampaale na matotelo Yawe icilibwe candi,

english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
translation: Niwe uulenga bashamfumu ukucimfya,

english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
translation: Ntulanyako no kumpusushako ukufuma ku maboko ya benafyalo,

english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
translation: Kanshi lyena abana besu abaume mu bwaice bwabo balekula nge miti iyamaka,

english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
translation: Amatala yesu yakesule paa ifilyo fya misango misango,

english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
translation: Iŋombe shesu uleke shibe ishamaka pakusenda ifyafina,

english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
translation: Balipaalwa abantu abashukila fyonse ifi,

english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
translation: Ni Lesa ewantemwa kabili e linga lyandi,

english: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
translation: We Yawe, ngo muntunse nao wanshi uwakuti uletontonkanyapo?

english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
translation: Umuntu abafye ngo mupu,

english: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
translation: We Yawe, ulekanye imyulu yobe, wikile pano panshi!

english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
translation: Tuma imyele ya nkuba, usalanganye na balwani,

english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
translation: Tambika ukuboko kobe ukufuma mu mulu,

english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
translation: Abo utunwa twabo twaisulamo ifyabufi,

english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
translation: Ine nkalakwimbila ulwimbo lupya, we Lesa,

english: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya, we Lesa wandi, we mfumu,

english: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
translation: Fyonse ifyo wabumba, we Yawe, ala fikalakulumbanya,

english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
translation: Bakalalanda pa bucindami bwa bufumu bobe,

english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
translation: Epakuti abantu bonse baleishiba ificitwa fyobe ifyabulamba,

english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
translation: Ubufumu bobe bwa pe na pe,

english: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
translation: Yawe alatungilila bonse abawa,

english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
translation: Amenso ya bonse yaloleshafye kuli iwe,

english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
translation: Ulafungulula iminwe yobe,

english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
translation: Yawe mulungami mu nshila shakwe shonse,

english: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
translation: Yawe alapalama kuli bonse abakuuta mutuule,

english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
translation: Bonse ababa na katiina kuli ena, alabapeela ifyo balekabila,

english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
translation: Cila bushiku ine nkalakutatakula,

english: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
translation: Bonse abatemwa Yawe bena alabasunga,

english: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
translation: Akanwa kandi kakalanda palwa kulumbanya Yawe.

english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
translation: Yawe mukulu kabili ewalinga ukulumbanya nganshi,

english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
translation: Inkulo imo ikalatasha ifintu ifyo wacita ku nkulo inankwe,

english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
translation: Abantu bakalalanda pa lulumbi lwa bucindami bwa bufumu bobe,

english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
translation: Abantu bakalalanda palwa maka aya milimo yobe iyaba iyakutiina,

english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
translation: Abantu bakasefya pa busuma bobe ubushaikulila,

english: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
translation: Yawe aba ne cikuku kabili aba no luse,

english: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
translation: Yawe musuma kuli bonse,

english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
translation: Yawe euteeka pe na pe,

english: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
translation: Ine nakulalumbanya Yawe inshiku shonse isha mweo wandi,

english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
translation: Mwilacetekela muli bakateeka,

english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
translation: Batila nga bafwa babwelela kwiloba,

english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
translation: Alishuka umuntu uo Lesa wakwa Yakobo atulanyako,

english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
translation: Lesa uyu ewabumba umulu ne sonde,

english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
translation: kabili apeela abatitikishiwa umulinganya,

english: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
translation: Yawe eupeela impofu amenso.

english: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
translation: Yawe eusunga abenafyalo,

english: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
translation: Amaka yakwa kabalwe tayamusekesha,

english: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
translation: Lelo Yawe asansamukafye mu bamukwatila akatiina,

english: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
translation: Uletasha Yawe, we Yerusalemu!

english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
translation: Pantu ewikasha imipilikisho ya mpongolo shobe,

english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
translation: Eulenga nokuti mu mipaka ya calo cobe muleba icibote,

english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
translation: Eupeela ne cipope cakwe pano isonde,

english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
translation: Eulokesha ubunga bwa mfula nga masako ya mpaanga,

english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
translation: Eulukusha na mabwe ya mfula nge nsakalabwe,

english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
translation: Nga alandafye ishiwi, apopene fyasunguluka,

english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
translation: Ewasokolola ishiwi lyakwe kuli Yakobo,

english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
translation: Yawe eukuula Yerusalemu,

english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
translation: Awe, tatala aucitilapo umushobo umbi ici,

english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
translation: Alaposha abafunshika imitima,

english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
translation: Ewaishiba ne mpendwa ya ntanda,

english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
translation: Imfumu yesu ikulu kabili yamaka nganshi,

english: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
translation: Yawe ewimya bonse abaicefya,

english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
translation: Akwimbileni Yawe inyimbo shakutasha,

english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
translation: Eubunganika amakumbi mu mulu,

english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
translation: Eupeela iŋombe icakulya,

english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
translation: mwe nama shonse isha mu mpanga na mwe fitekwa,

english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
translation: Ishamfumu sha pano isonde, ne mishobo yonse,

english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
translation: mwe balumendo na mwe bakashana,

english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
translation: Bonsefye nabalelumbanya ishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
translation: Alimisha abantu bakwe imfumu iyamaka,

english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
translation: Mulumbanyeni imwe mwe bamalaika bakwe bonse,

english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
translation: Mulumbanyeni mwe kasuba no mweshi,

english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
translation: Mulumbanyeni, mwe myulu iyasansama,

english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
translation: Lekeni ifintu fyonse filelumbanya ishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
translation: Ewafibika mu fifulo umo fyaikala umuyayaya,

english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe pano isonde ponse,

english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
translation: We nkuba, nobe we mfula ya mabwe,

english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
translation: Mwe mpili na imwe mwe tupili,

english: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
translation: Uleke abena Israeli basekelele muli Kabumba wabo,

english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
translation: Nabalecinda pakulumbanya ishina lyakwe,

english: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
translation: Pantu Yawe alacankilwa abantu bakwe,

english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
translation: Uleke abapetamina Lesa basekelele mu bucindami bwakwe,

english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
translation: Uleke amalumbo yakwa Lesa yafume mu tunwa twabo,

english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
translation: Eshakulandwilako imishobo ya bantu,

english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
translation: no kukaka ishamfumu shabo iminyololo,

english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
translation: Ekufikilisha ubupingushi ubwalembwa pali aba bantu.

english: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
translation: Impelwamano mu mutima itila, “Takwaba Lesa.”

english: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
translation: Ukufuma ku mulu, Yawe alolesha pa bana ba bantu,

english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
translation: Abantu bonse balifutatila Lesa,

english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
translation: Bushe abacita ifibi, emukuti mano bashakwata?

english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
translation: Bakulaikatwa no mwenso uukalamba

english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
translation: Mwe babifi nimwe mufulunganya amapange ya bapina,

english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
translation: Iyee, kuti cawama ukupusuka kwa bena Israeli nga kwafuma mu Sioni!

english: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe!

english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
translation: Mumulumbanye pa mulandu wa fintu acita ifyabulamba,

english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
translation: Mumulumbanye no kulisha amapenga,

english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
translation: Mumulumbanye no kulisha insombo no kucinda,

english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
translation: Mumulumbanye no kulisha imiwaya,

english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
translation: Ee, cine cine ifibumbwa fyonse ifipema nafilumbanye Yawe!

english: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
translation: Iye we Yawe, bushe ni nani uo calinga ukusangwa mwi Tenti lyobe,

english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
translation: Umuntu uwenda uwakaele, uucita ifyalungama,

english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
translation: Umuntu uo ululimi lwakwe talubepa bufi,

english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
translation: Mu menso yakwe alisuula imbela ya bantu babi,

english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
translation: Ena, abamukongola tabapinda nelyo kubalundishapo,

english: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
translation: Unsungilile we Lesa wandi,

english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
translation: Pantu we Yawe tawakaleke umweo wandi ukushala mu calo ca bafwa,

english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
translation: Walinangilila inshila iyitwala ku mweo,

english: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
translation: Ndalanda kuli Yawe nati,

english: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
translation: Yangu ifyo bacindama abamushilo abali mu calo,

english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
translation: Lelo ishamo likafulilako kuli abo abakonkelela imilungu imbi,

english: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
translation: We Yawe niwe cuma candi, kabili ulukombo lwandi,

english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
translation: Umupaka wandi ushinta mu fifulo fyansansa,

english: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
translation: Nakulapaala Yawe na matotelo pakumpanda amano,

english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
translation: Inshita shonse ntangisha Yawe pa ntanshi yandi,

english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
translation: Eico umutima wandi uli ne nsansa,

english: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
translation: Shi wingomfwa ku kupapata kwandi ukwalungama we Yawe,

english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
translation: Aba bantu imitima yabo ilafilwa ukukwata uluse

english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
translation: Nabanjimina no kunshinguluka,

english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
translation: Bali nge nkalamo iyileiteyanya pakwikata icintu,

english: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
translation: Ala bemine we Yawe,

english: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
translation: We Yawe ku maka ya kuboko kobe mpususha kuli aba bantu,

english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
translation: Lelo ine mu bololoke nkamona icinso cobe,

english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
translation: Niwe ushininkisha umulandu wandi no kuncitila umulinganya,

english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
translation: Nelyo wingalengula umutima wandi

english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
translation: Umwabela ificita abantu bambi,

english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
translation: Ine nalikonka mu nshila yobe,

english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
translation: Ndakuuta kuli we Lesa wandi,

english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
translation: Langa ukutemwa kobe ukwapesha amano,

english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
translation: Unsunge nge mboni ya linso lyobe,

english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
translation: Unsunge ukufuma ku babifi abanjimina,

english: I love you, LORD, my strength.
translation: Nalikutemwa we Yawe we maka yandi.

english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
translation: Aninine pali kerubi no kupupuka,

english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
translation: Alengele imfifi ukuba icifimbo cakwe,

english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
translation: Mu lubuuto ulwali pa ntanshi yakwe mwafutumuka amakumbi,

english: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
translation: Yawe abulukuta ukufuma ku mulu,

english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
translation: Aposele imifwi yakwe no kusalanganya abalwani bakwe,

english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
translation: Elyo panshi ya bemba palamoneka,

english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
translation: Elyo atambalike ukuboko kwakwe ukufuma mu mulu,

english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
translation: Ampokolwele ku balwani bandi abamaka,

english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
translation: Banjimine mu bushiku bwa cinkunka candi,

english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
translation: Amfumishemo no kumbika apapabuka,

english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
translation: Yawe e cilibwe candi,

english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
translation: Yawe ancitile ukulingana no bololoke bwandi.

english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
translation: Pantu ine ndacita ififwaya Yawe,

english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
translation: Nshafumako ku mafunde yakwe yonse ayaba ku ntanshi yandi,

english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
translation: Ndi uwabula akalema ku cinso cakwa Yawe,

english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
translation: Eico, Yawe alinambula pa mulandu wa bololoke bwandi,

english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
translation: Ku bacishinka, we mfumu ulailanga uwacishinka,

english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
translation: Kuli abo abapwililika, ulailanga ukuba uwapwililika,

english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
translation: Ulapususha abantu abaicefya,

english: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
translation: We Yawe niwe usanika icengelo candi,

english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
translation: Ku maka yobe kuti nasansa impuka ya mulalo,

english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
translation: Ndekuuta kuli Yawe uwalinga ukulumbanya,

english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
translation: Lelo Lesa ena, inshila yakwe yalilungama,

english: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
translation: Nga Lesa umbi ni nani ukucila pali Yawe,

english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
translation: Ni Lesa eumpangasha amaka,

english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
translation: Eulenga makasa yandi ukuba nga makasa ya nsebula,

english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
translation: Eusambilisha iminwe yandi kukulwa inkondo,

english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
translation: Walimpeela inkwela ye pusukilo lyobe,

english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
translation: Walikusha inshila umwakupita intampulo shandi,

english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
translation: Nasupile abalwani bandi mpaka nabasanga,

english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
translation: Nabakomaula mpaka bafilwa ukwima,

english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
translation: Pantu walimpangeshe amaka yakulwilako,

english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
translation: Imyando ya mfwa yalinshingulwike,

english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
translation: Niwe walengele abalwani bandi bamfutatile inuma shabo pakufulumuka,

english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
translation: Ilintu abalwani bandi balilile ubwafwilisho,

english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
translation: Nalebonaula ngo lukungu lwa mu mwela,

english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
translation: Walimpususha ku mitundu ya bantu imbi,

english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
translation: Na benafyalo balanakila pakumfwa ishiwi lyandi,

english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
translation: Bena bonse baba abatompoka imitima,

english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
translation: Nakalebalika kuli Yawe!

english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
translation: E Lesa uunandwilako,

english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
translation: Eumpususha ku balwani bandi,

english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
translation: Eico, nkakulumbanya pakati ka mishobo we Yawe,

english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
translation: Imyando ya ku calo ca bafwa yalimpombele,

english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
translation: Niwe ulenga imfumu yobe ukucimfya,

english: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
translation: Mu kupelelwa kwandi nakuutile kuli Yawe,

english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
translation: Pano isonde palisunkene no kutenta,

english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
translation: Mu myona yakwe mwafumine icushi,

english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
translation: Elyo aikile ukufuma ku mulu aisa pano panshi,

english: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
translation: Imyulu ilanga ubucindami bwakwa Yawe,

english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
translation: Fyaliwama ukucila golide uwalopololwa bwino,

english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
translation: Efinsoka ine ne mubomfi wakwa Yawe,

english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
translation: Bushe nani engeluka umo ifibi fyakwe fyalola?

english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
translation: Yawe ulengafwako ne mubomfi obe,

english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
translation: Leka amashiwi yandi na matontonkanyo yandi yasekelelwe pa cinso cobe,

english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
translation: Cila kasuba kalikwata ifyo kalanda,

english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
translation: Tafilanda, nangu ukusosa,

english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
translation: Lelo iciunda cafiko cilasalangana pano calo ponse,

english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
translation: Emo kafuma kwati ni shibwinga uulefuma mumwakwe,

english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
translation: Katula ku mpela ya mulu,

english: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
translation: Amafunde yakwa Yawe yantu yapwililika,

english: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
translation: Amalango yakwa Yawe yantu yalungama,

english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
translation: Ukukwatila Yawe akatiina kwaliwama,

english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
translation: Alishuka umuntu uushendela mu mano ayapanda ababifi,

english: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
translation: Lelo ena asansamukila mu mafunde yakwa Yawe,

english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
translation: Aba ngo muti uwalimbwa mu lulamba lwa mumana,

english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
translation: Lelo abantu ababifi tefyo baba,

english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
translation: Eico, abantu ababifi bakapeelwa umulandu kuli Yawe,

english: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
translation: Pantu Yawe alatungulula imyendele ya bantu abololoke,

english: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
translation: Yawe alekwasuka ilintu wafika mu nshita sha mafya,

english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
translation: Engakutumina ubwafwilisho ukufuma ku cifulo camushilo,

english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
translation: Engebukisha yonse amalambo yobe,

english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
translation: Engakupeela icakukabila ca pa mutima obe,

english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
translation: Tukapunda ubuseko ilintu ukacimfya,

english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
translation: Nomba naishiba ukuti Yawe alapususha uwasubwa wakwe,

english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
translation: Abantu bamo bacetekela mu maceleta,

english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
translation: Bakatalansuka no kuwa panshi,

english: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
translation: We Yawe upusushe imfumu,

english: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
translation: We Yawe, ni mu maka yobe imfumu isansamukila

english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
translation: Ukalofya ubufyashi bwabo pano isonde,

english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
translation: Nelyo baelenganya ifibi pali iwe,

english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
translation: Pantu ukabafulumuna,

english: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
translation: Ube uwasumbulwa we Yawe mu maka yobe,

english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
translation: Waliipeela ico umutima waiko wafwaile,

english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
translation: Walimupokelela na mapaalo ayakalamba nganshi,

english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
translation: Akulomba ubumi na iwe wamupeela,

english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
translation: Pa mulandu wa kucimfya uko wapeele alicindama,

english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
translation: Cine cine walimupeela amapaalo ayamuyayaya,

english: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
translation: Pantu imfumu yatetekela muli Yawe,

english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
translation: Ukuboko kobe kukasanga abalwani bobe bonse,

english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
translation: Ilyo ukamoneka,

english: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
translation: We Lesa wandi, we Lesa wandi, bushe cinshi wandekelesesha?

english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
translation: Ukufuma ku kufyalwa kwandi niwefye nashintamo umutima,

english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
translation: Wintaluka ico ubwafya buli mupepi,

english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
translation: Abalwani bandi nabanshinguluka,

english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
translation: Nabasamuna no tunwa nge nkalamo,

english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
translation: Ndepongololwa nga menshi,

english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
translation: Akanwa kandi kauma nge ciinga,

english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
translation: Imbwa nashinshinguluka,

english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
translation: Kuti napenda amafupa yandi yonse ayashele pa mbilibili,

english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
translation: Bayakana insalu shandi,

english: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
translation: Nomba we Yawe wintaluka,

english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
translation: We Lesa wandi nakuuta mu nshita yonse iya kasuba ukwabula ukunjasuka,

english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
translation: Mpokolola ku balefwaya ukunjipaya,

english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
translation: Mpokololako ukufuma ku kanwa ka nkalamo,

english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
translation: eico na ine nakulashimikila bamunyinane peshina lyobe,

english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
translation: Nakulatila, akulumbanyeni Yawe mwe bamutiina,

english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
translation: Pantu talekelesha umulanda uulecula,

english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
translation: Ni kuli iwe ekufuma ukulumbanya kwandi ukwa mu lukuta lukalamba,

english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
translation: Abalanda bakalya bakekuta,

english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
translation: Abantu bonse aba pano isonde bakebukisha

english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
translation: Pantu Yawe e mwine wabufumu,

english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
translation: Aba fyuma fya pano isonde bakailemena no kumupepa,

english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
translation: Lelo iwe uli Wamushilo,

english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
translation: Abantu ba nko sha kuntanshi bakalamubombela,

english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
translation: Bakalashimika pa mulandu wa bulungami bwakwe,

english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
translation: Ifikolwe fyesu fyatetekele muli iwe,

english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
translation: Niwe fyalelililako na iwe wafipususha,

english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
translation: Nomba ine ndi mwambo nshili muntu,

english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
translation: Bonse abalemona balanseka,

english: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
translation: Balantumfya abati, “Asubila muli Yawe,

english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
translation: Lelo niwe wamfumishe mwifumo muli mayo,

english: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
translation: Yawe e kacema wandi,

english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
translation: Mu nika ya mulemfwe emo anenga ukutuusha,

english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
translation: Alambwesesha umweo,

english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
translation: Nangu ningapita mu mukonko wa mfwa umwafiita fititi,

english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
translation: Ulantebeta pa cinso ca balwani bandi,

english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
translation: Cine cine ubusuma bweka no luse fyakulankonka

english: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
translation: Isonde lyonse na fyonse ifya bamo fyakwa Yawe,

english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
translation: Ngeyo Mfumu iyalulumbi nani?

english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
translation: Pantu ewalishimpa pa mulu wa pali babemba,

english: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
translation: Nani uwalinga ukunina ulupili lwakwa Yawe?

english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
translation: Ala kanofye muntu uwa minwe iyabula umulandu no mutima uwakaele,

english: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
translation: Ena eukapaalwa no kusekelelwa kuli Yawe,

english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
translation: Abantu ba uyu musango ebafwaya Yawe,

english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
translation: Isukeni mwe mpongolo isukisheni,

english: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
translation: Ngeyo Mfumu iyalulumbi nani?

english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
translation: Isukisheni mwe mpongolo,

english: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
translation: We mfumu Yawe ni kuli iwe nalosha umutima.

english: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
translation: Inshila shonse ishakwa Yawe shaluse ne cishinka

english: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
translation: Pa mulandu we shina lyobe we Yawe,

english: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
translation: Bushe nani umuntu uutiina Yawe?

english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
translation: Akalaikala uwashuka,

english: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
translation: Yawe alasokolola inkaama ku bantu abamutiina.

english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
translation: Amenso yandi lyonse ntonta kuli Yawe,

english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
translation: Pilibukila kuli ine no kunangulukilako,

english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
translation: Amacushi ya ku mutima wandi nayafulisha,

english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
translation: Mona ubulanda bwandi na fintu ndecululuka,

english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
translation: Mona abalwani bandi fintu bafulisha,

english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
translation: Niwe nacetekela we Lesa wandi.

english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
translation: Cingilila umweo wandi no kumpokolola,

english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
translation: Leka bukaele pamo no bulungami fincingilile,

english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
translation: Pususha Israeli, we Yawe,

english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
translation: Cinefye bonse abasubila muli iwe tauleka balengwe nsoni,

english: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
translation: We Yawe ulemfunda inshila shobe,

english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
translation: Ulentungulula no kunsambilisha icishinka cobe,

english: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
translation: Ibukisha we Yawe ubwingi bwa luse lobe ne cikuku cobe,

english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
translation: Wilaibukisha ifyabubifi fyandi ifya mu bulumendo,

english: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
translation: Yawe musuma kabili alilungama,

english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
translation: Alatungulula abaicefya mu fyalungama

english: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
translation: Ushininkishe umulandu wandi we Yawe,

english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
translation: abo mu minwe yabo mwaba imilimo iyibi,

english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
translation: Lelo ine njikala umweo wakaele,

english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
translation: Amakasa yandi yeminina umwatambalala,

english: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
translation: Unengule no kunjesha we Yawe,

english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
translation: Icitemwiko icishipwa caba pali ine lyonse,

english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
translation: Nshikala pamo na bantu incenjeshi,

english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
translation: Nshumfwana na babifi,

english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
translation: Ndesamba iminwe yandi ne wakaele.

english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
translation: no kulapunda pakwimba ulwimbo lwakutotela,

english: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
translation: Nalitemwa iŋanda yobe iyakwikalamo we Yawe,

english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
translation: Wilofya umweo wandi pamo na babifi,

english: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
translation: Yawe e lubuuto lwandi, kabili Ipusukilo lyandi,

english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
translation: Nangu tata na mayo bengandekelesha,

english: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
translation: Umfunde inshila shobe we Yawe,

english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
translation: Wilamposa ku balwani bandi kukunjimina,

english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
translation: Icintu cimo nasumina cakuti

english: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
translation: Lolela pali Yawe,

english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
translation: Ilintu ababifi banjimina pakuti bonaule umubili wandi,

english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
translation: Nelyo ifita finganjimina ne fyanso,

english: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
translation: Icintu cimofye ico nalomba kuli Yawe,

english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
translation: Pantu mu nshita yakucula

english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
translation: Nomba umutwe wandi wasumbuka,

english: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
translation: Umfwa inkuuta ye shiwi lyandi we Yawe,

english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
translation: Umutima wandi watila, “Fwaya icinso cakwe.”

english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
translation: Wifisa icinso cobe kuli ine,

english: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
translation: Kuli iwe, eko nalilila we Yawe,

english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
translation: Umfwe ishiwi lyandi ilyakupapata,

english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
translation: Winsendela mu cipyu pamo na babifi,

english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
translation: Landula pali bena pa mulandu wa ficitwa fyabo,

english: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti tabacindika Yawe pa milimo intu acita,

english: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
translation: Yawe napaalwe na matotelo,

english: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
translation: Yawe e maka yandi kabili inkwela yandi,

english: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
translation: Yawe e maka ya bantu bakwe,

english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
translation: Pususha abantu bobe no kupaala ubupyani bobe,

english: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe mwe fita fyakwe ifya ku mulu,

english: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
translation: Yawe ali pa cipuna pa nshita ya lyeshi,

english: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
translation: Yawe apeele amaka ku bantu bakwe,

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa bwa bucindami ubwalinga ishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyumfwika pali bemba,

english: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyamaka,

english: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lilafunaula ifimuti fya keda,

english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
translation: Alenga impili sha ku Lebanoni ukutolauka nge fiponti fya ŋombe,

english: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe

english: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe elisunkanya amatololo,

english: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe elilepaula ifimuti ifyakosa ifya oki,

english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi imishobo ya bantu ipondokela?

english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
translation: Eico shilimukeni mwe shamfumu,

english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
translation: Mulebombela Yawe na katiina,

english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
translation: Mulemucindika na katiina,

english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
translation: Ishamfumu sha pano isonde shileipekanya ku bulwi,

english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
translation: Balelanda no kuti, “Natuputaule iminyololo yabo,

english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
translation: Uyo uwaikala pa cipuna cabufumu ku mulu ena abaseka,

english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
translation: Elyo abasosha mwishiwi lyabukali,

english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
translation: “Ine ninsonta imfumu yandi

english: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
translation: Ine ndi nokulondolola icipope cakwa Yawe,

english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
translation: Ulombe kuli ine, na ine ndekupeela imishobo ya benafyalo ibe ubupyani bobe,

english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
translation: Ukalabateeka ku nkonto ya cela,

english: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
translation: Nakutasha we Yawe pantu naumpususha,

english: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
translation: Umfwa no kumbelelako uluse we Yawe,

english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
translation: Ukuloosha kwandi naukwalula insansa,

english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
translation: pakuti umutima wandi utwalilile ukukulumbanya ukwabula ukwikala tondolo,

english: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
translation: Ni kuli iwe nalepapata pakuti ungafwe we Yawe, we Lesa wandi,

english: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
translation: We Yawe wabwesha umweo wandi ukufuma ku calo ca bafwa,

english: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
translation: Akwimbileni Yawe inyimbo shakutasha, mwe bamushilo bakwe,

english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
translation: Pantu ubukali bwakwe tabuya patali,

english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
translation: Lelo ine, ilintu naikele umutende natile,

english: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
translation: Nomba we Yawe ilintu wansungile bwino,

english: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
translation: Na ine efyo nakubilikishe we Yawe,

english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
translation: Bushe busuma nshi bwingaba mu kufwa kwandi,

english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
translation: Muli iwe we Yawe emo nafisama,

english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
translation: Ubumi naikala bwa macushi,

english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
translation: Abalwani bandi bonse tepakunsuula,

english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
translation: Na bantu balitendeka ukundaba,

english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
translation: Ndomfwa uko abantu batotoshanya ulufyengo palwa ine,

english: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
translation: Nomba ine nacetekela muli we Yawe,

english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
translation: Inshita sha mweo wandi shaba mu minwe yobe,

english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
translation: Undoleshe luse luse ne mubomfi obe,

english: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti nakuuta mutuule kuli iwe,

english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
translation: Talalika utunwa twabo utwabufi,

english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
translation: Bwalikulisha ubusuma bobe buntu wabikila abakutiina,

english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
translation: Teya amatwi yobe kuli ine,

english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
translation: Ulabafisa mu cifulo cobe ku bantu ababapangila,

english: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
translation: Yawe apaalwe na matotelo,

english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
translation: Pa mulandu wa mwenso nasosele nati,

english: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
translation: Temweni Yawe bonse mwe bamushilo bakwe,

english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
translation: Koseni no kushipa,

english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
translation: Apo uli cilibwe candi kabili ilinga lyandi,

english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
translation: Umfumye mu citeyo cintu banteya,

english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
translation: Nalubwila umweo wandi mu minwe yobe,

english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
translation: Ine nalipata abapepa utulubi utwafye,

english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
translation: Nakulasekela pamo no kusangalala mu kutemwa kobe ukushipwa,

english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
translation: Tawamposa ku balwani bandi,

english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
translation: Wingambelelako uluse we Yawe ico ndi mu macushi,

english: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uo Lesa abelela uluse pafyo alufyanya,

english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
translation: Ababifi balaponenwa na macushi ayengi nganshi,

english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
translation: Mwe bololoke sangalaleni muli Yawe,

english: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uo ifyabubifi fyakwe Yawe tafibukisha,

english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
translation: Ilintu nafililwe ukuyebelela ifibi fyandi,

english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
translation: Akasuba no bushiku nali uwatitikishiwa na maka ya kuboko kobe.

english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
translation: Elyo nayebelele bumpulamafunde bwandi kuli iwe,

english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
translation: Eico, leka bonse abakupetamina bakupepe ilintu wingasangwa,

english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
translation: Roma 4:7-8

english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
translation: Ndi nokukulondolwela elyo no kukufunda inshila yakwendamo,

english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
translation: Wiba nga kabalwe nangu punda ifishaba na mano,

english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
translation: Sangalaleni muli Yawe imwe bonse mwe bololoke,

english: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
translation: Yawe eonaula amapange ya bantu,

english: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
translation: Lelo amapange yakwa Yawe yalabelelela pe na pe,

english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
translation: Walishuka umushobo uo Yawe e Lesa wabo,

english: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
translation: Ukufuma ku mulu Yawe alolesha pesonde,

english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
translation: Ukufuma kwisano lyakwe

english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
translation: Eupanga imitima yakwa cila muntu,

english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
translation: Takwaba imfumu iyipusukila mu bukulu bwa mulalo yakwata,

english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
translation: Kabalwe tewakucetekelamo pakuti upusuke,

english: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
translation: Lelo amenso yakwa Yawe yaba pa bantu abamukwatila akatiina,

english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
translation: Eubapokolola ukufuma ku mfwa,

english: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
translation: Akulisheni iseese pakutotela Yawe,

english: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
translation: Ifwe tulelolela Yawe,

english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
translation: Muli ena imitima yesu ilasangalala,

english: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
translation: Uleke ukutemwa kobe ukushifilwa kube pali ifwe, we Yawe,

english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
translation: Mwimbileni ulwimbo ulupya,

english: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
translation: Pantu ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyacishinka,

english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
translation: Yawe atemwa ubulungami no mulinganya,

english: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
translation: Ni kwishiwi lyakwa Yawe eko apangile imyulu

english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
translation: Ewalongenye amenshi ya muli bemba kwati yali mu musukupala,

english: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
translation: Kwateni akatiina kuli Yawe, mwe bantu ba pano isonde bonse,

english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
translation: Pantu ni panuma ye shiwi lyakwe elyo fyaishilebako,

english: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
translation: Ine nakulapaala Yawe na matotelo inshita shonse,

english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
translation: Ne nkalamo shilanaka no kubulwa icakulya mu nshiku shimo,

english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
translation: Ala iseni kuno mwe bana, umfweni kuli ine,

english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
translation: Nani pa kati kenu uufwaya umweo,

english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
translation: Asunge ululimi lwakwe ukufuma ku bubifi,

english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
translation: Taluka ku bubifi no kucita icisuma,

english: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
translation: Amenso yakwa Yawe yaba pa bololoke,

english: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
translation: Lelo alafutatila abacita ububifi,

english: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
translation: Yawe alomfwa inkuuta ya bololoke,

english: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
translation: Yawe alapalamina abafunshika imitima,

english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
translation: Fingi ifyo uwalungama engaculako,

english: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
translation: Umutima wandi wakulalumbanya Yawe,

english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
translation: Alamusungila na mafupa,

english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
translation: Ububifi bulepaisha umuntu umubifi,

english: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
translation: Yawe alubula imyeo ya babomfi bakwe,

english: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
translation: Lumbanyeni Yawe pamo na ine,

english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
translation: Nalilombele ubwafwilisho ukufuma kuli Yawe,

english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
translation: Bonse abamulolesha balaba ne nsansa pa menso yabo,

english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
translation: Umulanda wine uyu alila, na Yawe amumfwa,

english: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
translation: Malaika alekala nashinguluka abantu abakwatila Yawe akatiina,

english: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
translation: Sondeni no kuimwena mwe bene ukuti Yawe musuma,

english: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
translation: Muleba na katiina kuli Yawe mwe bamushilo bakwe,

english: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
translation: We Yawe niwe imina abantu abo abanjimina,

english: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
translation: Ubunte bwandi bonse bwakulapunda ati,

english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
translation: Inte ishalufyengo nashinjimina,

english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
translation: Balambwesesha ifibi pa fisuma mbacitila,

english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
translation: Lelo bena nga balwala, ndasakamana no kufwala insalu shabulanda,

english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
translation: eico ndakokola na mukuloosha,

english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
translation: Lelo ilyo nawa bena batemwa,

english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
translation: Balancusha ukupitila mukuncita nge ciwelewele,

english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
translation: Kufika ku nshita nshi we Yawe ukalabatambafye?

english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
translation: Elyo nkalakutotela mu lukuta lukalamba,

english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
translation: Wileka abalwani bandi ababufi baleanga pali ine

english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
translation: Isa ne nkwela pamo ne fyanso,

english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
translation: Tabasosa ifyamutende kanofye ukulanda amashiwi ayakutumfya,

english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
translation: Pakutumfya batila,

english: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
translation: Ifi fyonse ulafimona we Yawe,

english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
translation: Buuka, we Mfumu yandi ima undwileko,

english: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
translation: We Yawe, we Lesa wandi umpokololeko,

english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
translation: Yoani 15:25

english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
translation: Uleke bonse abacankwa nga naba mukucula balengwe nsoni,

english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
translation: Uleke bonse abatemwa ukuti nungamikwe,

english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
translation: Akanwa kandi kakulalanda pa bulungami bobe,

english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
translation: Unone ifumo no mufwi kukulasa abalensupila,

english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
translation: Leka abafwaya ukulofya umweo wandi balengwe nsoni,

english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
translation: Babe nge misungu iyileululwa ku mwela,

english: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
translation: Leka inshila yabo ibe mu mfifi no kutelela,

english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti bateya ne muntu wakaele ifiteyo apabula umulandu,

english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
translation: leka ubonaushi bubafikile mukupumikisha,

english: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
translation: Elyo umweo wandi ukasangalala muli Yawe,

english: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
translation: Ububi bulasesemena umubifi mu mutima wakwe,

english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
translation: Ukonkanyepo ukutemwa kobe kuli abo abakwishiba,

english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
translation: Wileka abantu abacilumba ukulanjimina,

english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
translation: Mona ifyo incitatubi shiwile shili panshi,

english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
translation: Pantu umubifi alaimona ukuti alicila abantu bonse,

english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
translation: Amashiwi ya ku kanwa kakwe yabubifi no bucenjeshi,

english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
translation: Na lintu ali pa musengele apanga ukucita ifintu ifyabipa,

english: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
translation: Uluse lobe ulushipwa we Yawe lwafika na ku mulu,

english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
translation: Ubulungami bobe bwaba nge mpili ishikalamba,

english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
translation: Ifyo kwawama ukutemwa kobe ukushipwa we Lesa,

english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
translation: Balya ifyanona mu ŋanda yobe

english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
translation: Pantu intulo yabumi yaba kuli iwe,

english: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
translation: Wilafimbila ababifi,

english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
translation: Kwashalafye inshita iyinono ninshi ababifi baloba,

english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
translation: Lelo abafuuka bakapyana icalo,

english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
translation: Ababifi balikwata amapange ayabi pa bololoke,

english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
translation: Lelo Yawe alaseka umubifi ico alishiba ukuti,

english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
translation: Ababifi balasomona ulupanga elyo no kutinta ubuta,

english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
translation: Lelo impanga shabo shikalasa imitima yabo ine,

english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
translation: Utuntu utunono uto umololoke akwata,

english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
translation: Pantu amaka ya babifi yakonaulwa,

english: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
translation: Yawe alishiba inshiku sha bakaele,

english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
translation: Na mu nshita ya finkunka tabakateletenshiwe,

english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
translation: Pantu bakabonsa nge cani,

english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
translation: Lelo ababifi bakaloba,

english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
translation: Ababifi nga bakongola tababwesha,

english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
