translation: Abantu abo Yawe apaala bakapyana icalo,

english: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
translation: Nga cakuti Yawe atemwa imibeele ya muntu,

english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
translation: Nelyo engatelententa tekuti awe,

english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
translation: Nali umwaice nomba ninkula,

english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
translation: Abololoke baba ne nkumbu no kupeela lyonse,

english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
translation: Taluka ku bubifi no kucita icisuma,

english: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
translation: Pantu Yawe atemwa umulinganya,

english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
translation: Abololoke bakapyana icalo,

english: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
translation: Uletetekela Yawe no kucita ifisuma,

english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
translation: Akanwa ka mololoke kasosa ifyamano,

english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
translation: Ena, alabaka amafunde yakwa Lesa wakwe,

english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
translation: Umubifi alabeleleka umuntu umusuma,

english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
translation: Lelo Yawe talekelesha umuntu umusuma mu minwe yabo,

english: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
translation: Lolela pali Yawe no kubaka inshila yakwe,

english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
translation: Nalimonapo muntu umubifi uwabula uluse alecusha abantu,

english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
translation: Lelo ilyo napitileko tabamoneke,

english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
translation: Upituluke mu wakaele no kwibukisha umulungami,

english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
translation: Lelo ababifi bonse bakonaulwa,

english: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
translation: Ipusukilo lya bololoke lifuma kuli Yawe

english: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
translation: Ulebekelwa muli Yawe,

english: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
translation: Yawe alabafwilisha no kubalubula,

english: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
translation: Uipeeleshe kuli Yawe,

english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
translation: Akalenga ubololoke bobe bulebalika ngo lubuuto lwa ku macaca,

english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
translation: Tekanya utalale tondolo pa cinso cakwa Yawe

english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
translation: Taluka ubukali, no kufutatila icipyu,

english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
translation: Ababifi bakatamfiwa,

english: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
translation: We Yawe wilankalipila ilyo ufulilwe,

english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
translation: Umutima wandi ulekubauka, na maka nshikwete,

english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
translation: Pa mulandu wa filonda fyandi bacibusa na bena mupalamano tabalempalama,

english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
translation: Abafwaya ukunjipaya balinteya ifiteyo,

english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
translation: Lelo naba kwati ni nkomamatwi uwakuti teti omfwe,

english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
translation: Ndi pamo ngo muntu uushumfwa,

english: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
translation: Lelo ine ndolela pali we Yawe,

english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
translation: Pantu natile, “Wileka abalwani bandi balentumfya,

english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
translation: Ico ndi mupepi no kuwa,

english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
translation: Pantu ndeyebelela pa bubifi bwandi,

english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
translation: Abantu abamfyenga apabula umulandu bengi,

english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
translation: Pantu imifwi yobe naindasaula,

english: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
translation: Abantu abancitila ububi apabula umulandu,

english: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
translation: We Yawe windekelesha,

english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
translation: Ala wendeshe ukungafwa,

english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
translation: Tamuli umutende mu mubili wandi,

english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
translation: Ifibi fyandi filentotobesha,

english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
translation: Pa mulandu wa bupuba bwandi,

english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
translation: Ninkontama ndekongosa, na maka nayapwa,

english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
translation: Inuma yandi yonse iletapata ku bukali,

english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
translation: Umubili wandi naufunshika, ndefilwa ne fyakucita,

english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
translation: We Yawe ifyo mfwaya walifishiba,

english: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
translation: Ine natile, “Nakulasunga imibeele yandi,

english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
translation: Witwalilila kunkanda,

english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
translation: Ulebaula no kukanda umuntu,

english: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
translation: “Kutika ku nkuuta yandi iyabwafwilisho we Yawe,

english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
translation: Uleke ukundolesha no bukali,

english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
translation: Lelo ilintu nali tondolo,

english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
translation: Umutima wandi watendeka ukucushiwa,

english: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
translation: “We Yawe leka njishibe impela ya mweo wandi,

english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
translation: Nawipifya inshita yandi iyakwikala pano isonde,

english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
translation: Umuntu abafye pamo nge cinshingwa,

english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
translation: “Nga nomba we mfumu ni cinshi ndelolela,

english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
translation: Mpususha ku mampulu yandi yonse,

english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
translation: Nalaikala tondolo ukwabula ukusosa,

english: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
translation: We Yawe, ifyo bafula abalwani bandi,

english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
translation: Nabafula abampingila ukuti,

english: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
translation: Lelo iwe uli nkwela iyakuncingilila, we Yawe,

english: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
translation: Kuli Yawe eko ndilila mutuule,

english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
translation: Ndalambalala no kulala mu tulo,

english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
translation: Tekuti ntiine abalwani imyandamishila,

english: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
translation: Ima we Yawe!

english: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
translation: Ukulubulwa kufuma kuli Yawe.

english: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
translation: Nalitekele umutima ukulolela pali Yawe,

english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
translation: Nshifisa ubwafwilisho bobe ubwakupususha mu mutima wandi.

english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
translation: Wileka ukumbelela uluse we Yawe,

english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
translation: Imintapendwa ya mafya nayanshinguluka,

english: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
translation: Napapata, we Yawe, umpokololeko,

english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
translation: Uleke bonse abafwaya ukonaula umweo wandi balengwe nsoni.

english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
translation: Uleke bonse abanseka ukuti, “Eya, Eya!”

english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
translation: Lelo leka bonse abakufwaya

english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
translation: Ine ndi mulanda kabili umupina,

english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
translation: Anjabwile ukufuma mu cilindi icitali nganshi

english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
translation: Amfundile no lwimbo ulupya

english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uutetekela muli Yawe,

english: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
translation: Ala fyalifulisha we Yawe, Lesa wandi,

english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
translation: Amalambo ne mituulo taufifwaya,

english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
translation: Na ine epakutila, “Mona naisa,

english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
translation: ukucita ubufwayo bobe ecaba mu mweo wandi we Lesa wandi,

english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
translation: Nga fintu waishiba we Yawe,

english: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
translation: Alishuka umuntu uusakamana abalanda na babusu,

english: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
translation: Lelo iwe umbelele uluse we Yawe

english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
translation: Na kuli ici eko ndi nokwishibila ifyo wantemwa,

english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
translation: Ulangafwa pantu ine ndi wakaele,

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli,

english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
translation: Yawe akamucingilila no kumusunga,

english: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
translation: Yawe alamukoselesha ninshi ali pa musengele nalwala,

english: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
translation: Lelo ine natile, “We Yawe umbeleleko uluse,

english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
translation: Abalwani bandi balanyamba abati,

english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
translation: Abesa mukumpempula baba ne mitima ibili,

english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
translation: Abampata bekalilafye ukutepeleshanya,

english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
translation: Bena batontonkanya ukuti balimulowa,

english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
translation: Na cibusa wandi uo nacetekele,

english: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
translation: Nga filya fine insebula ifuluka ukunwa amenshi,

english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
translation: Umusana wandi nauputuka ilintu abalwani bandi balentumfya abati,

english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi ine nkungumanine?

english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
translation: Umutima wandi ufuluka Lesa,

english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
translation: Ifilamba fyandi e cakulya candi akasuba no bushiku,

english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
translation: Umutima wandi ulasunguluka ilyo naibukisha

english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi ine nkungumanine?

english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
translation: Umutima wandi nautotobala,

english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
translation: Amatenga ya babemba yalekuminkana,

english: GOD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
translation: Yawe alenanga ukutemwa kwakwe akasuba,

english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
translation: Elyo naipusha Lesa icilibwe candi nati,

english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
translation: Nungamika no kumpokololako we Lesa wandi,

english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
translation: Niwe Lesa ubucingo bwandi,

english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
translation: Ntumina ulubuuto lobe ne cine pakuti fintungulule,

english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
translation: Elyo nkafika ku bulambo bwakwa Lesa,

english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi ine nkungumanine?

english: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
translation: We Lesa, ifwe twalyumfwile na matwi yesu,

english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
translation: Nauleka twalatiina abalwani besu,

english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
translation: Ulekele baletwipaya pamo nge mpaanga,

english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
translation: Nautushitisha fwe bantu bobe,

english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
translation: Nauleka abena mupalamano baletuwela,

english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
translation: Nauleka imishobo ya benafyalo ukutusuula,

english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
translation: Akasuba konse nyenda uwasebana,

english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
translation: pa mulandu wa banjebaula no kuntuka,

english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
translation: Ifi fyonse filetuponena nelyo tatwakulabako,

english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
translation: Ifwe imitima yesu tayakusangukila,

english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
translation: Lelo walituposelekesha mu matololo,

english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
translation: Ifyo ku kuboko kobe watamfishe imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
translation: Nga cakuti atuleka ukwibukisha ishina lyakwa Lesa wesu,

english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
translation: bushe kuti wafilwa ukwishiba fyonse ifi?

english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
translation: Lelo ni pa mulandu obe epo ifwe batwipaila akasuba konse.

english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
translation: We Yawe buuka, bushe cinshi walalila utulo?

english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi wafishila icinso cobe?

english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
translation: Nabatufwanta natuwa panshi,

english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
translation: Ima utwafweko,

english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
translation: Te ku lupanga lwabo nelyo ku maka balecimfisha iyoo,

english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
translation: Niwe we mfumu yandi kabili Lesa wandi,

english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
translation: Ni mu maka yobe emo tucimfisha abalwani besu,

english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
translation: Nshicetekela mu buta bwandi,

english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
translation: Lelo niwe utupeela ukucimfya,

english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
translation: Ni muli Lesa tuitakishisha akasuba konse,

english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
translation: Pali nomba nautulekelesha baletucimfya,

english: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
translation: Umutima wandi nausansamuka pa mulandu wa mashiwi ayasuma,

english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
translation: Umfwa kuno we mwana mwanakashi,

english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
translation: Ne mfumu ikatemwisha ukuwama kobe,

english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
translation: Umwana mwanakashi wa Turi akulaleta imituulo,

english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
translation: Umu mwine mwisano mwaba umwana wa mfumu nabwinga aipekanishisha,

english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
translation: Nafwala ifyapikulwa ifyabeeka, balemutwala ku mfumu,

english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
translation: Baleya baleenda ne nsansa pamo ne nshindishi,

english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
translation: We mfumu ukakwata abana abaume abengi,

english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
translation: Ca cine, ulwimbo lwandi lukakulenga ukulumbuka ku nkulo shonse,

english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
translation: Waliwamisha ukucila pa baume bonse,

english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
translation: Pikila ulupanga lobe mu musana we mpalume yabulamba,

english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
translation: Mu bucindami bobe ima kacimfye,

english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
translation: Imifwi yobe yalitwa,

english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
translation: Icipuna cobe icabufumu, we Lesa, cabelelela pe na pe,

english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
translation: Walitemwa ifintu ifyalungama, wapata ifyabipa,

english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
translation: Insalu shobe shilanunkila icena icisuma ica finyamuti ifyanunka ubusaka ifya muri na matembusha na kasia,

english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
translation: Pa banakashi abasangwa mwisano lyobe palibapo abana ba mfumu,

english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
translation: Lesa ewakufisamamo kabili e maka yesu,

english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
translation: Aletila “Tekanyeni mutalale tondolo mwishibe ukuti nine Lesa,

english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
translation: Ifwe twaba na Yawe umwine wa fita,

english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
translation: Kanshi nelyo isonde lingasunkana,

english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
translation: Nangufye bemba engalulunkana,

english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
translation: Eko waba umumana uusansamusha umusumba wakwa Lesa,

english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
translation: Lesa ewaikala mukati ka musumba,

english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
translation: Imishobo ya bantu ileipundilafye,

english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
translation: Ifwe twaba na Yawe umwine wa fita,

english: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
translation: Iseni mumone imilimo yakwa Yawe,

english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
translation: Eulesha inkondo pesonde ponse,

english: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
translation: Toteni amapi mwe bantu ba mishobo yonse,

english: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
translation: Mulekwatila Yawe Mukulu akatiina,

english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
translation: Ewatucimfishako imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
translation: Ewatusalilako ne calo cabupyani bwesu,

english: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
translation: Lesa alenina pakuya ikala pa cipuna cakwe icabufumu,

english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
translation: Imbileni Lesa isha malumbo, mwimbileni amalumbo!

english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
translation: Lesa euteeka pesonde lyonse,

english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
translation: Lesa euteeka imishobo ya benafyalo,

english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
translation: Elyo baisa longana bakateeka ba mishobo ya benafyalo,

english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
translation: Yawe mukulu kabili ewalinga ukulumbanya,

english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
translation: Pamo nge fyaba ishina lyobe we Lesa,

english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
translation: Leka bantu ba mu Sioni baleanga,

english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
translation: Shingulukeni umusumba wa Sioni,

english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
translation: Mucecete amalinga yauko,

english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
translation: “Uyu Lesa e Lesa shifwe wa pe na pe,

english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
translation: Ulupili lwaba ulwayemba mu kusansama kwaluko,

english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
translation: Lesa nailanga mukati ka musumba wakwe,

english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
translation: Ilintu ishamfumu shaishile mukwampana pamo,

english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
translation: Cilyafye bamona, batulumuka,

english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
translation: Shaiketwe umwenso no kutendeka ukushikitika,

english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
translation: Wabonaula kwati mato ya ku Tashishi

english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
translation: Ifi fintu twalifyumfwa nomba twaimwena,

english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
translation: Ni mwi Tempele lyobe we Lesa emo tutontonkanya,

english: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
translation: Umfweni kuno imwe bonse,

english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
translation: Umuntu alamona ukuti na bamano nabo balafwa,

english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
translation: Inindi shabo eshisanguka amayanda yabo pe na pe,

english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
translation: Ubucindami bwa muntu tekuti bumuleshe ukufwa,

english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
translation: Umfweni ifiponena abantu abaitetekela abene,

english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
translation: Ala bena icakaniko cabo kufwa nge mpaanga,

english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
translation: Lelo ine Lesa akampususha ku calo ca bafwa,

english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
translation: Wilasakamana ilyo umuntu anonka ifyuma ifingi nganshi,

english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
translation: Pantu takafisende nakalya ilintu inshita yakufwa ikafika,

english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
translation: Nangufye umuntu engaliila mu calo shani,

english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
translation: akaya ukwaya inkulo ya fikolwe fyakwe ukushimoneka ulubuuto,

english: both low and high, rich and poor together.
translation: Mwe bacindama na imwe mwe bantufye,

english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
translation: Umuntu umukankala uusuula ukupandwa amano,

english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
translation: Akanwa kandi kakalanda amashiwi ayamano

english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
translation: Ndeteyamika ukutwi kwandi kwipinda,

english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
translation: Bushe mulandu nshi ningakwatila umwenso pa nshita ya busanso,

english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
translation: Aba bantu bena babika amano ku fyuma,

english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
translation: Takwaba umuntu uwingalubula munyina,

english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
translation: Umutengo wakuilubwilapo ubumi walikosa,

english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
translation: icingalenga umuntu ukuti ekalilile pano isonde,

english: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
translation: Ilyo ine ndekuuta mutuule, ulenjasuka we Lesa wandi umulungami,

english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
translation: Mwe bantu, bushe ni lilali mukaleka ukusaalula ubucindami bwandi?

english: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
translation: Ishibeni ukuti Yawe aliipatwila abamupetamina,

english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
translation: Nga cakuti mwafulwa, mwilaleka ukufulwa kwenu kumutwale kukubifya,

english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
translation: Tuuleni amalambo ayalungama,

english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
translation: Abengi balepusha abati, “Bushe nani engatulanga icintu icisuma,

english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
translation: Walipeela umutima wandi ubuseko ubwacila,

english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
translation: Nakulalambalala no kulala umutende,

english: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
translation: Umwine wa maka yonse Yawe Lesa

english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
translation: Pantu inama shampanga shonse shandi,

english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
translation: Ifyuni fyonse pamo ne fipeema fyonse nalifishiba,

english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
translation: “Nga cakuti insala yansuma tekuti mwebe,

english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
translation: Bushe ine ndalya iminofu ya bacilume ba ŋombe,

english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
translation: Tuulila Lesa ilambo lyakumutotela,

english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
translation: Kabili mulendilila mu nshita ya mafya,

english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
translation: Lelo ku babifi Lesa aletila,

english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
translation: Tamufwaya ukusalapulwa,

english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
translation: Imwe mutila nga cakuti mwamona umupupu,

english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
translation: Utunwa twenu tulandafye ifyabipa,

english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
translation: Lesa alebengeshima ukufuma mu Sioni,

english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
translation: Mwaikalilafye ukwamba bamunyinenwe,

english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
translation: Pali fyonse ifyo mwacita naikele tondolo,

english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
translation: “Eico mwe balaba kuli Lesa cenjeleni

english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
translation: Umuntu uuntotela mukutuula ilambo lyakutasha alancindika,

english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
translation: Lesa wesu aleisa,

english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
translation: Aita bonse aba mu mulu na pano isonde,

english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
translation: Aleti, “Nonganikileni abantu bandi bonse,

english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
translation: Umulu uleimininako ubulungami bwakwe,

english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
translation: “Mwe bantu bandi umfweni ifyo ndelanda,

english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
translation: Nshilemwebaula pa mulandu wa mituulo yenu,

english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
translation: Ala ine nshikabila bacilume ba ŋombe,

english: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
translation: Umbeleleko uluse we Lesa,

english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
translation: Umbikemo umutima uwakaele we Lesa,

english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
translation: Wintamfya pa cinso cobe,

english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
translation: Umbweseshe insansa sha kupususha kobe,

english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
translation: Lyena elyo nakulafunda bampulamafunde umwakwishila kuli iwe,

english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
translation: Umpusushe ku milandu ya mulopa we Lesa,

english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
translation: Isula imilomo yandi we Yawe,

english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
translation: Ine kuti natuula ilambo, lelo ifi tefyo ufwaya,

english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
translation: Lelo umutima uwabupete e lambo lyakwa Lesa,

english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
translation: Cita ifisuma kuli Sioni mu nshita ya kutemwa kobe,

english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
translation: Elyo ukasekelela amalambo ayalungama,

english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
translation: Unsambe bwino bwino ukufuma ku fyabupulumushi fyandi fyonse,

english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
translation: Pantu bumpulamafunde bwandi ine nalibwishiba,

english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
translation: Ni kuli iwefye weka nabifyako,

english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
translation: Cine cine ine ni mu bubifi emo nafyalilwe,

english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
translation: Apo ufwaya umutima wabupete,

english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
translation: Ufuute ifibi fyandi ku tumisambo twa hisopo,

english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
translation: Leka ŋumfwe ukusekelela ne nsansa,

english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
translation: Utalushe icinso cobe ku fibi fyandi,

english: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
translation: Bushe cinshi ico uitakishisha pa bubi, we mwaume impalume?

english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
translation: Ululimi lobe lupangafye ubonaushi,

english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
translation: Watemwa ububifi ukucila ubusuma,

english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
translation: Watemwa ukulanda amashiwi ayakucena abantu,

english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
translation: Ee Lesa akakutentemuna umuyayaya,

english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
translation: Abacita ubololoke pakumona ici cintu bakalatiina,

english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
translation: Sam 21:7

english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
translation: Lelo ine nabafye ngo muti wa muolifa,

english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
translation: Impelwamano mu mutima itila, “Takwaba Lesa”.

english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
translation: Ukufuma ku mulu, Lesa alolesha pa bana ba bantu,

english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
translation: Abantu bonse balifutatila Lesa,

english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
translation: Bushe abacita ifibi, emukuti mano bashakwata?

english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
translation: Moneni nomba ifyo baleikatwa umwenso apashili icakubatiinya,

english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
translation: Iye, nga cakuti ukulubuka kwa bena Israeli nga kwafuma mu Sioni!

english: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
translation: Umfwa kwipepo lyandi, we Lesa,

english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
translation: Abantu bambi bambifye nabanjimina,

english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
translation: Ala cine cine Lesa e kafwa wandi,

english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
translation: Uleke ububi bubwelele abalwani bandi,

english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
translation: Ine nakulakutuula ilambo ilyakuitemenwa,

english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
translation: Pantu naumpususha ku macushi yandi yonse,

english: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
translation: Kutika kwipepo lyandi, we Lesa,

english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
translation: Akasuba no bushiku baleendaukafye pa mulu wa malinga,

english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
translation: Ubonaushi bulifye mpanga yonse mu musumba,

english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
translation: Aciba cakuti mulwani eulencusha,

english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
translation: Nomba niwe we muntu munandi,

english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
translation: Twaleumfwana nobe, no kwangalila pamo,

english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
translation: Uleke imfwa ibapumikishe abalwani bandi no kubasenda,

english: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.
translation: Lelo ine ni kuli Lesa eko ndelilila,

english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
translation: Ndilishika no kuteta uko ali,

english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
translation: Akulapokolola umweo wandi mu mutende ukufuma ku bulwi ubo ndwisha,

english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.
translation: Lesa uwaikala pa cipuna cabufumu umuyayaya,

english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
translation: Uŋumfwe no kunjasuka,

english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
translation: Cibusa wandi emine bacibusa bakwe,

english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
translation: Mu kanwa kakwe alande ifisuma nga mafuta,

english: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
translation: Tuula ifisendo fyobe kuli Yawe, nao akulakubaka,

english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
translation: Nomba ababifi bena, we Lesa ukabaposa mu cilindi cakubonawilamo,

english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
translation: Ine amano nayapela palwa cintiinya ca balwani bandi,

english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
translation: Umutima wandi uleshikitika,

english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
translation: Ine ndetiina no kututuma ndetutuma,

english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
translation: Eico ndetila, “Aciba cakuti nalikwata amapindo nge nkunda,

english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
translation: Ngakuti nafulumukila ukutali,

english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
translation: Ngakuti naendesha ukuya ukwakutuushisha,

english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
translation: Ubonaule, we Yawe, ufulunganye no lulimi lwabo,

english: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
translation: muli Lesa emo nakwata icitetekelo kabili teti ntiine,

english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
translation: We Lesa nalakupeela fyonse ifyo nalaile,

english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
translation: Pantu naupokolola umweo wandi ukufuma ku mfwa,

english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
translation: Abo twapusana nabo balensupila akasuba konse,

english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
translation: Ilyo umwenso wanjikata,

english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
translation: Muli Lesa umwine we shiwi ilyo numbanya,

english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
translation: Akasuba konse bafulunganya ifyo nanda,

english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
translation: Balongana elyo bambelamina,

english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
translation: Pali buncitatubi bwabo balimune we Lesa,

english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
translation: Ulembe ukulila kwandi,

english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
translation: Abalwani bandi bakafulumuka

english: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
translation: Umbelele uluse we Lesa wandi,

english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
translation: Pantu icitemwiko cobe cikulu nganshi cafika na mu myulu,

english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
translation: Ube uwasumbulwa ukucila na pa myulu we Lesa,

english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
translation: Ndalilila kuli Lesa Mukulu,

english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
translation: Euntumina ipusukilo ukufuma ku mulu no kumpususha,

english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
translation: Ine ndi pakati ka nkalamo,

english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
translation: Ube uwasumbulwa ukucila na pa myulu we Lesa,

english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
translation: Abalwani bandi nabanteya isumbu ilyakuti njikatwemo,

english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
translation: We Lesa umutima wandi ulifye uwashipa, ee ucilifye uwashipa,

english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
translation: Buuka we mutima wandi!

english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya mu mishobo ya bantu, we Mfumu,

english: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
translation: Bushe imwe bakateeka imipingwile yenu intu yalolamo?

english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
translation: Abololoke bakatemwa nganshi pakumona uko ababifi balekandwa,

english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
translation: Elyo abantu bakalasosa abati, “Ala cine cine abololoke bakalambulwa,

english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
translation: Nakalya imwe mu mitima yenu mutontonkanya palwa kucita ifyabipa,

english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
translation: Abantu babi ububifi bwabo butendekela mwifumo,

english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
translation: Bakwata ubusungu ngo bwa nsoka,

english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
translation: iyishumfwa ishiwi lya muntu uwacenjela ukwita,

english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.
translation: We Lesa, ukontaule ameno mu tunwa twabo,

english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
translation: Leka bapite nga menshi filya yakunkuluka,

english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
translation: Uleke babe nge nkola iyenguluka pakwenda,

english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
translation: Lintu inongo shenu tashilaumfwa icikabilila ca mulilo wa myunga,

english: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
translation: Mpokololako ku balwani bandi we Lesa,

english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
translation: We Lesa wandi, we wantemwisha walantangilila,

english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
translation: We Yawe, we nkwela yesu, wibepaya bwangu abantu aba,

english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
translation: Pa mulandu wakuti ifyabipa fyaba pa tunwa twabo,

english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
translation: ubonaule ku cipyu cobe,

english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
translation: Bena babwela icungulo,

english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
translation: Bekalilafye ukululumba mukufwaya ifyakulya,

english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
translation: Lelo ine nakulalumbanya amaka yobe,

english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya, we bulamba bwandi,

english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
translation: Mpokololako kuli aba bantu bacita ifyabubifi,

english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.
translation: Umone ifyo balalilila umweo wandi,

english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
translation: Apabula umulandu mbacitile

english: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
translation: Iye we Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita, Lesa wa bena Israeli,

english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
translation: Bena babwela icungulo,

english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
translation: Nga wakutika ku fifuma mu tunwa twabo,

english: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
translation: Lelo we Yawe ubasekafye,

english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
translation: Niwe maka yandi, ala niwe ndoleshako,

english: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
translation: Kutika kwipepo lyandi we Yawe,

english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
translation: Ubapeele umulandu we Lesa,

english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
translation: Lelo leka bonse abafisama muli iwe babe no buseko,

english: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
translation: Pantu we Yawe ulapaala abololoke,

english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
translation: Umfwa uko ndelila

english: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
translation: Cila lucelo ulomfwa ishiwi lyandi we Yawe,

english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
translation: Tawaba Lesa uwikala aletamba ifyabipa,

english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
translation: Abamataki tekuti beminine ku cinso cobe,

english: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
translation: Ulonaula bonse ababepa ubufi.

english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
translation: Lelo pa mulandu wa luse lobe ulukalamba,

english: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
translation: Ntungulula we Yawe mu kulungama kobe,

english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
translation: Pantu akanwa kabo takalanda fyacishinka,

english: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
translation: We Lesa, nautuposa naupasaula umo twashintilile,

english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
translation: Bushe teiwe we Lesa walituposa?

english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
translation: Shi wingatwafwilishako ukulwisha abalwani,

english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
translation: Lesa nga aba ku lubali lwesu ninshi tulecimfya,

english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
translation: Nautelentensha icalo, no kucilepula caisuka,

english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
translation: Naulenga abantu bobe ukulaculisha nganshi,

english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
translation: Naulanga icishibilo ku bantu bobe abakutiina,

english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
translation: Tupususheko no kutwafwa ku maka ya kuboko kobe ukwa ku kulyo,

english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
translation: Lesa nalanda mu cifulo cakwe icamushilo ati,

english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
translation: Gileadi ena wandi, na Manase nao wine wandi,

english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
translation: Moabu ena e musambilo wandi,

english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
translation: Nga nani akantwala mu musumba we linga?

english: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
translation: Kutika ku kulila kwandi, we Lesa

english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
translation: Ndelilila kuli iwe ukufuma ku mpela ya pano isonde,

english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
translation: Pantu niwe ine nshintililako,

english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
translation: Uleke ndeikalilila mwi Tenti lyobe pe na pe,

english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
translation: Pantu ulomfwa ifilayo fyandi we Lesa,

english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
translation: Ulundileko imfumu ya calo imyaka iyingi,

english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
translation: Uleke ileteeka umuyayaya pa cinso cobe we Lesa,

english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
translation: Eico ine nakulaimba inyimbo shakulumbanya ishina lyobe pe,

english: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
translation: Umweo wandi utuushisha muli Lesa eka,

english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
translation: Mwicetekela mu fyabukakashi,

english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
translation: Kwaba icintu cimo ico Lesa akomailapo,

english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
translation: ne cakuti iwe we Mfumu uli wa citemwiko icishipwa.

english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
translation: Ekafye e cilibwe candi, kabili ipusukilo lyandi,

english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
translation: Bushe iwe ukaposa inshita shinga ishakucenenapo umuntu,

english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
translation: Bena bafwailishafye inshila shakumufumya pa bukankala bwakwe,

english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
translation: Sanga ukutuusha muli Lesa eka we mweo wandi,

english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
translation: Ena ekafye e cilibwe candi, kabili e pusukilo lyandi,

english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
translation: Ipusukilo lyandi no mucinshi wandi fyaba muli Lesa,

english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
translation: Mwe bantu, ala lyonsefye mulecetekela Lesa,

english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
translation: Abantu yaweyawe baba ngo mupu,

english: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
translation: We Lesa, ala niwe Lesa wandi, ine ndekufwaya,

english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
translation: Bakafwila ku lupanga,

english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
translation: Lelo imfumu ikasansamukila muli Lesa,

english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
translation: Ine nalikumona mu cifulo cobe icamushilo,

english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
translation: Pantu icitemwiko cobe icishifilwa caliwama ukucila ubumi,

english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya ilyo ncili umumi,

english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
translation: Umutima wandi ukalaipakisha,

english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
translation: Ilyo ndala pa musengele wandi ine ndakwibukisha,

english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
translation: Pantu niwe ungafwa lyonsefye,

english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
translation: Umweo wandi wakonena muli iwe,

english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
translation: Lelo abafwaya ukulofya umweo wandi bakabalofya,

english: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
translation: Wingomfwa ishiwi lyandi ilyakulilishika, we Lesa,

english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
translation: Lekeni umuntu onse umololoke asekelele muli Yawe,

english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
translation: Umfise ukufuma kuli bantalamisoka,

english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
translation: Abanona indimi shabo ngo lupanga,

english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
translation: Balabelama pakulasa uwakaele,

english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
translation: Balakoseleshanya ilyo bapanga ukucita icabipa,

english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
translation: Ilyo balepangana ukucita ifyabipa batila,

english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
translation: Lelo Lesa akalasa umufwi pali bena,

english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
translation: Akabalofya pa mulandu wafyo balanda,

english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
translation: Elyo na bantu bonse bakatiina,

english: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
translation: Calilinga abantu balekulumbanya mu Sioni, we Lesa,

english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
translation: Amabala ayalimwa niwe uyaletela imfula iyingi,

english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
translation: Ifisabo filafuma ukulingana nefyo upeela cila mwaka,

english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
translation: Umulemfwe ulafulisha mu matololo,

english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
translation: Umwakucemena monse mwisula impaanga,

english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
translation: Pantu ulomfwa amapepo,

english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
translation: Ilyo ifibi fyatwanshishe

english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
translation: Balishuka abo wasala no kubapalamika kuli iwe,

english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
translation: Ulatwasuka mu bulungami ukupitila mu fisungusho,

english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
translation: Niwe waimike impili ku maka yobe,

english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
translation: Niwe utalalika icilulumo ca bemba,

english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
translation: Icakuti aba pano isonde abekala ukutali baikatwa umwenso

english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
translation: Niwe upempula icalo no kuciletela imfula,

english: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
translation: Auleni utupundu, mwe bantu bonse!

english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
translation: Pantu ifwe walitwesha, we Lesa,

english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
translation: Niwe watuleta mu cifungo,

english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
translation: Niwe walekele abalwani besu baletunyantaula,

english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
translation: Ndeleta ku ŋanda yobe amalambo ayakoca,

english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
translation: ifilayo imilomo yandi yalaile na kanwa kandi kalandile,

english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
translation: Nkakulekela amalambo ya nama ishaina,

english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
translation: Mwe bakwatila Lesa akatiina, iseni mumfwe bonse,

english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
translation: Nalilile kuli Lesa na kanwa kandi,

english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
translation: Umutima wandi ausaminwa ububi,

english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
translation: Lelo Lesa ine aliŋumfwile icine cine,

english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
translation: Imbileni ubucindami bwe shina lyakwe,

english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
translation: Lesa apaalwe na matotelo pantu tasuulile ipepo lyandi,

english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
translation: Ebeni Lesa amuti,

english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
translation: Aba pano isonde bonse niwe bapakata,

english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
translation: Iseni mumone ifyo Lesa acita,

english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
translation: Asangwile bemba ukuba umushili uwauma,

english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
translation: Euteeka pe ku maka yakwe,

english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
translation: Akulumbanyeni Lesa wesu, imwe mwe bantu bonse,

english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
translation: Ewatusunga abomi,

english: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
translation: Utubeleleko uluse kabili utupaale, we Lesa,

english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
translation: Pakuti abantu bonse aba pano isonde baleishiba inshila shobe,

english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
translation: Ala leka abantu balekulumba, we Lesa,

english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
translation: Leka imishobo ilesansamuka, no kulaimba inyimbo shansansa,

english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
translation: Ala leka abantu balekulumba, we Lesa,

english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
translation: Elyo no mushili ukamesha ifisabo fyauko,

english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
translation: Akatupaala Lesa wesu,

english: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
translation: Lekeni Lesa eme no kulenga abalwani bakwe basalangane,

english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
translation: Na bantu bobe emo baikele,

english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
translation: Yawe abilikishe ishiwi,

english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
translation: “Ala bashamfumu abengi ne fita fyabo nababutuka,

english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
translation: Ilyo mwe baume mwaletuusha mu fibumba fya macinka,

english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
translation: Ilyo Lesa wa maka yonse apasangenye shamfumu mu calo,

english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
translation: Ulupili lwa Bashani, bushe nalo lupili lwakwa Lesa?

english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
translation: Mwe mpili sha cilumba cinshi ico muleshulukila ulupili apo Lesa asalile ulwakuteekapo,

english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
translation: Yawe afumine ku Sinai na maceleta imyandamishila,

english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
translation: Ilyo aninine pamulu apasansama

english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Lesa uututulako ifyafina,

english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
translation: Nga filya fine icushi cisalangana ku mwela,

english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
translation: Lesa wesu ni Lesa uutupususha,

english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
translation: Cine cine Lesa akatobaula imitwe ya balwani bakwe,

english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
translation: Yawe asosa ati, “Ine nkababweshako ukufuma ku Bashani,

english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
translation: pakuti imwe mukalepita mu mulopa wa balwani benu,

english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
translation: We Lesa ala bonse balamonako uko balesefya pakukushindika

english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
translation: Abakwimba bali pantanshi, abakulisha ifilimba nabakonkapo,

english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
translation: Paaleni Lesa na matotelo, mwe lukuta ulukalamba,

english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
translation: Epo bali aba luko ulunono ulwa bena Benjamini ebalebatungulula,

english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
translation: Ulange amaka yobe we Lesa,

english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
translation: Pa mulandu we Tempele lyobe ilyaba mu Yerusalemu,

english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
translation: Lelo abololoke bena balesansamuka pa cinso cakwa Lesa,

english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
translation: Ukalipile filya fiswango fya mu matete,

english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
translation: Inkombe shikafuma ku Egupto,

english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
translation: Imbileni Lesa inyimbo mwe shamfumu sha pano isonde,

english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
translation: Kuli ena uwenda pa mulu wa myulu,

english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa bwa bulamba bwakwa Lesa,

english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
translation: Walicindama we Lesa mu cifulo cobe icamushilo,

english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
translation: Imbileni Lesa inyimbo shakulumbanya ishina lyakwe,

english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
translation: Lesa e wishi wa bakashiwa,

english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
translation: Eulanga abo balekelesha apakwikala,

english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
translation: We Lesa ilyo watungulwile abantu bobe,

english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
translation: icalo calitentele no mulu walosha imfula,

english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
translation: Niwe Lesa uwalokeshe imfula iyingi,

english: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
translation: Umpususheko we Lesa,

english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
translation: Ilyo ndila no kuleka ukulya,

english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
translation: Ilyo ine nafwala insalu shabulanda,

english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
translation: Abekala pa mpongolo nine bekalila ukwamba,

english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
translation: Lelo ine ndepepa kuli iwe we Yawe

english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
translation: Ntulako ku lutikiti,

english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
translation: Wileka amenshi yacitalawe yanjibishe,

english: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
translation: Unjasuke we Yawe, pantu waba ne citemwiko cisuma icishipwa,

english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
translation: Yoani 2:17

english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
translation: Umpalamine no kumpusushako,

english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
translation: Iwe walishiba ifyo ine nasuulwa,

english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
translation: Naya ndeibila mu lutikiti ulwashika nganshi,

english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
translation: Insele ine shalindepula umutima,
