english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
translation: Bambikila ifyabwanga mu fyakulya,

english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
translation: Leka amalila yabo yakabonaule,

english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
translation: Leka pa menso yabo pafiite fititi pakuti belamona,

english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
translation: Upongolwele pali bena ubukali bobe,

english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
translation: Uleke apo bekala pabe ni pa cibolya,

english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
translation: Pantu bena bapimpilafye ukulacusha abo wafulula kale,

english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
translation: Ubakande umukonkanina ububi bwabo,

english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
translation: Lelo ine ndi mulanda kabili ndecula,

english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
translation: Ninaka ku mulandu wakukuuta,

english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
translation: Ine nakulalumbanya ishina lyakwa Lesa mu lwimbo,

english: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
translation: Pantu ici cena kuti casekesha Yawe,

english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
translation: Lekeni abalanda baimwene no kusansamuka,

english: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
translation: Pantu Yawe alomfwa ukulila kwa balanda,

english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
translation: Lekeni umulu ne sonde fyonse fimulumbanye,

english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
translation: Pantu Lesa akapususha Sioni,

english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
translation: na bana ba babomfi bakwe ebakapyanamo,

english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
translation: Abampata apabula umulandu bafula ukucila pa mushishi wandi uwa ku mutwe.

english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
translation: Niwe waishiba ukutumpa kwandi, we Lesa,

english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
translation: Wileka abakutetekela balengwe insoni pa mulandu wa ine,

english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
translation: Pantu ni pali iwe epo bansuulila,

english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
translation: Ine nabafye ngo mweni kuli bamunyinane,

english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
translation: Icitemwiko cakutemwisha isano lyobe we Lesa ecikanjipaya,

english: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
translation: We Yawe ala windubulwisha mu cipyu

english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
translation: Abalwani bandi bonse bakekatwa insoni,

english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
translation: Umbelelefye uluse, we Yawe ico ine nshakosa.

english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
translation: Umutima wandi naushupikwa.

english: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
translation: We Yawe pilibukila kuli ine no kumpokolola.

english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
translation: Takwaba umuntu uukwibukisha panuma ya mfwa,

english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
translation: Ine nimfunshika kukuteta ubushiku bonse,

english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
translation: Amenso yandi nayanaka ku bulanda ndefilwa no kulolesha,

english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
translation: Ntalukeni imwe bonse mwe bacita ifyabipa,

english: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
translation: Yawe naumfwa inkuuta yandi,

english: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
translation: We Lesa, wise bwangu umpokololeko,

english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
translation: Uleke bonse abafwaya ukunjipaya basebane na mano yabo yabapele.

english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
translation: Uleke abatila, “Eya, eya!”

english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
translation: Uleke bonse abakufwaya basekelele no kusansamuka,

english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
translation: Lelo ine ndi mulanda kabili umupina,

english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
translation: Ine nafisama muli iwe, we Yawe,

english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
translation: Abalwani bandi lyonse balenyamba,

english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
translation: Bena batila, “Ala Lesa namulekelesha,

english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
translation: Wiba kutali we Lesa,

english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
translation: Uleke abampata balengwe nsoni kabili ubonaule,

english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
translation: Lelo ine lyonsefye niwe nakulacetekela,

english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
translation: Ine nakulalanda palwa bulungami bobe,

english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
translation: Ndeisa mukulumbanya ifyo wacita we Mfumu Yawe,

english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
translation: Niwe wamfundisha ukufuma ku bwaice bwandi, we Lesa,

english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
translation: Wikandekelesha we Lesa ilyo nkakota no kukwata imfwi,

english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
translation: Ubulungami bobe na maka yobe fyafika na ku mulu,

english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
translation: Mu bulungami bobe undubule no kumpokolola,

english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
translation: Nelyo walenga ukuti ine njishibe amasakamiko na macushi ayengi,

english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
translation: Niwe uli nokuncindamika,

english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
translation: Ine nakulakulumbila peseese

english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
translation: Akanwa kandi kakulaaula akapundu ilyo nakulakwimbila amalumbo,

english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
translation: Akasuba konse ine nakulalanda pa fyabulungami ifyo wabomba,

english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
translation: Ube kuli ine icilibwe cakuubamo

english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
translation: Mpokololako we Lesa wandi ukufuma ku minwe ya bantu babifi,

english: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
translation: Ine, niwe natetekela we Mfumu,

english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
translation: Ine niwe nashintamo umutima ukutulafye apo nafyalilwa,

english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
translation: Abantu abengi balapapa nga bamona,

english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
translation: Akanwa kandi keswilemofye amalumbo,

english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
translation: Wikantamfula ilyo ine nkakota,

english: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
translation: Wingapeela imfumu amano ayakupingula nga iwe, we Lesa,

english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
translation: Imfumu sha mu calo ca Tashishi,

english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
translation: Imfumu shonse shakulaifukamina,

english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
translation: Pantu imfumu eikalapokolola abalanda abakuuta mutuule,

english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
translation: Imbulwamaka na balanda yakulabakwatila uluse,

english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
translation: Yakulabapokololako ku babulwi na bamucusha,

english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
translation: Imfumu ya mu calo naileenda umutende!

english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
translation: Lekeni mu calo caiko muleba ifyakulya,

english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
translation: Lekeni ishina lyaiko libeko pe na pe,

english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
translation: Napaalwe na matotelo Yawe, Lesa wakwa Israeli,

english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
translation: Ishina lyakwe ilyacindama lipaalwe na matotelo pe,

english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
translation: Pakuti akalepingula abantu bobe mu bulungami,

english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
translation: Pano epapwila amapepo yakwa Davidi mwana Yese.

english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
translation: Impili shikaleta ubukankala ku bantu,

english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
translation: Akalapokololako abalanda pakati ka bantu,

english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
translation: Akabelelela pa nshita yonse ilyo akasuba no mweshi fikabako,

english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
translation: Uleke imfumu ilecita nga filya imfula iloka mu mabala,

english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
translation: Mu nshiku shakwe uleke abalungami bakashuke,

english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
translation: Imfumu ikateeka ukufuma kuli bemba umo ukufika kuli bemba munankwe,

english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
translation: Ne mitundu ya bantu abaikala mu matololo bakulafukamina apo ili,

english: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
translation: Cine cine, Lesa musuma ku bena Israeli,

english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
translation: Cilenga na bantu babo ukwalukila uko bali,

english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
translation: Bena basosa abati, “Bushe Lesa kuti aishiba shani?”

english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
translation: Ifi efyaba abantu babifi,

english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
translation: Mu cine ine njicushafye pakusunga umutima wandi uwasanguluka,

english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
translation: Ndi muntu uucula akasuba konse,

english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
translation: Ntila nati, “Kanande ngomo balya balandila,”

english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
translation: Eico ine naeseshe na maka ukuti njishibe umo cilolele,

english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
translation: Mpaka ilyo naingile mu cifulo camushilo icakwa Lesa,

english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
translation: Cine cine umwatelela emo wababika,

english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
translation: Yangu bapumikishiwa pakuloba,

english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
translation: Lelo ine nalifye mupepi no kuwa,

english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
translation: We Yawe ala bapwa,

english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
translation: Ilyo umutima wandi waiketwe ubulanda,

english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
translation: nayalwike uwabula amano kabili uushaishiba,

english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
translation: Lelo lyonsefye niwe tuba nobe,

english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
translation: Amano yobe eyantungulula,

english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
translation: Nga ni nani umbi nakwata mu mulu ukucila pali iwe?

english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
translation: Umubili wandi no mutima wandi kuti fyatompoka,

english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
translation: Bonse abakukaana bali nokuloba,

english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
translation: Lelo ine nalitemwa ukupalamina kuli Lesa,

english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
translation: Ine nalekumbwa abafikansa,

english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
translation: Bena tabakwata icibacusha,

english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
translation: Tabacula nga filya ficula abantu bambi nakalya,

english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
translation: Eico kanshi bena bafwala icilumba ngo bulungu bwa mu mukoshi,

english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
translation: Mu mitima yabo iyabipisha emufuma ifyabubifi,

english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
translation: Bena balatumfya abanabo no kusosa ifibi,

english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
translation: Pa tunwa twabo balanda ifyakupontela umulu,

english: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
translation: Bushe cinshi calenga ukuti utukaanininefye umuyayaya, we Lesa?

english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
translation: Bushe ni lilali abalwani bakaleka umusebanya kuli iwe we Lesa?

english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
translation: Cinshi ico wakaanina ukuti utupokololeko na maka ya kuboko kobe ukwa ku kulyo.

english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
translation: Lelo we Lesa mukulu niwe mfumu yandi ukufumafye na kale,

english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
translation: Ni ku bulamba bobefye wayakanishishe bemba pakati,

english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
translation: Niwe waonawile umutwe wa cishimweshimwe ci Lefiatani ,

english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
translation: Niwe walengele utumfukumfuku ukwisuka twalapisha imilonga,

english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
translation: Niwe walenga ukuti kuleba akasuba no bushiku,

english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
translation: Niwe wapakanya imipaka yonse iya pano isonde,

english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
translation: Lelo kwena uleibukisha imiponto ya balwani bobe we Yawe,

english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
translation: Wiposa mweo wa uo watemwa ku fiswango,

english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
translation: Ibukisha ulukuta lobe, ulo we mwine waisalile kalefye,

english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
translation: Ibukisha icipangano ico wapangene na ifwe,

english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
translation: Ukuf 14:21

english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
translation: Ima we Lesa wise uilandile we mwine,

english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
translation: Ibukisha ifyo abalwani bobe baleotauka,

english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
translation: Wende wise uimwene ubonaushi bwa lyonse,

english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
translation: Abalwani balebuluma mu cifulo camushilo umo watukumanishe,

english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
translation: Balemonekafye nga bantu abemishe amasembe

english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
translation: Balaonaula imbao sha ku fibumba,

english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
translation: Icifulo cobe icamushilo naboca ku mulilo ukufikafye na panshi

english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
translation: Mu mitima yabo balesosa nokuti, “Tuli nokulofyafye bonse,”

english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
translation: Nomba takwaba ne fishibilo fyacipeshamano,

english: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
translation: Twakutotela we Lesa, twakutotela,

english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
translation: Ine nkaputula insengo sha babifi bonse,

english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
translation: Lesa alanda ati, “Pa nshita iyo ine nkapima,

english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
translation: Ilyo icalo nabekalamo bonse fyatenkana,

english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
translation: Abafilumba ine ndabeba ukuti, ‘Mwilaitakisha,’

english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
translation: Mwicita ifyamataki ku wa mu mulu,

english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
translation: Pantu ukusumbulwa takufuma ku kabanga nangu ku masamba,

english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
translation: lelo ni Lesa eupingula,

english: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
translation: Yawe ali no lukombo mu minwe ulwaisulamo umwangashi uwakantuka,

english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
translation: Lelo ine nshakatale ndeka ukulumbanya Lesa wakwa Yakobo,

english: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
translation: Lesa alishibikwa nganshi mu calo ca Yuda,

english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
translation: Cine cine icipyu cobe pa bantu ecilenga ukuti balekulumbanya,

english: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
translation: Pangeni ifilayo kuli Yawe Lesa wenu no kufifikilisha,

english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
translation: Pantu ena alacefya bakateeka bafilumba,

english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
translation: Itenti lyakwe lyaba mu Salemu,

english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
translation: Palya pene epo afunawile imifwi iyalebengeshima,

english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
translation: Yangu ifyo wacindamisha we Lesa,

english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
translation: Abashilika babo abaswangana, balibapoka ifitapwa fyabo,

english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
translation: Ilyo wakalipe we Lesa wakwa Yakobo,

english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
translation: Niwe weka uwakutiinisha.

english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
translation: Wapingwile ukufuma ku mulu,

english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
translation: ilyo waiminine kukuputula umulandu, we Lesa,

english: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
translation: Ndilila kuli Lesa ukuti angafwe,

english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
translation: Elyo natontonkanya nati, “Ili lyena nalailishanya ukuti,

english: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
translation: Ine nakulaibukisha ifyakupapa fyonse ifyo wacita we Yawe,

english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
translation: Nakulatontonkanya pali fyonse ifyo wacita,

english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
translation: Inshila shobe shamushilo, we Lesa,

english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
translation: Niwe Lesa uucita ifipeshamano,

english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
translation: Ku kuboko kobe ukwamaka eko walubwile abantu bobe,

english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
translation: Amenshi yalitiinine ilyo yakumwene we Lesa,

english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
translation: Amakumbi yafumfumwine imfula, ne nkuba yalapanta,

english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
translation: Inkuba yalapanta no kumfwika ninshi kuli icimwela,

english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
translation: Walyendele muli bemba,

english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
translation: Ilyo nali mu bwafya nafwaile Imfumu,

english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
translation: Ee, walitungulwile abantu bobe ngo mukuni wa mpaanga,

english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
translation: Umutima wandi watusaile ilyo nakwibukishe we Lesa,

english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
translation: Walengele amenso yandi ukwikala yalelolesha,

english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
translation: Natontonkanya pa nshiku shakale,

english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
translation: Ndebukisha ulwimbo naleimba ubushiku,

english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
translation: “Bushe Yawe ali nokundekeleshafye fino fine umuyayaya?

english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
translation: Bushe emukuti naleka ukulantemwa umuyayaya?

english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
translation: Bushe Lesa naleka ukuba ne cikuku?

english: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
translation: Mwe bantu bandi kutikeni ku mafundisho yandi,

english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
translation: Tabasungile icipangano cakwa Lesa,

english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
translation: Balilabile na fyonse ifyo acita,

english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
translation: Lesa alicitile ifipeshamano pa cinso ca fikolwe fyabo,

english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
translation: Alyakenye bemba pakati epo abapisha,

english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
translation: Mu nshita sha kasuba alebatungulwila kwikumbi,

english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
translation: Alepawile ifimabwe ifyasansuka mu matololo,

english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
translation: Alilengele umulonga wa menshi ukufuma ku cilibwe,

english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
translation: Lelo bena babikilepofye ukulabifya kuli ena,

english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
translation: Basukile bayamba ukulaesha Lesa,

english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
translation: Bayamba no kuilishanya palwakwa Lesa abati,

english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
translation: Ine nakulalandila mu milumbe,

english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
translation: Ee cine cine Lesa alyumine pa cilibwe,

english: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
translation: Kanshi Yawe nao epakufulwa nganshi pakumfwa imilandile yabo,

english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
translation: Pantu bena tabasumine Lesa,

english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
translation: Lelo Lesa akonkomesha amakumbi ya mu lwelele,

english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
translation: Epakubafumfumwina maana wakulya,

english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
translation: Kanshi abantu nabo epakulya umukate wa bamalaika,

english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
translation: Elyo aimya umwela ku kabanga nao walapupa,

english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
translation: Nao wabaletela umunani wa nama uwingi kwati lukungu ku bwingi,

english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
translation: Alenga fyaisa kupa mpanga yonse pa nsakwe shabo,

english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
translation: Abantu nabo epakulalya ukucilapo,

english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
translation: Palwa fintu ifyo fwe bene twaishiba, nefyo twayumfwilile,

english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
translation: Nomba pa nshita bacili balelya,

english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
translation: Ubukali bwakwa Lesa bwali bemine,

english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
translation: Nangu kwena Lesa alebacitila fyonse ifi, batwalililafye ukulabifya,

english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
translation: Kanshi nao epakupwisha inshiku sha bumi bwabo mukuculafye,

english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
translation: Ilyo aipeyepo bamo, elyo babwelele uko ali,

english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
translation: Mateo 13:35

english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
translation: Lelo utunwa twabo twaiswilemo amashiwi yakusembeleka,

english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
translation: Tabalemupetamina nakalya,

english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
translation: Lelo Lesa ena alebelelako uluse abantu bakwe,

english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
translation: Ena aleibukisha ukuti balya bantufye,

english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
translation: Tatwakulafisa ifi fintu ku bana iyoo.

english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
translation: Pa mikufye iyingi balesangukila Lesa mu matololo,

english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Libili libili balesonsomba Lesa,

english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
translation: Abantu balilabile ubulamba bwakwe ubushaikulila,

english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
translation: Balabile ne finjelengwe ifyamaka ne fipeshamano acitile,

english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
translation: Amenshi mu mimana yabo ayasangwile umulopa,

english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
translation: Abatumina no tushembele, nato twalabasumaula,

english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
translation: Atuma amapantankola kukulya ifisabo fyabo,

english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
translation: Aonaula ne myangashi yabo ku mfula yacitalawe,

english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
translation: Aipaya ne fitekwa fyabo ku mfula yacitalawe iya mabwe,

english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
translation: Apongolwela pali bena icifukushi ca bukali bwakwe,

english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
translation: Ewapeele Yakobo amafunde,

english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
translation: Apekenye apakwenda ubukali bwakwe,

english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
translation: Aipeye na bana babo abaume amabeli,

english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
translation: Lelo Lesa epakwimya abantu bakwe ngo mukuni wa mpaanga,

english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
translation: Abasenda bwino bwino, bakaana no kukwata umwenso,

english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
translation: Asuka abafisha mu calo cakwe icamushilo,

english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
translation: Atamfyamo abaleikalamo ilyo abantu bakwe baleyamo,

english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
translation: Nomba bakaana ukunakila Lesa,

english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
translation: Bamusangukila baleka no kumupetamina,

english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
translation: Bamukalifya umutima palwa ncende ishakupepelamo isho bacindika,

english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
translation: Ilyo Lesa aumfwile afulwa nganshi,

english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
translation: Pakuti abakulakonkapo nabo bafishiba,

english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
translation: Afuma na mwi Tenti lyakwe ilyali ku Shilo,

english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
translation: Aleka abalwani baisa tapa Imbokoshi ya Cipangano,

english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
translation: Epakufulilwa abantu bakwe nganshi,

english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
translation: Abalumendo babo bafwa ku mulilo

english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
translation: Bashimapepo babo babepaya ku lupanga,

english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
translation: Elyo Yawe aima ngo wafuma mu tulo,

english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
translation: Apuma na balwani nabo babwelelamo,

english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
translation: Lyena, asuula insakwe sha bamwana Yosefu,

english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
translation: Lelo asalapo uluko lwakwa Yuda,

english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
translation: Epo aya kuula ne ŋanda yakwe iyamushilo,

english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
translation: Epakuti bakaletetekela Lesa,

english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
translation: Elyo asala umubomfi wakwe Davidi,

english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
translation: Amufumya kukucema utwana twa mpaanga,

english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
translation: Nao Davidi epakubika umutima wacishinka pakucema abantu,

english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
translation: Nokuti bekaba nga bashibo,

english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
translation: Abena Efulemu nelyo baipangeshe amata ne mifwi,

english: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
translation: We Lesa, ala abenafyalo nabasansa icalo ca bantu bobe,

english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
translation: Nga cinshi imishobo ingalasosela aiti

english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
translation: Uleke ukulila kwa bafungwa kumfwike kuli iwe,

english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
translation: We Yawe umusaalula onse uo abena mupalamano besu bakucitila,

english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
translation: Elyo ifwe fwe bantu bobe, fwe mukuni wa bucemi bobe,

english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
translation: Bapeele ifitumbi fya bantu bobe ku fyuni pakuti filelya,

english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
translation: Nabasumya umulopa wa bantu nga menshi ukushinguluka Yerusalemu,

english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
translation: Natuba abasebana ku bena mupalamano besu,

english: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
translation: Bushe kufika lilali we Yawe?

english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
translation: Shifulilwa abantu ba mishobo abashikupepa,

english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
translation: pantu nabepaulula Yakobo,

english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
translation: Witubika pakukandwa pa bubifi bwa fikolwe fyesu,

english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
translation: Sotwafweko we Lesa, we Mupusushi wesu,

english: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
translation: We Yawe Lesa wandi, ni muli iwe mfisama,

english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
translation: Ubucingo bwandi ni Lesa Uwapulamo,

english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
translation: Lesa ni kapingula uwalungama,

english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
translation: Nga cakuti umuntu tapilibwike,

english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
translation: Apekanya ifyanso fyakwe ifyakwipailako,

english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
translation: Umuntu uwaisulamo ububifi mwifumo lyakwe,

english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
translation: Umuntu uwimba ubucinga,

english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
translation: Ifyongo fintu aleta, fikamwalukila,

english: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
translation: Nakulatotela Yawe pa mulandu wa bulungami bwakwe,

english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
translation: Epali bandepaula nge nkalamo,

english: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
translation: We Yawe Lesa wandi, ine nga cakuti nalilufyanya,

english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
translation: nga cakuti nalibifya ku muntu munandi uwakaele,

english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
translation: leka umulwani uyu ansupile,

english: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
translation: We Yawe ima mu bukali bobe,

english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
translation: Leka imitundu ya bantu bonse balongane ukukushinguluka,

english: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
translation: Lekeni Yawe apingule imitundu ya bantu,

english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
translation: Pwisha ubunkalwe bwa bantu ababifi,

english: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
translation: We mucemi wa bena Israeli wingatumfwa,

english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
translation: Icintelelwe ca mwangashi calakupa pa mulu wa mpili,

english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
translation: Imisambo yauko yayandalala ukufika kuli Bemba,

english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
translation: Nga kanshi cinshi ico wabongolwela ifibumba fya mwangashi,

english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
translation: Na bakapoli ba mu mpanga baleonaula

english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
translation: We Lesa umwine wa fita ala ubwelele kuli ifwe,

english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
translation: uyo uo we mwine walimbile no kuboko kobe ukwa ku kulyo,

english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
translation: Nabatema umwangashi obe, baoca na mu mulilo.

english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
translation: Uleke ukuboko kobe kube pa muntu wa ku kulyo kobe,

english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
translation: Ifwe tatwakatale atukusangukila nakabili iyoo,

english: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
translation: Utubwekeshe mufyo twali we Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
translation: Uisokolole ku nko sha bena Efulemu, abena Benjamini na bena Manase,

english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
translation: Utubwekeshe mufyo twali we Yawe,

english: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
translation: We Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
translation: Amacushi e cakulya ico wabapeela ukulalya,

english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
translation: Kabili walenga na bena mupalamano besu baleumanina icalo cesu,

english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
translation: Utubweseshe mufyo twali we Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
translation: Niwe walimbwile umwangashi mu Egupto,

english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
translation: Walautungwila pakuti ulekula bwino,

english: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
translation: Imbeni ne nsansa kuli Lesa uwaba amaka yesu,

english: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
translation: “Nomba abantu bandi bena balikaana ifyo mbeba,

english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
translation: Kanshi eico ine nimbalekako pakuti bashale abaumalala ifyo fine,

english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
translation: lyena nga kuti nacimfya abalwani babo bwangu,

english: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
translation: Elyo abapata Yawe, nga nabesa cimba,

english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
translation: Lelo abantu bandi bena nga kuti ine nabalisha ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwapeleka bwino,

english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
translation: Samuneni ulwimbo, mulelisha ne nsombo,

english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
translation: Lisheni ipenga pa kutampa kwa mweshi,

english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
translation: Pantu e funde lya muno calo ca Israeli,

english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
translation: Eco akonkomeshe nge cebo kuli Yosefu,

english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
translation: Alesosa ati, “Ala nine namutulileko ifisendo fyenu ifyafina pa mabeya yenu,

english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
translation: Mwalikuutile ilyo mwalecula,

english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
translation: “Umfweni mwe bantu bandi, lekeni musoke,

english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
translation: Mwilaba ne milungu imbi,

english: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
translation: Lesa euteeka icilye ca lukuta ulukalamba,

english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
translation: “Bushe imwe mukaleka lilali ukulapondamika imilandu pakupingula,

english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
translation: Mulepokololako abalanda na bakashiwa,

english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
translation: Mulepokololako abalanda na bacushi,

english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
translation: “Tabaishiba nangu cimo kabili tabailuka nakalya,

english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
translation: “Limo nalimwebele nati,

english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
translation: Lelo mukafwa nga bantufye,

english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
translation: Ima we Lesa upingule isonde,

english: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
translation: Witalala tondolo we Lesa,

english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
translation: Abalobele pa Eni Dori,

english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
translation: Ucitile abakalamba babo ukuba nga Orebu na Seebu,

english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
translation: Abatile abati,

english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
translation: Ubolule nga kankungwe we Lesa wandi,

english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
translation: Filya umulilo oca umutengo,

english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
translation: efyo ubakunkunike kuli kankungwe,

english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.
translation: Uleke insoni shibawe pa menso,

english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
translation: Uleke babe ne nsoni pe no mwenso uukalamba,

english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
translation: Uleke beshibe ukuti niwe weka uwitwa ishina lya Yawe,

english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
translation: Pantu mona abalwani bobe ifyo balulunkene,

english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
translation: Balepangana ifyakucita abantu bobe mu bucenjeshi,

english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
translation: “Iseni tulofye umushobo wabo,

english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
translation: Bapangana no mutima umo,

english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
translation: E bena Edomu, na bena Ishimaeli,

english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
translation: pamo pene na bena Gebali, abena Amoni, abena Amaleki,

english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
translation: Na bena Asria bene nabampana nabo,

english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
translation: Ubacite ifyo wacitile abena Midiani,

english: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
translation: Yangu icifulo cobe ubusuma,

english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
translation: Ubushiku bumo bwawamishapo mwisano lyobe,

english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
translation: Pantu Yawe Lesa e kasuba ne nkwela,

english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
translation: We Yawe umwine wa fita,

english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
translation: Umweo wandi ulefuluka,

english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
translation: Uluseba nalupanga iŋanda,

english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
translation: Balishuka abekala mu ŋanda yobe,

english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
translation: Balishuka abantu abo amaka yabo yaba muli iwe,

english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
translation: Ilyo bena bapita mu mukonko wa ku Baka,

english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
translation: Amaka yabo yalacililako,

english: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
translation: Umfwe ipepo lyandi we Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita,

english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
translation: Uloleshe pa nkwela yesu, we Lesa,

english: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
translation: Walipaala icalo cobe we Yawe,

english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
translation: Icitemwiko icishipwa ne cishinka nafisuntinkana,

english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
translation: Icishinka nacimena pano isonde,

english: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
translation: Ifintu ifisuma efyo Yawe aletupeela,

english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
translation: Ubulungami ebwakulatangilila Yawe pantanshi,

english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
translation: Abantu bobe naubabelelako uluse kufyo babifya,

english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
translation: Nauleka no kulabakalipila,

english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
translation: Utubwekeshe kufyo twali, we Lesa Umupusushi wesu,

english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
translation: Bushe wakulatufulilwafye pe?

english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
translation: Bushe ekuti tawakabwekeshepo ukutupuputula,

english: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.
translation: Tulange icitemwiko cobe icishipwa we Yawe,

english: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
translation: Ine ndekutika kufyo Lesa Yawe alelanda,

english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
translation: Icine cine ipusukilo lyakwe lyalipalamina abamutiina,

english: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
translation: Unkutike we Lesa kabili unjasuke,

english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
translation: Pantu uli wabulamba, Lesa uucita ifipapwa,

english: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
translation: We Yawe umfunde inshila yobe

english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
translation: Ine nakulakulumbanya no mutima wandi onse we Mfumu Lesa wandi,

english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
translation: Pantu ukutemwa kobe kuli ine kukalamba nganshi,

english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
translation: Nashinjimina inkakashi sha bantu we Lesa,

english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
translation: Lelo iwe we Mfumu uli Lesa waluse ne cikuku,

english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
translation: Walukile kuli ine no kumbelela uluse,

english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
translation: Nangilila icakumwenako ca busuma bobe we Yawe,

english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
translation: Ubake umweo wandi pantu naliipeelesha kuli iwe,

english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
translation: Umbeleleko uluse we Mfumu,

english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
translation: Nsansamushako ine ne mubomfi obe we Mfumu,

english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
translation: Uli wamutembo, kabili ulabelela uluse we Mfumu,

english: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
translation: Kutika kwipepo lyandi we Yawe,

english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
translation: Pa bushiku nkacula nkalilila kuli iwe,

english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
translation: We Yawe ala takwaba Lesa umbi uwaba nga iwe,

english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
translation: Imishobo yonse iyo wabumba yakulaisa mukupepa pa cinso cobe we Mfumu,

english: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
translation: Atantika umufula wakwe pa lupili lwakwe ulwamushilo.

english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
translation: Yawe alitemwisha impongolo sha Sioni,

english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
translation: Ifintu ifyalulumbi fyalilandwa pali iwe,

english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
translation: “Ilyo ine nkalatantika abantu ba mishobo abampetamina,

english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
translation: Mu cine pali Sioni bakalalandapo ukuti,

english: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
translation: Yawe akalemba amashina ya aba bantu mu citabo akatila,

english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
translation: Ilyo bakapanga inyimbo bakalaimba abati,

english: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
translation: We Yawe, Lesa umupusushi wandi,

english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
translation: Bushe ulacitila abafwa ifisungusho?

english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
translation: Bushe mu nindi balalandapo pa citemwiko cobe?

english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
translation: Bushe ifipeshamano fyobe filamoneka umwafiita?

english: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
translation: Lelo ni kuli iwe we Yawe ndilila pakuti ungafwe,

english: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
translation: Bushe nga cinshi ico ine wankaanina we Yawe,

english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
translation: Naba uwacula ukufuma ku bwaice bwandi, ukupalama na ku mfwa,

english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
translation: Ubukali bobe nabumponena,

english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
translation: Akasuba konse filashinguluka nge lyeshi,

english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
translation: Niwe ulengele abatemwikwa ne fibusa fyandi ukuntaluka,

english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
translation: Leka ipepo lyandi lifike uko uli,

english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
translation: Pantu umutima wandi wiswilemo amacushi,

english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
translation: Ine bampendele pali balya bonse abali mupepi na ku nindi,

english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
translation: Ndi uwapatwilwa ku bafwa,

english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
translation: Naumposa panshi ya nindi,

english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
translation: Ubukali bobe nabuntitikisha,

english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
translation: Naulenga ifibusa fyandi ukutaluka ukufuma kuli ine,

english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.
translation: na menso yandi nayanaka kukucula.

english: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
translation: Nakulalumbanya ubukulu bwa citemwiko cobe icishipwa, we Yawe,

english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
translation: Niwe waonawile Rahabu , kwati untu uwafwile,

english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
translation: Yangu ifyo ukuboko kobe kwaba na maka,

english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
translation: Ubulungami no mulinganya e mufula wa cipuna ca bufumu bobe,

english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
translation: Balishuka abantu abakwawila utupundu,

english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
translation: Bena bakulasansamuka akasuba konse mwishina lyobe,

english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
translation: Pantu niwe bucindami bwabo kabili amaka yabo,

english: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
translation: Icine cine inkwela yesu yaba na iwe we Yawe,

english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
translation: Pa nshita imo walandile mu fimonwa

english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
translation: Ine nkalanda palwa citemwiko cobe icashimpwa pe na pe,

english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
translation: Ninsanga umubomfi wandi Davidi,

english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
translation: Ukuboko kwandi ukwamaka ekukamulenga ukubomba,

english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
translation: Imili 13:22

english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
translation: Nkonaula abalwani bakwe pa menso yakwe,

english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
translation: Bucishinka bwandi ne citemwiko candi fikalaba nankwe,

english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
translation: Nine nkabika ubufumu bwakwe ukufika kuli bemba,

english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
translation: Ena akulanjita ati, ‘Niwe tata, kabili niwe Lesa wandi,

english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
translation: Euli nokuba ibeli lyandi,

english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
translation: Nakulamukwatila icitemwiko pe,

english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
translation: Bamwane ebakulatwalilila ukuba pa bufumu pe,

english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
translation: Pantu walisosele auti, “Ine nalipangana icipangano no wasalwa wandi,

english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
translation: Imili 2:30

english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
translation: Nga cakuti baonaula ifipope fyandi,

english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
translation: awe ninshi lyena ine nakulaboma ku nkonto palwa bubi bwabo.

english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
translation: Lelo nshakafumye ukutemwa kwandi pali ena,

english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
translation: Ine nshakonaule icipangano candi nankwe,

english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
translation: Nalilala nalilapa ine ne wamushilo ukuti,

english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
translation: Ubufyashi bwakwe buli nokutwalilila inshita yonse,

english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
translation: Cikabelelela pe ngo mweshi,

english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
translation: Lelo iwe naumufumyako amano no kumusuula,

english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
translation: Naonaula icipangano wapangene no mubomfi obe,

english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
translation: ‘Bamwane ebakalatwalilila ukuba pa bufumu umuyayaya,

english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
translation: Nuwisha ifibumba fyonse,

english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
translation: Bonse abalepitapo baleiba ifyuma fyakwe,

english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
translation: Niwe upeela abalwani bakwe amaka,

english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
translation: Niwe ulengele ulupanga lwakwe ukufupa,

english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
translation: Niwe ufumishepo ubucindami bwakwe,

english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
translation: Naulenga nokuti inshiku sha bulumendo bwakwe shipipe,

english: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
translation: Bushe kufika lilali we Yawe uli nokwikala uwabelama inshita yonse?

english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
translation: Ibukisha ukuti ubumi bwandi tabwatantalila we Yawe,

english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
translation: Bushe nani engabelelela uwingakaana ukufwa,

english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
translation: Bushe icitemwiko icikulu icantanshi nomba cili kwi we Mfumu?

english: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
translation: Mu mulu balakulumbanya palwa fipapwa fyobe, we Yawe,

english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
translation: Ibukisha ifyo balensausha ne mubomfi obe we Mfumu,

english: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
translation: Abalwani ala tepakunsausha we Yawe,

english: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
translation: Yawe apaalwe na matotelo pe na pe. Ameni kabili ameni.

english: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,
translation: Nga nani pa ba mu mulu uwingalinganishiwa kuli Yawe?

english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
translation: Pebumba lya bamushilo, Lesa balimukwatila akatiina,

english: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.
translation: We Yawe Lesa umwine wa fita, ni nani uwaba nga iwe?

english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
translation: Niwe unasha ukutulumana kwa menshi ya pali bemba,

english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
translation: We Yawe, we mfumu yesu,

english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
translation: Ku tunwa twa twaice no twa kwibele,

english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
translation: Ntila nga nalolesha imyulu iyo wapanga ne minwe yobe,

english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
translation: Ntila ngo muntunse wanshi uwakuti ulemutontonkanyapo?

english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
translation: Lelo walimulenga ukuti abe uwacepapo panono pali Lesa ,

english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
translation: Walimupeela amaka ayakuteeka ifintu fyonse ifyo wabumba,

english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
translation: pa mpaanga ne ŋombe shonse,

english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
translation: pa fyuni fya mu lwelele na pesabi ilyaba muli bemba,

english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
translation: We Yawe, we mfumu yesu,

english: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
translation: Apo inkulo shabelako we Yawe,

english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
translation: Inshita ya bumi bwesu ibafye imyaka amakumi cine lubali (70),

english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
translation: Bushe nani engeshiba apapelela ubukali bwa cipyu cobe,

english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
translation: Eico uletufundako pakuti twaishiba bwino ubwipi bwa nshiku shesu,

english: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
translation: We Yawe uleshikatalako. Bushe ici kuti capelela kwisa?

english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
translation: Utulenge ukusekelela ukutemwa kobe ukushipwa cila lucelo,

english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
translation: Uleke inshiku shesu ishakusansamukamo

english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
translation: Leka ababomfi bobe bamone ifyo ulebabombela,

english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
translation: Uleke uluse lobe we Yawe lwise pali ifwe,

english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
translation: Ilyo impili tashilabumbwa,

english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
translation: Ulabwesesha abantu ku lukungu, walanda nokuti,

english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
translation: Pantu imyaka ikana limo (1,000) mu menso yobe

english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
translation: Ulakululula abantu mu nda ya tulo twa mfwa,

english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
translation: uwakuti akacelo cilya wamena no kululumuka,

english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
translation: Nefwe efyo ubukali bobe butucita,

english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
translation: Pet 3:8

english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
translation: Inshita ya bumi bwesu ulaipifya pa mulandu wa cipyu cobe,

english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
translation: Uyo onse uwikala mu nsakwe yakwa Lesa mukulu

english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
translation: kanshi teti kube nelyo cimo icakukuponena,

english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
translation: Pantu ena akakonkomesha bamalaika bakwe ukulakubaka,

english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
translation: Bakalakusendela mu minwe yabo,

english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
translation: Ukalanyanta pa nkalamo na pali ngoshe,

english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
translation: Lesa aleti, “Ine nakulamupusushako pantu antemwa,

english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
translation: Ilyo alilila kuli ine nakulamwasuka,

english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
translation: Ine ndi nokumwikusha pakutantalisha ne nshiku shakwe ishakwikala pano calo,

english: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
translation: Nkalalanda palwakwa Yawe nati,

english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
translation: Ala ali nokukupususha ku busanso bonse ubo ushenekele,

english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
translation: Akulakukupa amasako ya mapindo yakwe,

english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
translation: Tawakulatiina nangu cimo mu nshita ya bushiku,

english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
translation: nangu icikuko icipita ubushiku,

english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
translation: Nangu bambi ikana limo (1,000) bawile uku noku,

english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
translation: Uli nokulamonafye na menso yobe,

english: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
translation: Nga wacita Yawe ukuba ilinga lyobe,

english: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
translation: Ala cintu icisuma ukulumba Yawe,

english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
translation: Walitumpula ulusengo lwandi ngo mulume wa mboo,

english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
translation: Amenso yandi nayamona ukucimba kwa balwani bandi,

english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
translation: Abalungami bena bakulalelema ngo tuncindu,

english: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
translation: Bena baba nge miti iyalimbwa mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe,

english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
translation: Baba nge miti iyitwala ifitwalo na pa nshita yabukote,

english: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
translation: Epakulanga ukuti Yawe alikwata umulinganya.

english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
translation: Ukulatatakula icitemwiko cobe icishipwa cila lucelo,

english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
translation: Ukulakulumbila mu nsango yabushipa ikumi limo,

english: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
translation: Pantu ine tepakusansamuka ku ficitwa fyobe we Yawe,

english: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
translation: Yangu ifintu ubukulu ifyo wacita we Yawe,

english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
translation: Umuntu icipuba tapaba ico aishiba,

english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
translation: Icakuti nangu abantu babi bengafula nge cani,

english: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
translation: Lelo we Yawe walisumbulwa umuyayaya.

english: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
translation: Pantu cine cine we Yawe abalwani bobe bakaloba,

english: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
translation: Yawe euteeka ninshi nafwala ne fyabucindami,

english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
translation: Ubufumu bobe bwatendeke ukufuma ku kale nganshi,

english: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
translation: Amenshi ya muli bemba yayamba ukwima we Yawe,

english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
translation: Nomba walikwatisha amaka,

english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
translation: Ifipope fyobe fyacishinka nganshi,

english: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
translation: We Yawe, niwe Lesa uulandula,

english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
translation: Bushe uukalipila imishobo teti akande?

english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
translation: Yawe ewishiba ifitontonkanya abantu,

english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
translation: Alishuka umuntu uo usalapula we Yawe,

english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
translation: Ekumulenga aleikala tondolo mu nshita shakucula,
