english: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
translation: Yawe tekuti alekeleshe abantu bakwe,

english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
translation: Ubupingushi bukakonka pa micitile iyabulungami,

english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
translation: Nga nani uwingangafwa pakumpokako ku babifi?

english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
translation: Abula Yawe ukungafwilishako,

english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
translation: Ilyo nasosele nati, “Iye nalapona,”

english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
translation: Ilyo amasakamiko yafulisha muli ine,

english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
translation: Ima, we kapingula wa bantu bonse,

english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
translation: Bushe icipuna ca bufumfutungu kuti caampana na iwe,

english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
translation: Balekatana pakupingula abakaele,

english: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
translation: Lelo Yawe ewaisa ba ilinga lyandi,

english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
translation: Akabakanda pa fibi fyonse ifyo bacita,

english: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
translation: Bushe ababifi uko bakapela ni kwi we Yawe?

english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
translation: Balabwabwata no kulanda amashiwi ayabi,

english: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
translation: We Yawe bacilamo ukunyantilila abantu bobe,

english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
translation: Bepaya bamukamfwilwa na beni,

english: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
translation: Bena balanda ati, “Yawe tatumona nakalya,

english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
translation: Cenjeleni imwe mwe bantu abashakwata mano,

english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
translation: Bushe kuti uwapangile ukutwi ewafilwa ukumfwa?

english: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
translation: Iseni tulumbanye Yawe, tumwimbile ne nsansa,

english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
translation: Pa myaka amakumi yane (40) ilya nkulo tepakunselausha ku mukoshi,

english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
translation: Elyo ine nafulwa, no kulapa nati, “Napalifye ine,

english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
translation: Natwise tumutotele pa cinso cakwe,

english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
translation: Pantu Yawe e Lesa mukulu wine,

english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
translation: E mwine uwapanga imikonko ya pano isonde,

english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
translation: E mwine uwapanga bemba,

english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
translation: Iseni tuicefye no kumupepa,

english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
translation: Pantu e Lesa wesu,

english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
translation: mwilatalamika imitima yenu nga filya mwacitile ku Meriba,

english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
translation: Kulya ifikolwe fyenu fyalenjesha no kunsonsomba,

english: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
translation: Imbileni Yawe ulwimbo ulupya,

english: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
translation: Landeni pakati ka mishobo ati, “Yawe euteeka.”

english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
translation: Lekeni imyulu isansamuke, ne sonde lisekelele,

english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
translation: Lekeni mu mpanga mube ukwanga, pamo ne fintu fyonse ifyabamo,

english: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
translation: Nabaleimba ku ntanshi yakwa Yawe, pantu naisa,

english: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
translation: Muleimbila Yawe, kabili mulelumbanya ishina lyakwe,

english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
translation: Mulesabankanya ubucindami bwakwe mu mishobo yonse,

english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
translation: Pantu Yawe alipulamisha kabili ewalinga ukulumbanya,

english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
translation: Pantu imilungu yonse iya mishobo tulubifye,

english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
translation: Ubucindami no bupulami fyaba pa cinso cakwe,

english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa bwa bulamba bwakwa Yawe mwe ndupwa sha mishobo,

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
translation: Mulelondolola ubulumbwa ubwalinga ishina lyakwa Yawe,

english: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
translation: Mulepepa Yawe mu bucindami bwa mushilo wakwe,

english: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
translation: Yawe euteeka, lekeni aba pano isonde basansamuke,

english: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
translation: Lekeni bonse abatemwa Yawe bapate ifyabipa,

english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
translation: Ulubuuto lulasanikila pa balungama,

english: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
translation: Imwe mwe bololoke mulesansamukila muli Yawe,

english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
translation: Amakumbi ne mfifi iyikalamba fyalimushinguluka,

english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
translation: Umulilo eutangilila uko aleya,

english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
translation: Ukubyata kwa mfula ekusanika isonde lyonse,

english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
translation: Impili shisunguluka nge pula pa menso yakwa Yawe,

english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
translation: Imyulu ilalangilila ubulungami bwakwe,

english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
translation: Bonse abapepa ifimpashanya fya milungu balalengwa insoni,

english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
translation: Sioni naumfwako kabili aleanga,

english: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
translation: Pantu we Yawe, niwe Lesa mukulu uwacila fyonse ifya pano isonde,

english: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
translation: Imbileni Yawe ulwimbo ulupya

english: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
translation: Yawe nalanga apabuuta ipusukilo lyakwe ukwishibikwa,

english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translation: Alibukisha icitemwiko cakwe ne cishinka cakwe kuba ŋanda yakwa Israeli,

english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
translation: Akwawileni Yawe mwe sonde lyonse,

english: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
translation: Akulisheni iseese pakwimbila Yawe inyimbo,

english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
translation: Akulisheni amapenga no kupuuta mu nsengo,

english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
translation: Lekeni bemba alepoma pamo na fyonse ifyabamo,

english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
translation: Imimana yonse yambe ukutota,

english: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
translation: Lekeni bembe pa cinso cakwa Yawe,

english: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
translation: Yawe euteeka,

english: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
translation: Yawe mukulu mu Sioni,

english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
translation: Lekeni balelumbanya ishina lyobe ilikulu pantu lyalipulama.

english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
translation: Imfumu eyamaka, kabili eyatemwa umulinganya.

english: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
translation: Akulumbanyeni Yawe Lesa wesu,

english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
translation: Mose na Aroni bali ni bashimapepo bakwa Lesa,

english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
translation: Alelanda nabo ninshi ali mu ntumba ye kumbi,

english: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
translation: We Yawe, Lesa wesu, waleasuka abantu bobe,

english: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
translation: Akulumbanyeni Yawe Lesa wesu,

english: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
translation: Nakulakulumbanya we Yawe no mutima wandi onse,

english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
translation: Abantu abaishiba ishina lyobe balakucetekela,

english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
translation: Imbeni isha malumbo kuli Yawe uuteeka mu Sioni,

english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
translation: Ico ena uulandula pakusumya umulopa talaba abalecula,

english: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
translation: Unangulukileko ine we Yawe,

english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
translation: pakuti nkalumbule amalumbo yobe ku mwana mwanakashi Sioni,

english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
translation: Imishobo naiponena mu cilindi ico abene baimbile,

english: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
translation: Yawe nailangisha pafyo acitile ubupingushi,

english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
translation: Ababifi babwelela ku calo ca bafwa,

english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
translation: Lelo abalanda tabakalabwe,

english: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
translation: Ima, we Yawe, wileka ukuti umuntufye eo acimfye.

english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
translation: Nakulasangalala pamo no kusekelela muli iwe,

english: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
translation: We Yawe leka abantu bakukwatile akatiina,

english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
translation: Ilyo abalwani bandi bafulumuka,

english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
translation: Wampingula no kunsanga uwakaele,

english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
translation: Wakalipila imishobo no konaula ababifi,

english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
translation: Abalwani bena nabalala nabalobelela,

english: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
translation: Lelo icipuna cakwa Yawe ca pe na pe,

english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
translation: Akapingula abantu bonse mu bulungami,

english: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
translation: Muli Yawe emwakufisama abantu abacucutika,

english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
translation: Elyo namona malaika umbi uwamaka aleika ukufuma mu mulu naikubanya ne kumbi no mukolamfula uli pa mulu wa mutwe wakwe. Impumi yakwe yena ilebengeshima kwati kasuba, ne mikonso yakwe kwati ni nceshi ishilebilima no mulilo.

english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
translation: Awe napoka akatabo kuli malaika, nalya no kulya. Mu kanwa kaumfwika akalowa kwati buci, lelo lilya nakamina mu mala yandi mwena kayaluka, kalula nganshi.

english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
translation: Ukuf 20:11

english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
translation: Mu minwe yakwe mwena ninshi ekete akatabo akanono akakupukulwa. Ulukasa lwakwe ulwa ku kulyo anyantile pali bemba, elyo ulukasa lwakwe ulwa ku kuso lwena anyantile pa mulundu.

english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
translation: Elyo apunda ne shiwi ilikalamba kwati ni nkalamo ilebuluma. Cilya apunda ifyo, ukupanta cine lubali ukwa mfula kwaumfwika.

english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”
translation: Ilyo ukupanta cine lubali ukwa mfula kwaleka, nalafwaya ukulalemba. Lelo naumfwa ishiwi ukufuma ku mulu aliti, “Ufisunge mu nkaama ifyo ukupanta cine lubali ukwa mfula kusosele, wilemba iyoo!”

english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky
translation: Elyo malaika nacimona anyantile ulukasa lumo pali bemba no lubiye pa mulundu, aimisha mu mulu ukuboko kwa kulyo.

english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
translation: Elyo alapa Lesa uwakubelelela pe na pe, uwabumba umulu, icalo, bemba na fyonse ifyaba muli ifi fintu, atila nokuti, “Nomba inshita naipwa!

english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.
translation: Dan 12:7

english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
translation: Elyo ishiwi nacumfwa ukufuma ku mulu lyanjeba nakabili aliti, “Kabiye kabule akatabo akakupukulwa akali mu minwe yakwa malaika uunyantile ulukasa lumo pali bemba no lubiye pa mulundu.”

english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
translation: Awe naima naya kuli malaika namulomba ukuti ampeele akatabo. Nao anjeba ati, “Kabule, ukalye. Mu kanwa mwena kalelowa kwati buci, lelo mu mala kalelula.”

english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.
translation: Elyo bampeela itete ilyapala inkonto iyakupiminako ifintu. Banjeba abati, “Kabiye upime itempele lyakwa Lesa no bulambo, upende na bantu abapepamo.

english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
translation: Abantu ba pano calo bakasansamuka pa mulandu wa mfwa sha aba bantu babili. Bakasefya no kupeeleshanya ifyabupe pa mulandu wakuti aba bakasesema babili baletele amacushi pa bantu ba pa calo.

english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
translation: Elyo bakasesema balya babili baumfwa ishiwi ilikalamba ukufuma mu mulu lilebeba aliti, “Iseni kuno!” Awe baya na ku mulu mwikumbi, ninshi na balwani babo balemonako.

english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
translation: Elyo pa nshita iyo ine kwaisa icinkukuma icikalamba. Icipande cimo pa fipande ikumi ifya musumba cabongoloka, na bantu amakana cine lubali (7,000) bafwa ku cinkukuma. Elyo abapuswikeko baikatwa no mwenso, balalumbanya na Lesa wa mu mulu.

english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.
translation: Kanshi ishamo lyabubili lyapita, lelo ilyabutatu lyalaisafye bwangu bwangu.

english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
translation: Elyo malaika walenga cine lubali nao alisha ipenga lyakwe. Mu mulu mwaumfwika amashiwi ayakalamba yaleti, “Ubufumu bwa pano isonde bwayaluka bwaba ubwa Mfumu yesu na Kristu wakwe, kabili eukalateeka pe na pe.”

english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
translation: Elyo abakalamba amakumi yabili na bane abekala pa fipuna fyabufumu pa cinso cakwa Lesa, bafukama, bainamina panshi, balapepa Lesa.

english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
translation: Ukuf 5:18

english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
translation: Elyo itempele lyakwa Lesa ilya mu mulu lyaisuka, ne Mbokoshi ya cipangano cakwe yalamoneka mukati ke tempele lyakwe! Elyo imyele ya nkuba yalabyata, calabulukuta no kubulukuta, kwaisa no kupanta kwa mfula, ne cinkukuma, ne mfula iya mabwe iyingi nganshi.

english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
translation: Lelo ulubansa lwa kunse ye tempele lwena ulushe, wilupima. Pantu ulu lubansa lwena balupeela ku Benafyalo, pakuti baleyendelafye abene mu musumba wamushilo pa myeshi amakumi yane na ibili (42).

english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
translation: Esek 40:3

english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.
translation: Aba bakambone babili e miti ya Miolifa ibili, kabili efyakutekapo ifisaniko fibili ifyaba pa cinso ca Mfumu ya calo.

english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
translation: Umo nga afwaya ukubacusha, umulilo uwafuma mu tunwa twabo waipaya abalwani babo. Kabili na onse uwingafwaya ukubacusha, bakulamwipaila mu musango umo wine.

english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
translation: Mu nshita iyo, ilyo bacili balesesema amashiwi yakwa Lesa, balikwata amaka yakwisala umulu, ne mfula yafilwa ukuloka. Kabili balikwata na maka yakwalula amenshi ukuba umulopa. Balikwata na maka yakuposa icikuko ca musango onse pa calo lyonse ilyo balefwaya.

english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.
translation: Nomba ilyo bakapwisha ukupeela bukambone bwabo, elyo iciswango cikafuma mu muyenge kukwisa balwisha. Cikesa bacimfya no kubepaya.

english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
translation: Sam 4:8

english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
translation: Esaya 1:9-10

english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
translation: Elyo mu mulu mwamoneka icishibilo cacipeshamano ica mwanakashi, uufwele akasuba. Amakasa yakwe yanyantile pa mweshi, elyo ku mutwe afwele icisote cabufumu ica ntanda ikumi limo na shibili.

english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.
translation: Dan 8:10

english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
translation: Bamunyinefwe bacimfishe Ciwa ku maka ya mulopa wa Mwana wa Mpanga

english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”
translation: Kanshi sansamukeni, mwe myulu na imwe mwe bekalamo!

english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
translation: Uyu mwanakashi epakumupeela amapindo yabili aya cikapumpe icikalamba ayakuti apupukileko pakuya ku ncende yakwe mu matololo. Kuli iyi ncende eko akasungwa pa mwaka umo, imyaka ibili na umbi pakati pakumupususha ku cisoka.

english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
translation: Elyo ku kanwa ka cisoka kwapongoloka amenshi kwati mumana, ukulola ukuli umwanakashi pakuti asendwe no mukuku wa menshi.

english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.
translation: Lelo umushili wayafwilishako umwanakashi. Wayasama wamina umumana walepongoloka ku kanwa ka cisoka.

english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.
translation: Icisoka epakufulilwa umwanakashi. Caima caya na mukulalwisha abana ba mwanakashi bambi bonse. Aba bantu e abo abasunga amafunde yakwa Lesa, kabili ababa bakambone aba pa mashiwi yakwa Yesu.

english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
translation: Ali pa bukulu, nakomwa ne fumo, alekuuta no kukuuta ico aleumfwa ubukali ubwa pakupapa.

english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
translation: Kabili mu mulu mwamoneka icishibilo cacipeshamano cimbi ica cisoka icakashika icikulu nganshi, ica mitwe cine lubali ne nsengo ikumi limo. Kabili pali cila mutwe, nacifwala icisote cabufumu.

english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
translation: Elyo ku mucila waciko cakululula icipande cimo pa fipande fitatu ifya ntanda mu mulu, cashiponesha na pa calo. Kabili icisoka caisa iminina na pantanshi ya mwanakashi ilyo ali mukupapa, pakuti nga apapa cilye umwana.

english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.
translation: Awe umwanakashi apapa umwana mwaume uwakukwata amaka yakuteeka imishobofye yonse ne nkonto ya cela mu minwe. Lelo umwana baisa musompola, bamutwala na ku cipuna cakwa Lesa umwine.

english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
translation: Umwanakashi wena afulumukila ku matololo ku ncende iyo Lesa amuteyanishishe. Kuli iyi ncende eko ali nokusungwa pa nshiku ikana limo ne myanda ibili na makumi mutanda, 1,260.

english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
translation: Dan 7:7

english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
translation: Icisoka na bamalaika baciko abasangu tabakwete amaka, babatamfya, te bakumona icifulo mu mulu nakalya.

english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
translation: Amalu 2:9

english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.
translation: Elyo namona iciswango cilefuma muli bemba. Cikwete insengo ikumi limo ne mitwe cine lubali. Cila lusengo luli ne cisote cabufumu. Pali cila mutwe waciko palembelwe ishina lyakusaalula Lesa.

english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
translation: “Uyo onse uuli nokusendwa bunkole,

english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
translation: Ici ciswango cabubili calabomfya amaka yakuteeka aya ciswango capakubala pa malo yaciko. Calapatikisha na bantu bonse aba pano calo ukulapepa iciswango cakubalilapo, icali ne cibala ca cilonda.

english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.
translation: Iciswango cabubili naco calacita ifishibilo fyacipeshamano ifikalamba nganshi. Calenga no mulilo ukupona ukufuma ku mulu, ninshi na bantu balemonako.

english: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.
translation: Cabepaika na bantu bonse abekala pa calo mukubomfya ifipeshamano casuminishiwe ukucita pa cinso ca ciswango cakubalilapo. Iciswango cabubili caeba abantu ba pano calo ukubumba icilubi icakucindikilako iciswango cakubalilapo icakomenwe no lupanga lelo cali icumi.

english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.
translation: Iciswango cabubili casuminishiwa ukupuuta umupu wakupeela umweo mu cilubi ca ciswango cakubalilapo pakuti cilelanda, no kulenga ukuti baleipaya abo bonse abalekaana ukupepa icilubi ca ciswango.

english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;
translation: Iciswango cabubili capatikisha abantu bonse, abaice na bakalamba, abakankala na bapina, abasha na bantungwa, ukubabika icishibilo pa cisansa ca ku kulyo nangu pa mpumi shabo.

english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.
translation: Epakuti umuntu nelyo umo uushikwete ici cishibilo, emukutila ishina lya ciswango nangu icipendo ce shina lyaciko, tekuti ashite nangu ukushitisha

english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
translation: Apa pantu palefwaikwa ukuba na mano. Kanshi uwamano nasange umulolele icipendo ca ciswango, pantu icipendo cilelanga ishina lya muntu. Icipendo cakwe ni 666:

english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
translation: Ici ciswango namwene, mukumoneka cali kwati ni mbwili, lelo amakasa yaciko yali kwati cibea, elyo akanwa kaciko kwati kanwa ka nkalamo. Icisoka epakupeela iciswango amaka yaciko, icipuna cabufumu caiko, na maka yaciko yonse ayakuteeka.

english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.
translation: Dan 7:3

english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”
A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.
translation: Elyo iciswango capeelwa ukusosa amashiwi yakuitakisha no kusaalula Lesa. Kabili capeelwa na maka yakuteeka pa myeshi amakumi yane na ibili.

english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.
translation: Awe catendeka ukulasaalula Lesa, ishina lyakwe, incende ekalamo na bonse abekala mu mulu.

english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.
translation: Casuminishiwa ukulwisha abantu bamushilo no kubacimfya. Capeelwa na maka yakuteeka imitundu yonse, imishobo yonse, aba ndimi shonse ne mikowa yonse.

english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.
translation: Dan 7:8

english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
translation: Uuli na matwi, naomfwe!

english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
translation: Elyo nati ndoleshe, namona Umwana wa Mpanga eminine pa lupili lwa Sioni. Umwana wa Mpanga ali na bantu amakana umwanda umo na makanapo amakumi yane na yane (144,000). Aba bantu pa mpumi shabo palembelwe ishina lya Mwana wa Mpanga ne shina lyakwa Wishi.

english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
translation: ninshi uyo wena akanwa umwangashi wabukali bwakwa Lesa. Uyu mwangashi wa mu lukombo lwa bukali bwakwa Lesa untu wabula nokubikamo ifyakuunashako ubukali. Kabili akacushiwa mukumoca mu mulilo na mu fyanunka nga maluti pa cinso ca bamalaika bamushilo no Mwana wa Mpanga.”

english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
translation: Elyo icushi ca kucula kwabo cakubelelela pe. Abo bonse abapepa iciswango ne cilubi caciko, abo bonse basumina ukulembwa icishibilo ce shina lyaciko, takwakabe kupemwinako akasuba nelyo ubushiku.

english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”
translation: Kanshi ukushipikisha kulefwaikwa ku bantu bamushilo abasunga amafunde yakwa Lesa no kusumina muli Yesu.

english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
translation: Sefa 3:13

english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
translation: Elyo nati ndoleshe namona ikumbi ilyabuuta. Pali ili kumbi pekele umo uwapala Umwana wa muntu, afwele ne cisote cabufumu ica golide, na mu minwe yakwe ekete icikwakwa icatwa.

english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
translation: Elyo malaika umbi afuma mwitempele aikatisha ishiwi alabilikisha ku wikele pekumbi ati, “Tampa ukuseepa ne cikwakwa cobe, pantu inshita yakuseepa naifika, ifyakuseepa pa calo nafipya.”

english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
translation: Awe uwaikele pekumbi atendeka no kulaseepa pa calo, alobolola na fyonse ifyali nokuseepwa pa calo.

english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
translation: Esaya 51:17

english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
translation: Elyo malaika umbi uwangalila umulilo wa pa bulambo, afuma ku bulambo. Uyu malaika aikatisha ishiwi, alabilikisha kuli malaika uukwete icikwakwa icatwa, ati, “Bula icikwakwa cobe icatwa, putulako ifisansangu fyonse ifya myangashi ya pa calo, pantu imyangashi yaciko naipya.”

english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
translation: Elyo malaika atendeka ukuputula ifisansangu fya myangashi ya pano calo. Alonganya ifisansangu, afiposa na mu cakukaminamo umwangashi icikalamba ica bukali bwakwa Lesa.

english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
translation: Kabili naumfwa ishiwi ukufuma ku mulu, lileumfwika kwati kupooma kwa menshi, kabili kwati ni mfula ilepanta nganshi. Elyo ukumfwika kwena lileumfwika kwati lwimbo lwa bakalisha wa maseese ilyo balelisha amaseese yabo.

english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
translation: Ifitwalo fya mwangashi balafikamina mu cakukaminamo umwangashi icali kunse ya musumba. Mu cakukaminamo umwangashi, mwafumfumuka umulopa, ni cikanga kabalwe ebile, elyo ubutali bwena ni cikanga ikana limo ne myanda mutanda ukulingana ne cipimo cabo (1,600).

english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.
translation: Ubuso 7:3

english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
translation: Esek 9:4

english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.
translation: Tababa na bufi iyoo, tabatala abalufyanya.

english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
translation: Kabili namona malaika umbi alepupuka mu mulu apatali, ali ne mbila nsuma iyakubelelela, iyo ali nokweba abantu ba pano calo, imishobo yonse, imikowa yonse, imitundu yonse, aba ndimi shonse.

english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”
translation: Asosa ne shiwi ilikalamba ati, “Mulekwatila Lesa akatiina, mulemulumbanya, pantu inshita yakupingula abantu naifika. Mulepepa Lesa uwabumbile umulu, icalo, bemba no tumfukumfuku twa menshi!”

english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
translation: Elyo pakonkapo malaika walenga babili. Wena uyu asosa ati, “Naubongoloka! Umusumba ukalamba wa Babiloni naubongoloka! Umusumba uulenga imishobo yonse ukunwa umwangashi uukali wabulalelale wauko!”

english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
translation: Esaya 21:9

english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
translation: Kabili namona mu mulu icishibilo icapesha amano cimbi, icikulu kabili icakusunguka nganshi. Namwene bamalaika cine lubali bali ne finkunka cine lubali. Ifi finkunka efyakupelekeshako, pantu emo ubukali bwakwa Lesa bukapwila.

english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
translation: Elyo namona icintu icapala kwati ni bemba, cilemoneka kwati mulolani, umwasakanamo no mulilo. Namona nabo bacimfishe iciswango ne cilubi caciko, ne cipendo ce shina lyaciko, beminine mupepi na bemba walemoneka kwati mulolani, bekete na maseese yakwa Lesa.

english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
translation: Elyo baleimba ulwimbo lwakwa Mose, umusha wakwa Lesa no lwimbo lwa Mwana wa Mpanga baleti,

english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
translation: We Mfumu, nga nani ashingakukwatila akatiina no kukulumbanya?

english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
translation: Cilya ifi fyapita, namona itempele mu mulu lyaisuka, mukati muli ne Tenti lya cipangano.

english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
translation: Mwitempele mwafuma bamalaika cine lubali, bakwete ne finkunka cine lubali. Ifyakufwala fyena bafwele insalu ishisuma ishabengeshima ishabuuta tuutu, elyo ne mishipi ya golide ukushinguluka ififuba fyabo.

english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
translation: Yere 10:7

english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
translation: Itempele lyaisulamofye icushi icalefuma ku bucindami na ku maka yakwa Lesa. Kanshi tamwali mwakwingila muntu nelyo umo mpaka ifinkunka cine lubali ifya bamalaika cine lubali fyapwa.

english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”
translation: Elyo naumfwa ishiwi ilikalamba ukufuma mwitempele mu mulu lilelanda kuli bamalaika cine lubali lileti, “Kabiyeni muye itila ubukali bwakwa Lesa pa calo ubuli mu nweno cine lubali!”

english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
translation: Ukuf 9:10

english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.
translation: Kabili neco balaumfwa ubukali bwa filonda, balasaalula Lesa wa mu mulu. Bakaana ukulapila no kupilibuka pa fibi balecita.

english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
translation: Malaika walenga mutanda aitulwila ulunweno lwakwe pa mumana ukalamba wa Yufurate. Awe amenshi mu mumana yakama, pakupekanya umwakupita ishamfumu sha ku kabanga.

english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
translation: Elyo namona imipashi yakowela itatu iyapala bacula, ilefuma mu kanwa ka cisoka na mu kanwa ka ciswango na mu kanwa kakwa kasesema wabufi.

english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
translation: Iyi mipashi yakowela yena ilacita ifishibilo fyacipeshamano. Kabili iya ku shamfumu shonse isha pesonde lyonse, kukushilonganika ku bulwi bwa pali bulya bushiku bwakwa Lesa wa maka yonse.

english: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
translation: Esaya 11:15

english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.
translation: Iyo mipashi yakowela yalonganya ishamfumu mu ncende iyo beta mu Cihibulu Amagedoni.

english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
translation: Elyo kwaba no kubyata kwa myele ya nkuba, calabulukuta, no kupanta kwa mfula, elyo ne cinkukuma icikalamba. Apo Lesa abumbile icalo, takwatala akuba icinkukuma ica musango uyu. Ici cali e cinkukuma icabipisha pali fyonse.

english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
translation: Umusumba ukalamba wayakanikana mu fipande fitatu. Imisumba ya mu mishobo yonse nayo yabongoloka. Lesa talabile umusumba ukalamba Babiloni, lelo auleka ukunwa ulukombo lonse ulwaisula umwangashi wa cipyu ca bukali bwakwe.

english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
translation: Malaika wakubalilapo aya itulwila ulunweno lwakwe pa calo. Awe ifilonda ifibi kabili ifikali fyatumba abo bonse abakwete icishibilo ca ciswango no kupepa icilubi caciko.

english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
translation: Awe ifishi fyaluba napo fyaya, ne mpili shonse shaloba.

english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.
translation: Ukuf 10:21

english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
translation: Elyo malaika walenga babili aitulwila ulunweno lwakwe pali bemba. Amenshi ya muli bemba yayaluka yaba kwati mulopa wa muntu uwafwa. Awe na fyonse ifyabumi muli bemba fyafwa.

english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
translation: Malaika walenga batatu ena aitulwila ulunweno lwakwe pa mimana na pa tumfukumfuku twa menshi. Awe na menshi yayaluka umulopa.

english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.
translation: Elyo naumfwa malaika angalila amenshi asosa ati,

english: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
translation: Pantu ebasumya umulopa wa bantu bamushilo no wa bakasesema,

english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
translation: Naumfwa no bulambo bwasosa abuti,

english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
translation: Elyo malaika walenga bane aitulwila ulunweno lwakwe pa kasuba. Awe akasuba kalaoca abantu ne cikabilila ngo mulilo.

english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.
translation: Abantu epakupya nganshi ku cikabilila. Balasaalula na Lesa uwaba na maka pali ifi finkunka. Awe bakaana no kulapila nokuti balelumbanya Lesa.

english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
translation: Umo pali bamalaika cine lubali abali ne nweno cine lubali aisa kuli ine. Uyu malaika alanjeba ati, “Isa nkulange ifyo balapingwila umwanakashi cilende uwalumbuka uwikala mupepi na menshi ayengi.

english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
translation: Pali ishi mfumu cine lubali, shisano shena shalifwa, imo icili ileteeka, elyo imbi yena tailaisa. Lelo nga yaisa, ikateekafye inshita inono.

english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
translation: Cilya ciswango icali icabumi kale, nomba tacili na bumi, e mfumu yalenga cine konse konse. Ici ciswango caba pa shamfumu cine lubali, kabili cili mukuya kukonaulwa.

english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
translation: “Elyo insengo ikumi limo shilya wacimona, ni bashamfumu ikumi limo. Lelo kwena tabalatampa kulateeka, bakapeelwa amaka yakuteeka insa imo, kabili bakaba pamo ne ciswango.

english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
translation: Ishi shamfumu shabafye ne cintu cimo ico shifwaya, kupeela amaka yabo no buteeko bwabo ku ciswango.

english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
translation: Elyo iciswango ne shamfumu bakalwisha Umwana wa Mpanga. Lelo Umwana wa Mpanga, pamo pene nabo aita, abasalwa abamukonka ne cisumino, bakabacimfya, pantu ni Kateeka wa bakateeka bonse, kabili ni Mfumu ya shamfumu shonse.”

english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
translation: Kabili malaika anjeba ati, “Amenshi umwene umwanakashi cilende ekelepo, e bantu, e mabumba ya bantu, imishobo, na ba ndimi shonse.

english: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.
translation: Insengo ikumi limo umwene ne ciswango, fikapata cilende. Fikamupokolola ifintu fyonse no kumusha ubwamba. Fikalya umunofu wakwe no kumoca mu mulilo.

english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
translation: Pantu ni Lesa uwalengele ukuti insengo shibombele pamo pakuti ifyo Lesa alefwaya ficitike. Insengo shapeele amaka yakuteeka ku ciswango, mpaka amashiwi yakwa Lesa yakafikilishiwe.

english: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
translation: “Umwanakashi ulya umwene e musumba ukalamba uwateeka ishamfumu shonse isha pano calo.”

english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
translation: Uyu e mwanakashi ishamfumu sha pano calo shicita nao ubulalelale na bantu ba pano calo balikolwa umwangashi wa bulalelale bwakwe.”

english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
translation: Elyo malaika ansenda mu matololo, ninshi ninjikatwa na Mupashi Wamushilo. Kabili emo namona umwanakashi ekele pa ciswango icakashika icakwata imitwe cine lubali ne nsengo ikumi limo, elyo umubili onse waisulafye amashina ya nsele ishakutuka Lesa.

english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
translation: Umwanakashi wena ninshi afwele insalu ishakashikila ne shakashikafye, kabili naisamika ne fisamiko fya golide, utumabwe twamutengo no bulungu. Mu minwe yakwe mwena ekete ulukombo lwa golide umwaisula ifyabukakashi ne fyabipisha nganshi ifya bulalelale bwakwe.

english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”
translation: Pa mpumi yakwe pena palembelwe ishina ilyankaama ilyakuti,

english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.
translation: Namona nokuti umwanakashi nakolwa, akolelwe umulopa wa bantu bamushilo no wa bakambone bakwa Yesu.

english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
translation: Yere 51:7

english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.
translation: Ici ciswango wamona cali icamweo kale, lelo nomba tacili na bumi. Calafuma mu muyenge, elyo cikaye onaulwa. Abantu bekala pano calo, abo amashina yabo yashalembwa mu citabo ca bomi apo icalo catendekele ukubako, bakasunguka. Pantu bakamona iciswango icali icamweo kale, nomba tacili na bumi, lelo kabili cikesa moneka.

english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
translation: “Apa pantu palefwaikwa amano no kwiluka. Imitwe cine lubali, e mpili cine lubali apo umwanakashi ekala, kabili e shamfumu cine lubali.

english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, elyo namona malaika umbi aleika ku mulu. Uyu malaika ali uwamaka nganshi no kubengeshima kwakwe kwaleta ulubuuto pa calo.

english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
translation: Bakeminina ukutalifye, ico bakatiina amacushi yauko. Bakasosa abati,

english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:
translation: Abamakwebo aba pano calo nabo bakalila no kuloosha umusumba, pantu tapakabe nelyo umo uwakushita ifyuma fyabo.

english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
translation: Tapakabe wakushita ifyuma fya golide, ne fya silifa, ifyatumabwe twamutengo no bulungu, ne nsalu shabusaka ishabuuta tuutu, ne shakashikila ishatelela, ne shakashikafye. Tapakabe wakushita imiti yanunka ubusaka iya misango ne misango, ifintu fya misango misango ifyo bapanga ku meno ya nsofu, na ku fimuti ifyakosa umutengo, ne fya mukuba, ne fya cela, na mabwe ayakulungilwa bwino aya marbo.

english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
translation: Tapakabe wakushita ifyanunka ubusaka sinamoni, na fimbi ifyanunka ubusaka, ifyacinyamuti fya cena cisuma, muri no fulankinisenshi, umwangashi na mafuta, ubunga ne ŋanu, iŋombe ne mpaanga, bakabalwe na maceleta, abasha ne myeo ya bantu.

english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.
translation: Abantu bamakwebo bakakweba abati, “Ifintu fyonse ifyo walefwaisha nafiloba. Ifyuma no bukankala bobe bonse nafiloba tawakatale aufimona nakabili!”

english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
translation: Abamakwebo, abo banonkele fyuma mukucita amakwebo mu musumba ulya, bakeminina ukutalifye ico bakatiina amacushi yauko. Bakalila no kuloosha abati,

english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,
translation: Esaya 23:17

english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
translation: Balapunda pakumona uko umusumba ulepya abati, “Takwatala akuba umusumba uwaba ngoyu musumba ku bukulu!”

english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.
translation: Elyo balaikuba ulukungu pa mitwe. Balalila no kuloosha abati,

english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!
translation: Elyo aikatisha ishiwi apunda ati, “Naubongoloka! Umusumba ukalamba Babiloni naubongoloka! Nomba walwike icifulo ca mipashi yakowela ne mipashi yonse iyabipisha, ulucengo lwa fyuni fyonse ifyakowela, kabili ifyo abantu bapata.

english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”
translation: Esaya 48:20

english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
translation: Esaya 13:21

english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
translation: Muli iwe Babiloni tamwakatale amumfwika nakabili ukulila kwa maseese, ukwimba kwa ŋomba, ukulila kwa bamutolilo na mapenga. Kabili muli iwe tamwakatale amusangwa fundi wa mulimo uuli onse, ne congo ca libwe ililepela tacakatale acumfwikamo nakalya.

english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
translation: Ulubuuto lwa cisaniko talwakatale alumoneka muli iwe nakabili. Ishiwi lyakwa shibwinga na nabwinga talyakatale alyumfwika nakabili muli iwe. Abamakwebo bobe ebalumbwike nganshi mu calo conse. Amalele yobe yabepaike imishobo yonse.”

english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
translation: Muli Babiloni emwalesangwa umulopa wa bakasesema na bantu bamushilo, elyo no mulopa wa bantu bonse abo baipeye pano calo.

english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
translation: Pantu imishobo yonse yalinwako umwangashi wauko uukali uwabulalelale. Ishamfumu sha pano calo nasho shalecita ubulalelale nao. Abamakwebo ba calo conse nabo bamwenenemo ukuba abakankala ku mulandu wa lunkumbwa lwauko ulushaikulila.”

english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
translation: Elyo naumfwa ishiwi na limbi ukufuma ku mulu lileti,

english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
translation: Pantu ifyabubifi fyauko nafitulumana umwina ukufika na ku mulu,

english: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
translation: Yere 51:7

english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
translation: Yere 51:8

english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
translation: Esaya 21:9

english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, elyo naumfwa icapala icongo icikalamba ica mashiwi ya bantu abengi mu mulu balepunda abati,

english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”
translation: Esaya 34:10

english: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.
translation: Kabili namona umulu wacenama, namona na kabalwe uwabuuta. Uunininepo ishina lyakwe ni Mucetekelwa kabili Cishinka. Ni mu mulinganya apingula no kuya mu bulwi.

english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.
translation: Amenso yakwe yaba kwati lubingu lwa mulilo. Kabili ku mutwe wakwe afwala ifisote fyabufumu ifingi. Alilembwapo ne shina ilyo muntu nelyo umo ashaishiba, kanofye umwine eka.

english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
translation: Amalu 115:13

english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.
translation: Ifita fya mu mulu nafimukonka, fininine pali bakabalwe ababuuta, fifwele ne nsalu ishabusaka, ishabuuta tuutu.

english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
translation: Elyo mu kanwa kakwe mwafuma ulupanga ulwatwa ulwakucimfishako imishobo. Akabateeka ne nkonto ya cela mu minwe. Akanyantaula na mu cakukaminamo umwangashi wa bukali bwakwa Lesa.

english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”
translation: Pa mwingila wakwe na petanta lyakwe palembelwe ishina ilyakuti,

english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,
translation: Elyo namona malaika eminine pa kasuba. Alepunda ne shiwi likalamba ku fyuni fyonse ifipupuka mu lwelele aleti, “Iseni, longaneni pamo ku mitebeto ikalamba yakwa Lesa!

english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”
translation: Iseni mukulya iminofu ya bashamfumu, iya bakalamba ba fita, ne ya fita ifyamaka, iminofu ya bakabalwe ne ya benda pali bakabalwe, ne minofu ya bantufye bonse, abantungwa na basha, abakalamba na baice!”

english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.
translation: Elyo namona iciswango na bashamfumu ba pano calo ne fita fyabo nabalongana kukulwisha uuninine pali kabalwe ne fita fyakwe.

english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”
translation: Pantu apingula mu cishinka no mulinganya!

english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
translation: Ubuso 14:20

english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
translation: Ifita fya ciswango na bashamfumu fyena bafipaya ku lupanga lwafumine mu kanwa ka uuninine pali kabalwe. Ifyuni fyonse fyalya iminofu yabo fyaikuta nganshi.

english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
translation: Kabili babwekeshapo ukupunda abati,

english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
translation: Abakalamba balya amakumi yabili na bane ne fyamweo filya fine bawa panshi balapepa Lesa uwikele pa cipuna ca Mfumu. Balasosa abati,

english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
translation: Elyo ku cipuna ca Mfumu kwafuma ishiwi aliti,

english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
translation: Elyo naumfwa icapala icongo ca mashiwi ya bantu abengi, icaba kwati kupooma kwa menshi, kabili kwati kupanta kwa mfula, cilepunda aciti,

english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
translation: Isham 9:7

english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
translation: Napeelwa ukufwala insalu shabusaka ishabengeshima ishabuuta tuutu,

english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”
translation: Elyo malaika anjeba ati, “Lemba utile ‘Balishuka abo baitwa ku mitebeto ya bwinga bwa Mwana wa Mpanga!’” Malaika atila nokuti, “Aya mashiwi yakwa Lesa cine cinefye.”

english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
translation: Ifili muli ici citabo e fintu Lesa asokolwelele Yesu Kristu. Afisokolwele pakuti Yesu Kristu alange abasha bakwe ifintu ifyali nokucitikafye bwangu bwangu. Kristu nao atumine malaika kukwisa ishibisha ifi fintu kuli Yoani umusha wakwe.

english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
translation: Saka 12:10

english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
translation: Ishiwi lyaleti, “Lemba mu citabo, conse ico wamona elyo utume icitabo ku nkuta cine lubali isha ku Efeso, Simina, Pegamo, Tiyatila, Sadisi, Filadelfia na ku Laodikea.”

english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
translation: Awe nacebukila kunuma pakuti mone uulensosha. Ilyo nacebukilako, namona ifyakutekapo ifisaniko cine lubali ifyapangwa na golide.

english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
translation: Dan 7:13

english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
translation: Ukuf 3:14

english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
translation: Amakasa yakwe yena yalebengeshima kwati mukuba filya ubengeshima ilyo wafuma mukupya mwilungu lya mulilo. Elyo ne shiwi lyakwe lileumfwika kwati cipooma ca menshi.

english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
translation: Mu cisansa cakwe ica ku kulyo emo ekete intanda cine lubali. Mu kanwa kakwe mwena mwafuma ulupanga ulwatwa kubili. Impumi yakwe ilebengeshima kwati kasuba akabalikisha.

english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,
translation: Tesa 4:17

english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
translation: Nine mwine wamweo. Nalifwile, nomba ndi uwamweo uwakubelelela pe. Nalikwata amaka pa mfwa na pa calo ca bafwa.

english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.
translation: Kanshi lemba ifintu wamona, ifilecitika nomba, elyo ne fikacitika kuntanshi.

english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
translation: Yoani nao alishimika fyonse ifyo amwene. Kabili ni kambone pa mashiwi yakwa Lesa na pa cishinka Kristu aisa sokolola.

english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
translation: Kanshi intanda cine lubali isho wacimona mu cisansa candi ica ku kulyo ne fyakutekapo ifisaniko cine lubali, fili nomo filolele. Intanda cine lubali, ni bamalaika abamona pa nkuta cine lubali, elyo ifyakutekapo ifisaniko cine lubali e nkuta cine lubali.

english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
translation: Alishuka uubelengela abantu amashiwi yafuma kuli Lesa aya muli ici citabo. Balishuka na bantu abomfwako ayo mashiwi no kukonka ifyalembwamo. Pantu inshita naipalama ilyo fyonse ifi fikacitika.

english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
translation: Ine Yoani, namulembela imwe mwe nkuta cine lubali isha mu calo ca Asia.

english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—
translation: Ubuso 4:5

english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
translation: Kabili alitwalula ukuba ababufumu kabili bashimapepo abakutumika Lesa wakwe kabili Wishi. Kuli Yesu Kristu kube amalumbo na maka yakubelelela pe! Ameni.

english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
translation: Moneni, eulya aleisa mu makumbi! Bonse bakamumona, na bamulashile nabo bene bakamumona. Abantu bonse aba pano isonde bakamuloosha. Kanshi ifyo efyo cikaba! Ameni.

english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
translation: “Nine Alfa kabili nine Omega,” efyasosa Imfumu Lesa wa maka yonse, uwabako, uwaliko, kabili uukesa bako.

english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
translation: Ine, nine Yoani munyinenwe, apo naampana na Yesu, tucula pamo na imwe amacushi yamo yene no kushipikisha mu macushi ayo ayesa pa baba mu Bufumu bwakwa Kristu. Bambikile pa cishi ca Patimosi pa mulandu wakufunda amashiwi yakwa Lesa na pali bukambone bwandi pali Yesu.

english: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
translation: Elyo namona malaika aleika ukufuma ku mulu, mu minwe yakwe ekete ulufungulo lwa pa muyenge no munyololo ukalamba.

english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
translation: Elyo Ciwa uwalebabepaika nao akaposwa muli bemba wa mulilo umupya ifyanunka nga maluti, umo iciswango na kasesema wabufi bena baposwa kale. Muli uyu mulilo tabakatale abafumamo, emo bakalacula pe ubwaca no bwaila.

english: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.
translation: Elyo namona icipuna ca Mfumu icikalamba icabuuta kabili namona no wikelepo. Icalo no mulu fyafulumuka icinso cakwe, te fyakumona noko fyaya.

english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
translation: Elyo namona abafwa abakalamba na baice beminine pantashi ya cipuna ca Mfumu. Awe ifitabo fyakupukulwa, ne citabo cimbi, icitabo ca bomi cakupukulwa. Abafwa babapingula ukulinga nefyo bacita ngomo fyalembelwa mu fitabo.

english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
translation: Elyo bemba nao afumya bonse abafwilamo. Imfwa ne calo ca bafwa nafyo epakufumya abantu abafwa abalimo. Bonse babapingula ukulingana nefyo bacita.

english: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
translation: Elyo imfwa ne calo ca bafwa bafiposa muli bemba wa mulilo. Uyu bemba wa mulilo e mfwa yacibili.

english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
translation: Kabili umuntu onse uo ishina lyakwe lishisangilwe mu citabo ca bomi, bamuposa muli bemba wa mulilo.

english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
translation: Awe aikata icisoka, acikaka pa myaka ikana limo. Ici e cisoka cakale na kale, e Ciwa wine nangu Satana.

english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
translation: Aciposa na mu muyenge aisalapo, akomenenapo ne namba. Acitile ifyo pakuti cikalabepaika imishobo nakabili, mpaka imyaka ikana limo ikapite. Iyo myaka nga yapita, elyo akacikakula pa kashita akanono.

english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
translation: Elyo namona ifipuna fyabufumu, na bekelepo babapeela amaka yakuputula imilandu. Kabili namona ne mipashi ya abo bantu baipeye mukubaputulako imitwe pa mulandu wakwiminina bukambone pali Yesu na peshiwi lyakwa Lesa. Aba bena tabapepeleko ciswango nangu icilubi caciko, kabili tabasumine ukulembwa pa mpumi shabo nangu pa fisansa fyabo icishibilo ca ciswango. Awe bena babuuka ku bafwa, balateeka ubufumu pamo na Kristu imyaka ikana limo.

english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
translation: Abantu bambi abafwa bena tabali abomi mpaka imyaka ikana limo yapita. Uku e kushukuka kwakubalilapo.

english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
translation: Balishuka, kabili bamushilo abakashukilako ukushukuka kwakubalilapo. Pali aba bena imfwa yacibili tayakwatapo maka nakalya. Bakabafye bashimapepo bakwa Lesa na Kristu, elyo kabili bakateeka ubufumu pamo nankwe imyaka ikana limo.

english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison
translation: Ikatila imyaka ikana limo nga yapita, elyo Satana akakakulwa akafume mu cifungo cakwe.

english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
translation: Akesa kukubepaika imishobofye yonse iya pano isonde, iyo batila Gogi na Magogi. Satana akabalonganika ku bulwi, kabili bakaba kwati umusensenga wa pa lulamba lwa bemba ku bwingi.

english: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
translation: Dan 7:9

english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
translation: Elyo namona umulu upya ne calo cipya. Umulu wakubalilapo ne calo cakubalilapo ninshi nafipita, na bemba tewakumoneka.

english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
translation: Uyu musumba waba ne linga ilikalamba, kabili ilitali. Wakwata ne mpongolo ikumi limo na shibili, na bamalaika ikumi limo na babili abakulonda impongolo. Kabili pa mpongolo pene palembwapo amashina ya nko ikumi limo na shibili isha bena Israeli.

english: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
translation: Pet 3:13

english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
translation: Sam 7:14

english: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
translation: Malaika uo nalelanda nankwe akwete inkonto yakupiminako iya golide, pakuti apime umusumba, impongolo sha musumba ne linga lya musumba.

english: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.
translation: Umusumba waba na matungi yane, uwalingana ubutali no bwipi. Elyo malaika abuula inkonto yakupiminako, apima no musumba. Asanga ukuti mubutali na mubufumo, elyo no butali ukuya mu mulu fyonse fintu fyalingana, fyalepa amakana ikumi limo na fibili ukulingana no kupenda kwabo (12,000).

english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
translation: Esaya 65:17

english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
translation: Ilinga lyena lyakuulilwe na mabwe ya yasipeli. Elyo umusumba wena wakuulilwe na golide eka eka, uwalebeka kwati mulolani.

english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
translation: Namona na Yerusalemu mupya, umusumba wamushilo, uleika ukufuma kuli Lesa mu mulu, nabaupekanya no kuufwika ubusaka nga nabwinga uo baletwala kuli shibwinga.

english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
translation: Ilya busano libwe lya onikisi, ilyalenga mutanda libwe lya kanelia, ilyalenga cine lubali libwe lya kirisalite, ilyalenga cine konse konse libwe lya bereli, ilyalenga pabula libwe lya topasi ilyalenga ikumi limo libwe lya kilisopasi, ilyalenga ikumi limo na limo libwe lya yasinti, ne lyalenga ikumi limo na yabili libwe lya amefisiti.

english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
