translation: Elyo impongolo ikumi limo na shibili, e fimabwe fyamutengo ikumi limo na fibili. Cila mpongolo yapangwa ku cilibwe cimo. Umusebo ukalamba uwa mu musumba, ubeeka kwati mulolani, ico wapangwa na golide eka eka.

english: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.
translation: Umusumba taukabila ulubuuto lwa kasuba nangu ulwa mweshi. Pantu ubucindami bwakwa Lesa e lubuuto lwauko, no Mwana wa Mpanga e cisaniko cauko.

english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
translation: Imishobo ya pano isonde yakulaenda mu lubuuto lwauko. Kabili bashamfumu ba pano calo emo bakaleta ubucindami bwabo.

english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
translation: Impongolo sha musumba akasuba konse shikalaba ishacenama, tashakatale ashisalwa, pantu mu musumba tabwakatale abwila.

english: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
translation: Esek 37:27

english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
translation: Elyo naumfwa ishiwi ilikalamba ukufuma ku cipuna ca Mfumu lileti, “Nomba icifulo cakwa Lesa cili pakati ka bantu! Lesa akulaikala nabo, elyo nabo bakulaba abantu bakwe. Ni Lesa umwine akulaikala nabo, kabili akulaba Lesa wabo.

english: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
translation: Akabafuuta ifilamba fyonse ku menso yabo. Takwakatale akuba imfwa nakabili, nangu ukuloosha, nangu ukulila ifilamba, nangu ukukalipwa iyoo. Pantu ifintu fyonse ifyakale nafipita.”

english: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
translation: Elyo uwikele pa cipuna ca Mfumu asosa ati, “Nomba nalacita fyonse fibe ifipya!” Kabili anjeba ati, “Ale, lemba ifi fintu, pantu aya mashiwi yacishinka, kabili ayalinga ukucetekela.”

english: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
translation: Anjeba nokuti, “Capwa! Nine Alfa kabili nine Omega, nine Citendekelo kabili nine Kapeleko. Onse uuli ne cilaka nkamupeela amenshi yakunwa ayabupefye ukufuma ku kamfukumfuku ka menshi ayapeela umweo.

english: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
translation: Uwacimfya eo nkapeela ifi, kabili nkaba Lesa wakwe, nao akaba umwana wandi.

english: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
translation: Esaya 25:8

english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
translation: Elyo malaika umo pali bamalaika balya cine lubali, abali ne nweno cine lubali ishaisula ifinkunka cine lubali ifyakupelekeshako, aisa kuli ine, alanjeba ati, “Isa nalakulanga nabwinga muka Mwana wa Mpanga.”

english: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
translation: Elyo malaika ananga umumana uwa menshi ayapeela umweo. Uyu mumana untu wabengeshima kwati tumabwe twa kilistali, kabili wafuma mu cipuna cakwa Lesa no Mwana wa Mpanga.

english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
translation: Kabili anjeba ati, “Wisunga mu nkaama amashiwi ayasesemwa muli ici citabo, pantu inshita naipalama.

english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
translation: Saka 14:11

english: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
translation: Yesu aleti, “Mona! Nalaisafye bwangu! Ndeleta ifilambu fyandi ifyakupeela cila muntu ukulingana nefyo acita.

english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
translation: Nine Alfa kabili nine Omega, nine Wayambilako kabili nine Wakupelekeshako, nine Citendekelo kabili nine Kapeleko.”

english: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
translation: Balishuka abasamba imingila yabo, pakuti bakwate insambu shakulyako ifitwalo fya muti wamweo no kwingila mu musumba pa mpongolo.

english: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
translation: Lelo abashala kunse ya musumba bantu abolungana nge mbwa, abacita amalele, abacita ubulalelale, aba misoka abapepa utulubi, nabo bonse ababufi mukulanda na mu micitile yabo.

english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
translation: “Nine Yesu ne utumine malaika wandi ku kwisa sokolola ifi fintu ku nkunta shonse. Ine ndi wa mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi, kabili nine lutanda ulwabekesha ulwa lucelo.”

english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
translation: Mupashi na nabwinga balesosa abati, “Isa!”

english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
translation: Dan 7:18

english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
translation: Esaya 60:19

english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
translation: Elyo kabili wapita pakati ka musebo ukalamba uwa mu musumba. Cila bushilya bwa mumana, kwaba umuti wamweo uutwala ifitwalo imiku ikumi limo na ibili. Kanshi emukuti, utwala cila mweshi. Amabula yena yakundapilako abantu bonse.

english: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
translation: Uyu uwasokolola fyonse ifi asosa ati, “Cine cinefye! Nalaisafye bwangu!”

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu Yesu cibe na bamushilo bonse. Ameni.

english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
translation: Muli uyu musumba tamwakasangwe nelyo cimo ico Lesa alapisha.

english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
translation: Bakalatamba icinso cakwe, ne shina lyakwe likalembwa pa mpumi shabo.

english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
translation: Tabwakaleila, kabili takwakabe kukabila ulubuuto lwa cisaniko nangu ulubuuto lwa kasuba, pantu Imfumu Lesa eikaba ulubuuto lwabo. Elyo nabo bakalateeka pe na pe.

english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
translation: Malaika elyo anjeba ati, “Aya mashiwi yacishinka kabili ayalinga ukucetekela. Kabili Imfumu Lesa uutumina bakasesema Mupashi wakwe, ewatuma malaika wakwe ku babomfi bakwe pakuti abalange ifyalaswa ficitikefye bwangu bwangu.”

english: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
translation: Yesu aleti, “Umfwa! Nalaisafye bwangu. Balishuka abasunga amashiwi ayasesemwa muli ici citabo!”

english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
translation: Saka 14:8

english: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
translation: Icite 2:9

english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:
translation: “Lembela malaika wa lukuta lwa mu Efeso ukuti,

english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
translation: Witiina ifintu walaswa uculeko. Mona! Ciwa akakwesha, akaposa bamo pali imwe mu cifungo, mukaculamo inshiku ikumi limo. Nangu cakuti kumwipaya, mulecetekela muli ine. Elyo na ine nkamupeela icilambu camweo icacindama.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta!

english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
translation: Esek 28:13

english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
translation: Lelo kwena ninkwata ifintu fimo ifyakuilishanyapo pali iwe. Uli na bamo uko kwine abalekonka ifyafunda Balamu. Balamu afundile Balaki ifyakutwala abena Israeli mukubifya mukubasembeleka ukulya ifyakulya baletuula ku tulubi na mukucita ubulalelale.

english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation: Kabili uko kwine naukwata abantu bamo muli iwe abalekonka ififunda abena Nikola.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta!

english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:
translation: “Lembela malaika wa lukuta lwa mu Tiyatila ukuti,

english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
translation: Nalishiba ifyo ucita. Nalishiba icitemwiko cobe, icisumino cobe, ifyo waba no mutima wakutumika, elyo no mutekatima obe. Nalishiba nokuti pali nomba ulebombesha ukucila ifyo walebomba pakutampa.

english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.
translation: Ine nalishiba imilimo wabomba. Nalishiba ifyo wabombesha nganshi nefyo washipikisha. Nalishiba ukuti taufwaya abantu babi nelyo panono. Nalishiba nokuti walyesha abantu abaleitunga ukuba abasole kanshi ninshi tefyo baba, no kusanga walisanga ukuti babepafye.

english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
translation: Lelo ninkwatapo ico ndeilishanya pali iwe. Iwe tawacitapo nelyo cimo pali uyo mwanakashi Yesebele. Uyo mwanakashi aita ukuti ni kasesema. Ifyo alefunda filelenga abasha bandi ukuwila mukucita ubulalelale na mukulyako ifyakulya batuula ku tulubi.

english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
translation: Nalimupeela inshita yakulapila no kupilibuka. Lelo tafwaya kulapila pa bulalelale bwakwe.

english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
translation: Isham 9:22

english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
translation: Nkepaya abana bakwe ku cinkunka. Elyo ne nkuta shonse shikeshiba ukuti nine naishiba bwino ifyaba mu mitima yenu nefyo mutontonkanya. Ine nkalipila umuntu onse ukulingana nefyo acita.

english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.
translation: “Lelo imwe bonse mwe bashala, mweba mu Tiyatila mwe bashakonka ifyo Yesebele afunda, imwe tamwasambililako ifyo batila, ‘e nkaama ine ine iyakwa Satana.’ Kanshi ine kwena nshilemulundilapo amafunde na yambi ayakumusakamika.

english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
translation: Lelo imwe mwikatishefye ifyo mwafundwa mpaka nkese.

english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
translation: Kuli uyo uwacimfya, atwalilila no kucita ifyo mfwaya mpaka na ku mpela, nkamupeela amaka yakuteeka imishobo yonse.

english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;
translation: ‘Akabateeka ne nkonto ya cela mu minwe. Akabatobaula nge fipe fye bumba.’

english: and I will give him the morning star.
translation: Kabili nkamupeela no lutanda lwa lucelo.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta.

english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
translation: Iwe ulashipikisha, kabili ulacula pa mulandu wa ine ukwabula no kunenuka.

english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
translation: Lelo ninkwatapo ico ndeilishanya pali iwe. Iwe nomba tawantemwa nga filya wantemenwe pakutampa.

english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
translation: Tontonkanya ifyo wali kale ilyo wali taulanenuka. Kanshi lapila no kupilibuka, ulecita nefyo walecita pakutampa. Ukumfwa nga taulapile no kupilibuka, nkesa kuli iwe, nkafumye pa ncende yaciko icakutekapo icisaniko cobe.

english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
translation: Lelo icinsansamushako kuli iwe nico walipata ificita abena Nikola ifyo na ine napata.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta! Kuli uyo uwacimfya, nkamupeela insambu shakulyako ifitwalo fya muti upeela umweo uwaba mu Cifulo Cansansa.

english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
translation: Icite 2:9

english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
translation: “Lembela malaika wa lukuta lwa mu Sadisi ukuti,

english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
translation: Pantu mukushipikisha mu macushi walisunga amafunde yandi. Kanshi na ine nkakupususha mu nshita ya macushi ayali nokwishila mpanga yonse pano calo kukwesha abantu bonse aba pano isonde.

english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
translation: Nalaswa njise bwangu. Wikatishe ico wakwata, wileka nelyo umo akakupokolole icilambu cobe.

english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
translation: Uwacimfya, nkamucita uluceshi lwa mwitempele lyakwa Lesa wandi, kabili takatale afumamo. Nkamulembapo ishina lyakwa Lesa wandi ne shina lya musumba wakwa Lesa, Yerusalemu mupya, uukeka ukufuma ku mulu kuli Lesa wandi. Elyo nkamulembapo ne shina lyandi ilipya.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta.

english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
translation: Yobo 12:14

english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
translation: Ubuso 16:15

english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
translation: Lelo ico ulifye icifulefule tawakaba nangu ukutalala ndekufwisa nga mate mu kanwa kandi.

english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
translation: Iwe ulesosa auti, ‘Ndi mukankala, ndi ne fyuma, nshikabila nelyo cimo.’ Lelo iwe tawaishiba ukuti uli mulanda wine wine, uwakulangulukilakofye, uli mupina, uli mpofu, kabili wendafye ubwamba.

english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
translation: Kanshi ndekupandako amano. Shita kuli ine golide uwaengululwa mwilungu lya mulilo, lyena uleba umukankala. Ushite ne nsalu ishabuuta, ulefwala pakuti insoni shakwenda ubwamba shipwe. Shita no muti wakubika mu menso, pakuti ulemona.

english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
translation: Bonse abantu abo natemwa ndabakalipila no kubalulula. Kanshi kalabana lapila no kupilibuka.

english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
translation: Shibuka! Koselela mufyo ucili nafyo, pantu nafyo fine filifye mupepi nokupwa. Pantu ninsanga ukuti ifyo ucita tafyaba ifyapwililika pa cinso cakwa Lesa wandi.

english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
translation: Mona! Ninjiminina pa mwinshi ndekonkonsha. Umo nga aumfwa ishiwi lyandi, anjiswilako iciibi, nkengila mumwakwe, elyo ine na ena tukalya nankwe pamo.

english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
translation: Uyo uwacimfya, nkamusuminisha ukulaikala mupepi na ine pa cipuna ca Bufumu bwandi, nga filya na ine apo nalicimfya njikala na Tata pa cipuna mu Bufumu bwakwe.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
translation: Esaya 22:22

english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
translation: Kanshi uleibukisha ifyo wafundilwe nefyo waumfwile. Ulefikonka, ulapile no kupilibuka ku fyabubifi fyobe. Lelo nga taushibwike, nkakwishilila kwati mupupu, kabili tawakeshibe ne nshita nkeshilapo.

english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
translation: Lelo kwena emo bali abantu bamo aba mu Sadisi abashalamfya fyakufwala fyabo. Abo ebakenda na ine nabafwala insalu ishabuuta, pantu nacibalinga.

english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
translation: Uyo uwacimfya, akaba nga bena, eukafwala insalu shabuuta. Kabili nshakafuute ishina lyakwe mu citabo ca bomi. Elyo nkalumbula ishina lyakwe pa cinso cakwa Tata na bamalaika bakwe ukuti uyu e muntu wandi.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
translation: “Uuli na matwi, kanshi nakutike kufyo Mupashi alesosa ku nkuta.

english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
translation: “Lembela malaika wa lukuta lwa mu Filadelfia ukuti,

english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
translation: Iwe imilimo ucita naliishiba. Mona, ninkwiswila iciibi, tapali nangu umo uwingacisala. Nalishiba ukuti tawakwatisha amaka, lelo nalyo line walisunga amashiwi yandi kabili tawansangukila.

english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
translation: Mona! Epo bali ababufi abatila tuli Bayuda, lelo tabali Bayuda iyoo, cilonganinofye cakwa Satana. Ine nkabalenga ukuti bakese kufukamina, elyo bonse bakeshibe nokuti nalikutemwa.

english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita nati ndoleshe, namona iciibi icacenama mu mulu. Elyo ne shiwi ilya ciunda kwati lipenga ilyo naumfwile na pakubala, lyanjeba aliti, “Nina isa kuno, nalaisa kulanga ifili nokucitika kuntanshi.”

english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
translation: abakalamba amakumi yabili na bane balafukamina uwaikala pa cipuna ca Mfumu, no kulapepa uyu wakubelelela pe. Elyo babika pantanshi ya cipuna ca Mfumu ifisote fyabo ifyabufumu balesosa abati,

english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
translation: “We Mfumu yesu kabili we Lesa wesu!

english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
translation: Awe apopene Mupashi Wamushilo anjikata, ansenda. Mu mulu mulya, namona icipuna ca Mfumu na umo naikalapo.

english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
translation: Impumi ya waikele pa cipuna yalebengeshima kwati ni filya fibeka amabwe ya yasipeli na kanelia. Icipuna ca Mfumu cashingulwikwe no mukolamfula uwalemoneka kwati libwe lya emeradi.

english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
translation: Ukushinguluka icipuna ca Mfumu kwaliko ifipuna fyabufumu amakumi yabili na fine. Pali ifi fipuna pena paikele abakalamba amakumi yabili na bane bafwele insalu ishabuuta ne fisote fyabufumu ku mitwe ifya golide.

english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
translation: Mu cipuna ca Mfumu mwalefuma ukubyata kwa myele ya nkuba no kubulukuta no kupanta kwa mfula. Kabili pantanshi ya cipuna ca Mfumu pali ifisaniko cine lubali fileyaka. Ifi fisaniko e mipashi yakwa Lesa cine lubali.

english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
translation: Pantanshi ya cipuna ca Mfumu palemoneka nga bemba uwaba kwati mulolani uwabeka kwati libwe lya kilistali.

english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation: Icamweo icakubalilapo cali kwati ni nkalamo, icabubili cali kwati ni ŋombe, icabutatu cena cali ne mpumi kwati ni mpumi ya muntu, elyo icalenga fine cali kwati ni kapumpe uulepupuka.

english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
translation: Ifyamweo fyonse fine, cila cintu cali na mapindo mutanda, elyo naya mapindo mukati na kunse mwalifye amenso yeka yeka. Elyo akasuba no bushiku fibikapofye ukwimba ukwabula ukuleka fileti,

english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
translation: Ifyamweo fine fimba inyimbo shakulumbanya no kucindika no kutasha uwaikala pa cipuna ca Mfumu, uyu wakubelelela pe. Lyonse ilyo ficita ifyo,

english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
translation: Elyo namwene icitabo icapombwa mu minwe ya kuboko kwa kulyo kwa waikele pa cipuna ca Mfumu. Ico citabo calembelwe mukati na kunse. Kabili pakucifunga cakambatikilwepo inamba cine lubali.

english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
translation: Wabacita ukuba ubufumu kabili bashimapepo

english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
translation: Esaya 29:11

english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
translation: Balepunda pakwimba abati,

english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
translation: Elyo naumfwa ifibumbwa fyonse ifya mu mulu, ifya pano calo, ifya panshi ya calo, ifya muli bemba ne fibumbwafye fyonse fileimba afiti,

english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
translation: Ifyamweo fine filya fyasosa afiti, “Ameni!” Abakalamba bena bafukama balapepa.

english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
translation: Elyo namwene malaika uwamaka alebilikisha ne shiwi ilikalamba aleti, “Nani engalinga ukukakatulapo inamba no kukupukula icitabo?”

english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
translation: Lelo tapali nelyo umo mu mulu nangu ni pa calo, nangu panshi ya calo uwakuti akupukule icitabo nangu ukuloleshamo.

english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
translation: Awe na ine nalila icibi ico pashali nelyo umo uwakuti alinga ukukupukula icitabo nangu ukulolesha mukati.

english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
translation: Elyo umo pa bakalamba anjeba ati, “Leka ukulila. Mona! Inkalamo ya mu luko lwakwa Yuda, uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi uwalumbuka, alicimfya. Wena kuti akakatulapo inamba no kukupukula icitabo.”

english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
translation: Elyo namona pakati ka cipuna ca Mfumu, ne fyamweo fine nafishinguluka pamo na bakalamba, peminine Umwana wa Mpanga ali kwati untu bepeye. Umwana wa Mpanga ali ne nsengo cine lubali na menso nayo cine lubali, iyi e mipashi yakwa Lesa cine lubali iyatumwa isonde lyonse.

english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
translation: Esaya 53:7

english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
translation: Cilya apoka icitabo, ifyamweo fine na bakalamba amakumi yabili na bane bafukamina Umwana wa Mpanga. Bonse umo umo bali ne seese no lunweno ulwapangwa na golide ulwaisula ububani, nobu bubani e mapepo ya bantu bamushilo.

english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
translation: Esek 2:9-10

english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
translation: Elyo namona Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yapakubala pa namba cine lubali isho icitabo cafungilweko. Naumfwa icamweo cimo pali filya ifyamweo fine casosa ne shiwi ilyaumfwikike kwati kubulukuta kwa mfula aliti, “Isa!”

english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
translation: Balepunda na mashiwi ayakalamba baleti, “We Mfumu ya maka yonse, uwamushilo ne cishinka! Bushe pakapita inshita shani pakuti ukapingule no kukanda abantu ba pano calo pa mulandu wakutwipaya?”

english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
translation: Elyo cila muntu apeelwa umwingila uwabuuta. Elyo babeba ukutuushako akashita kanono mpaka impendwa yonse iya babomfi banabo na bamunyinabo bakabepaye nga filya nabo baipaiwe.

english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
translation: Kabili namona Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yalenga mutanda iyo icitabo cafungilweko. Awe kwapona ne cinkukuma icikalamba, akasuba kayaluka kafiita fititi kwati ni nsalu ya kafifi, elyo umweshi onse nao wayaluka uwakashika kwati mulopa.

english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
translation: Intanda mu mulu nasho elyo shalaponena pa calo, kwati ni filya ifipompo fya makunyu filukuta ku mukunyu ilyo icimwela icamaka caupukanya.

english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
translation: Umulu nao wafumapo kwati ni filya bapomba ubutanda pakubufumyapo. Impili ne fishi nafyo fyasela ukufuma pa ncende fyalipo.

english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
translation: Elyo ishamfumu sha pano isonde, bakateeka na bakalamba ba fita, abakankala bafyuma na bamaka, elyo na bantufye bonse, abasha na bantungwa, bafisama mu ncengo na mu fimabwe ifikulu ifya mu mpili.

english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,
translation: Elyo balabilikisha ku mpili na ku fimabwe ifikulu abati, “Twilikisheni mutufise na ku cinso ca wikele pa cipuna ca Mfumu na ku bukali bwa Mwana wa Mpanga!

english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”
translation: Pantu ubushiku bwabo ubwakukalipa nabwisa, nga nani engashipikisha?”

english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
translation: Awe nati ndoleshe, namona kabalwe uwabuuta. Uuninine pali kabalwe ekete ubuta kabili ninshi nabamupeela ne cisote cabufumu. Awe aima aya nga kacimfya, alecimfya no kucimfya.

english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.
translation: Awe kabalwe na umbi, wena uwakashika afuma. Uunininepo apeelwa amaka yakonaula icibote pa calo, epakuti abantu baleipayana. Wena apeelwa no lupanga ulukalamba.

english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
translation: Elyo Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yabutatu iyo icitabo cafungilweko. Naumfwa icamweo icalenga fitatu casosa aciti, “Isa!” Awe nati ndoleshe, namona kabalwe uwafiita. Uunininepo ekete icakupiminako ukufina kwa fintu mu minwe.

english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”
translation: Elyo naumfwa icongo icapala kwati lishiwi lyafuma pakati ka fyamweo fine aliti, “Amalipilo ya pa bushiku bumo ubutuntulu kushitamofye ubunga bwa ŋanu ubwafina kilo umo. Kabili amalipilo ya pa bushiku bumo ubutuntulu, kushitamofye ubunga bwa male ubwafina amakilo yatatu. Lelo mwionaula amafuta ya miolifa no mwangashi.”

english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
translation: Elyo Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yalenga shine iyo icitabo cafungilweko. Naumfwa icamweo icalenga fine casosa aciti, “Isa!”

english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
translation: Saka 1:8

english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
translation: Elyo kabili Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yalenga busano. Namona mwisamba lya bulambo imipashi ya bantu abo baipeye pa mulandu wa mashiwi yakwa Lesa na pali ico baiminine bukambone.

english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita, namona bamalaika bane beminine pa matungi yane aya calo. Aba bamalaika balelesha imyela ine ukuti nelyo umo wilapuupa pa calo nangu pali bemba nangu ku muti nelyo umo.

english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
translation: Elyo baikatisha amashiwi abati,

english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
translation: Bamalaika bonse ninshi beminine ukushinguluka icipuna ca Mfumu, abakalamba, ne fyamweo fine. Elyo bamalaika abo bafukama, bainamina panshi, balapepa Lesa,

english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
translation: abati,

english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”
translation: Elyo umo pa bakalamba anjipusha ati, “Bushe naubeshiba aba bafwele imingila yabuuta, kabili bushe ni kwi bafumine?”

english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
translation: Na ine nayasuka nati, “Mwe beshibe nimwe mukwai.”

english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
translation: Kanshi eco beminina pantanshi ya cipuna cakwa Lesa balemutumika ubwaca no bwaila mwitempele lyakwe. Uyu uwikele pa cipuna ca Mfumu apo ali nabo, akulabacingilila.

english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
translation: Tabakatale abomfwa nsala nangu icilaka nakabili. Kabili tabakatale abacula ku kasuba na ku cipuki.

english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
translation: Pantu Umwana wa Mpanga uuli pakati ka cipuna ca Mfumu, eukaba kacema wabo. Akalabatwala na ku tumfukumfuku twa menshi yakupeela umweo. Kabili Lesa akafuuta ifilamba fyonse ku menso yabo.”

english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
translation: Dan 7:2

english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
translation: Abeba ati, “Mwitala onaula icalo, bemba ne miti kano twatala twafwatika icishibilo pa mpumi sha basha bakwa Lesa wesu”

english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
translation: Esek 9:4

english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
translation: Saka 6:5

english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Asheri, 12,000.

english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Simeoni, 12,000.

english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
translation: Aba mu luko lwakwa Sebuloni, 12,000.

english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
translation: Ilyo ifi fyapita nati ndoleshe, namona ibumba lya bantu ilikalamba ilyo umuntu ashingapenda. Aba bantu bafumine ku mitundu yonse, ku mikowa yonse, ku mishobo yonse, na ku ba ndimi shonse, beminine pantanshi ya cipuna ca Mfumu, pa cinso ca Mwana wa Mpanga. Bafwele imingila iyabuuta nabekata no tuncindu mu minwe.

english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation: Ilyo Umwana wa Mpanga akakatulapo inamba yalenga cine lubali iyo icitabo cafungilweko, awe pa nsa imo pakati mu mulu mwatalalafye tondolo.

english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.
translation: Elyo malaika wabutatu nao alisha ipenga lyakwe. Ku mulu kwapona ulutanda ulukalamba, lulebilima kwati cisaniko, lwaponena pa ciputulwa cimo ica mimana iya pa fiputulwa fitatu ifya mimana na pa tumfukumfuku twa menshi.

english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
translation: Ishina lya ulo lutanda ni “Kulula.” Ne cipande cimo ica menshi pa fipande fitatu ifya menshi cayaluka amenshi ayalula. Awe na bantu abengi bafwa ico banwene ayo menshi, pantu yayalwike ayalula.

english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
translation: Levi 16:12

english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
translation: Kabili nati ndoleshe, naumfwa ishiwi ilyakwa kapumpe alepupuka mu mulu. Lilepunda lileti, “Owe, owe! We shamo we kuli bonse abo abekala pa calo, pa ciunda ca mapenga ayo bamalaika abo batatu balaswa balishe!”

english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
translation: Elyo namona bamalaika cine lubali beminine pa cinso cakwa Lesa, balepeelwa amapenga cine lubali.

english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
translation: Awe paisa malaika umbi ali ne cakubikamo ububani ica golide, aisa iminina mupepi no bulambo. Bamupeela ububani ubwingi ubo ali nokutuula pamo na mapepo ya bantu bamushilo pa bulambo ubwa golide ubwaba pantanshi ya cipuna ca Mfumu.

english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
translation: Elyo icushi ca bubani pamo na mapepo ya bantu bamushilo fyanina ukuya pa cinso cakwa Lesa ukufuma ku minwe yakwa malaika.

english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.
translation: Elyo malaika abula icakubikamo ububani acisushamo umulilo ukufuma pa bulambo, elyo aciposa na pa calo. Elyo kwaba ukubulukuta, ukupanta kwa mfula, imyele ya nkuba yalabyata, kwaba ne cinkukuma.

english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
translation: Elyo bamailaka cine lubali abali na mapenga cine lubali balaipekanya ukuyalisha.

english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
translation: Malaika uwakubalilapo alisha ipenga lyakwe. Imfula ya mabwe no mulilo ifyasakanamo no mulopa fyaposwa pa calo. Icipande cimo pa fipande fitatu ifya calo ne ca miti, pamo pene ne cani conse icamulemfwe fyapya nakalya nakalya.

english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
translation: Elyo malaika wabubili nao alisha ipenga lyakwe. Elyo icintu cimo icapala ulupili ulukalamba cilebilima no mulilo caposwa muli bemba. Elyo icipande cimo pa fipande fitatu ifya bemba cayaluka umulopa.

english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
translation: Elyo pa mabumba yonse yatatu aya fibumbwa ifipema ifikala muli bemba, ibumba limo lyafwa. Elyo ne mpuka imo iya mato pa mpuka shitatu isha mato nayo yaonaulwa.

english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
translation: Elyo malaika walenga basano alisha ipenga lyakwe. Namona ulutanda ulwacipona ukufuma mu mulu, balupeela ulufungulo lwa pa cilindi calola ku muyenge.

english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
translation: Abo bamakanta bali ne mbola mu micila yabo kwati ni kaliŋongo. Kabili ni ku maka ya mu micila yabo eko bakalacushisha abantu pa myeshi isano.

english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
translation: Baliba ne mfumu yakubateeka, ni malaika uwangalila umuyenge. Ishina lyakwe mu Cihibulu ni Abadoni, mu Cigiriki mwena ni Apolioni, calola mukuti, “Uwabonaushi.”

english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
translation: Elyo malaika walenga mutanda alisha ipenga lyakwe. Naumfwa ishiwi lyafuma ku matungi yane ya bulambo bwa golide ubuli pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
translation: Ishiwi lyaeba malaika uuli ne penga aliti, “Kakula bamalaika bane abo bakakila pa mumana ukalamba Yufurate!”

english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
translation: Awe akakula bamalaika balya bane. Aba bamalaika bapekanishiwe kale ukwipaya icipande cimo pa fipande fitatu ifya bantu bonse pa nshita ine iyi, pali buno bwine bushiku, muli uno wine mweshi wa uno wine mwaka.

english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
translation: Elyo naumfwa ukuti ifita fya pali bakabalwe, ni bamilioni imyanda ibili, (200,000,000).

english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
translation: Kabili mu cimonwa candi, namona bakabalwe na banininepo bafwele ifyela fyakucingilila icifuba ifyakashika kwati mulilo, ne fyaba kwati cifufya, ne fyamutuntula. Imitwe ya bakabalwe yena ilemoneka kwati mitwe ya nkalamo na mu tunwa twabo mulefuma umulilo, icushi ne fyanunka nga maluti.

english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
translation: Ifi finkunka fitatu, umulilo, icushi, ne fyanunka nga maluti ifyalefuma mu tunwa twa bakabalwe, fyaipaya icipande cimo pa fipande fitatu ifya bantu bonse.

english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
translation: Pantu amaka ya bakabalwe yaba mu tunwa twabo elyo na mu micila yabo. Imicila yabo yaba ne mitwe kwati ni nsoka. Ni mukubomfya imitwe bacushisha abantu.

english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
translation: Lwaisula ne cilindi icalola ku muyenge. Awe mwafuma icushi kwati cushi cifuma mwilungu lya mulilo. Akasuba na mu mulu mwafiitafye fititi ku cushi cilefuma mu muyenge.

english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.
translation: Lelo abantu abasheleko, abo bonse abashafwile kuli ifi finkunka, tabatalwike ku fintu ifyo bapanga ne minwe yabo. Tabalekele ukupepa imipashi yakowela, nangu utulubi utwapangwa na golide, na silifa, no mukuba, na mabwe, ne fimuti, kabili tatumona nangu ukumfwa nangu ukwenda.

english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
translation: Kabili tabalekele ukwipaya abantu, ubuloshi, ubulalelale nangu ukwiba.

english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
translation: Elyo mu cushi mwafuma bamakanta baisa pa calo, bapeelwe na maka ayo bakaliŋongo ba pano calo bakwata.

english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
translation: Babalesha ukonaula icani, nangu ifimuti, nangu conse cimbi icimena pano calo. Lelo kuti bacushafye abo bantu abashafwatikwa icishibilo cakwa Lesa pa mpumi shabo.

english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
translation: Kwena bamakanta tababasuminishe ukwipaya abo bantu, kanofye ukubacusha pa myeshi isano. Bamakanta aba nga basuma umuntu, ubukali bwabo bwali kwati bukali umuntu omfwa nga asumwa na kaliŋongo.

english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
translation: Muli iyo myeshi isano, abo bantu bakafwaya imfwa, lelo tabakaisange. Bakafwaisha ukufwa, lelo imfwa ikabataluka.

english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
translation: Bamakanta balemoneka kwati ni bakabalwe abo bateyenye ukuya ku bulwi. Pa mitwe yabo pena pali ifyapala kwati fisote fyabufumu ifya golide, elyo impumi shabo shena kwati ni mpumi sha bantu.

english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
translation: Imishishi yabo nayo kwati mishishi ya banakashi, elyo ameno yabo yena kwati meno ya nkalamo.

english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.
translation: Pa fifuba fyabo pali ifintu ifyapala kwati cela bafwala pakucingilila icifuba. Elyo icongo calepanga amapindo yabo cali kwati congo cipanga amaceleta ayo bakabalwe baletinta ilyo balebutukila ku bulwi.

english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ine ndafwaisha nganshi no mutima wandi onse no kupepelako abena Israeli ukuti bakapusuke.

english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
translation: Pantu ni mukusumina mu mutima emo tumwena ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa. Elyo mukulumbula pa lwalala, lyena ninshi twapusuka.

english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
translation: Kabili Amalembo Yamushilo yatila, “Uyo onse uwacetekela Lesa takekatwe ne nsoni.”

english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Abantu bonse abakalilila peshina lya Mfumu ebakapusuka.”

english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
translation: Nomba bushe kuti bakuuta shani Imfumu iyo bashasumina? Nga kuti basumina shani Imfumu, iyo bashatala abomfwapo? Nga kuti baumfwapo shani nga takuli uwakubabilila?

english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
translation: Nga kuti babila shani nga tababatumine? Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Ala yaliyemba amakasa ya baleta Imbila Nsuma!”

english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
translation: Esaya 28:16

english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
translation: Kanshi icisumino cifuma ku mashiwi bomfwa. Elyo na aya mashiwi, yantu bafundwa pali Kristu.

english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
translation: Nomba ine ndeipusha, bushe cine cine tabaumfwa? Awe ukumfwa balyumfwa! Kabili calembwa ukuti,

english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
translation: Nakabili ndeipusha, bushe abena Israeli tabaishiba umo calola? Mose umwine ayasuka kale ati,

english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
translation: Ine ndi kambone wabo ukuti balicincila nganshi mukubombela Lesa. Nomba babombafye ukwabula ukwishiba ico balecita.

english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
translation: Esaya wena alisosekeshapo nganshi ati,

english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
translation: Amaf 32:21

english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
translation: Pantu tabaishiba inshila Lesa alwilamo abantu ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe. Bena abene baifwaila inshila shabo. Kanshi eico bakaanina ukubomfya inshila Lesa alwilamo abantu ukuti babe abakaele pa cinso cakwe.

english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
translation: Pantu Amafunde yakwa Mose yapelelafye pali Kristu, epakuti abamusumina, Lesa abalule ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe.

english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
translation: Mose alemba pakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya ukulingana na Mafunde yakwe ayatila, “Uyo onse uusunga aya mafunde, ni ku mafunde akekalila umumi.”

english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
translation: Nomba ifyalandwa pakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya ukulingana ne cisumino fitila, “Wilasosa mu mutima obe auti, ‘Nani enganina mu mulu?’” (Ici ekweba ukuti Kristu ekile panshi.)

english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
translation: “Nangu ukusosa ukuti, ‘Nani engekila ku calo ca bafwa?’” (Ici ekweba ukuti Kristu abuuke ku bafwa.)

english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
translation: Lelo Amalembo Yamushilo yatila, “Ishiwi lilifye mupepi na iwe. Lili mu kanwa kobe na mu mutima obe.” Ili line e shiwi lya citetekelo tubila.

english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
translation: Kanshi nga walumbula pa lwalala auti, “Yesu ni Mfumu,” kabili na mu mutima obe nausumina ukuti Lesa alimubusha ku bafwa, awe ninshi wapusuka.

english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
translation: Kanshi ndeipusha, bushe Lesa alisuulako ku bantu bakwe? Awe iyoo! Ine wine ndi mwina Israeli, uwa mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu, mu luko lwakwa Benjamini.

english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
translation: Isham 19:10

english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
translation: Kanshi ndeipusha nati, ilyo abena Israeli bawa, bushe baliwililafye calipwa? Awe ico cakaana! Pantu ukubifya kwabo kwalenga ukuti Abenafyalo balepusuka, elyo abena Israeli nabo babe no mufimbila ku Benafyalo.

english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
translation: Ububifi bwa bena Israeli bwalenga ukuti abantu ba pano isonde bapaalwe. Elyo no kuluba kwabo kuli Lesa kwalenga ukuti Abenafyalo bapaalwe. Kanshi ilyo abena Israeli bonse bakabwelela kuli Lesa, lyena ninshi ipaalo likacililako.

english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
translation: Nomba nimwe nalalandako mwe Benafyalo. Ala ndomfwa icilumba pali uyu mulimo wakuba umusole wa Benafyalo,

english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
translation: pantu limbi kuti nalenga abantu ba mushobo wandi balaumfwa ubufuba, nasuka napusushako bamo.

english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
translation: Pantu ico Lesa abasuulako, nomba abantu ba pano isonde balishukila ukuwikishanya na Lesa. Nga kanshi cikaba shani ilyo kabili akalula abena Israeli ukuba abantu bakwe? Tacakabefye kwati kubusha abafwa!

english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
translation: Icipande ca mufuba nga bacituula kuli Lesa, ninshi no mufuba onse nautuulwa kuli Lesa. Imishila ya muti nga yatuulwa kuli Lesa, ninshi ne misambo ine nayo naituulwa kuli Lesa.

english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
translation: Nga baputula imisambo imo iya muolifa uo abantu balimba, kuti bakambatikako imisambo ya miolifa iya mu mpanga. Mwe Benafyalo imwe mwaba nge misambo ya miolifa iya mu mpanga. Nomba na imwe mulepoka icakulya cakumupeela amaka ukufuma ku mishila ya muolifa uwalimbwa.

english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
translation: Isham 19:18

english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
translation: Nalimo iwe kuti watila, “Ico bafumisheko iyo misambo, ni pakuti ine bankambatikeko.”

english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
translation: Awe Lesa tasuulako ku bantu bakwe abo aisalile umwine ukufumafye na ku kale. Mwalishiba ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo pali Eliya ilyo aleilishanya kuli Lesa pa mulandu wa bena Israeli.

english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
translation: Ee cacishinka. Iyo misambo baliifumisheko ico ishali na cisumino. Kanshi iwe kosapofye, wilaba na cilumba, lelo uleba na katiina.

english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
translation: Kanshi apo Lesa taleka imisambo ya miolifa ine ine ukulakula, bushe iwe niwe akaleka ukashale ulekula?

english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
translation: Na bena Israeli nga banakila Lesa, basumina, ninshi Lesa akabakambatika ku muolifa nakabili. Pantu Lesa tekuti afilwe ukubakambatikako nakabili.

english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
translation: Imwe mwe Benafyalo mwaba ngo musambo wa muolifa uwa mu mpanga uo abantu baputula. Elyo nangu tefyo cifwile ukuba, lelo baukambatika ku muolifa uo abantu balimba. Abena Israeli bena baba nge misambo ya muolifa uo abantu balimba. Kanshi kuti cayanguka nganshi kuli Lesa ukukambatika imisambo yaputuka, kwishinte uko yafumine.

english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, nshilefwaya ukuti mube ne cilumba cakuti muli bamano. Ndefwaya ukuti mwishibe bwino inkaama yakwa Lesa. Abena Israeli bamo bantu baumalala imitima. Kabili bakashala ifyo fine mpaka impendwa ya Benafyalo abakanakila Lesa ikakumane.

english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
translation: Elyo panuma abena Israeli bonse nabo bakapusuka. Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
translation: Nkapangana nabo icipangano,

english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
translation: Abena Israeli basanguka abalwani bakwa Lesa, ico basuula Imbila Nsuma. Ici calenga na imwe mwe Benafyalo mushukilemo. Lelo apo Lesa abasala, alibatemwa pa mulandu wa fikolwe fyabo.

english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
translation: Pantu Lesa tafutuka. Tapoka ubupe apeela umuntu, kabili uo aita, ninshi alala amwita.

english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
translation: Atila ati, “We Mfumu balipaya bakasesema bobe, balitobaula ne fibumbili fya malambo fyobe. Elyo nomba nshelepofye neka, kabili na ine wine balefwaya ukunjipaya.”

english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
translation: Imwe mwe Benafyalo kale tamwalenakila Lesa. Lelo nomba mwalishukila uluse lwakwa Lesa, ico Abena Israeli bashinakila Lesa.

english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
translation: Kanshi eifyo, imwe mwalishukila uluse lwakwa Lesa, nomba abena Israeli bena tabanakila Lesa, epakuti nabo nomba bashukile uluse lwakwa Lesa.

english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
translation: Pantu Lesa aleka abantu bonse bobelwe no kukanamunakila, epakuti alelanga uluse ku bantu bonse.

english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
translation: Yangu we bukankala bwakwa Lesa nobe ulakula!

english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
translation: Nani waishiba ifitontonkanya Imfumu?

english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
translation: “Nani watala abangilisha Lesa ubupe,

english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
translation: Ifintu fyonse fyafuma kuli Lesa. Ni Lesa walenga ukuti fibepo, kabili eo fili nokubombela. Lesa eufwile ukulalumbwa pe na pe! Ameni.

english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
translation: Bushe Lesa amwaswike shani? Lesa atile, “Ne mwine naliisungila abantu amakana cine lubali abo amakufi yabo tayatala ayafukamina Baali.”

english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
translation: Fili 3:5

english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
translation: Kanshi ni ku mulandu wa cikuuku cakwe eco abasalila, te pa mulandu wa fintu babomba. Nga cakuti ni pafyo babomba, ninshi icikuuku cakwa Lesa cafyefye.

english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
translation: Kanshi caba shani? Abena Israeli tabasangile ico balefwaya. Abasangile ico balefwaya bantufye banono abo Lesa asalile. Bambi bena, Lesa alekele ukuti bomalale imitima.

english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
translation: Elyo Davidi nao atila ati,

english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, Lesa alitukwatila uluse ulukalamba. Kanshi eico ndemupapata ukuti mu bumi bwenu muleituula kuli Lesa nge lambo ilyamweo, ilyamushilo kabili ilimusansamusha. Ili e pepo line line muli nokutuula.

english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
translation: Muletemwana ne citemwiko cabwananyina. Kabili mulesakamana ukulacindikana.

english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
translation: Mulekalabana, mwilaba na bunaŋani. Mulebombela Imfumu ne mitima yenu yonse.

english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
translation: Mulekumbusukako abamushilo abalanda. Kabili mulesekelela abeni kumyenu.

english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
translation: Mulepaala abantu abalemucusha. Ee, mulebapaala, mwilabatipwila iyoo.

english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
translation: Mulesansamuka pamo na balesansamuka. Muleloosha na baleloosha.

english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
translation: Muleba ne cikuuku kuli bonse. Mwiba na cilumba, lelo muletemwa no kwikala na balanda bene. Mwilaitunga ukuba abamano.

english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
translation: Umuntu nga amubifya, mwilailandula. Lelo mulecita ifintu ifyakuti bonse bamona ukuti fisuma.

english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
translation: Kanshi muli fyonse ifyo mulecita, imwe mulemona ukuti muleikala mu mutende na bantu bonse.

english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
translation: Mwilailandula mwe babile bandi, lekeni Lesa eo alelandula. Pantu calembwa ukuti,

english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
translation: Mwilapashanya myendele yenu ku myendele ya bantu ba pano calo. Mutole amano yapya pakuti mwalule imyendele yenu. Lyena ninshi mukeshiba ifyo Lesa afwaya, ifyawama, ifimusansamusha, kabili ifyapwililika.

english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
translation: Kabili calembwa nokuti,

english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
translation: Pa mulandu wa cikuuku Lesa ankwatila, ndemweba bonse ukuti mwilaitunga ukucila pafyo mwaba. Lelo mube abaicefya mu mitontonkanishishe yenu. Cila umo aleipimafye ku cisumino Lesa amupeela.

english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
translation: Umubili wesu waba ne filundwa ifingi. Elyo cila cilundwa caba no mulimo waciko.

english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
translation: Eifyo fine mukuba muli Kristu. Nangu twaba abengi, lelo tupangafye umubili umo muli Kristu. Kanshi nangu twaba ifilundwa ifyalekana lekana, twalisuntinkana no kupangafye umubili umo.

english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
translation: Eico kanshi tuli nokubomfya ubupe bwesu ubwalekana lekana ukulingana nomo Lesa atupeelela ku cikuuku cakwe. Ngo bupe bwakusesema, ninshi ali nokububomfya ukulingana ne cisumino cakwe.

english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
translation: Nga bupe bwakutumika, ninshi aletumika. Nga bupe bwakufunda, ninshi alefunda.

english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
translation: Nga bupe bwakukoselesha bambi, ninshi alekoselesha bambi. Uyo uukumbusuka bambi, ali nokucita ifyo ukwabula akaso. Uuleteeka bambi, ali nokuteeka na mano. Uulebomba imilimo yaluse, ali nokubomba ne nsansa.

english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
translation: Icitemwiko cenu cibe icacishinka. Mulepata ifyabipa, muleikatisha ifisuma.

english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
translation: Umuntu onse ali nokunakila ubuteko. Pantu ubuteko bonse bwafuma kuli Lesa. Ubuteko bonse ubwabapo ni Lesa walenga ukuti bubepo.

english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
translation: Umuntu uwatemwa umubiye, tekuti amucitile icintu icibi iyoo. Eico kanshi ukutemwana ekufikilisha Amafunde yonse ayakwa Mose.

english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
translation: Namwishiba inshita tulimo, kanshi mulecita ifi nalanda. Inshita naifika iyakubuuka mu tulo. Pantu inshita yakupusuka naipalama ukucila lilya twatampile ukusumina.

english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
translation: Tulifye nomba ku macaca, bwalaswa buce! Kanshi natuleke ukucita ificitwa fya mfifi, nomba natufwale ifyabulwi ifyakulwilako mu kasuba.

english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
translation: Kanshi natubuule imyendele isuma, imyendele iyo abantu benda nayo mu kasuba. Natutaluke ku malila yabi nangu kuli bucakolwa, ku bulalelale nangu ku misango yonse iyibi, kukuumana nangu ku mufimbila.

english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
translation: Ukuf 20:14

english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
translation: Kanshi onse uwakaana ukumfwila ubuteko, ninshi akaana no mulimo uwashimpwa na Lesa. Elyo na onse uwacita ifyo, ninshi akailetela ukupingulwa.

english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
translation: Abantu abacita ifisuma, bena tabatiina bakateeka, lelo abalufyanya bena balabatiina. Bushe ulefwaya ukukanatiina umuntu uuleteeka? Ninshi ulecita ifisuma, lyena na kateeka akakutasha.

english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
translation: Pantu kateeka mubomfi wakwa Lesa, uufwile ukukubombela ifintu ifisuma. Nomba nga walufyanya, lyena uli nokumutiina, pantu aba nokubomfya amaka yakukanda akwata. Kateeka, mubomfi wakwa Lesa. Kanshi alakanda abalufyanya pakulanga ubukali bwakwa Lesa.

english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
translation: Kanshi muli nokulaumfwila abateeka, te pa mulandu wakuti baba na maka yakumukanda, lelo nico kampingu wa mitima yenu amona ukuti nacilungama.

english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
translation: E mulandu wine musonkela ne misonko, pantu bakateeka babomfi bakwa Lesa, ilyo babomba imilimo bafwile ukubomba.

english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
translation: Mulepeela bonse ifyo muli nokubapeela. Mulebapeela imisonko yonse iyo mwaba nokubapeela. Kabili mulebacindika no kubakwatila akatiina.

english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
translation: Mwilaba ne nkongole ku muntu nelyo umo, kanofye ninshi inkongole yakutemwana. Uyo onse uwatemwa umuntu mubiye ninshi nafikilisha Amafunde yakwa Mose.

english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
translation: Ifyebo fitila, “Wilabembuka, wilaipaya, wilaiba, wilakumbwa fya bene,” ifi fyebo fyonse na fimbi fine fyonse, fyashintafye pali ici cebo cimo icakuti, “Uletemwa umubiyo ngefyo waitemwa we mwine.”

english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
translation: Mulesekelela umuntu nangu tali na cisumino icakosa. Mwilabikana nankwe ifikansa pafyo umwine aletontonkanya.

english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
translation: Nomba iwe, bushe cinshi ico upingwila munonko? Na iwe, nga cinshi usuulila munonko? Ala bonse tukeminina pa cinso cakwa Lesa, elyo akatupingule.

english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
translation: Pantu calembwa ukuti,

english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
translation: Mwamona kanshi, bonse umo umo tuli nokuya ilubulwila kuli Lesa.

english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
translation: Kanshi natuleke ukulapingula abanensu. Kabili mupange mu mitima yenu ukukanacitila munonko icakumupunwisha nangu ukumulenga ukuwila mukubifya.

english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
translation: Ine ku cisumino candi mu Mfumu Yesu nalishininkisha ukuti takwaba cakulya icikowesha. Lelo umuntu wena nga asumina ukuti ici cakulya cilakowesha, ee wena kuti camukowesha.

english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
translation: Nomba icakulya ulelya nga calalenga munonko ukucula, ninshi ifyo ulecita tamuli citemwiko. Wileka icakulya ulelya cilenge munonko ukuloba uo Kristu afwilile.

english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
translation: Kolo 2:16

english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
translation: Pantu Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa tabwaba pafyo abantu balya nangu ukunwa. Lelo Ubufumu bwakwa Lesa bwaba mukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, mukuba no mutende, elyo ne nsansa Mupashi Wamushilo apeela.

english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
translation: Lyena nga mwalabombela Kristu muli uyu musango, ninshi mukalasansamusha Lesa, na bantu nabo bakamutasha.

english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
translation: Kanshi lyonse natulecita ifintu ifyakutuletela umutende, ifyakutwafwako ukwikala bwino na banensu.

english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
translation: Umuntu umo icisumino cakwe kuti camweba ukulalya fyonse. Elyo umbi uo icisumino cakwe tacakosa wena alalyafye imisalu.

english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
translation: Wilaleka imilimo yakwa Lesa yonaike pa mulandufye wa fyakulya. Tapaba cakulya icikowesha. Lelo kwena cilubo ukulya icakulya conse, nga cakuti kuti calenga umuntu umbi ukuwila mukubifya.

english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
translation: Kanshi kuti cawamapo ukukanalya inama nangu ukunwa umwangashi nangu ukucita conse cimbi icingalenga munonko ukuwila mukubifya.

english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
translation: Ifyo wasumina pali uyu mulandu, fisungefye we mwine na Lesa. Alishuka umuntu uucita ifyo aletontonkanya ukuti nafilungama, kabili asanga nokuti tamuli cilubo mufyo apingwile ukucita.

english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
translation: Esaya 45:23

english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
translation: Umuntu uulya fyonse tali nakusuula uushilya fyonse. Elyo no muntu uulyafye imisalu tali nakweba uulya fyonse ukuti alelufyanya. Awe iyoo, pantu Lesa alimusekelela.

english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
translation: Bushe mulimo obe ukupingula umubomfi wa muntu umbi? Ni shikulu wakwe eumona ukuti umubomfi wakwe alebomba bwino nangu alefilwa ukubomba bwino. Lelo kwena akabomba bwino, pantu Imfumu ikalenga ukuti akalebomba bwino.

english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
translation: Abantu bamo kuti batontonkanya ukuti inshiku shimo shalicindama ukucila ishibiye, bambi bena baleti inshiku shonse shabafye cimo cine. Cila muntu ali nokushininkisha ukuti ico aletontonkanya e cishinka.

english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
