translation: Umuntu onse uucindikishapo ubushiku bumo ukucila shimbi, ali nokucita ifyo mukucindika Imfumu. Umuntu onse uulya fyonse, alacindika Imfumu mukulya fyonse, kabili alatasha Lesa. Elyo no muntu nao uushilya fyonse, alacindika Imfumu mukukanalya fyonse, kabili alatasha Lesa.

english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
translation: Tapali nangu umo pali ifwe uuyendela umumi umwine, kabili tapali nangu umo pali ifwe uufwa, aifwilafye umwine.

english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
translation: Ilyo twenda abomi, ni Mfumu twendela abomi. Kabili ilyo twafwa, ni Mfumu eyo tufwila. Kanshi nangu tuli abomi nangu twafwa, tuli bantu ba Mfumu.

english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
translation: Pantu ico Kristu afwilile kabili aisa buuka umumi ni pakuti abe Mfumu ya bomi na bafwa.

english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
translation: Ifwe fwe ba cisumino cakosa tuli nokwafwako abo icisumino cishilakosa mu bwafya balesanga. Twilacita ifyakutuwaminafye.

english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
translation: Na pambi calembwa ukuti,

english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
translation: Pambi napo calembwa ukuti,

english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
translation: Kabili Esaya nao alanda ati,

english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
translation: Cawama Lesa uulenga ukuti mube ne subilo, engalenga nokuti imitima yenu isulemo insansa, mube no mutende pali ico mwamusumina. Epakuti ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo mulecililakofye ukulasubila.

english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
translation: Mwe bamunyinane ine nalishininkisha ukuti muli basuma icine cine. Kabili mwalishiba fyonse ifyo muli nokucita. Kanshi kuti mulefundana.

english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
translation: Kwena muli uyu kalata naba uwapama nganshi mukulanda pa milandu imo imo iyo namwibukishako. Nalanda ifi, pa mulandu wa cikuuku Lesa ankwatila.

english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
translation: Ni Lesa wanenga ukuba umubomfi wakwa Kristu uwakubombela Abenafyalo. Pakuti, mukulabomba umulimo wa bushimapepo uwakubila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Lesa, Abenafyalo nabo babe ngo mutuulo wakusansamusha Lesa, abasangululwa na Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
translation: Kanshi ine kwena kuti naumfwa icilumba cakuba umubomfi wakwa Lesa ku maka Kristu ampeela.

english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
translation: Teti ntendeke ukulanda pa fintu fimbi kanofye ifyo Kristu afikilisha ukubomba muli ine ifyakulenga ukuti abenafyalo nabo banakile Lesa ukupitila mufyo nalelanda no kucita.

english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
translation: Kabili nefyo Kristu alenga ukuti ncite ifishibilo ne finjelengwe ku maka yakwa Mupashi Wamushilo. Kanshi nalibila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Kristu mpangafye yonse ukufuma ku Yerusalemu ukufika na ku Ililikamu.

english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
translation: Bonse umo umo tufwile ukucitila bamunyinefwe ifyakubawamina, pakuti nabo bakose mu cisumino.

english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
translation: Eico mfwaishafye kubila Imbila Nsuma mu ncende umo bashilaishiba Kristu. Pantu mukucita ifi, ninshi lyena nshilekuula apo bambi baimba umufula.

english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
translation: Imiku iyingi nalefwaya ukwisa kumwenu, lelo uyu mulandu ewandesha.

english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
translation: Ku ncende ya kuno kwena imilimo naipwa. Kabili pa myaka iyingi iyapita nalefwaisha nganshi ukwisa mumona.

english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
translation: Nomba ndesubila ukwisa mumona ili nkalaya ku Speni. Ndesubila mukesa ngafwilishako pali ulu lwendo, lelo kwena nkasansamuka ukwikala na imwe akashita kanono.

english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
translation: Pali nomba ndi nokuya ku Yerusalemu kukutwalako ifyakwafwilisha.

english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
translation: Abena Makedonia na bena Akaia abenefye balipingushanya ukusangula ifyakwafwako abalanda mu bamushilo mu Yerusalemu.

english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
translation: Abene bekafye ebapingushanya ukucita ifyo. Lelo kwena baba nokwafwilisha abalanda. Apo Abenafyalo nabo bashukilako ipaalo lyakwa Lesa ilyo Abayuda bakwata, kanshi Abenafyalo nabo bali nokwafwilishako Abayuda ku fyuma Lesa abapeela.

english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
translation: Kanshi nkatila nga napwisha uyu mulimo, nabapeela na fyonse ifyo basangula ifyakubafwako, lyena ninshi nkema ubulendo bwa ku Speni. Lelo ilyo nkalaya, nkesa mupempula.

english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
translation: Ilyo nkesa uko, ninjishiba ukuti nkamwishila ne paalo lyonse ilyakwa Kristu.

english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
translation: Pantu nangu ni Kristu wine talecita ifyakumuwaminafye. Lelo calembwa ukuti, “Umusaalula abantu bakusaalula waba pali ine.”

english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
translation: Mwe bamunyinane, ku cisumino mwakwata mu Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu na ku citemwiko Mupashi Wamushilo amukwatila, ndemupapata mulengafwilishako mu bulwi mukumpepelako kuli Lesa.

english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
translation: Mulempepelako pakuti nkapusuke ku bantu ba mu Yudeya abashinakila Lesa. Mulempepelako na pakuti mu Yerusalemu bakapokelele ifyakubafwako ifyo ndebatwalila.

english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
translation: Lesa nga alefwaya, lyena nkashukila insansa shakwisa kumwenu nkese tuushako, tukasansamuke pamo na imwe.

english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
translation: Lesa wamutende, engalaba na imwe bonse. Ameni.

english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
translation: Fyonse ifyalembwa mu Malembo Yamushilo fyalembelwa pakutufunda. Pantu Amalembo Yamushilo yapeela umutekatima ne cikoseleshi epakuti tube ne subilo.

english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
translation: Kanshi Lesa uupeela umutekatima ne cikoseleshi, engalenga nokuti imwe bonse mubefye umutima umo ngefyo Kristu Yesu atulanga.

english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Epakuti bonse capamo ne shiwi limo mulelumbanya Lesa, Wishi wa Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
translation: Eico mulesekelelana nga filya fine Kristu amusekelela, pakuti Lesa acindikwe.

english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
translation: Kanshi ndemweba ukuti Kristu alebombela Abayuda, pakufikilisha ifyo Lesa alaile ifikolwe ifyalumbuka, kabili alanga nefyo Lesa aba uwacishinka.

english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
translation: Amalu 69:9

english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
translation: Ndefwaya ukumweba ukuti Febi nkashi yesu uyo, muntu umusuma, umubomfi mu lukuta lwa mu Kenkrea.

english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
translation: Ndeposha Apele umubomfi wacine cine muli Kristu. Ndeposhapo na bonse aba mu ŋanda yakwa Alisitobulo.

english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
translation: Ndeposha Herodioni, Umuyuda munandi. Ndeposha abanandi aba mu ŋanda yakwa Nakiso abanakila Imfumu.

english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
translation: Ndeposha ababomfi ba Mfumu abapambana, Trufena na Trufosa. Ndeposha na cibusa wandi Pesisi nao uwabombela Imfumu nganshi.

english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
translation: Ndeposha Rufusi, umubomfi wine wine wa Mfumu, ndeposhapo na banyina, bena lyonse balensunga kwatifye ndi mwana wabo.

english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
translation: Ndeposha Asunkriti, Filegoni, Hemesi, Patuloba, Hema, na bonse bamunyinefwe abo bali nabo.

english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
translation: Ndeposha Filologo na Yulia, Nele na nkashi yakwe, Olimpa na bamushilo bonse abo balongana nabo.

english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
translation: Muleposhanya mu kutomona kwamushilo. Inkuta shonse ishakwa Kristu shilemuposha.

english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
translation: Bamunyinane ndemusokako. Mulecenjela ku bantu baleleta akapatulula, abalemufulunganya mu cisumino, abalefunda ne fyapusana nefyo mwafundwa. Muletaluka kuli aba bantu.

english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
translation: Pantu abantu ba uyu musango tabasakamana kubombela Kristu Imfumu yesu, lelo basakamanafye ifyakuisansamusha. Bafulunganya amano ya bantu abakaele mukubomfya amashiwi ayasuma, ayakubasembeleka.

english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
translation: Imwe abantu bonse balishiba bwino ifyo mwapetamina Kristu, neci cilalenga ukuti ndesansamuka. Ine mfwaya mube na mano yakucita ifisuma, muletaluka ku fyabipa.

english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
translation: Mumusekelele ngo mubomfi wa Mfumu, filya abamushilo bengasekelela umunabo. Mulemwafwako mu bwafwilisho bonse alekabila, pantu alyafwako abantu abengi na ine wine alingafwako.

english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
translation: Na Lesa wamutende akalenga mukacimfye Satana. Icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe.

english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
translation: Timote umubomfi munandi nao alemuposha. Elyo na Bayuda banandi Lukio, Yasoni, na Sosipata nabo balemuposha.

english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
translation: Na ine wine ne Tesio ne walemba uyu kalata, na ine ndemuposha.

english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
translation: Gayo uo nafikililako, kabili ni mumwakwe emo ulukuta lulongana, nao amuposha. Elasto, kasunga wa cipao ca musumba pamo na munyinefwe Kwato, nabo bamuposha.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
translation: Icikuuku ca Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu cileba na imwe bonse. Ameni.

english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
translation: Ndeposhapo Prisila na Akwila ababomfi banandi mu mulimo wakwa Kristu Yesu.

english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
translation: Aba bantu pa mulandu wakumpususha, tabatiinine no kufwa kwine. Kabili teine neka mbatasha, lelo ne nkuta shonse sha Benafyalo nasho shilabatasha.

english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
translation: Ndeposhapo no lukuta ululongana mu ŋanda yabo.

english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
translation: Ndeposhapo Maria, uwamubombela nganshi apakalamba.

english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
translation: Ndeposhapo Anduloniko na Yunia, Abayuda banandi abo twali nabo mu cifungo. Aba bantu bena bali abalumbuka nganshi pakati ka basole, kabili bena balyampene na Kristu, ine ninshi nshilati.

english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
translation: Ndeposha na Ampuliato cibusa wandi mu Mfumu.

english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
translation: Ndeposha Urbano, umubomfi munandi muli Kristu, elyo na cibusa wandi Sitakusi.

english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
translation: Ine Paulo umusha wakwa Kristu Yesu namulembela uyu kalata. Ni Lesa ewanjita ukuba umusole. Ewansala pakuti ndebila Imbila Nsuma.

english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
translation: Lyonse ilyo mpepa, ndalomba Lesa ukuti nga alefwaya kuti aleka nomba naisa mupempula.

english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
translation: Pantu ndefwaisha nganshi ukumumona, kusuka mwamona kuli ine ukulakoselela ku cafwilisho ca bupe bwakwa Mupashi.

english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
translation: Kanshi nalosha mukutila, tukalekoseleshanya bonse ku cisumino cesu twakwata umo umo.

english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
translation: Bamunyinane, ndefwaya mwishibe ukuti, ala imikufye iyingi napanga ukwisa mupempula, lelo ukufika na ndakai kulaba fimo ifyakundesha. Ndefwaya na kuli imwe mwe bena Roma nkamwenepo na bambi abakunakila Kristu, nga filya nacita ku Benafyalo bambi.

english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
translation: Pantu ine ndi nokubombela abantu bonse, umuntungwa no ushili muntungwa, uwasambilila no ushasambilila.

english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
translation: Kanshi ndefwaisha nganshi ukwisa bila Imbila Nsuma na kuli imwe, mwe bena Roma.

english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
translation: Ine nshumfwa nsoni pa Mbila Nsuma! Imbila Nsuma e maka yakwa Lesa ayapususha bonse abasumina, pakubala Abayuda, elyo na Benafyalo bene.

english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
translation: Pantu Imbila Nsuma isokolola ifyo Lesa atucita ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe, elyo neci caba mukuba ne cisumino epela. Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Umololoke ena akulaba umumi pa mulandu wa citetekelo.”

english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
translation: Ubukali bwakwa Lesa nabusokoloka ukufuma ku mulu. Bwishile pa bantu bonse abashicita ifyo Lesa afwaya na pa fibi fyonse ifyo abantu bacita. Pantu ni ku misango yabo ibi, balesha icishinka ukwishibikwa.

english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
translation: Kabili ifintu abantu bengeshiba pali Lesa, balifishibafye bwino. Lesa umwine ifi fintu alibeshibisha.

english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
translation: Lesa kale na kale alaile Imbila Nsuma mukutuma bakasesema bakwe, ngomo calembelwa mu Malembo Yamushilo.

english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
translation: Pantu ukufumafye apo Lesa abumbile isonde, amaka yakwe aya pe na pe na Bulesa bwakwe, nangu fyonse fishimoneka, lelo balifishibafye bwino bwino. Abantu balafimona mu fintu Lesa acita. Kanshi eico aba bantu tabakwata na kabepesho nakalya!

english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
translation: Imili 19:21

english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
translation: Baitunga ukuba abamano, kanshi fiwelewele.

english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
translation: Bafuma na kukupepa Lesa umucindami uushifwa, balapepa utulubi utwapala umuntu uufwa, nangu utwapala ifyuni, nangu inama nangu ifikulaika panshi.

english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
translation: Kanshi eico Lesa alibaleka bakonkelele ulunkumbwa lubi lwa mitima yabo. Bacita ifyabupulumushi ifyamusebanya nganshi.

english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
translation: Balisuula icishinka cakwa Lesa, basalapo ubufi. Bapepa no kubombela ifibumbwa fyakwa Lesa, elyo basuula Kabumba wine wafiko, uo abantu bafwile ukulalumbanya lyonse! Ameni.

english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
translation: Mulandu wakucita ifi fintu eco Lesa abalekela balekonkelela ulunkumbwa lubi ulwamusebanya. Abanakashi balecita ubupulumushi na banakashi banabo, ici tefyo cifwile ukuba.

english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
translation: Abaume nabo balileka ukulala na banakashi, nomba baikatwa no lunkumbwa lubi ulwa baume banabo. Kanshi abaume balecita ubupulumushi na baume banabo. Ici cintu camusebanya nganshi. Kanshi abene ebailetelela ukukandwa pa kulungana kwabo.

english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
translation: Apo aba bantu bakaana ukusakamana ifyacishinka pali Lesa, Lesa nao aleka amano yabo yawile ku fyabuwelewele. Nomba bacita ifintu bashifwile kucita.

english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
translation: Balyobelelwa no bubi bwa misango yonse, ulunkumbwa lwafyuma, no lunkumbwa lwabupulumushi. Balyobelelwa ku mufimbila, kukwipayana, kukuumana, kukufinshanya, ku mufulo na ku lwambo.

english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
translation: Imbila Nsuma itweba pali Mwane Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu. Palwa bumuntu bwakwe, Yesu afyelwe mu lupwa lwakwa Davidi.

english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
translation: Balabepeshanya, bapata Lesa, bacipongwe, bacilumba, kabili bamataki. Ni ncenjeshi mukubifya, elyo tabomfwila bafyashi babo.

english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
translation: Ni mpelwamano, tabasunga ifyo basosa, kabili tabakwata luse ne cikuuku ku banabo.

english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
translation: Balishiba ukuti Lesa alipingula ukuti abacita ifi, balingilefye ukufwa. Nomba bena babikapofye ukulaficita. Kabili balakoselesha na bambi abaficita.

english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
translation: Lelo ku Mupashi uwamushilo, Yesu alilangwa na makafye ukuti ni Mwana Lesa pakubuuka ku bafwa.

english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
translation: Lesa ku cikuuku atukwatila muli Kristu, atulenga ukuba abasole, pakuti Kristu acindikwe. Epakuti, ntungulule imishobo yonse iya Benafyalo kukumusumina no kumunakila.

english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
translation: Kanshi na imwe bene, Lesa alimwita ukuti mube abantu bakwa Yesu Kristu.

english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation: Kanshi namulembela imwe bonse mu Roma, mwe babile bakwa Lesa, mwebo aita ukuba abamushilo. Icikuuku no mutende wakwa Lesa Shifwe ne Mfumu Yesu Kristu fileba na imwe.

english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
translation: Icapakubala, ndatasha Lesa wandi pali Yesu Kristu, pa mulandu wa imwe bonse. Ala pantu abantu isonde lyonse balelanda palwa cisumino cenu.

english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
translation: Lesa wine uo mombela no mutima wandi onse mukubila Imbila Nsuma yakwa Mwane, e kambone wandi. Ala lyonsefye nshimulaba mu mapepo yandi.

english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
translation: We muntu we upingula umunobe, tekuti umone akabepesho nangu wingaba shani. Pantu ilyo ulepingula bambi, elyo kabili na iwe we kapingula ulecita fimo fine, ninshi uleipingulafye we mwine.

english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
translation: Lelo abantu bonse abawamya, bena Lesa akabalumbanya, akabacindamika, akabapeela no mutende. Pakubala ku Bayuda, elyo na ku Benafyalo bene.

english: For there is no partiality with God.
translation: Pantu Lesa taba na mucishacinani.

english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
translation: Amalu 62:12

english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
translation: Pantu temukumfwafye Amafunde yakwa Mose, emo abantu babela abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, lelo ni mukukonka ifyo Amafunde yakwa Mose yalanda.

english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
translation: Abenafyalo tabakwata Mafunde yakwa Mose. Nomba nga ku mano yabuntunse bacita ififwaya Amafunde yakwa Mose, ninshi lyena baba na mafunde, nangu bashakwata Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
translation: Imisango yabo ilangafye ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose yalilembwa mu mitima yabo. Kampingu wa mu mitima yabo nao ni kambone, pantu limo alasuminisha imitontonkanishishe yabo limbi akaana ati tacilolelemo.

english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
translation: Kanshi ngefyo Imbila Nsuma mfunda yalanda, Lesa pa bushiku bwabupingushi, asonta Yesu Kristu ukupingula abantu pa milandu yafisama mu mitima yabo.

english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
translation: Amaf 10:17

english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
translation: Iwe walishiba ifyo Lesa afwaya ukuti ulecita. Amafunde yakwa Mose yalakutungulula ukwishiba ifilingile ukusala.

english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
translation: Walishininkisha ukuti niwe uli nokutungulula impofu, niwe cisaniko icakusanikila abenda mu mfifi.

english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti Lesa alalungika ilyo apingula abantu abacita ifya uyo musango.

english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
translation: Walishininkisha ukuti niwe uli nokufunda impelwamano nokufunda na bashilacenjela. Iwe walishininkisha ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose yalikupanda amano, yaleka wishibe ne fyacishinka.

english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
translation: Iwe ufunda bambi, bushe cinshi tekuti uifunde we mwine? Ubila kuli bambi ukukanaiba. Bushe iwe tawiba?

english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
translation: Weba auti, “Mwilabembuka.” Bushe iwe taubembuka? Wapata utulubi. Kabili wapita waiba ifya mu matempele.

english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
translation: Ulaitakisha ukuti walikwata Amafunde yakwa Mose. Nomba, bushe tamuletelafye Lesa umusebanya pakupula mu mafunde yakwe?

english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Nimwe mwe Bayuda mwalenga ukuti Abenafyalo balesaalula ishina lyakwa Lesa.”

english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
translation: Nga ulesunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, ninshi ukusembululwa kuti kwakuwamina. Lelo nga ulepula mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, awe ninshi ukusembululwa kobe kwafyefye.

english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
translation: Umwinafyalo uushasembululwa, nga alasunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, bushe Lesa tekuti alemumona ngo muntu uwasembululwa?

english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
translation: Umwinafyalo uushasembululwa ku mubili, lelo alesunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, wena eukakupingula we Muyuda. Iwe walisembululwa, walikwata na mafunde ayalembwa, lelo tauyasunga.

english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
translation: Ukuba Umuyuda wine wine, teicofye ulemoneka ukuba ngo Muyuda. Elyo no kusembululwa kwacine tekwa ku mubilifye epela, iyoo.

english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
translation: Kanshi ukuba Umuyuda wine wine, kuba Umuyuda mu mutima. Elyo no kusembululwa, kusembululwa kwa mu mutima. Uyu wena mulimo wakwa Mupashi Wamushilo te mulimo wa mafunde ayalembwa iyoo. Uyu muntu nangu abantu bashilemutasha, Lesa wena alamutasha.

english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
translation: Nga kanshi we muntu we upingula bambi, elyo ulecita ifyo bacita, bushe kuti watila ukapusuka ku bupingushi bwakwa Lesa?

english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
translation: Bushe ninshi kukanasakamanafye ubukankala bwa cilela cakwa Lesa, umutekatima no kushipikisha kwakwe? Bushe ninshi kukanaishibafye ukuti Lesa alikukwatila icilela ico afwaya ukuti ulapile no kupilibuka?

english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
translation: Nomba iwe walyumalala umutima, ukaana no kulapila. Eico ulelenga ubukali bwakwa Lesa bukacilileko pali bulya Bushiku ilyo ubukali bwakwe no bupingushi bwakwe ubwamulinganya bukasokoloka.

english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
translation: Elyo Lesa “akapingula cila muntu ukulingana ne micitile yakwe.”

english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
translation: Abantu ababa no mute wakuwamya, abafwaya ukuti Lesa abalumbanye, abapeele no mucinshi, no mweo uushili wakonaika, ebo Lesa akapeela umweo wape.

english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
translation: Lelo bonse bakaitemwe, abakaana ukunakila icishinka, abakonkelela ukucita ifyabipa, ebo Lesa akakanda icibi no bukali bwakwe.

english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
translation: Amacushi no bulanda fikafikila abantu abacita ifibi. Pakubalilapo ku Bayuda, elyo na ku Benafyalo bene.

english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
translation: Bushe kanshi finshi Abayuda bacilapo pa Benafyalo? Bushe kanshi finshi Abayuda bamwenamo mukusembululwa?

english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
translation: Abantu bonse balifutatila Lesa.

english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
translation: Imikolomino yabo ni nindi ishacenama.

english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
translation: Mu tunwa twabo mwabafye ukulapisha no bukali.

english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
translation: Aba bantu basampuka nganshi kukwipaya.

english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
translation: Konse uko bapita,

english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
translation: Tabaishiba ifyakwikala mu cibote.

english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
translation: Umwenso wakutiina Lesa tawaba pa finso cabo.”

english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
translation: Nomba ifwe twalishiba ukuti fyonse ifyaba mu Mafunde yakwa Mose, fyaba nokukonkwa na bantu abo fyapeelwako. Fyapeelwa pakuti abantu bemona akabepesho. Elyo beshibe nokuti abantu bonse aba pano isonde bali nokulubulula kuli Lesa.

english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
translation: Awe fyena fingifye, ifyalekana lekana! Icapakubalilapofye, Abayuda ebo Lesa apeela ukulabakilila amashiwi yakwe.

english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
translation: Kaf 7:20

english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
translation: Nomba Lesa nasokolola ifyo afwaya ukuti alule umuntu abe uwakaele pa cinso cakwe. Kanshi temukusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose. Kwena Amafunde yakwa Mose na Bakasesema e bakambone pali uyu mulandu.

english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
translation: Ni mu cisumino muli Yesu Kristu emo Lesa alenga ukuti abantu babe abakaele pa cinso cakwe. Efyo Lesa acita ku muntu onse uwasumina muli Kristu. Pantu Lesa taba na kapatulula.

english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
translation: Abantu bonse balibifya kuli Lesa, kabili balafilwa no kufika ku bucindami Lesa abapekanishisha.

english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
translation: Nomba muli Yesu Kristu uwatulubula, emo Lesa ku cikuukufye cakwe atucita ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe.

english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
translation: Kabili ni mu mulopa wakwa Kristu uo Lesa alekele ukuba ilambo lyakufumisha abantu ifyabubifi, pali ico bamusumina. Kanshi mukucita ifi, Lesa atulanga ifyo aba umololoke. Ku mulandu wa mutekatima wakwe, na kale line alesuula ku fyabubifi fya bantu.

english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
translation: Lelo muli shino nshiku mukukanasuulakofye ku fyabubifi, Lesa alanga ukuti mololoke. Kanshi efyo alanga nokuti umwine wine wakaele, kabili alenga no muntu onse uwasumina muli Yesu ukuba uwakaele.

english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
translation: Nga kanshi finshi twingaitakishishapo? Awe nangu fimo! Nga mulandu nshi? Bushe nico tusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose? Awe iyoo, lelo nico twaba ne cisumino.

english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
translation: Ifwe twashininkisha ukuti umuntu aba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, teico asunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, lelo nico aba ne cisumino.

english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
translation: Bushe Lesa ni Lesa wa Bayuda beka? Bushe tali Lesa wa Benafyalo nabo bene? Ee, cine cine na Benafyalo bene nabo ni Lesa wabo.

english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
translation: Nomba nangu nga cakuti bamo tabali na cisumino, bushe ukukanaba ne cisumino, ekwingalenga Lesa ukubalukila?

english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
translation: Kwabafye Lesa umo, eulenga Abayuda babe abakaele pa cinso cakwe ico basumina. Kabili eulenga na Benafyalo nabo babe abakaele pa cinso cakwe ico basumina.

english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
translation: Bushe calola mukutila tuleonaula Amafunde yakwa Mose ku cisumino ici? Awe cakaana, tulekosha na Mafunde yakwa Mose.

english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
translation: Awe cakaana! Lesa wacishinka nangu abantu bonse babufi. Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
translation: Nga kanshi kuti twatilapo shani, apo ifyo tulufyanya filanga ukuti Lesa alalungika? Bushe kuti twatila, Lesa atufyenga nga atukalipila? (Pano ndelanda na mano yabuntunse.)

english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
translation: Awe iyoo! Lesa, nga talungika, bushe kuti apingula shani abantu bonse aba pano isonde?

english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
translation: Umo kuti atila, “Ndi wabufi, lelo ubufi bwandi bulalumbanya Lesa pantu buleka ukuti bucishinka bwakwa Lesa bumonekeshe. Nga kanshi cinshi Lesa acili alempeela umulandu nga ne mubifi?”

english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
translation: Ico cena e cimo nokutilafye, “Natulebifya pakuti ubusuma bulemoneka.” Efyo abantu bamo batubepesha ukuti efyo tufunda! Aba bantu cabalingafye ukukandwa.

english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
translation: Nga kanshi ni shani? Bushe ifwe fwe Bayuda twalicilapo pa Benafyalo? Awe cakaana! Ninanda kale ukuti, Abayuda pamo na Benafyalo bene, bonse twateekwa ubusha no bubifi.

english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
translation: Nga kanshi kuti twatila shani pali Abrahamu icikolwe cesu?

english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
translation: Bushe ici cacitike lilali? Bushe lintu Abrahamu asembulwilwe nangu lintu ali talasembululwa? Ala cacitike ilyo ali talasembululwa, te panuma yakusembululwa.

english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
translation: Kanshi ukusembululwa kwakwe cali cishibilo cakushininkisha ukuti icisumino cakwa Abrahamu muli Lesa, ilyo ali talasembululwa, ecalengele ukuti Lesa amumone ukuti wakaele. Kanshi efyo Abrahamu aba icikolwe ca bantu bonse abasumina Lesa nelyo bashasembululwa. Elyo Lesa nao abamona ukuti bakaele pa cinso cakwe nangu bashasembululwa.

english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
translation: Kanshi nomba efyo Abrahamu aba icikolwe ca bantu abasembululwa. Teicofye basembululwa, lelo nico benda ne cisumino ico icikolwe cesu Abrahamu akwete ilyo ali talasembululwa.

english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
translation: Lesa alaile ukupeela Abrahamu na ba mu lupwa lwakwe isonde lyonse. Lesa talaile Abrahamu ici cilayo ico alesunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, lelo ni pa cisumino cakwe muli Lesa ecalengele wena abe uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
translation: Lesa alafulwa nga twapula mu mafunde. Nomba nga tapali mafunde, ninshi teti pabe kupula mu mafunde.

english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
translation: Lesa alaile icilayo kuli Abrahamu, ico Abrahamu asumine muli Lesa. Epakuti bashininkishe ukuti icilayo bupefye bwakwa Lesa ku ba mu lupwa lonse ulwakwa Abrahamu. Kanshi temukutila ni ku bantufye abasunga Amafunde yakwa Mose beka, lelo na kuli bonse abasumina nga Abrahamu. Pantu Abrahamu e cikolwe cesu bonse mu cisumino.

english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti “Nakucita icikolwe ca mishobo iyingi.” Kanshi pa cinso cakwa Lesa, uo Abrahamu asuminemo, Abrahamu cikolwe cesu. Uyu wine Lesa eulenga abafwa ukuba abomi, eweba ifishaliko ukuti fibeko.

english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
translation: Abrahamu ena, nangu tapali cakuti atetekelemo, abikilepofye ukusumina no kutetekela muli Lesa, kanshi epakuba icikolwe ca mishobo iyingi. Efyo calembwa ukuti, “Ifi fine efikaba na bana bobe.”

english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
translation: Abrahamu ali ne myaka yakufyalwa cikanga umwanda umo. Nomba nangu mu mitontonkanishishe yakwe amwene ukuti umubili wakwe naunakuka, elyo Sara nao tekuti afyale umwana pantu nakota, awe nalyo line tanenwike mu cisumino.

english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
translation: Nga cakuti kufyo alebomba fyalengele ukuti aba uwakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, lyena Abrahamu kuti amona icakuitakishishapo. Nomba tekuti aitakishe pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
translation: Talufishe cisumino cakwe, nangu ukutwishika pa cilayo Lesa amulaile. Icisumino cakwe calemukoselesha alelumbanya na Lesa.

english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
translation: Alishininkishe nganshi ukuti Lesa aliba na maka yakucita conse ico alaya.

english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
translation: Cisumino cakwe calengele ukuti Lesa amone Abrahamu ukuti wakaele pa cinso cakwe.

english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
translation: Aya mashiwi yakuti, “Lesa amumwene ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe,” tayalembelwa Abrahamu eka iyoo.

english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
translation: Yalembelwa na kuli ifwe fwe bali nokuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, ico twasumina muli uyu wabushishe Yesu Imfumu yesu ku bafwa.

english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
translation: Lesa alekele ukuti Yesu afwe pa mulandu wa fyabubifi fyesu, elyo aisa mubusha ku bafwa, pakuti tube abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
translation: Pantu Amalembo Yamushilo yatila, “Abrahamu asumine Lesa, na pa mulandu wa cisumino cakwe, Lesa amumwene ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe.”

english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
translation: Umuntu uubomba alamwenamo amalipilo. Elyo tekuti batile amalipilo apoka bupe, awe iyoo, malipilo pali ico abomba.

english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
translation: Lelo umuntu uushibomba asuminafye muli Lesa uulenga ababi ukuba abakaele, uyu muntu wena icisumino cakwe calenga ukuti Lesa amumona ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe.

english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
translation: Icite 15:6

english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
translation: “Balishuka abantu abo Lesa abelela uluse pafyo balufyanya,

english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
translation: Alishuka umuntu uo ifyabubifi fyakwe Imfumu tayakatale aifibukishako.”

english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
translation: Bushe ili shuko Davidi aleeba, lya bantufye abasembululwa? Awe iyoo, lishuko lya bantu na bashasembululwa bene. Pantu natusosa ukuti, “Abrahamu asumine Lesa, na pa mulandu wa cisumino cakwe Lesa amumwene ukuba uwakaele pa cinso cakwe.”

english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
translation: Apo pa mulandu wa cisumino twaba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, kanshi Imfumu yesu Yesu Kristu alileta umutende pakati ka ifwe na Lesa.

english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
translation: Ilyo twali abalwani bakwa Lesa, Lesa umwine atuwikishenye nankwe mu mfwa yakwa Mwane. Apo nomba twawikishanya nankwe, bushe kanshi kuti umweo wakwa Mwane wakaana shani ukutupususha?

english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
translation: Kabili teici ceka iyoo, lelo tulasansamuka na pali ico Lesa atuwikishanya nankwe mu Mfumu yesu Yesu Kristu.

english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
translation: Umuntu umo ewalenga ububifi ukwisa muno calo, elyo ububifi nabo bwaleta imfwa. Kanshi nomba imfwa yalisalangana ku bantu bonse, pantu bonse balibifya.

english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
translation: Ububifi bwali muno calo, ninshi na Lesa talati apeele Amafunde yakwa Mose. Ukushili mafunde, tekuti kube ububifi bwakupula mu mafunde.

english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
translation: Lelo ukufuma pa nshita yakwa Adamu ukufika na ku nshita yakwa Mose, abantu bonse bateekelwe ne mfwa. Lelo kwena bena tababifishe mukupula mu cebo cakwa Lesa nga Adamu.

english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
translation: Lelo ubupe bwakwa Lesa tekuti tubupashanye ku bubifi bwakwa Adamu. Cine cine ububifi bwa muntu umo bwalenga abantu abengi ukufwa. Nomba icikuuku cakwa Lesa cena calicilapo nganshi. Pantu ku cikuuku ca muntufye umo Yesu Kristu, Lesa apeela ubupe bwakwe ku bantu abengi.

english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
translation: Kabili ifyo ubupe bwakwa Lesa bubomba fyalipusana nefyo ububifi bwakwa Adamu bwabomba. Ububifi bwakwa Adamu bwalengele ukupingwilwa ukukandwa. Lelo ubupe bwakwa Lesa bwena, nangu abantu babifishe imiku iyingi, bwabalenga ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
translation: Cine cine ububifi bwa muntu umo bwalenga imfwa ileteeka, ico umuntu umo abifishe. Lelo ifyabomba umuntu umofye Yesu Kristu fyalicilapo nganshi! Kristu alitupeela icikuuku cakwa Lesa no kuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe, pakuti tuleteeka pakuba abomi.

english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
translation: Kanshi nga filya fine ububifi bwa muntu umo bwalenga abantu bonse ukupingwilwa ukukandwa, efyo no mulimo umo usuma uo muntu umo abomba, wakulenga abantu bonse ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa no kukwata umweo.

english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
translation: Kanshi nga filya fine abantu bonse basanguka ababi ico umuntu umo akeene ukunakila Lesa, efyo fine ico umuntu umo anakila Lesa, calenga ukuti abantu abengi babe abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
translation: Cisumino muli Yesu Kristu emo twashukila icikuuku cakwa Lesa, ico tulimo. Eico tulasansamuka pakusubila ukuti na ifwe tukakuma ku bucindami bwakwa Lesa.

english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
translation: Amafunde yakwa Mose, yaishile fusha ifyakulufyanya. Lelo kwena nangu ifyabubifi fyafulileko, icikuuku cakwa Lesa cena calicilapo nganshi.

english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation: Kanshi nga filya ububifi bwaleteeka abantu ico bafwa, efyo ne cikuuku cakwa Lesa citeeka abantu ico abalenga ukuti babe abakaele pa cinso cakwe. Elyo neci cilenga ukutwala abantu ku mweo wape, ku maka yakwa Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu.

english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
translation: Teici ceka iyoo, tulasansamuka na mu macushi mwine. Pantu twalishiba ukuti amacushi yalenga ukushipikisha.

english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
translation: Ukushipikisha nako kulenga tukwate imibeele yacishinka, ne mibeele yacishinka nayo ilenga ukuti tukwate ukusubila.

english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
translation: Kabili ifyo tusubila, tukafimona, pantu Lesa alipongolwela icitemwiko cakwe mu mitima yesu pakutupeela Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
translation: Pa nshita Lesa apimine, ilyo twali imbulwamaka, elyo Kristu aishile fwila abashapetamina Lesa.

english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
translation: Calyafya umuntu ukufwila pa muntu uwakaele. Nalimo kwena umuntu kuti asumina ukufwila pa muntu umusuma.

english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
translation: Lelo kwena Lesa alilanga ifyo atutemwa pakuleka ukuti Kristu atufwile ilyo tucili ababifi!

english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
translation: Apo umulopa wakwa Kristu walitwalula ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, bushe kanshi kuti afilwa shani ukutupususha ku bukali bwakwe?

english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
translation: Bushe kanshi tutile shani? Bushe tutwalilile ukwikala mu bubifi, pakuti icikuuku cakwa Lesa cicilileko?

english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
translation: Ilyo afwile, afwilile pa bubifi, afwa umuku umo calipwa. Nomba aba umumi, ni Lesa eo abelapo umumi.

english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: Mu nshila imo ine efyo na imwe muleimona ukuti mwalifwa ku lubali lwa bubifi, lelo mwakulaikala abomi kuli Lesa mukuba pamo na Kristu Yesu.

english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
translation: Kolo 2:12

english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
translation: Mwilaleka icilundwa nelyo cimo ica mubili wenu ukuya kukubifya, ukucicita icibombelo ca fibi. Lelo muleituula kuli Lesa. Muleimona nga bantu Lesa abusha ku bafwa no kubapeela umweo. Kanshi muletuula ifilundwa fyonse ifya mibili yenu fibe ifibombelo fyakucitilako fyonse ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
translation: Kanshi imwe tamuli nakuteekwa no bubifi. Imwe tamuteekwa na Mafunde yakwa Mose iyoo, lelo cikuuku cakwa Lesa ecimuteeka.

english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
translation: Bushe kanshi tutile shani? Bushe ico tushiteekwa na Mafunde yakwa Mose, tuteekwa ne cikuuku cakwa Lesa, bushe eco twingalabifisha? Awe cakaana.

english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
translation: Mwalishiba ukuti ilyo mwaipeela kukubombela umuntu umo nga basha, ninshi muli basha ba uyo muntu mulenakila. Atemwa kuti mwalanakila ububifi ubukamutwala ku mfwa, nangu mwalanakila Lesa icikalenga ukuti mucite ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
translation: Lelo ndatasha Lesa! Pantu mwali abasha babubifi, lelo nomba mulenakila ne mitima yenu yonse kuli fyonse ifyo twamufunda.

english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
translation: Kanshi nomba mwalilubuka ku bubifi, nomba muli basha bakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
translation: Kanshi nomba nalalanda amashiwi yabuntunse, pantu muli bumuntu bwenu mucili abanakuka. Kale mwaipeele onse kukucita ifyabupulumushi ne fibi ifyaleya filefulilakofye. Kanshi eifyo fine nomba ipeeleni onse nga basha bakucita ifyo Lesa afwaya, pakuti mube abamushilo.

english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
translation: Awe iyoo! Ifwe twalifuma ku bubifi calipwa, nga kuti twaikala mu bubifi shani?

english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
translation: Ilyo mwali abasha babubifi, tamwalesakamikwa kukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
translation: Nga finshi mwalemwenamo mukucita ifyo fintu fyonse ifimuletela nomba insoni? Ifyo fintu fitwalafye ku mfwa!

english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
translation: Nomba mwalilubuka ku bubifi, muli basha bakwa Lesa. Nomba mwalishukila ukuituula onse kuli Lesa no kushukila umweo wape.

english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: Pantu amalipilo ya bubifi ni mfwa. Lelo ubupe bwakwa Lesa, bwena mweo wa pe ubo tushukila muli Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu.

english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
translation: Bushe tamwaishiba ukuti fwe babatishiwa mu lubatisho lwakwa Kristu Yesu, twalifwa nankwe pamo mu lubatisho?

english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
translation: Mu lubatisho mwena, twalifwa no kushiikwa nankwe pamo. Epakuti, nga filya Kristu abuuka ku bafwa ku maka yakwa Wishi ayakupapa, efyo na ifwe tuleenda no mweo upya.

english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
translation: Apo twalyampana na Kristu mukufwa pamo nankwe, kanshi tukampana nankwe mukushukuka nga filya fine ashukwike.

english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti bumuntu bwesu bwakale bwalitanikwa na Yesu pa musalaba. Epakuti bumuntu bwesu ubwateekwa no bubifi bonaike. Twiba basha babubifi nakabili.

english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
translation: Pantu umuntu nga afwa, ninshi alubuka ku busha bwa bubifi.

english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
translation: Apo twafwa pamo na Kristu, twalisumina ukuti kanshi na ifwe tukaba abomi pamo na Kristu.

english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
translation: Twalishiba ukuti Kristu alibuuka ku bafwa, takatale afwa nakabili. Imfwa tayakwata maka pali ena.

english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
translation: Bamunyinane, cine cine mwalailuka pafyo nalamweba, pantu imwe bonse mwalishiba ifyo amafunde yaba. Ni pa nshita umuntu acili umumi elyo akonka amafunde.

english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
translation: Kanshi icebo ico cine icali nokumpeela umweo, ine nasanga ukuti ecandetela imfwa.

english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
translation: Pantu ububifi bwabomfeshe icebo no kumbepaika. Kanshi ububifi bwaingila mu cebo no kunjipaya.

english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
translation: Kwena Amafunde yakwa Mose yamushilo, ne cebo cine camushilo, cisuma, citutungulula na kukucita ifyo Lesa afwaya.

english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
translation: Icite 3:13

english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
translation: Bonse twalishiba ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose, mafunde yakwa Lesa. Lelo ine ndi muntufye, nateekwa ubusha no bubifi.

english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
translation: Ifyo ncita, nshishiba neco mficitila. Kabili ifyo ndefwaya ukucita, nshicita. Elyo nasanga ndecita ifyo napata ukucita.

english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
translation: Ilyo ncita ifyo nshifwaya kucita, ninshi nasuminisha ukuti Amafunde yakwa Mose yasuma.

english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
translation: Ukuf 20:17

english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
translation: Nalishiba ukuti mu buntunse bwandi, tekuti ncite icisuma nelyo cimo. Pantu ine nangu ningafwaya ukucita ifisuma, awe ndafilwa ukuficita.

english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
translation: Pantu ifisuma mfwaya ukucita, nshicita. Lelo ifibi ifyo nshifwaya kucita, efyo ncita.

english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
translation: Kuti twamona ku mafunde pa mwanakashi uwaupwa. Umwanakashi uwaupwa tekuti aye upwa ku mwaume umbi ilyo wiba acili umumi. Nomba nga afwa, lyena ninshi ifunde lyakuba umukashi wakwe lyapwa.

english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
translation: Kanshi ilyo ncita ifintu nshilefwaya kucita, ninshi teine ncita ifyo, lelo bubifi ubwaba muli ine ebucita ifyo.

english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
translation: Kanshi lyonse ifyo ciba nifi, lyonse ilyo mfwaya ukucita icintu icisuma, nsanga ndecita icibi.

english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
translation: Mu mutima wandi mwena nalitemwa nganshi amafunde yakwa Lesa.

english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
translation: Lelo umubili wandi ukonkelelafye fimbi ifyapusana nefyo umutima ufwaya. Ici ecalenga ukuti ububifi bwaba muli ine bunteeke ubusha.

english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
translation: Yangu ne mulanda wine wine! Nani akampokololako kuli ici cimubili icilentwala ku mfwa?

english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
translation: Lesa nakutotela, pa mulandu wakwa Yesu Kristu Imfumu yesu.

english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
translation: Kanshi umwanakashi nga aya upwa ku mwaume umbi ilyo wiba acili umumi, ninshi uyu mwanakashi balamwita umucende. Nomba nga wiba afwa, lyena ninshi ifunde lyakuba umukashi wakwe lyapwa. Nga cakuti aupwa ku mwaume umbi, tekuti balemwita umucende.

english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
translation: Kanshi nifyo fine kuli imwe bamunyinane. Imwe nomba muli filundwa fya mubili wakwa Kristu. Kanshi calipwa, mwalifuma ku Mafunde yakwa Mose. Imwe nomba muli bantu bakwa uyu Lesa abushishe ku bafwa, pakuti na ifwe tulebombela Lesa icisuma.

english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
translation: Ilyo twalakonkelela imikalile yabuntunse, Amafunde yakwa Mose yalengele ulunkumbwa lubi lwa mu mibili yesu ukuti tulebombafye ifyakutuletela imfwa.

english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
translation: Kanshi apo capwilililafye twalisha icatuteekele ubusha, nomba twalilubuka ku Mafunde yakwa Mose. Kanshi nomba tatubombela Lesa mukukonka amafunde yalembelwe kale, lelo tukonka umusango upya wakwa Mupashi Wamushilo.

english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
translation: Nga kanshi tutile shani? Bushe Amafunde yakwa Mose e bubifi bwine? Awe iyoo! Lelo kwena ukwabula ukwishiba Amafunde yakwa Mose, nga tekuti njishibe ifyo ububifi bwaba. Pantu amafunde ayakaana kunjeba ukuti, “Wilakumbwa,” awe ine no lunkumbwa nga nshalwishiba.

english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
translation: Lelo ni muli ici cebo emo ububifi bwabelama no kundetela ulunkumbwa lwa misango ne misango. Pantu ukwabula Amafunde yakwa Mose ninshi ububifi takuli.

english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
translation: Na ine wine nali uwamweo ilyo nshilaishiba Mafunde yakwa Mose. Nomba ilyo naishiba icebo, no bubifi bwaisa mu bumi bwandi no kufwa nafwa.

english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
translation: Abantu ababa muli Kristu Yesu, bena tabakabapeele umulandu.

english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
translation: Lelo nga Kristu ekala muli imwe, kanshi nangu imibili yenu ingafwa pa mulandu wa bubifi, lelo imipashi yenu yaba no mweo ico muli bakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
translation: Lelo nga Mupashi wakwa Lesa uwabushishe Yesu ku bafwa ekala muli imwe, ninshi Lesa uwabushishe Yesu ku bafwa akapeela umweo ku mibili yenu iyifwa. Pantu Mupashi wakwe ekala muli imwe.

english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
translation: Kanshi mwe bamunyinane, kuli ifwe calileshiwa ukwikala mukukonkelela ifyabuntunse.

english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
translation: Pantu nga mwalakonkelela ifyabuntunse mukafwa. Lelo ku maka yakwa Mupashi nga mwaleka lufwe ulunkumbwa lubi, awe lyena mukaba abomi.

english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
translation: Abantu bonse abatungululwa na Mupashi wakwa Lesa, e bana bakwa Lesa.

english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
translation: Pantu Mupashi uo mwapokelela tewakumuteeka mu busha, icakuti kabili muleba no mwenso. Imwe Mupashi amucita abana bakwa Lesa. Ni Mupashi eulenga ukuti tuleita Lesa atuti, “Abba, Tata, Tata, ee!”

english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
translation: Kol 3:16

english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
translation: Apo tuli bana bakwa Lesa, ninshi na ifwe tukashukila ifisuma ifyo Lesa abikila abana bakwe. Kanshi pamo na Kristu, na ifwe, Lesa akatupeelako ifyo abikila Kristu. Pantu nga tulecula pamo na Kristu, ninshi na ifwe tukashukilako ubucindami bwakwe.

english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
translation: Ine mona ukuti amacushi tulecula nomba, teti yalingane no bucindami Lesa akatupeela kuntanshi.

english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
translation: Ala ifibumbwa fyonse filalolela nganshi ilyo Lesa akasokolola abana bakwe.

english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
translation: Pantu maka yakwa Mupashi uupeela umweo, eyatupususha ku maka ya bubifi ne mfwa, ico twaba muli Kristu Yesu.

english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
translation: Pantu ifibumbwa fiyakashafye ukucita ifyo filefwaya. Temukutila efyo fifwaya, awe, nico efyo Lesa afwaya. Lelo kwena fyalikwata ili subilo.

english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
translation: Filasubila ukuti ubushiku bumo fikapusuka ku busha bwakuya kukubola. Nafyo fikashukileko ubucindami bwa buntungwa bwa bana bakwa Lesa.

english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti ukufika na pali nomba ifibumbwa fyonse filacululuka no kumfwa ubukali kwati mwanakashi uukomenwe ne fumo.

english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
translation: Kwena te fibumbwa fyeka ficululuka, lelo na ifwe bene tulacula mu mitima yesu. Pantu tulelolela ukuti na ifwe fwebo Lesa abalilapo ukupeela ubupe bwakwa Mupashi, Lesa akatucite abana bakwe umupwilapo pakulubula imibili yesu.

english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
translation: Pantu ni mukusubila emo twapusukila. Lelo nga wamona ico ulesubila, ninshi tapali kusubila. Bushe kwaliba uusubila ico amwene?

english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
translation: Nomba ifwe nga tusubila ico tushimwene, ninshi kulapembelafye natuteka no mutima.

english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
translation: Kanshi efyo fine Mupashi nao alatwafwako mu bunasha bwesu. Pantu tatwaishiba nefyo tuli nokupepa. Mupashi wine eutupepelako kuli Lesa mu musango uo tushingalondolola mu mashiwi.

english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
translation: Na Lesa uumona fyonse ifya mu mitima ya bantu, alishiba ifyo Mupashi afwaya. Pantu Mupashi alapapatilako abantu kuli Lesa ukulingana nefyo Lesa afwaya.

english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
translation: Twalishiba ukuti ku bantu abatemwa Lesa, Lesa acita fyonse ukuti fibawamine. Ni abo bantu ebo Lesa umwine aita ku mulimo wakwe.

english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
translation: Abantu Lesa aisalile libela, ebo asobwela libela ukuti babe nga Mwane, epakuti Mwane abe e beli lya bamunyina abengi.

english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
translation: Lesa alibomba ifyo Amafunde yakwa Mose yafililwe ukubomba, ku mulandu wa bunasha bwabuntunse. Ni pa mulandu wa bubifi Lesa atumine Mwane uwaishile aluka umuntu nga ifwe, fwe babubifi, pakuti onaule ububifi.

english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
translation: Kanshi abo bene Lesa asobwela libela, ebo aita. Elyo abo bene aita, ebo alenga ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe. Kabili abo Lesa alenga ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe, ebo alaya ukuti babe nankwe mu bucindami bwakwe.

english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
translation: Nga kanshi pali ifi fyonse twaumfwa, kuti twatilapo shani? Nga Lesa ali na ifwe, nga nani engatulwisha?

english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
translation: Lesa tatiina na kutulekela Mwane, lelo alimulubwila kuli ifwe bonse! Apo Lesa atupeela Mwane, kanshi kuti akaana shani ukutupeelafye fyonse?

english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
translation: Nga nani wingapeela abantu umulandu abo Lesa asala? Lesa umwine atila tababa na mulandu!

english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
translation: Nani kanshi engabapeela umulandu? Bushe ni Kristu Yesu? Awe iyoo! Pantu Kristu uwafwile, kabili alishukuka, nomba ekala lubali lwa ku kulyo kwakwa Lesa, ena eutupapatilako kuli Lesa.

english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
translation: Bushe nani engatufumya ku citemwiko Kristu atukwatila? Bushe macushi, nangu ubwafya, nangu ukucushiwa na bantu, nangu icipowe, nangu ukusapula, nangu ubusanso, nangu ukwipaiwa?

english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
translation: Nomba ifi fyonse twalificimfya nganshi ku maka yakwa Kristu uwatutemwa!

english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
translation: Pantu nalishininkisha ukuti nangu imfwa, nangu ubumi, nangu bamalaika, nangufye fyonse ifyamaka nangu ifiteeka mu mulu, pali nomba nangu kuntanshi,

english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translation: nangu ifyaba mu mulu, nangu ifyaba pesamba lya calo, nangufye ifibumbwa fyonse, tekuti fitufumye ku citemwiko Lesa atukwatila muli Kristu Yesu Imfumu yesu.

english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
translation: Ico Lesa acitila ifyo, ni pakuti ifintu ifyalungama ifyo Amafunde yakwa Mose yafwaya fifikilishiwe muli ifwe, ico tuletungululwa na Mupashi Wamushilo, tatuletungululwa no buntunse bwesu iyoo.

english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
translation: Pantu abantu abaikalilafye ukukonka ifyabuntunse, bena amano yabo yabafye pafyo ubuntunse bufwaya. Lelo abantu abaikalila ukukonka ifyo Mupashi Wamushilo abeba, bena amano yabo yabafye pafyo Mupashi afwaya.

english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
translation: Umuntu uo amano yakwe yabafye pa fyabuntunse, ninshi ni mfwa afwaya. Lelo umuntu uo amano yakwe yaba pali Mupashi, wena ashukila umweo no mutende!

english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
translation: Umuntu uufwayafye ifyabuntunse, aluka umulwani wakwa Lesa. Pantu akaana ukukonka amafunde yakwa Lesa. Na mu cine tekuti ayakonke.

english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
translation: Abantu abateekwa ne fyabuntunse, tekuti basansamushe Lesa.

english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
translation: Lelo imwe tamwaikalila mukukonkelela ifyabuntunse. Mwaikalila mukukonka ifyo Mupashi amweba, nga Mupashi wakwa Lesa ekala muli imwe. Umuntu uushaba na Mupashi wakwa Kristu, ninshi uyo muntu te muntu wakwa Kristu iyoo.

english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
translation: Ifyo ndelanda fyacine cine. Nshilebepa iyoo, ndelanda ifi pa menso yakwa Kristu. Elyo na kampingu wa mutima wandi uutungululwa na Mupashi Wamushilo, nao nashininkisha ukuti nshilebepa iyoo.

english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
translation: Icite 18:10

english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
translation: Ilyo aba bana bashilati bafyalwe, nangu ukucita icisuma nangu icibi, Lesa aebele Rebeka ati, “Umukalamba eukalatumika umwaice.”

english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
translation: Icite 21:12

english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
translation: Kabili calembwa ukuti, “Natemenwe Yakobo, napatile Esau.”

english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
translation: Nga kanshi tuleti shani? Bushe Lesa aba no muncishanya? Awe iyoo.

english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
translation: Pantu Lesa aebele Mose ati, “Nkabelela uluse uo ndefwaya ukubelela uluse. Nkalangulukila uo ndefwaya ukulangulukila.”

english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
translation: Kanshi tacaba kufyo umuntu alefwaya nangu kufyo engacita, lelo cabafye ku luse lwakwa Lesa.

english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
translation: Kabili mu Malembo Yamushilo, calembwa ukuti Lesa aebele Falao ati, “Nakubika pa bufumu pakuti nange amaka yandi mukukubomfya na pakuti ishina lyandi lishibikwe isonde lyonse.”

english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
translation: Kanshi Lesa abelela uluse umuntu uo alefwaya ukubelela uluse. Elyo alomalalika umutima wa muntu uo alefwaya ukuti umutima wakwe umalale.

english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
translation: Ukuf 33:19

english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
translation: Ala ndomfwa ubulanda nganshi, kabili umutima wandi ukalipafye lyonse pa mulandu wa bantu bandi aba mu mutundu wandi.

english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
translation: We muntu we, bushe niwe ani uwakuti mulepaashanya na Lesa? Bushe inongo kuti yalailishanya ku waibumba aiti, “Cinshi ico wamumbila ifi?”

english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
translation: Bushe umuntu uubumba inongo, takwata nsambu shakubomfya ibumba mu musango onse uo alefwaya? Kwibumba limo line kuti abumbako inongo iyakubomfya ku milimo iyikankala, elyo na imbi iyakubomfya lyonse.

english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
translation: Kanshi ni shani nga cakuti Lesa nao afwaya ukulanga ubukali bwakwe nokuti abantu beshibe amaka yakwe? Lelo Lesa alabatekela umutima abantu abamukalifya umutima, nangufye balingile ukukandwa.

english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
translation: Icite 25:23

english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
translation: Nangu tube Abayuda nangu Abenafyalo, lelo nifwe bene Lesa aita.

english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
translation: Kabili efyo Lesa asosa mu citabo cakwa kasesema Hosea ati,
