english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
translation: “Mu ncende ine umo Lesa alebeba ati,

english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
translation: Esaya nao asosa pa bena Israeli ati,

english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
translation: Pantu Imfumu ikaputula bwangu bwangu

english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
translation: Kabili efyo Esaya asobele kale ati,

english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
translation: Kuti nafwaya nokuti Lesa andapisha, amfumye na kuli Kristu pa mulandu wa bena Israeli!

english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
translation: Nga kanshi tutile shani? Ee, kwena Abenafyalo tabalefwaya ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa, lelo ku mulandu wa cisumino cabo, balishukila ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa.

english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
translation: Elyo abena Israeli bena abalefwaya ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa mukusunga Amafunde yakwa Mose, awe bena balifilililwafye.

english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
translation: Cinshi bafililwa? Nico balefwaya ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwa Lesa ku milimo balebomba te ku cisumino iyoo. Kanshi abena Israeli epakuwa ico baipununa ku libwe abantu baipununako.

english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
translation: Efyo calembwa ukuti,

english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
translation: Aba bantu abo Lesa umwine aisalile, abacita na bana bakwe. Bashukila no bucindami bwakwe. Apangene nabo ifipangano, abapeele na Mafunde yakwa Mose. Bena alibalangile ne fyakupepa Lesa mu cishinka, abalaile ne filayo.

english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
translation: Bena ba mu lupwa lwa fikolwe fyalumbuka ifya mikowa yesu. Na Kristu wine muli bumuntu bwakwe, wa mu mushobo wabo. Ni Lesa uuteeka fyonse, abantu bengalamulumba pe na pe! Ameni.

english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
translation: Kanshi nshileeba nati Lesa tafikilisha ico alaile, awe iyoo. Pantu abo Lesa asala ukuba abantu bakwe, te bonse abantu ba mu Israeli.

english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
translation: Kabili te bonse aba mu lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu baba abana bene bene bakwa Lesa. Lesa aebele Abrahamu ati, “Ni kuli Isaki eko ukakwatila abantu ba mu lupwa lobe.”

english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
translation: Kanshi ici calola mukuti, tekufyalwafye mu musango wabuntunse ekulenga ukuba abana bakwa Lesa. Lelo bana abafyalwa ukulingana ne cilayo Lesa alaile, abo e ba lupwa lwakwa Abrahamu abene bene.

english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
translation: Pantu amashiwi Lesa alailemo Abrahamu icilayo ni aya ayakuti, “Nkabwela pa nshita iyalinga, na Sara akaba no mwana umwaume.”

english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.
translation: Muli shilya nshiku abapingushi bateekele icalo ca Israeli, mu calo mwali icipowe. Eico umuntu umo afumine ku Betelemu mu calo cakwa Yuda, pamo no mukashi wakwe na bana babili abaume, baile mukulebela mu calo ca Moabu.

english: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
translation: Elyo nabo baeba nafyala abati, “Awe ifwe tulebwelelafye na iwe ku bantu bobe.”

english: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
translation: Lelo Naomi abasuka ati, “Awe bakashana, mwe bana bandi, bwelelenimofye ku mushi, nga cinshi ico mulefwaila ukunkonkela? Bushe ine nkatala nkwatapo na bambi abana abaume, abo abengesa ba abalume benu?

english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,
translation: Bwelelenimofye ku mushi mwe bakashana bana bandi. Ine nomba ninkota uwakukwata na umbi umulume. Nangufye cingaba cakuti naba no mulume no kuba na bana abaume,

english: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for the LORD’s hand has gone out against me.”
translation: bushe kuti mwapembela mpaka nabo bakakule elyo bakese muupa? Bushe mukekala ifyo fine ukwabula ukuupwa? Awe iyoo bakashana, mwe bana bandi. Ici cintu nacafya nganshi kuli ine ukucila kuli imwe. Pantu ukuboko kwakwa Yawe kuli pali ine nakundetela ubucushi.”

english: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.
translation: Kabili nabo babwekeshapofye ukulalila. Elyo Opa ena atomona nafyala abwelelamo na kumwabo, lelo Ruti wena alambatilafye kuli nyinafyala.

english: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
translation: Elyo Naomi atile kuli Ruti, “Mona cufi mubiyo abwelelamo ku bantu bakwe na ku milungu yakwe. Awe na iwe wine kabiyefye nankwe.”

english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
translation: Ruti nao atile, “Mwimpapata pakuti mushe mweka nangu ukubwelelamo ukufuma kuli imwe. Ala konse uko muleya, eko na ine ndeya. Kabili uko mukekala, eko na ine nkekala. Abantu benu, ebakaba abantu bandi. Kabili Lesa wenu eukaba e Lesa wandi.

english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
translation: Uko imwe mukafwila, eko na ine nkafwila, kabili uko kwine eko bakanshiika. Ine Yawe akancitile icibi icili conse nga cakutifye imfwa teikalekanya imwe na ine.”

english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
translation: Naomi ilyo amona ukuti Ruti ali uwashangila mukuya nankwe, alekele ukulamupapata ukubwelelamo.

english: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”
translation: Eico bonse babili batendeke ukuya, mpaka no kuya fika ku Betelemu. Ilyo bafikile mu Betelemu, umusumba onse wakaba na see pa mulandu wabo. Elintu abanakashi ba mu musumba balaipushanya abati, “Bushe uyu kuti aba e Naomi?”

english: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.
translation: Ishina lya uyu muntu ni Elimeleki, ne shina lya mukashi wakwe ni Naomi, elyo amashina ya bana bakwe babili abaume bali ni Maloni na Kilioni. Bali abena Efulati ukufuma ku Betelemu, mu calo cakwa Yuda. Kabili baile ku Moabu no kwikala kulya kwine.

english: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
translation: Naomi nao alebeba ati, “Mwilanjita Naomi, mulenjita Mara, pantu Umwine wa maka yonse nanenga ukuba uwabulanda mu mweo wandi.

english: I went out full, and the LORD has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”
translation: Ine nafumine kuno umukankala, nomba Yawe ambweseshe ukwabula nangu cimo. Nga ni cinshi ico mulenjitila ati Naomi, apo Yawe nanshinina, kabili Umwine wa maka yonse nambika na mu macushi.”

english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo Naomi abwelelemo ukufuma ku Moabu, ali na nafyala wakwe Ruti umwina Moabu. Bafikile na mu Betelemu pa nshita yakwamba ukulobolola imbuto sha bale.

english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.
translation: Nomba Elimeleki, umulume wakwa Naomi, aisa fwa no kusha umukashi wakwe na bana babili abaume.

english: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.
translation: Aba bana baume baupile abanakashi abena Moabu. Umwanakashi umo ishina lyakwe ni Opa no mubiye nao ali ni Ruti. Panuma yakwikala kulya pa myaka nalimo ikumi limo,

english: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.
translation: bonse babili Maloni na Kilioni wine nabo balifwile. Eico kanshi, Naomi ashelefye ukwabula abana bakwe abaume pamo pene no mulume wakwe.

english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
translation: Ilyo Naomi aumfwile ku Moabu ukuti Yawe naisa kukwafwilisha abantu bakwe mukubapeela ifyakulya, Naomi alipekenye ukubwelelamo kumwakwe ukufuma ku Moabu pamo na banafyala bakwe bonse babili.

english: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
translation: Kanshi ena pamo na banafyala bonse babili epakutendeka ubulendo bwakufuma ku cifulo kulya baleikala no kwamba ukubwelelamo, balungama umusebo walola ku calo cakwa Yuda.

english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May the LORD deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
translation: Elyo Naomi atile kuli banafyala bonse babili, “Mwe, ala bwelelenimo, cila umo aleya uko afuma ku mushi wakwa nyina. Kabili Yawe akamukwatile uluse, pamo ngefyo na imwe mwakwatile uluse abayashi abali abena mwenu pamo pene na ine.

english: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.
translation: Kabili Yawe engamwafwako pakuti mukasange ubwikalo ubusuma, cila umo mu ŋanda ya mulume wakwe umbi.” Elyo Naomi abatomona pakubashalikapo, nabo bayambile ukulila nganshi.

english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.
translation: Nomba Naomi alipo na umo uwa mu lupwa lwa mulume uwa mu mukowa wakwa Elimeleki, uwali umukankala nganshi, ishina lyakwe ali ni Boasi.

english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”
translation: Ruti ilyo aumfwile aya mashiwi, awa ubukupeme no kushimpa impumi yakwe panshi. Elyo atile, “Bushe cinshi ico ine nasangila ukusekelelwa pa cinso cenu elyo no kunsakamana inefye ne mwinafyalo?”

english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.
translation: Boasi atile, “Ine, nabanjebafye fyonse ifyo wacita kuli nokofyala ukutulafye apo umulume obe afwila. Ifyo washile abafyashi bobe bawiso na banoko, nefyo washa ne calo cobe umo wafyalilwe no kwisa mukwikala na bantu abo ushaishibe kale.

english: May the LORD repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
translation: Yawe engakulambwilapo pali fyonse ifyo wacita. Kabili Yawe Lesa wa bena Israeli akakupeelelepo icilambu icituntulu, uyo wishile mukuuba mu mapindo yakwe.”

english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”
translation: Elyo Ruti asosele ati, “Lekeni nkonkanyepo ukusanga ukusekelelwa pa cinso cenu mwe mfumu yandi, pantu mwampeela icikoselesho no kulanda ifisuma kuli ine ne mubomfi wenu, nangu ine nshilingene na babomfi benu abanakashi nelyo umo.”

english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She sat beside the reapers, and they passed her parched grain. She ate, was satisfied, and left some of it.
translation: Awe pa nshita yakulya Boasi atile kuli Ruti, “Palama mupepi, wise ulyeko umukate, uutumpikeko na mu mwangashi uwasasamina.” Elyo Ruti aikele mupepi na basomboshi, na Boasi amupeelako imbuto ishasalulwa. Ruti nao alilafye apo alefwaila no kushapo shimo.

english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.
translation: Ilyo Ruti aimine ukuya mukusotasota imbuto mwibala, Boasi apeele ifipope ku baume bakwe ukutila, “Nangufye mwamona ukuti alesotasota na mu myanshi mwine, tecakwesha ukumulenga insoni iyoo.

english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”
translation: Kabili mulesomonamo imbuto shimo mu myanshi no kushisha pakuti ilyo aleisa alesotasota, aleshibuula, kabili tecakwesha ukumukalipila iyoo.”

english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
translation: Eico kanshi, Ruti alesotasota mwibala casuka caba icungulo. Ilyo apumine fyonse ifyo alesotasota ifya mbuto sha bale, afumishemo ifyafika ku cipimo ca efa umo.

english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.
translation: Alisendele no kubwelelamo ku musumba, alanga na nyinafyala ifyo alesotasota. Elyo Ruti nao afumishe icakulya icashelepo ilyo aikwite, apeela na nyinafyala.

english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, “The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz.”
translation: Amaf 24:19

english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
translation: Elyo Ruti umwina Moabu atile kuli Naomi, “Shilekeni njeko ku mabala no kutolatolako imisonso ya bale iyo umuntu umo aleshamo ilyo alesombola, nga cakuti aya nsuminisha.”

english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”
translation: Naomi atile kuli nafyala, “Abe uwapaalwa kuli Yawe! Pantu Yawe taleka ukulanga uluse ku bamweo na ku bafwa.” Kabili akonkeshepo no kutila, “Uyo muntu ni lupwa lwesu. E umo uwa pali bandubulwila besu.”

english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”
translation: Elyo Ruti umwina Moabu atile, “Ulya muntu acinjeba nokutila, ‘Wikaleka ukubomba pamo na babomfi bandi mpakafye bakapwishe ukusombola imbuto shandi shonse.’ ”

english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not meet you in any other field.”
translation: Nao Naomi atile kuli Ruti nafyala, “Ee cisuma iwe we mwana wandi ukuti ulebomba na bakashana bakwa Boasi, pantu mwibala lya muntu umbi kuti bakusanshilamo.”

english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.
translation: Awe Ruti epakulaba mupepi na babomfi abakashana bakwa Boasi mukusombola imbuto, mpakafye imbuto sha bale ne ŋanu fyapwa ukusombolwa. Kabili pali iyi nshita yonse, aleikala na nafyala wakwe Naomi.

english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
translation: Awe Ruti aliile no kwamba ukusotasota imbuto mu mabala mukukonka panuma ya balesombola. Elyo cabafye nkuma aisanga alebomba mwibala lyakwa Boasi. Boasi ali wa mu mukowa wakwa Elimeleki.

english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May the LORD be with you.” They answered him, “May the LORD bless you.”
translation: Kabili ilyo linefye, elyo Boasi afikile ukufuma ku Betelemu no kuposha bonse abasomboshi no kutila, “Yawe abe na imwe.” Nabo bayaswike ati, “Yawe akupaale.”

english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”
translation: Elyo Boasi aipwishe umubomfi wakwe uwaleyangalila abasomboshi ati, “Bushe uyu mukashana wakwani?”

english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.
translation: Kangalila wa basomboshi nao atile, “Uyu mukashana, mwina Moabu uwabwelele ukufuma ku calo ca Moabu pamo na Naomi.

english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”
translation: Ena acisa lomba ati, ‘Napapata lekeni nsotasotemo imisonso ya bale iyileshala no kukaka imyanshi, ndekonka umulesombola abasomboshi benu.’ Kanshi ukufumafye ulucelo ilyo aciya mwibala, acibafye alebomba ukufika na nombaline, elyo acituushakofye pa nshita inono mu cintelelelwe.”

english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.
translation: Elyo Boasi atile kuli Ruti, “We mwana wandi umwanakashi, umfwa kuli ine. Tecakwesha ukuya mukusotasota mwibala limbi kabili wiya kumbi ukufuma pano. Lelo wikalefye pano pene na bakashana bandi.

english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?
translation: Ubushiku bumo Naomi nafyala wakwa Ruti amwebele ati, “We mwana wandi umwanakashi, bushe tekuti nkufwaile iŋanda yobe iyakuti ukaikalile ne nsansa we mwine?

english: He said, “You are blessed by the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.
translation: Nao Boasi atile, “Yawe akupaale, we mwana wandi umwanakashi. Ukupetama kobe kwakula nganshi ukucila uko walangile intanshi. Pantu tawakonkelela abalumendo, nangu abakankala nangu abapina.

english: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.
translation: Kanshi nomba mwana wandi witiina. Ine nkakucitilafye conse ico uli nokunjeba. Ala bonse abena musumba banandi balishibafye bwino ukuti uli mwanakashi wacishinka.

english: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.
translation: Kwena nangu cacine cine ukuti ndi wa mu lupwa lobe, eko ali umbi ndubulwila uupaleme nganshi ku lupwa ukucila ine.

english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as the LORD lives. Lie down until the morning.”
translation: Lelo ikala kuno kwine muno cungulo mpaka ulucelo, nga cakuti ulya muntu uukwete insambu alefwaya kuti akulubula, ninshi cikawama. Nomba nga cakuti akaana ukukulubula, lyena ninshi mu cishinkafye cakwa Yawe uwamweo, nine wine nkakulubula. Sendama kuno kwine mpaka ulucelo.”

english: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”
translation: Elyo Boasi aebele Ruti ukusendama ku ntambalilo yakwe mpaka ulucelo. Lelo abuukile bwangu ukwabula umuntu nangu umo ukwishiba, pantu Boasi atile, “Wileka cikeshibikwe ukuti umwanakashi aliisa ku cipulilo ca lubansa lwandi.”

english: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.
translation: Kabili Boasi amweba ati, “Leta kuno insalu iyo ufwele no kuifungulula.” Ilyo afungulula, amwitililamo imbuto sha bale ukulingana ne miseke mutanda, no kumutwika. Awe Ruti abwelelemo ku musumba.

english: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told her all that the man had done for her.
translation: Ilyo Ruti afikile kuli nyinafyala, Naomi amwipusha ati, “Nge fintu fyaenda shani uko wile we mwana wandi?”

english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”
translation: Elyo Ruti alundapo nokuti, “Acimpeela iyi miseke mutanda iya mbuto sha bale, no kunjeba ati, ‘Awe tekuti ubwelelemo kuli banokofyala iminwe nkutwa.’”

english: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”
translation: Elyo Naomi atile, “Tekafye umutima we mukashana, we mwana wandi, pakuti wishibe ifyalacitika, pantu tatuushe nangu panono, mpaka uyu mulandu upwe lelo linefye.”

english: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.
translation: Nomba mona Boasi untu walebomba na bakashana bakwe bushe te muntu wesu? Ilelo icungulo akulasokola imbuto sha bale pa cipulilo ca pa lubansa lwakwe.

english: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
translation: Eico kanshi, usambe bwino bwino no kusuba amafuta ya cena cisuma kabili ufwale ne fyakufwala fyobe ifisuma nganshi. Elyo uye no kutententemukila ku cipulilo ca pa lubansa lwakwe. Nomba wileka eshibe ati uli kulya, mpakafye ilyo alepwisha ukulya no kunwa.

english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”
translation: Ilyo aleya sendama, umone bwino icifulo uko alesendama. Elyo nomba uye no kumufimbula ku ntabalilo eko usendame. Awe nao euleya kweba ifyakucita.”

english: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”
translation: Ruti atile, “Nalaya ncite fyonse ifyo mwanjeba.”

english: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.
translation: Awe Ruti aile ku cipulilo cakwa Boasi ica bale no kucita fyonse ifyo nyinafyala amwebele.

english: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
translation: Ilyo Boasi apwile ukulya no kunwa, no mutima wakwe wasansamuka, aima aya mukusendama apali akatalamukila ku mpela ya mwina wa mbuto sha bale. Elyo Ruti nao ayako alebendela, aya mufimbula ku ntambalilo eko asendama.

english: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.
translation: Nomba pakati ka bushiku Boasi acilimuka no kupilibuka, elyo apulikilwafye umwanakashi nasendama ku ntambalilo yakwe!

english: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”
translation: Elyo Boasi atile, “Bushe niwe nani?” Nao atile, “Nine Ruti umubomfi wenu, mfimbeniko icisempe ca nsalu yenu apo imwe muli bandubulwila.”

english: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.
translation: Mu nshita ilya ine, Boasi aile ku mpongolo ya musumba no kwikala kulya kwine. Elyo tapapitile ne nshita, ndubulwila Boasi asosele nao aisa ninshi alifye mukupita. Boasi amwita ati, “Isa kuno we munandi, ikala apa.” Nao aile ikala.

english: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”
translation: Kabili ninshitila kumo na Ruti umwina Moabu, mukamfwilwa wakwa Maloni, ukuba umukashi wandi pakuti ishina lyawafwa likabelele pa ncende ya cishilano cakwe. Neci ni pa mulandu wakuti ishina lyakwe likalobelela pakati ka lupwa nangu ukulisesha mu fyalembwa mu filembelo ifyaba ku musumba. Ecalenga, ilelo imwe bonse muli bakambone!”.

english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.
translation: Elyo abakalamba na bantu bonse abali pa mpongolo batile, “Ee ifwe tuli bakambone. Nacibefye ukuti Yawe akalenge umwanakashi uwalaisa mu ŋanda yobe akabe nga Rakeli na Lea abo babili abakulile iŋanda yakwa Israeli. Ala nauleba uwabulamba mu Efulata no kuba uwalumbuka mu Betelemu.

english: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which the LORD will give you by this young woman.”
translation: Kabili ukupitila mu bana abo Yawe ali nokukupeela muli uyu mukashana, shibengaba nga ba mu ŋanda yakwa Peresi, balya Tama afyele kuli Yuda.”

english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
translation: Awe Boasi epakubuula Ruti no kuba umukashi wakwe. Na panuma yakuupana, Yawe alengele Ruti ukwimita no kukwata umwana umwaume.

english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
translation: Elyo abanakashi batile kuli Naomi, “Napaalwe na matotelo kuli Yawe uyo mu bushiku bwa lelo takushilefye ukwabula ndubulwila. Kabili ne shina lyakwe likabe ilyalumbuka konsefye mu calo ca Israeli.

english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”
translation: Uyu mwana ali nokuba katalalika obe, kabili uwakukulela mu bukote bobe. Pantu nokofyala uwakutemwisha, kabili umusuma kuli iwe ukucila abana baume cine lubali, eukufyalile uyu mwana.”

english: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.
translation: Elyo Naomi abuulile umwana, amupakatila no kulamulela pakuti abe umwana wakwe.

english: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
translation: Elyo abanakashi abena mupalamano bakwe batile, “Naomi nakwata umwana umwaume.” Epakumwinika ishina lya Obedi, uyo uwaishile ba wishi wakwa Yese, elyo nao aisa fyala Davidi.

english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,
translation: Kanshi, ifi efyo ulupwa lwakwa Peresi lwatantama. Peresi ali ni wishi wakwa Hesroni.

english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
translation: Hesroni nao ali ni wishi wakwa Ramu. Ramu nao ali ni wishi wakwa Aminadabu.

english: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.
translation: Kabili Boasi aitile abakalamba ikumi limo aba mu musumba no kutila, “Ikaleni pano,” awe nabo baikala.

english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,
translation: Aminadabu ali ni wishi wakwa Nashoni, Nashoni nao ali ni wishi wakwa Salimoni.

english: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,
translation: Salimoni ali ni wishi wakwa Boasi, Boasi nao ali ni wishi wakwa Obedi.

english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.
translation: Obedi ali ni wishi wakwa Yese, kabili Yese nao ali ni wishi wakwa Davidi.

english: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.
translation: Elyo aeba ndubulwila uwali ne nsambu ati, “Naomi nabweluluka ukufuma ku Moabu, kabili alefwaya ukushitisha ibala lyakwa munyinefwe Elimeleki.

english: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.” He said, “I will redeem it.”
translation: Ine ntontonkenye ukuti cawama ukukwishibisha pali uyu mulandu. Kabili nga cakuti ulefwaya ukushita ushitile pa menso ya bantu aba bekele pano elyo na ya bakalamba ba bantu bandi. Nga ulefwaya ukulilubula, ulilubule. Lelo nga taulefwaya, kuti wanjeba pakuti njishibe. Pantu tapali nelyo umo ukucila iwe uuli ne nsambu shantanshi ishakulubula ibala ili, kano iwe, elyo ine ndi uwacibili kuli iwe emo twatantamina.”

english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”
translation: Elyo Boasi asosele ati, “Mu bushiku ukashite impanga iyi ukufuma kuli Naomi, ukashite na Ruti wine ulya namfwilwa umwina Moabu, pakuti ishina lya muyashi likaloba pa cifulo cacishilano cakwe.”

english: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”
translation: Ilyo ndubulwila uwali ne nsambu aumfwile ifi, atile, “Awe ine nafilwa ukulilubula, pantu limbi kuti naonaula ifyacishilano fyandi. Kanshi iwe wine lilubulefye. Ine nafilwa tekuti ndilubule.”

english: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.
translation: Nomba uyu ewali musango wakale mu bena Israeli uwakuti, pakushininkisha ifilecitika, umuntu nga alefwaya ukulubula icintu nangu ukukaushanya icipe cimo, umo ali nokufuula indyato no kupeela umunankwe. Uyu e umusango baleshininkishishamo umulandu pa cinso ca bakambone mu Israeli.

english: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.
translation: Eico ilyo ndubulwila atile kuli Boasi, “Niwe wine shita.” Kanshi ewafuulile ne ndyato no kumupeela.

english: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
translation: Amaf 25:9

english: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
translation: Inyimbo shakwa Solomoni ishawamisha ukucila inyimbo shimbi shonse.

english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
translation: Amasaya yobe yaba ayayemba apaselela amasikiyo.

english: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.
translation: Tulekupangila amasikiyo ya golide,

english: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
translation: Ilyo imfumu iletuusha apo yaikele,

english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
translation: Uwatemwikwa wandi anunka akacena akasuma muri,

english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
translation: Uwatemwikwa aba nge cisansangu ca maluba aya hena ayanunka ubusaka,

english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
translation: Ala waliyemba we mutemwikwa wandi!

english: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
translation: Yangu ifyo nobe wine wawama, we mutemwikwa wandi!

english: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
translation: Imyalo ya ŋanda yesu yakosa nge fimuti ifyalepesha ifya keda,

english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
translation: Wingantomona ukutomona kwa pa kanwa,

english: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
translation: Icena ca mafuta yobe cilanunka ubusaka,

english: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! They are right to love you.
translation: Angufyanya ukunsenda tubutuke,

english: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
translation: Nangula ine kwena naliyemba!

english: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.
translation: Mwilatamba kufiita kwandi,

english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
translation: Weo umutima wandi watemwa,

english: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
translation: Iwe we wayemba pa banakashi bonse, bushe tawishibeko?

english: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
translation: We mukashana wandi weo natemwa,

english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
translation: Ine ndi luba lya ntongola mukoshi ilya mwiwanga lya Sharoni,

english: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
translation: Umutemwikwa anjita nokutila kuli ine,

english: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
translation: Mona inshita yampepo naipwa,

english: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
translation: Amaluba nayabalula mu mpanga

english: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
translation: Amakunyu nayamba ukupya,

english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.
translation: We nkunda yandi, iyabelama mu bwendo bwa cilibwe,

english: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
translation: Twikatileniko bamumbwe, bamumbwe banono,

english: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
translation: Umutemwikwa wandi, ala wandifye,

english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
translation: Bwelulukila kuli ine, we mutemwikwa wandi, tube pamo ubushiku bonse,

english: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
translation: Nga filya intongola mukoshi iba pakati ka myunga,

english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
translation: Nga filya icitwalo cisuma ciba pakati ka miti ya mu mpanga,

english: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
translation: Alantwala mu ŋanda yakwe iya malila,

english: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
translation: Ndishako ubukambi bwa myangashi,

english: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
translation: Ninsaila umutwe wandi pa kuboko kwakwe ukwa ku kuso

english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
translation: Imwe mwe bakashana ba mu Yerusalemu,

english: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
translation: Naumfwa ishiwi lya mutemwikwa wandi.

english: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
translation: Umutemwikwa wandi aba nge nsebula,

english: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
translation: Ubushiku bonse pa musengele wandi tepakufuluka umutemwikwa wandi.

english: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.
translation: Amolu yaciko apanga aya silifa.

english: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart.
translation: Mwe bakashana ba mu Sioni,

english: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
translation: Nasuka nati, “Awe kanjimefye, mpitane mu musumba,

english: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
translation: Bamalonda abapitana mu musumba basuka bansanga,

english: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.
translation: Kutifye cilya nafuma apo bali,

english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love, until it so desires.
translation: Imwe mwe bakashana ba mu Yerusalemu,

english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant?
translation: Cinshi cilya cilefuma mu matololo kwati ni ntumba ya cushi?

english: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.
translation: Moneni! Ala licila lyakwa Solomoni.

english: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.
translation: Impalume shonse shintu shacenjela kukulwa no lupanga,

english: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.
translation: Imfumu Solomoni eyaipangile amacila ayakusendelapo icipuna cakwe icabufumu,

english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is as a flock of goats, that descend from Mount Gilead.
translation: Ala uli musuma we mutemwikwa wandi!

english: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices!
translation: Yangu ifyo ukutemwana nobe kwawama,

english: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
translation: We nabwinga wandi imilomo yobe itona uluto nge cipepe ca buci,

english: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
translation: Nkashi yandi, nabwinga wandi waba nge bala ilyapindililwa,

english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
translation: Emulimbwa kabili emukula bwino amateke,

english: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices,
translation: Emukula imiti ya cinyamuti icaitwa nardi ne fisali, umumfwemfwe na sinamoni,

english: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.
translation: We nabwinga wandi, uli kamfukumfuku akatapilila ibala lyandi,

english: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.
translation: Ima we mwela wa ku kapinda ka ku kuso,

english: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.
translation: Ameno yobe nao yabuuta tuutu ngo mukuni wa mpaanga ishikota,

english: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
translation: Imilomo yobe yaba iyakashika bwino kwati kasalu akakashika cee,

english: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.
translation: Akamukoshi kobe kapololoka ngo lupungu lwakwa Davidi,

english: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.
translation: Amabele yobe nayo yaba ngo twana tubili,

english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.
translation: Ine nalaya ikala pa lupili lwa cena ca muri ne ca cinyamuti ca fulankinisenshi,

english: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
translation: We mutemwikwa wandi, ala wayembafye onse,

english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
translation: Fumamo mu Lebanoni, tuleya iwe we nabwinga wandi,

english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.
translation: We nkashi yandi, we nabwinga wandi,

english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.
translation: We nkashi yandi, nabwinga wandi,

english: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.
translation: Umutemwikwa wandi aba no mubili uwatelela kabili umusweshi,

english: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.
translation: Umutwe wakwe ni golide uwalopololwa bwino.

english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.
translation: Amenso yakwe yaba nge nkunda ishili mupepi na kamana akalepita,

english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.
translation: Amasaya yakwe yaba nga molwa wa luputa,

english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
translation: Iminwe yakwe yaba isuma iyakulungilwa bwino kwati ni golide,

english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
translation: Amolu yakwe yaba nge nceshi ishakuulilwa na mabwe ayakulungika aya marbo,

english: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
translation: Akanwa kakwe kalilowesha

english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”
translation: Ine nali mu tulo, lelo umutima wandi wena walelola.

english: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?
translation: Na ine nayasuka nati, “Ala ine nimfula ifyakufwala,

english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.
translation: Umutemwikwa wandi epakupisha iminwe yakwe mu cipunda ca ciibi,

english: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.
translation: Awe naima, naya kukwiswilako umutemwikwa wandi,

english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.
translation: Kutifye cilya naiswilako umutemwikwa wandi,

english: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.
translation: Bamalonda abapitana mu musumba basuka bansanga,

english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
translation: Mwe bakashana ba mu Yerusalemu, nga mwamona umutemwikwa wandi,

english: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?
translation: Cinshi calenga umutemwikwa obe ukucila bambi,

english: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
translation: Iwe we wacila abanakashi bonse kukuyemba,

english: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?
translation: “Nani ulya alemoneka nge mibengelele ya pa macaca,

english: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.
translation: Ine naya kwibala lya miti ya fitwalo,

english: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
translation: Ukwabula ukwenekela, ukukabila kwandi kwambika mu maceleta ya bufumu bwa bantu bandi.

english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
translation: Umutemwikwa wandi ele kwibala lyakwe,

english: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.
translation: Ine ndi wa mutemwikwa wandi,

english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.
translation: Ala uli musuma we mutemwikwa wandi,

english: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.
translation: Leka ukundolekesha,

english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.
translation: Ameno yobe yabuuta tuutu ngo mukuni wa mpaanga ishikota

english: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
translation: Insensematwi shobe nasho shalingana bwino,

english: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
translation: Banamfumu abasano baba amakumi mutanda (60),

english: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.
translation: lelo inkunda yandi, uwapwililika wandi, ena abafye umo mpo.

english: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.
translation: Yangu amakasa yobe ukuyemba mu ndyato,

english: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.
translation: Ine ndi wa mutemwikwa wandi, nao ninefye afwaya epela.

english: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.
translation: Ale mune natuleya kwibala,

english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.
translation: Tukacelela ukubuuka no kupitana mu mabala ya myangashi

english: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.
translation: Umfwa ifyo ifimpusa fya mandarake aleta akacena kakwe akasuma.

english: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.
translation: Umutoto obe waba nga kamamfwente wa nsupa

english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.
translation: Amabele yobe nayo yaba ngo twana tubili,

english: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.
translation: Akamukoshi kobe kapololoka

english: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
translation: Umutwe obe wasansama ngo lupili lwa Kameli.

english: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
translation: Yangu ifyo wayemba, ifyo wawamisha we mutemwikwa wandi,

english: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
translation: Waba nga kancindu kukupololoka,

english: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples.
translation: Awe nalaninako ku kancindu, uleke ntonyeko ku fitwalo.

english: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.
translation: Akanwa kobe kaba ngo mwangashi uwawamisha.

english: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
translation: Yangu! Auba ndume yandi uo mayo aonseshe,

english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
translation: Ine ndi linga, na mabele yandi e mpungu shaliko.

english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
translation: Solomoni alikwata ibala lya myangashi ku Baali Hamoni,

english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
translation: Lelo ine nalikwatila ne mwine ibala lya myangashi.

english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!
translation: Iwe we mutemwikwa wandi we waikala mwibala,

english: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
translation: Endesha, isa we mutemwikwa wandi,

english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
translation: Nga nakubuula, uleka nkwingisha mu ŋanda yakwa mayo,

english: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
translation: Ninsaila umutwe wandi pa kuboko kwakwe ukwa ku kuso,

english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
translation: Imwe mwe bakashana ba mu Yerusalemu, ndemukonkomesha nati,

english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
translation: Nani ulya aleisa, alefuma mu matololo,

english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
translation: Umbike nge cishibilo mu mutima obe,

english: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
translation: Amenshi nangu yafule shani, awe teti yaushimye,

english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
translation: Nkashi yesu talakula, na mabele talamena.

english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
translation: Nkashi yesu nga lilinga,

english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
translation: Ine ne ulelemba nine Paulo, umusha wakwa Lesa, kabili ndi musole wakwa Yesu Kristu. Ine nalisontwa no kutumwa kukwafwilishako abasalwa bakwa Lesa mu cisumino cabo, elyo no kubatungulula kukwishiba icishinka icaba mu bwina Lesa.

english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
translation: Pantu eko balifye abengi abasangukila Lesa, abalelanda ifyaciwelewele no kubepaika abantu. Abengi pali aba, bena Kristu abafuma ku mipepele ya Bayuda.

english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
translation: Aba bantu bena uli nokubalesha, pantu baleonaulafye icisumino mu ndupwa sha bantu mukufunda ifyo bashifwile kufunda. Kabili balecita ifyo ku mulandu wakufwayafye ukunonka indalama.

english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
translation: Umwina Kiliti fye umwine, umo pali bakasesema wabo, ewasosele ati, “Abena Kiliti lyonse balandafye ifyabufi, fiswango ifibi, banaŋani, kabili abafunuka.”

english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
translation: Kanshi ifyo alandile fyacishinka. Eico iwe uli nokubakalipila nganshi, pakuti bakwate icisumino cacine cine.

english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
translation: Kabili baleke no kulakonkelela ifya mu milumbe ya Bayuda na mafunde ya bantu abasuula icishinka.

english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
translation: Ku bantu abakaele takwaba icabakowesha. Lelo ku bantu abaobelwa mukubifya na mukukanasumina, bena fyonse fyakubakowesha, pantu kampingu wa mitima yabo na mano yabo fyalikowela.

english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
translation: Bena basosa ukuti balishiba Lesa, lelo ifyo bacita filakaana ici. Bantu abalupato, kabili ni bacintomfwa, tekuti bacite icisuma nelyo cimo.

english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
translation: Neci cishinka cashintilila pesubilo lyakushukila umweo wape. Ni Lesa uushibepa, ewatulaile uyu mweo kale ilyo ne nshita tailabako.

english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
translation: Asokolwele ifi mu mashiwi yakwe pa nshita iyalingile. Lesa Umupusushi wesu ewankonkomeshe no kumpeela uyu mulimo wakubila aya mashiwi.

english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
translation: Nakulembela iwe Tito, we mwana wandi icine cine mu cisumino ico iwe na ine twakwata.

english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
translation: Ico nakushilile mu Kiliti ni pakuti ushale walungika ifintu fyonse ifilefwaikwa ukulungika, elyo no kusonta abakalamba ba nkuta mu misumba yonse. Uleibukisha ifyo nakwebele.

english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
translation: Umukalamba afwile ukuba umuntu uwabula umulandu. Afwile akwatefye umukashi umo na bamwane bafwile ukuba abantu abasumina, kabili abashili bampundililwa ku fyabukakashi nangu bucintomfwa.

english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
translation: Apo kangalila angalila umulimo wakwa Lesa, tafwile kuba na mulandu. Kabili elaumya maka yakuteeka, nangu ukuba uwacipyu, nangu ukuba cakolwa, nangu uwalubuli, nangu uukonkelela ulunkumbwa lwa ndalama.

english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
translation: Ali nokuba umuntu uwaishiba ukupokelela abeni, kabili uwatemwa ukucita ifisuma. Ali nokuba umuntu uwatekanya, uufwaya lyonse ukucita ifyalungama, uwakatiina kuli Lesa, kabili uwa misango isuma.

english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
translation: Afwile ukusunga bwino nganshi amashiwi yacishinka ayo afundwa, epakuti alekoseleshako bambi mukubafunda amafunde yacine cine, elyo kabili no kulanga ifyo baluba abo abaleyakaanya.

english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
translation: Lelo iwe ulefunda ifyakuti tafipusene na mafunde yacine cine.

english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
translation: nangu ukubebila ifintu. Lelo bafwile ukuilanga ukuti bantu abasuma lyonse, kabili bantu abalingile ukucetekelwa. Epakuti fyonse ifyo balecita fileleta umucinshi ku fifundwa pali Lesa Umupusushi wesu.

english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
translation: Pantu Lesa alisokolola ku bantu bonse icikuuku cakwe icakupusukilamo.

english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
translation: Ici cikuuku citufunda ukuleka imikalile ishili ya bwina Lesa no lunkumbwa lwa fya pano calo. Citufunda ukwikala pano calo abatekanya, abololoke, kabili abapetamina Lesa,

english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
translation: ilyo tulelolela no kusubila ne nsansa ukwisa ukwacindama ukwakwa Lesa Mukulu kabili Umupusushi wesu Kristu Yesu.

english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
translation: Kristu Yesu aliileka ilambo umwine pakuti atulubule ku bubi bwesu bonse, tube abakaele. Epakuti tubefye abantu bakwe, abasakamana ukucita ifisuma.

english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
translation: Kanshi ifi efyo uli nokufunda. Ulebomfya amaka yobe yonse wapeelwa mukucincisha no kukalipila abalekumfwa. Wilaleka nelyo umo ukuti akusuule.

english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
translation: Ulefunda abaume abakalamba ukuti bali nokuba abantu aba misango isuma, abamano, kabili abatekanya. Tabali nakunenuka mu cisumino, mu citemwiko, na mukushipikisha.

english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
translation: Eifyo fine ulefunda abanakashi abakalamba ukuti baleba ne misango nga banakashi abapetamina Lesa. Tabali nakuba ababepeshanya nangu ukuba abasha ba bwalwa. Bali nokulafunda ifintu ifisuma.

english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
translation: Epakuti balefunda abanakashi abacikashana ukulatemwa abalume babo na bana babo.

english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
translation: Kabili epakuti baleba abatekanya, abakaele, abasunga amayanda yabo bwino, abamutembo, abacumfwila ku balume babo, epakuti pelaba nelyo umo uwakulanda ifibi pa mashiwi yakwa Lesa.

english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
translation: Eifyo fine na balumendo nabo, ulebacincisha ukuba abatekanya.

english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
translation: Muli fyonse iwe wine uleba icilangililo kufyo ulecita. Ulebikako amano no kufunda ne cishinka.

english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
translation: Ulebomfya amashiwi ayasuma ayakuti teti pabe uwakuyasusha. Epakuti abalwani bobe baleikatwa ne nsoni, ico bafilwa ukukwata ifibi ifyakulanda pali ifwe.

english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
translation: Abasha balenakila bashikulwibo no kulabasansamusha mu fintu fyonse. Tabali nakulabakaanyapo nelyo cimo ilyo balelanda,

english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
translation: Ulecinkula abena Kristu ukuti bali nokunakila bakateeka na ba mu buteko. Bali nokubabeela, elyo nokuipekanya ukubomba imilimo yonse isuma.

english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
translation: Umuntu uulenga ukupusana, umusokeko pafyo alecita imiku ibili. Elyo lyena umusuulekofye.

english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
translation: Nawishiba ukuti umuntu wa musango uyo alifulungana, ne fyabubifi fyakwe filamushinina umwine ukuti alalufyanya.

english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
translation: Ilyo nkatuma Atema nangu Tukiko kuli iwe, ukeshe na maka yobe ukwisa ku Nikapoli, pantu eko mpingwile ukwikala mu nshita yampepo.

english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
translation: Weshe na maka yobe yonse ukwafwilisha Sena, fundi wa mafunde mu calo, na Apolo pakuti bakatampe ubulendo bwabo. Ukamone ukuti bakwata fyonse ifyo balekabila.

english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
translation: Abantu besu bali nokusambilila ukubomfya inshita yabo mukucita imilimo isuma, epakumona ukwafwilishako abalekabila icine cine. Kabili epakumwenamo ifyo balekabila abene.

english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
translation: Bonse abo tuli nabo kuno balekuposha. Uposhepo bonse abatutemwa pa mulandu wa cisumino.

english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
translation: Ulebeba tabali nakwamba umuntu nelyo umo nangu ukulaumana, baleba abamutembo elyo kabili abamucinshi ku bantu bonse.

english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
translation: Na ifwe pa nshita imo twali ifiwelewele, ficintomfwa kabili abalubantika. Twateekelwe ubusha no lunkumbwa lubi na ku fyakuisansamusha ifya misango misango. Ubumi bwesu bonse bwalifye mukubifya na mu mufimbila, bambi nga batupata na ifwe twalebapata.

english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
translation: Lelo ilyo uluse lwakwa Lesa Umupusushi wesu ne citemwiko cakwe ku bantu fyasokolweke,

english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
translation: elyo Lesa atupuswishe. Tatupuswishe ico ifwe fwe bene twacitile ifintu fimo ifisuma, lelo ni pa mulandu wa luse lwakwefye. Pantu atupuswishe ilyo Mupashi Wamushilo atusambile pakuti tufyalwe cipya cipya, nokutulenga ukuba no mweo upya.

english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
translation: Pantu Lesa alitufumfumwina Mupashi Wamushilo pa mulandu wakwa Yesu Kristu Umupusushi wesu.

english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
translation: Acita ifi, pakuti ku cikuuku cakwe tumone ukuba abakaele pa cinso cakwe, elyo no kushukila umweo wa pe uo tusubila.

english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
translation: Aya mashiwi yacishinka. Ine ndefwaya ukuti ulekomailapo nganshi pali ifi fintu, epakuti abasumina muli Lesa balesakamana ukulacita imilimo isuma. Ifi fintu, fisuma kabili ifyakwafwa abantu.

english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
translation: Lelo iwe uletaluka ku fikansa fyaciwelewele, ifya pa mashina ya fikolwe, kukuumana na kukulwila pa mafunde yakwa Mose. Ifi fintu fyafyefye, tafibomba nelyo cimo.

english: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
translation: Pa mibundo mulelomba imfula kuli Yawe.

english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
translation: Nkabafumya mu calo ca Egupto

english: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
translation: Bakabuka bemba uwayafya,

english: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
translation: Nine ne Yawe nkalakosha abantu bandi,

english: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
translation: Utulubi twakupendwilako pa ŋanda tusosa ifyabufi,

english: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
translation: “Ine nimfulilwa bakacema,

english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
translation: Ku Yuda ekukafuma umo uwakuba nge libwe lya petungi,

english: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.
translation: Abena Yuda bakacimfya kwati bashilika abalenyantauka pa balwani babo,

english: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.
translation: “Ine nkapeela aba ŋanda yakwa Yuda amaka,

english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.
translation: Abena Efulemu bakaba nge mpalume,

english: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.
translation: “Ine nkabetila mu munsoli,

english: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.
translation: Nangu ine nabasalanganishisha mu mishobo ya benafyalo,

english: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
translation: Isula ifibi fyobe iwe we calo ca Lebanoni,

english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
translation: Epakubuula ne nkonto yandi iyaleitwa Icikuuku, naikontolamo fibili pakonaula icipangano ico ine napangana na bantu ba mishobo yonse.

english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD’s word.
translation: Kanshi pali ubo bwine bushiku, ne cipangano emyonaikile. Abalecusha impaanga nabo balendolesha, no kushininkisha elyo nomba bashininkisha ukuti kanshi lishiwi lyakwa Yawe.

english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
translation: Na ine epakubeba nati, “Imwe nga mwamona ukuti nacilolamo, ninshi kanshi ndipileni amalipilo yandi. Nga tacilolelemo, ninshi kanshi amalipilo kayabefye.” Awe nabo epakundipila indalama sha silifa amakumi yatatu (30).

english: The LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD’s house.
translation: Yawe nao anjeba ati, “Isho ndalama, kashipose kuli kabumba wa nongo, eshintu bena bamwene ukuti e mutengo uuningilefye bwino, mwa.” Kanshi na ine epakubuula isho ndalama sha silifa amakumi yatatu (30), awe naya shiposa mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe kuli kabumba wa nongo.

english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
translation: Elyo kabili nabuula inkonto inankwe Ukwampana, nayo naikontolamo fibili pakonaula ubwananyina bwa bena Yuda na bena Israeli.

english: The LORD said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
translation: Mateo 26:15

english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.
translation: Ine nkasonta umuntu umo mu calo uukalacema impaanga shandi, lelo kwena takalesakamana kulapokololako impaanga ishilesanswa, takalefwaya ne shileluba nakalya, takaleundapa ne shilecenwa, nangu ukulaliisha ishileshalapo. Ena abingilefye ukulalyapo ishainisha, no kulashisotaulako imondo.

english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
translation: “Ala ashama uyu kacema iciwelewele ca muntu,

english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.
translation: Akuloosheni mwe miti ya paini,

english: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
translation: Umfweni bakacema abo baleloosha,

english: The LORD my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
translation: Ifi efyasosa Yawe Lesa wandi ati, “Iwe akucema impaanga isho balaswa baleipaya.

english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.
translation: Abashita impaanga balashipaya ukwabula ukupeelelwapo umulandu. Abashishitisha, no kusosa balasosa abati, ‘Yawe apaalwe na matotelo, pantu nomba ifwe tuli bakankala.’ Ala na bantu bene abashicema tabashilangulukilako nakalya.”

english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says the LORD; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Ine nomba nshakatale nakabili nangulukilako abekala muli cino calo. Abantu bonsefye umo umo ine nkaleka intungulushi yabo atemwa imfumu yabo eyo ikabateeke ku kalili. Isho ntungulushi shikonaula icalo, na ine wine nshakabapokololeko uko shili iyoo.”

english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.
translation: Elyo nacemena bashimakwebo impaanga isho bali nokulaipaya. Nafwaya ne nkonto shibili, imo nalaita Cikuuku, ibiye nayo nalaita Ukwampana. Awe na ine nalacema ne mpaanga.

english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
translation: Natamfishe bakacema batatu mu mweshi umo, kanshi na ine epakutendwa impaanga, nasho shamfulumuka.

english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”
translation: Elyo nasosa nati, “Awe ine nomba imwe nshalemusunga nakabili iyoo. Mwe sho bali nokwipaya, kabamwipayefye. Mwe shili nokuloba, lobenifye. Muleke ne shikashalapo shilelya imibili ya shibiye.”

english: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:
translation: Yawe alisobele ishiwi lyakwe palwa calo ca Israeli. Ifi efyasosa Yawe uwaandalika umulu, uwabumba ne isonde, uwapanga no mupashi wa muntu mu nda yakwe. Eulesosa ati,

english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.
translation: “Nomba pa ba ŋanda yakwa Davidi na pali bonse abaikala mu Yerusalemu nkapongolwelapo umupashi wakukwatisha uluse no wakupapata. Bakandolesha, pali uyo bapulinkanyamo icanso, bakamuloosha nga filya fine baloosha umwana mwaume uwabafye umo mpo. Bakamuloosha kwati bantu bafwililwe umwana wabo umwaume uwe beli.

english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku mu musumba wa Yerusalemu mukaba imisowa iyikalamba, nga ilya ine yumfwika mwiwanga lya Megido, ilyo abantu baloosha Hadadi Rimoni.

english: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
translation: Indupwa shonse mu calo shikalaloosha ulu lweka, ulu nalo lweka. Ulupwa lwa ba ŋanda yakwa Davidi abaume bakalaloosha beka, abakashi babo nabo beka. Ulupwa lwa ba ŋanda yakwa Natani abaume bakalaloosha beka, abakashi babo nabo beka.

english: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
translation: Ulupwa lwa ba ŋanda yakwa Levi abaume bakalaloosha beka, abakashi babo nabo beka. Ulupwa lwa ba ŋanda yakwa Shimei abaume bakalaloosha beka, abakashi babo nabo beka.

english: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
translation: Na mu ndupwa shimbi shonse lumo lumo ishashala, abaume bakalaloosha beka, abakashi babo nabo beka.”

english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.
translation: “Ine nkacita Yerusalemu ngo lukombo lwa fikola, abantu ba mishobo imbi iyashinguluka Yerusalemu bakanwamo, no kupungaila bakalapungaila ku lwakukolwa. Ilyo bakatebelela umusumba wa Yerusalemu, ne misumba imbi yonse iya mu calo ca Yuda nayo bakaitebelela no kuilwisha.

english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.
translation: Iyo nshita nga yafika, ilyo abantu ba mishobo yonse iya pano isonde bakakumbinkana no kuwililila umusumba wa Yerusalemu, ine nkaucita nge cilibwe icafinisha, na bantufye bonse abakeshako ukucimya, imisana yabo ikafunaika nganshi.

english: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku ine ne Yawe nkapupanya bakabalwe babo bonse, nkapenya na bonse abakalaendelapo.” Efyasosa Yawe. “Aba ŋanda yakwa Yuda nkalabalinda, lelo bakabalwe ba balwani babo bena ine nkabapofusha amenso.

english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’
translation: Elyo intungulushi sha bena Yuda shikalaebana mu mitima ashiti, ‘Ala ni Yawe umwine wa fita eutukosha ifwe fwe bantu bakwe, fwe baikala muno Yerusalemu.’

english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.
translation: “Pali bulya bushiku ine nkacita indupwa sha bena Yuda shikabe ngo mulilo uuleyaka mu mutengo umo, nangu mwibala limo umuli imyanshi ya ŋanu iilepya. Abena Yuda aba ebakalofya abantu ba mitundu yonse iyaba mupepi ku kulyo nangu ku kuso. Nomba abena Yerusalemu bena bakashala nabekalilila pa ncende yabo.”

english: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
translation: Yawe akabalilapo ukupususha amayanda ya bena Yuda, epakuti umucinshi wa ba ŋanda yakwa Davidi pamo no wa bena Yerusalemu wikacila umucinshi uo na bena Yuda bakakwata.

english: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku Yawe akalacingililako abena Yerusalemu, icakuti no tufwanda twabo twine tukaba no bulamba nga bulya bwine bwakweteko Davidi. Aba ŋanda yakwa Davidi ebakalabatungulula nga Lesa wine, kwati ni malaika wakwa Yawe alebatungulula.

english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
translation: Pali bulya bushiku ine nkatampa ukulalofya abantu ba mishobo yonse abakalawililila umusumba wa Yerusalemu.
