english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
translation: “Ubushiku bulya nga bwafika intulo ikapongwela amenshi aya kamfukumfuku, ayo aba ŋanda yakwa Davidi na bena Yerusalemu bakasambamo ifibi fyabo ne fyakowela fyabo.

english: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.
translation: “Pali bulya bushiku ine nkalofya amashina ya tulubi mu calo, tamwakabe nelyo umo uukalayebukisha nakabili iyoo.” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita. “Na bakasesema babufi nabo nkabafumyamo, nkapwishamo ne cikonkelelo cakufwaya umupashi wa fyakowela mu calo.

english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in the LORD’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.
translation: Elyo umo nga akakonkanyapo ukusesema, wishi na nyina abamufyalilila bakamweba abati, ‘Ulefwafye iwe, pantu iwe uleitunga ukulandila mwishina lyakwa Yawe, kanshi fyabufifye ulelanda.’ Elyo nga abwekeshapo ukusesema, ninshi wishi na nyina abamufyalilila ebakumupulinkanyamo icanso pa mulandu wakusesema ifyabufi.

english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,
translation: “Pali bulya bushiku bakasesema bonse bakekatwe nsoni palwa fimonwa fyabo ilyo basesema nangu ukufwala ifyakufwala fya bukasesema, pakubepa ukuti ni kasesema.

english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’
translation: Kasesema onse akalatilafye, ‘Awe ine nshili kasesema, ndi mulimifye. Ine ukulima eko nakulilamo ukutulafye na ku bwaice bwandi.’

english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’
translation: Umo akalati nga aipushapo kasesema umo ati, ‘Nga kanshi ifyo fibala fili pa mubili obe, wafikwata shani?’ Nao akalaasukafye ati, ‘Bancenene ku ŋanda ya bacibusa wandi.’”

english: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says the LORD of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
translation: “Ale we lupanga lwandi, sansa kacema wandi,

english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says the LORD, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.
translation: Efyasosa Yawe.

english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’”
translation: Iciputulwa cikashalapo eco ine nkaposa mu mulilo,

english: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.
translation: Ubushiku bwakwa Yawe bukafika ilyo ifyo bakamutapa bakalafyakanina pa menso yenu.

english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.
translation: Icalo conse icashinguluka umusumba wa Yerusalemu cikaba icabatama nga ku Araba, ukutendekelafye ku Geba lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ukuya shintafye na ku Rimoni lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kulyo. Lelo umusumba wa Yerusalemu ukaba uwasansama ukucila ne calo icaba mu mbali yauko. Umusumba ukatula ku mpongolo yakwa Benjamini, ukuya fika na ku mpongolo ya petungi, palya pabelele impongolo yapakubala, elyo kabinge ukufuma ku lupungu lwakwa Hananeli, ukuya fika na palya balekamina imfumu ya calo umwangashi.

english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.
translation: Abantu bakalaikalila mu musumba ku matwi tondolo, takwakabe nakabili uukalapangila ukonaula umusumba wa Yerusalemu.

english: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.
translation: Abantu ba mishobo yonse abalwishishe umusumba wa Yerusalemu, Yawe akabaletela icikuko icabipisha pamo ngeci. Imibili yabo ikalabola ilyo ninshi nabeminina pa makasa yabo, na menso yabo yakalabola mu fikumbi fya yako, ne ndimi shabo shine shikalabolela kumo mu tunwa twabo.

english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.
translation: Iyo nshita Yawe akapelenganya amano ya bantu abakalwisha Yerusalemu. Bakalaba no mwenso icakuti bonse umo umo bakalaikatanapo no munabo umo, no kulashomboka nankwe.

english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.
translation: Abena Yuda nabo bakaiposamo no kuya lwa ku Yerusalemu. Ifyuma fya bantu ba iyo mishobo iyashinguluka yonse, ifili nga golide, silifa ne fyakufwala ifingi, abena Yuda bakafilonganya no kufitapa bakafitapa.

english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.
translation: Ico cine cikuko ecikalaipaya na bakabalwe, ne mfalashi, ne ngamila, na bapunda, ne fitekwa fyonse ifikalaba mu nkambi sha balwani babo.

english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.
translation: Ilyo abalwani bakacimba, elyo aba mishobo bonse abakashalapo bakalaya imyaka yonse ku Yerusalemu, kukupepa Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita, na kukusefya inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe.

english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.
translation: Umushobo wa bantu umo pano isonde uukalakaana ukuya ku Yerusalemu kukupepa Imfumu Yawe umwine wa fita, awe wena ninshi mu calo cauko tamwakaleloka imfula nakalya.

english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.
translation: Abena Egupto nga balakaana ukulaisako no kubuulamo ulubali ninshi nabo bene bakaponenwa ne cikuko, ico Yawe akalaletela abantu ba mishobo yonse umo umo, abakalakaana ukulaya kukucindika inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe.

english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.
translation: Efyo abena Egupto bakalalimunwa pamo na bantu ba mishobo imbi yonse abakalakaana ukulaya kukusefya inshikunkulu ya Nsakwe.

english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
translation: Nkalonganya abantu ba mishobo yonse, pakuti bakese wililila umusumba wa Yerusalemu. Nabo bakaupoka, bakatapa ifyuma fya mu mayanda, bakolungana na banakashi ku maka. Citika wa bantu bakabasenda muli bunkole, abakashalapo bena tabakabafumye mu musumba iyoo.

english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.
translation: Pali bulya ubushiku pa tunyenjele uto bakabalwe bakalafwala, pakalalembwa amashiwi yakutila, “Kabalwe uyu wamushilo kuli Yawe.” Ne nongo sha mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe nasho shine shikaba ishamushilo, nga filya fyaba inweno shilya shikala pa ntanshi ya bulambo.

english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.
translation: Inongo shonse isha mu musumba wa Yerusalemu, ne sha mu calo ca Yuda, bakashipatwila Yawe umwine wa fita. Na bantu bonse abakalaisa kukutuula amalambo, bakalabuulapo shimo no kulaipikilamo inama ishikalatuulwa amalambo. Kanshi iyo nshita nga yafika, tamwakalemoneka nakabili shimakwebo mu ŋanda yakwa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
translation: Elyo Yawe nao nomba akema no kuya lwisha iyo mishobo, nga filya fine alecita na kale mu nshiku sha bulwi.

english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
translation: Pali bulya ubushiku lyena akeminina pa lupili lwa Miolifa, lulya lwalungatana no musumba wa Yerusalemu lubali lwa ku kabanga. No lupili lwa Miolifa lukalepuka pakati, ukutula ku kabanga ukulola na ku masamba, pakaba umukonko uukalamba nganshi. Icipande cimo ica lupili cikaselela ku kapinda ka ku kuso, icinankwe naco ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.

english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.
translation: Pakupusuka imwe mukapita muli uyo wine umukonko uukashinta ku lubali lwa Aseli. Mukafulumuka nga filya fine ifikolwe fyenu fyafulumwike ilyo kwaishile icinkukuma pa nshita imfumu Usia yaleteeka icalo ca Yuda. Elyo Yawe Lesa wandi akesa moneka pamo na bamushilo bakwe bonse.

english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.
translation: Pali bulya ubushiku takwakabe mpepo nangufye icikutuma, kabili tabwakele iyoo.

english: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.
translation: Kukabafye ulubuuto lwa kasuba inshita yonse, takwakabe ubushiku nelyo akasuba, lelo ku nshita ya cungulo kukaba ulubuuto. Ni Yawe ekafye ewaishiba ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika.

english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.
translation: Pali bulya ubushiku nga bwafika mu musumba wa Yerusalemu mukalafuma amenshi ayamweo, yamo yakalaya kuli bemba ulubali lwa ku kabanga , yambi nayo yakalalola kuli bemba ulubali lwa ku masamba . Ayo menshi yakalapitafye mu mainsa na mu lusuba.

english: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.
translation: Elyo nomba ninshi ni Yawe e mfumu ya pesonde lyonse, ninshi nomba ekafye ewalaba Yawe, ne shina lyakwe lyekafye elyo nomba abantu bakalalumbula.

english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
translation: Mu mweshi wa cine konse konse mu mwaka walengele ibili apo Dariusi abelele imfumu nkalamba iya calo ca Pesia, elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Sakaria mwana Berekia, mwana Ido ilyakuti,

english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”
translation: Elyo umuntu uwaiminine mu miti ya muetulo asosa ati, “Yawe natuma aba bantu abali pali bakabalwe, ukuya mukulonda isonde lyonse.”

english: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
translation: Nabo epakubwesesha amashiwi kuli malaika wakwa Yawe uwaiminine mu miti ya muetulo abati, “Natupitana pano isonde ponse, twaya sanga napatalala tondolo, pali cibote.”

english: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe asosa ati, “We Yawe umwine wa fita, nomba yaba imyaka amakumi cine lubali (70) apo wafulilwa umusumba wa Yerusalemu, ne misumba imbi iya mu calo ca Yuda. Bushe ni lilali ukailangulukilako?”

english: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.
translation: Elyo pakwasuka malaika uo twalelanda nankwe, Yawe amwasukafye amashiwi ayasuma, ayakumuteeka umutima.

english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
translation: Abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo abaikalafye ubwanalale, awe bena nalibafulilwa apakalambafye, pantu ine naletifye cilya nanashako ukufulilwa abantu bandi, ninshi abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo nabo elyo bacishamo ukulalufyanya abantu bandi.

english: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’
translation: Eco nomba ine mbwelulukile pakuti ncitile umusumba wa Yerusalemu uluse nakabili, ne ŋanda yandi ikakuulwa cipya cipya. No mwando wakupiminako ukatintwa pali Yerusalemu.” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”
translation: Kabinge malaika anjeba ukuti nje ndebila imbila nati, “Yawe umwine wa fita alesosa ukuti mu misumba yandi mukafulisha nakabili ifintu fisuma, nokuti nakabili nkalangulukilako Sioni, nokuti nkabwekeshapo nakabili ne mwine ukuteeka Yerusalemu.”

english: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.
translation: “Ine ne Yawe nalifulilwe bashinwe nganshi.

english: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Eico nomba ndemweba ukuti ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, ‘Bwelulukileni kuli ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita, na ine wine ne Yawe umwine wa fita ninshi nalabwelulukila uko muli.’

english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.
translation: Mwilaba nga bashinwe, abo bakasesema bakale balekonkomesha amashiwi yandi ne Yawe umwine wa fita, pakuti baleke imisango yabo ibi ne mikalile yabo ibi. Lelo bashinwe bena tebakuŋumfwa nangufye ukumbeela nakalya. Efyo nasosa ne Yawe.

english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
translation: Tepapa, nga nomba bashinwe bali kwi? Nga bakasesema bushe nabo balabelelela batini?

english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”
translation: Lelo amashiwi yandi ne fipope fyandi, ifyo naebele ababomfi bandi bakasesema pakuti bafifishe kuli bashinwe, kwena fyalibekete imitima. Basukile balapila, no kusumina basumina ukuti ee, nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita mbalimwine ukulingana ne myendele ne micitile yabo, ngomo napangile ukubalimwina.”

english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
translation: Mu mwaka walengele ibili apo Dariusi abelele imfumu, pa bushiku bwalenga amakumi yabili na shine (24), mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo na umo (11) , umweshi wine uo baleita Shebati, elintu ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli kasesema Sakaria mwana Berekia, mwana Ido.

english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.
translation: Pa nshita ya bushiku nalikwete icimonwa, namwene umuntu ali pali kabalwe umo uwakashika. Ilyo ninshi eminine mu miti ya muetulo iyali mu kamupokapoka kamo, na pa numa yakwe pali bakabalwe abakashika, abamabala mabala, na babuuta.

english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”
translation: Na ine namwipusha nati, “Mukwai, nga bakabalwe aba banshi?”

english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
translation: Mu cimonwa na cimbi, ine nainwine amenso no kumona umuntu ali no mwando umo uwakupiminako.

english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Akwaula utupundu ne nsansa iwe we mwana mwanakashi Sioni, pantu ine naisa kukwikala pakati kenu.”

english: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
translation: Pali ilya nshita abantu ba mishobo iyingi bakesa kuli Yawe no kuba abantu abandi. Ine nkalaikala pakati kenu, nemwe mukashininkisha ukuti kanshi ni Yawe umwine wa fita ewantumine uko muli.

english: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
translation: Nakabili Yawe akekatila Yuda nge cuma icakwefye icacishilano ica mu calo icamushilo, na Yerusalemu eukaba umusumba wakwe uo akatemwisha pali yonse.

english: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
translation: Mwe bantu bonse talaleni tondolo pa cinso cakwa Yawe, pantu nakakamuka mu cifulo cakwe icamushilo.

english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
translation: Na ine namwipusha nati “Waya kwi?”

english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,
translation: Malaika uo twalelanda nankwe cilya ati aleya, malaika umbi aisa ku mubiye, elyo malaika uo twalelanda nankwe aeba malaika mubiye ati,

english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
translation: “We, butuka, kebe ulya mulumendo ali no mwando wakupiminako auti, ‘Ala umusumba wa Yerusalemu tawakalebako malinga iyoo, pantu abantu abakalaikalamo bakafulisha ne ŋombe shine shikafulishamo.

english: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
translation: Pantu Yawe nalaya ukuti umwine wine eukaba nge linga lya mulilo ilikashinguluka umusumba pakuusunga, nokuti umwine wine eukalaikalamo no bucindami bwakwe bonse.’”

english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.
translation: “Iseni, Iseni, mufulumuke mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso, pantu nine namusalanganishishe mu tupinda tune utwa myulu.” Efyasosa Yawe.

english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
translation: “Isa we Sioni, fulumuka we waikala mu mwana mwanakashi wa Babiloni.”

english: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita nanjeba amashiwi ayakuya eba abantu ba mishobo ya benafyalo iyatapile abantu bakwe ukuti, “Umuntu onsefye uwikata mu bantu bandi ine ne Yawe, ala ninshi akumya pa mboni ya linso lyandi.

english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.
translation: Ine wine nine nkamulwisha imwe, nimwe nomba mukatapwa ku bantu bene abali kale abasha benu. Ilyo ici cintu cikacitika, ala elyo abantu bonse bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi ni Yawe umwine wa fita ewantumine.”

english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
translation: Elyo malaika anangile shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua uwaiminine lubali kuli malaika wakwa Yawe, kabili ananga na Satana uwaiminine nao ku kulyo kwakwa Yoshua pakuti amusoselele.

english: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
translation: Ubuso 12:10

english: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
translation: Esra 5:2

english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
translation: Yoshua ninshi naiminina lubali kuli malaika, ninshi nafwala ne nsalu ishalamba.

english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”
translation: Elyo malaika aeba abaiminine pa cinso cakwe ati, “Aleni fuuleni uyu muntu insalu shakwe ishalamba.” Elyo apilibukila kuli Yoshua ati, “Wamona, ine nakufumisha ifibi fyobe, nalakufwika nomba insalu ishawamisha.”

english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.
translation: Elyo nasosa nati, “Mupombeni insalu iyisuma ku mutwe wakwe.” Kanshi nabo epakupomba ne nsalu iyawamisha ku mutwe wakwe, ninshi na malaika wakwa Yawe naiminina apo pene.

english: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
translation: Elyo malaika wakwa Yawe akonkomesha Yoshua

english: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.
translation: ukuti Yawe umwine wa fita aletila ati, “Iwe nga walabeela amafunde yandi, walabomba imilimo iyo ine nakupeela, ninshi niwe wakulaba kateeka wa ŋanda yandi, niwe wakulayangalila ne mansa sha ŋanda yandi, kabili nkakupeela ne cifulo ne nsambu shakuba pamo naba beminine pano.

english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.
translation: Kanshi umfweni kuno we Yoshua, we shimapepo mukalamba, pamo na banobe abekala nobe, imwe nimwe cishibilo icakwishibilako ifikabako. Ine nkaletapo umubomfi wandi uwitwa Umusambo.

english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
translation: Mwamona ilibwe ili limo mpo ilyo ine nabika pa cinso cakwa Yoshua, nalyo lili na menso cine lubali. Nine ne mwine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nalalembapo ifilembo, na pa bushiku bumo bwinefye mpo ine nkafumya ububi muli cino calo.

english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
translation: Malaika uo twalandile nankwe pakubala, alishile nakabili, no kwisa ncilimusha kwati muntu uo babuusha mu tulo.

english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
translation: Nomba nani uwingasuula ifintu finono ifikacitika pali ubo bushiku? Abantu bakasansamuka pakumona ifyo Serubabeli ali no mwando wakukuulila mu minwe yakwe.”

english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
translation: Elyo na ine namwipusha nati, “Nga ilya imiti ya miolifa ibili iyili ku cakutekapo ifisaniko uku noku, nayo yanshi?

english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
translation: Nga ilya imisambo ibili iya muolifa ileitulwila amafuta mu mipaipi yabili aya golide, umo nayo amafuta yalekonkoloka, bushe nayo yanshi?”

english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
translation: Nao anjipusha ati, “Bushe kanshi tawishibe, mwa?”

english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
translation: Elyo nao ati, “Aba bantu babili ebo Imfumu umwine we sonde lyonse asuba amafuta no kuipatwila pakuti eo balebombela.”

english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;
translation: Elyo anjipusha ati, “Finshi wamona?”

english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
translation: Lubali lwaciko kuli imiti ya miolifa ibili, umo lubali lwa ku kulyo ulwa lunweno, uubiye nao lubali lwa ku kuso.”

english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”
translation: Ubuso 11:4

english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
translation: Nao malaika uwalelanda na ine anjasuka ati, “Bushe kanshi tawishibe, mwa?”

english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Malaika alinjebele ukuya fisha ili shiwi lyakwa Yawe kuli Serubabeli ilyakuti, “Te ku maka nangu ku bulamba cikacitika iyoo, lelo ni ku Mupashi wandi.” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita

english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
translation: “Niwe ani we lupili ulukalamba? Ku cinso cakwa Serubabeli iwe ukabatama nge wanga. Kabili eukabikako ne libwe lyapakulekelesha, ilyo ninshi na bantu bakalapunda abati, ‘Eya. Lesa napaale. Lesa napaale.’”

english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe na limbi lyaishile kuli ine aliti.

english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
translation: “Serubabeli natampa ukukuula umufula wa ŋanda yandi, no kupwisha eukapwisha. Ilyo ikapwa, elyo abantu bandi bakashininkisha ukuti kanshi nine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nakutumine uko bali.

english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
translation: Kabili naliloleshe, lyena namonafye icitabo icipombwa cilelelemba mu mulu.

english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
translation: Elyo ine naipusha malaika uo twalelanda nankwe nati, “Nikwi baletwala umuseke?”

english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
translation: Nao asuka ati, “Ni kukuya ukuulila iŋanda mu calo ca Babilonia . Iyo ŋanda nga yapwa, bakakuula na apakuteka umuseke wine.”

english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
translation: Elyo malaika anjipusha ati, “Finshi wamona?”

english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
translation: Nao epakunjeba ati, “Pali cilya citabo epalembelwe icitipu icakulapisha icalo conse. Lubali lumo ulwa citabo palembelwe ukuti umupupu onsefye bakamutamfyamo mu calo, na lubali lubiye ulwa citabo palembelwe ukuti umuntu onsefye uulapa ubufi bakamutamfya.

english: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita alesosa ukuti, ‘Nalatuma ici icitipu, kabili cakulalungama mu ŋanda ya mupupu onse, na mu ŋanda ya muntu onse uulapa ubufi mwishina lyandi. Cakulaba mu ŋanda yakwe, cikasuke icitipu cikailofye nakalya nakalya, imbao shaiko na mabwe yaiko.’”

english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”
translation: Malaika uo twalelanda nankwe na pakubala alishile pantanshi, alanjeba ati, “Inuna amenso yobe, no kumona ukuti ni cinshi ici cileisa.”

english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—
translation: Na ine namwipusha nati, “Ngeci ni cinshi?”

english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
translation: Pa museke pene ninshi pali ne nkupiko iya mutofwe. Pa nshita ndetamba, namona ne nkupiko baifumyapo, awe namona no mwanakashi naikala mu museke mwine.

english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.
translation: Malaika ati nokuti, “Uyu mwanakashi, e cishibilo ca bubi bwine.” Elyo malaika alatininkisha umwanakashi wine ulya mu museke, akupikapo ne nkupiko, nayo iyafina.

english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
translation: Na ine napunamina mu mulu, namona na banakashi bambi babili baleisa, balepupukila apo ndi, ninshi bali na mapindo kwati mapindo yakwa kabaso. Awe baisa imisha no museke mu lwelele.

english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
translation: Kabili nainwine amenso no kumona icimonwa na cimbi. Uyo muku wena namwene amaceleta yane yalefuma pakati ka mpili shibili isha mukuba.

english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
translation: “Iwe Sakaria, ukaye buula silifa na golide ukufuma kuli bankole Helidai, na Tobiya, na Yedaia, abo babwelele muli bunkole mu calo ca Babiloni, na pali ubo bwine bushiku ukaye ku ŋanda yakwa Yosia mwana Sefania.

english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
translation: Ukaye buula silifa na golide ukapangemo ingala yabufumu, ukafwike na shimapepo mukalamba Yoshua mwana Yehosadaki.

english: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.
translation: Ukamwebe ukuti ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita ndesosa nati, ‘Ala euyu muntu etwa Umusambo. Musambo akakulila apa pene ali, na ine wine ne Yawe eukankuulila cipya cipya Itempele lyandi.

english: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
translation: Eukankuulila Itempele lyandi ine ne Yawe, kabili akacindama nge mfumu ya calo, akalateeka na bantu bakwe. Akakwatapo shimapepo umo uukalaiminina ku cipuna cakwe icabufumu, bonse babili bakalaumfwana no kulabombela capamo mu mutelelwe.’

english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.
translation: Iyo ngala yabufumu eikaba icibukisho mwi Tempele lyakwa Yawe, icakwibukishishako Helidai, na Tobiya, na Yedaia, na Yosia, na Heni wine mwana Sefania.”

english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.
translation: Iceleta lyapakubala ni bakabalwe abakashika ebalelitinta, ilyabubili ni bakabalwe abafiita ebalelitinta.

english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.
translation: Ilyabutatu ni bakabalwe ababuuta ebalelitinta, ilyabune lyena ni bakabalwe abamabala mabala ebalelitinta. Aba bakabalwe bonsefye bali abamaka.

english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
translation: Ubuso 6:4

english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
translation: Nao malaika anjasuka ati, “Iyi e myela ine iya ku mulu, iyilefuma pa cinso ca Mfumu umwine we sonde lyonse.

english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
translation: Iceleta lilya lili na bakabalwe abafiita, lileya lubali lwa ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ilili na bakabalwe ababuuta, lilungeme ku calo ca ku masamba, lilya lili na bakabalwe abamabala mabala lilungeme ku calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kulyo.”

english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
translation: Bakabalwe ilyo bamoneke, bena balifye abakalabana pakuya kukulonda isonde. Malaika nao epakubeba ati, “Aleni akuyeni, kalondeni isonde.” Kanshi nabo epakuya mwisonde lyonse.

english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
translation: Elyo kabinge malaika anjita ati, “Wamona, balya bele lubali lwa ku calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso, ebatalalike Umupashi wandi mu calo ca ku kapinda ka ku kuso.”

english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli ine aliti.

english: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe lyaishile kuli Sakaria mu mwaka walengele ine apo Dariusi abelele pa bufumu. Cali ni pa bushiku bwalenga shine ilyo umweshi walenga pabula watampile, umweshi wine uo baleita Kisilefu.

english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
translation: Mwilacusha bamukamfwilwa na bakashiwa na beni abenafyalo abaikala uko muli, mwilacusha na balanda bene. Kabili mwilapanga mu mitima yenu ukulacushanya.’”

english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
translation: Lelo kwena abantu nabo kwitolo balakaana ukulaumfwa, bena babafye abaumalala, no kukanaposako amano kuli ifi fyonse.

english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.
translation: Imitima yabo balayumika ndi nge libwe, tebakufwaya na kulaumfwa, nangu ukulasakamana kufyo Yawe umwine wa fita alebafunda, ilyo aletuma Umupashi wakwe kuli bakasesema bantanshi, pakuti balesesema amashiwi yakwe ukutulafye na ku kale. Kanshi Yawe umwine wa fita nao epakulafulwa nganshi.

english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;
translation: Yawe umwine wa fita epakusosa ukuti, “Lilya naitile tabaleumfwa, kanshi nabo ilyo baitile nshabomfwile.

english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
translation: Lelo nabasalangenye kuli kankungwe mu mishobo yonse iya benafyalo, bantu abo bashaishibe nabo tababeshibe. Efyo ne calo panuma cashele amatololo icakuti takwali umuntu uwakuyamo nangu ukufumamo. Ifi efyo balengele ici icalo icali icisuma ukushala amatololo.”

english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,
translation: Abantu ba mu mushi wa Betele kanshi balitumine Sharese na Regemu Meleki na bantu babo kukuya papata kuli Yawe.

english: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
translation: Baisa kukwipushako bashimapepo na bakasesema bakwa Yawe umwine wa fita abati, “Bushe tuli nokubikapofye ukulaloosha no kulafunga ukulya mu mweshi walenga busano nga fintu tucita lyonse mu myaka iyi yapita?”

english: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,
translation: Elyo ishiwi lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
translation: “Ipusha abantu bonse mu calo, ebako na bashimapepo bene, ukuti, ‘ilyo muleleka ukulya ne lintu muleloosha mu mweshi walenga cisano no walenga cine lubali, pa myaka yonse iyi amakumi cine lubali (70) iyapita, awe ukuleka ukulya kwenu takwalelola kukucindika ine iyoo.

english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
translation: Ilyo mulelya ne lintu mulenwa, mulefwayafye ukulaipakisha mwe bene, epela.’

english: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
translation: Bushe aya te mashiwi Yawe asosele ukupitila muli bakasesema bantanshi ilyo mu Yerusalemu ne misumba iyashinguluka baikele ku matwi tondolo kabili mu bunonshi, ninshi na bantu balikala mu Negebu na mu calo ca mpili?”

english: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
translation: Nakabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita lyaishile kuli Sakaria ilyakutila,

english: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, ‘Ine ndemukonkomesha imwe ukulaputula imilandu no mulinganya wine wine. Muleba ne cikuuku no luse ku banenu.

english: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita lyaishile kuli ine aliti,

english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.
translation: Ilyo iyo nshita tayali tailafika, tabalepeela abantu amalipilo nangu amalipilo ya pa fitekwa. Na bantu balefilwa ukulabomba imilimo yabo pa mulandu wakutiina abalwani babo, pantu ine nalelwikanya abantu bonse.

english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: Nomba pali ino nshita, mwe bantu mwe bashelepo, ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita nomba nshakulamucita ngefyo nalemucita kale.” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita

english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
translation: “Imwe mwakulaibyalila imbuto ku matwi tondolo. Imyangashi yenu yakulatwala ifitwalo, no mushili nao wakulamesha ifisabo, kwakulaba ne mfula iyingi. Ifi fyonse efyo ine nakulamupeela imwe mwe bantu mwe bashelepo nge cabupyani cenu.

english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
translation: Mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda na imwe mwe ba ŋanda yakwa Israeli, kale abenafyalo balebuula ishina lyenu, elyo balelumbula pakutipwila bambi. Nomba ine nkamupususha, muli nokuba abapaalwa. Kanshi imwe shipenifye, mwilatiina iyoo, lelo lekeni amaboko yenu yakose.”

english: For the LORD of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Ilyo ifikolwe fyenu fyankalifye umutima, ine nalipangile ukufiponesha ifinkunka, no kubwesha nshabweseshe mutima iyoo.” Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.
translation: “Eico nomba muli shino nshiku nimpanga ukulasenamina abena Yerusalemu na ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda. Kanshi mwilatunsha na mitima iyoo.

english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,
translation: Ifyo imwe muli nokulacitafye nifi. Mulelanshanya ifyacishinka. Mu filye muleputulamo imilandu no mulinganya wine wine uwakuletapo icibote.

english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.
translation: Mwilapanga mu mitima yenu ukucusha abanenu. Mwilalapa bufi, pantu ifi fyonse ine nalifipata.” Efyo Yawe alanda.

english: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
translation: Kabili ishiwi lyakwa Yawe umwine wa fita lyaishile kuli ine ilyakuti,

english: The LORD of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”
translation: “Ukuleka ukulya uko imwe mucita mu mweshi walenga ine, na mu mweshi walenga isano, na mu mweshi walenga cine lubali elyo na mu mweshi walenga ikumi limo, kukalaba inshikunkulu shakusansamuka no kwangamo ku ba ŋanda yakwa Yuda. Kanshi imwe muletemwafye ifyacishinka no kulaikala umutelelwe.”

english: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
translation: “Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, ‘Nalikwatila Sioni ubufuba ubukalamba, ecilenga nokuti ndemufulilwa apakalamba nganshi.’

english: The LORD of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
translation: Kabili ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Kukaba inshita imo ilyo abantu abengi bakalaisa kuno Yerusalemu, pamo na bantu abakalatula mu misumba iyingi.

english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies. I will go also.’
translation: Aba mu musumba umo bakalaeba aba mu musumba ubiye abati, ‘Bane twendeni bonse capamo kukupepa Yawe, natuye papata Yawe umwine wa fita pakuti atupaaleko. Na ine wine ndeya.’

english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD.”
translation: Kanshi abantu ba mishobo iyingi kabili iyamaka bakalaisa kuno Yerusalemu kukupepa Yawe umwine wa fita, no kumupapata pakuti alebapaalako.”

english: The LORD of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
translation: Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, “Muli shilya nshiku abenafyalo ikumi limo ukufuma ku mishobo ya ndimi ishalekana lekana shonse, bakalaisa ku Muyuda umo ninshi nabekata ku cakufwala cakwe no kulamweba abati, ‘Tulefwaya tuye nobe, pantu ifwe twalyumfwa ukuti Lesa aba na imwe.’”

english: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
translation: “Ifi efyo Yawe asosa ati, ‘Ine nkabwelela ku Sioni no kwikala mu Yerusalemu emo nkalaikala. Lyena Yerusalemu akalaitwa umusumba wacishinka, no lupili lwandi ine ne Yawe umwine wa fita lukalaitwa ulupili lwamushilo.’

english: The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.
translation: Kabili Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, ‘Mu mansa sha mu Yerusalemu nakabili mukalaikala abakote abaume na banakashi, ilyo ninshi bakongamine ku nkonto shabo pa mulandu wakukotesha.

english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
translation: Na mu misebo yauko mukalaisula paa utulumendo no tukashana utukalayangalamo.’

english: The LORD of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says the LORD of Armies.
translation: “Ifi efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, ‘Nangu pali iyo nshita ico cintu cikamoneka icipeshamano ku bantu ba uyu mutundu abakashalapo, awe kuli ine tacakabe cipeshamano nakalya.’ Efyasosa Yawe umwine wa fita.

english: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.
translation: “Ifi efyo Yawe umwine wa fita asosa ati, ‘Ine nkapususha abantu bandi, nkabafumya mu fyalo fya ku kabanga, na mu fyalo fya ku masamba,

english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”
translation: nkababwesha, bakese ikala na mu Yerusalemu. Bakaba abantu abandifye, na ine nkaba Lesa uwabofye. Nkalabateeka bwino ne cishinka no bulungami.’”

english: The LORD of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
translation: Ifi efyo asosa Yawe umwine wa fita ati, “Kosheni amaboko imwe mwe bomfwa muli shino nshiku amashiwi ya bakasesema, ukufuma pa bushiku babikile umufula wa ŋanda yakwa Yawe umwine wa fita, pakuti Itempele likulwe

english: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe eili ilyakutila,

english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
translation: Mu calo cakwa Efulemu ine nkafumyamo amaceleta ya nkondo,

english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
translation: Nomba pa mulandu wa mulopa wa cipangano candi ico napangene nenu,

english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
translation: Bwelelenimo imwe ku musumba we linga, mwe bafungwa ababa ne subilo,

english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
translation: Yawe akamonekela pa mulu wa bantu bakwe,

english: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
translation: Kanshi ilyo ubo bushiku bukafika,

english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
translation: Yangu ifyo bakalamoneka ubusuma no kuyemba.

english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
translation: Icalo ca Hamati icapakana ne calo ca Hadiraki, naco cine cakwe,

english: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
translation: Yoeli 3:4-8

english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
translation: Aba mu Ashikeloni bakalaimwena na menso yabo no mwenso ukabekata.

english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
translation: Amosi 1:6-8

english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
translation: Tabakalelya nakabili inama iyabamo umulopa,

english: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
translation: Lyena, ine ne Yawe nkalasunga icalo candi,

english: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
translation: Amosi 1:9-10

english: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
translation: Ishiwi lyakwa Yawe ilyaishile kuli Sefania mwana Kushi uwali mwana Gedalia, na Gedalia nao ali ni mwana Amaria, uwali mwana wa mfumu Hesekia, pa nshita Yosia umwana wa mfumu Amoni ateekele icalo ca Yuda.

english: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
translation: Yawe asosa ati,

english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
translation: Ilyo mukomfwa ifi fintu mukapumepo imisowa

english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”
translation: Pali iyo inshita ine nkabuula ifisaniko,

english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
translation: Ala ifyuma fyabo fikatapwa,

english: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
translation: Ubushiku ubukalamba ubwakwa Yawe nabupalama,

english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
translation: Bulya bushiku bukaba ubushiku bwabukali,

english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.
translation: Ubushiku ubwakulisha ipenga ne nkuuta sha bulwi,

english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
translation: Ine nkaletela abantu ubulanda,

english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
translation: Nangu ni silifa wabo na golide wabo takakwate maka yakubapusushako,

english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
translation: Yawe alisosele ati,

english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
translation: nkalofya abantu bonse,

english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
translation: “Ine nkakanda abena Yuda

english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,
translation: Nkalofya bonse abaya pa mitenge

english: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.
translation: Nkalofya bonse abansangukila,

english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
translation: Ubushiku bwakwa Yawe nabupalama,

english: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.
translation: Yawe aletila ati, “Pali ubo bushiku ubwe lambo lyandi,

english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
translation: Pali ubo ubushiku nkakanda bonse abaciluka pa mwinshi ilyo baleingila,

english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
translation: Longaneni pamo, longaneni pamo,

english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.
The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
translation: Yawe akaba uwakutiinya

english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.
translation: Na imwe mwe bena Kushi,

english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
translation: Amosi 1:13-15

english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.
translation: Imikuni ya mpaanga, imbushi ne ŋombe efikalalalamo

english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.
translation: ilyo inshita iyapimwa tailafika,

english: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.
translation: Fwayeni Yawe imwe bonse mwe baicefya pano calo,

english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.
translation: Mu Gaza tamwakashale umuntu nangu umo,

english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.
translation: Saka 9:5-7

english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
translation: Amosi 1:6-8

english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.
translation: Cikaba cuma ca bakashalapo aba mu ŋanda yakwa Yuda.

english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.
translation: Nalyumfwa insele shakwa Moabu,

english: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.
translation: “Eico, napalifye ine ne Mumi,”

english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
translation: Walishama we musumba uwatalama,

english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
translation: Abantu bandi abampepa,

english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
translation: Mu bushiku bulya, we musumba, tawakabe na nsoni

english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
translation: Lelo muli iwe nkashamofye abantu abafuuka, kabili abanakilila,

english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
translation: Abakashalamo mu bena Israeli tabakalecita ulufyengo,

english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
translation: Imba ne nsansa we Mwana mwanakashi wa Sioni.

english: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
translation: Yawe nafumyapo ifyo akupingwile,

english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
translation: Mu bushiku bulya bakasosa mu Yerusalemu abati,

english: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
translation: Yawe Lesa obe ali mukati kobe,

english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
translation: nga pa nshita ya nshikunkulu iyasontwa.”

english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
translation: Mona inshita ikesa ilyo nkemina bonse abakucusha,

english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.
translation: Taumfwa kabili taupokelela na mafunde nakalya.

english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
translation: Inshita ikesa ilyo nkamulonganya,

english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
translation: Intungulushi ishabamo ni nkalamo ishilebuluma,

english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
translation: Bakasesema bauko ni bacilande lande,

english: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
translation: Lelo Yawe uwaba mu musumba, acitamofye ifyabololoke,

english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
translation: Yawe aletila ati,

english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
translation: Naletila nati, ‘Nomba abantu bakulantiina,

english: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
translation: Eico Yawe aletila ati, “Cisuma mulolelefye.

english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
translation: Elyo nkapilibula imisosele ya bantu ba mishobo yonse,

english:
Goat, Dog, and Cow
were great friends. One
day they went on a
journey in a taxi.
translation: Imbushi, Imbwa ne ŋombe baali fibusa saana. Ubushiku bumo baile pa bulendo muli motoka.

english:
When they reached the
end of their journey, the
driver asked them to
pay their fares. Cow
paid her fare.
translation: Ilyo baafikile uko baaleya, namutekenya aabebele ukulipila indalama. Iŋombe yalilipiile.

english:
Dog paid a bit extra,
because he did not
have the correct money.
translation: Imbwa yaalipile indalama iikalamba pantu tayakwete indalama iinoono.

english:
The driver was about to
give Dog his change
when Goat ran away
without paying
anything.
translation: Namutekenya cilya aalimukupeela Imbwa cenji, Imbushi yabutuka ukwabula ukulipila nangu lumo.

english:
The driver was very
annoyed. He drove
away without giving
Dog his change.
translation: Namutekenya tepakufulwa. Efyo aenseshe motoka ukwabula ukubwesesha Imbwa cenji.

english:
That is why, even
today, Dog runs
towards a car to peep
inside and find the
driver who owes him his
change.
translation: Eco, mpaka na leelo, Imbwa ipepekela motoka pakuti imone mukati nga cakuti namutekenya uwaikwatila indalama emwali.

english:
Goat runs away from
the sound of a car. She
is afraid she will be
arrested for not paying
her fare.
translation: Imbushi ilabutuka iciunda ca motoka. Ilatiina ukuikata pa mulandu wa kukaana lipila indalama.

english:
And Cow is not
bothered when a car is
coming. Cow takes her
time crossing the road
because she knows she
paid her fare in full.
translation: Elyo Iŋombe yena taisakamana nangu motoka ileisa. Yendafye cilumba-cilumba pa kuciluka umusebo nangu motoka ileisa pantu yalishiba ukuti yalilipila indalama shonse.

english:
Long long ago people didn’t
know anything. They didn’t
know how to plant crops, or
how to weave cloth, or how to
make iron tools.
The god Nyame up in the sky
had all the wisdom of the world.
He kept it safe in a clay pot.
translation: Mu nshita yakale saana, abantu tabaishibe nangu cimo. Tabaishibe ifyakubyala ifilimwa nangu ukupikula, nangu ukupanga ifibombelo fya fyela. Leesa Nyame uwali mu muulu umutali ewakwete amaano yonse mu caalo. Aayasungile mu nongo.

english:
One day, Nyame decided that
he would give the pot of
wisdom to Anansi.
Every time Anansi looked in the
clay pot, he learned something
new. It was so exciting!
translation: Ubushiku bumo, Nyame apeele Anansi inongo ya maano. Lyonse ilyo Anansi aalelolesha mu nongo, alesambililamo icintu cimo icipya. Caliweme nganshi.

english:
Greedy Anansi thought, “I’ll
keep the pot safe at the top of a
tall tree. Then I can have it all
to myself!”
He spun a long thread, wound it
round the clay pot, and tied it to
his stomach.
He began to climb the tree. But
it was hard climbing the tree
with the pot bumping him in the
knees all the time.
translation: Anansi mu kuitemwa, aatontonkenye ati, “Ndesungila inongo pa muulu wa muti uutali pakuti tailubile. Lyena ninshi ikabafye yandi neeka!” Apikula intambo iitali, aipomba ku nongo no kuikaka pa mala. Atampa no kuniina ku cimuti. Nomba cali icayafya ukuniina icimuti ne nongo pantu yalemupunka mu makufi cila nshita.

english:
All the time Anansi’s young son
had been standing at the
bottom of the tree watching. He
said, “Wouldn’t it be easier to
climb if you tied the pot to your
back instead?”
Anansi tried tying the clay pot
full of wisdom to his back, and it
really was a lot easier.
translation: Inshita yonse ii, umulumendo umwana uwakwa Anansi aiminiine mwisamba lya muti aletamba. Epakusosa ati, “Bushe teeti cangukeko nga mwakakiliile inongo panuma?” Efyo Anansi aeseshe ukukaka inongo ya maano panuma, awe no kwanguka cayanguka.

english:
In no time he reached the top of
the tree.
But then he stopped and
thought, “I’m supposed to be
the one with all the wisdom,
and here my son was cleverer
than me!”
Anansi was so angry about this
that he threw the clay pot down
out of the tree.
translation: Ukwabula ukupoosa ne nshita afika na pamuulu wa muti. Nomba atala iiminina no kutontonkaya ati, “Nine mfwile ukukwata amaano yonse, nomba apa umwana wandi akwatapo amaano ukuncila!” Anansi afulwa icibi. Apoosa ne nongo panshi ya cimuti.

english:
It smashed into pieces on the
ground. The wisdom was free
for everyone to share.

And that is how people learned
to farm, to weave cloth, to
make iron tools, and all the
other things that people know
how to do.
translation: Iŋongo yapona panshi yatobaika. Amaano nomba yabafye ya muntu onse. Ukufuma apo, efyo abantu baishibe ukulima, ukupikula no kufula ifishimbi na fimbipo ifyo abantu baishiba ukucita pali leelo.

english: I am singing.
translation: Ndeimba.

english: She is waving.
translation: Aleebaibisha.

english: I am clapping.
translation: Ndetoota.

english: She is stretching.
translation: Aleeyolola.

english: He is calling.
translation: Aleita.

english: I am answering.
translation: Ndeyasuka.

english: She is listening.
translation: Aleekutika.

english: What are you doing?
translation: Finshi uleecita?

english: Where is my cat?
translation: Puushi wandi alikwisa?

english: Is it under the bed?
translation: Bushe ali mwisamba lya busanshi?

english: Is it on top of the cupboard?
translation: Bushe ali pa muulu wa kabati?

english: Is it behind the couch?
translation: Bushe ali kunuma ya cipuna?

english: Is it next to the bin?
translation: Bushe ali mupepi na iŋungulu?

english: Is it inside the basket?
translation: Bushe ali muli bashiketi?

english: Is it outside the house?
translation: Bushe ali panse ya ŋanda?

english: Here it is!
translation: Uyu ali kuno!

english:
My village had many problems.

We made a long line to fetch water from one tap.
translation: Mu mushi wandi mwali amafya ayengi. Twalitantame umulongo pakuti twingatapa ameenshi kuli pompi umo.

english: We waited for food donated by others.
translation: Twaleeloleela ifyakulya ifyakupeelwa ukufuma ku bantu bambi.

english: We locked our houses early because of thieves.
translation: Twaleekoma amayanda yesu bwangu pa mulandu wa bapuupu.

english: Many children dropped out of school.
translation: Abaana abengi balilekele isukulu.

english: Young girls worked as maids in other villages.
translation: Utukashana twaleebomba incito ya kuwamya mu mayanda mu mishi imbi.

english: Young boys roamed around the village while others worked on people’s farms.
translation: Utulumenda twaleyangala mu mushi ninshi bambi baleebombela mu mabala.

english: When the wind blew, waste paper hung on trees and fences.
translation: Umwela nga wapuupa, ifipepala bapoosa fyalesama ku miti na ku malinga.

english: People were cut by broken glass that was thrown carelessly.
translation: Abantu baleicena ku mabotolo ayatobeka ayaleeposwa iciposweposwe.

english: Then one day, the tap dried up and our containers were empty.
translation: Ubushiku bumo, ameenshi yapwa kupompi ne fipe fyesu tafyakwete ameenshi.

english: My father walked from house to house asking people to attend a village meeting.
translation: Bataata baile cila ŋanda mukuwita abantu ukwisasangwa ku cilye ca mushi.

english: People gathered under a big tree and listened.
translation: Abantu baishileikala mwisamba lya muti no kukutika.

english: My father stood up and said, “We need to work together to solve our problems.”
translation: Bataata epakwima abati, “Tufwile ukubombela pamo pakuti tupwishe amafya yesu.”

english: Eight-year-old Juma, sitting on a tree trunk shouted, “I can help with cleaning up.”
translation: Umwana wamyaka cine-konse-konse uweshina lya Juma, uwaikele pa mulando abilikisha ati, “Kuti nabombako umulimo wa kuwamya.”

english: One woman said, “The women can join me to grow food.”
translation: Namaayo umo ati, “Banamaayo kuti twabombela pamo ukulima ifyakulya.”

english: Another man stood up and said, “The men will dig a well.”
translation: Shitaata umbi aiminina ati, “Bashitaata bakemba icishima.”

english:
We all shouted with one voice, “We must change our lives.”

From that day we worked together to solve our problems.
translation: Bonse twapundila pamo atuti, “Tufwile ukwalula imikalile yesu.” Ukufuma bulya bushiku twabombele pamo mukupwisha amafya yesu.

english:
My heart feels a lot of
things.
translation: Umutima wandi ulomfwa ifintu ifingi.

english:
I feel happy when my
granny tells us stories
in the evening.
translation: Ndatemwa nga bamaama baleetushimikila utushimi ubushiku.

english:
I feel silly when I play
with my friend.
translation: Ndomfwa ukusaamwa nga ndeyangala no munandi.

english:
I feel bad when my dad
says he does not have
money.
translation: Nshumfwa bwino bataata nga batiila tabakwete indalama.

english:
I feel loved when my
mom gives me a hug.
translation: Ndomfwa ukutemwikwa nga bamaayo bankumbatila.

english:
When Simbegwire’s mother died,
she was very sad. Simbegwire’s
father did his best to take care of
his daughter. Slowly, they learned
to feel happy again, without
Simbegwire’s mother.
Every morning they sat and talked
about the day ahead. Every evening
they made dinner together. After
they washed the dishes,
Simbegwire’s father helped her with
homework.
translation: Lintu banyina Simbegwire baafwile, aali uwabulanda saana. Bawishi balyesesha na maka yonse ukumusunga bwino no kumusansamusha. Panoono-panoono, baatampile ukusansamuka na kabili, nangu banyina Simbegwire bashalipo. Cila lucelo baleikala pamo no kulanda pafya ubo bushiku buleba. Cila cungulo baaleepekanya umulalilo bonse. Panuma ya kusamfya imbale, bawishi Simbegwire baaleafwako umwana imilimo yaku sukulu.

english:
One day, Simbegwire’s father came
home later than usual. “Where are
you my child?” he called.
Simbegwire ran to her father. She
stopped still when she saw that he
was holding a woman’s hand. “I
want you to meet someone special,
my child. This is Anita,” he said
smiling.
translation: Ubushiku bumo, bawishi Simbegwire baalicelelwe ukubwela ukucila inshita baalebwelelapo lyonse. Baitile Simbegwire abati, “Ulikwisa we mwana wandi?” Simbegwire aabutukiile kuli bawishi. Aileiminina shika ilyo aamwene bawishi nabekatilila ukuboko kwakwa namaayo. “Mwana wandi, ndefwaya uposhe aba njishile nabo. Niba Anita,” efyalandile bawishi ninshi baalemwentula.

english:
“Hello Simbegwire, your father told
me a lot about you,” said Anita. But
she did not smile or take the girl’s
hand.
Simbegwire’s father was happy and
excited. He talked about the three
of them living together, and how
good their life would be. “My child, I
hope you will accept Anita as your
mother,” he said.
translation: Ba Anita abati, “Mwapola Simbegwire, bawiso balinshimikila ifintu ifingi pali iwe.” Nomba tabamwentwile nangu ukutambika ukuboka ku mwana. Ba wishi Simbegwire baali temwa na ukusansamuka saana. Balandile pafyo bonse batatu bakalaikala pamo, na pafyo imikalile yabo ikawama. Abati, “We mwana wandi, ndesubila ukasumina ba Anita ukuba banoko.”

english:
Simbegwire’s life changed. She no
longer had time to sit with her
father in the mornings. Anita gave
her so many household chores that
she was too tired to do her school
work in the evenings. She went
straight to bed after dinner.
Her only comfort was the colourful
blanket her mother gave her.
Simbegwire’s father did not seem to
notice that his daughter was
unhappy.
translation: Ubwikashi bwakwa Simbegwire bwalicinjishe. Taakwete inshita yakuba na bawishi ulucelo. Ba Anita baaleemupeela incito shapa ŋanda ishingi saana icakuti aaleenaka aaleefilwa no kubomba imilimo yaku sukulu icungulo. Aaleeyafye mu kusendama panuma ya kulya icakulya ca mulalilo. Icaleemusansamushafye buulangeti bwamalangi ubwamupeele banyina. Calemoneka kwati bawishi Simbegwire tabaishibe kuti umwana wabo taasansamwike.

english:
After a few months, Simbegwire’s
father told them that he would be
away from home for a while. “I have
to travel for my job,” he said. “But I
know you will look after each other.”
Simbegwire’s face fell, but her
father did not notice. Anita did not
say anything. She was not happy
either.
translation: Panumafye ya myeshi inoono, bawishi Simbegwire balilaile pa ŋanda ukuti baleefumapo panshita inoono. Abati, “Mfwile ukuya ku ncito. Nomba ninjishiba ukuti mwakulasunganafye bwino.” Simbegwire taasansamwike, nomba bawishi taabaishibe. Ba Anita taabalandile nangu cimo. Nabo tabaatemenwe iyoo.

english:
Things got worse for Simbegwire. If
she didn’t finish her chores, or she
complained, Anita hit her. And at
dinner, the woman ate most of the
food, leaving Simbegwire with only
a few scraps.
Each night Simbegwire cried herself
to sleep, hugging her mother’s
blanket.
translation: Imikalile yakwa Simbegwire yalibiipiileko. Nga tapwishishe incito isha mu ŋganda, nangu nga ailishanya, ba Anita baaleemuuma. Pa mulalilo, Ba Anita eebaaleelya ifyakulya ifingi, baashilakofye Simbegwire utunoono. Cila bushiku Simbegwire aaleelaala alelila ninshi nakumbatila no bulangeti bwaba nyina.

english:
One morning, Simbegwire was late
getting out of bed. “You lazy girl!”
Anita shouted. She pulled
Simbegwire out of bed. The
precious blanket caught on a nail,
and tore in two.
translation: Ubushiku bumo ulucelo, Simbegwire alicelelwe ukubuuka. Ba Anita baapatile ati, “We munaŋani wamwanawe!” Efyo baakulwile Simbegwire ukumufunya pa busanshi. Ubulangeti atemwishishe bwaiketwe ku musomali no kulepuka ukwakanika pabili.

english:
Simbegwire was very upset. She
decided to run away from home.
She took the pieces of her mother’s
blanket, packed some food, and left
the house. She followed the road
her father had taken.
translation: Simbegwire alifulilwe saana. Aasalilepo ukufyuka pa ŋanda. Aasendele utupimfya twa bulangeti bwaba nyina, alonga no twakulya, no kufuma pa ŋanda. Aakonkele umusebo mwapitile bawishi.

english:
When it came to evening, she
climbed a tall tree near a stream
and made a bed for herself in the
branches.
As she went to sleep, she sang:
“Maama, maama, maama, you left
me.
You left me and never came back.
Father doesn’t love me anymore.
Mother, when are you coming back?
You left me.”
translation: Cilya bwaila, aniina ku cimuti icitali mupeepi na kamana no kupanga ubusanshi mu misambo. Pa kulaala, alaimba ati: “Maayo, maayo, maayo, mwalinsha ine. Mwalinsha ukwabula ukubwela. Bataata tabatemwa nomba. Maayo ni lilali mukabwela? Mwalinsha ine.”

english:
The next morning, Simbegwire sang
the song again. When the women
came to wash their clothes at the
stream, they heard the sad song
coming from the tall tree.
They thought it was only the wind
rustling the leaves, and carried on
with their work. But one of the
women listened very carefully to
the song.
translation: Ubushiku bwakonkelepo ulucelo, Simbegwire aimbile ulwimbo na kabili. Ilyo banamaayo baishile mu kucapa ifyakufwala mu mumana, baumfwile ulwimbo lwacililishi lulefumina ku cimuti icitali. Mu maano abati mwela uleelisha amabuula, awe bakonkenyepo ne milimo yabo. Nomba umo pali beena akutikishe ku lwimbo.

english:
This woman looked up into the tree.
When she saw the girl and the
pieces of colourful blanket, she
cried, “Simbegwire, my brother’s
child!”
The other women stopped washing
and helped Simbegwire to climb
down from the tree. Her aunt
hugged the little girl and tried to
comfort her.
translation: Uyu namaayo aalooleshe ku muulu wa cimuti. Lintu aamwene akakashana no tupimfya twa bulangeti ubwamalangi, aapundile ati, “Simbegwire, umwana wakwa ndume yandi!” Banamaayo bambi baaleekele ukucapa bayafwilishako Simbegwire ukwikila ku cimuti. Banyina-senge bakumbatile akakashana no kwesha ukukatalalika.

english:
Simbegwire’s aunt took the child to
her own house. She gave
Simbegwire warm food, and tucked
her in bed with her mother’s
blanket.
That night, Simbegwire cried as she
went to sleep. But they were tears
of relief. She knew her aunt would
look after her.
translation: Banyina-senge baasendele Simbegwire ku ŋanda ku mwabo. Panuma, baamupeele icakulya icakaba, no kumufimbilisha no bulangeti bwaba nyina pa busanshi. Bulya bushiku, Simbegwire aalililile pa kulaala. Nomba fyali fiilamba fyansansa. Aalishibe ukuti banyina-senge bakamusunga bwino.

english:
When Simbegwire’s father returned
home, he found her room empty.
“What happened, Anita?” he asked
with a heavy heart. The woman
explained that Simbegwire had run
away. “I wanted her to respect me,”
she said. “But perhaps I was too
strict.”
Simbegwire’s father left the house
and went in the direction of the
stream. He continued to his sister’s
village to find out if she had seen
Simbegwire.
translation: Ilyo bawishi Simbegwire baabwelele pa ŋanda, baasangile Simbegwire talimo mu muputule wakwe. Baipwishe bulanda-bulanda abati, “Anita, finshi fyacitike?” Namaayo alondolwele ukuti Simbegwire aalifyukile. Ati “Naalefwaya ancindike. Nomba limbi caalicilamo.” Bawishi Simbegwire baafumine pa ŋanda no kulola ku mumana. Bakonkeyepo ukuya ku mushi ukwaleikala bankashi yabo mu kuyaipusha nga cakuti baalimweneko Simbegwire.

english:
Simbegwire was playing with her
cousins when she saw her father
from far away. She was scared he
might be angry, so she ran inside
the house to hide.
But her father went to her and said,
“Simbegwire, you have found a
perfect mother for yourself. One
who loves you and understands
you. I am proud of you and I love
you.”
They agreed that Simbegwire would
stay with her aunt as long as she
wanted to.
translation: Simbegwire aaleyangala na bafyala bakwe ilyo aamwene bawishi akatalamukila. Aalitinine ukuti limbi balikalipe, icalengele ukuti abutukile mu ŋanda mu kubelama.
